Based on this information, we further separate the behaviors in different attack sessions targeting distinct categories of system resources, estimate the temporal relations and summarize their malicious intentions behind. Inspired by such investigations, we present several key insights about abusive behaviors of the file, network, process, and special capability resources, and further propose practical defense strategies to better protect IoT devices.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 近年来，IoT设备频繁遭受攻击，造成了严重影响。先前的研究通过离线样本分析展示了某些特定IoT恶意软件家族或攻击阶段的演变和特征。然而，我们仍然缺乏对活跃攻击者所滥用的各种系统资源及其背后恶意意图的系统性观察。这使得设计适当的保护策略来防御现有攻击和可能的未来变种变得困难。在本文中，我们通过分析由我们专门设计的高交互式IoT蜜罐HoneyAsclepius捕获的117,862个有效攻击会话，并在我们设计的工作流程中进一步发现攻击意图，从而填补了这一空白。HoneyAsclepius在活跃攻击会话期间实现了高捕获能力以及实时持续行为监控。通过大规模部署，我们收集了来自50,594个不同攻击者的11,301,239个恶意行为。基于这些信息，我们进一步区分针对不同类别系统资源的各类攻击会话中的行为，估计时间关系并总结其背后的恶意意图。受这些调查启发，我们提出了关于文件、网络、进程和特殊能力资源滥用行为的关键见解，并进一步提出了实用的防御策略以更好地保护IoT设备。

upstream_only.title: Enriching Compiler Testing with Real Program from Bug Report
upstream_only.abstract: Researchers have proposed various approaches to generate test programs. The state-of-the-art approaches can be roughly divided into random-based and mutation-based approaches: random-based approaches generate random programs and mutation-based approaches mutate programs to generate more test programs. Both lines of approaches mainly generate random code, but it is more beneficial to use real programs, since it is easier to learn the impacts of compiler bugs and it becomes reasonable to use both valid and invalid code. However, most real programs from code repositories are ineffective to trigger compiler bugs, partially because they are compiled before they are submitted. In this experience paper, we apply two techniques such as differential testing and code snippet extraction to the specific research domain of compiler testing. Based on our observations on the practice of testing compilers, we identify bug reports of compilers as a new source for compiler testing. To illustrate the benefits of the new source, we implement a tool, called LeRe, that extracts test programs from bug reports and uses differential testing to detect compiler bugs with extracted programs. After we enriched the test programs, we have found 156 unique bugs in the latest versions of gcc and clang. Among them, 103 bugs are confirmed as valid, and 9 bugs are already fixed. Our found bugs contain 59 accept-invalid bugs and 33 reject-valid bugs. In these bugs, compilers wrongly accept invalid programs or reject valid programs. The new source enables us detecting accept-invalid and reject-valid bugs that were usually missed by the prior approaches. The prior approaches seldom report the two types of bugs. Besides our found bugs, we also present our analysis on our invalid bug reports. The results are useful for programmers, when they are switching from one compiler to another, and can provide insights, when researchers apply differential testing to detect bugs in more types of software.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 研究人员提出了多种生成测试程序的方法。最先进的方法大致可分为基于随机生成和基于变异两类：基于随机的方法生成随机程序，基于变异的方法对程序进行变异以产生更多测试程序。这两类方法主要生成随机代码，但使用真实程序更有益，因为更容易了解编译器bug的影响，并且使用有效和无效代码都变得合理。然而，来自代码库的大多数真实程序很难触发编译器bug，部分原因是它们在提交前已被编译过。在这篇经验论文中，我们将差分测试和代码片段提取两种技术应用于编译器测试这一特定研究领域。基于我们在编译器测试实践中的观察，我们将编译器的bug报告确定为编译器测试的新来源。为了说明新来源的优势，我们实现了一个名为LeRe的工具，从bug报告中提取测试程序，并使用差分测试来检测提取程序中的编译器bug。在丰富测试程序后，我们在gcc和clang的最新版本中发现了156个独特bug。其中103个被确认为有效，9个已修复。我们发现的bug包括59个“接受无效程序”bug和33个“拒绝有效程序”bug。在这些bug中，编译器错误地接受无效程序或拒绝有效程序。这一新来源使我们能够检测到以往方法通常会错过的接受无效和拒绝有效类bug。以往的方法很少报告这两类bug。除了我们发现的bug，我们还对无效bug报告进行了分析。这些结果有助于程序员在不同编译器之间切换，并且当研究人员将差分测试应用于检测更多类型软件中的bug时，可以提供洞见。

upstream_only.title: Evolving Ranking-Based Failure Proximities for Better Clustering in Fault Isolation
upstream_only.abstract: Failures that are not related to a specific fault can reduce the effectiveness of fault localization in multi-fault scenarios. To tackle this challenge, researchers and practitioners typically cluster failures (e.g., failed test cases) into several disjoint groups, with those caused by the same fault grouped together. In such a fault isolation process that requires input in a mathematical form, ranking-based failure proximity (R-proximity) is widely used to model failed test cases. In R-proximity, each failed test case is represented as a suspiciousness ranking list of program statements through a fingerprinting function (i.e., a risk evaluation formula, REF). Although many off-the-shelf REFs have been integrated into R-proximity, they were designed for single-fault localization originally. To the best of our knowledge, no REF has been developed to serve as a fingerprinting function of R-proximity in multi-fault scenarios. For better clustering failures in fault isolation, in this paper, we present a genetic programming-based framework along with a sophisticated fitness function, for evolving REFs with the goal of more properly representing failures in multi-fault scenarios. By using a small set of programs for training, we get a collection of REFs that can obtain good results applicable in a larger and more general scale of scenarios. The best one of them outperforms the state-of-the-art by 50.72\% and 47.41\% in faults number estimation and clustering effectiveness, respectively. Our framework is highly configurable for further use, and the evolved formulas can be directly applied in future failure representation tasks without any retraining.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在多功能故障场景中，与特定故障无关的失败会降低故障定位的有效性。为解决这一挑战，研究人员和实践者通常将失败（例如失败测试用例）聚类成多个不相交的组，将同一故障导致的失败归入同一组。在需要数学形式输入的故障隔离过程中，基于排名的失败相似度（R-proximity）被广泛用于建模失败测试用例。在R-proximity中，每个失败测试用例通过一个指纹函数（即风险评估公式，REF）表示为程序语句可疑度的排名列表。尽管许多现成的REF已集成到R-proximity中，但它们最初是为单故障定位而设计的。据我们所知，在多功能故障场景中，尚未有REF被开发用作R-proximity的指纹函数。为了在故障隔离中更好地聚类失败，本文提出了一个基于遗传编程的框架，并配有精心设计的适应度函数，旨在演化为更适合多功能故障场景中失败表示的REF。通过使用少量程序进行训练，我们获得了一组能够在更大规模、更通用场景下取得良好结果的REF。其中最佳公式在故障数量估计和聚类有效性方面分别比现有最优方法提高50.72%和47.41%。我们的框架高度可配置，便于进一步使用，演化出的公式可直接用于未来的失败表示任务，无需重新训练。

upstream_only.title: Exploiting Epochs and Symmetries in Analysing MPI Programs
upstream_only.abstract: Communication nondeterminism is one of the main reasons for the intractability of verification of message passing concurrency. In many practical message passing programs, the non-deterministic communication structure is symmetric and decomposed into epochs to obtain efficiency. Thus, symmetries and epoch structure can be exploited to reduce verification complexity. In this paper, we present a dynamic-symbolic runtime verification technique for single-path MPI programs, which (i) exploits communication symmetries by way of specifying symmetry breaking predicates (SBP) and (ii) performs compositional verification based on epochs. On the one hand, SBPs prevent the symbolic decision procedure from exploring isomorphic parts of the search space, and on the other hand, epochs restrict the size of a program needed to be analyzed at a point in time. We show that our analysis is sound and complete for single-path MPI programs on a given input. Using our prototype tool SIMIAN, we further demonstrate that our approach leads to (i) a significant reduction in verification times and (ii) scaling up to larger benchmark sizes compared to prior trace verifiers.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 通信非确定性是消息传递并发验证难以处理的主要原因之一。在许多实际的传递消息程序中，非确定性通信结构是对称的，并被分解为阶段（epoch）以提高效率。因此，可以利用对称性和阶段结构来降低验证复杂度。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于单路径MPI程序的动态符号化运行时验证技术，该技术（i）通过指定对称性破缺谓词（SBP）来利用通信对称性，（ii）基于阶段执行组合验证。一方面，SBP防止符号决策过程探索搜索空间的同构部分；另一方面，阶段限制了在某一时间点需要分析的程序规模。我们证明，对于给定输入上的单路径MPI程序，我们的分析是可靠且完备的。利用我们的原型工具SIMIAN，我们进一步证明，与先前的迹验证器相比，我们的方法能够(i)显著减少验证时间，(ii)扩展到更大的基准规模。

upstream_only.title: Finding and Understanding Incompleteness Bugs in SMT Solvers
upstream_only.abstract: We propose Janus, an approach for finding incompleteness bugs in SMT solvers. The key insight is to mutate SMT formulas with local weakening and strengthening rules that preserve the satisfiability of the seed formula. The generated mutants are used to test SMT solvers for incompleteness bugs, i.e., inputs on which SMT solvers unexpectedly return unknown. We realized Janus on top of the SMT solver fuzzing framework YinYang. From June to August 2021, we stress-tested the two state-of-the-art SMT solvers Z3 and CVC5 with Janus and totally reported 31 incompleteness bugs. Out of these, 26 have been confirmed as unique bugs and 19 are already fixed by the developers. Our diverse bug findings uncovered functional, regression, and performance bugs—several triggered discussions among the developers sharing their in-depth analysis.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了Janus，一种在SMT求解器中查找不完整性缺陷的方法。其关键思想是使用局部弱化和强化规则来变异SMT公式，这些规则保持种子公式的可满足性。生成的变异体用于测试SMT求解器的不完整性缺陷，即SMT求解器意外返回“未知”的输入。我们在SMT求解器模糊测试框架YinYang之上实现了Janus。从2021年6月至8月，我们使用Janus对两个最先进的SMT求解器Z3和CVC5进行了压力测试，总共报告了31个不完整性缺陷。其中26个已被确认为独特缺陷，19个已被开发者修复。我们多样的缺陷发现揭示了功能性、回归性和性能性缺陷——其中几个引发了开发者之间分享深入分析的讨论。

upstream_only.title: FuzzerAid: Grouping Fuzzed Crashes Based On Fault Signatures
upstream_only.abstract: Fuzzing has been an important approach for finding bugs and vulnerabilities in programs. Many fuzzers deployed in industry run daily and can generate an overwhelming number of crashes. Diagnosing such crashes can be very challenging and time-consuming. Existing fuzzers typically employ heuristics such as code coverage or call stack hashes to weed out duplicate reporting of bugs. While these heuristics are cheap, they are often imprecise and end up still reporting many “unique” crashes corresponding to the same bug. In this paper, we present FuzzerAid that uses fault signatures to group crashes reported by the fuzzers. Fault signature is a small executable program and consists of a selection of necessary statements from the original program that can reproduce a bug. In our approach, we first generate a fault signature using a given crash. We then execute the fault signature with other crash inducing inputs. If the failure is reproduced, we classify the crashes into the group labeled with the fault signature; if not, we generate a new fault signature. After all the crash inducing inputs are classified, we further merge the fault signatures of the same root cause into a group. We implemented our approach in a tool called FuzzerAid and evaluated it on 3020 crashes generated from 15 real-world bugs and 4 large open source projects. Our evaluation shows that we are able to correctly group 99.1\% of the crashes and reported only 17 (+2) “unique” bugs, outperforming the state-of-the-art fuzzers.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 模糊测试一直是发现程序和漏洞的重要方法。许多在工业界部署的模糊器每天运行，可能会产生数量惊人的崩溃。诊断这些崩溃可能非常具有挑战性且耗时。现有的模糊器通常采用诸如代码覆盖或调用栈哈希等启发式方法来剔除重复的bug报告。虽然这些启发式方法成本低廉，但它们往往不精确，最终仍会报告许多对应于同一bug的“独特”崩溃。在本文中，我们提出了FuzzerAid，它使用故障签名对模糊器报告的崩溃进行分组。故障签名是一个小的可执行程序，由原始程序中能够重现bug的必要语句组成。我们的方法是：首先使用给定的崩溃生成故障签名，然后用其他崩溃诱导输入执行该故障签名。如果故障重现，我们将这些崩溃归类到以该故障签名标记的组中；如果未重现，则生成新的故障签名。对所有崩溃诱导输入分类后，我们进一步将根因相同的故障签名合并为一组。我们将该方法实现为一个名为FuzzerAid的工具，并在来自15个真实世界bug和4个大型开源项目的3020个崩溃上进行了评估。评估结果表明，我们能够正确地对99.1%的崩溃进行分组，并且仅报告了17个（+2）个“独特”bug，优于最先进的模糊器。

upstream_only.title: Fuzzle: Making a Puzzle for Fuzzers
upstream_only.abstract: With rapidly growing fuzzing technology, there has been surging demand for automatically synthesizing buggy programs. Previous approaches have been focused on injecting bugs into existing programs, making them suffer from providing the ground truth as the generated programs may contain unexpected bugs. In this paper, we address this challenge by casting the bug synthesis problem as a maze generation problem. Specifically, we synthesize a whole buggy program by encoding a sequence of moves in a maze as a chain of function calls. By design, our approach provides the exact ground truth of the synthesized benchmark. Furthermore, it allows generation of benchmarks with realistic path constraints extracted from existing vulnerabilities. We implement our idea in a tool, named Fuzzle, and evaluate it with five state-of-the-art fuzzers to empirically prove its value.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 随着模糊测试技术的迅速发展，对自动合成含缺陷程序的需求日益增长。以往的方法侧重于将缺陷注入现有程序，但这种方式可能因生成的程序包含意外缺陷而难以提供真实参照（ground truth）。在本文中，我们通过将缺陷合成问题转化为迷宫生成问题来应对这一挑战。具体而言，我们将迷宫中一系列移动编码为函数调用链，从而合成一个完整的含缺陷程序。通过设计，我们的方法为合成基准提供了精确的真实参照。此外，它允许从现有漏洞中提取真实的路径约束以生成基准。我们将这一思想实现为名为Fuzzle的工具，并使用五种最先进的模糊测试器进行评估，以实证其价值。

upstream_only.title: Generating Critical Test Scenarios for Autonomous Driving Systems via Influential Behavior Patterns
upstream_only.abstract: Autonomous Driving Systems (ADSs) are safety-critical, and must be fully tested before being deployed on real-world roads. To comprehensively evaluate the performance of ADSs, it is essential to generate various safety-critical scenarios. Most of existing studies assess ADSs either by searching high-dimensional input space, or using simple and pre-defined test scenarios, which are not efficient or not adequate. To better test ADSs, this paper proposes to automatically generate safety-critical test scenarios for ADSs by influential behavior patterns, which are mined from real traffic trajectories. Based on influential behavior patterns, a novel scenario generation technique, CRISCO, is presented to generate safety-critical scenarios for ADSs testing. CRISCO assigns participants to perform influential behaviors to challenge the ADS. It generates different test scenarios by solving trajectory constraints, and improves the challenge of those non-critical scenarios by adding participants’ behavior from influential behavior patterns incrementally. We demonstrate CRISCO on an industrial-grade ADS platform, Baidu Apollo. The experiment results show that our approach can effectively and efficiently generate critical scenarios to crash ADS, and it exposes 13 distinct types of safety violations in 12 hours. It also outperforms two state-of-art ADS testing techniques by exposing more 5 distinct types of safety violations on the same roads.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 自动驾驶系统（ADS）是安全关键的，在部署到真实道路之前必须进行充分测试。为了全面评估ADS的性能，生成各种安全关键的场景至关重要。已有的大多数研究要么通过搜索高维输入空间来评估ADS，要么使用简单且预定义的测试场景，这些方式要么效率不高，要么不够充分。为了更好地测试ADS，本文提出通过影响行为模式（从真实交通轨迹中挖掘）来自动生成安全关键的测试场景。基于影响行为模式，提出了一种新颖的场景生成技术CRISCO，用于生成ADS测试的安全关键场景。CRISCO分配参与者执行影响行为来挑战ADS。它通过求解轨迹约束生成不同的测试场景，并通过从影响行为模式中逐步添加参与者行为来提高非关键场景的挑战性。我们在工业级ADS平台百度Apollo上演示了CRISCO。实验结果表明，我们的方法能有效且高效地生成使ADS崩溃的关键场景，并在12小时内暴露了13种不同类型的安全违规。与两种最先进的ADS测试技术相比，它在相同道路上还多暴露了5种不同类型的安全违规。

upstream_only.title: GLITCH: Automated Polyglot Security Smell Detection in Infrastructure as Code
upstream_only.abstract: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) is the process of managing IT infrastructure via programmable configuration files (also called IaC scripts). Like other software artifacts, IaC scripts may contain security smells, which are coding patterns that can result in security weaknesses. Automated analysis tools to detect security smells in IaC scripts exist, but they focus on specific technologies such as Puppet, Ansible, or Chef. This means that when the detection of a new smell is implemented in one of the tools, it is not immediately available for the technologies supported by the other tools — the only option is to duplicate the effort. This paper presents an approach that enables consistent security smell detection across different IaC technologies. We conduct a large-scale empirical study that analyzes security smells on three large datasets containing 196,755 IaC scripts and 12,281,251 LOC. We show that all categories of security smells are identified across all datasets and we identify some smells that might affect many IaC projects. To conduct this study, we developed GLITCH, a new technology-agnostic framework that enables automated polyglot smell detection by transforming IaC scripts into an intermediate representation, on which different security smell detectors can be defined. GLITCH currently supports the detection of nine different security smells in scripts written in Ansible, Chef, or Puppet. We compare GLITCH with state-of-the-art security smell detectors. The results obtained not only show that GLITCH can reduce the effort of writing security smell analyses for multiple IaC technologies, but also that it has higher precision and recall than the current state-of-the-art tools.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 基础设施即代码（IaC）是通过可编程配置文件（也称为IaC脚本）来管理IT基础设施的过程。与其他软件制品一样，IaC脚本可能包含安全气味（security smells），即可能导致安全弱点的编码模式。目前已有用于检测IaC脚本中安全气味的自动化分析工具，但它们侧重于特定技术，如Puppet、Ansible或Chef。这意味着当某个工具实现了一种新气味的检测时，其他工具所支持的技术无法立即使用该检测——唯一的选择是重复劳动。本文提出了一种能够在不同IaC技术之间实现一致的安全气味检测的方法。我们进行了一项大规模实证研究，分析了包含196,755个IaC脚本和12,281,251行代码的三个大型数据集中的安全气味。我们表明，所有类别的安全气味都在所有数据集中被识别出来，并且我们识别出一些可能影响许多IaC项目的特定气味。为了进行这项研究，我们开发了GLITCH，这是一个新的与技术无关的框架，通过将IaC脚本转换为中间表示来实现自动化多语言气味检测，并可在该表示上定义不同的安全气味检测器。GLITCH目前支持检测以Ansible、Chef或Puppet编写的脚本中的九种不同安全气味。我们将GLITCH与最先进的安全气味检测器进行了比较。结果不仅表明GLITCH可以减少为多种IaC技术编写安全气味分析的工作量，而且还表明它在精确率和召回率方面均优于当前最先进的工具。

upstream_only.title: Graph based Incident Extraction and Diagnosis in Large-Scale Online Systems
upstream_only.abstract: With the ever increasing scale and complexity of online systems, incidents are gradually becoming commonplace. Without appropriate handling, they can seriously harm the system availability. However, in large-scale online systems, these incidents are usually drowning in a slew of issues (i.e., something abnormal, while not necessarily an incident), rendering them difficult to handle. Typically, these issues will result in a cascading effect across the system, and a proper management of the incidents depends heavily on a thorough analysis of this effect. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a method to automatically analyze the cascading effect of availability issues in online systems and extract the corresponding graph based issue representations incorporating both of the issue symptoms and affected service attributes. With the extracted representations, we train and utilize a graph neural networks based model to perform incident detection. Then, for the detected incident, we leverage the PageRank algorithm with a flexible transition matrix design to locate its root cause. We evaluate our approach using real-world data collected from the WeChat online service system, the largest instant message system in China. The results confirm the effectiveness of our approach. Moreover, our approach is successfully deployed in the company and eases the burden of operators in the face of a flood of issues and related alert signals.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 随着在线系统规模和复杂性的不断增加，事件逐渐变得司空见惯。如果处理不当，它们会严重损害系统的可用性。然而，在大规模在线系统中，这些事件通常淹没在大量的问题（即异常情况，但不一定是事件）之中，使它们难以处理。通常，这些问题会在系统中产生级联效应，而事件的妥善管理在很大程度上取决于对这种效应的彻底分析。因此，在本文中，我们提出了一种方法，自动分析在线系统中可用性问题的级联效应，并提取相应的基于图的问题表示，同时包含问题症状和受影响的服务属性。利用提取的表示，我们训练并使用基于图神经网络的模型进行事件检测。然后，对于检测到的事件，我们利用具有灵活转移矩阵设计的PageRank算法来定位其根本原因。我们使用从中国最大的即时消息系统——微信在线服务系统收集的真实数据来评估我们的方法。结果证实了我们方法的有效性。此外，我们的方法已成功部署在公司中，减轻了运营商面对大量问题和相关警报信号的负担。

upstream_only.title: Griffin : Grammar-Free DBMS Fuzzing
upstream_only.abstract: Fuzzing is a promising approach to DBMS testing. One crucial component in DBMS fuzzing is grammar: since DBMSs enforce strict validation on inputs, a grammar improves fuzzing efficiency by generating syntactically- and semantically-correct SQL statements. However, due to the vast differences in the complex grammar of various DBMSs, it is painstaking to adapt these fuzzers to them. Considering that lots of DBMSs are not yet well tested, there is an urgent need for an effective DBMS fuzzing approach that is free from grammar dependencies. In this paper, we propose Griffin, a grammar-free mutation based DBMS fuzzer. Rather than relying on grammar, Griffin summarizes the DBMS’s state into metadata graph, a lightweight data structure which improves mutation correctness in fuzzing. Specifically, it first tracks the metadata of the statements in built-in SQL test cases as they are executed, and constructs the metadata graph to describe the dependencies between metadata and statements iteratively. Based on the graphs, it reshuffles statements and employs metadata-guided substitution to correct semantic errors. We evaluate Griffin on MariaDB, SQLite, PostgreSQL, and DuckDB. Griffin covers 73.43\%-274.70\%, 80.47\%-312.89\%, 43.80\%-199.11\% more branches, and finds 27, 27, and 22 more bugs in 12 hours than SQLancer, SQLsmith, and Squirrel, respectively. In total, Griffin finds 55 previously unknown bugs with 13 CVEs assigned.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 模糊测试是一种有前景的数据库管理系统测试方法。数据库管理系统模糊测试的一个关键组成部分是语法：由于数据库管理系统对输入实行严格的验证，语法通过生成语法正确和语义正确的SQL语句来提高模糊测试的效率。然而，由于不同数据库管理系统的复杂语法差异巨大，将这些模糊测试器适配到它们非常费力。考虑到许多数据库管理系统尚未得到充分测试，目前迫切需要一种不依赖语法的有效数据库管理系统模糊测试方法。在本文中，我们提出了Griffin，一种无语法的基于变异的数据库管理系统模糊测试器。Griffin不依赖语法，而是将数据库管理系统的状态概括为元数据图，这是一种轻量级数据结构，可提高模糊测试中变异的正确性。具体来说，它首先在内置SQL测试用例执行时跟踪语句的元数据，并迭代地构建元数据图以描述元数据与语句之间的依赖关系。在此基础上，它对语句进行重新排序，并使用元数据引导的替换来纠正语义错误。我们在MariaDB、SQLite、PostgreSQL和DuckDB上评估了Griffin。与SQLancer相比，Griffin的分支覆盖率增加73.43%–274.70%；与SQLsmith相比增加80.47%–312.89%；与Squirrel相比增加43.80%–199.11%；同时，在12小时内分别比SQLancer、SQLsmith和Squirrel多发现27个、27个和22个缺陷。总的来说，Griffin发现了55个先前未知的缺陷，其中13个已分配CVE。

upstream_only.title: Groundhog: An Automated Accessibility Crawler for Mobile Apps
upstream_only.abstract: Accessibility is a critical software quality affecting more than 15\% of the world’s population with some form of disabilities. Modern mobile platforms, i.e., iOS and Android, provide guidelines and testing tools for developers to assess the accessibility of their apps. The main focus of the testing tools is on examining a particular screen’s compliance with some predefined rules derived from accessibility guidelines. Unfortunately, these tools cannot detect accessibility issues that manifest themselves in interactions with apps using assistive services, e.g., screen readers. A few recent studies have proposed assistive-service driven testing; however, they require manually constructed inputs from developers to evaluate a specific screen or presume availability of UI test cases. In this work, we propose an automated accessibility crawler for mobile apps, Groundhog, that explores an app with the purpose of finding accessibility issues without any manual effort from developers. Groundhog assesses the functionality of UI elements in an app with and without assistive services and pinpoints accessibility issues with an intuitive video of how to replicate them. Our experiments show Groundhog is highly effective in detecting accessibility barriers that existing techniques cannot discover. Powered by Groundhog, we conducted an empirical study on a large set of real-world apps and found new classes of critical accessibility issues that should be the focus of future work in this area.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 无障碍性是一项关键的软件质量属性，影响着全球超过15%的各类残障人群。现代移动平台（如iOS和Android）为开发者提供了评估其应用无障碍性的指南和测试工具。这些测试工具的主要重点是检查特定屏幕是否符合从无障碍指南中派生出的某些预定义规则。不幸的是，这些工具无法检测在使用辅助服务（例如读屏器）与应用交互时表现出的无障碍问题。最近一些研究提出了辅助服务驱动的测试，但它们需要开发者手动构造输入来评估特定屏幕，或假定存在UI测试用例。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种自动化的移动应用无障碍爬虫Groundhog，它无需开发者任何手动操作即可探索应用并发现无障碍问题。Groundhog评估应用中UI元素在有和没有辅助服务时的功能，并通过直观的视频指出问题及复现步骤。我们的实验表明，Groundhog在检测现有技术无法发现的无障碍障碍方面非常有效。在Groundhog的推动下，我们对大量真实应用进行了实证研究，并发现了新的关键无障碍问题类别，这些问题应成为该领域未来工作的重点。

upstream_only.title: Has My Release Disobeyed Semantic Versioning? Static Detection Based on Semantic Differencing
upstream_only.abstract: To enhance the compatibility in the version control of Java Third-party Libraries (TPLs), Maven adopts Semantic Versioning (SemVer) to standardize the underlying meaning of versions, but users could still confront abnormal execution and crash after upgrades even if compilation and linkage succeed. It is caused by semantic breaking (SemB) issues, such that APIs directly used by users have identical signatures but inconsistent semantics across upgrades. To strengthen compliance with SemVer rules, developers and users should be alerted of such issues. Unfortunately, it is challenging to detect them statically, because semantic changes in the internal methods of APIs are difficult to capture. Dynamic testing can confirmingly uncover some, but it is limited by inadequate coverage. To detect SemB issues over compatible upgrades (Patch and Minor) by SemVer rules, we conduct an empirical study on 180 SemB issues to understand the root causes, inspired by which, we propose Sembid (Semantic Breaking Issue Detector) to statically detect such issues of TPLs for developers and users. Since APIs are directly used by users, Sembid detects and reports SemB issues based on APIs. For a pair of APIs, Sembid walks through the call chains originating from the API to locate breaking changes by measuring semantic diff. Then, Sembid checks if the breaking changes can affect API’s output along call chains. The evaluation showed Sembid achieved recall and precision and outperformed other API checkers on SemB API detection. We also revealed Sembid detected over 3 times more SemB APIs with better coverage than unit tests, the commonly used solution. Furthermore, we carried out an empirical study on 1,629,589 APIs from 546 version pairs of top Java libraries and found there were 2 ∼ 4 times more SemB APIs than those with signature-based issues. Due to various version release strategies, of Patch version pairs and of Minor version pairs had at least one API affected by any breaking.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 为了增强Java第三方库（TPLs）版本控制中的兼容性，Maven采用语义化版本控制（SemVer）来规范化版本的内在含义，但即使升级后编译和链接成功，用户仍可能遭遇异常执行甚至崩溃。这是由于语义断裂（SemB）问题造成的，即用户直接使用的API在升级后保持相同签名但语义不一致。为了加强对SemVer规则的遵守，应提醒开发者和用户此类问题。不幸的是，静态检测它们具有挑战性，因为API内部方法的语义变化难以捕获。动态测试可以确凿地发现一些问题，但受限于覆盖率不足。为了检测SemVer规则所定义的在兼容升级（补丁和次版本升级）中出现的SemB问题，我们对180个SemB问题进行了实证研究以理解其根本原因，并受此启发提出了Sembid（语义断裂问题检测器），以静态检测TPLs中的此类问题，供开发者和用户使用。由于API是用户直接使用的，Sembid基于API检测并报告SemB问题。对于一对API，Sembid遍历源自API的调用链，通过测量语义差异来定位断裂性变更。然后，Sembid检查这些断裂性变更是否会沿调用链影响API的输出。评估显示，Sembid在SemB API检测上取得了较高的召回率和精确率，并优于其他API检查器。我们还发现，Sembid检测到的SemB API数量是常用解决方案单元测试的3倍以上，且覆盖率更好。此外，我们对来自546个版本对的高知名度Java库的1,629,589个API进行了实证研究，发现SemB API的数量是签名问题API数量的2至4倍。由于不同的版本发布策略，Patch版本对和Minor版本对中分别有一定比例的版本对至少有某个API受到任何断裂性变更的影响。

upstream_only.title: How Useful is Code Change Information for Fault Localization in Continuous Integration?
upstream_only.abstract: Continuous integration (CI) is the process in which code changes are automatically integrated, built, and tested in a shared repository. In CI, developers frequently merge and test code under development, which helps isolate faults with finer-grained change information. To identify faulty code, prior research has widely studied and evaluated the performance of spectrum-based fault localization (SBFL) techniques. While the continuous nature of CI requires the code changes to be atomic and presents fine-grained information on what part of the system is being changed, traditional SBFL techniques do not benefit from it. To overcome the limitation, we propose to integrate the code and coverage change information in fault localization under CI settings. First, code changes show how faults are introduced into the system, and provide developers with better understanding on the root cause. Second, coverage changes show how the code coverage is impacted when faults are introduced. This change information can help limit the search space of code coverage, which offers more opportunities for improving fault localization techniques. Based on the above observations, we propose three new change-based fault localization techniques, and compare them with Ochiai, a commonly used SBFL technique. We evaluate these techniques on 192 real faults from seven software systems. Our results show that all three change-based techniques outperform Ochiai on the Defects4J dataset. In particular, the improvement varies from 7\% to 23\% and 17\% to 24\% for average MAP and MRR, respectively. Moreover, we find that our change-based fault localization techniques can be integrated with Ochiai, and boost its performance by up to 53\% and 52\% for average MAP and MRR, respectively.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 持续集成（CI）是将代码变更在共享仓库中自动集成、构建和测试的过程。在CI中，开发人员频繁合并和测试正在开发的代码，这有助于以更细粒度的变更信息隔离故障。为了识别故障代码，先前的研究广泛研究和评估了基于频谱的故障定位（SBFL）技术的性能。虽然CI的持续特性要求代码变更是原子的，并提供有关系统哪部分正在被更改的细粒度信息，但传统的SBFL技术并未从中受益。为克服这一局限，我们提出在CI设置下将代码和覆盖率变更信息集成到故障定位中。首先，代码变更显示了故障如何被引入系统，并为开发人员提供了对根本原因的更好理解。其次，覆盖率变更显示了当引入故障时代码覆盖率如何受到影响。这种变更信息有助于限制代码覆盖率的搜索空间，为改进故障定位技术提供了更多机会。基于上述观察，我们提出了三种新的基于变更的故障定位技术，并将它们与常用的SBFL技术Ochiai进行比较。我们在来自七个软件系统的192个真实故障上评估了这些技术。结果显示，在Defects4J数据集上，所有三种基于变更的技术均优于Ochiai。特别是，平均MAP和MRR的提升分别从7%到23%和17%到24%不等。此外，我们发现基于变更的故障定位技术可以与Ochiai集成，并将其平均MAP和MRR性能分别提升最多53%和52%。

upstream_only.title: HTFuzz: Heap Operation Sequence Sensitive Fuzzing
upstream_only.abstract: Heap-based temporal vulnerabilities (i.e., use-after-free, double-free and null pointer dereference) are highly sensitive to heap operation (e.g., memory allocation, deallocation and access) sequences. To efficiently find such vulnerabilities, traditional code coverage-guided fuzzing solutions could be promoted by integrating heap operation sequence feedback. But current sequence sensitive solutions have limitations in practice. In this paper, we propose a novel fuzzing solution named HTFuzz, to find heap-based temporal vulnerabilities. At the core, we utilize fuzzing to increase the coverage of runtime heap operation sequences and the diversity of pointers accessed by these operations, where the former reflects the control-flow and the latter reflects the data-flow of heap operation sequences. With such increases, the fuzzer could find more heap-based temporal vulnerabilities. We have developed a prototype of HTFuzz and evaluated it on 14 real-world applications, and compared it with 11 state-of-the-art fuzzers. The results showed that, HTFuzz outperformed all the baselines and was statistically better on the number of heap-based temporal vulnerabilities discovered. In detail, HTFuzz found (1.82x, 2.62x, 2.66x, 2.02x, 2.21x, 2.06x, 1.47x, 2.98x, 1.98x) more heap operation sequences and (1.45x, 3.56x, 3.56x, 4.57x, 1.78x, 1.78x, 1.68x, 4.00x, 1.45x) more 0day heap-based temporal vulnerabilities than (AFL, AFL-sensitive-ma, AFL-sensitive-mw, Memlock, PathAFL, TortoiseFuzz, MOPT, Angora, Ankou), respectively. HTFuzz discovered 37 new vulnerabilities with 37 CVEs assigned, including 32 new heap-based temporal vulnerabilities and 5 of other types.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 基于堆的时序漏洞（如释放后使用、双重释放和空指针解引用）对堆操作（如内存分配、释放和访问）序列高度敏感。为了高效发现此类漏洞，传统的基于代码覆盖率引导的模糊测试解决方案可以通过整合堆操作序列反馈来改进。但现有的序列敏感解决方案在实践中存在局限性。本文提出了一种名为HTFuzz的新型模糊测试解决方案，用于发现基于堆的时序漏洞。其核心是利用模糊测试来增加运行时堆操作序列的覆盖率以及这些操作所访问指针的多样性，其中前者反映控制流，后者反映堆操作序列的数据流。通过这些增加，模糊器可以发现更多基于堆的时序漏洞。我们开发了HTFuzz的原型，并在14个真实应用上进行了评估，与11个最先进的模糊器进行了比较。结果表明，HTFuzz在所有基线上表现更优，并且在发现的基于堆时序漏洞数量上统计上更好。具体而言，HTFuzz发现的堆操作序列比(AFL、AFL-sensitive-ma、AFL-sensitive-mw、Memlock、PathAFL、TortoiseFuzz、MOPT、Angora、Ankou)分别多(1.82倍、2.62倍、2.66倍、2.02倍、2.21倍、2.06倍、1.47倍、2.98倍、1.98倍)，发现的0day基于堆时序漏洞分别多(1.45倍、3.56倍、3.56倍、4.57倍、1.78倍、1.78倍、1.68倍、4.00倍、1.45倍)。HTFuzz发现了37个新漏洞，分配了37个CVE，其中包括32个新的基于堆的时序漏洞和5个其他类型漏洞。

upstream_only.title: HyperAST: Enabling Efficient Analysis of Software Histories at Scale
upstream_only.abstract: Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs) are widely used beyond compilers in many tools that measure and improve code quality, such as code analysis, bug detection, mining code metrics, refactoring. With the advent of fast software evolution and multistage releases, the temporal analysis of an AST history is becoming useful to understand and maintain code. However, jointly analyzing thousands versions of ASTs independently faces scalability issues, mostly combinatorial, both in terms of memory and CPU usage. In this paper, we propose a novel type of AST, called HyperAST, that enables efficient temporal code analysis on a given software history by: 1/ leveraging code redundancy through space (between code elements) and time (between versions); 2/ reusing intermediate computation results. We show how the HyperAST can be built incrementally on a set of commits to capture all multiple ASTs at once in an optimized way. We evaluated the HyperAST on a curated list of large software projects. Compared to Spoon, a state-of-the-art technique, we observed that the HyperAST outperforms it with an order-of-magnitude difference from \texttimes{} 6 up to \texttimes{} 8076 in CPU construction time and from \texttimes{} 12 up to \texttimes{} 1159 in memory footprint. While the HyperAST requires up to 2 h 22 min and 7.2 GB for the biggest project, Spoon requires up to 93 h and 31 min and 2.2 TB. The gains in construction time varied from to and the gains in memory footprint varied from to . We further compared the task of finding references of declarations with the HyperAST and Spoon. We observed on average precision and recall without a significant difference in search time.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 抽象语法树（AST）不仅广泛用于编译器，还用于许多衡量和改进代码质量的工具，如代码分析、错误检测、代码指标挖掘和重构。随着软件快速演进和多阶段发布的出现，对AST历史进行时间分析正变得有助于理解和维护代码。然而，独立联合分析数千个版本的AST会面临可扩展性问题，主要是在内存和CPU使用方面存在组合爆炸。在本文中，我们提出了一种新型AST，称为HyperAST，它通过对给定软件历史进行高效的时间代码分析，其方法包括：1）利用代码在空间（代码元素之间）和时间（版本之间）上的冗余；2）重用中间计算结果。我们展示了如何在提交集合上以增量方式构建HyperAST，以优化的方式一次性捕获所有多个AST。我们在精选的大型软件项目集上评估了HyperAST。与最先进的技术Spoon相比，我们观察到HyperAST在CPU构建时间上从6倍到8076倍，在内存占用上从12倍到1159倍，均优于Spoon。对于最大的项目，HyperAST需要最多2小时22分钟和7.2 GB，而Spoon需要最多93小时31分钟和2.2 TB。构建时间的提升幅度从到不等，内存占用的提升幅度从到不等。我们进一步比较了使用HyperAST和Spoon查找声明引用的任务。我们观察到了平均精确率和召回率，搜索时间没有显著差异。

upstream_only.title: ICEBAR: Feedback-Driven Iterative Repair of Alloy Specifications
upstream_only.abstract: Automated program repair (APR) techniques have shown great success in automatically finding fixes for programs in programming languages such as C or Java. In this work, we focus on repairing formal specifications, in particular for the Alloy specification language. As opposed to most APR tools, our approach to repair Alloy specifications, named ICEBAR, does not use test-based oracles for patch assessment. Instead, ICEBAR relies on the use of property-based oracles, commonly found in Alloy specifications as predicates and assertions. These property-based oracles define stronger conditions for patch assessment, thus reducing the notorious overfitting issue caused by using test-based oracles, typically observed in APR contexts. Moreover, as assertions and predicates are inherent to Alloy, whereas test cases are not, our tool is potentially more appealing to Alloy users than test-based Alloy repair tools. At a high level, ICEBAR is an iterative, counterexample-based process, that generates and validates repair candidates. ICEBAR receives a faulty Alloy specification with a failing property-based oracle, and uses Alloy’s counterexamples to build tests and feed ARepair, a test-based Alloy repair tool, in order to produce a repair candidate. The candidate is then checked against the property oracle for overfitting: if the candidate passes, a repair has been found; if not, further counterexamples are generated to construct tests and enhance the test suite, and the process is iterated. ICEBAR includes different mechanisms, with different degrees of reliability, to generate counterexamples from failing predicates and assertions. Our evaluation shows that ICEBAR significantly improves over ARepair, in both reducing overfitting and improving the repair rate. Moreover, ICEBAR shows that iterative refinement allows us to significantly improve a state-of-the-art tool for automated repair of Alloy specifications without any modifications to the tool.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 自动化程序修复（APR）技术在自动修复C或Java等编程语言程序方面已展现出巨大成功。在本工作中，我们专注于修复形式化规范，特别是Alloy规范语言。与大多数APR工具不同，我们修复Alloy规范的方法名为ICEBAR，它不使用基于测试的预言机来评估补丁。相反，ICEBAR依赖于基于属性的预言机，这些预言机通常以谓词和断言的形式出现在Alloy规范中。基于属性的预言机为补丁评估设定了更强的条件，从而减少了APR环境中常见的由基于测试的预言机所导致的过拟合问题。此外，由于断言和谓词是Alloy固有的，而测试用例并非如此，因此与基于测试的Alloy修复工具相比，我们的工具可能对Alloy用户更具吸引力。在高层面上，ICEBAR是一个迭代的、基于反例的过程，它生成并验证修复候选。ICEBAR接收一个带有失败属性预言机的错误Alloy规范，利用Alloy的反例构建测试，并驱动ARepair（一个基于测试的Alloy修复工具）生成修复候选。然后，针对属性预言机检查候选是否存在过拟合：如果候选通过，则表示已找到修复；如果未通过，则生成更多反例以构建测试并增强测试套件，过程随之迭代。ICEBAR包含多种具有不同可靠性的机制，用于从失败的谓词和断言中生成反例。我们的评估表明，ICEBAR在减少过拟合和提高修复率方面均显著优于ARepair。此外，ICEBAR表明，无需对先进的Alloy规范自动修复工具做任何修改，迭代精化即可使我们显著改进该工具。

upstream_only.title: Identifying Solidity Smart Contract API Documentation Errors
upstream_only.abstract: Smart contracts are gaining popularity as a means to support transparent, traceable, and self-executing decentralized applications, which enable the exchange of value in a trustless environment. Developers of smart contracts rely on various libraries, such as OpenZeppelin for Solidity contracts, to improve application quality and reduce development costs. The API documentations of these libraries are important sources of information for developers who are unfamiliar with the APIs. Yet, maintaining high-quality documentations is non-trivial, and errors in documentations may place barriers for developers to learn the correct usages of APIs. In this paper, we propose a technique, DocCon, to detect inconsistencies between documentations and the corresponding code for Solidity smart contract libraries. Our fact-based approach allows inconsistencies of different severity levels to be queried, from a database containing precomputed facts about the API code and documentations. DocCon successfully detected high-priority API documentation errors in popular smart contract libraries, including mismatching parameters, missing requirements, outdated descriptions, etc. Our experiment result shows that DocCon achieves good precision and is applicable to different libraries: 29 and 22 out of our reported 40 errors have been confirmed and fixed by library developers so far.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 智能合约作为一种支持透明、可追溯且自动执行的去中心化应用的手段正日益流行，它使得在无需信任的环境下进行价值交换成为可能。智能合约开发者通常依赖OpenZeppelin等Solidity合约库来提高应用质量并降低开发成本。这些库的API文档对于不熟悉API的开发者来说是重要的信息来源。然而，维护高质量的文档并非易事，文档中的错误可能会妨碍开发者学习API的正确用法。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为DocCon的技术，用于检测Solidity智能合约库文档与对应代码之间的不一致。我们的基于事实的方法可以从预先计算的API代码与文档事实数据库中，查询不同严重程度的不一致。DocCon在流行的智能合约库中成功检测到了高优先级API文档错误，包括参数不匹配、缺失需求、过时描述等。实验结果表明，DocCon具有良好的精确度，并且适用于不同库：在报告的40个错误中，已有29个和22个分别得到库开发者的确认和修复。

upstream_only.title: Inline Tests
upstream_only.abstract: Unit tests are widely used to check source code quality, but they can be too coarse-grained or ill-suited for testing individual program statements. We introduce inline tests to make it easier to check for faults in statements. We motivate inline tests through several language features and a common testing scenario in which inline tests could be beneficial. For example, inline tests can allow a developer to test a regular expression in place. We also define language-agnostic requirements for inline testing frameworks. Lastly, we implement I-Test, the first inline testing framework. I-Test works for Python and Java, and it satisfies most of the requirements. We evaluate I-Test on open-source projects by using it to test 144 statements in 31 Python programs and 37 Java programs. We also perform a user study. All nine user study participants say that inline tests are easy to write and that inline testing is beneficial. The cost of running inline tests is negligible, at 0.007x–0.014x, and our inline tests helped find two faults that have been fixed by the developers.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 单元测试被广泛用于检查源代码质量，但它们可能过于粗略或不适合测试单个程序语句。我们引入内联测试，以便更容易检查语句中的故障。我们通过多种语言特性和一个常见测试场景来激发内联测试的动机，在这些场景中内联测试可能是有益的。例如，内联测试可以允许开发人员就地测试正则表达式。我们还为内联测试框架定义了与语言无关的要求。最后，我们实现了I-Test，这是第一个内联测试框架。I-Test支持Python和Java，并满足大多数要求。我们通过在31个Python程序和37个Java程序中测试144条语句来评估I-Test在开源项目上的表现。我们还进行了一项用户研究。所有九名用户研究参与者表示内联测试易于编写，并且内联测试是有益的。运行内联测试的成本可以忽略不计，仅为0.007倍到0.014倍，我们的内联测试帮助发现了两个已被开发者修复的故障。

upstream_only.title: Insight: Exploring Cross-Ecosystem Vulnerability Impacts
upstream_only.abstract: Vulnerabilities, referred to as CLV issues, are induced by cross-language invocations of vulnerable libraries. Such issues greatly increase the attack surface of Python/Java projects due to their pervasive use of C libraries. Existing Python/Java build tools in PyPI and Maven ecosystems fail to report the dependency on vulnerable libraries written in other languages such as C. CLV issues are easily missed by developers. In this paper, we conduct the first empirical study on the status quo of CLV issues in PyPI and Maven ecosystems. It is found that 82,951 projects in these ecosystems are directly or indirectly dependent on libraries compiled from the C project versions that are identified to be vulnerable in CVE reports. Our study arouses the awareness of CLV issues in popular ecosystems and presents related analysis results. The study also leads to the development of the first automated mechanism, Insight, which provides a turn-key solution to the identification of CLV issues in PyPI and Maven projects based on published CVE reports of vulnerable C projects. Insight automatically identifies if a PyPI or Maven project is using a C library compiled from vulnerable C project versions in published CVE reports. It also deduces the vulnerable APIs involved by analyzing the usage of various foreign function interfaces such as CFFI and JNI in the concerned PyPI or Maven project. Insight achieves a high detection rate of 88.4\% on a popular CLV issue benchmark. Contributing to the open-source community, we report 226 CLV issues detected in the actively maintained PyPI and Maven projects that are directly dependent on vulnerable C library versions. Our reports are well received and appreciated by developers with queries on the availability of Insight. 127 reported issues (56.2\%) were quickly confirmed by developers and 74.8\% of them were fixed/under fixing by popular projects, such as Mongodb [40] and Eclipse/Sumo [19].
upstream_only.abstract_zh: “漏洞，称为CLV问题，是由易受攻击库的跨语言调用引起的。由于Python/Java项目广泛使用C库，这类问题大大增加了其攻击面。PyPI和Maven生态系统中现有的Python/Java构建工具未能报告对其他语言（如C）编写的易受攻击库的依赖。开发人员很容易忽略CLV问题。在本文中，我们首次对PyPI和Maven生态系统中的CLV问题现状进行了实证研究。研究发现，这些生态系统中有82,951个项目直接或间接依赖于由CVE报告中确定为易受攻击的C项目版本编译而来的库。我们的研究提高了人们对流行生态系统中CLV问题的认识，并给出了相关分析结果。该研究还促成了第一个自动化机制Insight的开发，它基于已发布的易受攻击C项目的CVE报告，为识别PyPI和Maven项目中的CLV问题提供了一站式解决方案。Insight自动识别PyPI或Maven项目是否使用了由已发布CVE报告中易受攻击的C项目版本编译的C库。它还通过分析相关PyPI或Maven项目中CFFI和JNI等各种外部函数接口的使用情况，推断所涉及的易受攻击API。Insight在流行的CLV问题基准上实现了88.4%的高检测率。为开源社区做贡献，我们报告了在积极维护的PyPI和Maven项目中检测到的226个CLV问题，这些项目直接依赖于易受攻击的C库版本。我们的报告得到了开发人员的广泛认可和赞赏，并询问Insight的可用性。127个已报告问题（56.2%）被开发人员迅速确认，其中74.8%已被流行项目（如Mongodb[40]和Eclipse/Sumo[19]）修复或正在修复。”

upstream_only.title: Is this Change the Answer to that Problem? Correlating Descriptions of Bug and Code Changes for Evaluating Patch Correctness
upstream_only.abstract: Patch correctness has been the focus of automated program repair (APR) in recent years due to the propensity of APR tools to generate overfitting patches. Given a generated patch, the oracle (e.g., test suites) is generally weak in establishing correctness. Therefore, the literature has proposed various approaches of leveraging machine learning with engineered and deep learned features, or exploring dynamic execution information, to further explore the correctness of APR-generated patches. In this work, we propose a novel perspective to the problem of patch correctness assessment: a correct patch implements changes that “answer” to a problem posed by buggy behavior. Concretely, we turn the patch correctness assessment into a Question Answering problem. To tackle this problem, our intuition is that natural language processing can provide the necessary representations and models for assessing the semantic correlation between a bug (question) and a patch (answer). Specifically, we consider as inputs the bug reports as well as the natural language description of the generated patches. Our approach, Quatrain, first considers state-of-the-art commit message generation models to produce the relevant inputs associated to each generated patch. Then we leverage a neural network architecture to learn the semantic correlation between bug reports and commit messages. Experiments on a large dataset of 9 135 patches generated for three bug datasets (Defects4j, Bugs.jar and Bears) show that Quatrain achieves an AUC of 0.886 on predicting patch correctness, and recalling 93\% correct patches while filtering out 62\% incorrect patches. Our experimental results further demonstrate the influence of inputs quality on prediction performance. We further perform experiments to highlight that the model indeed learns the relationship between bug reports and code change descriptions for the prediction. Finally, we compare against prior work and discuss the benefits of our approach.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 近年来，由于自动程序修复（APR）工具容易生成过拟合补丁，补丁正确性已成为该领域的焦点。对于生成的补丁，测试套件等测试预言通常在确定正确性方面较弱。因此，已有文献提出了各种方法，利用机器学习与手工特征、深度学习特征，或探索动态执行信息，来进一步考察APR生成的补丁的正确性。在这项工作中，我们提出了补丁正确性评估问题的一个新视角：正确的补丁所实现的变化是对有缺陷行为所提出问题的“回答”。具体而言，我们将补丁正确性评估转化为一个问答问题。为了解决这一问题，我们的直觉是，自然语言处理能够提供必要的表示和模型，用于评估错误（问题）与补丁（答案）之间的语义相关性。我们特别将错误报告以及生成补丁的自然语言描述作为输入。我们的方法Quatrain首先采用最新的提交信息生成模型来生成与每个补丁相关的输入；然后利用神经网络架构学习错误报告与提交信息之间的语义相关性。在由三个错误数据集（Defects4j、Bugs.jar和Bears）生成的9135个补丁的大型数据集上的实验表明，Quatrain在预测补丁正确性上达到了0.886的AUC，并且能够召回93%的正确补丁，同时过滤掉62%的错误补丁。我们的实验结果进一步证明了输入质量对预测性能的影响。我们还进行了实验来强调模型确实学习了错误报告与代码变更描述之间的关系以进行预测。最后，我们与先前的工作进行了比较，并讨论了我们的方法的优势。

upstream_only.title: Jasmine: A Static Analysis Framework for Spring Core Technologies
upstream_only.abstract: The Spring framework is widely used in developing enterprise web applications. Spring core technologies, such as Dependency Injection and Aspect-Oriented Programming, make development faster and easier. However, the implementation of Spring core technologies uses a lot of dynamic features. Those features impose significant challenges when using static analysis to reason about the behavior of Spring-based applications. In this paper, we propose Jasmine, a static analysis framework for Spring core technologies extends from Soot to enhance the call graph’s completeness while not greatly affecting its performance. We evaluate Jasmine’s completeness, precision, and performance using Spring micro-benchmarks and a suite of 18 real-world Spring programs. Our experiments show that Jasmine effectively enhances the state-of-the-art tools based on Soot and Doop to better support Spring core technologies. We also add Jasmine support to FlowDroid and discovered twelve sensitive information leakage paths in our benchmarks. Jasmine is expected to provide significant benefits for many program analyses scenes of Spring applications where more complete call graphs are required.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Spring框架被广泛用于开发企业级网络应用。Spring核心技术，如依赖注入和面向切面编程，使开发更加快速和容易。然而，Spring核心技术的实现使用了大量动态特性。这些特性在使用静态分析来推理基于Spring的应用行为时带来了显著挑战。在本文中，我们提出了Jasmine，一个面向Spring核心技术的静态分析框架，它扩展自Soot，以提高调用图的完整性，同时不严重影响其性能。我们使用Spring微基准测试和18个真实Spring程序的组合来评估Jasmine的完整性、精度和性能。我们的实验表明，Jasmine有效地增强了基于Soot和Doop的最先进工具，以更好地支持Spring核心技术。我们还向FlowDroid添加了Jasmine支持，并在基准测试中发现了12条敏感信息泄露路径。Jasmine预期将能为需要更完整调用图的Spring应用分析场景提供显著益处。

upstream_only.title: Keeping Secrets: Multi-objective Genetic Improvement for Detecting and Reducing Information Leakage
upstream_only.abstract: Information leaks in software can unintentionally reveal private data, yet they are hard to detect and fix. Although several methods have been proposed to detect leakage, such as static verification-based approaches, they require specialist knowledge, and are time-consuming. Recently, we introduced HyperGI, a dynamic, hypertest-based approach that can detect and produce potential fixes for hyperproperty violations. In particular, we focused on violations of the noninterference property, as it results in information flow leakage. Our instantiation of HyperGI was able to detect and reduce leakage in three small programs. Its fitness function tried to balance information leakage and program correctness but, as we pointed out, there may be tradeoffs between keeping program semantics and reducing information leakage that require developer decisions. In this work we ask if it is possible to automatically detect and repair information leakage in more realistic programs without requiring specialist knowledge. We instantiate a multi-objective version of HyperGI in a tool, called LeakReducer, which explicitly encodes the tradeoff between program correctness and information leakage. We apply LeakReducer to six leaky programs, including the well-known Heartbleed bug. LeakReducer is able to detect leakage in all, in contrast to state-of-the-art fuzzers, detecting leakage in only two programs. Moreover, LeakReducer is able to reduce leakage in all subjects, with comparable results to previous work, while scaling to much larger software.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 软件中的信息泄露可能无意中暴露私人数据，但此类泄漏难以检测和修复。尽管已有多种检测方法（如基于静态验证的方法）被提出，但这些方法需要专业知识且耗时。近期，我们引入了HyperGI——一种基于动态超测试的方法，能够检测超属性违规并产生潜在的修复方案。我们特别关注非干涉属性的违规，因为它导致信息流泄漏。我们的HyperGI实例能够检测并减少三个小程序中的泄漏，其适应度函数试图平衡信息泄漏与程序正确性，但正如我们指出的，在保持程序语义与减少信息泄漏之间可能存在需要开发者决策的权衡。在本工作中，我们研究是否有可能在不需要专业知识的情况下自动检测和修复更现实程序中的信息泄漏。我们在一个名为LeakReducer的工具中实例化了HyperGI的多目标版本，该工具显式编码了程序正确性与信息泄漏之间的权衡。我们将LeakReducer应用于六个存在泄漏的程序，包括著名的Heartbleed漏洞。与最先进的模糊测试工具相比（后者仅能检测其中两个程序的泄漏），LeakReducer能够在所有程序中检测到泄漏。此外，LeakReducer能够在所有测试对象中减少泄漏，其结果与先前工作相当，同时能够扩展到更大的软件。

upstream_only.title: LawBreaker: An Approach for Specifying Traffic Laws and Fuzzing Autonomous Vehicles
upstream_only.abstract: Autonomous driving systems (ADSs) must be tested thoroughly before they can be deployed in autonomous vehicles. High-fidelity simulators allow them to be tested against diverse scenarios, including those that are difficult to recreate in real-world testing grounds. While previous approaches have shown that test cases can be generated automatically, they tend to focus on weak oracles (e.g. reaching the destination without collisions) without assessing whether the journey itself was undertaken safely and satisfied the law. In this work, we propose LawBreaker, an automated framework for testing ADSs against real-world traffic laws, which is designed to be compatible with different scenario description languages. LawBreaker provides a rich driver-oriented specification language for describing traffic laws, and a fuzzing engine that searches for different ways of violating them by maximising specification coverage. To evaluate our approach, we implemented it for Apollo+LGSVL and specified the traffic laws of China. LawBreaker was able to find 14 violations of these laws, including 173 test cases that caused accidents.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 自动驾驶系统（ADS）在部署到自动驾驶车辆之前必须经过充分测试。高保真模拟器可以针对多种场景对其进行测试，包括那些在现实测试场地中难以重现的场景。虽然先前的研究已表明可以自动生成测试用例，但它们往往侧重于弱测试预言（例如，无碰撞地到达目的地），而未评估整个行程是否安全进行并符合法律。在这项工作中，我们提出了LawBreaker，一个用于针对真实世界交通法规测试自动驾驶系统的自动化框架，其设计目的是兼容不同的场景描述语言。LawBreaker提供了一种面向驾驶员的富规范语言来描述交通法规，以及一个通过最大化规范覆盖率来搜索违反法规的不同方式的模糊测试引擎。为了评估我们的方法，我们针对Apollo和LGSVL实现了该框架，并指定了中国的交通法规。LawBreaker能够发现这些法规的14项违规，其中包括导致事故的173个测试用例。

upstream_only.title: Learning Contract Invariants Using Reinforcement Learning
upstream_only.abstract: Due to the popularity of smart contracts in the modern financial ecosystem, there has been growing interest in formally verifying their correctness and security properties. Most existing techniques in this space focus on common vulnerabilities like arithmetic overflows and perform verification by leveraging contract invariants (i.e., logical formulas hold at transaction boundaries). In this paper, we propose a new technique, based on deep reinforcement learning, for automatically learning contract invariants that are useful for proving arithmetic safety. Our method incorporates an off-line training phase in which the verifier uses its own verification attempts to learn a policy for contract invariant generation. This learned (neural) policy is then used at verification time to predict likely invariants that are also useful for proving arithmetic safety. We implemented this idea in a tool called Cider and incorporated it into an existing verifier (based on refinement type checking) for proving arithmetic safety. Our evaluation shows that Cider improves both the quality of the inferred invariants as well as inference time, leading to faster verification and hardened contracts with fewer run-time assertions.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 由于智能合约在现代金融生态系统中的普及，人们越来越关注对其正确性和安全性的形式化验证。该领域的大多数现有技术侧重于常见漏洞（如算术溢出），并通过利用合约不变量（即在交易边界成立或保持的逻辑公式）进行验证。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于深度强化学习的新技术，用于自动学习有助于证明算术安全性的合约不变量。我们的方法包含一个离线训练阶段，在该阶段中验证器利用自身的验证尝试来学习生成合约不变量的策略。这个学习到的（神经）策略随后在验证时用于预测可能的不变量，这些不变量对证明算术安全性也很有用。我们将这一想法实现为一个名为Cider的工具，并将其集成到一个现有的基于精化类型检查的验证器中，以证明算术安全性。我们的评估表明，Cider既提高了推断不变量的质量，也提高了推断时间，从而实现了更快的验证和更少的运行时断言，使合约更加安全。

upstream_only.title: Learning to Construct Better Mutation Faults
upstream_only.abstract: Mutation faults are the core of mutation testing and have been widely used in many other software testing and debugging tasks. Hence, constructing high-quality mutation faults is critical. There are many traditional mutation techniques that construct syntactic mutation faults based on a limited set of manually-defined mutation operators. To improve them, the state-of-the-art deep-learning (DL) based technique (i.e., DeepMutation) has been proposed to construct mutation faults by learning from real faults via classic sequence-to-sequence neural machine translation (NMT). However, its performance is not satisfactory since it cannot ensure syntactic correctness of constructed mutation faults and suffers from the effectiveness issue due to the huge search space and limited features by simply treating each targeted method as a token stream. In this work, we propose a novel DL-based mutation technique (i.e., LEAM) to overcome the limitations of both traditional techniques and DeepMutation. LEAM adapts the syntax-guided encoder-decoder architecture by extending a set of grammar rules specific to our mutation task, to guarantee syntactic correctness of constructed mutation faults. Instead of predicting a sequence of tokens one by one to form a whole mutated method, it predicts the statements to be mutated under the context of the targeted method to reduce search space, and then predicts grammar rules for mutation fault construction based on both semantic and structural features in AST. We conducted an extensive study to evaluate LEAM based on the widely-used Defects4J benchmark. The results demonstrate that the mutation faults constructed by LEAM can not only better represent real faults than two state-of-the-art traditional techniques (i.e., Major and PIT) and DeepMutation, but also substantially boost two important downstream applications of mutation faults, i.e., test case prioritization and fault localization.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 变异缺陷是变异测试的核心，并被广泛用于许多其他软件测试和调试任务中。因此，构建高质量的变异缺陷至关重要。有许多传统变异技术基于一组有限的、手动定义的变异算子来构造语法层面的变异缺陷。为改进它们，最先进的基于深度学习（DL）的技术（即DeepMutation）已被提出，通过经典的序列到序列神经机器翻译（NMT）从真实缺陷中学习来构建变异缺陷。然而，其性能并不令人满意，因为它无法确保所构造变异缺陷的语法正确性，并且由于仅将目标方法简单地视为标记流所导致的巨大搜索空间和有限特征，它存在有效性问题。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的基于深度学习的变异技术（即LEAM），以克服传统技术和DeepMutation的局限性。LEAM通过扩展一组特定于我们变异任务的语法规则，采用语法引导的编码器-解码器架构，以确保构造的变异缺陷的语法正确性。它不是在目标方法上下文中逐词预测整个变异方法，而是先预测需要变异的语句以缩减搜索空间，然后基于AST中的语义和结构特征来预测用于构建变异缺陷的语法规则。我们基于广泛使用的Defects4J基准对LEAM进行了全面的研究。结果表明，LEAM构造的变异缺陷不仅能比两种最先进的传统技术（即Major和PIT）以及DeepMutation更好地代表真实缺陷，而且还显著增强了变异缺陷的两个重要下游应用，即测试用例优先排序和缺陷定位。

upstream_only.title: Learning to Synthesize Relational Invariants
upstream_only.abstract: We propose a method for synthesizing invariants that can help verify relational properties over two programs or two different executions of a program. Applications of such invariants include verifying functional equivalence, non-interference security, and continuity properties. Our method generates invariant candidates using syntax guided synthesis (SyGuS) and then filters them using an SMT-solver based verifier, to ensure they are both inductive invariants and sufficient for verifying the property at hand. To improve performance, we propose two learning based techniques: a logical reasoning (LR) technique to determine which part of the search space can be pruned away, and a reinforcement learning (RL) technique to determine which part of the search space to prioritize. Our experiments on a diverse set of relational verification benchmarks show that our learning based techniques can drastically reduce the search space and, as a result, they allow our method to generate invariants of a higher quality in much shorter time than state-of-the-art invariant synthesis techniques.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种综合不变式的方法，以帮助验证两个程序或同一程序的不同执行之间的关系属性。此类不变式的应用包括验证功能等价性、非干涉安全性和连续性属性。我们的方法使用语法引导合成（SyGuS）生成不变式候选，然后使用基于SMT求解器的验证器进行过滤，以确保它们既是归纳不变式，又足以验证当前属性。为了提高性能，我们提出了两种基于学习的技术：一种逻辑推理（LR）技术，用于确定搜索空间中可以被剪除的部分；以及一种强化学习（RL）技术，用于确定应优先搜索搜索空间的哪个部分。我们在多种关系验证基准上的实验表明，我们基于学习的技术可以大幅缩减搜索空间，从而使我们的方法能够比最先进的不变式合成技术更快地生成更高质量的不变式。

upstream_only.title: Leveraging Practitioners’ Feedback to Improve a Security Linter
upstream_only.abstract: Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) is a technology that enables the management and distribution of infrastructure through code instead of manual processes. In 2020, Palo Alto Network’s Unit 42 announced the discovery of over 199K vulnerable IaC templates through their “Cloud Threat” Report. This report highlights the importance of tools to prevent vulnerabilities from reaching production. Unfortunately, we observed through a comprehensive study that a security linter for IaC scripts is not reliable yet—high false positive rates. Our approach to tackling this problem was to leverage community expertise to improve the precision of this tool. More precisely, we interviewed professional developers to collect their feedback on the root causes of imprecision of the state-of-the-art security linter for Puppet. From that feedback, we developed a linter adjusting 7 rules of an existing linter ruleset and adding 3 new rules. We conducted a new study with 131 practitioners, which helped us improve the tool’s precision significantly and achieve a final precision of . An important takeaway from this paper is that obtaining professional feedback is fundamental to improving the rules’ precision and extending the rulesets, which is critical for the usefulness and adoption of lightweight tools, such as IaC security linters.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 基础设施即代码（IaC）是一种通过代码而非手动流程来管理和分发基础设施的技术。2020年，Palo Alto Networks的Unit 42在“Cloud Threat”报告中宣布发现了超过19.9万个易受攻击的IaC模板。该报告凸显了防止漏洞进入生产环境的工具的重要性。然而，我们通过一项综合研究发现，针对IaC脚本的安全检测工具尚不可靠——误报率很高。我们解决这一问题的方法是借助社区专业知识来提高该工具的精确度。更具体地说，我们采访了专业开发者，收集他们对最先进的Puppet安全检测工具不精确根因的反馈。基于这些反馈，我们开发了一个检测工具，调整了现有检测工具规则集中的7条规则，并新增了3条规则。我们又开展了一项涉及131名从业者的新研究，该研究帮助我们显著提高了工具的精确度，并最终实现了较高的精确率。本文的一个重要启示是，获取专业反馈对于提高规则精确度和扩展规则集至关重要，而这对轻量级工具（例如IaC安全检测工具）的实用性和采用具有关键意义。

upstream_only.title: LISSA: Lazy Initialization with Specialized Solver Aid
upstream_only.abstract: Programs that deal with heap-allocated inputs are difficult to analyze with symbolic execution (SE). Lazy Initialization (LI) is an approach to SE that deals with heap-allocated inputs by starting SE over a fully symbolic heap, and initializing the inputs’ fields on demand, as the program under analysis accesses them. However, when the program’s assumed precondition has structural constraints over the inputs, operationally captured via repOK routines, LI may produce spurious symbolic structures, making SE traverse infeasible paths and undermining SE’s performance. repOK can only decide the feasibility of fully concrete structures, and thus previous work relied on manually crafted specifications designed to decide the (in)validity of partially symbolic inputs, to avoid producing spurious symbolic structures. However, these additional specifications require significant further effort from the developers. To deal with this issue, we introduce SymSolve, a test generation based approach that, given a partially symbolic structure and a repOK, automatically decides if the structure can be extended to a fully concrete one satisfying repOK. As opposed to previous approaches, SymSolve does not require additional specifications. It works by exploring feasible concretizations of partially symbolic structures in a bounded-exhaustive manner, until it finds a fully concrete structure satisfying repOK, or it exhausts the search space, deeming the corresponding partially symbolic structure spurious. SymSolve exploits sound pruning of the search space, combined with symmetry breaking (to discard structures isomorphic to previously explored ones), to efficiently explore very large search spaces. We incorporate SymSolve into LI in order to decide the feasibility of partially symbolic inputs, obtaining our LISSA technique. We experimentally assess LISSA against related techniques over various case studies, consisting of programs with heap-allocated inputs with complex constraints. The results show that LISSA is faster and scales better than related techniques.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 处理堆分配输入的程序难以用符号执行（SE）进行分析。惰性初始化（LI）是一种处理堆分配输入的SE方法，它从完全符号化的堆开始，并在被分析程序访问输入字段时按需初始化这些字段。然而，当程序的假定前置条件对输入具有结构性约束（通过repOK例程操作化表示）时，LI可能产生虚假的符号结构，导致SE遍历不可行路径并削弱SE的性能。repOK只能判定完全具体结构的可行性，因此先前的工作依赖于手工设计的规范来判断部分符号输入的合法性，以避免产生虚假的符号结构。然而，这些额外的规范需要开发人员付出大量额外努力。为了解决这一问题，我们引入了SymSolve——一种基于测试生成的方法，给定部分符号结构和repOK，自动判断该结构是否能扩展为满足repOK的完全具体结构。与先前的方法不同，SymSolve不需要额外的规范。它以有界穷举的方式探索部分符号结构的可行具体化，直到找到满足repOK的完全具体结构，或耗尽搜索空间，从而判定相应的部分符号结构是虚假的。SymSolve利用搜索空间的可靠剪枝，结合对称性破缺（以丢弃与已探索结构同构的结构），来高效地探索非常大的搜索空间。我们将SymSolve整合到LI中，以判定部分符号输入的可行性，从而获得LISSA技术。我们通过多个案例研究（由具有复杂约束的堆分配输入的程序组成）对LISSA与相关技术进行了实验评估。结果表明，LISSA比相关技术更快且可扩展性更好。

upstream_only.title: Low-Resources Project-Specific Code Summarization
upstream_only.abstract: Code summarization generates brief natural language descriptions of source code pieces, which can assist developers in understanding code and reduce documentation workload. Recent neural models on code summarization are trained and evaluated on large-scale multi-project datasets consisting of independent code-summary pairs. Despite the technical advances, their effectiveness on a specific project is rarely explored. In practical scenarios, however, developers are more concerned with generating high-quality summaries for their working projects. And these projects may not maintain sufficient documentation, hence having few historical code-summary pairs. To this end, we investigate low-resource project-specific code summarization, a novel task more consistent with the developers’ requirements. To better characterize project-specific knowledge with limited training samples, we propose a meta transfer learning method by incorporating a lightweight fine-tuning mechanism into a meta-learning framework. Experimental results on nine real-world projects verify the superiority of our method over alternative ones and reveal how the project-specific knowledge is learned.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 代码摘要为源代码片段生成简洁的自然语言描述，可帮助开发人员理解代码并减少文档编写工作量。最近的代码摘要神经模型是在由独立的代码-摘要对组成的大规模多项目数据集上进行训练和评估的。尽管技术上取得了进步，但它们在特定项目上的有效性很少被探讨。然而，在实际场景中，开发人员更关心为其正在进行的项目生成高质量的摘要。这些项目可能没有维护足够的文档，因此历史代码-摘要对很少。为此，我们研究了低资源项目特定代码摘要，这是一个更符合开发人员需求的新任务。为了在有限的训练样本下更好地表征项目特定知识，我们提出了一种元迁移学习方法，将轻量级微调机制纳入元学习框架中。在九个真实世界项目上的实验结果验证了我们的方法相对于其他方法的优越性，并揭示了项目特定知识是如何被学习的。

upstream_only.title: MalWhiteout: Reducing Label Errors in Android Malware Detection
upstream_only.abstract: Machine learning based Android malware detection has attracted a great deal of research work in recent years. A reliable malware dataset is critical to evaluate the effectiveness of malware detection approaches. Unfortunately, existing malware datasets used in our community are mainly labelled by leveraging existing anti-virus services (i.e., VirusTotal), which are prone to mislabelling. This, however, would lead to the inaccurate evaluation of the malware detection techniques. Removing label noises from Android malware datasets can be quite challenging, especially at a large data scale. To address this problem, we propose an effective approach called MalWhiteout to reduce label errors in Android malware datasets. Specifically, we creatively introduce Confident Learning (CL), an advanced noise estimation approach, to the domain of Android malware detection. To combat false positives introduced by CL, we incorporate the idea of ensemble learning and inter-app relation to achieve a more robust capability in noise detection. We evaluate MalWhiteout on a curated large-scale and reliable benchmark dataset. Experimental results show that MalWhiteout is capable of detecting label noises with over 94\% accuracy even at a high noise ratio (i.e., 30\%) of the dataset. MalWhiteout outperforms the state-of-the-art approach in terms of both effectiveness (8\% to 218\% improvement) and efficiency (70 to 249 times faster) across different settings. By reducing label noises, we show that the performance of existing malware detection approaches can be improved.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 基于机器学习的安卓恶意软件检测近年来吸引了大量研究工作。可靠的数据集对于评估恶意软件检测方法的有效性至关重要。遗憾的是，我们社区中现有的恶意软件数据集主要通过利用现有的防病毒服务（如VirusTotal）进行标注，这些服务容易出现误标。然而，这会导致对恶意软件检测技术的评估不准确。从安卓恶意软件数据集中移除标签噪声可能相当困难，尤其是在大规模数据上。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种名为MalWhiteout的有效方法，用于减少安卓恶意软件数据集中的标签错误。具体来说，我们创造性地将置信学习（Confident Learning, CL）这一先进的噪声估计方法引入安卓恶意软件检测领域。为了对抗置信学习引入的误报，我们结合集成学习和应用间关系的思路，以实现更强的噪声检测能力。我们在一个经过精心整理的大规模可靠基准数据集上对MalWhiteout进行了评估。实验结果表明，即使在数据集噪声率高达30%的情况下，MalWhiteout仍能以超过94%的准确率检测标签噪声。在不同设置下，MalWhiteout在有效性（提升8%至218%）和效率（快70至249倍）方面均优于现有方法。通过减少标签噪声，我们证明现有恶意软件检测方法的性能可以得到提升。

upstream_only.title: Mining Android API Usage to Generate Unit Test Cases for Pinpointing Compatibility Issues
upstream_only.abstract: Despite being one of the largest and most popular projects, the official Android framework has only provided test cases for less than 30\% of its APIs. Such a poor test case coverage rate has led to many compatibility issues that can cause apps to crash at runtime on specific Android devices, resulting in poor user experiences for both apps and the Android ecosystem. To mitigate this impact, various approaches have been proposed to automatically detect such compatibility issues. Unfortunately, these approaches have only focused on detecting signature-induced compatibility issues (i.e., a certain API does not exist in certain Android versions), leaving other equally important types of compatibility issues unresolved. In this work, we propose a novel prototype tool, JUnitTestGen, to fill this gap by mining existing Android API usage to generate unit test cases. After locating Android API usage in given real-world Android apps, JUnitTestGen performs inter-procedural backward data-flow analysis to generate a minimal executable code snippet (i.e., test case). Experimental results on thousands of real-world Android apps show that JUnitTestGen is effective in generating valid unit test cases for Android APIs. We show that these generated test cases are indeed helpful for pinpointing compatibility issues, including ones involving semantic code changes.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 尽管Android官方框架是最大和最受欢迎的项目之一，但其API中只有不到30%提供了测试用例。如此低的测试覆盖率导致了许多兼容性问题，这些问题可能导致应用在特定Android设备上运行时崩溃，从而给应用和Android生态系统带来糟糕的用户体验。为减轻这种影响，已有多种方法被提出来自动检测此类兼容性问题。不幸的是，这些方法仅关注于检测签名引起的兼容性问题（即某个API在特定Android版本中不存在），而留下了其他同等重要的兼容性问题类型未解决。在本工作中，我们提出了一个新颖的原型工具JUnitTestGen，通过挖掘现有Android API用法来生成单元测试用例，以填补这一空白。在定位给定真实Android应用中的Android API用法后，JUnitTestGen执行过程间反向数据流分析，以生成最小可执行代码片段（即测试用例）。在数千个真实Android应用上的实验结果表明，JUnitTestGen在为Android API生成有效单元测试用例方面是有效的。我们证明了这些生成的测试用例确实有助于定位兼容性问题，包括涉及语义代码变更的问题。

upstream_only.title: Natural Test Generation for Precise Testing of Question Answering Software
upstream_only.abstract: Question answering (QA) software uses information retrieval and natural language processing techniques to automatically answer questions posed by humans in a natural language. Like other AI-based software, QA software may contain bugs. To automatically test QA software without human labeling, previous work extracts facts from question answer pairs and generates new questions to detect QA software bugs. Nevertheless, the generated questions could be ambiguous, confusing, or with chaotic syntax, which are unanswerable for QA software. As a result, a relatively large proportion of the reported bugs are false positives. In this work, we proposed QAQA, a sentence-level mutation based metamorphic testing technique for QA software. To eliminate false positives and achieve precise automatic testing, QAQA leverages five Metamorphic Relations (MRs) as well as semantics-guided search and enhanced test oracles. Our evaluation on three QA datasets demonstrates that QAQA outperforms the state-of-the-art in both quantity (8,133 vs. 6,601 bugs) and quality (97.67\% vs. 49\% true positive rate) of the reported bugs. Moreover, the test inputs generated by QAQA successfully reduce MR violation rate from 44.29\% to 20.51\% when being adopted in fine-tuning the QA software under test.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 问答（QA）软件利用信息检索和自然语言处理技术，以自然语言自动回答人类提出的问题。与其他基于AI的软件一样，问答软件可能包含缺陷。为了在没有人工标注的情况下自动测试问答软件，先前的工作从问答对中提取事实并生成新问题以检测问答软件缺陷。然而，生成的问题可能含糊不清、令人困惑或语法混乱，导致问答软件无法回答。因此，报告的大量缺陷中相当比例是误报。在这项工作中，我们提出了QAQA，一种基于句子级突变的蜕变测试技术，用于测试问答软件。为消除误报并实现精确的自动测试，QAQA利用五种蜕变关系以及语义引导搜索和增强测试预言。我们在三个问答数据集上的评估表明，QAQA在报告缺陷的数量（8133个对比6601个）和质量（真阳性率97.67%对比49%）上均优于现有最先进技术。此外，QAQA生成的测试输入在被用于对被测问答软件进行微调时，成功将蜕变关系违反率从44.29%降低到20.51%。

upstream_only.title: Neuroevolution-Based Generation of Tests and Oracles for Games
upstream_only.abstract: Game-like programs have become increasingly popular in many software engineering domains such as mobile apps, web applications, or programming education. However, creating tests for programs that have the purpose of challenging human players is a daunting task for automatic test generators. Even if test generation succeeds in finding a relevant sequence of events to exercise a program, the randomized nature of games means that it may neither be possible to reproduce the exact program behavior underlying this sequence, nor to create test assertions checking if observed randomized game behavior is correct. To overcome these problems, we propose Neatest, a novel test generator based on the NeuroEvolution of Augmenting Topologies (NEAT) algorithm. Neatest systematically explores a program’s statements, and creates neural networks that operate the program in order to reliably reach each statement—that is, Neatest learns to play the game in a way to reliably cover different parts of the code. As the networks learn the actual game behavior, they can also serve as test oracles by evaluating how surprising the observed behavior of a program under test is compared to a supposedly correct version of the program. We evaluate this approach in the context of Scratch, an educational programming environment. Our empirical study on 25 non-trivial Scratch games demonstrates that our approach can successfully train neural networks that are not only far more resilient to random influences than traditional test suites consisting of static input sequences, but are also highly effective with an average mutation score of more than 65\%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 类游戏程序在移动应用、Web应用或编程教育等许多软件工程领域变得越来越流行。然而，为那些旨在挑战人类玩家的程序创建测试，对自动测试生成器来说是一项艰巨的任务。即使测试生成能够成功找到一系列相关事件来执行程序，游戏的随机性也意味着既无法重现该序列所依据的确切程序行为，也无法创建测试断言来检查观察到的随机游戏行为是否正确。为了克服这些问题，我们提出了Neatest，一种基于拓扑增强神经演化（NEAT）算法的新型测试生成器。Neatest系统地探索程序的语句，并创建神经网络来操作程序，以可靠地到达每条语句——即Neatest学习玩游戏的方式，以可靠地覆盖代码的不同部分。由于网络学习了实际游戏行为，它们还可以作为测试预言，通过评估被测程序观察到的行为与假设的正确版本之间的惊讶程度来判断其正确性。我们在Scratch（一种教育编程环境）的背景下评估了这种方法。我们在25个有代表性的Scratch游戏上的实证研究表明，我们的方法可以成功训练神经网络，这些网络不仅比由静态输入序列组成的传统测试套件对随机影响具有更强的鲁棒性，而且具有很高的有效性，平均变异分数超过65%。

upstream_only.title: Not All Dependencies are Equal: An Empirical Study on Production Dependencies in NPM
upstream_only.abstract: Modern software systems are often built by leveraging code written by others in the form of libraries and packages to accelerate their development. While there are many benefits to using third-party packages, software projects often become dependent on a large number of software packages. Consequently, developers are faced with the difficult challenge of maintaining their project dependencies by keeping them up-to-date and free of security vulnerabilities. However, how often are project dependencies used in production where they could pose a threat to their project’s security? We conduct an empirical study on 100 JavaScript projects using the Node Package Manager (npm) to quantify how often project dependencies are released to production and analyze their characteristics and their impact on security. Our results indicate that less than 1\% of the installed dependencies are released to production. Our analysis reveals that the functionality of a package is not enough to determine if it will be released to production or not. In fact, 59\% of the installed dependencies configured as runtime dependencies are not used in production, and 28.2\% of the dependencies configured as development dependencies are used in production, debunking two common assumptions of dependency management. Findings also indicate that most security alerts target dependencies not used in production, making them highly unlikely to be a risk for the security of the software. Our study unveils a more complex side of dependency management: not all dependencies are equal. Dependencies used in production are more sensitive to security exposure and should be prioritized. However, current tools lack the appropriate support in identifying production dependencies.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代软件系统通常通过利用他人编写的代码（以库和包的形式）来加速开发。尽管使用第三方包有很多好处，但软件项目往往依赖大量软件包。因此，开发人员面临着维护项目依赖关系、使其保持最新且无安全漏洞的艰巨挑战。然而，项目依赖中有多少在生产环境中被使用，从而可能对项目安全构成威胁呢？我们对使用Node包管理器（npm）的100个JavaScript项目进行了实证研究，以量化项目依赖发布到生产环境的频率，并分析其特性及对安全的影响。结果表明，安装的依赖中不到1%会被发布到生产环境。我们的分析显示，包的功能不足以判断其是否会发布到生产环境。事实上，配置为运行时依赖的安装依赖中有59%未在生产中使用，而配置为开发依赖的依赖中有28.2%在生产中使用，这推翻了依赖管理的两个常见假设。研究还发现，大多数安全警报针对的是未在生产中使用的依赖，这些依赖极不可能对软件安全构成风险。我们的研究揭示了依赖管理中更复杂的一面：并非所有依赖都同等重要。生产环境中使用的依赖对安全暴露更敏感，应优先处理。然而，当前工具在识别生产依赖方面缺乏足够支持。

upstream_only.title: Patching Weak Convolutional Neural Network Models through Modularization and Composition
upstream_only.abstract: Despite great success in many applications, deep neural networks are not always robust in practice. For instance, a convolutional neuron network (CNN) model for classification tasks often performs unsatisfactorily in classifying some particular classes of objects. In this work, we are concerned with patching the weak part of a CNN model instead of improving it through the costly retraining of the entire model. Inspired by the fundamental concepts of modularization and composition in software engineering, we propose a compressed modularization approach, CNNSplitter, which decomposes a strong CNN model for N-class classification into N smaller CNN modules. Each module is a sub-model containing a part of the convolution kernels of the strong model. To patch a weak CNN model that performs unsatisfactorily on a target class (TC), we compose the weak CNN model with the corresponding module obtained from a strong CNN model. The ability of the weak CNN model to recognize the TC can thus be improved through patching. Moreover, the ability to recognize non-TCs is also improved, as the samples misclassified as TC could be classified as non-TCs correctly. Experimental results with two representative CNNs on three widely-used datasets show that the averaged improvement on the TC in terms of precision and recall are 12.54\% and 2.14\%, respectively. Moreover, patching improves the accuracy of non-TCs by 1.18\%. The results demonstrate that CNNSplitter can patch a weak CNN model through modularization and composition, thus providing a new solution for developing robust CNN models.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 尽管深度神经网络在许多应用中取得了巨大成功，但在实践中并不总是稳健的。例如，用于分类任务的卷积神经网络（CNN）模型在对某些特定类别的对象进行分类时往往表现不佳。在这项工作中，我们关注的是修补CNN模型的薄弱部分，而不是通过昂贵地重新训练整个模型来改进它。受软件工程中模块化和组合基本概念的启发，我们提出了一种压缩模块化方法CNNSplitter，它将一个用于N类分类的强CNN模型分解为N个较小的CNN模块。每个模块都是一个包含强模型部分卷积核的子模型。为了修补在目标类（TC）上表现不佳的弱CNN模型，我们将弱CNN模型与从强CNN模型获得的相应模块进行组合。由此，弱CNN模型识别目标类的能力可以通过修补得到改善。此外，识别非目标类的能力也得到提升，因为被错误分类为目标类的样本可以被正确分类为非目标类。使用两个代表性CNN在三个广泛使用的数据集上的实验结果表明，目标类在精确率和召回率上的平均提升分别为12.54%和2.14%。此外，修补使非目标类的准确率提高了1.18%。结果表明，CNNSplitter可以通过模块化和组合修补弱CNN模型，从而为开发稳健的CNN模型提供新的解决方案。

upstream_only.title: PRCBERT: Prompt Learning for Requirement Classification using BERT-based Pretrained Language Models
upstream_only.abstract: Software requirement classification is a longstanding and important problem in requirement engineering. Previous studies have applied various machine learning techniques for this problem, including Support Vector Machine (SVM) and decision trees. With the recent popularity of NLP technique, the state-of-the-art approach NoRBERT utilizes the pre-trained language model BERT and achieves a satisfactory performance. However, the dataset PROMISE used by the existing approaches for this problem consists of only hundreds of requirements that are outdated according to today’s technology and market trends. Besides, the NLP technique applied in these approaches might be obsolete. In this paper, we propose an approach of prompt learning for requirement classification using BERT-based pretrained language models (PRCBERT), which applies flexible prompt templates to achieve accurate requirements classification. Experiments conducted on two existing small-size requirement datasets (PROMISE and NFR-Review) and our collected large-scale requirement dataset NFR-SO prove that PRCBERT exhibits moderately better classification performance than NoRBERT and MLM-BERT (BERT with the standard prompt template). On the de-labeled NFR-Review and NFR-SO datasets, Trans_PRCBERT (the version of PRCBERT which is fine-tuned on PROMISE) is able to have a satisfactory zero-shot performance with 53.27\% and 72.96\% F1-score when enabling a self-learning strategy.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 软件需求分类是需求工程中一个长期存在且重要的问题。以往的研究应用了各种机器学习技术，包括支持向量机（SVM）和决策树。随着近年来NLP技术的流行，最先进的方法NoRBERT利用预训练语言模型BERT取得了令人满意的性能。然而，现有方法使用的数据集PROMISE仅包含数百条需求，这些需求根据当今的技术和市场趋势已经过时。此外，这些方法中使用的NLP技术可能已经过时。在本文中，我们提出了一种使用基于BERT的预训练语言模型进行需求分类的提示学习方法（PRCBERT），该方法应用灵活的提示模板以实现准确的需求分类。在两个现有小型需求数据集（PROMISE和NFR-Review）以及我们收集的大型需求数据集NFR-SO上进行的实验证明，PRCBERT的分类性能略优于NoRBERT和MLM-BERT（使用标准提示模板的BERT）。在去标签的NFR-Review和NFR-SO数据集上，Trans_PRCBERT（在PROMISE上进行微调的PRCBERT版本）在启用自学习策略时，能够实现令人满意的零样本性能，F1分数分别为53.27%和72.96%。

upstream_only.title: Precise (Un)Affected Version Analysis for Web Vulnerabilities
upstream_only.abstract: Web applications are attractive attack targets given their popularity and large number of vulnerabilities. To mitigate the threat of web vulnerabilities, an important piece of information is their affected versions. However, it is non-trivial to build accurate affected version information because confirming a version as affected or unaffected requires security expertise and huge efforts, while there are usually hundreds of versions to examine. As a result, such information is maintained in a low-quality manner in almost every public vulnerability database. Therefore, it is extremely useful to have a tool that can automatically and precisely examine a large part (even if not all) of the software versions as affected or unaffected. To this end, this paper proposes a vulnerability-centric approach for precise (un)affected version analysis for web vulnerabilities. The key idea is to extract the vulnerability logic from a patch and directly use the vulnerability logic to check whether a version is (un)affected or not. Compared with existing works, our vulnerability-centric approach helps to tolerate the code changes across different software versions. We construct a high-quality dataset with 34 CVEs and 299 software versions to evaluate our approach. The results show that our approach achieves a precision of 98.15\% and a recall of 85.01\% in identifying (un)affected versions and significantly outperforms existing tools (e.g., V-SZZ, ReDebug, V0Finder).
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Web应用程序因其普及性和大量漏洞而成为有吸引力的攻击目标。为了缓解Web漏洞的威胁，一个重要的信息是受影响版本。然而，构建准确的受影响版本信息并非易事，因为确认某个版本是否受影响需要安全专业知识且耗费大量精力，而通常有数百个版本需要检查。因此，几乎每个公共漏洞数据库中的此类信息都维护质量低下。因此，拥有一个能够自动且精确地检查大部分（即使不是全部）软件版本是否受影响或不受影响的工具是非常有用的。为此，本文提出了一种以漏洞为中心的Web漏洞精确（未）受影响版本分析方法。关键思想是从补丁中提取漏洞逻辑，并直接利用漏洞逻辑来检查某个版本是否受影响或不受影响。与现有工作相比，我们以漏洞为中心的方法有助于容忍不同软件版本之间的代码变化。我们构建了一个包含34个CVE和299个软件版本的高质量数据集来评估我们的方法。结果表明，我们的方法在识别（未）受影响版本方面达到了98.15%的精确率和85.01%的召回率，显著优于现有工具（如V-SZZ、ReDebug、V0Finder）。

upstream_only.title: PredART: Towards Automatic Oracle Prediction of Object Placements in Augmented Reality Testing
