Exceptions are widely adopted in programs, often poorly documented, and sometimes ambiguous, making the rules of throwing correct exceptions rather complicated. A project team can leverage exceptions in a way totally different from other teams. As a result, even experienced programmers can have difficulties in determining which exception shall be thrown, although they have the skills to implement its surrounding code. In this paper, we propose the first approach, ThEx, to predict which exception(s) shall be thrown under a given programming context. The basic idea is to learn a classification model from existing thrown exceptions in source files. Here, the learning features are extracted from various code information surrounding the thrown exceptions, such as the thrown locations and related variable names. Then, given a new context, ThEx can predict its best exception(s). We have evaluated ThEx on 12,012 thrown exceptions that were collected from nine popular open-source projects. Our results show that it can achieve high f-scores and mcc values (both around 0.8). On this benchmark, we also evaluated the impacts of our underlying technical details. Furthermore, we evaluated our approach in the wild, and used ThEx to detect anomalies from the latest versions of the nine projects. In this way, we found 20 anomalies, and reported them as bugs to their issue trackers. Among them, 18 were confirmed, and 13 have already been fixed.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 尽管异常处理机制对于解决运行时错误至关重要，但该过程中的错误可能会产生深远的影响。因此，研究人员提出了各种方法来帮助捕获和处理此类抛出的异常，并检测相应的错误。如果抛出的异常本身是错误的，那么它们的错误将永远不会被正确地捕获和处理。与捕获和处理异常中的错误一样，错误的抛出异常已经导致了实际的关键错误。然而，据我们所知，还没有方法被提出用于推荐应该抛出哪个异常。异常在程序中被广泛采用，通常文档记录不佳，有时含义模糊，这使得抛出正确异常的规则变得相当复杂。一个项目团队使用异常的方式可能与另一个团队完全不同。因此，即使是有经验的程序员也可能难以确定应该抛出哪个异常，尽管他们具备实现其周围代码的技能。在本文中，我们提出了第一个方法ThEx，用于预测在给定编程上下文下应该抛出哪些异常。其基本思想是从源文件中现有的抛出异常中学习分类模型。这里，学习特征是从抛出异常周围的多种代码信息中提取的，例如抛出位置和相关变量名。然后，给定一个新的上下文，ThEx可以预测其最佳的异常。我们使用从九个流行的开源项目中收集的12,012个抛出异常对ThEx进行了评估。结果表明，它可以实现较高的F值和MCC值（均在0.8左右）。在此基准上，我们还评估了我们底层技术细节的影响。此外，我们在实际环境中评估了我们的方法，并使用ThEx来检测这九个项目最新版本中的异常。通过这种方式，我们发现20个异常，并将它们作为错误报告给其问题跟踪器。其中，18个已确认，13个已经被修复。

upstream_only.title: Titanium: efficient analysis of evolving alloy specifications
upstream_only.abstract: The Alloy specification language, and the corresponding Alloy Analyzer, have received much attention in the last two decades with applications in many areas of software engineering. Increasingly, formal analyses enabled by Alloy are desired for use in an on-line mode, where the specifications are automatically kept in sync with the running, possibly changing, software system. However, given Alloy Analyzer's reliance on computationally expensive SAT solvers, an important challenge is the time it takes for such analyses to execute at runtime. The fact that in an on-line mode, the analyses are often repeated on slightly revised versions of a given specification, presents us with an opportunity to tackle this challenge. We present Titanium, an extension of Alloy for formal analysis of evolving specifications. By leveraging the results from previous analyses, Titanium narrows the state space of the revised specification, thereby greatly reducing the required computational effort. We describe the semantic basis of Titanium in terms of models specified in relational logic. We show how the approach can be realized atop an existing relational logic model finder. Our experimental results show Titanium achieves a significant speed-up over Alloy Analyzer when applied to the analysis of evolving specifications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Alloy规范语言及对应的Alloy分析器在过去二十年中受到了广泛关注，并在软件工程的许多领域得到应用。越来越多的Alloy形式化分析希望以在线方式使用，即规范自动与运行中的、可能变化的软件系统保持同步。然而，由于Alloy分析器依赖计算昂贵的SAT求解器，一个重要的挑战是此类分析在运行时执行所需的时间。在在线模式下，分析通常针对同一规范的轻微修订版本重复进行，这为我们应对这一挑战提供了机会。我们提出了Titanium，一个用于演化规范形式化分析的Alloy扩展。通过利用先前分析的结果，Titanium缩小了修订后规范的状态空间，从而大大减少了所需的计算工作量。我们用关系逻辑中指定的模型描述了Titanium的语义基础，并展示了如何将这种方法实现在现有的关系逻辑模型查找器之上。实验结果表明，在应用于演化规范的分析时，Titanium相比Alloy分析器实现了显著的加速。

upstream_only.title: Mining performance specifications
upstream_only.abstract: Functional testing is widespread and supported by a multitude of tools, including tools to mine functional specifications. In contrast, non-functional attributes like performance are often less well understood and tested. While many profiling tools are available to gather raw performance data, interpreting this raw data requires expert knowledge and a thorough understanding of the underlying software and hardware infrastructure. In this work we present an approach that mines performance specifications from running systems autonomously. The tool creates performance models during runtime. The mined models are analyzed further to create compact and comprehensive performance assertions. The resulting assertions can be used as an evidence-based performance specification for performance regression testing, performance monitoring, or as a foundation for more formal performance specifications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 功能测试是普遍的，并受到众多工具的支持，包括用于挖掘功能规格的工具。相反，像性能这样的非功能属性往往不被充分理解和测试。虽然有许多分析工具可用于收集原始性能数据，但解释这些原始数据需要专家知识以及对底层软件和硬件基础设施的透彻理解。在本工作中，我们提出了一种从运行系统中自主挖掘性能规格的方法。该工具在运行时创建性能模型。进一步分析挖掘的模型，以创建紧凑且全面的性能断言。得到的断言可以用作性能回归测试、性能监控的循证性能规格，或作为更正式性能规格的基础。

upstream_only.title: Designing minimal effective normative systems with the help of lightweight formal methods
upstream_only.abstract: Normative systems (i.e., a set of rules) are an important approach to achieving effective coordination among (often an arbitrary number of) agents in multiagent systems. A normative system should be effective in ensuring the satisfaction of a desirable system property, and minimal (i.e., not containing norms that unnecessarily over-constrain the behaviors of agents). Designing or even automatically synthesizing minimal effective normative systems is highly non-trivial. Previous attempts on synthesizing such systems through simulations often fail to generate normative systems which are both minimal and effective. In this work, we propose a framework that facilitates designing of minimal effective normative systems using lightweight formal methods. Given a minimal effective normative system which coordinates many agents must be minimal and effective for a small number of agents, we start with automatically synthesizing one such system with a few agents. We then increase the number of agents so as to check whether the same design remains minimal and effective. If it is, we manually establish an induction proof so as to lift the design to an arbitrary number of agents.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 规范系统（即一组规则）是在多智能体系统中实现（通常是任意数量的）智能体之间有效协调的重要方法。一个规范系统应当有效确保理想系统属性的满足，并且是最小的（即不包含不必要地过度约束智能体行为的规范）。设计甚至自动综合最小有效规范系统是高度非平凡的。此前通过模拟综合此类系统的尝试往往无法生成既最小又有效的规范系统。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个利用轻量级形式化方法辅助设计最小有效规范系统的框架。给定一个用于协调许多智能体的最小有效规范系统，其必须对少数智能体也是最小有效的，我们首先从自动综合一个针对少量智能体的此类系统开始。然后我们增加智能体数量，以检查相同的设计是否仍然保持最小性和有效性。如果是，我们手动建立归纳证明，从而将该设计推广到任意数量的智能体。

upstream_only.title: Proteus: computing disjunctive loop summary via path dependency analysis
upstream_only.abstract: Loops are challenging structures for program analysis, especially when loops contain multiple paths with complex interleaving executions among these paths. In this paper, we first propose a classification of multi-path loops to understand the complexity of the loop execution, which is based on the variable updates on the loop conditions and the execution order of the loop paths. Secondly, we propose a loop analysis framework, named Proteus, which takes a loop program and a set of variables of interest as inputs and summarizes path-sensitive loop effects on the variables. The key contribution is to use a path dependency automaton (PDA) to capture the execution dependency between the paths. A DFS-based algorithm is proposed to traverse the PDA to summarize the effect for all feasible executions in the loop. The experimental results show that Proteus is effective in three applications: Proteus can 1) compute a more precise bound than the existing loop bound analysis techniques; 2) significantly outperform state-of-the-art tools for loop verification; and 3) generate test cases for deep loops within one second, while KLEE and Pex either need much more time or fail.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 循环对于程序分析而言是具挑战性的结构，尤其是当循环包含多条路径，并且这些路径之间存在复杂的交错执行时。本文首先提出了一种多路径循环的分类，以理解循环执行的复杂性，该分类基于循环条件上的变量更新和循环路径的执行顺序。其次，我们提出了一个循环分析框架Proteus，它将循环程序和一组感兴趣的变量作为输入，并总结路径敏感的循环对这些变量的影响。关键贡献在于使用路径依赖自动机（PDA）捕获路径之间的执行依赖关系。我们提出了一种基于DFS的算法来遍历PDA，以总结循环中所有可行执行的效果。实验结果表明Proteus在三个应用中有效：1）比现有循环界分析技术计算更精确的界；2）在循环验证方面明显优于最先进的工具；3）能在一秒内为深层循环生成测试用例，而KLEE和Pex需要更多时间或失败。

upstream_only.title: A cross-tool communication study on program analysis tool notifications
upstream_only.abstract: Program analysis tools use notifications to communicate with developers, but previous research suggests that developers encounter challenges that impede this communication. This paper describes a qualitative study that identifies 10 kinds of challenges that cause notifications to miscommunicate with developers. Our resulting notification communication theory reveals that many challenges span multiple tools and multiple levels of developer experience. Our results suggest that, for example, future tools that model developer experience could improve communication and help developers build more accurate mental models.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 程序分析工具使用通知与开发者沟通，但先前研究表明，开发者会遇到一些阻碍这种沟通的挑战。本文描述了一项定性研究，识别了导致通知与开发者沟通不畅的10种挑战。我们得出的通知沟通理论揭示，许多挑战跨越多个工具和多个开发者经验水平。我们的结果表明，例如，未来对开发者经验建模的工具可以改善沟通，并帮助开发者建立更准确的心智模型。

upstream_only.title: Factors influencing code review processes in industry
upstream_only.abstract: Code review is known to be an efficient quality assurance technique. Many software companies today use it, usually with a process similar to the patch review process in open source software development. However, there is still a large fraction of companies performing almost no code reviews at all. And the companies that do code reviews have a lot of variation in the details of their processes. For researchers trying to improve the use of code reviews in industry, it is important to know the reasons for these process variations. We have performed a grounded theory study to clarify process variations and their rationales. The study is based on interviews with software development professionals from 19 companies. These interviews provided insights into the reasons and influencing factors behind the adoption or non-adoption of code reviews as a whole as well as for different process variations. We have condensed these findings into seven hypotheses and a classification of the influencing factors. Our results show the importance of cultural and social issues for review adoption. They trace many process variations to differences in development context and in desired review effects.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 代码审查被认为是一种高效的质量保证技术。如今许多软件公司都在使用它，其流程通常类似于开源软件开发中的补丁审查过程。然而，仍有很大一部分公司几乎不进行代码审查。而且，进行代码审查的公司在流程细节上也存在很大差异。对于试图改进工业界代码审查使用情况的研究人员来说，了解这些流程差异的原因非常重要。我们进行了一项基于扎根理论的研究，以阐明流程差异及其背后的理由。该研究基于对来自19家公司的软件开发专业人士的访谈。这些访谈深入了解了整个代码审查采用或不采用的原因及影响因素，以及不同流程变异的原因与影响因素。我们将这些发现归纳为七个假设和影响因素分类。我们的结果显示了文化和社会问题对审查采纳的重要性，并将许多流程差异追溯到开发环境和期望审查效果的差异。

upstream_only.title: Foraging and navigations, fundamentally: developers' predictions of value and cost
upstream_only.abstract: Empirical studies have revealed that software developers spend 35\%–50\% of their time navigating through source code during development activities, yet fundamental questions remain: Are these percentages too high, or simply inherent in the nature of software development? Are there factors that somehow determine a lower bound on how effectively developers can navigate a given information space? Answering questions like these requires a theory that captures the core of developers' navigation decisions. Therefore, we use the central proposition of Information Foraging Theory to investigate developers' ability to predict the value and cost of their navigation decisions. Our results showed that over 50\% of developers' navigation choices produced less value than they had predicted and nearly 40\% cost more than they had predicted. We used those results to guide a literature analysis, to investigate the extent to which these challenges are met by current research efforts, revealing a new area of inquiry with a rich and crosscutting set of research challenges and open problems.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 实证研究表明，软件开发者在其开发活动中会花费35%—50%的时间在源代码中导航，然而一些根本性问题仍然存在：这些百分比是否过高，还是软件开发本身的特性使然？是否存在某些因素在某种程度上决定了开发者在给定信息空间中进行有效导航的下限？回答这类问题需要一种能够捕捉开发者导航决策核心的理论。因此，我们运用信息觅食理论的核心命题来研究开发者预测其导航决策价值与成本的能力。结果显示，超过50%的开发者导航选择所产生的价值低于其预测，而近40%的成本高于其预测。我们利用这些结果指导文献分析，以考察当前研究工作在多大程度上应对了这些挑战，从而揭示了一个具有丰富且交叉性研究挑战和开放性问题的全新研究领域。

upstream_only.title: How to break an API: cost negotiation and community values in three software ecosystems
upstream_only.abstract: Change introduces conflict into software ecosystems: breaking changes may ripple through the ecosystem and trigger rework for users of a package, but often developers can invest additional effort or accept opportunity costs to alleviate or delay downstream costs. We performed a multiple case study of three software ecosystems with different tooling and philosophies toward change, Eclipse, R/CRAN, and Node.js/npm, to understand how developers make decisions about change and change-related costs and what practices, tooling, and policies are used. We found that all three ecosystems differ substantially in their practices and expectations toward change and that those differences can be explained largely by different community values in each ecosystem. Our results illustrate that there is a large design space in how to build an ecosystem, its policies and its supporting infrastructure; and there is value in making community values and accepted tradeoffs explicit and transparent in order to resolve conflicts and negotiate change-related costs.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 变更将冲突引入软件生态系统：破坏性变更可能在生态系统中蔓延，为软件包的用户带来返工；但开发人员往往可以投入额外精力或接受机会成本来缓解或推迟下游成本。我们对三个具有不同变更工具和理念的软件生态系统（Eclipse、R/CRAN和Node.js/npm）进行了多案例研究，以了解开发人员如何就变更和变更相关成本做出决策，以及采用了哪些实践、工具和策略。我们发现，这三个生态系统在关于变更的实践和期望方面存在显著差异，而这些差异在很大程度上可以通过每个生态系统中不同的社区价值观来解释。我们的研究结果表明，如何构建生态系统、其政策和支持基础设施方面存在巨大的设计空间；同时，明确并透明地表达社区价值观和可接受的权衡，对于解决冲突和协商与变更相关的成本非常有价值。

upstream_only.title: Python predictive analysis for bug detection
upstream_only.abstract: Python is a popular dynamic language that allows quick software development. However, Python program analysis engines are largely lacking. In this paper, we present a Python predictive analysis. It first collects the trace of an execution, and then encodes the trace and unexecuted branches to symbolic constraints. Symbolic variables are introduced to denote input values, their dynamic types, and attribute sets, to reason about their variations. Solving the constraints identifies bugs and their triggering inputs. Our evaluation shows that the technique is highly effective in analyzing real-world complex programs with a lot of dynamic features and external library calls, due to its sophisticated encoding design based on traces. It identifies 46 bugs from 11 real-world projects, with 16 new bugs. All reported bugs are true positives.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Python是一种流行的动态语言，能够快速地进行软件开发。然而，Python程序分析引擎在很大程度上仍然缺乏。在本文中，我们提出了一种Python预测性分析。它首先收集一次执行的轨迹，然后将该轨迹和未执行的分支编码为符号约束。引入符号变量来表示输入值、其动态类型以及属性集合，以推理这些内容的变化。求解这些约束可以识别缺陷及其触发输入。我们的评估表明，由于基于轨迹的复杂编码设计，该技术在分析具有大量动态特性和外部库调用的真实世界复杂程序方面非常高效。它从11个真实世界项目中识别出46个缺陷，其中16个是新缺陷。所有报告的缺陷都是真阳性。

upstream_only.title: Crash consistency validation made easy
upstream_only.abstract: Software should behave correctly even in adverse conditions. Particularly, we study the problem of automated validation of crash consistency, i.e., file system data safety when systems crash. Existing work requires non-trivial manual efforts of specifying checking scripts and workloads, which is an obstacle for software developers. Therefore, we propose C3, a novel approach that makes crash consistency validation as easy as pressing a single button. With a program and an input, C3 automatically reports inconsistent crash sites. C3 not only exempts developers from the need of writing crash site checking scripts (by an algorithm that computes editing distance between file system snapshots) but also reduces the reliance on dedicated workloads (by test amplification). We implemented C3 as an open-source tool. With C3, we found 14 bugs in open-source software that have severe consequences at crash and 11 of them were previously unknown to the developers, including in highly mature software (e.g., GNU zip and GNU coreutils sort) and popular ones being actively developed (e.g., Adobe Brackets and TeXstudio).
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 软件即使在不利条件下也应正确运行。特别是，我们研究了崩溃一致性自动验证的问题，即系统崩溃时文件系统数据的安全性。现有工作需要大量手动指定检查脚本和工作负载，这对软件开发人员来说是一个障碍。因此，我们提出了C3，一种新颖的方法，使崩溃一致性验证就像按下一个按钮一样简单。有了程序和输入，C3自动报告不一致的崩溃点。C3不仅免除了开发人员编写崩溃点检查脚本的需要（通过计算文件系统快照之间的编辑距离的算法），而且通过测试放大减少了对专门工作负载的依赖。我们将C3实现为开源工具。借助C3，我们在开源软件中发现了14个在崩溃时后果严重的错误，其中11个是开发人员之前未知的，包括在高度成熟的软件（如GNU zip和GNU coreutils sort）和正在积极开发的流行软件（如Adobe Brackets和TeXstudio）中。

upstream_only.title: Discovering bug patterns in JavaScript
upstream_only.abstract: JavaScript has become the most popular language used by developers for client and server side programming. The language, however, still lacks proper support in the form of warnings about potential bugs in the code. Most bug finding tools in use today cover bug patterns that are discovered by reading best practices or through developer intuition and anecdotal observation. As such, it is still unclear which bugs happen frequently in practice and which are important for developers to be fixed. We propose a novel semi-automatic technique, called BugAID, for discovering the most prevalent and detectable bug patterns. BugAID is based on unsupervised machine learning using language-construct-based changes distilled from AST differencing of bug fixes in the code. We present a large-scale study of common bug patterns by mining 105K commits from 134 server-side JavaScript projects. We discover 219 bug fixing change types and discuss 13 pervasive bug patterns that occur across multiple projects and can likely be prevented with better tool support. Our findings are useful for improving tools and techniques to prevent common bugs in JavaScript, guiding tool integration for IDEs, and making developers aware of common mistakes involved with programming in JavaScript.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: JavaScript已成为开发人员用于客户端和服务器端编程的最流行语言。然而，该语言仍然缺乏以警告代码中潜在缺陷形式提供的适当支持。当今使用的大多数缺陷查找工具所覆盖的缺陷模式，是通过阅读最佳实践或通过开发者直觉和轶事观察发现的。因此，目前仍不清楚哪些缺陷在实际中频繁发生，以及哪些缺陷对开发人员来说需要修复。我们提出了一种名为BugAID的新型半自动技术，用于发现最普遍且可检测的缺陷模式。BugAID基于无监督机器学习，使用从代码缺陷修复的AST差异中提炼出的语言构造变更。我们通过挖掘134个服务器端JavaScript项目中的105K次提交，对常见缺陷模式进行了大规模研究。我们发现了219种缺陷修复变更类型，并讨论了13种跨多个项目普遍存在且可能通过更好的工具支持加以预防的缺陷模式。我们的发现有助于改进工具和技术以预防JavaScript中的常见缺陷，指导IDE的工具集成，并让开发人员意识到JavaScript编程中的常见错误。

upstream_only.title: Effort-aware just-in-time defect prediction: simple unsupervised models could be better than supervised models
upstream_only.abstract: Unsupervised models do not require the defect data to build the prediction models and hence incur a low building cost and gain a wide application range. Consequently, it would be more desirable for practitioners to apply unsupervised models in effort-aware just-in-time (JIT) defect prediction if they can predict defect-inducing changes well. However, little is currently known on their prediction effectiveness in this context. We aim to investigate the predictive power of simple unsupervised models in effort-aware JIT defect prediction, especially compared with the state-of-the-art supervised models in the recent literature. We first use the most commonly used change metrics to build simple unsupervised models. Then, we compare these unsupervised models with the state-of-the-art supervised models under cross-validation, time-wise-cross-validation, and across-project prediction settings to determine whether they are of practical value. The experimental results, from open-source software systems, show that many simple unsupervised models perform better than the state-of-the-art supervised models in effort-aware JIT defect prediction.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 无监督模型不需要缺陷数据来构建预测模型，因此构建成本低，应用范围广。因此，如果无监督模型能够很好地预测引入缺陷的变更，那么从业者更希望在努力感知的即时（JIT）缺陷预测中应用它们。然而，目前关于它们在此情境下的预测有效性知之甚少。我们旨在研究简单无监督模型在努力感知的即时缺陷预测中的预测能力，尤其是与近期文献中最先进的有监督模型相比。我们首先使用最常用的变更度量来构建简单的无监督模型。然后，我们在交叉验证、时间-wise交叉验证以及跨项目预测设置下，将这些无监督模型与最先进的有监督模型进行比较，以确定它们是否具有实用价值。来自开源软件系统的实验结果表明，许多简单的无监督模型在努力感知的即时缺陷预测中表现优于最先进的有监督模型。

upstream_only.title: Detecting sensitive data disclosure via bi-directional text correlation analysis
upstream_only.abstract: Traditional sensitive data disclosure analysis faces two challenges: to identify sensitive data that is not generated by specific API calls, and to report the potential disclosures when the disclosed data is recognized as sensitive only after the sink operations. We address these issues by developing BidText, a novel static technique to detect sensitive data disclosures. BidText formulates the problem as a type system, in which variables are typed with the text labels that they encounter (e.g., during key-value pair operations). The type system features a novel bi-directional propagation technique that propagates the variable label sets through forward and backward data-flow. A data disclosure is reported if a parameter at a sink point is typed with a sensitive text label. BidText is evaluated on 10,000 Android apps. It reports 4,406 apps that have sensitive data disclosures, with 4,263 apps having log based disclosures and 1,688 having disclosures due to other sinks such as HTTP requests. Existing techniques can only report 64.0\% of what BidText reports. And manual inspection shows that the false positive rate for BidText is 10\%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 传统的敏感数据泄露分析面临两个挑战：识别并非由特定API调用生成的敏感数据，以及在被泄露的数据仅在sink操作之后才被识别为敏感的情况下报告潜在的泄露。为解决这些问题，我们开发了BidText，这是一种新颖的静态技术，用于检测敏感数据泄露。BidText将问题形式化为一个类型系统，其中变量会根据其遇到的文本标签（例如，在键值对操作期间）被赋予相应的类型。该类型系统采用了一种新颖的双向传播技术，通过前向和后向数据流传播变量的标签集合。如果sink点的某个参数被标记为敏感文本标签，则报告存在数据泄露。我们在10,000个Android应用上评估了BidText。它报告了4,406个存在敏感数据泄露的应用，其中4,263个存在基于日志的泄露，1,688个存在因其他sink（如HTTP请求）导致的泄露。现有技术只能覆盖BidText报告结果的64.0%。人工检查表明，BidText的误报率为10%。

upstream_only.title: Multi-representational security analysis
upstream_only.abstract: Security attacks often exploit flaws that are not anticipated in an abstract design, but are introduced inadvertently when high-level interactions in the design are mapped to low-level behaviors in the supporting platform. This paper proposes a multi-representational approach to security analysis, where models capturing distinct (but possibly overlapping) views of a system are automatically composed in order to enable an end-to-end analysis. This approach allows the designer to incrementally explore the impact of design decisions on security, and discover attacks that span multiple layers of the system. This paper describes Poirot, a prototype implementation of the approach, and reports on our experience on applying Poirot to detect previously unknown security flaws in publicly deployed systems.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 安全攻击往往利用抽象设计中未预料到的缺陷，但这些缺陷是在高层设计交互映射到支撑平台的低层行为时无意引入的。本文提出了一种多表示的安全分析方法，其中捕获系统不同（但可能重叠）视图的模型被自动组合，以实现端到端分析。这种方法允许设计者逐步探索设计决策对安全性的影响，并发现跨多个系统层的攻击。本文描述了该方法的原型实现Poirot，并报告了我们将Poirot应用于检测公开部署系统中未知安全缺陷的经验。

upstream_only.title: String analysis for side channels with segmented oracles
upstream_only.abstract: We present an automated approach for detecting and quantifying side channels in Java programs, which uses symbolic execution, string analysis and model counting to compute information leakage for a single run of a program. We further extend this approach to compute information leakage for multiple runs for a type of side channels called segmented oracles, where the attacker is able to explore each segment of a secret (for example each character of a password) independently. We present an efficient technique for segmented oracles that computes information leakage for multiple runs using only the path constraints generated from a single run symbolic execution. Our implementation uses the symbolic execution tool Symbolic PathFinder (SPF), SMT solver Z3, and two model counting constraint solvers LattE and ABC. Although LattE has been used before for analyzing numeric constraints, in this paper, we present an approach for using LattE for analyzing string constraints. We also extend the string constraint solver ABC for analysis of both numeric and string constraints, and we integrate ABC in SPF, enabling quantitative symbolic string analysis.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种自动化方法，用于检测和量化Java程序中的侧信道，该方法结合符号执行、字符串分析和模型计数来计算程序单次运行的信息泄漏。我们进一步扩展该方法，针对一类称为分段预言机的侧信道计算多次运行的信息泄漏，其中攻击者能够独立地探测秘密的每个分段（例如密码的每个字符）。我们提出了一种高效的分段预言机技术，仅使用单次运行符号执行生成的路径约束即可计算多次运行的信息泄漏。我们的实现使用了符号执行工具Symbolic PathFinder (SPF)、SMT求解器Z3以及两个模型计数约束求解器LattE和ABC。虽然LattE此前曾用于分析数值约束，但在本文中我们提出了一种使用LattE分析字符串约束的方法。我们还扩展了字符串约束求解器ABC以支持数值和字符串约束的分析，并将ABC集成到SPF中，从而实现量化符号字符串分析。

upstream_only.title: WebRanz: web page randomization for better advertisement delivery and web-bot prevention
upstream_only.abstract: Nowadays, a rapidly increasing number of web users are using Ad-blockers to block online advertisements. Ad-blockers are browser-based software that can block most Ads on the websites, speeding up web browsers and saving bandwidth. Despite these benefits to end users, Ad-blockers could be catastrophic for the economic structure underlying the web, especially considering the rise of Ad-blocking as well as the number of technologies and services that rely exclusively on Ads to compensate their cost. In this paper, we introduce WebRanz that utilizes a randomization mechanism to circumvent Ad-blocking. Using WebRanz, content publishers can constantly mutate the internal HTML elements and element attributes of their web pages, without affecting their visual appearances and functionalities. Randomization invalidates the pre-defined patterns that Ad-blockers use to filter out Ads. Though the design of WebRanz is motivated by evading Ad-blockers, WebRanz also benefits the defense against bot scripts. We evaluate the effectiveness of WebRanz and its overhead using 221 randomly sampled top Alexa web pages and 8 representative bot scripts.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 如今，越来越多的网络用户使用广告拦截器来阻止在线广告。广告拦截器是基于浏览器的软件，可以阻止网站上的大多数广告，从而加快网页浏览速度并节省带宽。尽管这对终端用户有益，但广告拦截器对支撑网络的经济结构可能是灾难性的，尤其考虑到广告拦截的兴起以及完全依赖广告来补偿成本的技术和服务的数量。在本文中，我们介绍了WebRanz，它利用一种随机化机制来规避广告拦截。使用WebRanz，内容发布者可以不断改变其网页的内部HTML元素和元素属性，而不影响其视觉外观和功能。随机化使广告拦截器用于过滤广告的预定义模式失效。尽管WebRanz的设计动机是规避广告拦截器，但WebRanz也有助于防御僵尸脚本。我们使用221个随机抽样的Alexa顶级网页和8个代表性僵尸脚本评估了WebRanz的有效性及其开销。

upstream_only.title: A discrete-time feedback controller for containerized cloud applications
upstream_only.abstract: Modern Web applications exploit Cloud infrastructures to scale their resources and cope with sudden changes in the workload. While the state of practice is to focus on dynamically adding and removing virtual machines, we advocate that there are strong benefits in containerizing the applications and in scaling the containers. In this paper we present an autoscaling technique that allows containerized applications to scale their resources both at the VM level and at the container level. Furthermore, applications can combine this infrastructural adaptation with platform-level adaptation. The autoscaling is made possible by our planner, which consists of a grey-box discrete-time feedback controller. The work has been validated using two application benchmarks deployed to Amazon EC2. Our experiments show that our planner outperforms Amazon's AutoScaling by 78\% on average without containers; and that the introduction of containers allows us to improve by yet another 46\% on average.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代Web应用利用云基础设施来扩展其资源，并应对工作负载的突然变化。虽然当前实践侧重于动态添加和移除虚拟机，但我们主张将应用容器化并扩展容器具有显著优势。本文提出了一种自动扩展技术，使容器化应用能够在虚拟机层和容器层扩展资源。此外，应用可以将这种基础设施级自适应与平台级自适应相结合。该自动扩展功能由我们的规划器实现，该规划器由一个灰盒离散时间反馈控制器组成。该工作已使用部署在Amazon EC2上的两个应用基准进行了验证。我们的实验表明，在不使用容器的情况下，我们的规划器平均比Amazon的AutoScaling性能提升78%；而引入容器后，平均性能又额外提升了46%。

upstream_only.title: Keep it SIMPLEX: satisfying multiple goals with guarantees in control-based self-adaptive systems
upstream_only.abstract: An increasingly important concern of software engineers is handling uncertainties at design time, such as environment dynamics that may be difficult to predict or requirements that may change during operation. The idea of self-adaptation is to handle such uncertainties at runtime, when the knowledge becomes available. As more systems with strict requirements require self-adaptation, providing guarantees for adaptation has become a high-priority. Providing such guarantees with traditional architecture-based approaches has shown to be challenging. In response, researchers have studied the application of control theory to realize self-adaptation. However, existing control-theoretic approaches applied to adapt software systems have primarily focused on satisfying only a single adaptation goal at a time, which is often too restrictive for real applications. In this paper, we present Simplex Control Adaptation, SimCA, a new approach to self-adaptation that satisfies multiple goals, while being optimal with respect to an additional goal. SimCA offers robustness to measurement inaccuracy and environmental disturbances, and provides guarantees. We evaluate SimCA for two systems with strict requirements that have to deal with uncertainties: an underwater vehicle system used for oceanic surveillance, and a tele-assistance system for health care support.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 软件工程师日益关注的一个问题是在设计时处理不确定性，例如难以预测的环境动态或操作期间可能变化的需求。自适应的想法是在运行时处理这些不确定性，当知识变得可用时。随着更多具有严格要求的系统需要自适应，为适应提供保证已成为高优先级问题。传统的基于架构的方法在提供这种保证方面已被证明具有挑战性。作为回应，研究人员研究了应用控制理论来实现自适应。然而，现有的应用于软件系统自适应的控制理论方法主要专注于一次仅满足单个自适应目标，这往往对于实际应用过于受限。本文提出了Simplex控制自适应（SimCA），一种新的自适应方法，在满足多个目标的同时，相对于额外目标是最优的。SimCA对测量不准确和环境干扰具有鲁棒性，并提供保证。我们针对两个必须处理不确定性的严格要求的系统评估SimCA：用于海洋监视的水下航行器系统和用于医疗保健支持的远程辅助系统。

upstream_only.title: Automated change impact analysis between SysML models of requirements and design
upstream_only.abstract: An important activity in systems engineering is analyzing how a change in requirements will impact the design of a system. Performing this analysis manually is expensive, particularly for complex systems. In this paper, we propose an approach to automatically identify the impact of requirements changes on system design, when the requirements and design elements are expressed using models. We ground our approach on the Systems Modeling Language (SysML) due to SysML's increasing use in industrial applications. Our approach has two steps: For a given change, we first apply a static slicing algorithm to extract an estimated set of impacted model elements. Next, we rank the elements of the resulting set according to a quantitative measure designed to predict how likely it is for each element to be impacted. The measure is computed using Natural Language Processing (NLP) applied to the textual content of the elements. Engineers can then inspect the ranked list of elements and identify those that are actually impacted. We evaluate our approach on an industrial case study with 16 real-world requirements changes. Our results suggest that, using our approach, engineers need to inspect on average only 4.8\% of the entire design in order to identify the actually-impacted elements. We further show that our results consistently improve when our analysis takes into account both structural and behavioral diagrams rather than only structural ones, and the natural-language content of the diagrams in addition to only their structural and behavioral content.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 系统工程中一项重要活动是分析需求变更将如何影响系统设计。手动执行此分析成本高昂，尤其对于复杂系统。在本文中，我们提出了一种方法，当需求和设计元素以模型表达时，自动识别需求变更对系统设计的影响。由于SysML在工业应用中的日益普及，我们将方法基于系统建模语言(SysML)。我们的方法有两个步骤：对于给定的变更，首先应用静态切片算法提取一组估计受影响的模型元素；然后根据定量度量对结果集中的元素进行排序，该度量旨在预测每个元素受影响的可能性。该度量通过对元素的文本内容应用自然语言处理(NLP)来计算。工程师随后检查排序后的元素列表并识别实际受影响的元素。我们在包含16个真实世界需求变更的工业案例研究上评估了我们的方法。结果表明，使用我们的方法，工程师平均只需检查整个设计的4.8%就能识别实际受影响的元素。我们进一步表明，当我们的分析同时考虑结构图和行为图（而不仅仅是结构图），并考虑图的自然语言内容（而不仅仅是其结构和行为内容）时，结果持续改善。

upstream_only.title: Parameter-free probabilistic API mining across GitHub
upstream_only.abstract: Existing API mining algorithms can be difficult to use as they require expensive parameter tuning and the returned set of API calls can be large, highly redundant and difficult to understand. To address this, we present PAM (Probabilistic API Miner), a near parameter-free probabilistic algorithm for mining the most interesting API call patterns. We show that PAM significantly outperforms both MAPO and UPMiner, achieving 69\% test-set precision, at retrieving relevant API call sequences from GitHub. Moreover, we focus on libraries for which the developers have explicitly provided code examples, yielding over 300,000 LOC of hand-written API example code from the 967 client projects in the data set. This evaluation suggests that the hand-written examples actually have limited coverage of real API usages.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现有API挖掘算法往往难以使用，因为需要昂贵的参数调整，且返回的API调用集合可能庞大、高度冗余且难以理解。针对这一问题，我们提出了PAM（概率性API挖掘器），一种几乎无需参数的算法，用于挖掘最有趣的API调用模式。我们表明，PAM在从GitHub检索相关API调用序列时显著优于MAPO和UPMiner，测试集精确度达69%。此外，我们重点研究开发者明确提供代码示例的库，数据集中的967个客户端项目产生了超过30万行手写API示例代码。评估表明，手写示例实际上对真实API使用的覆盖有限。

upstream_only.title: API deprecation: a retrospective analysis and detection method for code examples on the web
upstream_only.abstract: Deprecation allows the developers of application programming interfaces (APIs) to signal to other developers that a given API item ought to be avoided. But little is known about deprecation practices beyond anecdotes. We examine how API deprecation has been used in 26 open source Java frameworks and libraries, finding that the classic deprecate–replace–remove cycle is often not followed, as many APIs were removed without prior deprecation, many deprecated APIs were subsequently un-deprecated, and removed APIs are even resurrected with surprising frequency. Furthermore, we identify several problems in the information commonly (not) provided to help API consumers transition their dependent code. As a consequence of deprecation, coding examples on the web --- an increasingly important source of information for developers --- can easily become outdated. Code examples that demonstrate how to use deprecated APIs can be difficult to disregard and a waste of time for developers. We propose a lightweight, version-sensitive framework to detect deprecated API usages in source code examples on the web so developers can be informed of such usages before they invest time and energy into studying them. We reify the framework as a prototype tool (Deprecation Watcher). Our evaluation on detecting deprecated Android API usages in code examples on Stack Overflow shows our tool obtains a precision of 100\% and a recall of 86\% in a random sample of 200 questions.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 弃用机制允许应用程序编程接口（API）的开发者向其他开发者发出信号，告知某一 API 项目应当避免使用。但除了一些轶事之外，人们对于弃用实践知之甚少。我们考察了弃用机制在 26 个开源 Java 框架和库中的使用情况，发现经典的“弃用-替换-移除”周期常常未被遵循，因为许多 API 在没有事先弃用的情况下就被移除，许多已弃用的 API 随后又被取消弃用，甚至被移除的 API 还以惊人的频率被重新启用。此外，我们还发现了在帮助 API 使用者迁移其依赖代码时通常（未）提供的信息中存在若干问题。由于弃用，网络上日益成为开发者重要信息来源的编码示例很容易过时。展示如何使用已弃用 API 的代码示例可能难以被忽视，而且会浪费开发者的时间。我们提出了一种轻量级、对版本敏感的框架，用于检测网络上源代码示例中已弃用 API 的使用情况，以便开发者在投入时间和精力研究这些示例之前获知相关信息。我们将该框架实现为原型工具（Deprecation Watcher）。我们使用该工具检测 Stack Overflow 代码示例中已弃用 Android API 使用情况的评估表明，在 200 个问题的随机样本中，该工具获得了 100% 的精确率和 86% 的召回率。

upstream_only.title: When should internal interfaces be promoted to public?
upstream_only.abstract: Commonly, software systems have public (and stable) interfaces, and internal (and possibly unstable) interfaces. Despite being discouraged, client developers often use internal interfaces, which may cause their systems to fail when they evolve. To overcome this problem, API producers may promote internal interfaces to public. In practice, however, API producers have no assistance to identify public interface candidates. In this paper, we study the transition from internal to public interfaces. We aim to help API producers to deliver a better product and API clients to benefit sooner from public interfaces. Our empirical investigation on five widely adopted Java systems present the following observations. First, we identified 195 promotions from 2,722 internal interfaces. Second, we found that promoted internal interfaces have more clients. Third, we predicted internal interface promotion with precision between 50\%-80\%, recall 26\%-82\%, and AUC 74\%-85\%. Finally, by applying our predictor on the last version of the analyzed systems, we automatically detected 382 public interface candidates.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 通常，软件系统拥有公共（且稳定）的接口以及内部（可能不稳定）的接口。尽管不鼓励，客户端开发者却经常使用内部接口，这可能导致其系统在接口演进时发生故障。为了克服这一问题，API 生产者可能会将内部接口晋升为公共接口。然而在实践中，API 生产者缺乏识别公共接口候选对象的辅助手段。在本文中，我们研究了从内部接口到公共接口的转变。我们的目标是帮助 API 生产者交付更好的产品，并帮助 API 客户端更早受益于公共接口。我们对五个广泛采用的 Java 系统进行的实证调查得出以下发现：首先，我们从 2,722 个内部接口中识别出 195 次晋升。其次，我们发现被晋升的内部接口拥有更多客户端。第三，我们以 50%-80% 的精确度、26%-82% 的召回率和 74%-85% 的 AUC 预测了内部接口的晋升。最后，通过将我们的预测器应用于所分析系统的最新版本，我们自动检测出 382 个公共接口候选对象。

upstream_only.title: POLLUX: safely upgrading dependent application libraries
upstream_only.abstract: Software evolution in third-party libraries across version upgrades can result in addition of new functionalities or change in existing APIs. As a result, there is a real danger of impairment of backward compatibility. Application developers, therefore, must keep constant vigil over library enhancements to ensure application consistency, i.e., application retains its semantic behavior across library upgrades. In this paper, we present the design and implementation of POLLUX, a framework to detect application-affecting changes across two versions of the same dependent non-adversarial library binary, and provide feedback on whether the application developer should link to the newer version or not. POLLUX leverages relevant application test cases to drive execution through both versions of the concerned library binary, records all concrete effects on the environment, and compares them to determine semantic similarity across the same API invocation for the two library versions. Our evaluation with 16 popular, open-source library binaries shows that POLLUX is accurate with no false positives and works across compiler optimizations.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 第三方库在版本升级过程中的软件演进可能导致新功能的添加或现有API的更改。因此，向后兼容性受损是一个真实的风险。应用程序开发者必须持续关注库的增强，以确保应用程序的一致性，即应用程序在库升级后保持其语义行为。在本文中，我们介绍了POLLUX的设计与实现，这是一个框架，用于检测同一非恶意依赖库二进制的两个版本之间的应用程序影响变更，并提供反馈以说明应用程序开发者是否应链接到较新版本。POLLUX利用相关的应用程序测试用例驱动两个版本的库二进制执行，记录对环境的所有具体影响，并比较它们以确定两个库版本在同一API调用上的语义相似性。我们在16个流行的开源库二进制上进行的评估表明，POLLUX准确且无误报，并可跨编译器优化工作。

upstream_only.title: Extracting instruction semantics via symbolic execution of code generators
upstream_only.abstract: Binary analysis and instrumentation form the basis of many tools and frameworks for software debugging, security hardening, and monitoring. Accurate modeling of instruction semantics is paramount in this regard, as errors can lead to program crashes, or worse, bypassing of security checks. Semantic modeling is a daunting task for modern processors such as x86 and ARM that support over a thousand instructions, many of them with complex semantics. This paper describes a new approach to automate this semantic modeling task. Our approach leverages instruction semantics knowledge that is already encoded into today's production compilers such as GCC and LLVM. Such an approach can greatly reduce manual effort, and more importantly, avoid errors introduced by manual modeling. Furthermore, it is applicable to any of the numerous architectures already supported by the compiler. In this paper, we develop a new symbolic execution technique to extract instruction semantics from a compiler's source code. Unlike previous applications of symbolic execution that were focused on identifying a single program path that violates a property, our approach addresses the all paths problem, extracting the entire input/output behavior of the code generator. We have applied it successfully to the 120K lines of C-code used in GCC's code generator to extract x86 instruction semantics. To demonstrate architecture-neutrality, we have also applied it to AVR, a processor used in the popular Arduino platform.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 二进制分析和插桩构成了许多软件调试、安全加固和监控工具及框架的基础。指令语义的准确建模为此至关重要，因为错误可能导致程序崩溃，甚至更糟——绕过安全检查。对于像x86和ARM这样支持超过一千条指令、其中许多具有复杂语义的现代处理器而言，语义建模是一项艰巨的任务。本文描述了一种自动化语义建模任务的新方法。我们的方法利用了已经编码在当今生产编译器（如GCC和LLVM）中的指令语义知识。这种方法可以大大减少人工工作量，更重要的是，避免了人工建模引入的错误。此外，它适用于编译器已支持的众多架构中的任何一种。在本文中，我们开发了一种新的符号执行技术，从编译器的源代码中提取指令语义。与以往侧重于识别违反属性的单一程序路径的符号执行应用不同，我们的方法解决了全路径问题，提取了代码生成器的完整输入/输出行为。我们已成功将其应用于GCC代码生成器所使用的12万行C代码，以提取x86指令语义。为证明其架构中立性，我们还将其应用于AVR——一种在流行的Arduino平台中使用的处理器。

upstream_only.title: Efficient generation of inductive validity cores for safety properties
upstream_only.abstract: Symbolic model checkers can construct proofs of properties over very complex models. However, the results reported by the tool when a proof succeeds do not generally provide much insight to the user. It is often useful for users to have traceability information related to the proof: which portions of the model were necessary to construct it. This traceability information can be used to diagnose a variety of modeling problems such as overconstrained axioms and underconstrained properties, and can also be used to measure completeness of a set of requirements over a model. In this paper, we present a new algorithm to efficiently compute the em inductive validity core (IVC) within a model necessary for inductive proofs of safety properties for sequential systems. The algorithm is based on the UNSAT core support built into current SMT solvers and a novel encoding of the inductive problem to try to generate a minimal inductive validity core. We prove our algorithm is correct, and describe its implementation in the JKind model checker for Lustre models. We then present an experiment in which we benchmark the algorithm in terms of speed, diversity of produced cores, and minimality, with promising results.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 符号模型检查器可以为非常复杂的模型构建性质的证明。然而，当证明成功时，工具报告的结果通常不会给用户提供太多洞见。通常用户需要与证明相关的可追溯性信息：模型的哪些部分对于构建证明是必要的。这些可追溯信息可用于诊断各种建模问题，如过度约束的公理和欠约束的性质，也可用于衡量模型上需求的完备性。在本文中，我们提出了一种新算法，以高效计算顺序系统安全性质归纳证明所需模型中的归纳有效核心（IVC）。该算法基于当前SMT求解器中内置的UNSAT核心支持，以及对归纳问题的一种新颖编码，以尝试生成最小的归纳有效核心。我们证明了我们的算法是正确的，并描述了其在用于Lustre模型的JKind模型检查器中的实现。然后，我们通过一个实验来基准测试该算法在速度、生成核心多样性以及最小性方面的表现，结果令人鼓舞。

upstream_only.title: Correctness witnesses: exchanging verification results between verifiers
upstream_only.abstract: Standard verification tools provide a counterexample to witness a specification violation, and, since a few years, such a witness can be validated by an independent validator using an exchangeable witness format. This way, information about the violation can be shared across verification tools and the user can use standard tools to visualize and explore witnesses. This technique is not yet established for the correctness case, where a program fulfills a specification. Even for simple programs, it is often difficult for users to comprehend why a given program is correct, and there is no way to independently check the verification result. We close this gap by complementing our earlier work on violation witnesses with correctness witnesses. While we use an extension of the established common exchange format for violation witnesses to represent correctness witnesses, the techniques for producing and validating correctness witnesses are different. The overall goal to make proofs available to engineers is probably as old as programming itself, and proof-carrying code was proposed two decades ago --- our goal is to make it practical: We consider witnesses as first-class exchangeable objects, stored independently from the source code and checked independently from the verifier that produced them, respecting the important principle of separation of concerns. At any time, the invariants from the correctness witness can be used to reconstruct a correctness proof to establish trust. We extended two state-of-the-art verifiers, CPAchecker and Ultimate Automizer, to produce and validate witnesses, and report that the approach is promising on a large set of verification tasks.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 标准验证工具提供反例来证明规范违规，并且自几年前以来，这种反例可以通过可交换的证人格式由独立的验证器进行验证。这样，违规信息可以在不同验证工具之间共享，用户可以使用标准工具来可视化和探索反例。然而，对于程序满足规范的正确性情况，这种技术尚未成熟。即使对于简单的程序，用户也常常难以理解为什么给定程序是正确的，并且无法独立检查验证结果。我们通过将先前关于违规证人的工作与正确性证人进行互补来填补这一空白。我们使用已建立的违规证人通用交换格式的扩展来表示正确性证人，但生成和验证正确性证人的技术是不同的。让工程师获得证明的总体目标可能与编程本身一样古老，而证明携带代码早在二十年前就被提出——我们的目标是使其实用化：我们将证人视为一级可交换对象，独立于源代码存储，并独立于生成它们的验证器进行检查，尊重关注点分离的重要原则。任何时候，来自正确性证人的不变式都可以用来重建正确性证明以建立信任。我们扩展了两种最先进的验证器CPAchecker和Ultimate Automizer来生成和验证证人，并报告该方法在一大批验证任务上是有前景的。

upstream_only.title: SMT-based verification of parameterized systems
upstream_only.abstract: It is well known that verification of safety properties of sequential programs is reducible to satisfiability modulo theory of a first-order logic formula, called a verification condition (VC). The reduction is used both in deductive and automated verification, the difference is only in whether the user or the solver provides candidates for inductive invariants. In this paper, we extend the reduction to parameterized systems consisting of arbitrary many copies of a user-specified process, and whose transition relation is definable in first-order logic modulo theory of linear arithmetic and arrays. We show that deciding whether a parameterized system has a universally quantified inductive invariant is reducible to satisfiability of (non-linear) Constraint Horn Clauses (CHC). As a consequence of our reduction, we obtain a new automated procedure for verifying parameterized systems using existing PDR and CHC engines. While the new procedure is applicable to a wide variety of systems, we show that it is a decision procedure for several decidable fragments.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 众所周知，顺序程序的安全性属性验证可归结为对一阶逻辑公式（称为验证条件，VC）的模理论可满足性判定。这种归约在演绎式和自动化验证中均有使用，区别仅在于归纳不变式的候选由用户提供还是由求解器提供。本文将这种归约扩展到参数化系统，此类系统包含任意多个用户指定进程的副本，且其转移关系可在线性算术与数组理论的模理论一阶逻辑中定义。我们证明了判定参数化系统是否存在全称量化的归纳不变式，可归结为对（非线性）约束Horn子句（CHC）的可满足性判定。作为该归约的结果，我们利用现有的PDR和CHC引擎获得了一个新的参数化系统自动化验证程序。虽然该新程序可应用于多种系统，但我们证明它对若干可判定片段是决策程序。

upstream_only.title: On-the-fly decomposition of specifications in software model checking
upstream_only.abstract: Major breakthroughs have increased the efficiency and effectiveness of software model checking considerably, such that this technology is now applicable to industrial-scale software. However, verifying the full formal specification of a software system is still considered too complex, and in practice, sets of properties are verified one by one in isolation. We propose an approach that takes the full formal specification as input and first tries to verify all properties simultaneously in one verification run. Our verification algorithm monitors itself and detects situations for which the full set of properties is too complex. In such cases, we perform an automatic decomposition of the full set of properties into smaller sets, and continue the verification seamlessly. To avoid state-space explosion for large sets of properties, we introduce on-the-fly property weaving: properties get weaved into the program's transition system on the fly, during the analysis; which properties to weave and verify is determined dynamically during the verification process. We perform an extensive evaluation based on verification tasks that were derived from 4336 Linux kernel modules, and a set of properties that define the correct usage of the Linux API. Checking several properties simultaneously can lead to a significant performance gain, due to the fact that abstract models share many parts among different properties.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 重大突破已显著提高了软件模型检测的效率和有效性，使这项技术如今可应用于工业规模的软件。然而，验证软件系统的完整形式化规范仍被认为过于复杂，在实践中，一组组属性通常会被隔离地逐一验证。我们提出了一种方法，该方法将完整形式化规范作为输入，并首先尝试在一次验证运行中同时验证所有属性。我们的验证算法对自身进行监控，并检测完整属性集过于复杂的情况。在这种情况下，我们自动将完整属性集分解为较小的集合，并无缝地继续验证。为避免大规模属性集的状态空间爆炸，我们引入了即时属性编织：在分析过程中，属性被即时编织到程序的转换系统中；编织和验证哪些属性在验证过程中动态决定。我们基于从4336个Linux内核模块推导出的验证任务以及一组定义Linux API正确使用方式的属性进行了广泛评估。同时检查多个属性可带来显著的性能提升，因为抽象模型在不同属性之间共享许多部分。

upstream_only.title: On well-separation of GR(1) specifications
upstream_only.abstract: Specifications for reactive synthesis, an automated procedure to obtain a correct-by-construction reactive system, consist of assumptions and guarantees. One way a controller may satisfy the specification is by preventing the environment from satisfying the assumptions, without satisfying the guarantees. Although valid this solution is usually undesired and specifications that allow it are called non-well-separated. In this work we investigate non-well-separation in the context of GR(1), an expressive fragment of LTL that enables efficient synthesis. We distinguish different cases of non-well-separation, and compute strategies showing how the environment can be forced to violate its assumptions. Moreover, we show how to find a core, a minimal set of assumptions that lead to non-well-separation, and further extend our work to support past-time LTL and patterns. We implemented our work and evaluated it on 79 specifications. The evaluation shows that non-well-separation is a common problem in specifications and that our tools can be efficiently applied to identify it and its causes.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 反应式综合是一种自动获得构造正确反应式系统的过程，其规范由假设和保证组成。控制器满足规范的一种方式是阻止环境满足假设而不满足保证。虽然这合法，但通常是不期望的，允许这种解的规范被称为非良好分离的。在本工作中，我们研究GR(1)（LTL的一个表达性片段，支持高效综合）中的非良好分离。我们区分非良好分离的不同情况，并计算显示如何迫使环境违反其假设的策略。此外，我们展示如何找到导致非良好分离的核心（一组最小假设），并进一步将我们的工作扩展到支持过去时LTL和模式。我们实现了我们的工作，并在79个规范上进行了评估。评估表明，非良好分离是规范中的常见问题，我们的工具可以有效地识别它及其原因。

upstream_only.title: Lightweight specification and analysis of dynamic systems with rich configurations
upstream_only.abstract: Model-checking is increasingly popular in the early phases of the software development process. To establish the correctness of a software design one must usually verify both structural and behavioral (or temporal) properties. Unfortunately, most specification languages, and accompanying model-checkers, excel only in analyzing either one or the other kind. This limits their ability to verify dynamic systems with rich configurations: systems whose state space is characterized by rich structural properties, but whose evolution is also expected to satisfy certain temporal properties. To address this problem, we first propose Electrum, an extension of the Alloy specification language with temporal logic operators, where both rich configurations and expressive temporal properties can easily be defined. Two alternative model-checking techniques are then proposed, one bounded and the other unbounded, to verify systems expressed in this language, namely to verify that every desirable temporal property holds for every possible configuration.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 模型检测在软件开发过程的早期阶段日益流行。要确立软件设计的正确性，通常必须同时验证结构属性和行为（或时序）属性。不幸的是，大多数规格说明语言及其配套模型检测器只擅长分析其中一种。这限制了它们验证具有丰富配置的动态系统的能力：此类系统的状态空间以丰富的结构属性为特征，但其演化也应满足某些时序属性。为解决此问题，我们首先提出Electrum，这是Alloy规格说明语言的一种扩展，加入了时序逻辑算子，从而可以轻松定义丰富的配置和表达性强的时序属性。随后提出两种替代性的模型检测技术，一种有界，一种无界，用于验证用该语言表示的系统，即验证每条期望的时序属性对所有可能的配置都成立。

upstream_only.title: Gray links in the use of requirements traceability
upstream_only.abstract: The value of traceability is in its use. How do different software engineering tasks affect the tracing of the same requirement? In this paper, we answer the question via an empirical study where we explicitly assign the participants into 3 trace-usage groups of one requirement: finding its implementation for verification and validation purpose, changing it within the original software system, and reusing it toward another application. The results uncover what we call "gray links"--around 20\% of the total traces are voted to be true links with respect to only one task but not the others. We provide a mechanism to identify such gray links and discuss how they can be leveraged to advance the research and practice of value-based requirements traceability.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 可追溯性的价值在于其使用。不同的软件工程任务如何影响对同一需求的可追溯性？在本文中，我们通过一项实证研究来回答这个问题，在该研究中，我们将参与者明确分配到三个需求追溯使用组：为验证和确认目的而查找其实现、在原始软件系统中对其进行修改，以及将其复用到另一个应用程序。结果揭示了我们所说的“灰色链接”——大约20%的追踪记录被投票认为仅相对于某一任务是真实链接，而相对于其他任务则不是。我们提供了一种识别此类灰色链接的机制，并讨论了如何利用它们来推进基于价值的需求可追溯性的研究和实践。

upstream_only.title: Understanding and detecting wake lock misuses for Android applications
upstream_only.abstract: Wake locks are widely used in Android apps to protect critical computations from being disrupted by device sleeping. Inappropriate use of wake locks often seriously impacts user experience. However, little is known on how wake locks are used in real-world Android apps and the impact of their misuses. To bridge the gap, we conducted a large-scale empirical study on 44,736 commercial and 31 open-source Android apps. By automated program analysis and manual investigation, we observed (1) common program points where wake locks are acquired and released, (2) 13 types of critical computational tasks that are often protected by wake locks, and (3) eight patterns of wake lock misuses that commonly cause functional and non-functional issues, only three of which had been studied by existing work. Based on our findings, we designed a static analysis technique, Elite, to detect two most common patterns of wake lock misuses. Our experiments on real-world subjects showed that Elite is effective and can outperform two state-of-the-art techniques.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 唤醒锁被广泛用于Android应用中，以保护关键计算不被设备休眠所干扰。唤醒锁的不当使用通常会严重影响用户体验。然而，关于唤醒锁在真实世界Android应用中如何被使用及其误用的影响，目前知之甚少。为了弥补这一差距，我们对44,736个商业应用和31个开源Android应用进行了大规模实证研究。通过自动化程序分析和人工调查，我们观察到（1）获取和释放唤醒锁的常见程序点，（2）通常受唤醒锁保护的13种关键计算任务，以及（3）八种常见的导致功能性和非功能性问题的唤醒锁误用模式，其中只有三种已被现有工作研究。基于我们的发现，我们设计了一种静态分析技术Elite来检测两种最常见的唤醒锁误用模式。我们在真实世界测试对象上的实验表明，Elite是有效的，并且能够超越两种最先进的技术。

upstream_only.title: DiagDroid: Android performance diagnosis via anatomizing asynchronous executions
upstream_only.abstract: Rapid UI responsiveness is a key consideration to Android app developers. However, the complicated concurrency model of Android makes it hard for developers to understand and further diagnose the UI performance. This paper presents DiagDroid, a tool specifically designed for Android UI performance diagnosis. The key notion of DiagDroid is that UI-triggered asynchronous executions contribute to the UI performance, and hence their performance and their runtime dependency should be properly captured to facilitate performance diagnosis. However, there are tremendous ways to start asynchronous executions, posing a great challenge to profiling such executions and their runtime dependency. To this end, we properly abstract five categories of asynchronous executions as the building basis. As a result, they can be tracked and profiled based on the specifics of each category with a dynamic instrumentation approach carefully tailored for Android. DiagDroid can then accordingly profile the asynchronous executions in a task granularity, equipping it with low-overhead and high compatibility merits. The tool is successfully applied in diagnosing 33 real-world open-source apps, and we find 14 of them contain 27 performance issues. It shows the effectiveness of our tool in Android UI performance diagnosis. The tool is open-source released online.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 快速的UI响应是Android应用开发者的关键考量。然而，Android复杂的并发模型使得开发者难以理解并进一步诊断UI性能。本文提出了DiagDroid，一个专为Android UI性能诊断设计的工具。DiagDroid的核心概念是，由UI触发的异步执行对UI性能有影响，因此应恰当地捕获其性能及运行时依赖以辅助性能诊断。然而，启动异步执行的方式多种多样，这给分析这类执行及其运行时依赖带来了巨大挑战。为此，我们合理抽象了五类异步执行作为构建基础，并据此结合为Android量身定制的动态插桩方法，对它们进行跟踪和分析。DiagDroid随后能以任务粒度剖析异步执行，从而具备低开销和高兼容性的优点。该工具已被成功用于诊断33个真实世界的开源应用，其中14个被发现存在27个性能问题。这显示了我们的工具在Android UI性能诊断中的有效性。该工具已在线上开源发布。

upstream_only.title: Minimizing GUI event traces
upstream_only.abstract: GUI input generation tools for Android apps, such as Android's Monkey, are useful for automatically producing test inputs, but these tests are generally orders of magnitude larger than necessary, making them difficult for humans to understand. We present a technique for minimizing the output of such tools. Our technique accounts for the non-deterministic behavior of mobile apps, producing small event traces that reach a desired activity with high probability. We propose a variant of delta debugging, augmented to handle non-determinism, to solve the problem of trace minimization. We evaluate our algorithm on two sets of commercial and open-source Android applications, showing that we can minimize large event traces reaching a particular application activity, producing traces that are, on average, less than 2\% the size of the original traces.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Android应用的GUI输入生成工具（如Android的Monkey）对于自动生成测试输入很有用，但这类测试通常比必要规模大出几个数量级，使人们难以理解。我们提出了一种最小化此类工具输出的技术。该技术考虑了移动应用的非确定性行为，产生能够以高概率到达目标活动的小规模事件轨迹。我们提出了一种变体的delta调试算法，并扩展以处理非确定性，从而解决轨迹最小化问题。我们在两组商业和开源Android应用上评估了我们的算法，表明我们可以最小化到达特定应用活动的庞大事件轨迹，产生的轨迹平均仅为原始轨迹规模的不到2%。

upstream_only.title: Causal impact analysis for app releases in google play
upstream_only.abstract: App developers would like to understand the impact of their own and their competitors’ software releases. To address this we introduce Causal Impact Release Analysis for app stores, and our tool, CIRA, that implements this analysis. We mined 38,858 popular Google Play apps, over a period of 12 months. For these apps, we identified 26,339 releases for which there was adequate prior and posterior time series data to facilitate causal impact analysis. We found that 33\% of these releases caused a statistically significant change in user ratings. We use our approach to reveal important characteristics that distinguish causal significance in Google Play. To explore the actionability of causal impact analysis, we elicited the opinions of app developers: 56 companies responded, 78\% concurred with the causal assessment, of which 33\% claimed that their company would consider changing its app release strategy as a result of our findings.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 应用开发者希望了解自己及竞争对手软件发布的影响。为此，我们引入了应用商店的因果影响发布分析，并实现了该分析工具CIRA。我们在12个月的期间内挖掘了38,858个热门Google Play应用。对于这些应用，我们识别出26,339次发布具有足够的前后时间序列数据以支持因果影响分析。我们发现这些发布中有33%导致了用户评级的统计学显著变化。我们利用该方法揭示了Google Play中区分因果显著性的重要特征。为了探索因果影响分析的可操作性，我们征求了应用开发者的意见：56家公司回应，其中78%同意因果评估，33%声称其公司会考虑根据我们的发现改变应用发布策略。

upstream_only.title: Static DOM event dependency analysis for testing web applications
upstream_only.abstract: The number and complexity of JavaScript-based web applications are rapidly increasing, but methods and tools for automatically testing them are lagging behind, primarily due to the difficulty in analyzing the subtle interactions between the applications and the event-driven execution environment. Although static analysis techniques have been routinely used on software written in traditional programming languages, such as Java and C++, adapting them to handle JavaScript code and the HTML DOM is difficult. In this work, we propose the first constraint-based declarative program analysis procedure for computing dependencies over program variables as well as event-handler functions of the various DOM elements, which is crucial for analyzing the behavior of a client-side web application. We implemented the method in a software tool named JSDEP and evaluated it in ARTEMIS, a platform for automated web application testing. Our experiments on a large set of web applications show the new method can significantly reduce the number of redundant test sequences and significantly increase test coverage with minimal overhead.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 基于JavaScript的Web应用的数量和复杂性正在迅速增加，但自动测试它们的方法和工具却滞后，主要困难在于分析应用与事件驱动执行环境之间的微妙交互。尽管静态分析技术已常被用于Java和C++等传统编程语言编写的软件，但将其适配以处理JavaScript代码和HTML DOM却具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们提出了第一个基于约束的声明式程序分析过程，用于计算程序变量以及各种DOM元素的事件处理函数之间的依赖关系，这对于分析客户端Web应用的行为至关重要。我们将该方法实现为名为JSDEP的软件工具，并在ARTEMIS自动化Web应用测试平台上进行评估。对大量Web应用的实验表明，新方法可以显著减少冗余测试序列的数量，并以最小开销显著提高测试覆盖率。

upstream_only.title: On-demand strong update analysis via value-flow refinement
upstream_only.abstract: We present a new Strong UPdate Analysis for C programs, called Supa, that enables computing points-to information on-demand via value-flow refinement, in environments with small time and memory budgets such as IDEs. We formulate Supa by solving a graph-reachability problem on a value- flow graph representation of the program, so that strong updates are performed where needed, as long as the total analysis budget is not exhausted. Supa facilitates efficiency and precision tradeoffs by allowing different pointer analyses to be applied in a hybrid multi-stage analysis framework. We have implemented Supa in LLVM with its artifact available at [1]. We evaluate Supa by choosing uninitialized pointer detection as a major client on 12 open-source C programs. As the analysis budget increases, Supa achieves improved precision, with its single-stage flow-sensitive analysis reaching 97\% of that achieved by whole-program flow- sensitive analysis by consuming about 0.19 seconds and 36KB of memory per query, on average (with a budget of at most 10000 value-flow edges per query).
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新的C程序强更新分析（Supa），通过值流细化实现按需计算指向信息，适用于IDE等时间和内存预算有限的环境。我们将Supa构建为在程序的值流图表示上求解图可达性问题，从而在总分析预算未耗尽的情况下，在需要的地方进行强更新。Supa通过允许不同的指针分析在混合多阶段分析框架中应用，从而在效率和精度之间进行权衡。我们已在LLVM中实现了Supa，其工件可在[1]处获得。我们选择未初始化指针检测作为主要客户端，对12个开源C程序进行了评估。随着分析预算的增加，Supa实现了精度的提高，其单阶段流敏感分析在平均每次查询消耗约0.19秒和36KB内存（最多10000条值流边预算）的情况下，达到了全程序流敏感分析精度的97%。

upstream_only.title: Call graph construction for Java libraries
upstream_only.abstract: Today, every application uses software libraries. Yet, while a lot of research exists w.r.t. analyzing applications, research that targets the analysis of libraries independent of any application is scarce. This is unfortunate, because, for developers of libraries, such as the Java Development Kit (JDK), it is crucial to ensure that the library behaves as intended regardless of how it is used. To fill this gap, we discuss the construction of call graphs for libraries that abstract over all potential library usages. Call graphs are particularly relevant as they are a precursor of many advanced analyses, such as inter-procedural data-flow analyses. We show that the current practice of using call graph algorithms designed for applications to analyze libraries leads to call graphs that, at the same time, lack relevant call edges and contain unnecessary edges. This motivates the need for call graph construction algorithms dedicated to libraries. Unlike algorithms for applications, call graph construction algorithms for libraries must take into consideration the goals of subsequent analyses. Specifically, we show that it is essential to distinguish between the scenario of an analysis for potential exploitable vulnerabilities from the scenario of an analysis for general software quality attributes, e.g., dead methods or unused fields. This distinction affects the decision about what constitutes the library-private implementation, which therefore, needs special treatment. Thus, building one call graph that satisfies all needs is not sensical. Overall, we observed that the proposed call graph algorithms reduce the number of call edges up to 30\% when compared to existing approaches.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 如今，每个应用程序都使用软件库。然而，尽管已有大量关于应用程序分析的研究，但针对独立于任何应用程序的库分析的研究却很少。这很遗憾，因为对于库的开发者（如Java开发工具包JDK）而言，确保库无论被如何使用都能按预期运行至关重要。为了填补这一空白，我们讨论了为库构建调用图的方法，这些调用图抽象了所有潜在的库用法。调用图尤其重要，因为它们是许多高级分析（如过程间数据流分析）的前驱。我们表明，目前使用为应用程序设计的调用图算法来分析库的做法，会导致调用图既缺少相关的调用边，又包含不必要的边。这激发了对专门用于库的调用图构建算法的需求。与针对应用程序的算法不同，针对库的调用图构建算法必须考虑后续分析的目标。具体而言，我们表明，区分“潜在可利用漏洞分析”和“一般软件质量属性（如死方法或未使用字段）分析”这两种场景至关重要。这种区分会影响对于什么是库私有实现（需要特殊处理）的决策。因此，构建一个满足所有需求的调用图是没有意义的。总体而言，我们观察到，与现有方法相比，所提出的调用图算法将调用边数量减少了多达30%。

upstream_only.title: Revamping JavaScript static analysis via localization and remediation of root causes of imprecision
upstream_only.abstract: Static analysis is challenged by the dynamic language constructs of JavaScript which often lead to unacceptable performance and/or precision results. We describe an approach that focuses on improving the practicality and accuracy of points-to analysis and call graph construction for JavaScript programs. The approach first identifies program constructs which are sources of imprecision (i.e., root causes) through monitoring the static analysis process. We then examine and suggest specific context-sensitive analyses to apply. Our technique is able to to find that the root causes comprise less than 2\% of the functions in JavaScript library applications. Moreover, the specialized analysis derived by our approach finishes within a few seconds, even on programs which can not complete within 10 minutes with the original analysis.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 静态分析受到JavaScript动态语言结构的挑战，这些结构常常导致难以接受的性能和/或精度结果。我们描述了一种专注于提高JavaScript程序指向分析和调用图构建的实用性与准确性的方法。该方法首先通过监控静态分析过程来识别导致不精确的程序结构（即根本原因）。然后我们检查并建议应用特定的上下文敏感分析。我们的技术能够发现，在JavaScript库应用程序中，根本原因涉及的函数不到2%。此外，通过我们的方法推导出的专门分析只需几秒即可完成，即使对于原始分析在10分钟内无法完成的程序也是如此。

upstream_only.title: What would users change in my app? summarizing app reviews for recommending software changes
upstream_only.abstract: Mobile app developers constantly monitor feedback in user reviews with the goal of improving their mobile apps and better meeting user expectations. Thus, automated approaches have been proposed in literature with the aim of reducing the effort required for analyzing feedback contained in user reviews via automatic classification/prioritization according to specific topics. In this paper, we introduce SURF (Summarizer of User Reviews Feedback), a novel approach to condense the enormous amount of information that developers of popular apps have to manage due to user feedback received on a daily basis. SURF relies on a conceptual model for capturing user needs useful for developers performing maintenance and evolution tasks. Then it uses sophisticated summarisation techniques for summarizing thousands of reviews and generating an interactive, structured and condensed agenda of recommended software changes. We performed an end-to-end evaluation of SURF on user reviews of 17 mobile apps (5 of them developed by Sony Mobile), involving 23 developers and researchers in total. Results demonstrate high accuracy of SURF in summarizing reviews and the usefulness of the recommended changes. In evaluating our approach we found that SURF helps developers in better understanding user needs, substantially reducing the time required by developers compared to manually analyzing user (change) requests and planning future software changes.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 移动应用开发者不断监控用户评论中的反馈，以期改进他们的移动应用并更好地满足用户期望。因此，文献中提出了自动化方法，旨在通过根据特定主题进行自动分类/排序来减少分析用户评论中反馈所需的工作量。本文介绍了SURF（用户反馈评论摘要器），这是一种新颖的方法，用于压缩热门应用开发者因每天收到用户反馈而需要管理的大量信息。SURF依靠一个概念模型来捕捉对执行维护和演进任务的开发者有用的用户需求。然后，它使用先进的摘要技术来总结数千条评论，并生成一个交互式、结构化且压缩的建议软件变更议程。我们对17个移动应用（其中5个由索尼移动开发）的用户评论进行了苏尔的端到端评估，共涉及23名开发者和研究人员。结果表明，SURF在总结评论方面具有高准确性，并且推荐的更改具有实用性。在评估我们的方法时，我们发现SURF帮助开发者更好地理解用户需求，与手动分析用户（变更）请求和规划未来软件更改相比，显著减少了开发者所需的时间。

upstream_only.title: API code recommendation using statistical learning from fine-grained changes
upstream_only.abstract: Learning and remembering how to use APIs is difficult. While code-completion tools can recommend API methods, browsing a long list of API method names and their documentation is tedious. Moreover, users can easily be overwhelmed with too much information. We present a novel API recommendation approach that taps into the predictive power of repetitive code changes to provide relevant API recommendations for developers. Our approach and tool, APIREC, is based on statistical learning from fine-grained code changes and from the context in which those changes were made. Our empirical evaluation shows that APIREC correctly recommends an API call in the first position 59\% of the time, and it recommends the correct API call in the top five positions 77\% of the time. This is a significant improvement over the state-of-the-art approaches by 30-160\% for top-1 accuracy, and 10-30\% for top-5 accuracy, respectively. Our result shows that APIREC performs well even with a one-time, minimal training dataset of 50 publicly available projects.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 学习和记住如何使用API是困难的。虽然代码补全工具可以推荐API方法，但浏览一长串API方法名称及其文档是繁琐的。此外，用户很容易被过多信息淹没。我们提出了一种新颖的API推荐方法，利用重复代码变化的预测能力来为开发者提供相关的API推荐。我们的方法和工具APIREC基于从细粒度代码变化及这些变化发生的上下文中进行的统计学习。我们的实证评估显示，APIREC在59%的情况下正确推荐了第一个API调用，在77%的情况下正确推荐了前五个API调用。与最先进的方法相比，这在前1准确率上提高了30-160%，在前5准确率上提高了10-30%。我们的结果表明，即使只使用一次性最小的50个公开可用项目的训练数据集，APIREC也表现良好。

upstream_only.title: TIPMerge: recommending experts for integrating changes across branches
upstream_only.abstract: Parallel development in branches is a common software practice. However, past work has found that integration of changes across branches is not easy, and often leads to failures. Thus far, there has been little work to recommend developers who have the right expertise to perform a branch integration. We propose TIPMerge, a novel tool that recommends developers who are best suited to perform merges, by taking into consideration developers’ past experience in the project, their changes in the branches, and de-pendencies among modified files in the branches. We evaluated TIPMerge on 28 projects, which included up to 15,584 merges with at least two developers, and potentially conflicting changes. On average, 85\% of the top-3 recommendations by TIPMerge correctly included the developer who performed the merge. Best (accuracy) results of recommendations were at 98\%. Our inter-views with developers of two projects reveal that in cases where the TIPMerge recommendation did not match the actual merge developer, the recommended developer had the expertise to per-form the merge, or was involved in a collaborative merge session.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在分支中进行并行开发是一种常见的软件实践。然而，先前的研究发现，跨分支的变更集成并不容易，常常导致失败。到目前为止，很少有研究来推荐具备适当专业知识的开发者去执行分支集成。我们提出了TIPMerge，一种新颖的工具，通过考虑开发者在该项目中的过往经验、他们在分支中的变更以及分支中修改文件之间的依赖关系，来推荐最适合执行合并的开发者。我们在28个项目上评估了TIPMerge，其中包括多达15,584次合并，涉及至少两名开发者以及可能存在的冲突变更。平均而言，TIPMerge的前3名推荐中有85%正确包含了实际执行合并的开发者。推荐的最佳（准确率）结果为98%。我们对两个项目的开发者进行的访谈表明，在TIPMerge推荐与实际合并开发者不匹配的情况下，被推荐的开发者具备执行合并的专业能力，或者参与了协作式合并会话。

upstream_only.title: Interactive and guided architectural refactoring with search-based recommendation
upstream_only.abstract: Architectural refactorings can contain hundreds of steps and experienced developers could carry them out over several weeks. Moreover, developers need to explore a correct sequence of refactorings steps among many more incorrect alternatives. Thus, carrying out architectural refactorings is costly, risky, and challenging. In this paper, we present Refactoring Navigator: a tool-supported and interactive recommendation approach for aiding architectural refactoring. Our approach takes a given implementation as the starting point, a desired high-level design as the target, and iteratively recommends a series of refactoring steps. Moreover, our approach allows the user to accept, reject, or ignore a recommended refactoring step, and uses the user's feedback in further refactoring recommendations. We evaluated the effectiveness of our approach and tool using a controlled experiment and an industrial case study. The controlled experiment shows that the participants who used Refactoring Navigator accomplished their tasks in 77.4\% less time and manually edited 98.3\% fewer lines than the control group. The industrial case study suggests that Refactoring Navigator has the potential to help with architectural refactorings in practice.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 架构重构可能包含数百个步骤，经验丰富的开发人员可能需要数周才能完成。此外，开发人员需要在众多错误的替代方案中探索出正确的重构步骤序列。因此，执行架构重构既昂贵、又有风险且充满挑战。在本文中，我们提出了Refactoring Navigator：一种支持工具且交互式的推荐方法，用于辅助架构重构。我们的方法以给定的实现为起点，以期望的高层设计为目标，迭代地推荐一系列重构步骤。此外，我们的方法允许用户接受、拒绝或忽略推荐的重构步骤，并在后续的重构推荐中使用用户的反馈。我们通过受控实验和工业案例研究评估了方法和工具的有效性。受控实验表明，与对照组相比，使用Refactoring Navigator的参与者完成任务的时间减少了77.4%，手动编辑的行数减少了98.3%。工业案例研究表明，Refactoring Navigator有望在实践中帮助进行架构重构。

upstream_only.title: Can testedness be effectively measured?
upstream_only.abstract: Among the major questions that a practicing tester faces are deciding where to focus additional testing effort, and deciding when to stop testing. Test the least-tested code, and stop when all code is well-tested, is a reasonable answer. Many measures of "testedness" have been proposed; unfortunately, we do not know whether these are truly effective. In this paper we propose a novel evaluation of two of the most important and widely-used measures of test suite quality. The first measure is statement coverage, the simplest and best-known code coverage measure. The second measure is mutation score, a supposedly more powerful, though expensive, measure. We evaluate these measures using the actual criteria of interest: if a program element is (by these measures) well tested at a given point in time, it should require fewer future bug-fixes than a "poorly tested" element. If not, then it seems likely that we are not effectively measuring testedness. Using a large number of open source Java programs from Github and Apache, we show that both statement coverage and mutation score have only a weak negative correlation with bug-fixes. Despite the lack of strong correlation, there are statistically and practically significant differences between program elements for various binary criteria. Program elements (other than classes) covered by any test case see about half as many bug-fixes as those not covered, and a similar line can be drawn for mutation score thresholds. Our results have important implications for both software engineering practice and research evaluation.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 实践中的测试人员面临的主要问题之一是如何决定将额外的测试工作集中在哪里，以及何时停止测试。一个合理的答案是：测试最少被测试的代码，并在所有代码都得到良好测试时停止。人们提出了许多衡量“测试充分性”的指标；遗憾的是，我们不知道这些指标是否真正有效。在本文中，我们提出对两个最重要且广泛使用的测试套件质量度量进行新颖的评估。第一个度量是语句覆盖率，这是最简单、最知名的代码覆盖率度量。第二个度量是变异得分，它被认为是一个更强大但代价昂贵的度量。我们使用实际关心的标准来评估这些度量：如果一个程序元素（根据这些度量）在某个时间点已经得到充分测试，那么它未来需要的缺陷修复次数应该少于“测试不足”的元素。如果不是这样，那么很可能我们并没有有效地测量测试充分性。我们使用来自GitHub和Apache的大量开源Java程序表明，语句覆盖率和变异得分与缺陷修复之间都只有微弱的负相关。尽管缺乏强相关性，但对于各种二元标准，程序元素之间存在统计上和实践上显著的差异。被任何测试用例覆盖的程序元素（类除外）所经历的缺陷修复次数约为未被覆盖元素的一半，对于变异得分阈值也存在类似的情况。我们的结果对软件工程实践和研究评估都具有重要意义。

upstream_only.title: A large-scale empirical comparison of static and dynamic test case prioritization techniques
upstream_only.abstract: The large body of existing research in Test Case Prioritization (TCP) techniques, can be broadly classified into two categories: dynamic techniques (that rely on run-time execution information) and static techniques (that operate directly on source and test code). Absent from this current body of work is a comprehensive study aimed at understanding and evaluating the static approaches and comparing them to dynamic approaches on a large set of projects. In this work, we perform the first extensive study aimed at empirically evaluating four static TCP techniques comparing them with state-of-research dynamic TCP techniques at different test-case granularities (e.g., method and class-level) in terms of effectiveness, efficiency and similarity of faults detected. This study was performed on 30 real-word Java programs encompassing 431 KLoC. In terms of effectiveness, we find that the static call-graph-based technique outperforms the other static techniques at test-class level, but the topic-model-based technique performs better at test-method level. In terms of efficiency, the static call-graph-based technique is also the most efficient when compared to other static techniques. When examining the similarity of faults detected for the four static techniques compared to the four dynamic ones, we find that on average, the faults uncovered by these two groups of techniques are quite dissimilar, with the top 10\% of test cases agreeing on only 25\% - 30\% of detected faults. This prompts further research into the severity/importance of faults uncovered by these techniques, and into the potential for combining static and dynamic information for more effective approaches.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现有的大量测试用例优先级排序（TCP）技术研究可大致分为两类：动态技术（依赖运行时执行信息）和静态技术（直接操作源代码和测试代码）。当前研究缺少一项旨在理解静态方法并用大规模项目将其与动态方法进行比较的综合研究。在这项工作中，我们首次对四种静态TCP技术与最新动态TCP技术在方法级和类级不同测试用例粒度下的有效性、效率和检测到故障的相似性进行了大规模实证评估。该研究在30个真实Java程序上进行，总计431千行代码。在有效性方面，我们发现基于静态调用图的技术在测试类级别优于其他静态技术，而基于主题模型的技术在测试方法级别表现更好。在效率方面，与其他静态技术相比，基于静态调用图的技术也是最高效的。在比较四种静态技术与四种动态技术检测到故障的相似性时，我们发现平均而言，这两类技术发现的故障相当不同，排名前10%的测试用例仅对25%至30%的已检测故障达成一致。这促进了关于这些技术所发现故障严重性/重要性以及结合静态和动态信息以实现更有效方法的进一步研究。

upstream_only.title: Analyzing the validity of selective mutation with dominator mutants
upstream_only.abstract: Various forms of selective mutation testing have long been accepted as valid approximations to full mutation testing. This paper presents counterevidence to traditional selective mutation. The recent development of dominator mutants and minimal mutation analysis lets us analyze selective mutation without the noise introduced by the redundancy inherent in traditional mutation. We then exhaustively evaluate all small sets of mutation operators for the Proteum mutation system and determine dominator mutation scores and required work for each of these sets on an empirical test bed. The results show that all possible selective mutation approaches have poor dominator mutation scores on at least some of these programs. This suggests that to achieve high performance with respect to full mutation analysis, selective approaches will have to become more sophisticated, possibly by choosing mutants based on the specifics of the artifact under test, that is, specialized selective mutation.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 长期以来，各种形式的选择性变异测试一直被视为完整变异测试的有效近似方法。本文提出了与传统选择性变异测试相悖的反例证据。支配变异体和最小变异分析的发展使我们能够在不引入传统变异测试固有冗余所带来的噪声的情况下分析选择性变异测试。然后，我们穷尽评估了Proteum变异系统中所有小规模变异算子组合，并在经验测试台上为这些组合确定了支配变异分数和所需工作量。结果表明，所有可能的选择性变异测试方法至少在某些程序上具有较差的支配变异分数。这表明，为了在完整变异分析方面达到高性能，选择性方法必须变得更加复杂，可能的方式是根据被测工件的具体特征来选择变异体，即专门化的选择性变异测试。

upstream_only.title: An extensive study of static regression test selection in modern software evolution
upstream_only.abstract: Regression test selection (RTS) aims to reduce regression testing time by only re-running the tests affected by code changes. Prior research on RTS can be broadly split into dy namic and static techniques. A recently developed dynamic RTS technique called Ekstazi is gaining some adoption in practice, and its evaluation shows that selecting tests at a coarser, class-level granularity provides better results than selecting tests at a finer, method-level granularity. As dynamic RTS is gaining adoption, it is timely to also evaluate static RTS techniques, some of which were proposed over three decades ago but not extensively evaluated on modern software projects. This paper presents the first extensive study that evaluates the performance benefits of static RTS techniques and their safety; a technique is safe if it selects to run all tests that may be affected by code changes. We implemented two static RTS techniques, one class-level and one method-level, and compare several variants of these techniques. We also compare these static RTS techniques against Ekstazi, a state-of-the-art, class-level, dynamic RTS technique. The experimental results on 985 revisions of 22 open-source projects show that the class-level static RTS technique is comparable to Ekstazi, with similar performance benefits, but at the risk of being unsafe sometimes. In contrast, the method-level static RTS technique performs rather poorly.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 回归测试选择（RTS）旨在通过只重新运行受代码更改影响的测试来减少回归测试时间。以往关于RTS的研究大致可分为动态技术和静态技术。最近开发的一种名为Ekstazi的动态RTS技术正在实践领域中获得一定采用，其评估表明，在较粗粒度的类级别上选择测试比在较细粒度的方法级别上选择测试效果更好。随着动态RTS逐渐得到采用，评估静态RTS技术也正合时宜，其中一些技术虽然早在三十多年前就已提出，但尚未在现代软件项目上进行广泛评估。本文首次对静态RTS技术的性能优势和安全性进行了大规模评估；所谓安全的技术是指它应选择运行所有可能受到代码更改影响的测试。我们实现了两种静态RTS技术（一种类级别、一种方法级别），并比较了这些技术的多个变体。我们还将这些静态RTS技术与Ekstazi（一种最先进的类级别动态RTS技术）进行了比较。对22个开源项目的985个修订版本的实验结果表明，类级别静态RTS技术可与Ekstazi相媲美，具有相似的性能优势，但有时可能不安全。相比之下，方法级别静态RTS技术的表现则相当糟糕。
