upstream_only.title: PerfGuard: binary-centric application performance monitoring in production environments
upstream_only.abstract: Diagnosis of performance problems is an essential part of software development and maintenance. This is in particular a challenging problem to be solved in the production environment where only program binaries are available with limited or zero knowledge of the source code. This problem is compounded by the integration with a significant number of third-party software in most large-scale applications. Existing approaches either require source code to embed manually constructed logic to identify performance problems or support a limited scope of applications with prior manual analysis. This paper proposes an automated approach to analyze application binaries and instrument the binary code transparently to inject and apply performance assertions on application transactions. Our evaluation with a set of large-scale application binaries without access to source code discovered 10 publicly known real world performance bugs automatically and shows that PerfGuard introduces very low overhead (less than 3\% on Apache and MySQL server) to production systems.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 性能问题的诊断是软件开发和维护的重要组成部分。在生产环境中，只有程序二进制可用，对源代码的了解有限或为零，这使得该问题的解决尤其具有挑战性。在大多数大型应用中，与大量第三方软件的集成更加剧了这一问题。现有方法要么需要源代码来嵌入手工构建的逻辑以识别性能问题，要么在事先进行手动分析的前提下支持有限范围的应用。本文提出了一种自动化方法，分析应用程序二进制文件并对二进制代码进行透明插桩，以在应用程序事务上注入和应用性能断言。我们使用一组无法获取源代码的大型应用程序二进制文件进行了评估，自动发现了10个公开已知的真实世界性能bug，并表明PerfGuard为生产系统带来的开销极低（在Apache和MySQL服务器上低于3%）。

upstream_only.title: Python probabilistic type inference with natural language support
upstream_only.abstract: We propose a novel type inference technique for Python programs. Type inference is difficult for Python programs due to their heavy dependence on external APIs and the dynamic language features. We observe that Python source code often contains a lot of type hints such as attribute accesses and variable names. However, such type hints are not reliable. We hence propose to use probabilistic inference to allow the beliefs of individual type hints to be propagated, aggregated, and eventually converge on probabilities of variable types. Our results show that our technique substantially outperforms a state-of-the-art Python type inference engine based on abstract interpretation.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种针对Python程序的新型类型推断技术。由于Python程序对外部API和动态语言特性的严重依赖，类型推断对Python程序而言很困难。我们观察到Python源代码通常包含大量类型提示，如属性访问和变量名。然而，这类类型提示并不可靠。因此，我们提出使用概率推断来使各个类型提示的信念得以传播、聚合，并最终收敛到变量类型的概率上。我们的结果表明，我们的技术显著优于基于抽象解释的最先进的Python类型推断引擎。

upstream_only.title: Detecting and fixing precision-specific operations for measuring floating-point errors
upstream_only.abstract: The accuracy of the floating-point calculation is critical to many applications and different methods have been proposed around floating-point accuracies, such as detecting the errors in the program, verifying the accuracy of the program, and optimizing the program to produce more accurate results. These approaches need a specification of the program to understand the ideal calculation performed by the program, which is usually approached by interpreting the program in a precision-unspecific way. However, many operations programmed in existing code are inherently precision-specific, which cannot be easily interpreted in a precision-unspecific way. In fact, the semantics used in existing approaches usually fail to interpret precision-specific operations correctly. In this paper, we present a systematic study on precision-specific operations. First, we propose a detection approach to detect precision-specific operations. Second, we propose a fixing approach to enable the tuning of precisions under the presence of precision-specific operations. Third, we studied the precision-specific operations in the GNU C standard math library based on our detection and fixing approaches. Our results show that (1) a significant number of code fragments in the standard C math library are precision-specific operations, and some large inaccuracies reported in existing studies are false positives or potential false positives due to precision-specific operations; (2) our detection approach has high precision and recall; (3) our fixing approach can lead to overall more accurate result.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 浮点计算的准确性对许多应用至关重要，围绕浮点精度已经提出了各种方法，例如检测程序中的错误、验证程序的准确性，以及优化程序以产生更准确的结果。这些方法需要程序的规范来理解程序所执行的理想计算，通常通过以精度无关的方式解释程序来实现。然而，现有代码中编写的许多操作本质上是与精度相关的，难以以精度无关的方式解释。实际上，现有方法中使用的语义通常无法正确解释精度特定操作。在本文中，我们对精度特定操作进行了系统研究。首先，我们提出了一种检测方法来识别精度特定操作。其次，我们提出了一种修复方法，使得在存在精度特定操作的情况下能够调整精度。第三，我们基于我们的检测和修复方法研究了GNU C标准数学库中的精度特定操作。结果表明：（1）标准C数学库中有大量代码片段属于精度特定操作，现有研究中报告的一些较大不准确性是由于精度特定操作导致的误报或潜在误报；（2）我们的检测方法具有高精确率和召回率；（3）我们的修复方法能够实现整体更准确的结果。

upstream_only.title: Deep API learning
upstream_only.abstract: Developers often wonder how to implement a certain functionality (e.g., how to parse XML files) using APIs. Obtaining an API usage sequence based on an API-related natural language query is very helpful in this regard. Given a query, existing approaches utilize information retrieval models to search for matching API sequences. These approaches treat queries and APIs as bags-of-words and lack a deep understanding of the semantics of the query. We propose DeepAPI, a deep learning based approach to generate API usage sequences for a given natural language query. Instead of a bag-of-words assumption, it learns the sequence of words in a query and the sequence of associated APIs. DeepAPI adapts a neural language model named RNN Encoder-Decoder. It encodes a word sequence (user query) into a fixed-length context vector, and generates an API sequence based on the context vector. We also augment the RNN Encoder-Decoder by considering the importance of individual APIs. We empirically evaluate our approach with more than 7 million annotated code snippets collected from GitHub. The results show that our approach generates largely accurate API sequences and outperforms the related approaches.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 开发人员经常想知道如何使用API实现某个特定功能（例如，如何解析XML文件）。根据与API相关的自然语言查询获得API使用序列在这方面非常有帮助。给定一个查询，现有方法利用信息检索模型搜索匹配的API序列。这些方法将查询和API视为词袋，缺乏对查询语义的深入理解。我们提出DeepAPI，一种基于深度学习的方法，为给定的自然语言查询生成API使用序列。它不是基于词袋假设，而是学习查询中的单词序列和相关的API序列。DeepAPI改编了一种名为RNN Encoder-Decoder的神经语言模型。它将单词序列（用户查询）编码为固定长度的上下文向量，并根据上下文向量生成API序列。我们还通过考虑各个API的重要性来增强RNN Encoder-Decoder。我们使用从GitHub收集的超过700万个带注释的代码片段对方法进行了实证评估。结果表明，我们的方法生成的API序列在很大程度上是准确的，并且优于相关方法。

upstream_only.title: Build system with lazy retrieval for Java projects
upstream_only.abstract: In the modern-day development, projects use Continuous Integration Services (CISs) to execute the build for every change in the source code. To ensure that the project remains correct and deployable, a CIS performs a clean build each time. In a clean environment, a build system needs to retrieve the project's dependencies (e.g., guava.jar). The retrieval, however, can be costly due to dependency bloat: despite a project using only a few files from each library, the existing build systems still eagerly retrieve all the libraries at the beginning of the build. This paper presents a novel build system, Molly, which lazily retrieves parts of libraries (i.e., files) that are needed during the execution of a build target. For example, the compilation target needs only public interfaces of classes within the libraries and the test target needs only implementation of the classes that are being invoked by the tests. Additionally, Molly generates a transfer script that retrieves parts of libraries based on prior builds. Molly's design requires that we ignore the boundaries set by the library developers and look at the files within the libraries. We implemented Molly for Java and evaluated it on 17 popular open-source projects. We show that test targets (on average) depend on only 9.97\% of files in libraries. A variant of Molly speeds up retrieval by 44.28\%. Furthermore, the scripts generated by Molly retrieve dependencies, on average, 93.81\% faster than the Maven build system.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在当今的开发中，项目使用持续集成服务（CIS）对源代码的每次更改执行构建。为了确保项目保持正确且可部署，CIS每次都会执行干净构建。在干净环境中，构建系统需要检索项目的依赖项（例如 guava.jar）。然而，由于依赖膨胀，检索可能非常昂贵：尽管项目只使用了每个库中的几个文件，现有构建系统仍在构建开始时急切地检索所有库。本文提出了一种新颖的构建系统 Molly，它惰性检索构建目标执行期间所需的库的部分内容（即文件）。例如，编译目标只需要库中类的公共接口，而测试目标只需要测试所调用的类的实现。此外，Molly 会基于先前构建生成一个传输脚本，用于检索库的部分内容。Molly 的设计要求我们忽略库开发者设定的边界，转而查看库中的文件。我们用 Java 实现了 Molly，并在 17 个流行的开源项目上进行了评估。我们表明，测试目标（平均）只依赖库中文件的 9.97%。Molly 的一个变体将检索速度提高了 44.28%。此外，Molly 生成的脚本平均比 Maven 构建系统快 93.81% 地检索依赖项。

upstream_only.title: iGen: dynamic interaction inference for configurable software
upstream_only.abstract: To develop, analyze, and evolve today's highly configurable software systems, developers need deep knowledge of a system's configuration options, e.g., how options need to be set to reach certain locations, what configurations to use for testing, etc. Today, acquiring this detailed information requires manual effort that is difficult, expensive, and error prone. In this paper, we propose iGen, a novel, lightweight dynamic analysis technique that automatically discovers a program's interactions---expressive logical formulae that give developers rich and detailed information about how a system's configuration option settings map to particular code coverage. iGen employs an iterative algorithm that runs a system under a small set of configurations, capturing coverage data; processes the coverage data to infer potential interactions; and then generates new configurations to further refine interactions in the next iteration. We evaluated iGen on 29 programs spanning five languages; the breadth of this study would be unachievable using prior interaction inference tools. Our results show that iGen finds precise interactions based on a very small fraction of the number of possible configurations. Moreover, iGen's results confirm several earlier hypotheses about typical interaction distributions and structures.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 为了开发、分析和演化当今高度可配置的软件系统，开发人员需要深入了解系统的配置选项，例如如何设置选项才能到达特定代码位置、测试时应使用哪些配置等。如今，获取这些详细信息需要手动操作，这些操作困难、昂贵且容易出错。在本文中，我们提出iGen，一种新颖的轻量级动态分析技术，能够自动发现程序中的交互——这些表达性的逻辑公式能为开发人员提供关于系统配置选项设置如何映射到特定代码覆盖的丰富而详细的信息。iGen采用迭代算法，在少量配置下运行系统并捕获覆盖数据，处理覆盖数据以推断潜在交互，然后生成新配置以在下一轮迭代中进一步细化交互。我们在涵盖五种语言的29个程序上对iGen进行了评估；这种广度是先前交互推断工具无法实现的。我们的结果表明，iGen基于可能配置数量中极小的一部分就能找到精确的交互。此外，iGen的结果证实了先前关于典型交互分布和结构的若干假设。

upstream_only.title: CacheOptimizer: helping developers configure caching frameworks for hibernate-based database-centric web applications
upstream_only.abstract: To help improve the performance of database-centric cloud-based web applications, developers usually use caching frameworks to speed up database accesses. Such caching frameworks require extensive knowledge of the application to operate effectively. However, all too often developers have limited knowledge about the intricate details of their own application. Hence, most developers find configuring caching frameworks a challenging and time-consuming task that requires extensive and scattered code changes. Furthermore, developers may also need to frequently change such configurations to accommodate the ever changing workload. In this paper, we propose CacheOptimizer, a lightweight approach that helps developers optimize the configuration of caching frameworks for web applications that are implemented using Hibernate. CacheOptimizer leverages readily-available web logs to create mappings between a workload and database accesses. Given the mappings, CacheOptimizer discovers the optimal cache configuration using coloured Petri nets, and automatically adds the appropriate cache configurations to the application. We evaluate CacheOptimizer on three open-source web applications. We find that i) CacheOptimizer improves the throughput by 27--138\%; and ii) after considering both the memory cost and throughput improvement, CacheOptimizer still brings statistically significant gains (with mostly large effect sizes) in comparison to the application's default cache configuration and to blindly enabling all possible caches.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 为了帮助提高以数据库为中心的基于云的Web应用程序的性能，开发者通常使用缓存框架来加速数据库访问。此类缓存框架需要深入了解应用程序才能有效运行。然而，开发者往往对自己应用程序的复杂细节了解有限。因此，大多数开发者认为配置缓存框架是一项具有挑战性且耗时的任务，需要进行大量分散的代码更改。此外，开发者可能还需要频繁更改这些配置以适应不断变化的工作负载。在本文中，我们提出CacheOptimizer，一种轻量级方法，帮助开发者优化使用Hibernate实现的Web应用程序的缓存框架配置。CacheOptimizer利用现成的Web日志创建工作负载与数据库访问之间的映射。基于该映射，CacheOptimizer使用着色Petri网发现最优缓存配置，并自动为应用程序添加适当的缓存配置。我们在三个开源Web应用程序上评估了CacheOptimizer。我们发现：i) CacheOptimizer将吞吐量提高了27%至138%；ii) 在兼顾内存成本和吞吐量提升后，与应用程序的默认缓存配置以及盲目启用所有可能的缓存相比，CacheOptimizer仍然带来了统计上显著的收益（多数情况下效应量较大）。

upstream_only.title: BinGo: cross-architecture cross-OS binary search
upstream_only.abstract: Binary code search has received much attention recently due to its impactful applications, e.g., plagiarism detection, malware detection and software vulnerability auditing. However, developing an effective binary code search tool is challenging due to the gigantic syntax and structural differences in binaries resulted from different compilers, architectures and OSs. In this paper, we propose BINGO — a scalable and robust binary search engine supporting various architectures and OSs. The key contribution is a selective inlining technique to capture the complete function semantics by inlining relevant library and user-defined functions. In addition, architecture and OS neutral function filtering is proposed to dramatically reduce the irrelevant target functions. Besides, we introduce length variant partial traces to model binary functions in a program structure agnostic fashion. The experimental results show that BINGO can find semantic similar functions across architecture and OS boundaries, even with the presence of program structure distortion, in a scalable manner. Using BINGO, we also discovered a zero-day vulnerability in Adobe PDF Reader, a COTS binary.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 二进制代码搜索近年来因诸多重要应用而备受关注，例如代码抄袭检测、恶意软件检测和软件漏洞审计。然而，由于不同编译器、架构和操作系统导致二进制文件在语法和结构上存在巨大差异，开发有效的二进制代码搜索工具颇具挑战性。在本文中，我们提出了BINGO——一个可扩展、稳健的二进制搜索引擎，支持多种架构和操作系统。其关键贡献是选择性内联技术，通过内联相关库函数和用户自定义函数来捕获完整的函数语义。此外，我们提出了架构和操作系统无关的函数过滤方法，以大幅减少无关目标函数；还引入了长度变体部分轨迹，以不依赖程序结构的方式建模二进制函数。实验结果表明，BINGO即使在程序结构扭曲的情况下也能跨架构和操作系统边界可扩展地找到语义相似函数。我们还使用BINGO在COTS二进制Adobe PDF Reader中发现了一个零日漏洞。

upstream_only.title: Relationship-aware code search for JavaScript frameworks
upstream_only.abstract: JavaScript frameworks, such as jQuery, are widely used for developing web applications. To facilitate using these JavaScript frameworks to implement a feature (e.g., functionality), a large number of programmers often search for code snippets that implement the same or similar feature. However, existing code search approaches tend to be ineffective, without taking into account the fact that JavaScript code snippets often implement a feature based on various relationships (e.g., sequencing, condition, and callback relationships) among the invoked framework API methods. To address this issue, we present a novel Relationship-Aware Code Search (RACS) approach for finding code snippets that use JavaScript frameworks to implement a specific feature. In advance, RACS collects a large number of code snippets that use some JavaScript frameworks, mines API usage patterns from the collected code snippets, and represents the mined patterns with method call relationship (MCR) graphs, which capture framework API methods’ signatures and their relationships. Given a natural language (NL) search query issued by a programmer, RACS conducts NL processing to automatically extract an action relationship (AR) graph, which consists of actions and their relationships inferred from the query. In this way, RACS reduces code search to the problem of graph search: finding similar MCR graphs for a given AR graph. We conduct evaluations against representative real-world jQuery questions posted on Stack Overflow, based on 308,294 code snippets collected from over 81,540 files on the Internet. The evaluation results show the effectiveness of RACS: the top 1 snippet produced by RACS matches the target code snippet for 46\% questions, compared to only 4\% achieved by a relationship-oblivious approach.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: JavaScript框架（如jQuery）被广泛用于开发Web应用程序。为了便于使用这些JavaScript框架实现某个功能，大量程序员经常搜索实现相同或相似功能的代码片段。然而，现有的代码搜索方法往往效果不佳，因为它们没有考虑到JavaScript代码片段通常基于所调用框架API方法之间的各种关系（例如，顺序、条件和回调关系）来实现功能。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的关系感知代码搜索（RACS）方法，用于查找使用JavaScript框架实现特定功能的代码片段。RACS预先收集大量使用某些JavaScript框架的代码片段，从中挖掘API使用模式，并使用方法调用关系（MCR）图表示挖掘出的模式，该图捕获框架API方法的签名及其关系。给定程序员发出的自然语言（NL）搜索查询，RACS进行自然语言处理以自动提取动作关系（AR）图，该图由从查询中推断出的动作及其关系组成。这样，RACS将代码搜索简化为图搜索问题：为给定的AR图查找相似的MCR图。我们基于从互联网上超过81,540个文件中收集的308,294个代码片段，对Stack Overflow上具有代表性的真实jQuery问题进行了评估。评估结果显示了RACS的有效性：RACS生成的前1个代码片段与46%问题的目标代码片段匹配，而关系无关的方法仅为4%。

upstream_only.title: Code relatives: detecting similarly behaving software
upstream_only.abstract: Detecting “similar code” is useful for many software engineering tasks. Current tools can help detect code with statically similar syntactic and–or semantic features (code clones) and with dynamically similar functional input/output (simions). Unfortunately, some code fragments that behave similarly at the finer granularity of their execution traces may be ignored. In this paper, we propose the term “code relatives” to refer to code with similar execution behavior. We define code relatives and then present DyCLINK, our approach to detecting code relatives within and across codebases. DyCLINK records instruction-level traces from sample executions, organizes the traces into instruction-level dynamic dependence graphs, and employs our specialized subgraph matching algorithm to efficiently compare the executions of candidate code relatives. In our experiments, DyCLINK analyzed 422+ million prospective subgraph matches in only 43 minutes. We compared DyCLINK to one static code clone detector from the community and to our implementation of a dynamic simion detector. The results show that DyCLINK effectively detects code relatives with a reasonable analysis time.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 检测“相似代码”对许多软件工程任务非常有用。现有工具可以帮助检测具有静态相似语法和/或语义特征的代码（代码克隆），以及具有动态相似功能输入/输出的代码（simion）。不幸的是，一些在执行轨迹的细粒度上行为相似的代码片段可能被忽略。在本文中，我们提出术语“代码亲属”来指代具有相似执行行为的代码。我们定义了代码亲属，然后提出了DyCLINK，一种在代码库内部和跨代码库中检测代码亲属的方法。DyCLINK记录样本执行时的指令级轨迹，将轨迹组织成指令级动态依赖图，并采用专用的子图匹配算法来有效比较候选代码亲属的执行。在我们的实验中，DyCLINK仅在43分钟内分析了超过4.22亿个潜在子图匹配。我们将DyCLINK与社区中的一种静态代码克隆检测器和我们实现的一种动态simion检测器进行了比较。结果表明，DyCLINK能够在合理的分析时间内有效检测代码亲属。

upstream_only.title: Understanding and generating high quality patches for concurrency bugs
upstream_only.abstract: Concurrency bugs are time-consuming to fix correctly by developers and a severe threat to software reliability. Although many auto-fixing techniques have been proposed recently for concurrency bugs, there is still a big gap between the quality of automatically generated patches and manually designed ones. This paper first conducts an in-depth study of manual patches for 77 real-world concurrency bugs, which provides both assessments for existing techniques and actionable suggestions for future research. Guided by this study, a new tool HFix is designed. It can automatically generate patches, which have matching quality as manual patches, for many concurrency bugs.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 并发错误对于开发者来说耗时且难以正确修复，并且严重威胁软件可靠性。尽管近年来针对并发错误提出了许多自动修复技术，但自动生成的补丁与人工设计的补丁之间仍存在很大差距。本文首先对77个真实世界并发错误的人工补丁进行深入研究，为现有技术提供评估并为未来研究提供可行建议。在该研究的指导下，设计了一个新工具HFix，它可以为许多并发错误自动生成与人工补丁质量相当的补丁。

upstream_only.title: Anti-patterns in search-based program repair
upstream_only.abstract: Search-based program repair automatically searches for a program fix within a given repair space. This may be accomplished by retrofitting a generic search algorithm for program repair as evidenced by the GenProg tool, or by building a customized search algorithm for program repair as in SPR. Unfortunately, automated program repair approaches may produce patches that may be rejected by programmers, because of which past works have suggested using human-written patches to produce templates to guide program repair. In this work, we take the position that we will not provide templates to guide the repair search because that may unduly restrict the repair space and attempt to overfit the repairs into one of the provided templates. Instead, we suggest the use of a set of anti-patterns --- a set of generic forbidden transformations that can be enforced on top of any search-based repair tool. We show that by enforcing our anti-patterns, we obtain repairs that localize the correct lines or functions, involve less deletion of program functionality, and are mostly obtained more efficiently. Since our set of anti-patterns are generic, we have integrated them into existing search based repair tools, including GenProg and SPR, thereby allowing us to obtain higher quality program patches with minimal effort.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 基于搜索的程序修复会在给定的修复空间内自动搜索程序修复方案。这可以通过改造通用搜索算法来实现（如 GenProg 工具），也可以像 SPR 中那样为程序修复构建定制化搜索算法。不幸的是，自动化程序修复方法可能生成让程序员拒绝的补丁，因此过往工作建议使用人工编写的补丁来生成模板以指导修复。在这项工作中，我们采取的立场是不提供模板来引导修复搜索，因为那样可能不当地限制修复空间，并试图将修复过度拟合到给定模板之一。相反，我们建议使用一组反模式——即一组通用的禁止变换，可叠加于任何基于搜索的修复工具之上。我们表明，通过强制执行我们的反模式，所得到的修复能够定位正确的代码行或函数，涉及更少程序功能的删除，并且大多能更高效地获得。由于我们的反模式集具有通用性，我们已将其集成到现有基于搜索的修复工具中，包括 GenProg 和 SPR，从而以最小代价获得更高质量的程序补丁。

upstream_only.title: Semi-supervised verified feedback generation
upstream_only.abstract: Students have enthusiastically taken to online programming lessons and contests. Unfortunately, they tend to struggle due to lack of personalized feedback. There is an urgent need of program analysis and repair techniques capable of handling both the scale and variations in student submissions, while ensuring quality of feedback. Towards this goal, we present a novel methodology called semi-supervised verified feedback generation. We cluster submissions by solution strategy and ask the instructor to identify or add a correct submission in each cluster. We then verify every submission in a cluster against the instructor-validated submission in the same cluster. If faults are detected in the submission then feedback suggesting fixes to them is generated. Clustering reduces the burden on the instructor and also the variations that have to be handled during feedback generation. The verified feedback generation ensures that only correct feedback is generated. We implemented a tool, named CoderAssist, based on this approach and evaluated it on dynamic programming assignments. We have designed a novel counter-example guided feedback generation algorithm capable of suggesting fixes to all faults in a submission. In an evaluation on 2226 submissions to 4 problems, CoderAssist could generate verified feedback for 1911 (85\%) submissions in 1.6s each on an average. It does a good job of reducing the burden on the instructor. Only one submission had to be manually validated or added for every 16 submissions.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 学生们热衷于在线编程课程和竞赛，但往往因缺乏个性化反馈而感到吃力。因此亟需能够处理学生提交的规模与多样性、同时确保反馈质量的程序分析与修复技术。为实现这一目标，我们提出了一种名为“半监督的已验证反馈生成”的新方法。我们按解题策略对提交进行聚类，并请教师在每个聚类中识别或添加一个正确提交。然后，我们将每个聚类中的全部提交与该聚类内经教师验证的提交进行对比验证。如果在提交中检测到错误，则生成建议修复这些错误的反馈。聚类减少了教师的负担，也减少了反馈生成过程中需要应对的多样性。已验证反馈生成确保了只生成正确的反馈。我们基于该方法实现了一个名为CoderAssist的工具，并在动态规划作业上进行了评估。我们设计了一种新颖的、基于反例引导的反馈生成算法，能够针对提交中的所有错误给出修复建议。在4个问题的2226份提交的评估中，CoderAssist能够为1911份（85%）提交生成已验证反馈，平均每份耗时1.6秒。该工具在减轻教师负担方面表现良好，平均每16份提交仅需人工验证或添加1份。

upstream_only.title: WATERFALL: an incremental approach for repairing record-replay tests of web applications
upstream_only.abstract: Software engineers use record/replay tools to capture use case scenarios that can serve as regression tests for web applications. Such tests, however, can be brittle in the face of code changes. Thus, researchers have sought automated approaches for repairing broken record/replay tests. To date, such approaches have operated by directly analyzing differences between the releases of web applications. Often, however, intermediate versions or commits exist between releases, and these represent finer-grained sequences of changes by which new releases evolve. In this paper, we present WATERFALL, an incremental test repair approach that applies test repair techniques iteratively across a sequence of fine-grained versions of a web application. The results of an empirical study on seven web applications show that our approach is substantially more effective than a coarse-grained approach (209\% overall), while maintaining an acceptable level of overhead.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 软件工程师使用录制/回放工具来捕获可作为Web应用回归测试的用例场景。然而，此类测试在代码变更面前可能很脆弱。因此，研究人员一直在寻求自动修复损坏的录制/回放测试的方法。迄今为止，这些方法通常通过直接分析Web应用发布版本之间的差异来操作。然而，在版本发布之间往往存在中间版本或提交，这些代表了新版本演变的更细粒度的变更序列。在本文中，我们提出了WATERFALL，一种增量式测试修复方法，该方法在一系列细粒度的Web应用版本中迭代应用测试修复技术。对七个Web应用进行实证研究的结果表明，我们的方法比粗粒度方法有效得多（总体提高209%），同时保持了可接受的开销水平。

upstream_only.title: Efficiency of projectional editing: a controlled experiment
upstream_only.abstract: Projectional editors are editors where a user's editing actions directly change the abstract syntax tree without using a parser. They promise essentially unrestricted language com position as well as flexible notations, which supports aligning languages with their respective domain and constitutes an essential ingredient of model-driven development. Such editors have existed since the 1980s and gained widespread attention with the Intentional Programming paradigm, which used projectional editing at its core. However, despite the benefits, programming still mainly relies on editing textual code, where projectional editors imply a very different -- typically perceived as worse -- editing experience, often seen as the main challenge prohibiting their widespread adoption. We present an experiment of code-editing activities in a projectional editor, conducted with 19 graduate computer-science students and industrial developers. We investigate the effects of projectional editing on editing efficiency, editing strategies, and error rates -- each of which we also compare to conventional, parser-based editing. We observe that editing is efficient for basic-editing tasks, but that editing strategies and typical errors differ. More complex tasks require substantial experience and a better understanding of the abstract-syntax-tree structure -- then, projectional editing is also efficient. We also witness a tradeoff between fewer typing mistakes and an increased complexity of code editing.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 投影式编辑器是一种用户编辑操作直接改变抽象语法树而无需使用解析器的编辑器。它们承诺实现几乎不受限制的语言组合以及灵活的表示法，这有助于使语言与其各自领域保持一致，并构成模型驱动开发的关键要素。这类编辑器自20世纪80年代就已存在，并随着以投影式编辑为核心的自编程（Intentional Programming）范式而受到广泛关注。然而，尽管有这些好处，编程仍然主要依赖文本代码编辑，而投影式编辑意味着一种截然不同——通常被认为更差——的编辑体验，这常被视为阻碍其广泛采用的主要挑战。我们展示了一项在投影式编辑器中进行的代码编辑活动实验，实验对象为19名计算机科学研究生和工业开发者。我们研究了投影式编辑对编辑效率、编辑策略和错误率的影响——这些也都与传统基于解析器的编辑进行了比较。我们观察到，对于基本编辑任务，编辑是高效的，但编辑策略和典型错误有所不同。更复杂的任务需要丰富的经验和对抽象语法树结构的更好理解——在这种情况下，投影式编辑也是高效的。我们还见证了打字错误减少与代码编辑复杂性增加之间的权衡。

upstream_only.title: ECHO: instantaneous in situ race detection in the IDE
upstream_only.abstract: We present ECHO, a new technique that detects data races instantaneously in the IDE while developers code. ECHO is the first technique of its kind for incremental race detection supporting both code addition and deletion in the IDE. Unlike conventional static race detectors, ECHO warns developers of potential data races immediately as they are introduced into the program. The core underpinning ECHO is a set of new change-aware static analyses based on a novel static happens-before graph that, given a program change, efficiently compute the change-relevant information without re-analyzing the whole program. Our evaluation within a Java environment on both popular benchmarks and real- world applications shows promising results: for each code addition, or deletion, ECHO can instantly pinpoint all the races in a few milliseconds on average, three to four orders of magnitude faster than a conventional whole-program race detector with the same precision.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了ECHO，一种在开发者编码时于集成开发环境（IDE）中即时检测数据竞争的新技术。ECHO是首个支持IDE中代码添加和删除的增量式竞态检测技术。与传统静态竞态检测器不同，ECHO会在潜在数据竞争引入程序时立即向开发者发出警告。ECHO的核心基础是一组基于新型静态happens-before图的变化感知静态分析，给定程序变更，该图能高效计算与变更相关的信息，而无需重新分析整个程序。我们在Java环境中对流行的基准测试和真实应用的评估显示了令人鼓舞的结果：对于每次代码添加或删除，ECHO平均能在几毫秒内即时定位所有竞态，比具有相同精度的传统全程序竞态检测器快三到四个数量级。

upstream_only.title: Detecting table clones and smells in spreadsheets
upstream_only.abstract: Spreadsheets are widely used by end users for various business tasks, such as data analysis and financial reporting. End users may perform similar tasks by cloning a block of cells (table) in their spreadsheets. The corresponding cells in these cloned tables are supposed to keep the same or similar computational semantics. However, when spreadsheets evolve, thus cloned tables can become inconsistent due to ad-hoc modifications, and as a result suffer from smells. In this paper, we propose TableCheck to detect table clones and related smells due to inconsistency among them. We observe that two tables with the same header information at their corresponding cells are likely to be table clones. Inspired by existing fingerprint-based code clone detection techniques, we developed a detection algorithm to detect this kind of table clones. We further detected outliers among corresponding cells as smells in the detected table clones. We implemented our idea into TableCheck, and applied it to real-world spreadsheets from the EUSES corpus. Experimental results show that table clones commonly exist (21.8\%), and 25.6\% of the spreadsheets with table clones suffer from smells due to inconsistency among these clones. TableCheck detected table clones and their smells with a precision of 92.2\% and 85.5\%, respectively, while existing techniques detected no more than 35.6\% true smells that TableCheck could detect.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 电子表格被最终用户广泛用于各种业务任务，如数据分析和财务报告。最终用户可能会通过克隆其电子表格中的单元格块（表格）来执行类似的任务。这些克隆表格中的对应单元格应当保持相同或相似的计算语义。然而，当电子表格演变时，由于临时性的修改，克隆表格可能变得不一致，从而产生坏味。在本文中，我们提出了TableCheck来检测表格克隆以及由于它们之间的不一致性导致的相关坏味。我们观察到，在对应单元格具有相同表头信息的两个表格很可能是表格克隆。受现有基于指纹的代码克隆检测技术的启发，我们开发了一种检测算法来检测此类表格克隆。我们进一步将对应单元格中的异常点作为检测到的表格克隆中的坏味进行检测。我们将这一想法实现为TableCheck，并将其应用于EUSES语料库中的真实电子表格。实验结果表明，表格克隆普遍存在（21.8%），并且有25.6%的含有表格克隆的电子表格因克隆间的不一致性而存在坏味。TableCheck检测表格克隆及其坏味的精确率分别为92.2%和85.5%，而现有技术最多只能检测出TableCheck能够检测出的真实坏味的35.6%。

upstream_only.title: Flow-sensitive composition of thread-modular abstract interpretation
upstream_only.abstract: We propose a constraint-based flow-sensitive static analysis for concurrent programs by iteratively composing thread-modular abstract interpreters via the use of a system of lightweight constraints. Our method is compositional in that it first applies sequential abstract interpreters to individual threads and then composes their results. It is flow-sensitive in that the causality ordering of interferences (flow of data from global writes to reads) is modeled by a system of constraints. These interference constraints are lightweight since they only refer to the execution order of program statements as opposed to their numerical properties: they can be decided efficiently using an off-the-shelf Datalog engine. Our new method has the advantage of being more accurate than existing, flow-insensitive, static analyzers while remaining scalable and providing the expected soundness and termination guarantees even for programs with unbounded data. We implemented our method and evaluated it on a large number of benchmarks, demonstrating its effectiveness at increasing the accuracy of thread-modular abstract interpretation.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于约束的流敏感并发程序静态分析方法，通过使用轻量级约束系统迭代地组合线程模块化抽象解释器。该方法是组合式的，首先将顺序抽象解释器应用于各个线程，然后组合它们的结果。它是流敏感的，因为干扰的因果顺序（从全局写入到读取的数据流）通过约束系统建模。这些干扰约束是轻量级的，因为它们仅涉及程序语句的执行顺序，而非数值属性：可以使用现成的Datalog引擎高效判定。我们的新方法相比现有的流不敏感静态分析器更精确，同时保持可扩展性，并且即使对于具有无界数据的程序也能提供预期的可靠性和终止保证。我们实现了该方法，并在大量基准测试上进行了评估，证明了其在提高线程模块化抽象解释准确性方面的有效性。

upstream_only.title: A deployable sampling strategy for data race detection
upstream_only.abstract: Dynamic data race detection incurs heavy runtime overheads. Recently, many sampling techniques have been proposed to detect data races. However, some sampling techniques (e.g., Pacer) are based on traditional happens-before relation and incur a large basic overhead. Others utilize hardware to reduce their sampling overhead (e.g., DataCollider) and they, however, detect a race only when the race really occurs by delaying program executions. In this paper, we study the limitations of existing techniques and propose a new data race definition, named as Clock Races, for low overhead sampling purpose. The innovation of clock races is that the detection of them does not rely on concrete locks and also avoids heavy basic overhead from tracking happens-before relation. We further propose CRSampler (Clock Race Sampler) to detect clock races via hardware based sampling without directly delaying program executions, to further reduce runtime overhead. We evaluated CRSampler on Dacapo benchmarks. The results show that CRSampler incurred less than 5\% overhead on average at 1\% sampling rate. Whereas, Pacer and DataCollider incurred larger than 25\% and 96\% overhead, respectively. Besides, at the same sampling rate, CRSampler detected significantly more data races than that by Pacer and DataCollider.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 动态数据竞争检测会带来沉重的运行时开销。近年来，人们提出了许多采样技术来检测数据竞争。然而，一些采样技术（如Pacer）基于传统的happens-before关系，会产生较大的基本开销。另一些技术则利用硬件来降低采样开销（如DataCollider），但它们通过延迟程序执行来检测竞争，因此只有在竞争真正发生时才能检测到。本文研究了现有技术的局限性，并提出了一种新的数据竞争定义，称为时钟竞争（Clock Races），用于低开销采样目的。时钟竞争的创新之处在于，其检测不依赖于具体的锁，也避免了对happens-before关系进行跟踪所带来的沉重基本开销。我们进一步提出了CRSampler（时钟竞争采样器），通过基于硬件的采样来检测时钟竞争，而不直接延迟程序执行，以进一步降低运行时开销。我们在Dacapo基准上对CRSampler进行了评估。结果表明，在1%的采样率下，CRSampler的平均开销低于5%。而Pacer和DataCollider的开销分别大于25%和96%。此外，在相同采样率下，CRSampler检测到的数据竞争数量明显多于Pacer和DataCollider。

upstream_only.title: Online shared memory dependence reduction via bisectional coordination
upstream_only.abstract: Order of shared memory accesses, known as the shared memory dependence, is the cornerstone of dynamic analyses of concurrent programs. In this paper, we study the problem of reducing shared memory dependences. We present the first online software-only algorithm to reduce shared memory dependences without vector clock maintenance, opening a new direction to a broad range of applications (e.g., deterministic replay and data race detection). Our algorithm exploits a simple yet effective observation, that adaptive variable grouping can recognize and match spatial locality in shared memory accesses, to reduce shared memory dependences. We designed and implemented the bisectional coordination protocol, which dynamically maintains a partition of the program's address space without its prior knowledge, such that shared variables in each partitioned interval have consistent thread and spatial locality properties. Evaluation on a set of real-world programs showed that by paying a 0--54.7\% (median 21\%) slowdown, bisectional coordination reduced 0.95--97\% (median 55\%) and 16--99.99\% (median 99\%) shared memory dependences compared with RWTrace and LEAP, respectively.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 共享内存访问的顺序，即共享内存依赖，是并发程序动态分析的基石。本文研究减少共享内存依赖的问题。我们提出了第一个不需要维护向量时钟的在线纯软件算法来减少共享内存依赖，为确定性情回放和数据竞争检测等广泛的应用开辟了新方向。该算法利用了一个简单而有效的观察——自适应的变量分组可以识别并匹配共享内存访问的空间局部性——来减少共享内存依赖。我们设计并实现了二分协调协议，该协议无需事先了解程序地址空间即可动态维护其划分，使得每个划分区间内的共享变量具有一致的线程与空间局部性特征。对一组真实程序进行的评估表明，与RWTrace和LEAP相比，二分协调在付出0–54.7%（中位数21%）的运行时开销的同时，分别减少了0.95–97%（中位数55%）和16–99.99%（中位数99%）的共享内存依赖。

upstream_only.title: Parallel data race detection for task parallel programs with locks
upstream_only.abstract: Programming with tasks is a promising approach to write performance portable parallel code. In this model, the programmer explicitly specifies tasks and the task parallel runtime employs work stealing to distribute tasks among threads. Similar to multithreaded programs, task parallel programs can also exhibit data races. Unfortunately, prior data race detectors for task parallel programs either run the program serially or do not handle locks, and/or detect races only in the schedule observed by the analysis. This paper proposes PTRacer, a parallel on-the-fly data race detector for task parallel programs that use locks. PTRacer detects data races not only in the observed schedule but also those that can happen in other schedules (which are permutations of the memory operations in the observed schedule) for a given input. It accomplishes the above goal by leveraging the dynamic execution graph of a task parallel execution to determine whether two accesses can happen in parallel and by maintaining constant amount of access history metadata with each distinct set of locks held for each shared memory location. To detect data races (beyond the observed schedule) in programs with branches sensitive to scheduling decisions, we propose static compiler instrumentation that records memory accesses that will be executed in the other path with simple branches. PTRacer has performance overheads similar to the state-of-the-art race detector for task parallel programs, SPD3, while detecting more races in programs with locks.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 使用任务进行编程是编写高性能可移植并行代码的一种有前途的方法。在该模型中，程序员显式指定任务，任务并行运行时采用工作窃取在线程之间分发任务。与多线程程序类似，任务并行程序也可能表现出数据竞争。不幸的是，先前针对任务并行程序的数据竞争检测器要么串行运行程序，要么不处理锁，和/或仅检测分析所观察到的调度中的竞争。本文提出了PTRacer，一种用于使用锁的任务并行程序的并行实时数据竞争检测器。PTRacer不仅检测观察到的调度中的数据竞争，而且还检测在给定输入下可能在其他调度（即观察到的调度中内存操作的排列）中发生的竞争。它通过利用任务并行执行的动态执行图来确定两个访问是否可以并行发生，并为每个共享内存位置维护每种持有锁集合的常量数量访问历史元数据来实现上述目标。为了在分支对调度决策敏感的程序中检测（超出观察到的调度的）数据竞争，我们提出了静态编译器插桩，通过简单分支记录在另一条路径中将要执行的内存访问。PTRacer的性能开销与最新任务并行程序竞争检测器SPD3相似，同时在带有锁的程序中检测到更多竞争。

upstream_only.title: Paradise unplugged: identifying barriers for female participation on stack overflow
upstream_only.abstract: It is no secret that females engage less in programming fields than males. However, in online communities, such as Stack Overflow, this gender gap is even more extreme: only 5.8\% of contributors are female. In this paper, we use a mixed-methods approach to identify contribution barriers females face in online communities. Through 22 semi-structured interviews with a spectrum of female users ranging from non-contributors to a top 100 ranked user of all time, we identified 14 barriers preventing them from contributing to Stack Overflow. We then conducted a survey with 1470 female and male developers to confirm which barriers are gender related or general problems for everyone. Females ranked five barriers significantly higher than males. A few of these include doubts in the level of expertise needed to contribute, feeling overwhelmed when competing with a large number of users, and limited awareness of site features. Still, there were other barriers that equally impacted all Stack Overflow users or affected particular groups, such as industry programmers. Finally, we describe several implications that may encourage increased participation in the Stack Overflow community across genders and other demographics.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 女性在编程领域的参与度低于男性，这已不是秘密。然而，在诸如Stack Overflow这类在线社区中，这种性别差距更为极端：只有5.8%的贡献者是女性。在本文中，我们采用混合方法识别女性在在线社区中面临的贡献障碍。通过对22位不同层级的女性用户（从非贡献者到历史上排名前100的用户）进行半结构化访谈，我们确定了阻止她们为Stack Overflow做贡献的14个障碍。随后，我们对1470名女性和男性开发者进行了调查，以确认哪些障碍是性别相关的，哪些是普遍问题。女性对五个障碍的评分显著高于男性。其中一些包括：对所需专业知识水平存疑、与大量用户竞争时感到不知所措、以及对网站功能了解有限等。尽管如此，还有其他一些障碍同样影响着所有Stack Overflow用户，或影响着特定群体，如行业程序员。最后，我们描述了可能鼓励更多性别和其他人群参与Stack Overflow社区的若干影响。

upstream_only.title: Why we refactor? confessions of GitHub contributors
upstream_only.abstract: Refactoring is a widespread practice that helps developers to improve the maintainability and readability of their code. However, there is a limited number of studies empirically investigating the actual motivations behind specific refactoring operations applied by developers. To fill this gap, we monitored Java projects hosted on GitHub to detect recently applied refactorings, and asked the developers to explain the reasons behind their decision to refactor the code. By applying thematic analysis on the collected responses, we compiled a catalogue of 44 distinct motivations for 12 well-known refactoring types. We found that refactoring activity is mainly driven by changes in the requirements and much less by code smells. Extract Method is the most versatile refactoring operation serving 11 different purposes. Finally, we found evidence that the IDE used by the developers affects the adoption of automated refactoring tools.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 重构是一种广泛应用的实践，帮助开发者改善代码的可维护性和可读性。然而，目前仍缺乏实证研究来调查开发者进行特定重构操作背后的实际动机。为填补这一空白，我们监测了GitHub上托管的Java项目，检测最近应用的重构，并邀请开发者解释其重构决策的原因。通过归纳分析收集到的回答，我们为12种知名重构类型编制了包含44种不同动机的目录。我们发现，重构行为主要由需求变化驱动，而较少由代码坏味驱动。提取方法是满足11种不同用途的最通用重构操作。最后，我们发现证据表明开发者使用的IDE会影响自动化重构工具的采用。

upstream_only.title: Effectiveness of code contribution: from patch-based to pull-request-based tools
upstream_only.abstract: Code contributions in Free/Libre and Open Source Software projects are controlled to maintain high-quality of software. Alternatives to patch-based code contribution tools such as mailing lists and issue trackers have been developed with the pull request systems being the most visible and widely available on GitHub. Is the code contribution process more effective with pull request systems? To answer that, we quantify the effectiveness via the rates contributions are accepted and ignored, via the time until the first response and final resolution and via the numbers of contributions. To control for the latent variables, our study includes a project that migrated from an issue tracker to the GitHub pull request system and a comparison between projects using mailing lists and pull request systems. Our results show pull request systems to be associated with reduced review times and larger numbers of contributions. However, not all the comparisons indicate substantially better accept or ignore rates in pull request systems. These variations may be most simply explained by the differences in contribution practices the projects employ and may be less affected by the type of tool. Our results clarify the importance of understanding the role of tools in effective management of the broad network of potential contributors and may lead to strategies and practices making the code contribution more satisfying and efficient from both contributors' and maintainers' perspectives.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在自由/开源软件项目中，代码贡献受到控制以保持软件的高质量。替代基于补丁的代码贡献工具（如邮件列表和问题追踪器）的方案已被开发出来，其中拉取请求系统最为显著，并在GitHub上广泛可用。使用拉取请求系统的代码贡献过程是否更有效？为回答这个问题，我们通过贡献被接受和被忽略的比率、首次响应和最终解决的时间以及贡献数量来量化有效性。为控制潜在变量，我们的研究包括一个从问题追踪器迁移到GitHub拉取请求系统的项目，以及使用邮件列表和拉取请求系统的项目之间的比较。结果显示，拉取请求系统与更短的审查时间和更多的贡献数量相关。然而，并非所有比较都表明拉取请求系统在接受率或忽略率方面明显更好。这些差异可能最简单的原因是项目所采用的贡献实践不同，而较少受工具类型的影响。我们的结果阐明了理解工具在有效管理潜在贡献者广泛网络中的作用的重要性，并可能从贡献者和维护者的角度促成使代码贡献更令人满意和高效的策略与实践。

upstream_only.title: Isomorphic regression testing: executing uncovered branches without test augmentation
upstream_only.abstract: In software testing, it is very hard to achieve high coverage with the program under test, leaving many behaviors unexplored. To alleviate this problem, various automated test generation and augmentation approaches have been proposed, among which symbolic execution and search-based techniques are the most competitive, while each has key challenges to be solved. Different from prior work, we present a new methodology for regression testing --Isomorphic Regression Testing,which explores the behaviors of the program under test by creating its variants (i.e., modified programs) instead of generating tests. In this paper, we make the first implementation of isomorphic regression testing through an approach named ISON, which creates program variants by negating branch conditions. The results show that ISON is able to additionally execute 5.3\% to 80.0\% branches that are originally uncovered. Furthermore, ISON also detects a number of faults not detected by a popular automated test generation tool (i.e., EvoSuite) under the scenario of regression testing.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在软件测试中，被测程序很难达到高覆盖率，导致许多行为未被探索。为缓解这一问题，研究者们提出了各种自动化测试生成和增强方法，其中符号执行和基于搜索的技术最具竞争力，但每种方法都有各自的关键挑战。与以往工作不同，我们提出了一种新的回归测试方法论——同构回归测试，它通过创建被测程序的变体（即修改后的程序）来探索其行为，而不是生成测试用例。本文通过名为ISON的方法首次实现了同构回归测试，该方法通过否定分支条件来创建程序变体。结果表明，ISON能够额外执行5.3%至80.0%原先未覆盖的分支。此外，在回归测试场景中，ISON还检测到了流行的自动化测试生成工具（如EvoSuite）未能检测出的若干故障。

upstream_only.title: Directed test generation to detect loop inefficiencies
upstream_only.abstract: Redundant traversal of loops in the context of other loops has been recently identified as a source of performance bugs in many Java libraries. This has resulted in the design of static and dynamic analysis techniques to detect these performance bugs automatically. However, while the effectiveness of dynamic analyses is dependent on the analyzed input tests, static analyses are less effective in automatically validating the presence of these problems, validating the fixes and avoiding regressions in future versions. This necessitates the design of an approach to automatically generate tests for exposing redundant traversal of loops. In this paper, we design a novel, scalable and automatic approach that addresses this goal. Our approach takes a library and an initial set of coverage-driven randomly generated tests as input and generates tests which enable detection of redundant traversal of loops. Our approach is broadly composed of three phases – analysis of the execution of random tests to generate method summaries, identification of methods with potential nested loops along with the appropriate context to expose the problem, and test generation to invoke the identified methods with the appropriate parameters. The generated tests can be analyzed by existing dynamic tools to detect possible performance issues. We have implemented our approach on top of the SOOT bytecode analysis framework and validated it on many open-source Java libraries. Our experiments reveal the effectiveness of our approach in generating 224 tests that reveal 46 bugs across seven libraries, including 34 previously unknown bugs. The tests generated using our approach significantly outperform the randomly generated tests in their ability to expose the inefficiencies, demonstrating the usefulness of our design. The implementation of our tool, named Glider, is available at http://drona.csa.iisc.ac.in/~sss/tools/glider.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 近期，在其他循环的上下文中循环的冗余遍历已被确定为许多Java库中性能缺陷的一个来源。这促使了静态和动态分析技术的设计以自动检测这些性能缺陷。然而，尽管动态分析的效果依赖于被分析的输入测试，静态分析在自动验证这些问题的存在、验证修复以及避免未来版本回归方面效果较差。因此有必要设计一种自动生成测试以暴露循环冗余遍历的方法。在本文中，我们设计了一种新颖、可扩展且自动的方法来实现这一目标。我们的方法以库和一组初始的覆盖驱动的随机生成测试为输入，并生成能够检测循环冗余遍历的测试。我们的方法大致由三个阶段组成——分析随机测试的执行以生成方法摘要；识别具有潜在嵌套循环的方法以及暴露问题的适当上下文；以及生成测试以使用适当参数调用已识别的方法。生成的测试可由现有的动态工具分析以检测可能的性能问题。我们在SOOT字节码分析框架上实现了我们的方法，并在许多开源Java库上进行了验证。我们的实验证明了我们的方法在生成224个测试（揭示七个库中的46个缺陷，包括34个先前未知的缺陷）方面的有效性。使用我们方法生成的测试在暴露低效性方面显著优于随机生成的测试，证明了我们设计的实用性。我们工具（名为Glider）的实现可在http://drona.csa.iisc.ac.in/~sss/tools/glider获取。

upstream_only.title: Field-exhaustive testing
upstream_only.abstract: We present a testing approach for object oriented programs, which encompasses a testing criterion and an automated test generation technique. The criterion, that we call field-exhaustive testing, requires a user-provided limit n on the size of data domains, and is based on the idea of considering enough inputs so as to exhaustively cover the extension of class fields, within the limit n. Intuitively, the extension of a field f is the binary relation established between objects and their corresponding values for field f, in valid instances. Thus, a suite S is field-exhaustive if whenever a field f relates an object o with a value v (i.e., o.f = v) within a valid instance I of size bounded by n, then S contains at least one input I' covering such relationship, i.e., o must also be part of I', and o.f = v must hold in I'. Our test generation technique uses incremental SAT solving to produce small field-exhaustive suites: field-exhaustiveness can be achieved with a suite containing at most # F x n2 inputs, where # F is the number of fields in the class under test. We perform an experimental evaluation on two different testing domains drawn from the literature: implementations of data structures, and of a refactoring engine. The experiments show that field-exhaustive suites can be computed efficiently, and retain similar levels of code coverage and mutation killing as significantly larger bounded exhaustive and random suites, thus consuming a fraction of the cost of test execution compared to these automated testing approaches.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种面向对象程序的测试方法，包含一个测试准则和一种自动化测试生成技术。该准则称为字段穷举测试（field-exhaustive testing），要求用户提供数据域大小的上限 n，其核心思想是考虑足够的输入，以便在给定上限 n 内穷举覆盖类字段的外延。直观地说，字段 f 的外延是有效实例中对象与其字段 f 对应值之间建立的二元关系。因此，如果每当字段 f 在大小不超过 n 的有效实例 I 中将对象 o 与值 v 关联（即 o.f = v），那么测试套件 S 中至少包含一个输入 I' 覆盖这种关系，即 o 也必须属于 I'，且在 I' 中 o.f = v 成立，那么 S 就是字段穷举的。我们的测试生成技术使用增量式 SAT 求解来生成小型字段穷举套件：字段穷举性可以由最多包含 #F × n^2 个输入的套件实现，其中 #F 是待测试类中的字段数量。我们对来自文献的两个不同测试领域进行了实验评估：数据结构实现和重构引擎实现。实验表明，字段穷举套件可以高效计算，并且与显著更大的有界穷举和随机套件相比，保持相似的代码覆盖率和变异杀死率，因此与这些自动化测试方法相比，测试执行成本仅为其一小部分。

upstream_only.title: Dually Hierarchical Drift Adaptation for Online Configuration Performance Learning
upstream_only.abstract: Modern configurable software systems need to learn models that correlate configuration and performance. However, when the system operates in dynamic environments, the workload variations, hardware changes, and system updates will inevitably introduce concept drifts at different levels—global drifts, which reshape the performance landscape of the entire configuration space; and local drifts, which only affect certain sub-regions of that space. As such, existing offline and transfer learning approaches can struggle to adapt to these implicit and unpredictable changes in real-time, rendering configuration performance learning challenging. To address this, we propose DHDA, an online configuration performance learning framework designed to capture and adapt to these drifts at different levels. The key idea is that DHDA adapts to both the local and global drifts using dually hierarchical adaptation: at the upper level, we redivide the data into different divisions, within each of which the local model is retrained, to handle global drifts only when necessary. At the lower level, the local models of the divisions can detect local drifts and adapt themselves asynchronously. To balance responsiveness and efficiency, DHDA combines incremental updates with periodic full retraining to minimize redundant computation when no drifts are detected. Through evaluating eight software systems and against state-of-the-art approaches, we show that DHDA achieves considerably better accuracy and can effectively adapt to drifts with up to 2 {\texttimes} improvements, while incurring reasonable overhead and is able to improve different local models in handling concept drift.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代可配置软件系统需要学习将配置与性能关联的模型。然而，当系统在动态环境中运行时，工作负载变化、硬件更改和系统更新将不可避免地在不同层面引入概念漂移——全局漂移会重塑整个配置空间的性能景观；局部漂移仅影响该空间的某些子区域。因此，现有的离线和迁移学习方法可能难以实时适应这些隐含且不可预测的变化，使得配置性能学习极具挑战。为了解决这一问题，我们提出DHDA，一个在线配置性能学习框架，旨在捕获并适应不同层面的这些漂移。其核心思想是DHDA使用双重分层适应来同时适应局部和全局漂移：在上层，我们将数据重新划分为不同的分区，并在每个分区内重新训练局部模型，仅在必要时处理全局漂移。在下层，各分区的局部模型可以检测局部漂移并异步地自我适应。为了平衡响应性和效率，DHDA将增量更新与周期性完全重新训练相结合，在未检测到漂移时最小化冗余计算。通过评估八个软件系统并与最先进的方法进行比较，我们表明DHDA取得了显著更好的准确性，并能有效适应漂移，提升幅度高达2倍，同时产生合理的开销，并且能够改进不同局部模型处理概念漂移的能力。

upstream_only.title: PromiseTune: Unveiling Causally Promising and Explainable Configuration Tuning
upstream_only.abstract: The high configurability of modern software systems has made configuration tuning a crucial step for assuring system performance, e.g., latency or throughput. However, given the expensive measurements, large configuration space, and rugged configuration landscape, existing tuners suffer ineffectiveness due to the difficult balance of budget utilization between exploring uncertain regions (for escaping from local optima) and exploiting guidance of known good configurations (for fast convergence). The root cause is that we lack knowledge of where the promising regions lay, which also causes challenges in the explainability of the results.In this paper, we propose PromiseTune that tunes the configuration guided by causally purified rules. PromiseTune is unique in the sense that we learn rules, which reflect certain regions in the configuration landscape, and purify them with causal inference. The remaining rules serve as approximated reflections of the promising regions, bounding the tuning to emphasize these places in the landscape. This, as we demonstrate, can effectively mitigate the impact of the exploration and exploitation trade-off. Those purified regions can then be paired with the measured configurations to provide spatial explainability at the landscape level. Compared with 11 state-of-the-art tuners on 12 systems and varying budgets, we show that PromiseTune performs significantly better than the others with (42\%) superior rank to the overall second best while providing richer information to explain the hidden system characteristics.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代软件系统的高度可配置性使得配置调优成为保证系统性能（例如延迟或吞吐量）的关键步骤。然而，由于测量代价高昂、配置空间庞大以及配置景观崎岖，现有调优器难以在探索不确定区域（以逃离局部最优）和利用已知良好配置的指导（以快速收敛）之间平衡预算利用，从而效果不佳。根本原因在于我们缺乏关于有前景区域位于何处的知识，这也导致了结果可解释性方面的挑战。在本文中，我们提出 PromiseTune，它由因果纯化规则引导进行配置调优。PromiseTune 的独特之处在于：我们学习规则，这些规则反映配置景观中的某些区域，并通过因果推断对其进行纯化。剩余的规则作为有前景区域的近似反映，约束调优过程以强调景观中的这些位置。正如我们所展示的，这可以有效缓解探索与利用权衡的影响。这些纯化后的区域随后可以与已测量的配置配对，以在景观层面提供空间可解释性。与 11 个最先进的调优器在 12 个系统和不同预算下相比，我们表明 PromiseTune 的性能显著优于其他调优器，其相对总体第二名的排名优势达到 (42%)，同时提供更丰富的信息来解释隐藏的系统特征。

upstream_only.title: Quantifying Memorization Advantage in Code LLMs
upstream_only.abstract: The lack of transparency regarding the code datasets used during LLM training creates substantial challenges in detecting, evaluating, and mitigating data leakage. This paper applies a perturbation-based approach to quantify the “memorization advantage” of LLMs across various coding tasks by measuring the performance gap between a model’s handling of data it has likely encountered during training versus novel inputs. Our comprehensive analysis examines 8 open-source code LLMs across 19 benchmark datasets spanning four distinct categories: standard code generation, code understanding, security vulnerability detection, and bug identification. The results reveal significant variations in sensitivity patterns, with models like StarCoder exhibiting substantially higher sensitivity scores (up to 0.8) on certain benchmarks like APPS compared to models like QwenCoder, which maintained consistently lower values (< 0.4) across most benchmarks, suggesting fundamental differences in their generalization process and their learned knowledge. Different task categories also showed distinct patterns, with code summarization demonstrating low sensitivity (< 0.3) and test generation tasks exhibiting significantly higher values (0.4-0.7, p < 0.001).Interestingly, our analysis of the widely-used CVEFixes and Defects4J benchmarks, frequently suspected of data leakage in the research community, reveals unexpectedly low memorization advantage scores across all models. Defects4J demonstrated significantly lower sensitivity (0.2-0.4, p < 0.01) compared to other program repair benchmarks (0.5-0.8), while CVEFixes showed consistently low values below 0.1. These findings challenge prevailing concerns about these datasets’ validity for evaluating code LLMs and suggest that models may be effectively generalizing from this data rather than merely memorizing it. Our findings provide critical insights into the generalization capabilities of code LLMs and emphasize the need for more robust evaluation frameworks, particularly in security-related domains where the widest range of sensitivity distributions (from < 0.1 to > 0.8) indicates variable generalization challenges.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 缺乏关于LLM训练所用代码数据集的透明度，给检测、评估和缓解数据泄漏带来了巨大挑战。本文应用一种基于扰动的方法，通过测量模型在处理其训练期间可能遇到过的数据与新颖输入之间的性能差距，来量化LLM在各种编码任务中的“记忆优势”。我们的全面分析考察了8个开源代码LLM在19个基准数据集上的表现，这些数据集涵盖四个不同类别：标准代码生成、代码理解、安全漏洞检测和缺陷识别。结果揭示了敏感模式的显著差异，例如StarCoder在APPS等某些基准上表现出高得多的敏感度分数（最高达0.8），而QwenCoder等模型在大多数基准上保持较低值（<0.4），这表明它们的泛化过程和学习知识存在根本差异。不同任务类别也表现出不同模式：代码摘要的敏感度较低（<0.3），而测试生成任务则显著更高（0.4-0.7，p < 0.001）。有趣的是，我们对研究界常怀疑存在数据泄漏的广泛使用的CVEFixes和Defects4J基准的分析显示，所有模型的记忆优势分数都出乎意料地低。Defects4J的敏感度显著低于其他程序修复基准（0.2-0.4，p < 0.01 vs 0.5-0.8），而CVEFixes则持续低于0.1。这些发现挑战了关于这些数据集用于评估代码LLM的有效性的普遍担忧，并表明模型可能是在有效地从这些数据中泛化，而非仅仅记忆。我们的发现为代码LLM的泛化能力提供了关键见解，并强调需要更稳健的评估框架，尤其是在安全相关领域，因为那里敏感度分布范围最广（从<0.1到>0.8），表明泛化挑战多变。

upstream_only.title: Portable Power Modeling with Transfer Learning on JVM-Based Applications
upstream_only.abstract: Developing energy-aware applications is an important approach to promoting sustainable computing. This paper addresses a fundamental and challenging problem faced by developers and deployers: how to port a power model built for one machine to another? We present LucRETius, a novel approach toward portable power modeling through transfer learning, where a pre-trained power model on one machine can serve as a teacher to help construct a student model on another machine rapidly. The key insight that enables transfer learning is that the layer of application runtimes can abstract away the machine-specific details, so that two machines—despite different hardware and software system configurations—are unified with a common set of runtime events that can serve as features for transfer learning. We evaluate LucRETius through bi-directional transfers across 4 machines, and we show the power models built by LucRETius have a median percentage error of 1.01\%-1.75\% when used for predicting the energy consumption of 36 real-world JVM-based applications. Compared with training from scratch, LucRETius can lead to a speed up of 8.07 {\texttimes}.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 开发能源感知应用程序是促进可持续计算的重要途径。本文解决了开发人员和部署人员面临的一个基本且具有挑战性的问题：如何将为一台机器构建的功耗模型移植到另一台机器？我们提出了LucRETius，一种通过迁移学习实现可移植功耗建模的新方法，其中在一台机器上预训练的功耗模型可以作为教师，帮助在另一台机器上快速构建学生模型。实现迁移学习的关键洞察在于，应用程序运行时层可以抽象掉机器特定的细节，从而使得两台机器——尽管硬件和软件系统配置不同——能够通过一组共同的运行时事件统一起来，这些事件可以作为迁移学习的特征。我们通过跨4台机器的双向迁移评估LucRETius，并表明LucRETius构建的功耗模型在预测36个真实世界基于JVM应用程序的能耗时，中位百分比误差为1.01%-1.75%。与从头训练相比，LucRETius可以实现8.07倍的加速。

upstream_only.title: Scrub It Out! Erasing Sensitive Memorization in Code Language Models via Machine Unlearning
upstream_only.abstract: While Code Language Models (CLMs) have demonstrated superior performance in software engineering tasks such as code generation and summarization, recent empirical studies reveal a critical privacy vulnerability: these models exhibit unintended memorization of sensitive training data, enabling verbatim reproduction of confidential information when specifically prompted. To address this issue, several approaches, including training data de-duplication and differential privacy augmentation, have been proposed. However, these methods require full-model retraining for deployed CLMs, which incurs substantial computational costs. In this paper, we aim to answer the following research question: Can sensitive information memorized by CLMs be erased effectively and efficiently?We conduct a pioneering investigation into erasing sensitive memorization in CLMs through machine unlearning—a post-hoc modification method that removes specific information from trained models without requiring full retraining. Specifically, we first quantify the memorization risks of sensitive data within CLM training datasets and curate a high-risk dataset of 50,000 sensitive memorized samples as unlearning targets. We study two widely used gradient ascent-based unlearning approaches: the vanilla and constraint-based methods, and introduce CodeEraser, an advanced variant that selectively unlearns sensitive memorized segments in code while preserving the structural integrity and functional correctness of the surrounding code. Extensive experiments on three families of CLMs, i.e., CodeParrot, CodeGen-Mono, and Qwen2.5-Coder, validate the effectiveness and efficiency of CodeEraser in erasing targeted sensitive memorization while maintaining model utility.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 尽管代码语言模型（CLM）在代码生成和摘要等软件工程任务中表现出优越的性能，但最近的实证研究揭示了一个关键的隐私漏洞：这些模型会无意中记忆敏感训练数据，从而在特定提示下逐字复现机密信息。为了解决这个问题，人们提出了几种方法，包括训练数据去重和差分隐私增强。然而，这些方法需要对已部署的CLM进行全模型重新训练，这会带来大量的计算成本。在本文中，我们旨在回答以下研究问题：CLM记忆的敏感信息能否被有效且高效地擦除？我们通过机器遗忘——一种无需完全重新训练即可从训练模型中移除特定信息的事后修改方法——对擦除CLM中的敏感记忆进行了开创性研究。具体来说，我们首先量化CLM训练数据集中敏感数据的记忆风险，并整理出一个包含50,000个敏感记忆样本的高风险数据集作为遗忘目标。我们研究了两种广泛使用的基于梯度上升的遗忘方法：普通方法和基于约束的方法，并引入了CodeEraser，这是一种高级变体，能够选择性地遗忘代码中的敏感记忆片段，同时保持周围代码的结构完整性和功能正确性。在三个CLM系列（即CodeParrot、CodeGen-Mono和Qwen2.5-Coder）上进行的大量实验验证了CodeEraser在擦除目标敏感记忆同时保持模型效用方面的有效性和效率。

upstream_only.title: InferLog: Accelerating LLM Inference for Online Log Parsing via ICL-oriented Prefix Caching
upstream_only.abstract: Modern software systems generate massive volumes of runtime logs, necessitating efficient and accurate log parsing to enable critical downstream tasks such as anomaly detection and root cause analysis. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have achieved advanced accuracy on log parsing, but their deployment in production environments faces two major limitations: First, the privacy risks associated with commercial LLMs, driving the adoption of local deployment. Second, online log parsing poses stringent challenges for latency and throughput. While recent methods reduce the number of LLM queries, they overlook the inherent overhead of LLM inference where concurrent log parsing requests can lead to performance degradation in the LLM inference system.In this study, we present InferLog, the first LLM inference optimization method for online log parsing. Our key insight is that the inference efficiency emerges as the vital bottleneck in LLM-based online log parsing, rather than parsing accuracy. InferLog accelerates inference by designing (i) A prefix-aware ICL refinement strategy to refine the examples and permutation of in-context learning to improve the prefix caching efficiency. (ii) A rapid and task-specific configuration tuning pipeline based on meta-learning to find the optimal LLM inference system configuration. The experimental results based on Loghub-2k dataset and vLLM demonstrate that InferLog significantly outperforms existing inference optimization methods and markedly accelerates the state-of-the-art LLM-based log parsers without compromising parsing accuracy.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代软件系统产生海量的运行时日志，因此需要高效且准确的日志解析，以支持诸如异常检测和根因分析等关键下游任务。近来，大型语言模型（LLM）在日志解析上已达到先进的准确率，但其在生产环境中的部署面临两大限制：第一，商业LLM带来的隐私风险，促使人们采用本地部署。第二，在线日志解析对延迟和吞吐量提出了严峻挑战。尽管近期方法减少了LLM查询次数，但它们忽略了LLM推理的固有开销，即并发的日志解析请求可能导致LLM推理系统的性能下降。在本研究中，我们提出了InferLog，这是首个面向在线日志解析的LLM推理优化方法。我们的关键洞察是：在基于LLM的在线日志解析中，推理效率而非解析准确率成为关键瓶颈。InferLog通过设计以下两点来加速推理：(i) 一种前缀感知的ICL精炼策略，用于改进上下文学习（ICL）的示例及其排列，以提高前缀缓存效率。(ii) 一种基于元学习的快速且任务特定的配置调优流程，以寻找最优的LLM推理系统配置。基于Loghub-2k数据集和vLLM的实验结果表明，InferLog显著优于现有的推理优化方法，并在不损害解析准确率的情况下显著加速了最先进的基于LLM的日志解析器。

upstream_only.title: ConfLogger: Enhance Systems' Configuration Diagnosability through Configuration Logging
upstream_only.abstract: Modern configurable systems, including distributed systems and recently popular decentralized systems in Web 3.0, offer customization via intricate configuration spaces, yet such flexibility introduces pervasive configuration-related issues such as misconfigurations and latent software bugs. Existing diagnosability supports focus on post-failure analysis of software behavior to identify configuration issues, but none of these approaches look into whether the software clues sufficient failure information for diagnosis. To fill in the blank, we propose the idea of configuration logging to enhance existing logging practices at the source code level. We develop ConfLogger, the first tool that unifies configuration-aware static taint analysis with LLM-based log generation to enhance software configuration diagnosability. Specifically, our method 1) identifies configuration-sensitive code segments by tracing configuration-related data flow in the whole project, and 2) generates diagnostic logging statements by analyzing configuration code contexts. Evaluation results on eight popular software systems demonstrate the effectiveness of ConfLogger to enhance configuration diagnosability. Specifically, ConfLogger-enhanced logs successfully aid a log-based misconfiguration diagnosis tool to achieve 100\% accuracy on error localization in 30 silent misconfiguration scenarios, with 80\% directly resolvable through explicit configuration information exposed. In addition, ConfLogger achieves 74\% coverage of existing logging points, outperforming baseline LLM-based loggers by 12\% and 30\%. It also gains 8.6\% higher in precision, 79.3\% higher in recall, and 26.2\% higher in F1 compared to the state-of-the-art baseline in terms of variable logging while also augmenting diagnostic value. A controlled user study on 22 cases further validated its utility, speeding up diagnostic time by 1.25{\texttimes} and improving troubleshooting accuracy by 251.4\%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代可配置系统，包括分布式系统以及近期在Web 3.0中流行的去中心化系统，通过复杂的配置空间提供定制化，然而这种灵活性引入了普遍存在的配置相关问题，例如配置错误和潜在软件缺陷。现有的可诊断性支持侧重于故障后对软件行为的分析以识别配置问题，但这些方法都没有探究软件是否提供了足够的故障信息用于诊断。为填补这一空白，我们提出配置日志的思想，以在源代码层面增强现有日志实践。我们开发了ConfLogger，这是首个将配置感知的静态污点分析与基于LLM的日志生成统一起来以增强软件配置可诊断性的工具。具体而言，我们的方法1）通过追踪整个项目中与配置相关的数据流来识别配置敏感的代码段，2）通过分析配置代码上下文来生成诊断日志语句。在八个流行软件系统上的评估结果证明了ConfLogger在增强配置可诊断性方面的有效性。具体来说，ConfLogger增强的日志成功帮助一个基于日志的配置错误诊断工具在30个静默配置错误场景中实现100%的错误定位准确率，其中80%可通过暴露的显式配置信息直接解决。此外，ConfLogger实现了对现有日志点74%的覆盖率，分别比基线LLM日志生成器高出12%和30%。在变量日志方面，与最先进的基线相比，其精确率提高8.6%，召回率提高79.3%，F1提高26.2%，同时还增强了诊断价值。一项针对22个案例的受控用户研究进一步验证了其效用，将诊断速度提升了1.25倍，并将故障排除准确率提高了251.4%。

upstream_only.title: RefAgent: A Multi-agent LLM-based Framework for Automatic Software Refactoring
upstream_only.abstract: Recent progress in Large Language Models (LLMs) has influenced various software engineering tasks, including code generation, program repair, and software maintenance. Indeed, in the case of software refactoring, traditional LLMs have shown the ability to reduce development time and enhance code quality. However, these LLMs often rely on static, detailed instructions for specific tasks. In contrast, LLM-based agents can dynamically adapt to evolving contexts and autonomously make decisions by interacting with software tools and executing workflows. In this paper, we explore the potential of LLM-based agents in supporting refactoring activities. Specifically, we introduce RefAgent, a multi-agent LLM-based framework for end-to-end software refactoring. RefAgent consists of specialized agents responsible for planning, executing, testing, and iteratively refining refactorings using self-reflection and tool-calling capabilities. We evaluate RefAgent on eight open-source Java projects, comparing its effectiveness against a single-agent approach, a search-based refactoring tool, and historical developer refactorings. Our results show that RefAgent achieves a median unit test pass rate of 90\%, reduces code smells by a median of 52.5\%, and improves key quality attributes (e.g., reusability) by a median of 8.6\%. Additionally, it closely aligns with developer refactorings and the search-based tool in identifying refactoring opportunities, attaining a median F1-score of 79.15\% and 72.7\%, respectively. Compared to single-agent approaches, RefAgent improves the median unit test pass rate by 64.7\% and the median compilation success rate by 40.1\%. These findings highlight the promise of multi-agent architectures in advancing automated software refactoring.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展影响了各种软件工程任务，包括代码生成、程序修复和软件维护。事实上，在软件重构方面，传统LLM已展现出减少开发时间和提升代码质量的能力。然而，这些LLM通常依赖于针对特定任务的静态、详细指令。相比之下，基于LLM的智能体可以通过与软件工具交互和执行工作流，动态适应不断变化的上下文并自主做出决策。在本文中，我们探索了基于LLM的智能体在支持重构活动方面的潜力。具体而言，我们介绍了RefAgent，一个用于端到端软件重构的多智能体LLM框架。RefAgent由专门化的智能体组成，负责规划、执行、测试和迭代优化重构，利用自反思和工具调用能力。我们在八个开源Java项目上评估RefAgent，将其有效性与单智能体方法、基于搜索的重构工具以及历史开发者重构进行比较。结果表明，RefAgent实现了90%的中位单元测试通过率，将代码坏味中位数减少52.5%，并将关键质量属性（例如可重用性）中位数提升8.6%。此外，它在识别重构机会方面与开发者重构和基于搜索的工具高度一致，中位F1分数分别达到79.15%和72.7%。与单智能体方法相比，RefAgent将中位单元测试通过率提高64.7%，中位编译成功率提高40.1%。这些发现凸显了多智能体架构在推进自动软件重构方面的前景。

upstream_only.title: Automatic Dockerfile Generation with Large Language Models
upstream_only.abstract: Project maintainers on platforms like GitHub usually provide a document (e.g., a Readme) describing how to build and use their software, whose instructions, often written in natural language, might sometimes be ambiguous or platform-specific. This task can be eased by containerization, which allows developers to define the build environments required for their software and to enable automatic builds. Docker is the leading platform in this field and relies on Dockerfiles for correct execution. Practitioners who want to use and build projects that do not include a Dockerfile need to develop it themselves. They often need to perform multiple builds by trial and error to discover the correct build steps and build dependencies (e.g., third-party library necessary for software builds). To address this challenge, we propose a novel approach and tool called Dockerfile Refinement and Fixing Tool (DRAFT), which can automatically generate a working Dockerfile by a Large Language Model (LLM). The core idea of DRAFT is that it emulates developers’ behavior iteratively. Specifically, DRAFT is used to iteratively generate prompts to instruct the LLM to generate patches for an initially generated Dockerfile until it executes successfully. Subsequently, it attempts to optimize the Dockerfile to reduce the size of the image it builds. We evaluated DRAFT on 35 projects and compared it with the Dockerfiles generated by Copilot (based on ChatGPT 4.0), Actions_remaker, Repo2docker, Boxing, and Starter in five different languages (C, Java, Go, Python, and Ruby). The evaluation results show that DRAFT can successfully generate Dockerfiles for 28 projects, resulting in a success rate of 80\%, which is much higher than all compared tools. The time consumed by DRAFT on generating Dockerfiles is 19.57 minutes at maximum with the median at 33.78s. Using DRAFT can reduce image size by 67.14\% and build time by 3.62\%. DRAFT relieves practitioners from the burden of manually creating build specifications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: GitHub等平台上的项目维护者通常会提供一份文档（例如Readme）来描述如何构建和使用其软件，其中的说明往往用自然语言编写，有时可能含义模糊或与平台相关。容器化可以缓解这一任务，它允许开发者定义其软件所需的构建环境并实现自动构建。Docker是该领域的领先平台，依赖Dockerfile来正确执行。想要使用和构建不包含Dockerfile的项目的从业者需要自行开发Dockerfile。他们通常需要通过反复试错进行多次构建，以发现正确的构建步骤和构建依赖（例如软件构建所需的第三方库）。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的方法和工具，称为Dockerfile Refinement and Fixing Tool (DRAFT)，它可以通过大型语言模型（LLM）自动生成可工作的Dockerfile。DRAFT的核心思想是迭代地模拟开发者的行为。具体而言，DRAFT用于迭代生成提示，指示LLM为初始生成的Dockerfile生成补丁，直到其成功执行。随后，它尝试优化Dockerfile以减小其构建的镜像大小。我们在35个项目上评估了DRAFT，并将其与Copilot（基于ChatGPT 4.0）、Actions_remaker、Repo2docker、Boxing和Starter生成的Dockerfile在五种不同语言（C、Java、Go、Python和Ruby）上进行了比较。评估结果表明，DRAFT可以成功为28个项目生成Dockerfile，成功率为80%，远高于所有对比工具。DRAFT生成Dockerfile所消耗的时间最多为19.57分钟，中位数为33.78秒。使用DRAFT可以将镜像大小减少67.14%，构建时间减少3.62%。DRAFT使从业者免于手动创建构建规范的负担。

upstream_only.title: What to Retrieve for Effective Retrieval-Augmented Code Generation? An Empirical Study and Beyond
upstream_only.abstract: Repository-level code generation remains challenging due to complex code dependencies and the limitations of large language models (LLMs) in processing long contexts. While retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frameworks are widely adopted, the effectiveness of different retrieved information sources—contextual code, APIs, and similar snippets—has not been rigorously analyzed. Through an empirical study on two benchmarks, we demonstrate that in-context code and potential API information significantly enhance LLM performance, whereas retrieved similar code often introduces noise, degrading results by up to 15\%. Based on the preliminary results, we propose AllianceCoder, a novel context-integrated method that employs chain-of-thought prompting to decompose user queries into implementation steps and retrieves APIs via semantic description matching. Through extensive experiments on public datasets, AllianceCoder achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving Pass@1 by up to 20\% over existing approaches.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 由于复杂的代码依赖关系以及大语言模型（LLM）处理长上下文的局限性，仓库级代码生成仍然具有挑战性。虽然检索增强生成（RAG）框架被广泛采用，但不同检索信息源——上下文代码、API和相似片段——的有效性尚未得到严格分析。通过对两个基准的实证研究，我们证明上下文代码和潜在API信息显著提升LLM性能，而检索到的相似代码往往引入噪声，使结果最多下降15%。基于初步结果，我们提出AllianceCoder，一种新颖的上下文集成方法，采用思维链提示将用户查询分解为实现步骤，并通过语义描述匹配检索API。在公开数据集上的大量实验表明，AllianceCoder达到最先进性能，相比现有方法将Pass@1最多提升20%。

upstream_only.title: Knowledge-Augmented Log Anomaly Detection with Large Language Models
upstream_only.abstract: Log anomaly detection is critical for maintaining system reliability, yet existing large language model (LLM)-based methods suffer from limited accuracy, high computational costs, and poor explainability. In this paper, we introduce LogPipe, a novel framework that enhances LLM-based log anomaly detection by integrating a dynamic knowledge base. LogPipe constructs a knowledge base using discrete and semantic log patterns, augmented by dynamic patterns that are generated by a sentiment dictionary and frequent pattern mining. During inference, log sequences are matched against the knowledge base to provide specific guidance to the LLM, improving detection accuracy and generating detailed explanations. A continuous update mechanism ensures that the knowledge base remains relevant while minimizing redundant LLM queries, significantly reducing inference costs. Evaluated on eight public datasets, LogPipe achieves an average F1 score of 0.975, outperforming state-of-the-art models, with reduced token consumption. Additionally, LogPipe excels in fault localization, which enhances the explainability of detected anomalies.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 日志异常检测对于维护系统可靠性至关重要，然而现有基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法存在准确性有限、计算成本高以及可解释性差的问题。本文介绍了 LogPipe，一个通过集成动态知识库来增强基于 LLM 的日志异常检测的新框架。LogPipe 使用离散和语义日志模式构建知识库，并通过情感词典和频繁模式挖掘生成的动态模式进行增强。在推理过程中，日志序列与知识库进行匹配，为 LLM 提供具体指导，从而提高检测准确性并生成详细解释。持续更新机制确保知识库保持相关性，同时最小化冗余的 LLM 查询，显著降低推理成本。在八个公开数据集上的评估中，LogPipe 实现了 0.975 的平均 F1 分数，优于最先进的模型，并减少了 token 消耗。此外，LogPipe 在故障定位方面表现优异，增强了检测到的异常的可解释性。

upstream_only.title: Order Matters! An Empirical Study on Large Language Models' Input Order Bias in Software Fault Localization
upstream_only.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) show great promise in software engineering tasks like Fault Localization (FL) and Automatic Program Repair (APR). This study investigates the impact of input order and context size on LLM performance in FL, a crucial step for many downstream software engineering tasks. We test different orders for methods using Kendall Tau distances, including "perfect" (where ground truths come first) and "worst" (where ground truths come last), using two benchmarks that consist of both Java and Python projects. Our results indicate a significant bias in order; Top-1 FL accuracy in Java projects drops from 57\% to 20\%, while in Python projects, it decreases from 38\% to approximately 3\% when we reverse the code order. Breaking down inputs into smaller contexts helps reduce this bias, narrowing the performance gap in FL from 22\% and 6\% to just 1\% on both benchmarks. We then investigated whether the bias in order was caused by data leakage by renaming the method names with more meaningful alternatives. Our findings indicated that the trend remained consistent, suggesting that the bias was not due to data leakage. We also look at ordering methods based on traditional FL techniques and metrics. Ordering using DepGraph’s ranking achieves 48\% Top-1 accuracy, which is better than more straightforward ordering approaches like CallGraphDFS. These findings underscore the importance of how we structure inputs, manage contexts, and choose ordering methods to improve LLM performance in FL and other software engineering tasks.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在故障定位（FL）和自动程序修复（APR）等软件工程任务中展现出巨大潜力。本研究探讨输入顺序和上下文大小对LLM在FL中性能的影响，FL是许多下游软件工程任务的关键步骤。我们使用Kendall Tau距离测试方法的不同顺序，包括“完美”顺序（真实结果在前）和“最差”顺序（真实结果在后），使用包含Java和Python项目的两个基准。结果表明顺序存在显著偏差；当反转代码顺序时，Java项目中的Top-1 FL准确率从57%下降到20%，而Python项目中从38%下降到约3%。将输入分解为更小的上下文有助于减少这种偏差，在两个基准上将FL的性能差距从22%和6%缩小到仅1%。然后我们通过用更有意义的替代名称重命名方法来研究顺序偏差是否由数据泄漏引起。我们的发现表明趋势保持一致，表明偏差不是由于数据泄漏。我们还研究了基于传统FL技术和指标的方法排序。使用DepGraph的排名进行排序达到48%的Top-1准确率，优于更直接的排序方法如CallGraphDFS。这些发现强调了如何构建输入、管理上下文和选择排序方法以提高LLM在FL和其他软件工程任务中性能的重要性。

upstream_only.title: Measuring the Influence of Incorrect Code on Test Generation
upstream_only.abstract: It is natural to suppose that a Large Language Model is more likely to generate correct test cases when prompted with correct code under test, compared to incorrect code under test. However, the size of this effect has never been previously measured, despite its obvious importance for both practicing software engineers and researchers. To answer the question, we conducted a comprehensive empirical study on 5 open source and 6 closed source language models, with 3 widely-used benchmark data sets together with 41 repo-level real-world examples from two different real-world data sets. Our results reveal that, when compared to incorrect code under test, LLMs prompted with correct code achieve improvements in test accuracy, code coverage, and bug detection of 57\%, 12\%, and 24\% respectively. We further show that these scientific conclusions carry over from the three benchmark data sets to the real-world code, where tests generated for incorrect code experience a 47\% worse bug detection rate. Finally, we report that improvements of +18\% in accuracy, +4\% coverage, and +34\% in bug detection can be achieved by providing natural language code descriptions. These findings have actionable conclusions. For example, the 47\% reduction in real-world bug detection is a clear concern. Fortunately, it is a concern for which our findings about the added value of descriptions offer an immediately actionable remedy.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 人们自然假设，与提供错误的被测代码相比，当大语言模型（LLMs）被提示正确的被测代码时，更可能生成正确的测试用例。然而，尽管这一效应对于实践中的软件工程师和研究人员显然很重要，其大小此前从未被测量过。为了回答这个问题，我们对5个开源和6个闭源语言模型进行了全面的实证研究，使用了3个广泛使用的基准数据集以及来自两个不同真实世界数据集的41个仓库级真实示例。我们的结果表明，与错误的被测代码相比，LLMs在提示正确代码时，在测试准确性、代码覆盖率和错误检测方面分别实现了57%、12%和24%的改进。我们进一步表明，这些科学结论从三个基准数据集延续到真实世界代码，其中为错误代码生成的测试的错误检测率要差47%。最后，我们报告通过提供自然语言代码描述，可以实现准确性提高18%、覆盖率提高4%和错误检测提高34%。这些发现具有可操作的结论。例如，真实世界错误检测率下降47%是一个明显的担忧。幸运的是，我们的发现关于描述附加价值提供了立即可行的补救措施。

upstream_only.title: Are “Solved Issues” in SWE-bench Really Solved Correctly? An Empirical Study
upstream_only.abstract: Automated issue solving aims to resolve real-world issues in software repositories. The most popular benchmarks for automated issue solving are SWE-bench and its human-filtered subset SWE-bench Verified, which are widely used to evaluate foundation models and software engineering agents. These benchmarks leverage testing to validate generated patches. However, because testing is rarely exhaustive, a patch may pass the tests but nevertheless fail to match the developers’ expectations. Unfortunately, it is currently unclear to what extent evaluations performed with SWE-bench suffer from such plausible but incorrect patches. This paper presents an in-depth empirical study of the correctness of plausible patches generated by three state-of-the-art issue-solving tools (CodeStory, LearnByInteract, and OpenHands) evaluated on SWE-bench Verified. We extensively test and inspect generated patches, and compare them against human-written ground truth patches. The core of our methodology is a novel technique for differential patch testing, called PatchDiff, which automatically exposes behavioral discrepancies between two patches. Our findings reveal critical weaknesses in SWE-bench’s patch validation mechanism, which causes 7.8\% of all patches to count as “correct” while failing the developer-written test suite. Moreover, our novel automated technique reveals that even more (29.6\%) plausible patches induce different behavior than the ground truth patches.
