upstream_only.abstract: AI-driven software development has rapidly advanced with the emergence of software development agents that leverage large language models (LLMs) to tackle complex, repository-level software engineering tasks. These agents go beyond just generation of final code; they engage in multi-step reasoning, utilize various tools for code modification and debugging, and interact with execution environments to diagnose and iteratively resolve issues. However, most existing evaluations focus primarily on static analyses of final code outputs, yielding limited insights into the agents’ dynamic problem-solving processes. To fill this gap, we conduct an in-depth empirical study on 3,977 solving-phase trajectories and 3,931 testing-phase logs from 8 top-ranked agents evaluated on 500 GitHub issues in the SWE-Bench benchmark. Our exploratory analysis shows that Python execution errors during the issue resolution phase correlate with lower resolution rates and increased reasoning overheads. We have identified the most prevalent errors—such as ModuleNotFoundError and TypeError—and highlighted particularly challenging errors like OSError and database-related issues (e.g., IntegrityError) that demand significantly more debugging effort. Furthermore, we have discovered 3 bugs in the SWE-Bench platform that affect benchmark fairness and accuracy; these issues have been reported to and confirmed by the maintainers. To promote transparency and foster future research, we publicly share our datasets and analysis scripts.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: AI驱动的软件开发随着软件开发智能体的出现而迅速发展，这些智能体利用大型语言模型（LLM）来处理复杂的、仓库级的软件工程任务。这些智能体不仅仅生成最终代码；它们进行多步推理，利用各种工具进行代码修改和调试，并与执行环境交互以诊断和迭代解决问题。然而，大多数现有评估主要关注最终代码输出的静态分析，对智能体动态问题解决过程的洞察有限。为了填补这一空白，我们对SWE-Bench基准中500个GitHub issue上8个排名靠前的智能体进行了深入的实证研究，分析了3,977条求解阶段轨迹和3,931条测试阶段日志。我们的探索性分析表明，问题解决阶段的Python执行错误与较低的问题解决率和增加的推理开销相关。我们识别出了最常见的错误——例如ModuleNotFoundError和TypeError——并强调了特别具有挑战性的错误，如OSError和数据库相关错误（例如IntegrityError），这些错误需要显著更多的调试工作。此外，我们发现了SWE-Bench平台中的3个影响基准公平性和准确性的缺陷；这些问题已报告给维护者并得到确认。为了促进透明度和未来研究，我们公开分享我们的数据集和分析脚本。

upstream_only.title: JEDI: Java Evaluation of Declarative and Imperative Queries: Benchmarking the Java Stream API
upstream_only.abstract: The Java Stream API aims at increasing developer productivity thanks to an easy-to-read declarative syntax to express computations. It also simplifies parallel computing, providing a high-level abstraction on top of common parallelization aspects. Unfortunately, there is a lack of benchmarks specifically targeting stream-based applications. Such a lack of benchmarks makes it difficult for researchers and developers of the Java class library to optimize the Stream API. Moreover, in the absence of dedicated benchmarks, it is difficult to analyze the performance of streams to suggest developers how to write efficient code using the API.In this work we present JEDI, a benchmark suite that targets the Stream API. JEDI is automatically generated by converting SQL benchmarks into Java benchmarks. Our code generator supports targets different implementations (both stream-based and imperative) for the same query. The ultimate goal of our benchmark suite—and the main contribution of this work—is to analyze the performance of the different implementations to spot inefficient code structures and better alternatives, suggesting best practices to Java developers. Among the multiple implementations we generate, we focus on different parallelization strategies and explain the most efficient parallelization strategies based on characteristics of the processed data. Finally, the code generation producing imperative code defines of a baseline that can guide researchers and Java implementers to optimize the Stream API.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Java Stream API旨在通过易于阅读的声明式语法来表达计算，从而提高开发人员生产力。它还简化了并行计算，在常见并行化方面之上提供了高级抽象。遗憾的是，目前缺乏专门针对基于流的应用程序的基准测试。这种基准测试的缺乏使得Java类库的研究人员和开发人员难以优化Stream API。此外，在没有专用基准测试的情况下，很难分析流的性能，以建议开发人员如何使用该API编写高效的代码。在这项工作中，我们提出了JEDI，一个针对Stream API的基准测试套件。JEDI通过将SQL基准转换为Java基准来自动生成。我们的代码生成器支持针对同一查询的不同实现（基于流的和命令式的）。我们基准测试套件的最终目标——也是这项工作的主要贡献——是分析不同实现的性能，以发现低效的代码结构和更好的替代方案，从而向Java开发人员建议最佳实践。在我们生成的多种实现中，我们关注不同的并行化策略，并根据所处理数据的特征解释最高效的并行化策略。最后，生成命令式代码的代码生成定义了一个基线，可以指导研究人员和Java实现者优化Stream API。

upstream_only.title: Energy-Efficient Software Development: A Multi-dimensional Empirical Analysis of Stack Overflow
upstream_only.abstract: Energy consumption of software applications has emerged as a critical concern for developers to contemplate in their daily development processes. Previous studies have surveyed a limited number of developers to understand their viewpoints on energy consumption. We complement these studies by analyzing a meticulously curated dataset of 1,193 Stack Overflow (SO) questions concerning energy consumption. These questions capture real-world energy-related challenges in practice. To understand practitioners’ perceptions, we investigate the intentions behind these questions, semantic topics, and associated technologies (e.g., programming languages). Our results reveal that: (i) the most prevalent energy consumption topic is about balancing Positioning usage; (ii) efficiently handling data is particularly challenging, with these questions having the longest response times; (iii) practitioners primarily ask questions to understand a concept or API related to energy consumption; and (iv) practitioners are concerned about energy consumption across multiple levels—hardware, operating systems, and programming languages—during energy efficient software development. Our findings raise awareness about energy consumption’s impact on software development. We also derive actionable implications for energy optimization at different levels (e.g., optimizing API usage or hardware accesses) during energy-aware software development.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 软件应用的能耗已成为开发者在日常开发过程中需要考虑的关键问题。以往研究通过调查有限的开发者来了解他们对能耗的看法。我们通过分析一个精心整理的、包含1193个与能耗相关的Stack Overflow（SO）问题数据集来补充这些研究。这些问题反映了实践中真实的能耗相关挑战。为了理解实践者的认知，我们研究了这些问题背后的意图、语义主题以及相关技术（例如编程语言）。我们的结果表明：(i) 最常见的能耗主题是关于平衡定位（Positioning）使用；(ii) 高效处理数据尤其具有挑战性，这些问题具有最长的响应时间；(iii) 实践者主要提出问题以理解与能耗相关的概念或API；(iv) 实践者在节能软件开发过程中关注多个层面的能耗——硬件、操作系统和编程语言。我们的发现提高了人们对能耗对软件开发影响的认识。我们还为节能感知软件开发中不同层面（例如优化API使用或硬件访问）的能耗优化提供了可操作的启示。

upstream_only.title: Towards Understanding and Characterizing Vulnerabilities in Intelligent Connected Vehicles through Real-World Exploits
upstream_only.abstract: Intelligent Connected Vehicles (ICVs) are a core component of modern transportation systems, and their security is crucial as it directly relates to user safety. Despite prior research, most existing studies focus only on specific sub-components of ICVs due to their inherent complexity. As a result, there is a lack of systematic understanding of ICV vulnerabilities. Moreover, much of the current literature relies on human subjective analysis, such as surveys and interviews, which tends to be high-level and unvalidated, leaving a significant gap between theoretical findings and real-world attacks.To address this issue, we conducted the first large-scale empirical study on ICV vulnerabilities. We began by analyzing existing ICV security literature and summarizing the prevailing taxonomies in terms of vulnerability locations and types. To evaluate their real-world relevance, we collected a total of 649 exploitable vulnerabilities, including 592 from eight ICV vulnerability discovery competitions, Anonymous Cup, between January 2023 and April 2024, covering 48 different vehicles. The remaining 57 vulnerabilities were submitted daily by researchers. Based on this dataset, we assessed the coverage of existing taxonomies and identified several gaps, discovering one new vulnerability location and 13 new vulnerability types. We further categorized these vulnerabilities into 6 threat types (e.g., privacy data breach) and 4 risk levels (ranging from low to critical) and analyzed participants’ skills and the types of ICVs involved in the competitions. This study provides a comprehensive and data-driven analysis of ICV vulnerabilities, offering actionable insights for researchers, industry practitioners, and policymakers. To support future research, we have made our vulnerability dataset publicly available.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 智能网联汽车（ICV）是现代交通系统的核心组成部分，其安全性至关重要，直接关系到用户安全。尽管已有先前研究，但由于ICV固有的复杂性，大多数现有研究仅关注ICV的特定子组件。因此，目前缺乏对ICV漏洞的系统性理解。此外，当前文献多依赖人类主观分析，如调查和访谈，这些分析往往停留在高层且未经证实，导致理论发现与现实世界攻击之间存在显著差距。为解决这一问题，我们开展了首个关于ICV漏洞的大规模实证研究。我们首先分析现有ICV安全文献，总结在漏洞位置和类型方面流行的分类法。为评估其现实相关性，我们共收集了649个可利用漏洞，包括2023年1月至2024年4月期间从八个ICV漏洞发现竞赛“Anonymous Cup”中获得的592个漏洞，覆盖48种不同车辆。其余57个漏洞由研究人员日常提交。基于该数据集，我们评估了现有分类法的覆盖范围并识别出若干差距，发现了一个新的漏洞位置和13种新的漏洞类型。我们进一步将这些漏洞归类为6种威胁类型（例如隐私数据泄露）和4个风险等级（从低到严重），并分析了参赛者技能和竞赛中涉及的ICV类型。本研究提供了对ICV漏洞的全面且数据驱动的分析，为研究人员、行业从业者和政策制定者提供了可操作的见解。为支持未来研究，我们公开了漏洞数据集。

upstream_only.title: Towards Supporting Open Source Library Maintainers with Community-Based Analytics
upstream_only.abstract: Open-source software (OSS) is a pillar of modern software development. Its success depends on the dedication of maintainers who work constantly to keep their libraries stable, adapt to changing needs, and support a growing community. Yet, they receive little to no continuous feedback on how the projects that rely on their libraries actually use their APIs. We believe that gaining these insights can help maintainers make better decisions, such as refining testing strategies, understanding the impact of changes, and guiding the evolution of their libraries more effectively.We propose the use of community-based analytics to analyze how an OSS library is used across its dependent ecosystem. We conduct an empirical study of 10 popular Java libraries and each with their respective dependent ecosystem of 50 projects. Our results reveal that while library developers offer a wide range of API methods, only 16\% on average are actively used by their dependent ecosystem. Moreover, only 73\% of the used API methods are partially or fully covered by their library test suite. We propose two metrics to help developers evaluate their test suite according to the APIs used by their community, and we conduct a survey on open-source practitioners to assess the practical value of these insights in guiding maintenance decisions.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 开源软件（OSS）是现代软件开发的支柱。其成功依赖于维护者的奉献，他们持续工作以保持库的稳定、适应不断变化的需求并支持不断增长的社区。然而，他们几乎得不到关于依赖其库的项目实际如何使用其API的持续反馈。我们相信，获得这些洞见可以帮助维护者做出更好的决策，例如改进测试策略、理解变更的影响，并更有效地指导其库的演进。我们提出使用基于社区的分析来分析开源库在其依赖生态系统中是如何被使用的。我们对10个流行的Java库及其各自包含50个项目的依赖生态系统进行了实证研究。我们的结果表明，尽管库开发者提供了广泛的API方法，但平均只有16%被其依赖生态系统积极使用。此外，仅73%被使用的方法被其库测试套件部分或完全覆盖。我们提出两个指标，帮助开发者根据其社区使用的API来评估测试套件，并对开源从业者进行了一项调查，以评估这些洞见在指导维护决策方面的实用价值。

upstream_only.title: Defects4REST: A Benchmark of Real-World Defects to Enable Controlled Testing and Debugging Studies for REST APIs
upstream_only.abstract: Existing research on REST API testing and debugging often relies on arbitrarily selected APIs for evaluation, leaving a critical gap in our understanding of real world defects in REST API based projects, particularly those that can be automatically detected or repaired. To address this gap, we present Defects4REST, the first public benchmark of defects in REST API projects, systematically mined from open source GitHub repositories. Using a semi-automated process that combines clustering, topic modeling, and manual validation, we build a dataset of 607 REST API defects from 50 projects and organize them into a taxonomy of 6 defect types and 13 sub-types. Each defect is linked to an issue report, the developer-modified versions of the patched files, and the corresponding commit messages. Defects4REST features easy access to the buggy and patched versions of projects for each defect and enables analysis of the associated artifacts. To evaluate current automated testing capabilities, we assess four state-of-the-art REST API testing tools on a sample of 30 defects from 11 projects. Our evaluation reveals that tools detect only 10\% (3/30) of real-world defects due to nine fundamental limitations including semantic validation, stateful testing, and infrastructure-aware testing. We release both the benchmark and the issue mining framework to support reproducible research in REST APIs, enabling the development and evaluation of REST API testing and debugging techniques.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现有的REST API测试与调试研究通常依赖于任意选择的API进行评估，这在我们对基于REST API的项目中真实世界缺陷的理解上留下了关键空白，尤其是那些能够被自动检测或修复的缺陷。为了弥补这一空白，我们提出了Defects4REST，这是首个公开的REST API项目缺陷基准，系统地从开源GitHub仓库中挖掘而来。通过结合聚类、主题建模和人工验证的半自动化流程，我们构建了一个包含来自50个项目的607个REST API缺陷的数据集，并将其组织为包含6种缺陷类型和13种子类型的分类体系。每个缺陷都链接到问题报告、开发者修改后的补丁文件版本以及相应的提交信息。Defects4REST支持轻松访问每个缺陷对应的项目缺陷版本和修复版本，并能够分析相关工件。为了评估当前自动化测试能力，我们在来自11个项目的30个缺陷样本上评估了四个最先进的REST API测试工具。我们的评估表明，由于语义验证、状态化测试和基础设施感知测试等九项根本限制，这些工具仅能检测出10%（3/30）的真实世界缺陷。我们发布了该基准和问题挖掘框架，以支持REST API的可复现研究，从而促进REST API测试与调试技术的开发与评估。

upstream_only.title: Characterizing GPU-accelerated Web Applications in Browsers
upstream_only.abstract: Driven by the rapid advancement of Web immersive experiences, the demand for GPU acceleration in Web applications has become an essential component of the Web ecosystem. However, little is known about the current practices of GPU-accelerated Web applications. To bridge the knowledge gap, we conduct the first comprehensive empirical study of real-world Web applications that leverage the Web Graphics Library (WebGL) for GPU acceleration, i.e., WebGL applications. We construct a dataset consisting of 5,954 real-world WebGL applications and develop a measurement tool to evaluate how these applications perform across various devices, operating systems, and browsers. Our findings reveal the performance defects in these applications, along with the root causes stemming from undesired development practices. Based on the findings, we propose actionable strategies for developers and browser vendors to mitigate the performance defects.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在Web沉浸式体验快速发展的推动下，Web应用对GPU加速的需求已成为Web生态系统的重要组成部分。然而，目前对GPU加速Web应用的实践知之甚少。为填补这一知识空白，我们开展了首个针对利用Web图形库（WebGL）进行GPU加速的真实Web应用（即WebGL应用）的全面实证研究。我们构建了一个包含5,954个真实WebGL应用的数据集，并开发了一个测量工具来评估这些应用在不同设备、操作系统和浏览器上的表现。我们的发现揭示了这些应用中的性能缺陷，以及源于不良开发实践的根本原因。基于这些发现，我们为开发者和浏览器厂商提出了可操作的策略以缓解性能缺陷。

upstream_only.title: A Comprehensive Study of Concurrency Bugs in the Linux Kernel
upstream_only.abstract: Concurrency bugs arise from unexpected orderings of concurrent instructions and are notoriously difficult to detect and diagnose due to their non-deterministic nature. Prior studies of concurrency bugs in user-space applications have identified common bug characteristics and informed the design of effective detection, diagnosis, and repair techniques. In contrast, far less is known about concurrency bugs in operating system kernels, where low-level systems programming and complex execution patterns introduce fundamentally different concurrent execution behaviors.This paper presents the first comprehensive study of concurrency bugs in the Linux kernel. We analyze 200 real-world kernel concurrency bugs and systematically characterize their manifestation conditions, root causes, discovery processes, and repair characteristics. Our study reveals that kernel concurrency bugs differ substantially from their user-space counterparts. For instance, 27.5\% of kernel concurrency bugs manifest only when specific interrupt events occur, yet such bugs are often overlooked by existing bug discovery approaches. Moreover, nearly half of the bugs occur in kernel drivers, and 69.3\% of them stem from concurrent device operations on control paths such as device registration and deregistration, highlighting driver control logic as a critical target for concurrency bug discovery. Overall, our findings expose key limitations in current approaches to kernel concurrency bug detection and analysis. By shedding light on these challenges, this work paves the way for new operating system designs, testing tools, and verification efforts that will make modern operating systems more reliable and secure.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 并发缺陷源于并发指令的意外执行顺序，并且由于其非确定性本质而极难检测和诊断。先前对用户空间应用中并发缺陷的研究已识别出常见的缺陷特征，并为有效的检测、诊断和修复技术的设计提供了依据。相比之下，人们对操作系统内核中的并发缺陷知之甚少，因为底层系统编程和复杂的执行模式引入了根本不同的并发执行行为。本文首次对Linux内核中的并发缺陷进行了全面研究。我们分析了200个真实世界的内核并发缺陷，并系统地刻画了它们的表现形式、根本原因、发现过程和修复特征。我们的研究表明，内核并发缺陷与用户空间对应缺陷存在显著差异。例如，27.5%的内核并发缺陷仅在特定中断事件发生时才会出现，而现有缺陷发现方法往往忽视此类缺陷。此外，近一半的缺陷发生在内核驱动程序中，其中69.3%源于设备注册和注销等控制路径上的并发设备操作，这凸显了驱动程序控制逻辑作为并发缺陷发现关键目标的重要性。总体而言，我们的发现揭示了当前内核并发缺陷检测与分析方法的关键局限性。通过阐明这些挑战，这项工作为新的操作系统设计、测试工具和验证工作铺平了道路，从而使现代操作系统更加可靠和安全。

upstream_only.title: Toward Efficient Package Maintenance: An Empirical Study of Patch Sharing across Four Linux Distributions
upstream_only.abstract: As a cornerstone of cloud computing and artificial intelligence, the Linux operating system has given rise to many popular distributions (distros), such as Fedora and Debian. A distro includes a rich collection of software packages derived from third-party open-source projects (upstream). Due to the nature of reusing upstream, some packages originate from the same upstream projects, noted as homologous packages. Maintaining packages is a core but tedious task for distros, which relies on continuously developing code patches. The maintenance of homologous packages could benefit from cross-distro collaboration. However, their shared origin may also lead to redundant efforts and delayed reuse of valuable maintenance work performed by other distros. To measure potential inefficiencies and explore possible solutions, this paper conducts an empirical study of patch sharing among homologous packages across four representative distros spanning three distinct families: Debian, Ubuntu, Fedora, and openEuler. We find that homologous packages are prevalent across distros, even across different distro families. Specifically, there are 13,873 homologous packages shared between Debian and Fedora, accounting for 40.3\% and 56.1\% of all packages in Debian and Fedora, respectively. For homologous packages with the same upstream version, we found that 19.5\% of the patches are shared between Fedora and Debian, and 46.7\% between Fedora and openEuler. However, these shared patches often exhibit remarkable propagation latency, with a median lag of 530.0 days between Fedora and Debian and 169.0 days between Fedora and openEuler. These results highlight the importance and necessity of cross-distro-family patch recommendations. We identified 17 shared Fedora-exclusive patches and contributed them to openEuler, among which 15 patches were successfully merged, demonstrating the potential of cross-distro-family patch recommendation and inspiring further research in this area.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 作为云计算和人工智能的基石，Linux操作系统催生了许多流行发行版（distro），如Fedora和Debian。发行版包含大量源自第三方开源项目（上游）的软件包。由于复用上游的性质，一些软件包源自相同的上游项目，称为同源软件包。维护软件包是发行版的核心但繁琐的任务，依赖于持续开发代码补丁。同源软件包的维护可以从跨发行版协作中受益。然而，它们的共同来源也可能导致重复努力，并延迟对其他发行版所做有价值维护工作的复用。为了衡量潜在的低效并探索可能的解决方案，本文对四个代表性发行版（涵盖三个不同家族：Debian、Ubuntu、Fedora和openEuler）中的同源软件包之间的补丁共享进行了实证研究。我们发现同源软件包在发行版之间普遍存在，甚至跨不同发行版家族。具体而言，Debian和Fedora之间共享13,873个同源软件包，分别占Debian和Fedora所有软件包的40.3%和56.1%。对于具有相同上游版本的同源软件包，我们发现19.5%的补丁在Fedora和Debian之间共享，46.7%在Fedora和openEuler之间共享。然而，这些共享补丁往往表现出显著的传播延迟，Fedora与Debian之间的中位滞后为530.0天，Fedora与openEuler之间为169.0天。这些结果突显了跨发行版家族补丁推荐的重要性和必要性。我们识别出17个Fedora独有的共享补丁，并将它们贡献给openEuler，其中15个补丁成功合并，展示了跨发行版家族补丁推荐的潜力，并激励了该领域的进一步研究。

upstream_only.title: Causal or Correlational? A Cohort Study on the Effects of Code Smells on Class Change- and Fault-Proneness
upstream_only.abstract: Code smells are suboptimal design choices in source code that are conjectured to hinder software maintainability. Previous research has studied the impact of code smells on class change- and fault-proneness, yet, as in most mining studies, it has been limited to highlighting correlations rather than detecting causal relationships.This paper instantiates the cohort study design to software repository studies and presents a cohort study aimed at assessing whether code smells cause an increase or decrease in class change- and fault-proneness.By reusing data from the work of Khomh et al.  [41] within a cohort study design, we investigate the causal effect of eleven types of code smells on class change- and fault-proneness.Our results show that, overall, the presence of code smells appears to be causing a significant increase in change-proneness, while, with few exceptions, fault-proneness appears unaffected. This work reinforces the principle that correlation does not imply causation: we partially confirmed some previous results on the effects of code smells, while challenging others. It also lays the groundwork for applying cohort study designs to other software properties and relationships previously studied using observational data.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 代码异味是源代码中的次优设计选择，被推测会阻碍软件可维护性。先前的研究已经研究了代码异味对类变更倾向和故障倾向的影响，然而，正如大多数挖掘研究一样，它仅限于强调相关性，而非检测因果关系。本文将队列研究设计引入软件仓库研究，并提出了一项队列研究，旨在评估代码异味是否会导致类变更倾向和故障倾向的增加或减少。通过在队列研究设计中重用Khomh等人[41]的数据，我们研究了十一种代码异味对类变更倾向和故障倾向的因果效应。我们的结果表明，总体而言，代码异味的存在似乎会导致变更倾向的显著增加，而除少数例外，故障倾向似乎不受影响。这项工作强化了相关性不意味着因果性的原则：我们部分证实了先前关于代码异味影响的一些结果，同时对其他结果提出了挑战。它还为将队列研究设计应用于其他先前使用观察数据研究的软件属性和关系奠定了基础。

upstream_only.title: FlowScope: Non-Intrusive Distributed Tracing with Method-Level Delay Estimation for Microservices Troubleshooting
upstream_only.abstract: As the scale and complexity of microservices increase, their operation and debugging become increasingly challenging. A single user request may involve interactions among hundreds of components. In such complex systems, non-intrusive distributed tracing techniques, which require no modification of application code, significantly enhance the convenience of troubleshooting. However, existing non-intrusive tracing frameworks still exhibit critical shortcomings in achieving tracing accuracy: current approaches either rely on specific thread model assumptions, limiting their applicability, or employ incorrectly constructed causal delay distributions to infer request causality, leading to erroneous trace construction. To overcome these limitations, we propose FlowScope, a non-intrusive distributed tracing framework for microservices that optimizes trace reconstruction through method-level delay distribution estimation. This framework estimates the causal delay distribution between requests of different method types via cross-correlation analysis, then uses these delay distributions to accurately evaluate the probability of causal relationships between requests. Subsequently, it efficiently reconstructs traces by incorporating multiple constraints with an iterative algorithm. Our testbed results indicate that FlowScope improves tracing accuracy by 51\% compared to state-of-the-art frameworks (e.g., DeepFlow and TraceWeaver) and has been successfully applied in multiple real-world use cases.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 随着微服务规模和复杂性的增加，其运行和调试变得越来越具有挑战性。单个用户请求可能涉及数百个组件之间的交互。在如此复杂的系统中，非侵入式分布式追踪技术无需修改应用代码，显著提高了故障排查的便利性。然而，现有的非侵入式追踪框架在实现追踪准确性方面仍然存在关键缺陷：当前方法要么依赖于特定的线程模型假设，限制了其适用性，要么采用构造不当的因果延迟分布来推断请求因果关系，导致错误的追踪构建。为了克服这些限制，我们提出FlowScope，一个面向微服务的非侵入式分布式追踪框架，通过方法级延迟分布估计来优化追踪重建。该框架通过互相关分析估计不同方法类型请求之间的因果延迟分布，然后使用这些延迟分布准确评估请求之间因果关系的概率。随后，它通过结合多个约束的迭代算法高效地重建追踪。我们的测试平台结果表明，与最先进的框架（例如DeepFlow和TraceWeaver）相比，FlowScope将追踪准确性提高了51%，并已成功应用于多个真实世界用例。

upstream_only.title: CCLInsight: Unveiling Insights in GPU Collective Communication Libraries via Primitive-Centric Analysis
upstream_only.abstract: As distributed AI workloads scale in complexity, GPU-based collective communication libraries (xCCLs) such as NCCL are becoming increasingly critical for efficient data movement across heterogeneous hardware. Characterizing and optimizing the interactions between hardware architectures, communication algorithm designs, and low-level primitive configurations is essential to fully utilize GPU and interconnect resources while ensuring scalability. However, existing analysis methods often lack depth, limit optimization insights, leave significant performance gains untapped, or lack generality. To address these limitations, we propose a novel primitive-centric profiling and analysis method that integrates architectural, algorithmic, and primitive-level insights to comprehensively qualify and quantify performance-critical parameters in GPU-based CCLs. We implement and evaluate this method in our tool CCLInsight. Evaluating three large-scale GPU clusters with diverse GPU architectures (64 H100s, 64 RTX 5000s, and 256 A100s) for design analysis, and a fourth 256-GPU H200 cluster for application-level evaluation, CCLInsight uncovers critical parameter influences on communication efficiency and scalability, as well as exposing a new CCL performance scaling law, the collapsed optimal configuration scaling law. Adjusting parameters based on this analysis, we demonstrate a 43.90\% improvement in NCCL and a 40.64{\texttimes} speedup in MSCCL over default configurations in the collective communication microbenchmark, while also improving NCCL and MSCCL performance by up to 2.27{\texttimes} and 3.00{\texttimes}, respectively, on LLM training workloads (GPT-3, LLaMA2, DeepSeek-R1). These contributions establish CCLInsight as a useful tool for xCCL characterization and optimization in distributed AI environments.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 随着分布式AI工作负载的复杂性不断增加，基于GPU的集合通信库（xCCL），如NCCL，对于跨异构硬件的高效数据移动正变得越来越关键。刻画并优化硬件架构、通信算法设计与底层原语配置之间的相互作用，对于充分利用GPU和互连资源并确保可扩展性至关重要。然而，现有的分析方法往往缺乏深度、限制优化洞见、未能挖掘显著性能收益，或缺乏通用性。为解决这些局限，我们提出了一种新颖的以原语为中心的剖析与分析方法，该方法整合架构、算法和原语级洞见，以全面定性和定量分析基于GPU的CCL中性能关键参数。我们在工具CCLInsight中实现并评估了该方法。通过评估三个具有不同GPU架构的大规模GPU集群（64 H100、64 RTX 5000和256 A100）进行设计分析，以及第四个256-GPU H200集群进行应用级评估，CCLInsight揭示了关键参数对通信效率和可扩展性的影响，并发现了一条新的CCL性能扩展定律，即坍缩最优配置扩展定律。根据该分析调整参数后，我们在集合通信微基准测试中实现了NCCL 43.90%的提升和MSCCL相比默认配置40.64倍的加速，同时在LLM训练工作负载（GPT-3、LLaMA2、DeepSeek-R1）上将NCCL和MSCCL性能分别提升至多2.27倍和3.00倍。这些贡献确立了CCLInsight作为分布式AI环境中xCCL刻画与优化的有用工具。

upstream_only.title: Semantic-Enhanced Automatic Refinement of Architecture Recovery Results Using LLMs
upstream_only.abstract: Understanding the architecture is crucial for effectively maintaining and managing large software systems. However, discrepancies often exist between the designed and implemented architectures, which can pose significant risks. To identify these discrepancies, architects need to extract the architecture from the system implementation, which is both time-consuming and error-prone. To simplify this procedure, many automatic architecture recovery techniques have been developed. Yet, their accuracy is often limited. Architects must still invest significant effort in refining recovery results to ensure they accurately reflect the implemented architecture.To reduce such manual effort, we introduce SemRef, a framework that combines LLMs with dependency analysis to automatically refine architectures recovered by existing architecture recovery tools. By leveraging the LLM’s semantic understanding capabilities and integrating structural dependencies, SemRef enhances both the accuracy and the comprehension of recovered architectures. To evaluate SemRef, we tested on 9 projects with published ground-truth architectures and 10 state-of-the-art architecture recovery tools. 5 commonly used metrics are adopted to evaluate the effectiveness of SemRef. The results show that SemRef improves accuracy across various metrics, with normalized gains ranges from 17.72\% to 43.35\%. Specifically, for MoJoFM and a2aadj metrics, SemRef achieves relative improvements of 118.57\% and 100.41\%, respectively. Moreover, SemRef is highly scalable. It maintains stable performance across projects ranging from thousands to trillions of lines of code with the cost scale linearly with project size. Further, we test SemRef on various LLMs to demonstrate its generalizability across different models. Beyond improving accuracy, the integration of LLMs enables SemRef to provide a structured module hierarchy and hierarchical module summaries, which further enhance the comprehensibility of recovered architectures.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 理解架构对于有效维护和管理大型软件系统至关重要。然而，设计架构与实现架构之间往往存在差异，这可能带来重大风险。为了识别这些差异，架构师需要从系统实现中提取架构，这既耗时又容易出错。为了简化这一过程，许多自动架构恢复技术已被开发出来。然而，它们的准确性往往有限。架构师仍必须投入大量精力来精化恢复结果，以确保其准确反映实现架构。为了减少这种人工投入，我们提出了SemRef，一个将LLM与依赖分析相结合的框架，用于自动精化现有架构恢复工具所恢复的架构。通过利用LLM的语义理解能力并集成结构依赖，SemRef提升了恢复架构的准确性和可理解性。为了评估SemRef，我们在9个具有公开真实架构的项目和10种最先进的架构恢复工具上进行了测试。采用5种常用指标来评估SemRef的有效性。结果表明，SemRef在各项指标上均提升了准确性，归一化增益范围从17.72%到43.35%。具体而言，对于MoJoFM和a2aadj指标，SemRef分别实现了118.57%和100.41%的相对改进。此外，SemRef具有高度可扩展性。它在从数千行到数万亿行代码的项目上保持稳定性能，且成本随项目规模线性增长。进一步地，我们在多种LLM上测试了SemRef，以证明其在不同模型间的泛化能力。除了提升准确性，LLM的集成还使SemRef能够提供结构化的模块层次和分层模块摘要，进一步增强了恢复架构的可理解性。

upstream_only.title: Metronome: Differentiated Delay Scheduling for Serverless Functions
upstream_only.abstract: Function-as-a-Service (FaaS) computing is an emerging cloud computing paradigm for its ease-of-management and elasticity. However, optimizing scheduling for serverless functions remains challenging due to their dynamic and event-driven nature. While data locality has been proven effective in traditional cluster computing systems through delay scheduling, its application in serverless platforms remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we systematically evaluate existing delay scheduling methods in serverless environments and identify three key observations: 1) delay scheduling benefits vary significantly based on function input characteristics; 2) serverless computing exhibits more complex locality patterns than cluster computing systems, encompassing both data locality and infrastructure locality; and 3) heterogeneous function execution times make rule-based delay thresholds ineffective. Based on these insights, we propose Metronome, a differentiated delay scheduling framework that employs predictive mechanisms to identify optimal locality-aware nodes for individual functions. Metronome leverages an online Random Forest Regression model to forecast function execution times across various nodes, enabling informed delay decisions while preventing SLA violations. Our implementation on OpenLambda shows that Metronome significantly outperforms baselines, achieving 64.88\%–95.83\% reduction in mean execution time for functions, while maintaining performance advantages under increased concurrency levels and ensuring SLA compliance.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 函数即服务（FaaS）计算因其易于管理和弹性而成为一种新兴的云计算范式。然而，由于无服务器函数动态且事件驱动的特性，优化其调度仍然具有挑战性。尽管数据局部性已通过延迟调度在传统集群计算系统中被证明有效，但其在无服务器平台中的应用仍 largely 未被探索。本文系统评估了无服务器环境中的现有延迟调度方法，并识别出三个关键观察：1）延迟调度收益因函数输入特征而显著不同；2）无服务器计算呈现出比集群计算系统更复杂的局部性模式，涵盖数据局部性和基础设施局部性；3）异构的函数执行时间使基于规则的延迟阈值失效。基于这些见解，我们提出 Metronome，一种差异化延迟调度框架，采用预测机制为单个函数识别最优的局部性感知节点。Metronome 利用在线随机森林回归模型预测函数在不同节点上的执行时间，从而在防止 SLA 违规的同时做出明智的延迟决策。我们在 OpenLambda 上的实现表明，Metronome 显著优于基线，将函数的平均执行时间减少了 64.88%–95.83%，同时在并发水平提高时保持性能优势并确保 SLA 合规。

upstream_only.title: SSAR: A Novel Software Architecture Recovery Approach Enhancing Accuracy and Scalability
upstream_only.abstract: Software architecture is critical for software development and maintenance. As software evolves, its architecture may drift from the original design, resulting in architectural degradation that negatively affects software quality. To effectively manage and maintain software systems, architects need an accurate understanding of the current architecture, but manual analysis is time-consuming and error-prone. Therefore, numerous automated architecture recovery techniques have been developed to facilitate this process. However, existing techniques often face limitations in either accuracy or efficiency, especially when dealing with large-scale software systems. In this paper, we propose a novel architecture recovery approach that integrates semantic similarity and structural dependencies between files to construct a weighted graph. Then it applies an optimized community detection algorithm to partition the graph for software modularization. To evaluate the effectiveness of our approach, we selected nine open-source projects with ground-truth architectures and compared our approach against six state-of-the-art architecture recovery techniques. Experimental results have shown that our approach improves accuracy ranging from 5.0\% to 90.9\%, 3.8\% to 16.9\%, and 12.5\% to 500\% in the three well-known architecture similarity metrics (MoJoFM, a2a, and c2ccvg), respectively. Additionally, it reduces the average execution time by 5\% to 99\%. In conclusion, our approach not only achieves a more precise recovery of software architecture but also significantly cuts down the time and effort required for the recovery process.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 软件架构对软件开发与维护至关重要。随着软件演化，其架构可能偏离原始设计，导致架构退化，从而对软件质量产生负面影响。为了有效管理和维护软件系统，架构师需要准确理解当前架构，但人工分析耗时且易错。因此，已有许多自动化架构恢复技术来促进这一过程。然而，现有技术在准确性或效率方面常常存在局限，尤其是在处理大规模软件系统时。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的架构恢复方法，该方法整合文件间的语义相似性和结构依赖关系来构建加权图。然后应用优化的社区检测算法对图进行划分以实现软件模块化。为了评估方法的有效性，我们选择了九个具有真实架构的开源项目，并将我们的方法与六种最先进的架构恢复技术进行了比较。实验结果表明，我们的方法在三个著名的架构相似性度量（MoJoFM、a2a和c2ccvg）上分别将准确性提升了5.0%到90.9%、3.8%到16.9%和12.5%到500%。此外，它将平均执行时间减少了5%到99%。总之，我们的方法不仅实现了更精确的软件架构恢复，而且显著减少了恢复过程所需的时间和精力。

upstream_only.title: LogFold: Compressing Logs with Structured Tokens and Hybrid Encoding
upstream_only.abstract: Logs are essential for diagnosing failures and conducting retrospective studies, leading many software organizations to retain log messages for a long time. Nevertheless, the volume of generated log data grows rapidly as software systems grow, necessitating an effective compression method. Apart from general-purpose compressors (e.g., Gzip, Bzip2), many recent studies developed log-specific compression algorithms, but they offer suboptimal performance because of (1) overlooking redundancies within certain complex tokens, and (2) lacking a fine-grained encoding strategy for diverse token types.This work uncovers a new redundancy pattern in structured tokens and proposes a new type-aware encoding strategy to improve log compression. Building on this insight, we introduce LogFold, a novel log compression method consisting of four components: a token analyzer to classifies tokens as structured, unstructured, or static types; a processor that mines recurring patterns within structured tokens based on their delimiter skeletons; a hybrid encoder that tailors data representation according to token types; and a packer that compresses the output into an archive file. Extensive experiments on 16 public log datasets demonstrate that LogFold surpasses state-of-the-art baselines, achieving average compression ratio improvements by 11.11\%, with a compression speed of 9.842 MB/s. Ablation studies further indicate the importance of each component. We also conduct sensitivity analyses to verify LogFold’s robustness and stability across various internal settings.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 日志对于诊断故障和进行回顾性研究至关重要，这使得许多软件组织长期保留日志消息。然而，随着软件系统的增长，生成的日志数据量迅速增长，因此需要一种有效的压缩方法。除了通用压缩器（如Gzip、Bzip2）之外，许多近期研究开发了针对日志的压缩算法，但由于（1）忽略了某些复杂令牌内部的冗余，以及（2）缺乏针对多样令牌类型的细粒度编码策略，它们提供的性能欠佳。这项工作揭示了结构化令牌中的一种新的冗余模式，并提出了一种新的类型感知编码策略来改进日志压缩。基于这一洞见，我们引入了LogFold，一种新颖的日志压缩方法，由四个组件组成：一个令牌分析器，将令牌分类为结构化、非结构化或静态类型；一个处理器，基于分隔符骨架挖掘结构化令牌中的重复模式；一个混合编码器，根据令牌类型定制数据表示；以及一个打包器，将输出压缩为归档文件。在16个公共日志数据集上的大量实验表明，LogFold超越了最先进的基线，平均压缩比提高了11.11%，压缩速度为9.842 MB/s。消融研究进一步表明了每个组件的重要性。我们还进行了敏感性分析，以验证LogFold在各种内部设置下的鲁棒性和稳定性。

upstream_only.title: Do Unit Proofs Work? An Empirical Study of Compositional Bounded Model Checking for Memory Safety Verification
upstream_only.abstract: Memory safety defects pose a major threat to software reliability, enabling cyberattacks, outages, and crashes. To mitigate these risks, organizations adopt Compositional Bounded Model Checking (BMC), using unit proofs to formally verify memory safety. However, methods for creating unit proofs vary across organizations and are inconsistent within the same project, leading to errors and missed defects. In addition, unit proofing remains understudied, with no systematic development methods or empirical evaluations.This work presents the first empirical study on unit proofing for memory safety verification. We introduce a systematic method for creating unit proofs that leverages verification feedback and objective criteria. Using this approach, we develop 73 unit proofs for four embedded operating systems and evaluate their effectiveness, characteristics, cost, and generalizability. Our results show unit proofs are cost-effective, detecting 74\% of recreated defects, with an additional 9\% found with increased BMC bounds, and 20 new defects exposed. We also found that embedded software requires small unit proofs, which can be developed in 87 minutes and executed in 61 seconds on average. These findings provide practical guidance for engineers and empirical data to inform tooling design.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 内存安全缺陷对软件可靠性构成重大威胁，可导致网络攻击、服务中断和崩溃。为降低这些风险，组织采用组合有界模型检测（BMC），使用单元证明来形式化验证内存安全。然而，创建单元证明的方法因组织而异，同一项目内也不一致，导致错误和遗漏缺陷。此外，单元证明仍缺乏研究，没有系统化的开发方法或实证评估。本工作提出了首个针对内存安全验证中单元证明的实证研究。我们引入一种系统化的单元证明创建方法，利用验证反馈和客观标准。使用该方法，我们为四个嵌入式操作系统开发了73个单元证明，并评估其有效性、特征、成本和泛化性。结果表明，单元证明具有成本效益，检测出74%的复现缺陷，在增加BMC边界后又发现9%，并暴露20个新缺陷。我们还发现嵌入式软件需要小型单元证明，平均可在87分钟内开发完成并在61秒内执行。这些发现为工程师提供实践指导，并为工具设计提供实证数据。

upstream_only.title: Accurate Inference of Termination Conditions
upstream_only.abstract: We present the first approach to infer termination conditions that are accurate in the sense of precisely characterizing terminating states. It builds on a simple but effective framework where non-terminating states are iteratively identified and removed, and a termination prover is employed to validate the current condition. We instantiate the framework with data-driven provers and design a multi-way data sharing mechanism to enhance their interaction. Our proofs show that this method is correct, accurate, terminating, and relatively complete. Additionally, we introduce generalization techniques for recurrent sets to accelerate the iteration process. Evaluation on a benchmark of programs from the literature shows that our implementation significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art tool Acabar, producing much more accurate termination conditions, with the proposed techniques playing a crucial role in speeding up the convergence of the process.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了首个推断终止条件的方法，这些条件在精确刻画终止状态的意义上是准确的。它建立在一个简单但有效的框架之上，其中非终止状态被迭代地识别和移除，并采用终止性证明器来验证当前条件。我们用数据驱动的证明器实例化该框架，并设计了一种多路数据共享机制来增强它们的交互。我们的证明表明该方法正确、准确、可终止且相对完备。此外，我们引入了递归集的泛化技术以加速迭代过程。在文献中的程序基准测试上的评估表明，我们的实现显著优于最先进的工具Acabar，产生更准确的终止条件，所提出的技术在加速过程收敛方面起到了关键作用。

upstream_only.title: One Size Does Fit All: Kernel-Assisted Fine-Grained Debloating and Layout Randomization for Shared Libraries
upstream_only.abstract: Prevalent software engineering practices, such as code reuse and the “one-size-fits-all” methodology, have significantly contributed to code bloat. Code debloating, which targets the reduction of extraneous code, emerges as a promising solution to combat this issue. However, current methods that depend on redundant code deletion are at odds with the foundational design philosophy of reusable code components, regardless of whether they are applied offline or at runtime.In this paper, we introduce a kernel-assisted debloating framework, K-Polarizer, that aligns with the “one-size-fits-all” design philosophy of shared libraries. Starting from scratch, K-Polarizer progressively appends dependencies on demand to the underlying page cache associated with offline-reconstructed shared libraries, enabling it to practice the hybrid debloating strategy of “cutting unwanted pages while loading needed functions.” This allows for code sharing among processes while minimizing the global code base, keeping the visible code base for each process to an approximate minimum. Additionally, K-Polarizer integrates layout randomization at load-time to enhance security further. We have thoroughly evaluated K-Polarizer using real-world shared libraries, including musl-libc, glibc, and libFLAC. The results indicate that K-Polarizer operates transparently, preserving the original functionality of the libraries. Furthermore, K-Polarizer provides security guarantees (76.1\% gadget reduction on musl-libc) comparable to the leading debloating technique with acceptable overhead, while gracefully handling the scenario of dynamic library loading. Meanwhile, it offers resilience against memory disclosures.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 流行的软件工程实践，如代码复用和“一刀切”方法，显著导致了代码膨胀。代码去膨胀旨在减少多余代码，是应对该问题的一种有前景的解决方案。然而，当前依赖冗余代码删除的方法与可复用代码组件的基础设计哲学相冲突，无论这些方法是在离线还是在运行时应用。在本文中，我们介绍了一种内核辅助的去膨胀框架 K-Polarizer，它与共享库的“一刀切”设计哲学相一致。K-Polarizer 从零开始，按需逐步将依赖项追加到与离线重建的共享库相关联的底层页缓存中，使其能够实践“剪除不需要的页，同时加载所需函数”的混合去膨胀策略。这允许进程间代码共享，同时最小化全局代码库，使每个进程可见的代码库保持在大致最小。此外，K-Polarizer 在加载时集成了布局随机化，以进一步增强安全性。我们使用真实世界的共享库（包括 musl-libc、glibc 和 libFLAC）对 K-Polarizer 进行了全面评估。结果表明，K-Polarizer 透明运行，保留了库的原始功能。此外，K-Polarizer 提供了与领先去膨胀技术相当的安全保证（在 musl-libc 上减少 76.1% 的 gadget），且开销可接受，同时优雅地处理动态库加载场景。同时，它对内存泄露具有韧性。

upstream_only.title: Project-Level Resource Leak Detection through Agent-based Ownership Analysis and Repair Pattern Verification
upstream_only.abstract: Resource leaks cause system performance degradation and crashes. Traditional static analysis approaches rely on predefined rules, limiting their ability to find unknown leaks. Emerging LLM-based methods can locate APIs but face challenges in large-scale projects, including high costs and numerous false positives. To address these limitations, we propose AROP, the first project-level resource leak detection framework integrating LLM-based agents. AROP first extracts project-level metadata to efficiently filter resource-related files. It then employs a detection agent to identify acquisition/release operations, followed by a validation agent and data-flow dependency analysis to reduce false positives. Finally, it determines leaks through leak repair pattern analysis.We evaluated the effectiveness of our tool on the JLeaks benchmark and 6 large-scale real-world open-source projects. On JLeaks, AROP achieved a recall of 66.1\% with a precision of 91.0\%, which outperformed the current state-of-the-art, INFERROI, surpassing it by 18.2\% in precision while maintaining a comparable recall. In evaluation on real-world projects, AROP discovered 106 previously unknown resource leak defects with a precision of 71.3\%. We submitted patches for 28 of these defects, all of which have been confirmed and merged by developers.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 资源泄漏会导致系统性能下降和崩溃。传统的静态分析方法依赖预定义规则，限制了其发现未知泄漏的能力。新兴的基于LLM的方法能够定位API，但面临大规模项目中的挑战，包括高成本和大量误报。为解决这些局限，我们提出AROP，首个集成基于LLM的智能体的项目级资源泄漏检测框架。AROP首先提取项目级元数据以高效过滤资源相关文件。然后使用检测智能体识别获取/释放操作，随后通过验证智能体和数据流依赖分析来减少误报。最后，它通过泄漏修复模式分析确定泄漏。我们在JLeaks基准和6个大规模真实开源项目上评估了工具的有效性。在JLeaks上，AROP实现了66.1%的召回率和91.0%的精确率，优于当前最先进的INFERROI，在召回率相当的情况下，精确率提高了18.2%。在真实项目评估中，AROP发现了106个先前未知的资源泄漏缺陷，精确率为71.3%。我们为其中28个缺陷提交了补丁，所有补丁均已被开发者确认并合并。

upstream_only.title: Verification of Multi-Model Stochastic Systems
upstream_only.abstract: Given its ability to analyse stochastic models ranging from discrete and continuous-time Markov chains to Markov decision processes and stochastic games, probabilistic model checking (PMC) is widely used to verify system dependability and performance properties. However, modelling the behaviour of, and verifying these properties for many software-intensive systems requires the joint analysis of multiple interdependent stochastic models of different types, which existing PMC techniques and tools cannot handle. To address this limitation, we introduce a tool-supported UniversaL stochasTIc Modelling, verificAtion and synThEsis (ULTIMATE) framework that supports the representation, verification and synthesis of heterogeneous multi-model stochastic systems with complex model interdependencies. Through its unique integration of multiple PMC paradigms, and underpinned by a novel verification method for handling model interdependencies, ULTIMATE unifies—for the first time—the modelling of probabilistic and nondeterministic uncertainty, discrete and continuous time, partial observability, and the use of both Bayesian and frequentist inference to exploit domain knowledge and data about the modelled system and its context. A comprehensive suite of case studies and experiments confirm the generality and effectiveness of our novel verification framework.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 鉴于概率模型检测（PMC）能够分析从离散和连续时间马尔可夫链到马尔可夫决策过程和随机博弈等随机模型，它被广泛用于验证系统的可靠性和性能属性。然而，对许多软件密集型系统的行为进行建模并验证这些属性，需要联合分析多个不同类型且相互依赖的随机模型，而现有的PMC技术和工具无法处理。为解决这一局限，我们引入了一个工具支持的 UniversaL stochasTIc Modelling, verificAtion and synThEsis (ULTIMATE) 框架，该框架支持具有复杂模型相互依赖关系的异构多模型随机系统的表示、验证和综合。通过独特地集成多种PMC范式，并以一种处理模型相互依赖关系的新颖验证方法为基础，ULTIMATE 首次统一了概率与非确定性不确定性、离散与连续时间、部分可观测性，以及使用贝叶斯和频率派推断来利用关于被建模系统及其上下文的领域知识和数据。一套全面的案例研究和实验证实了我们新颖验证框架的通用性和有效性。

upstream_only.title: Fast Flow-Sensitive C Program Partitioning via Iterative Value-Flow Refinement
upstream_only.abstract: Software vulnerabilities that expose confidential data remain a persistent threat. Even vulnerabilities in unprivileged code can expose data in privileged code when they share memory. Program partitioning safeguards against this by dividing a monolithic program into component programs according to a security policy for sharing confidential data, following the Principle of Least Privilege: each component of a system should operate with minimum privileges.Automatic C program partitioners determine a partition by tracking dataflows of confidential values; when pointers are involved, this means a pointer analysis, so precision and performance tradeoffs are inevitable. Existing work uses Andersen’s flow-insensitive analysis, which is efficient but rejects secure programs—on the other hand, flow-sensitive analysis has not traditionally scaled.In this paper, we present CSP (C Sparse Partitioner), a C partitioner that supports robust security policies for mutual distrust and employs sparse demand-driven pointer analysis to achieve flow-sensitive precision at a fraction of the cost of whole-program flow-sensitive analysis. Our key innovation is an iterative value-flow refinement where a flow-insensitive constraint system is locally refined for flow-sensitivity as partitioning conflicts are found. We evaluate CSP on large real-world C programs with security requirements such as OpenSSH and Sendmail, and find that our technique outperforms whole-program flow-sensitive pointer analysis by up to an order of magnitude without sacrificing precision.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 暴露机密数据的软件漏洞仍然是一个持续存在的威胁。即使是未特权代码中的漏洞，当它们共享内存时，也可能暴露特权代码中的数据。程序分区通过根据共享机密数据的安全策略将单体程序划分为组件程序来防止这种情况，遵循最小特权原则：系统的每个组件都应以最小特权运行。自动C程序分区器通过跟踪机密值的数据流来确定分区；当涉及指针时，这意味着需要进行指针分析，因此精度和性能之间的权衡不可避免。现有工作使用Andersen的流不敏感分析，这种方法高效但会拒绝安全程序——另一方面，流敏感分析传统上难以扩展。在本文中，我们提出了CSP（C稀疏分区器），一个支持相互不信任的鲁棒安全策略的C分区器，它采用稀疏需求驱动指针分析，以整个程序流敏感分析的一小部分成本实现流敏感精度。我们的关键创新是迭代值流精化，其中当发现分区冲突时，流不敏感约束系统被局部精化为流敏感。我们在具有安全要求的大型真实C程序（如OpenSSH和Sendmail）上评估了CSP，发现我们的技术在不牺牲精度的情况下，比整个程序流敏感指针分析快达一个数量级。

upstream_only.title: Accelerating IC3 Verification by Exploiting Unsatisfiable Cores and Satisfying Models
upstream_only.abstract: The IC3 algorithm represents a groundbreaking advancement in the field of model checking. However, its heavy reliance on numerous and frequent constraint-solving calls poses significant challenges when verifying complex programs. We observe that many of the constraints solved within IC3 share remarkable similarities. Based on this observation, we propose an IC3 acceleration verification method by reusing unsatisfiable cores and satisfying models of previous constraints. This method constructs an Unsatisfiable Core Library (UCL) and a Satisfying Model Library (SML) to store and index crucial unsatisfiable cores and satisfying models generated during the verification process. When a new constraint-solving request is received, our method preemptively determines the satisfiability of the constraint using the existing unsatisfiable cores and satisfying models. This approach can significantly reduce the number of required solver calls, thereby enhancing the verification efficiency. We have implemented our method on Kind2 and evaluated it on the standard benchmark suite of Kind2. Experimental evaluation demonstrates that, for complex examples, our method can reduce the number of solver calls by an order of magnitude, and achieves a 4.35-fold speedup with even less memory consumption.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: IC3算法代表了模型检测领域的突破性进展。然而，它严重依赖大量且频繁的约束求解调用，这在验证复杂程序时带来了重大挑战。我们观察到，IC3中求解的许多约束具有显著的相似性。基于这一观察，我们提出了一种通过复用先前约束的不可满足核和满足模型来加速IC3验证的方法。该方法构建了一个不可满足核库（UCL）和一个满足模型库（SML），用于存储和索引验证过程中生成的关键不可满足核与满足模型。当收到新的约束求解请求时，我们的方法利用已有的不可满足核和满足模型抢先判断该约束的可满足性。这种方法可以显著减少所需的求解器调用次数，从而提高验证效率。我们在Kind2上实现了我们的方法，并在Kind2的标准基准套件上进行了评估。实验评估表明，对于复杂示例，我们的方法可以将求解器调用次数减少一个数量级，并实现4.35倍的加速，同时内存消耗更少。

upstream_only.title: Towards Global Matches for Third-Party Library Detection in Android
upstream_only.abstract: The detection of third-party libraries (TPLs) is pivotal in upholding the security of Android supply chains. A significant hurdle in this domain pertains to ensuring accurate detection, particularly in the face of prevalent code obfuscation techniques. Recently, multiple research endeavors have advocated for the adoption of fuzzy library signatures to accommodate specific code features that can be affected by code obfuscation. Despite the potential promise of this approach, the use of such abstractions often results in the identification of multiple candidates that bear a striking resemblance. Unfortunately, prevailing methodologies tend to rely on local maxima of similarity matches, disregarding the broader contextual knowledge encapsulated within surrounding classes. This oversight culminates in suboptimal matching outcomes.The key observation motivating our research is that knowledge about surrounding library classes can significantly enhance matching accuracy. In this regard, we aim to establish a correspondence between sets of classes in a given app and target library—leveraging this contextual information from surrounding classes enables a transition from local matches to global matches. We implemented our idea in a TPL detection tool, called LibScope. LibScope refines obfuscation-resilient library signatures and introduces a strategic iterative process (i.e., a back-and-forth game), thereby elevating the pairwise similarity between independent classes to similarities among sets of classes. We extensively evaluated LibScope with state-of-the-art TPL detection approaches published at top venues. The comparative results on two representative public benchmarks reveal that LibScope significantly outperforms its counterparts in terms of recall, precision, and accuracy in library version detection.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 第三方库（TPL）的检测对于维护Android供应链的安全至关重要。该领域的一个重大障碍在于确保准确检测，特别是在面对普遍存在的代码混淆技术时。最近，多项研究工作主张采用模糊库签名来适应可能受代码混淆影响的特定代码特征。尽管这种方法具有潜在前景，但使用此类抽象往往会导致识别出多个高度相似的候选。遗憾的是，现有方法往往依赖于相似性匹配的局部最大值，忽略了周围类所包含的更广泛上下文知识。这种疏忽导致匹配结果次优。我们研究的核心观察是，关于周围库类的知识可以显著提高匹配准确性。为此，我们旨在建立给定应用中的类集合与目标库之间的对应关系——利用来自周围类的上下文信息，使得从局部匹配过渡到全局匹配。我们在一个名为LibScope的TPL检测工具中实现了我们的想法。LibScope改进了抗混淆的库签名，并引入了一种策略性迭代过程（即，一种来回博弈），从而将独立类之间的成对相似性提升为类集合之间的相似性。我们使用发表在顶级会议上的最先进TPL检测方法对LibScope进行了广泛评估。在两个代表性公开基准上的比较结果表明，LibScope在召回率、精确率和库版本检测准确性方面显著优于同类方法。

upstream_only.title: Closing the Chain: How to reduce your risk of being SolarWinds, Log4j, or XZ Utils
upstream_only.abstract: Software supply chain frameworks, such as the US NIST , detail what tasks software development organizations are recommended or mandated to adopt to reduce security risk. However, to further reduce the risk of similar attacks occurring, software organizations benefit from knowing what tasks mitigate attack techniques the attackers are currently using to address specific threats, prioritize tasks, and close mitigation gaps. The goal of this study is to aid software organizations in reducing the risk of software supply chain attacks by systematically synthesizing how framework tasks mitigate the attack techniques used in the SolarWinds (solarwinds), Log4j (log4j), and XZ Utils (xz) attacks. We qualitatively analyzed 106 reports of the 3 attacks to gather the attack techniques. We then systematically constructed a mapping between attack techniques and the 73 tasks enumerated in 10 software supply chain frameworks. Afterward, we established and ranked priority tasks that mitigate attack techniques. The three mitigation tasks with the highest scores are role-based access control, system monitoring, and boundary protection. Additionally, three mitigation tasks were missing from all ten frameworks, including sustainable open-source software and environmental scanning tools. Thus, software products would still be vulnerable to software supply chain attacks even if organizations adopted all recommended tasks.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 软件供应链框架（如美国NIST）详细说明了软件开发组织被建议或强制采用哪些任务来降低安全风险。然而，为了进一步降低类似攻击发生的风险，软件组织需要了解哪些任务能够缓解攻击者当前用于应对特定威胁的攻击技术、确定任务优先级并弥合缓解差距。本研究的目标是通过系统地综合框架任务如何缓解SolarWinds、Log4j和XZ Utils攻击中使用的攻击技术，来帮助软件组织降低软件供应链攻击的风险。我们对这3起攻击的106份报告进行了定性分析，以收集攻击技术。然后，我们系统地构建了攻击技术与10个软件供应链框架中列举的73项任务之间的映射。之后，我们建立并排序了缓解攻击技术的优先任务。得分最高的三个缓解任务是基于角色的访问控制、系统监控和边界保护。此外，所有十个框架都缺少三项缓解任务，包括可持续开源软件和环境扫描工具。因此，即使组织采用了所有推荐任务，软件产品仍然容易受到软件供应链攻击。

upstream_only.title: An Empirical Study on the Robustness of Android Third-Party Library Detection Tools Against Advanced Obfuscation
upstream_only.abstract: Third-party libraries (TPLs) play a crucial role in Android app development by providing reusable functionalities, improving development efficiency, and reducing time-to-market. However, detecting and analyzing TPLs is essential, as their vulnerabilities, outdated versions, or malicious modifications can introduce security risks and compromise the integrity of Android apps. Existing TPL detection approaches struggle against code obfuscation, a prevalent practice in Android apps. While prior research has explored obfuscation-resistant detection methods, they largely overlook advanced obfuscation techniques such as package hierarchy obfuscation.To bridge this gap, we first investigate the prevalence of advanced obfuscation in contemporary Android apps using ObfDetector, a novel static analysis tool capable of detecting identifier renaming, package hierarchy obfuscation, and code optimization. Our large-scale study on 77,504 closed-source Google Play apps and 619 widely used apps reveals extensive obfuscation adoption. We further evaluate the resilience of state-of-the-art TPL detection tools under realistic obfuscation conditions using a newly constructed benchmark dataset, exposing significant performance deficiencies, with F1-scores dropping below 50\% for library-level detection and under 10\% for version-level identification. Finally, we conduct a systematic failure analysis to uncover key architectural limitations in existing TPL detection frameworks and propose design guidelines for next-generation detection tools. We release our obfuscation detection tool and benchmark dataset to support further research in Android security.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 第三方库（TPLs）在Android应用开发中起着关键作用，提供可重用功能、提高开发效率并缩短上市时间。然而，检测和分析TPL至关重要，因为它们的漏洞、过时版本或恶意修改可能引入安全风险并损害Android应用的完整性。现有TPL检测方法难以应对代码混淆，这是Android应用中普遍存在的做法。尽管先前研究探索了抗混淆检测方法，但它们大多忽略了包层级混淆等高级混淆技术。为弥补这一差距，我们首先使用ObfDetector（一种能够检测标识符重命名、包层级混淆和代码优化的新型静态分析工具）调查当代Android应用中高级混淆的普遍性。我们对77,504个闭源Google Play应用和619个广泛使用的应用进行的大规模研究揭示了广泛的混淆采用。我们进一步使用新构建的基准数据集评估了最先进的TPL检测工具在现实混淆条件下的弹性，暴露了显著的性能缺陷：库级检测的F1分数降至50%以下，版本级识别降至10%以下。最后，我们进行系统性的失败分析，以揭示现有TPL检测框架中的关键架构限制，并提出下一代检测工具的设计指南。我们发布了混淆检测工具和基准数据集，以支持Android安全的进一步研究。

upstream_only.title: Insecure Ingredients? Exploring Dependency Update Patterns of Bundled JavaScript Packages on the Web
upstream_only.abstract: Reusable software components, typically distributed as packages, are a central paradigm of modern software development. The JavaScript ecosystem serves as a prime example, offering millions of packages with their use being promoted as idiomatic. However, download statistics on npm raise security concerns as they indicate a high popularity of vulnerable package versions while their real prevalence on production websites remains unknown. Package version detection mechanisms fill this gap by extracting utilized packages and versions from observed artifacts on the web. Prior research focuses on mechanisms for either hand-selected popular packages in bundles or for single-file resources utilizing the global namespace. This does not allow for a thorough analysis of modern web applications’ dependency update behavior at scale. In this work, we improve upon this by presenting Aletheia, a package-agnostic method which dissects JavaScript bundles to identify package versions through algorithms originating from the field of plagiarism detection. We show that Aletheia clearly outperforms the existing approaches in practical settings. Furthermore, we crawl the Tranco top 100,000 domains to reveal that 5\% to 20\% of domains update their dependencies within 16 weeks. Surprisingly, from a longitudinal perspective, bundled packages are updated significantly faster than their CDN-included counterparts, with consequently up to 10 times fewer known vulnerable package versions included. Still, we observe indicators that few widespread vendors seem to be a major driving force behind timely updates, implying that quantitative measures are not painting a complete picture.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 可重用软件组件，通常以包的形式分发，是现代软件开发的核心范式。JavaScript生态系统就是一个典型例子，它提供了数百万个包，其使用被宣传为惯用做法。然而，npm上的下载统计数据引发了安全担忧，因为它们表明易受攻击的包版本很流行，而其在生产网站上的实际流行程度仍未知。包版本检测机制通过从Web上观察到的制品中提取已使用的包和版本来填补这一空白。先前的研究要么关注包中手工挑选的流行包，要么关注利用全局命名空间的单文件资源。这无法对现代Web应用程序的依赖更新行为进行大规模彻底分析。在这项工作中，我们改进了这一点，提出了Aletheia，一种与包无关的方法，它通过源自抄袭检测领域的算法剖析JavaScript包以识别包版本。我们表明，Aletheia在实际环境中明显优于现有方法。此外，我们爬取了Tranco前10万个域名，发现5%到20%的域名在16周内更新其依赖项。令人惊讶的是，从纵向角度看，捆绑包比通过CDN引入的对应包更新得明显更快，因此包含的已知易受攻击包版本最多可减少10倍。尽管如此，我们观察到有迹象表明，少数广泛使用的供应商似乎是及时更新的主要驱动力，这意味着定量措施并未描绘出全貌。

upstream_only.title: AnchorDiff: Binary OSS Version Identification Method Based on Anchor Node Slicing
upstream_only.abstract: Binary Open-Source Software (OSS) is commonly embedded as third-party code within firmware and downstream software architectures, for simplifying the development process. However, vulnerabilities existing in OSS can be propagated through code reuse into embedded firmware and software architectures, posing security risks to these devices. To mitigate the security risks in firmware and software architectures, researchers have identified the versions of extracted firmware or binary software to detect N-day vulnerabilities in OSS. Existing works have achieved several success, but new challenges of non-linear update and minor updates hinder the improvement of the accuracy of binary OSS version identification.In this paper, we propose AnchorDiff, an efficient and accurate framework of binary OSS version identification. AnchorDiff filters out versions with significant updates from all OSS versions as Anchor Nodes which serve as boundaries to partition the entire version chain into sub-regions. The target file’s sub-region is located based on the binary code similarity detection (BCSD) results with the Anchor Nodes’ function libraries. Finally, AnchorDiff uses the Adaptive Weight Fine-grained Matching (AWM) algorithm to weight the fine-grained matching results and determine the true version of the target binary file.The experimental results show that AnchorDiff achieves the best performance in identifying binary OSS versions with complex compilation configurations in both small and large OSS datasets, with accuracies reaching 90.35\% and 97.17\% respectively, which are 2.76\% and 20.99\% higher than the current state-of-the-art (SOTA) work. In terms of database storage, AnchorDiff reduces storage requirements by a factor of 36, compared to the original binary files.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 二进制开源软件（OSS）通常作为第三方代码嵌入固件和下游软件架构中，以简化开发过程。然而，OSS中存在的漏洞可通过代码复用传播到嵌入式固件和软件架构中，给这些设备带来安全风险。为缓解固件和软件架构中的安全风险，研究者通过识别提取出的固件或二进制软件的版本，来检测OSS中的N-day漏洞。现有工作已取得一些成功，但非线性更新和微小更新带来的新挑战阻碍了二进制OSS版本识别准确率的提升。在本文中，我们提出AnchorDiff，一个高效且准确的二进制OSS版本识别框架。AnchorDiff从所有OSS版本中筛选出具有显著更新的版本作为锚节点，这些锚节点作为边界将整个版本链划分为子区域。基于目标文件与锚节点函数库的二进制代码相似性检测（BCSD）结果，定位目标文件所属的子区域。最后，AnchorDiff使用自适应权重细粒度匹配（AWM）算法对细粒度匹配结果进行加权，并确定目标二进制文件的真实版本。实验结果表明，AnchorDiff在识别具有复杂编译配置的二进制OSS版本方面，在小型和大型OSS数据集上均取得最佳性能，准确率分别达到90.35%和97.17%，比当前最先进（SOTA）工作分别高出2.76%和20.99%。在数据库存储方面，与原始二进制文件相比，AnchorDiff将存储需求降低了36倍。

upstream_only.title: Securing the AI Supply Chain: What Can We Learn From Developer-Reported Security Issues and Solutions of AI Projects?
upstream_only.abstract: The rapid growth of Artificial Intelligence (AI) models and applications has led to an increasingly complex security landscape. Developers of AI projects must contend not only with traditional software supply chain issues but also with novel, AI-specific security threats. However, little is known about what security issues are commonly encountered and how they are resolved in practice. This gap hinders the development of effective security measures for each component of the AI supply chain. We bridge this gap by conducting an empirical investigation of developer-reported issues and solutions, based on discussions from Hugging Face and GitHub. To identify security-related discussions, we develop a pipeline that combines keyword matching with an optimal fine-tuned distilBERT classifier, which achieved the best performance in our extensive comparison of various deep learning and large language models. This pipeline produces a dataset of 312,868 security discussions, providing insights into the security reporting practices of AI applications and projects. We conduct a thematic analysis of 753 posts sampled from our dataset and uncover a fine-grained taxonomy of 32 security issues and 24 solutions across four themes: (1) System and Software, (2) External Tools and Ecosystem, (3) Model, and (4) Data. We reveal that many security issues arise from the complex dependencies and black-box nature of AI components. Notably, challenges related to Models and Data often lack concrete solutions. Our insights can offer evidence-based guidance for developers and researchers to address real-world security threats across the AI supply chain.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）模型和应用的快速增长导致了日益复杂的安全格局。AI项目的开发者不仅需要应对传统的软件供应链问题，还需要应对新颖的、AI特有的安全威胁。然而，对于实践中常见的安全问题以及如何解决这些问题，人们知之甚少。这一空白阻碍了为AI供应链的每个组件开发有效的安全措施。我们通过基于Hugging Face和GitHub上的讨论，对开发者报告的问题和解决方案进行实证调查，来弥合这一空白。为了识别与安全相关的讨论，我们开发了一个结合关键词匹配和最优微调distilBERT分类器的流程，在我们对各种深度学习和大型语言模型的广泛比较中取得了最佳性能。该流程生成了一个包含312,868条安全讨论的数据集，为AI应用和项目的安全报告实践提供了见解。我们对从数据集中采样的753条帖子进行了主题分析，并揭示了一个细粒度的分类体系，涵盖四个主题下的32个安全问题和24个解决方案：（1）系统与软件，（2）外部工具与生态系统，（3）模型，以及（4）数据。我们发现，许多安全问题源于AI组件的复杂依赖关系和黑盒性质。值得注意的是，与模型和数据相关的挑战往往缺乏具体解决方案。我们的见解可以为开发者和研究人员提供基于证据的指导，以应对AI供应链中的现实世界安全威胁。

upstream_only.title: Beyond Fuzzy Matching: Constraint-Guided Patch Presence Testing for Obfuscated Java Binaries
upstream_only.abstract: Patch presence testing (PPT) is critical for mitigating vulnerabilities introduced by the use of third-party libraries (TPLs) in Java programs. However, the widespread use of obfuscation significantly undermines its accuracy by altering patch-relevant features. To preserve feature consistency before and after obfuscation for reliable comparison, existing studies summarize patch digests using several representative fuzzy features. These fuzzy features, designed to generalize obfuscation-prone details, have proven effective in TPL detection. Nevertheless, this approach faces limitations when directly applied to PPT, where finer features are needed to capture subtle patch changes. Although patch digests facilitate feature matching under obfuscation-induced code changes with high efficiency, methods with similar semantic structures—common in TPLs due to factors such as overriding and inheritance—often exhibit identical digests. Relying solely on feature similarity without considering method constraints often results in inaccurate outcomes.To tackle the aforementioned challenges, this paper presents PScan, a constraint-guided patch presence testing tool capable of detecting patches in both standard and obfuscated Java binaries (i.e., executables of Java programs). PScan first defines a set of actual constraints that must be satisfied during Java method matching. Guided by these constraints, it maps methods containing critical patch information to their obfuscated counterparts and then leverages these mappings to refine the associated fuzzy features into concrete expressions. Furthermore, leveraging the formalized constraints, PScan formulates the patch digest matching process as a binary integer programming (BIP) model to precisely identify correct method matches. Extensive evaluations on public datasets show that PScan outperforms state-of-the-art methods, improving accuracy by at least 15.0 percentage points and achieving an overall accuracy of 97.1\%. Our experiments also reveal that, with these constraints, PScan reduces the method mismatch rate to 1.5\%, a 16.9 percentage point reduction relative to the baseline.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 补丁存在性测试（PPT）对于缓解Java程序中使用第三方库（TPL）所引入的漏洞至关重要。然而，混淆的广泛使用会改变与补丁相关的特征，从而严重削弱其准确性。为了在混淆前后保持特征一致性以实现可靠比较，现有研究使用若干代表性模糊特征来总结补丁摘要。这些模糊特征旨在泛化易受混淆影响的细节，已被证明在TPL检测中有效。然而，当直接应用于PPT时，该方法面临局限，因为PPT需要更细粒度的特征来捕获细微的补丁变化。尽管补丁摘要能够以高效率促进混淆引起的代码变化下的特征匹配，但具有相似语义结构的方法——由于覆盖和继承等因素在TPL中很常见——常常表现出相同的摘要。仅依赖特征相似性而不考虑方法约束，往往会导致不准确的结果。为应对上述挑战，本文提出PScan，一种约束引导的补丁存在性测试工具，能够检测标准Java二进制和混淆Java二进制（即Java程序的可执行文件）中的补丁。PScan首先定义了一组在Java方法匹配期间必须满足的实际约束。在这些约束的引导下，它将包含关键补丁信息的方法映射到其混淆后的对应方法，然后利用这些映射将相关的模糊特征细化为具体表达式。此外，借助形式化约束，PScan将补丁摘要匹配过程建模为二进制整数规划（BIP）模型，以精确识别正确的方法匹配。在公开数据集上的大量评估表明，PScan优于最先进的方法，准确率至少提高15.0个百分点，总体准确率达到97.1%。我们的实验还表明，借助这些约束，PScan将方法不匹配率降低至1.5%，相对于基线降低了16.9个百分点。

upstream_only.title: Rusted Types: Static Detection of Rust Type Confusion Bugs
upstream_only.abstract: Rust is a modern programming language designed for strict memory and concurrency safety. Despite the safety checks, unsafe code in Rust can introduce memory safety issues. Unsafe type conversion, which reinterprets data from one type to another type, can alter the type spatial and temporal properties, leading to memory safety and data corruption issues. Since an unsafely converted value could violate a programmer’s intended conversion semantics and allows attackers to access the sensitive memory, type confusion bugs have critical security implications. Despite the increasing number of Rust type confusion bugs, the problem has not been systematically studied and addressed by the Rust community.In this paper, we propose DeRust, the first and a novel static analysis tool for detecting Rust type confusion bugs. By precisely tracking the inter-procedural data flows from unsafe type conversions to sensitive operations, DeRust can effectively and efficiently identify type confusion bugs. Our evaluation shows that DeRust can detect all the type confusion bugs in the benchmark datasets, and further helped report 54 previously unknown bugs in the top 1000 Rust packages with 13 RustSec IDs assigned.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Rust是一种现代编程语言，设计目标是严格的内存和并发安全。尽管有安全检查，Rust中的不安全代码仍可能引入内存安全问题。不安全类型转换会将数据从一种类型重新解释为另一种类型，可能改变类型的空间和时间属性，导致内存安全和数据损坏问题。由于不安全转换的值可能违反程序员预期的转换语义，并允许攻击者访问敏感内存，类型混淆漏洞具有关键安全影响。尽管Rust类型混淆漏洞数量不断增加，但Rust社区尚未系统性地研究和解决该问题。本文提出了DeRust，这是第一个也是新颖的用于检测Rust类型混淆漏洞的静态分析工具。通过精确跟踪从不安全类型转换到敏感操作的跨过程数据流，DeRust能够有效且高效地识别类型混淆漏洞。我们的评估表明，DeRust可以检测基准数据集中的所有类型混淆漏洞，并进一步帮助在排名前1000的Rust包中报告了54个先前未知的漏洞，其中13个被分配了RustSec ID。

upstream_only.title: Bytecode-centric Detection of Known-to-be-vulnerable Dependencies in Java Projects
upstream_only.abstract: On average, 71\% of the code in typical Java projects comes from open-source software (OSS) dependencies, making OSS dependencies the dominant component of modern software code bases. This high degree of OSS reliance comes with a considerable security risk of adding known security vulnerabilities to a code base. To remedy this risk, researchers and companies have developed various dependency scanners, which try to identify inclusions of known-to-be-vulnerable OSS dependencies. However, there are still challenges that modern dependency scanners do not overcome, especially when it comes to dependency modifications, such as re-compilations, re-bundlings or re-packagings, which are common in the Java ecosystem.To overcome these challenges, we present Jaralyzer, a bytecode-centric dependency scanner for Java. Jaralyzer does not rely on the metadata or the source code of the included OSS dependencies being available but directly analyzes a dependency’s bytecode.Our evaluation across 56 popular OSS components demonstrates that Jaralyzer outperforms other popular dependency scanners in detecting vulnerabilities within modified dependencies. It is the only scanner capable of identifying vulnerabilities across all the above mentioned types of modifications. But even when applied to unmodified dependencies, Jaralyzer outperforms the current state-of-the-art code-centric scanner Eclipse Steady by detecting 28 more true vulnerabilities and yielding 29 fewer false warnings.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 平均而言，典型Java项目中有71%的代码来自开源软件（OSS）依赖，使OSS依赖成为现代软件代码库的主要组成部分。这种对OSS的高度依赖带来了相当大的安全风险，即向代码库中引入已知安全漏洞。为缓解这一风险，研究人员和公司开发了各种依赖扫描器，试图识别已知易受攻击的OSS依赖的引入。然而，现代依赖扫描器仍面临一些挑战，特别是在依赖修改方面，例如重新编译、重新打包或重新封装，这些在Java生态系统中很常见。为克服这些挑战，我们提出了Jaralyzer，一个以字节码为中心的Java依赖扫描器。Jaralyzer不依赖于所包含OSS依赖的元数据或源代码是否可用，而是直接分析依赖的字节码。我们在56个流行OSS组件上的评估表明，Jaralyzer在检测修改后依赖中的漏洞方面优于其他流行的依赖扫描器。它是唯一能够识别上述所有修改类型中漏洞的扫描器。但即使在应用于未修改的依赖时，Jaralyzer也优于当前最先进的以代码为中心的扫描器Eclipse Steady，多检测到28个真实漏洞，并少产生29个误报警告。

upstream_only.title: CoBrA: Context-, Branch-sensitive Static Analysis for Detecting Taint-style Vulnerabilities in PHP Web Applications
upstream_only.abstract: PHP, a widely-used programming language in Web development, contains powerful dynamic features (e.g., dynamic function name construction), making static detection of taint-style vulnerabilities like SQL injection and XSS challenging. State-of-the-art (SoTA) static approaches perform call graph-guided backward dataflow tracking, thus failing to analyze those dynamic PHP features, like variable functions, and control structures, which results in high false positives and negatives. In this paper, we design and implement CoBrA, a context-, branch-sensitive approach to detect taint-style vulnerabilities in PHP-based Web applications. The key innovations are the abstract domain graph (ADG), which is used to efficiently guide the analysis, and a ‘‘stretch-relax’’ algorithm, which enables accurate resolution of PHP dynamic features and efficient inter-procedural taint propagation. Our evaluation of CoBrA’s prototype identified 54 zero-day vulnerabilities in 19 real-world applications with nine CVE identifiers assigned, achieved 88.66\% detection rate with under 0.3\% false positives on a PHP tarpits dataset, and outperformed four SoTA tools across all test datasets with reasonable time and space consumption.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: PHP是Web开发中广泛使用的编程语言，具有强大的动态特性（例如动态函数名构造），这使得对SQL注入和XSS等污点式漏洞的静态检测颇具挑战性。最先进的静态方法执行调用图引导的后向数据流跟踪，因此无法分析那些动态PHP特性（如变量函数）和控制结构，导致高误报和漏报。在本文中，我们设计并实现了CoBrA，一种上下文和分支敏感的静态分析方法，用于检测基于PHP的Web应用程序中的污点式漏洞。关键创新是抽象域图（ADG），用于高效指导分析，以及“拉伸-松弛”（stretch-relax）算法，可准确解析PHP动态特性并实现高效的过程间污点传播。我们对CoBrA原型的评估在19个真实应用程序中识别出54个零日漏洞，获得九个CVE标识符，在PHP tarpits数据集上达到88.66%的检测率和低于0.3%的误报率，并在所有测试数据集上以合理的时间和空间消耗优于四个最先进的工具。

upstream_only.title: One Signature, Multiple Payments: Demystifying and Detecting Signature Replay Vulnerabilities in Smart Contracts
upstream_only.abstract: Smart contracts have significantly advanced blockchain technology, and digital signatures are crucial for reliable verification of contract authority. Through signature verification, smart contracts can ensure that signers possess the required permissions, thus enhancing security and scalability. However, lacking checks on signature usage conditions can lead to repeated verifications, increasing the risk of permission abuse and threatening contract assets. We define this issue as the Signature Replay Vulnerability (SRV).In this paper, we conducted the first empirical study to investigate the causes and characteristics of the SRVs. From 1,419 audit reports across 37 blockchain security companies, we identified 108 with detailed SRV descriptions and classified five types of SRVs. To detect these vulnerabilities automatically, we designed LASiR, which utilizes the general semantic understanding ability of Large Language Models (LLMs) to assist in the static taint analysis of the signature state and identify the signature reuse behavior. It also employs path reachability verification via symbolic execution to ensure effective and reliable detection. To evaluate the performance of LASiR, we conducted large-scale experiments on 15,383 contracts involving signature verification, selected from the initial dataset of 918,964 contracts across four blockchains: Ethereum, Binance Smart Chain, Polygon, and Arbitrum. The results indicate that SRVs are widespread, with affected contracts holding $4.76 million in active assets. Among these, 19.63\% of contracts that use signatures on Ethereum contain SRVs. Furthermore, manual verification demonstrates that LASiR achieves an F1-score of 87.90\% for detection. Ablation studies and comparative experiments reveal that the semantic information provided by LLMs aids static taint analysis, significantly enhancing LASiR’s detection performance.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 智能合约极大地推进了区块链技术，而数字签名对于可靠验证合约权限至关重要。通过签名验证，智能合约可以确保签名者拥有所需权限，从而增强安全性和可扩展性。然而，若缺乏对签名使用条件的检查，可能导致重复验证，增加权限滥用风险并威胁合约资产。我们将此问题定义为签名重放漏洞（SRV）。本文首次开展实证研究，探究SRV的成因与特征。我们从37家区块链安全公司的1,419份审计报告中识别出108份包含详细SRV描述的报告，并将SRV分为五类。为自动检测这些漏洞，我们设计了LASiR，它利用大语言模型（LLM）的通用语义理解能力辅助对签名状态进行静态污点分析，并识别签名重用行为。它还通过符号执行进行路径可达性验证，以确保有效可靠的检测。为评估LASiR的性能，我们在15,383份涉及签名验证的合约上进行了大规模实验，这些合约选自以太坊、币安智能链、Polygon和Arbitrum四条区块链的918,964份合约的初始数据集。结果表明，SRV广泛存在，受影响的合约持有476万美元的活跃资产。其中，以太坊上使用签名的合约有19.63%包含SRV。此外，人工验证表明，LASiR的检测F1分数达到87.90%。消融研究和对比实验表明，LLM提供的语义信息有助于静态污点分析，显著提升了LASiR的检测性能。

upstream_only.title: TaintP2X: Detecting Taint-Style Prompt-to-Anything Injection Vulnerabilities in LLM-Integrated Applications
upstream_only.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized numerous domains, enabling the development of LLM-integrated applications that autonomously plan and act through tool calling. While these applications demonstrate remarkable capabilities, their ability to invoke sensitive operations, such as file system interactions, code execution, and database queries, introduces critical security risks. In particular, prompt injection vulnerabilities, combined with security-sensitive sink functions, can lead to a broad class of attacks we define as Prompt-to-Anything Injection (P2Xi). These vulnerabilities, stemming from the misuse of LLM-generated outputs without proper validation, can result in severe consequences such as Remote Command Execution (RCE), file injection, SQL injection, and Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF). To address this emerging threat, we propose TaintP2X, a novel static taint analysis framework that models LLM-generated outputs as taint sources, tracks their propagation through sensitive sink functions, and employs LLM-assisted analysis to prune false positives. TaintP2X achieves high precision and scalability, systematically identifying P2Xi vulnerabilities. In evaluations, TaintP2X demonstrated a 77.1\% recall on a ground truth dataset of 35 P2Xi vulnerabilities, outperforming state-of-the-art methods. With TaintP2X, we have uncovered 101 taint paths across 75 open source repositories, with 7 vulnerabilities confirmed by developers, and 5 of them fixed. These findings highlight the prevalence and impact of P2Xi vulnerabilities and establish TaintP2X as a practical solution for securing LLM-integrated ecosystems.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）已经彻底改变了许多领域，使得能够通过工具调用自主规划和行动的LLM集成应用得以发展。虽然这些应用展现出卓越的能力，但它们调用敏感操作（如文件系统交互、代码执行和数据库查询）的能力引入了严重的安全风险。特别是，提示注入漏洞与安全敏感的汇聚函数相结合，可能导致我们定义为提示到任意注入（P2Xi）的一大类攻击。这些漏洞源于未经验证就滥用LLM生成的输出，可能导致远程命令执行（RCE）、文件注入、SQL注入和服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）等严重后果。为了应对这一新兴威胁，我们提出了TaintP2X，一种新颖的静态污点分析框架，它将LLM生成的输出建模为污点源，跟踪它们通过敏感汇聚函数的传播，并采用LLM辅助分析来修剪误报。TaintP2X实现了高精度和可扩展性，能够系统地识别P2Xi漏洞。在评估中，TaintP2X在包含35个P2Xi漏洞的真实基准数据集上实现了77.1%的召回率，优于最先进的方法。借助TaintP2X，我们在75个开源仓库中发现了101条污点路径，其中7个漏洞得到了开发者的确认，5个已修复。这些发现凸显了P2Xi漏洞的普遍性和影响，并确立了TaintP2X作为保护LLM集成生态系统的实用解决方案。

upstream_only.title: ConfuGuard: Using Metadata to Detect Active and Stealthy Package Confusion Attacks Accurately and at Scale
upstream_only.abstract: Package confusion attacks, such as typosquatting, threaten software supply chains. Attackers make packages with names that syntactically or semantically resemble legitimate ones, tricking engineers into installing malware. While prior work has developed defenses against package confusions in some software package registries, notably NPM, PyPI, and RubyGems, gaps remain: high false-positive rates, generalization to more software package ecosystems, and insights from real-world deployment.In this work, we introduce ConfuGuard, a state-of-the-art detector for package confusion threats. We begin by presenting the first empirical analysis of benign signals derived from prior package confusion data, uncovering their threat patterns, engineering practices, and measurable attributes. Advancing existing detectors, we leverage package metadata to distinguish benign packages, and extend support from three up to seven software package registries. Our approach significantly reduces false positive rates (from 80\% to 28\%), at the cost of an additional 14s average latency to filter out benign packages by analyzing the package metadata. ConfuGuard is used in production at our industry partner, whose analysts have already confirmed 630 real attacks detected by ConfuGuard.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 包混淆攻击，例如域名仿冒，威胁软件供应链。攻击者制作名称在语法或语义上类似合法包的包，诱骗工程师安装恶意软件。虽然先前工作已在一些软件包注册表（尤其是NPM、PyPI和RubyGems）中开发了针对包混淆的防御措施，但仍存在差距：高假阳性率、对更多软件包生态系统的泛化能力，以及来自真实部署的洞见。在这项工作中，我们介绍了ConfuGuard，一种最先进的包混淆威胁检测器。我们首先对来自先前包混淆数据的良性信号进行首次实证分析，揭示其威胁模式、工程实践和可测量属性。在现有检测器的基础上，我们利用包元数据来区分良性包，并将支持从三个扩展到七个软件包注册表。我们的方法显著降低了假阳性率（从80%降至28%），代价是平均增加14秒延迟，通过分析包元数据过滤良性包。ConfuGuard已在我们的行业合作伙伴处投入生产使用，其分析师已确认ConfuGuard检测到630次真实攻击。

upstream_only.title: Enforcing Control Flow Integrity on DeFi Smart Contracts
upstream_only.abstract: Smart contracts power decentralized financial (DeFi) services but are vulnerable to security exploits that can lead to significant financial losses. Existing security measures often fail to adequately protect these contracts due to the composability of DeFi protocols and the increasing sophistication of attacks. Through a large-scale empirical study of historical transactions from the 37 hacked DeFi protocols, we discovered that while benign transactions typically exhibit a limited number of unique control flows, in stark contrast, attack transactions consistently introduce novel, previously unobserved control flows. Building on these insights, we developed CrossGuard, a novel framework that enforces control flow integrity onchain to secure smart contracts. Crucially, CrossGuard does not require prior knowledge of specific hacks. Instead, configured only once at deployment, it enforces control flow whitelisting policies and applies simplification heuristics at runtime. This approach monitors and prevents potential attacks by reverting all transactions that do not adhere to the established control flow whitelisting rules. Our evaluation demonstrates that CrossGuard effectively blocks 35 of the 37 analyzed attacks when configured only once at contract deployment, maintaining a low false positive rate of (0.26\%) and minimal additional gas costs. These results underscore the efficacy of applying control flow integrity to smart contracts, significantly enhancing security beyond traditional methods and addressing the evolving threat landscape in the DeFi ecosystem.
