Objective: We define the concepts of technical and sociotechnical infrastructure in software engineering, and develop and validate a psychometric scale that measures attitudes toward them. Method: Grounded in theories of infrastructure, attitudes, and prior work on psychometric measurement, we defined the target constructs and generated scale items. The items were reviewed and refined by domain experts. The scale was administered to 225 software professionals and evaluated using a split sample. We conducted an exploratory factor analysis (EFA) on one half of the sample to uncover the underlying factor structure and performed a confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) on the other half to validate the structure. Further analyses with the whole sample assessed face, criterion-related, and discriminant validity. Results: EFA supported a two-factor structure (technical and sociotechnical infrastructure), accounting for 65\% of the total variance with strong loadings. CFA confirmed excellent model fit. Face and content validity were supported by the item content reflecting cognitive, affective, and behavioral components. Both subscales were correlated with job satisfaction, perceived autonomy, and feedback from the job itself, supporting convergent validity. Regression analysis supported criterion-related validity, while the Heterotrait–Monotrait ratio of correlations (HTMT), the Fornell–Larcker criterion, and model comparison all supported discriminant validity. Discussion: The resulting scale is a valid instrument for measuring attitudes toward technical and sociotechnical infrastructure in software engineering research. Our work contributes to ongoing efforts to integrate psychological measurement rigor into empirical and behavioral software engineering research. The scale can also be used by companies and organizations to assess their employees’ attitudes toward the infrastructure they provide.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 背景：近期软件工程（SE）研究强调了社会技术研究的必要性，这意味着需要定制的心理测量量表。目标：我们定义软件工程中技术基础设施和社会技术基础设施的概念，并开发并验证一个测量对它们态度的心理测量量表。方法：基于基础设施、态度理论以及先前心理测量测量工作，我们定义了目标构念并生成量表条目。条目由领域专家审查和提炼。该量表对225名软件专业人员施测，并使用分半样本进行评估。我们对样本的一半进行探索性因子分析（EFA）以揭示潜在因子结构，并对另一半进行验证性因子分析（CFA）以验证该结构。对全样本的进一步分析评估了表面效度、效标关联效度和区分效度。结果：EFA支持双因子结构（技术基础设施和社会技术基础设施），解释了总方差的65%，载荷很强。CFA确认模型拟合极好。条目内容反映认知、情感和行为成分，支持表面效度和内容效度。两个子量表均与工作满意度、感知自主性以及工作本身反馈相关，支持聚合效度。回归分析支持效标关联效度，而异质-单质相关比（HTMT）、Fornell-Larcker准则和模型比较均支持区分效度。讨论：所得量表是测量软件工程研究中对技术和社会技术基础设施态度的有效工具。我们的工作有助于将心理测量严谨性融入实证和行为软件工程研究的持续努力。该量表也可供公司组织评估员工对其所提供基础设施的态度。

upstream_only.title: WhyFlow: Interrogative Debugger for Sensemaking Taint Analysis
upstream_only.abstract: Taint analysis is a security analysis technique used to track the flow of potentially dangerous data through an application and its dependent libraries. Investigating why certain unexpected flows appear and why expected flows are missing is an important sensemaking process during end-user taint analysis. Existing taint analysis tools often do not provide this end-user debugging capability, where developers can ask why, why-not, and what-if questions about dataflows and reason about the impact of configuring sources and sinks, and models of third-party libraries that abstract permissible and impermissible data flows. Furthermore, the tree-view or list-view used in existing taint analyzer visualizations makes it difficult to reason about the global impact on connectivity between multiple sources and sinks.Inspired by the insight that sensemaking tool-generated results can be significantly improved by a QA inquiry process, we propose WhyFlow, the first end-user question-answer style debugging interface for taint analysis. It enables a user to ask why, why-not, and what-if questions to investigate the existence of suspicious flows, the non-existence of expected flows, and the global impact of third-party library models. WhyFlow performs speculative what-if analysis, to help a user in debugging how different connectivity assumptions affect overall results. A user study with 12 participants shows that participants using WhyFlow achieved 21\% higher accuracy on average, compared to CodeQL. They also reported a 45\% reduction in mental demand (NASA-TLX) and rated higher confidence in identifying relevant flows using WhyFlow. This shows WhyFlow’s potential to significantly reduce sensemaking effort.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 污点分析是一种安全分析技术，用于跟踪潜在危险数据在应用程序及其依赖库中的流动。在最终用户污点分析过程中，调查某些意外流为何出现以及预期流为何缺失是一个重要的意义建构过程。现有污点分析工具通常不提供这种最终用户调试能力，即开发者可以就数据流提出 why、why-not 和 what-if 问题，并推理配置源和汇以及第三方库模型（抽象允许和不允许的数据流）的影响。此外，现有污点分析器可视化中使用的树视图或列表视图难以推理多个源与汇之间连通性的全局影响。受“通过问答式探究过程可以显著改善对工具生成结果的意义建构”这一洞见启发，我们提出 WhyFlow，这是首个用于污点分析的最终用户问答式调试界面。它使用户能够提出 why、why-not 和 what-if 问题，以调查可疑流是否存在、预期流为何不存在，以及第三方库模型的全局影响。WhyFlow 执行推测式 what-if 分析，帮助用户调试不同连通性假设如何影响整体结果。一项有 12 名参与者参与的用户研究表明，与 CodeQL 相比，使用 WhyFlow 的参与者平均准确率提高了 21%。他们还报告心理需求（NASA-TLX）降低了 45%，并评价使用 WhyFlow 识别相关流时信心更高。这表明 WhyFlow 具有显著减少意义建构努力的潜力。

upstream_only.title: Sapling: Quantifying and Measuring the Maturity of the RISC-V Software Ecosystem
upstream_only.abstract: Open-source technology has enabled RISC-V to emerge as a cost-effective alternative for processor manufacturers by reducing intellectual property expenses. A key factor influencing its broader application is the maturity of the RISC-V software ecosystem. However, quantifying this maturity remains challenging due to the complexity of the ecosystem. In this study, we introduce Sapling, an automated evaluation system designed to systematically evaluate the maturity of the RISC-V software ecosystem. Our framework categorizes the ecosystem into five scenarios comprising thirty software components, each assessed across six dimensions. These evaluations are then aggregated across multiple dimensions within each scenario and further synthesized to produce an overall result through a cross-scenario evaluation. Our findings indicate that while the RISC-V software ecosystem remains in its developmental phase, it is steadily advancing, demonstrating strong potential for sustained growth and broader industry application. Furthermore, thirteen key insights and five strategic recommendations are presented to advance the maturity of the RISC-V software ecosystem. We hope that this study contributes to a deeper understanding of the maturity of the RISC-V software ecosystem and offers valuable guidance for its effective enhancement.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 开源技术使RISC-V得以成为处理器制造商的一种经济高效的替代方案，从而降低了知识产权费用。影响其更广泛应用的一个关键因素是RISC-V软件生态系统的成熟度。然而，由于生态系统的复杂性，量化其成熟度仍然具有挑战性。在本研究中，我们引入了Sapling，一个旨在系统评估RISC-V软件生态系统成熟度的自动化评估系统。我们的框架将生态系统划分为五个场景，包含三十个软件组件，每个组件从六个维度进行评估。然后，在每个场景内跨多个维度汇总这些评估，并通过跨场景评估进一步综合以产生总体结果。我们的发现表明，尽管RISC-V软件生态系统仍处于发展阶段，但它正在稳步推进，展现出持续增长和更广泛行业应用的强大潜力。此外，我们还提出了十三项关键见解和五项战略建议，以提升RISC-V软件生态系统的成熟度。我们希望这项研究有助于更深入地理解RISC-V软件生态系统的成熟度，并为其有效提升提供有价值的指导。

upstream_only.title: Breaking the Alphabet: Rethinking File Ordering in Code Review
upstream_only.abstract: Effective code review is central to maintaining software quality, yet there is limited research about how the ordering of changed files in Pull Requests (PRs) influences review effectiveness. Most popular code review tools default to alphabetical ordering, favoring predictability over contextual relevance. While prior studies examined how file position shapes reviewer attention, it remains unclear how such ordering influences cognitive load and perceived review thoroughness. This study presents the first large-scale survey of 1,355 professional developers across 182 widely used open-source projects to investigate how file ordering impacts review behavior, comprehension, and perceived effectiveness. Our mixed-methods analysis reveals that only 10.2\% of reviewers consider alphabetical ordering optimal, underscoring a cognitive misalignment in their interpretation of code changes. Although some developers appreciate its predictability, more than half (57.6\%) report that it increases context switching, disrupts logical reasoning, and contributes to review fatigue, and 63.9\% expressed concern that the default ordering may cause them to miss bugs. We further identify key challenges in multi-file reviews and elicit developers’ expectations for improved tooling, including dependency-aware grouping and customizable file ordering (requested by 66\% of reviewers). These findings highlight the need for reviewer-centric interface designs that better align tool behavior with human cognition.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 有效的代码审查是维护软件质量的核心，然而关于拉取请求（PR）中变更文件的排序如何影响审查效果的研究却很有限。大多数流行的代码审查工具默认采用字母顺序，更倾向于可预测性而非上下文相关性。虽然先前的研究考察了文件位置如何影响审查者的注意力，但尚不清楚这种排序如何影响认知负荷和感知的审查彻底性。本研究首次对来自182个广泛使用的开源项目的1,355名专业开发者进行了大规模调查，以探究文件排序如何影响审查行为、理解和感知有效性。我们的混合方法分析显示，只有10.2%的审查者认为字母顺序是最优的，这凸显了他们在解释代码变更时的认知错位。尽管一些开发者欣赏其可预测性，但超过一半（57.6%）的人报告称它增加了上下文切换、扰乱了逻辑推理，并导致审查疲劳，63.9%的人担心默认排序可能导致他们遗漏错误。我们进一步确定了多文件审查中的关键挑战，并引出了开发者对改进工具的期望，包括依赖感知分组和可定制的文件排序（66%的审查者要求）。这些发现强调了需要以审查者为中心的界面设计，使工具行为更好地与人类认知保持一致。

upstream_only.title: "Making Our Life Less Monotonous" or "Just Tick Things Off": An Exploratory Multi-Method Study of Toil
upstream_only.abstract: Google introduced Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) as a DevOps approach focused on service reliability. A key concept in SRE is toil defined as manual, repetitive, automatable, and reactive tasks that arise in production service management, scale with service growth, and provide no lasting value. As SRE adoption expands beyond Google, organisations adapt SRE practices and terminology, leading to inconsistencies in how toil is defined and perceived.Understanding toil is crucial, as it is assumed to directly impact both operational efficiency and well-being of engineers, ultimately influencing the reliability and scalability of production services. In this study, we examine toil in light of Google’s claim that “less toil is better". We explore how different engineers define toil, its perceived impact, and whether reducing toil is seen as beneficial. To this end, we analyse grey literature, for a broad, practical perspective of toil and its effects, and conduct semi-structured interviews at the ING Group to triangulate the previous findings.We observe that while Google’s toil definition has been widely adopted, it has been expanded to include additional technical attributes (e.g., routine, time-consuming, persistent) and human aspects (e.g., mundane, not just unwanted work). Practitioners generally view toil negatively, citing its impact on organisations’ growth, teams’ efficiency, and morale. However, while toil elimination is generally praised, we also observe resistance stemming from concerns over cost, complexity, and the possible negative impact this elimination can have on employees predominantly working on toil.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 谷歌提出站点可靠性工程（SRE）作为一种专注于服务可靠性的DevOps方法。SRE的一个关键概念是Toil，定义为在生产服务管理中出现、随服务增长而扩展且不产生持久价值的手动、重复、可自动化且被动响应式的任务。随着SRE的采用扩展到谷歌之外，各组织会调整SRE实践和术语，导致Toil的定义和认知出现不一致。理解Toil至关重要，因为据认为它直接影响运营效率和工程师的福祉，最终影响生产服务的可靠性和可扩展性。在本研究中，我们根据谷歌“Toil越少越好”的说法来考察Toil。我们探讨不同工程师如何定义Toil、其感知影响，以及减少Toil是否被视为有益。为此，我们分析灰色文献以获得关于Toil及其影响的广泛实践视角，并在ING集团进行半结构化访谈，以三角验证此前的发现。我们观察到，虽然谷歌的Toil定义已被广泛采用，但它已被扩展，纳入更多技术属性（例如，例行性、耗时性、持续性）和人文方面（例如，平凡单调，而不仅仅是不想要的工作）。实践者通常对Toil持负面看法，指出其对组织增长、团队效率和士气的影响。然而，虽然消除Toil通常受到赞扬，我们也观察到阻力，源于对成本、复杂性以及这种消除可能对主要处理Toil的员工产生负面影响的担忧。

upstream_only.title: Staying or Leaving? How Job Satisfaction, Embeddedness and Antecedents Predict Turnover Intentions of Software Professionals
upstream_only.abstract: Context: Voluntary turnover is common in the software industry, increasing recruitment and onboarding costs and the risk of losing organizational and tacit knowledge. Objective: This study investigates how job satisfaction, work-life balance, job embeddedness, and their antecedents, including job quality, personality traits, attitudes toward technical and sociotechnical infrastructure, and perceptions of organizational justice, relate to software professionals’ turnover intentions. Method: We conducted a geographically diverse cross-sectional survey of software professionals (N = 224) and analyzed the data using partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM). Our model includes both reflective and formative constructs and tests 15 hypotheses grounded in occupational psychology and software engineering literature. Additionally, indirect effects were explored. Results: Job satisfaction and embeddedness were significantly negatively associated with software professionals’ turnover intentions, while work-life balance showed no direct effect. The strongest antecedents for job satisfaction were work-life balance and job quality, while organizational justice was the strongest predictor of job embeddedness. Exploratory analysis suggests that job satisfaction and job embeddedness mediate the effect of job quality, organizational justice, and work-life balance on turnover intentions. Discussion: The resulting PLS-SEM model has considerably higher explanatory power for key outcome variables than previous work conducted in the software development context, highlighting the importance of both psychological (e.g., job satisfaction, job embeddedness) and organizational (e.g., organizational justice, job quality) factors in understanding turnover intentions of software professionals. Our results imply that improving job satisfaction and job embeddedness is the key to retaining software professionals. In turn, enhancing job quality, supporting work-life balance, and ensuring high organizational justice can improve job satisfaction and embeddedness, indirectly reducing turnover intentions. Our results broadly suggest that retention strategies are best focused on fairness, meaningful work, and work-life balance.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 背景：自愿离职在软件行业很常见，增加了招聘和入职成本，也增加了失去组织知识和隐性知识的风险。目标：本研究探讨工作满意度、工作与生活平衡、工作嵌入度及其前因（包括工作质量、人格特质、对技术和社会技术基础设施的态度，以及组织公平感知）如何与软件专业人员的离职意向相关。方法：我们对软件专业人员（N = 224）进行了一项地域多样化的横断面调查，并使用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）分析数据。我们的模型包含反映性和形成性构念，并检验了基于职业心理学和软件工程文献的15个假设。此外，还探讨了间接效应。结果：工作满意度和嵌入度与软件专业人员的离职意向显著负相关，而工作与生活平衡没有直接影响。工作满意度的最强前因是工作与生活平衡和工作质量，而组织公平是工作嵌入度的最强预测因素。探索性分析表明，工作满意度和工作嵌入度中介了工作质量、组织公平和工作与生活平衡对离职意向的影响。讨论：由此得到的PLS-SEM模型对关键结果变量的解释力显著高于以往在软件开发情境中进行的研究，凸显了心理因素（如工作满意度、工作嵌入度）和组织因素（如组织公平、工作质量）在理解软件专业人员离职意向中的重要性。我们的结果表明，提高工作满意度和工作嵌入度是留住软件专业人员的关键。反过来，提高工作质量、支持工作与生活平衡以及确保高组织公平可以改善工作满意度和嵌入度，从而间接降低离职意向。我们的结果广泛表明，留任策略最好聚焦于公平、有意义的工作和工作与生活平衡。

upstream_only.title: Connected to Stay: Gender Homophily and Its Role in Open-Source Software Developer Retention
upstream_only.abstract: Understanding how social connections shape participation is critical for sustaining open-source software (OSS) communities. To investigate this, we analyze longitudinal collaboration networks of 1.6 million developers over 14 years (2008–2022) using the World of Code dataset, focusing on gender homophily, developers’ preference to collaborate with others of the same gender, and its relationship to retention. We find strong evidence of gender homophily beyond demographic baselines, with same-gender ties among women exceeding random expectations by more than twice. While women tend to form homophilous ties, men show a preference for cross-gender collaboration, and these patterns shift over time as the OSS ecosystem evolves. Most notably, we find that developers, especially women, who collaborate with other women experience significantly lower dropout risk, with hazard rates up to 20.7\% lower. These retention effects only become visible after accounting for activity levels, consistent with prior work showing that aggregate analyses can mask true relationships. Our results suggest that homophilous ties offer social support that improves developer persistence, highlighting the importance of inclusive, gender-diverse networks for sustaining participation in OSS projects.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 理解社会联系如何影响参与对维持开源软件（OSS）社区至关重要。为了研究这一点，我们使用World of Code数据集分析了160万名开发者在14年（2008–2022）内的纵向协作网络，重点关注性别同质性——开发者与同性别者协作的偏好——及其与留存的关系。我们发现强有力的证据表明，性别同质性超出了人口基线，女性之间的同性别联系比随机预期高出两倍多。虽然女性倾向于形成同质性联系，男性则表现出对跨性别协作的偏好，并且这些模式随着OSS生态系统的演变而随时间变化。最值得注意的是，我们发现与其他女性协作的开发者，尤其是女性，经历显著更低的流失风险，风险率最多降低20.7%。这些留存效应只有在考虑活动水平后才变得可见，这与先前工作一致，即聚合分析可能掩盖真实关系。我们的结果表明，同质性联系提供了社会支持，从而提高了开发者的持续参与，突显了包容、性别多样的网络对于维持OSS项目参与的重要性。

upstream_only.title: Perspective-Taking in Software Engineering: A Study on its Relationship to Team Performance
upstream_only.abstract: As software engineering (SE) becomes increasingly collaborative and cross-functional, teams must navigate differences in expertise, role priorities, and communication styles. While team diversity is often associated with greater innovation and creativity, it can also lead to misalignment, conflict, and diminished performance. Perspective-taking (PT), the cognitive process of understanding others’ viewpoints, has been studied in other fields as a way to convert diversity into improved team performance outcomes, yet its role in SE remains underexplored. In this work, we address this gap through an empirical study examining how PT operates in SE teams, and how it relates to team performance. We conducted an interview study with 33 software professionals across a range of roles and organizations, and used thematic analysis to identify common patterns in how participants described PT’s relationship to performance outcomes such as team output, team morale, and software quality. Our findings suggest that perspective-taking fosters more motivation and inclusion, and more productive task-based conflict in software engineering, all of which shape how teams reason, deliberate, and deliver. Given that PT can be difficult in practice, we also identify several factors that help overcome barriers to PT, such as psychological safety and open communication. By improving our understanding of how PT contributes to team performance in SE, and how it can be supported, this work advances efforts to create software that better serves diverse users and a more inclusive SE industry.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 随着软件工程（SE）变得日益协作化和跨职能化，团队必须应对专业知识、角色优先级和沟通风格方面的差异。虽然团队多样性通常与更大的创新和创造力相关，但它也可能导致不一致、冲突和绩效下降。换位思考（PT），即理解他人观点的认知过程，已在其他领域被研究作为将多样性转化为改善团队绩效成果的一种方式，但其在SE中的作用仍未得到充分探索。在这项工作中，我们通过一项实证研究来填补这一空白，考察PT在SE团队中如何运作，以及它与团队绩效的关系。我们对来自不同角色和组织的33名软件专业人员进行了访谈研究，并使用主题分析来识别参与者描述PT与团队产出、团队士气和软件质量等绩效成果关系时的常见模式。我们的发现表明，换位思考在软件工程中促进了更多的动力和包容性，以及更富有成效的基于任务的冲突，这些都会影响团队如何推理、商议和交付。鉴于PT在实践中可能很困难，我们还识别出了一些有助于克服PT障碍的因素，例如心理安全和开放沟通。通过增进我们对PT如何促进SE团队绩效以及如何支持它的理解，这项工作推进了创建更好地服务多样化用户的软件和更具包容性的SE行业的努力。

upstream_only.title: STEM-EF: A Scrum Teamwork Effectiveness Model Based on Emotional Factors
upstream_only.abstract: Background: Team effectiveness is critical to Agile Software Development (ASD), particularly within the Scrum framework. Existing models focus on behavioral and structural dimensions such as communication, coordination, and shared leadership, but largely overlook emotional dynamics. Objective: This study proposes the Scrum Team Effectiveness Model – Emotional Factors (STEM-EF), a novel instrument designed to assess team effectiveness in Scrum by incorporating emotional constructs. Method: STEM-EF was developed around four emotional factors—Emotional Intelligence (EI), Interpersonal Skills (IS), Conflict Resolution (CR), and Psychological Safety (PS)—and tailored to Scrum events, roles, and artifacts. Validation employed a mixed-methods approach, with content validity assessed using the Content Validity Index (CVI) and perceived utility evaluated through the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM). Data were collected from 11 Scrum experts, 56 team members, and 2 psychologists via interviews, focus groups, and surveys. Results: STEM-EF demonstrated high content validity across relevance, coherence, and simplicity (S-CVI-Relevance = 1.00, S-CVI-Coherence = 1.00, S-CVI-Simplicity = 0.99). TAM results indicated favorable perceptions of usefulness and intention to adopt the instrument. Conclusion: STEM-EF is a content-validated and practically promising instrument for integrating emotional assessment into Scrum team evaluations. It offers both researchers and practitioners a structured means to explore and support emotional dynamics that may affect team performance.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 背景：团队效能对敏捷软件开发（ASD）至关重要，尤其是在Scrum框架中。现有模型关注沟通、协调和共享领导等行为与结构维度，但很大程度上忽视了情感动态。目标：本研究提出Scrum团队效能模型——情感因素（STEM-EF），一种旨在通过纳入情感构念来评估Scrum团队效能的新工具。方法：STEM-EF围绕四个情感因素——情绪智力（EI）、人际技能（IS）、冲突解决（CR）和心理安全（PS）——开发，并针对Scrum事件、角色和工件进行定制。验证采用混合方法，使用内容效度指数（CVI）评估内容效度，并通过技术接受模型（TAM）评估感知有用性。数据通过访谈、焦点小组和问卷调查从11名Scrum专家、56名团队成员和2名心理学家处收集。结果：STEM-EF在相关性、一致性和简洁性方面表现出高内容效度（S-CVI-Relevance = 1.00, S-CVI-Coherence = 1.00, S-CVI-Simplicity = 0.99）。TAM结果表明对该工具有用性和采用意向的积极看法。结论：STEM-EF是一种经过内容效度验证且具有实践前景的工具，可将情感评估整合到Scrum团队评价中。它为研究人员和实践者提供了一种结构化的手段，以探索和支持可能影响团队绩效的情感动态。

upstream_only.title: Women’s Career Paths in the Nordic Software Industry: A Narrative Analysis Through Gender-Switched Personas
upstream_only.abstract: Recent data indicate that women are significantly more likely than men to leave the software engineering (SE) field or transition to other careers, with nearly half doing so by the age of 35. Despite ongoing efforts, retention strategies remain inadequate and insufficient. This study examines the career trajectories of women in the SE industry, with a specific focus on the Norwegian context. We adopted a narrative research approach, using a storytelling framework to explore the lived experiences of women working in SE. We collected data through a questionnaire and semi-structured interviews. To challenge gender stereotypes and foster reflection, we present the findings through a gender-switched approach. The personas vary in background, nationality and age, and highlight a range of personal and professional challenges. Key themes include self-doubt, mental health struggles, and what we refer to as the "good-girl syndrome"—a form of internalized pressure linked to perfectionism. For instance, Jakob, a non-native speaker, described how language barriers and the scarcity of women in the field affect career advancement. Andreas, a younger professional, expressed concerns about not being taken seriously due to age. The results underscore the importance of women-centered networks in sharing experiences and fostering a sense of safety, as well as the need for open communication and transparency from companies in their hiring practices, salary data, and representation of female leadership. Our study offers a new perspective on the career paths of women, inspiring future researchers and providing an actionable set of strategies to consider for addressing the retention of women in the SE field.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 近期数据表明，女性比男性更可能离开软件工程（SE）领域或转向其他职业，其中近一半在35岁前离开。尽管已有持续努力，留任策略仍然不足且不充分。本研究考察了软件工程行业中女性的职业轨迹，特别关注挪威语境。我们采用叙事研究方法，使用讲故事框架来探索软件工程领域女性的生活经历。我们通过问卷和半结构化访谈收集数据。为了挑战性别刻板印象并促进反思，我们以性别转换的方式呈现研究结果。这些人设的背景、国籍和年龄各不相同，并突显了一系列个人和职业挑战。关键主题包括自我怀疑、心理健康挣扎，以及我们称之为“好女孩综合征”的现象——一种与完美主义相关的内化压力。例如，非母语者Jakob描述了语言障碍和该领域女性稀缺如何影响职业发展。较年轻的从业者Andreas表达了对因年龄而不被认真对待的担忧。结果强调了以女性为中心的网络在分享经验和培养安全感方面的重要性，以及公司在招聘实践、薪资数据和女性领导层代表性方面进行开放沟通和保持透明的必要性。我们的研究为女性的职业路径提供了新视角，激励未来研究者，并提供了一套可操作策略，以考虑如何解决软件工程领域女性的留任问题。

upstream_only.title: "Maybe We Need Some More Examples:" Individual and Team Drivers of Developer GenAI Tool Use
upstream_only.abstract: Despite the widespread availability of generative AI tools in software engineering, developer adoption remains uneven. This unevenness is problematic because it hampers productivity efforts, frustrates management’s expectations, and creates uncertainty around the future roles of developers. Through paired interviews with 54 developers across 27 teams – one frequent and one infrequent user per team – we demonstrate that differences in usage result primarily from how developers perceive the tool (as a collaborator vs. feature), their engagement approach (experimental vs. conservative), and how they respond when encountering challenges (with adaptive persistence vs. quick abandonment). Our findings suggest that widespread organizational expectations for rapid productivity gains without sufficient investment in learning support can create a “Productivity Pressure Paradox,” undermining the very productivity benefits that motivate adoption.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 尽管生成式AI工具在软件工程中广泛可用，开发者的采用情况仍然不均衡。这种不均衡是有问题的，因为它阻碍了生产力提升努力，使管理层的期望受挫，并给开发者的未来角色带来不确定性。通过对来自27个团队的54名开发者进行配对访谈——每个团队一名频繁用户和一名不频繁用户——我们证明，使用差异主要源于开发者如何看待该工具（作为合作者还是功能）、他们的参与方式（实验性还是保守性），以及他们在遇到挑战时如何应对（适应性坚持还是迅速放弃）。我们的发现表明，组织若在没有足够学习支持投资的情况下，广泛期望快速获得生产力提升，可能会造成“生产力压力悖论”，反而削弱了促使采用的生产力收益。

upstream_only.title: "Game Changer" or "Overenthusiastic Drunk Acquaintance"? Generative AI Use by Blind and Low Vision Software Professionals in the Workplace
upstream_only.abstract: The software development workplace poses numerous technical and collaborative accessibility challenges for blind and low vision software professionals (BLVSPs). Though Generative AI (GenAI) is increasingly adopted within the software development industry and has been a rapidly growing topic of interest in research, to date, the unique perspectives of BLVSPs have yet to be consulted. We report on a qualitative study involving 39 semi-structured interviews with BLVSPs about what the introduction of GenAI has meant for their work. We found that BLVSPs used GenAI for many software development tasks, resulting in benefits such as increased productivity and accessibility. However, significant costs were also accompanied by GenAI use as they were more vulnerable to hallucinations than their sighted colleagues. Sometimes, organizational policies prevented use. Based on our findings, we discuss the higher-risks and higher-returns that BLVSPs had to carefully weigh when deciding whether and when to use GenAI tools for work.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 软件开发工作场所对盲人和低视力软件专业人员（BLVSPs）构成了许多技术和协作可访问性挑战。尽管生成式AI（GenAI）在软件开发行业中被越来越多地采用，并且已成为研究中快速增长的兴趣话题，但迄今为止，尚未咨询过BLVSPs的独特观点。我们报告了一项定性研究，涉及39次半结构化访谈，内容关于GenAI的引入对他们的工作意味着什么。我们发现BLVSPs将GenAI用于许多软件开发任务，从而带来了诸如提高生产力和可访问性等好处。然而，GenAI的使用也伴随着显著的成本，因为他们比视力正常的同事更容易受到幻觉的影响。有时，组织政策会阻止使用。基于我们的发现，我们讨论了BLVSPs在决定是否以及何时在工作中使用GenAI工具时必须仔细权衡的更高风险和更高回报。

upstream_only.title: Are Humans and LLMs Confused by the Same Code? An Empirical Study on Fixation-Related Potentials and LLM Perplexity
upstream_only.abstract: Already today, humans and programming assistants based on large language models (LLMs) collaborate in everyday programming tasks. Clearly, a misalignment between how LLMs and programmers comprehend code can lead to misunderstandings, inefficiencies, low code quality, and bugs. A key question in this space is whether humans and LLMs are confused by the same kind of code. This would not only guide our choices of integrating LLMs in software engineering workflows but also inform about possible improvements of LLMs. To this end, we conducted an empirical study comparing an LLM to human programmers comprehending clean and confusing code. We operationalized comprehension for the LLM by using LLM perplexity, and for human programmers using neurophysiological responses (in particular, EEG-based fixation-related potentials). We found that LLM perplexity spikes correlate, both in terms of location and amplitude, with human neurophysiological responses that indicate confusion. This result suggests that LLMs and humans are similarly confused about the code. Based on these findings, we devised a data-driven, LLM-based approach to identify regions of confusion in code that elicit confusion in human programmers.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 如今，人类和基于大语言模型（LLM）的编程助手已经在日常编程任务中协作。显然，LLM和程序员在理解代码方式上的不一致可能导致误解、低效、低代码质量和缺陷。该领域的一个关键问题是，人类和LLM是否会被同一类代码所困惑。这不仅将指导我们在软件工程工作流中集成LLM的选择，还将为LLM的潜在改进提供信息。为此，我们进行了一项实证研究，比较了一个LLM与人类程序员在理解清晰代码和令人困惑代码时的表现。我们通过使用LLM困惑度来操作化LLM的理解，并通过神经生理反应（特别是基于EEG的注视相关电位）来操作化人类程序员的理解。我们发现，LLM困惑度的峰值在位置和幅度上都与表明困惑的人类神经生理反应相关。这一结果表明，LLM和人类对代码的困惑是相似的。基于这些发现，我们设计了一种数据驱动的、基于LLM的方法，用于识别代码中引发人类程序员困惑的困惑区域。

upstream_only.title: Weak Programmers Need Not Apply, LLMs Welcome! Survey Screening in the AI Era
upstream_only.abstract: Quantitative research on software development practice often depends on the results of anonymous online surveys. However, it is difficult to verify that the respondents to such surveys are genuine developers, especially if survey responses are paid for, incentivising respondents to game the system and attracting the attention of bots and professional survey farms. One solution is to include screening questions to assess respondents’ coding skills, but this introduces the risk of unfairly excluding considered responses from developers who spent time and energy on the survey. We reviewed the responses of 86 developers who were excluded via screening from analysis of a large unpaid developer survey (n=1,048). We estimated that up to 86\% of the developers who were excluded were genuine developers. The advent of large language models (LLMs) casts further doubt on the use of screening questions. Investigating LLM ability, we found that five sample LLMs could answer most widely-used screening questions. Powerful LLM-based survey-taking tools now exist. We researched current survey screening techniques and found that they are susceptible to fraud via LLM use, bots and survey farms. Recruitment strategy may be a better screening technique. We recommend that if survey respondents are compensated only known developers should be invited. Surveys that are widely distributed, e.g. on social media, should not compensate respondents. Instead, researchers should focus on good survey design and sustained, imaginative recruitment strategies.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 关于软件开发实践的定量研究通常依赖于匿名在线调查的结果。然而，很难验证此类调查的受访者是否是真正的开发者，尤其是当调查回复获得报酬时，这会激励受访者钻系统空子，并吸引机器人和专业调查农场的注意。一种解决方案是加入筛选问题来评估受访者的编程能力，但这会带来不公平地排除那些在调查上花费了时间和精力的开发者的深思熟虑回复的风险。我们审查了在一项大型无报酬开发者调查（n=1,048）的分析中通过筛选被排除的86名开发者的回复。我们估计，被排除的开发者中高达86%是真正的开发者。大语言模型（LLM）的出现进一步让人质疑使用筛选问题的做法。在调查LLM的能力时，我们发现五个样本LLM能够回答大多数广泛使用的筛选问题。现在已有强大的基于LLM的调查作答工具。我们研究了当前的调查筛选技术，发现它们容易受到通过LLM使用、机器人和调查农场进行的欺诈。招募策略可能是一种更好的筛选技术。我们建议，如果调查受访者获得报酬，则只应邀请已知的开发者。广泛分发的调查（例如在社交媒体上）不应补偿受访者。相反，研究人员应专注于良好的调查设计和持续、富有想象力的招募策略。

upstream_only.title: Evolving with AI: A Longitudinal Analysis of Developer Logs
upstream_only.abstract: AI‑powered coding assistants are rapidly becoming fixtures in professional IDEs, yet their sustained influence on everyday development remains poorly understood. Prior research has focused on short-term use or self-reported perceptions, leaving open questions about how sustained AI use reshapes actual daily coding practices in the long term.We address this gap with a mixed-method study of AI adoption in IDEs, combining longitudinal two-year fine-grained telemetry from 800 developers with a survey of 62 professionals. We analyze five dimensions of workflow change: productivity, code quality, code editing, code reuse, and context switching. Telemetry reveals that AI users produce substantially more code but also delete significantly more. Meanwhile, survey respondents report productivity gains and perceive minimal changes in other dimensions.Our results offer empirical insights into the silent restructuring of software workflows and provide implications for designing future AI-augmented tooling.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: AI驱动的编码助手正迅速成为专业IDE中的常见工具，但它们对日常开发的持续影响仍鲜为人知。已有研究主要关注短期使用或自我报告的主观感受，对于长期持续使用AI如何重塑实际日常编码实践，仍存在未解问题。为填补这一空白，我们开展了一项关于IDE中AI采用的混合方法研究，结合了来自800名开发者的为期两年、细粒度的纵向遥测数据，以及对62名专业人士的问卷调查。我们分析了工作流变化的五个维度：生产力、代码质量、代码编辑、代码复用和上下文切换。遥测数据显示，AI用户编写的代码显著更多，但删除的代码也明显更多。同时，问卷受访者报告了生产力提升，并认为其他维度变化极小。我们的结果提供了关于软件工作流悄然重构的实证见解，并为设计未来AI增强工具提供了启示。

upstream_only.title: “I need to learn better searching tactics for privacy policy laws.” Investigating Software Developers’ Behavior When Using Sources on Privacy Issues
upstream_only.abstract: Since the introduction of the European General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), software developers increasingly have to make privacy-related decisions during system design and implementation. However, past research showed that they often lack legal expertise and struggle with privacy-compliant development. To shed light on how effective current information sources are in supporting them with privacy-sensitive implementation, we conducted a qualitative study with 30 developers. Participants were presented with a privacy-sensitive scenario and asked to identify privacy issues and suggest measures using their knowledge, online resources, and an AI assistant. We observed developers’ decision-making in think-aloud sessions and discussed it in follow-up interviews. We found that participants struggled with all three sources: personal knowledge was insufficient, web content was often too complex, and while AI assistants provided clear and user-tailored responses, they lacked contextual relevance and failed to identify scenario-specific issues. Our study highlights major shortcomings in existing support for privacy-related development tasks. Based on our findings, we discuss the need for more accessible, understandable, and actionable privacy resources for developers.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 自从《通用数据保护条例》(GDPR)和《加州消费者隐私法案》(CCPA)出台以来，软件开发者越来越需要在系统设计与实现过程中做出与隐私相关的决策。然而，过往研究表明，他们往往缺乏法律专业知识，并且在隐私合规开发方面遇到困难。为了揭示当前信息源在支持开发者进行隐私敏感实现方面的有效性，我们对30名开发者进行了一项定性研究。参与者被呈现一个隐私敏感场景，并被要求利用自身知识、在线资源和AI助手来识别隐私问题并提出措施。我们在出声思维环节中观察开发者的决策过程，并在后续访谈中讨论。我们发现参与者在所有三种来源上都遇到困难：个人知识不足，网络内容常常过于复杂，而AI助手虽然提供了清晰且针对用户的回答，却缺乏语境相关性，未能识别场景特定问题。我们的研究凸显了现有支持在隐私相关开发任务中的重大缺陷。基于研究结果，我们讨论了为开发者提供更易获取、更易理解且更具可操作性的隐私资源的需求。

upstream_only.title: What’s in a Software Engineering Job Posting?
upstream_only.abstract: A well-rounded software engineer is often defined by technical prowess and the ability to deliver on complex projects. However, the narrative around the ideal Software Engineering (SE) candidate is evolving, suggesting that there is more to the story. This article explores the non-technical aspects emphasized in SE job postings, revealing the sociotechnical and organizational expectations of employers. Our Thematic Analysis of 100 job postings shows that employers seek candidates who align with their sense of purpose, fit within company culture, pursue personal and career growth, and excel in interpersonal interactions. This study contributes to ongoing discussions in the SE community about the evolving role and workplace context of software engineers beyond technical skills. By highlighting these expectations, we provide relevant insights for researchers, educators, practitioners, and recruiters. Additionally, our analysis offers a valuable snapshot of SE job postings in 2023, providing a scientific record of prevailing trends and expectations.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 一名全面发展的软件工程师通常由技术实力和交付复杂项目的能力来定义。然而，围绕理想软件工程（SE）候选人的叙事正在演变，表明故事还有更多内容。本文探讨了SE职位招聘中强调的非技术方面，揭示了雇主的社会技术期望和组织期望。我们对100份职位招聘的主题分析表明，雇主寻求与自身目标感一致的候选人，他们能融入公司文化，追求个人和职业成长，并在人际互动中表现出色。这项研究有助于SE社区正在进行的关于软件工程师不断变化的角色和工作场所背景（超越技术技能）的讨论。通过强调这些期望，我们为研究人员、教育工作者、从业者和招聘人员提供了相关见解。此外，我们的分析提供了2023年SE职位招聘的宝贵快照，为普遍趋势和期望提供了科学记录。

upstream_only.title: TaCoS: Generated Context Summaries for Task Resumption
upstream_only.abstract: Interruptions are a frequent challenge in software development, requiring developers to reconstruct both the mental and working context of their tasks. While prior work has proposed visual timelines or manual notes to aid resumption, these approaches require effort or lack support for mental context reconstruction. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) offer new opportunities to support task resumption through automatically generated summaries. We present TaCoS, an IDE-integrated tool that generates task context summaries from IDE and browser activity, combining inferred intent, implementation steps, and links to relevant artifacts. We evaluated TaCoS in a controlled lab experiment with 32 software developers, who resumed three programming tasks. Each task was resumed using one of three cues: a manual note, a timeline of recent edits, or a TaCoS-generated summary. The generated summary led to the shortest resumption and edit lag, and was rated as the most helpful cue overall. However, the timeline condition achieved the highest task success rate. Participants valued the summaries’ structured, low-effort presentation of past activity, but noted that they often lacked forward-looking information, which was typically present in the self-authored manual notes. These findings highlight the potential of combining automated summarization with lightweight user annotations to support task resumption in development environments.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 中断是软件开发中常见的挑战，要求开发者重建任务的心理和工作上下文。尽管先前工作提出了视觉时间线或手动笔记来帮助恢复，但这些方法需要付出努力或缺乏对心理上下文重建的支持。大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展为通过自动生成摘要来支持任务恢复提供了新机会。我们提出了 TaCoS，一个集成在 IDE 中的工具，它根据 IDE 和浏览器活动生成任务上下文摘要，结合推断的意图、实现步骤以及相关工件的链接。我们在一个有 32 名软件开发人员参与的受控实验室实验中评估了 TaCoS，他们恢复了三个编程任务。每个任务使用三种线索之一进行恢复：手动笔记、最近编辑的时间线或 TaCoS 生成的摘要。生成的摘要导致最短的恢复和编辑滞后，并被总体评为最有帮助的线索。然而，时间线条件实现了最高的任务成功率。参与者重视摘要对过去活动的结构化、低努力呈现，但指出它们通常缺乏前瞻性信息，而自我编写的手动笔记通常包含这些信息。这些发现凸显了将自动摘要与轻量级用户注释相结合以支持开发环境中任务恢复的潜力。

upstream_only.title: Demystifying the CVE Ecosystem: Community-Perceived Impacts and Problems
upstream_only.abstract: The Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) system plays a critical role in global cybersecurity by standardizing the identification and cataloging of software and hardware vulnerabilities. However, recent high-profile incidents highlight the potential pitfall of the system, indicating the space for improvement. Despite significant interests in and substantial studies on CVE system, there is a lack of understanding to what extent the participants are impacted, and what problems are exactly in the CVE ecosystem. To bridge the knowledge gap, we extensively collect blog posts, community discussions, and editorial articles from various sources, including Reddit, LWN.net, and GitHub, and employ a thematic analysis approach to identify the perceived adverse impact on participants as well as the inherent problems within the CVE ecosystem. Then we conducted a community survey with 77 participants for verification. The results unveil the impacts on various participants within the prevailing CVE ecosystem and for the first time comprehensively trace and elucidate the problems that may cause these impacts. Based on the findings and survey results, we propose a series of implications to mitigate existing problems within the CVE ecosystem, aiming to enhance its efficiency and health.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 通用漏洞与暴露（CVE）系统通过标准化软件和硬件漏洞的识别与编目，在全球网络安全中发挥着关键作用。然而，近期备受关注的事件凸显了该系统的潜在缺陷，表明仍有改进空间。尽管对CVE系统有着浓厚的兴趣和大量研究，但人们对于参与者受到何种程度的影响以及CVE生态系统中究竟存在哪些问题仍缺乏了解。为填补这一知识空白，我们从Reddit、LWN.net和GitHub等多个来源广泛收集博客文章、社区讨论和社论文章，并采用主题分析方法来识别参与者所感知的不利影响以及CVE生态系统内部固有的问题。随后，我们开展了一项有77名参与者参与的社区调查以进行验证。结果揭示了当前CVE生态系统中各类参与者所受到的影响，并首次全面追溯和阐明了可能导致这些影响的问题。基于研究发现和调查结果，我们提出了一系列启示，以缓解CVE生态系统中现存的问题，旨在提升其效率和健康度。

upstream_only.title: Practitioner Views on Mobile App Accessibility: Practices and Challenges
upstream_only.abstract: As mobile applications (apps) become ubiquitous in everyday life, it is crucial for developers to prioritize accessibility for users with diverse abilities. While previous research has identified widespread accessibility issues and raised awareness of developer challenges, there remains a lack of cross-platform, globally representative insights into how practitioners approach accessibility in practice. This paper presents findings from a mixed-methods survey of 110 mobile app developers across 43 countries, examining how platform ecosystems (iOS vs. Android) and developer experience shape accessibility practices. Results show that while developers recognize the importance of accessibility, they often rely on platform-specific guidelines and typically perform compliance testing late in the development process. Developers primarily implement text-focused features while struggling with API limitations and organizational constraints. Through systematic cross-platform comparison, we identify novel platform-specific barriers and demonstrate how accessibility practices differ across developer experience levels. Our findings offer new insights into the challenges of achieving accessibility in practice and provide actionable steps for various stakeholders to promote more consistent and inclusive app development.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 随着移动应用程序在日常生活中变得无处不在，开发者必须优先考虑为具有不同能力的用户提供无障碍访问。虽然先前的研究已发现广泛的无障碍问题并提高了对开发者挑战的认识，但仍缺乏跨平台、全球代表性的关于实践者如何在实践中处理无障碍的见解。本文介绍了对来自43个国家的110名移动应用开发者进行的混合方法调查的发现，考察了平台生态系统（iOS与Android）和开发者经验如何塑造无障碍实践。结果表明，虽然开发者认识到无障碍的重要性，但他们通常依赖平台特定的指南，并且通常在开发过程后期进行合规性测试。开发者主要实现以文本为中心的功能，同时在API限制和组织约束方面遇到困难。通过系统的跨平台比较，我们识别出新的平台特定障碍，并展示了无障碍实践如何因开发者经验水平而异。我们的发现为在实践中实现无障碍的挑战提供了新见解，并为各利益相关者提供了可操作步骤，以促进更一致和包容的应用开发。

upstream_only.title: Synthesizing Hardware-Specific Instructions for Efficient Code Generation of Simulink
upstream_only.abstract: Simulink has become a pivotal tool in embedded scenarios, offering a model-driven approach for embedded software development. Given the tight performance and resource constraints in embedded applications, it is crucial to ensure the efficiency of the code generated from Simulink models. Code generators implement various optimizations to enhance performance. However, they neglect the potential of hardware-specific instructions available in modern processors, such as saturation-type instructions, which accomplish complex operations in fewer cycles. Moreover, relying on state-of-the-art compilers to use these instructions is also not as effective as expectation, due to their complex semantics.This paper proposes Amica, an efficient code generator for Simulink models with hardware-specific instruction synthesis. The key insight of Amica is to leverage model semantics to effectively synthesize the appropriate instructions. Amica first converts the model into the dataflow graph and crafts a series of optimization rules represented as dataflow subgraph with constraints related to block parameters, data types, and other critical properties. Then, Amica iteratively matches these rules with dataflow graph to obtain the optimizable candidates. The candidate that maximizes latency reduction is chosen to update the dataflow graph. Finally, Amica synthesizes the appropriate instructions for optimizable blocks in accordance with instruction syntax and block properties. We implemented and evaluated Amica on benchmark Simulink models. Compared with the state-of-the-art code generators Simulink Embedded Coder, Mercury, and Frodo, the code generated by Amica is 1.29 {\texttimes} - 8.36 {\texttimes} faster in terms of execution time across different platforms. Besides, Amica reduces 6\% - 53\% assembly code size of the compiled programs, while performing similarly in terms of data segment size and BSS segment size.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Simulink已成为嵌入式场景中的关键工具，为嵌入式软件开发提供模型驱动的方法。鉴于嵌入式应用中严格的性能和资源约束，确保从Simulink模型生成的代码效率至关重要。代码生成器实现了各种优化以提升性能。然而，它们忽视了现代处理器中可用的硬件特定指令的潜力，例如饱和类型指令，这些指令能在更少的周期内完成复杂操作。此外，由于这些指令语义复杂，依赖最先进的编译器来使用它们也不如预期有效。本文提出Amica，一种具有硬件特定指令合成功能的Simulink模型高效代码生成器。Amica的核心见解是利用模型语义来有效合成适当的指令。Amica首先将模型转换为数据流图，并制定一系列优化规则，这些规则表示为带有与块参数、数据类型和其他关键属性相关约束的数据流子图。然后，Amica迭代地将这些规则与数据流图匹配，以获得可优化的候选。选择能最大程度减少延迟的候选来更新数据流图。最后，Amica根据指令语法和块属性为可优化块合成适当的指令。我们在基准Simulink模型上实现并评估了Amica。与最先进的代码生成器Simulink Embedded Coder、Mercury和Frodo相比，Amica生成的代码在不同平台上执行时间快1.29倍至8.36倍。此外，Amica将编译程序的汇编代码大小减少了6%至53%，同时在数据段大小和BSS段大小方面表现相似。

upstream_only.title: Light over Heavy: Automated Performance Requirements Quantification with Linguistic Inducement
upstream_only.abstract: Elicited performance requirements need to be quantified for compliance in different engineering tasks, e.g., configuration tuning and performance testing. Much existing work has relied on manual quantification, which is expensive and error-prone due to the imprecision. In this paper, we present LQPR, a highly efficient automatic approach for performance requirements quantification. LQPR relies on a new theoretical framework that converts quantification as a classification problem. Despite the prevalent applications of Large Language Models (LLMs) for requirement analytics, LQPR takes a different perspective to address the classification: we observed that performance requirements can exhibit strong patterns and are often short/concise, therefore we design a lightweight linguistically induced matching mechanism. We compare LQPR against nine state-of-the-art learning-based approaches over diverse datasets, demonstrating that it is ranked as the sole best for 75\% or more cases with two orders less cost. Our work proves that, at least for performance requirement quantification, specialized methods can be more suitable than the general LLM-driven approaches.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 为了在不同工程任务（如配置调优和性能测试）中实现合规，需要对所获取的性能需求进行量化。现有许多工作依赖人工量化，这不仅昂贵，而且由于不精确而容易出错。本文提出 LQPR，一种高效自动的性能需求量化方法。LQPR 依赖一个新的理论框架，将量化转化为分类问题。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）在需求分析中广泛应用，LQPR 采取不同的视角来解决分类问题：我们观察到性能需求可以表现出很强的模式，并且通常简短/简洁，因此我们设计了一种轻量级的语言诱导匹配机制。我们在多样数据集上将 LQPR 与九种最先进的基于学习的方法进行比较，结果表明它在 75% 或更多情况下被列为唯一最佳，且成本低两个数量级。我们的工作证明，至少对于性能需求量化而言，专门方法可能比通用的 LLM 驱动方法更合适。

upstream_only.title: Unlocking the Silent Needs: Business-Logic-Driven Iterative Requirements Auto-completion
upstream_only.abstract: To tackle the dual challenges of incomplete requirements and hallucinations in large language models (LLMs), this paper proposes a business-logic-driven iterative requirements auto-completion approach named ReqCompleter. By treating the “use case – entity– operation” triplet as the smallest computable closed loop, ReqCompleter adopts a model-driven iterative mechanism. First, a use-case model, an E-R diagram, and a CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) matrix are fused into a unified semantic framework. Next, gaps in the CRUD matrix act as triggers to iteratively detect missing functionalities, while the E-R diagram delimits entity boundaries to steer the LLM toward generating requirements within a controlled scope. We evaluate our approach across seven cases in e-commerce, logistics, public safety and other domains. Compared to general-purpose LLMs, it improves requirements completeness rate by 20\%-88\% while reducing hallucination rate by 2.4\%-13.9\%. To the best of our knowledge, this work represents the first tight coupling of classical requirements engineering models with generative AI, establishing an automated closed-loop system that delivers “what’s missing, as needed" under explicit business logic constraints. This opens a new and practical technical pathway for high-quality, explainable, and continuously evolvable requirements engineering.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 为应对大型语言模型（LLM）中需求不完整与幻觉的双重挑战，本文提出了一种业务逻辑驱动的迭代式需求自动补全方法，名为 ReqCompleter。通过将“用例—实体—操作”三元组视为最小可计算闭环，ReqCompleter 采用模型驱动的迭代机制。首先，将用例模型、E-R 图和 CRUD（创建、读取、更新、删除）矩阵融合为统一的语义框架。接下来，CRUD 矩阵中的缺口作为触发器，迭代检测缺失功能，而 E-R 图界定实体边界，引导 LLM 在受控范围内生成需求。我们在电子商务、物流、公共安全等领域中的七个案例上评估了该方法。与通用 LLM 相比，它将需求完整率提高了 20%-88%，同时将幻觉率降低了 2.4%-13.9%。据我们所知，这项工作首次将经典需求工程模型与生成式 AI 紧密耦合，建立了一个自动化闭环系统，在明确的业务逻辑约束下实现“按需补缺”。这为高质量、可解释且可持续演进的需求工程开辟了一条新的实用技术路径。

upstream_only.title: Bayesian Multi-Level Performance Models for Multi-Factor Variability of Configurable Software Systems
upstream_only.abstract: Tuning a software system’s configuration is essential to meet performance requirements. However, not only do configuration options affect performance, but also the system’s interaction with external factors such as the workload. Hence, tuning requires understanding how a specific setting of external factors (e.g., a specific workload) in combination with the system configuration influences performance. To address this issue, we propose HyPerf , a Bayesian multi-level performance modeling approach that systematically distinguishes between setting-invariant and setting-variant influences, that is, influences that remain consistent across settings versus those that exhibit substantial variation. With HyPerf , we aim at balancing accuracy and efficiency, achieving robust performance predictions with significantly fewer training samples. Unlike the state of the art, HyPerf is able to identify a minimal set of settings that captures essential performance variations, so that developers can approximate whether all setting-variant influences have been accounted for. Empirical evaluations on ten real-world software systems across up to 35 workloads and scalability experiments on the Linux kernel demonstrate that HyPerf matches or outperforms state-of-the-art approaches while requiring fewer measurements. Notably, HyPerf is indeed capable of interpretable performance reasoning and can identify minimal workload subsets that capture essential performance variations.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 调整软件系统的配置对于满足性能需求至关重要。然而，不仅配置选项会影响性能，系统与工作负载等外部因素的交互也会影响性能。因此，调整需要理解外部因素的特定设置（例如特定工作负载）与系统配置的组合如何影响性能。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 HyPerf，一种贝叶斯多级性能建模方法，系统地区分设置不变和设置变化的影响，即在各种设置中保持一致的影响与表现出显著变化的影响。通过 HyPerf，我们旨在平衡准确性和效率，以显著更少的训练样本实现稳健的性能预测。与现有技术不同，HyPerf 能够识别捕获关键性能变化的最小设置集，以便开发人员可以近似判断是否已考虑所有设置变化的影响。在多达 35 个工作负载的十个真实世界软件系统上进行的实证评估以及在 Linux 内核上的可扩展性实验表明，HyPerf 在需要更少测量的情况下达到或优于最先进的方法。值得注意的是，HyPerf 确实能够进行可解释的性能推理，并能识别捕获关键性能变化的最小工作负载子集。

upstream_only.title: Can SAT Solvers Keep Up With the Linux Kernel's Feature Model?
upstream_only.abstract: The Linux kernel is a highly relevant, yet also highly configurable software system. Kernel developers keep track of this configurability in a feature model, which defines the features of Linux and their dependencies. To support kernel developers in various activities, many (semi-)automated product-line analyses have been proposed over the years. Under the hood, these analyses can often be computed with SAT solvers. Yet, the Linux kernel has constantly been growing in complexity for decades, which increasingly hampers its efficient analysis. At the same time, SAT solvers have been improving in performance for decades, which eases analysis. In this paper, we investigate empirically whether SAT solvers can keep up with the Linux kernel’s feature model. To this end, we analyze historic feature models of Linux with historic SAT solvers from several sources. We find that SAT solvers are generally not able to keep up with Linux. Even the optimal SAT solver is slowing down by 10\% every year, meaning that its performance halves every seven years. We conclude that the Linux kernel will become increasingly difficult to analyze if its growth is not counteracted.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Linux内核是一个高度相关且高度可配置的软件系统。内核开发者通过特性模型来跟踪这种可配置性，该模型定义了Linux的特性及其依赖关系。为了支持内核开发者的各种活动，多年来已经提出了许多（半）自动化的产品线分析。在底层，这些分析通常可以用SAT求解器来计算。然而，几十年来Linux内核的复杂性一直在不断增长，这日益阻碍了对其的高效分析。与此同时，SAT求解器的性能几十年来一直在提升，这减轻了分析的难度。在本文中，我们通过实证研究SAT求解器能否跟上Linux内核的特性模型。为此，我们使用来自多个来源的历史SAT求解器来分析Linux的历史特性模型。我们发现，SAT求解器通常无法跟上Linux的发展。即使是最优的SAT求解器，其性能也每年下降10%，这意味着其性能每七年减半。我们得出结论：如果不遏制Linux内核的增长，对其分析将变得越来越困难。

upstream_only.title: LikeThis! Empowering App Users to Submit UI Improvement Suggestions Instead of Complaints
upstream_only.abstract: User feedback is crucial for the evolution of mobile apps. However, research suggests that users tend to submit uninformative, vague, or destructive feedback. Unlike recent AI4SE approaches that focus on generating code and other development artifacts, our work aims at empowering users to submit better and more constructive UI feedback with concrete suggestions on how to improve the app. We propose LikeThis!, a GenAI-based approach that takes a user comment with the corresponding screenshot to immediately generate multiple improvement alternatives, from which the user can easily choose their preferred option. To evaluate LikeThis!, we first conducted a model benchmarking study based on a public dataset of carefully critiqued UI designs. The results show that GPT-Image-1 significantly outperformed three other state-of-the-art image generation models in improving the designs to address UI issues while keeping the fidelity and without introducing new issues. An intermediate step in LikeThis! to generate a solution specification before changing the design was key to achieving effective improvement. Second, we conducted a user study with 10 production apps, where 15 users used LikeThis! to submit their feedback on encountered issues. Later, the developers of the apps assessed the understandability and actionability of the feedback with and without generated improvements. The results show that our approach helps generate better feedback from both user and developer perspectives, paving the way for AI-assisted user-developer collaboration.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 用户反馈对于移动应用的演进至关重要。然而，研究表明用户往往提交无信息量、含糊或破坏性的反馈。与近期专注于生成代码和其他开发产物的AI4SE方法不同，我们的工作旨在赋能用户提交更好、更具建设性的UI反馈，并附有关于如何改进应用的具体建议。我们提出LikeThis!，一种基于生成式AI的方法，它接收用户评论及相应截图，立即生成多个改进备选方案，用户可以轻松选择自己偏好的选项。为了评估LikeThis!，我们首先基于一个经过仔细评审的UI设计公共数据集进行了模型基准测试研究。结果表明，GPT-Image-1在改进设计以解决UI问题方面显著优于其他三种最先进的图像生成模型，同时保持保真度且不引入新问题。LikeThis!中在更改设计前生成解决方案规范的中间步骤是实现有效改进的关键。其次，我们使用10个生产应用进行了用户研究，15名用户使用LikeThis!提交他们对所遇问题的反馈。随后，应用开发者评估了在有和没有生成改进的情况下反馈的可理解性和可操作性。结果表明，我们的方法从用户和开发者两个角度都有助于生成更好的反馈，为AI辅助的用户-开发者协作铺平了道路。

upstream_only.title: Modeling Like Peeling an Onion: Layerwise Analysis-Driven Automatic Behavioral Model Generation
upstream_only.abstract: As software complexity skyrockets and requirements evolve at breakneck speed, traditional human-centric behavioral modeling can no longer keep pace in terms of efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. While existing automated approaches can produce models, they still struggle with deep semantic understanding of textual requirements or with reasoning about intricate system logic, especially nested relationships. Inspired by the way experienced analysts “peel back” layers of a problem, we propose LATO, a Layerwise Analysis-Driven AuTomatic Behavioral MOdeling approach. It employs a progressive decomposition strategy to guide large language models in incrementally parsing requirement structures, deconstructing behavioral dependencies, and ultimately generating executable UML activity diagrams. Comprehensive evaluations on four open-source datasets and two real-world industrial systems show that LATO comprehensively outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in accuracy, completeness, and syntactic compliance: F1 scores for behavioral node-extraction improve by up to 71.1\%, relation-extraction F1 by 52.4\% relatively, and syntactic pass rates remain above 96.67\%. The framework also exhibits strong robustness to input perturbations, confirming its cross-domain generalizability. This paper is the first to tightly fuse human-inspired strategies with LLMs in behavior modeling, yielding an intelligent infrastructure that exhibits expert-level logical understanding and generalization. By closing the modeling-skills gap, LATO delivers a next-generation, low-cost, and explainable solution for requirements engineering and AI-native software development.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 随着软件复杂性飙升和需求快速演变，以人为中心的行为建模在效率、准确性和可扩展性方面已无法跟上步伐。尽管现有自动化方法可以生成模型，但它们仍难以深入理解文本需求，或难以推理复杂的系统逻辑，尤其是嵌套关系。受经验丰富的分析师“层层剥开”问题的方式启发，我们提出LATO，一种分层分析驱动的自动行为建模方法。它采用渐进式分解策略，引导大型语言模型逐步解析需求结构、解构行为依赖，并最终生成可执行的UML活动图。在四个开源数据集和两个真实工业系统上的综合评估表明，LATO在准确性、完整性和语法合规性方面全面优于最先进的基线：行为节点抽取的F1分数提升最高达71.1%，关系抽取F1相对提升52.4%，语法通过率保持在96.67%以上。该框架还对输入扰动表现出强鲁棒性，证实了其跨领域泛化能力。本文首次将人类启发式策略与LLM在行为建模中紧密结合，产生了一个具有专家级逻辑理解和泛化能力的智能基础设施。通过弥合建模技能差距，LATO为需求工程和AI原生软件开发提供了一种下一代、低成本且可解释的解决方案。

upstream_only.title: A Comprehensive Study of Deep Learning Model Fixing Approaches
upstream_only.abstract: Deep Learning (DL) has been widely adopted in diverse industrial domains, including autonomous driving, intelligent healthcare, and aided programming. Like traditional software, DL systems are also prone to faults, whose malfunctioning may expose users to significant risks. Consequently, numerous approaches have been proposed to address these issues. In this paper, we conduct a large-scale empirical study on 16 state-of-the-art DL model fixing approaches, spanning model-level, layer-level, and neuron-level categories, to comprehensively evaluate their performance. We assess not only their fixing effectiveness (their primary purpose) but also their impact on other critical properties, such as robustness, fairness, and backward compatibility. To ensure comprehensive and fair evaluation, we employ a diverse set of datasets, model architectures, and application domains within a uniform experimental setup for experimentation. We summarize several key findings with implications for both industry and academia. For example, model-level approaches demonstrate superior fixing effectiveness compared to others. No single approach can achieve the best fixing performance while improving accuracy and maintaining all other properties. Thus, academia should prioritize research on mitigating these side effects. These insights highlight promising directions for future exploration in this field.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 深度学习（DL）已广泛应用于自动驾驶、智能医疗和辅助编程等多个工业领域。与传统软件一样，深度学习系统也容易出错，其故障可能使用户面临重大风险。因此，人们提出了许多方法来解决这些问题。在本文中，我们对16种最先进的DL模型修复方法进行了大规模实证研究，涵盖模型级、层级和神经元级类别，以全面评估其性能。我们不仅评估其修复有效性（其主要目的），还评估它们对其他关键属性的影响，如鲁棒性、公平性和向后兼容性。为了确保全面和公平的评估，我们在统一的实验设置中采用了多样化的数据集、模型架构和应用领域进行实验。我们总结了几项关键发现，对工业界和学术界都具有启示意义。例如，模型级方法在修复有效性方面优于其他方法。没有一种方法能够在提高准确率并保持所有其他属性的同时实现最佳修复性能。因此，学术界应优先研究如何减轻这些副作用。这些见解突出了该领域未来探索的有希望的方向。

upstream_only.title: AtPatch: Debugging Transformers via Hot-Fixing Over-Attention
upstream_only.abstract: Transformer-based deep neural networks (DNNs) affected by backdoor attacks and unfairness typically exhibit anomalous attention patterns, leading to over-attend to backdoor triggers or protected attributes. Existing neuron-editing mitigation strategies often struggle to handle such situation and most of them lack flexibility and tend to distort feature representations. Motivated by such over-attention phenomenon and software engineering paradigms such as delta debugging and hot patching, we propose AtPatch, a hot-fix method that dynamically redistributes attention maps during model inference. Specifically, for a given input, AtPatch first extracts the attention map from the model’s inference process. Then, it uses a pre-trained detector to identify anomalous columns and replace them with unified benign attention. Then, AtPatch rescales other columns to mitigate the impact of over-attention. Finally, AtPatch returns the redistributed attention map to the model for continued inference. Notably, if the detector does not report any anomalous columns, AtPatch directly returns the original attention map to the model. Unlike existing techniques, AtPatch selectively redistributes the attention map, making it better at preserving the model’s original functionality. Furthermore, AtPatch’s on-the-fly nature allows it to work without modifying model parameters or retraining, making it better suited for deployed models. We conducted extensive experiments to validate AtPatch. Experimental results show that, compared to existing methods, AtPatch can more effectively mitigate backdoor attacks and unfairness while better preserving the model’s original functionality.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 受后门攻击和不公平性影响的基于Transformer的深度神经网络(DNN)通常表现出异常的注意力模式，导致过度关注后门触发器或受保护属性。现有的神经元编辑缓解策略往往难以处理这种情况，且大多数缺乏灵活性，容易扭曲特征表示。受这种过度注意力现象以及增量调试和热补丁等软件工程范式的启发，我们提出了AtPatch，一种在模型推理过程中动态重新分配注意力图的热修复方法。具体来说，对于给定输入，AtPatch首先从模型推理过程中提取注意力图。然后，它使用预训练的检测器识别异常列，并将其替换为统一的良性注意力。接着，AtPatch重新缩放其他列以减轻过度注意力的影响。最后，AtPatch将重新分配的注意力图返回给模型以继续推理。值得注意的是，如果检测器未报告任何异常列，AtPatch会直接将原始注意力图返回给模型。与现有技术不同，AtPatch选择性地重新分配注意力图，从而更好地保留模型的原始功能。此外，AtPatch的即时性使其无需修改模型参数或重新训练即可工作，更适合已部署的模型。我们进行了大量实验来验证AtPatch。实验结果表明，与现有方法相比，AtPatch能够更有效地缓解后门攻击和不公平性，同时更好地保留模型的原始功能。

upstream_only.title: Attention Pruning: Automated Fairness Repair of Language Models via Surrogate Simulated Annealing
upstream_only.abstract: This paper explores pruning attention heads as a post-processing bias mitigation method for large language models (LLMs). As LLMs expand into sensitive social contexts, fairness concerns become crucial since these models encode and perpetuate societal biases from their training data. While modifying training datasets is prohibitive, post-processing techniques like pruning attention heads can provide feasible approaches to improve fairness. However, identifying optimal parameters to prune presents a combinatorial challenge requiring efficient solutions that balance model fairness and utility. We introduce Attention Pruning, a fairness-aware surrogate simulated annealing approach that uses surrogate deep neural networks to efficiently model the relationship between attention head states and fairness/utility metrics, enabling optimization without directly searching the massive LLM parameter space. Our experimental evaluation shows that Attention Pruning achieves up to (40\%) reduction in gender bias, outperforming the state-of-the-art.Warning: This paper contains content that some readers may find offensive and harmful.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文探索将注意力头剪枝作为大型语言模型（LLM）的后处理偏见缓解方法。随着LLM扩展到敏感的社会语境中，公平性问题变得至关重要，因为这些模型从其训练数据中编码并延续了社会偏见。虽然修改训练数据集不可行，但后处理技术（如剪枝注意力头）可以为改善公平性提供可行的方法。然而，确定要剪枝的最优参数是一个组合难题，需要高效的解决方案来平衡模型公平性与效用。我们提出注意力剪枝，一种公平感知的代理模拟退火方法，它使用代理深度神经网络来高效建模注意力头状态与公平性/效用指标之间的关系，从而无需直接搜索庞大的LLM参数空间即可进行优化。我们的实验评估表明，注意力剪枝在性别偏见方面最多可减少40%，优于当前最先进的方法。警告：本文包含部分读者可能认为具有冒犯性和有害的内容。

upstream_only.title: DNN Modularization via Activation-Driven Training
upstream_only.abstract: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) tend to accrue technical debt and suffer from significant retraining costs when adapting to evolving requirements. Modularizing DNNs offers the promise of improving their reusability. Previous work has proposed techniques to decompose DNN models into modules both during and after training. However, these strategies yield several shortcomings, including significant weight overlaps and accuracy losses across modules, restricted focus on convolutional layers only, and added complexity and training time by introducing auxiliary masks to control modularity. In this work, we propose MODA, an activation-driven modular training approach. MODA promotes inherent modularity within a DNN model by directly regulating the activation outputs of its layers based on three modular objectives: intra-class affinity, inter-class dispersion, and compactness. MODA is evaluated using three well-known DNN models and five datasets with varying sizes. This evaluation indicates that, compared to the existing state-of-the-art, using MODA yields several advantages: (1) MODA accomplishes modularization with 22\% less training time; (2) the resultant modules generated by MODA comprise up to 24x fewer weights and 37x less weight overlap while (3) preserving the original model’s accuracy without additional fine-tuning; in module replacement scenarios, (4) MODA improves the accuracy of a target class by 12\% on average while ensuring minimal impact on the accuracy of other classes.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 深度神经网络（DNN）在适应不断变化的需求时，往往会累积技术债务并承受巨大的再训练成本。对DNN进行模块化有望提高其可重用性。先前的工作提出了在训练期间和训练之后将DNN模型分解为模块的技术。然而，这些策略存在若干缺点，包括显著的权重重叠和模块间的精度损失、仅局限于卷积层、以及通过引入辅助掩码来控制模块性而增加的复杂性和训练时间。在这项工作中，我们提出了MODA，一种激活驱动的模块化训练方法。MODA通过基于三个模块化目标直接调节其层的激活输出来促进DNN模型的内在模块性：类内亲和性、类间离散性和紧凑性。MODA使用三个著名的DNN模型和五个不同大小的数据集进行评估。该评估表明，与现有最先进方法相比，使用MODA可带来若干优势：(1) MODA以少22%的训练时间实现模块化；(2) MODA生成的模块所包含的权重数量最多减少到原来的1/24，权重重叠最多减少到原来的1/37，同时(3)无需额外微调即可保持原始模型的精度；在模块替换场景中，(4) MODA将目标类的精度平均提高12%，同时确保对其他类的精度影响最小。

upstream_only.title: TypeCare: Boosting Python Type Inference Models via Context-Aware Re-Ranking and Augmentation
upstream_only.abstract: Type annotations improve Python code quality by enabling better readability, static analysis, and developer productivity. However, manually annotating existing code is labor-intensive and error-prone. While recent learning-based models have advanced automatic type inference, they struggle with rare or complex types that are underrepresented in training data.We present TypeCare, a model-agnostic post-processing technique that refines the outputs of existing type inference models using code context, without requiring retraining or fine-tuning existing models. TypeCare combines two key components: (1) Re-Ranking, which prioritizes semantically and syntactically relevant types, and (2) Augmentation, which generates additional contextually plausible candidates. Applied to three state-of-the-art type inference models—TypeT5, Tiger, and TypeGen—TypeCare consistently improves top-1 accuracy, achieving up to 40.1\% gains on complex types that existing models often fail to predict correctly.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 类型注解通过提升可读性、静态分析和开发者生产力来提高Python代码质量。然而，手动为现有代码添加注解既劳动密集又容易出错。尽管近期基于学习的模型推进了自动类型推断，但它们在训练数据中代表性不足的稀有或复杂类型上仍然表现不佳。我们提出TypeCare，一种模型无关的后处理技术，利用代码上下文细化现有类型推断模型的输出，而无需重新训练或微调现有模型。TypeCare结合两个关键组件：(1) 重排序，优先考虑语义和句法相关的类型；(2) 增强，生成额外的上下文合理的候选。将TypeCare应用于三个最先进的类型推断模型——TypeT5、Tiger和TypeGen——TypeCare持续提升top-1准确率，在现有模型常无法正确预测的复杂类型上获得高达40.1%的提升。

upstream_only.title: A Semantic-based Optimization Approach for Repairing LLMs: Case Study on Code Generation
upstream_only.abstract: Language Models (LMs) are widely used in software engineering for code generation, but they may produce erroneous code. Rather than repairing outputs, a more thorough remedy is to address underlying model failures. LM repair offers a lightweight solution: it requires minimal data, lowers computational cost, and limits side effects. Unlike full retraining, LM repair focuses on applying tailored updates to targeted neurons, making it suitable for limited resources, high-performance demands, or strict safety requirements. In this paper, we propose Semantic Targeting for Analytical Repair (STAR), a novel semantic-based optimization method for repairing LLMs. STAR realizes the main operations of repairing LMs in an optimization process, including locating “buggy neurons”, solving “neuron patches”, and patching “buggy neurons”. The neuron patches are computed with a solid semantic-based analytical formula, which directly bridges the changes to logits with the deltas of neurons, by steering latent representations. Compared to the prior work of LM repair (MINT) and standard optimization methods (SGD), STAR integrates their strengths while mitigating their limitations. By reformulating LM repair as an optimization process, STAR may solve multiple failures together, significantly improving the usefulness. Evaluated on coding tasks using popular code LMs, STAR demonstrates superior effectiveness compared with the state-of-the-art. For instance, on CoNaLa, STAR obtained 10.5\%–19.9\% improvements in ExactMatch score. Besides, STAR exhibits better efficiency, achieving an average of 2.4–7.0 times speedup in solving each model failure. In terms of side effects, namely the balance between generalization and specificity, STAR outperforms prior work by a significant margin. Additionally, we conducted assessments on the overfitting risk of LM repair as well as the cumulative impact. Further, we analyzed the differences with pipeline-based methods and explained the reason why STAR is better and how it mitigated the common limitations of LM repair.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 语言模型（LM）在软件工程中广泛用于代码生成，但可能产生错误代码。与其修复输出，更彻底的补救措施是解决潜在的模型故障。LM修复提供了一种轻量级解决方案：它需要最少的数据，降低计算成本，并限制副作用。与完全重新训练不同，LM修复侧重于对目标神经元应用定制更新，使其适用于资源有限、高性能需求或严格安全要求的情况。在本文中，我们提出了语义靶向分析修复（STAR），一种用于修复LLM的新型基于语义的优化方法。STAR在优化过程中实现了修复LM的主要操作，包括定位“有缺陷的神经元”、求解“神经元补丁”以及修补“有缺陷的神经元”。神经元补丁通过坚实的基于语义的分析公式计算，通过引导潜在表示，直接将logits的变化与神经元的增量联系起来。与先前的LM修复工作（MINT）和标准优化方法（SGD）相比，STAR整合了它们的优势，同时减轻了它们的局限性。通过将LM修复重新表述为优化过程，STAR可以一起解决多个故障，显著提高实用性。在使用流行代码LM的编码任务上评估，STAR与最先进技术相比表现出优越的有效性。例如，在CoNaLa上，STAR在ExactMatch分数上获得了10.5%–19.9%的提升。此外，STAR表现出更好的效率，在解决每个模型故障时平均加速2.4–7.0倍。在副作用方面，即泛化与特异性之间的平衡，STAR显著优于先前工作。此外，我们还评估了LM修复的过拟合风险以及累积影响。进一步，我们分析了与基于流水线方法的差异，并解释了STAR为何更好以及它如何缓解LM修复的常见局限性。

upstream_only.title: FM4MC: Improving Feature Models for Microservice Chains—Towards More Efficient Configuration and Validation
upstream_only.abstract: AI-based applications deployed as microservice chains pose challenging configuration problems, as their Feature Models (FMs) quickly grow to sizes where state-of-the-art validation approaches become infeasible. We propose FM4MC, a correctness-preserving method that validates such models efficiently by (i) slicing them into Partial Feature Models (PFMs) and (ii) applying SAT solving selectively based on estimated complexity. This combination drastically reduces the number of solver calls while retaining exact results. Our evaluation on synthetic FMs, sampled to reflect realistic heavy-tail size distributions, shows that FM4MC validates large models up to 23 {\texttimes} faster in typical scenarios, reaches speedups of more than 100 {\texttimes} , and scales in extreme cases even to 1, 000 {\texttimes} faster than state-of-the-art techniques. These results demonstrate that FM4MC makes configuration and validation feasible for microservice-based AI applications under mission-critical time constraints, where existing approaches become impractical.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 以微服务链形式部署的AI应用带来了具有挑战性的配置问题，因为其特征模型（FM）会迅速增长到最先进的验证方法不可行的规模。我们提出FM4MC，一种保持正确性的方法，通过（i）将模型切片为部分特征模型（PFM），以及（ii）基于估计的复杂度选择性地应用SAT求解，来高效地验证此类模型。这种组合在保留精确结果的同时，大幅减少了求解器调用次数。我们在合成FM上的评估（采样以反映现实的重尾尺寸分布）表明，FM4MC在典型场景下验证大型模型的速度最高可提升23倍，加速可超过100倍，在极端情况下甚至比最先进技术快1000倍。这些结果表明，FM4MC使得在任务关键型时间约束下，基于微服务的AI应用的配置与验证变得可行，而现有方法则变得不切实际。

upstream_only.title: The Hidden Cost of Readability: How Code Formatting Silently Consumes Your LLM Budget
upstream_only.abstract: Source code is usually formatted with elements like indentation and newlines to improve readability for human developers. However, these visual aids do not seem to be beneficial for large language models (LLMs) in the same way since the code is processed as a linear sequence of tokens. Furthermore, these additional tokens can lead to increased computational costs and longer response times for LLMs. If such formatting elements are non-essential to LLMs, we can reduce such costs by removing them from the code. To figure out the role played by formatting elements, we conduct a comprehensive empirical study to evaluate the impact of code formatting on LLM performance and efficiency. Through large-scale experiments on Fill-in-the-Middle Code Completion tasks across four programming languages (Java, Python, C++, C#) and ten LLMs-including both commercial and open-source models-we systematically analyze token count and performance when formatting elements are removed. Key findings indicate that LLMs can maintain performance across formatted code and unformatted code, achieving an average input token reduction of 24.5\% with negligible output token reductions. This makes code format removal a practical optimization strategy for improving LLM efficiency. Further exploration reveals that both prompting and fine-tuning LLMs can lead to significant reductions (up to 36.1\%) in output code length without compromising correctness. To facilitate practical applications, we develop a bidirectional code transformation tool for format processing, which can be seamlessly integrated into existing LLM inference workflows, ensuring both human readability and LLM efficiency.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 源代码通常通过缩进和换行等元素进行格式化，以提高人类开发者的可读性。然而，这些视觉辅助手段似乎并不以同样方式有益于大型语言模型（LLM），因为代码被处理为线性的token序列。此外，这些额外的token可能导致LLM的计算成本增加和响应时间延长。如果这些格式元素对LLM并非必需，我们可以通过从代码中移除它们来降低此类成本。为了弄清楚格式元素所起的作用，我们进行了一项全面的实证研究，评估代码格式对LLM性能和效率的影响。通过在四种编程语言（Java、Python、C++、C#）和十个LLM（包括商业和开源模型）上进行大规模Fill-in-the-Middle代码补全任务实验，我们系统地分析了移除格式元素时的token数量和性能。关键发现表明，LLM在格式化代码和未格式化代码上能够保持性能，平均输入token减少24.5%，输出token减少可忽略不计。这使得代码格式移除成为提高LLM效率的实用优化策略。进一步探索表明，提示和微调LLM都可以在不损害正确性的情况下显著减少输出代码长度（最多减少36.1%）。为了促进实际应用，我们开发了一个双向代码转换工具用于格式处理，该工具可以无缝集成到现有的LLM推理工作流中，同时确保人类可读性和LLM效率。

upstream_only.title: ModularEvo: Evolving Multi-Task Models via Neural Network Modularization and Composition
upstream_only.abstract: Training a general multi-task deep neural network (DNN) model, such as a large language model, and deploying it across diverse downstream tasks has become a common practice. In long-term deployment scenarios, downstream tasks can change over time, such as new data distributions and requirements, leading to the fine-tuning of the model accordingly, i.e., evolving the model. However, traditional full-parameter fine-tuning methods adapt the model to individual tasks, resulting in degradation of the original knowledge. Although parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods could mitigate this problem, they still isolate new knowledge in external, separate parameters. As a result, the base model gains little cumulative benefit from downstream updates. These limitations stem from the indiscriminate model deployment and fine-tuning.Inspired by modular design principles in software engineering, we propose ModularEvo, a framework that enables on-demand deployment and co-evolution of multi-task models and modules across diverse downstream tasks. ModularEvo first decomposes the model into task-specific modules, each retaining a subset of relevant weights and functionality. These modules, instead of the entire model, are deployed on downstream tasks on demand. During long-term deployment, each module is independently optimized to adjust to the change of the corresponding task. Unlike conventional fine-tuning methods, ModularEvo applies modular fine-tuning to update only the task-relevant weights within modules. Furthermore, new knowledge acquired by modules is periodically integrated into the model through model merging, enabling the co-evolution of both the model and modules.We evaluate ModularEvo through extensive experiments on three Transformer models and six downstream tasks involving both classification and generation tasks. Results demonstrate the effectiveness of ModularEvo in model performance and inference efficiency in evolution scenarios. Compared to state-of-the-art baselines, ModularEvo achieves an absolute performance gain of 2.34\% in multi-round evolution scenarios and a 2.22 times speedup in inference. In all, our work provides a new paradigm for the reuse and evolution of DNN models in the development of intelligent software applications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 训练一个通用的多任务深度神经网络（DNN）模型，例如大型语言模型，并将其部署到各种下游任务已成为常见做法。在长期部署场景中，下游任务可能随时间变化，例如新的数据分布和需求，从而导致对模型进行相应的微调，即演化模型。然而，传统的全参数微调方法使模型适应单个任务，导致原始知识退化。尽管参数高效微调方法可以缓解这一问题，但它们仍将新知识隔离在外部、独立的参数中。结果，基础模型从下游更新中获得的累积收益很少。这些局限源于不加区分的模型部署和微调。受软件工程中模块化设计原则的启发，我们提出ModularEvo，一个框架，能够在多样的下游任务中按需部署多任务模型和模块并实现共同演化。ModularEvo首先将模型分解为任务特定模块，每个模块保留相关权重和功能的子集。这些模块，而非整个模型，按需部署到下游任务上。在长期部署期间，每个模块独立优化以调整适应相应任务的变化。与传统的微调方法不同，ModularEvo应用模块化微调，仅更新模块内与任务相关的权重。此外，模块获得的新知识通过模型合并定期集成到模型中，实现模型和模块的共同演化。我们通过在三个Transformer模型和六个下游任务（涉及分类和生成任务）上的大量实验评估ModularEvo。结果表明，ModularEvo在演化场景中的模型性能和推理效率方面有效。与最先进的基线相比，ModularEvo在多轮演化场景中取得了2.34%的绝对性能提升，并在推理中实现了2.22倍的加速。总之，我们的工作为智能软件应用开发中DNN模型的重用和演化提供了一种新范式。

upstream_only.title: A First Look at Model Supply Chain: From the Risk Perspective
upstream_only.abstract: The rapid proliferation of publicly available artificial intelligence models on platforms such Hugging Face has formed a complex model supply chain, where base models are continually transformed, e.g., by fine-tuning, quantization, and merging, into new derived models. Despite its critical importance for reuse, provenance, and risk management, this supply chain remains poorly characterized at scale.We construct the first comprehensive model supply chain based on models on Hugging Face as of June 25, 2025, which consists of 1.82 million models as well as 0.54 million dependency relations. Then, we conduct the first systematic study to characterize the usage, evolution, quality, and risk of this model supply chain. Finally, we provide actionable implications for model maintainers, consumers, platform designers, and researchers to foster this new direction in the era of AI.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 公开可用的人工智能模型在 Hugging Face 等平台上的迅速激增，形成了一个复杂的模型供应链，其中基础模型通过微调、量化和合并等方式不断被转化为新的衍生模型。尽管该供应链对复用、溯源和风险管理至关重要，但其在大规模上仍缺乏刻画。我们构建了首个基于截至2025年6月25日 Hugging Face 上模型的全面模型供应链，包含182万个模型以及54万条依赖关系。然后，我们开展了首个系统性研究，刻画该模型供应链的使用、演化、质量和风险。最后，我们为模型维护者、消费者、平台设计者和研究人员提供了可操作的建议，以推动 AI 时代的这一新方向。

upstream_only.title: PreServe: Intelligent Management for LMaaS Systems via Hierarchical Prediction
upstream_only.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized numerous domains, driving the rise of Language-Model-as-a-Service (LMaaS) platforms that process millions of queries daily. These platforms must minimize latency and meet Service Level Objectives (SLOs) while optimizing resource usage. However, conventional cloud service management techniques, designed for traditional workloads, are suboptimal for LMaaS due to its dynamic service workloads and variable request loads. To address this, we propose nm, a tailored LMaaS management framework centered on hierarchical prediction. nmincorporates a service workload predictor to estimate periodic token density at a coarse granularity and a novel request load predictor to assess the resource demand of individual LLM requests, enabling the construction of a load anticipator for each LLM instance. By integrating both long-term and short-term predictions, nmadjusts resource allocation in advance, mitigating the risks of instance under- or over-provisioning. Besides, nmoptimizes request routing by considering both current and anticipated future instance loads, ensuring balanced load distribution across instances. Evaluations on real-world production datasets show that nmoutperforms state-of-the-art methods, reducing tail latency by 41.3\%, cutting resource consumption by 49.38\%, while incurring only 0.23\% additional overhead.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）已革新众多领域，推动了语言模型即服务（LMaaS）平台的兴起，这些平台每天处理数百万次查询。这些平台必须最小化延迟并满足服务水平目标（SLO），同时优化资源使用。然而，为传统工作负载设计的传统云服务管理技术对LMaaS而言并非最优，因为其服务负载动态变化且请求负载多变。为解决这一问题，我们提出了nm，一个以分层预测为核心的定制化LMaaS管理框架。nm包含一个服务工作负载预测器，以粗粒度估计周期性token密度，以及一个新颖的请求负载预测器，用于评估单个LLM请求的资源需求，从而为每个LLM实例构建负载预测器。通过整合长期和短期预测，nm提前调整资源分配，降低实例配置不足或过度配置的风险。此外，nm通过同时考虑当前和预期的未来实例负载来优化请求路由，确保实例间的负载均衡。在真实生产数据集上的评估表明，nm优于最先进的方法，将尾部延迟降低41.3%，减少资源消耗49.38%，而仅增加0.23%的额外开销。

upstream_only.title: AgentSpec: Customizable Runtime Enforcement for Safe and Reliable LLM Agents
upstream_only.abstract: Agents built on LLMs are increasingly deployed across diverse domains, automating complex decision-making and task execution. However, their autonomy introduces safety risks, including security vulnerabilities, legal violations, and unintended harmful actions. Existing mitigation methods, such as model-based safeguards and early enforcement strategies, fall short in robustness, interpretability, and adaptability. To address these challenges, we propose AgentSpec, a lightweight domain-specific language for specifying and enforcing runtime constraints on LLM agents. With AgentSpec, users define structured rules that incorporate triggers, predicates, and enforcement mechanisms, ensuring agents operate within predefined safety boundaries. We implement AgentSpec across multiple domains, including code execution, embodied agents, and autonomous driving, demonstrating its adaptability and effectiveness. Our evaluation shows that AgentSpec successfully prevents unsafe executions in over 90\% of code agent cases, eliminates all hazardous actions in embodied agent tasks, and enforces 100\% compliance by autonomous vehicles (AVs). Despite its strong safety guarantees, AgentSpec remains computationally lightweight, with overheads in milliseconds. By combining interpretability, modularity, and efficiency, AgentSpec provides a practical and scalable solution for enforcing LLM agent safety across diverse applications. We also automate the generation of rules using LLMs and assess their effectiveness. Our evaluation shows that the rules generated by OpenAI o1 achieve a precision of 95.56\% and recall of 70.96\% for embodied agents, successfully identify 87.26\% of the risky code, and prevent AVs from breaking laws in 5 out of 8 scenarios.
