upstream_only.abstract_zh: 基于LLM的智能体正日益广泛地部署于各个领域，自动化复杂的决策制定和任务执行。然而，它们的自主性引入了安全风险，包括安全漏洞、法律违规和意外有害行为。现有的缓解方法，如基于模型的防护和早期执行策略，在鲁棒性、可解释性和适应性方面存在不足。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了AgentSpec，一种轻量级的领域特定语言，用于指定和强制执行LLM智能体的运行时约束。借助AgentSpec，用户定义结构化规则，这些规则包含触发器、谓词和执行机制，确保智能体在预定义的安全边界内运行。我们在多个领域实现了AgentSpec，包括代码执行、具身智能体和自动驾驶，展示了其适应性和有效性。我们的评估表明，AgentSpec成功阻止了超过90%的代码智能体案例中的不安全执行，消除了具身智能体任务中的所有危险行为，并使自动驾驶车辆（AV）实现100%合规。尽管具有强大的安全保障，AgentSpec在计算上仍然轻量，开销仅为毫秒级。通过结合可解释性、模块化和效率，AgentSpec为在不同应用中强制执行LLM智能体安全提供了一种实用且可扩展的解决方案。我们还使用LLM自动生成规则并评估其有效性。评估显示，OpenAI o1生成的规则在具身智能体上达到了95.56%的精确率和70.96%的召回率，成功识别了87.26%的风险代码，并防止AV在8个场景中的5个中违法。

upstream_only.title: Aligning Requirement for Large Language Model's Code Generation
upstream_only.abstract: Code generation refers to the automatic generation of source code based on a given programming specification, which has garnered significant attention particularly with the advancement of large language models (LLMs). However, due to the inherent complexity of real-world problems, the LLM-generated code often fails to fully align with the provided specification. While state-of-the-art agent-based techniques have been proposed to enhance LLM code generation, they overlook the critical issue of specification perception, resulting in persistent misalignment issues. Given that accurate perception of programming specifications serves as the foundation of the LLM-based code generation paradigm, ensuring specification alignment is particularly crucial. In this work, we draw on software requirements engineering to propose Specine, a novel specification alignment technique for LLM code generation. Its key idea is to identify misaligned input specifications, lift LLM-perceived specifications, and align them to enhance the code generation performance of LLMs. Our comprehensive experiments on four state-of-the-art LLMs across five challenging competitive benchmarks by comparing with ten state-of-the-art baselines, demonstrate the effectiveness of Specine. For example, Specine outperforms the most effective baseline, achieving an average improvement of 29.60\% across all subjects in terms of Pass@1.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 代码生成是指根据给定的编程规范自动生成源代码，随着大型语言模型（LLM）的进步，这一领域受到了广泛关注。然而，由于现实世界问题的内在复杂性，LLM生成的代码往往无法完全符合所提供的规范。尽管已提出最先进的基于智能体的技术来增强LLM代码生成，但它们忽视了规范感知这一关键问题，导致持续的对齐错误。鉴于准确感知编程规范是基于LLM的代码生成范式的基础，确保规范对齐尤为关键。在这项工作中，我们借鉴软件需求工程，提出了Specine，一种新颖的用于LLM代码生成的规范对齐技术。其核心思想是识别未对齐的输入规范，提升LLM感知到的规范，并对齐它们以增强LLM的代码生成性能。我们在四个最先进的LLM上、跨越五个具有挑战性的竞赛基准，并与十个最先进的基线进行比较，全面的实验证明了Specine的有效性。例如，Specine超越了最有效的基线，在所有受试对象上以Pass@1指标平均提升29.60%。

upstream_only.title: Evaluating the effectiveness of LLM-based interoperability
upstream_only.abstract: Background: Systems of systems are becoming increasingly dynamic and heterogeneous, and this adds pressure on the long-standing challenge of interoperability. Besides its technical aspect, interoperability has also an economic side, as development time efforts are required to build the interoperability artifacts. Objectives: With the recent advances in the field of large language models (LLMs), we aim at analyzing the effectiveness of LLM-based strategies to make systems interoperate autonomously, at runtime, without human intervention. Method: We selected 13 open source LLMs and curated four versions of a dataset in a concrete interoperability use case. We performed three runs of each model with each version of the dataset, using two different strategies. Then we compared the effectiveness of the models and the consistency of their results across multiple runs. Results: qwen2.5-coder:32b  was the most effective model using both strategies DIRECT (average pass@1 ≥ 0.99) and CODEGEN (average pass@1 ≥ 0.89) in three out of four dataset versions. In the fourth dataset version, which included an unit conversion, all models using the strategy DIRECT failed, whereas using CODEGEN qwen2.5-coder:32b  succeeded with an average pass@1 = 0.75. Conclusion: Some LLMs can make systems interoperate autonomously. Further evaluation in different domains is recommended, and further research on reliability strategies should be conducted.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 背景：系统之系统正变得越来越动态和异构，这加剧了互操作性这一长期挑战的压力。除了技术层面，互操作性也有经济层面，因为构建互操作性工件需要投入开发时间。目标：随着大语言模型（LLM）领域的最新进展，我们旨在分析基于LLM的策略在运行时无需人工干预地使系统自主互操作的有效性。方法：我们选择了13个开源LLM，并针对一个具体的互操作性用例整理了数据集的四个版本。我们使用两种不同策略，对每个模型和每个数据集版本进行了三次运行。然后，我们比较了模型的有效性及其多次运行结果的一致性。结果：qwen2.5-coder:32b 在使用 DIRECT（平均 pass@1 ≥ 0.99）和 CODEGEN（平均 pass@1 ≥ 0.89）两种策略时，在四个数据集版本中的三个里都是最有效的模型。在第四个数据集版本中（包含单位转换），所有使用 DIRECT 策略的模型都失败了，而使用 CODEGEN 时 qwen2.5-coder:32b 成功，平均 pass@1 = 0.75。结论：一些LLM可以使系统自主互操作。建议在不同领域进行进一步评估，并且应进一步研究可靠性策略。

upstream_only.title: Checking Unsupervised Learning for Nondeterminism and Inconsistency via SMT Solving
upstream_only.abstract: Unsupervised Learning (UL) implementations are widely used, but prone to issues such as nondeterminism and inconsistency, which makes them unreliable and exploitable. Moreover, the lack of a specification (or ground truth) makes UL implementations hard to verify or test: when they produce diverging results on a dataset, they do so subtly and silently, which gives users a false sense of security, and complicates developers’ job of tracing the error to its root cause. We introduce an approach, Ocelot, that reduces nondeterminism/inconsistency checking to satisfiability checking in Z3. Given the Python code of an UL implementation, Ocelot automatically isolates a nondeterministic “kernel” (variables and code), which forms the basis for a Z3 specification. A Z3-found solution acts as a “witness” dataset – a typically small dataset that can be used to reliably reproduce the error. Ocelot has exposed sources of nondeterminism and inconsistency in popular implementations (Scikit-learn, MATLAB, and R) of well-known Clustering algorithms (Affinity Propagation, DBSCAN, HAC, and K-means) and Anomaly Detection algorithms (Isolation Forest, Local Outlier Factor). Moreover, Ocelot has exposed regressions (changes in semantics) in the evolution of these implementations.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 无监督学习（UL）实现被广泛使用，但容易出现非确定性和不一致性等问题，这使得它们不可靠且可被利用。此外，缺乏规范（或真实基准）使得UL实现难以验证或测试：当它们在数据集上产生分歧结果时，这种分歧是微妙且无声的，给用户一种虚假的安全感，并使开发者追溯错误根本原因的工作复杂化。我们引入了一种方法Ocelot，它将非确定性/不一致性检查归约为Z3中的可满足性检查。给定UL实现的Python代码，Ocelot自动分离出一个非确定性的“内核”（变量和代码），这构成了Z3规范的基础。Z3找到的解充当“见证”数据集——一个通常很小的数据集，可用于可靠地重现错误。Ocelot已经在知名聚类算法（Affinity Propagation、DBSCAN、HAC和K-means）和异常检测算法（Isolation Forest、Local Outlier Factor）的流行实现（Scikit-learn、MATLAB和R）中暴露了非确定性和不一致性的来源。此外，Ocelot在这些实现的演化过程中暴露了回归（语义变化）。

upstream_only.title: Imitation Game: Reproducing Deep Learning Bugs Leveraging an Intelligent Agent
upstream_only.abstract: Despite their wide adoption in various domains (e.g., healthcare, finance, software engineering), Deep Learning (DL)-based applications suffer from many bugs, failures, and vulnerabilities. Reproducing these bugs is essential for their resolution, but it is extremely challenging due to the inherent nondeterminism of DL models and their tight coupling with hardware and software environments. According to recent studies, only about 3\% of DL bugs can be reliably reproduced using manual approaches. To address these challenges, we present RepGen, a novel, automated, and intelligent approach for reproducing deep learning bugs. RepGen constructs a learning-enhanced context from a project, develops a comprehensive plan for bug reproduction, employs an iterative generate-validate-refine mechanism, and thus generates such code using an LLM that reproduces the bug at hand. We evaluate RepGen on 106 real-world deep learning bugs and achieve a reproduction rate of 80.19\%, a 19.81\% improvement over the state-of-the-art measure. A developer study involving 27 participants shows that RepGen improves the success rate of DL bug reproduction by 23.35\%, reduces the time to reproduce by 56.8\%, and lowers participants’ cognitive load.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 尽管深度学习（DL）应用在医疗、金融、软件工程等多个领域被广泛采用，但它们仍存在许多缺陷、故障和漏洞。复现这些缺陷对于解决它们至关重要，但由于深度学习模型固有的非确定性及其与硬件和软件环境的紧密耦合，复现极具挑战性。根据近期研究，只有约3%的深度学习缺陷能够通过人工方法可靠复现。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了RepGen，一种新颖、自动化且智能的深度学习缺陷复现方法。RepGen从项目中构建学习增强的上下文，制定全面的缺陷复现计划，采用迭代的生成-验证-精炼机制，从而使用LLM生成能够复现当前缺陷的代码。我们在106个真实世界的深度学习缺陷上评估了RepGen，实现了80.19%的复现率，比最先进方法提高了19.81%。一项涉及27名参与者的开发者研究表明，RepGen将深度学习缺陷复现的成功率提高了23.35%，将复现时间减少了56.8%，并降低了参与者的认知负荷。

upstream_only.title: Beyond Correctness: Exposing LLM-generated Logical Flaws in Reasoning via Multi-step Automated Theorem Proving
upstream_only.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive reasoning capabilities, leading to their adoption in high-stakes domains such as healthcare, law, and scientific research. However, their reasoning often contains subtle logical errors masked by fluent language, posing significant risks for critical applications. While existing approaches like fact-checking, self-consistency methods, and rule-based validation provide partial solutions, they fail to detect complex logical flaws in multi-step reasoning.To overcome these challenges, we present MATP, an evaluation framework for systematically verifying LLM reasoning via Multi-step Automatic Theorem Proving. MATP translates natural language reasoning into First-Order Logic (FOL) and applies automated theorem provers to assess step-by-step logical validity. This approach identifies hidden logical errors and provides fine-grained classifications of reasoning correctness. Evaluations on a benchmark comprising 10,830 reasoning instances generated by 10 LLMs across tasks from PrOntoQA-OOD, ProofWriter, and FOLIO show that MATP surpasses prompting-based baselines by over 42 percentage points in reasoning step verification. It further reveals model-level disparities, with reasoning models generating more logically coherent outputs than general models. These results demonstrate MATP’s potential to enhance the trustworthiness of LLM-generated reasoning.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）已展现出令人印象深刻的推理能力，因而被应用于医疗、法律和科学研究等高风险领域。然而，其推理常包含被流畅语言掩盖的细微逻辑错误，给关键应用带来重大风险。尽管事实核查、自一致性方法和基于规则的验证等现有方法提供了部分解决方案，但它们无法检测多步推理中的复杂逻辑缺陷。为克服这些挑战，我们提出MATP，一个通过多步自动定理证明系统验证LLM推理的评估框架。MATP将自然语言推理转换为一阶逻辑（FOL），并应用自动定理证明器逐步评估逻辑有效性。该方法能识别隐藏的逻辑错误，并提供细粒度的推理正确性分类。对由10个LLM在PrOntoQA-OOD、ProofWriter和FOLIO任务上生成的10,830个推理实例组成的基准进行评估，MATP在推理步骤验证上比基于提示的基线高出超过42个百分点。它还揭示了模型层面的差异：推理模型比通用模型生成逻辑上更连贯的输出。这些结果表明MATP在增强LLM生成推理可信度方面的潜力。

upstream_only.title: Comfrey: Mitigating Integration Failures in LLM-enabled Software at Run-Time
upstream_only.abstract: Due to the unrestricted outputs of LLMs and strict requirements of software components, integration failures are widespread in software that incorporates LLM agents and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Even seemingly correct LLM/RAG responses can trigger software misbehaviors if they violate these requirements.In this paper, we conduct an empirical study to understand integration failures in real-world LLM-enabled applications. Guided by this study, we present Comfrey  [104], a runtime framework that adapts the LLM agent and RAG responses to meet software requirements, serving as a middle layer between AI and software components. It automatically detects and resolves potential integration failures through a three-stage workflow, ensuring component compatibility. Our evaluation with a variety of open-source applications demonstrates that Comfrey detects 75.1\% and prevents 63.3\% of potential integration failures with 8.4\% overhead, significantly outperforming the baselines.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 由于LLM输出不受限制而软件组件又有严格要求，在集成LLM代理和检索增强生成（RAG）的软件中，集成故障十分普遍。即使看似正确的LLM/RAG响应，如果违反这些要求，也可能引发软件行为异常。在本文中，我们开展了一项实证研究，以理解真实世界LLM赋能应用中的集成故障。在此研究指导下，我们提出Comfrey [104]，一个运行时框架，它调整LLM代理和RAG响应以满足软件要求，充当AI与软件组件之间的中间层。它通过三阶段工作流自动检测并解决潜在的集成故障，确保组件兼容性。我们使用多种开源应用进行的评估表明，Comfrey以8.4%的开销检测出75.1%并阻止了63.3%的潜在集成故障，显著优于基线。

upstream_only.title: MazeBreaker: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Jailbreaking of LLM Security Defenses
upstream_only.abstract: In recent years, the application of Large Language Models (LLMs) has become increasingly widespread, along with growing concerns about their security. To assess the security of LLMs, researchers have proposed various jailbreak attack algorithms, but only rely on the models’ internal information or face limitations in exploring the unsafe behavior, highlighting the need for a more adaptive and generalizable approach. Inspired by the game of rats escaping a maze, we introduce a novel jailbreak attack approach, MazeBreaker, where attackers dynamically learn to find the exit based on feedback and their accumulated experience to compromise the target LLMs’ security defenses. Our method is the first to systematically learn from the feedback of attack attempts on target LLMs through a multi-agent reinforcement learning system, enabling strategic exploration of the model’s unsafe boundaries without a reference oracle. We compared our approach with six state-of-the-art jailbreak attack methods, testing it on 13 different architectures of open-source and commercial models. The results show that our method performs exceptionally well in terms of attack effectiveness, especially for the commercial models (GPT-3.5-turbo, GPT-4o-mini, GLM-4-air, and Claude-3.5-sonnet) with strong safety alignment. We hope this study will help academia and industry better test the security of large language models and promote adherence to safety and ethical standards. Code and data are available on our repository: https://github.com/SMAT-Lab/MazeBreaker .
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 近年来，大型语言模型（LLMs）的应用日益广泛，其安全性也引发了越来越多的担忧。为了评估LLMs的安全性，研究人员提出了各种越狱攻击算法，但这些方法要么仅依赖模型的内部信息，要么在探索不安全行为方面存在局限，凸显了对更具适应性和通用性的方法的需求。受老鼠逃出迷宫游戏的启发，我们提出了一种新颖的越狱攻击方法MazeBreaker，攻击者根据反馈和积累的经验动态学习寻找出口，以攻破目标LLMs的安全防御。我们的方法是首个通过多智能体强化学习系统从目标LLMs的攻击尝试反馈中进行系统性学习的方法，能够在没有参考预言机的情况下对模型的不安全边界进行策略性探索。我们将我们的方法与六种最先进的越狱攻击方法进行了比较，并在13种不同架构的开源和商业模型上进行了测试。结果表明，我们的方法在攻击有效性方面表现尤为出色，尤其是对具有强大安全对齐的商业模型（GPT-3.5-turbo、GPT-4o-mini、GLM-4-air和Claude-3.5-sonnet）。我们希望这项研究能帮助学术界和工业界更好地测试大型语言模型的安全性，并促进对安全和伦理标准的遵守。代码和数据可在我们的仓库获取：https://github.com/SMAT-Lab/MazeBreaker 。

upstream_only.title: Smoke and Mirrors: Jailbreaking LLM-based Code Generation via Implicit Malicious Prompts
upstream_only.abstract: The proliferation of Large Language Models (LLMs) has revolutionized natural language processing and significantly impacted code generation tasks, enhancing software development efficiency and productivity. Notably, LLMs like GPT-4 have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in text-to-code generation tasks. However, the growing reliance on LLMs for code generation necessitates a critical examination of the safety implications associated with their outputs. Existing research efforts have primarily focused on verifying the functional correctness of LLMs, overlooking their safety in code generation. This paper introduces a jailbreaking approach, CodeJailbreaker, designed to uncover safety concerns in LLM-based code generation. The basic observation is that existing safety mechanisms for LLMs are built through the instruction-following paradigm, where malicious intent is explicitly articulated within the instruction of the prompt. Consequently, CodeJailbreaker explores to construct a prompt whose instruction is benign and the malicious intent is implicitly encoded in a covert channel, i.e., the commit message, to bypass the safety mechanism. Experiments on the recently-released RMCBench benchmark demonstrate that CodeJailbreaker markedly surpasses the conventional jailbreaking strategy, which explicitly conveys malicious intents in the instructions, in terms of the attack effectiveness across three code generation tasks. This study challenges the traditional safety paradigms in LLM-based code generation, emphasizing the need for enhanced safety measures in safeguarding against implicit malicious cues.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的激增已经革新了自然语言处理，并显著影响了代码生成任务，提高了软件开发的效率和生产力。值得注意的是，像GPT-4这样的LLM在文本到代码生成任务中表现出了非凡的能力。然而，对LLM代码生成的日益依赖要求对其输出相关的安全影响进行批判性审视。现有的研究工作主要关注验证LLM的功能正确性，而忽视了其在代码生成中的安全性。本文介绍了一种越狱方法CodeJailbreaker，旨在揭示基于LLM的代码生成中的安全问题。基本观察是，现有的LLM安全机制是通过指令遵循范式构建的，其中恶意意图在提示的指令中被明确表达。因此，CodeJailbreaker探索构造一种提示，其指令是良性的，而恶意意图被隐式编码在一个隐蔽通道中，即提交消息，以绕过安全机制。在最近发布的RMCBench基准上的实验表明，CodeJailbreaker在三个代码生成任务中的攻击有效性上显著超越了传统越狱策略，后者在指令中明确传达恶意意图。这项研究挑战了基于LLM的代码生成中的传统安全范式，强调需要增强安全措施以防范隐式恶意线索。

upstream_only.title: Why Attention Fails: A Taxonomy of Faults in Attention-Based Neural Networks
upstream_only.abstract: Attention mechanisms are at the core of modern neural architectures, powering systems ranging from ChatGPT to autonomous vehicles, and driving a major economic impact. However, high-profile failures, such as ChatGPT’s nonsensical outputs or Google’s suspension of Gemini’s image generation due to attention weight errors, highlight a critical gap: existing deep learning fault taxonomies might not adequately capture the unique failures introduced by attention mechanisms. This gap leaves practitioners without actionable diagnostic guidance. To address this gap, we present the first comprehensive empirical study of faults in attention-based neural networks (ABNNs). Our work is based on a systematic analysis of 555 real-world faults collected from 96 projects across ten frameworks, including GitHub, Hugging Face, and Stack Overflow. Through our analysis, we develop a novel taxonomy comprising seven attention-specific fault categories, not captured by existing work. Our results show that over half of the ABNN faults arise from mechanisms unique to attention architectures. We further analyze the root causes and manifestations of these faults through various symptoms. Finally, by analyzing symptom–root cause associations, we identify four evidence-based diagnostic heuristics that explain 33.0\% of attention-specific faults and provide systematic, taxonomy-driven guidance for diagnosing faults in ABNNs.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 注意力机制是现代神经网络架构的核心，驱动着从ChatGPT到自动驾驶汽车的各种系统，并产生了重大的经济影响。然而，备受瞩目的失败——例如ChatGPT的无意义输出，或Google因注意力权重错误而暂停Gemini的图像生成——突显了一个关键空白：现有的深度学习故障分类法可能无法充分捕捉由注意力机制引入的独特故障。这一空白使从业者缺乏可操作的诊断指导。为了弥补这一空白，我们提出了首个针对基于注意力的神经网络（ABNNs）中故障的全面实证研究。我们的工作基于对从GitHub、Hugging Face和Stack Overflow等十个框架的96个项目中收集的555个真实世界故障的系统分析。通过分析，我们开发了一个新颖的分类体系，包含七个注意力特有的故障类别，这是现有工作所未捕捉的。我们的结果表明，超过一半的ABNN故障源于注意力架构独有的机制。我们进一步通过各种症状分析这些故障的根本原因和表现形式。最后，通过分析症状与根本原因之间的关联，我们识别出四条基于证据的诊断启发式规则，它们解释了33.0%的注意力特有故障，并为诊断ABNNs中的故障提供了系统的、分类体系驱动的指导。

upstream_only.title: Revisiting "Revisiting Neuron Coverage for DNN Testing: A Layer-Wise and Distribution-Aware Criterion": A Critical Review and Implications on DNN Coverage Testing
upstream_only.abstract: We present a critical review of Neural Coverage (NLC), a state-of-the-art DNN coverage criterion by Yuan et al. at ICSE 2023. While NLC proposes to satisfy eight design requirements and demonstrates strong empirical performance, we question some of their theoretical and empirical assumptions. We observe that NLC deviates from core principles of coverage criteria, such as monotonicity and test suite order independence, and could more fully account for key properties of the covariance matrix. Additionally, we note threats to the validity of the empirical study, related to the ground truth ordering of test suites. Through our empirical validation, we substantiate our claims and propose improvements for future DNN coverage metrics. Finally, we conclude by discussing the implications of these insights.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们对Yuan等人在ICSE 2023上提出的最先进的DNN覆盖准则——神经覆盖（NLC）进行了批判性回顾。虽然NLC提出满足八项设计要求并展示了强大的实证性能，但我们对其一些理论和实证假设提出了质疑。我们观察到NLC偏离了覆盖准则的核心原则，如单调性和测试套件顺序独立性，并且未能更充分地考虑协方差矩阵的关键属性。此外，我们注意到与测试套件的地面真值排序相关的实证研究有效性威胁。通过我们的实证验证，我们证实了我们的主张，并为未来的DNN覆盖指标提出了改进建议。最后，我们讨论了这些见解的启示。

upstream_only.title: Training on Clean Data but Getting Backdoored Models! A Poisoning Attack on Code Encoders
upstream_only.abstract: Transformer-based code encoders like CodeBERT learn general knowledge from vast amounts of unlabeled source code. These encoders can convert input code into meaningful representations (i.e., code embeddings) and support a series of downstream tasks. Specifically, users can fine-tune a code encoder on certain datasets and obtain strong model performance on corresponding tasks. Recent studies have exposed critical security vulnerabilities in this widely-adopted paradigm: attackers can inject backdoors into models by poisoning the fine-tuning datasets with carefully crafted triggers (e.g., dead code snippets), causing the model to produce attacker-specified outputs when these triggers are present.However, backdoor attacks rely on a strong and often unrealistic assumption: attackers can directly poison the fine-tuning data and developers will unknowingly use these compromised datasets. It motivates us to propose a novel method and expose a new stealthy backdoor attack scenario: attackers can directly poison and release poisoned encoders; even when users fine-tune the poisoned encoder on clean datasets, the obtained model inherits the backdoor! This method bypasses the aforementioned unrealistic assumption and is thus easier to operate. Additionally, it fundamentally undermines existing defenses that focus on detecting user-side data poisoning as the latter does not happen at all. As a proof-of-concept, we evaluate the proposed attack on three popular pre-trained models across three software engineering tasks. Experiments show that the attack is both (1) effective: the average attack success rate can reach 91.62\% and (2) stealthy: the decrease in model performance is 1.26\%, unnoticeable by users. We additionally show that existing popular defenses cannot alarm the users when triggers appear in model inputs. These findings expose a critical blind spot in pre-trained code models and highlight the urgent need for automated defenses.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 基于Transformer的代码编码器（如CodeBERT）从大量无标签源代码中学习通用知识。这些编码器可以将输入代码转换为有意义的表示（即代码嵌入），并支持一系列下游任务。具体而言，用户可以在特定数据集上微调代码编码器，并在相应任务上获得强大的模型性能。近期研究揭示了这一广泛采用的范式中的严重安全漏洞：攻击者可以通过用精心设计的触发器（例如死代码片段）污染微调数据集，从而向模型中注入后门，使模型在出现这些触发器时产生攻击者指定的输出。然而，后门攻击依赖于一个很强且往往不现实的假设：攻击者能够直接污染微调数据，而开发者会在不知情的情况下使用这些受污染的数据集。这促使我们提出一种新方法，并揭示一种新的隐蔽后门攻击场景：攻击者可以直接污染并发布受污染的编码器；即使用户在干净数据集上微调受污染的编码器，所获得的模型也会继承后门！该方法绕过了上述不现实的假设，因此更容易实施。此外，它从根本上破坏了现有防御，因为现有防御主要关注检测用户侧的数据投毒，而后者根本没有发生。作为概念验证，我们在三个软件工程任务上对三个流行的预训练模型评估了所提出的攻击。实验表明，该攻击既(1)有效：平均攻击成功率可达91.62%，又(2)隐蔽：模型性能仅下降1.26%，用户难以察觉。我们还进一步表明，当触发器出现在模型输入中时，现有流行防御无法向用户发出警报。这些发现暴露了预训练代码模型中的一个关键盲点，并凸显了对自动化防御的迫切需求。

upstream_only.title: SpecOps: A Fully Automated AI Agent Testing Framework in Real-World GUI Environments
upstream_only.abstract: Autonomous AI agents powered by large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, where reliable and robust behavior is critical. However, existing agent evaluation frameworks either rely heavily on manual efforts, operate within simulated environments, or lack focus on testing complex, multimodal, real-world agents. We introduce SpecOps, a novel, fully automated testing framework designed to evaluate GUI-based AI agents in real-world environments. SpecOps decomposes the testing process into four specialized phases—test case generation, environment setup, test execution, and validation—each handled by a distinct LLM-based specialist agent. This structured architecture addresses key challenges including end-to-end task coherence, robust error handling, and adaptability across diverse agent platforms including CLI tools, web apps, and browser extensions. In comprehensive evaluations across five diverse real-world agents, SpecOps outperforms baselines including general-purpose agentic systems such as AutoGPT and LLM-crafted automation scripts in planning accuracy, execution success, and bug detection effectiveness. SpecOps identifies 164 true bugs in the real-world agents with an F1 score of 0.89. With a cost of under $0.73 and a runtime of under eight minutes per test, it demonstrates its practical viability and superiority in automated, real-world agent testing.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的自主AI智能体越来越多地部署在现实世界应用中，在这些场景中可靠和稳健的行为至关重要。然而，现有的智能体评估框架要么严重依赖人工努力，要么在模拟环境中运行，要么缺乏对测试复杂的、多模态的真实世界智能体的关注。我们提出SpecOps，一种新颖的全自动测试框架，旨在评估现实世界环境中基于GUI的AI智能体。SpecOps将测试过程分解为四个专门阶段——测试用例生成、环境搭建、测试执行和验证——每个阶段由不同的基于LLM的专用智能体处理。这种结构化架构解决了关键挑战，包括端到端任务一致性、稳健的错误处理，以及对包括CLI工具、Web应用和浏览器扩展在内的多样智能体平台的适应性。在跨五个多样真实世界智能体的全面评估中，SpecOps在规划准确性、执行成功率和缺陷检测有效性方面优于基线，包括AutoGPT等通用智能体系统和LLM编写的自动化脚本。SpecOps在真实世界智能体中识别出164个真实缺陷，F1分数为0.89。每次测试成本低于0.73美元，运行时间低于八分钟，展示了其在自动化、真实世界智能体测试中的实际可行性和优越性。

upstream_only.title: SustainDiffusion: Optimising the Social and Environmental Sustainability of Stable Diffusion Models
upstream_only.abstract: Background: Text-to-image generation models are widely used across numerous domains. Among these models, Stable Diffusion (SD) – an open-source text-to-image generation model – has become the most popular, producing over 12 billion images annually. However, the widespread use of these models raises concerns regarding their social and environmental sustainability. Aims: To reduce the harm that SD models may have on society and the environment, we introduce SustainDiffusion, a search-based approach designed to enhance the social and environmental sustainability of SD models. Method: SustainDiffusion searches the optimal combination of hyperparameters and prompt structures that can reduce gender and ethnic bias in generated images while also lowering the energy consumption required for image generation. Importantly, SustainDiffusion maintains image quality comparable to that of the original SD model. Results: We conduct a comprehensive empirical evaluation of SustainDiffusion, testing it against six different baselines using 56 different prompts. Our results demonstrate that SustainDiffusion can reduce gender bias in SD3 by 68\%, ethnic bias by 59\%, and energy consumption (calculated as the sum of CPU and GPU energy) by 48\%. Additionally, the outcomes produced by SustainDiffusion are consistent across multiple runs and can be generalised to various prompts depicting human-like figures in different tasks. Conclusions: With SustainDiffusion, we demonstrate how enhancing the social and environmental sustainability of text-to-image generation models is possible without fine-tuning or changing the model’s architecture.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 背景：文本到图像生成模型被广泛应用于众多领域。在这些模型中，Stable Diffusion（SD）——一个开源文本到图像生成模型——已成为最受欢迎的模型，每年生成超过120亿张图像。然而，这些模型的广泛使用引发了对其社会和环境可持续性的担忧。目标：为了减少SD模型可能对社会和环境造成的危害，我们提出了SustainDiffusion，一种基于搜索的方法，旨在增强SD模型的社会和环境可持续性。方法：SustainDiffusion搜索超参数和提示结构的最佳组合，以减少生成图像中的性别和种族偏见，同时降低图像生成所需的能耗。重要的是，SustainDiffusion保持了与原始SD模型相当的图像质量。结果：我们对SustainDiffusion进行了全面的实证评估，使用56种不同的提示将其与六个基线进行了测试。结果表明，SustainDiffusion可以将SD3中的性别偏见减少68%，种族偏见减少59%，能耗（按CPU和GPU能耗之和计算）减少48%。此外，SustainDiffusion产生的结果在多次运行中保持一致，并且可以推广到不同任务中描绘类人形象的各种提示。结论：通过SustainDiffusion，我们展示了如何在不微调或改变模型架构的情况下，增强文本到图像生成模型的社会和环境可持续性。

upstream_only.title: Toward Systematic Counterfactual Fairness Evaluation of Large Language Models: The CAFFE Framework
upstream_only.abstract: Nowadays, Large Language Models (LLMs) are foundational components of modern software systems. As their influence grows, concerns about fairness have become increasingly pressing. Prior work has proposed metamorphic testing to detect fairness issues, applying input transformations to uncover inconsistencies in model behavior. This paper introduces an alternative perspective for testing counterfactual fairness in LLMs, proposing a structured and intent-aware framework coined CAFFE (Counterfactual Assessment Framework for Fairness Evaluation). Inspired by traditional non-functional testing, CAFFE (1) formalizes LLM-Fairness test cases through explicitly defined components, including prompt intent, conversational context, input variants, expected fairness thresholds, and test environment configuration, (2) assists testers by automatically generating targeted test data, and (3) evaluates model responses using semantic similarity metrics. Our experiments, conducted on three different architectural families of LLM, demonstrate that CAFFE achieves broader bias coverage and more reliable detection of unfair behavior than existing metamorphic approaches.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 如今，大型语言模型（LLM）已成为现代软件系统的基础组件。随着其影响力的增长，对公平性的担忧日益迫切。先前的工作提出了蜕变测试来检测公平性问题，通过输入变换来揭示模型行为的不一致性。本文引入了一种测试LLM反事实公平性的替代视角，提出了一个结构化且意图感知的框架，命名为CAFFE（公平性评估的反事实评估框架）。受传统非功能测试的启发，CAFFE (1) 通过明确定义的组件形式化LLM公平性测试用例，包括提示意图、对话上下文、输入变体、预期公平性阈值和测试环境配置；(2) 通过自动生成有针对性的测试数据来辅助测试人员；(3) 使用语义相似度指标评估模型响应。我们在三个不同架构系列的LLM上进行的实验表明，与现有的蜕变方法相比，CAFFE实现了更广泛的偏差覆盖和更可靠的公平性行为检测。

upstream_only.title: TACO: Trust Assessment of Large Language Models in Coding Assistance Tasks
upstream_only.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have rapidly become integral to software development workflows, particularly in coding assistance tasks (CAT) such as debugging, implementation, and code optimization. However, the trustworthiness of LLM-generated responses remains a critical concern, as hallucinations (incorrect or misleading outputs) can severely hinder developer productivity and software reliability. In this paper, we introduce TACO, a comprehensive framework for trust assessment of LLMs in CAT scenarios. TACO jointly evaluates both the code quality and the alignment with user intent of LLM responses, enabling fine-grained and interpretable trust evaluation. We construct two new benchmarks: TACO-Judge, a human-annotated dataset for validating evaluation methods, and TACO-Eval, a large-scale benchmark for assessing LLM performance on real-world CAT problems. Through extensive experiments, we (1) demonstrate the accuracy of TACO as an automated evaluator, (2) investigate whether LLMs exhibit self-preference when scoring their own outputs, and (3) compare the trustworthiness of several state-of-the-art LLMs in CAT scenarios. Our results highlight both the promise and limitations of current LLMs, and establish TACO as a reliable tool for their evaluation in software engineering contexts.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）已迅速成为软件开发工作流中不可或缺的一部分，尤其是在调试、实现和代码优化等编码辅助任务（CAT）中。然而，LLM生成响应的可信度仍然是一个关键问题，因为幻觉（不正确或误导性的输出）会严重阻碍开发人员的生产力和软件可靠性。在本文中，我们介绍了TACO，一个用于在CAT场景中评估LLM信任度的综合框架。TACO联合评估LLM响应的代码质量以及与用户意图的一致性，从而实现细粒度且可解释的信任评估。我们构建了两个新的基准：TACO-Judge，一个用于验证评估方法的人工标注数据集；以及TACO-Eval，一个用于评估LLM在真实世界CAT问题上表现的大规模基准。通过大量实验，我们（1）证明了TACO作为自动评估器的准确性，（2）研究了LLM在给自己的输出评分时是否表现出自我偏好，以及（3）比较了若干最先进LLM在CAT场景中的可信度。我们的结果凸显了当前LLM的前景和局限性，并确立了TACO作为软件工程背景下可靠评估工具的定位。

upstream_only.title: Fairness Is Not Just Ethical: Performance Trade-Off via Data Correlation Tuning to Mitigate Bias in ML Software
upstream_only.abstract: Traditional software fairness research typically emphasizes ethical and social imperatives, neglecting that fairness fundamentally represents a core software quality issue arising directly from performance disparities across sensitive user groups. Recognizing fairness explicitly as a software quality dimension yields practical benefits beyond ethical considerations, notably improved predictive performance for unprivileged groups, enhanced out-of-distribution generalization, and increased geographic transferability in real-world deployments. Nevertheless, existing bias mitigation methods face a critical dilemma: while pre-processing methods offer broad applicability across model types, they generally fall short in effectiveness compared to post-processing techniques. To overcome this challenge, we propose Correlation Tuning (CoT), a novel pre-processing approach designed to mitigate bias by adjusting data correlations. Specifically, CoT introduces the Phi-coefficient, an intuitive correlation measure, to systematically quantify correlation between sensitive attributes and labels, and employs multi-objective optimization to address the proxy biases. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that CoT increases the true positive rate of unprivileged groups by an average of 17.5\% and reduces three key bias metrics, including statistical parity difference (SPD), average odds difference (AOD), and equal opportunity difference (EOD), by more than 50\% on average. CoT outperforms state-of-the-art methods by three and ten percentage points in single attribute and multiple attributes scenarios, respectively. We will publicly release our experimental results and source code to facilitate future research.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 传统软件公平性研究通常强调伦理和社会必要性，忽视了公平性从根本上代表了一个核心软件质量问题，直接源于不同敏感用户群体之间的性能差异。将公平性明确视为软件质量维度，会带来超越伦理考虑的实际好处，尤其是改善弱势群体的预测性能、增强分布外泛化能力以及提高现实部署中的地理可迁移性。然而，现有的偏差缓解方法面临一个关键困境：虽然预处理方法在不同模型类型上具有广泛适用性，但其效果通常不如后处理技术。为了克服这一挑战，我们提出了相关性调优（CoT），一种通过调整数据相关性来缓解偏差的新型预处理方法。具体而言，CoT引入了Phi系数这一直观的相关性度量，以系统地量化敏感属性与标签之间的相关性，并采用多目标优化来解决代理偏差。大量评估表明，CoT将弱势群体的真阳性率平均提高了17.5%，并将三个关键偏差指标——统计均等差异（SPD）、平均赔率差异（AOD）和机会均等差异（EOD）——平均降低了50%以上。在单属性和多属性场景中，CoT分别比最先进方法高出三个和十个百分点。我们将公开实验源代码和结果以促进未来研究。

upstream_only.title: VADA: A Multicultural Benchmark for Value-Aware Data Generation and Alignment Evaluation in LLMs
upstream_only.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) now sit inside an expanding set of intelligent software systems, from education assistants to legal advisory tools. When these systems ship to global users, ensuring their behavior respects diverse cultural values has become a pressing challenge for software engineers. Traditional software engineering methods such as unit testing and formal verification work well for functional requirements, but they struggle to encode and validate normative expectations like cultural sensitivity or moral appropriateness. To address this gap, we introduce VADA, a framework for testing and benchmarking LLMs under multiple cultural value systems. VADA builds test cases through a modular pipeline that generates scenarios and questions grounded in culturally defined value dimensions. The resulting suite covers 25 value dimensions drawn from China’s Core Values, EU’s fundamental rights framework, and Islamic ethical frameworks. VADA uses a Bayesian ensemble and assigns each evaluator a dimension specific weight based on its observed reliability to evaluate model responses, and we additionally fine tune a lightweight supervised evaluator using VADA generated data, offering a fast and scalable alternative to running multiple large evaluators. Using this pipeline, we build a large benchmark containing 11,865 automatically annotated cases, along with a human labeled subset of 1,000 instances for validation and evaluation. VADA substantially outperforms current prompt-based evaluators, reaching 93.6\% accuracy and showing strong alignment with human annotations. Ablation studies indicate that both evaluator diversity and reliability based weighting contribute to performance. VADA also supports comparative audits of recent LLMs and reveals inconsistent alignment across cultural dimensions. Together, these results suggest that VADA provides a robust basis for value aware evaluation and supports the development of culturally aligned LLM based systems.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）如今已嵌入越来越多的智能软件系统中，从教育助手到法律咨询工具。当这些系统面向全球用户发布时，确保其行为尊重多元文化价值观已成为软件工程师面临的紧迫挑战。传统的软件工程方法（如单元测试和形式化验证）能很好地处理功能需求，但难以编码和验证诸如文化敏感性或道德适当性等规范性期望。为弥补这一空白，我们提出 VADA，一个用于在多种文化价值体系下测试和基准评测 LLM 的框架。VADA 通过模块化流水线构建测试用例，生成基于文化定义价值维度的场景和问题。由此得到的套件涵盖来自中国核心价值观、欧盟基本权利框架和伊斯兰伦理框架的 25 个价值维度。VADA 使用贝叶斯集成，并根据每个评估器观察到的可靠性为其分配维度特定的权重来评估模型响应；此外，我们利用 VADA 生成的数据微调了一个轻量级监督评估器，为运行多个大型评估器提供了快速且可扩展的替代方案。利用这一流水线，我们构建了一个包含 11,865 个自动标注案例的大型基准，以及一个由 1,000 个实例组成的人工标注子集用于验证和评估。VADA 显著优于当前基于提示的评估器，达到 93.6% 的准确率，并与人工标注高度一致。消融研究表明，评估器多样性和基于可靠性的加权都有助于提升性能。VADA 还支持对近期 LLM 进行比较审计，并揭示跨文化维度上不一致的对齐情况。总之，这些结果表明 VADA 为价值感知评估提供了稳健基础，并支持开发文化对齐的基于 LLM 的系统。

upstream_only.title: Testora: Using Natural Language Intent to Detect Behavioral Regressions
upstream_only.abstract: As software is evolving, code changes can introduce regression bugs or affect the behavior in other unintended ways. Traditional regression test generation is impractical for detecting unintended behavioral changes, because it reports all behavioral differences as potential regressions. However, most code changes are intended to change the behavior in some way, e.g., to fix a bug or to add a new feature. This paper presents Testora, the first automated approach that detects regressions by comparing the intentions of a code change against behavioral differences caused by the code change. Given a pull request (PR), Testora queries an LLM to generate tests that exercise the modified code, compares the behavior of the original and modified code, and classifies any behavioral differences as intended or unintended. For the classification, we present an LLM-based technique that leverages the natural language information associated with the PR, such as the title, description, and commit messages – effectively using the natural language intent to detect behavioral regressions. Applying Testora to PRs of complex and popular Python projects, we find 19 regression bugs and 11 PRs that, despite having another intention, coincidentally fix a bug. Out of 13 regressions reported to the developers, 11 have been confirmed and 9 have already been fixed. The costs of using Testora are acceptable for real-world deployment, with 12.3 minutes to check a PR and LLM costs of only $0.003 per PR. We envision our approach to be used before or shortly after a code change gets merged into a code base, providing a way to early on detect regressions that are not caught by traditional approaches.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 随着软件的发展，代码更改可能会引入回归错误或以其他方式影响行为。传统的回归测试生成对于检测意外的行为变化是不切实际的，因为它将所有行为差异报告为潜在回归。然而，大多数代码更改旨在以某种方式改变行为，例如，修复错误或添加新功能。本文提出了Testora，这是第一个通过比较代码更改的意图与代码更改引起的行为差异来自动检测回归的方法。给定一个拉取请求（PR），Testora查询LLM以生成测试修改后的代码，比较原始代码和修改后代码的行为，并将任何行为差异分类为有意的或无意的。对于分类，我们提出了一种基于LLM的技术，该技术利用与PR相关的自然语言信息，如标题、描述和提交消息——有效地使用自然语言意图来检测行为回归。将Testora应用于复杂且流行的Python项目的PR，我们发现了19个回归错误和11个PR，尽管有其他意图，却偶然修复了一个错误。在向开发人员报告的13个回归中，11个已被确认，9个已被修复。使用Testora的成本对于实际部署来说是可以接受的，检查一个PR需要12.3分钟，每个PR的LLM成本仅为0.003美元。我们设想我们的方法在代码更改合并到代码库之前或之后不久使用，提供了一种早期检测传统方法未捕获的回归的方法。

upstream_only.title: CoReX: Context-Aware Refinement-Based Slicing for Debugging Regression Failures
upstream_only.abstract: Troubleshooting regression failures is one of the most frequent yet time-consuming development tasks. To help with this task, numerous approaches aim to narrow down developers’ attention to the subset of code statements relevant to the failure. The most prominent of these approaches are based on program slicing, as slicing not only identifies a subset of relevant statements but also maintains the flow of information between these statements.By surveying more than 50 practitioners from eight different countries, we observe that existing dual-version slicing-based approaches have two main limitations: (a) to minimize the number of statements presented to the developer, they omit contextual information required to truly understand the failure and (b) to keep information propagation between the statements in the slice intact, they include lengthy computations that are not necessary to understand the failure. We use these observations to define a new dual-version slicing approach for regression scenarios, called CoReX. We evaluate CoReX on a large number of subjects, comparing it with other existing dual-version slicing approaches. The results of our evaluation show that CoReX outperforms these approaches both in the quantitative metrics used in prior work and in alignment with developers’ expectations. We believe our work provides grounds for efficient integration of slicing-based approaches into development workflows.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 排查回归失败是最常见但最耗时的开发任务之一。为帮助完成此任务，许多方法旨在将开发者的注意力缩小到与失败相关的代码语句子集。其中最突出的方法基于程序切片，因为切片不仅识别相关语句子集，还保持这些语句之间的信息流。通过调查来自八个国家的50多名从业者，我们观察到现有的双版本切片方法有两个主要局限性：(a) 为了最小化呈现给开发者的语句数量，它们省略了真正理解失败所需的上下文信息；(b) 为了保持切片中语句之间的信息传播完整，它们包含了理解失败所不需要的冗长计算。我们利用这些观察定义了一种新的用于回归场景的双版本切片方法，称为CoReX。我们在大量对象上评估CoReX，并将其与其他现有的双版本切片方法进行比较。评估结果表明，CoReX在先前工作中使用的定量指标以及与开发者期望的一致性方面均优于这些方法。我们相信我们的工作为将基于切片的方法高效集成到开发工作流中提供了基础。

upstream_only.title: Test Flimsiness: Characterizing Flakiness Induced by Mutation to the Code Under Test
upstream_only.abstract: Flaky tests, which fail non-deterministically against the same version of code, pose a well-established challenge to software developers. In this paper, we characterize the overlooked phenomenon of test FLIMsiness: FLakiness Induced by Mutations to the code under test. These mutations are generated by the same operators found in standard mutation testing tools. Flimsiness has profound implications for software testing researchers. Previous studies quantified the impact of pre-existing flaky tests on mutation testing, but we reveal that mutations themselves can induce flakiness, exposing a previously neglected threat. This has serious effects beyond mutation testing, calling into question the reliability of any technique that relies on deterministic test outcomes in response to mutations.On the other hand, flimsiness presents an opportunity to surface potential flakiness that may otherwise remain hidden. Prior work perturbed the execution environment to augment rerunning-based detection and the test code to support benchmarking. We advance these efforts by perturbing a third major source of flakiness: the code under test. We conducted an empirical study on over half a million test suite executions across 28 Python projects. Our statistical analysis on over 30 million mutant-test pairs unveiled flimsiness in 54\% of projects. We found that extending the standard rerunning flaky test detection strategy with code-under-test mutations detects a substantially larger number of flaky tests (median 740 vs. 163) and uncovers many that the standard strategy is unlikely to detect.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 波动性测试（即在同一代码版本上非确定性地失败的测试）对软件开发者构成了公认的挑战。本文刻画了一个被忽视的现象：测试脆弱性（FLIMsiness），即由被测代码变异引起的波动性。这些变异由标准变异测试工具中相同的变异算子生成。脆弱性对软件测试研究者具有深远影响。此前的研究量化了预先存在的波动性测试对变异测试的影响，但我们揭示变异本身可以诱发波动性，暴露了一个此前被忽视的威胁。这对变异测试之外也有严重影响，质疑任何依赖于对变异产生确定性测试结果的技术的可靠性。另一方面，脆弱性提供了一个机会，可以揭示原本可能隐藏的潜在波动性。先前的工作通过扰动执行环境来增强基于重运行的检测，并扰动测试代码以支持基准测试。我们通过扰动波动性的第三个主要来源——被测代码——来推进这些工作。我们对28个Python项目中的超过50万次测试套件执行进行了实证研究。我们对超过3000万个变异-测试对的统计分析在54%的项目中揭示了脆弱性。我们发现，将标准重运行波动性测试检测策略扩展到包含被测代码变异，可以检测到数量显著更多的波动性测试（中位数740对163），并揭示许多标准策略不太可能检测到的测试。

upstream_only.title: E-Test: E'er-Improving Test Suites
upstream_only.abstract: Test suites are inherently imperfect, and testers can always enrich a suite with new test cases that improve its quality and, consequently, the reliability of the target software system. However, finding test cases that explore execution scenarios beyond the scope of an existing suite can be extremely challenging and labor-intensive, particularly when managing large test suites over extended periods.In this paper, we propose E-Test, an approach that reduces the gap between the execution space explored with a test suite and the executions experienced in production. E-Test (i) identifies executions that have not yet been tested from large sets of scenarios, such as those monitored during intensive production usage, and (ii) generates new test cases that enhance the test suite. E-Test leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to pinpoint scenarios that the current test suite does not adequately cover, and augments the suite with test cases that execute these scenarios.Our evaluation on a dataset of 1,975 execution scenarios demonstrates that E-Test identifies not-yet-tested execution scenarios significantly better than state-of-the-art approaches. While existing regression testing and field testing approaches for this task achieve a maximum F1-score of 0.34, and vanilla LLMs achieve a maximum F1-score of 0.39, E-Test reaches 0.55.These results highlight the impact of E-Test in enhancing test suites by effectively targeting not-yet-tested execution scenarios and reducing manual effort required for maintaining test suites.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 测试套件本质上是不完美的，测试人员总是可以通过新的测试用例来丰富套件，从而提高其质量，进而提升目标软件系统的可靠性。然而，找到能够探索现有套件范围之外的执行场景的测试用例可能极具挑战且耗费人力，尤其是在长期管理大型测试套件时。在本文中，我们提出E-Test，一种缩小测试套件所探索的执行空间与生产环境中实际执行之间差距的方法。E-Test (i) 从大量场景（例如在生产密集使用期间监控到的场景）中识别尚未测试的执行，并 (ii) 生成增强测试套件的新测试用例。E-Test利用大型语言模型（LLM）来精确找出当前测试套件未充分覆盖的场景，并用执行这些场景的测试用例来扩充套件。我们在一个包含1,975个执行场景的数据集上的评估表明，E-Test在识别尚未测试的执行场景方面显著优于最先进的方法。虽然现有的回归测试和现场测试方法在此任务上最高F1分数为0.34，而普通LLM最高为0.39，但E-Test达到了0.55。这些结果突显了E-Test通过有效针对尚未测试的执行场景并减少维护测试套件所需的人工投入来增强测试套件的影响力。

upstream_only.title: Repair Ingredients Are All You Need: Improving Large Language Model-Based Program Repair via Repair Ingredients Search
upstream_only.abstract: Automated Program Repair (APR) techniques aim to automatically fix buggy programs. Among these, Large Language Model-based (LLM-based) approaches have shown great promise. Recent advances demonstrate that directly leveraging LLMs can achieve leading results. However, these techniques remain suboptimal in generating contextually relevant and accurate patches, as they often overlook repair ingredients crucial for practical program repair. In this paper, we propose ReinFix, a novel framework that enables LLMs to autonomously search for repair ingredients throughout both the reasoning and solution phases of bug fixing. In the reasoning phase, ReinFix integrates static analysis tools to retrieve internal ingredients, such as variable definitions, to assist the LLM in root cause analysis when it encounters difficulty understanding the context. During the solution phase, when the LLM lacks experience in fixing specific bugs, ReinFix searches for external ingredients from historical bug fixes with similar bug patterns, leveraging both the buggy code and its root cause to guide the LLM in identifying appropriate repair actions, thereby increasing the likelihood of generating correct patches. Evaluations on two popular benchmarks (Defects4J V1.2 and V2.0) demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach over SOTA baselines. Notably, ReinFix fixes 146 bugs, which is 32 more than the baselines on Defects4J V1.2. On Defects4J V2.0, ReinFix fixes 38 more bugs than the SOTA. Importantly, when evaluating on the recent benchmarks that are free of data leakage risk, ReinFix also maintains the best performance.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 自动程序修复（APR）技术旨在自动修复有错误的程序。其中，基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法已展现出巨大前景。最近的进展表明，直接利用LLM可以达到领先的结果。然而，这些技术仍然难以生成上下文相关且准确的补丁，因为它们常常忽略了实际程序修复中至关重要的修复要素。在本文中，我们提出了ReinFix，一种新颖的框架，使LLM能够在错误修复的推理和解决两个阶段自主搜索修复要素。在推理阶段，ReinFix集成静态分析工具来检索内部要素，例如变量定义，以在LLM遇到理解上下文的困难时帮助其进行根因分析。在解决阶段，当LLM缺乏修复特定错误的经验时，ReinFix从具有相似错误模式的历史错误修复中搜索外部要素，利用有错误的代码及其根因来指导LLM识别适当的修复动作，从而增加生成正确补丁的可能性。在两个流行基准（Defects4J V1.2和V2.0）上的评估证明了我们的方法优于SOTA基线。值得注意的是，ReinFix在Defects4J V1.2上修复了146个错误，比基线多32个。在Defects4J V2.0上，ReinFix比SOTA多修复了38个错误。重要的是，在最近没有数据泄漏风险的基准上进行评估时，ReinFix也保持了最佳性能。

upstream_only.title: Breaking Single-Tester Limits: Multi-Agent LLMs for Multi-User Feature Testing
upstream_only.abstract: The growing dependence on mobile phones and their apps has made multi-user interactive features—like chat calls, live streaming, and video conferencing—indispensable for bridging the gaps in social connectivity caused by physical and situational barriers. However, automating these interactive features for testing is fraught with challenges, owing to their inherent need for timely, dynamic, and collaborative user interactions, which current automated testing methods inadequately address. Inspired by the concept of agents designed to autonomously and collaboratively tackle problems, we propose MAdroid, a novel multi-agent approach powered by the Large Language Models (LLMs) to automate the multi-user interactive task for app feature testing. Specifically, MAdroid employs two functional types of multi-agents: user agents (Operator) and supervisor agents (Coordinator and Observer). Each agent takes a specific role: the Coordinator directs the interactive task; the Operator mimics user interactions on the device; and the Observer monitors and reviews the task automation process. Our evaluation, which included 41 multi-user interactive tasks, demonstrates the effectiveness of our approach, achieving 82.9\% of the tasks with 96.8\% action similarity, outperforming the ablation studies and state-of-the-art baselines. Additionally, a preliminary investigation underscores MAdroid’s practicality by helping identify 11 multi-user interactive bugs during regression app testing, confirming its potential value in real-world software development contexts.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 移动电话及其应用日益普及，使得聊天通话、直播和视频会议等多用户交互功能成为弥合由物理和情境障碍造成的社会连接鸿沟不可或缺的手段。然而，由于这些功能本质上需要及时、动态和协作的用户交互，自动化测试面临诸多挑战，现有的自动化测试方法无法充分应对。受能够自主协作解决问题的智能体概念的启发，我们提出 MAdroid，一种由大语言模型驱动的新型多智能体方法，用于自动化应用功能测试中的多用户交互任务。具体而言，MAdroid 采用两类功能性多智能体：用户智能体（Operator）和监督智能体（Coordinator 和 Observer）。每个智能体承担特定角色：Coordinator 指导交互任务；Operator 在设备上模拟用户交互；Observer 监控并审查任务自动化过程。我们的评估包含 41 个多用户交互任务，证明了该方法的有效性，以 96.8% 的动作相似度完成了 82.9% 的任务，优于消融研究和最先进的基线。此外，一项初步调查通过帮助在回归应用测试期间识别出 11 个多用户交互缺陷，凸显了 MAdroid 的实用性，证实了其在真实软件开发场景中的潜在价值。

upstream_only.title: EchoFuzz: Empowering Smart Contract Fuzzing with Large Language Models
upstream_only.abstract: Smart contracts, serving as the cornerstone of decentralized applications, autonomously manage trillion-dollar digital assets, making them attractive targets for attacks. Fuzzing has emerged as a promising technique for detecting vulnerabilities in smart contracts, yet existing methods face two main challenges. (1) The logical gap in state transitions and combinatorial redundancy hinders effective tradeoffs between bug detection efficiency and state space exploration cost, leading to critical execution paths to be overlooked. (2) Rule-based sequence mutation strategies suffer from path redundancy and inadequate guidance from contract logic, resulting in performance bottlenecks that stall the exploration of in-depth vulnerability-oriented paths.To tackle these challenges, we propose EchoFuzz, an LLM-guided fuzzing framework introducing Vulnerable Function Call Sequences (VFCS) - minimal, behavior-preserving execution paths that expose bugs through key state transitions. EchoFuzz consists of two key procedures. First, we develop a chain-guided LLM approach, that combines static analysis with logical understanding to generate contract-specific VFCS candidates that eliminate combinatorial redundancy. Second, we adopt an iterative fuzzing strategy that uses LLMs with real-time feedback to adaptively steer fuzzer toward uncovered branches. Experiments show EchoFuzz outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving 29\% higher branch coverage and detecting 62\% more vulnerabilities. It also found 37 previously unknown vulnerabilities in real contracts, showing strong practicality.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 智能合约作为去中心化应用的基石，自主管理着数万亿美元的数字资产，因而成为攻击者的诱人目标。模糊测试已成为检测智能合约漏洞的一种有前景的技术，但现有方法面临两大挑战。(1) 状态转换中的逻辑鸿沟与组合冗余阻碍了在缺陷检测效率与状态空间探索成本之间进行有效权衡，导致关键执行路径被忽视。(2) 基于规则的序列变异策略存在路径冗余且缺乏来自合约逻辑的充分指导，造成性能瓶颈，使面向深度漏洞的路径探索停滞。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 EchoFuzz，一个由大语言模型引导的模糊测试框架，引入易受攻击函数调用序列（VFCS）——通过关键状态转换暴露缺陷的最小化、行为保持的执行路径。EchoFuzz 包含两个关键过程。首先，我们开发了一种链引导的大语言模型方法，将静态分析与逻辑理解相结合，生成合约特定的 VFCS 候选，从而消除组合冗余。其次，我们采用迭代式模糊测试策略，利用大语言模型和实时反馈自适应地引导模糊器走向未覆盖的分支。实验表明 EchoFuzz 优于最先进方法，分支覆盖率提高 29%，检测到的漏洞多 62%。它还在真实合约中发现了 37 个先前未知的漏洞，展现出很强的实用性。

upstream_only.title: MioHint: LLM-Assisted Request Mutation for Whitebox REST API Testing
upstream_only.abstract: Cloud applications heavily rely on APIs to communicate with each other and exchange data. To ensure the reliability of cloud applications, cloud providers widely adopt API testing techniques. Unfortunately, existing API testing approaches are insufficient to reach strict conditions, a problem known as fitness plateaus, due to the lack of a gradient provided by coverage metrics. To address this issue, we propose MioHint, a novel white-box API testing approach that leverages the code comprehension capabilities of Large Language Model (LLM) to boost API testing. The key challenge of LLM-based API testing lies in system-level testing, which emphasizes the dependencies between requests and targets across functions and files, thereby making the entire codebase the object of analysis. However, feeding the entire codebase to an LLM is impractical due to its limited context length and short memory. MioHint addresses this challenge by synergizing static analysis with LLMs. We retrieve relevant code with data-dependency analysis at the statement level, including def-use analysis for variables used in the target and function expansion for subfunctions called by the target.To evaluate the effectiveness of our method, we conducted experiments across 16 real-world REST API services. The findings reveal that MioHint achieves an average increase of 4.95\% absolute in line coverage compared to the baseline, EvoMaster, alongside a remarkable factor of 67 {\texttimes} improvement in mutation accuracy. Furthermore, our method successfully covers over 57\% of hard-to-cover targets, while in the baseline, the coverage is less than 10\%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 云应用严重依赖API相互通信和交换数据。为确保云应用的可靠性，云提供商广泛采用API测试技术。不幸的是，现有API测试方法由于覆盖率指标缺乏梯度，不足以达到严格条件，这一问题被称为适应度高原（fitness plateaus）。为解决该问题，我们提出MioHint，一种新颖的白盒API测试方法，利用大语言模型（LLM）的代码理解能力来提升API测试。基于LLM的API测试的关键挑战在于系统级测试，它强调跨函数和跨文件的请求与目标之间的依赖关系，从而使整个代码库成为分析对象。然而，由于LLM上下文长度有限且记忆短，将整个代码库输入LLM是不切实际的。MioHint通过将静态分析与LLM协同来解决这一挑战。我们在语句级别通过数据依赖分析检索相关代码，包括对目标中使用的变量进行定义-使用分析，以及对目标调用的子函数进行函数展开。为评估方法有效性，我们在16个真实世界的REST API服务上进行了实验。结果表明，与基线EvoMaster相比，MioHint在行覆盖率上平均绝对提升4.95%，突变准确率显著提升67倍。此外，我们的方法成功覆盖了超过57%的难以覆盖目标，而基线覆盖率不到10%。

upstream_only.title: Think Outside the Box: Automating Inter-App Functionality Testing via Memory Implanting and Reasoning
upstream_only.abstract: Inter-app functionality requires multiple apps to collaborate to complete a functional task, which has become essential in modern software ecosystems. However, due to the dynamic updates and openness of modern apps, automated GUI testing based on predefined interaction models or trained on historical data is difficult to achieve inter-app testing. The low fault tolerance and context-dependent characteristics of inter-app functionality paths, lead the LLM-based GUI testing to have UI semantic mapping ambiguity and irreversible operation generating problem. To address these challenges, this paper proposes InterDroid, an automated GUI testing approach that enhances inter-app testing by implanting structured semantic knowledge into LLM’s memory. InterDroid retrieves relevant historical inter-app interactions using a multimodal retrieval method that integrates visual and textual GUI information, significantly improving retrieval accuracy. Inspired by the research on memory implantation in cognitive psychology, we design a memory implanting mechanism: global memory presents inter-app paths in a conversational form, simulating prior testing experience, and local memory tracks real-time state transitions. Additionally, InterDroid proposes a testing monitor that dynamically tracks testing progress and detects deviations, ensuring comprehensive test execution. InterDroid is designed as an integrable module that activates upon detecting the transition of the app to another app, allowing existing automated GUI testing tools to continue seamlessly after inter-app testing is completed. We evaluate InterDroid on 100 inter-app functionalities across 63 apps, comparing it with state-of-the-art GUI testing baselines. InterDroid achieves up to 133\% improvement in page coverage, 124\% in action coverage, and 268\% in exact match accuracy over the best baseline. Furthermore, InterDroid detects 43 new crash bugs in real-world apps from Google Play, with 31 fixed and 12 confirmed by developers.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 跨应用功能需要多个应用协作完成一项功能任务，这已成为现代软件生态系统中不可或缺的一部分。然而，由于现代应用的动态更新和开放性，基于预定义交互模型或历史数据训练的自动化GUI测试难以实现跨应用测试。跨应用功能路径的低容错性和上下文依赖特性，导致基于LLM的GUI测试存在UI语义映射模糊和不可逆操作生成问题。为应对这些挑战，本文提出InterDroid，一种通过将结构化语义知识植入LLM记忆来增强跨应用测试的自动化GUI测试方法。InterDroid使用融合视觉和文本GUI信息的多模态检索方法检索相关的历史跨应用交互，显著提高了检索准确性。受认知心理学中记忆植入研究的启发，我们设计了一种记忆植入机制：全局记忆以对话形式呈现跨应用路径，模拟先前的测试经验，局部记忆跟踪实时状态转换。此外，InterDroid提出了一种测试监视器，动态跟踪测试进度并检测偏差，确保全面执行测试。InterDroid被设计为一个可集成模块，在检测到应用跳转到另一个应用时激活，使现有的自动化GUI测试工具能够在跨应用测试完成后无缝继续。我们在63个应用中的100个跨应用功能上评估InterDroid，并将其与最先进的GUI测试基线进行比较。InterDroid在页面覆盖率上提升高达133%，动作覆盖率提升124%，精确匹配准确率提升268%，超过最佳基线。此外，InterDroid在来自Google Play的真实应用中检测到43个新崩溃漏洞，其中31个已修复，12个已由开发者确认。

upstream_only.title: Predicting Failures in Smart Human-Centric Ecosystems
upstream_only.abstract: Smart cities, smart grids, and in general Smart Human-centric Ecosystems (SHEs) emerge from the co-existence of many systems that operate according to independently owned specifications, and evolve over time. SHEs may fail despite the correct behavior of the systems that comprise the SHEs. Fully testing SHEs on testbeds to prevent failures in production is impossible, and scenarios that may lead to catastrophic SHE failures are unavoidable.In this paper we frame the core issues of SHE failures, and propose Smart human-centric Ecosystem Monitoring, SEM, an approach that predicts SHE failures to enable corrective actions for mitigating the catastrophic effects of failures. SEM identifies failure-prone scenarios from the reconstruction error of SHE indicators, that is, metric values that SEM collects from the SHE at constant frequency. SEM computes the reconstruction error with a suitably trained denoising autoencoder combined with a transformer architecture. The results of experimenting with a peer-to-peer ride-hailing ecosystem operating in San Francisco confirm that SEM can effectively predict SHE failures early enough to activate preventing actions, and indicate the generalizability of SEM with continual learning.The main contributions of the paper are the definition and the exemplification of the impact of failures in SHEs, and an approach to detect incoming failures before otherwise inevitable disruptive effects.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 智能城市、智能电网，以及一般的智能以人为中心的生态系统（SHEs）源于许多系统的共存，这些系统按照各自独立拥有的规范运行，并随时间演变。尽管组成SHE的系统行为正确，SHE仍可能发生故障。在测试床上全面测试SHE以预防生产中的故障是不可能的，而可能导致灾难性SHE故障的场景也是不可避免的。在本文中，我们框定了SHE故障的核心问题，并提出了智能以人为中心的生态系统监控（SEM），一种预测SHE故障的方法，以便采取纠正措施来缓解故障的灾难性影响。SEM从SHE指标的重构误差中识别易发生故障的场景，这些指标是SEM以恒定频率从SHE收集的度量值。SEM使用适当训练的降噪自编码器与transformer架构相结合来计算重构误差。在旧金山运行的点对点网约车生态系统上进行的实验结果证实，SEM能够有效地提前预测SHE故障，从而激活预防措施，并表明SEM通过持续学习具有泛化能力。本文的主要贡献是定义和例证SHE中故障的影响，以及一种在否则不可避免的破坏性影响发生之前检测即将发生的故障的方法。

upstream_only.title: Scalpel: Automotive Deep Learning Framework Testing via Assembling Model Components
upstream_only.abstract: Deep learning (DL) plays a key role in autonomous driving systems. DL models support perception modules, equipped with tasks such as object detection and sensor fusion. These DL models enable vehicles to process multi-sensor inputs to understand complex surroundings. Deploying DL models in autonomous driving systems faces stringent challenges, including real-time processing, limited computational resources, and strict power constraints. To address these challenges, automotive DL frameworks (e.g., PaddleInference) have emerged to optimize inference efficiency. However, these frameworks encounter unique quality issues due to their more complex deployment environments, such as crashes stemming from limited scheduled memory and incorrect memory allocation. Unfortunately, existing DL framework testing methods fail to detect these quality issues due to the failure in deploying generated test input models, as these models lack three essential capabilities: (1) multi-input/output tensor processing, (2) multi-modal data processing, and (3) multi-level data feature extraction. These capabilities necessitate specialized model components, which existing testing methods neglect during model generation. To bridge this gap, we propose Scalpel, an automotive DL frameworks testing method that generates test input models at the model component level. Scalpel generates models by assembling model components (heads, necks, backbones) to support capabilities required by autonomous driving systems. Specifically, Scalpel maintains and updates a repository of model components, generating test inputs by selecting, mutating, and assembling them. Successfully generated models are added back to enrich the repository. Newly generated models are then deployed within the autonomous driving system to test automotive DL frameworks via differential testing. The experimental results demonstrate that Scalpel outperforms existing methods in both effectiveness and efficiency. In Apollo, Scalpel detects 16 crashes and 21 NaN \& inconsistency bugs. All detected bugs have been reported to open-source communities, with 10 crashes confirmed. Scalpel achieves 27.44 {\texttimes} and 8.5 {\texttimes} improvements in model generation efficiency and bug detection efficiency. Additionally, Scalpel detects nine crashes and 16 NaN \& inconsistency bugs in Autoware, which shows its excellent generalization.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 深度学习（DL）在自动驾驶系统中起着关键作用。DL模型支持感知模块，具备目标检测和传感器融合等任务。这些DL模型使车辆能够处理多传感器输入以理解复杂环境。在自动驾驶系统中部署DL模型面临严峻挑战，包括实时处理、有限的计算资源和严格的功耗约束。为应对这些挑战，汽车DL框架（如PaddleInference）应运而生，以优化推理效率。然而，这些框架由于其更复杂的部署环境而遇到独特质量问题，例如由有限调度内存和错误内存分配引起的崩溃。不幸的是，现有的DL框架测试方法无法检测这些质量问题，因为它们无法部署生成的测试输入模型，这些模型缺乏三项基本能力：(1) 多输入/输出张量处理，(2) 多模态数据处理，以及 (3) 多级数据特征提取。这些能力需要专门的模型组件，而现有测试方法在模型生成过程中忽略了这些组件。为弥补这一差距，我们提出Scalpel，一种在模型组件级别生成测试输入模型的汽车DL框架测试方法。Scalpel通过组装模型组件（heads、necks、backbones）来生成模型，以支持自动驾驶系统所需的能力。具体而言，Scalpel维护并更新模型组件仓库，通过选择、变异和组装它们来生成测试输入。成功生成的模型被添加回仓库以丰富它。然后，新生成的模型被部署在自动驾驶系统内，通过差分测试来测试汽车DL框架。实验结果表明，Scalpel在有效性和效率上均优于现有方法。在Apollo中，Scalpel检测到16个崩溃和21个NaN与不一致性错误。所有检测到的错误均已报告给开源社区，其中10个崩溃得到确认。Scalpel在模型生成效率和错误检测效率上分别实现了27.44倍和8.5倍的提升。此外，Scalpel在Autoware中检测到9个崩溃和16个NaN与不一致性错误，显示出其出色的泛化能力。

upstream_only.title: DeFT: Maintaining Determinism and Extracting Unit Tests for Autonomous Driving Planning
upstream_only.abstract: An Autonomous Driving System (ADS) is a complex software system often composed of multiple modules, each responsible for its own set of tasks. The ADS planning module is responsible for planning the autonomous vehicle’s future driving trajectories and has historically been the most buggy ADS module. In recent years, many approaches have been proposed to test an ADS in complex virtual scenarios through simulation, and these scenarios have been effective in revealing the ADS’s suboptimal decisions. However, due to the randomness of events that occur during the real-time execution of an ADS, test scenarios tend to produce varying outcomes and, in turn, make ADS testing non-deterministic, flaky, and unpredictable. To address this challenge, we propose and evaluate DeFT, an approach that extracts deterministic test cases for the ADS planning module from non-deterministic system-level scenario tests. DeFT monitors the messages exchanged by ADS modules during the execution of system-level scenario tests and reconstructs inputs to reproduce the planning module’s execution. By using DeFT, we find that planning module tests can (1) more accurately reproduce planning module executions that occurred during system-level scenario tests, (2) be used to deterministically detect the same 658 collision failures revealed by system-level scenario tests, and (3) reduce the time needed to reproduce failures by 43.69\% to 77.64\%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 自动驾驶系统（ADS）是一个复杂的软件系统，通常由多个模块组成，每个模块负责自己的任务集。ADS规划模块负责规划自动驾驶车辆的未来行驶轨迹，历来是ADS中缺陷最多的模块。近年来，许多方法被提出通过仿真在复杂虚拟场景中测试ADS，这些场景能有效揭示ADS的次优决策。然而，由于ADS实时执行过程中事件的随机性，测试场景往往产生不同结果，进而使ADS测试变得非确定性、不稳定且不可预测。为应对这一挑战，我们提出并评估了DeFT，一种从非确定性的系统级场景测试中为ADS规划模块提取确定性测试用例的方法。DeFT监控ADS模块在系统级场景测试执行期间交换的消息，并重建输入以复现规划模块的执行。通过使用DeFT，我们发现规划模块测试能够（1）更准确地复现系统级场景测试期间发生的规划模块执行，（2）确定性地检测系统级场景测试所揭示的相同658个碰撞失败，并且（3）将复现失败所需时间减少43.69%至77.64%。

upstream_only.title: Temporal Specification Oriented Fuzzing for Trigger-Action-Programming Smart Home Integrations
upstream_only.abstract: The convergence of Internet of Things (IoT) and home automation (HA) has revolutionized human-device interaction, typically through trigger-action programming paradigms such as If This Then That (IFTTT). While empowering user-customized automation, this integration introduces critical challenges: unexpected behaviors from improper rule configurations, and cybersecurity threats propagated through interconnected rule chains. Researchers model the integrations with the finite state machine, characterize these risks using linear temporal logic (LTL), and employ model checking techniques to check whether the system conforms to the properties. However, model checking suffers from the inherent state space explosion problem, so that relevant methods face difficulty in handling large-scale systems. Furthermore, the HA-IoT domain notably lacks standardized benchmark datasets for validating LTL-related methods.To efficiently detect LTL specification violations in smart home integrations, we propose HAFuzz - an innovative framework that combines formal methods with fuzzing techniques. Within the fuzzing process, we use Runtime Verification (RV) techniques to check violations within finite steps and guide the fuzzing seed selection. We further incorporate manually created specifications with large language model (LLM)-driven mutation generation, enabling systematic test case augmentation. Extensive evaluation demonstrates that HAFuzz achieves violation detection within 500 ms under typical scenarios, showing superior efficiency improvements compared to conventional approaches. Furthermore, comprehensive validation involving 3,343 LTL specifications confirms HAFuzz’s accuracy and effectiveness in identifying critical violations, particularly in large-scale deployments characterized by intricate rule interdependencies and specifications that feature complex temporal logic patterns.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 物联网（IoT）与家庭自动化（HA）的融合彻底改变了人机交互，通常通过诸如 If This Then That (IFTTT) 之类的触发-动作编程范式实现。这种集成在赋予用户自定义自动化能力的同时，也带来了严峻挑战：不当规则配置导致的意外行为，以及通过相互连接的规则链传播的网络安全威胁。研究人员用有限状态机对集成建模，使用线性时序逻辑（LTL）刻画这些风险，并采用模型检测技术检查系统是否满足属性。然而，模型检测受制于固有的状态空间爆炸问题，导致相关方法难以处理大规模系统。此外，HA-IoT 领域显著缺乏用于验证 LTL 相关方法的标准化基准数据集。为了高效检测智能家居集成中的 LTL 规范违反，我们提出 HAFuzz——一个将形式化方法与模糊测试技术相结合的新颖框架。在模糊测试过程中，我们使用运行时验证（RV）技术在有限步骤内检查违反，并指导模糊测试种子选择。我们进一步将人工创建的规范与大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的变异生成相结合，实现系统化的测试用例增强。大量评估表明，HAFuzz 在典型场景下能在 500 毫秒内实现违反检测，相比传统方法展现出更优的效率提升。此外，涉及 3,343 条 LTL 规范的全面验证证实了 HAFuzz 在识别关键违反方面的准确性和有效性，尤其是在具有复杂规则相互依赖的大规模部署以及具有复杂时序逻辑模式的规范中。

upstream_only.title: Fuzzing JavaScript Engines by Fusing JavaScript and WebAssembly
upstream_only.abstract: JavaScript engines are a fundamental part of modern browsers, and many efforts have been invested in testing them to enhance their security. However, the incorporation of WebAssembly into JavaScript engines introduces new attack surfaces that have not received sufficient attention. Existing fuzzers for JavaScript engines primarily focus on JavaScript, neglecting WebAssembly code and its interactions with JavaScript. We introduce Mad-Eye, the first fuzzer that can test the JavaScript-WebAssembly interaction using a novel cross-language code fusion technique. Evaluations of Mad-Eye on V8, SpiderMonkey, and JavaScriptCore detected 21 previously unknown vulnerabilities, with 20 confirmed and 18 fixed and merged into mainstream browsers by the developers, who acknowledged our reports with vulnerability bounties.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: JavaScript引擎是现代浏览器的基本组成部分，许多工作已投入对其测试以增强安全性。然而，将WebAssembly集成到JavaScript引擎中引入了尚未受到足够关注的新攻击面。现有的JavaScript引擎模糊测试器主要关注JavaScript，忽略了WebAssembly代码及其与JavaScript的交互。我们提出Mad-Eye，这是首个能够使用新颖的跨语言代码融合技术测试JavaScript-WebAssembly交互的模糊测试器。在V8、SpiderMonkey和JavaScriptCore上对Mad-Eye的评估检测到21个先前未知的漏洞，其中20个得到确认，18个被修复并由开发者合并到主流浏览器中，开发者还以漏洞赏金肯定了我们的报告。

upstream_only.title: RusyFuzz: Unhandled Exception Guided Fuzzing for Rust OS Kernel
upstream_only.abstract: Rust’s strong type system and ownership model eliminate many traditional memory safety issues in OS kernels. However, logic errors—such as unchecked indexing and failed unwrap operations—can still cause panic!s that crash the entire system. Existing kernel fuzzers, designed primarily for C-based kernels and reliant on KCOV, treat all crashes uniformly and fail to account for Rust-specific failure modes.We present RusyFuzz, the first fuzzing framework tailored to Rust OS kernels that explicitly targets panic-prone code paths using an unhandled-exception-guided strategy. RusyFuzz analyzes the compiler-inserted assertions within the Rust MIR, performs backward slicing to link these assertions to system call arguments, and uses constraint solving to synthesize inputs that trigger panics. In the absence of built-in coverage support, RusyFuzz employs a lightweight, log-based instrumentation method to enable coverage-guided fuzzing. We evaluate RusyFuzz on three emerging Rust-based kernels: Asterinas, Redox OS, and RuxOS. RusyFuzz discovers 70 previously unknown and developer-confirmed vulnerabilities. Compared to Trinity, it uncovers over twice as many bugs while improving line coverage by 14.4\%. These results demonstrate that unhandled-exception-guided fuzzing is critical for uncovering logic bugs and enhancing the reliability of Rust OS kernels, providing the first systematic methodology for detecting such vulnerabilities.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Rust强大的类型系统和所有权模型消除了操作系统内核中许多传统的内存安全问题。然而，逻辑错误——例如未检查的索引和失败的unwrap操作——仍然可能导致panic!，从而使整个系统崩溃。现有的内核模糊测试器主要针对基于C的内核设计，并依赖KCOV，它们统一对待所有崩溃，未能考虑Rust特有的故障模式。我们提出了RusyFuzz，这是第一个专为Rust操作系统内核定制的模糊测试框架，它通过未处理异常引导策略显式地针对容易发生panic的代码路径。RusyFuzz分析Rust MIR中编译器插入的断言，执行后向切片以将这些断言链接到系统调用参数，并使用约束求解来合成触发panic的输入。在缺乏内置覆盖率支持的情况下，RusyFuzz采用轻量级的基于日志的插桩方法来实现覆盖率引导的模糊测试。我们在三个新兴的基于Rust的内核上评估RusyFuzz：Asterinas、Redox OS和RuxOS。RusyFuzz发现了70个先前未知且经开发者确认的漏洞。与Trinity相比，它发现的错误数量超过两倍，同时将行覆盖率提高了14.4%。这些结果表明，未处理异常引导的模糊测试对于发现逻辑错误和提高Rust操作系统内核的可靠性至关重要，提供了检测此类漏洞的首个系统化方法。

upstream_only.title: VDBFuzz: Understanding and Detecting Crash Bugs in Vector Database Management Systems
upstream_only.abstract: Vector Database Management Systems (VDBMSs) have become critical in LLM-integrated applications. However, their inherent complexity, including high-dimensional data structures, diverse indexing strategies, and heterogeneous implementations, makes them prone to reliability issues. Among these, crash bugs caused by boundary condition failures, such as invalid configurations and mismatched data dimensions, are particularly severe. These bugs can result in serious consequences like data loss, corrupted indexes, and cascading failures. To address this gap, we propose VDBFuzz, the first fuzzing framework specifically designed to detect VDBMS crash bugs through boundary value testing. VDBFuzz systematically leverages techniques to collect high-quality seeds, generate edge-case inputs, and explore complex API interactions. We evaluated VDBFuzz on 8 representative VDBMSs, including native systems (e.g., Weaviate, Milvus), libraries (e.g., Faiss, hnswlib), and extended systems (e.g., pgvector, sqlite-vec). VDBFuzz achieved up to 3x higher code coverage compared to state-of-the-art tools such as RESTler and Schemathesis, uncovering 19 previously unknown bugs, including 13 crash vulnerabilities and 6 runtime exceptions. These results highlight VDBFuzz’s effectiveness in improving the robustness and reliability of VDBMSs.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 向量数据库管理系统（VDBMSs）在集成LLM的应用中已变得至关重要。然而，其固有的复杂性——包括高维数据结构、多样的索引策略以及异构实现——使其容易出现可靠性问题。其中，由边界条件失效（如无效配置和数据维度不匹配）导致的崩溃缺陷尤为严重。这些缺陷可能造成数据丢失、索引损坏和级联故障等严重后果。为填补这一空白，我们提出VDBFuzz，这是首个专门通过边界值测试来检测VDBMS崩溃缺陷的模糊测试框架。VDBFuzz系统地利用技术来收集高质量种子、生成边缘情况输入并探索复杂的API交互。我们在8个代表性VDBMS上评估了VDBFuzz，包括原生系统（如Weaviate、Milvus）、库（如Faiss、hnswlib）和扩展系统（如pgvector、sqlite-vec）。与RESTler和Schemathesis等最先进工具相比，VDBFuzz实现了高达3倍的代码覆盖率提升，并发现了19个此前未知的缺陷，包括13个崩溃漏洞和6个运行时异常。这些结果凸显了VDBFuzz在提高VDBMS健壮性和可靠性方面的有效性。

upstream_only.title: Variability-Aware Fuzzing
upstream_only.abstract: Modern software systems often provide a vast configuration space to enhance reusability and adaptability, but this configurability also significantly complicates bug finding. While existing static and dynamic variability-aware analysis approaches systematically explore the configuration space, they often suffer from scalability limitations. Conversely, grey-box fuzzing has demonstrated remarkable success in vulnerability detection through lightweight, iterative input space exploration, yet the state-of-the-art configuration fuzzers overlook the potential of integrating variability-aware analysis within the fuzzing process. In this paper, we present VAFuzz, a novel variability-aware fuzzer that integrates principled dynamic variability-aware analysis within the fuzzing process to enhance configuration space exploration. VAFuzz introduces new variability-aware seed selection and mutations to drive the fuzzing process. These are enabled by a new presence condition seed queue that tracks coverage and crash contributions across the configuration space, and a map that captures the relationship between data seeds and presence conditions. Our evaluation on a diverse set of programs show that VAFuzz outperforms the state-of-the-art configuration fuzzers on 21 out of 25 programs in terms of code coverage. It also detects more vulnerabilities than these baselines, including previous unknown bugs.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代软件系统通常提供庞大的配置空间以增强可重用性和适应性，但这种可配置性也显著增加了缺陷发现的难度。现有的静态和动态可变性感知分析方法虽然能系统地探索配置空间，但往往面临可扩展性限制。相反，灰盒模糊测试通过轻量级、迭代式的输入空间探索，在漏洞检测方面取得了显著成功，然而最先进的配置模糊测试器却忽视了在模糊测试过程中集成可变性感知分析的潜力。本文提出了VAFuzz，一种新颖的可变性感知模糊测试器，它将原则化的动态可变性感知分析集成到模糊测试过程中，以增强配置空间探索。VAFuzz引入了新的可变性感知种子选择和变异来驱动模糊测试过程。这些依赖于一个新的存在条件种子队列（用于跟踪跨配置空间的覆盖率和崩溃贡献）以及一个捕捉数据种子与存在条件之间关系的映射。我们在多样化的程序集上评估表明，VAFuzz在25个程序中的21个上，在代码覆盖率方面优于最先进的配置模糊测试器。它还比这些基线检测到更多漏洞，包括先前未知的缺陷。

upstream_only.title: CombCT: Compiler Testing via Combinatorial Testing
upstream_only.abstract: Compilers, as fundamental software, are essential for various applications, making their reliability crucial. Modern compilers like GCC and LLVM offer numerous optimizations to improve performance. Empirical studies present that most bugs occur during compiler optimization, especially with specific optimization sequences, yet little attention has been paid to this in compiler testing. The vast optimization sequence space challenges existing methods, leaving this important research direction in its early stages and in need of effective solutions. In this work, we propose a novel and effective compiler testing approach dubbed CombCT, aimed at boosting compiler testing. CombCT is the first approach that leverages the power of combinatorial testing for compiler testing, making it be capable of effectively exploring optimization sequences. Besides, CombCT incorporates three new techniques, i.e., dynamic optimization sequence adaption, partial sequence selection, and diversity augmentation, to enhance its effectiveness. Extensive experiments on various versions of GCC and LLVM demonstrate that CombCT detects much more unique bugs, which are caused by certain optimization sequences, than current state-of-the-art methods, indicating its superiority. Moreover, CombCT has disclosed 14 previously unknown bugs in the latest versions of GCC and LLVM, 13 of which have been confirmed or fixed, showing its practical value.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 编译器作为基础软件，对各类应用至关重要，因此其可靠性至关重要。像GCC和LLVM这样的现代编译器提供了大量优化以提高性能。实证研究表明，大多数错误发生在编译器优化期间，尤其是在特定优化序列下，但编译器测试对此关注甚少。庞大的优化序列空间对现有方法提出了挑战，使这一重要研究方向仍处于早期阶段，需要有效的解决方案。在本工作中，我们提出了一种新颖且有效的编译器测试方法，称为CombCT，旨在提升编译器测试。CombCT是首个利用组合测试能力进行编译器测试的方法，使其能够有效探索优化序列。此外，CombCT结合了三种新技术，即动态优化序列适应、部分序列选择和多样性增强，以提升其有效性。对GCC和LLVM多个版本的广泛实验表明，CombCT检测到的由特定优化序列引起的唯一错误远多于当前最先进的方法，表明其优越性。此外，CombCT在最新版本的GCC和LLVM中披露了14个此前未知的错误，其中13个已被确认或修复，展示了其实际价值。

upstream_only.title: Fuzzing Java Optimizing Compilers with Complex Inter-Class Structures Guided by Heterogeneous Program Graphs
upstream_only.abstract: Modern Java compilers, such as Just-In-Time (JIT) and Ahead-Of-Time (AOT) compilers, often infer and analyze complex inter-class structures to perform program optimizations while preserving semantic correctness. However, incorrect inference of these structures during compilation can lead to critical bugs, as observed in production compilers like HotSpot and R8. Despite their effectiveness, existing Java fuzzing tools fail to adequately explore inter-class relationships, focusing instead on simpler intra-class or intra-method constructs. To bridge this gap, we present InterFuzz, the first fuzzing framework designed to systematically generate Java test cases with complex inter-class structures. InterFuzz introduces a novel concept of Heterogeneous Program Graph (HPG) to abstract and manipulate inter-class relationships. It then employs Inter-Class Mutators to construct intricate interactions, and utilizes graph complexities to guide test generation toward high-diversity code. Our evaluation shows that InterFuzz effectively uncovers compiler bugs that elude traditional fuzzers, having discovered 24 new bugs across HotSpot, ART, and R8. Among these, 20 bugs are confirmed by developers and 16 bugs hinge on intricate inter-class structures.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代Java编译器，如即时（JIT）和提前（AOT）编译器，通常会推断并分析复杂的类间结构，以在保持语义正确性的同时执行程序优化。然而，在编译期间对这些结构的错误推断可能导致严重缺陷，正如在HotSpot和R8等生产编译器中所观察到的那样。尽管现有Java模糊测试工具很有效，但它们未能充分探索类间关系，而是专注于更简单的类内或方法内构造。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了InterFuzz，这是第一个旨在系统生成具有复杂类间结构的Java测试用例的模糊测试框架。InterFuzz引入了异构程序图（HPG）这一新概念，以抽象和操纵类间关系。然后，它采用类间变异器来构造复杂的交互，并利用图复杂性引导测试生成朝向高多样性代码。我们的评估表明，InterFuzz能有效发现传统模糊测试工具未能发现的编译器缺陷，在HotSpot、ART和R8中发现了24个新缺陷。其中，20个缺陷被开发者确认，16个缺陷依赖于复杂的类间结构。

upstream_only.title: Bounded Exhaustive Random Program Generation for Testing Solidity Compilers
upstream_only.abstract: By July 2025, smart contracts collectively manage roughly $120 billion in assets. With Solidity remaining the dominant language for smart contract development, the correctness of Solidity compilers has become critically important. However, Solidity compilers are prone to bugs, with a recent study revealing that combinations of qualifiers in Solidity programs are the primary cause of compiler crashes, accounting for (40.5\%) of all historical crashes. While random program generators are widely used for compiler testing, they may be less effective at finding Solidity compiler bugs because they explore the unbounded space of possible programs rather than concentrating on the specific subspace related to bug-prone qualifiers. A promising idea for finding qualifier-related bugs is to bound the search space based on empirical evidence of where such bugs are likely to occur, specifically focusing test generation to target subspaces with rich combinations of qualifiers. To address this, we propose bounded exhaustive random program generation, a novel approach that dynamically bounds the search space, enhancing the likelihood of uncovering Solidity compiler bugs. Specifically, our method bounds the search space by generating valid program templates that abstract programs that use bug-prone qualifiers, and then uses these templates as a basis for compiler testing through exhaustive enumeration of suitable qualifiers. Mechanisms are devised to address technical challenges regarding validity and efficiency.We have implemented our novel generation approach in a new tool, Erwin. We have used Erwin to find and report 26 bugs across two Solidity compilers, solc and solang, and one Solidity static analyzer, slither. Among these, 23 were previously unknown, 18 have been confirmed, and 10 have been fixed. Evaluation results demonstrate that Erwin outperforms state-of-the-art Solidity fuzzers in bug detection and complements developer-written test suites by covering 4,599 edges and 14,824 lines of the solc compiler that were missed by solc’s unit tests.
