upstream_only.abstract_zh: 截至2025年7月，智能合约共同管理着大约1200亿美元的资产。随着Solidity仍然是智能合约开发的主导语言，Solidity编译器的正确性变得至关重要。然而，Solidity编译器容易出错，最近的一项研究揭示，Solidity程序中限定符的组合是编译器崩溃的主要原因，占所有历史崩溃的40.5%。虽然随机程序生成器被广泛用于编译器测试，但它们在发现Solidity编译器缺陷方面可能效果不佳，因为它们探索的是无界的可能程序空间，而不是集中于与易出错限定符相关的特定子空间。寻找限定符相关缺陷的一个有前景的思路是，基于此类缺陷可能发生位置的实证证据来限制搜索空间，具体而言，将测试生成聚焦于针对具有丰富限定符组合的子空间。为了解决这个问题，我们提出有界穷举随机程序生成，这是一种新颖的方法，它动态地限制搜索空间，从而提高发现Solidity编译器缺陷的可能性。具体而言，我们的方法通过生成有效的程序模板来限制搜索空间，这些模板抽象了使用易出错限定符的程序，然后将这些模板作为编译器测试的基础，通过穷举枚举合适的限定符。我们设计了一些机制来解决有关有效性和效率的技术挑战。我们已将这种新颖的生成方法实现在一个新工具Erwin中。我们使用Erwin在两个Solidity编译器solc和solang以及一个Solidity静态分析器slither中查找并报告了26个缺陷。其中，23个此前未知，18个已被确认，10个已被修复。评估结果表明，Erwin在缺陷检测方面优于最先进的Solidity模糊测试器，并通过覆盖solc单元测试遗漏的4599条边和14824行solc编译器代码，补充了开发者编写的测试套件。

upstream_only.title: Is Call Graph Pruning Really Effective? An Empirical Re-evaluation
upstream_only.abstract: Recently proposed call graph pruning techniques, which use machine learning to predict and reduce false positives in static call graphs, have reported impressive results and demonstrated practicality for downstream analyses. However, as we research the methodology of how datasets are created and how evaluation is conducted in these research projects, we identify many risk factors that may make the reported results incomplete or even invalid. We further investigate these factors and provide empirical evidence to demonstrate they indeed result in misleading results. Motivated by these findings, we propose an empirical re-evaluation of existing call graph pruning techniques to assess their effectiveness. We first construct a new dataset of real-world programs, applying three complementary labeling approaches, resulting in 41,952 labels. To provide a full picture of these techniques, we utilize three popular call graph analysis frameworks (WALA, Doop, and OPAL) and seven tool configurations. Our results show that pruning is not as effective as reported in prior work, improving precision at the cost of significant coverage loss. We further train more general models across analysis tools and configurations, and explore the impact of data splitting and balancing. We find these models often match or outperform the existing configuration-specific ones, indicating their applicability in more general settings. Finally, we highlight the open challenges and potential solutions, including the need for better datasets as well as improved feature engineering.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 最近提出的调用图剪枝技术，利用机器学习预测并减少静态调用图中的误报，已报告了令人印象深刻的结果，并展示了其对下游分析的实用性。然而，当我们研究这些研究项目中数据集的创建方式和评估方式时，我们发现许多可能使报告结果不完整甚至无效的风险因素。我们进一步调查这些因素，并提供实证证据证明它们确实导致误导性结果。受这些发现启发，我们提出对现有调用图剪枝技术进行实证再评估，以评估其有效性。我们首先构建了一个真实世界程序的新数据集，应用三种互补的标注方法，得到41,952个标注。为了全面了解这些技术，我们使用了三种流行的调用图分析框架（WALA、Doop和OPAL）和七种工具配置。我们的结果表明，剪枝并不像先前工作中报告的那样有效，它在提高精确率的同时牺牲了显著的覆盖率。我们进一步跨分析工具和配置训练更通用的模型，并探索数据划分和平衡的影响。我们发现这些模型通常匹配或优于现有的特定配置模型，表明它们在更通用设置中的适用性。最后，我们强调开放挑战和潜在解决方案，包括需要更好的数据集以及改进的特征工程。

upstream_only.title: PyXray: Practical Cross-Language Call Graph Construction through Object Layout Analysis
upstream_only.abstract: A great number of software packages combine code in high-level languages, such as Python, with binary extensions compiled from low-level languages such as C, C++ or Rust to either boost efficiency or enable specific functionalities. In this context, high-level function calls can trigger native (binary) code execution. This setup introduces challenges for call graph generation. Accurate call graphs are essential for various applications, including vulnerability management and software maintenance, as they help track execution paths, assess security risks, and identify unused or redundant code.This work tackles the problem of cross-language call graph construction in Python. Instead of relying on static analysis, which struggles with identifying Python-native interactions, we propose a dynamic analysis technique which does not require inputs to execute code. Our approach is based on two key insights: (1) when a binary extension is imported from Python code, all its objects (e.g., functions) are loaded into memory, and (2) the layout of callable Python objects contains pointers to the native functions they invoke. By analyzing these memory layouts for every loaded object, we identify corresponding graph edges, which link Python functions to the native functions they eventually invoke. This is an essential element for constructing call graphs across language boundaries.We implement this approach in PyXray, a tool that efficiently analyzes massive Python packages such as NumPy and PyTorch in minutes, while significantly outpeforming existing static analysis methods in terms of precision and recall. PyXray enables two key applications: (1) cross-language vulnerability management, by identifying whether a Python package potentially calls a vulnerable native function and (2) cross-language bloat analysis, by quantifying unnecessary code across Python and native components.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大量软件包将Python等高级语言的代码与从C、C++或Rust等低级语言编译的二进制扩展相结合，以提高效率或启用特定功能。在此背景下，高级函数调用可以触发原生（二进制）代码执行。这种设置给调用图生成带来了挑战。准确的调用图对于漏洞管理和软件维护等各种应用至关重要，因为它们有助于跟踪执行路径、评估安全风险并识别未使用或冗余的代码。本工作解决了Python中跨语言调用图构建的问题。我们提出一种动态分析技术，不依赖静态分析（静态分析难以识别Python与原生的交互），且不需要输入来执行代码。我们的方法基于两个关键洞察：(1) 当从Python代码导入二进制扩展时，其所有对象（例如函数）都会被加载到内存中；(2) 可调用Python对象的布局包含指向它们所调用原生函数的指针。通过分析每个已加载对象的内存布局，我们识别出相应的图边，这些边将Python函数链接到它们最终调用的原生函数。这是跨语言边界构建调用图的关键要素。我们在PyXray中实现了该方法，该工具能在几分钟内高效分析NumPy和PyTorch等大型Python包，同时在精度和召回率方面显著优于现有静态分析方法。PyXray支持两个关键应用：(1) 跨语言漏洞管理，通过识别Python包是否可能调用易受攻击的原生函数；(2) 跨语言膨胀分析，通过量化Python和原生组件中不必要的代码。

upstream_only.title: D-BUNDLR: Destructing JavaScript Bundles for Effective Static Analysis
upstream_only.abstract: Static analysis for vulnerability detection in JavaScript is an extensively studied research area. However, state-of-the-art approaches ignore bundling, an emerging development practice, akin to compilation, which allows developers to merge code from different providers, while also applying optimizations to reduce code size. A typical bundle heavily reuses single-letter identifiers and extensively relies on dynamic JavaScript features to emulate code dependencies, thus, hindering static analysis. In this work, we propose a reverse engineering approach that relies on domain-specific code transformations to unpack bundles and replace reidentified libraries with their source code. Our technique applies lightweight static analysis to dissect bundles into individual components, machine learning to identify libraries, and dynamic analysis to verify that libraries were correctly identified. We implement this approach in a tool called D-Bundlr , and evaluate it by comparing the output of CodeQL (a popular static analysis tool) before and after debundling.For a JavaScript code benchmark with known vulnerabilities, our approach allows CodeQL to recover 89\% of the vulnerabilities and 83\% of all alerts that were also detected in the source code, but were dormant in bundles. Similarly, for real-world bundles where we can retrieve the source code, D-Bundlr recovered 33\% of the original alerts. When applied to bundles extracted from the 100,000 most popular websites, D-Bundlr identifies 34,445 instances corresponding to 63 unique libraries, and causes CodeQL to produce around 3.2K more security alerts than on packed bundles. We additionally illustrate how attackers can exploit some of our zero-day findings, causing unwanted security effects such as advertisement space hijacking.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: JavaScript中用于漏洞检测的静态分析是一个被广泛研究的研究领域。然而，最先进的方法忽略了打包（bundling）这一新兴开发实践，它类似于编译，允许开发者合并来自不同提供者的代码，同时应用优化以减小代码体积。典型的打包文件大量复用单字母标识符，并广泛依赖JavaScript动态特性来模拟代码依赖关系，从而阻碍静态分析。在这项工作中，我们提出一种逆向工程方法，依靠领域特定的代码转换来解包打包文件，并用其源代码替换被重新标识的库。我们的技术应用轻量级静态分析将打包文件剖析为各个组件，使用机器学习识别库，并使用动态分析验证库是否被正确识别。我们在一个名为D-Bundlr的工具中实现了该方法，并通过比较CodeQL（一种流行的静态分析工具）在去打包前后输出的结果来评估它。对于包含已知漏洞的JavaScript代码基准，我们的方法使CodeQL能够恢复89%的漏洞以及83%的所有警报，这些警报在源代码中也被检测到，但在打包文件中处于休眠状态。类似地，对于能够检索到源代码的真实世界打包文件，D-Bundlr恢复了33%的原始警报。当应用于从10万个最受欢迎网站提取的打包文件时，D-Bundlr识别出对应于63个唯一库的34,445个实例，并使CodeQL比在打包文件上多产生约3.2K条安全警报。我们进一步说明攻击者如何利用我们的一些零日发现，造成不良安全影响，例如广告位劫持。

upstream_only.title: Precise Static Identification of Ethereum Storage Variables
upstream_only.abstract: Smart contracts are small programs that run autonomously on the blockchain, using it as their persistent memory. The predominant platform for smart contracts is the Ethereum VM (EVM). In EVM smart contracts, a problem with significant applications is to identify data structures (in blockchain state, a.k.a. “storage”), given only the deployed smart contract code. The problem has been highly challenging and has often been considered nearly impossible to address satisfactorily. (For reference, the latest state-of-the-art research tool fails to recover nearly all complex data structures and scales to 50\% of contracts.) Much of the complication is that the main on-chain data structures (mappings and arrays) have their locations derived dynamically through code execution.We propose sophisticated static analysis techniques to solve the identification of on-chain data structures with extremely high fidelity and completeness. Our analysis scales nearly universally and recovers deep data structures. Our techniques are able to identify the exact types of data structures with 95.70\% precision and at least 94.96\% recall, compared to a state-of-the-art tool managing 83.30\% and 55.65\% respectively. Strikingly, the analysis is often more complete than the storage description that the compiler itself produces, with full access to the source code.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 智能合约是在区块链上自主运行的小型程序，并将区块链用作其持久内存。智能合约的主流平台是以太坊虚拟机（EVM）。在EVM智能合约中，一个具有重要应用价值的问题是：仅根据已部署的智能合约代码，识别数据结构（在区块链状态中，也称为“存储”）。这个问题极具挑战性，并且常常被认为几乎无法令人满意地解决。（作为参考，最新的研究工具无法恢复几乎所有复杂数据结构，并且只能扩展到50%的合约。）大部分复杂性在于，主要的链上数据结构（映射和数组）的位置是通过代码执行动态推导出来的。我们提出了复杂的静态分析技术，以极高保真度和完备性解决链上数据结构的识别问题。我们的分析几乎普遍可扩展，并能恢复深层数据结构。我们的技术能够以95.70%的精确率和至少94.96%的召回率识别数据结构的准确类型，而最先进的工具分别只能达到83.30%和55.65%。引人注目的是，该分析通常比编译器本身在拥有完整源代码访问权限时生成的存储描述更加完备。

upstream_only.title: Debugging Performance Issues in WebAssembly Runtimes via Mutation-based Inference
upstream_only.abstract: Performance debugging in WebAssembly (Wasm) runtimes is essential for ensuring the robustness of Wasm, especially since performance issues have frequently occurred in Wasm runtimes, which can significantly degrade the capabilities of hosted services. Many performance issues in Wasm runtimes result from suboptimal compilation of input Wasm programs, for which existing performance debugging methods primarily designed for application-level inefficiencies are not well-suited. In this paper, we present WarpL, a novel mutation-based approach that aims to identify the exact suboptimal instruction sequences responsible for the performance issues in Wasm runtimes, thereby narrowing down the root causes. Specifically, WarpL obtains a functionally similar mutant in which the performance issue does not manifest, and isolates the exact suboptimal instructions by comparing the machine code of the original and mutated programs. We implement WarpL as an open-source tool and evaluate it on 12 real-world performance issues across three widely used Wasm runtimes. WarpL identified the exact causes in 10 out of 12 issues. Notably, we have used WarpL to successfully diagnose six previously unknown performance issues in Wasmtime.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: WebAssembly (Wasm) 运行时中的性能调试对于确保 Wasm 的鲁棒性至关重要，尤其是因为 Wasm 运行时中经常出现性能问题，这些问题会显著降低托管服务的能力。Wasm 运行时中的许多性能问题源于对输入 Wasm 程序的次优编译，而现有主要针对应用级低效的性能调试方法并不适合此类问题。在本文中，我们提出了 WarpL，一种新颖的基于变异的方法，旨在识别导致 Wasm 运行时性能问题的确切次优指令序列，从而缩小根本原因的范围。具体而言，WarpL 获得一个功能相似但性能问题不显现的突变体，并通过比较原始程序和变异程序的机器码来隔离确切的次优指令。我们将 WarpL 实现为开源工具，并在三个广泛使用的 Wasm 运行时中的 12 个真实世界性能问题上进行了评估。WarpL 在 12 个问题中的 10 个中识别出了确切原因。值得注意的是，我们使用 WarpL 成功诊断了 Wasmtime 中六个先前未知的性能问题。

upstream_only.title: Dependency-aware Residual Risk Analysis
upstream_only.abstract: However much we test a software system, some residual risk of undiscovered bugs always remains. If we model test generation as a sampling process, the residual risk can be defined as the probability that the next test input reveals a bug. This risk is upper-bounded by the discovery probability (DP), i.e., the probability that the next test input covers new code, which itself is upper-bounded by the coverage rate, i.e., the expected number of new coverage elements per test input. Prior work introduced the Good-Turing estimator (GoTu) to estimate residual risk via coverage rate. However, we find that GoTu substantially overestimates, leading to undue optimism in bug finding because (i) the coverage rate is only a loose upper bound, and (ii) GoTu ignores dependencies among coverage elements.We propose dependency-aware DP estimation for residual risk analysis. Our estimator directly estimates DP and accounts for dependencies among coverage elements using Ma and Chao’s sample coverage estimation. A naive implementation requires space proportional to the number of coverage elements and executions, which can be prohibitively large. To make it practical, we introduce two optimizations: dependency-aware node removal, which reduces the number of coverage elements to observe, and online singleton cluster maintenance, which eliminates the need to record observed coverage elements in each execution.A comparison of our estimator and GoTu on real-world software from FuzzBench demonstrates a substantial reduction in estimation error. If we stopped the campaign when the estimate of residual risk fell below a certain threshold, GoTu would lead a tester to waste 7 {\texttimes} more time than our estimator before deciding to stop. Our estimator achieves a median absolute error of only one-fifth that of GoTu. Finally, our bug-based analysis shows that our estimator achieves one to two orders of magnitude lower error than GoTu.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 无论我们对软件系统进行多少测试，总会有一些未发现缺陷的剩余风险残留。如果我们把测试生成建模为采样过程，剩余风险可以定义为下一个测试输入揭示缺陷的概率。该风险的上界是发现概率（DP），即下一个测试输入覆盖新代码的概率；而发现概率本身又受覆盖率的上界约束，即每个测试输入预期新增的覆盖元素数量。先前工作引入了Good-Turing估计器（GoTu），通过覆盖率来估计剩余风险。然而，我们发现GoTu会显著高估，导致在缺陷发现方面产生过度乐观，因为：(i) 覆盖率只是一个宽松的上界；(ii) GoTu忽略了覆盖元素之间的依赖关系。我们提出了依赖感知的DP估计，用于剩余风险分析。我们的估计器直接估计DP，并利用Ma和Chao的样本覆盖估计来考虑覆盖元素之间的依赖关系。朴素实现所需的空间与覆盖元素和执行次数成正比，这可能大得令人望而却步。为了使其实用，我们引入了两项优化：依赖感知节点移除，可减少需要观察的覆盖元素数量；以及在线单例簇维护，可消除在每次执行中记录已观察覆盖元素的需要。在FuzzBench的真实软件上，对我们的估计器与GoTu进行比较，结果表明估计误差大幅降低。如果当剩余风险的估计值低于某个阈值时停止测试活动，那么与我们的估计器相比，GoTu会导致测试人员浪费7倍的时间才决定停止。我们的估计器的中位绝对误差仅为GoTu的五分之一。最后，基于缺陷的分析表明，我们的估计器比GoTu的误差低一至两个数量级。

upstream_only.title: Efficient Build Dependency Verification Using eBPF and Incremental Analysis
upstream_only.abstract: Build systems are fundamental to modern software development, but maintaining correct dependency specifications remains a significant challenge. Dependency-related errors, including missing and redundant dependencies, account for over 50\% of build errors in large-scale software projects. Existing tools for detecting such errors suffer from two major limitations: high runtime overhead due to ptrace-based system call tracing, and the need to verify all edges in the build dependency graph. This paper presents mkcheck2, a novel approach that combines extended Berkeley Packet Filter (eBPF)-based system call tracing with incremental analysis to enable efficient dependency verification. Our evaluation on a diverse set of open-source projects demonstrates that mkcheck2 reduces the overhead of dependency error detection by up to 99.7\% compared to existing ptrace-based approaches while maintaining detection accuracy. Across the entire 300-project Make corpus, the incremental analysis technique lowers the mean analysis time per commit from 1267.49 seconds to just 23.56 seconds, making continuous dependency verification practical in real-world development environments.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 构建系统是现代软件开发的基础，但维护正确的依赖规范仍然是一个重大挑战。与依赖相关的错误（包括缺失依赖和冗余依赖）占大型软件项目构建错误的50%以上。现有检测此类错误的工具存在两个主要局限：基于ptrace的系统调用跟踪导致的高运行时开销，以及需要验证构建依赖图中的所有边。本文提出了mkcheck2，一种新颖的方法，它将基于扩展伯克利包过滤器（eBPF）的系统调用跟踪与增量分析相结合，以实现高效的依赖验证。我们在多个开源项目上的评估表明，与现有的基于ptrace的方法相比，mkcheck2将依赖错误检测的开销降低了高达99.7%，同时保持了检测准确性。在整个300个项目的Make语料库上，增量分析技术将每次提交的平均分析时间从1267.49秒降低到仅23.56秒，使得持续的依赖验证在实际开发环境中变得可行。

upstream_only.title: Fine-Grained Analyses for Evolution-Aware Runtime Verification
upstream_only.abstract: Runtime verification (RV) found many bugs by monitoring passing tests in many open-source projects against formal specifications (specs). But, RV is often too slow for use in continuous integration. So, evolution-aware techniques were proposed to speed up RV by re-monitoring only a subset of specs affected by code changes. These techniques use coarse-grained class-level analyses, so they can sub-optimally and imprecisely re-monitor unaffected specs.We propose FineMOP to speed up evolution-aware RV by using fine-grained analyses to re-monitor fewer unaffected specs. The key idea is simple: changes often do not require re-monitoring specs that are only related to unchanged parts of changed classes. We implement six variants of three fine-grained analyses in FineMOP and evaluate them on 1,104 revisions of 68 open-source Java projects. Compared with two class-level techniques, FineMOP is up to 4.86x faster, re-monitors up to 81.04\% fewer specs per revision, and finds 99.68\% of all new violations that these techniques find. Also, FineMOP and Regression Test Selection (RTS) are complementary: combining FineMOP with RTS is faster than FineMOP or RTS alone.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 运行时验证（RV）通过根据形式化规范（specs）监控许多开源项目中通过的测试，发现了许多错误。但RV对于在持续集成中使用来说往往太慢。因此，人们提出了演化感知技术，通过仅重新监控受代码更改影响的规范子集来加速RV。这些技术使用粗粒度的类级分析，因此它们可能次优且不精确地重新监控未受影响的规范。我们提出FineMOP，通过使用细粒度分析来重新监控更少的未受影响规范，从而加速演化感知RV。关键思想很简单：更改通常不需要重新监控仅与已更改类中未更改部分相关的规范。我们在FineMOP中实现了三种细粒度分析的六种变体，并在68个开源Java项目的1,104个修订版本上进行了评估。与两种类级技术相比，FineMOP最高快4.86倍，每个修订版本重新监控的规范最多减少81.04%，并找到这些技术找到的所有新违规的99.68%。此外，FineMOP与回归测试选择（RTS）是互补的：将FineMOP与RTS结合比单独使用FineMOP或RTS更快。

upstream_only.title: Generator Solving for Symbolic Execution
upstream_only.abstract: Automated test input generation based on symbolic execution has garnered significant research interest. However, the main drawback of symbolic execution is its poor scalability. Since the overhead associated with constraint modeling and solving is high, generating only one test input per SMT query is inefficient. In this paper, we introduce the concept of generator solving. Instead of solving for only one particular solution, we propose to find a generator that can be called multiple times to continuously yield new test inputs. This approach offers several benefits: (1) it allows efficient generation of as many test inputs as needed, thereby significantly improving the input generation efficiency of symbolic execution methods; (2) the continuously generated inputs facilitate a more comprehensive exploration of the solution set, potentially triggering new program behaviors; and (3) compared to hybrid approaches based on mutation, using a generator ensures the satisfiability of the target constraints. We present three key techniques for generator solving: (1) reusing invertible model converters in Z3 as generators; (2) constructing hierarchical range-based samplers to sample solutions of range constraints; and (3) employing optimistic simplification strategies to enhance the generality of the solving process. We have implemented GenSlv, a prototypical generator solver specifically designed for automated test case generation based on symbolic execution. Evaluation results demonstrate that (1) GenSlv is effective in finding generators for constraints collected from real-world programs (specifically, GenSlv can find a generator for 97\% of the constraints that have at least two different solutions), and (2) GenSlv significantly and consistently improves the performance of commonly used symbolic executors (including KLEE, Angr, TritonDSE, and SymCC) in terms of program coverage and vulnerability detection across various settings in symbolic execution and hybrid fuzzing tasks, with a maximum of more than twofold increase in branch coverage.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 基于符号执行的自动化测试输入生成已引起广泛研究兴趣。然而，符号执行的主要缺点是可扩展性差。由于约束建模和求解的开销很高，每个SMT查询只生成一个测试输入效率低下。在本文中，我们引入了生成器求解的概念。我们不是只求解一个特定解，而是提出寻找一个生成器，该生成器可以被多次调用以持续产生新的测试输入。这种方法提供了几个好处：(1) 它允许按需高效生成任意数量的测试输入，从而显著提高符号执行方法的输入生成效率；(2) 持续生成的输入促进了对解集的更全面探索，可能触发新的程序行为；(3) 与基于变异的混合方法相比，使用生成器确保了目标约束的可满足性。我们提出了生成器求解的三项关键技术：(1) 重用Z3中的可逆模型转换器作为生成器；(2) 构建基于层次范围的采样器以采样范围约束的解；(3) 采用乐观简化策略以增强求解过程的通用性。我们实现了GenSlv，一个专为基于符号执行的自动化测试用例生成而设计的原型生成器求解器。评估结果表明：(1) GenSlv能有效地为从真实程序中收集的约束找到生成器（具体而言，GenSlv可以为97%的具有至少两个不同解的约束找到生成器）；(2) GenSlv在符号执行和混合模糊测试任务的各种设置中，显著且持续地提高了常用符号执行器（包括KLEE、Angr、TritonDSE和SymCC）在程序覆盖率和漏洞检测方面的性能，分支覆盖率最大提升超过两倍。

upstream_only.title: GPTrace: Effective Crash Deduplication Using LLM Embeddings
upstream_only.abstract: Fuzzing is a highly effective method for uncovering software vulnerabilities, but analyzing the resulting data typically requires substantial manual effort. This is amplified by the fact that fuzzing campaigns often find a large number of crashing inputs, many of which share the same underlying bug. Crash deduplication is the task of finding such duplicate crashing inputs and thereby reducing the data that needs to be examined. Many existing deduplication approaches rely on comparing stack traces or other information that is collected when a program crashes. Although various metrics for measuring the similarity of such pieces of information have been proposed, many do not yield satisfactory deduplication results. In this work, we present GPTrace, a deduplication workflow that leverages a large language model to evaluate the similarity of various data sources associated with crashes by computing embedding vectors and supplying those as input to a clustering algorithm. We evaluate our approach on over 300000 crashing inputs belonging to 50 ground truth labels from 14 different targets. The deduplication results produced by GPTrace show a noticeable improvement over hand-crafted stack trace comparison methods and even more complex state-of-the-art approaches that are less flexible.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 模糊测试是发现软件漏洞的一种非常有效的方法，但分析其产生的数据通常需要大量人工投入。模糊测试活动常常发现大量崩溃输入，而其中许多共享相同的底层缺陷，这进一步加剧了上述问题。崩溃去重正是找出这类重复崩溃输入、从而减少需要检查的数据量的任务。许多现有去重方法依赖于比较栈跟踪或程序崩溃时收集的其他信息。尽管已经提出了多种衡量此类信息相似度的指标，但许多方法并不能产生令人满意的去重结果。在本工作中，我们提出了GPTrace，一种去重工作流，它利用大型语言模型通过计算嵌入向量来评估与崩溃相关的多种数据源的相似度，并将这些嵌入向量作为聚类算法的输入。我们在来自14个不同目标、属于50个真实标签的超过300000个崩溃输入上评估了我们的方法。GPTrace产生的去重结果明显优于手工设计的栈跟踪比较方法，也优于那些灵活性较差但更复杂的先进方法。

upstream_only.title: BFix: Automated Safe Memory-Leak Fixing for Binary Code
upstream_only.abstract: Fixing memory leaks in software is crucial to improving system efficiency, reliability, and stability. Nevertheless, manually fixing memory leaks is not only time-consuming but also prone to errors. Recent research has proposed program repair techniques to fix memory leaks automatically. However, a common limitation of prior techniques is that they cannot tackle memory leaks in binary code. Given the huge popularity of binary code, it is highly necessary to fix its hidden memory leaks. To this end, this paper presents BFix, the first-ever binary-level memory-leak fixing tool. BFix creates effective binary analysis techniques to overcome the unique technical challenges of automatically and safely fixing memory leaks in binaries. Our experimental results show that BFix can achieve promising fixing effectiveness and efficiency, comparable to state-of-the-art source-level fixing tools. Meanwhile, it has a negligible impact on binary code size and performance.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 修复软件中的内存泄漏对于提高系统效率、可靠性和稳定性至关重要。然而，手动修复内存泄漏不仅耗时，而且容易出错。最近的研究提出了自动修复内存泄漏的程序修复技术。然而，先前技术的一个常见局限是它们无法处理二进制代码中的内存泄漏。鉴于二进制代码的广泛流行，修复其隐藏的内存泄漏非常必要。为此，本文提出了BFix，这是首个二进制级内存泄漏修复工具。BFix创建了有效的二进制分析技术，以克服自动且安全地修复二进制文件中内存泄漏的独特技术挑战。我们的实验结果表明，BFix能够实现令人满意的修复效果和效率，与最先进的源代码级修复工具相当。同时，它对二进制代码大小和性能的影响可以忽略不计。

upstream_only.title: Enhancing Symbolic Execution with Self-Configuring Parameters
upstream_only.abstract: We present ({{rmsmall {PARASUIT}}}), a self-configuring technique that enhances symbolic execution by autonomously adjusting its parameters tailored to each program under test. Modern symbolic execution tools are typically equipped with various external parameters to effectively test real-world programs. However, the need for users to fine-tune a multitude of parameters for optimal testing outcomes makes these tools harder to use and limits their potential benefits. Despite recent efforts to improve this tuning process, existing techniques are not self-configuring; they cannot dynamically identify which parameters to tune for each target program, and for each manually selected parameter, they sample a value from a fixed, user-defined set of candidate values that is specific to that parameter and remains unchanged across programs. The goal of this paper is to automatically configure symbolic execution parameters from scratch for each program. To this end, ({{rmsmall {PARASUIT}}}) begins by automatically identifying all available parameters in the symbolic execution tool and evaluating each parameter’s impact through interactions with the tool. It then applies a specialized algorithm to iteratively select promising parameters, construct sampling spaces for each, and update their sampling probabilities based on data accumulated from symbolic execution runs using sampled parameter values. We implemented ({{rmsmall {PARASUIT}}}) on KLEE and assessed it across 12 open-source C programs. The results demonstrate that ({{rmsmall {PARASUIT}}}) significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art method without self-configuring parameters, achieving an average of 26\% higher branch coverage. Remarkably, ({{rmsmall {PARASUIT}}}) identified 11 unique bugs, four of which were exclusively discovered by ({{rmsmall {PARASUIT}}}).
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了PARASUIT，一种自配置技术，通过自主调整参数来增强符号执行，这些参数针对每个被测程序量身定制。现代符号执行工具通常配备各种外部参数以有效测试真实程序。然而，用户需要微调大量参数以获得最佳测试结果，这使得这些工具更难使用，并限制了其潜在收益。尽管最近有改进调参过程的努力，现有技术并非自配置；它们无法动态识别每个目标程序需要调优哪些参数，并且对于每个手动选择的参数，它们从固定的、用户定义的候选值集合中采样一个值，该集合特定于该参数且在不同程序间保持不变。本文的目标是为每个程序从头自动配置符号执行参数。为此，PARASUIT首先自动识别符号执行工具中所有可用参数，并通过与工具交互评估每个参数的影响。然后，它应用一种专门算法，迭代选择有前景的参数，为每个参数构建采样空间，并根据使用采样参数值进行符号执行运行所积累的数据更新其采样概率。我们在KLEE上实现了PARASUIT，并在12个开源C程序上进行了评估。结果表明，PARASUIT显著优于没有自配置参数的最先进方法，平均分支覆盖率提高26%。值得注意的是，PARASUIT识别出11个独特缺陷，其中四个仅由PARASUIT发现。

upstream_only.title: MutDafny: A Mutation-Based Approach to Assess Dafny Specifications
upstream_only.abstract: In verification-aware languages, such as Dafny, despite their critical role, specifications are as prone to errors as implementations. Flaws in specifications can result in formally verified programs that deviate from the intended behavior. In this paper, we explore the use of mutation testing to reveal weaknesses in formal specifications written in Dafny.We present MutDafny, a tool that increases the reliability of Dafny specifications by automatically signaling potential weaknesses. Using a mutation testing approach, we introduce faults (mutations) into the code and rely on formal specifications for detecting them. If a program with a mutant verifies, this may indicate a weakness in the specification. We extensively analyze mutation operators from popular tools, identifying the ones applicable to Dafny. In addition, we synthesize new operators tailored for the language from bugfix commits in publicly available Dafny projects on GitHub. Drawing from both, we equipped our tool with a total of 40 mutation operators. We evaluate MutDafny’s effectiveness and efficiency on a dataset of 794 real-world Dafny programs, and manually analyze a subset of the resulting undetected mutants, identifying five weak real-world specifications (on average, one at every 241 lines of code) that would benefit from strengthening.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在诸如Dafny这类验证感知语言中，尽管规约至关重要，但它们和实现一样容易出错。规约中的缺陷可能导致形式化验证的程序偏离预期行为。本文探索使用变异测试来揭示用Dafny编写的形式化规约中的弱点。我们提出MutDafny，一个通过自动标记潜在弱点来提高Dafny规约可靠性的工具。采用变异测试方法，我们向代码中引入故障（变异），并依赖形式化规约来检测它们。如果带有变异的程序通过验证，这可能表明规约存在弱点。我们广泛分析流行工具中的变异算子，识别适用于Dafny的算子。此外，我们从GitHub上公开Dafny项目的缺陷修复提交中合成针对该语言的新算子。结合两者，我们为工具配备了共40个变异算子。我们在包含794个真实世界Dafny程序的数据集上评估MutDafny的有效性和效率，并人工分析结果中未被检测到的变异体子集，识别出五个薄弱的真实世界规约（平均每241行代码一个），这些规约将受益于加强。

upstream_only.title: Testing Deep Learning Libraries via Neurosymbolic Constraint Learning
upstream_only.abstract: Deep Learning (DL) libraries (e.g., Pytorch) are popular in the development of AI applications. These libraries are complex and contain bugs. Researchers have proposed various bug-finding techniques for such libraries. Yet, there is much room for improvement. A key challenge in testing DL libraries is the lack of API specifications. Prior testing approaches often inaccurately model the input specifications of DL APIs, resulting in missed valid inputs that could reveal bugs or false alarms due to invalid inputs.To address this challenge, we develop Centaur– the first neurosymbolic technique to test DL library APIs using dynamically learned input constraint s. Centaur leverages the key idea that formal API constraints can be learned from a small number of automatically generated seed inputs, and that the learned constraints can be solved using SMT solvers to generate valid and diverse test inputs to test the API.We develop a novel grammar that represents first-order logic formulae over API parameters and expresses tensor-related properties (e.g., shape, tensor data types, etc.) as well as relational properties between parameters. We use the grammar to guide a Large Language Model (LLM) to enumerate syntactically correct candidate rules, which we then validate using the seed inputs. Further, we develop a custom refinement strategy to prune the set of learned rules to eliminate spurious or redundant rules. We use the learned constraints to systematically generate valid and diverse inputs for the API by integrating SMT-based solving with randomized sampling.We evaluate Centaur for testing PyTorch and TensorFlow. Our results show that Centaur’s constraints have a recall of 94.0\% and a precision of 94.0\% on average. In terms of coverage, Centaur covers 203, 150, and 9,608 more branches than TitanFuzz, ACETest and Pathfinder, respectively. Using Centaur, we also detect 26 new bugs in PyTorch and TensorFlow, 18 of which are confirmed.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 深度学习（DL）库（例如 PyTorch）在人工智能应用开发中很受欢迎。这些库很复杂并且包含错误。研究人员已经为这类库提出了各种错误发现技术。然而，仍有很大的改进空间。测试 DL 库的一个关键挑战是缺乏 API 规范。先前的测试方法往往不准确地建模 DL API 的输入规范，导致错过可能揭示错误的有效输入，或者由于无效输入而产生误报。为了解决这一挑战，我们开发了 Centaur——第一个利用动态学习的输入约束来测试 DL 库 API 的神经符号技术。Centaur 利用的关键思想是：形式化的 API 约束可以从少量自动生成的种子输入中学习得到，并且学习到的约束可以使用 SMT 求解器求解，以生成有效且多样的测试输入来测试 API。我们开发了一种新的文法，它表示 API 参数上的一阶逻辑公式，并表达张量相关的属性（例如形状、张量数据类型等）以及参数之间的关系属性。我们使用该文法指导大型语言模型（LLM）枚举语法正确的候选规则，然后使用种子输入验证这些规则。此外，我们开发了一种定制精化策略，以修剪学习到的规则集，消除虚假或冗余规则。我们通过将基于 SMT 的求解与随机采样相结合，使用学习到的约束为 API 系统地生成有效且多样的输入。我们评估了 Centaur 在测试 PyTorch 和 TensorFlow 上的表现。我们的结果表明，Centaur 的约束平均召回率为 94.0%，精确率为 94.0%。在覆盖率方面，Centaur 分别比 TitanFuzz、ACETest 和 Pathfinder 多覆盖 203、150 和 9,608 个分支。使用 Centaur，我们还在 PyTorch 和 TensorFlow 中检测到 26 个新错误，其中 18 个已确认。

upstream_only.title: On Interaction Effects in Greybox Fuzzing
upstream_only.abstract: A greybox fuzzer is an automated software testing tool that generates new test inputs by applying randomly chosen mutators (e.g., flipping a bit or deleting a block of bytes) to a seed input in random order and adds all coverage-increasing inputs to the corpus of seeds. We hypothesize that the order in which mutators are applied to a seed input has an impact on the effectiveness of greybox fuzzers. In our experiments, we fit a linear model to a dataset that contains the effectiveness of all possible mutator pairs and indeed observe the conjectured interaction effect. This points us to more efficient fuzzing by choosing the most promising mutator sequence with a higher likelihood.We propose MuoFuzz, a greybox fuzzer that learns and chooses the most promising mutator sequences. MuoFuzz learns the conditional probability that the next mutator will yield an interesting input, given the previously selected mutator. Then, it samples from the learned probability using a random walk to generate mutator sequences. We compare the performance of MuoFuzz to AFL++, which uses a fixed selection probability, and MOPT, which optimizes the selection probability of each mutator in isolation. Experimental results on the FuzzBench and MAGMA benchmarks show that MuoFuzz achieves the highest code coverage and finds four bugs missed by AFL++ and one missed by both AFL++ and MOPT. Data and material: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17391100
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 灰盒模糊测试器是一种自动化软件测试工具，它通过以随机顺序对种子输入应用随机选择的变异器（例如翻转一个比特或删除一个字节块）来生成新的测试输入，并将所有能增加覆盖率的输入加入种子语料库。我们假设对种子输入应用变异器的顺序会影响灰盒模糊测试器的有效性。在实验中，我们对一个包含所有可能变异器对的有效性的数据集拟合线性模型，确实观察到了所推测的交互效应。这指引我们通过以更高概率选择最有前景的变异器序列来实现更高效的模糊测试。我们提出了 MuoFuzz，一种学习并选择最有前景的变异器序列的灰盒模糊测试器。MuoFuzz 学习在给定先前选择的变异器的情况下，下一个变异器将产生有趣输入的条件概率。然后，它使用随机游走从学习到的概率中采样以生成变异器序列。我们将 MuoFuzz 的性能与使用固定选择概率的 AFL++ 和单独优化每个变异器选择概率的 MOPT 进行比较。在 FuzzBench 和 MAGMA 基准上的实验结果表明，MuoFuzz 实现了最高的代码覆盖率，并发现了四个 AFL++ 遗漏的缺陷以及一个 AFL++ 和 MOPT 都遗漏的缺陷。数据和材料：https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17391100

upstream_only.title: How Good are Input Grammar Miners? An Empirical Study
upstream_only.abstract: To generate valid test inputs for a system, one needs a specification of its input language—typically a context-free grammar that describes input syntax. But where can one get such a grammar from? In the past years, the field of input grammar mining has emerged, with creative approaches to extract input grammars from inputs, code, or both. But how good are these approaches? In particular; How accurate are the grammars they mine?In this study, we systematically evaluate grammar miners for these questions. Notably, we find that the previous evaluations conducted by the respective authors—producing a set of inputs from a golden grammar and having them checked by the mined grammar, or vice versa—are insufficient, as they have a strong bias towards short, possibly unrealistic inputs. We therefore also measure the diversity of the mined grammars using k-path coverage with varying depths k to find how many combinations of grammar elements are actually represented.Ideally, a mined grammar should have perfect precision and recall regardless of the depth k. However, our results show that for all approaches presented so far, precision and recall can drop significantly compared to reported results when increasing k and thus checking for “deeper” diversity, especially for complex input languages such as Lisp, JSON, or Tiny-C. For instance, the Tiny-C grammar mined by Arvada achieves a precision of 75\% when considering k-paths with k = 1 (the originally reported precision was 73\%), but this drops to 46\% for k = 5. White-box approaches based on program analysis, such as Mimid and Stalagmite, are more stable with varying depth k, but can be challenged by complex parsers such as mjs. Raising the bars for evaluation, our study shows that there is still room for improvement in grammar mining.
upstream_only.abstract_zh:
为了为系统生成有效的测试输入，需要其输入语言的规范——通常是描述输入语法的上下文无关文法。但这样的文法从何而来？过去几年，输入文法挖掘领域已经出现，提出了从输入、代码或两者中提取输入文法的创造性方法。但这些方法有多好？特别是，它们挖掘的文法有多准确？
在本研究中，我们系统地评估文法挖掘器以回答这些问题。值得注意的是，我们发现各自作者先前进行的评估——从黄金文法生成一组输入并用挖掘的文法检查它们，或反之——是不充分的，因为它们强烈偏向于短的、可能不现实的输入。因此，我们还使用不同深度 k 的 k-路径覆盖来测量挖掘文法的多样性，以发现文法元素的多少组合实际上被表示出来。
理想情况下，挖掘的文法应在任何深度 k 下都具有完美的精确率和召回率。然而，我们的结果表明，对于迄今为止提出的所有方法，当增加 k 并因此检查“更深”的多样性时，精确率和召回率与报告结果相比可能显著下降，特别是对于复杂输入语言如 Lisp、JSON 或 Tiny-C。例如，Arvada 挖掘的 Tiny-C 文法在考虑 k = 1 的 k-路径时达到 75% 的精确率（最初报告的精确率为 73%），但当 k = 5 时下降到 46%。基于程序分析的白盒方法，如 Mimid 和 Stalagmite，在不同深度 k 下更稳定，但可能受到复杂解析器（如 mjs）的挑战。提高评估标准，我们的研究表明文法挖掘仍有改进空间。

upstream_only.title: LoopSCC: Summarizing Complex Multi-branch Nested Loops via Periodic Oscillation Interval
upstream_only.abstract: Analyzing programs with loops is a challenging task, suffering from potential issues such as the indeterminate number of iterations and exponential growth of control flow complexity. Loop summarization based on static symbolic analysis receives increasing focus in the field of loop program analysis. However, current loop summarization methods are only suitable for single-branch loops or multi-branch loops with simple cycles and fail to handle complex multi-branch nested loops with intricate non-functional variables and irregular jumps between multiple branches.In this paper, we propose a novel loop summarization approach based on symbolic analysis to address the complex loops mentioned above and develop a tool named LoopSCC. For a non-nested loop, LoopSCC constructs an SPath Graph, where each node represents a path from entry to exit of the control flow graph of the loop and contracts it to an acyclic graph by collapsing each strongly connected component (SCC) into a single node. The summarization of a loop is the disjunction of the summaries of each path in the acyclic graph. For non-functional variables and irregular jumps, we iteratively model a valid value and refine the conditions until reaching the minimum. We introduce the oscillation interval, within which SPaths in the SCC can jump between one another. Outside this interval, no such jumps occur. This allows us to transform loop iteration transitions into a piecewise function, then summarize the interest variables according to the piecewise function. For nested loops, we construct summaries using the approaches above and apply them sequentially from the innermost loop to the outermost.Comparing state-of-the-art loop summarization tools, LoopSCC can handle more types of loops with 100\% precision. We integrated LoopSCC with the symbolic execution tool, Angr, to enhance its efficiency, which enabled the detection of 18 previously unknown vulnerabilities across 11 IoT projects, 7 of which were assigned CVEs. The LoopSCC is publicly available at https://github.com/hahaleyile/LoopSCC.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 分析带有循环的程序是一项具有挑战性的任务，面临迭代次数不确定和控制流复杂度指数增长等潜在问题。基于静态符号分析的循环概括在循环程序分析领域受到越来越多的关注。然而，当前的循环概括方法仅适用于单分支循环或具有简单环的多分支循环，无法处理具有复杂非功能变量和多分支间不规则跳转的复杂多分支嵌套循环。本文提出了一种基于符号分析的新型循环概括方法，以处理上述复杂循环，并开发了名为LoopSCC的工具。对于非嵌套循环，LoopSCC构造一个SPath图，其中每个节点表示循环控制流图从入口到出口的一条路径，并通过将每个强连通分量（SCC）收缩为单个节点，将其收缩为无环图。循环的概括是无环图中每条路径概括的析取。对于非功能变量和不规则跳转，我们迭代地建模一个有效值并细化条件，直到达到最小值。我们引入振荡区间，在该区间内SCC中的SPath可以相互跳转；在该区间之外，不会发生此类跳转。这使我们能够将循环迭代转移转化为分段函数，然后根据分段函数概括感兴趣的变量。对于嵌套循环，我们使用上述方法构造概括，并从最内层循环到最外层循环依次应用。与最先进的循环概括工具相比，LoopSCC能够以100%的精度处理更多类型的循环。我们将LoopSCC与符号执行工具Angr集成以提高其效率，从而在11个IoT项目中检测到18个先前未知的漏洞，其中7个被分配了CVE。LoopSCC公开可用：https://github.com/hahaleyile/LoopSCC。

upstream_only.title: On the Robustness of Fairness Practices: A Causal Framework for Systematic Evaluation
upstream_only.abstract: Machine learning (ML) algorithms are increasingly deployed to make critical decisions in socioeconomic applications such as finance, criminal justice, and autonomous driving. However, due to their data-driven and pattern-seeking nature, ML algorithms may develop decision logic that disproportionately distributes opportunities, benefits, resources, or information among different population groups, potentially harming marginalized communities. In response to such fairness concerns, the software engineering and ML communities have made significant efforts to establish the best practices for creating fair ML software. These include fairness interventions for training ML models, such as including sensitive features, selecting non-sensitive attributes, and applying bias mitigators. But how reliably can software professionals tasked with developing data-driven systems depend on these recommendations? And how well do these practices generalize in the presence of faulty labels, missing data, or distribution shifts? These questions form the core theme of this paper.We present a testing tool and technique based on causality theory to assess the robustness of best practices in fair ML software development. Given a practice—specified as a first-order logic property— and a socio-critical dataset that satisfies the property, our goal is to search for neighborhood datasets to determine whether the property continues to hold. This process is akin to testing the robustness of a neural network for image classification, except that the “image" is an entire dataset, and its “neighbors" are datasets in which certain causal hypotheses are altered. Since computing neighborhood datasets while accounting for various factors—such as noise, faulty labeling, and demographic shifts—is challenging, we utilize causal graph representations of the dataset and leverage a search algorithm to explore equivalent causal graphs to generate datasets. Our results across various fairness-sensitive tasks, derived from prevalent fairness-sensitive applications, identify best practices that preserve robustness under the varying factors.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 机器学习（ML）算法越来越多地被部署用于在金融、刑事司法和自动驾驶等社会经济应用中做出关键决策。然而，由于其数据驱动和模式寻求的特性，ML算法可能发展出在不同人口群体之间不成比例地分配机会、利益、资源或信息的决策逻辑，从而可能伤害边缘化社区。针对此类公平性关切，软件工程和ML社区已做出重大努力，以建立创建公平ML软件的最佳实践。这些实践包括训练ML模型的公平性干预措施，例如包含敏感特征、选择非敏感属性以及应用偏差缓解器。但是，负责开发数据驱动系统的软件专业人员能在多大程度上可靠地依赖这些建议？在存在错误标签、缺失数据或分布偏移的情况下，这些实践又能多好地泛化？这些问题构成了本文的核心主题。我们提出了一种基于因果理论的测试工具和技术，以评估公平ML软件开发中最佳实践的鲁棒性。给定一个实践——指定为一阶逻辑属性——以及一个满足该属性的社会关键数据集，我们的目标是搜索邻域数据集，以确定该属性是否仍然成立。这个过程类似于测试图像分类神经网络的鲁棒性，只是这里的“图像”是整个数据集，而其“邻居”是改变某些因果假设的数据集。由于在考虑噪声、错误标注和人口结构变化等各种因素的同时计算邻域数据集具有挑战性，我们利用数据集的因果图表示，并利用搜索算法探索等价的因果图来生成数据集。我们在来自常见公平敏感应用的各种公平敏感任务上的结果，识别出了在不同因素下保持鲁棒性的最佳实践。

upstream_only.title: Context-Free Property Oriented Fuzzing
upstream_only.abstract: Fuzzing is effective for finding software bugs. However, the bugs specified in context-free properties are difficult for the existing fuzzers. These bugs are triggered when the program execution contains specific sequences of operations, e.g., push and pop operations on the stack, and locking and unlocking operations on the lock. As far as we know, existing approaches do not support fuzzing for non-regular context-free properties, which are more expressive and can be used to specify bugs in many scenarios.This paper proposes a general runtime monitoring-based fuzzing framework for the bugs expressed as context-free properties. We propose two algorithms to improve fuzzing’s effectiveness and efficiency with respect to the context-free property. The algorithm for preserving input mutants leverages the state transition information of the property’s monitors. The other algorithm for mutating the input seed combines control flow information with state transition information to prioritize the different parts of the input. We have implemented our framework CFPOFuzz for C/C++ programs. The results of the extensive experiments on real-world C/C++ programs indicate our method’s effectiveness and efficiency. Compared with coverage-oriented fuzzing, our method achieves 3.83x speedups for generating the first target input triggering the bugs. Our method found 7 unknown zero-day bugs.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 模糊测试在发现软件缺陷方面十分有效。然而，现有模糊测试器难以发现以上下文无关属性描述的缺陷。这类缺陷在程序执行包含特定操作序列时被触发，例如栈上的压栈与弹栈操作、锁上的加锁与解锁操作。据我们所知，现有方法不支持针对非正则上下文无关属性的模糊测试，而这类属性表达力更强，可用于描述许多场景中的缺陷。本文提出了一种通用的、基于运行时监控的模糊测试框架，用于处理以上下文无关属性表达的缺陷。我们提出两种算法来提升针对上下文无关属性的模糊测试的有效性和效率。保留输入变异体的算法利用了属性监控器的状态转移信息。另一种变异输入种子的算法结合控制流信息和状态转移信息来优先处理输入的不同部分。我们为C/C++程序实现了该框架CFPOFuzz。在真实C/C++程序上的大量实验结果表明了我们方法的有效性和效率。与面向覆盖率的模糊测试相比，我们的方法在生成第一个触发缺陷的目标输入时实现了3.83倍的加速。我们的方法发现了7个未知的零日缺陷。

upstream_only.title: Session Summary Podcast: Session 52: Testing and Analysis 8
upstream_only.abstract: An AI-generated podcast companion article to augment the Testing and Analysis 8 Session of the ICSE '26NOTE: AI content can contain errors and should be double-checked before use.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 一篇由AI生成的播客伴随文章，用于补充ICSE '26的测试与分析8分会。注意：AI内容可能包含错误，使用前应仔细核对。

upstream_only.title: Is My RPC Response Reliable? Detecting RPC Bugs in Blockchain Client under Context
upstream_only.abstract: Blockchain clients are fundamental software for running blockchain nodes. They provide users with various RPC (Remote Procedure Call) interfaces to interact with the blockchain. These RPC methods are expected to follow the same specification across different blockchain nodes, providing users with seamless interaction. However, there have been continuous reports on various RPC bugs that can cause unexpected responses or even Denial of Service weaknesses. Existing studies on blockchain RPC bug detection mainly focus on generating the RPC method calls for testing blockchain clients. However, a wide range of the reported RPC bugs are triggered in various blockchain contexts. To the best of our knowledge, little attention is paid to generating proper contexts that can trigger these context-dependent RPC bugs.In this work, we propose EthCRAFT, a Context-aware RPC Analysis and Fuzzing Tool for client RPC bug detection. EthCRAFT first proposes to explore the state transition program space of blockchain clients and generate various transactions to construct the context. EthCRAFT then designs a context-aware RPC method call generation method to send RPC calls to the blockchain clients. The responses of five different client implementations are used as cross-referencing oracles to detect the RPC bugs. We evaluate EthCRAFT on real-world RPC bugs collected from the GitHub issues of Ethereum client implementations. Experiment results show that EthCRAFT outperforms existing client RPC detectors by detecting more RPC bugs. Moreover, EthCRAFT has found six new bugs in major Ethereum clients and reported them to the developers. One of the bug fixes has been written into breaking changes in the client’s updates. Three of our bug reports have been offered a vulnerability bounty by the Ethereum Foundation.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 区块链客户端是运行区块链节点的基础软件。它们为用户提供了各种RPC（远程过程调用）接口以与区块链交互。这些RPC方法在不同区块链节点之间应遵循相同的规范，为用户提供无缝交互。然而，不断有报道指出各种RPC漏洞可能导致意外响应甚至拒绝服务弱点。现有的区块链RPC漏洞检测研究主要集中于生成RPC方法调用来测试区块链客户端。然而，大量已报告的RPC漏洞是在各种区块链上下文中触发的。据我们所知，很少有人关注生成能够触发这些依赖于上下文的RPC漏洞的适当上下文。在这项工作中，我们提出了EthCRAFT，一种用于客户端RPC漏洞检测的上下文感知RPC分析与模糊测试工具。EthCRAFT首先提出探索区块链客户端的状态转移程序空间，并生成各种交易来构造上下文。然后，EthCRAFT设计了一种上下文感知的RPC方法调用生成方法，向区块链客户端发送RPC调用。五种不同客户端实现的响应被用作交叉引用预言机来检测RPC漏洞。我们在从以太坊客户端实现的GitHub问题中收集的真实世界RPC漏洞上评估了EthCRAFT。实验结果表明，EthCRAFT通过检测更多RPC漏洞，优于现有的客户端RPC检测器。此外，EthCRAFT在主要以太坊客户端中发现了六个新漏洞，并已报告给开发者。其中一个错误修复已被写入客户端更新中的破坏性更改。我们的三份漏洞报告已获得以太坊基金会提供的漏洞赏金。

upstream_only.title: An Empirical Study on Static Application Security Testing (SAST) Tools for Python
upstream_only.abstract: Python is currently the most popular programming language and ensuring the security of Python applications has become a critical concern. Static Application Security Testing (SAST) tools have been introduced to address this need, claiming to support a wide range of Common Weakness Enumerations (CWEs). However, the ability of these tools to detect real-world vulnerabilities in Python programs has not been comprehensively evaluated.In this paper, we selected eight SAST tools from 117 existing ones based on well-designed criteria. Based on the synthetic and real-world dataset, we evaluated and compared these SAST tools from different perspectives including effectiveness and efficiency. Our results reveal significant limitations in current SAST tools: although perform well on the synthetic dataset, a single tool detects no more than 40\% of the vulnerabilities in our real-world dataset. Even when aggregating the outputs of all evaluated tools, only 66.7\% of the real-world vulnerabilities are identified. To further understand these shortcomings, we performed a root cause analysis of the detection results and identified useful insights for both SAST tool designers and users, focusing on tool development, evaluation, and selection.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Python 目前是最流行的编程语言，确保 Python 应用程序的安全已成为一个关键问题。静态应用程序安全测试（SAST）工具已被引入以满足这一需求，声称支持广泛的常见弱点枚举（CWE）。然而，这些工具在检测 Python 程序中真实世界漏洞方面的能力尚未得到全面评估。在本文中，我们根据精心设计的标准，从 117 个现有工具中选择了 8 个 SAST 工具。基于合成数据集和真实世界数据集，我们从有效性和效率等不同角度评估和比较了这些 SAST 工具。我们的结果揭示了当前 SAST 工具的重大局限性：尽管在合成数据集上表现良好，但单个工具在真实世界数据集中检测到的漏洞不超过 40%。即使聚合所有被评估工具的输出，也只能识别出 66.7% 的真实世界漏洞。为了进一步理解这些不足，我们对检测结果进行了根因分析，并为 SAST 工具设计者和用户识别了有用的见解，重点关注工具开发、评估和选择。

upstream_only.title: PTV: Scalable Version Detection of Web Libraries and its Security Application
upstream_only.abstract: Identifying the libraries used by a web application is an important task for sales intelligence, website profiling, and web security analysis. Recent work uses tree structures to represent the property relationships of the library at runtime, realizing automatic library identification without pinpointing versions. But when assessing the security risks associated with these web libraries or conducting fine-grained software analysis, it becomes essential to determine the specific version of the library in use. However, existing tree-based methods are not directly applicable to version detection due to the huge storage requirements for maintaining separate trees for a large number of versions. This paper proposes a novel algorithm to find the most unique structure out of each tree in a forest so that the footprint of the features can be greatly minimized. We implement this algorithm into a web library detection tool. Experimental evaluations on 556 web libraries, encompassing 30,810 versions, reveal that our tool reduces space requirements by up to 99\%, achieves more precise version detection compared to existing tools, and detects 190 vulnerabilities on 200 top-traffic websites.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 识别Web应用程序所使用的库对于销售情报、网站画像和Web安全分析是一项重要任务。近期工作使用树结构来表示库在运行时的属性关系，实现了无需精确定位版本的自动库识别。但在评估与这些Web库相关的安全风险或进行细粒度软件分析时，确定正在使用的库的具体版本变得至关重要。然而，由于要为大量版本维护独立树需要巨大的存储需求，现有的基于树的方法无法直接应用于版本检测。本文提出了一种新颖算法，从森林中的每棵树中找出最独特的结构，从而可以极大地最小化特征的足迹。我们将该算法实现为一个Web库检测工具。在涵盖30,810个版本的556个Web库上进行的实验评估表明，我们的工具将空间需求最多降低了99%，与现有工具相比实现了更精确的版本检测，并在200个高流量网站上检测到190个漏洞。

upstream_only.title: Hallucinating Certificates: Differential Testing of TLS Certificate Validation Using Generative Language Models
upstream_only.abstract: Certificate validation is a crucial step in Transport Layer Security (TLS), the de facto standard network security protocol. Prior research has shown that differentially testing TLS implementations with synthetic certificates can reveal critical security issues, such as accidentally accepting untrusted certificates. Leveraging known techniques, like random input mutations and program coverage guidance, prior work created corpora of synthetic certificates. By testing the certificates with multiple TLS libraries and comparing the validation outcomes, they discovered new bugs. However, they cannot generate the corresponding inputs efficiently, or they require to model the programs and their inputs in ways that scale poorly.In this paper, we introduce a new approach, MLCerts, to generate synthetic certificates for differential testing that leverages generative language models to more extensively test software implementations. Recently, these models have become (in)famous for their applications in generating content, writing code, and conversing with users, as well as for “hallucinating” syntactically correct yet semantically nonsensical output. In this paper, we provide and leverage two novel insights: (a) TLS certificates can be expressed in natural-like language, namely in the X.509 standard that aids human readability, and (b) differential testing can benefit from hallucinated malformed test cases. Using our approach MLCerts, we find significantly more distinct discrepancies between the five TLS implementations OpenSSL, LibreSSL, GnuTLS, MbedTLS, and MatrixSSL than the state-of-the-art benchmark Transcert (+30\%; 20 vs 26, out of a maximum possible of 30) and an order of magnitude more than the seminal work Frankencerts (+1,200\%; 2 vs 26). Finally, we show that the diversity of MLCerts -generated certificates reveals a range of previously unobserved and interesting behavior with security implications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 证书验证是传输层安全（TLS）——事实上的标准网络安全协议——中的关键步骤。先前研究表明，使用合成证书对TLS实现进行差分测试可以揭示关键安全问题，例如意外接受不受信任的证书。利用随机输入变异和程序覆盖率引导等已知技术，先前工作创建了合成证书语料库。通过用多个TLS库测试这些证书并比较验证结果，他们发现了新漏洞。然而，他们无法高效地生成相应的输入，或者需要以难以扩展的方式对程序及其输入进行建模。本文中，我们介绍一种新方法MLCerts，用于生成用于差分测试的合成证书，该方法利用生成式语言模型来更广泛地测试软件实现。最近，这些模型因其在生成内容、编写代码和与用户对话方面的应用，以及因“幻觉”出语法正确但语义无意义的输出而（不）著名。本文中，我们提供并利用两个新颖见解：(a) TLS证书可以用类自然语言表达，即X.509标准有助于人类可读性；(b) 差分测试可以从幻觉出的畸形测试用例中受益。使用我们的方法MLCerts，我们在五个TLS实现OpenSSL、LibreSSL、GnuTLS、MbedTLS和MatrixSSL之间发现的明显差异显著多于最先进的基准Transcert（+30%；MLCerts为26，Transcert为20，最大可能为30），并且比开创性工作Frankencerts多一个数量级（+1,200%；MLCerts为26，Frankencerts为2）。最后，我们表明MLCerts生成的证书的多样性揭示了一系列先前未观察到且具有安全影响的有趣行为。

upstream_only.title: Same Same But Different: Preventing Refactoring Attacks on Software Plagiarism Detection
upstream_only.abstract: Plagiarism detection in programming education faces growing challenges due to increasingly sophisticated obfuscation techniques, particularly automated refactoring-based attacks. While code plagiarism detection systems used in education practice are resilient against basic obfuscation, they struggle against structural modifications that preserve program behavior, especially caused by refactoring-based obfuscation.This paper presents a novel and extensible framework that enhances state-of-the-art detectors by leveraging code property graphs and graph transformations to counteract refactoring-based obfuscation. Our comprehensive evaluation of real-world student submissions, obfuscated using both algorithmic and AI-based obfuscation attacks, demonstrates a significant improvement in detecting plagiarized code.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 编程教育中的抄袭检测面临日益严峻的挑战，因为混淆技术日益复杂，尤其是自动化的基于重构的攻击。尽管教育实践中使用的代码抄袭检测系统对基本混淆具有鲁棒性，但它们难以应对保持程序行为的结构修改，特别是由基于重构的混淆引起的修改。本文提出了一种新颖且可扩展的框架，利用代码属性图和图变换来增强最先进的检测器，以对抗基于重构的混淆。我们对真实学生提交作品进行了全面评估，这些作品使用基于算法和基于AI的混淆攻击进行了混淆，结果表明在检测抄袭代码方面有显著改进。

upstream_only.title: Boosting Gas Revenues of Ethereum Miners
upstream_only.abstract: In cryptocurrency networks, transaction-fee revenue serves as the primary financial incentive for miners to participate in the consensus mechanism, securing the network by validating transactions and extending the blockchain. Maximizing this revenue is therefore a key optimization problem for miners. While this has been studied for UTXO blockchains like Bitcoin, where transaction fees are fixed, we focus on Ethereum, where the challenge is significantly greater. On Ethereum, the fee paid by a transaction depends on its execution cost (gas), which can change based on the ordering of preceding transactions in a block. This creates a combinatorial explosion, as miners must select not only a subset of transactions but also their optimal permutation to maximize revenue.In this work, we present a randomized framework to address this problem. Our approach first uses randomized testing, executing sample permutations of pending transactions to profile their gas usage. From this data, we employ decision trees to learn transaction interdependencies, identifying a small “neighborhood” of transactions that influence each other’s execution costs. These dependencies are then encoded as a set of logical rules that predict gas usage based on local transaction ordering. Finally, we translate these rules and other constraints (e.g., block gas limit, nonce ordering) into an integer linear programming (ILP) instance, which we solve to find a block composition that maximizes total tip revenue. Our experimental results demonstrate significant gains: our method outperforms real-world Ethereum miners by an average of 73.45 percent per block, which corresponds to roughly 63 million USD per annum.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在加密货币网络中，交易费收入是矿工参与共识机制的主要经济激励，他们通过验证交易和扩展区块链来保障网络安全。因此，最大化该收入是矿工的关键优化问题。虽然针对比特币等交易费固定的UTXO区块链已有研究，但我们关注以太坊，其中挑战要大得多。在以太坊上，一笔交易支付的费用取决于其执行成本（gas），而这可能因区块中前序交易的排序而改变。这造成了组合爆炸，因为矿工不仅必须选择交易子集，还必须选择其最优排列以最大化收入。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个随机化框架来解决该问题。我们的方法首先使用随机测试，执行待处理交易的样本排列以分析其gas使用情况。根据这些数据，我们使用决策树学习交易间的相互依赖关系，识别出一小部分会相互影响执行成本的交易“邻域”。然后，将这些依赖关系编码为一组逻辑规则，根据局部交易排序预测gas使用量。最后，我们将这些规则和其他约束（例如区块gas上限、nonce顺序）转换为一个整数线性规划（ILP）实例，并求解该实例以找到使总小费收入最大化的区块组成。我们的实验结果表明收益显著：我们的方法平均每个区块比真实以太坊矿工高出73.45%，相当于每年约6300万美元。

upstream_only.title: Context-Free Grammar Inference for Complex Programming Languages in Black Box Settings
upstream_only.abstract: Grammar inference for complex programming languages remains a significant challenge, as existing approaches fail to scale to real-world datasets within practical time constraints. In our experiments, none of the state-of-the-art tools, including Arvada, Treevada and Kedavra were able to infer grammars for complex languages such as C, C++, and Java within 48 hours. Arvada and Treevada perform grammar inference directly on full-length input examples, which proves inefficient for large files commonly found in such languages. While Kedavra introduces data decomposition to create shorter examples for grammar inference, its lexical analysis still relies on the original inputs. Additionally, its strict no-overgeneralization constraint limits the construction of complex grammars.To overcome these limitations, we propose Crucio, which builds a decomposition forest to extract short examples for lexical and grammar inference via a distributional matrix. Experimental results show that Crucio is the only method capable of successfully inferring grammars for complex programming languages (where the number of nonterminals is up to 23 {\texttimes} greater than in prior benchmarks) within reasonable time limits. On the prior simple benchmark, Crucio achieves an average recall improvement of 1.37 {\texttimes} and 1.19 {\texttimes} over Treevada and Kedavra, respectively, and improves F1 scores by 1.21 {\texttimes} and 1.13 {\texttimes}.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 复杂编程语言的文法推断仍然是一项重大挑战，因为现有方法无法在实际时间限制内扩展到现实世界的数据集。在我们的实验中，包括Arvada、Treevada和Kedavra在内的最先进工具均无法在48小时内推断出C、C++和Java等复杂语言的文法。Arvada和Treevada直接对全长输入示例进行文法推断，这对于此类语言中常见的大文件来说效率低下。虽然Kedavra引入了数据分解来创建更短的示例以进行文法推断，但其词法分析仍然依赖原始输入。此外，其严格的无过度泛化约束限制了复杂文法的构建。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了Crucio，它构建分解森林以通过分布矩阵提取用于词法和文法推断的短示例。实验结果表明，Crucio是唯一能够在合理时间限制内成功推断复杂编程语言文法的方法（其中非终结符数量比先前基准多出高达23倍）。在之前的简单基准上，Crucio的平均召回率分别比Treevada和Kedavra提高了1.37倍和1.19倍，F1分数分别提高了1.21倍和1.13倍。

upstream_only.title: No Shot in the Dark: Efficient Context-Free Language Reachability via Context-Aware Tabulation
upstream_only.abstract: Context-free language (CFL) reachability is a widely used framework for formulating static program analyses. Operating over edge-labeled graphs, the standard algorithm performs context-free tabulation by iteratively deriving new edges that summarize paths whose labels conform to the production rules of a context-free grammar. However, as the term “context-free” suggests, these derivations are made without considering the surrounding context of inferred edges, often resulting in unproductive edges that do not contribute to the final reachability result.In this paper, we present context-aware tabulation (CAT), a novel approach that incorporates a restricted form of context sensitivity into CFL-reachability analysis to eliminate such unproductive edges. Comprehensive experiments on three widely studied clients show that CAT significantly accelerates reachability solving—achieving speedups of 1.67 {\texttimes} , 1.41 {\texttimes} , and 1.98 {\texttimes} —and also reduces memory usage by 33.20\%, 24.16\%, and 50.01\%, respectively, compared to a state-of-the-art solver.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 上下文无关语言（CFL）可达性是用于表述静态程序分析的广泛使用框架。它在带边标签的图上操作，标准算法通过迭代推导新边来执行上下文无关制表，这些新边概括了标签符合上下文无关文法产生式规则的路径。然而，正如“上下文无关”一词所暗示的，这些推导没有考虑所推导边的周围上下文，常常导致无生产力的边，这些边对最终可达性结果没有贡献。在本文中，我们提出了上下文感知制表（CAT），一种新颖的方法，它将受限形式的上下文敏感性纳入CFL可达性分析，以消除此类无生产力的边。在三个广泛研究的客户端上的综合实验表明，与最先进的求解器相比，CAT显著加速了可达性求解——分别实现了1.67倍、1.41倍和1.98倍的加速——并且还将内存使用分别降低了33.20%、24.16%和50.01%。

upstream_only.title: SymRadar: PoC-Centered Bounded Verification for Vulnerability Repair
upstream_only.abstract: In this paper, we tackle the problem of patch verification. While automated vulnerability repair (AVR) techniques are gaining traction, it is not sufficient to merely generate patches; providing evidence of their correctness is also essential. However, the current state-of-the-art patch verification methods are not sufficiently effective. To address this issue, we present SymRadar, a patch verification tool based on under-constrained symbolic execution (UC-SE). What distinguishes SymRadar from existing patch verification techniques is its use of function-level symbolic execution with inputs centered around the provided proof-of-concept (PoC) input. As demonstrated in our evaluation, this PoC-centered symbolic execution is effective, achieving the highest recall (100\%) and specificity (78\%) among all compared techniques.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们解决补丁验证问题。虽然自动化漏洞修复（AVR）技术正日益受到关注，但仅仅生成补丁是不够的；提供其正确性的证据也至关重要。然而，当前最先进的补丁验证方法还不够有效。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了SymRadar，一个基于欠约束符号执行（UC-SE）的补丁验证工具。SymRadar与现有补丁验证技术的区别在于，它使用以所提供的概念验证（PoC）输入为中心的函数级符号执行。正如我们的评估所证明的，这种以PoC为中心的符号执行是有效的，在所有比较技术中实现了最高的召回率（100%）和特异性（78%）。

upstream_only.title: Efficient Strong Updates For Path Sensitive Data Dependence Analysis
upstream_only.abstract: Path-sensitive data dependence analysis is a powerful technique widely used in static vulnerability detection. One of the central challenges is how to resolve indirect data dependencies induced by pointer operations: the value loaded from a memory location may depend on different values stored before. Resolving indirect data dependencies in a path-sensitive manner significantly improves the analysis precision, but also induces high overhead that limits its scalability.We observe that much of the computation effort in path-sensitive data dependence analysis is spent on performing strong updates during load-store matching: a stored value propagates to a load statement only if it is not overwritten by other values stored to the same memory location during the propagation. Answering this question path-sensitively is extremely challenging and often leads to a state explosion that precludes efficient static analysis.To improve the efficiency for performing strong updates in path-sensitive data dependence analysis, our key insight is that the relation among multiple store statements could be determined in stages: most of the easy cases are handled efficiently by inferring a must-kill relation among the heap store statements, reserving the computationally expensive path-sensitive analysis for the rest. We design a tree-like data structure to encode both the control flow and alias information, which incrementally updates the relation during the analysis. Experiments have shown significant speed-ups and improved state coverage in static analysis through the algorithmic improvements of path-sensitive strong updates.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 路径敏感的数据依赖分析是一种强大的技术，广泛用于静态漏洞检测。其核心挑战之一是如何解析由指针操作引起的间接数据依赖：从内存位置加载的值可能依赖于之前存储的不同值。以路径敏感的方式解析间接数据依赖可以显著提高分析精度，但也会带来高开销，限制其可扩展性。我们观察到，路径敏感数据依赖分析中的大量计算工作花费在加载-存储匹配过程中执行强更新上：存储的值仅当在传播过程中未被存储到同一内存位置的其他值覆盖时，才会传播到加载语句。路径敏感地回答这个问题极具挑战性，并且常常导致状态爆炸，从而妨碍高效的静态分析。为了提高路径敏感数据依赖分析中执行强更新的效率，我们的关键见解是，多个存储语句之间的关系可以分阶段确定：大多数简单情况通过推断堆存储语句之间的必须杀死（must-kill）关系来高效处理，而将计算代价高昂的路径敏感分析保留给其余情况。我们设计了一种树状数据结构来编码控制流和别名信息，并在分析过程中增量更新该关系。实验表明，通过路径敏感强更新的算法改进，静态分析获得了显著加速并提高了状态覆盖率。

upstream_only.title: Optimization-Aware Test Generation for Deep Learning Compilers
upstream_only.abstract: Deep Learning (DL) compilers have been widely utilized to optimize DL models for efficient deployment across various hardware. Due to their vital role in the DL ecosystem, ensuring their reliability is critical. Such model optimizations are often designed to match specific computational graph structures. However, existing DL compiler fuzzing techniques do not generate tests for each optimization aware of its matched graph structures. In this paper, we propose OATest, a novel technique that synthesizes optimization-aware tests by extracting patterns from documented tests and integrating them into diverse computational graph contexts. To address the key technical challenge of synthesizing valid and optimization-aware computational graphs, OATest introduces two synthesis strategies: (1) reusing compatible inputs/outputs from existing nodes and (2) creating new nodes with compatible inputs/outputs, establishing effective connections between patterns and contexts. OATest is evaluated on two popular DL compilers, TVM and ONNXRuntime, regarding the bugs revealed by crashes and inconsistencies. The experimental results show that OATest significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art DL compiler fuzzing techniques by detecting more bugs and covering more optimization code in TVM and ONNXRuntime. Particularly, OATest uncovers 56 previously unknown bugs, 42/24 of which have been confirmed/fixed by developers.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 深度学习（DL）编译器已被广泛用于优化DL模型，以便在各种硬件上高效部署。由于它们在DL生态系统中起着至关重要的作用，确保其可靠性至关重要。此类模型优化通常被设计为匹配特定的计算图结构。然而，现有的DL编译器模糊测试技术并不会针对每个优化所匹配的图结构来生成测试。在本文中，我们提出了OATest，一种新颖的技术，它通过从文档化测试中提取模式并将其集成到多样化的计算图上下文中，来合成优化感知测试。为了解决合成有效且优化感知的计算图这一关键技术挑战，OATest引入了两种合成策略：(1) 复用现有节点中兼容的输入/输出；(2) 创建具有兼容输入/输出的新节点，从而在模式与上下文之间建立有效连接。OATest在两个流行的DL编译器TVM和ONNXRuntime上进行了评估，关注崩溃和不一致所揭示的bug。实验结果表明，OATest通过检测更多bug并覆盖TVM和ONNXRuntime中更多优化代码，显著优于最先进的DL编译器模糊测试技术。特别地，OATest发现了56个此前未知的bug，其中42/24个已被开发者确认/修复。

upstream_only.title: Validating Mixed-Integer Programming Solvers
upstream_only.abstract: Mixed-integer programming (MIP) is a fundamental class of mathematical optimization problems with broad applications in various domains such as finance, engineering, and management science. MIP solvers, software systems that automatically solve MIP problems, serve as the computational backbone for these applications. Given their widespread use, ensuring the correctness of MIP solvers is crucial, as incorrect results, such as falsely determining feasibility or returning incorrect solutions, can lead to serious real-world consequences. Despite its importance, validating the correctness of MIP solvers remains largely unexplored in both theory and practice.This paper presents the first systematic effort to address this problem. We propose feasibility-driven instance generation, a simple yet effective technique to generate random MIP instances for testing solver correctness. The core idea is to systematically synthesize MIP instances that are provably feasible or infeasible by construction. These instances are then fed to MIP solvers to detect potential bugs. We realize this methodology in Flip. To date, Flip has uncovered 67 confirmed bugs in five widely used MIP solvers, spanning both open-source and commercial systems. Among these, 54 have been promptly fixed by the developers. Our efforts and findings have been well acknowledged by the MIP solver community.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 混合整数规划（MIP）是一类基础的数学优化问题，在金融、工程和管理科学等多个领域有广泛应用。MIP求解器是自动求解MIP问题的软件系统，是这些应用的计算骨干。鉴于其广泛使用，确保MIP求解器的正确性至关重要，因为不正确的结果，例如错误地确定可行性或返回错误的解，可能导致严重的现实后果。尽管其重要性，验证MIP求解器的正确性在理论和实践中在很大程度上仍未被探索。本文首次系统性地解决这一问题。我们提出可行性驱动的实例生成，一种简单而有效的技术，用于生成随机MIP实例以测试求解器的正确性。核心思想是系统地合成在构造上可证明为可行或不可行的MIP实例。然后这些实例被馈送到MIP求解器以检测潜在缺陷。我们在Flip中实现了这一方法。迄今为止，Flip已在五个广泛使用的MIP求解器（涵盖开源和商业系统）中发现了67个已确认的缺陷。其中54个已由开发者迅速修复。我们的工作和发现得到了MIP求解器社区的充分认可。

upstream_only.title: NotDec: WebAssembly Decompilation With Inter-Procedural Type Recovery
upstream_only.abstract: With WebAssembly widely supported in browsers, containers, IoT devices, and serverless platforms and increasingly adopted as a universal low‑level bytecode standard, auditing its hidden vulnerabilities and malicious intentions has become critical. Decompiling existing WebAssembly modules can help security researchers and end users understand binary behavior, but current tools suffer from verbose result, poor readability, and limited type recovery.We present NotDec, an advanced WebAssembly decompilation framework. NotDec extends the WebAssembly type checking algorithm to lift bytecode into an SSA‑based IR, applies the inter-procedural type recovery algorithm Retypd with pointer and numeric value differentiation methods to recover complex data structures, and leverages Memory SSA alongside semantics‑preserving structured control‑flow analysis to emit readable, semantically consistent C code.NotDec achieves 100\% recompilation success rate on all 5,241 Juliet samples and all Howard dataset programs, significantly outperforming baselines including Ghidra (45.95\% success rate). On type recovery accuracy, NotDec recovers 85.33\% of struct member accesses in real-world programs, vastly exceeding Ghidra’s 9.24\%. While the full inter-procedural version faces scalability challenges on large binaries, the intra-procedural variant ({{rmsmall {NOTDEC}}}_F) demonstrates superior efficiency, consuming less than half of Ghidra’s memory and up to 97\% less execution time on unoptimized binaries.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 随着WebAssembly在浏览器、容器、IoT设备和无服务器平台中得到广泛支持，并日益被采用为通用低级字节码标准，审计其隐藏漏洞和恶意意图已变得至关重要。反编译现有WebAssembly模块可以帮助安全研究人员和最终用户理解二进制行为，但当前工具存在结果冗长、可读性差和类型恢复有限的问题。我们提出NotDec，一个先进的WebAssembly反编译框架。NotDec扩展了WebAssembly类型检查算法，将字节码提升为基于SSA的IR，应用过程间类型恢复算法Retypd以及指针和数值区分方法恢复复杂数据结构，并利用Memory SSA和保持语义的结构化控制流分析，生成可读且语义一致的C代码。NotDec在全部5,241个Juliet样本和所有Howard数据集程序上实现了100%的重新编译成功率，显著优于包括Ghidra（45.95%成功率）在内的基线。在类型恢复准确性上，NotDec恢复了真实世界程序中85.33%的结构体成员访问，远超Ghidra的9.24%。虽然完整的过程间版本在大二进制文件上面临可扩展性挑战，但过程内变体（{{rmsmall {NOTDEC}}}_F）表现出更优的效率，在未优化二进制上仅消耗Ghidra不到一半的内存，执行时间最多减少97%。

upstream_only.title: AssertFlip: Reproducing Bugs via Inversion of LLM-Generated Passing Tests
upstream_only.abstract: Bug reproduction is critical in the software debugging and repair process, yet the majority of bugs in open-source and industrial settings lack executable tests to reproduce them at the time they are reported, making diagnosis and resolution more difficult and time-consuming. To address this challenge, we introduce AssertFlip, a novel technique for automatically generating Bug Reproducible Tests (BRTs) using large language models (LLMs). Unlike existing methods that attempt direct generation of failing tests, AssertFlip first generates passing tests on the buggy behaviour and then inverts these tests to fail when the bug is present. We hypothesize that LLMs are better at writing passing tests than ones that crash or fail on purpose. Our results show that AssertFlip outperforms all known techniques in the leaderboard of SWT-Bench, a benchmark curated for BRTs. Specifically, AssertFlip achieves a fail-to-pass success rate of 43.6\% on the SWT-Bench-Verified subset.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 缺陷重现对于软件调试和修复过程至关重要，然而在开源和工业环境中，大多数缺陷在报告时缺乏可执行测试来重现它们，这使得诊断和解决更加困难且耗时。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了AssertFlip，一种利用大语言模型（LLM）自动生成缺陷可重现测试（BRT）的新技术。与直接尝试生成失败测试的现有方法不同，AssertFlip首先针对有缺陷的行为生成通过测试，然后反转这些测试，使其在缺陷存在时失败。我们假设LLM更擅长编写通过测试，而不是故意编写崩溃或失败的测试。我们的结果表明，在SWT-Bench（一个为BRT策划的基准）排行榜上，AssertFlip优于所有已知技术。具体而言，AssertFlip在SWT-Bench-Verified子集上实现了43.6%的失败转通过成功率。

upstream_only.title: Characterizing Regression Bug‑Inducing Changes and Improving LLM‑Based Regression Bug Detection
upstream_only.abstract: Regression bugs are common in real-world software projects. Although several studies have characterized various aspects of these bugs, a detailed analysis of the characteristics of code changes that introduce regression bugs is still lacking. It is also not clear whether and how regression bugs can be identified, in the era of wide usage of large language models (LLMs), in code commits during software development in the first place. To fill this gap, our study systematically analyzes 280 regression bugs from open-source Java projects, examining both the root causes and the associated development activities of regression bug-inducing changes, while also evaluating the effectiveness of LLMs in detection such commits and explaining their underlying causes.Our findings indicate that regression bugs are usually triggered by a single atomic development activity, with feature changes or additions, and bug fixes appearing more frequently in regression bug-inducing commits. Additionally, performance improvements and refactoring are often responsible for the introduction of bugs. We develop a taxonomy that categorizes the root causes of regression bugs into two types: intrinsic errors, such as logic errors and unchecked null references, and compatibility errors, where otherwise correct changes inadvertently violate assumptions or dependencies in other parts of the system.Furthermore, we verify that LLMs have limited ability to detect regression bugs. Based on our findings, we construct LLM4Reg that substantially improves the precision, recall, and explanation capabilities of LLM-based regression bug detection.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 回归缺陷在现实世界的软件项目中很常见。尽管已有若干研究描述了这些缺陷的各个方面，但仍缺乏对引入回归缺陷的代码变更特征的详细分析。在大语言模型（LLM）广泛使用的时代，回归缺陷是否以及如何在软件开发期间的代码提交中被识别，目前也尚不清楚。为填补这一空白，我们的研究系统分析了来自开源Java项目的280个回归缺陷，考察了回归缺陷引入变更的根本原因及相关开发活动，同时评估了LLM在检测此类提交方面的有效性并解释其潜在原因。我们的发现表明，回归缺陷通常由单个原子开发活动触发，其中功能变更或添加以及缺陷修复更频繁地出现在回归缺陷引入提交中。此外，性能改进和重构常常导致缺陷的引入。我们开发了一个分类法，将回归缺陷的根本原因分为两类：内在错误，如逻辑错误和未检查的空引用；以及兼容性错误，即原本正确的变更无意中违反了系统其他部分的假设或依赖。此外，我们验证了LLM检测回归缺陷的能力有限。基于我们的发现，我们构建了LLM4Reg，显著提高了基于LLM的回归缺陷检测的精确率、召回率和解释能力。

upstream_only.title: Online and Interactive Bayesian Inference Debugging
upstream_only.abstract: Probabilistic programming is a rapidly developing programming paradigm which enables the formulation of Bayesian models as programs and the automation of posterior inference. It facilitates the development of models and conducting Bayesian inference, which makes these techniques available to practitioners from multiple fields. Nevertheless, probabilistic programming is notoriously difficult as identifying and repairing issues with inference requires a lot of time and deep knowledge. Through this work, we introduce a novel approach to debugging Bayesian inference that reduces time and required knowledge significantly. We discuss several requirements a Bayesian inference debugging framework has to fulfill, and propose a new tool that meets these key requirements directly within the development environment. We evaluate our results in a study with 18 experienced participants and show that our approach to online and interactive debugging of Bayesian inference significantly reduces time and difficulty on inference debugging tasks.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 概率编程是一种快速发展的编程范式，它能够将贝叶斯模型表述为程序并自动进行后验推断。它促进了模型的开发和贝叶斯推断的进行，使这些技术可供多个领域的从业者使用。然而，概率编程以困难著称，因为识别和修复推断问题需要大量时间和深厚知识。通过这项工作，我们引入了一种新的贝叶斯推断调试方法，显著减少了时间和所需知识。我们讨论了贝叶斯推断调试框架必须满足的若干要求，并提出了一种新工具，可直接在开发环境中满足这些关键要求。我们通过对18名经验丰富的参与者进行研究来评估结果，表明我们的在线交互式贝叶斯推断调试方法显著减少了推断调试任务的时间和难度。

upstream_only.title: Hybrid Fault-Driven Mutation Testing for Python
upstream_only.abstract: Mutation testing is an effective technique for assessing the effectiveness of test suites by systematically injecting artificial faults into programs. However, existing mutation testing techniques fall short in capturing many types of common faults in dynamically-typed languages like Python. In this paper, we introduce a novel set of seven mutation operators that are inspired by prevalent anti-patterns in Python programs, designed to complement the existing general-purpose operators and broaden the spectrum of simulated faults. We propose a mutation testing technique that utilizes a hybrid of static and dynamic analyses to mutate Python programs based on these operators while minimizing equivalent mutants. We implement our approach in a tool called PyTation and evaluate it on 13 open-source Python applications. Our results show that PyTation generates mutants that complement those from general-purpose tools, exhibiting distinct behaviour under test execution and uncovering inadequacies in high-coverage test suites. We further demonstrate that PyTation produces a high proportion of unique mutants, a low cross-kill rate, and a low test overlap ratio relative to baseline tools, highlighting its novel fault model. PyTation also incurs few equivalent mutants, aided by dynamic analysis heuristics.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 变异测试是一种通过向程序系统性地注入人工故障来评估测试套件有效性的有效技术。然而，现有的变异测试技术在捕捉Python等动态类型语言中的许多常见故障方面存在不足。本文提出了一组新颖的七个变异算子，其灵感来源于Python程序中普遍存在的反模式，旨在补充现有的通用算子并拓宽所模拟故障的范围。我们提出了一种利用静态和动态分析混合的变异测试技术，基于这些算子对Python程序进行变异，同时尽量减少等价变异体。我们将方法实现在名为PyTation的工具中，并在13个开源Python应用上进行了评估。结果表明，PyTation生成的变异体补充了通用工具的变异体，在测试执行下表现出不同的行为，并揭示了高覆盖率测试套件中的不足。我们进一步证明，相对于基线工具，PyTation产生高比例的唯一变异体、低交叉杀死率和低测试重叠率，凸显了其新颖的故障模型。在动态分析启发式的帮助下，PyTation产生的等价变异体也很少。

upstream_only.title: Learning without Forgetting: Towards Continual learning of Fault Localization Models in Industrial Software Systems
upstream_only.abstract: Learning-based fault localization has achieved promising results. However, as software and tests are constantly evolving, models trained on old data become ineffective on new data. Particularly, in the context of system testing for large-scale software, each iteration generates a large volume of new data. This makes retraining the model from scratch incur an unacceptable time overhead, while merely fine-tuning on new data leads to catastrophic forgetting. Continual learning offers an effective method for models to avoid catastrophic forgetting during this iterative process. However, existing continual learning methods are not specifically designed for fault localization or for large-scale software system testing scenarios, which leads to their direct application yielding sub-optimal effectiveness. In response, we propose Ciallo, a novel continual learning framework specifically designed for large-scale software fault localization. Ciallo first extracts fine-grained program semantics from logs, then utilizes fault characteristics to enhance the weights of certain semantics. Finally, Ciallo uses an unsupervised algorithm to obtain corresponding embeddings and selects representative exemplars based on clustering. Subsequently, Ciallo mixes the representative exemplars with new samples for training and adjusts the loss weight according to the model’s degree of mastery over the sample. This allows the model to focus more on samples that are not yet well-mastered during the training process, thereby enabling it to learn new faults while mitigating the forgetting of old ones. In extensive evaluations against 6 continual learning baselines, Ciallo demonstrates superior performance, improving overall effectiveness by 17.30\% to 45.23\%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 基于学习的故障定位已取得良好结果。然而，随着软件和测试不断演进，在旧数据上训练的模型在新数据上变得无效。特别是在大规模软件的系统测试中，每次迭代都会产生大量新数据。这使得从头重新训练模型会带来不可接受的时间开销，而仅在新数据上微调会导致灾难性遗忘。持续学习为避免迭代过程中的灾难性遗忘提供了一种有效方法。然而，现有持续学习方法并非专为故障定位或大规模软件系统测试场景设计，因此直接应用效果次优。为此，我们提出Ciallo，一种专为大规模软件故障定位设计的新颖持续学习框架。Ciallo首先从日志中提取细粒度程序语义，然后利用故障特征增强某些语义的权重。最后，Ciallo使用无监督算法获得相应嵌入，并基于聚类选择代表性样本。随后，Ciallo将代表性样本与新样本混合训练，并根据模型对样本的掌握程度调整损失权重。这使模型在训练过程中更关注尚未很好掌握的样本，从而在学习新故障的同时减轻对旧故障的遗忘。在对6个持续学习基线的广泛评估中，Ciallo表现出更优性能，整体效果提升17.30%至45.23%。

upstream_only.title: Automated Network-Level Fault Injection Testing of Microservice Architectures
upstream_only.abstract: Microservice architectures are inherently vulnerable to partial failures, and they rely on resilience patterns to tolerate them. However, it is challenging to design and implement the resilience logic. Unforeseen interactions with faulty services can lead to errors in dependent services, resulting in incorrect system behavior. Fault injection testing techniques aim to uncover these errors by examining the system’s behavior in response to different fault combinations. However, existing automated techniques primarily focus on service-level fault injection, which limits their broader applicability.We present an automated fault-injection testing method that operates at the network level, enabling broad applicability. The method models the system’s resilience behaviors dynamically through the observed test executions and uses this information to reduce the set of fault combinations to explore. We implemented our method in a prototype tool called Reynard. Our evaluation demonstrates that Reynard efficiently explores system executions by significantly reducing the number of fault combinations to test. It incurs minimal overhead and can be easily integrated into existing benchmarks.
