upstream_only.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-based systems are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings where correct behaviour depends not only on the language model but also on the retrieval component that selects external documents at inference time. While existing RAG evaluation metrics assess retrieval and generation quality on a per-query basis, typically relying on query-level test oracles such as reference answers or relevance annotations, they provide limited insight into whether a test suite adequately exercises the retrieval behaviour of the system as a whole. In this paper, we introduce Chunk Coverage (CC), an oracle-independent test adequacy criterion for testing the retrieval component of RAG systems. CC measures the fraction of corpus chunks that are retrieved at least once across a test suite, providing a structural view of which parts of the retrieval space have been exercised. We further show how CC can be used to guide test selection and generation by prioritising queries that expand coverage of previously unexercised retrieval regions. We evaluate CC on clinical and financial RAG system scenarios. CC-guided testing reaches 50\% of attainable coverage 1.7x faster than random selection and 4.2x faster than redundancy-biased strategies. Moreover, CC improves fault detection effectiveness (APFD) by 10\% to 25\% over random, indicating earlier discovery of distinct retrieval faults. These results show that CC captures retrieval diversity relevant to effective testing without requiring test oracles.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 基于检索增强生成（RAG）的系统越来越多地部署在高风险环境中，在这些环境中，正确行为不仅取决于语言模型，还取决于在推理时选择外部文档的检索组件。虽然现有的RAG评估指标在逐查询的基础上评估检索和生成质量，通常依赖于查询级测试预言（如参考答案或相关性标注），但它们对于测试套件是否充分覆盖整个系统的检索行为提供的洞见有限。在本文中，我们引入了块覆盖率（CC），这是一种用于测试RAG系统检索组件的、独立于测试预言（oracle）的测试充分性准则。CC衡量在测试套件中至少被检索一次的语料库块的比例，从而提供哪些检索空间部分已被覆盖的结构化视图。我们进一步展示了如何使用CC通过优先选择能够扩展先前未覆盖检索区域覆盖范围的查询来指导测试选择和生成。我们在临床和金融RAG系统场景中评估了CC。CC引导的测试达到可达到覆盖率的50%的速度比随机选择快1.7倍，比冗余偏好策略快4.2倍。此外，CC将故障检测有效性（APFD）比随机提高了10%到25%，表明能够更早发现不同的检索故障。这些结果表明，CC捕获了与有效测试相关的检索多样性，而无需测试预言。

upstream_only.title: Function Calling as a Flexible LLM Defense Add-On: Capability and Application Exploration
upstream_only.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit impressive capabilities but are susceptible to adversarial attacks that induce harmful outputs. Although various defenses have been proposed, their practicality is restricted by substantial runtime overhead or degraded model helpfulness. Moreover, LLM applications typically have diverse and evolving security requirements that cannot be fully anticipated during the design of static defenses. These limitations call for a flexible, low-overhead defense mechanism that can be easily customized to meet task-specific needs. In this paper, we explore function calling (FC)—a built-in mechanism in modern LLMs for invoking custom tools—as a lightweight and adaptable defense add-on. We show that by defining functions representing malicious actions, LLMs equipped with FC can intercept harmful prompts by triggering these function calls instead of generating unsafe content. Extensive experiments across mainstream LLMs demonstrate that FC substantially improves defense effectiveness with minimal impact on model helpfulness. To further assess FC's practical utility, we also introduce DSPEC, a new dataset reflecting real-world LLM applications with specific defense requirements. Our evaluations on DSPEC show that FC substantially outperforms existing defenses in this realistic setting. Besides, we also explore the practical applications of FC in various scenarios, including universal defense frameworks and multi-agent systems, further demonstrating its versatility and effectiveness in enhancing LLM security.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）展现出令人印象深刻的能力，但容易受到对抗性攻击从而产生有害输出。尽管已经提出了各种防御措施，但其实用性受到大量运行时开销或模型有用性下降的限制。此外，LLM应用通常具有多样且不断变化的安全需求，这些需求无法在静态防御设计时完全预见。这些局限呼唤一种灵活、低开销的防御机制，能够轻松定制以满足特定任务需求。在本文中，我们探索函数调用（FC）——现代LLM中用于调用自定义工具的内置机制——作为一种轻量且可适应的防御附加组件。我们表明，通过定义表示恶意操作的函数，配备FC的LLM可以通过触发这些函数调用而不是生成不安全内容来拦截有害提示。跨主流LLM的大量实验表明，FC显著提高了防御有效性，同时对模型有用性的影响极小。为了进一步评估FC的实际效用，我们还引入了DSPEC，一个反映具有特定防御需求的真实世界LLM应用的新数据集。我们在DSPEC上的评估表明，FC在这种现实场景中显著优于现有防御。此外，我们还探索了FC在各种场景中的实际应用，包括通用防御框架和多智能体系统，进一步展示了其在增强LLM安全性方面的多功能性和有效性。

upstream_only.title: From Custom Logic to APIs: Understanding and Recommending API Replacement Refactorings
upstream_only.abstract: Software refactoring is essential for maintaining code quality. However, API replacement refactoring, which replaces custom logic with API calls, remains underexplored. Existing refactoring tools provide limited support for detecting such opportunities because they rely on predefined templates and have difficulty capturing complex, multi-statement semantic equivalents. To address this limitation, we conduct the first empirical study of API replacement refactorings by mining 166,299 commits across six open-source Java projects and manually analyzing a curated subset of 1,800 commits, from which we identify 366 validated instances to characterize their scope, categories, and recurring patterns. Based on these insights, we propose AKIRA (Adaptive Knowledge Discovery and Retrieval), a hybrid framework that integrates pattern-deterministic heuristics with a refactoring-aware knowledge base to assess the practical feasibility of recommending API replacement refactorings. Our evaluation shows that AKIRA achieves 90\% recall and 88\% precision on a manually curated dataset. Furthermore, on the external RETIWA dataset, AKIRA significantly improves the state of the art by increasing recall from 21\% to 81\% and precision from 40\% to 78\%. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining static pattern matching with semantic reasoning to support the automation of recommending complex API replacement refactorings.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 软件重构对于维护代码质量至关重要。然而，API替换重构——即用API调用替换自定义逻辑——仍未得到充分探索。现有重构工具对此类机会的检测支持有限，因为它们依赖预定义模板，难以捕捉复杂的、多语句的语义等价物。为弥补这一局限，我们开展了首个针对API替换重构的实证研究，挖掘了六个开源Java项目中的166,299次提交，并人工分析了其中精心筛选的1,800次提交，从中识别出366个经过验证的实例，以刻画其范围、类别和反复出现的模式。基于这些见解，我们提出AKIRA（自适应知识发现与检索），一个混合框架，将模式确定性的启发式方法与重构感知的知识库相结合，以评估推荐API替换重构的实际可行性。我们的评估表明，AKIRA在人工整理的数据集上达到90%的召回率和88%的精确率。此外，在外部RETIWA数据集上，AKIRA显著提升了当前最优水平，将召回率从21%提高到81%，精确率从40%提高到78%。这些结果证明了结合静态模式匹配与语义推理来支持自动化推荐复杂API替换重构的有效性。

upstream_only.title: IterTestQ: Assembly-Level, Cross-Platform Testing of Quantum Computing Platforms
upstream_only.abstract: Quantum computing platforms are susceptible to quantum-specific bugs, such as incorrectly ordering qubits or incorrectly implementing quantum abstractions. These bugs are difficult to detect and require specialized expertise. The field faces challenges due to a fragmented landscape of platforms and rapid development cycles that often prioritize new features over thorough testing, severely hindering the reliability of quantum software. To address these challenges, we present IterTestQ, a novel cross-platform testing approach for quantum computing platforms. The key technical contribution is our novel ITE process, which generates equivalent quantum programs by iteratively (I)mporting them into platform-specific representations, (T)ransforming the program via optimizations and gate conversions, and (E)xporting the program again. To transfer programs across platforms and test cross-platform consistency, IterTestQ leverages QASM, an assembly-level representation supported by most platforms. The approach uses a crash oracle to detect failures during cross-platform transformations and an equivalence oracle to validate the semantic consistency of the generated assembly programs, which are expected to be equivalent by construction. We evaluate IterTestQ on widely-used quantum computing platforms, including Qiskit, PennyLane, Pytket, BQSKit, and Cirq, revealing 23 bugs, 17 of which are already confirmed or fixed. Our results also demonstrate that IterTestQ complements existing quantum fuzzers (covering tens of thousands of otherwise uncovered lines), is efficient (with 0.00089 seconds per generated program), and that the ITE process is crucial for its effectiveness.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 量子计算平台容易受到量子特定错误的影响，例如错误地排列量子位或错误地实现量子抽象。这些错误难以检测，需要专业知识。由于平台碎片化和快速开发周期（通常优先考虑新功能而非彻底测试），该领域面临挑战，严重阻碍了量子软件的可靠性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了IterTestQ，一种新颖的量子计算平台跨平台测试方法。关键技术创新是我们的新型ITE过程，它通过迭代地将程序(I)导入平台特定表示、(T)通过优化和门转换对程序进行变换，并(E)再次导出程序，从而生成等价的量子程序。为了跨平台转移程序并测试跨平台一致性，IterTestQ利用QASM，一种大多数平台支持的汇编级表示。该方法使用崩溃预言来检测跨平台转换期间的故障，并使用等价预言来验证生成的汇编程序的语义一致性，这些程序在构造上预期是等价的。我们在广泛使用的量子计算平台上评估了IterTestQ，包括Qiskit、PennyLane、Pytket、BQSKit和Cirq，发现了23个错误，其中17个已被确认或修复。我们的结果还表明，IterTestQ补充了现有的量子模糊测试器（覆盖了数万行原本未覆盖的代码），效率高（每个生成程序0.00089秒），并且ITE过程对其有效性至关重要。

upstream_only.title: Integrating Multiple Features for Weakly-Supervised False-Passing Products Detection in Software Product Lines
upstream_only.abstract: Software Product Lines (SPL) enable the efficient development of configurable systems through feature modularization. However, the inherent configurability of software introduces significant challenges for fault localization within these systems. A key challenge among these is the problem of false-passing products, configurable products that contain faulty code yet coincidentally pass all their associated tests, thereby masking faults and misleading diagnosis efforts. To mitigate the negative impact of false-passing products. Supervised detection approaches are often impractical due to their reliance on complete labels, which are unavailable during early testing phases. To address this, we propose PULP, a label-agnostic detection approach that exploits the execution similarity between failing and false-passing products. PULP extracts five categories of features and employs a weakly-supervised learning algorithm to identify false-passing products without pre-labeled data. Evaluated on 823 buggy versions from six real-world SPL systems, PULP achieves superior detection performance, with best accuracy of 90.33\% and precision of 94.93\% for false-passing products and consistently enhances fault localization rankings after eliminating the negative impact of false-passing product. This method offers a practical tool for SPL testing and debugging in label-incomplete environments.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 软件产品线（SPL）通过特征模块化实现了可配置系统的高效开发。然而，软件固有的可配置性为这些系统中的故障定位带来了巨大挑战。其中的一个关键挑战是假通过产品问题：这些可配置产品包含故障代码，却碰巧通过了所有相关测试，从而掩盖故障并误导诊断工作。为了减轻假通过产品的负面影响，监督检测方法通常不切实际，因为它们依赖完整标签，而这些标签在早期测试阶段不可用。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了PULP，一种与标签无关的检测方法，它利用失败产品和假通过产品之间的执行相似性。PULP提取五类特征，并采用弱监督学习算法在没有预标注数据的情况下识别假通过产品。在来自六个真实SPL系统的823个含缺陷版本上进行评估，PULP取得了优异的检测性能，假通过产品的最佳准确率为90.33%，精确率为94.93%，并且在消除假通过产品的负面影响后，持续提升了故障定位排名。该方法为标签不完整环境下的SPL测试与调试提供了一个实用工具。

upstream_only.title: Applying System Call Filtering to Real-World Binaries (Experience Paper)
upstream_only.abstract: System call filtering restricts applications to the system calls they require, but inferring accurate syscall sets for binary-only programs remains challenging. A central difficulty lies in recovering precise control-flow information from binaries: over-approximation leads to overly permissive syscall filters, while missed control-flow edges result in unsound policies. Although many techniques have been proposed to improve control-flow recovery in binaries, their practical impact on syscall inference remains poorly understood. In this work, we conduct an empirical study of syscall inference from binaries using multiple off-the-shelf binary analysis tools. We evaluate how different control-flow refinement techniques affect inferred syscall sets in practice. Our experiments on real-world applications show that refinements targeting individual control-flow transfers (e.g., call-site and callee argument matching) substantially improve per-call target precision but often do not reduce the overall syscall set. In contrast, techniques that reduce the global set of address-taken functions---such as leveraging relocation information to accurately identify code pointers---yield the most significant syscall reductions. Finally, we identify a practical lower bound on syscall reduction achievable via sound static binary analysis alone, and show that further improvements are likely to require configuration or workload-aware specialization.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 系统调用过滤将应用程序限制在其所需的系统调用范围内，但为仅二进制程序推断准确的系统调用集合仍然具有挑战性。核心困难在于从二进制文件中恢复精确的控制流信息：过近似会导致系统调用过滤器过于宽松，而遗漏控制流边则会导致策略不健全。尽管已经提出了许多改进二进制控制流恢复的技术，但它们对系统调用推断的实际影响仍鲜为人知。在这项工作中，我们使用多个现成的二进制分析工具对从二进制文件进行系统调用推断进行了实证研究。我们评估了不同控制流精化技术在实践中如何影响推断出的系统调用集合。我们在真实世界应用上的实验表明，针对单个控制流转移的精化（例如调用点和被调用者参数匹配）能够显著提高每次调用的目标精度，但通常不会减少整体系统调用集合。相反，减少全局地址取用函数集合的技术——例如利用重定位信息准确识别代码指针——能够带来最显著的系统调用减少。最后，我们确定了仅通过可靠的静态二进制分析可实现的系统调用减少的实际下界，并表明进一步的改进可能需要配置或工作负载感知的特化。

upstream_only.title: Towards More Realistic Assertion Generation under Mixed-Assertion Scenario
upstream_only.abstract: Unit testing is essential for software quality assurance, where a test case typically consists of a test prefix and an oracle, expressed as assertions. In practice, crafting high-quality assertions is non-trivial and time-consuming, as it requires developers to reason carefully about program states and expected behaviors. While recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise for automating assertion generation (AG), current AG methods often rely on two unrealistic assumptions: (1) the Single-Assertion Formulation (A1), which assumes tests contain only one assertion, and (2) the Known-Position Formulation (A2), which treats AG as a "fill-in-the-blanks" task with pre-defined insertion points. Despite being widely adopted, the realism and implications of these assumptions have not been systematically examined. This paper revisits AG under a realistic Mixed-Assertion Scenario, where tests may contain one or multiple assertions and insertion positions are unavailable at inference time. To examine A1, we first conduct a large-scale empirical study of 358,117 developer-written tests from 7,061 projects. The results show that multi-assertion tests are prevalent, accounting for 40.32\% of all tests and appearing in 92.87\% of projects. Through manual analysis, we derive a taxonomy comprising ten fine-grained assertion patterns, showing that assertions in multi-assertion tests are rarely independent checks (4.69\%) and instead coordinate to validate a unified test objective. To examine A2, we remove ground-truth insertion cues and observe substantial performance degradation, with Exact Match dropping by 11.80\%--23.18\% overall. This suggests that position cues affect not only where assertions are placed, but also the quality of what to assert. Motivated by these findings, we propose DA-AG, a two-stage framework designed for the realistic Mixed-Assertion Scenario with unknown insertion positions. In the first stage, it predicts assertion insertion positions to construct an assertion skeleton with explicit insertion cues. In the second stage, it generates assertion content conditioned on the resulting skeleton and retrieved exemplar assertion sequences. Extensive experiments across 13 diverse LLMs show that DA-AG consistently outperforms the corresponding one-stage baselines, which directly generate the completed test from the focal method and raw test prefix. DA-AG improves Exact Match by 32.24\%--78.08\% and CodeBLEU by 2.80\%--8.63\%, increases real-bug detection on Defects4J by 4--37 exposed bugs and 5--21 unique exposed bugs, and further improves other execution-based metrics, including compilability, bug-finding quality, and mutation scores. Moreover, DA-AG outperforms closed-source LLMs evaluated in a prompt-only setting without task-specific fine-tuning (e.g., GPT-4o and Claude-3.5) in similarity-based quality and real-bug detection.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 单元测试对于软件质量保证至关重要，其中测试用例通常由测试前缀和以断言形式表达的判定条件组成。在实践中，编写高质量的断言并非易事且耗时，因为开发者需要仔细推理程序状态和预期行为。尽管大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展在自动化断言生成（AG）方面显示出潜力，但当前的AG方法往往依赖两个不现实的假设：（1）单一断言设定（A1），即假设测试只包含一个断言；（2）已知位置设定（A2），即将AG视为具有预定义插入点的“填空”任务。尽管这些假设被广泛采用，但其现实性和影响尚未得到系统检验。本文在现实的混合断言场景下重新审视AG，其中测试可能包含一个或多个断言，并且在推理时无法获得插入位置。为了检验A1，我们首先对来自7,061个项目的358,117个开发者编写的测试进行了大规模实证研究。结果表明，多断言测试非常普遍，占所有测试的40.32%，并出现在92.87%的项目中。通过人工分析，我们得出一个包含十种细粒度断言模式的分类体系，表明多断言测试中的断言很少是独立检查（4.69%），而是协同验证统一的测试目标。为了检验A2，我们移除真实插入线索，并观察到性能显著下降，总体精确匹配率下降11.80%--23.18%。这表明位置线索不仅影响断言放置的位置，还影响断言内容的质量。受这些发现启发，我们提出DA-AG，一个面向插入位置未知的现实混合断言场景的两阶段框架。在第一阶段，它预测断言插入位置，以构建带有显式插入线索的断言骨架。在第二阶段，它以所得骨架和检索到的范例断言序列为条件生成断言内容。在13个不同LLM上的大量实验表明，DA-AG始终优于相应的一阶段基线，后者直接从焦点方法和原始测试前缀生成完整测试。DA-AG将精确匹配率提高32.24%--78.08%，CodeBLEU提高2.80%--8.63%，在Defects4J上增加4--37个暴露缺陷和5--21个唯一暴露缺陷，并进一步改善其他基于执行的指标，包括可编译性、缺陷发现质量和变异得分。此外，在基于相似度的质量和真实缺陷检测方面，DA-AG优于在仅提示设置下、未进行任务特定微调的闭源LLM（如GPT-4o和Claude-3.5）。

upstream_only.title: OptiMine: Scalable and Precise Code Optimization for Android Apps via LLM-Driven Semantic Analysis
upstream_only.abstract: As Android applications grow in scale, latent performance issues increasingly degrade user experience and business outcomes, yet systematically identifying optimization opportunities in large codebases remains challenging. We present OptiMine, a hybrid knowledge-to-code framework that integrates large language models (LLMs) with static program analysis to automatically uncover actionable performance optimizations. OptiMine systematically transforms unstructured expert knowledge from documents, commit diffs, and reports into structured Optimization Signatures, enabling reproducible and context-aware program reasoning. These signatures drive scalable candidate retrieval via declarative Datalog queries, while LLM-guided semantic validation performs precise applicability checking, side-effect analysis, and impact-aware ranking. We evaluate OptiMine on a public benchmark and a large industrial Android codebase. The results show that OptiMine achieves higher precision and broader coverage than heuristic- and pattern-based baselines, while scaling effectively to industrial settings. Overall, OptiMine enables reliable and scalable performance auditing, bridging expert knowledge and actionable performance improvements in real-world mobile systems.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 随着Android应用规模的增长，潜在的性能问题日益降低用户体验和业务成果，然而在大型代码库中系统地识别优化机会仍然具有挑战性。我们提出OptiMine，一个混合的知识到代码框架，将大型语言模型（LLM）与静态程序分析相结合，以自动发现可操作的性能优化。OptiMine系统地将来自文档、提交差异和报告的非结构化专家知识转化为结构化的优化签名（Optimization Signatures），从而实现可复现且上下文感知的程序推理。这些签名通过声明式Datalog查询驱动可扩展的候选检索，而LLM引导的语义验证则执行精确的适用性检查、副作用分析和影响感知排序。我们在一个公共基准和一个大型工业Android代码库上评估OptiMine。结果表明，与基于启发式和模式的基线相比，OptiMine实现了更高的精确度和更广的覆盖范围，同时能有效扩展到工业环境。总体而言，OptiMine实现了可靠且可扩展的性能审计，在现实世界的移动系统中弥合了专家知识与可操作的性能改进之间的差距。

upstream_only.title: A Dataset of Reproducible Flaky-Test Failures
upstream_only.abstract: Flaky tests pass and fail non-deterministically when run on the same version of code. Previous research proposed techniques to detect, debug, and repair different categories of flaky tests. However, reproducing the flaky-test failures remains a major challenge due to their inherent non-determinism. Reliably reproducing flaky-test failures is essential for helping both developers and automatic techniques to debug and repair flaky tests. Many datasets related to flaky tests exist to help researchers study them, but these datasets are often composed of disjoint information, where each dataset provides some unique information over the others, such as flaky tests of many different categories, failure logs of flaky tests, or flaky tests reported by developers vs. flaky tests found by automated tools. Furthermore, several of them are missing the key aspect of providing a means to reliably reproduce the flaky-test failures. In this work, we aim to create a dataset of flaky tests, where each test’s failure is reproducible and there is a comprehensive set of information for the flaky test. Compared to prior flaky-test datasets, our dataset is the first to provide (1) an environment to compile the code for running the flaky tests, (2) scripts to run the tests to reproduce the flaky-test failures, (3) scripts to automatically apply flaky-test fixes and check that the test is no longer flaky, and (4) execution logs of the flaky test both passing and failing. We present ReproFlake, a dataset of 1115 flaky tests, spread across four different flaky-test categories. We also publish the guideline we developed to construct our dataset so others can contribute to this dataset by collecting the same information. We also study the categories of flaky tests in ReproFlake, the location and size of flaky-test fixes, and the code coverage of flaky tests before and after they are fixed. Our study highlights promising future flaky-test research directions, which our dataset helps enable.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 偶发测试在同一版本代码上运行时，会非确定性地通过或失败。先前的研究提出了检测、调试和修复不同类别偶发测试的技术。然而，由于偶发测试固有的非确定性，复现其失败仍然是一个重大挑战。可靠地复现偶发测试失败对于帮助开发人员和自动技术调试和修复偶发测试至关重要。许多与偶发测试相关的数据集存在，以帮助研究人员研究它们，但这些数据集通常由互不相交的信息组成，每个数据集提供一些其他数据集所没有的独特信息，例如许多不同类别的偶发测试、偶发测试的失败日志，或开发人员报告的偶发测试与自动化工具发现的偶发测试。此外，其中一些数据集缺少提供可靠复现偶发测试失败手段这一关键方面。在这项工作中，我们旨在创建一个偶发测试数据集，其中每个测试的失败都是可复现的，并且包含全面的偶发测试信息。与先前的偶发测试数据集相比，我们的数据集首次提供：(1) 用于编译代码以运行偶发测试的环境，(2) 用于运行测试以复现偶发测试失败的脚本，(3) 用于自动应用偶发测试修复并检查测试不再偶发的脚本，以及 (4) 偶发测试通过和失败的执行日志。我们提出了 ReproFlake，一个包含 1115 个偶发测试、横跨四个不同偶发测试类别的数据集。我们还发布了我们为构建数据集而制定的指南，以便其他人可以通过收集相同信息来为这个数据集做出贡献。我们还研究了 ReproFlake 中偶发测试的类别、偶发测试修复的位置和大小，以及偶发测试修复前后的代码覆盖率。我们的研究强调了有前景的未来偶发测试研究方向，而我们的数据集有助于实现这些方向。

upstream_only.title: MuMuTestUp: Mutation-Based Multi-agent Test Case Update
upstream_only.abstract: Modern software systems evolve rapidly under continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) practices, in which tests act as critical gatekeepers of software quality. However, when substantial code changes are introduced, existing test cases may become obsolete, leading to compilation failures, erroneous test behaviors, or inadequate regression coverage. Such issues can disrupt CI/CD pipelines, degrade development productivity, and ultimately undermine overall software quality. Many efforts are devoted to designing automatic test case update methods to address these issues. The most recent approaches rely on large language models (LLMs) to iteratively refine test cases using execution feedback from compilation errors or coverage reports, and on context retrieved via exact-matching approaches. They also prioritize test executability and line coverage to quickly build executable, correct test cases from the original broken test cases. Despite their correctness, current approaches face three limitations: (1) they focus on executabilty but overlook the adequacy of test assertions, which lowers the capability of test cases to detect faults; (2) they utilize only coarse line coverage singals instead of specific information about uncovered lines and branches; (3) they use exact-matching context retrieval approaches, which fails to provide accurate context given potential hallucinated queries from LLMs. To address these challenges, we propose MuMuTestUp, a Mutation-guided, Multi-agent framework for automated test case updating. MuMuTestUp integrates three specialized agents: (1) a Mutation Analysis agent that leverages surviving mutants as indicators of weak or missing test assertions and generates individual repair instructions to strengthen or synthesize assertions for each surviving mutant, (2) a Coverage Analysis agent generates individual repair instructions for each uncovered line, uncovered branch rather than exposing raw coverage signals to the LLM, and (3) a Semantic Retrieval agent that uses semantic-similarity search to handle unavailable or hallucinated symbols. Additionally, we construct Prbench, a pull-request–level dataset of 571 samples from 10 open-source Java projects that considered cross-commit update scenarios, validated through three rounds of execution following prior studies to detect outdated tests. We evaluate MuMuTestUp against state-of-the-art baselines using both open-source and closed-source LLMs (Deepseek-V3.2 and GPT-4.1). With GPT-4.1, MuMuTestUp achieves a line coverage of 88.94\%, branch coverage of 63.36\%, and mutation score of 72.39\%, outperforming the best baseline by 5.33\%, 19.93\%, and 16.66\%, respectively.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代软件系统在持续集成与部署（CI/CD）实践下快速演化，其中测试充当软件质量的关键守门人。然而，当引入大量代码变更时，现有测试用例可能过时，导致编译失败、错误的测试行为或回归覆盖率不足。此类问题会中断CI/CD流水线，降低开发效率，并最终损害整体软件质量。许多工作致力于设计自动测试用例更新方法来解决这些问题。最近的方法依赖大语言模型（LLMs）利用来自编译错误或覆盖率报告的执行反馈迭代地精化测试用例，并通过精确匹配方法检索上下文。它们还优先考虑测试可执行性和行覆盖率，以快速从原始损坏的测试用例构建可执行、正确的测试用例。尽管这些方法正确，但当前方法面临三个局限：(1) 它们关注可执行性但忽视测试断言的充分性，降低了测试用例检测故障的能力；(2) 它们仅使用粗粒度的行覆盖率信号，而非未覆盖行和分支的具体信息；(3) 它们使用精确匹配的上下文检索方法，当LLM产生潜在的幻觉查询时无法提供准确上下文。为应对这些挑战，我们提出MuMuTestUp，一个变异引导的多智能体自动测试用例更新框架。MuMuTestUp集成三个专用智能体：(1) 变异分析智能体，利用存活变异体作为弱或缺失测试断言的指标，并为每个存活变异体生成单独的修复指令以增强或合成断言；(2) 覆盖率分析智能体，为每个未覆盖行、未覆盖分支生成单独的修复指令，而不是将原始覆盖率信号暴露给LLM；(3) 语义检索智能体，使用语义相似性搜索来处理不可用或幻觉的符号。此外，我们构建了Prbench，一个包含来自10个开源Java项目的571个样本的拉取请求级数据集，考虑了跨提交更新场景，并按照先前研究通过三轮执行验证以检测过时测试。我们使用开源和闭源LLM（Deepseek-V3.2和GPT-4.1）将MuMuTestUp与最先进基线进行评估。使用GPT-4.1时，MuMuTestUp达到行覆盖率88.94%、分支覆盖率63.36%和变异得分72.39%，分别超过最佳基线5.33%、19.93%和16.66%。

upstream_only.title: Names Are All You Need: Effective and Safe Regression Test Selection for Python
upstream_only.abstract: Regression test selection (RTS) reduces the cost of regression testing by executing only those tests affected by a code change. Despite extensive study of RTS in statically typed languages such as Java, achieving effective and safe RTS in Python is challenging. Python’s dynamic typing makes precise call-graph construction difficult, which can cause call-graph-based RTS to miss affected tests, and hence, compromise safety. Python’s eager importing mechanism, in contrast, renders file-level dependency analysis overly conservative. This paper presents NameRTS, the first Python RTS approach based on fine-grained dependency analysis. NameRTS models a Python program as a bipartite graph of code element nodes (e.g., classes, functions, global variables) and name nodes (i.e., identifiers used to reference code elements), with edges capturing definitions and references. RTS is formulated as a reachability problem on this graph: a test is selected if any modified code element is reachable from the names used in that test. This design avoids call-graph construction, enabling a conservative analysis amenable to safety. To control dependency cascades introduced by coarse name matching, NameRTS applies two pruning strategies that leverage prior test executions and context information to refine name matching. To evaluate NameRTS, we construct the first Python RTS dataset with a ground truth indicating which test files are affected by each commit. It includes 500 commits drawn from 10 real-world Python projects. We compare NameRTS with the best-performing baseline, BabelRTS, an RTS technique based on coarse file-level dependencies. On this benchmark, NameRTS skips 69.90\% of test files on average, outperforming BabelRTS by 146.5\%. It also reduces end-to-end testing time by 45.59\%, yielding a 107.7\% improvement over BabelRTS. In terms of safety, NameRTS selects all affected tests for 99.6\% of commits, with only rare misses in exceptional cases. In contrast, BabelRTS is safe for 76.6\% of commits. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of NameRTS, paving the way for more efficient regression testing in Python.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 回归测试选择（RTS）通过仅执行受代码更改影响的测试来降低回归测试的成本。尽管在Java等静态类型语言中已有大量关于RTS的研究，但在Python中实现有效且安全的RTS仍具有挑战性。Python的动态类型特性使得精确的调用图构建变得困难，这可能导致基于调用图的RTS遗漏受影响的测试，从而损害安全性。相反，Python的急切导入机制使得文件级依赖分析过于保守。本文提出了NameRTS，这是第一个基于细粒度依赖分析的Python RTS方法。NameRTS将Python程序建模为代码元素节点（例如，类、函数、全局变量）和名称节点（即用于引用代码元素的标识符）组成的二部图，边表示定义和引用关系。RTS被形式化为该图上的可达性问题：如果测试中使用的名称可以到达任何被修改的代码元素，则选择该测试。这种设计避免了调用图构建，从而支持一种适合安全性的保守分析。为了控制粗粒度名称匹配引入的依赖级联，NameRTS应用了两种剪枝策略，利用先前的测试执行和上下文信息来细化名称匹配。为了评估NameRTS，我们构建了第一个Python RTS数据集，其中包含指示每个提交影响哪些测试文件的地面真值。该数据集包含来自10个真实世界Python项目的500个提交。我们将NameRTS与表现最佳的基线BabelRTS（一种基于粗粒度文件级依赖的RTS技术）进行比较。在该基准上，NameRTS平均跳过69.90%的测试文件，比BabelRTS高出146.5%。它还将端到端测试时间减少了45.59%，比BabelRTS提升了107.7%。在安全性方面，NameRTS为99.6%的提交选择了所有受影响的测试，仅在特殊情况下出现罕见遗漏。相比之下，BabelRTS对76.6%的提交是安全的。这些结果证明了NameRTS的有效性，为Python中更高效的回归测试铺平了道路。

upstream_only.title: From Static to Dynamic: Benchmarking Real-World Code Review with MCR-Bench
upstream_only.abstract: In real-world software development, code review typically involves iterative interactions between developers and reviewers to improve software quality, making the process costly and time-consuming. Although recent work explores large language models (LLMs) for automated code review, most approaches oversimplify code review into a single-round, static decision task, which fails to capture the multi-round interactive nature and the complex problem-solving processes inherent in realistic review scenarios. To bridge this gap, we introduce MCR-bench, the first defect state-aware benchmark designed for realistic multi-round code review. MCR-bench covers five commonly-used programming languages and consists of 2,269 real-world multi-round code review tasks, each of which is annotated with fine-grained defect information and cross-round state labels. Each task in MCR-bench is equipped with fine-grained defect metadata (e.g., description, type, severity) alongside dynamic state annotations, capturing the complete evolutionary trajectory of a defect throughout the multi-round process. We obtain several findings through extensive experiments on MCR-bench with mainstream LLMs. (1) Limited overall capability: experiments reveal that mainstream LLMs exhibit limited overall performance in defect detection and defect lifecycle state tracking, with performance degrading significantly as the number of interaction rounds increases; (2) Defect-sensitive performance: LLMs' performance varies substantially across different defect types and severity levels, with semantically complex or low-salience defects being significantly more likely to be missed; (3) Underlying Failure Mechanisms: our in-depth error analysis dissects the distinct drivers of false positives and false negatives, revealing critical weaknesses such as cross-round temporal misalignment and inadequate long-range memory.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在真实软件开发中，代码审查通常涉及开发人员和审查人员之间的迭代交互，以提高软件质量，使得该过程成本高昂且耗时。尽管最近的工作探索了使用大型语言模型（LLM）进行自动代码审查，但大多数方法将代码审查过度简化为单轮、静态决策任务，未能捕捉现实审查场景中固有的多轮交互性质和复杂问题解决过程。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了MCR-bench，这是第一个面向真实多轮代码审查的缺陷状态感知基准。MCR-bench涵盖五种常用编程语言，包含2,269个真实世界的多轮代码审查任务，每个任务都标注了细粒度缺陷信息和跨轮状态标签。MCR-bench中的每个任务都配备了细粒度缺陷元数据（例如描述、类型、严重性）以及动态状态标注，捕捉缺陷在多轮过程中的完整演化轨迹。我们通过对MCR-bench与主流LLM进行广泛实验，获得了若干发现。(1) 整体能力有限：实验表明，主流LLM在缺陷检测和缺陷生命周期状态跟踪方面表现出有限的整体性能，且随着交互轮数增加，性能显著下降；(2) 缺陷敏感的性能：LLM的性能在不同缺陷类型和严重性级别上差异很大，语义复杂或低显著性的缺陷更容易被遗漏；(3) 潜在失败机制：我们深入的错误分析剖析了假阳性和假阴性的不同驱动因素，揭示了跨轮时间错位和长程记忆不足等关键弱点。

upstream_only.title: Rust’s Type Checker Implementation Is Unsound: An Empirical Study on Soundness Bugs in rustc
upstream_only.abstract: Rust is claimed to be a type-sound language capable of preventing various undesirable behaviors, including memory bugs. However, rustc, the official Rust compiler, is not immune to defects; it contains soundness bugs, where the compiler accepts programs that should be rejected during type checking. In this work, we present an empirical study of 30 issues that report potential soundness bugs in rustc, collected from the GitHub issue tracker between January 1, 2022 and September 1, 2025. We analyze each issue in depth, focusing on its affected feature, symptom (how the feature is mishandled), consequence (the resulting undesirable behavior), triggering features, community consensus regarding whether it is a bug, and lifecycle, including introduction, discovery, and fix. Furthermore, we investigate existing artifacts, including implementations such as AddressSanitizer, Miri, Chalk, and a-mir-formality, alongside documentation such as the Rust Reference, the FLS, and Rust RFCs to assess their potential as oracles for testing the type soundness of rustc. Our key findings indicate that: (1) Certain soundness bugs, typically triggered by implied bounds or trait objects, compromise memory safety. (2) Sound type checking is challenged by edge cases involving associated types and the interaction between lifetimes and traits. (3) Most bugs persist from the initial introduction of the relevant features and require significant time to be discovered. (4) While AddressSanitizer and Miri can detect soundness bugs that lead to memory bugs, a-mir-formality and Chalk are currently immature despite their potential to identify other bug categories. (5) Existing documentation frequently fails to provide precise explanations of the language semantics.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Rust 被认为是一种类型健全的语言，能够防止各种不良行为，包括内存错误。然而，Rust 的官方编译器 rustc 并非无懈可击；它包含健全性错误，即编译器接受了本应在类型检查期间被拒绝的程序。在这项工作中，我们呈现了一项针对 30 个报告 rustc 中潜在健全性错误的 issue 的实证研究，这些 issue 收集自 2022 年 1 月 1 日至 2025 年 9 月 1 日期间的 GitHub issue tracker。我们深入分析每个 issue，重点关注其受影响特性、症状（特性如何被错误处理）、后果（由此产生的不良行为）、触发特性、社区关于其是否为 bug 的共识，以及生命周期，包括引入、发现和修复。此外，我们调查现有制品，包括 AddressSanitizer、Miri、Chalk 和 a-mir-formality 等实现，以及 Rust Reference、FLS 和 Rust RFC 等文档，以评估它们作为测试 rustc 类型健全性的预言机的潜力。我们的主要发现表明：(1) 某些健全性错误，通常由隐含约束或 trait 对象触发，会破坏内存安全。(2) 类型检查的健全性受到关联类型以及生命周期与 trait 之间交互的边缘情况的挑战。(3) 大多数 bug 从相关特性最初引入时就存在，并且需要很长时间才能被发现。(4) 虽然 AddressSanitizer 和 Miri 可以检测导致内存 bug 的健全性错误，但 a-mir-formality 和 Chalk 目前尚不成熟，尽管它们有潜力识别其他 bug 类别。(5) 现有文档常常无法提供对语言语义的精确解释。

upstream_only.title: Solving String Split Constraints via Structural Relaxation
upstream_only.abstract: String operations are integral to program analysis, yet reasoning about the ubiquitous split operation remains a challenge. SMT solvers have difficulty with split because it transforms a string into a variable-length sequence, creating a structural mismatch that leads to uninterpreted abstractions or unsound bounded approximations. In this paper, we bridge this gap with a precise, SMT-LIB-compliant encoding. Our key insight is structural relaxation: exploiting the sparsity of real-world constraints, we decouple the split structure from strict length requirements, materializing segments only on demand. We further introduce position-aware constraints to handle complex regex-based delimiters without overlaps. We evaluated our framework on 580 benchmarks using four leading string solvers. Our encoding enables off-the-shelf solvers to handle split constraints, solving 157 out of 168 real-world benchmarks and outperforming current baselines. Notably, our framework involves complex string operations, revealing 12 previously unknown implementation bugs in mainstream solvers.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 字符串操作是程序分析不可或缺的一部分，然而对无处不在的分割操作的推理仍然是一个挑战。SMT求解器难以处理分割，因为它将字符串转换为可变长度序列，造成结构不匹配，导致未解释抽象或不健全的有界近似。在本文中，我们通过一个精确且符合SMT-LIB的编码来弥合这一差距。我们的关键见解是结构松弛：利用现实世界约束的稀疏性，我们将分割结构与严格的长度要求解耦，仅在需要时物化片段。我们进一步引入位置感知约束，以处理复杂的基于正则表达式的分隔符而不产生重叠。我们在580个基准测试上使用四种领先的字符串求解器评估了我们的框架。我们的编码使现成的求解器能够处理分割约束，在168个真实世界基准测试中解决了157个，并优于当前基线。值得注意的是，我们的框架涉及复杂的字符串操作，揭示了主流求解器中12个先前未知的实现错误。

upstream_only.title: Augmenting Multi-technique Static Analysis with Large Language Models: A Neuro-symbolic Approach to Smart Contract Vulnerability Detection
upstream_only.abstract: Smart contracts facilitate and enforce agreements between untrusted parties without trusted intermediaries, but vulnerabilities within contracts can cause severe damage once exploited. Various analysis techniques have been proposed for vulnerability detection, but they are typically limited to specific vulnerability types. While recent frameworks employ aggregation to broaden detection capacity, they often accumulate false positives due to loose integration that fails to resolve underlying conflicts. Meanwhile, the semantic reasoning capacity of large language models (LLMs) has shown promise in detecting vulnerabilities, despite inherent reasoning bottlenecks and hallucinations. Recognizing these challenges, in this work, we propose a novel neuro-symbolic approach, named Ensemble LLM-Assisted Static Analysis (ELSA). ELSA comprises two key modules, namely, LLM-assisted static analysis and analyzer ensemble (the ensemble of multiple LLM-assisted static analyzers), each incorporating two distinct strategies. The LLM-assisted static analysis augments individual analysis techniques with constraint-guided neural semantic reasoning, while the analyzer ensemble resolves conflicting outputs to distill a robust consensus. We evaluate ELSA on a comprehensive benchmark, including three open-source datasets and additional self-constructed Zero-Knowledge Proof-based smart contracts whose complexity poses unique challenges to static analysis. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves an overall improvement of at least 17\% over baselines and advanced mainstream approaches, effectively bridging semantic gaps and synergizing the complementary advantages of different analyzers. Furthermore, an ablation study and fine-grained analysis are conducted to investigate the key factors contributing to overall performance gains.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 智能合约可以在没有可信中介的情况下促进和执行不受信任方之间的协议，但合约中的漏洞一旦被利用可能造成严重损害。虽然已经提出了各种分析技术用于漏洞检测，但它们通常局限于特定的漏洞类型。最近的一些框架采用聚合方式来扩展检测能力，但由于松散的集成未能解决潜在的冲突，往往会累积误报。与此同时，大语言模型（LLM）的语义推理能力在检测漏洞方面显示出潜力，尽管存在固有的推理瓶颈和幻觉问题。认识到这些挑战，在本工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的神经符号方法，名为集成LLM辅助静态分析（ELSA）。ELSA包含两个关键模块，即LLM辅助静态分析和分析器集成（多个LLM辅助静态分析器的集成），每个模块都包含两种不同的策略。LLM辅助静态分析通过约束引导的神经语义推理增强单个分析技术，而分析器集成则解决冲突输出以提炼出稳健的共识。我们在一个全面的基准上评估ELSA，包括三个开源数据集以及额外自构建的基于零知识证明的智能合约，其复杂性对静态分析提出了独特挑战。实验结果表明，我们的方法相比基线和先进主流方法总体提升至少17%，有效弥合了语义差距并协同了不同分析器的互补优势。此外，我们还进行了消融研究和细粒度分析，以探究促成整体性能提升的关键因素。

upstream_only.title: Rethinking Mixture-of-Experts for Vulnerability Detection: An Empirical Study and Improved Design
upstream_only.abstract: Deep learning–based vulnerability detection (DLVD) has recently adopted the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) paradigm to address vulnerability heterogeneity and the long-tailed distribution of Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) categories. A representative framework, MoEVD, builds CWE-specific experts and a router for expert selection, but its assumptions about expert specialization and routing reliability remain underexplored. We reproduce MoEVD under the same dataset, splits, backbone, and evaluation protocol, and conduct a fine-grained empirical study of expert behavior and routing decisions. We find that CWE-based experts do not consistently develop stable or exclusive specialization, and their effectiveness is highly sensitive to non-target vulnerabilities. More importantly, an idealized-router baseline shows that routing mismatch measurably limits what the original experts can achieve under idealized routing, while learned routing disproportionately sends non-vulnerable samples to a few experts. Guided by these findings, we explore targeted changes that relax strict CWE-based expert binding and replace fixed top-k routing with probability-mass-based top-p selection under a controlled OR-style voting rule. Under a controlled OR-style comparison on BigVul, the combined design shifts the precision--recall trade-off, improving F1 from 0.38 to 0.42 and recall from 0.32 to 0.39 while slightly increasing FPR. Repeated runs and zero-shot checks on two external datasets suggest that the trend is stable in the evaluated settings, while the improvements remain modest.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 基于深度学习的漏洞检测（DLVD）最近采用了混合专家（MoE）范式，以应对漏洞异质性和通用弱点枚举（CWE）类别的长尾分布。一个代表性框架 MoEVD 构建了 CWE 特定的专家和一个用于专家选择的路由器，但其关于专家专门化和路由可靠性的假设仍未得到充分探索。我们在相同的数据集、划分、骨干网络和评估协议下复现了 MoEVD，并对专家行为和路由决策进行了细粒度实证研究。我们发现，基于 CWE 的专家并未一致地形成稳定或排他的专门化，其有效性对非目标漏洞高度敏感。更重要的是，一个理想化路由器基线表明，路由不匹配可测量地限制了原始专家在理想化路由下能够达到的性能，而学习到的路由则不成比例地将非漏洞样本发送给少数专家。在这些发现的指导下，我们探索了有针对性的修改：放宽严格的基于 CWE 的专家绑定，并在受控的 OR 式投票规则下，将固定的 top-k 路由替换为基于概率质量的 top-p 选择。在 BigVul 上进行受控的 OR 式比较时，组合设计改变了精确率-召回率权衡，将 F1 从 0.38 提高到 0.42，召回率从 0.32 提高到 0.39，同时略微增加了 FPR。重复运行和在两个外部数据集上的零样本检查表明，在评估设置中该趋势是稳定的，而改进仍然有限。

upstream_only.title: RecurIC3: Exploiting Structural Lemma Reuse to Accelerate IC3
upstream_only.abstract: IC3/PDR has become a widely adopted technique for safety model checking due to its high efficiency. Despite its success, the algorithm often suffers from redundant exploration due to the lack of a cross-level memory mechanism. This results in the repetitive discovery of highly similar CTIs (Counterexamples to Induction), forcing the solver to waste computational effort traversing overlapping blocking chains. We propose RecurIC3, a framework that alleviates this bottleneck via structural reuse. RecurIC3 maintains a Bad State Tree (G_bad) that persistently records CTIs together with their level-aligned predecessor–successor links along blocking chains, turning the blocking phase into a history-aware process. To reduce solver calls, RecurIC3 first retrieves and rechecks lightweight candidates from G_bad and falls back to solver queries only when reuse is exhausted. This approach can significantly reduce the search space, thereby enhancing the verification efficiency of IC3. We implemented RecurIC3 in the state-of-the-art model checker Kind2 and evaluated it on the official benchmark suite. On instances where reuse is triggered, RecurIC3 reduces the number of explored tree nodes by 27\%, achieves a 1.42{\texttimes} cumulative speedup, and solves 16 additional instances (13 Safe and 3 Unsafe) within the same timeout. These results suggest that structural reuse can substantially accelerate IC3.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: IC3/PDR因其高效性已成为安全模型检测中广泛采用的技术。尽管取得了成功，该算法常常因缺乏跨层记忆机制而遭受冗余探索。这导致重复发现高度相似的CTI（归纳反例），迫使求解器浪费计算努力遍历重叠的阻塞链。我们提出RecurIC3，一个通过结构复用缓解此瓶颈的框架。RecurIC3维护一个坏状态树（G_bad），持续记录CTI及其沿阻塞链的层级对齐的前驱-后继链接，将阻塞阶段转变为历史感知过程。为了减少求解器调用，RecurIC3首先从G_bad中检索并重新检查轻量级候选，只有当复用耗尽时才回退到求解器查询。这种方法可以显著减少搜索空间，从而提高IC3的验证效率。我们在最先进的模型检测器Kind2中实现了RecurIC3，并在官方基准套件上进行了评估。在触发复用的实例上，RecurIC3将探索的树节点数量减少27%，实现1.42倍的累积加速，并在相同超时内多解决16个实例（13个安全，3个不安全）。这些结果表明结构复用可以显著加速IC3。

upstream_only.title: CausalRepair: Bridging the Causality Gap in Large Language Model-Based Automated Program Repair via Dual-Slicing
upstream_only.abstract: Automated Program Repair (APR) aims to automatically fix buggy programs. In recent years, with the rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs), LLM-based APR techniques have achieved significant progress. Despite their potential, the effectiveness of LLMs relies heavily on the quality of the provided repair context. However, existing LLM-based APR approaches suffer from a causality gap when constructing such contexts. Specifically, on the test side, existing methods struggle with test context ambiguity arising from noise interference or dependency absence; meanwhile, on the source side, existing retrieval-augmented methods primarily rely on static analysis inevitably introduce static over-approximation, resulting in contexts filled with unexecuted code and noise. Consequently, these contexts mislead LLMs, hindering them from identifying the true root cause and leading to incorrect fixes. To bridge this gap, we introduce the concept of minimal causal context, defined as the essential set of dependencies required to explain a specific failure. Based on this, we propose CausalRepair, a novel conversation-driven APR framework that instantiates this concept through a synergistic dual-slicing strategy. Specifically, CausalRepair employs context-aware static slicing on the test side to purify test semantics, and utilizes execution-trace-based dynamic slicing on the source side to capture precise runtime dependencies. This constructs a high-quality context causally relevant to the bug, which filters out irrelevant code and guides the iterative repair process. We evaluate CausalRepair on the widely used Defects4J (V1.2 and V2.0) and the latest Defects4J-Trans benchmarks. To ensure a fair comparison, we unify the backbone model as DeepSeek-V3 in all experiments. The results demonstrate that CausalRepair correctly fixes 313 bugs on Defects4J, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art approaches such as ReinFix and TSAPR, while reducing the average repair cost to $0.029 per bug, achieving a dual optimization of effectiveness and efficiency.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 自动程序修复（APR）旨在自动修复有缺陷的程序。近年来，随着大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展，基于LLM的APR技术取得了显著进展。尽管潜力巨大，但LLM的有效性在很大程度上依赖于所提供的修复上下文的质量。然而，现有的基于LLM的APR方法在构建此类上下文时存在因果差距。具体而言，在测试侧，现有方法难以应对由噪声干扰或依赖缺失引起的测试上下文模糊性；同时，在源代码侧，现有的检索增强方法主要依赖静态分析，不可避免地引入静态过近似，导致上下文中充满未执行的代码和噪声。因此，这些上下文会误导LLM，阻碍其识别真正的根本原因并导致错误的修复。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了最小因果上下文的概念，定义为解释特定故障所需的基本依赖集。基于此，我们提出了CausalRepair，一种新颖的对话驱动的APR框架，通过协同双切片策略实例化这一概念。具体而言，CausalRepair在测试侧采用上下文感知的静态切片来净化测试语义，并在源代码侧利用基于执行轨迹的动态切片来捕获精确的运行时依赖。这构建了与缺陷因果相关的高质量上下文，过滤掉无关代码并指导迭代修复过程。我们在广泛使用的Defects4J（V1.2和V2.0）以及最新的Defects4J-Trans基准上评估了CausalRepair。为确保公平比较，我们在所有实验中将骨干模型统一为DeepSeek-V3。结果表明，CausalRepair在Defects4J上正确修复了313个缺陷，显著优于ReinFix和TSAPR等最先进方法，同时将平均修复成本降低至每个缺陷0.029美元，实现了有效性和效率的双重优化。

upstream_only.title: Towards Understanding the Bugs in Verilator, a Hardware Description Language Compiler
upstream_only.abstract: Verilator is the premier open-source Hardware Description Language (HDL) compiler. It transforms Verilog and SystemVerilog designs into optimized C++ or SystemC models, enabling high-speed, cycle-accurate simulation prior to large-scale production. As a cornerstone of the hardware verification ecosystem, the correctness of Verilator is paramount; compiler faults can lead to silent simulation errors or unexpected failures, undermining the integrity of the hardware development lifecycle. Unlike traditional software compilers, HDL compilers manage unique concurrency and synthesis semantics, potentially introducing distinct bug patterns and complexities. However, while prior research has explored testing techniques for HDL toolchains, there remains a lack of systematic empirical studies characterizing the specific nature of bugs in Verilator. This knowledge gap hinders the development of targeted improvements in compiler robustness and testing strategies. To address this, we present the first comprehensive empirical study of Verilator bugs. We manually collected, analyzed, and categorized a dataset of 488 confirmed bugs from the official repository over three years. Our study investigates bug symptoms, root causes, and the characteristics of triggering test cases, while also evaluating the effectiveness of existing testing techniques. Based on our findings, we provide actionable guidance for developers to enhance Verilator's reliability and for researchers to design more effective automated testing methodologies for HDL compilers.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Verilator是首屈一指的开源硬件描述语言（HDL）编译器。它将Verilog和SystemVerilog设计转换为优化的C++或SystemC模型，从而能够在大规模生产之前进行高速、周期精确的仿真。作为硬件验证生态系统的基石，Verilator的正确性至关重要；编译器故障可能导致静默仿真错误或意外失败，破坏硬件开发生命周期的完整性。与传统软件编译器不同，HDL编译器管理独特的并发和综合语义，可能引入不同的缺陷模式和复杂性。然而，尽管先前研究探索了HDL工具链的测试技术，但仍缺乏系统的实证研究来刻画Verilator中缺陷的具体性质。这一知识空白阻碍了编译器鲁棒性和测试策略的针对性改进。为此，我们提出了首个针对Verilator缺陷的全面实证研究。我们从官方仓库手动收集、分析并分类了三年内488个已确认缺陷的数据集。我们的研究调查了缺陷症状、根本原因和触发测试用例的特征，同时评估了现有测试技术的有效性。基于我们的发现，我们为开发者增强Verilator的可靠性提供了可操作指导，并为研究人员设计更有效的HDL编译器自动化测试方法提供了建议。

upstream_only.title: DeepSCA: Dependency-Aware Software Composition Analysis for C/C++ Based on a Curated Code Feature Database
upstream_only.abstract: Software Composition Analysis (SCA) identifies reused third-party libraries (TPLs) and their dependencies, forming the basis of Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) for securing software supply chain. Current C/C++ SCA techniques extract code features and match them against a TPL feature database. However, detection recall is limited by feature database coverage, and two key challenges remain: (1) Coverage-Precision Trade-off: Feature databases built from a single repository (e.g., GitHub) often yield high false negatives, as C/C++ TPLs are inherently distributed across diverse hosting platforms (e.g., Debian, ArchLinux, and Xrepo), each offering partially overlapping yet distinct sets of TPLs. Although a multi-repository feature database improves TPL coverage, it inevitably introduces numerous shared functions (e.g., cross-TPL code clones) that map to a broader set of candidate origins. When coupled with the limitations of existing SCA techniques in tracing provenance, this ambiguity further increases false positives. (2) Neglected Dependency Context: Existing SCA techniques primarily focus on detecting reused TPLs but often overlook their inter-dependencies. However, license compatibility constraints are inherently determined by directed dependency relationships among TPLs. DeepSCA addresses Challenge 1 by constructing a feature database with 66,143,596 functions extracted from 33,100 C/C++ TPLs, covering nine mainstream hosting repositories. To reduce false positives from shared functions, DeepSCA groups TPLs with shared code, and uses distinctiveness scores to trace functions to their origins—ensuring high precision without sacrificing recall. To overcome Challenge 2, DeepSCA generates the dependency graph from the detected TPLs. it resolves filename ambiguity by simulating compiler header search paths and mitigates symbol ambiguity via namespace-aware resolution, enabling accurate file-level dependency mapping to TPLs. Evaluated on a ground-truth dataset of 335 OpenHarmony projects (10,583 TPLs, 64,200 dependencies), DeepSCA achieves 85.6\% precision and 87.3\% recall for TPL detection, outperforming state-of-the-art tools (e.g., 16.8\% precision and 21.1\% recall improvement over TPLite). Its dependency graphs reach 91.8\% precision, surpassing Cneps by 11.3\%. Moreover, the dependency graph generated by DeepSCA uncovers previously hidden combinations of license incompatibility issues in real-world projects.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 软件成分分析（SCA）识别被复用的第三方库（TPL）及其依赖关系，构成软件物料清单（SBOM）的基础，以保障软件供应链安全。当前的C/C++ SCA技术提取代码特征，并与TPL特征数据库进行匹配。然而，检测召回率受限于特征数据库的覆盖范围，并且仍存在两个关键挑战：（1）覆盖范围与精度之间的权衡：基于单一仓库（如GitHub）构建的特征数据库通常会导致较高的假阴性，因为C/C++ TPL本质上分布在不同的托管平台（如Debian、ArchLinux和Xrepo）上，每个平台提供部分重叠但不同的TPL集合。尽管多仓库特征数据库提高了TPL覆盖率，但它不可避免地引入了大量共享函数（例如跨TPL代码克隆），这些函数映射到更广泛的候选来源。当与现有SCA技术在溯源方面的局限性相结合时，这种模糊性进一步增加了假阳性。（2）被忽视的依赖上下文：现有SCA技术主要关注检测被复用的TPL，但往往忽视它们之间的相互依赖关系。然而，许可证兼容性约束本质上是由TPL之间的有向依赖关系决定的。DeepSCA通过构建一个包含从33,100个C/C++ TPL中提取的66,143,596个函数的特征数据库来解决挑战1，覆盖九个主流托管仓库。为了减少共享函数带来的假阳性，DeepSCA将具有共享代码的TPL分组，并使用独特性评分将函数溯源到其来源——确保高精度而不牺牲召回率。为了克服挑战2，DeepSCA从检测到的TPL生成依赖图。它通过模拟编译器头文件搜索路径来解决文件名歧义，并通过命名空间感知的解析来缓解符号歧义，从而实现准确的、到TPL的文件级依赖映射。在包含335个OpenHarmony项目（10,583个TPL，64,200个依赖关系）的真实基准数据集上评估，DeepSCA在TPL检测上达到85.6%的精度和87.3%的召回率，优于最先进的工具（例如，相比TPLite精度提高16.8%，召回率提高21.1%）。其依赖图达到91.8%的精度，超过Cneps 11.3%。此外，DeepSCA生成的依赖图揭示了现实项目中以前隐藏的许可证不兼容问题组合。

upstream_only.title: MalTotal: Cost-Effective and Language-Agnostic Malicious Code Poisoning Detection for Millions of Repositories
upstream_only.abstract: The widespread adoption of open source software (OSS) has introduced significant security risks, with malicious code poisoning attacks increasingly targeting public package registries and open-source platforms. Existing detection approaches, including heuristic-, learning-, and LLM-based methods, suffer from language-specific designs, limited generalization, and high analysis costs, making them unsuitable for large-scale multi-language analysis. To address these challenges, we propose MalTotal, a scalable and cost-effective framework for language-agnostic malicious code detection. MalTotal leverages LLM-assisted semantic reasoning to identify sensitive APIs, perform hybrid semantic slicing, and reconstruct malicious behavior contexts while reducing analysis overhead. Our evaluations show that MalTotal outperforms 8 state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an average F1-score of 93.1
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 开源软件（OSS）的广泛采用引入了显著的安全风险，恶意代码投毒攻击越来越多地针对公共包注册表和开源平台。现有检测方法，包括基于启发式、学习和LLM的方法，存在语言特定设计、泛化能力有限和分析成本高昂等问题，使其不适合大规模多语言分析。为应对这些挑战，我们提出MalTotal，一个可扩展且经济高效的语言无关恶意代码检测框架。MalTotal利用LLM辅助的语义推理来识别敏感API、执行混合语义切片，并在降低分析开销的同时重建恶意行为上下文。我们的评估表明，MalTotal优于8个最先进的基线，平均F1分数达到93.1

upstream_only.title: Repair-Driven Greybox Fuzzing
upstream_only.abstract: We present repair-driven greybox fuzzing, a new approach to greybox fuzzing that combines the strengths of unstructured, byte-level input mutation and grammar-guided input generation. By increasing input diversity while preserving input validity, repair-driven fuzzing promises to improve bug-finding ability for systems under test such as programming language interpreters that consume highly structured inputs. Our idea is to first mutate an input using a standard byte-level mutator, typically leading to an invalid input, and then repair the input using a grammar. Aggressively breaking and then repairing an input provides an effective way to reach parts of the input space that would be left unexplored by both byte-level and idiomatic grammar-based mutations. We put this idea into practice via RepairFuzz, a new greybox fuzzer based on AFL++, leveraging the byte level mutations of AFL++ and using the CPCT+ error recovery algorithm for input repair. We present experiments applying RepairFuzz to six SUTs covering four programming language input formats (Lua, PHP, JavaScript and Ruby), and present an experimental comparison with AFL++, Grammarinator and Nautilus, the state-of-the-art in standard greybox fuzzing and grammar-guided fuzzing. Our evaluation shows that RepairFuzz was able to find 13 confirmed bugs that were previously unknown, including 9 that were not found by AFL++, Grammarinator or Nautilus. Further, RepairFuzz yields absolute increases in code coverage for several SUTs and substantial complementary code coverage across all.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了修复驱动的灰盒模糊测试，这是一种新的灰盒模糊测试方法，它结合了非结构化的字节级输入变异和语法引导的输入生成的优势。通过在保持输入有效性的同时增加输入多样性，修复驱动的模糊测试有望提高对被测系统的错误发现能力，例如处理高度结构化输入的编程语言解释器。我们的想法是首先使用标准的字节级变异器对输入进行变异，通常导致无效输入，然后使用语法修复该输入。积极地破坏输入然后修复输入，提供了一种有效的方式来触及字节级变异和惯用语法变异都会未探索的输入空间部分。我们通过 RepairFuzz 将这一想法付诸实践，RepairFuzz 是一种基于 AFL++ 的新型灰盒模糊器，利用 AFL++ 的字节级变异，并使用 CPCT+ 错误恢复算法进行输入修复。我们展示了将 RepairFuzz 应用于六个 SUT 的实验，涵盖四种编程语言输入格式（Lua、PHP、JavaScript 和 Ruby），并与 AFL++、Grammarinator 和 Nautilus 进行了实验比较，这些是标准灰盒模糊测试和语法引导模糊测试的最新技术。我们的评估表明，RepairFuzz 能够发现 13 个先前未知的已确认错误，其中 9 个是 AFL++、Grammarinator 或 Nautilus 未发现的。此外，RepairFuzz 在多个 SUT 上实现了代码覆盖率的绝对增加，并在所有 SUT 上实现了大量的互补代码覆盖率。

upstream_only.title: CLIR: Liveness-Driven and Structure-Aware Fuzzing for the Cranelift Compiler
upstream_only.abstract: Modern compilers are complex software systems that must correctly translate high-level programming languages into machine code across multiple architectures. Cranelift, a fast and modern compiler backend originally developed for WebAssembly and recently adopted as an experimental backend for Rust, has gained increasing importance due to its superior compilation speed compared to LLVM and comprehensive multi-architecture support, including x86-64, AArch64, s390x, and RISCV64. However, despite decades of development in compiler testing, testing Cranelift still presents unique challenges, including (1) constructing valid IR under the strict enforcement of SSA form, (2) generating sequences with sufficient computational density to stress backend components, and (3) balancing broad backend coverage with efficient root cause analysis across heterogeneous architectures. To address these challenges, we propose CLIR, a differential testing framework that integrates a syntax-preserving hierarchical generation strategy to guarantee SSA validity, a liveness-guided instruction refinement mechanism to maximize computational density, and a diagnosis-guided cross-architecture adaptation scheme to facilitate efficient root cause analysis across heterogeneous backends. Our comprehensive evaluation demonstrates that CLIR substantially outperforms existing state-of-the-art baselines, detecting 8{\texttimes}, 24{\texttimes}, and 8{\texttimes} as many unique bugs as cranelift-fuzzgen, wasm-smith, and WASMaker, respectively, while RustSmith uncovered no bugs. Within 72 hours of testing, CLIR discovered 24 bugs spanning all target architectures, with 21 confirmed and 9 fixed.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代编译器是复杂的软件系统，必须正确地将高级编程语言翻译成跨多种架构的机器码。Cranelift是一个快速且现代的编译器后端，最初为WebAssembly开发，最近被采用为Rust的实验性后端。由于其编译速度优于LLVM以及全面的多架构支持（包括x86-64、AArch64、s390x和RISCV64），其重要性日益增加。然而，尽管编译器测试已有数十年的发展，测试Cranelift仍然面临独特挑战，包括：(1) 在严格强制SSA形式下构造有效IR；(2) 生成具有足够计算密度的序列以对后端组件进行压力测试；(3) 在异构架构上平衡广泛的后端覆盖与高效的根本原因分析。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了CLIR，一个差分测试框架，它集成了语法保持的分层生成策略以保证SSA有效性，一种活性引导的指令细化机制以最大化计算密度，以及一种诊断引导的跨架构适配方案以促进异构后端间的高效根本原因分析。我们的综合评估表明，CLIR大幅优于现有最先进的基线，检测到的唯一错误分别是cranelift-fuzzgen、wasm-smith和WASMaker的8倍、24倍和8倍，而RustSmith未发现任何错误。在72小时测试中，CLIR发现了24个覆盖所有目标架构的错误，其中21个已确认，9个已修复。

upstream_only.title: Testing Static Taint Analyzers with Equivalence Modulo Taint
upstream_only.abstract: Static taint analyzers are widely used to detect security vulnerabilities, yet their complexity makes them prone to soundness and precision issues. Validating these analyzers is challenging because ground-truth taint flows are rarely available and differential testing requires multiple comparable tools. To address this challenge, we introduce Equivalence Modulo Taint (EMT), a testing oracle for static taint analysis that defines program equivalence in terms of preserved source-sink flows rather than program semantics. EMT enables testing a single analyzer without ground-truth labels by checking consistency of reported flows across equivalent-modulo-taint program variants. Based on EMT, we present TaintCC, a framework that generates equivalent-modulo-taint variants through semantically equivalent, taint-oblivious, and taint-aware transformations targeting recurring difficulty dimensions in taint analysis. We evaluate TaintCC on four widely used analyzers---FlowDroid, Mariana Trench, Pysa, and Semgrep---and uncover 16 unique developer-confirmed issues, showing that even mature analyzers, whether academic or industrial, remain susceptible to reliability issues.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 静态污点分析器广泛用于检测安全漏洞，然而其复杂性使其容易出现健全性和精度问题。验证这些分析器具有挑战性，因为基准真值污点流很少可得，而差分测试需要多个可比较的工具。为应对这一挑战，我们引入了等价模污点（Equivalence Modulo Taint, EMT），一种用于静态污点分析的测试预言，它根据保留的源-汇流而非程序语义来定义程序等价性。EMT使得无需基准真值标签即可测试单个分析器，通过检查在等价模污点程序变体之间报告流的一致性。基于EMT，我们提出了TaintCC，一个通过语义等价、污点无感和污点感知的变换生成等价模污点变体的框架，这些变换针对污点分析中反复出现的困难维度。我们在四个广泛使用的分析器——FlowDroid、Mariana Trench、Pysa和Semgrep——上评估了TaintCC，并发现了16个由开发者确认的独特问题，表明即使是成熟的分析器，无论是学术的还是工业的，仍然容易受到可靠性问题的影响。

upstream_only.title: How Does Killing Surviving Mutants Help Detect Real Bugs with Assertion Generation? A Controlled Experiment
upstream_only.abstract: Killing surviving mutants is a central activity of mutation testing. This activity is motivated by the coupling-effect hypothesis: tests that expose simple artificial faults can also detect more complex, previously unseen real bugs. Despite these claimed benefits, automated studies have not directly measured the causal impact of mutant killing on real-bug detection. This limitation stems from open-ended mutant-killing strategies and a fundamental evaluation asymmetry that obscures causal attribution. In this work, we present the first large-scale controlled experiment that directly measures whether killing surviving mutants, without knowledge of future real bugs, would have enabled their detection. We model mutant killing as a selective, incremental process under realistic budget constraints, and we restrict test improvements to assertion augmentation. This restriction enables precise attribution of each test augmentation to a specific mutant-killing action. To support the experiment, we design a fully automated, fault-based assertion-augmentation technique that operates uniformly on mutants and real bugs and integrate it into Defects4J. Our controlled experiment yields several key empirical insights: (1) Across 642 Defects4J bugs, we find that 104 bugs would become detectable by adding an additional assertion to an existing passing, non-triggering test. (2) When coupling exists, a real bug is, on average, coupled with 21 surviving mutants, through which mutant killing can produce triggering tests. This number is substantially higher than the average of two mutants reported in prior studies. In those studies, coupling is inferred solely from documented bug-fixing tests rather than from tests derived via mutant killing. (3) Among these bugs, 63 of the 104 are detectable through principled mutant-killing (test augmentation) process. Notably, killing a randomly selected 30\% of relevant surviving mutants, using only one assertion per mutant, suffices to detect 84.5\% of these bugs. (4) By substituting mutants with real bugs and comparing their resulting assertion augmentation outputs, we find that real bugs induce broader behavioral effects than mutants, affecting more memory state locations, variables, and tests. (5) When mutation-derived assertions detect real bugs, they validate program outputs that overlap with, and are often strict subsets of, those affected by the real bugs. This offers a mechanistic explanation for why killing simple mutants can enable the detection of more complex real bugs.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 杀死存活的变异体是变异测试的核心活动。这一活动由耦合效应假说驱动：暴露简单人工故障的测试也能检测到更复杂、此前未见的真实缺陷。尽管有这些声称的益处，自动化研究尚未直接测量杀死变异体对真实缺陷检测的因果影响。这一局限源于开放的变异体杀死策略和一种根本性的评估不对称，后者模糊了因果归因。在本工作中，我们提出了首个大规模对照实验，直接测量在不知道未来真实缺陷的情况下，杀死存活变异体是否本应能够检测到这些缺陷。我们将变异体杀死建模为现实预算约束下的选择性、增量过程，并将测试改进限制为断言增强。这一限制使得每次测试增强都能精确归因于特定的变异体杀死动作。为支持实验，我们设计了一种完全自动化、基于故障的断言增强技术，该技术统一作用于变异体和真实缺陷，并将其集成到Defects4J中。我们的对照实验得出了若干关键实证见解：(1) 在642个Defects4J缺陷中，我们发现通过向一个现有的通过但未触发缺陷的测试添加额外断言，104个缺陷将变得可检测。(2) 当耦合存在时，一个真实缺陷平均与21个存活变异体耦合，通过杀死这些变异体可以产生触发测试。这一数字远高于先前研究报告的平均两个变异体。在那些研究中，耦合仅从文档化的修复缺陷测试中推断，而不是从通过杀死变异体衍生的测试中推断。(3) 在这些缺陷中，104个中有63个可通过原则化的变异体杀死（测试增强）过程检测到。值得注意的是，随机选择30%的相关存活变异体，每个变异体仅使用一条断言，就足以检测这些缺陷中的84.5%。(4) 通过用真实缺陷替换变异体并比较它们产生的断言增强输出，我们发现真实缺陷比变异体引发更广泛的行为效应，影响更多的内存状态位置、变量和测试。(5) 当变异体衍生的断言检测到真实缺陷时，它们验证的程序输出与真实缺陷影响的输出重叠，且通常是其严格子集。这为为什么杀死简单变异体能够检测更复杂的真实缺陷提供了一种机制性解释。

upstream_only.title: The Illusion of Success: Learning-Based Android Malware Detectors (Replicability Study)
upstream_only.abstract: Since 2012, hundreds of machine-learning-based classification approaches have been proposed to help separate malware from benign Android applications. These approaches typically collect a large number of applications of both types, split them into training and testing subsets, train a binary classifier on the training subset, and measure accuracy on the testing subset. They typically report very high achieved accuracy, i.e., F1-score of around 95\%. Recent work has also highlighted several biases and flaws in the experimental setup and evaluation methodology of such approaches, questioning the trustworthiness of their reported results. In an effort to better understand the current status of classification-based malware detection, we first conduct a systematic literature review to extract the properties of existing tools and the datasets that they use. We then design a large-scale longitudinal study, where we evaluate the most prominent tools on a range of datasets spanning 13 years (2011-2023), which we systematically collected from the AndroZoo and VirusShare repositories while controlling for the known experimental setup biases. Our results show lower than reported classification performance, with the F1-score for a tool ranging from high 60 to low 90 percent, depending on a dataset. Moreover, even successful classification often utilizes hidden but semantically weak correlations in the data. In fact, a deliberately na{\"i}ve and unreliable classifier we designed for this study, which uses application package names as features for classification, performs comparably to and sometimes even better than the state-of-the-art tools when compared under the same setup. These results challenge the claimed detection capabilities of the tools, render comparisons of reported tool accuracy (without empirical evaluation on the exact same set of applications) practically meaningless, and call for the creation of more reliable and explainable semantic malware detection tools.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 自2012年以来，已有数百种基于机器学习的分类方法被提出，用于帮助区分恶意与良性Android应用。这些方法通常收集大量两类应用，将其划分为训练集和测试集，在训练集上训练二分类器，并在测试集上测量准确率。它们通常报告极高的准确率，即F1分数约为95%。近期工作也指出了此类方法在实验设置和评估方法上的若干偏差与缺陷，质疑其报告结果的可信度。为了更好地理解基于分类的恶意软件检测的现状，我们首先进行系统性文献综述，提取现有工具的特性及其使用的数据集。然后，我们设计了一项大规模纵向研究，在跨越13年（2011-2023）的一系列数据集上评估最突出的工具，这些数据集是我们从AndroZoo和VirusShare仓库中系统收集的，同时控制了已知的实验设置偏差。我们的结果显示分类性能低于报告值，工具的F1分数因数据集不同而在60%多到90%出头之间。此外，即使分类成功，也往往利用了数据中隐藏但语义微弱的关联。事实上，我们为本研究设计的一个刻意朴素且不可靠的分类器，使用应用包名作为分类特征，在相同设置下与最先进的工具相比表现相当，有时甚至更好。这些结果挑战了这些工具所声称的检测能力，使得（未在完全相同应用集上进行实证评估的）工具准确率比较实际上毫无意义，并呼吁创建更可靠且可解释的语义恶意软件检测工具。

upstream_only.title: No One-Size-Fits-All: Adaptive Code Editing with Feature-Based Strategy Selection
upstream_only.abstract: Large language models have shown strong potential in automating code editing (CE) tasks, yet most existing systems rely on a fixed CE strategy (i.e., one-step, search-replace, and plan-apply) across diverse scenarios. In practice, CE tasks vary widely in code context, edit locality, and semantic complexity, causing no single strategy to perform consistently well. Moreover, systematic studies on the relationship between strategies and CE tasks remain scarce, limiting further optimization of LLM-based code editing strategies. To address this gap, we construct CEBench, comprising 500 real-world CE tasks curated from SWE-bench. Then we compare three representative CE strategies (one-step, search-replace, plan-apply). Our study reveals two key findings: (1) each strategy exhibits distinct advantages for specific CE tasks, with no universal optimality; (2) strategy effectiveness is significantly influenced by four core task features: total lines of code, modification type, modification scope, and task type. Motivated by these findings, we propose Ace, an adaptive code editing framework that dynamically selects optimal CE strategies based on task features. Unlike classifier-based or instruction-prompting approaches, Ace employs a fine-tuned LLM that learns feature-strategy mappings from empirical data to recommend strategies with interpretable rationales. Extensive experiments on our CEBench-verified show that Ace outperforms state-of-the-art baselines: it boosts Pass@1 by 21.7\% while reducing token consumption by 27.3\% compared to the best baseline (AutoCodeRover). Our strategy selector achieves 72.6\% selection accuracy with 69.9\% rationale accuracy (Cohen’s Kappa=0.807), providing transparent and trustworthy decision-making for developers.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型在自动化代码编辑（CE）任务中已展现出强大潜力，但大多数现有系统在多样化场景中依赖固定的CE策略（即一步式、搜索替换和计划-应用）。在实践中，CE任务在代码上下文、编辑局部性和语义复杂度方面差异很大，导致没有一种策略能始终表现良好。此外，关于策略与CE任务之间关系的系统性研究仍然稀缺，限制了基于LLM的代码编辑策略的进一步优化。为弥补这一空白，我们构建了CEBench，包含从SWE-bench中筛选出的500个真实世界CE任务。然后我们比较了三种代表性CE策略（一步式、搜索替换、计划-应用）。我们的研究揭示了两项关键发现：(1) 每种策略对特定CE任务表现出独特优势，不存在普遍最优性；(2) 策略有效性显著受到四个核心任务特征的影响：代码总行数、修改类型、修改范围和任务类型。受这些发现启发，我们提出了Ace，一种自适应代码编辑框架，可根据任务特征动态选择最优CE策略。与基于分类器或指令提示的方法不同，Ace采用微调的LLM，从经验数据中学习特征-策略映射，以可解释的理由推荐策略。在我们CEBench-verified上的大量实验表明，Ace优于最先进的基线：与最佳基线（AutoCodeRover）相比，它将Pass@1提升了21.7%，同时将token消耗降低了27.3%。我们的策略选择器实现了72.6%的选择准确率和69.9%的理由准确率（Cohen’s Kappa=0.807），为开发者提供了透明且可信的决策。

upstream_only.title: When Optimizations Backfire: The Paradox of Plaintext Optimizations in Privacy-Preserving ML Compilers
upstream_only.abstract: Growing concerns about data security and privacy have fueled the widespread adoption of Privacy-Preserving Machine Learning (PPML). Cryptography-based PPML, which allows computation directly on encrypted data, significantly mitigates data leakage risks. To facilitate its adoption, Ciphertext Machine Learning Compilers (CMLCs) automate the translation of high-level ML procedures into low-level circuits for encrypted data. Recently, CMLCs have increasingly adopted infrastructure from Plaintext Machine Learning Compilers (PMLCs). While integrating Plaintext-Domain Optimization Passes (PDOPs) into CMLCs offers potential performance, usability, and extensibility benefits, our study shows it can also lead to severe performance regressions — a risk that has been largely overlooked. To address this, we introduce Hopta, a hybrid domain optimization defects tester and analyzer, aiming to find optimization bugs that can degrade the performance of compiled circuits from CMLCs. We carefully design two core components: (1) an optimization pipeline mutation mechanism to detect optimization anomalies by selectively enabling/disabling PDOPs, and (2) a profile-guided code reduction tool that efficiently simplifies defect-triggering programs to isolate optimization anomalies and facilitate debugging. Applying Hopta to SecretFlow-SPU, a production-grade CMLC, we identified 11 optimization defects (spanning matrix indexing,arithmetic/boolean conversion, and cost model deviation) that led to substantial performance regressions, with compiled circuits incurring up to 310.2\% increased cost. Our comprehensive analysis provides empirical insights into fundamental differences between plaintext and ciphertext domain optimization strategies, offering crucial guidance for future CMLC development. We conclude with a brief discussion of extensions to other hybrid ML compilers, underscoring the methodology’s compiler-agnostic nature. This work establishes a new research direction for enhancing CMLC performance and the practical deployment of privacy-preserving ML systems.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 随着对数据安全和隐私的日益关注，隐私保护机器学习（PPML）得到了广泛采用。基于密码学的PPML允许直接在加密数据上进行计算，显著降低了数据泄漏风险。为促进其应用，密文机器学习编译器（CMLC）将高层机器学习过程自动转换为用于加密数据的低层电路。近来，CMLC越来越多地采用明文机器学习编译器（PMLC）的基础设施。虽然将明文域优化遍（PDOP）集成到CMLC中可带来性能、可用性和可扩展性方面的潜在收益，但我们的研究表明，这也可能导致严重的性能回退——这一风险在很大程度上被忽视了。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了Hopta，一种混合域优化缺陷测试与分析器，旨在发现可能降低CMLC编译电路性能的优化缺陷。我们精心设计了两个核心组件：(1) 优化流水线变异机制，通过选择性地启用/禁用PDOP来检测优化异常；(2) 一种profile引导的代码缩减工具，可高效简化触发缺陷的程序，以隔离优化异常并便于调试。将Hopta应用于生产级CMLC SecretFlow-SPU，我们发现了11个优化缺陷（涉及矩阵索引、算术/布尔转换和成本模型偏差），这些缺陷导致了严重的性能回退，编译后的电路成本增加高达310.2%。我们的全面分析提供了关于明文与密文域优化策略根本差异的实证见解，为未来CMLC开发提供了关键指导。我们最后简要讨论了扩展到其他混合机器学习编译器的方法，强调了该方法的编译器无关性。这项工作为提升CMLC性能和隐私保护机器学习系统的实际部署开辟了新的研究方向。

upstream_only.title: Test Case Selection for Deep Neural Networks: A Replication Study on LLMs for Code (Replicability Study)
upstream_only.abstract: Test case selection (TCS) techniques have been explored to support the operational evaluation of deep neural networks (DNNs) under limited testing budgets, where labeling cost is a primary concern and early model failure detection is a key objective. Although prior studies report promising results, existing empirical evaluations focus almost exclusively on vision-based DNNs and datasets. As observed in recent surveys, models and datasets specifically designed for software engineering tasks have not been considered, leaving it unclear whether prior findings generalize to LLM code models. This paper presents a large-scale replication study of TCS techniques in the context of LLM code models. We re-examine established TCS strategies originally proposed for DNNs and complement them with statistical sampling strategies that have not previously been evaluated for TCS. We assess their effectiveness on three code-related classification tasks: clone detection, vulnerability detection, and technical debt prediction. The study spans 17 task-specific fine-tuned model instances, 7 predictive features, and 13 selection strategies, including 12 feature-aware strategies and simple random sampling (SRS) as a feature-agnostic baseline. We evaluate performance along two dimensions: operational accuracy estimation and early failure discovery. The results indicate that only a subset of findings reported for vision-based DNNs generalize when TCS is applied to LLMs for code. In particular, uncertainty-based features are effective for early failure discovery, while representation-based features are more robust for accuracy estimation. At the same time, performance varies substantially across tasks and models, indicating that the effectiveness of TCS techniques is context-dependent. Overall, this study provides empirical evidence on the replicability of TCS techniques beyond vision-based deep learning and offers insights into their use for the operational evaluation of LLMs for code.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 测试用例选择（TCS）技术已被探索用于在有限测试预算下支持深度神经网络（DNN）的运行评估，其中标注成本是主要关注点，而早期模型故障检测是关键目标。尽管先前研究报告了有希望的结果，但现有的实证评估几乎完全集中于基于视觉的DNN和数据集。正如近期综述所观察到的，专门为软件工程任务设计的模型和数据集尚未被考虑，这使得先前的发现能否推广到LLM代码模型仍不清楚。本文提出了在LLM代码模型背景下对TCS技术的大规模复制研究。我们重新检验了最初为DNN提出的成熟TCS策略，并补充了此前未在TCS中评估过的统计采样策略。我们在三个与代码相关的分类任务上评估其有效性：克隆检测、漏洞检测和技术债务预测。该研究涵盖17个任务特定微调模型实例、7个预测特征和13种选择策略，包括12种特征感知策略和作为特征无关基线的简单随机采样（SRS）。我们从两个维度评估性能：运行准确率估计和早期故障发现。结果表明，当TCS应用于代码LLM时，只有一部分针对基于视觉的DNN报告的发现能够推广。特别是，基于不确定性的特征对于早期故障发现有效，而基于表示的特征在准确率估计方面更稳健。同时，不同任务和模型之间的性能差异很大，表明TCS技术的有效性依赖于上下文。总体而言，本研究提供了关于TCS技术在基于视觉的深度学习之外的可复制性的实证证据，并为其在代码LLM运行评估中的使用提供了见解。

upstream_only.title: CAST: A Compiler-Based Framework for Systematically Testing LLM Compositional Safety
upstream_only.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in software pipelines, raising concerns about harmful behaviors in security-critical domains. Existing safety evaluations predominantly probe models with single prompts or short interactions, and therefore do not capture how safety behaves under multi-step workflows where individual requests are composed into complex behavior. This paper introduces compositional safety, the property that an LLM remains safe not only against isolated malicious prompts, but also under structured, long-horizon decompositions of harmful intents. We propose CAST, a systematic testing framework designed to evaluate the compositional safety of LLMs in the domain of malicious code. Drawing inspiration from modern compiler infrastructures, CAST decouples test case generation from test execution using a novel intermediate representation, CAIR. This architecture allows the framework to automatically refine high-level testing intents into granular sub-tasks that serve as unit tests for the model’s alignment. These components are subsequently instantiated by the SUT and reassembled according to the CAIR control structure. The resulting artifact is then evaluated by intent-fulfillment scoring and, for the severity subset, external behavioral detectors and manual inspection. We evaluate CAST on four state-of-the-art LLMs across three security-critical testbeds. Our results demonstrate that CAST systematically exposes severe safety violations in strongly aligned models that resist conventional red-teaming, achieving up to a 365\% increase in successful test cases compared to baseline testing strategies
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于软件流水线中，引发了对其在安全关键领域中有害行为的担忧。现有的安全评估主要用单一提示或简短交互探测模型，因此无法捕捉当单个请求被组合成复杂行为时，安全在多步工作流中的表现。本文引入了组合安全性（compositional safety），即LLM不仅对孤立的恶意提示保持安全，而且在有害意图的结构化、长时程分解下也保持安全。我们提出了CAST，一个系统化测试框架，用于评估LLM在恶意代码领域的组合安全性。受现代编译器基础设施的启发，CAST使用一种新颖的中间表示CAIR将测试用例生成与测试执行解耦。这种架构使框架能够自动将高层测试意图细化为细粒度子任务，作为模型对齐的单元测试。这些组件随后由SUT实例化，并根据CAIR控制结构重新组装。产生的工件随后通过意图实现评分进行评估，对于严重性子集，还使用外部行为检测器和人工检查。我们在三个安全关键测试平台上对四个最先进的LLM评估了CAST。我们的结果表明，CAST系统性地暴露了能够抵抗传统红队测试的强对齐模型中的严重安全违规，与基线测试策略相比，成功测试用例增加了高达365%。

upstream_only.title: CAM: A Causality-Based Analysis Framework for Multi-agent Code Generation Systems
upstream_only.abstract: Despite the remarkable success that Multi-Agent Code Generation Systems (MACGS) have achieved, the inherent complexity of multi-agent architectures produces substantial volumes of intermediate outputs. To date, the individual importance of these intermediate outputs to the system correctness remains opaque, which impedes targeted optimization of MACGS designs. To address this challenge, we propose CAM, the first Causality-based Analysis framework for MACGS that systematically quantifies the contribution of different intermediate features to system correctness. By comprehensively categorizing intermediate outputs and systematically simulating realistic errors on intermediate features, we identify the important features for system correctness and aggregate their importance rankings, facilitating comprehensive analysis of MACGS. We instantiate CAM on representative MACGS across multiple backend LLMs and datasets and conduct extensive empirical analysis on the identified importance rankings. Our analysis reveals intriguing findings: first, we uncover context-dependent features—features whose importance emerges mainly through interactions with other features, revealing that quality assurance for MACGS should move beyond module-level validation to incorporate cross-feature consistency checks; second, we reveal that hybrid backend MACGS with different backend LLMs assigned according to their relative strength achieves up to 7.3\% Pass@1 improvement, underscoring hybrid architectures as a promising direction for future MACGS design. We further demonstrate CAM’s practical utility through two applications: (1) failure repair, which achieves a 73.6\% success rate by optimizing top-3 importance-ranked features and (2) feature pruning, that reduces up to 33.6\% intermediate token consumption with negligible or sometimes positive performance impact by pruning low-importance features. Our work provides actionable insights for MACGS design and deployment, establishing causality analysis as a powerful approach for understanding and improving MACGS.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 尽管多智能体代码生成系统（MACGS）取得了显著成功，但多智能体架构固有的复杂性会产生大量中间输出。迄今为止，这些中间输出对系统正确性的各自重要性仍然不透明，这阻碍了对MACGS设计的针对性优化。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了CAM，这是首个针对MACGS的基于因果性的分析框架，能够系统地量化不同中间特征对系统正确性的贡献。通过全面分类中间输出并系统地在中间特征上模拟真实错误，我们识别出对系统正确性重要的特征，并聚合其重要性排名，从而促进对MACGS的全面分析。我们在多个后端LLM和数据集上，将CAM实例化于具有代表性的MACGS，并对识别出的重要性排名进行了广泛的实证分析。我们的分析揭示了有趣的发现：首先，我们发现了上下文依赖特征——这些特征的重要性主要通过与其他特征的交互而显现，表明MACGS的质量保证应超越模块级验证，纳入跨特征一致性检查；其次，我们揭示出混合后端MACGS（根据不同后端LLM的相对优势进行分配）可实现高达7.3%的Pass@1提升，凸显混合架构是未来MACGS设计的有前景方向。我们通过两个应用进一步展示了CAM的实用价值：(1) 故障修复，通过优化排名前3的重要特征，成功率可达73.6%；(2) 特征剪枝，通过剪枝低重要性特征，最多可减少33.6%的中间令牌消耗，且性能影响可忽略甚至有时为正。我们的工作为MACGS的设计和部署提供了可操作的见解，将因果性分析确立为理解和改进MACGS的强大方法。

upstream_only.title: KaPilot: LLM-Assisted Generation of Kani Specifications for Unsafe Rust Verification
upstream_only.abstract: Rust’s ownership and type system provide strong memory safety guarantees, but unsafe code still presents memory safety risks. Formal verification is crucial for ensuring memory safety, but writing precise specifications for unsafe Rust is challenging and largely manual. Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in generating formal specifications but are often code-centric, prone to inheriting implementation flaws, and lack systematic quality assessment. In this paper, we present KaPilot, a multi-agent framework for automatically generating specifications to verify unsafe Rust memory safety using Kani. The process begins with lightweight program analysis and proof harness generation. The SafetyReq agent extracts a concise, refined list of safety requirements from the target Rust function’s documentation, which guides the SpecGen agent in producing initial specifications that specify memory safety concerns. Then, the specifications are iteratively refined through a generate–precheck–verify loop involving SpecGenerate, SpecPrecheck, and SpecVerify agents, which assess quality and feed errors back. By executing this loop multiple times, KaPilot generates a set of candidate specifications. Finally, the shuffle-and-implication strategy is applied to systematically determine the best specification from these candidates. We evaluated KaPilot on 54 unsafe Rust functions with ground truth and 44 without. KaPilot achieved 88.9\% and 69.2\% specification generation success, respectively, with 57.4\% of generated specifications equivalent to or stronger than the ground truth. Compared with AutoSpec, KaPilot produces 14.8\% more verifiable specifications and 25.9\% more equivalent-or-better specifications.
