upstream_only.abstract_zh: Rust的所有权和类型系统提供了强大的内存安全保障，但不安全代码仍然存在内存安全风险。形式化验证对于确保内存安全至关重要，但为不安全Rust编写精确的规范具有挑战性且主要依靠人工。大型语言模型（LLM）在生成形式化规范方面已展现出潜力，但往往以代码为中心，容易继承实现缺陷，并缺乏系统性的质量评估。在本文中，我们提出了KaPilot，一个用于自动生成规范以使用Kani验证不安全Rust内存安全的多智能体框架。该过程从轻量级程序分析和证明框架生成开始。SafetyReq智能体从目标Rust函数的文档中提取简洁、精炼的安全需求列表，指导SpecGen智能体生成针对内存安全问题的初始规范。然后，这些规范通过由SpecGenerate、SpecPrecheck和SpecVerify智能体参与的生成—预检查—验证循环进行迭代细化，这些智能体评估质量并反馈错误。通过多次执行该循环，KaPilot生成一组候选规范。最后，应用混洗与蕴含策略从这些候选中系统地确定最佳规范。我们在54个有真实标注的不安全Rust函数和44个没有真实标注的函数上评估了KaPilot。KaPilot分别实现了88.9%和69.2%的规范生成成功率，其中57.4%的生成规范等同于或强于真实标注。与AutoSpec相比，KaPilot生成的可验证规范多14.8%，等同于或更优的规范多25.9%。

upstream_only.title: RippleGUItester: Change-Aware Exploratory Testing
upstream_only.abstract: Software systems evolve continuously through frequent code changes, yet such changes often introduce unintended bugs despite extensive testing and code review. Existing testing approaches are largely constrained to predefined execution paths or rely on unguided exploration, leaving many change-induced issues undetected. To address this challenge, we present RippleGUItester, a change-driven testing system that treats a code change as the epicenter of a ripple effect and explores its broader, user-visible impacts via the GUI. Given a code change, RippleGUItester performs LLM-based change-impact analysis to generate and enrich realistic test scenarios, executes these scenarios on both pre-change and post-change versions of the system, and applies differential analysis to identify behavioral differences. Crucially, RippleGUItester employs multimodal bug detection, comparing visual GUI changes and interpreting them in the context of natural-language change intents to distinguish unintended bugs from intended behavioral updates. We evaluate our approach on hundreds of real-world code changes across four widely used software systems: Firefox, Zettlr, JabRef, and Godot. Our results show that the proposed approach uncovers bugs introduced by code changes that were missed by existing test suites, CI pipelines, and code review. In total, we identify and report 26 previously unknown bugs that still exist in the latest versions of the evaluated systems. 18 bugs have been fixed, 3 have been confirmed, and 5 were marked as intended. We envision RippleGUItester being applied before or shortly after a code change is merged, enabling earlier detection of regressions.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 软件系统通过频繁的代码更改不断演进，然而尽管进行了大量测试和代码审查，这些更改往往仍会引入意外错误。现有的测试方法在很大程度上局限于预定义的执行路径或依赖无引导的探索，导致许多变更引发的问题未被发现。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了RippleGUItester，一种变更驱动的测试系统，它将代码更改视为涟漪效应的中心，并通过GUI探索其更广泛的、用户可见的影响。给定一个代码更改，RippleGUItester执行基于LLM的变更影响分析，以生成和丰富真实的测试场景，在系统的变更前和变更后版本上执行这些场景，并应用差分分析来识别行为差异。关键的是，RippleGUItester采用多模态缺陷检测，比较视觉GUI变化，并在自然语言变更意图的背景下解释这些变化，以区分意外错误和预期的行为更新。我们在四个广泛使用的软件系统（Firefox、Zettlr、JabRef和Godot）的数百个真实代码更改上评估了我们的方法。我们的结果表明，所提出的方法发现了现有测试套件、CI流水线和代码审查所遗漏的由代码更改引入的错误。我们总共识别并报告了26个先前未知的错误，这些错误仍然存在于被评估系统的最新版本中。其中18个错误已被修复，3个已被确认，5个被标记为预期行为。我们设想RippleGUItester可以在代码更改合并之前或之后不久应用，从而实现更早的回归检测。

upstream_only.title: Gleaner: A Semantically-Rich and Efficient Online Sampler for Microservice Diagnostics
upstream_only.abstract: Distributed tracing in microservices is critical for diagnostics but generates overwhelming data volumes, necessitating intelligent sampling. To maximize fidelity, state-of-the-art (SOTA) tail-based samplers analyze complete (or even log-enriched) traces by modeling them as graphs. However, this reliance on computationally expensive graph analysis creates a performance bottleneck that prohibits their use in online settings. To this end, we propose Gleaner, an online tail-sampling framework that breaks this trade-off. It is founded on the key insight that explicit graph structures are unnecessary for high-fidelity trace grouping. Instead, Gleaner represents each trace as a “bag-of-edges” augmented with log semantics, replacing slow graph algorithms with highly efficient set-based operations. It also employs an alarm-driven quota and a diversity-preserving strategy to prioritize anomalous and rare traces for downstream Root Cause Analysis (RCA). Experimentally, Gleaner processes traces at 0.74ms each, improving Trace Pattern Coverage by up to 128.7\% and Shannon Entropy by up to 32.9\% over baselines. At just a 1\% sampling rate, Gleaner improves RCA accuracy by 42\%-107\% over the next-best sampler. Moreover, RCA on Gleaner’s sampled data is more accurate than with the entire, unsampled dataset. This result reframes intelligent sampling from a data reduction technique to a powerful signal enhancement paradigm for automated operations.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 微服务中的分布式追踪对诊断至关重要，但会产生海量数据，因此需要智能采样。为了最大化保真度，最先进的（SOTA）尾部采样器通过将完整（甚至日志增强）的追踪建模为图来进行分析。然而，这种对计算昂贵图分析的依赖造成了性能瓶颈，阻碍了它们在在线场景中的使用。为此，我们提出Gleaner，一个打破这一权衡的在线尾部采样框架。它基于一个关键洞见：高保真追踪分组并不需要显式的图结构。相反，Gleaner将每条追踪表示为一个“边袋”（bag-of-edges），并增强日志语义，用高效的基于集合的运算替代缓慢的图算法。它还采用告警驱动的配额和保持多样性的策略，为下游根因分析（RCA）优先选择异常和稀有追踪。实验表明，Gleaner处理每条追踪耗时0.74毫秒，相比基线将追踪模式覆盖率提升最多128.7%，香农熵提升最多32.9%。仅以1%的采样率，Gleaner就将RCA准确率比次优采样器提升42%-107%。此外，基于Gleaner采样数据的RCA比使用整个未采样数据集更准确。这一结果将智能采样从一种数据缩减技术重新定义为一种用于自动化运维的强大信号增强范式。

upstream_only.title: Context Matters: Improving the Practical Reliability of LLM-Based Unit Test Generation (Experience Paper)
upstream_only.abstract: Automated unit test generation has recently benefited from advances in large language models (LLMs), yet our industrial deployments reveal a persistent gap between promising research results and practical usability. In real-world projects with complex frameworks and cross-file dependencies, LLM-generated tests frequently fail to compile, require costly manual repair, or provide unstable coverage improvements. This paper reports our experience in designing, deploying, and evaluating CATGen, a context-aware workflow for LLM-based unit test generation, informed by repeated industrial failures and refinements. Rather than relying on LLMs to infer incomplete project context, we found that compilation robustness critically depends on making project-level dependencies explicit, stabilizing test class scaffolding, and replacing iterative LLM-based repair with lightweight static analysis. These experience-driven insights shaped CATGen’s multi-stage design, which combines structured context retrieval, deterministic test skeleton construction, and program analysis–based post-processing. We evaluate CATGen on real-world complex focal methods from proprietary industrial projects and additionally on the Defects4J benchmark to assess generalizability. Across both settings, CATGen substantially improves compilation success and structural coverage while significantly reducing generation time and token consumption compared to existing LLM-based approaches. Our results demonstrate that reliable LLM-based unit test generation in practice depends less on prompt engineering alone and more on systematic engineering support grounded in real-world development constraints.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 自动化单元测试生成最近受益于大型语言模型（LLM）的进展，但我们的工业部署揭示出有前景的研究结果与实际可用性之间存在持续差距。在具有复杂框架和跨文件依赖的真实项目中，LLM生成的测试经常无法编译，需要昂贵的人工修复，或提供不稳定的覆盖率提升。本文报告了我们设计、部署和评估CATGen的经验，这是一个面向LLM单元测试生成的上下文感知工作流，其灵感来自反复的工业失败和改进。我们不是依赖LLM来推断不完整的项目上下文，而是发现编译稳健性关键取决于使项目级依赖显式化、稳定测试类脚手架，并用轻量级静态分析替代基于LLM的迭代修复。这些经验驱动的见解塑造了CATGen的多阶段设计，它结合了结构化上下文检索、确定性测试骨架构建和基于程序分析的后处理。我们在来自专有工业项目的真实复杂焦点方法上评估CATGen，并额外在Defects4J基准上评估其泛化性。在两种设置中，与现有基于LLM的方法相比，CATGen显著提高了编译成功率和结构覆盖率，同时显著减少了生成时间和令牌消耗。我们的结果表明，实践中可靠的基于LLM的单元测试生成较少取决于单纯的提示工程，而更多取决于基于真实开发约束的系统化工程支持。

upstream_only.title: Inferring 1-Minimal Trigger Configurations for Assessing Linux Kernel CVE Triggerability
upstream_only.abstract: Vendors assessing Linux kernel CVEs need to know whether a bug is triggerable under production-tailored configurations, not merely whether a version is affected, yet upstream reproducers and vulnerability databases rarely provide configuration-level context. We study minimal trigger-configuration inference: given a CVE entry and a target kernel version (optionally a baseline .config), we synthesize a Kconfig-satisfiable option set that remains effective after make olddefconfig and, when a reproducer is available, still triggers under a specified evaluation protocol; we then prune it to a 1-minimal (subset-minimal) boundary for evaluation. Our framework FCC links vulnerability cues to build-system symbols, completes implicit prerequisites under olddefconfig feedback to avoid silent rollback, and performs runtime-validated minimization guided by dependency topology. We evaluate on KernJC and KernelCTF, totaling 88 CVEs across multiple kernel versions. On the 88-CVE set, FCC improves the post-make olddefconfig configuration success rate from 62.5\% (55/88) to 96.6\% (85/88) over an olddef-only injection baseline; on the KernJC set, FCC reduces the average candidate set size by 78.7\% compared to KernJC (Avg. 14.72 vs. 69.00 options per CVE). A stage-wise analysis of time and token costs shows that Stage I dominates overhead, while CVE-focused evidence selection substantially reduces this cost. By returning an effective and auditable 1-minimal configuration boundary, FCC helps vendors scope triggerability against their deployment configurations with a clear, tool-supported decision line.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 评估Linux内核CVE的供应商需要知道某个缺陷在生产定制配置下是否可触发，而不仅仅是某个版本是否受影响，但上游复现程序和漏洞数据库很少提供配置级别的上下文。我们研究最小触发配置推断：给定一个CVE条目和目标内核版本（可选基线.config），我们合成一个满足Kconfig的选项集，该选项集在make olddefconfig之后仍然有效，并且当有复现程序可用时，在指定的评估协议下仍能触发；然后我们将其修剪为1-最小（子集最小）边界以进行评估。我们的框架FCC将漏洞线索链接到构建系统符号，在olddefconfig反馈下补全隐式先决条件以避免静默回滚，并在依赖拓扑指导下执行运行时验证的最小化。我们在KernJC和KernelCTF上进行评估，总共涵盖多个内核版本的88个CVE。在88个CVE集合上，与仅使用olddef注入的基线相比，FCC将make olddefconfig后的配置成功率从62.5%（55/88）提高到96.6%（85/88）；在KernJC集合上，与KernJC相比，FCC将平均候选集大小减少了78.7%（平均每个CVE 14.72 vs. 69.00个选项）。对时间和token成本的分阶段分析表明，阶段I主导了开销，而针对CVE的证据选择显著降低了这一成本。通过返回有效且可审计的1-最小配置边界，FCC帮助供应商对照其部署配置确定可触发性范围，并提供清晰、工具支持的决策线。

upstream_only.title: The Discreet Charm of the Bugeoisie: A First Look at Bug Reports Created by Researchers
upstream_only.abstract: Many ISSTA papers present automated tools to find software bugs. Some researchers create bug reports for the bugs they deem worth reporting, e.g., new bugs found by the tools. We study bug reports created by researchers and coin the term Bugeoisie to refer to such bug reports. We collect the Bugeoisie for ISSTA 2025 by reading the papers, examining the artifacts, and contacting the authors, trying to “chase” bug report links. This process turns out to be surprisingly challenging because only a few authors make such links readily available. We then analyze the Bugeoisie to understand potential bad practices. For most papers that claim some bugs reported or confirmed, independently checking the claims is again surprisingly challenging. We also start analyzing Bugeoisie for FSE 2025 to check generalizability of our findings. Our findings point out to the important changes that conference organizers and reviewers may want to require for the Bugeoisie. We also provide some suggestions for paper authors to prepare and describe their Bugeoisie in their papers and artifacts.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 许多ISSTA论文展示了用于发现软件缺陷的自动化工具。一些研究者为他们认为值得报告的缺陷（例如工具发现的新缺陷）创建缺陷报告。我们研究研究者创建的缺陷报告，并创造术语Bugeoisie来指代此类缺陷报告。我们通过阅读论文、检查工件并联系作者，尝试“追踪”缺陷报告链接，为ISSTA 2025收集Bugeoisie。这一过程令人惊讶地具有挑战性，因为只有少数作者使此类链接易于获取。然后我们分析Bugeoisie以理解潜在的不良实践。对于大多数声称报告或确认了某些缺陷的论文，独立核查这些声明同样令人惊讶地具有挑战性。我们还开始分析FSE 2025的Bugeoisie，以检查我们发现的普遍性。我们的发现指出了会议组织者和审稿人可能希望对Bugeoisie要求的重要改变。我们还为论文作者提供了一些建议，以便在其论文和工件中准备和描述其Bugeoisie。

upstream_only.title: BinRAG: An RAG-Based Decompilation Framework Fusing Name Prediction and Calling Context
upstream_only.abstract: Decompiling stripped binaries to assist human reverse engineers remains a critical yet highly challenging task in software security. Prior work has developed various neural networks and even dedicated large language models (LLMs) to improve function and variable name recovery in decompiled code. Nonetheless, these approaches alone fall short of enabling a generic LLM-based decompilation pipeline that can reliably enhance the readability and semantic clarity of decompiled outputs. In this paper, we propose BinRAG, a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) based decompilation framework designed to enhance the decompilation of stripped binaries. Building upon name prediction models, BinRAG features three novel designs: (1) it first utilizes name prediction models to transform raw decompiled outputs into enriched, source-like queries for RAG retrieval; (2) it further enhances these queries using a fine-tuned specialized LLM conditioned on the predicted variable names, enabling more accurate retrieval from a curated example database; (3) it then integrates these retrieved examples with the target’s calling context, employing a general-purpose LLM to synthesize high-fidelity, human-readable decompiled code. Evaluation on 3,200 functions from real-world software repositories demonstrates that BinRAG improves readability by 8.4\% over standard RAG and semantic precision by 31.2\% over the next-best prior baseline. Our results show that BinRAG effectively scales to large codebases and significantly reduces manual effort in reverse engineering tasks.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 反编译去符号二进制文件以辅助人工逆向工程师，仍然是软件安全中一项关键但极具挑战性的任务。先前工作已开发出各种神经网络甚至专用大语言模型（LLM），以改进反编译代码中的函数和变量名恢复。然而，仅靠这些方法不足以构建一个通用的基于LLM的反编译流水线，可靠地提升反编译输出的可读性和语义清晰度。本文提出BinRAG，一个基于检索增强生成（RAG）的反编译框架，旨在增强去符号二进制文件的反编译。在名称预测模型的基础上，BinRAG具有三项新颖设计：（1）首先利用名称预测模型将原始反编译输出转换为丰富的、类源代码查询，用于RAG检索；（2）进一步使用一个经过微调的专用LLM，以预测的变量名为条件增强这些查询，从而从精选示例数据库中实现更准确的检索；（3）然后将检索到的示例与目标的调用上下文相结合，采用通用LLM合成高保真、人类可读的反编译代码。在来自真实世界软件仓库的3,200个函数上的评估表明，BinRAG相比标准RAG将可读性提高了8.4%，相比次优先前基线将语义精确度提高了31.2%。我们的结果表明，BinRAG能有效扩展到大型代码库，并显著减少逆向工程任务中的人工工作量。

upstream_only.title: Exploiting Ethereum Rollback Semantics: Profit-Driven Attack Synthesis and Off-Chain Misinterpretation Testing
upstream_only.abstract: The Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) enforces atomic execution through rollback, reverting all state changes when execution fails. While necessary for correctness, rollback semantics introduce a distinct attack surface affecting both on-chain execution and off-chain infrastructures. On-chain, attackers can use conditional failure to filter executions, committing only profitable outcomes while rolling back unprofitable attempts. Off-chain, systems such as explorers, token trackers, and RPC providers may misinterpret aborted executions as successful, leading to inconsistent records or unintended transfers. Existing tools largely treat rollback as an execution endpoint, providing limited support for profit-driven attack synthesis or off-chain misinterpretation testing. To address this gap, we formalize two rollback attack models and develop RollGain, a unified framework for rollback-aware analysis. For on-chain attacks, RollGain models contract structure and value flows, validates candidate executions symbolically, and replays on a forked chain to rank profitability. For off-chain testing, RollGain conducts call tree analysis on 3.08 billion Ethereum transactions to characterize rollback patterns and exercises rollback-inducing execution vectors against external services. On our evaluation datasets, RollGain achieves 95.3\% recall with zero false positives, and uncovers 20 rollback misinterpretation vulnerabilities across 18 off-chain systems, of which 18 have been confirmed, 16 fixed, and 5 assigned CVE identifiers.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 以太坊虚拟机（EVM）通过回滚强制执行原子性执行，当执行失败时回滚所有状态更改。虽然这对于正确性是必要的，但回滚语义引入了一个独特的攻击面，影响链上执行和链下基础设施。在链上，攻击者可以利用条件失败来过滤执行，仅提交有利可图的结果，同时回滚无利可图的尝试。在链下，区块浏览器、代币追踪器和RPC提供商等系统可能将中止的执行误解为成功，导致记录不一致或意外转账。现有工具大多将回滚视为执行终点，对利润驱动的攻击合成或链下误解测试的支持有限。为弥补这一空白，我们形式化了两种回滚攻击模型，并开发了RollGain，一个用于回滚感知分析的统一框架。对于链上攻击，RollGain对合约结构和价值流进行建模，以符号方式验证候选执行，并在分叉链上重放以对盈利能力进行排名。对于链下测试，RollGain对30.8亿笔以太坊交易进行调用树分析，以刻画回滚模式，并针对外部服务测试诱发回滚的执行向量。在我们的评估数据集上，RollGain实现了95.3%的召回率且零误报，并在18个链下系统中发现了20个回滚误解漏洞，其中18个已确认，16个已修复，5个被分配了CVE标识符。

upstream_only.title: Enhancing LLM-Based Bug Reproduction via Code Entity Retrieval and Test Case Repair
upstream_only.abstract: Automated bug reproduction from bug reports is a critical yet challenging step in software debugging. While LLM-based bug reproduction shows promise, its effectiveness is often hampered by insufficient contextual awareness of the relevant codebase and a tendency to produce invalid test cases. To address these limitations, we propose a novel approach, called LTER, that enhances LLM-based bug reproduction through fine-grained code entity retrieval and a feedback-driven dynamic repair loop. LTER first identifies specific code entities within bug reports to automatically extract precise contexts, including class definitions, constructors, and method logic. The extracted contexts are then used to guide the LLM in generating reproduced test cases. To further ensure executability, LTER employs an iterative repair mechanism to resolve complex dependencies. Specifically, upon injecting a generated test case into the project, if a compilation failure occurs, the framework forwards the error messages to the LLM for an initial repair. Should this initial repair fail, it empowers the LLM to analyze diagnostic messages to recognize missing context and retrieve indispensable dependencies, subsequently regenerating the test case with the supplemented data. Finally, LTER employs a hybrid cascade ranking strategy to accurately select the most effective reproduction test case from the generated candidates. The experimental results on the widely-used Defects4J benchmark show that LTER substantially outperforms the best performance in automated bug reproduction, increasing the reproduction success rate to 46.2\% with successfully identifying a valid reproduction test as the top candidate in 38.1\% of the cases. Furthermore, LTER demonstrates strong generalization capability, delivering robust performance on the GHRB dataset containing recent bugs previously unseen by the LLM.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 从缺陷报告中自动复现缺陷是软件调试中关键但具有挑战性的步骤。虽然基于LLM的缺陷复现展现出前景，但其有效性常常受到对相关代码库上下文感知不足以及倾向于生成无效测试用例的阻碍。为解决这些局限，我们提出一种新方法LTER，它通过细粒度代码实体检索和反馈驱动的动态修复循环来增强基于LLM的缺陷复现。LTER首先识别缺陷报告中的特定代码实体，自动提取精确的上下文，包括类定义、构造器和方法逻辑。提取的上下文随后用于指导LLM生成复现测试用例。为进一步确保可执行性，LTER采用迭代修复机制来解决复杂依赖。具体而言，将生成的测试用例注入项目后，如果发生编译失败，框架会将错误消息转发给LLM进行初步修复。若初步修复失败，它使LLM能够分析诊断消息以识别缺失的上下文并检索不可或缺的依赖，随后用补充数据重新生成测试用例。最后，LTER采用混合级联排序策略，从生成的候选中准确选择最有效的复现测试用例。在广泛使用的Defects4J基准上的实验结果表明，LTER在自动缺陷复现方面显著优于最佳性能，将复现成功率提高到46.2%，并在38.1%的案例中成功将有效的复现测试识别为首选候选。此外，LTER展现出强大的泛化能力，在包含LLM此前未见过的近期缺陷的GHRB数据集上提供了稳健的性能。

upstream_only.title: DocPrism: Multi-lingual Detection of Incorrectness Inconsistencies between Code and Documentation
upstream_only.abstract: Code-documentation inconsistencies are common and undesirable: they can lead to developer misunderstandings and software defects. This paper introduces DocPrism, a lightweight multi-language, code-documentation inconsistency detection tool. DocPrism uses a standard large language model (LLM) to analyze and explain inconsistencies, and focuses on outputting incorrectness inconsistencies. Plain use of LLMs for this task yields unacceptably high inconsistency flag rates—i.e., over 90\% of functions are flagged as inconsistent with their documentation. One substantial reason is that LLMs identify natural gaps between high-level documentation and code as incompleteness inconsistencies. We introduce and apply the Local Categorization, External Filtering (LCEF) methodology: LCEF uses an LLM’s local completion skills, rather than its long-term reasoning skills, to focus on reporting incorrectness inconsistencies. In our ablation study, LCEF reduces DocPrism’s inconsistency flag rate from 98\% to 14\%, and increases F1 score from 0.22 to 0.77, compared to standard prompting techniques. On a broad evaluation across Python, TypeScript, C++, and Java, DocPrism maintains a low flag rate of 17\%, and achieves a precision of 0.63 without performing any fine-tuning. We also establish a conservative lower bound across four programming languages, showing that inconsistency errors are present in 11\% of code-documentation pairs. In addition, DocPrism achieves precision comparable to the state-of-the-art on an established synthetic dataset, but substantially outperforms it on our real-world Java dataset in precision (DocPrism: 0.47–0.67 vs. SOTA: 0.05–0.14).
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 代码与文档不一致很常见且不受欢迎：它们可能导致开发者误解和软件缺陷。本文介绍DocPrism，一种轻量级多语言代码-文档不一致检测工具。DocPrism使用标准大型语言模型（LLM）来分析和解释不一致，并专注于输出不正确性不一致。直接使用LLM完成此任务会产生不可接受的高不一致标记率——即超过90%的函数被标记为与其文档不一致。一个主要原因是LLM将高级文档与代码之间的自然差距识别为不完整性不一致。我们引入并应用局部分类、外部过滤（LCEF）方法：LCEF利用LLM的局部补全能力，而非其长期推理能力，以专注于报告不正确性不一致。在我们的消融研究中，与标准提示技术相比，LCEF将DocPrism的不一致标记率从98%降低到14%，并将F1分数从0.22提高到0.77。在跨Python、TypeScript、C++和Java的广泛评估中，DocPrism保持了17%的低标记率，并在没有任何微调的情况下达到了0.63的精确率。我们还建立了跨四种编程语言的保守下界，表明不一致错误存在于11%的代码-文档对中。此外，DocPrism在已建立的合成数据集上达到了与最先进技术相当的精确率，但在我们的真实世界Java数据集上显著优于它（DocPrism: 0.47–0.67 vs. SOTA: 0.05–0.14）。

upstream_only.title: NCFuzz: Configuration-Guided Network Service Fuzzing
upstream_only.abstract: Network services like FTP and DNS are critical components of modern reliable Internet infrastructure. Software fuzzing, especially network protocol fuzzing, is widely used to uncover flaws in these systems. However, conventional fuzzers operate under a single, fixed configuration throughout the fuzzing campaign, leaving the service’s rich configuration space unexplored. Incorporating configurations as a dynamic input dimension is challenging due to complex semantics, trigger conditions, and the resulting enlarged search space. We tackle the problem of finding bugs under non-default configurations, termed ConfBug, by designing a new fuzzer called NCFuzz. The non-default configurations can be uncommon but administrators may enable them, which cannot be exercised by conventional fuzzers. With the assumption that software documentation that describes configuration options is available, NCFuzz leverages two key observations: 1) software documentation contains rich information about configurations; 2) interactions between configuration and network messages can be tracked through code instrumentation and data-flow analysis. Using these insights, NCFuzz uses configuration knowledge and the relationships between configurations and network messages to guide the fuzzer toward new software states. The quality and completeness of the documentation will affect the effectiveness of NCFuzz. Evaluation on six network service implementations shows NCFuzz achieves higher coverage than baseline fuzzers. Five ConfBugs were discovered during fuzzing.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 像FTP和DNS这样的网络服务是现代可靠互联网基础设施的关键组件。软件模糊测试，尤其是网络协议模糊测试，被广泛用于发现这些系统中的缺陷。然而，传统模糊测试器在整个模糊测试过程中在单一固定配置下运行，使服务丰富的配置空间未被探索。将配置作为动态输入维度极具挑战，因为存在复杂语义、触发条件以及由此扩大的搜索空间。我们通过设计一种新的模糊测试器NCFuzz，来解决在非默认配置下发现缺陷的问题，称为ConfBug。非默认配置可能不常见，但管理员可能启用它们，而传统模糊测试器无法覆盖这些配置。假设描述配置选项的软件文档可用，NCFuzz利用两个关键观察：1）软件文档包含丰富的配置信息；2）配置与网络消息之间的交互可以通过代码插桩和数据流分析进行跟踪。利用这些见解，NCFuzz使用配置知识以及配置与网络消息之间的关系来引导模糊测试器走向新的软件状态。文档的质量和完整性会影响NCFuzz的有效性。在六个网络服务实现上的评估表明，NCFuzz比基线模糊测试器实现了更高的覆盖率。在模糊测试过程中发现了五个ConfBug。

upstream_only.title: Re-evaluating Detection of Equivalent Mutants using LLMs: We Should Properly Measure How Far We Are
upstream_only.abstract: Mutation testing is a widely used approach for measuring test-suite quality. A critical problem in mutation testing is equivalent mutant detection (EMD), i.e., determining if a mutant semantically behaves the same as the original code despite some syntactic differences. A recent study has shown that LLM-based EMD techniques hold great promise, reporting substantial improvements over traditional compiler- and machine-learning–based approaches. In this work, we revisit those recent results and evaluate the generalization capabilities of the proposed LLM-based EMD techniques across two additional datasets that differ from the prior dataset in mutation operators, programming languages, or source projects. Contrary to prior findings, the proposed LLM-based EMD techniques suffer substantial performance degradation on the two additional datasets. Through an extensive analysis, we identify a key factor underlying the differences as original-method–level data leakage (i.e., the same original method appearing in both training and testing sets), indicating that prior results under within-method evaluation do not generalize to cross-method evaluation. We find that the studied LLMs tend to rely on a method-wise majority-voting shortcut rather than reasoning about the semantic effects of mutations. Based on these findings, we call for the adoption of realistic cross-method evaluation and the development of mutation-centric semantic reasoning in future LLM-based EMD research.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 变异测试是衡量测试套件质量的一种广泛使用的方法。变异测试中的一个关键问题是等价变异体检测（EMD），即确定某个变异体在语义上是否与原代码行为相同，尽管存在一些句法差异。最近的一项研究表明，基于LLM的EMD技术具有巨大前景，并报告了相对于传统基于编译器和机器学习的方法的显著改进。在本工作中，我们重新审视这些近期结果，并在两个额外数据集上评估所提出的基于LLM的EMD技术的泛化能力，这些数据集在变异算子、编程语言或源项目方面与先前数据集不同。与先前发现相反，所提出的基于LLM的EMD技术在这两个额外数据集上出现显著性能下降。通过广泛分析，我们确定了差异背后的一个关键因素：原始方法级数据泄漏（即同一原始方法同时出现在训练集和测试集中），这表明先前在方法内评估下的结果无法泛化到跨方法评估。我们发现，所研究的LLM倾向于依赖按方法多数投票的捷径，而非推理变异的语义效应。基于这些发现，我们呼吁在未来的基于LLM的EMD研究中采用现实的跨方法评估，并开发以变异为中心的语义推理。

upstream_only.title: CID: Clean-Seed-Free Backdoor Defense via Counterfactual Invariance for Neural Code Models
upstream_only.abstract: Neural code models automate core software engineering tasks such as code classification and generation, but remain vulnerable to backdoor attacks. Existing defenses struggle with both injection-based and Semantically-Equivalent Transformation (SET)-based triggers and often require a trusted, pre-verified in-distribution clean seed set, which can be costly to obtain in third-party fine-tuning. This paper introduces Counterfactual Invariance-based Defense (CID), a clean-seed-free defense requiring no a priori trusted in-distribution clean data and grounded in operational counterfactual invariance tests. CID exploits asymmetric counterfactual behavior: clean predictions tend to degrade under semantic context corruption, whereas backdoor predictions show larger representation drift when shortcut-carrying structures are neutralized. Accordingly, CID applies two orthogonal probes—a contextual intervention for semantic-sufficiency testing and a gradient-guided structural intervention for representation-drift testing—to extract a high-purity clean seed set directly from a mixed dataset. CID then uses these seeds to calibrate representation-space filtering over the full dataset. Across four software engineering tasks, six trigger instantiations, poisoning rates from 1\% to 10\%, multiple model architectures, and multilingual code summarization, CID achieves high poison-detection performance relative to evaluated baselines while keeping false positives low in most settings. Clean-only and selected retraining experiments further show conservative benign-data retention, preserved clean-task utility, and reduced residual attack success rate in challenging Defect Detection settings.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 神经代码模型可以自动化代码分类和生成等核心软件工程任务，但仍然容易受到后门攻击。现有防御难以应对基于注入和基于语义等价变换（SET）的触发器，并且通常需要一个可信、预先验证的同分布干净种子集，而在第三方微调场景中获取这样的种子集可能代价高昂。本文提出基于反事实不变性的防御（CID），这是一种无需干净种子的防御方法，不依赖先验可信的同分布干净数据，并以可操作的反事实不变性测试为基础。CID利用了不对称的反事实行为：干净预测在语义上下文破坏下往往会退化，而后门预测在携带捷径的结构被中和时则表现出更大的表示漂移。据此，CID应用两种正交探针——用于语义充分性测试的上下文干预和用于表示漂移测试的梯度引导结构干预——直接从混合数据集中提取高纯度干净种子集。然后，CID使用这些种子在整个数据集上校准表示空间过滤。在四个软件工程任务、六种触发器实例、1%到10%的投毒率、多种模型架构以及多语言代码摘要上，CID相对于所评估的基线取得了较高的投毒检测性能，同时在大多数设置下保持较低的假阳性。仅干净数据和选择性重训练实验进一步表明，在具有挑战性的缺陷检测设置中，CID能保守地保留良性数据、保持干净任务效用，并降低残余攻击成功率。

upstream_only.title: Provably Lossless Acceleration of DNN Mutation Testing via Memoization
upstream_only.abstract: Mutation analysis has recently reemerged in the context of deep neural networks (DNNs) as a promising, but notoriously costly, approach for assessing test dataset adequacy. Existing techniques speed up DNN mutation testing through lossy approximations that trade efficiency for mutation score accuracy. This paper introduces Mure, the first provably lossless framework for accelerating DNN mutation testing via memoization. Mure is based on the idea that DNN mutants and the original model share substantial redundant computation, so during mutation testing, it executes only the mutated suffixes of each mutant and reuses the common prefix from the original model, which is computed only once. We give a formal account of memoized mutation testing, and prove that Mure is sound, i.e., it produces results equivalent to exhaustive vanilla mutation testing, and identify basic conditions under which speed-up is guaranteed. We have implemented Mure and evaluated it on 15 DNN models of various architectures, complexities, and sizes ranging from a few thousands to millions of parameters. This provides empirical evidence that Mure reduces the computational cost of mutation testing by 44.54\%, on average. We also observed that while state-of-the-art techniques tend to yield higher acceleration (up to 88.97\%, on average), they come at the cost of some error in mutation score. We further analyze the effect of mutation generation selection ratio on the effectiveness of Mure and observed predictable reductions in memoization opportunities with increasing the percentage of mutated neurons. We observed that Mure offers more than 20\% speed-up even when as high as 5\% of the neurons are mutated.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 变异分析最近在深度神经网络（DNN）背景下重新兴起，作为一种有前景但以高成本著称的评估测试数据集充分性的方法。现有技术通过有损近似来加速DNN变异测试，以效率换取变异得分准确性。本文提出Mure，这是首个通过记忆化实现DNN变异测试可证明无损加速的框架。Mure基于以下思想：DNN变异体与原始模型共享大量冗余计算，因此在变异测试期间，它只执行每个变异体的变异后缀，并复用原始模型计算一次的共同前缀。我们给出了记忆化变异测试的形式化描述，并证明Mure是可靠的，即其产生的结果等价于穷举的普通变异测试，同时识别了保证加速的基本条件。我们实现了Mure，并在15个不同架构、复杂度和规模的DNN模型上进行了评估，参数从几千到数百万不等。这提供了经验证据，表明Mure将变异测试的计算成本平均降低44.54%。我们还观察到，虽然最先进的技术往往能带来更高的加速（平均高达88.97%），但它们以变异得分存在一定误差为代价。我们进一步分析了变异生成选择比例对Mure有效性的影响，并观察到随着变异神经元百分比的增加，记忆化机会出现可预测的减少。我们观察到，即使高达5%的神经元被变异，Mure也能提供超过20%的加速。

upstream_only.title: Profiling-Guided Bayesian Optimization of JVM Configurations
upstream_only.abstract: Regression testing is essential for maintaining software quality but often incurs substantial time costs. While regression testing time can often be reduced by selectively running fewer tests, prior work has demonstrated that tuning Java Virtual Machine (JVM) configuration flags can also reduce testing time in Java projects, even while running all tests and preserving original testing outcomes. However, finding effective flag combinations remains challenging due to the vast configuration space and complex interactions between flags. Random search and direct modeling approaches that map flag configurations to testing time have shown limited effectiveness in navigating this complex optimization landscape. We present PROBO (PROfiling-Guided Bayesian Optimization), an iterative approach that leverages JVM runtime metrics (e.g., garbage collection frequency, just-in-time (JIT) compilation rates, and memory allocation) to guide Bayesian optimization for testing time reduction. Unlike prior work using Bayesian inference that directly models the relationship from flag configurations to testing time, PROBO decomposes the prediction problem through observable runtime behaviors: a metrics model predicts how flag configurations affect runtime metrics, and a performance model predicts how those metrics affect testing time. PROBO collects 44 runtime metrics using a profiler during test execution, and propagates feature importance scores through both models to identify which flags most strongly influence testing time-predictive metrics. Finally, PROBO generates candidate flag configurations through three complementary strategies guided by expected testing time improvement. We evaluate PROBO on 16 open-source Java projects, comparing against random search and BOCA (a Bayesian optimization baseline). PROBO achieves an average testing time reduction of 10.7\% across all projects when evaluating 20 configurations per project, outperforming random search (5.8\%) by 1.85{\texttimes} and BOCA (4.3\%) by 2.49{\texttimes}. PROBO successfully generates configurations that substantially reduce testing time for all 16 projects, with reductions ranging up to 27.4\%. With a one-hour time budget for search, PROBO maintains its advantage with 8.0\% average reduction, demonstrating practical applicability. PROBO-generated configurations remain effective across software evolution, maintaining 8.8\% average reduction over an average of 88 future commits per project. Our analysis reveals that metrics related to JIT compilation, particularly Total Compilation Rate (methods compiled per second) and C1 Compilation Rate (first-tier JIT compilation rate), are the strongest predictors of testing time, accounting for 67.2\% of consistently important metrics across projects.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 回归测试对于维护软件质量至关重要，但通常会产生大量时间成本。虽然回归测试时间通常可以通过选择性地运行更少的测试来减少，但先前的工作表明，调整Java虚拟机（JVM）配置标志也可以减少Java项目中的测试时间，即使运行所有测试并保持原始测试结果。然而，由于庞大的配置空间和标志之间复杂的相互作用，找到有效的标志组合仍然具有挑战性。将标志配置映射到测试时间的随机搜索和直接建模方法在导航这一复杂优化景观方面效果有限。我们提出了PROBO（PROfiling-Guided Bayesian Optimization），一种迭代方法，利用JVM运行时指标（例如垃圾回收频率、即时（JIT）编译率和内存分配）来指导贝叶斯优化以减少测试时间。与使用贝叶斯推理直接建模从标志配置到测试时间关系的先前工作不同，PROBO通过可观察的运行时行为分解预测问题：一个指标模型预测标志配置如何影响运行时指标，一个性能模型预测这些指标如何影响测试时间。PROBO在测试执行期间使用分析器收集44个运行时指标，并通过两个模型传播特征重要性分数，以识别哪些标志对测试时间预测指标影响最大。最后，PROBO通过三种互补策略生成候选标志配置，这些策略由预期测试时间改进指导。我们在16个开源Java项目上评估PROBO，与随机搜索和BOCA（贝叶斯优化基线）进行比较。当每个项目评估20种配置时，PROBO在所有项目上平均减少测试时间10.7%，比随机搜索（5.8%）高出1.85倍，比BOCA（4.3%）高出2.49倍。PROBO成功为所有16个项目生成配置，大幅减少测试时间，减少幅度最高达27.4%。在搜索时间为1小时的预算下，PROBO保持优势，平均减少8.0%，展示了实际适用性。PROBO生成的配置在软件演化过程中仍然有效，在平均每个项目88个未来提交中保持8.8%的平均减少。我们的分析表明，与JIT编译相关的指标，特别是总编译率（每秒编译的方法数）和C1编译率（第一层JIT编译率），是测试时间的最强预测因子，在所有项目中占持续重要指标的67.2%。

upstream_only.title: Understanding and Improving Model Editing for Secure Code Generation
upstream_only.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used for code generation but may reproduce vulnerabilities learned from insecure training data. Prior work mainly relies on inference-time hardening, which introduces auxiliary components and runtime overhead. We present the first systematic study of model editing as a model-level hardening mechanism for secure code generation, directly injecting security knowledge through localized parameter updates. We evaluate three state-of-the-art editing methods across diverse LLM families against CoSec, a representative inference-time approach, examining security effectiveness and robustness, generalization to unseen vulnerabilities, and functional correctness. Model editing substantially outperforms CoSec on seen vulnerabilities, improving security ratios by 15
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）被广泛用于代码生成，但可能重现从非安全训练数据中学到的漏洞。先前的工作主要依赖推理时加固，这会引入辅助组件和运行时开销。我们首次对模型编辑作为安全代码生成的模型级加固机制进行了系统性研究，通过局部参数更新直接注入安全知识。我们针对代表性的推理时方法CoSec，跨多种LLM系列评估了三种最先进的编辑方法，考察安全有效性和鲁棒性、对未见漏洞的泛化能力以及功能正确性。在已见过的漏洞上，模型编辑显著优于CoSec，将安全比率提高了15

upstream_only.title: Multi-stage On-Demand Program Slicing for Modular Analysis of Multi-threaded Programs
upstream_only.abstract: Precise analysis of multi-threaded programs requires combining flow-sensitive pointer analysis (FSPTA) with interleaving and lock analysis (ILA) to reason about cross-thread value flows under feasible concurrent executions. ILA computes may-happen-in-parallel (MHP) relations and lock-release spans to determine when shared accesses can occur concurrently. Unfortunately, these analyses are both expensive and tightly coupled: FSPTA needs ILA to rule out infeasible inter-thread def-use relations, while ILA needs alias information to identify interference-relevant interactions. As a result, whole-program analyses often spend most of their time on code that is irrelevant to the client query. We present MSli, an on-demand slicing framework for modular analysis of multi-threaded programs. It extracts compact, query-relevant program slices while preserving the answers of downstream analyses. Unlike single-pass slicing over a unified dependence graph, MSliperforms multi-stage slicing with analysis-specific criteria. Concretely, a lightweight pre-analysis establishes an over-approximation of inter-thread value flows and performs ILA slicing source extraction to identify the MHP and lock-span queries required later for ILA slicing. The refined main-phase ILA results then enable reconstruction of a thread-aware value-flow graph to guide FSPTA slicing, supporting modular analysis and downstream clients. We implement MSliin SVF and evaluate it on ten large real-world projects with data race detection as a representative client. Compared with the unsliced baseline (FSAM), MSlireduces the analyzed ICFG to 5.4\% (ILA) and 25.7\% (FSPTA), reduces ILA/FSPTA runtimes to 4.7\%/18.3\%, and cuts total analysis time to 20.8\% on average, while producing identical query outcomes and race alarms.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 多线程程序的精确分析需要结合流敏感指针分析（FSPTA）与交错和锁分析（ILA），以在可行的并发执行下推理跨线程的值流。ILA计算可能并行发生（MHP）关系和锁释放区间，以确定共享访问何时可能并发发生。不幸的是，这些分析既昂贵又紧密耦合：FSPTA需要ILA来排除不可行的线程间定义-使用关系，而ILA需要别名信息来识别与干扰相关的交互。因此，全程序分析通常将大部分时间花在与客户端查询无关的代码上。我们提出MSli，一个用于多线程程序模块化分析的按需切片框架。它提取紧凑的、与查询相关的程序切片，同时保留下游分析的答案。与在统一依赖图上进行单遍切片不同，MSli使用特定于分析的标准执行多阶段切片。具体而言，一个轻量级预分析建立线程间值流的过近似，并执行ILA切片源提取，以识别稍后ILA切片所需的MHP和锁区间查询。精化后的主阶段ILA结果随后支持重建线程感知的值流图，以指导FSPTA切片，从而支持模块化分析和下游客户端。我们在SVF中实现了MSli，并在十个大型真实世界项目上以数据竞争检测作为代表性客户端进行评估。与未切片的基线（FSAM）相比，MSli将被分析的ICFG减少到5.4%（ILA）和25.7%（FSPTA），将ILA/FSPTA运行时间减少到4.7%/18.3%，并将总分析时间平均削减到20.8%，同时产生相同的查询结果和竞争警报。

upstream_only.title: ProgSCA: Software Composition Analysis via Program-Level Modeling
upstream_only.abstract: Software composition analysis (SCA) aims to identify third-party dependencies in programs, which plays a critical role in ensuring software supply chain security. Existing approaches largely follow a rule-based paradigm: they first compute function-level similarities, then aggregate these results using handcrafted heuristics to determine which third-party libraries (TPLs) the target program depends on. However, such rules require substantial manual effort and expert knowledge to design, tune, and maintain. To address this, we present ProgSCA, an SCA framework based on a two-stage strategy and program-level rather than function-level modeling. ProgSCA formulates SCA as a retrieval problem, first employing lightweight methods to quickly filter out irrelevant libraries from numerous candidate TPLs, then using a model trained at the program level to directly predict dependency between programs. Comprehensive evaluations show that ProgSCA achieves state-of-the-art performance in SCA tasks, improving F1 scores over existing methods by 174\% and 100\% in two mainstream scenarios, respectively. Moreover, ProgSCA maintains a consistent advantage across different datasets and different candidate pool scales, and also proves effective in the downstream task of function similarity matching, further demonstrating the practical value of our approach.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 软件成分分析（SCA）旨在识别程序中的第三方依赖，对保障软件供应链安全起着关键作用。现有方法大多遵循基于规则的范式：先计算函数级相似度，再使用手工设计的启发式规则聚合结果，以判断目标程序依赖哪些第三方库（TPL）。然而，此类规则需要大量人工投入和专家知识来设计、调优和维护。为解决这一问题，我们提出 ProgSCA，一个基于两阶段策略并以程序级而非函数级建模的 SCA 框架。ProgSCA 将 SCA 形式化为检索问题，首先采用轻量级方法从大量候选 TPL 中快速过滤掉无关库，然后使用在程序级训练的模型直接预测程序之间的依赖关系。综合评估表明，ProgSCA 在 SCA 任务上达到当前最优性能，在两个主流场景中分别将 F1 分数较现有方法提升 174% 和 100%。此外，ProgSCA 在不同数据集和不同候选池规模下均保持一致优势，并在函数相似度匹配的下游任务中也被证明有效，进一步证明了我们方法的实用价值。

upstream_only.title: SmartDecompiler-R1: Enhancing Faithful and Explainable Smart Contract Bytecode Decompilation with Reinforcement Learning
upstream_only.abstract: Understanding EVM bytecode is critical for smart contract security analysis. Existing decompilers typically rely on heuristic rules or leverage large language models (LLMs) to generate source code after bytecode analysis. However, heuristic-based approaches often produce pseudocode that is difficult for humans to interpret, while LLM-based methods also face several problems. LLMs have little experience with low-level bytecode, which weakens their reasoning and causes inaccurate results. Additionally, their tendency to auto-correct code breaks faithfulness to the original program. A general lack of clarity in these approaches also hinders effective auditing and interpretation. In this paper, we propose SmartDecompiler-R1, an end-to-end decompilation framework that translates Three-Address Code (TAC), a register-based representation of EVM bytecode, into source code using reinforcement learning. SmartDecompiler-R1 significantly improves both the accuracy and consistency of decompiled code, while additionally providing human-readable explanations for the bytecode-to-source generation process. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to design a benchmark equipped with well-defined test cases and a systematic evaluation framework for smart contract decompilation. Experimental results on this benchmark demonstrate that SmartDecompiler-R1 substantially outperforms existing decompilers on execution consistency by 46.23\%. In particular, compared with LLM-based approaches, SmartDecompiler-R1 achieves a significant improvement in preserving vulnerability consistency between the original and decompiled contracts. Furthermore, we conduct extensive ablation studies to validate the effectiveness of individual components of SmartDecompiler-R1, and design targeted experiments to demonstrate the interpretability and readability of the generated explanations.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 理解EVM字节码对于智能合约安全分析至关重要。现有的反编译器通常依赖启发式规则，或利用大语言模型（LLM）在字节码分析后生成源代码。然而，基于启发式的方法往往产生难以被人理解的伪代码，而基于LLM的方法也面临若干问题。LLM对底层字节码经验很少，这削弱了其推理能力并导致结果不准确。此外，它们自动纠正代码的倾向破坏了与原始程序的忠实性。这些方法普遍缺乏清晰性也阻碍了有效的审计和解释。在本文中，我们提出了SmartDecompiler-R1，一种端到端反编译框架，它使用强化学习将三地址码（TAC）——EVM字节码的一种基于寄存器的表示——转换为源代码。SmartDecompiler-R1显著提高了反编译代码的准确性和一致性，同时还为字节码到源代码的生成过程提供了人类可读的解释。据我们所知，我们是第一个为智能合约反编译设计带有明确定义测试用例和系统评估框架的基准。在此基准上的实验结果表明，SmartDecompiler-R1在执行一致性上显著优于现有反编译器46.23%。特别是，与基于LLM的方法相比，SmartDecompiler-R1在保持原始合约与反编译合约之间的漏洞一致性方面取得了显著改进。此外，我们进行了广泛的消融研究以验证SmartDecompiler-R1各个组件的有效性，并设计了针对性实验来展示所生成解释的可解释性和可读性。

upstream_only.title: Revisiting Graph Representations for ML-Based Binary Code Similarity Detection: A Systematic Study
upstream_only.abstract: Binary Code Similarity Detection (BCSD) is a foundational capability in software security, underpinning critical applications ranging from vulnerability detection to malware analysis. While recent tools based on Machine Learning (ML) have achieved significant performance improvements, their efficacy is heavily contingent upon the underlying code representation. Through a systematic literature review of ML-based BCSD papers, we find that existing approaches typically leverage linear sequences or adopt graph-based representations, with the latter constituting the majority (77\%). Despite this prevalence, there is no consensus on which graph representation yields superior effectiveness. Existing works usually couple graph construction with customized learning backbones and evaluate them on inconsistent benchmarks. This makes isolating the representation's impact difficult. Consequently, determining which graph topologies most effectively capture robust binary-code semantics under controlled and comparable evaluation settings remains an open problem. In this paper, we present a systematic study of graph representations for ML-based BCSD to bridge this gap. Specifically, we implement a modular evaluation framework that decouples graph construction from model training. Using this framework, we systematically evaluate seven representative graph representations, finding that no single representation is universally dominant, that distinct topologies exhibit unique strengths depending on the evaluation scenario, and that their rankings are largely backbone-stable despite varying absolute performance. We further investigate their combination effectiveness in N-day vulnerability detection and employ a tailored post-hoc analysis tool to study model-level structural reliance. The results show that DFG, PDG, and SOG subgraph pairs more often preserve trained models' similarity scores under pruning, while several other representations are more sensitive to structural reduction.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 二进制代码相似性检测（BCSD）是软件安全中的一项基础能力，支撑着从漏洞检测到恶意软件分析等关键应用。尽管近期基于机器学习（ML）的工具取得了显著的性能提升，但其有效性在很大程度上取决于底层的代码表示。通过对基于ML的BCSD论文进行系统性文献综述，我们发现现有方法通常利用线性序列或采用基于图的表示，后者占大多数（77%）。尽管基于图的表示如此普遍，但关于哪种图表示能产生更优效果，尚无共识。现有工作通常将图构建与定制的学习骨干网络耦合在一起，并在不一致的基准上进行评估。这使得难以孤立地衡量表示的影响。因此，在受控且可比较的评估设置下，确定哪些图拓扑能最有效地捕获稳健的二进制代码语义，仍然是一个开放问题。在本文中，我们提出了一项针对基于ML的BCSD的图表示的系统性研究，以弥补这一空白。具体而言，我们实现了一个模块化评估框架，将图构建与模型训练解耦。利用该框架，我们系统性地评估了七种具有代表性的图表示，发现没有一种表示具有普遍优势，不同拓扑根据评估场景展现出独特优势，并且尽管绝对性能有所变化，它们的排名在很大程度上对骨干网络保持稳定。我们进一步研究了它们在N日漏洞检测中的组合有效性，并采用定制的事后分析工具来研究模型层面的结构依赖性。结果表明，DFG、PDG和SOG子图对在修剪下更常保持训练模型的相似性分数，而其他几种表示对结构削减更为敏感。

upstream_only.title: SEDCoT: Enhancing LLM-Based COBOL Code Translation via Symbolic Execution and Delta Debugging
upstream_only.abstract: COBOL remains critical across banking, insurance, and government infrastructure. However, maintenance is increasingly challenging due to outdated technologies, sparse documentation, and developer retirement, necessitating code translation into modern languages like C. Traditional rule-based transcompilers yield outputs that are difficult to read and maintain, while general-purpose large language models (LLMs) achieve suboptimal correctness because COBOL is a low-resource language with distinct logic patterns. To bridge this gap, we propose SEDCoT, a novel COBOL-to-C translation framework. SEDCoT first leverages LLMs for initial translation, then combines symbolic execution with LLM guidance to generate test suites and iteratively repair semantic discrepancies. Finally, it integrates delta debugging to minimize failing tests into succinct counterexamples, accelerating automated code repair. Evaluating SEDCoT on a public COBOL-to-C dataset demonstrates that it outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by at least 12\% while producing translations with substantially higher readability than rule-based alternatives.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在银行、保险和政府基础设施中，COBOL仍然至关重要。然而，由于技术过时、文档稀少和开发者退休，维护日益困难，需要将代码翻译成C等现代语言。传统的基于规则的转译器生成的输出难以阅读和维护，而通用大语言模型（LLM）的正确性欠佳，因为COBOL是一种低资源语言，具有独特的逻辑模式。为弥补这一差距，我们提出SEDCoT，一种新颖的COBOL到C翻译框架。SEDCoT首先利用LLM进行初始翻译，然后结合符号执行与LLM引导来生成测试套件，并迭代修复语义差异。最后，它集成增量调试（delta debugging），将失败测试最小化为简洁的反例，从而加速自动代码修复。在公开的COBOL到C数据集上评估SEDCoT表明，它比最先进的基线至少高出12%，同时生成的翻译比基于规则的替代方案具有显著更高的可读性。

upstream_only.title: ConUT: Condition-Aware Test Generation for Complex Java Code
upstream_only.abstract: Automatically generating high-coverage unit tests for complex Java methods remains a formidable challenge, particularly when execution paths are guarded by intricate control-flow nesting and cross-class state dependencies. Existing LLM-based approaches predominantly follow a goal-driven paradigm, relying on unguided code synthesis within a vast search space to satisfy coverage objectives. Lacking explicit guidance on how to construct the precise object states required for complex predicates, these methods suffer from a construction-reachability gap, ultimately resulting in insufficient coverage for complex methods. This paper introduces ConUT, a condition-aware unit test generation framework centered on the paradigm of Configuration-Driven Guidance, which is a strategy that bridges the gap between abstract branch targets and concrete code realization by providing the LLM with structured instantiation recipes. Our core insight is that the implicit causal chain leading to a target branch can be explicitly manifested via static analysis and distilled into structured guidance. ConUT utilizes Backward Dependency Tracing (BDT) to identify the fields and method calls that influence predicates, and distills these findings into structured Configuration Templates (Ccfg). These templates serve as a “semantic roadmap,” pruning the LLM’s search space and transitioning it from a stochastic generator into a guided logic realizer. We evaluate ConUT on eight real-world Java projects characterized by high-complexity “logic hotspots.” Experimental results demonstrate that ConUT outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an average branch coverage of 72.84\% and line coverage of 83.87\%. Notably, ConUT exceeds the best baseline in average branch coverage by 11.94 percentage points while utilizing 67\% fewer test cases.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 为复杂Java方法自动生成高覆盖率单元测试仍然是一项艰巨挑战，尤其当执行路径受到复杂控制流嵌套和跨类状态依赖的约束时。现有基于LLM的方法主要遵循目标驱动范式，依赖在巨大搜索空间中进行无引导的代码合成以满足覆盖率目标。由于缺乏关于如何构造复杂谓词所需精确对象状态的显式指导，这些方法面临构造-可达性鸿沟，最终导致复杂方法的覆盖率不足。本文提出ConUT，一个以配置驱动引导范式为中心的条件感知单元测试生成框架；该策略通过为LLM提供结构化的实例化配方，弥合抽象分支目标与具体代码实现之间的差距。我们的核心洞见是，通向目标分支的隐式因果链可以通过静态分析显式呈现，并提炼为结构化指导。ConUT利用反向依赖追踪（BDT）识别影响谓词的字段和方法调用，并将这些发现提炼为结构化配置模板（Ccfg）。这些模板充当“语义路线图”，剪枝LLM的搜索空间，使其从随机生成器转变为有引导的逻辑实现器。我们在八个以高复杂度“逻辑热点”为特征的现实Java项目上评估ConUT。实验结果表明，ConUT优于最先进的基线，平均分支覆盖率达到72.84%，行覆盖率达到83.87%。值得注意的是，ConUT在平均分支覆盖率上超过最佳基线11.94个百分点，同时使用的测试用例减少了67%。

upstream_only.title: Testing Method Relocation Algorithms via Template-Based Systematic Structural Traversal and Precondition Filtering
upstream_only.abstract: Method relocation refactorings, primarily Move Method and Pull Up/Push Down Method, are indispensable for reducing coupling and enhancing cohesion. Despite their widespread automation in modern refactoring engines, these algorithms remain notoriously error-prone, posing significant risks to software reliability. A primary challenge in testing them lies in the vast search space of complex program structures and the intricate preconditions required for safe method relocation. To address this, we propose RelocTest, a comprehensive testing framework that combines template-driven structural traversal with automated precondition filtering. RelocTest systematically explores the input space by populating program templates specially designed for method relocation through a two-stage generation process: (1) Skeleton Synthesis, which systematically traverses diverse syntactic structures, and (2) LLM-Guided Completion, which leverages Large Language Models to inject diverse, executable code into these skeletons. This hybrid strategy ensures high structural coverage while maintaining test program validity. Furthermore, to optimize testing efficiency, we introduce an LLM-based Precondition Extractor that analyzes the implementation of method relocation algorithms to identify and prune test programs destined for rejection. We evaluated RelocTest on 7 mainstream refactoring engines. Our approach successfully uncovered 56 previously unknown bugs, with 19 already confirmed by tool vendors, demonstrating its effectiveness in hardening industrial-strength refactoring tools.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 方法重定位重构，主要是移动方法和上移/下移方法，对于降低耦合和提高内聚性不可或缺。尽管在现代重构引擎中广泛自动化，这些算法仍然众所周知地容易出错，对软件可靠性构成重大风险。测试它们的一个主要挑战在于复杂程序结构的巨大搜索空间以及安全方法重定位所需的复杂前置条件。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了RelocTest，一个综合测试框架，结合了模板驱动的结构遍历和自动前置条件过滤。RelocTest通过两阶段生成过程填充专门为方法重定位设计的程序模板，系统地探索输入空间：(1) 骨架合成，系统地遍历多样化的语法结构；(2) LLM引导的补全，利用大型语言模型向这些骨架注入多样化、可执行的代码。这种混合策略确保了高结构覆盖率，同时保持测试程序的有效性。此外，为了优化测试效率，我们引入了一个基于LLM的前置条件提取器，它分析方法重定位算法的实现，以识别并修剪注定被拒绝的测试程序。我们在7个主流重构引擎上评估了RelocTest。我们的方法成功发现了56个先前未知的缺陷，其中19个已被工具供应商确认，证明了其在强化工业级重构工具方面的有效性。

upstream_only.title: E2WR: An Effective and Efficient Reduction Framework for WebAssembly Binaries
upstream_only.abstract: WebAssembly (Wasm) is a prominent programming language enabling high-performance execution across diverse computing environments. However, bugs in Wasm runtimes, which execute Wasm binaries, can lead to severe security breaches and system failures. Manually debugging Wasm binaries that trigger such runtime bugs is exceedingly difficult due to their poor human readability, stemming from low-level stack-based instructions, complex control flow structures, and extraordinary length. Thus, there is a critical need for automated reduction techniques that minimize Wasm binaries while preserving the ability to trigger the original bug. However, existing reducers often suffer from significant limitations in effectiveness and efficiency: language-agnostic reducers frequently generate invalid variants without Wasm validation awareness, while Wasm-specific reducers still lack efficient intra-function instruction-sequence reduction and reduce definitions inefficiently. To address these challenges, we propose E2WR, an effective and efficient reduction framework for Wasm binaries. E2WR introduces a two-stage approach for intra-function instruction-sequence reduction, consisting of operand-dependency guided instruction reduction and combination-aware redundancy elimination to enable efficient delta debugging while avoiding unnecessary padding instructions, and a definition reduction approach that combines static analysis with delta-debugging-guided trials to remove property-irrelevant definitions efficiently. Compared with Wasm-Shrink and Wasm-Reduce, E2WR produces binaries that are 95.0\% and 68.6\% smaller, respectively, and achieves reduction speedups of 7.9{\texttimes}–12.4{\texttimes}.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: WebAssembly（Wasm）是一种突出的编程语言，可在多种计算环境中实现高性能执行。然而，执行 Wasm 二进制文件的 Wasm 运行时中的漏洞可能导致严重的安全漏洞和系统故障。手动调试触发此类运行时漏洞的 Wasm 二进制文件极其困难，因为其可读性差，这源于低级基于栈的指令、复杂的控制流结构以及超常的长度。因此，迫切需要自动化缩减技术，在保留触发原始漏洞能力的同时最小化 Wasm 二进制文件。然而，现有缩减器通常在有效性和效率方面存在显著局限：语言无关的缩减器常常生成未经 Wasm 验证感知的无效变体，而 Wasm 特定的缩减器仍然缺乏高效的函数内指令序列缩减，并且缩减定义效率低下。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 E2WR，一种有效且高效的 Wasm 二进制缩减框架。E2WR 引入了一个两阶段的函数内指令序列缩减方法，包括操作数依赖引导的指令缩减和组合感知的冗余消除，以在避免不必要填充指令的同时实现高效的 delta 调试，以及一种定义缩减方法，将静态分析与 delta 调试引导的试验相结合，以高效移除与性质无关的定义。与 Wasm-Shrink 和 Wasm-Reduce 相比，E2WR 产生的二进制文件分别小 95.0% 和 68.6%，并实现了 7.9 倍至 12.4 倍的缩减加速。

upstream_only.title: LogNexus: Effective Log Compression via Unified Redundancy Encoding
upstream_only.abstract: State-of-the-art log compressors typically rely on a decoupled “parse-then-compress” workflow, where parsing is optimized for semantic accuracy (i.e., event identification) rather than storage efficiency. Through a comprehensive empirical study, we reveal that this architectural decoupling prevents the exploitation of deep correlations between static templates and dynamic variables. To address it, we propose LogNexus based on the principle of unified redundancy encoding, a new log compression paradigm that co-designs structural extraction and variable encoding. LogNexus constructs a Unified Redundancy Tree (URT) using a hierarchical strategy that progressively mines frequent “structure+variable” patterns in logs. Such a design captures deep contextual redundancies ignored by traditional methods while minimizing computational overhead by pre-emptively encoding dominant patterns. Extensive evaluation on 16 benchmark datasets demonstrates that LogNexus establishes a new state-of-the-art. It achieves the highest compression ratio on 14 datasets (outperforming baselines by 9.48\%–89.13\%) and the fastest speed (1.51{\texttimes}–40.06{\texttimes} faster than competitors). Furthermore, when configured in non-chunked mode to maximize global pattern discovery, LogNexus boosts its compression ratio by 285.13\%, which is 27.08\% higher than the best baseline, while retaining a 2.43{\texttimes} speed advantage. The decompression audit further shows that LogNexus successfully restores every token on all 16 datasets.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 最先进的日志压缩器通常依赖于解耦的“先解析后压缩”工作流，其中解析针对语义准确性（即事件识别）而非存储效率进行优化。通过全面的实证研究，我们揭示了这种架构解耦阻碍了对静态模板和动态变量之间深层相关性的利用。为解决此问题，我们提出了基于统一冗余编码原理的LogNexus，一种新的日志压缩范式，它协同设计结构提取和变量编码。LogNexus使用分层策略构建统一冗余树（URT），逐步挖掘日志中频繁的“结构+变量”模式。这种设计捕获了传统方法忽略的深层上下文冗余，同时通过预先编码主导模式来最小化计算开销。在16个基准数据集上的大量评估表明，LogNexus确立了新的最先进水平。它在14个数据集上实现了最高压缩率（比基线高出9.48%–89.13%）和最快速度（比竞争者快1.51–40.06倍）。此外，当配置为非分块模式以最大化全局模式发现时，LogNexus将其压缩率提高了285.13%，比最佳基线高27.08%，同时保持2.43倍的速度优势。解压审计进一步表明，LogNexus成功恢复了所有16个数据集上的每个令牌。

upstream_only.title: Paired Code Smells and Test Smells: A Fine-Grained Longitudinal Empirical Study
upstream_only.abstract: As software systems grow in complexity, ensuring maintainability is essential, but often hindered by various quality issues. Among them, code smells and test smells are widely recognized indicators of technical debt that degrade system quality. While production code and test suites are intrinsically coupled and evolve together, existing research predominantly studies code smells and test smells in isolation, ignoring their underlying connection over time. To bridge this gap, this paper presents a fine-grained longitudinal study on the co-evolutionary dynamics of "paired smells", which refer to cases where code and test smells exist concurrently in linked production and test code. By analyzing 128,417 commits across 19 long-lived open-source Java repositories, we investigate the statistical associations, survival lifespans, and removal motivations of these paired flaws. As a result, we identify 30 statistically significant rules where specific test smells imply the presence of underlying production code smells and our survival analysis reveals that in most repositories, paired smells have relatively shorter lifespans than unpaired ones. To explain this phenomenon, our manual inspection reveals that paired smells often signal deeper structural issues, prompting explicit risk-driven refactoring. Finally, we discuss the implications of these results for code quality analysis and continuous integration tools, suggesting that they should link related smell findings between production and test code and guide synchronized refactoring.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 随着软件系统复杂性增加，确保可维护性至关重要，但常常受到各种质量问题的阻碍。其中，代码异味和测试异味是被广泛认可的技术债务指标，会降低系统质量。虽然生产代码和测试套件本质上是耦合的并且共同演化，但现有研究主要孤立地研究代码异味和测试异味，忽视了它们随时间推移的潜在联系。为弥补这一空白，本文对“成对异味”的协同演化动态进行了细粒度纵向研究，其中成对异味指在相关联的生产代码和测试代码中同时存在代码异味和测试异味的情况。通过分析19个长期开源Java仓库中的128,417次提交，我们研究了这些成对缺陷的统计关联、生存寿命和移除动机。结果，我们识别出30条统计显著的规则，其中特定的测试异味暗示存在底层的生产代码异味；我们的生存分析揭示，在大多数仓库中，成对异味的寿命相对短于非成对异味。为解释这一现象，我们的手动检查发现，成对异味往往标志着更深层的结构问题，促使以风险为驱动的显式重构。最后，我们讨论了这些结果对代码质量分析和持续集成工具的意义，建议它们应关联生产代码和测试代码中相关的异味发现，并指导同步重构。

upstream_only.title: Fixed-Point Guided ADS Scenario Generation via Multi-modal LLM Reasoning and Software Testing
upstream_only.abstract: Robust scenario generation is essential for systematically testing Autonomous Driving Systems (ADSs) under rare and safety-critical conditions. However, search-based approaches often lack semantic guidance, whereas specification-based approaches rely heavily on manually constructed rules. Existing LLM-assisted techniques primarily translate accident artifacts into scene descriptions without producing executable behavioral specifications that guide subsequent testing. We present InvarGen, a framework that uses a multi-modal LLM as a parametric specification generator. InvarGen organizes safety requirements into a predefined taxonomy of Scenario Fixed Points while dynamically instantiating their predicates, thresholds, and temporal bounds from each accident context. These fixed points serve as executable test oracles and optimization objectives. Unlike static templates, these fixed points adaptively constrain the search space, guiding a hybrid evolutionary process: Intelligent Fuzzing exploits boundary parameters to trigger specific violations, while Structural Mutation ensures the global exploration of diverse environmental contexts. Evaluation using 200 real-world accidents and 1,400 synthesized scenarios shows that InvarGen discovers 37.8\% more critical scenario types than the best baseline, achieves a 30\% fixed-point violation rate, and achieves the highest semantic-diversity score. The scenarios also achieve high physical plausibility and cross-simulator executability, with 100\% syntactic compliance with the evaluated OpenX formats. These results highlight the promise of fixed-point semantics as a principled bridge between unstructured LLM reasoning and rigorous robustness testing.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 鲁棒场景生成对于在罕见且安全攸关的条件下系统性地测试自动驾驶系统（ADS）至关重要。然而，基于搜索的方法往往缺乏语义引导，而基于规约的方法则严重依赖人工构造的规则。现有的LLM辅助技术主要将事故资料转化为场景描述，而没有产生可执行的行为规格来指导后续测试。我们提出InvarGen，一个使用多模态LLM作为参数化规格生成器的框架。InvarGen将安全需求组织到预定义的场景不动点分类体系中，同时根据每个事故上下文动态实例化其谓词、阈值和时间边界。这些不动点充当可执行的测试预言和优化目标。与静态模板不同，这些不动点自适应地约束搜索空间，引导一种混合进化过程：智能模糊测试利用边界参数触发特定违规，而结构变异确保对不同环境上下文的全局探索。使用200个真实世界事故和1,400个合成场景的评估表明，InvarGen发现的关键场景类型比最佳基线多37.8%，达到30%的不动点违反率，并获得最高的语义多样性得分。这些场景还实现了高物理合理性和跨模拟器可执行性，对评估的OpenX格式具有100%的语法合规性。这些结果突显了不动点语义作为非结构化LLM推理与严格鲁棒性测试之间原则性桥梁的前景。

upstream_only.title: ARQ: A Mixed-Precision Quantization Framework for Accurate and Certifiably Robust DNNs
upstream_only.abstract: Mixed precision quantization has become an important technique for optimizing the execution of deep neural networks (DNNs). Certified robustness, which provides provable guarantees about a model’s ability to withstand different adversarial perturbations, has rarely been addressed in quantization due to the unacceptably high cost of certifying robustness. This paper introduces ARQ, an innovative mixed-precision quantization method that not only preserves the clean accuracy of the smoothed classifiers, but also maintains their certified robustness. ARQ uses reinforcement learning to find accurate and robust DNN quantization, while efficiently leveraging randomized smoothing, a popular class of statistical DNN verification algorithms. ARQ consistently performs better than multiple state-of-the-art quantization techniques across all the benchmarks and the input perturbation levels. The performance of ARQ quantized networks reaches that of the original DNN with floating-point weights, while using only 1.5\% instructions and the highest certified radius. ARQ’s code is available at https://github.com/uiuc-arc/ARQ.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 混合精度量化已成为优化深度神经网络（DNN）执行的一项重要技术。可认证鲁棒性提供了关于模型抵御不同对抗扰动能力的可证明保证，但由于认证鲁棒性的成本高得令人无法接受，量化中很少涉及这一问题。本文提出ARQ，一种创新的混合精度量化方法，不仅能保持平滑分类器的干净准确率，还能维持其可认证鲁棒性。ARQ使用强化学习来寻找准确且鲁棒的DNN量化，同时高效利用随机平滑——一类流行的统计DNN验证算法。在所有基准和输入扰动水平上，ARQ始终优于多种最先进的量化技术。ARQ量化网络的性能达到具有浮点权重的原始DNN的水平，同时仅使用1.5%的指令并具有最高的认证半径。ARQ的代码见 https://github.com/uiuc-arc/ARQ。

upstream_only.title: Red-Teaming Coding Agents from a Tool-Invocation Perspective: An Empirical Security Assessment
upstream_only.abstract: Coding agents powered by large language models are becoming central modules of modern IDEs. They help users to perform various complex coding tasks by invoking tools. Although powerful, tool-invocation operation in coding agents opens a substantial attack surface for adversaries. Prior work has demonstrated attacks against both general-purpose LLM agents and domain-specific agents. However, to our knowledge, no previous works focus on the security risks of tool-invocation in coding agents. To fill this gap, we conduct the first systematic, in-depth red-teaming from a tool-invocation perspective in six popular real-world coding agents: Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, and Trae. Our red-teaming proceeds in two phases. In Phase 1, we conduct a prompt leakage as reconnaissance to recover system prompts and related context. Specifically, we identify a mode gap between chat generation and tool-call argument generation: during schema-driven argument completion, the model behaves as if it is performing benign structured filling and may copy hidden agent context into tool-call arguments. We instantiate this gap as ToolLeak, which exfiltrates agent-internal prompts (e.g., system prompts and tool metadata) via required tool parameters. In Phase 2, we hijack the tool-invocation behavior of the coding agent with a novel two-channel prompt injection in the tool description and the tool return. Our hijacking achieves remote code execution (RCE) on major real-world coding agents. We adaptively construct the malicious payload using leaked security information in Phase 1. Our evaluation shows that ToolLeak substantially outperforms strong prompt-leak baselines in both emulated and real-world settings. In the emulated setting, ToolLeak achieves the best overall prompt-exfiltration performance across all six simulated coding agents. On real-world coding agents, ToolLeak achieves the best pseudo-recall on 18 of 25 evaluated agent-LLM pairs. Furthermore, our red-teaming successfully hijacks all six real-world coding agents for RCE and consistently yields higher attack success rates than baseline attacks. Lastly, we present two case studies on Cursor and Claude Code to demonstrate the real-world impact of our red-teaming.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 由大型语言模型驱动的编码代理正在成为现代IDE的核心模块。它们通过调用工具来帮助用户执行各种复杂的编码任务。尽管功能强大，但编码代理中的工具调用操作给对手开辟了巨大的攻击面。已有工作已经展示了对通用LLM代理和特定领域代理的攻击。然而，据我们所知，此前没有工作关注编码代理中工具调用的安全风险。为了填补这一空白，我们从工具调用视角对六个流行的真实世界编码代理进行了首次系统、深入的红队测试：Cursor、Claude Code、Copilot、Windsurf、Cline和Trae。我们的红队测试分两个阶段进行。在第一阶段，我们进行提示泄漏作为侦察，以恢复系统提示和相关上下文。具体而言，我们识别出聊天生成与工具调用参数生成之间存在一种模式差距：在模式驱动的参数补全过程中，模型表现得好像在进行良性的结构化填充，并可能将隐藏的代理上下文复制到工具调用参数中。我们将这一差距实例化为ToolLeak，它通过必需的工具参数泄露代理内部提示（例如系统提示和工具元数据）。在第二阶段，我们通过一种新颖的双通道提示注入在工具描述和工具返回中劫持编码代理的工具调用行为。我们的劫持在主要的真实世界编码代理上实现了远程代码执行（RCE）。我们利用第一阶段泄露的安全信息自适应地构造恶意载荷。我们的评估表明，ToolLeak在模拟和真实世界设置中都显著优于强大的提示泄漏基线。在模拟设置中，ToolLeak在六个模拟编码代理上取得了最佳的整体提示泄露性能。在真实世界编码代理上，ToolLeak在25个评估的代理-LLM对中的18个上取得了最佳伪召回率。此外，我们的红队测试成功劫持了所有六个真实世界编码代理以实现RCE，并且始终比基线攻击产生更高的攻击成功率。最后，我们在Cursor和Claude Code上展示了两个案例研究，以证明我们红队测试的真实世界影响。

upstream_only.title: How Safe Is Your Screen? Understanding and Detecting Privacy Leaks in Sensitive Activities
upstream_only.abstract: Android apps handle sensitive data, often displayed on screens (i.e., Activities), and protecting these activities is vital for ensuring user privacy. Several studies have demonstrated the risk of private data leakage via screen capture and identified malware exploiting this vulnerability. To mitigate such threats, Google introduced FLAG_SECURE, an activity-level security feature that protects an Activity when set by blocking screen capture and restricting display on non-secure devices. Proper usage of this security feature could significantly reduce data leakage risks. However, to the best of our knowledge, its adoption across diverse Android apps has not been systematically studied. In this work, we present a large-scale empirical study of screenshot-based vulnerabilities in Android apps using a systematic static analysis pipeline, ASSA. The pipeline automatically constructs UI models of activities and fragments by leveraging a customized version of Frontmatter, and combines them with a Large Language Model (LLM) to infer runtime context and identify sensitive user data rendered on screens. We apply ASSA to 5,667 popular real-world Android apps and find that 19.8\% contain at least one activity that displays sensitive information without screen-capture protection, while 87.2\% of apps do not apply FLAG_SECURE to any activity, exposing credentials, financial information, and location data to screenshot attacks. Beyond quantifying prevalence, we analyze FLAG_SECURE usage patterns and establish a taxonomy that captures diverse factors influencing developers’ decisions to adopt or omit screen protection, including intentional privacy protection, intellectual property safeguarding, and unintentional inheritance from base activities. To assess real-world impact, we further conduct in-depth case studies on 200 vulnerable apps and responsibly disclose our findings to the affected vendors, receiving 6 confirmed patches and 20 acknowledgments, including 11 vendors who reported ongoing efforts toward mitigation. These findings indicate that screenshot-based vulnerabilities are not only widespread but also systematically overlooked in practice, highlighting the need for greater awareness and more careful handling of sensitive on-screen information by developers.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Android应用处理敏感数据，并经常将其显示在屏幕（即Activity）上，保护这些Activity对于确保用户隐私至关重要。若干研究已经证明了通过屏幕截图造成隐私数据泄露的风险，并识别了利用此漏洞的恶意软件。为缓解此类威胁，Google引入了FLAG_SECURE，这是一种Activity级安全功能，设置后可保护Activity，阻止屏幕截图并限制在非安全设备上的显示。正确使用此安全功能可以显著降低数据泄露风险。然而，据我们所知，其在各种Android应用中的采用情况尚未被系统研究。在这项工作中，我们使用系统化静态分析流水线ASSA，对Android应用中的截图漏洞进行了大规模实证研究。该流水线通过利用定制版Frontmatter自动构建Activity和Fragment的UI模型，并将其与大语言模型（LLM）结合以推断运行时上下文并识别屏幕上渲染的敏感用户数据。我们将ASSA应用于5,667个流行的真实世界Android应用，发现19.8%至少包含一个显示敏感信息且未受屏幕截图保护的Activity，而87.2%的应用未对任何Activity应用FLAG_SECURE，从而将凭据、财务信息和位置数据暴露于截图攻击。除了量化普遍性外，我们还分析了FLAG_SECURE的使用模式，并建立了一个分类法，涵盖影响开发者采用或省略屏幕保护决策的多种因素，包括有意的隐私保护、知识产权保护以及无意间从基类Activity继承。为评估真实世界影响，我们进一步对200个易受攻击的应用进行了深入案例研究，并负责任地向受影响厂商披露我们的发现，获得6个已确认补丁和20个致谢，其中包括11家报告正在努力缓解的厂商。这些发现表明，基于截图的漏洞不仅广泛存在，而且在实践中被系统性地忽视，凸显了开发者需要提高意识并更谨慎地处理屏幕上的敏感信息。

upstream_only.title: Cracking Query Bottlenecks: Towards Efficiency-Oriented Text-to-SQL Generation
upstream_only.abstract: Text-to-SQL models translate natural language questions into SQL, enabling non-technical users to access databases. However, most existing research focuses on correctness, neglecting query efficiency. In this paper, we address the challenge of evaluating the execution efficiency of generated SQL in Text-to-SQL by introducing EESQLBench, a novel benchmark designed to assess both correctness and efficiency. EESQLBench pairs each natural language question with an expert-optimized SQL query, providing a reliable efficiency baseline. We evaluate six representative large language models (LLMs), including four open-source models (SQLCoder, CodeLlama, DeepSeek-Coder, and DeepSeek-R1) and two closed-source models (GPT-5.2 and Gemini-2.5-Pro), using cost-based metrics including Cost Reachability (CR) and Acceptable Reachability at kk (AR@kk). Our results reveal that current LLMs, despite achieving high correctness, struggle to produce efficient queries. We observe substantial efficiency gaps between models and emphasize that semantic correctness alone does not guarantee query efficiency. Furthermore, we provide insights into common inefficiency patterns in LLM-generated SQL queries, such as missing access pruning and inefficient subquery logic.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Text-to-SQL模型将自然语言问题翻译为SQL，使非技术用户能够访问数据库。然而，大多数现有研究关注正确性，而忽视了查询效率。在本文中，我们通过引入EESQLBench——一个旨在评估正确性和效率的新基准——来应对Text-to-SQL中评估生成SQL执行效率的挑战。EESQLBench为每个自然语言问题配对一个专家优化的SQL查询，从而提供可靠的效率基线。我们使用包括成本可达性（CR）和可接受可达性@k（AR@k）在内的基于成本的指标，评估了六个具有代表性的大语言模型（LLM），包括四个开源模型（SQLCoder、CodeLlama、DeepSeek-Coder和DeepSeek-R1）以及两个闭源模型（GPT-5.2和Gemini-2.5-Pro）。我们的结果表明，当前LLM虽然实现了高正确性，却难以生成高效的查询。我们观察到模型之间存在显著的效率差距，并强调仅凭语义正确性并不能保证查询效率。此外，我们还深入分析了LLM生成SQL查询中常见低效模式，例如缺少访问剪枝和低效的子查询逻辑。

upstream_only.title: Lingxi: Repository-Level Issue Resolution Framework Enhanced by Procedural Knowledge Guided Scaling
upstream_only.abstract: Driven by the advancements of Large Language Models (LLMs), LLM-powered agents are making significant improvements in software engineering tasks, yet struggle with complex, repository-level issue resolution. Existing agent-based methods have two key limitations. First, they lack of procedural knowledge (i.e., how an issue is fixed step-by-step and rationales behind it) to learn and leverage for issue resolution. Second, they rely on massive computational power to blindly explore the solution space. To address those limitations, we propose Lingxi, an issue resolution framework that leverages procedural knowledge extracted from historical issue-fixing data to guide agents in solving repository-level issues. Lingxi first constructs this knowledge offline through a hierarchical abstraction mechanism, enabling agents to learn the how and why behind a fix, not just the final solution. During online application, it employs a knowledge-driven scaling method that leverages the procedural knowledge of similar issues to intelligently analyze the target issue from multiple perspectives, in sharp contrast to undirected, brute-force exploration.Lingxi successfully resolves 74.6\% of bugs on the SWE-bench Verified benchmark in Pass@1 setting, outperforming five state-of-the-art techniques by a significant margin (5.4\% to 14.9\%). Our comprehensive ablation study confirmed that the success of Lingxi comes directly from its use of procedural knowledge. Without it, the performance gains from scaling alone is negligible. Our qualitative study further shows that the “design patterns \& coding practices” is the most critical knowledge aspect, and that the roles of different knowledge aspects switch across different stages (i.e., analysis, planning, and fixing).
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型（LLM）进步的推动下，由LLM驱动的智能体在软件工程任务上取得了显著改进，但在复杂的仓库级问题解决上仍步履维艰。现有的基于智能体的方法有两个关键局限。第一，它们缺乏过程知识（即一个问题如何逐步修复以及其背后的理由）来学习和利用以解决问题。第二，它们依赖巨大的计算能力盲目探索解空间。为了解决这些局限，我们提出了Lingxi，一个利用从历史问题修复数据中提取的过程知识来指导智能体解决仓库级问题的框架。Lingxi首先通过分层抽象机制离线构建这种知识，使智能体能够学习修复背后的方法和原因，而不仅仅是最终解决方案。在在线应用时，它采用一种知识驱动的扩展方法，利用相似问题的过程知识从多个角度智能分析目标问题，这与无向的蛮力探索形成鲜明对比。Lingxi在SWE-bench Verified基准上以Pass@1设置成功解决了74.6%的bug，显著优于五种最先进技术（5.4%到14.9%）。我们全面的消融研究证实，Lingxi的成功直接来自其对过程知识的使用。没有它，仅靠扩展带来的性能提升可以忽略不计。我们的定性研究进一步表明，“设计模式与编码实践”是最关键的知识方面，并且不同知识方面的作用在不同阶段（即分析、规划和修复）之间会发生转换。

upstream_only.title: Characterizing Real-World Bugs in Tile Programs for Automated Bug Detection
upstream_only.abstract: Tile-based programming frameworks are increasingly adopted to write high-performance GPU kernels in domains such as deep learning and scientific computing. While these frameworks enhance productivity and hardware utilization, their multi-stage compilation pipelines introduce distinct code generation bugs that are tightly coupled to input shapes, data types, and backend targets. These bugs often manifest as silent wrong results or performance issues, making them difficult to detect using existing compiler testing tools. Additionally, the unique programming conventions of tile domain-specific languages complicate root cause identification, while fixing such bugs demands specialized knowledge of tile abstractions and compilation pipelines. Despite the growing adoption of tile-based systems, their code generation bugs remain largely unexplored. This paper presents the first systematic study of tile-program code generation bugs. We curate 401 bug reports from GitHub and identify 301 tile-program codegen bugs for analysis, characterizing their root causes and symptoms, the input patterns that trigger them, the test oracles that detect them, and the strategies for fixing these bugs. Our study provides foundational insights for building debugging, testing, and repair tools tailored to tile-based compiler infrastructures.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 基于Tile的编程框架正越来越多地被用于在深度学习和科学计算等领域编写高性能GPU内核。虽然这些框架提高了生产力和硬件利用率，但其多阶段编译流水线引入了独特的代码生成缺陷，这些缺陷与输入形状、数据类型和后端目标紧密耦合。这些缺陷通常表现为静默的错误结果或性能问题，使其难以用现有的编译器测试工具检测。此外，Tile领域特定语言的独特编程约定使根因识别复杂化，而修复此类缺陷需要关于Tile抽象和编译流水线的专业知识。尽管基于Tile的系统日益普及，其代码生成缺陷在很大程度上仍未得到探索。本文首次对Tile程序代码生成缺陷进行了系统研究。我们从GitHub收集了401份缺陷报告，并识别出301个Tile程序代码生成缺陷进行分析，刻画了它们的根因和症状、触发它们的输入模式、检测它们的测试预言，以及修复这些缺陷的策略。我们的研究为构建面向基于Tile的编译器基础设施的调试、测试和修复工具提供了基础性见解。

upstream_only.title: Automated Program Repair for UI-Centric Android Bugs: How Far Are We?
upstream_only.abstract: Substantial research effort has been devoted to developing techniques for automated program repair (APR) that suggest patches for localized buggy code -- and more recent techniques have begun to leverage the capabilities of code-centric large language models (LLMs). However, the scope and diversity of bugs to which these techniques have historically been applied are limited. In particular, the research community currently lacks a comprehensive understanding of the performance of APR techniques on bugs that arise in UI-centric programs, such as mobile apps. Bugs in UI centric programs carry with them unique challenges, including (i) the need to reason across interconnected subroutines that connect presentation and program logic, (ii) event-driven programming paradigms, and (iii) the need to reason about program state through cues in the UI. In this paper, we investigate the effectiveness of existing APR techniques when applied to fix bugs in UI-centric programs - specifically Android applications. To explore this phenomenon, we conduct a comprehensive empirical study with five existing program repair techniques (including those that utilize LLMs) on a hybrid dataset including 46 synthetic bugs, generated via MDroid+, an Android-specific mutation tool, and 50 real bugs systematically mined from issue reports of 23 popular Android applications. Our findings illustrate important current limitations in resolving UI-related issues in mobile apps. We synthesize these results to form a taxonomy of the limitations of existing program repair techniques. This taxonomy outlines key limitations and can inform future research efforts in designing automated program repair tools for UI-centric bugs in mobile applications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大量研究工作致力于开发自动程序修复（APR）技术，为局部有缺陷的代码提出补丁——最近的技术已开始利用以代码为中心的大语言模型（LLM）的能力。然而，这些技术历史上所适用的缺陷范围和多样性是有限的。特别是，研究界目前缺乏对APR技术在以UI为中心的程序（如移动应用）中出现的缺陷上的性能的全面理解。以UI为中心的程序中的缺陷带来独特挑战，包括（i）需要跨连接呈现与程序逻辑的相互关联子程序进行推理，（ii）事件驱动编程范式，以及（iii）需要通过UI中的线索推理程序状态。本文研究现有APR技术应用于修复以UI为中心的程序（特别是Android应用）中的缺陷时的有效性。为探索这一现象，我们在一个混合数据集上对五种现有程序修复技术（包括利用LLM的技术）进行了全面的实证研究，该数据集包含通过MDroid+（一种Android专用变异工具）生成的46个合成缺陷，以及从23个流行Android应用的问题报告中系统挖掘出的50个真实缺陷。我们的发现说明了当前在解决移动应用中UI相关问题方面的重要局限。我们综合这些结果，形成了现有程序修复技术局限性的分类法。该分类法概述了关键局限性，并可为未来设计面向移动应用中以UI为中心缺陷的自动程序修复工具的研究工作提供参考。

upstream_only.title: EventSpec: Defining and Detecting Event-Semantic Issues in Blockchain Ecosystems
upstream_only.abstract: In recent years, smart contracts have become the backbone of decentralized applications (DApps), and off-chain systems such as bridges, wallets, and indexers rely heavily on event logs to track contract execution and state changes. However, the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) does not validate or enforce event semantics, so logs can diverge from on-chain state, misleading off-chain systems into accepting incorrect state transitions. Existing smart contract vulnerability detection tools focus on logic bugs, with limited support for detecting event-semantic defects. To address this gap, we collect audit reports and incident cases and apply open card sorting to define five classes of event-semantic defects: event collision, state-event mismatch, unauthorized event emission, event emission mismatch, and event parameter mismatch. We propose EventSpec, which infers event specifications from a contract corpus via behavior inference and semantic-constraint extraction and applies differential checking to identify event-semantic defects in target contracts. We run EventSpec on 6,617 real-world contracts and evaluate detection effectiveness based on manually labeled results; EventSpec achieves an overall comprehensive precision of 90.17\%. We further provide an off-chain evaluation harness that reproduces two off-chain attack vectors on any EVM-compatible chain: event origin confusion caused by unintended emitters and event–state desynchronization where events lack matching state updates. Using this harness, we demonstrate the feasibility of these attacks on bridge relayers, blockchain explorers, and NFT marketplaces, and report six wallet issues, four of which were confirmed (including a $600 bounty), with two remaining pending.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 近年来，智能合约已成为去中心化应用（DApps）的支柱，而桥、钱包和索引器等链下系统严重依赖事件日志来跟踪合约执行和状态变化。然而，以太坊虚拟机（EVM）并不验证或强制执行事件语义，因此日志可能与链上状态不一致，从而误导链下系统接受不正确的状态转换。现有的智能合约漏洞检测工具侧重于逻辑错误，对检测事件语义缺陷的支持有限。为弥补这一空白，我们收集审计报告和事件案例，并应用开放式卡片分类来定义五类事件语义缺陷：事件冲突、状态-事件不匹配、未授权事件发出、事件发出不匹配和事件参数不匹配。我们提出EventSpec，它通过行为推断和语义约束提取从合约语料库中推断事件规范，并应用差分检查来识别目标合约中的事件语义缺陷。我们在6,617个真实世界合约上运行EventSpec，并基于人工标注结果评估检测效果；EventSpec的总体综合精确率达到90.17%。我们进一步提供一个链下评估框架，可在任何EVM兼容链上复现两种链下攻击向量：由非预期发出者引起的事件来源混淆，以及事件缺乏匹配状态更新的事件-状态不同步。使用该框架，我们演示了这些攻击在桥接中继器、区块链浏览器和NFT市场上的可行性，并报告了六个钱包问题，其中四个已确认（包括600美元赏金），两个待处理。

upstream_only.title: avaCGs: Version-Aware Call Graphs for Efficient Version-Range Queries
upstream_only.abstract: Developers employ version ranges to specify a range of valid versions for software libraries their projects depend on. While this can yield benefits like automatic adoption of library updates, it complicates method reachability analysis: a sound whole-program analysis must consider method invocations of every library release within that range. Such releases might themselves introduce transitive ranged dependencies to a project, leading to a combinatorial blow-up in the number of configurations to analyze.
