If developers wanted to soundly determine whether a critical method might be reachable via a ranged library dependency, they would have to build the individual call graphs for every release within that range, and perform reachability analysis on each one of them. As call-graph construction is an expensive operation, this approach is rarely practical. To enable direct version-range queries, we introduce artifact version-aware call graphs (avaCGs) that comprise call graph information about all versions of a software artifact in a single graph structure. Further, we propose a novel approach that incrementally computes call graphs based on Rapid Type Analysis (RTA), implement it for the JVM platform, and show that it yields identical results to full RTA call-graph builds. Our evaluation shows that on our benchmarks, avaCGs can improve the performance of reachability queries by up to 9.58x, while our incremental construction is up to 79\% faster compared to full builds for each release. We also observe that for real-world libraries hosted on Maven Central, almost 80\% of all releases do not change the RTA call graph compared to their previous release, further justifying the use of incremental approaches.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 开发者使用版本范围来指定其项目所依赖的软件库的一系列有效版本。虽然这可以带来诸如自动采用库更新等好处，但它使方法可达性分析变得复杂：一个可靠的全程序分析必须考虑该范围内每个库发行版的方法调用。这些发行版本身可能给项目引入传递性的范围依赖，导致需要分析的配置数量组合爆炸。如果开发者想要可靠地确定某个关键方法是否可能通过一个范围库依赖可达，他们必须为该范围内的每个发行版分别构建调用图，并对每个调用图执行可达性分析。由于调用图构建是一项昂贵的操作，这种方法很少实用。为了实现直接的版本范围查询，我们引入了工件版本感知调用图（avaCGs），它在单一图结构中包含关于某个软件工件所有版本的调用图信息。此外，我们提出了一种基于快速类型分析（RTA）增量计算调用图的新方法，在JVM平台上实现，并证明其产生与完整RTA调用图构建相同的结果。我们的评估表明，在我们的基准测试中，avaCGs可以将可达性查询的性能提升高达9.58倍，而我们增量构建与为每个发行版进行完整构建相比最高可快79%。我们还观察到，对于Maven Central上的真实世界库，几乎80%的发行版与上一发行版相比不改变RTA调用图，这进一步证明了使用增量方法的合理性。

upstream_only.title: What Makes In-Context Examples Effective for Code Generation?
upstream_only.abstract: In-Context Learning (ICL) has emerged as a promising solution to enhance the code generation capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) by incorporating code examples inside the prompt to let LLMs learn from demonstrations. However, despite their effectiveness gains, it remains unclear which specific properties of ICL-provided code examples (e.g., solution insight, essential contextual information, identifier naming styles, code formatting) drive these gains. This paper systematically investigates the impact of different sources and internal features of code examples on ICL for code generation through controlled experiments on contest-style programming questions and repository-level tasks. Our results show that while LLMs struggle to extract generalizable problem-solving insights from provided solutions to similar questions or repository snippets, their retrieval-augmented ICL performance can significantly benefit from explicit contextual information, such as input/output demonstrations, required helper functions, and namespace information. Through targeted mutation operators, we further find that identifier naming is substantially more critical than code formatting or low-level implementation details, with the elimination of descriptive variable names causing performance drops of up to 30 percentage points. Finally, we demonstrate that LLMs significantly prefer semantically meaningful identifier names and that adherence to surface-level naming conventions is far less important than semantic clarity. These findings provide practical guidelines for constructing effective ICL code examples and highlight challenges in reflection-based learning for code generation.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 上下文学习（ICL）已成为增强大型语言模型（LLMs）代码生成能力的一种有前景的解决方案，其方法是在提示中嵌入代码示例，让LLMs从演示中学习。然而，尽管取得了有效性提升，但ICL提供的代码示例的哪些具体属性（例如，解题思路、必要的上下文信息、标识符命名风格、代码格式）驱动了这些提升，仍不清楚。本文通过在竞赛式编程问题和仓库级任务上进行受控实验，系统性地研究了代码示例的不同来源和内部特征对代码生成中ICL的影响。我们的结果表明，虽然LLMs难以从相似问题或仓库片段提供的解决方案中提取可泛化的解题思路，但它们的检索增强ICL性能可以显著受益于显式的上下文信息，例如输入/输出演示、所需的辅助函数和命名空间信息。通过针对性的变异算子，我们进一步发现标识符命名比代码格式或底层实现细节重要得多，消除描述性变量名会导致性能下降高达30个百分点。最后，我们证明LLMs显著偏好语义上有意义的标识符名称，并且遵循表面命名约定远不如语义清晰重要。这些发现为构建有效的ICL代码示例提供了实践指南，并突显了基于反思的学习在代码生成中的挑战。

upstream_only.title: Code-MUE: Measuring Code LLMs’ Uncertainty through Execution-Based Semantic Interaction Graphs
upstream_only.abstract: As Code Large Language Models (LLMs) become central to modern software engineering, their inherent stochasticity poses significant real-world risks, where even minor errors can lead to severe functional, security, or safety consequences. Reliable automation, therefore, demands the ability to distinguish between confident, well-supported predictions and stochastic guessing. However, existing uncertainty estimation methods face a critical gap: white-box and grey-box techniques are often inapplicable to closed-source models, while standard black-box text metrics fail to capture the unique fragility of code, where syntactic variation does not necessarily imply semantic divergence. To bridge this syntax-semantics gap, we introduce Code-MUE, a purely black-box framework that measures uncertainty through execution-based Semantic Interaction Graphs. Unlike prior approaches that rely on superficial textual similarity, Code-MUE grounds uncertainty in observable runtime behavior and calculates the von Neumann entropy of the solution space to quantify global semantic diversity. A large-scale empirical study across eight state-of-the-art LLMs demonstrates that Code-MUE achieves a strong negative correlation with functional correctness, with Spearman’s correlation reaching up to −0.98. It significantly outperforms lexical and embedding-based baselines while enabling robust risk detection and selective prediction in practical workflows.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 随着代码大语言模型（LLMs）成为现代软件工程的核心，其固有的随机性带来了重大的现实风险，即使微小的错误也可能导致严重的功能、安全或安全性后果。因此，可靠的自动化需要能够区分自信且有充分支持的预测与随机猜测。然而，现有的不确定性估计方法面临一个关键缺口：白盒和灰盒技术往往不适用于闭源模型，而标准的黑盒文本指标无法捕捉代码特有的脆弱性，即句法变化并不一定意味着语义分歧。为弥合这一句法-语义鸿沟，我们提出Code-MUE，一个纯黑盒框架，通过基于执行的语义交互图来测量不确定性。与依赖表面文本相似性的先前方法不同，Code-MUE将不确定性建立在可观察的运行时行为之上，并计算解空间的冯·诺依曼熵以量化全局语义多样性。对八个最先进LLM的大规模实证研究表明，Code-MUE与功能正确性呈强负相关，Spearman相关系数最高达-0.98。它显著优于基于词汇和嵌入的基线，同时在实际工作流中实现稳健的风险检测和选择性预测。

upstream_only.title: RICE: Harnessing LLMs and Historical Issues to Discover Internal Rust Compiler Errors
upstream_only.abstract: Rust is a modern system-level programming language that emphasizes safety, concurrency, and performance. Ensuring the reliability of the Rust compiler is critical, as undetected compiler defects, particularly internal compiler errors (ICEs), can lead to runtime crashes or undefined behavior in system software. Existing compiler testing methods, including generation-based, mutation-based, and recent LLM-driven approaches, are limited in their ability to systematically uncover ICEs triggered by advanced language features or complex code interactions. In this paper, we propose RICE, an LLM-assisted Rust compiler testing framework that generates test cases by adapting defect-prone patterns extracted from historical ICE issues to diverse code contexts in the official test suite. RICE features simplification-guided identification of defect-prone patterns and context- aware adaptation of patterns to maintain compilability and meaningful semantic interactions. Applied to multiple recent Rust compiler releases, RICE discovered 37 ICEs, including 15 previously unknown zero-day bugs, outperforming existing testing tools in code coverage and ICE discovery. Our results demonstrate that systematically leveraging historical defect-prone patterns enables more effective testing, accelerates bug fixing, and enhances regression testing in Rust compilers
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Rust是一门现代系统级编程语言，强调安全性、并发性和性能。确保Rust编译器的可靠性至关重要，因为未被发现的编译器缺陷，特别是内部编译器错误（ICE），可能导致系统软件在运行时崩溃或出现未定义行为。现有的编译器测试方法，包括基于生成、基于变异以及近期由LLM驱动的方法，在系统性地发现由高级语言特性或复杂代码交互触发的ICE方面能力有限。本文提出RICE，一个LLM辅助的Rust编译器测试框架，它通过将从历史ICE问题中提取的易缺陷模式适配到官方测试套件中的多样代码上下文来生成测试用例。RICE具有简化引导的易缺陷模式识别和上下文感知的模式适配，以保持可编译性和有意义的语义交互。在多个近期Rust编译器版本上应用后，RICE发现了37个ICE，其中包括15个此前未知的零日缺陷，在代码覆盖率和ICE发现方面优于现有测试工具。我们的结果表明，系统性地利用历史易缺陷模式能够实现更有效的测试，加速错误修复，并增强Rust编译器的回归测试。

upstream_only.title: Efficient Predictive Monitoring of Message Passing Interface Programs
upstream_only.abstract: The Message Passing Interface (MPI) is the standard programming model for high-performance computing, yet nondeterministic scheduling in concurrent executions makes reliability assurance highly challenging. Beyond deadlocks, property-related bugs such as modifying a send buffer before a nonblocking send completes or accessing a freed RMA window are often hard to reproduce and validate, as they typically manifest only under rare event interleavings and can be both latent and catastrophic. Existing dynamic checkers usually cover only the observed schedule of a single execution; dynamic verification largely focuses on deadlocks; and static techniques scale poorly to medium-to-large programs, often timing out or running out of memory. Overall, existing techniques do not support scalable analysis of temporal properties in large MPI programs. To address these limitations, we propose the first efficient predictive monitoring approach for temporal properties in MPI programs. From a single execution, we collect an event trace and use trace equivalence to predict the set of legal equivalent executions under the same input. We then check whether any predicted execution satisfies the target property. To make this process sound, we formalize three correctness criteria for MPI trace reordering and enforce them through MPI-semantics-driven dependency extraction, tracked with vector clocks. To improve efficiency, we exploit the bounded length of a pattern language and reduce long-trace reordering to reordering short patterns. We implement our approach in MPI-PRV, instantiate ten representative MPI bug properties, and evaluate it on 13 real-world MPI applications with 38 configurations. MPI-PRV successfully and correctly analyzes all 38 tasks, whereas MPI-SV and MUST analyze only 14 and 11 tasks, respectively. MPI-PRV also achieves orders-of-magnitude reductions in runtime and memory usage, demonstrating strong efficiency and scalability for large MPI programs.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 消息传递接口（MPI）是高性能计算的标准编程模型，但并发执行中的非确定性调度使得可靠性保证极具挑战性。除了死锁之外，与性质相关的错误——例如在非阻塞发送完成之前修改发送缓冲区，或访问已释放的RMA窗口——通常难以复现和验证，因为它们通常只在罕见的事件交错下出现，并且可能既是潜在的又是灾难性的。现有的动态检查器通常只覆盖单次执行中观察到的调度；动态验证主要关注死锁；而静态技术难以扩展到中大型程序，常常超时或内存不足。总体而言，现有技术不支持对大型MPI程序中的时序性质进行可扩展分析。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了首个针对MPI程序中时序性质的高效预测性监控方法。我们从单次执行中收集事件迹，并利用迹等价来预测相同输入下合法的等价执行集合。然后我们检查任何预测执行是否满足目标性质。为了使该过程可靠，我们形式化了MPI迹重排序的三个正确性准则，并通过MPI语义驱动的依赖提取来强制执行它们，使用向量时钟进行跟踪。为了提高效率，我们利用了模式语言的有界长度，并将长迹重排序归约为短模式重排序。我们在MPI-PRV中实现了我们的方法，实例化了十个代表性的MPI错误性质，并在13个真实世界MPI应用（38种配置）上进行了评估。MPI-PRV成功且正确地分析了全部38个任务，而MPI-SV和MUST分别只分析了14个和11个任务。MPI-PRV还实现了运行时和内存使用数量级的减少，展示了针对大型MPI程序的强大效率和可扩展性。

upstream_only.title: Contamination Means Overestimation? A Fine-Grained Empirical Study in Code Intelligence
upstream_only.abstract: In recent years, code intelligence has gained increasing importance in the field of automated software engineering. Meanwhile, the widespread adoption of Pretrained Language Models (PLMs) and Large Language Models (LLMs) has raised concerns regarding data contamination and its potential impact on model performance evaluation. Previous studies mainly focused on sample-level contamination, ignoring partial contamination scenarios that are pervasive in code intelligence. This paper fills this gap and presents a systematic empirical study to investigate the fine-grained data contamination on mainstream code tasks. Our study involves diverse representative PLMs: RoBERTa and GPT-2, and LLMs: LLaMA and StarCoder, covering three major tasks: code translation, code generation, and code summarization, across two Programming Languages (PLs): Java and Python. We categorize contamination scenarios into four types according to the code intelligence practice, namely input-only, output-only, unpaired, and paired contamination settings, and construct corresponding experimental and control groups for exploration. Experimental results show that, under the pre-training, fine-tuning, and inference paradigm adopted by PLMs, even deliberately injecting paired contamination does not lead to significant performance overestimation. But direct inference or small-scale fine-tuning uncovers the contamination effects. In contrast, LLMs with pre-training and inference paradigm are significantly affected by the paired contamination. Apart from the above, other contamination scenarios have no impact on both PLMs and LLMs. Our findings challenge the conventional belief that contamination inevitably leads to performance overestimation, providing new insights into the evaluation and deployment of code intelligence models.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 近年来，代码智能在自动化软件工程领域日益重要。与此同时，预训练语言模型（PLMs）和大语言模型（LLMs）的广泛采用引发了人们对数据污染及其对模型性能评估潜在影响的担忧。以往研究主要关注样本级污染，忽略了代码智能中普遍存在的部分污染场景。本文填补这一空白，开展了一项系统性实证研究，以探究主流代码任务中的细粒度数据污染。我们的研究涉及多种代表性PLMs：RoBERTa和GPT-2，以及LLMs：LLaMA和StarCoder，涵盖三项主要任务：代码翻译、代码生成和代码摘要，覆盖两种编程语言（PLs）：Java和Python。我们根据代码智能实践将污染场景分为四类，即仅输入、仅输出、未配对和配对污染设置，并构建相应的实验组和对照组进行探索。实验结果表明，在PLMs采用的预训练、微调和推理范式下，即使故意注入配对污染也不会导致显著的性能高估。但直接推理或小规模微调会揭示污染效应。相反，采用预训练和推理范式的LLMs则受到配对污染的显著影响。除此之外，其他污染场景对PLMs和LLMs均无影响。我们的发现挑战了污染必然导致性能高估的传统观念，为代码智能模型的评估和部署提供了新见解。

upstream_only.title: A Closer Look at the Use of Reinforcement Learning for Speeding Up Runtime Verification of Software Tests (Experience Paper)
upstream_only.abstract: Runtime verification (RV) found many bugs by monitoring passing tests against formal specifications (specs), but it is slow. A recent work, Valg, used reinforcement learning (RL) to speed up RV by up to 551.5x or 27 hours. Valg aims to probabilistically monitor most unique traces—sequences of spec-related events like method calls—and monitor fewer redundant ones. But, there is no in-depth study of Valg’s current limits and how to address them. We study Valg on 93 Java open-source projects to answer five unaddressed questions. (i) How much slower is Valg than optimal baselines? Up to 323.8x, or 3.2 hours vs. running tests without RV, and up to 9.6x, or 25.3 minutes vs. a theoretically optimal baseline that monitors only unique traces. (ii) Where is Valg’s time spent? 30.5\% on monitoring and 18.4\% on signaling events to monitors, on average. (iii) What characterizes code where Valg monitors too many redundant traces or misses unique ones? In 100 cases, 67.8\% of redundant traces are due to limitations of Valg’s RL convergence heuristic, and 41.3\% of missed unique traces occur when a Valg assumption does not hold. (iv) How much can test non-determinism and RL stochasticity cause monitored unique traces to vary? By 42.5 percentage points (pp) and 12.3pp on average, respectively, but they vary by up to 98pp. (v) How do other off-the-shelf RL algorithms compare with Valg’s? Only two of 11 RL algorithms that we survey are feasible for RV during continuous integration. Both are slower and miss more unique traces than Valg, so custom RL algorithms for RV may be needed. So, despite Valg’s promising results, it has plenty of room to improve. We highlight several exciting future directions on using RL to speed up RV.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 运行时验证（RV）通过根据形式化规约（specs）监控通过的测试发现了许多缺陷，但速度很慢。最近的一项工作 Valg 使用强化学习（RL）将 RV 加速了最高 551.5 倍或 27 小时。Valg 旨在以概率方式监控大多数唯一迹（与规约相关的事件序列，如方法调用），并减少对冗余迹的监控。但是，目前尚无对 Valg 当前局限及如何解决这些局限的深入研究。我们在 93 个 Java 开源项目上研究 Valg，以回答五个未解决的问题。(i) Valg 比最优基线慢多少？最高慢 323.8 倍（3.2 小时 vs. 不进行 RV 运行测试），比仅监控唯一迹的理论最优基线最高慢 9.6 倍（25.3 分钟）。(ii) Valg 的时间花在哪里？平均 30.5% 用于监控，18.4% 用于向监控器发送事件信号。(iii) 在哪些代码中 Valg 监控了过多冗余迹或遗漏唯一迹？在 100 个案例中，67.8% 的冗余迹源于 Valg 的 RL 收敛启发式的局限，41.3% 的遗漏唯一迹发生在 Valg 的某个假设不成立时。(iv) 测试非确定性和 RL 随机性可导致监控的唯一迹变化多少？平均分别变化 42.5 个百分点（pp）和 12.3 个百分点，但最多可变化 98 个百分点。(v) 其他现成 RL 算法与 Valg 相比如何？我们调查的 11 种 RL 算法中只有两种适用于持续集成中的 RV。两者都比 Valg 更慢且遗漏更多唯一迹，因此可能需要为 RV 定制 RL 算法。因此，尽管 Valg 的结果很有前景，但它仍有很大的改进空间。我们指出了使用 RL 加速 RV 的几个令人兴奋的未来方向。

upstream_only.title: WITFuzz: Validity-Preserving Greybox Fuzzing for WebAssembly Interface Type Binding Generators
upstream_only.abstract: Modern build pipelines often rely on code generation to turn constraint-rich interface specifications into artifacts for target programming languages. In the WebAssembly component model, binding generators (bindgens) follow this pattern by translating WebAssembly Interface Types (WIT) packages into language-specific bindings that are later compiled with application code. This bindgen step already targets more than ten language ecosystems, and the Rust wit-bindgen crate alone has accumulated tens of millions of downloads. Yet a WIT package may pass WIT validation but still break this build pipeline: bindgens may crash or hang during generation (Phase I), or downstream toolchains may reject the generated bindings even when generation succeeds (Phase II). Testing bindgens at scale is challenging because WIT is strongly typed and constraint-rich, and Phase II failures require language-specific checking. We present WITFuzz, a validity-preserving greybox fuzzer for WIT bindgens. WITFuzz mutates resolved WIT abstract syntax trees via structure-aware rewrites expressed in a small domain-specific language, and propagates correlated updates to maintain WIT validity. When coverage plateaus, WITFuzz expands its strategy pool online using coverage-guided, LLM-assisted DSL synthesis, admitting only strategies that pass local validation. WITFuzz further uses a build-aware, multi-layer oracle that combines in-loop checks with selective asynchronous compilation/typechecking of generated bindings to capture non-crashing build breakers. Across 12 bindgens, WITFuzz improves average edge coverage by 8.3\% over standalone wit-smith. It uncovers 40 previously unknown Phase I and Phase II build-breaking bugs, including 35 that are missed by all external baselines.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代构建流水线常依赖代码生成，将约束丰富的接口规范转换为目标编程语言的工件。在WebAssembly组件模型中，绑定生成器（bindgen）遵循这一模式，将WebAssembly接口类型（WIT）包转换为特定语言的绑定，随后与应用程序代码一起编译。这一bindgen步骤已经面向十多个语言生态系统，仅Rust的wit-bindgen crate就累计了数千万次下载。然而，一个WIT包可能通过WIT验证，却仍然破坏这一构建流水线：bindgen可能在生成期间崩溃或挂起（第一阶段），或者即使生成成功，下游工具链也可能拒绝生成的绑定（第二阶段）。大规模测试bindgen具有挑战性，因为WIT是强类型且约束丰富的，而第二阶段失败需要特定语言的检查。我们提出WITFuzz，一种面向WIT bindgen的保有效性灰盒模糊测试器。WITFuzz通过以小领域特定语言表达的结构感知重写来变异已解析的WIT抽象语法树，并传播相关更新以保持WIT有效性。当覆盖率进入平台期时，WITFuzz使用覆盖率引导、LLM辅助的DSL合成在线扩展其策略池，仅接纳通过本地验证的策略。WITFuzz进一步使用构建感知的多层预言机，将循环内检查与对生成绑定的选择性异步编译/类型检查相结合，以捕获非崩溃的构建破坏。在12个bindgen上，WITFuzz相比独立的wit-smith将平均边覆盖率提高8.3%。它发现了40个此前未知的第一阶段和第二阶段构建破坏性缺陷，其中35个被所有外部基线遗漏。

upstream_only.title: On the Evaluation of Large Language Models in Unit Test Evolution (Experience Paper)
upstream_only.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown promising potential in automating unit test evolution for evolving software systems. However, the effectiveness of LLMs in unit test evolution remains insufficiently understood, particularly with respect to prompt design choices, in-context learning (ICL) strategies, and different types of test evolution. In this paper, we present the first comprehensive empirical study to evaluate LLMs for unit test evolution. We systematically assess nine open-source code LLMs (3B to 34B parameters) and three state-of-the-art commercial models across diverse prompt designs, ICL strategies, and representative test evolution frameworks. To support robust and execution-based evaluation, we construct a new benchmark consisting of 530 real-world focal method–test co-evolution instances collected from seven actively maintained open-source projects. Our evaluation employs a suite of compilation, execution, and coverage-based metrics. Extensive experimental results reveal that prompt design and ICL methods significantly impact LLM effectiveness. Furthermore, the optimal configurations of these strategies vary substantially across different LLMs and evolution types. Based on our findings, we derive actionable insights to guide future research and practical adoption of LLM-based techniques for unit test evolution.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）最近在自动化演化软件系统的单元测试方面展现出潜力。然而，LLM在单元测试演化中的有效性仍未被充分理解，尤其是在提示设计选择、上下文学习（ICL）策略以及不同类型测试演化方面。在本文中，我们提出了首个全面的实证研究，以评估LLM用于单元测试演化的效果。我们系统评估了九个开源代码LLM（3B至34B参数）和三个最先进的商业模型，涵盖了不同的提示设计、ICL策略和代表性测试演化框架。为了支持稳健且基于执行的评估，我们构建了一个新基准，包含从七个活跃维护的开源项目中收集的530个真实世界焦点方法-测试协同演化实例。我们的评估采用了一套编译、执行和覆盖率指标。大量实验结果表明，提示设计和ICL方法显著影响LLM的有效性。此外，这些策略的最优配置在不同LLM和演化类型之间差异很大。基于我们的发现，我们得出了可操作的见解，以指导未来研究和LLM-based单元测试演化技术的实际采用。

upstream_only.title: STARS: Static Analysis-Guided Assertion Synthesis using Large Language Models
upstream_only.abstract: Automated unit test generation promises to reduce the cost of software quality assurance, and hence, is attracting attention from both academia and industry. Yet, generating assertions that are executable, meaningful to developers, and able to catch faults remains an unsolved challenge. Existing approaches either randomly enumerate assertions that are plausible based on static program analysis without considering whether they naturally fit the test prefix or query an LLM to generate assertions based on local context only, such as the test prefix and the focal method. However, we observe that local context alone is insufficient for LLMs to generate high-quality assertions because many desirable assertions are built from components that are almost impossible to guess for an LLM, such as sequences of multiple method calls. This paper presents STARS, a novel test assertion generation technique that combines the benefits of static program analysis and LLM-based synthesis. The key idea is to first gather a set of assertion components based on static program analysis and to then combine, concretize, prioritize, and improve them with an LLM. The resulting assertions go beyond what an LLM alone could realistically guess based on the test prefix and focal method, and they naturally fit the given test case. Empirical results show that STARS consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art baseline in five evaluation metrics. STARS achieves an exact-match rate of at most 83.4\% using GPT-5.4. Compared with the baseline, STARS’s mutation score nearly triples that of the baseline (10.97\% vs. 3.97\%), approaching that of developer-written assertions, while consuming 24.75\% fewer tokens and 30.6\% fewer LLM queries.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 自动化单元测试生成有望降低软件质量保证的成本，因此吸引了学术界和工业界的关注。然而，生成可执行、对开发者有意义且能够捕获故障的断言仍然是一个未解决的挑战。现有方法要么基于静态程序分析随机枚举看似合理的断言，而不考虑它们是否自然地适合测试前缀；要么仅基于局部上下文（如测试前缀和焦点方法）查询大语言模型（LLM）来生成断言。然而，我们观察到仅凭局部上下文不足以让LLM生成高质量断言，因为许多理想的断言是由LLM几乎不可能猜测到的组件构建的，例如多个方法调用的序列。本文提出了STARS，一种新颖的测试断言生成技术，它结合了静态程序分析和基于LLM的合成的优势。其核心思想是首先基于静态程序分析收集一组断言组件，然后利用LLM对它们进行组合、具体化、排序和改进。由此生成的断言超越了仅凭测试前缀和焦点方法LLM能够现实猜测的范围，并且自然地适合给定的测试用例。实证结果表明，STARS在五个评估指标上始终优于最先进的基线。使用GPT-5.4时，STARS的精确匹配率最高可达83.4%。与基线相比，STARS的变异得分几乎是基线的三倍（10.97%对3.97%），接近开发者编写的断言，同时消耗的token减少24.75%，LLM查询减少30.6%。

upstream_only.title: AdaptAgent: A Multi-agent, Domain-Guided Reasoning Framework for Code Adaptation
upstream_only.abstract: Developers often need to adapt into their projects the code generated from LLMs or code snippets from online forums. However, integrating them into an existing repository remains challenging in a manual process. A successful integration typically requires more than copying code as a user must produce correct adapting changes at a designated location in the target repository. We formalize this as the code adaptation problem: given a snippet, functional intent, a target repository, and an adaptation location, generate a patch that adapts the snippet into the repository. We present AdaptAgent, a multi-agent, domain-guided reasoning framework for code adaptation. Rather than relying on single-shot prompting, AdaptAgent decomposes adaptation into specialized agents that communicate via typed artifacts: an Intent Summarizer extracts adaptation goals from Q&A text; a Policy Agent derives domain policies from six adaptation categories; a Domain Planner generates a self-ordered plan; a Context Miner distills sibling-method semantics from the target codebase; and a Code Adapter realizes the plan as a minimal unified diff, iteratively refined using a compiler-based Verifier. This division of labor enables robust, policy-aligned adaptations and supports adapting code snippets into a project. On a real-world dataset, AdaptAgent outperforms strong baselines in semantic correctness and produces patches that mirror developers’ actual adaptation patterns. Our ablation study shows each agent’s necessity, especially planning for code-hardening and exception-handling, and intent for logic customization.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 开发者常常需要将LLM生成的代码或来自在线论坛的代码片段适配到他们的项目中。然而，将其集成到现有代码仓库中仍然是一个具有挑战性的手动过程。成功的集成通常不仅仅是复制代码，因为用户必须在目标仓库的指定位置生成正确的适配变更。我们将其形式化为代码适配问题：给定一个代码片段、功能意图、目标仓库和适配位置，生成一个将该片段适配到仓库中的补丁。我们提出了AdaptAgent，一个用于代码适配的多智能体、领域引导推理框架。AdaptAgent不依赖单次提示，而是将适配分解为通过类型化工件进行通信的专用智能体：意图摘要器从问答文本中提取适配目标；策略智能体从六种适配类别中推导领域策略；领域规划器生成自排序计划；上下文挖掘器从目标代码库中提炼兄弟方法语义；代码适配器将计划实现为最小统一差异补丁，并使用基于编译器的验证器进行迭代精化。这种分工实现了稳健的、策略对齐的适配，并支持将代码片段适配到项目中。在真实数据集上，AdaptAgent在语义正确性方面优于强基线，并产生与开发者实际适配模式相符的补丁。我们的消融研究表明每个智能体的必要性，尤其是规划对于代码加固和异常处理，以及意图对于逻辑定制。

upstream_only.title: Understanding Automated Program Repair Agents through the Lens of Traceability: An Empirical Study
upstream_only.abstract: Automated Program Repair (APR) agents leverage large language models (LLMs) to autonomously diagnose and patch software bugs using planning, reasoning, and tools. Although these agents show strong performance on leaderboards such as SWE-bench, little is understood about how they take actions, where they fail, and how their behavior compares to human developers. In this paper, we present the first systematic analysis of these limitations using 5 state-of-the-art APR agents. We trace the full decision-making pipelines of the 5 APR agents across 500 real-world repair tasks, from issue description to patch validation. Our study reveals that, while agents excel at simple fixes, they struggle with logic-intensive bugs, often generating verbose, overfitted patches that pass existing test suites without solving the root cause. Test generation and regression test selection remain major bottlenecks, as agents fail to reproduce issues or run relevant regression tests. Moreover, many agents operate with primitive tooling (e.g. bash scripts) and do not have access to debuggers or program analysis tools. These findings highlight key limitations of current APR systems and motivate several directions for next-generation APR design, including but not limited to: (1) a shift-left approach emphasizing early, high-quality test generation and validation to reduce spurious fixes and improve semantic correctness; (2) richer, more integrated tool ecosystems; (3) diversified agent architectures that combine complementary strengths; and (4) benchmarks that prioritize semantic repair quality and test-generation fidelity over surface-level success metrics.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 自动化程序修复（APR）代理利用大型语言模型（LLM），通过规划、推理和工具来自主诊断和修补软件缺陷。尽管这些代理在SWE-bench等排行榜上表现出色，但人们对它们如何采取行动、在何处失败以及其行为与人类开发者相比如何知之甚少。在本文中，我们使用5种最先进的APR代理对这些局限性进行了首次系统分析。我们追踪了5种APR代理在500个真实世界修复任务中的完整决策流程，从问题描述到补丁验证。我们的研究揭示，虽然代理在简单修复上表现出色，但它们在逻辑密集型缺陷上表现不佳，常常生成冗长、过拟合的补丁，这些补丁能通过现有测试套件而未解决根本原因。测试生成和回归测试选择仍然是主要瓶颈，因为代理无法重现问题或运行相关的回归测试。此外，许多代理使用原始工具（例如bash脚本），并且无法访问调试器或程序分析工具。这些发现凸显了当前APR系统的关键局限性，并激发了下一代APR设计的若干方向，包括但不限于：（1）左移方法，强调早期、高质量的测试生成和验证，以减少虚假修复并提高语义正确性；（2）更丰富、更集成的工具生态系统；（3）结合互补优势的多样化代理架构；（4）优先考虑语义修复质量和测试生成保真度而非表面成功指标的基准。

upstream_only.title: CONCUR: Benchmarking LLMs for Concurrent Code Generation
upstream_only.abstract: Leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) for code generation has increasingly emerged as a common practice in the domain of software engineering. Relevant benchmarks have been established to evaluate the code generation capabilities of LLMs. However, existing benchmarks focus primarily on sequential code, lacking the ability to effectively evaluate LLMs on concurrent code generation. Compared to sequential code, concurrent code exhibits greater complexity and possesses unique types of bugs, such as deadlocks and race conditions, that do not occur in sequential code. Therefore, a benchmark for evaluating sequential code generation cannot be useful for evaluating concurrent code generation with LLMs. To address this gap, we designed a benchmark CONCUR specifically aimed at evaluating the capability of LLMs to generate concurrent code. CONCUR consists of a base set of 43 concurrency problems derived from a standard concurrency textbook, together with 72 validated mutant variants, resulting in 115 total problems. The base problems serve as the semantic core of the benchmark, while the mutants expand linguistic and structural diversity. We conducted an evaluation of a range of LLMs on CONCUR, highlighting limitations of current models. Overall, our work provides a novel direction for evaluating the capability of LLMs to generate code with focus on concurrency.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 利用大型语言模型（LLMs）进行代码生成在软件工程领域已日益成为一种常见做法。已有相关基准用于评估LLMs的代码生成能力。然而，现有基准主要关注顺序代码，缺乏有效评估LLMs并发代码生成的能力。与顺序代码相比，并发代码具有更大的复杂性，并具有顺序代码中不会出现的独特缺陷类型，如死锁和竞态条件。因此，用于评估顺序代码生成的基准无法用于评估LLMs的并发代码生成。为弥补这一空白，我们设计了一个专门用于评估LLMs生成并发代码能力的基准CONCUR。CONCUR由源自标准并发教材的43个基础并发问题组成，加上72个经过验证的变异变体，共计115个问题。基础问题作为基准的语义核心，而变异体则扩展了语言和结构多样性。我们在CONCUR上评估了一系列LLMs，并突出了当前模型的局限性。总体而言，我们的工作为评估LLMs生成代码的能力提供了一个新方向，重点关注并发性。

upstream_only.title: PatchPorter: LLM-Driven Security Patch Porting via Version Tracing and Context Selection for NPM
upstream_only.abstract: Third-Party Libraries are widely used in modern software development, yet their vulnerabilities pose serious security risks. This issue is particularly severe in the NPM ecosystem, where high-risk 1-day vulnerabilities can remain unpatched for extended periods. Although upgrading to the latest patched version is commonly recommended, it often causes major compatibility issues. Patch porting offers an effective solution to this challenge. However, existing patch porting methods are mainly designed for C and have two limitations when applied to NPM. First, they can be brittle in precisely localizing fix locations when substantial semantic gaps exist across versions. Second, they rely on either excessive or insufficient context for patch adaptation, which may introduce redundant information and increase the risk of hallucination. This paper introduces PatchPorter, a method for single-branch security patch porting in NPM that builds on Large Language Models (LLMs). PatchPorter addresses these limitations through two modules. The localization module leverages LLM semantic understanding and code evolution analysis over version histories maintained by version control systems to identify fix locations. The context selection module analyzes patch dependencies to select minimal yet sufficient context around the localized fix location. The selected context is used as input for the LLM to generate the patch. We construct a dataset of 112 NPM vulnerabilities with Proof- of-Concepts for dynamic validation. Experimental results show that PatchPorter significantly surpasses other methods in accuracy, achieving a 26.23\% improvement over the best-performing baseline and a 70.59\% increase on the most difficult tasks. Its ability to handle various vulnerability types highlights its practical value. Additional results confirm that both of its main modules also outperform alternative approaches.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 第三方库在现代软件开发中被广泛使用，然而其漏洞带来了严重的安全风险。这个问题在NPM生态系统中尤为严重，高风险1-day漏洞可能长期未修复。尽管通常建议升级到最新修复版本，但这往往会导致重大兼容性问题。补丁移植为这一挑战提供了有效解决方案。然而，现有补丁移植方法主要针对C语言设计，应用于NPM时存在两个局限。首先，当版本间存在显著语义差异时，它们在精确定位修复位置方面可能很脆弱。其次，它们依赖过多或不足的上下文进行补丁适配，可能引入冗余信息并增加幻觉风险。本文介绍PatchPorter，一种面向NPM单分支安全补丁移植、基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法。PatchPorter通过两个模块解决这些局限。定位模块利用LLM语义理解以及对版本控制系统维护的版本历史的代码演化分析来识别修复位置。上下文选择模块分析补丁依赖关系，以选择局部修复位置周围最小但充分的上下文。所选上下文作为LLM生成补丁的输入。我们构建了包含112个NPM漏洞的数据集，并带有用于动态验证的概念验证。实验结果表明，PatchPorter在准确性上显著超越其他方法，比最佳基线提高26.23%，在最困难任务上提高70.59%。其处理各种漏洞类型的能力凸显了实用价值。额外结果证实，其两个主要模块也优于替代方法。

upstream_only.title: AsyncLeakBench: A Curated Benchmark of Asynchronous Resource Leaks in Open-Source Java Projects
upstream_only.abstract: Asynchronous programming is widely used in modern Java software, including server-side processing, network I/O, reactive streams, task scheduling, and RPC communication. Unlike synchronous executions, resource creation and release in asynchronous programs are distributed across callbacks, Future/Promise chains, threads, and scheduler boundaries. Consequently, resource lifecycles may depend on execution ordering, races, cancellation, and timeouts, making resource leaks a significant source of performance degradation and reliability failures. Prior research and public datasets have largely focused on synchronous resource leaks, which typically involve missing close calls or unhandled exceptional paths within a single call stack. In asynchronous environments, however, resource release may depend on callback execution, Future completion, and scheduler decisions, and the release path may change under cancellation, timeouts, or reordered execution. Existing datasets therefore do not adequately capture the triggering conditions and repair strategies of asynchronous resource leaks, limiting the systematic evaluation of detection and automated repair techniques. To address this gap, we present AsyncLeakBench, a public benchmark of real-world asynchronous resource leak defects fixed in open-source Java projects. Using a semi-automatic mining workflow, we collected 16,242 candidate defect–patch pairs from 31 open-source Java projects. Through iterative filtering, duplicate removal, async-specific validation, and manual inspection of resource lifecycles and patches, we identified 902 high-confidence defect–patch pairs. We further classify these cases into 11 categories that characterize major triggers and repair strategies involving cancellation, timeouts, scheduler boundaries, and other asynchronous events. An initial evaluation of existing resource leak detectors reveals limited effectiveness, particularly for leaks triggered by cancellation and timeouts. AsyncLeakBench provides a realistic and reproducible basis for evaluating resource leak detection and repair, static and dynamic analysis, fault localization, and LLM-based debugging. By characterizing asynchronous resource leaks as a distinct defect class and providing a standardized benchmark, this work enables systematic research on their detection, localization, and repair.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 异步编程在现代Java软件中被广泛使用，包括服务器端处理、网络I/O、响应式流、任务调度和RPC通信。与同步执行不同，异步程序中的资源创建和释放分布在回调、Future/Promise链、线程和调度器边界之间。因此，资源生命周期可能取决于执行顺序、竞争、取消和超时，使得资源泄漏成为性能下降和可靠性故障的重要来源。先前的研究和公开数据集主要关注同步资源泄漏，通常涉及单个调用栈内缺失的close调用或未处理的异常路径。然而，在异步环境中，资源释放可能取决于回调执行、Future完成和调度器决策，并且释放路径可能在取消、超时或重排序执行下发生变化。因此，现有数据集不足以捕捉异步资源泄漏的触发条件和修复策略，限制了检测和自动修复技术的系统评估。为填补这一空白，我们提出AsyncLeakBench，一个公开的基准，包含在开源Java项目中修复的真实世界异步资源泄漏缺陷。使用半自动挖掘工作流，我们从31个开源Java项目中收集了16,242个候选缺陷-补丁对。通过迭代过滤、重复删除、异步特定验证以及对资源生命周期和补丁的手动检查，我们识别出902个高置信度缺陷-补丁对。我们进一步将这些案例分为11个类别，刻画涉及取消、超时、调度器边界和其他异步事件的主要触发因素和修复策略。对现有资源泄漏检测器的初步评估显示其效果有限，特别是对于由取消和超时触发的泄漏。AsyncLeakBench为评估资源泄漏检测与修复、静态和动态分析、故障定位以及基于LLM的调试提供了现实且可复现的基础。通过将异步资源泄漏描述为一个独特的缺陷类别并提供标准化基准，这项工作使得对其检测、定位和修复的系统研究成为可能。

upstream_only.title: Systematically Cover SQL Syntactic Structures via 𝑘-Sequence
upstream_only.abstract: Testing Relational Database Management Systems (RDBMSs) is inherently challenging because SQL, the primary language for interacting with RDBMSs, exhibits a vast and highly complex grammar with hundreds of interdependent production rules in the Extended Backus--Naur Form. While existing grammar-based testing techniques have made progress in covering SQL syntactic structures, they predominantly focus on parent-child relationships in derivation paths, which capture vertical expansions from a non-terminal to its alternatives. However, they overlook an equally critical dimension, sibling-like relationships, which capture co-occurring alternatives across derivation paths. This oversight results in insufficient coverage of intricate syntactic interactions that may trigger unique behaviors or latent bugs in RDBMSs. In this work, we propose k-sequence, a novel coverage criterion that characterizes syntactic structures as ordered sequences of k alternatives encountered during derivation. By simultaneously capturing both vertical parent-child and horizontal sibling-like relationships in the SQL syntactic structures, k-sequence provides a unified framework for comprehensive SQL syntactic coverage. Based on this criterion, we develop KSeqFuzz, a directed fuzzing approach that systematically generates SQL statements to explore previously unseen k-sequences, achieving deeper and broader testing coverage. We implement and evaluate KSeqFuzz on four widely-deployed RDBMSs, i.e., MySQL, MariaDB, TiDB, and OceanBase. In total, KSeqFuzz detects 58 new unique bugs, including 6 critical crashes. Evaluation results demonstrate that KSeqFuzz outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, detecting 26\% more unique bugs during 24-hour testing campaigns.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 测试关系数据库管理系统（RDBMS）本身就具有挑战性，因为SQL作为与RDBMS交互的主要语言，具有庞大且高度复杂的语法，在扩展巴科斯范式（EBNF）中包含数百条相互依赖的产生式规则。尽管现有的基于语法的测试技术在覆盖SQL语法结构方面已取得进展，但它们主要关注推导路径中的父子关系，这些关系捕获从非终结符到其备选项的垂直扩展。然而，它们忽略了一个同样关键的维度，即类兄弟关系，这种关系捕获跨推导路径共同出现的备选项。这一疏忽导致对复杂语法交互的覆盖不足，而这些交互可能触发RDBMS中的独特行为或潜在缺陷。在这项工作中，我们提出k-sequence，一种新颖的覆盖准则，它将语法结构刻画为推导过程中遇到的k个备选项的有序序列。通过同时捕获SQL语法结构中的垂直父子关系和水平类兄弟关系，k-sequence为全面的SQL语法覆盖提供了一个统一框架。基于该准则，我们开发了KSeqFuzz，一种定向模糊测试方法，它系统化地生成SQL语句以探索以前未见的k-sequence，从而实现更深更广的测试覆盖。我们在四个广泛部署的RDBMS（即MySQL、MariaDB、TiDB和OceanBase）上实现并评估了KSeqFuzz。总共，KSeqFuzz检测到58个新的独特缺陷，其中包括6个严重崩溃。评估结果表明，KSeqFuzz优于最先进的基线，在24小时测试活动中检测到多26%的独特缺陷。

upstream_only.title: IssueExec: A Test-Driven Approach for Localizing Software Engineering Issues
upstream_only.abstract: Issue localization, which identifies code locations requiring modification from issue descriptions, is a critical step in automated software maintenance. Existing approaches predominantly attempt to directly align issue descriptions with code elements, yet often struggle due to the inherent abstraction gap between the issue description and code implementation. Seeking alternative signals, our theoretical analysis suggests that test suites can serve as executable proxies for requirements, reducing localization uncertainty by 7.73 bits of entropy on average. A large-scale empirical study on 18 repositories validates this premise: existing tests cover 96.98\% of ground-truth files, and the two-hop pathway yields stronger semantic connectivity than direct matching in 82.4\% of cases. Despite their potential, leveraging tests for localization faces two key challenges: the semantic gap separating issue descriptions from test identifiers, and the substantial noise in execution traces from infrastructure code. To address these, we propose IssueExec, which bridges the semantic gap through domain-knowledge-enhanced test representations and filters noise via hierarchical trace analysis. Experiments on SWE-bench Lite show that IssueExec achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving function-level Recall@1 by 41.57\% over the strongest baseline. When integrated into the Agentless pipeline, IssueExec resolves 17.72\% more issues, demonstrating practical downstream benefits.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 问题定位，即从问题描述中识别需要修改的代码位置，是自动化软件维护中的关键步骤。现有方法主要尝试直接将问题描述与代码元素对齐，但由于问题描述与代码实现之间存在固有的抽象鸿沟，往往难以奏效。为寻求替代信号，我们的理论分析表明，测试套件可以作为需求的可执行代理，平均将定位不确定性降低7.73比特的熵。对18个代码仓库的大规模实证研究验证了这一前提：现有测试覆盖了96.98%的真实文件，并且在82.4%的情况下，两跳路径比直接匹配产生更强的语义连通性。尽管具有潜力，利用测试进行定位仍面临两个关键挑战：问题描述与测试标识符之间的语义鸿沟，以及来自基础设施代码的执行轨迹中的大量噪声。为解决这些问题，我们提出IssueExec，它通过领域知识增强的测试表示来弥合语义鸿沟，并通过分层轨迹分析过滤噪声。在SWE-bench Lite上的实验表明，IssueExec达到了最先进的性能，在函数级Recall@1上比最强基线提高了41.57%。当集成到Agentless流水线中时，IssueExec多解决了17.72%的问题，展示了实际的下游收益。

upstream_only.title: Mathematically-Guided Detection of Floating-Point Errors
upstream_only.abstract: Floating-point computations are important for modern scientific and engineering software, especially for safety-critical systems, yet only a small subset of inputs typically trigger substantial numerical errors. Detecting such error-inducing inputs and the underlying bugs is therefore essential for improving their security and reliability. Existing techniques commonly rely on either oracle-driven exploration that repeatedly compares against high-precision references or search-driven heuristics. Despite the improvements made, they remain limited by (1) Expensive computation of high-precision oracles and (2) Lack of long-range convergence, which often requires dense probing near narrow error-inducing regions and expensive computation. We propose MGDE (Mathematically-Guided Detection of floating-point Errors), a method that replaces trial-and-error exploration with mathematically defined targets and directed convergence. MGDE first uses condition-number theory to identify numerically unstable atomic operations without invoking expensive high-precision oracles during exploration. MGDE exploits the observation that extreme condition numbers occur near structured boundaries (e.g., cancellation points and singularities), reformulating detection as a numerical root-finding problem. By solving the resulting objectives with the Newton–Raphson method, MGDE can steer inputs toward error-prone regions from far-away initializations. We evaluate MGDE on GNU Scientific Library (GSL) functions and compare against two state-of-the-art baselines, ATOMU and FPCC, using triggered bugs as the primary metric. On 88 single-input functions, MGDE triggers 80 numerically validated bugs across 47 functions, outperforming ATOMU (70 bugs in 46 functions) and FPCC (53 bugs in 42 functions). MGDE is also faster: ATOMU and FPCC require 42.71{\texttimes} and 11.17{\texttimes} the exploration time of MGDE, respectively. Regarding multi-input functions, we evaluate MGDE under two complementary settings. On the native multi-input dataset of FPCC, MGDE detects 28 triggered bugs, while FPCC finds 23 bugs. MGDE also takes 8.91 seconds in total, compared with 2,100 seconds used by FPCC. On an additional external benchmark of 18 dual-input GSL functions, MGDE detects nine bugs not found by FPCC. Overall, MGDE substantially advances the state-of-the-art in both effectiveness and efficiency, and we report 16 previously unknown GSL bugs, which have been confirmed by the GSL community.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 浮点计算对于现代科学与工程软件非常重要，尤其是安全关键系统，然而通常只有一小部分输入会触发显著的数值错误。因此，检测这类引发错误的输入及其底层缺陷对于提升其安全性和可靠性至关重要。现有技术通常依赖基于预言机的探索（反复与高精度参考进行比较）或搜索驱动的启发式方法。尽管已有改进，它们仍受限于：(1) 高精度预言机的昂贵计算；(2) 缺乏长程收敛性，这往往需要在狭窄的易错区域附近进行密集探测并付出高昂计算代价。我们提出 MGDE（Mathematically-Guided Detection of floating-point Errors，数学引导的浮点错误检测），一种用数学定义的目标和定向收敛替代试错式探索的方法。MGDE 首先利用条件数理论来识别数值不稳定的原子操作，而无需在探索过程中调用昂贵的高精度预言机。MGDE 利用极端的条件数出现在结构化边界（例如消去点和奇点）附近的观察，将检测重新表述为数值求根问题。通过用牛顿–拉夫森法求解所得目标，MGDE 可以从远离的初始点将输入引导至易错区域。我们在 GNU 科学库（GSL）函数上评估 MGDE，并与两个最先进的基线 ATOMU 和 FPCC 比较，主要指标为触发的缺陷。在 88 个单输入函数上，MGDE 在 47 个函数中触发了 80 个经数值验证的缺陷，优于 ATOMU（46 个函数中 70 个缺陷）和 FPCC（42 个函数中 53 个缺陷）。MGDE 也更快：ATOMU 和 FPCC 所需的探索时间分别是 MGDE 的 42.71 倍和 11.17 倍。对于多输入函数，我们在两种互补设置下评估 MGDE。在 FPCC 的原生多输入数据集上，MGDE 检测到 28 个触发缺陷，而 FPCC 发现 23 个缺陷。MGDE 总共耗时 8.91 秒，而 FPCC 耗时 2,100 秒。在另一个包含 18 个双输入 GSL 函数的外部基准上，MGDE 检测到 FPCC 未发现的 9 个缺陷。总体而言，MGDE 在有效性和效率上大幅推进了最先进水平，并且我们报告了 16 个此前未知的 GSL 缺陷，这些缺陷已得到 GSL 社区的确认。

upstream_only.title: TracePilot: Self-Verifiable Framework for Decentralized Applications Fault Localization across Transactions
upstream_only.abstract: Decentralized Applications (DApps) serve as a critical technical underpinning for business logic and user interaction within the blockchain-powered Web3 ecosystem. However, DApps are prone to faults, and localizing these faults within their intricate and often interconnected logic is a particularly time-consuming process, frequently taking tens of hours and leading to substantial economic losses for developers. Existing state-of-the-art DApp fault localization methods, e.g., FaultSeeker, cannot capture cross-transaction fault logic and produce verifiable diagnostic reports. Therefore, security experts have to spend substantial time manually verifying results and devising fixes. In this paper, we present TracePilot, a large language model (LLM)-based framework that automates DApp fault localization in two phases: distilling global fault insights from transaction sequences and then performing focused trace exploration to isolate the faulty logic. Crucially, we propose a patch verification mechanism that treats attack-blocking patches as executable evidence for fault localization while flagging potential overfitting risks for expert review. This mechanism improves result trustworthiness and reduces manual verification costs. Evaluated on a dataset of 149 real-world cases, TracePilot achieves a 71.14\% Top-1 Recall. In the single-transaction fair comparison, it achieves 72.73\%, substantially outperforming the state-of-the-art method at 32.23\%. On cross-transaction cases, TracePilot achieves a 64.29\% Top-1 Recall. The proposed algorithm is being integrated into the contract security agent developed by Ant Digital Technologies. Moreover, to facilitate further research, our code and dataset are publicly available online: https://github.com/feiqiuaaaa/TracePilot.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 去中心化应用（DApps）是区块链驱动的Web3生态系统中业务逻辑和用户交互的关键技术支撑。然而，DApps容易发生故障，在其复杂且往往相互关联的逻辑中定位这些故障是一个特别耗时的过程，通常需要数十小时，并给开发者带来重大经济损失。现有的最先进的DApp故障定位方法（如FaultSeeker）无法捕获跨交易的故障逻辑，也无法生成可验证的诊断报告。因此，安全专家不得不花费大量时间手动验证结果并制定修复方案。在本文中，我们提出了TracePilot，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的框架，分两个阶段自动化DApp故障定位：从交易序列中提炼全局故障洞察，然后进行聚焦的轨迹探索以隔离故障逻辑。至关重要的是，我们提出了一种补丁验证机制，将阻止攻击的补丁视为故障定位的可执行证据，同时标记潜在的过拟合风险以供专家审查。该机制提高了结果的可信度并降低了手动验证成本。在包含149个真实案例的数据集上进行评估，TracePilot实现了71.14%的Top-1召回率。在单交易公平比较中，它达到72.73%，大幅优于最先进方法的32.23%。在跨交易案例中，TracePilot实现了64.29%的Top-1召回率。所提出的算法正被集成到蚂蚁数字科技开发的合约安全代理中。此外，为促进进一步研究，我们的代码和数据集已在线公开：https://github.com/feiqiuaaaa/TracePilot。

upstream_only.title: Empowering Lightweight Language Models for Security Code Review via Context-Aware Distillation
upstream_only.abstract: Security code review, which specifically examines software from a security perspective, is indispensable for preempting vulnerabilities and bolstering software reliability. However, existing automated approaches face a dilemma. They either rely on large language models with prohibitive deployment costs, or employ lightweight models that struggle with complex reasoning and global contextual understanding. In this paper, we propose LSCR, a context-aware distillation approach that empowers lightweight language models for security code review by distilling static-analysis–style security rationale from powerful teacher models. Rather than directly transferring final review outputs, LSCR guides student models to internalize how high-level security judgments are systematically derived from low-level code evidence, leveraging repository-level context during training. By embedding this evidence-driven analysis paradigm into lightweight models, LSCR enables more reliable security code reviews under constrained model capacity. When compared with competitive lightweight baselines, LSCR attains an average improvement of over 12\% in security issue classification accuracy and more than 13.3\% gains in BLEU score for review generation. Human evaluation reveals that LSCR increases the proportion of instrumental reviews by 52.6\% on average over state-of-the-art baselines, while reducing misleading feedback by 22.6\%. LSCR effectively narrows the performance gap between small-scale and large-scale models, making on-premise security code review more feasible in practice.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 安全代码审查，即从安全角度专门检查软件，对于预防漏洞和增强软件可靠性不可或缺。然而，现有的自动化方法面临两难境地。它们要么依赖部署成本高昂的大型语言模型，要么采用难以进行复杂推理和全局上下文理解的轻量级模型。在本文中，我们提出了LSCR，一种上下文感知蒸馏方法，通过从强大的教师模型中蒸馏出静态分析风格的安全推理依据，来赋能轻量级语言模型进行安全代码审查。LSCR不是直接迁移最终审查输出，而是引导学生模型内化如何从低级代码证据中系统地推导出高级安全判断，并在训练期间利用仓库级上下文。通过将这种证据驱动的分析范式嵌入轻量级模型，LSCR使得在受限模型容量下能够进行更可靠的安全代码审查。与有竞争力的轻量级基线相比，LSCR在安全问题的分类准确率上平均提升超过12%，在审查生成的BLEU分数上提升超过13.3%。人工评估显示，与最先进的基线相比，LSCR平均将有用审查的比例提高了52.6%，同时将误导性反馈减少了22.6%。LSCR有效缩小了小规模与大规模模型之间的性能差距，使本地部署的安全代码审查在实践中更加可行。

upstream_only.title: EvidenT: An Evidence-Preserving Framework for Iterative System-Level Package Repair
upstream_only.abstract: Frequent toolchain updates and the expanding diversity of instruction set architectures (ISAs) have made large-scale system-level software package repair a critical task. Diagnosing and repairing build failures remains challenging due to heterogeneous failure evidence, complex dependency constraints, and architecture-specific build conventions. While recent LLM-based repair methods have shown promise for project-level source code fixes, they struggle with system-level repair where failures involve multi-language artifacts (e.g., build recipes, scripts, and source archives) and require iterative validation through external build services. In this paper, we first conduct a systematic empirical study of real-world system-level build failures. Our findings reveal that 72\% of successful repairs primarily involve adjustments to build configurations, dependencies, or environment settings rather than isolated source-code modifications, suggesting that effective repair must prioritize packaging logic and iterative feedback. Motivated by these insights, we propose EvidenT, an evidence-preserving repair framework that decouples iteration-aware evidence management from tool execution. EvidenT comprises (1) an external Build Service for reproducible build execution and feedback; (2) an Evidence-Preserving Repair Controller that performs cross-modal fusion of repair history, knowledge context, and build artifacts; and (3) an automated Repair Orchestrator that executes a suite of modular tools for failure localization and system-level repair actions within a closed-loop validation environment. We evaluate EvidenT on a benchmark of 219 real-world RISC-V package build failures. EvidenT successfully repairs 118 packages (53.88\%), substantially outperforming state-of-the-art agentic baselines (20.55\%) and direct LLM-based repair (1.83\%). To demonstrate its architectural generality, we extend EvidenT to other ISAs by updating only ISA-specific knowledge context. In preliminary experiments, it achieves success rates of 41.77\% on aarch64 and 46.99\% on x86_64, showcasing its robustness across diverse hardware ecosystems.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 频繁的工具链更新和指令集架构（ISA）的日益多样化，使大规模系统级软件包修复成为一项关键任务。由于异构的失败证据、复杂的依赖约束以及特定架构的构建约定，诊断和修复构建失败仍然具有挑战性。尽管近期基于LLM的修复方法在项目级源代码修复方面展现出潜力，但它们在系统级修复中面临困难，因为失败涉及多语言工件（例如构建配方、脚本和源代码归档），并且需要通过外部构建服务进行迭代验证。在本文中，我们首先对真实世界的系统级构建失败进行系统的实证研究。我们的发现表明，72%的成功修复主要涉及对构建配置、依赖项或环境设置的调整，而非孤立的源代码修改，这表明有效的修复必须优先考虑打包逻辑和迭代反馈。受这些见解启发，我们提出EvidenT，一个证据保留的修复框架，它将迭代感知的证据管理与工具执行解耦。EvidenT包含：(1) 一个外部构建服务，用于可复现的构建执行与反馈；(2) 一个证据保留的修复控制器，执行修复历史、知识上下文和构建工件的跨模态融合；以及(3) 一个自动修复编排器，在闭环验证环境中执行一套模块化工具，用于失败定位和系统级修复动作。我们在包含219个真实世界RISC-V软件包构建失败的基准上评估EvidenT。EvidenT成功修复了118个软件包（53.88%），大幅优于最先进的智能体基线（20.55%）和直接基于LLM的修复（1.83%）。为展示其架构通用性，我们仅通过更新ISA特定的知识上下文，将EvidenT扩展到其他ISA。在初步实验中，它在aarch64上达到41.77%的成功率，在x86_64上达到46.99%，展示了其在不同硬件生态系统中的稳健性。

upstream_only.title: CARE: Cascading Impact-Aware Compliance Test Suite Evolution under Regulatory Changes
upstream_only.abstract: In response to frequent changes in regulatory rules, this paper proposes CARE, a cascading impact-aware framework for automated compliance testing evolution. Existing approaches often suffer from over-reuse or missed updates because they treat rule changes in isolation and ignore complex inter-dependencies across testing artifacts. This paper highlights cascading impact propagation as a central challenge in regulation-driven test maintenance and shows that shifting from isolated rule handling to cascading impact-aware evolution is essential for achieving both high test quality and maintenance efficiency. Specifically, our CARE framework addresses this challenge by constructing a unified four-layer cascading relation model spanning Rule-Requirement-Scenario-Test Case, enabling fine-grained traceability across abstraction levels. By explicitly modeling how rule changes propagate and amplify along this chain, the framework precisely identifies impacted scenarios and test cases that need updating, while safely maximizing the reuse of unaffected ones. Experiments conducted on real-world compliance testing tasks across multiple domains show that CARE achieves an average F1 of 90.3\% on updated test suites, outperforming existing methods by up to 164\% and approaching expert-level effectiveness. Ablation studies further demonstrate that explicit cascading impact modeling and handling are key contributors to these improvements. In addition, CARE substantially reduces manual effort and improves test maintenance efficiency, and indicates strong cross-domain generalization.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 为应对监管规则的频繁变化，本文提出了CARE，一个用于自动化合规测试演化的级联影响感知框架。现有方法通常因孤立地处理规则变化并忽略测试工件间复杂的相互依赖关系，而存在过度复用或遗漏更新等问题。本文强调级联影响传播是监管驱动测试维护中的核心挑战，并表明从孤立的规则处理转向级联影响感知的演化，对于同时实现高测试质量和维护效率至关重要。具体而言，我们的CARE框架通过构建一个跨越规则-需求-场景-测试用例的统一四层级联关系模型来应对这一挑战，从而实现跨抽象层次的细粒度可追溯性。通过显式建模规则变化如何沿此链条传播和放大，该框架能精确识别需要更新的受影响场景和测试用例，同时安全地最大化复用未受影响的场景和测试用例。在多个领域的真实世界合规测试任务上进行的实验表明，CARE在更新后的测试套件上平均F1达到90.3%，比现有方法高出最多164%，并接近专家级效果。消融研究进一步表明，显式的级联影响建模和处理是这些改进的关键贡献因素。此外，CARE大幅减少了人工工作量，提高了测试维护效率，并展现出强大的跨领域泛化能力。

upstream_only.title: Fine-Grained Privacy Leakage Detection in OpenHarmony Apps
upstream_only.abstract: In recent years, the distributed operating system OpenHarmony has gained significant popularity. As the number of OpenHarmony apps grows rapidly, privacy abuse and data leakage have emerged as critical concerns. However, the untyped and highly flexible nature of Ark bytecode poses substantial challenges. We propose HScope, a novel fine-grained program analysis framework designed to directly analyze OpenHarmony app bytecode and identify privacy risks. HScope employs abstract interpretation to model the dynamic behaviors of OpenHarmony apps, enabling precise resolution of indirect calls and the complex inter-component communication mechanisms. We evaluate HScope on a dataset of 300 real-world OpenHarmony apps. The results demonstrate that HScope is both effective and comprehensive, successfully uncovering 39 previously unknown privacy issues (corresponding to 27 apps). These findings highlight HScope’s potential as a practical and scalable solution for securing the evolving OpenHarmony ecosystem.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 近年来，分布式操作系统OpenHarmony获得了显著普及。随着OpenHarmony应用数量迅速增长，隐私滥用和数据泄露已成为关键问题。然而，Ark字节码的无类型且高度灵活的性质带来了巨大挑战。我们提出HScope，一种新颖的细粒度程序分析框架，旨在直接分析OpenHarmony应用字节码并识别隐私风险。HScope采用抽象解释来建模OpenHarmony应用的动态行为，从而能够精确解析间接调用和复杂的组件间通信机制。我们在300个真实OpenHarmony应用的数据集上评估了HScope。结果表明HScope既有效又全面，成功发现了39个先前未知的隐私问题（对应27个应用）。这些发现凸显了HScope作为保护不断发展的OpenHarmony生态系统的实用且可扩展解决方案的潜力。

upstream_only.title: An Empirical Study and Benchmark of Kubernetes Misconfiguration Scanners
upstream_only.abstract: Kubernetes is a widely adopted container orchestration framework, yet misconfigurations remain a leading cause of cloud security incidents and a major challenge for practitioners. Automated security scanners are commonly used to detect such misconfigurations, but their effectiveness has not been systematically evaluated. As a result, it remains unclear which tools can be trusted, what misconfigurations they reliably detect, and to what extent they improve Kubernetes security. This paper presents the first systematic investigation of ten prominent Kubernetes security scanners that are actively used in practice. We begin by examining the misconfigurations that each scanner claims to detect. Although scanners provide documentation of their coverage, these descriptions are written in natural language and are often ambiguous, making it unclear what is actually detected. To address this issue, we manually analyze scanner implementations to identify their precise detection targets and validate them through dynamic testing. Our analysis reveals that scanners frequently adopt different criteria for the same documented misconfiguration, exposing significant inconsistencies caused by ambiguous specifications. Building on these results, we introduce the first comprehensive benchmark for Kubernetes misconfigurations, covering all misconfigurations targeted by the ten scanners. The benchmark includes 4,109 misconfiguration files for static and dynamic analysis and 144 shell scripts for dynamic analysis, encompassing 281 unique misconfigurations. Using this benchmark, we conducted an empirical evaluation of ten scanners. Our results show that, in static scanning, Kubescape achieves the highest recall (43.8\%), and it also performs best in dynamic analysis with an recall of 62.3\%. We further analyze the strengths and limitations of each scanner, identifying coverage gaps that significantly affect detection effectiveness. Our findings provide practical guidance for practitioners selecting Kubernetes security scanners and highlight key challenges that should be addressed by the software engineering community. Moreover, the proposed benchmark establishes a foundation for future research on Kubernetes security.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Kubernetes 是一个被广泛采用的容器编排框架，但错误配置仍然是云安全事件的主要原因之一，也是从业者面临的主要挑战。自动化安全扫描器通常用于检测此类错误配置，但其有效性尚未得到系统评估。因此，哪些工具值得信赖、它们能可靠地检测哪些错误配置，以及它们在多大程度上改善 Kubernetes 安全性，仍不清楚。本文首次对实践中积极使用的十款知名 Kubernetes 安全扫描器进行了系统研究。我们首先考察每款扫描器声称能检测的错误配置。尽管扫描器提供了其覆盖范围的文档，但这些描述以自然语言编写，往往模糊不清，导致实际检测内容不明确。为解决这一问题，我们人工分析扫描器实现，以识别其精确检测目标，并通过动态测试进行验证。我们的分析表明，扫描器常常对同一文档化错误配置采用不同标准，暴露出由模糊规范引起的显著不一致。基于这些结果，我们引入了首个面向 Kubernetes 错误配置的综合基准，覆盖十款扫描器所针对的所有错误配置。该基准包含用于静态和动态分析的 4,109 个错误配置文件以及用于动态分析的 144 个 shell 脚本，涵盖 281 种独特错误配置。利用该基准，我们对十款扫描器进行了实证评估。结果表明，在静态扫描中，Kubescape 实现了最高召回率（43.8%），并且在动态分析中也表现最佳，召回率为 62.3%。我们进一步分析每款扫描器的优势与局限，识别出显著影响检测有效性的覆盖缺口。我们的发现为从业者选择 Kubernetes 安全扫描器提供了实用指导，并突出了软件工程社区应解决的关键挑战。此外，所提出的基准为未来 Kubernetes 安全研究奠定了基础。

upstream_only.title: Towards Iterative End-to-End Software Development: A Feature-Driven Multi-agent Framework
upstream_only.abstract: Recent advances in large language model agents offer the promise of automating end-to-end software development from natural language requirements. However, existing approaches largely adopt linear, waterfall-style pipelines, which oversimplify the iterative nature of real-world development and struggle with complex, larger-scale projects. To address these limitations, we propose EvoDev, an iterative software development framework inspired by feature-driven development. EvoDev decomposes user requirements into a set of user-valued features and constructs a Feature Map, a directed acyclic graph that explicitly models dependencies between features. Each feature node in the feature map maintains multi-layer contexts, including business logic, software design, and code implementation, which are propagated along dependencies to provide context for subsequent development iterations. We evaluate EvoDev on challenging Android development tasks and show that it improves Function Completeness by 57.3\% over the best-performing baseline, Claude Code, while achieving 16.0\%–58.5\% improvements over single-agent baselines with different base LLMs. These results highlight the importance of feature decomposition, dependency modeling, context propagation, and workflow-aware agent design for end-to-end software development. Moreover, our work summarizes practical insights for designing iterative, LLM-driven development frameworks and informs future training of base LLMs to better support iterative software development.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 近期，大型语言模型智能体的进展为从自然语言需求出发自动化端到端软件开发带来了希望。然而，现有方法大多采用线性的、瀑布式流水线，这过度简化了现实世界开发的迭代性质，并且难以应对复杂、规模较大的项目。为克服这些局限，我们提出EvoDev，一个受特征驱动开发启发的迭代式软件开发框架。EvoDev将用户需求分解为一组对用户有价值的特征，并构建特征图——一个有向无环图，显式建模特征之间的依赖关系。特征图中的每个特征节点维护多层上下文，包括业务逻辑、软件设计和代码实现，这些上下文沿依赖关系传播，为后续开发迭代提供上下文。我们在具有挑战性的Android开发任务上评估EvoDev，结果表明，与表现最好的基线Claude Code相比，其功能完整性提高了57.3%，同时在不同基础LLM的单智能体基线上实现了16.0%–58.5%的提升。这些结果凸显了特征分解、依赖建模、上下文传播和工作流感知智能体设计对端到端软件开发的重要性。此外，我们的工作总结了设计迭代式、LLM驱动开发框架的实用见解，并为未来基础LLM的训练提供参考，以更好地支持迭代式软件开发。

upstream_only.title: Silence of Commit Messages: An Empirical Study for Vulnerability Commit Message Generation using Large Language Models
upstream_only.abstract: The vulnerability commit message serves as crucial metadata for maintaining software within version control systems. Nonetheless, manually crafted vulnerability commit messages often lack detail or exhibit inconsistent formatting. Recently, the growing use of Large Language Models (LLMs) for code and natural language comprehension has opened avenues to automate the crafting of these messages. This paper systematically and thoroughly explores the generation of security patch commit messages in the context of LLMs, delving into topics such as dataset construction, evaluation method design, and the relationship between vulnerability types and submission structure. First, we explore the elements of commit messages using LLMs and integrate a questionnaire survey to pinpoint four essential types of information: summary, background, impact, and fix, which are essential for developers. This aims to establish a structured dataset of bug submissions and assess its quality. Next, we examine general automated evaluation techniques for assessing LLM-generated commit messages and find that GPT-3.5's evaluation methods align more closely with human judgment. Then, we conduct an organized investigation into how LLM generation effects vary across three principal vulnerability types, uncovering that LLMs' adaptability differs across vulnerabilities. Furthermore, we perform an exhaustive examination of generation quality across various components and find that LLMs excel at generating summaries but struggle to produce impact details. In particular, the smallest DeepSeek-Coder shows a semantic retention advantage in crafting backgrounds, whereas DeepSeek-V3 struggles with impact aspects. Lastly, we investigate the effects of different prompting strategies (e.g., zero-shot, few-shot prompts) and parameter settings (e.g., temperature and top_p) on the quality of commit message generation, finding that prompt and parameter configurations critically influence output quality, with model sensitivity varying.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 漏洞提交信息是版本控制系统中维护软件的关键元数据。然而，人工编写的漏洞提交信息往往缺乏细节或格式不一致。近年来，大型语言模型（LLM）在代码和自然语言理解方面的日益广泛使用，为自动化编写这些信息开辟了途径。本文系统而深入地探讨了在LLM背景下生成安全补丁提交信息的问题，涉及数据集构建、评估方法设计以及漏洞类型与提交结构之间的关系等主题。首先，我们使用LLM探索提交信息的要素，并结合问卷调查，确定了四类对开发者至关重要的信息：摘要、背景、影响和修复。这旨在建立一个结构化的缺陷提交数据集并评估其质量。接着，我们研究了评估LLM生成的提交信息的一般自动化评估技术，发现GPT-3.5的评估方法与人类判断更为一致。然后，我们系统地调查了LLM生成效果在三种主要漏洞类型上的差异，发现LLM的适应性因漏洞而异。此外，我们对各个组件的生成质量进行了详尽检查，发现LLM擅长生成摘要，但难以生成影响细节。特别是，最小的DeepSeek-Coder在编写背景方面表现出语义保留优势，而DeepSeek-V3在影响方面表现不佳。最后，我们研究了不同提示策略（如零样本、少样本提示）和参数设置（如温度和top_p）对提交信息生成质量的影响，发现提示和参数配置对输出质量有重要影响，且模型敏感性各不相同。

upstream_only.title: Characterizing and Repairing Obsolete Android GUI Tests under UI Evolution
upstream_only.abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) tests are widely used in regression testing of mobile applications (apps) to validate app behavior from the user's perspective. However, frequent app evolution, such as UI redesigns and feature updates, often renders existing GUI tests obsolete, even when underlying functionality remains unchanged. Automatically repairing such tests is critical for maintaining test suites and reducing substantial manual effort. Despite the practical importance, there is still a lack of a systematic understanding of the characteristics of obsolete GUI tests and a publicly available benchmark to support their study. To fill this gap, we construct a benchmark comprising 736 obsolete GUI tests collected from 36 real-world mobile apps across 668 historical versions. We then conduct a large-scale empirical study that reveals two major challenges in repairing obsolete GUI tests: First, identifying the intended target widget is difficult because widget attributes are frequently missing or unstable, and visually similar widgets may correspond to different functionalities. Second, the target widget is often no longer directly reachable from the failure state, as it may be hidden behind additional UI interactions or relocated to another page. To address these challenges, we further propose GUIRevive, an automated GUI test repair approach that addresses semantic ambiguity in widget identification and target unreachability under UI evolution by integrating semantic-aware reasoning, functionality-preserving validation, and goal-guided UI exploration. Our evaluation shows that GUIRevive successfully repairs 86.4\% of obsolete GUI tests and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art repair techniques by up to 220\%. Moreover, GUIRevive has been deployed in industrial settings, achieving a 93\% repair success rate on industrial mobile apps.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 图形用户界面（GUI）测试广泛用于移动应用程序（app）的回归测试，以从用户角度验证app行为。然而，频繁的app演化（如UI重新设计和功能更新）往往使现有GUI测试过时，即使底层功能保持不变。自动修复此类测试对于维护测试套件和减少大量人工工作至关重要。尽管具有实际重要性，但目前仍缺乏对过时GUI测试特征的系统性理解以及支持其研究的公开基准。为填补这一空白，我们构建了一个基准，包含从36个真实世界移动app的668个历史版本中收集的736个过时GUI测试。随后，我们进行了一项大规模实证研究，揭示了修复过时GUI测试中的两个主要挑战：第一，由于widget属性经常缺失或不稳定，且视觉相似的widget可能对应不同功能，识别预期目标widget很困难。第二，目标widget通常无法从失败状态直接到达，因为它可能隐藏在额外的UI交互之后或已重新定位到另一个页面。为应对这些挑战，我们进一步提出GUIRevive，一种自动化GUI测试修复方法，通过集成语义感知推理、功能保持验证和目标引导的UI探索，解决UI演化下widget识别中的语义歧义和目标不可达问题。我们的评估表明，GUIRevive成功修复了86.4%的过时GUI测试，并显著优于最先进的修复技术，最高提升220%。此外，GUIRevive已在工业环境中部署，在工业移动app上达到93%的修复成功率。

upstream_only.title: Project-Scale Statement-Level Fault Localization via Multi-view Semantic Learning and Pairwise Reranking
upstream_only.abstract: Statement-level fault localization (FL) is critical for effective software debugging, as it enables developers to precisely identify faulty lines of code. While traditional spectrum-based, mutation-based, and deep learning-based FL techniques have achieved notable progress, they remain limited in modeling rich fault semantics. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) offer new opportunities for FL due to their strong capacity for semantic understanding and reasoning over bugs. However, existing LLM-based FL approaches largely treat fault localization as isolated, code-centric prediction, limiting their ability to perform the holistic fault reasoning required for precise statement-level localization. In this paper, we propose FaultScape, a novel LLM-based framework for project-scale, statement-level FL that formulates FL as a multi-view semantic learning and reasoning problem. FaultScape addresses the limitations of existing approaches through three key components. First, we introduce a joint contrastive fine-tuning strategy that trains LLMs on large-scale bug-fix data to explicitly learn fault semantics from multiple complementary views. View-specific fault semantics, including code semantics, fault type, root cause, and repair intent, are learned via supervised binary classification, while cross-view semantic consistency is enforced through contrastive learning. These two objectives are jointly optimized within a unified training loss. The fine-tuned models extract multi-view fault likelihoods as semantic features for each suspicious statement. Second, we adopt a dynamic feature integration module that combines these semantic features with spectrum-based and mutation-based execution features, producing an initial suspiciousness statement ranking. Third, we design an LLM-based, test-guided pairwise re-ranking strategy that explicitly compares highly suspicious candidate statements using failing-test context. By estimating relative fault likelihoods through pairwise comparison rather than independent scoring, the model produces a refined statement-level ranking. We evaluate FaultScape on Defects4J v1.2.0, where it localizes 112/171/196 bugs at Top-1/3/5 out of 395, outperforming state-of-the-art DL-based and LLM-based baselines. On leakage-free benchmarks, FaultScape further localizes 11/18/20 bugs at Top-1/3/5 on ConDefects (31 bugs) and 12/21/22 bugs on GHRB (34 bugs), demonstrating strong generalization to unseen projects. These results show that combining multi-view fault semantics with contrastive, failure-guided reasoning substantially improves the effectiveness and robustness of statement-level fault localization.Statement-level fault localization (FL) is critical for effective software debugging, as it enables developers to precisely identify faulty lines of code. On leakage-free benchmarks, FaultScape further localizes 11/18/20 bugs at Top-1/3/5 on ConDefects (31 bugs) and 12/21/22 bugs on GHRB (34 bugs), demonstrating strong generalization to unseen projects. These results show that combining multi-view fault semantics with contrastive, failure-guided reasoning substantially improves the effectiveness and robustness of statement-level fault localization.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 语句级故障定位（FL）对于有效的软件调试至关重要，因为它使开发人员能够精确定位有故障的代码行。尽管传统的基于频谱、基于变异和基于深度学习的FL技术已取得显著进展，但它们在建模丰富的故障语义方面仍然有限。大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展为FL提供了新机会，因为它们对缺陷具有很强的语义理解和推理能力。然而，现有的基于LLM的FL方法在很大程度上将故障定位视为孤立的、以代码为中心的预测，限制了它们执行精确语句级定位所需的整体故障推理的能力。在本文中，我们提出FaultScape，一种新颖的基于LLM的项目级语句级FL框架，将FL形式化为多视角语义学习和推理问题。FaultScape通过三个关键组件解决现有方法的局限性。首先，我们引入联合对比微调策略，在大规模缺陷修复数据上训练LLM，以从多个互补视角显式学习故障语义。特定视角的故障语义，包括代码语义、故障类型、根本原因和修复意图，通过监督二元分类学习，而跨视角语义一致性通过对比学习强制实现。这两个目标在统一的训练损失中联合优化。微调后的模型为每个可疑语句提取多视角故障似然作为语义特征。其次，我们采用动态特征集成模块，将这些语义特征与基于频谱和基于变异的执行特征相结合，生成初始可疑度语句排名。第三，我们设计了一种基于LLM、测试引导的成对重排序策略，使用失败测试上下文显式比较高度可疑的候选语句。通过成对比较而不是独立评分来估计相对故障似然，模型产生细化的语句级排名。我们在Defects4J v1.2.0上评估FaultScape，在395个缺陷中，其在Top-1/3/5分别定位了112/171/196个缺陷，优于最先进的基于深度学习和基于LLM的基线。在无泄漏基准上，FaultScape在ConDefects（31个缺陷）上Top-1/3/5分别定位了11/18/20个缺陷，在GHRB（34个缺陷）上定位了12/21/22个缺陷，展示了对未见项目的强泛化能力。这些结果表明，将多视角故障语义与对比性、失败引导推理相结合，显著提高了语句级故障定位的有效性和鲁棒性。

upstream_only.title: Lottery scheduling: flexible proportional-share resource management
upstream_only.abstract: This paper presents lottery scheduling, a novel randomized resource allocation mechanism. Lottery scheduling provides efficient, responsive control over the relative execution rates of computations. Such control is beyond the capabilities of conventional schedulers, and is desirable in systems that service requests of varying importance, such as databases, media-based applications, and networks. Lottery scheduling also supports modular resource management by enabling concurrent modules to insulate their resource allocation policies from one another. A currency abstraction is introduced to flexibly name, share, and protect resource rights. We also show that lottery scheduling can be generalized to manage many diverse resources, such as I/O bandwidth, memory, and access to locks. We have implemented a prototype lottery scheduler for the Mach 3.0 microkernel, and found that it provides flexible and responsive control over the relative execution rates of a wide range of applications. The overhead imposed by our unoptimized prototype is comparable to that of the standard Mach timesharing policy.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的随机化资源分配机制——彩票调度。彩票调度能够高效、灵敏地控制计算执行的相对速率，这种控制能力超出了传统调度器的能力范围，在服务各种重要性请求的系统中（如数据库、媒体应用和网络）尤为可取。彩票调度还支持模块化资源管理，使并发模块能够彼此隔离其资源分配策略。文中引入了货币抽象的概念，以灵活地命名、共享和保护资源权利。同时表明，彩票调度可以被推广用于管理多种多样的资源，如I/O带宽、内存和锁的访问。我们在Mach 3.0微内核上实现了彩票调度器的原型，发现它能灵活而灵敏地控制各种应用程序的相对执行速率。我们未优化的原型所产生的开销与标准Mach分时策略相当。

upstream_only.title: Scheduling for reduced CPU energy
upstream_only.abstract: The energy usage of computer systems is becoming more important, especially for battery operated systems. Displays, disks, and cpus, in that order, use the most energy. Reducing the energy used by displays and disks has been studied elsewhere; this paper considers a new method for reducing the energy used by the cpu. We introduce a new metric for cpu energy performance, millions-of-instructions-per-joule (MIPJ). We examine a class of methods to reduce MIPJ that are characterized by dynamic control of system clock speed by the operating system scheduler. Reducing clock speed alone does not reduce MIPJ, since to do the same work the system must run longer. However, a number of methods are available for reducing energy with reduced clock-speed, such as reducing the voltage [Chandrakasan et al 1992][Horowitz 1993] or using reversible [Younis and Knight 1993] or adiabatic logic [Athas et al 1994].What are the right scheduling algorithms for taking advantage of reduced clock-speed, especially in the presence of applications demanding ever more instructions-per-second? We consider several methods for varying the clock speed dynamically under control of the operating system, and examine the performance of these methods against workstation traces. The primary result is that by adjusting the clock speed at a fine grain, substantial CPU energy can be saved with a limited impact on performance.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 计算机系统的能耗正变得越来越重要，特别是对于电池供电的系统。显示器、磁盘和CPU按顺序消耗最多的能量。降低显示器和磁盘能耗的方法已在别处研究；本文考虑一种降低CPU能耗的新方法。我们引入了一个新的CPU能耗性能指标：每焦耳百万条指令（MIPJ）。我们研究了一类通过操作系统调度器动态控制系统时钟速度来降低MIPJ的方法。仅降低时钟速度并不能降低MIPJ，因为要完成同样的工作，系统必须运行更长时间。然而，有许多方法可以在降低时钟速度的同时减少能耗，例如降低电压[Chandrakasan等，1992]、使用可逆逻辑[Younis和Knight，1993]或绝热逻辑[Athas等，1994]。在需要每秒更多指令的应用存在的情况下，正确的调度算法是什么？我们考虑了在操作系统控制下动态改变时钟速度的几种方法，并根据工作站轨迹检验了这些方法的性能。主要结果是，通过细粒度地调整时钟速度，可以在对性能影响有限的情况下节省大量CPU能耗。

upstream_only.title: Storage alternatives for mobile computers
upstream_only.abstract: Mobile computers such as notebooks, subnotebooks, and palmtops require low weight, low power consumption, and good interactive performance. These requirements impose many challenges on architectures and operating systems. This paper investigates three alternative storage devices for mobile computers: magnetic hard disks, flash memory disk emulators, and flash memory cards.We have used hardware measurements and trace-driven simulation to evaluate each of the alternative storage devices and their related design strategies. Hardware measurements on an HP OmniBook 300 highlight differences in the performance of the three devices as used on the Omnibook, especially the poor performance of version 2.00 of the Microsoft Flash File System [11] when accessing large files. The traces used in our study came from different environments, including mobile computers (Macintosh Power-Books) and desktop computers (running Windows or HPUX), as well as synthetic workloads. Our simulation study shows that flash memory can reduce energy consumption by an order of magnitude, compared to magnetic disk, while providing good read performance and acceptable write performance. These energy savings can translate into a 22\% extension of battery life. We also find that the amount of unused memory in a flash memory card has a substantial impact on energy consumption, performance, and endurance: compared to low storage utilizations (40\% full), running flash memory near its capacity (95\% full) can increase energy consumption by 70-190\%, degrade write response time by 30\%, and decrease the lifetime of the memory card by up to a third. For flash disks, asynchronous erasure can improve write response time by a factor of 2.5.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 笔记型电脑、亚笔记本和掌上电脑等移动计算机需要低重量、低功耗和良好的交互性能。这些需求对体系结构和操作系统提出了许多挑战。本文研究了三种移动计算机的替代存储设备：磁性硬盘、闪存磁盘模拟器和闪存卡。我们利用硬件测量和轨迹驱动模拟来评估每种替代存储设备及其相关设计策略。在HP OmniBook 300上的硬件测量突出了三种设备在Omnibook上使用时性能的差异，特别是微软Flash文件系统2.00版本在访问大文件时的糟糕性能。我们研究中使用的轨迹来自不同环境，包括移动电脑（Macintosh PowerBooks）和桌面电脑（运行Windows或HPUX），以及合成工作负载。我们的模拟研究表明，与磁盘相比，闪存可以将能耗降低一个数量级，同时提供良好的读取性能和可接受的写入性能。这些节能可以转化为电池寿命延长22\%。我们还发现，闪存卡中未使用的内存量对能耗、性能和耐久性有显著影响：与低存储利用率（40\%满）相比，闪存在接近其容量（95\%满）下运行可使能耗增加70-190\%，写入响应时间降低30\%，并使存储卡的寿命缩短三分之一。对于闪存磁盘，异步擦除可以将写入响应时间提高2.5倍。

upstream_only.title: Opportunistic log: efficient installation reads in a reliable storage server
upstream_only.abstract: In a distributed storage system, client caches managed on the basis of small granularity objects can provide better memory utilization then page-based caches. However, object servers, unlike page servers, must perform additional disk reads. These installation reads are required to install modified objects onto their corresponding disk pages. The opportunistic log is a new technique that significantly reduces the cost of installation reads. It defers the installation reads, removing them from the modification commit path, and manages a large pool of pending installation reads that can be scheduled efficiently.Using simulations, we show that the opportunistic log substantially enhances the I/O performance of reliable storage servers. An object server without the opportunistic log requires much better client caching to outperform a page server. With an opportunistic log, only a small client cache improvement suffices.Our results imply that efficient scheduling of installation reads can substantially improve the performance of large-scale storage systems and therefore introduces a new performance tradeoff between page-based and object-based architectures.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在分布式存储系统中，基于小粒度对象管理的客户端缓存可以提供比基于页面的缓存更好的内存利用率。然而，与页面服务器不同，对象服务器必须执行额外的磁盘读取。这些安装读取是必要的，用于将修改后的对象安装到对应的磁盘页面上。机会性日志是一种显著降低安装读取成本的新技术。它延迟安装读取，将其移出修改提交路径，并管理一个大量待处理安装读取的池，以便高效调度。通过模拟，我们表明机会性日志显著提高了可靠存储服务器的I/O性能。没有机会性日志的对象服务器需要更好的客户端缓存才能超越页面服务器。有了机会性日志，只需很小的客户端缓存改进就足够了。我们的结果表明，高效的安装读取调度可以显著提高大规模存储系统的性能，从而在基于页面和基于对象的架构之间引入了新的性能权衡。

upstream_only.title: Metadata update performance in file systems
upstream_only.abstract: Structural changes, such as file creation and block allocation, have consistently been identified as file system performance problems in many user environments. We compare several implementations that maintain metadata integrity in the event of a system failure but do not require changes to the on-disk structures. In one set of schemes, the file system uses asynchronous writes and passes ordering requirements to the disk scheduler. These scheduler-enforced ordering schemes outperform the conventional approach (synchronous writes) by more than 30 percent for metadata update intensive benchmarks, but are suboptimal mainly due to their inability to safely use delayed writes when ordering is required. We therefore introduce soft updates, an implementation that asymptotically approaches memory-based file system performance (within 5 percent) while providing stronger integrity and security guarantees than most UNIX file systems. For metadata update in-tensive benchmarks, this improves performance by more than a factor of two when compared to the conventional approach.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 结构性变化，例如文件创建和块分配，在许多用户环境中一直被认为是文件系统的性能问题。我们比较了几种在系统故障时保持元数据完整性但不需要更改磁盘结构的实现方案。在一组方案中，文件系统使用异步写入并将排序要求传递给磁盘调度器。这些由调度器强制排序的方案在元数据更新密集型基准测试中比传统方法（同步写入）性能提高超过30%，但其次优之处主要在于当需要排序时无法安全地使用延迟写入。因此，我们引入了软更新（soft updates），这是一种渐近接近基于内存的文件系统性能（5%以内）的实现，同时比大多数UNIX文件系统提供更强的完整性和安全保证。对于元数据更新密集型基准测试，与传统方法相比，性能提升超过两倍。

upstream_only.title: Disk-directed I/O for MIMD multiprocessors
upstream_only.abstract: Many scientific applications that run on today's multiprocessors, such as weather forecasting and seismic analysis, are bottlenecked by their file-I/O needs. Even if the multiprocessor is configured with sufficient I/O hardware, the file-system software often fails to provide the available bandwidth to the application. Although libraries and enhanced file-system interfaces can make a significant improvement, we believe that fundamental changes are needed in the file-server software. We propose a new technique, disk-directed I/O, to allow the disk servers to determine the flow of data for maximum performance. Our simulations show that tremendous performance gains are possible. Indeed, disk-directed I/O provided consistent high performance that was largely independent of data distribution, obtained up to 93\% of peak disk bandwidth, and was as much as 16 times faster than traditional parallel file systems.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 当今多处理器上运行的许多科学应用（如天气预报和地震分析）都受到文件I/O需求的瓶颈限制。即使多处理器配置了足够的I/O硬件，文件系统软件也往往无法为应用提供可用的带宽。虽然库和增强的文件系统接口可以带来显著改进，但我们认为文件服务器软件需要根本性的变革。我们提出了一种新技术——磁盘导向I/O，让磁盘服务器决定数据流以实现最大性能。我们的模拟表明，可以获得巨大的性能提升。实际上，磁盘导向I/O提供了持续的高性能，其性能在很大程度上独立于数据分布，最高可达峰值磁盘带宽的93%，并且比传统并行文件系统快多达16倍。

upstream_only.title: Message-driven relaxed consistency in a software distributed shared memory
