upstream_only.abstract: Message-passing and distributed shared memory have their respective advantages and disadvantages in distributed parallel programming. We approach the problem of integrating both mechanisms into a single system by proposing a new message-driven coherency mechanism. Messages carrying explicit causality annotations are exchanged to trigger memory coherency actions. By adding annotations to standard message-based protocols, it is easy to construct efficient implementations of common synchronization and communication mechanisms. Because these are user-level messages, the set of available primitives is extended easily with language-or application-specific mechanisms. CarlOS, an experimental prototype for evaluating this approach, is derived from the lazy release consistent memory of TreadMarks. We describe the message-driven coherency memory model used in CarlOS, and we examine the performance of several applications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 消息传递和分布式共享内存在分布式并行编程中各有其优缺点。我们通过提出一种新的消息驱动一致性机制，将两者集成到单个系统中。携带显式因果注释的消息被交换以触发内存一致性操作。通过向基于消息的标准协议添加注释，可以轻松构建常见同步和通信机制的高效实现。由于这些是用户级消息，可用原语集可以轻松扩展语言或应用特定的机制。CarlOS是一个用于评估该方法的实验原型，它源自TreadMarks的宽松释放一致性内存。我们描述了CarlOS中使用的消息驱动一致性内存模型，并检查了几个应用程序的性能。

upstream_only.title: Software write detection for a distributed shared memory
upstream_only.abstract: Most software-based distributed shared memory (DSM) systems rely on the operating system's virtual memory interface to detect writes to shared data. Strategies based on virtual memory page protection create two problems for a DSM system. First, writes can have high overhead since they are detected with a page fault. As a result, a page must be written many times to amortize the cost of that fault. Second, the size of a virtual memory page is too big to serve as a unit of coherency, inducing false sharing. Mechanisms to handle false sharing can increase runtime overhead and may cause data to be unnecessarily communicated between processors.In this paper, we present a new method for write detection that solves these problems. Our method relies on the compiler and runtime system to detect writes to shared data without invoking the operating system. We measure and compare implementations of a distributed shared memory system using both strategies, virtual memory and compiler/runtime, running a range of applications on a small scale distributed memory multicomputer. We show that the new method has low average write latency and supports fine-grained sharing with low overhead. Further, we show that the dominant cost of write detection with either strategy is due to the mechanism used to handle fine-grain sharing.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大多数基于软件的分布式共享内存（DSM）系统依赖操作系统的虚拟内存接口来检测对共享数据的写入。基于虚拟内存页保护策略会给DSM系统带来两个问题。首先，写入开销可能很高，因为需要通过页故障来检测写入，因此必须多次写入一个页才能摊销该故障的成本。其次，虚拟内存页的大小太大，无法作为一致性单元，导致虚假共享。处理虚假共享的机制会增加运行时开销，并可能导致数据在处理器之间不必要地传输。本文提出了一种新的写检测方法来解决这些问题。该方法依靠编译器和运行时系统来检测对共享数据的写入，而无需调用操作系统。我们在小型分布式内存多计算机上运行一系列应用程序，测量并比较了使用两种策略（虚拟内存和编译器/运行时）实现的分布式共享内存系统。我们证明新方法具有较低的平均写入延迟，并支持低开销的细粒度共享。此外，我们表明，无论采用哪种策略，写检测的主要成本都归因于用于处理细粒度共享的机制。

upstream_only.title: The design and evaluation of a shared object system for distributed memory machines
upstream_only.abstract: This paper describes the design and evaluation of SAM, a shared object system for distributed memory machines. SAM is a portable run-time system that provides a global name space and automatic caching of shared data. SAM incorporates mechanisms to address the problem of high communication overheads on distributed memory machines; these mechanisms include tying synchronization to data access, chaotic access to data, prefetching of data, and pushing of data to remote processors. SAM has been implemented on the CM-5, Intel iPSC/860 and Paragon, IBM SP1, and networks of workstations running PVM. SAM applications run on all these platforms without modification.This paper provides an extensive analysis on several complex scientific algorithms written in SAM on a variety of hardware platforms. We find that the performance of these SAM applications depends fundamentally on the scalability of the underlying parallel algorithm, and whether the algorithm's communication requirements can be satisfied by the hardware. Our experience suggests that SAM is successful in allowing programmers to use distributed memory machines effectively with much less programming effort than required today.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文描述了SAM的设计与评估，SAM是一种面向分布式内存机器的共享对象系统。SAM是一个可移植的运行时系统，提供全局命名空间和共享数据的自动缓存。SAM包含解决分布式内存机器高通信开销问题的机制；这些机制包括将同步与数据访问绑定、数据混沌访问、数据预取以及将数据推送到远程处理器。SAM已在CM-5、Intel iPSC/860和Paragon、IBM SP1以及运行PVM的工作站网络上实现。SAM应用程序无需修改即可在所有平台上运行。本文对在多种硬件平台上用SAM编写的几个复杂科学算法进行了广泛分析。我们发现，这些SAM应用程序的性能从根本上取决于底层并行算法的可扩展性，以及该算法的通信需求是否能被硬件满足。我们的经验表明，SAM成功地将程序员从对分布式内存机器的低效使用中解放出来，并且所需的编程工作量远少于当前所需。

upstream_only.title: Performance issues in parallelized network protocols
upstream_only.abstract: Parallel processing has been proposed as a means of improving network protocol throughput. Several different strategies have been taken towards parallelizing protocols. A relatively popular approach is packet-level parallelism, where packets are distributed across processors.This paper provides an experimental performance study of packet-level parallelism on a contemporary shared-memory multiprocessor. We examine several unexplored areas in packet-level parallelism and investigate how various protocol structuring and implementation techniques can affect performance. We study TCP/IP and UDP/IP protocol stacks, implemented with a parallel version of the x-kernel running in user space on Silicon Graphics multiprocessors.Our results show that only limited packet-level parallelism can be achieved within a single connection under TCP, but that using multiple connections can improve available parallelism. We also demonstrate that packet ordering plays a key role in determining single-connection TCP performance, that careful use of locks is a necessity, and that selective exploitation of caching can improve throughput. We also describe experiments that compare parallel protocol performance on two generations of a parallel machine and show how computer architectural trends can influence performance.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 并行处理已被提议作为提高网络协议吞吐量的一种手段。在协议并行化上采取了多种不同策略。一种相对流行的方法是包级并行，其中数据包被分配到多个处理器。本文对当代共享内存多处理器上的包级并行进行了实验性能研究。我们考察了包级并行中若干未探索的领域，并调查了各种协议结构和实现技术如何影响性能。我们研究了基于并行版本的x-kernel实现的TCP/IP和UDP/IP协议栈，运行在Silicon Graphics多处理器的用户空间。我们的结果表明，在TCP下单个连接内只能实现有限的包级并行性，但使用多个连接可以提高可用的并行性。我们还证明，包序在决定单连接TCP性能中起关键作用，仔细使用锁是必要的，选择性利用缓存可以提高吞吐量。我们还描述了在一台并行机器的两代产品上比较并行协议性能的实验，并展示了计算机体系结构趋势如何影响性能。

upstream_only.title: Experiences with locking in a NUMA multiprocessor operating system kernel
upstream_only.abstract: We describe the locking architecture of a new operating system, HURRICANE, designed for large scale shared-memory multiprocessors. Many papers already describe kernel locking techniques, and some of the techniques we use have been previously described by others. However, our work is novel in the particular combination of techniques used, as well as several of the individual techniques themselves. Moreover, it is the way the techniques work together that is the source of our performance advantages and scalability. Briefly, we use: • a hybrid coarse-grain/fine-grain locking strategy that has the low latency and space overhead of a coarse-grain locking strategy while having the high concurrency of a fine-grain locking strategy; • replication of data structures to increase access bandwidth and improve concurrency; • a clustered kernel that bounds the number of processors that can compete for a lock so as to reduce second order effects such as memory and interconnect contention; • Distributed Locks to further reduce second order effects, with modifications that reduce the uncontended latency of these locks to close to that of spin locks.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们描述了一个面向大规模共享内存多处理器设计的新操作系统HURRICANE的锁架构。已有许多论文描述了内核锁技术，我们使用的某些技术也已被他人描述过。然而，我们的工作在新颖之处在于所采用的特定技术组合，以及若干独立技术本身。而且，正是这些技术协同工作的方式带来了我们的性能优势和可扩展性。简言之，我们使用了：• 一种混合粗粒度/细粒度锁策略，它兼具粗粒度锁策略的低延迟和低空间开销，同时拥有细粒度锁策略的高并发性；• 复制数据结构以增加访问带宽并提高并发性；• 集群化内核，限制可竞争同一把锁的处理器数量，以减少内存和互连争用等二阶效应；• 分布式锁以进一步减少二阶效应，并对其进行了修改，使无竞争状态下的延迟接近自旋锁。

upstream_only.title: HiPEC: high performance external virtual memory caching
upstream_only.abstract: Traditional operating systems use a fixed LRU-like page replacement policy and centralized frame pool that cannot properly serve all types of memory access patterns of various applications As a result many memory-intensive applications such as databases multimedia applications and scientific simulators induce excessive page faults and page replacement when running on top of existing operating systems.This paper presents a High Performance External virtual memory Caching mechanism (HiPEC) to provide applications with their own specific page replacement management. The user specific policy programmed in the HiPEC command set is stored in user address space. When a page fault occurs the kernel fetches and interprets the corresponding policy commands to perform the user specific page replacement management. Experimental results show that HiPEC induces little overhead and can significantly improve performance for memory-intensive applications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 传统操作系统使用固定的类LRU页面替换策略和集中式帧池，无法适当地服务于各种应用程序的各种内存访问模式。因此，许多内存密集型应用程序（如数据库、多媒体应用和科学模拟器）在现有操作系统上运行时，会引发过度的缺页错误和页面替换。本文提出了一种高性能外部虚拟内存缓存机制（HiPEC），为应用程序提供它们自己的特定页面替换管理。在HiPEC命令集中编程的用户特定策略存储在用户地址空间中。当缺页错误发生时，内核获取并解释相应的策略命令，以执行用户特定的页面替换管理。实验结果表明，HiPEC引入的开销很小，并且可以显著提高内存密集型应用的性能。

upstream_only.title: Implementation and performance of application-controlled file caching
upstream_only.abstract: Traditional file system implementations do not allow applications to control file caching replacement decisions. We have implemented two-level replacement, a scheme that allows applications to control their own cache replacement, while letting the kernel control the allocation of cache space among processes. We designed an interface to let applications exert control on replacement via a set of directives to the kernel. This is effective and requires low overhead.We demonstrate that for applications that do not perform well under traditional caching policies, the combination of good application-chosen replacement strategies, and our kernel allocation policy LRU-SP, can reduce the number of block I/Os by up to 80\%, and can reduce the elapsed time by up to 45\%. We also show that LRU-SP is crucial to the performance improvement for multiple concurrent applications: LRU-SP fairly distributes cache blocks and offers protection against foolish applications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 传统文件系统实现不允许应用程序控制文件缓存的替换决策。我们实现了两级替换方案，该方案允许应用程序控制自身的缓存替换，同时让内核控制各进程间缓存空间的分配。我们设计了一个接口，让应用程序通过一组内核指令来施加对替换策略的控制。这种方法有效且开销较低。我们证明，对于在传统缓存策略下表现不佳的应用程序，良好的应用程序自选替换策略与我们的内核分配策略 LRU-SP 相结合，可以减少最多 80% 的块 I/O，并缩短最多 45% 的运行时间。我们还表明，对于多个并发应用，LRU-SP 对性能提升至关重要：它能公平地分配缓存块，并防止轻率应用程序造成干扰。

upstream_only.title: A caching model of operating system kernel functionality
upstream_only.abstract: Operating system research has endeavored to develop micro-kernels that provide modularity, reliability and security improvements over conventional monolithic kernels. However, the resulting kernels have been slower, larger and more error-prone than desired. These efforts have also failed to provide sufficient application control of resource management required by sophisticated applications.This paper describes a caching model of operating system functionality as implemented in the Cache Kernel, the supervisor-mode component of the V++ operating system. The Cache Kernel caches operating system objects such as threads and address spaces just as conventional hardware caches memory data. User-mode application kernels handle the loading and writeback of these objects, implementing application-specific management policies and mechanisms. Experience with implementing the Cache Kernel and measurements of its performance on a multiprocessor suggest that the caching model can provide competitive performance with conventional monolithic operating systems, yet provides application-level control of system resources, better modularity, better scalability, smaller size and a basis for fault containment.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 操作系统研究一直致力于开发微内核，以提供比传统单内核更好的模块化、可靠性和安全性。然而，由此产生的内核比期望的更慢、更大且更容易出错。这些努力也未能为复杂应用提供所需的资源管理控制。本文描述了在V++操作系统的监管模式组件Cache Kernel中实现的操作系统功能的缓存模型。Cache Kernel像传统硬件缓存内存数据一样缓存线程和地址空间等操作系统对象。用户态应用内核负责这些对象的加载和写回，实现应用特定的管理策略和机制。在Cache Kernel上的实现经验及在多处理器上的性能测量表明，缓存模型可以提供与传统单内核操作系统相当的性能，同时提供应用级的系统资源控制、更好的模块化、更好的可扩展性、更小的体积以及故障隔离的基础。

upstream_only.title: Distributed filaments: efficient fine-grain parallelism on a cluster of workstations
upstream_only.abstract: A fine-grain parallel program is one in which processes are typically small ranging from a few to a few hundred instructions. Fine-grain parallelism arises naturally in many situations such as iterative grid computations recursive fork/join programs the bodies of parallel FOR loops and the implicit parallelism in functional or dataflow languages. It is useful both to describe massively parallel computations and as a target for code generation by compilers. However fine-grain parallelism has long been thought to be inefficient due to the overheads of process creation context switching, and synchronization. This paper describes a software kernel. Distributed Filaments (DF) that implements fine-grain parallelism both portably and efficiently on a workstation cluster DF runs on existing off-the-shelf hardware and software. It has a simple interface so it is easy to use. DF achieves e ciency by using stateless threads on each node overlapping communication and computation, employing a new reliable datagram communication protocol and automatically balancing the work generated by fork/join computations.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 细粒度并行程序是指进程通常很小（从几条到几百条指令）的程序。细粒度并行在多种情况下自然出现，例如迭代网格计算、递归分叉/汇合程序、并行FOR循环体以及函数式或数据流语言中的隐式并行。它既可用于描述大规模并行计算，也可作为编译器代码生成的目标。然而，由于进程创建、上下文切换和同步的开销，细粒度并行长期以来被认为效率低下。本文描述了一个软件内核——分布式细丝（DF），它能在工作站集群上可移植且高效地实现细粒度并行。DF在现有的现成硬件和软件上运行，具有简单的接口，易于使用。DF通过在每个节点上使用无状态线程，重叠通信与计算，采用新的可靠数据报通信协议，并自动平衡fork/join计算产生的工作来实现高效。

upstream_only.title: Integrating coherency and recoverability in distributed systems
upstream_only.abstract: We propose a technique for maintaining coherency of a transactional distributed shared memory, used by applications accessing a shared persistent store. Our goal is to improve support for fine-grained distributed data sharing in collaborative design applications, such as CAD systems and software development environments. In contrast, traditional research in distributed shared memory has focused on supporting parallel programs; in this paper, we show how distributed programs can benefit from this shared-memory abstraction as well.Our approach, called log-based coherency, integrates coherency support with a standard mechanism for ensuring recoverability of persistent data. In our system, transaction logs are the basis of both recoverability and coherency. We have prototyped log-based coherency as a set of extensions to RVM [Satyanarayanan et al. 94], a runtime package supporting recoverable virtual memory. Our prototype adds coherency support to RVM in a simple way that does not require changes to existing RVM applications. We report on our prototype and its performance, and discuss its relationship to other DSM systems.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种维护事务性分布式共享内存一致性的技术，该技术用于访问共享持久存储的应用程序。我们的目标是改进协作设计应用程序（如CAD系统和软件开发环境）中细粒度分布式数据共享的支持。相比之下，传统的分布式共享内存研究侧重于支持并行程序；在本文中，我们展示了分布式程序如何也能从这种共享内存抽象中受益。我们的方法称为基于日志的一致性，它将一致性支持与确保持久数据可恢复性的标准机制集成在一起。在我们的系统中，事务日志既是可恢复性也是一致性的基础。我们已经将基于日志的一致性原型化为RVM（一种支持可恢复虚拟内存的运行时包）的一组扩展。我们的原型以一种简单的方式向RVM添加了一致性支持，而无需更改现有的RVM应用程序。我们报告了我们的原型及其性能，并讨论了它与其他DSM系统的关系。

upstream_only.title: Garbage collection and DSM consistency
upstream_only.abstract: This paper presents the design of a copying garbage collector for persistent distributed shared objects in a loosely coupled network with weakly consistent distributed shared memory (DSM). The main goal of the design for this garbage collector is to minimize the communication overhead due to collection between nodes of the system, and to avoid any interference with the DSM memory consistency protocol. Our design is based on the observation that, in a weakly consistent DSM system, the memory consistency requirements of the garbage collector are less strict than those of the applications. Thus, the garbage collector reclaims objects independently of other copies of the same objects without interfering with the DSM consistency protocol. Furthermore, our design does not require reliable communication support, and is capable of reclaiming distributed cycles of dead objects.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种在松散耦合网络和弱一致分布式共享内存（DSM）环境下，针对持久化分布式共享对象的复制式垃圾收集器设计。该垃圾收集器的主要设计目标是最大限度减少因节点间收集而产生的通信开销，并避免干扰DSM内存一致性协议。我们的设计基于以下观察：在弱一致DSM系统中，垃圾收集器的内存一致性要求比应用程序更宽松。因此，垃圾收集器可以独立于同一对象的其他副本回收对象，而不会干扰DSM一致性协议。此外，我们的设计不需要可靠的通信支持，并且能够回收分布式死对象循环。

upstream_only.title: Software prefetching and caching for translation lookaside buffers
upstream_only.abstract: A number of interacting trends in operating system structure, processor architecture, and memory systems are increasing both the rate of translation lookaside buffer (TLB) misses and the cost of servicing amiss. This paper presents two novel software schemes, implemented under Mach 3.0, to decrease both the number and the cost of kernel TLB misses (i.e., misses on kernel data structures, including user page tables). The first scheme is a new use of prefetching for TLB entries on the IPC path, and the second scheme is a new use of software caching of TLB entries for hierarchical page table organizations.For a range of applications, prefetching decreases the number of kernel TLB misses by 40\% to 50\%, and caching decreases TLB penalties by providing a fast path for over 90\% of the misses. Our caching scheme also decreases the number of nested TLB traps due to the page table hierarchy, reducing the number of kernel TLB miss traps for applications by 20\% to 40\%. Prefetching and caching, when used alone, each improve application performance by up to 3.5\%; when used together, they improve application performance by up to 3\%. On synthetic benchmarks that involve frequent communication among several different address spaces (and thus put more pressure on the TLB), prefetching improves overall performance by about 6\%, caching improves overall performance by about 10\%, and the two used together improve overall performance by about 12\%.Our techniques are very effective in reducing kernel TLB penalties, which currently range from 1\% to 5\% of application runtime for the benchmarks studied. Since processor speeds continue to increase relative to memory speeds, our schemes should be even more effective in improving application performance in future architectures.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 操作系统结构、处理器架构和内存系统中的一系列相互作用趋势正在增加转换后备缓冲区（TLB）缺失的频率以及处理缺失的成本。本文提出了两种在Mach 3.0下实现的新型软件方案，旨在减少内核TLB缺失（即内核数据结构（包括用户页表）上的缺失）的数量和成本。第一种方案是在IPC路径上对TLB条目进行预取的新用途；第二种方案是对分层页表组织的TLB条目进行软件缓存的新用途。对于一系列应用程序，预取将内核TLB缺失数量减少了40%至50%，而缓存通过为超过90%的缺失提供快速路径来减少TLB惩罚。我们的缓存方案还减少了由于页表层级导致的嵌套TLB陷阱数量，使应用程序的内核TLB缺失陷阱减少了20%至40%。单独使用预取和缓存，每项都能使应用程序性能提升高达3.5%；同时使用时，它们能使应用程序性能提升高达3%。在涉及多个不同地址空间之间频繁通信的合成基准测试中（从而对TLB施加更大压力），预取使整体性能提升约6%，缓存约提升10%，两者结合使用约提升12%。我们的技术在减少内核TLB惩罚方面非常有效，在研究的基准测试中，这些惩罚目前占应用程序运行时间的1%至5%。由于处理器速度相对于内存速度持续增长，我们的方案在未来架构中应能更有效地提高应用程序性能。

upstream_only.title: Cooperative caching: using remote client memory to improve file system performance
upstream_only.abstract: Emerging high-speed networks will allow machines to access remote data nearly as quickly as they can access local data. This trend motivates the use of cooperative caching: coordinating the file caches of many machines distributed on a LAN to form a more effective overall file cache. In this paper we examine four cooperative caching algorithms using a trace-driven simulation study. These simulations indicate that for the systems studied cooperative caching can halve the number of disk accesses, improving file system read response time by as much as 73\%. Based on these simulations we conclude that cooperative caching can significantly improve file system read response time and that relatively simple cooperative caching algorithms are sufficient to realize most of the potential performance gain.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 新兴的高速网络将允许机器几乎以访问本地数据的速度访问远程数据。这一趋势推动了协作式缓存的使用：协调局域网中多台机器的文件缓存，以形成一个更有效的整体文件缓存。在本文中，我们利用基于轨迹的模拟研究考察了四种协作式缓存算法。这些模拟表明，对于所研究的系统，协作式缓存可以将磁盘访问次数减半，将文件系统读取响应时间提高多达73%。基于这些模拟，我们得出结论：协作式缓存能够显著提高文件系统的读取响应时间，并且相对简单的协作式缓存算法就足以实现大部分潜在的性能提升。

upstream_only.title: Checking system rules using system-specific, programmer-written compiler extensions
upstream_only.abstract: Systems software such as OS kernels, embedded systems, and libraries must obey many rules for both correctness and performance. Common examples include "accesses to variable A must be guarded by lock B," "system calls must check user pointers for validity before using them," and "message handlers should free their buffers as quickly as possible to allow greater parallelism." Unfortunately, adherence to these rules is largely unchecked.This paper attacks this problem by showing how system implementors can use meta-level compilation (MC) to write simple, system-specific compiler extensions that automatically check their code for rule violations. By melding domain-specific knowledge with the automatic machinery of compilers, MC brings the benefits of language-level checking and optimizing to the higher, "meta" level of the systems implemented in these languages. This paper demonstrates the effectiveness of the MC approach by applying it to four complex, real systems: Linux, OpenBSD, the Xok exokernel, and the FLASH machine's embedded software. MC extensions found roughly 500 errors in these systems and led to numerous kernel patches. Most extensions were less than a hundred lines of code and written by implementors who had a limited understanding of the systems checked.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 系统软件（如操作系统内核、嵌入式系统和库）在正确性和性能方面必须遵守许多规则。常见例子包括“对变量A的访问必须由锁B保护”、“系统调用在用户指针使用前必须检查其有效性”以及“消息处理程序应尽快释放缓冲区以允许更大的并行性”。不幸的是，对这些规则的遵守在很大程度上未被检查。本文通过展示系统实现者如何使用元级编译（meta-level compilation, MC）编写简单的、系统特定的编译器扩展来自动检查其代码是否存在规则违规行为，来解决这一问题。通过将领域特定知识与编译器的自动机制相结合，MC将语言级检查和优化的优势提升到这些语言所实现的系统的更高“元”级别。本文通过对四个复杂的真实系统——Linux、OpenBSD、Xok外核和FLASH机器的嵌入式软件——应用MC方法，证明了MC方法的有效性。MC扩展在这些系统中发现了约500个错误，并促成了许多内核补丁。大多数扩展只有不到一百行代码，且由对被检查系统了解有限的实现者编写。

upstream_only.title: Devil: an IDL for hardware programming
upstream_only.abstract: To keep up with the frantic pace at which devices come out, drivers need to be quickly developed, debugged and tested. Although a driver is a critical system component, the driver development process has made little (if any) progress. The situation is particularly disastrous when considering the hardware operating code (i.e., the layer interacting with the device). Writing this code often relies on inaccurate or incomplete device documentation and involves assembly-level operations. As a result, hard-ware operating code is tedious to write, prone to errors, and hard to debug and maintain.This paper presents a new approach to developing hardware operating code based on an Interface Definition Language (IDL) for hard-ware functionalities, named Devil. This IDL allows a high-level definition of the communication with a device. A compiler automatically checks the consistency of a Devil definition and generates efficient low-level code.Because the Devil compiler checks safety critical properties, the long-awaited notion of robustness for hardware operating code is made possible. Finally, the wide variety of devices that we have already specified (mouse, sound, DMA, interrupt, Ethernet, video, and IDE disk controllers) demonstrates the expressiveness of the Devil language.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 为了跟上设备推出的疯狂节奏，驱动程序需要快速开发、调试和测试。尽管驱动程序是关键的组件，但驱动程序开发过程几乎没有取得进展。在处理硬件操作代码（即与设备交互的层）时，情况尤其糟糕。编写这些代码通常依赖于不准确或不完整的设备文档，并涉及汇编级操作。因此，硬件操作代码编写乏味、容易出错，且难以调试和维护。本文提出了一种基于硬件功能接口定义语言（IDL）的新型硬件操作代码开发方法，名为Devil。该IDL支持对设备通信进行高级定义。编译器自动检查Devil定义的一致性并生成高效的低级代码。由于Devil编译器检查安全关键属性，因此硬件操作代码期待已久的健壮性概念成为可能。最后，我们已经规范化的各种设备（鼠标、声音、DMA、中断、以太网、视频和IDE磁盘控制器）展示了Devil语言的表达力。

upstream_only.title: Taming the memory hogs: using compiler-inserted releases to manage physical memory intelligently
upstream_only.abstract: Out-of-core applications consume physical resources at a rapid rate, causing interactive applications sharing the same machine to exhibit poor response times. This behavior is the result of default resource management strategies in the OS that are inappropriate for memory-intensive applications. Using an approach that integrates compiler analysis with simple OS support and a run-time layer that adapts to dynamic conditions, we have shown that the impact of out-of-core applications on interactive ones can be greatly mitigated. A combination of prefetching pages that will soon be needed, and releasing pages no longer in use results in good throughput for the out-of-core task and good response time for the interactive one. Each class of application performs well according to the metric most important to it. In addition, the OS does not need to attempt to identify these application classes, or modify its default resource management policies in any way. We also observe that when an out-of-core application releases pages, it both improves the response time of interactive tasks, and also improves its own performance through better replacement decisions and reduced memory management overhead.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 外核（超出内存）应用程序会快速消耗物理资源，导致共享同一机器的交互式应用响应时间变差。这一行为是操作系统默认资源管理策略对于内存密集型应用不适用的结果。我们采用一种将编译器分析与简单操作系统支持以及适应动态条件的运行时层相结合的方法，证明了可以大幅减轻外核应用对交互应用的影响。预取即将需要的页面与释放不再使用的页面相结合，使得外核任务获得良好吞吐量，交互任务获得良好响应时间。每类应用都能根据对其最重要的指标表现良好。此外，操作系统无需尝试识别这些应用类别，或以任何方式修改其默认资源管理策略。我们还注意到，当外核应用释放页面时，既改善了交互任务的响应时间，也通过更佳的替换决策和降低内存管理开销改进了其自身性能。

upstream_only.title: Surplus fair scheduling: a proportional-share CPU scheduling algorithm for symmetric multiprocessors
upstream_only.abstract: In this paper, we present surplus fair scheduling (SFS), a proportional-share CPU scheduler designed for symmetric multiprocessors. We first show that the infeasibility of certain weight assignments in multiprocessor environments results in unfairness or starvation in many existing proportional-share schedulers. We present a novel weight readjustment algorithm to translate infeasible weight assignments to a set of feasible weights. We show that weight readjustment enables existing proportional-share schedulers to significantly reduce, but not eliminate, the unfairness in their allocations. We then present surplus fair scheduling, a proportional-share scheduler that is designed explicitly for multiprocessor environments. We implement our scheduler in the Linux kernel and demonstrate its efficacy through an experimental evaluation. Our results show that SFS can achieve proportionate allocation, application isolation and good interactive performance, albeit at a slight increase in scheduling overhead. We conclude from our results that a proportional-share scheduler such as SFS is not only practical but also desirable for server operating systems.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文提出剩余公平调度（SFS），一种为对称多处理器设计的比例共享CPU调度器。我们首先表明在多处理器环境中，某些权重分配在可行性上的问题会导致许多现有比例共享调度器出现不公平或饥饿现象。我们提出一种新颖的权重重新调整算法，将不可行的权重分配转换为一组可行权重。我们证明权重重新调整能够使现有比例共享调度器显著减少但不消除其分配中的不公平性。然后我们提出剩余公平调度，这是一种专门为多处理器环境设计的比例共享调度器。我们将调度器实现在Linux内核中，并通过实验评估证明其有效性。结果表明，尽管调度开销略有增加，SFS能够实现比例分配、应用隔离和良好的交互性能。我们得出结论，像SFS这样的比例共享调度器不仅是实用的，而且对于服务器操作系统也是可取的。

upstream_only.title: Performance-driven processor allocation
upstream_only.abstract: This work is focused on processor allocation in shared-memory multiprocessor systems, where no knowledge of the application is available when applications are submitted. We perform the processor allocation taking into account the characteristics of the application measured at run-time. We want to demonstrate the importance of an accurate performance analysis and the criteria used to distribute the processors. With this aim, we present the SelfAnalyzer, an approach to dynamically analyzing the performance of applications (speedup, efficiency and execution time), and the Performance-Driven Processor Allocation (PDPA), a new scheduling policy that distributes processors considering both the global conditions of the system and the particular characteristics of running applications. This work also defends the importance of the interaction between the medium-term and the long-term scheduler to control the multiprogramming level in the case of the clairvoyant scheduling pol-icies1. We have implemented our proposal in an SGI Origin2000 with 64 processors and we have compared its performance with that of some scheduling policies proposed so far and with the native IRIX scheduling policy. Results show that the combination of the SelfAnalyzer+PDPA with the medium/long-term scheduling interaction outperforms the rest of the scheduling policies evaluated. The evaluation shows that in workloads where a simple equipartition performs well, the PDPA also performs well, and in extreme workloads where all the applications have a bad performance, our proposal can achieve a speedup of 3.9 with respect to an equipartition and 11.8 with respect to the native IRIX scheduling policy.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 这项工作集中于共享内存多处理器系统中的处理器分配，其中在提交应用程序时不知道应用程序的任何信息。我们根据运行时测量的应用程序特征来执行处理器分配。我们想证明准确的性能分析和用于分配处理器的标准的重要性。为此，我们提出了SelfAnalyzer，一种动态分析应用程序性能（加速比、效率和执行时间）的方法，以及性能驱动处理器分配（PDPA），一种新的调度策略，它同时考虑系统的全局条件和运行应用程序的特定特征来分配处理器。这项工作还捍卫了中期调度器和长期调度器之间交互的重要性，以控制先见性调度策略情况下的多程序级别1。我们已经在具有64个处理器的SGI Origin2000上实现了我们的提议，并将其性能与迄今为止提出的一些调度策略以及本机IRIX调度策略进行了比较。结果表明，SelfAnalyzer+PDPA与中期/长期调度交互的组合优于所评估的其他调度策略。评估表明，在简单均分运行良好的工作负载中，PDPA也表现出色；在极端工作负载下（即所有应用程序性能不佳时），与均分相比，我们的提议可以实现3.9的加速比，与本机IRIX调度策略相比可实现11.8的加速比。

upstream_only.title: Policies for dynamic clock scheduling
upstream_only.abstract: Pocket computers are beginning to emerge that provide sufficient processing capability and memory capacity to run traditional desktop applications and operating systems on them. The increasing demand placed on these systems by software is competing against the continuing trend in the design of low-power microprocessors towards increasing the amount of computation per unit of energy. Consequently, in spite of advances in low-power circuit design, the microprocessor is likely to continue to account for a significant portion of the overall power consumption of pocket computers.This paper investigates clock scaling algorithms on the Itsy, an experimental pocket computer that runs a complete, functional multitasking operating system (a version of Linux 2.0.30). We implemented a number of clock scaling algorithms that are used to adjust the processor speed to reduce the power used by the processor. After testing these algorithms, we conclude that currently proposed algorithms consistently fail to achieve their goal of saving power while not causing user applications to change their interactive behavior.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 口袋电脑开始出现，具备足够的处理能力和内存容量来运行传统的桌面应用程序和操作系统。软件对这些系统日益增长的需求，与低功耗微处理器设计领域中增加每单位能量计算量的持续趋势形成竞争。因此，尽管低功耗电路设计取得了进步，微处理器仍可能占据口袋电脑总功耗的显著部分。本文研究了Itsy上的时钟缩放算法，Itsy是一台运行完整的多任务操作系统（Linux 2.0.30的一个版本）的实验性口袋电脑。我们实现了多种时钟缩放算法，用于调整处理器速度以减少处理器功耗。在测试这些算法后，我们得出结论：目前提出的算法始终未能实现节省功耗且不改变用户应用程序交互行为的目标。

upstream_only.title: Towards higher disk head utilization: extracting free bandwidth from busy disk drives
upstream_only.abstract: Freeblock scheduling is a new approach to utilizing more of a disk's potential media bandwidth. By filling rotational latency periods with useful media transfers, 20-50\% of a never-idle disk's bandwidth can often be provided to background applications with no effect on foreground response times. This paper describes freeblock scheduling and demonstrates its value with simulation studies of two concrete applications: segment cleaning and data mining. Free segment cleaning often allows an LFS file system to maintain its ideal write performance when cleaning overheads would otherwise reduce performance by up to a factor of three. Free data mining can achieve over 47 full disk scans per day on an active transaction processing system, with no effect on its disk performance.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 自由块调度是一种利用磁盘潜在介质带宽的新方法。通过在旋转延迟期间填充有用的介质传输，一个从不空闲的磁盘的带宽中通常有20%-50%可以提供给后台应用程序，而对前台响应时间没有影响。本文描述了自由块调度，并通过两个具体应用的模拟研究展示了其价值：段清理和数据挖掘。自由段清理通常能使LFS文件系统在清理开销本会使性能降低至多三倍的情况下，保持其理想的写入性能。自由数据挖掘可以在活跃的事务处理系统上每天实现超过47次全盘扫描，而对其磁盘性能没有影响。

upstream_only.title: Latency management in storage systems
upstream_only.abstract: Storage Latency Estimation Descriptors, or SLEDs, are an API that allow applications to understand and take advantage of the dynamic state of a storage system. By accessing data in the file system cache or high-speed storage first, total I/O workloads can be reduced and performance improved. SLEDs report estimated data latency, allowing users, system utilities, and scripts to make file access decisions based on those retrieval time estimates. SLEDs thus can be used to improve individual application performance, reduce system workloads, and improve the user experience with more predictable behavior.We have modified the Linux 2.2 kernel to support SLEDs, and several Unix utilities and astronomical applications have been modified to use them. As a result, execution times of the Unix utilities when data file sizes exceed the size of the file system buffer cache have been reduced from 50\% up to more than an order of magnitude. The astronomical applications incurred 30-50\% fewer page faults and reductions in execution time of 10-35\%. Performance of applications which use SLEDs also degrade more gracefully as data file size grows.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 存储延迟估计描述符（SLEDs）是一种API，允许应用程序理解并利用存储系统的动态状态。通过优先访问文件系统缓存或高速存储中的数据，可以减少总的I/O工作负载并提高性能。SLEDs报告估计的数据延迟，使用户、系统实用程序和脚本能够基于这些检索时间估计做出文件访问决策。因此，SLEDs可用于提高单个应用程序性能、减少系统工作负载，并通过更可预测的行为改善用户体验。我们修改了Linux 2.2内核以支持SLEDs，并修改了几个Unix实用程序和天文学应用程序以使用它们。结果表明，当数据文件大小超过文件系统缓冲区缓存大小时，Unix实用程序的执行时间减少了50%到超过一个数量级。天文学应用程序的缺页错误减少了30-50%，执行时间减少了10-35%。使用SLEDs的应用程序在数据文件大小增长时，性能下降也更加平缓。

upstream_only.title: A low-overhead high-performance unified buffer management scheme that exploits sequential and looping references
upstream_only.abstract: In traditional file system implementations, the Least Recently Used (LRU) block replacement scheme is widely used to manage the buffer cache due to its simplicity and adaptability. However, the LRU scheme exhibits performance degradations because it does not make use of reference regularities such as sequential and looping references. In this paper, we present a Unified Buffer Management (UBM) scheme that exploits these regularities and yet, is simple to deploy. The UBM scheme automatically detects sequential and looping references and stores the detected blocks in separate partitions of the buffer cache. These partitions are managed by appropriate replacement schemes based on their detected patterns. The allocation problem among the divided partitions is also tackled with the use of the notion of marginal gains. In both trace-driven simulation experiments and experimental studies using an actual implementation in the FreeBSD operating system, the performance gains obtained through the use of this scheme are substantial. The results show that the hit ratios improve by as much as 57.7\% (with an average of 29.2\%) and the elapsed times are reduced by as much as 67.2\% (with an average of 28.7\%) compared to the LRU scheme for the workloads we used.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在传统文件系统实现中，最近最少使用（LRU）块替换方案因其简单性和适应性而被广泛用于管理缓冲区缓存。然而，由于LRU方案未利用顺序引用和循环引用等引用规律性，其性能会退化。本文提出了一种统一缓冲区管理（UBM）方案，该方案利用这些规律性且易于部署。UBM方案自动检测顺序引用和循环引用，并将检测到的块分别存储在缓冲区缓存的不同分区中。这些分区根据检测到的模式由适当的替换方案管理。分区间的分配问题也通过边际收益的概念来解决。在基于轨迹的模拟实验以及使用FreeBSD操作系统实际实现的实验研究中，使用该方案获得的性能提升显著。结果表明，与我们使用的工作负载上的LRU方案相比，命中率最多提升57.7%（平均提升29.2%），运行时间最多减少67.2%（平均减少28.7%）。

upstream_only.title: How to build a trusted database system on untrusted storage
upstream_only.abstract: Some emerging applications require programs to maintain sensitive state on untrusted hosts. This paper presents the architecture and implementation of a trusted database system, TDB, which leverages a small amount of trusted storage to protect a scalable amount of untrusted storage. The database is encrypted and validated against a collision-resistant hash kept in trusted storage, so untrusted programs cannot read the database or modify it undetectably. TDB integrates encryption and hashing with a low-level data model, which protects data and metadata uniformly, unlike systems built on top of a conventional database system. The implementation exploits synergies between hashing and log-structured storage. Preliminary performance results show that TDB outperforms an off-the-shelf embedded database system, thus supporting the suitability of the TDB architecture.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 一些新兴应用需要程序在不可信主机上维护敏感状态。本文介绍了一种可信数据库系统TDB的架构与实现，它利用少量可信存储来保护大规模不可信存储。数据库被加密，并通过存储在可信存储中的抗碰撞哈希进行校验，因此不可信程序无法读取数据库或在不可检测的情况下修改它。TDB将加密和哈希与一种低级数据模型集成，为数据和元数据提供统一保护，这不同于构建在传统数据库系统之上的方案。该实现利用了哈希与日志结构存储之间的协同效应。初步性能结果表明，TDB优于现成的嵌入式数据库系统，从而支持了TDB架构的适用性。

upstream_only.title: End-to-end authorization
upstream_only.abstract: Many boundaries impede the flow of authorization information, forcing applications that span those boundaries into hop-by-hop approaches to authorization. We present a unified approach to authorization. Our approach allows applications that span administrative, network, abstraction, and protocol boundaries to understand the end-to-end authority that justifies any given request. The resulting distributed systems are more secure and easier to audit.We describe boundaries that can interfere with end-to-end authorization, and outline our unified approach. We describe the system we built and the applications we adapted to use our unified authorization system, and measure its costs. We conclude that our system is a practical approach to the desirable goal of end-to-end authorization.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 许多边界阻碍了授权信息的流动，迫使跨越这些边界的应用程序采用逐跳（hop-by-hop）的授权方式。我们提出了一种统一的授权方法。该方法允许跨越管理、网络、抽象和协议边界的应用程序理解证明任何给定请求合理性的端到端权威。由此产生的分布式系统更安全且更易于审计。我们描述了可能干扰端到端授权的边界，并概述了我们的统一方法。我们描述了构建的系统以及为使用统一授权系统而改造的应用程序，并衡量了其成本。我们得出结论，我们的系统是实现端到端授权这一目标的一种实用方法。

upstream_only.title: Self-securing storage: protecting data in compromised system
upstream_only.abstract: Self-securing storage prevents intruders from undetectably tampering with or permanently deleting stored data. To accomplish this, self-securing storage devices internally audit all requests and keep old versions of data for a window of time, regardless of the commands received from potentially compromised host operating systems. Within the window, system administrators have this valuable information for intrusion diagnosis and recovery. Our implementation, called S4, combines log-structuring with journal-based metadata to minimize the performance costs of comprehensive versioning. Experiments show that self-securing storage devices can deliver performance that is comparable with conventional storage systems. In addition, analyses indicate that several weeks worth of all versions can reasonably be kept on state-of-the-art disks, especially when differencing and compression technologies are employed.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 自安全存储可防止入侵者不被察觉地篡改或永久删除存储的数据。为实现这一目标，自安全存储设备会内部审计所有请求，并在一定时间窗口内保留数据的旧版本，无论其收到的来自可能已受损主机操作系统的命令是什么。在该时间窗口内，系统管理员可获得这些宝贵信息以进行入侵诊断和恢复。我们的实现称为S4，它将日志结构技术与基于日志的元数据相结合，以最大限度地降低全面版本化的性能成本。实验表明，自安全存储设备可提供与传统存储系统相当的性能。此外，分析表明，在现有磁盘上合理保留数周的所有版本是可行的，尤其是在使用差分和压缩技术的情况下。

upstream_only.title: Fast and secure distributed read-only file system
upstream_only.abstract: Internet users increasingly rely on publicly available data for everything from software installation to investment decisions. Unfortunately, the vast majority of public content on the Internet comes with no integrity or authenticity guarantees. This paper presents the self-certifying read-only file system, a content distribution system providing secure, scalable access to public, read-only data.The read-only file system makes the security of published content independent from that of the distribution infrastructure. In a secure area (perhaps off-line), a publisher creates a digitally-signed database out of a file system's contents. The publisher then replicates the database on untrusted content-distribution servers, allowing for high availability. The read-only file system protocol furthermore pushes the cryptographic cost of content verification entirely onto clients, allowing servers to scale to a large number of clients. Measurements of an implementation show that an individual server running on a 550 Mhz Pentium III with FreeBSD can support 1,012 connections per second and 300 concurrent clients compiling a large software package.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 互联网用户越来越依赖公开可用的数据进行从软件安装到投资决策的一切活动。不幸的是，互联网上绝大多数公开内容都没有完整性或真实性保证。本文介绍了自认证只读文件系统（self-certifying read-only file system），这是一种提供对公共只读数据进行安全、可扩展访问的内容分发系统。只读文件系统使已发布内容的安全性独立于分发基础设施的安全性。在安全区域（可能离线），发布者使用文件系统的内容创建数字签名的数据库。然后，发布者将数据库复制到不受信任的内容分发服务器上，以实现高可用性。只读文件系统协议还将内容验证的密码学成本完全推给客户端，使服务器能够扩展到大量客户端。对实现的测量表明，一台运行FreeBSD的550 MHz Pentium III服务器每秒可以支持1,012个连接，并能支持300个并发客户端编译大型软件包。

upstream_only.title: Overcast: reliable multicasting with on overlay network
upstream_only.abstract: Overcast is an application-level multicasting system that can be incrementally deployed using today's Internet infrastructure. These properties stem from Overcast's implementation as an overlay network. An overlay network consists of a collection of nodes placed at strategic locations in an existing network fabric. These nodes implement a network abstraction on top of the network provided by the underlying substrate network.Overcast provides scalable and reliable single-source multicast using a simple protocol for building efficient data distribution trees that adapt to changing network conditions. To support fast joins, Overcast implements a new protocol for efficiently tracking the global status of a changing distribution tree.Results based on simulations confirm that Overcast provides its added functionality while performing competitively with IP Multicast. Simulations indicate that Overcast quickly builds bandwidth-efficient distribution trees that, compared to IP Multicast, provide 70\%-100\% of the total bandwidth possible, at a cost of somewhat less than twice the network load. In addition, Overcast adapts quickly to changes caused by the addition of new nodes or the failure of existing nodes without causing undue load on the multicast source.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Overcast是一个应用层多播系统，可以利用当今的互联网基础设施进行增量部署。这些特性源于Overcast作为覆盖网络的实现。覆盖网络由放置在现有网络结构中战略位置的一组节点组成。这些节点在底层网络提供的网络之上实现网络抽象。Overcast通过简单的协议构建高效的数据分发树，并适应变化的网络条件，从而提供可扩展且可靠的单源多播。为了支持快速加入，Overcast实现了一种新协议，以高效跟踪变化的分发树的全局状态。基于仿真的结果确认，Overcast在提供其附加功能的同时，其性能与IP多播相当。仿真表明，Overcast能够快速构建带宽高效的分发树，与IP多播相比，可提供总带宽的70%\%-100%，而代价是网络负载略低于两倍。此外，Overcast能快速适应新节点加入或现有节点故障引起的变化，而不会给多播源带来过重负载。

upstream_only.title: System support for bandwidth management and content adaptation in internet applications
upstream_only.abstract: This paper describes the implementation and evaluation of an operating system module, the Congestion Manager (CM), which provides integrated network flow management and exports a convenient programming interface that allows applications to be notified of, and adapt to, changing network conditions. We describe the API by which applications interface with the CM, and the architectural considerations that factored into the design. To evaluate the architecture and API, we describe our implementations of TCP; a streaming layered audio/video application; and an interactive audio application using the CM, and show that they achieve adaptive behavior without incurring much end-system overhead. All flows including TCP benefit from the sharing of congestion information, and applications are able to incorporate new functionality such as congestion control and adaptive behavior.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文描述了操作系统模块——拥塞管理器（CM）的实现与评估，该模块提供集成的网络流管理，并导出一个便捷的编程接口，使应用程序能够获知并适应不断变化的网络条件。我们描述了应用程序与CM交互的API，以及影响其设计的架构考量。为评估该架构和API，我们描述了使用CM实现的TCP、流式分层音/视频应用和交互式音频应用，并表明它们实现了自适应行为而不会产生太多端系统开销。包括TCP在内的所有流都受益于拥塞信息的共享，应用程序能够整合诸如拥塞控制和自适应行为等新功能。

upstream_only.title: Operating system management of MEMS-based storage devices
upstream_only.abstract: MEMS-based storage devices promise significant performance, reliability, and power improvements relative to disk drives. This paper compares and contrasts these two storage technologies and explores how the physical characteristics of MEMS-based storage devices change four aspects of operating system (OS) management: request scheduling, data placement, failure management, and power conservation. Straightforward adaptations of existing disk request scheduling algorithms are found to be appropriate for MEMS-based storage devices. A new bipartite data placement scheme is shown to better match these devices' novel mechanical positioning characteristics. With aggressive internal redundancy, MEMS-based storage devices can mask and tolerate failure modes that halt operation or cause data loss for disks. In addition, MEMS-based storage devices simplify power management because the devices can be stopped and started rapidly.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 基于MEMS的存储设备相较于磁盘驱动器，承诺在性能、可靠性和功耗方面有显著改进。本文比较和对比了这两种存储技术，并探讨了基于MEMS的存储设备的物理特性如何改变操作系统（OS）管理的四个方面：请求调度、数据放置、故障管理和功耗保护。研究发现，对现有磁盘请求调度算法的直接改编适用于基于MEMS的存储设备。一种新的二分数据放置方案能更好地匹配这些设备新颖的机械定位特性。通过积极的内部冗余，基于MEMS的存储设备可以掩盖和容忍那些会导致磁盘停止运行或数据丢失的故障模式。此外，基于MEMS的存储设备简化了电源管理，因为设备可以快速启动和停止。

upstream_only.title: Trading capacity for performance in a disk array
upstream_only.abstract: A variety of performance-enhancing techniques, such as striping, mirroring, and rotational data replication, exist in the disk array literature. Given a fixed budget of disks, one must intelligently choose what combination of these techniques to employ. In this paper, we present a way of designing disk arrays that can flexibly and systematically reduce seek and rotational delay in a balanced manner. We give analytical models that can guide an array designer towards optimal configurations by considering both disk and workload characteristics. We have implemented a prototype disk array that incorporates the configuration models. In the process, we have also developed a robust disk head position prediction mechanism without any hardware support. The resulting prototype demonstrates the effectiveness of the configuration models.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 磁盘阵列文献中存在多种性能增强技术，如条带化、镜像和旋转数据复制。在磁盘预算固定的情况下，必须智能地选择使用这些技术的组合。本文提出了一种设计磁盘阵列的方法，能够灵活且系统地以均衡的方式减少寻道和旋转延迟。我们给出了分析模型，通过考虑磁盘和工作负载特性，指导阵列设计者实现最优配置。我们实现了一个包含配置模型的原型磁盘阵列。在此过程中，我们还开发了一种无需硬件支持的鲁棒磁头位置预测机制。最终原型验证了配置模型的有效性。

upstream_only.title: Interposed request routing for scalable network storage
upstream_only.abstract: This paper explores interposed request routing in Slice, a new storage system architecture for high-speed networks incorporating network-attached block storage. Slice interposes a request switching filter - called a µproxy - along each client's network path to the storage service (e.g., in a network adapter or switch). The µproxy intercepts request traffic and distributes it across a server ensemble. We propose request routing schemes for I/O and file service traffic, and explore their effect on service structure.The Slice prototype uses a packet filter µproxy to virtualize the standard Network File System (NFS) protocol, presenting to NFS clients a unified shared file volume with scalable bandwidth and capacity. Experimental results from the industry-standard SPECsfs97 workload demonstrate that the architecture enables construction of powerful network-attached storage services by aggregating cost-effective components on a switched Gigabit Ethernet LAN.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了Slice中的插入式请求路由，Slice是一种面向高速网络的新型存储系统架构，集成了网络附加块存储。Slice在每个客户端通向存储服务的网络路径上（例如在网络适配器或交换机中）插入一个请求交换过滤器——称为µproxy。µproxy拦截请求流量，并将其分发到一组服务器上。我们提出了针对I/O和文件服务流量的请求路由方案，并探讨了它们对服务结构的影响。Slice原型使用一个包过滤µproxy来虚拟化标准的网络文件系统（NFS）协议，向NFS客户端提供一个具有可扩展带宽和容量的统一共享文件卷。来自行业标准SPECsfs97工作负载的实验结果表明，该架构通过在交换式千兆以太网局域网上聚合高性价比组件，能够构建强大的网络附加存储服务。

upstream_only.title: Proactive recovery in a Byzantine-fault-tolerant system
upstream_only.abstract: This paper describes an asynchronous state-machine replication system that tolerates Byzantine faults, which can be caused by malicious attacks or software errors. Our system is the first to recover Byzantine-faulty replicas proactively and it performs well because it uses symmetric rather than public-key cryptography for authentication. The recovery mechanism allows us to tolerate any number of faults over the lifetime of the system provided fewer than 1/3 of the replicas become faulty within a window of vulnerability that is small under normal conditions. The window may increase under a denial-of-service attack but we can detect and respond to such attacks. The paper presents results of experiments showing that overall performance is good and that even a small window of vulnerability has little impact on service latency.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文描述了一个容忍拜占庭故障（可能由恶意攻击或软件错误引起）的异步状态机复制系统。我们的系统是首个主动恢复拜占庭故障副本的系统，并且由于使用对称密码学而非公钥密码学进行认证，其性能表现良好。恢复机制使我们能够容忍系统生命周期内任意数量的故障，前提是在一个正常条件下很小的脆弱性窗口内，故障副本数少于三分之一。该窗口在拒绝服务攻击下可能会增加，但我们能够检测并响应此类攻击。本文展示了实验结果，表明整体性能良好，且即使很小的脆弱性窗口对服务延迟的影响也很小。

upstream_only.title: Exploring failure transparency and the limits of generic recovery
upstream_only.abstract: We explore the abstraction of failure transparency in which the operating system provides the illusion of failure-free operation. To provide failure transparency, an operating system must recover applications after hardware, operating system, and application failures, and must do so without help from the programmer or unduly slowing failure-free performance. We describe two invariants that must be upheld to provide failure transparency: one that ensures sufficient application state is saved to guarantee the user cannot discern failures, and another that ensures sufficient application state is lost to allow recovery from failures affecting application state. We find that several real applications get failure transparency in the presence of simple stop failures with overhead of 0-12\%. Less encouragingly, we find that applications violate one invariant in the course of upholding the other for more than 90\% of application faults and 3-15\% of operating system faults, rendering transparent recovery impossible for these cases.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了故障透明性抽象，其中操作系统提供无故障运行的假象。为了提供故障透明性，操作系统必须在硬件、操作系统和应用程序故障后恢复应用程序，且无需程序员帮助或不当降低无故障性能。我们描述了必须维护的两个不变量以实现故障透明性：一个确保保存足够的应用程序状态以保证用户无法辨别故障，另一个确保丢失足够的应用程序状态以便从影响应用程序状态的故障中恢复。我们发现，几个真实应用程序在简单停止故障情况下实现了故障透明性，开销为0-12%。不太令人鼓舞的是，我们发现应用程序在维护其中一个不变量的过程中违反了另一个不变量，这在超过90%的应用程序故障和3-15%的操作系统故障中发生，使得对这些情况进行透明恢复变得不可能。

upstream_only.title: Design and evaluation of a continuous consistency model for replicated services
upstream_only.abstract: The tradeoffs between consistency, performance, and availability are well understood. Traditionally, however, designers of replicated systems have been forced to choose from either strong consistency guarantees or none at all. This paper explores the semantic space between traditional strong and optimistic consistency models for replicated services. We argue that an important class of applications can tolerate relaxed consistency, but benefit from bounding the maximum rate of inconsistent access in an application-specific manner. Thus, we develop a set of metrics, Numerical Error, Order Error, and Staleness, to capture the consistency spectrum. We then present the design and implementation of TACT, a middleware layer that enforces arbitrary consistency bounds among replicas using these metrics. Finally, we show that three replicated applications demonstrate significant semantic and performance benefits from using our framework.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 一致性、性能和可用性之间的权衡已被充分理解。然而，传统上，复制系统的设计者被迫只能在强一致性保证或完全无一致性保证之间做出选择。本文探索了传统强一致性与乐观一致性模型之间为复制服务提供的语义空间。我们认为，一类重要的应用程序可以容忍放松的一致性，但受益于以应用特定的方式限制最大不一致访问速率。因此，我们开发了一组指标——数值误差（Numerical Error）、顺序误差（Order Error）和过时性（Staleness）——以捕获一致性谱系。随后，我们展示了TACT的设计与实现，这是一个使用这些指标在副本之间强制实施任意一致性界限的中间件层。最后，我们表明三个复制的应用程序在使用我们的框架时展现出显著的语义和性能优势。

upstream_only.title: Scalable, distributed data structures for internet service construction
upstream_only.abstract: This paper presents a new persistent data management layer designed to simplify cluster-based Internet service construction. This self-managing layer, called a distributed data structure (DDS), presents a conventional single-site data structure interface to service authors, but partitions and replicates the data across a cluster. We have designed and implemented a distributed hash table DDS that has properties necessary for Internet services (incremental scaling of throughput and data capacity, fault tolerance and high availability, high concurrency, consistency, and durability). The hash table uses two-phase commits to present a coherent view of its data across all cluster nodes, allowing any node to service any task. We show that the distributed hash table simplifies Internet service construction by decoupling service-specific logic from the complexities of persistent, consistent state management, and by allowing services to inherit the necessary service properties from the DDS rather than having to implement the properties themselves. We have scaled the hash table to a 128 node cluster, 1 terabyte of storage, and an in-core read throughput of 61,432 operations/s and write throughput of 13,582 operations/s.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的持久化数据管理层，旨在简化基于集群的互联网服务构建。这一自管理层称为分布式数据结构（DDS），向服务作者呈现传统的单站点数据结构接口，但将数据在集群中进行分区和复制。我们设计并实现了一个具备互联网服务所需属性（吞吐量和数据容量的增量扩展、容错和高可用性、高并发、一致性和持久性）的分布式哈希表DDS。该哈希表使用两阶段提交来在集群所有节点间提供一致的数据视图，允许任何节点处理任何任务。我们表明，通过将服务特定逻辑与持久化、一致状态管理的复杂性解耦，并允许服务从DDS继承必要的服务属性而非自行实现，该分布式哈希表简化了互联网服务的构建。我们已将哈希表扩展到128个节点的集群、1太字节存储，以及每秒61,432次操作的内存读取吞吐量和每秒13,582次操作的写入吞吐量。

upstream_only.title: Processes in KaffeOS: isolation, resource management, and sharing in java
upstream_only.abstract: Single-language runtime systems, in the form of Java virtual machines, are widely deployed platforms for executing untrusted mobile code. These runtimes provide some of the features that operating systems provide: inter-application memory protection and basic system services. They do not, however, provide the ability to isolate applications from each other, or limit their resource consumption. This paper describes KaffeOS, a Java runtime system that provides these features. The KaffeOS architecture takes many lessons from operating system design, such as the use of a user/kernel boundary, and employs garbage collection techniques, such as write barriers.The KaffeOS architecture supports the OS abstraction of a process in a Java virtual machine. Each process executes as if it were run in its own virtual machine, including separate garbage collection of its own heap. The difficulty in designing KaffeOS lay in balancing the goals of isolation and resource management against the goal of allowing direct sharing of objects. Overall, KaffeOS is no more than 11\% slower than the freely available JVM on which it is based, which is an acceptable penalty for the safety that it provides. Because of its implementation base, KaffeOS is substantially slower than commercial JVMs for trusted code, but it clearly outperforms those JVMs in the presence of denial-of-service attacks or misbehaving code.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 单一语言运行时系统，以Java虚拟机为形式，是执行不可信移动代码的广泛部署平台。这些运行时提供了操作系统提供的一些特性：应用间内存保护和基本系统服务。然而，它们并不能将应用程序相互隔离或限制其资源消耗。本文描述了KaffeOS，一个提供这些特性的Java运行时系统。KaffeOS架构借鉴了操作系统设计的许多经验，如用户/内核边界的使用，并采用了垃圾收集技术，如写屏障。KaffeOS架构在Java虚拟机中支持操作系统进程的抽象。每个进程都表现得像是在自己的虚拟机中运行，包括对其堆的独立垃圾回收。设计KaffeOS的困难在于平衡隔离和资源管理的目标与允许对象直接共享的目标。总体而言，KaffeOS比其基于的免费JVM慢不超过11%，这是为其提供的安全性所可接受的代价。由于其实现基础，KaffeOS在可信代码上明显慢于商业JVM，但在面对拒绝服务攻击或恶意代码时，它明显优于这些JVM。

upstream_only.title: Knit: component composition for systems software
upstream_only.abstract: Knit is a new component definition and linking language for systems code. Knit helps make C code more understandable and reusable by third parties, helps eliminate much of the performance overhead of componentization, detects subtle errors in component composition that cannot be caught with normal component type systems, and provides a foundation for developing future analyses over C-based components, such as cross-component optimization. The language is especially designed for use with component kits, where standard linking tools provide inadequate support for component configuration. In particular, we developed Knit for use with the OSKit, a large collection of components for building low-level systems. However, Knit is not OSKit-specific, and we have implemented parts of the Click modular router in terms of Knit components to illustrate the expressiveness and flexibility of our language. This paper provides an overview of the Knit language and its applications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Knit是一种用于系统代码的组件定义和链接语言。Knit有助于使C代码更易于第三方理解和重用，有助于消除组件化的许多性能开销，检测普通组件类型系统无法捕获的组件组合中的细微错误，并为开发基于C组件的未来分析方法（如跨组件优化）提供基础。该语言特别设计用于组件套件，在这些场景中，标准链接工具对组件配置的支持不足。具体而言，我们为OSKit开发了Knit，OSKit是一个用于构建底层系统的大型组件集合。然而，Knit并非OSKit专用，我们还用Knit组件实现了Click模块化路由器的部分功能，以展示我们语言的表现力和灵活性。本文概述了Knit语言及其应用。

upstream_only.title: Farsite: federated, available, and reliable storage for an incompletely trusted environment
upstream_only.abstract: Farsite is a secure, scalable file system that logically functions as a centralized file server but is physically distributed among a set of untrusted computers. Farsite provides file availability and reliability through randomized replicated storage; it ensures the secrecy of file contents with cryptographic techniques; it maintains the integrity of file and directory data with a Byzantine-fault-tolerant protocol; it is designed to be scalable by using a distributed hint mechanism and delegation certificates for pathname translations; and it achieves good performance by locally caching file data, lazily propagating file updates, and varying the duration and granularity of content leases. We report on the design of Farsite and the lessons we have learned by implementing much of that design.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Farsite是一个安全、可扩展的文件系统，它在逻辑上充当集中式文件服务器，但在物理上分布在一组不可信的计算机上。Farsite通过随机化复制存储提供文件可用性和可靠性；它利用密码技术确保文件内容的保密性；通过拜占庭容错协议维护文件和目录数据的完整性；通过使用分布式提示机制和用于路径名转换的委派证书，设计为可扩展；并通过在本地缓存文件数据、惰性传播文件更新以及改变内容租约的持续时间和粒度来实现良好的性能。我们报告了Farsite的设计以及我们在实现该设计的大部分过程中吸取的经验教训。

upstream_only.title: Taming aggressive replication in the Pangaea wide-area file system
upstream_only.abstract: Pangaea is a wide-area file system that supports data sharing among a community of widely distributed users. It is built on a symmetrically decentralized infrastructure that consists of commodity computers provided by the end users. Computers act autonomously to serve data to their local users. When possible, they exchange data with nearby peers to improve the system's overall performance, availability, and network economy. This approach is realized by aggressively creating a replica of a file whenever and wherever it is accessed.This paper presents the design, implementation, and evaluation of the Pangaea file system. Pangaea offers efficient, randomized algorithms to manage highly dynamic and potentially large groups of file replicas. It applies optimistic consistency semantics to replica contents, but it also offers stronger guarantees when required by the users. The evaluation demonstrates that Pangaea outperforms existing distributed file systems in large heterogeneous environments, typical of the Internet and of large corporate intranets.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Pangaea是一个支持广泛分布的用户群体共享数据的广域网文件系统。它建立在由最终用户提供的商用计算机组成的对称去中心化基础设施之上。计算机自主运行，向本地用户提供数据；在可能的情况下，它们与附近的对等节点交换数据，以提升系统的整体性能、可用性和网络经济性。这种方法通过在文件被访问时随时随地激进地创建副本来实现。本文介绍了Pangaea文件系统的设计、实现与评估。Pangaea采用高效的随机化算法来管理高度动态且可能规模巨大的文件副本集合，并对副本内容应用乐观一致性语义，同时在用户需要时提供更强的保障。评估表明，在典型的互联网和大型企业内联网等高度异构环境中，Pangaea的性能优于现有分布式文件系统。

upstream_only.title: Ivy: a read/write peer-to-peer file system
upstream_only.abstract: Ivy is a multi-user read/write peer-to-peer file system. Ivy has no centralized or dedicated components, and it provides useful integrity properties without requiring users to fully trust either the underlying peer-to-peer-storage system or the other users of the file system.An Ivy file system consists solely of a set of logs, one log per participant. Ivy stores its logs in the DHash distributed hash table. Each participant finds data by consulting all logs, but performs modifications by appending only to its own log. This arrangement allows Ivy to maintain meta-data consistency without locking. Ivy users can choose which other logs to trust, an appropriate arrangement in a semi-open peer-to-peer system.Ivy presents applications with a conventional file system interface. When the underlying network is fully connected, Ivy provides NFS-like semantics, such as close-to-open consistency. Ivy detects conflicting modifications made during a partition, and provides relevant version information to application-specific conflict resolvers. Performance measurements on a wide-area network show that Ivy is two to three times slower than NFS.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Ivy是一个多用户读写对等文件系统。Ivy没有中心化或专用组件，并提供有用的完整性保证，无需用户完全信任底层对等存储系统或文件系统中的其他用户。Ivy文件系统仅由一组日志组成，每个参与者一个日志。Ivy将其日志存储在DHash分布式哈希表中。每个参与者通过检查所有日志来查找数据，但仅通过附加到自己的日志来执行修改。这种安排使Ivy无需锁定即可保持元数据一致性。Ivy用户可以选择信任哪些其他日志，这在一个半开放的对等系统中是合适的安排。Ivy向应用程序提供传统的文件系统接口。当底层网络完全连接时，Ivy提供类似NFS的语义，如close-to-open一致性。Ivy检测分区期间发生的冲突修改，并向特定于应用程序的冲突解决器提供相关版本信息。广域网上的性能测量表明，Ivy比NFS慢两到三倍。

upstream_only.title: Defensive programming: using an annotation toolkit to build DoS-resistant software
upstream_only.abstract: This paper describes a toolkit to help improve the robustness of code against DoS attacks. We observe that when developing software, programmers primarily focus on functionality. Protecting code from attacks is often considered the responsibility of the OS, firewalls and intrusion detection systems. As a result, many DoS vulnerabilities are not discovered until the system is attacked and the damage is done. Instead of reacting to attacks after the fact, this paper argues that a better solution is to make software defensive by systematically injecting protection mechanisms into the code itself. Our toolkit provides an API that programmers use to annotate their code. At runtime, these annotations serve as both sensors and actuators: watching for resource abuse and taking the appropriate action should abuse be detected. This paper presents the design and implementation of the toolkit, as well as evaluation of its effectiveness with three widely-deployed network services.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文描述了一个工具包，旨在帮助提高代码抵御拒绝服务（DoS）攻击的鲁棒性。我们观察到，在开发软件时，程序员主要关注功能。保护代码免受攻击通常被认为是操作系统、防火墙和入侵检测系统的责任。因此，许多DoS漏洞直到系统遭受攻击并造成损害后才被发现。本文认为，与其在攻击发生后被动应对，更好的解决方案是通过系统地将保护机制注入代码本身来使软件具备防御性。我们的工具包提供了一个API，程序员可以使用它对代码进行注解。在运行时，这些注解既充当传感器又充当执行器：监视资源滥用，并在检测到滥用时采取适当行动。本文介绍了该工具包的设计与实现，并通过三个广泛部署的网络服务对其有效性进行了评估。

upstream_only.title: Using model checking to debug device firmware
upstream_only.abstract: Device firmware is a piece of concurrent software that achieves high performance at the cost of software complexity. They contain subtle race conditions that make them difficult to debug using traditional debugging techniques. The problem is further compounded by the lack of debugging support on the devices. This is a serious problem because the device firmware is trusted by the operating system.Model checkers are designed to systematically verify properties of concurrent systems. Therefore, model checking is a promising approach to debugging device firmware. However, model checking involves an exponential search. Consequently, the models have to be small to allow effective model checking.This paper describes the abstraction techniques used by the ESP compiler to extract abstract models from device firmware written in ESP. The abstract models are small because they discard some of the details in the firmware that is irrelevant to the particular property being verified. The programmer is required to specify the abstractions to be performed. The ESP compiler uses the abstraction specification to extract models conservatively. Therefore, every bug in the original program will be present in the extracted model.This paper also presents our experience with using Spin model checker to develop and debug VMMC firmware for the Myrinet network interfaces. An earlier version of the ESP compiler yielded models that were too large to check for system-wide properties like absence of deadlocks. The new version of the compiler generated abstract models that were used to identify several subtle bugs in the firmware. So far, we have not encountered any bugs that were not caught by Spin.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 设备固件是一种并发软件，它通过牺牲软件复杂性来换取高性能。固件中存在微妙的竞态条件，使得使用传统调试技术难以调试。设备上缺乏调试支持又进一步加剧了问题。这是一个严重的问题，因为操作系统信任设备固件。模型检测器旨在系统地验证并发系统的属性，因此模型检测是调试设备固件的一种很有前途的方法。然而，模型检测涉及指数级搜索，因此模型必须足够小才能进行有效检测。本文描述了ESP编译器用于从以ESP编写的设备固件中提取抽象模型的抽象技术。抽象模型之所以小，是因为它们丢弃了与验证的特定属性无关的固件细节。程序员需要指定要执行的抽象。ESP编译器使用抽象规范来保守地提取模型，因此原始程序中的每个bug都会出现在提取的模型中。本文还介绍了我们使用Spin模型检测器开发和调试Myrinet网络接口VMMC固件的经验。早期版本的ESP编译器生成的模型太大，无法检查系统级属性（如无死锁性）。新版本的编译器生成的抽象模型成功识别了固件中的几个微妙bug。到目前为止，我们还没有遇到Spin未能捕获的bug。

upstream_only.title: CMC: a pragmatic approach to model checking real code
upstream_only.abstract: Many system errors do not emerge unless some intricate sequence of events occurs. In practice, this means that most systems have errors that only trigger after days or weeks of execution. Model checking [4] is an effective way to find such subtle errors. It takes a simplified description of the code and exhaustively tests it on all inputs, using techniques to explore vast state spaces efficiently. Unfortunately, while model checking systems code would be wonderful, it is almost never done in practice: building models is just too hard. It can take significantly more time to write a model than it did to write the code. Furthermore, by checking an abstraction of the code rather than the code itself, it is easy to miss errors.The paper's first contribution is a new model checker, CMC, which checks C and C++ implementations directly, eliminating the need for a separate abstract description of the system behavior. This has two major advantages: it reduces the effort to use model checking, and it reduces missed errors as well as time-wasting false error reports resulting from inconsistencies between the abstract description and the actual implementation. In addition, changes in the implementation can be checked immediately without updating a high-level description.The paper's second contribution is demonstrating that CMC works well on real code by applying it to three implementations of the Ad-hoc On-demand Distance Vector (AODV) networking protocol [7]. We found 34 distinct errors (roughly one bug per 328 lines of code), including a bug in the AODV specification itself. Given our experience building systems, it appears that the approach will work well in other contexts, and especially well for other networking protocols.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 许多系统错误只有在发生某种复杂的事件序列时才会出现。实际上，这意味着大多数系统的错误只有在执行数天或数周后才会触发。模型检查是一种寻找此类微妙错误的有效方法。它采用代码的简化描述，并对所有输入进行穷举测试，利用技术高效地探索巨大的状态空间。然而，尽管对系统代码进行模型检查会非常理想，但在实践中几乎从未这样做过：构建模型太难了。编写模型所花费的时间可能比编写代码本身多得多。此外，检查代码的抽象描述而非代码本身，很容易遗漏错误。本文的第一个贡献是一个新的模型检查器CMC，它直接检查C和C++实现，无需对系统行为进行单独的抽象描述。这有两个主要优点：减少了使用模型检查的工作量，并且减少了由于抽象描述与实际实现之间的不一致而导致的错误遗漏以及浪费时间的误报。此外，实现中的更改可以立即检查，而无需更新高层描述。本文的第二个贡献是通过将CMC应用于Ad-hoc按需距离矢量（AODV）网络协议的三个实现，证明其在真实代码上运行良好。我们发现了34个不同的错误（大约每328行代码一个错误），包括AODV规范本身的一个错误。根据我们构建系统的经验，这种方法在其他环境中也会运行良好，特别是在其他网络协议中。

upstream_only.title: Practical, transparent operating system support for superpages
upstream_only.abstract: Most general-purpose processors provide support for memory pages of large sizes, called superpages. Superpages enable each entry in the translation lookaside buffer (TLB) to map a large physical memory region into a virtual address space. This dramatically increases TLB coverage, reduces TLB misses, and promises performance improvements for many applications. However, supporting superpages poses several challenges to the operating system, in terms of superpage allocation and promotion tradeoffs, fragmentation control, etc. We analyze these issues, and propose the design of an effective superpage management system. We implement it in FreeBSD on the Alpha CPU, and evaluate it on real workloads and benchmarks. We obtain substantial performance benefits, often exceeding 30\%; these benefits are sustained even under stressful workload scenarios.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大多数通用处理器都支持大尺寸内存页，称为超级页面。超级页面使转换后备缓冲器（TLB）中的每个条目能够将大的物理内存区域映射到虚拟地址空间。这显著提高了TLB覆盖面，减少了TLB未命中，并有望为许多应用带来性能提升。然而，支持超级页面给操作系统带来了若干挑战，涉及超级页面分配与提升权衡、碎片控制等。我们分析了这些问题，并提出了一种有效的超级页面管理系统的设计。我们在Alpha CPU上的FreeBSD中实现该系统，并在真实负载和基准测试中进行了评估。我们获得了显著的性能收益，通常超过30%；即使在压力较大的工作负载场景下，这些收益也能维持。

upstream_only.title: Vertigo: automatic performance-setting for Linux
upstream_only.abstract: Combining high performance with low power consumption is becoming one of the primary objectives of processor designs. Instead of relying just on sleep mode for conserving power, an increasing number of processors take advantage of the fact that reducing the clock frequency and corresponding operating voltage of the CPU can yield quadratic decrease in energy use. However, performance reduction can only be beneficial if it is done transparently, without causing the software to miss its deadlines. In this paper, we describe the implementation and performance-setting algorithms used in Vertigo, our power management extensions for Linux. Vertigo makes its decisions automatically, without any application-specific involvement. We describe how a hierarchy of performance-setting algorithms, each specialized for different workload characteristics, can be used for controlling the processor's performance. The algorithms operate independently from one another and can be dynamically configured. As a basis for comparison with conventional algorithms, we contrast measurements made on a Transmeta Crusoe-based computer using its built-in LongRun power manager with Vertigo running on the same system. We show that unlike conventional interval-based algorithms like LongRun, Vertigo is successful at focusing in on a small range of performance levels that are sufficient to meet an application's deadlines. When playing MPEG movies, this behavior translates into a 11\%-35\% reduction of mean performance level over LongRun, without any negative impact on the framerate. The performance reduction can in turn yield significant power savings.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 兼顾高性能与低功耗正成为处理器设计的主要目标之一。越来越多的处理器不再仅依赖休眠模式来节能，而是利用降低CPU时钟频率和相应工作电压可使能耗二次方下降的特性。然而，只有在对软件透明地降低性能而不导致其错过截止期限时，性能降低才是有益的。本文描述了我们在Linux上的电源管理扩展Vertigo的实现和性能设置算法。Vertigo自动做出决策，无需任何特定应用参与。我们描述了如何利用一组针对不同工作负载特性而专长化的性能设置算法层次结构来控制处理器的性能。这些算法彼此独立运行，并可以动态配置。作为与传统算法的比较基准，我们将基于Transmeta Crusoe的计算机上使用其内置LongRun电源管理器所得到的测量结果，与同一系统上运行Vertigo的结果进行对比。我们表明，与类似LongRun的传统基于间隔的算法不同，Vertigo能够成功聚焦于足以满足应用截止期限的一小段性能水平范围。在播放MPEG影片时，这种特性使得平均性能水平较LongRun降低11%至35%，同时不影响帧率。性能降低进而可带来显著的功耗节省。

upstream_only.title: Cooperative I/O: a novel I/O semantics for energy-aware applications
upstream_only.abstract: In this paper we demonstrate the benefits of application involvement in operating system power management. We present Coop-I/O, an approach to reduce the power consumption of devices while encompassing all levels of the system---from the hardware and OS to a new interface for cooperative I/O that can be used by energy-aware applications. We assume devices which can be set to low-power operation modes if they are not accessed and where switching between modes consumes additional energy, e.g. devices with rotating components or network devices consuming energy for the establishment and shutdown of network connections. In these cases frequent mode switches should be avoided.With Coop-I/O, applications can declare open, read and write operations as deferrable and even abortable by specifying a time-out and a cancel flag. This information enables the operating system to delay and batch requests so that the number of power mode switches is reduced and the device can be kept longer in a low-power mode. We have deployed our concept to the IDE hard disk driver and Ext2 file system of Linux and to typical real-life programs so that they make use of the new cooperative I/O functions. With energy savings of up to 50\%, the experimental results demonstrate the benefits of the concept. We will show that Coop-I/O even outperforms the "oracle" shutdown policy which defines the lower bound in power consumption if the timing of requests can not be influenced.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文展示了应用参与操作系统电源管理的好处。我们提出Coop-I/O，一种在涵盖从硬件和操作系统到新型协作式I/O接口的所有系统层面降低设备功耗的方法，该接口可由能量感知的应用使用。我们假设设备在不被访问时可设置为低功耗运行模式，并且模式切换会消耗额外能量，例如带有旋转组件的设备或为建立和断开网络连接而消耗能量的网络设备。在这些情况下，应避免频繁的模式切换。通过Coop-I/O，应用可以将打开、读取和写入操作声明为可延迟甚至可中止的，方法是指定超时和取消标志。这些信息使操作系统能够延迟和批处理请求，从而减少电源模式切换的次数，并让设备在低功耗模式下保持更长时间。我们已将这一概念部署到Linux的IDE硬盘驱动器和Ext2文件系统，并部署到典型的实际程序中，使其利用新的协作式I/O功能。实验结果表明，该概念可节省高达50%的能量。我们将证明，在请求时间无法被影响的情况下，Coop-I/O甚至优于定义了功耗下限的“oracle”关闭策略。

upstream_only.title: TAG: a Tiny AGgregation service for Ad-Hoc sensor networks
upstream_only.abstract: We present the Tiny AGgregation (TAG) service for aggregation in low-power, distributed, wireless environments. TAG allows users to express simple, declarative queries and have them distributed and executed efficiently in networks of low-power, wireless sensors. We discuss various generic properties of aggregates, and show how those properties affect the performance of our in network approach. We include a performance study demonstrating the advantages of our approach over traditional centralized, out-of-network methods, and discuss a variety of optimizations for improving the performance and fault-tolerance of the basic solution.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了用于低功耗、分布式无线环境中的聚合服务的TAG（微型聚合）服务。TAG允许用户表达简单的声明式查询，并在低功耗无线传感器网络中高效地进行分发和执行。我们讨论了聚合的各种通用属性，并展示了这些属性如何影响我们的网内方法的性能。我们提供了一项性能研究，证明了我们的方法相对于传统的集中式网外方法的优势，并讨论了各种优化方法以提高基本解决方案的性能和容错性。

upstream_only.title: Fine-grained network time synchronization using reference broadcasts
upstream_only.abstract: Recent advances in miniaturization and low-cost, low-power design have led to active research in large-scale networks of small, wireless, low-power sensors and actuators. Time synchronization is critical in sensor networks for diverse purposes including sensor data fusion, coordinated actuation, and power-efficient duty cycling. Though the clock accuracy and precision requirements are often stricter than in traditional distributed systems, strict energy constraints limit the resources available to meet these goals.We present Reference-Broadcast Synchronization, a scheme in which nodes send reference beacons to their neighbors using physical-layer broadcasts. A reference broadcast does not contain an explicit timestamp; instead, receivers use its arrival time as a point of reference for comparing their clocks. In this paper, we use measurements from two wireless implementations to show that removing the sender's nondeterminism from the critical path in this way produces high-precision clock agreement (1.85± 1.28μsec, using off-the-shelf 802.11 wireless Ethernet), while using minimal energy. We also describe a novel algorithm that uses this same broadcast property to federate clocks across broadcast domains with a slow decay in precision (3.68± 2.57μsec after 4 hops). RBS can be used without external references, forming a precise relative timescale, or can maintain microsecond-level synchronization to an external timescale such as UTC. We show a significant improvement over the Network Time Protocol (NTP) under similar conditions.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 近年来，小型化以及低成本低功耗设计的进步推动了对大规模小型无线低功耗传感器和执行器网络的积极研究。在传感器网络中，时间同步对于传感器数据融合、协调执行和低功耗占空比等多种目的至关重要。虽然时钟精度和准确度要求通常比传统分布式系统更严格，但严格的能量约束限制了可用于实现这些目标的资源。我们提出了参考广播同步（Reference-Broadcast Synchronization，RBS），这是一种让节点通过物理层广播向其邻居发送参考信标的方案。参考广播不包含显式时间戳；相反，接收端将其到达时间作为比较各自时钟的参考点。在本文中，我们使用两个无线实现的测量结果表明，通过这种方式将发送端的不确定性从关键路径中移除，可以在使用现成802.11无线以太网时实现高精度的时钟一致性（1.85±1.28微秒），同时消耗极少的能量。我们还描述了一种新算法，利用同样的广播特性跨广播域联合时钟，其精度衰减缓慢（4跳后为3.68±2.57微秒）。RBS可以在没有外部参考的情况下使用，形成精确的相对时间尺度，也可以保持与外部时间尺度（如UTC）的微秒级同步。我们展示了在类似条件下相较于网络时间协议（NTP）的显著改进。

upstream_only.title: Supporting time-sensitive applications on a commodity OS
upstream_only.abstract: Commodity operating systems are increasingly being used for serving time-sensitive applications. These applications require low-latency response from the kernel and from other system-level services. In this paper, we explore various operating systems techniques needed to support time-sensitive applications and describe the design of our Time-Sensitive Linux (TSL) system. We show that the combination of a high-precision timing facility, a well-designed preemptible kernel and the use of appropriate scheduling techniques is the basis for a low-latency response system and such a system can have low overhead. We evaluate the behavior of realistic time-sensitive user- and kernel-level applications on our system and show that, in practice, it is possible to satisfy the constraints of time-sensitive applications in a commodity operating system without significantly compromising the performance of throughput-oriented applications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 通用操作系统越来越多地用于服务时间敏感应用。这些应用需要来自内核和其他系统级服务的低延迟响应。在本文中，我们探讨了支持时间敏感应用所需的各种操作系统技术，并描述了我们的时间敏感Linux (TSL)系统的设计。我们展示了高精度计时设施、设计良好的可抢占内核以及适当的调度技术的结合是低延迟响应系统的基础，且这样的系统可以具有低开销。我们评估了现实中的时间敏感用户级和内核级应用在我们系统上的行为，并表明在实践中，在通用操作系统中满足时间敏感应用的约束是可能的，同时不会显著损害吞吐量导向应用的性能。

upstream_only.title: Memory resource management in VMware ESX server
upstream_only.abstract: VMware ESX Server is a thin software layer designed to multiplex hardware resources efficiently among virtual machines running unmodified commodity operating systems. This paper introduces several novel ESX Server mechanisms and policies for managing memory. A ballooning technique reclaims the pages considered least valuable by the operating system running in a virtual machine. An idle memory tax achieves efficient memory utilization while maintaining performance isolation guarantees. Content-based page sharing and hot I/O page remapping exploit transparent page remapping to eliminate redundancy and reduce copying overheads. These techniques are combined to efficiently support virtual machine workloads that overcommit memory.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: VMware ESX Server是一个轻量级软件层，旨在高效地在一组运行未修改的商用操作系统的虚拟机之间复用硬件资源。本文介绍了用于管理内存的几种新的ESX Server机制和策略。一种气球回收技术回收虚拟机内操作系统认为最不值得保留的页面。一种空闲内存税在维持性能隔离保证的同时实现高效的内存利用。基于内容的内存页共享和热点I/O页重映射利用透明的页重映射来消除冗余并减少复制开销。这些技术相结合，可高效支持超订内存的虚拟机工作负载。

upstream_only.title: Scale and performance in the Denali isolation kernel
upstream_only.abstract: This paper describes the Denali isolation kernel, an operating system architecture that safely multiplexes a large number of untrusted Internet services on shared hardware. Denali's goal is to allow new Internet services to be "pushed" into third party infrastructure, relieving Internet service authors from the burden of acquiring and maintaining physical infrastructure. Our isolation kernel exposes a virtual machine abstraction, but unlike conventional virtual machine monitors, Denali does not attempt to emulate the underlying physical architecture precisely, and instead modifies the virtual architecture to gain scale, performance, and simplicity of implementation. In this paper, we first discuss design principles of isolation kernels, and then we describe the design and implementation of Denali.
