Following this, we present a detailed evaluation of Denali, demonstrating that the overhead of virtualization is small, that our architectural choices are warranted, and that we can successfully scale to more than 10,000 virtual machines on commodity hardware.

upstream_only.title: ReVirt: enabling intrusion analysis through virtual-machine logging and replay
upstream_only.abstract: Current system loggers have two problems: they depend on the integrity of the operating system being logged, and they do not save sufficient information to replay and analyze attacks that include any non-deterministic events. ReVirt removes the dependency on the target operating system by moving it into a virtual machine and logging below the virtual machine. This allows ReVirt to replay the system's execution before, during, and after an intruder compromises the system, even if the intruder replaces the target operating system. ReVirt logs enough information to replay a long-term execution of the virtual machine instruction-by-instruction. This enables it to provide arbitrarily detailed observations about what transpired on the system, even in the presence of non-deterministic attacks and executions. ReVirt adds reasonable time and space overhead. Overheads due to virtualization are imperceptible for interactive use and CPU-bound workloads, and 13--58\% for kernel-intensive workloads. Logging adds 0--8\% overhead, and logging traffic for our workloads can be stored on a single disk for several months.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 当前系统日志记录器存在两个问题：它们依赖被日志记录的操作系统的完整性，并且它们没有保存足够的信息来重放和分析包含任何非确定性事件的攻击。ReVirt通过将目标操作系统移入虚拟机并在虚拟机之下进行日志记录，消除了对目标操作系统的依赖。这使ReVirt能够在入侵者入侵系统之前、期间和之后重放系统的执行，即使入侵者替换了目标操作系统。ReVirt记录足够的信息，以逐条指令重放虚拟机的长期执行过程。这使其能够提供关于系统上发生之事的任意详细观察，即使在存在非确定性攻击和执行的情况下也是如此。ReVirt增加了合理的时间和空间开销。虚拟化带来的开销对于交互式使用和CPU密集型工作负载而言几乎不可察觉，对于内核密集型工作负载则为13-58%。日志记录增加了0-8%的开销，我们工作负载的日志流量可以存储在单个磁盘上数月之久。

upstream_only.title: Integrated resource management for cluster-based internet services
upstream_only.abstract: Client request rates for Internet services tend to be bursty and thus it is important to maintain efficient resource utilization under a wide range of load conditions. Network service clients typically seek services interactively and maintaining reasonable response time is often imperative for such services. In addition, providing differentiated service qualities and resource allocation to multiple service classes can also be desirable at times. This paper presents an integrated resource management framework (part of Neptune system) that provides flexible service quality specification, efficient resource utilization, and service differentiation for cluster-based services. This framework introduces the metric of quality-aware service yield to combine the overall system efficiency and individual service response time in one flexible model. Resources are managed through a two-level request distribution and scheduling scheme. At the cluster level, a fully decentralized request distribution architecture is employed to achieve high scalability and availability. Inside each service node, an adaptive scheduling policy maintains efficient resource utilization under a wide range of load conditions. Our trace-driven evaluations demonstrate the performance, scalability, and service differentiation achieved by the proposed techniques.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 互联网服务的客户端请求率往往具有突发性，因此在各种负载条件下保持高效的资源利用至关重要。网络服务客户端通常寻求交互式服务，而对于此类服务，保持合理的响应时间通常是必需的。此外，有时还需要为多个服务类别提供差异化的服务质量和资源分配。本文提出了一个集成资源管理框架（Neptune系统的一部分），该框架为基于集群的服务提供了灵活的服务质量规范、高效的资源利用和服务差异化。该框架引入了质量感知服务产出率这一指标，将整体系统效率与单个服务响应时间灵活地结合在一个模型中。资源通过两级请求分发和调度方案进行管理。在集群层面，采用完全去中心化的请求分发架构以实现高可扩展性和可用性。在每个服务节点内部，自适应调度策略在各种负载条件下维持高效的资源利用。我们的基于痕迹的评估证明了所提出技术在性能、可扩展性和服务差异化方面取得的成效。

upstream_only.title: Resource overbooking and application profiling in shared hosting platforms
upstream_only.abstract: In this paper, we present techniques for provisioning CPU and network resources in shared hosting platforms running potentially antagonistic third-party applications. The primary contribution of our work is to demonstrate the feasibility and benefits of overbooking resources in shared platforms, to maximize the platform yeld: the revenue generated by the available resources. We do this by first deriving an accurate estimate of application resource needs by profiling applications on dedicated nodes, and then using these profiles to guide the placement of application components onto shared nodes. By overbooking cluster resources in a controlled fashion, our platform can provide performance guarantees to applications even when overbooked, and combine these techniques with commonly used QoS resource allocation mechanisms to provide application isolation and performance guarantees at run-time. When compared to provisioning based on the worst-case, the efficiency (and consequently revenue) benefits from controlled overbooking of resources can be dramatic. Specifically, experiments on our Linux cluster implementation indicate that overbooking resources by as little as 1\% can increase the utilization of the cluster by a factor of two, and a 5\% overbooking yields a 300--500\% improvement, while still providing useful resource guarantees to applications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了在运行可能相互对抗的第三方应用的共享托管平台中配置CPU和网络资源的技术。我们工作的主要贡献是证明在共享平台中超售资源的可行性和好处，以最大化平台收益：即由可用资源产生的收入。我们首先通过在专用节点上对应用进行配置文件分析，得出应用资源需求的准确估计，然后使用这些配置文件来指导应用组件在共享节点上的放置。通过以受控方式超售集群资源，我们的平台即使在超售情况下也能为应用提供性能保证，并将这些技术与常用的服务质量（QoS）资源分配机制相结合，在运行时提供应用隔离和性能保证。与基于最坏情况的配置相比，受控超售资源在效率（因而收入）上的收益可能是巨大的。具体来说，在我们Linux集群实现上的实验表明，超售资源即使只有1%，也能将集群利用率提高两倍，而5%的超售则带来300%-500%的改进，同时仍为应用提供有用的资源保证。

upstream_only.title: An integrated experimental environment for distributed systems and networks
upstream_only.abstract: Three experimental environments traditionally support network and distributed systems research: network emulators, network simulators, and live networks. The continued use of multiple approaches highlights both the value and inadequacy of each. Netbed, a descendant of Emulab, provides an experimentation facility that integrates these approaches, allowing researchers to configure and access networks composed of emulated, simulated, and wide-area nodes and links. Netbed's primary goals are ease of use, control, and realism, achieved through consistent use of virtualization and abstraction.By providing operating system-like services, such as resource allocation and scheduling, and by virtualizing heterogeneous resources, Netbed acts as a virtual machine for network experimentation. This paper presents Netbed's overall design and implementation and demonstrates its ability to improve experimental automation and efficiency. These, in turn, lead to new methods of experimentation, including automated parameter-space studies within emulation and straightforward comparisons of simulated, emulated, and wide-area scenarios.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 传统上，三种实验环境支持网络和分布式系统研究：网络仿真器、网络模拟器和真实网络。多种方法的持续使用突显了各自的价值和不足。Netbed作为Emulab的后继者，提供了一个集成这些方法的实验设施，使研究人员能够配置和访问由仿真、模拟和广域网节点与链路组成的网络。Netbed的主要目标是易用性、可控性和真实性，这些通过一致地使用虚拟化和抽象来实现。通过提供类似操作系统的服务（如资源分配和调度）并对异构资源进行虚拟化，Netbed充当了网络实验的虚拟机。本文介绍了Netbed的总体设计和实现，并展示了其提升实验自动化和效率的能力。这些能力进而带来了新的实验方法，包括在仿真中进行自动化参数空间研究，以及对模拟、仿真和广域网场景的直接比较。

upstream_only.title: Scalability and accuracy in a large-scale network emulator
upstream_only.abstract: This paper presents ModelNet, a scalable Internet emulation environment that enables researchers to deploy unmodified software prototypes in a configurable Internet-like environment and subject them to faults and varying network conditions. Edge nodes running user-specified OS and application software are configured to route their packets through a set of ModelNet core nodes, which cooperate to subject the traffic to the bandwidth, congestion constraints, latency, and loss profile of a target network topology.This paper describes and evaluates the ModelNet architecture and its implementation, including novel techniques to balance emulation accuracy against scalability. The current ModelNet prototype is able to accurately subject thousands of instances of a distrbuted application to Internet-like conditions with gigabits of bisection bandwidth. Experiments with several large-scale distributed services demonstrate the generality and effectiveness of the infrastructure.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了ModelNet，一种可扩展的互联网仿真环境，使研究人员能够在可配置的类似互联网的环境中部署未经修改的软件原型，并使其遭受故障和多变的网络条件。运行用户指定的操作系统和应用软件的边缘节点被配置为通过一组ModelNet核心节点路由其数据包，这些核心节点协同作用，使流量受到目标网络拓扑的带宽、拥塞约束、延迟和丢失率的影响。本文描述并评估了ModelNet架构及其实现，包括用于平衡仿真精度与可扩展性的新技术。当前的ModelNet原型能够以吉比特的对分带宽，将数千个分布式应用实例准确地置于类似互联网的条件下。对多个大规模分布式服务的实验证明了该基础设施的通用性和有效性。

upstream_only.title: Pastiche: making backup cheap and easy
upstream_only.abstract: Backup is cumbersome and expensive. Individual users almost never back up their data, and backup is a significant cost in large organizations. This paper presents Pastiche, a simple and inexpensive backup system. Pastiche exploits excess disk capacity to perform peer-to-peer backup with no administrative costs. Each node minimizes storage overhead by selecting peers that share a significant amount of data. It is easy for common installations to find suitable peers, and peers with high overlap can be identified with only hundreds of bytes. Pastiche provides mechanisms for confidentiality, integrity, and detection of failed or malicious peers. A Pastiche prototype suffers only 7.4\% overhead for a modified Andrew Benchmark, and restore performance is comparable to cross-machine copy.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 备份既繁琐又昂贵。个人用户几乎从不备份数据，而在大型组织中，备份也是一项重大成本。本文介绍了Pastiche，一个简单且廉价的备份系统。Pastiche利用多余的磁盘容量进行点对点备份，且无需管理成本。每个节点通过选择与之共享大量数据的对等节点来最小化存储开销。在常见安装中很容易找到合适的对等节点，而且仅需数百字节就能识别出重叠度高的对等节点。Pastiche提供了保密性、完整性以及检测故障或恶意对等节点的机制。Pastiche原型在修改后的Andrew基准测试中仅产生7.4%的开销，其恢复性能与跨机器复制相当。

upstream_only.title: Secure routing for structured peer-to-peer overlay networks
upstream_only.abstract: Structured peer-to-peer overlay networks provide a substrate for the construction of large-scale, decentralized applications, including distributed storage, group communication, and content distribution. These overlays are highly resilient; they can route messages correctly even when a large fraction of the nodes crash or the network partitions. But current overlays are not secure; even a small fraction of malicious nodes can prevent correct message delivery throughout the overlay. This problem is particularly serious in open peer-to-peer systems, where many diverse, autonomous parties without preexisting trust relationships wish to pool their resources. This paper studies attacks aimed at preventing correct message delivery in structured peer-to-peer overlays and presents defenses to these attacks. We describe and evaluate techniques that allow nodes to join the overlay, to maintain routing state, and to forward messages securely in the presence of malicious nodes.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 结构化对等覆盖网络为构建大规模去中心化应用（包括分布式存储、组通信和内容分发）提供了基础。这些覆盖网络具有高度弹性；即使很大一部分节点崩溃或网络发生分区，它们仍能正确路由消息。但当前的覆盖网络并不安全；即使一小部分恶意节点也能在整个覆盖网络中阻止消息的正确传递。这个问题在开放对等系统中尤为严重，因为许多不同的、自治的、没有预先信任关系的参与方希望汇集其资源。本文研究了旨在阻止结构化对等覆盖网络中正确消息传递的攻击，并提出了针对这些攻击的防御措施。我们描述并评估了允许节点加入覆盖网络、维护路由状态以及在存在恶意节点情况下安全转发消息的技术。

upstream_only.title: An analysis of internet content delivery systems
upstream_only.abstract: In the span of only a few years, the Internet has experienced an astronomical increase in the use of specialized content delivery systems, such as content delivery networks and peer-to-peer file sharing systems. Therefore, an understanding of content delivery on the Internet now requires a detailed understanding of how these systems are used in practice.This paper examines content delivery from the point of view of four content delivery systems: HTTP web traffic, the Akamai content delivery network, and Kazaa and Gnutella peer-to-peer file sharing traffic. We collected a trace of all incoming and outgoing network traffic at the University of Washington, a large university with over 60,000 students, faculty, and staff. From this trace, we isolated and characterized traffic belonging to each of these four delivery classes. Our results (1) quantify the rapidly increasing importance of new content delivery systems, particularly peer-to-peer networks, (2) characterize the behavior of these systems from the perspectives of clients, objects, and servers, and (3) derive implications for caching in these systems.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在短短几年内，互联网上对专用内容分发系统（如内容分发网络和对等文件共享系统）的使用呈现爆炸式增长。因此，要理解互联网上的内容分发，现在需要对如何使用这些系统有详细的了解。本文从四种内容分发系统的角度考察内容分发：HTTP网络流量、Akamai内容分发网络、以及Kazaa和Gnutella对等文件共享流量。我们收集了华盛顿大学（一所拥有超过60000名学生、教职员工的大型大学）的所有进出网络流量的轨迹。从这个轨迹中，我们分离并表征了属于这四个分发类别的流量。我们的结果(1)量化了新的内容分发系统日益增长的重要性，特别是对等网络；(2)从客户端、对象和服务器的角度表征了这些系统的行为；(3)得出了对缓存设计的影响。

upstream_only.title: TCP Nice: a mechanism for background transfers
upstream_only.abstract: Many distributed applications can make use of large background transfers - transfers of data that humans are not waiting for -- to improve availability, reliability, latency or consistency. However, given the rapid fluctuations of available network bandwidth and changing resource costs due to technology trends, hand tuning the aggressiveness of background transfers risks (1) complicating applications, (2) being too aggressive and interfering with other applications, and (3) being too timid and not gaining the benefits of background transfers. Our goal is for the operating system to manage network resources in order to provide a simple abstraction of near zero-cost background transfers. Our system, TCP Nice, can provably bound the interference inflicted by background flows on foreground flows in a restricted network model. And our microbenchmarks and case study applications suggest that in practice it interferes little with foreground flows, reaps a large fraction of spare network bandwidth, and simplifies application construction and deployment. For example, in our prefetching case study application, aggressive prefetching improves demand performance by a factor of three when Nice manages resources; but the same prefetching hurts demand performance by a factor of six under standard network congestion control.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 许多分布式应用可以利用大规模后台传输（即人类并不等待的数据传输）来提高可用性、可靠性、延迟或一致性。然而，鉴于可用网络带宽的快速波动以及技术趋势带来的资源成本变化，手工调整后台传输的激进程度会带来风险：(1) 使应用复杂化；(2) 过于激进而干扰其他应用；(3) 过于保守而无法获得后台传输的好处。我们的目标是让操作系统管理网络资源，以提供近零成本后台传输的简单抽象。我们的系统TCP Nice可以在受限网络模型中证明后台流对前台流造成的干扰是有界的。我们的微基准测试和案例研究应用表明，它在实践中对前台流的干扰很小，能获取大部分剩余网络带宽，并简化应用的构建和部署。例如，在我们的预取案例研究应用中，当Nice管理资源时，激进预取能将需求性能提升三倍；但在标准网络拥塞控制下，同样的预取会使需求性能降低六倍。

upstream_only.title: The effectiveness of request redirection on CDN robustness
upstream_only.abstract: It is becoming increasingly common to construct network services using redundant resources geographically distributed across the Internet. Content Distribution Networks are a prime example. Such systems distribute client requests to an appropriate server based on a variety of factors---e.g., server load, network proximity, cache locality---in an effort to reduce response time and increase the system capacity under load. This paper explores the design space of strategies employed to redirect requests, and defines a class of new algorithms that carefully balance load, locality, and proximity. We use large-scale detailed simulations to evaluate the various strategies. These simulations clearly demonstrate the effectiveness of our new algorithms, which yield a 60--91\% improvement in system capacity when compared with the best published CDN technology, yet user-perceived response latency remains low and the system scales well with the number of servers.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 使用地理分布在整个互联网上的冗余资源来构建网络服务正变得越来越普遍。内容分发网络（CDN）就是一个典型的例子。这类系统根据多种因素（例如服务器负载、网络邻近性、缓存局部性）将客户端请求分配到合适的服务器，以减少响应时间并提高系统在负载下的容量。本文探索了用于重定向请求的策略设计空间，并定义了一类新算法，这些算法仔细平衡了负载、局部性和邻近性。我们使用大规模详细模拟来评估各种策略。这些模拟清楚地证明了我们新算法的有效性，与已发布的最佳CDN技术相比，系统容量提升了60%至91%，同时用户感知的响应延迟保持较低，并且系统随服务器数量扩展良好。

upstream_only.title: The design and implementation of Zap: a system for migrating computing environments
upstream_only.abstract: We have created Zap, a novel system for transparent migration of legacy and networked applications. Zap provides a thin virtualization layer on top of the operating system that introduces pods, which are groups of processes that are provided a consistent, virtualized view of the system. This decouples processes in pods from dependencies to the host operating system and other processes on the system. By integrating Zap virtualization with a checkpoint-restart mechanism, Zap can migrate a pod of processes as a unit among machines running independent operating systems without leaving behind any residual state after migration. We have implemented a Zap prototype in Linux that supports transparent migration of unmodified applications without any kernel modifications. We demonstrate that our Linux Zap prototype can provide general-purpose process migration functionality with low overhead. Our experimental results for migrating pods used for running a standard user's X windows desktop computing environment and for running an Apache web server show that these kinds of pods can be migrated with subsecond checkpoint and restart latencies.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们创建了Zap，一个用于透明迁移遗留和网络应用的新颖系统。Zap在操作系统之上提供了一层轻量级虚拟化层，引入了“pod”（进程组），这些进程组被赋予一致的、虚拟化的系统视图。这将pod中的进程与对宿主操作系统以及系统上其他进程的依赖解耦。通过将Zap虚拟化与检查点-重启机制集成，Zap可以将一个进程组作为一个单元，在运行独立操作系统的机器之间迁移，而不会在迁移后留下任何残余状态。我们在Linux中实现了一个Zap原型，支持未修改应用的透明迁移，且无需任何内核修改。我们证明了我们的Linux Zap原型能够提供通用目的的进程迁移功能，且开销较低。我们对用于运行标准用户的X窗口桌面计算环境和运行Apache web服务器的pod进行迁移的实验结果表明，这类pod可以以亚秒级的检查点和重启延迟进行迁移。

upstream_only.title: Optimizing the migration of virtual computers
upstream_only.abstract: This paper shows how to quickly move the state of a running computer across a network, including the state in its disks, memory, CPU registers, and I/O devices. We call this state a capsule. Capsule state is hardware state, so it includes the entire operating system as well as applications and running processes.We have chosen to move x86 computer states because x86 computers are common, cheap, run the software we use, and have tools for migration. Unfortunately, x86 capsules can be large, containing hundreds of megabytes of memory and gigabytes of disk data. We have developed techniques to reduce the amount of data sent over the network: copy-on-write disks track just the updates to capsule disks, "ballooning" zeros unused memory, demand paging fetches only needed blocks, and hashing avoids sending blocks that already exist at the remote end. We demonstrate these optimizations in a prototype system that uses VMware GSX Server virtual machine monitor to create and run x86 capsules. The system targets networks as slow as 384 kbps.Our experimental results suggest that efficient capsule migration can improve user mobility and system management. Software updates or installations on a set of machines can be accomplished simply by distributing a capsule with the new changes. Assuming the presence of a prior capsule, the amount of traffic incurred is commensurate with the size of the update or installation package itself. Capsule migration makes it possible for machines to start running an application within 20 minutes on a 384 kbps link, without having to first install the application or even the underlying operating system. Furthermore, users' capsules can be migrated during a commute between home and work in even less time.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文展示了如何快速地在网络上移动一台正在运行的计算机的状态，包括其磁盘、内存、CPU寄存器和I/O设备中的状态。我们将这种状态称为“胶囊”（capsule）。胶囊状态是硬件状态，因此它包含整个操作系统以及应用程序和运行进程。我们选择迁移x86计算机状态，因为x86计算机常见、便宜、运行我们使用的软件，并且拥有迁移工具。不幸的是，x86胶囊可能很大，包含数百兆字节的内存和数千兆字节的磁盘数据。我们开发了减少网络传输数据量的技术：写时复制磁盘仅跟踪胶囊磁盘的更新，“气球”技术将未使用的内存清零，按需分页仅获取需要的块，而哈希技术避免发送远程端已存在的块。我们在一个原型系统中演示了这些优化，该系统使用VMware GSX Server虚拟机监控器来创建和运行x86胶囊。该系统面向低至384 kbps的网络。我们的实验结果表明，高效的胶囊迁移可以改善用户移动性和系统管理。对一组机器进行软件更新或安装只需分发包含新变更的胶囊即可。假设存在先前胶囊，所产生的流量与更新或安装包本身的大小相当。胶囊迁移使机器能够在384 kbps链路上于20分钟内开始运行应用程序，而不必事先安装应用程序甚至底层操作系统。此外，在上下班往返途中，用户的胶囊可以在更短的时间内完成迁移。

upstream_only.title: Luna: a flexible Java protection system
upstream_only.abstract: Extensible Java systems face a difficult trade-off between sharing and protection. On one hand, Java's ability to run different protection domains in a single virtual machine enables domains to share data easily and communicate without address space switches. On the other hand, unrestricted sharing blurs the boundaries between protection domains, making it difficult to terminate domains and enforce restrictions on resource usage. Existing solutions to these problems restrict sharing in an ad-hoc fashion, ruling out many desirable programming styles.This paper presents an extension to Java's type system that systematically addresses the issues of data sharing, revocation, thread control, and resource control. Multiple tasks running in a single virtual machines share data using special remote pointers, which have different types from local pointers. The distinction between local and remote pointers allows the Java runtime system to mediate the communication between tasks without slowing down operations on ordinary pointers. The extensions to Java are implemented by a system called Luna, based on the Guavac and Marmot compilers, extended with special optimizations to support both fast inter-task communication and dynamic access control. The paper describes two applications written in Luna: a simple extensible web server, and an extension of the Squid web cache to support dynamic content generation.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 可扩展的Java系统在共享与保护之间面临艰难的权衡。一方面，Java在单个虚拟机中运行不同保护域的能力使得各域能够轻松共享数据并在无需地址空间切换的情况下进行通信。另一方面，无限制的共享模糊了保护域之间的边界，使得终止域和对资源使用施加限制变得困难。针对这些问题的现有解决方案以特别方式限制共享，排除了许多理想的编程风格。本文提出了对Java类型系统的一种扩展，系统地解决了数据共享、撤销、线程控制和资源控制问题。运行在单个虚拟机中的多个任务通过特殊的远程指针共享数据，这些远程指针具有与本地指针不同的类型。本地指针与远程指针的区分使得Java运行时系统能够调解任务间的通信，而不会减慢普通指针的操作速度。对Java的这些扩展由一个名为Luna的系统实现，该系统基于Guavac和Marmot编译器，并添加了特殊优化以支持快速的任务间通信和动态访问控制。本文描述了用Luna编写的两个应用：一个简单的可扩展Web服务器，以及一个支持动态内容生成的Squid Web缓存的扩展。

upstream_only.title: Rethink the sync
upstream_only.abstract: We introduce external synchrony, a new model for local file I/O that provides the reliability and simplicity of synchronous I/O, yet also closely approximates the performance of asynchronous I/O. An external observer cannot distinguish the output of a computer with an externally synchronous file system from the output of a computer with a synchronous file system. No application modification is required to use an externally synchronous file system: in fact, application developers can program to the simpler synchronous I/O abstraction and still receive excellent performance. We have implemented an externally synchronous file system for Linux, called xsyncfs. Xsyncfs provides the same durability and ordering guarantees as those provided by a synchronously mounted ext3 file system. Yet, even for I/O-intensive benchmarks, xsyncfs performance is within 7\% of ext3 mounted asynchronously. Compared to ext3 mounted synchronously, xsyncfs is up to two orders of magnitude faster.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了外部同步（external synchrony）这一全新模型，用于本地文件I/O，它既具备同步I/O的可靠性和简单性，同时又能在性能上逼近异步I/O。外部观察者无法区分采用外部同步文件系统的计算机与采用同步文件系统的计算机的输出。使用外部同步文件系统无需修改应用程序：事实上，应用程序开发人员可以按照更简单的同步I/O抽象进行编程，同时仍能获得出色的性能。我们在Linux上实现了一个外部同步文件系统，称为xsyncfs。xsyncfs提供了与同步挂载的ext3文件系统相同的持久性和顺序保证。然而，即使面对I/O密集型基准测试，xsyncfs的性能也处于异步挂载ext3的7%范围内。与同步挂载的ext3相比，xsyncfs最多可快两个数量级。

upstream_only.title: Type-safe disks
upstream_only.abstract: We present the notion of a type-safe disk (TSD). Unlike a traditional disk system, a TSD is aware of the pointer relationships between disk blocks that are imposed by higher layers such as the file system. A TSD utilizes this knowledge in two key ways. First, it enables active enforcement of invariants on data access based on the pointer relationships, resulting in better security and integrity. Second, it enables semantics-aware optimizations within the disk system. Through case studies, we demonstrate the benefits of TSDs and show that a TSD presents a simple yet effective general interface to build the next generation of storage systems.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了类型安全磁盘（TSD）的概念。与传统磁盘系统不同，TSD能够感知由文件系统等更高层强加于磁盘块之间的指针关系。TSD以两种关键方式利用这一知识：首先，它能够基于指针关系主动强制执行数据访问上的不变量，从而带来更好的安全性和完整性；其次，它使得磁盘系统内部能够进行语义感知的优化。通过案例研究，我们展示了TSD的优势，并表明TSD为构建下一代存储系统提供了一个简单而有效的通用接口。

upstream_only.title: Stasis: flexible transactional storage
upstream_only.abstract: An increasing range of applications requires robust support for atomic, durable and concurrent transactions. Databases provide the default solution, but force applications to interact via SQL and to forfeit control over data layout and access mechanisms. We argue there is a gap between DBMSs and file systems that limits designers of data-oriented applications.Stasis is a storage framework that incorporates ideas from traditional write-ahead logging algorithms and file systems. It provides applications with flexible control over data structures, data layout, robustness, and performance. Stasis enables the development of unforeseen variants on transactional storage by generalizing write-ahead logging algorithms. Our partial implementation of these ideas already provides specialized (and cleaner) semantics to applications.We evaluate the performance of a traditional transactional storage system based on Stasis, and show that it performs favorably relative to existing systems. We present examples that make use of custom access methods, modified buffer manager semantics, direct log file manipulation, and LSN-free pages. These examples facilitate sophisticated performance optimizations such as zero-copy I/O. These extensions are composable, easy to implement and significantly improve performance.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 越来越多的应用需要原子性、持久性和并发事务的健壮支持。数据库提供了默认的解决方案，但强制应用通过SQL进行交互，并放弃对数据布局和访问机制的控制。我们认为数据库管理系统与文件系统之间存在一个空白，这限制了面向数据应用的设计者的发挥。Stasis是一个存储框架，融合了传统预写日志算法和文件系统的思想。它为应用提供了对数据结构、数据布局、健壮性和性能的灵活控制。Stasis通过泛化预写日志算法，支持开发意外出现的移动存储变体。我们对该思想的局部实现已经为应用提供了专门化（且更简洁）的语义。我们评估了基于Stasis的传统移动存储系统的性能，并表明其相对于现有系统具有良好表现。我们提供了利用自定义访问方法、修改缓冲区管理器语义、直接日志文件操作和无LSN页面的示例。这些示例促进了诸如零拷贝I/O之类的复杂性能优化。这些扩展是可组合的，易于实现，并显著提高了性能。

upstream_only.title: SafeDrive: safe and recoverable extensions using language-based techniques
upstream_only.abstract: We present SafeDrive, a system for detecting and recovering from type safety violations in software extensions. SafeDrive has low overhead and requires minimal changes to existing source code. To achieve this result, SafeDrive uses a novel type system that provides fine-grained isolation for existing extensions written in C. In addition, SafeDrive tracks invariants using simple wrappers for the host system API and restores them when recovering from a violation. This approach achieves fine-grained memory error detection and recovery with few code changes and at a significantly lower performance cost than existing solutions based on hardware-enforced domains, such as Nooks [33], L4 [21], and Xen [13], or software-enforced domains, such as SFI [35]. The principles used in SafeDrive can be applied to any large system with loadable, error-prone extension modules.In this paper we describe our experience using SafeDrive for protection and recovery of a variety of Linux device drivers. In order to apply SafeDrive to these device drivers, we had to change less than 4\% of the source code. SafeDrive recovered from all 44 crashes due to injected faults in a network card driver. In experiments with 6 different drivers, we observed increases in kernel CPU utilization of 4--23\% with no noticeable degradation in end-to-end performance.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了SafeDrive，一个用于检测和恢复软件扩展中类型安全违规的系统。SafeDrive具有低开销，并且需要对现有源代码进行最小程度的修改。为实现这一目标，SafeDrive使用了一种新颖的类型系统，为用C编写的现有扩展提供细粒度隔离。此外，SafeDrive使用简单的包装器跟踪宿主系统API的不变量，并在从违规中恢复时恢复这些不变量。这种方法实现了细粒度的内存错误检测和恢复，只需很少的代码更改，并且性能成本显著低于基于硬件强制域（如Nooks、L4和Xen）或软件强制域（如SFI）的现有解决方案。SafeDrive中使用的原理可应用于任何具有可加载、易出错扩展模块的大型系统。本文描述了我们将SafeDrive用于保护和恢复各种Linux设备驱动程序的经验。为了将SafeDrive应用于这些设备驱动程序，我们只需更改不到4%的源代码。SafeDrive从网络卡驱动程序中注入故障导致的所有44次崩溃中恢复。在6个不同驱动程序的实验中，我们观察到内核CPU利用率增加了4-23%，而端到端性能没有明显下降。

upstream_only.title: BrowserShield: vulnerability-driven filtering of dynamic HTML
upstream_only.abstract: Vulnerability-driven filtering of network data can offer a fast and easy-to-deploy alternative or intermediary to software patching, as exemplified in Shield [43]. In this paper, we take Shield's vision to a new domain, inspecting and cleansing not just static content, but also dynamic content. The dynamic content we target is the dynamic HTML in web pages, which have become a popular vector for attacks. The key challenge in filtering dynamic HTML is that it is undecidable to statically determine whether an embedded script will exploit the browser at run-time. We avoid this undecidability problem by rewriting web pages and any embedded scripts into safe equivalents, inserting checks so that the filtering is done at run-time. The rewritten pages contain logic for recursively applying run-time checks to dynamically generated or modified web content, based on known vulnerabilities. We have built and evaluated BrowserShield, a system that performs this dynamic instrumentation of embedded scripts, and that admits policies for customized run-time actions like vulnerability-driven filtering.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 基于漏洞的网络数据过滤可以作为一种快速、易于部署的软件补丁替代方案或中间方案，如Shield[43]所示。在本文中，我们将Shield的构想拓展到一个新领域，不仅检查静态内容，还检查并净化动态内容。我们针对的动态内容是网页中的动态HTML，它已成为一种流行的攻击载体。过滤动态HTML的关键挑战在于，静态确定嵌入的脚本是否会在运行时利用浏览器是不可判定的。我们通过将网页和嵌入的脚本重写为安全的等价物来避免这一不可判定问题，插入检查以便在运行时进行过滤。重写后的页面包含递归地将运行时检查应用于动态生成或修改的网页内容的逻辑，且基于已知漏洞。我们构建并评估了BrowserShield系统，该系统执行嵌入脚本的动态插桩，并支持自定义运行时操作策略，如基于漏洞的过滤。

upstream_only.title: XFI: software guards for system address spaces
upstream_only.abstract: XFI is a comprehensive protection system that offers both flexible access control and fundamental integrity guarantees, at any privilege level and even for legacy code in commodity systems. For this purpose, XFI combines static analysis with inline software guards and a two-stack execution model. We have implemented XFI for Windows on the x86 architecture using binary rewriting and a simple, stand-alone verifier; the implementation's correctness depends on the verifier, but not on the rewriter. We have applied XFI to software such as device drivers and multimedia codecs. The resulting modules function safely within both kernel and user-mode address spaces, with only modest enforcement overheads.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: XFI是一个全面的保护系统，在任何特权级别，甚至对于商业系统中的遗留代码，都能提供灵活的访问控制和基本完整性保证。为此，XFI将静态分析与内联软件防护及双栈执行模型相结合。我们已经针对x86架构上的Windows实现了XFI，采用二进制重写和一个简单、独立的验证器；该实现的正确性依赖于验证器，而不依赖于重写器。我们已将XFI应用于设备驱动程序和多媒体编解码器等软件。由此产生的模块在内核和用户态地址空间中都能安全运行，且仅带来适度的强制开销。

upstream_only.title: Operating system profiling via latency analysis
upstream_only.abstract: Operating systems are complex and their behavior depends on many factors. Source code, if available, does not directly help one to understand the OS's behavior, as the behavior depends on actual workloads and external inputs. Runtime profiling is a key technique to prove new concepts, debug problems, and optimize performance. Unfortunately, existing profiling methods are lacking in important areas---they do not provide enough information about the OS's behavior, they require OS modification and therefore are not portable, or they incur high overheads thus perturbing the profiled OS.We developed OSprof: a versatile, portable, and efficient OS profiling method based on latency distributions analysis. OSprof automatically selects important profiles for subsequent visual analysis. We have demonstrated that a suitable workload can be used to profile virtually any OS component. OSprof is portable because it can intercept operations and measure OS behavior from user-level or from inside the kernel without requiring source code. OSprof has typical CPU time overheads below 4\%. In this paper we describe our techniques and demonstrate their usefulness through a series of profiles conducted on Linux, FreeBSD, and Windows, including client/server scenarios. We discovered and investigated a number of interesting interactions, including scheduler behavior, multi-modal I/O distributions, and a previously unknown lock contention, which we fixed.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 操作系统十分复杂，其行为取决于许多因素。源代码（如果有的话）并不能直接帮助人们理解操作系统的行为，因为行为取决于实际工作负载和外部输入。运行时剖析是验证新概念、调试问题和优化性能的关键技术。不幸的是，现有剖析方法在重要领域存在不足——它们无法提供足够的操作系统行为信息，需要修改操作系统因此不可移植，或者带来高开销从而干扰被剖析的系统。我们开发了OSprof：一种基于延迟分布分析的通用、可移植且高效的操作系统剖析方法。OSprof自动选择重要的剖析结果以供后续可视化分析。我们证明了可以使用合适的工作负载来剖析几乎任何操作系统组件。OSprof具有可移植性，因为它可以在用户态或内核内部拦截操作并测量操作系统行为，而无需源代码。OSprof的典型CPU时间开销低于4%。本文描述了我们的技术，并通过在Linux、FreeBSD和Windows上进行的一系列剖析（包括客户端/服务器场景）展示了其实用性。我们发现并调查了若干有趣的交互现象，包括调度器行为、多模态I/O分布以及一个先前未知的锁竞争问题，并对其进行了修复。

upstream_only.title: CRAMM: virtual memory support for garbage-collected applications
upstream_only.abstract: Existing virtual memory systems usually work well with applications written in C and C++, but they do not provide adequate support for garbage-collected applications. The performance of garbage-collected applications is sensitive to heap size. Larger heaps reduce the frequency of garbage collections, making them run several times faster. However, if the heap is too large to fit in the available RAM, garbage collection can trigger thrashing. Existing Java virtual machines attempt to adapt their application heap sizes to fit in RAM, but suffer performance degradations of up to 94\% when subjected to bursts of memory pressure.We present CRAMM (Cooperative Robust Automatic Memory Management), a system that solves these problems. CRAMM consists of two parts: (1) a new virtual memory system that collects detailed reference information for (2) an analytical model tailored to the underlying garbage collection algorithm. The CRAMM virtual memory system tracks recent reference behavior with low overhead. The CRAMM heap sizing model uses this information to compute a heap size that maximizes throughput while minimizing paging. We present extensive empirical results demonstrating CRAMM's ability to maintain high performance in the face of changing application and system load.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现有的虚拟内存系统通常能很好地支持用 C 和 C++ 编写的应用程序，但并不能为垃圾回收应用程序提供足够的支持。垃圾回收应用程序的性能对堆大小很敏感。较大的堆会减少垃圾回收的频率，使其运行速度提升数倍。然而，如果堆太大而无法装入可用 RAM，垃圾回收可能会引发颠簸。现有的 Java 虚拟机尝试调整应用程序堆大小以适应 RAM，但在遭遇内存压力突发时，性能下降幅度可高达 94%。我们提出了 CRAMM（协作式健壮自动内存管理），一个解决这些问题的系统。CRAMM 由两部分组成：(1) 一个新的虚拟内存系统，用于为一个（2）针对底层垃圾回收算法量身定制的分析模型收集详细的引用信息。CRAMM 虚拟内存系统以低开销跟踪近期引用行为。CRAMM 堆大小调整模型利用这些信息来计算一个在最大化吞吐量的同时最小化分页的堆大小。我们提供了广泛的实证结果，证明 CRAMM 能够在应用程序和系统负载变化时保持高性能。

upstream_only.title: Flight data recorder: monitoring persistent-state interactions to improve systems management
upstream_only.abstract: Mismanagement of the persistent state of a system---all the executable files, configuration settings and other data that govern how a system functions---causes reliability problems, security vulnerabilities, and drives up operation costs. Recent research traces persistent state interactions---how state is read, modified, etc.---to help troubleshooting, change management and malware mitigation, but has been limited by the difficulty of collecting, storing, and analyzing the 10s to 100s of millions of daily events that occur on a single machine, much less the 1000s or more machines in many computing environments.We present the Flight Data Recorder (FDR) that enables always-on tracing, storage and analysis of persistent state interactions. FDR uses a domain-specific log format, tailored to observed file system workloads and common systems management queries. Our lossless log format compresses logs to only 0.5--0.9 bytes per interaction. In this log format, 1000 machine-days of logs---over 25 billion events---can be analyzed in less than 30 minutes. We report on our deployment of FDR to 207 production machines at MSN, and show that a single centralized collection machine can potentially scale to collecting and analyzing the complete records of persistent state interactions from 4000+ machines. Furthermore, our tracing technology is shipping as part of the Windows Vista OS.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 系统持久状态——即控制系统运行方式的所有可执行文件、配置设置及其他数据——的管理不善会导致可靠性问题、安全漏洞，并推高运维成本。近期研究追踪持久状态交互（即状态如何被读取、修改等），以帮助故障排除、变更管理和恶意软件缓解，但一直受限于在一台机器上收集、存储和分析每天数千万事件的难度，更不用说在许多计算环境中多达数千台甚至更多的机器。我们提出了飞行数据记录器（FDR），能够实现对持久状态交互的持续追踪、存储和分析。FDR采用一种领域特定的日志格式，该格式针对观察到的文件系统工作负载和常见的系统管理查询进行定制。我们的无损日志格式将日志压缩到每次交互仅0.5–0.9字节。在此日志格式下，1000机器天的日志——超过250亿个事件——可在不到30分钟内完成分析。我们报告了在MSN中207台生产机器上部署FDR的情况，并表明单个集中式收集机器可以扩展到从4000多台机器收集和分析持久状态交互的完整记录。此外，我们的追踪技术已作为Windows Vista操作系统的一部分发货。

upstream_only.title: EXPLODE: a lightweight, general system for finding serious storage system errors
upstream_only.abstract: Storage systems such as file systems, databases, and RAID systems have a simple, basic contract: you give them data, they do not lose or corrupt it. Often they store the only copy, making its irrevocable loss almost arbitrarily bad. Unfortunately, their code is exceptionally hard to get right, since it must correctly recover from any crash at any program point, no matter how their state was smeared across volatile and persistent memory.This paper describes EXPLODE, a system that makes it easy to systematically check real storage systems for errors. It takes user-written, potentially system-specific checkers and uses them to drive a storage system into tricky corner cases, including crash recovery errors. EXPLODE uses a novel adaptation of ideas from model checking, a comprehensive, heavy-weight formal verification technique, that makes its checking more systematic (and hopefully more effective) than a pure testing approach while being just as lightweight.EXPLODE is effective. It found serious bugs in a broad range of real storage systems (without requiring source code): three version control systems, Berkeley DB, an NFS implementation, ten file systems, a RAID system, and the popular VMware GSX virtual machine. We found bugs in every system we checked, 36 bugs in total, typically with little effort.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 存储系统（如文件系统、数据库和RAID系统）有一个简单而基本的契约：你给它们数据，它们不能丢失或损坏。它们常常保存着唯一的副本，使其不可挽回的丢失几乎任意糟糕。不幸的是，它们的代码极难做到正确，因为它必须能够在任何程序点从任何崩溃中正确恢复，而无论其状态如何分布在易失性和持久性内存中。本文描述了EXPLODE，一个能够轻松系统性检查真实存储系统错误的系统。它采用用户编写的、可能特定于系统的检查器，并驱动存储系统进入棘手的边界情况，包括崩溃恢复错误。EXPLODE采用了模型检查思想的创新改编——一种全面的、重量级的形式化验证技术——使其检查比纯测试方法更系统（并且希望更有效），同时又保持轻量级。EXPLODE是有效的。它在各种真实存储系统中发现了严重错误（无需源代码）：三个版本控制系统、Berkeley DB、一个NFS实现、十个文件系统、一个RAID系统以及流行的VMware GSX虚拟机。我们在每个被检查的系统中都发现了错误，总共36个，通常只需很少的努力。

upstream_only.title: Securing software by enforcing data-flow integrity
upstream_only.abstract: Software attacks often subvert the intended data-flow in a vulnerable program. For example, attackers exploit buffer overflows and format string vulnerabilities to write data to unintended locations. We present a simple technique that prevents these attacks by enforcing data-flow integrity. It computes a data-flow graph using static analysis, and it instruments the program to ensure that the flow of data at runtime is allowed by the data-flow graph. We describe an efficient implementation of data-flow integrity enforcement that uses static analysis to reduce instrumentation overhead. This implementation can be used in practice to detect a broad class of attacks and errors because it can be applied automatically to C and C++ programs without modifications, it does not have false positives, and it has low overhead.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 软件攻击常常破坏易受攻击程序中的预期数据流。例如，攻击者利用缓冲区溢出和格式化字符串漏洞将数据写入非预期位置。我们提出了一种通过强制数据流完整性来防止这些攻击的简单技术。该技术利用静态分析计算数据流图，并对程序进行插桩，以确保运行时数据流是数据流图所允许的。我们描述了一种高效的数据流完整性强制执行实现，该实现使用静态分析来减少插桩开销。该实现可用于实际检测广泛类别的攻击和错误，因为它可以自动应用于C和C++程序而无需修改，不会产生误报，且开销较低。

upstream_only.title: From uncertainty to belief: inferring the specification within
upstream_only.abstract: Automatic tools for finding software errors require a set of specifications before they can check code: if they do not know what to check, they cannot find bugs. This paper presents a novel framework based on factor graphs for automatically inferring specifications directly from programs. The key strength of the approach is that it can incorporate many disparate sources of evidence, allowing us to squeeze significantly more information from our observations than previously published techniques.We illustrate the strengths of our approach by applying it to the problem of inferring what functions in C programs allocate and release resources. We evaluated its effectiveness on five codebases: SDL, OpenSSH, GIMP, and the OS kernels for Linux and Mac OS X (XNU). For each codebase, starting with zero initially provided annotations, we observed an inferred annotation accuracy of 80--90\%, with often near perfect accuracy for functions called as little asfive times. Many of the inferred allocator and deallocator functions are functions for which we both lack the implementation and are rarely called---in some cases functions with at most one or two callsites. Finally, with the inferred annotations we quickly found both missing and incorrect properties in a specification used by a commercial static bug-finding tool.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 用于发现软件错误的自动化工具在检查代码之前需要一组规范：如果它们不知道要检查什么，就无法发现缺陷。本文提出了一个基于因子图的新框架，用于直接从程序中自动推断规范。该方法的关键优势在于它能整合许多不同来源的证据，使我们能够从观察中获取比先前发表的技术多得多的信息。我们将该方法应用于推断C程序中哪些函数分配和释放资源的问题，以展示其优势。我们在五个代码库上评估了其有效性：SDL、OpenSSH、GIMP，以及Linux和Mac OS X（XNU）的操作系统内核。对于每个代码库，从零个初始标注开始，我们观察到推断标注的准确率为80%–90%，对于调用次数仅为5次的函数，准确率通常接近完美。许多推断出的分配器和释放器函数，我们既缺乏其实现，又很少被调用——在某些情况下，调用点最多只有一到两处。最后，利用推断出的标注，我们很快在一个商业静态缺陷查找工具所使用的规范中发现了缺失和错误的属性。

upstream_only.title: HQ replication: a hybrid quorum protocol for byzantine fault tolerance
upstream_only.abstract: There are currently two approaches to providing Byzantine-fault-tolerant state machine replication: a replica-based approach, e.g., BFT, that uses communication between replicas to agree on a proposed ordering of requests, and a quorum-based approach, such as Q/U, in which clients contact replicas directly to optimistically execute operations. Both approaches have shortcomings: the quadratic cost of inter-replica communication is un-necessary when there is no contention, and Q/U requires a large number of replicas and performs poorly under contention.We present HQ, a hybrid Byzantine-fault-tolerant state machine replication protocol that overcomes these problems. HQ employs a lightweight quorum-based protocol when there is no contention, but uses BFT to resolve contention when it arises. Furthermore, HQ uses only 3f + 1 replicas to tolerate f faults, providing optimal resilience to node failures.We implemented a prototype of HQ, and we compare its performance to BFT and Q/U analytically and experimentally. Additionally, in this work we use a new implementation of BFT designed to scale as the number of faults increases. Our results show that both HQ and our new implementation of BFT scale as f increases; additionally our hybrid approach of using BFT to handle contention works well.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 目前有两种提供拜占庭容错状态机复制的方法：一种是基于副本的方法（例如BFT），它利用副本之间的通信来商定请求的提议顺序；另一种是基于法定人数的方法（例如Q/U），客户端直接联系副本以乐观地执行操作。两种方法都有缺点：在没有争用的情况下，副本间通信的二次方成本是不必要的；而Q/U需要大量副本，并且在争用情况下表现不佳。我们提出了HQ，一种克服这些问题的混合拜占庭容错状态机复制协议。HQ在没有争用时采用轻量级基于法定人数的协议，但在出现争用时使用BFT来解决。此外，HQ仅使用3f+1个副本即可容忍f个故障，提供了对节点故障的最优弹性。我们实现了HQ的原型，并通过分析和实验将其性能与BFT和Q/U进行比较。此外，在这项工作中，我们使用了一个新的BFT实现，该实现设计为随故障数量增加而扩展。我们的结果表明，HQ和我们新的BFT实现都能随f的增加而扩展；此外，我们使用BFT处理争用的混合方法效果良好。

upstream_only.title: BAR gossip
upstream_only.abstract: We present the first peer-to-peer data streaming application that guarantees predictable throughput and low latency in the BAR (Byzantine/Altruistic/Rational) model, in which non-altruistic nodes can behave in ways that are self-serving (rational) or arbitrarily malicious (Byzantine). At the core of our solution is a BAR-tolerant version of gossip, a well-known technique for scalable and reliable data dissemination. BAR Gossip relies on verifiable pseudo-random partner selection to eliminate non-determinism that can be used to game the system while maintaining the robustness and rapid convergence of traditional gossip. A novel fair enough exchange primitive entices cooperation among selfish nodes on short timescales, avoiding the need for long-term node reputations. Our initial experience provides evidence for BAR Gossip's robustness. Our BAR-tolerant streaming application provides over 99\% convergence for broadcast updates when all clients are selfish but not colluding, and over 95\% convergence when up to 40\% of clients collude while the rest follow the protocol. BAR Gossip also performs well when the client population consists of both selfish and Byzantine nodes, achieving over 93\% convergence even when 20\% of the nodes are Byzantine.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了首个对等数据流应用，该应用在BAR（拜占庭/利他/理性）模型中保证可预测的吞吐量和低延迟。在BAR模型中，非利他节点可能以自利（理性）或任意恶意（拜占庭）的方式行为。我们解决方案的核心是八卦协议的BAR容忍版本，八卦是一种众所周知的可扩展且可靠的数据传播技术。BAR八卦依赖可验证的伪随机伙伴选择来消除可用于操纵系统的不确定性，同时保持传统八卦的鲁棒性和快速收敛。一种新颖的公平足够交换原语在短时间尺度上诱使自私节点合作，避免了对长期节点声誉的需求。我们的初步经验为BAR八卦的鲁棒性提供了证据。当所有客户端自私但未合谋时，我们的BAR容忍流应用对广播更新的收敛率超过99%；当最多40%的客户端合谋而其余客户端遵循协议时，收敛率超过95%。当客户端群体同时包含自私和拜占庭节点时，BAR八卦也表现良好，即使20%的节点是拜占庭的，收敛率也超过93%。

upstream_only.title: Bigtable: a distributed storage system for structured data
upstream_only.abstract: Bigtable is a distributed storage system for managing structured data that is designed to scale to a very large size: petabytes of data across thousands of commodity servers. Many projects at Google store data in Bigtable, including web indexing, Google Earth, and Google Finance. These applications place very different demands on Bigtable, both in terms of data size (from URLs to web pages to satellite imagery) and latency requirements (from backend bulk processing to real-time data serving). Despite these varied demands, Bigtable has successfully provided a flexible, high-performance solution for all of these Google products. In this paper we describe the simple data model provided by Bigtable, which gives clients dynamic control over data layout and format, and we describe the design and implementation of Bigtable.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Bigtable是一种用于管理结构化数据的分布式存储系统，设计目标是扩展到极大规模：跨数千台商用服务器的PB级数据。Google的许多项目（包括网页索引、Google Earth和Google Finance）都将数据存储在Bigtable中。这些应用对Bigtable提出了不同的需求，无论是数据规模（从URL到网页再到卫星图像）还是延迟要求（从后端批量处理到实时数据服务）。尽管需求各异，Bigtable已成功为所有这些Google产品提供了灵活、高性能的解决方案。在本文中，我们描述了Bigtable提供的简单数据模型，该模型让客户端能够动态控制数据布局和格式，并描述了Bigtable的设计与实现。

upstream_only.title: EnsemBlue: integrating distributed storage and consumer electronics
upstream_only.abstract: EnsemBlue is a distributed file system for personal multimedia that incorporates both general-purpose computers and consumer electronic devices (CEDs). Ensem-Blue leverages the capabilities of a few general-purpose computers to make CEDs first class clients of the file system. It supports namespace diversity by translating between its distributed namespace and the local namespaces of CEDs. It supports extensibility through persistent queries, a robust event notification mechanism that leverages the underlying cache consistency protocols of the file system. Finally, it allows mobile clients to self-organize and share data through device ensembles. Our results show that these features impose little overhead, yet they enable the integration of emerging platforms such as digital cameras, MP3 players, and DVRs.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: EnsemBlue是一个针对个人多媒体的分布式文件系统，融合了通用计算机和消费电子设备（CED）。EnsemBlue利用少量通用计算机的能力，使CED成为文件系统的一等客户端。它通过在分布式命名空间与CED的本地命名空间之间进行转换，支持命名空间多样性。它通过持久查询（一种利用底层文件系统缓存一致性协议的稳健事件通知机制）支持可扩展性。此外，它允许移动客户端通过设备集合自行组织并共享数据。我们的结果表明，这些功能带来的开销很小，同时它们支持集成数字相机、MP3播放器和DVR等新兴平台。

upstream_only.title: Persistent personal names for globally connected mobile devices
upstream_only.abstract: The Unmanaged Internet Architecture (UIA) provides zero-configuration connectivity among mobile devices through personal names. Users assign personal names through an ad hoc device introduction process requiring no central allocation. Once assigned, names bind securely to the global identities of their target devices independent of network location. Each user manages one namespace, shared among all the user's devices and always available on each device. Users can also name other users to share resources with trusted acquaintances. Devices with naming relationships automatically arrange connectivity when possible, both in ad hoc networks and using global infrastructure when available. A UIA prototype demonstrates these capabilities using optimistic replication for name resolution and group management and a routing algorithm exploiting the user's social network for connectivity.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 非受管互联网架构（UIA）通过个人名称在移动设备之间提供零配置连接。用户通过无需中央分配的临时设备引入过程来分配个人名称。一旦分配，名称便安全地绑定到目标设备的全局身份，与网络位置无关。每个用户管理一个命名空间，该命名空间在用户的所有设备之间共享，并在每台设备上始终可用。用户还可以为其他用户命名，以与可信熟人共享资源。具有命名关系的设备在可能的情况下会自动安排连接，既可在临时网络中也可利用可用时的全球基础设施。UIA原型通过用于名称解析和组管理的乐观复制以及利用用户社交网络进行连接的路由算法展示了这些能力。

upstream_only.title: A modular network layer for sensorsets
upstream_only.abstract: An overall sensornet architecture would help tame the increasingly complex structure of wireless sensornet software and help foster greater interoperability between different codebases. A previous step in this direction is the Sensornet Protocol (SP), a unifying link-abstraction layer. This paper takes the natural next step by proposing a modular network-layer for sensornets that sits atop SP. This modularity eases implementation of new protocols by increasing code reuse, and enables co-existing protocols to share and reduce code and resources consumed at run-time. We demonstrate how current protocols can be decomposed into this modular structure and show that the costs, in performance and code footprint, are minimal relative to their monolithic counterparts.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 一个整体的传感器网络架构将有助于梳理无线传感器网络软件日益复杂的结构，并促进不同代码库之间更强的互操作性。此前朝此方向迈出的一步是Sensornet Protocol（SP），一个统一的链路抽象层。本文提出自然的下一步：在SP之上构建一个模块化的传感器网络网络层。该模块化通过提高代码复用来简化新协议的实现，并使共存协议能够共享代码，从而减少运行时资源消耗。我们展示了当前协议如何被分解为该模块化结构，并表明相对于整体式协议，其在性能和代码占用方面的成本微不足道。

upstream_only.title: Making information flow explicit in HiStar
upstream_only.abstract: HiStar is a new operating system designed to minimize the amount of code that must be trusted. HiStar provides strict information flow control, which allows users to specify precise data security policies without unduly limiting the structure of applications. HiStar's security features make it possible to implement a Unix-like environment with acceptable performance almost entirely in an untrusted user-level library. The system has no notion of superuser and no fully trusted code other than the kernel. HiStar's features permit several novel applications, including an entirely untrusted login process, separation of data between virtual private networks, and privacy-preserving, untrusted virus scanners.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: HiStar是一种旨在最小化需信任代码量的新型操作系统。HiStar提供严格的信息流控制，允许用户指定精确的数据安全策略，同时不过度限制应用程序的结构。HiStar的安全特性使得几乎完全在不受信任的用户级库中实现类似Unix的环境且性能可接受成为可能。该系统没有超级用户的概念，除内核外也没有完全受信任的代码。HiStar的特性支持多种新颖应用，包括完全不受信任的登录进程、虚拟专用网络之间的数据隔离，以及保护隐私的不受信任病毒扫描器。

upstream_only.title: Splitting interfaces: making trust between applications and operating systems configurable
upstream_only.abstract: In current commodity systems, applications have no way of limiting their trust in the underlying operating system (OS), leaving them at the complete mercy of an attacker who gains control over the OS. In this work, we describe the design and implementation of Proxos, a system that allows applications to configure their trust in the OS by partitioning the system call interface into trusted and untrusted components. System call routing rules that indicate which system calls are to be handled by the un-trusted commodity OS, and which are to be handled by a trusted private OS, are specified by the application developer. We find that rather than defining a new system call interface, routing system calls of an existing interface allows applications currently targeted towards commodity operating systems to isolate their most sensitive components from the commodity OS with only minor source code modifications.We have built a prototype of our system on top of the Xen Virtual Machine Monitor with Linux as the commodity OS. In practice, we find that the system call routing rules are short and simple -- on the order of 10's of lines of code. In addition, applications in Proxos incur only modest performance overhead, with most of the cost resulting from inter-VM context switches.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在当前商品化系统中，应用程序无法限制其对底层操作系统（OS）的信任，这使得一旦攻击者控制了操作系统，应用程序便完全任其摆布。在这项工作中，我们描述了Proxos的设计与实现，该系统允许应用程序通过将系统调用接口划分为可信和不可信组件来配置对操作系统的信任。指示哪些系统调用由不可信的商用操作系统处理、哪些由可信的私有操作系统处理的系统调用路由规则，由应用程序开发者指定。我们发现，与其定义一个新的系统调用接口，对现有接口的系统调用进行路由，能使当前面向商用操作系统的应用程序仅需少量源代码修改即可将其最敏感的组件与商用操作系统隔离。我们在Xen虚拟机监视器之上构建了系统原型，以Linux作为商用操作系统。实践中我们发现，系统调用路由规则简短而简单——大约几十行代码。此外，Proxos中的应用程序仅承受适度的性能开销，大部分成本来自虚拟机间上下文切换。

upstream_only.title: Connection handoff policies for TCP offload network interfaces
upstream_only.abstract: This paper presents three policies for effectively utilizing TCP offload network interfaces that support connection handoff. These policies allow connection handoff to reduce the computation and memory bandwidth requirements for packet processing on the host processor without causing the resource constraints on the network interface to limit overall system performance. First, prioritizing packet processing on the network interface ensures that its TCP processing does not harm performance of the connections on the host operating system. Second, dynamically adapting the number of connections on the network interface to the current load avoids overloading the network interface. Third, the operating system can predict connection lifetimes to select long-lived connections for handoff to better utilize the network interface. The use of the first two policies improves web server throughput by 12--31\% over the baseline throughput achieved without offload. The third policy helps improve performance when the network interface can only handle a small number of connections at a time. Furthermore, by using a faster offload processor, offloading can improve server throughput by 33--72\%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文提出了三种策略，用于有效利用支持连接交接的TCP卸载网络接口。这些策略允许连接交接减少主机处理器上数据包处理所需的计算和内存带宽，而不会使网络接口上的资源限制限制整体系统性能。首先，优先处理网络接口上的数据包确保其TCP处理不会损害主机操作系统上连接的性能。其次，动态调整网络接口上的连接数量以适应当前负载，避免网络接口过载。第三，操作系统可以预测连接生命周期，以选择长连接进行交接，从而更好地利用网络接口。使用前两种策略可将Web服务器吞吐量比无卸载的基线吞吐量提高12-31%。当网络接口一次只能处理少量连接时，第三种策略有助于提高性能。此外，通过使用更快的卸载处理器，卸载可将服务器吞吐量提高33-72%。

upstream_only.title: Ceph: a scalable, high-performance distributed file system
upstream_only.abstract: We have developed Ceph, a distributed file system that provides excellent performance, reliability, and scalability. Ceph maximizes the separation between data and metadata management by replacing allocation tables with a pseudo-random data distribution function (CRUSH) designed for heterogeneous and dynamic clusters of unreliable object storage devices (OSDs). We leverage device intelligence by distributing data replication, failure detection and recovery to semi-autonomous OSDs running a specialized local object file system. A dynamic distributed metadata cluster provides extremely efficient metadata management and seamlessly adapts to a wide range of general purpose and scientific computing file system workloads. Performance measurements under a variety of workloads show that Ceph has excellent I/O performance and scalable metadata management, supporting more than 250,000 metadata operations per second.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们开发了Ceph，一个提供出色性能、可靠性和可扩展性的分布式文件系统。Ceph通过用伪随机数据分布函数(CRUSH)替代分配表来最大化数据与元数据管理的分离，该函数专为异构和动态集群的不可靠对象存储设备(OSD)设计。我们利用设备智能，将数据复制、故障检测和恢复分布到运行专用本地对象文件系统的半自主OSD上。一个动态分布式元数据集群提供了极其高效的元数据管理，并能够无缝适应各种通用和科学计算文件系统工作负载。在各种工作负载下的性能测量表明，Ceph具有优秀的I/O性能和可扩展的元数据管理，每秒可支持超过25万次元数据操作。

upstream_only.title: Distributed directory service in the Farsite file system
upstream_only.abstract: We present the design, implementation, and evaluation of a fully distributed directory service for Farsite, a logically centralized file system that is physically implemented on a loosely coupled network of desktop computers. Prior to this work, the Farsite system included distributed mechanisms for file content but centralized mechanisms for file metadata. Our distributed directory service introduces tree-structured file identifiers that support dynamically partitioning metadata at arbitrary granularity, recursive path leases for scalably maintaining name-space consistency, and a protocol for consistently performing operations on files managed by separate machines. It also mitigates metadata hotspots via file-field leases and the new mechanism of disjunctive leases. We experimentally show that Farsite can dynamically partition file-system metadata while maintaining full file-system semantics.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们介绍了Farsite中完全分布式目录服务的设计、实现和评估。Farsite是一个逻辑上集中但在松散耦合的桌面计算机网络上物理实现的文件系统。在这项工作之前，Farsite系统包含用于文件内容的分布式机制，但文件元数据采用了集中式机制。我们的分布式目录服务引入了树状文件标识符，支持任意粒度动态划分元数据；递归路径租约，以可扩展方式维护命名空间一致性；以及在不同机器管理文件时一致执行操作的协议。它还通过文件字段租约和新的析取租约机制缓解元数据热点。我们通过实验证明，Farsite能够在维护完整文件系统语义的同时动态划分文件系统元数据。

upstream_only.title: The Chubby lock service for loosely-coupled distributed systems
upstream_only.abstract: We describe our experiences with the Chubby lock service, which is intended to provide coarse-grained locking as well as reliable (though low-volume) storage for a loosely-coupled distributed system. Chubby provides an interface much like a distributed file system with advisory locks, but the design emphasis is on availability and reliability, as opposed to high performance. Many instances of the service have been used for over a year, with several of them each handling a few tens of thousands of clients concurrently. The paper describes the initial design and expected use, compares it with actual use, and explains how the design had to be modified to accommodate the differences.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文描述了我们在Chubby锁服务上的经验。该服务旨在为松散耦合的分布式系统提供粗粒度锁以及可靠但低容量的存储。Chubby提供的接口非常类似于带建议性锁的分布式文件系统，但设计重点在于可用性和可靠性，而非高性能。多个服务实例已运行一年多，其中几个实例每个并发处理数万个客户端。本文介绍了初始设计和预期用途，与实际使用情况进行了比较，并解释了设计为了适应差异而如何被修改。

upstream_only.title: Experiences building PlanetLab
upstream_only.abstract: This paper reports our experiences building PlanetLab over the last four years. It identifies the requirements that shaped PlanetLab, explains the design decisions that resulted from resolving conflicts among these requirements, and reports our experience implementing and supporting the system. Due in large part to the nature of the "PlanetLab experiment," the discussion focuses on synthesis rather than new techniques, balancing system-wide considerations rather than improving performance along a single dimension, and learning from feedback from a live system rather than controlled experiments using synthetic workloads.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文报告了我们在过去四年中构建PlanetLab的经验。它确定了塑造PlanetLab的需求，解释了解决这些需求之间冲突所产生的设计决策，并报告了我们实施和支持该系统的经验。在很大程度上由于“PlanetLab实验”的性质，讨论侧重于综合而非新技术，平衡系统层面的考虑而非沿单一维度提升性能，以及从真实系统的反馈中学习而非使用合成工作负载进行受控实验。

upstream_only.title: iPlane: an information plane for distributed services
upstream_only.abstract: In this paper, we present the design, implementation, and evaluation of iPlane, a scalable service providing accurate predictions of Internet path performance for emerging overlay services. Unlike the more common black box latency prediction techniques in use today, iPlane adopts a structural approach and predicts end-to-end path performance by composing the performance of measured segments of Internet paths. For the paths we observed, this method allows us to accurately and efficiently predict latency, bandwidth, capacity and loss rates between arbitrary Internet hosts. We demonstrate the feasibility and utility of the iPlane service by applying it to several representative overlay services in use today: content distribution, swarming peer-to-peer filesharing, and voice-over-IP. In each case, using iPlane's predictions leads to improved overlay performance.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们介绍了iPlane的设计、实现和评估，它是一种可扩展的服务，为新兴的覆盖服务提供互联网路径性能的准确预测。与当今使用的更常见的黑盒延迟预测技术不同，iPlane采用结构化方法，通过组合互联网路径的测量网段性能来预测端到端路径性能。对于我们观察到的路径，这种方法使我们能够准确、高效地预测任意互联网主机之间的延迟、带宽、容量和丢包率。我们通过将iPlane应用于当今几种代表性的覆盖服务：内容分发、群组对等文件共享和IP语音，来展示其可行性和实用性。在每种情况下，使用iPlane的预测都能提高覆盖服务的性能。

upstream_only.title: Fidelity and yield in a volcano monitoring sensor network
upstream_only.abstract: We present a science-centric evaluation of a 19-day sensor network deployment at Reventador, an active volcano in Ecuador. Each of the 16 sensors continuously sampled seismic and acoustic data at 100 Hz. Nodes used an event-detection algorithm to trigger on interesting volcanic activity and initiate reliable data transfer to the base station. During the deployment, the network recorded 229 earthquakes, eruptions, and other seismoacoustic events.The science requirements of reliable data collection, accurate event detection, and high timing precision drive sensor networks in new directions for geophysical monitoring. The main contribution of this paper is an evaluation of the sensor network as a scientific instrument, holding it to the standards of existing instrumentation in terms of data fidelity (the quality and accuracy of the recorded signals) and yield (the quantity of the captured data). We describe an approach to time rectification of the acquired signals that can recover accurate timing despite failures of the underlying time synchronization protocol. In addition, we perform a detailed study of the sensor network's data using a direct comparison to a standalone data logger, as well as an investigation of seismic and acoustic wave arrival times across the network.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们对厄瓜多尔Reventador活火山上一个为期19天的传感器网络部署进行了以科学为中心的评估。16个传感器中的每一个都以100 Hz的频率连续采样地震和声学数据。节点使用事件检测算法来触发对有趣火山活动的响应，并启动到基站的高可靠性数据传输。在部署期间，网络记录了229次地震、火山喷发和其他地震声学事件。科学要求包括可靠的数据收集、准确的事件检测和高时间精度，这推动了传感器网络在地球物理监测方面的新的发展方向。本文的主要贡献是将传感器网络作为科学仪器进行评估，在数据保真度（记录信号的质量和准确性）和产出（捕获数据的数量）方面将其与现有仪器的标准进行比较。我们描述了一种对获取信号进行时间校正的方法，即使底层时间同步协议出现故障，也能恢复准确的时间。此外，我们通过与独立数据记录器的直接比较，以及研究网络中地震和声波到达时间，对传感器网络的数据进行了详细研究。

upstream_only.title: DryadLINQ: a system for general-purpose distributed data-parallel computing using a high-level language
upstream_only.abstract: DryadLINQ is a system and a set of language extensions that enable a new programming model for large scale distributed computing. It generalizes previous execution environments such as SQL, MapReduce, and Dryad in two ways: by adopting an expressive data model of strongly typed .NET objects; and by supporting general-purpose imperative and declarative operations on datasets within a traditional high-level programming language.A DryadLINQ program is a sequential program composed of LINQ expressions performing arbitrary side-effect-free transformations on datasets, and can be written and debugged using standard .NET development tools. The DryadLINQ system automatically and transparently translates the data-parallel portions of the program into a distributed execution plan which is passed to the Dryad execution platform. Dryad, which has been in continuous operation for several years on production clusters made up of thousands of computers, ensures efficient, reliable execution of this plan.We describe the implementation of the DryadLINQ compiler and runtime. We evaluate DryadLINQ on a varied set of programs drawn from domains such as web-graph analysis, large-scale log mining, and machine learning. We show that excellent absolute performance can be attained--a general-purpose sort of 1012 Bytes of data executes in 319 seconds on a 240-computer, 960- disk cluster--as well as demonstrating near-linear scaling of execution time on representative applications as we vary the number of computers used for a job.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: DryadLINQ是一个系统和一组语言扩展，它为大规模分布式计算提供了一种新的编程模型。它在两个方面推广了先前诸如SQL、MapReduce和Dryad之类的执行环境：采用强类型.NET对象的表达性数据模型；并支持在传统高级编程语言中对数据集进行通用的命令式和声明式操作。DryadLINQ程序是由LINQ表达式组成的顺序程序，对数据集执行任意的无副作用转换，并且可以使用标准.NET开发工具进行编写和调试。DryadLINQ系统自动且透明地将程序的数据并行部分转换为分布式执行计划，该计划传递给Dryad执行平台。Dryad已在由数千台计算机构成的生产集群上连续运行多年，确保该计划的高效、可靠执行。我们描述了DryadLINQ编译器和运行时的实现。我们在来自Web图分析、大规模日志挖掘和机器学习等领域的多种程序上评估了DryadLINQ。我们展示了可以获得的优异绝对性能——在包含240台计算机、960块磁盘的集群上，对10^12字节数据的通用排序在319秒内完成——同时也展示了在使用不同数量的计算机执行作业时，代表性应用程序的执行时间呈近线性扩展。

upstream_only.title: Everest: scaling down peak loads through I/O off-loading
upstream_only.abstract: Bursts in data center workloads are a real problem for storage subsystems. Data volumes can experience peak I/O request rates that are over an order of magnitude higher than average load. This requires significant overprovisioning, and often still results in significant I/O request latency during peaks.In order to address this problem we propose Everest, which allows data written to an overloaded volume to be temporarily off-loaded into a short-term virtual store. Everest creates the short-term store by opportunistically pooling underutilized storage resources either on a server or across servers within the data center. Writes are temporarily off-loaded from overloaded volumes to lightly loaded volumes, thereby reducing the I/O load on the former. Everest is transparent to and usable by unmodified applications, and does not change the persistence or consistency of the storage system. We evaluate Everest using traces from a production Exchange mail server as well as other benchmarks: our results show a 1.4-70 times reduction in mean response times during peaks.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 数据中心工作负载中的突发峰值对存储子系统而言是一个现实问题。数据卷可能经历比平均负载高一个数量级以上的峰值I/O请求率。这需要大量的过度供应，并且在峰值期间往往仍会导致显著的I/O请求延迟。为解决此问题，我们提出了Everest，它允许将写入超载卷的数据临时卸载到短期虚拟存储中。Everest通过机会性地汇集服务器上或数据中心内服务器间的未充分利用的存储资源来创建短期存储。写入将被临时从超载卷卸载到负载较轻的卷，从而减少前者的I/O负载。Everest对未修改的应用程序透明且可用，并且不会改变存储系统的持久性或一致性。我们使用来自生产环境Exchange邮件服务器以及其它基准测试的痕迹评估Everest：结果显示在峰值期间平均响应时间降低了1.4至70倍。

upstream_only.title: Improving MapReduce performance in heterogeneous environments
upstream_only.abstract: MapReduce is emerging as an important programming model for large-scale data-parallel applications such as web indexing, data mining, and scientific simulation. Hadoop is an open-source implementation of MapReduce enjoying wide adoption and is often used for short jobs where low response time is critical. Hadoop's performance is closely tied to its task scheduler, which implicitly assumes that cluster nodes are homogeneous and tasks make progress linearly, and uses these assumptions to decide when to speculatively re-execute tasks that appear to be stragglers. In practice, the homogeneity assumptions do not always hold. An especially compelling setting where this occurs is a virtualized data center, such as Amazon's Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2). We show that Hadoop's scheduler can cause severe performance degradation in heterogeneous environments. We design a new scheduling algorithm, Longest Approximate Time to End (LATE), that is highly robust to heterogeneity. LATE can improve Hadoop response times by a factor of 2 in clusters of 200 virtual machines on EC2.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: MapReduce正逐渐成为大规模数据并行应用（如网页索引、数据挖掘和科学模拟）的重要编程模型。Hadoop作为MapReduce的开源实现得到广泛采用，并且通常用于低响应时间至关重要的短作业。Hadoop的性能与其任务调度器密切相关，该调度器隐式地假设集群节点是同构的，且任务呈线性进展，并利用这些假设来决定何时推测性地重新执行那些看起来落后的任务。然而在实践中，同构性假设并不总是成立。一个特别具有说服力的场景是虚拟化数据中心，例如亚马逊的弹性计算云（EC2）。我们研究表明，Hadoop的调度器在异构环境中可能导致严重的性能下降。为此，我们设计了一种新的调度算法——最长近似完成时间（LATE），该算法对异构性具有高度鲁棒性。在EC2上由200台虚拟机组成的集群中，LATE可将Hadoop的响应时间提高一倍。

upstream_only.title: Corey: an operating system for many cores
upstream_only.abstract: Multiprocessor application performance can be limited by the operating system when the application uses the operating system frequently and the operating system services use data structures shared and modified by multiple processing cores. If the application does not need the sharing, then the operating system will become an unnecessary bottleneck to the application's performance.This paper argues that applications should control sharing: the kernel should arrange each data structure so that only a single processor need update it, unless directed otherwise by the application. Guided by this design principle, this paper proposes three operating system abstractions (address ranges, kernel cores, and shares) that allow applications to control inter-core sharing and to take advantage of the likely abundance of cores by dedicating cores to specific operating system functions.Measurements of microbenchmarks on the Corey prototype operating system, which embodies the new abstractions, show how control over sharing can improve performance. Application benchmarks, using MapReduce and a Web server, show that the improvements can be significant for overall performance: MapReduce on Corey performs 25\% faster than on Linux when using 16 cores. Hardware event counters confirm that these improvements are due to avoiding operations that are expensive on multicore machines.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 当应用程序频繁使用操作系统，并且操作系统服务使用由多个处理核心共享和修改的数据结构时，多处理器应用程序的性能可能受到操作系统的限制。如果应用程序不需要这种共享，操作系统将成为应用程序性能的不必要瓶颈。本文认为应用程序应控制共享：内核应安排每个数据结构，使得在应用程序未另有指示的情况下，只有单个处理器需要更新它。在这一设计原则的指导下，本文提出了三种操作系统抽象（地址范围、内核核心和份额），这些抽象允许应用程序控制核心间共享，并利用可能多核充裕的优势，将核心专门用于特定的操作系统功能。对体现这些新抽象的Corey原型操作系统的微基准测试表明，控制共享如何提高性能。使用MapReduce和Web服务器的应用基准测试表明，这些改进对整体性能可能具有重要意义：在16核下，Corey上的MapReduce比Linux上运行快25%。硬件事件计数器证实，这些改进归因于避免了在多核机器上开销高昂的操作。

upstream_only.title: CuriOS: improving reliability through operating system structure
upstream_only.abstract: An error that occurs in a microkernel operating system service can potentially result in state corruption and service failure. A simple restart of the failed service is not always the best solution for reliability. Blindly restarting a service which maintains client-related state such as session information results in the loss of this state and affects all clients that were using the service. CuriOS represents a novel OS design that uses lightweight distribution, isolation and persistence of OS service state to mitigate the problem of state loss during a restart. The design also significantly reduces error propagation within client-related state maintained by an OS service. This is achieved by encapsulating services in separate protection domains and granting access to client-related state only when required for request processing. Fault injection experiments show that it is possible to recover from between 87\% and 100\% of manifested errors in OS services such as the file system, network, timer and scheduler while maintaining low performance overheads.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 微内核操作系统服务中发生的错误可能导致状态损坏和服务失败。简单重启失败的服务并不总是提高可靠性的最佳方案。盲目重启维护客户端相关状态（如会话信息）的服务会导致这些状态丢失，并影响所有使用该服务的客户端。CuriOS代表了一种新颖的OS设计，它使用OS服务状态的轻量级分布、隔离和持久化来减轻重启期间状态丢失的问题。该设计还显著减少了操作系统服务维护的客户端相关状态中的错误传播。这是通过将服务封装在独立的保护域中，并仅在处理请求需要时授予对客户端相关状态的访问来实现的。故障注入实验表明，对于文件系统、网络、定时器和调度器等OS服务，可以从87%到100%的已显现错误中恢复，同时保持较低的性能开销。

upstream_only.title: Redline: first class support for interactivity in commodity operating systems
upstream_only.abstract: While modern workloads are increasingly interactive and resource-intensive (e.g., graphical user interfaces, browsers, and multimedia players), current operating systems have not kept up. These operating systems, which evolved from core designs that date to the 1970s and 1980s, provide good support for batch and command-line applications, but their ad hoc attempts to handle interactive workloads are poor. Their best-effort, priority-based schedulers provide no bounds on delays, and their resource managers (e.g., memory managers and disk I/O schedulers) are mostly oblivious to response time requirements. Pressure on any one of these resources can significantly degrade application responsiveness.We present Redline, a system that brings first-class support for interactive applications to commodity operating systems. Redline works with unaltered applications and standard APIs. It uses lightweight specifications to orchestrate memory and disk I/O management so that they serve the needs of interactive applications. Unlike realtime systems that treat specifications as strict requirements and thus pessimistically limit system utilization, Redline dynamically adapts to recent load, maximizing responsiveness and system utilization. We show that Redline delivers responsiveness to interactive applications even in the face of extreme workloads including fork bombs, memory bombs and bursty, large disk I/O requests, reducing application pauses by up to two orders of magnitude.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 虽然现代工作负载日益具有交互性和资源密集性（例如图形用户界面、浏览器和多媒体播放器），但当前操作系统并未跟上步伐。这些操作系统源自可追溯至20世纪70年代和80年代的核心设计，为批处理和命令行应用程序提供了良好支持，但其处理交互式工作负载的临时方法却很糟糕。它们基于尽力而为的优先级调度器对延迟没有界限，其资源管理器（例如内存管理器和磁盘I/O调度器）大多不考虑响应时间要求。对这些资源中的任何一个施加压力都会显着降低应用程序的响应能力。我们提出了Redline，这是一个为商用操作系统带来对交互式应用程序的一等支持的系统。Redline与未经修改的应用程序和标准API协同工作。它使用轻量级规范来协调内存和磁盘I/O管理，使其服务于交互式应用程序的需求。与将规范视为严格要求从而悲观地限制系统利用率的实时系统不同，Redline动态适应近期的负载，最大限度地提高响应能力和系统利用率。我们展示了Redline即使在极端工作负载（包括fork炸弹、内存炸弹和突发性大磁盘I/O请求）下也能为交互式应用程序提供响应能力，将应用程序暂停时间减少高达两个数量级。

upstream_only.title: Network imprecision: a new consistency metric for scalable monitoring
upstream_only.abstract: This paper introduces a new consistency metric, Network Imprecision (NI), to address a central challenge in largescale monitoring systems: safeguarding accuracy despite node and network failures. To implement NI, an overlay that monitors a set of attributes also monitors its own state so that queries return not only attribute values but also information about the stability of the overlay--the number of nodes whose recent updates may be missing and the number of nodes whose inputs may be double counted due to overlay reconfigurations. When NI indicates that the network is stable, query results are guaranteed to reflect the true state of the system. But when the network is unstable, NI puts applications on notice that query results should not be trusted, allowing them to take corrective action such as filtering out inconsistent results. To scalably implement NI's introspection, our prototype introduces a key optimization, dual-tree prefix aggregation, which exploits overlay symmetry to reduce overheads by more than an order of magnitude. Evaluation of three monitoring applications demonstrates that NI flags inaccurate results while incurring low overheads, and monitoring applications that use NI to select good information can improve their accuracy by up to an order of magnitude.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的一致性度量——网络不精确性（Network Imprecision, NI）——以解决大规模监控系统中的一个核心挑战：即使存在节点和网络故障，也要保证准确性。为了实现NI，一个监控一组属性的覆盖网络也会监控自身的状态，使得查询不仅返回属性值，还返回关于覆盖网络稳定性的信息——即可能缺少的最近更新的节点数量，以及因覆盖网络重新配置而可能被重复计数的节点数量。当NI表明网络稳定时，查询结果被保证反映系统的真实状态。但当网络不稳定时，NI会提醒应用程序不应信任查询结果，使它们能够采取纠正措施，例如过滤掉不一致的结果。为了可扩展地实现NI的自省，我们的原型引入了一项关键优化——双树前缀聚合（dual-tree prefix aggregation），它利用覆盖网络的对称性将开销降低一个数量级以上。对三个监控应用的评估表明，NI能够标记不准确的结果，同时保持较低的开销，而使用NI来选择良好信息的监控应用可将其准确性提高多达一个数量级。

upstream_only.title: Lightweight, high-resolution monitoring for troubleshooting production systems
upstream_only.abstract: Production systems are commonly plagued by intermittent problems that are difficult to diagnose. This paper describes a new diagnostic tool, called Chopstix, that continuously collects profiles of low-level OS events (e.g., scheduling, L2 cache misses, CPU utilization, I/O operations, page allocation, locking) at the granularity of executables, procedures and instructions. Chopstix then reconstructs these events offline for analysis. We have used Chopstix to diagnose several elusive problems in a largescale production system, thereby reducing these intermittent problems to reproducible bugs that can be debugged using standard techniques. The key to Chopstix is an approximate data collection strategy that incurs very low overhead. An evaluation shows Chopstix requires under 1\% of the CPU, under 256KB of RAM, and under 16MB of disk space per day to collect a rich set of system-wide data.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 生产系统常常受到难以诊断的间歇性问题困扰。本文描述了一种新的诊断工具Chopstix，它持续收集底层操作系统事件（例如调度、L2缓存未命中、CPU利用率、I/O操作、页分配、锁定）的配置信息，粒度涵盖可执行文件、过程和指令。随后，Chopstix离线重建这些事件以供分析。我们使用Chopstix诊断了一个大规模生产系统中的几个难以捉摸的问题，从而将这些间歇性问题简化为可以使用标准技术调试的可复现缺陷。Chopstix的关键是一种开销极低的近似数据收集策略。评估表明，Chopstix每天仅需不到1%的CPU、不到256KB的内存和不到16MB的磁盘空间，即可收集丰富的系统级数据。

upstream_only.title: Automating network application dependency discovery: experiences, limitations, and new solutions
upstream_only.abstract: Large enterprise networks consist of thousands of services and applications. The performance and reliability of any particular application may depend on multiple services, spanning many hosts and network components. While the knowledge of such dependencies is invaluable for ensuring the stability and efficiency of these applications, thus far the only proven way to discover these complex dependencies is by exploiting human expert knowledge, which does not scale with the number of applications in large enterprises.Recently, researchers have proposed automated discovery of dependencies from network traffic [8, 18]. In this paper, we present a comprehensive study of the performance and limitations of this class of dependency discovery techniques (including our own prior work), by comparing with the ground truth of five dominant Microsoft applications. We introduce a new system, Orion, that discovers dependencies using packet headers and timing information in network traffic based on a novel insight of delay spike based analysis. Orion improves the state of the art significantly, but some shortcomings still remain. To take the next step forward, Orion incorporates external tests to reduce errors to a manageable level. Our results show Orion provides a solid foundation for combining automated discovery with simple testing to obtain accurate and validated dependencies.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大型企业网络由成千上万的服务和应用组成。任何特定应用的性能和可靠性可能依赖于跨越许多主机和网络组件的多个服务。虽然此类依赖关系对于确保这些应用的稳定性和效率至关重要，但迄今为止，发现这些复杂依赖关系的唯一经过验证的方法是依靠人类专家知识，这种方法无法随着大型企业中应用数量的增加而扩展。最近，研究者提出了从网络流量中自动发现依赖关系的方法[8,18]。本文通过与微软五个主要应用的真实情况进行比较，对这类依赖发现技术（包括我们之前的工作）的性能和局限性进行了全面研究。我们引入了一个新系统Orion，基于延迟尖峰分析的新颖见解，利用网络流量中的报文头和时序信息来发现依赖关系。Orion显著改善了现有技术水平，但仍存在一些不足。为了更进一步，Orion结合外部测试将错误降低到可管理的水平。结果显示，Orion为将自动发现与简单测试相结合以获得准确且经过验证的依赖关系提供了坚实基础。

upstream_only.title: SQCK: a declarative file system checker
upstream_only.abstract: The lowly state of the art for file system checking and repair does not match what is needed to keep important data available for users. Current file system checkers, such as e2fsck, are complex pieces of imperfect code written in low-level languages. We introduce SQCK, a file system checker based on a declarative query language; declarative queries are a natural match for the cross-checking that must be performed across the many structures of a file system image. We show that SQCK is able to perform the same functionality as e2fsck with surprisingly elegant and compact queries. We also show that SQCK can easily perform more useful repairs than e2fsck by combining information available across the file system. Finally, our prototype implementation of SQCK achieves this improved functionality with comparable performance to e2fsck.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 文件系统检查与修复的现有技术水平远不能满足保持重要数据对用户可用的需求。当前的文件系统检查器（如e2fsck）是以低级语言编写的复杂且不完美的代码。我们引入了SQCK，这是一种基于声明式查询语言的文件系统检查器；声明式查询与跨文件系统映像的多种结构进行交叉检查的需求天然契合。我们展示了SQCK能够以出人意料地优雅和紧凑的查询执行与e2fsck相同的功能。我们还表明，通过结合整个文件系统中的信息，SQCK可以轻松进行比e2fsck更有用的修复。最后，我们的SQCK原型实现在改进功能的同时，性能与e2fsck相当。

upstream_only.title: Transactional flash
upstream_only.abstract: Transactional flash (TxFlash) is a novel solid-state drive (SSD) that uses flash memory and exports a transactional interface (WriteAtomic) to the higher-level software. The copy-on-write nature of the flash translation layer and the fast random access makes flash memory the right medium to support such an interface.
