We further develop a novel commit protocol called cyclic commit for TxFlash; the protocol has been specified formally and model checked.Our evaluation, both on a simulator and an emulator on top of a real SSD, shows that TxFlash does not increase the flash firmware complexity significantly and provides transactional features with very small overheads (less than 1\%), thereby making file systems easier to build. It further shows that the new cyclic commit protocol significantly outperforms traditional commit for small transactions (95\% improvement in transaction throughput) and completely eliminates the space overhead due to commit records.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 事务性闪存（TxFlash）是一种新型固态硬盘（SSD），它使用闪存并向上层软件提供事务性接口（WriteAtomic）。闪存转换层的写时复制特性和快速随机访问使闪存成为支持此类接口的合适介质。我们进一步为TxFlash开发了一种称为循环提交的新颖提交协议；该协议已被正式规约并通过模型检查。我们在模拟器和真实SSD之上的仿真器上的评估表明，TxFlash并未显著增加闪存固件的复杂性，并以非常小的开销（低于1%）提供事务特性，从而使文件系统更容易构建。评估还表明，新的循环提交协议在小事务方面显著优于传统提交（事务吞吐量提升95%），并完全消除了提交记录带来的空间开销。

upstream_only.title: Avoiding file system micromanagement with range writes
upstream_only.abstract: We introduce range writes, a simple but powerful change to the disk interface that removes the need for file system micromanagement of block placement. By allowing a file system to specify a set of possible address targets, range writes enable the disk to choose the final on-disk location of the request; the disk improves performance by writing to the closest location and subsequently reporting its choice to the file system above. The result is a clean separation of responsibility; the file system (as high-level manager) provides coarse-grained control over placement, while the disk (as low-level worker) makes the final fine-grained placement decision to improve write performance. We show the benefits of range writes through numerous simulations and a prototype implementation, in some cases improving performance by a factor of three across both synthetic and real workloads.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们引入了range writes，这是对磁盘接口的一个简单但强大的改变，消除了文件系统对块放置进行微观管理的需要。通过允许文件系统指定一组可能的地址目标，range writes使磁盘能够选择请求的最终盘上位置；磁盘通过写入最近的位置来提高性能，并随后将其选择报告给上方的文件系统。结果是责任清晰分离；文件系统（作为高层管理器）提供粗粒度的放置控制，而磁盘（作为低层执行者）做出最终的细粒度放置决策以提高写入性能。我们通过大量模拟和原型实现展示了range writes的好处，在合成和真实工作负载中，某些情况下性能提升达三倍。

upstream_only.title: Binary translation using peephole superoptimizers
upstream_only.abstract: We present a new scheme for performing binary translation that produces code comparable to or better than existing binary translators with much less engineering effort. Instead of hand-coding the translation from one instruction set to another, our approach automatically learns translation rules using superoptimization techniques. We have implemented a PowerPC-x86 binary translator and report results on small and large computeintensive benchmarks. When compared to the native compiler, our translated code achieves median performance of 67\% on large benchmarks and in some small stress tests actually outperforms the native compiler. We also report comparisons with the open source binary translator Qemu and a commercial tool, Apple's Rosetta. We consistently outperformthe former and are comparable to or faster than the latter on all but one benchmark.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新的二进制翻译方案，其生成的代码可与现有二进制翻译器相媲美或更优，而工程工作量却大大减少。我们的方法不是手工编写从一种指令集到另一种指令集的翻译规则，而是使用超级优化技术自动学习翻译规则。我们实现了一个PowerPC到x86的二进制翻译器，并在小型和大型计算密集型基准测试上报告了结果。与原生编译器相比，我们翻译后的代码在大型基准测试上的中位性能达到67%，在某些小型压力测试中甚至超过了原生编译器。我们还与开源二进制翻译器Qemu以及商业工具Apple的Rosetta进行了比较。我们在所有基准测试中均持续优于前者，并且除了一个基准测试外，在所有基准测试中与后者相当或更快。

upstream_only.title: R2: an application-level kernel for record and replay
upstream_only.abstract: Library-based record and replay tools aim to reproduce an application's execution by recording the results of selected functions in a log and during replay returning the results from the log rather than executing the functions. These tools must ensure that a replay run is identical to the record run. The challenge in doing so is that only invocations of a function by the application should be recorded, recording the side effects of a function call can be difficult, and not executing function calls during replay, multithreading, and the presence of the tool may change the application's behavior from recording to replay. These problems have limited the use of such tools.R2 allows developers to choose functions that can be recorded and replayed correctly. Developers annotate the chosen functions with simple keywords so that R2 can handle calls with side effects andmultithreading. R2 generates code for record and replay from templates, allowing developers to avoid implementing stubs for hundreds of functions manually. To track whether an invocation is on behalf of the application or the implementation of a selected function, R2 maintains a mode bit, which stubs save and restore.We have implemented R2 on Windows and annotated large parts (1,300 functions) of the Win32 API, and two higher-level interfaces (MPI and SQLite). R2 can replay multithreaded web and database servers that previous library-based tools cannot replay. By allowing developers to choose high-level interfaces, R2 can also keep recording overhead small; experiments show that its recording overhead for Apache is approximately 10\%, that recording and replaying at the SQLite interface can reduce the log size up to 99\% (compared to doing so at the Win32 API), and that using optimization annotations for BitTorrent and MPI applications achieves log size reduction ranging from 13.7\% to 99.4\%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 基于库的记录和重放工具旨在通过记录选定函数调用的结果并在重放时从日志中返回这些结果（而非执行这些函数）来重现应用程序的执行过程。这些工具必须确保重放运行与记录运行完全相同。其中的挑战在于：只应记录应用程序对函数的调用；记录函数调用的副作用可能很困难；不执行函数调用、多线程以及工具本身的存在都可能改变应用程序在重放阶段的执行行为。这些问题限制了此类工具的使用。R2允许开发者选择那些可以被正确记录和重放的函数。开发者用简单的关键字标注所选函数，从而让R2能够处理带副作用的调用和多线程。R2根据模板生成记录和重放代码，使开发者无需手动为数百个函数实现存根（stub）。为了跟踪一次调用是代表应用程序还是代表某个选定函数的实现，R2维护了一个模式位（mode bit），存根会保存和恢复该模式位。我们在Windows上实现了R2，并标注了Win32 API的很大一部分（1300个函数），以及两个更高级别的接口（MPI和SQLite）。R2可以重放多线程Web服务器和数据库服务器，这是此前基于库的工具无法做到的。通过允许开发者选择更高级别的接口，R2还能保持较低的开销；实验表明，其对Apache的录制开销约为10%；在SQLite接口层面上进行记录和重放可将日志大小缩减高达99%（与在Win32 API层面操作相比）；对BitTorrent和MPI应用使用优化标注可将日志大小缩减13.7%至99.4%。

upstream_only.title: KLEE: unassisted and automatic generation of high-coverage tests for complex systems programs
upstream_only.abstract: We present a new symbolic execution tool, KLEE, capable of automatically generating tests that achieve high coverage on a diverse set of complex and environmentally-intensive programs. We used KLEE to thoroughly check all 89 stand-alone programs in the GNU COREUTILS utility suite, which form the core user-level environment installed on millions of Unix systems, and arguably are the single most heavily tested set of open-source programs in existence. KLEE-generated tests achieve high line coverage -- on average over 90\% per tool (median: over 94\%) -- and significantly beat the coverage of the developers' own hand-written test suite. When we did the same for 75 equivalent tools in the BUSYBOX embedded system suite, results were even better, including 100\% coverage on 31 of them.We also used KLEE as a bug finding tool, applying it to 452 applications (over 430K total lines of code), where it found 56 serious bugs, including three in COREUTILS that had been missed for over 15 years. Finally, we used KLEE to crosscheck purportedly identical BUSYBOX and COREUTILS utilities, finding functional correctness errors and a myriad of inconsistencies.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新的符号执行工具KLEE，能够为多种复杂且环境密集型的程序自动生成实现高覆盖率的测试。我们使用KLEE全面检查了GNU COREUTILS工具集中的全部89个独立程序，这些程序构成了数百万Unix系统上安装的核心用户级环境，并且可以说是现存被测试最密集的开源程序集合。KLEE生成的测试达到了高行覆盖率——每个工具平均超过90%（中位数超过94%）——并显著超过了开发者自己手写测试套件的覆盖率。当我们对BUSYBOX嵌入式系统套件中的75个等价工具进行相同操作时，结果甚至更好，其中31个工具实现了100%覆盖率。我们还将KLEE作为bug查找工具应用于452个应用程序（总代码超过43万行），发现了56个严重bug，其中包括COREUTILS中15年来未被发现的三个bug。最后，我们使用KLEE来交叉检查声称相同的BUSYBOX和COREUTILS工具，发现了功能正确性错误以及大量不一致之处。

upstream_only.title: Hardware enforcement of application security policies using tagged memory
upstream_only.abstract: Computers are notoriously insecure, in part because application security policies do not map well onto traditional protection mechanisms such as Unix user accounts or hardware page tables. Recent work has shown that application policies can be expressed in terms of information flow restrictions and enforced in an OS kernel, providing a strong assurance of security. This paper shows that enforcement of these policies can be pushed largely into the processor itself, by using tagged memory support, which can provide stronger security guarantees by enforcing application security even if the OS kernel is compromised.We present the Loki tagged memory architecture, along with a novel operating system structure that takes advantage of tagged memory to enforce application security policies in hardware. We built a full-system prototype of Loki by modifying a synthesizable SPARC core, mapping it to an FPGA board, and porting HiStar, a Unix-like operating system, to run on it. One result is that Loki allows HiStar, an OS already designed to have a small trusted kernel, to further reduce the amount of trusted code by a factor of two, and to enforce security despite kernel compromises. Using various workloads, we also demonstrate that HiStar running on Loki incurs a low performance overhead.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 计算机的安全性众所周知地薄弱，部分原因是应用程序的安全策略难以映射到传统保护机制（如Unix用户账户或硬件页表）上。近期研究表明，应用程序策略可以用信息流限制来表达，并在操作系统内核中实施，从而提供强有力的安全保障。本文表明，这些策略的执行可以大幅下推到处理器本身，通过使用标签内存支持，即使在操作系统内核被攻破的情况下，也能通过执行应用程序安全性来提供更强的安全保证。我们提出了Loki标签内存架构，以及一种利用标签内存在硬件中执行应用程序安全策略的新型操作系统结构。我们通过修改可综合的SPARC内核、将其映射到FPGA板，并移植类Unix操作系统HiStar在其上运行，构建了Loki的全系统原型。一个结果是，Loki允许HiStar——一个本已设计为具有小型可信内核的操作系统——进一步将可信代码量减少一半，并即使在内核被攻破的情况下也能执行安全性。通过多种工作负载，我们还证明了运行在Loki上的HiStar仅产生较低的性能开销。

upstream_only.title: Device driver safety through a reference validation mechanism
upstream_only.abstract: Device drivers typically execute in supervisor mode and thus must be fully trusted. This paper describes how to move them out of the trusted computing base, by running them without supervisor privileges and constraining their interactions with hardware devices. An implementation of this approach in the Nexus operating system executes drivers in user space, leveraging hardware isolation and checking their behavior against a safety specification. These Nexus drivers have performance comparable to inkernel, trusted drivers, with a level of CPU overhead acceptable for most applications. For example, the monitored driver for an Intel e1000 Ethernet card has throughput comparable to a trusted driver for the same hardware under Linux. And a monitored driver for the Intel i810 sound card provides continuous playback. Drivers for a disk and a USB mouse have also been moved successfully to operate in user space with safety specifications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 设备驱动程序通常在超级用户模式下执行，因此必须被完全信任。本文描述如何通过在没有超级用户权限的情况下运行它们，并限制其与硬件设备的交互，将它们移出可信计算基。Nexus操作系统中的一种实现方法在用户空间中执行驱动程序，利用硬件隔离并对照安全规范检查其行为。这些Nexus驱动程序的性能与内核内的可信驱动程序相当，其CPU开销水平对大多数应用而言可以接受。例如，经过监控的Intel e1000以太网卡驱动程序的吞吐量与Linux下同一硬件的可信驱动程序相当。而经过监控的Intel i810声卡驱动程序可提供连续播放。磁盘和USB鼠标的驱动程序也已成功地在带有安全规范的用户空间中运行。

upstream_only.title: Digging for data structures
upstream_only.abstract: Because writing computer programs is hard, computer programmers are taught to use encapsulation and modularity to hide complexity and reduce the potential for errors. Their programs will have a high-level, hierarchical structure that reflects their choice of internal abstractions. We designed and forged a system, Laika, that detects this structure in memory using Bayesian unsupervised learning. Because almost all programs use data structures, their memory images consist of many copies of a relatively small number of templates. Given a memory image, Laika can find both the data structures and their instantiations.We then used Laika to detect three common polymorphic botnets by comparing their data structures. Because it avoids their code polymorphism entirely, Laika is extremely accurate. Finally, we argue that writing a data structure polymorphic virus is likely to be considerably harder than writing a code polymorphic virus.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 因为编写计算机程序很难，计算机程序员被教导使用封装和模块化来隐藏复杂性并减少出错的可能性。他们的程序将具有反映其内部抽象选择的高层次、分层结构。我们设计并构建了一个名为Laika的系统，利用贝叶斯无监督学习在内存中检测这种结构。由于几乎所有程序都使用数据结构，它们的内存映像由相对较少模板的许多副本组成。给定一个内存映像，Laika可以同时找到数据结构及其实例。然后我们使用Laika通过比较其数据结构来检测三种常见的多态僵尸网络。由于它完全避开了代码多态性，Laika非常准确。最后，我们认为编写数据结构多态病毒可能比编写代码多态病毒要困难得多。

upstream_only.title: Finding and reproducing Heisenbugs in concurrent programs
upstream_only.abstract: Concurrency is pervasive in large systems. Unexpected interference among threads often results in "Heisenbugs" that are extremely difficult to reproduce and eliminate. We have implemented a tool called CHESS for finding and reproducing such bugs. When attached to a program, CHESS takes control of thread scheduling and uses efficient search techniques to drive the program through possible thread interleavings. This systematic exploration of program behavior enables CHESS to quickly uncover bugs that might otherwise have remained hidden for a long time. For each bug, CHESS consistently reproduces an erroneous execution manifesting the bug, thereby making it significantly easier to debug the problem. CHESS scales to large concurrent programs and has found numerous bugs in existing systems that had been tested extensively prior to being tested by CHESS. CHESS has been integrated into the test frameworks of many code bases inside Microsoft and is used by testers on a daily basis.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 并发性在大型系统中普遍存在。线程之间意外的干扰常常导致“Heisenbug”（瞬态bug），这些bug极难复现和消除。我们实现了一个名为CHESS的工具，用于发现并复现此类bug。当CHESS附加到程序上时，它会控制线程调度，并使用高效的搜索技术驱动程序遍历可能的线程交错。这种对程序行为的系统化探索使CHESS能够快速发现那些可能在很长一段时间内隐藏的bug。对于每个bug，CHESS能够一致地复现出展示该bug的错误执行过程，从而显著简化了调试问题的工作。CHESS可扩展到大型并发程序，并已在现有系统中发现了大量在CHESS测试之前已被广泛测试的bug。CHESS已集成到Microsoft内部许多代码库的测试框架中，并被测试人员日常使用。

upstream_only.title: Gadara: dynamic deadlock avoidance for multithreaded programs
upstream_only.abstract: Deadlock is an increasingly pressing concern as the multicore revolution forces parallel programming upon the average programmer. Existing approaches to deadlock impose onerous burdens on developers, entail high runtime performance overheads, or offer no help for unmodified legacy code. Gadara automates dynamic deadlock avoidance for conventional multithreaded programs. It employs whole-program static analysis to model programs, and Discrete Control Theory to synthesize lightweight, decentralized, highly concurrent logic that controls them at runtime. Gadara is safe, and can be applied to legacy code with modest programmer effort. Gadara is efficient because it performs expensive deadlock-avoidance computations offline rather than online. We have implemented Gadara for C/Pthreads programs. In benchmark tests, Gadara successfully avoids injected deadlock faults, imposes negligible to modest performance overheads (at most 18\%), and outperforms a software transactional memory system. Tests on a real application show that Gadara identifies and avoids both previously known and unknown deadlocks while adding performance overheads ranging from negligible to 10\%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 随着多核革命迫使普通程序员进行并行编程，死锁问题日益紧迫。现有的死锁处理方法要么给开发者带来沉重负担，要么带来高运行时性能开销，要么对未修改的遗留代码没有帮助。Gadara自动化了传统多线程程序的动态死锁避免。它使用全程序静态分析来建模程序，并利用离散控制理论合成轻量级、去中心化、高度并发的逻辑，在运行时控制程序。Gadara是安全的，并且可以以适度的程序员工作量应用于遗留代码。Gadara高效，因为它将昂贵的死锁避免计算离线执行而非在线执行。我们已针对C/Pthreads程序实现了Gadara。在基准测试中，Gadara成功避免了注入的死锁故障，带来了可忽略不计到适度的性能开销（最多18%），且优于软件事务内存系统。在一个真实应用程序上的测试表明，Gadara能够识别并避免先前已知和未知的死锁，同时增加从可忽略到10%的性能开销。

upstream_only.title: Deadlock immunity: enabling systems to defend against deadlocks
upstream_only.abstract: Deadlock immunity is a property by which programs, once afflicted by a given deadlock, develop resistance against future occurrences of that and similar deadlocks. We describe a technique that enables programs to automatically gain such immunity without assistance from programmers or users. We implemented the technique for both Java and POSIX threads and evaluated it with several real systems, including MySQL, JBoss, SQLite, Apache ActiveMQ, Limewire, and Java JDK. The results demonstrate effectiveness against real deadlock bugs, while incurring modest performance overhead and scaling to 1024 threads. We therefore conclude that deadlock immunity offers programmers and users an attractive tool for coping with elusive deadlocks.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 死锁免疫是一种属性，通过该属性，程序一旦遭受特定死锁，就会对将来出现的该死锁及类似死锁产生抵抗能力。我们描述了一种技术，使程序无需程序员或用户协助即可自动获得这种免疫能力。我们在Java和POSIX线程中实现了该技术，并针对多个真实系统进行了评估，包括MySQL、JBoss、SQLite、Apache ActiveMQ、Limewire和Java JDK。结果表明，该方法对真实死锁缺陷有效，同时仅产生适度的性能开销，并可扩展到1024个线程。因此，我们得出结论：死锁免疫为程序员和用户提供了一种有吸引力的工具，用以应对难以捉摸的死锁问题。

upstream_only.title: Difference engine: harnessing memory redundancy in virtual machines
upstream_only.abstract: Virtual machine monitors (VMMs) are a popular platform for Internet hosting centers and cloud-based compute services. By multiplexing hardware resources among virtual machines (VMs) running commodity operating systems, VMMs decrease both the capital outlay and management overhead of hosting centers. Appropriate placement and migration policies can take advantage of statistical multiplexing to effectively utilize available processors. However, main memory is not amenable to such multiplexing and is often the primary bottleneck in achieving higher degrees of consolidation.Previous efforts have shown that content-based page sharing provides modest decreases in the memory footprint of VMs running similar operating systems and applications. Our studies show that significant additional gains can be had by leveraging both sub-page level sharing (through page patching) and in-core memory compression. We build Difference Engine, an extension to the Xen virtual machine monitor, to support each of these--in addition to standard copy-on-write full page sharing--and demonstrate substantial savings not only between VMs running similar applications and operating systems (up to 90\%), but even across VMs running disparate workloads (up to 65\%). In head-to-head memory-savings comparisons, Difference Engine outperforms VMware ESX server by a factor of 1.5 for homogeneous workloads and by a factor of 1.6-2.5 for heterogeneous workloads. In all cases, the performance overhead of Difference Engine is less than 7\%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 虚拟机监视器（VMM）是互联网托管中心和基于云的计算服务的流行平台。通过在多台运行商用操作系统的虚拟机（VM）之间复用硬件资源，VMM降低了托管中心的资本支出和管理开销。适当的放置和迁移策略可以利用统计复用有效利用可用处理器。然而，主内存不适合这种复用，并且通常成为实现更高整合度的主要瓶颈。先前的研究表明，基于内容的页面共享可以将运行相似操作系统和应用程序的虚拟机的内存占用适度减少。我们的研究表明，通过利用子页面级共享（通过页面修补）和内存内压缩，可以获得显著的额外收益。我们构建了差分引擎（Difference Engine），这是Xen虚拟机监视器的一个扩展，用于支持这些功能——除了标准的写时复制全页共享之外——并证明不仅在运行相似应用程序和操作系统的虚拟机之间（最高达90%），甚至在运行不同工作负载的虚拟机之间（最高达65%）也能实现可观的节省。在面对面的内存节省比较中，差分引擎在同构工作负载下比VMware ESX服务器高1.5倍，在异构工作负载下高1.6至2.5倍。在所有情况下，差分引擎的性能开销低于7%。

upstream_only.title: Quanto: tracking energy in networked embedded systems
upstream_only.abstract: We present Quanto, a network-wide time and energy profiler for embedded network devices. By combining well-defined interfaces for hardware power states, fast high-resolution energy metering, and causal tracking of programmer-defined activities, Quanto can map how energy and time are spent on nodes and across a network. Implementing Quanto on the TinyOS operating system required modifying under 350 lines of code and adding 1275 new lines. We show that being able to take fine-grained energy consumption measurements as fast as reading a counter allows developers to precisely quantify the effects of low-level system implementation decisions, such as using DMA versus direct bus operations, or the effect of external interference on the power draw of a low duty-cycle radio. Finally, Quanto is lightweight enough that it has a minimal effect on system behavior: each sample takes 100 CPU cycles and 12 bytes of RAM.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了Quanto，一种用于嵌入式网络设备的全网时间和能量分析器。通过结合定义良好的硬件电源状态接口、快速高分辨率能量计量以及程序员定义活动的因果跟踪，Quanto可以映射能量和时间如何在节点上以及网络中消耗。在TinyOS操作系统上实现Quanto只需修改不到350行代码，并新增1275行代码。我们表明，能够像读取计数器一样快速地进行细粒度能耗测量，使开发者能够精确量化底层系统实现决策（例如使用DMA与直接总线操作）的影响，或外部干扰对低占空比无线电功耗的影响。最后，Quanto足够轻量，对系统行为的影响极小：每次采样仅需100个CPU周期和12字节RAM。

upstream_only.title: Leveraging legacy code to deploy desktop applications on the web
upstream_only.abstract: Xax is a browser plugin model that enables developers to leverage existing tools, libraries, and entire programs to deliver feature-rich applications on the web. Xax employs a novel combination of mechanisms that collectively provide security, OS-independence, performance, and support for legacy code. These mechanisms include memory-isolated native code execution behind a narrow syscall interface, an abstraction layer that provides a consistent binary interface across operating systems, system services via hooks to existing browser mechanisms, and lightweight modifications to existing tool chains and code bases. We demonstrate a variety of applications and libraries from existing code bases, in several languages, produced with various tool chains, running in multiple browsers on multiple operating systems. With roughly two person-weeks of effort, we ported 3.3 million lines of code to Xax, including a PDF viewer, a Python interpreter, a speech synthesizer, and an OpenGL pipeline.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Xax是一种浏览器插件模型，使开发者能够利用现有工具、库和完整程序在Web上提供功能丰富的应用。Xax采用了一种新颖的机制组合，这些机制共同提供了安全性、操作系统无关性、性能以及遗留代码支持。这些机制包括在窄系统调用接口之后执行内存隔离的原生代码，一个提供跨操作系统一致二进制接口的抽象层，通过挂钩现有浏览器机制实现的系统服务，以及对现有工具链和代码库的轻量级修改。我们演示了来自现有代码库的各种应用和库，涵盖多种语言，由多种工具链生成，运行在多种操作系统上的多个浏览器中。我们用大约两周人力的工作量，将330万行代码移植到Xax，其中包括PDF查看器、Python解释器、语音合成器和OpenGL管线。

upstream_only.title: FlightPath: obedience vs. choice in cooperative services
upstream_only.abstract: We present FlightPath, a novel peer-to-peer streaming application that provides a highly reliable data stream to a dynamic set of peers. We demonstrate that FlightPath reduces jitter compared to previous works by several orders of magnitude. Furthermore, FlightPath uses a number of run-time adaptations to maintain low jitter despite 10\% of the population behaving maliciously and the remaining peers acting selfishly. At the core of FlightPath's success are approximate equilibria. These equilibria allow us to design incentives to limit selfish behavior rigorously, yet they provide sufficient flexibility to build practical systems. We show how to use an undefined-Nash equilibrium, instead of a strict Nash, to engineer a live streaming system that uses bandwidth efficiently, absorbs flash crowds, adapts to sudden peer departures, handles churn, and tolerates malicious activity.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出FlightPath，一种新颖的点对点流媒体应用，能够为动态节点集合提供高度可靠的数据流。我们证明，与先前工作相比，FlightPath将抖动降低了数个数量级。此外，FlightPath利用多种运行时自适应机制，在总人口中10%行为恶意、其余节点行为自私的情况下，仍能保持低抖动。FlightPath成功的核心在于近似均衡。这些均衡使我们能够严格地设计激励措施以限制自私行为，同时又提供足够的灵活性来构建实用系统。我们展示了如何利用未定义的纳什均衡（而非严格纳什均衡）来工程设计一个实时流媒体系统，该系统能高效利用带宽、吸收热门突发流量、适应节点突然离开、应对持续扰动，并容忍恶意活动。

upstream_only.title: Mencius: building efficient replicated state machines for WANs
upstream_only.abstract: We present a protocol for general state machine replication - a method that provides strong consistency - that has high performance in a wide-area network. In particular, our protocol Mencius has high throughput under high client load and low latency under low client load even under changing wide-area network environment and client load. We develop our protocol as a derivation from the well-known protocol Paxos. Such a development can be changed or further refined to take advantage of specific network or application requirements.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种用于通用状态机复制的协议——一种提供强一致性的方法——该协议在广域网中具有高性能。特别是，我们的协议Mencius在高客户端负载下具有高吞吐量，在低客户端负载下具有低延迟，即使在变化的广域网环境和客户端负载下也是如此。我们将我们的协议作为著名协议Paxos的推导而开发。这种开发可以根据具体的网络或应用需求进行修改或进一步细化。

upstream_only.title: An analysis of Linux scalability to many cores
upstream_only.abstract: This paper analyzes the scalability of seven system applications (Exim, memcached, Apache, PostgreSQL, gmake, Psearchy, and MapReduce) running on Linux on a 48- core computer. Except for gmake, all applications trigger scalability bottlenecks inside a recent Linux kernel. Using mostly standard parallel programming techniques-- this paper introduces one new technique, sloppy counters-- these bottlenecks can be removed from the kernel or avoided by changing the applications slightly. Modifying the kernel required in total 3002 lines of code changes. A speculative conclusion from this analysis is that there is no scalability reason to give up on traditional operating system organizations just yet.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文分析了在48核计算机上运行的七个系统应用程序（Exim、memcached、Apache、PostgreSQL、gmake、Psearchy和MapReduce）在Linux上的可扩展性。除gmake外，所有应用程序都触发了最近的Linux内核中的可扩展性瓶颈。主要使用标准的并行编程技术（本文介绍了一种新技术——粗略计数器），这些瓶颈可以从内核中移除，或通过稍微修改应用程序来避免。修改内核总共需要3002行代码更改。从这一分析中可以得出一个推测性结论：目前还没有可扩展性理由要放弃传统的操作系统组织方式。

upstream_only.title: Trust and protection in the Illinois browser operating system
upstream_only.abstract: Current web browsers are complex, have enormous trusted computing bases, and provide attackers with easy access to modern computer systems. In this paper we introduce the Illinois Browser Operating System (IBOS), a new operating system and a new browser that reduces the trusted computing base for web browsers. In our architecture we expose browser-level abstractions at the lowest software layer, enabling us to remove almost all traditional OS components and services from our trusted computing base by mapping browser abstractions to hardware abstractions directly. We show that this architecture is flexible enough to enable new browser security policies, can still support traditional applications, and adds little overhead to the overall browsing experience.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 当前的Web浏览器复杂、可信计算基庞大，并为攻击者提供了轻松访问现代计算机系统的途径。在本文中，我们介绍了伊利诺伊浏览器操作系统（IBOS），这是一个新操作系统和一个新浏览器，旨在减少Web浏览器的可信计算基。在我们的架构中，我们在最低软件层暴露浏览器级抽象，通过将浏览器抽象直接映射到硬件抽象，从而几乎将传统操作系统组件和服务从可信计算基中移除。我们展示了这种架构足够灵活，能够支持新的浏览器安全策略，仍然可以支持传统应用程序，并且对整体浏览体验几乎不添加额外开销。

upstream_only.title: FlexSC: flexible system call scheduling with exception-less system calls
upstream_only.abstract: For the past 30+ years, system calls have been the de facto interface used by applications to request services from the operating system kernel. System calls have almost universally been implemented as a synchronous mechanism, where a special processor instruction is used to yield userspace execution to the kernel. In the first part of this paper, we evaluate the performance impact of traditional synchronous system calls on system intensive workloads. We show that synchronous system calls negatively affect performance in a significant way, primarily because of pipeline flushing and pollution of key processor structures (e.g., TLB, data and instruction caches, etc.).We propose a new mechanism for applications to request services from the operating system kernel: exception-less system calls. They improve processor efficiency by enabling flexibility in the scheduling of operating system work, which in turn can lead to significantly increased temporal and spacial locality of execution in both user and kernel space, thus reducing pollution effects on processor structures. Exception-less system calls are particularly effective on multicore processors. They primarily target highly threaded server applications, such as Web servers and database servers.We present FlexSC, an implementation of exceptionless system calls in the Linux kernel, and an accompanying user-mode thread package (FlexSC-Threads), binary compatible with POSIX threads, that translates legacy synchronous system calls into exception-less ones transparently to applications. We show how FlexSC improves performance of Apache by up to 116\%, MySQL by up to 40\%, and BIND by up to 105\% while requiring no modifications to the applications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 过去30多年，系统调用一直是应用程序请求操作系统内核服务的实际接口。系统调用几乎普遍实现为同步机制，其中使用特殊处理器指令将用户态执行切换到内核态。在本文前半部分，我们评估传统同步系统调用对系统密集型工作负载的性能影响。我们表明同步系统调用显著负面影响性能，主要是由于流水线清空以及对关键处理器结构（如TLB、数据和指令缓存等）的污染。我们提出一种新的机制，让应用程序请求操作系统内核服务：无异常系统调用。它通过灵活调度操作系统工作来提高处理器效率，这可以显著增加用户态和内核态执行的时间和空间局部性，从而减少对处理器结构的污染效应。无异常系统调用在多核处理器上尤其有效。它们主要针对高线程服务器应用，如Web服务器和数据库服务器。我们展示了FlexSC——Linux内核中无异常系统调用的实现，以及配套的用户态线程包（FlexSC-Threads），与POSIX线程二进制兼容，能透明地将传统同步系统调用转换为无异常系统调用。我们展示FlexSC如何将Apache性能提升高达116%，MySQL提升高达40%，BIND提升高达105%，而无需修改应用程序。

upstream_only.title: Finding a needle in Haystack: facebook's photo storage
upstream_only.abstract: This paper describes Haystack, an object storage system optimized for Facebook's Photos application. Facebook currently stores over 260 billion images, which translates to over 20 petabytes of data. Users upload one billion new photos (∼60 terabytes) each week and Facebook serves over one million images per second at peak. Haystack provides a less expensive and higher performing solution than our previous approach, which leveraged network attached storage appliances over NFS. Our key observation is that this traditional design incurs an excessive number of disk operations because of metadata lookups. We carefully reduce this per photo metadata so that Haystack storage machines can perform all metadata lookups in main memory. This choice conserves disk operations for reading actual data and thus increases overall throughput.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文介绍Haystack，一个为Facebook照片应用优化的对象存储系统。Facebook目前存储超过2600亿张图片，相当于超过20拍字节的数据。用户每周上传10亿张新照片（约60太字节），Facebook在高峰期每秒服务超过100万张图片。Haystack比我们之前基于NFS的网络附加存储设备方案提供了成本更低、性能更高的解决方案。我们的关键观察是，传统设计因元数据查找而产生过多的磁盘操作。我们精心减少了每张照片的元数据，使得Haystack存储机器能在主内存中完成所有元数据查找。这一选择将磁盘操作保留用于读取实际数据，从而提高了整体吞吐量。

upstream_only.title: Availability in globally distributed storage systems
upstream_only.abstract: Highly available cloud storage is often implemented with complex, multi-tiered distributed systems built on top of clusters of commodity servers and disk drives. Sophisticated management, load balancing and recovery techniques are needed to achieve high performance and availability amidst an abundance of failure sources that include software, hardware, network connectivity, and power issues. While there is a relative wealth of failure studies of individual components of storage systems, such as disk drives, relatively little has been reported so far on the overall availability behavior of large cloudbased storage services.We characterize the availability properties of cloud storage systems based on an extensive one year study of Google's main storage infrastructure and present statistical models that enable further insight into the impact of multiple design choices, such as data placement and replication strategies. With these models we compare data availability under a variety of system parameters given the real patterns of failures observed in our fleet.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 高可用的云存储通常建立在由商品服务器和磁盘驱动器集群构成的复杂多层分布式系统之上。为了在包含软件、硬件、网络连接和电源问题等众多故障源的情况下实现高性能和高可用性，需要复杂的管理、负载均衡和恢复技术。尽管对存储系统单个组件（如磁盘驱动器）的故障研究相对丰富，但迄今为止，关于大型基于云的存储服务的整体可用性行为的报道相对较少。我们基于对Google主要存储基础设施为期一年的广泛研究，描述了云存储系统的可用性特征，并提出了统计模型，以进一步洞察多种设计选择（如数据放置和复制策略）的影响。利用这些模型，我们根据实际观察到的故障模式，在不同系统参数下比较了数据可用性。

upstream_only.title: Nectar: automatic management of data and computation in datacenters
upstream_only.abstract: Managing data and computation is at the heart of datacenter computing. Manual management of data can lead to data loss, wasteful consumption of storage, and laborious bookkeeping. Lack of proper management of computation can result in lost opportunities to share common computations across multiple jobs or to compute results incrementally.Nectar is a system designed to address the aforementioned problems. It automates and unifies the management of data and computation within a datacenter. In Nectar, data and computation are treated interchangeably by associating data with its computation. Derived datasets, which are the results of computations, are uniquely identified by the programs that produce them, and together with their programs, are automatically managed by a datacenter wide caching service. Any derived dataset can be transparently regenerated by reexecuting its program, and any computation can be transparently avoided by using previously cached results. This enables us to greatly improve datacenter management and resource utilization: obsolete or infrequently used derived datasets are automatically garbage collected, and shared common computations are computed only once and reused by others.This paper describes the design and implementation of Nectar, and reports on our evaluation of the system using analytic studies of logs from several production clusters and an actual deployment on a 240-node cluster.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 管理数据和计算是数据中心计算的核心。手动管理数据可能导致数据丢失、存储浪费以及繁重的记录工作。缺乏对计算的适当管理可能导致错失跨多个作业共享公共计算或增量计算结果的机会。Nectar是一个旨在解决上述问题的系统。它自动化并统一了数据中心内数据和计算的管理。在Nectar中，数据和计算通过将数据与其计算关联而可互换地对待。派生数据集（即计算的结果）由生成它们的程序唯一标识，并与其程序一起由数据中心范围的缓存服务自动管理。任何派生数据集都可以通过重新执行其程序而透明地重新生成，任何计算都可以通过使用先前缓存的结果而透明地避免。这使我们能够极大地改善数据中心管理和资源利用：过时或不常用的派生数据集会被自动垃圾收集，共享的公共计算只计算一次并由其他人重用。本文描述了Nectar的设计与实现，并通过对几个生产集群日志的分析研究以及在一个240节点集群上的实际部署来报告我们对系统的评估。

upstream_only.title: Intrusion recovery using selective re-execution
upstream_only.abstract: RETRO repairs a desktop or server after an adversary compromises it, by undoing the adversary's changes while preserving legitimate user actions, with minimal user involvement. During normal operation, RETRO records an action history graph, which is a detailed dependency graph describing the system's execution. RETRO uses refinement to describe graph objects and actions at multiple levels of abstraction, which allows for precise dependencies. During repair, RETRO uses the action history graph to undo an unwanted action and its indirect effects by first rolling back its direct effects, and then reexecuting legitimate actions that were influenced by that change. To minimize user involvement and re-execution, RETRO uses predicates to selectively re-execute only actions that were semantically affected by the adversary's changes, and uses compensating actions to handle external effects.An evaluation of a prototype of RETRO for Linux with 2 real-world attacks, 2 synthesized challenge attacks, and 6 attacks from previous work, shows that RETRO can often repair the system without user involvement, and avoids false positives and negatives from previous solutions. These benefits come at the cost of 35-127\% in execution time overhead and of 4-150 GB of log space per day, depending on the workload. For example, a HotCRP paper submission web site incurs 35\% slowdown and generates 4 GB of logs per day under the workload from 30 minutes prior to the SOSP 2007 deadline.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: RETRO在对手入侵桌面或服务器后进行修复，方法是撤销对手的更改，同时保留合法用户操作，并且只需极少用户参与。在正常操作期间，RETRO会记录一个动作历史图，该图是描述系统执行的详细依赖图。RETRO使用细化（refinement）在多个抽象层次上描述图对象和动作，从而能够获得精确的依赖关系。在修复过程中，RETRO利用动作历史图撤销不需要的动作及其间接影响：首先回滚其直接影响，然后重新执行受该更改影响的合法动作。为了最大限度地减少用户参与和重执行，RETRO使用谓词仅选择性地重执行那些语义上受对手更改影响的动作，并使用补偿动作来处理外部影响。对Linux上RETRO原型的评估使用了2个真实世界攻击、2个合成挑战攻击以及6个来自以往工作的攻击，结果表明RETRO通常可以在无需用户参与的情况下修复系统，并避免了以前解决方案的误报和漏报。这些好处以35-127%的执行时间开销和每天4-150 GB的日志空间为代价，具体取决于工作负载。例如，HotCRP论文提交网站在SOSP 2007截止日期前30分钟的工作负载下，会产生35%的减速，并每天生成4 GB日志。

upstream_only.title: Static checking of dynamically-varying security policies in database-backed applications
upstream_only.abstract: We present a system for sound static checking of security policies for database-backed Web applications. Our tool checks a combination of access control and information flow policies, where the policies vary based on database contents. For instance, one or more database tables may represent an access control matrix, controlling who may read or write which cells of these and other tables. Using symbolic evaluation and automated theorem-proving, our tool checks these policies statically, requiring no program annotations (beyond the policies themselves) and adding no run-time overhead. Specifications come in the form of SQL queries as policies: for instance, an application's confidentiality policy is a fixed set of queries, whose results provide an upper bound on what information may be released to the user. To provide userdependent policies, we allow queries to depend on what secrets the user knows. We have used our prototype implementation to check several programs representative of the data-centric Web applications that are common today.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 用户生成内容网站通常会在Tor等隐私增强代理的用户贡献上设限，因为代理被视为破坏、垃圾邮件和滥用的来源。尽管这些屏蔽或许有效，但未实现的有价值的匿名寻求者贡献所造成的附带损害是看不见的。维基百科作为最大且最重要的用户生成内容网站之一，早在2005年就尝试屏蔽来自Tor用户的贡献。我们证明，这些屏蔽并不完美，且上千次通过Tor编辑维基百科的尝试已经成功。我们利用多种数据来源和分析技术，测量并描述了Tor用户在维基百科上的编辑历史随时间的变化，并将Tor用户的贡献与其他维基百科用户群体的贡献进行了比较。我们的分析表明，虽然绕过维基百科禁令的Tor用户所贡献的内容更可能被回退，也更可能回退他人，但他们的贡献质量在其他方面与未注册参与者以及注册用户的初始贡献相似。

upstream_only.title: Accountable virtual machines
upstream_only.abstract: In this paper, we introduce accountable virtual machines (AVMs). Like ordinary virtual machines, AVMs can execute binary software images in a virtualized copy of a computer system; in addition, they can record non-repudiable information that allows auditors to subsequently check whether the software behaved as intended. AVMs provide strong accountability, which is important, for instance, in distributed systems where different hosts and organizations do not necessarily trust each other, or where software is hosted on third-party operated platforms. AVMs can provide accountability for unmodified binary images and do not require trusted hardware. To demonstrate that AVMs are practical, we have designed and implemented a prototype AVM monitor based on VMware Workstation, and used it to detect several existing cheats in Counterstrike, a popular online multi-player game.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们引入了可审计虚拟机（AVM）。与普通虚拟机一样，AVM可以在计算机系统的虚拟化副本中执行二进制软件映像；此外，它们还能记录不可否认的信息，使审计人员事后能够检查软件是否按预期运行。AVM提供强大的可审计性，这在分布式系统（不同主机和组织不一定相互信任）或软件托管在第三方运营平台上时尤为重要。AVM能够为未修改的二进制映像提供可审计性，且不需要可信硬件。为了证明AVM的实用性，我们基于VMware Workstation设计和实现了一个AVM监控器原型，并用它检测了流行在线多人游戏Counterstrike中的若干现有作弊行为。

upstream_only.title: Bypassing races in live applications with execution filters
upstream_only.abstract: Deployed multithreaded applications contain many races because these applications are difficult to write, test, and debug. Worse, the number of races in deployed applications may drastically increase due to the rise of multicore hardware and the immaturity of current race detectors.LOOM is a "live-workaround" system designed to quickly and safely bypass application races at runtime. LOOM provides a flexible and safe language for developers to write execution filters that explicitly synchronize code. It then uses an evacuation algorithm to safely install the filters to live applications to avoid races. It reduces its performance overhead using hybrid instrumentation that combines static and dynamic instrumentation.We evaluated LOOM on nine real races from a diverse set of six applications, including MySQL and Apache. Our results show that (1) LOOM can safely fix all evaluated races in a timely manner, thereby increasing application availability; (2) LOOM incurs little performance overhead; (3) LOOM scales well with the number of application threads; and (4) LOOM is easy to use.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 已部署的多线程应用程序中包含许多竞争条件，因为这些应用程序难以编写、测试和调试。更糟糕的是，由于多核硬件的兴起和当前竞争条件检测器的不成熟，已部署应用程序中的竞争条件数量可能会急剧增加。LOOM是一个“实时修复”系统，旨在运行时快速安全地绕过应用程序竞争条件。LOOM为开发人员提供了一种灵活且安全的语言，用于编写显式同步代码的执行过滤器。然后，它使用一种疏散算法将过滤器安全地安装到实时应用程序中，以避免竞争条件。它通过结合静态和动态插桩的混合插桩来降低性能开销。我们在来自六种不同应用程序（包括MySQL和Apache）的九个真实竞争条件上评估了LOOM。我们的结果表明：(1) LOOM能够及时安全地修复所有评估的竞争条件，从而提高应用程序的可用性；(2) LOOM产生的性能开销很小；(3) LOOM随着应用程序线程数量的增加具有良好的可扩展性；以及(4) LOOM易于使用。

upstream_only.title: Effective data-race detection for the kernel
upstream_only.abstract: Data races are an important class of concurrency errors where two threads erroneously access a shared memory location without appropriate synchronization. This paper presents DataCollider, a lightweight and effective technique for dynamically detecting data races in kernel modules. Unlike existing data-race detection techniques, DataCollider is oblivious to the synchronization protocols (such as locking disciplines) the program uses to protect shared memory accesses. This is particularly important for low-level kernel code that uses a myriad of complex architecture/device specific synchronization mechanisms. To reduce the runtime overhead, DataCollider randomly samples a small percentage of memory accesses as candidates for data-race detection. The key novelty of DataCollider is that it uses breakpoint facilities already supported by many hardware architectures to achieve negligible runtime overheads. We have implemented DataCollider for the Windows 7 kernel and have found 25 confirmed erroneous data races of which 12 have already been fixed.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 数据竞争是一类重要的并发错误，其中两个线程在没有适当同步的情况下错误地访问同一共享内存位置。本文提出了DataCollider，一种轻量级且有效的技术，用于动态检测内核模块中的数据竞争。与现有的数据竞争检测技术不同，DataCollider不关心程序用于保护共享内存访问的同步协议（如锁纪律）。这对于使用大量复杂架构/设备特定同步机制的底层内核代码尤为重要。为了降低运行时开销，DataCollider随机采样一小部分内存访问作为数据竞争检测的候选对象。DataCollider的关键创新在于它利用了许多硬件架构已支持的断点设施，从而实现可忽略的运行时开销。我们已在Windows 7内核上实现了DataCollider，并发现25个已确认的错误数据竞争，其中12个已被修复。

upstream_only.title: Ad hoc synchronization considered harmful
upstream_only.abstract: Many synchronizations in existing multi-threaded programs are implemented in an ad hoc way. The first part of this paper does a comprehensive characteristic study of ad hoc synchronizations in concurrent programs. By studying 229 ad hoc synchronizations in 12 programs of various types (server, desktop and scientific), including Apache, MySQL, Mozilla, etc., we find several interesting and perhaps alarming characteristics: (1) Every studied application uses ad hoc synchronizations. Specifically, there are 6-83 ad hoc synchronizations in each program. (2) Ad hoc synchronizations are error-prone. Significant percentages (22-67\%) of these ad hoc synchronizations introduced bugs or severe performance issues. (3) Ad hoc synchronization implementations are diverse and many of them cannot be easily recognized as synchronizations, i.e. have poor readability and maintainability.The second part of our work builds a tool called SyncFinder to automatically identify and annotate ad hoc synchronizations in concurrent programswritten in C/C++ to assist programmers in porting their code to better structured implementations, while also enabling other tools to recognize them as synchronizations. Our evaluation using 25 concurrent programs shows that, on average, SyncFinder can automatically identify 96\% of ad hoc synchronizations with 6\% false positives.We also build two use cases to leverage SyncFinder's auto-annotation. The first one uses annotation to detect 5 deadlocks (including 2 new ones) and 16 potential issues missed by previous analysis tools in Apache, MySQL and Mozilla. The second use case reduces Valgrind data race checker's false positive rates by 43-86\%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现有许多多线程程序中的同步是以临时（ad hoc）方式实现的。本文第一部分对并发程序中的临时同步进行了全面的特征研究。通过研究12个不同类型（服务器、桌面和科学计算）的程序（包括Apache、MySQL、Mozilla等）中的229个临时同步，我们发现了一些有趣且可能令人担忧的特征：（1）每个被研究的应用都使用了临时同步。具体而言，每个程序中有6-83个临时同步。（2）临时同步容易出错。其中22-67%的临时同步引入了错误或严重的性能问题。（3）临时同步的实现多种多样，其中许多不易被识别为同步，即可读性和可维护性较差。工作的第二部分构建了一个名为SyncFinder的工具，用于自动识别和注释C/C++并发程序中的临时同步，以帮助程序员将其代码移植为更结构化的实现，同时使其他工具也能将它们识别为同步。我们对25个并发程序的评估表明，SyncFinder平均能自动识别96%的临时同步，误报率为6%。我们还构建了两个用例来利用SyncFinder的自动注释。第一个用例利用注释在Apache、MySQL和Mozilla中检测到5个死锁（包括2个新的）和16个先前分析工具遗漏的潜在问题。第二个用例使Valgrind数据竞争检查器的误报率降低了43-86%。

upstream_only.title: Deterministic process groups in dOS
upstream_only.abstract: Current multiprocessor systems execute parallel and concurrent software nondeterministically: even when given precisely the same input, two executions of the same program may produce different output. This severely complicates debugging, testing, and automatic replication for fault-tolerance. Previous efforts to address this issue have focused primarily on record and replay, but making execution actually deterministic would address the problem at the root.Our goals in this work are twofold: (1) to provide fully deterministic execution of arbitrary, unmodified, multithreaded programs as an OS service; and (2) to make all sources of intentional nondeterminism, such as network I/O, be explicit and controllable. To this end we propose a new OS abstraction, the Deterministic Process Group (DPG). All communication between threads and processes internal to a DPG happens deterministically, including implicit communication via shared-memory accesses, as well as communication via OS channels such as pipes, signals, and the filesystem. To deal with fundamentally nondeterministic external events, our abstraction includes the shim layer, a programmable interface that interposes on all interaction between a DPG and the external world, making determinism useful even for reactive applications.We implemented the DPG abstraction as an extension to Linux and demonstrate its benefits with three use cases: plain deterministic execution; replicated execution; and record and replay by logging just external input. We evaluated our implementation on both parallel and reactive workloads, including Apache, Chromium, and PARSEC.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 当前的多处理器系统以非确定性方式执行并行和并发软件：即使给定完全相同的输入，同一程序的两次执行也可能产生不同输出。这严重复杂化了调试、测试和容错自动复制。以往的努力主要集中于记录和重放，但让执行实际上变成确定性的将从根本上解决问题。我们的目标有二：（1）提供任意、未修改的多线程程序的完全确定性执行作为操作系统服务；（2）使所有有意非确定性的来源（如网络I/O）变得明确且可控。为此，我们提出一种新的操作系统抽象——确定性进程组（DPG）。DPG内部线程和进程之间的所有通信都确定性地发生，包括通过共享内存访问的隐式通信以及通过管道、信号和文件系统等OS通道的通信。为了处理根本上非确定性的外部事件，我们的抽象包含shim层，这是一个可编程接口，介入DPG与外部世界的所有交互，使确定性甚至对反应式应用也很有用。我们在Linux上实现了DPG抽象，并通过三个用例展示了其益处：普通确定性执行、复制执行以及通过仅记录外部输入进行记录和重放。我们在并行和反应式工作负载（包括Apache、Chromium和PARSEC）上评估了我们的实现。

upstream_only.title: Efficient system-enforced deterministic parallelism
upstream_only.abstract: Deterministic execution offers many benefits for debugging, fault tolerance, and security. Current methods of executing parallel programs deterministically, however, often incur high costs, allow misbehaved software to defeat repeatability, and transform time-dependent races into input- or path-dependent races without eliminating them. We introduce a new parallel programming model addressing these issues, and use Determinator, a proof-of-concept OS, to demonstrate the model's practicality. Determinator's microkernel API provides only "shared-nothing" address spaces and deterministic interprocess communication primitives to make execution of all unprivileged code--well-behaved or not-- precisely repeatable. Atop this microkernel, Determinator's user-level runtime adapts optimistic replication techniques to offer a private workspace model for both thread-level and process-level parallel programing. This model avoids the introduction of read/write data races, and converts write/write races into reliably-detected conflicts. Coarse-grained parallel benchmarks perform and scale comparably to nondeterministic systems, on both multicore PCs and across nodes in a distributed cluster.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 确定性执行为调试、容错和安全性带来了诸多好处。然而，现有并行程序的确定性执行方法往往成本高昂，允许行为不当的软件破坏可重现性，并将依赖于时间的竞争转化为依赖输入或路径的竞争，而非消除它们。我们引入了一种新的并行编程模型来应对这些问题，并通过概念验证操作系统 Determinator 证明该模型的实用性。Determinator 的微内核 API 仅提供“无共享”地址空间和确定性进程间通信原语，使所有非特权代码——无论其行为是否规范——都能被精确、可重现地执行。在该微内核之上，Determinator 的用户级运行时采用乐观复制技术，为线程级和进程级并行编程提供私有工作空间模型。该模型避免引入读/写数据竞争，并将写/写竞争转化为可被可靠检测到的冲突。粗粒度并行基准测试表明，无论在多核 PC 上还是在分布式集群的节点间，其性能和扩展性均可与非确定性系统相媲美。

upstream_only.title: Stable deterministic multithreading through schedule memoization
upstream_only.abstract: A deterministic multithreading (DMT) system eliminates nondeterminism in thread scheduling, simplifying the development of multithreaded programs. However, existing DMT systems are unstable; they may force a program to (ad)venture into vastly different schedules even for slightly different inputs or execution environments, defeating many benefits of determinism. Moreover, few existing DMT systems work with server programs whose inputs arrive continuously and nondeterministically.TERN is a stable DMT system. The key novelty in TERN is the idea of schedule memoization that memoizes past working schedules and reuses them on future inputs, making program behaviors stable across different inputs. A second novelty in TERN is the idea of windowing that extends schedule memoization to server programs by splitting continuous request streams into windows of requests. Our TERN implementation runs on Linux. It operates as user-space schedulers, requiring no changes to the OS and only a few lines of changes to the application programs. We evaluated TERN on a diverse set of 14 programs (e.g., Apache and MySQL) with real and synthetic workloads. Our results show that TERN is easy to use, makes programs more deterministic and stable, and has reasonable overhead.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 确定性多线程（DMT）系统消除了线程调度中的非确定性，简化了多线程程序的开发。然而，现有的DMT系统不稳定；即使是输入或执行环境的细微差异，它们也可能迫使程序进入截然不同的调度路径，从而削弱了确定性的许多优点。此外，很少有现有的DMT系统能够处理输入连续且非确定地到达的服务器程序。TERN是一个稳定的DMT系统。TERN的关键创新在于调度记忆化的思想，它记忆过去可行的调度并在未来的输入上重放这些调度，从而使程序行为在不同输入间保持稳定。TERN的第二个创新是窗口化的思想，通过将连续的请求流分割为请求窗口，将调度记忆化扩展到服务器程序。我们在Linux上实现了TERN。它作为用户态调度器运行，无需修改操作系统，仅需改动应用程序的几行代码。我们在14个不同程序（如Apache和MySQL）上使用真实和合成工作负载对TERN进行了评估。结果表明，TERN易于使用，使程序更具确定性和稳定性，且开销合理。

upstream_only.title: Enabling configuration-independent automation by non-expert users
upstream_only.abstract: The Internet has allowed collaboration on an unprecedented scale. Wikipedia, Luis Von Ahn's ESP game, and reCAPTCHA have proven that tasks typically performed by expensive in-house or outsourced teams can instead be delegated to the mass of Internet computer users. These success stories show the opportunity for crowd-sourcing other tasks, such as allowing computer users to help each other answer questions like "How do I make my computer do X?". The current approach to crowd-sourcing IT tasks, however, limits users to text descriptions of task solutions, which is both ineffective and frustrating. We propose instead, to allow the mass of Internet users to help each other answer how-to computer questions by actually performing the task rather than documenting its solution.This paper presents KarDo, a system that takes as input traces of low-level user actions that perform a task on individual computers, and produces an automated solution to the task that works on a wide variety of computer configurations. Our core contributions are machine learning and static analysis algorithms that infer state and action dependencies without requiring any modifications to the operating system or applications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 互联网实现了前所未有的协作规模。维基百科、Luis Von Ahn的ESP游戏和reCAPTCHA已经证明，通常由昂贵的内部或外包团队执行的任务，可以委托给广大互联网计算机用户。这些成功案例展示了众包其他任务的机会，例如允许计算机用户互相帮助回答诸如“我如何让我的电脑做X？”这样的问题。然而，目前众包IT任务的方法将用户限制为任务解决方案的文本描述，这既无效又令人沮丧。我们建议，转而让广大互联网用户通过实际执行任务而不是记录解决方案来互相帮助解答如何操作计算机的问题。本文介绍了KarDo系统，该系统将单个计算机上执行任务的低级用户操作痕迹作为输入，并生成适用于各种计算机配置的自动化任务解决方案。我们的核心贡献是机器学习和静态分析算法，这些算法在不需要修改操作系统或应用程序的情况下推断状态和动作依赖关系。

upstream_only.title: Automating configuration troubleshooting with dynamic information flow analysis
upstream_only.abstract: Software misconfigurations are time-consuming and enormously frustrating to troubleshoot. In this paper, we show that dynamic information flow analysis helps solve these problems by pinpointing the root cause of configuration errors. We have built a tool called ConfAid that instruments application binaries to monitor the causal dependencies introduced through control and data flow as the program executes -- ConfAid uses these dependencies to link the erroneous behavior to specific tokens in configuration files. Our results using ConfAid to solve misconfigurations in OpenSSH, Apache, and Postfix show that ConfAid identifies the source of the misconfiguration as the first or second most likely root cause for 18 out of 18 real-world configuration errors and for 55 out of 60 randomly generated errors. ConfAid runs in only a few minutes, making it an attractive alternative to manual debugging.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 软件配置错误排查耗时且非常令人沮丧。在本文中，我们证明动态信息流分析能够通过定位配置错误的根本原因来解决这些问题。我们构建了一个名为ConfAid的工具，它对应用程序二进制进行插桩，以监控程序执行期间通过控制流和数据流引入的因果依赖关系——ConfAid利用这些依赖关系将错误行为与配置文件中的特定标记关联起来。我们使用ConfAid解决OpenSSH、Apache和Postfix中的配置错误，结果显示，对于18个真实世界配置错误中的18个以及60个随机生成错误中的55个，ConfAid能识别出配置错误的根源并将其列为第一或第二最可能的根本原因。ConfAid仅需几分钟即可运行，使其成为手动调试的极具吸引力的替代方案。

upstream_only.title: Large-scale incremental processing using distributed transactions and notifications
upstream_only.abstract: Updating an index of the web as documents are crawled requires continuously transforming a large repository of existing documents as new documents arrive. This task is one example of a class of data processing tasks that transform a large repository of data via small, independent mutations. These tasks lie in a gap between the capabilities of existing infrastructure. Databases do not meet the storage or throughput requirements of these tasks: Google's indexing system stores tens of petabytes of data and processes billions of updates per day on thousands of machines. MapReduce and other batch-processing systems cannot process small updates individually as they rely on creating large batches for efficiency.We have built Percolator, a system for incrementally processing updates to a large data set, and deployed it to create the Google web search index. By replacing a batch-based indexing system with an indexing system based on incremental processing using Percolator, we process the same number of documents per day, while reducing the average age of documents in Google search results by 50\%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 随着文档被爬取，更新网络索引需要在新文档到达时不断转换现有的大型文档仓库。这个任务是一类通过小而独立的变更来转换大型数据仓库的数据处理任务的代表。这些任务存在于现有基础设施能力之间的空白地带。数据库无法满足这些任务的存储或吞吐量要求：谷歌的索引系统存储数十PB的数据，每天在数千台机器上处理数十亿次更新。MapReduce和其他批处理系统无法单独处理小更新，因为它们依赖于创建大批量来提高效率。我们构建了Percolator——一个用于增量处理大数据集更新的系统，并部署它以创建谷歌网络搜索索引。通过用基于Percolator的增量处理索引系统取代基于批处理的索引系统，我们处理了相同数量的每日文档，同时将搜索结果中文档的平均年龄降低了50%。

upstream_only.title: Reining in the outliers in map-reduce clusters using Mantri
upstream_only.abstract: Experience froman operational Map-Reduce cluster reveals that outliers significantly prolong job completion. The causes for outliers include run-time contention for processor, memory and other resources, disk failures, varying bandwidth and congestion along network paths and, imbalance in task workload. We present Mantri, a system that monitors tasks and culls outliers using cause- and resource-aware techniques. Mantri's strategies include restarting outliers, network-aware placement of tasks and protecting outputs of valuable tasks. Using real-time progress reports, Mantri detects and acts on outliers early in their lifetime. Early action frees up resources that can be used by subsequent tasks and expedites the job overall. Acting based on the causes and the resource and opportunity cost of actions lets Mantri improve over prior work that only duplicates the laggards. Deployment in Bing's production clusters and trace-driven simulations show that Mantri improves job completion times by 32\%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 对一个运行中的Map-Reduce集群的经验表明，离群任务会显著延长作业完成时间。离群的原因包括运行时对处理器、内存和其他资源的争用、磁盘故障、网络路径上变化的带宽和拥塞，以及任务工作负载的不均衡。我们提出了Mantri系统，它通过感知原因和资源的技术来监控任务并剔除离群任务。Mantri的策略包括重启离群任务、网络感知的任务放置以及保护有价值任务的输出。利用实时进度报告，Mantri在其生命周期早期检测并处理离群任务。早期行动释放了可供后续任务使用的资源，并整体上加速了作业完成。基于原因以及行动的资源成本和机会成本来采取行动，使Mantri相比仅复制落后任务的先前工作有所改进。在Bing生产集群中的部署和基于轨迹的仿真表明，Mantri将作业完成时间缩短了32%。

upstream_only.title: Transactional consistency and automatic management in an application data cache
upstream_only.abstract: Distributed in-memory application data caches like memcached are a popular solution for scaling database-driven web sites. These systems are easy to add to existing deployments, and increase performance significantly by reducing load on both the database and application servers. Unfortunately, such caches do not integrate well with the database or the application. They cannot maintain transactional consistency across the entire system, violating the isolation properties of the underlying database. They leave the application responsible for locating data in the cache and keeping it up to date, a frequent source of application complexity and programming errors.Addressing both of these problems, we introduce a transactional cache, TxCache, with a simple programming model. TxCache ensures that any data seen within a transaction, whether it comes from the cache or the database, reflects a slightly stale but consistent snapshot of the database. TxCache makes it easy to add caching to an application by simply designating functions as cacheable; it automatically caches their results, and invalidates the cached data as the underlying database changes. Our experiments found that adding TxCache increased the throughput of a web application by up to 5.2\texttimes{}, only slightly less than a non-transactional cache, showing that consistency does not have to come at the price of performance.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 像memcached这样的分布式内存应用数据缓存是扩展数据库驱动网站的热门解决方案。这些系统易于添加到现有部署中，并通过减少数据库和应用服务器上的负载来显著提高性能。不幸的是，此类缓存无法与数据库或应用程序良好集成。它们无法在整个系统中维持事务一致性，从而违反了底层数据库的隔离属性。它们使应用程序负责在缓存中定位数据并保持其最新，这通常是应用程序复杂性和编程错误的来源。针对这两个问题，我们引入了一种具有简单编程模型的事务性缓存TxCache。TxCache确保在事务中看到的任何数据，无论来自缓存还是数据库，都反映出一个略微陈旧但一致的数据库快照。TxCache通过简单地将函数指定为可缓存，使得向应用程序添加缓存变得容易；它会自动缓存函数结果，并在底层数据库变化时使缓存数据失效。实验发现，添加TxCache可将Web应用的吞吐量提高至多5.2倍，仅比非事务性缓存略低，这表明一致性不必以性能为代价。

upstream_only.title: Piccolo: building fast, distributed programs with partitioned tables
upstream_only.abstract: Piccolo is a new data-centric programming model for writing parallel in-memory applications in data centers. Unlike existing data-flow models, Piccolo allows computation running on different machines to share distributed, mutable state via a key-value table interface. Piccolo enables efficient application implementations. In particular, applications can specify locality policies to exploit the locality of shared state access and Piccolo's run-time automatically resolves write-write conflicts using user-defined accumulation functions.Using Piccolo, we have implemented applications for several problem domains, including the PageRank algorithm, k-means clustering and a distributed crawler. Experiments using 100 Amazon EC2 instances and a 12 machine cluster show Piccolo to be faster than existing data flow models for many problems, while providing similar fault-tolerance guarantees and a convenient programming interface.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Piccolo是一种新的以数据为中心的编程模型，用于在数据中心编写并行内存应用程序。与现有的数据流模型不同，Piccolo允许运行在不同机器上的计算通过键值表接口共享分布式可变状态。Piccolo能够实现高效的应用程序实现。特别是，应用程序可以指定局部性策略以利用共享状态访问的局部性，而Piccolo的运行时通过用户定义的累加函数自动解决写写冲突。使用Piccolo，我们实现了多个问题域的应用程序，包括PageRank算法、k-means聚类和分布式爬虫。在100个Amazon EC2实例和12台机器集群上进行的实验表明，对于许多问题，Piccolo比现有的数据流模型更快，同时提供相似的容错保证和方便的编程接口。

upstream_only.title: Depot: cloud storage with minimal trust
upstream_only.abstract: The paper describes the design, implementation, and evaluation of Depot, a cloud storage system that minimizes trust assumptions. Depot tolerates buggy or malicious behavior by any number of clients or servers, yet it provides safety and liveness guarantees to correct clients. Depot provides these guarantees using a two-layer architecture. First, Depot ensures that the updates observed by correct nodes are consistently ordered under Fork-Join-Causal consistency (FJC). FJC is a slight weakening of causal consistency that can be both safe and live despite faulty nodes. Second, Depot implements protocols that use this consistent ordering of updates to provide other desirable consistency, staleness, durability, and recovery properties. Our evaluation suggests that the costs of these guarantees are modest and that Depot can tolerate faults and maintain good availability, latency, overhead, and staleness even when significant faults occur.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文描述了Depot的设计、实现和评估，Depot是一种最小化信任假设的云存储系统。Depot能够容忍任意数量的客户端或服务器的错误或恶意行为，同时为正确客户端提供安全性和活性保证。Depot通过两层架构提供这些保证。首先，Depot确保正确节点观察到的更新在分叉-加入-因果一致性（FJC）下一致排序。FJC是因果一致性的轻微弱化，尽管存在故障节点，它仍然是安全和活跃的。其次，Depot实现了利用这种一致排序更新来提供其他理想的一致性、陈旧性、持久性和恢复属性的协议。我们的评估表明，这些保证的成本适中，并且即使在发生重大故障时，Depot也能容忍故障并保持良好的可用性、延迟、开销和新鲜度。

upstream_only.title: Comet: an active distributed key-value store
upstream_only.abstract: Distributed key-value storage systems are widely used in corporations and across the Internet. Our research seeks to greatly expand the application space for key-value storage systems through application-specific customization. We designed and implemented Comet, an extensible, distributed key-value store. Each Comet node stores a collection of active storage objects (ASOs) that consist of a key, a value, and a set of handlers. Comet handlers run as a result of timers or storage operations, such as get or put, allowing an ASO to take dynamic, application-specific actions to customize its behavior. Handlers are written in a simple sandboxed extension language, providing properties of safety and isolation.We implemented a Comet prototype for the Vuze DHT, deployed Comet nodes on Vuze from PlanetLab, and built and evaluated over a dozen Comet applications. Our experience demonstrates that simple, safe, and restricted extensibility can significantly increase the power and range of applications that can run on distributed active storage systems. This approach facilitates the sharing of a single storage system by applications with diverse needs, allowing them to reap the consolidation benefits inherent in today's massive clouds.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 分布式键值存储系统广泛应用于企业和整个互联网。我们的研究旨在通过特定于应用的定制化来大幅扩展键值存储系统的应用空间。我们设计并实现了Comet，一个可扩展的分布式键值存储系统。每个Comet节点存储一组活动存储对象（ASO），其中包含键、值和一组处理器。Comet处理器由定时器或存储操作（如get或put）触发运行，使ASO能够采取动态的、特定于应用的操作来自定义其行为。处理器使用简单且受沙箱限制的扩展语言编写，从而提供安全性和隔离性属性。我们在Vuze DHT上实现了Comet原型，从PlanetLab将Comet节点部署到Vuze上，并构建和评估了十多个Comet应用。我们的经验表明，简单、安全且受限制的可扩展性能够显著提高可在分布式活动存储系统上运行的应用的能力和范围。这种方法使得具有不同需求的应用程序可以共享一个存储系统，从而充分利用当今大规模云环境中的整合优势。

upstream_only.title: SPORC: group collaboration using untrusted cloud resources
upstream_only.abstract: Cloud-based services are an attractive deployment model for user-facing applications like word processing and calendaring. Unlike desktop applications, cloud services allow multiple users to edit shared state concurrently and in real-time, while being scalable, highly available, and globally accessible. Unfortunately, these benefits come at the cost of fully trusting cloud providers with potentially sensitive and important data.To overcome this strict tradeoff, we present SPORC, a generic framework for building a wide variety of collaborative applications with untrusted servers. In SPORC, a server observes only encrypted data and cannot deviate from correct execution without being detected. SPORC allows concurrent, low-latency editing of shared state, permits disconnected operation, and supports dynamic access control even in the presence of concurrency. We demonstrate SPORC's flexibility through two prototype applications: a causally-consistent key-value store and a browser-based collaborative text editor.Conceptually, SPORC illustrates the complementary benefits of operational transformation (OT) and fork* consistency. The former allows SPORC clients to execute concurrent operations without locking and to resolve any resulting conflicts automatically. The latter prevents a misbehaving server from equivocating about the order of operations unless it is willing to fork clients into disjoint sets. Notably, unlike previous systems, SPORC can automatically recover from such malicious forks by leveraging OT's conflict resolution mechanism.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 基于云的服务对于面向用户的应用（如文字处理和日程安排）是一种有吸引力的部署模型。与桌面应用不同，云服务允许多个用户并发地、实时地编辑共享状态，同时具备可扩展性、高可用性和全球可访问性。不幸的是，这些好处需要以完全信任云提供商处理潜在敏感和重要数据为代价。为了克服这种严格的权衡，我们提出了SPORC，这是一个通用的框架，用于构建具有不可信服务器的各种协作应用。在SPORC中，服务器只能观察到加密数据，并且如果偏离正确执行就无法不被检测到。SPORC允许并发、低延迟地编辑共享状态，支持离线操作，并且即使在并发存在的情况下也支持动态访问控制。我们通过两个原型应用展示了SPORC的灵活性：一个因果一致性的键值存储和一个基于浏览器的协作文本编辑器。从概念上讲，SPORC展示了操作变换（OT）和fork*一致性的互补优势。前者允许SPORC客户端在无需锁定的情况下执行并发操作，并自动解决任何由此产生的冲突。后者防止行为不当的服务器对操作的顺序进行模棱两可的处理，除非它愿意将客户端分叉成不相交的集合。值得注意的是，与之前的系统不同，SPORC可以通过利用OT的冲突解决机制自动从这种恶意分叉中恢复。

upstream_only.title: Onix: a distributed control platform for large-scale production networks
upstream_only.abstract: Computer networks lack a general control paradigm, as traditional networks do not provide any network-wide management abstractions. As a result, each new function (such as routing) must provide its own state distribution, element discovery, and failure recovery mechanisms. We believe this lack of a common control platform has significantly hindered the development of flexible, reliable and feature-rich network control planes.To address this, we present Onix, a platform on top of which a network control plane can be implemented as a distributed system. Control planes written within Onix operate on a global view of the network, and use basic state distribution primitives provided by the platform. Thus Onix provides a general API for control plane implementations, while allowing them to make their own trade-offs among consistency, durability, and scalability.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 计算机网络缺乏通用控制范式，因为传统网络不提供任何网络范围的管理抽象。因此，每种新功能（如路由）都必须提供自身的状态分发、元素发现和故障恢复机制。我们认为，缺乏通用控制平台已严重阻碍了灵活、可靠且功能丰富的网络控制平面的发展。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Onix，一个可以在其上将网络控制平面实现为分布式系统的平台。在Onix内编写的控制平面基于网络的全局视图运作，并使用平台提供的基础状态分发原语。因此，Onix为控制平面实现提供了通用API，同时允许它们在一致性、持久性和可扩展性之间做出自己的权衡。

upstream_only.title: Can the production network be the testbed?
upstream_only.abstract: A persistent problem in computer network research is validation. When deciding how to evaluate a new feature or bug fix, a researcher or operator must trade-off realism (in terms of scale, actual user traffic, real equipment) and cost (larger scale costs more money, real user traffic likely requires downtime, and real equipment requires vendor adoption which can take years). Building a realistic testbed is hard because "real" networking takes place on closed, commercial switches and routers with special purpose hardware. But if we build our testbed from software switches, they run several orders of magnitude slower. Even if we build a realistic network testbed, it is hard to scale, because it is special purpose and is in addition to the regular network. It needs its own location, support and dedicated links. For a testbed to have global reach takes investment beyond the reach of most researchers.In this paper, we describe a way to build a testbed that is embedded in--and thus grows with--the network. The technique--embodied in our first prototype, FlowVisor--slices the network hardware by placing a layer between the control plane and the data plane. We demonstrate that FlowVisor slices our own production network, with legacy protocols running in their own protected slice, alongside experiments created by researchers. The basic idea is that if unmodified hardware supports some basic primitives (in our prototype, Open-Flow, but others are possible), then a worldwide testbed can ride on the coat-tails of deployments, at no extra expense. Further, we evaluate the performance impact and describe how FlowVisor is deployed at seven other campuses as part of a wider evaluation platform.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 计算机网络研究中一个长期存在的问题是验证。在决定如何评估新功能或错误修复时，研究人员或运营商必须在真实性（在规模、实际用户流量、真实设备方面）与成本之间进行权衡（更大规模成本更高，真实用户流量可能需要停机，而真实设备则需要供应商采用，这可能耗时数年）。构建真实的测试平台很难，因为“真实”的网络发生在带有专用硬件的封闭、商用交换机和路由器上。但如果我们使用软件交换机来构建测试平台，它们的运行速度会慢几个数量级。即使我们构建了一个真实的网络测试平台，它也难以扩展，因为它是专用平台，并且是常规网络的补充。它需要自己的位置、支持和专用链路。要让测试平台覆盖全球，其投资超出了大多数研究人员的能力范围。本文描述了一种构建嵌入网络并随网络一同增长的测试平台的方法。该技术——体现在我们的第一个原型FlowVisor中——通过在控制平面和数据平面之间放置一个层来对网络硬件进行切片。我们证明了FlowVisor能够对我们的生产网络进行切片，传统协议在自己的受保护切片中运行，并同时承载研究人员创建的实验。基本思想是，如果未修改的硬件支持一些基本原语（在我们的原型中是OpenFlow，但其他原语也可能），那么一个全球性的测试平台就可以借助部署的顺风车，而无需额外费用。此外，我们评估了性能影响，并描述了FlowVisor作为更广泛评估平台的一部分在另外七所校园中的部署情况。

upstream_only.title: Building extensible networks with rule-based forwarding
upstream_only.abstract: We present a network design that provides flexible and policy-compliant forwarding. Our proposal centers around a new architectural concept: that of packet rules. A rule is a simple if-then-else construct that describes the manner in which the network should - or should not - forward packets. A packet identifies the rule by which it is to be forwarded and routers forward each packet in accordance with its associated rule. Each packet rule is certified, guaranteeing that all parties involved in forwarding a packet agree with the packet's rule. Packets containing uncertified rules are simply dropped in the network. We present the design, implementation and evaluation of a Rule-Based Forwarding (RBF) architecture. We demonstrate flexibility by illustrating how RBF supports a variety of use cases including content caching, middlebox selection and DDoS protection. Using our prototype router implementation we show that the overhead RBF imposes is within the capabilities of modern network equipment.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种提供灵活且符合策略转发的网络设计。我们的提议围绕一个新的架构概念：数据包规则。规则是一种简单的if-then-else结构，描述了网络应该如何或不应该转发数据包。数据包标识了其被转发的规则，路由器根据每个数据包关联的规则进行转发。每个数据包规则都经过认证，确保参与转发数据包的所有各方都同意该数据包的规则。包含未经认证规则的数据包将直接被网络丢弃。我们介绍了基于规则的转发（RBF）架构的设计、实现和评估。我们通过展示RBF如何支持各种用例（包括内容缓存、中间盒选择和DDoS防护）来证明其灵活性。使用我们的原型路由器实现，我们表明RBF引入的开销在现代网络设备的能力范围内。

upstream_only.title: TaintDroid: an information-flow tracking system for realtime privacy monitoring on smartphones
upstream_only.abstract: Today's smartphone operating systems frequently fail to provide users with adequate control over and visibility into how third-party applications use their private data. We address these shortcomings with TaintDroid, an efficient, system-wide dynamic taint tracking and analysis system capable of simultaneously tracking multiple sources of sensitive data. TaintDroid provides realtime analysis by leveraging Android's virtualized execution environment. TaintDroid incurs only 14\% performance overhead on a CPU-bound micro-benchmark and imposes negligible overhead on interactive third-party applications. Using TaintDroid to monitor the behavior of 30 popular third-party Android applications, we found 68 instances of potential misuse of users' private information across 20 applications. Monitoring sensitive data with TaintDroid provides informed use of third-party applications for phone users and valuable input for smartphone security service firms seeking to identify misbehaving applications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 当今的智能手机操作系统往往无法为用户提供足够的控制力和可见性，来了解第三方应用如何使用他们的私人数据。我们通过TaintDroid解决了这些缺点，这是一个高效、系统级的动态污点追踪和分析系统，能够同时追踪多个敏感数据源。TaintDroid利用Android的虚拟化执行环境提供实时分析。在CPU密集型微基准测试中，TaintDroid仅产生14%的性能开销，并且对交互式第三方应用的开销可忽略不计。使用TaintDroid监控30个流行的第三方Android应用，我们发现20个应用中有68个可能滥用用户私人信息的实例。使用TaintDroid监控敏感数据，为手机用户提供了第三方应用的知情使用，也为寻求识别违规应用的智能手机安全服务公司提供了宝贵输入。

upstream_only.title: StarTrack next generation: a scalable infrastructure for track-based applications
upstream_only.abstract: StarTrack was the first service designed to manage tracks of GPS location coordinates obtained from mobile devices and to facilitate the construction of track-based applications. Our early attempts to build practical applications on StarTrack revealed substantial efficiency and scalability problems, including frequent client-server roundtrips, unnecessary data transfers, costly similarity comparisons involving thousands of tracks, and poor fault-tolerance. To remedy these limitations, we revised the overall system architecture, API, and implementation. The API was extended to operate on collections of tracks rather than individual tracks, delay query execution, and permit caching of query results. New data structures, namely track trees, were introduced to speed the common operation of searching for similar tracks. Map matching algorithms were adopted to convert each track into a more compact and canonical sequence of road segments. And the underlying track database was partitioned and replicated among multiple servers. Altogether, these changes not only simplified the construction of track-based applications, which we confirmed by building applications using our new API, but also resulted in considerable performance gains. Measurements of similarity queries, for example, show two to three orders of magnitude improvement in query times.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: StarTrack是首个用于管理从移动设备获取的GPS位置轨迹并促进基于轨迹应用构建的服务。我们早期在StarTrack上构建实际应用的尝试揭示了严重的效率和可扩展性问题，包括频繁的客户端-服务器往返、不必要的数据传输、涉及数千条轨迹的高成本相似性比较，以及较差的容错性。为解决这些限制，我们修订了整体系统架构、API和实现。API被扩展为操作轨迹集而非单个轨迹，延迟查询执行，并允许缓存查询结果。引入了新的数据结构，即轨迹树，以加速搜索相似轨迹这一常见操作。采用地图匹配算法将每条轨迹转换为更紧凑和规范的路径段序列。并且底层轨迹数据库在多台服务器之间进行了分区和复制。总之，这些更改不仅简化了基于轨迹应用的构建（我们通过使用新API构建应用进行了确认），而且带来了显著的性能提升。例如，对相似性查询的测量显示查询时间改善了两到三个数量级。

upstream_only.title: The turtles project: design and implementation of nested virtualization
upstream_only.abstract: In classical machine virtualization, a hypervisor runs multiple operating systems simultaneously, each on its own virtual machine. In nested virtualization, a hypervisor can run multiple other hypervisors with their associated virtual machines. As operating systems gain hypervisor functionality--Microsoft Windows 7 already runs Windows XP in a virtual machine--nested virtualization will become necessary in hypervisors that wish to host them. We present the design, implementation, analysis, and evaluation of high-performance nested virtualization on Intel x86-based systems. The Turtles project, which is part of the Linux/KVM hypervisor, runs multiple unmodified hypervisors (e.g., KVM and VMware) and operating systems (e.g., Linux and Windows). Despite the lack of architectural support for nested virtualization in the x86 architecture, it can achieve performance that is within 6-8\% of single-level (non-nested) virtualization for common workloads, through multi-dimensional paging for MMU virtualization and multi-level device assignment for I/O virtualization.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在经典机器虚拟化中，虚拟机监控器可以同时运行多个操作系统，每个操作系统位于各自的虚拟机上。在嵌套虚拟化中，虚拟机监控器可以运行其他多个虚拟机监控器及其关联的虚拟机。随着操作系统获得虚拟机监控器功能——Microsoft Windows 7已经在虚拟机中运行Windows XP——嵌套虚拟化对于希望托管它们的虚拟机监控器来说将变得必要。我们介绍了在基于Intel x86架构的系统上实现高性能嵌套虚拟化的设计、实现、分析和评估。作为Linux/KVM虚拟机监控器的一部分，Turtles项目可以运行多个未经修改的虚拟机监控器（例如KVM和VMware）以及操作系统（例如Linux和Windows）。尽管x86架构缺乏对嵌套虚拟化的架构支持，但通过用于内存管理单元（MMU）虚拟化的多维分页和用于I/O虚拟化的多级设备分配，它在常见工作负载下可以达到单级（非嵌套）虚拟化性能的6-8%以内。

upstream_only.title: Flat datacenter storage
upstream_only.abstract: Flat Datacenter Storage (FDS) is a high-performance, fault-tolerant, large-scale, locality-oblivious blob store. Using a novel combination of full bisection bandwidth networks, data and metadata striping, and flow control, FDS multiplexes an application's large-scale I/O across the available throughput and latency budget of every disk in a cluster. FDS therefore makes many optimizations around data locality unnecessary. Disks also communicate with each other at their full bandwidth, making recovery from disk failures extremely fast. FDS is designed for datacenter scale, fully distributing metadata operations that might otherwise become a bottleneck.FDS applications achieve single-process read and write performance of more than 2GB/s. We measure recovery of 92GB data lost to disk failure in 6.2 s and recovery from a total machine failure with 655GB of data in 33.7 s. Application performance is also high: we describe our FDS-based sort application which set the 2012 world record for disk-to-disk sorting.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 扁平数据中心存储（FDS）是一种高性能、容错、大规模、位置无关的块存储系统。通过结合全二分带宽网络、数据与元数据条带化以及流量控制的创新方式，FDS将应用的大规模I/O复用到集群中每块磁盘的可用吞吐量和延迟预算之上。因此，FDS使得许多围绕数据局部性的优化变得不再必要。磁盘之间也能以全带宽相互通信，使得磁盘故障恢复极为迅速。FDS专为数据中心规模设计，完全分布化了原本可能成为瓶颈的元数据操作。FDS应用实现了单进程读写性能超过2GB/s。我们测得在发生磁盘故障后，92GB数据的恢复时间为6.2秒；整机故障时，655GB数据的恢复时间为33.7秒。应用性能也很高：我们描述了基于FDS的排序应用，该应用创造了2012年磁盘到磁盘排序的世界纪录。

upstream_only.title: PowerGraph: distributed graph-parallel computation on natural graphs
upstream_only.abstract: Large-scale graph-structured computation is central to tasks ranging from targeted advertising to natural language processing and has led to the development of several graph-parallel abstractions including Pregel and GraphLab. However, the natural graphs commonly found in the real-world have highly skewed power-law degree distributions, which challenge the assumptions made by these abstractions, limiting performance and scalability.In this paper, we characterize the challenges of computation on natural graphs in the context of existing graph-parallel abstractions. We then introduce the PowerGraph abstraction which exploits the internal structure of graph programs to address these challenges. Leveraging the PowerGraph abstraction we introduce a new approach to distributed graph placement and representation that exploits the structure of power-law graphs. We provide a detailed analysis and experimental evaluation comparing PowerGraph to two popular graph-parallel systems. Finally, we describe three different implementation strategies for PowerGraph and discuss their relative merits with empirical evaluations on large-scale real-world problems demonstrating order of magnitude gains.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大规模图结构计算是定向广告到自然语言处理等任务的核心，并已推动了包括Pregel和GraphLab在内的多种图并行抽象的发展。然而，现实世界中常见的自然图具有高度偏斜的幂律度分布，这挑战了这些抽象所做假设，限制了性能和可扩展性。在本文中，我们在现有图并行抽象的背景下描述了自然图上计算所面临的挑战。然后，我们引入了PowerGraph抽象，它利用图程序的内部结构来应对这些挑战。借助PowerGraph抽象，我们提出了一种新的分布式图放置和表示方法，该方法利用幂律图的结构。我们提供了详细的分析和实验评估，将PowerGraph与两个流行的图并行系统进行比较。最后，我们描述了PowerGraph的三种不同实现策略，并通过对大规模现实问题的实证评估来讨论其相对优缺点，展示了数量级的改进。

upstream_only.title: GraphChi: large-scale graph computation on just a PC
upstream_only.abstract: Current systems for graph computation require a distributed computing cluster to handle very large real-world problems, such as analysis on social networks or the web graph. While distributed computational resources have become more accessible, developing distributed graph algorithms still remains challenging, especially to non-experts.In this work, we present GraphChi, a disk-based system for computing efficiently on graphs with billions of edges. By using a well-known method to break large graphs into small parts, and a novel parallel sliding windows method, GraphChi is able to execute several advanced data mining, graph mining, and machine learning algorithms on very large graphs, using just a single consumer-level computer. We further extend GraphChi to support graphs that evolve over time, and demonstrate that, on a single computer, GraphChi can process over one hundred thousand graph updates per second, while simultaneously performing computation. We show, through experiments and theoretical analysis, that GraphChi performs well on both SSDs and rotational hard drives.By repeating experiments reported for existing distributed systems, we show that, with only fraction of the resources, GraphChi can solve the same problems in very reasonable time. Our work makes large-scale graph computation available to anyone with a modern PC.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 当前的图计算系统需要分布式计算集群来处理大型现实问题，例如社交网络或网络图分析。虽然分布式计算资源变得更容易获取，但特别是对于非专业人员而言，开发分布式图算法仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们展示了GraphChi，一个基于磁盘的系统，可以在具有数十亿条边的图上高效计算。通过一种已知的方法将大图分解为小部分，并采用新颖的并行滑动窗口方法，GraphChi仅使用一台消费级计算机，就能在超大图上执行若干先进的数据挖掘、图挖掘和机器学习算法。我们进一步扩展GraphChi以支持随时间演化的图，并证明在单台计算机上，GraphChi每秒能处理超过十万次图更新，同时还能进行计算。通过实验和理论分析，我们证明GraphChi在固态硬盘和旋转机械硬盘上均表现良好。通过重复现有分布式系统报告的实验，我们表明仅需一小部分资源，GraphChi就能在非常合理的时间内解决相同的问题。这项工作使得任何人都可以用一台现代个人电脑进行大规模图计算。

upstream_only.title: Hails: protecting data privacy in untrusted web applications
upstream_only.abstract: Modern extensible web platforms like Facebook and Yammer depend on third-party software to offer a rich experience to their users. Unfortunately, users running a third-party "app" have little control over what it does with their private data. Today's platforms offer only ad-hoc constraints on app behavior, leaving users an unfortunate trade-off between convenience and privacy. A principled approach to code confinement could allow the integration of untrusted codewhile enforcing flexible, end-to-end policies on data access. This paper presents a new web framework, Hails, that adds mandatory access control and a declarative policy language to the familiar MVC architecture.
