Traditional protocols for distributed transactions are based on two-phase locking (2PL) or optimistic concurrency control (OCC). 2PL serializes transactions as soon as they conflict and OCC resorts to aborts, leaving many opportunities for concurrency on the table. This paper presents ROCOCO, a novel concurrency control protocol for distributed transactions that outperforms 2PL and OCC by allowing more concurrency. ROCOCO executes a transaction as a collection of atomic pieces, each of which commonly involves only a single server. Servers first track dependencies between concurrent transactions without actually executing them. At commit time, a transaction's dependency information is sent to all servers so they can re-order conflicting pieces and execute them in a serializable order.We compare ROCOCO to OCC and 2PL using a scaled TPC-C benchmark. ROCOCO outperforms 2PL and OCC in workloads with varying degrees of contention. When the contention is high, ROCOCO's throughput is 130\% and 347\% higher than that of 2PL and OCC.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 分布式存储系统跨机器运行事务以确保可串行化。传统的分布式事务协议基于两阶段锁（2PL）或乐观并发控制（OCC）。2PL在事务一发生冲突时就将其串行化，而OCC则诉诸中止，这都留下了许多并发机会未被利用。本文提出了ROCOCO，一种新颖的分布式事务并发控制协议，它允许更多并发，从而优于2PL和OCC。ROCOCO将事务执行为一系列原子片段，每个片段通常只涉及单个服务器。服务器首先跟踪并发事务之间的依赖关系，但并不实际执行它们。在提交时，事务的依赖信息被发送到所有服务器，以便它们能够对冲突片段重新排序，并以可串行化的顺序执行它们。我们使用缩放后的TPC-C基准将ROCOCO与OCC和2PL进行了比较。在不同争用程度的工作负载中，ROCOCO均优于2PL和OCC。当争用程度高时，ROCOCO的吞吐量比2PL和OCC分别高130%和347%。

upstream_only.title: Salt: combining ACID and BASE in a distributed database
upstream_only.abstract: This paper presents Salt, a distributed database that allows developers to improve the performance and scalability of their ACID applications through the incremental adoption of the BASE approach. Salt's motivation is rooted in the Pareto principle: for many applications, the transactions that actually test the performance limits of ACID are few. To leverage this insight, Salt introduces BASE transactions, a new abstraction that encapsulates the workflow of performance-critical transactions. BASE transactions retain desirable properties like atomicity and durability, but, through the new mechanism of Salt Isolation, control which granularity of isolation they offer to other transactions, depending on whether they are BASE or ACID. This flexibility allows BASE transactions to reap the performance benefits of the BASE paradigm without compromising the guarantees enjoyed by the remaining ACID transactions. For example, in our MySQL Cluster-based implementation of Salt, BASE-ifying just one out of 11 transactions in the open source ticketing application Fusion Ticket yields a 6.5x increase over the throughput obtained with an ACID implementation.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了Salt，一种分布式数据库，它允许开发人员通过逐步采用BASE方法来提高其ACID应用程序的性能和可扩展性。Salt的动机源于帕累托原则：对于许多应用程序，真正考验ACID性能极限的事务很少。为了利用这一见解，Salt引入了BASE事务，这是一种封装性能关键型事务工作流的新抽象。BASE事务保留了原子性和持久性等理想属性，但通过新的Salt隔离机制，控制它们对事务提供的隔离粒度（取决于事务是BASE还是ACID）。这种灵活性使BASE事务能够在不影响剩余ACID事务享受的保证的情况下，获得BASE范式的性能优势。例如，在我们基于MySQL Cluster的Salt实现中，将开源票务应用Fusion Ticket中的11个事务中的仅一个转化为BASE事务，吞吐量相比ACID实现增加了6.5倍。

upstream_only.title: Phase reconciliation for contended in-memory transactions
upstream_only.abstract: Multicore main-memory database performance can collapse when many transactions contend on the same data. Contending transactions are executed serially--either by locks or by optimistic concurrency control aborts--in order to ensure that they have serializable effects. This leaves many cores idle and performance poor. We introduce a new concurrency control technique, phase reconciliation, that solves this problem for many important workloads. Doppel, our phase reconciliation database, repeatedly cycles through joined, split, and reconciliation phases. Joined phases use traditional concurrency control and allow any transaction to execute. When workload contention causes unnecessary serial execution, Doppel switches to a split phase. There, updates to contended items modify per-core state, and thus proceed in parallel on different cores. Not all transactions can execute in a split phase; for example, all modifications to a contended item must commute. A reconciliation phase merges these per-core states into the global store, producing a complete database ready for joined-phase transactions. A key aspect of this design is determining which items to split, and which operations to allow on split items.Phase reconciliation helps most when there are many updates to a few popular database records. Its throughput is up to 38x higher than conventional concurrency control protocols on microbenchmarks, and up to 3x on a larger application, at the cost of increased latency for some transactions.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 多核主内存数据库在大量事务竞争同一数据时，性能可能会崩溃。竞争事务会被串行执行（通过锁或乐观并发控制中止），以确保它们具有可串行化的效果。这导致许多核心闲置且性能不佳。我们引入了一种新的并发控制技术——阶段调和（phase reconciliation），它可以为许多重要工作负载解决这一问题。我们的阶段调和数据库Doppel反复循环经过连接（joined）、分离（split）和调和（reconciliation）阶段。连接阶段使用传统并发控制，允许任意事务执行。当工作负载争用导致不必要的串行执行时，Doppel切换到分离阶段。在那里，对被争用项的更新会修改每个核心的状态，从而在不同核心上并行进行。并非所有事务都能在分离阶段执行，例如，对同一被争用项的所有修改必须可交换。调和阶段将这些每核心状态合并到全局存储中，生成一个完整的数据库，为连接阶段的事务做好准备。该设计的一个关键方面是确定哪些项应被分离，以及允许对分离项执行哪些操作。当许多更新集中在对少数热门数据库记录上时，阶段调和最为有效。在微基准测试中，其吞吐量比传统并发控制协议最高提升38倍，在较大的应用程序中最高提升3倍，但代价是增加了某些事务的延迟。

upstream_only.title: Eidetic systems
upstream_only.abstract: The vast majority of state produced by a typical computer is generated, consumed, then lost forever. We argue that a computer system should instead provide the ability to recall any past state that existed on the computer, and further, that it should be able to provide the lineage of any byte in a current or past state. We call a system with this ability an eidetic computer system. To preserve all prior state efficiently, we observe and leverage the synergy between deterministic replay and information flow. By dividing the system into groups of replaying processes and tracking dependencies among groups, we enable the analysis of information flow among groups, make it possible for one group to regenerate the data needed by another, and permit the replay of subsets of processes rather than of the entire system. We use model-based compression and deduplicated file recording to reduce the space overhead of deterministic replay. We also develop a variety of linkage functions to analyze the lineage of state, and we apply these functions via retrospective binary analysis. In this paper we present Arnold, the first practical eidetic computing platform. Preliminary data from several weeks of continuous use on our workstations shows that Arnold's storage requirements for 4 or more years of usage can be satisfied by adding a 4 TB hard drive to the system. Further, the performance overhead on almost all workloads we measured was under 8\%. We show that Arnold can reconstruct prior state and answer lineage queries, including backward queries (on what did this item depend?) and forward queries (what other state did this item affect?).
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 典型计算机产生的绝大多数状态都是被生成、消耗然后永久丢失的。我们认为，计算机系统反而应当能够回忆计算机上存在过的任何过去状态，并且还应能够提供当前或过去状态中任何字节的谱系。我们称具备这种能力的系统为完整记忆计算机系统。为了高效保留所有先前状态，我们观察并利用了确定性重放与信息流之间的协同作用。通过将系统划分为若干组可重放的进程并跟踪组间的依赖关系，我们能够分析组间的信息流，使一个组能够重新生成另一个组所需的数据，并允许重放部分进程而非整个系统。我们使用基于模型的压缩和去重文件记录来降低确定性重放的空间开销。我们还开发了多种链接函数来分析状态的谱系，并通过回顾性二进制分析来应用这些函数。本文介绍Arnold，第一个实用的完整记忆计算平台。我们工作站上连续数周使用的初步数据显示，Arnold在未来4年以上的存储需求只需在系统中添加一块4TB硬盘即可满足。此外，我们测量到的几乎所有工作负载的性能开销均低于8%。我们证明Arnold能够重建过去状态并回答谱系查询，包括反向查询（此项依赖什么？）和正向查询（此项还影响了其他什么状态？）。

upstream_only.title: Detecting covert timing channels with time-deterministic replay
upstream_only.abstract: This paper presents a mechanism called time-deterministic replay (TDR) that can reproduce the execution of a program, including its precise timing. Without TDR, reproducing the timing of an execution is difficult because there are many sources of timing variability - such as preemptions, hardware interrupts, cache effects, scheduling decisions, etc. TDR uses a combination of techniques to either mitigate or eliminate most of these sources of variability. Using a prototype implementation of TDR in a Java Virtual Machine, we show that it is possible to reproduce the timing to within 1.85\% of the original execution, even on commodity hardware.The paper discusses several potential applications of TDR, and studies one of them in detail: the detection of a covert timing channel. Timing channels can be used to exfiltrate information from a compromised machine; they work by subtly varying the timing of the machine's outputs, and it is this variation that can be detected with TDR. Unlike prior solutions, which generally look for a specific type of timing channel, our approach can detect a wide variety of channels with high accuracy.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: No paper abstract provided.

upstream_only.title: Identifying information disclosure in web applications with retroactive auditing
upstream_only.abstract: RAIL is a framework for building web applications that can precisely identify inappropriately disclosed data after a vulnerability is discovered. To do so, RAIL introduces retroactive disclosure auditing: re-running the application with previous inputs once the vulnerability is fixed, to determine what data should have been disclosed. A key challenge for RAIL is to reconcile state divergence between the original and replay executions, so that the differences between executions precisely correspond to inappropriately disclosed data. RAIL provides application developers with APIs to address this challenge, by identifying sensitive data, assigning semantic names to non-deterministic inputs, and tracking dependencies.Results from a prototype of RAIL built on top of the Meteor framework show that RAIL can quickly and precisely identify data disclosure from complex attacks, including programming bugs, administrative mistakes, and stolen passwords. RAIL incurs up to 22\% throughput overhead and 0.5 KB storage overhead per request. Porting three existing web applications required fewer than 25 lines of code changes per application.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: RAIL是一个构建Web应用的框架，能够在发现漏洞后精确识别被不当披露的数据。为此，RAIL引入了回溯式披露审计：在漏洞修复后使用先前的输入重新运行应用程序，以确定本应披露哪些数据。RAIL的关键挑战是协调原始执行与重放执行之间的状态分叉，从而使两次执行之间的差异能够精确对应被不当披露的数据。RAIL通过识别敏感数据、为非确定性输入分配语义名称以及跟踪依赖关系，为应用开发者提供了应对这一挑战的API。基于Meteor框架的RAIL原型实验结果表明，RAIL能够快速、精确地识别来自复杂攻击的数据泄露，包括编程错误、管理失误和密码被盗。RAIL每个请求的吞吐量开销最高为22%，存储开销为0.5 KB。移植三个现有Web应用所需的代码改动每应用不到25行。

upstream_only.title: Project Adam: building an efficient and scalable deep learning training system
upstream_only.abstract: Large deep neural network models have recently demonstrated state-of-the-art accuracy on hard visual recognition tasks. Unfortunately such models are extremely time consuming to train and require large amount of compute cycles. We describe the design and implementation of a distributed system called Adam comprised of commodity server machines to train such models that exhibits world-class performance, scaling and task accuracy on visual recognition tasks. Adam achieves high efficiency and scalability through whole system co-design that optimizes and balances workload computation and communication. We exploit asynchrony throughout the system to improve performance and show that it additionally improves the accuracy of trained models. Adam is significantly more efficient and scalable than was previously thought possible and used 30x fewer machines to train a large 2 billion connection model to 2x higher accuracy in comparable time on the ImageNet 22,000 category image classification task than the system that previously held the record for this benchmark. We also show that task accuracy improves with larger models. Our results provide compelling evidence that a distributed systems-driven approach to deep learning using current training algorithms is worth pursuing.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大型深度神经网络模型最近在困难的视觉识别任务上展示了最先进的准确性。不幸的是，此类模型训练极其耗时，需要大量的计算周期。我们描述了一个名为Adam的分布式系统的设计和实现，该系统由商用服务器机构成，用于训练此类模型，在视觉识别任务上表现出世界级的性能、可扩展性和任务准确性。Adam通过全系统协同设计实现高效率和可扩展性，优化并平衡工作负载计算和通信。我们在整个系统中利用异步性来提高性能，并表明它还能提高训练模型的准确性。Adam比以前认为可能的更加高效和可扩展，在ImageNet 22,000类图像分类任务上，使用比之前保持该基准记录的系统少30倍的机器，在相当的时间内训练了一个大型20亿连接模型，准确率提高到2倍。我们还表明，任务准确性随着模型变大而提高。我们的结果提供了令人信服的证据，表明使用当前训练算法的分布式系统驱动方法进行深度学习是值得追求的。

upstream_only.title: Scaling distributed machine learning with the parameter server
upstream_only.abstract: We propose a parameter server framework for distributed machine learning problems. Both data and workloads are distributed over worker nodes, while the server nodes maintain globally shared parameters, represented as dense or sparse vectors and matrices. The framework manages asynchronous data communication between nodes, and supports flexible consistency models, elastic scalability, and continuous fault tolerance.To demonstrate the scalability of the proposed framework, we show experimental results on petabytes of real data with billions of examples and parameters on problems ranging from Sparse Logistic Regression to Latent Dirichlet Allocation and Distributed Sketching.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种用于分布式机器学习问题的参数服务器框架。数据和负载都分布在工作者节点上，而服务器节点维护全局共享的参数，以稠密或稀疏向量及矩阵的形式表示。该框架管理节点之间的异步数据通信，并支持灵活的一致性模型、弹性扩展性和持续的容错能力。为了展示所提出框架的可扩展性，我们展示了在PB级真实数据上的实验结果，这些数据涉及数十亿个示例和参数，涵盖从稀疏逻辑回归到潜在狄利克雷分配和分布式草绘等问题。

upstream_only.title: GraphX: graph processing in a distributed dataflow framework
upstream_only.abstract: In pursuit of graph processing performance, the systems community has largely abandoned general-purpose distributed dataflow frameworks in favor of specialized graph processing systems that provide tailored programming abstractions and accelerate the execution of iterative graph algorithms. In this paper we argue that many of the advantages of specialized graph processing systems can be recovered in a modern general-purpose distributed dataflow system. We introduce GraphX, an embedded graph processing framework built on top of Apache Spark, a widely used distributed dataflow system. GraphX presents a familiar composable graph abstraction that is sufficient to express existing graph APIs, yet can be implemented using only a few basic dataflow operators (e.g., join, map, group-by). To achieve performance parity with specialized graph systems, GraphX recasts graph-specific optimizations as distributed join optimizations and materialized view maintenance. By leveraging advances in distributed dataflow frameworks, GraphX brings low-cost fault tolerance to graph processing. We evaluate GraphX on real workloads and demonstrate that GraphX achieves an order of magnitude performance gain over the base dataflow framework and matches the performance of specialized graph processing systems while enabling a wider range of computation.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 为了追求图处理性能，系统社区在很大程度上放弃了通用分布式数据流框架，转而采用专门的图处理系统，这些系统提供定制化的编程抽象并加速迭代图算法的执行。在本文中，我们认为现代通用分布式数据流系统可以恢复专门图处理系统的许多优势。我们介绍了GraphX，一个构建在Apache Spark之上的嵌入式图处理框架，Apache Spark是一个广泛使用的分布式数据流系统。GraphX呈现了一种熟悉的可组合图抽象，足以表达现有的图API，并且仅使用几个基本的数据流运算符（例如join、map、group-by）即可实现。为了在性能上与专门的图系统持平，GraphX将特定于图的优化重新转化为分布式连接优化和物化视图维护。通过利用分布式数据流框架的进展，GraphX为图处理带来了低成本的容错能力。我们在真实负载上评估了GraphX，并证明GraphX相对于基础数据流框架实现了数量级的性能提升，并且与专门的图处理系统性能相当，同时支持更广泛的计算。

upstream_only.title: Nail: a practical tool for parsing and generating data formats
upstream_only.abstract: Nail is a tool that greatly reduces the programmer effort for safely parsing and generating data formats defined by a grammar. Nail introduces several key ideas to achieve its goal. First, Nail uses a protocol grammar to define not just the data format, but also the internal object model of the data. Second, Nail eliminates the notion of semantic actions, used by existing parser generators, which reduces the expressive power but allows Nail to both parse data formats and generate them from the internal object model, by establishing a semantic bijection between the data format and the object model. Third, Nail introduces dependent fields and stream transforms to capture protocol features such as size and offset fields, checksums, and compressed data, which are impractical to express in existing protocol languages. Using Nail, we implement an authoritative DNS server in C in under 300 lines of code and grammar, and an unzip program in C in 220 lines of code and grammar, demonstrating that Nail makes it easy to parse complex real-world data formats. Performance experiments show that a Nail-based DNS server can outperform the widely used BIND DNS server on an authoritative workload, demonstrating that systems built with Nail can achieve good performance.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Nail是一种工具，它能大幅减少程序员在安全解析和生成由语法定义的数据格式时所需的工作量。Nail引入了几个关键思想来实现其目标。首先，Nail使用协议语法不仅定义数据格式，还定义数据的内部对象模型。其次，Nail消除了现有解析器生成器中使用的语义动作概念，这降低了表达能力，但允许Nail通过建立数据格式与对象模型之间的语义双射，既解析数据格式又从内部对象模型生成它们。第三，Nail引入了依赖字段和流转换来捕获诸如大小和偏移字段、校验和以及压缩数据等协议特性，这些特性在现有协议语言中难以表达。我们使用Nail在不到300行的代码和语法中实现了一个权威DNS服务器（C语言），并在220行的代码和语法中实现了一个unzip程序（C语言），展示了Nail使得解析复杂的真实世界数据格式变得容易。性能实验表明，基于Nail的DNS服务器在处理权威工作负载时可以胜过广泛使用的BIND DNS服务器，证明使用Nail构建的系统可以达到良好的性能。

upstream_only.title: lprof: a non-intrusive request flow profiler for distributed systems
upstream_only.abstract: Applications implementing cloud services, such as HDFS, Hadoop YARN, Cassandra, and HBase, are mostly built as distributed systems designed to scale. In order to analyze and debug the performance of these systems effectively and efficiently, it is essential to understand the performance behavior of service requests, both in aggregate and individually.lprof is a profiling tool that automatically reconstructs the execution flow of each request in a distributed application. In contrast to existing approaches that require instrumentation, lprof infers the request-flow entirely from runtime logs and thus does not require any modifications to source code. lprof first statically analyzes an application's binary code to infer how logs can be parsed so that the dispersed and intertwined log entries can be stitched together and associated to specific individual requests.We validate lprof using the four widely used distributed services mentioned above. Our evaluation shows lprof's precision in request extraction is 88\%, and lprof is helpful in diagnosing 65\% of the sampled real-world performance anomalies.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 实现云服务的应用程序（如HDFS、Hadoop YARN、Cassandra和HBase）大多被构建为旨在扩展的分布式系统。为了有效且高效地分析和调试这些系统的性能，必须了解服务请求的性能行为，无论是总体上还是单独地。lprof是一个性能分析工具，能够自动重建分布式应用中每个请求的执行流。与需要插桩的现有方法不同，lprof完全从运行时日志推断请求流，因此不需要对源代码进行任何修改。lprof首先对应用程序的二进制代码进行静态分析，以推断日志的解析方式，从而将分散且交织的日志条目拼接在一起，并与特定请求关联。我们使用上述四个广泛使用的分布式服务对lprof进行了验证。评估结果表明，lprof在请求提取方面的精度为88%，并且lprof有助于诊断65%的抽样真实世界性能异常。

upstream_only.title: Pydron: semi-automatic parallelization for multi-core and the cloud
upstream_only.abstract: The cloud, rack-scale computing, and multi-core are the basis for today's computing platforms. Their intrinsic parallelism is a challenge for programmers, specially in areas lacking the necessary economies of scale in application/ code reuse because of the small number of potential users and frequently changing code and data. In this paper, based on an on-going collaboration with several projects in astrophysics, we present Pydron, a system to parallelize and execute sequential Python code on a cloud, cluster, or multi-core infrastructure. While focused on scientific applications, the solution we propose is general and provides a competitive alternative to moving the development effort to application specific platforms. Pydron uses semi-automatic parallelization and can parallelize with an API of only two decorators. Pydron also supports the scheduling and run-time management of the parallel code, regardless of the target platform. First experiences with real astrophysics data pipelines indicate Pydron significantly simplifies development without sacrificing the performance gains of parallelism at the machine or cluster level.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 云、机架级计算和多核是当今计算平台的基础。它们固有的并行性对程序员来说是一个挑战，尤其是在那些因潜在用户数量少且代码和数据频繁变化而缺乏必要的应用/代码复用规模经济的领域。基于与多个天体物理学项目的持续合作，本文提出了Pydron，一个用于在云、集群或多核基础设施上并行化和执行顺序Python代码的系统。虽然专注于科学应用，但我们提出的方案是通用的，并为将开发工作转移到特定应用平台提供了一种有竞争力的替代方案。Pydron使用半自动并行化，仅需两个装饰器即可实现并行化。Pydron还支持并行代码的调度和运行时管理，无论目标平台如何。在真实天体物理学数据管道上的初步经验表明，Pydron显著简化了开发，同时不牺牲机器或集群级别的并行性能收益。

upstream_only.title: User-guided device driver synthesis
upstream_only.abstract: Automatic device driver synthesis is a radical approach to creating drivers faster and with fewer defects by generating them automatically based on hardware device specifications. We present the design and implementation of a new driver synthesis toolkit, called Termite-2. Termite-2 is the first tool to combine the power of automation with the flexibility of conventional development. It is also the first practical synthesis tool based on abstraction refinement. Finally, it is the first synthesis tool to support automated debugging of input specifications. We demonstrate the practicality of Termite-2 by synthesizing drivers for a number of I/O devices representative of a typical embedded platform.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 自动设备驱动程序综合是一种激进的方法，通过基于硬件设备规范自动生成驱动程序，从而更快地创建驱动程序并减少缺陷。我们介绍了一种新的驱动程序综合工具包 Termite-2 的设计与实现。Termite-2 是第一个将自动化能力与传统开发的灵活性相结合的工具，也是第一个基于抽象细化的实用综合工具，并且是第一个支持对输入规范进行自动调试的综合工具。我们通过综合一个典型嵌入式平台上若干 I/O 设备的驱动程序，证明了 Termite-2 的实用性。

upstream_only.title: Push-button verification of file systems via crash refinement
upstream_only.abstract: The file system is an essential operating system component for persisting data on storage devices. Writing bug-free file systems is non-trivial, as they must correctly implement and maintain complex on-disk data structures even in the presence of system crashes and reorderings of disk operations.This paper presents Yggdrasil, a toolkit for writing file systems with push-button verification: Yggdrasil requires no manual annotations or proofs about the implementation code, and it produces a counterexample if there is a bug. Yggdrasil achieves this automation through a novel definition of file system correctness called crash refinement, which requires the set of possible disk states produced by an implementation (including states produced by crashes) to be a subset of those allowed by the specification. Crash refinement is amenable to fully automated satisfiability modulo theories (SMT) reasoning, and enables developers to implement file systems in a modular way for verification.With Yggdrasil, we have implemented and verified the Yxv6 journaling file system, the Ycp file copy utility, and the Ylog persistent log. Our experience shows that the ease of proof and counterexample-based debugging support make Yggdrasil practical for building reliable storage applications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 文件系统是操作系统中用于在存储设备上持久化数据的基本组件。编写无错误的文件系统并非易事，因为即使在系统崩溃和磁盘操作重排序的情况下，文件系统也必须正确实现并维护复杂的磁盘上数据结构。本文介绍了Yggdrasil，一个用于编写可“按钮式验证”的文件系统的工具包：Yggdrasil不需要对实现代码进行任何手动注解或证明，如果存在错误则会生成一个反例。Yggdrasil通过一种新颖的文件系统正确性定义——崩溃精化（crash refinement）——实现了这种自动化，该定义要求实现产生的所有可能的磁盘状态集合（包括崩溃产生的状态）必须是规范所允许的状态的子集。崩溃精化适用于完全自动化的可满足性模理论（SMT）推理，并使开发人员能够以模块化的方式实现文件系统以进行验证。利用Yggdrasil，我们实现并验证了Yxv6日志文件系统、Ycp文件复制工具和Ylog持久化日志。我们的经验表明，证明的简便性和基于反例的调试支持使Yggdrasil成为构建可靠存储应用程序的实用工具。

upstream_only.title: Intermittent computation without hardware support or programmer intervention
upstream_only.abstract: As computation scales downward in area, the limitations imposed by the batteries required to power that computation become more pronounced. Thus, many future devices will forgo batteries and harvest energy from their environment. Harvested energy, with its frequent power cycles, is at odds with current models of long-running computation.To enable the correct execution of long-running applications on harvested energy--without requiring special-purpose hardware or programmer intervention--we propose Ratchet. Ratchet is a compiler that adds lightweight checkpoints to unmodified programs that allow existing programs to execute across power cycles correctly. Ratchet leverages the idea of idempotency, decomposing programs into a continuous stream of re-executable sections connected by lightweight checkpoints, stored in non-volatile memory. We implement Ratchet on top of LLVM, targeted at embedded systems with high-performance non-volatile main memory. Using eight embedded systems benchmarks, we show that Ratchet correctly stretches program execution across frequent, random power cycles. Experimental results show that Ratchet enables a range of existing programs to run on intermittent power, with total run-time overhead averaging below 60\%--comparable to approaches that require hardware support or programmer intervention.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 随着计算在面积上不断缩小，为其供电所需电池带来的限制变得更加显著。因此，许多未来设备将放弃电池，转而从环境中采集能量。然而，采集能量带来的频繁断电循环与当前长期运行计算模型相矛盾。为了在采集能量上实现长期运行应用程序的正确执行——同时无需专用硬件或程序员干预——我们提出了Ratchet。Ratchet是一个编译器，它向未经修改的程序添加轻量级检查点，使现有程序能够跨断电周期正确执行。Ratchet利用了幂等性的思想，将程序分解为由非易失性存储器中存储的轻量级检查点连接的连续可重执行代码段流。我们在LLVM之上实现了Ratchet，目标是具有高性能非易失性主存的嵌入式系统。通过八个嵌入式系统基准测试，我们证明Ratchet能够正确地使程序执行跨越频繁、随机的断电周期。实验结果表明，Ratchet能够使一系列现有程序在间歇性电源上运行，总运行时间开销平均低于60%——与需要硬件支持或程序员干预的方法相当。

upstream_only.title: Machine-aware atomic broadcast trees for multicores
upstream_only.abstract: The performance of parallel programs on multicore machines often critically depends on group communication operations like barriers and reductions being highly tuned to hardware, a task requiring considerable developer skill.Smelt is a library that automatically builds efficient inter-core broadcast trees tuned to individual machines, using a machine model derived from hardware registers plus micro-benchmarks capturing the low-level machine characteristics missing from vendor specifications.Experiments on a wide variety of multicore machines show that near-optimal tree topologies and communication patterns are highly machine-dependent, but can nevertheless be derived by Smelt and often further improve performance over well-known static topologies.Furthermore, we show that the broadcast trees built by Smelt can be the basis for complex group operations like global barriers or state machine replication, and that the hardware-tuning provided by the underlying tree is sufficient to deliver as good or better performance than state-of-the-art approaches: the higher-level operations require no further hardware optimization.

upstream_only.title: Light-weight contexts: an OS abstraction for safety and performance
upstream_only.abstract: We introduce a new OS abstraction--light-weight contexts (lwCs)--that provides independent units of protection, privilege, and execution state within a process. A process may include several lwCs, each with possibly different views of memory, file descriptors, and access capabilities. lwCs can be used to efficiently implement roll-back (process can return to a prior recorded state), isolated address spaces (lwCs within the process may have different views of memory, e.g., isolating sensitive data from network-facing components or isolating different user sessions), and privilege separation (in-process reference monitors can arbitrate and control access).lwCs can be implemented efficiently: the overhead of a lwC is proportional to the amount of memory exclusive to the lwC; switching lwCs is quicker than switching kernel threads within the same process. We describe the lwC abstraction and API, and an implementation of lwCs within the FreeBSD 11.0 kernel. Finally, we present an evaluation of common usage patterns, including fast rollback, session isolation, sensitive data isolation, and inprocess reference monitoring, using Apache, nginx, PHP, and OpenSSL.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们引入了一种新的操作系统抽象——轻量级上下文（lwCs），它在进程内提供独立的保护单元、特权单元和执行状态单元。一个进程可以包含多个lwC，每个lwC可能具有不同的内存视图、文件描述符和访问能力。lwC可用于高效实现回滚（进程可恢复到先前记录的状态）、隔离地址空间（进程内不同lwC可能具有不同的内存视图，例如将敏感数据与面向网络的部分隔离，或隔离不同的用户会话），以及特权分离（进程内引用监视器可仲裁并控制访问）。lwC可以被高效实现：lwC的开销与其独占内存量成正比；切换lwC比切换同一进程内的内核线程更快。我们描述了lwC抽象及API，以及在FreeBSD 11.0内核中的实现。最后，我们评估了常见使用模式，包括使用Apache、nginx、PHP和OpenSSL的快速回滚、会话隔离、敏感数据隔离和进程内引用监视。

upstream_only.title: Altruistic scheduling in multi-resource clusters
upstream_only.abstract: Given the well-known tradeoffs between fairness, performance, and efficiency, modern cluster schedulers often prefer instantaneous fairness as their primary objective to ensure performance isolation between users and groups. However, instantaneous, short-term convergence to fairness often does not result in noticeable long-term benefits. Instead, we propose an altruistic, long-term approach, CARBYNE, where jobs yield fractions of their allocated resources without impacting their own completion times. We show that leftover resources collected via altruisms of many jobs can then be rescheduled to further secondary goals such as application-level performance and cluster efficiency without impacting performance isolation. Deployments and large-scale simulations show that CARBYNE closely approximates the state-of-the-art solutions (e.g., DRF [27]) in terms of performance isolation, while providing 1:26\texttimes{} better efficiency and 1:59\texttimes{} lower average job completion time.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 鉴于公平性、性能和效率之间众所周知的权衡，现代集群调度器通常将瞬时公平性作为主要目标，以确保用户和组之间的性能隔离。然而，瞬时、短期的公平性收敛往往不会带来显著的长期收益。相反，我们提出了一种利他主义的长期方法CARBYNE，其中作业在不影响自身完成时间的情况下让出其分配资源的一部分。我们表明，通过许多作业的利他行为收集的剩余资源可以被重新调度，以进一步实现诸如应用程序级性能和集群效率等次要目标，同时不影响性能隔离。部署和大规模模拟表明，CARBYNE在性能隔离方面与最先进的解决方案（例如DRF）非常接近，同时提供了1.26倍的效率提升和1.59倍的平均作业完成时间降低。

upstream_only.title: Graphene: packing and dependency-aware scheduling for data-parallel clusters
upstream_only.abstract: We present a newcluster scheduler, GRAPHENE, aimed at jobs that have a complex dependency structure and heterogeneous resource demands. Relaxing either of these challenges, i.e., scheduling a DAG of homogeneous tasks or an independent set of heterogeneous tasks, leads to NP-hard problems. Reasonable heuristics exist for these simpler problems, but they perform poorly when scheduling heterogeneous DAGs. Our key insights are: (1) focus on the long-running tasks and those with tough-to-pack resource demands, (2) compute a DAG schedule, offline, by first scheduling such troublesome tasks and then scheduling the remaining tasks without violating dependencies. These offline schedules are distilled to a simple precedence order and are enforced by an online component that scales to many jobs. The online component also uses heuristics to compactly pack tasks and to trade-off fairness for faster job completion. Evaluation on a 200-server cluster and using traces of production DAGs at Microsoft, shows that GRAPHENE improves median job completion time by 25\% and cluster throughput by 30\%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新的集群调度器GRAPHENE，其目标是具有复杂依赖结构和异构资源需求的作业。放宽其中任一挑战，即对同构任务的DAG进行调度或对独立的异构任务集进行调度，都会导致NP难问题。针对这些较简单的问题存在合理的启发式方法，但在调度异构DAG时它们表现不佳。我们的关键洞见是：(1) 重点关注长期运行的任务以及那些资源需求难以打包的任务；(2) 离线计算一个DAG调度：先调度此类棘手的任务，然后在满足依赖约束的情况下调度剩余任务。这些离线调度被提炼为简单的优先顺序，并由一个能够扩展到许多作业的在线组件强制执行。在线组件还使用启发式方法对任务进行紧凑打包，并在公平性与更快的作业完成时间之间进行权衡。在200台服务器集群上并使用来自Microsoft的生产DAG轨迹进行的评估表明，GRAPHENE将作业完成时间的中位数改善了25%，集群吞吐量提高了30%。

upstream_only.title: Firmament: fast, centralized cluster scheduling at scale
upstream_only.abstract: Centralized datacenter schedulers can make high-quality placement decisions when scheduling tasks in a cluster. Today, however, high-quality placements come at the cost of high latency at scale, which degrades response time for interactive tasks and reduces cluster utilization.This paper describes Firmament, a centralized scheduler that scales to over ten thousand machines at sub-second placement latency even though it continuously reschedules all tasks via a min-cost max-flow (MCMF) optimization. Firmament achieves low latency by using multiple MCMF algorithms, by solving the problem incrementally, and via problem-specific optimizations.Experiments with a Google workload trace from a 12,500-machine cluster show that Firmament improves placement latency by 20\texttimes{} over Quincy [22], a prior centralized scheduler using the same MCMF optimization. Moreover, even though Firmament is centralized, it matches the placement latency of distributed schedulers for workloads of short tasks. Finally, Firmament exceeds the placement quality of four widely-used centralized and distributed schedulers on a real-world cluster, and hence improves batch task response time by 6\texttimes{}.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 集中式数据中心调度器在集群中调度任务时可以做出高质量的放置决策。然而，如今高质量放置的代价是扩大了规模下的高延迟，这会降低交互式任务的响应时间并降低集群利用率。本文描述了Firmament，一个即使在通过最小费用最大流（MCMF）优化持续重新调度所有任务的情况下，也能以亚秒级放置延迟扩展到超过一万台机器的集中式调度器。Firmament通过使用多种MCMF算法、增量地解决问题以及问题特定的优化来实现低延迟。使用来自一台12，500台机器集群的Google工作负载轨迹进行的实验表明，与同样使用MCMF优化的先前集中式调度器Quincy[22]相比，Firmament将放置延迟提升了20倍。此外，尽管Firmament是集中式的，但其对于短任务工作负载的放置延迟与分布式调度器相当。最后，在真实集群上，Firmament在放置质量上超过了四种广泛使用的集中式和分布式调度器，从而将批处理任务的响应时间提升了6倍。

upstream_only.title: Morpheus: towards automated SLOs for enterprise clusters
upstream_only.abstract: Modern resource management frameworks for large-scale analytics leave unresolved the problematic tension between high cluster utilization and job's performance predictability--respectively coveted by operators and users. We address this in Morpheus, a new system that: 1) codifies implicit user expectations as explicit Service Level Objectives (SLOs), inferred from historical data, 2) enforces SLOs using novel scheduling techniques that isolate jobs from sharing-induced performance variability, and 3) mitigates inherent performance variance (e.g., due to failures) by means of dynamic reprovisioning of jobs. We validate these ideas against production traces from a 50k node cluster, and show that Morpheus can lower the number of deadline violations by 5\texttimes{} to 13\texttimes{}, while retaining cluster-utilization, and lowering cluster footprint by 14\% to 28\%. We demonstrate the scalability and practicality of our implementation by deploying Morpheus on a 2700-node cluster and running it against production-derived workloads.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代大规模分析资源管理框架尚未解决高集群利用率与作业性能可预测性之间的问题性矛盾——这两者分别是操作员和用户所追求的。我们在Morpheus中解决了这一问题，这是一个新系统，它：1）将隐式的用户期望编码为从历史数据推断出的显式服务级别目标（SLO），2）通过新颖的调度技术强制执行SLO，将作业与共享引起的性能变化隔离开，以及3）通过动态重新配置作业来减轻固有的性能变化（例如，由于故障导致）。我们针对一个5万节点集群的生产轨迹验证了这些想法，并表明Morpheus可以将截止日期违规的数量降低5倍到13倍，同时保持集群利用率，并将集群占用空间降低14%到28%。我们通过在2700节点集群上部署Morpheus并针对生产衍生的工作负载运行，证明了我们实现的可扩展性和实用性。

upstream_only.title: The SNOW theorem and latency-optimal read-only transactions
upstream_only.abstract: Scalable storage systems where data is sharded across many machines are now the norm for Web services as their data has grown beyond what a single machine can handle. Consistently reading data across different shards requires transactional isolation for the reads. Yet a Web service may read from its data store hundreds or thousands of times for a single page load and must minimize read latency to keep response times low. Examining the read-only transaction algorithms for many recent academic and industrial scalable storage systems suggests there is a tradeoff between their power--expressed as the consistency they provide and their compatibility with other types of transactions--and their latency.We show that this tradeoff is fundamental by proving the SNOW Theorem, an impossibility result that states that no read-only transaction algorithm can provide both the lowest latency and the highest power. We then use the tight boundary from the theorem to guide the design of new read-only transaction algorithms for two scalable storage systems, COPS and Rococo. We implement our new algorithms and then evaluate them to demonstrate they provide lower latency for read-only transactions and to understand their impact on overall throughput.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在Web服务中，数据分布在多台机器上的可扩展存储系统已成为常态，因为其数据量已超出单台机器的处理能力。跨不同分片一致地读取数据需要事务隔离。然而，一个Web服务在单次页面加载时可能对其数据存储执行数百次甚至数千次读取，因此必须最小化读取延迟以保持较低的响应时间。对近期许多学术和工业可扩展存储系统的只读事务算法进行考察表明，在其能力（以所提供的一致性以及与其他类型事务的兼容性表示）和延迟之间存在权衡。我们通过证明SNOW定理（一个不可能性结果）表明这种权衡是根本性的，该定理指出没有任何只读事务算法能够同时提供最低延迟和最高能力。然后，我们利用定理所给出的严格边界来指导为两种可扩展存储系统COPS和Rococo设计新的只读事务算法。我们实现了新算法并对其进行了评估，以证明它们为只读事务提供了更低的延迟，并理解其对整体吞吐量的影响。

upstream_only.title: Correlated crash vulnerabilities
upstream_only.abstract: Modern distributed storage systems employ complex protocols to update replicated data. In this paper, we study whether such update protocols work correctly in the presence of correlated crashes. We find that the correctness of such protocols hinges on how local file-system state is updated by each replica in the system. We build PACE, a framework that systematically generates and explores persistent states that can occur in a distributed execution. PACE uses a set of generic rules to effectively prune the state space, reducing checking time from days to hours in some cases. We apply PACE to eight widely used distributed storage systems to find correlated crash vulnerabilities, i.e., problems in the update protocol that lead to user-level guarantee violations. PACE finds a total of 26 vulnerabilities across eight systems, many of which lead to severe consequences such as data loss, corrupted data, or unavailable clusters.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代分布式存储系统采用复杂协议来更新复制数据。本文研究这类更新协议在关联崩溃存在时是否能正确工作。我们发现，协议的正确性取决于系统中每个副本对本地文件系统状态的更新方式。我们构建了PACE框架，该系统性地生成并探索分布式执行中可能出现持久状态。PACE利用一组通用规则有效剪枝状态空间，在某些情况下将检查时间从数天缩短至数小时。我们将PACE应用于八个广泛使用的分布式存储系统，以发现相关崩溃漏洞，即更新协议中导致用户级保证被违反的问题。PACE在这些系统中共发现26个漏洞，其中许多会导致严重后果，如数据丢失、数据损坏或集群不可用。

upstream_only.title: Incremental consistency guarantees for replicated objects
upstream_only.abstract: Programming with replicated objects is difficult. Developers must face the fundamental trade-off between consistency and performance head on, while struggling with the complexity of distributed storage stacks. We introduce Correctables, a novel abstraction that hides most of this complexity, allowing developers to focus on the task of balancing consistency and performance. To aid developers with this task, Correctables provide incremental consistency guarantees, which capture successive refinements on the result of an ongoing operation on a replicated object. In short, applications receive both a preliminary--fast, possibly inconsistent--result, as well as a final--consistent--result that arrives later.We show how to leverage incremental consistency guarantees by speculating on preliminary values, trading throughput and bandwidth for improved latency. We experiment with two popular storage systems (Cassandra and ZooKeeper) and three applications: a Twissandra-based microblogging service, an ad serving system, and a ticket selling system. Our evaluation on the Amazon EC2 platform with YCSB workloads A, B, and C shows that we can reduce the latency of strongly consistent operations by up to 40\% (from 100ms to 60ms) at little cost (10\% bandwidth increase, 6\% throughput drop) in the ad system. Even if the preliminary result is frequently inconsistent (25\% of accesses), incremental consistency incurs a bandwidth overhead of only 27\%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 使用复制对象进行编程是困难的。开发者必须直接面对一致性与性能之间的基本权衡，同时还要应对分布式存储栈的复杂性。我们引入了Correctables，一种新颖的抽象，它隐藏了大部分这种复杂性，使开发者能够专注于平衡一致性和性能的任务。为了帮助开发者完成这一任务，Correctables提供了增量一致性保证，这些保证捕获了对复制对象上正在进行操作的结果的连续细化。简而言之，应用程序会收到一个初步的——快速的、可能不一致的——结果，以及一个稍后到达的最终的——一致的——结果。我们展示了如何通过推测初步值来利用增量一致性保证，以吞吐量和带宽换取更低的延迟。我们使用了两个流行的存储系统（Cassandra和ZooKeeper）以及三个应用进行了实验：一个基于Twissandra的微博服务、一个广告服务系统和一个售票系统。我们在Amazon EC2平台上使用YCSB工作负载A、B和C的评估表明，在广告系统中，我们可以将强一致操作的延迟降低最多40%（从100毫秒降至60毫秒），而代价很小（带宽增加10%，吞吐量下降6%）。即使初步结果经常不一致（25%的访问），增量一致性也仅带来27%的带宽开销。

upstream_only.title: FaSST: fast, scalable and simple distributed transactions with two-sided (RDMA) datagram RPCs
upstream_only.abstract: FaSST is an RDMA-based system that provides distributed in-memory transactions with serializability and durability. Existing RDMA-based transaction processing systems use one-sided RDMA primitives for their ability to bypass the remote CPU. This design choice brings several drawbacks. First, the limited flexibility of one-sided RDMA reduces performance and increases software complexity when designing distributed data stores. Second, deep-rooted technical limitations of RDMA hardware limit scalability in large clusters. FaSST eschews one-sided RDMA for fast RPCs using two-sided unreliable datagrams, which we show drop packets extremely rarely on modern RDMA networks. This approach provides better performance, scalability, and simplicity, without requiring expensive reliability mechanisms in software. In comparison with published numbers, FaSST outperforms FaRM on the TATP benchmark by almost 2x while using close to half the hardware resources, and it outperforms DrTM+R on the SmallBank benchmark by around 1.7x without making data locality assumptions.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: FaSST是一个基于RDMA的系统，提供具有可串行性和持久性的分布式内存事务。现有的基于RDMA的事务处理系统使用单边RDMA原语，原因是其能够绕过远程CPU。但这种设计选择带来了几个缺点。首先，单边RDMA有限的灵活性降低了性能并增加了设计分布式数据存储时的软件复杂度。其次，RDMA硬件深层次的技术限制限制了大型集群的可扩展性。FaSST放弃单边RDMA，转而使用基于双向不可靠数据报的快速RPC；我们证明，在现代RDMA网络上，这种数据报极少丢包。这种方法无需在软件中实现昂贵的可靠性机制，即可提供更好的性能、可扩展性和简单性。与已发表的数据相比，FaSST在TATP基准测试上的性能比FaRM高出近2倍，同时使用的硬件资源接近一半；在SmallBank基准测试上，FaSST在未做数据局部性假设的情况下比DrTM+R高出约1.7倍。

upstream_only.title: NetBricks: taking the V out of NFV
upstream_only.abstract: The move from hardware middleboxes to software network functions, as advocated by NFV, has proven more challenging than expected. Developing new NFs remains a tedious process, requiring that developers repeatedly rediscover and reapply the same set of optimizations, while current techniques for providing isolation between NFs (using VMs or containers) incur high performance overheads. In this paper we describe NetBricks, a new NFV framework that tackles both these problems. For building NFs we take inspiration from modern data analytics frameworks (e.g., Spark and Dryad) and build a small set of customizable network processing elements. We also embrace type checking and safe runtimes to provide isolation in software, rather than rely on hardware isolation. NetBricks provides the same memory isolation as containers and VMs, without incurring the same performance penalties. To improve I/O efficiency, we introduce a novel technique called zero-copy software isolation.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 从硬件中间盒转向软件网络功能（如NFV所倡导的）已被证明比预期更具挑战性。开发新的网络功能仍然是一个繁琐的过程，要求开发者反复重新发现和应用同一套优化，而当前用于提供网络功能之间隔离的技术（使用虚拟机或容器）会导致较高的性能开销。在本文中，我们描述了NetBricks，一个新的NFV框架，它解决了这两个问题。对于构建网络功能，我们从现代数据分析框架（如Spark和Dryad）中汲取灵感，构建了一小组可定制的网络处理元素。我们还利用类型检查和安全的运行时来在软件中提供隔离，而不是依赖硬件隔离。NetBricks提供了与容器和虚拟机相同的内存隔离，而无需承担相同的性能损失。为了提高I/O效率，我们引入了一种称为零拷贝软件隔离的新技术。

upstream_only.title: Efficient network reachability analysis using a succinct control plane representation
upstream_only.abstract: To guarantee network availability and security, operators must ensure that their reachability policies (e.g., A can or cannot talk to B) are correctly implemented. This is a difficult task due to the complexity of network configuration and the constant churn in a network's environment, e.g., new route announcements arrive and links fail. Current network reachability analysis techniques are limited as they can only reason about the current "incarnation" of the network, cannot analyze all configuration features, or are too slow to enable exploration of many environments. We build ERA, a tool for efficient reasoning about network reachability. Instead of reasoning about individual incarnations of the network, ERA directly reasons about the network "control plane" that generates these incarnations. We address key expressiveness and scalability challenges by building (i) a succinct model for the network control plane (i.e., various routing protocols and their interactions), and (ii) a repertoire of techniques for scalable (taking a few seconds for a network with > 1000 routers) exploration of this model. We have used ERA to successfully find both known and new violations of a range of common intended polices.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 为了保证网络的可用性和安全性，运营商必须确保其可达性策略（例如A能否与B通信）被正确实施。由于网络配置的复杂性和网络环境的持续变化（如新路由通告到达、链路故障等），这是一项困难的任务。现有的网络可达性分析技术存在局限：它们只能推理网络当前的“化身”，无法分析所有配置特性，或者速度太慢以致难以探索多种环境。我们构建了ERA，一个用于高效推理网络可达性的工具。ERA并不推理网络的各个化身，而是直接推理生成这些化身的网络“控制平面”。我们通过构建(i)网络控制平面的简洁模型（包括各种路由协议及其交互）和(ii)一套可扩展探索该模型的技术（对于具有超过1000台路由器的网络只需几秒），解决了关键的表达性和可扩展性挑战。我们已使用ERA成功发现了多种常见预期策略的已知和新的违规行为。

upstream_only.title: Simplifying datacenter network debugging with pathdump
upstream_only.abstract: Datacenter networks continue to grow complex due to larger scales, higher speeds and higher link utilization. Existing tools to manage and debug these networks are even more complex, requiring in-network techniques like collecting per-packet per-switch logs, dynamic switch rule updates, periodically collecting data plane snapshots, packet mirroring, packet sampling, traffic replay, etc.This paper calls for a radically different approach to network management and debugging: in contrast to implementing the functionality entirely in-network, we should carefully partition the debugging tasks between the edge devices and the network elements. We present the design, implementation and evaluation of PathDump, a minimalistic tool that utilizes resources at edge devices for network debugging. PathDump currently runs over a real network comprising only of commodity hardware, and yet, can support a surprisingly large class of network debugging problems. Evaluation results show that Path-Dump requires minimal switch and edge resources, while enabling network debugging at fine-grained time scales.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 数据中心网络因规模更大、速度更高和链路利用率更高而持续复杂化。现有的管理和调试这些网络的工具甚至更为复杂，需要采用收集每包每交换机日志、动态交换机规则更新、周期收集数据平面快照、报文镜像、报文采样、流量重放等网络内技术。本文呼吁采用一种截然不同的网络管理和调试方法：不是完全在网络内实现功能，而是应在边缘设备和网络元素之间仔细划分调试任务。我们展示了PathDump的设计、实现与评估，PathDump是一个极简工具，利用边缘设备上的资源进行网络调试。PathDump当前运行在一个仅由商用硬件组成的真实网络上，然而却能支持众多出乎意料的网络调试问题。评估结果表明，PathDump仅需极少的交换机和边缘资源，同时能支持细粒度的网络调试。

upstream_only.title: Network requirements for resource disaggregation
upstream_only.abstract: Traditional datacenters are designed as a collection of servers, each of which tightly couples the resources required for computing tasks. Recent industry trends suggest a paradigm shift to a disaggregated datacenter (DDC) architecture containing a pool of resources, each built as a standalone resource blade and interconnected using a network fabric.A key enabling (or blocking) factor for disaggregation will be the network - to support good application-level performance it becomes critical that the network fabric provide low latency communication even under the increased traffic load that disaggregation introduces. In this paper, we use a workload-driven approach to derive the minimum latency and bandwidth requirements that the network in disaggregated datacenters must provide to avoid degrading application-level performance and explore the feasibility of meeting these requirements with existing system designs and commodity networking technology.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 传统数据中心被设计为服务器的集合，每个服务器紧密耦合计算任务所需的资源。最近的行业趋势表明，范式正在向分解式数据中心（DDC）架构转变，该架构包含一个资源池，每个资源作为独立的资源刀片构建，并通过网络结构互连。分解的一个关键推动（或阻碍）因素将是网络——为了支持良好的应用级性能，网络结构必须在分解引入的流量负载增加的情况下仍提供低延迟通信。在本文中，我们采用工作负载驱动的方法，推导分解数据中心中网络必须提供的最低延迟和带宽要求，以避免降低应用级性能，并探索使用现有系统设计和商用网络技术满足这些要求的可行性。

upstream_only.title: TensorFlow: a system for large-scale machine learning
upstream_only.abstract: TensorFlow is a machine learning system that operates at large scale and in heterogeneous environments. Tensor-Flow uses dataflow graphs to represent computation, shared state, and the operations that mutate that state. It maps the nodes of a dataflow graph across many machines in a cluster, and within a machine across multiple computational devices, including multicore CPUs, general-purpose GPUs, and custom-designed ASICs known as Tensor Processing Units (TPUs). This architecture gives flexibility to the application developer: whereas in previous "parameter server" designs the management of shared state is built into the system, TensorFlow enables developers to experiment with novel optimizations and training algorithms. TensorFlow supports a variety of applications, with a focus on training and inference on deep neural networks. Several Google services use TensorFlow in production, we have released it as an open-source project, and it has become widely used for machine learning research. In this paper, we describe the TensorFlow dataflow model and demonstrate the compelling performance that TensorFlow achieves for several real-world applications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: TensorFlow 是一个在异构环境中大规模运行的机器学习系统。TensorFlow 使用数据流图来表示计算、共享状态以及改变该状态的操作。它将数据流图的节点映射到集群中的多台机器上，并在单个机器内映射到多个计算设备上，包括多核 CPU、通用 GPU 以及称为张量处理单元（TPU）的定制 ASIC。这种架构为应用程序开发人员提供了灵活性：而在以往的“参数服务器”设计中，共享状态的管理内置于系统中，TensorFlow 使开发人员能够试验新颖的优化和训练算法。TensorFlow 支持多种应用，重点关注深度神经网络的训练和推理。Google 的多项服务在生产环境中使用 TensorFlow，我们已将其发布为开源项目，并且它已被广泛用于机器学习研究。在本文中，我们描述了 TensorFlow 数据流模型，并展示了 TensorFlow 在几个真实世界应用中实现的令人信服的性能。

upstream_only.title: Exploring the hidden dimension in graph processing
upstream_only.abstract: Task partitioning of a graph-parallel system is traditionally considered equivalent to the graph partition problem. Such equivalence exists because the properties associated with each vertex/edge are normally considered indivisible. However, this assumption is not true for many Machine Learning and Data Mining (MLDM) problems: instead of a single value, a vector of data elements is defined as the property for each vertex/edge. This feature opens a new dimension for task partitioning because a vertex could be divided and assigned to different nodes.To explore this new opportunity, this paper presents 3D partitioning, a novel category of task partition algorithms that significantly reduces network traffic for certain MLDM applications. Based on 3D partitioning, we build a distributed graph engine CUBE. Our evaluation results show that CUBE outperforms state-of-the-art graph-parallel system PowerLyra by up to 4:7\texttimes{} (up to 7:3\texttimes{} speedup against PowerGraph).
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 传统上，图并行系统的任务划分被认为等价于图划分问题。这种等价之所以存在，是因为与每个顶点/边关联的属性通常被视为不可分割的。然而，这一假设对于许多机器学习和数据挖掘（MLDM）问题并不成立：每个顶点/边的属性并非单一值，而是一个数据元素向量。这一特性为任务划分开辟了一个新的维度，因为一个顶点可以被分割并分配给不同节点。为了探索这一新机遇，本文提出了三维划分（3D partitioning），这是一类新颖的任务划分算法，可显著减少某些MLDM应用的网络流量。基于三维划分，我们构建了一个分布式图引擎CUBE。我们的评估结果表明，CUBE在性能上优于最先进的图并行系统PowerLyra最高达4.7倍（相比PowerGraph最高可达7.3倍的加速）。

upstream_only.title: Gemini: a computation-centric distributed graph processing system
upstream_only.abstract: Traditionally distributed graph processing systems have largely focused on scalability through the optimizations of inter-node communication and load balance. However, they often deliver unsatisfactory overall processing efficiency compared with shared-memory graph computing frameworks. We analyze the behavior of several graph-parallel systems and find that the added overhead for achieving scalability becomes a major limiting factor for efficiency, especially with modern multi-core processors and high-speed interconnection networks.Based on our observations, we present Gemini, a distributed graph processing system that applies multiple optimizations targeting computation performance to build scalability on top of efficiency. Gemini adopts (1) a sparse-dense signal-slot abstraction to extend the hybrid push-pull computation model from shared-memory to distributed scenarios, (2) a chunk-based partitioning scheme enabling low-overhead scaling out designs and locality-preserving vertex accesses, (3) a dual representation scheme to compress accesses to vertex indices, (4) NUMA-aware sub-partitioning for efficient intra-node memory accesses, plus (5) locality-aware chunking and fine-grained work-stealing for improving both internode and intra-node load balance, respectively. Our evaluation on an 8-node high-performance cluster (using five widely used graph applications and five real-world graphs) shows that Gemini significantly outperforms all well-known existing distributed graph processing systems, delivering up to 39.8\texttimes{} (from 8.91\texttimes{}) improvement over the fastest among them.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 传统上，分布式图处理系统主要通过优化节点间通信和负载均衡来关注可扩展性。然而，与共享内存图计算框架相比，它们通常难以提供令人满意的整体处理效率。我们分析了几个图并行系统的行为，发现为了实现可扩展性而增加的额外开销成为效率的主要限制因素，尤其是在现代多核处理器和高速互连网络的环境中。基于我们的观察，我们提出了Gemini，一个分布式图处理系统，它应用了多种针对计算性能的优化，在效率之上构建可扩展性。Gemini采用了(1)稀疏-稠密信号-槽抽象，将混合推拉计算模型从共享内存扩展到分布式场景；(2)基于块的分区方案，实现低开销的扩展设计以及保持局部性的顶点访问；(3)双表示方案，以压缩对顶点索引的访问；(4)NUMA感知的子分区，以实现高效的节点内内存访问；以及(5)局部感知分块和细粒度工作窃取，分别改善节点间和节点内的负载均衡。我们在一个8节点高性能集群上的评估（使用五个广泛使用的图应用和五个真实世界图）表明，Gemini显著优于所有已知的现有分布式图处理系统，相较其中最快的系统，提升高达39.8倍（最低8.91倍）。

upstream_only.title: Fast and concurrent RDF queries with RDMA-based distributed graph exploration
upstream_only.abstract: Many public knowledge bases are represented and stored as RDF graphs, where users can issue structured queries on such graphs using SPARQL. With massive queries over large and constantly growing RDF data, it is imperative that an RDF graph store should provide low latency and high throughput for concurrent query processing. However, prior systems still experience high per-query latency over large datasets and most prior designs have poor resource utilization such that each query is processed in sequence.We present Wukong, a distributed graph-based RDF store that leverages RDMA-based graph exploration to provide highly concurrent and low-latency queries over large data sets. Wukong is novel in three ways. First, Wukong provides an RDMA-friendly distributed key/- value store that provides differentiated encoding and fine-grained partitioning of graph data to reduce RDMA transfers. Second, Wukong leverages full-history pruning to avoid the cost of expensive final join operations, based on the observation that the cost of one-sided RDMA operations is largely oblivious to the payload size to a certain extent. Third, countering conventional wisdom of preferring migration of execution over data, Wukong seamlessly combines data migration for low latency and execution distribution for high throughput by leveraging the low latency and high throughput of one-sided RDMA operations, and proposes a worker-obliger model for efficient load balancing.Evaluation on a 6-node RDMA-capable cluster shows that Wukong significantly outperforms state-of-the-art systems like TriAD and Trinity.RDF for both latency and throughput, usually at the scale of orders of magnitude.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 许多公共知识库以RDF图的形式表示和存储，用户可以通过SPARQL对这种图发出结构化查询。面对大规模且不断增长的RDF数据上的海量查询，RDF图存储必须为并发查询处理提供低延迟和高吞吐量。然而，现有系统在大数据集上仍然存在较高的单查询延迟，且大多数先前设计资源利用率较差，每个查询都是顺序处理的。我们提出了Wukong，一个基于图的分布式RDF存储系统，利用基于RDMA的图探索为大数据集提供高并发和低延迟的查询。Wukong的创新体现在三个方面。首先，Wukong提供了一个RDMA友好的分布式键值存储，通过差异化编码和细粒度图数据分区来减少RDMA传输。其次，Wukong利用全历史剪枝来避免昂贵的最终连接操作，其基于的观察是：在某种程度上，单侧RDMA操作的成本与有效载荷大小基本无关。第三，与传统观点（倾向于将执行迁移到数据位置）不同，Wukong通过利用单侧RDMA的低延迟和高吞吐量，无缝结合了数据迁移（用于低延迟）和分布式执行（用于高吞吐量），并提出了一个worker-obliger模型来实现高效负载均衡。在6节点支持RDMA的集群上的评估表明，Wukong在延迟和吞吐量方面都显著优于TriAD和Trinity.RDF等最先进系统，通常达到数量级的提升。

upstream_only.title: REX: a development platform and online learning approach for runtime emergent software systems
upstream_only.abstract: Conventional approaches to self-adaptive software architectures require human experts to specify models, policies and processes by which software can adapt to its environment. We present REX, a complete platform and online learning approach for runtime emergent software systems, in which all decisions about the assembly and adaptation of software are machine-derived. REX is built with three major, integrated layers: (i) a novel component-based programming language called Dana, enabling discovered assembly of systems and very low cost adaptation of those systems for dynamic re-assembly; (ii) a perception, assembly and learning framework (PAL) built on Dana, which abstracts emergent software into configurations and perception streams; and (iii) an online learning implementation based on a linear bandit model, which helps solve the search space explosion problem inherent in runtime emergent software. Using an emergent web server as a case study, we show how software can be autonomously self-assembled from discovered parts, and continually optimized over time (by using alternative parts) as it is subjected to different deployment conditions. Our system begins with no knowledge that it is specifically assembling a web server, nor with knowledge of the deployment conditions that may occur at runtime.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 传统的自适应软件架构方法需要人类专家指定软件适应其环境的模型、策略和流程。我们提出了REX，一个针对运行时涌现式软件系统的完整平台和在线学习方法，其中关于软件组装和适应的所有决策均由机器推导得出。REX由三个主要的集成层组成：(i) 一种名为Dana的新型基于组件的编程语言，支持系统的发现式组装以及极低成本的动态重组适应；(ii) 构建在Dana之上的感知、组装和学习框架（PAL），将涌现式软件抽象为配置和感知流；(iii) 基于线性赌博机模型的在线学习实现，有助于解决运行时涌现式软件固有的搜索空间爆炸问题。以涌现式Web服务器为案例研究，我们展示了软件如何从发现的部件中自主自组装，并在面临不同部署条件时通过使用替代部件持续优化。我们的系统开始时既不知道具体组装的是Web服务器，也不知道运行时可能出现的部署条件。

upstream_only.title: Yak: a high-performance big-data-friendly garbage collector
upstream_only.abstract: Most "Big Data" systems are written in managed languages, such as Java, C#, or Scala. These systems suffer from severe memory problems due to the massive volume of objects created to process input data. Allocating and deallocating a sea of data objects puts a severe strain on existing garbage collectors (GC), leading to high memory management overheads and reduced performance.This paper describes the design and implementation of Yak, a "Big Data" friendly garbage collector that provides high throughput and low latency for all JVM-based languages. Yak divides the managed heap into a control space (CS) and a data space (DS), based on the observation that a typical data-intensive system has a clear distinction between a control path and a data path. Objects created in the control path are allocated in the CS and subject to regular tracing GC. The lifetimes of objects in the data path often align with epochs creating them. They are thus allocated in the DS and subject to region-based memory management. Our evaluation with three large systems shows very positive results.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大多数“大数据”系统都是用托管语言（如Java、C#或Scala）编写的。由于处理输入数据需要创建海量对象，这些系统遭受严重的内存问题。分配和释放海量数据对象给现有垃圾收集器（GC）带来了严重压力，导致内存管理开销高、性能下降。本文描述了Yak的设计与实现，Yak是一个“大数据”友好的垃圾收集器，为所有基于JVM的语言提供高吞吐量和低延迟。Yak基于典型数据密集型系统在控制路径和数据路径之间存在明显区别的观察，将托管堆划分为控制空间（CS）和数据空间（DS）。在控制路径中创建的对象分配在CS中，并接受常规的追踪式GC。数据路径中对象的生命周期通常与其创建时的周期（epoch）一致。因此它们被分配在DS中，并采用基于区域的内存管理。我们使用三个大型系统的评估结果非常积极。

upstream_only.title: Shuffler: fast and deployable continuous code re-randomization
upstream_only.abstract: While code injection attacks have been virtually eliminated on modern systems, programs today remain vulnerable to code reuse attacks. Particularly pernicious are Just-In-Time ROP (JIT-ROP) techniques, where an attacker uses a memory disclosure vulnerability to discover code gadgets at runtime. We designed a code-reuse defense, called Shuffler, which continuously re-randomizes code locations on the order of milliseconds, introducing a real-time deadline on the attacker. This deadline makes it extremely difficult to form a complete exploit, particularly against server programs that often sit tens of milliseconds away from attacker machines.Shuffler focuses on being fast, self-hosting, and nonintrusive to the end user. Specifically, for speed, Shuffler randomizes code asynchronously in a separate thread and atomically switches from one code copy to the next. For security, Shuffler adopts an "egalitarian" principle and randomizes itself the same way it does the target. Lastly, to deploy Shuffler, no source, kernel, compiler, or hardware modifications are necessary.Evaluation shows that Shuffler defends against all known forms of code reuse, including ROP, direct JIT-ROP, indirect JIT-ROP, and Blind ROP. We observed 14.9\% overhead on SPEC CPU when shuffling every 50 ms, and ran Shuffler on real-world applications such as Nginx. We showed that the shuffled Nginx scales up to 24 worker processes on 12 cores.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 虽然代码注入攻击在现代系统上几乎已被消除，但程序至今仍易受代码重用攻击。特别顽固的是即时重用攻击（JIT-ROP）技术，其中攻击者利用内存泄露漏洞在运行时发现代码小工具。我们设计了一种称为Shuffler的代码重用防御方法，它每隔几毫秒就连续随机化代码位置，为攻击者引入实时截止期限。这一期限使得形成完整攻击极其困难，尤其是针对通常距离攻击者机器几十毫秒的服务器程序。Shuffler注重快速、自托管，并且对最终用户无侵入性。具体来说，为了速度，Shuffler在单独的线程中异步随机化代码，并在下一个代码副本之间进行原子切换。为了安全，Shuffler采用“平等主义”原则，并像随机化目标一样随机化自身。最后，部署Shuffler不需要修改源代码、内核、编译器或硬件。评估表明，Shuffler能防御所有已知形式的代码重用攻击，包括ROP、直接JIT-ROP、间接JIT-ROP和盲ROP。我们观察到在每50毫秒随机化一次时SPEC CPU上有14.9%的开销，并在Nginx等现实应用上运行了Shuffler。我们展示了随机化的Nginx在12个核上可扩展到24个工作进程。

upstream_only.title: Don't get caught in the cold, warm-up your JVM: understand and eliminate JVM warm-up overhead in data-parallel systems
upstream_only.abstract: Many widely used, latency sensitive, data-parallel distributed systems, such as HDFS, Hive, and Spark choose to use the Java Virtual Machine (JVM), despite debate on the overhead of doing so. This paper analyzes the extent and causes of the JVM performance overhead in the above mentioned systems. Surprisingly, we find that the warm-up overhead, i.e., class loading and interpretation of bytecode, is frequently the bottleneck. For example, even an I/O intensive, 1GB read on HDFS spends 33\% of its execution time in JVM warm-up, and Spark queries spend an average of 21 seconds in warm-up.The findings on JVM warm-up overhead reveal a contradiction between the principle of parallelization, i.e., speeding up long running jobs by parallelizing them into short tasks, and amortizing JVM warm-up overhead through long tasks. We solve this problem by designing HotTub, a new JVM that amortizes the warm-up overhead over the lifetime of a cluster node instead of over a single job by reusing a pool of already warm JVMs across multiple applications. The speed-up is significant. For example, using HotTub results in up to 1.8X speedups for Spark queries, despite not adhering to the JVM specification in edge cases.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 许多广泛使用的、对延迟敏感的数据并行分布式系统（如HDFS、Hive和Spark）尽管存在关于Java虚拟机（JVM）开销的争议，仍选择使用JVM。本文分析了上述系统中JVM性能开销的程度及原因。令人惊讶的是，我们发现在许多情况下预热开销（即类加载和字节码解释）是瓶颈。例如，即使是一个I/O密集型、读取1GB的HDFS操作，也有33%的执行时间花在JVM预热上，而Spark查询平均花费21秒进行预热。关于JVM预热开销的发现揭示了一个矛盾：并行化原则（即将长时间运行的作业并行化为短任务以加速）与通过长任务摊销JVM预热开销之间的矛盾。我们通过设计HotTub来解决这个问题——这是一种新的JVM，它通过跨多个应用程序重用已预热的JVM池，将预热开销摊销到集群节点的整个生命周期而不是单个作业。加速效果显著。例如，使用HotTub对Spark查询可实现最高1.8倍的加速，尽管在边缘情况下并不遵循JVM规范。

upstream_only.title: EC-cache: load-balanced, low-latency cluster caching with online erasure coding
upstream_only.abstract: Data-intensive clusters and object stores are increasingly relying on in-memory object caching to meet the I/O performance demands. These systems routinely face the challenges of popularity skew, background load imbalance, and server failures, which result in severe load imbalance across servers and degraded I/O performance. Selective replication is a commonly used technique to tackle these challenges, where the number of cached replicas of an object is proportional to its popularity. In this paper, we explore an alternative approach using erasure coding.EC-Cache is a load-balanced, low latency cluster cache that uses online erasure coding to overcome the limitations of selective replication. EC-Cache employs erasure coding by: (i) splitting and erasure coding individual objects during writes, and (ii) late binding, wherein obtaining any k out of (k + r) splits of an object are sufficient, during reads. As compared to selective replication, EC-Cache improves load balancing by more than 3\texttimes{} and reduces the median and tail read latencies by more than 2\texttimes{}, while using the same amount of memory. EC-Cache does so using 10\% additional bandwidth and a small increase in the amount of stored metadata. The benefits offered by EC-Cache are further amplified in the presence of background network load imbalance and server failures.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 数据密集型集群和对象存储越来越依赖内存对象缓存来满足I/O性能需求。这些系统经常面临流行度倾斜、后台负载不均衡和服务器故障等挑战，这些会导致服务器间严重的负载不均和I/O性能下降。选择性复制是应对这些挑战的常用技术，其中对象缓存副本的数量与其流行度成正比。本文探索了一种使用纠删码的替代方法。EC-Cache是一个负载均衡、低延迟的集群缓存，它利用在线纠删码来克服选择性复制的局限性。EC-Cache的纠删码实现方式为：(i)在写入时将单个对象拆分并纠删编码，以及(ii)采用后期绑定，即读取时只需获取对象的任意k个（共k+r个）拆分。与选择性复制相比，EC-Cache将负载均衡性提升了3倍以上，并将中位数和尾读延迟降低了2倍以上，同时使用相同的内存量。EC-Cache仅以10%的额外带宽和少量元数据存储增加为代价实现了上述优势。在存在后台网络负载不均衡和服务器故障的情况下，EC-Cache带来的好处更为显著。

upstream_only.title: To waffinity and beyond: a scalable architecture for incremental parallelization of file system code
upstream_only.abstract: In order to achieve higher I/O throughput and better overall system performance, it is necessary for commercial storage systems to fully exploit the increasing core counts on modern systems. At the same time, legacy systems with millions of lines of code cannot simply be rewritten for improved scalability. In this paper, we describe the evolution of the multiprocessor software architecture (MP model) employed by the Netapp® Data ONTAP® WAFL® file system as a case study in incrementally scaling a production storage system.The initial model is based on small-scale data partitioning, whereby user-file reads and writes to disjoint file regions are parallelized. This model is then extended with hierarchical data partitioning to manage concurrent accesses to important file system objects, thus benefiting additional workloads. Finally, we discuss a fine-grained lock-based MP model within the existing data-partitioned architecture to support workloads where data accesses do not map neatly to the predefined partitions. In these data partitioning and lock-based MP models, we have facilitated incremental advances in parallelism without a large-scale code rewrite, a major advantage in the multi-million line WAFL codebase. Our results show that we are able to increase CPU utilization by as much as 104\% on a 20-core system, resulting in throughput gains of up to 130\%. These results demonstrate the success of the proposed MP models in delivering scalable performance while balancing time-to-market requirements. The models presented can also inform scalable system redesign in other domains.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 为了获得更高的I/O吞吐量和更好的整体系统性能，商业存储系统有必要充分利用现代系统上不断增加的核心数量。与此同时，拥有数百万行代码的遗留系统不能为了改进可扩展性而被简单重写。在本文中，我们描述了NetApp® Data ONTAP® WAFL®文件系统所采用的多处理器软件架构（MP模型）的演变，作为增量扩展生产存储系统的一个案例研究。最初的模型基于小规模数据分区，即对不相交文件区域的用户文件读写进行并行化。随后，该模型通过分层数据分区进行了扩展，以管理对重要文件系统对象的并发访问，从而惠及更多工作负载。最后，我们讨论了在现有数据分区架构内的一种细粒度基于锁的MP模型，以支持数据访问不能很好地映射到预定义分区的负载。在这些数据分区和基于锁的MP模型中，我们在无需大规模代码重写的情况下实现了并行性的增量推进，这是在数百万行的WAFL代码库中的一个主要优势。我们的结果表明，在20核系统上，我们能够将CPU利用率提高多达104%，从而使吞吐量提升高达130%。这些结果证明了所提出的MP模型在提供可扩展性能的同时平衡上市时间需求方面取得了成功。所提出的模型也可以为其他领域的可扩展系统重新设计提供参考。

upstream_only.title: CLARINET: WAN-aware optimization for analytics queries
upstream_only.abstract: Recent work has made the case for geo-distributed analytics, where data collected and stored at multiple datacenters and edge sites world-wide is analyzed in situ to drive operational and management decisions. A key issue in such systems is ensuring low response times for analytics queries issued against geo-distributed data. A central determinant of response time is the query execution plan (QEP). Current query optimizers do not consider the network when deriving QEPs, which is a key drawback as the geo-distributed sites are connected via WAN links with heterogeneous and modest bandwidths, unlike intra-datacenter networks. We propose CLARINET, a novel WAN-aware query optimizer. Deriving a WAN-aware QEP requires working jointly with the execution layer of analytics frameworks that places tasks to sites and performs scheduling. We design efficient heuristic solutions in CLARINET to make such a joint decision on the QEP. Our experiments with a real prototype deployed across EC2 datacenters, and large-scale simulations using production workloads show that CLARINET improves query response times by ≥ 50\% compared to state-of-the-art WAN-aware task placement and scheduling.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 近期工作提出了地理分布式分析的用例，即对全球多个数据中心和边缘站点收集和存储的数据进行就地分析，以驱动运营和管理决策。此类系统的关键问题在于确保针对地理分布式数据发起的分析查询具有较低响应时间。响应时间的一个核心决定因素是查询执行计划（QEP）。当前的查询优化器在推导QEP时未考虑网络因素，这是一个关键缺陷，因为地理分布式站点通过异构且带宽适中的WAN链路互连，不同于数据中心内部网络。我们提出了CLARINET，一种新颖的感知WAN的查询优化器。推导感知WAN的QEP需要与分析框架的执行层协作，该执行层负责任务到站点的放置和调度。我们在CLARINET中设计了高效的启发式解决方案，以对QEP做出这种联合决策。我们在跨EC2数据中心部署的真实原型上的实验，以及使用生产工作负载的大规模模拟表明，与最先进的感知WAN的任务放置和调度相比，CLARINET将查询响应时间提高了至少50%。

upstream_only.title: JetStream: cluster-scale parallelization of information flow queries
upstream_only.abstract: Dynamic information flow tracking (DIFT) is an important tool in many domains, such as security, debugging, forensics, provenance, configuration troubleshooting, and privacy tracking. However, the usability of DIFT is currently limited by its high overhead; complex information flow queries can take up to two orders of magnitude longer to execute than the original execution of the program. This precludes interactive uses in which users iteratively refine queries to narrow down bugs, leaks of private data, or performance anomalies.JetStream applies cluster computing to parallelize and accelerate information flow queries over past executions. It uses deterministic record and replay to time slice executions into distinct contiguous chunks of execution called epochs, and it tracks information flow for each epoch on a separate core in the cluster. It structures the aggregation of information flow data from each epoch as a streaming computation. Epochs are arranged in a sequential chain from the beginning to the end of program execution; relationships to program inputs (sources) are streamed forward along the chain, and relationships to program outputs (sinks) are streamed backward. Jet-Stream is the first system to parallelize DIFT across a cluster. Our results show that JetStream queries scale to at least 128 cores over a wide range of applications. JetStream accelerates DIFT queries to run 12-48 times faster than sequential queries; in most cases, queries run faster than the original execution of the program.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 动态信息流跟踪（DIFT）是许多领域的重要工具，如安全、调试、取证、溯源、配置故障排除和隐私跟踪。然而，DIFT的可用性目前受到其高开销的限制；复杂的信息流查询可能需要比程序原始执行时间长两个数量级。这阻碍了交互式使用，即用户迭代细化查询以缩小错误、私有数据泄漏或性能异常的范围。JetStream 应用集群计算来并行化和加速对过去执行的信息流查询。它使用确定性记录和重放将执行时间切片为不同的连续执行块（称为 epoch），并在集群中的单独核心上跟踪每个 epoch 的信息流。它将来自每个 epoch 的信息流数据聚合构造成流式计算。Epoch 按从程序执行开始到结束的顺序链排列；与程序输入（源）的关系沿链向前流动，而与程序输出（汇）的关系向后流动。JetStream 是第一个在集群上并行化 DIFT 的系统。我们的结果表明，JetStream 查询在广泛的应用中可扩展到至少 128 个核心。JetStream 将 DIFT 查询加速至比顺序查询快 12-48 倍；在大多数情况下，查询运行速度比程序的原始执行更快。

upstream_only.title: Just say no to paxos overhead: replacing consensus with network ordering
upstream_only.abstract: Distributed applications use replication, implemented by protocols like Paxos, to ensure data availability and transparently mask server failures. This paper presents a new approach to achieving replication in the data center without the performance cost of traditional methods. Our work carefully divides replication responsibility between the network and protocol layers. The network orders requests but does not ensure reliable delivery - using a new primitive we call ordered unreliable multicast (OUM). Implementing this primitive can be achieved with near-zero-cost in the data center. Our new replication protocol, Network-Ordered Paxos (NOPaxos), exploits network ordering to provide strongly consistent replication without coordination. The resulting system not only outperforms both latency - and throughput-optimized protocols on their respective metrics, but also yields throughput within 2\% and latency within 16 ms of an unreplicated system - providing replication without the performance cost.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 分布式应用使用Paxos等协议实现的复制来确保数据可用性，并透明地掩盖服务器故障。本文提出了一种在数据中心内实现复制的新方法，而无需传统方法的性能开销。我们的工作将复制职责仔细地划分为网络层和协议层。网络层对请求进行排序，但不确保可靠投递——我们使用一种称为有序不可靠组播（OUM）的新原语。在数据中心中实现这一原语几乎可以零成本完成。我们的新复制协议Network-Ordered Paxos（NOPaxos）利用网络排序在没有协调的情况下提供强一致的复制。最终系统不仅在各自的指标上优于延迟优化和吞吐量优化的协议，而且相对于未复制系统，其吞吐量差距在2%以内，延迟差距在16毫秒以内——实现了复制的性能无成本化。

upstream_only.title: XFT: practical fault tolerance beyond crashes
upstream_only.abstract: Despite years of intensive research, Byzantine fault-tolerant (BFT) systems have not yet been adopted in practice. This is due to additional cost of BFT in terms of resources, protocol complexity and performance, compared with crash fault-tolerance (CFT). This overhead of BFT comes from the assumption of a powerful adversary that can fully control not only the Byzantine faulty machines, but at the same time also the message delivery schedule across the entire network, effectively inducing communication asynchrony and partitioning otherwise correct machines at will. To many practitioners, however, such strong attacks appear irrelevant.In this paper, we introduce cross fault tolerance or XFT, a novel approach to building reliable and secure distributed systems and apply it to the classical state-machine replication (SMR) problem. In short, an XFT SMR protocol provides the reliability guarantees of widely used asynchronous CFT SMR protocols such as Paxos and Raft, but also tolerates Byzantine faults in combination with network asynchrony, as long as a majority of replicas are correct and communicate synchronously. This allows the development of XFT systems at the price of CFT (already paid for in practice), yet with strictly stronger resilience than CFT -- sometimes even stronger than BFT itself.As a showcase for XFT, we present XPaxos, the first XFT SMR protocol, and deploy it in a geo-replicated setting. Although it offers much stronger resilience than CFT SMR at no extra resource cost, the performance of XPaxos matches that of the state-of-the-art CFT protocols.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 尽管经过多年深入研究，拜占庭容错系统尚未在实践中得到采用。这是因为与崩溃容错相比，拜占庭容错在资源、协议复杂度和性能方面需要额外成本。拜占庭容错的这种开销源于一个假设，即存在一个强大的对手，既能完全控制拜占庭故障机器，又能同时控制整个网络中的消息传递调度，从而有效诱导通信异步并在任意时刻分区隔离原本正确的机器。然而，在许多实践者看来，如此强大的攻击似乎并不现实。本文提出了交叉容错（cross fault tolerance，简称XFT），一种构建可靠和安全分布式系统的新方法，并将其应用于经典的状态机复制问题。简单来说，XFT SMR协议既提供了广泛使用的异步CFT SMR协议（如Paxos和Raft）的可靠性保证，又在多数副本正确且同步通信的前提下容忍拜占庭故障与网络异步的组合。这使得开发XFT系统只需付出CFT的代价（实践中已为CFT付出了代价），但获得比CFT严格更强的弹性——有时甚至比拜占庭容错本身更强。作为XFT的展示，我们提出了XPaxos，即首个XFT状态机复制协议，并将其部署在异地复制场景中。尽管XPaxos在不增加额外资源成本的情况下提供了比CFT状态机复制强得多的弹性，其性能仍与最先进的CFT协议相当。

upstream_only.title: Realizing the fault-tolerance promise of cloud storage using locks with intent
upstream_only.abstract: Cloud computing promises easy development and deployment of large-scale, fault tolerant, and highly available applications. Cloud storage services are a key enabler of this, because they provide reliability, availability, and fault tolerance via internal mechanisms that developers need not reason about. Despite this, challenges remain for distributed cloud applications developers. They still need to make their code robust against failures of the machines running the code, and to reason about concurrent access to cloud storage by multiple machines.We address this problem with a new abstraction, called locks with intent, which we implement in a client library called Olive. Olive makes minimal assumptions about the underlying cloud storage, enabling it to operate on a variety of platforms including Amazon DynamoDB and Microsoft Azure Storage. Leveraging the underlying cloud storage, Olive's locks with intent offer strong exactly-once semantics for a snippet of code despite failures and concurrent duplicate executions.To ensure exactly-once semantics, Olive incurs the unavoidable overhead of additional logging writes. However, by decoupling isolation from atomicity, it supports consistency levels ranging from eventual to transactional. This flexibility allows applications to avoid costly transactional mechanisms when weaker semantics suffice. We apply Olive's locks with intent to build several advanced storage functionalities, including snapshots, transactions via optimistic concurrency control, secondary indices, and live table re-partitioning. Our experience demonstrates that Olive eases the burden of creating correct, fault-tolerant distributed cloud applications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 云计算承诺使大规模、容错且高可用的应用易于开发和部署。云存储服务是实现这一点的关键推动者，因为它们通过内部机制提供可靠性、可用性和容错性，开发者无需理解这些机制。尽管如此，分布式云应用开发者仍面临挑战。他们仍需让自己的代码能抵抗运行代码的机器故障，并推理多台机器对云存储的并发访问。我们用一个名为“intent锁”（locks with intent）的新抽象来解决这个问题，并在一个名为Olive的客户端库中实现了它。Olive 对底层云存储作出最小假设，使其能够在包括Amazon DynamoDB和Microsoft Azure Storage在内的多种平台上运行。借助底层云存储，Olive的intent锁在故障和并发重复执行情况下，为一段代码提供强精确一次语义。为确保精确一次语义，Olive承担了额外日志写入的不可避免开销。然而，通过将隔离与原子性分离，它支持从最终一致到事务一致的各种一致性级别。这种灵活性使应用程序在较弱语义足够时避免昂贵的事务机制。我们应用Olive的intent锁构建了多个高级存储功能，包括快照、基于乐观并发控制的事务、辅助索引和实时表重分区。我们的经验表明，Olive减轻了创建正确、容错分布式云应用的负担。

upstream_only.title: Consolidating concurrency control and consensus for commits under conflicts
upstream_only.abstract: Conventional fault-tolerant distributed transactions layer a traditional concurrency control protocol on top of the Paxos consensus protocol. This approach provides scalability, availability, and strong consistency. When used for wide-area storage, however, this approach incurs cross-data-center coordination twice, in serial: once for concurrency control, and then once for consensus. In this paper, we make the key observation that the coordination required for concurrency control and consensus is highly similar. Specifically, each tries to ensure the serialization graph of transactions is acyclic. We exploit this insight in the design of Janus, a unified concurrency control and consensus protocol. Janus targets one-shot transactions written as stored procedures, a common, but restricted, class of transactions. Like MDCC [16] and TAPIR [51], Janus can commit unconflicted transactions in this class in one round-trip. Unlike MDCC and TAPIR, Janus avoids aborts due to contention: it commits conflicted transactions in this class in at most two round-trips as long as the network is well behaved and a majority of each server replica is alive.We compare Janus with layered designs and TAPIR under a variety of workloads in this class. Our evaluation shows that Janus achieves ∼5\texttimes{} the throughput of a layered system and 90\% of the throughput of TAPIR under a contention-free microbenchmark. When the workloads become contended, Janus provides much lower latency and higher throughput (up to 6:8\texttimes{}) than the baselines.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 传统的容错分布式事务在Paxos共识协议之上分层实现传统并发控制协议。这种方法提供了可扩展性、可用性和强一致性。然而，当用于广域存储时，这种方法会串行地在跨数据中心协调两次：一次用于并发控制，又一次用于共识。本文提出关键观察：并发控制和共识所需的协调高度相似。具体而言，两者都试图保证事务的序列化图是无环的。我们利用这一见解设计了Janus，一个统一的并发控制和共识协议。Janus针对以存储过程编写的一次性事务，这是一类常见但受限的事务。与MDCC和TAPIR类似，Janus可以在一次往返中提交此类别中无冲突的事务。与MDCC和TAPIR不同，Janus避免了因争用而中止：只要网络行为正常且每个服务器副本的大多数存活，它最多在两个往返内提交此类别中有冲突的事务。我们在此类别的各种工作负载下将Janus与分层设计和TAPIR进行比较。评估表明，在无争用微基准测试中，Janus达到分层系统吞吐量的约5倍，以及TAPIR吞吐量的90%。当工作负载变得有争用时，Janus比基线提供更低的延迟和更高的吞吐量（高达6.8倍）。

upstream_only.title: Ryoan: a distributed sandbox for untrusted computation on secret data
upstream_only.abstract: Users of modern data-processing services such as tax preparation or genomic screening are forced to trust them with data that the users wish to keep secret. Ryoan protects secret data while it is processed by services that the data owner does not trust. Accomplishing this goal in a distributed setting is difficult because the user has no control over the service providers or the computational platform. Confining code to prevent it from leaking secrets is notoriously difficult, but Ryoan benefits from new hardware and a request-oriented data model.Ryoan provides a distributed sandbox, leveraging hardware enclaves (e.g., Intel's software guard extensions (SGX) [15]) to protect sandbox instances from potentially malicious computing platforms. The protected sandbox instances confine untrusted data-processing modules to prevent leakage of the user's input data. Ryoan is designed for a request-oriented data model, where confined modules only process input once and do not persist state about the input. We present the design and prototype implementation of Ryoan and evaluate it on a series of challenging problems including email filtering, heath analysis, image processing and machine translation.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代数据处理服务（如税务准备或基因组筛查）的用户被迫信任这些服务处理他们希望保密的的数据。Ryoan在数据所有者不信任的服务处理秘密数据时保护这些数据。在分布式环境中实现这一目标很困难，因为用户无法控制服务提供商或计算平台。限制代码以防止其泄露秘密是众所周知的难题，但Ryoan受益于新硬件和面向请求的数据模型。Ryoan提供了一种分布式沙箱，利用硬件围圈（例如英特尔的软件保护扩展（SGX））来保护沙箱实例免受潜在恶意计算平台的侵害。受保护的沙箱实例限制不可信数据处理模块，以防止用户输入数据泄露。Ryoan专为面向请求的数据模型设计，其中受限模块仅处理一次输入，不持久化关于输入的状態。我们展示了Ryoan的设计和原型实现，并在包括电子邮件过滤、健康分析、图像处理和机器翻译在内的一系列具有挑战性的问题上对其进行了评估。

upstream_only.title: Unobservable communication over fully untrusted infrastructure
