Our extensive case studies show that DIFFPROF provides developers with actionable diagnosis beyond a traditional energy profiler: it identifies non-essential (unmatched or extra) and known-to-be inefficient (matched) tasks, and the call trees of tasks it extracts further allow developers to quickly understand the reasons and develop fixes for the energy difference with minor manual debugging efforts.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 移动应用能量剖析器通过识别应用源代码中的能量热点，提供了一种基础的能量诊断工具。然而，它们只解决了开发者面临的首要挑战，因为当面对能量热点后，开发者通常对余下的优化过程没有任何指导：(1)同一应用任务是否存在更节能的实现？(2)如何设计出更高效的实现？为了帮助开发者应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种名为差分能量剖析的新能量剖析方法，该方法利用应用商店中丰富存在的相似应用的现有实现，自动揭示常见应用任务的更高效实现。为证明其有效性，我们为Android应用实现了一个名为DIFFPROF的差分能量剖析器，并使用它剖析了来自6个流行应用类别的8组应用，每组5个相似应用。我们广泛案例研究表明，DIFFPROF提供了超越传统能量剖析器的可操作诊断：它识别出非必要（未匹配或多余）任务以及已知低效（匹配）任务，并且其提取的任务调用树能使开发者通过少量手动调试工作，快速理解能量差异的原因并制定修复方案。

upstream_only.title: wPerf: generic Off-CPU analysis to identify bottleneck waiting events
upstream_only.abstract: This paper tries to identify waiting events that limit the maximal throughput of a multi-threaded application. To achieve this goal, we not only need to understand an event's impact on threads waiting for this event (i.e., local impact), but also need to understand whether its impact can reach other threads that are involved in request processing (i.e., global impact).To address these challenges, wPerf computes the local impact of a waiting event with a technique called cascaded re-distribution; more importantly, wPerf builds a wait-for graph to compute whether such impact can indirectly reach other threads. By combining these two techniques, wPerf essentially tries to identify events with large impacts on all threads.We apply wPerf to a number of open-source multithreaded applications. By following the guide of wPerf, we are able to improve their throughput by up to 4.83\texttimes{}. The overhead of recording waiting events at runtime is about 5.1\% on average.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文试图识别限制多线程应用最大吞吐量的等待事件。为实现这一目标，我们不仅需要理解事件对等待该事件的线程的影响（即局部影响），还需要理解其影响是否能传递给参与请求处理的其他线程（即全局影响）。为应对这些挑战，wPerf 使用一种称为级联重新分配的技术来计算等待事件的局部影响；更重要的是，wPerf 构建一个等待图来计算这种影响是否能够间接地到达其他线程。通过结合这两种技术，wPerf 本质上试图识别对所有线程具有较大影响的事件。我们将 wPerf 应用于多个开源多线程应用。遵循 wPerf 的指引，我们能够将其吞吐量提升最高达 4.83 倍。运行时记录等待事件的平均开销约为 5.1%。

upstream_only.title: Sledgehammer: cluster-fueled debugging
upstream_only.abstract: Current debugging tools force developers to choose between power and interactivity. Interactive debuggers such as gdb let them quickly inspect application state and monitor execution, which is perfect for simple bugs. However, they are not powerful enough for complex bugs such as wild stores and synchronization errors where developers do not know which values to inspect or when to monitor the execution. So, developers add logging, insert timing measurements, and create functions that verify invariants. Then, they re-run applications with this instrumentation. These powerful tools are, unfortunately, not interactive; they can take minutes or hours to answer one question about a complex execution, and debugging involves asking and answering many such questions.In this paper, we propose cluster-fueled debugging, which provides interactivity for powerful debugging tools by parallelizing their work across many cores in a cluster. At sufficient scale, developers can get answers to even detailed queries in a few seconds. Sledgehammer is a cluster-fueled debugger: it improves performance by timeslicing program execution, debug instrumentation, and analysis of results, and then executing each chunk of work on a separate core. Sledgehammer enables powerful, interactive debugging tools that are infeasible today. Parallel retro-logging allows developers to change their logging instrumentation and then quickly see what the new logging would have produced on a previous execution. Continuous function evaluation logically evaluates a function such as a data-structure integrity check at every point in a program's execution. Retro-timing allows fast performance analysis of a previous execution. With 1024 cores, Sledgehammer executes these tools hundreds of times faster than single-core execution while returning identical results.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 当前的调试工具迫使开发者在功能和交互性之间做出选择。交互式调试器（如gdb）允许他们快速检查应用程序状态并监控执行过程，这对于简单缺陷非常理想。然而，它们对于复杂缺陷（如野指针存储和同步错误）不够强大，因为开发者不知道要检查哪些值或何时监控执行。因此，开发者会添加日志、插入时间测量、创建验证不变量的函数，然后使用这些插桩重新运行应用程序。不幸的是，这些强大的工具不具备交互性；它们可能需要几分钟或几小时来回答关于一次复杂执行的一个问题，而调试涉及提出和回答许多此类问题。在本文中，我们提出了集群驱动的调试，通过将强大的调试工具的工作在集群中的多个核心上并行化来提供交互性。在足够规模下，开发者甚至可以在几秒钟内获得详细查询的答案。Sledgehammer是一个集群驱动的调试器：它通过将程序执行、调试插桩和结果分析进行时间切片，然后在单独的核心上执行每个工作块来提升性能。Sledgehammer使得目前不可行的强大交互式调试工具成为可能。并行回溯日志允许开发者更改其日志插桩，然后快速查看在新日志条件下先前执行会产生什么结果。连续函数评估在程序执行的每个点逻辑上评估函数（如数据结构完整性检查）。回溯计时允许对先前执行进行快速性能分析。使用1024个核心，Sledgehammer执行这些工具的速度比单核执行快数百倍，同时返回相同的结果。

upstream_only.title: Ray: a distributed framework for emerging AI applications
upstream_only.abstract: The next generation of AI applications will continuously interact with the environment and learn from these interactions. These applications impose new and demanding systems requirements, both in terms of performance and flexibility. In this paper, we consider these requirements and present Ray--a distributed system to address them. Ray implements a unified interface that can express both task-parallel and actor-based computations, supported by a single dynamic execution engine. To meet the performance requirements, Ray employs a distributed scheduler and a distributed and fault-tolerant store to manage the system's control state. In our experiments, we demonstrate scaling beyond 1.8 million tasks per second and better performance than existing specialized systems for several challenging reinforcement learning applications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 下一代AI应用将不断与环境交互，并从这些交互中学习。这些应用在性能和灵活性方面带来了新的、高要求的系统需求。本文考虑了这些需求，并提出了Ray——一个解决这些需求的分布式系统。Ray实现了统一的接口，能够表达基于任务并行和基于角色的计算，并由一个动态执行引擎支持。为了满足性能要求，Ray采用了分布式调度器以及一个分布式且容错的状态存储。在我们的实验中，我们证明了其扩展能力超过每秒180万个任务，并且在几个具有挑战性的强化学习应用中，性能优于现有专门系统。

upstream_only.title: TVM: an automated end-to-end optimizing compiler for deep learning
upstream_only.abstract: There is an increasing need to bring machine learning to a wide diversity of hardware devices. Current frameworks rely on vendor-specific operator libraries and optimize for a narrow range of server-class GPUs. Deploying workloads to new platforms - such as mobile phones, embedded devices, and accelerators (e.g., FPGAs, ASICs) - requires significant manual effort. We propose TVM, a compiler that exposes graph-level and operator-level optimizations to provide performance portability to deep learning workloads across diverse hardware back-ends. TVM solves optimization challenges specific to deep learning, such as high-level operator fusion, mapping to arbitrary hardware primitives, and memory latency hiding. It also automates optimization of low-level programs to hardware characteristics by employing a novel, learning-based cost modeling method for rapid exploration of code optimizations. Experimental results show that TVM delivers performance across hardware back-ends that are competitive with state-of-the-art, hand-tuned libraries for low-power CPU, mobile GPU, and server-class GPUs. We also demonstrate TVM's ability to target new accelerator back-ends, such as the FPGA-based generic deep learning accelerator. The system is open sourced and in production use inside several major companies.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 将机器学习应用于各种各样的硬件设备的需求日益增长。当前框架依赖供应商特定的算子库，并针对有限的服务器级GPU进行优化。将工作负载部署到新平台——如手机、嵌入式设备和加速器（例如FPGA、ASIC）——需要大量人工努力。我们提出了TVM，一个编译器，它暴露图级和算子级优化，为跨不同硬件后端的深度学习工作负载提供性能可移植性。TVM解决了深度学习特有的优化挑战，如高级算子融合、映射到任意硬件原语以及内存延迟隐藏。它还通过采用新颖的基于学习的成本建模方法来自动优化低级程序以适应硬件特性，从而快速探索代码优化。实验结果表明，TVM在低功耗CPU、移动GPU和服务器级GPU等硬件后端上提供的性能与最先进的手动调优库相当。我们还展示了TVM针对新加速器后端（如基于FPGA的通用深度学习加速器）的能力。该系统已开源，并在多家主要公司中投入生产使用。

upstream_only.title: Gandiva: introspective cluster scheduling for deep learning
upstream_only.abstract: We introduce Gandiva, a new cluster scheduling framework that utilizes domain-specific knowledge to improve latency and efficiency of training deep learning models in a GPU cluster.One key characteristic of deep learning is feedback-driven exploration, where a user often runs a set of jobs (or a multi-job) to achieve the best result for a specific mission and uses early feedback on accuracy to dynamically prioritize or kill a subset of jobs; simultaneous early feedback on the entire multi-job is critical. A second characteristic is the heterogeneity of deep learning jobs in terms of resource usage, making it hard to achieve best-fit a priori. Gandiva addresses these two challenges by exploiting a third key characteristic of deep learning: intra-job predictability, as they perform numerous repetitive iterations called mini-batch iterations. Gandiva exploits intra-job predictability to time-slice GPUs efficiently across multiple jobs, thereby delivering low-latency. This predictability is also used for introspecting job performance and dynamically migrating jobs to better-fit GPUs, thereby improving cluster efficiency.We show via a prototype implementation and micro-benchmarks that Gandiva can speed up hyper-parameter searches during deep learning by up to an order of magnitude, and achieves better utilization by transparently migrating and time-slicing jobs to achieve better job-to-resource fit. We also show that, in a real workload of jobs running in a 180-GPU cluster, Gandiva improves aggregate cluster utilization by 26\%, pointing to a new way of managing large GPU clusters for deep learning.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们介绍了Gandiva，一种新的集群调度框架，它利用领域特定知识来提高在GPU集群中训练深度学习模型的延迟和效率。深度学习的一个关键特征是反馈驱动的探索，用户通常运行一组作业（或多作业）以针对特定任务达到最佳结果，并利用对准确性的早期反馈动态优先或终止部分作业；整个多作业的同步早期反馈至关重要。第二个特征是深度学习作业在资源使用方面具有异构性，使得难以先验地实现最佳匹配。Gandiva通过利用深度学习的第三个关键特征解决这两个挑战：作业内可预测性，因为它们执行大量重复的迭代，称为小批量迭代。Gandiva利用作业内可预测性来有效地跨多个作业对GPU进行时间切片，从而提供低延迟。这种可预测性也用于内省作业性能和动态迁移作业以更好地匹配GPU，从而提高集群效率。我们通过原型和微基准测试表明，Gandiva可以在深度学习超参数搜索期间将其加速最多一个数量级，并通过透明地迁移和时间切片作业来获得更好的作业-资源匹配，从而获得更高的利用率。我们还表明，在180个GPU集群中运行的真实工作负载中，Gandiva将总体集群利用率提高了26%，指向了一种为深度学习管理大型GPU集群的新方式。

upstream_only.title: Pretzel: opening the black box of machine learning prediction serving systems
upstream_only.abstract: Machine Learning models are often composed of pipelines of transformations. While this design allows to efficiently execute single model components at training-time, prediction serving has different requirements such as low latency, high throughput and graceful performance degradation under heavy load. Current prediction serving systems consider models as black boxes, whereby prediction-time-specific optimizations are ignored in favor of ease of deployment. In this paper, we present PRETZEL, a prediction serving system introducing a novel white box architecture enabling both end-to-end and multi-model optimizations. Using production-like model pipelines, our experiments show that PRETZEL is able to introduce performance improvements over different dimensions; compared to state-of-the-art approaches PRETZEL is on average able to reduce 99th percentile latency by 5.5\texttimes{} while reducing memory footprint by 25\texttimes{}, and increasing throughput by 4.7\texttimes{}.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 机器学习模型通常由一系列转换管道组成。虽然这种设计能够在训练时高效执行单个模型组件，但预测服务有不同的需求，如低延迟、高吞吐量以及在重负载下优雅的性能降级。当前的预测服务系统将模型视为黑箱，偏向于易于部署而忽略了预测时特有的优化。在本文中，我们提出了PRETZEL，一个预测服务系统，引入了新颖的白盒架构，能够实现端到端和多模型优化。使用类似生产环境的模型管道，我们的实验表明，PRETZEL能够在不同维度上带来性能改进；与最先进的方法相比，PRETZEL平均能够将第99百分位延迟降低5.5倍，内存占用减少25倍，吞吐量提高4.7倍。

upstream_only.title: Splinter: bare-metal extensions for multi-tenant low-latency storage
upstream_only.abstract: In-memory key-value stores that use kernel-bypass networking serve millions of operations per second per machine with microseconds of latency. They are fast in part because they are simple, but their simple interfaces force applications to move data across the network. This is inefficient for operations that aggregate over large amounts of data, and it causes delays when traversing complex data structures. Ideally, applications could push small functions to storage to avoid round trips and data movement; however, pushing code to these fast systems is challenging. Any extra complexity for interpreting or isolating code cuts into their latency and throughput benefits.We present Splinter, a low-latency key-value store that clients extend by pushing code to it. Splinter is designed for modern multi-tenant data centers; it allows mutually distrusting tenants to write their own fine-grained extensions and push them to the store at runtime. The core of Splinter's design relies on type- and memory-safe extension code to avoid conventional hardware isolation costs. This still allows for bare-metal execution, avoids data copying across trust boundaries, and makes granular storage functions that perform less than a microsecond of compute practical. Our measurements show that Splinter can process 3.5 million remote extension invocations per second with a median round-trip latency of less than 9 µs at densities of more than 1,000 tenants per server. We provide an implementation of Facebook's TAO as an 800 line extension that, when pushed to a Splinter server, improves performance by 400 Kop/s to perform 3.2 Mop/s over online graph data with 30 µs remote access times.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 使用内核旁路网络的内存键值存储每台机器每秒可处理数百万次操作，延迟为微秒级。它们之所以快，部分原因在于其简单性，但简单的接口迫使应用程序跨网络移动数据。对于需要对大量数据进行聚合的操作来说，这种方式效率低下，并且在遍历复杂数据结构时会造成延迟。理想情况下，应用程序可以将小型函数推送到存储端，以避免往返和数据移动。然而，将代码推送到这些快速系统具有挑战性。任何用于解释或隔离代码的额外复杂性都会削弱其延迟和吞吐量优势。我们提出了Splinter，一种低延迟键值存储，客户端可通过向其推送代码进行扩展。Splinter专为现代多租户数据中心设计；它允许互不信任的租户编写自己的细粒度扩展并在运行时将其推送到存储。Splinter设计的核心依赖于类型安全和内存安全的扩展代码，以避免传统的硬件隔离成本。这仍然可以实现裸机执行，避免跨信任边界的数据复制，并使计算量小于一微秒的细粒度存储功能成为现实。我们的测量表明，Splinter在每台服务器超过1000个租户的密度下，每秒可处理350万次远程扩展调用，中位往返延迟低于9微秒。我们实现了Facebook TAO作为800行扩展，当推送到Splinter服务器时，其性能提升了400 Kop/s，在在线图数据上达到320万次操作/秒，远程访问时间为30微秒。

upstream_only.title: Neural adaptive content-aware internet video delivery
upstream_only.abstract: Internet video streaming has experienced tremendous growth over the last few decades. However, the quality of existing video delivery critically depends on the bandwidth resource. Consequently, user quality of experience (QoE) suffers inevitably when network conditions become unfavorable. We present a new video delivery framework that utilizes client computation and recent advances in deep neural networks (DNNs) to reduce the dependency for delivering high-quality video. The use of DNNs enables us to enhance the video quality independent to the available bandwidth. We design a practical system that addresses several challenges, such as client heterogeneity, interaction with bitrate adaptation, and DNN transfer, in enabling the idea. Our evaluation using 3G and broadband network traces shows the proposed system outperforms the current state of the art, enhancing the average QoE by 43.08\% using the same bandwidth budget or saving 17.13\% of bandwidth while providing the same user QoE.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在过去的几十年里，互联网视频流媒体经历了巨大的增长。然而，现有视频传输的质量严重依赖于带宽资源。因此，当网络条件不利时，用户体验质量（QoE）不可避免地会受到影响。我们提出了一种新的视频传输框架，利用客户端计算和深度神经网络（DNN）的最新进展来减少对传输高质量视频的依赖。DNN的使用使我们能够独立于可用带宽来提升视频质量。我们设计了一个实用系统，解决了实现这一理念的若干挑战，例如客户端异构性、与码率自适应的交互以及DNN迁移。我们使用3G和宽带网络轨迹进行的评估表明，所提出的系统优于当前最先进的系统，在相同带宽预算下将平均QoE提高了43.08%，或者在提供相同用户QoE的同时节省了17.13%的带宽。

upstream_only.title: Floem: a programming system for NIC-accelerated network applications
upstream_only.abstract: Developing server applications that offload computation to a NIC accelerator is complex and laborious. Developers have to explore the design space, which includes semantic changes for different offloading strategies, as well as variations on parallelization, program-to-resource mapping, and communication strategies for program components across devices.We therefore design FLOEM -- a language, compiler, and runtime -- for programming NIC-accelerated applications. FLOEM enables offload design exploration by providing programming abstractions to assign computation to hardware resources; control mapping of logical queues to physical queues; access fields of a packet and its metadata without manually marshaling a packet; use a NIC to memoize expensive computation; and interface with an external application. The compiler infers which data must be transferred between the CPU and NIC and generates a complete cache implementation, while the runtime transparently optimizes DMA throughput. We use FLOEM to explore NIC-offloading designs of real-world applications, including a key-value store and a distributed real-time data analytics system; improve their throughput by 1.3-3.6\texttimes{} and by 75-96\%, respectively, over a CPU-only implementation.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 开发将计算卸载到NIC加速器的服务器应用是复杂且费力的。开发人员必须探索设计空间，包括不同卸载策略的语义变化，以及并行化、程序到资源映射和跨设备程序组件通信策略的变化。因此，我们设计了FLOEM——一种用于编程NIC加速应用的语言、编译器和运行时。FLOEM通过提供编程抽象来实现卸载设计探索：将计算分配给硬件资源；控制逻辑队列到物理队列的映射；访问数据包及其元数据字段而无需手动封包；使用NIC对昂贵计算进行记忆化；以及与外部应用接口。编译器推断CPU与NIC之间需要传输的数据并生成完整的缓存实现，而运行时则透明地优化DMA吞吐量。我们使用FLOEM来探索实际应用的NIC卸载设计，包括一个键值存储和一个分布式实时数据分析系统；与仅使用CPU的实现相比，其吞吐量分别提升了1.3-3.6倍和75-96%。

upstream_only.title: Graviton: trusted execution environments on GPUs
upstream_only.abstract: We propose Graviton, an architecture for supporting trusted execution environments on GPUs. Graviton enables applications to offload security- and performance-sensitive kernels and data to a GPU, and execute kernels in isolation from other code running on the GPU and all software on the host, including the device driver, the operating system, and the hypervisor. Graviton can be integrated into existing GPUs with relatively low hardware complexity; all changes are restricted to peripheral components, such as the GPU's command processor, with no changes to existing CPUs, GPU cores, or the GPU's MMU and memory controller. We also propose extensions to the CUDA runtime for securely copying data and executing kernels on the GPU. We have implemented Graviton on off-the-shelf NVIDIA GPUs, using emulation for new hardware features. Our evaluation shows that overheads are low (17-33\%) with encryption and decryption of traffic to and from the GPU being the main source of overheads.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出Graviton，一种支持GPU上可信执行环境的架构。Graviton使应用程序能够将安全和性能敏感的核函数与数据卸载到GPU，并在与其他在GPU上运行的代码以及主机上所有软件（包括设备驱动程序、操作系统和虚拟机监视器）隔离的环境中执行核函数。Graviton可以以相对较低的硬件复杂度集成到现有GPU中；所有更改都限制在外围组件，如GPU的命令处理器，无需更改现有CPU、GPU核心或GPU的MMU和内存控制器。我们还提出了对CUDA运行时的扩展，用于在GPU上安全地复制数据和执行核函数。我们已经使用仿真新硬件特性的方法，在现成的NVIDIA GPU上实现了Graviton。我们的评估表明，开销较低（17-33%），主要开销来源是与GPU之间传输数据的加解密。

upstream_only.title: ZebRAM: comprehensive and compatible software protection against rowhammer attacks
upstream_only.abstract: The Rowhammer vulnerability common to many modern DRAM chips allows attackers to trigger bit flips in a row of memory cells by accessing the adjacent rows at high frequencies. As a result, they are able to corrupt sensitive data structures (such as page tables, cryptographic keys, object pointers, or even instructions in a program), and circumvent all existing defenses.This paper introduces ZebRAM, a novel and comprehensive software-level protection against Rowhammer. ZebRAM isolates every DRAM row that contains data with guard rows that absorb any Rowhammer-induced bit flips; the only known method to protect against all forms of Rowhammer. Rather than leaving guard rows unused, ZebRAM improves performance by using the guard rows as efficient, integrity-checked and optionally compressed swap space. ZebRAM requires no hardware modifications and builds on virtualization extensions in commodity processors to transparently control data placement in DRAM. Our evaluation shows that ZebRAM provides strong security guarantees while utilizing all available memory.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Rowhammer漏洞常见于许多现代DRAM芯片，它允许攻击者通过高频访问相邻行来触发内存单元行中的位翻转。因此，攻击者能够破坏敏感的数据结构（例如页表、加密密钥、对象指针，甚至程序中的指令），并绕过所有现有防御。本文介绍了ZebRAM，一种新颖且全面的软件级Rowhammer防护方法。ZebRAM将包含数据的每个DRAM行与守卫行隔离，这些守卫行会吸收任何Rowhammer引起的位翻转；这是已知的抵御所有形式Rowhammer的唯一方法。ZebRAM并非闲置守卫行，而是将守卫行用作高效、经过完整性检查且可选压缩的交换空间，从而提高性能。ZebRAM不需要硬件修改，并利用商用处理器中的虚拟化扩展，透明地控制DRAM中的数据放置。我们的评估表明，ZebRAM在利用所有可用内存的同时提供了强大的安全保证。

upstream_only.title: Karaoke: distributed private messaging immune to passive traffic analysis
upstream_only.abstract: Karaoke is a system for low-latency metadata-private communication. Karaoke provides differential privacy guarantees, and scales better with the number of users than prior such systems (Vuvuzela and Stadium). Karaoke achieves high performance by addressing two challenges faced by prior systems. The first is that differential privacy requires continuously adding noise messages, which leads to high overheads. Karaoke avoids this using optimistic indistinguishability: in the common case, Karaoke reveals no information to the adversary, and Karaoke clients can detect precisely when information may be revealed (thus requiring less noise). The second challenge lies in generating sufficient noise in a distributed system where some nodes may be malicious. Prior work either required each server to generate enough noise on its own, or used expensive verifiable shuffles to prevent any message loss. Karaoke achieves high performance using efficient noise verification, generating noise across many servers and using Bloom filters to efficiently check if any noise messages have been discarded. These techniques allow our prototype of Karaoke to achieve a latency of 6.8 seconds for 2M users. Overall, Karaoke's latency is 5\texttimes{} to 10\texttimes{} better than Vuvuzela and Stadium.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Karaoke是一种用于低延迟、元数据私密通信的系统。Karaoke提供差分隐私保证，并且比先前的此类系统（Vuvuzela和Stadium）具有更好的用户规模扩展性。Karaoke通过解决先前系统面临的两个挑战来实现高性能。第一个挑战是差分隐私需要持续添加噪声消息，这会导致高开销。Karaoke使用乐观不可区分性来避免这一开销：在常见情况下，Karaoke不会向对手泄露任何信息，并且Karaoke客户端可以精确检测何时可能泄露信息（因此需要更少的噪声）。第二个挑战在于如何在某些节点可能恶意的分布式系统中生成足够的噪声。先前的工作要么要求每个服务器自行生成足够的噪声，要么使用昂贵的可验证洗牌来防止任何消息丢失。Karaoke通过高效的噪声验证实现高性能，即跨多个服务器生成噪声，并使用布隆过滤器有效检查是否有噪声消息被丢弃。这些技术使我们的Karaoke原型在200万用户下实现了6.8秒的延迟。总体而言，Karaoke的延迟比Vuvuzela和Stadium好5到10倍。

upstream_only.title: Obladi: oblivious serializable transactions in the cloud
upstream_only.abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of Obladi, the first system to provide ACID transactions while also hiding access patterns. Obladi uses as its building block oblivious RAM, but turns the demands of supporting transactions into a performance opportunity. By executing transactions within epochs and delaying commit decisions until an epoch ends, Obladi reduces the amortized bandwidth costs of oblivious storage and increases overall system throughput. These performance gains, combined with new oblivious mechanisms for concurrency control and recovery, allow Obladi to execute OLTP workloads with reasonable throughput: it comes within 5\texttimes{} to 12\texttimes{} of a non-oblivious baseline on the TPC-C, SmallBank, and FreeHealth applications. Latency overheads, however, are higher (70\texttimes{} on TPC-C).
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了Obladi的设计与实现，这是第一个在隐藏访问模式的同时提供ACID事务的系统。Obladi以不经意RAM（ORAM）为构建模块，但将支持事务的需求转化为性能机会。通过在时间段内执行事务并延迟提交决定至时间段结束，Obladi降低了隐晦存储的摊销带宽成本并提高了整体系统吞吐量。这些性能提升，加上用于并发控制和恢复的新隐晦机制，使Obladi能够以合理的吞吐量执行OLTP工作负载：在TPC-C、SmallBank和FreeHealth应用中，其吞吐量达到非隐晦基线的5到12倍之内。然而，延迟开销更高（TPC-C上为70倍）。

upstream_only.title: ASAP: fast, approximate graph pattern mining at scale
upstream_only.abstract: While there has been a tremendous interest in processing data that has an underlying graph structure, existing distributed graph processing systems take several minutes or even hours to mine simple patterns on graphs. This paper presents ASAP, a fast, approximate computation engine for graph pattern mining. ASAP leverages state-of-the-art results in graph approximation theory, and extends it to general graph patterns in distributed settings. To enable the users to navigate the tradeoff between the result accuracy and latency, we propose a novel approach to build the Error-Latency Profile (ELP) for a given computation. We have implemented ASAP on a general-purpose distributed dataflow platform and evaluated it extensively on several graph patterns. Our experimental results show that ASAP outperforms existing exact pattern mining solutions by up to 77\texttimes{}. Further, ASAP can scale to graphs with billions of edges without the need for large clusters.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 虽然人们对处理具有底层图结构的数据有了极大的兴趣，但现有的分布式图处理系统需要几分钟甚至几小时才能在图上挖掘简单模式。本文提出了ASAP，一个用于图模式挖掘的快速近似计算引擎。ASAP利用了图近似理论的最新成果，并将其扩展到分布式环境中的一般图模式。为了使用户能够在结果准确性和延迟之间进行权衡，我们提出了一种新颖的方法来为给定计算构建误差-延迟轮廓（ELP）。我们在通用分布式数据流平台上实现了ASAP，并在多个图模式上进行了广泛评估。实验结果表明，ASAP比现有精确模式挖掘解决方案快最多77倍。此外，ASAP可以扩展到具有数十亿条边的图，而无需大型集群。

upstream_only.title: RStream: marrying relational algebra with streaming for efficient graph mining on a single machine
upstream_only.abstract: Graph mining is an important category of graph algorithms that aim to discover structural patterns such as cliques and motifs in a graph. While a great deal of work has been done recently on graph computation such as PageRank, systems support for scalable graph mining is still limited. Existing mining systems such as Arabesque focus on distributed computing and need large amounts of compute and memory resources.We built RStream, the first single-machine, out-of-core mining system that leverages disk support to store intermediate data. At its core are two innovations: (1) a rich programming model that exposes relational algebra for developers to express a wide variety of mining tasks; and (2) a runtime engine that implements relational algebra efficiently with tuple streaming. A comparison between RStream and four state-of-the-art distributed mining/Datalog systems--Arabesque, ScaleMine, DistGraph, and BigDatalog -- demonstrates that RStream outperforms all of them, running on a 10-node cluster, e.g., by at least a factor of 1.7\texttimes{}, and can process large graphs on an inexpensive machine.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 图挖掘是图算法中的一个重要类别，旨在发现图中的结构模式，如团和模体。尽管近期在图计算（如PageRank）方面已有大量工作，但对可扩展图挖掘的系统支持仍然有限。现有的挖掘系统如Arabesque侧重于分布式计算，需要大量的计算和内存资源。我们构建了RStream，这是首个单机、外核挖掘系统，利用磁盘支持来存储中间数据。其核心有两个创新：（1）一个丰富的编程模型，暴露关系代数，使开发人员能够表达各种挖掘任务；（2）一个运行时引擎，通过元组流高效地实现关系代数。RStream与四个最先进的分布式挖掘/Datalog系统（Arabesque、ScaleMine、DistGraph和BigDatalog）的比较表明，RStream在10节点集群上运行时性能优于所有这些系统，例如至少达到1.7倍的提升，并且可以在廉价的机器上处理大型图。

upstream_only.title: Three steps is all you need: fast, accurate, automatic scaling decisions for distributed streaming dataflows
upstream_only.abstract: Streaming computations are by nature long-running, and their workloads can change in unpredictable ways. This in turn means that maintaining performance may require dynamic scaling of allocated computational resources.Some modern large-scale stream processors allow dynamic scaling but typically leave the difficult task of deciding how much to scale to the user. The process is cumbersome, slow and often inefficient. Where automatic scaling is supported, policies rely on coarse-grained metrics like observed throughput, backpressure, and CPU utilization. As a result, they tend to show incorrect provisioning, oscillations, and long convergence times.We present DS2, an automatic scaling controller for such systems which combines a general performance model of streaming dataflows with lightweight instrumentation to estimate the true processing and output rates of individual dataflow operators.We apply DS2 on Apache Flink and Timely Dataflow and demonstrate its accuracy and fast convergence. When compared to Dhalion, the state-of-the-art technique in Heron, DS2 converges to the optimal, backpressure-free configuration in a single step instead of six.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 流式计算本质上长期运行，其工作负载可能以不可预测的方式变化。这反过来意味着，维持性能可能需要动态调整所分配的计算资源。一些现代大规模流处理器支持动态伸缩，但通常将决定需要伸缩多少的困难任务交给用户。这个过程繁琐、缓慢且往往低效。在支持自动伸缩的地方，策略依赖于粗粒度的指标，如观测到的吞吐量、背压和CPU利用率。因此，它们往往表现出错误的资源配置、振荡和较长的收敛时间。我们提出DS2，一种用于此类系统的自动伸缩控制器，它将流数据流的通用性能模型与轻量级插桩相结合，以估算各个数据流算子的真实处理速率和输出速率。我们将DS2应用于Apache Flink和Timely Dataflow，并展示了其准确性和快速收敛性。与Heron中最先进的技术Dhalion相比，DS2能在一步而非六步内收敛到最优的、无背压的配置。

upstream_only.title: Flare: optimizing apache spark with native compilation for scale-up architectures and medium-size data
upstream_only.abstract: In recent years, Apache Spark has become the de facto standard for big data processing. Spark has enabled a wide audience of users to process petabyte-scale workloads due to its flexibility and ease of use: users are able to mix SQL-style relational queries with Scala or Python code, and have the resultant programs distributed across an entire cluster, all without having to work with low-level parallelization or network primitives.However, many workloads of practical importance are not large enough to justify distributed, scale-out execution, as the data may reside entirely in main memory of a single powerful server. Still, users want to use Spark for its familiar interface and tooling. In such scale-up scenarios, Spark's performance is suboptimal, as Spark prioritizes handling data size over optimizing the computations on that data. For such medium-size workloads, performance may still be of critical importance if jobs are computationally heavy, need to be run frequently on changing data, or interface with external libraries and systems (e.g., TensorFlow for machine learning).We present Flare, an accelerator module for Spark that delivers order of magnitude speedups on scale-up architectures for a large class of applications. Inspired by query compilation techniques from main-memory database systems, Flare incorporates a code generation strategy designed to match the unique aspects of Spark and the characteristics of scale-up architectures, in particular processing data directly from optimized file formats and combining SQL-style relational processing with external frameworks such as TensorFlow.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 近年来，Apache Spark已成为大数据处理的实际标准。Spark凭借其灵活性和易用性，使广大用户能够处理PB级工作负载：用户可以混合使用SQL风格的关系查询与Scala或Python代码，并让生成的程序分布在整个集群中，而无需接触底层的并行化或网络原语。然而，许多具有实际重要性的工作负载规模并不足以证明分布式横向扩展执行的合理性，因为数据可能完全驻留在单个强大服务器的主内存中。尽管如此，用户仍希望使用Spark，因为它提供了熟悉的界面和工具。在这种纵向扩展场景下，Spark的性能并不理想，因为Spark优先考虑处理数据规模，而不是优化对该数据的计算。对于此类中型工作负载，如果任务计算量大、需要在变化的数据上频繁运行，或需要与外部库和系统（例如用于机器学习的TensorFlow）交互，性能可能仍然至关重要。我们提出了Flare，这是Spark的一个加速模块，可在纵向扩展架构上为一类广泛的应用程序实现数量级的加速。受主内存数据库系统中的查询编译技术的启发，Flare引入了一种代码生成策略，旨在匹配Spark的独特方面和纵向扩展架构的特征，特别是直接从优化的文件格式处理数据，并将SQL风格的关系处理与TensorFlow等外部框架相结合。

upstream_only.title: Theseus: an experiment in operating system structure and state management
upstream_only.abstract: This paper describes an operating system (OS) called Theseus. Theseus is the result of multi-year experimentation to redesign and improve OS modularity by reducing the states one component holds for another, and to leverage a safe programming language, namely Rust, to shift as many OS responsibilities as possible to the compiler.Theseus embodies two primary contributions. First, an OS structure in which many tiny components with clearly-defined, runtime-persistent bounds interact without holding states for each other. Second, an intralingual approach that realizes the OS itself using language-level mechanisms such that the compiler can enforce invariants about OS semantics.Theseus's structure, intralingual design, and state management realize live evolution and fault recovery for core OS components in ways beyond that of existing works.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文描述了一个名为Theseus的操作系统。Theseus是多年实验的成果，旨在通过减少组件之间相互持有的状态来重新设计和改进操作系统的模块化，并利用Rust这一安全编程语言，尽可能将操作系统职责转移给编译器。Theseus有两个主要贡献：第一，一种操作系统结构，其中许多具有清晰定义、运行时持久边界的微小组件在不为彼此持有状态的情况下进行交互；第二，一种语言内方法，利用语言级机制实现操作系统本身，使编译器能够强制执行有关操作系统语义的不变量。Theseus的结构、语言内设计和状态管理在实时演化和核心操作系统组件故障恢复方面超越了现有工作。

upstream_only.title: RedLeaf: isolation and communication in a safe operating system
upstream_only.abstract: RedLeaf is a new operating system developed from scratch in Rust to explore the impact of language safety on operating system organization. In contrast to commodity systems, RedLeaf does not rely on hardware address spaces for isolation and instead uses only type and memory safety of the Rust language. Departure from costly hardware isolation mechanisms allows us to explore the design space of systems that embrace lightweight fine-grained isolation. We develop a new abstraction of a lightweight language-based isolation domain that provides a unit of information hiding and fault isolation. Domains can be dynamically loaded and cleanly terminated, i.e., errors in one domain do not affect the execution of other domains. Building on RedLeaf isolation mechanisms, we demonstrate the possibility to implement end-to-end zero-copy, fault isolation, and transparent recovery of device drivers. To evaluate the practicality of RedLeaf abstractions, we implement Rv6, a POSIX-subset operating system as a collection of RedLeaf domains. Finally, to demonstrate that Rust and fine-grained isolation are practical--we develop efficient versions of a 10Gbps Intel ixgbe network and NVMe solid-state disk device drivers that match the performance of the fastest DPDK and SPDK equivalents.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: RedLeaf 是一个用 Rust 从零开始开发的新操作系统，旨在探索语言安全对操作系统组织方式的影响。与传统系统不同，RedLeaf 不依赖硬件地址空间进行隔离，而仅使用 Rust 语言的类型安全和内存安全。放弃代价高昂的硬件隔离机制，使我们能够探索采用轻量级细粒度隔离的系统的设计空间。我们开发了一种新的轻量级基于语言的隔离域抽象，它提供了信息隐藏和故障隔离的单元。域可以动态加载并被干净地终止，即一个域中的错误不会影响其他域的执行。基于 RedLeaf 的隔离机制，我们展示了实现端到端零拷贝、故障隔离和设备驱动透明恢复的可能性。为评估 RedLeaf 抽象的实际可行性，我们实现了 Rv6——一个由 RedLeaf 域集合构成的 POSIX 子集操作系统。最后，为证明 Rust 和细粒度隔离的实用性，我们开发了高效的 10Gbps Intel ixgbe 网络设备驱动和 NVMe 固态硬盘驱动，其性能与最快的 DPDK 和 SPDK 等价实现相当。

upstream_only.title: Specification and verification in the field: applying formal methods to BPF just-in-time compilers in the Linux kernel
upstream_only.abstract: This paper describes our experience applying formal methods to a critical component in the Linux kernel, the just-in-time compilers ("JITs") for the Berkeley Packet Filter (BPF) virtual machine. We verify these JITs using Jitterbug, the first framework to provide a precise specification of JIT correctness that is capable of ruling out real-world bugs, and an automated proof strategy that scales to practical implementations. Using Jitterbug, we have designed, implemented, and verified a new BPF JIT for 32-bit RISC-V, found and fixed 16 previously unknown bugs in five other deployed JITs, and developed new JIT optimizations; all of these changes have been upstreamed to the Linux kernel. The results show that it is possible to build a verified component within a large, unverified system with careful design of specification and proof strategy.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文描述了我们将形式化方法应用于Linux内核中的一个关键组件——伯克利包过滤器（BPF）虚拟机的即时编译器（JIT）——的经验。我们使用Jitterbug来验证这些JIT。Jitterbug是第一个为JIT正确性提供精确规范、能够排除真实世界漏洞，并提供可扩展至实际实现的自动化证明策略的框架。利用Jitterbug，我们设计、实现并验证了一个针对32位RISC-V的新型BPF JIT，在另外五个已部署的JIT中发现并修复了16个先前未知的漏洞，并开发了新的JIT优化；所有这些改动都已被合入Linux内核上游。结果表明，通过仔细设计规范和证明策略，可以在一个大型非验证系统中构建经过验证的组件。

upstream_only.title: COBRA: making transactional key-value stores verifiably serializable
upstream_only.abstract: Today's cloud databases offer strong properties, including serializability, sometimes called the gold standard database correctness property. But cloud databases are complicated black boxes, running in a different administrative domain from their clients. Thus, clients might like to know whether the databases are meeting their contract. To that end, we introduce cobra; cobra applies to transactional key-value stores. It is the first system that combines (a) black-box checking, of (b) serializability, while (c) scaling to real-world online transactional processing workloads. The core technical challenge is that the underlying search problem is computationally expensive. COBRA tames that problem by starting with a suitable SMT solver. COBRA then introduces several new techniques, including a new encoding of the validity condition; hardware acceleration to prune inputs to the solver; and a transaction segmentation mechanism that enables scaling and garbage collection. Cobra imposes modest overhead on clients, improves over baselines by 10\texttimes{} in verification cost, and (unlike the baselines) supports continuous verification. Our artifact can handle 2000 transactions/sec, equivalent to 170M/day.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 当今的云数据库提供强大的属性，包括可串行化，这有时被称为数据库正确性的黄金标准。但云数据库是复杂的黑盒，运行在与客户端不同的管理域中。因此，客户端可能希望知道数据库是否在履行其契约。为此，我们引入了COBRA；它适用于事务性键值存储。它是第一个将（a）黑盒检查与（b）可串行化检查相结合，并且（c）能够扩展到真实世界在线事务处理工作负载的系统。核心技术挑战是底层搜索问题计算成本高昂。COBRA通过先选用一个合适的SMT求解器来应对该问题。随后引入了几项新技术，包括新的有效性条件编码；用于缩减求解器输入规模的硬件加速；以及能够实现扩展和垃圾回收的事务分段机制。COBRA对客户端施加的开销适中，与基线相比在验证成本上提升了10倍，并且（与基线不同）支持持续验证。我们的工具能够处理每秒2000个事务，相当于每天1.7亿个事务。

upstream_only.title: Determinizing crash behavior with a verified snapshot-consistent flash translation layer
upstream_only.abstract: This paper introduces the design of a snapshot-consistent flash translation layer (SCFTL) for flash disks, which has a stronger guarantee about the possible behavior after a crash than conventional designs. More specifically, the flush operation of SCFTL also has the functionality of making a "disk snapshot." When a crash occurs, the flash disk is guaranteed to recover to the state right before the last flush. The major benefit of SCFTL is that it allows a more efficient design of upper layers in the storage stack. For example, the file system built on SCFTL does not require the use of a journal for crash recovery. Instead, it only needs to perform a flush operation of SCFTL at the end of each atomic transaction. We use a combination of a proof assistant, a symbolic executor, and an SMT solver, to formally verify the correctness of our SCFTL implementation. We modify the xv6 file system to support group commit and utilize SCFTL's stronger crash guarantee. Our evaluation using file system benchmarks shows that the modified xv6 on SCFTL is 3 to 30 times faster than xv6 with logging on conventional FTLs, and is in the worst case only two times slower than the state-of-the-art setting: the ext4 file system on the Physical Block Device (pblk) FTL.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于闪存盘、具有快照一致性保证的闪存转换层（SCFTL）的设计，该设计比传统设计对崩溃后可能的系统行为提供了更强的保证。更具体地说，SCFTL的flush操作还具备创建“磁盘快照”的功能。当发生崩溃时，闪存盘保证恢复到最近一次flush之前的状态。SCFTL的主要优点在于它使得存储栈上层的设计更加高效。例如，基于SCFTL构建的文件系统无需使用日志即可进行崩溃恢复；相反，它只需在每个原子事务结束时执行一次SCFTL的flush操作。我们结合使用证明助手、符号执行器和SMT求解器来形式化验证SCFTL实现的正确性。我们修改了xv6文件系统以支持组提交，并利用SCFTL更强的崩溃保证。通过文件系统基准测试进行的评估表明，基于SCFTL的修改版xv6比基于传统FTL并带有日志的xv6快3到30倍，在最坏情况下也仅比最新技术设置——基于物理块设备(pblk)FTL上的ext4文件系统——慢两倍。

upstream_only.title: Storage systems are distributed systems (so verify them that way!)
upstream_only.abstract: To verify distributed systems, prior work introduced a methodology for verifying both the code running on individual machines and the correctness of the overall system when those machines interact via an asynchronous distributed environment. The methodology requires neither domain-specific logic nor tooling. However, distributed systems are only one instance of the more general phenomenon of systems code that interacts with an asynchronous environment. We argue that the software of a storage system can (and should!) be viewed similarly. We evaluate this approach in VeriBetrKV, a key-value store based on a state-of-the-art Bεtree.In building VeriBetrKV, we introduce new techniques to scale automated verification to larger code bases, still without introducing domain-specific logic or tooling. In particular, we show a discipline that keeps the automated verification development cycle responsive. We also combine linear types with dynamic frames to relieve the programmer from most heap-reasoning obligations while enabling them to break out of the linear type system when needed. VeriBetrKV exhibits similar query performance to unverified databases. Its insertion performance is 24\texttimes{} faster than unverified BerkeleyDB and 8\texttimes{} slower than RocksDB.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 为了验证分布式系统，先前的工作提出了一种方法论，用于验证单个机器上运行的代码以及当这些机器通过异步分布式环境交互时整个系统的正确性。该方法论既不需要特定领域的逻辑，也不需要特定领域的工具。然而，分布式系统只是与异步环境交互的系统代码这一更普遍现象的一个实例。我们认为存储系统的软件也可以（并且应该！）以类似的方式看待。我们在VeriBetrKV中评估了这种方法，这是一个基于最先进的Bε树的关键值存储。在构建VeriBetrKV时，我们引入了新技术，将自动化验证扩展到更大的代码库，同时仍然不引入特定领域的逻辑或工具。具体而言，我们展示了一种保持自动化验证开发周期响应性的纪律。我们还将线性类型与动态帧相结合，以减轻程序员大部分堆推理义务，同时使他们在需要时能够跳出线性类型系统。VeriBetrKV的查询性能与未经验证的数据库相似。其插入性能比未经验证的BerkeleyDB快24倍，比RocksDB慢8倍。

upstream_only.title: Fast RDMA-based ordered key-value store using remote learned cache
upstream_only.abstract: RDMA (Remote Direct Memory Access) has gained considerable interests in network-attached in-memory key-value stores. However, traversing the remote tree-based index in ordered stores with RDMA becomes a critical obstacle, causing an order-of-magnitude slowdown and limited scalability due to multiple roundtrips. Using index cache with conventional wisdom--caching partial data and traversing them locally--usually leads to limited effect because of unavoidable capacity misses, massive random accesses, and costly cache invalidations.We argue that the machine learning (ML) model is a perfect cache structure for the tree-based index, termed learned cache. Based on it, we design and implement XSTORE, an RDMA-based ordered key-value store with a new hybrid architecture that retains a tree-based index at the server to perform dynamic workloads (e.g., inserts) and leverages a learned cache at the client to perform static workloads (e.g., gets and scans). The key idea is to decouple ML model retraining from index updating by maintaining a layer of indirection from logical to actual positions of key-value pairs. It allows a stale learned cache to continue predicting a correct position for a lookup key. XSTORE ensures correctness using a validation mechanism with a fallback path and further uses speculative execution to minimize the cost of cache misses. Evaluations with YCSB benchmarks and production workloads show that a single XSTORE server can achieve over 80 million read-only requests per second. This number out-performs state-of-the-art RDMA-based ordered key-value stores (namely, DrTM-Tree, Cell, and eRPC+Masstree) by up to 5.9\texttimes{} (from 3.7\texttimes{}). For workloads with inserts, XSTORE still provides up to 3.5\texttimes{} (from 2.7\texttimes{}) throughput speedup, achieving 53M reqs/s. The learned cache can also reduces client-side memory usage and further provides an efficient memory-performance tradeoff, e.g., saving 99\% memory at the cost of 20\% peak throughput.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: RDMA（远程直接内存访问）在网络附加内存键值存储中引起了相当大的关注。然而，在有序存储中通过RDMA遍历远程基于树的索引成为一个关键障碍，由于多次往返，导致性能降低一个数量级并限制可扩展性。使用传统智慧的索引缓存（在本地缓存部分数据并遍历）通常效果有限，因为不可避免的容量缺失、大量随机访问和昂贵的缓存失效。我们认为机器学习（ML）模型是树状索引的完美缓存结构，称为学习型缓存。在此基础上，我们设计并实现了XSTORE，一个基于RDMA的有序键值存储，采用新的混合架构：在服务器端保留树状索引以处理动态工作负载（如插入），并在客户端利用学习型缓存处理静态工作负载（如查询和扫描）。关键思想是通过维护从逻辑位置到键值对实际位置的间接层，将ML模型重新训练与索引更新解耦。这允许过时的学习型缓存继续为查找键预测正确位置。XSTORE使用带有回退路径的验证机制确保正确性，并进一步利用推测执行最小化缓存未命中的成本。使用YCSB基准测试和生产工作负载的评估表明，单个XSTORE服务器可以达到每秒超过8000万次只读请求。这一数字比最先进的基于RDMA的有序键值存储（即DrTM-Tree、Cell和eRPC+Masstree）高出高达5.9倍（从3.7倍起）。对于包含插入的工作负载，XSTORE仍提供高达3.5倍（从2.7倍起）的吞吐量加速，达到5300万请求/秒。学习型缓存还可以减少客户端内存使用，并提供高效的内存-性能权衡，例如，以20%的峰值吞吐量代价节省99%的内存。

upstream_only.title: CrossFS: a cross-layered direct-access file system
upstream_only.abstract: We design CrossFS, a cross-layered direct-access file system disaggregated across user-level, firmware, and kernel layers for scaling I/O performance and improving concurrency. CrossFS is designed to exploit host- and device-level compute capabilities. For concurrency with or without data sharing across threads and processes, CrossFS introduces a file descriptor-based concurrency control that maps each file descriptor to one hardware-level I/O queue. This design allows CrossFS's firmware component to process disjoint access across file descriptors concurrently. CrossFS delegates concurrency control to powerful host-CPUs, which convert the file descriptor synchronization problem into an I/O queue request ordering problem. To guarantee crash consistency in the cross-layered design, CrossFS exploits byte-addressable nonvolatile memory for I/O queue persistence and designs a lightweight firmware-level journaling mechanism. Finally, CrossFS designs a firmware-level I/O scheduler for efficient dispatch of file descriptor requests. Evaluation of emulated CrossFS on storage-class memory shows up to 4.87X concurrent access gains for benchmarks and 2.32X gains for real-world applications over the state-of-the-art kernel, user-level, and firmware file systems.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们设计了CrossFS，一种跨层直接访问文件系统，它被分解到用户层、固件层和内核层，以扩展I/O性能并提高并发性。CrossFS旨在利用主机和设备级的计算能力。为了支持线程和进程间无论是否共享数据的并发，CrossFS引入了一种基于文件描述符的并发控制，将每个文件描述符映射到一个硬件级I/O队列。这种设计允许CrossFS的固件组件并发地处理跨文件描述符的不相交访问。CrossFS将并发控制委托给强大的主机CPU，将文件描述符同步问题转化为I/O队列请求排序问题。为了保证跨层设计中的崩溃一致性，CrossFS利用字节寻址的非易失性内存实现I/O队列持久化，并设计了一种轻量级的固件级日志机制。最后，CrossFS设计了一个固件级I/O调度器，用于高效调度文件描述符请求。在存储级内存上对CrossFS的模拟评估显示，与最先进的内核级、用户级和固件级文件系统相比，基准测试的并发访问性能提升可达4.87倍，实际应用程序的并发访问性能提升可达2.32倍。

upstream_only.title: From WiscKey to Bourbon: a learned index for log-structured merge trees
upstream_only.abstract: We introduce BOURBON, a log-structured merge (LSM) tree that utilizes machine learning to provide fast lookups. We base the design and implementation of BOURBON on empirically-grounded principles that we derive through careful analysis of LSM design. BOURBON employs greedy piecewise linear regression to learn key distributions, enabling fast lookup with minimal computation, and applies a cost-benefit strategy to decide when learning will be worthwhile. Through a series of experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets, we show that BOURBON improves lookup performance by 1.23\texttimes{}-1.78\texttimes{} as compared to state-of-the-art production LSMs.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们介绍了BOURBON，一种利用机器学习提供快速查找的日志结构合并（LSM）树。我们基于通过仔细分析LSM设计而得出的经验性原则来设计和实现BOURBON。BOURBON采用贪婪分段线性回归来学习键分布，以最小的计算量实现快速查找，并应用成本效益策略来决定何时学习是值得的。通过在合成数据集和真实数据集上的一系列实验，我们表明，与最先进的生产级LSM相比，BOURBON将查找性能提高了1.23倍至1.78倍。

upstream_only.title: A large scale analysis of hundreds of in-memory cache clusters at Twitter
upstream_only.abstract: Modern web services use in-memory caching extensively to increase throughput and reduce latency. There have been several workload analyses of production systems that have fueled research in improving the effectiveness of in-memory caching systems. However, the coverage is still sparse considering the wide spectrum of industrial cache use cases. In this work, we significantly further the understanding of real-world cache workloads by collecting production traces from 153 in-memory cache clusters at Twitter, sifting through over 80 TB of data, and sometimes interpreting the workloads in the context of the business logic behind them. We perform a comprehensive analysis to characterize cache workloads based on traffic pattern, time-to-live (TTL), popularity distribution, and size distribution. A fine-grained view of different workloads uncover the diversity of use cases: many are far more write-heavy or more skewed than previously shown and some display unique temporal patterns. We also observe that TTL is an important and sometimes defining parameter of cache working sets. Our simulations show that ideal replacement strategy in production caches can be surprising, for example, FIFO works the best for a large number of workloads.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代Web服务广泛使用内存缓存来提高吞吐量和降低延迟。已有若干针对生产系统的工作负载分析，推动了提高内存缓存系统有效性的研究。然而，考虑到工业缓存用例的广泛范围，覆盖仍然稀少。在这项工作中，我们通过从Twitter的153个内存缓存集群收集生产跟踪、筛选超过80 TB数据，并有时结合其背后的业务逻辑来解释工作负载，进一步加深了对真实世界缓存工作负载的理解。我们基于流量模式、生存时间（TTL）、流行度分布和大小分布进行了全面分析以刻画缓存工作负载。对不同工作负载的细粒度视图揭示了用例的多样性：许多工作负载比此前显示的更偏向写入密集型或更倾斜，有些还显示出独特的时间模式。我们还观察到TTL是缓存工作集的一个重要且有时具有决定性的参数。我们的模拟表明，生产缓存中的理想替换策略可能出人意料，例如，在许多工作负载中，FIFO效果最佳。

upstream_only.title: Generalized sub-query fusion for eliminating redundant I/O from big-data queries
upstream_only.abstract: SQL is the de-facto language for big-data analytics. Despite the cost of distributed SQL execution being dominated by disk and network I/O, we find that state-of-the-art optimizers produce plans that are not I/O optimal. For a significant fraction of queries (25\% of popular benchmarks like TPCDS), a large amount of data is shuffled redundantly between different pairs of stages. The fundamental reason for this limitation is that optimizers do not have the right set of primitives to perform reasoning at the map-reduce level that can potentially identify and eliminate the redundant I/O.This paper proposes RESIN, an optimizer extension that adds first-class support for map-reduce reasoning. RESIN uses a novel technique called Generalized Sub-Query Fusion that identifies sub-queries computing on overlapping data, and fuses them into the same map-reduce stages. The analysis is general; it does not require that the sub-queries be syntactically the same, nor are they required to produce the same output. Sub-query fusion allows RESIN to sometimes also eliminate expensive binary operations like Joins and Unions altogether for further gains.We have integrated RESIN into SPARKSQL and evaluated it on TPCDS, a standard analytics benchmark suite. Our results demonstrate that the proposed optimizations apply to 40\% of the queries and speed up a large fraction of them by 1.1-6\texttimes{}, reducing the overall execution time of the benchmark suite by 12\%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: SQL是大数据分析的事实标准语言。尽管分布式SQL执行的成本主要由磁盘和网络I/O决定，但我们发现最先进的优化器生成的计划并不是I/O最优的。在相当大比例的查询中（如TPCDS等流行基准测试的25%），大量数据在不同阶段对之间被冗余地重排。这种局限的根本原因在于优化器缺乏在map-reduce层面进行推理的正确原语，从而无法识别和消除冗余I/O。本文提出了RESIN，一个优化器扩展，为map-reduce推理添加了一等支持。RESIN使用一种称为通用子查询融合的新技术，识别在重叠数据上计算的子查询，并将其融合到相同的map-reduce阶段。该分析是通用的；它不要求子查询语法相同，也不要求它们产生相同的输出。子查询融合有时还使RESIN能够完全消除昂贵的二元操作（如Join和Union）以进一步获益。我们已将RESIN集成到SPARKSQL中，并在标准分析基准套件TPCDS上进行了评估。结果表明，所提出的优化适用于40%的查询，并加速了其中很大一部分1.1-6倍，将整个基准套件的总执行时间减少了12%。

upstream_only.title: A simpler and faster NIC driver model for network functions
upstream_only.abstract: The advent of software network functions calls for stronger correctness guarantees and higher performance at every level of the stack. Current network stacks trade simplicity for performance and flexibility, especially in their driver model. We show that performance and simplicity can coexist, at the cost of some flexibility, with a new NIC driver model tailored to network functions. The key idea behind our model is that the driver can efficiently reuse packet buffers because buffers follow a single logical path.We implement a driver for the Intel 82599 network card in 550 lines of code. By merely replacing the state-of-the-art driver with our driver, formal verification of the entire software stack completes in 7x less time, while the verified functions' throughput improves by 160\%. Our driver also beats, on realistic workloads, the throughput of drivers that cannot yet be formally verified, thanks to its low variability and resource use.Our code is available at github.com/dslab-epfl/tinynf.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 软件网络功能的出现对整个协议栈的每一层都提出了更强的正确性保证和更高性能的要求。当前的网络栈在驱动模型上牺牲了简洁性以换取性能和灵活性。我们表明，如果在灵活性方面做出一定的让步，一个针对网络功能定制的新NIC驱动模型可以实现性能与简洁性的共存。我们模型背后的关键思想是，由于缓冲区沿着单一逻辑路径流动，驱动程序可以高效地重复利用数据包缓冲区。我们用550行代码为Intel 82599网卡实现了一个驱动程序。仅仅是将现有最先进的驱动程序替换为我们编写的驱动程序，整个软件栈的形式化验证时间就缩短了7倍，同时通过验证的函数的吞吐量提高了160%。在现实负载下，我们的驱动程序依靠较低的可变性和资源占用，超越了那些目前仍无法进行形式化验证的驱动程序的吞吐量。我们的代码发布在github.com/dslab-epfl/tinynf。

upstream_only.title: PANIC: a high-performance programmable NIC for multi-tenant networks
upstream_only.abstract: Programmable NICs have diverse uses, and there is a need for a NIC platform that can offload computation from multiple co-resident applications to many different types of substrates, including hardware accelerators, embedded FPGAs, and embedded processor cores. Unfortunately, there is no existing NIC design that can simultaneously support a large number of diverse offloads while ensuring high throughput/low latency, multi-tenant isolation, flexible offload chaining, and support for offloads with variable performance.This paper presents PANIC, a new programmable NIC. There are two new key components of the PANIC design that enable it to overcome the limitations of existing NICs: 1) A high-performance switching interconnect that scalably connects independent engines into offload chains, and 2) A new hybrid push/pull packet scheduler that provides cross-tenant performance isolation and low-latency load-balancing across parallel offload engines. From experiments performed on an 100 Gbps FPGA-based prototype, we find that this design overcomes the limitations of state-of-the-art programmable NICs.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 可编程网卡具有多种用途，并且需要一种网卡平台，能够将多个共存应用程序的计算卸载到多种不同类型的底层设施上，包括硬件加速器、嵌入式FPGA和嵌入式处理器核心。不幸的是，现有网卡设计无法同时支持大量多样化卸载，同时保证高吞吐量/低延迟、多租户隔离、灵活的卸载链，以及支持性能可变的卸载。本文提出PANIC，一种新型可编程网卡。PANIC设计的两个关键新组件使其能够克服现有网卡的局限性：1）一种高性能交换互连，可将独立引擎可扩展地连接成卸载链；2）一种新的混合推/拉分组调度器，可提供跨租户性能隔离和跨并行卸载引擎的低延迟负载均衡。通过在100 Gbps FPGA原型上进行的实验，我们发现该设计克服了最先进可编程网卡的局限性。

upstream_only.title: Semeru: a memory-disaggregated managed runtime
upstream_only.abstract: Resource-disaggregated architectures have risen in popularity for large datacenters. However, prior disaggregation systems are designed for native applications; in addition, all of them require applications to possess excellent locality to be efficiently executed. In contrast, programs written in managed languages are subject to periodic garbage collection (GC), which is a typical graph workload with poor locality. Although most datacenter applications are written in managed languages, current systems are far from delivering acceptable performance for these applications.This paper presents Semeru, a distributed JVM that can dramatically improve the performance of managed cloud applications in a memory-disaggregated environment. Its design possesses three major innovations: (1) a universal Java heap, which provides a unified abstraction of virtual memory across CPU and memory servers and allows any legacy program to run without modifications; (2) a distributed GC, which offloads object tracing to memory servers so that tracing is performed closer to data; and (3) a swap system in the OS kernel that works with the runtime to swap page data efficiently. An evaluation of Semeru on a set of widely-deployed systems shows very promising results.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 资源分解架构已在大型数据中心中日益流行。然而，先前的分解系统是为原生应用程序设计的；此外，所有此类系统都要求应用程序具备良好的局部性才能高效执行。相比之下，用托管语言编写的程序需要定期进行垃圾回收（GC），这是典型的图工作负载，具有较差的局部性。尽管大多数数据中心应用程序都是用托管语言编写的，现有系统却远不能为这些应用程序提供可接受的性能。本文提出了Semeru，一种分布式JVM，可以显著提升内存分解环境中托管云应用程序的性能。其设计包含三项主要创新：（1）通用Java堆，跨CPU和内存服务器提供统一的虚拟内存抽象，允许任何遗留程序无需修改即可运行；（2）分布式GC，将对象追踪任务卸载到内存服务器，使追踪更接近数据；（3）操作系统内核中的交换系统，与运行时协同高效地交换页面数据。在一组广泛部署的系统上对Semeru的评估显示了非常有前景的结果。

upstream_only.title: Caladan: mitigating interference at microsecond timescales
upstream_only.abstract: The conventional wisdom is that CPU resources such as cores, caches, and memory bandwidth must be partitioned to achieve performance isolation between tasks. Both the widespread availability of cache partitioning in modern CPUs and the recommended practice of pinning latency-sensitive applications to dedicated cores attest to this belief.In this paper, we show that resource partitioning is neither necessary nor sufficient. Many applications experience bursty request patterns or phased behavior, drastically changing the amount and type of resources they need. Unfortunately, partitioning-based systems fail to react quickly enough to keep up with these changes, resulting in extreme spikes in latency and lost opportunities to increase CPU utilization.Caladan is a new CPU scheduler that can achieve significantly better quality of service (tail latency, throughput, etc.) through a collection of control signals and policies that rely on fast core allocation instead of resource partitioning. Caladan consists of a centralized scheduler core that actively manages resource contention in the memory hierarchy and between hyperthreads, and a kernel module that bypasses the standard Linux Kernel scheduler to support microsecond-scale monitoring and placement of tasks. When colocating memcached with a best-effort, garbage-collected workload, Caladan outperforms Parties, a state-of-the-art resource partitioning system, by 11,000\texttimes{}, reducing tail latency from 580 ms to 52 µs during shifts in resource usage while maintaining high CPU utilization.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 传统观点认为，必须对CPU资源（如核心、缓存和内存带宽）进行分区，才能在任务之间实现性能隔离。现代CPU中缓存分区技术的广泛可用性以及将延迟敏感型应用固定到专用核心的推荐做法都证明了这一信念。在本文中，我们表明资源分区既不必要也不充分。许多应用会出现突发性请求模式或阶段性行为，导致其所需资源的数量和类型发生剧烈变化。不幸的是，基于分区的系统无法足够快速地做出反应以适应这些变化，从而导致极端的延迟尖峰和CPU利用率提升机会的丧失。Caladan是一种新的CPU调度器，通过一系列依赖于快速核心分配而非资源分区的控制信号和策略，能够实现显著更好的服务质量（尾延迟、吞吐量等）。Caladan由一个集中式调度器核心组成，该核心主动管理内存层次结构和超线程之间的资源争用，并包含一个绕过标准Linux内核调度器以支持微秒级任务监控和放置的内核模块。当将memcached与一个尽力而为的、带垃圾回收的工作负载共存时，Caladan比最先进的资源分区系统Parties性能提升11,000倍，在资源使用变化期间将尾延迟从580毫秒降低到52微秒，同时保持较高的CPU利用率。

upstream_only.title: Overload control for µs-scale RPCs with breakwater
upstream_only.abstract: Modern datacenter applications are composed of hundreds of microservices with high degrees of fanout. As a result, they are sensitive to tail latency and require high request throughputs. Maintaining these characteristics under overload is difficult, especially for RPCs with short service times. In this paper, we consider the challenging case of microsecond-scale RPCs, where the cost of communicating information and dropping a request is similar to the cost of processing a request. We present Breakwater, an overload control scheme that can prevent overload in microsecond-scale services through a new, server-driven admission control scheme that issues credits based on server-side queueing delay. Breakwater contributes several techniques to amortize communication costs. It engages in demand speculation, where it assumes clients have unmet demand and issues additional credits when the server is not overloaded. Moreover, it piggybacks client-side demand information in RPC requests and credits in RPC responses. To cope with the occasional bursts in load caused by demand speculation, Breakwater drops requests when overloaded using active queue management. When clients' demand spikes unexpectedly to 1.4\texttimes{} capacity, Breakwater converges to stable performance in less than 20 ms with no congestion collapse while DAGOR and SEDA take 500 ms and 1.58 s to recover from congestion collapse, respectively.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代数据中心应用由数百个具有高扇出度的微服务组成。因此，它们对尾延迟敏感，并需要高请求吞吐量。在过载情况下维持这些特性十分困难，尤其是对于服务时间很短的RPC。在本文中，我们考虑了微秒级RPC这一具有挑战性的场景，其中通信信息和丢弃请求的成本与处理请求的成本相近。我们提出了Breakwater，一种过载控制方案，通过一种新的、基于服务器端队列延迟发放信用的服务器驱动准入控制机制，来防止微秒级服务的过载。Breakwater贡献了几项摊销通信成本的技术。它进行需求推测，假设客户端有未满足的需求，并在服务器未过载时发放额外信用。此外，它在RPC请求中捎带客户端需求信息，在RPC响应中捎带信用。为了应对需求推测偶尔引起的负载突发，Breakwater在过载时使用主动队列管理丢弃请求。当客户端需求意外飙升至容量的1.4倍时，Breakwater在不到20毫秒内收敛到稳定性能且不发生拥塞崩溃，而DAGOR和SEDA分别需要500毫秒和1.58秒才能从拥塞崩溃中恢复。

upstream_only.title: AIFM: high-performance, application-integrated far memory
upstream_only.abstract: Memory is the most contended and least elastic resource in datacenter servers today. Applications can use only local memory--which may be scarce--even though memory might be readily available on another server. This leads to unnecessary killings of workloads under memory pressure and reduces effective server utilization.We present application-integrated far memory (AIFM), which makes remote, "far" memory available to applications through a simple API and with high performance. AIFM achieves the same common-case access latency for far memory as for local RAM; it avoids read and write amplification that paging-based approaches suffer; it allows data structure engineers to build remoteable, hybrid near/far memory data structures; and it makes far memory transparent and easy to use for application developers.Our key insight is that exposing application-level semantics to a high-performance runtime makes efficient remoteable memory possible. Developers use AIFM's APIs to make allocations remoteable, and AIFM's runtime handles swapping objects in and out, prefetching, and memory evacuation.We evaluate AIFM with a prototypical web application frontend, a NYC taxi data analytics workload, a memcached-like key-value cache, and Snappy compression. Adding AIFM remoteable memory to these applications increases their available memory without performance penalty. AIFM outperforms Fastswap, a state-of-the-art kernel-integrated, paging-based far memory system [6] by up to 61\texttimes{}.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 内存是当今数据中心服务器中争用最严重且弹性最差的资源。应用程序只能使用本地内存（可能很稀缺），即使另一台服务器上可能很容易获得内存。这导致在内存压力下不必要地终止工作负载，并降低了服务器的有效利用率。我们提出了应用集成远端内存（AIFM），它通过一个简单的API以高性能将远端“远”内存提供给应用程序。AIFM实现了与本地RAM相同的常见访问延迟；它避免了基于分页的方法所遭受的读和写放大；它允许数据结构工程师构建可远程化的混合近/远内存数据结构；并使远端内存对应用程序开发人员透明且易于使用。我们的关键见解是，将应用程序级语义暴露给高性能运行时可以实现高效的远程内存。开发人员使用AIFM的API使分配可远程化，AIFM的运行时处理对象的换入换出、预取和内存疏散。我们使用一个原型Web应用程序前端、一个纽约出租车数据分析工作负载、一个类memcached的键值缓存以及Snappy压缩来评估AIFM。为这些应用程序添加AIFM可远程内存可在无性能损失的情况下增加其可用内存。AIFM的性能比最先进的基于内核集成、分页的远端内存系统Fastswap [6] 最多可提高61倍。

upstream_only.title: Performance-optimal read-only transactions
upstream_only.abstract: Read-only transactions are critical for consistently reading data spread across a distributed storage system but have worse performance than simple, non-transactional reads. We identify three properties of simple reads that are necessary for read-only transactions to be performance-optimal, i.e., come as close as possible to simple reads. We demonstrate a fundamental tradeoff in the design of read-only transactions by proving that performance optimality is impossible to achieve with strict serializability, the strongest consistency.Guided by this result, we present PORT, a performance-optimal design with the strongest consistency to date. Central to PORT are version clocks, a specialized logical clock that concisely captures the necessary ordering constraints. We show the generality of PORT with two applications. Scylla-PORT provides process-ordered serializability with simple writes and shows performance comparable to its nontransactional base system. Eiger-PORT provides causal consistency with write transactions and significantly improves the performance of its transactional base system.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 只读事务对于一致地读取分布式存储系统中分布的数据至关重要，但其性能比简单的非事务性读取要差。我们确定了简单读取的三个属性，这些属性对于只读事务达到性能最优（即尽可能接近简单读取）是必要的。我们通过证明在最严格的一致性——严格可串行化下，性能最优无法实现，展示了只读事务设计中的一个根本性权衡。受此结果指导，我们提出了PORT，一个至今在最强一致性下实现性能最优的设计。PORT的核心是版本时钟（version clocks），一种专门化的逻辑时钟，能够简洁地捕获必要的排序约束。我们通过两个应用展示了PORT的通用性。Scylla-PORT提供具有简单写入的进程有序可串行化，并展现出与其非事务性基础系统相当的性能。Eiger-PORT提供支持写事务的因果一致性，并显著提高了其事务性基础系统的性能。

upstream_only.title: Toward a generic fault tolerance technique for partial network partitioning
upstream_only.abstract: We present an extensive study focused on partial network partitioning. Partial network partitions disrupt the communication between some but not all nodes in a cluster.First, we conduct a comprehensive study of system failures caused by this fault in 12 popular systems. Our study reveals that the studied failures are catastrophic (e.g., lead to data loss), easily manifest, and can manifest by partially partitioning a single node.Second, we dissect the design of eight popular systems and identify four principled approaches for tolerating partial partitions. Unfortunately, our analysis shows that implemented fault tolerance techniques are inadequate for modern systems; they either patch a particular mechanism or lead to a complete cluster shutdown, even when alternative network paths exist.Finally, our findings motivate us to build Nifty, a transparent communication layer that masks partial network partitions. Nifty builds an overlay between nodes to detour packets around partial partitions. Our prototype evaluation with six popular systems shows that Nifty overcomes the shortcomings of current fault tolerance approaches and effectively masks partial partitions while imposing negligible overhead.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们针对部分网络分区进行了广泛的研究。部分网络分区会中断集群中部分节点之间的通信，但并非所有节点。首先，我们对该故障在12个流行系统中造成的系统故障进行了全面的研究。我们的研究表明，所研究的故障是灾难性的（例如导致数据丢失），很容易显现，并且可以通过部分分区单个节点来显现。其次，我们剖析了八个流行系统的设计，并确定了容忍部分分区的四种原则性方法。不幸的是，我们的分析表明，已实现的容错技术不足以满足现代系统的需求；它们要么修补某个特定机制，要么导致整个集群停机，即使存在替代网络路径也是如此。最后，我们的研究结果促使我们构建了Nifty，一个透明的通信层，用于掩盖部分网络分区。Nifty在节点之间构建一个覆盖网络，将数据包绕开部分分区。我们使用六个流行系统进行的原型评估表明，Nifty克服了当前容错方法的缺点，能有效掩盖部分分区，同时引入的开销可忽略不计。

upstream_only.title: PACEMAKER: avoiding HeART attacks in storage clusters with disk-adaptive redundancy
upstream_only.abstract: Data redundancy provides resilience in large-scale storage clusters, but imposes significant cost overhead. Substantial space-savings can be realized by tuning redundancy schemes to observed disk failure rates. However, prior design proposals for such tuning are unusable in real-world clusters, because the IO load of transitions between schemes overwhelms the storage infrastructure (termed transition overload).This paper analyzes traces for millions of disks from production systems at Google, NetApp, and Backblaze to expose and understand transition overload as a roadblock to disk-adaptive redundancy: transition IO under existing approaches can consume 100\% cluster IO continuously for several weeks. Building on the insights drawn, we present PACEMAKER, a low-overhead disk-adaptive redundancy orchestrator. PACEMAKER mitigates transition overload by (1) proactively organizing data layouts to make future transitions efficient, and (2) initiating transitions proactively in a manner that avoids urgency while not compromising on space-savings. Evaluation of PACEMAKER with traces from four large (110K-450K disks) production clusters show that the transition IO requirement decreases to never needing more than 5\% cluster IO bandwidth (0.2-0.4\% on average). PACEMAKER achieves this while providing overall space-savings of 14-20\% and never leaving data under-protected. We also describe and experiment with an integration of PACEMAKER into HDFS.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 数据冗余为大型存储集群提供了弹性，但会带来显著的额外成本。通过根据观测到的磁盘故障率调整冗余方案，可以实现可观的存储空间节省。然而，之前针对此类调整的设计方案在实际集群中不可用，因为方案转换所产生的IO负载会使存储基础设施不堪重负（称为转换过载）。本文分析了来自Google、NetApp和Backblaze生产系统中数百万磁盘的跟踪数据，以揭示并理解转换过载作为磁盘自适应冗余的主要障碍：现有方法下的转换IO可能连续数周消耗100%的集群IO。基于这些洞察，我们提出了PACEMAKER，一种低开销的磁盘自适应冗余编排器。PACEMAKER通过以下方式减轻转换过载：(1) 主动组织数据布局，使未来的转换更高效，(2) 主动发起转换以避免紧急性，同时不损害空间节省。使用来自四个大型（110K-450K磁盘）生产集群的跟踪数据进行的评估显示，转换IO需求降低到永远不需要超过5%的集群IO带宽（平均0.2-0.4%）。PACEMAKER在实现这一点的同时，总体节省了14-20%的存储空间，并且从未使数据保护不足。我们还描述并实验了PACEMAKER集成到HDFS的方案。

upstream_only.title: Pegasus: Tolerating skewed workloads in distributed storage with in-network coherence directories
upstream_only.abstract: High performance distributed storage systems face the challenge of load imbalance caused by skewed and dynamic workloads. This paper introduces Pegasus, a new storage system that leverages new-generation programmable switch ASICs to balance load across storage servers. Pegasus uses selective replication of the most popular objects in the data store to distribute load. Using a novel in-network coherence directory, the Pegasus switch tracks and manages the location of replicated objects. This allows it to achieve load-aware forwarding and dynamic rebalancing for replicated keys, while still guaranteeing data coherence and consistency. The Pegasus design is practical to implement as it stores only forwarding metadata in the switch data plane. The resulting system improves the throughput of a distributed in-memory key-value store by more than 10\texttimes{} under a latency SLO - results which hold across a large set of workloads with varying degrees of skew, read/write ratio, object sizes, and dynamism.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 高性能分布式存储系统面临由偏斜和动态工作负载引起的负载不平衡挑战。本文介绍了Pegasus，一种利用新一代可编程交换机ASIC来平衡存储服务器负载的新型存储系统。Pegasus通过对数据存储中最流行的对象进行选择性复制来分散负载。利用一种新颖的网内一致性目录，Pegasus交换机跟踪并管理复制对象的位置。这使得它能够实现对复制键的负载感知转发和动态重新平衡，同时仍然保证数据的一致性和连贯性。Pegasus的设计具有实用性，因为它只在交换机数据平面中存储转发元数据。由此产生的系统在延迟SLO下将分布式内存键值存储的吞吐量提高了10倍以上——这一结果在具有不同程度偏斜、读写比、对象大小和动态性的大量工作负载中均成立。

upstream_only.title: FlightTracker: consistency across read-optimized online stores at facebook
upstream_only.abstract: Social media platforms deliver fresh personalized content by performing a large number of reads from an online data store. This store must be optimized for read efficiency, availability, and scalability. Multi-layer caches and asynchronous replication can satisfy these goals, such as in Facebook's graph store TAO, but it is challenging for the resulting system to provide a developer-friendly consistency model. TAO originally provided read-your-writes (RYW) consistency via write-through caching, but scaling challenges with this approach have led us to a new implementation.This paper introduces FlightTracker, a family of APIs and systems which now manage consistency for online access to Facebook's graph. FlightTracker implicitly provides RYW and can be explicitly used to provide alternative consistency guarantees for special use cases; it enables flexible communication patterns between caches, which we have found important as the number of datacenters increases; it extends the same consistency guarantees to cross-shard indexes and materialized views, allowing us to transparently optimize queries; and it provides a uniform primitive for clients to obtain desired consistency guarantees across a variety of data stores. FlightTracker delivers these advantages while preserving the efficiency, latency, and availability benefits of asynchronous replication for the underlying systems, managing consistency for billions of users and more than 1015 queries per day.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 社交媒体平台通过从在线数据存储执行大量读取来提供新鲜个性化内容。该存储必须针对读取效率、可用性和可扩展性进行优化。多层缓存和异步复制可以满足这些目标，例如 Facebook 的图存储 TAO，但由此产生的系统很难提供对开发者友好的一致性模型。TAO 最初通过写穿缓存提供读己之写（RYW）一致性，但这种方法带来的扩展挑战使我们的实现焕然一新。本文介绍 FlightTracker，这是一个 API 和系统家族，现在用于管理对 Facebook 图的在线访问一致性。FlightTracker 隐式提供 RYW，并且可显式用于为特殊用例提供替代一致性保证；它支持缓存之间灵活的通信模式，我们发现在数据中心数量增加时这很重要；它将相同的一致性保证扩展到跨分片索引和物化视图，使我们能够透明地优化查询；并且它为客户端提供统一的原语，以在各种数据存储中获得所需的一致性保证。FlightTracker 在保持底层系统异步复制的效率、延迟和可用性优势的同时，带来了这些优势，管理着数十亿用户和每天超过 10^15 次查询的一致性。

upstream_only.title: KVell+: snapshot isolation without snapshots
upstream_only.abstract: Snapshot Isolation (SI) enables online analytical processing (OLAP) queries to observe a snapshot of the data at the time the query is issued, despite concurrent updates by online transactional processing (OLTP) transactions. The conventional implementation of SI creates a new version of a data item when it is updated, rather than overwriting the old version. Versions are garbage collected when they can no longer be read by any OLAP query. Frequent updates during long-running OLAP queries therefore create significant space amplification, and garbage collection can give rise to latency spikes for OLTP transactions. These problems are exacerbated on modern low-latency drives that can persist millions of updates per second.We observe that analytic queries often consist in large part of commutative processing of data items resulting from range scans in which each item in the range is read exactly once. We introduce Online Commutative Processing (OLCP), a new model for processing analytical queries, that takes advantage of this observation. Under OLCP, analytical queries observe the same snapshot of the data as they would under conventional SI, but space amplification and garbage collection costs are largely and oftentimes nearly entirely avoided. When an item in such a range is updated, the old version of the item is propagated to the OLCP queries that might need it instead of being kept in the store.We demonstrate OLCP's expressiveness by showing how to formulate, among others, the TPC-H benchmark queries in OLCP. We implement OLCP in KVell+, an extension of KVell, a key-value store for NVMe SSDs. Using YCSB-T, TPC-CH and production workloads from Nutanix, we run a wide range of analytics queries concurrently with write-intensive transactions. We show that OLCP incurs little or no space amplification or garbage collection overhead. As a surprising by-product we also show that OLCP speeds up analytical queries compared to SI.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 快照隔离（SI）使在线分析处理（OLAP）查询能够在发出查询时观察到数据的快照，尽管在线事务处理（OLTP）事务会并发更新。SI的常规实现是在数据项更新时创建其新版本，而非覆盖旧版本。当旧版本不再被任何OLAP查询读取时，它们会被垃圾回收。因此，在长时间运行的OLAP查询期间频繁更新会导致显著的空间放大，而垃圾回收可能引起OLTP事务的延迟尖峰。在现代低延迟驱动器上，这些问题会更加严重，因为此类驱动器每秒可持久化数百万次更新。我们观察到，分析查询通常在很大程度上包含由范围扫描产生的数据项的交换性（commutative）处理，其中范围内每个项恰好被读取一次。我们引入在线交换处理（OLCP），一种处理分析查询的新模型，利用了这一观察。在OLCP下，分析查询观察到的数据快照与常规SI下相同，但空间放大和垃圾回收成本在很大程度上（往往几乎完全）被避免。当此类范围内的一个项被更新时，该项的旧版本会被传播给可能需要它的OLCP查询，而不是存储在存储中。我们通过展示如何用OLCP表述TPC-H基准查询（以及其他查询），证明了OLCP的表达能力。我们在KVell+中实现了OLCP，KVell+是KVell（一种面向NVMe SSD的键值存储）的扩展。使用YCSB-T、TPC-CH和Nutanix的生产工作负载，我们并发运行了广泛的分析查询与写密集型事务。我们表明，OLCP几乎或完全不产生空间放大或垃圾回收开销。作为令人惊讶的副产品，我们还表明，与SI相比，OLCP加速了分析查询。

upstream_only.title: Serving DNNs like clockwork: performance predictability from the bottom up
upstream_only.abstract: Machine learning inference is becoming a core building block for interactive web applications. As a result, the underlying model serving systems on which these applications depend must consistently meet low latency targets. Existing model serving architectures use well-known reactive techniques to alleviate common-case sources of latency, but cannot effectively curtail tail latency caused by unpredictable execution times. Yet the underlying execution times are not fundamentally unpredictable--on the contrary we observe that inference using Deep Neural Network (DNN) models has deterministic performance.Here, starting with the predictable execution times of individual DNN inferences, we adopt a principled design methodology to successively build a fully distributed model serving system that achieves predictable end-to-end performance. We evaluate our implementation, Clockwork, using production trace workloads, and show that Clockwork can support thousands of models while simultaneously meeting 100 ms latency targets for 99.9999\% of requests. We further demonstrate that Clockwork exploits predictable execution times to achieve tight request-level service-level objectives (SLOs) as well as a high degree of request-level performance isolation.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 机器学习推理正成为交互式Web应用的核心构建模块。因此，这些应用所依赖的底层模型服务系统必须始终满足低延迟目标。现有的模型服务架构使用众所周知的响应式技术来缓解常见情况的延迟来源，但无法有效抑制由不可预测的执行时间引起的尾部延迟。然而，底层执行时间并非根本不可预测——相反，我们观察到使用深度神经网络模型的推理具有确定性性能。在此，从单个DNN推理的可预测执行时间开始，我们采用一种有原则的设计方法，逐步构建一个完全分布式的模型服务系统，实现可预测的端到端性能。我们使用生产工作负载轨迹评估了我们的实现Clockwork，并表明Clockwork可以支持数千个模型，同时为99.9999%的请求满足100毫秒的延迟目标。我们进一步证明，Clockwork利用可预测的执行时间来实现严格的请求级服务级别目标(SLO)以及高度的请求级性能隔离。

upstream_only.title: A unified architecture for accelerating distributed DNN training in heterogeneous GPU/CPU clusters
upstream_only.abstract: Data center clusters that run DNN training jobs are inherently heterogeneous. They have GPUs and CPUs for computation and network bandwidth for distributed training. However, existing distributed DNN training architectures, all-reduce and Parameter Server (PS), cannot fully utilize such heterogeneous resources. In this paper, we present a new distributed DNN training architecture called BytePS. BytePS can leverage spare CPU and bandwidth resources in the cluster to accelerate distributed DNN training tasks running on GPUs. It provides a communication framework that is both proved optimal and unified - existing all-reduce and PS become two special cases of BytePS. To achieve the proved optimality in practice, BytePS further splits the functionalities of a parameter optimizer. It introduces a Summation Service abstraction for aggregating gradients, which is common for all the optimizers. Summation Service can be accelerated by AVX instructions and can be efficiently run on CPUs, while DNN model-related optimizer algorithms are run on GPUs for computation acceleration. BytePS can accelerate DNN training for major frameworks including TensorFlow, PyTorch and MXNet. For representative DNN training jobs with up to 256 GPUs, BytePS outperforms the state-of-the-art open source all-reduce and PS by up to 84\% and 245\%, respectively.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 运行DNN训练作业的数据中心集群本质上是异构的。它们拥有用于计算的GPU和CPU，以及用于分布式训练的网络带宽。然而，现有的分布式DNN训练架构——全归约（all-reduce）和参数服务器（Parameter Server，PS）——无法充分利用这些异构资源。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的分布式DNN训练架构，称为BytePS。BytePS可以利用集群中空闲的CPU和带宽资源来加速运行在GPU上的分布式DNN训练任务。它提供了一个既被证明最优又统一的通信框架——现有的all-reduce和PS架构成为BytePS的两种特例。为了在实践中实现被证明的最优性，BytePS进一步拆分参数优化器的功能。它引入了一个用于梯度聚合的求和服务（Summation Service）抽象，该抽象对所有优化器都是通用的。求和服务可以通过AVX指令加速，并且可以在CPU上高效运行，而与DNN模型相关的优化器算法则在GPU上运行以实现计算加速。BytePS可以加速包括TensorFlow、PyTorch和MXNet在内的主要框架的DNN训练。对于多达256个GPU的代表性DNN训练作业，BytePS相比最先进的开源all-reduce和PS架构，分别实现了高达84%和245%的性能提升。

upstream_only.title: Heterogeneity-aware cluster scheduling policies for deep learning workloads
upstream_only.abstract: Specialized accelerators such as GPUs, TPUs, FPGAs, and custom ASICs have been increasingly deployed to train deep learning models. These accelerators exhibit heterogeneous performance behavior across model architectures. Existing schedulers for clusters of accelerators, which are used to arbitrate these expensive training resources across many users, have shown how to optimize for various multi-job, multiuser objectives, like fairness and makespan. Unfortunately, existing schedulers largely do not consider performance heterogeneity. In this paper, we propose Gavel, a heterogeneityaware scheduler that systematically generalizes a wide range of existing scheduling policies. Gavel expresses these policies as optimization problems and then systematically transforms these problems into heterogeneity-aware versions using an abstraction we call effective throughput. Gavel then uses a round-based scheduling mechanism to ensure jobs receive their ideal allocation given the target scheduling policy. Gavel's heterogeneity-aware policies allow a heterogeneous cluster to sustain higher input load, and improve end objectives such as makespan and average job completion time by 1.4\texttimes{} and 3.5\texttimes{} compared to heterogeneity-agnostic policies.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: GPU、TPU、FPGA和定制ASIC等专用加速器已被越来越多地用于训练深度学习模型。这些加速器在不同的模型架构上表现出异构的性能行为。现有的加速器集群调度器（用于在众多用户之间仲裁这些昂贵的训练资源）已展示如何为各种多作业、多用户目标（如公平性和完工时间）进行优化。不幸的是，现有调度器在很大程度上未考虑性能异构性。在本文中，我们提出Gavel，一种异构感知调度器，它系统地将广泛的现有调度策略泛化。Gavel将这些策略表示为优化问题，然后使用我们称之为“有效吞吐量”的抽象将这些系统性地转化为异构感知版本。随后，Gavel使用基于轮次的调度机制，确保作业在给定目标调度策略下获得理想的分配。Gavel的异构感知策略使异构集群能够维持更高的输入负载，并相比异构不可知策略，将完工时间和平均作业完成时间等最终目标分别提升了1.4倍和3.5倍。

upstream_only.title: PipeSwitch: fast pipelined context switching for deep learning applications
upstream_only.abstract: Deep learning (DL) workloads include throughput-intensive training tasks and latency-sensitive inference tasks. The dominant practice today is to provision dedicated GPU clusters for training and inference separately. Due to the need to meet strict Service-Level Objectives (SLOs), GPU clusters are often over-provisioned based on the peak load with limited sharing between applications and task types. We present PipeSwitch, a system that enables unused cycles of an inference application to be filled by training or other inference applications. It allows multiple DL applications to time-share the same GPU with the entire GPU memory and millisecond-scale switching overhead. With PipeSwitch, GPU utilization can be significantly improved without sacrificing SLOs. We achieve so by introducing pipelined context switching. The key idea is to leverage the layered structure of neural network models and their layer-by-layer computation pattern to pipeline model transmission over the PCIe and task execution in the GPU with model-aware grouping. We also design unified memory management and active-standby worker switching mechanisms to accompany the pipelining and ensure process-level isolation. We have built a PipeSwitch prototype and integrated it with PyTorch. Experiments on a variety of DL models and GPU cards show that PipeSwitch only incurs a task startup overhead of 3.6-6.6 ms and a total overhead of 5.4-34.6 ms (10-50\texttimes{} better than NVIDIA MPS), and achieves near 100\% GPU utilization.
