upstream_only.abstract_zh: 深度学习（DL）工作负载包括高吞吐量的训练任务和延迟敏感的推理任务。当前的主流做法是分别部署专用GPU集群用于训练和推理。由于需要满足严格的服务级别目标（SLO），GPU集群往往按峰值负载过度配置，且应用与任务类型之间共享有限。我们提出了PipeSwitch，一种能够利用推理应用的空闲周期来运行训练或其他推理应用的系统。它允许多个深度学习应用以毫秒级切换开销共享同一GPU，并充分利用整个GPU内存。通过引入流水线式上下文切换，PipeSwitch能够在不牺牲SLO的情况下显著提高GPU利用率。其关键在于利用神经网络模型的分层结构及逐层计算模式，通过模型感知的分组，将模型在PCIe上的传输与GPU中的任务执行进行流水线化。我们还设计了统一内存管理和主备工作线程切换机制，配合流水线并确保进程级隔离。我们构建了PipeSwitch原型，并将其集成到PyTorch中。在多种深度学习模型和GPU卡上的实验表明，PipeSwitch的任务启动开销仅为3.6–6.6毫秒，总开销为5.4–34.6毫秒（比NVIDIA MPS高10–50倍），并实现了接近100%的GPU利用率。

upstream_only.title: HiveD: sharing a GPU cluster for deep learning with guarantees
upstream_only.abstract: Deep learning training on a shared GPU cluster is becoming a common practice. However, we observe severe sharing anomaly in production multi-tenant clusters where jobs in some tenants experience worse queuing delay than they would have in a private cluster with their allocated shares of GPUs. This is because tenants use quota, the number of GPUs, to reserve resources, whereas deep learning jobs often use GPUs with a desirable GPU affinity, which quota cannot guarantee.HiveD is the first framework to share a GPU cluster safely, so that such anomaly would never happen by design. In HiveD, each tenant reserves resources through a Virtual Private Cluster (VC), defined in terms of multi-level cell structures corresponding to different levels of GPU affinity in a cluster. This design allows HiveD to incorporate any existing schedulers within each VC to achieve their respective design goals while sharing the cluster safely.HiveD develops an elegant buddy cell allocation algorithm to ensure sharing safety by efficiently managing the dynamic binding of cells from VCs to those in a physical cluster. A straightforward extension of buddy cell allocation can further support low-priority jobs to scavenge the unused GPU resources to improve cluster utilization.With a combination of real deployment and trace-driven simulation, we show that: (i) sharing anomaly exists in three state-of-the-art deep learning schedulers, incurring extra queuing delay of up to 1,000 minutes; (ii) HiveD can incorporate these schedulers and eliminate the sharing anomaly in all of them, achieving separation of concerns that allows the schedulers to focus on their own scheduling goals without violating sharing safety.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在共享GPU集群上进行深度学习训练已成为普遍做法。然而，我们观察到生产环境中的多租户集群存在严重的共享异常：某些租户的作业经历的排队延迟比它们使用所分配GPU份额的私有集群时更差。这是因为租户使用配额（GPU数量）来预留资源，而深度学习作业通常以理想的GPU亲和性使用GPU，这是配额无法保证的。HiveD是第一个能够安全共享GPU集群的框架，在设计中从根本上杜绝此类异常。在HiveD中，每个租户通过虚拟私有集群（VC）预留资源，VC以多级单元结构定义，对应集群中不同级别的GPU亲和性。该设计使HiveD能够在每个VC内整合任何现有调度器，以实现各自的设计目标，同时安全地共享集群。HiveD提出了一种优雅的伙伴单元分配算法，通过有效管理VC单元与物理集群单元的动态绑定来确保共享安全。伙伴单元分配的直接扩展还能支持低优先级作业回收未使用的GPU资源，以提高集群利用率。结合实际部署和基于轨迹的模拟，我们表明：（i）共享异常存在于三种最先进的深度学习调度器中，造成高达1000分钟的额外排队延迟；（ii）HiveD可以整合这些调度器并消除所有共享异常，实现关注点分离，使调度器在满足自身调度目标的同时不违反共享安全。

upstream_only.title: AntMan: dynamic scaling on GPU clusters for deep learning
upstream_only.abstract: Efficiently scheduling deep learning jobs on large-scale GPU clusters is crucial for job performance, system throughput, and hardware utilization. It is getting ever more challenging as deep learning workloads become more complex. This paper presents AntMan, a deep learning infrastructure that co-designs cluster schedulers with deep learning frameworks and has been deployed in production at Alibaba to manage tens of thousands of daily deep learning jobs across thousands of GPUs. AntMan accommodates the fluctuating resource demands of deep learning training jobs. As such, it utilizes the spare GPU resources to co-execute multiple jobs on a shared GPU. AntMan exploits unique characteristics of deep learning training to introduce dynamic scaling mechanisms for memory and computation within the deep learning frameworks. This allows fine-grained coordination between jobs and prevents job interference. Evaluations show that AntMan improves the overall GPU memory utilization by 42\% and computation utilization by 34\% in our multi-tenant cluster without compromising fairness, presenting a new approach to efficiently utilizing GPUs at scale.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在大型GPU集群上高效调度深度学习作业对作业性能、系统吞吐量和硬件利用率至关重要。随着深度学习工作负载变得越来越复杂，这一挑战也日益严峻。本文介绍了AntMan，这是一个深度学习基础设施，它将集群调度器与深度学习框架协同设计，并已在阿里巴巴生产环境中部署，用于管理数千个GPU上每天数以万计的深度学习作业。AntMan适应深度学习训练作业波动的资源需求，因此它利用空闲的GPU资源在共享GPU上共同执行多个作业。AntMan利用深度学习训练的独特特性，在深度学习框架内引入了内存和计算的动态扩缩容机制。这实现了作业之间的细粒度协调，并防止作业干扰。评估表明，在不牺牲公平性的前提下，AntMan在我们的多租户集群中将整体GPU内存利用率提高了42%，计算利用率提高了34%，为大规模高效利用GPU提供了一种新方法。

upstream_only.title: Write dependency disentanglement with HORAE
upstream_only.abstract: Storage systems rely on write dependency to achieve atomicity and consistency. However, enforcing write dependency comes at the expense of performance; it concatenates multiple hardware queues into a single logical queue, disables the concurrency of flash storage and serializes the access to isolated devices. Such serialization prevents the storage system from taking full advantage of high-performance drives (e.g., NVMe SSD) and storage arrays.In this paper, we propose a new IO stack called HORAE to alleviate the write dependency overhead for high-performance drives. HORAE separates the dependency control from the data flow, and uses a dedicated interface to maintain the write dependency. Further, HORAE introduces the joint flush to enable parallel FLUSH commands on individual devices, and write redirection to handle dependency loops and parallelize in-place updates. We implement HORAE in Linux kernel and demonstrate its effectiveness through a wide variety of workloads. Evaluations show HORAE brings up to 1.8\texttimes{} and 2.1\texttimes{} performance gain in MySQL and BlueStore, respectively.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 存储系统依赖写依赖来实现原子性和一致性。然而，强制实施写依赖会牺牲性能；它将多个硬件队列串联成一个逻辑队列，禁用了闪存的并发性，并将对隔离设备的访问串行化。这种串行化使得存储系统无法充分利用高性能驱动器（如NVMe SSD）和存储阵列。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为HORAE的新型IO栈，以缓解高性能驱动器上的写依赖开销。HORAE将依赖控制与数据流分离，并使用专用接口来维护写依赖。此外，HORAE引入了联合刷新（joint flush）以实现在各独立设备上并行执行FLUSH命令，以及写重定向（write redirection）来处理依赖循环并并行化就地更新。我们在Linux内核中实现了HORAE，并通过多种工作负载证明了其有效性。评估表明，在MySQL和BlueStore中，HORAE分别带来了高达1.8倍和2.1倍的性能提升。

upstream_only.title: Blockene: a high-throughput blockchain over mobile devices
upstream_only.abstract: We introduce Blockene, a blockchain that reduces resource usage at member nodes by orders of magnitude, requiring only a smartphone to participate in block validation and consensus. Despite being lightweight, Blockene provides a high throughput of transactions and scales to a large number of participants. Blockene consumes negligible battery and data in smartphones, enabling millions of users to participate in the blockchain without incentives, to secure transactions with their collective honesty. Blockene achieves these properties with a novel split-trust design based on delegating storage and gossip to untrusted nodes.We show, with a prototype implementation, that Blockene provides throughput of 1045 transactions/sec, and runs with very low resource usage on smartphones, pointing to a new paradigm for building secure, decentralized applications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了Blockene，一种将成员节点的资源使用量降低数个数量级的区块链，仅需一部智能手机即可参与区块验证和共识。尽管轻量级，Blockene仍能提供高交易吞吐量，并可扩展至大量参与者。Blockene在智能手机上仅消耗极少的电量和数据，使得数百万用户无需激励即可参与区块链，并以其集体诚实行为为交易提供安全保障。Blockene通过一种新颖的基于将存储和流言委托给不可信节点的分裂信任设计来实现这些特性。通过原型实现，我们展示了Blockene可提供每秒1045笔交易的吞吐量，并且在智能手机上以极低的资源占用运行，这为构建安全的去中心化应用指明了新模式。

upstream_only.title: Tolerating slowdowns in replicated state machines using copilots
upstream_only.abstract: Replicated state machines are linearizable, fault-tolerant groups of replicas that are coordinated using a consensus algorithm. Copilot replication is the first 1-slowdown-tolerant consensus protocol: it delivers normal latency despite the slowdown of any 1 replica. Copilot uses two distinguished replicas--the pilot and copilot--to proactively add redundancy to all stages of processing a client's command. Copilot uses dependencies and deduplication to resolve potentially differing orderings proposed by the pilots. To avoid dependencies leading to either pilot being able to slow down the group, Copilot uses fast takeovers that allow a fast pilot to complete the ongoing work of a slow pilot. Copilot includes two optimizations--ping-pong batching and null dependency elimination--that improve its performance when there are 0 and 1 slow pilots respectively. Our evaluation of Copilot shows its performance is lower but competitive with Multi-Paxos and EPaxos when no replicas are slow. When a replica is slow, Copilot is the only protocol that avoids high latencies.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 复制状态机是由共识算法协调的、具有线性一致性和容错能力的副本组。Copilot复制是第一个容忍1个副本速度下降的共识协议：即使任意1个副本出现速度下降，它仍能提供正常延迟。Copilot使用两个特殊的副本——主驾驶(pilot)和副驾驶(copilot)——在处理客户端命令的所有阶段主动添加冗余。Copilot使用依赖关系和去重来解决主驾驶可能提出的不同顺序。为了避免依赖关系导致任一主驾驶拖慢整个组，Copilot采用了快速接管机制，使快速主驾驶能够完成缓慢主驾驶正在进行的操作。Copilot包含两项优化——乒乓批处理和空依赖消除——分别在0个和1个缓慢主驾驶的情况下提高其性能。我们对Copilot的评估表明，当没有副本速度下降时，其性能低于但与Multi-Paxos和EPaxos相当。当某个副本速度下降时，Copilot是唯一能避免高延迟的协议。

upstream_only.title: Microsecond consensus for microsecond applications
upstream_only.abstract: We consider the problem of making apps fault-tolerant through replication, when apps operate at the microsecond scale, as in finance, embedded computing, and microservices apps. These apps need a replication scheme that also operates at the microsecond scale, otherwise replication becomes a burden. We propose Mu, a system that takes less than 1.3 microseconds to replicate a (small) request in memory, and less than a millisecond to fail-over the system--this cuts the replication and fail-over latencies of the prior systems by at least 61\% and 90\%. Mu implements bona fide state machine replication/consensus (SMR) with strong consistency for a generic app, but it really shines on microsecond apps, where even the smallest overhead is significant. To provide this performance, Mu introduces a new SMR protocol that carefully leverages RDMA. Roughly, in Mu a leader replicates a request by simply writing it directly to the log of other replicas using RDMA, without any additional communication. Doing so, however, introduces the challenge of handling concurrent leaders, changing leaders, garbage collecting the logs, and more--challenges that we address in this paper through a judicious combination of RDMA permissions and distributed algorithmic design. We implemented Mu and used it to replicate several systems: a financial exchange app called Liquibook, Redis, Memcached, and HERD [33]. Our evaluation shows that Mu incurs a small replication latency, in some cases being the only viable replication system that incurs an acceptable overhead.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们考虑了当应用程序以微秒级运行时（如金融、嵌入式计算和微服务应用），通过复制实现容错的问题。这些应用需要一种同样以微秒级运行的复制方案，否则复制将成为负担。我们提出了Mu，一个在内存中复制（小）请求耗时不到1.3微秒、故障转移时间不到1毫秒的系统——这比先前系统的复制和故障转移延迟至少降低了61%和90%。Mu为通用应用实现了真正意义上的状态机复制/共识（SMR），并保证强一致性，但它在微秒级应用上表现尤为出色，因为即使最小的开销也举足轻重。为了实现这种性能，Mu引入了一种新的SMR协议，巧妙利用了RDMA。大致而言，在Mu中，领导者通过RDMA将请求直接写入其他副本的日志中，无需额外通信即可完成复制。然而，这样做引入了处理并发领导者、领导者更换、日志垃圾回收等挑战——我们通过结合RDMA权限和分布式算法设计解决了这些挑战。我们实现了Mu，并用它复制了多个系统：一个名为Liquibook的金融交易应用、Redis、Memcached和HERD[33]。我们的评估表明，Mu引入了很小的复制延迟，在某些情况下是唯一能带来可接受开销的可行复制系统。

upstream_only.title: Virtual consensus in delos
upstream_only.abstract: Consensus-based replicated systems are complex, monolithic, and difficult to upgrade once deployed. As a result, deployed systems do not benefit from innovative research, and new consensus protocols rarely reach production. We propose virtualizing consensus by virtualizing the shared log API, allowing services to change consensus protocols without downtime. Virtualization splits the logic of consensus into the VirtualLog, a generic and reusable reconfiguration layer; and pluggable ordering protocols called Loglets. Loglets are simple, since they do not need to support reconfiguration or leader election; diverse, consisting of different protocols, codebases, and even deployment modes; and composable, via RAID-like stacking and striping. We describe a production database called Delos1 which leverages virtual consensus for rapid, incremental development and deployment. Delos reached production within 8 months, and 4 months later upgraded its consensus protocol without downtime for a 10X latency improvement. Delos can dynamically change its performance properties by changing consensus protocols: we can scale throughput by up to 10X by switching to a disaggregated Loglet, and double the failure threshold of an instance without sacrificing throughput via a striped Loglet.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 基于共识的复制系统复杂、整体化，且一旦部署就难以升级。因此，已部署的系统无法受益于创新研究，新的共识协议也很少投入生产。我们提出通过虚拟化共享日志API来实现共识的虚拟化，使服务无需停机即可更改共识协议。虚拟化将共识逻辑拆分为VirtualLog（一个通用且可重用的重配置层）和称为Loglets的可插拔排序协议。Loglets简单，因为它们不需要支持重配置或领导者选举；多样化，由不同的协议、代码库甚至部署模式组成；并且可组合，通过类似RAID的堆叠和条带化。我们描述了一个名为Delos的生产数据库，它利用虚拟共识进行快速、增量的开发和部署。Delos在8个月内投入生产，4个月后在不停机的情况下升级了其共识协议，实现了10倍的延迟改进。Delos可以通过更改共识协议来动态改变其性能特性：通过切换到分离式Loglet，我们可以将吞吐量扩展至10倍；通过条带化Loglet，可以在不牺牲吞吐量的情况下将实例的故障阈值提高一倍。

upstream_only.title: Byzantine ordered consensus without byzantine oligarchy
upstream_only.abstract: The specific order of commands agreed upon when running state machine replication (SMR) is immaterial to fault-tolerance: all that is required is for all correct deterministic replicas to follow it. In the permissioned blockchains that rely on Byzantine fault tolerant (BFT) SMR, however, nodes have a stake in the specific sequence that ledger records, as well as in preventing other parties from manipulating the sequencing to their advantage. The traditional specification of SMR correctness, however, has no language to express these concerns. This paper introduces Byzantine ordered consensus, a new primitive that augments the correctness specification of BFT SMR to include specific guarantees on the total orders it produces; and a new architecture for BFT SMR that, by factoring out ordering from consensus, can enforce these guarantees and prevent Byzantine nodes from controlling ordering decisions (a Byzantine oligarchy). These contributions are instantiated in Pompe, a BFT SMR protocol that is guaranteed to order commands in a way that respects a natural extension of linearizability.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在运行状态机复制（SMR）时，所商定的具体命令顺序对容错来说并不重要：所有正确且确定性的副本只需遵循该顺序即可。然而，在依赖拜占庭容错（BFT）SMR的许可区块链中，节点对账本记录的具体顺序以及对防止其他方为自身利益操纵排序有着利害关系。然而，传统的SMR正确性规范没有表达这些关切的语言。本文引入了拜占庭有序共识（Byzantine ordered consensus），这是一种新的原语，它增强了BFT SMR的正确性规范，以包含对其产生的全序关系的具体保证；并引入了一种新的BFT SMR架构，通过将排序从共识中分离出来，可以执行这些保证并防止拜占庭节点控制排序决策（即拜占庭寡头）。这些贡献在Pompe中得到了实例化，Pompe是一种BFT SMR协议，其保证以一种自然扩展线性一致性的方式对命令进行排序。

upstream_only.title: From global to local quiescence: wait-free code patching of multi-threaded processes
upstream_only.abstract: Live patching has become a common technique to keep long-running system services secure and up-to-date without causing downtimes during patch application. However, to safely apply a patch, existing live-update methods require the entire process to enter a state of quiescence, which can be highly disruptive for multi-threaded programs: Having to halt all threads (e.g., at a global barrier) for patching not only hampers quality of service, but can also be tremendously difficult to implement correctly without causing deadlocks or other synchronization issues.In this paper, we present WFPATCH, a wait-free approach to inject code changes into running multi-threaded programs. Instead of having to stop the world before applying a patch, WFPATCH can gradually apply it to each thread individually at a local point of quiescence, while all other threads can make uninterrupted progress.We have implemented WFPATCH as a kernel service and user-space library for Linux 5.1 and evaluated it with Open-LDAP, Apache, Memcached, Samba, Node.js, and MariaDB on Debian 10 ("buster"). In total, we successfully applied 33 different binary patches into running programs while they were actively servicing requests; 15 patches had a CVE number or were other critical updates. Applying a patch with WFPATCH did not lead to any noticeable increase in request latencies - even under high load - while applying the same patch after reaching global quiescence increases tail latencies by a factor of up to 41\texttimes{} for MariaDB.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 实时修补已成为保持长期运行的系统服务安全且最新状态的常用技术，而不会在修补应用期间导致停机。然而，为了安全地应用补丁，现有的实时更新方法要求整个进程进入静止状态，这对多线程程序来说可能极具破坏性：为了修补而必须停止所有线程（例如，在全局屏障处）不仅会妨碍服务质量，而且可能极难正确实现，同时避免死锁或其他同步问题。在本文中，我们提出了WFPATCH，一种将代码更改注入运行中的多线程程序的无等待方法。WFPATCH无需在应用补丁前停止整个世界，而是可以在局部静止点逐步将补丁应用于每个线程，而所有其他线程则可以不受干扰地继续推进。我们将WFPATCH作为Linux 5.1的内核服务和用户空间库实现，并在Debian 10（“buster”）上使用Open-LDAP、Apache、Memcached、Samba、Node.js和MariaDB对其进行了评估。总体而言，我们成功地将33个不同的二进制补丁应用到了正在运行且积极处理请求的程序中；其中15个补丁带有CVE编号或是其他关键更新。使用WFPATCH应用补丁没有导致请求延迟的任何明显增加——即使在高压负载下也是如此——而在达到全局静止后应用相同的补丁则使MariaDB的尾部延迟增加了最多41倍。

upstream_only.title: Testing database engines via pivoted query synthesis
upstream_only.abstract: Database Management Systems (DBMSs) are used widely, and have been extensively tested by fuzzers, which are successful in finding crash bugs. However, approaches to finding logic bugs, such as when a DBMS computes an incorrect result set, have remained mostly untackled. To this end, we devised a novel and general approach that we have termed Pivoted Query Synthesis. The core idea of this approach is to automatically generate queries for which we ensure that they fetch a specific, randomly selected row, called the pivot row. If the DBMS fails to fetch the pivot row, the likely cause is a bug in the DBMS. We tested our approach on three widely used and mature DBMSs, namely SQLite, MySQL, and PostgreSQL. In total, we found 121 unique bugs in these DBMSs, 96 of which have been fixed or verified, demonstrating that the approach is highly effective and general. We expect that the wide applicability and simplicity of our approach will enable improving the robustness of many DBMSs.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 数据库管理系统（DBMS）被广泛使用，并已通过模糊测试工具进行了大量测试，这些工具在发现崩溃缺陷方面取得了成功。然而，寻找逻辑缺陷（例如数据库管理系统计算结果集不正确的情况）的方法在很大程度上仍未被解决。为此，我们设计了一种新颖且通用的方法，称为‘枢轴查询合成’。该方法的核心思想是自动生成查询，并确保这些查询能够获取一个特定的、随机选择的行，称为枢轴行。如果数据库管理系统未能获取枢轴行，则可能存在缺陷。我们将该方法应用于三个广泛使用且成熟的数据库管理系统：SQLite、MySQL和PostgreSQL。总共在这些数据库管理系统中发现了121个独特缺陷，其中96个已被修复或验证，表明该方法非常有效且通用。我们预期该方法具有广泛的适用性和简洁性，将有助于提升众多数据库管理系统的健壮性。

upstream_only.title: Gauntlet: finding bugs in compilers for programmable packet processing
upstream_only.abstract: Programmable packet-processing devices such as programmable switches and network interface cards are becoming mainstream. These devices are configured in a domain-specific language such as P4, using a compiler to translate packet-processing programs into instructions for different targets. As networks with programmable devices become widespread, it is critical that these compilers be dependable.This paper considers the problem of finding bugs in compilers for packet processing in the context of P416. We introduce domain-specific techniques to induce both abnormal termination of the compiler (crash bugs) and miscompilation (semantic bugs). We apply these techniques to (1) the opensource P4 compiler (P4C) infrastructure, which serves as a common base for different P4 back ends; (2) the P4 back end for the P4 reference software switch; and (3) the P4 back end for the Barefoot Tofino switch.Across the 3 platforms, over 8 months of bug finding, our tool Gauntlet detected 96 new and distinct bugs (62 crash and 34 semantic), which we confirmed with the respective compiler developers. 54 have been fixed (31 crash and 23 semantic); the remaining have been assigned to a developer. Our bug-finding efforts also led to 6 P4 specification changes. We have open sourced Gauntlet at p4gauntlet.github.io and it now runs within P4C's continuous integration pipeline.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 可编程数据包处理设备（如可编程交换机和网络接口卡）正在成为主流。这些设备使用P4等特定领域语言进行配置，通过编译器将数据包处理程序转换为不同目标的指令。随着可编程设备网络日益普及，这些编译器的可靠性至关重要。本文研究了在P416背景下查找数据包处理编译器错误的问题。我们引入了特定领域技术来诱发编译器的异常终止（崩溃错误）和错误编译（语义错误）。我们将这些技术应用于：(1) 开源的P4编译器（P4C）基础设施，该基础设施是不同P4后端的公共基础；(2) P4参考软件交换机的P4后端；(3) Barefoot Tofino交换机的P4后端。在3个平台上，经过8个月的错误查找，我们的工具Gauntlet检测到96个新的且不同的错误（62个崩溃错误和34个语义错误），并已与相应的编译器开发人员确认。其中54个已修复（31个崩溃错误和23个语义错误）；其余已分配给开发人员。我们的错误查找工作还促成了6项P4规范的变更。我们已在p4gauntlet.github.io开源了Gauntlet，目前它已在P4C的持续集成管道中运行。

upstream_only.title: Aragog: scalable runtime verification of shardable networked systems
upstream_only.abstract: Network functions like firewalls, proxies, and NATs are instances of distributed systems that lie on the critical path for a substantial fraction of today's cloud applications. Unfortunately, validating these systems remains difficult due to their complex stateful, timed, and distributed behaviors.In this paper, we present the design and implementation of Aragog, a runtime verification system for distributed network functions that achieves high expressiveness, fidelity, and scalability. Given a property of interest, Aragog efficiently checks running systems for violations of the property with a scale-out architecture consisting of a collection of global verifiers and local monitors. To improve performance and reduce communication overhead, Aragog includes an array of optimizations that leverage properties of networked systems to suppress provably unnecessary system events and to shard verification over every available local and global component. We evaluate Aragog over several network functions including a NAT Gateway that powers Azure, identifying both design and implementation bugs in the process.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 防火墙、代理和NAT等网络功能是分布式系统的实例，它们位于当今云应用中相当大比例部分的临界路径上。然而，由于这些系统具有复杂的有状态、定时和分布式行为，验证它们仍然很困难。在本文中，我们提出了Aragog的设计与实现，这是一个用于分布式网络功能的运行时验证系统，实现了高表达力、高保真度和可扩展性。给定一个感兴趣的属性，Aragog通过包含一组全局验证器和本地监控器的横向扩展架构，高效地检查运行中的系统是否存在违反该属性的行为。为了提高性能并降低通信开销，Aragog包含一系列优化，利用网络系统的特性来抑制可证明不必要的事件，并在所有可用的本地和全局组件上分片验证。我们针对包括为Azure提供支持的NAT网关在内的多个网络功能对Aragog进行了评估，过程中发现了设计和实现上的缺陷。

upstream_only.title: Automated reasoning and detection of specious configuration in large systems with symbolic execution
upstream_only.abstract: Misconfiguration is a major cause of system failures. Prior solutions focus on detecting invalid settings that are introduced by user mistakes. But another type of misconfiguration that continues to haunt production services is specious configuration-- settings that are valid but lead to unexpectedly poor performance in production. Such misconfigurations are subtle, so even careful administrators may fail to foresee them.We propose a tool called Violet to detect specious configuration. We realize the crux of specious configuration is that it causes some slow code path to be executed, but the bad performance effect cannot always be triggered. Violet thus takes a novel approach that uses selective symbolic execution to systematically reason about the performance effect of configuration parameters, their combination effect, and the relationship with input. Violet outputs a performance impact model for the automatic detection of poor configuration settings. We applied Violet on four large systems. To evaluate the effectiveness of Violet, we collect 17 real-world specious configuration cases. Violet detects 15 of them. Violet also identifies 11 unknown specious configurations.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 错误配置是系统故障的主要原因。现有解决方案侧重于检测由用户错误引入的无效设置。但另一种继续困扰生产服务的错误配置类型是可疑配置（specious configuration）——即有效但导致生产中意外性能低下的设置。此类错误配置较为微妙，即使谨慎的管理员也可能无法预见。我们提出了一个名为Violet的工具来检测可疑配置。我们意识到可疑配置的关键在于它导致某些慢速代码路径被执行，但糟糕的性能影响并非总能被触发。因此，Violet采用了一种新颖的方法，使用选择性符号执行系统地推理配置参数的性能影响、它们的组合效应以及与输入的关系。Violet输出一个性能影响模型，用于自动检测糟糕的配置设置。我们将Violet应用于四个大型系统。为了评估Violet的有效性，我们收集了17个真实世界的可疑配置案例。Violet检测出其中15个。Violet还识别出11个未知的可疑配置。

upstream_only.title: Testing configuration changes in context to prevent production failures
upstream_only.abstract: Large-scale cloud services deploy hundreds of configuration changes to production systems daily. At such velocity, configuration changes have inevitably become prevalent causes of production failures. Existing misconfiguration detection and configuration validation techniques only check configuration values. These techniques cannot detect common types of failure-inducing configuration changes, such as those that cause code to fail or those that violate hidden constraints.We present ctests, a new type of tests for detecting failure-inducing configuration changes to prevent production failures. The idea behind ctests is simple--connecting production system configurations to software tests so that configuration changes can be tested in the context of code affected by the changes. So, ctests can detect configuration changes that expose dormant software bugs and diverse misconfigurations.We show how to generate ctests by transforming the many existing tests in mature systems. The key challenge that we address is the automated identification of test logic and oracles that can be reused in ctests. We generated thousands of ctests from the existing tests in five cloud systems.Our results show that ctests are effective in detecting failure-inducing configuration changes before deployment. We evaluate ctests on real-world failure-inducing configuration changes, injected misconfigurations, and deployed configuration files from public Docker images. Ctests effectively detect real-world failure-inducing configuration changes and misconfigurations in the deployed files.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大规模云服务每天向生产系统部署数百次配置更改。在这样的速度下，配置更改不可避免地成为生产故障的普遍原因。现有的错误配置检测和配置验证技术仅检查配置值。这些技术无法检测常见的诱发故障的配置更改类型，例如那些导致代码失败或违反隐藏约束的更改。我们提出了ctests，一种新型测试，用于检测诱发故障的配置更改以防止生产故障。ctests背后的思想很简单——将生产系统配置连接到软件测试，以便配置更改可以在受更改影响的代码上下文中进行测试。因此，ctests可以检测暴露潜在软件缺陷的配置更改以及各种错误配置。我们展示了如何通过转换成熟系统中众多现有测试来生成ctests。我们解决的关键挑战是自动识别可在ctests中重用的测试逻辑和预言。我们从五个云系统的现有测试中生成了数千个ctests。结果表明，ctests在部署前检测诱发故障的配置更改方面是有效的。我们在真实世界的诱发故障配置更改、注入的错误配置以及来自公共Docker镜像的已部署配置文件上评估ctests。结果证明，ctests能有效检测真实世界的诱发故障配置更改以及已部署文件中的错误配置。

upstream_only.title: Providing SLOs for resource-harvesting VMs in cloud platforms
upstream_only.abstract: Cloud providers rent the resources they do not allocate as evictable virtual machines (VMs), like spot instances. In this paper, we first characterize the unallocated resources in Microsoft Azure, and show that they are plenty but may vary widely over time and across servers. Based on the characterization, we propose a new class of VM, called Harvest VM, to harvest and monetize the unallocated resources. A Harvest VM is more flexible and efficient than a spot instance, because it grows and shrinks according to the amount of unallocated resources at its underlying server; it is only evicted/killed when the provider needs its minimum set of resources. Next, we create models that predict the availability of the unallocated resources for Harvest VM deployments. Based on these predictions, we provide Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for the survival rate (e.g., 65\% of the Harvest VMs will survive more than a week) and the average number of cores that can be harvested. Our short-term predictions have an average error under 2\% and less than 6\% for longer terms. We also extend a popular cluster scheduling framework to leverage the harvested resources. Using our SLOs and framework, we can offset the rare evictions with extra harvested cores and achieve the same computational power as regular-priority VMs, but at 91\% lower cost. Finally, we outline lessons and results from running Harvest VMs and our framework in production.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 云服务提供商将其未分配的资源以可被回收的虚拟机（VM）形式出租，例如竞价实例。在本文中，我们首先刻画了Microsoft Azure中未分配资源的特征，表明这些资源数量庞大，但在时间和服务器之间可能波动很大。基于该特征，我们提出了一类新的虚拟机，称为Harvest VM，用于回收这些未分配资源并将其变现。Harvest VM比竞价实例更灵活高效，因为它会根据底层服务器上的未分配资源量进行弹性伸缩；只有当提供商需要其最小资源集时才会被驱逐/终止。接下来，我们创建了预测Harvest VM部署的未分配资源可用性的模型。基于这些预测，我们为存活率（例如65%的Harvest VM存活超过一周）和可回收的平均核心数提供服务水平目标（SLO）。我们的短期预测平均误差低于2%，长期预测误差低于6%。我们还扩展了一个流行的集群调度框架以利用回收的资源。使用我们的SLO和框架，我们可以用额外的回收核心来抵消罕见的驱逐事件，并以普通优先级虚拟机91%更低的成本实现相同的计算能力。最后，我们总结了在生产环境中运行Harvest VM及其框架的经验和结果。

upstream_only.title: The CacheLib caching engine: design and experiences at scale
upstream_only.abstract: Web services rely on caching at nearly every layer of the system architecture. Commonly, each cache is implemented and maintained independently by a distinct team and is highly specialized to its function. For example, an application-data cache would be independent from a CDN cache. However, this approach ignores the difficult challenges that different caching systems have in common, greatly increasing the overall effort required to deploy, maintain, and scale each cache.This paper presents a different approach to cache development, successfully employed at Facebook, which extracts a core set of common requirements and functionality from otherwise disjoint caching systems. CacheLib is a general-purpose caching engine, designed based on experiences with a range of caching use cases at Facebook, that facilitates the easy development and maintenance of caches. CacheLib was first deployed at Facebook in 2017 and today powers over 70 services including CDN, storage, and application-data caches.This paper describes our experiences during the transition from independent, specialized caches to the widespread adoption of CacheLib. We explain how the characteristics of production workloads and use cases at Facebook drove important design decisions. We describe how caches at Facebook have evolved over time, including the significant benefits seen from deploying CacheLib. We also discuss the implications our experiences have for future caching design and research.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Web 服务几乎在系统架构的每一层都依赖缓存。通常，每个缓存由不同的团队独立实现和维护，并且高度专门化于其功能。例如，应用数据缓存与 CDN 缓存是相互独立的。然而，这种方法忽视了不同缓存系统共同面临的困难挑战，大大增加了部署、维护和扩展每个缓存所需的整体工作量。本文提出了一种不同的缓存开发方法，并在 Facebook 成功应用。该方法从原本互不相干的缓存系统中提取一组核心的通用需求和功能。CacheLib 是一个通用缓存引擎，基于 Facebook 上多种缓存使用场景的经验设计，便于轻松开发和维护缓存。CacheLib 于 2017 年在 Facebook 首次部署，如今支持包括 CDN、存储和应用数据缓存在内的 70 多项服务。本文描述了我们从独立的专用缓存向广泛采用 CacheLib 过渡期间的经验。我们解释了 Facebook 生产工作负载和使用场景的特征如何推动重要的设计决策。我们描述了 Facebook 的缓存如何随时间演变，包括部署 CacheLib 所带来的显著收益。我们还讨论了我们的经验对未来缓存设计研究的启示。

upstream_only.title: Twine: a unified cluster management system for shared infrastructure
upstream_only.abstract: We present Twine, Facebook's cluster management system which has been running in production for the past decade. Twine has helped convert our infrastructure from a collection of siloed pools of customized machines dedicated to individual workloads, into a large-scale shared infrastructure with fungible hardware.Our goal of ubiquitous shared infrastructure leads us to some decisions counter to common practices. For instance, rather than deploying an isolated control plane per cluster, Twine scales a single control plane to manage one million machines across all data centers in a geographic region and transparently move jobs across clusters.Twine accommodates workload-specific customization in shared infrastructure, and this approach further departs from common practices. The TaskControl API allows an application to collaborate with Twine to handle container lifecycle events, e.g., restarting a ZooKeeper deployment's followers first and its leader last during a rolling upgrade. Host profiles capture hardware and OS settings that workloads can tune to improve performance and reliability; Twine dynamically allocates machines to workloads and switches host profiles accordingly.Finally, going against the conventional wisdom of prioritizing stacking workloads on big machines to increase utilization, we universally deploy power-efficient small machines outfit with a single CPU and 64GB RAM to achieve higher performance per watt, and we leverage autoscaling to improve machine utilization.We describe the design of Twine and share our experience in migrating Facebook's workloads onto shared infrastructure.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们介绍了Twine，这是Facebook的集群管理系统，已在生产环境中运行了十年。Twine帮助我们将基础设施从一系列相互隔离的定制机器池转变为具有可互换硬件的大规模共享基础设施。我们对无处不在的共享基础设施的目标导致我们做出了一些与常见做法相反的决定。例如，Twine不是为每个集群部署隔离的控制平面，而是扩展单个控制平面来管理某个地理区域内所有数据中心的百万台机器，并在集群之间透明地移动作业。Twine在共享基础设施中支持特定于工作负载的定制，这种方法进一步偏离了常见做法。TaskControl API允许应用程序与Twine协作来处理容器生命周期事件，例如在滚动升级期间先重启ZooKeeper部署的跟随者，最后重启领导者。主机配置文件捕获工作负载可以调整以改善性能和可靠性的硬件和操作系统设置；Twine动态地将机器分配给工作负载并相应地切换主机配置文件。最后，与优先将工作负载堆叠在大机器上以提高利用率的传统智慧相反，我们普遍部署配备单个CPU和64GB RAM的节能小型机器，以获得更高的每瓦性能，并利用自动伸缩来提高机器利用率。我们描述了Twine的设计，并分享了将Facebook的工作负载迁移到共享基础设施上的经验。

upstream_only.title: FIRM: an intelligent fine-grained resource management framework for SLO-oriented microservices
upstream_only.abstract: User-facing latency-sensitive web services include numerous distributed, intercommunicating microservices that promise to simplify software development and operation. However, multiplexing of compute resources across microservices is still challenging in production because contention for shared resources can cause latency spikes that violate the service-level objectives (SLOs) of user requests. This paper presents FIRM, an intelligent fine-grained resource management framework for predictable sharing of resources across microservices to drive up overall utilization. FIRM leverages online telemetry data and machine-learning methods to adaptively (a) detect/localize microservices that cause SLO violations, (b) identify low-level resources in contention, and (c) take actions to mitigate SLO violations via dynamic reprovisioning. Experiments across four microservice benchmarks demonstrate that FIRM reduces SLO violations by up to 16\texttimes{} while reducing the overall requested CPU limit by up to 62\%. Moreover, FIRM improves performance predictability by reducing tail latencies by up to 11\texttimes{}.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 面向用户的延迟敏感型Web服务包含大量分布式、相互通信的微服务，这有望简化软件开发和运维。然而，在微服务之间实现计算资源的多路复用仍然具有挑战性，因为共享资源的争用可能导致延迟尖峰，从而违反用户请求的服务级别目标（SLO）。本文提出了FIRM，一个智能的细粒度资源管理框架，用于在微服务之间实现可预测的资源共享，以提高整体利用率。FIRM利用在线遥测数据和机器学习方法，自适应地（a）检测/定位导致SLO违规的微服务，（b）识别竞争中的低层资源，以及（c）通过动态重新配置采取行动以减轻SLO违规。在四个微服务基准上的实验表明，FIRM将SLO违规减少高达16倍，同时将总体请求的CPU限制减少高达62%。此外，FIRM通过将尾部延迟降低高达11倍来提高性能可预测性。

upstream_only.title: Building scalable and flexible cluster managers using declarative programming
upstream_only.abstract: Cluster managers like Kubernetes and OpenStack are notoriously hard to develop, given that they routinely grapple with hard combinatorial optimization problems like load balancing, placement, scheduling, and configuration. Today, cluster manager developers tackle these problems by developing system-specific best effort heuristics, which achieve scalability by significantly sacrificing the cluster manager's decision quality, feature set, and extensibility over time. This is proving untenable, as solutions for cluster management problems are routinely developed from scratch in the industry to solve largely similar problems across different settings.We propose DCM, a radically different architecture where developers specify the cluster manager's behavior declaratively, using SQL queries over cluster state stored in a relational database. From the SQL specification, the DCM compiler synthesizes a program that, at runtime, can be invoked to compute policy-compliant cluster management decisions given the latest cluster state. Under the covers, the generated program efficiently encodes the cluster state as an optimization problem that can be solved using off-the-shelf solvers, freeing developers from having to design ad-hoc heuristics.We show that DCM significantly lowers the barrier to building scalable and extensible cluster managers. We validate our claim by powering three production-grade systems with it: a Kubernetes scheduler, a virtual machine management solution, and a distributed transactional datastore.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 集群管理器（如Kubernetes和OpenStack）以难以开发著称，因为它们常常需要处理难以解决的组合优化问题，例如负载均衡、放置、调度和配置。如今，集群管理器开发者通过开发特定于系统的尽力而为启发式方法来解决这些问题，这些方法以显著降低决策质量、功能集和长期可扩展性为代价来获得可扩展性。事实证明，这种方法难以为继，因为业界经常从头开始构建集群管理问题的解决方案，以解决不同场景下高度相似的问题。我们提出DCM，一种截然不同的架构，开发人员使用SQL查询以声明式方式指定集群管理器的行为，这些查询作用于存储在关系数据库中的集群状态。DCM编译器从SQL规范合成了一个程序，该程序在运行时可以根据最新的集群状态被调用来计算符合策略的集群管理决策。在底层，生成的程序将集群状态有效地编码为优化问题，可以使用现成的求解器来解决，从而无需开发者设计临时启发式方法。我们证明DCM显著降低了构建可扩展和可扩展集群管理器的障碍。我们用它为三个生产级系统提供支持来验证我们的主张：一个Kubernetes调度器、一个虚拟机管理解决方案和一个分布式事务数据存储。

upstream_only.title: Protean: VM allocation service at scale
upstream_only.abstract: We describe the design and implementation of Protean - the Microsoft Azure service responsible for allocating Virtual Machines (VMs) to millions of servers around the globe. A single instance of Protean serves an entire availability zone (10-100k machines), facilitating seamless failover and scaleout to customers. The design has proven robust, enabling a substantial expansion of VM offerings and features with minimal changes to the core infrastructure. In particular, Protean preserves a clear separation between policy and mechanisms. From a policy perspective, a flexible rule-based Allocation Agent (AA) allows Protean to efficiently address multiple constraints and performance criteria, and adapt to different conditions. On the system side, a multi-layer caching mechanism expedites the allocation process, achieving turnaround times of few milliseconds. A slight compromise on allocation quality enables multiple AAs to run concurrently on the same inventory, resulting in increased throughput with negligible conflict rate. Our results from both simulations and production demonstrate that Protean achieves high throughput and utilization (85-90\% on a key utilization metric), while satisfying user-specific requirements. We also demonstrate how Protean is adapted to handle capacity crunch conditions, by zooming in on spikes caused by COVID-19.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们描述了Protean的设计与实现——这是微软Azure中负责将虚拟机（VM）分配到全球数百万台服务器上的服务。单个Protean实例服务整个可用区（10-10万台机器），为客户提供无缝故障转移和横向扩展。该设计已被证明是稳健的，使得VM产品和功能在核心基础设施改动最小的情况下得以大幅扩展。特别是，Protean保留了策略与机制之间的清晰分离。从策略角度来看，一个灵活的基于规则的分配代理（AA）使Protean能够高效地处理多种约束和性能标准，并适应不同条件。在系统方面，多层缓存机制加速了分配过程，实现了数毫秒的周转时间。对分配质量的轻微妥协允许多个AA在同一库存上并发运行，从而以可忽略的冲突率提高吞吐量。我们在仿真和生产环境中的结果表明，Protean在满足用户特定需求的同时，实现了高吞吐量和利用率（关键利用率指标为85-90%）。我们还演示了Protean如何通过关注COVID-19导致的尖峰来应对容量紧张状况。

upstream_only.title: Ansor: generating high-performance tensor programs for deep learning
upstream_only.abstract: High-performance tensor programs are crucial to guarantee efficient execution of deep neural networks. However, obtaining performant tensor programs for different operators on various hardware platforms is notoriously challenging. Currently, deep learning systems rely on vendor-provided kernel libraries or various search strategies to get performant tensor programs. These approaches either require significant engineering effort to develop platform-specific optimization code or fall short of finding high-performance programs due to restricted search space and ineffective exploration strategy.We present Ansor, a tensor program generation framework for deep learning applications. Compared with existing search strategies, Ansor explores many more optimization combinations by sampling programs from a hierarchical representation of the search space. Ansor then fine-tunes the sampled programs with evolutionary search and a learned cost model to identify the best programs. Ansor can find high-performance programs that are outside the search space of existing state-of-the-art approaches. In addition, Ansor utilizes a task scheduler to simultaneously optimize multiple subgraphs in deep neural networks. We show that Ansor improves the execution performance of deep neural networks relative to the state-of-the-art on the Intel CPU, ARM CPU, and NVIDIA GPU by up to 3.8\texttimes{}, 2.6\texttimes{}, and 1.7\texttimes{}, respectively.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 高性能张量程序对于确保深度神经网络的高效执行至关重要。然而，为不同运算符在各种硬件平台上获得高性能张量程序是非常具有挑战性的。目前，深度学习系统依赖于供应商提供的内核库或各种搜索策略来获得高性能张量程序。这些方法要么需要大量工程工作来开发特定平台的优化代码，要么由于搜索空间受限和探索策略无效而无法找到高性能程序。我们提出了Ansor，一个面向深度学习应用的张量程序生成框架。与现有搜索策略相比，Ansor通过从搜索空间的分层表示中采样程序来探索更多的优化组合。然后，Ansor使用进化搜索和学习成本模型对采样程序进行微调，以识别最佳程序。Ansor能够找到现有最先进方法搜索空间之外的高性能程序。此外，Ansor利用任务调度器同时优化深度神经网络中的多个子图。我们表明，在Intel CPU、ARM CPU和NVIDIA GPU上，相对于最先进方法，Ansor将深度神经网络的执行性能分别提升了最多3.8倍、2.6倍和1.7倍。

upstream_only.title: RAMMER: enabling holistic deep learning compiler optimizations with rtasks
upstream_only.abstract: Performing Deep Neural Network (DNN) computation on hardware accelerators efficiently is challenging. Existing DNN frameworks and compilers often treat the DNN operators in a data flow graph (DFG) as opaque library functions and schedule them onto accelerators to be executed individually. They rely on another layer of scheduler, often implemented in hardware, to exploit the parallelism available in the operators. Such a two-layered approach incurs significant scheduling overhead and often cannot fully utilize the available hardware resources. In this paper, we propose RAMMER, a DNN compiler design that optimizes the execution of DNN workloads on massively parallel accelerators. RAMMER generates an efficient static spatio-temporal schedule for a DNN at compile time to minimize scheduling overhead. It maximizes hardware utilization by holistically exploiting parallelism through inter- and intra- operator co-scheduling. RAMMER achieves this by proposing several novel, hardware neutral, and clean abstractions for the computation tasks and the hardware accelerators. These abstractions expose a much richer scheduling space to RAMMER, which employs several heuristics to explore this space and finds efficient schedules. We implement RAMMER for multiple hardware backends such as NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, and Graphcore IPU. Experiments show RAMMER significantly outperforms state-of-the-art compilers such as TensorFlow XLA and TVM by up to 20.1\texttimes{}. It also outperforms TensorRT, a vendor optimized proprietary DNN inference library from NVIDIA, by up to 3.1\texttimes{}
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在硬件加速器上高效执行深度神经网络（DNN）计算是一项挑战。现有的DNN框架和编译器通常将数据流图（DFG）中的DNN算子视为不透明的库函数，并调度它们到加速器上单独执行。它们依赖另一层调度器（通常在硬件中实现）来利用算子中可用的并行性。这种两层方法会带来显著的调度开销，并且往往无法充分利用可用的硬件资源。在本文中，我们提出RAMMER，一种DNN编译器设计，用于优化在大规模并行加速器上执行DNN工作负载。RAMMER在编译时为DNN生成高效的静态时空调度，以最小化调度开销。它通过跨算子和算子内协同调度全面利用并行性，从而最大化硬件利用率。RAMMER通过为计算任务和硬件加速器提出几种新颖、硬件无关且干净的抽象来实现这一点。这些抽象为RAMMER暴露了更丰富的调度空间，RAMMER采用多种启发式方法探索该空间并找到高效的调度。我们为多种硬件后端实现了RAMMER，如NVIDIA GPU、AMD GPU和Graphcore IPU。实验表明，RAMMER显著优于最先进的编译器，如TensorFlow XLA和TVM，最高可达20.1倍。它也优于NVIDIA的专有DNN推理库TensorRT，最高可达3.1倍。

upstream_only.title: A tensor compiler for unified machine learning prediction serving
upstream_only.abstract: Machine Learning (ML) adoption in the enterprise requires simpler and more efficient software infrastructure--the bespoke solutions typical in large web companies are simply untenable. Model scoring, the process of obtaining predictions from a trained model over new data, is a primary contributor to infrastructure complexity and cost as models are trained once but used many times. In this paper we propose HUMMINGBIRD, a novel approach to model scoring, which compiles featurization operators and traditional ML models (e.g., decision trees) into a small set of tensor operations. This approach inherently reduces infrastructure complexity and directly leverages existing investments in Neural Network compilers and runtimes to generate efficient computations for both CPU and hardware accelerators. Our performance results are intriguing: despite replacing imperative computations (e.g., tree traversals) with tensor computation abstractions, HUMMINGBIRD is competitive and often outperforms hand-crafted kernels on micro-benchmarks on both CPU and GPU, while enabling seamless end-to-end acceleration of ML pipelines. We have released HUMMINGBIRD as open source.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在企业的机器学习应用中，采用ML需要更简单、更高效的软件基础设施——大型网络公司中典型的定制解决方案根本不可持续。模型评分，即从训练好的模型对新数据进行预测的过程，是基础设施复杂性和成本的主要来源，因为模型通常只训练一次却会被多次使用。在本文中，我们提出了HUMMINGBIRD，一种新颖的模型评分方法，它将特征工程算子以及传统ML模型（如决策树）编译成一小部分张量操作。这种方法从根本上降低了基础设施的复杂性，并直接利用现有的神经网络编译器和运行时的投资，为CPU和硬件加速器生成高效计算。我们的性能结果引人关注：尽管将命令式计算（如树遍历）替换为张量计算抽象，HUMMINGBIRD在CPU和GPU上的微基准测试中依然具有竞争力并常常超过手工调优的内核，同时实现了ML流水线的无缝端到端加速。我们已将HUMMINGBIRD作为开源软件发布。

upstream_only.title: Retiarii: a deep learning exploratory-training framework
upstream_only.abstract: Traditional deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch support training on a single deep neural network (DNN) model, which involves computing the weights iteratively for the DNN model. Designing a DNN model for a task remains an experimental science and is typically a practice of deep learning model exploration, dovetailed with training and validation, aiming to find the best model among a set that yields the best result. Retrofitting such exploratory-training into the training process of a single DNN model, as supported by current deep learning frameworks, is unintuitive, cumbersome, and inefficient, because of the fundamental mismatch between exploring a set of models and training a single one.Retiarii is the first framework to support deep learning exploratory-training. In particular, Retiarii (i) provides a new programming interface to specify a DNN model space for exploration, as well as an interface to describe the exploration strategy that decides which order to instantiate and train models in, how to prioritize model training, and when to terminate training of certain models; (ii) offers a Just-In-Time (JIT) engine that instantiates models, manages the training of the instantiated models, gathers the information for the exploration strategy to consume, and executes the decisions accordingly; (iii) identifies the correlations between the instantiated models and develops a set of cross-model optimizations to improve the overall exploratory-training process. Retiarii does so by introducing a key abstraction, Mutator, that connects the specifications of DNN model spaces and exploration strategies, while exposing the correlations between models for optimization. As a result, Retiarii's clean separation of DNN model space specification, exploration strategy, and cross-model optimizations, connected through the single mutator abstraction, leads to ease of programming, reuse of components, and vastly improved (up to 8.58x) overall exploratory-training efficiency.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 传统的深度学习框架如TensorFlow和PyTorch支持对单个深度神经网络（DNN）模型进行训练，这涉及迭代计算该模型的权重。为一个任务设计DNN模型仍是一门实验科学，通常是一种深度学习模型探索的实践，与训练和验证相结合，旨在从一组模型中找出产生最佳结果的最佳模型。由于探索一组模型与训练单个模型之间存在根本上的不匹配，因此将这种探索性训练改造成当前深度学习框架所支持的单DNN模型训练过程是不直观的、笨拙且低效的。Retiarii是首个支持深度学习探索训练框架的框架。具体来说，Retiarii（i）提供了一种新的编程接口来指定待探索的DNN模型空间，以及一种描述探索策略的接口，该策略决定以何种顺序实例化和训练模型、如何对模型训练进行优先级排序、以及何时终止某些模型的训练；（ii）提供了一个即时（JIT）引擎，用于实例化模型、管理已实例化模型的训练、收集供探索策略使用的信息，并据此执行决策；（iii）识别已实例化模型之间的相关性，并开发一套跨模型优化以提高整体探索训练过程。Retiarii通过引入一个关键抽象——Mutator——来实现这一点，该抽象连接了DNN模型空间和探索策略的规范，同时暴露了模型之间的相关性以供优化。因此，Retiarii将DNN模型空间规范、探索策略和跨模型优化通过单一变体抽象清晰分离，带来了易于编程、组件复用以及整体探索训练效率的极大提升（最高达8.58倍）。

upstream_only.title: KungFu: making training in distributed machine learning adaptive
upstream_only.abstract: When using distributed machine learning (ML) systems to train models on a cluster of worker machines, users must configure a large number of parameters: hyper-parameters (e.g. the batch size and the learning rate) affect model convergence; system parameters (e.g. the number of workers and their communication topology) impact training performance. In current systems, adapting such parameters during training is ill-supported. Users must set system parameters at deployment time, and provide fixed adaptation schedules for hyper-parameters in the training program.We describe KungFu, a distributed ML library for Tensor-Flow that is designed to enable adaptive training. KungFu allows users to express high-level Adaptation Policies (APs) that describe how to change hyper- and system parameters during training. APs take real-time monitored metrics (e.g. signal-to-noise ratios and noise scale) as input and trigger control actions (e.g. cluster rescaling or synchronisation strategy updates). For execution, APs are translated into monitoring and control operators, which are embedded in the dataflow graph. APs exploit an efficient asynchronous collective communication layer, which ensures concurrency and consistency of monitoring and adaptation operations.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在使用分布式机器学习（ML）系统在worker机器集群上训练模型时，用户必须配置大量参数：超参数（例如批大小和学习率）影响模型收敛；系统参数（例如worker数量及其通信拓扑）影响训练性能。在现有系统中，训练期间调整此类参数支持不足。用户必须在部署时设置系统参数，并在训练程序中提供固定的超参数调整计划。我们提出了KungFu，一个旨在支持自适应训练的TensorFlow分布式ML库。KungFu允许用户表达描述训练期间如何更改超参数和系统参数的高级调整策略（AP）。AP将实时监控指标（如信噪比和噪声尺度）作为输入，并触发控制动作（如集群动态调整规模或同步策略更新）。为执行，AP被翻译成监控和控制算子，嵌入数据流图中。AP利用高效的异步集体通信层，确保监控和自适应操作之间的并发性和一致性。

upstream_only.title: FVM: FPGA-assisted virtual device emulation for fast, scalable, and flexible storage virtualization
upstream_only.abstract: Emerging big-data workloads with massive I/O processing require fast, scalable, and flexible storage virtualization support. Hardware-assisted virtualization can achieve reasonable performance for fast storage devices, but it comes at the expense of limited functionalities in a virtualized environment (e.g., migration, replication, caching). To restore the VM features with minimal performance degradation, recent advances propose to implement a new software-based virtualization layer by dedicating computing cores to virtual device emulation. However, due to the dedication of expensive generalpurpose cores and the nature of host-driven storage device management, the proposed schemes raise the critical performance and scalability issues with the increasing number and performance of storage devices per server.In this paper, we propose FVM, a new hardware-assisted storage virtualization mechanism to achieve high performance and scalability while maintaining the flexibility to support various VM features. The key idea is to implement (1) a storage virtualization layer on an FPGA card (FVM-engine) decoupled from the host resources and (2) a device-control method to have the card directly manage the physical storage devices. In this way, a server equipped with FVM-engine can save the invaluable host-side resources (i.e., CPU, memory bandwidth) from virtual and physical device management and utilize the decoupled FPGA resources for virtual device emulation. Our FVM-engine prototype outperforms existing storage virtualization schemes while maintaining the same flexibility and programmability as software implementations.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 新兴的大数据工作负载具有海量I/O处理需求，要求快速、可扩展且灵活的存储虚拟化支持。硬件辅助虚拟化可以为快速存储设备提供合理的性能，但代价是虚拟化环境中的功能受限（例如迁移、复制、缓存）。为了在性能损失最小的情况下恢复VM功能，近期研究提出通过将计算核心专用于虚拟设备仿真来实现新的基于软件的虚拟化层。然而，由于专用昂贵的通用核心以及主机驱动存储设备管理的特性，所提出方案随着每台服务器存储设备的数量和性能的增加而面临严重的性能和可扩展性问题。本文提出了FVM，一种新的硬件辅助存储虚拟化机制，以实现高性能和可扩展性，同时保持支持各种VM功能的灵活性。关键思想是：（1）在与主机资源解耦的FPGA卡（FVM引擎）上实现存储虚拟化层，（2）采用设备控制方法，让该卡直接管理物理存储设备。这样，配备FVM引擎的服务器可以从虚拟和物理设备管理中节省宝贵的主机侧资源（即CPU、内存带宽），并利用解耦的FPGA资源进行虚拟设备仿真。我们的FVM引擎原型在保持与软件实现相同的灵活性和可编程性的同时，性能优于现有存储虚拟化方案。

upstream_only.title: hXDP: efficient software packet processing on FPGA NICs
upstream_only.abstract: FPGA accelerators on the NIC enable the offloading of expensive packet processing tasks from the CPU. However, FPGAs have limited resources that may need to be shared among diverse applications, and programming them is difficult.We present a solution to run Linux's eXpress Data Path programs written in eBPF on FPGAs, using only a fraction of the available hardware resources while matching the performance of high-end CPUs. The iterative execution model of eBPF is not a good fit for FPGA accelerators. Nonetheless, we show that many of the instructions of an eBPF program can be compressed, parallelized or completely removed, when targeting a purpose-built FPGA executor, thereby significantly improving performance. We leverage that to design hXDP, which includes (i) an optimizing-compiler that parallelizes and translates eBPF bytecode to an extended eBPF Instruction-set Architecture defined by us; a (ii) soft-CPU to execute such instructions on FPGA; and (iii) an FPGA-based infrastructure to provide XDP's maps and helper functions as defined within the Linux kernel.We implement hXDP on an FPGA NIC and evaluate it running real-world unmodified eBPF programs. Our implementation is clocked at 156.25MHz, uses about 15\% of the FPGA resources, and can run dynamically loaded programs. Despite these modest requirements, it achieves the packet processing throughput of a high-end CPU core and provides a 10x lower packet forwarding latency.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 网卡上的FPGA加速器能够将昂贵的报文处理任务从CPU卸载。然而，FPGA硬件资源有限，可能需要由多种应用共享，且对其进行编程十分困难。我们提出一种解决方案，在FPGA上运行用eBPF编写的Linux eXpress Data Path程序，仅使用可用硬件资源的一小部分，同时达到高端CPU的性能。eBPF的迭代执行模型并不适合FPGA加速器。尽管如此，我们表明，当针对专门构建的FPGA执行器时，eBPF程序的许多指令可以被压缩、并行化或完全移除，从而显著提高性能。我们据此设计了hXDP，其包括：(i) 一个优化编译器，用于并行化eBPF字节码并将其转换为我们定义的扩展eBPF指令集架构；(ii) 一个在FPGA上执行这些指令的软CPU；(iii) 一个基于FPGA的基础设施，提供Linux内核中定义的XDP映射和辅助函数。我们在FPGA网卡上实现了hXDP，并运行真实的、未修改的eBPF程序进行评测。实现时钟频率为156.25MHz，使用约15%的FPGA资源，并能运行动态加载的程序。尽管资源需求很小，它仍能达到高端CPU核心的报文处理吞吐量，并提供10倍更低的报文转发延迟。

upstream_only.title: Do OS abstractions make sense on FPGAs?
upstream_only.abstract: Hybrid computing systems, consisting of a CPU server coupled with a Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) for application acceleration, are today a common facility in datacenters and clouds. FPGAs can deliver tremendous improvements in performance and energy e_ciency for a range or workloads, but development and deployment of FPGA-based applications remains cumbersome, leading to recent work which replicates subsets of the traditional OS execution environment (virtual memory, processes, etc.) on the FPGA.In this paper we ask a different question: to what extent do traditional OS abstractions make sense in the context of an FPGA as part of a hybrid system, particularly when taken as a complete package, as they would be in an OS? To answer this, we built and evaluated Coyote, an open source, portable, configurable "shell" for FPGAs which provides a full suite of OS abstractions, working with the host OS. Coyote supports secure spatial and temporal multiplexing of the FPGA between tenants, virtual memory, communication, and memory management inside a uniform execution environment. The overhead of Coyote is small and the performance benefit is significant, but more importantly it allows us to reflect on whether importing OS abstractions wholesale to FPGAs is the best way forward.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 混合计算系统——由CPU服务器与用于应用加速的现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）耦合而成——如今已成为数据中心和云中的常见设施。FPGA可以为一系列工作负载带来巨大的性能和能效提升，但基于FPGA的应用开发和部署仍然繁琐，这促使近期工作在FPGA上复制传统操作系统执行环境的子集（虚拟内存、进程等）。在本文中，我们提出一个不同的问题：在混合系统中，作为FPGA一部分时，传统操作系统抽象在多大程度上是有意义的，特别是当它们作为一个完整包（如同在操作系统中那样）被采用时？为了回答这一问题，我们构建并评估了Coyote——一个开源的、可移植的、可配置的FPGA“外壳”，它提供了全套操作系统抽象，并与主机操作系统协同工作。Coyote支持在租户之间对FPGA进行安全的空间和时间复用，并在统一执行环境中提供虚拟内存、通信和内存管理。Coyote的开销很小，性能收益显著，但更重要的是，它使我们反思：将操作系统抽象整体引入FPGA是否是最佳前进方向。

upstream_only.title: Assise: performance and availability via client-local NVM in a distributed file system
upstream_only.abstract: The adoption of low latency persistent memory modules (PMMs) upends the long-established model of remote storage for distributed file systems. Instead, by colocating computation with PMM storage, we can provide applications with much higher IO performance, sub-second application failover, and strong consistency. To demonstrate this, we built the Assise distributed file system, based on a persistent, replicated coherence protocol that manages client-local PMM as a linearizable and crash-recoverable cache between applications and slower (and possibly remote) storage. Assise maximizes locality for all file IO by carrying out IO on process-local, socket-local, and client-local PMM whenever possible. Assise minimizes coherence overhead by maintaining consistency at IO operation granularity, rather than at fixed block sizes.We compare Assise to Ceph/BlueStore, NFS, and Octopus on a cluster with Intel Optane DC PMMs and SSDs for common cloud applications and benchmarks, such as LevelDB, Postfix, and FileBench. We find that Assise improves write latency up to 22\texttimes{}, throughput up to 56\texttimes{}, fail-over time up to 103\texttimes{}, and scales up to 6\texttimes{} better than its counterparts, while providing stronger consistency semantics.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 低延迟持久内存模块（PMM）的采用颠覆了分布式文件系统长期以来的远程存储模式。相反，通过将计算与PMM存储放在一起，我们可以为应用程序提供更高的IO性能、亚秒级应用程序故障转移和强一致性。为了证明这一点，我们构建了基于持久化、复制一致性协议的Assise分布式文件系统，该协议将客户端本地PMM管理为应用程序与较慢（可能远程）存储之间的线性化、崩溃可恢复的缓存。Assise尽可能在进程本地、套接字本地和客户端本地的PMM上执行IO，从而最大化所有文件IO的局部性。Assise通过在IO操作粒度而非固定块大小上维持一致性，最小化一致性开销。我们将Assise与Ceph/BlueStore、NFS和Octopus在配备Intel Optane DC PMM和SSD的集群上，针对常见云应用和基准（如LevelDB、Postfix和FileBench）进行了比较。我们发现，Assise将写入延迟提升高达22倍，吞吐量提升高达56倍，故障转移时间缩短高达103倍，并且扩展性比同类系统好6倍，同时提供了更强的一致性语义。

upstream_only.title: Persistent state machines for recoverable in-memory storage systems with NVRam
upstream_only.abstract: Distributed in-memory storage systems are crucial for meeting the low latency requirements of modern datacenter services. However, they lose all state on failure, so recovery is expensive and data loss is always a risk. Persistent memory (PM) offers the possibility of building fast, persistent in-memory storage; however, existing PM systems are built from scratch or require heavy modification of existing systems. To rectify these problems, this paper presents Persimmon, a PM-based system that converts existing distributed in-memory storage systems into persistent, crash-consistent versions with low overhead and minimal code changes.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 分布式内存存储系统对于满足现代数据中心服务的低延迟要求至关重要。然而，它们在故障时会丢失所有状态，因此恢复成本高昂且数据丢失始终是风险。持久内存（PM）为构建快速、持久的内存存储提供了可能性；然而，现有的PM系统要么从零构建，要么需要对现有系统进行大幅修改。为了解决这些问题，本文提出了Persimmon，一种基于PM的系统，可将现有的分布式内存存储系统转换为具有低开销和最少代码更改的持久、崩溃一致性的版本。

upstream_only.title: AGAMOTTO: how persistent is your persistent memory application?
upstream_only.abstract: Persistent Memory (PM) can be used by applications to directly and quickly persist any data structure, without the overhead of a file system. However, writing PM applications that are simultaneously correct and efficient is challenging. As a result, PM applications contain correctness and performance bugs. Prior work on testing PM systems has low bug coverage as it relies primarily on extensive test cases and developer annotations.In this paper we aim to build a system for more thoroughly testing PM applications. We inform our design using a detailed study of 63 bugs from popular PM projects. We identify two application-independent patterns of PM misuse which account for the majority of bugs in our study and can be detected automatically. The remaining application-specific bugs can be detected using compact custom oracles provided by developers.We then present AGAMOTTO, a generic and extensible system for discovering misuse of persistent memory in PM applications. Unlike existing tools that rely on extensive test cases or annotations, AGAMOTTO symbolically executes PM systems to discover bugs. AGAMOTTO introduces a new symbolic memory model that is able to represent whether or not PM state has been made persistent. AGAMOTTO uses a state space exploration algorithm, which drives symbolic execution towards program locations that are susceptible to persistency bugs. AGAMOTTO has so far identified 84 new bugs in 5 different PM applications and frameworks while incurring no false positives.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 持久内存（PM）使应用程序能够直接且快速地持久化任何数据结构，无需文件系统的开销。然而，编写既正确又高效的PM应用程序颇具挑战性。因此，PM应用程序存在正确性和性能缺陷。先前关于PM系统测试的工作主要依赖大量测试用例和开发者注释，导致缺陷覆盖率较低。本文旨在构建一个更彻底地测试PM应用程序的系统。我们通过对流行PM项目中63个缺陷的详细研究来指导设计。我们识别出两种与应用无关的PM误用模式，这些模式占据了研究中大部分缺陷，并且可以自动检测。其余特定于应用的缺陷可以使用开发者提供的紧凑自定义预言机进行检测。随后我们介绍了AGAMOTTO，一个用于发现PM应用程序中持久内存误用的通用且可扩展的系统。与依赖大量测试用例或注释的现有工具不同，AGAMOTTO通过符号执行PM系统来发现缺陷。AGAMOTTO引入了一种新的符号内存模型，能够表示PM状态是否已持久化。AGAMOTTO使用状态空间探索算法，将符号执行引导至易受持久性缺陷影响的程序位置。迄今，AGAMOTTO已在5个不同的PM应用程序和框架中发现84个新缺陷，且没有产生误报。

upstream_only.title: Orchard: differentially private analytics at scale
upstream_only.abstract: This paper presents Orchard, a system that can answer queries about sensitive data that is held by millions of user devices, with strong differential privacy guarantees. Orchard combines high accuracy with good scalability, and it uses only a single untrusted party to facilitate the query. Moreover, whereas previous solutions that shared these properties were custom-built for specific queries, Orchard is general and can accept a wide range of queries. Orchard accomplishes this by rewriting queries into a distributed protocol that can be executed efficiently at scale, using cryptographic primitives.Our prototype of Orchard can execute 14 out of 17 queries chosen from the literature; to our knowledge, no other system can handle more than one of them in this setting. And the costs are moderate: each user device typically needs only a few megabytes of traffic and a few minutes of computation time. Orchard also includes a novel defense against malicious users who attempt to distort the results of a query.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文提出了Orchard，一个能够针对由数百万用户设备持有的敏感数据回答问题，并提供强差分隐私保证的系统。Orchard将高准确性与良好的可扩展性相结合，并且仅使用一个不受信任的方来促进查询。此外，以往的解决方案虽具有这些特性，但都是针对特定查询定制的，而Orchard是通用的，可以接受广泛的查询。Orchard通过使用密码学原语将查询重写为可大规模高效执行的分布式协议来实现这一点。我们的Orchard原型能够执行从文献中选出的17个查询中的14个；据我们所知，在此场景下，没有其他系统能够处理超过一个此类查询。而且成本适中：每个用户设备通常只需要几兆字节的流量和几分钟的计算时间。Orchard还包含一种针对恶意用户试图扭曲查询结果的新型防御措施。

upstream_only.title: Achieving 100Gbps intrusion prevention on a single server
upstream_only.abstract: Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS) are among the most demanding stateful network functions. Today's network operators are faced with securing 100Gbps networks with 100K+ concurrent connections by deploying IDS/IPSes to search for 10K+ rules concurrently. In this paper we set an ambitious goal: Can we do all of the above in a single server? Through the Pigasus IDS/IPS, we show that this goal is achievable, perhaps for the first time, by building on recent advances in FPGA-capable SmartNICs. Pigasus' design takes an FPGA-first approach, where the majority of processing, and all state and control flow are managed on the FPGA. However, doing so requires careful design of algorithms and data structures to ensure fast common-case performance while densely utilizing system memory resources. Our experiments with a variety of traces show that Pigasus can support 100Gbps using an average of 5 cores and 1 FPGA, using 38\texttimes{} less power than a CPU-only approach.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 入侵检测与防御系统(IDS/IPS)是要求最苛刻的有状态网络功能之一。当今的网络运营商需要通过部署IDS/IPS来保护100Gbps网络，同时处理10万+并发连接，并并发搜索1万+规则。本文设定了一个雄心勃勃的目标：能否在单台服务器上完成以上所有任务？通过Pigasus IDS/IPS，我们展示了这一目标或许是首次得以实现，其关键在于利用了基于FPGA的SmartNIC的最新进展。Pigasus采用FPGA优先的设计，大部分处理以及所有状态和控制流均在FPGA上进行管理。然而，这需要仔细设计算法和数据结构，以确保常见情况下的快速性能，同时密集利用系统内存资源。我们使用多种流量进行的实验表明，Pigasus平均使用5个CPU核心和1个FPGA即可支持100Gbps，功耗比纯CPU方案低38倍。

upstream_only.title: DORY: an encrypted search system with distributed trust
upstream_only.abstract: Efficient, leakage-free search on encrypted data has remained an unsolved problem for the last two decades; efficient schemes are vulnerable to leakage-abuse attacks, and schemes that eliminate leakage are impractical to deploy. To overcome this tradeoff, we reexamine the system model. We surveyed five companies providing end-to-end encrypted filesharing to better understand what they require from an encrypted search system. Based on our findings, we design and build DORY, an encrypted search system that addresses real-world requirements and protects search access patterns; namely, when a user searches for a keyword over the files within a folder, the server learns only that a search happens in that folder, but does not learn which documents match the search, the number of documents that match, or other information about the keyword. DORYsplits trust between multiple servers to protect against a malicious attacker who controls all but one of the servers. We develop new cryptographic and systems techniques to meet the efficiency and trust model requirements outlined by the companies we surveyed. We implement DORY and show that it performs orders of magnitude better than a baseline built on ORAM. Parallelized across 8 servers, each with 16 CPUs, DORY takes 116ms to search roughly 50K documents and 862ms to search over 1M documents.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在加密数据上进行高效、无泄漏的搜索在过去二十年里一直是一个未解决的问题；高效方案容易受到泄漏滥用攻击，而消除泄漏的方案又不切实际，难以部署。为了克服这种权衡，我们重新审视了系统模型。我们调查了五家提供端到端加密文件共享的公司，以更好地了解他们对加密搜索系统的需求。基于我们的发现，我们设计并构建了DORY，一个满足现实需求并保护搜索访问模式的加密搜索系统；即，当用户在一个文件夹中的文件上搜索关键字时，服务器只知道该文件夹中发生了搜索，但不会知道哪些文档匹配搜索、匹配的文档数量，或其他关于该关键字的信息。DORY在多个服务器之间分散信任，以防御一个控制除一台服务器外所有服务器的恶意攻击者。我们开发了新的密码学和系统技术，以满足所调查公司提出的效率和信任模型要求。我们实现了DORY，并表明其性能比基于ORAM的基线高出几个数量级。在8台服务器（每台16个CPU）上并行化时，DORY搜索约5万个文档需116毫秒，搜索超过100万个文档需862毫秒。

upstream_only.title: SafetyPin: encrypted backups with human-memorable secrets
upstream_only.abstract: We present the design and implementation of Safety-Pin, a system for encrypted mobile-device backups. Like existing cloud-based mobile-backup systems, including those of Apple and Google, SafetyPin requires users to remember only a short PIN and defends against brute-force PIN-guessing attacks using hardware security protections. Unlike today's systems, SafetyPin splits trust over a cluster of hardware security modules (HSMs) in order to provide security guarantees that scale with the number of HSMs. In this way, SafetyPin protects backed-up user data even against an attacker that can adaptively compromise many of the system's constituent HSMs. SafetyPin provides this protection without sacrificing scalability or fault tolerance. Decentralizing trust while respecting the resource limits of today's HSMs requires a synthesis of systems-design principles and cryptographic tools. We evaluate SafetyPin on a cluster of 100 low-cost HSMs and show that a SafetyPin-protected recovery takes 1.01 seconds. To process 1B recoveries a year, we estimate that a SafetyPin deployment would need 3,100 low-cost HSMs.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了Safety-Pin的设计与实现，这是一个用于加密移动设备备份的系统。与现有的基于云端的移动备份系统（包括苹果和谷歌的系统）类似，SafetyPin要求用户仅记住一个短PIN码，并利用硬件安全保护来抵御暴力破解PIN码猜测攻击。与当今系统不同的是，SafetyPin将信任分散到一个硬件安全模块（HSM）集群上，以提供随HSM数量增长的安全保证。通过这种方式，即使攻击者能够自适应地破坏系统中的许多组成HSM，SafetyPin也能保护备份的用户数据。SafetyPin在不牺牲可扩展性或容错性的情况下提供了这种保护。在尊重当今HSM资源限制的同时分散信任，需要系统设计原则和密码学工具的综合运用。我们在一个由100个低成本HSM组成的集群上对SafetyPin进行了评估，结果表明经过SafetyPin保护的恢复过程耗时1.01秒。我们估计，为了每年处理10亿次恢复，SafetyPin部署需要3100个低成本HSM。

upstream_only.title: Efficiently mitigating transient execution attacks using the unmapped speculation contract
upstream_only.abstract: Today's kernels pay a performance penalty for mitigations-- such as KPTI, retpoline, return stack stuffing, speculation barriers--to protect against transient execution side-channel attacks such as Meltdown [21] and Spectre [16].To address this performance penalty, this paper articulates the unmapped speculation contract, an observation that memory that isn't mapped in a page table cannot be leaked through transient execution. To demonstrate the value of this contract, the paper presents WARD, a new kernel design that maintains a separate kernel page table for every process. This page table contains mappings for kernel memory that is safe to expose to that process. Because a process doesn't map data of other processes, this design allows for many system calls to execute without any mitigation overhead. When a process needs access to sensitive data, WARD switches to a kernel page table that provides access to all of memory and executes with all mitigations.An evaluation of the WARD design implemented in the sv6 research kernel [8] shows that LEBench [24] can execute many system calls without mitigations. For some hardware generations, this results in performance improvement ranging from a few percent (huge page fault) to several factors (getpid), compared to a standard design with mitigations.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 当今的内核为缓解瞬态执行侧信道攻击（如Meltdown和Spectre）而采取的措施（如KPTI、retpoline、返回栈填充、推测屏障）付出了性能代价。为了解决这一性能损失，本文阐述了“未映射推测契约”这一观察，即页表中未映射的内存不能通过瞬态执行泄露。为了展示该契约的价值，本文提出了WARD，一种新的内核设计，为每个进程维护独立的页表。该页表包含对该进程安全暴露的内核内存映射。由于进程不映射其他进程的数据，这种设计允许许多系统调用在没有任何缓解开销的情况下执行。当进程需要访问敏感数据时，WARD切换到提供对全部内存访问权限的内核页表，并在启用所有缓解措施的情况下执行。在sv6研究内核[8]中实现的WARD设计评估表明，LEBench[24]可以在无缓解措施的情况下执行许多系统调用。对于某些硬件代际，与带有缓解措施的标准设计相比，这带来了从几个百分点（巨页错误）到数倍（getpid）的性能提升。

upstream_only.title: Predictive and adaptive failure mitigation to avert production cloud VM interruptions
upstream_only.abstract: When a failure occurs in production systems, the highest priority is to quickly mitigate it. Despite its importance, failure mitigation is done in a reactive and ad-hoc way: taking some fixed actions only after a severe symptom is observed. For cloud systems, such a strategy is inadequate. In this paper, we propose a preventive and adaptive failure mitigation service, NARYA, that is integrated in a production cloud, Microsoft Azure's compute platform. Narya predicts imminent host failures based on multi-layer system signals and then decides smart mitigation actions. The goal is to avert VM failures. Narya's decision engine takes a novel online experimentation approach to continually explore the best mitigation action. Narya further enhances the adaptive decision capability through reinforcement learning. Narya has been running in production for 15 months. It on average reduces VM interruptions by 26\% compared to the previous static strategy.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 当生产系统发生故障时，最高优先级是快速缓解故障。尽管故障缓解至关重要，但其执行方式却是反应性和临时性的：只有在观察到严重症状后才采取某些固定行动。对于云系统而言，这种策略并不充分。在本文中，我们提出了一种预防性和自适应的故障缓解服务NARYA，该服务集成在生产云即微软Azure的计算平台中。Narya基于多层系统信号预测即将发生的主机故障，然后决定智能的缓解行动，目标是避免虚拟机故障。Narya的决策引擎采用新颖的在线实验方法，持续探索最佳缓解行动，并通过强化学习进一步增强自适应决策能力。Narya已在生产中运行15个月，与之前的静态策略相比，平均将虚拟机中断减少了26%。

upstream_only.title: Sundial: fault-tolerant clock synchronization for datacenters
upstream_only.abstract: Clock synchronization is critical for many datacenter applications such as distributed transactional databases, consistent snapshots, and network telemetry. As applications have increasing performance requirements and datacenter networks get into ultra-low latency, we need submicrosecond-level bound on time-uncertainty to reduce transaction delay and enable new network management applications (e.g., measuring one-way delay for congestion control). The state-of-the-art clock synchronization solutions focus on improving clock precision but may incur significant time-uncertainty bound due to the presence of failures. This significantly affects applications because in large-scale datacenters, temperature-related, link, device, and domain failures are common. We present Sundial, a fault-tolerant clock synchronization system for datacenters that achieves ∼100ns time-uncertainty bound under various types of failures. Sundial provides fast failure detection based on frequent synchronization messages in hardware. Sundial enables fast failure recovery using a novel graph-based algorithm to precompute a backup plan that is generic to failures. Through experiments in a >500-machine testbed and large-scale simulations, we show that Sundial can achieve ∼100ns time-uncertainty bound under different types of failures, which is more than two orders of magnitude lower than the state-of-the-art solutions. We also demonstrate the benefit of Sundial on applications such as Spanner and Swift congestion control.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 对于许多数据中心应用（例如分布式事务数据库、一致性快照和网络遥测）来说，时钟同步至关重要。随着应用性能需求不断提高，且数据中心网络进入超低延迟时代，我们需要将时间不确定性的上界控制在亚微秒级，以减少事务延迟并支持新的网络管理应用（例如，测量单向时延以实施拥塞控制）。最先进的时钟同步解决方案注重提高时钟精度，但在故障存在时可能会产生较大的时间不确定性界限。这会显著影响应用的表现，因为在大型数据中心中，与温度相关的故障、链路故障、设备故障和域故障都很常见。我们提出Sundial，一种面向数据中心的容错时钟同步系统，在各种故障下可实现约100纳秒的时间不确定性界限。Sundial基于硬件中的高频同步消息提供快速故障检测。Sundial借助一种新颖的基于图的算法预先计算对故障具有通用性的备份方案，从而实现快速故障恢复。通过在一个由超过500台机器组成的测试平台上的实验和大规模仿真，我们表明，在不同类型的故障下，Sundial可实现约100纳秒的时间不确定性界限，比现有最优方案低两个数量级以上。我们还展示了Sundial在Spanner和Swift拥塞控制等应用中的优势。

upstream_only.title: Fault-tolerant and transactional stateful serverless workflows
upstream_only.abstract: This paper introduces Beldi, a library and runtime system for writing and composing fault-tolerant and transactional stateful serverless functions. Beldi runs on existing providers and lets developers write complex stateful applications that require fault tolerance and transactional semantics without the need to deal with tasks such as load balancing or maintaining virtual machines. Beldi's contributions include extending the log-based fault-tolerant approach in Olive (OSDI 2016) with new data structures, transaction protocols, function invocations, and garbage collection. They also include adapting the resulting framework to work over a federated environment where each serverless function has sovereignty over its own data. We implement three applications on Beldi, including a movie review service, a travel reservation system, and a social media site. Our evaluation on 1,000 AWS Lambdas shows that Beldi's approach is effective and affordable.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了Beldi，一个用于编写和组合容错且事务性有状态无服务器函数的库和运行时系统。Beldi在现有提供商上运行，让开发人员可以编写需要容错和事务语义的复杂有状态应用程序，而无需处理负载平衡或维护虚拟机等任务。Beldi的贡献包括在Olive（OSDI 2016）中基于日志的容错方法的基础上，扩展了新的数据结构、事务协议、函数调用和垃圾收集。还包括使所得框架能够适应联邦环境，在这种环境中每个无服务器函数对其自身数据拥有主权。我们在Beldi上实现三个应用，包括电影评论服务、旅行预订系统和社交媒体网站。我们在1000个AWS Lambda上的评估表明，Beldi的方法是有效且可负担的。

upstream_only.title: Unearthing inter-job dependencies for better cluster scheduling
upstream_only.abstract: Inter-job dependencies pervade shared data analytics infrastructures (so-called "data lakes"), as jobs read output files written by previous jobs, yet are often invisible to current cluster schedulers. Jobs are submitted one-by-one, without indicating dependencies, and the scheduler considers them independently based on priority, fairness, etc. This paper analyzes hidden inter-job dependencies in a 50k+ node analytics cluster at Microsoft, based on job and data provenance logs, finding that nearly 80\% of all jobs depend on at least one other job. Yet, even in a business-critical setting, we see jobs that fail because they depend on not-yet-completed jobs, jobs that depend on jobs of lower priority, and other difficulties with hidden inter-job dependencies.The Wing dependency profiler analyzes job and data provenance logs to find hidden inter-job dependencies, characterizes them, and provides improved guidance to a cluster scheduler. Specifically, for the 68\% of jobs (in the analyzed data lake) that exhibit their dependencies in a recurring fashion, Wing predicts the impact of a pending job on subsequent jobs and user downloads, and uses that information to refine valuation of that job by the scheduler. In simulations driven by real job logs, we find that a traditional YARN scheduler that uses Wing-provided valuations in place of user-specified priorities extracts more value (in terms of successful dependent jobs and user downloads) from a heavily-loaded cluster. By relying completely on Wing for guidance, YARN can achieve nearly 100\% of value at constrained cluster capacities, almost 2\texttimes{} that achieved by using the user-provided job priorities.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 作业间依赖关系普遍存在于共享数据分析基础设施（所谓的“数据湖”）中，因为作业会读取先前作业写入的输出文件，但这些依赖关系往往对当前的集群调度器不可见。作业逐个提交，不指明依赖关系，调度器基于优先级、公平性等独立考虑它们。本文基于作业和数据溯源日志，分析了微软一个拥有超过5万个节点的分析集群中的隐藏作业间依赖关系，发现近80%的作业至少依赖另一个作业。然而，即使在业务关键环境中，我们也观察到作业因依赖尚未完成的作业而失败、作业依赖低优先级作业，以及其他因隐藏作业间依赖关系导致的困难。Wing依赖分析器分析作业和数据溯源日志，发现隐藏的作业间依赖关系，刻画其特征，并为集群调度器提供改进的指导。具体来说，对于被分析数据湖中68%以重复方式展现其依赖关系的作业，Wing预测一个待处理作业对后续作业和用户下载的影响，并利用该信息优化调度器对该作业的估值。在由真实作业日志驱动的模拟中，我们发现使用Wing提供的估值代替用户指定优先级的传统YARN调度器，能从高负载集群中获得更多价值（以成功的依赖作业和用户下载数量衡量）。通过完全依赖Wing的指导，YARN在受限集群容量下几乎能实现100%的价值，几乎是使用用户提供的作业优先级所获价值的2倍。

upstream_only.title: RackSched: a microsecond-scale scheduler for rack-scale computers
upstream_only.abstract: Low-latency online services have strict Service Level Objectives (SLOs) that require datacenter systems to support high throughput at microsecond-scale tail latency. Dataplane operating systems have been designed to scale up multicore servers with minimal overhead for such SLOs. However, as application demands continue to increase, scaling up is not enough, and serving larger demands requires these systems to scale out to multiple servers in a rack.We present RackSched, the first rack-level microsecond-scale scheduler that provides the abstraction of a rack-scale computer (i.e., a huge server with hundreds to thousands of cores) to an external service with network-system co-design. The core of RackSched is a two-layer scheduling framework that integrates inter-server scheduling in the top-of-rack (ToR) switch with intra-server scheduling in each server. We use a combination of analytical results and simulations to show that it provides near-optimal performance as centralized scheduling policies, and is robust for both low-dispersion and high-dispersion workloads. We design a custom switch data plane for the inter-server scheduler, which realizes power-of-k-choices, ensures request affinity, and tracks server loads accurately and efficiently. We implement a RackSched prototype on a cluster of commodity servers connected by a Barefoot Tofino switch. End-to-end experiments on a twelve-server testbed show that RackSched improves the throughput by up to 1.44\texttimes{}, and scales out the throughput near linearly, while maintaining the same tail latency as one server until the system is saturated.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 低延迟在线服务具有严格的服务水平目标（SLO），要求数据中心系统在微秒级尾部延迟下支持高吞吐量。数据平面操作系统已被设计用于以最小开销横向扩展多核服务器以满足此类SLO。然而，随着应用需求的持续增长，仅靠扩展单个服务器已不够，服务更大需求需要这些系统扩展到机架内的多台服务器。我们提出了RackSched，这是首个机架级微秒级调度器，通过网络与系统协同设计，向外部服务提供机架级计算机（即一台拥有数百至数千个核心的巨型服务器）的抽象。RackSched的核心是一个两层调度框架，将架顶（ToR）交换机中的服务器间调度与每台服务器内的服务器内调度集成在一起。我们结合理论分析和模拟表明，它能提供与集中式调度策略接近最优的性能，并且对低离散度与高离散度工作负载都具有鲁棒性。我们为服务器间调度器设计了一个自定义交换机数据平面，实现了k-choices能力、确保请求亲和性，并准确高效地跟踪服务器负载。我们在由Barefoot Tofino交换机连接的商用服务器集群上实现了RackSched原型。在十二台服务器测试床上的端到端实验表明，RackSched可将吞吐量最高提升1.44倍，并近乎线性地扩展吞吐量，同时直到系统饱和前都能保持与单台服务器相同的尾部延迟。

upstream_only.title: Thunderbolt: throughput-optimized, quality-of-service-aware power capping at scale
upstream_only.abstract: As the demand for data center capacity continues to grow, hyperscale providers have used power oversubscription to increase efficiency and reduce costs. Power oversubscription requires power capping systems to smooth out the spikes that risk overloading power equipment by throttling workloads. Modern compute clusters run latency-sensitive serving and throughput-oriented batch workloads on the same servers, provisioning resources to ensure low latency for the former while using the latter to achieve high server utilization. When power capping occurs, it is desirable to maintain low latency for serving tasks and throttle the throughput of batch tasks. To achieve this, we seek a system that can gracefully throttle batch workloads and has task-level quality-of-service (QoS) differentiation.In this paper we present Thunderbolt, a hardware-agnostic power capping system that ensures safe power oversubscription while minimizing impact on both long-running throughput-oriented tasks and latency-sensitive tasks. It uses a two-threshold, randomized unthrottling/multiplicative decrease control policy to ensure power safety with minimized performance degradation. It leverages the Linux kernel's CPU bandwidth control feature to achieve task-level QoS-aware throttling. It is robust even in the face of power telemetry unavailability. Evaluation results at the node and cluster levels demonstrate the system's responsiveness, effectiveness for reducing power, capability of QoS differentiation, and minimal impact on latency and task health. We have deployed this system at scale, in multiple production clusters. As a result, we enabled power oversubscription gains of 9\%-25\%, where none was previously possible.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 随着数据中心容量需求的持续增长，超大规模提供商利用功率超订来提高效率并降低成本。功率超订需要功率上限控制系统，通过限流工作负载来平滑可能使功率设备过载的尖峰。现代计算集群在同一服务器上运行延迟敏感的在线服务和吞吐型批处理工作负载，通过资源调配来保证前者的低延迟，同时利用后者实现高服务器利用率。当进行功率上限控制时，理想的做法是保持在线服务任务的低延迟，并对批处理任务的吞吐量进行限制。为实现这一目标，我们寻求一种能够优雅地限制批处理工作负载并具备任务级服务质量（QoS）差异化能力的系统。本文提出了Thunderbolt，一种与硬件无关的功率上限控制系统，可在确保安全功率超订的同时，最大限度地减少对长期运行的吞吐型任务和延迟敏感任务的影响。它采用双阈值、随机解除限制/乘法递减的控制策略，以最小化性能损失的方式确保功率安全；利用Linux内核的CPU带宽控制功能实现任务级QoS感知的限流；即使在功率遥测不可用的情况下也能保持稳健性。节点级和集群级评估结果展示了系统的响应性、降低功率的有效性、QoS差异化能力以及对延迟和任务健康的最小影响。我们已在多个生产集群中大规模部署该系统，从而实现了先前无法实现的9%-25%的功率超订收益。

upstream_only.title: Distributed Trust: Is “Blockchain” the answer?
