The first one is contention awareness, i.e., a small number of threads cannot thoroughly saturate the PM bandwidth, while many concurrent accesses lead to significant PM performance degradation. The second one is NUMA awareness, i.e., exploiting the remote PM efficiently, as accessing remote PM naively leads to significant performance degradation.

We present ODINFS, a NUMA-aware scalable datapath PM file system that addresses these two challenges using a novel opportunistic delegation scheme. Under this scheme, ODINFS decouples the PM accesses from application threads with the help of background threads that access PM on behalf of the application. Because of PM access decoupling, ODINFS automatically parallelizes the access to PM across NUMA nodes in a controlled and localized manner. Our evaluation shows that ODINFS outperforms existing PM file systems up to 32.7× on real-world workloads.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现有的持久内存（PM）文件系统利用了其字节可寻址的非易失性访问特性，具有低延迟和高带宽。然而，它们未能有效利用PM的两个独特属性。第一个是争用感知：少量线程无法完全饱和PM带宽，而大量并发访问则会导致显著的PM性能下降。第二个是NUMA感知：有效利用远程PM具有挑战性，因为简单访问远程PM会导致显著的性能下降。我们提出了ODINFS，一个NUMA感知的可扩展数据路径PM文件系统，通过一种新颖的机会式委派方案来解决这两个挑战。在该方案下，ODINFS借助后台线程代表应用程序访问PM，将PM访问与应用程序线程解耦。由于PM访问的解耦，ODINFS以受控和本地化的方式自动并行化跨NUMA节点的PM访问。我们的评估表明，在真实工作负载上，ODINFS的性能比现有PM文件系统最高提升32.7倍。

upstream_only.title: DURINN: Adversarial Memory and Thread Interleaving for Detecting Durable Linearizability Bugs
upstream_only.abstract:
Non-volatile memory (NVM) has promoted the development of concurrent crash-consistent data structures, which serve as the backbone of various in-memory persistent applications. Durable linearizability defines the correct semantics of NVM-backed concurrent crash-consistent data structures, in which linearizability is preserved even in the presence of a crash event. However, designing and implementing a correct durable linearizable data structure remain challenging as developers are to manually control durability (persistence) using low-level cache flush and store fence instructions.

We present DURINN, to the best of our knowledge, the first durable linearizability checker for concurrent NVM data structures. DURINN is based on the novel observation on the gap between linearizability point – when the changes to a concurrent data structure become publicly visible – and durability point – when the changes become persistent. From the detailed gap analysis, we derive three durable linearizability bug patterns that render a linearizable data structure not durable linearizable. To tame the huge NVM states and thread interleaving test space, DURINN statically identifies likely-linearization points and actively constructs adversarial NVM state and thread interleaving settings that increase the likelihood of revealing DL bugs. DURINN effectively detected 27 (15 new) durable linearizability bugs from 12 concurrent NVM data structures without a test space explosion problem.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 非易失性内存（NVM）推动了并发崩溃一致性数据结构的发展，这些结构构成了各种内存持久化应用的骨干。持久线性izability定义了NVM支持的并发崩溃一致性数据结构的正确语义，即使在发生崩溃事件时也能保持线性izability。然而，设计和实现正确的持久线性izable数据结构仍然具有挑战性，因为开发者需要使用底层的缓存刷新和存储栅栏指令手动控制持久性（persistence）。我们提出了DURINN，据我们所知，这是第一个面向并发NVM数据结构的持久线性izability检查器。DURINN基于对线性化点（当对并发数据结构的更改变为公开可见时）与持久点（当更改变为持久时）之间差距的新颖观察。通过详细的差距分析，我们推导出三种持久线性izability bug模式，它们使一个线性izable数据结构不再是持久线性izable的。为了控制巨大的NVM状态和线程交错测试空间，DURINN以静态方式识别可能的线性化点，并主动构造对抗性的NVM状态和线程交错设置，以增加揭示DL错误的可能性。DURINN有效地从12个并发NVM数据结构中检测到27个（其中15个是新的）持久线性izability错误，而没有出现测试空间爆炸的问题。

upstream_only.title: SparTA: Deep-Learning Model Sparsity via Tensor-with-Sparsity-Attribute
upstream_only.abstract:
Sparsity is becoming arguably the most critical dimension to explore for efficiency and scalability, as deep learning models grow significantly larger and more complex. After all, the biological neural networks, where deep learning draws inspirations, are naturally sparse and highly efficient. 

We advocate an end-to-end approach to model sparsity via a new abstraction called Tensor-with-Sparsity-Attribute (TeSA), which augments the default Tensor abstraction that is fundamentally designed for dense models. TeSA enables the sparsity attributes and patterns (e.g., for pruning and quantization) to be specified, propagated forward and backward across the entire deep learning model, and used to create highly efficient, specialized operators, taking into account the execution efficiency of different sparsity patterns on different (sparsity-aware) hardware. The resulting SparTA framework can accommodate various sparsity patterns and optimization techniques, delivering 1.7x~8.4x average speedup on inference latency compared to seven state-of-the-art (sparse) solutions with smaller memory footprints. As an end-to-end model sparsity framework, SparTA facilitates sparsity algorithms to explore better sparse models.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 随着深度学习模型变得显著更大、更复杂，稀疏性可以说是探索效率和可扩展性方面最关键的方向。毕竟，深度学习所借鉴的生物神经网络天然是稀疏且高效的。我们通过一种名为“带稀疏属性的张量”（TeSA）的新抽象来倡导一种端到端的模型稀疏化方法，该抽象增强了默认为密集模型设计的Tensor抽象。TeSA使得稀疏属性和模式（例如用于剪枝和量化）能够在整个深度学习模型中被指定、向前和向后传播，并用于创建高效、专门的算子，同时考虑不同稀疏模式在不同（感知稀疏性的）硬件上的执行效率。由此产生的SparTA框架可以容纳各种稀疏模式和优化技术，与七种最先进的（稀疏）解决方案相比，推理延迟平均提升1.7倍至8.4倍，且内存占用更小。作为一个端到端的模型稀疏化框架，SparTA有助于稀疏算法探索更好的稀疏模型。

upstream_only.title: ROLLER: Fast and Efficient Tensor Compilation for Deep Learning
upstream_only.abstract:
Despite recent advances in tensor compilers, it often costs hours to generate an efficient kernel for an operator, a compute-intensive sub-task in a deep neural network (DNN), on various accelerators (e.g., GPUs). This significantly slows down DNN development cycles and incurs heavy burdens on the development of general kernel libraries and custom kernels, especially for new hardware vendors. The slow compilation process is due to the large search space formulated by existing DNN compilers, which have to use machine learning algorithms to find good solutions.

In this paper, we present ROLLER, which takes a different construction-based approach to generate kernels. At the core of ROLLER is rTile, a new tile abstraction that encapsulates tensor shapes that align with the key features of the underlying accelerator, thus achieving efficient execution by limiting the shape choices. ROLLER then adopts a recursive rTile-based construction algorithm to generate rTile-based programs (rProgram), whose performance can be evaluated efficiently with a micro-performance model without being evaluated in a real device. As a result, ROLLER can generate efficient kernels in seconds, with comparable performance to the state-of-the-art solutions on popular accelerators like GPUs, while offering better kernels on less mature accelerators like IPUs.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 尽管张量编译器取得了近期进展，但为深度神经网络(DNN)中的算子（一项计算密集型子任务）在各种加速器（例如GPU）上生成高效内核，往往需要花费数小时。这显著减慢了DNN开发周期，并给通用内核库和自定义内核的开发带来沉重负担，尤其是对新的硬件供应商而言。编译过程缓慢是因为现有DNN编译器所构建的大规模搜索空间，这些编译器必须使用机器学习算法来寻找良好解。在本文中，我们提出了ROLLER，它采用一种不同的基于构建的方法来生成内核。ROLLER的核心是rTile，一种新的磁贴抽象，它封装了与底层加速器关键特征对齐的张量形状，从而通过限制形状选择来实现高效执行。ROLLER随后采用基于rTile的递归构建算法来生成基于rTile的程序(rProgram)，其性能可以通过微性能模型高效评估，而无需在真实设备上运行。因此，ROLLER可以在数秒内生成高效内核，在GPU等流行加速器上与最先进方案性能相当，同时在IPU等不太成熟的加速器上提供更好的内核。

upstream_only.title: Walle: An End-to-End, General-Purpose, and Large-Scale Production System for Device-Cloud Collaborative Machine Learning
upstream_only.abstract: To break the bottlenecks of mainstream cloud-based machine learning (ML) paradigm, we adopt device-cloud collaborative ML and build the first end-to-end and general-purpose system, called Walle, as the foundation. Walle consists of a deployment platform, distributing ML tasks to billion-scale devices in time; a data pipeline, efficiently preparing task input; and a compute container, providing a cross-platform and high-performance execution environment, while facilitating daily task iteration. Specifically, the compute container is based on Mobile Neural Network (MNN), a tensor compute engine along with the data processing and model execution libraries, which are exposed through a refined Python thread-level virtual machine (VM) to support diverse ML tasks and concurrent task execution. The core of MNN is the novel mechanisms of operator decomposition and semi-auto search, sharply reducing the workload in manually optimizing hundreds of operators for tens of hardware backends and further quickly identifying the best backend with runtime optimization for a computation graph. The data pipeline introduces an on-device stream processing framework to enable processing user behavior data at source. The deployment platform releases ML tasks with an efficient push-then-pull method and supports multi-granularity deployment policies. We evaluate Walle in practical e-commerce application scenarios to demonstrate its effectiveness, efficiency, and scalability. Extensive micro-benchmarks also highlight the superior performance of MNN and the Python thread-level VM. Walle has been in large-scale production use in Alibaba, while MNN has been open source with a broad impact in the community.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 为突破主流基于云的机器学习（ML）范式的瓶颈，我们采用端云协同机器学习，并构建了首个端到端、通用型的系统，命名为Walle，作为基础。Walle由部署平台、数据管道和计算容器组成。部署平台将ML任务及时分发到十亿级设备上；数据管道高效地准备任务输入；计算容器提供跨平台的高性能执行环境，同时促进日常任务迭代。具体来说，计算容器基于移动神经网络（MNN），它包含一个张量计算引擎以及数据处理和模型执行库，通过精炼的Python线程级虚拟机（VM）暴露接口，以支持多样化的ML任务和并发任务执行。MNN的核心是算子分解和半自动搜索的新机制，大幅减少了为数十个硬件后端手动优化数百个算子的工作量，并能进一步为计算图快速确定具有运行时优化的最佳后端。数据管道引入了设备端流处理框架，以便在源头处理用户行为数据。部署平台采用高效的先推送后拉取方法发布ML任务，并支持多粒度的部署策略。我们在实际的电子商务应用场景中评估了Walle，以证明其有效性、效率和可扩展性。大量的微基准测试也突出了MNN和Python线程级虚拟机的卓越性能。Walle已在阿里大规模生产中使用，而MNN已开源并在社区中产生广泛影响。

upstream_only.title: Unity: Accelerating DNN Training Through Joint Optimization of Algebraic Transformations and Parallelization
upstream_only.abstract:
This paper presents Unity, the first system that jointly optimizes algebraic transformations and parallelization in distributed DNN training. Unity represents both parallelization and algebraic transformations as substitutions on a unified parallel computation graph (PCG), which simultaneously expresses the computation, parallelization, and communication of a distributed DNN training procedure.

Optimizations, in the form of graph substitutions, are automatically generated given a list of operator specifications, and are formally verified correct using an automated theorem prover. Unity then uses a novel hierarchical search algorithm to jointly optimize algebraic transformations and parallelization while maintaining scalability. The combination of these techniques provides a generic and extensible approach to optimizing distributed DNN training, capable of integrating new DNN operators, parallelization strategies, and model architectures with minimal manual effort. 

We evaluate Unity on seven real-world DNNs running on up to 192 GPUs on 32 nodes and show that Unity outperforms existing DNN training frameworks by up to 3.6× while keeping optimization times under 20 minutes. Unity is available to use as part of the open-source DNN training framework FlexFlow at https://github.com/flexflow/flexflow.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文提出了Unity，这是第一个在分布式DNN训练中联合优化代数变换与并行化的系统。Unity将并行化和代数变换都表示为对统一并行计算图（PCG）的替换，该图同时表达分布式DNN训练过程的计算、并行化和通信。优化以图替换的形式，根据算子规范列表自动生成，并使用自动化定理证明器进行形式化验证。Unity随后采用一种新颖的层次化搜索算法来联合优化代数变换和并行化，同时保持可扩展性。这些技术的结合提供了一种通用且可扩展的方法来优化分布式DNN训练，能够以最少的人工工作量集成新的DNN算子、并行化策略和模型架构。我们在多达32个节点上的192块GPU上对七个真实DNN进行了评估，结果表明Unity在保持优化时间低于20分钟的同时，比现有DNN训练框架的性能最高提升3.6倍。Unity可作为开源DNN训练框架FlexFlow的一部分使用，地址：https://github.com/flexflow/flexflow。

upstream_only.title: Trustworthy Open Source: The Consequences of Success
upstream_only.abstract: Wide-spread use of open-source software is a remarkable achievement, but also creates a tremendous responsibility. How can we collectively step up to ensure open-source software is worthy of the trust the world now expects and deserves? We cover a range of structural and security challenges and how we might address them, including our hopes for a more sustainable future.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 开源软件的广泛使用是一项非凡的成就，但也带来了巨大的责任。我们如何共同采取措施，确保开源软件能够不辜负世界现在期望和理应得到的信任？我们探讨了一系列结构性和安全性挑战以及可能的应对方式，包括我们对于更可持续未来的期望。

upstream_only.title: Trinity: High-Performance Mobile Emulation through Graphics Projection
upstream_only.abstract: Mobile emulation, which creates full-fledged software mobile devices on a physical PC/server, is pivotal to the mobile ecosystem, especially for PC-based mobile gaming, app debugging, and malware detection. Unfortunately, existing mobile emulators perform poorly on graphics-intensive apps in terms of both efficiency and compatibility. To address this, we introduce graphics projection, a novel graphics virtualization mechanism that adds a small-size projection space inside the guest memory of a virtual mobile device. The projection space processes graphics operations involving control contexts and resource handles without host interactions. Novel flow control and data teleporting mechanisms are used to match the decoupled graphics processing rates of the virtual device and the host GPU to maximize performance. The resulting new Android emulator, dubbed Trinity, exhibits an average of 93.3% native hardware performance and 97.2% app support, in some cases outperforming other emulators by more than an order of magnitude. It has been adopted by Huawei DevEco Studio, a major Android IDE with millions of developers.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 移动模拟是在物理PC/服务器上创建功能完备的软件移动设备，对移动生态系统至关重要，尤其是在面向PC的移动游戏、应用调试和恶意软件检测方面。不幸的是，现有的移动模拟器在图形密集型应用上的性能和兼容性都很差。为此，我们引入了图形投影，一种新颖的图形虚拟化机制，在虚拟移动设备的客户内存中添加一个小型投影空间。投影空间处理涉及控制上下文和资源句柄的图形操作，无需与宿主机交互。新颖的流控制和数据传送机制用于匹配虚拟设备和宿主机GPU之间解耦的图形处理速率，从而最大化性能。由此产生的新的Android模拟器Trinity平均达到93.3%的本地硬件性能和97.2%的应用支持，在某些情况下比其他模拟器快一个数量级以上。它已被华为DevEco Studio（拥有数百万开发者的主要Android IDE）采用。

upstream_only.title: ORION and the Three Rights: Sizing, Bundling, and Prewarming for Serverless DAGs
upstream_only.abstract: Serverless applications represented as DAGs have been growing in popularity. For many of these applications, it would be useful to estimate the end-to-end (E2E) latency and to allocate resources to individual functions so as to meet probabilistic guarantees for the E2E latency. This goal has not been met till now due to three fundamental challenges. The ﬁrst is the high variability and correlation in the execution time of individual functions, the second is the skew in execution times of the parallel invocations, and the third is the incidence of cold starts. In this paper, we introduce ORION to achieve these goals. We ﬁrst analyze traces from a production FaaS infrastructure to identify three characteristics of serverless DAGs. We use these to motivate and design three features. The ﬁrst is a performance model that accounts for runtime variabilities and dependencies among functions in a DAG. The second is a method for co-locating multiple parallel invocations within a single VM thus mitigating content-based skew among these invocations. The third is a method for pre-warming VMs for subsequent functions in a DAG with the right look-ahead time. We integrate these three innovations and evaluate ORION on AWS Lambda with three serverless DAG applications. Our evaluation shows that compared to three competing approaches, ORION achieves up to 90% lower P95 latency without increasing $ cost, or up to 53% lower $ cost without increasing tail latency.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 以DAG形式表示的无服务器应用日益流行。对于许多此类应用，估计端到端延迟并分配资源给单个函数以满足端到端延迟的概率性保证将非常有用。由于三个基本挑战，这一目标至今尚未实现：第一是单个函数执行时间的高变异性和相关性，第二是并行调用执行时间的偏斜，第三是冷启动的发生。本文引入了ORION来实现这些目标。我们首先分析生产级FaaS基础设施的轨迹，以识别无服务器DAG的三个特征，并据此设计三项功能。第一是考虑DAG中函数间运行时变异和依赖关系的性能模型；第二是将多个并行调用共置在单个VM中以缓解这些调用间基于内容偏斜的方法；第三是以适当的提前量预热DAG中后续函数VM的方法。我们将这三项创新整合起来，在AWS Lambda上使用三个无服务器DAG应用评估ORION。评估表明，与三种竞争方法相比，ORION在不增加成本的情况下将P95延迟降低了高达90%，或在不必增加尾部延迟的情况下将成本降低了高达53%。

upstream_only.title: Occualizer: Optimistic Concurrent Search Trees From Sequential Code
upstream_only.abstract:
This paper presents Occualizer, a mechanical source code transformation for adding scalable optimistic synchronization to a sequential search tree implementation. Occualizer injects synchronization only to the update steps of tree operations, leaving traversal steps to execute unsynchronized, thereby maximizing parallelism.

We use Occualizer to create concurrent versions of a sequential B+tree, trie, and red-black tree. Evaluation on a 28-core machine shows that Occualizer's trees significantly outperform prior mechanically-crafted trees on non-read-only workloads and are comparable (within 4%) on read-only workloads. Overall, Occualizer shrinks the performance gap between mechanically- and hand-crafted trees by up to 13×. When using Occualizer's B+tree as the index in the STO main-memory database, the system's throughput degrades by less than 30% compared to the default Masstree index, and it scales better.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了Occualizer，这是一种机械化源代码转换，用于为顺序搜索树实现添加可扩展的乐观同步。Occualizer仅向树操作的更新步骤注入同步，而使遍历步骤在无同步状态下执行，从而最大化并行性。我们使用Occualizer创建了顺序B+树、字典树和红黑树的并发版本。在28核机器上的评估表明，Occualizer生成的树在非只读工作负载上显著优于先前机械构造的树，在只读工作负载上则与之相当（差距在4%以内）。总体而言，Occualizer将机械构造树与手工构造树之间的性能差距缩小了最多13倍。当使用Occualizer的B+树作为STO主存数据库的索引时，与默认的Masstree索引相比，系统吞吐量下降不超过30%，并且扩展性更好。

upstream_only.title: Immortal Threads: Multithreaded Event-driven Intermittent Computing on Ultra-Low-Power Microcontrollers
upstream_only.abstract: We introduce Immortal Threads, a novel programming model that brings pseudo-stackful multithreaded processing to intermittent computing. Programmers using Immortal Threads are oblivious to intermittent execution and write their applications in a multithreaded fashion using common event-driven multithreading primitives. Our compiler fronted transforms the stackful threads into stackless threads that waste a minimum amount of computational progress upon power failures. Our runtime implements fair scheduling to switch between threads efficiently. We evaluated Immortal Threads on real hardware by comparing it against the state-of-the-art intermittent runtimes. Our comparison showed that the price paid for the Immortal Threads is a runtime overhead comparable to existing intermittent computing runtimes.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们引入了不朽线程（Immortal Threads），一种新颖的编程模型，为间歇计算带来了伪栈式多线程处理。使用不朽线程的程序员无需关注间歇执行，可以使用常见的事件驱动多线程原语以多线程方式编写应用程序。我们的编译器前端将栈式线程转换为无栈线程，在掉电时浪费最少的计算进展。我们的运行时实现了公平调度，以在线程间高效切换。我们在真实硬件上通过将不朽线程与最先进的间歇运行时进行比较来评估其性能。比较结果表明，不朽线程所付出的运行时常量开销与现有的间歇计算运行时相当。

upstream_only.title: Debugging the OmniTable Way
upstream_only.abstract:
Debugging is time-consuming, accounting for roughly 50% of a developer's time. To identify the cause of a failure, a developer usually tracks the state of their program as it executes on a failing input. Unfortunately, most debugging tools make it difficult for a developer to specify the program state that they wish to observe and computationally expensive to observe execution state. Moreover, existing work to improve our debugging tools often restrict the state that a developer can track by either exposing incomplete execution state or requiring manual instrumentation.

In this paper, we propose an OmniTable, an abstraction that captures all execution state as a large queryable data table. We build a query model around an OmniTable that supports SQL to simplify debugging without restricting the state that a developer can observe: we find that OmniTable debugging queries are more succinct than equivalent logic specified using existing tools. An OmniTable decouples debugging logic from the original execution, which SteamDrill, our prototype, uses to reduce the performance overhead of debugging. The system employs lazy materialization: it uses deterministic record/replay to store the execution associated with each OmniTable and resolves queries by inspecting replay executions. It employs a novel multi-replay strategy that partitions query resolution across multiple replays and a parallel resolution strategy that simultaneously observes state at multiple points-in-time. We find that SteamDrill queries are an order-of-magnitude faster than existing debugging tools.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 调试耗时巨大，约占开发人员约50%的时间。为了确定故障原因，开发人员通常会在有问题的输入上跟踪程序执行时的状态。遗憾的是，大多数调试工具难以让开发人员指定他们想观察的程序状态，并且在观察执行状态时计算开销很高。此外，现有改进调试工具的工作往往限制了开发人员可以跟踪的状态，要么暴露不完整的执行状态，要么需要手动插桩。在本文中，我们提出了OmniTable，一种将执行中的所有状态捕获为大型可查询数据表的抽象。我们围绕OmniTable构建了一种支持SQL的查询模型，以简化调试且不限制开发人员可观察的状态：我们发现OmniTable调试查询比使用现有工具实现等效逻辑更加简洁。OmniTable将调试逻辑与原始执行解耦，我们的原型SteamDrill利用这一点来降低调试的性能开销。系统采用惰性物化：它使用确定性记录/重放来存储与每个OmniTable关联的执行，并通过检查重放执行来解析查询。它采用了一种新颖的多重放策略，将查询解析分区到多次重放中，以及一种并行解析策略，可同时观察多个时间点的状态。我们发现SteamDrill查询比现有调试工具快一个数量级。

upstream_only.title: XRP: In-Kernel Storage Functions with eBPF
upstream_only.abstract: With the emergence of microsecond-scale NVMe storage devices, the Linux kernel storage stack overhead has become significant, almost doubling access times. We present XRP, a framework that allows applications to execute user-defined storage functions, such as index lookups or aggregations, from an eBPF hook in the NVMe driver, safely bypassing most of the kernel’s storage stack. To preserve file system semantics, XRP propagates a small amount of kernel state to its NVMe driver hook where the user-registered eBPF functions are called. We show how two key-value stores, BPF-KV, a simple B+-tree key-value store, and WiredTiger, a popular log-structured merge tree storage engine, can leverage XRP to significantly improve throughput and latency.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 随着微秒级NVMe存储设备的出现，Linux内核存储栈的开销变得显著，几乎使访问时间翻倍。我们提出了XRP，一个允许应用程序在NVMe驱动程序的eBPF钩子中执行用户定义的存储函数（如索引查找或聚合）的框架，安全地绕过内核存储栈的大部分。为了保持文件系统语义，XRP将少量内核状态传播到其NVMe驱动程序钩子，在那里调用用户注册的eBPF函数。我们展示了两个键值存储——BPF-KV（一个简单的B+树键值存储）和WiredTiger（一个流行的日志结构合并树存储引擎）——如何利用XRP显著提高吞吐量和延迟。

upstream_only.title: TriCache: A User-Transparent Block Cache Enabling High-Performance Out-of-Core Processing with In-Memory Programs
upstream_only.abstract:
Out-of-core systems rely on high-performance cache sub-systems to reduce the number of I/O operations. While the page cache in modern operating systems enables transparent access to memory and storage devices, it suffers from efficiency and scalability issues on cache misses, forcing out-of-core systems to design and implement their own cache components, which is a non-trivial task.

This study proposes TriCache, a cache mechanism that enables in-memory programs to efficiently process out-of-core datasets without requiring any code rewrite. It provides a virtual memory interface on top of the conventional block interface to simultaneously achieve user transparency and sufficient out-of-core performance. A multi-level block cache design is proposed to address the challenge of per-access address translations required by a memory interface. It can exploit spatial and temporal localities in memory or storage accesses to render storage-to-memory address translation and page-level concurrency control adequately efficient for the virtual-memory interface.

Our evaluation shows that in-memory systems operating on top of TriCache can outperform Linux OS page cache by more than one order of magnitude, and can deliver performance comparable to or even better than that of corresponding counterparts designed specifically for out-of-core scenarios.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 超内存（out-of-core）系统依赖高性能缓存子系统来减少I/O操作次数。虽然现代操作系统中的页缓存能够实现对内存和存储设备的透明访问，但它在缓存未命中时存在效率和可扩展性问题，迫使超内存系统自行设计和实现缓存组件，而这是一项艰巨的任务。本研究提出TriCache，一种缓存机制，使内存程序无需重写代码即可高效处理超内存数据集。它在传统块接口之上提供虚拟内存接口，以同时实现用户透明性和足够的超内存性能。提出了一种多级块缓存设计，以解决内存接口所需的每次访问地址转换带来的挑战。该设计可以利用内存或存储访问中的空间和时间局部性，使存储到内存的地址转换和页级并发控制对虚拟内存接口而言足够高效。我们的评估显示，运行在TriCache之上的内存系统其性能可以超过Linux操作系统页缓存一个数量级以上，并且能够提供与专门为超内存场景设计的对应系统相当甚至更优的性能。

upstream_only.title: Tiger: Disk-Adaptive Redundancy Without Placement Restrictions
upstream_only.abstract:
Large-scale cluster storage systems use redundancy (via erasure coding) to ensure data durability. Disk-adaptive redundancy—dynamically tailoring the redundancy scheme to observed disk failure rates—promises significant space and cost savings. Existing disk-adaptive redundancy systems, however, pose undesirable constraints on data placement, partitioning disks into subclusters that have homogeneous failure rates and forcing each erasure-coded stripe to be entirely placed on the disks within one subcluster. This design increases risk, by reducing intra-stripe diversity and being more susceptible to unanticipated changes in a make/model's failure rate, and only works for very large storage clusters fully committed to disk-adaptive redundancy.

Tiger is a new disk-adaptive redundancy system that efficiently avoids adoption-blocking placement constraints, while also providing higher space-savings and lower risk relative to prior designs. To do so, Tiger introduces the eclectic stripe, in which redundancy is tailored to the potentially-diverse failure rates of whichever disks are selected for storing that particular stripe. With eclectic stripes, pre-existing placement policies can be used while still enjoying the space-savings and robustness benefits of disk-adaptive redundancy. This paper introduces eclectic striping and Tiger's design, including a new mean-time-to-data-loss (MTTDL) approximation technique and new approaches for ensuring safe per-stripe settings given that failure rates of different devices change over time. In addition to avoiding placement constraints, evaluation with logs from real-world clusters shows that Tiger provides better space-savings, less bursty IO for changing redundancy schemes, and better robustness (due to increased risk-diversity) than prior disk-adaptive redundancy designs.
upstream_only.abstract_zh:
大规模集群存储系统使用冗余（通过纠删码）来确保数据持久性。磁盘自适应冗余——根据观测到的磁盘故障率动态调整冗余方案——有望节省大量空间和成本。然而，现有的磁盘自适应冗余系统对数据放置施加了不期望的限制，即把磁盘划分为具有同质故障率的子集群，并强制每个纠删码条带完全放置在一个子集群的磁盘内。这种设计降低了条带内多样性，更容易受到品牌/型号故障率意外变化的影响，从而增加了风险，并且仅适用于完全致力于磁盘自适应冗余的超大型存储集群。

Tiger是一种新的磁盘自适应冗余系统，它有效地避免了阻碍采用的放置限制，同时相对于先前设计提供了更高的空间节省和更低的风险。为此，Tiger引入了“折衷条带”（eclectic stripe），其中冗余度根据存储该特定条带所选磁盘上可能各不相同的故障率进行定制。借助折衷条带，可以使用已有的放置策略，同时仍然享有磁盘自适应冗余的空间节省和鲁棒性优势。本文介绍了折衷条带和Tiger的设计，包括一种新的平均数据丢失时间（MTTDL）近似技术，以及在设备故障率随时间变化的情况下确保每个条带设置安全的新方法。除了避免放置限制之外，使用来自真实世界集群日志的评估表明，与先前的磁盘自适应冗余设计相比，Tiger提供了更好的空间节省、更少的因更改冗余方案而产生的突发IO，以及更好的鲁棒性（得益于更高的风险多样性）。

upstream_only.title: zIO: Accelerating IO-Intensive Applications with Transparent Zero-Copy IO
upstream_only.abstract:
We present zIO, a transparent zero-copy IO mechanism for unmodified IO-intensive applications. zIO tracks IO data through the application, eliminating copies that are unnecessary while maintaining data consistency. 

Applications often modify only a part of the data they process. zIO leverages this insight and interposes on IO stack and standard library memory copy calls to track IO data and eliminate unnecessary copies. Instead, intermediate data locations are unmapped, allowing zIO to intercept and resolve any access via page faults to maintain data consistency. To avoid harming application performance in situations where data tracking overhead is high, zIO’s tracking policy decides on a per IO basis when to eliminate copies. Further, we demonstrate how to use zIO to achieve optimistic network receiver persistence for applications storing data from the network in non-volatile memory (NVM). By mapping socket receive buffers in NVM and leveraging kernel-bypass IO, we can rely on zIO to transparently eliminate all copies from the network, through the application, to storage.

We implement zIO as a user-space library. On top of kernel IO stacks, zIO eliminates application-level IO copies. We also integrate zIO with kernel-bypass IO stacks, where it can additionally eliminate copies incurred by the IO stack APIs and enable optimistic network receiver persistence. We evaluate zIO with IO-intensive applications, such as Redis, Icecast, and MongoDB. zIO improves application throughput by up to 1.8× with Linux and by up to 2.5× with kernel-bypass IO stacks and optimistic network receiver persistence. Compared to common uses of zero-copy IO stack APIs, such as memory mapped files, zIO can improve performance by up to 17% due to reduced TLB shootdown overhead.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出zIO，一种用于未修改的IO密集型应用的透明零拷贝IO机制。zIO在应用中跟踪IO数据，在保持数据一致性的同时消除不必要的拷贝。应用往往只修改其处理数据的一部分。zIO利用这一洞察，插入到IO栈和标准库内存拷贝调用中，以跟踪IO数据并消除不必要的拷贝。中间数据位置反而被取消映射，允许zIO通过页面错误拦截并解析任何访问以保持数据一致性。为避免在数据跟踪开销高的情况下损害应用性能，zIO的跟踪策略基于每个IO来决定何时消除拷贝。此外，我们演示了如何使用zIO来实现乐观网络接收端持久化，适用于从网络接收数据并存储到非易失性内存（NVM）的应用。通过将套接字接收缓冲区映射到NVM并利用内核旁路IO，我们可以依靠zIO透明地消除从网络经应用到存储的所有拷贝。我们将zIO实现为一种用户态库。在内核IO栈之上，zIO消除了应用层的IO拷贝。我们还将zIO与内核旁路IO栈集成，在那里它可以额外消除由IO栈API引起的拷贝，并实现乐观网络接收端持久化。我们使用IO密集型应用（如Redis、Icecast和MongoDB）评估zIO。在Linux上，zIO将应用吞吐量提升最高1.8倍，使用内核旁路IO栈和乐观网络接收端持久化时提升最高2.5倍。与常用的零拷贝IO栈API（如内存映射文件）相比，zIO由于减少了TLB shootdown开销，可将性能提升最高17%。

upstream_only.title: Verifying the DaisyNFS concurrent and crash-safe file system with sequential reasoning
upstream_only.abstract:
This paper develops a new approach to verifying a performant file system that isolates crash safety and concurrency reasoning to a transaction system that gives atomic access to the disk, so that the rest of the file system can be verified with sequential reasoning.

We demonstrate this approach in DaisyNFS, a Network File System (NFS) server written in Go that runs on top of a disk. DaisyNFS uses GoTxn, a new verified, concurrent transaction system that extends GoJournal with two-phase locking and an allocator. The transaction system's specification formalizes under what conditions transactions can be verified with only sequential reasoning, and comes with a mechanized proof in Coq that connects the specification to the implementation.

As evidence that proofs enjoy sequential reasoning, DaisyNFS uses Dafny, a sequential verification language, to implement and verify all the NFS operations on top of GoTxn. The sequential proofs helped achieve a number of good properties in DaisyNFS: easy incremental development (for example, adding support for large files), a relatively short proof (only 2× as many lines of proof as code), and a performant implementation (at least 60% the throughput of the Linux NFS server exporting ext4 across a variety of benchmarks).
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文开发了一种新方法来验证高性能文件系统，该方法将崩溃安全和并发推理隔离到事务系统中，事务系统提供对磁盘的原子访问，因此文件系统的其余部分可以使用顺序推理进行验证。我们在 DaisyNFS 中演示了这种方法，DaisyNFS 是一个用 Go 编写的网络文件系统（NFS）服务器，运行在磁盘之上。DaisyNFS 使用 GoTxn，这是一个新的经过验证的并发事务系统，它扩展了 GoJournal，加入了两阶段锁和分配器。该事务系统的规范形式化了在何种条件下事务可以仅用顺序推理进行验证，并附带 Coq 中的机械化证明，将规范与实现联系起来。作为证明能够享受顺序推理的证据，DaisyNFS 使用 Dafny（一种顺序验证语言）来在 GoTxn 之上实现和验证所有 NFS 操作。这些顺序证明帮助 DaisyNFS 实现了若干良好特性：轻松的增量开发（例如，添加对大文件的支持）、相对简短的证明（证明行数仅为代码的 2 倍），以及高性能的实现（在各种基准测试中，吞吐量至少达到导出 ext4 的 Linux NFS 服务器的 60%）。

upstream_only.title: Design and Verification of the Arm Confidential Compute Architecture
upstream_only.abstract: The increasing use of sensitive private data in computing is matched by a growing concern regarding data privacy. System software such as hypervisors and operating systems are supposed to protect and isolate applications and their private data, but their large codebases contain many vulnerabilities that can risk data confidentiality and integrity. We introduce Realms, a new abstraction for confidential computing to protect the data confidentiality and integrity of virtual machines. Hardware creates and enforces Realm world, a new physical address space for Realms. Firmware controls the hardware to secure Realms and handles requests from untrusted system software to manage Realms, including creating and running them. Untrusted system software retains control of the dynamic allocation of memory to Realms, but cannot access Realm memory contents, even if run at a higher privileged level. To guarantee the security of Realms, we verified the firmware, introducing novel verification techniques that enable us to prove, for the first time, the security and correctness of concurrent software with hand-over-hand locking and dynamically allocated shared page tables, data races in kernel code running on relaxed memory hardware, integrated C and Arm assembly code calling one another, and untrusted software being in full control of allocating system resources. Realms are included in the Arm Confidential Compute Architecture.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 计算中对敏感私有数据的使用日益增长，也带来了对数据隐私越来越多的关注。系统软件（如虚拟机监控器和操作系统）本应保护并隔离应用程序及其私有数据，但其庞大的代码库包含许多可能危及数据机密性和完整性的漏洞。我们引入了Realms，一种用于机密计算的新抽象，以保护虚拟机的数据机密性和完整性。硬件创建并强制实施Realm世界，这是一个为Realms新增的物理地址空间。固件控制硬件以保护Realms，并处理来自不可信系统软件的请求以管理Realms，包括创建和运行它们。不可信系统软件保留了对Realms内存进行动态分配的控制权，但即使以更高特权级运行，也无法访问Realms的内存内容。为了保障Realms的安全性，我们对固件进行了验证，引入了新颖的验证技术，使我们能够首次证明具有手握手锁和动态分配共享页表的并发软件的安全性和正确性、运行在宽松内存硬件上的内核代码中的数据竞争、相互调用集成C代码和Arm汇编代码，以及不可信软件完全控制系统资源配置等情况下的安全性与正确性。Realms已包含在Arm机密计算架构中。

upstream_only.title: DuoAI: Fast, Automated Inference of Inductive Invariants for Verifying Distributed Protocols
upstream_only.abstract:
Distributed systems are complex and difficult to build correctly. Formal verification can provably rule out bugs in such systems, but finding an inductive invariant that implies the safety property of the system is often the hardest part of the proof. We present DuoAI, an automated system that quickly finds inductive invariants for verifying distributed protocols by reducing SMT query costs in checking invariants with existential quantifiers. DuoAI enumerates the strongest candidate invariants that hold on validate states from protocol simulations, then applies two methods in parallel, returning the result from the method that succeeds first. One checks all candidate invariants and weakens them as needed until it finds an inductive invariant that implies the safety property. Another checks invariants without existential quantifiers to find an inductive invariant without the safety property, then adds candidate invariants with existential 
quantifiers to strengthen it until the safety property holds. Both methods are guaranteed to find an inductive invariant that proves desired safety properties, if one exists, but the first reduces SMT query costs when more candidate invariants with existential quantifiers are needed, while the second reduces SMT query costs when few candidate invariants with existential quantifiers suffice. We show that DuoAI verifies more than two dozen common distributed protocols automatically, including various versions of Paxos, and outperforms alternative methods both in the number of protocols it verifies and the speed at which it does so, including solving Paxos more than two orders of magnitude faster than previous methods.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 分布式系统复杂且难以正确构建。形式化验证可以证明性地排除此类系统中的错误，但找到蕴含系统安全性属性的归纳不变式通常是证明中最困难的部分。我们提出了DuoAI，一个自动化系统，它通过降低检查带有存在量词的不变式时的SMT查询成本，快速找到用于验证分布式协议的归纳不变式。DuoAI从协议模拟的验证状态中枚举出最强的候选不变式，然后并行应用两种方法，返回先成功的方法的结果。一种方法检查所有候选不变式，并在需要时逐步弱化它们，直到找到蕴含安全性属性的归纳不变式。另一种方法检查不含存在量词的不变式，先找到不蕴含安全性属性的归纳不变式，然后添加带有存在量词的候选不变式来强化它，直到安全性属性成立。两种方法都保证在存在的情况下找到能够证明所需安全性属性的归纳不变式，但当需要更多含存在量词的候选不变式时，第一种方法降低了SMT查询成本；而当少量含存在量词的候选不变式就足够时，第二种方法则降低了SMT查询成本。我们表明，DuoAI能够自动验证二十多个常见分布式协议，包括各种版本的Paxos，并且在验证的协议数量和速度上都优于其他方法，其中解决Paxos的速度比先前方法快两个数量级以上。

upstream_only.title: Verifying Hardware Security Modules with Information-Preserving Refinement
upstream_only.abstract:
Knox is a new framework that enables developers to build hardware security modules (HSMs) with high assurance through formal verification. The goal is to rule out all hardware bugs, software bugs, and timing side channels.

Knox's approach is to relate an implementation's wire-level behavior to a functional specification stated in terms of method calls and return values with a new definition called information-preserving refinement (IPR). This definition captures the notion that the HSM implements its functional specification, and that it leaks no additional information through its wire-level behavior. The Knox framework provides support for writing specifications, importing HSM implementations written in Verilog and C code, and proving IPR using a combination of lightweight annotations and interactive proofs.

To evaluate the IPR definition and the Knox framework, we verified three simple HSMs, including an RFC 6238-compliant TOTP token. The TOTP token is written in 2950 lines of Verilog and 360 lines of C and assembly. Its behavior is captured in a succinct specification: aside from the definition of the TOTP algorithm, the spec is only 10 lines of code. In all three case studies, verification covers entire hardware and software stacks and rules out hardware/software bugs and timing side channels.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Knox是一个新框架，使开发人员能够通过形式化验证构建具有高保证性的硬件安全模块（HSM），目标是排除所有硬件漏洞、软件漏洞和时序侧信道。Knox的方法是通过一种称为“信息保持精化”（IPR）的新定义，将实现的线级行为与以方法调用和返回值陈述的功能规范相关联。该定义体现了HSM实现其功能规范，且不会通过线级行为泄露额外信息的含义。Knox框架支持编写规范、导入用Verilog和C语言编写的HSM实现，并结合轻量级注解和交互式证明来证明IPR。为评估IPR定义和Knox框架，我们验证了三个简单的HSM，其中包括一个符合RFC 6238的TOTP令牌。该TOTP令牌由2950行Verilog和360行C及汇编语言编写。其行为通过一个简洁的规范捕获：除TOTP算法的定义外，该规范仅有10行代码。在全部三个案例研究中，验证覆盖了完整的硬件和软件栈，并排除了硬件/软件漏洞和时序侧信道。

upstream_only.title: Orca: A Distributed Serving System for Transformer-Based Generative Models
upstream_only.abstract:
Large-scale Transformer-based models trained for generation tasks (e.g., GPT-3) have recently attracted huge interest, emphasizing the need for system support for serving models in this family. Since these models generate a next token in an autoregressive manner, one has to run the model multiple times to process an inference request where each iteration of the model generates a single output token for the request. However, existing systems for inference serving do not perform well on this type of workload that has a multi-iteration characteristic, due to their inflexible scheduling mechanism that
cannot change the current batch of requests being processed; requests that have finished earlier than other requests in a batch cannot return to the client, while newly arrived requests have to wait until the current batch completely finishes.

In this paper, we propose iteration-level scheduling, a new scheduling mechanism that schedules execution at the granularity of iteration (instead of request) where the scheduler invokes the execution engine to run only a single iteration of the model on the batch. In addition, to apply batching and
iteration-level scheduling to a Transformer model at the same time, we suggest selective batching, which applies batching only to a selected set of operations. Based on these two techniques, we have implemented a distributed serving system called ORCA, with additional designs for scalability to models with hundreds of billions of parameters. Our evaluation on a GPT-3 175B model shows that ORCA can significantly outperform NVIDIA FasterTransformer in terms of both latency and throughput: 36:9× throughput improvement at the same level of latency.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 近年来，用于生成任务的大规模Transformer模型（如GPT-3）引起了巨大关注，凸显了为此类模型提供服务所需的系统支持。由于这类模型以自回归方式生成下一个token，因此处理一个推理请求需要多次运行模型，每次迭代为请求生成一个输出token。然而，现有的推理服务系统在处理这种具有多迭代特性的工作负载时表现不佳，原因是其调度机制缺乏灵活性，无法改变当前正在处理的请求批次；一个批次中较早完成的请求无法返回给客户端，而新到达的请求必须等到当前批次完全结束。本文提出迭代级调度，一种新的调度机制，以迭代（而非请求）为粒度执行调度，调度器调用执行引擎仅在批次上运行模型的一次迭代。此外，为了同时将批处理和迭代级调度应用于Transformer模型，我们提出了选择性批处理，即只对选定的操作集应用批处理。基于这两种技术，我们实现了一个名为ORCA的分布式服务系统，并进行了额外设计以实现对拥有数千亿参数模型的可扩展性。我们在GPT-3 175B模型上的评估表明，在延迟和吞吐量方面，ORCA都显著优于NVIDIA FasterTransformer：在同等级别延迟下吞吐量提升36.9倍。

upstream_only.title: Microsecond-scale Preemption for Concurrent GPU-accelerated DNN Inferences
upstream_only.abstract: Many intelligent applications like autonomous driving and virtual reality require running both latency-critical and best-effort DNN inference tasks to achieve both real time and work conserving on GPU. However, commodity GPUs lack efficient preemptive scheduling support and state-of-the-art approaches either have to monopolize GPU or let the real-time tasks to wait for best-effort tasks to complete, which causes low utilization or high latency, or both. This paper presents REEF, the first GPU-accelerated DNN inference serving system that enables microsecond-scale kernel preemption and controlled concurrent execution in GPU scheduling. REEF is novel in two ways. First, based on the observation that DNN inference kernels as mostly idempotent, REEF devises a reset-based preemption scheme that launches a real-time kernel on the GPU by proactively killing and restoring best-effort kernels at microsecond-scale. Second, since DNN inference kernels have varied parallelism and predictable latency, REEF proposes a dynamic kernel padding mechanism that dynamically pads the real-time kernel with appropriate best-effort kernels to fully utilize the GPU with negligible overhead. Evaluation using a new DNN inference serving benchmark (DISB) with diverse workloads and a real-world trace on an AMD GPU shows that REEF only incurs less than 2% overhead in the end-to-end latency for real-time tasks but increases the overall throughput by up to 7.7×, compared to dedicating the GPU to real-time tasks. To demonstrate the feasibility of our approaches on closed-source GPUs, we further ported and evaluated a restricted version of REEF on an NVIDIA GPU with a reduction of the preemption latency by up to 12.3× (from 6.3×).
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 许多智能应用（如自动驾驶和虚拟现实）需要同时运行延迟关键型和尽力而为型DNN推理任务，以在GPU上同时实现实时性和工作守恒。然而，商用GPU缺乏高效的抢占式调度支持，现有方法要么垄断GPU，要么让实时任务等待尽力而为任务完成，这导致利用率低或延迟高，或两者兼而有之。本文提出了REEF，这是首个GPU加速的DNN推理服务系统，能够在GPU调度中实现微秒级内核抢占和受控并发执行。REEF的创新体现在两个方面。首先，基于DNN推理内核大多为幂等的观察，REEF设计了一种基于重置的抢占方案，通过主动在微秒级杀死并恢复尽力而为内核来启动实时内核。其次，由于DNN推理内核具有不同的并行度和可预测的延迟，REEF提出了一种动态内核填充机制，用适当的尽力而为内核动态填充实时内核，以在可忽略的开销下充分利用GPU。使用包含多样工作负载的新的DNN推理服务基准（DISB）和AMD GPU上的真实世界轨迹进行的评估表明，与将GPU专用于实时任务相比，REEF对实时任务的端到端延迟仅产生不到2%的开销，但总吞吐量提高了高达7.7倍。为了证明我们的方法在闭源GPU上的可行性，我们还在NVIDIA GPU上移植并评估了REEF的受限版本，将抢占延迟降低了高达12.3倍（从6.3倍降低）。

upstream_only.title: Alpa: Automating Inter- and Intra-Operator Parallelism for Distributed Deep Learning
upstream_only.abstract: Alpa automates model-parallel training of large deep learning (DL) models by generating execution plans that unify data, operator, and pipeline parallelism. Existing model-parallel training systems either require users to manually create a parallelization plan or automatically generate one from a limited space of model parallelism configurations. They do not suffice to scale out complex DL models on distributed compute devices. Alpa distributes the training of large DL models by viewing parallelisms as two hierarchical levels: inter-operator and intra-operator parallelisms. Based on it, Alpa constructs a new hierarchical space for massive model-parallel execution plans. Alpa designs a number of compilation passes to automatically derive efficient parallel execution plans at each parallelism level. Alpa implements an efficient runtime to orchestrate the two-level parallel execution on distributed compute devices. Our evaluation shows Alpa generates parallelization plans that match or outperform hand-tuned model-parallel training systems even on models they are designed for. Unlike specialized systems, Alpa also generalizes to models with heterogeneous architectures and models without manually-designed plans. Alpa's source code is publicly available at https://github.com/alpa-projects/alpa
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Alpa通过生成统一数据、算子与流水线并行的执行计划，实现大型深度学习（DL）模型的模型并行训练自动化。现有的模型并行训练系统要么要求用户手动创建并行化计划，要么从受限的模型并行配置空间中自动生成计划，它们不足以在分布式计算设备上扩展复杂的深度学习模型。Alpa将并行性视为两个层次：算子间并行和算子内并行，以此为基础构建了一个用于大规模模型并行执行计划的新的层次化空间。Alpa设计了多种编译流程，以在每个并行性级别自动推导高效的并行执行计划。Alpa实现了高效的运行时，用于在分布式计算设备上协调这两级并行执行。我们的评估表明，即使在为它们设计的模型上，Alpa生成的并行化计划也能匹配或超过手工调优的模型并行训练系统。与专用系统不同，Alpa还能推广到具有异构架构的模型以及没有手动设计计划的模型。Alpa的源代码可在 https://github.com/alpa-projects/alpa 公开获取。

upstream_only.title: Looking Beyond GPUs for DNN Scheduling on Multi-Tenant Clusters
upstream_only.abstract: Training Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) is a popular workload in both enterprises and cloud data centers. Existing schedulers for DNN training consider GPU as the dominant resource and allocate other resources such as CPU and memory proportional to the number of GPUs requested by the job. Unfortunately, these schedulers do not consider the impact of a job’s sensitivity to allocation of CPU and memory resources. In this work, we propose Synergy, a resource-sensitive scheduler for shared GPU clusters. Synergy infers the sensitivity of DNNs to different resources using optimistic profiling; some jobs might benefit from more than the GPU-proportional allocation and some jobs might not be affected by less than GPU-proportional allocation. Synergy performs such multi-resource workload-aware assignments across a set of jobs scheduled on shared multi-tenant clusters using a new near-optimal online algorithm. Our experiments show that workload-aware CPU and memory allocations can improve average job completion time upto 3.4x, by better utilizing existing cluster resources, compared to traditional GPU-proportional scheduling.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 训练深度神经网络（DNN）是企业和云数据中心中的常见工作负载。现有的DNN训练调度器将GPU视为主要资源，并根据作业请求的GPU数量按比例分配CPU和内存等其他资源。遗憾的是，这些调度器没有考虑作业对CPU和内存资源分配的敏感性影响。在这项工作中，我们提出了Synergy，一种针对共享GPU集群的资源敏感调度器。Synergy通过乐观剖析来推断DNN对不同资源的敏感性；某些作业可能受益于超过GPU比例的分配，而某些作业可能不受低于GPU比例分配的影响。Synergy使用一种新的近乎最优的在线算法，在共享多租户集群上调度的一组作业中执行这种多资源工作负载感知的分配。我们的实验表明，与传统的GPU比例调度相比，通过更好地利用现有集群资源，工作负载感知的CPU和内存分配可以将平均作业完成时间提高多达3.4倍。

upstream_only.title: The Computing and Information Science and Engineering Landscape: A Look Forward
upstream_only.abstract: The United States National Science Foundation (NSF) supports a majority of US academic research in the Computer and Information Science and Engineering (CISE) topic areas.  A long-time computing researcher herself, Dr. Margaret Martonosi is now serving a 4-year term leading the NSF CISE Directorate, and stewarding the CISE directorate’s $1B+ annual budget on behalf of research, education, workforce, and infrastructure funding in CISE topic areas and for science as a whole.  In this talk, she will discuss key themes for the field, how CISE is developing programmatic opportunities to advance research related to them, and also how CISE invests in cross-cutting people issues for the field as well.  More broadly, she will discuss CISE and NSF in the context of the global research efforts, and our approach to industry and international research partnerships. Across it all, she will note how the ATC/OSDI community can contribute to these efforts and priorities.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 美国国家科学基金会（NSF）支持了美国大部分计算机与信息科学与工程（CISE）领域的学术研究。Margaret Martonosi博士本人长期从事计算研究，目前正领导NSF CISE理事会任期四年，代表CISE领域及整个科学界的研究、教育、劳动力和基础设施经费，管理CISE理事会每年超过10亿美元的预算。在本次演讲中，她将讨论该领域的关键主题，CISE如何制定项目机会以推进相关研究，以及CISE如何投资于该领域的跨领域人才问题。更广泛地说，她将讨论在全球研究背景下的CISE和NSF，以及我们对产业和国际研究伙伴关系的方法。在所有这些内容中，她将指出ATC/OSDI社区如何为这些努力和优先事项做出贡献。

upstream_only.title: CAP-VMs: Capability-Based Isolation and Sharing in the Cloud
upstream_only.abstract:
Cloud stacks must isolate application components, while permitting efficient data sharing between components deployed on the same physical host. Traditionally, the MMU enforces isolation and permits sharing at page granularity. MMU approaches, however, lead to cloud stacks with large TCBs in kernel space, and page granularity requires inefficient OS interfaces for data sharing. Forthcoming CPUs with hardware support for memory capabilities offer new opportunities to implement isolation and sharing at a finer granularity.

We describe cVMs, a new VM-like abstraction that uses memory capabilities to isolate application components while supporting efficient data sharing, all without mandating application code to be capability-aware. cVMs share a single virtual address space safely, each having only capabilities to access its own memory. A cVM may include a library OS, thus minimizing its dependency on the cloud environment. cVMs efficiently exchange data through two capability-based primitives assisted by a small trusted monitor: (i) an asynchronous read-write interface to buffers shared between cVMs; and (ii) a call interface to transfer control between cVMs. Using these two primitives, we build more expressive mechanisms for efficient cross-cVM communication. Our prototype implementation using CHERI RISC-V capabilities shows that cVMs isolate services (Redis and Python) with low overhead while improving data sharing.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 云技术栈必须隔离应用组件，同时允许部署在同一物理主机上的组件之间进行高效的数据共享。传统上，MMU强制隔离并允许以页面粒度进行共享。然而，MMU方法导致云技术栈在内核空间具有庞大的可信计算基（TCB），而且页面粒度要求使用低效的OS接口进行数据共享。即将推出的具有硬件内存能力支持的CPU为实现更细粒度的隔离和共享提供了新的机会。我们描述了cVM，一种新的类VM抽象，它使用内存能力来隔离应用组件，同时支持高效的数据共享，且不要求应用代码感知能力。cVM安全地共享单个虚拟地址空间，每个cVM仅有访问自身内存的能力。cVM可以包含库操作系统，从而最大限度地减少其对云环境的依赖。cVM通过两种由小型受信监视器辅助的基于能力的原语高效交换数据：（i）用于cVM间共享缓冲区的异步读写接口；（ii）用于在cVM间转移控制权的调用接口。使用这两个原语，我们构建了更富表现力的机制以实现高效的跨cVM通信。我们使用CHERI RISC-V能力的原型实现表明，cVM能够以低开销隔离服务（Redis和Python），同时改善数据共享。

upstream_only.title: KSplit: Automating Device Driver Isolation
upstream_only.abstract: Researchers have shown that recent CPU extensions support practical, low-overhead driver isolation to protect kernels from defects and vulnerabilities in device drivers. With performance no longer being the main roadblock, the complexity of isolating device drivers has become the main challenge. Device drivers and kernel extensions are developed in a shared memory environment in which the state shared between the kernel and the driver is mixed in a complex hierarchy of data structures, making it difficult for programmers to ensure that the shared state is synchronized correctly. In this paper, we present KSplit, a new framework for isolating unmodified device drivers in a modern, full-featured kernel. KSplit performs automated analyses on the unmodified source code of the kernel and the driver to: 1) identify the state shared between the kernel and driver and 2) to compute the synchronization requirements for just this shared state for efficient isolation. While some kernel idioms present ambiguities that cannot be resolved automatically at present, KSplit classifies most ambiguous pointers and identifies ones requiring manual intervention. We evaluate our solution on nine subsystems in the Linux kernel by applying KSplit to 354 device drivers and validating isolation for 10 drivers. For example, for a complex Ixgbe driver KSplit requires only 53 lines of manual changes to 2,476 lines of automatically generated interface specifications and 19 lines of changes to the driver’s code. The KSplit analysis of the 354 drivers shows a similar fraction of manual work is expected, showing that KSplit is a practical tool for automating key tasks to enable driver isolation.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 研究人员已经证明，最近的CPU扩展支持实用且低开销的驱动程序隔离，以保护内核免受设备驱动程序中的缺陷和漏洞的影响。随着性能不再是主要障碍，隔离设备驱动程序的复杂性已成为主要挑战。设备驱动程序和内核扩展在共享内存环境中开发，其中内核与驱动程序之间共享的状态混合在复杂的数据结构层次中，使得程序员难以确保共享状态正确同步。在本文中，我们提出了KSplit，一个在现代全功能内核中隔离未经修改的设备驱动程序的新框架。KSplit对内核和驱动程序的未修改源代码执行自动分析，以：1）识别内核与驱动程序之间共享的状态；2）仅为此共享状态计算同步需求，以实现高效隔离。虽然某些内核惯用语存在当前无法自动解决的歧义，但KSplit对大多数模糊指针进行了分类，并识别出需要人工干预的指针。我们通过将KSplit应用于Linux内核中的9个子系统，对354个设备驱动程序进行了评估，并验证了10个驱动程序的隔离。例如，对于复杂的Ixgbe驱动程序，KSplit只需要对2476行自动生成的接口规范进行53行人工修改，以及对驱动程序代码进行19行更改。对354个驱动程序的KSplit分析表明，预期的人工工作量比例相似，这表明KSplit是自动化关键任务以实现驱动程序隔离的实用工具。

upstream_only.title: Operating System Support for Safe and Efficient Auxiliary Execution
upstream_only.abstract:
Modern applications run various auxiliary tasks. These tasks gain high observability and control by executing in the application address space, but doing so causes safety and performance issues. Running them in a separate process offers strong isolation but poor observability and control.

In this paper, we propose special OS support for auxiliary tasks to address this challenge with an abstraction called orbit. An orbit task offers strong isolation. At the same time, it conveniently observes the main program with an automatic state synchronization feature. We implement the abstraction in the Linux kernel. We use orbit to port 7 existing auxiliary tasks and add one new task in 6 large applications. The evaluation shows that the orbit-version tasks have strong isolation with comparable performance of the original unsafe tasks.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代应用程序运行各种辅助任务。这些任务通过在应用程序地址空间中执行而获得高度的可观察性和控制能力，但这会引发安全和性能问题。将它们放在独立进程中运行可提供强隔离，但可观察性和控制能力较差。在本文中，我们提出了一种针对辅助任务的特殊操作系统支持，通过称为orbit的抽象来应对这一挑战。orbit任务提供强隔离，同时通过自动状态同步功能方便地观察主程序。我们在Linux内核中实现了该抽象，并使用orbit移植了7个现有辅助任务，并在6个大型应用中新增了一个任务。评估表明，orbit版本的任务具有强隔离性，且性能与原有不安全任务相当。

upstream_only.title: From Dynamic Loading to Extensible Transformation: An Infrastructure for Dynamic Library Transformation
upstream_only.abstract:
The dynamic linker and loader has been one of the fundamental software, and more than 99% of binaries are dynamically linked on Ubuntu. On one hand, vendors are going to break production software into more and more dynamic libraries to lower the maintenance cost. On the other hand, customers require the dynamic loader to provide rich functionalities to serve their isolation, security, and performance demands. However, existing dynamic loaders are implemented in a monolithic fashion, so they are difficult to extend, configure and optimize.

This paper presents iFed , an infrastructure for extensible and flexible dynamic library transformation. We design iFed in a pass-based architecture to compose various functional and optimization passes. iFed uses a runnable in-memory format to represent libraries and coordinate among multiple transformation passes. We further implement two optimization passes in iFed , which efficiently leverages hugepages and eliminates relocation overhead. iFed is implemented as a drop-in replacement of the current system default dynamic loader. We evaluate iFed and its optimization passes with a wide range of applications on different hardware platforms. Compared to the default glibc dynamic loader, iFed reduces an order of magnitude of TLB miss. We improve the throughput of a dynamic website by 13.3%, along with a 12.5% reduction of tail latency without any modifications to the applications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 动态链接器和加载器一直是基础软件，在Ubuntu上超过99%的二进制文件是动态链接的。一方面，供应商为了降低维护成本，倾向于将生产软件拆分成越来越多的动态库。另一方面，客户要求动态加载器提供丰富的功能以满足其隔离、安全和性能需求。然而，现有的动态加载器采用单体式实现，难以扩展、配置和优化。本文提出 iFed，一个用于可扩展且灵活的动态库变换的基础设施。我们采用基于 pass 的架构来组合各种功能和优化 pass。iFed 使用可运行的内存格式来表示库并在多个变换 pass 之间进行协调。我们还在 iFed 中实现了两个优化 pass，它们高效地利用大页面并消除重定位开销。iFed 作为当前系统默认动态加载器的即插即用替代品实现。我们在不同硬件平台上用多种应用评估 iFed 及其优化 pass。与默认的 glibc 动态加载器相比，iFed 将 TLB 缺失减少了一个数量级。我们将动态网站的吞吐量提高了 13.3%，同时尾延迟降低了 12.5%，且无需修改应用。

upstream_only.title: Application-Informed Kernel Synchronization Primitives
upstream_only.abstract:
Kernel synchronization primitives are the backbone of any OS design. Kernel locks, for instance, are crucial for both application performance and correctness. However, unlike application locks, kernel locks are far from the reach of application developers, who have minimal interpolation of the kernel's behavior and cannot control or influence the policies that govern kernel synchronization behavior. This disconnect between the kernel and applications can lead to pathological scenarios in which optimizing the kernel synchronization primitives under one context, such as high contention, leads to adversarial effects under a context with no lock contention. In addition, rapid-evolving heterogeneous hardware makes kernel lock development too slow for modern applications with stringent performance requirements and frequent deployment timelines.

This paper addresses the above issues with application-informed kernel synchronization primitives. We allow application developers to deploy workload-specific and hardware-aware kernel lock policies to boost application performance, resolve pathological usage of kernel locks, and even enable dynamic profiling of locks of interest. To showcase this idea, we design SynCord, a framework to modify kernel locks without recompiling or rebooting the kernel. SynCord abstracts key behaviors of kernel locks and exposes them as APIs for designing user-defined kernel locks. SynCord provides the mechanisms to customize kernel locks safely and correctly from the user space. We design five lock policies specialized for new heterogeneous hardware and specific software requirements. Our evaluation shows that SynCord incurs minimal runtime overhead and generates kernel locks with performance comparable to that of the state-of-the-art locks.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 内核同步原语是任何操作系统设计的支柱。例如，内核锁对于应用程序性能和正确性都至关重要。然而，与应用程序锁不同，内核锁远远超出了应用程序开发人员的掌控范围，他们对内核行为的解释能力极弱，无法控制或影响管理内核同步行为的策略。内核与应用程序之间的这种脱节可能导致病态场景，即在一种上下文（如高争用）下优化内核同步原语在无锁争用的上下文下会产生不利影响。此外，快速发展的异构硬件使得内核锁的开发对于具有严格性能要求和频繁部署时间表的现代应用程序来说过于缓慢。本文通过应用感知的内核同步原语解决了上述问题。我们允许应用程序开发人员部署工作负载特定且硬件感知的内核锁策略，以提升应用程序性能，解决内核锁的病态使用，甚至实现对感兴趣锁的动态分析。为了展示这一想法，我们设计了SynCord，一个无需重新编译或重启内核即可修改内核锁的框架。SynCord抽象了内核锁的关键行为，并将其作为API暴露出来，用于设计用户自定义的内核锁。SynCord提供了从用户空间安全且正确定制内核锁的机制。我们设计了五种针对新异构硬件和特定软件需求的锁策略。我们的评估表明，SynCord引入了极小的运行时开销，并生成了性能与最先进锁相当的内核锁。

upstream_only.title: BlackBox: A Container Security Monitor for Protecting Containers on Untrusted Operating Systems
upstream_only.abstract: Containers are widely deployed to package, isolate, and multiplex applications on shared computing infrastructure, but rely on the operating system to enforce their security guarantees. This poses a significant security risk as large operating system codebases contain many vulnerabilities. We have created BlackBox, a new container architecture that provides fine-grain protection of application data confidentiality and integrity without trusting the operating system. BlackBox introduces a container security monitor, a small trusted computing base that creates protected physical address spaces (PPASes) for each container such that there is no direct information flow from container to operating system or other container PPASes. Indirect information flow can only happen through the monitor, which only copies data between container PPASes and the operating system as system call arguments, encrypting data as needed to protect interprocess communication through the operating system. Containerized applications do not need to be modified, can still make use of operating system services via system calls, yet their CPU and memory state are isolated and protected from other containers and the operating system. We have implemented BlackBox by leveraging Arm hardware virtualization support, using nested paging to enforce PPASes. The trusted computing base is a few thousand lines of code, many orders of magnitude less than Linux, yet supports widely-used Linux containers with only modest modifications to the Linux kernel. We show that BlackBox provides superior security guarantees over traditional hypervisor and container architectures with only modest performance overhead on real application workloads.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 容器被广泛用于在共享计算基础设施上打包、隔离和多路复用应用程序，但其安全保证依赖于操作系统来强制执行。这带来了重大的安全风险，因为庞大的操作系统代码库包含许多漏洞。我们创建了BlackBox，一种新的容器架构，无需信任操作系统即可提供应用程序数据机密性和完整性的细粒度保护。BlackBox引入了一个容器安全监视器，这是一个小型可信计算基，为每个容器创建受保护的物理地址空间（PPAS），使得从容器到操作系统或其他容器PPAS之间不存在直接信息流。间接信息流只能通过监视器发生，监视器仅作为系统调用参数在容器PPAS和操作系统之间复制数据，并在需要时加密数据以保护通过操作系统的进程间通信。容器化应用程序无需修改，仍可通过系统调用使用操作系统服务，但它们的CPU和内存状态被隔离并受到保护，免受其他容器和操作系统的影响。我们利用Arm硬件虚拟化支持实现了BlackBox，使用嵌套页表来强制实施PPAS。可信计算基只有几千行代码，比Linux少多个数量级，但只需对Linux内核进行少量修改即可支持广泛使用的Linux容器。我们表明，BlackBox比传统虚拟机管理程序和容器架构提供了更优越的安全保证，并且在实际应用程序工作负载上仅产生适度的性能开销。

upstream_only.title: Blockaid: Data Access Policy Enforcement for Web Applications
upstream_only.abstract:
Modern web applications serve large amounts of sensitive user data, access to which is typically governed by data-access policies. Enforcing such policies is crucial to preventing improper data access, and prior work has proposed many enforcement mechanisms. However, these prior methods either alter application semantics or require adopting a new programming model; the former can result in unexpected application behavior, while the latter cannot be used with existing web frameworks.

Blockaid is an access-policy enforcement system that preserves application semantics and is compatible with existing web frameworks. It intercepts database queries from the application, attempts to verify that each query is policy-compliant, and blocks queries that are not. It verifies policy compliance using SMT solvers and generalizes and caches previous compliance decisions for better performance. We show that Blockaid supports existing web applications while requiring minimal code changes and adding only modest overheads.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代Web应用服务于大量敏感的用户数据，对其访问通常由数据访问策略管理。执行此类策略对于防止不当访问至关重要，先前的工作已提出许多执行机制。然而，此前的方法要么改变应用语义，要么要求采用新的编程模型；前者可能导致意外的应用行为，后者无法与现有Web框架一起使用。Blockaid是一种访问策略执行系统，它在保留应用语义的同时兼容现有Web框架。该系统拦截来自应用的数据库查询，尝试验证每个查询是否符合策略，并阻止不符合的查询。它使用SMT求解器验证策略合规性，并对之前的合规性判断进行泛化和缓存以获得更好的性能。我们证明，Blockaid在支持现有Web应用的同时，只要求最小程度的代码更改，且仅增加适度的开销。

upstream_only.title: SHORTSTACK: Distributed, Fault-tolerant, Oblivious Data Access
upstream_only.abstract:
Many applications that benefit from data offload to cloud services operate on private data. A now-long line of work has shown that, even when data is offloaded in an encrypted form, an adversary can learn sensitive information by analyzing data access patterns. Existing techniques for oblivious data access—that protect against access pattern attacks—require a centralized and stateful trusted proxy to orchestrate data accesses from applications to cloud services. We show that, in failure-prone deployments, such a centralized and stateful proxy results in violation of oblivious data access security guarantees and/or in system unavailability. We thus initiate the study of distributed, fault-tolerant, oblivious data access.

We present Shortstack, a distributed proxy architecture for oblivious data access in failure-prone deployments. Shortstack achieves the classical obliviousness guarantee—access patterns observed by the adversary being independent of the input—even under a powerful passive persistent adversary that can force failure of an arbitrary (bounded-sized) subset of proxy servers at arbitrary times. We also introduce a security model that enables studying oblivious data access with distributed, failure-prone, servers. We provide a formal proof that Shortstack enables oblivious data access under this model, and show empirically that Shortstack performance scales near-linearly with number of distributed proxy servers.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 许多受益于将数据卸载到云服务的应用程序都处理私有数据。已有大量研究表明，即使数据以加密形式卸载，攻击者仍可通过分析数据访问模式来获取敏感信息。现有的不经意数据访问技术——用于防范访问模式攻击——需要集中式且有状态的受信代理来编排从应用程序到云服务的数据访问。我们表明，在易发生故障的部署中，这种集中式且有状态的代理会导致不经意数据访问安全保证被违反和/或系统不可用。因此，我们开创了对分布式、容错、不经意数据访问的研究。

upstream_only.title: Groove: Flexible Metadata-Private Messaging
upstream_only.abstract:
Metadata-private messaging designs that scale to support millions of users are rigid: they limit users to a single device that is online all the time and transmits on short regular intervals, and require users to choose precisely when each of their buddies can message them. These requirements induce high network and energy costs for the clients, restricting users to communicate via one powerful device, like their desktop.

Groove is the first scalable metadata-private messaging system that gives users flexibility: it supports users with multiple devices, allows them to message buddies at any time, even when those buddies are offline, and conserves the user's device bandwidth and energy. Groove offers flexibility by introducing oblivious delegation, where users designate an untrusted service provider to participate in rigid mechanisms of metadata-private communication. It provides differential privacy guarantees on par with rigid systems like Stadium and Karaoke.

An evaluation of a Groove prototype on AWS with 100 servers, distributed across four data centers on two continents, demonstrates that it can achieve 32s of latency for 1 million users with 50 buddies in their contact lists. Experiments with a client running on a Pixel 4 smartphone show that it uses about 100 MB/month of bandwidth and increases battery consumption by 50mW (+16%) compared to an idle smartphone. These measurements show that Groove makes it realistic to hide messaging metadata on a mobile device.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 能够扩展以支持数百万用户的元数据私密消息传递设计是僵化的：它们将用户限制为始终在线且以短而规则的间隔传输的单一设备，并要求用户精确选择每个好友何时可以给他们发消息。这些要求给客户端带来了高昂的网络和能源成本，限制用户只能通过一台强大的设备（如台式机）进行通信。Groove是第一个可扩展的元数据私密消息传递系统，它为用户提供了灵活性：支持用户使用多台设备，允许他们在任何时刻向好友发送消息，即使好友离线也能送达，并节省用户的设备带宽和能源。Groove通过引入 oblivious delegation（隐匿委托）来提供灵活性，用户可指定一个不受信任的服务提供商参与元数据私密通信的刚性机制。它提供的差分隐私保证与 Stadium 和 Karaoke 等刚性系统相当。在横跨两大洲四个数据中心的 AWS 100台服务器上对 Groove 原型进行的评估表明，对于100万用户且每个联系人列表有50个好友的情况，它可实现32秒的延迟。在 Pixel 4 智能手机上运行的客户端实验表明，与空闲智能手机相比，它每月约使用100 MB的带宽，并将电池消耗增加50mW（+16%）。这些测量结果表明，Groove 使得在移动设备上隐藏消息传递元数据变得现实可行。

upstream_only.title: UPGRADVISOR: Early Adopting Dependency Updates Using Hybrid Program Analysis and Hardware Tracing
upstream_only.abstract:
Applications often have fast-paced release schedules, but adoption of software dependency updates can lag by years, leaving applications susceptible to security risks and unexpected breakage. To address this problem, we present UPGRADVISOR, a system that reduces developer effort in evaluating dependency updates and can, in many cases, automatically determine which updates are backward-compatible versus API-breaking. UPGRADVISOR introduces a novel co-designed static analysis and dynamic tracing mechanism to gauge the scope and effect of dependency updates on an application. Static analysis prunes changes irrelevant to an application and clusters relevant ones into targets. Dynamic tracing needs to focus only on whether targets affect an application, making it fast and accurate. UPGRADVISOR handles dynamic interpreted languages and introduces call graph over-approximation to account for their lack of type information and selective hardware tracing to capture program execution while ignoring interpreter machinery.

We have implemented UPGRADVISOR for Python and evaluated it on 172 dependency updates previously blocked from being adopted in widely-used open-source software, including Django, aws-cli, tfx, and Celery. UPGRADVISOR automatically determined that 56% of dependencies were safe to update and reduced by more than an order of magnitude the number of code changes that needed to be considered by dynamic tracing. Evaluating UPGRADVISOR’s tracer in a production-like environment incurred only 3% overhead on average, making it fast enough to deploy in practice. We submitted safe updates that were previously blocked as pull requests for nine projects, and their developers have already merged most of them.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 应用程序通常有快节奏的发布周期，但软件依赖项更新的采用可能滞后数年，使应用程序面临安全风险和意外破坏。为解决此问题，我们提出了UPGRADVISOR，一个降低开发者在评估依赖更新时工作量的系统，并且在许多情况下能自动确定更新是向后兼容还是API破坏性的。UPGRADVISOR引入了一种新颖的协同设计的静态分析和动态追踪机制，以评估依赖更新对应用程序的影响范围和效果。静态分析会裁剪与应用程序无关的更改，并将相关更改聚类为目标。动态追踪只需关注目标是否影响应用程序，因此快速而准确。UPGRADVISOR处理动态解释语言，并通过调用图过度逼近来应对其缺乏类型信息的问题，同时采用选择性硬件追踪来捕获程序执行而忽略解释器机制。

upstream_only.title: Practically Correct, Just-in-Time Shell Script Parallelization
upstream_only.abstract:
Recent shell-script parallelization systems enjoy mostly automated parallel speedups by compiling scripts ahead-of-time. Unfortunately, such static parallelization is hampered by the dynamic behaviors pervasive in shell scripts—e.g., variable expansion and command substitution—which often requires reasoning about the current state of the shell and filesystem.

We present a just-in-time (JIT) shell-script compiler, PaSh-JIT, that intermixes evaluation and parallelization during a script's run-time execution. JIT parallelization collects run-time information about the system’s state, but must not alter the behavior of the original script and must maintain minimal overhead. PaSh-JIT addresses these challenges by (1) using a dynamic interposition framework, guided by a static preprocessing pass, (2) developing runtime support for transparently pausing and resuming shell execution; and (3) operating as a stateful server, communicating with the current shell by passing messages—all without requiring modifications to the system's underlying shell interpreter.

When run on a wide variety of benchmarks, including the POSIX shell test suite, PaSh-JIT (1) does not break scripts, even in cases that are likely to break shells in widespread use; and (2) offers significant speedups, whenever parallelization is possible. These results show that PaSh-JIT can be used as a drop-in replacement for any non-interactive shell use, providing significant speedups without any risk of breakage.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 近期的shell脚本并行化系统通过提前编译脚本实现了大多自动并行的加速。然而，这种静态并行化受到shell脚本中普遍存在的动态行为（例如变量扩展和命令替换）的阻碍，这通常需要推理shell和文件系统的当前状态。我们提出了一种即时（JIT）shell脚本编译器PaSh-JIT，它在脚本运行时将求值和并行化交织在一起。JIT并行化收集有关系统状态的运行时信息，但不能改变原始脚本的行为，并且必须保持最小开销。PaSh-JIT通过以下方式解决这些挑战：(1)使用由静态预处理阶段引导的动态插桩框架，(2)开发用于透明暂停和恢复shell执行的运行时支持；(3)作为有状态服务器运行，通过消息传递与当前shell通信——所有这些都无需对系统底层shell解释器进行修改。当在包括POSIX shell测试套件在内的各种基准测试上运行时，PaSh-JIT (1)即使在被广泛使用的shell可能出现故障的情况下也不会破坏脚本；(2)在可能并行化时提供显著加速。这些结果表明，PaSh-JIT可以作为任何非交互式shell使用的即插即用替代品，提供显著加速且没有任何出错风险。

upstream_only.title: Hubble: Performance Debugging with In-Production, Just-In-Time Method Tracing on Android
upstream_only.abstract: Hubble is a method-tracing system shipped on all supported and upcoming Android devices manufactured by Huawei, in order to aid in debugging performance problems. Hubble instruments every non-inlined bytecode method's entry and exit to record the method's name and a timestamp. Instead of persisting all data, trace points are recorded into an in-memory ring buffer where older data is constantly overwritten. This data is only persisted when a performance problem is detected, giving engineers access to invaluable, detailed runtime data Just-In-Time before the detected anomaly. Hubble is highly efficient, with its tracing inducing negligible overhead in real-world usage and each trace point taking less than one nanosecond in our microbenchmark. Hubble significantly eases the debugging of user-experienced performance problems and has enabled engineers to quickly resolve many bug tickets that were open for months before Hubble was available.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Hubble是一个方法跟踪系统，预装在所有受支持和即将推出的华为制造Android设备上，以帮助调试性能问题。Hubble对每个未内联字节码方法的入口和出口进行插桩，记录方法名和时间戳。它不持久化所有数据，而是将跟踪点记录到内存环形缓冲区中，旧数据不断被覆盖。只有在检测到性能问题时，该数据才会被持久化，从而让工程师在检测到异常前即时获取宝贵的详细运行时数据。Hubble非常高效，其跟踪在实际使用中产生的开销可忽略不计，在我们的微基准测试中每个跟踪点耗时不到一纳秒。Hubble显著简化了用户所体验性能问题的调试，并使工程师能够快速解决许多在Hubble出现之前已开放数月的缺陷工单。

upstream_only.title: Jawa: Web Archival in the Era of JavaScript
upstream_only.abstract:
By repeatedly crawling and saving web pages over time, web archives (such as the Internet Archive) enable users to visit historical versions of any page. In this paper, we point out that existing web archives are not well designed to cope with the widespread presence of JavaScript on the web. Some archives store petabytes of JavaScript code, and yet many pages render incorrectly when users load them. Other archives which store the end-state of page loads (e.g., screen captures) break post-load interactions implemented in JavaScript.

To address these problems, we present Jawa, a new design for web archives which significantly reduces the storage necessary to save modern web pages while also improving the fidelity with which archived pages are served. Key to enabling Jawa’s use at scale are our observations on a) the forms of non-determinism which impair the execution of JavaScript on archived pages, and b) the ways in which JavaScript’s execution fundamentally differs between live web pages and their archived copies. On a corpus of 1 million archived pages, Jawa reduces overall storage needs by 41%, when compared to the techniques currently used by the Internet Archive.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 通过随着时间的推移反复爬取和保存网页，Web存档（如互联网档案馆）使用户能够访问任何页面的历史版本。在本文中，我们指出现有的Web存档在设计上并不能很好地应对JavaScript在网络上的广泛存在。一些档案馆存储了PB级的JavaScript代码，但当用户加载许多页面时，这些页面渲染不正确。另一些档案馆存储页面加载的最终状态（例如屏幕截图），但这破坏了以JavaScript实现的后加载交互。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了Jawa——一种新的Web存档设计，它显著减少了保存现代网页所需的存储量，同时提高了存档页面提供时的保真度。支持Jawa大规模使用的关键是我们对以下方面的观察：a) 损害存档页面上JavaScript执行的非确定性形式，以及b) JavaScript在实时网页与其存档副本之间的执行方式存在的根本差异。在一个包含100万个存档页面的语料库上，与互联网档案馆目前使用的技术相比，Jawa的整体存储需求减少了41%。

upstream_only.title: Ekko: A Large-Scale Deep Learning Recommender System with Low-Latency Model Update
upstream_only.abstract:
Deep Learning Recommender Systems (DLRSs) need to update models at low latency, thus promptly serving new users and content. Existing DLRSs, however, fail to do so. They train/validate models offline and broadcast entire models to global inference clusters. They thus incur significant model update latency (e.g. dozens of minutes), which adversely affects Service-Level Objectives (SLOs).

This paper describes Ekko, a novel DLRS that enables low-latency model updates. Its design idea is to allow model updates to be immediately disseminated to all inference clusters, thus bypassing long-latency model checkpoint, validation and broadcast. To realise this idea, we first design an efficient peer-to-peer model update dissemination algorithm. This algorithm exploits the sparsity and temporal locality in updating DLRS models to improve the throughput and latency of updating models. Further, Ekko has a model update scheduler that can prioritise, over busy networks, the sending of model updates that can largely affect SLOs. Finally, Ekko has an inference model state manager which monitors the SLOs of inference models and rollbacks the models if SLO-detrimental biased updates are detected. Evaluation results show that Ekko is orders of magnitude faster than state-of-the-art DLRS systems. Ekko has been deployed in production for more than one year, serves over a billion users daily and reduces the model update latency compared to state-of-the-art systems from dozens of minutes to 2.4 seconds.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 深度学习推荐系统（DLRS）需要以低延迟更新模型，从而快速服务新用户和新内容。然而，现有的DLRS无法做到这一点。它们离线训练/验证模型，并将整个模型广播到全球推理集群。因此，它们会产生显著的模型更新延迟（例如数十分钟），这对服务水平目标（SLO）产生不利影响。本文描述了Ekko，一种新颖的DLRS，能够实现低延迟模型更新。其设计理念是允许模型更新立即传播到所有推理集群，从而绕过长时间延迟的模型检查点、验证和广播过程。为实现这一理念，我们首先设计了一种高效的端到端模型更新传播算法。该算法利用更新DLRS模型时的稀疏性和时间局部性来提高更新模型的吞吐量和延迟。此外，Ekko具有模型更新调度器，可以在繁忙网络中对显著影响SLO的模型更新进行优先排序。最后，Ekko具有推理模型状态管理器，该管理器监控推理模型的SLO，并在检测到有害于SLO的偏差更新时回滚模型。评估结果表明，Ekko比最先进的DLRS系统快数个数量级。Ekko已在生产中部署超过一年，每天服务超过十亿用户，并将模型更新延迟从最先进系统的数十分钟降低到2.4秒。

upstream_only.title: FAERY: An FPGA-accelerated Embedding-based Retrieval System
upstream_only.abstract:
Embedding-based retrieval (EBR) is widely used in recommendation systems to retrieve thousands of relevant candidates from a large corpus with millions or more items. A good EBR system needs to achieve both high throughput and low latency, as high throughput usually means cost saving and low latency improves user experience. Unfortunately, the performances of existing CPU- and GPU-based EBR are far from optimal due to their inherent architectural limitations.

In this paper, we first study how an ideal yet practical EBR system works, and then design FAERY , an FPGA-accelerated EBR, which achieves the optimal performance of the practically ideal EBR system. FAERY is composed of three key components: It uses a high bandwidth HBM for memory bandwidth-intensive corpus scanning, a data parallelism approach for similarity calculation, and a pipeline-based approach for K-selection. To further reduce hardware resources, FAERY introduces a filter to early drop the non-Top-K items. Experiments show that the degraded FAERY with the same memory bandwidth of GPU still achieves 1.21×-12.27× lower latency and up to 4.29× higher throughput under a latency target of 10 ms than GPU-based EBR.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 基于嵌入的检索（EBR）广泛应用于推荐系统，从包含数百万或更多项目的大型语料库中检索数千个相关候选。一个好的EBR系统需要同时实现高吞吐量和低延迟，因为高吞吐量通常意味着节省成本，低延迟则提升用户体验。不幸的是，由于CPU和GPU固有的架构限制，现有基于CPU和GPU的EBR性能远非最优。在本文中，我们首先研究了一个理想但实际的EBR系统的工作方式，然后设计了FAERY，一个FPGA加速的EBR系统，实现了实际理想EBR系统的最优性能。FAERY由三个关键组件组成：它使用高带宽HBM用于内存带宽密集的语料库扫描，一种数据并行方法用于相似度计算，以及一种基于流水线的方法用于K选择。为了进一步减少硬件资源，FAERY引入了一个过滤器来提前丢弃非Top-K项目。实验表明，在相同GPU内存带宽下，降级的FAERY在10 ms延迟目标下仍比基于GPU的EBR实现了1.21倍到12.27倍的更低延迟和高达4.29倍的更高吞吐量。

upstream_only.title: Efficient and Scalable Graph Pattern Mining on GPUs
upstream_only.abstract:
Graph Pattern Mining (GPM) extracts higher-order information in a large graph by searching for small patterns of interest. GPM applications are computationally expensive, and thus attractive for GPU acceleration. Unfortunately, due to the complexity of GPM algorithms and parallel hardware, hand optimizing GPM applications suffers programming complexity, while existing GPM frameworks sacrifice efficiency for programmability. Moreover, little work has been done on GPU to scale GPM computation to large problem sizes. 

We describe G2Miner, the first graph pattern mining (GPM) framework that runs efficiently on multiple GPUs. G2Miner uses pattern-aware, input-aware and architecture-aware search strategies to achieve high efficiency on GPUs. To simplify programming, it provides a code generator that automatically generates pattern-aware CUDA code. G2Miner flexibly supports both breadth-first search (BFS) and depth-first search (DFS) to maximize memory utilization and generate sufficient parallelism for GPUs. For the scalability of G2Miner, we propose a customized scheduling policy to balance workload among multiple GPUs. Experiments on a V100 GPU show that G2Miner is 5.4× and 7.2× faster than the two state-of-the-art single-GPU systems, Pangolin and PBE, respectively. In the multi-GPU setting, G2Miner achieves linear speedups from 1 to 8 GPUs, for various patterns and data graphs. We also show that G2Miner on a V100 GPU is 48.3× and 15.2× faster than the state-of-the-art CPU-based systems, Peregrine and GraphZero, on a 56-core CPU machine.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 图模式挖掘(GPM)通过搜索感兴趣的小模式来提取大图中的高阶信息。GPM应用计算代价高昂，因此非常适合GPU加速。然而，由于GPM算法和并行硬件的复杂性，手工优化GPM应用面临编程复杂性，而现有GPM框架则以牺牲效率换取可编程性。此外，在GPU上扩展GPM计算以处理大规模问题的工作还很少。我们描述了G2Miner，这是第一个在多GPU上高效运行的图模式挖掘框架。G2Miner采用模式感知、输入感知和架构感知的搜索策略，以在GPU上实现高效率。为了简化编程，它提供了一个代码生成器，可自动生成模式感知的CUDA代码。G2Miner灵活支持广度优先搜索(BFS)和深度优先搜索(DFS)，以最大化内存利用率并为GPU生成足够的并行性。为了G2Miner的可扩展性，我们提出了一种自定义调度策略，以在多GPU之间平衡工作负载。在V100 GPU上的实验表明，G2Miner分别比两个最先进的单GPU系统Pangolin和PBE快5.4倍和7.2倍。在多GPU设置中，G2Miner在1到8个GPU上实现了线性加速，适用于各种模式和数据图。我们还表明，在V100 GPU上的G2Miner比在56核CPU机器上运行的最先进的基于CPU的系统Peregrine和GraphZero分别快48.3倍和15.2倍。

upstream_only.title: Sky Computing
upstream_only.abstract: Technology ecosystems often undergo significant transformations as they mature. For example, telephony, the Internet, and PCs all started with a single provider, but each is now served by a competitive market that uses comprehensive technology standards to provide compatibility. In this talk, I will present our view on how the cloud ecosystem, only fifteen years old, could evolve as it matures, and discuss our early results and experience in this endeavor.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 技术生态系统在成熟过程中常常经历重大转型。例如，电话、互联网和个人电脑都始于单一供应商，但如今均由一个竞争性市场提供服务，该市场利用全面的技术标准来实现兼容性。在本次报告中，我将阐述我们对于年仅十五年历史的云生态系统在成熟过程中可能如何演变的看法，并讨论我们在此项工作中的早期成果和经验。

upstream_only.title: Ship your Critical Section, Not Your Data: Enabling Transparent Delegation with TCLOCKS
upstream_only.abstract:
Today's high-performance applications heavily rely on various synchronization mechanisms, such as locks. While locks ensure mutual exclusion of shared data, their design impacts application scalability. Locks, as used in practice, move the lock-guarded shared data to the core holding it, which leads to shared data transfer among cores. This design adds unavoidable critical path latency leading to performance scalability issues. Meanwhile, some locks avoid this shared data movement by localizing the access to shared data on one core, and shipping the critical section to that specific core. However, such locks require modifying applications to explicitly package the critical section, which makes it virtually infeasible for complicated applications with large code bases, such as the Linux kernel.  

We propose transparent delegation, in which a waiter automatically encodes its critical section information on its stack and notifies the combiner (lock holder). The combiner executes the shipped critical section on the waiter's behalf using a lightweight context switch. Using transparent delegation, we design a family of locking protocols, called TCLocks, that requires zero modification to applications' logic.
