upstream_only.title: AdaEmbed: Adaptive Embedding for Large-Scale Recommendation Models
upstream_only.abstract:
Deep learning recommendation models (DLRMs) are using increasingly larger embedding tables to represent categorical sparse features such as video genres. Each embedding row of the table represents the trainable weight vector for a specific instance of that feature. While increasing the number of embedding rows typically improves model accuracy by considering more feature instances, it can lead to larger deployment costs and slower model execution. 

Unlike existing efforts that primarily focus on optimizing DLRMs for the given embedding, we present a complementary system, AdaEmbed, to reduce the size of embeddings needed for the same DLRM accuracy via in-training embedding pruning. Our key insight is that the access patterns and weights of different embeddings are heterogeneous across embedding rows, and dynamically change over the training process, implying varying embedding importance with respect to model accuracy. However, identifying important embeddings and then enforcing pruning for modern DLRMs with up to billions of embeddings (terabytes) is challenging. Given the total embedding size, AdaEmbed considers embeddings with higher runtime access frequencies and larger training gradients to be more important, and it dynamically prunes less important embeddings at scale to automatically determine per-feature embeddings. Our evaluations in industrial settings show that AdaEmbed saves 35-60% embedding size needed in deployment and improves model execution speed by 11-34%, while achieving noticeable accuracy gains.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 深度学习推荐模型（DLRM）正使用越来越大的嵌入表来表示类别稀疏特征，如视频类型。表中的每一行嵌入表示该特征特定实例的可训练权重向量。虽然增加嵌入行数通常通过考虑更多特征实例来提高模型准确性，但也可能导致更高的部署成本和更慢的模型执行速度。与现有主要针对给定嵌入优化DLRM的工作不同，我们提出了一种互补系统AdaEmbed，通过训练中嵌入剪枝来减少达到相同DLRM精度所需的嵌入大小。我们的关键洞察是，不同嵌入的访问模式和权重在嵌入行之间是异构的，并在训练过程中动态变化，这意味着嵌入对模型准确性的重要性各不相同。然而，对于拥有高达数十亿嵌入（TB级）的现代DLRM，识别重要嵌入并实施剪枝具有挑战性。在给定总嵌入大小的情况下，AdaEmbed认为运行时访问频率更高且训练梯度更大的嵌入更为重要，它在大规模下动态剪枝不太重要的嵌入，以自动确定每个特征的嵌入。我们在工业环境中的评估表明，AdaEmbed在部署中节省了35%-60%的嵌入大小，模型执行速度提高了11%-34%，同时实现了显著的准确率提升。

upstream_only.title: BWoS: Formally Verified Block-based Work Stealing for Parallel Processing
upstream_only.abstract:
Work stealing is a widely-used scheduling technique for parallel processing on multicore. Each core owns a queue of tasks and avoids idling by stealing tasks from other queues. Prior work mostly focuses on balancing workload among cores, disregarding whether stealing may adversely impact the owner's performance or hinder synchronization optimizations. Real-world industrial runtimes for parallel processing heavily rely on work-stealing queues for scalability, and such queues can become bottlenecks to their performance. 

We present Block-based Work Stealing (BWoS), a novel and pragmatic design that splits per-core queues into multiple blocks. Thieves and owners rarely operate on the same blocks, greatly removing interferences and enabling aggressive optimizations on the owner's synchronization with thieves. Furthermore, BWoS enables a novel probabilistic stealing policy that guarantees thieves steal from longer queues with higher probability. In our evaluation, using BWoS improves performance by up to 1.25x in the Renaissance macrobenchmark when applied to Java GC, provides average 1.26x speedup in JSON processing when applied to Go runtime, and improves maximum throughput of Hyper HTTP server by 1.12x when applied to Rust Tokio runtime. In microbenchmarks, it provides 8-11x better performance than state-of-the-art designs. We have formally verified and optimized BWoS on weak memory models with a model-checking-based framework.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 工作窃取是一种广泛使用的多核并行处理调度技术。每个核心拥有一个任务队列，并通过窃取其他队列的任务来避免空闲。先前的工作大多侧重于平衡核心间的工作负载，而忽略了窃取是否会对拥有者性能产生不利影响或阻碍同步优化。现实世界中的并行处理工业运行时高度依赖工作窃取队列来实现可扩展性，而此类队列可能成为其性能瓶颈。我们提出了基于块的工作窃取（BWoS），一种新颖且实用的设计，将每核心队列拆分为多个块。窃取者和拥有者很少操作同一块，大大减少了干扰，并允许对拥有者与窃取者的同步进行激进优化。此外，BWoS引入了一种新颖的概率窃取策略，保证窃取者以更高的概率从更长的队列中窃取。在我们的评估中，将BWoS应用于Java GC时，在Renaissance宏基准测试中性能提升最高达1.25倍；应用于Go运行时，JSON处理平均加速1.26倍；应用于Rust Tokio运行时，Hyper HTTP服务器的最大吞吐量提升1.12倍。在微基准测试中，其性能比最先进的设计好8-11倍。我们使用基于模型检查的框架在弱内存模型上对BWoS进行了形式化验证和优化。

upstream_only.title: Spoq: Scaling Machine-Checkable Systems Verification in Coq
upstream_only.abstract: System software is often large and complex, resulting in many vulnerabilities that can potentially be exploited to compromise the security of a system. Formal verification offers a potential solution to creating bug-free software, but a key impediment to its adoption remains proof cost. We present Spoq, a highly automated verification framework to construct machine-checkable proofs in Coq for system software with much less proof cost. Spoq introduces a novel program structure reconstruction technique to leverage LLVM to translate C code into Coq, supporting full C semantics, including C macros, inline assembly, and compiler directives, so that source code no longer has to be manually modified to be verified. Spoq leverages a layering proof strategy and introduces novel Coq tactics and transformation rules to automatically generate layer specifications and refinement proofs to simplify verification of concurrent system software. Spoq also supports easy integration of manually written layer specifications and refinement proofs. We use Spoq to verify a multiprocessor KVM hypervisor implementation. Verification using Spoq required 70% less proof effort than the manually written specifications and proofs to verify an older implementation. Furthermore, the proofs using Spoq hold for the unmodified implementation that is directly compiled and executed.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 系统软件通常庞大而复杂，导致许多可能被利用来危害系统安全的漏洞。形式化验证为创建无缺陷软件提供了一种潜在解决方案，但阻碍其采用的一个关键因素仍然是证明成本。我们提出了Spoq，一个高度自动化的验证框架，能够在Coq中为系统软件构建机器可检查的证明，从而大幅降低证明成本。Spoq引入了一种新颖的程序结构重建技术，利用LLVM将C代码翻译为Coq，支持完整的C语义，包括C宏、内联汇编和编译器指令，从而无需为了验证而手动修改源代码。Spoq采用分层证明策略，并引入新颖的Coq策略和转换规则，以自动生成层规范与精化证明，从而简化并发系统软件的验证。Spoq还支持轻松集成手动编写的层规范和精化证明。我们使用Spoq验证了一个多处理器KVM虚拟机监控器实现。与验证旧实现时手动编写的规范和证明相比，使用Spoq进行验证所需的证明工作量减少了70%。此外，使用Spoq的证明适用于未被修改且直接编译和执行的具体实现。

upstream_only.title: Verifying vMVCC, a high-performance transaction library using multi-version concurrency control
upstream_only.abstract: Multi-version concurrency control (MVCC) is a widely used, sophisticated approach for handling concurrent transactions. vMVCC is the first MVCC-based transaction library that comes with a machine-checked proof of correctness, providing clients with a guarantee that it will correctly handle all transactions despite a complicated design and implementation that might otherwise be error-prone. vMVCC is implemented in Go, stores data in memory, and uses several optimizations, such as RDTSC-based timestamps, to achieve high performance (25–96% the throughput of Silo, a state-of-the-art in-memory database, for YCSB and TPC-C workloads). Formally specifying and verifying vMVCC required adopting advanced proof techniques, such as logical atomicity and prophecy variables, owing to the fact that MVCC transactions can linearize at timestamp generation prior to transaction execution.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 多版本并发控制（MVCC）是一种广泛使用且复杂的事务并发处理方法。vMVCC 是首个带有机检正确性证明的基于 MVCC 的事务库，它向客户端保证：尽管设计和实现复杂且可能容易出错，该库仍能正确处理所有事务。vMVCC 使用 Go 语言实现，将数据存储在内存中，并采用多种优化手段（如基于 RDTSC 的时间戳）以获得高性能（在 YCSB 和 TPC-C 工作负载下，吞吐量达到最先进内存数据库 Silo 的 25%–96%）。由于 MVCC 事务可以在事务执行之前的时间戳生成处进行线性化，因此正式规范并验证 vMVCC 需要采用先进的证明技术，如逻辑原子性和预言变量。

upstream_only.title: Automated Verification of Idempotence for Stateful Serverless Applications
upstream_only.abstract:
Serverless computing has become a popular cloud computing paradigm. By default, when a serverless function fails, the serverless platform re-executes the function to tolerate the failure. However, such a retry-based approach requires functions to be idempotent, which means that functions should expose the same behavior regardless of retries. This requirement is challenging for developers, especially when functions are stateful. Failures may cause functions to repeatedly read and update shared states, potentially corrupting data consistency.   

This paper presents Flux, the first toolkit that automatically verifies the idempotence of serverless applications. It proposes a new correctness definition, idempotence consistency, which stipulates that a serverless function’s retry is transparent to users. To verify idempotence consistency, Flux defines a novel property, idempotence simulation, which decomposes the proof for a concurrent serverless application into the reasoning of individual functions. Furthermore, Flux extends existing verification techniques to realize automated reasoning, enabling Flux to identify idempotence-violating operations and fix them with existing log-based methods.   

We demonstrate the efficacy of Flux with 27 representative serverless applications. Flux has successfully identified previously unknown issues in 12 applications. Developers have confirmed 8 issues. Compared to state-of-the-art systems (namely Beldi and Boki) that log every operation, Flux achieves up to 6× lower latency and 10× higher peak throughput, as it logs only the identified idempotence-violating ones.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 无服务器计算已成为一种流行的云计算范式。默认情况下，当无服务器函数失败时，平台会重新执行该函数以容忍故障。然而，这种基于重试的方法要求函数是幂等的，也就是说，无论重试多少次，函数都应表现出相同的行为。这一要求对开发者而言具有挑战性，尤其是当函数是有状态的。故障可能导致函数反复读取和更新共享状态，从而可能破坏数据一致性。本文提出了Flux，这是第一个自动验证无服务器应用幂等性的工具包。它定义了一个新的正确性概念——幂等一致性，规定无服务器函数的重试对用户是透明的。为了验证幂等一致性，Flux定义了一个新属性——幂等模拟，它将并发无服务器应用的证明分解为对各个函数的推理。此外，Flux扩展了现有的验证技术以实现自动化推理，使其能够识别违反幂等性的操作，并用现有的基于日志的方法加以修复。我们用27个代表性的无服务器应用展示了Flux的有效性。Flux成功识别了12个应用中先前未知的问题。开发人员已确认其中8个问题。与对所有操作都记录日志的最新系统（即Beldi和Boki）相比，Flux仅记录识别到的违反幂等性的操作，因此实现了最高6倍的更低延迟和10倍的更高峰值吞吐量。

upstream_only.title: Sharding the State Machine: Automated Modular Reasoning for Complex Concurrent Systems
upstream_only.abstract: We present IronSync, an automated verification framework for concurrent code with shared memory. IronSync scales to complex systems by splitting system-wide proofs into isolated concerns such that each can be substantially automated. As a starting point, IronSync's ownership type system allows a developer to straightforwardly prove both data safety and the logical correctness of thread-local operations. IronSync then introduces the concept of a Localized Transition System, which connects the correctness of local actions to the correctness of the entire system. We demonstrate IronSync by verifying two state-of-the-art concurrent systems comprising thousands of lines: a library for black-box replication on NUMA architectures, and a highly concurrent page cache.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了 IronSync，一个用于共享内存并发代码的自动化验证框架。IronSync 通过将系统级证明分解为孤立关注点，使得每个关注点都可以大幅自动化，从而扩展到复杂系统。作为起点，IronSync 的所有权类型系统允许开发者直接证明数据安全性和线程本地操作的逻辑正确性。接着，IronSync 引入了局部迁移系统（Localized Transition System）的概念，将局部动作的正确性与整个系统的正确性联系起来。我们通过验证两个包含数千行代码的最新并发系统来演示 IronSync：一个用于 NUMA 架构上的黑盒复制库，以及一个高度并发的页缓存。

upstream_only.title: Flor: An Open High Performance RDMA Framework Over Heterogeneous RNICs
upstream_only.abstract: Datacenter applications have been increasingly applying RDMA for the ultra-low latency and low CPU overhead. However, RDMA-capable NICs (RNICs) of different vendors and different generations from the same vendors do not cooperate well, which causes bandwidth imbalance in the production network. Our observation of the heterogeneous RNICs is that though the data path functions of these RNICs follow the same RoCEv2 specifications, their control path functions are vendor and version specific. To this end, we propose Flor, an open framework that provides a flexible control plane in software and a unified hardware plane by adopting heterogeneous RNICs. The hardware plane requires no changes of current specifications. The software plane can run in NPU of RNICs, DPUs and host CPUs, following which we build up strengthen reliable transport over the large-scale lossy Ethernet. We implemented and evaluated Flor in both testbed and production clusters over Intel E180, Mellanox CX-4 and CX-5 and Broadcom RNICs. Experiments show that Flor achieves comparable performance to vanilla RDMA in many scenarios including 1/4096 packet loss, 6000:1 incast, and large-scale cross-pod communication. Flor mitigates the performance gap of CX-4 and CX-5 RNICs from 24.3% to 1.3% when they are deployed together without PFC dependency.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 数据中心应用越来越多地采用RDMA以获得超低延迟和低CPU开销。然而，不同厂商以及同一厂商不同代际的RDMA网卡（RNIC）之间协作不佳，导致生产网络中带宽失衡。我们对异构RNIC的观察是，虽然这些RNIC的数据路径功能遵循相同的RoCEv2规范，但其控制路径功能是厂商和版本特定的。为此，我们提出了Flor，一个开放框架，通过在软件中提供灵活的控制平面，并采用异构RNIC实现统一的硬件平面。该硬件平面无需修改现有规范。软件平面可运行于RNIC的NPU、DPU和主机CPU之上，从而在大规模有损以太网上建立增强的可靠传输。我们在Intel E180、Mellanox CX-4和CX-5以及Broadcom RNIC的测试床和生产集群中实现并评估了Flor。实验表明，在包括1/4096丢包、6000:1 发塞流量和大规模跨Pod通信的许多场景中，Flor均实现了与原生RDMA相当的性能。当CX-4和CX-5 RNIC共同部署时，Flor将它们的性能差距从24.3%降至1.3%，且不依赖PFC。

upstream_only.title: ShRing: Networking with Shared Receive Rings
upstream_only.abstract:
Multicore systems parallelize to accommodate incoming Ethernet traffic, allocating one receive (Rx) ring with ≥1Ki entries per core by default. This ring size is sufficient to absorb packet bursts of single-core workloads. But the combined size of all Rx buffers (pointed to by all Rx rings) can exceed the size of the last-level cache. We observe that, in this case, NIC and CPU memory accesses are increasingly served by main memory, which might incur nonnegligible overheads when scaling to hundreds of incoming gigabits per second. 

To alleviate this problem, we propose "shRing," which shares each Rx ring among several cores when networking memory bandwidth consumption is high. ShRing thus adds software synchronization costs, but this overhead is offset by the smaller memory footprint. We show that, consequently, shRing increases the throughput of NFV workloads by up to 1.27x, and that it reduces their latency by up to 38x. The substantial latency reduction occurs when shRing shortens the per-packet processing time to a value smaller than the packet interarrival time, thereby preventing overload conditions.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 多核系统通过并行化来接纳传入的以太网流量，默认情况下为每个核心分配一个具有≥1K个条目的接收(Rx)环。该环的大小足以吸收单核工作负载的数据包突发。但所有Rx缓冲区（由所有Rx环指向）的总大小可能超过末级缓存的大小。我们观察到，在这种情况下，NIC和CPU的内存访问越来越多地由主内存来服务，当扩展到每秒数百吉比特的传入流量时，这可能会产生不可忽略的开销。为缓解这一问题，我们提出了“shRing”，当网络内存带宽消耗较高时，它在多个核心之间共享每个Rx环。因此，shRing增加了软件同步成本，但这一开销会被更小的内存占用所抵消。我们表明，shRing可以将NFV工作负载的吞吐量提升至多1.27倍，并将其延迟降低至多38倍。当shRing将每数据包处理时间缩短到小于数据包到达间隔时，就会实现显著的延迟降低，从而防止过载情况的发生。

upstream_only.title: ServiceRouter: Hyperscale and Minimal Cost Service Mesh at Meta
upstream_only.abstract: Datacenter applications are often structured as many interconnected microservices, and the service mesh has become a popular approach to route RPC traffic among services. This paper presents Meta's global service mesh, called ServiceRouter (SR), which has been in production since 2012. SR differs from publicly known service meshes in several important ways. First, SR is designed for hyperscale and currently uses millions of L7 routers to route tens of billions of requests per second across tens of thousands of services. Second, while SR adopts the common approach of using sidecar or remote proxies to route 1% of RPC requests in our fleet, it employs a routing library that is directly linked into service executables to route the remaining 99% directly from clients to servers, without the extra hop of going through a proxy. This approach significantly reduces the hardware costs of our hyperscale service mesh, saving hundreds of thousands of machines. Third, SR provides built-in support for sharded services, which account for 68% of RPC requests in our fleet, whereas existing general-purpose service meshes do not support sharded services. Finally, SR introduces the concept of locality rings to simultaneously minimize RPC latency and balance load across geo-distributed datacenter regions, which, to our knowledge, has not been attempted before.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 数据中心应用程序通常由许多互相连接的微服务组成，服务网格已成为在服务之间路由RPC流量的流行方法。本文介绍了Meta的全球服务网格，称为ServiceRouter（SR），自2012年以来一直在生产环境中运行。SR在一些重要方面与公开已知的服务网格不同。首先，SR被设计用于超大规模场景，目前使用数百万个L7路由器每秒路由数百亿请求，跨越数万个服务。第二，虽然SR采用常用方法使用sidecar或远程代理来路由我们数据中心内1%的RPC请求，但它使用一个直接链接到服务可执行文件中的路由库，将剩余的99%直接从客户端路由到服务器，无需经过代理的额外一跳。这种方法大幅降低了超大规模服务网格的硬件成本，节省了数十万台机器。第三，SR为分片服务提供内建支持，这占了我们数据中心内68%的RPC请求，而现有的通用服务网格不支持分片服务。最后，SR引入了定位环的概念，以同时最小化RPC延迟并均衡跨地理分布式数据中心区域的负载，据我们所知，此前尚未有过这样的尝试。

upstream_only.title: Characterizing Off-path SmartNIC for Accelerating Distributed Systems
upstream_only.abstract: SmartNICs have recently emerged as an appealing device for accelerating distributed systems. However, there has not been a comprehensive characterization of SmartNICs, and existing designs typically only leverage a single communication path for workload offloading. This paper presents the first holistic study of a representative off-path SmartNIC, specifically the Bluefield-2, from a communication-path perspective. Our experimental study systematically explores the key performance characteristics of communication among the client, on-board SoC, and host, and offers insightful findings and advice for designers. Moreover, we propose the concurrent use of multiple communication paths of a SmartNIC and present a pioneering guideline to expose new optimization opportunities for various distributed systems. To demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, we conducted case studies on a SmartNIC-based distributed file system (LineFS) and an RDMA-based disaggregated key-value store (DrTM-KV). Our experimental results show improvements of up to 30% and 25% for LineFS and DrTM-KV, respectively.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: SmartNIC最近已成为加速分布式系统的一种有吸引力的设备。然而，尚未有对SmartNIC的全面特征化，现有设计通常只利用单一通信路径进行工作负载卸载。本文从通信路径的角度首次对具有代表性的路径外SmartNIC（特别是Bluefield-2）进行了整体研究。我们的实验研究系统地探索了客户端、片上SoC和主机之间通信的关键性能特征，并为设计者提供了有见地的发现和建议。此外，我们提出了并发使用SmartNIC的多条通信路径，并提出了开创性的指导方针，以揭示各种分布式系统的新优化机会。为了证明我们方法的有效性，我们基于SmartNIC的分布式文件系统（LineFS）和基于RDMA的分解式键值存储（DrTM-KV）进行了案例研究。实验结果显示，LineFS和DrTM-KV的性能分别提升了高达30%和25%。

upstream_only.title: Ensō: A Streaming Interface for NIC-Application Communication
upstream_only.abstract:
Today, most communication between the NIC and software involves exchanging fixed-size packet buffers. This packetized interface was designed for an era when NICs implemented few offloads and software implemented the logic for translating between application data and packets. However, both NICs and networked software have evolved: modern NICs implement hardware offloads, e.g., TSO, LRO, and serialization offloads that can more efficiently translate between application data and packets. Furthermore, modern software increasingly batches network I/O to reduce overheads. These changes have led to a mismatch between the packetized interface, which assumes that the NIC and software exchange fixed-size buffers, and the features provided by modern NICs and used by modern software. This incongruence between interface and data adds software complexity and I/O overheads, which in turn limits communication performance.

This paper proposes Ensō, a new streaming NIC-to-software interface designed to better support how NICs and software interact today. At its core, Ensō eschews fixed-size buffers, and instead structures communication as a stream that can be used to send arbitrary data sizes. We show that this change reduces software overheads, reduces PCIe bandwidth requirements, and leads to fewer cache misses. These improvements allow an Ensō-based NIC to saturate a 100 Gbps link with minimum-sized packets (forwarding at 148.8 Mpps) using a single core, improve throughput for high-performance network applications by 1.5-6x, and reduce latency by up to 43%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 如今，NIC与软件之间的大多数通信均涉及交换固定大小的数据包缓冲区。这种数据包化接口设计于一个NIC仅实现少量卸载、而由软件实现应用数据与数据包之间转换逻辑的时代。然而，无论是NIC还是网络软件都已演变：现代NIC实现了硬件卸载（例如TSO、LRO以及串行化卸载），可以更高效地在应用数据与数据包之间进行转换。此外，现代软件日益采用批处理网络I/O以降低开销。这些变化导致数据包化接口（假设NIC与软件交换固定大小缓冲区）与现代NIC提供的特性和现代软件采用的做法之间产生了错配。接口与数据之间的这种不一致增加了软件复杂性和I/O开销，进而限制了通信性能。本文提出Ensō，一种新的数据流式NIC到软件接口，旨在更好地支持当今NIC与软件的交互方式。Ensō的核心是摒弃固定大小缓冲区，而是将通信结构化为一个可用于发送任意大小数据的流。我们表明，这一改变降低了软件开销、减少了PCIe带宽需求，并减少了缓存未命中。这些改进使基于Ensō的NIC能够用单个内核以最小大小数据包饱和100 Gbps链路（148.8 Mpps转发），将高性能网络应用的吞吐量提升1.5-6倍，并将延迟降低高达43%。

upstream_only.title: Sabre: hardware-accelerated snapshot compression for serverless MicroVMs
upstream_only.abstract: MicroVM snapshotting significantly reduces the cold start overheads in serverless applications. Snapshotting enables storing part of the physical memory of a microVM guest into a file, and later restoring from it to avoid long cold start-up times. Prefetching memory pages from snapshots can further improve the effectiveness of snapshotting. However, the efficacy of prefetching depends on the size of the memory that needs to be restored. Lossless page compression is therefore a great way to improve the coverage of the memory footprint that snapshotting with prefetching achieves. Unfortunately, the high overhead and high CPU cost of software-based (de)compression make this impractical.We introduce Sabre, a novel approach to snapshot page prefetching based on hardware-accelerated (de)compression. Sabre leverages an increasingly pervasive near-memory analytics accelerator available in modern datacenter processors. We show that by appropriately leveraging such accelerators, microVM snapshots of serverless applications can be compressed up to a factor of 4.5\texttimes{}, with nearly negligible decompression costs. We use this insight to build an efficient page prefetching library capable of speeding up memory restoration from snapshots by up to 55\%. We integrate the library with the production-grade Firecracker microVMs and evaluate its end-to-end performance on a wide set of serverless applications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 微虚拟机快照大大减少了无服务器应用中的冷启动开销。快照可以将微虚拟机客户机的部分物理内存存储到文件中，并在之后进行恢复，以避免漫长的冷启动时间。从快照预取内存页面可以进一步提高快照的有效性。然而，预取的效果取决于需要恢复的内存大小。因此，无损页面压缩是提高预取式快照所覆盖内存占用范围的好方法。不幸的是，基于软件的解/压缩的高开销和高CPU成本使其不切实际。我们介绍了Sabre，一种基于硬件加速解/压缩的快照页面预取新方法。Sabre利用了现代数据中心处理器中日益普及的近内存分析加速器。我们表明，通过适当利用此类加速器，无服务器应用的微虚拟机快照可以被压缩高达4.5倍，而解压成本几乎可以忽略不计。我们利用这一见解构建了一个高效的页面预取库，能够将快照的内存恢复速度提升高达55%。我们将该库与生产级Firecracker微虚拟机集成，并在广泛的无服务器应用上评估其端到端性能。

upstream_only.title: NOMAD: non-exclusive memory tiering via transactional page migration
upstream_only.abstract: With the advent of byte-addressable memory devices, such as CXL memory, persistent memory, and storage-class memory, tiered memory systems have become a reality. Page migration is the de facto method within operating systems for managing tiered memory. It aims to bring hot data whenever possible into fast memory to optimize the performance of data accesses while using slow memory to accommodate data spilled from fast memory. While the existing research has demonstrated the effectiveness of various optimizations on page migration, it falls short of addressing a fundamental question: Is exclusive memory tiering, in which a page is either present in fast memory or slow memory, but not both simultaneously, the optimal strategy for tiered memory management?We demonstrate that page migration-based exclusive memory tiering suffers significant performance degradation when fast memory is under pressure. In this paper, we propose nonexclusive memory tiering, a page management strategy that retains a copy of pages recently promoted from slow memory to fast memory to mitigate memory thrashing. To enable non-exclusive memory tiering, we develop NOMAD, a new page management mechanism for Linux that features transactional page migration and page shadowing. NOMAD helps remove page migration off the critical path of program execution and makes migration completely asynchronous. Evaluations with carefully crafted micro-benchmarks and real-world applications show that NOMAD is able to achieve up to 6x performance improvement over the state-of-the-art transparent page placement (TPP) approach in Linux when under memory pressure. We also compare NOMAD with a recently proposed hardware-assisted, access sampling-based page migration approach and demonstrate NOMAD's strengths and potential weaknesses in various scenarios.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 随着字节可寻址内存设备（如CXL内存、持久内存和存储级内存）的出现，分层内存系统已成为现实。页迁移是操作系统中管理分层内存的事实标准方法。它旨在尽可能将热数据引入快速内存以优化数据访问性能，同时使用慢速内存容纳从快速内存溢出的数据。尽管现有研究展示了页迁移的各种优化的有效性，但它未能解决一个基本问题：独占式内存分层（即一个页面要么存在于快速内存中，要么存在于慢速内存中，但不能同时存在于两者）是否是分层内存管理的最佳策略？我们证明，当快速内存压力较大时，基于页迁移的独占式内存分层会遭受显著的性能下降。在本文中，我们提出了非独占式内存分层，这是一种页管理策略，它保留最近从慢速内存提升到快速内存的页面的副本，以减轻内存抖动。为了实现非独占式内存分层，我们开发了NOMAD，一种用于Linux的新型页管理机制，具有事务性页迁移和页面影子功能。NOMAD有助于将页迁移从程序执行的关键路径中移除，并使迁移完全异步。通过精心设计的微基准测试和真实应用的评估表明，在内存压力下，与Linux中最先进的透明页放置（TPP）方法相比，NOMAD能够实现高达6倍的性能提升。我们还将NOMAD与最近提出的硬件辅助、基于访问采样的页迁移方法进行了比较，并展示了NOMAD在各种场景下的优势和潜在弱点。

upstream_only.title: Managing memory tiers with CXL in virtualized environments
upstream_only.abstract: Cloud providers seek to deploy CXL-based memory to increase aggregate memory capacity, reduce costs, and lower carbon emissions. However, CXL accesses incur higher latency than local DRAM. Existing systems use software to manage data placement across memory tiers at page granularity. Cloud providers are reluctant to deploy software-based tiering due to high overheads in virtualized environments. Hardware-based memory tiering could place data at cacheline granularity, mitigating these drawbacks. However, hardware is oblivious to application-level performance.We propose combining hardware-managed tiering with software-managed performance isolation to overcome the pitfalls of either approach. We introduce Intel® Flat Memory Mode, the first hardware-managed tiering system for CXL. Our evaluation on a full-system prototype demonstrates that it provides performance close to regular DRAM, with no more than 5\% degradation for more than 82\% of workloads. Despite such small slowdowns, we identify two challenges that can still degrade performance by up to 34\% for "outlier" workloads: (1) memory contention across tenants, and (2) intra-tenant contention due to conflicting access patterns.To address these challenges, we introduce Memstrata, a lightweight multi-tenant memory allocator. Memstrata employs page coloring to eliminate inter-VM contention. It improves performance for VMs with access patterns that are sensitive to hardware tiering by allocating them more local DRAM using an online slowdown estimator. In multi-VM experiments on prototype hardware, Memstrata is able to identify performance outliers and reduce their degradation from above 30\% to below 6\%, providing consistent performance across a wide range of workloads.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 云服务提供商希望通过部署基于CXL的内存来增加总内存容量、降低成本和减少碳排放。然而，CXL访问比本地DRAM面临更高的延迟。现有系统使用软件在页面粒度上管理跨内存层级的数据放置。由于虚拟化环境中的高开销，云服务提供商不愿采用基于软件的层间管理。基于硬件的内存层级管理可以在缓存行粒度上放置数据，从而缓解这些缺点。然而，硬件对应用层面的性能并不敏感。我们提出将硬件管理的内存层间调度与软件管理的性能隔离相结合，以克服任一方法的缺陷。我们引入了Intel® Flat Memory Mode，这是首款适用于CXL的硬件管理内存层级系统。我们在全系统原型上的评估表明，它提供了接近普通DRAM的性能，对超过82%的工作负载，性能降幅不超过5%。尽管这些降幅很小，但我们发现两个挑战仍可能导致“异常”工作负载性能下降高达34%：(1) 多租户间的内存争用，以及(2) 由于访问模式冲突导致的租户内争用。为解决这些挑战，我们引入了Memstrata，一个轻量级的多租户内存分配器。Memstrata采用页着色来消除VM间争用。通过在线减速估计器，它为对硬件层级调度敏感的VM分配更多本地DRAM，从而提升其性能。在原型硬件上进行的多VM实验中，Memstrata能够识别性能异常者并将其性能下降从30%以上降低到6%以下，在广泛的工作负载范围内提供一致的性能。

upstream_only.title: Harvesting memory-bound CPU stall cycles in software with MSH
upstream_only.abstract: Memory-bound stalls account for a significant portion of CPU cycles in datacenter workloads, which makes harvesting them to execute other useful work highly valuable. However, mainstream implementations of the hardware harvesting mechanism, simultaneous multithreading (SMT), are unsatisfactory. They incur high latency overhead and do not offer fine-grained configurability of the trade-off between latency and harvesting throughput, which hinders wide adoption for latency-critical services; and they support only limited degrees of concurrency, which prevents full harvesting of memory stall cycles.We present MSH, the first system that transparently and efficiently harvests memory-bound stall cycles in software. MSH makes full use of stall cycles with concurrency scaling, while incurring minimal and configurable latency overhead. MSH achieves these with a novel co-design of profiling, program analysis, binary instrumentation and runtime scheduling. Our evaluation shows that MSH achieves up to 72\% harvesting throughput of SMT for latency SLOs under which SMT has to be disabled, and that strategically combining MSH with SMT leads to higher throughput than SMT due to MSH's capability to fully harvest memory-bound stall cycles.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 内存停顿周期在数据中心工作负载的CPU周期中占比很大，因此利用它们来执行其他有用工作非常有价值。然而，硬件回收机制——同步多线程（SMT）——的主流实现并不令人满意。SMT会产生较高的延迟开销，并且无法在延迟和回收吞吐量之间进行细粒度配置，这阻碍了其对延迟敏感型服务的广泛采用；而且SMT仅支持有限的并发度，无法充分回收内存停顿周期。我们提出了MSH，这是第一个在软件中透明且高效地回收内存受限停顿周期的系统。MSH通过并发扩展充分利用停顿周期，同时带来最小且可配置的延迟开销。MSH通过剖析、程序分析、二进制插桩和运行时调度的新型协同设计实现了这些目标。我们的评估表明，在必须禁用SMT的延迟SLO下，MSH的回收吞吐量最高可达SMT的72%，并且由于MSH能够充分回收内存受限停顿周期，将MSH与SMT进行策略性结合可获得比单纯使用SMT更高的吞吐量。

upstream_only.title: A tale of two paths: toward a hybrid data plane for efficient far-memory applications
upstream_only.abstract: With rapid advances in network hardware, far memory has gained a great deal of traction due to its ability to break the memory capacity wall. Existing far memory systems fall into one of two data paths: one that uses the kernel's paging system to transparently access far memory at the page granularity, and a second that bypasses the kernel, fetching data at the object granularity. While it is generally believed that object fetching outperforms paging due to its fine-grained access, it requires significantly more compute resources to run object-level LRU and eviction.We built Atlas, a hybrid data plane enabled by a runtime-kernel co-design that simultaneously enables accesses via these two data paths to provide high efficiency for real-world applications. Atlas uses always-on profiling to continuously measure page locality. For workloads already with good locality, paging is used to fetch data, whereas for those without, object fetching is employed. Object fetching moves objects that are accessed close in time to contiguous local space, dynamically improving locality and making the execution increasingly amenable to paging, which is much more resource-efficient. Our evaluation shows that Atlas improves the throughput (e.g., by 1.5\texttimes{} and 3.2\texttimes{}) and reduces the tail latency (e.g., by one and two orders of magnitude) when using remote memory, compared with AIFM and Fastswap, the state-of-the-art techniques respectively in the two categories.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 随着网络硬件的快速发展，远内存因其能够打破内存容量墙而备受关注。现有的远内存系统属于两种数据路径之一：一种利用内核的分页系统以页面粒度透明地访问远内存，另一种则绕过内核，以对象粒度获取数据。虽然人们普遍认为对象获取因其细粒度访问而优于分页，但它需要显著更多的计算资源来运行对象级LRU和逐出操作。我们构建了Atlas，这是一个通过运行时-内核协同设计实现的混合数据平面，可同时通过这两种数据路径进行访问，从而为现实世界应用提供高效率。Atlas使用持续分析来不断测量页面局部性。对于已经具有良好局部性的工作负载，使用分页获取数据；而对于没有局部性的工作负载，则采用对象获取。对象获取会将时间上接近访问的对象移动到连续的本地空间，从而动态改善局部性，使执行越来越适合分页，而分页的资源效率要高得多。我们的评估表明，与AIFM和Fastswap（这两个类别中各自最先进的技术）相比，Atlas在使用远程内存时提高了吞吐量（例如，1.5倍和3.2倍）并降低了尾延迟（例如，一个和两个数量级）。

upstream_only.title: DRust: language-guided distributed shared memory with fine granularity, full transparency, and ultra efficiency
upstream_only.abstract: Despite being a powerful concept, distributed shared memory (DSM) has not been made practical due to the extensive synchronization needed between servers to implement memory coherence. This paper shows a practical DSM implementation based on the insight that the ownership model embedded in programming languages such as Rust automatically constrains the order of read and write, providing opportunities for significantly simplifying the coherence implementation if the ownership semantics can be exposed to and leveraged by the runtime. This paper discusses the design and implementation of DRust, a Rust-based DSM system that outperforms the two state-of-the-art DSM systems GAM and Grappa by up to 2.64\texttimes{} and 29.16\texttimes{} in throughput, and scales much better with the number of servers.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 尽管分布式共享内存（DSM）是一个强大的概念，但由于服务器之间实现内存一致性所需的广泛同步，它一直未能变得实用。本文展示了一种实用的DSM实现，其基于以下洞察：诸如Rust等编程语言中嵌入的所有权模型自动约束了读写的顺序，如果能够将所有权语义暴露给运行时并加以利用，则为显著简化一致性实现提供了机会。本文讨论了DRust的设计与实现，这是一个基于Rust的DSM系统，在吞吐量上比两个最先进的DSM系统GAM和Grappa分别高出2.64倍和29.16倍，并且随着服务器数量的增加扩展性更好。

upstream_only.title: Taming throughput-latency tradeoff in LLM inference with sarathi-serve
upstream_only.abstract: Each LLM serving request goes through two phases. The first is prefill which processes the entire input prompt and produces the first output token and the second is decode which generates the rest of output tokens, one-at-a-time. Prefill iterations have high latency but saturate GPU compute due to parallel processing of the input prompt. In contrast, decode iterations have low latency but also low compute utilization because a decode iteration processes only a single token per request. This makes batching highly effective for decodes and consequently for overall throughput. However, batching multiple requests leads to an interleaving of prefill and decode iterations which makes it challenging to achieve both high throughput and low latency.We introduce an efficient LLM inference scheduler, Sarathi-Serve, to address this throughput-latency tradeoff. Sarathi-Serve introduces chunked-prefills which splits a prefill request into near equal sized chunks and creates stall-free schedules that adds new requests in a batch without pausing ongoing decodes. Stall-free scheduling unlocks the opportunity to improve throughput with large batch sizes while minimizing the effect of batching on latency. Furthermore, uniform batches in Sarathi-Serve ameliorate the imbalance between iterations, resulting in minimal pipeline bubbles.Our techniques yield significant improvements in inference performance across models and hardware under tail latency constraints. For Mistral-7B on single A100 GPUs, we achieve 2.6\texttimes{} higher serving capacity and up to 3.7\texttimes{} higher serving capacity for the Yi-34B model on two A100 GPUs as compared to vLLM. When used with pipeline parallelism on Falcon- 180B, Sarathi-Serve provides up to 5.6\texttimes{} gain in the end-to-end serving capacity. The source code for Sarathi-Serve is available at https://github.com/microsoft/sarathi-serve.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 每个 LLM 服务请求都要经历两个阶段。第一阶段是预填充（prefill），它处理整个输入提示并生成第一个输出 token；第二阶段是解码（decode），它逐个生成其余的输出 token。预填充迭代具有高延迟，但由于输入提示的并行处理而饱和 GPU 计算。相比之下，解码迭代具有低延迟，但计算利用率也较低，因为解码迭代每个请求仅处理一个 token。这使得批处理对解码以及整体吞吐量非常有效。然而，批处理多个请求会导致预填充和解码迭代交错，这使得同时实现高吞吐量和低延迟变得具有挑战性。我们引入了一个高效的 LLM 推理调度器 Sarathi-Serve 来解决这种吞吐量-延迟权衡。Sarathi-Serve 引入了分块预填充（chunked-prefills），它将预填充请求拆分成近似相等大小的块，并创建无停顿调度，从而在批处理中添加新请求而不暂停正在进行的解码。无停顿调度解锁了通过大批量大小提高吞吐量的机会，同时最大限度地减少批处理对延迟的影响。此外，Sarathi-Serve 中的均匀批次改善了迭代之间的不平衡，从而最小化流水线气泡。我们的技术在不同模型和硬件上、在尾延迟约束下显著提升了推理性能。对于单个 A100 GPU 上的 Mistral-7B，与 vLLM 相比，我们实现了 2.6 倍的服务容量提升；对于两个 A100 GPU 上的 Yi-34B 模型，服务容量提升了高达 3.7 倍。当将流水线并行用于 Falcon-180B 时，Sarathi-Serve 在端到端服务容量上提供了高达 5.6 倍的增益。Sarathi-Serve 的源代码可在 https://github.com/microsoft/sarathi-serve 获取。

upstream_only.title: ServerlessLLM: low-latency serverless inference for large language models
upstream_only.abstract: This paper presents ServerlessLLM, a distributed system designed to support low-latency serverless inference for Large Language Models (LLMs). By harnessing the substantial near-GPU storage and memory capacities of inference servers, ServerlessLLM achieves effective local checkpoint storage, minimizing the need for remote checkpoint downloads and ensuring efficient checkpoint loading. The design of ServerlessLLM features three core contributions: (i) fast multi-tier checkpoint loading, featuring a new loading-optimized checkpoint format and a multi-tier loading system, fully utilizing the bandwidth of complex storage hierarchies on GPU servers; (ii) efficient live migration of LLM inference, which enables newly initiated inferences to capitalize on local checkpoint storage while ensuring minimal user interruption; and (iii) startup-time-optimized model scheduling, which assesses the locality statuses of checkpoints on each server and schedules the model onto servers that minimize the time to start the inference. Comprehensive evaluations, including microbenchmarks and real-world scenarios, demonstrate that Serverless-LLM dramatically outperforms state-of-the-art serverless systems, reducing latency by 10 - 200X across various LLM inference workloads.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了ServerlessLLM，一个支撑大语言模型（LLM）低延迟无服务器推理的分布式系统。通过利用推理服务器丰富的近GPU存储和内存容量，ServerlessLLM实现了高效的本地检查点存储，最小化远程检查点下载需求并确保高效的检查点加载。ServerlessLLM的设计包含三个核心贡献：(i) 快速多层检查点加载，采用新颖的加载优化检查点格式和多层加载系统，充分利用GPU服务器上复杂存储层次结构的带宽；(ii) 高效的LLM推理实时迁移，使新发起的推理能利用本地检查点存储同时确保极小的用户中断；(iii) 启动时间优化的模型调度，评估每台服务器上检查点的局部性状态，将模型调度到能最小化推理启动时间的服务器上。包括微基准测试和真实场景在内的全面评估表明，ServerlessLLM显著优于最先进的无服务器系统，在各种LLM推理工作负载下将延迟降低了10至200倍。

upstream_only.title: InfiniGen: efficient generative inference of large language models with dynamic KV cache management
upstream_only.abstract: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive performance across various natural language processing tasks. Serving LLM inference for generating long contents, however, poses a challenge due to the enormous memory footprint of the transient state, known as the keyvalue (KV) cache, which scales with the sequence length and batch size. In this paper, we present InfiniGen, a novel KV cache management framework tailored for long-text generation, which synergistically works with modern offloading-based inference systems. InfiniGen leverages the key insight that a few important tokens that are essential for computing the subsequent attention layer in the Transformer can be speculated by performing a minimal rehearsal with the inputs of the current layer and part of the query weight and key cache of the subsequent layer. This allows us to prefetch only the essential KV cache entries (without fetching them all), thereby mitigating the fetch overhead from the host memory in offloading-based LLM serving systems. Our evaluation on several representative LLMs shows that InfiniGen improves the overall performance of a modern offloading-based system by up to 3.00\texttimes{} compared to prior KV cache management methods while offering substantially better model accuracy.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 基于Transformer的大语言模型（LLM）在各种自然语言处理任务中展现了出色的性能。然而，为长内容生成提供服务时，由于瞬态状态（称为键值（KV）缓存）的巨大内存占用会随序列长度和批次大小扩展，因此面临挑战。在本文中，我们提出了InfiniGen，一种专为长文本生成量身定制的新型KV缓存管理框架，它与现代基于卸载的推理系统协同工作。InfiniGen利用了关键洞察：对于计算Transformer中后续注意力层所必需的一些重要token，可以通过使用当前层的输入以及后续层的部分查询权重和键缓存执行最小排练来推测出。这使得我们只需预取必要的KV缓存条目（而无需一次获取全部），从而减轻基于卸载的LLM服务系统中从主机内存取回的开销。我们对多个代表性LLM的评估表明，与之前的KV缓存管理方法相比，InfiniGen将现代基于卸载系统的整体性能提升了高达3.00倍，同时提供了显著更好的模型精度。

upstream_only.title: Llumnix: dynamic scheduling for large language model serving
upstream_only.abstract: Inference serving for large language models (LLMs) is the key to unleashing their potential in people's daily lives. However, efficient LLM serving remains challenging today because the requests are inherently heterogeneous and unpredictable in terms of resource and latency requirements, as a result of the diverse applications and the dynamic execution nature of LLMs. Existing systems are fundamentally limited in handling these characteristics and cause problems such as severe queuing delays, poor tail latencies, and SLO violations. We introduce Llumnix, an LLM serving system that reacts to such heterogeneous and unpredictable requests by runtime rescheduling across multiple model instances. Similar to context switching across CPU cores in modern operating systems, Llumnix reschedules requests to improve load balancing and isolation, mitigate resource fragmentation, and differentiate request priorities and SLOs. Llumnix implements the rescheduling with an efficient and scalable live migration mechanism for requests and their in-memory states, and exploits it in a dynamic scheduling policy that unifies the multiple rescheduling scenarios elegantly. Our evaluations show that Llumnix improves tail latencies by an order of magnitude, accelerates high-priority requests by up to 1.5\texttimes{}, and delivers up to 36\% cost savings while achieving similar tail latencies, compared against state-of-the-art LLM serving systems. Llumnix is publicly available at https://github.com/AlibabaPAI/llumnix.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的推理服务是释放其在人们日常生活中潜力的关键。然而，由于应用多样化以及LLM动态执行的特性，请求在资源和延迟需求方面本质上异构且不可预测，因此高效的LLM服务在今天仍然充满挑战。现有系统在处理这些特性时存在根本性局限，导致排队延迟严重、尾部延迟差和SLO违约等问题。我们提出了Llumnix，一个LLM服务系统，通过跨多个模型实例的运行时重调度来响应这类异构且不可预测的请求。类似于现代操作系统中跨CPU核心的上下文切换，Llumnix通过重调度请求来改善负载均衡和隔离、缓解资源碎片化，并区分请求优先级和SLO。Llumnix利用一种高效且可扩展的请求及其内存状态的实时迁移机制来实现重调度，并在一个统一多个重调度场景的动态调度策略中加以利用。我们的评估表明，与最先进的LLM服务系统相比，Llumnix将尾部延迟提高了一个数量级，将高优先级请求加速最高达1.5倍，并在实现相似尾部延迟的同时节省高达36%的成本。Llumnix可在https://github.com/AlibabaPAI/llumnix公开获取。

upstream_only.title: DistServe: disaggregating prefill and decoding for goodput-optimized large language model serving
upstream_only.abstract: DistServe improves the performance of large language models (LLMs) serving by disaggregating the prefill and decoding computation. Existing LLM serving systems colocate the two phases and batch the computation of prefill and decoding across all users and requests. We find that this strategy not only leads to strong prefill-decoding interferences but also couples the resource allocation and parallelism plans for both phases. LLM applications often emphasize individual latency for each phase: time to first token (TTFT) for the prefill phase and time per output token (TPOT) of each request for the decoding phase. In the presence of stringent latency requirements, existing systems have to prioritize one latency over the other, or over-provision compute resources to meet both. DistServe assigns prefill and decoding computation to different GPUs, hence eliminating prefill-decoding interferences. Given the application's TTFT and TPOT requirements, Dist-Serve co-optimizes the resource allocation and parallelism strategy tailored for each phase. DistServe also places the two phases according to the serving cluster's bandwidth to minimize the communication caused by disaggregation. As a result, DistServe significantly improves LLM serving performance in terms of the maximum rate that can be served within both TTFT and TPOT constraints on each GPU. Our evaluations show that on various popular LLMs, applications, and latency requirements, DistServe can serve 7.4\texttimes{} more requests or 12.6\texttimes{} tighter SLO, compared to state-of-the-art systems, while staying within latency constraints for > 90\% of requests.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: DistServe通过分离预填充（prefill）和解码（decoding）计算来提升大语言模型（LLM）的服务性能。现有的LLM服务系统将这两个阶段放在一起，并对所有用户和请求的预填充与解码计算进行批量处理。我们发现，这种策略不仅导致强烈的预填充-解码相互干扰，还耦合了两个阶段的资源分配和并行计划。LLM应用通常强调每个阶段的单独延迟：预填充阶段的“首个令牌时间”（TTFT）和解码阶段每个请求的“每个输出令牌时间”（TPOT）。在严格的延迟要求下，现有系统必须优先考虑其中一个延迟，或者过度配置计算资源以满足两者。DistServe将预填充和解码计算分配到不同的GPU上，从而消除了预填充-解码干扰。根据应用的TTFT和TPOT要求，DistServe针对每个阶段协同优化资源分配和并行策略。DistServe还根据服务集群的带宽来放置两个阶段，以最小化由分离引起的通信。因此，DistServe在每个GPU的TTFT和TPOT约束内可服务的最大请求速率方面显著提升了LLM服务性能。我们的评估表明，在各种流行的LLM、应用和延迟要求下，与最先进的系统相比，DistServe可以服务7.4倍的请求或实现12.6倍的更严格SLO，同时使超过90%的请求保持在延迟约束内。

upstream_only.title: ACCL+: an FPGA-based collective engine for distributed applications
upstream_only.abstract: FPGAs are increasingly prevalent in cloud deployments, serving as Smart-NICs or network-attached accelerators. To facilitate the development of distributed applications with FPGAs, in this paper we propose ACCL+, an open-source, FPGA-based collective communication library. Portable across different platforms and supporting UDP, TCP, as well as RDMA, ACCL+ empowers FPGA applications to initiate direct FPGA-to-FPGA collective communication. Additionally, it can serve as a collective offload engine for CPU applications, freeing the CPU from networking tasks. It is user-extensible, allowing new collectives to be implemented and deployed without having to re-synthesize the entire design. We evaluated ACCL+ on an FPGA cluster with 100 Gb/s networking, comparing its performance against software MPI over RDMA. The results demonstrate ACCL+'s significant advantages for FPGA-based distributed applications and its competitive performance for CPU applications. We showcase ACCL+'s dual role with two use cases: as a collective offload engine to distribute CPU-based vector-matrix multiplication, and as a component in designing fully FPGA-based distributed deep-learning recommendation inference.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: FPGA在云部署中日益普及，通常作为智能网卡或网络加速器使用。为了促进基于FPGA的分布式应用的开发，本文提出了ACCL+，一个开源的、基于FPGA的集体通信库。ACCL+跨平台可移植，支持UDP、TCP以及RDMA，使FPGA应用能够发起直接的FPGA到FPGA集体通信。此外，它还可以充当CPU应用的集体通信卸载引擎，将CPU从网络任务中解放出来。ACCL+是可用户扩展的，无需重新综合整个设计即可实现和部署新的集合操作。我们在配置了100Gb/s网络的FPGA集群上对ACCL+进行了评估，并将其性能与基于RDMA的软件MPI进行了比较。结果表明，ACCL+对于基于FPGA的分布式应用具有显著优势，对于CPU应用也表现出具有竞争力的性能。我们通过两个用例展示了ACCL+的双重角色：作为分布式CPU向量矩阵乘法的集体通信卸载引擎，以及作为设计完全基于FPGA的分布式深度学习推荐推断的一部分。

upstream_only.title: Beaver: practical partial snapshots for distributed cloud services
upstream_only.abstract: Distributed snapshots are a classic class of protocols used for capturing a causally consistent view of states across machines. Although effective, existing protocols presume an isolated universe of processes to snapshot and require instrumentation and coordination of all. This assumption does not match today's cloud services--it is not always practical to instrument all involved processes nor realistic to assume zero interaction of the machines of interest with the external world.To bridge this gap, this paper presents Beaver, the first practical partial snapshot protocol that ensures causal consistency under external traffic interference. Beaver presents a unique design point that tightly couples its protocol with the regularities of the underlying data center environment. By exploiting the placement of software load balancers in public clouds and their associated communication pattern, Beaver not only requires minimal changes to today's data center operations but also eliminates any form of blocking to existing communication, thus incurring near-zero overhead to user traffic. We demonstrate the Beaver's effectiveness through extensive testbed experiments and novel use cases.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 分布式快照是一类经典协议，用于捕获各机器之间因果一致的状态视图。虽然有效，现有协议假设对一组隔离的进程进行快照，并且需要对所有进程进行插桩和协调。这种假设与当今的云服务不符——插桩所有涉及的进程并不总是可行，而且假设目标机器与外部世界零交互也不现实。为了弥补这一差距，本文提出了Beaver，这是第一个实用部分快照协议，可在外部流量干扰下确保因果一致性。Beaver具有独特的设计点，将其协议与底层数据中心环境的规律性紧密耦合。通过利用公共云中软件负载均衡器的位置及其相关通信模式，Beaver不仅需要尽可能少地改动当今数据中心操作，还消除了对现有通信的任何阻塞形式，从而对用户流量产生近零的开销。我们通过广泛的测试平台实验和新颖用例展示了Beaver的有效性。

upstream_only.title: Fast and scalable in-network lock management using lock fission
upstream_only.abstract: Distributed lock services are extensively utilized in distributed systems to serialize concurrent accesses to shared resources. The need for fast and scalable lock services has become more pronounced with decreasing task execution times and expanding dataset scales. However, traditional lock managers, reliant on server CPUs to handle lock requests, experience significant queuing delays in lock grant latency. Advanced network hardware (e.g. programmable switches) presents an avenue to manage locks without queuing delays due to their high packet processing power. Nevertheless, their constrained memory capacity restricts the manageable lock scale, thereby limiting their effect in large-scale workloads.This paper presents FISSLOCK, a fast and scalable distributed lock service that exploits the programmable switch to improve (tail) latency and peak throughput for millions of locks. The key idea behind FISSLOCK is the concept of lock fission, which decouples lock management into grant decision and participant maintenance. FISSLOCK leverages the programmable switch to decide lock grants synchronously and relies on servers to maintain participants (i.e., holders and waiters) asynchronously. By using the programmable switch for routing, FISSLOCK enables on-demand fine-grained lock migration, thereby reducing the lock grant and release delays. FISSLOCK carefully designs and implements grant decision procedure on the programmable switch, supporting over one million locks. Evaluation using various benchmarks and a real-world application shows the efficiency of FISSLOCK. Compared to the state-of-the-art switch-based approach (NetLock), FISSLOCK cuts up to 79.1\% (from 43.0\%) of median lock grant time in the microbenchmark and improves transaction throughput for TATP and TPC-C by 1.76\texttimes{} and 2.28\texttimes{}, respectively.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 分布式锁服务被广泛用于分布式系统中，以串行化对共享资源的并发访问。随着任务执行时间的缩短和数据集规模的扩大，对快速且可扩展的锁服务的需求变得更加突出。然而，传统锁管理器依赖服务器CPU来处理锁请求，导致锁授权延迟出现显著的排队延迟。先进的网络硬件（如可编程交换机）凭借其高数据包处理能力，为无排队延迟地管理锁提供了途径。然而，其有限的内存容量限制了可管理的锁规模，从而限制了其在大规模工作负载中的效果。本文提出了FISSLOCK，一种快速且可扩展的分布式锁服务，利用可编程交换机来改善数百万把锁的（尾部）延迟和峰值吞吐量。FISSLOCK背后的关键思想是锁分裂（lock fission）概念，它将锁管理解耦为授权决策和参与者维护。FISSLOCK利用可编程交换机同步决定锁授权，并依靠服务器异步维护参与者（即持有者和等待者）。通过使用可编程交换机进行路由，FISSLOCK实现了按需的细粒度锁迁移，从而减少了锁授权和释放延迟。FISSLOCK精心设计并在可编程交换机上实现了授权决策流程，支持超过一百万把锁。使用各种基准测试和真实应用进行的评估显示了FISSLOCK的高效性。与最先进的基于交换机的方法（NetLock）相比，在微基准测试中，FISSLOCK将锁授权时间中位数削减了最多79.1%（而NetLock为43.0%），并在TATP和TPC-C基准测试中分别将事务吞吐量提高了1.76倍和2.28倍。

upstream_only.title: Chop Chop: Byzantine atomic broadcast to the network limit
upstream_only.abstract: At the heart of state machine replication, the celebrated technique enabling decentralized and secure universal computation, lies Atomic Broadcast, a fundamental communication primitive that orders, authenticates, and deduplicates messages. This paper presents Chop Chop, a Byzantine Atomic Broadcast system that uses a novel authenticated memory pool to amortize the cost of ordering, authenticating and deduplicating messages, achieving "line rate" (i.e., closely matching the complexity of a protocol that does not ensure any ordering, authentication or Byzantine resilience) even when processing messages as small as 8 bytes. Chop Chop attains this performance by means of a new form of batching we call distillation. A distilled batch is a set of messages that are fast to authenticate, deduplicate, and order. Batches are distilled using a novel interactive protocol involving brokers, an untrusted layer of facilitating processes between clients and servers. In a geo-distributed deployment of 64 medium-sized servers, Chop Chop processes 43,600,000 messages per second with an average latency of 3.6 seconds. Under the same conditions, state-of-the-art alternatives offer two orders of magnitude less throughput for the same latency. We showcase three simple Chop Chop applications: a Payment system, an Auction house and a "Pixel war" game, respectively achieving 32, 2.3 and 35 million operations per second.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在状态机复制的核心——这一实现去中心化且安全通用计算的技术中，原子广播起着基础性作用，它是一种对消息进行排序、认证和去重的基本通信原语。本文提出了Chop Chop，一个拜占庭原子广播系统，它使用一种新颖的经过认证的内存池来摊销排序、认证和去重的成本，即使在处理小至8字节的消息时，也能实现“线速”（即与任何不保证排序、认证或拜占庭韧性的协议的复杂度接近）。Chop Chop通过对一种我们称为“蒸馏”的新型批处理方式实现了这一性能。蒸馏批次是一组易于认证、去重和排序的消息。批次通过一种涉及代理（broker）的新型交互协议进行蒸馏，代理是位于客户端和服务器之间的不受信任的促进层。在一个由64台中大型服务器组成的地理分布部署中，Chop Chop每秒处理43,600,000条消息，平均延迟为3.6秒。在相同条件下，最先进的替代方案在相同延迟下吞吐量低两个数量级。我们展示了三个简单的Chop Chop应用：一个支付系统、一个拍卖行和一个“像素战争”游戏，分别实现了每秒3200万、230万和3500万次操作。

upstream_only.title: Enabling tensor language model to assist in generating high-performance tensor programs for deep learning
upstream_only.abstract: Obtaining high-performance tensor programs with high efficiency continues to be a substantial challenge. Approaches that favor efficiency typically limit their exploration space through heuristic constraints, which often lack generalizability. Conversely, approaches targeting high performance tend to create an expansive exploration space but employ ineffective exploration strategies.We propose a tensor program generation framework for deep learning applications. Its core idea involves maintaining an expansive space to ensure high performance while performing powerful exploration with the help of language models to generate tensor programs efficiently. We thus transform the tensor program exploration task into a language model generation task. To facilitate this, we explicitly design the language model-friendly tensor language that records decision information to represent tensor programs. During the compilation of target workloads, the tensor language model (TLM) combines knowledge from offline learning and previously made decisions to probabilistically sample the best decision in the current decision space. This approach allows more informed space exploration than random sampling commonly used in previously proposed approaches.Experimental results indicate that TLM excels in delivering both efficiency and performance. Compared to fully tuned Ansor/MetaSchedule, TLM matches their performance with a compilation speedup of 61\texttimes{}. Furthermore, when evaluated against Roller, with the same compilation time, TLM improves the performance by 2.25\texttimes{}. Code available at https://github.com/zhaiyi000/tlm.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 高效地获得高性能张量程序仍然是一个巨大的挑战。倾向于效率的方法通常会通过启发式约束来限制其探索空间，而这些约束往往缺乏通用性。相反，面向高性能的方法倾向于构建广阔的探索空间，但采用低效的探索策略。我们提出了一个面向深度学习应用的高性能张量程序生成框架。其核心思想是在保持广阔探索空间以确保高性能的同时，借助语言模型进行强大的探索，从而高效地生成张量程序。因此，我们将张量程序探索任务转化为语言模型生成任务。为促进这一点，我们显式设计了语言模型友好的张量语言，记录决策信息以表示张量程序。在编译目标工作负载时，张量语言模型(TLM)结合离线学习的知识和先前做出的决策，在当前决策空间中以概率方式采样最佳决策。这种方法使得空间探索比先前提出的方法中常用的随机抽样更具信息性。实验结果表明，TLM在效率和性能方面均表现出色。与完全调优的Ansor/MetaSchedule相比，TLM在编译速度提升61倍的情况下达到了与其相当的性能。此外，在与Roller相同编译时间的比较中，TLM将性能提升了2.25倍。代码可在 https://github.com/zhaiyi000/tlm 获取。

upstream_only.title: LADDER: enabling efficient low-precision deep learning computing through hardware-aware tensor transformation
upstream_only.abstract: The increasing demand for improving deep learning model performance has led to a paradigm shift in supporting low-precision computation to harness the robustness of deep learning to errors. Despite the emergence of new low-precision data types and optimization approaches, existing hardware and software have insufficient and inefficient support for those evolving data types, making it challenging to achieve real performance gains through low-precision computing.This paper introduces LADDER, a novel compiler designed to bridge the gap between evolving custom data types and the fixed precision formats supported by current hardware. Leveraging a general type system, tType, and an extended tensor expression, LADDER transforms deep neural network (DNN) computations into optimized computing pipelines with custom data types as the first-class citizen, exposing an optimization space for efficiently handling data storage, accesses, and type conversions. LADDER employs a new set of tensor scheduling primitives and a hardware-aware optimization policy to navigate the complex transformation space, ensuring optimal performance across different memory layers and DNN operators. Our evaluation demonstrates LADDER's capability to systematically support a wide array of low-bit precision custom data types, significantly enhancing the performance of DNN computations on modern accelerators without necessitating hardware modifications. This innovation empowers model designers with the ability to explore data type optimizations and offers hardware vendors a flexible solution to expand their support for diverse precision formats.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 对提高深度学习模型性能日益增长的需求导致了支持低精度计算的范式转变，以利用深度学习对错误的鲁棒性。尽管出现了新的低精度数据类型和优化方法，现有硬件和软件对这些不断发展的数据类型的支持不足且效率低下，使得通过低精度计算实现真正的性能提升面临挑战。本文介绍了LADDER，一种新颖的编译器，旨在弥合不断发展的自定义数据类型与当前硬件支持的固定精度格式之间的差距。利用通用类型系统tType和扩展的张量表达式，LADDER将深度神经网络(DNN)计算转换为以自定义数据类型为一等公民的优化计算流水线，为高效处理数据存储、访问和类型转换暴露了优化空间。LADDER采用一组新的张量调度原语和硬件感知的优化策略来导航复杂的转换空间，确保跨不同内存层和DNN运算符的最佳性能。我们的评估表明，LADDER能够系统地支持各种低位宽自定义数据类型，在现代加速器上显著提升DNN计算性能，而无需修改硬件。这一创新使模型设计者能够探索数据类型优化，并为硬件供应商提供灵活的解决方案，以扩展其对多种精度格式的支持。

upstream_only.title: CARAVAN: practical online learning of in-network ML models with labeling agents
upstream_only.abstract: Recent work on in-network machine learning (ML) anticipates offline models to operate well in modern networking environments. However, upon deployment, these models struggle to cope with fluctuating traffic patterns and network conditions and, therefore, must be validated and updated frequently in an online fashion.This paper presents CARAVAN, a practical online learning system for in-network ML models. We tackle two primary challenges in facilitating online learning for networking: (a) the automatic labeling of evolving traffic and (b) the efficient monitoring and detection of model performance degradation to trigger retraining. CARAVAN repurposes existing systems (e.g., heuristics, access control lists, and foundation models)-- not directly suitable for such dynamic environments--into high-quality labeling sources for generating labeled data for online learning. CARAVAN also introduces a new metric, accuracy proxy, to track model degradation and potential drift to efficiently trigger retraining. Our evaluations show that CARAVAN's labeling strategy enables in-network ML models to closely follow the changes in the traffic dynamics with a 30.3\% improvement in F1 score (on average), compared to offline models. Moreover, CARAVAN sustains comparable inference accuracy to that of a continuous-learning system while consuming 61.3\% less GPU compute time (on average) via accuracy proxy and retraining triggers.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 关于网内机器学习（ML）的最新研究预期离线模型能够在现代网络环境中良好运行。然而，在部署后，这些模型难以应对波动的流量模式和网络状况，因此必须频繁地以在线方式验证和更新。本文提出了CARAVAN，一种用于网内机器学习模型的实用在线学习系统。我们解决了促进网络在线学习的两个主要挑战：（a）自动标注不断演变的流量，（b）高效监控和检测模型性能退化以触发重新训练。CARAVAN将现有系统（例如启发式方法、访问控制列表和基础模型）——虽然并非直接适用于此类动态环境——重新用作高质量标注来源，为在线学习生成标注数据。CARAVAN还引入了一种新的指标——准确率代理（accuracy proxy），用于追踪模型退化和潜在漂移，从而高效地触发重新训练。我们的评估表明，CARAVAN的标注策略使网内机器学习模型能够紧密跟随流量动态的变化，与离线模型相比，F1分数平均提升30.3%。此外，CARAVAN在保持与持续学习系统相当的推理准确率的同时，通过准确率代理和重新训练触发机制，平均节省61.3%的GPU计算时间。

upstream_only.title: nnScaler: constraint-guided parallelization plan generation for deep learning training
upstream_only.abstract: With the growing model size of deep neural networks (DNN), deep learning training is increasingly relying on handcrafted search spaces to find efficient parallelization execution plans. However, our study shows that existing search spaces exclude plans that significantly impact the training performance of well-known DNN models (e.g., AlphaFold2) under important settings, such as when handling large embedding tables in large language models.To address this problem, we propose nnScaler, a framework that generates efficient parallelization plans for deep learning training. Instead of relying on the existing search space, nnScaler advocates a more general approach that empowers domain experts to construct their own search space through three primitives, op-trans, op-assign, and op-order, which capture model transformation and the temporal-spatial scheduling of the transformed model of any parallelization plans. To avoid space explosion, nnScaler allows the application of constraints to those primitives during space construction. With the proposed primitives and constraints, nnScaler can compose existing search spaces as well as new ones. Experiments show that nnScaler can find new parallelization plans in new search spaces that achieve up to 3.5\texttimes{} speedup compared to solutions such as DeepSpeed, Megatron-LM, and Alpa for popular DNN models like Swin-Transformer and AlphaFold2.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 随着深度神经网络（DNN）模型规模的不断增长，深度学习训练越来越依赖于手工设计的搜索空间来寻找高效的并行化执行计划。然而，我们的研究表明，现有搜索空间排除了在某些重要设置下对知名DNN模型（如AlphaFold2）训练性能有显著影响的计划，例如在大型语言模型中处理大型嵌入表时。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了nnScaler，一个为深度学习训练生成高效并行化计划的框架。nnScaler不依赖现有搜索空间，而是倡导一种更通用的方法，通过三个原语——op-trans、op-assign和op-order——使领域专家能够构建自己的搜索空间，这三个原语捕获了模型转换以及转换后模型的时空调度。为了避免空间爆炸，nnScaler允许在空间构建过程中对这些原语应用约束。借助所提出的原语和约束，nnScaler可以组合现有搜索空间以及新的搜索空间。实验表明，nnScaler能在新搜索空间中找到新的并行化计划，与DeepSpeed、Megatron-LM和Alpa等解决方案相比，在流行的DNN模型（如Swin-Transformer和AlphaFold2）上实现高达3.5倍的加速。

upstream_only.title: ChameleonAPI: automatic and efficient customization of neural networks for ML applications
upstream_only.abstract: ML APIs have greatly relieved application developers of the burden to design and train their own neural network models-- classifying objects in an image can now be as simple as one line of Python code to call an API. However, these APIs offer the same pre-trained models regardless of how their output is used by different applications. This can be suboptimal as not all ML inference errors can cause application failures, and the distinction between inference errors that can or cannot cause failures varies greatly across applications.To tackle this problem, we first study 77 real-world applications, which collectively use six ML APIs from two providers, to reveal common patterns of how ML API output affects applications' decision processes. Inspired by the findings, we propose ChameleonAPI, an optimization framework for ML APIs, which takes effect without changing the application source code. ChameleonAPI provides application developers with a parser that automatically analyzes the application to produce an abstract of its decision process, which is then used to devise an application-specific loss function that only penalizes API output errors critical to the application. Chameleon-API uses the loss function to efficiently train a neural network model customized for each application and deploys it to serve API invocations from the respective application via existing interface. Compared to a baseline that selects the best-of-all commercial ML API, we show that ChameleonAPI reduces incorrect application decisions by 43\%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 机器学习API极大地减轻了应用程序开发者设计和训练自己神经网络模型的负担——如今，对图像中的物体进行分类可以简单到只需一行Python代码来调用API。然而，这些API为所有应用程序提供相同的预训练模型，无论其输出在具体应用中如何使用。这可能并非最优，因为并非所有的机器学习推理错误都会导致应用程序故障，而且可能导致或不会导致故障的推理错误之间的区别在不同应用中差异巨大。为了解决这个问题，我们首先研究了77个真实应用，这些应用共同使用了来自两个提供商的六个机器学习API，以揭示机器学习API输出影响应用决策过程的常见模式。受这些发现的启发，我们提出了ChameleonAPI，一个机器学习API的优化框架，它在不改变应用程序源代码的情况下生效。ChameleonAPI为应用开发者提供了一个解析器，该解析器自动分析应用以生成其决策过程的摘要，然后利用该摘要设计一个针对特定应用的损失函数，该函数只惩罚对应用关键的API输出错误。ChameleonAPI利用该损失函数高效地训练一个为每个应用定制的神经网络模型，并经由现有接口部署它，以响应来自相应应用的API调用。与选择最佳商业机器学习API的基线相比，我们展示了ChameleonAPI将错误的应用程序决策减少了43%。

upstream_only.title: SquirrelFS: using the rust compiler to check file-system crash consistency
upstream_only.abstract: This work introduces a new approach to building crash-safe file systems for persistent memory. We exploit the fact that Rust's typestate pattern allows compile-time enforcement of a specific order of operations. We introduce a novel crash-consistency mechanism, Synchronous Soft Updates, that boils down crash safety to enforcing ordering among updates to file-system metadata. We employ this approach to build SQUIRRELFS, a new file system with crash-consistency guarantees that are checked at compile time. SQUIRRELFS avoids the need for separate proofs, instead incorporating correctness guarantees into the typestate itself. Compiling SQUIRRELFS only takes tens of seconds; successful compilation indicates crash consistency, while an error provides a starting point for fixing the bug. We evaluate SQUIRRELFS against state of the art file systems such as NOVA and WineFS, and find that SQUIRRELFS achieves similar or better performance on a wide range of benchmarks and applications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 这项工作介绍了一种为持久内存构建崩溃安全文件系统的新方法。我们利用Rust的类型状态模式允许在编译时强制执行特定操作顺序这一特性。我们提出了一种新颖的崩溃一致性机制——同步软更新，它将崩溃安全性归结为在文件系统元数据更新之间强制排序。我们采用这种方法构建了SQUIRRELFS，一个在编译时检查崩溃一致性保证的新文件系统。SQUIRRELFS无需单独的证明，而是将正确性保证直接融入类型状态本身。编译SQUIRRELFS只需几十秒；编译成功即表明崩溃一致性，而错误则为修复缺陷提供了起点。我们针对NOVA和WineFS等最先进的文件系统评估了SQUIRRELFS，发现在各种基准测试和应用中，SQUIRRELFS的性能与它们相当或更好。

upstream_only.title: High-throughput and flexible host networking for accelerated computing
upstream_only.abstract: Modern network hardware is able to meet the stringent bandwidth demands of applications like GPU-accelerated AI. However, existing host network stacks offer a hard tradeoff between performance (in terms of sustained throughput when compared to network hardware capacity) and flexibility (in terms of the ability to select, customize, and extend different network protocols).This paper explores a clean-slate approach to simultaneously offer high performance and flexibility. We present a co-design of the NIC hardware and the software stack to achieve this. The key idea in our design is the physical separation of the data path (payload transfer between network and application buffers) and the control path (header processing and transport-layer decisions). The NIC enables a high-performance zero-copy data path, independent of the placement of the application (CPU, GPU, FPGA, or other accelerators). The software stack provides a flexible control path by enabling the integration of any network protocol, executing in any environment (in the kernel, in user space, or in an accelerator).We implement and evaluate ZeroNIC, a prototype that combines an FPGA-based NIC with a software stack that integrates the Linux TCP protocol. We demonstrate that ZeroNIC achieves RDMA-like throughput while maintaining the benefits of robust protocols like TCP under various network perturbations. For instance, ZeroNIC enables a single TCP flow to saturate a 100Gbps link while utilizing only 17\% of a single CPU core. ZeroNIC improves NCCL and Redis throughput by 2.66\texttimes{} and 3.71\texttimes{}, respectively, over Linux TCP on a Mellanox ConnectX-6 NIC, without requiring application modifications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代网络硬件能够满足GPU加速AI等应用对带宽的严格要求。然而，现有的主机网络栈在性能（与网络硬件容量相比可持续吞吐量）和灵活性（选择、定制和扩展不同网络协议的能力）之间提供了艰难的权衡。本文探索了一种全新方法，以同时提供高性能和灵活性。我们提出了NIC硬件与软件栈的协同设计来实现这一目标。我们设计的关键思想是将数据路径（网络与应用缓冲区之间的负载传输）和控制路径（头部处理和传输层决策）进行物理分离。NIC实现了高性能的零拷贝数据路径，与应用所处的位置（CPU、GPU、FPGA或其他加速器）无关。软件栈通过支持任何网络协议的集成（可在内核、用户空间或加速器中执行）提供了灵活的控制路径。我们实现并评估了ZeroNIC，一个将基于FPGA的NIC与集成Linux TCP协议的软件栈相结合的原型。我们证明ZeroNIC在保持TCP等健壮协议在各种网络扰动下的优势的同时，实现了类似RDMA的吞吐量。例如，ZeroNIC使单个TCP流能够充分利用100Gbps链路，同时仅使用单CPU核心的17%。与Mellanox ConnectX-6 NIC上的Linux TCP相比，ZeroNIC将NCCL和Redis吞吐量分别提高了2.66倍和3.71倍，且无需修改应用程序。

upstream_only.title: INTOS: persistent embedded operating system and language support for multi-threaded intermittent computing
upstream_only.abstract: This paper introduces INTOS, an embedded operating system and language support for multi-threaded intermittent computing on a battery-less energy-harvesting platform. INTOS simplifies programming with a traditional "thread" and a "transaction" with automatic undo-logging of persistent objects in non-volatile memory. While INTOS allows the use of volatile memory for performance and energy efficiency, conventional transactions do not ensure crash consistency of volatile register and memory states. To address this challenge, INTOS proposes a novel replay-and-bypass approach, eliminating the need for users to checkpoint volatile states. Upon power restoration, INTOS recovers non-volatile states by undoing the updates of power-interrupted transactions. To reconstruct volatile states, INTOS restarts each thread bypassing committed transactions and system calls by returning recorded results without re-execution. INTOS seeks to build a persistent, full-fledged embedded OS, supporting priority-based preemptive multithreading while ensuring crash consistency even if power failure occurs during a system call or while some threads are blocked. Experiments on a commodity platform MSP430FR5994 show that when subjected to an extreme power failure frequency of 1 ms, INTOS demonstrated 1.24x lower latency and 1.29x less energy consumption than prior work leveraging idempotent processing. This trend turns out to be more pronounced on Apollo 4 Blue Plus.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了INTOS，一种嵌入式操作系统及语言支持，用于电池供电的无电池能量采集平台上的多线程间歇计算。INTOS通过传统的“线程”和“事务”简化编程，并在非易失性存储器中自动进行持久对象的回滚日志记录。虽然INTOS允许使用易失性存储器以提高性能和能效，但传统事务不能确保易失性寄存器和存储器状态的崩溃一致性。为解决这一挑战，INTOS提出了一种新颖的重放-绕过方法，无需用户对易失性状态进行检查点保存。在电力恢复时，INTOS通过撤销被电力中断的事务的更新来恢复非易失性状态。为重建易失性状态，INTOS重启每个线程，绕过已提交的事务和系统调用，通过返回记录的结果而不重新执行。INTOS旨在构建一个持久、功能完整的嵌入式操作系统，支持基于优先级的抢占式多线程，同时确保即使在系统调用期间或某些线程被阻塞时发生电力故障也能保证崩溃一致性。在商用平台MSP430FR5994上的实验表明，当经受1毫秒的极端断电频率时，INTOS相比先前利用幂等处理的方法，延迟降低了1.24倍，能耗降低了1.29倍。在Apollo 4 Blue Plus上，这一趋势更加明显。

upstream_only.title: Data-flow availability: achieving timing assurance on autonomous systems
upstream_only.abstract: Due to the continuous interaction with the physical world, autonomous cyber-physical systems (CPS) require both functional and temporal correctness. Despite recent advances in the theoretical foundation of real-time computing, leveraging these results efficiently in modern CPS platforms often requires domain expertise, and presents non-trivial challenges to many developers.To understand the practical challenges in building real-time software, we conducted a survey of 189 software issues from 7 representative CPS open-source projects. Through this exercise, we found that most bugs are due to misalignment in time between cyber and physical states. This inspires us to abstract three key temporal properties: freshness, consistency, and stability. Using a newly developed concept, Data-flow Availability (DFA), which aims to capture temporal/availability expectation of data flow, we show how these essential properties can be represented as timing constraints on data flows. To realize the timing assurance from DFA, we designed and implemented Kairos, which automatically detects and mitigates timing constraint violations. To detect violations, Kairos translates the policy definition from the API-based annotations into run-time program instrumentation. To mitigate the violations, it provides an infrastructure to bridge semantic gaps between schedulers at different abstraction layers to allow for coordinated efforts. End-to-end evaluation on three real-world CPS platforms shows that Kairos improves timing predictability and safety while introducing a minimal 2.8\% run-time overhead.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 由于与物理世界的持续交互，自主信息物理系统（CPS）需要功能和时序上的正确性。尽管实时计算的理论基础取得了最新进展，但在现代CPS平台上有效利用这些成果通常需要领域专业知识，并给许多开发者带来了不小的挑战。为了理解构建实时软件的实际挑战，我们对来自7个具有代表性的CPS开源项目的189个软件问题进行了调查。通过这项工作，我们发现大多数错误是由于物理和网络状态之间的时间失调造成的。这启发我们抽象出三个关键的时序属性：新鲜度、一致性和稳定性。使用新开发的概念——数据流可用性（DFA），其旨在捕捉数据流的时序/可用性期望，我们展示了如何将这些基本属性表示为数据流上的时序约束。为了实现DFA的时序保证，我们设计并实现了Kairos，它自动检测并缓解时序约束违反。为了检测违反，Kairos将基于API注解的策略定义转换为运行时程序插桩。为了缓解违反，它提供了一个基础设施来弥合不同抽象层调度器之间的语义鸿沟，以允许协同工作。在三个真实世界CPS平台上的端到端评估表明，Kairos提高了时序可预测性和安全性，同时引入了仅2.8%的运行时开销。

upstream_only.title: Microkernel goes general: performance and compatibility in the HongMeng production microkernel
upstream_only.abstract: The virtues of security, reliability, and extensibility have made state-of-the-art microkernels prevalent in embedded and safety-critical scenarios. However, they face performance and compatibility issues when targeting more general scenarios, such as smartphones and smart vehicles.This paper presents the design and implementation of Hong-Meng kernel (HM), a commercialized general-purpose microkernel that preserves most of the virtues of microkernels while addressing the above challenges. For the sake of commercial practicality, we design HM to be compatible with the Linux API and ABI to reuse its rich applications and driver ecosystems. To make it performant despite the constraints of compatibility and being general-purpose, we reexamine the traditional microkernel wisdom, including IPC, capability-based access control, and userspace paging, and retrofit them accordingly. Specifically, we argue that per-invocation IPC is not the only concern for performance, but IPC frequency, state double bookkeeping among OS services, and capabilities that hide kernel objects contribute to significant performance degradation. We mitigate them accordingly with a set of techniques, including differentiated isolation classes, flexible composition, policy-free kernel paging, and address-token-based access control.HM consists of a minimal core kernel and a set of least-privileged OS services, and it can run complex frameworks like AOSP and OpenHarmony. HM has been deployed in production on tens of millions of devices in emerging scenarios, including smart routers, smart vehicles and smartphones, typically with improved performance and security over their Linux counterparts.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 安全、可靠和可扩展性的优点使得最先进的微内核在嵌入式和安全攸关场景中非常普遍。然而，在面向智能手机和智能汽车等更通用场景时，它们面临性能和兼容性问题。本文介绍了鸿蒙内核的设计与实现，这是一个商业化的通用微内核，在解决上述挑战的同时保留了微内核的大部分优点。为了商业实用性，我们设计鸿蒙与Linux API和ABI兼容，以复用其丰富的应用程序和驱动程序生态系统。为了在兼容性和通用性的约束下实现高性能，我们重新审视了传统微内核的理念，包括IPC、基于能力(权限)的访问控制和用户态分页，并相应地进行改造。具体来说，我们认为每次调用的IPC并不是性能的唯一问题，IPC频率、操作系统服务间的状态重复记账、以及隐藏内核对象的能力(权限)机制也造成了显著的性能下降。我们通过一组技术来缓解这些问题，包括差异化隔离类、灵活组合、无策略内核分页和基于地址令牌的访问控制。鸿蒙由一个最小的核心内核和一组最小特权的OS服务组成，能够运行像AOSP和OpenHarmony这样的复杂框架。鸿蒙已在智能路由器、智能汽车和智能手机等新兴场景中于数千万设备上投入生产，通常比同类的Linux系统具有更好的性能和安全性。

upstream_only.title: When will my ML job finish? toward providing completion time estimates through predictability-centric scheduling
upstream_only.abstract: In this paper, we make a case for providing job completion time estimates to GPU cluster users, similar to providing the delivery date of a package or arrival time of a booked ride. Our analysis reveals that providing predictability can come at the expense of performance and fairness. Existing GPU schedulers optimize for extreme points in the trade-off space, making them either extremely unpredictable or impractical.To address this challenge, we present PCS, a new scheduling framework that aims to provide predictability while balancing other traditional objectives. The key idea behind PCS is to use Weighted-Fair-Queueing (WFQ) and find a suitable configuration of different WFQ parameters (e.g., queue weights) that meets specific goals for predictability. It uses a simulation-aided search strategy to efficiently discover WFQ configurations that lie around the Pareto front of the trade-off space between these objectives. We implement and evaluate PCS in the context of scheduling ML training workloads on GPUs. Our evaluation, on a small-scale GPU testbed and larger-scale simulations, shows that PCS can provide accurate completion time estimates while marginally compromising on performance and fairness.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们主张向GPU集群用户提供作业完成时间估计，类似于提供包裹的送货日期或预订搭车的到达时间。我们的分析表明，提供可预测性可能会以性能和公平性为代价。现有的GPU调度器优化了权衡空间中的极端点，使其要么极度不可预测，要么不切实际。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了PCS，一种新的调度框架，旨在提供可预测性的同时平衡其他传统目标。PCS背后的关键思想是使用加权公平队列（WFQ），并找到合适的WFQ参数（例如队列权重）配置，以实现在可预测性方面的特定目标。它通过模拟辅助搜索策略高效地发现位于这些目标之间权衡空间帕累托前沿附近的WFQ配置。我们在GPU上调度ML训练工作负载的背景下实现并评估了PCS。我们在小规模GPU测试平台和大规模模拟上的评估表明，PCS能够提供准确的完成时间估计，同时仅在性能和公平性上略有折损。

upstream_only.title: Optimizing resource allocation in hyperscale datacenters: scalability, usability, and experiences
upstream_only.abstract: Meta's private cloud uses millions of servers to host tens of thousands of services that power multiple products for billions of users. This complex environment has various optimization problems involving resource allocation, including hardware placement, server allocation, ML training \& inference placement, traffic routing, database \& container migration for load balancing, grouping serverless functions for locality, etc.The main challenges for a reusable resource-allocation framework are its usability and scalability. Usability is impeded by practitioners struggling to translate real-life policies into precise mathematical formulas required by formal optimization methods, while scalability is hampered by NP-hard problems that cannot be solved efficiently by commercial solvers.These challenges are addressed by Rebalancer, Meta's resource-allocation framework. It has been applied to dozens of large-scale use cases over the past seven years, demonstrating its usability, scalability, and generality. At the core of Rebalancer is an expression graph that enables its optimization algorithm to run more efficiently than past algorithms. Moreover, Rebalancer offers a high-level specification language to lower the barrier for adoption by systems practitioners.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Meta的私有云使用数百万台服务器为数以万计的服务提供支持，这些服务为数亿用户的产品提供动力。这种复杂环境涉及各种资源分配优化问题，包括硬件放置、服务器分配、机器学习训练与推理放置、流量路由、用于负载均衡的数据库与容器迁移、为局部性而分组的无服务器函数等。可复用资源分配框架的主要挑战是其可用性和可扩展性。可用性受阻碍是因为从业者难以将现实政策转化为形式化优化方法所需的精确数学公式；可扩展性则受限于NP难题，商用求解器无法高效求解。这些挑战由Meta的资源分配框架Rebalancer解决。在过去七年中，它已被应用于数十个大规模用例，展示了其可用性、可扩展性和通用性。Rebalancer的核心是一个表达式图，使其优化算法比以往算法运行更高效。此外，Rebalancer提供了一种高级规范语言，降低了系统从业者的采用门槛。

upstream_only.title: µSlope: high compression and fast search on semi-structured logs
upstream_only.abstract: Internet-scale services can produce a large amount of logs. Such logs are increasingly appearing in semi-structured formats such as JSON. At Uber, the amount of semi-structured log data can exceed 10PB/day. It is prohibitively expensive to store and analyze them. As a result, logs are only kept searchable for a few days.This paper proposes µSlope, a system that losslessly compresses semi-structured log data, and allows search without full decompression. It concisely represents the schema structures, and only keeps this representation stored once per dataset instead of interspersing it with each record. It further "structurizes" the semi-structured data by grouping the records with the same schema structure into the same table, so that each table is also well structured. Our evaluation shows that µSlope achieves 21.9:1 to 186.8:1 compression ratio, which is at least a few times higher than any existing semi-structured data management systems (SSDMS); The compression ratio is 2.34x as high as Zstandard and the search speed is 5.77x of the other SSDMSes.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 互联网规模的服务可能产生大量日志。此类日志日益以半结构化格式（如JSON）出现。在Uber，半结构化日志数据量可超过每天10PB。存储和分析这些数据的成本极其高昂。因此，日志通常只能保留几天可搜索状态。本文提出µSlope，一个无损压缩半结构化日志数据并允许无需完全解压即可搜索的系统。它简洁地表示模式结构，并且仅每数据集存储一次该表示，而不是将其与每条记录交织在一起。它进一步通过将具有相同模式结构的记录分组到同一张表中来“结构化”半结构化数据，从而使每张表也具有良好的结构化。我们的评估显示，µSlope实现了21.9:1至186.8:1的压缩比，至少比任何现有半结构化数据管理系统（SSDMS）高出数倍；压缩比是Zstandard的2.34倍，搜索速度是其他SSDMS的5.77倍。

upstream_only.title: ServiceLab: preventing tiny performance regressions at hyperscale through pre-production testing
upstream_only.abstract: This paper presents ServiceLab, a large-scale performance testing platform developed at Meta. Currently, the diverse set of applications and ML models it tests consumes millions of machines in production, and each year it detects performance regressions that could otherwise lead to the wastage of millions of machines. A major challenge for ServiceLab is to detect small performance regressions, sometimes as tiny as 0.01\%. These minor regressions matter due to our large fleet size and their potential to accumulate over time. For instance, the median regression detected by ServiceLab for our large serverless platform, running on more than half a million machines, is only 0.14\%. Another challenge is running performance tests in our private cloud, which, like the public cloud, is a noisy environment that exhibits inherent performance variances even for machines of the same instance type. To address these challenges, we conduct a large-scale study with millions of performance experiments to identify machine factors, such as the kernel, CPU, and datacenter location, that introduce variance to test results. Moreover, we present statistical analysis methods to robustly identify small regressions. Finally, we share our seven years of operational experience in dealing with a diverse set of applications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了ServiceLab，这是Meta开发的一个大规模性能测试平台。目前，它测试的各种应用和机器学习模型消耗了数百万台生产机器，每年它能检测出性能回退，否则这些回退可能导致数百万台机器的浪费。ServiceLab面临的一个重大挑战是检测微小的性能回退，有时小至0.01%。这些微小的回退很重要，因为我们的机队规模庞大，且它们可能随时间累积。例如，对于运行在超过50万台机器上的大型无服务器平台，ServiceLab检测到的回退中位数仅为0.14%。另一个挑战是在我们的私有云中运行性能测试，私有云和公有云一样，是一个嘈杂的环境，即使对于相同实例类型的机器也存在固有的性能差异。为了解决这些挑战，我们进行了涉及数百万次性能实验的大规模研究，以确定引入测试结果差异的机器因素，如内核、CPU和数据中心位置。此外，我们提出了能够稳健识别微小回退的统计分析方法。最后，我们分享了在处理多样化应用集方面的七年运营经验。

upstream_only.title: MAST: global scheduling of ML training across geo-distributed datacenters at hyperscale
upstream_only.abstract: In public clouds, users must manually select a datacenter region to upload their ML training data and launch ML training workloads in the same region to ensure data and computation colocation.
