upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在扩展律时代，GPU在计算机系统中扮演着越来越重要的角色，理解细粒度的GPU运行时行为比以往任何时候都更为关键。然而，现有的GPU内核剖析器通常是内核独占的或依赖硬件的，往往无法捕获细粒度的测量数据。本文提出了NEUTRINO，一个可编程的GPU内核剖析接口，利用汇编层探针实现指令级细粒度、跨时间和值域的剖析通用性以及硬件独立性。为了更好地可视化NEUTRINO捕获的丰富细节，我们引入了密集内存访问时间线（DMAT），这是一种新颖的表示方法，为GPU运行时行为提供了新的见解。我们在Linux上为NVIDIA和AMD GPU实现了NEUTRINO，并进行了广泛的评估和分析。结果表明NEUTRINO在GPU内核剖析方面具有卓越的能力且开销较低。我们期望NEUTRINO能成为社区的有用工具，并已将其开源以促进未来研究，地址为https://github.com/open-neutrino/neutrino。

upstream_only.title: Principles and methodologies for serial performance optimization
upstream_only.abstract: Throughout the history of computer science, optimizing existing systems to achieve higher performance has been a longstanding aspiration. While the primary emphasis of this endeavor lies in reducing latency and increasing throughput, these two are closely intertwined, and answering the how question has remained a challenge, often relying on intuition and experience.This paper introduces a systematic approach to optimizing sequential tasks, which are fundamental for overall performance. We define three principles--task removal, replacement, and reordering--and distill them into eight actionable methodologies: batching, caching, precomputing, deferring, relaxation, contextualization, hardware specialization, and layering. Our review of OSDI and SOSP papers over the past decade shows that these techniques, when taken together, comprehensively account for the observed sequential optimization strategies.To illustrate the framework's practical value, we present two case studies: one on file and storage systems, and another analyzing kernel synchronization to uncover missed optimization opportunities. Furthermore, we introduce SysGPT, a fine-tuned GPT model trained on curated literature analysis, which offer context-aware performance suggestions. SysGPT's outputs are more specific and feasible than GPT-4's, aligning with core strategies from recent research without direct exposure, demonstrating its utility as an optimization assistant.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在计算机科学的整个历史中，优化现有系统以实现更高性能一直是长期的追求。虽然这一努力的主要重点在于减少延迟和增加吞吐量，但这两者紧密相连，而且如何优化的问题仍然是一个挑战，往往依赖于直觉和经验。本文介绍了一种系统化的方法来优化串行任务，这些任务对于整体性能至关重要。我们定义了三个原则——任务移除、替换和重排序——并将其提炼为八种可操作的方法：批处理、缓存、预计算、延迟执行、松弛化、情境化、硬件专用化和分层。我们回顾了过去十年中OSDI和SOSP论文，显示这些技术综合在一起，能够全面解释所观察到的串行优化策略。为了展示该框架的实用价值，我们提出了两个案例研究：一个关于文件和存储系统，另一个分析内核同步以发现被遗漏的优化机会。此外，我们引入了SysGPT，一个基于精选文献分析微调的GPT模型，能够提供情境感知的性能建议。SysGPT的输出比GPT-4更具体且更可行，与近期研究的核心策略一致而无需直接接触，展示了其作为优化助手的实用性。

upstream_only.title: S\"{o}ze: one network telemetry is all you need for per-flow weighted bandwidth allocation at scale
upstream_only.abstract: Weighted bandwidth allocation is a powerful abstraction that has a wide range of use cases in modern data center networks. However, realizing highly agile and precise weighted bandwidth allocation for large-scale cloud environments is fundamentally challenging. In this paper, we propose S\"{o}ze, a lightweight decentralized weighted bandwidth allocation system that leverages simple network telemetry features of commodity Ethernet switches. Given the flow weights, S\"{o}ze can effectively use the telemetry information to compute and enforce the weighted bandwidth allocations without per-flow, topology, or routing knowledge. We demonstrate the effectiveness of S\"{o}ze through simulations and testbed experiments, improving TPC-H jobs completion time by up to 0.59\texttimes{} and 0.79\texttimes{} on average.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 加权带宽分配是一种强大的抽象，在现代数据中心网络中有广泛的应用场景。然而，为大规模云环境实现高度敏捷和精确的加权带宽分配从根本上具有挑战性。在本文中，我们提出了Söze，一个轻量级的去中心化加权带宽分配系统，它利用商用以太网交换机的简单网络遥测特性。给定流权重，Söze可以有效地利用遥测信息来计算和执行加权带宽分配，而无需每流、拓扑或路由知识。我们通过模拟和测试平台实验证明了Söze的有效性，将TPC-H作业完成时间平均最多提高了0.59倍和0.79倍。

upstream_only.title: Decouple and decompose: scaling resource allocation with DEDE
upstream_only.abstract: Efficient resource allocation is essential in cloud systems to facilitate resource sharing among tenants. However, the growing scale of these optimization problems have outpaced commercial solvers commonly employed in production. To accelerate resource allocation, prior approaches either customize solutions for narrow domains or impose workload-specific assumptions. In this work, we revisit real-world resource allocation problems and uncover a common underlying structure: the vast majority of these problems are inherently separable, i.e., they optimize the aggregate utility of individual resource and demand allocations, under separate constraints for each resource and each demand. Building on this observation, we develop DEDE, a scalable and theoretically rooted optimization framework for large-scale resource allocation. At the core of DEDE is a decouple-and-decompose approach: it decouples entangled resource and demand constraints and thereby decomposes the overall optimization into alternating per-resource and per-demand subproblems that can be solved efficiently and in parallel. We have implemented and released DEDE as a Python package with a familiar modeling interface. Our experiments on three representative resource allocation tasks--cluster scheduling, traffic engineering, and load balancing--demonstrate that DEDE delivers significant speedups while generating higher-quality allocations.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 高效的资源分配对于云系统中促进租户之间的资源共享至关重要。然而，这些优化问题的规模不断增长，已经超越了生产环境中常用的商业求解器。为了加速资源分配，先前的方法要么为狭窄领域定制解决方案，要么施加负载特定假设。在这项工作中，我们重新审视真实的资源分配问题，并揭示了一个共同的底层结构：绝大多数问题本质上是可分离的，即它们在每个资源和每个需求的单独约束下，优化各资源和需求分配的总体效用。基于这一观察，我们开发了DEDE，这是一个可扩展且具有理论根基的大规模资源分配优化框架。DEDE的核心是一种解耦-分解方法：它解耦相互纠缠的资源约束和需求约束，从而将整体优化分解为可高效并行解决的逐资源和逐需求交替子问题。我们已将DEDE作为Python包实现并发布，具有熟悉的建模接口。我们在三个代表性资源分配任务上的实验——集群调度、流量工程和负载均衡——表明，DEDE在生成更高质量分配的同时带来了显著加速。

upstream_only.title: Quantum virtual machines
upstream_only.abstract: Cloud computing services offer time on quantum computers, but users are forced to each use the entire quantum computer to run their programs as there is no way to multiplex a quantum computer among multiple programs at the same time. We present HyperQ, a system that introduces virtual machines for quantum computers to provide fault isolation, better resource utilization, and lower latency for quantum cloud computing. A quantum virtual machine is defined in terms of quantum computer hardware, specifically its quantum gates and qubits arranged in a hardware-specific topology. HyperQ enables quantum virtual machines to be simultaneously executed together on a quantum computer by multiplexing them in time and space on the hardware and ensuring that they are isolated from one another. HyperQ works with existing quantum programs and compiler frameworks; programs are simply compiled to run in virtual machines without the programs or compilers needing to know what else might be executed at the same time. We have implemented HyperQ for the IBM quantum computing service, the largest quantum computing fleet in the world. Our experimental results running quantum programs in virtual machines using the IBM service demonstrate that HyperQ can increase utilization and throughput while reducing program latency, by up to an order of magnitude, without sacrificing, and in some cases improving, fidelity in the results of quantum program execution.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 云计算服务提供量子计算机的使用时间，但用户被迫各自使用整台量子计算机来运行他们的程序，因为目前还没有办法在同一时间在多个程序之间复用量子计算机。我们提出了HyperQ，一个为量子计算机引入虚拟机以提供故障隔离、更优资源利用率和更低延迟的系统，用于量子云计算。量子虚拟机以量子计算机硬件来定义，具体包括其量子门和按硬件特定拓扑排列的量子比特。HyperQ通过在硬件上对量子虚拟机进行时间和空间复用，并确保它们彼此隔离，从而使其能在量子计算机上同时执行。HyperQ可与现有量子程序和编译器框架配合工作；程序只需编译到虚拟机中运行，而程序或编译器无需知道同一时间还可能执行什么其他内容。我们已在IBM量子计算服务上实现了HyperQ，该服务是世界上最大的量子计算车队。我们使用IBM服务在虚拟机中运行量子程序的实验结果表明，HyperQ能够提高利用率和吞吐量，同时将程序延迟降低多达一个数量级，且不会牺牲（在某些情况下还会提高）量子程序执行结果的保真度。

upstream_only.title: QOS: quantum operating system
upstream_only.abstract: Quantum computers face challenges due to hardware constraints, noise errors, and heterogeneity, and face fundamental design tradeoffs between key performance metrics such as quantum fidelity and system utilization. This substantially complicates managing quantum resources to scale the size and number of quantum algorithms that can be executed reliably in a given time.We introduce QOS, a modular quantum operating system that holistically addresses the challenges of quantum resource management by systematically exploring key design tradeoffs across the stack. QOS exposes a hardware-agnostic API for transparent quantum job execution, mitigates hardware errors, and systematically multi-programs and schedules the jobs across space and time to achieve high quantum fidelity in a resource-efficient manner. QOS's modular design enables synergistic cross- and intra-layer optimizations, while introducing new concepts such as compatibility-based multi-programming and effective utilization.We evaluate QOS on real quantum devices hosted by IBM, using 7000 real quantum runs of more than 70.000 benchmark instances. We show that the QOS achieves 2.6-456.5\texttimes{} higher fidelity, increases resource utilization by up to 9.6\texttimes{}, and reduces waiting times by up to 5\texttimes{} while sacrificing only 1-3\% fidelity, on average, compared to the baselines.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 量子计算机由于硬件限制、噪声错误和异质性而面临挑战，并在量子保真度和系统利用率等关键性能指标之间面临根本性的设计权衡。这大大复杂化了量子资源的管理，难以在给定时间内扩大可可靠执行的量子算法的规模和数量。我们介绍了QOS，一个模块化的量子操作系统，通过系统地探索整个技术栈中的关键设计权衡，全面应对量子资源管理的挑战。QOS为透明的量子作业执行提供了一种与硬件无关的API，减轻了硬件错误，并系统地跨空间和时间对作业进行多程序设计和调度，以资源高效的方式实现高量子保真度。QOS的模块化设计能够实现跨层和层内的协同优化，同时引入了基于兼容性的多程序设计和有效利用率等新概念。我们使用IBM托管的真实量子设备对QOS进行了评估，使用了7000次真实量子运行，涵盖超过7万个基准实例。我们证明，与基线相比，QOS平均将保真度提高了2.6-456.5倍，资源利用率提高了高达9.6倍，等待时间减少了高达5倍，而平均仅牺牲了1-3%的保真度。

upstream_only.title: Scalio: scaling up DPU-based JBOF key-value store with NVMe-oF target offload
upstream_only.abstract: The rapid growth of data-intensive applications has created a demand for high-density storage systems. Data-Processing-Unit-based (DPU-based) Just a Bunch of Flash (JBOF) solutions provide an energy-efficient and cost-effective architecture to meet this need. However, existing JBOF solutions struggle with scalability when handling an increasing number of attached SSDs, due to their heavy reliance on the DPU's CPU for SSD I/O operations.In this paper, we introduce Scalio, a scalable disaggregated key-value store designed to address the limitations of current DPU-based JBOF systems. Scalio offloads as many SSD I/O operations as possible to the DPU's network I/O capabilities, including traditional RDMA verbs and a recent hardware optimization, NVMe over Fabrics Target Offload. Additionally, Scalio incorporates a two-layer design with compact in-memory data structures to handle hot read traffic and manage bursty writes. One of the key challenges in this design is ensuring consistency between the DRAM states in the DPU and the SSD states, which, unlike CPU L1/L2 caches, are not automatically synchronized through hardware cache coherence protocols. To address this, Scalio introduces an RDMA-based cache consistency protocol that guarantees linearizability across the system, despite the disaggregated nature of the architecture.Our experiments show that Scalio significantly improves both scalability and throughput, achieving up to 3.3\texttimes{} higher throughput compared to existing systems, especially in high-density SSD configurations.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 数据密集型应用的快速增长产生了对高密度存储系统的需求。基于数据处理单元（DPU）的“一堆闪存”（JBOF）解决方案提供了一种节能且成本效益高的架构来满足这一需求。然而，现有的JBOF解决方案在处理越来越多的直连SSD时，由于其对DPU的CPU处理SSD I/O操作的过度依赖，面临着可扩展性问题。在本文中，我们介绍了Scalio，一种可扩展的解聚合键值存储，旨在解决当前基于DPU的JBOF系统的局限性。Scalio将尽可能多的SSD I/O操作卸载到DPU的网络I/O能力上，包括传统的RDMA动词和最近的一种硬件优化——NVMe over Fabrics目标卸载。此外，Scalio采用了两层设计，具有紧凑的内存中数据结构，以处理热读流量和管理突发写入。这种设计中的一个关键挑战是确保DPU中的DRAM状态与SSD状态之间的一致性，这与CPU L1/L2缓存不同，它们不会通过硬件缓存一致性协议自动同步。为解决此问题，Scalio引入了一种基于RDMA的缓存一致性协议，尽管架构具有解聚合性，但保证了跨系统的线性一致性。我们的实验表明，Scalio显著提高了可扩展性和吞吐量，特别是在高密度SSD配置下，与现有系统相比实现了高达3.3倍的吞吐量提升。

upstream_only.title: Low end-to-end latency atop a speculative shared log with fix-ante ordering
upstream_only.abstract: Today's shared logs incur expensive coordination to globally order records across storage shards before they can deliver records to applications. This makes them unsuitable for many modern applications that must process ingested data as early as possible and realize low end-to-end (e2e) latencies. We propose SpecLog, a new shared log abstraction that delivers records by speculating the global order, allowing the application's computation and shared-log coordination to be overlapped, thus reducing e2e latency. To enable accurate speculations, we introduce fix-ante ordering, a novel ordering mechanism that predetermines the global order and makes the shards adhere to the predetermined order. With fix-ante ordering, shards, except in rare cases, can accurately predict where their records will sit in the total order before global coordination. We build Belfast, an implementation of the SpecLog abstraction and fix-ante ordering. Our experiments show that Belfast offers lower e2e latencies than current shared logs while preserving their elasticity, flexibility, and scalability.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 如今的共享日志需要在将记录传递给应用程序之前，通过昂贵的协调机制在存储分片之间全局排序记录。这使得它们不适用于许多现代应用程序，这些应用程序必须尽早处理摄入的数据，并实现低端到端（e2e）延迟。我们提出了SpecLog，一种新的共享日志抽象，它通过推测全局顺序来传递记录，使应用程序的计算与共享日志的协调能够重叠，从而降低端到端延迟。为了实现准确的推测，我们引入了“前置固定顺序”（fix-ante ordering），这是一种新颖的排序机制，它预先确定全局顺序并使分片遵循该预定顺序。通过前置固定顺序，分片在极少数情况之外，都能在全局协调之前准确预测其记录在总顺序中的位置。我们构建了Belfast，即SpecLog抽象和前置固定顺序的实现。实验表明，与当前的共享日志相比，Belfast在保持其弹性、灵活性和可扩展性的同时，提供了更低的端到端延迟。

upstream_only.title: Understanding stragglers in large model training using what-if analysis
upstream_only.abstract: Large language model (LLM) training is one of the most demanding distributed computations today, often requiring thousands of GPUs with frequent synchronization across machines. Such a workload pattern makes it susceptible to stragglers, where the training can be stalled by few slow workers. At ByteDance we find stragglers are not trivially always caused by hardware failures, but can arise from multiple complex factors. This work aims to present a comprehensive study on the straggler issues in LLM training, using a five-month trace collected from our ByteDance LLM training cluster. The core methodology is what-if analysis that simulates the scenario without any stragglers and contrasts with the actual case. We use this method to study the following questions: (1) how often do stragglers affect training jobs, and what effect do they have on job performance; (2) do stragglers exhibit temporal or spatial patterns; and (3) what are the potential root causes for stragglers?
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型训练是当今最苛刻的分布式计算任务之一，通常需要数千个 GPU，并跨机器频繁同步。这种工作负载模式使其容易受到落伍者（straggler）的影响，即训练可能被少数缓慢的工作节点所阻塞。在字节跳动，我们发现落伍者并非总是由硬件故障引起的，而可能源于多种复杂因素。本工作旨在通过我们从字节跳动 LLM 训练集群收集的五个月追踪数据，对 LLM 训练中的落伍者问题进行全面的研究。核心方法是假设分析（what-if analysis），它模拟没有落伍者的场景，并与实际情况进行对比。我们使用这种方法研究以下问题：（1）落伍者影响训练任务的频率以及它们对任务性能的影响；（2）落伍者是否表现出时间或空间模式；（3）落伍者的潜在根本原因是什么？

upstream_only.title: Fork in the road: reflections and optimizations for cold start latency in production serverless systems
upstream_only.abstract: Serverless computing has seen widespread adoption in public cloud environments. However, it continues to suffer from long cold start latency, which remains a key performance bottleneck. We have conducted an in-depth investigation of existing cold start optimizations and evaluated their effectiveness in large-scale industrial deployments. Our study reveals several common limitations in prior research: (1) reliance on simplified assumptions that overlook the complexities of large-scale systems; (2) a narrow focus on optimizing isolated components of the cold start process, while ignoring end-to-end workflow interactions; and (3) insufficient attention to the challenges introduced by concurrent execution environments. As a result, despite incorporating prior techniques, cold start latency on the Ant Group serverless platform remains in the range of hundreds of milliseconds to several seconds.This paper identifies three previously overlooked sources of latency: (1) control path latency, stemming from interactions within the serverless runtime; (2) resource contention latency, arising under high concurrency and sustained execution; and (3) user code initialization latency, which reflects the trade-off between resource efficiency and startup performance. To address these challenges, we propose a suite of novel techniques that overcome key limitations in existing approaches. These techniques are designed to be both adaptable to real-world workloads and scalable to large deployments. Our system, AFaaS (short for Ant FaaS), reduces cold start latency to the millisecond level. AFaaS has been deployed in production for over 18 months and has consistently demonstrated stable performance at scale.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 无服务器计算已在公共云环境中得到广泛采用。然而，它仍然饱受冷启动延迟过长之苦，这依然是一个关键的性能瓶颈。我们对现有的冷启动优化进行了深入调查，并评估了它们在大规模工业部署中的有效性。我们的研究揭示了先前研究的几个常见局限：(1) 依赖简化假设，忽视大规模系统的复杂性；(2) 只关注优化冷启动过程的孤立组件，而忽略端到端工作流交互；(3) 对并发执行环境带来的挑战关注不足。因此，尽管采用了先前的技术，蚂蚁集团无服务器平台上的冷启动延迟仍在数百毫秒到数秒之间。本文指出了三个先前被忽视的延迟来源：(1) 控制路径延迟，源于无服务器运行时的内部交互；(2) 资源争用延迟，在高并发和持续执行情况下出现；(3) 用户代码初始化延迟，反映了资源效率与启动性能之间的权衡。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一套新技术，克服了现有方法中的关键局限。这些技术既适用于真实工作负载，又可扩展到大规模部署。我们的系统AFaaS（蚂蚁无服务器函数即服务的缩写）将冷启动延迟降低到毫秒级。AFaaS已投入生产超过18个月，并始终表现出大规模稳定性能。

upstream_only.title: Kamino: efficient VM allocation at scale with latency-driven cache-aware scheduling
upstream_only.abstract: In virtual machine (VM) allocation systems, caching repetitive and similar VM allocation requests and associated resolution rules is crucial for reducing computational costs and meeting strict latency requirements. While modern allocation systems distribute requests among multiple allocator agents and use caching to improve performance, current schedulers often neglect the cache state and latency considerations when assigning each new request to an agent. Due to the high variance in costs of cache hits and misses and the associated processing overheads of updating the caches, simple load-balancing and cache-aware mechanisms result in high latencies. We introduce Kamino, a high-performance, latency-driven and cache-aware request scheduling system aimed at minimizing end-to-end latencies. Kamino employs a novel scheduling algorithm grounded in theory which uses partial indicators from the cache state to assign each new request to the agent with the lowest estimated latency. Evaluation of Kamino using a high-fidelity simulator on large-scale production workloads shows a 42\% reduction in average request latencies. Our deployment of Kamino in the control plane of a large public cloud confirms these improvements, with a 33\% decrease in cache miss rates and 17\% reduction in memory usage.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在虚拟机（VM）分配系统中，缓存重复和相似的虚拟机分配请求及相关的解析规则对于降低计算成本和满足严格的延迟要求至关重要。虽然现代分配系统将请求分发到多个分配代理并使用缓存来提高性能，但当前的调度器在为每个新请求分配代理时往往忽略了缓存状态和延迟考虑。由于缓存命中和未命中的成本差异极大，以及更新缓存的相关处理开销，简单的负载均衡和缓存感知机制会导致较高的延迟。我们提出了Kamino，一种高性能、延迟驱动且缓存感知的请求调度系统，旨在最小化端到端延迟。Kamino采用了一种基于理论的新型调度算法，利用缓存状态的部分指标，将每个新请求分配给估算延迟最低的代理。使用高保真模拟器在大型生产工作负载上对Kamino的评估显示，平均请求延迟降低了42%。我们在大型公有云控制平面中部署Kamino，证实了这些改进，缓存未命中率降低了33%，内存使用量减少了17%。

upstream_only.title: ZEN: empowering distributed training with sparsity-driven data synchronization
upstream_only.abstract: Distributed training is the de facto standard to scale up the training of deep learning models with multiple GPUs. Its performance bottleneck lies in communications for gradient synchronization. Although high tensor sparsity is widely observed, the optimal communication scheme to fully leverage sparsity is still missing. This paper aims to bridge this gap. We first analyze the characteristics of sparse tensors in popular models to understand the fundamentals of sparsity. We then systematically explore the design space of communication schemes for sparse tensors and find the optimal ones. These findings give a new understanding and inspire us to develop a holistic gradient synchronization system for sparse tensors called ZEN. We demonstrate that ZEN can achieve up to 5.09\texttimes{} speedup in communication time and up to 2.48\texttimes{} speedup in training throughput compared to the state-of-the-art methods.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 分布式训练是通过多个GPU扩展深度学习模型训练的事实标准。其性能瓶颈在于梯度同步的通信。虽然经常观察到较高的张量稀疏性，但充分利用稀疏性的最优通信方案仍然缺失。本文旨在弥合这一差距。我们首先分析流行模型中稀疏张量的特征，以理解稀疏性的基本原理。然后我们系统探索稀疏张量通信方案的设计空间，并找到最优方案。这些发现提供了新的认识，并启发我们开发了一个针对稀疏张量的整体式梯度同步系统，称为ZEN。我们证明，与最先进的方法相比，ZEN在通信时间上可实现高达5.09倍的加速，在训练吞吐量上可实现高达2.48倍的加速。

upstream_only.title: Extending applications safely and efficiently
upstream_only.abstract: This paper presents the Extension Interface Model (EIM) and bpftime, which together enable safer and more efficient extension of userspace applications than the current state-of-the-art. EIM is a new model that treats each required feature of an extension as a resource, including concrete hardware resources (e.g., memory) and abstract ones (e.g., the ability to invoke a function from the extended application). An extension manager, i.e., the person who manages a deployment, uses EIM to specify only the resources an extension needs to perform its task. bpftime is a new extension framework that enforces an EIM specification. Compared to prior systems, bpftime is efficient because it uses extended Berkeley Packet Filter (eBPF)-style verification, hardware-supported isolation features (e.g., Intel MPK), and dynamic binary rewriting. Moreover, bpftime is easy to adopt into existing workflows since it is compatible with the current eBPF ecosystem. We demonstrate the usefulness of EIM and bpftime across 6 use cases that improve security, monitor and enhance performance, and explore configuration trade-offs.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文提出了扩展接口模型（EIM）和bpftime，它们共同比当前最先进技术更安全、更高效地扩展用户空间应用程序。EIM是一种新模型，它将扩展的每个必要特性视为一种资源，包括具体的硬件资源（例如内存）和抽象资源（例如调用被扩展应用程序函数的能力）。扩展管理器（即管理部署的人员）使用EIM来仅指定扩展执行其任务所需的资源。bpftime是一个新扩展框架，用于强制实施EIM规范。与先前的系统相比，bpftime高效的原因在于它采用了eBPF风格的验证、硬件支持的隔离特性（例如Intel MPK）以及动态二进制重写。此外，bpftime兼容现有的eBPF生态系统，因此易于被纳入现有工作流程。我们通过6个用例展示了EIM和bpftime在改善安全性、监控和提升性能以及探索配置权衡方面的实用性。

upstream_only.title: Tintin: a unified hardware performance profiling infrastructure to uncover and manage uncertainty
upstream_only.abstract: Hardware performance counters (HPCs) enable the measurement of microarchitectural events, which are crucial for tracking and predicting program behavior. High-fidelity measurement and precise attribution are essential for accurate profiling. However, existing profiling tools have fundamental challenges in both aspects. In measurement, numerous events compete for limited hardware monitoring resources; while for attribution, applications have diverse requirements, but systems provide limited support. Existing tools mitigate the former limitation through event multiplexing, but this approach introduces non-trivial errors. The latter limitation, however, remains largely unaddressed.This paper introduces Tintin, an HPC profiling infrastructure with a modular three-component design that addresses both challenges. Tintin introduces mechanisms to mitigate multiplexing errors by characterizing uncertainty at runtime, scheduling events to minimize it, and reporting uncertainty to applications. It also proposes the Event Profiling Context (ePX) as a new OS primitive to unify diverse profiling requirements. Tintin is evaluated using benchmarks as well as real-world resource orchestration, performance debugging, and intrusion detection systems, to demonstrate its ability to improve hardware profiling with low runtime overhead.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 硬件性能计数器（HPC）能够测量微架构事件，这对于跟踪和预测程序行为至关重要。高保真测量和精确归因是准确剖析的关键。然而，现有剖析工具在测量和归因两方面都面临根本性挑战。测量方面，众多事件竞争有限的硬件监控资源；归因方面，应用具有多样化的需求，但系统所提供的支持有限。现有工具通过事件多路复用来缓解前一种局限，但这种方法引入了不小的误差；后者则基本未得到解决。本文介绍了 Tintin——一个具有模块化三组件设计的 HPC 剖析基础设施，旨在同时应对这两个挑战。Tintin 引入了相应机制，通过运行时表征不确定性、调度事件以最小化不确定性，以及向应用报告不确定性来缓解多路复用误差。它还提出了事件剖析上下文（ePX）作为一种新的操作系统原语，以统一多样的剖析需求。Tintin 使用基准测试以及真实世界的资源编排、性能调试和入侵检测系统进行了评估，展示了其能够以较低运行时开销改进硬件剖析的能力。

upstream_only.title: Building bridges: safe interactions with foreign languages through Omniglot
upstream_only.abstract: Memory- and type-safe languages promise to eliminate entire classes of systems vulnerabilities by construction. In practice, though, even clean-slate systems often need to incorporate libraries written in other languages with fewer safety guarantees. Because these interactions threaten the soundness of safe languages, they can reintroduce the exact vulnerabilities that safe languages prevent in the first place.This paper presents Omniglot: the first framework to efficiently uphold safety and soundness of Rust in the presence of unmodified and untrusted foreign libraries. Omniglot facilitates interactions with foreign code by integrating with a memory isolation primitive and validation infrastructure, and avoids expensive operations such as copying or serialization.We implement Omniglot for two systems: we use it to integrate kernel components in a highly-constrained embedded operating system kernel, as well as to interface with conventional Linux userspace libraries. Omniglot performs comparably to approaches that deliver weaker guarantees and significantly better than those with similar safety guarantees.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 内存安全和类型安全的语言承诺从根本上消除整类系统漏洞。然而在实践中，即使是全新设计的系统也常常需要引入用其他安全性保证较少的语言编写的库。由于这些交互威胁到安全语言的可信性（soundness），它们可能重新引入安全语言一开始所防止的那些漏洞。本文提出Omniglot：第一个能够在存在未修改且不可信的外部库的情况下高效维护Rust安全性和可信性的框架。Omniglot通过集成内存隔离原语和验证基础设施来促进与外部代码的交互，并避免了复制或序列化等昂贵操作。我们为两个系统实现了Omniglot：一个用于在高度受限的嵌入式操作系统内核中集成内核组件，另一个用于与常规Linux用户空间库进行接口交互。Omniglot的性能可与提供较弱保证的方法相媲美，并且明显优于提供类似安全保证的方法。

upstream_only.title: KRR: efficient and scalable kernel record replay
upstream_only.abstract: Modern kernels are large, complex, and plagued with bugs. Unfortunately, their large size and complexity make kernel failures very challenging for developers to diagnose since failures encountered in deployment are often notoriously difficult to reproduce. Although record-replay techniques provide the powerful ability to accurately record a failed execution and deterministically replay it, enabling advanced manual and automated analysis techniques, they are inefficient and do not scale with modern I/O-intensive, concurrent workloads.This paper introduces KRR, a kernel record-replay framework that provides a highly efficient execution recording mechanism by narrowing the scope of the record and replay boundary to the kernel. Unlike previous record-replay wholestack approaches, KRR adopts a split-recorder design that employs the guest and the host to jointly record the kernel execution. Our evaluation demonstrates that KRR scales efficiently up to 8 cores, across a range of different workloads, including kernel compilation, RocksDB, and Nginx. When recording 8-core VMs that run RocksDB and kernel compilation, KRR incurs only a 1.52\texttimes{} ∼ 2.79\texttimes{} slowdown compared to native execution, while traditional whole-VM RR suffers from 8.97\texttimes{} ∼ 29.94\texttimes{} slowdown. We validate that KRR is practical and has a broad recording scope by reproducing 17 bugs across different Linux versions, including 6 non-deterministic bugs and 5 high-risk CVEs; KRR was able to record and reproduce all but one non-deterministic bug.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代内核庞大、复杂且充满漏洞。不幸的是，其规模和复杂性使得内核故障对开发者来说极具挑战性，因为部署中遇到的故障通常难以复现。尽管记录重放技术提供了准确记录失败执行并确定性重放的能力，从而支持高级的人工和自动分析技术，但它们效率低下，无法扩展到现代I/O密集型并发工作负载。本文介绍了KRR，一种内核记录重放框架，通过将记录和重放的边界缩小到内核来提供高效的执行记录机制。与以往的整体栈记录重放方法不同，KRR采用分裂记录器设计，利用客户机和主机共同记录内核执行。我们的评估表明，在内核编译、RocksDB和Nginx等一系列不同工作负载下，KRR能够高效扩展到8核。在记录运行RocksDB和内核编译的8核虚拟机时，KRR仅产生1.52倍至2.79倍于原生执行的减速，而传统的整虚拟机RR则遭受8.97倍至29.94倍的减速。通过复现不同Linux版本中的17个bug（包括6个非确定性bug和5个高危CVE），我们验证了KRR的实用性和广泛的记录范围。除一个非确定性bug外，KRR成功记录并复现了其余所有bug。

upstream_only.title: Deterministic client: enforcing determinism on untrusted machine code
upstream_only.abstract: This paper presents Deterministic Client (DeCl), a software-based sandboxing system for enforcing deterministic behavior on untrusted machine code, either x86-64 or Arm64. DeCl adapts techniques from Software Fault Isolation (SFI) traditionally used to guarantee memory isolation to instead enforce the stronger property of determinism. By using a simple and efficient machine code verifier that can guarantee that a program behaves deterministically, DeCl does not rely on a trusted compiler/interpreter for correctness. This allows the use of LLVM without compromising the size of the trusted code base. We also describe how to implement two efficient metering mechanisms that enforce deterministic preemption of sandboxed programs, and how DeCl can be implemented in combination with traditional software-based isolation, by making the sandboxed code position-oblivious. DeCl is able to combine and improve upon the benefits of both interpreters and JIT compilers at once, with low CPU overhead, fast startup time, and strong security via a small trusted code base. We evaluate DeCl's effectiveness on general-purpose CPU benchmarks, as well as in an application-specific context by integrating with the Groundhog smart contract engine, and using DeCl for zero-knowledge-proof verification.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了确定性客户端（Deterministic Client, DeCl），一种基于软件的沙箱系统，用于在不信任的机器代码（x86-64或Arm64）上强制确定性行为。DeCl改编了传统上用于保证内存隔离的软件故障隔离（SFI）技术，转而强制实现更强的确定性属性。通过使用一种简单高效的机器代码验证器来保证程序行为是确定性的，DeCl在正确性上不依赖受信任的编译器或解释器。这使得在不损害可信计算基规模的前提下可以使用LLVM。我们还描述了如何实现两种高效的计量机制来强制沙箱程序的确定性抢占，以及如何通过使沙箱代码位置无关来将DeCl与传统基于软件的隔离相结合。DeCl能够同时结合并改进解释器和JIT编译器的优势，具有低CPU开销、快速启动时间和通过小型可信计算基实现的强安全性。我们在通用CPU基准测试上评估了DeCl的有效性，并通过与Groundhog智能合约引擎集成以及使用DeCl进行零知识证明验证来评估其在特定应用场景中的效果。

upstream_only.title: Disentangling the dual role of NIC receive rings
upstream_only.abstract: CPUs parallelize packet processing across cores via per-core receive (Rx) rings, which are typically sized to absorb bursts with ≥1Ki entries by default. The combined I/O working set (packet buffers pointed to by all Rx rings) easily exceeds the LLC capacity, thus degrading performance due to high memory bandwidth pressure. Recent work has reduced the I/O working set size by sharing Rx rings among cores with the "shRing" system. But this approach suffers from a bottleneck under imbalanced loads, which are common.We contend that the bottleneck stems from an unnecessary entanglement of two orthogonal producer-consumer structures: (1) memory allocation, where the core produces empty buffers that the NIC consumes to store packets; and (2) packet delivery, where the NIC produces incoming packets that the core consumes. We propose rxBisect, a new CPU-NIC interface that decouples these structures. RxBisect replaces each Rx ring with two separate rings corresponding to the two structures, allowing memory allocation to be performed independently of packet reception. RxBisect can thus pass empty buffers efficiently between cores upon imbalance, thereby eliminating the aforementioned bottleneck. We implement rxBisect with software emulation and find that it improves throughput by up to 20\% and 37\% relative to the state-of-the-art (shRing) and state-of-the-practice (per-core Rx rings).
upstream_only.abstract_zh: CPU通过每核接收（Rx）环路并行处理数据包，这些环路通常默认配置为能够吸收包含≥1K条目的突发流量。组合的I/O工作集（所有Rx环路指向的数据包缓冲区）很容易超过LLC容量，从而由于高内存带宽压力而降低性能。近期工作通过'共享环路'（shRing）系统在核心间共享Rx环路来减小I/O工作集大小，但这种方法在常见的不平衡负载下会遭遇瓶颈。我们认为，该瓶颈源于两个正交的生产者-消费者结构的不必要纠缠：（1）内存分配，其中核心产生空闲缓冲区供NIC消费以存储数据包；（2）数据包交付，其中NIC产生传入数据包供核心消费。我们提出了rxBisect，一种新的CPU-NIC接口，用于解耦这些结构。rxBisect将每个Rx环路替换为对应两个结构的两个独立环路，使得内存分配能够独立于数据包接收进行。这样，rxBisect可以在不平衡时将空闲缓冲区高效地在核心间传递，从而消除上述瓶颈。我们通过软件模拟实现了rxBisect，并发现相对于当前最优方法（shRing）和当前实践常态（每核Rx环路），其吞吐量分别提升了最高20%和37%。

upstream_only.title: XSched: preemptive scheduling for diverse XPUs
upstream_only.abstract: XPUs, such as GPUs, NPUs, ASICs, and FPGAs, lack flexible scheduling capabilities, failing to meet rich application requirements (e.g., priority and fairness) in multitasking environments. This paper presents XSched, a scheduling framework that enables preemptive scheduling on diverse XPUs with flexible policies. XSched provides unified interfaces for scheduling XPU tasks through a preemptible command queue abstraction (XQueue). The key challenge in implementing the abstraction is adapting to XPUs with diverse and evolving hardware capabilities and software stacks. XSched proposes a multi-level hardware model that enables mature, advanced XPUs to achieve optimal scheduling performance while maintaining compatibility with emerging, wimpy XPUs. To demonstrate the generalizability of XSched, we adapted it to ten XPUs of different types, brands, and generations across seven software platforms and implemented two hardware-agnostic scheduling policies. We further evaluated XSched through three case studies of multitasking workloads on XPUs. XSched effectively achieves various scheduling objectives using its efficient and flexible preemption mechanisms.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: XPU（如GPU、NPU、ASIC和FPGA）缺乏灵活的调度能力，无法满足多任务环境中丰富的应用需求（如优先级和公平性）。本文提出了XSched，一个调度框架，能够通过灵活的策略在多样化的XPU上实现抢占式调度。XSched通过可抢占的命令队列抽象（XQueue）为XPU任务调度提供统一接口。实现该抽象的关键挑战在于适应具有多样化且不断发展的硬件功能和软件栈的XPU。XSched提出了一种多级硬件模型，使成熟且先进的XPU能够实现最优调度性能，同时保持对新兴且功能较弱的XPU的兼容性。为证明XSched的通用性，我们将其适配到涵盖七个软件平台的十种不同类型、品牌和代际的XPU上，并实现了两种与硬件无关的调度策略。我们通过三个在XPU上的多任务负载案例研究对XSched进行了进一步评估。XSched利用其高效灵活的抢占机制有效实现了多种调度目标。

upstream_only.title: OS rendering service made parallel with out-of-order execution and in-order commit
upstream_only.abstract: Rendering service is an indispensable OS service on smart-device OSes like Android, iOS and OpenHarmony. However, the recent shift towards highly scalable display scenarios, such as foldable and multiple screens, has notably amplified the rendering workload, leading to low frame rates that degrade user experience. Yet, rendering services predominantly follow a sequential model, which is notoriously hard to parallelize due to the complex state dependency, drawing order dependency, and interface dependency.This paper observes that a significant portion of the rendering procedure is potentially parallelizable through proper state pre-untangling and drawing order post-preserving. To this end, this paper introduces Spars, a scalable parallelized OS rendering service inspired by the out-of-order execution with in-order commit in computer architecture. Spars revolutionizes the rendering procedure by initially generating self-contained rendering tasks through in-order preparation, executing such tasks in an out-of-order manner to maximize multi-core parallelism, and subsequently committing the tasks in-order to enforce drawing order dependencies. Evaluation results on state-of-the-art single-screen, dual-fold, and trifold smartphones (Mate 70, X5, XT) as well as one-chip-multiple-screen configurations show an average frame rate improvement of 1.76\texttimes{}-1.91\texttimes{}. Moreover, Spars is able to decrease the device power consumption by 3.0\% or increase the budget of graphics primitives by 2.31\texttimes{} for more appealing visual effects with the same stable frame rate.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 渲染服务是Android、iOS和OpenHarmony等智能设备操作系统中不可或缺的OS服务。然而，近年来向高度可扩展显示场景（如可折叠屏和多屏）的转变显著增加了渲染工作负载，导致帧率降低，用户体验下降。然而，渲染服务主要遵循顺序模型，由于复杂的状态依赖、绘制顺序依赖和接口依赖，该模型众所周知难以并行化。本文观察到，渲染过程的很大一部分通过适当的状态预解缠和绘制顺序后保留是可能并行的。为此，本文介绍了Spars，一种受计算机体系结构中乱序执行和顺序提交启发的可扩展并行OS渲染服务。Spars革新了渲染过程：首先通过有序准备生成自包含的渲染任务，以乱序方式执行这些任务以最大化多核并行性，随后按顺序提交任务以强制执行绘制顺序依赖。在最新一代单屏、双折叠和三折叠智能手机（Mate 70、X5、XT）以及一芯多屏配置上的评估结果显示，平均帧率提高了1.76倍至1.91倍。此外，Spars能够将设备功耗降低3.0%，或在保持相同稳定帧率的情况下将图元预算增加2.31倍，以实现更吸引人的视觉效果。

upstream_only.title: EMT: an OS framework for new memory translation architectures
upstream_only.abstract: With terabyte-scale memory capacity and memory-intensive workloads, memory translation has become a major performance bottleneck. Many novel hardware schemes are developed to speed up memory translation, but few are experimented with commodity OSes. A main reason is that memory management in major OSes, like Linux, does not have the extensibility to empower emerging hardware schemes.We develop EMT, a pragmatic framework atop Linux to empower different hardware schemes of memory translation such as radix tree and hash table. EMT provides an architecture-neutral interface that 1) supports diverse memory translation architectures, 2) enables hardware-specific optimizations, 3) accommodates modern hardware and OS complexity, and 4) has negligible overhead over hardwired implementations. We port Linux's memory management onto EMT and show that EMT enables extensibility without sacrificing performance. We use EMT to implement OS support for ECPT and FPT, two recent experimental translation schemes for fast translation; EMT enables us to understand the OS perspective of these architectures and further optimize their designs.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 随着TB级内存容量和内存密集型工作负载的出现，内存转换已成为主要的性能瓶颈。许多新型硬件方案被提出以加速内存转换，但很少在商用操作系统上得到实验验证。一个主要原因是主流操作系统（如Linux）中的内存管理缺乏可扩展性，无法赋能新兴硬件方案。我们开发了EMT，一个基于Linux的实用框架，用以支持不同的内存转换硬件方案（如基数树和哈希表）。EMT提供了一种与架构无关的接口，能够：1）支持多样化的内存转换架构；2）实现硬件特定优化；3）适应现代硬件和操作系统的复杂性；4）相比硬接线实现具有可忽略的开销。我们将Linux的内存管理移植到EMT上，并证明EMT能够在不牺牲性能的情况下实现可扩展性。我们使用EMT为ECPT和FPT这两个近期用于快速内存转换的实验性方案提供操作系统支持；EMT使我们能够从操作系统视角理解这些架构，并进一步优化其设计。

upstream_only.title: Tiered memory management beyond hotness
upstream_only.abstract: Tiered memory systems often rely on access frequency ("hotness") to guide data placement. However, hot data is not always performance-critical, limiting the effectiveness of hotness-based policies. We introduce amortized offcore latency (AOL), a novel metric that precisely captures the true performance impact of memory accesses by accounting for memory access latency and memory-level parallelism (MLP). Leveraging AOL, we present two powerful tiering mechanisms: SOAR, a profile-guided allocation policy that places objects based on their performance contribution, and ALTO, a lightweight page migration regulation policy to eliminate unnecessary migrations. SOAR and ALTO outperform four state-of-the-art tiering designs across a diverse set of workloads by up to 12.4\texttimes{}, while underperforming in a few cases by no more than 3\%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 分层内存系统通常依赖访问频率（“热度”）来指导数据放置。然而，热数据并不总是性能关键的，这限制了基于热度的策略的有效性。我们引入了摊销非核心延迟（AOL），这是一种新的度量指标，通过考虑内存访问延迟和内存级并行性（MLP）来精确捕获内存访问的真实性能影响。利用AOL，我们提出了两种强大的分层机制：SOAR，一种基于配置文件指导的分配策略，根据对象的性能贡献进行放置；以及ALTO，一种轻量级的页面迁移调节策略，以消除不必要的迁移。SOAR和ALTO在多种工作负载上比四种最先进的分层设计性能提升高达12.4倍，而在少数情况下性能下降不超过3%。

upstream_only.title: NanoFlow: towards optimal large language model serving throughput
upstream_only.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have resulted in a surging demand for planet-scale serving systems, where tens of thousands of GPUs continuously serve hundreds of millions of users. Consequently, throughput has emerged as a key metric that determines serving systems' performance. Due to large model sizes and memory-intensive self-attention, LLM serving has been commonly assumed to be memory-bound. Through a detailed analysis, we show that despite having memory-intensive components, end-to-end LLM serving is compute bound for most common workloads and LLMs. Alas, most existing serving engines fall short from optimal compute utilization, because the heterogeneous operations that comprise LLM serving--compute, memory, networking--are executed sequentially within a device.We propose NanoFlow, a novel serving framework that exploits intra-device parallelism, which overlaps the usage of heterogeneous resources within a single device. NanoFlow splits inputs into smaller nano-batches and duplicates operations to operate on each portion independently, enabling overlapping. NanoFlow automatically identifies the number, size, ordering, and GPU resource allocation of nano-batches to minimize the execution time, while considering the interference of concurrent operations. We evaluate NanoFlow's end-to-end serving throughput on several popular models such as LLaMA-2-70B, Mixtral 8\texttimes{}7B, LLaMA-3-8B, etc. With practical workloads, NanoFlow provides 1.91\texttimes{} throughput boost compared to state-of-the-art serving systems, achieving between 50\% to 72\% of optimal throughput across popular models.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）引发了对全球规模服务系统的巨大需求，在这些系统中，数万个GPU持续为数亿用户提供服务。因此，吞吐量已成为决定服务系统性能的关键指标。由于模型规模庞大且自注意力机制对内存需求高，LLM服务通常被认为受内存限制。通过详细分析，我们表明尽管存在内存密集型组件，端到端LLM服务在大多数常见工作负载和LLM下实际上是计算受限的。然而，大多数现有服务引擎远未达到最佳计算利用率，因为LLM服务包含的异构操作——计算、内存、网络——在设备内是顺序执行的。我们提出了NanoFlow，一种利用设备内并行性的新型服务框架，它在单个设备内重叠使用异构资源。NanoFlow将输入拆分为更小的纳米批次，并复制操作以独立处理每个部分，从而实现重叠。NanoFlow自动确定纳米批次的数量、大小、顺序和GPU资源分配，以最小化执行时间，同时考虑并发操作的干扰。我们在几个流行模型上评估了NanoFlow的端到端服务吞吐量，如LLaMA-2-70B、Mixtral 8×7B、LLaMA-3-8B等。在实际工作负载下，与最先进的服务系统相比，NanoFlow提供了1.91倍的吞吐量提升，在流行模型上实现了最优吞吐量的50%至72%。

upstream_only.title: PipeThreader: software-defined pipelining for efficient DNN execution
upstream_only.abstract: To effectively utilize heterogeneous specialized hardware units in modern GPUs, such as TensorCores and Tensor Memory Accelerators, this paper introduces PipeThreader, a new DNN compiler. PipeThreader proposes shifting scheduling functionality from hardware to software so as to enable more efficient and sophisticated computation pipelining with minimal manual effort. This is achieved through sTask-graph, a new DNN computation abstraction, a hierarchical hardware abstraction that captures the capabilities of specialized units, and new scheduling primitives. As a result, PipeThreader can discover efficient pipeline scheduling for well-studied DNN architectures like FlashAttention, achieving comparable or even superior performance. Additionally, it can uncover novel pipeline schemes for emerging models like Mamba2, delivering significantly better performance compared to state-of-the-art hand-crafted implementations. The code is open-sourced at https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 为了有效利用现代GPU中的异构专用硬件单元（如TensorCores和Tensor Memory Accelerators），本文介绍了PipeThreader，一种新的DNN编译器。PipeThreader提出将调度功能从硬件转移到软件，从而以最小的人工努力实现更高效和复杂的计算流水线。这是通过sTask-graph（一种新的DNN计算抽象）、捕获专用单元能力的层次化硬件抽象以及新的调度原语实现的。因此，PipeThreader能够为像FlashAttention这样的经过充分研究的DNN架构发现高效的流水线调度，实现可比甚至更优越的性能。此外，它还能为像Mamba2这样的新兴模型发现新颖的流水线方案，与最先进的手工实现相比提供显著更好的性能。代码已在https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang开源。

upstream_only.title: WLB-LLM: workload-balanced 4D parallelism for large language model training
upstream_only.abstract: In this work, we present WLB-LLM, a WorkLoad-Balanced 4D Parallelism for Large Language Model Training. We first thoroughly analyze the workload imbalance issue in LLM training and identify two primary sources of imbalance at the pipeline parallelism and context parallelism levels. Then, to address the imbalance issue, at the pipeline parallelism level, WLB-LLM incorporates a workload-aware variable-length document packing method to balance the computation and communication workload across micro-batches. Additionally, at the context parallelism level, WLB-LLM introduces a novel fine-grained per-document sharding strategy, ensuring each worker within a context parallelism group has an identical workload. Comprehensive experiments under different model scales demonstrate that WLB-LLM significantly mitigates the workload imbalance during 4D parallelism LLM training and achieves an average speedup of 1.23\texttimes{} when applying WLBLLM in our internal LLM training framework.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了WLB-LLM，一种用于大语言模型训练的工作负载均衡4D并行方法。我们首先深入分析了LLM训练中的工作负载不均衡问题，并识别出流水线并行和上下文并行层面的两个主要不均衡来源。然后，为解决该不均衡问题，在流水线并行层面，WLB-LLM引入了一种负载感知的可变长度文档打包方法，以平衡各微批次的计算和通信负载。此外，在上下文并行层面，WLB-LLM提出了一种新颖的基于每个文档的细粒度分片策略，确保上下文并行组内的每个工作节点具有相同的工作负载。在不同模型规模下的综合实验表明，WLB-LLM显著缓解了4D并行LLM训练中的工作负载不均衡问题，并在我们内部的LLM训练框架中应用WLB-LLM后实现了平均1.23倍的加速。

upstream_only.title: DecDEC: a systems approach to advancing low-bit LLM quantization
upstream_only.abstract: Quantization of Large Language Models (LLMs) has recently gained popularity, particularly for on-device settings with limited hardware resources. While efficient, quantization inevitably degrades model quality, especially in aggressive lowbit settings such as 3-bit and 4-bit precision. In this paper, we propose DecDEC, an inference scheme that improves the quality of low-bit LLMs while preserving the key benefits of quantization: GPU memory savings and latency reduction. DecDEC stores the residual matrix--the difference between full-precision and quantized weights--in CPU, and dynamically fetches the residuals for only a small portion of the weights. This portion corresponds to the salient channels, marked by activation outliers, with the fetched residuals helping to correct quantization errors in these channels. Salient channels are identified dynamically at each decoding step by analyzing the input activations--this enables adaptation to the dynamic nature of activation distribution, thus maximizing the effectiveness of error compensation. We demonstrate the effectiveness of DecDEC by augmenting state-of-the-art quantization methods. For example, DecDEC reduces the perplexity of a 3-bit Llama-3-8B-Instruct model from 10.15 to 9.12--outperforming its 3.5-bit counterpart--while adding less than 0.0003\% to GPU memory usage and incurring only a 1.7\% inference slowdown on NVIDIA RTX 4050 Mobile.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的量化最近变得流行，特别是在硬件资源有限的自带设备环境中。虽然量化高效，但不可避免地会降低模型质量，尤其是在3位和4位精度等激进的低位设置中。在本文中，我们提出了DecDEC，一种推理方案，可提高低位LLM的质量，同时保持量化的关键优势：GPU内存节省和延迟降低。DecDEC将残差矩阵——全精度与量化权重之间的差异——存储在CPU中，并仅对一小部分权重动态获取残差。这部分对应于以激活异常值为标志的显著通道，获取的残差有助于纠正这些通道中的量化误差。在每个解码步骤中，通过分析输入激活来动态识别显著通道——这能够适应激活分布的动态特性，从而最大化误差补偿的有效性。我们通过增强最先进的量化方法来证明DecDEC的有效性。例如，DecDEC将3位Llama-3-8B-Instruct模型的困惑度从10.15降低到9.12，超过了其3.5位对应版本，同时增加不到0.0003%的GPU内存使用，并在NVIDIA RTX 4050 Mobile上仅引起1.7%的推理减速。

upstream_only.title: Stripeless data placement for erasure-coded in-memory storage
upstream_only.abstract: Erasure coding plays a crucial role in distributed storage systems to provide fault tolerance at a low storage cost. Conventional erasure coding schemes determine data placement based on stripes. However, placing data into stripes can incur non-negligible performance overheads that will manifest in emerging fast in-memory storage systems, making conventional erasure coding schemes suboptimal in such scenarios.Aiming to eliminate such overheads, we present Nos, a stripeless placement scheme for erasure-coded in-memory storage. It lets each node independently replicate data to other nodes and encode received data replicas into parities with XOR. Thus, it avoids the overheads caused by stripes. To enable failure recovery, Nos uses a combinatoric structure called symmetric balanced incomplete block design (SBIBD) to decide primary-to-backup node affinities during replication. Atop Nos, we further build Nostor, a distributed in-memory key-value store. Evaluations demonstrate that Nostor achieves 1.61\texttimes{} to 2.60\texttimes{} throughputs with similar or lower latencies than stripe-based erasure coding baselines.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 纠删码在分布式存储系统中发挥着关键作用，以较低的存储成本提供容错能力。传统的纠删码方案基于条带来确定数据放置。然而，将数据放入条带会产生不可忽略的性能开销，这在新兴的快速内存存储系统中会显现出来，使得传统纠删码方案在这种场景下不是最优的。为了消除这些开销，我们提出了Nos，一种用于纠删码内存存储的无条带放置方案。它让每个节点独立地将数据复制到其他节点，并用XOR将接收到的数据副本编码为奇偶校验。因此，它避免了由条带引起的开销。为了支持故障恢复，Nos使用一种称为对称平衡不完全区组设计（SBIBD）的组合结构来决定复制期间主节点到备份节点的亲和性。在Nos之上，我们进一步构建了Nostor，一个分布式内存键值存储系统。评估表明，与基于条带的纠删码基线相比，Nostor实现了1.61倍至2.60倍的吞吐量，且延迟相似或更低。

upstream_only.title: PoWER never corrupts: tool-agnostic verification of crash consistency and corruption detection
upstream_only.abstract: Storage systems must maintain integrity even after rare and difficult-to-test-for conditions like power losses and media errors. Formal verification presents a promising avenue to ensure storage systems are resilient, but current approaches involve significant complexity and rely on verification constructs or forms of logic beyond what most verifiers natively support. In this paper, we present two new verification techniques that rely only on standard constructs provided by most verification tools such as Hoare logic, ghost variables, and quantifiers. First, we introduce PoWER (Preconditions on Writes Enforcing Recoverability), a novel approach to verifying crash consistency that encodes its requirements in the preconditions of storage API methods. Second, we present a new model of media corruption for provable corruption detection on any type of storage device. To demonstrate the power of these new techniques, we use them to build two verified storage systems using two different verification frameworks. We build and verify the key-value (KV) store CAPYBARAKV using Verus and the notary server CAPYBARANS using Dafny. Both systems are built for persistent memory (PM), which we target due to new challenges it presents to building resilient storage systems. We develop new techniques to address these challenges, including the corruption-detecting Boolean, a new primitive for atomic checksum updates. Both systems verify in under a minute, and CAPYBARAKV achieves performance competitive with similar unverified PM KV stores.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 存储系统即使在诸如电源故障和介质错误等罕见且难以测试的条件下也必须保持完整性。形式化验证为确保存储系统的韧性提供了一条有前景的途径，但当前的方法涉及显著的复杂性，并且依赖于大多数验证器原生不支持的特殊验证构造或逻辑形式。在本文中，我们提出了两种新技术，仅依赖于大多数验证工具提供的标准构造，如Hoare逻辑、幽灵变量和量词。首先，我们引入PoWER（强力写入前置条件以强制执行可恢复性），这是一种新颖的崩溃一致性验证方法，将其需求编码在存储API方法的前置条件中。其次，我们提出了一种新的介质损坏模型，以在任何类型的存储设备上进行可证明的损坏检测。为了展示这些新技术的能力，我们使用它们构建了两个经过验证的存储系统，并采用了两个不同的验证框架。我们使用Verus验证了键值存储CAPYBARAKV，并使用Dafny验证了公证服务器CAPYBARANS。这两个系统均为持久内存而构建，我们选择该目标是因为它在构建有韧性的存储系统时带来了新的挑战。我们开发了新技术来应对这些挑战，包括损坏检测布尔值——一种用于原子校验和更新的新原语。两个系统均在一分钟内完成验证，而CAPYBARAKV的性能与类似的未经验证的持久内存键值存储相当。

upstream_only.title: Fast and synchronous crash consistency with metadata write-once file system
upstream_only.abstract: Low-latency persistent memory (PM) encourages file systems to pursue synchronous crash consistency. However, existing crash consistency approaches, such as journaling and log structure file system, incur many small, random, and ordered metadata I/Os, failing to exploit PM I/O potential. We propose a new file system model called metadata write-once file system (WOFS) to achieve fast and synchronous crash consistency. The key idea is to generate specific metadata for each file operation as a checksum-protected package and write it once with a single ordering point. The package is then managed to provide file abstractions through a package translation layer without extra writes. Using an array of techniques to generate, organize, and recover from packages, WOFS can provide practical, efficient, and reliable file system services. We implement WOLVES as a WOFS prototype in Linux kernel. Experiments using benchmarks and applications suggest that WOLVES can recover from crashes, improve operation throughput, and potentially reach PM I/O bandwidth limits.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 低延迟持久内存（PM）促使文件系统追求同步崩溃一致性。然而，现有的崩溃一致性方法（如日志和日志结构文件系统）会产生大量小型、随机的有序元数据I/O，无法发挥PM的I/O潜力。我们提出了一种名为元数据一次写入文件系统（WOFS）的新文件系统模型，以实现快速同步的崩溃一致性。其关键思想是为每个文件操作生成特定的元数据，作为受校验和保护的数据包，并通过单个排序点一次性写入。随后，该数据包通过一个包翻译层被管理以提供文件抽象，而无需额外写入。利用一系列生成、组织和从数据包中恢复的技术，WOFS可以提供实用、高效且可靠的文件系统服务。我们在Linux内核中实现了WOLVES作为WOFS原型。使用基准测试和应用程序的实验表明，WOLVES可以从崩溃中恢复，提高操作吞吐量，并可能达到PM I/O带宽极限。

upstream_only.title: Decentralized, epoch-based F2FS journaling with fine-grained crash recovery
upstream_only.abstract: F2FS, a log-structured filesystem, has gained widespread adoption in Android systems. However, F2FS relies on coarse-grained checkpointing for crash recovery. When triggered, this mechanism significantly degrades system performance by blocking file writes. Additionally, F2FS's checkpointing approach may not fully recover file data and metadata to a consistent state after a crash. Given these limitations, it is crucial to design a new journaling mechanism for F2FS that provides fine-grained crash recovery. While journaling methods are well-studied for in-place-update filesystems (such as JBD2 for EXT4), directly applying these state-of-the-art techniques to F2FS - an out-of-place-update filesystem - does not yield similar benefits.In this paper, we propose a novel journaling technique, called F2FSJ, for F2FS with ordered journal mode. Catering to the out-of-place update features of F2FS, F2FSJ incorporate several innovative designs. First, in F2FSJ, only metadata changes are journaled and committed after data flushing, by which I/O and storage overheads can be mitigated. Second, we propose a decentralized journal design by embedding journal logs into inodes, which significantly reduces lock contention and interference when recording metadata changes. Third, we propose an epoch-based approach with a novel data/controlplane decoupling mechanism, which eliminates waiting times during journal period transfers. Finally, for journal apply, we propose a fast-forward-to-latest approach to consolidate multiple small updates into one update for reducing small writes. We have implemented a fully functional prototype of F2FSJ and conducted extensive experiments. Our experimental results demonstrate that F2FSJ can effectively reduce the checkpointing time by up to 4.9x and reduce the latency by up to 35\% compared with F2FS. F2FSJ is open-sourced for public access.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: F2FS作为一种日志结构化文件系统，已在Android系统中得到广泛应用。然而，F2FS依赖粗粒度的检查点机制进行崩溃恢复。该机制被触发时会阻塞文件写入，从而显著降低系统性能。此外，F2FS的检查点方法在崩溃后可能无法将文件数据和元数据完全恢复至一致状态。鉴于这些限制，为F2FS设计一种提供细粒度崩溃恢复的新日志机制至关重要。尽管针对原地更新文件系统（如EXT4的JBD2）的日志方法已有深入研究，但将这些先进技术直接应用于F2FS——一种非原地更新文件系统——并不能带来类似的收益。在本文中，我们为F2FS提出了一种新的日志技术F2FSJ，采用顺序日志模式。针对F2FS非原地更新的特性，F2FSJ融入了多项创新设计。首先，F2FSJ仅记录元数据变更并在数据刷新后提交，从而减轻I/O和存储开销。其次，我们提出了一种去中心化日志设计，通过将日志嵌入inode，显著减少了记录元数据变更时的锁竞争和干扰。第三，我们提出了一种基于时代的方法，并引入新颖的数据/控制平面解耦机制，消除了时代切换期间的等待时间。最后，对于日志应用，我们提出了一种快速前滚至最新状态的方法，将多个小更新合并为一次更新以减少小写操作。我们已实现F2FSJ的完整功能原型并进行了大量实验。实验结果表明，与F2FS相比，F2FSJ能有效将检查点时间最多减少4.9倍，并将延迟最多降低35%。F2FSJ已开源供公众使用。

upstream_only.title: Okapi: decoupling data striping and redundancy grouping in cluster file systems
upstream_only.abstract: The Okapi cluster file system decouples how data is spread across disks (data striping) for IO efficiency from how data is erasure coded together (redundancy grouping) for durability. Existing systems couple these two mechanisms' configurations, inducing significant inefficiencies. Decoupling allows grouping to be configured based on reliability and space efficiency goals, while simultaneously allowing striping to be configured based on performance goals. Decoupling also allows redundancy scheme changes from one EC scheme to another (e.g., to react to data temperature or disk failure rate changes) to occur without having to re-write data. Evaluation of an Okapi prototype shows that decoupling can be accomplished with <1\% increase in metadata size and file manager memory, and minimal file creation and degraded read resource increase. Experiments demonstrate that decoupling can improve read throughput by 80\% and reduce seeks per second by up to 70\%, without yielding any data reliability, and reduce the overhead of redundancy transitions by up to 70\%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Okapi集群文件系统将数据在磁盘上的分布方式（数据条带化，以提高IO效率）与数据一起进行纠删码编码的方式（冗余分组，以实现持久性）解耦。现有系统将这两种机制的配置耦合在一起，导致显著的效率低下。解耦允许根据可靠性和空间效率目标来配置分组，同时允许根据性能目标来配置条带化。解耦还允许冗余方案从一种纠删码方案更改为另一种（例如，为了响应数据温度或磁盘故障率的变化），而无需重写数据。对Okapi原型的评估表明，解耦可以实现元数据大小和文件管理器内存增加不足1%，文件创建和降级读资源增加最小。实验表明，解耦可以将读吞吐量提高80%，并将每秒寻道次数减少最多70%，而不会牺牲任何数据可靠性，并且可以将冗余转换的开销减少最多70%。

upstream_only.title: Compass: encrypted semantic search with high accuracy
upstream_only.abstract: We present Compass, a semantic search system for encrypted data that achieves high accuracy, matching state-of-the-art plaintext search quality, while ensuring the privacy of data, queries, and results, even if the server is compromised. Compass contributes a novel way to traverse a state-of-the-art graph-based semantic search index and a white-box co-design with Oblivious RAM, a cryptographic primitive that hides access patterns, to enable efficient search over encrypted embeddings. With our techniques, Directional Neighbor Filtering, Speculative Neighbor Prefetch, and Graph-Traversal Tailored ORAM, Compass achieves user-perceived latencies within or around a second and is orders of magnitude faster than baselines under various network conditions.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了Compass，一个针对加密数据的语义搜索系统，实现了与最先进明文搜索相当的高精度，同时即使在服务器被攻破的情况下也能保证数据、查询和结果的隐私。Compass提出了一种新颖的方式，遍历最先进的基于图的语义搜索索引，并与Oblivious RAM（一种隐藏访问模式的密码学原语）进行白盒协同设计，以支持对加密嵌入的高效搜索。借助我们的定向邻居过滤、推测性邻居预取和图遍历定制ORAM技术，Compass实现了约1秒以内或1秒左右的用户感知延迟，并在各种网络条件下比基线方法快数个数量级。

upstream_only.title: Weave: efficient and expressive oblivious analytics at scale
upstream_only.abstract: Many distributed analytics applications offloaded to the cloud operate on sensitive data. Even when the computations for such analytics workloads are confined to trusted hardware enclaves, and all stored data and network communications are encrypted, several studies have shown that they are still vulnerable to access pattern attacks. Prior efforts to prevent access pattern leakage often incur network and compute overheads that are logarithmic in dataset size while also limiting the functionality of supported analytics jobs.We present Weave, an efficient, expressive, and secure analytics platform that scales to large datasets. Weave employs a combination of noise injection and hardware memory isolation to reduce the network and compute overheads for oblivious analytics to a constant factor. Weave also employs several optimizations and extensions that exploit dataset and workload-specific properties to ensure performance at scale without compromising functionality. Weave reduces the end-to-end execution time for a wide range of analytics jobs on large real-world datasets by 4-10\texttimes{} compared to prior state-of-the-art while providing strong obliviousness guarantees.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 许多卸载到云端的分布式分析应用程序处理敏感数据。即使此类分析工作负载的计算被限制在可信硬件飞地内，并且所有存储的数据和网络通信都经过加密，多项研究表明它们仍容易受到访问模式攻击。先前防止访问模式泄漏的努力通常在网络和计算开销上以数据集大小的对数为量级，同时也限制了所支持分析工作的功能。我们提出了Weave，一个高效、富有表现力且安全的分析平台，可扩展到大型数据集。Weave结合噪声注入和硬件内存隔离，将不经意分析的网络和计算开销降低到常数因子。Weave还采用了一些利用数据集和工作负载特定属性的优化和扩展，以确保在大规模下不牺牲功能的性能。与现有最先进技术相比，Weave在大型真实世界数据集上的各类分析工作的端到端执行时间减少了4-10倍，同时提供了强不经意性保证。

upstream_only.title: Paralegal: practical static analysis for privacy bugs
upstream_only.abstract: Finding privacy bugs in software today usually requires onerous manual audits. Code analysis tools could help, but existing tools aren't sufficiently practical and ergonomic to be used.Paralegal is a static analysis tool to find privacy bugs in Rust programs. Key to Paralegal's practicality is its distribution of work between the program analyzer, privacy engineers, and application developers. Privacy engineers express a high-level privacy policy over markers, which application developers then apply to source code entities. Paralegal extracts a Program Dependence Graph (PDG) from the program, leveraging Rust's ownership type system to model the behavior of library code. Paralegal augments the PDG with the developers' markers and checks privacy policies against the marked PDG.In an evaluation on eight real-world applications, Paralegal found real privacy bugs, including two previously unknown ones. Paralegal supports a broader range of policies than information flow control (IFC) and CodeQL, a widely-used code analysis engine. Paralegal is fast enough to deploy interactively, and its markers are easy to maintain as code evolves.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 如今发现软件中的隐私缺陷通常需要繁重的人工审计。代码分析工具可以提供帮助，但现有工具还不够实用和人性化。Paralegal是一个用于在Rust程序中查找隐私缺陷的静态分析工具。Paralegal实用性的关键在于它在程序分析器、隐私工程师和应用程序开发人员之间分配工作。隐私工程师在标记上表达高层隐私策略，应用程序开发人员随后将这些标记应用于源代码实体。Paralegal从程序中提取程序依赖图（PDG），利用Rust的所有权类型系统来建模库代码的行为。Paralegal为PDG增加开发人员的标记，并对照标记后的PDG检查隐私策略。在对八个真实应用的评估中，Paralegal发现了真实的隐私缺陷，包括两个此前未知的缺陷。Paralegal支持比信息流控制（IFC）和广泛使用的代码分析引擎CodeQL更广泛的策略。Paralegal的速度足够快，可交互部署，并且其标记在代码演进过程中易于维护。

upstream_only.title: MettEagle: costs and benefits of implementing containers on microkernels
upstream_only.abstract: Today, many applications are hosted by cloud providers. In order to isolate the workloads of different clients, cloud enterprises mostly rely on containers rather than standard processes, since the latter are able to exercise a lot of ambient authority. Containers counter this deficiency by sandboxing processes. To this end, they use dedicated security mechanisms such as seccomp-bpf. However, these mechanisms add complexity to the kernel and increase its attack surface, thus prompting new security challenges.Processes in microkernel-based systems do not have ambient authority. Thus, they do not require additional security mechanisms to build sandboxes. In this paper, we try to answer the question whether a microkernel-based OS architecture enables a leaner and more secure container infrastructure. Based on a CVE analysis, we show that the conceptual simplicity of containers on microkernels results in a better security posture than that typically found on monolithic systems.We furthermore demonstrate the practical feasibility of implementing containers on state-of-the-art microkernels by building MettEagle, a prototype container service running on L4Re. We found that applications running in containers on L4Re expose performance characteristics comparable to that of containers on Linux for both synthetic and real-world benchmarks. In some cases, the container implementation of L4Re even outperforms Linux, accelerating container startup latency and improving network performance.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 如今，许多应用由云提供商托管。为了隔离不同客户端的工作负载，云企业主要依赖容器而非标准进程，因为标准进程能够行使大量环境权限。容器通过沙箱化进程来弥补这一缺陷。为此，它们使用诸如seccomp-bpf等专用安全机制。然而，这些机制增加了内核的复杂性并扩大了其攻击面，从而带来了新的安全挑战。在基于微内核的系统中，进程没有环境权限。因此，它们不需要额外的安全机制来构建沙箱。在本文中，我们试图回答基于微内核的操作系统架构能否实现更精简、更安全的容器基础设施这一问题。基于CVE分析，我们表明微内核上容器的概念简单性使其安全态势优于典型的单体系统。此外，我们通过构建MettEagle（一个运行在L4Re上的原型容器服务）证明了在现代微内核上实现容器的实际可行性。我们发现，在L4Re容器中运行的应用程序，在合成基准和真实世界基准测试中均表现出与Linux容器相当的性能特征。在某些情况下，L4Re的容器实现甚至优于Linux，缩短了容器启动延迟并改善了网络性能。

upstream_only.title: Strata: Hierarchical Context Caching for Long Context Language Model Serving
upstream_only.abstract:
Long-context large language models (LLMs) enable applications that reason over hundreds of thousands to millions of tokens, but serving these workloads efficiently is challenging. Modern systems cache key-value (KV) states and rely on hierarchical context caching across GPU HBM, CPU memory, and SSDs. We show that naïve designs often become I/O-bound: fragmented KV layouts lead to small transfers that underutilize bandwidth, cache loading stalls prefill, and schedulers that ignore cache-loading latency and delay hits (concurrent requests for the same context during a cache miss) suffer severe throughput degradation.
We present Strata, a hierarchical context caching framework for long-context LLM serving. Strata introduces a GPU-assisted I/O mechanism that decouples GPU and host layouts to enable efficient large transfers, and a cache-aware scheduler that mitigates delay hits, balances batches to hide cache-loading latency, and opportunistically overlaps complementary work. Implemented as part of SGLang and deployed in production, Strata improves throughput by up to 5× over vLLM-LMCache and 3.75× over NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, without hurting short-context performance.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 长上下文大语言模型（LLM）催生了能够对数十万至数百万个标记进行推理的应用，但高效服务这些工作负载颇具挑战。现代系统会缓存键值（KV）状态，并依赖于跨GPU HBM、CPU内存和SSD的分层上下文缓存。我们发现，朴素的设计往往容易受到I/O瓶颈的制约：碎片化的KV布局导致小规模传输，使带宽利用不足；缓存加载会阻塞预填充阶段；而忽略缓存加载延迟的调度器会因命中延迟（在缓存未命中期间对相同上下文的并发请求）而遭受严重的吞吐量下降。我们提出了Strata，一个面向长上下文LLM服务的分层上下文缓存框架。Strata引入了GPU辅助的I/O机制，将GPU和主机布局解耦，以实现高效的大规模传输，并采用一个缓存感知调度器，用于缓解命中延迟、平衡批次以隐藏缓存加载延迟，并机会式地重叠互补工作。作为SGLang的一部分实现并部署于生产环境，Strata在吞吐量上最高比vLLM-LMCache提升5倍，比NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM提升3.75倍，且不影响短上下文性能。

upstream_only.title: ECHO: Efficient KV Cache Offloading with Lossless Prefetching for Serving Native Sparse Attention LLMs
upstream_only.abstract: Native sparse attention has emerged as a promising approach for efficient long-context LLM inference without compromising accuracy. While it significantly reduces the attention computation and KV cache access costs, the KV cache size exhibits steeper linear growth with the context length. As a result, GPU HBM capacity becomes the bottleneck, limiting the concurrency of long-context requests and leading to poor hardware utilization and low generation throughput. We introduce ECHO, a serving system designed for native sparse-attention LLMs that employs KV cache offloading to overcome GPU HBM capacity limits. ECHO incorporates a graph-friendly cache manager that enables efficient dynamic KV cache eviction and recall entirely within GPU graphs, minimizing management overhead. Furthermore, by exploiting the numerical predictability of index scores and the sequential processing of queries, ECHO enables lossless intra-query prefetching for decoding and inter-query prefetching for prefill. By applying a fully pipelined fused GPU kernel, ECHO overlaps the recall overhead with indexer computation. Experiments show that ECHO delivers up to 2.1× higher generation throughput than state-of-the-art systems such as SGLang and vLLM under long-context workloads, while maintaining comparable latency under light load.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 原生稀疏注意力已成为一种在不损失准确性的前提下实现高效长上下文LLM推理的有前景方法。虽然它显著降低了注意力计算和KV缓存访问成本，但KV缓存大小随上下文长度呈更陡峭的线性增长。因此，GPU HBM容量成为瓶颈，限制了长上下文请求的并发度，导致硬件利用率低下和生成吞吐量较低。我们提出了ECHO，一种专为原生稀疏注意力LLM设计的服务系统，采用KV缓存卸载来突破GPU HBM容量限制。ECHO结合了图友好的缓存管理器，能够在GPU图内高效实现动态KV缓存驱逐和召回，最大程度减少管理开销。此外，通过利用索引分数的数值可预测性和查询的序列化处理，ECHO实现了解码阶段的无损查询内预取和预填充阶段的查询间预取。通过应用完全流水线化的融合GPU内核，ECHO将召回开销与索引器计算重叠。实验表明，在长上下文工作负载下，与SGLang和vLLM等最先进系统相比，ECHO的生成吞吐量最高可提升2.1倍，同时在轻负载下保持相当的延迟。

upstream_only.title: No Buffer, No Bottleneck: Efficient Zero-Copy KV Cache Offloading for Long-Context LLMs
upstream_only.abstract: Long-context large language models (LLMs) store computed attention key and value (KV) matrices from previous decoding steps to avoid full-sequence recomputation. While this reuse reduces computation, the KV cache grows linearly with sequence length, exerting significant pressure on GPU memory capacity. Existing offloading stores KV blocks in CPU memory but requires extra GPU buffers, wasting GPU memory and doubling CPU–GPU transfers, which creates capacity and bandwidth bottlenecks. We present DirectKV, to our knowledge, the first zero-copy KV cache offloading system for modern heterogeneous CPU–GPU platforms such as NVIDIA GH200/GB200 with high-bandwidth NVLink-C2C interconnects. By leveraging NVLink-C2C instead of PCIe, DirectKV makes CPU memory a practical extension of GPU KV-cache capacity during long-context inference. DirectKV eliminates the GPU staging buffer (no buffer) by enabling GPU kernels to directly access CPU-resident KV cache, and substantially reduces the CPU– GPU data-movement bottleneck (no bottleneck) through CPU-memory-aware CUDA kernels tailored for heterogeneous CPU–GPU platforms. It further fuses KV generation with attention computation into a single CUDA kernel and employs warp-level pipelining to overlap KV fetching, computation, and write-back, thereby hiding stalls caused by CPU memory access. On GH200, DirectKV reduces CPU–GPU transfer volume by up to 50%, cuts GPU memory usage by 43%, and improves end-to-end performance by up to 1.2× compared to existing solutions.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 长上下文大语言模型(LLM)存储先前解码步骤中计算得到的注意力键和值(KV)矩阵，以避免全序列重新计算。虽然这种复用减少了计算量，但KV缓存随序列长度线性增长，给GPU内存容量带来了显著压力。现有的卸载方法将KV块存储在CPU内存中，但需要额外的GPU缓冲区，浪费了GPU内存并使CPU-GPU传输加倍，从而造成容量和带宽瓶颈。我们提出了DirectKV，据我们所知，这是首个针对现代异构CPU-GPU平台(如NVIDIA GH200/GB200)上高带宽NVLink-C2C互连的零拷贝KV缓存卸载系统。通过利用NVLink-C2C而非PCIe，DirectKV使CPU内存成为长上下文推理期间GPU KV缓存容量的实用扩展。DirectKV通过让GPU内核直接访问驻留在CPU上的KV缓存，消除了GPU暂存缓冲区(无缓冲)，并通过专为异构CPU-GPU平台定制的CPU内存感知CUDA内核显著减少了CPU-GPU数据移动瓶颈(无瓶颈)。它还将KV生成与注意力计算融合到单个CUDA内核中，并采用warp级流水线来重叠KV获取、计算和写回，从而隐藏CPU内存访问引起的停顿。在GH200上，与现有解决方案相比，DirectKV将CPU-GPU传输量减少了高达50%，将GPU内存使用量减少了43%，并将端到端性能提升了高达1.2倍。

upstream_only.title: Simple Is Better: Multiplication May Be All You Need for LLM Request Scheduling
upstream_only.abstract:
High-quality LLM request scheduling requires meeting two key objectives: ensuring the routed instance has KV$ to accelerate request execution, and ensuring that the workload is balanced across instances. Achieving both objectives is challenging because pursuing one may compromise the other. Current approaches use various combinators (e.g., linear combinations) to compute a scheduling score that combines indicators for the two objectives. These approaches are complex: they either require significant workload-specific hyperparameter tuning or model-hardware-aware simulator development, yet could still lead to suboptimal performance.
In this paper, we show that using a simple multiplication of two carefully chosen indicators—one KV$-aware (new prefill tokens if routed to an instance) and one load-balancing-aware (current batch size of the instance)—as the scheduling score (LMetric) can achieve both objectives simultaneously without any hyperparameter tuning. The key idea is that the simply multiplied score considers both objectives in a manner similar to a linear combination, but the original hyperparameters cancel out during comparison, so no tuning is needed to find the best parameters. The two indicators are chosen based on our analysis of LLM characteristics. Our extensive experiments show that this simple approach can reduce TTFT by 92% and 39%, and TPOT by 24% and 51%, compared to vLLM-v1 and an in-production scheduler on real-world workloads covering chatbots and coding agents. We also derive the mathematical conditions under which multiplication may fail, and find that such conditions are extremely rare in practice and can be detected (and mitigated) beforehand.
LMetric has been deployed in production and canary release confirms its effectiveness.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 高质量的LLM请求调度需要满足两个关键目标：确保路由到的实例有KV缓存以加速请求执行，以及确保工作负载在实例之间平衡。实现这两个目标具有挑战性，因为追求一个目标可能会损害另一个目标。当前方法使用各种组合器（例如线性组合）来计算调度分数，以结合两个目标的指标。这些方法很复杂：它们要么需要大量特定于工作负载的超参数调整，要么需要开发模型-硬件感知的模拟器，但仍可能导致次优性能。在本文中，我们表明使用两个精心选择的指标的简单乘法——一个与KV缓存相关（如果路由到某个实例则产生新的预填充令牌）和一个与负载平衡相关（实例的当前批次大小）——作为调度分数（LMetric），可以同时实现两个目标而无需任何超参数调整。关键思想是，简单相乘的分数类似于线性组合的方式同时考虑两个目标，但原始超参数在比较过程中会抵消，因此无需调整即可找到最佳参数。这两个指标是基于我们对LLM特征的分析选择的。我们的大量实验表明，在覆盖聊天机器人和编码代理的真实工作负载上，与vLLM-v1和实际生产调度器相比，这种简单方法可以分别将TTFT降低92%和39%，将TPOT降低24%和51%。我们还推导了乘法可能失败的数学条件，并发现这些条件在实践中极为罕见，并且可以提前检测（并缓解）。LMetric已部署到生产中，金丝雀发布确认了其有效性。

upstream_only.title: Prism: Cost-Efficient Multi-LLM Serving via GPU Memory Ballooning
upstream_only.abstract: Inference providers must maintain availability for many LLMs, including low-volume but essential models, making resource efficiency increasingly important as token prices fall. Analysis of production traces reveals a dynamic bursty-group pattern in which sets of models become active together and shift over time; existing space- and time-sharing approaches lack principled mechanisms to adapt to this variability, forcing trade-offs between SLO adherence and efficiency. We observe that elastic memory allocation can unify spatial and temporal sharing. Based on this insight, we have developed Prism, a memory-centric LLM co-serving framework that applies memory ballooning to reclaim memory across models and support both forms of sharing under a single scheme. Prism’s balloon driver, referred to as kvcached, has been open-sourced at https://github.com/ovg-project/kvcached, and deployed in production environments across 10K+ GPUs.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 推理提供商必须为许多LLM维持可用性，包括低流量但至关重要的模型，随着token价格下降，资源效率变得越来越重要。对生产轨迹的分析揭示了一种动态突发组模式，其中多组模型同时变为活跃状态并随时间转移；现有的空间和时间共享方法缺乏适应这种可变性的原则性机制，从而在SLO达标与效率之间被迫做出权衡。我们观察到弹性内存分配可以统一空间和时间共享。基于这一洞察，我们开发了Prism，一个以内存为中心的LLM协同服务框架，应用内存气球技术跨模型回收内存，并在单一方案下支持两种共享形式。Prism的气球驱动程序称为kvcached，已在https://github.com/ovg-project/kvcached开源，并部署在10K+ GPU的生产环境中。

upstream_only.title: Break On Through to the Other Side: Pooling Memory Elastically with RamRyder
upstream_only.abstract: Cloud vendors offer diverse infrastructure services by flexibly allocating resources, such as compute, storage, and networking, across virtual machines. However, memory allocation is still less flexible: the vendors allocate memory capacity in a fixed ratio to virtual CPUs and provide no mechanism for allocating memory bandwidth. Recent data show that this can lead to underutilization of both capacity and bandwidth when an application’s demands diverge or change over time. To address these challenges, we propose RamRyder, a software-defined elastic memory system for cloud virtual machines that allows the system to allocate memory bandwidth and capacity (mostly) independently. RamRyder controls the mapping between memory pages in the guest OS and the underlying memory channels, providing performance isolation between virtual machines and allowing dynamic changes to bandwidth and capacity allocation. RamRyder improves average capacity and bandwidth utilization by 28.6% and 43.2%, respectively, across the cluster while delivering performance comparable to the best case with exclusive access.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 云供应商通过跨虚拟机灵活分配计算、存储和网络等资源来提供多样化的基础设施服务。然而，内存分配仍然不够灵活：供应商以固定比例将内存容量分配给虚拟CPU，并且没有提供分配内存带宽的机制。近期数据表明，当应用程序的需求不同或随时间变化时，这可能导致容量和带宽利用率不足。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了RamRyder，一种面向云虚拟机的软件定义弹性内存系统，它允许系统（基本独立地）分配内存带宽和容量。RamRyder控制客户操作系统中内存页与底层内存通道之间的映射，在虚拟机之间提供性能隔离，并允许动态更改带宽和容量分配。RamRyder在集群中的平均容量和带宽利用率分别提高了28.6%和43.2%，同时提供了与独占访问最佳情况相当的性能。

upstream_only.title: MAC: Metadata Acceleration for Sustainable Performance in Big-Data Systems with CXL DRAM
upstream_only.abstract: Compute Express Link (CXL) DRAM has emerged as a promising solution to address the capacity constraints of conventional systems using DDR DRAM. By decoupling memory expansion from the DDR interface generation imposed by the host CPU’s memory controller, CXL DRAM allows cost-effective scaling of system memory capacity. However, as memory capacity grows, memory management metadata can become too large to fit entirely in DDR DRAM, necessitating that part or all of it to be placed in CXL DRAM. Moreover, since the OS views CXL DRAM as a CPU-less remote node, the host CPU manages metadata in CXL DRAM, thereby increasing metadata management latency. We find that this overhead significantly reduces memory reclamation efficiency and causes considerable increases in the tail latency of latency-sensitive applications. In this work, we investigate the performance impact of metadata placement in CXL DRAM and propose MAC, a near-memory processing (NMP) solution that accelerates memory-intensive components of metadata management directly within CXL DRAM to improve memory reclamation efficiency. Compared to conventional OS-based memory reclamation, MAC reduces application tail latency by up to 98%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Compute Express Link（CXL）DRAM已成为解决传统DDR DRAM系统容量限制的有前景方案。通过将内存扩展与主机CPU内存控制器所依赖的DDR接口代际解耦，CXL DRAM能够以经济高效的方式扩展系统内存容量。然而，随着内存容量增长，内存管理元数据可能变得过大而无法完全容纳在DDR DRAM中，从而需要将部分或全部元数据放置在CXL DRAM中。此外，由于操作系统将CXL DRAM视为无CPU的远程节点，主机CPU管理CXL DRAM中的元数据，从而增加了元数据管理延迟。我们发现这种开销显著降低了内存回收效率，并导致延迟敏感应用的尾延迟大幅增加。在本工作中，我们研究了元数据放置在CXL DRAM中的性能影响，并提出MAC——一种近内存处理（NMP）解决方案，直接在CXL DRAM中加速内存管理中的内存密集型组件，以提高内存回收效率。与传统的基于操作系统的内存回收相比，MAC最高可将应用尾延迟降低98%。

upstream_only.title: Finding NEMO: Nimble and Expressive Memory Observability
upstream_only.abstract:
Modern datacenter servers increasingly deploy heterogeneous, multi-tier memory hierarchies. For these new architectures, OSes depend on measurements of memory usage to make intelligent placement and control decisions. However, existing hardware and software mechanisms for tracking memory usage on these systems require difficult tradeoffs between coverage, timeliness, granularity, flexibility, and overhead.
We present NEMO, a nimble and expressive hardware memory telemetry engine for server memory controllers (MCs) that gives OS subsystems policy-specific views of memory behavior. NEMO enables flexible telemetry rules that filter memory operations, map accesses to counters, and apply simple updates to per-counter state. We prototype NEMO on an FPGA-based CXL-attached memory expander. Evaluating three diverse use cases, we show that NEMO provides higher-fidelity signals at substantially lower CPU overhead across a range of state-of-the-art memory management systems: it speeds up HeMem’s reaction to hot-set changes by 5×, accelerates THP splitting in MEMTIS by 10.4×, and detects noisy neighbors in Linux with 350× lower overhead. These telemetry improvements yield up to 1.7× higher throughput and 23% lower latency across key-value stores and databases.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代数据中心服务器日益部署异构、多层级的内存层次结构。对于这些新架构，操作系统依赖内存使用情况的测量来做出智能的放置和控制决策。然而，现有的硬件和软件跟踪机制在这些系统上往往需要在覆盖范围、及时性、粒度、灵活性和开销之间进行艰难的权衡。我们提出了NEMO，一种用于服务器内存控制器（MC）的灵活且富有表现力的硬件内存遥测引擎，它为操作系统子系统提供策略特定的内存行为视图。NEMO支持灵活的遥测规则，这些规则可以过滤内存操作、将访问映射到计数器，并对每个计数器状态应用简单的更新。我们在基于FPGA的CXL连接内存扩展器上对NEMO进行了原型验证。通过评估三种不同的用例，我们表明NEMO在一系列最先进的内存管理系统中以显著更低的CPU开销提供了更高保真度的信号：它将HeMem对热集变化的反应速度提高了5倍，将MEMTIS中的THP拆分加速了10.4倍，并以低350倍的开销在Linux中检测噪声邻居。这些遥测改进使键值存储和数据库的吞吐量最高提升1.7倍，延迟最低降低23%。

upstream_only.title: OBASE: Object-Based Address-Space Engineering to Improve Memory Tiering
upstream_only.abstract: Hardware and OS mechanisms for memory tiering are widely deployed, yet datacenters still overprovision DRAM. The root cause is hotness fragmentation: allocators place objects by size rather than access pattern, so hot and cold objects become interleaved within the same pages. A single hot object marks its page as active, trapping surrounding cold data in expensive DRAM. Our analysis of Google datacenter workloads shows that up to 97% of the bytes in active pages are cold and unreclaimable. We propose address-space engineering: dynamically reorganizing virtual memory so that hot objects cluster into uniformly hot pages and cold objects into uniformly cold pages. We present OBASE, a compiler-runtime system for unmanaged languages that serves as an object-aware frontend for page-aware OS backends. OBASE tracks accesses via lightweight pointer instrumentation and migrates objects at runtime using a lock-free protocol that is safe under concurrency. By reorganizing the address space, OBASE enables unmodified backends (kswapd, TMO, TPP, Memtis) to tier memory effectively. Across ten concurrent data structures, six backends, and production traces from Meta and Twitter, OBASE improves page utilization by 2–4× and reduces memory footprint by up to 70%, with only 2–5% overhead.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 硬件和操作系统层面的内存分层机制已被广泛部署，但数据中心仍然过度配置DRAM。根本原因在于热度碎片化：分配器按大小而非访问模式放置对象，导致热对象和冷对象交错在同一页面内。一个热对象就会将其所在页面标记为活跃，从而使周围的冷数据困在昂贵的DRAM中。我们对谷歌数据中心工作负载的分析显示，活跃页面中高达97%的字节是冷的且无法回收。我们提出地址空间工程：动态重组虚拟内存，使热对象聚集成均匀的热页面，冷对象聚集成均匀的冷页面。我们提出了OBASE，一个针对非托管语言的编译器-运行时系统，充当面向页面的操作系统后端之前端。OBASE通过轻量级指针插桩来跟踪访问，并使用在并发下安全的无锁协议在运行时迁移对象。通过重组地址空间，OBASE使未经修改的后端（kswapd、TMO、TPP、Memtis）能够有效进行内存分层。在十个并发数据结构、六个后端以及来自Meta和Twitter的生产流量上，OBASE将页面利用率提高了2–4倍，并将内存占用减少高达70%，开销仅为2–5%。

upstream_only.title: MDK: Rethinking the Data Center Memory Reclamation Problem
upstream_only.abstract:
The traditional memory management problem maximizes application performance when constrained by a fixed-size memory. Today’s data centers face a different problem: their goal is to maximize the number of jobs on a server without violating performance Service Level Objectives (SLOs). Since a key constraint for placing additional jobs is memory, data center systems proactively reclaim memory from running jobs to create space for new jobs. This difference fundamentally flips the optimization problem that memory management policies need to address. 
Designing practical policies requires a set of tools: 1) an optimal policy that provides a bound on what any policy can achieve, 2) metrics to compare policies, and 3) efficient techniques for evaluating potential policies. However, we find that foundational tools from the traditional setting, such as the optimal policy OPT, Miss Ratio Curves (MRCs), and efficient ways to generate MRCs, do not apply in this new setting. The data center setting demands a new set of tools.
We present the Memory Designer’s Kit, MDK, a framework for designing and evaluating data center memory management policies. MDK includes an offline provably optimal policy; Memory Performance Curves (MPCs), which show how memory savings vary when constrained by performance; and an efficient technique that is up to 208× faster than simulation for producing MPCs.
