We demonstrate MDK’s utility by developing three data center policies that improve average memory savings by up to 10% relative to a state-of-the-art policy.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 传统内存管理问题是在内存大小固定的约束下最大化应用程序性能。今天的数据中心面临着一个不同的问题：其目标是在不违反性能服务级别目标(SLO)的情况下最大化服务器上的作业数量。由于放置额外作业的关键约束是内存，数据中心系统会主动从正在运行的作业中回收内存，为新的作业腾出空间。这种差异从根本上颠倒了内存管理策略需要解决的优化问题。设计实用的策略需要一套工具：1）一个最优策略，为任何策略能达成的效果提供界限；2）用于比较策略的指标；3）评估可能策略的高效技术。然而，我们发现传统场景中的基础工具，如最优策略OPT、未命中率曲线(MRC)以及生成MRC的高效方法，并不适用于这个新场景。数据中心场景需要一套新的工具。我们提出了MDK（Memory Designer's Kit），一个用于设计和评估数据中心内存管理策略的框架。MDK包括一个离线可证明最优的策略；内存性能曲线(MPC)，它展示了在性能约束下内存节省如何变化；以及一种高效技术，其生成MPC的速度比模拟快最多208倍。我们通过开发三种数据中心策略来展示MDK的实用性，与最先进的策略相比，平均内存节省最多提升10%。

upstream_only.title: USEC: A User-Requirement-Driven Mandatory Access Control Framework for Operating Systems (Operational Systems)
upstream_only.abstract: Fine-grained access control over kernel resources is essential for containing compromised applications and protecting modern operating systems. However, mainstream mandatory access control (MAC) mechanisms such as SELinux are notoriously hard to configure, incur non-trivial performance overhead, and often break compatibility. In practice, many enterprise Linux deployments disable SELinux by default due to its complexity, configuration burden, and compatibility issues. In this paper, we present USEC, a new kernel access-control framework co-designed with security vendors to make strong MAC practical at scale. USEC introduces: (1) simpler configuration via resource-centric policy templates and semantic resource classes; (2) a demand-driven enforcement path with decision caching that reduces kernel overhead; and (3) binary-compatible LSM interfaces for process lifecycle, file I/O, and socket events that coexist with existing modules for compatibility. We implement USEC as a Linux security extension and evaluate it in terms of configuration simplicity, runtime overhead, and compatibility. Under the same security requirements,USEC policies contain up to 10× fewer lines of policy code than SELinux, while reducing runtime overhead by 3.4%–17.1% relative to SELinux across representative server and desktop workloads. USEC has been adopted by over 210 security vendors, including QiAnXin, 360, and NSFOCUS. As of early 2025, it has been deployed on more than 8,000,000 enterprise endpoints in production. These results demonstrate that USEC can provide strong, configurable kernel protection that is both efficient and widely deployable.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 对内核资源进行细粒度访问控制对于遏制被攻陷应用和保护现代操作系统至关重要。然而，SELinux等主流强制访问控制（MAC）机制以难以配置而著称，会带来不可忽视的性能开销，并且经常破坏兼容性。在实践中，许多企业Linux部署默认禁用SELinux，原因在于其复杂性、配置负担和兼容性问题。本文提出了USEC，一个与安全厂商共同设计的新型内核访问控制框架，旨在使强大的MAC能够在大规模场景下实际落地。USEC引入了：（1）通过以资源为中心的策略模板和语义化资源类实现更简单的配置；（2）一条需求驱动的强制执行路径，并带有决策缓存以降低内核开销；（3）兼容二进制的LSM接口，涵盖进程生命周期、文件I/O和套接字事件，并与现有模块共存以保持兼容性。我们将USEC实现为一个Linux安全扩展，并从配置简洁性、运行时开销和兼容性三个方面进行评估。在相同安全需求下，USEC策略的策略代码行数比SELinux最多少10倍，同时在具有代表性的服务器和桌面工作负载上，运行时开销比SELinux降低3.4%–17.1%。USEC已被包括奇安信、360和绿盟科技在内的210多家安全厂商采用。截至2025年初，它已部署在生产环境中的800多万个企业端点。这些结果表明，USEC能够提供强大、可配置的内核保护，且兼具高效性和广泛可部署性。

upstream_only.title: Mohabi: Disaggregating and Sandboxing the Firefox JavaScript Engine
upstream_only.abstract:
We present Mohabi—a modern Firefox browser with a securely sandboxed JavaScript engine. Mohabi leverages software-based fault isolation (SFI) to ensure JavaScript engine bugs cannot affect the rest of the browser. To achieve this, we disaggregated the JavaScript engine (SpiderMonkey) from the rest of the browser, and developed techniques that leverage the type system and automatic code generation to make this complex transformation—that spans numerous data structures and deeply intertwined control flow across tens of thousands of functions—safe and tractable with reasonable engineering effort.
We then sandboxed SpiderMonkey using an optimized SFI toolchain we developed to meet the unique challenges of JavaScript engines, such as efficient support for large memory footprints. Mohabi only incurs modest overheads on common benchmarks—24.82% on JetStream and 24.43% on Speedometer. Mohabi is the most ambitious case study in retrofitting in-process sandboxing in a large system to date, and our x86-64 SFI toolchain is the fastest to date, imposing overheads between 5.9%–6.6% in SPEC 2017.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了Mohabi——一个带有安全沙箱化JavaScript引擎的现代Firefox浏览器。Mohabi利用基于软件的故障隔离（SFI）来确保JavaScript引擎的缺陷不会影响浏览器的其他部分。为实现这一目标，我们将JavaScript引擎（SpiderMonkey）与浏览器其他部分拆分，并开发了利用类型系统和自动代码生成的技术，使这一涉及众多数据结构和跨越数万函数深度交织的控制流的复杂转换变得安全可信且工程工作量合理。随后，我们使用自研的优化SFI工具链对SpiderMonkey进行了沙箱化，以应对JavaScript引擎的独特挑战，例如对大内存足迹的高效支持。Mohabi在常见基准上仅带来适度开销——JetStream为24.82%，Speedometer为24.43%。Mohabi是迄今为止在大型系统中进行就地沙箱化改造的最雄心勃勃的案例研究，我们的x86-64 SFI工具链也是迄今最快的，在SPEC 2017中开销介于5.9%–6.6%之间。

upstream_only.title: Ichnaea: A Framework for Precise Tracking of Memory Objects
upstream_only.abstract:
Tracing memory objects (who accessed what object and when) is often important for understanding the runtime behavior of modern software. This type of rich per-access metadata can aid in debugging, tracing, forensics and other tasks. Collecting this information is non-trivial since it will either be incomplete or requires heavy instrumentation and/or hardware support and likely adds significant runtime overheads (e.g., Intel Pin or Valgrind slow programs down by 10−100x).
We present Ichnaea, a purpose-built, precise and complete framework based on memory protection keys (MPK) that delivers context-rich object events at very low cost to the application. Ichnaea is dormant until one of the objects of interest (ObjOfInterest) is read or written to — at which point it logs any access attempts and changes to the ObjOfInterest along with rich context information ("who is attempting access?", "what changes, if any, are being applied?") before returning control to the application. In general Ichnaea reduces the tracing overheads by 10−60x when compared to the widely used framework Intel Pin, while still capturing precise, per-access information needed to diagnose memory vulnerabilities, performance hot-spots and subtle concurrency errors.

upstream_only.title: Extracting Database Access-Control Policies from Web Applications
upstream_only.abstract:
To safeguard sensitive user data, web developers typically rely on implicit access-control policies, which they implement using access checks and query filters. This ad hoc approach is error-prone as these scattered checks and filters are easy to misplace or misspecify, and the lack of an explicit policy precludes external access-control enforcement. More critically, it is difficult for humans to discern what policy is embedded in application code (i.e., what data the application may access)—an issue that worsens as development teams evolve.
This paper tackles policy extraction: the task of extracting the access-control policy embedded in an application by summarizing its data queries. An extracted policy, once vetted for errors, can stand alone as a specification for the application’s data access, and can be enforced to ensure compliance as code changes over time. We introduce Ote, a policy extractor for Ruby on Rails web applications. Ote uses concolic execution to explore execution paths through the application, generating traces of SQL queries and conditions that trigger them. It then merges and simplifies these traces into a final policy that aligns with the observed behaviors. We applied Ote to three real-world applications and compared extracted policies to handwritten ones, revealing several errors in the latter.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 为了保护敏感的用户数据，Web开发者通常依赖于隐式的访问控制策略，这些策略通过访问检查和查询过滤器来实现。这种临时性的方法容易出错，因为分散的检查和过滤器很容易被放错位置或错误指定，并且缺乏显式策略会妨碍外部的访问控制执行。更重要的是，人类很难辨别嵌入在应用程序代码中的策略（即应用程序可以访问哪些数据），而随着开发团队的发展，这个问题会更加严重。本文解决了策略提取问题：通过总结应用程序的数据查询来提取嵌入其中的访问控制策略。提取出的策略在审查错误后，可以独立地作为应用程序数据访问的规范，并可在代码随时间变化时强制执行以确保合规。我们介绍了Ote，一个用于Ruby on Rails Web应用程序的策略提取工具。Ote使用concolic执行来探索应用程序的执行路径，生成触发这些路径的SQL查询和条件的踪迹，然后将这些踪迹合并和简化，形成与观察行为一致的最终策略。我们将Ote应用于三个真实世界的应用程序，并将提取出的策略与手写的策略进行比较，发现后者存在多个错误。

upstream_only.title: iLand: An Instruction-Level Dynamic Binary Instrumentation Framework for iOS
upstream_only.abstract:
Dynamic binary instrumentation (DBI) enables monitoring and modification of executing programs and forms the foundation for a range of program analysis and security testing. On iOS, however, no DBI is available for non-jailbroken devices. Existing approaches on other platforms (e.g., Android) rely on JIT compilation, which is prohibited by the iOS sandbox. The limited CPU and memory resources of mobile devices further constrain the practical deployment of DBI.
We propose iLand, a novel instruction-level DBI framework for iOS. Instead of JIT compilation, it translates instructions into predefined micro-operations and interprets using precompiled atomic execution units. To reduce CPU and memory overhead, it employs application-only emulation: only the app’s code is interpreted, while system libraries run natively. We implement iLand as a standard sandboxed iOS app capable of emulating other apps. It preserves the emulated apps’ original functionality and user experience such as dynamic UI rendering, real-time interaction, live video streaming.
Based on this DBI framework, we further implemented an instruction-level dynamic tracing tool and used it to study policy‑violation behaviors on 60 top-ranked App Store apps. We found that 13 (21%) apps are still invoking private APIs, of which 2 invoke APIs explicitly prohibited by Apple. Our analysis further revealed the new and stealthy methods employed by apps to evade Apple’s App Review. In particular, in 15 (25%) of the apps, we observed a new way to collect sensitive information by direct invocation of the SVC instruction.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 动态二进制插桩（DBI）能够监控和修改正在执行的程序，是多种程序分析与安全测试的基础。然而，在iOS上，对于未越狱设备没有可用的DBI框架。其他平台（如Android）的现有方法依赖于JIT编译，而JIT编译被iOS沙盒禁止。移动设备有限的CPU和内存资源进一步限制了DBI的实际部署。我们提出了iLand，一个面向iOS的新型指令级动态二进制插桩框架。它不采用JIT编译，而是将指令翻译为预定义的微操作，并使用预编译的原子执行单元进行解释。为了降低CPU和内存开销，它采用仅应用程序模拟：只有应用程序的代码被解释，而系统库则原生运行。我们将iLand实现为一个标准的沙盒化iOS应用，能够模拟其他应用。它保留了被模拟应用原有的功能和用户体验，如动态UI渲染、实时交互和实时视频流。基于该DBI框架，我们进一步实现了一个指令级动态跟踪工具，并用它研究了60个顶级App Store应用中的违规行为。我们发现13个（21%）应用仍在调用私有API，其中2个调用了苹果明确禁止的API。我们的分析进一步揭示了应用为规避苹果应用审核所采用的新颖且隐蔽的方法。特别是，在15个（25%）应用中，我们观察到一种通过直接调用SVC指令来收集敏感信息的新方式。

upstream_only.title: Tessera: A Holistic Pipeline Parallelism Framework for Trillion-Parameter Heterogeneous MoE Training (Operational Systems)
upstream_only.abstract:
Training trillion-parameter models relies on pipeline parallelism to scale across thousands of accelerators. However, architectures exemplified by the Qwen family are evolving from uniform Transformer blocks into heterogeneous compositions that combine sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) with different attention variants. This heterogeneity breaks the uniformity assumption behind existing pipeline systems: partitions chosen from serial layer costs become imbalanced after communication is overlapped with computation, because different layer combinations hide different fractions of their communication. Furthermore, at the scale of 10K+ GPUs, MoE routing variation adds a runtime source of stalls, creating transient idle slots that static plans cannot anticipate.
We present Tessera, a framework that co-optimizes partitioning and overlap scheduling for heterogeneous pipeline training, and adapts to runtime dynamics. Tessera introduces: (1) an overlap scheduler that synthesizes fine-grained interleavings for each layer combination; (2) an overlap-aware partitioner that uses profiled post-overlap cost to select partitions balanced for parallel execution; and (3) a dynamic bubble optimizer that fills routing-induced idle slots with movable tasks at runtime. Deployed on production clusters for pre-training Qwen3 and Qwen3-Next, Tessera improves throughput by 20%–33% over our production baseline across five workloads at scales from 4,096 to 12,288 GPUs, reaching 39% MFU on a trillion-parameter model. In controlled experiments against Megatron-Core MoE with public recipes, Tessera achieves up to 1.24× higher MFU.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 训练万亿参数模型依赖流水线并行来扩展到数千个加速器。然而，以Qwen系列为代表的架构正在从统一的Transformer模块演变为异构组合，将稀疏混合专家（MoE）与不同的注意力变体相结合。这种异构性打破了现有流水线系统背后的均匀性假设：根据串行层成本选择的分区在通信与计算重叠后会变得不平衡，因为不同的层组合隐藏了其通信的不同比例。此外，在10K+ GPU规模下，MoE路由变化增加了运行时的停顿源，产生了静态计划无法预见的瞬时空闲槽位。我们提出了Tessera，一个针对异构流水线训练协同优化分区和重叠调度，并适应运行时动态的框架。Tessera引入了：(1) 一个重叠调度器，为每种层组合合成细粒度的交错执行；(2) 一个感知重叠的分区器，使用分析后的重叠后成本来选择适用于并行执行均衡的分区；(3) 一个动态气泡优化器，在运行时用可移动任务填充路由导致的空闲槽位。在生产集群上预训练Qwen3和Qwen3-Next时，Tessera在五类工作负载、4096至12288个GPU规模下，相比我们的生产基线将吞吐量提升了20%至33%，在万亿参数模型上达到了39%的MFU。在与采用公开配方的Megatron-Core MoE的对照实验中，Tessera实现了高达1.24倍的MFU提升。

upstream_only.title: Hetu v2: A General and Scalable Deep Learning System with Hierarchical and Heterogeneous Single Program Multiple Data Annotations
upstream_only.abstract:
The Single-Program Multiple-Data (SPMD) paradigm provides a unified abstraction to annotate various parallel dimensions in distributed deep learning (DL) training. With SPMD, users can write training programs from the viewpoint of a single device, and the system will automatically deduce the tensor sharding and communication patterns. However, with the recent development in large-scale DL models, distributed training exhibits spatial and temporal workload heterogeneity, arising from both device disparities (e.g., mixed hardware, failures) and data variations (e.g., uneven sequence lengths). Such heterogeneity violates SPMD’s assumption of symmetric workload partitioning, which restricts its ability to express and optimize heterogeneous parallel strategies effectively. 
To address this, we propose HSPMD within the Hetu v2 system to achieve general and scalable DL training. HSPMD extends SPMD’s declarative annotations to support asymmetric sharding and composes standard communication primitives for hierarchical communication, all while retaining the simplicity of a single-device programming model. HSPMD handles spatial heterogeneity through progressive graph specialization, enabling device-specific execution logic, and addresses temporal heterogeneity via dynamic graph switching. Evaluations on (a) heterogeneous devices, (b) unstable devices, and (c) mixed-length data scenarios show that HSPMD matches or outperforms specialized systems, providing a flexible and efficient solution for modern distributed DL training. Code is available: https://github.com/PKU-DAIR/Hetu.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 单程序多数据（SPMD）范式为分布式深度学习训练中的各种并行维度提供了统一抽象。使用SPMD，用户可以从单个设备的角度编写训练程序，系统将自动推导张量切分和通信模式。然而，随着大规模深度学习模型的最新发展，分布式训练呈现出空间和时间上的工作负载异构性，这既源于设备差异（如混合硬件、故障），也源于数据变化（如不均匀的序列长度）。这种异构性违反了SPMD对对称工作负载划分的假设，从而限制了其有效表达和优化异构并行策略的能力。为解决这一问题，我们在Hetu v2系统中提出了HSPMD，以实现通用且可扩展的深度学习训练。HSPMD扩展了SPMD的声明式注释以支持不对称切分，并组合标准通信原语实现层次化通信，同时保留了单设备编程模型的简洁性。HSPMD通过渐进式图特化处理空间异构性，从而实现设备特定的执行逻辑，并通过动态图切换解决时间异构性。在（a）异构设备、（b）不稳定设备和（c）混合长度数据场景下的评估表明，HSPMD匹配或超越了专门系统，为现代分布式深度学习训练提供了灵活高效的解决方案。代码可在https://github.com/PKU-DAIR/Hetu获取。

upstream_only.title: Syncopate: Efficient Multi-GPU AI Kernels via Automatic Chunk-Centric Compute-Communication Overlap
upstream_only.abstract: Communication has become a first-order bottleneck in large-scale GPU workloads, and existing distributed compilers address it mainly by overlapping whole compute and communication kernels at the stream level. This coarse granularity incurs extra kernel launches, forces device-wide synchronizations at kernel boundaries, and leaves substantial slack when the slowest tile or kernel stretches the communication tail. We present Syncopate, a compiler and runtime that enable automatic fine-grained overlap around a single fused compute kernel. Syncopate introduces a communication chunk abstraction that decouples communication granularity from kernel structure and backend mechanisms, allowing chunk-level plans to be ported from existing distributed compilers, written directly by users, or instantiated from reusable templates. Given a local Triton kernel and a chunk schedule, Syncopate performs transformations to align computation with chunk availability. Implemented as a source-to-source compiler on Triton, Syncopate delivers an average end-to-end speedup of 1.3× and up to 4.7× on multi-GPU workloads. Our code is open-sourced at https://github.com/tie-pilot-qxw/syncopate.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 通信已成为大规模GPU工作负载中的首要瓶颈，现有的分布式编译器主要通过流级重叠整个计算和通信内核来解决这一问题。这种粗粒度会引入额外的内核启动，强制在内核边界进行设备级同步，并且在最慢的块或内核拉长通信尾部时留下大量空档。我们提出了Syncopate，一个编译器和运行时，能够实现围绕单个融合计算内核的自动细粒度重叠。Syncopate引入了通信块抽象，将通信粒度与内核结构和后端机制解耦，使得块级计划可以从现有的分布式编译器中移植、由用户直接编写或从可复用的模板中实例化。给定一个本地Triton内核和一个块调度，Syncopate执行变换以使计算与块可用性对齐。Syncopate作为Triton上的源到源编译器实现，在多GPU工作负载上平均端到端加速1.3倍，最高可达4.7倍。我们的代码已在https://github.com/tie-pilot-qxw/syncopate开源。

upstream_only.title: Teaching the Old Dog New Tricks: Building Efficient Data Pipelines for Large-Scale LLM Pre-Training (Operational Systems)
upstream_only.abstract: Data pipelines play a critical role in the performance of large-scale pre-training jobs running on thousands of GPUs. In this work, we present a comprehensive quantitative analysis of data access patterns from production workloads and reveal three previously underreported bottlenecks. First, cross-datacenter traffic emerges as a major source of latency when evaluating in-training models using remote checkpoints. Second, checkpoint loading during startup phases frequently suffers from I/O contention that delays job initialization. Third, data transformation during loading becomes a significant and CPU-intensive bottleneck for multimodal models. Guided by these findings, we introduce three optimizations: global-namespace-based predictive checkpoint replication, proactive hot-file replication, and offloading data transformation to storage-tier CPU resources. Crucially, we demonstrate that these optimizations are not system-specific but address fundamental architectural mismatches in the LLM era. They are broadly applicable to both legacy and modern storage systems, offering a high-return path to upgrade infrastructure with minimal engineering intrusion. Together, these techniques reduce wasted GPU hours per evaluation from 16,800 to 4,000, shorten checkpoint loading time at each training start by 40.8%, and reduce training stalls caused by dataloading by 63.2%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 数据流水线在运行于数千个GPU上的大规模预训练任务的性能中起着关键作用。在这项工作中，我们对生产工作负载中的数据访问模式进行了全面的定量分析，并揭示了三个此前未被充分报道的瓶颈。首先，当使用远程检查点进行训练中模型评估时，跨数据中心流量成为延迟的主要来源。其次，启动阶段的检查点加载经常遭受I/O争用，从而延迟作业初始化。第三，加载过程中的数据转换成为多模态模型的重大CPU密集型瓶颈。在这些发现的指导下，我们引入了三项优化：基于全局命名空间的预测性检查点复制、主动式热文件复制，以及将数据转换卸载到存储层CPU资源。至关重要的是，我们证明这些优化并非特定于系统，而是解决了LLM时代的基础架构错配问题。它们广泛适用于传统和现代存储系统，提供了一条以最小工程侵入升级基础设施的高回报路径。这些技术合计将每次评估浪费的GPU小时数从16,800减少到4,000，将每次训练启动时的检查点加载时间缩短40.8%，并将由数据加载引起的训练停滞减少63.2%。

upstream_only.title: Cocoon: A System Architecture for Differentially Private Training with Correlated Noises
upstream_only.abstract: Machine learning (ML) models memorize and leak training data, causing serious privacy issues to data owners. Training algorithms with differential privacy (DP) have been gaining attention as a solution. However, these algorithms add noise at each training iteration and degrade accuracy, limiting their real-world adoption. To improve accuracy, a new family of approaches adds carefully designed correlated noises, so that noises cancel out each other across iterations. We performed an extensive characterization study of these new mechanisms and show they incur non-negligible overheads when the model is relatively large or uses large embedding tables compared to the hardware capacity. Motivated by the analysis, we propose Cocoon, a framework for efficient training with correlated noises. Cocoon stores and processes the large noise history across CPU, GPU, and memory extension module, introduces optimizations for sparse embedding tables, and leverages to-be-commercialized near-memory processing (NMP) devices. On a real system with an FPGA-based NMP device prototype, Cocoon improves the performance by 1.23–10.82×.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 机器学习（ML）模型会记忆并泄露训练数据，给数据所有者带来严重的隐私问题。具有差分隐私（DP）的训练算法正作为解决方案受到越来越多的关注。然而，这些算法在每次训练迭代中都会添加噪声，从而导致精度下降，限制了其实际应用。为了提高精度，一系列新方法会添加经过精心设计的相关噪声，使噪声在迭代之间相互抵消。我们对这些新机制进行了广泛的表征研究，并表明当模型相对较大或使用与硬件容量相比更大的嵌入表时，它们会产生不可忽视的开销。受上述分析启发，我们提出了Cocoon——一个用于高效相关噪声训练的系统框架。Cocoon在CPU、GPU和内存扩展模块之间存储和处理庞大的噪声历史，引入针对稀疏嵌入表的优化，并利用即将商业化的近内存处理（NMP）设备。在带有基于FPGA的NMP设备原型的真实系统上，Cocoon将性能提升了1.23–10.82倍。

upstream_only.title: ValScope: Value-Semantics-Aware Metamorphic Testing for Detecting Logical Bugs in DBMSs
upstream_only.abstract:
Database Management Systems (DBMSs) are crucial for data processing in many large-scale applications. However, detecting logical bugs in DBMSs remains challenging, as defining what constitutes a correct query result is inherently difficult. Metamorphic testing (MT) addresses this issue by checking relations between systematically transformed queries. However, existing MT approaches mainly rely on equivalent or set-semantic relations, and thus fail to detect subtle bugs that preserve the result set while corrupting value semantics, such as faulty aggregation, ordering, or numeric computation.
In this paper, we propose a unified SQL query approximation model that integrates set-semantic and value-semantic reasoning. Beyond result set inclusion or equivalence, our model captures how value-level changes affect query correctness. Based on this model, we develop ValScope, which generates and mutates SQL queries using predefined mutators and performs approximation propagation analysis to reason about global semantic effects. We evaluate ValScope on 6 widely used DBMSs and uncover 67 unique logical bugs, many of which were missed by prior approaches. The results show that ValScope substantially broadens the spectrum of detectable logical bugs beyond existing MT techniques.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 数据库管理系统（DBMS）在许多大规模应用中对于数据处理至关重要。然而，检测DBMS中的逻辑错误仍然具有挑战性，因为定义什么是正确的查询结果本身就很难。蜕变测试（MT）通过检查系统性转换后的查询之间的关系来解决这个问题。然而，现有的MT方法主要依赖于等价或集合语义关系，因此无法检测保留结果集同时破坏值语义的细微错误，例如错误的聚合、排序或数值计算。在本文中，我们提出了一种统一的SQL查询逼近模型，该模型集成了集合语义和值语义推理。除了结果集的包含或等价性之外，我们的模型还捕捉值级变化如何影响查询正确性。基于该模型，我们开发了ValScope，它使用预定义的变异算子生成和变异SQL查询，并执行逼近传播分析以推理全局语义效应。我们在6个广泛使用的DBMS上评估了ValScope，发现了67个独特的逻辑错误，其中许多是先前方法未发现的。结果表明，ValScope在现有MT技术之上显著拓宽了可检测逻辑错误的种类。

upstream_only.title: The Abstention Protocol: RCA for Clos Fabrics (Operational Systems)
upstream_only.abstract:
Root cause analysis (RCA) in large datacenter networks is challenging because telemetry is noisy, partial, and asynchronous. Score-based approaches degrade under these conditions, often yielding unstable or incorrect attributions.
We present CoreSec, a production RCA system that replaces weighted fusion with a PAM-style abstention algebra. Telemetry agents are composed using control flags that yield deterministic decisions and explicit abstention when evidence is ambiguous. CoreSec combines this algebra with topology-aware configurations that capture failure surfaces across Clos fabrics and converge monotonically as evidence accumulates.
Deployed at hyperscale, CoreSec provides stable and explainable RCA behavior across diverse environments without retuning. Our experience shows that structured composition with abstention forms a practical foundation for automated RCA in real-world cloud networks.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在大型数据中心网络中进行根因分析（RCA）具有挑战性，因为遥测数据嘈杂、不完整且异步。基于评分的方法在这些条件下会退化，常常产生不稳定或错误的归因。我们提出了 CoreSec，一个生产级 RCA 系统，它用 PAM 风格的弃权代数取代了加权融合。遥测代理通过控制标志组合，产生确定性决策，并在证据不明确时明确弃权。CoreSec 将该代数与拓扑感知配置相结合，这些配置捕捉了 Clos 网络结构上的故障面，并随着证据积累而单调收敛。在超大规模部署中，CoreSec 无需重新调优即可在各种环境中提供稳定且可解释的 RCA 行为。我们的经验表明，带弃权的结构化组合为真实世界云网络中的自动化 RCA 奠定了实用的基础。

upstream_only.title: When Sampling Lies: Trustworthy Performance Profiling for Flat Workloads with Blink (Operational Systems)
upstream_only.abstract:
Performance optimization of mobile systems is critical for achieving responsive user experiences. However, accurately measuring the effects of such optimizations is challenging. We found that real-world mobile workloads exhibit a flat profile, invoking thousands of short-lived routines that contribute evenly to overall performance with no dominant bottlenecks. Sampling-based profilers such as perf struggle in this setting: skid, shadow effects, and incomplete function coverage can yield systematically incorrect results, not just high variance.
We present Blink, a lightweight instrumentation framework that provides robust coverage for short-lived routines while maintaining low overhead. Blink inserts instrumentation into functions, enabling precise measurements. We show that Blink achieves 99.999% accuracy while incurring 1% overhead. Deployed in a variety of use cases at Huawei, Blink offers a practical and reliable alternative for mobile compiler performance analysis.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 移动系统的性能优化对于实现响应式用户体验至关重要。然而，准确衡量这些优化的效果具有挑战性。我们发现，真实世界的移动工作负载呈现出平坦的轮廓，调用成千上万个短暂例程，它们均匀地贡献整体性能，没有主导性瓶颈。基于采样的分析工具（如perf）在此境况下难以胜任：skid（偏移）、影子效应以及不完整的函数覆盖不仅会导致高方差，还可能产生系统性错误的结果。我们提出了Blink，一个轻量级的插桩框架，在保持低开销的同时为短暂例程提供稳健的覆盖。Blink在函数中插入插桩，从而实现精确测量。我们展示Blink达到了99.999%的准确率，同时产生1%的开销。在华为的多种用例中部署，Blink为移动编译器性能分析提供了一种实用且可靠的替代方案。

upstream_only.title: Breaking the Reward Barrier: Accelerating Tree-of-Thought Reasoning via Speculative Exploration
upstream_only.abstract:
Tree-of-Thought (ToT) reasoning structures Large Language Model (LLM) inference as a tree-based search, demonstrating strong potential for solving complex mathematical and programming tasks. However, its efficiency is constrained by the reward dependency barrier—a synchronization bottleneck caused by sequential reward-guided exploration that limits search parallelism and introduces substantial latency. Prior system optimizations, mainly designed for linear Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, cannot address these challenges, leaving the efficiency of ToT underexplored.
To enhance ToT reasoning efficiency, we observe that the reasoning paths can be explored speculatively to break the reward synchronization barrier. Therefore, in this paper, we propose SPEX and introduce three key techniques: (i) intra-query speculative path selection to predict and expand high-potential branches of ToT, (ii) inter-query budget allocation to balance speculative resource allocation across queries dynamically, and (iii) adaptive early termination to prune deep and redundant branches for a skewed search tree.
We implement SPEX on top of the SGLang framework and evaluate it across diverse ToT algorithms and LLMs. Extensive experiments show that SPEX achieves 1.2 3 × speedup for different ToT reasoning algorithms. Moreover, SPEX synergizes with token-level speculative decoding, achieving cumulative speedups of up to 4.1×. Ablation studies further confirm the contributions of each technique. Overall, SPEX represents a significant step toward efficient and scalable ToT reasoning, unlocking the parallelism required for high-performance inference-time scaling for LLMs.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 思维树（Tree-of-Thought，ToT）推理将大语言模型（LLM）推理结构化为基于树的搜索，展现出解决复杂数学和编程任务的巨大潜力。然而，其效率受到奖励依赖障碍的制约——这是一种由顺序奖励引导探索引起的同步瓶颈，限制了搜索并行性并引入了大量延迟。先前的系统优化主要针对线性思维链（Chain-of-Thought，CoT）推理设计，无法解决这些挑战，导致ToT的效率未得到充分探索。为提高ToT推理效率，我们观察到推理路径可以被推测性探索，从而打破奖励同步障碍。因此，在本文中，我们提出SPEX并引入三种关键技术：（i）查询内推测性路径选择，以预测并扩展ToT的高潜力分支；（ii）查询间预算分配，以动态平衡跨查询的推测性资源分配；以及（iii）自适应提前终止，以剪除偏斜搜索树中深层和冗余的分支。我们在SGLang框架之上实现了SPEX，并在多种ToT算法和LLM上进行了评估。大量实验表明，SPEX对不同ToT推理算法实现了1.2至3倍的加速。此外，SPEX与token级推测解码协同工作，累计加速可达4.1倍。消融研究进一步证实了每种技术的贡献。总体而言，SPEX朝着高效且可扩展的ToT推理迈出了重要一步，释放了LLM高性能推理时扩展所需的并行性。

upstream_only.title: Controlling Opaque-Component Effects with Semisolates and Try
upstream_only.abstract: Many developers and systems today rely on opaque software components. When executing, these components affect each other and the broader environment in which they execute. Some of these effects are expected and desired; others not so. This paper introduces semisolates, an abstraction and corresponding subsystem for controlling and manipulating the effects of opaque components. Available as an unprivileged, higher-order, language-agnostic command, try interposes on a component’s execution to automatically capture and control its effects. Effect control includes introspection, optional application, effect stacking, and further manipulation—all driven by several real-world case studies. Today try is used in research and production applications across several organizations, mediating potentially undesired effects, maintaining full compatibility with real-world components, and incurring a modest performance overhead well within each case’s acceptable levels.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 如今许多开发者和系统都依赖不透明软件组件。在执行时，这些组件会相互影响并影响其运行所在的更广泛环境。其中一些影响是预期且期望的，另一些则不然。本文介绍了半隔离（semisolates），这是一种用于控制和操纵不透明组件效应的抽象及相应子系统。作为一个无特权的、高阶的、与语言无关的命令，try 会在组件执行时对其进行拦截，以自动捕获和控制其影响。效应控制包括内省、可选应用、效应叠加以及进一步操作——所有这些都由多个真实世界的案例研究驱动。目前，try 已被多个组织的研究和生产应用所使用，用于调解潜在的不良效应，保持与现实世界组件的完全兼容性，并产生适当且可接受的性能开销，在各类可接受范围内。

upstream_only.title: SBB: Eliminating Centralized Bottlenecks in Userspace Network Runtime
upstream_only.abstract:
To achieve high throughput, low latency, and high CPU efficiency, userspace network runtimes must perform three types of scheduling: 1) request preemption to minimize tail latency, 2) CPU allocation among services to avoid wasting CPU cycles when the load is low, and 3) request load balancing across worker cores to achieve work conservation. However, prior designs rely on centralized components, which inevitably become scalability bottlenecks as the number of CPU workers increases, limiting system performance scaling.
This paper presents SBB, a purely decentralized userspace network runtime that simultaneously delivers high performance, high CPU efficiency, and high scalability by advancing in both system mechanism and scheduling policy. For system mechanism, SBB leverages the emerging User Interrupt mechanism in a novel way, delivering two types of device interrupts to the userspace runtime: 1) user-level timer interrupts for request preemption, and 2) user-level NIC interrupts for packet arrival to perform CPU allocation. For scheduling policy, SBB introduces a two-level algorithm, which marries flow migration (for persistent imbalance) with task stealing (for temporary imbalance), challenging the conventional wisdom that centralized load balancing outperforms decentralized approaches. Evaluation shows that SBB achieves 1.7× to 5.2× higher throughput when scaling to 48 cores, while meeting the same tail latency target.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 为了实现高吞吐量、低延迟和高CPU效率，用户态网络运行时必须执行三种类型的调度：1）请求抢占以最小化尾部延迟，2）服务之间的CPU分配以避免在负载较低时浪费CPU周期，以及3）跨工作核心的请求负载均衡以实现工作守恒。然而，先前的设计依赖集中式组件，随着CPU工作线程数量的增加，这些组件不可避免地将成为可扩展性瓶颈，从而限制系统性能的扩展。本文提出了SBB，一种纯分布式的用户态网络运行时，通过推进系统机制和调度策略两方面，同时实现高性能、高CPU效率和高可扩展性。在系统机制方面，SBB以新颖的方式利用新兴的用户中断机制，向用户态运行时传递两种类型的设备中断：1）用于请求抢占的用户级定时器中断，以及2）用于数据包到达以执行CPU分配的用户级NIC中断。在调度策略方面，SBB引入了一种两级算法，将流迁移（针对持续不均衡）与任务窃取（针对临时不均衡）相结合，挑战了集中式负载均衡优于分布式方法的传统观点。评估表明，在扩展到48个核心时，SBB实现了1.7倍到5.2倍的更高吞吐量，同时满足相同的尾部延迟目标。

upstream_only.title: Rakaia: Scalable In-Kernel Scheduling for TCP-Based RPCs
upstream_only.abstract:
Delivering RPCs with high throughput and low latency demands work-conserving scheduling across many CPU cores and eliminating head-of-line (HOL) blocking across all messages. By exposing per-connection byte streams rather than messages to userspace, the POSIX TCP API inherently induces HOL blocking both within and across connections. To mitigate HOL blocking, RPC frameworks such as gRPC must reconstruct message semantics in userspace through additional abstractions including dedicated I/O threads, work queues, and worker thread pools, introducing significant context switching and synchronization overheads.
This paper presents Rakaia, a framework that hides all TCP-level abstractions from userspace and exposes a purely message-oriented API. By performing message parsing and work-conserving scheduling directly in the kernel’s TCP receive path, at the earliest possible point, Rakaia efficiently eliminates HOL blocking and avoids the heavy userspace machinery imposed by stream-based APIs.
We implemented Rakaia as a Linux kernel module with support for kTLS. Rakaia is compatible with the kernel’s TCP stack and existing RPC protocols. We also adapted gRPC to use Rakaia’s API. Our evaluation shows Rakaia: (i) consistently eliminates HOL blocking across a wide range of connection counts; (ii) achieves up to 5× higher throughput-under-SLO than KCM, Linux’s current in-kernel message API over TCP; (iii) improves gRPC-Go’s throughput-under-SLO by up to 1.56×, and gRPC-C++’s by up to 2.69×; and (iv) improves the throughput-under-SLO for real-world applications including Silo running TPC-C and OpenTelemetry Collector by 1.39× and 1.42×, respectively.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 以高吞吐量和低延迟交付RPC，要求跨多个CPU核心进行工作守恒调度，并消除所有消息的头对行阻塞。通过向用户空间公开每连接的字节流而非消息，POSIX TCP API固有地在连接内部和跨连接间引发HOL阻塞。为缓解HOL阻塞，gRPC等RPC框架必须在用户空间重建消息语义，采用专用I/O线程、工作队列和工作者线程池等额外抽象，从而引入显著的上下文切换和同步开销。本文提出Rakaia框架，该框架对用户空间隐藏所有TCP级抽象，并公开纯面向消息的API。通过在内核TCP接收路径中尽可能早的位置直接执行消息解析和工作守恒调度，Rakaia高效地消除了HOL阻塞，并避免了基于流的API所强加的重型用户空间机制。我们以支持kTLS的Linux内核模块形式实现了Rakaia。Rakaia与内核TCP栈及现有RPC协议兼容。我们还改造了gRPC以使用Rakaia的API。评估表明，Rakaia：(i)在多种连接数量下持续消除HOL阻塞；(ii)相比KCM（Linux当前的TCP内核消息API），SLO吞吐量最高提升5倍；(iii)使gRPC-Go的SLO吞吐量最高提升1.56倍，gRPC-C++最高提升2.69倍；(iv)使实际应用（包括运行TPC-C的Silo和OpenTelemetry Collector）的SLO吞吐量分别提升1.39倍和1.42倍。

upstream_only.title: kSTEP: Characterization and Deterministic Testing of Linux CPU Scheduler Bugs
upstream_only.abstract: We present an in-depth study of CPU scheduler bugs, covering both functional violations and misalignments between implementation and policy. Our study shows that these bugs are hard to observe and even harder to trigger. To close this gap, we introduce kSTEP. kSTEP gives testers fine-grained control over scheduler-invoking events and runs them deterministically on isolated CPUs. kSTEP produces noise-free, repeatable traces that expose subtle behavior. We then build a coverage-guided fuzzer on top of kSTEP for automated CPU scheduler testing. We demonstrate kSTEP’s effectiveness by reproducing seven real-world scheduler bugs and uncovering four new ones. kSTEP is publicly available at https://github.com/kstep-dev/kstep.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们深入研究了CPU调度器缺陷，涵盖了功能违规和实现与策略之间的不匹配。我们的研究表明，这些缺陷很难观察，更难触发。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了kSTEP。kSTEP让测试人员能够对调度器调用事件进行细粒度控制，并在隔离的CPU上确定性地运行它们。kSTEP产生无噪声、可重复的追踪，揭示微妙的行为。然后我们在kSTEP之上构建了一个覆盖引导的模糊器，用于自动CPU调度器测试。我们通过重现七个真实世界的调度器缺陷并发现四个新缺陷来证明kSTEP的有效性。kSTEP可在https://github.com/kstep-dev/kstep公开发布。

upstream_only.title: What Are You (M)Waiting For: The Hidden Cost of Idle in the Hyperscale Cloud (Operational Systems)
upstream_only.abstract:
Oversubscription is central to large-scale clouds: multiplexing virtual CPUs (vCPUs) over fewer physical CPUs (pCPUs) improves utilization and sales density, but meeting strict latency Service Level Objectives (SLOs) requires precise control over idle behavior. In 1:1 settings, idle-passthrough—especially mwait-passthrough—works well: by allowing guests to initiate hardware idle transitions directly, it eliminates idle-induced Virtual Machine (VM) exits and achieves near–bare-metal latency.
In production oversubscribed environments, however, passthrough breaks down. Because the hypervisor cannot observe mwait idleness, a vCPU never yields its pCPU, causing idle vCPU to monopolize cores and driving up contention, steal time ratios, live migrations, and SLO alarms across regions. Controlled experiments reproduce these production symptoms: even an idle vCPU executing mwait can raise colocated tail latency by up to 3×.
We present mwait-sched, a virtualization-aware redesign of mwait handling that reconciles bare-metal-like idle latency with predictable pCPU multiplexing. mwait-sched integrates deterministic timer-based emulation, fine-grained idle-interval classification, and a scalable multi-address mwait-proxy that restores idle visibility without frequent VM exits. Across nine representative workloads, it reduces P99 (99th percentile) latency by 30–50% and reduces steal ratio by 30–40%. At hyperscale, across globally distributed production regions comprising ∼3.2M pCPUs, it reduces high-contention steal events by over 80%, cuts daily live migrations by 30–50%, and raises oversubscription ratio from 1.0% to 20.3%, effectively adding ∼600,000 vCPUs of sellable capacity.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 超订阅是大规模云的核心：将虚拟CPU（vCPU）多路复用到更少的物理CPU（pCPU）上可提高利用率和销售密度，但满足严格的延迟服务级别目标（SLO）要求对空闲行为进行精确控制。在1:1设置中，空闲直通——尤其是mwait直通——效果良好：它允许guest直接发起硬件空闲转换，从而消除了空闲引起的虚拟机（VM）退出，并实现了接近裸机的延迟。然而，在生产环境的超订阅情况下，直通会失效。由于hypervisor无法观察到mwait空闲状态，vCPU永远不会让出其pCPU，导致空闲vCPU独占核心，并在各区域引发争用、窃取时间比率、实时迁移和SLO告警的增加。受控实验重现了这些生产症状：即使是执行mwait的空闲vCPU也可能将共置的尾部延迟最多提高3倍。我们提出了mwait-sched，一种虚拟机感知的mwait处理重新设计，它调和了类似裸机的空闲延迟与可预测的pCPU多路复用。mwait-sched集成了基于定时器的确定性模拟、细粒度的空闲间隔分类以及可扩展的多地址mwait代理，无需频繁的VM退出即可恢复空闲可见性。在九个代表性工作负载中，它将P99（第99百分位）延迟降低30-50%，窃取比率降低30-40%。在超大规模场景中，在全球分布的生产区域（约320万pCPU）中，它使高争用窃取事件减少超过80%，将每日实时迁移减少30-50%，并将超订阅比率从1.0%提高到20.3%，实际上增加了约60万个vCPU的可销售容量。

upstream_only.title: Xkernel: Principled Performance Tunability of Operating System Kernels
upstream_only.abstract: The Linux kernel is permeated with constant values that are critical to system performance. Many of these constants, referred to as perf-consts, are magic numbers with brittle assumptions on hardware and workloads. Unfortunately, there is no capability of in-situ tuning of perf-const values on deployed kernels. This paper rethinks OS performance tunability. We present Xkernel, a system that offers a safe, efficient, and programmable interface for in-situ tuning of any perf-consts directly on a running kernel. Xkernel transforms any perf-const into a tunable knob on demand using a novel approach called Scoped Indirect Execution (SIE). SIE captures precise binary boundaries where a perf-const enters system state and redirects control to synthesized instructions that update the state as if new values were used. Xkernel goes beyond version atomicity when updating perf-consts to guarantee side-effect safety, a property notably absent in existing kernel update mechanisms. Case studies on various OS subsystems demonstrate significant performance benefits of tuning perf-consts which is made possible by Xkernel.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Linux内核中充斥着对系统性能至关重要的常量。这些常量中有许多被称为性能常量（perf-consts），它们是对硬件和工作负载有着脆弱假设的魔数。不幸的是，在已部署的内核上，没有对性能常量的值进行原位调整的能力。本文重新思考了操作系统性能的可调性。我们提出了Xkernel，一个为运行中的内核上的任何性能常量提供安全、高效且可编程的原位调整接口的系统。Xkernel通过一种称为“作用域间接执行”（Scoped Indirect Execution，简称SIE）的方法，按需将任何性能常量转换为可调旋钮。SIE精确捕获性能常量进入系统状态的二进制边界，并将控制流重定向到合成的指令，这些指令更新状态，就像使用了新值一样。在更新性能常量时，Xkernel超越版本原子性，保证副作用安全性——这是现有内核更新机制中明显缺失的属性。对各种操作系统子系统的案例研究表明，Xkernel使得调整性能常量能够带来显著的性能提升。

upstream_only.title: Murakkab: Resource-Efficient Agentic Workflow Orchestration in Cloud Platforms
upstream_only.abstract:
Agentic workflows commonly coordinate multiple models and tools with complex control logic. They are quickly becoming the dominant paradigm for AI applications. However, serving them remains inefficient with today’s frameworks. The key problem is that they expose workflows as opaque sequences of model and tool calls that tightly couple agent logic with model and hardware choices. This prevents systems from holistically reasoning about trade-offs across accuracy, latency, energy, and cost. This leads to resource waste and degraded service-level objectives (SLOs).
We present Murakkab, a resource-efficient serving system for agentic workflows. Murakkab introduces a declarative abstraction that decouples workflow specification from execution configuration. A profile-guided optimizer and adaptive runtime jointly manage the full stack: orchestrating workflow components, mapping them to models and hardware, and dynamically reconfiguring execution to satisfy user-defined SLOs. By exposing the internal structure of agentic workflows, Murakkab enables cross-layer optimization that existing frameworks and cloud schedulers cannot achieve.
Our evaluation on diverse workflows shows that, compared to state-of-the-art systems, Murakkab reduces GPU usage by up to 2.8×, energy consumption by 3.7×, and cost by 4.3× while maintaining SLOs.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 智能体工作流通常以复杂的控制逻辑协调多个模型和工具，正迅速成为AI应用的主导范式。然而，如今的框架在服务它们时仍然效率低下。关键问题在于，这些框架将工作流暴露为模型和工具调用的不透明序列，将智能体逻辑与模型及硬件选择紧密耦合，从而阻止系统对准确性、延迟、能耗和成本之间的权衡进行整体推理，导致资源浪费和服务级目标（SLO）退化。我们提出了Murakkab，一个面向智能体工作流的资源高效服务系统。Murakkab引入了一种声明式抽象，将工作流规范与执行配置解耦。一个基于配置文件的优化器和自适应运行时共同管理整个栈：编排工作流组件，将其映射到模型和硬件，并动态重新配置执行以满足用户定义的SLO。通过暴露智能体工作流的内部结构，Murakkab实现了现有框架和云调度器无法实现的跨层优化。我们对多样化工作流的评估显示，与最先进系统相比，Murakkab在保持SLO的同时，将GPU使用量降低高达2.8倍，能耗降低3.7倍，成本降低4.3倍。

upstream_only.title: ECO: An AI-Driven Code Efficiency Optimizer for Warehouse Scale Computers (Operational Systems)
upstream_only.abstract:
Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown significant promise in automating code efficiency optimization. While prior work demonstrates these techniques on artificial datasets such as programming competitions or small benchmarks, deploying these techniques at scale in production has remained an open problem. Arguably, two challenges have prevented the adoption in large-scale real-world systems: opportunity localization and reliability. First, applying an LLM to every line across a large code base is expensive and prone to generating an overwhelming number of low-quality suggestions, placing unsustainable cognitive load on human code reviewers. Second, the inherent unreliability of LLM-generated code risks introducing errors that can lead to production incidents. These challenges are largely orthogonal to the ML techniques prior work has focused on; they are real-world systems problems.
This paper introduces ECO, a system that automatically modifies source code to improve performance at scale. ECO overcomes the localization problem by combining fleet-wide continuous profiling to identify performance-critical code with an embedding-based search to pinpoint specific optimization candidates, guided by a mined dictionary of performance anti-patterns. It overcomes the reliability problem through a multi-stage verification approach that uses automated testing, LLM-based self-review, and post-deployment monitoring to ensure changes are both correct and effective. Fully productionized and deployed within Google’s hyperscale production fleet, ECO has successfully landed over 6,400 commits, changing more than 25,000 lines of production code. Incorrect changes are caught before they are submitted to production, and 99.5% of the submitted commits did not cause any rollbacks. These optimizations have resulted in savings equivalent to several hundred thousand normalized CPU cores, showing that ECO makes LLM-based optimization both practical at scale and highly impactful in real-world settings.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在自动化代码效率优化方面展现了显著潜力。虽然先前的工作在人工数据集（如编程竞赛或小型基准）上展示了这些技术，但在生产中大规模部署这些技术仍然是一个未解决的问题。可以说，有两个挑战阻碍了在大型真实世界系统中的采纳：机会定位和可靠性。首先，将LLM应用于大型代码库的每一行代码成本高昂，并且容易产生大量低质量建议，给人工代码审查者带来不可持续的认知负担。其次，LLM生成代码固有的不可靠性有可能引入导致生产事故的错误。这些挑战在很大程度上与先前工作所关注的机器学习技术无关；它们是现实世界的系统问题。本文介绍了ECO，一个自动修改源代码以大规模提升性能的系统。ECO通过结合整个机群的持续性能剖析来识别性能关键代码，并利用嵌入搜索在挖掘出的性能反模式词典指导下精确定位候选优化点，从而克服了定位问题。它通过多阶段验证方法克服了可靠性问题，该方法使用自动化测试、基于LLM的自审和部署后监控来确保更改既正确又有效。ECO已在Google的超大规模生产机群中完全投入生产并部署，成功落地了超过6400个提交，更改了超过25000行生产代码。错误的更改在提交到生产环境之前就被捕获，99.5%的已提交未引起任何回滚。这些优化节省了相当于数十万个标准化CPU内核的计算资源，表明ECO使基于LLM的优化在大规模生产中既实用又具有高度影响力。

upstream_only.title: StriaTrace: Efficient Tracing and Diagnosis for Online LLM Inference (Operational Systems)
upstream_only.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) inference services in production operate under stringent, fine-grained Service Level Objectives (SLOs). Unlike throughput-oriented LLM training, even sporadic performance anomalies during inference can violate SLOs, underscoring the need for improved tracing and diagnosis solutions. However, existing solutions face two primary limitations: (1) existing tracing tools incur prohibitive overhead; (2) training-centric diagnosis tools are ill-suited for capturing sporadic inference anomalies. To bridge these gaps, we propose StriaTrace, a novel tracing and diagnosis system tailored for online LLM inference. StriaTrace is built upon three principles distilled from production experience: (1) tracing key synchronization points, (2) tracing critical paths, and (3) detailed tracing only during abnormalities. StriaTrace further constructs a dynamic regression-based roofline model and correlation-based diagnosis to identify why each LLM inference abnormality happens. Evaluations show that StriaTrace reduces tracing overhead by 97.8% relative to alternatives. StriaTrace has been widely used in our development, testing, and production release cycles, and has successfully diagnosed hundreds of abnormalities spanning 19 distinct root causes.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 生产环境中的大型语言模型（LLM）推理服务在严格的、细粒度的服务等级目标（SLO）下运行。与面向吞吐量的LLM训练不同，推理过程中即使是偶发的性能异常也可能违反SLO，这凸显了改进追踪和诊断解决方案的必要性。然而，现有解决方案面临两个主要限制：（1）现有追踪工具会产生过高的开销；（2）以训练为中心的诊断工具不适合捕获偶发的推理异常。为了弥补这些差距，我们提出了StriaTrace，一种专为在线LLM推理定制的全新追踪与诊断系统。StriaTrace建立在从生产经验中提炼的三条原则之上：（1）追踪关键同步点，（2）追踪关键路径，（3）仅在异常期间进行详细追踪。StriaTrace还构建了一个基于动态回归的屋顶线模型和基于相关性的诊断方法，以识别每次LLM推理异常发生的原因。评估表明，与替代方案相比，StriaTrace将追踪开销降低了97.8%。StriaTrace已广泛用于我们的开发、测试和生产发布周期，并成功诊断了涵盖19种不同根本原因的数百个异常。

upstream_only.title: Diagnosing Performance Issues in Application-Defined Resources
upstream_only.abstract:
Many performance issues in large software systems are caused by application-defined resources, such as buffer pools, query caches, and temporary data structures. These resources are managed within the application logic and can strongly affect program execution. However, their resource-specific semantics are often not visible through system-level metrics. As a result, inefficient designs in the management of these resources can cause performance degradation that is difficult to observe and diagnose with existing profilers.
This paper presents gigiprofiler, a profiler that diagnoses performance problems caused by application-defined resources. gigiprofiler uses a hybrid method that combines LLM-based semantic inference with static analysis: LLM identifies candidate application-defined resources and their usage events from semantic cues, while static analysis validates these candidates against the code. gigiprofiler then tracks how each request interacts with inferred resources and records usage events at runtime. gigiprofiler detects bottlenecks from aggregate usage events and attributes each resource bottleneck to responsible requests and links the runtime evidence back to code paths to explain how the bottleneck occurs.
We evaluated gigiprofiler on 15 real-world performance issues in five widely deployed applications. gigiprofiler detects and diagnoses all 15 issues and further uncovers two previously unknown performance issues in MariaDB, both later confirmed by the developers.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大型软件系统中的许多性能问题是由应用程序定义的资源引起的，例如缓冲池、查询缓存和临时数据结构。这些资源在应用程序逻辑中管理，并能强烈影响程序执行。然而，它们特定于资源的语义通常无法通过系统级指标可见。因此，这些资源管理中的低效设计可能导致性能下降，而现有的分析器很难观察和诊断这些问题。本文介绍了 gigiprofiler，一个诊断由应用程序定义资源引起的性能问题的分析器。gigiprofiler 使用结合基于 LLM 的语义推理和静态分析的混合方法：LLM 从语义线索中识别候选的应用程序定义资源及其使用事件，而静态分析则根据代码验证这些候选。然后 gigiprofiler 跟踪每个请求如何与推断的资源交互，并在运行时记录使用事件。gigiprofiler 从聚合的使用事件中检测瓶颈，并将每个资源瓶颈归因于负责的请求，并将运行时的证据链接回代码路径以解释瓶颈是如何发生的。我们在五个广泛部署的应用程序中的 15 个真实性能问题上评估了 gigiprofiler。gigiprofiler 检测并诊断了所有 15 个问题，还进一步发现了 MariaDB 中两个先前未知的性能问题，这两个问题后来都得到了开发人员的确认。

upstream_only.title: hS: Speculative Script Reordering at Subprocess Granularity
upstream_only.abstract: Shell scripts are pervasive, acting as the glue between commands and subprocesses that are written in a variety of languages and perform complex, system-wide effects. Given the black-box nature of these subprocesses, all work that optimizes script performance until now has relied on handwritten annotations that describe subprocess effects. In this paper we introduce hS, a system that brings out-of-order, speculative execution to scripts that invoke subprocesses without requiring any user input or annotations about them. hS speculatively executes command instances—typically simple commands, pipelines, or small synchronization regions—dynamically detecting their effects: blocking unsafe ones, like network accesses, and selectively committing independent effects, like file writes, given no conflicts. On a wide range of real-world scripts, hS offers up to 9.3× speedups compared to bash, and up to 7× speedups over PaSh—all while not requiring any developer involvement or command annotations.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Shell脚本无处不在，充当命令与子进程之间的粘合剂，这些子进程以多种语言编写并执行复杂的系统级影响。鉴于这些子进程的黑盒特性，迄今为止所有优化脚本性能的工作都依赖于描述子进程效果的手写注释。本文介绍了hS，一个将乱序、推测性执行引入调用子进程的脚本的系统，无需任何用户输入或关于子进程的注释。hS推测性地执行命令实例（通常是简单命令、管道或小的同步区域），动态检测它们的效果：阻止不安全的操作（如网络访问），并在无冲突的情况下选择性提交独立的效果（如文件写入）。在广泛的真实世界脚本上，与bash相比，hS提供了高达9.3倍的加速，比PaSh提供了高达7倍的加速——而且无需任何开发人员参与或命令注释。

upstream_only.title: Incr: Faster Re-Execution via Bolt-On Incrementalization
upstream_only.abstract: While most software development is incremental, most execution environments are not: even small program modifications fail to take advantage of prior executions, at worst requiring full re-execution of all computational stages in the modified program. Such full re-execution decelerates software development and debugging, especially in dynamic polyglot environments such as the Unix and Linux shell. This paper presents Incr, a system that accelerates the re-execution of unmodified shell programs by automatically incrementalizing their execution. Incr analyzes and tracks interdependencies to detect and store key intermediate results, reusing them on subsequent re-executions whenever possible. Incr’s effect analysis supports correct re-execution even for non-idempotent computations, and several static and dynamic optimizations reduce the runtime and storage overheads of incrementalization. Applied to diverse real-world scenarios, Incr accelerates re-execution by an average of 34.2× and a maximum of 373.3×—all while requiring no developer annotations or code modifications and remaining behaviorally indistinguishable on over 10,000 test cases.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 尽管大多数软件开发是增量的，但大多数执行环境并非如此：即使是微小的程序修改也无法利用先前的执行，最坏情况下需要完整重新执行修改后程序的所有计算阶段。这种完全重新执行会拖慢软件开发和调试，尤其是在Unix和Linux shell等动态多语言环境中。本文介绍了Incr，一个通过自动增量执行来加速未修改shell程序的系统。Incr分析并跟踪依赖关系以检测和存储关键中间结果，并在后续重新执行时尽可能重用它们。Incr的效果分析即使对于非幂等计算也能支持正确的重新执行，多种静态和动态优化降低了增量执行的运行时和存储开销。应用于多样化的真实场景中，Incr平均加速重新执行34.2倍，最大加速达373.3倍——且无需任何开发人员注释或代码修改，并在超过10，000个测试用例上保持行为上的不可区分性。

upstream_only.title: A Compilation-Based Under-Constrained Execution Engine
upstream_only.abstract: Software bugs continue to pose significant challenges to the security and correctness of computer systems. Finding and eliminating bugs for large-scale software systems, such as the Linux kernel, remains a difficult task. Static analyses can cover the whole codebase, but often produce too many false positives. Whole program dynamic testing is precise but has limited code coverage, and could require special environments. Due to the modular design of large software systems, a promising alternative is to instantiate an execution environment for individual components in isolation, and then apply precise dynamic analyses to these components. Unfortunately, existing execution engines that support such under-constrained execution are all interpreter-based, thus suffering from poor scalability. In this paper, we introduce UCSan, a compilation-based under-constrained execution engine that can compile an arbitrary set of C/C++ functions into a self-contained executable without manual modifications. To demonstrate the scalability and versatility of UCSan, we showcase combining UCSan with a compilation-based concolic execution engine to conduct under-constrained symbolic execution. Our evaluation shows that the resulting analysis engine is up to 15.06x faster on Linux kernel analysis tasks than the KLEE-based engine. This enhanced scalability not only improves the bug detection effectiveness but also enables its application across a broader range of software systems.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 软件缺陷持续对计算机系统的安全性和正确性构成重大挑战。对于Linux内核等大型软件系统，查找和消除缺陷仍然是一项艰巨的任务。静态分析可以覆盖整个代码库，但往往产生过多误报。全程序动态测试虽然精确，但代码覆盖率有限，并且可能需要特殊环境。由于大型软件系统的模块化设计，一个很有前景的替代方案是为单个组件单独实例化执行环境，然后对这些组件应用精确的动态分析。不幸的是，支持这种欠约束执行的现有执行引擎都是基于解释器的，因此扩展性差。在本文中，我们介绍了UCSan，一种基于编译的欠约束执行引擎，可以将任意一组C/C++函数编译成自包含的可执行文件，无需手动修改。为了展示UCSan的扩展性和通用性，我们演示了将UCSan与基于编译的混合执行引擎相结合，以进行欠约束符号执行。我们的评估表明，在Linux内核分析任务中，所得到的分析引擎比基于KLEE的引擎快达15.06倍。这种增强的扩展性不仅提高了缺陷检测的有效性，还使其能够应用于更广泛的软件系统。

upstream_only.title: Aletheia: Automated Detection of Data Integrity Violations in Microservices
upstream_only.abstract:
The decomposition of applications into microservices results in data being stored across heterogeneous systems, with data schemas partitioned and managed by separate services. As the size and complexity of microservice deployments grow, the consistency of data associations at the application level can be overlooked, and it becomes challenging to manually identify data integrity violations.
In this paper, we present a systematic approach for identifying semantic violations in microservice ecosystems, namely operations and service interactions that break data integrity. We formalize these violations by leveraging the Entity-Relationship model and relational algebra to characterize problematic operation patterns across distributed services. We then introduce Aletheia, a static analysis tool that operationalizes this framework, using the static single assignment (SSA) representation to track data flow and a novel abstract call graph to detect integrity violations. We evaluate Aletheia on 7 open-source applications, detecting 46 previously unreported integrity violations, and use production-scale synthetic applications to demonstrate scalability to large call graphs with up to 500 microservices.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 将应用程序拆分为微服务会导致数据存储在异构系统中，数据模式由各个服务分区和管理。随着微服务部署的规模和复杂性增长，应用程序级别的数据关联一致性可能被忽视，手动识别数据完整性违规变得具有挑战性。在本文中，我们提出了一种系统方法，用于识别微服务生态系统中的语义违规，即破坏数据完整性的操作和服务交互。我们利用实体-关系模型和关系代数来形式化这些违规，以描述跨分布式服务的有问题的操作模式。然后，我们介绍了Aletheia，一个静态分析工具，它使用静态单赋值（SSA）表示来跟踪数据流，并使用新颖的抽象调用图来检测完整性违规，从而实现了该框架。我们在7个开源应用程序上评估了Aletheia，检测到46个先前未报告的完整性违规，并使用生产级合成应用程序证明了其可扩展性，可扩展到多达500个微服务的大型调用图。

upstream_only.title: Arctic: A Practical Lock-Free Adaptive Radix Tree
upstream_only.abstract: Indexing data structures are vital to the modern systems ecosystem, but there are no indexes that offer high performance, lock freedom, and range scans. Arctic is a lock-free adaptive radix tree that achieves all three: Arctic outcompetes lock-based indexes, including a concurrent hash map, on many YCSB configurations, guarantees non-blocking operation through careful metadata layout and an (eponymous) freezing-based coordination protocol, and offers non-linearizable range and prefix scans. Arctic also contributes a novel safe memory reclamation scheme that uses operation keys to approximate reachable pointers. We integrate Arctic into RocksDB and Turso, improving throughput up to 40% and 12% on their write-heavy benchmarks relative to their default skiplist indexes.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 索引数据结构对现代系统生态系统至关重要，但目前还没有同时具备高性能、无锁操作和范围扫描能力的索引。Arctic是一种无锁的自适应基数树，它同时实现了这三个目标：在许多YCSB配置下，Arctic的性能优于基于锁的索引（包括并发哈希表）；通过精心的元数据布局和一种（同名的）基于冻结的协调协议，它保证了无阻塞操作；并且它提供了不可线性化的范围和前缀扫描。Arctic还贡献了一种新颖的安全内存回收方案，该方案使用操作键来近似可达指针。我们将Arctic集成到RocksDB和Turso中，在它们的写密集型基准测试中，相对于它们默认的跳表索引，吞吐量分别提升了40%和12%。

upstream_only.title: Efficient and Scalable Synchronization via Generalized Cache Coherence
upstream_only.abstract:
We explore the design of efficient and scalable synchronization for disaggregated shared memory. Porting existing synchronization primitives to such architectures results in poor performance scaling due to redundant inter-cache communications, exacerbated by high cache-coherence latency in disaggregated shared memory.
Driven by our insight that synchronization is a generalization of cache coherence in time and space, we argue for minimally extending existing cache coherence protocols to support synchronization primitives, thereby eliminating the redundant inter-cache communication inherent in layered synchronization. We propose a novel Generalized cache-Coherence Protocol (GCP) that realizes this insight by leveraging wait queues and variable-size cache lines directly at the cache-coherence layer for temporal and spatial generalization, respectively. We have verified GCP’s correctness using model checking. We present Soul, an end-to-end system implementation of GCP atop a disaggregated shared-memory platform. Soul supports popular lock APIs through a user-space library that offers improved performance without requiring any changes to application code. Our evaluation of Soul against state-of-the-art locks shows that it improves the performance of unmodified real-world applications at scale by 1–2 orders of magnitude while incurring <8% storage overhead.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们探索了针对分解式共享内存的高效且可扩展的同步设计。将现有的同步原语移植到此类架构中，会因冗余的缓存间通信而导致性能扩展不佳，而分解式共享内存中高延迟的缓存一致性又加剧了这一问题。基于我们的洞察——同步在时间和空间上是缓存一致性的泛化——我们主张在最小编程范围内扩展现有的缓存一致性协议以支持同步原语，从而消除分层同步中固有的冗余缓存间通信。我们提出了一种新颖的广义缓存一致性协议（GCP），该协议通过在缓存一致性层直接利用等待队列和可变大小缓存行来实现时间和空间上的泛化。我们已使用模型检查验证了GCP的正确性。我们提出了Soul，一种在分解式共享内存平台上实现GCP的端到端系统。Soul通过用户态库支持流行的锁API，无需应用程序代码修改即可提供改进的性能。我们与最先进的锁进行的评估表明，Soul能够让未经修改的真实应用在大规模部署下的性能提升1至2个数量级，同时引入的存储开销低于8%。

upstream_only.title: Shaving the Peaks: Taming Tail Latency for Managed Workloads via Disaggregated Garbage Collection
upstream_only.abstract:
Language runtimes are essential systems commonly used in multi-tenant cloud scenarios, such as interactive web services and other cloud workloads. They usually provide memory management services, or garbage collection (GC), to automatically reclaim memory and reduce the labor work of application developers. Recent concurrent collectors allow GC to co-run with application threads (mutators), which reduces application pauses and intends to improve the applications’ tail latency. However, this work observes that periodic GC workloads remain a primary source of long tail latency, particularly in resource-constrained multi-tenant environments. In such settings, GC threads consume significant CPU resources, leading to severe performance contention with mutators.
To resolve the contention, this work presents DGC, a disaggregated GC architecture that exposes GC as an external service. DGC decouples the most costly marking phase in concurrent GC and offloads it to a disaggregated marking engine. Through a co-design of the GC marking algorithm and an RDMA-based software paging mechanism, DGC’s disaggregated marking engine achieves performance on par with local execution while offloading marking to a remote node. To improve resource utilization, DGC introduces a global GC orchestrator to serve multiple runtimes while minimizing the conflicts due to the overlapping of individual GC triggering points. DGC is implemented on the OpenJDK HotSpot Java virtual machine, and the evaluation results on representative latency-sensitive applications show that DGC reduces P99 latency by up to 64.4% under moderate workloads and improves the peak goodput by up to 24.0%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 用户生成内容网站通常会屏蔽来自Tor等隐私增强代理用户的贡献，因为人们认为这些代理是破坏、垃圾邮件和滥用的来源。尽管这类屏蔽可能有效，但未实现的匿名寻求者有价值贡献这一附带损害却是不可见的。维基百科作为最大和最重要的用户生成内容网站之一，早在2005年就尝试屏蔽Tor用户的贡献。我们证明这些屏蔽并不完善，并且有成千上万次通过Tor编辑维基百科的尝试获得了成功。我们利用多个数据源和分析技术，对Tor用户在维基百科上的编辑历史进行了随时间变化的测量和描述，并将Tor用户的贡献与其他维基百科用户群体的贡献进行比较。我们的分析表明，虽然绕过维基百科禁令的Tor用户所贡献的内容更可能被回退，也更可能回退他人的编辑，但除此之外，他们的贡献质量与其他未注册参与者以及注册用户的初始贡献相似。

upstream_only.title: DeLFS: A Decentralized Log-Structured File System for Manycores
upstream_only.abstract: This paper introduces DeLFS, a novel decentralized log-structured file system (LFS) designed for manycore scalability. DeLFS decentralizes metadata/data organization and management with an LFS-aware decentralized locking scheme that distributes lock ownership to eliminate global contention. In addition, DeLFS disentangles the critical path from the deferrable path to further increase concurrency. We implement DeLFS with three techniques in the Linux kernel and evaluate it on a 128-core machine. The experimental results show that DeLFS outperforms F2FS, MAX, and F2FSJ by up to 4.34×, 4.29×, and 4.50×, respectively, and delivers up to 2.00× higher sustained performance than ScaleLFS.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了DeLFS，一种新颖的面向众核可扩展性的去中心化日志结构化文件系统（LFS）。DeLFS通过一种LFS感知的去中心化锁机制来实现元数据/数据组织与管理的去中心化，该机制通过分散锁所有权来消除全局竞争。此外，DeLFS将关键路径与可延迟路径解耦，以进一步提高并发性。我们在Linux内核中用三种技术实现了DeLFS，并在128核机器上进行了评估。实验结果表明，DeLFS相比F2FS、MAX和F2FSJ分别最高提升了4.34倍、4.29倍和4.50倍，并且其持续性能比ScaleLFS高出达2.00倍。

upstream_only.title: Weave: Efficient Co-Scheduling for Disaggregated RL Post-Training
upstream_only.abstract: Rollout–training disaggregation is emerging as the standard architecture for Reinforcement Learning (RL) post-training, where memory-bound rollout and compute-bound training are physically disaggregated onto purpose-built clusters to maximize hardware efficiency. However, the strict synchronization required by on-policy algorithms introduces severe dependency bubbles, forcing one cluster to idle while the dependent phase is running on the other. We present WEAVE, a cluster scheduling framework that reclaims these bubbles through cross-cluster orchestration. WEAVE is built on the insight that the structural idleness of one job can be effectively utilized by the active phase of another. To realize this, we introduce the co-execution group abstraction, which partitions the cluster into isolated locality domains. This abstraction enables a two-tier scheduling architecture: an inter-group scheduler that optimizes job placement using conservative stochastic planning, and an intra-group scheduler that orchestrates a provably optimal round-robin schedule. The group abstraction also imposes a residency constraint, ensuring that massive model states remain cached in host memory to enable “warm-start” context switching. We evaluate WEAVE on a production-scale testbed with 328 H20 and 328 H800 GPUs. WEAVE improves cost efficiency by 1.84× over standard disaggregation and 1.38× over state-of-the-art co-located baselines, all while achieving 100% SLO attainment.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 推出（rollout）与训练（training）的解聚正在成为强化学习（RL）后训练的标准架构，其中内存密集的推出任务和计算密集的训练任务被物理地分离到专用集群上，以最大化硬件效率。然而，同策略算法所要求的严格同步引入了严重的依赖气泡，导致一个集群在另一个集群运行依赖阶段时空闲。我们提出了WEAVE，一个通过跨集群编排来回收这些气泡的集群调度框架。WEAVE的核心洞见是：一个作业的结构性空闲可以被另一个作业的活动阶段有效利用。为此，我们引入了共同执行组（co-execution group）抽象，它将集群划分为隔离的局部性域。该抽象支持一种两层调度架构：组间调度器使用保守随机规划优化作业放置，组内调度器则编排一个可证明最优的轮询调度。组抽象还施加了驻留约束，确保大型模型状态保留在主机内存缓存中，从而实现“热启动”上下文切换。我们在包含328块H20和328块H800 GPU的生产规模测试平台上对WEAVE进行了评估。相对于标准解聚，WEAVE将成本效率提高了1.84倍；相对于最先进的共置基线，提高了1.38倍，同时实现了100%的服务水平目标（SLO）达成率。

upstream_only.title: RLinf: Flexible and Efficient Large-Scale Reinforcement Learning via Macro-to-Micro Flow Transformation
upstream_only.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has demonstrated immense potential in advancing artificial general intelligence, agentic intelligence, and embodied intelligence. However, the inherent heterogeneity and dynamicity of RL workflows often lead to low hardware utilization and slow training on existing systems. In this paper, we present RLinf, a high-performance RL training system based on our key observation that the major roadblock to efficient RL training lies in system flexibility. To maximize flexibility and efficiency, RLinf is built atop a novel RL system design paradigm called macro-to-micro flow transformation (M2Flow), which automatically breaks down high-level, easy-to-compose RL workflows at both the temporal and spatial dimensions, and recomposes them into optimized execution flows. Supported by Rinf worker’s adaptive communication capability, we devise context switching and elastic pipelining to realize M2Flow transformation, and a profiling-guided scheduling policy to generate optimal execution plans. Extensive evaluations on both reasoning RL and embodied RL tasks demonstrate that Rinf consistently outperforms state-of-the-art systems, achieving 1.07×∼2.43× speedup in end-to-end training throughput.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）在推进通用人工智能、智能体智能和具身智能方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，RL工作流固有的异构性和动态性往往导致现有系统硬件利用率低、训练速度慢。本文提出RLinf，一个高性能强化学习训练系统，其核心观察是：高效RL训练的主要障碍在于系统灵活性。为了最大化灵活性和效率，RLinf基于一种名为“宏到微流程转换”（M2Flow）的新型RL系统设计范式构建，该范式在时间和空间维度上自动分解高层、易于组合的RL工作流，并将它们重新组合为优化的执行流程。依托RLinf worker的自适应通信能力，我们设计了上下文切换和弹性流水线以实现M2Flow转换，并采用基于配置的调度策略生成最优执行计划。在推理型RL和具身型RL任务上的广泛评估表明，RLinf持续优于最先进系统，端到端训练吞吐量提升了1.07倍至2.43倍。

upstream_only.title: DynaRL: Flexible and Dynamic Scheduling of Large-Scale Reinforcement Learning Training
upstream_only.abstract: Modern reinforcement learning (RL) workloads, powering large language models, long‑horizon reasoning, and agentic systems, exhibit extreme dynamicity due to heavy‑tailed rollouts, irregular multi‑turn tool interactions, and time‑varying bottlenecks. Static resource allocations in today’s distributed RL systems leave large fractions of compute idle and prolong training. This paper presents DynaRL, the first RL system that dynamically reallocates computation, memory, and communication resources across heterogeneous RL components. DynaRL models the entire RL pipeline with a dynamic hypergraph that serves as a centralized, continuously-evolving control surface. Supported by a unified resource migration interface and context‑aware data routing, the scheduler reallocates GPUs from overprovisioned components to the current bottleneck via a combination of a multi-level scheduling algorithm and fine-grained resource migration. Comprehensive evaluation demonstrates that DynaRL improves end-to-end throughput on math-reasoning and agentic RL workloads by up to 1.98×, with negligible online scheduling overhead.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代强化学习（RL）工作负载为大语言模型、长时推理和智能体系统提供支持，由于重尾的轨迹生成、不规则的多轮工具交互以及随时间变化的瓶颈，这些工作负载表现出极大的动态性。当今分布式RL系统中的静态资源分配使得大量计算资源闲置并延长训练时间。本文提出了DynaRL，这是首个在不同RL组件之间动态重新分配计算、内存和通信资源的RL系统。DynaRL使用动态超图对整个RL流程进行建模，该超图作为集中式、持续演变的控制面。在统一资源迁移接口和上下文感知数据路由的支持下，调度器通过多级调度算法与细粒度资源迁移的结合，将GPU从过量配置的组件重新分配到当前瓶颈。综合评估表明，DynaRL在数学推理和智能体RL工作负载上可将端到端吞吐量提升高达1.98倍，且在线调度开销可忽略不计。

upstream_only.title: RollArt: Disaggregated Multi-Task Agentic RL Training at Scale
upstream_only.abstract:
Agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL) trains LLMs through multi-turn interactions with environments, producing workloads that mix compute-bound prefill, bandwidth-bound decoding, CPU-heavy environment execution, and bursty reward evaluation. Existing systems either colocate all stages on a single GPU cluster or decouple them only at a coarse granularity, overlooking hardware heterogeneity and incurring substantial synchronization overhead across stages.
We present ROLLART, a system for multi-task agentic RL on disaggregated infrastructure. ROLLART maps each pipeline stage to best-fit hardware, routing prefill-heavy tasks to compute-optimized GPUs, decode-heavy tasks to bandwidth-optimized GPUs, and environments to CPU clusters. It decouples rollout at the trajectory level, allowing generation, environment interaction, and reward scoring to proceed independently, so that slow or failed environments never block the others. ROLLART offloads stateless reward computation to serverless infrastructure and overlaps rollout with training via staleness-bounded asynchronous weight synchronization. Our results demonstrate that ROLLART effectively improves training throughput and achieves 1.31–2.05× training time reduction compared to various RL systems. We also evaluated ROLLART by training a hundreds-of-billions-parameter MoE model for Qoder product on an Alibaba cluster with above 3,000 GPUs, demonstrating its stability and scalability.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 智能体强化学习（Agentic RL）通过与环境的多轮交互来训练大语言模型，产生的工作负载混合了计算密集的预填充阶段、带宽受限的解码阶段、CPU密集的环境执行以及突发的奖励评估。现有系统要么将所有阶段部署在单一GPU集群上，要么仅以粗粒度进行解耦，忽视了硬件异构性并导致跨阶段大量同步开销。我们提出了ROLLART，一个用于解聚式基础设施上多任务智能体强化学习的系统。ROLLART将每个流水线阶段映射到最合适的硬件上，将预填充密集型任务路由到计算优化GPU，解码密集型任务路由到带宽优化GPU，环境任务路由到CPU集群。它在轨迹级别上解耦环境交互，使得生成、环境交互和奖励评分能够独立进行，从而缓慢或失败的环境不会阻塞其他环境。ROLLART将无状态奖励计算卸载到无服务器基础设施，并通过有界陈旧性的异步权重同步将环境交互与训练重叠。我们的结果表明，ROLLART有效提高了训练吞吐量，相比各种RL系统实现了1.31–2.05倍的训练时间缩减。我们还通过在阿里巴巴一个超过3000个GPU的集群上为Qoder产品训练一个数千亿参数的MoE模型来评估ROLLART，证明了其稳定性和可扩展性。

upstream_only.title: Seer: Online Context Learning for Fast Synchronous LLM Reinforcement Learning
upstream_only.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a critical technique for advancing modern Large Language Models (LLMs), yet existing synchronous RL systems face severe performance bottlenecks. The rollout phase, which dominates end-to-end iteration time, suffers from substantial long-tail latency and poor resource utilization due to inherent workload imbalance. We present Seer, a novel context learning RL system that addresses these challenges through a key observation: requests sharing the same prompt exhibit strong similarities in output lengths and response patterns. Leveraging this insight, Seer introduces three coordinated techniques: (1) divided rollout for dynamic load balancing, (2) context-aware scheduling to mitigate long-tail request delays, and (3) adaptive grouped speculative decoding to accelerate generation. These mechanisms work in concert to markedly reduce long-tail latency and improve resource efficiency during rollout. Evaluations on production-grade RL workloads demonstrate that Seer achieves up to 2.04× end-to-end rollout throughput improvement compared to the state-of-the-art synchronous RL systems, while notably reducing long-tail latency by 72–94%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）已成为推动现代大型语言模型（LLM）发展的关键技术，然而现有的同步RL系统面临严重的性能瓶颈。在端到端迭代时间中占主导地位的rollout阶段，由于固有的工作负载不平衡，遭受了严重的尾部延迟和资源利用率低下。我们提出了Seer，一种新颖的上下文学习RL系统，通过一个关键观察来解决这些挑战：共享相同提示的请求在输出长度和响应模式上表现出强烈的相似性。利用这一见解，Seer引入了三种协调技术：（1）分段rollout以实现动态负载均衡，（2）上下文感知调度以缓解尾部请求延迟，（3）自适应分组推测解码以加速生成。这些机制协同工作，显著减少了rollout过程中的尾部延迟并提高了资源效率。在生产级RL工作负载上的评估表明，与最先进的同步RL系统相比，Seer实现了高达2.04倍的端到端rollout吞吐量提升，同时将尾部延迟显著降低了72-94%。

upstream_only.title: Harvesting Sub-Microsecond CXL Memory Stalls with LiteSwitch
upstream_only.abstract: Compute Express Link (CXL) offers a practical path to scale memory capacity and bandwidth available to a single host. However, CXL memory incurs sub-microsecond latency that is typically 3× or more compared to local memory, exacerbating memory-induced CPU stalls and degrading application performance. This paper presents LiteSwitch, a lightweight hardware-software co-design that opportunistically harvests otherwise idle cycles caused by CXL memory accesses. LiteSwitch introduces: (1) a hardware mechanism that precisely identifies a CXL-induced memory stall and exposes it to software with near-perfect accuracy and minimal overhead; (2) an ultra-fast software path that switches to another ready thread for harvesting in under 20 nanoseconds, an order of magnitude faster than conventional context switches. Together, these mechanisms enable efficient harvesting of sub-μs-scale memory stalls (>200 nanoseconds), without requiring changes to the application. The evaluation demonstrates that with a sufficient number of available threads per core, LiteSwitch recovers up to 80% of the performance lost due to CXL access latency, enabling the adoption of CXL memory without prohibitive slowdowns.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Compute Express Link (CXL) 为扩展单主机可用的内存容量和带宽提供了一条实用途径。然而，CXL 内存产生的亚微秒延迟通常是本地内存的 3 倍或更高，这会加剧内存引起的 CPU 停顿并降低应用程序性能。本文介绍了 LiteSwitch，一种轻量级的软硬件协同设计，它机会性地利用 CXL 内存访问引起的空闲周期。LiteSwitch 引入了：(1) 一种硬件机制，能够精确识别 CXL 引起的内存停顿，并以接近完美的准确度和极低开销将其暴露给软件；(2) 一条超快软件路径，可在 20 纳秒内切换到另一个就绪线程以利用这些周期，比传统上下文切换快一个数量级。这些机制共同实现了对亚微秒级（超过 200 纳秒）内存停顿的高效利用，且无需修改应用程序。评估表明，在每核拥有足够可用线程的情况下，LiteSwitch 可以恢复因 CXL 访问延迟而损失的多达 80% 的性能，从而使采用 CXL 内存不会带来令人望而却步的减速。

upstream_only.title: Duhu: Shared Disaggregated Memory for Distributed Data Processing Frameworks
upstream_only.abstract: Today’s distributed data processing frameworks (DDFs) have large memory and network transfer overheads because these frameworks require that each node (server or VM) copy objects into local memory before processing. Emerging shared disaggregated memory (SDM) clusters enable an alternate approach because they allow nodes to access data in a shared memory. However, using SDMs for DDFs is challenging: current SDM clusters provide weak coherence guarantees, and even for emerging SDMs coherence poses a scalability and complexity challenge. Thus, to adopt SDMs, a DDF would need to modify its logic and implement software coordination. In this paper, we describe Duhu, an SDM-based object store that is designed to allow DDFs to use SDMs without these changes, simplifying their adoption. We have integrated Duhu with Ray, and evaluated our system on an SDM cluster with a prototype CXL-attached memory pool. We show that Duhu can improve job completion time (JCT) by up to 3.39× on a shuffle workload.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 当今的分布式数据处理框架（DDFs）具有较大的内存和网络传输开销，因为这些框架要求每个节点（服务器或虚拟机）在处理之前将对象复制到本地内存。新兴的共享分解内存（SDM）集群提供了一种替代方法，因为它们允许节点访问共享内存中的数据。然而，将SDM用于DDFs具有挑战性：当前的SDM集群提供较弱的连贯性保证，即使对于新兴的SDM，连贯性也带来了可扩展性和复杂性的挑战。因此，为了采用SDM，DDF需要修改其逻辑并实现软件协调。在本文中，我们描述了Duhu，一个基于SDM的对象存储，旨在让DDF无需这些更改即可使用SDM，从而简化其采用。我们已将Duhu与Ray集成，并在带有原型CXL附加内存池的SDM集群上评估了我们的系统。我们表明，Duhu在shuffle工作负载上可以将作业完成时间（JCT）提高最多3.39倍。

upstream_only.title: Blowfish: Elastic Virtual Machine Memory for Disaggregated Memory
upstream_only.abstract: Cold memory rebalancing exhibits unique challenges to the existing memory overcommitment mechanisms, such as page tracking under Transparent Huge Pages (THP) and frequent remapping of page tables, leading to a series of throughput and latency issues. In this paper, we propose Blowfish, a memory overcommitment framework built on disaggregated memory, performing cold (and free) memory reclamation and restoration at μs-scale. Based on paravirtualization, Blowfish leverages a lightweight guest-level THP-aware hotness tracker to monitor page access and let the hypervisor directly reclaim and reallocate host physical memory across VMs with a dedicated cross-layer path for cold memory, bypassing the modifications of guest page table and modifications of I/O page table while benefiting from the rich program semantics of guest VM when recognizing the cold memory. As a result, Blowfish significantly speeds up the page reclamation and restoration, 2.48× and 2.14× faster than the state-of-the-art solution, HyperAlloc, respectively, and improves memory reclamation ratios by 1.6×-6.1× within 5% performance degradation.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 冷内存重新平衡对现有内存超卖机制提出了独特挑战，例如透明大页（THP）下的页面跟踪以及页表的频繁重映射，从而导致一系列吞吐量和延迟问题。在本文中，我们提出了Blowfish，一个构建在分解内存上的内存超卖框架，能在微秒级执行冷（和空闲）内存回收与恢复。基于半虚拟化，Blowfish利用一个轻量级的访客级THP感知热度跟踪器来监控页面访问，并让Hypervisor通过一条专用的跨层路径直接跨虚拟机回收和重新分配主机物理内存，从而绕过访客页表和I/O页表的修改，同时在识别冷内存时受益于访客虚拟机的丰富程序语义。因此，Blowfish显著加速了页面回收和恢复，分别比最先进的解决方案HyperAlloc快2.48倍和2.14倍，并且在5%的性能下降内将内存回收率提高了1.6倍至6.1倍。

upstream_only.title: Espresso: Constructing Cost-Efficient CXL JBOF via Inter-SSD Computing Resource Sharing
upstream_only.abstract: Enterprise SSDs integrate substantial computing resources (e.g., ARM processor and onboard DRAM) to handle I/O bursts. However, these resources significantly raise SSD monetary cost and suffer severely underutilized in JBOF deployments due to the sporadic nature of I/O bursts. In this paper, we present Espresso, a cost-efficient JBOF design that provisions only moderate computing resources per SSD at low monetary cost, while delivering demanded I/O performance through efficient inter-SSD resource sharing. Specifically, Espresso first disaggregates SSD architecture into functionally distinct components, enabling fine-grained SSD internal resource management. Espresso then employs a decentralized scheme to manage these disaggregated resources and harvests the computing resources of idle SSDs to assist busy SSDs in handling I/O bursts. This idea is facilitated by the cache-coherent CXL fabric, with which the busy SSDs can directly utilize the harvested computing resources to accelerate metadata processing. The evaluation results show that Espresso can improve SSD resource utilization by 50.4% and reduce monetary cost by 19.0% with negligible performance degradation, compared to the state-of-the-art JBOF designs.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 企业级固态硬盘（SSD）集成了大量计算资源（如ARM处理器和板载DRAM）以处理I/O突发。然而，这些资源显著提高了SSD的货币成本，并且在JBOF部署中由于I/O突发的偶发性，这些资源严重利用不足。在本文中，我们提出了Espresso，一种成本高效的JBOF设计，该设计在低货币成本下为每个SSD配备适度的计算资源，同时通过高效的SSD间资源共享提供所需的I/O性能。具体而言，Espresso首先将SSD架构分解为功能不同的组件，实现细粒度的SSD内部资源管理。然后，Espresso采用去中心化方案来管理这些分解后的资源，并利用空闲SSD的计算资源来帮助繁忙的SSD处理I/O突发。这一想法由缓存一致性CXL架构促进，借助该架构，繁忙的SSD可以直接利用所获取的计算资源来加速元数据处理。评估结果表明，与最先进的JBOF设计相比，Espresso可以将SSD资源利用率提高50.4%，同时将货币成本降低19.0%，且性能损失可忽略不计。

upstream_only.title: FORGE: Mitigating Synchronization Amplification for Memory-Disaggregated Caching Systems
upstream_only.abstract: Disaggregated Memory (DM) architectures offer caching systems the potential for elastic scaling and improved resource utilization by decoupling compute and memory. However, this advantage is undermined by costly cross-node synchronization, which exacerbates the overheads of critical cache operations, including hotness tracking, eviction coordination, and memory defragmentation. To address this challenge, we present FORGE, a caching system tailored for DM that prioritizes synchronization efficiency. FORGE groups cached objects based on similarity and performs group-level synchronizations to amortize overheads. It evicts cold groups via a contention-free and hotness-aware FIFO queue, efficiently sustaining high hit ratios while mitigating memory fragmentation. Leveraging the predictability of FIFO evictions, FORGE adopts a lazy synchronization strategy that updates hotness metrics just-in-time for eviction and offloads this process to on-chip memory in RDMA NICs for acceleration. Extensive evaluations on YCSB and real-world workloads demonstrate that FORGE achieves up to 4.5× higher throughput, 4.0×/7.5× lower P50/P99 latency, and an average of 1.14× higher cache hit ratio compared with state-of-the-art systems.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 内存分离（Disaggregated Memory, DM）架构通过解耦计算与内存，为缓存系统提供了弹性扩展和改善资源利用率的潜力。然而，这一优势被昂贵的跨节点同步所削弱，这会加剧关键缓存操作的开销，包括热度跟踪、逐出协调和内存碎片整理。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了FORGE，一个专为DM设计的缓存系统，优先考虑同步效率。FORGE基于相似性对缓存对象进行分组，并执行组级同步以分摊开销。它通过一个无竞争且热度感知的FIFO队列逐出冷组，有效维持高命中率的同时减轻内存碎片化。利用FIFO逐出的可预测性，FORGE采用惰性同步策略，在逐出时即时更新热度指标，并将该过程卸载到RDMA网卡中的片上内存以加速。对YCSB和真实工作负载的大量评估表明，与最先进系统相比，FORGE实现了高达4.5倍的吞吐量提升、4.0倍/7.5倍的P50/P99延迟降低，以及平均1.14倍的缓存命中率提升。

upstream_only.title: Accelerating Confidential Databases with Crypto-Free Mappings
upstream_only.abstract:
Confidential databases (CDBs) enable secure queries over sensitive data in untrusted cloud environments using confidential computing hardware. While adoption is growing, widespread deployment is hindered by high overheads from frequent synchronous cryptographic operations, which cause significant computational and I/O bottlenecks.
ZENO is a novel CDB design that removes cryptographic operations from the critical path. It introduces crypto-free mappings that maintain data-independent identifiers within the database while securely mapping them to plaintext secrets in a trusted domain. This paradigm shift yields substantial performance gains across industry-standard benchmarks (TPC-C, TPC-H) and a real-world industrial workload. Specifically, ZENO speeds up TPC-H queries by up to 53.1× on ARM S-EL2 and 94.7× on x86 TDX compared to HEDB. ZENO’s optimization techniques have been integrated into GaussDB.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 机密数据库（CDBs）利用机密计算硬件在不受信任的云环境中对敏感数据执行安全查询。虽然采用率正在增长，但由于频繁的同步密码操作带来的巨大计算和 I/O 瓶颈，其广泛部署仍受到阻碍。ZENO 是一种新颖的 CDB 设计，它将密码操作从关键路径中移除。它引入了无密码映射，在数据库内维护与数据无关的标识符，同时在可信域内安全地将它们映射到明文秘密。这种范式转变在行业标准基准测试（TPC-C、TPC-H）和真实工业负载中取得了显著的性能提升。具体来说，与 HEDB 相比，ZENO 在 ARM S-EL2 上将 TPC-H 查询速度提升了最多 53.1 倍，在 x86 TDX 上提升了最多 94.7 倍。ZENO 的优化技术已集成到 GaussDB 中。

upstream_only.title: JANUS: Cross-World, Cooperative Nested Virtualization for Secure Containers
upstream_only.abstract:
Secure containers such as Kata Containers strengthen isolation by running each container inside a lightweight VM. On today’s virtualized clouds, this creates an unavoidable form of nested virtualization with dominant cost in memory virtualization.
