upstream_only.title: Pirateship: Append-Only Ledgers for (Mostly) Trusted Execution Environments
upstream_only.abstract: Distributed ledgers are increasingly relied upon by industry to provide trustworthy accountability, strong integrity-protection, and high availability for critical data without centralizing trust. Recently, distributed append-only logs are opting for a layered approach, combining crash-fault-tolerant (CFT) consensus with hardware-based Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) for greater resiliency. Unfortunately, hardware TEEs can be subject to (rare) attacks, undermining the very guarantees that distributed ledgers are carefully designed to achieve. In response, we present Pirateship, a new distributed consensus protocol that cautiously trusts the guarantees of TEEs. Pirateship carefully embeds a Byzantine fault-tolerant (BFT) protocol inside of a CFT protocol with no additional messages. This is made possible through careful refactoring of both the CFT and BFT protocols such that their structure aligns. Pirateship achieves performance in line with regular TEE-enabled consensus protocols, while guaranteeing integrity in the face of TEE platform compromises.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 分布式账本正日益被工业界依赖，以在不集中信任的情况下为关键数据提供可信问责、强完整性保护和高可用性。最近，分布式仅追加日志开始采用分层方法，将崩溃容错（CFT）共识与基于硬件的可信执行环境（TEE）相结合，以获得更强的韧性。不幸的是，硬件TEE可能遭受（罕见的）攻击，从而破坏分布式账本精心设计所要实现的保证。为此，我们提出Pirateship，一种新的分布式共识协议，它谨慎地信任TEE的保证。Pirateship在不增加额外消息的情况下，将拜占庭容错（BFT）协议谨慎地嵌入到CFT协议中。这通过对CFT和BFT协议进行仔细重构，使它们的结构对齐而成为可能。Pirateship的性能与常规的TEE启用共识协议相当，同时在TEE平台被攻陷时仍能保证完整性。

upstream_only.title: DDB: Source-Level Interactive Debugging for Distributed Applications
upstream_only.abstract: Interactive debugging is an effective tool for understanding program behavior at the source level, allowing developers to pause execution, navigate the call stack, and inspect runtime state. However, interactive debuggers are designed for single-process execution, and interactive debugging has been widely considered impractical for distributed systems. Call stacks stop at process boundaries, debugging state fails to survive infrastructure dynamics, and, most critically, debugger-induced execution pauses trigger catastrophic timeout cascades that destroy the intended debug flow. Consequently, developers are forced to abandon live hypothesis testing in favor of unwieldy and iterative log-and-redeploy cycles.We present DDB, a source-level interactive debugger that extends interactive debugging capabilities to distributed applications. We show that each of these challenges admits a targeted solution. To bridge disjoint processes, Distributed Backtrace (DBT) embeds compact causality metadata in every RPC and reconstructs a unified call stack across RPC boundaries. To manage the lifecycle of a distributed session, an intent-preserving control plane automatically coordinates and propagates breakpoints across dynamic process sets. To make pausing safe, Pause-Erased Time (PET) virtualizes each process's clock, decoupling logical time from physical pauses and preventing timeout cascades. DDB integrates with an RPC framework in 10-60 lines of code. Evaluated on gRPC, ServiceWeaver, Nu, and Quicksand across up to 122 processes, DDB achieves 30 ms median cross-RPC backtrace latency, sub-5 ms time jump under repeated execution pauses, and adds 1-5\% throughput overhead, comparable to attaching a single-process debugger. In a controlled user study, DDB achieves a 100\% fault localization success rate (compared to 38.5\% for baseline tools) with a median localization time of ~8 minutes.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 交互式调试是在源代码级别理解程序行为的有效工具，允许开发者暂停执行、浏览调用栈并检查运行时状态。然而，交互式调试器是为单进程执行设计的，而且交互式调试一直被广泛认为对分布式系统不切实际。调用栈在进程边界处终止，调试状态无法在基础设施动态变化中存活，并且最关键的是，调试器引起的执行暂停会触发灾难性的超时级联，破坏预期的调试流程。因此，开发者被迫放弃实时假设检验，转而采用笨拙且迭代的日志-重新部署循环。我们提出DDB，一种源代码级交互式调试器，将交互式调试能力扩展到分布式应用。我们表明，这些挑战中的每一个都有针对性的解决方案。为了连接不相交的进程，分布式回溯（DBT）在每个RPC中嵌入紧凑的因果元数据，并跨RPC边界重建统一的调用栈。为了管理分布式会话的生命周期，一个保持意图的控制平面自动在动态进程集合之间协调和传播断点。为了使暂停安全，暂停擦除时间（PET）虚拟化每个进程的时钟，将逻辑时间与物理暂停解耦，并防止超时级联。DDB以10-60行代码与RPC框架集成。在gRPC、ServiceWeaver、Nu和Quicksand上，跨多达122个进程进行评估，DDB实现了30毫秒的中位跨RPC回溯延迟，在重复执行暂停下小于5毫秒的时间跳变，并增加1-5%的吞吐量开销，与附加单进程调试器相当。在一项受控用户研究中，DDB实现了100%的故障定位成功率（相比之下，基线工具为38.5%），中位定位时间约为8分钟。

upstream_only.title: Sintr: Safe Interactive Transactions in the Presence of Byzantine Clients
upstream_only.abstract: Byzantine fault-tolerant (BFT) systems are, in principle, an appealing foundation for transactional applications involving mutually distrustful participants. Yet their adoption has been hampered by two persistent stumbling blocks—performance and developer convenience—which are often in tension with one another. Recent systems show promising progress on both fronts by shifting to a client-centric architecture; clients execute transactions locally and concurrently, while the system resolves any data conflicts to maintain database serializability. We argue that, in its current form, this approach introduces a critical vulnerability: it leaves the integrity of the database exposed to Byzantine clients, which may issue malicious or incorrect transactions. We address this threat with Sintr, a framework that prevents Byzantine clients from compromising database integrity by executing rogue transactions. Sintr combines redundant execution to validate transaction outcomes with a flexible, heterogeneous policy framework for expressing an application's data integrity requirements. We apply Sintr to harden several existing BFT database systems and find that it imposes only modest overheads—3\%-16\% in throughput and 3\%-21\% in latency.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 拜占庭容错（BFT）系统原则上是为涉及互不信任参与者的交易应用提供的一个有吸引力的基础。然而，其采用一直受到两个持续障碍的阻碍——性能和开发者便利性——这两者往往相互制约。最近的系统通过转向以客户端为中心的架构，在这两方面都显示出有希望的进展；客户端在本地并发执行事务，而系统解决任何数据冲突以保持数据库可串行化。我们认为，当前形式的这种方法引入了一个关键漏洞：它使数据库的完整性暴露于拜占庭客户端，后者可能发出恶意或不正确的事务。我们用 Sintr 来应对这一威胁，Sintr 是一个框架，通过防止拜占庭客户端执行恶意事务来破坏数据库完整性。Sintr 结合了冗余执行以验证事务结果，以及一个灵活的、异构的策略框架来表达应用的数据完整性要求。我们将 Sintr 应用于加固几个现有的 BFT 数据库系统，发现它只带来适度的开销——吞吐量 3%-16%，延迟 3%-21%。

upstream_only.title: Smaran: Serving Authenticated Time-Travel Queries
upstream_only.abstract: Time-travel queries ask what data looked like at a past time or over an interval. Modern databases support time-travel queries, but this support is insufficient for applications that cannot trust the query server, such as secure messaging and decentralized applications, where clients need proofs that the returned results are correct. Existing approaches either require aggregating evidence from multiple auditors, incur per-step proof costs that scale linearly with history length, or impose massive storage and communication costs.In this paper, we introduce Smaran, an authenticated data structure that enables servers to answer time-travel queries efficiently with a constant number of fixed-size proofs, independent of the query range. Smaran achieves this through a novel integration of segment trees with vector commitments, sidestepping scalability challenges as history grows via a hierarchical architecture, and avoiding redundancy by introducing versioned vector commitments.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 时间旅行查询询问数据在过去某个时间或某个时间段的样子。现代数据库支持时间旅行查询，但这种支持不足以满足无法信任查询服务器的应用，如安全消息传递和去中心化应用，其中客户端需要证明返回结果是正确的。现有方法要么需要从多个审计者那里聚合证据，要么产生随历史长度线性增长的每步证明成本，要么施加巨大的存储和通信成本。本文中，我们介绍 Smaran，一种可认证的数据结构，使服务器能够以恒定数量的固定大小证明高效地回答时间旅行查询，且与查询范围无关。Smaran 通过将线段树与向量承诺新颖地集成来实现这一点，通过分层架构规避了历史增长带来的可扩展性挑战，并通过引入版本化向量承诺避免了冗余。

upstream_only.title: RPCShield: Defending Microservices Against Cascading Failures
upstream_only.abstract: Microservice-based systems are tightly interdependent. A failure in one service can propagate to a dependent service, potentially bringing down critical, user-facing functionality. We have developed and deployed RPCShield, a suite of program analyses for Go and Java that detects such cascading-failure risks. RPCShield uses static program analysis to track error and exception propagation through service code. Two insights make this practical. First, error propagation needs to be only checked per service, so the analysis is intra-service and avoids inter-service analysis entirely. Second, deciding the property counterfactually, by asking whether an endpoint could have succeeded had a given call succeeded, attributes the failure to the specific responsible dependency rather than to every dependency whose error reaches the caller. We have deployed RPCShield at Uber, across a fleet of over 6K microservices. Since deployment, it has detected over 3,800 cascading failure risks, of which service owners have already remediated more than 1,300. Manual review indicates that RPCShield has a false positive rate of around 5\%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 基于微服务的系统紧密相互依赖。一个服务的故障可能传播到依赖服务，可能使关键的用户功能瘫痪。我们开发并部署了RPCShield，这是一套用于Go和Java的程序分析工具，可检测此类级联故障风险。RPCShield使用静态程序分析来跟踪错误和异常在服务代码中的传播。两个见解使其切实可行。首先，错误传播只需按服务检查，因此分析是服务内的，完全避免了服务间分析。其次，通过反事实地判定属性，即询问如果给定调用成功，端点是否可能成功，将故障归因于具体负责的依赖项，而不是每个错误到达调用者的依赖项。我们已在Uber部署RPCShield，覆盖超过6000个微服务的集群。自部署以来，它已检测到超过3800个级联故障风险，服务所有者已修复超过1300个。人工审查表明，RPCShield的误报率约为5%。

upstream_only.title: QProf: Fleetwide Transitive Cost Profiling of Warehouse-Scale Services
upstream_only.abstract: Warehouse-scale services form the backbone of major cloud services relied on by billions of users every day. As these systems grow increasingly complex, understanding them and finding opportunities for optimization becomes more and more difficult. In this paper, we present QProf, a distributed systems profiler built upon RPC tracing. Going well beyond prior work that focuses on fleetwide profiling of single programs, QProf focuses on cost profiling of entire services. By treating a distributed program as if it were a single process, QProf can produce call-graph profiles of entire systems, so it can measure the transitive cost of services through the entire stack of backend dependencies. QProf is backed by a novel tracing mechanism called skeletal tracing which is exceedingly low-overhead and invisible to applications, ensuring that tracing minimally perturbs application behavior. An ambient per-query CPU profiler ensures high profiling coverage across thousands of microservices without manual instrumentation, and new fan-in APIs provide support for representing batched requests in a tracing data model that is tree-centric. QProf processes billions of traces per day to produce aggregated datasets which can be queried by engineers. Despite the sampled nature of traces, QProf is highly accurate in measuring QPS and CPU across thousands of microservices in an extremely diverse datacenter fleet. QProf has been deployed for every job in Google's production fleet for several years. It has a myriad of use cases, and we present several case studies showing how it has been used to find the “room-at-the-top” in complex systems and optimize them across many dimensions.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 仓库级服务构成了每天数十亿用户所依赖的主要云服务的骨干。随着这些系统日益复杂，理解它们并寻找优化机会变得越来越困难。本文提出 QProf，一个基于 RPC 追踪的分布式系统剖析器。远超先前专注于单程序全集群剖析的工作，QProf 聚焦于整个服务的成本剖析。通过将分布式程序视为单个进程，QProf 可以生成整个系统的调用图剖析，从而可以测量服务通过整个后端依赖栈的传递成本。QProf 由一种新颖的追踪机制——骨架追踪（skeletal tracing）支撑，该机制开销极低且对应用不可见，确保追踪对应用行为的扰动最小。环境式每查询 CPU 剖析器确保在数千个微服务之间具有高剖析覆盖率而无需手动插桩，新的扇入 API 提供了在树为中心的追踪数据模型中表示批量请求的支持。QProf 每天处理数十亿条追踪以生成可由工程师查询的聚合数据集。尽管追踪具有采样性质，QProf 在极其多样化的数据中心集群中跨数千个微服务测量 QPS 和 CPU 时仍高度准确。QProf 已在 Google 生产集群中的每个作业上部署多年。它有无数的用例，我们展示了几个案例研究，说明它如何被用于发现复杂系统中的“顶部空间”并在多个维度上优化它们。

upstream_only.title: Anchor: Mitigating GPU Shallow Disruptions with Decoupled Memory
upstream_only.abstract: Job failures are frequent in large-scale GPU clusters for LLM workloads, leading to significant resource wastage. The vast majority of these are shallow disruptions (e.g., software errors or updates), where only the worker process crashes while the underlying GPU and OS kernel remain intact. Existing recovery systems, however, are failure-agnostic, relying on heavyweight checkpointing that forces a full, slow state reload even when the data could have survived on the GPU.In this paper, we propose Anchor, a system that avoids this overhead by decoupling memory ownership from the failure-prone worker process. Anchor uses a daemon process to manage GPU memory. Leveraging the GPU's native IPC memory mechanism, Anchor enables a restarted worker to remap and reuse the daemon-managed memory with no overhead on the normal execution path. To make this idea practical for real-world ML applications, Anchor introduces an access-path-based identity resolution mechanism to remap logical tensors to their physical memory objects after restart. Anchor also provides lightweight, application-aware consistency protocols to ensure data integrity with little overhead. We integrate Anchor into DeepSpeed and vLLM. Our evaluation demonstrates recovery acceleration, with recovery time reduced by 60.7\% for inference and 26.6\% for training on average. For Qwen3-235B inference, Anchor reduces the recovery time from 143.78 s to 27.85 s.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在大规模GPU集群中，LLM工作负载的作业故障频繁发生，导致显著的资源浪费。其中绝大多数是浅层故障（例如软件错误或更新），此时只有工作进程崩溃，而底层GPU和操作系统内核仍保持完好。然而，现有的恢复系统不区分故障类型，依赖于重量级检查点，即使数据本可以在GPU上存活，也会强制进行完整且缓慢的状态重载。在本文中，我们提出Anchor，一种通过将内存所有权与易故障工作进程解耦来避免这种开销的系统。Anchor使用守护进程管理GPU内存。利用GPU原生的IPC内存机制，Anchor使重启后的工作进程能够重新映射并复用守护进程管理的内存，且在正常执行路径上无额外开销。为了使这一想法适用于现实世界的机器学习应用，Anchor引入了基于访问路径的身份解析机制，在重启后将逻辑张量重新映射到其物理内存对象。Anchor还提供轻量级、应用感知的一致性协议，以极小的开销确保数据完整性。我们将Anchor集成到DeepSpeed和vLLM中。我们的评估表明恢复加速：推理平均恢复时间减少60.7%，训练平均减少26.6%。对于Qwen3-235B推理，Anchor将恢复时间从143.78秒减少到27.85秒。

upstream_only.title: Linux AGX: An Adaptive GPU eXtension to Linux Fair Scheduling for Physical AI and Robotic Systems
upstream_only.abstract: Linux fair scheduling (EEVDF in kernel ≥ 6.6, CFS in older releases) is the default time-sharing policy on many production robots. ML-driven robotic pipelines, combining perception, planning, and on-device LLM/VLM inference, create workloads in which short CPU preparation steps gate GPU launches and the active task graph reconfigures at runtime as scenes change, humans intervene, or new behaviors are triggered. Because Linux fair scheduling observes only CPU service and sleep-wake events, it cannot identify GPU-gating feeder slices or adapt as the critical path shifts, leading to avoidable GPU idle time and inflated end-to-end latency on single-GPU embedded platforms.We present AGX (Adaptive GPU eXtension), a lightweight, scheduler-agnostic mechanism that preserves Linux fair scheduling's pick logic, virtual-deadline computation, and fairness semantics while making its weight interface GPU-, dependency-, and adaptation-aware. A user-space profiler periodically computes a bounded per-task importance score, which the kernel applies as an effective weight, requiring no new queues, locks, or vendor-specific paths. AGX tracks the evolving critical path online without manual retuning. We prove that AGX preserves proportional fairness under effective weights and bounds competition-induced GPU launch delay, yielding a K-independent bound when the bounded boost is not clipped and bounded coalescing otherwise. AGX instantiates on EEVDF, specializes to CFS, and generalizes to any proportional-share fair scheduler.Experiments on three NVIDIA platforms across fuzz-generated DAGs, realistic robotic pipelines, background CPU-pressure stress tests, and a physical TurtleBot stack show that AGX reduces makespan by 6.0-20.0\% and raises average GPU utilization by 7.6-22.1\% relative to vanilla EEVDF. Under background CPU pressure, AGX cuts p99 perception-to-control latency by 38.5\% and deadline misses by 33.8 percentage points while preserving CPU-only fairness. AGX incurs minimal overhead and remains a drop-in extension that degrades cleanly to vanilla behavior.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Linux 公平调度（内核 ≥ 6.6 中的 EEVDF，旧版本中的 CFS）是许多生产机器人的默认分时策略。由机器学习驱动的机器人流水线结合感知、规划和设备端 LLM/VLM 推理，所产生的工作负载中，短的 CPU 准备步骤会限制 GPU 启动，并且随着场景变化、人工干预或新行为触发，活动任务图会在运行时重新配置。由于 Linux 公平调度只观察 CPU 服务和睡眠-唤醒事件，它无法识别限制 GPU 的供给切片，也无法在关键路径发生变化时进行调整，导致单 GPU 嵌入式平台上出现可避免的 GPU 空闲时间和端到端延迟增加。我们提出 AGX（自适应 GPU 扩展），一种轻量级、调度器无关的机制，它保留 Linux 公平调度的选择逻辑、虚拟截止时间计算和公平性语义，同时使其权重接口能够感知 GPU、依赖关系和自适应。用户空间分析器定期计算有界的每任务重要性分数，内核将其作为有效权重应用，不需要新的队列、锁或供应商特定路径。AGX 在线跟踪不断变化的关键路径，无需手动重新调优。我们证明 AGX 在有效权重下保持比例公平性，并限制竞争引起的 GPU 启动延迟，当有界提升未被裁剪时得到与 K 无关的界，否则得到有界合并。AGX 在 EEVDF 上实例化，专门化到 CFS，并推广到任何比例份额公平调度器。在三个 NVIDIA 平台上的实验，涵盖模糊生成的 DAG、真实机器人流水线、后台 CPU 压力压力测试和物理 TurtleBot 栈，表明相对于原生 EEVDF，AGX 将完工时间减少 6.0-20.0%，并将平均 GPU 利用率提高 7.6-22.1%。在后台 CPU 压力下，AGX 将 p99 感知到控制延迟降低 38.5%，将截止时间错过减少 33.8 个百分点，同时保持仅 CPU 的公平性。AGX 开销极小，并保持即插即用扩展，可干净地退化为原生行为。

upstream_only.title: TensorHub: Scalable and Elastic Weight Transfer for LLM RL Training
upstream_only.abstract: Modern LLM reinforcement learning (RL) workloads require a high-performance weight transfer system to scale training across heterogeneous compute resources. However, efficiently transferring terabyte-scale model weights across thousands of GPUs remains challenging because the system must accommodate clusters that dynamically scale up and down while keeping coordination, data movement, and storage overhead low.We introduce Reference-Oriented Storage (ROS), a new storage abstraction for RL weight transfer that exploits highly replicated model weights in place. ROS presents the illusion that certain versions of the model weights are stored and can be fetched on demand. Underneath, ROS does not physically store any copies of the weights; instead, it tracks the workers that hold these weights on GPUs for inference. Upon request, ROS directly uses them to serve reads. We build TensorHub, a production-quality system that instantiates the ROS idea with topology-aware transfer, model-parallel consistency, and fault tolerance. Evaluation shows that TensorHub saturates RDMA bandwidth and adapts to three distinct rollout workloads with minimal engineering effort. Specifically, TensorHub reduces total GPU stall time by up to 6.7{\texttimes} for standalone rollouts, accelerates weight updates for elastic rollouts by up to 4.8{\texttimes}, and cuts cross-datacenter rollout stall time by up to 19{\texttimes}. TensorHub has been deployed in ByteDance production to support cutting-edge RL training.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代LLM强化学习（RL）工作负载需要高性能的权重传输系统，以便在异构计算资源上扩展训练。然而，在数千个GPU之间高效传输TB级模型权重仍然具有挑战性，因为系统必须适应动态扩缩容的集群，同时保持协调、数据移动和存储开销较低。我们引入面向引用的存储（Reference-Oriented Storage，ROS），一种用于RL权重传输的新存储抽象，它就地利用高度复制的模型权重。ROS呈现出某些版本的模型权重已被存储并可按需获取的假象。实际上，ROS并不物理存储任何权重副本；相反，它跟踪在GPU上持有这些权重用于推理的工作节点。收到请求时，ROS直接使用它们来服务读取。我们构建了TensorHub，一个生产级系统，通过拓扑感知传输、模型并行一致性和容错来实例化ROS理念。评估表明，TensorHub能够饱和RDMA带宽，并以最小的工程工作量适应三种不同的rollout工作负载。具体而言，TensorHub将独立rollout的总GPU停顿时间减少高达6.7倍，将弹性rollout的权重更新加速高达4.8倍，并将跨数据中心的rollout停顿时间减少高达19倍。TensorHub已部署在字节跳动生产环境中，以支持前沿RL训练。

upstream_only.title: A Few GPUs, A Whole Lotta Scale: Faithful LLM Training Emulation with CrystalLLM
upstream_only.abstract: Large language model (LLM) training today runs on clusters spanning thousands of GPUs. While this scale enables rapid model advances, developing, debugging, and performance-tuning, the training framework inevitably becomes complex and costly. This is because engineers often need to reproduce production behaviors to diagnose failures or evaluate optimizations, thereby demanding frequent and even exclusive access to production-scale clusters—which becomes increasingly hard given that the majority of GPUs are already committed to production workloads. Simulation relies on complex performance models that are difficult to maintain, and downscaled experiments often fail to capture scale-dependent behaviors.We present CrystalLLM to decouple large-scale execution from the need to access large clusters, enabling engineers to run and observe ranks of interest under faithful large-scale behavior using only a few GPUs. CrystalLLM constructs a high-fidelity execution graph via a slicing-based approach that captures computation, communication, and dependencies of the target scale. Then, CrystalLLM performs hybrid emulation where selected ranks execute the original program while the remaining are replayed as virtual participants.Experiments on large-scale LLM training workloads show that CrystalLLM accurately reproduces performance and memory behavior, achieving only 0.58\% average error in iteration time and less than 0.01\% error in peak GPU memory usage. CrystalLLM can emulate clusters of up to 8192 GPUs using fewer than 1\% of the physical GPUs required by the original deployment.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 当前大语言模型（LLM）训练运行在跨越数千个GPU的集群上。虽然这种规模使模型快速进步成为可能，但开发、调试和性能调优的训练框架不可避免地变得复杂且昂贵。这是因为工程师经常需要复现生产行为以诊断故障或评估优化，从而需要频繁甚至独占访问生产规模集群——鉴于大多数GPU已被用于生产工作负载，这变得越来越困难。仿真依赖难以维护的复杂性能模型，而降规模实验往往无法捕捉规模相关行为。我们提出CrystalLLM，将大规模执行与访问大型集群的需求解耦，使工程师仅使用少量GPU即可运行并观察感兴趣的rank，同时呈现忠实的大规模行为。CrystalLLM通过基于切片的方法构建高保真执行图，捕获目标规模的计算、通信和依赖关系。然后，CrystalLLM执行混合仿真，其中选定的rank执行原始程序，而其余rank作为虚拟参与者重放。在大规模LLM训练工作负载上的实验表明，CrystalLLM准确复现了性能和内存行为，迭代时间平均误差仅为0.58%，峰值GPU内存使用误差小于0.01%。CrystalLLM可以使用不到原始部署所需物理GPU的1%来仿真多达8192个GPU的集群。

upstream_only.title: LLM-42: Enabling Determinism in LLM Inference with Verified Speculation
upstream_only.abstract: In LLM inference, the same prompt often returns different outputs across different runs. At the system level, this non-determinism arises from floating-point non-associativity interacting with dynamic batching and GPU kernels whose reduction orders vary with batch size. A straightforward way to eliminate nondeterminism is to disable dynamic batching, but doing so severely degrades throughput. Another approach is to make the kernels batch-invariant; however, this tightly couples determinism to kernel design, requires new implementations, and imposes fixed overheads regardless of how much of the workload actually requires determinism.Inspired by self-speculative decoding, we present LLM-42 — a scheduling-based approach to enable determinism in LLM inference. Our key observation is that a given sequence of tokens is likely to emit the same next token across multiple runs, even with dynamic batching. Moreover, most GPU kernels use the same reduction schedules for all inputs of a given shape. Leveraging these insights, LLM-42 decodes tokens using a nondeterministic fast path and enforces determinism through a verify-rollback protocol. The verifier replays fast path tokens under a fixed batch size to obtain a deterministic reference output, commits tokens that match the reference, and rolls back those that do not. LLM-42 reuses many existing kernels unchanged and incurs overhead only proportional to the fraction of traffic that requires determinism.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在LLM推理中，相同的提示在不同运行中往往返回不同的输出。在系统层面，这种非确定性源于浮点非结合性与动态批处理和GPU内核相互作用，而后者的归约顺序会随批大小变化。消除非确定性的一种直接方法是禁用动态批处理，但这样做会严重降低吞吐量。另一种方法是使内核批不变；然而，这会将确定性与内核设计紧密耦合，需要新的实现，并且无论工作负载中实际需要确定性的比例如何，都会带来固定开销。受自推测解码的启发，我们提出LLM-42——一种基于调度的方法来实现LLM推理的确定性。我们的关键观察是，即使使用动态批处理，给定令牌序列在多次运行中也很可能发出相同的下一个令牌。此外，大多数GPU内核对于给定形状的所有输入使用相同的归约调度。利用这些见解，LLM-42使用非确定性快速路径解码令牌，并通过验证-回滚协议强制确定性。验证器在固定批大小下重放快速路径令牌以获得确定性参考输出，提交与参考匹配的令牌，并回滚不匹配的令牌。LLM-42重复使用许多现有内核而无需更改，并且仅按需要确定性的流量比例产生开销。

upstream_only.title: Ahead-of-Time Analysis of Shell Program Effects
upstream_only.abstract: The Unix shell remains a core system substrate across system administration, automation, and software development. Shell programs, however, are prone to subtle, severe, and often irreversible effects that are difficult to predict. The challenge stems from the shell's unique execution model, its reliance on external computation and state, its highly dynamic expansion semantics, and the complex interactions among these features. This paper presents SaSh, a system that statically analyzes shell programs to identify errors in their execution before they occur. SaSh introduces an optimistic symbolic execution engine for shell programs that limits path explosion and focuses on high-impact failures. It tracks the effects of external commands over a filesystem model, and approximates shell word expansion using a tailored abstract domain. SaSh quickly identifies bugs even in large programs with a risk-directed exploration strategy, steering its analysis to program fragments likely to exhibit dangerous behavior. Applied to 61 buggy programs, including several high-profile disasters, SaSh identifies all but one instance of unwanted behavior with no false positives, going far beyond the current state-of-the-art. Furthermore, SaSh has already yielded 104 new bug reports in 50 open-source projects such as PyTorch, the P4 compiler, Kubernetes, and vLLM, including bugs that can lead to irreversible data loss.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Unix shell 仍然是系统管理、自动化和软件开发中的核心系统基础。然而，shell 程序容易产生微妙、严重且往往不可逆的效果，难以预测。这一挑战源于 shell 独特的执行模型、对外部计算和状态的依赖、高度动态的展开语义，以及这些特性之间复杂的交互。本文提出了 SaSh，一个静态分析 shell 程序以在执行发生前识别其中错误的系统。SaSh 为 shell 程序引入了一种乐观符号执行引擎，限制了路径爆炸并关注高影响故障。它在文件系统模型之上跟踪外部命令的效果，并使用定制的抽象域近似 shell 单词展开。SaSh 通过风险导向的探索策略，即使对大型程序也能快速识别错误，将分析导向可能表现出危险行为的程序片段。应用于 61 个有缺陷的程序（包括若干备受瞩目的事故）时，SaSh 在没有误报的情况下识别出除一例之外的所有不良行为，远超当前最先进水平。此外，SaSh 已在 PyTorch、P4 编译器、Kubernetes 和 vLLM 等 50 个开源项目中产生 104 个新错误报告，包括可能导致不可逆数据丢失的错误。

upstream_only.title: Testing Custom Control Planes Without the Cluster
upstream_only.abstract: Modern cloud infrastructure is increasingly managed by software. On platforms like Kubernetes, the control plane maintains desired system state through controllers: software components that continuously monitor cluster resources and reconcile them toward a declared specification. This pattern has proven effective, and a thriving ecosystem of projects now compose controllers into custom control planes (CCPs) to automate tasks such as managing application delivery, scaling infrastructure dynamically, and composing cloud provider APIs into higher-level abstractions. The correctness of a CCP, however, depends on how its constituent controllers interact at run time. Bugs arise from implicit assumptions about these interactions that do not hold under all possible executions. As such, finding them requires enumerating the space of possible executions and searching it systematically, which is infeasible in a live cluster environment. In this paper, we present Kamera, a system for testing CCPs that uses partial simulation to execute the code of multiple interacting controllers against a lightweight model of the Kubernetes runtime. Thus far, Kamera has found 31 new bugs in five popular CCP projects and achieves a 1,781{\texttimes} speedup over existing cluster-based controller testing approaches.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代云基础设施正日益由软件管理。在Kubernetes等平台上，控制平面通过控制器维护期望的系统状态：这些软件组件持续监控集群资源，并将其协调至声明的规范。这种模式已被证明有效，如今一个蓬勃发展的项目生态系统将控制器组合成自定义控制平面（CCP），以自动化诸如管理应用交付、动态扩展基础设施以及将云提供商API组合成更高级抽象等任务。然而，CCP的正确性取决于其组成控制器在运行时的交互方式。错误源于对这些交互的隐式假设，这些假设并非在所有可能执行中都成立。因此，发现它们需要枚举可能的执行空间并系统地搜索，这在实时集群环境中是不可行的。在本文中，我们提出了Kamera，一个用于测试CCP的系统，它使用部分模拟针对Kubernetes运行时的轻量级模型执行多个交互控制器的代码。到目前为止，Kamera已在五个流行的CCP项目中发现了31个新错误，并且相比现有的基于集群的控制器测试方法实现了1,781倍的加速。

upstream_only.title: On-site, Non-speculative Failure Diagnosis with CLODS
upstream_only.abstract: Diagnosing complex production failures is a notoriously difficult task. The bottleneck of diagnosing these failures is often wild goose chases: developers make incorrect hypotheses about the root cause, leading to time and effort spent in verifying these hypotheses, ultimately realizing they were wrong. This is caused by speculations not backed by sufficient evidence because there is insufficient diagnostic data.We present CLODS, a closed-loop on-site diagnostic tool that can diagnose production failures without going into any wild goose chases. CLODS has a feedback loop of static analysis and logging placement that runs completely on-site giving it the advantages of: 1) Real-time diagnosis 2) Preserving the failure environment and input 3) Eliminating log aggregation costs. CLODS is evaluated on both large-scale distributed systems like YARN, Cassandra, Hadoop HDFS and the Android ecosystem on Element bugs.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 诊断复杂的生产故障是一项众所周知的困难任务。诊断这些故障的瓶颈往往是徒劳的追查：开发人员对根本原因做出错误假设，导致花费时间和精力验证这些假设，最终意识到它们是错误的。这是由于缺乏足够的诊断数据，使得推测没有足够证据支持。我们提出CLODS，一种闭环的现场诊断工具，可以在不进行任何徒劳追查的情况下诊断生产故障。CLODS具有静态分析和日志放置的反馈回路，完全在现场运行，使其具有以下优势：1）实时诊断；2）保留故障环境和输入；3）消除日志聚合成本。CLODS在YARN、Cassandra、Hadoop HDFS等大规模分布式系统以及Android生态系统中的Element缺陷上进行了评估。

upstream_only.title: State-Aware Fuzzing of JavaScript Engines with LLM-Guided Instrumentation
upstream_only.abstract: The security of the modern web depends on the correctness of JavaScript (JS) engines, yet these complex systems remain vulnerable to high-impact bugs. A critical limitation of state-of-the-art fuzzers is the coverage plateau: once a fuzzer saturates the control-flow graph, edge coverage loses its ability to guide discovery. Because complex engine behaviors, such as JIT optimization tiers and hidden class transitions, often share identical edge coverage, standard coverage metrics are blind to the distinct internal states required to trigger deep errors. To bridge this gap, we present StateLens, a framework that employs Large Language Models (LLM) to automate the discovery of deep internal states. Blindly placing instrumentation probes at all states is infeasible due to the vast state space and the high runtime overhead. State-Lens introduces a novel agent-based reasoning pipeline that emulates the intuition of a security researcher. By iteratively traversing code and developer comments, our agents intelligently select high-value instrumentation targets, effectively separating logic-driving states from irrelevant data. This results in synthesizable, high-signal feedback probes that map the engine's hidden configurations. This instrumentation feeds a dual-feedback mechanism, effectively guiding the fuzzer toward unexplored engine semantics. Our evaluation confirms that StateLens significantly outperforms state-of-the-art fuzzers and uncovers 68 new bugs.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代Web的安全依赖于JavaScript（JS）引擎的正确性，但这些复杂系统仍然容易受到高影响漏洞的攻击。当前最先进模糊测试器的一个关键局限是覆盖率平台期：一旦模糊测试器饱和了控制流图，边覆盖就失去了指导发现的能力。由于复杂的引擎行为，例如JIT优化层级和隐藏类转换，常常共享相同的边覆盖，标准覆盖率指标无法感知触发深层错误所需的不同内部状态。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了StateLens，一个利用大型语言模型（LLM）来自动发现深层内部状态的框架。由于状态空间庞大且运行时开销高，盲目地在所有状态放置插桩探针是不可行的。StateLens引入了一种新颖的基于智能体的推理流水线，模拟安全研究人员的直觉。通过迭代遍历代码和开发者注释，我们的智能体智能地选择高价值插桩目标，有效地区分驱动逻辑的状态与无关数据。这产生了可合成的、高信号的反馈探针，映射引擎的隐藏配置。这种插桩为双反馈机制提供输入，有效地引导模糊测试器走向未探索的引擎语义。我们的评估证实，StateLens显著优于最先进的模糊测试器，并发现了68个新漏洞。

upstream_only.title: Tamias: Feedback-Guided Systematic Concurrency Exploration for Transparent Distributed System Fuzzing
upstream_only.abstract: Existing distributed system fuzzers are limited by coarsegrained, nondeterministic event control and weak support for systematic schedule mutation. They rely on timing perturbations (e.g., injecting delays), which can influence execution but do not precisely realize the fine-grained event orderings that trigger many distributed bugs. In addition, they do not integrate systematic schedule exploration with mutation, making exploration less effective in large search spaces.This paper presents Tamias, the first distributed system testing tool to integrate transparent, feedback-guided input exploration with systematic concurrency exploration. Tamias is built on two insights: effective distributed-system fuzzing requires feedback determinism rather than full execution determinism, and systematic scheduling algorithms can be integrated with feedback-guided mutation through a replay-explore strategy that allows them to benefit from prior executions while jointly exploring the input and schedule spaces. Guided by these insights, Tamias combines lightweight feedback-deterministic transparent event control with feedback-guided input and concurrency exploration, enabling effective distributed system testing.We evaluate Tamias on six widely used distributed systems implemented in C/C++ and Go, without requiring source-code modifications. Tamias found 12 new bugs across mature releases. Our ablation study shows that replay-explore mutation improves branch coverage by up to 22\% and also improves bug-finding effectiveness. Tamias improves branch coverage over the state of the art and achieves feedback determinism for branch coverage on all evaluated target systems.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现有的分布式系统模糊测试器受限于粗粒度、非确定性的事件控制，以及对系统化调度变异支持薄弱。它们依赖时序扰动（例如注入延迟），这可以影响执行，但无法精确实现触发许多分布式缺陷所需的细粒度事件顺序。此外，它们没有将系统化调度探索与变异相结合，使得在大型搜索空间中的探索效率较低。本文提出了Tamias，这是首个将透明的反馈引导输入探索与系统化并发探索相结合的分布式系统测试工具。Tamias基于两个洞见：有效的分布式系统模糊测试需要反馈确定性而非完全执行确定性；通过回放-探索策略，系统化调度算法可以与反馈引导变异相结合，从而在联合探索输入空间和调度空间时受益于先前的执行。在这些洞见的指导下，Tamias将轻量级的反馈确定性透明事件控制与反馈引导的输入和并发探索相结合，实现了有效的分布式系统测试。我们在六个广泛使用、分别用C/C++和Go实现的分布式系统上评估了Tamias，且无需修改源代码。Tamias在成熟版本中发现了12个新缺陷。我们的消融研究表明，回放-探索变异将分支覆盖率最多提高了22%，并提升了缺陷发现效果。Tamias在分支覆盖率上优于现有技术，并在所有评估的目标系统上实现了分支覆盖率的反馈确定性。

upstream_only.title: Validating Rust Compilers with Trait-Type Constraint Graph
upstream_only.abstract: Rust is increasingly adopted in safety-critical systems software, making the reliability of its compiler particularly important. Defects in the Rust compiler can lead to incorrect compiler behavior and compromise the reliability of the compilation process. Systematic validation of the compiler is therefore imperative. Through an empirical analysis of real-world Rust compiler bugs, we find that the trait mechanism remains a primary source of hard-to-detect compiler bugs that existing validation tools consistently miss. To address this, we propose a validation methodology based on a novel concept of Trait-Type Constraint Graph (TTCG), a graph that captures semantic relationships between traits and types and enables the derivation of the Trait Constraint Space (TCS) for systematic exploration. Guided by TTCG, our tool TraitFuzzer first leverages large language models to rewrite seed programs into trait-dense forms, and then applies TTCG-guided mutations to drive the compiler toward under-tested trait-solving logic and cross-feature interactions. In total, TraitFuzzer has discovered 51 bugs, 45 of which have already been confirmed. Further analysis reveals that 41 bugs can only be triggered with trait structures. More importantly, none of these bugs can be detected by the baseline approaches. Our tool, together with the reported bugs, has also received positive feedback from the community.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Rust正越来越多地被安全关键系统软件所采用，这使得其编译器的可靠性尤为重要。Rust编译器中的缺陷可能导致错误的编译器行为，并危及编译过程的可靠性。因此，对编译器进行系统化验证是必要的。通过对现实世界Rust编译器缺陷的实证分析，我们发现特质（trait）机制仍然是难以检测的编译器缺陷的主要来源，而现有验证工具一贯会漏掉这些缺陷。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种基于特质-类型约束图（Trait-Type Constraint Graph, TTCG）这一新概念的验证方法。该图捕获特质与类型之间的语义关系，并能够推导出特质约束空间（Trait Constraint Space, TCS）以进行系统化探索。在TTCG的指导下，我们的工具TraitFuzzer首先利用大语言模型将种子程序重写为特质密集的形式，然后应用TTCG引导的变异，以驱动编译器触及测试不足的特质求解逻辑和跨特性交互。TraitFuzzer共发现了51个缺陷，其中45个已被确认。进一步分析表明，有41个缺陷只能在存在特质结构时被触发。更重要的是，这些缺陷均无法被基线方法检测到。我们的工具以及所报告的缺陷还获得了社区的积极反馈。

upstream_only.title: Efficient GPU Multitasking with Morphable Kernels
upstream_only.abstract: GPU multitasking offers a promising approach to improving hardware utilization by co-locating concurrent workloads on the same device. However, achieving high resource utilization with minimized interference requires fine-grained, adaptive scheduling. Existing scheduling solutions are fundamentally constrained by a rigid assumption: once a kernel is launched, its resource footprint remains fixed throughout its execution. Consequently, they either rely on static resource pre-partitioning, which lacks the flexibility to adapt to rapid workload changes, or adopt kernel-slicing techniques, which achieve fine-grained control at the cost of prohibitive kernel launch overheads.In this paper, we break this constraint by introducing morphable kernels, a new software abstraction that allows a kernel to dynamically yield or reclaim compute resources on the fly without additional launches. Building on this abstraction, we design MorphX, a GPU multitasking system that embraces the runtime adjustability of kernels as the first principle. MorphX transparently transforms traditional kernels into morphable ones at compile time, and leverages an in-place profiling mechanism to orchestrate fine-grained scheduling based on real-time resource contention. Evaluation under various scenarios shows that MorphX can improve background task throughput by 2.24x under the same foreground task latency, compared to existing systems.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: GPU多任务处理提供了一种有前景的方法，通过在同一个设备上共置并发工作负载来提高硬件利用率。然而，在最小化干扰的同时实现高资源利用率需要细粒度、自适应的调度。现有的调度解决方案从根本上受限于一个僵化的假设：一旦内核被启动，其资源占用在整个执行过程中保持不变。因此，它们要么依赖静态资源预分区，缺乏适应快速工作负载变化的灵活性；要么采用内核切片技术，以高昂的内核启动开销为代价实现细粒度控制。在本文中，我们通过引入可变形内核（morphable kernels）打破了这一限制，这是一种新的软件抽象，允许内核在不额外启动的情况下动态让出或回收计算资源。基于这一抽象，我们设计了MorphX，一个以内核的运行时可调整性为首要原则的GPU多任务处理系统。MorphX在编译时透明地将传统内核转换为可变形内核，并利用原地性能分析机制，根据实时资源争用来编排细粒度调度。在各种场景下的评估表明，与现有系统相比，在相同前台任务延迟下，MorphX可以将后台任务吞吐量提高2.24倍。

upstream_only.title: Ave: Guiding Agentic GPU Optimization Using Data-Flow Invariants
upstream_only.abstract: LLM coding agents can generate correct GPU kernels, yet their performance still lags behind expert libraries. Achieving peak GPU throughput requires coordinating low-level transformations such as shared-memory staging, software pipelining, and instruction scheduling. Unit tests and performance profiles provide only sparse end-to-end feedback, leaving agents unable to localize violations of the global constraints that these transformations must preserve.We present Ave, an agentic framework that uses data-flow invariants as compile-time guardrails for kernel optimization. These invariants specify relationships among data values that must hold throughout execution. Ave's tile-based Pythonic DSL exposes hardware instructions and compiler policies while abstracting complex memory layout encodings as tiles. Tag functions assign symbolic labels derived from selected logical coordinates and expressions. The compiler propagates these labels through data and control flow, and tag assertions enforce required relationships among them at use sites. The compiler checks these assertions with a tractable, flow-sensitive, path-insensitive analysis backed by an SMT solver, returning concrete assignments that witness abstract violations and guide repairs with no runtime overhead. An in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) planner proposes optimizations from a curated knowledge base. A lowering agent implements them and instantiates their invariants.We evaluate Ave on AMD MI300X across GEMM, flash attention, and MoE, which together account for up to 90\% of GPU time in LLM inference. With GPT-5.6 Sol, its optimized kernels achieve 89-99\% of the effective throughput of state-of-the-art hand-optimized libraries and improve geometric-mean throughput by 1.62-1176{\texttimes} over uncontaminated agentic baselines. On 200 KernelBench tasks, with GPT-5.6 Sol and in-context DSL examples, Ave produces valid kernels within three attempts for 100\% of Level 1 and 88\% of Level 2 problems. Ave is open source at https://github.com/causalflowai/avelang.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: LLM编码智能体能够生成正确的GPU内核，但其性能仍落后于专家库。要实现峰值GPU吞吐量，需要协调共享内存暂存、软件流水线和指令调度等底层变换。单元测试和性能剖析仅提供稀疏的端到端反馈，使智能体无法定位这些变换必须保持的全局约束的违反。我们提出Ave，一个智能体框架，使用数据流不变量作为内核优化的编译时护栏。这些不变量指定了执行过程中必须保持的数据值之间的关系。Ave基于tile的Pythonic DSL暴露硬件指令和编译器策略，同时将复杂的内存布局编码抽象为tile。Tag函数分配从选定逻辑坐标和表达式派生的符号标签。编译器通过数据流和控制流传播这些标签，tag断言在使用点强制它们之间的所需关系。编译器使用由SMT求解器支持的可处理的、流敏感、路径不敏感的分析来检查这些断言，返回具体赋值作为抽象违反的见证，并指导修复且无运行时开销。上下文强化学习（ICRL）规划器从精心整理的知识库中提出优化建议。下沉代理实现这些优化并实例化其不变量。我们在AMD MI300X上对GEMM、flash attention和MoE评估Ave，这些合计占LLM推理中GPU时间的90%。在GPT-5.6 Sol下，其优化内核达到最先进手工优化库有效吞吐量的89-99%，并将几何平均吞吐量相对于未受污染的智能体基线提高了1.62-1176倍。在200个KernelBench任务上，使用GPT-5.6 Sol和上下文DSL示例，Ave在三次尝试内为100%的Level 1和88%的Level 2问题生成有效内核。Ave已在https://github.com/causalflowai/avelang开源。

upstream_only.title: Taming Dynamism on GPUs: Cross-SM Kernel Fusion via SM Cooperation and Just-in-Time Reduction
upstream_only.abstract: Modern LLM architectures and systems render GPU kernel input shapes increasingly dynamic, e.g., conditional expert routing in MoE and batches with variable-length sequences. This dynamism degrades performance in both expert-tuned kernels and compiler frameworks. We identify the root cause as dynamic cross-SM data dependencies across execution phases, which force distinct phases into separate kernels for correctness. The resulting kernel boundaries amplify intra-phase workload imbalance across SMs, and compel intermediate states to expensive round trips through off-chip memory.We propose cross-SM kernel fusion, which pushes kernel fusion boundary from traditional intra-SM scope to the entire GPU. Instead of enforcing dependencies via kernel boundaries, it utilizes dynamic SM cooperation and just-in-time reduction. We present MeldKernel (Meld for short), a compiler framework realizing cross-SM fusion for dynamic workloads. First, utilizing GPU on-chip interconnects, Meld enables finegrained SM cooperation, which decomposes coarse-grained, phase-level dependencies into sub-task-level ones, transforming sequential kernels into a fluid, cross-SM pipeline. This further enables just-in-time reduction, facilitating waiting-free and localized state reduction via asynchronous communication. Second, to handle workload dynamism, we propose a decoupled execution model. Developers declaratively define computation logic, while the hardware mapping and inter-SM cooperation are deferred to runtime and adapted to input shapes. Meld accelerates critical workloads like decoding attention by 1.3{\texttimes} on average over the best solutions. Meld shifts GPU execution from a BSP-centric model toward fine-grained, dataflow-driven execution.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代LLM架构和系统使得GPU内核输入形状日益动态化，例如MoE中的条件专家路由和变长序列的批次。这种动态性降低了专家调优内核和编译器框架的性能。我们将根本原因确定为跨执行阶段的动态跨SM数据依赖，为了正确性，这些依赖迫使不同阶段进入独立的内核。由此产生的内核边界加剧了SM之间的阶段内工作负载不均衡，并迫使中间状态通过片外存储器进行昂贵的往返。我们提出跨SM内核融合，将内核融合边界从传统的SM内范围推向整个GPU。它不通过内核边界强制依赖，而是利用动态SM协作和即时归约。我们提出MeldKernel（简称Meld），一个为动态工作负载实现跨SM融合的编译器框架。首先，利用GPU片上互连，Meld实现了细粒度的SM协作，将粗粒度的阶段级依赖分解为子任务级依赖，将顺序内核转换为流畅的跨SM流水线。这进一步实现了即时归约，通过异步通信促进无等待和本地化的状态归约。其次，为了处理工作负载的动态性，我们提出了一种解耦的执行模型。开发者声明式地定义计算逻辑，而硬件映射和SM间协作则推迟到运行时，并根据输入形状进行调整。Meld在解码注意力等关键工作负载上平均比最佳解决方案加速1.3倍。Meld将GPU执行从以BSP为中心的模型转向细粒度的、数据流驱动的执行。

upstream_only.title: M2K: Making the Model-Kernel Interface Explicit for Reliable CUDA Kernel Verification
upstream_only.abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference systems rely on CUDA kernels for core GPU computations, yet the interface between models and kernels is implicit and poorly specified. Models and kernels evolve independently and often make incompatible assumptions about tensor shapes and input sizes, leading to subtle memory bugs in CUDA kernels. These bugs can crash inference services, corrupt model weights, or be exploited by remote adversaries. Existing techniques either incur prohibitive runtime overhead, require specialized hardware, or fail to handle dynamic tensor shapes and variable kernel launch configurations, leaving the CUDA memory bugs largely unaddressed.This paper presents M2K, a fully automated framework that makes the model-kernel interface explicit and leverages it to detect memory bugs in CUDA kernels used in LLM inference systems. M2K consists of two components. HFProbe traces model execution without GPU hardware, classifies kernel arguments into model-fixed and user-variable, and emits symbolic constraints that capture the interface. cuK-LEE then performs symbolic execution on CUDA kernels to pinpoint memory bugs under the interface constraints, modeling tensors as disjoint memory regions and treating thread identifiers symbolically to scale to thousands of threads. In the evaluation, M2K discovers 181 previously unknown bugs in real LLM inference systems, while producing only nine false positives, demonstrating its effectiveness.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）推理系统依赖CUDA内核进行核心GPU计算，然而模型与内核之间的接口是隐式的且规范不足。模型和内核独立演化，并且经常对张量形状和输入大小做出不兼容的假设，导致CUDA内核中出现隐蔽的内存错误。这些错误可能导致推理服务崩溃、损坏模型权重，或被远程攻击者利用。现有技术要么带来过高的运行时开销，要么需要专用硬件，要么无法处理动态张量形状和可变的核函数启动配置，使得CUDA内存错误在很大程度上仍未得到解决。本文提出M2K，一个全自动框架，它显式化模型-内核接口，并利用该接口检测LLM推理系统中使用的CUDA内核的内存错误。M2K由两个组件组成。HFProbe无需GPU硬件即可追踪模型执行，将内核参数分类为模型固定参数和用户可变参数，并发出捕获该接口的符号约束。然后cuK-LEE对CUDA内核执行符号执行，在接口约束下精确定位内存错误，将张量建模为不相交的内存区域，并符号化处理线程标识符以扩展到数千个线程。在评估中，M2K在真实LLM推理系统中发现了181个先前未知的错误，同时仅产生9个误报，证明了其有效性。

upstream_only.title: Wavel: A Fast and Efficient Compilation System for Wafer-Scale Accelerators
upstream_only.abstract: Wafer-scale accelerators offer a new scaling point for AI infrastructure, but they also create a new compilation regime: communication cost varies sharply with location, and the space of possible placements and execution schedules is enormous. Existing GPU, distributed, and vendor compilation systems largely retain a sharding-oriented view and therefore fail to fully leverage these emerging accelerators, leaving the dominant physical scheduling decisions unresolved.We make a key observation: at wafer scale, the central complexity of compilation shifts from finding a logical shard plan to constructing an executable schedule that fixes placement, layout alignment, and execution ordering. Based on this observation, we present Wavel, a fast and efficient compilation system for wafer-scale accelerators. Wavel introduces MeshIR to make executable schedules explicit, constructs them through two legal locality-preserving primitives, CUT and TUNE, and uses physical cost evaluation with structured pruning to keep search practical. On WSE-3 hardware, Wavel delivers 1.31{\texttimes}-1.35{\texttimes} higher mean per-setting throughput than the expert-optimized WaferLLM and up to 1.85{\texttimes} speedup over the Full-Chip baseline on dense models; calibrated cost-model results predict a 2.97{\texttimes} speedup on MoE workloads over the same baseline.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 晶圆级加速器为AI基础设施提供了新的扩展点，但也带来了一种新的编译范式：通信成本随位置急剧变化，而可能的布局与执行调度空间极其庞大。现有的GPU、分布式和厂商编译系统大多保留分片导向的视角，因此未能充分利用这些新兴加速器，导致主要的物理调度决策仍未解决。我们发现一个关键观察：在晶圆级规模下，编译的核心复杂性从寻找逻辑分片方案转移到构建可执行调度，该调度需确定放置、布局对齐和执行顺序。基于这一观察，我们提出Wavel，一种面向晶圆级加速器的快速高效编译系统。Wavel引入MeshIR以显式表示可执行调度，通过两个保持局部性的合法原语CUT和TUNE构造调度，并使用物理代价评估与结构化剪枝使搜索保持实用。在WSE-3硬件上，Wavel相比专家优化的WaferLLM在每设置平均吞吐量上提升1.31至1.35倍，在稠密模型上相比全芯片基线最高取得1.85倍加速；经校准的代价模型结果预测，在MoE工作负载上相比同一基线可取得2.97倍加速。

upstream_only.title: MeshRT: Compile-Time Governed Wafer-Scale Runtime for Low-Latency High-Throughput Inference
upstream_only.abstract: Wafer-scale accelerators promise ultra-low-latency AI inference, but current system stacks still carry an unsustainably high cost premium. The reason is that many current and emerging inference techniques, such as batching and MoE, introduce runtime dynamism that existing wafer-scale systems cannot support efficiently. As a result, they must choose between two unsatisfactory options: accept suboptimal latency, or preserve low latency by restricting dynamic techniques, thereby limiting the models they can support and reducing aggregate throughput. This tradeoff significantly increases the cost of low-latency serving.We present MeshRT, the first wafer-scale system to achieve both ultra-low latency and high throughput for LLM inference. MeshRT achieves this via a novel system architecture, which we call compile-time governance of runtime dynamism. This architecture features new system abstractions and mechanisms that enable MeshRT to compile dynamic events arising from LLM inference directly into per-core schedules, enabling asynchronous and decentralized execution with low runtime overhead. Implemented on a commodity wafer-scale accelerator, MeshRT preserves ultra-low latency while improving throughput by up to 56{\texttimes} over the state-of-the-art system for wafer-scale accelerators. Against measured single-instance SGLang results on H200, MeshRT achieves 4.5-7.0{\texttimes} lower latency. Under ideal linear scaling of those GPU measurements to an area-normalized H200 cluster, MeshRT achieves 1.6-12.1{\texttimes} higher decode energy efficiency in the low-latency regime.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 晶圆级加速器有望实现超低延迟AI推理，但当前系统栈仍承担不可持续的高成本溢价。原因是许多当前和新兴推理技术，如批处理和MoE，引入了现有晶圆级系统无法高效支持的运行时动态性。因此，它们必须在两个不理想选项之间选择：接受次优延迟，或通过限制动态技术来保持低延迟，从而限制可支持的模型并降低总吞吐量。这种权衡显著增加了低延迟服务的成本。我们提出MeshRT，首个为LLM推理同时实现超低延迟和高吞吐的晶圆级系统。MeshRT通过一种新颖的系统架构实现这一点，我们称之为运行时动态性的编译期治理。该架构具有新的系统抽象和机制，使MeshRT能够将LLM推理产生的动态事件直接编译为每核调度，从而实现低运行时开销的异步去中心化执行。在商用晶圆级加速器上实现，MeshRT保持超低延迟，同时将吞吐量相比最先进的晶圆级加速器系统提升最高56倍。与在H200上测得的单实例SGLang结果相比，MeshRT实现了4.5-7.0倍的更低延迟。在这些GPU测量按面积归一化H200集群的理想线性扩展下，MeshRT在低延迟区间实现了1.6-12.1倍的更高解码能效。

upstream_only.title: The Power of Community: Insights and Opportunities
upstream_only.abstract:
Understanding the cyber-security landscape, its current state and trajectory, the challenges in the field, as well as the direction of cutting-edge research and innovation, is a difficult endeavor that is critical for the future of technology and humanity at large. An essential element of gaining this visibility and understanding is found in the community: experts get together, share knowledge, opinions, and points of view, and collectively define the landscape as a living organism. The power of community is central to a healthy, vibrant, and effective ecosystem. 

As the custodians of one of the largest gatherings of cyber-security experts, we share the responsibility of fostering and supporting community, providing opportunities for fertile engagement, and enabling the continuity and vibrancy of engagement in a 24/7/365 world. As a result, we have unique insights into the landscape and its direction that we share back with the community, while also trying to invent new ways to enable additional opportunities for engagement. 

In this talk, we will discuss some of the recent trends and insights we have observed in the cyber-security space, provide a view on the evolution of different areas of interest, and propose new ways to strengthen community.
upstream_only.abstract_zh:
理解网络安全格局、其现状和轨迹、领域中的挑战以及前沿研究和创新的方向，是一项艰巨的工作，对技术的未来乃至整个人类都至关重要。获得这种可见性和理解的一个关键要素在于社区：专家们聚集在一起，分享知识、意见和观点，并共同将这一格局定义为一个活的有机体。社区的力量是健康、充满活力和有效生态系统的核心。

作为最大的网络安全专家聚会的守护者之一，我们肩负着培育和支持社区、为富有成效的参与提供机会、以及在全年无休的世界中保持参与的连续性和活力的责任。因此，我们对这一格局及其方向拥有独特的见解，我们将其回馈给社区，同时也在尝试发明新的方式来创造更多参与机会。

在本次演讲中，我们将讨论我们在网络安全领域观察到的一些最新趋势和洞见，提供对各个兴趣领域演变的看法，并提出加强社区的新方法。

upstream_only.title: Please (Don't) Stop the Music: Adversarial Red-Teaming of AI Music Generation Models
upstream_only.abstract:
Harmful music is an effective propaganda and recruitment tool. It serves as a revenue stream for extremist groups, can be used to shock and disorient and be leveraged for targeted harassment. Generative Music AI models severely lower the bar on how fast and simple harmful musical works can be produced. 
In this talk we'll assess the two main providers for generative Music AI from a red-teaming perspective, have fun with bypassing safety filters and end up designing a more reliable classification solution to prevent generative models from causing harm. If you're interested in red-teaming generative AI, are curious about how to approach security-testing of novel models systematically and wonder about the ethical implications of designing your assessments this talk is just for you! 
By looking at a unique misuse vector of generative artificial intelligence models you will learn what considerations go into defending your next AI solution. Previous ML experience is not required.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 有害音乐是一种有效的宣传和招募工具。它成为极端组织的收入来源，可用于制造震惊和迷失方向，并可被用于定向骚扰。生成式音乐AI模型大大降低了制作有害音乐作品的速度和简单性门槛。在本次报告中，我们将从红队测试的角度评估两家主要的生成式音乐AI提供商，享受绕过安全过滤器的乐趣，并最终设计一个更可靠的分类解决方案，以防止生成式模型造成危害。如果你对生成式AI的红队测试感兴趣，好奇如何系统地对新模型进行安全测试，并思考设计此类评估的道德影响，本次报告正适合你！通过观察生成式人工智能模型的一个独特滥用向量，你将了解到防御你的下一个AI解决方案时需要考虑的事项。不需要之前的机器学习经验。

upstream_only.title: AI Red Teaming and Automation: Exploring Societal Risks in GenAI
upstream_only.abstract:
Generative AI (GenAI) is rapidly transforming industries, from healthcare to military defense. However, as these systems become more powerful, they introduce increasingly complex risks, safety concerns, and ethical challenges. Many of these risks are novel and evolving, requiring flexible and proactive strategies to address them.
AI Red Teaming is a critical approach for uncovering these emerging threats, but manual testing alone cannot keep pace with GenAI's rapid development. Automation is essential for scalable, efficient, and adaptive red teaming efforts. In this talk, I will cover the fundamentals of AI Red Teaming, demonstrate how automated attacks can help identify ethical and security risks at scale, and explore how open-source AI red teaming tools are making these techniques more accessible. By proactively identifying vulnerabilities before AI systems are deployed, we can work together toward a safer and more ethical AI future.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能（GenAI）正在迅速改变从医疗到国防等各行各业。然而，随着这些系统变得更加强大，它们也引入了越来越复杂的风险、安全问题和伦理挑战。其中许多风险是新颖且不断演变的，需要灵活主动的策略来应对。AI红队测试是发现这些新兴威胁的关键方法，但仅靠手动测试无法跟上GenAI的快速发展。自动化对于实现可扩展、高效和自适应的红队测试工作至关重要。在本次演讲中，我将介绍AI红队测试的基础知识，演示自动化攻击如何帮助大规模识别伦理和安全风险，并探讨开源AI红队测试工具如何使这些技术更加易于使用。通过在AI系统部署前主动识别漏洞，我们可以共同努力实现更安全、更符合伦理的AI未来。

upstream_only.title: Trust Agility in an Era of Transient Ties: Rethinking TLS Trust in a Rapidly Evolving Ecosystem
upstream_only.abstract:
The TLS trust and Web PKI ecosystems are undergoing rapid and foundational shifts. Root programs will enforce stricter policies; root certificates will have an active lifetime of 10 years, and server certificates can be valid for no more than 47 days by 2029. These changes are designed to promote crypto-agility and resilience, but they also create new operational and security challenges across the ecosystem.
In this talk, we explore the concept of trust agility in practice: the ability to securely and rapidly update trust relationships as cryptographic standards, certificate authorities, and threat models evolve. While browsers can update quickly, consumer devices have a slower upgrade cycle, especially in developing countries. Meanwhile, machine-to-machine communication and non-browser use cases increasingly fall outside the scope of traditional browser-based trust models.
Drawing from real-world experience, we will discuss strategies for achieving trust agility, focusing on automation and lifecycle-aware certificate management across diverse endpoints. Attendees will walk away with concrete techniques for navigating the modern TLS Trust landscape and future-proofing their PKI infrastructure.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: TLS信任和Web PKI生态系统正在经历快速而根本性的转变。根计划将执行更严格的策略；根证书的有效期将为10年，到2029年服务器证书的有效期不得超过47天。这些变化旨在促进加密敏捷性和抗毁性，但也给整个生态系统带来了新的操作和安全挑战。在本次演讲中，我们探讨了信任敏捷性的实践概念：在密码标准、证书颁发机构和威胁模型演变时安全且快速更新信任关系的能力。尽管浏览器可以快速更新，但消费类设备的升级周期较慢，尤其是在发展中国家。与此同时，机器对机器通信和非浏览器用例越来越超出传统基于浏览器的信任模型的范围。借鉴实际经验，我们将讨论实现信任敏捷性的策略，重点关注跨各种端点的自动化和生命周期感知的证书管理。参会者将获得应对现代TLS信任格局和使其PKI基础设施面向未来的具体技术。

upstream_only.title: Trusted Hardware for AI Workloads: Extending Confidential Computing to Enable AI Adoption
upstream_only.abstract: As companies race to adopt AI in new use cases, hardware vendors and cloud providers are developing the protocols to secure AI workloads with limited input from the broader security community. This talk surveys key challenges of extending Confidential Computing and Trusted Execution Environments from CPUs to clusters of AI accelerators, highlighting technical contributions needed from security experts: efficient remote attestation and key management, secure interconnects, and device memory protection. These advancements would enable stronger security guarantees while maintaining performance and code compatibility—crucial requirements for commercial adoption. We draw from our experience evaluating market opportunities for emerging technologies to offer a unique perspective on both the commercial potential and technical feasibility of trusted hardware for large-scale AI.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 随着企业竞相在新用例中采用人工智能，硬件厂商和云服务提供商正在开发协议以保护AI工作负载，但安全界广泛群体的参与有限。本报告综述了将机密计算和可信执行环境从CPU扩展到AI加速器集群的关键挑战，重点指出了安全专家所需的技术贡献：高效的远程证明和密钥管理、安全互连以及设备内存保护。这些进展将能够在保持性能和代码兼容性的同时提供更强的安全保障，而这两者对于商业采用至关重要。我们借鉴评估新兴技术市场机会的经验，为大规模AI可信硬件提供关于商业潜力和技术可行性的独特视角。

upstream_only.title: Securing Meta's Production PKI Credentials
upstream_only.abstract: Meta's production infrastructure, which safeguards sensitive data on millions of hosts, relies heavily on the confidentiality of private key material tied to billions of active identity credentials with lifetimes of up to 3 months. These credentials, when improperly stored, are vulnerable to exfiltration by users with root or supervisory access, which can lead to unauthorized access to sensitive data. To address this, we are implementing a multi-faceted approach that includes certificate revocation, IP binding enforcement, the use of delegated credentials, and the integration of Trusted Platform Modules (TPMs) with platform attestation and integrity measurements. These measures aim to prevent credential mobility, reduce credential lifetime, and increase the cost of credential exfiltration. By securing the private keys within TPMs and enforcing IP binding, we ensure that credentials are tied to specific hosts, thereby mitigating the risk of unauthorized use in different environments.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Meta的生产基础设施保护着数百万主机上的敏感数据，其安全性高度依赖于与数十亿个活跃身份凭据相关的私钥材料的机密性，这些凭据的生命周期长达3个月。这些凭据如果存储不当，可能被拥有root或超级用户权限的用户窃取，从而导致对敏感数据的未授权访问。为了解决这一问题，我们正在实施一种多管齐下的方案，包括证书撤销、IP绑定强制、使用委派凭据，以及将可信平台模块（TPM）与平台证明和完整性度量相集成。这些措施旨在防止凭据的移动性、缩短凭据生命周期，并提高凭据窃取的成本。通过将私钥保存在TPM中并强制执行IP绑定，我们确保凭据与特定主机绑定，从而减轻在不同环境中未经授权使用的风险。

upstream_only.title: Security Theater Is Canceled: Time for a Real Show
upstream_only.abstract: Real-world security is a human-driven challenge that demands cross-functional collaboration—not just from security teams, but also from partners like SRE, Trust, and Legal—because most security goals (like reliability and accountability) are shared across disciplines. From hacker pipelines like Scattered Spider, to the complexities of cryptography as key management, to the dark realities of ransomware and state-sponsored actors, security is deeply entangled with people, systems, and incentives. The lesson: security isn’t just about fixing bugs—it’s about understanding motivations, building alliances with partners and stakeholders across the org, and designing systems that make doing the right thing the easy thing.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现实世界中的安全是一项由人驱动的挑战，需要跨职能协作——不仅是安全团队，还包括SRE、信任与法务等合作伙伴——因为大多数安全目标（如可靠性和问责制）是跨学科共享的。从Scattered Spider等黑客渠道，到密码学作为密钥管理的复杂性，再到勒索软件和国家级行为者的黑暗现实，安全与人、系统和激励因素深度纠缠。教训是：安全不仅仅是修复漏洞，而是理解动机、与组织内外的合作伙伴和利益相关者建立联盟，并设计使正确行事成为轻而易举之事的系统。

upstream_only.title: Risk Is Not a Hammer, and Most Hazards Aren't Nails
upstream_only.abstract:
"Risk management" has been given a privileged position in security, that of an axiomatic truth. It doesn't deserve it. Even if we could quantify likelihood or impact, it's not clear that risk management estimation or communication are effective ways to reduce either. More, there are more than 200 risk management standards. Which ones work, and what does that even mean? Respected authorities like NASA write things like: "While there will probably always be vigorous debate over the details of what comprises the best approach to managing risk, few will disagree that effective risk management is critical to program and project success and affordability." If there's vigorous debate, to what are we agreeing? Does it achieve the goal of affordability? We can decrease the cost of risk approaches by standardizing answers to "impossible to answer questions" such as "what's an acceptable rate of phishing test failure?" The answers are not made better by requiring every company to determine their own: if the results fit a normal curve, almost half will be over-permissive while the other half are too strict. 
A first step is to acknowledge that risk framing is creating more problems than it solves. Most of us can either stop spending energy on risk management, or spend less, freeing that energy for useful work. We can treat specified risk management techniques as objects of study, looking to properties like accuracy, precision and cost, as well as sensitivity of decisions. We can look for other properties that influence decisions (cost to address, and who bears the cost).
upstream_only.abstract_zh: “风险管理”在安全领域被赋予了特权地位，被视为公理性的真理，但它并不配得到这种地位。即使我们能够量化可能性或影响，也不清楚风险管理估算或沟通是否能有效降低两者。此外，有超过200种风险管理标准。哪些有效？这又意味着什么？像NASA这样受人尊敬的机构写道：“尽管关于构成最佳风险管理方法的细节可能永远存在激烈辩论，但很少有人会否认有效的风险管理对项目和计划的成功及可负担性至关重要。”如果存在激烈辩论，我们又同意了什么？它是否实现了可负担性的目标？我们可以通过标准化一些“无法回答的问题”（如“可接受的网络钓鱼测试失败率是多少？”）的答案来降低风险方法的成本。这些答案并不会因为要求每家公司自行确定而变得更好：如果结果符合正态分布，那么几乎一半会过于宽松，而另一半过于严格。第一步是承认风险框架造成的问题多于其解决的问题。我们大多数人可以停止在风险管理上花费精力，或减少花费，将这些精力用于有用的工作。我们可以将特定的风险管理技术视为研究对象，关注准确性、精确性和成本等属性，以及决策的敏感性。我们还可以寻找影响决策的其他属性（处理成本，以及由谁承担成本）。

upstream_only.title: Everything Old Is New Again: Legal Restrictions on Vulnerability Disclosure on Bug Bounty Platforms
upstream_only.abstract:
Thirty years ago, a debate raged over whether vulnerability disclosure was good for computer security. On one side, full disclosure advocates argued that software bugs weren't getting fixed and wouldn't get fixed if companies that made insecure software wasn't called out publicly. On the other side, companies argued that full disclosure led to exploitation of unpatched vulnerabilities, especially if they were hard to fix. After blog posts, public debates, and countless mailing list flame wars, there emerged a compromise solution: coordinated vulnerability disclosure, where vulnerabilities were disclosed after a period of confidentiality where vendors can attempt to fix things. Although full disclosure fell out of fashion, disclosure won and security through obscurity lost. We've lived happily ever after since.
Or have we? The move towards paid bug bounties and the rise of platforms that manage bug bounty programs for security teams has changed the reality of disclosure significantly. In certain cases, these programs require agreement to contractual restrictions. Under the status quo, that means that software companies sometimes funnel vulnerabilities into bug bounty management platforms and then condition submission on confidentiality agreements that can prohibit researchers from ever sharing their findings. 
In this talk, I'll explain how confidentiality requirements for managed bug bounty programs restrict the ability of those who attempt to report vulnerabilities to share their findings publicly, compromising the bargain at the center of the CVD process.  I'll discuss what contract law can tell us about how and when these restrictions are enforceable, and more importantly, when they aren't, providing advice to hackers around how to understand their legal rights when submitting. Finally, I'll call upon platforms and companies to adapt their practices to be more in line with the original bargain of coordinated vulnerability disclosure, including by banning agreements that require non-disclosure.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 三十年前，一场关于漏洞披露对计算机安全是否有益的辩论激烈展开。一方主张全面披露，认为软件缺陷得不到修复，如果生产不安全软件的公司不受到公众批评，缺陷就不会被修复。另一方则辩称，全面披露会导致未修补漏洞被利用，特别是当这些漏洞难以修复时。经过博客文章、公开辩论和无数邮件列表上的争论，最终达成了一种折衷方案：协调漏洞披露（coordinated vulnerability disclosure），即在给厂商一段保密期以尝试修复问题后，再进行披露。尽管全面披露已不再流行，但披露思路获胜了，而‘通过隐蔽实现安全’则失败了。从此我们幸福地生活下去。或者真的如此吗？朝向付费漏洞赏金计划的转变，以及为安全团队管理漏洞赏金计划的平台的兴起，已显著改变了披露的现实。在某些情况下，这些计划要求同意合同限制。在现状下，这意味着软件公司有时会将漏洞引入漏洞赏金管理平台，然后以保密协议为提交条件，这些协议可能禁止研究者公开分享他们的发现。在本次演讲中，我将解释托管漏洞赏金计划的保密要求如何限制那些试图报告漏洞的人公开发布其发现的能力，从而损害了CVD流程核心的约定。我将讨论合同法如何告诉我们这些限制何时以及如何可强制执行，更重要的是何时不可强制执行，并为黑客提供关于在提交时理解其法律权利的建议。最后，我将呼吁平台和公司调整其做法，使其更符合协调漏洞披露的初始约定，包括禁止要求不披露的协议。

upstream_only.title: Fighting Fire with Venom: Adversarial Defense Against Unauthorized Web Crawling
upstream_only.abstract:
As companies developing large language models (LLMs) race to gather fresh data from the open web, their crawling operations grow increasingly aggressive. While the Robots Exclusion Standard (robots.txt) was meant to provide guidelines for responsible crawling, many entities either ignore it or interpret it loosely in pursuit of large-scale data. This talk explores a novel way to push back by actively serving different or misleading content to identified crawlers.
We will introduce Venom, an experimental toolkit that combines advanced fingerprinting and inline proxy techniques to dynamically alter served content based on the specific crawler detected. Venom evaluates multiple signals—request headers, behavior patterns, and known crawler infrastructure—before deciding how to respond. The talk will cover the practical challenges of implementing this defense, the legal and ethical dilemmas involved, and how well it works against both text-based and image-based crawling strategies.
Drawing on case studies covering text and image scraping, this presentation includes a validation study demonstrating how LLMs trained on intentionally "poisoned" content experience degraded performance, ultimately making large-scale crawling a net negative for data harvesters. Rather than relying on traditional blocking (which remains neutral to a crawler's value proposition) or CAPTCHA/puzzle approaches, this adversarial strategy focuses on reshaping the cost-benefit equation so that unscrupulous collection efforts yield poor results.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 随着开发大型语言模型（LLM）的公司竞相从开放网络获取新鲜数据，其爬虫操作变得越来越激进。虽然机器人排除标准（robots.txt）本意是为负责任的爬取提供指导，但许多实体为了大规模数据，要么忽视它，要么松散地解读它。本演讲探索了一种新颖的反击方式：主动向已识别的爬虫提供不同或误导性内容。我们将介绍Venom，一个实验性工具包，它结合高级指纹识别和内联代理技术，根据检测到的具体爬虫动态改变所提供的内容。Venom在决定如何响应之前评估多个信号——请求头、行为模式和已知的爬虫基础设施。演讲将涵盖实施这一防御的实际挑战、所涉及的法律和伦理困境，以及它对基于文本和图像的爬取策略的有效性。通过涵盖文本和图像抓取的案例研究，本演示包含一项验证研究，证明在被故意“投毒”的内容上训练的LLM性能下降，最终使大规模爬取对数据采集者来说净收益为负。与其依赖传统的阻止（这对爬虫的价值主张保持中性）或CAPTCHA/验证码方法，这一对抗性策略侧重于重塑成本效益方程，使不道德的内容收集工作产生糟糕的结果。

upstream_only.title: Inside Out: Security Designed With, Not For
upstream_only.abstract:
In the rapidly evolving cybersecurity landscape, ensuring that security products are robust and accessible is crucial. Failing to design an inclusive cybersecurity product can lead to significant barriers and security risks not only for people with disabilities but for everyone. This talk delves into the crucial role of engaging people with disabilities in qualitative research to design truly secure security products for enterprise customers. 
We will explore how involving people with disabilities in qualitative research can influence the design of enterprise security products. Past research has underscored the need for accessibility and usability as part of security requirements for effective risk management. This presentation outlines how to equip teams with the knowledge and structure to engage assistive technology users throughout the product development lifecycle. We must rethink security design—not just as a technical capability but as something that emerges from diverse perspectives and lived experiences. 
Embracing inclusivity in research and design processes allows us to create security solutions that are not only robust and reliable but also accessible and user-friendly for everyone. This approach is the future of security product development, fostering trust and loyalty among a broader user base and ultimately delivering a differentiated user experience.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在快速演变的网络安全格局中，确保安全产品既稳健又易于使用至关重要。若未能设计出包容性的网络安全产品，不仅会给残障人士，也会给所有人带来重大障碍和安全风险。本次演讲深入探讨了让残障人士参与定性研究、为企业客户设计真正安全的安全产品的关键作用。我们将探讨让残障人士参与定性研究如何影响企业安全产品的设计。过去的研究已强调，将可访问性和可用性作为有效风险管理安全要求的一部分十分必要。本演讲概述了如何为团队提供知识和结构，在整个产品开发生命周期中让辅助技术用户参与进来。我们必须重新思考安全设计——不仅要将其视为一种技术能力，还要将其视为源于多元视角和生活经验的产物。在研究和设计过程中 embracing 包容性，使我们能够创造出既稳健可靠、又对所有人都易于访问和使用的安全解决方案。这种方法是安全产品开发的未来，能够在更广泛的用户群体中培养信任和忠诚，并最终带来差异化的用户体验。

upstream_only.title: Building a Voting Machine Everyone Can Trust
upstream_only.abstract: Voting is a particularly complicated field. Every citizen gets one vote, ballots must be secret, and the tally must be fair. In the United States, due to the complexity of our ballots, we must use electronic tabulation equipment, and the problem thus becomes even harder. Over the last seven years, at VotingWorks, we've been building an open-source voting machine for US elections. We've learned a few key lessons in what it takes to build a voting machine everyone can trust. In some ways, these lessons are deeply surprising: though good security practices are obviously necessary for trust, they are very far from sufficient.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 投票是一个特别复杂的领域。每个公民都有一票，选票必须保密，计票必须公平。在美国，由于选票的复杂性，我们必须使用电子制表设备，问题因此变得更加困难。在过去的七年里，在VotingWorks，我们一直在为美国选举构建一台开源投票机。我们学到了一些关于打造一台每个人都能信任的投票机的关键经验。在某些方面，这些经验深深令人惊讶：尽管良好的安全实践显然是信任所必需的，但它们远非充分条件。

upstream_only.title: Securing Packages in npm, Homebrew, PyPI, Maven Central, and RubyGems
upstream_only.abstract: Signing software has never been easy. Securing access to private keys, distributing public keys, and being able to rotate key material all pose challenges. Several package ecosystems (npm, Homebrew, PyPI, Maven Central, and RubyGems) are moving from traditional PGP signatures to build attestations. These attestations not only ensure the integrity of the package, but also include non-falsifiable links back to the specific source code revision, build instructions, and build logs of a package. We'll show you how to access this new source of information, describe how it helped respond to the Ultralytics package compromise on PyPI in December of 2024, and describe how it works by walking you through how to add this information to open source packages you maintain.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 签署软件从来都不容易。保护私钥的访问、分发公钥以及能够轮换密钥材料都构成挑战。几个包生态系统（npm、Homebrew、PyPI、Maven Central 和 RubyGems）正在从传统的 PGP 签名转向构建证明。这些证明不仅确保包的完整性，还包括指向特定源代码修订版、构建指令和构建日志的不可伪造链接。我们将展示如何访问这一新信息来源，描述它如何帮助应对2024年12月PyPI上Ultralytics软件包泄露事件，并通过向您维护的开源软件包添加此信息来逐步演示其工作原理。

upstream_only.title: Zombie Devices Are Running Amuck!
upstream_only.abstract: More and more consumer products are connected to the internet. But when consumers keep connected devices such as routers and IoT products online after they have stopped receiving software and security updates, they become zombies, and are open to cyberattack. Zombie devices are connected devices that are no longer receiving security updates and are potential attack vectors. Nation states and malicious actors use these zombie devices to launch botnets, and access consumer networks. We can't take out all of the undead, but we can certainly reduce their number with policy tweaks, consumer education and industry changes. Manufacturers will have to design for longevity and recognize the obligations that come with selling connected products. Transparency around how long a manufacturer plans to support a connected device will help. As will education. Consumer Reports conducted a nationally representative survey in December that found four in ten (43%) owners of a connected device said that the last time they purchased one they were not aware that it might lose software support at some point. Consumer Reports will present model legislation, manufacturer best practices and an overview of current consumer understanding to help reduce the number of zombie devices in the wild.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 越来越多的消费产品连接到互联网。但当消费者在设备停止接收软件和安全更新后仍将其（如路由器和其他物联网产品）保持在线时，这些设备就变成了僵尸设备，容易受到网络攻击。僵尸设备是指不再接收安全更新的联网设备，它们可能成为攻击的入口。国家和恶意行为者利用这些僵尸设备发起僵尸网络，并侵入消费者的网络。我们无法消灭所有“亡灵”，但肯定可以通过政策调整、消费者教育和行业变革来减少其数量。制造商必须面向长期使用进行设计，并认识到销售联网设备所伴随的义务。制造商计划支持设备多久的透明度将有所帮助。教育同样重要。消费者报告（Consumer Reports）在12月开展的一项具有全国代表性的调查发现，在拥有联网设备的受访者中，四成（43%）表示在最近一次购买时并未意识到该设备可能会在某个时间点失去软件支持。消费者报告将提出示范性立法、制造商最佳实践以及消费者当前认知情况的概述，以帮助减少现实中僵尸设备的数量。

upstream_only.title: Usernames, Passwords, and Security
upstream_only.abstract: We all have learned how important passwords are, that we must use them carefully and keep them secret. But what about usernames? Usernames are just as ubiquitous, and just like passwords, come with rules for creating new ones. In this talk, we'll take a look at usernames across the decades, from mainframes to the cloud, and learn exactly how usernames relate to security and how they have been used. It turns out that there are just two patterns to how usernames get used in operating systems for security, and both patterns are still used today. Understanding these patterns is useful to anyone concerned with security. It's also interesting that these patterns have remained in constant use, and where they are used.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们都已了解密码有多重要，必须谨慎使用并加以保密。但用户名呢？用户名同样无处不在，而且像密码一样，在创建新用户名时有相应的规则。在本演讲中，我们将回顾几十年来从大型机到云环境中的用户名，了解用户名与安全的确切关系以及它们是如何被使用的。事实证明，在操作系统中，用户名的安全使用方式只有两种模式，并且这两种模式沿用至今。理解这些模式对任何关注安全的人来说都很有用。同样有趣的是，这些模式一直保持不变地在使用，以及它们各自被应用在何处。

upstream_only.title: HasteBoots: Proving TFHE Programmable Bootstrapping in Seconds
upstream_only.abstract:
Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) enables computations on encrypted data, ensuring privacy for outsourced computation. However, verifying the integrity of FHE computations remains a significant challenge, especially for bootstrapping, the most computationally intensive operation in FHE. Prior approaches, including zkVM-based solutions and general-purpose SNARKs, suffer from inefficiencies, with proof generation time ranging from several hours to days.
In this work, we propose HasteBoots, a succinct argument tailored for TFHE with programmable bootstrapping. By designing efficient protocols for arithmetic operations over quotient rings, HasteBoots achieves proof generation in a few seconds for TFHE evaluation with programmable bootstrapping, significantly outperforming the state-of-the-art, Zama (CCS'25). Moreover, HasteBoots supports batching multiple TFHE evaluations and bootstrappings, a feature that prior work cannot practically support due to prohibitive proving cost. HasteBoots can prove a batch of 16 operations within one minute, while maintaining succinct verification, requiring only 126 ms and a proof size of 0.28 MB. Our approach demonstrates the potential for scalable and efficient verifiable FHE, paving the way for practical, privacy-preserving computations.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 全同态加密（FHE）支持对加密数据进行计算，从而确保外包计算的隐私。然而，验证FHE计算的完整性仍然是一个重大挑战，尤其是对于自举（bootstrapping），这是FHE中计算开销最大的操作。此前的方法，包括基于zkVM的解决方案和通用SNARK，效率低下，证明生成时间从数小时到数天不等。在本工作中，我们提出HasteBoots，一种针对具有可编程自举的TFHE的简洁论证。通过为商环上的算术运算设计高效协议，HasteBoots在带可编程自举的TFHE求值中实现了数秒内的证明生成，显著优于最先进的Zama（CCS'25）。此外，HasteBoots支持批量处理多个TFHE求值和自举，这是此前工作由于证明成本过高而无法实际支持的特性。HasteBoots可以在一分钟内证明一批16个操作，同时保持简洁验证，仅需126毫秒，证明大小为0.28 MB。我们的方法展示了可扩展且高效的可验证FHE的潜力，为实用的隐私保护计算铺平了道路。

upstream_only.title: Orbit: Optimizing Rescale and Bootstrap Placement with Integer Linear Programming Techniques for Secure Inference
upstream_only.abstract:
Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) allows computation on encrypted data without decrypting it. In theory, FHE makes privacy-preserving machine learning possible. In practice, however, it remains impractically slow for real workloads. A major source of slowdown is bootstrap operations; in CKKS, a popular FHE scheme for tensor workloads, the slowdown is compounded by scale management and rescale operations.
FHE compilers for machine learning inference aim to make bootstrap placement and scale management efficient and easy by compiling high-level tensor programs into optimized CKKS computations. Unfortunately, existing approaches miss crucial optimization opportunities because they overlook a key property of CKKS programs: bootstrap and rescale placement are fundamentally coupled through the level budget. In this paper, we present Orbit, an FHE compiler that jointly optimizes bootstrap and rescale placement through a novel Integer Linear Programming (ILP) formulation that reasons about both ciphertext level and scale constraints. To make this formulation tractable for structured tensor workloads, particularly convolutional neural networks, we introduce three techniques that reduce ILP complexity while preserving optimality. Across five workloads and multiple cryptographic parameter configurations, Orbit achieves a geometric mean speedup of 19% over DaCapo, 73% over Orion, and 52% over ReSBM, keeps compilation under 6 minutes, and retains model accuracy within 0.3% of plaintext execution.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 全同态加密（FHE）允许在不解密的情况下对加密数据进行计算。理论上，FHE使隐私保护机器学习成为可能。然而在实践中，对于真实工作负载，它仍然慢得不切实际。一个主要的减速来源是自举（bootstrap）操作；在CKKS——一种用于张量工作负载的流行FHE方案——中，这种减速又因规模管理和重缩放（rescale）操作而加剧。面向机器学习推理的FHE编译器旨在通过将高层张量程序编译为优化的CKKS计算，使自举放置和规模管理变得高效且容易。不幸的是，现有方法错过了关键优化机会，因为它们忽略了CKKS程序的一个关键性质：自举和重缩放放置通过层级预算（level budget）从根本上耦合在一起。在本文中，我们提出Orbit，一种FHE编译器，它通过一种新颖的整数线性规划（ILP）公式联合优化自举和重缩放放置，该公式同时考虑密文层级和规模约束。为了使该公式对结构化张量工作负载（尤其是卷积神经网络）可行，我们引入三种技术，在保持最优性的同时降低ILP复杂度。在五个工作负载和多种密码参数配置下，Orbit相比DaCapo、Orion和ReSBM分别实现了19%、73%和52%的几何平均加速，编译时间保持在6分钟以内，并且模型准确率与明文执行的差距在0.3%以内。

upstream_only.title: VROOM: Accelerating (Almost All) Number-Theoretic Cryptography Using Vectorization and the Residue Number System
upstream_only.abstract:
Modular arithmetic with a large prime modulus is a dominant computational cost in number-theoretic cryptography. Modular operations are especially challenging to parallelize efficiently on CPUs using vector instructions. Standard CPU implementations rely on costly carry operations and permutation instructions to align with the multiplication datapath, negating the benefits of vectorization.
We develop vectorized algorithms for modular addition and multiplication, and present a new, constant-time modular multiplication algorithm suitable for general moduli—prime or otherwise. Our method uses a Residue Number System (RNS) representation to align the arithmetic naturally with wide vector units, and strategically eliminate extraneous instructions. Existing works either require the use of customized hardware or fail to show latency improvements.
Reducing the latency of modular arithmetic results in speedups for cryptographic applications. We accelerate RSA-4096 signatures by 4.0× (verify) and 1.3× (sign) over OpenSSL, and speed up BLS signature verifications by 4.05× over the assembly-optimized blst library. To facilitate broad practical adoption, we are upstreaming our implementation into BoringSSL, where it will directly benefit real-world TLS and cryptographic deployments. Results on mapping our algorithm to Nvidia GPUs demonstrate speedups on modular multiplication over Nvidia's CGBN library.
upstream_only.abstract_zh:
模大素数的模运算在数论密码学中占主导计算成本。使用向量指令在CPU上高效并行化模运算尤其具有挑战性。标准的CPU实现依赖昂贵的进位操作和置换指令来对齐乘法数据通路，从而抵消了向量化的优势。
我们开发了用于模加法和乘法的向量化算法，并提出了一种新的、适用于一般模数（素数或其他）的恒定时间模乘法算法。我们的方法使用剩余数系统（RNS）表示，使算术自然地对齐宽向量单元，并策略性地消除多余指令。现有工作要么需要使用定制硬件，要么未能显示出延迟改进。
降低模运算的延迟可为密码应用带来加速。我们将RSA-4096签名相对于OpenSSL加速了4.0倍（验证）和1.3倍（签名），并将BLS签名验证相对于汇编优化的blst库加速了4.05倍。为促进广泛的实践采用，我们正在将实现上游合并到BoringSSL中，它将直接惠及实际TLS和密码部署。将我们的算法映射到Nvidia GPU的结果表明，在模乘法上比Nvidia的CGBN库有加速。

upstream_only.title: Patcher: Post-Hoc Patching of Backdoored Large Language Models
upstream_only.abstract: Large language models remain vulnerable to jailbreak backdoor attacks, where adversaries poison safety alignment data to embed hidden triggers that bypass safety mechanisms. Existing defenses often require comprehensive attack information or multiple triggered examples, making them impractical when defenders only observe a single reported failure case without knowing whether it stems from a backdoor attack or a natural alignment bug. This paper presents Patcher, a post-hoc defense framework that repairs backdoored language models using only a single reported failure case and the model parameters. Patcher operates in two stages. First, it localizes backdoor triggers by computing response-conditioned gradient-based saliency scores and applying adaptive clustering to separate triggers from benign context. Second, it patches the model through a constrained fine-tuning objective that breaks the trigger-response association while preserving benign-task utility and robustness to non-triggered jailbreak attacks through KL-divergence constraints. We conduct extensive evaluations across multiple backdoor attack strategies and demonstrate that Patcher successfully localizes triggers and neutralizes backdoors while maintaining model utility. We further show robustness against adaptive attacks designed to evade our defense. This work represents a significant step toward practical defenses against training-time attacks in deployed language models.
