upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型仍然容易受到越狱后门攻击，其中攻击者通过污染安全对齐数据来嵌入隐藏触发器，从而绕过安全机制。现有防御通常需要全面的攻击信息或多个已触发示例，当防御者仅观察到单个报告失败案例且不知道其源于后门攻击还是自然对齐缺陷时，这些防御往往不切实际。本文提出 Patcher，一种事后防御框架，仅使用单个报告失败案例和模型参数即可修复后门语言模型。Patcher分两阶段运行。首先，它通过计算基于响应条件的梯度显著性分数并应用自适应聚类来定位后门触发器，将触发器与良性上下文分离。其次，它通过约束微调目标对模型进行修补，打破触发器-响应关联，同时通过KL散度约束保持良性任务效用以及对非触发越狱攻击的鲁棒性。我们在多种后门攻击策略上进行了广泛评估，证明Patcher能够成功定位触发器并中和后门，同时保持模型效用。我们还进一步展示了针对旨在规避我们防御的自适应攻击的鲁棒性。这项工作代表了在已部署语言模型中防御训练时攻击的实用化防御方面的重要一步。

upstream_only.title: When the Aggregator Cheats: Data-Free Backdoors in Federated LLM-based QA Systems
upstream_only.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based question-answering (QA) systems are increasingly deployed in sensitive domains such as healthcare, mental health counseling, and legal consultation. Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative training without sharing raw client data, for which locally trained models are aggregated at a central server (i.e., a cloud service provider) to obtain a global model. In this paper, we explore the potential vulnerability where a malicious aggregator, who may collude with a third-party vendor, stealthily implants advertisement-type backdoors into federated QA models, without ever accessing client data. The attacker's goals are twofold: (1) preserve clean QA fidelity (i.e., the poisoned model behaves like a clean model on non-triggered queries); and (2) generate highly natural, contextually relevant responses with target advertisements when a trigger appears. Achieving these two goals simultaneously is highly challenging, as naive backdoor injection without knowledge about private data may degrade model's clean performance or fail to inject the target. Motivated by this, we propose to leverage clients' uploaded gradients during training, and develop a two-stage framework for data-free and stealthy poisoning: (1) recover representative training samples from client gradients, and (2) construct poisoning datasets utilizing recovered samples and trigger phrases to inject backdoors into the global model. Experiments across representative QA datasets and LLM families under full fine-tuning and LoRA settings demonstrate that, our method achieves nearly 100% Attack Success Rate (ASR) while incurring negligible degradation on clean tasks. Crucially, reconstructing only 5–20% of gradients suffices to mount a reliable attack, exposing a practical blind spot in the pipeline of federated training of QA LLMs.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的问答（QA）系统正越来越多地部署在医疗保健、心理健康咨询和法律咨询等敏感领域。联邦学习（FL）能够在不共享原始客户端数据的情况下进行协作训练，其中本地训练的模型在中央服务器（即云服务提供商）进行聚合以获得全局模型。本文探讨了一种潜在漏洞：恶意聚合方可能与第三方供应商勾结，在从未访问客户端数据的情况下，向联邦QA模型中隐秘地植入广告型后门。攻击者的目标有两个：(1) 保持干净的QA保真度（即被投毒模型在非触发查询上表现得像干净模型）；(2) 当触发出现时，生成高度自然、上下文相关的带有目标广告的回复。同时实现这两个目标极具挑战性，因为在不知道私有数据的情况下进行朴素的后门注入可能会降低模型的干净性能或无法注入目标。受此启发，我们提出利用训练期间客户端上传的梯度，并开发一个两阶段框架以实现无数据且隐蔽的投毒：(1) 从客户端梯度中恢复代表性训练样本，(2) 利用恢复的样本和触发短语构建投毒数据集，以将后门注入全局模型。在代表性QA数据集和LLM系列上，在全量微调和LoRA设置下的实验表明，我们的方法实现了接近100%的攻击成功率（ASR），同时对干净任务的性能下降可忽略不计。至关重要的是，仅重建5–20%的梯度就足以发动可靠攻击，这暴露了联邦训练QA LLM流程中的一个实际盲点。

upstream_only.title: Unveiling the Pitfalls of Data-Free Backdoor Detection Against Pre-Trained Models
upstream_only.abstract:
Backdoor attacks pose a significant threat to deep learning models, enabling adversaries to manipulate the output through hidden triggers. Recent detection methods aim to identify backdoors without relying on clean samples or assumptions about attacks. Although they report strong performance, these methods are rarely evaluated on pre-trained models. In this paper, we present the first large-scale study of data-free backdoor detection on pre-trained models. Our benchmark includes more than 30,000 models and covers common backdoor attacks. We find that existing data-free methods fail on most pre-trained models, leading to a false sense of security. Despite our effective improvements, serious vulnerabilities remain.
To address this, we propose using convergence speed as a new side-channel signal for backdoor detection. Using this signal, we reveal the cause of the remaining vulnerabilities and build a novel data-free detector that achieves state-of-the-art performance against existing methods. We further analyze how backdoor attacks evade detection and outline unresolved issues. Our results indicate that detecting backdoor attacks requires further exploration. We hope that our work can draw attention to the vulnerabilities in backdoor detection mechanisms for machine learning systems.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 后门攻击对深度学习模型构成重大威胁，使攻击者能够通过隐藏触发器操纵输出。近期的检测方法旨在不依赖干净样本或攻击假设的情况下识别后门。尽管它们报告了强劲的性能，但这些方法很少在预训练模型上进行评估。在本文中，我们首次对预训练模型上的无数据后门检测进行了大规模研究。我们的基准包含超过30,000个模型，并涵盖了常见的后门攻击。我们发现，现有的无数据方法在大多数预训练模型上失败，导致虚假的安全感。尽管我们进行了有效的改进，严重的漏洞仍然存在。为了解决这个问题，我们提出使用收敛速度作为后门检测的新侧信道信号。利用该信号，我们揭示了剩余漏洞的原因，并构建了一种新颖的无数据检测器，其性能优于现有方法。我们进一步分析了后门攻击如何逃避检测，并概述了未解决的问题。我们的结果表明，检测后门攻击需要进一步探索。我们希望我们的工作能够引起人们对机器学习系统后门检测机制中漏洞的关注。

upstream_only.title: Robust Watermarks Meet Backdoored Models: Evading Diffusion Semantic Watermarks via Stealthy Backdoor
upstream_only.abstract: Although semantic watermarking is considered a promising safeguard for images generated by Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs), the reliance of the watermark detection pipeline on neural networks introduces a critical yet underexplored backdoor attack surface. To systematically study this vulnerability, we propose GhostVAE to plant a stealthy backdoor into the encoder of Variational Autoencoder (VAE), enabling reliable evasion of watermark detection. GhostVAE operates in two stages: it first constructs a universal trigger via power spectrum regularization to improve the trigger robustness, and then trains a backdoored VAE encoder with a parameter-aligned objective. Through extensive evaluations across three state-of-the-art semantic watermarking schemes and three widely adopted LDMs, we show that GhostVAE preserves watermark detection performance on benign images (achieving an average true positive rate of 94.4%), while simultaneously enabling highly effective evasion under trigger activation (achieving an average attack success rate of 94.6%). Moreover, we comprehensively analyze seventeen representative defenses and demonstrate that GhostVAE remains stealthy across the input space, parameter space, and latent space. Our work fundamentally undermines the trustworthiness of semantic watermarking systems and highlights that secure deployment of semantic watermarks requires end-to-end security considerations, particularly for neural network components.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 尽管语义水印被认为是潜在扩散模型（LDMs）生成图像的一种有前景的保障措施，但水印检测流程对神经网络的依赖引入了一个关键却未被充分探索的后门攻击面。为了系统地研究这一漏洞，我们提出GhostVAE，将隐蔽后门植入变分自编码器（VAE）的编码器中，从而能够可靠地规避水印检测。GhostVAE分两个阶段运行：首先通过功率谱正则化构建通用触发器以提高触发器的鲁棒性，然后使用参数对齐目标训练后门VAE编码器。通过在三种最先进的语义水印方案和三种广泛采用的LDM上进行广泛评估，我们表明GhostVAE在良性图像上保持了水印检测性能（平均真阳性率达到94.4%），同时在触发器激活下实现了高效的规避（平均攻击成功率达到94.6%）。此外，我们全面分析了十七种代表性防御措施，并证明GhostVAE在输入空间、参数空间和潜在空间中都保持隐蔽。我们的工作从根本上破坏了语义水印系统的可信度，并强调语义水印的安全部署需要端到端的安全考量，特别是对神经网络组件而言。

upstream_only.title: Confundo: Learning to Generate Robust Poison for Practical RAG Systems
upstream_only.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is increasingly deployed in real-world applications, where its reference-grounded design makes outputs appear trustworthy. This trust has spurred research on poisoning attacks that craft malicious content, inject it into knowledge sources, and manipulate RAG responses. However, when evaluated in practical RAG systems, existing attacks suffer from severely degraded effectiveness. This gap stems from two overlooked realities: (i) content is often processed before use, which can fragment the poison and weaken its effect, and (ii) users often do not issue the exact queries anticipated during attack design. These factors can lead practitioners to underestimate risks and develop a false sense of security. To better characterize the threat to practical systems, we present Confundo, a learning-to-poison framework that fine-tunes a large language model as a poison generator to achieve high effectiveness, robustness, and stealthiness. Confundo provides a unified framework supporting multiple attack objectives, demonstrated by manipulating factual correctness, inducing biased opinions, and triggering hallucinations. By addressing these overlooked challenges, Confundo consistently outperforms a wide range of purpose-built attacks across datasets and RAG configurations by large margins, even in the presence of defenses. Beyond exposing vulnerabilities, we also present a defensive use case that protects web content from unauthorized incorporation into RAG systems via scraping, with no impact on user experience.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）正越来越多地部署于现实应用中，其基于引用的设计使输出显得可信。这种信任促进了针对毒化攻击的研究，这些攻击通过构造恶意内容、将其注入知识源并操纵RAG响应来实施。然而，在实际RAG系统中评估时，现有攻击的效果严重下降。这一差距源于两个被忽视的现实：(i) 内容在使用前通常会被处理，这可能分割毒化内容并削弱其效果；(ii) 用户通常不会发出攻击设计时所预期的精确查询。这些因素可能导致从业者低估风险并产生虚假的安全感。为了更好地刻画对实际系统的威胁，我们提出了Confundo，一个学习毒化框架，它微调大语言模型作为毒化生成器，以实现高有效性、鲁棒性和隐蔽性。Confundo提供了一个支持多种攻击目标的统一框架，并通过操纵事实正确性、诱导偏见观点和触发幻觉进行了演示。通过解决这些被忽视的挑战，Confundo在多个数据集和RAG配置上，即使存在防御，也以较大优势持续优于各种专门构建的攻击。除了揭示漏洞外，我们还提出了一个防御用例，通过抓取保护网页内容免遭未经授权地纳入RAG系统，且不影响用户体验。

upstream_only.title: Breaking the Boundaries: Analyzing QUIC Frame-Packet Interactions With QUIC-Attacker
upstream_only.abstract:
QUIC is a new network protocol based on UDP that replaces TCP and TLS with an integrated protocol. It provides multiplexing of streams over a single encrypted and authenticated connection. The QUIC standard allows many different combinations of UDP datagrams, and QUIC packets, frames, and streams to transport the same information. This implies that testing the receiving side of QUIC is difficult.
We develop probes to explore how different QUIC server implementations handle the coalescence and fragmentation of payloads, covering both valid and invalid combinations of datagrams, packets, and frames. Already at this basic level, we observe significant differences between implementations, some of which pointing towards exploitable vulnerabilities. Previous QUIC research tools were not designed to implement such probes. To address this limitation, we present QUIC-Attacker, a testing framework that allows maximum freedom on the sending side of QUIC.
We present our results on these probes when applied to 15 QUIC server libraries, uncovering eight DoS vulnerabilities caused by unhandled exceptions and exploitable injection vulnerabilities in Kwik and Alibaba's XQUIC.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: QUIC 是一种基于 UDP 的新网络协议，用集成协议取代 TCP 和 TLS。它通过单个加密和认证连接提供流的复用。QUIC 标准允许 UDP 数据报以及 QUIC 包、帧和流的许多不同组合来传输相同信息。这意味着测试 QUIC 的接收端很困难。我们开发探测方法来探索不同 QUIC 服务器实现如何处理载荷的合并与分片，涵盖数据报、包和帧的有效和无效组合。仅在这个基本层面上，我们就观察到实现之间的显著差异，其中一些指向可利用的漏洞。先前的 QUIC 研究工具并未设计用于实现此类探测。为解决这一限制，我们提出 QUIC-Attacker，一个允许在 QUIC 发送端拥有最大自由度的测试框架。我们展示了对 15 个 QUIC 服务器库应用这些探测的结果，发现了 8 个由未处理异常引起的 DoS 漏洞，以及 Kwik 和阿里巴巴 XQUIC 中可利用的注入漏洞。

upstream_only.title: When Authorization Loses Its Meaning: Breaking and Fixing Third-Party Online Payments
upstream_only.abstract: Third-party online payment systems, such as Alipay and PSPB, constitute critical infrastructure for modern e-commerce. However, their security rests on the unrealistic assumption of fully trusted communication channels. While prior studies have identified isolated vulnerabilities, a systematic formal analysis of payment protocol security remains absent. This paper presents formal security models for six third-party payment protocols, spanning three major payment scenarios and two dominant payment service providers. Our analysis reveals a fundamental design flaw: whenever channel integrity is compromised between the merchant client, merchant server, or payment system, order tampering attacks become feasible. We validate this threat on Android, where over 20% of tested merchant applications allow order tampering through implicit Intent hijacking. To mitigate this threat, we propose user-side order authentication, where per-user-merchant key pairs cryptographically bind consent to order semantics. Formal verification demonstrates its resilience against identified attacks under weak channel assumptions. By bridging formal methods and empirical analysis, this work offers actionable guidance for standardizing secure payment protocols.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 第三方在线支付系统，如支付宝和PSPB，构成了现代电子商务的关键基础设施。然而，其安全性建立在完全可信通信信道这一不现实的假设之上。尽管此前研究已发现一些孤立的漏洞，但对支付协议安全性的系统性形式化分析仍然缺失。本文提出了六种第三方支付协议的形式化安全模型，涵盖三大支付场景和两家主要支付服务提供商。我们的分析揭示了一个根本性设计缺陷：一旦商户客户端、商户服务器或支付系统之间的信道完整性遭到破坏，订单篡改攻击就成为可能。我们在Android上验证了这一威胁，超过20%的受测商户应用允许通过隐式Intent劫持进行订单篡改。为缓解这一威胁，我们提出了用户侧订单认证，其中每用户-商户密钥对将同意与订单语义进行密码学绑定。形式化验证表明，在弱信道假设下，该方法能够抵御所识别的攻击。通过连接形式化方法与实证分析，本工作为标准化安全支付协议提供了可操作的指导。

upstream_only.title: TONTOU: On the Exploitability of Time-of-Neutralization to Time-of-Use Windows
upstream_only.abstract:
Recently deployed Spectre v2 mitigations neutralize branch predictor state when switching privilege contexts or immediately prior to indirect branch execution, either through domain isolation or sanitization. These defenses assume that subsequent branch predictor behavior remains free from attacker influence until the neutralized state is used.
Unfortunately, this paper shows that this assumption does not hold on recent AMD and Intel CPUs. We find that postneutralization (Time-of-Neutralization to Time-of-Use, TONTOU) windows can be exploited by an attacker to re-poison the predictor. Specifically, within the post-neutralization window, the attacker can re-direct control-flow of the victim to a training gadget that updates the predictor.
To re-direct control-flow, we introduce INTERRUPT INJECTION, a primitive that exploits post-neutralization windows by leveraging the fact that interrupts can occur at nearly any point in time. Using this primitive, we demonstrate that an attacker can trigger mispredictions during kernel execution on recent AMD and Intel CPUs. To prove its practicality, we build an end-to-end exploit using INTERRUPT INJECTION that leaks arbitrary kernel memory on AMD Zen 2 at a rate of 5.47 bytes/s, despite the latest neutralization techniques.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 最近部署的Spectre v2缓解措施在切换特权上下文或间接分支执行之前立即中和分支预测器状态，方式包括域隔离或清理。这些防御假设后续分支预测器行为在已中和状态被使用之前不受攻击者影响。不幸的是，本文表明这一假设在最近的AMD和Intel CPU上并不成立。我们发现，中和后（Time-of-Neutralization to Time-of-Use, TONTOU）窗口可被攻击者利用来重新污染预测器。具体而言，在中和后窗口内，攻击者可以将受害者的控制流重定向到更新预测器的训练gadget。为了重定向控制流，我们引入了INTERRUPT INJECTION，一种利用中断几乎可在任何时间点发生这一事实来利用中和后窗口的原语。利用该原语，我们证明攻击者可以在最近的AMD和Intel CPU上触发内核执行期间的错误预测。为证明其实用性，我们构建了一个使用INTERRUPT INJECTION的端到端利用，尽管采用了最新的中和技术，仍能以5.47字节/秒的速度泄露AMD Zen 2上的任意内核内存。

upstream_only.title: Amortizing Randomness Cost: Efficient Masked Implementation of SDitH Signatures with Common Shares
upstream_only.abstract:
MPC-in-the-Head (MPCitH) signatures are attractive for postquantum deployment, but they are structurally vulnerable to side-channel leakage: verification opens almost all simulated views, so any leakage correlated with the remaining unopened view(s) can be amplified and exploited to recover the witness. Among the MPCitH-based signature candidates considered in NIST’s additional-signature round, Syndrome-Decodingin-the-Head (SDitH)-Hypercube is particularly susceptible to this concern, since its signing process combines: (i) offline last-party completion involving nonlinear arithmetic computations, (ii) online Baum–Nof (BN) arithmetic checking, and (iii) Keccak sponge calls that generate or absorb secretbearing values.
To the best of our knowledge, this is the first protocol-compatible masked implementation-level protection architecture for SDitH-Hypercube on Cortex-M4. Our implementation combines three techniques, each protecting one attackcritical hotspot: (i) Common Shares to amortize the masking randomness required by masked multiplications in the offline phase, (ii) a Sec/Pub typing discipline that reconstructs transcript-public and verifier-reconstructible values early to avoid costly Sec×Sec gadgets in the online BN kernels, and (iii) selective masked Keccak backends applied only to secretbearing sponge call sites.
On the L1 parameter set, Common Shares reduces arithmetic masking randomness from 8.37 KiB/signature of the Strong Non-Interference (SNI) profile to 16 B/signature, while the Sec/Pub-typed optimization removes 3,264 B/signature from the online BN kernels. When Keccak is masked, masking randomness is dominated by the sponge: 41,118.75 KiB/signature with DOM-Keccak and 82,237.50 KiB/signature with SNI-Keccak, motivating selective masked hashing and tunable backends. We implement a low-stack reference signer and all protected signers on Cortex-M4. Across protected profiles, signing takes 913.7–1,542.0 Mcycles (1.84×–3.10× over the *Corresponding Author. reference), and fits within 155.6 KiB flash, 136.7 KiB static RAM, and 7.96 KiB signing stack. A 1M-trace first-order fixed-vs-random Test Vector Leakage Assessment (TVLA) experiment on Cortex-M4 no longer detects the previously observed leakage peaks after protection.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: MPC-in-the-Head（MPCitH）签名对于后量子部署具有吸引力，但其结构上易受侧信道泄漏影响：验证会打开几乎所有模拟视图，因此任何与剩余未打开视图相关的泄漏都可能被放大并用于恢复见证。在NIST额外签名轮次考虑的基于MPCitH的签名候选中，Syndrome-Decoding-in-the-Head（SDitH）-Hypercube尤其容易受到这一问题影响，因为其签名过程结合了：(i) 涉及非线性算术计算的离线最后一方完成；(ii) 在线Baum–Nof（BN）算术检查；以及 (iii) 生成或吸收含密值的Keccak海绵调用。据我们所知，这是首个在Cortex-M4上针对SDitH-Hypercube的协议兼容的掩码实现级保护架构。我们的实现结合了三种技术，每种技术保护一个攻击关键热点：(i) 公共份额（Common Shares）以摊销离线阶段掩码乘法所需的掩码随机性；(ii) Sec/Pub类型规约，提前重建转录公开和验证者可重建的值，以避免在线BN内核中昂贵的Sec×Sec小工具；(iii) 选择性掩码Keccak后端，仅应用于含密值的海绵调用点。在L1参数集上，公共份额将算术掩码随机性从强非干涉（SNI）配置的每个签名8.37 KiB降低到每个签名16 B，而Sec/Pub类型化优化从在线BN内核中每个签名移除3,264 B。当Keccak被掩码时，掩码随机性由海绵主导：使用DOM-Keccak时为每个签名41,118.75 KiB，使用SNI-Keccak时为每个签名82,237.50 KiB，这促使采用选择性掩码哈希和可调后端。我们在Cortex-M4上实现了低栈参考签名器和所有受保护签名器。在受保护配置中，签名需要913.7–1,542.0 M周期（为参考实现的1.84×–3.10×），并适配于155.6 KiB闪存、136.7 KiB静态RAM和7.96 KiB签名栈。在Cortex-M4上进行的一百万条轨迹的一阶固定-随机测试向量泄漏评估（TVLA）实验在保护后不再检测到先前观察到的泄漏峰。

upstream_only.title: Principled Design of Indexing Functions for Memory Coloring
upstream_only.abstract:
On shared multi-core CPUs, memory coloring achieves microarchitectural isolation by partitioning resources between trust domains. Previous work has shown that memory coloring can, in principle, be used to isolate multiple components simultaneously, e.g., both the last-level (L3) cache and DRAM. The number of colors obtained by these methods depends on the algebraic properties of the indexing functions, though, and today's off-the-shelf CPU designs are often not suited for multi-component memory coloring. 
We develop algorithms to automatically synthesize indexing functions that guarantee a minimum number of colors. Given a set of typical workloads and some context on the CPU design, our algorithms compute a new linear indexing function that supports the requested number of colors while maximizing the performance on the workloads. Our approach is based on the observation that the number of colors depends on the overlap of the algebraic kernels of the involved indexing functions. Building on this observation, we translate the requirements that the CPU design imposes on the function into algebraic constraints that our algorithms enforce. 
In a case study on a 16-core server-class CPU, we show that our framework yields a coloring scheme that partitions the L3 cache and DRAM banks, increasing the number of colors from 1 to 16 while incurring less than 2.5% performance overhead, on average across SPEC and PARSEC benchmarks.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在共享多核CPU上，内存着色通过在不同信任域之间划分资源来实现微架构隔离。先前工作表明，内存着色原则上可用于同时隔离多个组件，例如末级(L3)缓存和DRAM。然而，这些方法获得的颜色数量取决于索引函数的代数性质，而当今的现成CPU设计往往不适合多组件内存着色。我们开发了自动合成索引函数的算法，以保证最低数量的颜色。给定一组典型工作负载以及有关CPU设计的一些上下文，我们的算法计算一个新的线性索引函数，在支持所需颜色数量的同时最大化工作负载上的性能。我们的方法基于这样的观察：颜色数量取决于相关索引函数的代数核的重叠。基于这一观察，我们将CPU设计对函数施加的要求转化为我们的算法所执行的代数约束。在一项针对16核服务器级CPU的案例研究中，我们展示了我们的框架产生了一种着色方案，该方案划分L3缓存和DRAM bank，将颜色数量从1增加到16，同时在SPEC和PARSEC基准测试上平均带来不到2.5%的性能开销。

upstream_only.title: An Integer Overflow Endgame: Compiler and Architecture Support for Default-On Integer Overflow Mitigation
upstream_only.abstract:
Integer overflow checks are off-by-default in most production settings due to their high overheads. Consequently, many serious vulnerabilities remain unmitigated. We analyze the source of these overheads---in compilers including LLVM (UBSan, Rust), and in processors including x86-64, ARM64, and RISC-V---and show how to eliminate them.
Overheads in LLVM stem from how overflow semantics are expressed in LLVM IR. LLVM's current approach, based on intrinsics and branches, interferes with a variety of middle end optimizations. We develop an alternative approach that tracks overflow semantics with metadata, but otherwise leaves LLVM IR unchanged, eliminating this overhead. Overheads in hardware primarily result from current ISA designs, that require doubling the number of μops for checked vs. unchecked arithmetic, stressing the processor pipeline. We show how simple ISA extensions can alleviate this stress, enabling overflow-checked arithmetic to issue as a single μop.
We evaluate these extensions through compiler-based emulation on real hardware and simulation in gem5. Our work offers a path to significantly reducing the cost of overflow checks in existing compilers, and demonstrates that integer overflow mitigation can be cheap enough for default-on use in future hardware.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 由于开销高昂，整数溢出检查在大多数生产环境中默认关闭。因此，许多严重漏洞仍未得到缓解。我们分析了这些开销的来源——包括LLVM（UBSan、Rust）等编译器，以及x86-64、ARM64和RISC-V等处理器——并展示了如何消除它们。LLVM中的开销源于溢出语义在LLVM IR中的表达方式。LLVM当前基于内建函数和分支的方法会干扰多种中端优化。我们开发了一种替代方法，用元数据跟踪溢出语义，但在其他方面保持LLVM IR不变，从而消除了这一开销。硬件中的开销主要源于当前ISA设计，这些设计使得带检查的算术与未检查的算术相比需要加倍的μop，给处理器流水线带来压力。我们展示了简单的ISA扩展如何缓解这种压力，使溢出检查算术能够以单个μop发射。我们通过真实硬件上的基于编译器的仿真和gem5中的模拟来评估这些扩展。我们的工作为显著降低现有编译器中溢出检查的成本提供了一条路径，并表明整数溢出缓解可以足够廉价，以便在未来硬件中默认开启使用。

upstream_only.title: HyperAudit: Towards User Transparent and Highly Efficient System Auditing for Cloud Platforms
upstream_only.abstract:
System auditing is a critical security primitive for cloud platforms, but existing auditing frameworks place the log collection module inside the compromise-prone guest kernel. This design exposes a large attack surface and enables race condition attacks, where an attacker that compromises the kernel can tamper with uncommitted logs and erase pre-compromise traces. Prior secure collectors mitigate this by frequent synchronous or timed submissions, which incur non-trivial runtime overhead.
We present HyperAudit, a hypervisor-assisted auditing architecture that isolates the log collection module from the guest kernel while keeping collection efficient and deployable. HyperAudit injects a kernel-independent collector into a hidden memory region, protects its code with execute-only permissions, and shields the log buffer with guard-page trapping, minimizing the exposed attack surface. Logs are asynchronously pulled by a consumer in a dedicated Secure VM, avoiding periodic synchronous commits. Under the common auditing assumption that logs generated after kernel compromise are untrustworthy, HyperAudit guarantees the integrity of all pre-compromise logs against race condition and flooding attacks. We implement HyperAudit on both x86 and Arm without extra hardware, and show that it reduces log-intensive application overhead by 49% and 66% compared to eAudit and HitchHiker, even outperforming host-only collectors.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 系统审计是云平台的关键安全原语，但现有审计框架将日志收集模块置于易受攻击的客户机内核中。这种设计暴露了较大的攻击面，并使得竞态条件攻击成为可能：攻击者一旦攻陷内核，就可以篡改未提交的日志并抹除攻陷前的痕迹。先前的安全收集器通过频繁的同步或定时提交来缓解这一问题，但这会带来不小的运行时开销。我们提出 HyperAudit，一种虚拟机监控器辅助的审计架构，它将日志收集模块与客户机内核隔离，同时保持收集高效且可部署。HyperAudit 将内核无关的收集器注入隐藏内存区域，使用只执行权限保护其代码，并通过保护页陷阱保护日志缓冲区，从而最小化暴露的攻击面。日志由专用安全虚拟机中的消费者异步拉取，避免周期性的同步提交。在常见的审计假设下，即内核攻陷后生成的日志不可信，HyperAudit 保证所有攻陷前日志在面对竞态条件和洪泛攻击时的完整性。我们在 x86 和 Arm 上实现了 HyperAudit，无需额外硬件，并表明与 eAudit 和 HitchHiker 相比，它将日志密集型应用开销降低了 49% 和 66%，甚至优于仅宿主机收集器。

upstream_only.title: Anchors that Don't Lift: Understanding Supply Chain Driven Kernel Lock-In and Governance-Mediated Mitigation Strategies in SOHO Devices
upstream_only.abstract:
Small Office/Home Office (SOHO) devices are widely popular, yet often attacked due to security vulnerabilities in their firmware, affecting tens of thousands of devices at a time. These security vulnerabilities often stem from outdated Linux kernel versions included in SOHO device firmware. Naturally, prior work audited the extent and impact of this issue by simple Linux version extraction and version number based vulnerability mapping. However, it is unclear how many of these anticipated vulnerabilities actually exist in the heavily customized SOHO kernels and if there are any barriers towards updating Linux kernels in SOHO firmwares. 
To address this gap, we uncover actual kernel-related vulnerabilities found in 306 SOHO devices using a high-precision template-based CVE detection mechanism on GPL source releases of more than 900 firmwares from these devices (multiple versions per device). Next, as a first, we traced the supply chain of these vulnerable SOHO devices at scale and identify kernel lock-in as a significant security issue---SOHO vendors are effectively locked to specific (often older) kernel versions due to the system-on-chip (SoC) SDKs they use. This kernel lock-in produces a vulnerability debt that is inherited along the supply chain from SoC vendor to firmware creators (ODM/OEM) to router/IP-camera vendor and ultimately borne by end users. All five SoC vendors in our dataset have used SDKs with Linux kernels that had reached End of Life (EoL) more than a year before their usage in a SOHO device. Finally, we explore the mitigation-potential of individual, regulatory and community governance by analyzing social media posts, regulations and community efforts. Our results show that regulation compliance is insufficient and only SoC vendors who engage with communities for kernel upgradation offered a viable path towards mitigation. We conclude by discussing broader implications of our work for improving holistic security of the supply chain for SOHO devices.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 小型办公室/家庭办公室（SOHO）设备广受欢迎，但由于其固件中的安全漏洞而经常遭受攻击，一次会影响数万台设备。这些安全漏洞通常源于SOHO设备固件中包含的过时Linux内核版本。自然，先前的工作通过简单的Linux版本提取和基于版本号的漏洞映射来审计此问题的范围和影响。然而，尚不清楚这些预期漏洞中有多少实际存在于高度定制的SOHO内核中，以及是否存在更新SOHO固件中Linux内核的障碍。为弥补这一空白，我们对306台SOHO设备中实际发现的内核相关漏洞进行了挖掘，使用高精度基于模板的CVE检测机制，对来自这些设备的900多个固件的GPL源代码发布（每个设备多个版本）进行分析。接下来，作为首次，我们大规模追踪了这些易受攻击的SOHO设备的供应链，并确定内核锁定是一个重要的安全问题——SOHO供应商实际上由于使用的片上系统（SoC）SDK而被锁定在特定（通常较旧）的内核版本上。这种内核锁定产生了一种漏洞债务，它沿着供应链从SoC供应商继承到固件创建者（ODM/OEM），再到路由器/IP摄像头供应商，最终由最终用户承担。我们数据集中的所有五家SoC供应商都使用了Linux内核已达到生命周期终止（EoL）超过一年后才用于SOHO设备的SDK。最后，我们通过分析社交媒体帖子、法规和社区努力，探索了个人、监管和社区治理的缓解潜力。我们的结果表明，法规合规不足，只有与社区合作进行内核升级的SoC供应商提供了可行的缓解路径。我们最后讨论了我们的工作对改善SOHO设备供应链整体安全性的更广泛影响。

upstream_only.title: The Six Developers You'll Meet in Security: Why Secure by Design Needs a Behavioral Playbook
upstream_only.abstract:
The Secure by Design movement has advanced security by shifting responsibility from individual developers to the systems they use. However, it assumes developers will respond uniformly to secure defaults and guardrails. They don't.
Using the COM-B behavioral model, which analyzes behavior through Capability, Opportunity, and Motivation, and synthesizing empirical research on developer security practices, I identified six developer personas reflecting fundamentally different patterns of security engagement. A developer skeptical about security's ROI requires a different intervention than one who is enthusiastic but lacks organizational support, or one who actively resists security processes.
This talk introduces the SECUR-E framework (Skeptic, Enthusiast, Compliant, Unaware, Resistant, Embedded) and explains why recognizing behavioral diversity is essential for Secure by Design to succeed. When organizations approach developer security as a behavioral design challenge rather than a compliance issue, they can tailor interventions to the actual barriers of each developer type.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 安全设计（Secure by Design）运动通过将责任从个体开发者转移到他们所使用的系统，推动了安全性的提升。然而，它假设开发者会对安全默认值和护栏做出一致响应。事实并非如此。利用COM-B行为模型（从能力、机会和动机三个维度分析行为），并综合关于开发者安全实践的实证研究，我识别出六种开发者画像，反映了根本不同的安全参与模式。一个对安全投资回报率持怀疑态度的开发者，与一个热情但缺乏组织支持的开发者，或一个积极抵制安全流程的开发者，需要不同的干预措施。本次演讲介绍SECUR-E框架（怀疑者、热情者、顺从者、无意识者、抵制者、嵌入者），并解释为何认识到行为多样性对于安全设计取得成功至关重要。当组织将开发者安全视为行为设计挑战而非合规问题时，他们就能针对每种开发者类型的实际障碍量身定制干预措施。

upstream_only.title: Broken Promises: Who's Accountable When VPNs Fail?
upstream_only.abstract:
Systematic research across five years, encompassing over a thousand users, nine VPN providers, and hundreds of desktop and mobile apps, reveals that VPNs routinely fail the users who depend on them most. For example:

Kill switches leak real IP addresses during tunnel failures
DNS queries escape the tunnel, exposing browsing activity to ISPs and adversaries,
VPN apps transmit cleartext traffic, deliver configuration files unencrypted, and exfiltrate advertising IDs for cross-app tracking.

These failures are not bugs but the predictable consequence of unregulated markets, misaligned incentives, and app stores that substitute self-reported safety claims and paid verification badges for independent auditing.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 一项为期五年、涵盖一千多名用户、九家VPN提供商以及数百个桌面和移动应用程序的系统性研究揭示，VPN经常辜负那些最依赖它们的用户。例如：在隧道故障期间，终止开关会泄露真实IP地址；DNS查询逃逸隧道，将浏览活动暴露给ISP和对手；VPN应用传输明文流量、以未加密方式传递配置文件，并窃取广告ID以进行跨应用跟踪。这些失败不是缺陷，而是不受监管的市场、错位的激励以及用自我声明的安全声明和付费验证徽章替代独立审计的应用商店所带来的可预见后果。

upstream_only.title: Youth Digital Immersion: Cyber Readiness Builds Mental Health Resilience
upstream_only.abstract:
Seventy percent of youth report negative online experiences annually, yet most interventions still rely on restriction, approaches that fail to reflect how young people actually navigate digital environments.
Drawing on a systematic review of 52+ studies and survey data from 1,869 students across four countries, I developed a Youth Mental Health Risk Assessment Framework mapping how usage patterns, individual characteristics, and environmental context shape online harm—and how awareness functions as a measurable protective factor.
Effective intervention means meeting youth where they are. Approaches that match how young people actually learn, gamification chief among them, are central to translating research into practice.
New developments include a prototype ML model identifying structured risk signals and connections with a gamified cybersecurity learning system built by HackerRangers for school deployment.
Ultimately, individualized digital readiness coupled with innovative learning approaches empowers youth to be capable digital citizens.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 每年有70%的青少年报告遭遇负面在线经历，然而大多数干预措施仍依赖限制，这种方法未能反映年轻人实际在数字环境中的行为方式。基于对52项以上研究的系统综述和来自四个国家1,869名学生的调查数据，我开发了青少年心理健康风险评估框架，描绘使用模式、个体特征和环境背景如何塑造在线伤害——以及意识如何作为一种可测量的保护因素发挥作用。有效的干预意味着在青少年所在之处与他们相遇。符合年轻人实际学习方式的干预方法（其中游戏化尤为突出）是将研究转化为实践的核心。新进展包括一个识别结构化风险信号的原型机器学习模型，以及与HackerRangers为学校部署而构建的游戏化网络安全学习系统的连接。最终，个性化的数字准备能力与创新学习方法相结合，使青少年能够成为有能力的数字公民。

upstream_only.title: When HTTP 402 Meets the Blockchain: Risks on Emerging x402 Payments
upstream_only.abstract:
x402 is an emerging payment protocol for Web APIs and autonomous AI agents. It is driven by the rise of LLM-based agents that can autonomously purchase access to online services. x402 extends HTTP 402 with a payment negotiation flow and delegates payment proof verification and on-chain settlement to third-party facilitators. As a result, facilitators serve as a shared payment infrastructure for many independent merchants. This centralizes trust and validation in one component, so a single flaw can affect many services. Despite rapid adoption by major vendors and economically meaningful mainnet activity, the security posture of real-world x402 deployments remains poorly characterized.
We present the first systematic study of authorization correctness and execution safety in current facilitator-mediated x402 deployments in the wild, identifying eight security rules for facilitators as critical payment infrastructure. Based on our analysis of rule violations, we derive four new attack vectors, including Free Shopping, Asset Theft, Service Denial, and Gas Abuse. These attacks exploit weaknesses in the real-world facilitator and server implementations and cause severe harm, including direct financial loss to merchants, theft of facilitator-held assets, unbounded sponsor-paid gas/fees, and disruption of payment services. To assess the security of x402 deployments at scale, we propose a semi-automated black-box tool and apply it to 15 major x402 facilitators collectively used by over 60K sellers and 360K buyers. Alarmingly, we find violations in all evaluated facilitators. We responsibly disclosed our findings to the affected parties, who acknowledged the issues and adopted mitigations, including changes by Coinbase. Finally, we complement our controlled testing with an empirical measurement of over 119 million recent Base and Solana transactions, quantifying x402 adoption, facilitator centralization, and ecosystem-level risk indicators.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: x402是一种面向Web API和自主AI代理的新兴支付协议。其兴起由能够自主购买在线服务访问权限的基于LLM的代理推动。x402通过支付协商流程扩展了HTTP 402，并将支付证明验证和链上结算委托给第三方 facilitator。因此，facilitator 成为许多独立商户共享的支付基础设施。这将信任和验证集中在一个组件中，因此单个缺陷可能影响许多服务。尽管被主要供应商迅速采用，并且主网活动具有经济意义，但现实世界x402部署的安全态势仍然缺乏系统刻画。我们提出了首个针对当前由 facilitator 中介的x402真实部署中授权正确性与执行安全性的系统研究，识别出作为关键支付基础设施的 facilitator 应遵循的八条安全规则。基于对规则违反情况的分析，我们推导出四种新的攻击向量，包括免费购物、资产盗窃、服务拒绝和Gas滥用。这些攻击利用了真实 facilitator 和服务器实现中的弱点，并造成严重危害，包括商户直接财务损失、facilitator 持有资产被盗、无上限的赞助方支付Gas/费用，以及支付服务中断。为了大规模评估x402部署的安全性，我们提出了一种半自动化黑盒工具，并将其应用于15个主要x402 facilitator，这些 facilitator 合计被超过6万卖家和36万买家使用。令人担忧的是，我们在所有评估的 facilitator 中都发现了违规行为。我们负责任地向受影响方披露了发现结果，他们确认了问题并采取了缓解措施，包括Coinbase所做的更改。最后，我们通过测量超过1.19亿笔近期Base和Solana交易来补充受控测试，量化了x402采用情况、facilitator 中心化程度和生态系统层面的风险指标。

upstream_only.title: Kintsugi: Empowering LLMs to Mitigate Web Vulnerabilities via Runtime Policy Injection
upstream_only.abstract: The "response gap" between vulnerability detection and patching leaves web applications exposed to high-impact exploits such as remote code execution, command injection, and server-side request forgery. Current mitigations are flawed: code fixes often break functionality, while global runtime policies produce excessive false positives. We propose Kintsugi, an automated runtime containment system that provides temporary protection for exploits that manifest as diverging syscall behaviors at the OS level. Kintsugi uses a three-stage pipeline: First, by performing differential syscall analysis on normal and malicious requests, it locates a few vulnerability-related functions. Subsequently, leveraging LLMs, it precisely delineates the boundaries of the specific code snippets causing the malicious behavior within these functions and establishes policy trigger points. Finally, by analyzing the execution profiles from normal requests, it derives a deterministic, least-privilege syscall whitelist to serve as the runtime policy. This policy is enforced at the kernel level via eBPF and cgroups and is dynamically activated only when the request's execution flow enters the protected code snippet. Evaluation on 27 real-world CVEs across PHP, Python, and Java shows that Kintsugi effectively neutralizes diverse exploits and their variants while preserving original application functionality. Kintsugi achieves an average response time of 7.6 minutes. While the enforcement of surgical policies introduces a modest average latency overhead of 9.2% on targeted APIs, the impact on concurrent non-vulnerable traffic remains minimal, with an average throughput (RPS) drop of only 2.21%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 漏洞检测与修补之间的“响应差距”使Web应用暴露于远程代码执行、命令注入和服务器端请求伪造等高危利用。当前的缓解措施存在缺陷：代码修复常常破坏功能，而全局运行时策略会产生过多误报。我们提出Kintsugi，一种自动化运行时遏制系统，为在操作系统层面表现为系统调用行为偏离的漏洞利用提供临时保护。Kintsugi采用三阶段流水线：首先，通过对正常请求和恶意请求进行差分系统调用分析，定位少量与漏洞相关的函数。随后，利用LLM，精确刻画这些函数中导致恶意行为的特定代码片段的边界，并建立策略触发点。最后，通过分析正常请求的执行画像，推导出确定性的最小权限系统调用白名单作为运行时策略。该策略通过eBPF和cgroups在内核级强制执行，并且仅当请求的执行流进入受保护代码片段时动态激活。在涵盖PHP、Python和Java的27个真实世界CVE上的评估表明，Kintsugi有效中和了多样化的漏洞利用及其变体，同时保留原始应用功能。Kintsugi平均响应时间为7.6分钟。虽然精准策略的执行在目标API上引入了9.2%的平均延迟开销，但对并发非漏洞流量的影响仍然很小，平均吞吐量(RPS)仅下降2.21%。

upstream_only.title: Alias Equals Zone? Large-Scale and Stealthy Takeover of Domain Hosting Service via CNAME-Following Cross-Domain Verification
upstream_only.abstract: CNAME records define alias relationships between domains and are widely used for service hosting and load balancing. We find that popular domain hosting providers misinterpret CNAME semantics during domain ownership verification. They accept DNS records after CNAME redirection as valid challenge tokens for alias domains, even though these domains do not configure any tokens. Based on this flaw, we propose ALIASLEAP, a novel domain takeover attack that enables hijacking hosting services of alias domains in CNAME chains. ALIASLEAP poses a serious threat in the real world: we identify four email and seven web hosting providers that are vulnerable, affecting over two million domains, including 200K in the Tranco Top 1M domain list. ALIASLEAP is highly stealthy because vulnerable CNAME chains are typically legitimate and long-lived: about half persist for more than 12 months, and up to 19,819 domains have been exposed for over 10 years. We propose mitigation strategies and responsibly disclose ALIASLEAP to 11 affected hosting providers, receiving confirmations from eight of them. We call on the Internet community to revisit the usage practices and capability boundaries of CNAME records.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: CNAME记录定义了域之间的别名关系，广泛用于服务托管和负载均衡。我们发现流行域名托管提供商在域名所有权验证过程中误解了CNAME语义。它们接受CNAME重定向后的DNS记录作为别名域的有效质询令牌，即使这些域未配置任何令牌。基于此缺陷，我们提出ALIASLEAP，一种新型域名接管攻击，能够劫持CNAME链中别名域的托管服务。ALIASLEAP在现实世界中构成严重威胁：我们发现四个电子邮件和七个Web托管提供商存在漏洞，影响超过200万个域，其中包括Tranco Top 1M域名列表中的20万个。ALIASLEAP极具隐蔽性，因为易受攻击的CNAME链通常是合法且长期存在的：约一半持续超过12个月，多达19,819个域已暴露超过10年。我们提出缓解策略，并负责任地向11家受影响托管提供商披露ALIASLEAP，收到其中8家的确认。我们呼吁互联网社区重新审视CNAME记录的使用实践和能力边界。

upstream_only.title: Securing Retrieval-Augmented Code Generation via Contextual Knowledge Injection: A Case for Embedded IoT Applications
upstream_only.abstract:
Repository-grounded retrieval-augmented code generation (RACG) is increasingly used in embedded IoT development by retrieving code and documentation from a pinned RTOS/SDK repository (e.g., Zephyr OS). In this setting, security risks are often version-inherited: even without retrieval poisoning, generated applications may invoke benign-looking public APIs that transitively reach vulnerable internal routines in the pinned snapshot, thereby inheriting known CVEs. Existing secure RACG pipelines largely focus on task-level intent and generic vulnerability patterns, which can miss repository- and version-specific exposure. Meanwhile, conventional CVE scanners can flag vulnerable locations but cannot determine whether those vulnerabilities are reachable through the public APIs that the generator commits to during repository-grounded generation.
In this paper, we present IoTRAGuarder, a contextual knowledge injection framework that aligns security hardening with generation-time API selection under repository grounding. IoTRAGuarder (i) recovers auditable reverse call chains from CVE-localized internals to exposing public APIs via static analysis plus an evidence-gated LLM to bridge indirections and macro-driven "call-graph islands", (ii) constructs a version-aware security knowledge base that binds affected version intervals to exposed public APIs with prompt-ready constraints, safer alternatives, or avoidance/upgrade guidance, and (iii) performs dual-layer, API-aligned online retrieval to inject concise, version-matched constraints into the final prompt. We evaluate IoTRAGuarder on 44 real-world Zephyr tasks across four LLMs. Compared to the prior state-of-the-art secure RACG baseline, IoTRAGuarder improves the overall security success rate from 5.11% to 78.41%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh:
基于仓库的检索增强代码生成（RACG）正越来越多地用于嵌入式物联网开发，其方式是从固定的RTOS/SDK仓库（例如Zephyr OS）中检索代码与文档。在此场景中，安全风险往往是版本继承的：即使没有检索投毒，生成的应用程序也可能调用看似良性的公共API，而这些API会传递性地到达固定快照中存在漏洞的内部例程，从而继承已知CVE。现有的安全RACG流水线主要关注任务级意图和通用漏洞模式，可能遗漏仓库和版本特定的暴露面。与此同时，传统CVE扫描器可以标记易受攻击的位置，但无法确定这些漏洞是否可通过生成器在基于仓库的生成过程中所承诺的公共API到达。
在本文中，我们提出IoTRAGuarder，一种上下文知识注入框架，使安全加固与基于仓库的生成时API选择保持一致。IoTRAGuarder (i) 通过静态分析以及一个证据门控的LLM来恢复从CVE定位的内部例程到暴露的公共API的可审计反向调用链，以桥接间接调用和宏驱动的“调用图孤岛”；(ii) 构建版本感知的安全知识库，将受影响版本区间与暴露的公共API绑定，并提供可直接用于提示的约束、更安全的替代方案或规避/升级指导；(iii) 执行双层、与API对齐的在线检索，以将简洁、版本匹配的约束注入最终提示。我们在44个真实Zephyr任务上跨四个LLM评估IoTRAGuarder。与之前最先进的安全RACG基线相比，IoTRAGuarder将整体安全成功率从5.11%提升至78.41%。

upstream_only.title: Discovering, characterizing and exploiting controllable-copy objects for kernel data-only attacks with CopyKat
upstream_only.abstract: Modern kernel hardening mechanisms considerably reduce the viability of control-flow hijacking attacks, prompting attackers to shift their focus to data-only attacks. These attacks depend on corrupting non-control data to amplify limited memory-corruption primitives into more powerful capabilities such as arbitrary writes. Prior work has identified small sets of such objects in specific circumstances. However, no existing approach discovers and characterizes them at scale. In this paper, we introduce CopyKat, a fully automated pipeline for identifying and characterizing Controllable-Copy Objects (CCOs): heap-allocated kernel structures whose fields can be corrupted to redirect a store or memory-transfer operation involving attacker-controlled data. We propose a multi-stage methodology with progressive filtering of objects. Through lightweight taint-analysis applied to a fuzzing campaign, we uncover candidate CCOs. Then, we confirm such taint by using a precise taint engine, thereby enhancing our precision. Finally, we perform the corruption of the CCO using a concolic execution engine to verify the controllability of the object. We also collect the necessary path and value constraints for exploitation. We find 122 verified CCOs and build 8 end-to-end exploits involving different exploitation patterns, showcasing the correctness of our characterization and the flexibility of the discovered objects.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代内核加固机制大幅降低了控制流劫持攻击的可行性，促使攻击者将焦点转向数据攻击。这些攻击依赖于破坏非控制数据，将有限的内存破坏原语放大为任意写等更强大的能力。已有工作已在特定情形下识别出少量此类对象。然而，尚无现有方法能够大规模地发现和刻画它们。在本文中，我们提出CopyKat，一个全自动流水线，用于识别和刻画可控复制对象（CCO）：即堆分配的内核结构，其字段可被破坏以重定向涉及攻击者可控数据的存储或内存传输操作。我们提出一种多阶段方法，对对象进行渐进式过滤。通过对模糊测试活动应用轻量级污点分析，我们发现候选CCO。然后，我们使用精确的污点引擎确认此类污点，从而提高精度。最后，我们使用混合执行引擎对CCO进行破坏，以验证对象的可控性。我们还收集利用所需的路径和值约束。我们找到了122个已验证的CCO，并构建了8个涉及不同利用模式的端到端漏洞利用，展示了我们刻画的正确性和所发现对象的灵活性。

upstream_only.title: SoK: On the Fragility of Memory Error Exploit Mitigations
upstream_only.abstract:
The perennial war in memory has long been shaped by a continuous arms race: defenses are deployed, bypasses emerge, and stronger mitigations follow, only for the cycle to repeat. This pattern persists in part due to the fragility of many defenses, which often fail when assumptions change. Such fragility reflects how security guarantees are assessed, often through ad hoc reasoning tied to specific threat models. In a fast-evolving landscape of polyglot applications and heterogeneous systems, manually re-evaluating these guarantees for every new context is both labor-intensive and error-prone.
This SoK advocates for a more systematic,adversary-aware approach. We introduce a graph-based framework for evaluating the fragility of memory safety defenses by modeling the progression of memory corruption exploits, and where, how, and under what assumptions defenses intervene and may fail. We demonstrate the utility of this model by revisiting flaws in prominent defenses and showing how their shortcomings could have been anticipated. Finally, we release open-source tooling that implements our model and supports systematized and semi-automated fragility testing.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 内存领域长期存在的战争一直由持续不断的军备竞赛所塑造：防御措施被部署，绕过方法出现，更强的缓解措施随之而来，然后循环重复。这种模式之所以持续，部分原因在于许多防御措施的脆弱性——当假设发生变化时，它们往往就会失效。这种脆弱性反映了安全保证的评估方式，通常是通过与特定威胁模型绑定的临时性推理。在多语言应用和异构系统快速演变的背景下，针对每个新环境手动重新评估这些保证既费力又容易出错。本SoK倡导一种更系统化、更具对手意识的方法。我们引入一个基于图的框架，通过建模内存破坏利用的进展过程，以及防御措施在何处、如何以及在何种假设下介入并可能失效，来评估内存安全防御的脆弱性。我们通过重新审视著名防御措施中的缺陷并展示其不足如何本可被预见，来证明该模型的实用性。最后，我们发布实现了该模型并支持系统化和半自动化脆弱性测试的开源工具。

upstream_only.title: Fence2Pwn: KFENCE-Enabled Kernel Exploitation Bypassing Slab Hardening and Memory Tagging
upstream_only.abstract:
While the Linux kernel remains a prime target due to its privileged execution model, exploitation has become substantially more difficult in recent years. Kernel hardening efforts have increasingly focused on the slab allocator, aiming to mitigate entire vulnerability classes (e.g., via memory tagging) or disrupt exploit techniques (e.g., via heap object segregation). However, it remains unclear whether these protections are consistently enforced across all allocation paths.
In this paper, we find that one allocation path is excluded from all state-of-the-art slab defenses: the path used for KFENCE allocations. KFENCE is designed as a low-overhead sampling-based memory-safety error detector for production kernels. It is enabled by default and active in billions of systems including on Android, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, and most Linux distributions. We show that it unintentionally enables a new exploit technique, Fence2Pwn. Concretely, Fence2Pwn leverages several KFENCE-specific behaviors. Three are particularly notable: (i) using a timing side channel, we detect when the kernel falls back to KFENCE allocations; (ii) KFENCE allocations are served by KFENCE-managed caches rather than size- and type-segregated slab caches, enabling bypass of heap segregation; and (iii) KFENCE allocations are untagged, enabling bypass of memory tagging. We evaluate Fence2Pwn by profiling our timing side channel, KFENCE's object slot dynamics as well as different environments and noise floors. Finally, we demonstrate that Fence2Pwn exploits this slab-defense gap: Fence2Pwn uses KFENCE to exploit an existing UAF-based memory-reuse vulnerability, which allows it to overlay security-relevant objects of different types and sizes.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 尽管Linux内核因其特权执行模型而始终是主要攻击目标，但近年来漏洞利用已变得困难得多。内核加固工作日益聚焦于slab分配器，旨在缓解整个漏洞类别（例如通过内存标记）或破坏利用技术（例如通过堆对象隔离）。然而，这些保护是否在所有分配路径上一致执行仍不清楚。在本文中，我们发现有一条分配路径被所有最先进的slab防御排除在外：用于KFENCE分配的路径。KFENCE被设计为一种低开销、基于采样的内存安全错误检测器，用于生产内核。它默认启用，并活跃在数十亿系统中，包括Android、Red Hat Enterprise Linux和大多数Linux发行版。我们表明，它无意中启用了一种新的利用技术，Fence2Pwn。具体而言，Fence2Pwn利用了若干KFENCE特有的行为。其中三点尤为显著：(i) 使用时序侧信道，我们检测内核何时回退到KFENCE分配；(ii) KFENCE分配由KFENCE管理的缓存提供，而非按大小和类型隔离的slab缓存，从而能够绕过堆隔离；(iii) KFENCE分配未打标签，从而能够绕过内存标记。我们通过分析我们的时序侧信道、KFENCE的对象槽位动态以及不同环境和噪声底限来评估Fence2Pwn。最后，我们证明Fence2Pwn利用了这一slab防御缺口：Fence2Pwn利用KFENCE来利用一个现有的基于UAF的内存重用漏洞，从而允许它覆盖不同大小和类型的与安全相关的对象。

upstream_only.title: CoKeMon: Configurable Kernel Monitoring by Decoupling Isolation
upstream_only.abstract: Monolithic OSes such as Linux are susceptible to security vulnerabilities. This has led to a line of research to detect and prevent runtime kernel exploitation, e.g., with kernel integrity measurement, page table monitoring, event logging. Prior works are either purpose-built for one type of monitoring or make invasive changes to the kernel. This motivates the need for a design that can accommodate various monitors on a need basis. As a first step, we identify five key requirements that such a solution must satisfy: selective permissions, non-privileged management, static isolation boundaries, architecturally-supported atomic switching, and device support. It is challenging to satisfy all of the requirements while preserving security. To address this, our insight is to decouple the isolation enforcement from the monitor management, which allows us to use native hardware techniques with ease. We demonstrate the feasibility of such a design on Arm platform by modifying ~300 LoC in the firmware and ~500 LoC in the Linux kernel. We implement three monitoring use-cases to demonstrate the versatility of COKEMON and report performance overhead ranging from 0% to 13%.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 像Linux这样的单体操作系统容易受到安全漏洞的影响。这促使了一系列研究来检测和防御运行时内核漏洞利用，例如通过内核完整性测量、页表监控、事件日志记录。先前的工作要么专为某一类监控而构建，要么对内核进行侵入性修改。这促使我们需要一种能够按需容纳各种监控器的设计。作为第一步，我们确定了此类方案必须满足的五项关键要求：选择性权限、非特权管理、静态隔离边界、架构支持的原子切换以及设备支持。在保持安全性的同时满足所有要求具有挑战性。为了解决这个问题，我们的见解是将隔离执行与监控器管理解耦，这使我们能够轻松使用原生硬件技术。我们通过在Arm平台上修改固件中约300行代码和Linux内核中约500行代码，证明了这种设计的可行性。我们实现了三个监控用例来展示COKEMON的多功能性，并报告性能开销在0%到13%之间。

upstream_only.title: Exploiting PoH Time Semantics in Solana via Re-Anchoring and Forking
upstream_only.abstract:
Proof of History (PoH) is a core component of Solana that realizes a publicly verifiable notion of logical time via a sequential hash chain. It allows Solana to run a slot-based leader schedule, where a designated leader is expected to propose a block in each slot. Yet, the security implications of PoH-driven logical time remain insufficiently understood. In this paper, we identify a new protocol-valid attack surface in Solana's PoH time semantics: by withholding and later releasing protocol-valid blocks that commit to an earlier PoH-derived logical time than a validator's current local view, a scheduled malicious leader can trigger PoH re-anchoring at honest validators. Building on this primitive, we develop two attacks. First, Time Inflation Attack (TI) extends the malicious leader's effective block-production time budget by multiple slot intervals, enabling it to include more transactions without necessarily invalidating honest blocks. Second, Fork-Assisted Time Inflation Attack (FTI) extends the former by leveraging fork choice to further increase the time budget while suppressing honest leaders' proposals.
We present a formal analysis that characterizes the conditions under which PoH re-anchoring occurs and bounds the adversary's impact under realistic network and stake assumptions. We implemented the attacks in a testbed and reported our findings to the Solana development team. We also analyze on-chain data and report timing and inclusion patterns that are compatible with the incentive channel exploited by TI. Finally, we discuss defenses that harden PoH time semantics and reduce incentives to exploit PoH re-anchoring.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 历史证明（PoH）是Solana的核心组件，它通过顺序哈希链实现了一种可公开验证的逻辑时间概念。它允许Solana运行基于时隙的领导者调度，其中指定的领导者应在每个时隙中提出一个区块。然而，PoH驱动的逻辑时间的安全影响仍未得到充分理解。在本文中，我们识别了Solana的PoH时间语义中一个新的协议有效攻击面：通过扣留并稍后释放协议有效的区块，这些区块承诺了比验证者当前本地视图更早的PoH派生逻辑时间，一个被调度的恶意领导者可以触发诚实验证者处的PoH重锚定。基于这一原语，我们开发了两种攻击。首先，时间膨胀攻击（TI）将恶意领导者的有效区块生产时间预算扩展多个时隙间隔，使其能够包含更多交易而不必使诚实区块无效。其次，分叉辅助时间膨胀攻击（FTI）扩展了前者，利用分叉选择进一步增加时间预算，同时抑制诚实领导者的提议。我们提出了形式化分析，描述了PoH重锚定发生的条件，并在现实的网络和权益假设下界定了对手的影响。我们在测试床上实现了这些攻击，并向Solana开发团队报告了我们的发现。我们还分析了链上数据，并报告了与TI所利用的激励渠道兼容的时序和包含模式。最后，我们讨论了加强PoH时间语义并减少利用PoH重锚定动机的防御措施。

upstream_only.title: Just One Bit Vector: Complement-Free Ring Confidential Transactions with Transparent Setup
upstream_only.abstract: Ring Confidential Transactions (RingCTs) rely on their signature schemes to ensure transaction validity while preserving user privacy. In the discrete-logarithm setting, state-of-the art RingCT signatures leverage Bulletproof as their backbone. In this work, we conduct a thorough analysis of existing Bulletproof-based RingCT signatures and identify two pervasive sources of inefficiency: (i) redundant complement advice induced by binary constraints, and (ii) substantial overhead incurred by defenses against the Knowledge-of-Known-Discrete-Logarithm (KKDL) issue. We present new techniques that eliminate the first inefficiency and significantly reduce the second. We introduce the Weighted-Norm Inner Linear Argument (WNILA) as a new compression pivot and leverage it to design zero-knowledge proofs that capture constraints arising in RingCT without introducing complement advice. We then adopt the techniques of Omniring and Lin et al. to unify the K-Weight and K-Link techniques proposed by ZGSX23 and BulletCT. Building on this framework, we derive three RingCT signature schemes: UniBit, UniBit+, and UniBitRange. We implement all three schemes and benchmark them against BulletCT and Omniring⋆ under practical parameter regimes. Our experimental results demonstrate 2.540× improvements in signing and verification speed over Omniring⋆, and 1.6–2.3× signing speedups together with up to 1.65× verification speedup over BulletCT, while achieving comparable signature sizes.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 环机密交易（RingCT）依赖其签名方案来确保交易有效性，同时保护用户隐私。在离散对数设置中，最先进的RingCT签名以Bulletproof为骨干。在本工作中，我们对现有基于Bulletproof的RingCT签名进行了全面分析，并识别出两个普遍存在的低效来源：(i) 由二元约束引起的冗余补集建议，以及 (ii) 针对已知离散对数知识（KKDL）问题的防御措施所带来的大量开销。我们提出了新技术来消除第一种低效并显著减少第二种。我们引入加权范数内积线性论证（WNILA）作为新的压缩支点，并利用它设计零知识证明，以在不引入补集建议的情况下捕获RingCT中出现的约束。然后我们采用Omniring和Lin等人的技术，统一ZGSX23和BulletCT提出的K-Weight和K-Link技术。在此框架基础上，我们推导出三种RingCT签名方案：UniBit、UniBit+和UniBitRange。我们实现了所有三种方案，并在实际参数范围下与BulletCT和Omniring⋆进行基准测试。实验结果表明，与Omniring⋆相比，签名和验证速度提高了2.540倍；与BulletCT相比，签名速度提高了1.6–2.3倍，验证速度提高最多1.65倍，同时实现相当的签名大小。

upstream_only.title: The Perils of Flexibility: Uncovering Application-Layer Vulnerabilities in Cosmos SDK Customization Points
upstream_only.abstract:
The Cosmos SDK is a premier blockchain development framework that facilitates the construction of application-layer logic through reusable modules and extensible customization interfaces. Currently, the Cosmos ecosystem encompasses over one hundred production blockchains, reaching a peak total market capitalization exceeding $32 billion. While this modular architecture significantly lowers development barriers, it simultaneously expands the application-layer attack surface, as developer-accessible customization points are susceptible to misuse or incorrect composition.
In this work, we present a security analysis of application-layer pitfalls within Cosmos-based blockchains. By analyzing the transaction execution lifecycle and developer-accessible customization points, we formalize four execution invariants essential for correct transaction processing. Guided by these invariants, we identify eight recurring classes of error-prone development patterns in which violations compromise transaction safety, resulting in severe consequences ranging from asset theft to chain-halting failures. To assess the prevalence and impact of these pitfalls, we conducted an ecosystem-wide empirical analysis, uncovering 65 vulnerabilities across various Cosmos-based blockchains. Following responsible disclosure, 26 of these vulnerabilities were acknowledged by the affected project teams, with 19 subsequently receiving public fixes and two resulting in assigned CVE identifiers. These disclosures yielded $51,000 in bug bounty rewards and prevented potential asset theft affecting assets valued in the tens of millions of dollars. Our findings demonstrate that application-layer vulnerabilities are widespread in the Cosmos ecosystem and underscore the critical need for increased rigor in application-layer design, development, and auditing.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Cosmos SDK 是首屈一指的区块链开发框架，它通过可复用模块和可扩展定制接口促进应用层逻辑的构建。目前，Cosmos 生态系统包含超过一百条生产区块链，其总市值峰值超过 320 亿美元。虽然这种模块化架构显著降低了开发门槛，但它同时扩大了应用层攻击面，因为开发者可访问的定制点容易被误用或错误组合。在这项工作中，我们对基于 Cosmos 的区块链中的应用层陷阱进行了安全分析。通过分析交易执行生命周期和开发者可访问的定制点，我们形式化了四个对正确交易处理至关重要的执行不变量。在这些不变量指导下，我们识别出八类反复出现的易错开发模式，违反这些模式会破坏交易安全性，导致从资产盗窃到链停机故障等严重后果。为了评估这些陷阱的普遍性和影响，我们进行了全生态系统的实证分析，在各类基于 Cosmos 的区块链中发现了 65 个漏洞。在负责任披露后，其中 26 个漏洞得到受影响项目团队的确认，19 个随后获得公开修复，两个导致分配了 CVE 标识符。这些披露带来了 51,000 美元的漏洞赏金，并防止了影响价值数千万美元资产的潜在资产盗窃。我们的发现表明，应用层漏洞在 Cosmos 生态系统中广泛存在，并强调在应用层设计、开发和审计中亟需提高严谨性。

upstream_only.title: MHOT: Height-Optimized Authenticated Data Structure for Blockchain State Commitment
upstream_only.abstract:
State root computation dominates (~78%) blockchain block processing time. Ethereum's canonical authenticated data structure, i.e., Merkle Patricia Trie (MPT), suffers from severe tree-height growth and is vulnerable to Nurgle attacks (S&P'24), where adversaries inflate path depth via hash collisions and degrade system performance at negligible cost. Existing defenses increase node fanout (span) to bound tree height, but higher span inflates proof size exponentially. Prior work mitigates this trade-off using vector commitments, at the cost of trusted setup or expensive verification.
We present MHOT, a height-optimal authenticated data structure for blockchain state commitment that preserves standard hash-based verification without trusted setup. Unlike MPT's fixed-prefix indexing, which couples span and fanout exponentially, MHOT indexes by discriminative bits that actually distinguish keys, achieving adaptive span with linear fanout coupling and provably minimal height. To prevent high fanout from inflating proofs, we introduce hierarchical proofs, a two-layer Merkle construction that reduces per-node proof overhead from O(k) to O(logk).
On Ethereum mainnet workloads, MHOT achieves up to 9× higher write throughput, 4× lower write amplification, and 2× smaller proofs than MPT. Under Nurgle attacks, even when the adversary consumes an entire block's gas budget, MHOT maintains a 0% attack success rate (v.s., 99.97% for MPT). Our results, somewhat surprisingly, show that height optimality (not new crypto primitives!) is the key abstraction for scalable and attack-resilient blockchain state commitment.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 状态根计算占据了区块链区块处理时间的约78%。以太坊的规范认证数据结构，即默克尔帕特里夏树（MPT），面临严重的树高增长，并容易受到Nurgle攻击（S&P'24），其中对手通过哈希冲突膨胀路径深度，以微不足道的成本降低系统性能。现有防御增加节点扇出（span）以限制树高，但更高的span会指数级膨胀证明大小。先前工作使用向量承诺来缓解这种权衡，但代价是可信设置或昂贵的验证。我们提出MHOT，一种用于区块链状态承诺的高度最优认证数据结构，它保留了标准的基于哈希的验证，无需可信设置。与MPT的固定前缀索引（将span和扇出指数级耦合）不同，MHOT通过真正区分键的判别位进行索引，实现自适应span与线性扇出耦合以及可证明的最小高度。为防止高扇出膨胀证明，我们引入分层证明，一种两层Merkle构造，将每个节点的证明开销从O(k)降低到O(logk)。在以太坊主网工作负载上，MHOT相比MPT实现高达9倍的写入吞吐量、4倍的写入放大降低和2倍更小的证明。在Nurgle攻击下，即使对手消耗整个区块的gas预算，MHOT仍保持0%的攻击成功率（而MPT为99.97%）。我们的结果有些令人惊讶地表明，高度最优性（而非新的密码原语！）是可扩展且抗攻击的区块链状态承诺的关键抽象。

upstream_only.title: Perils of Parallelism: Transaction Fee Mechanisms under Execution Uncertainty
upstream_only.abstract: Modern blockchains increasingly rely on parallel execution to improve throughput. We show several industry and academic transaction fee mechanisms (TFMs) struggle to simultaneously account for execution parallelism while remaining performant and fair. First, if parallelism affects fees, adversarial protocol manipulations that offset possible benefits to throughput by introducing fake transactions become rational: users can insert functionally useless parallel transactions solely to reduce fees, and schedulers can create useless sequential transactions to increase revenue. Execution contingency, a core feature of expressive programming languages, both exacerbates the aforementioned threats and introduces new ones: (1) users may overpay for unused resources, and (2) scheduler revenue is harmed when reserved scheduling slots go unused due to contingency. We introduce a framework for this challenging setting, and prove an impossibility highlighting an inherent tension: both parallelism and contingency involve a trade-off between minimizing risks for users and schedulers, as favoring one comes at the expense of the other. To complete the picture, we introduce fee mechanisms and prove that they achieve the boundaries of this trade-off. Our results provide rigorous foundations for evaluating designs advanced by notable blockchains, such as Sui and Monad.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代区块链越来越多地依赖并行执行来提高吞吐量。我们表明，若干工业界和学术界的交易费用机制（TFM）难以同时兼顾执行并行性，并保持高性能和公平性。首先，如果并行性影响费用，那么通过引入虚假交易来抵消吞吐量可能收益的对抗性协议操纵就变得理性：用户可以插入功能上无用的并行交易仅仅为了降低费用，而调度器可以创建无用的顺序交易来增加收入。执行偶发性（execution contingency）——富有表现力的编程语言的一个核心特性——既加剧了上述威胁，又引入了新的威胁：(1) 用户可能为未使用的资源多付费用；(2) 当预留的调度槽因偶发性而未被使用时，调度器的收入会受到损害。我们为这一具有挑战性的场景引入了一个框架，并证明了一个不可能性结果，凸显出一种内在张力：并行性和偶发性都涉及在最小化用户和调度器风险之间的权衡，因为偏向一方会以牺牲另一方为代价。为完善整体图景，我们引入了费用机制并证明它们达到了这一权衡的边界。我们的结果为评估知名区块链（如 Sui 和 Monad）所提出的设计提供了严格的基础。

upstream_only.title: Sok: Private Transformer-based Model Inference
upstream_only.abstract: The growing demand for privacy-preserving Transformer inference has led to the emergence of numerous protocols designed to protect sensitive data and model parameters. These protocols utilize diverse cryptographic tools under varying assumptions, each presenting unique characteristics and trade-offs between computation, communication, and accuracy. In this paper, we conduct a systematic and in-depth analysis of existing approaches from diverse performance perspectives, identifying their limitations and research gaps. We further evaluate the reproducibility of prior systems and re-benchmark representative solutions under standardized configurations. Our results yield a principled guideline for balancing protocol trade-offs under different deployment settings.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 对隐私保护Transformer推理日益增长的需求，催生了大量旨在保护敏感数据和模型参数的协议。这些协议在不同假设下利用多种密码学工具，各自呈现出独特的特性，并在计算、通信和精度之间进行权衡。在本文中，我们从多种性能视角对现有方法进行了系统而深入的分析，识别出它们的局限性和研究空白。我们进一步评估了先前系统的可复现性，并在标准化配置下对代表性解决方案进行了重新基准测试。我们的结果为不同部署设置下平衡协议权衡提供了原则性指导。

upstream_only.title: Five Queries Are Enough: Query-Efficient and Surrogate-Free Membership Inference Attacks on RAG via Entailment
upstream_only.abstract: Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) has become central to large language model (LLM) deployments, grounding responses in enterprise or proprietary data to reduce hallucinations. However, this design introduces a new privacy risk: model outputs may signal the presence of specific documents in the retrieval corpus, enabling membership inference attacks (MIAs) that leak sensitive information. Existing MIAs are feasible, but they often rely on easily-detected templated queries or require many non-templated yet costly and repetitive queries, limiting practicality. We ask: Can an adversary launch a limited-budget, surrogate-free, stealthy, and defense-agnostic membership inference attack using non-templated queries? We present MEntA (Membership Entailment Attack)—a query‑efficient MIA that leverages natural‑language entailment to maximize information gained per query. By asking low-cost, broad, information‑seeking questions and measuring entailment between model responses and candidate documents, MEntA eliminates the need for costly shadow LLMs and large query budgets. Across NFCorpus, SCIDOCS, and TREC‑COVID, MEntA achieves up to 0.991 AUC with only 5 queries, outperforming prior methods by up to 0.42 AUC under equivalent conditions. It remains effective under state‑of‑the‑art (SOTA) RAG defenses, while current detectors miss MEntA or flag benign queries at high rates. Regarding cost, MEntA reduces total attack cost by up to 65× lower compared to SOTA attacks under the same attack setting. Our findings expose the feasibility of realistic, low‑cost privacy leakage in RAG systems and highlight the urgent need for privacy‑aware retrieval and defense mechanisms.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）已成为大语言模型（LLM）部署的核心，其通过将回答建立在企业或专有数据之上来减少幻觉。然而，这种设计引入了一种新的隐私风险：模型输出可能表明检索语料库中存在特定文档，从而使得能够泄露敏感信息的成员推理攻击（MIA）成为可能。现有的MIA虽然可行，但往往依赖于容易被检测的模板化查询，或者需要大量非模板化但成本高昂且重复的查询，从而限制了实用性。我们提出疑问：攻击者能否使用非模板化查询发起一种有限预算、无需替代模型、隐蔽且与防御无关的成员推理攻击？我们提出MEntA（成员蕴涵攻击）——一种查询高效的MIA，它利用自然语言蕴涵来最大化每次查询获得的信息。通过提出低成本、广泛、信息寻求型的问题，并测量模型响应与候选文档之间的蕴涵关系，MEntA消除了对昂贵的影子LLM和大量查询预算的需求。在NFCorpus、SCIDOCS和TREC-COVID上，MEntA仅用5个查询就达到高达0.991的AUC，在同等条件下比先前方法高出最多0.42 AUC。它在最先进的（SOTA）RAG防御下仍然有效，而当前检测器要么漏掉MEntA，要么以高概率将良性查询标记为异常。在成本方面，在相同攻击设置下，MEntA将总攻击成本相比SOTA攻击降低了最多65倍。我们的发现揭示了RAG系统中现实、低成本隐私泄露的可行性，并凸显了对隐私感知检索和防御机制的迫切需求。

upstream_only.title: Verifiable Elections—Now Is the Time
upstream_only.abstract:
We have a crisis of confidence in elections today in the U.S. and in many parts of the world.  Voters are asked to "trust the process" without being given direct evidence that their votes have been counted correctly.  We can do better!
Technology has existed for over four decades that allows voters to independently verify that their votes have been accurately counted – without having to trust any election software, hardware, or personnel.  This technology is now mature, practical, easy to use, and has been deployed in public elections.
This talk will describe what it means for an election to be publicly verifiable, provide a high-level view of how these systems work, and reflect on lessons learned from real-world deployments.  It will also discuss how individuals can help drive the adoption of verifiable election technology in their own jurisdictions.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 如今在美国和世界许多地方，选举存在信任危机。选民被要求“相信流程”，却没有获得选票被正确计数的直接证据。我们可以做得更好！四十多年来，已有技术能让选民独立验证自己的选票被准确计数——而无需信任任何选举软件、硬件或人员。这项技术如今已成熟、实用、易于使用，并已在公共选举中部署。本次演讲将描述选举公开可验证意味着什么，提供这些系统工作原理的概览，并反思来自真实部署的经验教训。它还将讨论个人如何帮助推动可验证选举技术在其所在辖区的采用。

upstream_only.title: If They Can Touch It, They Own It: The Stories We Tell Ourselves About Medical Device Cybersecurity
upstream_only.abstract:
Medical device security differs from traditional security in one important way: when it fails, patient safety can be at risk. Regulators around the world have responded with policies, requirements, and frameworks intended to drive secure-by-design development. However, regulatory frameworks rely heavily on manufacturer risk assessments. As a result, the quality of the underlying security reasoning becomes critical.
This talk presents real-world case studies of security decisions shaped by familiar justifications, including "competitors are doing less," "previous products shipped without incident," and "physical access makes security irrelevant." These decisions result in flawed risk management, weak cryptographic designs, and avoidable vulnerabilities. To illustrate how these decisions emerge in practice, each case study describes the technical issue, stakeholder dynamics, and outcome. It also discusses penetration-testing findings, regulatory feedback, and practical remediation approaches.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 医疗设备安全与传统安全有一个重要区别：当安全失效时，患者安全可能受到威胁。全球监管机构已通过旨在推动安全设计开发的政策、要求和框架作出回应。然而，监管框架严重依赖制造商的风险评估。因此，底层安全推理的质量变得至关重要。本演讲介绍了由常见理由塑造的安全决策的真实案例研究，这些理由包括“竞争对手做得更少”、“之前产品发布未出事故”以及“物理访问使安全变得无关紧要”。这些决策导致风险管理缺陷、弱密码设计和可避免的漏洞。为了说明这些决策在实践中如何出现，每个案例研究描述了技术问题、利益相关者动态和结果。它还讨论了渗透测试发现、监管反馈和实际补救方法。

upstream_only.title: High-Accuracy, Poisoning-Resilient Frequency Estimation in the Shuffle Model
upstream_only.abstract:
We study frequency estimation in the shuffle model of differential privacy under poisoning attacks, where corrupted users may deviate from the local randomizer to inject crafted in-domain messages. Existing shuffle-model protocols face a core tension: achieving low estimation error relies on flexible multi-message noise generation, which can amplify poisoning influence once messages are anonymized by shuffling.
To address this tension, we propose a symmetric binomial-sum noise distribution (i.e., Bin(n/2, p)+Bin(n/2,1− p)), which preserves high accuracy while limiting the impact of crafted in-domain messages. We realize this distribution via preprocessing-guided noise generation, which routes a balanced collection of mode flags through the shuffler so that each user receives a randomly assigned mode flag that fixes their noise-sampling behavior prior to shuffling. For binary estimation, our protocol requires a single Bernoulli trial per user and at most 2 messages per user(1.5 on average),while bounding the worst-case poisoning influence of a single corrupted user by O(1/n). We extend the protocol to histograms, including large domains via hashing, and provide formal privacy, accuracy, and robustness guarantees. Experiments on real datasets show that our protocols remain resilient under poisoning and reduce MAE by up to nearly 2× over the strongest baseline at comparable per-user communication on small domains, and match it on large domains.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们研究在投毒攻击下洗牌模型差分隐私中的频率估计，其中被腐蚀的用户可能偏离本地随机化器，注入精心构造的域内消息。现有的洗牌模型协议面临核心矛盾：实现低估计误差依赖于灵活的多消息噪声生成，而一旦消息经洗牌匿名化，这可能放大投毒影响。为了解决这一矛盾，我们提出一种对称二项和噪声分布（即 Bin(n/2, p)+Bin(n/2,1−p)），它在保持高精度的同时限制精心构造的域内消息的影响。我们通过预处理引导的噪声生成来实现这一分布，该方法将均衡的模式标志集合通过洗牌器路由，使得每个用户在洗牌前收到随机分配的模式标志，从而固定其噪声采样行为。对于二值估计，我们的协议每个用户只需一次伯努利试验，且每个用户至多2条消息（平均1.5条），同时将单个被腐蚀用户的最坏情况投毒影响限制在 O(1/n)。我们将协议扩展到直方图，包括通过哈希处理大域，并提供形式化的隐私、精度和鲁棒性保证。在真实数据集上的实验表明，我们的协议在投毒下保持韧性，在小域上以可比的每用户通信量将MAE相比最强基线降低近2倍，在大域上则与最强基线相当。

upstream_only.title: Fully Oblivious Differential Privacy for Frequency Estimation in the Augmented Shuffle Model with Trusted Processors
upstream_only.abstract:
In the shuffle model of DP (Differential Privacy), a shuffler randomly permutes users' data to achieve high accuracy and privacy. Recent studies show that most existing shuffle protocols are vulnerable to collusion attacks by the data collector and users. They address this issue by introducing the augmented shuffle model that incorporates random sampling and dummy data addition into the shuffler. However, it remains open how to ensure the shuffler follows the protocol and does not collude with the data collector in this model.
We address this trust issue by thoroughly exploring the augmented shuffle model with TEEs (Trusted Execution Environments). We first introduce a new privacy notion, FODP (Fully Oblivious DP), which strengthens DP to prevent various TEE side-channel attacks based on external/internal memory access patterns and control flows. We propose a general framework for FODP algorithms based on memory-size obfuscation and three concrete algorithms within it. We also improve the efficiency of our algorithms by using the count-min sketch and optimizing the number of hashes. We evaluate our algorithms on Intel SGX and demonstrate their effectiveness through comparisons with nine baselines.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在差分隐私（DP）的混洗模型中，混洗器随机置换用户数据以实现高精度和隐私。近期研究表明，大多数现有混洗协议容易受到数据收集者和用户合谋攻击。他们通过引入增强混洗模型来解决此问题，该模型将随机采样和添加虚假数据纳入混洗器。然而，在该模型中如何确保混洗器遵循协议且不与数据收集者合谋仍是一个未决问题。我们通过深入探索带有TEE（可信执行环境）的增强混洗模型来解决这一信任问题。我们首先引入一种新的隐私概念FODP（完全不经意差分隐私），它强化了DP，以防止基于外部/内部内存访问模式和控制流的各种TEE侧信道攻击。我们提出了基于内存大小混淆的FODP算法通用框架，以及其中的三个具体算法。我们还通过使用count-min sketch并优化哈希数量来提高算法效率。我们在Intel SGX上评估了我们的算法，并通过与九个基线方法的比较证明了其有效性。

upstream_only.title: Sequential Auditing for f-Differential Privacy
upstream_only.abstract: We present new auditors to assess Differential Privacy (DP) of an algorithm based on output samples. Such empirical auditors are common to check for algorithmic correctness and implementation bugs. Most existing auditors are batch-based or targeted toward the traditional notion of (ε,δ)-DP; typically both. In this work, we shift the focus to the highly expressive privacy concept of f-DP, in which the entire privacy behavior is captured by a single tradeoff curve. Our auditors detect violations across the full privacy spectrum with statistical significance guarantees, which are supported by theory and simulations. Most importantly, and in contrast to prior work, our auditors do not require a user-specified sample size as an input. Rather, they adaptively determine a near-optimal number of samples needed to reach a decision, thereby avoiding the excessively large sample sizes common in many auditing studies. This reduction in sampling cost becomes especially beneficial for expensive training procedures such as DP-SGD. Our method supports both whitebox and blackbox settings and can also be executed in one-run frameworks.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了新的审计器，用于基于输出样本评估算法的差分隐私（DP）。此类经验审计器常用于检查算法正确性和实现缺陷。大多数现有审计器是批处理的，或针对传统的(ε,δ)-DP概念；通常两者兼有。在本工作中，我们将重点转向极具表达力的隐私概念f-DP，其中整个隐私行为由单条权衡曲线刻画。我们的审计器在整个隐私谱系上检测违规，并具有统计显著性保证，这些保证得到了理论和模拟的支持。最重要的是，与先前工作不同，我们的审计器不需要用户指定样本量作为输入。相反，它们自适应地确定达到决策所需的近乎最优样本数量，从而避免了许多审计研究中常见过大的样本量。这种采样成本的降低对于DP-SGD等昂贵的训练过程尤其有益。我们的方法支持白盒和黑盒设置，也可以在单次运行框架中执行。

upstream_only.title: Measuring Real-World Prompt Injection Attacks in LLM-based Resume Screening
upstream_only.abstract: LLMs are vulnerable to prompt injection attacks. However, this vulnerability has been primarily demonstrated conceptually in academic studies or through a few anecdotal case studies. Its prevalence and impact in real-world LLM-based applications are largely unexplored. In this work, we present the first systematic study of prompt-injection attacks in a widely used application: LLM-based resume screening. Our analysis is based on approximately 200K real-world resumes collected over multiple years by AnonyCom (The company's name is intentionally anonymized for double-blind review purposes). We first design tailored methods to detect prompt injection in resumes. Manual verification on a small-scale dataset demonstrates that our detectors achieve high precision and outperform state-of-the-art general-purpose detectors. We then apply our detector to the full resume dataset and conduct a comprehensive measurement study of real-world prompt injection attacks. Our analysis reveals several intriguing findings: approximately 1% of resumes contain hidden prompt injections; the prevalence of such injected resumes has increased noticeably over the past one to two years; and more than 90% of injected prompts do not use explicit instructions. These results provide the first evidence of large-scale prompt injection in real-world LLM-based applications and lay the groundwork for future studies to understand and mitigate such attacks.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: LLM易受提示注入攻击。然而，这种脆弱性主要是在学术研究中从概念上展示，或者通过少数轶事案例研究来展示。其在真实世界基于LLM的应用中的普遍性和影响在很大程度上尚未被探索。在这项工作中，我们首次对一种广泛使用的应用——基于LLM的简历筛选——中的提示注入攻击进行了系统研究。我们的分析基于AnonyCom（该公司名称出于双盲评审目的而被有意匿名化）多年来收集的约20万份真实简历。我们首先设计了定制方法来检测简历中的提示注入。对一个小规模数据集的人工验证表明，我们的检测器达到了高精度，并优于最先进的通用检测器。然后，我们将检测器应用于完整的简历数据集，并对真实世界的提示注入攻击进行了全面的测量研究。我们的分析揭示了一些有趣的发现：大约1%的简历包含隐藏的提示注入；这类注入简历的普遍性在过去一到两年中显著增加；超过90%的注入提示不使用显式指令。这些结果首次提供了真实世界基于LLM的应用中大规模提示注入的证据，并为未来理解和缓解此类攻击的研究奠定了基础。

upstream_only.title: Cordyceps: Covert Control Attacks on LLMs via Data Poisoning
upstream_only.abstract:
Large language models (LLMs) are often fine-tuned on uncurated text datasets that adversaries can poison. Existing poisoning attacks primarily rely on fixed trigger phrases that defenses such as outlier detection, clean-data regularization, or online monitoring can neutralize. In this paper, we propose a data poisoning method that teaches an LLM an information hiding scheme reliably and stealthily through semantic associations between shared knowledge such as facts or concepts and attacker-chosen phrases. The induced hiding scheme can encode and decode arbitrary malicious instructions, thus revealing a new and subtle poisoning-induced vulnerability: covert control attacks.
We precisely characterize covert control attacks and evaluate them across 5 LLMs, 3 backdoor defenses, and 4 prompt injection defenses. With a small poisoned fraction, covert control attacks outperform heuristic-based prompt injection attacks in average attack success rate by about 40% relative to clean fine-tuned models. They also circumvent defenses based on detection and fine-tuning, maintaining up to 93% attack success rate after backdoor defenses and up to 98% after prompt injection defenses. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/Sadcardation/cordyceps.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）通常会在未经整理且可能被对手投毒的文本数据集上进行微调。现有的投毒攻击主要依赖固定的触发短语，而异常值检测、干净数据正则化或在线监控等防御可以使其失效。在本文中，我们提出一种数据投毒方法，通过共享知识（如事实或概念）与攻击者选定短语之间的语义关联，可靠且隐蔽地教会LLM一种信息隐藏方案。所诱导的隐藏方案能够编码和解码任意恶意指令，从而揭示了一种新的、微妙的投毒诱发漏洞：隐蔽控制攻击。我们精确刻画了隐蔽控制攻击，并在5个LLM、3种后门防御和4种提示注入防御上进行了评估。在少量投毒比例下，相对于干净微调模型，隐蔽控制攻击的平均攻击成功率比基于启发式的提示注入攻击高出约40%。它们还规避了基于检测和微调的防御，在后门防御后保持高达93%的攻击成功率，在提示注入防御后高达98%。我们的代码和数据可在 https://github.com/Sadcardation/cordyceps 获取。

upstream_only.title: The Attacker Moves Second: Stronger Adaptive Attacks Bypass Defenses Against LLM Jailbreaks and Prompt Injections
upstream_only.abstract:
How should we evaluate the robustness of language model defenses? Current defenses against jailbreaks and prompt injections (which aim to prevent an attacker from eliciting harmful knowledge or remotely triggering malicious actions, respectively) are typically evaluated either against a static set of harmful attack strings, or against computationally weak optimization methods that were not designed with the defense in mind. We argue that this evaluation process is flawed.
Instead, we should evaluate defenses against adaptive attackers who explicitly modify their attack strategy to counter a defense's design while spending considerable resources to optimize their objective. By systematically tuning and scaling general optimization techniques—gradient descent, reinforcement learning, random search, and human-guided exploration—we bypass 12 recent defenses (based on a diverse set of techniques) with attack success rate above 90% (under adaptive attacks) for most; importantly, the majority of defenses originally reported near-zero attack success rates. We believe that future defense work must consider stronger attacks, such as the ones we describe, in order to make reliable and convincing claims of robustness.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 应如何评估语言模型防御的鲁棒性？当前针对越狱和提示注入的防御（分别旨在防止攻击者诱导有害知识或远程触发恶意操作）通常要么针对一组静态的有害攻击字符串进行评估，要么针对未考虑防御而设计的计算能力较弱的优化方法进行评估。我们认为这一评估过程是有缺陷的。相反，我们应该针对自适应攻击者评估防御，这些攻击者会明确修改其攻击策略以对抗防御的设计，同时投入大量资源优化其目标。通过系统地调整和扩展通用优化技术——梯度下降、强化学习、随机搜索和人工引导探索——我们绕过了12种近期防御（基于多种不同技术），在自适应攻击下大多数攻击成功率超过90%；重要的是，大多数防御最初报告的攻击成功率接近零。我们认为未来的防御工作必须考虑更强的攻击，例如我们所描述的攻击，才能对鲁棒性做出可靠且有说服力的声明。

upstream_only.title: DualSentinel: A Lightweight Framework for Detecting Targeted Attacks in Black-box LLM via Dual Entropy Lull Pattern
upstream_only.abstract: Recent intelligent systems integrate powerful Large Language Models (LLMs) through APIs, but their trustworthiness may be critically undermined by sequence-coercing targeted attacks that force the model to emit an attacker-chosen payload, including malicious URLs, system commands, and specific misinformation. Existing defensive approaches for such threats typically rely on high access rights, impose prohibitive costs, and hinder normal inference, rendering them impractical for real-world scenarios. To solve these limitations, we introduce DualSentinel, a lightweight defense framework that can accurately and promptly detect the activation of targeted attacks alongside the LLM generation process. We first identify a characteristic of compromised LLMs, termed Entropy Lull: when a sequence-coercing targeted attack successfully hijacks the generation process, the LLM exhibits a distinct period of abnormally low and stable token probability entropy, indicating it is following a fixed path rather than making creative choices. DualSentinel leverages this pattern by developing an innovative dual-check approach. It first employs a magnitude and trend-aware monitoring method to proactively and sensitively flag an entropy lull pattern at runtime. Upon such flagging, it triggers a lightweight yet powerful secondary verification based on task-flipping. An attack is confirmed only if the entropy lull pattern persists across both the original and the flipped task, proving that the LLM's output is coercively controlled. Extensive evaluations show that DualSentinel is both highly effective (superior detection accuracy with the lowest false positives) and remarkably efficient (negligible additional cost), offering a truly practical path toward securing deployed LLMs.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 近期智能系统通过API集成强大的大语言模型（LLM），但其可信度可能被序列强制型定向攻击严重破坏，这类攻击迫使模型输出攻击者选定的载荷，包括恶意URL、系统命令和特定虚假信息。现有针对此类威胁的防御方法通常依赖高访问权限、成本高昂，并妨碍正常推理，使其在现实场景中不切实际。为解决这些局限，我们提出DualSentinel，一个轻量级防御框架，能够在LLM生成过程中准确且及时地检测定向攻击的激活。我们首先识别出受损LLM的一个特征，称为熵静止（Entropy Lull）：当序列强制型定向攻击成功劫持生成过程时，LLM会表现出一段异常低且稳定的词元概率熵，表明它正在遵循固定路径而非进行创造性选择。DualSentinel利用这一模式，开发了一种创新的双重检查方法。它首先采用幅度与趋势感知的监控方法，在运行时主动且敏感地标记熵静止模式。一旦标记，便触发基于任务翻转的轻量级但强大的二次验证。只有当熵静止模式在原始任务和翻转任务中均持续存在时，才确认攻击，证明LLM的输出受到强制控制。大量评估表明，DualSentinel既高效（检测准确率优越且误报率最低）又极其高效（额外成本可忽略），为保护已部署的LLM提供了一条真正实用的路径。

upstream_only.title: Context Contamination in LLM Analysis of Network Security Logs: Poison with Passive Prompt Injection and Mitigation Evaluation
upstream_only.abstract: Large Language Models are increasingly deployed in Security Operations Centers for log analysis tasks including summarization, alert triage, and threat investigation. These systems ingest logs from external-facing services and process network logs as natural language contexts to generate security insights.
