Stripped binaries dominate real-world security analysis: COTS software, firmware, and malware are released without symbols, obscuring program semantics. Recent LLM-based approaches target narrowly predefined tasks, limiting applicability in intent-driven analysis. Toward general binary analysis, agentic LLMs provide a natural direction, yet achieving generality remains challenging: query intent is hard to ground in stripped binaries, and effective tool-driven analysis is difficult.
We present BINREX, the first agentic framework for general, fully automated static binary analysis. BINREX employs a dual-encoder pipeline to enrich stripped functions with semantic context, paired with hierarchical planning to decompose intents into executable subtasks. It leverages code synthesis to translate subtasks into IDAPython scripts, executed with iterative validation to produce outputs aggregated into the final report.
We evaluate BINREX on BinREval, a benchmark of 72 tasks across seven COTS categories with machine-checkable oracles. BINREX achieves 83.3% success rate, outperforming baselines (Codex: 27.8%, Codex with IDA: 43.1%) while reducing total analysis time from 87.9 to 36.1 hours. On domain benchmarks (Juliet, NYU CTF), BINREX is competitive with task-specific methods on their respective evaluation settings. Human study and industrial deployment confirm practical value: BINREX identifies 395 unknown malware samples with 96× average efficiency gain over experts.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 剥离符号的二进制文件在现实世界的安全分析中占主导地位：商业现成软件、固件和恶意软件在发布时都不带符号，掩盖了程序语义。最近的基于LLM的方法针对狭窄预定义任务，限制了在意图驱动分析中的适用性。走向通用二进制分析，智能体LLM提供了一个自然方向，但实现通用性仍然具有挑战性：查询意图难以在剥离符号的二进制文件中落地，而有效的工具驱动分析也很困难。我们提出BINREX，这是首个用于通用、全自动静态二进制分析的智能体框架。BINREX采用双编码器流水线，用语义上下文丰富剥离符号的函数，并结合分层规划将意图分解为可执行子任务。它利用代码合成将子任务转换为IDAPython脚本，通过迭代验证执行，将输出聚合成最终报告。我们在BinREval上评估BINREX，这是一个包含72个任务、跨越七个COTS类别、带有机器可检查预言机的基准。BINREX达到83.3%的成功率，优于基线（Codex：27.8%，Codex加IDA：43.1%），同时将总分析时间从87.9小时减少到36.1小时。在领域基准（Juliet、NYU CTF）上，BINREX在其各自的评估设置中与任务特定方法具有竞争力。人类研究和工业部署证实了实用价值：BINREX识别出395个未知恶意软件样本，平均效率比专家提高96倍。

upstream_only.title: Melting the Flesh of PHP's Memory Hardening
upstream_only.abstract: Heap allocators are responsible for efficiently allocating or releasing memory on the heap. In addition, they also commonly implement various mitigation measures to defend against heap-based memory corruption. Recently, the PHP project launched a heap hardening initiative aimed at stopping popular heap exploit techniques or restricting the exploit strategy space. In this paper, we conduct the first security study to understand the impact and effectiveness of these new protective measures. We find that while they are effective at stopping current-generation exploits, they fall short against determined attackers who will adapt. Through our analysis, we not only identify the flaw that allows specific mitigations to be bypassed, but also a new suite of novel exploitation strategies that work for the most common vulnerabilities involving out-of-bounds memory write and use-after-free write primitives. Notably, our strategy is generic across the built-in PHP objects and can still work even with a single-byte out-of-bounds memory write primitive. Finally, we evaluate our exploit strategies against five real vulnerabilities in an environment with all evaluated protections enabled. The results show that although the new protection measures can effectively defend against the exploitation of most vulnerabilities, the attack strategies proposed by this work can still make these vulnerabilities exploitable again. The identified flaw has since been patched after our responsible disclosure.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 堆分配器负责高效地在堆上分配或释放内存。此外，它们通常还实现各种缓解措施，以防御基于堆的内存破坏。最近，PHP 项目发起了一项堆加固计划，旨在阻止流行的堆利用技术或限制利用策略空间。在本文中，我们开展了首个安全性研究，以理解这些新保护措施的影响和有效性。我们发现，尽管它们能有效阻止当前一代的利用，但对于会适应调整的坚定攻击者仍显不足。通过分析，我们不仅识别出允许特定缓解措施被绕过的缺陷，还提出了一套新颖的利用策略，适用于涉及越界内存写入和释放后使用写入原语的最常见漏洞。值得注意的是，我们的策略在 PHP 内置对象上具有通用性，甚至仅凭单字节越界内存写入原语也能奏效。最后，我们在启用所有评估保护措施的环境中，针对五个真实漏洞评估了我们的利用策略。结果表明，尽管新保护措施能有效防御大多数漏洞的利用，但本工作提出的攻击策略仍可使这些漏洞重新可被利用。所识别的缺陷已在我们的负责任披露后得到修补。

upstream_only.title: Retrofit: Continual Learning with Controlled Forgetting for Binary Security Detection and Analysis
upstream_only.abstract:
Binary security has increasingly relied on deep learning to reason about malware behavior and program semantics. However, the performance often degrades as threat landscapes evolve and code representations shift. While continual learning (CL) offers a natural solution through sequential updates, most existing approaches rely on data replay or unconstrained updates, limiting their applicability and effectiveness in data-sensitive security environments. We propose RETROFIT, which regulates knowledge retention and adaptation with controlled forgetting at each update, without requiring historical data. Our key idea is to consolidate previously trained and newly fine-tuned models, serving as teachers of legacy and emergent knowledge, through retrospective-free parameter merging. Forgetting control is achieved by 1) constraining parameter changes to low-rank and sparse subspaces for approximate orthogonality, and 2) employing a confidence-guided arbitration mechanism to dynamically aggregate knowledge from both teachers.
Our evaluation on two representative applications demonstrates that RETROFIT consistently mitigates forgetting while maintaining adaptability. In malware detection under temporal drift, it substantially improves the retention score, from 20.2% to 38.6% over CL baselines, and exceeds the oracle upper bound on new data. In binary summarization across decompilation levels, where analyzing stripped binaries is especially challenging, RETROFIT achieves over 2x the BLEU score of transfer learning used in prior work and surpasses all baselines in cross-representation generalization.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 二进制安全越来越依赖深度学习来推理恶意软件行为和程序语义。然而，随着威胁格局演变和代码表示发生变化，性能往往会下降。虽然持续学习（CL）通过顺序更新提供了自然的解决方案，但大多数现有方法依赖数据回放或无约束更新，限制了其在数据敏感的安全环境中的适用性和有效性。我们提出了RETROFIT，它在每次更新时通过受控遗忘来调节知识保留与适应，且不需要历史数据。我们的核心思想是通过无回顾的参数合并，整合先前训练和新微调的模型，分别作为遗留知识和新兴知识的教师。遗忘控制通过以下方式实现：1）将参数变化约束在低秩和稀疏子空间以实现近似正交性，2）采用置信度引导的仲裁机制动态聚合来自两个教师的知识。我们在两个代表性应用上的评估表明，RETROFIT在保持适应性的同时持续缓解遗忘。在时间漂移下的恶意软件检测中，它将保留分数从20.2%显著提高到38.6%，超过CL基线，并在新数据上超过了oracle上界。在跨反编译级别的二进制摘要中，分析剥离二进制文件尤其具有挑战性，RETROFIT的BLEU分数达到先前工作中迁移学习的2倍以上，并在跨表示泛化方面超越了所有基线。

upstream_only.title: Butterfly: Scalable Multi-Party Circuit-PSI via Triplet Zero-Sharing
upstream_only.abstract:
Multi-party circuit private set intersection (MP-CPSI) enables m parties to compute the intersection of their private sets in secret-shared form, facilitating secure downstream computations. However, existing protocols face severe efficiency bottlenecks: they either rely on generic circuit-based approaches (e.g., Sort-Compare-Shuffle) that incur prohibitive non-linear complexity, or they aggregate pairwise two-party protocols using full-scale m-party MPC, where the communication cost scales super-linearly with the number of participants.
In this work, we propose Butterfly, a highly scalable MP-CPSI protocol that achieves the communication cost of each party independent of the number of parties m and linear in the set size n. Our construction reduces the general m-party problem to an honest-majority three-party committee via a novel dual-execution blueprint and triplet zero-sharing, leveraging only efficient key-value stores (KVS) and symmetric-key operations. Furthermore, our protocol decouples the complexity of downstream generic computations from m, allowing the subsequent circuits to be evaluated using efficient generic honest-majority three-party computations among the committee (the "body"), while the other m-3 clients (the "wings") achieve only one-shot communication and are dropout-tolerant. The security of our protocol relies on the non-collusion assumption among the committee and is secure against any adversary corrupting arbitrary clients and at most one committee party. We further provide an efficient extension of our protocol to support associated payloads, enabling downstream complex analytics with practical efficiency. 
Compared to the state-of-the-art baselines without non-collusion assumptions, our protocol achieves up to 10130× and 3231× reductions in communication and running time, respectively, for m=30. In the special case of m=3, our protocol requires 4× less communication and runs 14× faster than the honest-majority baseline in the same model. We separately evaluate our protocol in large-scale settings, which runs in just 2.66 (resp. 65.5) seconds under a 10Gbps (resp. 200Mbps) network for 120 parties each holding 220 items, incurring only 1405 MB communication costs in total.
upstream_only.abstract_zh:
多方电路私有集合交集（MP-CPSI）使 m 个参与方能够以秘密共享形式计算其私有集合的交集，从而促进安全的下游计算。然而，现有协议面临严重的效率瓶颈：它们要么依赖通用电路方法（例如 Sort-Compare-Shuffle），导致难以承受的非线性复杂度；要么使用全规模 m 方 MPC 来聚合两两双方协议，其中通信成本随参与方数量超线性增长。
在这项工作中，我们提出 Butterfly，一种高度可扩展的 MP-CPSI 协议，使得每个参与方的通信成本与参与方数量 m 无关，且与集合大小 n 呈线性关系。我们的构造通过一种新颖的双重执行蓝图和三元组零共享，将一般 m 方问题归约到一个诚实多数三方委员会，仅利用高效的键值存储（KVS）和对称密钥操作。此外，我们的协议将下游通用计算的复杂度与 m 解耦，允许后续电路在委员会（“主体”）中通过高效的通用诚实多数三方计算进行评估，而其他 m-3 个客户端（“翼”）仅需一次性通信且可容忍掉线。我们协议的安全性依赖于委员会之间的非合谋假设，并且能够安全抵御腐败任意客户端和至多一个委员会方的对手。我们进一步提供协议的高效扩展以支持关联载荷，从而以实际效率支持下游复杂分析。
与没有非合谋假设的最先进基线相比，对于 m=30，我们的协议在通信和运行时间上分别实现了高达 10130 倍和 3231 倍的降低。在 m=3 的特殊情况下，我们的协议比同一模型下的诚实多数基线所需通信少 4 倍，运行速度快 14 倍。我们单独在大规模设置中评估了我们的协议，在 10Gbps（或 200Mbps）网络下，对于 120 个各持有 2^20 个条目的参与方，其运行时间仅为 2.66（或 65.5）秒，总通信成本仅为 1405 MB。

upstream_only.title: Enhanced Private Set Union from Secret-shared Private Membership Test
upstream_only.abstract:
Private set union (PSU) enables two parties to compute the union of their sets without revealing additional information. Jia et al. (USENIX Security 2024) point out that most scalable PSU protocols suffer from during-execution leakage, whereby membership information is revealed to the receiver before the protocol completes, and consequently introduce the functionality of enhanced PSU to mitigate this issue. While several recent works propose protocols for enhanced PSU, existing solutions either incur high computational overhead due to reliance on computation-intensive public-key primitives, or suffer from large communication costs arising from generic secure computation.
In this work, we present a modular framework for constructing enhanced PSU based on the multi-query secret-shared private membership test (ssPMT) protocol (ASIACRYPT 2023) and a new primitive called secret-shared oblivious transfer with default (ssOTd). Our framework eliminates duringexecution leakage by ensuring that all intermediate information remains secret-shared between the parties throughout the protocol. At its core, we present two efficient ssPMT constructions relying primarily on lightweight symmetric-key primitives. We further design a customized, communication-efficient ssOTd protocol to optimize the overhead of enhanced PSU. As a byproduct, we obtain a computation-efficient construction of multi-query reverse PMT (mqRPMT) that avoids the computation-heavy public-key primitives used in the stateof-the-art approaches.
We implement two enhanced PSU protocols, denoted as ePSU-fast and ePSU-low, which are optimized for computational efficiency and communication efficiency, respectively, making them suitable for different network settings. Extensive evaluations show that ePSU-low simultaneously achieves lower computation and communication overhead than the state-of-the-art protocols by Jia et al. (USENIX Security 2024) and Tu et al. (USENIX Security 2025). Moreover, the ePSUfast protocol further reduces computation costs compared to ePSU-low, at the expense of increased communication.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 隐私集合求并（PSU）使两方能够计算其集合的并集而不泄露额外信息。Jia等人（USENIX Security 2024）指出，大多数可扩展的PSU协议在执行期间存在泄露，即在协议完成之前成员信息就被泄露给接收方，并因此引入了增强PSU的功能来缓解此问题。虽然最近有几项工作提出了增强PSU的协议，但现有解决方案要么因依赖计算密集型的公钥原语而带来高计算开销，要么因通用安全计算而产生大量通信成本。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个模块化框架，用于基于多查询秘密共享私有成员测试（ssPMT）协议（ASIACRYPT 2023）和一个称为带默认值的秘密共享不经意传输（ssOTd）的新原语来构建增强PSU。我们的框架通过确保所有中间信息在整个协议过程中始终在双方之间秘密共享，从而消除了执行期间泄露。其核心是我们提出了两种高效的ssPMT构造，主要依赖轻量级对称密钥原语。我们进一步设计了一种定制的、通信高效的ssOTd协议，以优化增强PSU的开销。作为副产品，我们获得了一种计算高效的多查询反向PMT（mqRPMT）构造，避免了当前最先进方法中使用的计算量大的公钥原语。我们实现了两种增强PSU协议，分别称为ePSU-fast和ePSU-low，它们分别针对计算效率和通信效率进行了优化，适用于不同的网络设置。大量评估表明，ePSU-low同时实现了比Jia等人（USENIX Security 2024）和Tu等人（USENIX Security 2025）的最先进协议更低的计算和通信开销。此外，ePSU-fast协议与ePSU-low相比进一步降低了计算成本，但代价是通信量增加。

upstream_only.title: SING: Improving the Efficiency of MPC Protocol Assignment using Graph Neural Networks
upstream_only.abstract:
Secure Multi-Party Computation (MPC) enables private computation, but has significantly higher overhead than plaintext execution. Hybrid MPC compilers improve concrete efficiency by mapping distinct computation parts to contextually optimal MPC protocols. However, state-of-the-art systems like Silph (Chen et al., S&P'23) depend on deployment-specific cost models that are cumbersome to retune, and compute mappings via brittle heuristics or costly Integer Linear Programming (ILP), limiting scalability and portability across protocols and deployment settings.
We present SING, the first machine-learning-based framework for hybrid MPC share assignment. SING leverages Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for: (1) imitation of Silph's assignments, accelerating share assignment by up to 76,697x with comparable quality; and (2) cost-driven learning, where we train a GNN cost predictor on synthetic or empirical costs (e.g., runtime or communication), freeze it, and train the share-assigning GNN to minimize predicted costs. The latter supports expressive non-linear cost models, avoiding ILP's linearity constraints, and enables retargeting to new protocol suites and deployment settings by re-fitting the predictor. Finally, we release our synthetic benchmark resources, including a dataset of 704 MPC circuits with wide-ranging hybrid assignments.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 安全多方计算（MPC）使私有计算成为可能，但开销显著高于明文执行。混合MPC编译器通过将不同计算部分映射到上下文最优的MPC协议来提高具体效率。然而，Silph（Chen et al., S&P'23）等最先进系统依赖特定部署的成本模型，重新调整十分繁琐，并且通过脆弱启发式或昂贵的整数线性规划（ILP）计算映射，限制了可扩展性以及跨协议和部署设置的便携性。我们提出SING，首个基于机器学习的混合MPC份额分配框架。SING利用图神经网络（GNN）进行：(1) 模仿Silph的分配，将份额分配加速高达76,697倍且质量相当；(2) 成本驱动学习，我们在合成或经验成本（例如运行时间或通信）上训练GNN成本预测器，冻结它，并训练份额分配GNN以最小化预测成本。后者支持表达性非线性成本模型，避免ILP的线性约束，并可通过重新拟合预测器重定向到新协议套件和部署设置。最后，我们发布合成基准资源，包括一个包含704个MPC电路及广泛混合分配的数据集。

upstream_only.title: FLOSS: Fast Linear Online Secret-Shared Shuffling
upstream_only.abstract: Randomly permuting secret data vectors is a core building block in many privacy-preserving protocols, including those for analytics, advertising, and communication. Existing approaches either rely on computation-heavy public key cryptography and zero-knowledge proofs or scale poorly for large vectors due to use of a quasilinear-sized permutation network. This work presents a preprocessing approach to enable fast linear-time online shuffles in the malicious-secure two-party computation (2PC) setting. We propose FLOSS, a 2PC protocol for securely computing any interactive arithmetic permutation circuit, a notion we introduce to capture how higher level protocols are built on secret-shared field arithmetic and permutations. We show how secret-shared sorting (a subprotocol in data analytics) can be described as an arithmetic permutation circuit, and can thus be compiled to an efficient online 2PC protocol using FLOSS. Our implementation and evaluation confirm FLOSS performs online shuffles fast: shuffling 2^20 elements in under 500ms, greater than 800× faster than state-of-the-art alternatives.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 随机置换秘密数据向量是许多隐私保护协议的核心构建模块，包括用于分析、广告和通信的协议。现有方法要么依赖计算密集的公钥密码学和零知识证明，要么由于使用准线性大小的置换网络而难以扩展到大型向量。本文提出一种预处理方法，以在恶意安全的两方计算（2PC）设置中实现快速线性时间的在线混洗。我们提出FLOSS，一种用于安全计算任何交互式算术置换电路的2PC协议，我们引入这一概念来刻画更高级别协议如何构建在秘密共享域算术和置换之上。我们展示了秘密共享排序（数据分析中的子协议）如何可以描述为算术置换电路，并因此可以使用FLOSS编译为高效的在线2PC协议。我们的实现和评估证实FLOSS执行在线混洗很快：在500毫秒内混洗2^20个元素，比最先进的替代方案快800倍以上。

upstream_only.title: Lighthouse: Single-Server Secure Aggregation with O(1) Server-Committee Communication at Scale
upstream_only.abstract:
Secure aggregation is a core primitive for privacy-preserving federated learning, enabling a server to compute aggregates of client updates without learning individual inputs. Recent protocols have explored committee-based designs to reduce client overhead and tolerate weakly connected participants. However, existing approaches still incur communication and computation costs that scale with the number of clients and/or the size of model updates. This becomes a serious bottleneck in interaction between the server and the committee, given that model updates are high-dimensional and the committee is a small set of clients.
We present Lighthouse, a new secure aggregation protocol that supports one-shot client communication and achieves constant committee computation and communication overhead with the server, independent of both the number of clients and the size of the input vector. Our protocol attains the best-known round complexity of two rounds, matching OPA (CRYPTO 2025) and TACITA (ePrint 2025) and improving upon Flamingo (S&P 2023) and Willow (CRYPTO 2025). Our core technical contribution is a novel application of recent advances in batched threshold encryption, which enables succinct server–committee interaction while preserving security and correctness. Beyond asymptotic improvements over prior works, Lighthouse yields substantial concrete efficiency gains: For an aggregation with 1024 clients, we reduce server-to-committee communication by over 100× and committee-to-server communication by over 300× compared to Flamingo and Willow. Also, we present an extension that supports dynamic client participation, a critical requirement for practical deployments at scale, while preserving the asymptotic and concrete efficiency of the static protocol for clients.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 安全聚合是隐私保护联邦学习的核心原语，使服务器能够计算客户端更新的聚合值，而无需获知单个输入。近期协议探索了基于委员会的设计，以降低客户端开销并容忍弱连接参与者。然而，现有方法仍会产生随客户端数量和/或模型更新规模而增长的通信与计算成本。鉴于模型更新是高维的且委员会是小型客户端集合，这成为服务器与委员会之间交互的严重瓶颈。我们提出Lighthouse，一种新的安全聚合协议，支持一次性客户端通信，并实现与服务器之间恒定的委员会计算与通信开销，且不依赖于客户端数量与输入向量规模。我们的协议达到已知最佳的两轮轮复杂度，与OPA (CRYPTO 2025)和TACITA (ePrint 2025)相当，并优于Flamingo (S&P 2023)和Willow (CRYPTO 2025)。我们的核心技术贡献是对近期批量阈值加密进展的新颖应用，从而在保持安全性和正确性的同时实现简洁的服务器-委员会交互。除了对先前工作的渐近改进外，Lighthouse还带来显著的具体效率提升：对于1024个客户端的聚合，与Flamingo和Willow相比，我们将服务器到委员会的通信降低超过100倍，委员会到服务器的通信降低超过300倍。此外，我们提出一种支持动态客户端参与的扩展，这是大规模实际部署的关键需求，同时为客户端保持静态协议的渐近和具体效率。

upstream_only.title: Revelio: A Global Study of VoIP Blocking
upstream_only.abstract:
Online censorship has substantially increased over the past decade. While prior work on censorship detection has largely focused on the web, the landscape and mechanisms of VoIP censorship remain poorly understood.
This work presents the first global study of VoIP blocking by introducing Revelio, a system that systematically detects and comprehensively analyzes VoIP censorship at scale. Unlike the only prior work, which is limited to two countries and requires authors to travel to conduct measurements, Revelio remotely uncovers VoIP blocking by carefully crafting probe packets and strategically leveraging IP address space within target countries, enabling detection of otherwise invisible VoIP censorship.
Using Revelio, we studied 71 countries, covering 11 widely used VoIP applications. Our findings reveal evidence of VoIP blocking in 19 countries, primarily through targeted interference with the STUN traffic. By studying packet traces, we reverse-engineer censorship behavior and uncover four classes and six subtypes of middleboxes that trigger on unique application-specific STUN packets. We further analyze domain-level blocking at the HTTP and HTTPS layers, revealing cases where only VoIP calling is blocked while messaging remains accessible.
Overall, our study advances the understanding of the privacy and censorship community by providing the first comprehensive, global view of an understudied yet highly prevalent form of censorship. We release our code to support reproducibility and future research.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 过去十年中，在线审查显著增加。尽管此前关于审查检测的工作主要集中于Web，但VoIP审查的格局和机制仍然鲜为人知。这项工作通过引入Revelio，提出了首个VoIP封锁的全球研究，Revelio是一个能够大规模系统地检测并全面分析VoIP审查的系统。与唯一一项先前工作（仅限于两个国家，且需要作者亲自前往进行测量）不同，Revelio通过精心构造探测数据包并策略性地利用目标国家内的IP地址空间，远程揭示VoIP封锁，从而能够检测到原本不可见的VoIP审查。使用Revelio，我们研究了71个国家，覆盖11种广泛使用的VoIP应用。我们的发现揭示了19个国家存在VoIP封锁的证据，主要是通过对STUN流量的定向干扰。通过研究数据包轨迹，我们逆向工程了审查行为，并发现了四类六种子类型的中介盒，它们由独特的应用特定STUN数据包触发。我们进一步分析了HTTP和HTTPS层面的域名级封锁，揭示了仅VoIP通话被封锁而消息传递仍可访问的情况。总体而言，我们的研究通过提供对这一研究不足但高度普遍的审查形式的首个全面全球视角，增进了隐私与审查领域的理解。我们发布代码以支持可复现性和未来研究。

upstream_only.title: Towards Practical Few-shot Multi-tab Website Fingerprinting
upstream_only.abstract: Website fingerprinting (WF) attacks can infer the visited websites to deanonymize Tor networks by analyzing encrypted traffic patterns. Recent few-shot WF methods reduce reliance on large-scale data collection, yet they predominantly formulate WF as a single-label classification task and rely on meta-learning episodes that assume disjoint label sets and stable embedding spaces. These assumptions break down in the realistic multi-tab browsing, where traffic from multiple websites interleaves within a single observation window and the number of concurrent tabs is unknown. Meanwhile, the label space grows exponentially as the monitored set expands, making existing multi-tab WF methods costly to update. To address these challenges, we propose MMF, a novel framework for few-shot multi-tab WF. MMF shifts the meta-learning objective from single-label classification to support-guided presence detection. In each episode, we pair a mixed multi-tab query trace with a small set of single-tab support traces for each monitored website, and generate class-specific features by feature reweighting to decide which websites are present. This detection-centric formulation yields well-defined few-shot tasks in multi-tab scenarios and enables MMF to detect previously unseen websites from limited traces. We evaluate MMF on established public datasets and a new real-world dataset collected under varied browsing conditions. Results demonstrate that MMF consistently outperforms state-of-the-art multi-tab WF attacks across all settings. Notably, in the 5-shot scenario, MMF achieves improvements of up to 300% in Novel Precision@k, highlighting its strong capability for few-shot detection in dynamically growing website sets.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 网站指纹（WF）攻击可以通过分析加密流量模式来推断访问的网站，从而对Tor网络进行去匿名化。最近的少样本WF方法减少了对大规模数据收集的依赖，但它们主要将WF表述为单标签分类任务，并依赖元学习片段，这些片段假设标签集不相交且嵌入空间稳定。这些假设在现实的多标签页浏览中不成立，因为来自多个网站的流量在单个观察窗口内交织，且并发标签页的数量未知。同时，随着监控集合扩大，标签空间呈指数增长，使得现有多标签页WF方法更新成本高昂。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了MMF，一种新颖的少样本多标签页WF框架。MMF将元学习目标从单标签分类转变为支持引导的存在检测。在每个片段中，我们将混合的多标签页查询轨迹与每个监控网站的一小组单标签页支持轨迹配对，并通过特征重加权生成类别特定特征，以决定哪些网站存在。这种以检测为中心的表述在多标签页场景中产生了明确定义的少样本任务，并使MMF能够从有限的轨迹中检测以前未见过的网站。我们在既有的公共数据集和在不同浏览条件下收集的新真实世界数据集上评估MMF。结果表明，MMF在所有设置中始终优于最先进的多标签页WF攻击。值得注意的是，在5-shot场景中，MMF在Novel Precision@k上实现了高达300%的提升，突显了其在动态增长的网站集合中进行少样本检测的强大能力。

upstream_only.title: Technical Analysis of the Geedge Networks Firewall Source Code Leak
upstream_only.abstract:
In September 2025, over 100K internal documents (including code, communications, etc.) from Geedge Networks, a Chinese DPI company with ties to the Great Firewall of China, were leaked to the public. In this paper, we analyze the source code from this leak, focusing on Geedge Networks' flagship product, the Tiangou Secure Gateway (TSG) firewall. Working across multiple repositories, we successfully build and run a local copy of TSG---revealing key aspects of its architecture, including the protocols it is capable of parsing and the format of blocking rules used to censor sites, proxies, and other resources. Finally, we extract several fingerprints from TSG, including custom random number generators and parsing idiosyncrasies that allow us to identify its use and similar deployments in the Great Firewall of China.
This is the first time that the source code of a commercial DPI has been leaked, and our work is the first code analysis of a core firewall component used in national censorship infrastructure. This unprecedented investigation offers insights that can assist circumvention developers and Internet security researchers in further understanding the capabilities and limitations of modern censorship technology.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 2025年9月，与中国防火墙有关联的中国DPI公司Geedge Networks的超过10万份内部文档（包括代码、通信等）被泄露给公众。在本文中，我们分析此次泄露中的源代码，重点关注Geedge Networks的旗舰产品“天狗安全网关”（TSG）防火墙。我们在多个代码仓库间工作，成功构建并运行了TSG的本地副本——揭示了其架构的关键方面，包括它能够解析的协议以及用于审查网站、代理和其他资源的封锁规则格式。最后，我们从TSG中提取了若干指纹，包括自定义随机数生成器和解析特性，使我们能够识别其在中国的防火墙中的使用及类似部署。这是商业DPI源代码首次被泄露，我们的工作是首次对国家审查基础设施中使用的核心防火墙组件进行代码分析。这项前所未有的调查提供了洞见，可帮助规避开发者与互联网安全研究人员进一步理解现代审查技术的能力与局限。

upstream_only.title: From Symmetry toward Weak Asymmetry: Secure Steganography under the Receiver's Partial Channel Knowledge
upstream_only.abstract: Provably secure steganography enables covert communication by disguising secret messages as normal communication content while guaranteeing computational indistinguishability. Recent work typically assumes that the sender can construct stegotext based on explicit conditional distributions, while the receiver either has access to the same distributions for decoding or has no such access at all. In many realistic communication settings, however, the receiver's access lies between these two extremes, a regime that is not captured by either assumption. We therefore introduce and study a new setting, called weakly asymmetric steganography, in which the sender has access to the full conditional distributions used for stegotext construction, while the receiver only has partial knowledge derived from them. We design provably secure steganography schemes under several representative forms of receiver-side knowledge. Specifically, we consider binary alphabets in which the receiver only knows whether a symbol's probability exceeds a given threshold, as well as general alphabets where the receiver only observes a possibly partial ranking of symbols by probability. We evaluate our rank-based constructions in language-model-based text steganography under both limited receiver-side knowledge and precision-induced distribution mismatch. The results show that weakly asymmetric steganography can achieve non-trivial embedding capacity, and further suggest the potential of this setting in distribution-mismatch scenarios.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 可证明安全的隐写术通过将秘密消息伪装成正常通信内容，同时保证计算不可区分性，从而实现隐蔽通信。近期工作通常假设发送方能够基于显式条件分布构造隐写文本，而接收方要么能够访问相同的分布以进行解码，要么完全无法访问这些分布。然而，在许多现实通信环境中，接收方的访问权限介于这两个极端之间，而这一情形未被上述任一假设所刻画。因此，我们引入并研究一种新设定，称为弱不对称隐写术：发送方可以访问用于构造隐写文本的完整条件分布，而接收方仅拥有由这些分布导出的部分知识。我们针对几种具有代表性的接收方知识形式设计了可证明安全的隐写方案。具体而言，我们考虑二元字母表下接收方仅知道某个符号的概率是否超过给定阈值的情形，以及一般字母表下接收方仅观察到符号按概率的（可能不完整的）排序的情形。我们在基于语言模型的文本隐写中，在有限的接收方知识与精度引起的分布失配两种情况下评估了基于排序的构造。结果表明，弱不对称隐写术能够实现非平凡的嵌入容量，并进一步表明该设定在分布失配场景中具有潜力。

upstream_only.title: Breaking the Lethal Trifecta: Secure Agentic Computing via Causal Isolation Architecture
upstream_only.abstract:
Most LLM agents over private data have a dangerous shape: the same model reads untrusted instructions, sees sensitive context, and speaks to the outside world. It is like handing a press secretary every private email, incident note, and salary spreadsheet, then hoping a policy memo keeps secrets safe.
Causal Isolation Architecture treats leakage as a systems design failure, not a prompt-writing failure. It splits the lethal trifecta across isolated components, passes only typed abstractions across boundaries, and uses a rule-of-two release judge to preserve useful private-derived guidance while stripping exact facts based on requester trust and source sensitivity.
The key lesson: safety without utility becomes a refusal machine. In our bounded real-model matrix, claim-eligible OpenAI and Anthropic rows showed 0.0% observed secure-path leakage with 83-100% measured utility; matching single-agent baselines leaked private facts. The talk shows the demo, tradeoffs, and limits.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大多数处理私有数据的LLM智能体具有一种危险的形态：同一个模型读取不可信的指令、查看敏感上下文，并对外界发声。这就像把每一封私人邮件、事件记录和工资表都交给新闻秘书，然后指望一份政策备忘录来保守秘密。因果隔离架构将泄漏视为系统设计失败，而非提示词编写失败。它将致命三重奏拆分到相互隔离的组件中，仅跨边界传递类型化抽象，并使用规则二发布裁决器，根据请求者信任度和来源敏感度，在剥离确切事实的同时保留有用的私有派生指导。关键教训：没有效用的安全会变成拒绝机器。在我们有限的实际模型矩阵中，符合声明条件的OpenAI和Anthropic行显示，观察到的安全路径泄漏为0.0%，测得效用为83-100%；匹配的单智能体基线泄漏了私有事实。演讲展示了演示、权衡和局限。

upstream_only.title: Do You Need a Receipt? Anonymous Credential Revocation at Continental Scale via Private Record Certification
upstream_only.abstract:
A key challenge in digital credential systems is revocation, that is, the ability to invalidate credentials post-issuance and verify their status upon presentation. While anonymous credentials enhance privacy over classical credentials (e.g., by providing unlinkability), they complicate revocation. Existing revocation schemes for anonymous credentials often suffer from high client or verifier computation, long delays before revocation takes effect (e.g., epoch-based settings), or require updates to all users with each revocation.
We present an efficient, real-time revocation system for anonymous credentials with decentralized revocation authorities based on a novel primitive called Private Record Certification (PRC). PRC enables users to obtain a certificate for a record stored in a server-managed database without the servers learning which record was requested. This primitive is of independent interest, and we construct it by combining techniques from private information retrieval and secure multi-party computation. Our revocation scheme outsources its computation to the revocation authorities and has minimal overhead for clients and verifiers, while ensuring the communication costs are sublinear in the number of credentials. We build a prototype and demonstrate that our system achieves sub-second real-time latency for PRC requests, at a scale of over 1 billion credentials, with an online operational cost of 2.5$ per server for processing 1 million PRC requests.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 数字凭证系统中的一个关键挑战是撤销，即能够使已签发的凭证失效并在出示时验证其状态。虽然匿名凭证相比传统凭证增强了隐私（例如通过提供不可链接性），但它们使撤销变得复杂。现有的匿名凭证撤销方案通常面临客户端或验证者计算开销高、撤销生效前延迟长（例如基于纪元的设置），或者每次撤销都需要更新所有用户的问题。我们提出了一种高效、实时的匿名凭证撤销系统，其撤销机构是去中心化的，基于一种称为私有记录认证（PRC）的新原语。PRC使用户能够获得服务器管理数据库中存储的记录的证书，而服务器不会得知请求的是哪条记录。该原语具有独立的研究价值，我们通过结合私有信息检索和安全多方计算的技术来构建它。我们的撤销方案将计算外包给撤销机构，对客户端和验证者的开销最小，同时确保通信成本与凭证数量呈亚线性关系。我们构建了一个原型并证明，我们的系统在超过10亿凭证的规模下，PRC请求可实现亚秒级实时延迟，处理100万次PRC请求的在线运营成本为每台服务器2.5美元。

upstream_only.title: Remise: Authorized Anonymous Communication Systems
upstream_only.abstract: We present Remise, a two-server authorized anonymous communication system built on Distributed Oblivious RAM (DORAM). Remise supports two modes of operation: (i) an anonymous bulletin board, where messages are publicly revealed at the end of each epoch without linking senders to messages, and (ii) anonymous communication channels, where messages remain secret-shared, and writers selectively grant and revoke read access to chosen readers. In both modes, the two servers execute read and write operations without learning which indices are accessed, which authorization tokens are used, or which relationships exist between writers and readers, assuming no collusion between the servers. A central contribution of Remise is a lightweight and efficient access-control mechanism. Authorization tokens are maintained in secret-shared form across the two servers, enabling oblivious verification and updates, while preventing leakage even under client–server collusion. Unlike prior DPF-based systems, Remise provides built-in auditing by having the semi-honest servers generate standard-basis vector shares internally, eliminating the need for server-side DPF validity checks. We implement a prototype of Remise and evaluate it under realistic network conditions. Our experiments show an 80× improvement in online server time for request validity check when compared to PACL (IEEE S&P 2023) for large database size.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们提出了Remise，一个基于分布式不经意RAM（DORAM）的两服务器授权匿名通信系统。Remise支持两种操作模式：(i) 匿名公告板，消息在每个epoch结束时公开，但不将发送者与消息关联；(ii) 匿名通信通道，消息保持秘密共享，写入者可以选择性地授予和撤销选定读取者的读取权限。在这两种模式中，两个服务器执行读写操作时不会得知访问了哪些索引、使用了哪些授权令牌，或者在假设服务器之间不串通的情况下，写入者和读取者之间存在哪些关系。Remise的一个核心贡献是轻量级且高效的访问控制机制。授权令牌以秘密共享的形式在两个服务器上维护，从而实现不经意验证和更新，同时即使在客户端-服务器串通下也能防止泄漏。与先前的基于DPF的系统不同，Remise通过让半诚实服务器内部生成标准基向量份额来提供内置审计，从而消除了对服务器端DPF有效性检查的需求。我们实现了Remise的原型，并在真实网络条件下对其进行了评估。我们的实验表明，对于大型数据库大小，与PACL（IEEE S&P 2023）相比，请求有效性检查的在线服务器时间提高了80倍。

upstream_only.title: Sliced Rényi Pufferfish Privacy: Tractable Privatization Mechanism and Private Learning with Gradient Clipping
upstream_only.abstract: We study the design of a privatization mechanism and privacy accounting in the Pufferfish Privacy (PP) family. Specifically, motivated by the curse of dimensionality and lack of practical composition tools for iterative learning in the recent Rényi Pufferfish Privacy (RPP) framework, we propose Sliced Rényi Pufferfish Privacy (SRPP). SRPP preserves PP/RPP semantics (customizable secrets with probability-aware secret–dataset relationships) while replacing high-dimensional Rényi divergence with projection-based quantification via two sliced measures, Average SRPP and Joint SRPP. We develop sliced Wasserstein mechanisms, yielding sound SRPP certificates and closed-form Gaussian noise calibration. For iterative learning systems, we introduce an SRPP-SGD scheme with gradient clipping and new accountants based on History-Uniform Caps (HUC) and a subsampling-aware variant (sa-HUC), enabling decompose-then-compose privatization and additive composition under a common slicing geometry. Experiments on static and iterative privatization show that the proposed framework exhibits favorable privacy–utility trade-offs, as well as practical scalability.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们研究Pufferfish隐私（PP）族中私有化机制的设计和隐私核算。具体而言，受近期Rényi Pufferfish隐私（RPP）框架中维数灾难以及迭代学习缺乏实用组合工具的启发，我们提出切片Rényi Pufferfish隐私（SRPP）。SRPP保留PP/RPP语义（可定制秘密以及概率感知的秘密-数据集关系），同时通过两种切片度量（平均SRPP和联合SRPP）以基于投影的量化替代高维Rényi散度。我们开发切片Wasserstein机制，给出可靠的SRPP证书和闭式高斯噪声校准。对于迭代学习系统，我们引入带梯度裁剪的SRPP-SGD方案，以及基于历史均匀上限（HUC）和子采样感知变体（sa-HUC）的新核算器，从而在共同切片几何下实现先分解后组合的私有化和加性组合。静态和迭代私有化实验表明，所提框架展现出有利的隐私-效用权衡以及实际可扩展性。

upstream_only.title: sigma-rs: A Modular Approach for Keyed-Verification Anonymous Credentials
upstream_only.abstract:
We introduce a new software stack in Rust aimed at simplifying constructions and deployments of protocols based on modern anonymous credential systems.
The stack, called sigma-rs, through its layered design, abstracts cryptographic complexity while remaining flexible enough to support a range of credential schemes, proofs, and access policies. It emphasizes misuse resistance via type safety, domain separation, and prover-state discipline, and supports side-channel-aware constant-time strategies.
We evaluate practicality through re-implementations of Tor's Lox bridge distribution protocols and of user authentication in the Open Observatory for Network Interference.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们推出了一种新的Rust软件栈，旨在简化基于现代匿名凭证系统的协议的构建和部署。该软件栈名为sigma-rs，通过其分层设计抽象了密码学复杂性，同时保持足够的灵活性以支持一系列凭证方案、证明和访问策略。它通过类型安全、域分离和证明者状态纪律来强调防误用性，并支持侧信道感知的常数时间策略。我们通过重新实现Tor的Lox网桥分发协议以及开放网络干扰观测站（OONI）中的用户认证来评估其实用性。

upstream_only.title: A Cuckoo in the Nest: Multi‑Stage, Multi‑Identifier Hijacking in BACnet/SC
upstream_only.abstract: To address the well-known security limitations of legacy Building Automation and Control Network (BACnet), BACnet Secure Connect (BACnet/SC) introduces mutually authenticated WebSocket Secure (WSS) channels and mandates PKI-based certificate management. Despite these protections, we identify a fundamental identifier-binding failure in BACnet/SC's security model: X.509 certificate authentication is not cryptographically bound to the logical identifiers used for connection management (UUID) and message forwarding (VMAC). Through a systematic analysis of BACnet/SC connection state machines, we show that this decoupling enables a multi-stage, multi-identifier hijacking attack, in which malicious roles progressively displace a legitimate device's authenticated connection state and persistently intercept its traffic. We term this attack the Cuckoo Attack and validate it across the official BACnet/SC Reference Stack, the open-source BACnet-Stack, and commercial building automation platforms from major vendors, including Siemens, Johnson Controls, Honeywell, and Carrier. We further propose mitigation measures to address this vulnerability. Our findings provide the first systematic characterization of an authentication-identifier decoupling flaw in BACnet/SC, highlight a broader class of identifier-binding risks in stateful secure protocols, and have been presented to and acknowledged by ASHRAE SSPC 135, the standards committee responsible for BACnet.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 为解决传统楼宇自动化和控制网络（BACnet）众所周知的安全限制，BACnet安全连接（BACnet/SC）引入了相互认证的WebSocket安全（WSS）通道，并强制实施基于PKI的证书管理。尽管有这些保护措施，我们仍发现BACnet/SC安全模型中存在一个根本性的标识符绑定缺陷：X.509证书认证在密码学上并未绑定到用于连接管理（UUID）和消息转发（VMAC）的逻辑标识符。通过对BACnet/SC连接状态机进行系统分析，我们表明这种解耦使得一种多阶段、多标识符劫持攻击成为可能，其中恶意角色逐步取代合法设备的已认证连接状态并持续拦截其流量。我们将此攻击称为杜鹃攻击，并在官方BACnet/SC参考栈、开源BACnet-Stack以及来自主要厂商（包括西门子、江森自控、霍尼韦尔和开利）的商业楼宇自动化平台上进行了验证。我们进一步提出了缓解措施以解决此漏洞。我们的发现首次系统性地刻画了BACnet/SC中的认证-标识符解耦缺陷，揭示了有状态安全协议中更广泛的一类标识符绑定风险，并已提交给负责BACnet的标准委员会ASHRAE SSPC 135并获得其确认。

upstream_only.title: ARTO: Efficient Execution Integrity Attestation for Real-Time Operation of Cyber-Physical Systems
upstream_only.abstract: Real-time embedded systems are prevalent in cyber-physical applications such as drones and autonomous vehicles. Due to their high complexity, the environmental uncertainties, and the openness to remote control, these systems are vulnerable to control-flow hijacking and data-only attacks that compromise runtime integrity and reliability. Traditional control-flow integrity (CFI) and data-flow integrity (DFI) approaches impose excessive overhead, while the control-flow attestation (CFA) allows detection latency incompatible with real-time constraints. This paper presents ARTO, the first control-flow and data-flow protection approach that integrates the control-flow attestation to provide strong security with competitive runtime overhead. Through the prover-side path segmentation and hash-based validation result caching, ARTO provides partial context-sensitive protection at minimal runtime cost, offloading complete context-sensitive detection to the remote verifier. Furthermore, ARTO implements an equivalence-class-based data-flow protection that combines the address-based target check for memory reads with the value-based checks to protect critical variables, stronger than the SOTA operation integrity enforcement in validating the read source for critical variables. Extensive evaluations on robotic vehicle autopilots confirm ARTO's efficacy in mitigating both control-flow and data-only attacks while maintaining runtime overhead within real-time limits, outperforming SOTA CFA and operation-integrity enforcement methods in operation execution time.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 实时嵌入式系统广泛应用于无人机和自动驾驶汽车等信息物理应用中。由于其高度复杂性、环境不确定性以及远程控制的开放性，这些系统容易受到控制流劫持和仅数据攻击，从而危及运行时完整性和可靠性。传统的控制流完整性（CFI）和数据流完整性（DFI）方法开销过大，而控制流证明（CFA）的检测延迟与实时约束不兼容。本文提出ARTO，这是首个将控制流证明与数据流保护集成以提供强安全性且运行时开销具有竞争力的方法。通过证明方路径分段和基于哈希的验证结果缓存，ARTO以最小的运行时成本提供部分上下文敏感保护，将完整的上下文敏感检测卸载到远程验证方。此外，ARTO实现了基于等价类的数据流保护，将针对内存读取的基于地址的目标检查与基于值的检查相结合以保护关键变量，在验证关键变量的读取来源方面比最先进的操作完整性执行方法更强。对机器人车辆自动驾驶仪的广泛评估证实了ARTO在缓解控制流和仅数据攻击方面的有效性，同时将运行时开销保持在实时限制内，在操作执行时间上优于最先进的CFA和操作完整性执行方法。

upstream_only.title: BLE Theft Auto: Evaluating the Security of Aftermarket BLE-based Automotive Remote Control Systems
upstream_only.abstract: Vehicles are increasingly remotely controllable from smartphone apps that function like keyfobs: unlocking a vehicle's doors and even starting its engine. These systems use Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) for ofﬂine remote control. However, they do not use BLE's built-in security; instead they use proprietary application-layer protocols, introducing a new attack surface. This is especially concerning for aftermarket BLE remote control systems, because they have not received scrutiny by security researchers. In this paper, we evaluate feasible BLE-based attacks on aftermarket vehicle remote control systems. We discovered six aftermarket BLE remote control systems in use today, and analyzed their application-layer BLE security. We found critical vulnerabilities in three systems, exposing what we estimate to be 1.4 million aftermarket BLE control systems to attack. We show that targeted BLE remote attacks are practical: an attacker can use crowdsourced Bluetooth scanning databases to target speciﬁc vehicles with vulnerable systems installed. Our disclosures lead all vendors to patch improved app-layer BLE security into their systems, affecting many vehicle owners that did not even know they had a BLE remote control system installed.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 车辆正越来越多地可以通过功能类似钥匙扣的智能手机应用进行远程控制：解锁车门甚至启动发动机。这些系统使用低功耗蓝牙（BLE）进行离线远程控制。然而，它们并未使用BLE内置的安全机制；相反，它们使用专有的应用层协议，从而引入了新的攻击面。这对售后市场BLE远程控制系统尤其令人担忧，因为它们尚未受到安全研究人员的审视。在本文中，我们评估了对售后市场车辆远程控制系统可行的基于BLE的攻击。我们发现了目前正在使用的六种售后市场BLE远程控制系统，并分析了它们的应用层BLE安全性。我们在三个系统中发现了严重漏洞，据我们估计，这使约140万个售后市场BLE控制系统面临攻击。我们表明，针对性的BLE远程攻击是可行的：攻击者可以使用众包蓝牙扫描数据库来定位安装了易受攻击系统的特定车辆。我们的披露促使所有供应商将其系统修补为改进的应用层BLE安全，影响了许多甚至不知道自己安装了BLE远程控制系统的车主。

upstream_only.title: Lost in Encapsulation: Exploiting Open Tunnelling Hosts and Attacking Private Networks
upstream_only.abstract:
Tunnelling protocols form an essential backbone of today's Internet, where they primarily interconnect remote networks. However, many tunnelling hosts do not implement authentication, making them behave as open one-way proxies and, in turn, introducing denial-of-service (DoS) risks. 
In this paper, we show that the security risk of open tunnelling hosts extends beyond DoS attacks. First, we study NAT-enabled tunnelling hosts and demonstrate a novel attack that manipulates the NAT's TCP state, enabling an attacker to fingerprint and inject traffic into the co-located private network. We also study tunnelling hosts that translate global IP addresses, and turn them into two-way proxies. We demonstrate how these two-way proxies enable an attacker to: (1) spoof TCP connections; and (2) launch a novel loop DoS attack. Additionally, we show that Layer 2 (L2) tunnelling hosts, specifically GRETAP, can be abused to attack the LAN, and we demonstrate the impact with 5 attacks: leaking the host's global and private MAC addresses, DHCP starvation, DNS poisoning, ARP spoofing, and an infinite loop DoS attack. 
To evaluate the prevalence of vulnerable hosts, we conduct 9 Internet-wide scans and identify that 438,280 hosts are potentially vulnerable. Overall, we show that open tunnelling protocols enable new attacks on co-located private networks, and we hope our work encourages the adoption of new defences.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 隧道协议构成了当今互联网的重要骨干，主要用于互连远程网络。然而，许多隧道主机未实现身份验证，使其表现为开放的单向代理，进而引入拒绝服务（DoS）风险。在本文中，我们表明开放隧道主机的安全风险不仅限于DoS攻击。首先，我们研究启用NAT的隧道主机，并展示了一种新型攻击，该攻击操纵NAT的TCP状态，使攻击者能够对同地私有网络进行指纹识别并注入流量。我们还研究了转换全局IP地址的隧道主机，并将其变为双向代理。我们展示了这些双向代理如何使攻击者能够：(1) 欺骗TCP连接；(2) 发动一种新型循环DoS攻击。此外，我们表明二层（L2）隧道主机，特别是GRETAP，可被滥用来攻击局域网，并通过5种攻击展示其影响：泄露主机的全局和私有MAC地址、DHCP耗尽、DNS投毒、ARP欺骗以及无限循环DoS攻击。为了评估易受攻击主机的普遍性，我们进行了9次全网扫描，并识别出438,280台潜在易受攻击的主机。总体而言，我们表明开放隧道协议能够对同地私有网络发起新攻击，并希望我们的工作能促进新防御措施的采用。

upstream_only.title: TED: Abusing Tunnel Hosts and IPv6 Extension Headers for Pulsing DoS Attacks
upstream_only.abstract: IP tunneling mechanisms are widely deployed to facilitate the Internet's transition from IPv4 to IPv6, yet their security implications remain insufficiently scrutinized. In this paper, we present TED, a novel pulsing denial-of-service attack that exploits structural vulnerabilities in IP tunneling and IPv6 Extension Headers (EHs) processing. Unlike prior reflection attacks that depend on application-layer services, TED operates entirely at the network layer, requiring no victim interaction, prolonged traffic accumulation, or protocol-specific dependencies. Delay lines are constructed by TED through nested EHs, capitalizing on the tunnel hosts' blind forwarding logic and lack of deep packet inspection. These artificial delay lines allow attackers to solve the send-time schedule problem, converging asynchronous, low-rate traffic into a destructive, high-magnitude pulse at the victim. Our Internet-wide measurement identified over 1.9 million vulnerable tunnel hosts acting as unwitting relays, including hosts within critical satellite infrastructure. Evaluation results demonstrate that TED achieves normalized pulse amplitude exceeding 180× while successfully evading existing low-rate and pulsing attack detection mechanisms based on specific application layer protocols. We discuss the root causes of these transitional vulnerabilities and possible mitigation strategies for network operators and equipment vendors.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: IP隧道机制被广泛部署以促进互联网从IPv4向IPv6的过渡，然而其安全影响仍未得到充分审视。在本文中，我们提出TED，一种新颖的脉冲式拒绝服务攻击，它利用IP隧道和IPv6扩展首部（EH）处理中的结构性漏洞。与先前依赖应用层服务的反射攻击不同，TED完全在网络层运行，不需要受害者交互、长时间流量累积或协议特定依赖。TED通过嵌套EH构造延迟线，利用隧道主机的盲目转发逻辑和缺乏深度包检测。这些人工延迟线使攻击者能够解决发送时间调度问题，将异步的低速率流量汇聚成对受害者的破坏性高幅度脉冲。我们的互联网范围测量识别出超过190万台易受攻击的隧道主机作为不知情的中继，包括关键卫星基础设施内的主机。评估结果表明，TED实现了超过180倍的归一化脉冲幅度，同时成功规避了基于特定应用层协议的现有低速率和脉冲攻击检测机制。我们讨论了这些过渡性漏洞的根本原因以及网络运营商和设备供应商可能的缓解策略。

upstream_only.title: Toward Understanding the Security Implications in Python Configuration Files
upstream_only.abstract: Security incidents targeting open-source software have increased substantially in recent years, yet existing defenses primarily focus on analyzing source code while largely overlooking configuration files that define how software is built, installed, and executed. In this paper, we present an in-depth study of security risks in Python configuration files, analyzing five widely used formats across the project lifecycle. We focus on risks that exploit configuration files to silently redirect dependency resolution to attacker-controlled infrastructure or hijack benign commands. We design an automated framework and identify 39 configuration fields that can be exploited under realistic usage scenarios. We further demonstrate that existing malware detection tools fail to detect most of these risks. As mitigation, we develop ConfigScoper, which not only examines security-relevant fields but also employs multiple vulnerability detectors to identify potential malicious behaviors. We apply ConfigScoper in a measurement study analyzing millions of open-source Python projects on GitHub, and our empirical results show that exploitable risks already exist in real-world projects. Finally, we have responsibly disclosed the identified vulnerabilities to relevant stakeholders.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 近年来，针对开源软件的安全事件大幅增加，然而现有防御主要集中于分析源代码，而很大程度上忽略了定义软件如何构建、安装和执行的配置文件。本文对Python配置文件中的安全风险进行了深入研究，分析了项目生命周期中五种广泛使用的格式。我们关注利用配置文件将依赖解析静默重定向到攻击者控制的基础设施或劫持良性命令的风险。我们设计了一个自动化框架，并识别出在现实使用场景中可被利用的39个配置字段。我们进一步证明，现有恶意软件检测工具无法检测出其中大多数风险。作为缓解措施，我们开发了ConfigScoper，它不仅检查与安全相关的字段，还采用多个漏洞检测器来识别潜在恶意行为。我们将ConfigScoper应用于一项测量研究，分析了GitHub上数百万个开源Python项目，实证结果表明可被利用的风险已存在于现实项目中。最后，我们负责任地向相关利益相关者披露了所识别的漏洞。

upstream_only.title: FRAGJAM: DoS Attacks Using IP Reassembly Congestion
upstream_only.abstract:
UDP, one of the major transport protocols for multiple popular services such as DNS and video conferencing, is an important component of today's network. Its reliance on IP fragmentation is known to cause both security and reliability issues. To avoid fragmentation, UDP-based applications hence usually limit the payload size. Currently, Linux's IP fragment reassembling algorithm relies on a per-network-namespace buffer size limit. That is, a classic resource-exhaustion DoS attack against UDP services relying on IP fragmentation is possible. However, the fragility of present real-world services has not yet been thoroughly researched.
In this paper, we examine the practicability of such an IP-fragmentation-based DoS attack against real-world providers of popular UDP-based services, including VPN, video conferencing, and RADIUS. We assess the attack from both the client and service provider perspectives. On the server side, we observe that many real-world service providers fragment the server-to-client traffic with respect to artificially small path MTUs when receiving attacker forged ICMP Fragmentation Needed messages. On the client side, we show the chance of dropping server-to-client fragmented traffic by flooding Linux-based NAT gateways with bogus fragments. Through simulated attacks, we demonstrate that the fragmentation-based DoS attack is realistic, affecting various providers such as Zoom and ExpressVPN. We conduct a comprehensive disclosure to affected parties and suggest possible mitigations.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: UDP是DNS和视频会议等多种流行服务的主要传输协议之一，是当今网络的重要组成部分。其依赖IP分片已知会导致安全性和可靠性问题。为了避免分片，基于UDP的应用程序通常限制有效载荷大小。目前，Linux的IP分片重组算法依赖于每个网络命名空间的缓冲区大小限制。也就是说，针对依赖IP分片的UDP服务的经典资源耗尽型DoS攻击是可能的。然而，现实世界中服务的脆弱性尚未得到彻底研究。在本文中，我们研究了这种基于IP分片的DoS攻击对现实世界中流行UDP服务（包括VPN、视频会议和RADIUS）提供商的可行性。我们从客户端和服务提供商两个角度评估该攻击。在服务器端，我们观察到许多现实世界服务提供商在收到攻击者伪造的ICMP分片需要（Fragmentation Needed）消息时，会以人为缩小的路径MTU来分片服务器到客户端的流量。在客户端，我们展示了通过用伪造分片洪泛基于Linux的NAT网关来丢弃服务器到客户端分片流量的可能性。通过模拟攻击，我们证明基于分片的DoS攻击是现实的，影响Zoom和ExpressVPN等各种提供商。我们向受影响方进行了全面披露，并提出了可能的缓解措施。

upstream_only.title: Download More RAM: Dismantling Windows Operating System Defences with Mischievous Memory
upstream_only.abstract: Virtualisation-Based Security (VBS) is the cornerstone of modern Windows desktop defences, relied upon by both the operating system and third-party software, with a virtualised secure kernel providing strong security guarantees against even privileged attackers. In this paper, we introduce Download More RAM, software-only memory aliasing attack that breaks these guarantees without physical access. On systems running the most common consumer DIMMs, our attack allows arbitrary memory read/write, letting a privileged user compromise the OS at every level, including the secure kernel, Hypervisor Enforced Code Integrity (HVCI), and all defences it provides. With this access we develop a series of case study attacks targeting VBS-protected processes, Windows Defender, anti-virus & EDR software, and game anti-cheats. Our work breaks the strongest security guarantees offered by the Windows OS, questioning key trust assumptions on such systems. Microsoft have assigned CVE-2026-23670 to our findings and issued a patch that partially mitigates our attack.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 基于虚拟化的安全（VBS）是现代Windows桌面防御的基石，操作系统和第三方软件都依赖它，其虚拟化安全内核即使面对特权攻击者也能提供强大的安全保证。在本文中，我们提出了“下载更多RAM”（Download More RAM），一种纯软件的内存别名攻击，无需物理访问即可破坏这些保证。在运行最常见消费级DIMM的系统上，我们的攻击允许任意内存读写，使特权用户能够在各个层面攻破操作系统，包括安全内核、虚拟机监控程序强制代码完整性（HVCI）及其提供的所有防御。利用这种访问权限，我们开发了一系列案例研究攻击，针对受VBS保护的进程、Windows Defender、杀毒软件与EDR软件以及游戏反作弊系统。我们的工作打破了Windows操作系统提供的最强安全保证，质疑了此类系统上的关键信任假设。微软已为我们的发现分配了CVE-2026-23670，并发布了一个部分缓解我们攻击的补丁。

upstream_only.title: Secpoline: A Scalable Approach to Build Secure In-Process Syscall Interposers
upstream_only.abstract:
In-process system call interposers are increasingly used to extend or monitor application functionality without context-switching or inter-process communication (IPC) overhead. However, when embedded inside untrusted applications, existing solutions face a trade-off: they either enforce no isolation at all, or impose severe restrictions on the monitor's isolated programming environment that are incompatible with complex, real-world use cases.
This paper presents Secpoline, a new interposition platform that allows in-process monitors to support arbitrary interposer functionality without compromising isolation. Secpoline achieves this via isolated multi-program loading and a novel meta-monitor design that interposes the monitor itself to emulate a seamless programming environment. In addition, Secpoline implements the first fully self-contained in-process sandbox to harden its own isolation primitive, while preserving fast-path syscall interposition with zero kernel involvement.
Our evaluation shows that Secpoline matches the efficiency of state-of-the-art secure in-process interposers while enabling a significantly more expressive programming environment. We specifically demonstrate this by implementing a kernel-module-free version of the Falco intrusion detection engine. We also implement an in-process ProxySQL sidecar, embedded directly into the application process, where Secpoline transparently provides a kernel-bypass communication path to increase throughput by roughly 50%. These results confirm that Secpoline finally delivers on the promise of secure, complex application monitoring at in-process speeds.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 进程内系统调用拦截器越来越多地被用于扩展或监控应用程序功能，同时避免上下文切换或进程间通信（IPC）开销。然而，当嵌入到不可信应用程序中时，现有解决方案面临一种权衡：它们要么完全不实施隔离，要么对监控器的隔离编程环境施加与复杂现实用例不兼容的严格限制。本文提出了Secpoline，一种新的拦截平台，允许进程内监控器在不损害隔离性的情况下支持任意拦截器功能。Secpoline通过隔离的多程序加载以及一种新颖的元监控器设计来实现这一点，该设计拦截监控器本身以模拟无缝编程环境。此外，Secpoline实现了首个完全自包含的进程内沙箱来加固其自身的隔离原语，同时保持零内核参与的快速路径系统调用拦截。我们的评估表明，Secpoline在保持与最先进的安全进程内拦截器相同效率的同时，提供了显著更具表达力的编程环境。我们通过实现一个无需内核模块的Falco入侵检测引擎版本具体证明了这一点。我们还实现了一个直接嵌入应用程序进程的进程内ProxySQL边车，其中Secpoline透明地提供内核旁路通信路径，使吞吐量提高约50%。这些结果证实，Secpoline最终兑现了以进程内速度进行安全、复杂应用程序监控的承诺。

upstream_only.title: SoK: Capability Operating Systems: Is the Future Finally Here?
upstream_only.abstract: Capability operating systems have existed for six decades, yet we do not have a systematic way to compare them and their different design aspects. We even lack a consensus on the purpose of capabilities in these systems. Given the recent resurgence of interest in capability systems in different domains, we provide a definition of such systems and a set of characteristics to describe and distinguish them. Applying our characteristics to seminal capability systems, we then provide a taxonomy of fundamental design approaches that emerged over the last sixty years. Our results lead us to discuss further research in this field and highlight open challenges in creating pure object-capability systems.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 能力操作系统已经存在了六十年，但我们还没有一种系统化的方法来比较它们及其不同的设计方面。我们甚至对这些系统中能力的目的缺乏共识。鉴于近来在不同领域对能力系统的兴趣重新兴起，我们提供了此类系统的定义以及一组用于描述和区分它们的特征。将我们的特征应用于开创性的能力系统，我们提供了过去六十年中出现的基本设计方法的分类学。我们的结果促使我们讨论该领域的进一步研究，并强调创建纯对象能力系统中的开放挑战。

upstream_only.title: Enjoy the Free Lunch, Someone Paid for Us: Escaping Resource Limits of MicroVM-based Containers
upstream_only.abstract:
MicroVM-based containers are increasingly deployed in public clouds (e.g., AWS, Azure, and Alibaba Cloud) to combine container efficiency with strong isolation. However, we demonstrate that microVM-based architectures introduce a new class of resource accounting vulnerabilities which cause discrepancies between the physical resources consumed by a guest and the resource usage accounted by the host. To systematically uncover such issues, we propose a resource accounting analysis framework that examines accounting inconsistencies across both memory and storage subsystems. Using this framework, we identify three easily exploitable attack vectors: (i) writable memory accounting evasion via shared file-backed mappings, (ii) read-only memory accounting evasion via private file-backed mappings, and (iii) a storage accounting evasion that enables unbounded disk consumption through unmonitored file paths.
We further combine these attack vectors into FREE (File-based Resource Expansion & Exploitation), a consolidated attack that freely inflates both memory and storage usage while evading associated resource accounting and billings. We also present a practical attack implementation capable of seamless integration into real-world applications, leveraging a custom dynamic shared library that transparently redirects standard allocations (e.g., malloc) to unaccounted file-backed mappings. We validate the feasibility of the FREE attack on MicroVM-based containers deployed in AWS, Azure and Alibaba Cloud, and use a billing evaluation model to quantify the economic profit of adversarial tenants. Our evaluation demonstrates that FREE can reduce the attacker's billed cost to 42.12% (Kata) and 41.93% (Firecracker) of the original payment. FREE can also be used to degrade the performance of co-located tenants, including up to 57.1% reduction in memory bandwidth and 67.06% loss in I/O throughput.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 基于MicroVM的容器正越来越多地部署在公有云（如AWS、Azure和阿里云）中，以结合容器的效率与强隔离。然而，我们证明基于MicroVM的架构引入了一类新的资源计量漏洞，导致客户机消耗的物理资源与宿主机计量的资源使用量之间存在差异。为了系统性地发现此类问题，我们提出了一个资源计量分析框架，用于检查内存和存储子系统中的计量不一致性。利用该框架，我们识别出三个易于利用的攻击向量：(i) 通过共享的文件后备映射逃逸可写内存计量；(ii) 通过私有的文件后备映射逃逸只读内存计量；(iii) 一种存储计量逃逸，可通过未监控的文件路径实现无限制的磁盘消耗。我们进一步将这些攻击向量组合成FREE（基于文件的资源扩展与利用），这是一种综合攻击，可在逃避相关资源计量和计费的同时，自由膨胀内存和存储使用量。我们还提出了一种实用的攻击实现，能够无缝集成到真实应用中，利用自定义的动态共享库透明地将标准分配（例如malloc）重定向到未计量的文件后备映射。我们在AWS、Azure和阿里云部署的基于MicroVM的容器上验证了FREE攻击的可行性，并使用计费评估模型量化了恶意租户的经济收益。我们的评估表明，FREE可以将攻击者的计费成本降至原费用的42.12%（Kata）和41.93%（Firecracker）。FREE还可用于降低共置租户的性能，包括内存带宽最多降低57.1%和I/O吞吐量损失67.06%。

upstream_only.title: Plaintext Recovery Against Post-Filtering Access Control
upstream_only.abstract:
Fine-grained access control (FGAC) mechanisms such as row-level security (RLS) and document-level security (DLS) are widely deployed in databases to restrict access to data stored in physical indexing structures shared by multiple users (e.g., in multi-tenant databases, or in the implementation of least-privilege within an organization). FGAC implementations often use post-filtering where untrusted queries run over all data and private results are redacted afterwards. Prior work shows this approach can lead to side-channels that enable attackers to test if a chosen value exists in unseen data. While damaging, prior attacks do not enable the efficient recovery of rich, high-entropy data like full records or text documents.
We show these side-channels are more damaging than previously thought. Using rich query interfaces (e.g., range, prefix, and conjunctive predicates), we amplify existence leakage into reconstruction attacks. We do this in two settings:

PostgreSQL (RLS timing). We exploit a timing side-channel and expressive SQL queries (e.g., ranges, conjunctions) to enumerate unknown attribute values and, in turn, full records via binary search over large domains.
Elasticsearch/OpenSearch (DLS scoring). We exploit scoring and prefix-expansion side-channels to recover indexed terms from documents. In some cases, we can extract n-grams in the corpus to recover approximate text.

Our results show that FGAC side-channels must be evaluated in the presence of rich predicates, which can turn membership tests into scalable reconstruction of high-entropy records.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 细粒度访问控制（FGAC）机制，如行级安全（RLS）和文档级安全（DLS），广泛部署在数据库中，用于限制对存储在多个用户共享的物理索引结构中的数据的访问（例如，在多租户数据库中，或在组织内实现最小权限）。FGAC实现通常使用后过滤，即不受信任的查询在所有数据上运行，随后对私有结果进行脱敏。先前工作表明，这种方法可能导致侧信道，使攻击者能够测试所选值是否存在于未见数据中。虽然具有破坏性，但先前的攻击无法高效恢复丰富的高熵数据，如完整记录或文本文档。我们表明，这些侧信道的破坏性比之前认为的更大。利用丰富的查询接口（例如范围、前缀和合取谓词），我们将存在性泄漏放大为重构攻击。我们在两种设置中实现了这一点：PostgreSQL（RLS计时）。我们利用计时侧信道和表达性SQL查询（例如范围、合取），通过在大域上进行二分搜索来枚举未知属性值，进而枚举完整记录。Elasticsearch/OpenSearch（DLS评分）。我们利用评分和前缀扩展侧信道，从文档中恢复索引词项。在某些情况下，我们可以提取语料库中的n-gram以恢复近似文本。我们的结果表明，必须在存在丰富谓词的情况下评估FGAC侧信道，因为丰富谓词可以将成员测试转变为对高熵记录的可扩展重构。

upstream_only.title: PICASSO: Scaling CHERI Use-After-Free Protection to Millions of Allocations using Colored Capabilities
upstream_only.abstract:
While the CHERI instruction-set architecture extensions for capabilities enable strong spatial memory safety, CHERI lacks built-in temporal safety, particularly for heap allocations. Prior attempts to augment CHERI with temporal safety fall short in terms of scalability, memory overhead, and incomplete security guarantees due to periodical sweeps of the system's memory to individually revoke stale capabilities.
We address these limitations by introducing colored capabilities that add a controlled form of indirection to CHERI's capability model. This enables provenance tracking of capabilities to their respective allocations via a hardware-managed provenance-validity table, allowing bulk retraction of dangling pointers without needing to quarantine freed memory. Colored capabilities significantly reduce the frequency of capability revocation sweeps while improving security.
We realize colored capabilities in PICASSO, an extension of the CHERI-RISC-V architecture on a speculative out-of-order FPGA softcore (CHERI-Toooba). We also integrate colored-capability support into the CheriBSD OS and CHERI-enabled Clang/LLVM toolchain. Our evaluation shows effective mitigation of use-after-free and double-free bugs across all heap-based temporal memory-safety vulnerabilities in NIST Juliet test cases, real-world CVEs, only a small performance overhead on SPEC CPU benchmarks (≈ 5% g.m.), less latency, and more consistent performance in long-running SQLite, PostgreSQL, and gRPC workloads compared to prior work.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 虽然CHERI指令集架构的能力扩展实现了强空间内存安全，但CHERI缺乏内置的时间安全，尤其是对堆分配而言。此前为CHERI增加时间安全的尝试因需要周期性扫描系统内存以逐个撤销过期能力，在可扩展性、内存开销和完整安全保证方面存在不足。我们通过引入带色能力（colored capabilities）来解决这些限制，它们为CHERI的能力模型增加了一种受控的间接形式。这通过硬件管理来源有效性表，实现能力到各自分配的来源跟踪，从而无需隔离已释放内存即可批量撤回悬空指针。带色能力显著降低了能力撤销扫描的频率，同时提高了安全性。我们在PICASSO中实现了带色能力，这是CHERI-RISC-V架构在推测性乱序FPGA软核（CHERI-Toooba）上的扩展。我们还将带色能力支持集成到CheriBSD操作系统和启用CHERI的Clang/LLVM工具链中。我们的评估表明，在NIST Juliet测试用例中所有基于堆的时间内存安全漏洞、真实世界CVE中，有效缓解了释放后使用和双重释放错误，在SPEC CPU基准测试中仅带来较小性能开销（约5%几何平均），与先前工作相比，在长时间运行的SQLite、PostgreSQL和gRPC工作负载中延迟更低且性能更一致。

upstream_only.title: Trust Nothing: RTOS Security without Run-Time Software TCB
upstream_only.abstract:
Embedded devices face an ever-expanding threat landscape: vulnerabilities in application software, operating system kernels, and peripherals threaten the embedded device integrity. Existing computer-architectural defenses fully consider at most two of these threat vectors in their security model.
This paper aims at addressing this gap using a novel capability architecture. To this end, we combine a token capability approach suitable for building an untrusted operating system with protection against malicious devices without requiring hardware changes to peripherals.
First, we develop and evaluate a full FPGA implementation of our capability architecture around legacy hardware components. Further, we present a soft real-time operating system based on Zephyr that has no run-time software TCB. To this end, we disaggregate Zephyr's subsystems into small, mutually isolated components. All subsystems that exist at run time, including scheduler, allocator and DMA drivers, and all peripherals are fully untrusted. We believe that our work offers a foundation for more rigorous security-by-design in tomorrow's security-critical embedded devices.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 嵌入式设备面临不断扩大的威胁格局：应用软件、操作系统内核和外设中的漏洞威胁着嵌入式设备的完整性。现有的计算机体系结构防御在其安全模型中最多只考虑其中两个威胁向量。本文旨在利用一种新颖的能力架构来弥补这一空白。为此，我们将一种适用于构建不可信操作系统的令牌能力方法与针对恶意设备的防护相结合，且无需对硬件外设进行更改。首先，我们围绕传统硬件组件开发并评估了我们能力架构的完整FPGA实现。此外，我们提出了一种基于Zephyr的软实时操作系统，其没有任何运行时软件TCB。为此，我们将Zephyr的子系统分解为小型、相互隔离的组件。所有运行时存在的子系统，包括调度器、分配器和DMA驱动程序，以及所有外设，都是完全不可信的。我们相信，我们的工作为未来安全关键嵌入式设备中更严格的安全设计奠定了基础。

upstream_only.title: How Can We Have Private Access to Intelligence?
upstream_only.abstract:
Our interactions with AI models are getting more intimate. It started out with chat, where we voluntarily shared specifics. Now agents are always on and always listening. Today, all context flows through cloud servers in plaintext, accessible to model providers, hackers, and governments. Digital privacy now effectively means protecting your brain.

This talk examines the paths to private AI. Fully homomorphic encryption offers mathematical elegance but remains impractical for frontier-scale inference. However, secure hardware primitives are practical today and will take us very far in accomplishing the goal of building a verifiably private infrastructure for AI. Based on lessons from deploying confidential inference serving billions of tokens daily, I'll chart why this matters now, and how secure hardware, combined with transparency logs, and open-source verification, can make private AI the default.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们与AI模型的交互正变得越来越私密。它始于聊天，我们自愿分享具体信息。如今，代理始终在线并始终倾听。今天，所有上下文都以明文形式流经云服务器，模型提供商、黑客和政府都可以访问。数字隐私现在实际上意味着保护你的大脑。本次演讲探讨通往私有AI的路径。全同态加密提供了数学上的优雅，但对于前沿规模的推理仍然不实用。然而，安全硬件原语在今天已经实用，并且将在实现构建可验证私密AI基础设施这一目标方面带我们走得很远。基于每天服务数十亿token的机密推理部署经验，我将阐述为何这现在很重要，以及安全硬件结合透明度日志和开源验证如何能使私有AI成为默认选项。

upstream_only.title: Cryptography at Scale: Building a Practical Cryptographic Inventory for Risk, Compliance, and Post‑Quantum Readiness
upstream_only.abstract: Large organizations depend on cryptography for security and compliance with existing standards yet often lack a reliable understanding of where cryptographic assets actually exist. "Assets", like, certificates, keys, algorithms, and protocols are scattered across source code, network traffic, infrastructure, and third‑party systems, frequently managed by different teams. This lack of visibility makes it difficult to assess cryptographic risk and create a well-informed plan to migrate to newer quantum-resistant algorithms. Post-quantum readiness largely depends on what we can observe – we cannot fix cryptography that we cannot see. This talk presents XIPHER, a scalable approach to cryptographic inventory. We discuss XIPHER as a methodology and a suite of tools that can build scalable inventory of cryptographic assets to help with current and future compliance with encryption standards.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大型组织依赖密码学来实现安全并满足现有标准，但往往无法可靠地了解密码资产实际存在于何处。证书、密钥、算法和协议等“资产”分散在源代码、网络流量、基础设施和第三方系统中，并且常常由不同团队管理。这种缺乏可见性的状况使得评估密码风险以及制定向新型抗量子算法迁移的明智计划变得困难。后量子就绪在很大程度上取决于我们能够观察到什么——我们无法修复看不见的密码学。本报告介绍 XIPHER，一种可扩展的密码资产清单构建方法。我们将 XIPHER 讨论为一种方法论和一套工具，能够构建可扩展的密码资产清单，以帮助满足当前和未来对加密标准的合规要求。

upstream_only.title: What Is a PUF and Why Might You Need One?
upstream_only.abstract: How does a chip prove its identity? As networked IoT devices and AI clusters increasingly handle and transmit sensitive data, strong device authentication has become more central to commodity hardware design. Physical Unclonable Functions (PUFs) are one way of providing unique device identifiers, leveraging natural variations in the manufacturing process to create a "silicon fingerprint." By tracing PUFs from their origins in smart card security to their emerging role in data centre silicon, I will explain what PUFs uniquely offer and why these properties matter: from device physics, to attacks on OTP memory and implementation challenges.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 芯片如何证明自己的身份？随着联网的物联网设备和AI集群越来越多地处理和传输敏感数据，强设备认证已成为商用硬件设计的核心。物理不可克隆函数（PUF）是提供唯一设备标识符的一种方式，它利用制造过程中的自然变异来创建“硅指纹”。通过追溯PUF从智能卡安全中的起源到其在数据中心芯片中的新兴作用，我将解释PUF独特地提供了什么以及为什么这些特性很重要：从设备物理，到对OTP存储器的攻击和实现挑战。

upstream_only.title: Security and Privacy Considerations for Confirming Payments in Rwandan Mobile Money Systems
upstream_only.abstract: Mobile money (MoMo) services let users pay individual merchants or businesses using either a smartphone or a basic phone. They are widely used for commerce in African countries, including Rwanda. To better understand the security and privacy aspects of how Rwandan businesses confirm MoMo payments in practice, we interviewed 30 Rwandan business owners and employees. While MoMo services send payment confirmations over SMS to both senders (customers) and recipients (merchants), we found that merchants often inspect confirmation messages on customers' phones, not their own. The reasons included confirmation messages being sent only to business owners' (not employees') phones, busy markets, phones being physically unavailable, and delayed SMS delivery. Trust also played a major role. As the customer controls their phone, this workaround can enable fraud via screenshots of past messages or spoofed confirmations. As these confirmation messages include customers' account balances, participants also reported privacy concerns. In response, we investigated the design space of alternative workflows, finding promise in redesigning customers' confirmation screens to remove private information and to add a secret known only to the merchant. We reflect on designing for security and privacy under the unique constraints of Sub-Saharan Africa.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 移动货币（MoMo）服务让用户可以使用智能手机或基础手机向个体商户或企业付款。它们在包括卢旺达在内的非洲国家的商业中被广泛使用。为了更好地理解卢旺达企业实际确认MoMo付款的安全和隐私方面，我们采访了30位卢旺达企业主和员工。虽然MoMo服务通过短信向发送方（客户）和接收方（商户）发送付款确认，但我们发现商户经常查看客户手机上的确认消息，而不是自己的手机。原因包括确认消息仅发送到企业主（而非员工）的手机、市场繁忙、手机物理上不可用以及短信延迟。信任也起了重要作用。由于客户控制着自己的手机，这种变通方法可能通过过往消息的截图或伪造确认来促成欺诈。由于这些确认消息包含客户的账户余额，参与者还报告了隐私担忧。作为回应，我们研究了替代工作流程的设计空间，发现重新设计客户的确认屏幕以移除私人信息并添加仅商户知道的秘密是有前景的。我们反思了在撒哈拉以南非洲独特约束下进行安全和隐私设计的问题。

upstream_only.title: Cross-National Information Attacks: A Two-Decade Analysis of Troll Behavior in Korea
upstream_only.abstract: Coordinated foreign influence operations pose a growing threat to online platforms, but detecting state-linked troll activity and tracking its evolution remain challenging. This paper presents an explainable machine learning framework for theory-guided detection and longitudinal analysis of suspected trolling within Korean online news comment sections. Our hierarchical model classifies comments along three dimensions central to influence campaigns: foreign origin, moral-emotional framing, and target country. To support explainability, it also extracts brief span-level textual evidence that provides human-interpretable rationales. We apply the approach to 112M South Korean news comments authored by 4M users over nearly 20 years, identifying 23,998 accounts exhibiting behavior consistent with coordinated manipulation. Analyzing these accounts, we find that they predominantly rely on morally condemning rhetoric rather than direct promotion of foreign-aligned narratives; this rhetoric receives significantly higher user engagement. Among the highest-engagement comments, the moral condemnation most frequently targets domestic political figures (e.g., presidents or party leaders) on both the left and the right, potentially amplifying polarization. Our framework supports transparent platform governance through explainable, evidence-based moderation. These observed rhetorical and engagement patterns can inform how platforms and observatories prioritize defenses and intervene before harmful narrative-target combinations achieve widespread reach.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 协调性的外国影响力行动对在线平台构成日益严重的威胁，但检测与国家相关的网络喷子活动并追踪其演变仍然具有挑战性。本文提出了一个可解释的机器学习框架，用于在韩国在线新闻评论区中，进行理论指导的检测和纵向分析疑似网络喷子行为。我们的分层模型从影响力行动核心的三个维度对评论进行分类：外国来源、道德-情感框架和目标国家。为支持可解释性，该模型还提取简短的片段级文本证据，提供人类可理解的依据。我们将该方法应用于近20年间由400万用户撰写的1.12亿条韩国新闻评论，识别出23,998个表现出与协调操纵一致行为的账户。分析这些账户，我们发现它们主要依赖道德谴责修辞，而非直接推广与外国一致的叙事；这种修辞获得了显著更高的用户参与度。在参与度最高的评论中，道德谴责最常针对左翼和右翼的国内政治人物（如总统或政党领袖），可能加剧两极分化。我们的框架通过可解释、基于证据的审核，支持透明的平台治理。这些观察到的修辞和参与模式可以为平台和观察机构如何优先安排防御措施、并在有害叙事-目标组合获得广泛传播之前进行干预提供信息。

upstream_only.title: Exploring Privacy Negotiation Strategies for Camera-Equipped Smart Home Devices in Airbnb
upstream_only.abstract: Privacy conflicts among multiple users are prevalent in smart environments. To address such conflicts and mitigate the privacy concerns of bystanders, privacy negotiation has been proposed as a promising approach. Yet it remains unclear what makes such negotiations accessible to tenants. In this paper, using camera-equipped smart devices in Airbnb as a case, we explored different privacy negotiation strategies to shed light on future designs to support such actions. We developed 24 storyboards varying four factors, including device types (e.g., driveway camera, video conferencing device for TVs, smart display device), negotiation initiators (host vs. tenant), strategies (physical adjustment vs. monetary compensation), and outcomes (accepted vs. declined). Then, using a vignette survey study (N = 400), we find that device type and strategy significantly shape evaluations: physical adjustment was consistently preferred over monetary compensation, and driveway camera negotiations were evaluated more favorably than those involving indoor devices (video conferencing device for TVs, smart display device). We summarize design implications to support privacy negotiations.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在智能环境中，多用户之间的隐私冲突普遍存在。为了解决此类冲突并减轻旁观者的隐私担忧，隐私协商已被提出作为一种有前景的方法。然而，目前尚不清楚如何使这种协商对租户而言是可行的。本文以Airbnb中配备摄像头的智能设备为例，探索了不同的隐私协商策略，以期为未来支持此类行动的设计提供启示。我们开发了24个故事板，变化了四个因素，包括设备类型（例如，车道摄像头、用于电视的视频会议设备、智能显示设备）、协商发起者（房东 vs. 租户）、策略（物理调整 vs. 金钱补偿）以及结果（接受 vs. 拒绝）。然后，通过一项小插图调查研究（N = 400），我们发现设备类型和策略显著影响评估：物理调整始终比金钱补偿更受青睐，并且车道摄像头协商比涉及室内设备（用于电视的视频会议设备、智能显示设备）的协商得到更积极的评价。我们总结了支持隐私协商的设计启示。

upstream_only.title: Selling the Dream: How Intimate Insiders and Identity-Based Attackers Disrupt Micro-businesses
upstream_only.abstract:
Micro-businesses represent the majority of all businesses, and act as vehicles to economic freedom for many at-risk population groups. At the risk of falling behind, many microbusiness owners (MBOs) increasingly adopt platforms as their primary infrastructure, and rely heavily on recruiting friends, families, and even romantic partners for running essential operations. Despite these facts, most prior work has focused on larger corporations and enterprise cybersecurity hygiene, ignoring the cybersecurity risks that such social relationships and changes in visibility introduce.
In this work, we conduct a deep dive into the experiences of MBOs through two complementary analyses: an evaluation of case records of 38 at-risk MBOs subject to insider threats, and semi-structured interviews with 16 MBOs. Our analysis show a combination of restricted access to financial resources and disruption to relationships drove them to take greater risks in recruiting and access control, leaving them more vulnerable to malicious insider attacks. They also shared that their pursuit of market reach frequently led to an unwanted, hypervisible presence, inadvertently providing intimate insiders among other adversaries with further leverage or information needed to cause harm. We conclude by proposing avenues for eCommerce governance that address these risks, focusing on preventing insider harm within these highly visible environments.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 微型企业占所有企业的大多数，并且是许多高风险人群实现经济自由的载体。为了避免落后，许多微型企业主（MBO）越来越多地采用平台作为其主要基础设施，并严重依赖招募朋友、家人甚至恋爱伴侣来运行关键业务。尽管有这些事实，大多数先前工作都聚焦于大型企业和企业网络安全卫生，忽视了此类社会关系和可见性变化所引入的网络安全风险。在这项工作中，我们通过两项互补分析深入探究了MBO的经历：对38家遭受内部威胁的高风险MBO的案例记录进行评估，以及对16家MBO进行半结构化访谈。我们的分析表明，财务资源获取受限和关系中断共同驱使他们在大幅招募和访问控制方面承担更大风险，从而使他们更容易受到恶意内部攻击。他们还分享说，他们对市场覆盖的追求经常导致一种不受欢迎的、过度可见的存在，无意中为亲密内部人员及其他对手提供了造成伤害所需的进一步杠杆或信息。最后，我们提出了针对这些风险的电子商务治理途径，重点关注在这些高度可见的环境中防止内部人员伤害。

upstream_only.title: WarrInt: Integrity Validation for Criminal Legal Process
upstream_only.abstract: In the U.S., criminal legal process (e.g., a search warrant) is the key mechanism by which law enforcement entities and courts compel third parties (e.g., Google or Meta) to produce evidence in support of a criminal investigation. However, these legal orders are simply documents, commonly served electronically, and there is no inherent mechanism to guarantee their integrity. In recent years, law enforcement has increasingly reported the use of forged legal process used to advance a variety of malign purposes, with online sellers offering such capabilities for a fee. We design a practical system, WarrInt, that is compatible with the constraints of existing process mechanics and helps third parties identify when the legal orders they receive may be forged or tampered with. Our evaluation on real and modified legal process documents shows that WarrInt is effective at identifying modifications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 在美国，刑事法律流程（例如搜查令）是执法机构和法院强制第三方（例如谷歌或Meta）提供支持刑事调查证据的关键机制。然而，这些法律命令只是文件，通常以电子方式送达，并且没有内在机制保证其完整性。近年来，执法部门越来越多地报告有人使用伪造的法律流程来推进各种恶意目的，在线卖家以收费方式提供此类能力。我们设计了一个实用系统WarrInt，它与现有流程机制的约束兼容，帮助第三方识别其收到的法律命令可能被伪造或篡改的情况。我们在真实和修改过的法律流程文件上的评估表明，WarrInt能有效识别修改。

upstream_only.title: Characterizing Security and Privacy Teaching Standards for Schools in the United States
upstream_only.abstract: Increasingly, students begin learning aspects of security and privacy during their primary and secondary education (grades K-12 in the United States). Individual U.S. states and some national organizations publish teaching standards—guidance that outlines expectations for what students should learn. However, research has not yet examined what is covered by these standards and whether the topics align with what the broader security and privacy community thinks students should know. To shed light on these questions, we manually examined 12,201 standards from all U.S. states and eight national organizations. We labeled 3,920 of them as being related to security and privacy, further classifying these into 109 topics ranging from encryption to appropriate online behavior.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 越来越多的学生在小学和中学教育阶段（美国K-12年级）开始学习安全与隐私方面的内容。美国各州和一些全国性组织发布了教学标准——概述学生应学习内容的指导方针。然而，研究尚未考察这些标准涵盖了哪些内容，以及这些主题是否与更广泛的安全与隐私社区认为学生应该知道的内容相一致。为了阐明这些问题，我们人工审查了来自美国所有州和八个全国性组织的12,201项标准。我们将其中3,920项标记为与安全与隐私相关，并进一步将其归类为109个主题，从加密到适当的在线行为不等。

upstream_only.title: Resilience Amid Diffused Surveillance During a Political Movement in Bangladesh
upstream_only.abstract: In July 2024, Bangladesh witnessed a historic, student-led uprising where social media became both a tool of mobilization and a site of repression. While surveillance is often framed through Bentham's vertical Panopticon model, our study extends the discourse on lateral surveillance. Drawing on 23 interviews with protesters, activists, and digital organizers, we examine how lateral surveillance operates within a political movement in Bangladesh, where discipline is enacted not only by the state but also through peers, kin, and intimate social ties. Participants described living under constant fear while also developing creative strategies of resilience, from improvised encrypted systems and panic deletions to cultural tactics like satire and hidden speech. We contribute to security and privacy literature on activism by highlighting the need for designs that strengthen safety, anonymity, and collective resilience in fragile and repressive contexts.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 2024年7月，孟加拉国见证了一场历史性的、由学生领导的起义，社交媒体既是动员工具，也是镇压场所。虽然监控通常以边沁的垂直全景敞视模型来框定，但我们的研究扩展了关于横向监控的讨论。基于对23名抗议者、活动人士和数字组织者的访谈，我们考察了横向监控如何在孟加拉国的政治运动中运作，其中纪律不仅由国家实施，也通过同伴、亲属和亲密社会关系来执行。参与者描述了在持续恐惧中生活，同时也发展出创造性的韧性策略，从临时加密系统和恐慌性删除到讽刺和隐蔽言论等文化策略。我们通过强调在脆弱和压制性语境中需要加强安全、匿名性和集体韧性的设计，为关于行动主义的安全与隐私文献做出贡献。

upstream_only.title: Information Security in Small-Scale Protests: Surveillance of Ugandan Anti-EACOP Protesters
upstream_only.abstract: We examine the information security practices of Ugandan climate activists protesting the development of the East African Crude Oil Pipeline (EACOP). We conducted five-week fieldwork in Kampala, Uganda, which included interviews with 13 anti-EACOP activists. Through an inductive analysis, we report on the complexities faced by small groups of predominantly student protesters as they covertly organise small-scale anti-EACOP protests within a context marked by state surveillance and repression. Our study points to a multi-layered adversarial landscape, where participants' experiences of direct threats, including arrests and information compromise, and their fears of abduction, shaped their security practices. These practices were rooted in autonomous decision-making within groups. We present a grounded understanding of how participants' need to protect information for their own security, as well as that of others, permeated their lives, leading them to adjust day-to-day aspects of their device management, communication, accommodation, transport and social relations as deliberate tactics to mitigate surveillance.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 我们考察了乌干达气候活动人士在抗议东非原油管道（EACOP）开发过程中的信息安全实践。我们在乌干达坎帕拉进行了为期五周的实地调研，其中包括对13名反EACOP活动人士的访谈。通过归纳分析，我们报告了一群以学生为主的抗议者在国家监控和镇压背景下秘密组织小规模反EACOP抗议时所面临的复杂性。我们的研究揭示了一个多层次的对抗性环境，参与者对直接威胁（包括逮捕和信息泄露）的经历以及对绑架的恐惧塑造了他们的安全实践。这些实践植根于群体内部的自主决策。我们提出了一种扎根的理解：参与者保护自身及他人信息安全的需求渗透到他们的生活中，促使他们调整设备管理、通信、住宿、交通和社会关系等日常方面，作为减轻监控的刻意策略。

upstream_only.title: BugAuditor: Detecting Bugs via Inconsistent Defensive Code Auditing
upstream_only.abstract:
