Modern software systems contain complex behaviors that are prone to bugs when handled incorrectly. Detecting such bugs requires reliable oracles, which are difficult to construct as they require project-specific knowledge. Prior studies mainly obtain oracles from comparable code deviations, documentation, or historical bugs. However, these sources are inherently limited, leaving many project-specific bugs undetected.
In this paper, we propose inconsistent defensive handling as a new bug oracle for LLM-driven bug auditing. Specifically, we observe that real-world systems contain abundant defensive code, where developers proactively apply defensive handling in security-sensitive contexts to prevent bugs, and inconsistencies in such handling can indicate bugs. To realize this idea, we design BugAuditor, a framework that performs bug auditing via inconsistent defensive handling. BugAuditor first locates defensive code snippets across the codebase. It then reasons about the code to infer its security intent and underlying defensive patterns, characterizing the associated security-sensitive behaviors and defensive handling. Finally, BugAuditor applies the inferred patterns to audit the codebase and reports inconsistent defensive handling of the same security-sensitive behaviors across different contexts.
We evaluate BugAuditor on the Linux kernel. The results show that BugAuditor effectively mines project-specific knowledge embedded in defensive code that existing methods miss. Using the inferred defensive patterns, BugAuditor detects 54 long-latent bugs, including resource leaks, information leaks, and invalid pointer dereferences. To date, 20 bugs have been confirmed and fixed in the latest version, and two have been assigned CVE identifiers.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代软件系统包含复杂行为，若处理不当容易产生缺陷。检测此类缺陷需要可靠的判定基准（oracles），而这些基准因需要项目特定知识而难以构建。先前研究主要从可比较的代码偏差、文档或历史缺陷中获取判定基准。然而，这些来源本质上有限，导致许多项目特定缺陷未被检测到。本文提出不一致的防御性处理（inconsistent defensive handling）作为面向LLM驱动缺陷审计的新缺陷判定基准。具体而言，我们观察到现实世界系统中包含大量防御性代码，开发者在安全敏感情境中主动应用防御性处理以防止缺陷，而此类处理中的不一致可能指示缺陷。为实现这一想法，我们设计了BugAuditor，一个通过不一致防御性处理执行缺陷审计的框架。BugAuditor首先在代码库中定位防御性代码片段；然后对代码进行推理，推断其安全意图和底层防御模式，刻画相关的安全敏感行为与防御性处理；最后，BugAuditor将推断出的模式应用于整个代码库进行审计，并报告不同情境下对同一安全敏感行为的不一致防御性处理。我们在Linux内核上评估BugAuditor。结果表明，BugAuditor有效挖掘出现有方法遗漏的、嵌入在防御性代码中的项目特定知识。利用推断出的防御模式，BugAuditor检测到54个长期潜伏缺陷，包括资源泄漏、信息泄漏和无效指针解引用。迄今为止，已有20个缺陷在最新版本中被确认并修复，两个被分配了CVE编号。

upstream_only.title: TrioFuzz: A Three-Tier Architecture for Adaptive Strategy Selection in Fuzzing
upstream_only.abstract:
Adaptive strategy selection is a promising direction for improving fuzzing effectiveness, yet existing learning-based approaches often fail to outperform random selection in practice. We identify the root cause as an architectural mismatch rather than an algorithmic limitation. Our empirical study reveals that strategy effectiveness shifts at minute-level timescales, while existing in-loop architectures require tens of minutes per learning cycle. This order-of-magnitude gap prevents timely adaptation regardless of which learning algorithm is used. 
We propose TrioFuzz, a new fuzzing engine that decouples learning from execution through a three-tier thread architecture. A centralized learning thread aggregates feedback from parallel execution threads, compressing the adaptation cycle to under one minute. TrioFuzz integrates the same learning algorithms as prior work, isolating the architectural contribution from algorithmic factors. Our ablation study shows that learning algorithms perform significantly better under our proposed architecture than under their original in-loop implementations. Notably, native MOpt underperforms baselines, but becomes the top performer under TrioFuzz's architecture. Evaluation on FuzzBench and OSS-Fuzz shows that TrioFuzz achieves the highest coverage on 7 out of 9 FuzzBench targets and 8 out of 10 OSS-Fuzz projects, triggers 17% more vulnerabilities than AFL++ on Magma, and discovers 19 new CVEs in 6 real-world projects
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 自适应策略选择是提高模糊测试有效性的一个有前景的方向，然而现有的基于学习的方法在实践中往往无法超越随机选择。我们确定根本原因在于架构不匹配，而非算法限制。我们的实证研究表明，策略有效性在分钟级时间尺度上发生变化，而现有的循环内架构每个学习周期需要数十分钟。这种数量级的差距阻碍了及时适应，无论使用哪种学习算法。我们提出TrioFuzz，一种新的模糊测试引擎，通过三层线程架构将学习与执行解耦。一个集中式学习线程聚合来自并行执行线程的反馈，将适应周期压缩到一分钟以内。TrioFuzz集成了与先前工作相同的学习算法，将架构贡献与算法因素隔离开来。我们的消融研究表明，学习算法在我们提出的架构下比其原始循环内实现表现显著更好。值得注意的是，原生MOpt表现不如基线，但在TrioFuzz的架构下成为最佳表现者。在FuzzBench和OSS-Fuzz上的评估表明，TrioFuzz在9个FuzzBench目标中的7个和10个OSS-Fuzz项目中的8个上实现了最高覆盖率，在Magma上比AFL++多触发17%的漏洞，并在6个真实世界项目中发现了19个新CVE。

upstream_only.title: Generating Precise Format Specification for Network Protocols Through Adversarial LLM Interactions
upstream_only.abstract: This paper aims to address a significant gap in inferring precise format specifications for network protocols, particularly regarding the exact constraints on network packet fields. That is, while current methods can often derive accurate syntactic structures that divide a network packet into multiple fields, they typically struggle to capture the semantic dependencies or constraints among those fields. To address this issue, our central insight is that large language models (LLMs) have proven effective across various tasks, and adversarial interactions among these tasks can significantly alleviate the hallucination problem. Based on the insight, we propose a novel approach to generating precise protocol formats by adversarially combining LLM-based specification inference and code generation. By inputting the structured RFC documents of network protocols into LLMs, we generate both packet formats and reference packet parsers that iteratively refine one another to reduce hallucinations: the packet formats allow us to create a variety of network packets for parser testing, while runtime checks in the parsers help identify format errors. Our evaluation of 8 protocols shows a significant increase in precision and recall, achieving a 326% improvement over the state of the art in inferring field constraints. Furthermore, the improved format specifications enable effective fuzzing, leading to the discovery of 24 zero-day vulnerabilities in widely used protocol implementations.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文旨在解决推断网络协议精确格式规范中的重大空白，特别是关于网络包字段的确切约束。也就是说，现有方法通常能够推导出将网络包划分为多个字段的准确语法结构，但往往难以捕获这些字段之间的语义依赖或约束。为了解决这个问题，我们的核心洞见是，大型语言模型（LLM）已在各种任务中被证明有效，而这些任务之间的对抗性交互可以显著缓解幻觉问题。基于这一洞见，我们提出了一种新方法：通过对抗性结合基于LLM的规范推断和代码生成，生成精确的协议格式。将网络协议的结构化RFC文档输入LLM，我们生成数据包格式和参考数据包解析器，它们相互迭代细化以减少幻觉：数据包格式允许我们创建各种网络数据包用于解析器测试，而解析器中的运行时检查有助于识别格式错误。我们对8种协议的评估表明，精度和召回率显著提高，在推断字段约束方面比现有技术提升了326%。此外，改进后的格式规范实现了有效的模糊测试，从而在广泛使用的协议实现中发现了24个零日漏洞。

upstream_only.title: Bulbasaur: Branch-Guided Online Mutator Generation for Greybox Fuzzing
upstream_only.abstract:
Coverage-guided greybox fuzzing (CGF) hinges on generating inputs that satisfy branch constraints in order to explore deep code regions. Existing CGF techniques propose various approaches to improve the probability of solving such constraints. However, they still rely on general-purpose mutators, which lack the ability to precisely manipulate relevant input bytes to satisfy complex constraints.
Our analysis reveals that LLMs can more accurately solve branch constraints by generating tailored mutators. These mutators enable the fuzzer to perform localized and reusable modifications on inputs that reach target branches, producing precise mutations to satisfy target constraints. To achieve this, we propose Bulbasaur, a branch-guided framework for online LLM-based mutator generation. Bulbasaur employs hard frontier-guided branch selection to identify critical branches, continuously collects and organizes relevant static and dynamic context to support high-quality mutator generation, and adopts an efficient and adaptive strategy to apply generated mutators during fuzzing.
We evaluate Bulbasaur on the FuzzBench and UniFuzz benchmarks. The results show that Bulbasaur improves line and branch coverage by up to 23.18% and 24.46%, respectively, over state-of-the-art fuzzers, discovers 21 vulnerabilities missed by all baselines, and identifies 15 previously unknown vulnerabilities on OSS-Fuzz, all of which have been assigned CVE identifiers.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 覆盖率引导的灰盒模糊测试（CGF）依赖于生成满足分支约束的输入，以探索深层代码区域。现有的CGF技术提出了各种方法来提高求解此类约束的概率。然而，它们仍然依赖通用变异器，这些变异器缺乏精确操纵相关输入字节以满足复杂约束的能力。我们的分析表明，LLM可以通过生成定制的变异器来更准确地求解分支约束。这些变异器使模糊测试器能够对到达目标分支的输入进行局部化和可重用的修改，从而产生满足目标约束的精确变异。为实现这一目标，我们提出了Bulbasaur，一个分支引导的在线LLM变异器生成框架。Bulbasaur采用硬前沿引导的分支选择来识别关键分支，持续收集和组织相关的静态与动态上下文以支持高质量变异器生成，并采用高效且自适应的策略在模糊测试过程中应用生成的变异器。我们在FuzzBench和UniFuzz基准上评估了Bulbasaur。结果表明，Bulbasaur相比最先进的模糊测试器，将行覆盖率和分支覆盖率分别最多提高了23.18%和24.46%，发现了所有基线均遗漏的21个漏洞，并在OSS-Fuzz上识别出15个此前未知的漏洞，所有这些漏洞均已分配CVE标识符。

upstream_only.title: Death by a Thousand Drips: Uncovering Critical Resource Leaks in the Windows Ecosystem
upstream_only.abstract: Windows remote services are a critical attack surface due to their privileged execution and widespread deployment. Under the shared service-host model (svchost.exe), a single resource-exhaustion bug can trigger fate-sharing failures across co-resident services. Yet most vulnerability discovery remains crash-centric and is thus blind to silent, long-horizon resource leaks (e.g., memory/handle exhaustion) that do not cause immediate exceptions, while the closed-source Windows ecosystem limits the applicability of source-level sanitizers. We present REDOSPECTOR, a fuzzing framework for discovering resource-oriented Denial-of-Service (DoS) vulnerabilities in opaque Windows binaries. REDOSPECTOR combines (1) lightweight in-process hook-based telemetry by intercepting native ntdll heap routines, (2) an amplification-based oracle that identifies persistent leaks via repeated execution and growth-trend analysis, and (3) a hybrid seed-generation pipeline that leverages static binary analysis and Large Language Models (LLMs) to reach deep protocol states. Evaluated on the latest builds of Windows 11 (24H2) and Windows Server Preview, REDOSPECTOR uncovers 19 vulnerabilities in core services (including MSMQ, Remote Desktop Gateway, and CDP), leading to 12 assigned CVEs. Microsoft confirmed seven pre-authentication DoS issues in CDP and performed architectural adjustments, demonstrating that REDOSPECTOR can expose resource-mismanagement flaws that evade conventional fuzzing.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Windows远程服务因其特权执行和广泛部署而成为关键攻击面。在共享服务宿主模型（svchost.exe）下，单个资源耗尽漏洞可引发共驻服务间的命运共享故障。然而，大多数漏洞发现仍以崩溃为中心，因而对不会立即引发异常的静默、长周期资源泄漏（例如内存/句柄耗尽）视而不见，而闭源Windows生态系统又限制了源码级清理器（sanitizers）的适用性。我们提出REDOSPECTOR，一个用于发现不透明Windows二进制中面向资源的拒绝服务（DoS）漏洞的模糊测试框架。REDOSPECTOR结合了：(1)通过拦截原生ntdll堆例程实现的轻量级进程内钩子遥测；(2)一种基于放大的预言机，通过重复执行和增长趋势分析识别持续性泄漏；(3)一种混合种子生成流水线，利用静态二进制分析和大型语言模型（LLM）到达深层协议状态。在Windows 11（24H2）和Windows Server Preview的最新版本上评估，REDOSPECTOR在核心服务（包括MSMQ、远程桌面网关和CDP）中发现了19个漏洞，导致分配了12个CVE。微软确认了CDP中的七个预认证DoS问题并进行了架构调整，表明REDOSPECTOR能够暴露规避传统模糊测试的资源管理缺陷。

upstream_only.title: RecStruct: Recovering Nested Struct Types from Stripped Binaries via Stack-Driven Unification
upstream_only.abstract: Recovering composite data types from stripped binaries is critical for reverse engineering and vulnerability analysis. Existing approaches either rely on heavyweight decompilers with limited type reasoning, or employ expensive constraint solvers that fail to scale. While some methods can handle nested structures, they struggle with large real-world binaries due to prohibitive computational costs. We present RecStruct, a fast type recovery framework that reconstructs nested structures without dependence on any decompiler. RecStruct lifts binaries directly, performs flow-insensitive symbolic execution to reduce memory aliases, and introduces Stack-Driven Unification—a novel union-find algorithm that maintains an offset stack during traversal to merge types only when their nesting depths align. This enables precise recovery of recursive structures. We implement an end-to-end pipeline and evaluate it on 418 binaries comprising 744,770 functions, including benchmarks from prior work and large-scale programs such as QEMU and OpenSSL. Experimental results demonstrate competitive accuracy compared to existing tools, with substantial improvements in efficiency and scalability, enabling analysis of binaries that were previously intractable.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 从剥离二进制中恢复复合数据类型对于逆向工程和漏洞分析至关重要。现有方法要么依赖类型推理能力有限的重量级反编译器，要么采用无法扩展的昂贵约束求解器。虽然一些方法能够处理嵌套结构，但由于计算成本过高，它们难以应对大型真实世界二进制。我们提出RecStruct，一个快速类型恢复框架，无需依赖任何反编译器即可重建嵌套结构。RecStruct直接提升二进制，执行流不敏感符号执行以减少内存别名，并引入栈驱动统一——一种新颖的并查集算法，在遍历过程中维护偏移栈，仅当嵌套深度对齐时合并类型。这能够精确恢复递归结构。我们实现了端到端流水线，并在418个二进制（包含744,770个函数）上评估，包括先前工作的基准测试以及QEMU和OpenSSL等大规模程序。实验结果表明，与现有工具相比具有竞争性的准确性，并在效率和可扩展性方面有显著提升，使得以前难以处理的二进制分析成为可能。

upstream_only.title: Crypto Wars in Secure Messaging: Covert Channels in Signal Despite Leaked Keys
upstream_only.abstract:
End-to-end encryption (E2EE) is the foundation of modern secure messaging, with the Signal protocol as the de facto standard in applications such as Signal, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger and Google Messages. At the same time, the deployment of E2EE has led to growing pressure from authorities to decrypt user traffic under law enforcement. This raises a critical question: if an adversary can routinely decrypt Signal messages (for example via a mandated access or a leaked key), can users still communicate securely and covertly? 
We address this question through the lens of anamorphic encryption, which enables hidden communication within seemingly legitimate ciphertexts, even against an adversary who can decrypt them. We design two constructions that embed covert channels into the existing Signal Double Ratchet protocol. Concretely, we show how to embed covert messages (i) into Diffie-Hellman keys used in the asymmetric ratchet, or (ii) into authentication tags produced in the symmetric ratchet. Our techniques are compatible with existing Signal-style deployments and require no changes by the service provider. 
We formalize security in threat models that capture adversaries with decryption capabilities granted through lawful-access mechanisms, and prove that the resulting protocol transcripts are indistinguishable from those of standard Signal. We implement our constructions in the official Signal library and Android client, and show that they incur low overhead and are practical in real-world settings. Our results show that covert communication channels can persist even when conventional E2EE guarantees are compromised.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 端到端加密（E2EE）是现代安全消息传递的基础，Signal协议是Signal、WhatsApp、Facebook Messenger和Google Messages等应用中的事实标准。与此同时，E2EE的部署导致当局施加越来越大的压力，要求执法部门解密用户流量。这提出了一个关键问题：如果对手能够例行解密Signal消息（例如通过强制访问或泄露的密钥），用户还能安全且隐蔽地通信吗？我们通过变形加密的视角来解决这个问题，该技术能够在看似合法的密文中实现隐藏通信，即使对手可以解密它们。我们设计了两种构造，将隐蔽信道嵌入现有的Signal双棘轮协议中。具体而言，我们展示了如何将隐蔽消息（i）嵌入非对称棘轮中使用的Diffie-Hellman密钥，或（ii）嵌入对称棘轮中生成的身份验证标签。我们的技术与现有Signal风格部署兼容，且无需服务提供商进行任何更改。我们在威胁模型中形式化安全性，这些模型捕获通过合法访问机制获得解密能力的对手，并证明生成的协议记录与标准Signal的记录不可区分。我们在官方Signal库和Android客户端中实现了我们的构造，并表明它们开销低且在现实环境中实用。我们的结果表明，即使传统E2EE保证被破坏，隐蔽通信信道仍可保持。

upstream_only.title: Oblivious Signaling
upstream_only.abstract:
An anonymous messaging service has to solve a basic routing problem: a server must deliver an encrypted message to its recipient without learning who the recipient is. Broadcasting all ciphertexts hides the destination but forces every recipient to constantly scan for new messages. Oblivious Message Retrieval (OMR; CRYPTO~'22) tackles this by using fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) to let an untrusted server perform message retrieval on a recipient's behalf without learning which messages are pertinent.
We introduce Oblivious Signaling, which shifts this cost from retrieval to sending. The server maintains a fixed-size encrypted inbox for each recipient. When a sender submits a message, the server applies the same homomorphic update to every inbox: the intended inbox absorbs the message, and the rest remain unchanged at the plaintext level. The update is uniform, can be parallelized across inboxes, and ties the delivery cost strictly to the size of the anonymity set rather than global traffic. Recipients retrieve by fetching and decrypting their inbox, so checking for new messages is independent of the global traffic.
We formalize receiver privacy against an untrusted server, even when it colludes with other users, give a concrete construction based on fully homomorphic encryption, and analyze the resulting ``digital postage'' trade-off: delivery is expensive, but checking is cheap. Our prototype identifies practical regimes in which this cost-model shift is preferable to scan-based retrieval, even with highly optimized OMR implementations. This cost model is well-suited to settings where recipients check frequently, and messages arrive sporadically, and it naturally discourages high-volume spam.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 匿名消息服务必须解决一个基本的路由问题：服务器必须将加密消息投递给其接收者，同时不能获知接收者是谁。广播所有密文隐藏了目的地，但迫使每个接收者不断扫描新消息。不经意消息检索（OMR；CRYPTO '22）通过使用全同态加密（FHE）让不可信服务器代表接收者执行消息检索，同时不获知哪些消息是相关的，从而解决了这个问题。我们引入了不经意信令，它将这种成本从检索转移到发送。服务器为每个接收者维护一个固定大小的加密收件箱。当发送者提交消息时，服务器对每个收件箱应用相同的同态更新：目标收件箱吸收该消息，其余收件箱在明文层面保持不变。该更新是统一的，可以跨收件箱并行化，并将投递成本严格地与匿名集的大小而非全局流量挂钩。接收者通过获取并解密其收件箱来检索，因此检查新消息与全局流量无关。我们对不可信服务器形式化了接收者隐私，即使服务器与其他用户勾结；我们给出了基于全同态加密的具体构造，并分析了由此产生的“数字邮资”权衡：投递昂贵，但检查便宜。我们的原型确定了实际场景，在这些场景中，即使使用高度优化的OMR实现，这种成本模型转变也比基于扫描的检索更可取。这种成本模型非常适合接收者频繁检查且消息零星到达的场景，并且天然抑制高容量垃圾邮件。

upstream_only.title: Message Injection Attacks Against Signal
upstream_only.abstract: Signal is a secure messaging app offering end-to-end security for pairwise and group communications. It has tens of millions of users, and has heavily influenced the design of other secure messaging apps (including WhatsApp). Signal has been heavily analysed and, as a result, is rightly regarded as setting the "gold standard" for messaging apps by the scientific community. We present two practical attacks that break the integrity properties of Signal in its advertised threat model. Each attack arises from different features of Signal that are poorly documented and have eluded formal security analyses. The first attack, affecting Android and Desktop, arises from Signal's introduction of identities based on usernames (instead of phone numbers) in early 2022. We show that the protocol for resolving identities based on usernames and on phone numbers introduced a vulnerability that allows a malicious server to inject arbitrary messages into one-to-one conversations under specific circumstances. The injection causes a user-visible alert about a change of safety numbers, but if the users compare their safety numbers, they will be correct. The second attack is even more severe. It arises from Signal's Sealed Sender (SSS) feature, designed to allow sender identities to be hidden. We show that a combination of two errors in the SSS implementation in Android allows a malicious server to inject arbitrary messages into both one-to-one and group conversations. The errors relate to missing key checks and the loss of context when cryptographic processing is distributed across multiple software components. The attack is undetectable by users and can be mounted at any time, without any preconditions. As far as we can tell, the vulnerability has been present since the introduction of SSS in 2018. We disclosed both attacks to the engineers at Signal who promptly developed and deployed patches. Beyond presenting these devastating attacks on Signal's end-to-end security guarantees, we discuss more broadly what can be learned about the challenges of deploying new security features in complex software projects.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: Signal是一款安全消息应用，为成对和群组通信提供端到端安全。它有数千万用户，并深刻影响了其他安全消息应用（包括WhatsApp）的设计。Signal已被大量分析，因此科学界正确地将其视为消息应用的“黄金标准”。我们提出两种实际攻击，打破了Signal在其宣称威胁模型下的完整性属性。每种攻击都源于Signal的不同特性，这些特性文档不足且未经过形式化安全分析。第一种攻击影响Android和桌面版，源于Signal在2022年初引入基于用户名（而非电话号码）的身份。我们表明，基于用户名和电话号码解析身份的协议引入了一个漏洞，允许恶意服务器在特定情况下向一对一对话中注入任意消息。注入会导致用户可见的关于安全号码更改的警报，但如果用户比较他们的安全号码，它们将是正确的。第二种攻击更为严重。它源于Signal的密封发送者（Sealed Sender, SSS）功能，该功能旨在隐藏发送者身份。我们表明，Android中SSS实现的两个错误组合允许恶意服务器向一对一和群组对话中注入任意消息。这些错误涉及缺少密钥检查以及当密码处理分布在多个软件组件时上下文的丢失。该攻击用户无法检测，并且可以在任何时间、无任何前提条件的情况下发动。据我们所知，该漏洞自2018年引入SSS以来一直存在。我们向Signal的工程师披露了这两种攻击，他们迅速开发并部署了补丁。除了展示这些对Signal端到端安全保证的毁灭性攻击外，我们还更广泛地讨论了在复杂软件项目中部署新安全功能所面临的挑战中可以学到什么。

upstream_only.title: Cryptanalysis of LDPC-Based Pseudorandom Error-Correcting Codes
upstream_only.abstract: Pseudorandom error-correcting codes (PRCs), a novel cryptographic primitive recently proposed at CRYPTO 2024, are primarily applied in undetectable watermarking schemes for large generative models. However, the security of PRCs has not yet been systematically analyzed. To fill this gap, we present the first cryptanalysis of PRCs. Specifically, focusing on LDPC-PRC, the only known practical instantiation of PRCs, we propose three novel attacks that challenge its undetectability and robustness. To rigorously demonstrate the practical threat, we analyze the concrete attack complexity under realistic parameters and validate the attack effectiveness on both real-world large language models and generative image models, including DeepSeek and Stable Diffusion. Our analysis shows that the claimed security guarantees of LDPC-PRC are undermined across all practically feasible regimes. For example, our attacks can detect the presence of a watermark with overwhelming probability at a cost of 222 operations. Beyond attacks, we further propose three defenses: parameter recommendation, implementation suggestion, and a revised key generation function. However, PRC-based watermarking schemes still fail to achieve 128-bit security due to inherent constraints of large generative models, such as the maximum output length of large language models. Overall, our work clarifies the concrete security limits of PRCs in real-world watermarking applications.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 伪随机纠错码（PRCs）是最近在CRYPTO 2024上提出的一种新型密码学原语，主要应用于大型生成模型的水印方案中，以实现不可检测性。然而，PRCs的安全性尚未得到系统分析。为填补这一空白，我们提出了首个针对PRCs的密码分析。具体而言，我们聚焦于LDPC-PRC——目前已知唯一实用的PRCs实例化方案——提出了三种新颖攻击，挑战其不可检测性和鲁棒性。为严格证明实际威胁，我们分析了现实参数下的具体攻击复杂度，并在真实世界的大型语言模型和生成图像模型（包括DeepSeek和Stable Diffusion）上验证了攻击有效性。我们的分析表明，LDPC-PRC所声称的安全保障在所有实际可行的范围内均被削弱。例如，我们的攻击能够以压倒性概率检测到水印的存在，成本仅为222次操作。除了攻击，我们还提出了三种防御措施：参数推荐、实现建议和修订的密钥生成函数。然而，由于大型生成模型的固有限制（例如大型语言模型的最大输出长度），基于PRC的水印方案仍然无法达到128位安全性。总体而言，我们的工作阐明了PRCs在实际水印应用中的具体安全限制。

upstream_only.title: Anamorphic Messaging: Analyzing the Double Ratchet, Triple Ratchet, PQ3, and MLS
upstream_only.abstract:
Anamorphic cryptography targets the scenario in which a dictator does not forbid the use of cryptography but requires all users to reveal their secret keys to them. Thus, the dictator can decrypt all honestly generated ciphertexts. The approach for bypassing this is to identify spots, such as random nonces, in existing cryptographic protocols in which secret messages can be hidden using an additional secret double key. So far, the literature mostly focused on identifying such spots in simple primitives like public-key encryption or signatures; only recently, an initial work identified limited spots in Signal's Double Ratchet Algorithm.
We are the first to leverage the statefulness of cryptographic communication protocols to employ continuously updated double states and, thereby, achieve Forward Security: Even if the adversary (i) observes all traffic, (ii) knows all users' regular secret key material at any stage of the protocol execution, and (iii) at some point learns the secret double state, the entire protocol execution looks benign although covert messages were previously hidden in the traffic anamorphically. We formalize this notion and also cover robustness and authenticity, which appear to be particularly relevant in the messaging context.
In this new model, we study four of the most relevant messaging protocols and identify hiding spots therein: Signal's Double Ratchet, Signal's Triple Ratchet, Apple's PQ3, and the two-party core of the Messaging Layer Security Standard. We focus on the cryptographic parts of these protocols and, despite their complexity, identify surprisingly few anamorphic hiding spots. We prove that all these protocols offer forward secure, authenticated anamorphic channels and we evaluate their bandwidths: While 16 bits can be embedded in every epoch of the Double Ratchet, Triple Ratchet and PQ3 provide 176 bits, respectively 256 bits, of bandwidth per post-quantum epoch, and MLS provides 688 bits per epoch.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 变形密码学针对的场景是：独裁者并不禁止使用密码学，但要求所有用户向其揭示秘密密钥。因此，独裁者可以解密所有诚实生成的密文。绕过这一点的方法是在现有密码协议中识别一些位置，例如随机数，在这些位置可以使用额外的秘密双密钥隐藏秘密消息。迄今为止，文献大多集中于在公钥加密或签名等简单原语中识别此类位置；直到最近，一项初期工作才在Signal的双棘轮算法中识别出有限的位置。我们首次利用密码通信协议的有状态性来采用持续更新的双状态，从而实现前向安全：即使对手（i）观察所有流量，（ii）在协议执行的任何阶段都知道所有用户的常规秘密密钥材料，并且（iii）在某个时刻获知秘密双状态，整个协议执行看起来也是良性的，尽管此前曾以变形方式在流量中隐藏了隐蔽消息。我们将这一概念形式化，并且还涵盖鲁棒性和真实性，这些在消息传递场景中似乎特别相关。在这个新模型中，我们研究了四个最相关的消息传递协议，并识别出其中的隐藏位置：Signal的双棘轮、Signal的三棘轮、Apple的PQ3，以及消息层安全标准的两方核心。我们关注这些协议的密码学部分，尽管它们很复杂，但我们识别出的变形隐藏位置少得惊人。我们证明所有这些协议都提供前向安全的、经过认证的变形信道，并评估其带宽：双棘轮的每个纪元可嵌入16比特，而三棘轮和PQ3在每个后量子纪元分别提供176比特和256比特的带宽，MLS每个纪元提供688比特。

upstream_only.title: ORPHEUS: A Separation-Robust Proactive Defense for Singing Voice Conversion
upstream_only.abstract: Recent advances in singing voice conversion enable realistic cloning of a singer's voice, raising concerns about unauthorized voice misuse. Existing proactive defenses inject imperceptible perturbations to disrupt such conversion, and they are designed for vocal signals rather than mixed music. In real-world scenarios, however, attackers usually obtain mixed music and apply source separation to decompose the mixture into vocal and backing tracks before conversion. Since separation models are trained to distinguish vocals from background components, perturbations are often treated as backing, causing the perturbations to be filtered out. To address this, we present ORPHEUS, the first proactive defense framework tailored for singing voice conversion involving source separation. Specifically, we jointly (i) interfere with the separation model via mask-misguiding and cross-track losses, (ii) disrupt identity information using an ensemble of heterogeneous speaker encoders to enhance transferability, and (iii) optimize perceptual quality through tonality harmony constraints and psychoacoustic masking. To evaluate ORPHEUS, we conduct experiments on two datasets with three source separation models and four singing voice conversion systems. Compared with the best-performing baseline, ORPHEUS further reduces identity similarity by 8.02% and 5.61% on two speaker verification models, respectively, demonstrating consistently stronger defense effectiveness and cross-model transferability.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 近年来，歌声转换的进展使得能够逼真地克隆歌手的声音，引发了对其未经授权使用的担忧。现有的主动防御方法通过注入不可察觉的扰动来破坏这种转换，并且它们是针对人声信号而非混合音乐设计的。然而在现实场景中，攻击者通常获取混合音乐，并在转换前应用源分离将混合音分解为人声和伴奏轨。由于分离模型被训练来区分人声和背景成分，扰动往往被当作伴奏，从而被滤除。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 ORPHEUS，这是首个针对涉及源分离的歌声转换量身定制的主动防御框架。具体来说，我们联合 (i) 通过掩码误导和跨轨损失干扰分离模型，(ii) 使用异构说话人编码器集成来破坏身份信息以增强可迁移性，以及 (iii) 通过音调和谐约束和心理声学掩蔽来优化感知质量。为了评估 ORPHEUS，我们在两个数据集上使用三个源分离模型和四个歌声转换系统进行了实验。与最佳基线相比，ORPHEUS 在两个说话人验证模型上分别进一步将身份相似度降低了 8.02% 和 5.61%，展示了持续更强的防御效果和跨模型可迁移性。

upstream_only.title: On Improving Robustness of Deepfake Image Detectors
upstream_only.abstract:
The rapid advancement of Generative AI has introduced remarkable opportunities while simultaneously raising critical concerns regarding content authenticity. While recent work has increasingly focused on improving the generalization of deepfake detectors across unseen generative models, their robustness against adversarial attacks remains limited. In particular, Abdullah et al. (IEEE SP 2024) evaluated eight detectors and demonstrated that most of them exhibit significant performance degradation under adversarial attacks. We also observed the same phenomenon by testing seven most recent state-of-the-art detectors. To address this problem, we propose a unified framework that integrates three complementary design principles without relying on adversarial training data: (i) higher-order statistical modeling in the frequency domain via Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT)-based moment pooling up to fourth order, (ii) content-agnostic feature representations derived from noise residuals, and (iii) cross-scene generalization enforced through patch-level semantic disruption. A key insight underpinning our approach is that adversarial attacks primarily operate on low-order statistics and visual semantics,
leaving higher-order residual-frequency characteristics, particularly kurtosis, largely unconstrained. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently improves robustness across six architecturally diverse detectors. Notably, we achieve up to 88.9% reduction in recall degradation on current adversarial benchmarks, and improve the best-performing recent detector (Yang et al., IEEE CVPR 2025) from 81.9% to 97.15% accuracy under attack. Overall, our method provides a principled, architecture-agnostic approach for improving deepfake detection robustness against current attacks.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 生成式AI的快速发展带来了显著机遇，同时也引发了关于内容真实性的严重担忧。尽管近期工作越来越关注提高深度伪造检测器在未见生成模型上的泛化能力，但其对抗对抗性攻击的鲁棒性仍然有限。特别是，Abdullah等人（IEEE SP 2024）评估了八种检测器，并证明大多数在对抗性攻击下表现出显著性能下降。我们通过测试七种最新的最先进检测器也观察到了同样现象。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个统一框架，集成了三种互补的设计原则，且不依赖对抗训练数据：(i) 通过基于离散余弦变换（DCT）的矩池化高达四阶的频率域高阶统计建模，(ii) 从噪声残差导出的内容无关特征表示，以及 (iii) 通过补丁级语义破坏强制实现的跨场景泛化。支撑我们方法的一个关键见解是，对抗性攻击主要作用于低阶统计和视觉语义，而高阶残差频率特征，特别是峰度，基本不受约束。大量实验表明，我们的方法在六种架构多样的检测器上持续提高了鲁棒性。值得注意的是，我们在当前对抗基准上实现了召回率下降最多减少88.9%，并将表现最好的最新检测器（Yang等人，IEEE CVPR 2025）在攻击下的准确率从81.9%提高到97.15%。总体而言，我们的方法提供了一种原则性的、与架构无关的方法，用于提高深度伪造检测对当前攻击的鲁棒性。

upstream_only.title: SafeAdapt: Safety Alignment with Adaptive Thinking Allocation for Large Reasoning Models
upstream_only.abstract:
Reasoning models have garnered growing importance as their strong Chain-of-Thought (CoT) capabilities unleash exceptional performance on complex tasks. Consequently, an emerging research direction explores "safety thinking" which leverages reasoning models' reasoning capabilities to assess the safety of input prompts and prevent harmful content generation. A prevailing yet under-examined belief in existing studies is that allocating more computational resources to the safety reasoning budget, i.e., rolling out longer safety thinking trajectories, necessarily yields safer behavior. However, this premise has not been systematically analyzed, despite the widespread adoption of reasoning models.
In this paper, we aim to fill this gap by conducting a rigorous safety evaluation to examine the relationship between the safety reasoning budget and the safety of reasoning model generations, particularly under adversarial conditions. Our analysis reveals that safety does not monotonically improve with longer thinking trajectories: both over-thinking on simple attacks and under-thinking on difficult attacks incur excess safety risks, leading to systematic failures under fixed-budget safety policies. Motivated by these key findings, we propose SafeAdapt: Safety Alignment with adaptive thinking Allocation, a novel approach that learns to dynamically adjust reasoning models' safety thinking budget based on prompt difficulty. This enables reasoning models to allocate computational resources adaptively, rather than following a single fixed thinking pattern (e.g., the longer the safer), thereby mitigating excess risks incurred by under-/over-thinking. Experiments across multiple adversarial benchmarks demonstrate that SafeAdapt significantly improves safety performance with a more ideal thinking budget under diverse and challenging attack settings.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 推理模型因其强大的思维链（CoT）能力而在复杂任务上表现出色，日益重要。因此，一个新兴的研究方向探索“安全思维”，利用推理模型的推理能力来评估输入提示的安全性并防止有害内容生成。现有研究中一个普遍但未经充分检验的信念是，为安全推理预算分配更多计算资源，即展开更长的安全思考轨迹，必然会产生更安全的行为。然而，尽管推理模型被广泛采用，这一前提尚未得到系统分析。本文旨在填补这一空白，通过严格的安全评估来考察安全推理预算与推理模型生成安全性之间的关系，特别是在对抗条件下。我们的分析表明，安全性并不会随思考轨迹变长而单调提升：对简单攻击的过度思考和对困难攻击的思考不足都会带来过度的安全风险，导致固定预算安全策略下的系统性失败。基于这些关键发现，我们提出SafeAdapt：安全对齐与自适应思考分配，这是一种学习根据提示难度动态调整推理模型安全思考预算的新方法。这使推理模型能够自适应地分配计算资源，而不是遵循单一的固定思考模式（例如越长越安全），从而缓解由思考不足/过度思考带来的过度风险。在多个对抗性基准上的实验表明，SafeAdapt在多样且具有挑战性的攻击设置下，以更理想的思考预算显著提升了安全性能。

upstream_only.title: GoodVibe: Security-by-Vibe for LLM-Based Code Generation
upstream_only.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation in fast, informal development workflows, often referred to as vibe coding, where speed and convenience are prioritized, and security requirements are rarely made explicit. In this setting, models frequently produce functionally correct but insecure code, creating a growing security risk. Existing approaches to improving code security rely on full-parameter fine-tuning or parameter-efficient adaptations, which are either costly and prone to catastrophic forgetting or operate at coarse granularity with limited interpretability and control. We present GoodVibe, a neuron-level framework for improving the security of code language models by default. GoodVibe is based on the key insight that security-relevant reasoning is localized to a small subset of neurons. We identify these neurons using gradient-based attribution from a supervised security task and perform neuron-selective fine-tuning that updates only this security-critical subspace. To further reduce training cost, we introduce activation-driven neuron clustering, enabling structured updates with minimal overhead. We evaluate GoodVibe on six LLMs across security-critical programming languages, including C++, Java, Swift, and Go. GoodVibe substantially improves the security of generated code while preserving general model utility, achieving up to a 2.5× improvement over base models, achieving performance competitive with full fine-tuning while using over 4700× fewer trainable parameters, and reducing training computation by more than 3.6× compared to the parameter-efficient baseline (LoRA). Our results demonstrate that neuron-level optimization offers an effective and scalable approach to securing code generation without sacrificing generality.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于快速、非正式的开发工作流中的代码生成，这种工作流通常被称为氛围编程（vibe coding），其中速度和便利性被优先考虑，而安全需求很少被明确。在这种场景下，模型经常生成功能正确但不安全的代码，从而造成日益严重的安全风险。现有改善代码安全性的方法依赖于全参数微调或参数高效适配，这些方法要么成本高昂且容易发生灾难性遗忘，要么在粗粒度上操作，可解释性和控制力有限。我们提出GoodVibe，一个神经元级框架，用于默认提升代码语言模型的安全性。GoodVibe基于一个关键洞察：与安全相关的推理局限于一小部分神经元。我们使用来自监督式安全任务的基于梯度的归因来识别这些神经元，并执行神经元选择性微调，仅更新这个安全关键子空间。为进一步降低训练成本，我们引入激活驱动的神经元聚类，以最小开销实现结构化更新。我们在六种LLM上跨安全关键编程语言（包括C++、Java、Swift和Go）评估GoodVibe。GoodVibe大幅提升生成代码的安全性，同时保持模型通用效用，相比基础模型提升最高2.5倍，在使用超过4700倍更少可训练参数的情况下达到与全微调相当的性能，并且相比参数高效基线（LoRA）减少超过3.6倍训练计算量。我们的结果表明，神经元级优化为在不牺牲通用性的情况下保障代码生成安全提供了一种有效且可扩展的方法。

upstream_only.title: Red-Teaming for Scraping
upstream_only.abstract:
Scraping has evolved from a nuisance into a sophisticated, economically motivated threat to user privacy and platform integrity. Most organizations rely on reactive rate-limiting and passive monitoring defenses routinely bypassed by well-resourced attackers.
This talk presents a different approach: proactively attacking your own platform through a dedicated Scraping Red Team program. We introduce adversary economics as the primary defensive metric such as, the attacker's cost-per-record. When that number is low, your defenses are failing regardless of what your dashboards say.
Drawing on real operational experience, we walk through engagement design, privacy-aware data handling, structured vulnerability reporting, and validated remediation.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 爬取已从一种滋扰演变为一种由经济动机驱动、针对用户隐私和平台完整性的复杂威胁。大多数组织依赖被动限流和被动监控防御，而这些防御通常会被资源充足的攻击者绕过。本演讲提出一种不同的方法：通过专门的爬取红队项目，主动攻击自己的平台。我们引入对手经济学作为主要防御指标，例如攻击者的单条记录成本。当该数值很低时，无论仪表盘显示什么，你的防御都在失效。基于实际运营经验，我们将逐步介绍演练设计、隐私感知数据处理、结构化漏洞报告和经过验证的修复。

upstream_only.title: Security Tools Don't Detect Attacks—Humans Do
upstream_only.abstract:
Modern security tools claim to detect attacks, yet in practice they generate signals: alerts, anomalies, and observations. The actual act of detection is performed by human analysts who correlate fragmented evidence, form hypotheses, and reconstruct attack narratives across identities, systems, and time. This distinction exposes a fundamental architectural flaw in modern security operations. Most security infrastructures are designed around alert generation, while the critical work of investigative reasoning remains largely manual.
This talk introduces the concept of Inference-Driven Detection, a model that reframes attack detection as a reasoning problem rather than an anomaly-identification problem. Drawing on lessons from large-scale enterprise security environments, it explores why attacks such as credential abuse, privilege escalation, and lateral movement are often discovered through narrative reconstruction rather than isolated alerts. The talk argues that future security systems must move beyond alert-centric architectures and instead support human and AI-assisted investigative reasoning to identify and understand adversarial behavior.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代安全工具声称能检测攻击，但在实践中它们生成的是信号：警报、异常和观察结果。实际的检测行为是由人类分析师执行的，他们关联碎片化证据、形成假设，并跨身份、系统和时间重建攻击叙事。这种区分揭示了现代安全运营中的一个根本架构缺陷。大多数安全基础设施是围绕警报生成设计的，而调查推理这一关键工作在很大程度上仍是手工完成的。本演讲介绍推理驱动检测（Inference-Driven Detection）的概念，这是一个将攻击检测重新定义为推理问题而非异常识别问题的模型。它借鉴大规模企业安全环境的经验，探讨为什么凭证滥用、权限提升和横向移动等攻击通常是通过叙事重建而非孤立警报被发现的。演讲认为，未来的安全系统必须超越以警报为中心的架构，转而支持人类和AI辅助的调查推理，以识别和理解对抗行为。

upstream_only.title: Supply Chain Attacks on Open Source: What's Happening, What Can We Do Today, and What's Next
upstream_only.abstract:
There's a new pattern of supply chain attacks on open source, where malware exfiltrates secrets from build processes in order to publish more malicious packages from attacker-controlled machines to propagate the attack. These attacks happen at the intersection of how open source projects are maintained, what security capabilities build platforms and package repositories have, what steps consumers of open source take to protect themselves, and how ready we all are to do incident response when an attack happens.
But there are things we can do today to make things better. We'll cover how to secure your build process including removing secrets altogether, how to prepare for an attack by tracking your open source dependencies and putting together an incident response playbook, and where to go for information during an attack and how to minimize impact. Lastly we'll talk about potential signals to proactive detect when a package might be compromised.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 开源领域出现了一种新的供应链攻击模式：恶意软件从构建过程中窃取机密信息，以便从攻击者控制的机器上发布更多恶意软件包，从而传播攻击。这些攻击发生在开源项目维护方式、构建平台和软件包仓库所具备的安全能力、开源消费者为保护自身所采取的步骤，以及我们在攻击发生时进行事件响应的准备程度之间的交叉点。但今天我们可以采取一些措施来改善现状。我们将介绍如何保护构建过程，包括彻底移除机密信息；如何通过跟踪开源依赖项和制定事件响应手册来为攻击做好准备；以及在攻击期间从哪里获取信息，以及如何最小化影响。最后，我们将讨论一些潜在的信号，用于主动检测软件包可能已被入侵的情况。

upstream_only.title: SPIRIT: Batch Hintless Single-Server PIR via Stateful Ciphertext Conversion
upstream_only.abstract: This work proposes a single-server private information retrieval (PIR) protocol for the efficient evaluation of batched queries without offline hints. It has recently been shown that hintless PIR can be established through the cross-scheme ciphertext conversion technique. However, we point out that such a conversion introduces a considerable amount of computational and communication overheads in the batch PIR setting. To tackle the performance challenge, we propose SPIRIT, a batch, hintless, and single-server PIR protocol that leverages stateful ciphertext conversion to simultaneously achieve high-throughput query execution and low communication cost. To enhance computational efficiency, we develop a novel stateful key expansion procedure that amortizes the conversion cost across multiple queries, significantly accelerating the query evaluation speed. To reduce the communication overhead, we derive a new response compression strategy based on a shared intermediate representation, such that a batch of PIR responses can be packed into a single ciphertext efficiently. In experiments, we show that SPIRIT can achieve up to by 3.1×−5.1× speedup in query execution and reduce the communication bandwidth by 2.3×−3.6× compared to state-of-the-art batch PIR protocols.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种单服务器私有信息检索（PIR）协议，用于在无需离线提示的情况下高效执行批量查询。最近的研究表明，无提示PIR可以通过跨方案密文转换技术来实现。然而，我们指出这种转换在批量PIR场景中会引入大量的计算和通信开销。为了解决性能挑战，我们提出了SPIRIT，一种批量、无提示且单服务器的PIR协议。它利用有状态密文转换来同时实现高吞吐量查询执行和低通信成本。为了提高计算效率，我们开发了一种新颖的有状态密钥扩展过程，将转换成本分摊到多个查询上，从而显著加速查询评估速度。为了降低通信开销，我们基于共享中间表示推导出一种新的响应压缩策略，使得一批PIR响应可以高效地打包到单个密文中。实验表明，与最先进的批量PIR协议相比，SPIRIT在查询执行方面可实现高达3.1倍至5.1倍的加速，并将通信带宽减少2.3倍至3.6倍。

upstream_only.title: Your Keywords Know Each Other: Breaking SSE with <1% Leaked Documents
upstream_only.abstract:
Searchable symmetric encryption (SSE) schemes inevitably leak search, access, and volume patterns, which adversaries can exploit along with partial knowledge of the data to recover documents and queries. Prior passive attacks rely on document-keyword occurrence matching, but under realistic low leakage, many keywords induce identical patterns, forming large ambiguous groups that sharply limit recovery.
We observe this failure arises from missing relational signals among keywords. Keywords, however, exhibit stable semantic regularities across corpora even when direct co-occurrence is sparse, allowing external linguistic knowledge to augment observed leakage. Based on this insight, we present Whisper, a staged co-occurrence augmented query recovery framework that weaves LLM-synthesized corpora with pre-trained embeddings to densify co-occurrence matrices and disambiguate otherwise indistinguishable candidates.
We evaluate Whisper on six diverse real-world datasets, including three collected in late 2025 to test generalization beyond LLM training cutoffs. At 0.1% leakage, previously considered safe, Whisper boosts correct query recovery from 1727% under current SOTA to 36–49% across all datasets, a 22.5× improvement. Even at 1% leakage, Whisper approaches near-complete recovery, exceeding 80% on most datasets and peaking at 95%, while remaining effective against padding and volume hiding defenses, exposing a previously underestimated vulnerability in SSE.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 可搜索对称加密（SSE）方案不可避免地泄露搜索、访问和体积模式，敌手可以利用这些模式以及部分数据知识来恢复文档和查询。先前的被动攻击依赖于文档-关键词出现匹配，但在现实的低泄露条件下，许多关键词会产生相同模式，形成大型歧义组，严重限制了恢复。我们观察到这一失败源于关键词之间缺失的关系信号。然而，即使在直接共现稀疏的情况下，关键词在语料库中也表现出稳定的语义规律，这使得外部语言知识可以增强观察到的泄露。基于这一见解，我们提出了 Whisper，一个分阶段的共现增强查询恢复框架，它将 LLM 合成的语料库与预训练嵌入编织在一起，以稠密化共现矩阵并消歧原本不可区分的候选。我们在六个多样化的真实世界数据集上评估 Whisper，包括三个在 2025 年底收集的数据集，以测试超出 LLM 训练截止时间的泛化能力。在 0.1% 泄露（此前被认为安全）下，Whisper 将所有数据集上的正确查询恢复率从当前 SOTA 的 17–27% 提升到 36–49%，提高了 22.5 倍。即使在 1% 泄露下，Whisper 也接近完全恢复，在大多数数据集上超过 80%，最高达 95%，同时对填充和体积隐藏防御仍然有效，暴露了 SSE 中此前被低估的漏洞。

upstream_only.title: Non-Interactive Key Exchange from Lattices in the Standard Model
upstream_only.abstract: Existing non-interactive key exchange (NIKE) constructions in the CKS-heavy security model either incur loose security reductions or lack lattice instantiations due to the absence of suitable hash proof systems (HPS). To overcome this limitation, we introduce a new cryptographic primitive, named as decoupled key encapsulation mechanisms (decoupled KEMs), which separates recipient-independent ciphertext generation from recipient-specific key derivation. Moreover, we formalize the security of our decoupled KEM as MU-IND-wCCA^Corr+, which is a multi-user security notion. Based on this, we give a new framework that any decoupled KEM with MU-IND-wCCA^Corr+ implies a NIKE protocol with much tighter security in the CKS-heavy security model. For concrete instantiation, we first construct a specific HPS based on Modulus-LWE in the standard model, and then obtain a decoupled KEM with the desired security notion. Applying our framework, we obtain a lattice-based NIKE secure in the standard model, denoted NIKEHPS. NIKEHPS. achieves a linear security reduction loss in the number of users and close to the known optimum, improving upon the quadratic loss of SWOOSH (USENIX Security' 24) under CKS-heavy security. Experiments show that our protocol achieves significant speedups in key generation and shared-key derivation over SWOOSH.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现有的CKS-heavy安全模型下的非交互密钥交换（NIKE）构造要么安全归约不紧，要么由于缺乏合适的哈希证明系统（HPS）而无法给出格上实例。为克服这一限制，我们引入一种新的密码原语，称为解耦密钥封装机制（解耦KEM），它将接收者无关的密文生成与接收者特定的密钥派生分离。此外，我们将解耦KEM的安全性形式化为MU-IND-wCCA^Corr+，这是一个多用户安全概念。在此基础上，我们给出一个新框架：任何满足MU-IND-wCCA^Corr+的解耦KEM都可蕴含一个在CKS-heavy安全模型下具有更紧安全性的NIKE协议。具体实例化时，我们首先在标准模型下基于Modulus-LWE构造一个特定的HPS，然后得到一个具有所需安全概念的解耦KEM。应用我们的框架，我们获得一个标准模型下安全的基于格的NIKE，记为NIKEHPS。NIKEHPS实现了用户数量上的线性安全归约损失，接近已知最优，改进了SWOOSH（USENIX Security' 24）在CKS-heavy安全性下的二次损失。实验表明，我们的协议在密钥生成和共享密钥派生方面较SWOOSH有显著加速。

upstream_only.title: DuetORAM: Two-Server Distributed ORAM with Constant Rounds and O(log N) Communication
upstream_only.abstract:
Distributed Oblivious RAM (DORAM) is a promising building block for privacy-preserving cloud databases and outsourced storage systems. However, existing two-server designs often rely on slow linear scans or heavy cryptographic primitives, making them struggle to balance efficiency and bandwidth, and thus hindering their practical deployment.
We present DuetORAM, a two-server DORAM that achieves constant-round access with O(log N) communication while avoiding these computational bottlenecks. Our key idea is a replicated-to-shared block encoding that allows servers to keep identical ciphertexts for efficient PIR-based retrieval, while locally interpreting them as secret shares to enable oblivious eviction via a lightweight shuffle. We further design a secret-shared shuffle with an offline-online decomposition that shifts most bandwidth-intensive work to a preprocessing phase, significantly reducing online communication. We implement a prototype of DuetORAM and evaluate it under diverse network conditions. Our results show that DuetORAM outperforms both the state-of-the-art two-server scheme DUORAM (reducing retrieval latency by up to 170× in LAN settings), and three-server design S^3ORAM (reducing retrieval latency by 1.7× in LAN and accelerating eviction by 7× in LAN and 5× in WAN, respectively).
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 分布式不经意随机访问存储器（DORAM）是隐私保护云数据库和外包存储系统的有前景的构建模块。然而，现有的双服务器设计通常依赖缓慢的线性扫描或重量级密码原语，难以平衡效率与带宽，从而阻碍了实际部署。我们提出DuetORAM，一种双服务器DORAM，在避免这些计算瓶颈的同时，实现常数轮次访问和O(log N)通信。我们的核心思想是一种复制到共享的块编码，允许服务器保留相同的密文以进行高效的基于PIR的检索，同时在本地将其解释为秘密共享，从而通过轻量级混洗实现不经意驱逐。我们进一步设计了一种具有离线-在线分解的秘密共享混洗，将大多数带宽密集型工作转移到预处理阶段，显著减少在线通信。我们实现了DuetORAM的原型，并在多种网络条件下进行评估。结果表明，DuetORAM优于最先进的双服务器方案DUORAM（在局域网设置中检索延迟降低高达170倍）和三服务器设计S^3ORAM（在局域网中检索延迟降低1.7倍，在局域网中驱逐加速7倍，在广域网中加速5倍）。

upstream_only.title: HijackKV: New Threat in Position-Independent KV Cache Reuse
upstream_only.abstract:
Key-Value (KV) cache reduces inference latency in large language models (LLMs). Traditional prefix-based reuse has low cache hit rates across inference requests because it requires exact token and position matches. To improve efficiency, recent system optimizations introduce position-independent KV reuse, allowing KV cache to be reused whenever identical text chunks appear, regardless of their position in the sequence.
We show this design introduces a new threat, KV Cache Hijacking. Since KV caches are retrieved by token match but encode the context in which they were originally computed, the KV tied to a benign-looking token chunk may encode an attacker-controlled prefix. When later reused in a victim query, this contaminated KV silently hijacks the model's behavior, even if no attacker-controlled text appears in the input.
We introduce HIJACKKV, the first attack framework that systematically exploits this vulnerability, demonstrating its severity and practicality. HIJACKKV optimizes an attacker-controlled prefix, so that the KV computed for a subsequent common benign text encodes the attacker's goal, while the text remains unchanged for future cache hits. HIJACKKV achieves an average 94% success rate in a single attempt, remains effective under realistic constraints including low hit rates (10%) and frequent recomputation (50%), persists over multi-turn interactions, and transfers across models in black-box settings. We further provide design insights for building secure KV reuse systems.
upstream_only.abstract_zh:
键值（KV）缓存降低了大型语言模型（LLM）的推理延迟。传统的基于前缀的重用在不同推理请求之间的缓存命中率较低，因为它要求精确的token和位置匹配。为了提高效率，近期系统优化引入了位置无关的KV重用，允许只要出现相同的文本块就重用KV缓存，而不管其在序列中的位置。
我们表明这种设计引入了一种新威胁：KV缓存劫持。由于KV缓存通过token匹配来检索，但编码了其最初计算时的上下文，与看似良性的token块绑定的KV可能编码了攻击者控制的前缀。当稍后在受害者查询中被重用时，这种受污染的KV会静默地劫持模型的行为，即使输入中没有出现攻击者控制的文本。
我们介绍了HIJACKKV，这是首个系统性地利用该漏洞的攻击框架，展示了其严重性和实用性。HIJACKKV优化攻击者控制的前缀，使得后续常见良性文本计算出的KV编码了攻击者的目标，同时该文本保持不变以便未来缓存命中。HIJACKKV在单次尝试中平均达到94%的成功率，在现实约束下（包括10%的低命中率和50%的频繁重计算）仍然有效，在多轮交互中持续存在，并在黑盒设置中跨模型迁移。我们进一步为构建安全的KV重用系统提供了设计见解。

upstream_only.title: MarkNull: Model-Agnostic Watermark Removal in AI-Generated Images via On-Manifold Latent Manipulation
upstream_only.abstract: Digital watermarking has emerged as a critical technique for provenance and copyright attribution in AI-generated imagery, yet its robustness against realistic, model-agnostic removal attacks remains poorly explored. Existing attacks either succeed only against specific generative models or achieve removal at the cost of severe visual degradation. In this paper, we propose MarkNull, a model-agnostic watermark removal attack via on-manifold latent manipulation. MarkNull is grounded in a key observation: watermarked images exhibit a strong statistical dependency between the generated latent representation and the embedded initial noise. To quantify this dependency, we introduce the Noise-Latent Alignment Score (NLAS) and formulate an optimization objective that selectively decorrelates the latent representation from the embedded watermark while preserving semantic fidelity. Extensive evaluations across different categories of watermarking paradigms, including post-hoc, fine-tuning-based, and initial-noise-based schemes, demonstrate that MarkNull reduces average bit accuracy to 53.14%, approaching random-guessing (50%), without perceptible image degradation. To further improve scalability, we propose MarkNull-A, an amortized, optimization-free variant that distills the attack into a single forward pass, achieving 0.50 s/image with modest computational overhead. Notably, our attacks successfully compromise Google's SynthID-Image system while preserving high visual quality and transfer effectively to video watermarking. Finally, we present an attack detection mechanism as a defensive counterpart to MarkNull and MarkNull-A, highlighting the necessity of developing watermark designs resilient to model-agnostic latent-space attacks.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 数字水印已成为AI生成图像中出处和版权归属的关键技术，然而其针对现实、模型无关的移除攻击的鲁棒性仍鲜有探索。现有攻击要么仅对特定生成模型有效，要么在实现移除的同时造成严重视觉退化。本文提出MarkNull，一种通过流形上潜在操纵实现的模型无关水印移除攻击。MarkNull基于一个关键观察：带水印图像在生成的潜在表示与嵌入的初始噪声之间表现出强统计依赖。为量化这种依赖，我们引入噪声-潜在对齐分数（NLAS），并制定优化目标，选择性地使潜在表示与嵌入水印去相关，同时保持语义保真度。在不同水印范式（包括事后、微调式和初始噪声式方案）上的广泛评估表明，MarkNull将平均比特准确率降至53.14%，接近随机猜测（50%），且无可察觉的图像退化。为进一步提高可扩展性，我们提出MarkNull-A，一种摊销的、无需优化的变体，将攻击蒸馏为单次前向传播，以0.50秒/图像的速度实现且计算开销适中。值得注意的是，我们的攻击成功攻破了Google的SynthID-Image系统，同时保持高视觉质量，并可有效迁移到视频水印。最后，我们提出一种攻击检测机制，作为MarkNull和MarkNull-A的防御对应，强调开发能够抵御模型无关潜在空间攻击的水印设计的必要性。

upstream_only.title: BadGraph: Structural Knowledge Isolation Attacks against Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
upstream_only.abstract:
Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) improves cross-document reasoning by introducing graph structures into retrieval. However, these graph structures also expose an under-studied topological attack surface. Existing research on GraphRAG attacks primarily focuses on targeted attacks based on text or relation manipulation, which induce the model to generate specific incorrect answers by injecting factual errors. These attacks often rely on explicit false-answer payloads, poisoned relations, or corpus rewriting, and their documents can be easier to flag during content auditing.
In this paper, we propose a targeted availability attack against GraphRAG: Structural Knowledge Isolation. Unlike traditional wrong-answer manipulation attacks, this attack targets the system's availability by degrading retrieval of critical evidence through topological manipulation. The resulting context can lack the evidence needed for grounded answer generation. We first mathematically analyze three topological vulnerabilities of graph algorithms used in GraphRAG systems when subjected to topological perturbations. Based on this analysis, we propose the BadGraph attack framework. By injecting a small amount of semantically neutral text, it generates adversarial subgraphs in the knowledge graph and reduces the visibility of target evidence in top-ranked retrieval contexts. Experiments show that with a small document injection budget (49 documents on HotpotQA and 30 on 2WikiMultiHopQA), BadGraph consistently lowers source recall and end-to-end QA F1 on three mainstream GraphRAG systems (MS-GraphRAG, LightRAG, and FastGraphRAG), while using neutral linker documents.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 图检索增强生成（GraphRAG）通过将图结构引入检索来改进跨文档推理。然而，这些图结构也暴露了一个未被充分研究的拓扑攻击面。现有的GraphRAG攻击研究主要关注基于文本或关系操纵的目标攻击，这些攻击通过注入事实错误来诱导模型生成特定的错误答案。这类攻击通常依赖于显式的错误答案载荷、被污染的关系或语料库重写，其文档在内容审计期间更容易被标记。在本文中，我们提出了一种针对GraphRAG的目标可用性攻击：结构化知识隔离。与传统的错误答案操纵攻击不同，该攻击通过拓扑操纵降低对关键证据的检索，从而针对系统的可用性。由此产生的上下文可能缺乏生成有依据答案所需的证据。我们首先从数学上分析了GraphRAG系统中所用图算法在遭受拓扑扰动时的三种拓扑脆弱性。基于此分析，我们提出了BadGraph攻击框架。通过注入少量语义中性的文本，它在知识图谱中生成对抗性子图，并降低目标证据在排名靠前的检索上下文中的可见性。实验表明，在较小的文档注入预算下（HotpotQA上49篇文档，2WikiMultiHopQA上30篇文档），BadGraph持续降低了三种主流GraphRAG系统（MS-GraphRAG、LightRAG和FastGraphRAG）的来源召回率和端到端问答F1，同时使用中性的链接文档。

upstream_only.title: FragFuse: Bypassing Access Control of Large Language Model Agents via Memory-Based Query Fragmentation and Fusion
upstream_only.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on long-term memory to support complex task execution, user personalization, and domain adaptation. Meanwhile, emerging access-control mechanisms for LLM agents are being explored to block policy-violating requests, aiming to prevent misuse and improve resource efficiency. In this paper, we reveal a novel attack surface arising from agents' memory operations: prohibited content triggering access control can be fragmented across interactions, stored in long-term memory in a benign-appearing form, and later reconstructed through memory retrieval, without appearing explicitly in the final user query. Specifically, we propose FragFuse, the first attack that enables unprivileged users to bypass agent access control by exploiting this temporal channel introduced by long-term memory. FragFuse operates in three stages: (1) identifying rejection-responsible fragments via black-box adaptive querying with fragment masking; (2) injecting these fragments into memory using marked carrier queries; and (3) retrieving and fusing the stored fragments through a follow-up attack query. While FragFuse can be instantiated manually for individual agents, we propose an optimization scheme that tunes fusion instructions and marker designs on surrogate models, enabling automated attack generation without violating the attacker's threat model assumptions. We evaluate FragFuse across four representative agent settings and task domains, covering three state-of-the-art agent access-control mechanisms. FragFuse achieves an average bypass success rate of 86.3% and an average end-to-end harmful task success rate of 41.1% across all settings, with only 4.4% average task success rate degradation compared to configurations without access control. Additionally, we show that alternative defenses, such as state-of-the-art prompt-injection detectors and perplexity detectors, cannot effectively address our attack.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体日益依赖长期记忆来支持复杂任务执行、用户个性化和领域适应。同时，针对LLM智能体的新兴访问控制机制正在被探索，以阻止违反策略的请求，旨在防止滥用并提高资源效率。在本文中，我们揭示了智能体记忆操作带来的新型攻击面：触发访问控制的禁止内容可以跨交互被碎片化，以看似无害的形式存储在长期记忆中，随后通过记忆检索重建，而不会明确出现在最终用户查询中。具体而言，我们提出了FragFuse，这是首个使无权限用户能够利用长期记忆引入的时序信道绕过智能体访问控制的攻击。FragFuse分三个阶段运行：(1) 通过带片段掩码的黑盒自适应查询识别导致拒绝的片段；(2) 使用标记载体查询将这些片段注入记忆；(3) 通过后续攻击查询检索并融合存储的片段。虽然FragFuse可以针对单个智能体手动实例化，但我们提出了一种优化方案，在替代模型上调整融合指令和标记设计，从而在不违反攻击者威胁模型假设的情况下实现自动化攻击生成。我们在四个代表性智能体设置和任务领域中评估了FragFuse，涵盖三种最先进的智能体访问控制机制。FragFuse在所有设置中平均绕过成功率达到86.3%，平均端到端有害任务成功率达到41.1%，与无访问控制配置相比，平均任务成功率仅下降4.4%。此外，我们表明，诸如最先进的提示注入检测器和困惑度检测器等替代防御措施无法有效应对我们的攻击。

upstream_only.title: From Zero to Hero: Cross-modal-enhanced Adversarial Item Promotion Attack against Multimodal Recommender Systems
upstream_only.abstract: Multimodal recommender systems (MRSs) jointly leverage visual and textual item representations to determine item ranking and exposure in modern online platforms. Their strong dependence on item content, however, introduces new security risks. In particular, malicious sellers can conduct the adversarial item promotion (AIP) attack to manipulate item content to deceive the recommender into overranking specific items. When it succeeds, the promoted items gain disproportionately higher exposure, leading to significant market visibility and direct economic gain. However, existing AIP research primarily targets unimodal recommenders, leaving the unique vulnerabilities of MRSs largely unexplored. Meanwhile, multimodal adversarial attacks for vision–language models (VLMs) optimize objectives unrelated to ranking and lack cross-modal coordination unique to MRSs. To bridge this gap, we propose CREAM (CRoss-modal-Enhanced AIP attack against MRSs). Our key insight is to jointly perturb multiple modalities in a semantically consistent manner}. We integrate a tailored visual perturbator, a text generator, and a joint optimization controller to fully exploit cross-modal correlations in a black-box setting. Our comprehensive evaluation shows that CREAM significantly outperforms existing methods, achieving on average 5.75x and 2.89x higher exposure at top-10 and top-50 metrics, and demonstrates robustness under evolving real-world conditions. This exposes a tangible economic risk to recommender platforms. Meanwhile, CREAM maintains high imperceptibility across visual, textual, and cross-modal dimensions. We further investigate several potential defense strategies and demonstrate their limitations, highlighting the urgent need for stronger protections against adversarial threats in MRSs.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 多模态推荐系统（MRSs）联合利用视觉和文本物品表示来确定现代在线平台中的物品排名和曝光。然而，它们对物品内容的高度依赖引入了新的安全风险。特别是，恶意卖家可以执行对抗性物品推广（AIP）攻击，操纵物品内容以欺骗推荐系统对特定物品进行过度排名。当攻击成功时，被推广的物品获得不成比例的高曝光，带来显著的市场可见性和直接经济收益。然而，现有的AIP研究主要针对单模态推荐系统，使得MRSs特有的脆弱性在很大程度上未被探索。同时，针对视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的多模态对抗攻击优化的目标与排名无关，并且缺乏MRSs特有的跨模态协调。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了CREAM（针对MRSs的跨模态增强AIP攻击）。我们的关键见解是以语义一致的方式联合扰动多个模态。我们集成了一个定制的视觉扰动器、一个文本生成器和一个联合优化控制器，以在黑盒设置下充分利用跨模态相关性。我们的综合评估表明，CREAM显著优于现有方法，在top-10和top-50指标上平均分别实现了5.75倍和2.89倍更高的曝光，并在不断变化的现实条件下表现出鲁棒性。这给推荐平台带来了切实的经济风险。同时，CREAM在视觉、文本和跨模态维度上保持了高不可感知性。我们进一步研究了几种潜在的防御策略并展示了它们的局限性，突显了针对MRSs中对抗性威胁需要更强保护的紧迫性。

upstream_only.title: Low-Cost Hard-Label Adversarial Attack with Theoretical Foundations
upstream_only.abstract: Hard-label black-box attacks, relying solely on top-1 predictions, represent one of the most challenging yet practically threat models. Despite recent progress, existing approaches face two key limitations: (1) they overlook the critical role of initialization, focusing primarily on optimization strategies; and (2) they rely heavily on empirical heuristics without theoretical guarantees. To bridge this gap, we establish a unified theoretical framework showing that existing sign-flipping hard-label attacks can be understood as approximating the true gradient sign. Guided by this {principled analysis}, we propose a novel attack framework featuring a zero-query initialization strategy and a Pattern-Driven Optimization (PDO) algorithm. We provide theoretical guarantees that our initialization yields higher cosine similarity to the true gradient sign than random baselines, and our PDO module achieves significantly lower query complexity than baseline search methods. Extensive experiments across CIFAR-10, ImageNet, and ObjectNet—covering standard and adversarially trained models, commercial APIs, and CLIP models—demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms SOTA hard-label attacks in both success rate and efficiency, particularly under low query budgets. Furthermore, our method demonstrates robust generalization across corrupted data (ImageNet-C), biomedical images (PathMNIST), and dense prediction tasks such as segmentation. Notably, it bypasses the stateful defense Blacklight, achieving a 0% detection rate.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 硬标签黑盒攻击仅依赖 top-1 预测，是最具挑战性但也最切实的威胁模型之一。尽管近期取得了进展，现有方法仍面临两个关键局限：(1) 它们忽视了初始化的关键作用，主要关注优化策略；(2) 它们严重依赖经验启发式方法，缺乏理论保证。为弥补这一空白，我们建立了一个统一的理论框架，表明现有的符号翻转硬标签攻击可以理解为对真实梯度符号的近似。在这一原则性分析的指导下，我们提出了一种新的攻击框架，其特色是零查询初始化策略和模式驱动优化（PDO）算法。我们提供理论保证：我们的初始化比随机基线具有更高的与真实梯度符号的余弦相似度，并且我们的 PDO 模块比基线搜索方法实现了显著更低的查询复杂度。在 CIFAR-10、ImageNet 和 ObjectNet 上的大量实验——涵盖标准和对抗训练模型、商业 API 以及 CLIP 模型——表明我们的方法在成功率和效率上始终优于最先进的硬标签攻击，尤其是在低查询预算下。此外，我们的方法在损坏数据（ImageNet-C）、生物医学图像（PathMNIST）以及分割等密集预测任务上表现出稳健的泛化能力。值得注意的是，它绕过了有状态防御 Blacklight，实现了 0% 的检测率。

upstream_only.title: BlockMeNot: Automatic Selection of Domain and URL Blocking Granularity to Minimize Collateral Damage and Evasion
upstream_only.abstract: Domain and URL blocking is a fundamental mechanism for mitigating malicious, illegal, and inappropriate online content. Yet, selecting the right blocking granularity remains a largely unexplored problem. Overblocking can cause severe collateral damage if the content to be blocked uses the infrastructure of benign services, which may be unintentionally disrupted. Underblocking instead enables trivial evasion. This paper addresses this gap by proposing a novel approach that, given a domain or URL to be blocked, automatically selects the most appropriate blocking granularity (URL, subdomain, or apex) to minimize collateral damage and evasion opportunities. At the core of our approach are two novel machine learning classifiers to identify URL-leasing and subdomain-leasing apexes. The classifiers are trained and evaluated using a manually labeled dataset of 10,843 apexes, achieving F1 scores over 0.9. We implement our approach into BlockMeNot, a tool for identifying potential collateral damage prior to enforcement. We evaluate BlockMeNot on 225,355 entries (i.e., domains and URLs) collected from six blocklists and two threat exchanges. Although only 2.6% of apexes belong to leasers, they host 34.7% of the entries, and up to 71.7% in phishing-focused blocklists, underscoring the importance of fine-grained blocking. BlockMeNot identifies 1,976 leasing apexes, 59.3% of which were not in our ground truth, demonstrating the limitations of static lists and the need for our classifiers. Only 37.2% of blocklist entries are listed at the optimal granularity, 1.3% produce collateral damage, and 61.6% enable easy evasion. Overall, our work provides the first automated solution for domain and URL blocking granularity selection and offers practical guidance for block requesters, executors, and blocklist maintainers.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 域名和URL屏蔽是缓解恶意、非法和不当在线内容的基本机制。然而，选择正确的屏蔽粒度仍然是一个很大程度上未被探索的问题。如果待屏蔽内容使用了良性服务的基础设施，过度屏蔽可能导致严重的附带损害，可能无意中干扰这些服务。相反，屏蔽不足则会导致轻易规避。本文针对这一空白，提出了一种新颖方法：给定要屏蔽的域名或URL，自动选择最合适的屏蔽粒度（URL、子域名或根域名），以最小化附带损害和规避机会。我们方法的核心是两个新颖的机器学习分类器，用于识别URL租赁和子域名租赁的根域名。这些分类器使用手动标记的10,843个根域名数据集进行训练和评估，F1分数超过0.9。我们将该方法实现为BlockMeNot，一个用于在强制执行前识别潜在附带损害的工具。我们在从六个屏蔽列表和两个威胁交换平台收集的225,355个条目（即域名和URL）上评估BlockMeNot。尽管只有2.6%的根域名属于租赁者，但它们承载了34.7%的条目，在专注于网络钓鱼的屏蔽列表中这一比例高达71.7%，凸显了细粒度屏蔽的重要性。BlockMeNot识别出1,976个租赁根域名，其中59.3%不在我们的真实标注中，这展示了静态列表的局限性以及我们分类器的必要性。只有37.2%的屏蔽列表条目以最优粒度列出，1.3%产生附带损害，61.6%使规避变得容易。总体而言，我们的工作提供了首个用于域名和URL屏蔽粒度选择的自动化解决方案，并为屏蔽请求者、执行者和屏蔽列表维护者提供了实用指导。

upstream_only.title: H3Act: Automated Measuring Semantic Conversion Anomalies of HTTP/3-to-HTTP/1.1 Translation in CDNs
upstream_only.abstract: Content Delivery Networks (CDNs) are adopting HTTP/3 to enhance performance; however, they often need to convert it to HTTP/1.1 for compatibility. This conversion creates significant attack surfaces and may reintroduce confirmed or even patched vulnerabilities in HTTP/2 or HTTP/1. Unfortunately, existing tools struggle to adapt to the HTTP/3 environment and efficiently leverage accumulated attack knowledge. To overcome these challenges and systematically measure HTTP/3-to-HTTP/1.1 conversion anomalies within the black-box CDN environment, we present H3Act, a dual-agent, knowledge-driven fuzzing framework targeting HTTP/3-to-HTTP/1.1 semantic conversion anomalies. Our approach combines Large Language Models (LLMs) with Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to automatically transform protocol specifications and historical threat intelligence into high-precision HTTP/3 test payloads, enabling regression testing of semantic translation risks. In a large-scale study of 9 commercial CDNs, including Cloudflare, Cloudfront, and Tencent CDN, we found a significant regression in protocol security, which means vulnerabilities in old protocols are reintroduced in HTTP/3. Our research identified 7 common attack vectors across various categories, including request smuggling, cache poisoning, and Denial-of-Service (DoS) amplification. Every CDN is vulnerable to at least one attack vector. We have responsibly disclosed these vulnerabilities and have received confirmations from some vendors. These findings highlight that the CDN ecosystem currently lacks the capacity to maintain security consistency checks while pursuing improvements in protocol performance.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 内容分发网络（CDN）正在采用HTTP/3以提升性能；然而，为了兼容性，它们通常需要将其转换为HTTP/1.1。这种转换为攻击面创造了显著空间，并可能重新引入HTTP/2或HTTP/1中已确认甚至已修补的漏洞。不幸的是，现有工具难以适应HTTP/3环境并高效利用积累的攻击知识。为克服这些挑战并在黑盒CDN环境中系统性地测量HTTP/3到HTTP/1.1转换异常，我们提出了H3Act，一个双智能体、知识驱动的模糊测试框架，针对HTTP/3到HTTP/1.1语义转换异常。我们的方法将大型语言模型（LLM）与混合检索增强生成（RAG）相结合，自动将协议规范和历史威胁情报转化为高精度HTTP/3测试载荷，从而实现对语义转换风险的回归测试。在对9个商业CDN（包括Cloudflare、Cloudfront和腾讯CDN）的大规模研究中，我们发现协议安全性出现显著回归，这意味着旧协议中的漏洞在HTTP/3中被重新引入。我们的研究识别出跨多个类别的7种常见攻击向量，包括请求走私、缓存投毒和拒绝服务（DoS）放大。每个CDN都至少容易受到一种攻击向量的影响。我们已负责任地披露这些漏洞，并收到部分厂商的确认。这些发现突出表明，CDN生态系统目前在追求协议性能提升的同时，缺乏维持安全一致性检查的能力。

upstream_only.title: JScamd: An Automated Static Taint Analysis Framework for Detecting Cryptographic API Misuses in JavaScript
upstream_only.abstract:
Cryptographic APIs are essential to application security, yet frequent developer misuse leads to widespread vulnerabilities. Detecting cryptographic misuse in JavaScript is challenging due to its dynamic semantics and fragmented cryptographic library ecosystem, which hinder static analysis tools from accurately modeling data flows and covering non-standard or evolving libraries, leading to high false-negative rates.
In this paper, we propose JScamd, a static analysis framework for scalable detection of cryptographic misuse in JavaScript. JScamd integrates an enhanced program representation engine, an LLM-assisted taint rule generation pipeline, and a precise static taint analysis engine to address JavaScript dynamic features. Building upon 16 systematically defined cryptographic security constraints, JScamd automatically analyzes cryptographic APIs, identifies security-sensitive taint sources and sinks, and synthesizes comprehensive taint analysis rules. This design enables accurate detection of cryptographic misuse across diverse JavaScript libraries and application scenarios. We performed a comprehensive large-scale evaluation on 322 widely adopted JavaScript projects. JScamd detects 1,059 misuses and achieves 97.78% precision, significantly outperforming three state-of-the-art tools. Our analysis further uncovers previously unknown vulnerabilities, resulting in 41 assigned CVEs. These results demonstrate that JScamd effectively bridges cryptographic security specifications and ecosystem-scale vulnerability detection in JavaScript.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 密码API对应用安全至关重要，然而开发者频繁的误用导致广泛漏洞。由于JavaScript的动态语义和碎片化的密码库生态系统，检测JavaScript中的密码误用颇具挑战，这阻碍了静态分析工具准确建模数据流并覆盖非标准或不断演化的库，导致高漏报率。本文提出JScamd，一个用于可扩展检测JavaScript中密码误用的静态分析框架。JScamd集成了增强的程序表示引擎、LLM辅助的污点规则生成流水线以及精确的静态污点分析引擎，以应对JavaScript动态特性。基于16个系统定义的密码安全约束，JScamd自动分析密码API，识别安全敏感的污点源和汇聚点，并合成全面的污点分析规则。该设计能够跨多样化的JavaScript库和应用场景准确检测密码误用。我们在322个广泛采用的JavaScript项目上进行了全面大规模评估。JScamd检测到1,059处误用，精确率达97.78%，显著优于三个最先进的工具。我们的分析进一步揭示了此前未知的漏洞，获得41个分配的CVE。这些结果表明JScamd有效桥接了JavaScript中密码安全规范与生态系统规模漏洞检测之间的鸿沟。

upstream_only.title: BUIzz: Finding Policy Enforcement Bugs via Interaction Simulation on the Browser User Interface
upstream_only.abstract:
Modern web ecosystems rely on security policy headers, such as Content Security Policy (CSP) and the SameSite cookie attribute, for client-side defenses. Because browsers enforce these headers, browser bugs in policy enforcement directly undermine these defenses. While recent studies have attempted to find such bugs, they largely overlook bugs triggered by user interactions on the browser user interface (BUI).
In this paper, we propose BUIZZ, the first testing framework that identifies policy enforcement bugs triggered by BUI-level user interactions. BUIZZ first collects a comprehensive set of interactions by referencing browser manuals, right-click context menus, and known browser bugs. It then executes each interaction and their combinations on the test pages via OS-level simulation. Instead of cross-browser differential testing, BUIZZ leverages a pre/post-interaction oracle that checks for enforcement inconsistencies before and after applying interactions, enabling bug detection within a single browser. We demonstrate the efficacy of BUIZZ by finding 35 security bugs and three functional bugs across six browsers, including Chrome and Firefox. Our reports have led to fixes for 14 security bugs, resulting in seven CVEs and $14,700 in bug bounties.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 现代Web生态系统依赖安全策略头，如内容安全策略（CSP）和SameSite cookie属性，来实现客户端防御。由于浏览器执行这些头，策略执行中的浏览器缺陷会直接削弱这些防御。虽然近期研究试图发现此类缺陷，但它们在很大程度上忽略了由浏览器用户界面（BUI）上的用户交互触发的缺陷。在本文中，我们提出BUIZZ，这是首个识别由BUI级用户交互触发的策略执行缺陷的测试框架。BUIZZ首先通过参考浏览器手册、右键上下文菜单和已知浏览器缺陷来收集一组全面的交互。然后，它通过操作系统级模拟在测试页面上执行每个交互及其组合。BUIZZ不采用跨浏览器差分测试，而是利用交互前/后预言机，检查应用交互前后执行的不一致性，从而在单个浏览器内实现缺陷检测。我们通过发现六个浏览器（包括Chrome和Firefox）中的35个安全缺陷和三个功能缺陷，证明了BUIZZ的有效性。我们的报告已促成14个安全缺陷的修复，产生了七个CVE和14,700美元漏洞赏金。

upstream_only.title: Raising the Flag: Detecting Missing Permission Controls in Mini-Program APIs
upstream_only.abstract: Mini-programs embedded within super-apps like WeChat have surged in popularity due to their flexibility and convenience, offering rich functionalities through underlying APIs. However, this tight integration introduces serious security risks: mini-programs often inherit the mobile operating system's permissions granted to their host super-app, potentially bypassing critical security checks. In this paper, we address the urgent need for more fine-grained access control tailored to mini-programs. We propose PERMSCOPE, a systematic framework to detect and analyze missing scope checks in mini-program APIs, revealing instances where Android permissions are implicitly inherited and exercised in mini-program APIs, i.e., cases where "ask and check'' primitives are absent. Our empirical analysis of four major super-apps reveals that 183 (8.85%) APIs are not properly protected at the mini-program API layer. We discuss the challenges underlying this issue and advocate for super-app developers to enforce fine-grained access control mechanisms at the API boundary, thereby strengthening the trustworthiness of the mobile super-app ecosystem.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 嵌入微信等超级应用中的小程序因其灵活性和便利性而迅速流行，通过底层 API 提供丰富的功能。然而，这种紧密集成带来了严重的安全风险：小程序通常继承宿主超级应用所获得的移动操作系统权限，可能绕过关键的安全检查。在本文中，我们针对小程序更细粒度访问控制的迫切需求，提出了 PERMSCOPE，一个系统化框架，用于检测和分析小程序 API 中缺失的作用域检查，揭示 Android 权限被隐式继承并在小程序 API 中行使的情况，即缺少“询问并检查”（ask and check）原语的情形。我们对四大超级应用的实证分析表明，有 183 个（8.85%）API 在小程序 API 层没有得到适当保护。我们讨论了该问题背后的挑战，并倡导超级应用开发者在 API 边界实施细粒度访问控制机制，从而增强移动超级应用生态系统的可信度。

upstream_only.title: Meerkat: Pushing the Practical Limits of Dynamic Bisection with PoC Mutation
upstream_only.abstract: Once a Linux kernel bug is identified, the developers perform the difficult task of patching it. Triage tools such as Syz-bisect provide a form of root cause analysis called bisection, which systematically checks historical kernel commits for the presence of the bug until it determines the Bug-Introducing Commit (BiC). Unfortunately, Syz-bisect correctly identifies the BiC for only 35% of bugs. In order to improve Syz-bisect while remaining within its time and resource constraints, we identify three areas where Syz-bisect could be improved: bug deduplication, the use of all available PoCs, and PoC mutation. Our solution Meerkat is the first dynamic bisection tool to apply scalable PoC mutation, improving over Syz-bisect by 64%. Through an in-depth manual analysis of Meerkat's bisection results, we find that dynamic bisection is critically limited by bug detectors changing with kernel versions, changes near the buggy code, and unrelated bugs that block dynamic analysis. Based on the nature of these issues, we argue that Meerkat is approaching the practical limits of what is possible with dynamic bisection in the real world. Furthermore, we correct the ground truth for 13 bugs, thus improving the dataset for future research.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 一旦Linux内核漏洞被识别，开发者就要执行修补它的艰巨任务。诸如Syz-bisect之类的分类工具提供了一种称为二分定位的根本原因分析，它系统地检查历史内核提交中是否存在该漏洞，直到确定引入漏洞的提交（BiC）。不幸的是，Syz-bisect仅能正确识别35%漏洞的BiC。为了在保持其时间和资源约束的前提下改进Syz-bisect，我们识别出Syz-bisect可以改进的三个领域：漏洞去重、使用所有可用的PoC以及PoC变异。我们的解决方案Meerkat是首个应用可扩展PoC变异的动态二分定位工具，相比Syz-bisect提升了64%。通过对Meerkat的二分定位结果进行深入人工分析，我们发现动态二分定位受到随内核版本变化的漏洞检测器、有缺陷代码附近的更改以及阻塞动态分析的不相关漏洞的严重限制。基于这些问题的性质，我们认为Meerkat正逼近现实世界中动态二分定位所能达到的实用极限。此外，我们修正了13个漏洞的真值，从而为未来研究改进了数据集。

upstream_only.title: BenchChecker: Assessing the Credibility of Bug-Fixing Benchmarks for LLMs
upstream_only.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise for Automatic Program Repair (APR), existing benchmarks suffer from data contamination, in which test samples appear in training sets, artificially inflating performance. To address this, we propose BenchChecker, a framework compatible with both open-source and closed-source models that supports more credible evaluation by detecting such contamination. Grounded in the observation that persistent patches likely remain in recent repository snapshots used for training, BenchChecker employs a forensics-based two-stage detection process using only textual model outputs together with public repository history. The first stage conducts a repository presence test by probing the model with code prefixes to infer training inclusion; the second stage performs a patch presence test to verify patch persistence via similarity alignment and test-suite verification. Evaluations using StarCoder-15B, StarCoder2-15B, and CodeGen2-16B trained on The Stack v2 demonstrate that BenchChecker achieves robust detection with AUC scores around 0.9 across six benchmarks. Furthermore, applying BenchChecker to SWE-bench Verified and Multi-SWE-bench reveals that filtering contaminated samples reduces the reported resolution rates of most LLMs by more than 20% relative to the original rates on medium-difficulty tasks.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）在自动程序修复（APR）方面显示出前景，但现有基准存在数据污染问题，即测试样本出现在训练集中，人为地夸大了性能。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了BenchChecker，一个兼容开源和闭源模型的框架，通过检测此类污染来支持更可信的评估。基于持久性补丁可能保留在用于训练的近期仓库快照中的观察，BenchChecker采用基于取证的两阶段检测过程，仅使用文本模型输出和公共仓库历史。第一阶段通过用代码前缀探测模型来进行仓库存在性测试，以推断训练包含情况；第二阶段进行补丁存在性测试，通过相似性对齐和测试套件验证来验证补丁的持久性。使用在The Stack v2上训练的StarCoder-15B、StarCoder2-15B和CodeGen2-16B进行评估，结果表明BenchChecker在六个基准上实现了稳健的检测，AUC分数约为0.9。此外，将BenchChecker应用于SWE-bench Verified和Multi-SWE-bench，发现过滤受污染样本后，大多数LLM报告的中等难度任务解决率相对于原始率下降了20%以上。

upstream_only.title: Firmenstein: Scaling Dynamic Analysis for Linux-Based Firmware Services via API-Centric Intervention Code Synthesis
upstream_only.abstract:
The rapid proliferation of Linux-based IoT devices necessitates rigorous security analysis. To achieve scalable, hardware-free analysis, firmware rehosting has become essential for constructing faithful emulated environments. However, existing approaches rely on inflexible heuristics to perform semantic-agnostic interventions, failing to generalize to diverse targets and leaving many firmware samples unanalyzable.
In this paper, we propose FIRMENSTEIN, a novel API-centric framework that unifies the complex and cumbersome rehosting process into a systematic program analysis and synthesis task. Specifically, we introduce an agentic cross-program analysis built upon the API Dependency Graph to automatically diagnose rehosting roadblocks. Guided by these diagnostics, FIRMENSTEIN further introduces a roadblock-driven workflow to synthesize high-fidelity intervention code that resolves environmental dependencies, thereby enabling successful firmware execution. Evaluation on an LFwC-based dataset demonstrates that FIRMENSTEIN enables 2.5×, 3.1×, and 2.1× more firmware samples to reach interact states than the state-of-the-art rehosting tools Greenhouse, FirmAE, and Penguin, respectively. Even with incomplete rehosting, FIRMENSTEIN executes 29% more basic blocks than Greenhouse. Furthermore, FIRMENSTEIN executes 5.2% more basic blocks than Greenhouse in interactive testing, validates 29 out of 31 known N-day vulnerabilities, and facilitates the discovery of 43 previously unknown vulnerabilities, with 19 CVE IDs assigned to date.
upstream_only.abstract_zh: 基于Linux的IoT设备的快速普及需要进行严格的安全分析。为了实现可扩展、无需硬件的分析，固件重宿主已成为构建高保真仿真环境的关键。然而，现有方法依赖不灵活的启发式规则来执行语义无关的干预，无法泛化到多样化的目标，并导致许多固件样本无法被分析。在本文中，我们提出FIRMENSTEIN，一种新颖的以API为中心的框架，将复杂繁琐的重宿主过程统一为系统化的程序分析与合成任务。具体而言，我们引入基于API依赖图的代理式跨程序分析，以自动诊断重宿主障碍。在这些诊断的指导下，FIRMENSTEIN进一步引入障碍驱动的工作流，合成高保真干预代码以解决环境依赖，从而实现成功的固件执行。在基于LFwC的数据集上的评估表明，与最先进的重宿主工具Greenhouse、FirmAE和Penguin相比，FIRMENSTEIN分别使多2.5倍、3.1倍和2.1倍的固件样本达到交互状态。即使重宿主不完整，FIRMENSTEIN执行的基本块比Greenhouse多29%。此外，在交互测试中，FIRMENSTEIN执行的基本块比Greenhouse多5.2%，验证了31个已知N-day漏洞中的29个，并促进了43个先前未知漏洞的发现，其中19个已分配CVE ID。

upstream_only.title: CULPA: Universal Detection of Memory-Safety Bugs in Unsafe Rust Through the Lens of Safety Requirements
upstream_only.abstract: Rust has emerged as a leading system programming language by providing strong compile-time guarantees for memory safety. However, these guarantees do not extend to unsafe Rust, where developers may bypass compiler checks and inadvertently introduce memory-safety vulnerabilities. Although prior static analyzers have made progress in detecting such bugs, existing approaches are often fragmented: they target specific coding patterns or bug classes without modeling the underlying causes of unsafety. In this paper, we present CULPA, a universal detector for memory-safety bugs in Rust programs. The key insight of CULPA is to detect the root cause of such bugs: the violation of safety requirements in unsafe Rust contexts. To do so, CULPA first transforms the safety requirements in the standard library documentation into machine-executable predicates. Then it constructs the distinct memory segments to comply with safety requirements. Finally, CULPA collects all safety-relevant safeguards to construct the Requirement Graph. Based on the requirement graph traversal, we can determine whether violations inside unsafe blocks can be triggered. CULPA covers existing bug classes addressed by four prior static analyzers and identifies additional memory-safety vulnerabilities beyond their scope. We evaluate CULPA on the top 1,000 Rust packages. CULPA uncovers 55 previously unknown (zero-day) memory-safety bugs, 29 of which have been confirmed by developers. Most of these vulnerabilities are missed by four state-of-the-art Rust static analyzers and one LLM-based tool. To date, we have received five RustSec IDs and one CVE ID.
