We answer the above-type questions by implementing a generic process within a framework, called B-AIS, which systematically evaluates AIS perception against the semantic specifications of a domain, while treating the model as a black-box. Semantics is the meaning and understanding of words in a language, and therefore, is more comprehensible for humans’ brains than the AIS pixel-level visual information. B-AIS processes the heterogeneous artifacts to be comparable, and leverages the comparison’s results to reveal AIS weaknesses in a human-understandable language. The evaluations of B-AIS for the two vision tasks of pedestrian and aircraft detection showed a F2 measure of 95\% and 85\% as well as 45\% and 72\% respectively in the dataset and model for the detection of pedestrian and aircraft variants.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: AI赋能的软件系统（AIS）广泛应用于各类视觉任务，例如自主系统的视觉感知，并广泛部署于汽车、航空和航海领域。因此，在AIS部署到公共道路等安全关键环境之前，人类评估模型的智能至关重要。本文通过衡量模型对某领域主要概念及其变体感知的完整性来评估AIS的视觉智能。例如，自主检测器的视觉感知是否足够成熟，能否识别身着万圣节服装的行人（汽车领域概念）的实例？如果模型感知概念的能力能以人类可理解的语言展现，AIS将更加可靠。例如，当领域概念“自行车”和“轮椅”都关联一个共同特征“轮子”时，坐轮椅的行人是否会被错误地识别为骑自行车的人？我们通过在一个名为B-AIS的框架内实现一个通用过程来回答上述问题，该过程根据领域的语义规范系统地评估AIS感知，同时将模型视为黑盒。语义是语言中词语的意义和理解，因此相比AIS像素级的视觉信息，更容易被人类大脑理解。B-AIS处理异构工件使其可比，并利用比较结果以人类可理解的语言揭示AIS的弱点。对行人和飞机检测两个视觉任务的评估表明，在行人变体和飞机变体的数据集和模型上，F2度量分别达到了95%和85%，以及45%和72%。

import_candidates.title: Boosting the Revealing of Detected Violations in Deep Learning Testing: A Diversity-Guided Method
import_candidates.abstract: Due to the ability to bypass the oracle problem, Metamorphic Testing (MT) has been a popular technique to test deep learning (DL) software. However, no work has taken notice of the prioritization for Metamorphic test case Pairs (MPs), which is quite essential and beneficial to the effectiveness of MT in DL testing. When the fault-sensitive MPs apt to trigger violations and expose defects are not prioritized, the revealing of some detected violations can be greatly delayed or even missed to conceal critical defects. In this paper, we propose the first method to prioritize the MPs for DL software, so as to boost the revealing of detected violations in DL testing. Specifically, we devise a new type of metric to measure the execution diversity of DL software on MPs based on the distribution discrepancy of the neuron outputs. The fault-sensitive MPs are next prioritized based on the devised diversity metric. Comprehensive evaluation results show that the proposed prioritization method and diversity metric can effectively prioritize the fault-sensitive MPs, boost the revealing of detected violations, and even facilitate the selection and design of the effective Metamorphic Relations for the image classification DL software.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 由于能够绕过预言机问题，蜕变测试（MT）已成为测试深度学习（DL）软件的流行技术。然而，尚未有工作关注蜕变测试用例对（MPs）的优先级排序，而这对于MT在DL测试中的有效性至关重要且有益。当易于触发违规并揭露缺陷的故障敏感型MPs未被优先排序时，某些已检测到违规的揭示可能会被大大延迟，甚至丢失，从而掩盖关键缺陷。在本文中，我们提出了第一种对DL软件的MPs进行优先级排序的方法，以增强DL测试中已检测到违规的揭示。具体而言，我们基于神经元输出的分布差异，设计了一种新的度量类型来衡量DL软件在MPs上的执行多样性。接下来，根据所设计的多样性度量对故障敏感型MPs进行优先级排序。综合评估结果表明，所提出的优先级排序方法和多样性度量能够有效对故障敏感型MPs进行优先级排序，增强已检测到违规的揭示，甚至有助于为图像分类DL软件选择和设计有效的蜕变关系。

import_candidates.title: BuildSonic: Detecting and Repairing Performance-Related Configuration Smells for Continuous Integration Builds
import_candidates.abstract: Despite the benefits, continuous integration (CI) can incur high costs. One of the well-recognized costs is long build time, which greatly affects the speed of software development and increases the cost in computational resources. While there exist configuration options in the CI infrastructure to accelerate builds, the CI infrastructure is often not optimally configured, leading to CI configuration smells. Attempts have been made to detect or repair CI configuration smells. However, none of them is specifically designed to improve build performance in CI. In this paper, we first create a catalog of 20 performance-related CI configuration smells (PCSs) in three tools (i.e., Travis CI, Maven and Gradle) of the CI infrastructure for Java projects. Then, we propose an automated approach, named BuildSonic, to detect and repair 15 types of PCSs by analyzing configuration files. We have conducted large-scale experiments to evaluate BuildSonic. We detected 20,318 PCSs in 99.0\% of the 4,140 Java projects, with a precision of 0.998 and a recall of 0.991. We submitted 1,138 pull requests for sampled PCSs of each PCS type, 246 and 11 of which have been respectively merged and accepted by developers. We successfully triggered CI builds before and after merging 288 pull requests, and observed an average build performance improvement of 12.4\% after repairing a PCS.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 尽管持续集成（CI）有好处，但它可能带来高成本。公认的成本之一是构建时间长，这大大影响了软件开发的速度并增加了计算资源成本。虽然CI基础设施中存在配置选项以加速构建，但CI基础设施通常未优化配置，导致CI配置坏味道。已有研究尝试检测或修复CI配置坏味道。然而，没有一项专门旨在提升CI构建性能。本文首先在Java项目CI基础设施的三个工具（即Travis CI、Maven和Gradle）中创建了20种与性能相关的CI配置坏味道（PCS）目录。然后，我们提出了一种自动化方法，名为BuildSonic，通过分析配置文件来检测和修复15种PCS类型。我们进行了大规模实验来评估BuildSonic。在4140个Java项目中的99.0%中检测到20318个PCS，精确度为0.998，召回率为0.991。我们为每种PCS类型的采样PCS提交了1138个拉取请求，其中246个已合并，11个被开发者接受。我们成功地在288个拉取请求合并前后触发了CI构建，并观察到修复PCS后平均构建性能提高了12.4%。

import_candidates.title: Call Me Maybe: Using NLP to Automatically Generate Unit Test Cases Respecting Temporal Constraints
import_candidates.abstract: A class may need to obey temporal constraints in order to function correctly. For example, the correct usage protocol for an iterator is to always check whether there is a next element before asking for it; iterating over a collection when there are no items left leads to a NoSuchElementException. Automatic test case generation tools such as Randoop and EvoSuite do not have any notion of these temporal constraints. Generating test cases by randomly invoking methods on a new instance of the class under test may raise run time exceptions that do not necessarily expose software faults, but are rather a consequence of violations of temporal properties. This paper presents CallMeMaybe, a novel technique that uses natural language processing to analyze Javadoc comments to identify temporal constraints. This information can guide a test case generator towards executing sequences of method calls that respect the temporal constraints. Our evaluation on 73 subjects from seven popular Java systems shows that CallMeMaybe achieves a precision of 83\% and a recall of 70\% when translating temporal constraints into Java expressions. For the two biggest subjects, the integration with Randoop flags 11,818 false alarms and enriches 12,024 correctly failing test cases due to violations of temporal constraints with clear explanation that can help software developers.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 一个类可能需要遵守时间约束才能正确运行。例如，迭代器的正确使用协议是在请求下一个元素之前始终检查是否存在下一个元素；当没有剩余项时遍历集合会导致NoSuchElementException。自动测试用例生成工具（如Randoop和EvoSuite）没有这些时间约束的概念。通过对被测类的新实例随机调用方法来生成测试用例可能会引发运行时异常，这些异常未必暴露软件缺陷，而是违反时间特性的结果。本文介绍了CallMeMaybe，一种使用自然语言处理分析Javadoc注释以识别时间约束的新技术。该信息可引导测试用例生成器执行遵循时间约束的方法调用序列。我们在来自七个流行Java系统的73个主题上的评估表明，CallMeMaybe在将时间约束转换为Java表达式时达到了83%的精确度和70%的召回率。对于最大的两个主题，与Randoop的集成标记了11,818个误报，并由于违反时间约束而丰富了12,024个正确失败的测试用例，并配有清晰的解释，可帮助软件开发人员。

import_candidates.title: CARGO: AI-Guided Dependency Analysis for Migrating Monolithic Applications to Microservices Architecture
import_candidates.abstract: Microservices Architecture (MSA) has become a de-facto standard for designing cloud-native enterprise applications due to its efficient infrastructure setup, service availability, elastic scalability, dependability, and better security. Existing (monolithic) systems must be decomposed into microservices to harness these characteristics. Since manual decomposition of large scale applications can be laborious and error-prone, AI-based systems to decompose applications are gaining popularity. However, the usefulness of these approaches is limited by the expressiveness of the program representation and their inability to model the application’s dependency on critical external resources such as databases. Consequently, partitioning recommendations offered by current tools result in architectures that result in (a) distributed monoliths, and/or (b) force the use of (often criticized) distributed transactions. This work attempts to overcome these challenges by introducing CARGO (short for Context-sensitive lAbel pRopaGatiOn)—a novel un-/semi-supervised partition refinement technique that uses a context- and flow-sensitive system dependency graph of the monolithic application to refine and thereby enrich the partitioning quality of the current state-of-the-art algorithms. CARGO was used to augment four state-of-the-art microservice partitioning techniques (comprised of 1 industrial tool and 3 open-source projects). These were applied on five Java EE applications (comprised of 1 proprietary and 4 open source projects). Experiments show that CARGO is capable of improving the partition quality of all four partitioning techniques. Further, CARGO substantially reduces distributed transactions, and a real-world performance evaluation of a benchmark application (deployed under varying loads) shows that CARGO also lowers the overall the latency of the deployed microservice application by 11\% and increases throughput by 120\% on average.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 微服务架构（MSA）已成为设计云原生企业应用的事实标准，因为它具备高效的基础设施设置、服务可用性、弹性可扩展性、可靠性和更好的安全性。为了充分利用这些特性，现有（单体）系统必须被分解为微服务。由于人工分解大规模应用既费时又容易出错，基于AI的系统分解应用正日益流行。然而，这些方法的有用性受限于程序表示的表达能力及其对关键外部资源（如数据库）依赖的建模能力。因此，当前工具提供的划分建议往往导致：(a) 分布式单体，和/或 (b) 强制使用（常被批评的）分布式事务。本工作通过引入CARGO（Context-sensitive lAbel pRopaGatiOn的缩写）——一种新颖的有监督/无监督划分细化技术，利用单体应用的上下文和流敏感系统依赖图来细化并丰富当前最先进算法的划分质量，从而试图克服这些挑战。CARGO被用于增强四种最先进的微服务划分技术（包括1个工业工具和3个开源项目），并应用于五个Java EE应用（包括1个专有项目和4个开源项目）。实验表明，CARGO能够提高所有四种划分技术的划分质量。此外，CARGO大幅减少了分布式事务，并且对基准应用（在不同负载下部署）进行的真实性能评估表明，CARGO还将部署的微服务应用的整体延迟平均降低了11%，吞吐量平均提高了120%。

import_candidates.title: Checking LTL Satisfiability via End-to-end Learning
import_candidates.abstract: Linear temporal logic (LTL) satisfiability checking is a fundamental and hard (PSPACE-complete) problem. In this paper, we explore checking LTL satisfiability via end-to-end learning, so that we can take only polynomial time to check LTL satisfiability. Existing approaches have shown that it is possible to leverage end-to-end neural networks to predict the Boolean satisfiability problem with performance considerably higher than random guessing. Inspired by these approaches, we study two interesting questions: can end-to-end neural networks check LTL satisfiability, and can neural networks capture the semantics of LTL? To this end, we train different neural networks for keeping three logical properties of LTL, i.e., recursive property, permutation invariance, and sequentiality. We demonstrate that neural networks can indeed capture some effective biases for checking LTL satisfiability. Besides, designing a special neural network keeping the logical properties of LTL can provide a better inductive bias. We also show the competitive results of neural networks compared with state-of-the-art approaches, i.e., nuXmv and Aalta, on large scale datasets.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 线性时序逻辑（LTL）可满足性检查是一个基础且困难（PSPACE完备）的问题。在本文中，我们探索通过端到端学习来检查LTL可满足性，从而能够仅以多项式时间完成检查。现有方法已经表明，利用端到端神经网络预测布尔可满足性问题可以实现远高于随机猜测的性能。受这些方法的启发，我们研究两个有趣的问题：端到端神经网络能否检查LTL可满足性，以及神经网络能否捕获LTL的语义？为此，我们训练不同的神经网络以保持LTL的三个逻辑属性，即递归性、置换不变性和顺序性。我们证明神经网络确实可以捕获一些用于检查LTL可满足性的有效偏置。此外，设计保持LTL逻辑属性的特殊神经网络可以提供更好的归纳偏置。我们还展示了神经网络与最先进方法（即nuXmv和Aalta）在大规模数据集上的竞争性结果。

import_candidates.title: CoditT5: Pretraining for Source Code and Natural Language Editing
import_candidates.abstract: Pretrained language models have been shown to be effective in many software-related generation tasks; however, they are not well-suited for editing tasks as they are not designed to reason about edits. To address this, we propose a novel pretraining objective which explicitly models edits and use it to build CoditT5, a large language model for software-related editing tasks that is pretrained on large amounts of source code and natural language comments. We fine-tune it on various downstream editing tasks, including comment updating, bug fixing, and automated code review. By outperforming standard generation-based models, we demonstrate the generalizability of our approach and its suitability for editing tasks. We also show how a standard generation model and our edit-based model can complement one another through simple reranking strategies, with which we achieve state-of-the-art performance for the three downstream editing tasks.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 预训练语言模型已被证明在许多软件相关的生成任务中是有效的；然而，它们并不适合编辑任务，因为它们并非为推理编辑而设计。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种明确建模编辑的新型预训练目标，并使用它构建了CoditT5，一个用于软件相关编辑任务的大型语言模型，该模型在大量源代码和自然语言注释上进行了预训练。我们在各种下游编辑任务上对其进行微调，包括注释更新、错误修复和自动化代码审查。通过优于标准的基于生成的模型，我们证明了我们方法的泛化能力及其对编辑任务的适用性。我们还展示了标准生成模型和我们的基于编辑的模型如何通过简单的重排序策略相互补充，从而在三个下游编辑任务上实现了最先进的性能。

import_candidates.title: Compiler Testing using Template Java Programs
import_candidates.abstract: We present JAttack, a framework that enables template-based testing for compilers. Using JAttack, a developer writes a template program that describes a set of programs to be generated and given as test inputs to a compiler. Such a framework enables developers to incorporate their domain knowledge on testing compilers, giving a basic program structure that allows for exploring complex programs that can trigger sophisticated compiler optimizations. A developer writes a template program in the host language (Java) that contains holes to be filled by JAttack. Each hole, written using a domain-specific language, constructs a node within an extended abstract syntax tree (eAST). An eAST node defines the search space for the hole, i.e., a set of expressions and values. JAttack generates programs by executing templates and filling each hole by randomly choosing expressions and values (available within the search space defined by the hole). Additionally, we introduce several optimizations to reduce JAttack’s generation cost. While JAttack could be used to test various compiler features, we demonstrate its capabilities in helping test just-in-time (JIT) Java compilers, whose optimizations occur at runtime after a sufficient number of executions. Using JAttack, we have found six critical bugs that were confirmed by Oracle developers. Four of them were previously unknown, including two unknown CVEs (Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures). JAttack shows the power of combining developers’ domain knowledge (via templates) with random testing to detect bugs in JIT compilers.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了JAttack，一个支持基于模板的编译器测试的框架。使用JAttack，开发人员可以编写一个模板程序，该程序描述了一组要生成的程序，并作为编译器的测试输入。这样的框架使开发人员能够将他们对编译器测试的领域知识融入其中，提供一种基本程序结构，从而能够探索可触发复杂编译器优化的复杂程序。开发人员使用宿主语言（Java）编写模板程序，其中包含由JAttack填充的孔洞。每个孔洞使用一种领域特定语言编写，在扩展抽象语法树（eAST）中构建一个节点。eAST节点定义了孔洞的搜索空间，即一组表达式和值。JAttack通过执行模板并随机选择表达式和值（在孔洞定义的搜索空间内可用）来填充每个孔洞，从而生成程序。此外，我们引入了若干优化以减少JAttack的生成成本。虽然JAttack可用于测试各种编译器的特性，但我们展示了其在辅助测试Java即时（JIT）编译器方面的能力，此类编译器的优化在运行过程中经过足够次数的执行后才会发生。使用JAttack，我们发现了六个关键错误，已由Oracle开发人员确认。其中四个是先前未知的，包括两个未知的CVE（公共漏洞和暴露）。JAttack展示了将开发人员的领域知识（通过模板）与随机测试相结合以检测JIT编译器错误的力量。

import_candidates.title: Compressing Pre-trained Models of Code into 3 MB
import_candidates.abstract: Although large pre-trained models of code have delivered significant advancements in various code processing tasks, there is an impediment to the wide and fluent adoption of these powerful models in software developers’ daily workflow: these large models consume hundreds of megabytes of memory and run slowly on personal devices, which causes problems in model deployment and greatly degrades the user experience. It motivates us to propose Compressor, a novel approach that can compress the pre-trained models of code into extremely small models with negligible performance sacrifice. Our proposed method formulates the design of tiny models as simplifying the pre-trained model architecture: searching for a significantly smaller model that follows an architectural design similar to the original pre-trained model. Compressor proposes a genetic algorithm (GA)-based strategy to guide the simplification process. Prior studies found that a model with higher computational cost tends to be more powerful. Inspired by this insight, the GA algorithm is designed to maximize a model’s Giga floating-point operations (GFLOPs), an indicator of the model computational cost, to satisfy the constraint of the target model size. Then, we use the knowledge distillation technique to train the small model: unlabelled data is fed into the large model and the outputs are used as labels to train the small model. We evaluate Compressor with two state-of-the-art pre-trained models, i.e., CodeBERT and GraphCodeBERT, on two important tasks, i.e., vulnerability prediction and clone detection. We use our method to compress pre-trained models to a size (3 MB), which is 160 \texttimes{} smaller than the original size. The results show that compressed CodeBERT and GraphCodeBERT are 4.31 \texttimes{} and 4.15 \texttimes{} faster than the original model at inference, respectively. More importantly, they maintain and of the original performance on the vulnerability prediction task. They even maintain higher ratios ( and ) of the original performance on the clone detection task.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 尽管大规模预训练代码模型在各种代码处理任务中取得了显著进展，但阻碍这些强大模型在软件开发人员日常工作中广泛而流畅使用的一个障碍是：这些大模型消耗数百MB内存，并且在个人设备上运行缓慢，这导致模型部署问题并严重降低用户体验。这促使我们提出Compressor，一种新颖的方法，可以将预训练代码模型压缩为极小的模型，且性能损失可忽略不计。我们提出的方法将小型模型的设计表述为简化预训练模型架构：寻找一个与原始预训练模型架构设计相似但显著更小的模型。Compressor提出了一种基于遗传算法（GA）的策略来指导简化过程。先前研究发现，计算成本较高的模型往往更强大。受此启发，遗传算法被设计为最大化模型的Giga浮点运算次数（GFLOPs），即模型计算成本的指标，以满足目标模型大小的约束。然后，我们使用知识蒸馏技术来训练小模型：将未标注数据输入大模型，其输出作为标签来训练小模型。我们使用两个最先进的预训练模型（即CodeBERT和GraphCodeBERT）在两个重要任务（即漏洞预测和克隆检测）上评估Compressor。我们使用该方法将预训练模型压缩到3 MB的大小，比原始大小小160倍。结果表明，压缩后的CodeBERT和GraphCodeBERT在推理时分别比原始模型快4.31倍和4.15倍。更重要的是，它们在漏洞预测任务上保持了原始性能的（和），在克隆检测任务上甚至保持了更高的原始性能比例（和）。

import_candidates.title: Consistent Scene Graph Generation by Constraint Optimization
import_candidates.abstract: Scene graph generation takes an image and derives a graph representation of key objects in the image and their relations. This core computer vision task is often used in autonomous driving, where traditional software and machine learning (ML) components are used in tandem. However, in such a safety-critical context, valid scene graphs can be further restricted by consistency constraints captured by domain or safety experts. Existing ML approaches for scene graph generation focus exclusively on relation-level accuracy but provide little to no guarantee that consistency constraints are satisfied in the generated scene graphs. In this paper, we aim to complement existing ML-based approaches by a post-processing step using constraint optimization over probabilistic scene graphs that can (1) guarantee that no consistency constraints are violated and (2) improve the overall accuracy of scene graph generation by fixing constraint violations. We evaluate the effectiveness of our approach using well-known, and novel metrics in the context of two popular ML datasets augmented with consistency constraints and two ML-based scene graph generation approaches as baselines.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 场景图生成从图像中提取关键对象及其关系的图表示。这一核心计算机视觉任务常被用于自动驾驶领域，其中传统软件和机器学习（ML）组件协同工作。然而，在这种安全关键的环境中，有效的场景图可能还需要进一步受领域或安全专家捕获的一致性约束的限制。现有的基于ML的场景图生成方法仅关注关系级别的准确性，但几乎无法保证生成的场景图满足一致性约束。在本文中，我们旨在通过一个后处理步骤补充现有的基于ML的方法，该步骤对概率场景图使用约束优化，能够（1）保证不违反任何一致性约束，以及（2）通过修复约束违规来提高场景图生成的总体准确性。我们使用众所周知的以及新颖的指标，在两个补充了约束的流行ML数据集上，并以两种基于ML的场景图生成方法为基线，来评估我们方法的有效性。

import_candidates.title: Constructing a System Knowledge Graph of User Tasks and Failures from Bug Reports to Support Soap Opera Testing
import_candidates.abstract: Exploratory testing is an effective testing approach which leverages the tester’s knowledge and creativity to design test cases to provoke and recognize failures at the system level from the end user’s perspective. Although some principles and guidelines have been proposed to guide exploratory testing, there are no effective tools for automatic generation of exploratory test scenarios (a.k.a soap opera tests). Existing test generation techniques rely on specifications, program differences and fuzzing, which are not suitable for exploratory test generation. In this paper, we propose to leverage the scenario and oracle knowledge in bug reports to generate soap opera test scenarios. We develop open information extraction methods to construct a system knowledge graph (KG) of user tasks and failures from the steps to reproduce, expected results and observed results in bug reports. We construct a proof-of-concept KG from 25,939 bugs of the Firefox browser. Our evaluation shows the constructed KG is of high quality. Based on the KG, we create soap opera test scenarios by combining the scenarios of relevant bugs, and develop a web tool to present the created test scenarios and support exploratory testing. In our user study, 5 users find 18 bugs from 5 seed bugs in 2 hours using our tool, while the control group finds only 5 bugs based on the recommended similar bugs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 探索性测试是一种有效的测试方法，它利用测试人员的知识和创造力来设计测试用例，从最终用户的角度在系统层面引发并识别失败。尽管已经提出了一些指导探索性测试的原则和指南，但目前还没有有效的工具来自动生成探索性测试场景（即肥皂剧测试）。现有的测试生成技术依赖于规格说明、程序差异和模糊测试，不适合探索性测试生成。在本文中，我们提出利用Bug报告中的场景和预言知识来生成肥皂剧测试场景。我们开发了开放信息抽取方法，从Bug报告中的重现步骤、预期结果和观察结果中构建用户任务与失败的系统知识图谱（KG）。我们从Firefox浏览器的25,939个Bug中构建了一个概念验证知识图谱。评估表明构建的知识图谱质量很高。基于该知识图谱，我们通过组合相关Bug的场景来创建肥皂剧测试场景，并开发了一个Web工具来展示所创建的测试场景并支持探索性测试。在我们的用户研究中，使用我们工具的5名用户在2小时内从5个种子Bug中发现了18个Bug，而对照组仅根据推荐的相似Bug发现了5个Bug。

import_candidates.title: Cornucopia : A Framework for Feedback Guided Generation of Binaries
import_candidates.abstract: Binary analysis is an important capability required for many security and software engineering applications. Consequently, there are many binary analysis techniques and tools with varied capabilities. However, testing these tools requires a large, varied binary dataset with corresponding source-level information. In this paper, we present Cornucopia, an architecture agnostic automated framework that can generate a plethora of binaries from corresponding program source by exploiting compiler optimizations and feedback-guided learning. Our evaluation shows that Cornucopia was able to generate 309K binaries across four architectures (x86, x64, ARM, MIPS) with an average of 403 binaries for each program and outperforms BinTuner  [53], a similar technique. Our experiments revealed issues with the LLVM optimization scheduler resulting in compiler crashes (∼ 300). Our evaluation of four popular binary analysis tools angr, Ghidra, ida, and radare, using Cornucopia generated binaries, revealed various issues with these tools. Specifically, we found 263 crashes in angr and one memory corruption issue in ida. Our differential testing on the analysis results revealed various semantic bugs in these tools. We also tested machine learning tools, Asm2Vec, SAFE, and Debin, that claim to capture binary semantics and show that they perform poorly (e.g., Debin F1 score dropped to 12.9\% from reported 63.1\%) on Cornucopia generated binaries. In summary, our exhaustive evaluation shows that Cornucopia is an effective mechanism to generate binaries for testing binary analysis techniques effectively.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 二进制分析是许多安全和软件工程应用所需的重要能力。因此，存在许多功能和能力各异的二进制分析技术和工具。然而，测试这些工具需要带有相应源代码信息的大规模、多样化的二进制数据集。在本文中，我们提出了Cornucopia，一个与架构无关的自动化框架，它通过利用编译器优化和反馈引导学习，可以从相应的程序源代码生成大量二进制文件。我们的评估表明，Cornucopia能够在四种架构（x86、x64、ARM、MIPS）上生成309K个二进制文件，每个程序平均生成403个二进制文件，并且优于类似技术BinTuner [53]。我们的实验发现了LLVM优化调度程序的问题，导致编译器崩溃（约300次）。我们使用Cornucopia生成的二进制文件对四种流行的二进制分析工具（angr、Ghidra、ida和radare）进行了评估，揭示了这些工具的各种问题。具体来说，我们发现了angr中的263次崩溃和ida中的一个内存损坏问题。我们对分析结果进行的差分测试揭示了这些工具中的各种语义错误。我们还测试了声称能够捕获二进制语义的机器学习工具Asm2Vec、SAFE和Debin，结果显示它们在Cornucopia生成的二进制文件上表现不佳（例如，Debin的F1分数从报告的63.1%降至12.9%）。总之，我们的详尽评估表明，Cornucopia是生成用于有效测试二进制分析技术的二进制的有效机制。

import_candidates.title: CrystalBLEU: Precisely and Efficiently Measuring the Similarity of Code
import_candidates.abstract: Recent years have brought a surge of work on predicting pieces of source code, e.g., for code completion, code migration, program repair, or translating natural language into code. All this work faces the challenge of evaluating the quality of a prediction w.r.t. some oracle, typically in the form of a reference solution. A common evaluation metric is the BLEU score, an n-gram-based metric originally proposed for evaluating natural language translation, but adopted in software engineering because it can be easily computed on any programming language and enables automated evaluation at scale. However, a key difference between natural and programming languages is that in the latter, completely unrelated pieces of code may have many common n-grams simply because of the syntactic verbosity and coding conventions of programming languages. We observe that these trivially shared n-grams hamper the ability of the metric to distinguish between truly similar code examples and code examples that are merely written in the same language. This paper presents CrystalBLEU, an evaluation metric based on BLEU, that allows for precisely and efficiently measuring the similarity of code. Our metric preserves the desirable properties of BLEU, such as being language-agnostic, able to handle incomplete or partially incorrect code, and efficient, while reducing the noise caused by trivially shared n-grams. We evaluate CrystalBLEU on two datasets from prior work and on a new, labeled dataset of semantically equivalent programs. Our results show that CrystalBLEU can distinguish similar from dissimilar code examples 1.9–4.5 times more effectively, when compared to the original BLEU score and a previously proposed variant of BLEU for code.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 近年来，预测源代码片段的工作激增，例如用于代码补全、代码迁移、程序修复或将自然语言转换为代码。所有这些工作都面临一个挑战，即根据某个参考标准（通常是参考解决方案）来评估预测的质量。一种常见的评估指标是BLEU分数，这是一种基于n-gram的指标，最初用于评估自然语言翻译，但由于可以轻松应用于任何编程语言并支持大规模自动化评估而被软件工程采用。然而，自然语言与编程语言的一个关键区别在于，在后者中，完全不相关的代码片段可能因为编程语言的语法冗长性和编码惯例而共享许多共同的n-gram。我们观察到，这些琐碎共享的n-gram削弱了该指标区分真正相似的代码示例与仅仅用同一种语言编写的代码示例的能力。本文提出了CrystalBLEU，一种基于BLEU的评估指标，能够精确且高效地衡量代码的相似性。我们的指标保留了BLEU的理想特性，如与语言无关、能够处理不完整或部分不正确的代码以及高效，同时减少了琐碎共享n-gram带来的噪声。我们在先前工作的两个数据集和一个新的、带标签的语义等价程序数据集上评估了CrystalBLEU。结果表明，与原始BLEU分数以及先前提出的BLEU代码变体相比，CrystalBLEU区分相似与不相似代码示例的效果提高了1.9至4.5倍。

import_candidates.title: Data Augmentation for Improving Emotion Recognition in Software Engineering Communication
import_candidates.abstract: Emotions (e.g., Joy, Anger) are prevalent in daily software engineering (SE) activities, and are known to be significant indicators of work productivity (e.g., bug fixing efficiency). Recent studies have shown that directly applying general purpose emotion classification tools to SE corpora is not effective. Even within the SE domain, tool performance degrades significantly when trained on one communication channel and evaluated on another (e.g, StackOverflow vs. GitHub comments). Retraining a tool with channel-specific data takes significant effort since manually annotating a large dataset of ground truth data is expensive. In this paper, we address this data scarcity problem by automatically creating new training data using a data augmentation technique. Based on an analysis of the types of errors made by popular SE-specific emotion recognition tools, we specifically target our data augmentation strategy in order to improve the performance of emotion recognition. Our results show an average improvement of 9.3\% in micro F1-Score for three existing emotion classification tools (ESEM-E, EMTk, SEntiMoji) when trained with our best augmentation strategy.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 情绪（如喜悦、愤怒）在软件工程（SE）日常活动中普遍存在，并且已知是工作效率（例如，缺陷修复效率）的重要指标。近期研究表明，将通用情绪分类工具直接应用于SE语料库效果不佳。即使在SE领域内，工具在一个沟通渠道上训练、然后在另一个渠道上评估时（如StackOverflow与GitHub评论），性能也会显著下降。使用特定渠道的数据重新训练工具需要大量工作，因为手动标注大型基准数据集成本高昂。本文通过自动创建新训练数据来解决数据稀缺问题，采用数据增强技术。基于对流行的SE特定情绪识别工具所犯错误类型的分析，我们针对性地设计数据增强策略，以提高情绪识别性能。结果表明，使用我们最佳增强策略训练时，三种现有情绪分类工具（ESEM-E、EMTk、SEntiMoji）的微观F1得分平均提高了9.3%。

import_candidates.title: Data Leakage in Notebooks: Static Detection and Better Processes
import_candidates.abstract: Data science pipelines to train and evaluate models with machine learning may contain bugs just like any other code. Leakage between training and test data can lead to overestimating the model’s accuracy during offline evaluations, possibly leading to deployment of low-quality models in production. Such leakage can happen easily by mistake or by following poor practices, but may be tedious and challenging to detect manually. We develop a static analysis approach to detect common forms of data leakage in data science code. Our evaluation shows that our analysis accurately detects data leakage and that such leakage is pervasive among over 100,000 analyzed public notebooks. We discuss how our static analysis approach can help both practitioners and educators, and how leakage prevention can be designed into the development process.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 用于训练和评估机器学习模型的数据科学流水线可能像其他任何代码一样包含错误。训练数据和测试数据之间的泄漏可能导致在离线评估中高估模型的准确率，从而可能在生产环境中部署低质量的模型。这种泄漏可能由于错误或遵循不良实践而轻易发生，但手动检测可能繁琐且具有挑战性。我们开发了一种静态分析方法，用于检测数据科学代码中常见形式的数据泄漏。我们的评估表明，我们的分析能够准确检测数据泄漏，并且这种泄漏在超过10万个被分析的公开笔记本中普遍存在。我们讨论了我们的静态分析方法如何帮助实践者和教育者，以及如何在开发过程中设计泄漏预防机制。

import_candidates.title: DeepPerform: An Efficient Approach for Performance Testing of Resource-Constrained Neural Networks
import_candidates.abstract: Today, an increasing number of Adaptive Deep Neural Networks (AdNNs) are being used on resource-constrained embedded devices. We observe that, similar to traditional software, redundant computation exists in AdNNs, resulting in considerable performance degradation. The performance degradation is dependent on the input and is referred to as input-dependent performance bottlenecks (IDPBs). To ensure an AdNN satisfies the performance requirements of resource-constrained applications, it is essential to conduct performance testing to detect IDPBs in the AdNN. Existing neural network testing methods are primarily concerned with correctness testing, which does not involve performance testing. To fill this gap, we propose DeepPerform, a scalable approach to generate test samples to detect the IDPBs in AdNNs. We first demonstrate how the problem of generating performance test samples detecting IDPBs can be formulated as an optimization problem. Following that, we demonstrate how DeepPerform efficiently handles the optimization problem by learning and estimating the distribution of AdNNs’ computational consumption. We evaluate DeepPerform on three widely used datasets against five popular AdNN models. The results show that DeepPerform generates test samples that cause more severe performance degradation (FLOPs: increase up to 552\%). Furthermore, DeepPerform is substantially more efficient than the baseline methods in generating test inputs (runtime overhead: only 6–10 milliseconds).
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 如今，越来越多的自适应深度神经网络（AdNNs）被用于资源受限的嵌入式设备。我们观察到，与传统软件类似，AdNNs中存在冗余计算，导致显著性能下降。这种性能下降依赖于输入，被称为输入相关性能瓶颈（IDPBs）。为了确保AdNN满足资源受限应用的性能要求，有必要进行性能测试以检测AdNN中的IDPBs。现有的神经网络测试方法主要关注正确性测试，不涉及性能测试。为填补这一空白，我们提出DeepPerform，一种可扩展的方法，用于生成测试样本以检测AdNNs中的IDPBs。我们首先展示了如何将检测IDPBs的性能测试样本生成问题表述为优化问题。接着，我们演示了DeepPerform如何通过学习和估计AdNNs计算消耗的分布来高效地处理该优化问题。我们在三个广泛使用的数据集上对五个流行的AdNN模型进行了评估。结果表明，DeepPerform生成的测试样本会造成更严重的性能退化（FLOPs增加高达552%）。此外，DeepPerform在生成测试输入方面比基线方法高效得多（运行时开销仅为6-10毫秒）。

import_candidates.title: Detecting Blocking Errors in Go Programs using Localized Abstract Interpretation
import_candidates.abstract: Channel-based concurrency is a widely used alternative to shared-memory concurrency but is difficult to use correctly. Common programming errors may result in blocked threads that wait indefinitely. Recent work exposes this as a considerable problem in Go programs and shows that many such errors can be detected automatically using SMT encoding and dynamic analysis techniques. In this paper, we present an alternative approach to detect such errors based on abstract interpretation. To curb the large state spaces of real-world multi-threaded programs, our static program analysis leverages standard pre-analyses to divide the given program into individually analyzable fragments. Experimental results on 6 large real-world Go programs show that the abstract interpretation achieves good scalability and finds 104 blocking errors that are missed by the state-of-the-art tool GCatch.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 基于通道的并发是共享内存并发的一种广泛使用的替代方案，但难以正确使用。常见的编程错误可能导致线程被阻塞并无限期等待。最近的研究将这一问题暴露为Go程序中的一个重大问题，并表明许多此类错误可以通过SMT编码和动态分析技术自动检测。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于抽象解释的替代方法来检测此类错误。为了限制真实世界多线程程序的巨大状态空间，我们的静态程序分析利用标准预分析将给定程序划分为可独立分析的片段。对6个大型真实世界Go程序的实验结果表明，抽象解释具有良好的可扩展性，并发现了104个被最先进工具GCatch遗漏的阻塞错误。

import_candidates.title: Detecting Build Conflicts in Software Merge for Java Programs via Static Analysis
import_candidates.abstract: In software merge, the edits from different branches can textually overlap (i.e., textual conflicts) or cause build and test errors (i.e., build and test conflicts), jeopardizing programmer productivity and software quality. Existing tools primarily focus on textual conflicts; few tools detect higher-order conflicts (i.e., build and test conflicts). However, existing detectors of build conflicts are limited. Due to their heavy usage of automatic build, current detectors (e.g., Crystal) only report build errors instead of identifying the root causes; developers have to manually locate conflicting edits. These detectors only help when the branches-to-merge have no textual conflict. We present a new static analysis-based approach Bucond (“build conflict detector”). Given three code versions in a merging scenario: base b, left l, and right r, Bucond models each version as a graph, and compares graphs to extract entity-related edits (e.g., class renaming) in l and r. We believe that build conflicts occur when certain edits are co-applied to related entities between branches. Bucond realizes this insight via pattern matching to identify any cross-branch edit combination that can trigger build conflicts (e.g., one branch adds a reference to field F while the other branch removes F). We systematically explored and devised 57 patterns, covering 97\% of the build conflicts in our experiments. Our evaluation shows Bucond to complement build-based detectors, as it (1) detects conflicts with 100\% precision and 88\%–100\% recall, (2) locates conflicting edits, and (3) works well when those detectors do not.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在软件合并中，来自不同分支的修改可能在文本上重叠（即文本冲突），或导致构建和测试错误（即构建和测试冲突），从而影响开发者的效率和软件质量。现有工具主要关注文本冲突；很少有工具能检测高阶冲突（即构建和测试冲突）。然而，现有的构建冲突检测器是有限的。由于大量使用自动构建，当前检测器（如Crystal）只报告构建错误，而不识别根本原因；开发者必须手动定位冲突修改。这些检测器仅在待合并分支无文本冲突时才有帮助。我们提出了一种新的基于静态分析的方法Bucond（“构建冲突检测器”）。给定合并场景中的三个代码版本：基础版b、左版本l和右版本r，Bucond将每个版本建模为图，并通过比较图来提取l和r中与实体相关的修改（如类重命名）。我们认为，当某些修改被共同应用于分支间的相关实体时，就会发生构建冲突。Bucond通过模式匹配实现这一洞见，以识别任何可能触发构建冲突的跨分支修改组合（例如，一个分支添加对字段F的引用，而另一个分支删除F）。我们系统性地探索并设计了57种模式，覆盖了实验中97%的构建冲突。我们的评估表明，Bucond能补充基于构建的检测器，因为它（1）以100%的精确率和88%-100%的召回率检测冲突，（2）定位冲突修改，以及（3）在这些检测器无法工作的情况下表现良好。

import_candidates.title: Detecting Semantic Code Clones by Building AST-based Markov Chains Model
import_candidates.abstract: Code clone detection aims to find functionally similar code fragments, which is becoming more and more important in the field of software engineering. Many code clone detection methods have been proposed, among which tree-based methods are able to handle semantic code clones. However, these methods are difficult to scale to big code due to the complexity of tree structures. In this paper, we design Amain, a scalable tree-based semantic code clone detector by building Markov chains models. Specifically, we propose a novel method to transform the original complex tree into simple Markov chains and measure the distance of all states in these chains. After obtaining all distance values, we feed them into a machine learning classifier to train a code clone detector. To examine the effectiveness of Amain, we evaluate it on two widely used datasets namely Google Code Jam and BigCloneBench. Experimental results show that Amain is superior to nine state-of-the-art code clone detection tools (i.e., SourcererCC, RtvNN, Deckard, ASTNN, TBCNN, CDLH, FCCA, DeepSim, and SCDetector).
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 代码克隆检测旨在发现功能相似的代码片段，这在软件工程领域中变得越来越重要。许多代码克隆检测方法已被提出，其中基于树的方法能够处理语义代码克隆。然而，由于树结构的复杂性，这些方法难以扩展到大型代码。在本文中，我们通过构建马尔可夫链模型，设计了一个可扩展的基于树的语义代码克隆检测器Amain。具体而言，我们提出了一种新方法，将原始的复杂树转换为简单的马尔可夫链，并测量这些链中所有状态之间的距离。获得所有距离值后，我们将它们输入到机器学习分类器中，以训练代码克隆检测器。为了检验Amain的有效性，我们在两个广泛使用的数据集（即Google Code Jam和BigCloneBench）上进行了评估。实验结果表明，Amain优于九种最先进的代码克隆检测工具（即SourcererCC、RtvNN、Deckard、ASTNN、TBCNN、CDLH、FCCA、DeepSim和SCDetector）。

import_candidates.title: Differentially Testing Database Transactions for Fun and Profit
import_candidates.abstract: Database Management Systems (DBMSs) utilize transactions to ensure the consistency and integrity of data. Incorrect transaction implementations in DBMSs can lead to severe consequences, e.g., incorrect database states and query results. Therefore, it is critical to ensure the reliability of transaction implementations. In this paper, we propose DT2, an approach for automatically testing transaction implementations in DBMSs. We first randomly generate a database and a group of concurrent transactions operating the database, which can support complex features in DBMSs, e.g., various database schemas and cross-table queries. We then leverage differential testing to compare transaction execution results on multiple DBMSs to find discrepancies. The non-determinism of concurrent transactions can affect the effectiveness of our method. Therefore, we propose a transaction test protocol to ensure the deterministic execution of concurrent transactions. We evaluate DT2 on three widely-used MySQL-compatible DBMSs: MySQL, MariaDB and TiDB. In total, we have detected 10 unique transaction bugs and 88 transaction-related compatibility issues from the observed discrepancies. Our empirical study on these compatibility issues shows that DBMSs suffer from various transaction-related compatibility issues, although they claim that they are compatible. These compatibility issues can also lead to serious consequences, e.g., inconsistent database states among DBMSs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 数据库管理系统利用事务来确保数据的一致性和完整性。数据库管理系统中错误的事务实现可能导致严重后果，例如错误的数据状态和查询结果。因此，确保事务实现的可靠性至关重要。本文提出DT2，一种自动测试数据库管理系统中事务实现的方法。我们首先随机生成一个数据库和一组操作该数据库的并发事务，这些事务可以支持数据库管理系统的复杂特性，例如各种数据库模式和跨表查询。然后，我们利用差分测试比较多个数据库管理系统上的事务执行结果，以发现差异。并发事务的非确定性可能影响我们方法的有效性。因此，我们提出一种事务测试协议，以确保并发事务的确定性执行。我们在三个广泛使用的MySQL兼容数据库管理系统（MySQL、MariaDB和TiDB）上评估DT2。总体而言，我们从观察到的差异中检测到10个独特的事务bug和88个与事务相关的兼容性问题。我们对这些兼容性问题的实证研究表明，尽管声称兼容，但各数据库管理系统存在各种与事务相关的兼容性问题。这些兼容性问题也可能导致严重后果，例如各数据库管理系统之间不一致的数据状态。

import_candidates.title: Effectively Generating Vulnerable Transaction Sequences in Smart Contracts with Reinforcement Learning-guided Fuzzing
import_candidates.abstract: As computer programs run on top of blockchain, smart contracts have proliferated a myriad of decentralized applications while bringing security vulnerabilities, which may cause huge financial losses. Thus, it is crucial and urgent to detect the vulnerabilities of smart contracts. However, existing fuzzers for smart contracts are still inefficient to detect sophisticated vulnerabilities that require specific vulnerable transaction sequences to trigger. To address this challenge, we propose a novel vulnerability-guided fuzzer based on reinforcement learning, namely RLF, for generating vulnerable transaction sequences to detect such sophisticated vulnerabilities in smart contracts. In particular, we firstly model the process of fuzzing smart contracts as a Markov decision process to construct our reinforcement learning framework. We then creatively design an appropriate reward with consideration of both vulnerability and code coverage so that it can effectively guide our fuzzer to generate specific transaction sequences to reveal vulnerabilities, especially for the vulnerabilities related to multiple functions. We conduct extensive experiments to evaluate RLF’s performance. The experimental results demonstrate that our RLF outperforms state-of-the-art vulnerability-detection tools (e.g., detecting 8\%-69\% more vulnerabilities within 30 minutes).
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着计算机程序运行在区块链之上，智能合约在推动去中心化应用大量涌现的同时，也带来了可能造成巨大经济损失的安全漏洞。因此，检测智能合约中的漏洞至关重要且刻不容缓。然而，现有的智能合约模糊测试工具在检测需要特定易受攻击交易序列才能触发的复杂漏洞方面效率仍然低下。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了一种基于强化学习的漏洞引导模糊测试工具，称为RLF，旨在生成易受攻击的交易序列以检测智能合约中的此类复杂漏洞。特别地，我们首先将智能合约模糊测试过程建模为马尔可夫决策过程，以构建我们的强化学习框架。然后，我们创造性地设计了一个综合考虑漏洞和代码覆盖率的适当奖励函数，从而能够有效引导我们的模糊测试工具生成特定的交易序列以揭示漏洞，尤其是与多个函数相关的漏洞。我们进行了大量实验以评估RLF的性能。实验结果表明，我们的RLF优于最先进的漏洞检测工具（例如，在30分钟内多检测出8%至69%的漏洞）。

import_candidates.title: Efficient Greybox Fuzzing to Detect Memory Errors
import_candidates.abstract: Greybox fuzzing is a proven and effective testing method for the detection of security vulnerabilities and other bugs in modern software systems. Greybox fuzzing can also be used in combination with a sanitizer, such as AddressSanitizer (ASAN), to further enhance the detection of certain classes of bugs such as buffer overflow and use-after-free errors. However, sanitizers also introduce additional performance overheads, and this can degrade the performance of greybox mode fuzzing—measured in the order of 2.36 \texttimes{} for fuzzing with ASAN—partially negating the benefit of using a sanitizer in the first place. Recent research attributes the extra overhead to program startup/teardown costs that can dominate fork-mode fuzzing. In this paper, we present a new memory error sanitizer design that is specifically optimized for fork-mode fuzzing. The basic idea is to mark object boundaries using randomized tokens rather than disjoint metadata (as used by traditional sanitizer designs). All read/write operations are then instrumented to check for the token, and if present, a memory error will be detected. Since our design does not use a disjoint metadata, it is also very lightweight, meaning that program startup and teardown costs are minimized for the benefit of fork-mode fuzzing. We implement our design in the form of the tool, and show an improved fuzzing performance overhead of 1.14-1.27 \texttimes{}, depending on the configuration.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 灰盒模糊测试是一种经过验证且有效的测试方法，用于检测现代软件系统中的安全漏洞和其他缺陷。灰盒模糊测试还可以与AddressSanitizer（ASAN）等消毒器结合使用，以进一步增强对缓冲区溢出和释放后使用等特定类别错误的检测。然而，消毒器也会引入额外的性能开销，这可能会降低灰盒模式模糊测试的性能——使用ASAN进行模糊测试的开销约为2.36倍——这在一定程度上抵消了使用消毒器带来的好处。近期研究将额外开销归因于程序启动/拆卸成本，这些成本可能在fork模式模糊测试中占主导地位。在本文中，我们提出了一种专门针对fork模式模糊测试优化的新型内存错误消毒器设计。基本思想是使用随机化令牌来标记对象边界，而不是像传统消毒器设计那样使用不连续的内存元数据。随后对所有读写操作进行插桩以检查令牌，如果存在则检测到内存错误。由于我们的设计不使用不连续的元数据，它也极为轻量，这意味着程序启动和拆卸成本被最小化，从而有利于fork模式模糊测试。我们以工具的形式实现了我们的设计，并显示出改进后的模糊测试性能开销为1.14-1.27倍，具体取决于配置。

import_candidates.title: Efficient Synthesis of Method Call Sequences for Test Generation and Bounded Verification
import_candidates.abstract: Modern programs are usually heap-based, where the programs manipulate heap-based data structures to perform computations. In software engineering tasks such as test generation and bounded verification, we need to determine the existence of a reachable heap state that satisfies a given specification, or construct the heap state by a sequence of calls to the public methods. Given the huge space combined from the methods and their arguments, the existing approaches typically adopt static analysis or heuristic search to explore only a small part of search space in the hope of finding the target state and target call sequence early on. However, these approaches do not have satisfactory performance on many real-world complex methods and specifications. In this paper, we propose an efficient synthesis algorithm for method call sequences, including an offline procedure for exploring all reachable heap states within a scope, and an online procedure for generating a method call sequence from the explored heap states to satisfy the given specification. To improve the efficiency of state exploration, we introduce a notion of abstract heap state for compactly representing heap states of the same structure and propose a strategy of merging structurally-isomorphic states. The experimental results demonstrate that our approach substantially outperforms the baselines in both test generation and bounded verification.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代程序通常是基于堆的，即程序操纵基于堆的数据结构来执行计算。在测试生成和有界验证等软件工程任务中，我们需要确定是否存在满足给定规范的可达堆状态，或者通过调用公共方法的序列来构造该堆状态。考虑到方法及其参数组合产生的巨大空间，现有方法通常采用静态分析或启发式搜索，仅探索搜索空间的一小部分，希望尽早找到目标状态和目标调用序列。然而，这些方法在许多真实世界的复杂方法和规范上性能并不令人满意。在本文中，我们提出了一种高效的方法调用序列合成算法，包括一个用于探索作用域内所有可达堆状态的离线过程，以及一个从已探索的堆状态生成方法调用序列以满足给定规范的在线过程。为了提高状态探索的效率，我们引入了抽象堆状态的概念，以紧凑地表示结构相同的堆状态，并提出了一种合并结构同构状态的策略。实验结果表明，我们的方法在测试生成和有界验证方面均显著优于基线方法。

import_candidates.title: Empirical Study of System Resources Abused by IoT Attackers
import_candidates.abstract: IoT devices have been under frequent attacks in recent years, causing severe impacts. Previous research has shown the evolution and features of some specific IoT malware families or stages of IoT attacks through offline sample analysis. However, we still lack a systematic observation of various system resources abused by active attackers and the malicious intentions behind these behaviors. This makes it difficult to design appropriate protection strategies to defend against existing attacks and possible future variants. In this paper, we fill this gap by analyzing 117,862 valid attack sessions captured by our dedicated high-interaction IoT honeypot, HoneyAsclepius, and further discover the intentions in our designed workflow. HoneyAsclepius enables high capture capability as well as continuous behavior monitoring during active attack sessions in real-time. Through a large-scale deployment, we collected 11,301,239 malicious behaviors originating from 50,594 different attackers. Based on this information, we further separate the behaviors in different attack sessions targeting distinct categories of system resources, estimate the temporal relations and summarize their malicious intentions behind. Inspired by such investigations, we present several key insights about abusive behaviors of the file, network, process, and special capability resources, and further propose practical defense strategies to better protect IoT devices.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 近年来，IoT设备频繁遭受攻击，造成了严重影响。先前的研究通过离线样本分析展示了某些特定IoT恶意软件家族或攻击阶段的演变和特征。然而，我们仍然缺乏对活跃攻击者所滥用的各种系统资源及其背后恶意意图的系统性观察。这使得设计适当的保护策略来防御现有攻击和可能的未来变种变得困难。在本文中，我们通过分析由我们专门设计的高交互式IoT蜜罐HoneyAsclepius捕获的117,862个有效攻击会话，并在我们设计的工作流程中进一步发现攻击意图，从而填补了这一空白。HoneyAsclepius在活跃攻击会话期间实现了高捕获能力以及实时持续行为监控。通过大规模部署，我们收集了来自50,594个不同攻击者的11,301,239个恶意行为。基于这些信息，我们进一步区分针对不同类别系统资源的各类攻击会话中的行为，估计时间关系并总结其背后的恶意意图。受这些调查启发，我们提出了关于文件、网络、进程和特殊能力资源滥用行为的关键见解，并进一步提出了实用的防御策略以更好地保护IoT设备。

import_candidates.title: Enriching Compiler Testing with Real Program from Bug Report
import_candidates.abstract: Researchers have proposed various approaches to generate test programs. The state-of-the-art approaches can be roughly divided into random-based and mutation-based approaches: random-based approaches generate random programs and mutation-based approaches mutate programs to generate more test programs. Both lines of approaches mainly generate random code, but it is more beneficial to use real programs, since it is easier to learn the impacts of compiler bugs and it becomes reasonable to use both valid and invalid code. However, most real programs from code repositories are ineffective to trigger compiler bugs, partially because they are compiled before they are submitted. In this experience paper, we apply two techniques such as differential testing and code snippet extraction to the specific research domain of compiler testing. Based on our observations on the practice of testing compilers, we identify bug reports of compilers as a new source for compiler testing. To illustrate the benefits of the new source, we implement a tool, called LeRe, that extracts test programs from bug reports and uses differential testing to detect compiler bugs with extracted programs. After we enriched the test programs, we have found 156 unique bugs in the latest versions of gcc and clang. Among them, 103 bugs are confirmed as valid, and 9 bugs are already fixed. Our found bugs contain 59 accept-invalid bugs and 33 reject-valid bugs. In these bugs, compilers wrongly accept invalid programs or reject valid programs. The new source enables us detecting accept-invalid and reject-valid bugs that were usually missed by the prior approaches. The prior approaches seldom report the two types of bugs. Besides our found bugs, we also present our analysis on our invalid bug reports. The results are useful for programmers, when they are switching from one compiler to another, and can provide insights, when researchers apply differential testing to detect bugs in more types of software.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 研究人员提出了多种生成测试程序的方法。最先进的方法大致可分为基于随机生成和基于变异两类：基于随机的方法生成随机程序，基于变异的方法对程序进行变异以产生更多测试程序。这两类方法主要生成随机代码，但使用真实程序更有益，因为更容易了解编译器bug的影响，并且使用有效和无效代码都变得合理。然而，来自代码库的大多数真实程序很难触发编译器bug，部分原因是它们在提交前已被编译过。在这篇经验论文中，我们将差分测试和代码片段提取两种技术应用于编译器测试这一特定研究领域。基于我们在编译器测试实践中的观察，我们将编译器的bug报告确定为编译器测试的新来源。为了说明新来源的优势，我们实现了一个名为LeRe的工具，从bug报告中提取测试程序，并使用差分测试来检测提取程序中的编译器bug。在丰富测试程序后，我们在gcc和clang的最新版本中发现了156个独特bug。其中103个被确认为有效，9个已修复。我们发现的bug包括59个“接受无效程序”bug和33个“拒绝有效程序”bug。在这些bug中，编译器错误地接受无效程序或拒绝有效程序。这一新来源使我们能够检测到以往方法通常会错过的接受无效和拒绝有效类bug。以往的方法很少报告这两类bug。除了我们发现的bug，我们还对无效bug报告进行了分析。这些结果有助于程序员在不同编译器之间切换，并且当研究人员将差分测试应用于检测更多类型软件中的bug时，可以提供洞见。

import_candidates.title: Evolving Ranking-Based Failure Proximities for Better Clustering in Fault Isolation
import_candidates.abstract: Failures that are not related to a specific fault can reduce the effectiveness of fault localization in multi-fault scenarios. To tackle this challenge, researchers and practitioners typically cluster failures (e.g., failed test cases) into several disjoint groups, with those caused by the same fault grouped together. In such a fault isolation process that requires input in a mathematical form, ranking-based failure proximity (R-proximity) is widely used to model failed test cases. In R-proximity, each failed test case is represented as a suspiciousness ranking list of program statements through a fingerprinting function (i.e., a risk evaluation formula, REF). Although many off-the-shelf REFs have been integrated into R-proximity, they were designed for single-fault localization originally. To the best of our knowledge, no REF has been developed to serve as a fingerprinting function of R-proximity in multi-fault scenarios. For better clustering failures in fault isolation, in this paper, we present a genetic programming-based framework along with a sophisticated fitness function, for evolving REFs with the goal of more properly representing failures in multi-fault scenarios. By using a small set of programs for training, we get a collection of REFs that can obtain good results applicable in a larger and more general scale of scenarios. The best one of them outperforms the state-of-the-art by 50.72\% and 47.41\% in faults number estimation and clustering effectiveness, respectively. Our framework is highly configurable for further use, and the evolved formulas can be directly applied in future failure representation tasks without any retraining.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在多功能故障场景中，与特定故障无关的失败会降低故障定位的有效性。为解决这一挑战，研究人员和实践者通常将失败（例如失败测试用例）聚类成多个不相交的组，将同一故障导致的失败归入同一组。在需要数学形式输入的故障隔离过程中，基于排名的失败相似度（R-proximity）被广泛用于建模失败测试用例。在R-proximity中，每个失败测试用例通过一个指纹函数（即风险评估公式，REF）表示为程序语句可疑度的排名列表。尽管许多现成的REF已集成到R-proximity中，但它们最初是为单故障定位而设计的。据我们所知，在多功能故障场景中，尚未有REF被开发用作R-proximity的指纹函数。为了在故障隔离中更好地聚类失败，本文提出了一个基于遗传编程的框架，并配有精心设计的适应度函数，旨在演化为更适合多功能故障场景中失败表示的REF。通过使用少量程序进行训练，我们获得了一组能够在更大规模、更通用场景下取得良好结果的REF。其中最佳公式在故障数量估计和聚类有效性方面分别比现有最优方法提高50.72%和47.41%。我们的框架高度可配置，便于进一步使用，演化出的公式可直接用于未来的失败表示任务，无需重新训练。

import_candidates.title: Exploiting Epochs and Symmetries in Analysing MPI Programs
import_candidates.abstract: Communication nondeterminism is one of the main reasons for the intractability of verification of message passing concurrency. In many practical message passing programs, the non-deterministic communication structure is symmetric and decomposed into epochs to obtain efficiency. Thus, symmetries and epoch structure can be exploited to reduce verification complexity. In this paper, we present a dynamic-symbolic runtime verification technique for single-path MPI programs, which (i) exploits communication symmetries by way of specifying symmetry breaking predicates (SBP) and (ii) performs compositional verification based on epochs. On the one hand, SBPs prevent the symbolic decision procedure from exploring isomorphic parts of the search space, and on the other hand, epochs restrict the size of a program needed to be analyzed at a point in time. We show that our analysis is sound and complete for single-path MPI programs on a given input. Using our prototype tool SIMIAN, we further demonstrate that our approach leads to (i) a significant reduction in verification times and (ii) scaling up to larger benchmark sizes compared to prior trace verifiers.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 通信非确定性是消息传递并发验证难以处理的主要原因之一。在许多实际的传递消息程序中，非确定性通信结构是对称的，并被分解为阶段（epoch）以提高效率。因此，可以利用对称性和阶段结构来降低验证复杂度。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于单路径MPI程序的动态符号化运行时验证技术，该技术（i）通过指定对称性破缺谓词（SBP）来利用通信对称性，（ii）基于阶段执行组合验证。一方面，SBP防止符号决策过程探索搜索空间的同构部分；另一方面，阶段限制了在某一时间点需要分析的程序规模。我们证明，对于给定输入上的单路径MPI程序，我们的分析是可靠且完备的。利用我们的原型工具SIMIAN，我们进一步证明，与先前的迹验证器相比，我们的方法能够(i)显著减少验证时间，(ii)扩展到更大的基准规模。

import_candidates.title: Finding and Understanding Incompleteness Bugs in SMT Solvers
import_candidates.abstract: We propose Janus, an approach for finding incompleteness bugs in SMT solvers. The key insight is to mutate SMT formulas with local weakening and strengthening rules that preserve the satisfiability of the seed formula. The generated mutants are used to test SMT solvers for incompleteness bugs, i.e., inputs on which SMT solvers unexpectedly return unknown. We realized Janus on top of the SMT solver fuzzing framework YinYang. From June to August 2021, we stress-tested the two state-of-the-art SMT solvers Z3 and CVC5 with Janus and totally reported 31 incompleteness bugs. Out of these, 26 have been confirmed as unique bugs and 19 are already fixed by the developers. Our diverse bug findings uncovered functional, regression, and performance bugs—several triggered discussions among the developers sharing their in-depth analysis.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了Janus，一种在SMT求解器中查找不完整性缺陷的方法。其关键思想是使用局部弱化和强化规则来变异SMT公式，这些规则保持种子公式的可满足性。生成的变异体用于测试SMT求解器的不完整性缺陷，即SMT求解器意外返回“未知”的输入。我们在SMT求解器模糊测试框架YinYang之上实现了Janus。从2021年6月至8月，我们使用Janus对两个最先进的SMT求解器Z3和CVC5进行了压力测试，总共报告了31个不完整性缺陷。其中26个已被确认为独特缺陷，19个已被开发者修复。我们多样的缺陷发现揭示了功能性、回归性和性能性缺陷——其中几个引发了开发者之间分享深入分析的讨论。

import_candidates.title: FuzzerAid: Grouping Fuzzed Crashes Based On Fault Signatures
import_candidates.abstract: Fuzzing has been an important approach for finding bugs and vulnerabilities in programs. Many fuzzers deployed in industry run daily and can generate an overwhelming number of crashes. Diagnosing such crashes can be very challenging and time-consuming. Existing fuzzers typically employ heuristics such as code coverage or call stack hashes to weed out duplicate reporting of bugs. While these heuristics are cheap, they are often imprecise and end up still reporting many “unique” crashes corresponding to the same bug. In this paper, we present FuzzerAid that uses fault signatures to group crashes reported by the fuzzers. Fault signature is a small executable program and consists of a selection of necessary statements from the original program that can reproduce a bug. In our approach, we first generate a fault signature using a given crash. We then execute the fault signature with other crash inducing inputs. If the failure is reproduced, we classify the crashes into the group labeled with the fault signature; if not, we generate a new fault signature. After all the crash inducing inputs are classified, we further merge the fault signatures of the same root cause into a group. We implemented our approach in a tool called FuzzerAid and evaluated it on 3020 crashes generated from 15 real-world bugs and 4 large open source projects. Our evaluation shows that we are able to correctly group 99.1\% of the crashes and reported only 17 (+2) “unique” bugs, outperforming the state-of-the-art fuzzers.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 模糊测试一直是发现程序和漏洞的重要方法。许多在工业界部署的模糊器每天运行，可能会产生数量惊人的崩溃。诊断这些崩溃可能非常具有挑战性且耗时。现有的模糊器通常采用诸如代码覆盖或调用栈哈希等启发式方法来剔除重复的bug报告。虽然这些启发式方法成本低廉，但它们往往不精确，最终仍会报告许多对应于同一bug的“独特”崩溃。在本文中，我们提出了FuzzerAid，它使用故障签名对模糊器报告的崩溃进行分组。故障签名是一个小的可执行程序，由原始程序中能够重现bug的必要语句组成。我们的方法是：首先使用给定的崩溃生成故障签名，然后用其他崩溃诱导输入执行该故障签名。如果故障重现，我们将这些崩溃归类到以该故障签名标记的组中；如果未重现，则生成新的故障签名。对所有崩溃诱导输入分类后，我们进一步将根因相同的故障签名合并为一组。我们将该方法实现为一个名为FuzzerAid的工具，并在来自15个真实世界bug和4个大型开源项目的3020个崩溃上进行了评估。评估结果表明，我们能够正确地对99.1%的崩溃进行分组，并且仅报告了17个（+2）个“独特”bug，优于最先进的模糊器。

import_candidates.title: Fuzzle: Making a Puzzle for Fuzzers
import_candidates.abstract: With rapidly growing fuzzing technology, there has been surging demand for automatically synthesizing buggy programs. Previous approaches have been focused on injecting bugs into existing programs, making them suffer from providing the ground truth as the generated programs may contain unexpected bugs. In this paper, we address this challenge by casting the bug synthesis problem as a maze generation problem. Specifically, we synthesize a whole buggy program by encoding a sequence of moves in a maze as a chain of function calls. By design, our approach provides the exact ground truth of the synthesized benchmark. Furthermore, it allows generation of benchmarks with realistic path constraints extracted from existing vulnerabilities. We implement our idea in a tool, named Fuzzle, and evaluate it with five state-of-the-art fuzzers to empirically prove its value.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着模糊测试技术的迅速发展，对自动合成含缺陷程序的需求日益增长。以往的方法侧重于将缺陷注入现有程序，但这种方式可能因生成的程序包含意外缺陷而难以提供真实参照（ground truth）。在本文中，我们通过将缺陷合成问题转化为迷宫生成问题来应对这一挑战。具体而言，我们将迷宫中一系列移动编码为函数调用链，从而合成一个完整的含缺陷程序。通过设计，我们的方法为合成基准提供了精确的真实参照。此外，它允许从现有漏洞中提取真实的路径约束以生成基准。我们将这一思想实现为名为Fuzzle的工具，并使用五种最先进的模糊测试器进行评估，以实证其价值。

import_candidates.title: Generating Critical Test Scenarios for Autonomous Driving Systems via Influential Behavior Patterns
import_candidates.abstract: Autonomous Driving Systems (ADSs) are safety-critical, and must be fully tested before being deployed on real-world roads. To comprehensively evaluate the performance of ADSs, it is essential to generate various safety-critical scenarios. Most of existing studies assess ADSs either by searching high-dimensional input space, or using simple and pre-defined test scenarios, which are not efficient or not adequate. To better test ADSs, this paper proposes to automatically generate safety-critical test scenarios for ADSs by influential behavior patterns, which are mined from real traffic trajectories. Based on influential behavior patterns, a novel scenario generation technique, CRISCO, is presented to generate safety-critical scenarios for ADSs testing. CRISCO assigns participants to perform influential behaviors to challenge the ADS. It generates different test scenarios by solving trajectory constraints, and improves the challenge of those non-critical scenarios by adding participants’ behavior from influential behavior patterns incrementally. We demonstrate CRISCO on an industrial-grade ADS platform, Baidu Apollo. The experiment results show that our approach can effectively and efficiently generate critical scenarios to crash ADS, and it exposes 13 distinct types of safety violations in 12 hours. It also outperforms two state-of-art ADS testing techniques by exposing more 5 distinct types of safety violations on the same roads.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 自动驾驶系统（ADS）是安全关键的，在部署到真实道路之前必须进行充分测试。为了全面评估ADS的性能，生成各种安全关键的场景至关重要。已有的大多数研究要么通过搜索高维输入空间来评估ADS，要么使用简单且预定义的测试场景，这些方式要么效率不高，要么不够充分。为了更好地测试ADS，本文提出通过影响行为模式（从真实交通轨迹中挖掘）来自动生成安全关键的测试场景。基于影响行为模式，提出了一种新颖的场景生成技术CRISCO，用于生成ADS测试的安全关键场景。CRISCO分配参与者执行影响行为来挑战ADS。它通过求解轨迹约束生成不同的测试场景，并通过从影响行为模式中逐步添加参与者行为来提高非关键场景的挑战性。我们在工业级ADS平台百度Apollo上演示了CRISCO。实验结果表明，我们的方法能有效且高效地生成使ADS崩溃的关键场景，并在12小时内暴露了13种不同类型的安全违规。与两种最先进的ADS测试技术相比，它在相同道路上还多暴露了5种不同类型的安全违规。

import_candidates.title: GLITCH: Automated Polyglot Security Smell Detection in Infrastructure as Code
import_candidates.abstract: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) is the process of managing IT infrastructure via programmable configuration files (also called IaC scripts). Like other software artifacts, IaC scripts may contain security smells, which are coding patterns that can result in security weaknesses. Automated analysis tools to detect security smells in IaC scripts exist, but they focus on specific technologies such as Puppet, Ansible, or Chef. This means that when the detection of a new smell is implemented in one of the tools, it is not immediately available for the technologies supported by the other tools — the only option is to duplicate the effort. This paper presents an approach that enables consistent security smell detection across different IaC technologies. We conduct a large-scale empirical study that analyzes security smells on three large datasets containing 196,755 IaC scripts and 12,281,251 LOC. We show that all categories of security smells are identified across all datasets and we identify some smells that might affect many IaC projects. To conduct this study, we developed GLITCH, a new technology-agnostic framework that enables automated polyglot smell detection by transforming IaC scripts into an intermediate representation, on which different security smell detectors can be defined. GLITCH currently supports the detection of nine different security smells in scripts written in Ansible, Chef, or Puppet. We compare GLITCH with state-of-the-art security smell detectors. The results obtained not only show that GLITCH can reduce the effort of writing security smell analyses for multiple IaC technologies, but also that it has higher precision and recall than the current state-of-the-art tools.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 基础设施即代码（IaC）是通过可编程配置文件（也称为IaC脚本）来管理IT基础设施的过程。与其他软件制品一样，IaC脚本可能包含安全气味（security smells），即可能导致安全弱点的编码模式。目前已有用于检测IaC脚本中安全气味的自动化分析工具，但它们侧重于特定技术，如Puppet、Ansible或Chef。这意味着当某个工具实现了一种新气味的检测时，其他工具所支持的技术无法立即使用该检测——唯一的选择是重复劳动。本文提出了一种能够在不同IaC技术之间实现一致的安全气味检测的方法。我们进行了一项大规模实证研究，分析了包含196,755个IaC脚本和12,281,251行代码的三个大型数据集中的安全气味。我们表明，所有类别的安全气味都在所有数据集中被识别出来，并且我们识别出一些可能影响许多IaC项目的特定气味。为了进行这项研究，我们开发了GLITCH，这是一个新的与技术无关的框架，通过将IaC脚本转换为中间表示来实现自动化多语言气味检测，并可在该表示上定义不同的安全气味检测器。GLITCH目前支持检测以Ansible、Chef或Puppet编写的脚本中的九种不同安全气味。我们将GLITCH与最先进的安全气味检测器进行了比较。结果不仅表明GLITCH可以减少为多种IaC技术编写安全气味分析的工作量，而且还表明它在精确率和召回率方面均优于当前最先进的工具。

import_candidates.title: Graph based Incident Extraction and Diagnosis in Large-Scale Online Systems
import_candidates.abstract: With the ever increasing scale and complexity of online systems, incidents are gradually becoming commonplace. Without appropriate handling, they can seriously harm the system availability. However, in large-scale online systems, these incidents are usually drowning in a slew of issues (i.e., something abnormal, while not necessarily an incident), rendering them difficult to handle. Typically, these issues will result in a cascading effect across the system, and a proper management of the incidents depends heavily on a thorough analysis of this effect. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a method to automatically analyze the cascading effect of availability issues in online systems and extract the corresponding graph based issue representations incorporating both of the issue symptoms and affected service attributes. With the extracted representations, we train and utilize a graph neural networks based model to perform incident detection. Then, for the detected incident, we leverage the PageRank algorithm with a flexible transition matrix design to locate its root cause. We evaluate our approach using real-world data collected from the WeChat online service system, the largest instant message system in China. The results confirm the effectiveness of our approach. Moreover, our approach is successfully deployed in the company and eases the burden of operators in the face of a flood of issues and related alert signals.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着在线系统规模和复杂性的不断增加，事件逐渐变得司空见惯。如果处理不当，它们会严重损害系统的可用性。然而，在大规模在线系统中，这些事件通常淹没在大量的问题（即异常情况，但不一定是事件）之中，使它们难以处理。通常，这些问题会在系统中产生级联效应，而事件的妥善管理在很大程度上取决于对这种效应的彻底分析。因此，在本文中，我们提出了一种方法，自动分析在线系统中可用性问题的级联效应，并提取相应的基于图的问题表示，同时包含问题症状和受影响的服务属性。利用提取的表示，我们训练并使用基于图神经网络的模型进行事件检测。然后，对于检测到的事件，我们利用具有灵活转移矩阵设计的PageRank算法来定位其根本原因。我们使用从中国最大的即时消息系统——微信在线服务系统收集的真实数据来评估我们的方法。结果证实了我们方法的有效性。此外，我们的方法已成功部署在公司中，减轻了运营商面对大量问题和相关警报信号的负担。

import_candidates.title: Griffin : Grammar-Free DBMS Fuzzing
import_candidates.abstract: Fuzzing is a promising approach to DBMS testing. One crucial component in DBMS fuzzing is grammar: since DBMSs enforce strict validation on inputs, a grammar improves fuzzing efficiency by generating syntactically- and semantically-correct SQL statements. However, due to the vast differences in the complex grammar of various DBMSs, it is painstaking to adapt these fuzzers to them. Considering that lots of DBMSs are not yet well tested, there is an urgent need for an effective DBMS fuzzing approach that is free from grammar dependencies. In this paper, we propose Griffin, a grammar-free mutation based DBMS fuzzer. Rather than relying on grammar, Griffin summarizes the DBMS’s state into metadata graph, a lightweight data structure which improves mutation correctness in fuzzing. Specifically, it first tracks the metadata of the statements in built-in SQL test cases as they are executed, and constructs the metadata graph to describe the dependencies between metadata and statements iteratively. Based on the graphs, it reshuffles statements and employs metadata-guided substitution to correct semantic errors. We evaluate Griffin on MariaDB, SQLite, PostgreSQL, and DuckDB. Griffin covers 73.43\%-274.70\%, 80.47\%-312.89\%, 43.80\%-199.11\% more branches, and finds 27, 27, and 22 more bugs in 12 hours than SQLancer, SQLsmith, and Squirrel, respectively. In total, Griffin finds 55 previously unknown bugs with 13 CVEs assigned.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 模糊测试是一种有前景的数据库管理系统测试方法。数据库管理系统模糊测试的一个关键组成部分是语法：由于数据库管理系统对输入实行严格的验证，语法通过生成语法正确和语义正确的SQL语句来提高模糊测试的效率。然而，由于不同数据库管理系统的复杂语法差异巨大，将这些模糊测试器适配到它们非常费力。考虑到许多数据库管理系统尚未得到充分测试，目前迫切需要一种不依赖语法的有效数据库管理系统模糊测试方法。在本文中，我们提出了Griffin，一种无语法的基于变异的数据库管理系统模糊测试器。Griffin不依赖语法，而是将数据库管理系统的状态概括为元数据图，这是一种轻量级数据结构，可提高模糊测试中变异的正确性。具体来说，它首先在内置SQL测试用例执行时跟踪语句的元数据，并迭代地构建元数据图以描述元数据与语句之间的依赖关系。在此基础上，它对语句进行重新排序，并使用元数据引导的替换来纠正语义错误。我们在MariaDB、SQLite、PostgreSQL和DuckDB上评估了Griffin。与SQLancer相比，Griffin的分支覆盖率增加73.43%–274.70%；与SQLsmith相比增加80.47%–312.89%；与Squirrel相比增加43.80%–199.11%；同时，在12小时内分别比SQLancer、SQLsmith和Squirrel多发现27个、27个和22个缺陷。总的来说，Griffin发现了55个先前未知的缺陷，其中13个已分配CVE。

import_candidates.title: Groundhog: An Automated Accessibility Crawler for Mobile Apps
import_candidates.abstract: Accessibility is a critical software quality affecting more than 15\% of the world’s population with some form of disabilities. Modern mobile platforms, i.e., iOS and Android, provide guidelines and testing tools for developers to assess the accessibility of their apps. The main focus of the testing tools is on examining a particular screen’s compliance with some predefined rules derived from accessibility guidelines. Unfortunately, these tools cannot detect accessibility issues that manifest themselves in interactions with apps using assistive services, e.g., screen readers. A few recent studies have proposed assistive-service driven testing; however, they require manually constructed inputs from developers to evaluate a specific screen or presume availability of UI test cases. In this work, we propose an automated accessibility crawler for mobile apps, Groundhog, that explores an app with the purpose of finding accessibility issues without any manual effort from developers. Groundhog assesses the functionality of UI elements in an app with and without assistive services and pinpoints accessibility issues with an intuitive video of how to replicate them. Our experiments show Groundhog is highly effective in detecting accessibility barriers that existing techniques cannot discover. Powered by Groundhog, we conducted an empirical study on a large set of real-world apps and found new classes of critical accessibility issues that should be the focus of future work in this area.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 无障碍性是一项关键的软件质量属性，影响着全球超过15%的各类残障人群。现代移动平台（如iOS和Android）为开发者提供了评估其应用无障碍性的指南和测试工具。这些测试工具的主要重点是检查特定屏幕是否符合从无障碍指南中派生出的某些预定义规则。不幸的是，这些工具无法检测在使用辅助服务（例如读屏器）与应用交互时表现出的无障碍问题。最近一些研究提出了辅助服务驱动的测试，但它们需要开发者手动构造输入来评估特定屏幕，或假定存在UI测试用例。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种自动化的移动应用无障碍爬虫Groundhog，它无需开发者任何手动操作即可探索应用并发现无障碍问题。Groundhog评估应用中UI元素在有和没有辅助服务时的功能，并通过直观的视频指出问题及复现步骤。我们的实验表明，Groundhog在检测现有技术无法发现的无障碍障碍方面非常有效。在Groundhog的推动下，我们对大量真实应用进行了实证研究，并发现了新的关键无障碍问题类别，这些问题应成为该领域未来工作的重点。

import_candidates.title: Has My Release Disobeyed Semantic Versioning? Static Detection Based on Semantic Differencing
import_candidates.abstract: To enhance the compatibility in the version control of Java Third-party Libraries (TPLs), Maven adopts Semantic Versioning (SemVer) to standardize the underlying meaning of versions, but users could still confront abnormal execution and crash after upgrades even if compilation and linkage succeed. It is caused by semantic breaking (SemB) issues, such that APIs directly used by users have identical signatures but inconsistent semantics across upgrades. To strengthen compliance with SemVer rules, developers and users should be alerted of such issues. Unfortunately, it is challenging to detect them statically, because semantic changes in the internal methods of APIs are difficult to capture. Dynamic testing can confirmingly uncover some, but it is limited by inadequate coverage. To detect SemB issues over compatible upgrades (Patch and Minor) by SemVer rules, we conduct an empirical study on 180 SemB issues to understand the root causes, inspired by which, we propose Sembid (Semantic Breaking Issue Detector) to statically detect such issues of TPLs for developers and users. Since APIs are directly used by users, Sembid detects and reports SemB issues based on APIs. For a pair of APIs, Sembid walks through the call chains originating from the API to locate breaking changes by measuring semantic diff. Then, Sembid checks if the breaking changes can affect API’s output along call chains. The evaluation showed Sembid achieved recall and precision and outperformed other API checkers on SemB API detection. We also revealed Sembid detected over 3 times more SemB APIs with better coverage than unit tests, the commonly used solution. Furthermore, we carried out an empirical study on 1,629,589 APIs from 546 version pairs of top Java libraries and found there were 2 ∼ 4 times more SemB APIs than those with signature-based issues. Due to various version release strategies, of Patch version pairs and of Minor version pairs had at least one API affected by any breaking.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 为了增强Java第三方库（TPLs）版本控制中的兼容性，Maven采用语义化版本控制（SemVer）来规范化版本的内在含义，但即使升级后编译和链接成功，用户仍可能遭遇异常执行甚至崩溃。这是由于语义断裂（SemB）问题造成的，即用户直接使用的API在升级后保持相同签名但语义不一致。为了加强对SemVer规则的遵守，应提醒开发者和用户此类问题。不幸的是，静态检测它们具有挑战性，因为API内部方法的语义变化难以捕获。动态测试可以确凿地发现一些问题，但受限于覆盖率不足。为了检测SemVer规则所定义的在兼容升级（补丁和次版本升级）中出现的SemB问题，我们对180个SemB问题进行了实证研究以理解其根本原因，并受此启发提出了Sembid（语义断裂问题检测器），以静态检测TPLs中的此类问题，供开发者和用户使用。由于API是用户直接使用的，Sembid基于API检测并报告SemB问题。对于一对API，Sembid遍历源自API的调用链，通过测量语义差异来定位断裂性变更。然后，Sembid检查这些断裂性变更是否会沿调用链影响API的输出。评估显示，Sembid在SemB API检测上取得了较高的召回率和精确率，并优于其他API检查器。我们还发现，Sembid检测到的SemB API数量是常用解决方案单元测试的3倍以上，且覆盖率更好。此外，我们对来自546个版本对的高知名度Java库的1,629,589个API进行了实证研究，发现SemB API的数量是签名问题API数量的2至4倍。由于不同的版本发布策略，Patch版本对和Minor版本对中分别有一定比例的版本对至少有某个API受到任何断裂性变更的影响。

import_candidates.title: How Useful is Code Change Information for Fault Localization in Continuous Integration?
import_candidates.abstract: Continuous integration (CI) is the process in which code changes are automatically integrated, built, and tested in a shared repository. In CI, developers frequently merge and test code under development, which helps isolate faults with finer-grained change information. To identify faulty code, prior research has widely studied and evaluated the performance of spectrum-based fault localization (SBFL) techniques. While the continuous nature of CI requires the code changes to be atomic and presents fine-grained information on what part of the system is being changed, traditional SBFL techniques do not benefit from it. To overcome the limitation, we propose to integrate the code and coverage change information in fault localization under CI settings. First, code changes show how faults are introduced into the system, and provide developers with better understanding on the root cause. Second, coverage changes show how the code coverage is impacted when faults are introduced. This change information can help limit the search space of code coverage, which offers more opportunities for improving fault localization techniques. Based on the above observations, we propose three new change-based fault localization techniques, and compare them with Ochiai, a commonly used SBFL technique. We evaluate these techniques on 192 real faults from seven software systems. Our results show that all three change-based techniques outperform Ochiai on the Defects4J dataset. In particular, the improvement varies from 7\% to 23\% and 17\% to 24\% for average MAP and MRR, respectively. Moreover, we find that our change-based fault localization techniques can be integrated with Ochiai, and boost its performance by up to 53\% and 52\% for average MAP and MRR, respectively.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 持续集成（CI）是将代码变更在共享仓库中自动集成、构建和测试的过程。在CI中，开发人员频繁合并和测试正在开发的代码，这有助于以更细粒度的变更信息隔离故障。为了识别故障代码，先前的研究广泛研究和评估了基于频谱的故障定位（SBFL）技术的性能。虽然CI的持续特性要求代码变更是原子的，并提供有关系统哪部分正在被更改的细粒度信息，但传统的SBFL技术并未从中受益。为克服这一局限，我们提出在CI设置下将代码和覆盖率变更信息集成到故障定位中。首先，代码变更显示了故障如何被引入系统，并为开发人员提供了对根本原因的更好理解。其次，覆盖率变更显示了当引入故障时代码覆盖率如何受到影响。这种变更信息有助于限制代码覆盖率的搜索空间，为改进故障定位技术提供了更多机会。基于上述观察，我们提出了三种新的基于变更的故障定位技术，并将它们与常用的SBFL技术Ochiai进行比较。我们在来自七个软件系统的192个真实故障上评估了这些技术。结果显示，在Defects4J数据集上，所有三种基于变更的技术均优于Ochiai。特别是，平均MAP和MRR的提升分别从7%到23%和17%到24%不等。此外，我们发现基于变更的故障定位技术可以与Ochiai集成，并将其平均MAP和MRR性能分别提升最多53%和52%。

import_candidates.title: HTFuzz: Heap Operation Sequence Sensitive Fuzzing
import_candidates.abstract: Heap-based temporal vulnerabilities (i.e., use-after-free, double-free and null pointer dereference) are highly sensitive to heap operation (e.g., memory allocation, deallocation and access) sequences. To efficiently find such vulnerabilities, traditional code coverage-guided fuzzing solutions could be promoted by integrating heap operation sequence feedback. But current sequence sensitive solutions have limitations in practice. In this paper, we propose a novel fuzzing solution named HTFuzz, to find heap-based temporal vulnerabilities. At the core, we utilize fuzzing to increase the coverage of runtime heap operation sequences and the diversity of pointers accessed by these operations, where the former reflects the control-flow and the latter reflects the data-flow of heap operation sequences. With such increases, the fuzzer could find more heap-based temporal vulnerabilities. We have developed a prototype of HTFuzz and evaluated it on 14 real-world applications, and compared it with 11 state-of-the-art fuzzers. The results showed that, HTFuzz outperformed all the baselines and was statistically better on the number of heap-based temporal vulnerabilities discovered. In detail, HTFuzz found (1.82x, 2.62x, 2.66x, 2.02x, 2.21x, 2.06x, 1.47x, 2.98x, 1.98x) more heap operation sequences and (1.45x, 3.56x, 3.56x, 4.57x, 1.78x, 1.78x, 1.68x, 4.00x, 1.45x) more 0day heap-based temporal vulnerabilities than (AFL, AFL-sensitive-ma, AFL-sensitive-mw, Memlock, PathAFL, TortoiseFuzz, MOPT, Angora, Ankou), respectively. HTFuzz discovered 37 new vulnerabilities with 37 CVEs assigned, including 32 new heap-based temporal vulnerabilities and 5 of other types.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 基于堆的时序漏洞（如释放后使用、双重释放和空指针解引用）对堆操作（如内存分配、释放和访问）序列高度敏感。为了高效发现此类漏洞，传统的基于代码覆盖率引导的模糊测试解决方案可以通过整合堆操作序列反馈来改进。但现有的序列敏感解决方案在实践中存在局限性。本文提出了一种名为HTFuzz的新型模糊测试解决方案，用于发现基于堆的时序漏洞。其核心是利用模糊测试来增加运行时堆操作序列的覆盖率以及这些操作所访问指针的多样性，其中前者反映控制流，后者反映堆操作序列的数据流。通过这些增加，模糊器可以发现更多基于堆的时序漏洞。我们开发了HTFuzz的原型，并在14个真实应用上进行了评估，与11个最先进的模糊器进行了比较。结果表明，HTFuzz在所有基线上表现更优，并且在发现的基于堆时序漏洞数量上统计上更好。具体而言，HTFuzz发现的堆操作序列比(AFL、AFL-sensitive-ma、AFL-sensitive-mw、Memlock、PathAFL、TortoiseFuzz、MOPT、Angora、Ankou)分别多(1.82倍、2.62倍、2.66倍、2.02倍、2.21倍、2.06倍、1.47倍、2.98倍、1.98倍)，发现的0day基于堆时序漏洞分别多(1.45倍、3.56倍、3.56倍、4.57倍、1.78倍、1.78倍、1.68倍、4.00倍、1.45倍)。HTFuzz发现了37个新漏洞，分配了37个CVE，其中包括32个新的基于堆的时序漏洞和5个其他类型漏洞。

import_candidates.title: HyperAST: Enabling Efficient Analysis of Software Histories at Scale
import_candidates.abstract: Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs) are widely used beyond compilers in many tools that measure and improve code quality, such as code analysis, bug detection, mining code metrics, refactoring. With the advent of fast software evolution and multistage releases, the temporal analysis of an AST history is becoming useful to understand and maintain code. However, jointly analyzing thousands versions of ASTs independently faces scalability issues, mostly combinatorial, both in terms of memory and CPU usage. In this paper, we propose a novel type of AST, called HyperAST, that enables efficient temporal code analysis on a given software history by: 1/ leveraging code redundancy through space (between code elements) and time (between versions); 2/ reusing intermediate computation results. We show how the HyperAST can be built incrementally on a set of commits to capture all multiple ASTs at once in an optimized way. We evaluated the HyperAST on a curated list of large software projects. Compared to Spoon, a state-of-the-art technique, we observed that the HyperAST outperforms it with an order-of-magnitude difference from \texttimes{} 6 up to \texttimes{} 8076 in CPU construction time and from \texttimes{} 12 up to \texttimes{} 1159 in memory footprint. While the HyperAST requires up to 2 h 22 min and 7.2 GB for the biggest project, Spoon requires up to 93 h and 31 min and 2.2 TB. The gains in construction time varied from to and the gains in memory footprint varied from to . We further compared the task of finding references of declarations with the HyperAST and Spoon. We observed on average precision and recall without a significant difference in search time.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 抽象语法树（AST）不仅广泛用于编译器，还用于许多衡量和改进代码质量的工具，如代码分析、错误检测、代码指标挖掘和重构。随着软件快速演进和多阶段发布的出现，对AST历史进行时间分析正变得有助于理解和维护代码。然而，独立联合分析数千个版本的AST会面临可扩展性问题，主要是在内存和CPU使用方面存在组合爆炸。在本文中，我们提出了一种新型AST，称为HyperAST，它通过对给定软件历史进行高效的时间代码分析，其方法包括：1）利用代码在空间（代码元素之间）和时间（版本之间）上的冗余；2）重用中间计算结果。我们展示了如何在提交集合上以增量方式构建HyperAST，以优化的方式一次性捕获所有多个AST。我们在精选的大型软件项目集上评估了HyperAST。与最先进的技术Spoon相比，我们观察到HyperAST在CPU构建时间上从6倍到8076倍，在内存占用上从12倍到1159倍，均优于Spoon。对于最大的项目，HyperAST需要最多2小时22分钟和7.2 GB，而Spoon需要最多93小时31分钟和2.2 TB。构建时间的提升幅度从到不等，内存占用的提升幅度从到不等。我们进一步比较了使用HyperAST和Spoon查找声明引用的任务。我们观察到了平均精确率和召回率，搜索时间没有显著差异。

import_candidates.title: ICEBAR: Feedback-Driven Iterative Repair of Alloy Specifications
import_candidates.abstract: Automated program repair (APR) techniques have shown great success in automatically finding fixes for programs in programming languages such as C or Java. In this work, we focus on repairing formal specifications, in particular for the Alloy specification language. As opposed to most APR tools, our approach to repair Alloy specifications, named ICEBAR, does not use test-based oracles for patch assessment. Instead, ICEBAR relies on the use of property-based oracles, commonly found in Alloy specifications as predicates and assertions.
