Moreover, we focus on libraries for which the developers have explicitly provided code examples, yielding over 300,000 LOC of hand-written API example code from the 967 client projects in the data set. This evaluation suggests that the hand-written examples actually have limited coverage of real API usages.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现有API挖掘算法往往难以使用，因为需要昂贵的参数调整，且返回的API调用集合可能庞大、高度冗余且难以理解。针对这一问题，我们提出了PAM（概率性API挖掘器），一种几乎无需参数的算法，用于挖掘最有趣的API调用模式。我们表明，PAM在从GitHub检索相关API调用序列时显著优于MAPO和UPMiner，测试集精确度达69%。此外，我们重点研究开发者明确提供代码示例的库，数据集中的967个客户端项目产生了超过30万行手写API示例代码。评估表明，手写示例实际上对真实API使用的覆盖有限。

import_candidates.title: API deprecation: a retrospective analysis and detection method for code examples on the web
import_candidates.abstract: Deprecation allows the developers of application programming interfaces (APIs) to signal to other developers that a given API item ought to be avoided. But little is known about deprecation practices beyond anecdotes. We examine how API deprecation has been used in 26 open source Java frameworks and libraries, finding that the classic deprecate–replace–remove cycle is often not followed, as many APIs were removed without prior deprecation, many deprecated APIs were subsequently un-deprecated, and removed APIs are even resurrected with surprising frequency. Furthermore, we identify several problems in the information commonly (not) provided to help API consumers transition their dependent code. As a consequence of deprecation, coding examples on the web --- an increasingly important source of information for developers --- can easily become outdated. Code examples that demonstrate how to use deprecated APIs can be difficult to disregard and a waste of time for developers. We propose a lightweight, version-sensitive framework to detect deprecated API usages in source code examples on the web so developers can be informed of such usages before they invest time and energy into studying them. We reify the framework as a prototype tool (Deprecation Watcher). Our evaluation on detecting deprecated Android API usages in code examples on Stack Overflow shows our tool obtains a precision of 100\% and a recall of 86\% in a random sample of 200 questions.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 弃用机制允许应用程序编程接口（API）的开发者向其他开发者发出信号，告知某一 API 项目应当避免使用。但除了一些轶事之外，人们对于弃用实践知之甚少。我们考察了弃用机制在 26 个开源 Java 框架和库中的使用情况，发现经典的“弃用-替换-移除”周期常常未被遵循，因为许多 API 在没有事先弃用的情况下就被移除，许多已弃用的 API 随后又被取消弃用，甚至被移除的 API 还以惊人的频率被重新启用。此外，我们还发现了在帮助 API 使用者迁移其依赖代码时通常（未）提供的信息中存在若干问题。由于弃用，网络上日益成为开发者重要信息来源的编码示例很容易过时。展示如何使用已弃用 API 的代码示例可能难以被忽视，而且会浪费开发者的时间。我们提出了一种轻量级、对版本敏感的框架，用于检测网络上源代码示例中已弃用 API 的使用情况，以便开发者在投入时间和精力研究这些示例之前获知相关信息。我们将该框架实现为原型工具（Deprecation Watcher）。我们使用该工具检测 Stack Overflow 代码示例中已弃用 Android API 使用情况的评估表明，在 200 个问题的随机样本中，该工具获得了 100% 的精确率和 86% 的召回率。

import_candidates.title: When should internal interfaces be promoted to public?
import_candidates.abstract: Commonly, software systems have public (and stable) interfaces, and internal (and possibly unstable) interfaces. Despite being discouraged, client developers often use internal interfaces, which may cause their systems to fail when they evolve. To overcome this problem, API producers may promote internal interfaces to public. In practice, however, API producers have no assistance to identify public interface candidates. In this paper, we study the transition from internal to public interfaces. We aim to help API producers to deliver a better product and API clients to benefit sooner from public interfaces. Our empirical investigation on five widely adopted Java systems present the following observations. First, we identified 195 promotions from 2,722 internal interfaces. Second, we found that promoted internal interfaces have more clients. Third, we predicted internal interface promotion with precision between 50\%-80\%, recall 26\%-82\%, and AUC 74\%-85\%. Finally, by applying our predictor on the last version of the analyzed systems, we automatically detected 382 public interface candidates.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 通常，软件系统拥有公共（且稳定）的接口以及内部（可能不稳定）的接口。尽管不鼓励，客户端开发者却经常使用内部接口，这可能导致其系统在接口演进时发生故障。为了克服这一问题，API 生产者可能会将内部接口晋升为公共接口。然而在实践中，API 生产者缺乏识别公共接口候选对象的辅助手段。在本文中，我们研究了从内部接口到公共接口的转变。我们的目标是帮助 API 生产者交付更好的产品，并帮助 API 客户端更早受益于公共接口。我们对五个广泛采用的 Java 系统进行的实证调查得出以下发现：首先，我们从 2,722 个内部接口中识别出 195 次晋升。其次，我们发现被晋升的内部接口拥有更多客户端。第三，我们以 50%-80% 的精确度、26%-82% 的召回率和 74%-85% 的 AUC 预测了内部接口的晋升。最后，通过将我们的预测器应用于所分析系统的最新版本，我们自动检测出 382 个公共接口候选对象。

import_candidates.title: POLLUX: safely upgrading dependent application libraries
import_candidates.abstract: Software evolution in third-party libraries across version upgrades can result in addition of new functionalities or change in existing APIs. As a result, there is a real danger of impairment of backward compatibility. Application developers, therefore, must keep constant vigil over library enhancements to ensure application consistency, i.e., application retains its semantic behavior across library upgrades. In this paper, we present the design and implementation of POLLUX, a framework to detect application-affecting changes across two versions of the same dependent non-adversarial library binary, and provide feedback on whether the application developer should link to the newer version or not. POLLUX leverages relevant application test cases to drive execution through both versions of the concerned library binary, records all concrete effects on the environment, and compares them to determine semantic similarity across the same API invocation for the two library versions. Our evaluation with 16 popular, open-source library binaries shows that POLLUX is accurate with no false positives and works across compiler optimizations.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 第三方库在版本升级过程中的软件演进可能导致新功能的添加或现有API的更改。因此，向后兼容性受损是一个真实的风险。应用程序开发者必须持续关注库的增强，以确保应用程序的一致性，即应用程序在库升级后保持其语义行为。在本文中，我们介绍了POLLUX的设计与实现，这是一个框架，用于检测同一非恶意依赖库二进制的两个版本之间的应用程序影响变更，并提供反馈以说明应用程序开发者是否应链接到较新版本。POLLUX利用相关的应用程序测试用例驱动两个版本的库二进制执行，记录对环境的所有具体影响，并比较它们以确定两个库版本在同一API调用上的语义相似性。我们在16个流行的开源库二进制上进行的评估表明，POLLUX准确且无误报，并可跨编译器优化工作。

import_candidates.title: Extracting instruction semantics via symbolic execution of code generators
import_candidates.abstract: Binary analysis and instrumentation form the basis of many tools and frameworks for software debugging, security hardening, and monitoring. Accurate modeling of instruction semantics is paramount in this regard, as errors can lead to program crashes, or worse, bypassing of security checks. Semantic modeling is a daunting task for modern processors such as x86 and ARM that support over a thousand instructions, many of them with complex semantics. This paper describes a new approach to automate this semantic modeling task. Our approach leverages instruction semantics knowledge that is already encoded into today's production compilers such as GCC and LLVM. Such an approach can greatly reduce manual effort, and more importantly, avoid errors introduced by manual modeling. Furthermore, it is applicable to any of the numerous architectures already supported by the compiler. In this paper, we develop a new symbolic execution technique to extract instruction semantics from a compiler's source code. Unlike previous applications of symbolic execution that were focused on identifying a single program path that violates a property, our approach addresses the all paths problem, extracting the entire input/output behavior of the code generator. We have applied it successfully to the 120K lines of C-code used in GCC's code generator to extract x86 instruction semantics. To demonstrate architecture-neutrality, we have also applied it to AVR, a processor used in the popular Arduino platform.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 二进制分析和插桩构成了许多软件调试、安全加固和监控工具及框架的基础。指令语义的准确建模为此至关重要，因为错误可能导致程序崩溃，甚至更糟——绕过安全检查。对于像x86和ARM这样支持超过一千条指令、其中许多具有复杂语义的现代处理器而言，语义建模是一项艰巨的任务。本文描述了一种自动化语义建模任务的新方法。我们的方法利用了已经编码在当今生产编译器（如GCC和LLVM）中的指令语义知识。这种方法可以大大减少人工工作量，更重要的是，避免了人工建模引入的错误。此外，它适用于编译器已支持的众多架构中的任何一种。在本文中，我们开发了一种新的符号执行技术，从编译器的源代码中提取指令语义。与以往侧重于识别违反属性的单一程序路径的符号执行应用不同，我们的方法解决了全路径问题，提取了代码生成器的完整输入/输出行为。我们已成功将其应用于GCC代码生成器所使用的12万行C代码，以提取x86指令语义。为证明其架构中立性，我们还将其应用于AVR——一种在流行的Arduino平台中使用的处理器。

import_candidates.title: Efficient generation of inductive validity cores for safety properties
import_candidates.abstract: Symbolic model checkers can construct proofs of properties over very complex models. However, the results reported by the tool when a proof succeeds do not generally provide much insight to the user. It is often useful for users to have traceability information related to the proof: which portions of the model were necessary to construct it. This traceability information can be used to diagnose a variety of modeling problems such as overconstrained axioms and underconstrained properties, and can also be used to measure completeness of a set of requirements over a model. In this paper, we present a new algorithm to efficiently compute the em inductive validity core (IVC) within a model necessary for inductive proofs of safety properties for sequential systems. The algorithm is based on the UNSAT core support built into current SMT solvers and a novel encoding of the inductive problem to try to generate a minimal inductive validity core. We prove our algorithm is correct, and describe its implementation in the JKind model checker for Lustre models. We then present an experiment in which we benchmark the algorithm in terms of speed, diversity of produced cores, and minimality, with promising results.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 符号模型检查器可以为非常复杂的模型构建性质的证明。然而，当证明成功时，工具报告的结果通常不会给用户提供太多洞见。通常用户需要与证明相关的可追溯性信息：模型的哪些部分对于构建证明是必要的。这些可追溯信息可用于诊断各种建模问题，如过度约束的公理和欠约束的性质，也可用于衡量模型上需求的完备性。在本文中，我们提出了一种新算法，以高效计算顺序系统安全性质归纳证明所需模型中的归纳有效核心（IVC）。该算法基于当前SMT求解器中内置的UNSAT核心支持，以及对归纳问题的一种新颖编码，以尝试生成最小的归纳有效核心。我们证明了我们的算法是正确的，并描述了其在用于Lustre模型的JKind模型检查器中的实现。然后，我们通过一个实验来基准测试该算法在速度、生成核心多样性以及最小性方面的表现，结果令人鼓舞。

import_candidates.title: Correctness witnesses: exchanging verification results between verifiers
import_candidates.abstract: Standard verification tools provide a counterexample to witness a specification violation, and, since a few years, such a witness can be validated by an independent validator using an exchangeable witness format. This way, information about the violation can be shared across verification tools and the user can use standard tools to visualize and explore witnesses. This technique is not yet established for the correctness case, where a program fulfills a specification. Even for simple programs, it is often difficult for users to comprehend why a given program is correct, and there is no way to independently check the verification result. We close this gap by complementing our earlier work on violation witnesses with correctness witnesses. While we use an extension of the established common exchange format for violation witnesses to represent correctness witnesses, the techniques for producing and validating correctness witnesses are different. The overall goal to make proofs available to engineers is probably as old as programming itself, and proof-carrying code was proposed two decades ago --- our goal is to make it practical: We consider witnesses as first-class exchangeable objects, stored independently from the source code and checked independently from the verifier that produced them, respecting the important principle of separation of concerns. At any time, the invariants from the correctness witness can be used to reconstruct a correctness proof to establish trust. We extended two state-of-the-art verifiers, CPAchecker and Ultimate Automizer, to produce and validate witnesses, and report that the approach is promising on a large set of verification tasks.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 标准验证工具提供反例来证明规范违规，并且自几年前以来，这种反例可以通过可交换的证人格式由独立的验证器进行验证。这样，违规信息可以在不同验证工具之间共享，用户可以使用标准工具来可视化和探索反例。然而，对于程序满足规范的正确性情况，这种技术尚未成熟。即使对于简单的程序，用户也常常难以理解为什么给定程序是正确的，并且无法独立检查验证结果。我们通过将先前关于违规证人的工作与正确性证人进行互补来填补这一空白。我们使用已建立的违规证人通用交换格式的扩展来表示正确性证人，但生成和验证正确性证人的技术是不同的。让工程师获得证明的总体目标可能与编程本身一样古老，而证明携带代码早在二十年前就被提出——我们的目标是使其实用化：我们将证人视为一级可交换对象，独立于源代码存储，并独立于生成它们的验证器进行检查，尊重关注点分离的重要原则。任何时候，来自正确性证人的不变式都可以用来重建正确性证明以建立信任。我们扩展了两种最先进的验证器CPAchecker和Ultimate Automizer来生成和验证证人，并报告该方法在一大批验证任务上是有前景的。

import_candidates.title: SMT-based verification of parameterized systems
import_candidates.abstract: It is well known that verification of safety properties of sequential programs is reducible to satisfiability modulo theory of a first-order logic formula, called a verification condition (VC). The reduction is used both in deductive and automated verification, the difference is only in whether the user or the solver provides candidates for inductive invariants. In this paper, we extend the reduction to parameterized systems consisting of arbitrary many copies of a user-specified process, and whose transition relation is definable in first-order logic modulo theory of linear arithmetic and arrays. We show that deciding whether a parameterized system has a universally quantified inductive invariant is reducible to satisfiability of (non-linear) Constraint Horn Clauses (CHC). As a consequence of our reduction, we obtain a new automated procedure for verifying parameterized systems using existing PDR and CHC engines. While the new procedure is applicable to a wide variety of systems, we show that it is a decision procedure for several decidable fragments.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 众所周知，顺序程序的安全性属性验证可归结为对一阶逻辑公式（称为验证条件，VC）的模理论可满足性判定。这种归约在演绎式和自动化验证中均有使用，区别仅在于归纳不变式的候选由用户提供还是由求解器提供。本文将这种归约扩展到参数化系统，此类系统包含任意多个用户指定进程的副本，且其转移关系可在线性算术与数组理论的模理论一阶逻辑中定义。我们证明了判定参数化系统是否存在全称量化的归纳不变式，可归结为对（非线性）约束Horn子句（CHC）的可满足性判定。作为该归约的结果，我们利用现有的PDR和CHC引擎获得了一个新的参数化系统自动化验证程序。虽然该新程序可应用于多种系统，但我们证明它对若干可判定片段是决策程序。

import_candidates.title: On-the-fly decomposition of specifications in software model checking
import_candidates.abstract: Major breakthroughs have increased the efficiency and effectiveness of software model checking considerably, such that this technology is now applicable to industrial-scale software. However, verifying the full formal specification of a software system is still considered too complex, and in practice, sets of properties are verified one by one in isolation. We propose an approach that takes the full formal specification as input and first tries to verify all properties simultaneously in one verification run. Our verification algorithm monitors itself and detects situations for which the full set of properties is too complex. In such cases, we perform an automatic decomposition of the full set of properties into smaller sets, and continue the verification seamlessly. To avoid state-space explosion for large sets of properties, we introduce on-the-fly property weaving: properties get weaved into the program's transition system on the fly, during the analysis; which properties to weave and verify is determined dynamically during the verification process. We perform an extensive evaluation based on verification tasks that were derived from 4336 Linux kernel modules, and a set of properties that define the correct usage of the Linux API. Checking several properties simultaneously can lead to a significant performance gain, due to the fact that abstract models share many parts among different properties.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 重大突破已显著提高了软件模型检测的效率和有效性，使这项技术如今可应用于工业规模的软件。然而，验证软件系统的完整形式化规范仍被认为过于复杂，在实践中，一组组属性通常会被隔离地逐一验证。我们提出了一种方法，该方法将完整形式化规范作为输入，并首先尝试在一次验证运行中同时验证所有属性。我们的验证算法对自身进行监控，并检测完整属性集过于复杂的情况。在这种情况下，我们自动将完整属性集分解为较小的集合，并无缝地继续验证。为避免大规模属性集的状态空间爆炸，我们引入了即时属性编织：在分析过程中，属性被即时编织到程序的转换系统中；编织和验证哪些属性在验证过程中动态决定。我们基于从4336个Linux内核模块推导出的验证任务以及一组定义Linux API正确使用方式的属性进行了广泛评估。同时检查多个属性可带来显著的性能提升，因为抽象模型在不同属性之间共享许多部分。

import_candidates.title: On well-separation of GR(1) specifications
import_candidates.abstract: Specifications for reactive synthesis, an automated procedure to obtain a correct-by-construction reactive system, consist of assumptions and guarantees. One way a controller may satisfy the specification is by preventing the environment from satisfying the assumptions, without satisfying the guarantees. Although valid this solution is usually undesired and specifications that allow it are called non-well-separated. In this work we investigate non-well-separation in the context of GR(1), an expressive fragment of LTL that enables efficient synthesis. We distinguish different cases of non-well-separation, and compute strategies showing how the environment can be forced to violate its assumptions. Moreover, we show how to find a core, a minimal set of assumptions that lead to non-well-separation, and further extend our work to support past-time LTL and patterns. We implemented our work and evaluated it on 79 specifications. The evaluation shows that non-well-separation is a common problem in specifications and that our tools can be efficiently applied to identify it and its causes.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 反应式综合是一种自动获得构造正确反应式系统的过程，其规范由假设和保证组成。控制器满足规范的一种方式是阻止环境满足假设而不满足保证。虽然这合法，但通常是不期望的，允许这种解的规范被称为非良好分离的。在本工作中，我们研究GR(1)（LTL的一个表达性片段，支持高效综合）中的非良好分离。我们区分非良好分离的不同情况，并计算显示如何迫使环境违反其假设的策略。此外，我们展示如何找到导致非良好分离的核心（一组最小假设），并进一步将我们的工作扩展到支持过去时LTL和模式。我们实现了我们的工作，并在79个规范上进行了评估。评估表明，非良好分离是规范中的常见问题，我们的工具可以有效地识别它及其原因。

import_candidates.title: Lightweight specification and analysis of dynamic systems with rich configurations
import_candidates.abstract: Model-checking is increasingly popular in the early phases of the software development process. To establish the correctness of a software design one must usually verify both structural and behavioral (or temporal) properties. Unfortunately, most specification languages, and accompanying model-checkers, excel only in analyzing either one or the other kind. This limits their ability to verify dynamic systems with rich configurations: systems whose state space is characterized by rich structural properties, but whose evolution is also expected to satisfy certain temporal properties. To address this problem, we first propose Electrum, an extension of the Alloy specification language with temporal logic operators, where both rich configurations and expressive temporal properties can easily be defined. Two alternative model-checking techniques are then proposed, one bounded and the other unbounded, to verify systems expressed in this language, namely to verify that every desirable temporal property holds for every possible configuration.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 模型检测在软件开发过程的早期阶段日益流行。要确立软件设计的正确性，通常必须同时验证结构属性和行为（或时序）属性。不幸的是，大多数规格说明语言及其配套模型检测器只擅长分析其中一种。这限制了它们验证具有丰富配置的动态系统的能力：此类系统的状态空间以丰富的结构属性为特征，但其演化也应满足某些时序属性。为解决此问题，我们首先提出Electrum，这是Alloy规格说明语言的一种扩展，加入了时序逻辑算子，从而可以轻松定义丰富的配置和表达性强的时序属性。随后提出两种替代性的模型检测技术，一种有界，一种无界，用于验证用该语言表示的系统，即验证每条期望的时序属性对所有可能的配置都成立。

import_candidates.title: Gray links in the use of requirements traceability
import_candidates.abstract: The value of traceability is in its use. How do different software engineering tasks affect the tracing of the same requirement? In this paper, we answer the question via an empirical study where we explicitly assign the participants into 3 trace-usage groups of one requirement: finding its implementation for verification and validation purpose, changing it within the original software system, and reusing it toward another application. The results uncover what we call "gray links"--around 20\% of the total traces are voted to be true links with respect to only one task but not the others. We provide a mechanism to identify such gray links and discuss how they can be leveraged to advance the research and practice of value-based requirements traceability.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 可追溯性的价值在于其使用。不同的软件工程任务如何影响对同一需求的可追溯性？在本文中，我们通过一项实证研究来回答这个问题，在该研究中，我们将参与者明确分配到三个需求追溯使用组：为验证和确认目的而查找其实现、在原始软件系统中对其进行修改，以及将其复用到另一个应用程序。结果揭示了我们所说的“灰色链接”——大约20%的追踪记录被投票认为仅相对于某一任务是真实链接，而相对于其他任务则不是。我们提供了一种识别此类灰色链接的机制，并讨论了如何利用它们来推进基于价值的需求可追溯性的研究和实践。

import_candidates.title: Understanding and detecting wake lock misuses for Android applications
import_candidates.abstract: Wake locks are widely used in Android apps to protect critical computations from being disrupted by device sleeping. Inappropriate use of wake locks often seriously impacts user experience. However, little is known on how wake locks are used in real-world Android apps and the impact of their misuses. To bridge the gap, we conducted a large-scale empirical study on 44,736 commercial and 31 open-source Android apps. By automated program analysis and manual investigation, we observed (1) common program points where wake locks are acquired and released, (2) 13 types of critical computational tasks that are often protected by wake locks, and (3) eight patterns of wake lock misuses that commonly cause functional and non-functional issues, only three of which had been studied by existing work. Based on our findings, we designed a static analysis technique, Elite, to detect two most common patterns of wake lock misuses. Our experiments on real-world subjects showed that Elite is effective and can outperform two state-of-the-art techniques.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 唤醒锁被广泛用于Android应用中，以保护关键计算不被设备休眠所干扰。唤醒锁的不当使用通常会严重影响用户体验。然而，关于唤醒锁在真实世界Android应用中如何被使用及其误用的影响，目前知之甚少。为了弥补这一差距，我们对44,736个商业应用和31个开源Android应用进行了大规模实证研究。通过自动化程序分析和人工调查，我们观察到（1）获取和释放唤醒锁的常见程序点，（2）通常受唤醒锁保护的13种关键计算任务，以及（3）八种常见的导致功能性和非功能性问题的唤醒锁误用模式，其中只有三种已被现有工作研究。基于我们的发现，我们设计了一种静态分析技术Elite来检测两种最常见的唤醒锁误用模式。我们在真实世界测试对象上的实验表明，Elite是有效的，并且能够超越两种最先进的技术。

import_candidates.title: DiagDroid: Android performance diagnosis via anatomizing asynchronous executions
import_candidates.abstract: Rapid UI responsiveness is a key consideration to Android app developers. However, the complicated concurrency model of Android makes it hard for developers to understand and further diagnose the UI performance. This paper presents DiagDroid, a tool specifically designed for Android UI performance diagnosis. The key notion of DiagDroid is that UI-triggered asynchronous executions contribute to the UI performance, and hence their performance and their runtime dependency should be properly captured to facilitate performance diagnosis. However, there are tremendous ways to start asynchronous executions, posing a great challenge to profiling such executions and their runtime dependency. To this end, we properly abstract five categories of asynchronous executions as the building basis. As a result, they can be tracked and profiled based on the specifics of each category with a dynamic instrumentation approach carefully tailored for Android. DiagDroid can then accordingly profile the asynchronous executions in a task granularity, equipping it with low-overhead and high compatibility merits. The tool is successfully applied in diagnosing 33 real-world open-source apps, and we find 14 of them contain 27 performance issues. It shows the effectiveness of our tool in Android UI performance diagnosis. The tool is open-source released online.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 快速的UI响应是Android应用开发者的关键考量。然而，Android复杂的并发模型使得开发者难以理解并进一步诊断UI性能。本文提出了DiagDroid，一个专为Android UI性能诊断设计的工具。DiagDroid的核心概念是，由UI触发的异步执行对UI性能有影响，因此应恰当地捕获其性能及运行时依赖以辅助性能诊断。然而，启动异步执行的方式多种多样，这给分析这类执行及其运行时依赖带来了巨大挑战。为此，我们合理抽象了五类异步执行作为构建基础，并据此结合为Android量身定制的动态插桩方法，对它们进行跟踪和分析。DiagDroid随后能以任务粒度剖析异步执行，从而具备低开销和高兼容性的优点。该工具已被成功用于诊断33个真实世界的开源应用，其中14个被发现存在27个性能问题。这显示了我们的工具在Android UI性能诊断中的有效性。该工具已在线上开源发布。

import_candidates.title: Minimizing GUI event traces
import_candidates.abstract: GUI input generation tools for Android apps, such as Android's Monkey, are useful for automatically producing test inputs, but these tests are generally orders of magnitude larger than necessary, making them difficult for humans to understand. We present a technique for minimizing the output of such tools. Our technique accounts for the non-deterministic behavior of mobile apps, producing small event traces that reach a desired activity with high probability. We propose a variant of delta debugging, augmented to handle non-determinism, to solve the problem of trace minimization. We evaluate our algorithm on two sets of commercial and open-source Android applications, showing that we can minimize large event traces reaching a particular application activity, producing traces that are, on average, less than 2\% the size of the original traces.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Android应用的GUI输入生成工具（如Android的Monkey）对于自动生成测试输入很有用，但这类测试通常比必要规模大出几个数量级，使人们难以理解。我们提出了一种最小化此类工具输出的技术。该技术考虑了移动应用的非确定性行为，产生能够以高概率到达目标活动的小规模事件轨迹。我们提出了一种变体的delta调试算法，并扩展以处理非确定性，从而解决轨迹最小化问题。我们在两组商业和开源Android应用上评估了我们的算法，表明我们可以最小化到达特定应用活动的庞大事件轨迹，产生的轨迹平均仅为原始轨迹规模的不到2%。

import_candidates.title: Causal impact analysis for app releases in google play
import_candidates.abstract: App developers would like to understand the impact of their own and their competitors’ software releases. To address this we introduce Causal Impact Release Analysis for app stores, and our tool, CIRA, that implements this analysis. We mined 38,858 popular Google Play apps, over a period of 12 months. For these apps, we identified 26,339 releases for which there was adequate prior and posterior time series data to facilitate causal impact analysis. We found that 33\% of these releases caused a statistically significant change in user ratings. We use our approach to reveal important characteristics that distinguish causal significance in Google Play. To explore the actionability of causal impact analysis, we elicited the opinions of app developers: 56 companies responded, 78\% concurred with the causal assessment, of which 33\% claimed that their company would consider changing its app release strategy as a result of our findings.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 应用开发者希望了解自己及竞争对手软件发布的影响。为此，我们引入了应用商店的因果影响发布分析，并实现了该分析工具CIRA。我们在12个月的期间内挖掘了38,858个热门Google Play应用。对于这些应用，我们识别出26,339次发布具有足够的前后时间序列数据以支持因果影响分析。我们发现这些发布中有33%导致了用户评级的统计学显著变化。我们利用该方法揭示了Google Play中区分因果显著性的重要特征。为了探索因果影响分析的可操作性，我们征求了应用开发者的意见：56家公司回应，其中78%同意因果评估，33%声称其公司会考虑根据我们的发现改变应用发布策略。

import_candidates.title: Static DOM event dependency analysis for testing web applications
import_candidates.abstract: The number and complexity of JavaScript-based web applications are rapidly increasing, but methods and tools for automatically testing them are lagging behind, primarily due to the difficulty in analyzing the subtle interactions between the applications and the event-driven execution environment. Although static analysis techniques have been routinely used on software written in traditional programming languages, such as Java and C++, adapting them to handle JavaScript code and the HTML DOM is difficult. In this work, we propose the first constraint-based declarative program analysis procedure for computing dependencies over program variables as well as event-handler functions of the various DOM elements, which is crucial for analyzing the behavior of a client-side web application. We implemented the method in a software tool named JSDEP and evaluated it in ARTEMIS, a platform for automated web application testing. Our experiments on a large set of web applications show the new method can significantly reduce the number of redundant test sequences and significantly increase test coverage with minimal overhead.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 基于JavaScript的Web应用的数量和复杂性正在迅速增加，但自动测试它们的方法和工具却滞后，主要困难在于分析应用与事件驱动执行环境之间的微妙交互。尽管静态分析技术已常被用于Java和C++等传统编程语言编写的软件，但将其适配以处理JavaScript代码和HTML DOM却具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们提出了第一个基于约束的声明式程序分析过程，用于计算程序变量以及各种DOM元素的事件处理函数之间的依赖关系，这对于分析客户端Web应用的行为至关重要。我们将该方法实现为名为JSDEP的软件工具，并在ARTEMIS自动化Web应用测试平台上进行评估。对大量Web应用的实验表明，新方法可以显著减少冗余测试序列的数量，并以最小开销显著提高测试覆盖率。

import_candidates.title: On-demand strong update analysis via value-flow refinement
import_candidates.abstract: We present a new Strong UPdate Analysis for C programs, called Supa, that enables computing points-to information on-demand via value-flow refinement, in environments with small time and memory budgets such as IDEs. We formulate Supa by solving a graph-reachability problem on a value- flow graph representation of the program, so that strong updates are performed where needed, as long as the total analysis budget is not exhausted. Supa facilitates efficiency and precision tradeoffs by allowing different pointer analyses to be applied in a hybrid multi-stage analysis framework. We have implemented Supa in LLVM with its artifact available at [1]. We evaluate Supa by choosing uninitialized pointer detection as a major client on 12 open-source C programs. As the analysis budget increases, Supa achieves improved precision, with its single-stage flow-sensitive analysis reaching 97\% of that achieved by whole-program flow- sensitive analysis by consuming about 0.19 seconds and 36KB of memory per query, on average (with a budget of at most 10000 value-flow edges per query).
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新的C程序强更新分析（Supa），通过值流细化实现按需计算指向信息，适用于IDE等时间和内存预算有限的环境。我们将Supa构建为在程序的值流图表示上求解图可达性问题，从而在总分析预算未耗尽的情况下，在需要的地方进行强更新。Supa通过允许不同的指针分析在混合多阶段分析框架中应用，从而在效率和精度之间进行权衡。我们已在LLVM中实现了Supa，其工件可在[1]处获得。我们选择未初始化指针检测作为主要客户端，对12个开源C程序进行了评估。随着分析预算的增加，Supa实现了精度的提高，其单阶段流敏感分析在平均每次查询消耗约0.19秒和36KB内存（最多10000条值流边预算）的情况下，达到了全程序流敏感分析精度的97%。

import_candidates.title: Call graph construction for Java libraries
import_candidates.abstract: Today, every application uses software libraries. Yet, while a lot of research exists w.r.t. analyzing applications, research that targets the analysis of libraries independent of any application is scarce. This is unfortunate, because, for developers of libraries, such as the Java Development Kit (JDK), it is crucial to ensure that the library behaves as intended regardless of how it is used. To fill this gap, we discuss the construction of call graphs for libraries that abstract over all potential library usages. Call graphs are particularly relevant as they are a precursor of many advanced analyses, such as inter-procedural data-flow analyses. We show that the current practice of using call graph algorithms designed for applications to analyze libraries leads to call graphs that, at the same time, lack relevant call edges and contain unnecessary edges. This motivates the need for call graph construction algorithms dedicated to libraries. Unlike algorithms for applications, call graph construction algorithms for libraries must take into consideration the goals of subsequent analyses. Specifically, we show that it is essential to distinguish between the scenario of an analysis for potential exploitable vulnerabilities from the scenario of an analysis for general software quality attributes, e.g., dead methods or unused fields. This distinction affects the decision about what constitutes the library-private implementation, which therefore, needs special treatment. Thus, building one call graph that satisfies all needs is not sensical. Overall, we observed that the proposed call graph algorithms reduce the number of call edges up to 30\% when compared to existing approaches.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 如今，每个应用程序都使用软件库。然而，尽管已有大量关于应用程序分析的研究，但针对独立于任何应用程序的库分析的研究却很少。这很遗憾，因为对于库的开发者（如Java开发工具包JDK）而言，确保库无论被如何使用都能按预期运行至关重要。为了填补这一空白，我们讨论了为库构建调用图的方法，这些调用图抽象了所有潜在的库用法。调用图尤其重要，因为它们是许多高级分析（如过程间数据流分析）的前驱。我们表明，目前使用为应用程序设计的调用图算法来分析库的做法，会导致调用图既缺少相关的调用边，又包含不必要的边。这激发了对专门用于库的调用图构建算法的需求。与针对应用程序的算法不同，针对库的调用图构建算法必须考虑后续分析的目标。具体而言，我们表明，区分“潜在可利用漏洞分析”和“一般软件质量属性（如死方法或未使用字段）分析”这两种场景至关重要。这种区分会影响对于什么是库私有实现（需要特殊处理）的决策。因此，构建一个满足所有需求的调用图是没有意义的。总体而言，我们观察到，与现有方法相比，所提出的调用图算法将调用边数量减少了多达30%。

import_candidates.title: Revamping JavaScript static analysis via localization and remediation of root causes of imprecision
import_candidates.abstract: Static analysis is challenged by the dynamic language constructs of JavaScript which often lead to unacceptable performance and/or precision results. We describe an approach that focuses on improving the practicality and accuracy of points-to analysis and call graph construction for JavaScript programs. The approach first identifies program constructs which are sources of imprecision (i.e., root causes) through monitoring the static analysis process. We then examine and suggest specific context-sensitive analyses to apply. Our technique is able to to find that the root causes comprise less than 2\% of the functions in JavaScript library applications. Moreover, the specialized analysis derived by our approach finishes within a few seconds, even on programs which can not complete within 10 minutes with the original analysis.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 静态分析受到JavaScript动态语言结构的挑战，这些结构常常导致难以接受的性能和/或精度结果。我们描述了一种专注于提高JavaScript程序指向分析和调用图构建的实用性与准确性的方法。该方法首先通过监控静态分析过程来识别导致不精确的程序结构（即根本原因）。然后我们检查并建议应用特定的上下文敏感分析。我们的技术能够发现，在JavaScript库应用程序中，根本原因涉及的函数不到2%。此外，通过我们的方法推导出的专门分析只需几秒即可完成，即使对于原始分析在10分钟内无法完成的程序也是如此。

import_candidates.title: What would users change in my app? summarizing app reviews for recommending software changes
import_candidates.abstract: Mobile app developers constantly monitor feedback in user reviews with the goal of improving their mobile apps and better meeting user expectations. Thus, automated approaches have been proposed in literature with the aim of reducing the effort required for analyzing feedback contained in user reviews via automatic classification/prioritization according to specific topics. In this paper, we introduce SURF (Summarizer of User Reviews Feedback), a novel approach to condense the enormous amount of information that developers of popular apps have to manage due to user feedback received on a daily basis. SURF relies on a conceptual model for capturing user needs useful for developers performing maintenance and evolution tasks. Then it uses sophisticated summarisation techniques for summarizing thousands of reviews and generating an interactive, structured and condensed agenda of recommended software changes. We performed an end-to-end evaluation of SURF on user reviews of 17 mobile apps (5 of them developed by Sony Mobile), involving 23 developers and researchers in total. Results demonstrate high accuracy of SURF in summarizing reviews and the usefulness of the recommended changes. In evaluating our approach we found that SURF helps developers in better understanding user needs, substantially reducing the time required by developers compared to manually analyzing user (change) requests and planning future software changes.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 移动应用开发者不断监控用户评论中的反馈，以期改进他们的移动应用并更好地满足用户期望。因此，文献中提出了自动化方法，旨在通过根据特定主题进行自动分类/排序来减少分析用户评论中反馈所需的工作量。本文介绍了SURF（用户反馈评论摘要器），这是一种新颖的方法，用于压缩热门应用开发者因每天收到用户反馈而需要管理的大量信息。SURF依靠一个概念模型来捕捉对执行维护和演进任务的开发者有用的用户需求。然后，它使用先进的摘要技术来总结数千条评论，并生成一个交互式、结构化且压缩的建议软件变更议程。我们对17个移动应用（其中5个由索尼移动开发）的用户评论进行了苏尔的端到端评估，共涉及23名开发者和研究人员。结果表明，SURF在总结评论方面具有高准确性，并且推荐的更改具有实用性。在评估我们的方法时，我们发现SURF帮助开发者更好地理解用户需求，与手动分析用户（变更）请求和规划未来软件更改相比，显著减少了开发者所需的时间。

import_candidates.title: API code recommendation using statistical learning from fine-grained changes
import_candidates.abstract: Learning and remembering how to use APIs is difficult. While code-completion tools can recommend API methods, browsing a long list of API method names and their documentation is tedious. Moreover, users can easily be overwhelmed with too much information. We present a novel API recommendation approach that taps into the predictive power of repetitive code changes to provide relevant API recommendations for developers. Our approach and tool, APIREC, is based on statistical learning from fine-grained code changes and from the context in which those changes were made. Our empirical evaluation shows that APIREC correctly recommends an API call in the first position 59\% of the time, and it recommends the correct API call in the top five positions 77\% of the time. This is a significant improvement over the state-of-the-art approaches by 30-160\% for top-1 accuracy, and 10-30\% for top-5 accuracy, respectively. Our result shows that APIREC performs well even with a one-time, minimal training dataset of 50 publicly available projects.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 学习和记住如何使用API是困难的。虽然代码补全工具可以推荐API方法，但浏览一长串API方法名称及其文档是繁琐的。此外，用户很容易被过多信息淹没。我们提出了一种新颖的API推荐方法，利用重复代码变化的预测能力来为开发者提供相关的API推荐。我们的方法和工具APIREC基于从细粒度代码变化及这些变化发生的上下文中进行的统计学习。我们的实证评估显示，APIREC在59%的情况下正确推荐了第一个API调用，在77%的情况下正确推荐了前五个API调用。与最先进的方法相比，这在前1准确率上提高了30-160%，在前5准确率上提高了10-30%。我们的结果表明，即使只使用一次性最小的50个公开可用项目的训练数据集，APIREC也表现良好。

import_candidates.title: TIPMerge: recommending experts for integrating changes across branches
import_candidates.abstract: Parallel development in branches is a common software practice. However, past work has found that integration of changes across branches is not easy, and often leads to failures. Thus far, there has been little work to recommend developers who have the right expertise to perform a branch integration. We propose TIPMerge, a novel tool that recommends developers who are best suited to perform merges, by taking into consideration developers’ past experience in the project, their changes in the branches, and de-pendencies among modified files in the branches. We evaluated TIPMerge on 28 projects, which included up to 15,584 merges with at least two developers, and potentially conflicting changes. On average, 85\% of the top-3 recommendations by TIPMerge correctly included the developer who performed the merge. Best (accuracy) results of recommendations were at 98\%. Our inter-views with developers of two projects reveal that in cases where the TIPMerge recommendation did not match the actual merge developer, the recommended developer had the expertise to per-form the merge, or was involved in a collaborative merge session.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在分支中进行并行开发是一种常见的软件实践。然而，先前的研究发现，跨分支的变更集成并不容易，常常导致失败。到目前为止，很少有研究来推荐具备适当专业知识的开发者去执行分支集成。我们提出了TIPMerge，一种新颖的工具，通过考虑开发者在该项目中的过往经验、他们在分支中的变更以及分支中修改文件之间的依赖关系，来推荐最适合执行合并的开发者。我们在28个项目上评估了TIPMerge，其中包括多达15,584次合并，涉及至少两名开发者以及可能存在的冲突变更。平均而言，TIPMerge的前3名推荐中有85%正确包含了实际执行合并的开发者。推荐的最佳（准确率）结果为98%。我们对两个项目的开发者进行的访谈表明，在TIPMerge推荐与实际合并开发者不匹配的情况下，被推荐的开发者具备执行合并的专业能力，或者参与了协作式合并会话。

import_candidates.title: Interactive and guided architectural refactoring with search-based recommendation
import_candidates.abstract: Architectural refactorings can contain hundreds of steps and experienced developers could carry them out over several weeks. Moreover, developers need to explore a correct sequence of refactorings steps among many more incorrect alternatives. Thus, carrying out architectural refactorings is costly, risky, and challenging. In this paper, we present Refactoring Navigator: a tool-supported and interactive recommendation approach for aiding architectural refactoring. Our approach takes a given implementation as the starting point, a desired high-level design as the target, and iteratively recommends a series of refactoring steps. Moreover, our approach allows the user to accept, reject, or ignore a recommended refactoring step, and uses the user's feedback in further refactoring recommendations. We evaluated the effectiveness of our approach and tool using a controlled experiment and an industrial case study. The controlled experiment shows that the participants who used Refactoring Navigator accomplished their tasks in 77.4\% less time and manually edited 98.3\% fewer lines than the control group. The industrial case study suggests that Refactoring Navigator has the potential to help with architectural refactorings in practice.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 架构重构可能包含数百个步骤，经验丰富的开发人员可能需要数周才能完成。此外，开发人员需要在众多错误的替代方案中探索出正确的重构步骤序列。因此，执行架构重构既昂贵、又有风险且充满挑战。在本文中，我们提出了Refactoring Navigator：一种支持工具且交互式的推荐方法，用于辅助架构重构。我们的方法以给定的实现为起点，以期望的高层设计为目标，迭代地推荐一系列重构步骤。此外，我们的方法允许用户接受、拒绝或忽略推荐的重构步骤，并在后续的重构推荐中使用用户的反馈。我们通过受控实验和工业案例研究评估了方法和工具的有效性。受控实验表明，与对照组相比，使用Refactoring Navigator的参与者完成任务的时间减少了77.4%，手动编辑的行数减少了98.3%。工业案例研究表明，Refactoring Navigator有望在实践中帮助进行架构重构。

import_candidates.title: Can testedness be effectively measured?
import_candidates.abstract: Among the major questions that a practicing tester faces are deciding where to focus additional testing effort, and deciding when to stop testing. Test the least-tested code, and stop when all code is well-tested, is a reasonable answer. Many measures of "testedness" have been proposed; unfortunately, we do not know whether these are truly effective. In this paper we propose a novel evaluation of two of the most important and widely-used measures of test suite quality. The first measure is statement coverage, the simplest and best-known code coverage measure. The second measure is mutation score, a supposedly more powerful, though expensive, measure. We evaluate these measures using the actual criteria of interest: if a program element is (by these measures) well tested at a given point in time, it should require fewer future bug-fixes than a "poorly tested" element. If not, then it seems likely that we are not effectively measuring testedness. Using a large number of open source Java programs from Github and Apache, we show that both statement coverage and mutation score have only a weak negative correlation with bug-fixes. Despite the lack of strong correlation, there are statistically and practically significant differences between program elements for various binary criteria. Program elements (other than classes) covered by any test case see about half as many bug-fixes as those not covered, and a similar line can be drawn for mutation score thresholds. Our results have important implications for both software engineering practice and research evaluation.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 实践中的测试人员面临的主要问题之一是如何决定将额外的测试工作集中在哪里，以及何时停止测试。一个合理的答案是：测试最少被测试的代码，并在所有代码都得到良好测试时停止。人们提出了许多衡量“测试充分性”的指标；遗憾的是，我们不知道这些指标是否真正有效。在本文中，我们提出对两个最重要且广泛使用的测试套件质量度量进行新颖的评估。第一个度量是语句覆盖率，这是最简单、最知名的代码覆盖率度量。第二个度量是变异得分，它被认为是一个更强大但代价昂贵的度量。我们使用实际关心的标准来评估这些度量：如果一个程序元素（根据这些度量）在某个时间点已经得到充分测试，那么它未来需要的缺陷修复次数应该少于“测试不足”的元素。如果不是这样，那么很可能我们并没有有效地测量测试充分性。我们使用来自GitHub和Apache的大量开源Java程序表明，语句覆盖率和变异得分与缺陷修复之间都只有微弱的负相关。尽管缺乏强相关性，但对于各种二元标准，程序元素之间存在统计上和实践上显著的差异。被任何测试用例覆盖的程序元素（类除外）所经历的缺陷修复次数约为未被覆盖元素的一半，对于变异得分阈值也存在类似的情况。我们的结果对软件工程实践和研究评估都具有重要意义。

import_candidates.title: A large-scale empirical comparison of static and dynamic test case prioritization techniques
import_candidates.abstract: The large body of existing research in Test Case Prioritization (TCP) techniques, can be broadly classified into two categories: dynamic techniques (that rely on run-time execution information) and static techniques (that operate directly on source and test code). Absent from this current body of work is a comprehensive study aimed at understanding and evaluating the static approaches and comparing them to dynamic approaches on a large set of projects. In this work, we perform the first extensive study aimed at empirically evaluating four static TCP techniques comparing them with state-of-research dynamic TCP techniques at different test-case granularities (e.g., method and class-level) in terms of effectiveness, efficiency and similarity of faults detected. This study was performed on 30 real-word Java programs encompassing 431 KLoC. In terms of effectiveness, we find that the static call-graph-based technique outperforms the other static techniques at test-class level, but the topic-model-based technique performs better at test-method level. In terms of efficiency, the static call-graph-based technique is also the most efficient when compared to other static techniques. When examining the similarity of faults detected for the four static techniques compared to the four dynamic ones, we find that on average, the faults uncovered by these two groups of techniques are quite dissimilar, with the top 10\% of test cases agreeing on only 25\% - 30\% of detected faults. This prompts further research into the severity/importance of faults uncovered by these techniques, and into the potential for combining static and dynamic information for more effective approaches.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现有的大量测试用例优先级排序（TCP）技术研究可大致分为两类：动态技术（依赖运行时执行信息）和静态技术（直接操作源代码和测试代码）。当前研究缺少一项旨在理解静态方法并用大规模项目将其与动态方法进行比较的综合研究。在这项工作中，我们首次对四种静态TCP技术与最新动态TCP技术在方法级和类级不同测试用例粒度下的有效性、效率和检测到故障的相似性进行了大规模实证评估。该研究在30个真实Java程序上进行，总计431千行代码。在有效性方面，我们发现基于静态调用图的技术在测试类级别优于其他静态技术，而基于主题模型的技术在测试方法级别表现更好。在效率方面，与其他静态技术相比，基于静态调用图的技术也是最高效的。在比较四种静态技术与四种动态技术检测到故障的相似性时，我们发现平均而言，这两类技术发现的故障相当不同，排名前10%的测试用例仅对25%至30%的已检测故障达成一致。这促进了关于这些技术所发现故障严重性/重要性以及结合静态和动态信息以实现更有效方法的进一步研究。

import_candidates.title: Analyzing the validity of selective mutation with dominator mutants
import_candidates.abstract: Various forms of selective mutation testing have long been accepted as valid approximations to full mutation testing. This paper presents counterevidence to traditional selective mutation. The recent development of dominator mutants and minimal mutation analysis lets us analyze selective mutation without the noise introduced by the redundancy inherent in traditional mutation. We then exhaustively evaluate all small sets of mutation operators for the Proteum mutation system and determine dominator mutation scores and required work for each of these sets on an empirical test bed. The results show that all possible selective mutation approaches have poor dominator mutation scores on at least some of these programs. This suggests that to achieve high performance with respect to full mutation analysis, selective approaches will have to become more sophisticated, possibly by choosing mutants based on the specifics of the artifact under test, that is, specialized selective mutation.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 长期以来，各种形式的选择性变异测试一直被视为完整变异测试的有效近似方法。本文提出了与传统选择性变异测试相悖的反例证据。支配变异体和最小变异分析的发展使我们能够在不引入传统变异测试固有冗余所带来的噪声的情况下分析选择性变异测试。然后，我们穷尽评估了Proteum变异系统中所有小规模变异算子组合，并在经验测试台上为这些组合确定了支配变异分数和所需工作量。结果表明，所有可能的选择性变异测试方法至少在某些程序上具有较差的支配变异分数。这表明，为了在完整变异分析方面达到高性能，选择性方法必须变得更加复杂，可能的方式是根据被测工件的具体特征来选择变异体，即专门化的选择性变异测试。

import_candidates.title: An extensive study of static regression test selection in modern software evolution
import_candidates.abstract: Regression test selection (RTS) aims to reduce regression testing time by only re-running the tests affected by code changes. Prior research on RTS can be broadly split into dy namic and static techniques. A recently developed dynamic RTS technique called Ekstazi is gaining some adoption in practice, and its evaluation shows that selecting tests at a coarser, class-level granularity provides better results than selecting tests at a finer, method-level granularity. As dynamic RTS is gaining adoption, it is timely to also evaluate static RTS techniques, some of which were proposed over three decades ago but not extensively evaluated on modern software projects. This paper presents the first extensive study that evaluates the performance benefits of static RTS techniques and their safety; a technique is safe if it selects to run all tests that may be affected by code changes. We implemented two static RTS techniques, one class-level and one method-level, and compare several variants of these techniques. We also compare these static RTS techniques against Ekstazi, a state-of-the-art, class-level, dynamic RTS technique. The experimental results on 985 revisions of 22 open-source projects show that the class-level static RTS technique is comparable to Ekstazi, with similar performance benefits, but at the risk of being unsafe sometimes. In contrast, the method-level static RTS technique performs rather poorly.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 回归测试选择（RTS）旨在通过只重新运行受代码更改影响的测试来减少回归测试时间。以往关于RTS的研究大致可分为动态技术和静态技术。最近开发的一种名为Ekstazi的动态RTS技术正在实践领域中获得一定采用，其评估表明，在较粗粒度的类级别上选择测试比在较细粒度的方法级别上选择测试效果更好。随着动态RTS逐渐得到采用，评估静态RTS技术也正合时宜，其中一些技术虽然早在三十多年前就已提出，但尚未在现代软件项目上进行广泛评估。本文首次对静态RTS技术的性能优势和安全性进行了大规模评估；所谓安全的技术是指它应选择运行所有可能受到代码更改影响的测试。我们实现了两种静态RTS技术（一种类级别、一种方法级别），并比较了这些技术的多个变体。我们还将这些静态RTS技术与Ekstazi（一种最先进的类级别动态RTS技术）进行了比较。对22个开源项目的985个修订版本的实验结果表明，类级别静态RTS技术可与Ekstazi相媲美，具有相似的性能优势，但有时可能不安全。相比之下，方法级别静态RTS技术的表现则相当糟糕。

import_candidates.title: PerfGuard: binary-centric application performance monitoring in production environments
import_candidates.abstract: Diagnosis of performance problems is an essential part of software development and maintenance. This is in particular a challenging problem to be solved in the production environment where only program binaries are available with limited or zero knowledge of the source code. This problem is compounded by the integration with a significant number of third-party software in most large-scale applications. Existing approaches either require source code to embed manually constructed logic to identify performance problems or support a limited scope of applications with prior manual analysis. This paper proposes an automated approach to analyze application binaries and instrument the binary code transparently to inject and apply performance assertions on application transactions. Our evaluation with a set of large-scale application binaries without access to source code discovered 10 publicly known real world performance bugs automatically and shows that PerfGuard introduces very low overhead (less than 3\% on Apache and MySQL server) to production systems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 性能问题的诊断是软件开发和维护的重要组成部分。在生产环境中，只有程序二进制可用，对源代码的了解有限或为零，这使得该问题的解决尤其具有挑战性。在大多数大型应用中，与大量第三方软件的集成更加剧了这一问题。现有方法要么需要源代码来嵌入手工构建的逻辑以识别性能问题，要么在事先进行手动分析的前提下支持有限范围的应用。本文提出了一种自动化方法，分析应用程序二进制文件并对二进制代码进行透明插桩，以在应用程序事务上注入和应用性能断言。我们使用一组无法获取源代码的大型应用程序二进制文件进行了评估，自动发现了10个公开已知的真实世界性能bug，并表明PerfGuard为生产系统带来的开销极低（在Apache和MySQL服务器上低于3%）。

import_candidates.title: Python probabilistic type inference with natural language support
import_candidates.abstract: We propose a novel type inference technique for Python programs. Type inference is difficult for Python programs due to their heavy dependence on external APIs and the dynamic language features. We observe that Python source code often contains a lot of type hints such as attribute accesses and variable names. However, such type hints are not reliable. We hence propose to use probabilistic inference to allow the beliefs of individual type hints to be propagated, aggregated, and eventually converge on probabilities of variable types. Our results show that our technique substantially outperforms a state-of-the-art Python type inference engine based on abstract interpretation.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种针对Python程序的新型类型推断技术。由于Python程序对外部API和动态语言特性的严重依赖，类型推断对Python程序而言很困难。我们观察到Python源代码通常包含大量类型提示，如属性访问和变量名。然而，这类类型提示并不可靠。因此，我们提出使用概率推断来使各个类型提示的信念得以传播、聚合，并最终收敛到变量类型的概率上。我们的结果表明，我们的技术显著优于基于抽象解释的最先进的Python类型推断引擎。

import_candidates.title: Detecting and fixing precision-specific operations for measuring floating-point errors
import_candidates.abstract: The accuracy of the floating-point calculation is critical to many applications and different methods have been proposed around floating-point accuracies, such as detecting the errors in the program, verifying the accuracy of the program, and optimizing the program to produce more accurate results. These approaches need a specification of the program to understand the ideal calculation performed by the program, which is usually approached by interpreting the program in a precision-unspecific way. However, many operations programmed in existing code are inherently precision-specific, which cannot be easily interpreted in a precision-unspecific way. In fact, the semantics used in existing approaches usually fail to interpret precision-specific operations correctly. In this paper, we present a systematic study on precision-specific operations. First, we propose a detection approach to detect precision-specific operations. Second, we propose a fixing approach to enable the tuning of precisions under the presence of precision-specific operations. Third, we studied the precision-specific operations in the GNU C standard math library based on our detection and fixing approaches. Our results show that (1) a significant number of code fragments in the standard C math library are precision-specific operations, and some large inaccuracies reported in existing studies are false positives or potential false positives due to precision-specific operations; (2) our detection approach has high precision and recall; (3) our fixing approach can lead to overall more accurate result.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 浮点计算的准确性对许多应用至关重要，围绕浮点精度已经提出了各种方法，例如检测程序中的错误、验证程序的准确性，以及优化程序以产生更准确的结果。这些方法需要程序的规范来理解程序所执行的理想计算，通常通过以精度无关的方式解释程序来实现。然而，现有代码中编写的许多操作本质上是与精度相关的，难以以精度无关的方式解释。实际上，现有方法中使用的语义通常无法正确解释精度特定操作。在本文中，我们对精度特定操作进行了系统研究。首先，我们提出了一种检测方法来识别精度特定操作。其次，我们提出了一种修复方法，使得在存在精度特定操作的情况下能够调整精度。第三，我们基于我们的检测和修复方法研究了GNU C标准数学库中的精度特定操作。结果表明：（1）标准C数学库中有大量代码片段属于精度特定操作，现有研究中报告的一些较大不准确性是由于精度特定操作导致的误报或潜在误报；（2）我们的检测方法具有高精确率和召回率；（3）我们的修复方法能够实现整体更准确的结果。

import_candidates.title: Deep API learning
import_candidates.abstract: Developers often wonder how to implement a certain functionality (e.g., how to parse XML files) using APIs. Obtaining an API usage sequence based on an API-related natural language query is very helpful in this regard. Given a query, existing approaches utilize information retrieval models to search for matching API sequences. These approaches treat queries and APIs as bags-of-words and lack a deep understanding of the semantics of the query. We propose DeepAPI, a deep learning based approach to generate API usage sequences for a given natural language query. Instead of a bag-of-words assumption, it learns the sequence of words in a query and the sequence of associated APIs. DeepAPI adapts a neural language model named RNN Encoder-Decoder. It encodes a word sequence (user query) into a fixed-length context vector, and generates an API sequence based on the context vector. We also augment the RNN Encoder-Decoder by considering the importance of individual APIs. We empirically evaluate our approach with more than 7 million annotated code snippets collected from GitHub. The results show that our approach generates largely accurate API sequences and outperforms the related approaches.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 开发人员经常想知道如何使用API实现某个特定功能（例如，如何解析XML文件）。根据与API相关的自然语言查询获得API使用序列在这方面非常有帮助。给定一个查询，现有方法利用信息检索模型搜索匹配的API序列。这些方法将查询和API视为词袋，缺乏对查询语义的深入理解。我们提出DeepAPI，一种基于深度学习的方法，为给定的自然语言查询生成API使用序列。它不是基于词袋假设，而是学习查询中的单词序列和相关的API序列。DeepAPI改编了一种名为RNN Encoder-Decoder的神经语言模型。它将单词序列（用户查询）编码为固定长度的上下文向量，并根据上下文向量生成API序列。我们还通过考虑各个API的重要性来增强RNN Encoder-Decoder。我们使用从GitHub收集的超过700万个带注释的代码片段对方法进行了实证评估。结果表明，我们的方法生成的API序列在很大程度上是准确的，并且优于相关方法。

import_candidates.title: Build system with lazy retrieval for Java projects
import_candidates.abstract: In the modern-day development, projects use Continuous Integration Services (CISs) to execute the build for every change in the source code. To ensure that the project remains correct and deployable, a CIS performs a clean build each time. In a clean environment, a build system needs to retrieve the project's dependencies (e.g., guava.jar). The retrieval, however, can be costly due to dependency bloat: despite a project using only a few files from each library, the existing build systems still eagerly retrieve all the libraries at the beginning of the build. This paper presents a novel build system, Molly, which lazily retrieves parts of libraries (i.e., files) that are needed during the execution of a build target. For example, the compilation target needs only public interfaces of classes within the libraries and the test target needs only implementation of the classes that are being invoked by the tests. Additionally, Molly generates a transfer script that retrieves parts of libraries based on prior builds. Molly's design requires that we ignore the boundaries set by the library developers and look at the files within the libraries. We implemented Molly for Java and evaluated it on 17 popular open-source projects. We show that test targets (on average) depend on only 9.97\% of files in libraries. A variant of Molly speeds up retrieval by 44.28\%. Furthermore, the scripts generated by Molly retrieve dependencies, on average, 93.81\% faster than the Maven build system.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在当今的开发中，项目使用持续集成服务（CIS）对源代码的每次更改执行构建。为了确保项目保持正确且可部署，CIS每次都会执行干净构建。在干净环境中，构建系统需要检索项目的依赖项（例如 guava.jar）。然而，由于依赖膨胀，检索可能非常昂贵：尽管项目只使用了每个库中的几个文件，现有构建系统仍在构建开始时急切地检索所有库。本文提出了一种新颖的构建系统 Molly，它惰性检索构建目标执行期间所需的库的部分内容（即文件）。例如，编译目标只需要库中类的公共接口，而测试目标只需要测试所调用的类的实现。此外，Molly 会基于先前构建生成一个传输脚本，用于检索库的部分内容。Molly 的设计要求我们忽略库开发者设定的边界，转而查看库中的文件。我们用 Java 实现了 Molly，并在 17 个流行的开源项目上进行了评估。我们表明，测试目标（平均）只依赖库中文件的 9.97%。Molly 的一个变体将检索速度提高了 44.28%。此外，Molly 生成的脚本平均比 Maven 构建系统快 93.81% 地检索依赖项。

import_candidates.title: iGen: dynamic interaction inference for configurable software
import_candidates.abstract: To develop, analyze, and evolve today's highly configurable software systems, developers need deep knowledge of a system's configuration options, e.g., how options need to be set to reach certain locations, what configurations to use for testing, etc. Today, acquiring this detailed information requires manual effort that is difficult, expensive, and error prone. In this paper, we propose iGen, a novel, lightweight dynamic analysis technique that automatically discovers a program's interactions---expressive logical formulae that give developers rich and detailed information about how a system's configuration option settings map to particular code coverage. iGen employs an iterative algorithm that runs a system under a small set of configurations, capturing coverage data; processes the coverage data to infer potential interactions; and then generates new configurations to further refine interactions in the next iteration. We evaluated iGen on 29 programs spanning five languages; the breadth of this study would be unachievable using prior interaction inference tools. Our results show that iGen finds precise interactions based on a very small fraction of the number of possible configurations. Moreover, iGen's results confirm several earlier hypotheses about typical interaction distributions and structures.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 为了开发、分析和演化当今高度可配置的软件系统，开发人员需要深入了解系统的配置选项，例如如何设置选项才能到达特定代码位置、测试时应使用哪些配置等。如今，获取这些详细信息需要手动操作，这些操作困难、昂贵且容易出错。在本文中，我们提出iGen，一种新颖的轻量级动态分析技术，能够自动发现程序中的交互——这些表达性的逻辑公式能为开发人员提供关于系统配置选项设置如何映射到特定代码覆盖的丰富而详细的信息。iGen采用迭代算法，在少量配置下运行系统并捕获覆盖数据，处理覆盖数据以推断潜在交互，然后生成新配置以在下一轮迭代中进一步细化交互。我们在涵盖五种语言的29个程序上对iGen进行了评估；这种广度是先前交互推断工具无法实现的。我们的结果表明，iGen基于可能配置数量中极小的一部分就能找到精确的交互。此外，iGen的结果证实了先前关于典型交互分布和结构的若干假设。

import_candidates.title: CacheOptimizer: helping developers configure caching frameworks for hibernate-based database-centric web applications
import_candidates.abstract: To help improve the performance of database-centric cloud-based web applications, developers usually use caching frameworks to speed up database accesses. Such caching frameworks require extensive knowledge of the application to operate effectively. However, all too often developers have limited knowledge about the intricate details of their own application. Hence, most developers find configuring caching frameworks a challenging and time-consuming task that requires extensive and scattered code changes. Furthermore, developers may also need to frequently change such configurations to accommodate the ever changing workload. In this paper, we propose CacheOptimizer, a lightweight approach that helps developers optimize the configuration of caching frameworks for web applications that are implemented using Hibernate. CacheOptimizer leverages readily-available web logs to create mappings between a workload and database accesses. Given the mappings, CacheOptimizer discovers the optimal cache configuration using coloured Petri nets, and automatically adds the appropriate cache configurations to the application. We evaluate CacheOptimizer on three open-source web applications. We find that i) CacheOptimizer improves the throughput by 27--138\%; and ii) after considering both the memory cost and throughput improvement, CacheOptimizer still brings statistically significant gains (with mostly large effect sizes) in comparison to the application's default cache configuration and to blindly enabling all possible caches.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 为了帮助提高以数据库为中心的基于云的Web应用程序的性能，开发者通常使用缓存框架来加速数据库访问。此类缓存框架需要深入了解应用程序才能有效运行。然而，开发者往往对自己应用程序的复杂细节了解有限。因此，大多数开发者认为配置缓存框架是一项具有挑战性且耗时的任务，需要进行大量分散的代码更改。此外，开发者可能还需要频繁更改这些配置以适应不断变化的工作负载。在本文中，我们提出CacheOptimizer，一种轻量级方法，帮助开发者优化使用Hibernate实现的Web应用程序的缓存框架配置。CacheOptimizer利用现成的Web日志创建工作负载与数据库访问之间的映射。基于该映射，CacheOptimizer使用着色Petri网发现最优缓存配置，并自动为应用程序添加适当的缓存配置。我们在三个开源Web应用程序上评估了CacheOptimizer。我们发现：i) CacheOptimizer将吞吐量提高了27%至138%；ii) 在兼顾内存成本和吞吐量提升后，与应用程序的默认缓存配置以及盲目启用所有可能的缓存相比，CacheOptimizer仍然带来了统计上显著的收益（多数情况下效应量较大）。

import_candidates.title: BinGo: cross-architecture cross-OS binary search
import_candidates.abstract: Binary code search has received much attention recently due to its impactful applications, e.g., plagiarism detection, malware detection and software vulnerability auditing. However, developing an effective binary code search tool is challenging due to the gigantic syntax and structural differences in binaries resulted from different compilers, architectures and OSs. In this paper, we propose BINGO — a scalable and robust binary search engine supporting various architectures and OSs. The key contribution is a selective inlining technique to capture the complete function semantics by inlining relevant library and user-defined functions. In addition, architecture and OS neutral function filtering is proposed to dramatically reduce the irrelevant target functions. Besides, we introduce length variant partial traces to model binary functions in a program structure agnostic fashion. The experimental results show that BINGO can find semantic similar functions across architecture and OS boundaries, even with the presence of program structure distortion, in a scalable manner. Using BINGO, we also discovered a zero-day vulnerability in Adobe PDF Reader, a COTS binary.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 二进制代码搜索近年来因诸多重要应用而备受关注，例如代码抄袭检测、恶意软件检测和软件漏洞审计。然而，由于不同编译器、架构和操作系统导致二进制文件在语法和结构上存在巨大差异，开发有效的二进制代码搜索工具颇具挑战性。在本文中，我们提出了BINGO——一个可扩展、稳健的二进制搜索引擎，支持多种架构和操作系统。其关键贡献是选择性内联技术，通过内联相关库函数和用户自定义函数来捕获完整的函数语义。此外，我们提出了架构和操作系统无关的函数过滤方法，以大幅减少无关目标函数；还引入了长度变体部分轨迹，以不依赖程序结构的方式建模二进制函数。实验结果表明，BINGO即使在程序结构扭曲的情况下也能跨架构和操作系统边界可扩展地找到语义相似函数。我们还使用BINGO在COTS二进制Adobe PDF Reader中发现了一个零日漏洞。

import_candidates.title: Relationship-aware code search for JavaScript frameworks
import_candidates.abstract: JavaScript frameworks, such as jQuery, are widely used for developing web applications. To facilitate using these JavaScript frameworks to implement a feature (e.g., functionality), a large number of programmers often search for code snippets that implement the same or similar feature. However, existing code search approaches tend to be ineffective, without taking into account the fact that JavaScript code snippets often implement a feature based on various relationships (e.g., sequencing, condition, and callback relationships) among the invoked framework API methods. To address this issue, we present a novel Relationship-Aware Code Search (RACS) approach for finding code snippets that use JavaScript frameworks to implement a specific feature. In advance, RACS collects a large number of code snippets that use some JavaScript frameworks, mines API usage patterns from the collected code snippets, and represents the mined patterns with method call relationship (MCR) graphs, which capture framework API methods’ signatures and their relationships. Given a natural language (NL) search query issued by a programmer, RACS conducts NL processing to automatically extract an action relationship (AR) graph, which consists of actions and their relationships inferred from the query. In this way, RACS reduces code search to the problem of graph search: finding similar MCR graphs for a given AR graph. We conduct evaluations against representative real-world jQuery questions posted on Stack Overflow, based on 308,294 code snippets collected from over 81,540 files on the Internet. The evaluation results show the effectiveness of RACS: the top 1 snippet produced by RACS matches the target code snippet for 46\% questions, compared to only 4\% achieved by a relationship-oblivious approach.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: JavaScript框架（如jQuery）被广泛用于开发Web应用程序。为了便于使用这些JavaScript框架实现某个功能，大量程序员经常搜索实现相同或相似功能的代码片段。然而，现有的代码搜索方法往往效果不佳，因为它们没有考虑到JavaScript代码片段通常基于所调用框架API方法之间的各种关系（例如，顺序、条件和回调关系）来实现功能。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的关系感知代码搜索（RACS）方法，用于查找使用JavaScript框架实现特定功能的代码片段。RACS预先收集大量使用某些JavaScript框架的代码片段，从中挖掘API使用模式，并使用方法调用关系（MCR）图表示挖掘出的模式，该图捕获框架API方法的签名及其关系。给定程序员发出的自然语言（NL）搜索查询，RACS进行自然语言处理以自动提取动作关系（AR）图，该图由从查询中推断出的动作及其关系组成。这样，RACS将代码搜索简化为图搜索问题：为给定的AR图查找相似的MCR图。我们基于从互联网上超过81,540个文件中收集的308,294个代码片段，对Stack Overflow上具有代表性的真实jQuery问题进行了评估。评估结果显示了RACS的有效性：RACS生成的前1个代码片段与46%问题的目标代码片段匹配，而关系无关的方法仅为4%。

import_candidates.title: Code relatives: detecting similarly behaving software
import_candidates.abstract: Detecting “similar code” is useful for many software engineering tasks. Current tools can help detect code with statically similar syntactic and–or semantic features (code clones) and with dynamically similar functional input/output (simions). Unfortunately, some code fragments that behave similarly at the finer granularity of their execution traces may be ignored. In this paper, we propose the term “code relatives” to refer to code with similar execution behavior. We define code relatives and then present DyCLINK, our approach to detecting code relatives within and across codebases. DyCLINK records instruction-level traces from sample executions, organizes the traces into instruction-level dynamic dependence graphs, and employs our specialized subgraph matching algorithm to efficiently compare the executions of candidate code relatives. In our experiments, DyCLINK analyzed 422+ million prospective subgraph matches in only 43 minutes. We compared DyCLINK to one static code clone detector from the community and to our implementation of a dynamic simion detector. The results show that DyCLINK effectively detects code relatives with a reasonable analysis time.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 检测“相似代码”对许多软件工程任务非常有用。现有工具可以帮助检测具有静态相似语法和/或语义特征的代码（代码克隆），以及具有动态相似功能输入/输出的代码（simion）。不幸的是，一些在执行轨迹的细粒度上行为相似的代码片段可能被忽略。在本文中，我们提出术语“代码亲属”来指代具有相似执行行为的代码。我们定义了代码亲属，然后提出了DyCLINK，一种在代码库内部和跨代码库中检测代码亲属的方法。DyCLINK记录样本执行时的指令级轨迹，将轨迹组织成指令级动态依赖图，并采用专用的子图匹配算法来有效比较候选代码亲属的执行。在我们的实验中，DyCLINK仅在43分钟内分析了超过4.22亿个潜在子图匹配。我们将DyCLINK与社区中的一种静态代码克隆检测器和我们实现的一种动态simion检测器进行了比较。结果表明，DyCLINK能够在合理的分析时间内有效检测代码亲属。

import_candidates.title: Understanding and generating high quality patches for concurrency bugs
import_candidates.abstract: Concurrency bugs are time-consuming to fix correctly by developers and a severe threat to software reliability. Although many auto-fixing techniques have been proposed recently for concurrency bugs, there is still a big gap between the quality of automatically generated patches and manually designed ones. This paper first conducts an in-depth study of manual patches for 77 real-world concurrency bugs, which provides both assessments for existing techniques and actionable suggestions for future research. Guided by this study, a new tool HFix is designed. It can automatically generate patches, which have matching quality as manual patches, for many concurrency bugs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 并发错误对于开发者来说耗时且难以正确修复，并且严重威胁软件可靠性。尽管近年来针对并发错误提出了许多自动修复技术，但自动生成的补丁与人工设计的补丁之间仍存在很大差距。本文首先对77个真实世界并发错误的人工补丁进行深入研究，为现有技术提供评估并为未来研究提供可行建议。在该研究的指导下，设计了一个新工具HFix，它可以为许多并发错误自动生成与人工补丁质量相当的补丁。

import_candidates.title: Anti-patterns in search-based program repair
import_candidates.abstract: Search-based program repair automatically searches for a program fix within a given repair space. This may be accomplished by retrofitting a generic search algorithm for program repair as evidenced by the GenProg tool, or by building a customized search algorithm for program repair as in SPR. Unfortunately, automated program repair approaches may produce patches that may be rejected by programmers, because of which past works have suggested using human-written patches to produce templates to guide program repair. In this work, we take the position that we will not provide templates to guide the repair search because that may unduly restrict the repair space and attempt to overfit the repairs into one of the provided templates. Instead, we suggest the use of a set of anti-patterns --- a set of generic forbidden transformations that can be enforced on top of any search-based repair tool. We show that by enforcing our anti-patterns, we obtain repairs that localize the correct lines or functions, involve less deletion of program functionality, and are mostly obtained more efficiently. Since our set of anti-patterns are generic, we have integrated them into existing search based repair tools, including GenProg and SPR, thereby allowing us to obtain higher quality program patches with minimal effort.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 基于搜索的程序修复会在给定的修复空间内自动搜索程序修复方案。这可以通过改造通用搜索算法来实现（如 GenProg 工具），也可以像 SPR 中那样为程序修复构建定制化搜索算法。不幸的是，自动化程序修复方法可能生成让程序员拒绝的补丁，因此过往工作建议使用人工编写的补丁来生成模板以指导修复。在这项工作中，我们采取的立场是不提供模板来引导修复搜索，因为那样可能不当地限制修复空间，并试图将修复过度拟合到给定模板之一。相反，我们建议使用一组反模式——即一组通用的禁止变换，可叠加于任何基于搜索的修复工具之上。我们表明，通过强制执行我们的反模式，所得到的修复能够定位正确的代码行或函数，涉及更少程序功能的删除，并且大多能更高效地获得。由于我们的反模式集具有通用性，我们已将其集成到现有基于搜索的修复工具中，包括 GenProg 和 SPR，从而以最小代价获得更高质量的程序补丁。

import_candidates.title: Semi-supervised verified feedback generation
import_candidates.abstract: Students have enthusiastically taken to online programming lessons and contests. Unfortunately, they tend to struggle due to lack of personalized feedback. There is an urgent need of program analysis and repair techniques capable of handling both the scale and variations in student submissions, while ensuring quality of feedback. Towards this goal, we present a novel methodology called semi-supervised verified feedback generation. We cluster submissions by solution strategy and ask the instructor to identify or add a correct submission in each cluster. We then verify every submission in a cluster against the instructor-validated submission in the same cluster. If faults are detected in the submission then feedback suggesting fixes to them is generated. Clustering reduces the burden on the instructor and also the variations that have to be handled during feedback generation. The verified feedback generation ensures that only correct feedback is generated. We implemented a tool, named CoderAssist, based on this approach and evaluated it on dynamic programming assignments. We have designed a novel counter-example guided feedback generation algorithm capable of suggesting fixes to all faults in a submission. In an evaluation on 2226 submissions to 4 problems, CoderAssist could generate verified feedback for 1911 (85\%) submissions in 1.6s each on an average. It does a good job of reducing the burden on the instructor. Only one submission had to be manually validated or added for every 16 submissions.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 学生们热衷于在线编程课程和竞赛，但往往因缺乏个性化反馈而感到吃力。因此亟需能够处理学生提交的规模与多样性、同时确保反馈质量的程序分析与修复技术。为实现这一目标，我们提出了一种名为“半监督的已验证反馈生成”的新方法。我们按解题策略对提交进行聚类，并请教师在每个聚类中识别或添加一个正确提交。然后，我们将每个聚类中的全部提交与该聚类内经教师验证的提交进行对比验证。如果在提交中检测到错误，则生成建议修复这些错误的反馈。聚类减少了教师的负担，也减少了反馈生成过程中需要应对的多样性。已验证反馈生成确保了只生成正确的反馈。我们基于该方法实现了一个名为CoderAssist的工具，并在动态规划作业上进行了评估。我们设计了一种新颖的、基于反例引导的反馈生成算法，能够针对提交中的所有错误给出修复建议。在4个问题的2226份提交的评估中，CoderAssist能够为1911份（85%）提交生成已验证反馈，平均每份耗时1.6秒。该工具在减轻教师负担方面表现良好，平均每16份提交仅需人工验证或添加1份。

import_candidates.title: WATERFALL: an incremental approach for repairing record-replay tests of web applications
import_candidates.abstract: Software engineers use record/replay tools to capture use case scenarios that can serve as regression tests for web applications. Such tests, however, can be brittle in the face of code changes. Thus, researchers have sought automated approaches for repairing broken record/replay tests. To date, such approaches have operated by directly analyzing differences between the releases of web applications. Often, however, intermediate versions or commits exist between releases, and these represent finer-grained sequences of changes by which new releases evolve. In this paper, we present WATERFALL, an incremental test repair approach that applies test repair techniques iteratively across a sequence of fine-grained versions of a web application. The results of an empirical study on seven web applications show that our approach is substantially more effective than a coarse-grained approach (209\% overall), while maintaining an acceptable level of overhead.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 软件工程师使用录制/回放工具来捕获可作为Web应用回归测试的用例场景。然而，此类测试在代码变更面前可能很脆弱。因此，研究人员一直在寻求自动修复损坏的录制/回放测试的方法。迄今为止，这些方法通常通过直接分析Web应用发布版本之间的差异来操作。然而，在版本发布之间往往存在中间版本或提交，这些代表了新版本演变的更细粒度的变更序列。在本文中，我们提出了WATERFALL，一种增量式测试修复方法，该方法在一系列细粒度的Web应用版本中迭代应用测试修复技术。对七个Web应用进行实证研究的结果表明，我们的方法比粗粒度方法有效得多（总体提高209%），同时保持了可接受的开销水平。

import_candidates.title: Efficiency of projectional editing: a controlled experiment
import_candidates.abstract: Projectional editors are editors where a user's editing actions directly change the abstract syntax tree without using a parser. They promise essentially unrestricted language com position as well as flexible notations, which supports aligning languages with their respective domain and constitutes an essential ingredient of model-driven development. Such editors have existed since the 1980s and gained widespread attention with the Intentional Programming paradigm, which used projectional editing at its core. However, despite the benefits, programming still mainly relies on editing textual code, where projectional editors imply a very different -- typically perceived as worse -- editing experience, often seen as the main challenge prohibiting their widespread adoption. We present an experiment of code-editing activities in a projectional editor, conducted with 19 graduate computer-science students and industrial developers. We investigate the effects of projectional editing on editing efficiency, editing strategies, and error rates -- each of which we also compare to conventional, parser-based editing. We observe that editing is efficient for basic-editing tasks, but that editing strategies and typical errors differ. More complex tasks require substantial experience and a better understanding of the abstract-syntax-tree structure -- then, projectional editing is also efficient. We also witness a tradeoff between fewer typing mistakes and an increased complexity of code editing.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 投影式编辑器是一种用户编辑操作直接改变抽象语法树而无需使用解析器的编辑器。它们承诺实现几乎不受限制的语言组合以及灵活的表示法，这有助于使语言与其各自领域保持一致，并构成模型驱动开发的关键要素。这类编辑器自20世纪80年代就已存在，并随着以投影式编辑为核心的自编程（Intentional Programming）范式而受到广泛关注。然而，尽管有这些好处，编程仍然主要依赖文本代码编辑，而投影式编辑意味着一种截然不同——通常被认为更差——的编辑体验，这常被视为阻碍其广泛采用的主要挑战。我们展示了一项在投影式编辑器中进行的代码编辑活动实验，实验对象为19名计算机科学研究生和工业开发者。我们研究了投影式编辑对编辑效率、编辑策略和错误率的影响——这些也都与传统基于解析器的编辑进行了比较。我们观察到，对于基本编辑任务，编辑是高效的，但编辑策略和典型错误有所不同。更复杂的任务需要丰富的经验和对抽象语法树结构的更好理解——在这种情况下，投影式编辑也是高效的。我们还见证了打字错误减少与代码编辑复杂性增加之间的权衡。

import_candidates.title: ECHO: instantaneous in situ race detection in the IDE
import_candidates.abstract: We present ECHO, a new technique that detects data races instantaneously in the IDE while developers code. ECHO is the first technique of its kind for incremental race detection supporting both code addition and deletion in the IDE. Unlike conventional static race detectors, ECHO warns developers of potential data races immediately as they are introduced into the program. The core underpinning ECHO is a set of new change-aware static analyses based on a novel static happens-before graph that, given a program change, efficiently compute the change-relevant information without re-analyzing the whole program. Our evaluation within a Java environment on both popular benchmarks and real- world applications shows promising results: for each code addition, or deletion, ECHO can instantly pinpoint all the races in a few milliseconds on average, three to four orders of magnitude faster than a conventional whole-program race detector with the same precision.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了ECHO，一种在开发者编码时于集成开发环境（IDE）中即时检测数据竞争的新技术。ECHO是首个支持IDE中代码添加和删除的增量式竞态检测技术。与传统静态竞态检测器不同，ECHO会在潜在数据竞争引入程序时立即向开发者发出警告。ECHO的核心基础是一组基于新型静态happens-before图的变化感知静态分析，给定程序变更，该图能高效计算与变更相关的信息，而无需重新分析整个程序。我们在Java环境中对流行的基准测试和真实应用的评估显示了令人鼓舞的结果：对于每次代码添加或删除，ECHO平均能在几毫秒内即时定位所有竞态，比具有相同精度的传统全程序竞态检测器快三到四个数量级。

import_candidates.title: Detecting table clones and smells in spreadsheets
import_candidates.abstract: Spreadsheets are widely used by end users for various business tasks, such as data analysis and financial reporting. End users may perform similar tasks by cloning a block of cells (table) in their spreadsheets. The corresponding cells in these cloned tables are supposed to keep the same or similar computational semantics. However, when spreadsheets evolve, thus cloned tables can become inconsistent due to ad-hoc modifications, and as a result suffer from smells. In this paper, we propose TableCheck to detect table clones and related smells due to inconsistency among them. We observe that two tables with the same header information at their corresponding cells are likely to be table clones. Inspired by existing fingerprint-based code clone detection techniques, we developed a detection algorithm to detect this kind of table clones. We further detected outliers among corresponding cells as smells in the detected table clones. We implemented our idea into TableCheck, and applied it to real-world spreadsheets from the EUSES corpus. Experimental results show that table clones commonly exist (21.8\%), and 25.6\% of the spreadsheets with table clones suffer from smells due to inconsistency among these clones. TableCheck detected table clones and their smells with a precision of 92.2\% and 85.5\%, respectively, while existing techniques detected no more than 35.6\% true smells that TableCheck could detect.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 电子表格被最终用户广泛用于各种业务任务，如数据分析和财务报告。最终用户可能会通过克隆其电子表格中的单元格块（表格）来执行类似的任务。这些克隆表格中的对应单元格应当保持相同或相似的计算语义。然而，当电子表格演变时，由于临时性的修改，克隆表格可能变得不一致，从而产生坏味。在本文中，我们提出了TableCheck来检测表格克隆以及由于它们之间的不一致性导致的相关坏味。我们观察到，在对应单元格具有相同表头信息的两个表格很可能是表格克隆。受现有基于指纹的代码克隆检测技术的启发，我们开发了一种检测算法来检测此类表格克隆。我们进一步将对应单元格中的异常点作为检测到的表格克隆中的坏味进行检测。我们将这一想法实现为TableCheck，并将其应用于EUSES语料库中的真实电子表格。实验结果表明，表格克隆普遍存在（21.8%），并且有25.6%的含有表格克隆的电子表格因克隆间的不一致性而存在坏味。TableCheck检测表格克隆及其坏味的精确率分别为92.2%和85.5%，而现有技术最多只能检测出TableCheck能够检测出的真实坏味的35.6%。

import_candidates.title: Flow-sensitive composition of thread-modular abstract interpretation
import_candidates.abstract: We propose a constraint-based flow-sensitive static analysis for concurrent programs by iteratively composing thread-modular abstract interpreters via the use of a system of lightweight constraints. Our method is compositional in that it first applies sequential abstract interpreters to individual threads and then composes their results. It is flow-sensitive in that the causality ordering of interferences (flow of data from global writes to reads) is modeled by a system of constraints. These interference constraints are lightweight since they only refer to the execution order of program statements as opposed to their numerical properties: they can be decided efficiently using an off-the-shelf Datalog engine. Our new method has the advantage of being more accurate than existing, flow-insensitive, static analyzers while remaining scalable and providing the expected soundness and termination guarantees even for programs with unbounded data. We implemented our method and evaluated it on a large number of benchmarks, demonstrating its effectiveness at increasing the accuracy of thread-modular abstract interpretation.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于约束的流敏感并发程序静态分析方法，通过使用轻量级约束系统迭代地组合线程模块化抽象解释器。该方法是组合式的，首先将顺序抽象解释器应用于各个线程，然后组合它们的结果。它是流敏感的，因为干扰的因果顺序（从全局写入到读取的数据流）通过约束系统建模。这些干扰约束是轻量级的，因为它们仅涉及程序语句的执行顺序，而非数值属性：可以使用现成的Datalog引擎高效判定。我们的新方法相比现有的流不敏感静态分析器更精确，同时保持可扩展性，并且即使对于具有无界数据的程序也能提供预期的可靠性和终止保证。我们实现了该方法，并在大量基准测试上进行了评估，证明了其在提高线程模块化抽象解释准确性方面的有效性。

import_candidates.title: A deployable sampling strategy for data race detection
import_candidates.abstract: Dynamic data race detection incurs heavy runtime overheads. Recently, many sampling techniques have been proposed to detect data races. However, some sampling techniques (e.g., Pacer) are based on traditional happens-before relation and incur a large basic overhead.
