import_candidates.title: SSAR: A Novel Software Architecture Recovery Approach Enhancing Accuracy and Scalability
import_candidates.abstract: Software architecture is critical for software development and maintenance. As software evolves, its architecture may drift from the original design, resulting in architectural degradation that negatively affects software quality. To effectively manage and maintain software systems, architects need an accurate understanding of the current architecture, but manual analysis is time-consuming and error-prone. Therefore, numerous automated architecture recovery techniques have been developed to facilitate this process. However, existing techniques often face limitations in either accuracy or efficiency, especially when dealing with large-scale software systems. In this paper, we propose a novel architecture recovery approach that integrates semantic similarity and structural dependencies between files to construct a weighted graph. Then it applies an optimized community detection algorithm to partition the graph for software modularization. To evaluate the effectiveness of our approach, we selected nine open-source projects with ground-truth architectures and compared our approach against six state-of-the-art architecture recovery techniques. Experimental results have shown that our approach improves accuracy ranging from 5.0\% to 90.9\%, 3.8\% to 16.9\%, and 12.5\% to 500\% in the three well-known architecture similarity metrics (MoJoFM, a2a, and c2ccvg), respectively. Additionally, it reduces the average execution time by 5\% to 99\%. In conclusion, our approach not only achieves a more precise recovery of software architecture but also significantly cuts down the time and effort required for the recovery process.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 软件架构对软件开发与维护至关重要。随着软件演化，其架构可能偏离原始设计，导致架构退化，从而对软件质量产生负面影响。为了有效管理和维护软件系统，架构师需要准确理解当前架构，但人工分析耗时且易错。因此，已有许多自动化架构恢复技术来促进这一过程。然而，现有技术在准确性或效率方面常常存在局限，尤其是在处理大规模软件系统时。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的架构恢复方法，该方法整合文件间的语义相似性和结构依赖关系来构建加权图。然后应用优化的社区检测算法对图进行划分以实现软件模块化。为了评估方法的有效性，我们选择了九个具有真实架构的开源项目，并将我们的方法与六种最先进的架构恢复技术进行了比较。实验结果表明，我们的方法在三个著名的架构相似性度量（MoJoFM、a2a和c2ccvg）上分别将准确性提升了5.0%到90.9%、3.8%到16.9%和12.5%到500%。此外，它将平均执行时间减少了5%到99%。总之，我们的方法不仅实现了更精确的软件架构恢复，而且显著减少了恢复过程所需的时间和精力。

import_candidates.title: LogFold: Compressing Logs with Structured Tokens and Hybrid Encoding
import_candidates.abstract: Logs are essential for diagnosing failures and conducting retrospective studies, leading many software organizations to retain log messages for a long time. Nevertheless, the volume of generated log data grows rapidly as software systems grow, necessitating an effective compression method. Apart from general-purpose compressors (e.g., Gzip, Bzip2), many recent studies developed log-specific compression algorithms, but they offer suboptimal performance because of (1) overlooking redundancies within certain complex tokens, and (2) lacking a fine-grained encoding strategy for diverse token types.This work uncovers a new redundancy pattern in structured tokens and proposes a new type-aware encoding strategy to improve log compression. Building on this insight, we introduce LogFold, a novel log compression method consisting of four components: a token analyzer to classifies tokens as structured, unstructured, or static types; a processor that mines recurring patterns within structured tokens based on their delimiter skeletons; a hybrid encoder that tailors data representation according to token types; and a packer that compresses the output into an archive file. Extensive experiments on 16 public log datasets demonstrate that LogFold surpasses state-of-the-art baselines, achieving average compression ratio improvements by 11.11\%, with a compression speed of 9.842 MB/s. Ablation studies further indicate the importance of each component. We also conduct sensitivity analyses to verify LogFold’s robustness and stability across various internal settings.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 日志对于诊断故障和进行回顾性研究至关重要，这使得许多软件组织长期保留日志消息。然而，随着软件系统的增长，生成的日志数据量迅速增长，因此需要一种有效的压缩方法。除了通用压缩器（如Gzip、Bzip2）之外，许多近期研究开发了针对日志的压缩算法，但由于（1）忽略了某些复杂令牌内部的冗余，以及（2）缺乏针对多样令牌类型的细粒度编码策略，它们提供的性能欠佳。这项工作揭示了结构化令牌中的一种新的冗余模式，并提出了一种新的类型感知编码策略来改进日志压缩。基于这一洞见，我们引入了LogFold，一种新颖的日志压缩方法，由四个组件组成：一个令牌分析器，将令牌分类为结构化、非结构化或静态类型；一个处理器，基于分隔符骨架挖掘结构化令牌中的重复模式；一个混合编码器，根据令牌类型定制数据表示；以及一个打包器，将输出压缩为归档文件。在16个公共日志数据集上的大量实验表明，LogFold超越了最先进的基线，平均压缩比提高了11.11%，压缩速度为9.842 MB/s。消融研究进一步表明了每个组件的重要性。我们还进行了敏感性分析，以验证LogFold在各种内部设置下的鲁棒性和稳定性。

import_candidates.title: Do Unit Proofs Work? An Empirical Study of Compositional Bounded Model Checking for Memory Safety Verification
import_candidates.abstract: Memory safety defects pose a major threat to software reliability, enabling cyberattacks, outages, and crashes. To mitigate these risks, organizations adopt Compositional Bounded Model Checking (BMC), using unit proofs to formally verify memory safety. However, methods for creating unit proofs vary across organizations and are inconsistent within the same project, leading to errors and missed defects. In addition, unit proofing remains understudied, with no systematic development methods or empirical evaluations.This work presents the first empirical study on unit proofing for memory safety verification. We introduce a systematic method for creating unit proofs that leverages verification feedback and objective criteria. Using this approach, we develop 73 unit proofs for four embedded operating systems and evaluate their effectiveness, characteristics, cost, and generalizability. Our results show unit proofs are cost-effective, detecting 74\% of recreated defects, with an additional 9\% found with increased BMC bounds, and 20 new defects exposed. We also found that embedded software requires small unit proofs, which can be developed in 87 minutes and executed in 61 seconds on average. These findings provide practical guidance for engineers and empirical data to inform tooling design.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 内存安全缺陷对软件可靠性构成重大威胁，可导致网络攻击、服务中断和崩溃。为降低这些风险，组织采用组合有界模型检测（BMC），使用单元证明来形式化验证内存安全。然而，创建单元证明的方法因组织而异，同一项目内也不一致，导致错误和遗漏缺陷。此外，单元证明仍缺乏研究，没有系统化的开发方法或实证评估。本工作提出了首个针对内存安全验证中单元证明的实证研究。我们引入一种系统化的单元证明创建方法，利用验证反馈和客观标准。使用该方法，我们为四个嵌入式操作系统开发了73个单元证明，并评估其有效性、特征、成本和泛化性。结果表明，单元证明具有成本效益，检测出74%的复现缺陷，在增加BMC边界后又发现9%，并暴露20个新缺陷。我们还发现嵌入式软件需要小型单元证明，平均可在87分钟内开发完成并在61秒内执行。这些发现为工程师提供实践指导，并为工具设计提供实证数据。

import_candidates.title: Accurate Inference of Termination Conditions
import_candidates.abstract: We present the first approach to infer termination conditions that are accurate in the sense of precisely characterizing terminating states. It builds on a simple but effective framework where non-terminating states are iteratively identified and removed, and a termination prover is employed to validate the current condition. We instantiate the framework with data-driven provers and design a multi-way data sharing mechanism to enhance their interaction. Our proofs show that this method is correct, accurate, terminating, and relatively complete. Additionally, we introduce generalization techniques for recurrent sets to accelerate the iteration process. Evaluation on a benchmark of programs from the literature shows that our implementation significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art tool Acabar, producing much more accurate termination conditions, with the proposed techniques playing a crucial role in speeding up the convergence of the process.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了首个推断终止条件的方法，这些条件在精确刻画终止状态的意义上是准确的。它建立在一个简单但有效的框架之上，其中非终止状态被迭代地识别和移除，并采用终止性证明器来验证当前条件。我们用数据驱动的证明器实例化该框架，并设计了一种多路数据共享机制来增强它们的交互。我们的证明表明该方法正确、准确、可终止且相对完备。此外，我们引入了递归集的泛化技术以加速迭代过程。在文献中的程序基准测试上的评估表明，我们的实现显著优于最先进的工具Acabar，产生更准确的终止条件，所提出的技术在加速过程收敛方面起到了关键作用。

import_candidates.title: One Size Does Fit All: Kernel-Assisted Fine-Grained Debloating and Layout Randomization for Shared Libraries
import_candidates.abstract: Prevalent software engineering practices, such as code reuse and the “one-size-fits-all” methodology, have significantly contributed to code bloat. Code debloating, which targets the reduction of extraneous code, emerges as a promising solution to combat this issue. However, current methods that depend on redundant code deletion are at odds with the foundational design philosophy of reusable code components, regardless of whether they are applied offline or at runtime.In this paper, we introduce a kernel-assisted debloating framework, K-Polarizer, that aligns with the “one-size-fits-all” design philosophy of shared libraries. Starting from scratch, K-Polarizer progressively appends dependencies on demand to the underlying page cache associated with offline-reconstructed shared libraries, enabling it to practice the hybrid debloating strategy of “cutting unwanted pages while loading needed functions.” This allows for code sharing among processes while minimizing the global code base, keeping the visible code base for each process to an approximate minimum. Additionally, K-Polarizer integrates layout randomization at load-time to enhance security further. We have thoroughly evaluated K-Polarizer using real-world shared libraries, including musl-libc, glibc, and libFLAC. The results indicate that K-Polarizer operates transparently, preserving the original functionality of the libraries. Furthermore, K-Polarizer provides security guarantees (76.1\% gadget reduction on musl-libc) comparable to the leading debloating technique with acceptable overhead, while gracefully handling the scenario of dynamic library loading. Meanwhile, it offers resilience against memory disclosures.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 流行的软件工程实践，如代码复用和“一刀切”方法，显著导致了代码膨胀。代码去膨胀旨在减少多余代码，是应对该问题的一种有前景的解决方案。然而，当前依赖冗余代码删除的方法与可复用代码组件的基础设计哲学相冲突，无论这些方法是在离线还是在运行时应用。在本文中，我们介绍了一种内核辅助的去膨胀框架 K-Polarizer，它与共享库的“一刀切”设计哲学相一致。K-Polarizer 从零开始，按需逐步将依赖项追加到与离线重建的共享库相关联的底层页缓存中，使其能够实践“剪除不需要的页，同时加载所需函数”的混合去膨胀策略。这允许进程间代码共享，同时最小化全局代码库，使每个进程可见的代码库保持在大致最小。此外，K-Polarizer 在加载时集成了布局随机化，以进一步增强安全性。我们使用真实世界的共享库（包括 musl-libc、glibc 和 libFLAC）对 K-Polarizer 进行了全面评估。结果表明，K-Polarizer 透明运行，保留了库的原始功能。此外，K-Polarizer 提供了与领先去膨胀技术相当的安全保证（在 musl-libc 上减少 76.1% 的 gadget），且开销可接受，同时优雅地处理动态库加载场景。同时，它对内存泄露具有韧性。

import_candidates.title: Project-Level Resource Leak Detection through Agent-based Ownership Analysis and Repair Pattern Verification
import_candidates.abstract: Resource leaks cause system performance degradation and crashes. Traditional static analysis approaches rely on predefined rules, limiting their ability to find unknown leaks. Emerging LLM-based methods can locate APIs but face challenges in large-scale projects, including high costs and numerous false positives. To address these limitations, we propose AROP, the first project-level resource leak detection framework integrating LLM-based agents. AROP first extracts project-level metadata to efficiently filter resource-related files. It then employs a detection agent to identify acquisition/release operations, followed by a validation agent and data-flow dependency analysis to reduce false positives. Finally, it determines leaks through leak repair pattern analysis.We evaluated the effectiveness of our tool on the JLeaks benchmark and 6 large-scale real-world open-source projects. On JLeaks, AROP achieved a recall of 66.1\% with a precision of 91.0\%, which outperformed the current state-of-the-art, INFERROI, surpassing it by 18.2\% in precision while maintaining a comparable recall. In evaluation on real-world projects, AROP discovered 106 previously unknown resource leak defects with a precision of 71.3\%. We submitted patches for 28 of these defects, all of which have been confirmed and merged by developers.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 资源泄漏会导致系统性能下降和崩溃。传统的静态分析方法依赖预定义规则，限制了其发现未知泄漏的能力。新兴的基于LLM的方法能够定位API，但面临大规模项目中的挑战，包括高成本和大量误报。为解决这些局限，我们提出AROP，首个集成基于LLM的智能体的项目级资源泄漏检测框架。AROP首先提取项目级元数据以高效过滤资源相关文件。然后使用检测智能体识别获取/释放操作，随后通过验证智能体和数据流依赖分析来减少误报。最后，它通过泄漏修复模式分析确定泄漏。我们在JLeaks基准和6个大规模真实开源项目上评估了工具的有效性。在JLeaks上，AROP实现了66.1%的召回率和91.0%的精确率，优于当前最先进的INFERROI，在召回率相当的情况下，精确率提高了18.2%。在真实项目评估中，AROP发现了106个先前未知的资源泄漏缺陷，精确率为71.3%。我们为其中28个缺陷提交了补丁，所有补丁均已被开发者确认并合并。

import_candidates.title: Verification of Multi-Model Stochastic Systems
import_candidates.abstract: Given its ability to analyse stochastic models ranging from discrete and continuous-time Markov chains to Markov decision processes and stochastic games, probabilistic model checking (PMC) is widely used to verify system dependability and performance properties. However, modelling the behaviour of, and verifying these properties for many software-intensive systems requires the joint analysis of multiple interdependent stochastic models of different types, which existing PMC techniques and tools cannot handle. To address this limitation, we introduce a tool-supported UniversaL stochasTIc Modelling, verificAtion and synThEsis (ULTIMATE) framework that supports the representation, verification and synthesis of heterogeneous multi-model stochastic systems with complex model interdependencies. Through its unique integration of multiple PMC paradigms, and underpinned by a novel verification method for handling model interdependencies, ULTIMATE unifies—for the first time—the modelling of probabilistic and nondeterministic uncertainty, discrete and continuous time, partial observability, and the use of both Bayesian and frequentist inference to exploit domain knowledge and data about the modelled system and its context. A comprehensive suite of case studies and experiments confirm the generality and effectiveness of our novel verification framework.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 鉴于概率模型检测（PMC）能够分析从离散和连续时间马尔可夫链到马尔可夫决策过程和随机博弈等随机模型，它被广泛用于验证系统的可靠性和性能属性。然而，对许多软件密集型系统的行为进行建模并验证这些属性，需要联合分析多个不同类型且相互依赖的随机模型，而现有的PMC技术和工具无法处理。为解决这一局限，我们引入了一个工具支持的 UniversaL stochasTIc Modelling, verificAtion and synThEsis (ULTIMATE) 框架，该框架支持具有复杂模型相互依赖关系的异构多模型随机系统的表示、验证和综合。通过独特地集成多种PMC范式，并以一种处理模型相互依赖关系的新颖验证方法为基础，ULTIMATE 首次统一了概率与非确定性不确定性、离散与连续时间、部分可观测性，以及使用贝叶斯和频率派推断来利用关于被建模系统及其上下文的领域知识和数据。一套全面的案例研究和实验证实了我们新颖验证框架的通用性和有效性。

import_candidates.title: Fast Flow-Sensitive C Program Partitioning via Iterative Value-Flow Refinement
import_candidates.abstract: Software vulnerabilities that expose confidential data remain a persistent threat. Even vulnerabilities in unprivileged code can expose data in privileged code when they share memory. Program partitioning safeguards against this by dividing a monolithic program into component programs according to a security policy for sharing confidential data, following the Principle of Least Privilege: each component of a system should operate with minimum privileges.Automatic C program partitioners determine a partition by tracking dataflows of confidential values; when pointers are involved, this means a pointer analysis, so precision and performance tradeoffs are inevitable. Existing work uses Andersen’s flow-insensitive analysis, which is efficient but rejects secure programs—on the other hand, flow-sensitive analysis has not traditionally scaled.In this paper, we present CSP (C Sparse Partitioner), a C partitioner that supports robust security policies for mutual distrust and employs sparse demand-driven pointer analysis to achieve flow-sensitive precision at a fraction of the cost of whole-program flow-sensitive analysis. Our key innovation is an iterative value-flow refinement where a flow-insensitive constraint system is locally refined for flow-sensitivity as partitioning conflicts are found. We evaluate CSP on large real-world C programs with security requirements such as OpenSSH and Sendmail, and find that our technique outperforms whole-program flow-sensitive pointer analysis by up to an order of magnitude without sacrificing precision.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 暴露机密数据的软件漏洞仍然是一个持续存在的威胁。即使是未特权代码中的漏洞，当它们共享内存时，也可能暴露特权代码中的数据。程序分区通过根据共享机密数据的安全策略将单体程序划分为组件程序来防止这种情况，遵循最小特权原则：系统的每个组件都应以最小特权运行。自动C程序分区器通过跟踪机密值的数据流来确定分区；当涉及指针时，这意味着需要进行指针分析，因此精度和性能之间的权衡不可避免。现有工作使用Andersen的流不敏感分析，这种方法高效但会拒绝安全程序——另一方面，流敏感分析传统上难以扩展。在本文中，我们提出了CSP（C稀疏分区器），一个支持相互不信任的鲁棒安全策略的C分区器，它采用稀疏需求驱动指针分析，以整个程序流敏感分析的一小部分成本实现流敏感精度。我们的关键创新是迭代值流精化，其中当发现分区冲突时，流不敏感约束系统被局部精化为流敏感。我们在具有安全要求的大型真实C程序（如OpenSSH和Sendmail）上评估了CSP，发现我们的技术在不牺牲精度的情况下，比整个程序流敏感指针分析快达一个数量级。

import_candidates.title: Accelerating IC3 Verification by Exploiting Unsatisfiable Cores and Satisfying Models
import_candidates.abstract: The IC3 algorithm represents a groundbreaking advancement in the field of model checking. However, its heavy reliance on numerous and frequent constraint-solving calls poses significant challenges when verifying complex programs. We observe that many of the constraints solved within IC3 share remarkable similarities. Based on this observation, we propose an IC3 acceleration verification method by reusing unsatisfiable cores and satisfying models of previous constraints. This method constructs an Unsatisfiable Core Library (UCL) and a Satisfying Model Library (SML) to store and index crucial unsatisfiable cores and satisfying models generated during the verification process. When a new constraint-solving request is received, our method preemptively determines the satisfiability of the constraint using the existing unsatisfiable cores and satisfying models. This approach can significantly reduce the number of required solver calls, thereby enhancing the verification efficiency. We have implemented our method on Kind2 and evaluated it on the standard benchmark suite of Kind2. Experimental evaluation demonstrates that, for complex examples, our method can reduce the number of solver calls by an order of magnitude, and achieves a 4.35-fold speedup with even less memory consumption.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: IC3算法代表了模型检测领域的突破性进展。然而，它严重依赖大量且频繁的约束求解调用，这在验证复杂程序时带来了重大挑战。我们观察到，IC3中求解的许多约束具有显著的相似性。基于这一观察，我们提出了一种通过复用先前约束的不可满足核和满足模型来加速IC3验证的方法。该方法构建了一个不可满足核库（UCL）和一个满足模型库（SML），用于存储和索引验证过程中生成的关键不可满足核与满足模型。当收到新的约束求解请求时，我们的方法利用已有的不可满足核和满足模型抢先判断该约束的可满足性。这种方法可以显著减少所需的求解器调用次数，从而提高验证效率。我们在Kind2上实现了我们的方法，并在Kind2的标准基准套件上进行了评估。实验评估表明，对于复杂示例，我们的方法可以将求解器调用次数减少一个数量级，并实现4.35倍的加速，同时内存消耗更少。

import_candidates.title: Towards Global Matches for Third-Party Library Detection in Android
import_candidates.abstract: The detection of third-party libraries (TPLs) is pivotal in upholding the security of Android supply chains. A significant hurdle in this domain pertains to ensuring accurate detection, particularly in the face of prevalent code obfuscation techniques. Recently, multiple research endeavors have advocated for the adoption of fuzzy library signatures to accommodate specific code features that can be affected by code obfuscation. Despite the potential promise of this approach, the use of such abstractions often results in the identification of multiple candidates that bear a striking resemblance. Unfortunately, prevailing methodologies tend to rely on local maxima of similarity matches, disregarding the broader contextual knowledge encapsulated within surrounding classes. This oversight culminates in suboptimal matching outcomes.The key observation motivating our research is that knowledge about surrounding library classes can significantly enhance matching accuracy. In this regard, we aim to establish a correspondence between sets of classes in a given app and target library—leveraging this contextual information from surrounding classes enables a transition from local matches to global matches. We implemented our idea in a TPL detection tool, called LibScope. LibScope refines obfuscation-resilient library signatures and introduces a strategic iterative process (i.e., a back-and-forth game), thereby elevating the pairwise similarity between independent classes to similarities among sets of classes. We extensively evaluated LibScope with state-of-the-art TPL detection approaches published at top venues. The comparative results on two representative public benchmarks reveal that LibScope significantly outperforms its counterparts in terms of recall, precision, and accuracy in library version detection.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 第三方库（TPL）的检测对于维护Android供应链的安全至关重要。该领域的一个重大障碍在于确保准确检测，特别是在面对普遍存在的代码混淆技术时。最近，多项研究工作主张采用模糊库签名来适应可能受代码混淆影响的特定代码特征。尽管这种方法具有潜在前景，但使用此类抽象往往会导致识别出多个高度相似的候选。遗憾的是，现有方法往往依赖于相似性匹配的局部最大值，忽略了周围类所包含的更广泛上下文知识。这种疏忽导致匹配结果次优。我们研究的核心观察是，关于周围库类的知识可以显著提高匹配准确性。为此，我们旨在建立给定应用中的类集合与目标库之间的对应关系——利用来自周围类的上下文信息，使得从局部匹配过渡到全局匹配。我们在一个名为LibScope的TPL检测工具中实现了我们的想法。LibScope改进了抗混淆的库签名，并引入了一种策略性迭代过程（即，一种来回博弈），从而将独立类之间的成对相似性提升为类集合之间的相似性。我们使用发表在顶级会议上的最先进TPL检测方法对LibScope进行了广泛评估。在两个代表性公开基准上的比较结果表明，LibScope在召回率、精确率和库版本检测准确性方面显著优于同类方法。

import_candidates.title: Closing the Chain: How to reduce your risk of being SolarWinds, Log4j, or XZ Utils
import_candidates.abstract: Software supply chain frameworks, such as the US NIST , detail what tasks software development organizations are recommended or mandated to adopt to reduce security risk. However, to further reduce the risk of similar attacks occurring, software organizations benefit from knowing what tasks mitigate attack techniques the attackers are currently using to address specific threats, prioritize tasks, and close mitigation gaps. The goal of this study is to aid software organizations in reducing the risk of software supply chain attacks by systematically synthesizing how framework tasks mitigate the attack techniques used in the SolarWinds (solarwinds), Log4j (log4j), and XZ Utils (xz) attacks. We qualitatively analyzed 106 reports of the 3 attacks to gather the attack techniques. We then systematically constructed a mapping between attack techniques and the 73 tasks enumerated in 10 software supply chain frameworks. Afterward, we established and ranked priority tasks that mitigate attack techniques. The three mitigation tasks with the highest scores are role-based access control, system monitoring, and boundary protection. Additionally, three mitigation tasks were missing from all ten frameworks, including sustainable open-source software and environmental scanning tools. Thus, software products would still be vulnerable to software supply chain attacks even if organizations adopted all recommended tasks.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 软件供应链框架（如美国NIST）详细说明了软件开发组织被建议或强制采用哪些任务来降低安全风险。然而，为了进一步降低类似攻击发生的风险，软件组织需要了解哪些任务能够缓解攻击者当前用于应对特定威胁的攻击技术、确定任务优先级并弥合缓解差距。本研究的目标是通过系统地综合框架任务如何缓解SolarWinds、Log4j和XZ Utils攻击中使用的攻击技术，来帮助软件组织降低软件供应链攻击的风险。我们对这3起攻击的106份报告进行了定性分析，以收集攻击技术。然后，我们系统地构建了攻击技术与10个软件供应链框架中列举的73项任务之间的映射。之后，我们建立并排序了缓解攻击技术的优先任务。得分最高的三个缓解任务是基于角色的访问控制、系统监控和边界保护。此外，所有十个框架都缺少三项缓解任务，包括可持续开源软件和环境扫描工具。因此，即使组织采用了所有推荐任务，软件产品仍然容易受到软件供应链攻击。

import_candidates.title: An Empirical Study on the Robustness of Android Third-Party Library Detection Tools Against Advanced Obfuscation
import_candidates.abstract: Third-party libraries (TPLs) play a crucial role in Android app development by providing reusable functionalities, improving development efficiency, and reducing time-to-market. However, detecting and analyzing TPLs is essential, as their vulnerabilities, outdated versions, or malicious modifications can introduce security risks and compromise the integrity of Android apps. Existing TPL detection approaches struggle against code obfuscation, a prevalent practice in Android apps. While prior research has explored obfuscation-resistant detection methods, they largely overlook advanced obfuscation techniques such as package hierarchy obfuscation.To bridge this gap, we first investigate the prevalence of advanced obfuscation in contemporary Android apps using ObfDetector, a novel static analysis tool capable of detecting identifier renaming, package hierarchy obfuscation, and code optimization. Our large-scale study on 77,504 closed-source Google Play apps and 619 widely used apps reveals extensive obfuscation adoption. We further evaluate the resilience of state-of-the-art TPL detection tools under realistic obfuscation conditions using a newly constructed benchmark dataset, exposing significant performance deficiencies, with F1-scores dropping below 50\% for library-level detection and under 10\% for version-level identification. Finally, we conduct a systematic failure analysis to uncover key architectural limitations in existing TPL detection frameworks and propose design guidelines for next-generation detection tools. We release our obfuscation detection tool and benchmark dataset to support further research in Android security.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 第三方库（TPLs）在Android应用开发中起着关键作用，提供可重用功能、提高开发效率并缩短上市时间。然而，检测和分析TPL至关重要，因为它们的漏洞、过时版本或恶意修改可能引入安全风险并损害Android应用的完整性。现有TPL检测方法难以应对代码混淆，这是Android应用中普遍存在的做法。尽管先前研究探索了抗混淆检测方法，但它们大多忽略了包层级混淆等高级混淆技术。为弥补这一差距，我们首先使用ObfDetector（一种能够检测标识符重命名、包层级混淆和代码优化的新型静态分析工具）调查当代Android应用中高级混淆的普遍性。我们对77,504个闭源Google Play应用和619个广泛使用的应用进行的大规模研究揭示了广泛的混淆采用。我们进一步使用新构建的基准数据集评估了最先进的TPL检测工具在现实混淆条件下的弹性，暴露了显著的性能缺陷：库级检测的F1分数降至50%以下，版本级识别降至10%以下。最后，我们进行系统性的失败分析，以揭示现有TPL检测框架中的关键架构限制，并提出下一代检测工具的设计指南。我们发布了混淆检测工具和基准数据集，以支持Android安全的进一步研究。

import_candidates.title: Insecure Ingredients? Exploring Dependency Update Patterns of Bundled JavaScript Packages on the Web
import_candidates.abstract: Reusable software components, typically distributed as packages, are a central paradigm of modern software development. The JavaScript ecosystem serves as a prime example, offering millions of packages with their use being promoted as idiomatic. However, download statistics on npm raise security concerns as they indicate a high popularity of vulnerable package versions while their real prevalence on production websites remains unknown. Package version detection mechanisms fill this gap by extracting utilized packages and versions from observed artifacts on the web. Prior research focuses on mechanisms for either hand-selected popular packages in bundles or for single-file resources utilizing the global namespace. This does not allow for a thorough analysis of modern web applications’ dependency update behavior at scale. In this work, we improve upon this by presenting Aletheia, a package-agnostic method which dissects JavaScript bundles to identify package versions through algorithms originating from the field of plagiarism detection. We show that Aletheia clearly outperforms the existing approaches in practical settings. Furthermore, we crawl the Tranco top 100,000 domains to reveal that 5\% to 20\% of domains update their dependencies within 16 weeks. Surprisingly, from a longitudinal perspective, bundled packages are updated significantly faster than their CDN-included counterparts, with consequently up to 10 times fewer known vulnerable package versions included. Still, we observe indicators that few widespread vendors seem to be a major driving force behind timely updates, implying that quantitative measures are not painting a complete picture.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 可重用软件组件，通常以包的形式分发，是现代软件开发的核心范式。JavaScript生态系统就是一个典型例子，它提供了数百万个包，其使用被宣传为惯用做法。然而，npm上的下载统计数据引发了安全担忧，因为它们表明易受攻击的包版本很流行，而其在生产网站上的实际流行程度仍未知。包版本检测机制通过从Web上观察到的制品中提取已使用的包和版本来填补这一空白。先前的研究要么关注包中手工挑选的流行包，要么关注利用全局命名空间的单文件资源。这无法对现代Web应用程序的依赖更新行为进行大规模彻底分析。在这项工作中，我们改进了这一点，提出了Aletheia，一种与包无关的方法，它通过源自抄袭检测领域的算法剖析JavaScript包以识别包版本。我们表明，Aletheia在实际环境中明显优于现有方法。此外，我们爬取了Tranco前10万个域名，发现5%到20%的域名在16周内更新其依赖项。令人惊讶的是，从纵向角度看，捆绑包比通过CDN引入的对应包更新得明显更快，因此包含的已知易受攻击包版本最多可减少10倍。尽管如此，我们观察到有迹象表明，少数广泛使用的供应商似乎是及时更新的主要驱动力，这意味着定量措施并未描绘出全貌。

import_candidates.title: AnchorDiff: Binary OSS Version Identification Method Based on Anchor Node Slicing
import_candidates.abstract: Binary Open-Source Software (OSS) is commonly embedded as third-party code within firmware and downstream software architectures, for simplifying the development process. However, vulnerabilities existing in OSS can be propagated through code reuse into embedded firmware and software architectures, posing security risks to these devices. To mitigate the security risks in firmware and software architectures, researchers have identified the versions of extracted firmware or binary software to detect N-day vulnerabilities in OSS. Existing works have achieved several success, but new challenges of non-linear update and minor updates hinder the improvement of the accuracy of binary OSS version identification.In this paper, we propose AnchorDiff, an efficient and accurate framework of binary OSS version identification. AnchorDiff filters out versions with significant updates from all OSS versions as Anchor Nodes which serve as boundaries to partition the entire version chain into sub-regions. The target file’s sub-region is located based on the binary code similarity detection (BCSD) results with the Anchor Nodes’ function libraries. Finally, AnchorDiff uses the Adaptive Weight Fine-grained Matching (AWM) algorithm to weight the fine-grained matching results and determine the true version of the target binary file.The experimental results show that AnchorDiff achieves the best performance in identifying binary OSS versions with complex compilation configurations in both small and large OSS datasets, with accuracies reaching 90.35\% and 97.17\% respectively, which are 2.76\% and 20.99\% higher than the current state-of-the-art (SOTA) work. In terms of database storage, AnchorDiff reduces storage requirements by a factor of 36, compared to the original binary files.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 二进制开源软件（OSS）通常作为第三方代码嵌入固件和下游软件架构中，以简化开发过程。然而，OSS中存在的漏洞可通过代码复用传播到嵌入式固件和软件架构中，给这些设备带来安全风险。为缓解固件和软件架构中的安全风险，研究者通过识别提取出的固件或二进制软件的版本，来检测OSS中的N-day漏洞。现有工作已取得一些成功，但非线性更新和微小更新带来的新挑战阻碍了二进制OSS版本识别准确率的提升。在本文中，我们提出AnchorDiff，一个高效且准确的二进制OSS版本识别框架。AnchorDiff从所有OSS版本中筛选出具有显著更新的版本作为锚节点，这些锚节点作为边界将整个版本链划分为子区域。基于目标文件与锚节点函数库的二进制代码相似性检测（BCSD）结果，定位目标文件所属的子区域。最后，AnchorDiff使用自适应权重细粒度匹配（AWM）算法对细粒度匹配结果进行加权，并确定目标二进制文件的真实版本。实验结果表明，AnchorDiff在识别具有复杂编译配置的二进制OSS版本方面，在小型和大型OSS数据集上均取得最佳性能，准确率分别达到90.35%和97.17%，比当前最先进（SOTA）工作分别高出2.76%和20.99%。在数据库存储方面，与原始二进制文件相比，AnchorDiff将存储需求降低了36倍。

import_candidates.title: Securing the AI Supply Chain: What Can We Learn From Developer-Reported Security Issues and Solutions of AI Projects?
import_candidates.abstract: The rapid growth of Artificial Intelligence (AI) models and applications has led to an increasingly complex security landscape. Developers of AI projects must contend not only with traditional software supply chain issues but also with novel, AI-specific security threats. However, little is known about what security issues are commonly encountered and how they are resolved in practice. This gap hinders the development of effective security measures for each component of the AI supply chain. We bridge this gap by conducting an empirical investigation of developer-reported issues and solutions, based on discussions from Hugging Face and GitHub. To identify security-related discussions, we develop a pipeline that combines keyword matching with an optimal fine-tuned distilBERT classifier, which achieved the best performance in our extensive comparison of various deep learning and large language models. This pipeline produces a dataset of 312,868 security discussions, providing insights into the security reporting practices of AI applications and projects. We conduct a thematic analysis of 753 posts sampled from our dataset and uncover a fine-grained taxonomy of 32 security issues and 24 solutions across four themes: (1) System and Software, (2) External Tools and Ecosystem, (3) Model, and (4) Data. We reveal that many security issues arise from the complex dependencies and black-box nature of AI components. Notably, challenges related to Models and Data often lack concrete solutions. Our insights can offer evidence-based guidance for developers and researchers to address real-world security threats across the AI supply chain.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）模型和应用的快速增长导致了日益复杂的安全格局。AI项目的开发者不仅需要应对传统的软件供应链问题，还需要应对新颖的、AI特有的安全威胁。然而，对于实践中常见的安全问题以及如何解决这些问题，人们知之甚少。这一空白阻碍了为AI供应链的每个组件开发有效的安全措施。我们通过基于Hugging Face和GitHub上的讨论，对开发者报告的问题和解决方案进行实证调查，来弥合这一空白。为了识别与安全相关的讨论，我们开发了一个结合关键词匹配和最优微调distilBERT分类器的流程，在我们对各种深度学习和大型语言模型的广泛比较中取得了最佳性能。该流程生成了一个包含312,868条安全讨论的数据集，为AI应用和项目的安全报告实践提供了见解。我们对从数据集中采样的753条帖子进行了主题分析，并揭示了一个细粒度的分类体系，涵盖四个主题下的32个安全问题和24个解决方案：（1）系统与软件，（2）外部工具与生态系统，（3）模型，以及（4）数据。我们发现，许多安全问题源于AI组件的复杂依赖关系和黑盒性质。值得注意的是，与模型和数据相关的挑战往往缺乏具体解决方案。我们的见解可以为开发者和研究人员提供基于证据的指导，以应对AI供应链中的现实世界安全威胁。

import_candidates.title: Beyond Fuzzy Matching: Constraint-Guided Patch Presence Testing for Obfuscated Java Binaries
import_candidates.abstract: Patch presence testing (PPT) is critical for mitigating vulnerabilities introduced by the use of third-party libraries (TPLs) in Java programs. However, the widespread use of obfuscation significantly undermines its accuracy by altering patch-relevant features. To preserve feature consistency before and after obfuscation for reliable comparison, existing studies summarize patch digests using several representative fuzzy features. These fuzzy features, designed to generalize obfuscation-prone details, have proven effective in TPL detection. Nevertheless, this approach faces limitations when directly applied to PPT, where finer features are needed to capture subtle patch changes. Although patch digests facilitate feature matching under obfuscation-induced code changes with high efficiency, methods with similar semantic structures—common in TPLs due to factors such as overriding and inheritance—often exhibit identical digests. Relying solely on feature similarity without considering method constraints often results in inaccurate outcomes.To tackle the aforementioned challenges, this paper presents PScan, a constraint-guided patch presence testing tool capable of detecting patches in both standard and obfuscated Java binaries (i.e., executables of Java programs). PScan first defines a set of actual constraints that must be satisfied during Java method matching. Guided by these constraints, it maps methods containing critical patch information to their obfuscated counterparts and then leverages these mappings to refine the associated fuzzy features into concrete expressions. Furthermore, leveraging the formalized constraints, PScan formulates the patch digest matching process as a binary integer programming (BIP) model to precisely identify correct method matches. Extensive evaluations on public datasets show that PScan outperforms state-of-the-art methods, improving accuracy by at least 15.0 percentage points and achieving an overall accuracy of 97.1\%. Our experiments also reveal that, with these constraints, PScan reduces the method mismatch rate to 1.5\%, a 16.9 percentage point reduction relative to the baseline.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 补丁存在性测试（PPT）对于缓解Java程序中使用第三方库（TPL）所引入的漏洞至关重要。然而，混淆的广泛使用会改变与补丁相关的特征，从而严重削弱其准确性。为了在混淆前后保持特征一致性以实现可靠比较，现有研究使用若干代表性模糊特征来总结补丁摘要。这些模糊特征旨在泛化易受混淆影响的细节，已被证明在TPL检测中有效。然而，当直接应用于PPT时，该方法面临局限，因为PPT需要更细粒度的特征来捕获细微的补丁变化。尽管补丁摘要能够以高效率促进混淆引起的代码变化下的特征匹配，但具有相似语义结构的方法——由于覆盖和继承等因素在TPL中很常见——常常表现出相同的摘要。仅依赖特征相似性而不考虑方法约束，往往会导致不准确的结果。为应对上述挑战，本文提出PScan，一种约束引导的补丁存在性测试工具，能够检测标准Java二进制和混淆Java二进制（即Java程序的可执行文件）中的补丁。PScan首先定义了一组在Java方法匹配期间必须满足的实际约束。在这些约束的引导下，它将包含关键补丁信息的方法映射到其混淆后的对应方法，然后利用这些映射将相关的模糊特征细化为具体表达式。此外，借助形式化约束，PScan将补丁摘要匹配过程建模为二进制整数规划（BIP）模型，以精确识别正确的方法匹配。在公开数据集上的大量评估表明，PScan优于最先进的方法，准确率至少提高15.0个百分点，总体准确率达到97.1%。我们的实验还表明，借助这些约束，PScan将方法不匹配率降低至1.5%，相对于基线降低了16.9个百分点。

import_candidates.title: Rusted Types: Static Detection of Rust Type Confusion Bugs
import_candidates.abstract: Rust is a modern programming language designed for strict memory and concurrency safety. Despite the safety checks, unsafe code in Rust can introduce memory safety issues. Unsafe type conversion, which reinterprets data from one type to another type, can alter the type spatial and temporal properties, leading to memory safety and data corruption issues. Since an unsafely converted value could violate a programmer’s intended conversion semantics and allows attackers to access the sensitive memory, type confusion bugs have critical security implications. Despite the increasing number of Rust type confusion bugs, the problem has not been systematically studied and addressed by the Rust community.In this paper, we propose DeRust, the first and a novel static analysis tool for detecting Rust type confusion bugs. By precisely tracking the inter-procedural data flows from unsafe type conversions to sensitive operations, DeRust can effectively and efficiently identify type confusion bugs. Our evaluation shows that DeRust can detect all the type confusion bugs in the benchmark datasets, and further helped report 54 previously unknown bugs in the top 1000 Rust packages with 13 RustSec IDs assigned.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Rust是一种现代编程语言，设计目标是严格的内存和并发安全。尽管有安全检查，Rust中的不安全代码仍可能引入内存安全问题。不安全类型转换会将数据从一种类型重新解释为另一种类型，可能改变类型的空间和时间属性，导致内存安全和数据损坏问题。由于不安全转换的值可能违反程序员预期的转换语义，并允许攻击者访问敏感内存，类型混淆漏洞具有关键安全影响。尽管Rust类型混淆漏洞数量不断增加，但Rust社区尚未系统性地研究和解决该问题。本文提出了DeRust，这是第一个也是新颖的用于检测Rust类型混淆漏洞的静态分析工具。通过精确跟踪从不安全类型转换到敏感操作的跨过程数据流，DeRust能够有效且高效地识别类型混淆漏洞。我们的评估表明，DeRust可以检测基准数据集中的所有类型混淆漏洞，并进一步帮助在排名前1000的Rust包中报告了54个先前未知的漏洞，其中13个被分配了RustSec ID。

import_candidates.title: Bytecode-centric Detection of Known-to-be-vulnerable Dependencies in Java Projects
import_candidates.abstract: On average, 71\% of the code in typical Java projects comes from open-source software (OSS) dependencies, making OSS dependencies the dominant component of modern software code bases. This high degree of OSS reliance comes with a considerable security risk of adding known security vulnerabilities to a code base. To remedy this risk, researchers and companies have developed various dependency scanners, which try to identify inclusions of known-to-be-vulnerable OSS dependencies. However, there are still challenges that modern dependency scanners do not overcome, especially when it comes to dependency modifications, such as re-compilations, re-bundlings or re-packagings, which are common in the Java ecosystem.To overcome these challenges, we present Jaralyzer, a bytecode-centric dependency scanner for Java. Jaralyzer does not rely on the metadata or the source code of the included OSS dependencies being available but directly analyzes a dependency’s bytecode.Our evaluation across 56 popular OSS components demonstrates that Jaralyzer outperforms other popular dependency scanners in detecting vulnerabilities within modified dependencies. It is the only scanner capable of identifying vulnerabilities across all the above mentioned types of modifications. But even when applied to unmodified dependencies, Jaralyzer outperforms the current state-of-the-art code-centric scanner Eclipse Steady by detecting 28 more true vulnerabilities and yielding 29 fewer false warnings.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 平均而言，典型Java项目中有71%的代码来自开源软件（OSS）依赖，使OSS依赖成为现代软件代码库的主要组成部分。这种对OSS的高度依赖带来了相当大的安全风险，即向代码库中引入已知安全漏洞。为缓解这一风险，研究人员和公司开发了各种依赖扫描器，试图识别已知易受攻击的OSS依赖的引入。然而，现代依赖扫描器仍面临一些挑战，特别是在依赖修改方面，例如重新编译、重新打包或重新封装，这些在Java生态系统中很常见。为克服这些挑战，我们提出了Jaralyzer，一个以字节码为中心的Java依赖扫描器。Jaralyzer不依赖于所包含OSS依赖的元数据或源代码是否可用，而是直接分析依赖的字节码。我们在56个流行OSS组件上的评估表明，Jaralyzer在检测修改后依赖中的漏洞方面优于其他流行的依赖扫描器。它是唯一能够识别上述所有修改类型中漏洞的扫描器。但即使在应用于未修改的依赖时，Jaralyzer也优于当前最先进的以代码为中心的扫描器Eclipse Steady，多检测到28个真实漏洞，并少产生29个误报警告。

import_candidates.title: CoBrA: Context-, Branch-sensitive Static Analysis for Detecting Taint-style Vulnerabilities in PHP Web Applications
import_candidates.abstract: PHP, a widely-used programming language in Web development, contains powerful dynamic features (e.g., dynamic function name construction), making static detection of taint-style vulnerabilities like SQL injection and XSS challenging. State-of-the-art (SoTA) static approaches perform call graph-guided backward dataflow tracking, thus failing to analyze those dynamic PHP features, like variable functions, and control structures, which results in high false positives and negatives. In this paper, we design and implement CoBrA, a context-, branch-sensitive approach to detect taint-style vulnerabilities in PHP-based Web applications. The key innovations are the abstract domain graph (ADG), which is used to efficiently guide the analysis, and a ‘‘stretch-relax’’ algorithm, which enables accurate resolution of PHP dynamic features and efficient inter-procedural taint propagation. Our evaluation of CoBrA’s prototype identified 54 zero-day vulnerabilities in 19 real-world applications with nine CVE identifiers assigned, achieved 88.66\% detection rate with under 0.3\% false positives on a PHP tarpits dataset, and outperformed four SoTA tools across all test datasets with reasonable time and space consumption.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: PHP是Web开发中广泛使用的编程语言，具有强大的动态特性（例如动态函数名构造），这使得对SQL注入和XSS等污点式漏洞的静态检测颇具挑战性。最先进的静态方法执行调用图引导的后向数据流跟踪，因此无法分析那些动态PHP特性（如变量函数）和控制结构，导致高误报和漏报。在本文中，我们设计并实现了CoBrA，一种上下文和分支敏感的静态分析方法，用于检测基于PHP的Web应用程序中的污点式漏洞。关键创新是抽象域图（ADG），用于高效指导分析，以及“拉伸-松弛”（stretch-relax）算法，可准确解析PHP动态特性并实现高效的过程间污点传播。我们对CoBrA原型的评估在19个真实应用程序中识别出54个零日漏洞，获得九个CVE标识符，在PHP tarpits数据集上达到88.66%的检测率和低于0.3%的误报率，并在所有测试数据集上以合理的时间和空间消耗优于四个最先进的工具。

import_candidates.title: One Signature, Multiple Payments: Demystifying and Detecting Signature Replay Vulnerabilities in Smart Contracts
import_candidates.abstract: Smart contracts have significantly advanced blockchain technology, and digital signatures are crucial for reliable verification of contract authority. Through signature verification, smart contracts can ensure that signers possess the required permissions, thus enhancing security and scalability. However, lacking checks on signature usage conditions can lead to repeated verifications, increasing the risk of permission abuse and threatening contract assets. We define this issue as the Signature Replay Vulnerability (SRV).In this paper, we conducted the first empirical study to investigate the causes and characteristics of the SRVs. From 1,419 audit reports across 37 blockchain security companies, we identified 108 with detailed SRV descriptions and classified five types of SRVs. To detect these vulnerabilities automatically, we designed LASiR, which utilizes the general semantic understanding ability of Large Language Models (LLMs) to assist in the static taint analysis of the signature state and identify the signature reuse behavior. It also employs path reachability verification via symbolic execution to ensure effective and reliable detection. To evaluate the performance of LASiR, we conducted large-scale experiments on 15,383 contracts involving signature verification, selected from the initial dataset of 918,964 contracts across four blockchains: Ethereum, Binance Smart Chain, Polygon, and Arbitrum. The results indicate that SRVs are widespread, with affected contracts holding $4.76 million in active assets. Among these, 19.63\% of contracts that use signatures on Ethereum contain SRVs. Furthermore, manual verification demonstrates that LASiR achieves an F1-score of 87.90\% for detection. Ablation studies and comparative experiments reveal that the semantic information provided by LLMs aids static taint analysis, significantly enhancing LASiR’s detection performance.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 智能合约极大地推进了区块链技术，而数字签名对于可靠验证合约权限至关重要。通过签名验证，智能合约可以确保签名者拥有所需权限，从而增强安全性和可扩展性。然而，若缺乏对签名使用条件的检查，可能导致重复验证，增加权限滥用风险并威胁合约资产。我们将此问题定义为签名重放漏洞（SRV）。本文首次开展实证研究，探究SRV的成因与特征。我们从37家区块链安全公司的1,419份审计报告中识别出108份包含详细SRV描述的报告，并将SRV分为五类。为自动检测这些漏洞，我们设计了LASiR，它利用大语言模型（LLM）的通用语义理解能力辅助对签名状态进行静态污点分析，并识别签名重用行为。它还通过符号执行进行路径可达性验证，以确保有效可靠的检测。为评估LASiR的性能，我们在15,383份涉及签名验证的合约上进行了大规模实验，这些合约选自以太坊、币安智能链、Polygon和Arbitrum四条区块链的918,964份合约的初始数据集。结果表明，SRV广泛存在，受影响的合约持有476万美元的活跃资产。其中，以太坊上使用签名的合约有19.63%包含SRV。此外，人工验证表明，LASiR的检测F1分数达到87.90%。消融研究和对比实验表明，LLM提供的语义信息有助于静态污点分析，显著提升了LASiR的检测性能。

import_candidates.title: TaintP2X: Detecting Taint-Style Prompt-to-Anything Injection Vulnerabilities in LLM-Integrated Applications
import_candidates.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized numerous domains, enabling the development of LLM-integrated applications that autonomously plan and act through tool calling. While these applications demonstrate remarkable capabilities, their ability to invoke sensitive operations, such as file system interactions, code execution, and database queries, introduces critical security risks. In particular, prompt injection vulnerabilities, combined with security-sensitive sink functions, can lead to a broad class of attacks we define as Prompt-to-Anything Injection (P2Xi). These vulnerabilities, stemming from the misuse of LLM-generated outputs without proper validation, can result in severe consequences such as Remote Command Execution (RCE), file injection, SQL injection, and Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF). To address this emerging threat, we propose TaintP2X, a novel static taint analysis framework that models LLM-generated outputs as taint sources, tracks their propagation through sensitive sink functions, and employs LLM-assisted analysis to prune false positives. TaintP2X achieves high precision and scalability, systematically identifying P2Xi vulnerabilities. In evaluations, TaintP2X demonstrated a 77.1\% recall on a ground truth dataset of 35 P2Xi vulnerabilities, outperforming state-of-the-art methods. With TaintP2X, we have uncovered 101 taint paths across 75 open source repositories, with 7 vulnerabilities confirmed by developers, and 5 of them fixed. These findings highlight the prevalence and impact of P2Xi vulnerabilities and establish TaintP2X as a practical solution for securing LLM-integrated ecosystems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）已经彻底改变了许多领域，使得能够通过工具调用自主规划和行动的LLM集成应用得以发展。虽然这些应用展现出卓越的能力，但它们调用敏感操作（如文件系统交互、代码执行和数据库查询）的能力引入了严重的安全风险。特别是，提示注入漏洞与安全敏感的汇聚函数相结合，可能导致我们定义为提示到任意注入（P2Xi）的一大类攻击。这些漏洞源于未经验证就滥用LLM生成的输出，可能导致远程命令执行（RCE）、文件注入、SQL注入和服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）等严重后果。为了应对这一新兴威胁，我们提出了TaintP2X，一种新颖的静态污点分析框架，它将LLM生成的输出建模为污点源，跟踪它们通过敏感汇聚函数的传播，并采用LLM辅助分析来修剪误报。TaintP2X实现了高精度和可扩展性，能够系统地识别P2Xi漏洞。在评估中，TaintP2X在包含35个P2Xi漏洞的真实基准数据集上实现了77.1%的召回率，优于最先进的方法。借助TaintP2X，我们在75个开源仓库中发现了101条污点路径，其中7个漏洞得到了开发者的确认，5个已修复。这些发现凸显了P2Xi漏洞的普遍性和影响，并确立了TaintP2X作为保护LLM集成生态系统的实用解决方案。

import_candidates.title: ConfuGuard: Using Metadata to Detect Active and Stealthy Package Confusion Attacks Accurately and at Scale
import_candidates.abstract: Package confusion attacks, such as typosquatting, threaten software supply chains. Attackers make packages with names that syntactically or semantically resemble legitimate ones, tricking engineers into installing malware. While prior work has developed defenses against package confusions in some software package registries, notably NPM, PyPI, and RubyGems, gaps remain: high false-positive rates, generalization to more software package ecosystems, and insights from real-world deployment.In this work, we introduce ConfuGuard, a state-of-the-art detector for package confusion threats. We begin by presenting the first empirical analysis of benign signals derived from prior package confusion data, uncovering their threat patterns, engineering practices, and measurable attributes. Advancing existing detectors, we leverage package metadata to distinguish benign packages, and extend support from three up to seven software package registries. Our approach significantly reduces false positive rates (from 80\% to 28\%), at the cost of an additional 14s average latency to filter out benign packages by analyzing the package metadata. ConfuGuard is used in production at our industry partner, whose analysts have already confirmed 630 real attacks detected by ConfuGuard.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 包混淆攻击，例如域名仿冒，威胁软件供应链。攻击者制作名称在语法或语义上类似合法包的包，诱骗工程师安装恶意软件。虽然先前工作已在一些软件包注册表（尤其是NPM、PyPI和RubyGems）中开发了针对包混淆的防御措施，但仍存在差距：高假阳性率、对更多软件包生态系统的泛化能力，以及来自真实部署的洞见。在这项工作中，我们介绍了ConfuGuard，一种最先进的包混淆威胁检测器。我们首先对来自先前包混淆数据的良性信号进行首次实证分析，揭示其威胁模式、工程实践和可测量属性。在现有检测器的基础上，我们利用包元数据来区分良性包，并将支持从三个扩展到七个软件包注册表。我们的方法显著降低了假阳性率（从80%降至28%），代价是平均增加14秒延迟，通过分析包元数据过滤良性包。ConfuGuard已在我们的行业合作伙伴处投入生产使用，其分析师已确认ConfuGuard检测到630次真实攻击。

import_candidates.title: Enforcing Control Flow Integrity on DeFi Smart Contracts
import_candidates.abstract: Smart contracts power decentralized financial (DeFi) services but are vulnerable to security exploits that can lead to significant financial losses. Existing security measures often fail to adequately protect these contracts due to the composability of DeFi protocols and the increasing sophistication of attacks. Through a large-scale empirical study of historical transactions from the 37 hacked DeFi protocols, we discovered that while benign transactions typically exhibit a limited number of unique control flows, in stark contrast, attack transactions consistently introduce novel, previously unobserved control flows. Building on these insights, we developed CrossGuard, a novel framework that enforces control flow integrity onchain to secure smart contracts. Crucially, CrossGuard does not require prior knowledge of specific hacks. Instead, configured only once at deployment, it enforces control flow whitelisting policies and applies simplification heuristics at runtime. This approach monitors and prevents potential attacks by reverting all transactions that do not adhere to the established control flow whitelisting rules. Our evaluation demonstrates that CrossGuard effectively blocks 35 of the 37 analyzed attacks when configured only once at contract deployment, maintaining a low false positive rate of (0.26\%) and minimal additional gas costs. These results underscore the efficacy of applying control flow integrity to smart contracts, significantly enhancing security beyond traditional methods and addressing the evolving threat landscape in the DeFi ecosystem.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 智能合约驱动着去中心化金融（DeFi）服务，但容易受到可导致重大财务损失的安全漏洞利用。现有安全措施往往无法充分保护这些合约，因为DeFi协议具有可组合性且攻击日益复杂。通过对37个被黑客攻击的DeFi协议的历史交易进行大规模实证研究，我们发现良性交易通常表现出有限数量的唯一控制流，而与之形成鲜明对比的是，攻击交易持续引入新颖的、此前未观察到的控制流。基于这些发现，我们开发了CrossGuard，一个在链上强制控制流完整性以保护智能合约的新颖框架。关键的是，CrossGuard不需要预先了解特定黑客攻击。相反，它仅在部署时配置一次，在运行时强制执行控制流白名单策略并应用简化启发式。该方法通过回退所有不符合既定控制流白名单规则的交易来监控并阻止潜在攻击。我们的评估表明，仅在合约部署时配置一次，CrossGuard就能有效阻止37个分析攻击中的35个，同时保持0.26%的低误报率和最小的额外gas成本。这些结果凸显了将控制流完整性应用于智能合约的有效性，显著增强了传统方法之外的安全性，并应对了DeFi生态系统中不断演变的威胁态势。

import_candidates.title: GenDetect: Generalizing Reactive Detection for Resilience Against Imitative DeFi Attack Cascade
import_candidates.abstract: As blockchain ecosystems grow, financially motivated attackers have increasingly exploited vulnerabilities in decentralized finance (DeFi) protocols, resulting in frequent and severe losses. Unlike conventional cyberattacks, DeFi exploits propagate rapidly due to the transparent and composable nature of smart contracts. In this setting, we identify a critical behavioral pattern: Imitative Attack Cascade, where an initial successful exploit is quickly followed by a flurry of mimicking transactions that reuse attack logic with minor modifications or parameter changes. Our empirical analysis shows that over 69\% of DeFi attacks exhibit strong behavioral similarity to earlier incidents, often occurring within hours or days of the initial attack.This phenomenon highlights a fundamental limitation in current reactive detection workflows. While the initial attacks are often flagged through heuristic alerts, such as Tornado Cash traces, anomalous nonce usage, or known exploiter labels, these signals require manual validation and the construction of handcrafted detection rules through trace analysis. This process is labor-intensive and slow, resulting in unacceptable latency while follow-up attacks continue to spread. Motivated by this gap, our research goal is to ensure that once an attack has been observed, even a single instance, it can be rapidly abstracted into an actionable and generalizable detection rule, enabling scalable protection against imitative attacks.We decompose the problem into two core challenges: (I) abstracting the semantics of diverse, obscure function signatures, and (II) matching transaction logic in noisy, evasive traces. To address these, we leverage two key insights: (i) the open-source nature of most DeFi protocols enables high-fidelity semantic classification of function signatures; (ii) contract labels allow us to isolate essential logic by filtering irrelevant calls and classifying attack intent. Based on these, we develop a reactive detection framework, GenDetect, which achieves strong benchmark performance (ACC: 98\%, FPR: 1\%, FNR: 3\%) and, critically, discovers 56 previously unrevealed attacks from the past three years, highlighting its practical effectiveness. Our source code and dataset are released on Github.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着区块链生态系统的发展，出于经济动机的攻击者越来越多地利用去中心化金融（DeFi）协议中的漏洞，导致频繁且严重的损失。与传统网络攻击不同，DeFi漏洞利用由于智能合约的透明性和可组合性而迅速传播。在这种背景下，我们识别出一种关键的行为模式：模仿性攻击级联（Imitative Attack Cascade），即一次初始的成功漏洞利用之后，会迅速出现大量模仿性交易，这些交易以微小修改或参数变化重用攻击逻辑。我们的实证分析表明，超过69%的DeFi攻击与早先事件表现出强烈的行为相似性，通常发生在初始攻击后的数小时或数天内。这一现象凸显了当前反应式检测工作流的一个根本局限。虽然初始攻击通常通过启发式警报（如Tornado Cash痕迹、异常nonce使用或已知攻击者标签）被标记，但这些信号需要人工验证，并通过痕迹分析构建手工检测规则。这一过程劳动密集且缓慢，导致不可接受的延迟，而后续攻击继续蔓延。受此差距驱动，我们的研究目标是确保一旦观察到攻击——即使只有一个实例——也能迅速将其抽象为可操作且可泛化的检测规则，从而实现针对模仿性攻击的可扩展保护。我们将问题分解为两个核心挑战：（I）抽象多样、晦涩函数签名的语义；（II）在嘈杂、规避性痕迹中匹配交易逻辑。为解决这些问题，我们利用两个关键见解：（i）大多数DeFi协议的开源性质使得能够对函数签名进行高保真语义分类；（ii）合约标签使我们能够通过过滤无关调用和分类攻击意图来隔离关键逻辑。基于这些，我们开发了一个反应式检测框架GenDetect，它取得了强大的基准性能（ACC: 98%, FPR: 1%, FNR: 3%），并且关键在于，从过去三年中发现了56个此前未披露的攻击，突显了其实际有效性。我们的源代码和数据集已在Github上发布。

import_candidates.title: LLM-based Vulnerability Discovery through the Lens of Code Metrics
import_candidates.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel in many tasks of software engineering, yet progress in leveraging them for vulnerability discovery has stalled in recent years. To understand this phenomenon, we investigate LLMs through the lens of classic code metrics. Surprisingly, we find that a classifier trained solely on these metrics performs on par with state-of-the-art LLMs for vulnerability discovery. A root-cause analysis reveals a strong correlation and a causal effect between LLMs and code metrics: When the value of a metric is changed, LLM predictions tend to shift by a corresponding magnitude. This dependency suggests that LLMs operate at a similarly shallow level as code metrics, limiting their ability to grasp complex patterns and fully realize their potential in vulnerability discovery. Based on these findings, we derive recommendations on how research should more effectively address this challenge.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在软件工程的许多任务中表现出色，然而近年来利用它们进行漏洞发现的进展却停滞不前。为了理解这一现象，我们通过经典代码度量的视角来研究LLMs。令人惊讶的是，我们发现仅基于这些度量训练的分类器在漏洞发现方面与最先进的LLMs表现相当。根因分析揭示了LLMs与代码度量之间存在强相关性和因果效应：当度量的值发生变化时，LLM的预测往往会相应幅度地偏移。这种依赖性表明，LLMs与代码度量在相似浅层级别上运行，限制了它们掌握复杂模式并充分发挥在漏洞发现中潜力的能力。基于这些发现，我们提出了关于研究应如何更有效应对这一挑战的建议。

import_candidates.title: Exploring and Improving Real-World Vulnerability Data Generation via Prompting Large Language Models
import_candidates.abstract: Data-driven approaches have proven to be promising for vulnerability analysis, contingent on quality and sizable training data being available. Several dedicated vulnerability data generation techniques have demonstrated strong merits, yet they are limited to simple (single-line injection induced) vulnerabilities only and suffer from overfitting to seed samples. Large language models (LLMs) may overcome these fundamental limitations as they are known to be effective at generative tasks. However, it remains unclear how they would perform on the task of vulnerable sample generation. In this paper, we explore the potential and gaps of seven state-of-the-art (SOTA) LLMs for that task via prompting.We reveal that the LLMs are capable of injecting vulnerabilities, with advanced prompting strategies such as few-shot in-context learning and our new vulnerability-introducing code-change semantics (VICS) guided prompting boosting the effectiveness, achieving up to 93\% success rate on a synthetic dataset and 88\% on real-world code. The LLMs can effectively perform both single- and multi-line injections, addressing a key limitation of prior work. Notably, they exhibit a strong preference for replacement edits, different from ground-truth patterns, and their effectiveness varies across CWE types. Furthermore, LLMs, particularly with VICS, outperform existing SOTA vulnerability generators with success rate improvements of up to 210\%-343\%. Crucially, the LLM-generated data substantially improves the performance of downstream DL-based vulnerability analysis models, especially with multi-line injections, boosting their accuracy by up to 70.1\%. The generated samples also enhance the effectiveness of other LLMs for vulnerability analysis via RAG, with multi-line-injected samples yielding up to 16.5\% gains. Most importantly, our findings reveal that, augmenting existing DL models with high-quality, LLM-generated data can lead to vulnerability analysis performance (up to 67.50\% accuracy) superior to that of even the most advanced LLMs performing the same analysis (up to 27.40\%), indicating the usefulness of the LLM-generated vulnerability data at present and in the longer term.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 数据驱动方法已被证明在漏洞分析方面具有前景，前提是有高质量和足够大的训练数据可用。若干专门的漏洞数据生成技术已展现出强大优势，但仅限于简单（单行注入引发）的漏洞，并且存在对种子样本的过拟合问题。大语言模型（LLMs）可能克服这些根本限制，因为它们在生成任务上已知很有效。然而，它们在生成易受攻击样本任务上的表现仍不清楚。本文中，我们通过提示探索了七种最先进（SOTA）LLMs在该任务上的潜力和差距。我们发现LLMs能够注入漏洞，采用高级提示策略，如少样本上下文学习和我们新的引入漏洞的代码变更语义（VICS）引导提示，可提升有效性，在合成数据集上达到高达93%的成功率，在真实世界代码上达到88%。LLMs能有效执行单行和多行注入，解决了先前工作的关键限制。值得注意的是，它们表现出对替换编辑的强烈偏好，不同于真实漏洞模式，且其有效性因CWE类型而异。此外，LLMs，尤其是结合VICS时，优于现有SOTA漏洞生成器，成功率提升高达210%-343%。关键的是，LLM生成的数据显著提升了下游基于深度学习的漏洞分析模型的性能，尤其是在多行注入下，将其准确率提升高达70.1%。生成的样本还通过RAG增强了其他LLMs进行漏洞分析的有效性，多行注入样本带来高达16.5%的增益。最重要的是，我们的发现表明，用高质量的LLM生成数据增强现有DL模型，可以使漏洞分析性能（高达67.50%准确率）优于甚至最先进的LLMs执行相同分析（高达27.40%），这表明LLM生成的漏洞数据在当前和长期内都有用。

import_candidates.title: RulePilot: An LLM-Powered Agent for Security Rule Generation
import_candidates.abstract: The real-time demand for system security leads to the detection rules becoming an integral part of the intrusion detection life-cycle. Rule-based detection often identifies malicious logs based on the predefined grammar logic, requiring experts with deep domain knowledge for rule generation. Therefore, automation of rule generation can result in significant time savings and ease the burden of rule-related tasks on security engineers. In this paper, we propose RulePilot, which mimics human expertise via LLM-based agent for addressing rule-related challenges like rule creation or conversion. Using RulePilot, the security analysts do not need to write down the rules following the grammar, instead, they can just provide the annotations such as the natural-language-based descriptions of a rule, our RulePilot can automatically generate the detection rules without more intervention. RulePilot is equipped with the intermediate representation (IR), which abstracts the complexity of config rules into structured, standardized formats, allowing LLMs to focus on generation rules in a more manageable and consistent way. We present a comprehensive evaluation of RulePilot in terms of textual similarity and execution success abilities, showcasing RulePilot can generate high-fidelity rules, outperforming the baseline models by up to 107.4\% in textual similarity to ground truths and achieving better detection accuracy in real-world execution tests. We perform a case study from our industry collaborators in Singapore, showcasing that RulePilot significantly help junior analysts/general users in the rule creation process.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 系统安全的实时需求使得检测规则成为入侵检测生命周期中不可或缺的一部分。基于规则的检测通常基于预定义的语法逻辑来识别恶意日志，需要具有深厚领域知识的专家来生成规则。因此，规则生成的自动化可以显著节省时间，并减轻安全工程师在规则相关任务上的负担。在本文中，我们提出RulePilot，它通过基于LLM的智能体来模拟人类专业知识，以应对规则创建或转换等规则相关挑战。使用RulePilot，安全分析师无需按照语法编写规则，只需提供注释，例如基于自然语言的规则描述，我们的RulePilot即可自动生成检测规则，无需更多干预。RulePilot配备了中间表示（IR），将配置规则的复杂性抽象为结构化、标准化的格式，使LLM能够以更可管理和一致的方式专注于生成规则。我们对RulePilot在文本相似性和执行成功能力方面进行了全面评估，展示出RulePilot能够生成高保真规则，在与真实值的文本相似性上比基线模型高出最多107.4%，并在真实世界执行测试中实现了更好的检测准确率。我们进行了来自新加坡行业合作者的案例研究，表明RulePilot在规则创建过程中显著帮助了初级分析师/普通用户。

import_candidates.title: BTreeFuzz: Enhanced Feedback Mechanism for ROS Program Fuzzer Based on Behavior Tree
import_candidates.abstract: Robots are increasingly taking on human roles and functions, and societal expectations for these machines to perform critical tasks and eliminate the problem of human error continue to rise. The robot operating system (ROS) is considered the de facto standard that has been widely used to develop robotic programs. However, even though robot malfunctions should be minimized, it remains highly challenging to develop ROS programs without software vulnerabilities. As a result, many ROS programs still contain software vulnerabilities that can lead to serious malfunctions. To address this concern, researchers have recently presented several fuzzing techniques to automatically detect these vulnerabilities in ROS programs. A feedback mechanism for fuzzing requires a specific metric tailored to the features of ROS programs. However, existing ROS program fuzzers have been unable to provide adequate feedback mechanisms to make this possible. For instance, ROFER, a state-of-the-art ROS program fuzzer, cannot correctly differentiate between multiple distinct robot statuses based on its feedback mechanism metric, and often mistakenly identifies identical statuses as being different from each other, making it ineffective at detecting unique crashes.In this paper, we propose a new ROS program fuzzer named BTreeFuzz, which incorporates a novel feedback mechanism metric. BTreeFuzz collects a behavior tree log to track the sequence of the robot’s executed tasks and their statuses. Based on the log, BTreeFuzz constructs a status graph that represents the robot’s state transitions and its status as dictated by the status graph. Using the degree of similarity between the status graphs, BTreeFuzz determines whether the corresponding inputs are interesting or not. Compared to other state-of-the-art ROS program fuzzers, BTreeFuzz differentiates robot statuses more precisely and detects 49.31\% more unique crashes per run on average. Finally, we present 35 bugs that BTreeFuzz found, 11 of which were previously unknown.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 机器人正越来越多地承担人类的角色和功能，社会对这些机器执行关键任务并消除人为错误问题的期望持续上升。机器人操作系统（ROS）被认为是事实上的标准，已广泛用于开发机器人程序。然而，尽管应尽可能减少机器人故障，但在没有软件漏洞的情况下开发ROS程序仍然极具挑战性。因此，许多ROS程序仍包含可能导致严重故障的软件漏洞。为解决这一问题，研究人员最近提出了几种模糊测试技术来自动检测ROS程序中的这些漏洞。模糊测试的反馈机制需要针对ROS程序特征量身定制的特定度量。然而，现有的ROS程序模糊测试器未能提供足够的反馈机制来实现这一点。例如，ROFER，一个最先进的ROS程序模糊测试器，无法根据其反馈机制度量正确区分多个不同的机器人状态，并且经常错误地将相同状态识别为彼此不同，从而无法有效检测独特的崩溃。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的ROS程序模糊测试器，名为BTreeFuzz，它结合了一种新颖的反馈机制度量。BTreeFuzz收集行为树日志以跟踪机器人执行任务及其状态的序列。基于该日志，BTreeFuzz构建状态图，表示机器人的状态转换及其状态，如状态图所示。使用状态图之间的相似度，BTreeFuzz确定相应输入是否有价值。与其他最先进的ROS程序模糊测试器相比，BTreeFuzz更精确地区分机器人状态，并且平均每次运行检测到的独特崩溃多49.31%。最后，我们展示了BTreeFuzz发现的35个缺陷，其中11个以前未知。

import_candidates.title: OctopusGuard: K-Line Enhanced Token Scam Detector Powered by Multimodal LLMs
import_candidates.abstract: Token scams in Decentralized Finance (DeFi) have become more sophisticated, shifting from simple contract exploits to behavior-driven fraud involving obfuscated code, abnormal fund flows, and deceptive market activity. While recent works leverage large language models (LLMs) for vulnerability detection, existing methods still depend on predefined patterns and lack deep semantic reasoning, limiting their ability to detect novel scams.In this paper, we present OctopusGuard, a unified multimodal detector for token scams, which includes three key contributions: (i) K-line information is, for the first time, introduced to token scam detection. A RAG-based knowledge base is constructed by combining K-line images from both benign and scam tokens to enhance training and reasoning. (ii) A novel, structured tool-augmented data chain-of-thought (structured CoT) is designed to integrate code, transaction data, and K-line images into a unified reasoning process. (iii) A multimodal fine-tuning pipeline that jointly trains on structured CoT to learn cross-modal correlations and enhance generalization across diverse scam strategies.We also construct a newly collected, labeled multimodal dataset of 1,495 recent token contracts and conduct extensive experiments. Results demonstrate that OctopusGuard significantly outperforms existing detectors and LLMs in detecting token scams, achieving an F1-score of 0.96.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 去中心化金融（DeFi）中的代币骗局日益复杂，从简单的合约漏洞利用转向涉及混淆代码、异常资金流和欺骗性市场活动的行为驱动型欺诈。虽然近期工作利用大语言模型（LLM）进行漏洞检测，现有方法仍依赖预定义模式，缺乏深度语义推理，限制了其检测新型骗局的能力。本文提出OctopusGuard，一个面向代币骗局的统一多模态检测器，包含三项关键贡献：（i）首次将K线信息引入代币骗局检测。通过结合良性代币和骗局代币的K线图像构建基于RAG的知识库，以增强训练和推理。（ii）设计了一种新颖的结构化工具增强数据思维链（结构化CoT），将代码、交易数据和K线图像整合到统一的推理过程中。（iii）提出多模态微调流程，在结构化CoT上联合训练，以学习跨模态关联并增强对不同骗局策略的泛化能力。我们还构建了一个新收集的、带标注的多模态数据集，包含1,495个近期代币合约，并进行了大量实验。结果表明，OctopusGuard在检测代币骗局方面显著优于现有检测器和LLM，F1分数达到0.96。

import_candidates.title: Attention Distance: A Novel Metric for Directed Fuzzing with Large Language Models
import_candidates.abstract: In the domain of software security testing, Directed Grey-Box Fuzzing (DGF) has garnered widespread attention for its efficient target localization and excellent detection performance. However, existing approaches measure only the physical distance between seed execution paths and target locations, overlooking logical relationships among code segments. This omission can yield redundant or misleading guidance in complex binaries, weakening DGF’s real-world effectiveness. To address this, we introduce attention distance, a novel metric that leverages a large language model’s contextual analysis to compute attention scores between code elements and reveal their intrinsic connections. Under the same AFLGo configuration—without altering any fuzzing components other than the distance metric—replacing physical distances with attention distances across 38 real vulnerability reproduction experiments delivers a 3.43{\texttimes} average increase in testing efficiency over the traditional method. Compared to state-of-the-art directed fuzzers DAFL and WindRanger, our approach achieves 2.89{\texttimes} and 7.13{\texttimes} improvements, respectively. To further validate the generalizability of attention distance, we integrate it into DAFL and WindRanger, where it also consistently enhances their original performance.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在软件安全测试领域，定向灰盒模糊测试（DGF）因其高效的目标定位和出色的检测性能而受到广泛关注。然而，现有方法仅度量种子执行路径与目标位置之间的物理距离，忽略了代码片段之间的逻辑关系。这种忽略可能在复杂二进制文件中产生冗余或误导性的引导，削弱DGF在实际中的有效性。为解决这一问题，我们引入了注意力距离，这是一种利用大语言模型的上下文分析来计算代码元素之间注意力分数并揭示其内在联系的新度量。在相同的AFLGo配置下——除距离度量外不改变任何模糊测试组件——将物理距离替换为注意力距离，在38个真实漏洞复现实验中，测试效率相比传统方法平均提升3.43倍。与当前最先进的定向模糊测试器DAFL和WindRanger相比，我们的方法分别实现了2.89倍和7.13倍的提升。为进一步验证注意力距离的泛化性，我们将其集成到DAFL和WindRanger中，也持续提升了它们的原有性能。

import_candidates.title: Out of Distribution, Out of Luck: How Well Can LLMs Trained on Vulnerability Datasets Detect Top 25 CWE Weaknesses?
import_candidates.abstract: Automated vulnerability detection research has made substantial progress, yet its real-world impact remains limited. Prior work found that current vulnerability datasets suffer from issues including label inaccuracy rates of 20\%-71\%, extensive duplication, and poor coverage of critical Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE). These issues create a significant “generalization gap” where models achieve misleading In-Distribution (ID) accuracies (testing on splits from the same dataset) by exploiting spurious correlations rather than learning true vulnerability patterns.To address these limitations, we present a three-part solution. First, we introduce BenchVul, which is a manually curated and balanced test dataset covering the MITRE Top 25 Most Dangerous CWEs, to enable fair model evaluation. Second, we construct a high-quality training dataset, TitanVul, comprising 38,548 functions by aggregating seven public sources and applying deduplication and validation using a novel multi-agent LLM pipeline. Third, we propose a Realistic Vulnerability Generation (RVG) pipeline, which synthesizes context-aware vulnerability examples for underrepresented but critical CWE types through simulated development workflows.Our evaluation reveals that In-Distribution (ID) performance does not reliably predict Out-of-Distribution (OOD) performance on BenchVul. For example, a model trained on BigVul achieves the highest 0.703 ID accuracy but fails on BenchVul’s real-world samples (0.493 OOD accuracy). Conversely, a model trained on our TitanVul achieves the highest OOD performance on both the real-world (0.881) and synthesized (0.785) portions of BenchVul, improving upon the next-best performing dataset by 5.3\% and 11.8\% respectively, despite a modest ID score (0.590). Augmenting TitanVul with our RVG further boosts this leading OOD performance, improving accuracy on real-world data by 5.8\% (to 0.932). Data is available at: https://github.com/yikun-li/TitanVul-BenchVul.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 自动化漏洞检测研究已取得实质性进展，但其实际影响仍然有限。先前工作发现，当前漏洞数据集存在标签不准确率20%-71%、大量重复以及关键常见弱点枚举（CWE）覆盖不足等问题。这些问题造成了显著的“泛化差距”，即模型通过利用虚假关联而非学习真实漏洞模式，在分布内（ID）测试（在同一数据集的划分上测试）上取得误导性的高准确率。为解决这些局限，我们提出三部分解决方案。第一，我们引入BenchVul，这是一个手动整理且平衡的测试数据集，覆盖MITRE Top 25最危险CWE，以支持公平的模型评估。第二，我们构建高质量训练数据集TitanVul，通过聚合七个公开来源并应用去重和验证（使用新颖的多智能体LLM流水线），包含38,548个函数。第三，我们提出真实漏洞生成（RVG）流水线，通过模拟开发工作流为代表性不足但关键的CWE类型合成上下文感知的漏洞示例。我们的评估表明，分布内（ID）性能不能可靠预测在BenchVul上的分布外（OOD）性能。例如，在BigVul上训练的模型达到最高的0.703 ID准确率，但在BenchVul的真实样本上失败（0.493 OOD准确率）。相反，在我们的TitanVul上训练的模型在BenchVul的真实世界部分（0.881）和合成部分（0.785）均取得最高的OOD性能，分别比次优数据集提高5.3%和11.8%，尽管ID分数一般（0.590）。用我们的RVG增强TitanVul进一步提升了这一领先的OOD性能，将真实数据上的准确率提高5.8%（达到0.932）。数据见：https://github.com/yikun-li/TitanVul-BenchVul。

import_candidates.title: Learning From Software Failures: A Case Study at a National Space Research Center
import_candidates.abstract: Software failures can have significant consequences, making learning from failures a critical aspect of software engineering. While software organizations are recommended to conduct postmortems to learn from failures, the effectiveness and adoption of these practices vary widely. Understanding how engineers gather, document, share, and apply lessons from failures is essential for improving software reliability and preventing recurring failures. High-reliability organizations (HROs) often develop software systems where failures carry catastrophic risks, requiring continuous learning practices to ensure reliability. These organizations provide a valuable setting to examine practices and challenges for learning from software failures. Such insight could help develop processes and tools to improve reliability and to prevent recurring failures. However, we lack in-depth industry perspectives on the practices and challenges of learning from failures.To address this gap, we conducted a case study through 10 in-depth interviews with research software engineers at a national space research center. We examine how they learn from failures: how they gather, document, share, and apply lessons learned. To assess the transferability of our findings, we include data from 5 additional interviews at other HROs. Our findings provide insight on how software engineers learn from failures in practice. To summarize our findings: (1) failure learning is informal, ad-hoc, and inconsistently integrated into SDLC; (2) recurring failures persist due to the absence of structured processes; and (3) key challenges, including time constraints, knowledge loss due to team turnover \& fragmented documentation, and weak process enforcement, undermine efforts to systematically learn from failures. Our findings contribute to a deeper understanding of how software engineers learn from failures and offer guidance for improving failure management practices.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 软件故障可能带来严重后果，因此从故障中学习是软件工程的一个关键方面。虽然建议软件组织进行事后分析以从故障中学习，但这些实践的有效性和采用情况差异很大。理解工程师如何收集、记录、分享和应用故障教训，对于提高软件可靠性和防止重复故障至关重要。高可靠性组织（HRO）通常开发的软件系统一旦发生故障会带来灾难性风险，因此需要持续学习实践来确保可靠性。这些组织为考察从软件故障中学习的实践和挑战提供了有价值的场景。这种洞察有助于开发流程和工具，以提高可靠性并防止重复故障。然而，我们缺乏关于从故障中学习的实践和挑战的深入行业视角。为弥补这一空白，我们通过对一家国家空间研究中心的研究软件工程师进行10次深度访谈，开展了一项案例研究。我们考察他们如何从故障中学习：如何收集、记录、分享和应用经验教训。为了评估我们发现的可转移性，我们还纳入了来自其他HRO的5次额外访谈数据。我们的发现提供了关于软件工程师在实践中如何从故障中学习的见解。总结我们的发现：(1)故障学习是非正式的、临时的，并且不一致地融入软件开发生命周期（SDLC）；(2)由于缺乏结构化流程，重复故障持续存在；(3)关键挑战，包括时间限制、团队更替和碎片化文档导致的知识流失，以及流程执行薄弱，削弱了系统化地从故障中学习的努力。我们的发现有助于更深入地理解软件工程师如何从故障中学习，并为改进故障管理实践提供指导。

import_candidates.title: WhisperCatcher: Demystifying Unauthorized and Encrypted Private Data Transmission in Android Applications
import_candidates.abstract: The privacy issues associated with Android apps are increasingly raising our concerns. Unfortunately, a large portion of privacy breaches in Android apps cannot be accurately detected by existing approaches, especially private data that is collected without consent and transmitted in encrypted form. Even if existing studies are able to break the encryption at protocol level to recover the structure and content of traffic packets, they are still unable to understand the code layer encrypted data. To solve this problem, we propose WhisperCatcher, an automated tool for analyzing unauthorized and encrypted private data transmitted by apps. For each app, WhisperCatcher first captures the raw traffic generated during the app’s startup phase, before the user consents to the privacy policy, and then extracts the semantic information. Furthermore, it utilizes the traffic semantics to guide static code analysis and extracts transmission-related key functions. Finally, it performs dynamic instrumentation analysis and recovers the encrypted data, thereby identifying unauthorized private data transmissions. Extensive evaluations show that WhisperCatcher significantly outperforms existing tools, and it achieves the recall of 91.38\% and F1-Score of 95.49\%, respectively. In addition, we conduct a large-scale measurement analysis on 14,879 apps and WhisperCatcher identifies 13,966 traffic flows from 4,966 apps that transmit private data prior to obtaining user consent, among which 3,838 (27.48\%) flows contain app-encrypted data. Our findings highlight the potential privacy leakage risks in Android apps, which should be brought to the attention of the community.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Android应用相关的隐私问题日益引起我们的关注。遗憾的是，现有方法无法准确检测Android应用中的大部分隐私泄露，尤其是未经同意收集并以加密形式传输的私有数据。即使现有研究能够在协议层面破解加密以恢复流量包的结构和内容，它们仍然无法理解代码层面的加密数据。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了WhisperCatcher，一种用于分析应用传输的未经授权且加密的私有数据的自动化工具。对于每个应用，WhisperCatcher首先捕获应用启动阶段（在用户同意隐私政策之前）生成的原始流量，然后提取语义信息。此外，它利用流量语义来指导静态代码分析，并提取与传输相关的关键函数。最后，它执行动态插桩分析并恢复加密数据，从而识别未经授权的私有数据传输。大量评估表明，WhisperCatcher显著优于现有工具，其召回率和F1分数分别达到91.38%和95.49%。此外，我们对14,879个应用进行了大规模测量分析，WhisperCatcher识别出来自4,966个应用的13,966条流量，这些流量在获得用户同意之前传输私有数据，其中3,838条（27.48%）流量包含应用加密数据。我们的发现凸显了Android应用中潜在的隐私泄露风险，应引起社区的关注。

import_candidates.title: Understanding DevOps Security of Google Workspace Apps
import_candidates.abstract: Cloud-based workspace systems, such as Google Workspace and Microsoft OneDrive, have enabled third-party developers to create and upload functionality-rich applications (referred to as add-ons). Existing studies have primarily examined user-centric data protection and permission management of this emerging ecosystem, but the underlying DevOps mechanisms that regulate add-on development, deployment, and operation remain largely unexplored.In this work, we conduct the first developer-centric investigation of these DevOps mechanisms. We propose a hybrid method that combines a static analysis to abstract development and integration (i.e., deployment) (Dev) models and a dynamic analysis to add-ons’ runtime operation workflows (Ops). It yields insights into the DevOps lifecycle of add-ons, unveiling associated attack surfaces and multiple types of security vulnerabilities, including source code leakage, code tampering and secret key exposure. Our large-scale evaluation of 5,300 Google Workspace add-ons reveals a concerning status quo of the ecosystem: 274 add-ons are subject to source code leakage, including widely-used ones with over 100,000 users. Among them, 96 (around one third) expose the secret keys of developers, e.g., PayPal merchant secret key and secret keys to access the developer’s back-end databases.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 基于云的工作空间系统，如 Google Workspace 和 Microsoft OneDrive，已使第三方开发者能够创建并上传功能丰富的应用程序（称为加载项）。现有研究主要考察了这一新兴生态系统中以用户为中心的数据保护和权限管理，但规范加载项开发、部署和运行的底层 DevOps 机制在很大程度上仍未被探索。在本工作中，我们首次对这些 DevOps 机制进行了以开发者为中心的调查。我们提出一种混合方法，结合静态分析来抽象开发和集成（即部署）（Dev）模型，以及动态分析来刻画加载项的运行时操作工作流（Ops）。这使我们深入了解加载项的 DevOps 生命周期，揭示相关的攻击面和多种类型的安全漏洞，包括源代码泄漏、代码篡改和密钥暴露。我们对 5,300 个 Google Workspace 加载项的大规模评估揭示了该生态系统令人担忧的现状：274 个加载项存在源代码泄漏，其中包括拥有超过 100,000 用户的广泛使用的加载项。其中，96 个（约三分之一）暴露了开发者的密钥，例如 PayPal 商家密钥以及访问开发者后端数据库的密钥。

import_candidates.title: LLM4JMH: Studying the Use of LLMs for Generating Java Performance Microbenchmarks
import_candidates.abstract: Performance regressions pose a significant threat to software reliability. In recent years, smaller-scale performance testing, such as performance microbenchmarks, has been adopted in practice to detect such regressions in an early stage of development. Developing these microbenchmarks is costly, error-prone, and demands specialized expertise. Motivated by the recent progress of large language models (LLMs) in code-related tasks, we study whether LLMs can step in as performance experts to automate the generation of microbenchmarks for performance regression detection. While existing approaches typically depend on functional unit tests to generate performance microbenchmarks, we instead design an LLM-based approach, LLM4JMH, to assess the capability of LLMs in generating reliable and effective performance microbenchmarks directly from source code. We further explore how program analysis techniques, such as static analysis, can enhance the reliability and effectiveness of LLM-generated performance microbenchmarks. Experimental results show that LLM-generated performance microbenchmarks achieve comparable bug detection effectiveness to expert-written microbenchmarks, while reducing overall expected detection latency by up to 52.60\% across RxJava, Eclipse Collections, and Zipkin. In the study, the generated tests can successfully identify six out of 11 real-world performance bugs in Apache Flink. These results demonstrate that LLM-based performance microbenchmark generation can automate early performance regression detection in continuous integration pipelines of the software development process and reduce reliance on expert-crafted tests, advancing performance-aware software engineering.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 性能回归对软件可靠性构成重大威胁。近年来，实践中已采用更小规模的性能测试，如性能微基准，以在开发早期阶段检测此类回归。开发这些微基准成本高昂、容易出错，并且需要专业知识。受大型语言模型（LLM）在代码相关任务上近期进展的启发，我们研究LLM能否作为性能专家，自动生成用于性能回归检测的微基准。现有方法通常依赖功能性单元测试来生成性能微基准，而我们则设计了一种基于LLM的方法LLM4JMH，以评估LLM直接从源代码生成可靠且有效的性能微基准的能力。我们进一步探索程序分析技术（如静态分析）如何增强LLM生成的性能微基准的可靠性和有效性。实验结果表明，LLM生成的性能微基准在缺陷检测有效性上与专家编写的微基准相当，同时在RxJava、Eclipse Collections和Zipkin上将总体预期检测延迟降低最多52.60%。在该研究中，生成的测试能够成功识别Apache Flink中11个真实世界性能缺陷中的6个。这些结果表明，基于LLM的性能微基准生成可以在软件开发过程的持续集成流水线中自动进行早期性能回归检测，并减少对专家手工编写测试的依赖，从而推进性能感知的软件工程。

import_candidates.title: Back to the Basics: Rethinking Issue-Commit Linking with LLM-Assisted Retrieval
import_candidates.abstract: Issue-commit linking, which connects issues with commits that fix them, is crucial for software maintenance. Existing approaches have shown promise in automatically recovering these links. Evaluations of these techniques assess their ability to identify genuine links from plausible but false links. However, these evaluations overlook the fact that, in reality, when a repository has more commits, the presence of more plausible yet unrelated commits may interfere with the tool in differentiating the correct fix commits. To address this, we propose the Realistic Distribution Setting (RDS) and use it to construct a more realistic evaluation dataset that includes 20 open-source projects. By evaluating tools on this dataset, we observe that the performance of the state-of-the-art deep learning-based approach drops by more than half, while the traditional Information Retrieval method, VSM, outperforms it.Inspired by these observations, we propose EasyLink, which utilizes a vector database as a modern Information Retrieval technique.
