To address the long-standing problem of the semantic gap between issues and commits, EasyLink leverages a large language model to rerank the commits retrieved from the database. Under our evaluation, EasyLink achieves an average Precision@1 of 75.03\%, improving over the state-of-the-art by over four times. Additionally, this paper provides practical guidelines for advancing research in issue-commit link recovery.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 问题-提交链接（将问题与修复它们的提交关联起来）对于软件维护至关重要。现有方法在自动恢复这些链接方面已显示出前景。对这些技术的评估衡量的是它们从看似合理但错误的链接中识别真实链接的能力。然而，这些评估忽略了一个事实：在现实中，当一个仓库拥有更多提交时，更多看似合理但不相关的提交的存在可能会干扰工具区分正确修复提交。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了现实分布设置（RDS），并用它构建了一个更现实的评估数据集，包含20个开源项目。通过在该数据集上评估工具，我们观察到最先进的基于深度学习的方法性能下降了一半以上，而传统的信息检索方法VSM则优于它。受这些观察启发，我们提出了EasyLink，它利用向量数据库作为现代信息检索技术。为了解决问题与提交之间长期存在的语义鸿沟问题，EasyLink利用大型语言模型对从数据库中检索到的提交进行重排序。在我们的评估中，EasyLink实现了平均 Precision@1 为75.03\%，比最先进的方法提高了四倍以上。此外，本文为推进问题-提交链接恢复研究提供了实践指南。

import_candidates.title: Decades of GNU Patch and Git Cherry-Pick: Can We Do Better?
import_candidates.abstract: Patching is a fundamental software maintenance and evolution task enabling the (semi-)automated propagation of changes across different software versions. Established and widely used language-agnostic patchers, such as GNU patch and Git cherry-pick, work on textual artifact representations (i.e., text files) and typically rely on line numbers and contexts (i.e., surrounding unchanged text fragments) to apply changes. This strategy often fails if source and target of a patch differ, provoking cumbersome manual effort. In this paper, we study the effectiveness of commonly-used patchers, and propose a novel technique that significantly increases patch automation. First, we curate and analyze a large dataset of more than 400000 patch scenarios (i.e., cherry picks) from 5000 GitHub projects. Next, we examine the effectiveness of established patchers on the gathered patch scenarios. Third, we develop a novel language-agnostic patch technique, mpatch, that utilizes a source-to-target matching to determine suitable change locations. By comparing mpatch to other patchers, we find that it can correctly apply 44\% more patches automatically than other language-agnostic patchers, while it also requires fewer manual fixes in cases that cannot be automated completely. Thus, mpatch considerably reduces the burden of manually fixing failed patches in practice, specifically in projects with frequent patch applications.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 打补丁是一项基础的软件维护和演化任务，能够（半）自动地在不同软件版本之间传播变更。已有的、被广泛使用的语言无关补丁工具，如 GNU patch 和 Git cherry-pick，基于文本工件表示（即文本文件）工作，并且通常依赖行号和上下文（即周围未变更的文本片段）来应用变更。当补丁的源和目标不同时，这种策略常常失败，引发繁琐的手工工作。在本文中，我们研究常用补丁工具的有效性，并提出一种新技术，显著提高补丁自动化程度。首先，我们整理并分析了来自 5000 个 GitHub 项目的超过 400000 个补丁场景（即 cherry pick）的大型数据集。其次，我们在收集到的补丁场景上检验已有补丁工具的有效性。第三，我们开发了一种新颖的语言无关补丁技术 mpatch，它利用源到目标的匹配来确定合适的变更位置。通过将 mpatch 与其他补丁工具进行比较，我们发现它能够自动正确应用比其他语言无关补丁工具多 44% 的补丁，同时在无法完全自动化的情况下需要更少的手工修复。因此，mpatch 在实践中显著减少了修复失败补丁的负担，特别是在频繁应用补丁的项目中。

import_candidates.title: SeRe: A Security-Related Code Review Dataset Aligned with Real-World Review Activities
import_candidates.abstract: Software security vulnerabilities can lead to severe consequences, making early detection essential. Although code review serves as a critical defense mechanism against security flaws, relevant feedback remains scarce due to limited attention to security issues or a lack of expertise among reviewers. Existing datasets and studies primarily focus on general-purpose code review comments, either lacking security-specific annotations or being too limited in scale to support large-scale research. To bridge this gap, we introduce SeRe, a security-related code review dataset, constructed using an active learning-based ensemble classification approach. The proposed approach iteratively refines model predictions through human annotations, achieving high precision while maintaining reasonable recall. Using the fine-tuned ensemble classifier, we extracted 6,732 security-related reviews from 373,824 raw review instances, ensuring representativeness across multiple programming languages. Statistical analysis indicates that SeRe generally aligns with real-world security-related review distribution. To assess both the utility of SeRe and the effectiveness of existing code review comment generation approaches, we benchmark state-of-the-art approaches on security-related feedback generation. By releasing SeRe along with our benchmark results, we aim to advance research in automated security-focused code review and contribute to the development of more effective secure software engineering practices.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 软件安全漏洞可能导致严重后果，因此早期检测至关重要。尽管代码评审是防御安全缺陷的关键机制，但由于对安全问题的关注有限或评审者缺乏专业知识，相关反馈仍然稀缺。现有数据集和研究主要关注通用代码评审评论，要么缺乏安全特定标注，要么规模太有限，无法支持大规模研究。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了 SeRe，一个安全相关代码评审数据集，采用基于主动学习的集成分类方法构建。所提方法通过人工标注迭代地改进模型预测，在保持合理召回率的同时实现高精度。使用微调后的集成分类器，我们从 373,824 条原始评审实例中提取了 6,732 条安全相关评审，确保在多种编程语言中具有代表性。统计分析表明，SeRe 总体上与现实世界安全相关评审分布一致。为了评估 SeRe 的实用性以及现有代码评审评论生成方法的有效性，我们在安全相关反馈生成任务上对最先进方法进行了基准测试。通过发布 SeRe 及其基准测试结果，我们旨在推动自动化安全聚焦代码评审的研究，并促进更有效的安全软件工程实践的发展。

import_candidates.title: Actionable Warning Is Not Enough: Recommending Valid Actionable Warnings with Weak Supervision
import_candidates.abstract: The use of static analysis tools has gained increasing popularity among developers in the last few years. However, the widespread adoption of static analysis tools is hindered by their high false alarm rates (up to 90\%). Previous studies have introduced the concept of actionable warnings and built machine-learning method to distinguish actionable warnings from false alarms. However, according to our empirical observation, the current assumption used for actionable warning(s) collection is rather shaky and inaccurate, leading to a large number of invalid actionable warnings. To address this problem, in this study, we build the first large actionable warning dataset by mining 68,274 reversions from Top-500 GitHub C repositories, we then take one step further by assigning each actionable warning a weak label regarding its likelihood of being a real bug. Following that, we propose a two-stage framework called ACWRecommender to automatically recommend the actionable warnings with high probability to be real bugs (AWHB). Our approach warms up the pre-trained model UniXcoder by identifying actionable warnings task (coarse-grained detection stage) and rerank AWHB to the top by weakly supervised learning (fine-grained reranking stage). Experimental results show that our proposed model outperforms several baselines by a large margin in terms of nDCG and MRR for AWHB recommendation. Moreover, we ran our tool on 6 randomly selected projects and manually checked the top-ranked warnings from 2,197 reported warnings, we reported top-10 recommended warnings to developers, 27 of them were already confirmed by developers as real bugs. Developers can quickly find real bugs among the massive amount of reported warnings, which verifies the practical usage of our tool.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 近年来，静态分析工具的使用在开发者中越来越流行。然而，静态分析工具的高误报率（高达90%）阻碍了它们的广泛采用。先前的研究引入了可操作警告的概念，并构建了机器学习方法来区分可操作警告和误报。然而，根据我们的实证观察，当前用于收集可操作警告的假设相当不可靠且不准确，导致大量无效的可操作警告。为了解决这个问题，在本研究中，我们通过挖掘Top-500 GitHub C仓库中的68,274次回滚，构建了第一个大型可操作警告数据集；我们进一步为每个可操作警告分配一个关于其成为真实缺陷可能性的弱标签。随后，我们提出了一个名为ACWRecommender的两阶段框架，以自动推荐高概率为真实缺陷的可操作警告（AWHB）。我们的方法通过识别可操作警告任务（粗粒度检测阶段）来预热预训练模型UniXcoder，并通过弱监督学习（细粒度重排序阶段）将AWHB重排到顶部。实验结果表明，我们提出的模型在AWHB推荐的nDCG和MRR方面大幅优于几个基线。此外，我们在6个随机选择的项目上运行了我们的工具，并人工检查了2,197条报告警告中排名靠前的警告；我们向开发者报告了前10条推荐警告，其中27条已被开发者确认为真实缺陷。开发者可以在大量报告警告中快速找到真实缺陷，这验证了我们工具的实用性。

import_candidates.title: MINES: Explainable Anomaly Detection through Web API Invariant Inference
import_candidates.abstract: Detecting the anomalies of web applications, important infrastructures for running modern companies and governments, is crucial for providing reliable web services. Many modern web applications operate on web APIs (e.g., RESTful, SOAP, and WebSockets), their exposure invites intended attacks or unintended illegal visits, causing abnormal system behaviors. However, such anomalies can share very similar logs (sometimes even identical logs) with normal logs, missing crucial information (which could be in database) for log discrimination. Further, log instances can be also noisy, which can further mislead the state-of-the-art log learning solutions to learn spurious correlation, resulting superficial models and rules for anomaly detection.In this work, we propose MINES which infers explainable API invariants for anomaly detection from the schema level instead of detailed raw log instances, which can (1) significantly discriminate noise in logs to identify precise normalities and (2) detect abnormal behaviors beyond the instrumented logs (e.g., regarding the database state or session state). Our learned invariants can capture API preconditions such as (1) “what is the legitimate database state to initiate the call events?” and (2) “what are the constraints to satisfy between different API calls?”. Then we translate the invariants into executable Python code to verify its consistency with the runtime logs. Technically, MINES (1) converts API signatures into table schema to enhance the original database shema; and (2) infers the potential database constraints (such as reference constraint and check constraints) on the enhanced database schema to capture the potential relationships between APIs and database tables. MINES uses LLM for extracting potential relationship based on two given table structures; and use normal log instances to reject and accept LLM-generated invariants. Finally, MINES translates the inferred constraints into invariants to generate Python code for verifying the runtime logs. We extensively evaluate MINES on web-tamper attacks on the benchmarks of Train-Ticket, NiceFish, Gitea, Mastodon, and NextCloud against baselines such as LogRobust, LogFormer, and WebNorm. The results show that MINES achieves high recall (more than 14\% over LogRobust, LogFormer, and WebNorm) for the anomalies while introducing almost zero false positives, indicating a new state-of-the-art.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 检测Web应用程序（运行现代公司和政府的重要基础设施）的异常对于提供可靠的Web服务至关重要。许多现代Web应用程序基于Web API（例如RESTful、SOAP和WebSockets）运行，它们的暴露会招致有意攻击或无意非法访问，导致系统行为异常。然而，此类异常可能与正常日志共享非常相似的日志（有时甚至完全相同），并且可能缺少用于日志区分的关键信息（这些信息可能位于数据库中）。此外，日志实例还可能存在噪声，这会进一步误导最先进的日志学习解决方案学习到虚假关联，从而产生用于异常检测的肤浅模型和规则。在这项工作中，我们提出MINES，它从模式层面而非详细的原始日志实例推断可解释的API不变量以进行异常检测，从而能够（1）显著区分日志中的噪声以识别精确的正常性，并且（2）检测超出插桩日志范围的异常行为（例如，关于数据库状态或会话状态）。我们学习到的不变量可以捕获API前置条件，例如（1）“什么是启动调用事件的合法数据库状态？”以及（2）“不同API调用之间需要满足哪些约束？”。然后，我们将这些不变量转换为可执行的Python代码，以验证其与运行时日志的一致性。在技术上，MINES（1）将API签名转换为表模式，以增强原始数据库模式；（2）在增强的数据库模式上推断潜在的数据库约束（如引用约束和检查约束），以捕获API与数据库表之间的潜在关系。MINES使用LLM基于两个给定的表结构提取潜在关系；并使用正常日志实例来拒绝和接受LLM生成的不变量。最后，MINES将推断出的约束转换为不变量，以生成用于验证运行时日志的Python代码。我们在Train-Ticket、NiceFish、Gitea、Mastodon和NextCloud基准上的Web篡改攻击中，针对LogRobust、LogFormer和WebNorm等基线对MINES进行了广泛评估。结果表明，MINES在异常检测方面实现了高召回率（比LogRobust、LogFormer和WebNorm高出14%以上），同时几乎不引入误报，表明达到了新的最先进水平。

import_candidates.title: Diffploit: Facilitating Cross-Version Exploit Migration for Open Source Library Vulnerabilities
import_candidates.abstract: Exploits are commonly used to demonstrate the presence of library vulnerabilities and validate their impact across different versions. However, their direct application to alternative versions often fails due to breaking changes introduced during evolution. These failures stem from both changes in triggering conditions (e.g., API refactorings) and broken dynamic environments (e.g., build or runtime errors), which are challenging to interpret and adapt manually. Existing techniques primarily focus on code-level trace alignment through fuzzing, which is both time-consuming and insufficient for handling environment-level failures. Moreover, they often fall short when dealing with complicated triggering condition changes across versions. To overcome this, we propose Diffploit, an iterative, diff-driven exploit migration method structured around two key modules: the Context Module and the Migration Module. The Context Module constructs contexts derived from analyzing behavioral discrepancies between the target and reference versions, which capture the failure symptom and its related diff hunks. Leveraging these contexts, the Migration Module guides an LLM-based adaptation through an iterative feedback loop, balancing exploration of diff candidates and gradual refinement to resolve reproduction failures effectively. We evaluate Diffploit on a large-scale dataset containing 102 Java CVEs and 689 version-migration tasks across 79 libraries. Diffploit successfully migrates 84.2\% exploits, outperforming the change-aware test repair tool TaRGET by 52.0\% and the rule-based tool in IDEA by 61.6\%. Beyond technical effectiveness, Diffploit identifies 5 CVE reports with incorrect affected version ranges, three of which have been confirmed. We also discover 111 unreported versions in GitHub Advisory Database.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 漏洞利用通常被用来证明库漏洞的存在并验证其在不同版本中的影响。然而，由于演化过程中引入的破坏性变更，它们直接应用于其他版本时往往会失败。这些失败源于触发条件的变化（例如API重构）和动态环境损坏（例如构建或运行时错误），这些变化难以解释且手动适配颇具挑战。现有技术主要关注通过模糊测试进行代码级轨迹对齐，这既耗时又不足以处理环境级失败。此外，它们往往难以应对跨版本复杂的触发条件变化。为克服这一问题，我们提出Diffploit，一种迭代的、差异驱动（diff-driven）的漏洞利用迁移方法，围绕两个关键模块构建：上下文模块和迁移模块。上下文模块通过分析目标版本与参考版本之间的行为差异来构建上下文，这些上下文捕获失败症状及其相关的差异块（diff hunks）。利用这些上下文，迁移模块通过迭代反馈循环引导基于LLM的适配，平衡对差异候选的探索与逐步细化，以有效解决复现失败。我们在一个包含102个Java CVE和跨79个库的689个版本迁移任务的大规模数据集上评估Diffploit。Diffploit成功迁移了84.2%的漏洞利用，分别比变更感知测试修复工具TaRGET和IDEA中的基于规则工具高出52.0%和61.6%。除技术有效性外，Diffploit还识别出5份受影响版本范围错误的CVE报告，其中三份已得到确认。我们还在GitHub Advisory Database中发现了111个未报告的版本。

import_candidates.title: Minimizing Breaking Changes and Redundancy in Mitigating Technical Lag for Java Projects
import_candidates.abstract: Re-using open-source software (OSS) can avoid reinventing the wheel, but failing to keep it up-to-date can lead to missing new features and persistent bugs or vulnerabilities that have already been resolved. The use of outdated OSS libraries introduces technical lag, necessitating timely upgrades. However, maintaining up-to-date libraries is challenging, as it may introduce incompatibility issues that break the project or redundant dependencies that unnecessarily increase the size of the project. These issues discourage developers from upgrading libraries, highlighting the need for a fully automated solution that balances version upgrades, reduces technical lag, ensures compatibility, and avoids redundant dependencies.To this end, we propose DepUpdater, which ensures that upgrades minimize technical lag as much as possible while avoiding incompatibility issues and redundant dependencies. The comparison with existing dependency management tools demonstrates that DepUpdater more effectively reduces technical lag while ensuring compatibility and pruning redundant dependencies. Additionally, an ablation study highlights the potential benefits of considering pruning requirements during upgrades to mitigate incompatibility issues. Finally, leveraging DepUpdater, we investigate the impact of transitive dependency upgrades on client compatibility, providing insights for future research.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 复用开源软件（OSS）可以避免重复造轮子，但未能保持其更新可能导致错过新功能以及遗留本已解决的错误或漏洞。使用过时的OSS库会引入技术滞后，因此需要及时升级。然而，维护最新的库具有挑战性，因为它可能引入破坏项目的不兼容问题，或引入不必要地增大项目规模的冗余依赖。这些问题阻碍开发者升级库，凸显了对一种完全自动化解决方案的需求，该方案需权衡版本升级、减少技术滞后、确保兼容性并避免冗余依赖。为此，我们提出了DepUpdater，它确保升级尽可能减少技术滞后，同时避免不兼容问题和冗余依赖。与现有依赖管理工具的对比表明，DepUpdater在确保兼容性和修剪冗余依赖的同时，更有效地减少了技术滞后。此外，消融研究强调了在升级过程中考虑修剪需求以缓解不兼容问题的潜在好处。最后，利用DepUpdater，我们研究了传递依赖升级对客户端兼容性的影响，为未来研究提供了见解。

import_candidates.title: Remediating Superfluous Re-Rendering in React Applications
import_candidates.abstract: React is an extremely popular framework for constructing user interfaces (UIs). A React UI is organized as a tree of components, each of which is defined by a function that returns a literal written in JSX, a syntactic extension of JavaScript consisting of a combination of XML tags, executable JavaScript code, and references to sub-components. React supports incremental re-rendering by maintaining an in-memory representation of a web page’s Document Object Model (DOM) and automatically calculating a set of minimal changes that must be applied to the DOM when state changes occur.However, React’s semantics are complex and subtle, and programmers often write code that gives rise to unnecessary re-rendering, which hurts performance and responsiveness. We identify 5 React anti-patterns that give rise to unnecessary re-rendering, present a static analysis for detecting them, and rewrite rules that suggest how to refactor the code to improve rendering performance. The static analysis is potentially unsound, so developers should carefully review the suggested refactorings. A survey of 7,758 React repositories showed that 92.1\% of them exhibit at least one anti-pattern, and careful experimental evaluation on 23 React projects revealed that the suggested refactoring reduces the number of rendering operations by 33.3\% on average while preserving application behavior in all but one case. With a small increase in code complexity, we find an average reduction in rendering time of 20.54\%, and three case studies reveal that the refactorings can greatly improve application responsiveness as the number of components scales.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: React 是构建用户界面（UI）极为流行的框架。一个 React UI 组织为组件树，每个组件由一个函数定义，该函数返回用 JSX 编写的字面量，JSX 是 JavaScript 的语法扩展，由 XML 标签、可执行 JavaScript 代码以及对子组件的引用组合而成。React 通过维护网页文档对象模型（DOM）的内存表示，并在状态变化时自动计算必须应用于 DOM 的最小变更集，从而支持增量重渲染。然而，React 的语义复杂而微妙，程序员经常编写导致不必要重渲染的代码，这损害性能和响应性。我们识别出 5 种导致不必要重渲染的 React 反模式，提出一种检测它们的静态分析，以及建议如何重构代码以改善渲染性能的重写规则。该静态分析可能是不可靠的，因此开发者应仔细审查建议的重构。对 7,758 个 React 仓库的调查显示，92.1% 的仓库至少表现出一种反模式，而对 23 个 React 项目的仔细实验评估表明，建议的重构平均将渲染操作数量减少 33.3%，同时在除一例之外的所有情况下保持应用行为。随着代码复杂度的略微增加，我们发现渲染时间平均减少 20.54%，并且三个案例研究表明，随着组件数量的扩展，这些重构可以极大地提高应用响应性。

import_candidates.title: HistoryFinder: Advancing Method-Level Source Code History Generation with Accurate Oracles and Enhanced Algorithm
import_candidates.abstract: Reconstructing a method’s change history efficiently and accurately is critical for many software engineering tasks, including maintenance, refactoring, and comprehension. Despite the availability of method history generation tools such as CodeShovel and CodeTracker, existing evaluations of their effectiveness are limited by inaccuracies in the ground truth oracles used. In this study, we systematically construct two new oracles—the corrected CodeShovel oracle and a newly developed HistoryFinder oracle—by combining automated analysis with expert-guided manual validation. We also introduce HistoryFinder, a new method history generation tool designed to improve not only the accuracy and completeness of method change histories but also to offer competitive runtime performance. Through extensive evaluation across 400 methods from 40 open-source repositories, we show that HistoryFinder consistently outperforms CodeShovel, CodeTracker, IntelliJ, and Git-based baselines in terms of precision, recall, and F1 score. Moreover, HistoryFinder achieves competitive runtime performance, offering the lowest mean and median execution times among all the research-based tools. While Git-based tools exhibit the fastest runtimes, this efficiency comes at the cost of significantly lower precision and recall—leaving HistoryFinder as the best overall choice when both accuracy and efficiency are important. To facilitate adoption, we provide a web interface, CLI, and Java library for flexible usage.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 高效且准确地重建方法的变更历史对于许多软件工程任务至关重要，包括维护、重构和理解。尽管已有 CodeShovel 和 CodeTracker 等方法历史生成工具，但现有对其有效性的评估受限于所用真实基准（oracle）的不准确。在本研究中，我们通过结合自动分析与专家指导的人工验证，系统性地构建了两个新基准——修正后的 CodeShovel 基准和新开发的 HistoryFinder 基准。我们还提出了 HistoryFinder，一种新的方法历史生成工具，不仅旨在提高方法变更历史的准确性和完整性，还提供有竞争力的运行时性能。通过对来自 40 个开源代码库的 400 个方法进行广泛评估，我们表明 HistoryFinder 在精确率、召回率和 F1 分数上始终优于 CodeShovel、CodeTracker、IntelliJ 以及基于 Git 的基线。此外，HistoryFinder 实现了有竞争力的运行时性能，在所有基于研究的工具中具有最低的平均和中位执行时间。虽然基于 Git 的工具运行时间最快，但这种效率以显著较低的精确率和召回率为代价——这使得 HistoryFinder 在准确性和效率都很重要时成为最佳整体选择。为便于采用，我们提供了 Web 界面、CLI 和 Java 库，以支持灵活使用。

import_candidates.title: Using a Sledgehammer to Crack a Nut? Revisiting Automated Compiler Fault Isolation
import_candidates.abstract: Background: Compilers are fundamental to software development, translating high-level source code into executable software systems. Faults in compilers can have severe consequences and thus effective localization and resolution of compiler bugs are crucial. Problem: In practice, developers often examine version history to identify and investigate bug-inducing commit (BIC) for fixing bugs. However, while numerous sophisticated Spectrum-Based Fault Localization (SBFL) techniques have been proposed for compiler fault isolation, their effectiveness has not been evaluated against the BIC-based strategies widely adopted in practice. Objective: This study aims to bridge this gap by directly comparing a BIC-based strategy, called Basic, with representative SBFL-based compiler fault isolation techniques. The BIC-based strategy closely aligns with common developer practices, as it directly identifies the BIC and treats the files modified in that commit as faulty candidates. Method: Basic  strategy identifies the most recent good release and earliest bad release, and then employs a binary search to pinpoint the bug-inducing commit. All files modified in the identified commit are flagged as potentially faulty. We rigorously compare Basic against SBFL techniques using a benchmark consisting of 60 GCC bugs and 60 LLVM bugs. Result: Our analysis reveals that Basic generally outperforms state-of-the-art SBFL techniques on the critical Top-1 and Top-5 ranking metrics. Conclusion: This study provides new insights into the practical effectiveness of SBFL techniques in real-world compiler debugging scenarios. We recommend that future research adopt Basic as a baseline when developing and evaluating new compiler fault isolation methods.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 背景：编译器是软件开发的基础，将高级源代码转换为可执行的软件系统。编译器中的故障可能产生严重后果，因此有效定位和解决编译器缺陷至关重要。问题：在实践中，开发者通常检查版本历史以识别和调查引入缺陷的提交（BIC）来修复缺陷。然而，尽管已经提出了许多用于编译器故障隔离的复杂基于频谱的故障定位（SBFL）技术，它们的有效性尚未与实践中广泛采用的基于BIC的策略进行评估。目标：本研究旨在通过直接比较一种基于BIC的策略（称为Basic）与代表性的基于SBFL的编译器故障隔离技术来弥合这一差距。基于BIC的策略与常见开发者实践紧密一致，因为它直接识别BIC，并将该提交中修改的文件视为故障候选。方法：Basic策略识别最近的良好版本和最早的坏版本，然后采用二分搜索来定位引入缺陷的提交。所识别提交中修改的所有文件都被标记为可能故障。我们使用包含60个GCC缺陷和60个LLVM缺陷的基准，严格比较Basic与SBFL技术。结果：我们的分析表明，在关键的Top-1和Top-5排名指标上，Basic通常优于最先进的SBFL技术。结论：本研究为SBFL技术在实际编译器调试场景中的实际有效性提供了新见解。我们建议未来研究在开发和评估新的编译器故障隔离方法时采用Basic作为基线。

import_candidates.title: CodeMapper: A Language-Agnostic Approach to Mapping Code Regions Across Commits
import_candidates.abstract: During software evolution, developers commonly face the problem of mapping a specific code region from one commit to another. For example, they may want to determine how the condition of an if-statement, a specific line in a configuration file, or the definition of a function changes. We call this the code mapping problem. Existing techniques, such as git diff, address this problem only insufficiently because they show all changes made to a file instead of focusing on a code region of the developer’s choice. Other techniques focus on specific code elements and programming languages (e.g., methods in Java), limiting their applicability. This paper introduces CodeMapper, an approach to address the code mapping problem in a way that is independent of specific program elements and programming languages. Given a code region in one commit, CodeMapper finds the corresponding region in another commit. The approach consists of two phases: (i) computing candidate regions by analyzing diffs, detecting code movements, and searching for specific code fragments, and (ii) selecting the most likely target region by calculating similarities. Our evaluation applies CodeMapper to four datasets, including two new hand-annotated datasets containing code region pairs in ten popular programming languages. CodeMapper correctly identifies the expected target region in 71.0\%–94.5\% of all cases, improving over the best available baselines by 1.5–58.8 absolute percent points.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在软件演化过程中，开发者通常面临将一个特定代码区域从一个提交映射到另一个提交的问题。例如，他们可能想要确定if语句的条件、配置文件中的特定行或函数定义是如何变化的。我们称此为代码映射问题。现有技术（如git diff）仅不充分地解决此问题，因为它们显示对文件所做的所有更改，而不是聚焦于开发者所选择的代码区域。其他技术则聚焦于特定的代码元素和编程语言（例如Java中的方法），限制了其适用性。本文介绍了CodeMapper，一种以独立于特定程序元素和编程语言的方式解决代码映射问题的方法。给定一个提交中的代码区域，CodeMapper在另一个提交中找到对应的区域。该方法包括两个阶段：(i) 通过分析差异、检测代码移动和搜索特定代码片段来计算候选区域；(ii) 通过计算相似度来选择最可能的目标区域。我们的评估将CodeMapper应用于四个数据集，包括两个新的手动标注数据集，其中包含十种流行编程语言中的代码区域对。CodeMapper在所有案例中正确识别预期目标区域的比例为71.0%–94.5%，比最佳可用基线提高了1.5–58.8个绝对百分点。

import_candidates.title: The State of Open Science in Software Engineering Research: A Case Study of ICSE Artifacts
import_candidates.abstract: Replication packages are crucial for enabling transparency, validation, and reuse in software engineering (SE) research. While artifact sharing is now a standard practice and even expected at premier SE venues such as ICSE, the practical usability of these replication packages remain underexplored. In particular, there is a marked lack of studies that comprehensively examine the executability and reproducibility of replication packages in SE research. In this paper, we aim to fill this gap by evaluating 100 replication packages published in ICSE proceedings over the past decade (2015–2024). We assess the (1) executability of the replication packages, (2) efforts and modifications required to execute them, (3) challenges that prevent executability, and (4) reproducibility of the original findings for those that are executable. We spent approximately 650 person-hours in total to execute the artifacts and reproduce the study findings. Our analysis shows that only 40 of the 100 evaluated artifacts were fully executable. Among these, 32.5\% ran without any modification. However, even executable artifacts required varying levels of effort: 17.5\% required low effort, while 82.5\% required moderate to high effort to execute successfully. We identified five common types of modifications and 13 challenges that lead to execution failure, encompassing environmental, documentation, and structural issues. Among the executable artifacts, only 35\% (14 out of 40) reproduced the original results. These findings highlight a notable gap between artifact availability, executability, and reproducibility. Our study proposes three actionable guidelines to improve the preparation, documentation, and review of research artifacts, thereby strengthening the rigor and sustainability of open science practices in SE research.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 复制包对于在软件工程（SE）研究中实现透明度、验证和重用至关重要。尽管工件共享如今已成为标准实践，甚至在ICSE等顶级SE会议上被期望，但这些复制包的实际可用性仍然未被充分探索。特别是，缺乏全面考察SE研究中复制包的可执行性和可复现性的研究。在本文中，我们旨在填补这一空白，评估过去十年（2015–2024）在ICSE会议录中发表的100个复制包。我们评估(1)复制包的可执行性，(2)执行它们所需的工作量和修改，(3)阻碍可执行性的挑战，以及(4)对于那些可执行的包，原始发现的可复现性。我们总共花费了约650人时来执行这些工件并复现研究结果。我们的分析显示，100个被评估工件中只有40个完全可执行。其中，32.5%无需任何修改即可运行。然而，即使可执行的工件也需要不同程度的工作量：17.5%需要低工作量，而82.5%需要中到高工作量才能成功执行。我们识别出五种常见的修改类型和13种导致执行失败的挑战，涵盖环境、文档和结构问题。在可执行工件中，只有35%（40个中的14个）复现了原始结果。这些发现突显了工件可用性、可执行性和可复现性之间的显著差距。我们的研究提出了三项可操作指南，以改进研究工件的准备、文档和评审，从而加强SE研究中开放科学实践的严谨性和可持续性。

import_candidates.title: CRUDinfer: Automated CRUD Semantics Inference for REST APIs Through Black-box Testing
import_candidates.abstract: REST APIs are the de facto standard for web service interaction, praised for flexibility and simplicity of adoption. Nevertheless, the lack of mandatory implementation guidelines for REST APIs has led to the diffusion of poor-quality and difficult-to-maintain web services. A key concern in this context is the misuse of CRUD (Create, Read, Update, and Delete) semantics of API operations. While best practices suggest mapping CRUD verbs to HTTP methods (POST, GET, PUT/PATCH, and DELETE, respectively), many implementations fail to adhere to such a guideline. This common anti-pattern makes interaction with the API ambiguous, hindering maintainability and decreasing the effectiveness of automated REST API testing.In this paper, we propose CRUDinfer, a novel approach to automatically infer REST API operation CRUD semantics by leveraging (black-box) interactions with the API. The approach incrementally refines the knowledge about API operations’ CRUD semantics via CRUD test scenarios. Specifically, it employs interaction patterns typical of each CRUD semantics verb to craft test scenarios (i.e., HTTP interactions) for API operations with the aim of confirming their semantics. Testing failures indicate a mismatch between the intended CRUD semantics and the actual implementation. Thus, it refines API operations’ CRUD semantics knowledge through improved test scenarios. Empirical evaluation indicates high inference capabilities for CRUDinfer, with an overall precision higher than 95\% on the considered benchmark REST APIs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: REST API是Web服务交互的事实标准，因其灵活性和易于采用而备受赞誉。然而，REST API缺乏强制性实现指南，导致低质量和难以维护的Web服务泛滥。一个关键问题是API操作中CRUD（创建、读取、更新和删除）语义的误用。虽然最佳实践建议将CRUD动词映射到HTTP方法（分别为POST、GET、PUT/PATCH和DELETE），但许多实现未能遵循这一准则。这种常见的反模式使API交互变得模糊，妨碍了可维护性并降低了自动化REST API测试的有效性。在本文中，我们提出了CRUDinfer，一种通过利用与API的（黑盒）交互来自动推断REST API操作CRUD语义的新方法。该方法通过CRUD测试场景逐步细化关于API操作CRUD语义的知识。具体来说，它采用每种CRUD语义动词典型的交互模式，为API操作设计测试场景（即HTTP交互），以确认其语义。测试失败表明预期的CRUD语义与实际实现之间存在不匹配。因此，它通过改进的测试场景来细化API操作的CRUD语义知识。实证评估表明CRUDinfer具有高推断能力，在基准REST API上总体精确度高于95%。

import_candidates.title: An Empirical Study of Fine-Grained Entity Relationships for Tracing Natural Language and Code Vulnerability Artifacts
import_candidates.abstract: Understanding software vulnerabilities requires analyzing fine-grained entities and their complex relationships across natural language (NL) artifacts and source code. Vulnerability descriptions often interweave vulnerability triggers (VT), crash phenomena (CP), and after-fix (AF) actions within the same sentence, making it challenging to distinguish root causes, failure symptoms, and remediation strategies. Additionally, missing key NL entities further hinders traceability, limiting an analyst’s ability to determine why and how a vulnerability was introduced and resolved. To address these challenges, we conduct an empirical study on fine-grained entity relationships using a manually curated dataset of 1,000 vulnerabilities. We extract phrase-level VT, CP, and AF entities, categorize them into structured taxonomies, and analyze cross-entity relationships within NL artifacts and source code, uncovering recurring patterns in vulnerability evolution and remediation strategies. Furthermore, we investigate the automation of vulnerability entity extraction using different approaches, showing that ELECTRA [7], a state-of-the-art pre-trained language model, along with other LLM-based approaches, outperforms other methods.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 理解软件漏洞需要分析细粒度实体及其在自然语言（NL）工件与源代码之间的复杂关系。漏洞描述常常在同一句话中交织漏洞触发条件（VT）、崩溃现象（CP）和修复后（AF）动作，使得区分根本原因、故障症状和修复策略变得困难。此外，缺失关键的自然语言实体进一步阻碍了可追溯性，限制了分析人员确定漏洞为何以及如何被引入和解决的能力。为了应对这些挑战，我们使用一个包含1000个漏洞的人工整理数据集，对细粒度实体关系进行了实证研究。我们提取短语级别的VT、CP和AF实体，将其分类为结构化分类体系，并分析自然语言工件和源代码内部的跨实体关系，揭示漏洞演化与修复策略中的重复模式。此外，我们研究了使用不同方法自动提取漏洞实体，表明ELECTRA [7]——一种最先进的预训练语言模型——以及其他基于LLM的方法优于其他方法。

import_candidates.title: Designing Abandabot: When Does Open Source Dependency Abandonment Matter?
import_candidates.abstract: Despite the inevitable risk posed by abandoned open source dependencies, many developers feel they lack sufficient guidance on how to deal with dependency abandonment. Automated detection of abandonment is feasible, but not all abandoned dependencies impact downstream projects equally. In this paper, we perform a need-finding interview study with 22 open source maintainers exploring what makes the abandonment of certain dependencies impactful to their project given the context of their usage, as well as their information needs and design requirements for such an automated notification tool. We identify four categories of context-specific information that often affect the impactfulness of a given dependency’s abandonment to a particular downstream project: the depth of integration, the availability of alternatives, the importance of the functionality, and external environmental pressures. Using this emerging theory, we then build an LLM-based classifier to predict the impact of a dependency’s abandonment in a given context, and evaluate it with an independent user study with 124 open source maintainers. Our results show that the classifier is effective at predicting whether a dependency’s abandonment would be impactful to a project and that LLM-generated theory-based explanations are useful to many developers when making judgments about the potential impactfulness of abandonment.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 尽管被弃用的开源依赖会带来不可避免的风险，但许多开发者认为他们缺乏足够的指导来应对依赖弃用问题。自动检测弃用是可行的，但并非所有被弃用的依赖都会对下游项目产生同等影响。本文中，我们对22位开源维护者进行了需求发现访谈研究，探讨在使用情境下，某些依赖的弃用为何会对其项目产生影响，以及他们对这种自动通知工具的信息需求和设计需求。我们识别出四类通常会影响特定依赖弃用对某个下游项目影响程度的上下文相关信息：集成深度、替代方案的可用性、功能的重要性以及外部环境压力。基于这一新兴理论，我们构建了一个基于LLM的分类器来预测在给定情境下依赖弃用的影响，并通过一项包含124位开源维护者的独立用户研究对其进行评估。结果表明，该分类器能够有效预测某个依赖的弃用是否会对项目产生影响，并且基于理论的LLM生成解释对许多开发者在判断弃用潜在影响时很有帮助。

import_candidates.title: How Does Core Contributor Disengagement Impact Open Source Project Activity? A Quasi-Experiment
import_candidates.abstract: The sustainability of Open Source Software (OSS) projects often depends on a small group of core contributors. When these contributors disengage, projects may face disruption; however, the consequences of such disengagement on OSS contribution workflows remain underexplored. This paper presents a large-scale quasi-experimental study quantifying the impact of core contributor disengagement on pull request (PR) throughput, acceptance rate, and time to merge. We analyzed over 35 million PRs across 50,804 GitHub repositories, identifying 95,958 disengagement bursts (one or more core contributors becoming inactive for > 365 days within the same week) involving 174,887 contributors. Using Difference-in-Differences with matched control groups, we found that the impact varies substantially with contributor and project characteristics. Disengagements of contributors with a high share of commits lead to pronounced declines in throughput and acceptance, while long-tenured contributors’ disengagements have milder effects on those metrics but increase merge time, suggesting loss of tacit project knowledge. These findings provide empirical evidence of how core contributors’ disengagement influences OSS workflows and highlight structural factors associated with project resilience.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 开源软件（OSS）项目的可持续性通常依赖于一小群核心贡献者。当这些贡献者脱离时，项目可能面临中断；然而，这种脱离对OSS贡献工作流的影响仍未得到充分探索。本文提出了一项大规模准实验研究，量化了核心贡献者脱离对拉取请求（PR）吞吐量、接受率和合并时间的影响。我们分析了50,804个GitHub仓库中的超过3500万个PR，识别出95,958次脱离爆发（一位或多位核心贡献者在同一周内不活跃超过365天），涉及174,887名贡献者。使用双重差分法与匹配对照组，我们发现影响因贡献者和项目特征而存在显著差异。提交占比高的贡献者的脱离会导致吞吐量和接受率显著下降，而长期任职贡献者的脱离对这些指标影响较小，但会增加合并时间，表明项目隐性知识的流失。这些发现为核心贡献者脱离如何影响OSS工作流提供了经验证据，并突出了与项目韧性相关的结构性因素。

import_candidates.title: Small Changes, Big Trouble: Demystifying and Parsing License Variants for Incompatibility Detection in the PyPI Ecosystem
import_candidates.abstract: Open-source licenses establish the legal foundation for software reuse, yet license variants, including both modified standard licenses and custom-created alternatives, introduce significant compliance complexities. Despite their prevalence and potential impact, these variants are poorly understood in modern software systems, and existing tools do not account for their existence, leading to significant challenges in both effectiveness and efficiency of license analysis. To fill this knowledge gap, we conduct a comprehensive empirical study of license variants in the PyPI ecosystem. Our findings show that textual variations in licenses are common, yet only 2\% involve substantive modifications. However, these license variants lead to significant compliance issues, with 10.7\% of their downstream dependencies found to be license-incompatible.Inspired by our findings, we introduce LV-Parser, a novel approach for efficient license variant analysis leveraging diff-based techniques and large language models, along with LV-Compat, an automated pipeline for detecting license incompatibilities in software dependency networks. Our evaluation demonstrates that LV-Parser achieves an accuracy of 0.936 while reducing computational costs by 29\%, and LV-Compat identifies 5.2 times more incompatible packages than existing methods with a precision of 0.98.This work not only provides the first empirical study into license variants in software packaging ecosystem but also equips developers and organizations with practical tools for navigating the complex landscape of open-source licensing.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 开源许可证为软件复用奠定了法律基础，然而许可证变体——包括修改过的标准许可证和自定义的替代许可证——引入了显著的合规复杂性。尽管这些变体普遍存在且可能产生重大影响，但在现代软件系统中人们对它们知之甚少，现有工具也未考虑它们的存在，导致许可证分析在有效性和效率上面临重大挑战。为填补这一知识空白，我们对PyPI生态系统中的许可证变体进行了全面的实证研究。研究发现，许可证中的文本差异很常见，但只有2%涉及实质性修改。然而，这些许可证变体导致了显著的合规问题，其下游依赖中有10.7%被发现存在许可证不兼容。受此发现启发，我们提出了LV-Parser，一种利用基于差异的技术和大语言模型进行高效许可证变体分析的新方法，以及LV-Compat，一个用于检测软件依赖网络中许可证不兼容性的自动化流水线。评估表明，LV-Parser达到了0.936的准确率，同时将计算成本降低了29%，而LV-Compat以0.98的精确率识别出的不兼容包数量是现有方法的5.2倍。这项工作不仅首次对软件打包生态系统中的许可证变体进行了实证研究，还为开发者和组织提供了实用工具，以应对开源许可的复杂格局。

import_candidates.title: Beyond Adoption: Examining the Evolution and Impact of Code of Conduct on Open Source Communities
import_candidates.abstract: While open source software (OSS) communities thrive on collaboration, conflicts such as toxic behavior and discrimination can surface, threatening project sustainability. To address these concerns, many communities have adopted a Code of Conduct (CoC) as a mechanism for governing and moderating members’ behavior. Prior research has explored the motivations behind CoC adoption and their content updates, but it remains unclear how different communities are using and maintaining CoCs over time after initial adoption and how adoption impacts communities. To bridge these gaps, in our study, we compile a large-scale dataset of CoCs along with their change histories from GitHub to quantitatively (1) understand the evolution of CoC content and identify change patterns across different communities, and (2) investigate the potential impact of CoC adoption on community engagement. Our results show that OSS communities with a CoC attract more new contributors in both the short- and long-term. However, CoC adoption also leads to a short-term increase in disengagement among existing contributors, with very limited effects on long-term disengagement. The insights from this study can provide guidance for maintaining CoCs and offer statistically significant evidence of their impact.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 尽管开源软件（OSS）社区因协作而蓬勃发展，但有毒行为和歧视等冲突也可能浮现，威胁项目的可持续性。为了解决这些问题，许多社区采用了行为准则（CoC）作为治理和规范成员行为的机制。先前的研究探讨了采用CoC的动机及其内容更新，但不同社区在初始采用后如何长期使用和维护CoC，以及采用CoC如何影响社区，仍不清楚。为了弥合这些差距，在我们的研究中，我们编译了一个来自GitHub的大规模CoC数据集及其变更历史，以定量地（1）理解CoC内容的演变，并识别不同社区中的变更模式，以及（2）调查采用CoC对社区参与的潜在影响。我们的结果表明，拥有CoC的OSS社区在短期和长期内都能吸引更多新贡献者。然而，采用CoC也会导致现有贡献者在短期内退出增加，而对长期退出的影响非常有限。本研究的见解可以为维护CoC提供指导，并为其影响提供统计上显著的证据。

import_candidates.title: An empirical Analysis of Community and Coding Patterns in OSS4SG vs. Conventional OSS
import_candidates.abstract: Open Source Software for Social Good (OSS4SG) projects aim to address critical societal challenges, such as healthcare access and community safety. Understanding the community dynamics and contributor patterns in these projects is essential for ensuring their sustainability and long-term impact. However, while extensive research has focused on conventional Open Source Software (OSS), little is known about how the mission-driven nature of OSS4SG influences its development practices. To address this gap, we conduct a large-scale empirical study of 1,039 GitHub repositories, comprising 422 OSS4SG and 617 conventional OSS projects, to compare community structure, contributor engagement, and coding practices. Our findings reveal that OSS4SG projects foster significantly more stable and “sticky” (63.4\%) communities, whereas conventional OSS projects are more “magnetic” (75.4\%), attracting a high turnover of contributors. OSS4SG projects also demonstrate consistent engagement throughout the year, while conventional OSS communities exhibit seasonal fluctuations. Additionally, OSS4SG projects rely heavily on core contributors for both code quality and issue resolution, while conventional OSS projects leverage casual contributors for issue resolution, with core contributors focusing primarily on code quality.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 面向社会公益的开源软件（OSS4SG）项目旨在应对关键社会挑战，如医疗可及性和社区安全。理解这些项目中的社区动态和贡献者模式对于确保其可持续性和长期影响至关重要。然而，尽管大量研究聚焦于传统开源软件（OSS），但人们对于OSS4SG的使命驱动性质如何影响其开发实践知之甚少。为填补这一空白，我们对1,039个GitHub仓库进行了大规模实证研究，其中包括422个OSS4SG项目和617个传统OSS项目，以比较社区结构、贡献者参与度和编码实践。我们的发现表明，OSS4SG项目培育出显著更稳定且“黏性”更强（63.4%）的社区，而传统OSS项目则更具“磁性”（75.4%），吸引着高流动性的贡献者。OSS4SG项目还表现出全年持续的参与度，而传统OSS社区则呈现季节性波动。此外，OSS4SG项目在代码质量和问题解决方面都严重依赖核心贡献者，而传统OSS项目则利用临时贡献者来解决问题，核心贡献者主要关注代码质量。

import_candidates.title: Toxicity Ahead: Forecasting Conversational Derailment on GitHub
import_candidates.abstract: Toxic interactions in Open Source Software (OSS) communities reduce contributor engagement and threaten project sustainability. Preventing such toxicity before it emerges requires a clear understanding of how harmful conversations unfold. However, most proactive moderation strategies are manual, requiring significant time and effort from community maintainers. To support more scalable approaches, we curate a dataset of 159 derailed toxic threads and 207 non-toxic threads from GitHub discussions. Our analysis reveals that toxicity can be forecast by tension triggers, sentiment shifts, and specific conversational patterns.We present a novel Large Language Model (LLM)-based framework for predicting conversational derailment on GitHub using a two-step prompting pipeline. First, we generate Summaries of Conversation Dynamics (SCDs) via Least-to-Most (LtM) prompting; then we use these summaries to estimate the likelihood of derailment. Evaluated on Qwen and Llama models, our LtM strategy achieves F1-scores of 0.901 and 0.852, respectively, at a decision threshold of 0.3, outperforming established NLP baselines on conversation derailment. External validation on a dataset of 308 GitHub issue threads (65 toxic, 243 non-toxic) yields an F1-score up to 0.797. Our findings demonstrate the effectiveness of structured LLM prompting for early detection of conversational derailment in OSS, enabling proactive and explainable moderation.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 开源软件（OSS）社区中的毒性互动会降低贡献者参与度并威胁项目可持续性。在毒性出现之前进行预防需要清晰理解有害对话如何展开。然而，大多数主动审核策略都是手动的，需要社区维护者投入大量时间和精力。为了支持更具可扩展性的方法，我们整理了一个来自GitHub讨论的数据集，包含159个脱轨的毒性帖子和207个非毒性帖子。我们的分析表明，毒性可以通过紧张触发因素、情感转变和特定对话模式进行预测。我们提出了一种新颖的基于大语言模型（LLM）的框架，使用两步提示流水线预测GitHub上的对话脱轨。首先，我们通过Least-to-Most（LtM）提示生成对话动态摘要（SCD）；然后使用这些摘要估计脱轨的可能性。在Qwen和Llama模型上评估，我们的LtM策略在决策阈值0.3下分别达到0.901和0.852的F1分数，优于既有的对话脱轨NLP基线。在包含308个GitHub问题线程（65个毒性，243个非毒性）的数据集上进行外部验证，F1分数最高达到0.797。我们的发现证明了结构化LLM提示在OSS中早期检测对话脱轨的有效性，从而实现主动且可解释的审核。

import_candidates.title: “Write in English, Nobody Understands Your Language Here”: A Study of Non-English Trends in Open-Source Repositories
import_candidates.abstract: The open-source software (OSS) community has historically been dominated by English as the primary language for code, documentation, and developer interactions. However, with growing global participation and better support for non-Latin scripts through standards like Unicode, OSS is gradually becoming more multilingual. This study investigates the extent to which OSS is becoming more multilingual, analyzing 9.14 billion GitHub issues, pull requests, and discussions, and 62,500 repositories across five programming languages and 30 natural languages, covering the period from 2015 to 2025. We examine six research questions to track changes in language use across communication, code, and documentation. We find that multilingual participation has steadily increased, especially in Korean, Chinese, and Russian. This growth appears not only in issues and discussions but also in code comments, string literals, and documentation files. While this shift reflects greater inclusivity and language diversity in OSS, it also creates language tension. The ability to express oneself in a native language can clash with shared norms around English use, especially in collaborative settings. Non-English or multilingual projects tend to receive less visibility and participation, suggesting that language remains both a resource and a barrier, shaping who gets heard, who contributes, and how open collaboration unfolds.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 开源软件（OSS）社区历史上一直以英语作为代码、文档和开发者互动的主要语言。然而，随着全球参与度的增长以及通过 Unicode 等标准对非拉丁字符集更好的支持，OSS 正逐渐变得更加多语言化。本研究调查 OSS 在多大程度上正变得更加多语言化，分析了 91.4 亿条 GitHub issue、pull request 和 discussion，以及 62,500 个代码库，涵盖五种编程语言和 30 种自然语言，时间跨度为 2015 年至 2025 年。我们考察六个研究问题，以追踪沟通、代码和文档中语言使用的变化。我们发现，多语言参与稳步增加，尤其是在韩语、中文和俄语中。这种增长不仅出现在 issue 和 discussion 中，也出现在代码注释、字符串字面量和文档文件中。虽然这一转变反映了 OSS 中更大的包容性和语言多样性，但它也造成了语言张力。用母语表达自己的能力可能与围绕英语使用的共享规范发生冲突，尤其是在协作环境中。非英语或多语言项目往往获得更少的可见度和参与，这表明语言既是一种资源，也是一种障碍，塑造着谁被听见、谁做出贡献以及开放协作如何展开。

import_candidates.title: Views on Internal and External Validity in Empirical Software Engineering: 10 Years Later and Beyond
import_candidates.abstract: Ten years ago, a survey (ICSE’15) revealed an unsatisfactory picture among key players of the software engineering research community: There was dissent and confusion on how to approach empirical research. Specifically, researchers were divided on the tradeoff between internal and external validity, holding strong and often opposing opinions, which cannot be a basis for stringent scientific progress. Clearly, the field has progressed over the last decade, but did the views progress, as well, or is the community still divided and confused? Our study addresses these questions by replicating the original survey among current key players of the field. Analyzing 790 open answers learning how perspectives have changed over the past ten years, we found that, despite increased awareness of the intricacies of conducting empirical studies, not nearly enough has changed to address the wide range of opinions on what a good study is and how that can be reflected in the review process. Specifically, participants disagree on balancing internal, external, and ecological validity, and while there is consensus on the need for replication studies, the specifics of when, how, and what to replicate remain unclear. Our results suggest the need for a more sophisticated review process, incorporating clear empirical standards for various methods and fostering honest discussions on what is worth replicating.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 十年前，一项调查（ICSE’15）揭示了软件工程研究界关键参与者中一幅不尽如人意的图景：在如何开展实证研究方面存在分歧与困惑。具体而言，研究者在内部效度与外部效度之间的权衡上存在分歧，持有强烈且往往对立的观点，这无法成为严格科学进步的基础。显然，该领域在过去十年中有所发展，但观点是否也随之进步，还是共同体仍然分裂且困惑？我们的研究通过在该领域当前关键参与者中复现原始调查来探讨这些问题。通过分析790份开放式回答，了解过去十年间视角如何变化，我们发现，尽管人们对开展实证研究的复杂性有了更多认识，但在什么是好的研究以及如何在评审过程中体现这一点上，要应对广泛的观点差异，变化还远远不够。具体而言，参与者在平衡内部效度、外部效度和生态效度方面存在分歧；尽管在需要复现研究这一点上存在共识，但关于何时、如何以及复现什么的细节仍不明确。我们的结果表明，需要一个更精细的评审过程，为各种方法纳入清晰的实证标准，并促进关于什么值得复现的诚实讨论。

import_candidates.title: Cognitive Biases in LLM-Assisted Software Development
import_candidates.abstract: The widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) in software development is transforming programming from a solution-generative to a solution-evaluative activity. This shift opens a pathway for new cognitive challenges that amplify existing decision-making biases or create entirely novel ones. One such type of challenge stems from cognitive biases, which are thinking patterns that lead people away from logical reasoning and result in sub-optimal decisions. How do cognitive biases manifest and impact decision-making in emerging AI-collaborative development? This paper presents the first comprehensive study of cognitive biases in LLM-assisted development. We employ a mixed-methods approach, combining observational studies with 14 student and professional developers, followed by surveys with 22 additional developers. We qualitatively compare categories of biases affecting developers against the traditional non-LLM workflows. Our findings suggest that LLM-related actions are more likely to be associated with novel biases. Through a systematic analysis of 90 cognitive biases specific to developer-LLM interactions, we develop a taxonomy of 15 bias categories validated by cognitive psychologists. We found that 48.8\% of total programmer actions are biased, and developer-LLM interactions account for 56.4\% of these biased actions. We discuss how these bias categories manifest, present tools and practices for developers, and recommendations for LLM tool builders to help mitigate cognitive biases in human-AI programming.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在软件开发中的广泛采用正在将编程从解决方案生成活动转变为解决方案评估活动。这一转变开辟了新的认知挑战路径，这些挑战会放大现有的决策偏差或创造全新的偏差。其中一类挑战源于认知偏差，即引导人们偏离逻辑推理并导致次优决策的思维模式。在新兴的AI协作开发中，认知偏差如何表现并影响决策？本文首次对LLM辅助开发中的认知偏差进行了全面研究。我们采用混合方法，结合对14名学生和专业开发者的观察性研究，随后对另外22名开发者进行了调查。我们定性比较了影响开发者的偏差类别与传统非LLM工作流中的偏差。我们的发现表明，与LLM相关的操作更可能伴随新颖偏差。通过对开发者-LLM交互中特有的90种认知偏差进行系统分析，我们开发了一个包含15个偏差类别的分类法，并得到认知心理学家的验证。我们发现，48.8%的程序员操作存在偏差，而开发者-LLM交互占这些偏差操作的56.4%。我们讨论了这些偏差类别如何表现，提出了面向开发者的工具和实践，以及面向LLM工具构建者以帮助缓解人-AI编程中认知偏差的建议。

import_candidates.title: The Software Infrastructure Attitude Scale (SIAS): A Questionnaire Instrument for Measuring Professionals’ Attitudes Toward Technical and Sociotechnical Infrastructure
import_candidates.abstract: Context: Recent software engineering (SE) research has highlighted the need for sociotechnical research, implying a demand for customized psychometric scales. Objective: We define the concepts of technical and sociotechnical infrastructure in software engineering, and develop and validate a psychometric scale that measures attitudes toward them. Method: Grounded in theories of infrastructure, attitudes, and prior work on psychometric measurement, we defined the target constructs and generated scale items. The items were reviewed and refined by domain experts. The scale was administered to 225 software professionals and evaluated using a split sample. We conducted an exploratory factor analysis (EFA) on one half of the sample to uncover the underlying factor structure and performed a confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) on the other half to validate the structure. Further analyses with the whole sample assessed face, criterion-related, and discriminant validity. Results: EFA supported a two-factor structure (technical and sociotechnical infrastructure), accounting for 65\% of the total variance with strong loadings. CFA confirmed excellent model fit. Face and content validity were supported by the item content reflecting cognitive, affective, and behavioral components. Both subscales were correlated with job satisfaction, perceived autonomy, and feedback from the job itself, supporting convergent validity. Regression analysis supported criterion-related validity, while the Heterotrait–Monotrait ratio of correlations (HTMT), the Fornell–Larcker criterion, and model comparison all supported discriminant validity. Discussion: The resulting scale is a valid instrument for measuring attitudes toward technical and sociotechnical infrastructure in software engineering research. Our work contributes to ongoing efforts to integrate psychological measurement rigor into empirical and behavioral software engineering research. The scale can also be used by companies and organizations to assess their employees’ attitudes toward the infrastructure they provide.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 背景：近期软件工程（SE）研究强调了社会技术研究的必要性，这意味着需要定制的心理测量量表。目标：我们定义软件工程中技术基础设施和社会技术基础设施的概念，并开发并验证一个测量对它们态度的心理测量量表。方法：基于基础设施、态度理论以及先前心理测量测量工作，我们定义了目标构念并生成量表条目。条目由领域专家审查和提炼。该量表对225名软件专业人员施测，并使用分半样本进行评估。我们对样本的一半进行探索性因子分析（EFA）以揭示潜在因子结构，并对另一半进行验证性因子分析（CFA）以验证该结构。对全样本的进一步分析评估了表面效度、效标关联效度和区分效度。结果：EFA支持双因子结构（技术基础设施和社会技术基础设施），解释了总方差的65%，载荷很强。CFA确认模型拟合极好。条目内容反映认知、情感和行为成分，支持表面效度和内容效度。两个子量表均与工作满意度、感知自主性以及工作本身反馈相关，支持聚合效度。回归分析支持效标关联效度，而异质-单质相关比（HTMT）、Fornell-Larcker准则和模型比较均支持区分效度。讨论：所得量表是测量软件工程研究中对技术和社会技术基础设施态度的有效工具。我们的工作有助于将心理测量严谨性融入实证和行为软件工程研究的持续努力。该量表也可供公司组织评估员工对其所提供基础设施的态度。

import_candidates.title: WhyFlow: Interrogative Debugger for Sensemaking Taint Analysis
import_candidates.abstract: Taint analysis is a security analysis technique used to track the flow of potentially dangerous data through an application and its dependent libraries. Investigating why certain unexpected flows appear and why expected flows are missing is an important sensemaking process during end-user taint analysis. Existing taint analysis tools often do not provide this end-user debugging capability, where developers can ask why, why-not, and what-if questions about dataflows and reason about the impact of configuring sources and sinks, and models of third-party libraries that abstract permissible and impermissible data flows. Furthermore, the tree-view or list-view used in existing taint analyzer visualizations makes it difficult to reason about the global impact on connectivity between multiple sources and sinks.Inspired by the insight that sensemaking tool-generated results can be significantly improved by a QA inquiry process, we propose WhyFlow, the first end-user question-answer style debugging interface for taint analysis. It enables a user to ask why, why-not, and what-if questions to investigate the existence of suspicious flows, the non-existence of expected flows, and the global impact of third-party library models. WhyFlow performs speculative what-if analysis, to help a user in debugging how different connectivity assumptions affect overall results. A user study with 12 participants shows that participants using WhyFlow achieved 21\% higher accuracy on average, compared to CodeQL. They also reported a 45\% reduction in mental demand (NASA-TLX) and rated higher confidence in identifying relevant flows using WhyFlow. This shows WhyFlow’s potential to significantly reduce sensemaking effort.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 污点分析是一种安全分析技术，用于跟踪潜在危险数据在应用程序及其依赖库中的流动。在最终用户污点分析过程中，调查某些意外流为何出现以及预期流为何缺失是一个重要的意义建构过程。现有污点分析工具通常不提供这种最终用户调试能力，即开发者可以就数据流提出 why、why-not 和 what-if 问题，并推理配置源和汇以及第三方库模型（抽象允许和不允许的数据流）的影响。此外，现有污点分析器可视化中使用的树视图或列表视图难以推理多个源与汇之间连通性的全局影响。受“通过问答式探究过程可以显著改善对工具生成结果的意义建构”这一洞见启发，我们提出 WhyFlow，这是首个用于污点分析的最终用户问答式调试界面。它使用户能够提出 why、why-not 和 what-if 问题，以调查可疑流是否存在、预期流为何不存在，以及第三方库模型的全局影响。WhyFlow 执行推测式 what-if 分析，帮助用户调试不同连通性假设如何影响整体结果。一项有 12 名参与者参与的用户研究表明，与 CodeQL 相比，使用 WhyFlow 的参与者平均准确率提高了 21%。他们还报告心理需求（NASA-TLX）降低了 45%，并评价使用 WhyFlow 识别相关流时信心更高。这表明 WhyFlow 具有显著减少意义建构努力的潜力。

import_candidates.title: Sapling: Quantifying and Measuring the Maturity of the RISC-V Software Ecosystem
import_candidates.abstract: Open-source technology has enabled RISC-V to emerge as a cost-effective alternative for processor manufacturers by reducing intellectual property expenses. A key factor influencing its broader application is the maturity of the RISC-V software ecosystem. However, quantifying this maturity remains challenging due to the complexity of the ecosystem. In this study, we introduce Sapling, an automated evaluation system designed to systematically evaluate the maturity of the RISC-V software ecosystem. Our framework categorizes the ecosystem into five scenarios comprising thirty software components, each assessed across six dimensions. These evaluations are then aggregated across multiple dimensions within each scenario and further synthesized to produce an overall result through a cross-scenario evaluation. Our findings indicate that while the RISC-V software ecosystem remains in its developmental phase, it is steadily advancing, demonstrating strong potential for sustained growth and broader industry application. Furthermore, thirteen key insights and five strategic recommendations are presented to advance the maturity of the RISC-V software ecosystem. We hope that this study contributes to a deeper understanding of the maturity of the RISC-V software ecosystem and offers valuable guidance for its effective enhancement.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 开源技术使RISC-V得以成为处理器制造商的一种经济高效的替代方案，从而降低了知识产权费用。影响其更广泛应用的一个关键因素是RISC-V软件生态系统的成熟度。然而，由于生态系统的复杂性，量化其成熟度仍然具有挑战性。在本研究中，我们引入了Sapling，一个旨在系统评估RISC-V软件生态系统成熟度的自动化评估系统。我们的框架将生态系统划分为五个场景，包含三十个软件组件，每个组件从六个维度进行评估。然后，在每个场景内跨多个维度汇总这些评估，并通过跨场景评估进一步综合以产生总体结果。我们的发现表明，尽管RISC-V软件生态系统仍处于发展阶段，但它正在稳步推进，展现出持续增长和更广泛行业应用的强大潜力。此外，我们还提出了十三项关键见解和五项战略建议，以提升RISC-V软件生态系统的成熟度。我们希望这项研究有助于更深入地理解RISC-V软件生态系统的成熟度，并为其有效提升提供有价值的指导。

import_candidates.title: Breaking the Alphabet: Rethinking File Ordering in Code Review
import_candidates.abstract: Effective code review is central to maintaining software quality, yet there is limited research about how the ordering of changed files in Pull Requests (PRs) influences review effectiveness. Most popular code review tools default to alphabetical ordering, favoring predictability over contextual relevance. While prior studies examined how file position shapes reviewer attention, it remains unclear how such ordering influences cognitive load and perceived review thoroughness. This study presents the first large-scale survey of 1,355 professional developers across 182 widely used open-source projects to investigate how file ordering impacts review behavior, comprehension, and perceived effectiveness. Our mixed-methods analysis reveals that only 10.2\% of reviewers consider alphabetical ordering optimal, underscoring a cognitive misalignment in their interpretation of code changes. Although some developers appreciate its predictability, more than half (57.6\%) report that it increases context switching, disrupts logical reasoning, and contributes to review fatigue, and 63.9\% expressed concern that the default ordering may cause them to miss bugs. We further identify key challenges in multi-file reviews and elicit developers’ expectations for improved tooling, including dependency-aware grouping and customizable file ordering (requested by 66\% of reviewers). These findings highlight the need for reviewer-centric interface designs that better align tool behavior with human cognition.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 有效的代码审查是维护软件质量的核心，然而关于拉取请求（PR）中变更文件的排序如何影响审查效果的研究却很有限。大多数流行的代码审查工具默认采用字母顺序，更倾向于可预测性而非上下文相关性。虽然先前的研究考察了文件位置如何影响审查者的注意力，但尚不清楚这种排序如何影响认知负荷和感知的审查彻底性。本研究首次对来自182个广泛使用的开源项目的1,355名专业开发者进行了大规模调查，以探究文件排序如何影响审查行为、理解和感知有效性。我们的混合方法分析显示，只有10.2%的审查者认为字母顺序是最优的，这凸显了他们在解释代码变更时的认知错位。尽管一些开发者欣赏其可预测性，但超过一半（57.6%）的人报告称它增加了上下文切换、扰乱了逻辑推理，并导致审查疲劳，63.9%的人担心默认排序可能导致他们遗漏错误。我们进一步确定了多文件审查中的关键挑战，并引出了开发者对改进工具的期望，包括依赖感知分组和可定制的文件排序（66%的审查者要求）。这些发现强调了需要以审查者为中心的界面设计，使工具行为更好地与人类认知保持一致。

import_candidates.title: "Making Our Life Less Monotonous" or "Just Tick Things Off": An Exploratory Multi-Method Study of Toil
import_candidates.abstract: Google introduced Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) as a DevOps approach focused on service reliability. A key concept in SRE is toil defined as manual, repetitive, automatable, and reactive tasks that arise in production service management, scale with service growth, and provide no lasting value. As SRE adoption expands beyond Google, organisations adapt SRE practices and terminology, leading to inconsistencies in how toil is defined and perceived.Understanding toil is crucial, as it is assumed to directly impact both operational efficiency and well-being of engineers, ultimately influencing the reliability and scalability of production services. In this study, we examine toil in light of Google’s claim that “less toil is better". We explore how different engineers define toil, its perceived impact, and whether reducing toil is seen as beneficial. To this end, we analyse grey literature, for a broad, practical perspective of toil and its effects, and conduct semi-structured interviews at the ING Group to triangulate the previous findings.We observe that while Google’s toil definition has been widely adopted, it has been expanded to include additional technical attributes (e.g., routine, time-consuming, persistent) and human aspects (e.g., mundane, not just unwanted work). Practitioners generally view toil negatively, citing its impact on organisations’ growth, teams’ efficiency, and morale. However, while toil elimination is generally praised, we also observe resistance stemming from concerns over cost, complexity, and the possible negative impact this elimination can have on employees predominantly working on toil.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 谷歌提出站点可靠性工程（SRE）作为一种专注于服务可靠性的DevOps方法。SRE的一个关键概念是Toil，定义为在生产服务管理中出现、随服务增长而扩展且不产生持久价值的手动、重复、可自动化且被动响应式的任务。随着SRE的采用扩展到谷歌之外，各组织会调整SRE实践和术语，导致Toil的定义和认知出现不一致。理解Toil至关重要，因为据认为它直接影响运营效率和工程师的福祉，最终影响生产服务的可靠性和可扩展性。在本研究中，我们根据谷歌“Toil越少越好”的说法来考察Toil。我们探讨不同工程师如何定义Toil、其感知影响，以及减少Toil是否被视为有益。为此，我们分析灰色文献以获得关于Toil及其影响的广泛实践视角，并在ING集团进行半结构化访谈，以三角验证此前的发现。我们观察到，虽然谷歌的Toil定义已被广泛采用，但它已被扩展，纳入更多技术属性（例如，例行性、耗时性、持续性）和人文方面（例如，平凡单调，而不仅仅是不想要的工作）。实践者通常对Toil持负面看法，指出其对组织增长、团队效率和士气的影响。然而，虽然消除Toil通常受到赞扬，我们也观察到阻力，源于对成本、复杂性以及这种消除可能对主要处理Toil的员工产生负面影响的担忧。

import_candidates.title: Staying or Leaving? How Job Satisfaction, Embeddedness and Antecedents Predict Turnover Intentions of Software Professionals
import_candidates.abstract: Context: Voluntary turnover is common in the software industry, increasing recruitment and onboarding costs and the risk of losing organizational and tacit knowledge. Objective: This study investigates how job satisfaction, work-life balance, job embeddedness, and their antecedents, including job quality, personality traits, attitudes toward technical and sociotechnical infrastructure, and perceptions of organizational justice, relate to software professionals’ turnover intentions. Method: We conducted a geographically diverse cross-sectional survey of software professionals (N = 224) and analyzed the data using partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM). Our model includes both reflective and formative constructs and tests 15 hypotheses grounded in occupational psychology and software engineering literature. Additionally, indirect effects were explored. Results: Job satisfaction and embeddedness were significantly negatively associated with software professionals’ turnover intentions, while work-life balance showed no direct effect. The strongest antecedents for job satisfaction were work-life balance and job quality, while organizational justice was the strongest predictor of job embeddedness. Exploratory analysis suggests that job satisfaction and job embeddedness mediate the effect of job quality, organizational justice, and work-life balance on turnover intentions. Discussion: The resulting PLS-SEM model has considerably higher explanatory power for key outcome variables than previous work conducted in the software development context, highlighting the importance of both psychological (e.g., job satisfaction, job embeddedness) and organizational (e.g., organizational justice, job quality) factors in understanding turnover intentions of software professionals. Our results imply that improving job satisfaction and job embeddedness is the key to retaining software professionals. In turn, enhancing job quality, supporting work-life balance, and ensuring high organizational justice can improve job satisfaction and embeddedness, indirectly reducing turnover intentions. Our results broadly suggest that retention strategies are best focused on fairness, meaningful work, and work-life balance.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 背景：自愿离职在软件行业很常见，增加了招聘和入职成本，也增加了失去组织知识和隐性知识的风险。目标：本研究探讨工作满意度、工作与生活平衡、工作嵌入度及其前因（包括工作质量、人格特质、对技术和社会技术基础设施的态度，以及组织公平感知）如何与软件专业人员的离职意向相关。方法：我们对软件专业人员（N = 224）进行了一项地域多样化的横断面调查，并使用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）分析数据。我们的模型包含反映性和形成性构念，并检验了基于职业心理学和软件工程文献的15个假设。此外，还探讨了间接效应。结果：工作满意度和嵌入度与软件专业人员的离职意向显著负相关，而工作与生活平衡没有直接影响。工作满意度的最强前因是工作与生活平衡和工作质量，而组织公平是工作嵌入度的最强预测因素。探索性分析表明，工作满意度和工作嵌入度中介了工作质量、组织公平和工作与生活平衡对离职意向的影响。讨论：由此得到的PLS-SEM模型对关键结果变量的解释力显著高于以往在软件开发情境中进行的研究，凸显了心理因素（如工作满意度、工作嵌入度）和组织因素（如组织公平、工作质量）在理解软件专业人员离职意向中的重要性。我们的结果表明，提高工作满意度和工作嵌入度是留住软件专业人员的关键。反过来，提高工作质量、支持工作与生活平衡以及确保高组织公平可以改善工作满意度和嵌入度，从而间接降低离职意向。我们的结果广泛表明，留任策略最好聚焦于公平、有意义的工作和工作与生活平衡。

import_candidates.title: Connected to Stay: Gender Homophily and Its Role in Open-Source Software Developer Retention
import_candidates.abstract: Understanding how social connections shape participation is critical for sustaining open-source software (OSS) communities. To investigate this, we analyze longitudinal collaboration networks of 1.6 million developers over 14 years (2008–2022) using the World of Code dataset, focusing on gender homophily, developers’ preference to collaborate with others of the same gender, and its relationship to retention. We find strong evidence of gender homophily beyond demographic baselines, with same-gender ties among women exceeding random expectations by more than twice. While women tend to form homophilous ties, men show a preference for cross-gender collaboration, and these patterns shift over time as the OSS ecosystem evolves. Most notably, we find that developers, especially women, who collaborate with other women experience significantly lower dropout risk, with hazard rates up to 20.7\% lower. These retention effects only become visible after accounting for activity levels, consistent with prior work showing that aggregate analyses can mask true relationships. Our results suggest that homophilous ties offer social support that improves developer persistence, highlighting the importance of inclusive, gender-diverse networks for sustaining participation in OSS projects.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 理解社会联系如何影响参与对维持开源软件（OSS）社区至关重要。为了研究这一点，我们使用World of Code数据集分析了160万名开发者在14年（2008–2022）内的纵向协作网络，重点关注性别同质性——开发者与同性别者协作的偏好——及其与留存的关系。我们发现强有力的证据表明，性别同质性超出了人口基线，女性之间的同性别联系比随机预期高出两倍多。虽然女性倾向于形成同质性联系，男性则表现出对跨性别协作的偏好，并且这些模式随着OSS生态系统的演变而随时间变化。最值得注意的是，我们发现与其他女性协作的开发者，尤其是女性，经历显著更低的流失风险，风险率最多降低20.7%。这些留存效应只有在考虑活动水平后才变得可见，这与先前工作一致，即聚合分析可能掩盖真实关系。我们的结果表明，同质性联系提供了社会支持，从而提高了开发者的持续参与，突显了包容、性别多样的网络对于维持OSS项目参与的重要性。

import_candidates.title: Perspective-Taking in Software Engineering: A Study on its Relationship to Team Performance
import_candidates.abstract: As software engineering (SE) becomes increasingly collaborative and cross-functional, teams must navigate differences in expertise, role priorities, and communication styles. While team diversity is often associated with greater innovation and creativity, it can also lead to misalignment, conflict, and diminished performance. Perspective-taking (PT), the cognitive process of understanding others’ viewpoints, has been studied in other fields as a way to convert diversity into improved team performance outcomes, yet its role in SE remains underexplored. In this work, we address this gap through an empirical study examining how PT operates in SE teams, and how it relates to team performance. We conducted an interview study with 33 software professionals across a range of roles and organizations, and used thematic analysis to identify common patterns in how participants described PT’s relationship to performance outcomes such as team output, team morale, and software quality. Our findings suggest that perspective-taking fosters more motivation and inclusion, and more productive task-based conflict in software engineering, all of which shape how teams reason, deliberate, and deliver. Given that PT can be difficult in practice, we also identify several factors that help overcome barriers to PT, such as psychological safety and open communication. By improving our understanding of how PT contributes to team performance in SE, and how it can be supported, this work advances efforts to create software that better serves diverse users and a more inclusive SE industry.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着软件工程（SE）变得日益协作化和跨职能化，团队必须应对专业知识、角色优先级和沟通风格方面的差异。虽然团队多样性通常与更大的创新和创造力相关，但它也可能导致不一致、冲突和绩效下降。换位思考（PT），即理解他人观点的认知过程，已在其他领域被研究作为将多样性转化为改善团队绩效成果的一种方式，但其在SE中的作用仍未得到充分探索。在这项工作中，我们通过一项实证研究来填补这一空白，考察PT在SE团队中如何运作，以及它与团队绩效的关系。我们对来自不同角色和组织的33名软件专业人员进行了访谈研究，并使用主题分析来识别参与者描述PT与团队产出、团队士气和软件质量等绩效成果关系时的常见模式。我们的发现表明，换位思考在软件工程中促进了更多的动力和包容性，以及更富有成效的基于任务的冲突，这些都会影响团队如何推理、商议和交付。鉴于PT在实践中可能很困难，我们还识别出了一些有助于克服PT障碍的因素，例如心理安全和开放沟通。通过增进我们对PT如何促进SE团队绩效以及如何支持它的理解，这项工作推进了创建更好地服务多样化用户的软件和更具包容性的SE行业的努力。

import_candidates.title: STEM-EF: A Scrum Teamwork Effectiveness Model Based on Emotional Factors
import_candidates.abstract: Background: Team effectiveness is critical to Agile Software Development (ASD), particularly within the Scrum framework. Existing models focus on behavioral and structural dimensions such as communication, coordination, and shared leadership, but largely overlook emotional dynamics. Objective: This study proposes the Scrum Team Effectiveness Model – Emotional Factors (STEM-EF), a novel instrument designed to assess team effectiveness in Scrum by incorporating emotional constructs. Method: STEM-EF was developed around four emotional factors—Emotional Intelligence (EI), Interpersonal Skills (IS), Conflict Resolution (CR), and Psychological Safety (PS)—and tailored to Scrum events, roles, and artifacts. Validation employed a mixed-methods approach, with content validity assessed using the Content Validity Index (CVI) and perceived utility evaluated through the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM). Data were collected from 11 Scrum experts, 56 team members, and 2 psychologists via interviews, focus groups, and surveys. Results: STEM-EF demonstrated high content validity across relevance, coherence, and simplicity (S-CVI-Relevance = 1.00, S-CVI-Coherence = 1.00, S-CVI-Simplicity = 0.99). TAM results indicated favorable perceptions of usefulness and intention to adopt the instrument. Conclusion: STEM-EF is a content-validated and practically promising instrument for integrating emotional assessment into Scrum team evaluations. It offers both researchers and practitioners a structured means to explore and support emotional dynamics that may affect team performance.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 背景：团队效能对敏捷软件开发（ASD）至关重要，尤其是在Scrum框架中。现有模型关注沟通、协调和共享领导等行为与结构维度，但很大程度上忽视了情感动态。目标：本研究提出Scrum团队效能模型——情感因素（STEM-EF），一种旨在通过纳入情感构念来评估Scrum团队效能的新工具。方法：STEM-EF围绕四个情感因素——情绪智力（EI）、人际技能（IS）、冲突解决（CR）和心理安全（PS）——开发，并针对Scrum事件、角色和工件进行定制。验证采用混合方法，使用内容效度指数（CVI）评估内容效度，并通过技术接受模型（TAM）评估感知有用性。数据通过访谈、焦点小组和问卷调查从11名Scrum专家、56名团队成员和2名心理学家处收集。结果：STEM-EF在相关性、一致性和简洁性方面表现出高内容效度（S-CVI-Relevance = 1.00, S-CVI-Coherence = 1.00, S-CVI-Simplicity = 0.99）。TAM结果表明对该工具有用性和采用意向的积极看法。结论：STEM-EF是一种经过内容效度验证且具有实践前景的工具，可将情感评估整合到Scrum团队评价中。它为研究人员和实践者提供了一种结构化的手段，以探索和支持可能影响团队绩效的情感动态。

import_candidates.title: Women’s Career Paths in the Nordic Software Industry: A Narrative Analysis Through Gender-Switched Personas
import_candidates.abstract: Recent data indicate that women are significantly more likely than men to leave the software engineering (SE) field or transition to other careers, with nearly half doing so by the age of 35. Despite ongoing efforts, retention strategies remain inadequate and insufficient. This study examines the career trajectories of women in the SE industry, with a specific focus on the Norwegian context. We adopted a narrative research approach, using a storytelling framework to explore the lived experiences of women working in SE. We collected data through a questionnaire and semi-structured interviews. To challenge gender stereotypes and foster reflection, we present the findings through a gender-switched approach. The personas vary in background, nationality and age, and highlight a range of personal and professional challenges. Key themes include self-doubt, mental health struggles, and what we refer to as the "good-girl syndrome"—a form of internalized pressure linked to perfectionism. For instance, Jakob, a non-native speaker, described how language barriers and the scarcity of women in the field affect career advancement. Andreas, a younger professional, expressed concerns about not being taken seriously due to age. The results underscore the importance of women-centered networks in sharing experiences and fostering a sense of safety, as well as the need for open communication and transparency from companies in their hiring practices, salary data, and representation of female leadership. Our study offers a new perspective on the career paths of women, inspiring future researchers and providing an actionable set of strategies to consider for addressing the retention of women in the SE field.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 近期数据表明，女性比男性更可能离开软件工程（SE）领域或转向其他职业，其中近一半在35岁前离开。尽管已有持续努力，留任策略仍然不足且不充分。本研究考察了软件工程行业中女性的职业轨迹，特别关注挪威语境。我们采用叙事研究方法，使用讲故事框架来探索软件工程领域女性的生活经历。我们通过问卷和半结构化访谈收集数据。为了挑战性别刻板印象并促进反思，我们以性别转换的方式呈现研究结果。这些人设的背景、国籍和年龄各不相同，并突显了一系列个人和职业挑战。关键主题包括自我怀疑、心理健康挣扎，以及我们称之为“好女孩综合征”的现象——一种与完美主义相关的内化压力。例如，非母语者Jakob描述了语言障碍和该领域女性稀缺如何影响职业发展。较年轻的从业者Andreas表达了对因年龄而不被认真对待的担忧。结果强调了以女性为中心的网络在分享经验和培养安全感方面的重要性，以及公司在招聘实践、薪资数据和女性领导层代表性方面进行开放沟通和保持透明的必要性。我们的研究为女性的职业路径提供了新视角，激励未来研究者，并提供了一套可操作策略，以考虑如何解决软件工程领域女性的留任问题。

import_candidates.title: "Maybe We Need Some More Examples:" Individual and Team Drivers of Developer GenAI Tool Use
import_candidates.abstract: Despite the widespread availability of generative AI tools in software engineering, developer adoption remains uneven. This unevenness is problematic because it hampers productivity efforts, frustrates management’s expectations, and creates uncertainty around the future roles of developers. Through paired interviews with 54 developers across 27 teams – one frequent and one infrequent user per team – we demonstrate that differences in usage result primarily from how developers perceive the tool (as a collaborator vs. feature), their engagement approach (experimental vs. conservative), and how they respond when encountering challenges (with adaptive persistence vs. quick abandonment). Our findings suggest that widespread organizational expectations for rapid productivity gains without sufficient investment in learning support can create a “Productivity Pressure Paradox,” undermining the very productivity benefits that motivate adoption.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 尽管生成式AI工具在软件工程中广泛可用，开发者的采用情况仍然不均衡。这种不均衡是有问题的，因为它阻碍了生产力提升努力，使管理层的期望受挫，并给开发者的未来角色带来不确定性。通过对来自27个团队的54名开发者进行配对访谈——每个团队一名频繁用户和一名不频繁用户——我们证明，使用差异主要源于开发者如何看待该工具（作为合作者还是功能）、他们的参与方式（实验性还是保守性），以及他们在遇到挑战时如何应对（适应性坚持还是迅速放弃）。我们的发现表明，组织若在没有足够学习支持投资的情况下，广泛期望快速获得生产力提升，可能会造成“生产力压力悖论”，反而削弱了促使采用的生产力收益。

import_candidates.title: "Game Changer" or "Overenthusiastic Drunk Acquaintance"? Generative AI Use by Blind and Low Vision Software Professionals in the Workplace
import_candidates.abstract: The software development workplace poses numerous technical and collaborative accessibility challenges for blind and low vision software professionals (BLVSPs). Though Generative AI (GenAI) is increasingly adopted within the software development industry and has been a rapidly growing topic of interest in research, to date, the unique perspectives of BLVSPs have yet to be consulted. We report on a qualitative study involving 39 semi-structured interviews with BLVSPs about what the introduction of GenAI has meant for their work. We found that BLVSPs used GenAI for many software development tasks, resulting in benefits such as increased productivity and accessibility. However, significant costs were also accompanied by GenAI use as they were more vulnerable to hallucinations than their sighted colleagues. Sometimes, organizational policies prevented use. Based on our findings, we discuss the higher-risks and higher-returns that BLVSPs had to carefully weigh when deciding whether and when to use GenAI tools for work.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 软件开发工作场所对盲人和低视力软件专业人员（BLVSPs）构成了许多技术和协作可访问性挑战。尽管生成式AI（GenAI）在软件开发行业中被越来越多地采用，并且已成为研究中快速增长的兴趣话题，但迄今为止，尚未咨询过BLVSPs的独特观点。我们报告了一项定性研究，涉及39次半结构化访谈，内容关于GenAI的引入对他们的工作意味着什么。我们发现BLVSPs将GenAI用于许多软件开发任务，从而带来了诸如提高生产力和可访问性等好处。然而，GenAI的使用也伴随着显著的成本，因为他们比视力正常的同事更容易受到幻觉的影响。有时，组织政策会阻止使用。基于我们的发现，我们讨论了BLVSPs在决定是否以及何时在工作中使用GenAI工具时必须仔细权衡的更高风险和更高回报。

import_candidates.title: Are Humans and LLMs Confused by the Same Code? An Empirical Study on Fixation-Related Potentials and LLM Perplexity
import_candidates.abstract: Already today, humans and programming assistants based on large language models (LLMs) collaborate in everyday programming tasks. Clearly, a misalignment between how LLMs and programmers comprehend code can lead to misunderstandings, inefficiencies, low code quality, and bugs. A key question in this space is whether humans and LLMs are confused by the same kind of code. This would not only guide our choices of integrating LLMs in software engineering workflows but also inform about possible improvements of LLMs. To this end, we conducted an empirical study comparing an LLM to human programmers comprehending clean and confusing code. We operationalized comprehension for the LLM by using LLM perplexity, and for human programmers using neurophysiological responses (in particular, EEG-based fixation-related potentials). We found that LLM perplexity spikes correlate, both in terms of location and amplitude, with human neurophysiological responses that indicate confusion. This result suggests that LLMs and humans are similarly confused about the code. Based on these findings, we devised a data-driven, LLM-based approach to identify regions of confusion in code that elicit confusion in human programmers.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 如今，人类和基于大语言模型（LLM）的编程助手已经在日常编程任务中协作。显然，LLM和程序员在理解代码方式上的不一致可能导致误解、低效、低代码质量和缺陷。该领域的一个关键问题是，人类和LLM是否会被同一类代码所困惑。这不仅将指导我们在软件工程工作流中集成LLM的选择，还将为LLM的潜在改进提供信息。为此，我们进行了一项实证研究，比较了一个LLM与人类程序员在理解清晰代码和令人困惑代码时的表现。我们通过使用LLM困惑度来操作化LLM的理解，并通过神经生理反应（特别是基于EEG的注视相关电位）来操作化人类程序员的理解。我们发现，LLM困惑度的峰值在位置和幅度上都与表明困惑的人类神经生理反应相关。这一结果表明，LLM和人类对代码的困惑是相似的。基于这些发现，我们设计了一种数据驱动的、基于LLM的方法，用于识别代码中引发人类程序员困惑的困惑区域。

import_candidates.title: Weak Programmers Need Not Apply, LLMs Welcome! Survey Screening in the AI Era
import_candidates.abstract: Quantitative research on software development practice often depends on the results of anonymous online surveys. However, it is difficult to verify that the respondents to such surveys are genuine developers, especially if survey responses are paid for, incentivising respondents to game the system and attracting the attention of bots and professional survey farms. One solution is to include screening questions to assess respondents’ coding skills, but this introduces the risk of unfairly excluding considered responses from developers who spent time and energy on the survey. We reviewed the responses of 86 developers who were excluded via screening from analysis of a large unpaid developer survey (n=1,048). We estimated that up to 86\% of the developers who were excluded were genuine developers. The advent of large language models (LLMs) casts further doubt on the use of screening questions. Investigating LLM ability, we found that five sample LLMs could answer most widely-used screening questions. Powerful LLM-based survey-taking tools now exist. We researched current survey screening techniques and found that they are susceptible to fraud via LLM use, bots and survey farms. Recruitment strategy may be a better screening technique. We recommend that if survey respondents are compensated only known developers should be invited. Surveys that are widely distributed, e.g. on social media, should not compensate respondents. Instead, researchers should focus on good survey design and sustained, imaginative recruitment strategies.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 关于软件开发实践的定量研究通常依赖于匿名在线调查的结果。然而，很难验证此类调查的受访者是否是真正的开发者，尤其是当调查回复获得报酬时，这会激励受访者钻系统空子，并吸引机器人和专业调查农场的注意。一种解决方案是加入筛选问题来评估受访者的编程能力，但这会带来不公平地排除那些在调查上花费了时间和精力的开发者的深思熟虑回复的风险。我们审查了在一项大型无报酬开发者调查（n=1,048）的分析中通过筛选被排除的86名开发者的回复。我们估计，被排除的开发者中高达86%是真正的开发者。大语言模型（LLM）的出现进一步让人质疑使用筛选问题的做法。在调查LLM的能力时，我们发现五个样本LLM能够回答大多数广泛使用的筛选问题。现在已有强大的基于LLM的调查作答工具。我们研究了当前的调查筛选技术，发现它们容易受到通过LLM使用、机器人和调查农场进行的欺诈。招募策略可能是一种更好的筛选技术。我们建议，如果调查受访者获得报酬，则只应邀请已知的开发者。广泛分发的调查（例如在社交媒体上）不应补偿受访者。相反，研究人员应专注于良好的调查设计和持续、富有想象力的招募策略。

import_candidates.title: Evolving with AI: A Longitudinal Analysis of Developer Logs
