import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）已迅速成为软件开发工作流中不可或缺的一部分，尤其是在调试、实现和代码优化等编码辅助任务（CAT）中。然而，LLM生成响应的可信度仍然是一个关键问题，因为幻觉（不正确或误导性的输出）会严重阻碍开发人员的生产力和软件可靠性。在本文中，我们介绍了TACO，一个用于在CAT场景中评估LLM信任度的综合框架。TACO联合评估LLM响应的代码质量以及与用户意图的一致性，从而实现细粒度且可解释的信任评估。我们构建了两个新的基准：TACO-Judge，一个用于验证评估方法的人工标注数据集；以及TACO-Eval，一个用于评估LLM在真实世界CAT问题上表现的大规模基准。通过大量实验，我们（1）证明了TACO作为自动评估器的准确性，（2）研究了LLM在给自己的输出评分时是否表现出自我偏好，以及（3）比较了若干最先进LLM在CAT场景中的可信度。我们的结果凸显了当前LLM的前景和局限性，并确立了TACO作为软件工程背景下可靠评估工具的定位。

import_candidates.title: Fairness Is Not Just Ethical: Performance Trade-Off via Data Correlation Tuning to Mitigate Bias in ML Software
import_candidates.abstract: Traditional software fairness research typically emphasizes ethical and social imperatives, neglecting that fairness fundamentally represents a core software quality issue arising directly from performance disparities across sensitive user groups. Recognizing fairness explicitly as a software quality dimension yields practical benefits beyond ethical considerations, notably improved predictive performance for unprivileged groups, enhanced out-of-distribution generalization, and increased geographic transferability in real-world deployments. Nevertheless, existing bias mitigation methods face a critical dilemma: while pre-processing methods offer broad applicability across model types, they generally fall short in effectiveness compared to post-processing techniques. To overcome this challenge, we propose Correlation Tuning (CoT), a novel pre-processing approach designed to mitigate bias by adjusting data correlations. Specifically, CoT introduces the Phi-coefficient, an intuitive correlation measure, to systematically quantify correlation between sensitive attributes and labels, and employs multi-objective optimization to address the proxy biases. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that CoT increases the true positive rate of unprivileged groups by an average of 17.5\% and reduces three key bias metrics, including statistical parity difference (SPD), average odds difference (AOD), and equal opportunity difference (EOD), by more than 50\% on average. CoT outperforms state-of-the-art methods by three and ten percentage points in single attribute and multiple attributes scenarios, respectively. We will publicly release our experimental results and source code to facilitate future research.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 传统软件公平性研究通常强调伦理和社会必要性，忽视了公平性从根本上代表了一个核心软件质量问题，直接源于不同敏感用户群体之间的性能差异。将公平性明确视为软件质量维度，会带来超越伦理考虑的实际好处，尤其是改善弱势群体的预测性能、增强分布外泛化能力以及提高现实部署中的地理可迁移性。然而，现有的偏差缓解方法面临一个关键困境：虽然预处理方法在不同模型类型上具有广泛适用性，但其效果通常不如后处理技术。为了克服这一挑战，我们提出了相关性调优（CoT），一种通过调整数据相关性来缓解偏差的新型预处理方法。具体而言，CoT引入了Phi系数这一直观的相关性度量，以系统地量化敏感属性与标签之间的相关性，并采用多目标优化来解决代理偏差。大量评估表明，CoT将弱势群体的真阳性率平均提高了17.5%，并将三个关键偏差指标——统计均等差异（SPD）、平均赔率差异（AOD）和机会均等差异（EOD）——平均降低了50%以上。在单属性和多属性场景中，CoT分别比最先进方法高出三个和十个百分点。我们将公开实验源代码和结果以促进未来研究。

import_candidates.title: VADA: A Multicultural Benchmark for Value-Aware Data Generation and Alignment Evaluation in LLMs
import_candidates.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) now sit inside an expanding set of intelligent software systems, from education assistants to legal advisory tools. When these systems ship to global users, ensuring their behavior respects diverse cultural values has become a pressing challenge for software engineers. Traditional software engineering methods such as unit testing and formal verification work well for functional requirements, but they struggle to encode and validate normative expectations like cultural sensitivity or moral appropriateness. To address this gap, we introduce VADA, a framework for testing and benchmarking LLMs under multiple cultural value systems. VADA builds test cases through a modular pipeline that generates scenarios and questions grounded in culturally defined value dimensions. The resulting suite covers 25 value dimensions drawn from China’s Core Values, EU’s fundamental rights framework, and Islamic ethical frameworks. VADA uses a Bayesian ensemble and assigns each evaluator a dimension specific weight based on its observed reliability to evaluate model responses, and we additionally fine tune a lightweight supervised evaluator using VADA generated data, offering a fast and scalable alternative to running multiple large evaluators. Using this pipeline, we build a large benchmark containing 11,865 automatically annotated cases, along with a human labeled subset of 1,000 instances for validation and evaluation. VADA substantially outperforms current prompt-based evaluators, reaching 93.6\% accuracy and showing strong alignment with human annotations. Ablation studies indicate that both evaluator diversity and reliability based weighting contribute to performance. VADA also supports comparative audits of recent LLMs and reveals inconsistent alignment across cultural dimensions. Together, these results suggest that VADA provides a robust basis for value aware evaluation and supports the development of culturally aligned LLM based systems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）如今已嵌入越来越多的智能软件系统中，从教育助手到法律咨询工具。当这些系统面向全球用户发布时，确保其行为尊重多元文化价值观已成为软件工程师面临的紧迫挑战。传统的软件工程方法（如单元测试和形式化验证）能很好地处理功能需求，但难以编码和验证诸如文化敏感性或道德适当性等规范性期望。为弥补这一空白，我们提出 VADA，一个用于在多种文化价值体系下测试和基准评测 LLM 的框架。VADA 通过模块化流水线构建测试用例，生成基于文化定义价值维度的场景和问题。由此得到的套件涵盖来自中国核心价值观、欧盟基本权利框架和伊斯兰伦理框架的 25 个价值维度。VADA 使用贝叶斯集成，并根据每个评估器观察到的可靠性为其分配维度特定的权重来评估模型响应；此外，我们利用 VADA 生成的数据微调了一个轻量级监督评估器，为运行多个大型评估器提供了快速且可扩展的替代方案。利用这一流水线，我们构建了一个包含 11,865 个自动标注案例的大型基准，以及一个由 1,000 个实例组成的人工标注子集用于验证和评估。VADA 显著优于当前基于提示的评估器，达到 93.6% 的准确率，并与人工标注高度一致。消融研究表明，评估器多样性和基于可靠性的加权都有助于提升性能。VADA 还支持对近期 LLM 进行比较审计，并揭示跨文化维度上不一致的对齐情况。总之，这些结果表明 VADA 为价值感知评估提供了稳健基础，并支持开发文化对齐的基于 LLM 的系统。

import_candidates.title: Testora: Using Natural Language Intent to Detect Behavioral Regressions
import_candidates.abstract: As software is evolving, code changes can introduce regression bugs or affect the behavior in other unintended ways. Traditional regression test generation is impractical for detecting unintended behavioral changes, because it reports all behavioral differences as potential regressions. However, most code changes are intended to change the behavior in some way, e.g., to fix a bug or to add a new feature. This paper presents Testora, the first automated approach that detects regressions by comparing the intentions of a code change against behavioral differences caused by the code change. Given a pull request (PR), Testora queries an LLM to generate tests that exercise the modified code, compares the behavior of the original and modified code, and classifies any behavioral differences as intended or unintended. For the classification, we present an LLM-based technique that leverages the natural language information associated with the PR, such as the title, description, and commit messages – effectively using the natural language intent to detect behavioral regressions. Applying Testora to PRs of complex and popular Python projects, we find 19 regression bugs and 11 PRs that, despite having another intention, coincidentally fix a bug. Out of 13 regressions reported to the developers, 11 have been confirmed and 9 have already been fixed. The costs of using Testora are acceptable for real-world deployment, with 12.3 minutes to check a PR and LLM costs of only $0.003 per PR. We envision our approach to be used before or shortly after a code change gets merged into a code base, providing a way to early on detect regressions that are not caught by traditional approaches.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着软件的发展，代码更改可能会引入回归错误或以其他方式影响行为。传统的回归测试生成对于检测意外的行为变化是不切实际的，因为它将所有行为差异报告为潜在回归。然而，大多数代码更改旨在以某种方式改变行为，例如，修复错误或添加新功能。本文提出了Testora，这是第一个通过比较代码更改的意图与代码更改引起的行为差异来自动检测回归的方法。给定一个拉取请求（PR），Testora查询LLM以生成测试修改后的代码，比较原始代码和修改后代码的行为，并将任何行为差异分类为有意的或无意的。对于分类，我们提出了一种基于LLM的技术，该技术利用与PR相关的自然语言信息，如标题、描述和提交消息——有效地使用自然语言意图来检测行为回归。将Testora应用于复杂且流行的Python项目的PR，我们发现了19个回归错误和11个PR，尽管有其他意图，却偶然修复了一个错误。在向开发人员报告的13个回归中，11个已被确认，9个已被修复。使用Testora的成本对于实际部署来说是可以接受的，检查一个PR需要12.3分钟，每个PR的LLM成本仅为0.003美元。我们设想我们的方法在代码更改合并到代码库之前或之后不久使用，提供了一种早期检测传统方法未捕获的回归的方法。

import_candidates.title: CoReX: Context-Aware Refinement-Based Slicing for Debugging Regression Failures
import_candidates.abstract: Troubleshooting regression failures is one of the most frequent yet time-consuming development tasks. To help with this task, numerous approaches aim to narrow down developers’ attention to the subset of code statements relevant to the failure. The most prominent of these approaches are based on program slicing, as slicing not only identifies a subset of relevant statements but also maintains the flow of information between these statements.By surveying more than 50 practitioners from eight different countries, we observe that existing dual-version slicing-based approaches have two main limitations: (a) to minimize the number of statements presented to the developer, they omit contextual information required to truly understand the failure and (b) to keep information propagation between the statements in the slice intact, they include lengthy computations that are not necessary to understand the failure. We use these observations to define a new dual-version slicing approach for regression scenarios, called CoReX. We evaluate CoReX on a large number of subjects, comparing it with other existing dual-version slicing approaches. The results of our evaluation show that CoReX outperforms these approaches both in the quantitative metrics used in prior work and in alignment with developers’ expectations. We believe our work provides grounds for efficient integration of slicing-based approaches into development workflows.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 排查回归失败是最常见但最耗时的开发任务之一。为帮助完成此任务，许多方法旨在将开发者的注意力缩小到与失败相关的代码语句子集。其中最突出的方法基于程序切片，因为切片不仅识别相关语句子集，还保持这些语句之间的信息流。通过调查来自八个国家的50多名从业者，我们观察到现有的双版本切片方法有两个主要局限性：(a) 为了最小化呈现给开发者的语句数量，它们省略了真正理解失败所需的上下文信息；(b) 为了保持切片中语句之间的信息传播完整，它们包含了理解失败所不需要的冗长计算。我们利用这些观察定义了一种新的用于回归场景的双版本切片方法，称为CoReX。我们在大量对象上评估CoReX，并将其与其他现有的双版本切片方法进行比较。评估结果表明，CoReX在先前工作中使用的定量指标以及与开发者期望的一致性方面均优于这些方法。我们相信我们的工作为将基于切片的方法高效集成到开发工作流中提供了基础。

import_candidates.title: Test Flimsiness: Characterizing Flakiness Induced by Mutation to the Code Under Test
import_candidates.abstract: Flaky tests, which fail non-deterministically against the same version of code, pose a well-established challenge to software developers. In this paper, we characterize the overlooked phenomenon of test FLIMsiness: FLakiness Induced by Mutations to the code under test. These mutations are generated by the same operators found in standard mutation testing tools. Flimsiness has profound implications for software testing researchers. Previous studies quantified the impact of pre-existing flaky tests on mutation testing, but we reveal that mutations themselves can induce flakiness, exposing a previously neglected threat. This has serious effects beyond mutation testing, calling into question the reliability of any technique that relies on deterministic test outcomes in response to mutations.On the other hand, flimsiness presents an opportunity to surface potential flakiness that may otherwise remain hidden. Prior work perturbed the execution environment to augment rerunning-based detection and the test code to support benchmarking. We advance these efforts by perturbing a third major source of flakiness: the code under test. We conducted an empirical study on over half a million test suite executions across 28 Python projects. Our statistical analysis on over 30 million mutant-test pairs unveiled flimsiness in 54\% of projects. We found that extending the standard rerunning flaky test detection strategy with code-under-test mutations detects a substantially larger number of flaky tests (median 740 vs. 163) and uncovers many that the standard strategy is unlikely to detect.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 波动性测试（即在同一代码版本上非确定性地失败的测试）对软件开发者构成了公认的挑战。本文刻画了一个被忽视的现象：测试脆弱性（FLIMsiness），即由被测代码变异引起的波动性。这些变异由标准变异测试工具中相同的变异算子生成。脆弱性对软件测试研究者具有深远影响。此前的研究量化了预先存在的波动性测试对变异测试的影响，但我们揭示变异本身可以诱发波动性，暴露了一个此前被忽视的威胁。这对变异测试之外也有严重影响，质疑任何依赖于对变异产生确定性测试结果的技术的可靠性。另一方面，脆弱性提供了一个机会，可以揭示原本可能隐藏的潜在波动性。先前的工作通过扰动执行环境来增强基于重运行的检测，并扰动测试代码以支持基准测试。我们通过扰动波动性的第三个主要来源——被测代码——来推进这些工作。我们对28个Python项目中的超过50万次测试套件执行进行了实证研究。我们对超过3000万个变异-测试对的统计分析在54%的项目中揭示了脆弱性。我们发现，将标准重运行波动性测试检测策略扩展到包含被测代码变异，可以检测到数量显著更多的波动性测试（中位数740对163），并揭示许多标准策略不太可能检测到的测试。

import_candidates.title: E-Test: E'er-Improving Test Suites
import_candidates.abstract: Test suites are inherently imperfect, and testers can always enrich a suite with new test cases that improve its quality and, consequently, the reliability of the target software system. However, finding test cases that explore execution scenarios beyond the scope of an existing suite can be extremely challenging and labor-intensive, particularly when managing large test suites over extended periods.In this paper, we propose E-Test, an approach that reduces the gap between the execution space explored with a test suite and the executions experienced in production. E-Test (i) identifies executions that have not yet been tested from large sets of scenarios, such as those monitored during intensive production usage, and (ii) generates new test cases that enhance the test suite. E-Test leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to pinpoint scenarios that the current test suite does not adequately cover, and augments the suite with test cases that execute these scenarios.Our evaluation on a dataset of 1,975 execution scenarios demonstrates that E-Test identifies not-yet-tested execution scenarios significantly better than state-of-the-art approaches. While existing regression testing and field testing approaches for this task achieve a maximum F1-score of 0.34, and vanilla LLMs achieve a maximum F1-score of 0.39, E-Test reaches 0.55.These results highlight the impact of E-Test in enhancing test suites by effectively targeting not-yet-tested execution scenarios and reducing manual effort required for maintaining test suites.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 测试套件本质上是不完美的，测试人员总是可以通过新的测试用例来丰富套件，从而提高其质量，进而提升目标软件系统的可靠性。然而，找到能够探索现有套件范围之外的执行场景的测试用例可能极具挑战且耗费人力，尤其是在长期管理大型测试套件时。在本文中，我们提出E-Test，一种缩小测试套件所探索的执行空间与生产环境中实际执行之间差距的方法。E-Test (i) 从大量场景（例如在生产密集使用期间监控到的场景）中识别尚未测试的执行，并 (ii) 生成增强测试套件的新测试用例。E-Test利用大型语言模型（LLM）来精确找出当前测试套件未充分覆盖的场景，并用执行这些场景的测试用例来扩充套件。我们在一个包含1,975个执行场景的数据集上的评估表明，E-Test在识别尚未测试的执行场景方面显著优于最先进的方法。虽然现有的回归测试和现场测试方法在此任务上最高F1分数为0.34，而普通LLM最高为0.39，但E-Test达到了0.55。这些结果突显了E-Test通过有效针对尚未测试的执行场景并减少维护测试套件所需的人工投入来增强测试套件的影响力。

import_candidates.title: Repair Ingredients Are All You Need: Improving Large Language Model-Based Program Repair via Repair Ingredients Search
import_candidates.abstract: Automated Program Repair (APR) techniques aim to automatically fix buggy programs. Among these, Large Language Model-based (LLM-based) approaches have shown great promise. Recent advances demonstrate that directly leveraging LLMs can achieve leading results. However, these techniques remain suboptimal in generating contextually relevant and accurate patches, as they often overlook repair ingredients crucial for practical program repair. In this paper, we propose ReinFix, a novel framework that enables LLMs to autonomously search for repair ingredients throughout both the reasoning and solution phases of bug fixing. In the reasoning phase, ReinFix integrates static analysis tools to retrieve internal ingredients, such as variable definitions, to assist the LLM in root cause analysis when it encounters difficulty understanding the context. During the solution phase, when the LLM lacks experience in fixing specific bugs, ReinFix searches for external ingredients from historical bug fixes with similar bug patterns, leveraging both the buggy code and its root cause to guide the LLM in identifying appropriate repair actions, thereby increasing the likelihood of generating correct patches. Evaluations on two popular benchmarks (Defects4J V1.2 and V2.0) demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach over SOTA baselines. Notably, ReinFix fixes 146 bugs, which is 32 more than the baselines on Defects4J V1.2. On Defects4J V2.0, ReinFix fixes 38 more bugs than the SOTA. Importantly, when evaluating on the recent benchmarks that are free of data leakage risk, ReinFix also maintains the best performance.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 自动程序修复（APR）技术旨在自动修复有错误的程序。其中，基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法已展现出巨大前景。最近的进展表明，直接利用LLM可以达到领先的结果。然而，这些技术仍然难以生成上下文相关且准确的补丁，因为它们常常忽略了实际程序修复中至关重要的修复要素。在本文中，我们提出了ReinFix，一种新颖的框架，使LLM能够在错误修复的推理和解决两个阶段自主搜索修复要素。在推理阶段，ReinFix集成静态分析工具来检索内部要素，例如变量定义，以在LLM遇到理解上下文的困难时帮助其进行根因分析。在解决阶段，当LLM缺乏修复特定错误的经验时，ReinFix从具有相似错误模式的历史错误修复中搜索外部要素，利用有错误的代码及其根因来指导LLM识别适当的修复动作，从而增加生成正确补丁的可能性。在两个流行基准（Defects4J V1.2和V2.0）上的评估证明了我们的方法优于SOTA基线。值得注意的是，ReinFix在Defects4J V1.2上修复了146个错误，比基线多32个。在Defects4J V2.0上，ReinFix比SOTA多修复了38个错误。重要的是，在最近没有数据泄漏风险的基准上进行评估时，ReinFix也保持了最佳性能。

import_candidates.title: Breaking Single-Tester Limits: Multi-Agent LLMs for Multi-User Feature Testing
import_candidates.abstract: The growing dependence on mobile phones and their apps has made multi-user interactive features—like chat calls, live streaming, and video conferencing—indispensable for bridging the gaps in social connectivity caused by physical and situational barriers. However, automating these interactive features for testing is fraught with challenges, owing to their inherent need for timely, dynamic, and collaborative user interactions, which current automated testing methods inadequately address. Inspired by the concept of agents designed to autonomously and collaboratively tackle problems, we propose MAdroid, a novel multi-agent approach powered by the Large Language Models (LLMs) to automate the multi-user interactive task for app feature testing. Specifically, MAdroid employs two functional types of multi-agents: user agents (Operator) and supervisor agents (Coordinator and Observer). Each agent takes a specific role: the Coordinator directs the interactive task; the Operator mimics user interactions on the device; and the Observer monitors and reviews the task automation process. Our evaluation, which included 41 multi-user interactive tasks, demonstrates the effectiveness of our approach, achieving 82.9\% of the tasks with 96.8\% action similarity, outperforming the ablation studies and state-of-the-art baselines. Additionally, a preliminary investigation underscores MAdroid’s practicality by helping identify 11 multi-user interactive bugs during regression app testing, confirming its potential value in real-world software development contexts.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 移动电话及其应用日益普及，使得聊天通话、直播和视频会议等多用户交互功能成为弥合由物理和情境障碍造成的社会连接鸿沟不可或缺的手段。然而，由于这些功能本质上需要及时、动态和协作的用户交互，自动化测试面临诸多挑战，现有的自动化测试方法无法充分应对。受能够自主协作解决问题的智能体概念的启发，我们提出 MAdroid，一种由大语言模型驱动的新型多智能体方法，用于自动化应用功能测试中的多用户交互任务。具体而言，MAdroid 采用两类功能性多智能体：用户智能体（Operator）和监督智能体（Coordinator 和 Observer）。每个智能体承担特定角色：Coordinator 指导交互任务；Operator 在设备上模拟用户交互；Observer 监控并审查任务自动化过程。我们的评估包含 41 个多用户交互任务，证明了该方法的有效性，以 96.8% 的动作相似度完成了 82.9% 的任务，优于消融研究和最先进的基线。此外，一项初步调查通过帮助在回归应用测试期间识别出 11 个多用户交互缺陷，凸显了 MAdroid 的实用性，证实了其在真实软件开发场景中的潜在价值。

import_candidates.title: EchoFuzz: Empowering Smart Contract Fuzzing with Large Language Models
import_candidates.abstract: Smart contracts, serving as the cornerstone of decentralized applications, autonomously manage trillion-dollar digital assets, making them attractive targets for attacks. Fuzzing has emerged as a promising technique for detecting vulnerabilities in smart contracts, yet existing methods face two main challenges. (1) The logical gap in state transitions and combinatorial redundancy hinders effective tradeoffs between bug detection efficiency and state space exploration cost, leading to critical execution paths to be overlooked. (2) Rule-based sequence mutation strategies suffer from path redundancy and inadequate guidance from contract logic, resulting in performance bottlenecks that stall the exploration of in-depth vulnerability-oriented paths.To tackle these challenges, we propose EchoFuzz, an LLM-guided fuzzing framework introducing Vulnerable Function Call Sequences (VFCS) - minimal, behavior-preserving execution paths that expose bugs through key state transitions. EchoFuzz consists of two key procedures. First, we develop a chain-guided LLM approach, that combines static analysis with logical understanding to generate contract-specific VFCS candidates that eliminate combinatorial redundancy. Second, we adopt an iterative fuzzing strategy that uses LLMs with real-time feedback to adaptively steer fuzzer toward uncovered branches. Experiments show EchoFuzz outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving 29\% higher branch coverage and detecting 62\% more vulnerabilities. It also found 37 previously unknown vulnerabilities in real contracts, showing strong practicality.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 智能合约作为去中心化应用的基石，自主管理着数万亿美元的数字资产，因而成为攻击者的诱人目标。模糊测试已成为检测智能合约漏洞的一种有前景的技术，但现有方法面临两大挑战。(1) 状态转换中的逻辑鸿沟与组合冗余阻碍了在缺陷检测效率与状态空间探索成本之间进行有效权衡，导致关键执行路径被忽视。(2) 基于规则的序列变异策略存在路径冗余且缺乏来自合约逻辑的充分指导，造成性能瓶颈，使面向深度漏洞的路径探索停滞。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 EchoFuzz，一个由大语言模型引导的模糊测试框架，引入易受攻击函数调用序列（VFCS）——通过关键状态转换暴露缺陷的最小化、行为保持的执行路径。EchoFuzz 包含两个关键过程。首先，我们开发了一种链引导的大语言模型方法，将静态分析与逻辑理解相结合，生成合约特定的 VFCS 候选，从而消除组合冗余。其次，我们采用迭代式模糊测试策略，利用大语言模型和实时反馈自适应地引导模糊器走向未覆盖的分支。实验表明 EchoFuzz 优于最先进方法，分支覆盖率提高 29%，检测到的漏洞多 62%。它还在真实合约中发现了 37 个先前未知的漏洞，展现出很强的实用性。

import_candidates.title: MioHint: LLM-Assisted Request Mutation for Whitebox REST API Testing
import_candidates.abstract: Cloud applications heavily rely on APIs to communicate with each other and exchange data. To ensure the reliability of cloud applications, cloud providers widely adopt API testing techniques. Unfortunately, existing API testing approaches are insufficient to reach strict conditions, a problem known as fitness plateaus, due to the lack of a gradient provided by coverage metrics. To address this issue, we propose MioHint, a novel white-box API testing approach that leverages the code comprehension capabilities of Large Language Model (LLM) to boost API testing. The key challenge of LLM-based API testing lies in system-level testing, which emphasizes the dependencies between requests and targets across functions and files, thereby making the entire codebase the object of analysis. However, feeding the entire codebase to an LLM is impractical due to its limited context length and short memory. MioHint addresses this challenge by synergizing static analysis with LLMs. We retrieve relevant code with data-dependency analysis at the statement level, including def-use analysis for variables used in the target and function expansion for subfunctions called by the target.To evaluate the effectiveness of our method, we conducted experiments across 16 real-world REST API services. The findings reveal that MioHint achieves an average increase of 4.95\% absolute in line coverage compared to the baseline, EvoMaster, alongside a remarkable factor of 67 {\texttimes} improvement in mutation accuracy. Furthermore, our method successfully covers over 57\% of hard-to-cover targets, while in the baseline, the coverage is less than 10\%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 云应用严重依赖API相互通信和交换数据。为确保云应用的可靠性，云提供商广泛采用API测试技术。不幸的是，现有API测试方法由于覆盖率指标缺乏梯度，不足以达到严格条件，这一问题被称为适应度高原（fitness plateaus）。为解决该问题，我们提出MioHint，一种新颖的白盒API测试方法，利用大语言模型（LLM）的代码理解能力来提升API测试。基于LLM的API测试的关键挑战在于系统级测试，它强调跨函数和跨文件的请求与目标之间的依赖关系，从而使整个代码库成为分析对象。然而，由于LLM上下文长度有限且记忆短，将整个代码库输入LLM是不切实际的。MioHint通过将静态分析与LLM协同来解决这一挑战。我们在语句级别通过数据依赖分析检索相关代码，包括对目标中使用的变量进行定义-使用分析，以及对目标调用的子函数进行函数展开。为评估方法有效性，我们在16个真实世界的REST API服务上进行了实验。结果表明，与基线EvoMaster相比，MioHint在行覆盖率上平均绝对提升4.95%，突变准确率显著提升67倍。此外，我们的方法成功覆盖了超过57%的难以覆盖目标，而基线覆盖率不到10%。

import_candidates.title: Think Outside the Box: Automating Inter-App Functionality Testing via Memory Implanting and Reasoning
import_candidates.abstract: Inter-app functionality requires multiple apps to collaborate to complete a functional task, which has become essential in modern software ecosystems. However, due to the dynamic updates and openness of modern apps, automated GUI testing based on predefined interaction models or trained on historical data is difficult to achieve inter-app testing. The low fault tolerance and context-dependent characteristics of inter-app functionality paths, lead the LLM-based GUI testing to have UI semantic mapping ambiguity and irreversible operation generating problem. To address these challenges, this paper proposes InterDroid, an automated GUI testing approach that enhances inter-app testing by implanting structured semantic knowledge into LLM’s memory. InterDroid retrieves relevant historical inter-app interactions using a multimodal retrieval method that integrates visual and textual GUI information, significantly improving retrieval accuracy. Inspired by the research on memory implantation in cognitive psychology, we design a memory implanting mechanism: global memory presents inter-app paths in a conversational form, simulating prior testing experience, and local memory tracks real-time state transitions. Additionally, InterDroid proposes a testing monitor that dynamically tracks testing progress and detects deviations, ensuring comprehensive test execution. InterDroid is designed as an integrable module that activates upon detecting the transition of the app to another app, allowing existing automated GUI testing tools to continue seamlessly after inter-app testing is completed. We evaluate InterDroid on 100 inter-app functionalities across 63 apps, comparing it with state-of-the-art GUI testing baselines. InterDroid achieves up to 133\% improvement in page coverage, 124\% in action coverage, and 268\% in exact match accuracy over the best baseline. Furthermore, InterDroid detects 43 new crash bugs in real-world apps from Google Play, with 31 fixed and 12 confirmed by developers.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 跨应用功能需要多个应用协作完成一项功能任务，这已成为现代软件生态系统中不可或缺的一部分。然而，由于现代应用的动态更新和开放性，基于预定义交互模型或历史数据训练的自动化GUI测试难以实现跨应用测试。跨应用功能路径的低容错性和上下文依赖特性，导致基于LLM的GUI测试存在UI语义映射模糊和不可逆操作生成问题。为应对这些挑战，本文提出InterDroid，一种通过将结构化语义知识植入LLM记忆来增强跨应用测试的自动化GUI测试方法。InterDroid使用融合视觉和文本GUI信息的多模态检索方法检索相关的历史跨应用交互，显著提高了检索准确性。受认知心理学中记忆植入研究的启发，我们设计了一种记忆植入机制：全局记忆以对话形式呈现跨应用路径，模拟先前的测试经验，局部记忆跟踪实时状态转换。此外，InterDroid提出了一种测试监视器，动态跟踪测试进度并检测偏差，确保全面执行测试。InterDroid被设计为一个可集成模块，在检测到应用跳转到另一个应用时激活，使现有的自动化GUI测试工具能够在跨应用测试完成后无缝继续。我们在63个应用中的100个跨应用功能上评估InterDroid，并将其与最先进的GUI测试基线进行比较。InterDroid在页面覆盖率上提升高达133%，动作覆盖率提升124%，精确匹配准确率提升268%，超过最佳基线。此外，InterDroid在来自Google Play的真实应用中检测到43个新崩溃漏洞，其中31个已修复，12个已由开发者确认。

import_candidates.title: Predicting Failures in Smart Human-Centric Ecosystems
import_candidates.abstract: Smart cities, smart grids, and in general Smart Human-centric Ecosystems (SHEs) emerge from the co-existence of many systems that operate according to independently owned specifications, and evolve over time. SHEs may fail despite the correct behavior of the systems that comprise the SHEs. Fully testing SHEs on testbeds to prevent failures in production is impossible, and scenarios that may lead to catastrophic SHE failures are unavoidable.In this paper we frame the core issues of SHE failures, and propose Smart human-centric Ecosystem Monitoring, SEM, an approach that predicts SHE failures to enable corrective actions for mitigating the catastrophic effects of failures. SEM identifies failure-prone scenarios from the reconstruction error of SHE indicators, that is, metric values that SEM collects from the SHE at constant frequency. SEM computes the reconstruction error with a suitably trained denoising autoencoder combined with a transformer architecture. The results of experimenting with a peer-to-peer ride-hailing ecosystem operating in San Francisco confirm that SEM can effectively predict SHE failures early enough to activate preventing actions, and indicate the generalizability of SEM with continual learning.The main contributions of the paper are the definition and the exemplification of the impact of failures in SHEs, and an approach to detect incoming failures before otherwise inevitable disruptive effects.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 智能城市、智能电网，以及一般的智能以人为中心的生态系统（SHEs）源于许多系统的共存，这些系统按照各自独立拥有的规范运行，并随时间演变。尽管组成SHE的系统行为正确，SHE仍可能发生故障。在测试床上全面测试SHE以预防生产中的故障是不可能的，而可能导致灾难性SHE故障的场景也是不可避免的。在本文中，我们框定了SHE故障的核心问题，并提出了智能以人为中心的生态系统监控（SEM），一种预测SHE故障的方法，以便采取纠正措施来缓解故障的灾难性影响。SEM从SHE指标的重构误差中识别易发生故障的场景，这些指标是SEM以恒定频率从SHE收集的度量值。SEM使用适当训练的降噪自编码器与transformer架构相结合来计算重构误差。在旧金山运行的点对点网约车生态系统上进行的实验结果证实，SEM能够有效地提前预测SHE故障，从而激活预防措施，并表明SEM通过持续学习具有泛化能力。本文的主要贡献是定义和例证SHE中故障的影响，以及一种在否则不可避免的破坏性影响发生之前检测即将发生的故障的方法。

import_candidates.title: Scalpel: Automotive Deep Learning Framework Testing via Assembling Model Components
import_candidates.abstract: Deep learning (DL) plays a key role in autonomous driving systems. DL models support perception modules, equipped with tasks such as object detection and sensor fusion. These DL models enable vehicles to process multi-sensor inputs to understand complex surroundings. Deploying DL models in autonomous driving systems faces stringent challenges, including real-time processing, limited computational resources, and strict power constraints. To address these challenges, automotive DL frameworks (e.g., PaddleInference) have emerged to optimize inference efficiency. However, these frameworks encounter unique quality issues due to their more complex deployment environments, such as crashes stemming from limited scheduled memory and incorrect memory allocation. Unfortunately, existing DL framework testing methods fail to detect these quality issues due to the failure in deploying generated test input models, as these models lack three essential capabilities: (1) multi-input/output tensor processing, (2) multi-modal data processing, and (3) multi-level data feature extraction. These capabilities necessitate specialized model components, which existing testing methods neglect during model generation. To bridge this gap, we propose Scalpel, an automotive DL frameworks testing method that generates test input models at the model component level. Scalpel generates models by assembling model components (heads, necks, backbones) to support capabilities required by autonomous driving systems. Specifically, Scalpel maintains and updates a repository of model components, generating test inputs by selecting, mutating, and assembling them. Successfully generated models are added back to enrich the repository. Newly generated models are then deployed within the autonomous driving system to test automotive DL frameworks via differential testing. The experimental results demonstrate that Scalpel outperforms existing methods in both effectiveness and efficiency. In Apollo, Scalpel detects 16 crashes and 21 NaN \& inconsistency bugs. All detected bugs have been reported to open-source communities, with 10 crashes confirmed. Scalpel achieves 27.44 {\texttimes} and 8.5 {\texttimes} improvements in model generation efficiency and bug detection efficiency. Additionally, Scalpel detects nine crashes and 16 NaN \& inconsistency bugs in Autoware, which shows its excellent generalization.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 深度学习（DL）在自动驾驶系统中起着关键作用。DL模型支持感知模块，具备目标检测和传感器融合等任务。这些DL模型使车辆能够处理多传感器输入以理解复杂环境。在自动驾驶系统中部署DL模型面临严峻挑战，包括实时处理、有限的计算资源和严格的功耗约束。为应对这些挑战，汽车DL框架（如PaddleInference）应运而生，以优化推理效率。然而，这些框架由于其更复杂的部署环境而遇到独特质量问题，例如由有限调度内存和错误内存分配引起的崩溃。不幸的是，现有的DL框架测试方法无法检测这些质量问题，因为它们无法部署生成的测试输入模型，这些模型缺乏三项基本能力：(1) 多输入/输出张量处理，(2) 多模态数据处理，以及 (3) 多级数据特征提取。这些能力需要专门的模型组件，而现有测试方法在模型生成过程中忽略了这些组件。为弥补这一差距，我们提出Scalpel，一种在模型组件级别生成测试输入模型的汽车DL框架测试方法。Scalpel通过组装模型组件（heads、necks、backbones）来生成模型，以支持自动驾驶系统所需的能力。具体而言，Scalpel维护并更新模型组件仓库，通过选择、变异和组装它们来生成测试输入。成功生成的模型被添加回仓库以丰富它。然后，新生成的模型被部署在自动驾驶系统内，通过差分测试来测试汽车DL框架。实验结果表明，Scalpel在有效性和效率上均优于现有方法。在Apollo中，Scalpel检测到16个崩溃和21个NaN与不一致性错误。所有检测到的错误均已报告给开源社区，其中10个崩溃得到确认。Scalpel在模型生成效率和错误检测效率上分别实现了27.44倍和8.5倍的提升。此外，Scalpel在Autoware中检测到9个崩溃和16个NaN与不一致性错误，显示出其出色的泛化能力。

import_candidates.title: DeFT: Maintaining Determinism and Extracting Unit Tests for Autonomous Driving Planning
import_candidates.abstract: An Autonomous Driving System (ADS) is a complex software system often composed of multiple modules, each responsible for its own set of tasks. The ADS planning module is responsible for planning the autonomous vehicle’s future driving trajectories and has historically been the most buggy ADS module. In recent years, many approaches have been proposed to test an ADS in complex virtual scenarios through simulation, and these scenarios have been effective in revealing the ADS’s suboptimal decisions. However, due to the randomness of events that occur during the real-time execution of an ADS, test scenarios tend to produce varying outcomes and, in turn, make ADS testing non-deterministic, flaky, and unpredictable. To address this challenge, we propose and evaluate DeFT, an approach that extracts deterministic test cases for the ADS planning module from non-deterministic system-level scenario tests. DeFT monitors the messages exchanged by ADS modules during the execution of system-level scenario tests and reconstructs inputs to reproduce the planning module’s execution. By using DeFT, we find that planning module tests can (1) more accurately reproduce planning module executions that occurred during system-level scenario tests, (2) be used to deterministically detect the same 658 collision failures revealed by system-level scenario tests, and (3) reduce the time needed to reproduce failures by 43.69\% to 77.64\%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 自动驾驶系统（ADS）是一个复杂的软件系统，通常由多个模块组成，每个模块负责自己的任务集。ADS规划模块负责规划自动驾驶车辆的未来行驶轨迹，历来是ADS中缺陷最多的模块。近年来，许多方法被提出通过仿真在复杂虚拟场景中测试ADS，这些场景能有效揭示ADS的次优决策。然而，由于ADS实时执行过程中事件的随机性，测试场景往往产生不同结果，进而使ADS测试变得非确定性、不稳定且不可预测。为应对这一挑战，我们提出并评估了DeFT，一种从非确定性的系统级场景测试中为ADS规划模块提取确定性测试用例的方法。DeFT监控ADS模块在系统级场景测试执行期间交换的消息，并重建输入以复现规划模块的执行。通过使用DeFT，我们发现规划模块测试能够（1）更准确地复现系统级场景测试期间发生的规划模块执行，（2）确定性地检测系统级场景测试所揭示的相同658个碰撞失败，并且（3）将复现失败所需时间减少43.69%至77.64%。

import_candidates.title: Temporal Specification Oriented Fuzzing for Trigger-Action-Programming Smart Home Integrations
import_candidates.abstract: The convergence of Internet of Things (IoT) and home automation (HA) has revolutionized human-device interaction, typically through trigger-action programming paradigms such as If This Then That (IFTTT). While empowering user-customized automation, this integration introduces critical challenges: unexpected behaviors from improper rule configurations, and cybersecurity threats propagated through interconnected rule chains. Researchers model the integrations with the finite state machine, characterize these risks using linear temporal logic (LTL), and employ model checking techniques to check whether the system conforms to the properties. However, model checking suffers from the inherent state space explosion problem, so that relevant methods face difficulty in handling large-scale systems. Furthermore, the HA-IoT domain notably lacks standardized benchmark datasets for validating LTL-related methods.To efficiently detect LTL specification violations in smart home integrations, we propose HAFuzz - an innovative framework that combines formal methods with fuzzing techniques. Within the fuzzing process, we use Runtime Verification (RV) techniques to check violations within finite steps and guide the fuzzing seed selection. We further incorporate manually created specifications with large language model (LLM)-driven mutation generation, enabling systematic test case augmentation. Extensive evaluation demonstrates that HAFuzz achieves violation detection within 500 ms under typical scenarios, showing superior efficiency improvements compared to conventional approaches. Furthermore, comprehensive validation involving 3,343 LTL specifications confirms HAFuzz’s accuracy and effectiveness in identifying critical violations, particularly in large-scale deployments characterized by intricate rule interdependencies and specifications that feature complex temporal logic patterns.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 物联网（IoT）与家庭自动化（HA）的融合彻底改变了人机交互，通常通过诸如 If This Then That (IFTTT) 之类的触发-动作编程范式实现。这种集成在赋予用户自定义自动化能力的同时，也带来了严峻挑战：不当规则配置导致的意外行为，以及通过相互连接的规则链传播的网络安全威胁。研究人员用有限状态机对集成建模，使用线性时序逻辑（LTL）刻画这些风险，并采用模型检测技术检查系统是否满足属性。然而，模型检测受制于固有的状态空间爆炸问题，导致相关方法难以处理大规模系统。此外，HA-IoT 领域显著缺乏用于验证 LTL 相关方法的标准化基准数据集。为了高效检测智能家居集成中的 LTL 规范违反，我们提出 HAFuzz——一个将形式化方法与模糊测试技术相结合的新颖框架。在模糊测试过程中，我们使用运行时验证（RV）技术在有限步骤内检查违反，并指导模糊测试种子选择。我们进一步将人工创建的规范与大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的变异生成相结合，实现系统化的测试用例增强。大量评估表明，HAFuzz 在典型场景下能在 500 毫秒内实现违反检测，相比传统方法展现出更优的效率提升。此外，涉及 3,343 条 LTL 规范的全面验证证实了 HAFuzz 在识别关键违反方面的准确性和有效性，尤其是在具有复杂规则相互依赖的大规模部署以及具有复杂时序逻辑模式的规范中。

import_candidates.title: Fuzzing JavaScript Engines by Fusing JavaScript and WebAssembly
import_candidates.abstract: JavaScript engines are a fundamental part of modern browsers, and many efforts have been invested in testing them to enhance their security. However, the incorporation of WebAssembly into JavaScript engines introduces new attack surfaces that have not received sufficient attention. Existing fuzzers for JavaScript engines primarily focus on JavaScript, neglecting WebAssembly code and its interactions with JavaScript. We introduce Mad-Eye, the first fuzzer that can test the JavaScript-WebAssembly interaction using a novel cross-language code fusion technique. Evaluations of Mad-Eye on V8, SpiderMonkey, and JavaScriptCore detected 21 previously unknown vulnerabilities, with 20 confirmed and 18 fixed and merged into mainstream browsers by the developers, who acknowledged our reports with vulnerability bounties.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: JavaScript引擎是现代浏览器的基本组成部分，许多工作已投入对其测试以增强安全性。然而，将WebAssembly集成到JavaScript引擎中引入了尚未受到足够关注的新攻击面。现有的JavaScript引擎模糊测试器主要关注JavaScript，忽略了WebAssembly代码及其与JavaScript的交互。我们提出Mad-Eye，这是首个能够使用新颖的跨语言代码融合技术测试JavaScript-WebAssembly交互的模糊测试器。在V8、SpiderMonkey和JavaScriptCore上对Mad-Eye的评估检测到21个先前未知的漏洞，其中20个得到确认，18个被修复并由开发者合并到主流浏览器中，开发者还以漏洞赏金肯定了我们的报告。

import_candidates.title: RusyFuzz: Unhandled Exception Guided Fuzzing for Rust OS Kernel
import_candidates.abstract: Rust’s strong type system and ownership model eliminate many traditional memory safety issues in OS kernels. However, logic errors—such as unchecked indexing and failed unwrap operations—can still cause panic!s that crash the entire system. Existing kernel fuzzers, designed primarily for C-based kernels and reliant on KCOV, treat all crashes uniformly and fail to account for Rust-specific failure modes.We present RusyFuzz, the first fuzzing framework tailored to Rust OS kernels that explicitly targets panic-prone code paths using an unhandled-exception-guided strategy. RusyFuzz analyzes the compiler-inserted assertions within the Rust MIR, performs backward slicing to link these assertions to system call arguments, and uses constraint solving to synthesize inputs that trigger panics. In the absence of built-in coverage support, RusyFuzz employs a lightweight, log-based instrumentation method to enable coverage-guided fuzzing. We evaluate RusyFuzz on three emerging Rust-based kernels: Asterinas, Redox OS, and RuxOS. RusyFuzz discovers 70 previously unknown and developer-confirmed vulnerabilities. Compared to Trinity, it uncovers over twice as many bugs while improving line coverage by 14.4\%. These results demonstrate that unhandled-exception-guided fuzzing is critical for uncovering logic bugs and enhancing the reliability of Rust OS kernels, providing the first systematic methodology for detecting such vulnerabilities.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Rust强大的类型系统和所有权模型消除了操作系统内核中许多传统的内存安全问题。然而，逻辑错误——例如未检查的索引和失败的unwrap操作——仍然可能导致panic!，从而使整个系统崩溃。现有的内核模糊测试器主要针对基于C的内核设计，并依赖KCOV，它们统一对待所有崩溃，未能考虑Rust特有的故障模式。我们提出了RusyFuzz，这是第一个专为Rust操作系统内核定制的模糊测试框架，它通过未处理异常引导策略显式地针对容易发生panic的代码路径。RusyFuzz分析Rust MIR中编译器插入的断言，执行后向切片以将这些断言链接到系统调用参数，并使用约束求解来合成触发panic的输入。在缺乏内置覆盖率支持的情况下，RusyFuzz采用轻量级的基于日志的插桩方法来实现覆盖率引导的模糊测试。我们在三个新兴的基于Rust的内核上评估RusyFuzz：Asterinas、Redox OS和RuxOS。RusyFuzz发现了70个先前未知且经开发者确认的漏洞。与Trinity相比，它发现的错误数量超过两倍，同时将行覆盖率提高了14.4%。这些结果表明，未处理异常引导的模糊测试对于发现逻辑错误和提高Rust操作系统内核的可靠性至关重要，提供了检测此类漏洞的首个系统化方法。

import_candidates.title: VDBFuzz: Understanding and Detecting Crash Bugs in Vector Database Management Systems
import_candidates.abstract: Vector Database Management Systems (VDBMSs) have become critical in LLM-integrated applications. However, their inherent complexity, including high-dimensional data structures, diverse indexing strategies, and heterogeneous implementations, makes them prone to reliability issues. Among these, crash bugs caused by boundary condition failures, such as invalid configurations and mismatched data dimensions, are particularly severe. These bugs can result in serious consequences like data loss, corrupted indexes, and cascading failures. To address this gap, we propose VDBFuzz, the first fuzzing framework specifically designed to detect VDBMS crash bugs through boundary value testing. VDBFuzz systematically leverages techniques to collect high-quality seeds, generate edge-case inputs, and explore complex API interactions. We evaluated VDBFuzz on 8 representative VDBMSs, including native systems (e.g., Weaviate, Milvus), libraries (e.g., Faiss, hnswlib), and extended systems (e.g., pgvector, sqlite-vec). VDBFuzz achieved up to 3x higher code coverage compared to state-of-the-art tools such as RESTler and Schemathesis, uncovering 19 previously unknown bugs, including 13 crash vulnerabilities and 6 runtime exceptions. These results highlight VDBFuzz’s effectiveness in improving the robustness and reliability of VDBMSs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 向量数据库管理系统（VDBMSs）在集成LLM的应用中已变得至关重要。然而，其固有的复杂性——包括高维数据结构、多样的索引策略以及异构实现——使其容易出现可靠性问题。其中，由边界条件失效（如无效配置和数据维度不匹配）导致的崩溃缺陷尤为严重。这些缺陷可能造成数据丢失、索引损坏和级联故障等严重后果。为填补这一空白，我们提出VDBFuzz，这是首个专门通过边界值测试来检测VDBMS崩溃缺陷的模糊测试框架。VDBFuzz系统地利用技术来收集高质量种子、生成边缘情况输入并探索复杂的API交互。我们在8个代表性VDBMS上评估了VDBFuzz，包括原生系统（如Weaviate、Milvus）、库（如Faiss、hnswlib）和扩展系统（如pgvector、sqlite-vec）。与RESTler和Schemathesis等最先进工具相比，VDBFuzz实现了高达3倍的代码覆盖率提升，并发现了19个此前未知的缺陷，包括13个崩溃漏洞和6个运行时异常。这些结果凸显了VDBFuzz在提高VDBMS健壮性和可靠性方面的有效性。

import_candidates.title: Variability-Aware Fuzzing
import_candidates.abstract: Modern software systems often provide a vast configuration space to enhance reusability and adaptability, but this configurability also significantly complicates bug finding. While existing static and dynamic variability-aware analysis approaches systematically explore the configuration space, they often suffer from scalability limitations. Conversely, grey-box fuzzing has demonstrated remarkable success in vulnerability detection through lightweight, iterative input space exploration, yet the state-of-the-art configuration fuzzers overlook the potential of integrating variability-aware analysis within the fuzzing process. In this paper, we present VAFuzz, a novel variability-aware fuzzer that integrates principled dynamic variability-aware analysis within the fuzzing process to enhance configuration space exploration. VAFuzz introduces new variability-aware seed selection and mutations to drive the fuzzing process. These are enabled by a new presence condition seed queue that tracks coverage and crash contributions across the configuration space, and a map that captures the relationship between data seeds and presence conditions. Our evaluation on a diverse set of programs show that VAFuzz outperforms the state-of-the-art configuration fuzzers on 21 out of 25 programs in terms of code coverage. It also detects more vulnerabilities than these baselines, including previous unknown bugs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代软件系统通常提供庞大的配置空间以增强可重用性和适应性，但这种可配置性也显著增加了缺陷发现的难度。现有的静态和动态可变性感知分析方法虽然能系统地探索配置空间，但往往面临可扩展性限制。相反，灰盒模糊测试通过轻量级、迭代式的输入空间探索，在漏洞检测方面取得了显著成功，然而最先进的配置模糊测试器却忽视了在模糊测试过程中集成可变性感知分析的潜力。本文提出了VAFuzz，一种新颖的可变性感知模糊测试器，它将原则化的动态可变性感知分析集成到模糊测试过程中，以增强配置空间探索。VAFuzz引入了新的可变性感知种子选择和变异来驱动模糊测试过程。这些依赖于一个新的存在条件种子队列（用于跟踪跨配置空间的覆盖率和崩溃贡献）以及一个捕捉数据种子与存在条件之间关系的映射。我们在多样化的程序集上评估表明，VAFuzz在25个程序中的21个上，在代码覆盖率方面优于最先进的配置模糊测试器。它还比这些基线检测到更多漏洞，包括先前未知的缺陷。

import_candidates.title: CombCT: Compiler Testing via Combinatorial Testing
import_candidates.abstract: Compilers, as fundamental software, are essential for various applications, making their reliability crucial. Modern compilers like GCC and LLVM offer numerous optimizations to improve performance. Empirical studies present that most bugs occur during compiler optimization, especially with specific optimization sequences, yet little attention has been paid to this in compiler testing. The vast optimization sequence space challenges existing methods, leaving this important research direction in its early stages and in need of effective solutions. In this work, we propose a novel and effective compiler testing approach dubbed CombCT, aimed at boosting compiler testing. CombCT is the first approach that leverages the power of combinatorial testing for compiler testing, making it be capable of effectively exploring optimization sequences. Besides, CombCT incorporates three new techniques, i.e., dynamic optimization sequence adaption, partial sequence selection, and diversity augmentation, to enhance its effectiveness. Extensive experiments on various versions of GCC and LLVM demonstrate that CombCT detects much more unique bugs, which are caused by certain optimization sequences, than current state-of-the-art methods, indicating its superiority. Moreover, CombCT has disclosed 14 previously unknown bugs in the latest versions of GCC and LLVM, 13 of which have been confirmed or fixed, showing its practical value.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 编译器作为基础软件，对各类应用至关重要，因此其可靠性至关重要。像GCC和LLVM这样的现代编译器提供了大量优化以提高性能。实证研究表明，大多数错误发生在编译器优化期间，尤其是在特定优化序列下，但编译器测试对此关注甚少。庞大的优化序列空间对现有方法提出了挑战，使这一重要研究方向仍处于早期阶段，需要有效的解决方案。在本工作中，我们提出了一种新颖且有效的编译器测试方法，称为CombCT，旨在提升编译器测试。CombCT是首个利用组合测试能力进行编译器测试的方法，使其能够有效探索优化序列。此外，CombCT结合了三种新技术，即动态优化序列适应、部分序列选择和多样性增强，以提升其有效性。对GCC和LLVM多个版本的广泛实验表明，CombCT检测到的由特定优化序列引起的唯一错误远多于当前最先进的方法，表明其优越性。此外，CombCT在最新版本的GCC和LLVM中披露了14个此前未知的错误，其中13个已被确认或修复，展示了其实际价值。

import_candidates.title: Fuzzing Java Optimizing Compilers with Complex Inter-Class Structures Guided by Heterogeneous Program Graphs
import_candidates.abstract: Modern Java compilers, such as Just-In-Time (JIT) and Ahead-Of-Time (AOT) compilers, often infer and analyze complex inter-class structures to perform program optimizations while preserving semantic correctness. However, incorrect inference of these structures during compilation can lead to critical bugs, as observed in production compilers like HotSpot and R8. Despite their effectiveness, existing Java fuzzing tools fail to adequately explore inter-class relationships, focusing instead on simpler intra-class or intra-method constructs. To bridge this gap, we present InterFuzz, the first fuzzing framework designed to systematically generate Java test cases with complex inter-class structures. InterFuzz introduces a novel concept of Heterogeneous Program Graph (HPG) to abstract and manipulate inter-class relationships. It then employs Inter-Class Mutators to construct intricate interactions, and utilizes graph complexities to guide test generation toward high-diversity code. Our evaluation shows that InterFuzz effectively uncovers compiler bugs that elude traditional fuzzers, having discovered 24 new bugs across HotSpot, ART, and R8. Among these, 20 bugs are confirmed by developers and 16 bugs hinge on intricate inter-class structures.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代Java编译器，如即时（JIT）和提前（AOT）编译器，通常会推断并分析复杂的类间结构，以在保持语义正确性的同时执行程序优化。然而，在编译期间对这些结构的错误推断可能导致严重缺陷，正如在HotSpot和R8等生产编译器中所观察到的那样。尽管现有Java模糊测试工具很有效，但它们未能充分探索类间关系，而是专注于更简单的类内或方法内构造。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了InterFuzz，这是第一个旨在系统生成具有复杂类间结构的Java测试用例的模糊测试框架。InterFuzz引入了异构程序图（HPG）这一新概念，以抽象和操纵类间关系。然后，它采用类间变异器来构造复杂的交互，并利用图复杂性引导测试生成朝向高多样性代码。我们的评估表明，InterFuzz能有效发现传统模糊测试工具未能发现的编译器缺陷，在HotSpot、ART和R8中发现了24个新缺陷。其中，20个缺陷被开发者确认，16个缺陷依赖于复杂的类间结构。

import_candidates.title: Bounded Exhaustive Random Program Generation for Testing Solidity Compilers
import_candidates.abstract: By July 2025, smart contracts collectively manage roughly $120 billion in assets. With Solidity remaining the dominant language for smart contract development, the correctness of Solidity compilers has become critically important. However, Solidity compilers are prone to bugs, with a recent study revealing that combinations of qualifiers in Solidity programs are the primary cause of compiler crashes, accounting for (40.5\%) of all historical crashes. While random program generators are widely used for compiler testing, they may be less effective at finding Solidity compiler bugs because they explore the unbounded space of possible programs rather than concentrating on the specific subspace related to bug-prone qualifiers. A promising idea for finding qualifier-related bugs is to bound the search space based on empirical evidence of where such bugs are likely to occur, specifically focusing test generation to target subspaces with rich combinations of qualifiers. To address this, we propose bounded exhaustive random program generation, a novel approach that dynamically bounds the search space, enhancing the likelihood of uncovering Solidity compiler bugs. Specifically, our method bounds the search space by generating valid program templates that abstract programs that use bug-prone qualifiers, and then uses these templates as a basis for compiler testing through exhaustive enumeration of suitable qualifiers. Mechanisms are devised to address technical challenges regarding validity and efficiency.We have implemented our novel generation approach in a new tool, Erwin. We have used Erwin to find and report 26 bugs across two Solidity compilers, solc and solang, and one Solidity static analyzer, slither. Among these, 23 were previously unknown, 18 have been confirmed, and 10 have been fixed. Evaluation results demonstrate that Erwin outperforms state-of-the-art Solidity fuzzers in bug detection and complements developer-written test suites by covering 4,599 edges and 14,824 lines of the solc compiler that were missed by solc’s unit tests.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 截至2025年7月，智能合约共同管理着大约1200亿美元的资产。随着Solidity仍然是智能合约开发的主导语言，Solidity编译器的正确性变得至关重要。然而，Solidity编译器容易出错，最近的一项研究揭示，Solidity程序中限定符的组合是编译器崩溃的主要原因，占所有历史崩溃的40.5%。虽然随机程序生成器被广泛用于编译器测试，但它们在发现Solidity编译器缺陷方面可能效果不佳，因为它们探索的是无界的可能程序空间，而不是集中于与易出错限定符相关的特定子空间。寻找限定符相关缺陷的一个有前景的思路是，基于此类缺陷可能发生位置的实证证据来限制搜索空间，具体而言，将测试生成聚焦于针对具有丰富限定符组合的子空间。为了解决这个问题，我们提出有界穷举随机程序生成，这是一种新颖的方法，它动态地限制搜索空间，从而提高发现Solidity编译器缺陷的可能性。具体而言，我们的方法通过生成有效的程序模板来限制搜索空间，这些模板抽象了使用易出错限定符的程序，然后将这些模板作为编译器测试的基础，通过穷举枚举合适的限定符。我们设计了一些机制来解决有关有效性和效率的技术挑战。我们已将这种新颖的生成方法实现在一个新工具Erwin中。我们使用Erwin在两个Solidity编译器solc和solang以及一个Solidity静态分析器slither中查找并报告了26个缺陷。其中，23个此前未知，18个已被确认，10个已被修复。评估结果表明，Erwin在缺陷检测方面优于最先进的Solidity模糊测试器，并通过覆盖solc单元测试遗漏的4599条边和14824行solc编译器代码，补充了开发者编写的测试套件。

import_candidates.title: Is Call Graph Pruning Really Effective? An Empirical Re-evaluation
import_candidates.abstract: Recently proposed call graph pruning techniques, which use machine learning to predict and reduce false positives in static call graphs, have reported impressive results and demonstrated practicality for downstream analyses. However, as we research the methodology of how datasets are created and how evaluation is conducted in these research projects, we identify many risk factors that may make the reported results incomplete or even invalid. We further investigate these factors and provide empirical evidence to demonstrate they indeed result in misleading results. Motivated by these findings, we propose an empirical re-evaluation of existing call graph pruning techniques to assess their effectiveness. We first construct a new dataset of real-world programs, applying three complementary labeling approaches, resulting in 41,952 labels. To provide a full picture of these techniques, we utilize three popular call graph analysis frameworks (WALA, Doop, and OPAL) and seven tool configurations. Our results show that pruning is not as effective as reported in prior work, improving precision at the cost of significant coverage loss. We further train more general models across analysis tools and configurations, and explore the impact of data splitting and balancing. We find these models often match or outperform the existing configuration-specific ones, indicating their applicability in more general settings. Finally, we highlight the open challenges and potential solutions, including the need for better datasets as well as improved feature engineering.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 最近提出的调用图剪枝技术，利用机器学习预测并减少静态调用图中的误报，已报告了令人印象深刻的结果，并展示了其对下游分析的实用性。然而，当我们研究这些研究项目中数据集的创建方式和评估方式时，我们发现许多可能使报告结果不完整甚至无效的风险因素。我们进一步调查这些因素，并提供实证证据证明它们确实导致误导性结果。受这些发现启发，我们提出对现有调用图剪枝技术进行实证再评估，以评估其有效性。我们首先构建了一个真实世界程序的新数据集，应用三种互补的标注方法，得到41,952个标注。为了全面了解这些技术，我们使用了三种流行的调用图分析框架（WALA、Doop和OPAL）和七种工具配置。我们的结果表明，剪枝并不像先前工作中报告的那样有效，它在提高精确率的同时牺牲了显著的覆盖率。我们进一步跨分析工具和配置训练更通用的模型，并探索数据划分和平衡的影响。我们发现这些模型通常匹配或优于现有的特定配置模型，表明它们在更通用设置中的适用性。最后，我们强调开放挑战和潜在解决方案，包括需要更好的数据集以及改进的特征工程。

import_candidates.title: PyXray: Practical Cross-Language Call Graph Construction through Object Layout Analysis
import_candidates.abstract: A great number of software packages combine code in high-level languages, such as Python, with binary extensions compiled from low-level languages such as C, C++ or Rust to either boost efficiency or enable specific functionalities. In this context, high-level function calls can trigger native (binary) code execution. This setup introduces challenges for call graph generation. Accurate call graphs are essential for various applications, including vulnerability management and software maintenance, as they help track execution paths, assess security risks, and identify unused or redundant code.This work tackles the problem of cross-language call graph construction in Python. Instead of relying on static analysis, which struggles with identifying Python-native interactions, we propose a dynamic analysis technique which does not require inputs to execute code. Our approach is based on two key insights: (1) when a binary extension is imported from Python code, all its objects (e.g., functions) are loaded into memory, and (2) the layout of callable Python objects contains pointers to the native functions they invoke. By analyzing these memory layouts for every loaded object, we identify corresponding graph edges, which link Python functions to the native functions they eventually invoke. This is an essential element for constructing call graphs across language boundaries.We implement this approach in PyXray, a tool that efficiently analyzes massive Python packages such as NumPy and PyTorch in minutes, while significantly outpeforming existing static analysis methods in terms of precision and recall. PyXray enables two key applications: (1) cross-language vulnerability management, by identifying whether a Python package potentially calls a vulnerable native function and (2) cross-language bloat analysis, by quantifying unnecessary code across Python and native components.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大量软件包将Python等高级语言的代码与从C、C++或Rust等低级语言编译的二进制扩展相结合，以提高效率或启用特定功能。在此背景下，高级函数调用可以触发原生（二进制）代码执行。这种设置给调用图生成带来了挑战。准确的调用图对于漏洞管理和软件维护等各种应用至关重要，因为它们有助于跟踪执行路径、评估安全风险并识别未使用或冗余的代码。本工作解决了Python中跨语言调用图构建的问题。我们提出一种动态分析技术，不依赖静态分析（静态分析难以识别Python与原生的交互），且不需要输入来执行代码。我们的方法基于两个关键洞察：(1) 当从Python代码导入二进制扩展时，其所有对象（例如函数）都会被加载到内存中；(2) 可调用Python对象的布局包含指向它们所调用原生函数的指针。通过分析每个已加载对象的内存布局，我们识别出相应的图边，这些边将Python函数链接到它们最终调用的原生函数。这是跨语言边界构建调用图的关键要素。我们在PyXray中实现了该方法，该工具能在几分钟内高效分析NumPy和PyTorch等大型Python包，同时在精度和召回率方面显著优于现有静态分析方法。PyXray支持两个关键应用：(1) 跨语言漏洞管理，通过识别Python包是否可能调用易受攻击的原生函数；(2) 跨语言膨胀分析，通过量化Python和原生组件中不必要的代码。

import_candidates.title: D-BUNDLR: Destructing JavaScript Bundles for Effective Static Analysis
import_candidates.abstract: Static analysis for vulnerability detection in JavaScript is an extensively studied research area. However, state-of-the-art approaches ignore bundling, an emerging development practice, akin to compilation, which allows developers to merge code from different providers, while also applying optimizations to reduce code size. A typical bundle heavily reuses single-letter identifiers and extensively relies on dynamic JavaScript features to emulate code dependencies, thus, hindering static analysis. In this work, we propose a reverse engineering approach that relies on domain-specific code transformations to unpack bundles and replace reidentified libraries with their source code. Our technique applies lightweight static analysis to dissect bundles into individual components, machine learning to identify libraries, and dynamic analysis to verify that libraries were correctly identified. We implement this approach in a tool called D-Bundlr , and evaluate it by comparing the output of CodeQL (a popular static analysis tool) before and after debundling.For a JavaScript code benchmark with known vulnerabilities, our approach allows CodeQL to recover 89\% of the vulnerabilities and 83\% of all alerts that were also detected in the source code, but were dormant in bundles. Similarly, for real-world bundles where we can retrieve the source code, D-Bundlr recovered 33\% of the original alerts. When applied to bundles extracted from the 100,000 most popular websites, D-Bundlr identifies 34,445 instances corresponding to 63 unique libraries, and causes CodeQL to produce around 3.2K more security alerts than on packed bundles. We additionally illustrate how attackers can exploit some of our zero-day findings, causing unwanted security effects such as advertisement space hijacking.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: JavaScript中用于漏洞检测的静态分析是一个被广泛研究的研究领域。然而，最先进的方法忽略了打包（bundling）这一新兴开发实践，它类似于编译，允许开发者合并来自不同提供者的代码，同时应用优化以减小代码体积。典型的打包文件大量复用单字母标识符，并广泛依赖JavaScript动态特性来模拟代码依赖关系，从而阻碍静态分析。在这项工作中，我们提出一种逆向工程方法，依靠领域特定的代码转换来解包打包文件，并用其源代码替换被重新标识的库。我们的技术应用轻量级静态分析将打包文件剖析为各个组件，使用机器学习识别库，并使用动态分析验证库是否被正确识别。我们在一个名为D-Bundlr的工具中实现了该方法，并通过比较CodeQL（一种流行的静态分析工具）在去打包前后输出的结果来评估它。对于包含已知漏洞的JavaScript代码基准，我们的方法使CodeQL能够恢复89%的漏洞以及83%的所有警报，这些警报在源代码中也被检测到，但在打包文件中处于休眠状态。类似地，对于能够检索到源代码的真实世界打包文件，D-Bundlr恢复了33%的原始警报。当应用于从10万个最受欢迎网站提取的打包文件时，D-Bundlr识别出对应于63个唯一库的34,445个实例，并使CodeQL比在打包文件上多产生约3.2K条安全警报。我们进一步说明攻击者如何利用我们的一些零日发现，造成不良安全影响，例如广告位劫持。

import_candidates.title: Precise Static Identification of Ethereum Storage Variables
import_candidates.abstract: Smart contracts are small programs that run autonomously on the blockchain, using it as their persistent memory. The predominant platform for smart contracts is the Ethereum VM (EVM). In EVM smart contracts, a problem with significant applications is to identify data structures (in blockchain state, a.k.a. “storage”), given only the deployed smart contract code. The problem has been highly challenging and has often been considered nearly impossible to address satisfactorily. (For reference, the latest state-of-the-art research tool fails to recover nearly all complex data structures and scales to 50\% of contracts.) Much of the complication is that the main on-chain data structures (mappings and arrays) have their locations derived dynamically through code execution.We propose sophisticated static analysis techniques to solve the identification of on-chain data structures with extremely high fidelity and completeness. Our analysis scales nearly universally and recovers deep data structures. Our techniques are able to identify the exact types of data structures with 95.70\% precision and at least 94.96\% recall, compared to a state-of-the-art tool managing 83.30\% and 55.65\% respectively. Strikingly, the analysis is often more complete than the storage description that the compiler itself produces, with full access to the source code.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 智能合约是在区块链上自主运行的小型程序，并将区块链用作其持久内存。智能合约的主流平台是以太坊虚拟机（EVM）。在EVM智能合约中，一个具有重要应用价值的问题是：仅根据已部署的智能合约代码，识别数据结构（在区块链状态中，也称为“存储”）。这个问题极具挑战性，并且常常被认为几乎无法令人满意地解决。（作为参考，最新的研究工具无法恢复几乎所有复杂数据结构，并且只能扩展到50%的合约。）大部分复杂性在于，主要的链上数据结构（映射和数组）的位置是通过代码执行动态推导出来的。我们提出了复杂的静态分析技术，以极高保真度和完备性解决链上数据结构的识别问题。我们的分析几乎普遍可扩展，并能恢复深层数据结构。我们的技术能够以95.70%的精确率和至少94.96%的召回率识别数据结构的准确类型，而最先进的工具分别只能达到83.30%和55.65%。引人注目的是，该分析通常比编译器本身在拥有完整源代码访问权限时生成的存储描述更加完备。

import_candidates.title: Debugging Performance Issues in WebAssembly Runtimes via Mutation-based Inference
import_candidates.abstract: Performance debugging in WebAssembly (Wasm) runtimes is essential for ensuring the robustness of Wasm, especially since performance issues have frequently occurred in Wasm runtimes, which can significantly degrade the capabilities of hosted services. Many performance issues in Wasm runtimes result from suboptimal compilation of input Wasm programs, for which existing performance debugging methods primarily designed for application-level inefficiencies are not well-suited. In this paper, we present WarpL, a novel mutation-based approach that aims to identify the exact suboptimal instruction sequences responsible for the performance issues in Wasm runtimes, thereby narrowing down the root causes. Specifically, WarpL obtains a functionally similar mutant in which the performance issue does not manifest, and isolates the exact suboptimal instructions by comparing the machine code of the original and mutated programs. We implement WarpL as an open-source tool and evaluate it on 12 real-world performance issues across three widely used Wasm runtimes. WarpL identified the exact causes in 10 out of 12 issues. Notably, we have used WarpL to successfully diagnose six previously unknown performance issues in Wasmtime.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: WebAssembly (Wasm) 运行时中的性能调试对于确保 Wasm 的鲁棒性至关重要，尤其是因为 Wasm 运行时中经常出现性能问题，这些问题会显著降低托管服务的能力。Wasm 运行时中的许多性能问题源于对输入 Wasm 程序的次优编译，而现有主要针对应用级低效的性能调试方法并不适合此类问题。在本文中，我们提出了 WarpL，一种新颖的基于变异的方法，旨在识别导致 Wasm 运行时性能问题的确切次优指令序列，从而缩小根本原因的范围。具体而言，WarpL 获得一个功能相似但性能问题不显现的突变体，并通过比较原始程序和变异程序的机器码来隔离确切的次优指令。我们将 WarpL 实现为开源工具，并在三个广泛使用的 Wasm 运行时中的 12 个真实世界性能问题上进行了评估。WarpL 在 12 个问题中的 10 个中识别出了确切原因。值得注意的是，我们使用 WarpL 成功诊断了 Wasmtime 中六个先前未知的性能问题。

import_candidates.title: Dependency-aware Residual Risk Analysis
import_candidates.abstract: However much we test a software system, some residual risk of undiscovered bugs always remains. If we model test generation as a sampling process, the residual risk can be defined as the probability that the next test input reveals a bug. This risk is upper-bounded by the discovery probability (DP), i.e., the probability that the next test input covers new code, which itself is upper-bounded by the coverage rate, i.e., the expected number of new coverage elements per test input. Prior work introduced the Good-Turing estimator (GoTu) to estimate residual risk via coverage rate. However, we find that GoTu substantially overestimates, leading to undue optimism in bug finding because (i) the coverage rate is only a loose upper bound, and (ii) GoTu ignores dependencies among coverage elements.We propose dependency-aware DP estimation for residual risk analysis. Our estimator directly estimates DP and accounts for dependencies among coverage elements using Ma and Chao’s sample coverage estimation. A naive implementation requires space proportional to the number of coverage elements and executions, which can be prohibitively large. To make it practical, we introduce two optimizations: dependency-aware node removal, which reduces the number of coverage elements to observe, and online singleton cluster maintenance, which eliminates the need to record observed coverage elements in each execution.A comparison of our estimator and GoTu on real-world software from FuzzBench demonstrates a substantial reduction in estimation error. If we stopped the campaign when the estimate of residual risk fell below a certain threshold, GoTu would lead a tester to waste 7 {\texttimes} more time than our estimator before deciding to stop. Our estimator achieves a median absolute error of only one-fifth that of GoTu. Finally, our bug-based analysis shows that our estimator achieves one to two orders of magnitude lower error than GoTu.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 无论我们对软件系统进行多少测试，总会有一些未发现缺陷的剩余风险残留。如果我们把测试生成建模为采样过程，剩余风险可以定义为下一个测试输入揭示缺陷的概率。该风险的上界是发现概率（DP），即下一个测试输入覆盖新代码的概率；而发现概率本身又受覆盖率的上界约束，即每个测试输入预期新增的覆盖元素数量。先前工作引入了Good-Turing估计器（GoTu），通过覆盖率来估计剩余风险。然而，我们发现GoTu会显著高估，导致在缺陷发现方面产生过度乐观，因为：(i) 覆盖率只是一个宽松的上界；(ii) GoTu忽略了覆盖元素之间的依赖关系。我们提出了依赖感知的DP估计，用于剩余风险分析。我们的估计器直接估计DP，并利用Ma和Chao的样本覆盖估计来考虑覆盖元素之间的依赖关系。朴素实现所需的空间与覆盖元素和执行次数成正比，这可能大得令人望而却步。为了使其实用，我们引入了两项优化：依赖感知节点移除，可减少需要观察的覆盖元素数量；以及在线单例簇维护，可消除在每次执行中记录已观察覆盖元素的需要。在FuzzBench的真实软件上，对我们的估计器与GoTu进行比较，结果表明估计误差大幅降低。如果当剩余风险的估计值低于某个阈值时停止测试活动，那么与我们的估计器相比，GoTu会导致测试人员浪费7倍的时间才决定停止。我们的估计器的中位绝对误差仅为GoTu的五分之一。最后，基于缺陷的分析表明，我们的估计器比GoTu的误差低一至两个数量级。

import_candidates.title: Efficient Build Dependency Verification Using eBPF and Incremental Analysis
import_candidates.abstract: Build systems are fundamental to modern software development, but maintaining correct dependency specifications remains a significant challenge. Dependency-related errors, including missing and redundant dependencies, account for over 50\% of build errors in large-scale software projects. Existing tools for detecting such errors suffer from two major limitations: high runtime overhead due to ptrace-based system call tracing, and the need to verify all edges in the build dependency graph. This paper presents mkcheck2, a novel approach that combines extended Berkeley Packet Filter (eBPF)-based system call tracing with incremental analysis to enable efficient dependency verification. Our evaluation on a diverse set of open-source projects demonstrates that mkcheck2 reduces the overhead of dependency error detection by up to 99.7\% compared to existing ptrace-based approaches while maintaining detection accuracy. Across the entire 300-project Make corpus, the incremental analysis technique lowers the mean analysis time per commit from 1267.49 seconds to just 23.56 seconds, making continuous dependency verification practical in real-world development environments.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 构建系统是现代软件开发的基础，但维护正确的依赖规范仍然是一个重大挑战。与依赖相关的错误（包括缺失依赖和冗余依赖）占大型软件项目构建错误的50%以上。现有检测此类错误的工具存在两个主要局限：基于ptrace的系统调用跟踪导致的高运行时开销，以及需要验证构建依赖图中的所有边。本文提出了mkcheck2，一种新颖的方法，它将基于扩展伯克利包过滤器（eBPF）的系统调用跟踪与增量分析相结合，以实现高效的依赖验证。我们在多个开源项目上的评估表明，与现有的基于ptrace的方法相比，mkcheck2将依赖错误检测的开销降低了高达99.7%，同时保持了检测准确性。在整个300个项目的Make语料库上，增量分析技术将每次提交的平均分析时间从1267.49秒降低到仅23.56秒，使得持续的依赖验证在实际开发环境中变得可行。

import_candidates.title: Fine-Grained Analyses for Evolution-Aware Runtime Verification
import_candidates.abstract: Runtime verification (RV) found many bugs by monitoring passing tests in many open-source projects against formal specifications (specs). But, RV is often too slow for use in continuous integration. So, evolution-aware techniques were proposed to speed up RV by re-monitoring only a subset of specs affected by code changes. These techniques use coarse-grained class-level analyses, so they can sub-optimally and imprecisely re-monitor unaffected specs.We propose FineMOP to speed up evolution-aware RV by using fine-grained analyses to re-monitor fewer unaffected specs. The key idea is simple: changes often do not require re-monitoring specs that are only related to unchanged parts of changed classes. We implement six variants of three fine-grained analyses in FineMOP and evaluate them on 1,104 revisions of 68 open-source Java projects. Compared with two class-level techniques, FineMOP is up to 4.86x faster, re-monitors up to 81.04\% fewer specs per revision, and finds 99.68\% of all new violations that these techniques find. Also, FineMOP and Regression Test Selection (RTS) are complementary: combining FineMOP with RTS is faster than FineMOP or RTS alone.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 运行时验证（RV）通过根据形式化规范（specs）监控许多开源项目中通过的测试，发现了许多错误。但RV对于在持续集成中使用来说往往太慢。因此，人们提出了演化感知技术，通过仅重新监控受代码更改影响的规范子集来加速RV。这些技术使用粗粒度的类级分析，因此它们可能次优且不精确地重新监控未受影响的规范。我们提出FineMOP，通过使用细粒度分析来重新监控更少的未受影响规范，从而加速演化感知RV。关键思想很简单：更改通常不需要重新监控仅与已更改类中未更改部分相关的规范。我们在FineMOP中实现了三种细粒度分析的六种变体，并在68个开源Java项目的1,104个修订版本上进行了评估。与两种类级技术相比，FineMOP最高快4.86倍，每个修订版本重新监控的规范最多减少81.04%，并找到这些技术找到的所有新违规的99.68%。此外，FineMOP与回归测试选择（RTS）是互补的：将FineMOP与RTS结合比单独使用FineMOP或RTS更快。

import_candidates.title: Generator Solving for Symbolic Execution
import_candidates.abstract: Automated test input generation based on symbolic execution has garnered significant research interest. However, the main drawback of symbolic execution is its poor scalability. Since the overhead associated with constraint modeling and solving is high, generating only one test input per SMT query is inefficient. In this paper, we introduce the concept of generator solving. Instead of solving for only one particular solution, we propose to find a generator that can be called multiple times to continuously yield new test inputs. This approach offers several benefits: (1) it allows efficient generation of as many test inputs as needed, thereby significantly improving the input generation efficiency of symbolic execution methods; (2) the continuously generated inputs facilitate a more comprehensive exploration of the solution set, potentially triggering new program behaviors; and (3) compared to hybrid approaches based on mutation, using a generator ensures the satisfiability of the target constraints. We present three key techniques for generator solving: (1) reusing invertible model converters in Z3 as generators; (2) constructing hierarchical range-based samplers to sample solutions of range constraints; and (3) employing optimistic simplification strategies to enhance the generality of the solving process. We have implemented GenSlv, a prototypical generator solver specifically designed for automated test case generation based on symbolic execution. Evaluation results demonstrate that (1) GenSlv is effective in finding generators for constraints collected from real-world programs (specifically, GenSlv can find a generator for 97\% of the constraints that have at least two different solutions), and (2) GenSlv significantly and consistently improves the performance of commonly used symbolic executors (including KLEE, Angr, TritonDSE, and SymCC) in terms of program coverage and vulnerability detection across various settings in symbolic execution and hybrid fuzzing tasks, with a maximum of more than twofold increase in branch coverage.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 基于符号执行的自动化测试输入生成已引起广泛研究兴趣。然而，符号执行的主要缺点是可扩展性差。由于约束建模和求解的开销很高，每个SMT查询只生成一个测试输入效率低下。在本文中，我们引入了生成器求解的概念。我们不是只求解一个特定解，而是提出寻找一个生成器，该生成器可以被多次调用以持续产生新的测试输入。这种方法提供了几个好处：(1) 它允许按需高效生成任意数量的测试输入，从而显著提高符号执行方法的输入生成效率；(2) 持续生成的输入促进了对解集的更全面探索，可能触发新的程序行为；(3) 与基于变异的混合方法相比，使用生成器确保了目标约束的可满足性。我们提出了生成器求解的三项关键技术：(1) 重用Z3中的可逆模型转换器作为生成器；(2) 构建基于层次范围的采样器以采样范围约束的解；(3) 采用乐观简化策略以增强求解过程的通用性。我们实现了GenSlv，一个专为基于符号执行的自动化测试用例生成而设计的原型生成器求解器。评估结果表明：(1) GenSlv能有效地为从真实程序中收集的约束找到生成器（具体而言，GenSlv可以为97%的具有至少两个不同解的约束找到生成器）；(2) GenSlv在符号执行和混合模糊测试任务的各种设置中，显著且持续地提高了常用符号执行器（包括KLEE、Angr、TritonDSE和SymCC）在程序覆盖率和漏洞检测方面的性能，分支覆盖率最大提升超过两倍。

import_candidates.title: GPTrace: Effective Crash Deduplication Using LLM Embeddings
import_candidates.abstract: Fuzzing is a highly effective method for uncovering software vulnerabilities, but analyzing the resulting data typically requires substantial manual effort. This is amplified by the fact that fuzzing campaigns often find a large number of crashing inputs, many of which share the same underlying bug. Crash deduplication is the task of finding such duplicate crashing inputs and thereby reducing the data that needs to be examined. Many existing deduplication approaches rely on comparing stack traces or other information that is collected when a program crashes. Although various metrics for measuring the similarity of such pieces of information have been proposed, many do not yield satisfactory deduplication results. In this work, we present GPTrace, a deduplication workflow that leverages a large language model to evaluate the similarity of various data sources associated with crashes by computing embedding vectors and supplying those as input to a clustering algorithm. We evaluate our approach on over 300000 crashing inputs belonging to 50 ground truth labels from 14 different targets. The deduplication results produced by GPTrace show a noticeable improvement over hand-crafted stack trace comparison methods and even more complex state-of-the-art approaches that are less flexible.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 模糊测试是发现软件漏洞的一种非常有效的方法，但分析其产生的数据通常需要大量人工投入。模糊测试活动常常发现大量崩溃输入，而其中许多共享相同的底层缺陷，这进一步加剧了上述问题。崩溃去重正是找出这类重复崩溃输入、从而减少需要检查的数据量的任务。许多现有去重方法依赖于比较栈跟踪或程序崩溃时收集的其他信息。尽管已经提出了多种衡量此类信息相似度的指标，但许多方法并不能产生令人满意的去重结果。在本工作中，我们提出了GPTrace，一种去重工作流，它利用大型语言模型通过计算嵌入向量来评估与崩溃相关的多种数据源的相似度，并将这些嵌入向量作为聚类算法的输入。我们在来自14个不同目标、属于50个真实标签的超过300000个崩溃输入上评估了我们的方法。GPTrace产生的去重结果明显优于手工设计的栈跟踪比较方法，也优于那些灵活性较差但更复杂的先进方法。

import_candidates.title: BFix: Automated Safe Memory-Leak Fixing for Binary Code
import_candidates.abstract: Fixing memory leaks in software is crucial to improving system efficiency, reliability, and stability. Nevertheless, manually fixing memory leaks is not only time-consuming but also prone to errors. Recent research has proposed program repair techniques to fix memory leaks automatically. However, a common limitation of prior techniques is that they cannot tackle memory leaks in binary code. Given the huge popularity of binary code, it is highly necessary to fix its hidden memory leaks. To this end, this paper presents BFix, the first-ever binary-level memory-leak fixing tool. BFix creates effective binary analysis techniques to overcome the unique technical challenges of automatically and safely fixing memory leaks in binaries. Our experimental results show that BFix can achieve promising fixing effectiveness and efficiency, comparable to state-of-the-art source-level fixing tools. Meanwhile, it has a negligible impact on binary code size and performance.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 修复软件中的内存泄漏对于提高系统效率、可靠性和稳定性至关重要。然而，手动修复内存泄漏不仅耗时，而且容易出错。最近的研究提出了自动修复内存泄漏的程序修复技术。然而，先前技术的一个常见局限是它们无法处理二进制代码中的内存泄漏。鉴于二进制代码的广泛流行，修复其隐藏的内存泄漏非常必要。为此，本文提出了BFix，这是首个二进制级内存泄漏修复工具。BFix创建了有效的二进制分析技术，以克服自动且安全地修复二进制文件中内存泄漏的独特技术挑战。我们的实验结果表明，BFix能够实现令人满意的修复效果和效率，与最先进的源代码级修复工具相当。同时，它对二进制代码大小和性能的影响可以忽略不计。

import_candidates.title: Enhancing Symbolic Execution with Self-Configuring Parameters
import_candidates.abstract: We present ({{rmsmall {PARASUIT}}}), a self-configuring technique that enhances symbolic execution by autonomously adjusting its parameters tailored to each program under test. Modern symbolic execution tools are typically equipped with various external parameters to effectively test real-world programs. However, the need for users to fine-tune a multitude of parameters for optimal testing outcomes makes these tools harder to use and limits their potential benefits. Despite recent efforts to improve this tuning process, existing techniques are not self-configuring; they cannot dynamically identify which parameters to tune for each target program, and for each manually selected parameter, they sample a value from a fixed, user-defined set of candidate values that is specific to that parameter and remains unchanged across programs. The goal of this paper is to automatically configure symbolic execution parameters from scratch for each program. To this end, ({{rmsmall {PARASUIT}}}) begins by automatically identifying all available parameters in the symbolic execution tool and evaluating each parameter’s impact through interactions with the tool. It then applies a specialized algorithm to iteratively select promising parameters, construct sampling spaces for each, and update their sampling probabilities based on data accumulated from symbolic execution runs using sampled parameter values. We implemented ({{rmsmall {PARASUIT}}}) on KLEE and assessed it across 12 open-source C programs. The results demonstrate that ({{rmsmall {PARASUIT}}}) significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art method without self-configuring parameters, achieving an average of 26\% higher branch coverage. Remarkably, ({{rmsmall {PARASUIT}}}) identified 11 unique bugs, four of which were exclusively discovered by ({{rmsmall {PARASUIT}}}).
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了PARASUIT，一种自配置技术，通过自主调整参数来增强符号执行，这些参数针对每个被测程序量身定制。现代符号执行工具通常配备各种外部参数以有效测试真实程序。然而，用户需要微调大量参数以获得最佳测试结果，这使得这些工具更难使用，并限制了其潜在收益。尽管最近有改进调参过程的努力，现有技术并非自配置；它们无法动态识别每个目标程序需要调优哪些参数，并且对于每个手动选择的参数，它们从固定的、用户定义的候选值集合中采样一个值，该集合特定于该参数且在不同程序间保持不变。本文的目标是为每个程序从头自动配置符号执行参数。为此，PARASUIT首先自动识别符号执行工具中所有可用参数，并通过与工具交互评估每个参数的影响。然后，它应用一种专门算法，迭代选择有前景的参数，为每个参数构建采样空间，并根据使用采样参数值进行符号执行运行所积累的数据更新其采样概率。我们在KLEE上实现了PARASUIT，并在12个开源C程序上进行了评估。结果表明，PARASUIT显著优于没有自配置参数的最先进方法，平均分支覆盖率提高26%。值得注意的是，PARASUIT识别出11个独特缺陷，其中四个仅由PARASUIT发现。

import_candidates.title: MutDafny: A Mutation-Based Approach to Assess Dafny Specifications
import_candidates.abstract: In verification-aware languages, such as Dafny, despite their critical role, specifications are as prone to errors as implementations. Flaws in specifications can result in formally verified programs that deviate from the intended behavior. In this paper, we explore the use of mutation testing to reveal weaknesses in formal specifications written in Dafny.We present MutDafny, a tool that increases the reliability of Dafny specifications by automatically signaling potential weaknesses. Using a mutation testing approach, we introduce faults (mutations) into the code and rely on formal specifications for detecting them. If a program with a mutant verifies, this may indicate a weakness in the specification. We extensively analyze mutation operators from popular tools, identifying the ones applicable to Dafny. In addition, we synthesize new operators tailored for the language from bugfix commits in publicly available Dafny projects on GitHub. Drawing from both, we equipped our tool with a total of 40 mutation operators. We evaluate MutDafny’s effectiveness and efficiency on a dataset of 794 real-world Dafny programs, and manually analyze a subset of the resulting undetected mutants, identifying five weak real-world specifications (on average, one at every 241 lines of code) that would benefit from strengthening.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在诸如Dafny这类验证感知语言中，尽管规约至关重要，但它们和实现一样容易出错。规约中的缺陷可能导致形式化验证的程序偏离预期行为。本文探索使用变异测试来揭示用Dafny编写的形式化规约中的弱点。我们提出MutDafny，一个通过自动标记潜在弱点来提高Dafny规约可靠性的工具。采用变异测试方法，我们向代码中引入故障（变异），并依赖形式化规约来检测它们。如果带有变异的程序通过验证，这可能表明规约存在弱点。我们广泛分析流行工具中的变异算子，识别适用于Dafny的算子。此外，我们从GitHub上公开Dafny项目的缺陷修复提交中合成针对该语言的新算子。结合两者，我们为工具配备了共40个变异算子。我们在包含794个真实世界Dafny程序的数据集上评估MutDafny的有效性和效率，并人工分析结果中未被检测到的变异体子集，识别出五个薄弱的真实世界规约（平均每241行代码一个），这些规约将受益于加强。

import_candidates.title: Testing Deep Learning Libraries via Neurosymbolic Constraint Learning
import_candidates.abstract: Deep Learning (DL) libraries (e.g., Pytorch) are popular in the development of AI applications. These libraries are complex and contain bugs. Researchers have proposed various bug-finding techniques for such libraries. Yet, there is much room for improvement. A key challenge in testing DL libraries is the lack of API specifications. Prior testing approaches often inaccurately model the input specifications of DL APIs, resulting in missed valid inputs that could reveal bugs or false alarms due to invalid inputs.To address this challenge, we develop Centaur– the first neurosymbolic technique to test DL library APIs using dynamically learned input constraint s. Centaur leverages the key idea that formal API constraints can be learned from a small number of automatically generated seed inputs, and that the learned constraints can be solved using SMT solvers to generate valid and diverse test inputs to test the API.We develop a novel grammar that represents first-order logic formulae over API parameters and expresses tensor-related properties (e.g., shape, tensor data types, etc.) as well as relational properties between parameters. We use the grammar to guide a Large Language Model (LLM) to enumerate syntactically correct candidate rules, which we then validate using the seed inputs. Further, we develop a custom refinement strategy to prune the set of learned rules to eliminate spurious or redundant rules. We use the learned constraints to systematically generate valid and diverse inputs for the API by integrating SMT-based solving with randomized sampling.We evaluate Centaur for testing PyTorch and TensorFlow. Our results show that Centaur’s constraints have a recall of 94.0\% and a precision of 94.0\% on average.
