Additionally, we perform a comparative analysis of mainstream regulations, uncovering significant misalignments in policy standards across different jurisdictions. Our study establishes a critical, theoretical, and practical foundation for ecosystem governance, enabling more effective detection and evidence-based policy refinement.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 移动广告已成为Android生态系统的主要变现模块。然而，这种增长伴随着日益复杂的侵入式广告，它们通过复杂的行为干扰破坏用户自主权。当前对侵入式广告的研究主要针对网页或浏览器内环境，未能解决移动侵入式广告独特的应用内特征。由于缺乏意图感知建模，现有广告分析工具难以区分自愿的人类行为与强制交互。此外，现有市场政策和法律框架缺乏统一术语和可执行规则，导致监管不一致。本文开展了一项探索性研究，以系统性地调查并建模这些侵入式广告行为。我们提出了一个基于监管政策、平台治理指南、行业标准以及主要SDK提供商记录的现实侵入式广告实践的形式化分类体系。基于此，我们应用自动化流水线检测侵入式模式。我们对6000多个应用的分析证实了移动侵入式广告的普遍性。此外，我们对主流法规进行了比较分析，揭示了不同司法辖区政策标准之间的显著错位。我们的研究为生态系统治理建立了关键的理论与实践基础，支持更有效的检测和基于证据的政策完善。

import_candidates.title: Is “Knowing It’s Malicious” Enough? Evaluating LLMs for Fine-Grained Malware Behavior Auditing
import_candidates.abstract: Automated malware classifiers achieve strong detection performance, but auditing requires more than flagging a sample: analysts must explain malicious behaviors and justify them with concrete code evidence, a requirement that traditional signature-based methods and learning-based XAI often fail to satisfy in a human-interpretable manner. Large Language Models (LLMs) appear well-suited for this task due to their code reasoning and summarization ability, yet it remains unclear whether they can support reliable auditing. In particular, evaluating them faces three hurdles: (1) the lack of detailed, human-written behavior ground truth for reliable benchmarking; (2) real-world application codebases typically exceed the context limits of current models, which cannot be fully processed at once; and (3) the absence of reliable mechanisms to verify whether LLM-generated behavioral claims are faithfully supported by concrete code evidence. Together, these obstacles make benchmarking LLM-based auditing non-trivial, leaving their true capabilities and failure modes opaque. To bridge this gap, we introduce MalEval, a diagnostic evaluation framework for systematically measuring the capability boundaries of LLMs in malware auditing. We pair real-world application codebases with expert-written audit reports to obtain fine-grained, behavior-level ground truth. Large codebases are compressed into unified behavior-relevant program contexts via a context-driven intermediate representation that preserves essential call relations. Both expert reports and model outputs are then mapped, through constrained reasoning, into structured evidence chains linking code-level facts to high-level behaviors in a common, comparable space. Built on this foundation, MalEval decomposes auditing into 4 stage-wise auditing tasks, allowing each intermediate judgment to be independently verified under limited context windows. We leverage MalEval to evaluate seven widely used LLMs and uncover clear capability boundaries: models rely on surface cues over verifiable evidence, struggle to compose dispersed facts into coherent attack chains, and are highly sensitive to context formulation. These findings shift the focus from optimizing isolated outputs to designing LLM and agentic workflows that can reliably support malware auditing.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 自动化恶意软件分类器取得了强大的检测性能，但审计需要的不仅仅是标记一个样本：分析人员必须解释恶意行为，并用具体的代码证据来证明这些行为，而传统的基于签名的方法和基于学习的XAI往往无法以人类可解释的方式满足这一要求。大型语言模型（LLM）因其代码推理和摘要能力似乎非常适合这项任务，但它们能否支持可靠的审计仍不清楚。特别地，评估它们面临三个障碍：(1)缺乏详细的人工编写的行为真值来进行可靠基准测试；(2)真实世界的应用代码库通常超出当前模型的上下文限制，无法一次性完整处理；(3)缺乏可靠机制来验证LLM生成的行为声明是否由具体代码证据忠实支持。这些障碍共同使得基于LLM的审计基准测试并非易事，使其真正能力和失败模式不透明。为弥合这一差距，我们引入MalEval，一个诊断性评估框架，用于系统性地衡量LLM在恶意软件审计中的能力边界。我们将真实应用代码库与专家编写的审计报告配对，以获得细粒度、行为级别的真值。大型代码库通过一种上下文驱动的中间表示被压缩为统一的行为相关程序上下文，该表示保留必要的调用关系。然后，通过约束推理，将专家报告和模型输出映射到结构化证据链中，在共同可比较的空间中将代码级事实与高层行为联系起来。在此基础上，MalEval将审计分解为4个阶段式审计任务，允许在有限上下文窗口下独立验证每个中间判断。我们利用MalEval评估了七个广泛使用的LLM，并揭示了明确的能力边界：模型依赖表面线索而非可验证证据，难以将分散的事实组合成连贯的攻击链，并且对上下文表述高度敏感。这些发现将焦点从优化孤立输出转向设计能够可靠支持恶意软件审计的LLM和智能体工作流。

import_candidates.title: Answer Is Cheap, Show Me the Evidence! Augmenting Automated Vulnerability Assessment with Evidence
import_candidates.abstract: Software Vulnerability (SV) assessment is a vital phase in SV management, which characterizes discovered SVs to locate hot spots and prioritize their remediation. To reduce the overhead and latency of manual assessment, prior works have explored automatically predicting assessment results from SV reports (SVRs). However, existing approaches fail to process the information conveyed by the rich text content (e.g., screenshots and code snippets) embedded in SVRs and miss information about vulnerable projects. More importantly, they primarily focus on assessment accuracy while neglecting to provide explanations or evidence supporting their predictions. As a result, these approaches remain impractical in real-world settings, where imperfect accuracy necessitates manual validation. LLMs offer a promising opportunity to address this limitation by performing SV assessment while simultaneously providing supporting evidence. Nevertheless, our extensive evaluation reveals that mainstream LLMs perform poorly on SV assessment tasks, largely due to a lack of assessment specific knowledge. To address the above challenges, we propose EAVA, a novel framework that effectively leverages LLMs to perform SV assessment and provide supporting evidence. EAVA employs specialized LLM agents to process rich text content in SVRs and incorporate information about vulnerable projects. EAVA builds a dedicated assessment LLM by injecting assessment-specific knowledge through finetuning. Specifically, we enable large-scale reasoning trajectory annotation using off-the-shelf LLMs and adopt a two-stage training paradigm, i.e., supervised instruction tuning to inject domain knowledge, followed by reinforcement learning to enhance the model’s intrinsic reasoning capability. Evaluations on a newly collected SVR dataset demonstrate that EAVA outperforms the best-performing baseline by 5.3\%-35.2\% across multiple evaluation metrics. Ablation studies validate the effectiveness of our design choices for both assessment specific model training and SV information enrichment. Finally, a user study with security experts confirms that the evidence provided by EAVA is useful and practical for real-world SV assessment.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 软件漏洞（SV）评估是SV管理中的一个关键阶段，它描述已发现的SV以定位热点并确定其修复优先级。为了减少人工评估的开销和延迟，先前工作探索了从SV报告（SVR）中自动预测评估结果。然而，现有方法无法处理SVR中嵌入的富文本内容（例如截图和代码片段）所传达的信息，并且遗漏了有关易受攻击项目的信息。更重要的是，它们主要关注评估准确性，而忽视了提供支持其预测的解释或证据。因此，在现实环境中，由于不完美的准确性需要人工验证，这些方法仍然不实用。LLM提供了一个有希望的机会，通过执行SV评估同时提供支持证据来解决这一限制。然而，我们的广泛评估表明，主流LLM在SV评估任务上表现不佳，很大程度上是由于缺乏评估特定知识。为了应对上述挑战，我们提出EAVA，一个新颖的框架，有效利用LLM执行SV评估并提供支持证据。EAVA采用专门的LLM代理来处理SVR中的富文本内容，并纳入有关易受攻击项目的信息。EAVA通过微调注入评估特定知识来构建专用的评估LLM。具体而言，我们使用现成的LLM进行大规模推理轨迹标注，并采用两阶段训练范式，即监督指令微调以注入领域知识，随后进行强化学习以增强模型的内在推理能力。在新收集的SVR数据集上的评估表明，EAVA在多个评估指标上比表现最佳的基线高出5.3%-35.2%。消融研究验证了我们在评估特定模型训练和SV信息丰富方面的设计选择的有效性。最后，与安全专家的用户研究证实，EAVA提供的证据对于现实世界的SV评估是有用且实用的。

import_candidates.title: Bridging User Feedback and System Diagnosis: Reproducing Mobile Performance Issues from Reviews
import_candidates.abstract: Mobile application performance is a vital factor for user experience. Yet, performance issues are notoriously difficult to detect in development environments, where they often manifest less conspicuously, making their diagnosis more challenging. In this setting, app reviews from end users across diverse devices and usage contexts can provide timely and context-rich information about emerging performance issues. However, unlike structured bug reports, app reviews are written by end-users and tend to be more ambiguous, with individual reviews often providing only partial descriptions of the underlying issue. To bridge this gap, we present RevPerf, the first approach to automatically reproduce mobile application performance issues by leveraging and synthesizing information from app reviews. RevPerf retrieves complementary reviews via semantic retrieval and uses prompt engineering to integrate them, enriching the original review with performance issue details. An execution agent is then employed to generate and execute commands to reproduce the issue. After executing all necessary steps, the system incorporates multifaceted detection methods to identify performance issues by monitoring Android logs, GUI changes, and system resource utilization during the reproduction process. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed framework achieves a 72.73\% success rate in reproducing performance issues on the constructed dataset, outperforming the best baseline by 27.28 percentage points.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 移动应用性能是用户体验的关键因素。然而，性能问题在开发环境中 notoriously 难以检测，它们往往表现得不那么明显，从而使其诊断更具挑战性。在这种情况下，来自不同设备和使用场景的终端用户的应用评论可以提供关于新出现性能问题的及时且上下文丰富的信息。然而，与结构化缺陷报告不同，应用评论由终端用户撰写，往往更加模糊，单条评论通常只提供底层问题的部分描述。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了 RevPerf，这是第一个通过利用和综合应用评论中的信息来自动复现移动应用性能问题的方法。RevPerf 通过语义检索获取互补评论，并使用提示工程将其整合，用性能问题细节丰富原始评论。然后使用执行代理生成并执行命令以复现该问题。在执行所有必要步骤后，系统结合多方面检测方法，通过监控 Android 日志、GUI 变化和复现过程中的系统资源利用率来识别性能问题。实验结果表明，我们提出的框架在构建的数据集上复现性能问题达到了 72.73% 的成功率，比最佳基线高出 27.28 个百分点。

import_candidates.title: Vbox: Efficient Black-Box Serializability Verification
import_candidates.abstract: Verifying the serializability of transaction histories is essential for assessing whether a database management system (DBMS) correctly enforces the claimed serializable isolation level. Black-box serializability verification provides a practical means for such a validation without relying on internal system details. Existing approaches often suffer from limitations, including incomplete anomaly detection, high verification overhead, excessive memory consumption, or dependence on specific concurrency control protocols. This paper presents Vbox, a black-box serializability verification method that incorporates support for predicate database operations, systematic use of transaction timing information, and a satisfiability (SAT)-based formulation with an efficient solver. Both theoretical analysis and experimental evaluation show that Vbox is correct and efficient, detects a wider range of data anomalies, and does not rely on any particular concurrency control protocol.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 验证事务历史的可串行性对于评估数据库管理系统（DBMS）是否正确实现了所声称的可串行化隔离级别至关重要。黑盒可串行化验证提供了一种不依赖内部系统细节的实用验证手段。现有方法通常存在局限性，包括异常检测不完整、验证开销高、内存消耗过大或依赖特定并发控制协议。本文提出了Vbox，一种黑盒可串行化验证方法，它支持谓词数据库操作、系统化地利用事务时序信息，以及基于可满足性（SAT）的高效求解器公式化。理论分析和实验评估均表明，Vbox正确且高效，能检测更广泛的数据异常，并且不依赖任何特定的并发控制协议。

import_candidates.title: Automated Dependency Optimization for Artifact-Based Build Systems
import_candidates.abstract: As projects grow, the maintenance of intra- and inter-project dependencies becomes increasingly complex. If dependency maintenance is lax, redundant dependencies may accrue, inflating incremental build and test latencies. The heterogeneity of language- and tool-specific dependency expressions and the complexity of the dependency graphs that they specify exacerbate the challenge of identifying and removing redundant dependencies. To address these challenges, this paper introduces DepReduce, an automated approach for optimizing declared dependencies in artifact-based build systems. DepReduce operates directly on the dependency graph managed by the underlying build system, and formalizes the optimization objective as minimizing the cumulative rebuild cost triggered by changes to individual targets. To achieve this, DepReduce performs the dependency lifting and dependency flattening operations on the dependency graph in topological order, which we prove is both correct and optimal under the defined optimization objective. To empirically evaluate the approach, we implemented BazelDepReduce, an automated dependency optimization tool for Bazel. Bazel is an artifact-based build system with native support for multiple programming languages. We evaluated BazelDepReduce on 19 open-source Bazel projects written in seven programming languages. Among them, 16 projects across six languages achieved reductions in rebuild cost. In total, BazelDepReduce identified and removed 430 redundant dependencies, which we used to produce 16 Pull Requests (PRs). Twelve PRs have been merged by the target projects, including Angular and Apache RocketMQ, affecting up to 80.6\% of subsequent commits, with a median of 26.3\%. We also adapted BazelDepReduce to support Buck and Cargo, providing preliminary evidence that the implementation can be extended to other artifact-based build systems. Overall, these results show that our approach can effectively reduce rebuild cost on selected Bazel projects spanning multiple languages.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着项目增长，项目内和项目间依赖的维护变得越来越复杂。如果依赖维护松懈，冗余依赖可能会累积，从而增加增量构建和测试的延迟。语言和工具特定的依赖表达方式的异构性，以及它们所指定的依赖图的复杂性，加剧了识别和移除冗余依赖的挑战。为了应对这些挑战，本文提出了DepReduce，一种用于优化基于工件的构建系统中声明依赖的自动化方法。DepReduce直接作用于底层构建系统管理的依赖图，并将优化目标形式化为最小化由单个目标变更触发的累积重建成本。为了实现这一点，DepReduce按拓扑顺序对依赖图执行依赖提升和依赖展平操作，我们证明在定义的优化目标下该操作既正确又最优。为了实证评估该方法，我们实现了BazelDepReduce，一个面向Bazel的自动化依赖优化工具。Bazel是一个原生支持多种编程语言的基于工件的构建系统。我们在19个用七种编程语言编写的开源Bazel项目上评估了BazelDepReduce。其中，16个跨六种语言的项目实现了重建成本的降低。总体而言，BazelDepReduce识别并移除了430个冗余依赖，我们用这些依赖生成了16个拉取请求（PR）。十二个PR已被目标项目合并，包括Angular和Apache RocketMQ，影响后续提交的比例高达80.6%，中位数为26.3%。我们还调整了BazelDepReduce以支持Buck和Cargo，提供了初步证据表明该实现可以扩展到其他基于工件的构建系统。总体而言，这些结果表明我们的方法可以有效降低所选跨多种语言的Bazel项目的重建成本。

import_candidates.title: Uncovering Business Logic Bugs via Semantics-Driven Unit Test Generation (Experience Paper)
import_candidates.abstract: Business logic bugs violate intended business semantics and are particularly prevalent in enterprise software. Yet most existing unit test generation techniques are code-centric, making such bugs difficult to expose. We present SeGa, a semantics-driven unit test generation technique for uncovering business logic bugs. SeGa constructs a semantic knowledge base from product requirement documents, represented as a set of functionality entries that group related requirements under a common business intent. Given a focal method, SeGa retrieves the relevant functionality entries and derives fine-grained business scenarios with explicit preconditions, triggering actions, expected outcomes, and semantic constraints to guide LLM-based test generation. We evaluate SeGa on four industrial Go projects containing 60 real-world business logic bugs. SeGa detects 22~25 more bugs than four state-of-the-art LLM-based techniques and improves precision by 26.9\%~34.3\%. Deployment across 6 production repositories further uncovers 16 previously unknown business logic bugs that were confirmed and fixed by developers, demonstrating SeGa's practical value. From our industrial study, we summarize a series of lessons and suggestions for practical use and future research.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 业务逻辑缺陷违反预期的业务语义，在企业软件中尤为普遍。然而，大多数现有单元测试生成技术以代码为中心，使得这类缺陷难以暴露。我们提出SeGa，一种语义驱动的单元测试生成技术，用于揭示业务逻辑缺陷。SeGa从产品需求文档构建语义知识库，表示为一组功能条目，这些条目将相关需求归组在共同的业务意图下。给定一个焦点方法，SeGa检索相关的功能条目，并推导出细粒度的业务场景，包括明确的前置条件、触发动作、预期结果和语义约束，以指导基于LLM的测试生成。我们在四个包含60个真实世界业务逻辑缺陷的工业Go项目上评估SeGa。SeGa比四种最先进的基于LLM的技术多检测出22~25个缺陷，并将精确率提高了26.9%~34.3%。在6个生产代码库中的部署进一步发现了16个此前未知的业务逻辑缺陷，这些缺陷已由开发者确认并修复，证明了SeGa的实际价值。从我们的工业研究中，我们总结了一系列经验教训和建议，以供实际使用和未来研究参考。

import_candidates.title: Just Old Wine in a New Bottle: Improving Vulnerability Repair Robustness to Combat Homologous but Heterogeneous Vulnerabilities
import_candidates.abstract: Collaborative development practices, such as forking and branching, enable parallel development and rapid iteration but significantly complicate vulnerability management. A major challenge is the propagation of homologous but heterogeneous vulnerabilities, where the same vulnerability appears within evolved code contexts that differ structurally and contextually across divergent branches or forks.Existing Automated Vulnerability Repair (AVR) approaches often fail in these scenarios due to their limited ability to generalize across structural and contextual variations. To address this problem, we propose EvoRepair, a robust AVR framework tailored for code evolution contexts. Our approach leverages a Retrieval-Augmented Generation based Evolution Specialist to synthesize code evolution variants, enriching the training data with diverse code contexts. We then employ Chain-of-Thought reasoning and curriculum learning to train a Repair Specialist, enabling it to capture invariant repair logic during structural and contextual changes. We evaluate EvoRepair on two datasets representing cross-branch and cross-fork scenarios. Evaluation results demonstrate that EvoRepair successfully repaired 35.33\% of the vulnerabilities on average in evolution scenarios, outperforming the state-of-the-art baseline Vul-R2 by 42.12\%. Furthermore, EvoRepair also demonstrates superior generalizability in non-evolution scenarios, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the PrimeVul dataset by fixing 25.75\% of the vulnerabilities, surpassing the best baseline by 21.75\%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 协作开发实践（如复刻和分支）实现了并行开发和快速迭代，但显著复杂化了漏洞管理。一个主要挑战是同源但异质漏洞的传播，即同一漏洞出现在不同分支或复刻之间在结构和上下文上存在差异的演化代码环境中。现有的自动化漏洞修复（AVR）方法由于在结构和上下文变化上的泛化能力有限，在这些场景中往往失败。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 EvoRepair，一个针对代码演化环境量身定制的鲁棒 AVR 框架。我们的方法利用基于检索增强生成的演化专家来合成代码演化变体，用多样的代码上下文丰富训练数据。然后，我们采用思维链推理和课程学习来训练修复专家，使其能够在结构和上下文变化期间捕获不变的修复逻辑。我们在代表跨分支和跨复刻场景的两个数据集上评估 EvoRepair。评估结果表明，EvoRepair 在演化场景中平均成功修复了 35.33% 的漏洞，比最先进的基线 Vul-R2 高出 42.12%。此外，EvoRepair 在非演化场景中也表现出卓越的泛化能力，在 PrimeVul 数据集上达到最先进性能，修复了 25.75% 的漏洞，超过最佳基线 21.75%。

import_candidates.title: SpectraDL: A Historical Issue-Driven, Test Specification-Assisted Transfer Testing Approach for Deep Learning Frameworks via LLMs
import_candidates.abstract: Deep learning (DL) frameworks provide diverse fundamental algorithmic units as operators, which are critical infrastructure for constructing various intelligent software. Since mainstream frameworks widely adopt the open-source development paradigm, bugs may recur across operators and even across frameworks. Recent studies leverage large language models (LLMs) and historical issues to generate cross-framework test cases. However, existing approaches still suffer from two limitations. First, their test cases have low fault detection capability because they mainly reuse inputs or contexts from historical issues without considering the underlying root causes. Second, an effective mechanism for determining the appropriate transfer scope within a target framework is lacking. To overcome these limitations, we propose SpectraDL, a historical issue-driven, test specification-assisted transfer testing approach for DL frameworks. SpectraDL first extracts rigorous test specifications for each operator from official documentation, and then extracts and transforms historical issues and associated pull requests into structured fault representations (i.e., bug patterns). SpectraDL uses a dual retrieval mechanism based on semantic intent and structural input-space features to transfer these bug patterns to related operators across frameworks. Experiments on four mainstream DL frameworks show that SpectraDL detected 125 previously unknown bugs, 107 of which developers confirmed. The results confirm that SpectraDL delivers a promising transfer testing approach for DL frameworks.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 深度学习（DL）框架提供了多种基础算法单元作为算子，这些算子是构建各种智能软件的关键基础设施。由于主流框架广泛采用开源开发范式，缺陷可能在算子之间甚至框架之间重复出现。近期研究利用大型语言模型（LLM）和历史问题来生成跨框架测试用例。然而，现有方法仍存在两个局限。首先，它们的测试用例故障检测能力较低，因为它们主要复用历史问题中的输入或上下文，而没有考虑根本原因。其次，缺乏一种有效机制来确定目标框架内合适的迁移范围。为克服这些局限，我们提出SpectraDL，一种历史问题驱动、测试规范辅助的深度学习框架迁移测试方法。SpectraDL首先从官方文档中为每个算子提取严格的测试规范，然后将历史问题及关联的拉取请求提取并转换为结构化的故障表示（即缺陷模式）。SpectraDL使用基于语义意图和结构化输入空间特征的双重检索机制，将这些缺陷模式迁移到跨框架的相关算子上。在四个主流深度学习框架上的实验表明，SpectraDL检测到125个先前未知的缺陷，其中107个被开发者确认。结果证实SpectraDL为深度学习框架提供了一种有前景的迁移测试方法。

import_candidates.title: BCaLLM: Call Graph-Guided Python Breaking Change Detection with Large Language Models
import_candidates.abstract: Software libraries frequently evolve, introducing breaking changes that disrupt client applications. Existing detection approaches primarily target static programming languages or focus on syntactic changes, leaving behavioral breaking changes in dynamic languages such as Python underexplored. This task is particularly challenging due to side effects and call relationships, two critical factors that implicitly alter API behaviors and propagate change impact across library APIs. To address these challenges, we propose a generalized taxonomy of function API breaking changes. Grounded in Hyrum’s Law, our taxonomy is defined from the client’s perspective of observable behaviors and unifies both syntactic and behavioral categories in a multi-label formulation. Furthermore, we present BCaLLM, a novel framework to detect fine-grained breaking changes in Python packages by leveraging call graphs and large language models (LLMs). BCaLLM constructs a fused call graph to scope change impact, prunes compatible APIs and code context via memory-based heuristics, and employs an LLM to detect specific breaking changes. We construct PyBCEval, a manually annotated benchmark of 588 APIs from 27 version pairs of 19 widely used Python packages. Experiments with diverse LLMs show that BCaLLM outperforms text-based baselines by 3.71\%–10.16\% and LLM-based baselines by 1.60\%–4.83\% in F1-score.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 软件库频繁演化，引入破坏性变更，从而干扰客户端应用。现有的检测方法主要针对静态编程语言或关注语法变更，导致诸如Python等动态语言中的行为性破坏变更研究不足。由于副作用和调用关系这两个关键因素会隐式改变API行为并在库API之间传播变更影响，该任务尤其具有挑战性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一个函数API破坏性变更的广义分类法。基于Hyrum定律，我们的分类法从客户端可观察行为的角度定义，并在多标签公式中统一了语法和行为的类别。此外，我们提出了BCaLLM，一种通过利用调用图和大语言模型（LLMs）来检测Python包中细粒度破坏性变更的新框架。BCaLLM构建融合调用图以界定变更影响范围，通过基于记忆的启发式方法修剪兼容的API和代码上下文，并采用LLM检测特定的破坏性变更。我们构建了PyBCEval，这是一个手动标注的基准，包含来自19个广泛使用的Python包的27个版本对中的588个API。使用多种LLM进行的实验表明，BCaLLM在F1分数上比基于文本的基线高出3.71%–10.16%，比基于LLM的基线高出1.60%–4.83%。

import_candidates.title: Compiling Large Multi-modal Requirement Documents into Runnable Software Systems: From an Agentic Test-Driven Perspective
import_candidates.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly improved programming efficiency by parsing natural language into code snippets. However, their performance degrades significantly as requirements scale; when faced with multi-modal documents containing hundreds of scenarios, LLMs often produce incorrect implementations or omit crucial constraints. Observing LLMs' ever-evolving capability and their persistent stochastic hallucination, we raise a question: whether it is possible to make LLM-based agentic programming go beyond "code generation" to "requirement compilation", i.e., whether programmers can produce a runnable system by only accomplishing (non-trivial) requirement documents? In this work, we take a first step by proposing the ARC (Agentic Requirement Compilation) technique to parse a multi-modal requirement document, describing hundreds of scenarios in a DSL format, into a runnable software system. In addition to the source code, ARC also generates software engineering artifacts including (1) a modular design that spans the user interface, API interface, and database, (2) enriched test cases for each interface (including unit tests, modular tests, and integration tests), and (3) detailed traceability across all artifacts for software maintenance. Our approach employs a bidirectional test-driven agentic loop: (1) a top-down architecture phase that decomposes requirements into UI, API, and database interfaces, each of which is equipped with verifiable test suites, and (2) a bottom-up implementation phase where agents generate code that must satisfy the generated tests. Throughout this process, ARC maintains strict traceability across requirements, design, and code to facilitate intelligent asset reuse and follow-up maintenance. We evaluate ARC on two complementary benchmarks, i.e., a depth-oriented benchmark of 6 runnable web systems spanning 50-200 requirement scenarios, and the breadth-oriented AppForge benchmark comprising 101 Android app generation tasks. Across 3 independent trials, ARC outperforms all state-of-the-art LLM-based baselines, with the generated web systems passing on average 50.6\% more GUI tests, and achieving 100\% compile success and 68.3\% test case pass rate on AppForge. In addition, a user study with 21 participants shows that participants with limited programming experience successfully write DSL-based documents consisting of 50 to 174 scenarios, within 5.6 hours on average, to generate a runnable system such as a real-world ticket-booking system of around 10K lines of code with maintainable architecture.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）通过将自然语言解析为代码片段，显著提高了编程效率。然而，当需求规模扩大时，它们的性能会显著下降；面对包含数百个场景的多模态文档时，LLM 常常产生错误实现或遗漏关键约束。观察到 LLM 不断增强的能力以及其持续存在的随机幻觉，我们提出一个问题：是否可能让基于 LLM 的智能体编程超越“代码生成”而走向“需求编译”，即程序员是否只需完成（非平凡的）需求文档就能生成一个可运行的系统？在这项工作中，我们迈出第一步，提出 ARC（Agentic Requirement Compilation）技术，将用 DSL 格式描述数百个场景的多模态需求文档解析为可运行的软件系统。除了源代码，ARC 还生成软件工程制品，包括：（1）跨越用户界面、API 接口和数据库的模块化设计，（2）为每个接口丰富的测试用例（包括单元测试、模块测试和集成测试），以及（3）所有制品之间详细的追溯关系，以支持软件维护。我们的方法采用双向测试驱动的智能体循环：（1）自顶向下的架构阶段，将需求分解为 UI、API 和数据库接口，每个接口都配备可验证的测试套件；（2）自底向上的实现阶段，智能体生成必须满足所生成测试的代码。在整个过程中，ARC 在需求、设计和代码之间保持严格的可追溯性，以促进智能资产复用和后续维护。我们在两个互补的基准上评估 ARC，即一个面向深度的基准，包含 6 个可运行 Web 系统，跨越 50-200 个需求场景；以及一个面向广度的 AppForge 基准，包含 101 个 Android 应用生成任务。在 3 次独立试验中，ARC 优于所有最先进的基于 LLM 的基线，生成的 Web 系统平均多通过 50.6% 的 GUI 测试，并在 AppForge 上实现 100% 编译成功和 68.3% 测试用例通过率。此外，一项有 21 名参与者参与的用户研究表明，编程经验有限的参与者成功编写了包含 50 到 174 个场景的基于 DSL 的文档，平均耗时 5.6 小时，生成了可运行系统，例如一个约 1 万行代码、具有可维护架构的真实世界票务预订系统。

import_candidates.title: COEUR: COhesion and Exhaustiveness of User Stories Representations
import_candidates.abstract: User Stories are key artifacts in Requirement and Software Engineering. Despite their wide adoption, their writing in industrial contexts tends to diverge from the principles initially stated in Agile methodologies. In this context, sets of metrics such as INVEST or QUS emerged to qualify these items. In this paper, we argue that the said sets of metrics are only partially efficient at capturing the quality of user stories contextualized in a project, and that their actual adoption in business contexts is limited due to multiple aspects: their unfitness to specific contexts, the difficulty of implementation requiring human intervention, the absence of reproducibility or their misalignment with actual quality of user stories. Such limitations, prevent practitioners from efficiently applying them for downstream tasks such as LLM-based user story generation. To address these challenges, we introduce COEUR, a framework comprising two metrics: Cohesion and Exhaustiveness. These metrics are designed to mirror core Product Owner responsibilities. Specifically, Cohesion evaluates the structural organization and logical grouping of the backlog, while Exhaustiveness monitors the semantic alignment between the elicited needs and the proposed technical solutions. Additionally, they are quantitative, reproducible, and automatically computable. To evaluate COEUR, we conduct four empirical experiments organized into two validation tracks. The first track utilizes two noising-based experiments to assess our metrics' sensitivity to requirement degradation. The second track evaluates their performance in generative contexts through two standard learning paradigms for LLMs: In-Context Learning (ICL) and Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), both applied to our user story generation task. Subsequently, COEUR provides a turnkey measurement of Product Backlogs' quality for both project monitoring by human experts and LLM benchmarking applied to automatic user stories generation.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 用户故事是需求工程与软件工程中的关键制品。尽管其被广泛采用，工业环境中的写作往往偏离敏捷方法最初提出的原则。在此背景下，INVEST 或 QUS 等度量指标集应运而生，用于限定这些条目的质量。本文认为，这些度量指标集只能部分有效地捕捉项目中情境化的用户故事质量，并且由于多方面原因，其在业务环境中的实际采用有限：不适合特定情境、需要人工干预而难以实现、缺乏可复现性，或者与实际用户故事质量不一致。这些局限使从业者难以将其有效应用于下游任务，例如基于 LLM 的用户故事生成。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 COEUR，一个包含两个度量指标的框架：内聚性（Cohesion）和穷尽性（Exhaustiveness）。这些指标旨在反映产品负责人的核心职责。具体而言，内聚性评估待办事项列表的结构组织与逻辑分组，而穷尽性监控所激发的需求与所提出的技术解决方案之间的语义对齐。此外，它们是定量的、可复现的，并且可以自动计算。为评估 COEUR，我们开展了四项实证实验，组织为两条验证路线。第一条路线使用两个基于噪声的实验来评估我们的指标对需求退化的敏感性。第二条路线通过两种标准的 LLM 学习范式——上下文学习（ICL）和有监督微调（SFT）——在生成情境中评估其性能，二者均应用于我们的用户故事生成任务。随后，COEUR 为产品待办列表的质量提供了即用型度量，既可用于人类专家的项目监控，也可用于面向自动用户故事生成的 LLM 基准测试。

import_candidates.title: Ghosts in the Memory: Detecting Unintended Sensitive Data in Android Apps
import_candidates.abstract: Android apps often retain sensitive information such as co-users’ data, authentication tokens, and encryption keys in memory, leaving them vulnerable to unauthorized access. Existing dynamic analysis tools struggle to detect such memory-resident leaks because of three fundamental challenges: (i) runtime application self-protection (RASP) and other anti-analysis mechanisms actively detect and block conventional instrumentation;(ii) the semantic gap between high-level data types and their raw memory representations obscures sensitive content; and (iii) the transient nature of memory-resident data causes snapshot-based methods to misscritical exposures. We present Android-MRI, an OS-level analysis tool that embeds tracing directly into the Android kernel to detect unintended sensitive data leakage through memory while remaining invisible to application-layer defenses. Android-MRI provides instruction-granular monitoring to track the propagation of sensitive data in memory, surfacing the full context of unintended persistence. In an evaluation of 50 popular apps (≥1M installs), Android-MRI bypassed 97.6\% of RASP protections (vs. 52.4\% for Frida) and revealed 17 previously unknown memory disclosures. These included leaks of profile PINs, subscription-only content, and cryptographic keys. 12 vendors confirmed the issues; 4 have patched them, and 3 (Netflix, Smule, and Delivery Express) acknowledged them via bug bounty programs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Android应用通常会在内存中保留敏感信息，例如共同用户的数据、身份验证令牌和加密密钥，使其容易被未经授权访问。现有的动态分析工具难以检测此类驻留内存的泄漏，原因有三项根本挑战：(i) 运行时应用自保护（RASP）和其他反分析机制会主动检测并阻止常规插桩；(ii) 高层数据类型与其原始内存表示之间的语义差距会掩盖敏感内容；(iii) 内存驻留数据的瞬态性质导致基于快照的方法错过关键暴露。我们提出 Android-MRI，一种操作系统级分析工具，将跟踪直接嵌入 Android 内核，以检测通过内存发生的非预期敏感数据泄漏，同时对应用层防御保持不可见。Android-MRI 提供指令粒度的监控，以跟踪敏感数据在内存中的传播，揭示非预期驻留的完整上下文。在对50款热门应用（安装量≥100万）的评估中，Android-MRI 绕过了97.6%的RASP保护（Frida为52.4%），并揭示了17个此前未知的内存泄露。这些包括个人资料PIN码、仅订阅内容以及加密密钥的泄露。12家供应商确认了这些问题；4家已修补，3家（Netflix、Smule 和 Delivery Express）通过漏洞赏金计划予以确认。

import_candidates.title: PAGENT: Program Analysis Guided LLM Agent for Proof-of-Concept Generation
import_candidates.abstract: Software developers frequently receive vulnerability reports that require them to reproduce the vulnerability in a reliable manner by generating a proof-of-concept (PoC) input that triggers it. Given the source code for a software project and a specific code location for a potential vulnerability, automatically generating a PoC for the given vulnerability has been a challenging research problem. Symbolic execution and fuzzing techniques require expert guidance and manual steps and face scalability challenges for PoC generation. Although recent advances in LLMs have increased the level of automation and scalability, the success rate of PoC generation with LLMs remains quite low. In this paper, we present a novel approach called Program Analysis Guided proof of concept generation agENT (PAGENT) that is scalable and significantly improves the success rate of LLM-based automated PoC generation compared to prior results. PAGENT integrates lightweight and rule-based static analysis phases for providing static analysis guidance and sanitizer-based profiling and coverage information for providing dynamic analysis guidance with a PoC generation agent. Our experiments demonstrate that the resulting hybrid approach significantly outperforms the prior top-performing agentic approach by 132\% for the PoC generation task across 10 open-source projects. PAGENT also discovered 32 post-patch PoCs that trigger the vulnerability in the patched version of the source code, with 2 reproducing the crash in the most recent versions.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 软件开发人员经常收到漏洞报告，需要通过生成触发漏洞的概念验证（PoC）输入来可靠地复现该漏洞。给定软件项目的源代码以及潜在漏洞的具体代码位置，自动为给定漏洞生成PoC一直是一个具有挑战性的研究问题。符号执行和模糊测试技术需要专家指导与手动步骤，并且在PoC生成方面面临可扩展性挑战。尽管最近LLM的进展提高了自动化水平和可扩展性，但使用LLM生成PoC的成功率仍然相当低。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的方法，称为程序分析引导的概念验证生成智能体（PAGENT），它具有可扩展性，并且与先前结果相比，显著提高了基于LLM的自动化PoC生成成功率。PAGENT将轻量级且基于规则的静态分析阶段（用于提供静态分析指导）以及基于Sanitizer的性能剖析与覆盖率信息（用于提供动态分析指导）与PoC生成智能体集成在一起。我们的实验表明，在10个开源项目的PoC生成任务上，由此产生的混合方法显著优于先前表现最佳的智能体方法，提升了132%。PAGENT还发现了32个补丁后PoC，它们在源代码的已修补版本中触发该漏洞，其中2个在最新版本中复现了崩溃。

import_candidates.title: Steering Tree-of-Thought Reasoning via Deductive Verification
import_candidates.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated great potential in code reasoning tasks, but their reasoning processes lack reliable verification mechanisms, making it difficult to ensure logical correctness. The Tree of Thoughts (ToT) framework improves reasoning by exploring multiple paths and employing backtracking, yet its path selection relies entirely on LLM-based self-evaluation—a heuristic and error-prone mechanism—leading to frequent erroneous pruning and unproductive exploration. We identify a key insight: LLMs’ encoding capability is stronger than their reasoning capability—translating code semantics into formal constraints is a pattern-matching task that LLMs can perform reliably, while verification should be delegated to SMT(Satisfiability Modulo Theories) solvers. Based on this insight, we propose Deductive Steering, a mechanism that integrates SMT solver verification into Tree of Thoughts exploration. It consists of four core components: (1) Candidate Generator produces candidate reasoning steps, each comprising a natural language thought t and its SMT constraint encoding ϕ; (2) Deductive Evaluator verifies whether a candidate constraint ϕ is a logical consequence of the accumulated constraint Φ by checking the unsatisfiability of Φ ∧ ¬ ϕ; (3) Counterexample Refinement uses counterexample to guide the LLM in correcting its reasoning when verification fails; (4) Exploration and Backtracking Strategy manages path exploration and backtracks to alternative candidates when verification fails. Experiments on five benchmarks covering fault localization, program synthesis, and loop invariant generation show that, compared with ToT, Deductive Steering improves task-level effectiveness by 9.2–32.6 percentage points while reducing token consumption by 35.7–52.4\%. The method generalizes across different LLMs and extends to mathematical reasoning, demonstrating broad applicability to domains where reasoning can be encoded as formal constraints.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在代码推理任务中展现出巨大潜力，但其推理过程缺乏可靠的验证机制，难以确保逻辑正确性。思维树（Tree of Thoughts, ToT）框架通过探索多条路径并采用回溯来改进推理，但其路径选择完全依赖于基于LLM的自我评估——一种启发式且易出错的机制——导致频繁的错误剪枝和无效探索。我们发现一个关键洞见：LLM的编码能力强于其推理能力——将代码语义翻译为形式化约束是一种模式匹配任务，LLM可以可靠地执行，而验证应委托给SMT（可满足性模理论）求解器。基于这一洞见，我们提出演绎引导（Deductive Steering），一种将SMT求解器验证集成到思维树探索中的机制。它包含四个核心组件：（1）候选生成器产生候选推理步骤，每个步骤包含自然语言思维t及其SMT约束编码φ；（2）演绎评估器通过检查Φ ∧ ¬φ的不可满足性来验证候选约束φ是否是累积约束Φ的逻辑后承；（3）反例精化在验证失败时利用反例引导LLM修正其推理；（4）探索与回溯策略管理路径探索，并在验证失败时回溯到备选候选。在涵盖故障定位、程序合成和循环不变式生成的五个基准上的实验表明，与ToT相比，演绎引导将任务级有效性提高了9.2–32.6个百分点，同时将token消耗降低了35.7–52.4%。该方法可泛化到不同的LLM，并扩展到数学推理，展示了在推理可编码为形式化约束的领域中的广泛适用性。

import_candidates.title: HELO-APR: Enhancing Low-Resource Program Repair through Cross-Lingual Knowledge Transfer
import_candidates.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on automatic program repair (APR) for high-resource programming languages (HRPLs), but their effectiveness drops sharply in low-resource programming languages (LRPLs) due to the lack of sufficient verified buggy–fixed pairs for APR training. To address this challenge, we propose HELO-APR (High-resource Enabled LOw-resource APR), a two-stage APR framework that enables cross-lingual transfer of repair knowledge from HRPLs to LRPLs. HELO-APR (1) constructs high-quality LRPL training data by synthesizing LRPL buggy–fixed pairs from their HRPL counterparts, preserving defect-type consistency while ensuring that the synthesized code is idiomatic; and (2) adopts a curriculum learning strategy that progressively performs HRPL repair learning, cross-lingual repair alignment, and LRPL repair adaptation, thereby improving repair effectiveness in LRPLs. Using C++ as the source HRPL and Ruby and Rust as the target LRPLs, experiments on xCodeEval show that HELO-APR achieves the best macro-average Pass@k results and outperforms strong baselines in most settings. It increases Pass@1 from 31.17\% to 48.65\% on DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B and from 1.67\% to 11.97\% on CodeLlama-7B, while improving syntactic validity by raising the macro-average target compilation rate on CodeLlama from 49.77\% to 91.98\%. On Defects4Ruby, HELO-APR increases BLEU-4 from 61.20 to 66.79 and ROUGE-1 from 76.76 to 83.59 on CodeLlama-7B, indicating higher similarity to developer patches in real-world settings. Finally, we conduct ablation studies to assess the necessity of each core component. These results suggest that verified cross-lingual supervision provides a reusable approach for improving LLM-based repair in low-resource programming languages.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在高资源编程语言（HRPLs）的自动程序修复（APR）中表现良好，但由于缺乏足够的经过验证的错误-修复对用于APR训练，它们在低资源编程语言（LRPLs）中的效果急剧下降。为应对这一挑战，我们提出HELO-APR（High-resource Enabled LOw-resource APR），一个两阶段的APR框架，能够将修复知识从HRPLs跨语言迁移到LRPLs。HELO-APR（1）通过从HRPL对应代码合成LRPL错误-修复对来构建高质量的LRPL训练数据，在保持缺陷类型一致性的同时确保合成代码符合语言习惯；（2）采用课程学习策略，逐步进行HRPL修复学习、跨语言修复对齐和LRPL修复适应，从而提高LRPLs中的修复效果。使用C++作为源HRPL，Ruby和Rust作为目标LRPLs，在xCodeEval上的实验表明，HELO-APR取得了最佳的宏平均Pass@k结果，并在大多数设置中优于强基线。它将DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B上的Pass@1从31.17%提高到48.65%，将CodeLlama-7B上的Pass@1从1.67%提高到11.97%，同时通过将CodeLlama的宏平均目标编译率从49.77%提高到91.98%来改善语法有效性。在Defects4Ruby上，HELO-APR在CodeLlama-7B上将BLEU-4从61.20提高到66.79，将ROUGE-1从76.76提高到83.59，表明与真实世界设置中开发者补丁的相似度更高。最后，我们进行消融研究以评估每个核心组件的必要性。这些结果表明，经过验证的跨语言监督为改善低资源编程语言中基于LLM的修复提供了一种可重用的方法。

import_candidates.title: On Behavioral Alignment of Model-Code and Human-Code Understandability via Behavioral Proxies
import_candidates.abstract: Code understandability is a critical aspect of software quality. Prior research has largely focused on this attribute from a human-centric or code-centric perspective, while it should be viewed as a relational property arising from the interaction between a reader and the code. With the increasing adoption of large language models (LLMs) in software engineering, we posit that the notion of “reader” should be generalized to encompass both humans and models. Building on this relational perspective, we extend the concept of code understandability to distinguish between human and model code understandability, aiming to investigate the behavioral alignment between the two. To this end, we use a dataset from a prior study containing human-rated judgments of understandability across diverse participant groups, and evaluate multiple open and closed-source LLMs. To operationalize such behavioral alignment, we introduce four behavioral proxies of model-code understandability (BPMU): P0, based on program comprehension-focused question answering; and P1–P3, based on program intent summarization (derived from our proposed semantic self-consistency). Our findings show that LLMs exhibit stronger behavioral alignment with general human code understandability than previously used shallow machine learning baselines. Stratified analyses further reveal that model code understandability aligns most closely with professional developers, but significantly less with other student groups. Role-conditioned prompting does not improve the alignment for the latter, suggesting that current LLMs cannot accurately mimic the perspectives of human readers with varying expertise. Finally, we demonstrate that semantic self-consistency is a reliable and extensible measure to be used as a behavioral proxy for quantifying model code understandability, with broad implications in both software engineering research and practice.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 代码可理解性是软件质量的一个关键方面。先前的研究主要从以人为中心或以代码为中心的视角关注这一属性，而它应被视为一种由读者与代码之间交互所产生的关系属性。随着大型语言模型（LLMs）在软件工程中的日益采用，我们主张“读者”的概念应被推广至涵盖人类和模型。基于这种关系视角，我们扩展了代码可理解性的概念，以区分人类代码可理解性和模型代码可理解性，旨在研究两者之间的行为对齐。为此，我们使用了一项先前研究中的数据集，该数据集包含跨不同参与者群体的人类评级的可理解性判断，并评估了多个开源和闭源LLMs。为了操作化这种行为对齐，我们引入了四个模型代码可理解性的行为代理（BPMU）：P0，基于程序理解聚焦的问答；以及P1–P3，基于程序意图摘要（源自我们提出的语义自一致性）。我们的研究结果表明，与先前使用的浅层机器学习基线相比，LLMs 与一般人类代码可理解性表现出更强的行为对齐。分层分析进一步表明，模型代码可理解性与专业开发人员最为一致，但与其他学生群体的一致性显著较低。角色条件提示并未改善后者的对齐，这表明当前的 LLMs 无法准确模仿具有不同专业知识的人类读者的视角。最后，我们证明语义自一致性是一种可靠且可扩展的度量，可用作量化模型代码可理解性的行为代理，在软件工程研究和实践中具有广泛的意义。

import_candidates.title: FuncDroid: Towards Inter-functional Flows for Comprehensive Mobile App GUI Testing
import_candidates.abstract: As mobile application (app) functionalities grow increasingly complex and their iterations accelerate, ensuring high reliability presents significant challenges. While functionality-oriented GUI testing has attracted growing research attention, existing approaches largely overlook interactions across functionalities, making them ineffective at uncovering deep bugs hidden in inter-functional behaviors. To fill this gap, we first design a Functional Flow Graph (FFG), a behavioral model that explicitly captures an app’s functional units and their inter-functional interactions. Based on the FFG, we further introduce an inter-functional-flow-oriented GUI testing approach with the dual goals of precise model construction and deep bug detection. This approach is realized through a long–short-term-view-guided testing process. By combining two complementary test-generation views, it can adaptively refine functional boundaries and systematically explore inter-functional flows under diverse triggering conditions. We implement our approach in a tool called FuncDroid, and evaluate it on two benchmarks: (1) a widely‑used open‑source benchmark with 50 reproducible crash bugs and (2) a diverse set of 52 popular commercial apps. Experimental results demonstrate that FuncDroid significantly outperforms state‑of‑the‑art baselines in both coverage (+28\%) and bug detection number (+107\%). Moreover, FuncDroid successfully uncovers 18 previously unknown non‑crash functional bugs in commercial apps, confirming its practical effectiveness.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着移动应用程序（app）功能日益复杂且迭代加速，确保高可靠性面临重大挑战。尽管面向功能的GUI测试已吸引越来越多的研究关注，现有方法在很大程度上忽略了功能之间的交互，使其无法有效发现隐藏在功能间行为中的深层缺陷。为填补这一空白，我们首先设计了一个功能流图（FFG），这是一种显式捕捉应用功能单元及其功能间交互的行为模型。基于FFG，我们进一步引入了一种面向功能间流的GUI测试方法，其双重目标是精确模型构建和深层缺陷检测。该方法通过长短期视图引导的测试过程实现。通过结合两种互补的测试生成视图，它能够自适应地细化功能边界，并在多种触发条件下系统地探索功能间流。我们在一个名为FuncDroid的工具中实现了我们的方法，并在两个基准上进行了评估：（1）一个广泛使用的开源基准，包含50个可复现的崩溃缺陷；（2）一组多样化的52个流行商业应用。实验结果表明，FuncDroid在覆盖率（+28%）和缺陷检测数量（+107%）方面均显著优于最先进的基线。此外，FuncDroid成功地在商业应用中发现了18个此前未知的非崩溃功能缺陷，证实了其实际有效性。

import_candidates.title: Evaluating and Mitigating the Misguidance Effect of Buggy Code in LLM-Generated Unit Tests
import_candidates.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) show great promise for automating unit test generation, recent studies suggest that the quality of generated tests can be negatively impacted when models are prompted with buggy code. This paper presents a new metric to quantitatively measure the "misguidance effect," a phenomenon where buggy code steers LLMs toward generating tests that validate its erroneous behavior rather than expose it. Our analysis reveals that prompting LLMs with buggy code has a severe, twofold impact: it significantly increases "misguided tests" that assert incorrect behavior while simultaneously suppressing the generation of effective, bug-finding tests. We further corroborate this effect from a model-internal perspective, showing that buggy code skews LLMs' preference toward tests that assert the same erroneous behavior. To counter this, we introduce and validate a specification-based unit test generation paradigm that replaces the code under test in the prompt with an LLM-generated specification docstring. Our results show that this paradigm effectively reduces misguided tests while substantially increasing effective tests, improves multi-round, feedback-driven test generation pipelines, and remains applicable to both buggy and bug-free code. Overall, these results suggest that specification-based prompting is a promising strategy for mitigating misguidance from buggy code in LLM-generated unit tests.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 虽然大型语言模型（LLM）在自动化单元测试生成方面展现出巨大潜力，但近期研究表明，当模型被提示包含错误代码时，生成的测试质量可能受到负面影响。本文提出了一种新的度量标准，用于定量测量“误导效应”，即错误代码引导LLM生成验证其错误行为而非暴露该行为的测试。我们的分析揭示，用错误代码提示LLM会产生严重的双重影响：它显著增加了断言错误行为的“误导性测试”，同时抑制了有效的、发现错误的测试的生成。我们从模型内部视角进一步证实了这一效应，表明错误代码使LLM偏好断言相同错误行为的测试。为了应对这一问题，我们引入并验证了一种基于规范的单元测试生成范式，该范式将提示中待测代码替换为LLM生成的规范文档字符串。我们的结果表明，该范式有效减少了误导性测试，同时大幅增加了有效测试，改进了多轮、反馈驱动的测试生成流程，并且适用于有错误和无错误的代码。总体而言，这些结果表明，基于规范的提示是缓解LLM生成单元测试中错误代码误导的一种有前景的策略。

import_candidates.title: Fuzzing the Boundary between Models and Code in Hybrid AI-Enabled Systems
import_candidates.abstract: Deep learning (DL) techniques are increasingly integrated into traditional software systems, giving rise to hybrid AI-enabled systems that combine neural models with program logic. While these systems exhibit remarkable capabilities, their complex and heterogeneous architectures pose significant challenges for reliability and testing, particularly in safety-critical domains such as autonomous driving. Existing testing approaches either target traditional code or isolate neural networks, overlooking failures arising from their interactions. In this paper, we present Neude, a lightweight and extensible coverage-guided fuzzing framework specifically designed for hybrid AI-enabled systems. Unlike existing tools, Neude combines observations of program execution and neural model coverage to guide input mutations toward unexplored state spaces, enabling systematic testing of the entire hybrid system. Moreover, Neude employs domain-aware mutation operators coupled with metamorphic relations, allowing automated bug detection without manual assertions. We evaluate Neude on Pylot, a complex autonomous driving system with tightly coupled neural and program components. Experimental results show that Neude uncovers diverse errors, and further analysis reveals how model uncertainty propagates through deterministic program logic to trigger downstream module failures. Our findings highlight the fragility of current hybrid architectures, calling for a paradigm shift from model-centric testing to system-centric quality assurance that accounts for the intricate interplay between neural and procedural components.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 深度学习（DL）技术正越来越多地融入传统软件系统，产生了将神经模型与程序逻辑相结合的混合AI赋能系统。虽然这些系统展现出卓越的能力，但其复杂且异构的架构给可靠性和测试带来了重大挑战，尤其是在自动驾驶等安全关键领域。现有的测试方法要么针对传统代码，要么孤立地测试神经网络，忽视了二者交互所产生的故障。在本文中，我们提出Neude，一个专为混合AI赋能系统设计的轻量级、可扩展的覆盖率引导模糊测试框架。与现有工具不同，Neude结合程序执行观察和神经模型覆盖率来引导输入变异走向未探索的状态空间，从而实现对整个混合系统的系统化测试。此外，Neude采用领域感知的变异算子并配合蜕变关系，无需手动断言即可自动检测缺陷。我们在Pylot上评估Neude，这是一个神经与程序组件紧密耦合的复杂自动驾驶系统。实验结果表明，Neude发现了多种错误，进一步分析揭示了模型不确定性如何通过确定性程序逻辑传播，从而触发下游模块故障。我们的发现凸显了当前混合架构的脆弱性，呼吁从以模型为中心的测试转向以系统为中心的质量保证，以考虑神经与过程组件之间复杂的相互作用。

import_candidates.title: Unpacking AI Agent Participation in Issue-Centered Collaboration in Open-Source Software Development
import_candidates.abstract: The increasing participation of AI agents in open-source software development raises questions about their role in collaborative processes. This paper investigates how AI agent participation relates to the structure and outcomes of issue-centered collaboration in open-source software projects. We adopt a process-level perspective by modeling issue handling as sequences of events and extending dynamic issue-pr entropy to distinguish between agent-related and non-agent-related contributions. Using large-scale issue event data from 83 GitHub repositories, we construct a project–month panel dataset and analyze associations between collaboration complexity and development outcomes. Our results show that agent-related collaboration complexity is more strongly associated with development output than human-only collaboration complexity, and is associated with fewer newly introduced defects. In contrast, its relationship with issue resolution efficiency is highly context-dependent. These findings highlight the importance of considering collaboration structure when evaluating the impact of AI agents in open-source software development.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 人工智能代理在开源软件开发中的参与度不断增加，引发了关于其在协作过程中作用的疑问。本文研究了AI代理参与如何与开源软件项目中以问题为中心的协作结构和结果相关联。我们采用过程级视角，将问题处理建模为事件序列，并扩展动态问题-拉取请求熵以区分代理相关与非代理相关的贡献。利用来自83个GitHub仓库的大规模问题事件数据，我们构建了项目-月度面板数据集，并分析协作复杂性与开发结果之间的关联。结果表明，与纯人类协作复杂性相比，代理相关协作复杂性与开发产出关联更强，且与更少的新引入缺陷相关。相比之下，其与问题解决效率的关系高度依赖情境。这些发现凸显了在评估AI代理在开源软件开发中的影响时考虑协作结构的重要性。

import_candidates.title: Checked-In Secret Detection: Strings Are All You Need
import_candidates.abstract: Hardcoded secrets in source code pose critical security vulnerabilities which can be easily exploited by malicious adversaries. Existing regex-based detection approaches suffer from fundamental limitations, as secrets often lack identifiable patterns, resulting in poor precision and recall. Recent studies have explored context-aware detection methods, as surrounding code can reveal the purpose of candidate strings. However, these methods confront three key challenges: (1) obfuscation robustness where models over-rely on easily obfuscated identifiers, (2) cross-language generalization difficulties due to uneven training data distribution, and (3) lengthy and noisy context that introduces excessive irrelevant tokens and slows inference. We observe that strings serve as a critical information source for code semantics, offering superior contextual density, obfuscation robustness, and language independence. Based on this insight, we propose StringGroup, a novel context extraction algorithm that mines strings surrounding potential secrets. By introducing a relatively simple modification to existing patterns that narrows the analysis specifically to string literals, the method achieves significant gains. With only 33.2\% of the original context, it preserves over 80\% of semantic information and significantly improves the signal-to-noise ratio for secret detection. We further design a context-aware secret detection tool, Secretron, based on StringGroup methods and Transformer model. Evaluation on the SecretBench dataset demonstrates high accuracy with 98.74\% F1-score and strong robustness under obfuscation and cross-language scenarios, outperforming state-of-the-art LLM-based baselines. We deploy our tool in real-world environments and successfully detect 48 previously unknown secret keys from 26 applications, demonstrating the practical effectiveness of our approach.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 源代码中的硬编码密钥构成严重安全漏洞，容易被恶意攻击者利用。现有的基于正则表达式的检测方法存在根本局限，因为密钥往往缺乏可识别的模式，导致精确率和召回率较低。近期研究探索了上下文感知检测方法，因为周边代码可以揭示候选字符串的用途。然而，这些方法面临三个关键挑战：(1) 混淆鲁棒性，模型过度依赖易被混淆的标识符；(2) 跨语言泛化困难，由于训练数据分布不均；(3) 冗长且嘈杂的上下文引入过多无关标记并拖慢推理。我们观察到，字符串是代码语义的关键信息源，具有更优的上下文密度、混淆鲁棒性和语言独立性。基于这一洞察，我们提出 StringGroup，一种新颖的上下文提取算法，挖掘潜在密钥周围的字符串。通过引入对现有模式的相对简单修改，将分析专门缩小到字符串字面量，该方法取得了显著收益。仅用原始上下文的33.2%，就保留了超过80%的语义信息，并显著提高了密钥检测的信噪比。我们进一步设计了基于 StringGroup 方法和 Transformer 模型的上下文感知密钥检测工具 Secretron。在 SecretBench 数据集上的评估表明，其准确率高，F1 分数达到 98.74%，在混淆和跨语言场景下具有强鲁棒性，优于最先进的基于 LLM 的基线。我们已将工具部署到真实环境中，成功从26个应用中检测出48个先前未知的密钥，证明了该方法的实际有效性。

import_candidates.title: Testing Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems with Chunk Coverage
import_candidates.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-based systems are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings where correct behaviour depends not only on the language model but also on the retrieval component that selects external documents at inference time. While existing RAG evaluation metrics assess retrieval and generation quality on a per-query basis, typically relying on query-level test oracles such as reference answers or relevance annotations, they provide limited insight into whether a test suite adequately exercises the retrieval behaviour of the system as a whole. In this paper, we introduce Chunk Coverage (CC), an oracle-independent test adequacy criterion for testing the retrieval component of RAG systems. CC measures the fraction of corpus chunks that are retrieved at least once across a test suite, providing a structural view of which parts of the retrieval space have been exercised. We further show how CC can be used to guide test selection and generation by prioritising queries that expand coverage of previously unexercised retrieval regions. We evaluate CC on clinical and financial RAG system scenarios. CC-guided testing reaches 50\% of attainable coverage 1.7x faster than random selection and 4.2x faster than redundancy-biased strategies. Moreover, CC improves fault detection effectiveness (APFD) by 10\% to 25\% over random, indicating earlier discovery of distinct retrieval faults. These results show that CC captures retrieval diversity relevant to effective testing without requiring test oracles.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 基于检索增强生成（RAG）的系统越来越多地部署在高风险环境中，在这些环境中，正确行为不仅取决于语言模型，还取决于在推理时选择外部文档的检索组件。虽然现有的RAG评估指标在逐查询的基础上评估检索和生成质量，通常依赖于查询级测试预言（如参考答案或相关性标注），但它们对于测试套件是否充分覆盖整个系统的检索行为提供的洞见有限。在本文中，我们引入了块覆盖率（CC），这是一种用于测试RAG系统检索组件的、独立于测试预言（oracle）的测试充分性准则。CC衡量在测试套件中至少被检索一次的语料库块的比例，从而提供哪些检索空间部分已被覆盖的结构化视图。我们进一步展示了如何使用CC通过优先选择能够扩展先前未覆盖检索区域覆盖范围的查询来指导测试选择和生成。我们在临床和金融RAG系统场景中评估了CC。CC引导的测试达到可达到覆盖率的50%的速度比随机选择快1.7倍，比冗余偏好策略快4.2倍。此外，CC将故障检测有效性（APFD）比随机提高了10%到25%，表明能够更早发现不同的检索故障。这些结果表明，CC捕获了与有效测试相关的检索多样性，而无需测试预言。

import_candidates.title: Function Calling as a Flexible LLM Defense Add-On: Capability and Application Exploration
import_candidates.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit impressive capabilities but are susceptible to adversarial attacks that induce harmful outputs. Although various defenses have been proposed, their practicality is restricted by substantial runtime overhead or degraded model helpfulness. Moreover, LLM applications typically have diverse and evolving security requirements that cannot be fully anticipated during the design of static defenses. These limitations call for a flexible, low-overhead defense mechanism that can be easily customized to meet task-specific needs. In this paper, we explore function calling (FC)—a built-in mechanism in modern LLMs for invoking custom tools—as a lightweight and adaptable defense add-on. We show that by defining functions representing malicious actions, LLMs equipped with FC can intercept harmful prompts by triggering these function calls instead of generating unsafe content. Extensive experiments across mainstream LLMs demonstrate that FC substantially improves defense effectiveness with minimal impact on model helpfulness. To further assess FC's practical utility, we also introduce DSPEC, a new dataset reflecting real-world LLM applications with specific defense requirements. Our evaluations on DSPEC show that FC substantially outperforms existing defenses in this realistic setting. Besides, we also explore the practical applications of FC in various scenarios, including universal defense frameworks and multi-agent systems, further demonstrating its versatility and effectiveness in enhancing LLM security.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）展现出令人印象深刻的能力，但容易受到对抗性攻击从而产生有害输出。尽管已经提出了各种防御措施，但其实用性受到大量运行时开销或模型有用性下降的限制。此外，LLM应用通常具有多样且不断变化的安全需求，这些需求无法在静态防御设计时完全预见。这些局限呼唤一种灵活、低开销的防御机制，能够轻松定制以满足特定任务需求。在本文中，我们探索函数调用（FC）——现代LLM中用于调用自定义工具的内置机制——作为一种轻量且可适应的防御附加组件。我们表明，通过定义表示恶意操作的函数，配备FC的LLM可以通过触发这些函数调用而不是生成不安全内容来拦截有害提示。跨主流LLM的大量实验表明，FC显著提高了防御有效性，同时对模型有用性的影响极小。为了进一步评估FC的实际效用，我们还引入了DSPEC，一个反映具有特定防御需求的真实世界LLM应用的新数据集。我们在DSPEC上的评估表明，FC在这种现实场景中显著优于现有防御。此外，我们还探索了FC在各种场景中的实际应用，包括通用防御框架和多智能体系统，进一步展示了其在增强LLM安全性方面的多功能性和有效性。

import_candidates.title: From Custom Logic to APIs: Understanding and Recommending API Replacement Refactorings
import_candidates.abstract: Software refactoring is essential for maintaining code quality. However, API replacement refactoring, which replaces custom logic with API calls, remains underexplored. Existing refactoring tools provide limited support for detecting such opportunities because they rely on predefined templates and have difficulty capturing complex, multi-statement semantic equivalents. To address this limitation, we conduct the first empirical study of API replacement refactorings by mining 166,299 commits across six open-source Java projects and manually analyzing a curated subset of 1,800 commits, from which we identify 366 validated instances to characterize their scope, categories, and recurring patterns. Based on these insights, we propose AKIRA (Adaptive Knowledge Discovery and Retrieval), a hybrid framework that integrates pattern-deterministic heuristics with a refactoring-aware knowledge base to assess the practical feasibility of recommending API replacement refactorings. Our evaluation shows that AKIRA achieves 90\% recall and 88\% precision on a manually curated dataset. Furthermore, on the external RETIWA dataset, AKIRA significantly improves the state of the art by increasing recall from 21\% to 81\% and precision from 40\% to 78\%. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining static pattern matching with semantic reasoning to support the automation of recommending complex API replacement refactorings.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 软件重构对于维护代码质量至关重要。然而，API替换重构——即用API调用替换自定义逻辑——仍未得到充分探索。现有重构工具对此类机会的检测支持有限，因为它们依赖预定义模板，难以捕捉复杂的、多语句的语义等价物。为弥补这一局限，我们开展了首个针对API替换重构的实证研究，挖掘了六个开源Java项目中的166,299次提交，并人工分析了其中精心筛选的1,800次提交，从中识别出366个经过验证的实例，以刻画其范围、类别和反复出现的模式。基于这些见解，我们提出AKIRA（自适应知识发现与检索），一个混合框架，将模式确定性的启发式方法与重构感知的知识库相结合，以评估推荐API替换重构的实际可行性。我们的评估表明，AKIRA在人工整理的数据集上达到90%的召回率和88%的精确率。此外，在外部RETIWA数据集上，AKIRA显著提升了当前最优水平，将召回率从21%提高到81%，精确率从40%提高到78%。这些结果证明了结合静态模式匹配与语义推理来支持自动化推荐复杂API替换重构的有效性。

import_candidates.title: IterTestQ: Assembly-Level, Cross-Platform Testing of Quantum Computing Platforms
import_candidates.abstract: Quantum computing platforms are susceptible to quantum-specific bugs, such as incorrectly ordering qubits or incorrectly implementing quantum abstractions. These bugs are difficult to detect and require specialized expertise. The field faces challenges due to a fragmented landscape of platforms and rapid development cycles that often prioritize new features over thorough testing, severely hindering the reliability of quantum software. To address these challenges, we present IterTestQ, a novel cross-platform testing approach for quantum computing platforms. The key technical contribution is our novel ITE process, which generates equivalent quantum programs by iteratively (I)mporting them into platform-specific representations, (T)ransforming the program via optimizations and gate conversions, and (E)xporting the program again. To transfer programs across platforms and test cross-platform consistency, IterTestQ leverages QASM, an assembly-level representation supported by most platforms. The approach uses a crash oracle to detect failures during cross-platform transformations and an equivalence oracle to validate the semantic consistency of the generated assembly programs, which are expected to be equivalent by construction. We evaluate IterTestQ on widely-used quantum computing platforms, including Qiskit, PennyLane, Pytket, BQSKit, and Cirq, revealing 23 bugs, 17 of which are already confirmed or fixed. Our results also demonstrate that IterTestQ complements existing quantum fuzzers (covering tens of thousands of otherwise uncovered lines), is efficient (with 0.00089 seconds per generated program), and that the ITE process is crucial for its effectiveness.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 量子计算平台容易受到量子特定错误的影响，例如错误地排列量子位或错误地实现量子抽象。这些错误难以检测，需要专业知识。由于平台碎片化和快速开发周期（通常优先考虑新功能而非彻底测试），该领域面临挑战，严重阻碍了量子软件的可靠性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了IterTestQ，一种新颖的量子计算平台跨平台测试方法。关键技术创新是我们的新型ITE过程，它通过迭代地将程序(I)导入平台特定表示、(T)通过优化和门转换对程序进行变换，并(E)再次导出程序，从而生成等价的量子程序。为了跨平台转移程序并测试跨平台一致性，IterTestQ利用QASM，一种大多数平台支持的汇编级表示。该方法使用崩溃预言来检测跨平台转换期间的故障，并使用等价预言来验证生成的汇编程序的语义一致性，这些程序在构造上预期是等价的。我们在广泛使用的量子计算平台上评估了IterTestQ，包括Qiskit、PennyLane、Pytket、BQSKit和Cirq，发现了23个错误，其中17个已被确认或修复。我们的结果还表明，IterTestQ补充了现有的量子模糊测试器（覆盖了数万行原本未覆盖的代码），效率高（每个生成程序0.00089秒），并且ITE过程对其有效性至关重要。

import_candidates.title: Integrating Multiple Features for Weakly-Supervised False-Passing Products Detection in Software Product Lines
import_candidates.abstract: Software Product Lines (SPL) enable the efficient development of configurable systems through feature modularization. However, the inherent configurability of software introduces significant challenges for fault localization within these systems. A key challenge among these is the problem of false-passing products, configurable products that contain faulty code yet coincidentally pass all their associated tests, thereby masking faults and misleading diagnosis efforts. To mitigate the negative impact of false-passing products. Supervised detection approaches are often impractical due to their reliance on complete labels, which are unavailable during early testing phases. To address this, we propose PULP, a label-agnostic detection approach that exploits the execution similarity between failing and false-passing products. PULP extracts five categories of features and employs a weakly-supervised learning algorithm to identify false-passing products without pre-labeled data. Evaluated on 823 buggy versions from six real-world SPL systems, PULP achieves superior detection performance, with best accuracy of 90.33\% and precision of 94.93\% for false-passing products and consistently enhances fault localization rankings after eliminating the negative impact of false-passing product. This method offers a practical tool for SPL testing and debugging in label-incomplete environments.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 软件产品线（SPL）通过特征模块化实现了可配置系统的高效开发。然而，软件固有的可配置性为这些系统中的故障定位带来了巨大挑战。其中的一个关键挑战是假通过产品问题：这些可配置产品包含故障代码，却碰巧通过了所有相关测试，从而掩盖故障并误导诊断工作。为了减轻假通过产品的负面影响，监督检测方法通常不切实际，因为它们依赖完整标签，而这些标签在早期测试阶段不可用。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了PULP，一种与标签无关的检测方法，它利用失败产品和假通过产品之间的执行相似性。PULP提取五类特征，并采用弱监督学习算法在没有预标注数据的情况下识别假通过产品。在来自六个真实SPL系统的823个含缺陷版本上进行评估，PULP取得了优异的检测性能，假通过产品的最佳准确率为90.33%，精确率为94.93%，并且在消除假通过产品的负面影响后，持续提升了故障定位排名。该方法为标签不完整环境下的SPL测试与调试提供了一个实用工具。

import_candidates.title: Applying System Call Filtering to Real-World Binaries (Experience Paper)
import_candidates.abstract: System call filtering restricts applications to the system calls they require, but inferring accurate syscall sets for binary-only programs remains challenging. A central difficulty lies in recovering precise control-flow information from binaries: over-approximation leads to overly permissive syscall filters, while missed control-flow edges result in unsound policies. Although many techniques have been proposed to improve control-flow recovery in binaries, their practical impact on syscall inference remains poorly understood. In this work, we conduct an empirical study of syscall inference from binaries using multiple off-the-shelf binary analysis tools. We evaluate how different control-flow refinement techniques affect inferred syscall sets in practice. Our experiments on real-world applications show that refinements targeting individual control-flow transfers (e.g., call-site and callee argument matching) substantially improve per-call target precision but often do not reduce the overall syscall set. In contrast, techniques that reduce the global set of address-taken functions---such as leveraging relocation information to accurately identify code pointers---yield the most significant syscall reductions. Finally, we identify a practical lower bound on syscall reduction achievable via sound static binary analysis alone, and show that further improvements are likely to require configuration or workload-aware specialization.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 系统调用过滤将应用程序限制在其所需的系统调用范围内，但为仅二进制程序推断准确的系统调用集合仍然具有挑战性。核心困难在于从二进制文件中恢复精确的控制流信息：过近似会导致系统调用过滤器过于宽松，而遗漏控制流边则会导致策略不健全。尽管已经提出了许多改进二进制控制流恢复的技术，但它们对系统调用推断的实际影响仍鲜为人知。在这项工作中，我们使用多个现成的二进制分析工具对从二进制文件进行系统调用推断进行了实证研究。我们评估了不同控制流精化技术在实践中如何影响推断出的系统调用集合。我们在真实世界应用上的实验表明，针对单个控制流转移的精化（例如调用点和被调用者参数匹配）能够显著提高每次调用的目标精度，但通常不会减少整体系统调用集合。相反，减少全局地址取用函数集合的技术——例如利用重定位信息准确识别代码指针——能够带来最显著的系统调用减少。最后，我们确定了仅通过可靠的静态二进制分析可实现的系统调用减少的实际下界，并表明进一步的改进可能需要配置或工作负载感知的特化。

import_candidates.title: Towards More Realistic Assertion Generation under Mixed-Assertion Scenario
import_candidates.abstract: Unit testing is essential for software quality assurance, where a test case typically consists of a test prefix and an oracle, expressed as assertions. In practice, crafting high-quality assertions is non-trivial and time-consuming, as it requires developers to reason carefully about program states and expected behaviors. While recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise for automating assertion generation (AG), current AG methods often rely on two unrealistic assumptions: (1) the Single-Assertion Formulation (A1), which assumes tests contain only one assertion, and (2) the Known-Position Formulation (A2), which treats AG as a "fill-in-the-blanks" task with pre-defined insertion points. Despite being widely adopted, the realism and implications of these assumptions have not been systematically examined. This paper revisits AG under a realistic Mixed-Assertion Scenario, where tests may contain one or multiple assertions and insertion positions are unavailable at inference time. To examine A1, we first conduct a large-scale empirical study of 358,117 developer-written tests from 7,061 projects. The results show that multi-assertion tests are prevalent, accounting for 40.32\% of all tests and appearing in 92.87\% of projects. Through manual analysis, we derive a taxonomy comprising ten fine-grained assertion patterns, showing that assertions in multi-assertion tests are rarely independent checks (4.69\%) and instead coordinate to validate a unified test objective. To examine A2, we remove ground-truth insertion cues and observe substantial performance degradation, with Exact Match dropping by 11.80\%--23.18\% overall. This suggests that position cues affect not only where assertions are placed, but also the quality of what to assert. Motivated by these findings, we propose DA-AG, a two-stage framework designed for the realistic Mixed-Assertion Scenario with unknown insertion positions. In the first stage, it predicts assertion insertion positions to construct an assertion skeleton with explicit insertion cues. In the second stage, it generates assertion content conditioned on the resulting skeleton and retrieved exemplar assertion sequences. Extensive experiments across 13 diverse LLMs show that DA-AG consistently outperforms the corresponding one-stage baselines, which directly generate the completed test from the focal method and raw test prefix. DA-AG improves Exact Match by 32.24\%--78.08\% and CodeBLEU by 2.80\%--8.63\%, increases real-bug detection on Defects4J by 4--37 exposed bugs and 5--21 unique exposed bugs, and further improves other execution-based metrics, including compilability, bug-finding quality, and mutation scores. Moreover, DA-AG outperforms closed-source LLMs evaluated in a prompt-only setting without task-specific fine-tuning (e.g., GPT-4o and Claude-3.5) in similarity-based quality and real-bug detection.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 单元测试对于软件质量保证至关重要，其中测试用例通常由测试前缀和以断言形式表达的判定条件组成。在实践中，编写高质量的断言并非易事且耗时，因为开发者需要仔细推理程序状态和预期行为。尽管大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展在自动化断言生成（AG）方面显示出潜力，但当前的AG方法往往依赖两个不现实的假设：（1）单一断言设定（A1），即假设测试只包含一个断言；（2）已知位置设定（A2），即将AG视为具有预定义插入点的“填空”任务。尽管这些假设被广泛采用，但其现实性和影响尚未得到系统检验。本文在现实的混合断言场景下重新审视AG，其中测试可能包含一个或多个断言，并且在推理时无法获得插入位置。为了检验A1，我们首先对来自7,061个项目的358,117个开发者编写的测试进行了大规模实证研究。结果表明，多断言测试非常普遍，占所有测试的40.32%，并出现在92.87%的项目中。通过人工分析，我们得出一个包含十种细粒度断言模式的分类体系，表明多断言测试中的断言很少是独立检查（4.69%），而是协同验证统一的测试目标。为了检验A2，我们移除真实插入线索，并观察到性能显著下降，总体精确匹配率下降11.80%--23.18%。这表明位置线索不仅影响断言放置的位置，还影响断言内容的质量。受这些发现启发，我们提出DA-AG，一个面向插入位置未知的现实混合断言场景的两阶段框架。在第一阶段，它预测断言插入位置，以构建带有显式插入线索的断言骨架。在第二阶段，它以所得骨架和检索到的范例断言序列为条件生成断言内容。在13个不同LLM上的大量实验表明，DA-AG始终优于相应的一阶段基线，后者直接从焦点方法和原始测试前缀生成完整测试。DA-AG将精确匹配率提高32.24%--78.08%，CodeBLEU提高2.80%--8.63%，在Defects4J上增加4--37个暴露缺陷和5--21个唯一暴露缺陷，并进一步改善其他基于执行的指标，包括可编译性、缺陷发现质量和变异得分。此外，在基于相似度的质量和真实缺陷检测方面，DA-AG优于在仅提示设置下、未进行任务特定微调的闭源LLM（如GPT-4o和Claude-3.5）。

import_candidates.title: OptiMine: Scalable and Precise Code Optimization for Android Apps via LLM-Driven Semantic Analysis
import_candidates.abstract: As Android applications grow in scale, latent performance issues increasingly degrade user experience and business outcomes, yet systematically identifying optimization opportunities in large codebases remains challenging. We present OptiMine, a hybrid knowledge-to-code framework that integrates large language models (LLMs) with static program analysis to automatically uncover actionable performance optimizations. OptiMine systematically transforms unstructured expert knowledge from documents, commit diffs, and reports into structured Optimization Signatures, enabling reproducible and context-aware program reasoning. These signatures drive scalable candidate retrieval via declarative Datalog queries, while LLM-guided semantic validation performs precise applicability checking, side-effect analysis, and impact-aware ranking. We evaluate OptiMine on a public benchmark and a large industrial Android codebase. The results show that OptiMine achieves higher precision and broader coverage than heuristic- and pattern-based baselines, while scaling effectively to industrial settings. Overall, OptiMine enables reliable and scalable performance auditing, bridging expert knowledge and actionable performance improvements in real-world mobile systems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着Android应用规模的增长，潜在的性能问题日益降低用户体验和业务成果，然而在大型代码库中系统地识别优化机会仍然具有挑战性。我们提出OptiMine，一个混合的知识到代码框架，将大型语言模型（LLM）与静态程序分析相结合，以自动发现可操作的性能优化。OptiMine系统地将来自文档、提交差异和报告的非结构化专家知识转化为结构化的优化签名（Optimization Signatures），从而实现可复现且上下文感知的程序推理。这些签名通过声明式Datalog查询驱动可扩展的候选检索，而LLM引导的语义验证则执行精确的适用性检查、副作用分析和影响感知排序。我们在一个公共基准和一个大型工业Android代码库上评估OptiMine。结果表明，与基于启发式和模式的基线相比，OptiMine实现了更高的精确度和更广的覆盖范围，同时能有效扩展到工业环境。总体而言，OptiMine实现了可靠且可扩展的性能审计，在现实世界的移动系统中弥合了专家知识与可操作的性能改进之间的差距。

import_candidates.title: A Dataset of Reproducible Flaky-Test Failures
import_candidates.abstract: Flaky tests pass and fail non-deterministically when run on the same version of code. Previous research proposed techniques to detect, debug, and repair different categories of flaky tests. However, reproducing the flaky-test failures remains a major challenge due to their inherent non-determinism. Reliably reproducing flaky-test failures is essential for helping both developers and automatic techniques to debug and repair flaky tests. Many datasets related to flaky tests exist to help researchers study them, but these datasets are often composed of disjoint information, where each dataset provides some unique information over the others, such as flaky tests of many different categories, failure logs of flaky tests, or flaky tests reported by developers vs. flaky tests found by automated tools. Furthermore, several of them are missing the key aspect of providing a means to reliably reproduce the flaky-test failures. In this work, we aim to create a dataset of flaky tests, where each test’s failure is reproducible and there is a comprehensive set of information for the flaky test. Compared to prior flaky-test datasets, our dataset is the first to provide (1) an environment to compile the code for running the flaky tests, (2) scripts to run the tests to reproduce the flaky-test failures, (3) scripts to automatically apply flaky-test fixes and check that the test is no longer flaky, and (4) execution logs of the flaky test both passing and failing. We present ReproFlake, a dataset of 1115 flaky tests, spread across four different flaky-test categories. We also publish the guideline we developed to construct our dataset so others can contribute to this dataset by collecting the same information. We also study the categories of flaky tests in ReproFlake, the location and size of flaky-test fixes, and the code coverage of flaky tests before and after they are fixed. Our study highlights promising future flaky-test research directions, which our dataset helps enable.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 偶发测试在同一版本代码上运行时，会非确定性地通过或失败。先前的研究提出了检测、调试和修复不同类别偶发测试的技术。然而，由于偶发测试固有的非确定性，复现其失败仍然是一个重大挑战。可靠地复现偶发测试失败对于帮助开发人员和自动技术调试和修复偶发测试至关重要。许多与偶发测试相关的数据集存在，以帮助研究人员研究它们，但这些数据集通常由互不相交的信息组成，每个数据集提供一些其他数据集所没有的独特信息，例如许多不同类别的偶发测试、偶发测试的失败日志，或开发人员报告的偶发测试与自动化工具发现的偶发测试。此外，其中一些数据集缺少提供可靠复现偶发测试失败手段这一关键方面。在这项工作中，我们旨在创建一个偶发测试数据集，其中每个测试的失败都是可复现的，并且包含全面的偶发测试信息。与先前的偶发测试数据集相比，我们的数据集首次提供：(1) 用于编译代码以运行偶发测试的环境，(2) 用于运行测试以复现偶发测试失败的脚本，(3) 用于自动应用偶发测试修复并检查测试不再偶发的脚本，以及 (4) 偶发测试通过和失败的执行日志。我们提出了 ReproFlake，一个包含 1115 个偶发测试、横跨四个不同偶发测试类别的数据集。我们还发布了我们为构建数据集而制定的指南，以便其他人可以通过收集相同信息来为这个数据集做出贡献。我们还研究了 ReproFlake 中偶发测试的类别、偶发测试修复的位置和大小，以及偶发测试修复前后的代码覆盖率。我们的研究强调了有前景的未来偶发测试研究方向，而我们的数据集有助于实现这些方向。

import_candidates.title: MuMuTestUp: Mutation-Based Multi-agent Test Case Update
import_candidates.abstract: Modern software systems evolve rapidly under continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) practices, in which tests act as critical gatekeepers of software quality. However, when substantial code changes are introduced, existing test cases may become obsolete, leading to compilation failures, erroneous test behaviors, or inadequate regression coverage. Such issues can disrupt CI/CD pipelines, degrade development productivity, and ultimately undermine overall software quality. Many efforts are devoted to designing automatic test case update methods to address these issues. The most recent approaches rely on large language models (LLMs) to iteratively refine test cases using execution feedback from compilation errors or coverage reports, and on context retrieved via exact-matching approaches. They also prioritize test executability and line coverage to quickly build executable, correct test cases from the original broken test cases. Despite their correctness, current approaches face three limitations: (1) they focus on executabilty but overlook the adequacy of test assertions, which lowers the capability of test cases to detect faults; (2) they utilize only coarse line coverage singals instead of specific information about uncovered lines and branches; (3) they use exact-matching context retrieval approaches, which fails to provide accurate context given potential hallucinated queries from LLMs. To address these challenges, we propose MuMuTestUp, a Mutation-guided, Multi-agent framework for automated test case updating. MuMuTestUp integrates three specialized agents: (1) a Mutation Analysis agent that leverages surviving mutants as indicators of weak or missing test assertions and generates individual repair instructions to strengthen or synthesize assertions for each surviving mutant, (2) a Coverage Analysis agent generates individual repair instructions for each uncovered line, uncovered branch rather than exposing raw coverage signals to the LLM, and (3) a Semantic Retrieval agent that uses semantic-similarity search to handle unavailable or hallucinated symbols. Additionally, we construct Prbench, a pull-request–level dataset of 571 samples from 10 open-source Java projects that considered cross-commit update scenarios, validated through three rounds of execution following prior studies to detect outdated tests. We evaluate MuMuTestUp against state-of-the-art baselines using both open-source and closed-source LLMs (Deepseek-V3.2 and GPT-4.1). With GPT-4.1, MuMuTestUp achieves a line coverage of 88.94\%, branch coverage of 63.36\%, and mutation score of 72.39\%, outperforming the best baseline by 5.33\%, 19.93\%, and 16.66\%, respectively.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代软件系统在持续集成与部署（CI/CD）实践下快速演化，其中测试充当软件质量的关键守门人。然而，当引入大量代码变更时，现有测试用例可能过时，导致编译失败、错误的测试行为或回归覆盖率不足。此类问题会中断CI/CD流水线，降低开发效率，并最终损害整体软件质量。许多工作致力于设计自动测试用例更新方法来解决这些问题。最近的方法依赖大语言模型（LLMs）利用来自编译错误或覆盖率报告的执行反馈迭代地精化测试用例，并通过精确匹配方法检索上下文。它们还优先考虑测试可执行性和行覆盖率，以快速从原始损坏的测试用例构建可执行、正确的测试用例。尽管这些方法正确，但当前方法面临三个局限：(1) 它们关注可执行性但忽视测试断言的充分性，降低了测试用例检测故障的能力；(2) 它们仅使用粗粒度的行覆盖率信号，而非未覆盖行和分支的具体信息；(3) 它们使用精确匹配的上下文检索方法，当LLM产生潜在的幻觉查询时无法提供准确上下文。为应对这些挑战，我们提出MuMuTestUp，一个变异引导的多智能体自动测试用例更新框架。MuMuTestUp集成三个专用智能体：(1) 变异分析智能体，利用存活变异体作为弱或缺失测试断言的指标，并为每个存活变异体生成单独的修复指令以增强或合成断言；(2) 覆盖率分析智能体，为每个未覆盖行、未覆盖分支生成单独的修复指令，而不是将原始覆盖率信号暴露给LLM；(3) 语义检索智能体，使用语义相似性搜索来处理不可用或幻觉的符号。此外，我们构建了Prbench，一个包含来自10个开源Java项目的571个样本的拉取请求级数据集，考虑了跨提交更新场景，并按照先前研究通过三轮执行验证以检测过时测试。我们使用开源和闭源LLM（Deepseek-V3.2和GPT-4.1）将MuMuTestUp与最先进基线进行评估。使用GPT-4.1时，MuMuTestUp达到行覆盖率88.94%、分支覆盖率63.36%和变异得分72.39%，分别超过最佳基线5.33%、19.93%和16.66%。

import_candidates.title: Names Are All You Need: Effective and Safe Regression Test Selection for Python
import_candidates.abstract: Regression test selection (RTS) reduces the cost of regression testing by executing only those tests affected by a code change. Despite extensive study of RTS in statically typed languages such as Java, achieving effective and safe RTS in Python is challenging. Python’s dynamic typing makes precise call-graph construction difficult, which can cause call-graph-based RTS to miss affected tests, and hence, compromise safety. Python’s eager importing mechanism, in contrast, renders file-level dependency analysis overly conservative. This paper presents NameRTS, the first Python RTS approach based on fine-grained dependency analysis. NameRTS models a Python program as a bipartite graph of code element nodes (e.g., classes, functions, global variables) and name nodes (i.e., identifiers used to reference code elements), with edges capturing definitions and references. RTS is formulated as a reachability problem on this graph: a test is selected if any modified code element is reachable from the names used in that test. This design avoids call-graph construction, enabling a conservative analysis amenable to safety. To control dependency cascades introduced by coarse name matching, NameRTS applies two pruning strategies that leverage prior test executions and context information to refine name matching. To evaluate NameRTS, we construct the first Python RTS dataset with a ground truth indicating which test files are affected by each commit. It includes 500 commits drawn from 10 real-world Python projects. We compare NameRTS with the best-performing baseline, BabelRTS, an RTS technique based on coarse file-level dependencies. On this benchmark, NameRTS skips 69.90\% of test files on average, outperforming BabelRTS by 146.5\%. It also reduces end-to-end testing time by 45.59\%, yielding a 107.7\% improvement over BabelRTS. In terms of safety, NameRTS selects all affected tests for 99.6\% of commits, with only rare misses in exceptional cases. In contrast, BabelRTS is safe for 76.6\% of commits. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of NameRTS, paving the way for more efficient regression testing in Python.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 回归测试选择（RTS）通过仅执行受代码更改影响的测试来降低回归测试的成本。尽管在Java等静态类型语言中已有大量关于RTS的研究，但在Python中实现有效且安全的RTS仍具有挑战性。Python的动态类型特性使得精确的调用图构建变得困难，这可能导致基于调用图的RTS遗漏受影响的测试，从而损害安全性。相反，Python的急切导入机制使得文件级依赖分析过于保守。本文提出了NameRTS，这是第一个基于细粒度依赖分析的Python RTS方法。NameRTS将Python程序建模为代码元素节点（例如，类、函数、全局变量）和名称节点（即用于引用代码元素的标识符）组成的二部图，边表示定义和引用关系。RTS被形式化为该图上的可达性问题：如果测试中使用的名称可以到达任何被修改的代码元素，则选择该测试。这种设计避免了调用图构建，从而支持一种适合安全性的保守分析。为了控制粗粒度名称匹配引入的依赖级联，NameRTS应用了两种剪枝策略，利用先前的测试执行和上下文信息来细化名称匹配。为了评估NameRTS，我们构建了第一个Python RTS数据集，其中包含指示每个提交影响哪些测试文件的地面真值。该数据集包含来自10个真实世界Python项目的500个提交。我们将NameRTS与表现最佳的基线BabelRTS（一种基于粗粒度文件级依赖的RTS技术）进行比较。在该基准上，NameRTS平均跳过69.90%的测试文件，比BabelRTS高出146.5%。它还将端到端测试时间减少了45.59%，比BabelRTS提升了107.7%。在安全性方面，NameRTS为99.6%的提交选择了所有受影响的测试，仅在特殊情况下出现罕见遗漏。相比之下，BabelRTS对76.6%的提交是安全的。这些结果证明了NameRTS的有效性，为Python中更高效的回归测试铺平了道路。

import_candidates.title: From Static to Dynamic: Benchmarking Real-World Code Review with MCR-Bench
import_candidates.abstract: In real-world software development, code review typically involves iterative interactions between developers and reviewers to improve software quality, making the process costly and time-consuming.
