Although recent work explores large language models (LLMs) for automated code review, most approaches oversimplify code review into a single-round, static decision task, which fails to capture the multi-round interactive nature and the complex problem-solving processes inherent in realistic review scenarios. To bridge this gap, we introduce MCR-bench, the first defect state-aware benchmark designed for realistic multi-round code review. MCR-bench covers five commonly-used programming languages and consists of 2,269 real-world multi-round code review tasks, each of which is annotated with fine-grained defect information and cross-round state labels. Each task in MCR-bench is equipped with fine-grained defect metadata (e.g., description, type, severity) alongside dynamic state annotations, capturing the complete evolutionary trajectory of a defect throughout the multi-round process. We obtain several findings through extensive experiments on MCR-bench with mainstream LLMs. (1) Limited overall capability: experiments reveal that mainstream LLMs exhibit limited overall performance in defect detection and defect lifecycle state tracking, with performance degrading significantly as the number of interaction rounds increases; (2) Defect-sensitive performance: LLMs' performance varies substantially across different defect types and severity levels, with semantically complex or low-salience defects being significantly more likely to be missed; (3) Underlying Failure Mechanisms: our in-depth error analysis dissects the distinct drivers of false positives and false negatives, revealing critical weaknesses such as cross-round temporal misalignment and inadequate long-range memory.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在真实软件开发中，代码审查通常涉及开发人员和审查人员之间的迭代交互，以提高软件质量，使得该过程成本高昂且耗时。尽管最近的工作探索了使用大型语言模型（LLM）进行自动代码审查，但大多数方法将代码审查过度简化为单轮、静态决策任务，未能捕捉现实审查场景中固有的多轮交互性质和复杂问题解决过程。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了MCR-bench，这是第一个面向真实多轮代码审查的缺陷状态感知基准。MCR-bench涵盖五种常用编程语言，包含2,269个真实世界的多轮代码审查任务，每个任务都标注了细粒度缺陷信息和跨轮状态标签。MCR-bench中的每个任务都配备了细粒度缺陷元数据（例如描述、类型、严重性）以及动态状态标注，捕捉缺陷在多轮过程中的完整演化轨迹。我们通过对MCR-bench与主流LLM进行广泛实验，获得了若干发现。(1) 整体能力有限：实验表明，主流LLM在缺陷检测和缺陷生命周期状态跟踪方面表现出有限的整体性能，且随着交互轮数增加，性能显著下降；(2) 缺陷敏感的性能：LLM的性能在不同缺陷类型和严重性级别上差异很大，语义复杂或低显著性的缺陷更容易被遗漏；(3) 潜在失败机制：我们深入的错误分析剖析了假阳性和假阴性的不同驱动因素，揭示了跨轮时间错位和长程记忆不足等关键弱点。

import_candidates.title: Rust’s Type Checker Implementation Is Unsound: An Empirical Study on Soundness Bugs in rustc
import_candidates.abstract: Rust is claimed to be a type-sound language capable of preventing various undesirable behaviors, including memory bugs. However, rustc, the official Rust compiler, is not immune to defects; it contains soundness bugs, where the compiler accepts programs that should be rejected during type checking. In this work, we present an empirical study of 30 issues that report potential soundness bugs in rustc, collected from the GitHub issue tracker between January 1, 2022 and September 1, 2025. We analyze each issue in depth, focusing on its affected feature, symptom (how the feature is mishandled), consequence (the resulting undesirable behavior), triggering features, community consensus regarding whether it is a bug, and lifecycle, including introduction, discovery, and fix. Furthermore, we investigate existing artifacts, including implementations such as AddressSanitizer, Miri, Chalk, and a-mir-formality, alongside documentation such as the Rust Reference, the FLS, and Rust RFCs to assess their potential as oracles for testing the type soundness of rustc. Our key findings indicate that: (1) Certain soundness bugs, typically triggered by implied bounds or trait objects, compromise memory safety. (2) Sound type checking is challenged by edge cases involving associated types and the interaction between lifetimes and traits. (3) Most bugs persist from the initial introduction of the relevant features and require significant time to be discovered. (4) While AddressSanitizer and Miri can detect soundness bugs that lead to memory bugs, a-mir-formality and Chalk are currently immature despite their potential to identify other bug categories. (5) Existing documentation frequently fails to provide precise explanations of the language semantics.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Rust 被认为是一种类型健全的语言，能够防止各种不良行为，包括内存错误。然而，Rust 的官方编译器 rustc 并非无懈可击；它包含健全性错误，即编译器接受了本应在类型检查期间被拒绝的程序。在这项工作中，我们呈现了一项针对 30 个报告 rustc 中潜在健全性错误的 issue 的实证研究，这些 issue 收集自 2022 年 1 月 1 日至 2025 年 9 月 1 日期间的 GitHub issue tracker。我们深入分析每个 issue，重点关注其受影响特性、症状（特性如何被错误处理）、后果（由此产生的不良行为）、触发特性、社区关于其是否为 bug 的共识，以及生命周期，包括引入、发现和修复。此外，我们调查现有制品，包括 AddressSanitizer、Miri、Chalk 和 a-mir-formality 等实现，以及 Rust Reference、FLS 和 Rust RFC 等文档，以评估它们作为测试 rustc 类型健全性的预言机的潜力。我们的主要发现表明：(1) 某些健全性错误，通常由隐含约束或 trait 对象触发，会破坏内存安全。(2) 类型检查的健全性受到关联类型以及生命周期与 trait 之间交互的边缘情况的挑战。(3) 大多数 bug 从相关特性最初引入时就存在，并且需要很长时间才能被发现。(4) 虽然 AddressSanitizer 和 Miri 可以检测导致内存 bug 的健全性错误，但 a-mir-formality 和 Chalk 目前尚不成熟，尽管它们有潜力识别其他 bug 类别。(5) 现有文档常常无法提供对语言语义的精确解释。

import_candidates.title: Solving String Split Constraints via Structural Relaxation
import_candidates.abstract: String operations are integral to program analysis, yet reasoning about the ubiquitous split operation remains a challenge. SMT solvers have difficulty with split because it transforms a string into a variable-length sequence, creating a structural mismatch that leads to uninterpreted abstractions or unsound bounded approximations. In this paper, we bridge this gap with a precise, SMT-LIB-compliant encoding. Our key insight is structural relaxation: exploiting the sparsity of real-world constraints, we decouple the split structure from strict length requirements, materializing segments only on demand. We further introduce position-aware constraints to handle complex regex-based delimiters without overlaps. We evaluated our framework on 580 benchmarks using four leading string solvers. Our encoding enables off-the-shelf solvers to handle split constraints, solving 157 out of 168 real-world benchmarks and outperforming current baselines. Notably, our framework involves complex string operations, revealing 12 previously unknown implementation bugs in mainstream solvers.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 字符串操作是程序分析不可或缺的一部分，然而对无处不在的分割操作的推理仍然是一个挑战。SMT求解器难以处理分割，因为它将字符串转换为可变长度序列，造成结构不匹配，导致未解释抽象或不健全的有界近似。在本文中，我们通过一个精确且符合SMT-LIB的编码来弥合这一差距。我们的关键见解是结构松弛：利用现实世界约束的稀疏性，我们将分割结构与严格的长度要求解耦，仅在需要时物化片段。我们进一步引入位置感知约束，以处理复杂的基于正则表达式的分隔符而不产生重叠。我们在580个基准测试上使用四种领先的字符串求解器评估了我们的框架。我们的编码使现成的求解器能够处理分割约束，在168个真实世界基准测试中解决了157个，并优于当前基线。值得注意的是，我们的框架涉及复杂的字符串操作，揭示了主流求解器中12个先前未知的实现错误。

import_candidates.title: Augmenting Multi-technique Static Analysis with Large Language Models: A Neuro-symbolic Approach to Smart Contract Vulnerability Detection
import_candidates.abstract: Smart contracts facilitate and enforce agreements between untrusted parties without trusted intermediaries, but vulnerabilities within contracts can cause severe damage once exploited. Various analysis techniques have been proposed for vulnerability detection, but they are typically limited to specific vulnerability types. While recent frameworks employ aggregation to broaden detection capacity, they often accumulate false positives due to loose integration that fails to resolve underlying conflicts. Meanwhile, the semantic reasoning capacity of large language models (LLMs) has shown promise in detecting vulnerabilities, despite inherent reasoning bottlenecks and hallucinations. Recognizing these challenges, in this work, we propose a novel neuro-symbolic approach, named Ensemble LLM-Assisted Static Analysis (ELSA). ELSA comprises two key modules, namely, LLM-assisted static analysis and analyzer ensemble (the ensemble of multiple LLM-assisted static analyzers), each incorporating two distinct strategies. The LLM-assisted static analysis augments individual analysis techniques with constraint-guided neural semantic reasoning, while the analyzer ensemble resolves conflicting outputs to distill a robust consensus. We evaluate ELSA on a comprehensive benchmark, including three open-source datasets and additional self-constructed Zero-Knowledge Proof-based smart contracts whose complexity poses unique challenges to static analysis. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves an overall improvement of at least 17\% over baselines and advanced mainstream approaches, effectively bridging semantic gaps and synergizing the complementary advantages of different analyzers. Furthermore, an ablation study and fine-grained analysis are conducted to investigate the key factors contributing to overall performance gains.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 智能合约可以在没有可信中介的情况下促进和执行不受信任方之间的协议，但合约中的漏洞一旦被利用可能造成严重损害。虽然已经提出了各种分析技术用于漏洞检测，但它们通常局限于特定的漏洞类型。最近的一些框架采用聚合方式来扩展检测能力，但由于松散的集成未能解决潜在的冲突，往往会累积误报。与此同时，大语言模型（LLM）的语义推理能力在检测漏洞方面显示出潜力，尽管存在固有的推理瓶颈和幻觉问题。认识到这些挑战，在本工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的神经符号方法，名为集成LLM辅助静态分析（ELSA）。ELSA包含两个关键模块，即LLM辅助静态分析和分析器集成（多个LLM辅助静态分析器的集成），每个模块都包含两种不同的策略。LLM辅助静态分析通过约束引导的神经语义推理增强单个分析技术，而分析器集成则解决冲突输出以提炼出稳健的共识。我们在一个全面的基准上评估ELSA，包括三个开源数据集以及额外自构建的基于零知识证明的智能合约，其复杂性对静态分析提出了独特挑战。实验结果表明，我们的方法相比基线和先进主流方法总体提升至少17%，有效弥合了语义差距并协同了不同分析器的互补优势。此外，我们还进行了消融研究和细粒度分析，以探究促成整体性能提升的关键因素。

import_candidates.title: Rethinking Mixture-of-Experts for Vulnerability Detection: An Empirical Study and Improved Design
import_candidates.abstract: Deep learning–based vulnerability detection (DLVD) has recently adopted the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) paradigm to address vulnerability heterogeneity and the long-tailed distribution of Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) categories. A representative framework, MoEVD, builds CWE-specific experts and a router for expert selection, but its assumptions about expert specialization and routing reliability remain underexplored. We reproduce MoEVD under the same dataset, splits, backbone, and evaluation protocol, and conduct a fine-grained empirical study of expert behavior and routing decisions. We find that CWE-based experts do not consistently develop stable or exclusive specialization, and their effectiveness is highly sensitive to non-target vulnerabilities. More importantly, an idealized-router baseline shows that routing mismatch measurably limits what the original experts can achieve under idealized routing, while learned routing disproportionately sends non-vulnerable samples to a few experts. Guided by these findings, we explore targeted changes that relax strict CWE-based expert binding and replace fixed top-k routing with probability-mass-based top-p selection under a controlled OR-style voting rule. Under a controlled OR-style comparison on BigVul, the combined design shifts the precision--recall trade-off, improving F1 from 0.38 to 0.42 and recall from 0.32 to 0.39 while slightly increasing FPR. Repeated runs and zero-shot checks on two external datasets suggest that the trend is stable in the evaluated settings, while the improvements remain modest.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 基于深度学习的漏洞检测（DLVD）最近采用了混合专家（MoE）范式，以应对漏洞异质性和通用弱点枚举（CWE）类别的长尾分布。一个代表性框架 MoEVD 构建了 CWE 特定的专家和一个用于专家选择的路由器，但其关于专家专门化和路由可靠性的假设仍未得到充分探索。我们在相同的数据集、划分、骨干网络和评估协议下复现了 MoEVD，并对专家行为和路由决策进行了细粒度实证研究。我们发现，基于 CWE 的专家并未一致地形成稳定或排他的专门化，其有效性对非目标漏洞高度敏感。更重要的是，一个理想化路由器基线表明，路由不匹配可测量地限制了原始专家在理想化路由下能够达到的性能，而学习到的路由则不成比例地将非漏洞样本发送给少数专家。在这些发现的指导下，我们探索了有针对性的修改：放宽严格的基于 CWE 的专家绑定，并在受控的 OR 式投票规则下，将固定的 top-k 路由替换为基于概率质量的 top-p 选择。在 BigVul 上进行受控的 OR 式比较时，组合设计改变了精确率-召回率权衡，将 F1 从 0.38 提高到 0.42，召回率从 0.32 提高到 0.39，同时略微增加了 FPR。重复运行和在两个外部数据集上的零样本检查表明，在评估设置中该趋势是稳定的，而改进仍然有限。

import_candidates.title: RecurIC3: Exploiting Structural Lemma Reuse to Accelerate IC3
import_candidates.abstract: IC3/PDR has become a widely adopted technique for safety model checking due to its high efficiency. Despite its success, the algorithm often suffers from redundant exploration due to the lack of a cross-level memory mechanism. This results in the repetitive discovery of highly similar CTIs (Counterexamples to Induction), forcing the solver to waste computational effort traversing overlapping blocking chains. We propose RecurIC3, a framework that alleviates this bottleneck via structural reuse. RecurIC3 maintains a Bad State Tree (G_bad) that persistently records CTIs together with their level-aligned predecessor–successor links along blocking chains, turning the blocking phase into a history-aware process. To reduce solver calls, RecurIC3 first retrieves and rechecks lightweight candidates from G_bad and falls back to solver queries only when reuse is exhausted. This approach can significantly reduce the search space, thereby enhancing the verification efficiency of IC3. We implemented RecurIC3 in the state-of-the-art model checker Kind2 and evaluated it on the official benchmark suite. On instances where reuse is triggered, RecurIC3 reduces the number of explored tree nodes by 27\%, achieves a 1.42{\texttimes} cumulative speedup, and solves 16 additional instances (13 Safe and 3 Unsafe) within the same timeout. These results suggest that structural reuse can substantially accelerate IC3.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: IC3/PDR因其高效性已成为安全模型检测中广泛采用的技术。尽管取得了成功，该算法常常因缺乏跨层记忆机制而遭受冗余探索。这导致重复发现高度相似的CTI（归纳反例），迫使求解器浪费计算努力遍历重叠的阻塞链。我们提出RecurIC3，一个通过结构复用缓解此瓶颈的框架。RecurIC3维护一个坏状态树（G_bad），持续记录CTI及其沿阻塞链的层级对齐的前驱-后继链接，将阻塞阶段转变为历史感知过程。为了减少求解器调用，RecurIC3首先从G_bad中检索并重新检查轻量级候选，只有当复用耗尽时才回退到求解器查询。这种方法可以显著减少搜索空间，从而提高IC3的验证效率。我们在最先进的模型检测器Kind2中实现了RecurIC3，并在官方基准套件上进行了评估。在触发复用的实例上，RecurIC3将探索的树节点数量减少27%，实现1.42倍的累积加速，并在相同超时内多解决16个实例（13个安全，3个不安全）。这些结果表明结构复用可以显著加速IC3。

import_candidates.title: CausalRepair: Bridging the Causality Gap in Large Language Model-Based Automated Program Repair via Dual-Slicing
import_candidates.abstract: Automated Program Repair (APR) aims to automatically fix buggy programs. In recent years, with the rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs), LLM-based APR techniques have achieved significant progress. Despite their potential, the effectiveness of LLMs relies heavily on the quality of the provided repair context. However, existing LLM-based APR approaches suffer from a causality gap when constructing such contexts. Specifically, on the test side, existing methods struggle with test context ambiguity arising from noise interference or dependency absence; meanwhile, on the source side, existing retrieval-augmented methods primarily rely on static analysis inevitably introduce static over-approximation, resulting in contexts filled with unexecuted code and noise. Consequently, these contexts mislead LLMs, hindering them from identifying the true root cause and leading to incorrect fixes. To bridge this gap, we introduce the concept of minimal causal context, defined as the essential set of dependencies required to explain a specific failure. Based on this, we propose CausalRepair, a novel conversation-driven APR framework that instantiates this concept through a synergistic dual-slicing strategy. Specifically, CausalRepair employs context-aware static slicing on the test side to purify test semantics, and utilizes execution-trace-based dynamic slicing on the source side to capture precise runtime dependencies. This constructs a high-quality context causally relevant to the bug, which filters out irrelevant code and guides the iterative repair process. We evaluate CausalRepair on the widely used Defects4J (V1.2 and V2.0) and the latest Defects4J-Trans benchmarks. To ensure a fair comparison, we unify the backbone model as DeepSeek-V3 in all experiments. The results demonstrate that CausalRepair correctly fixes 313 bugs on Defects4J, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art approaches such as ReinFix and TSAPR, while reducing the average repair cost to $0.029 per bug, achieving a dual optimization of effectiveness and efficiency.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 自动程序修复（APR）旨在自动修复有缺陷的程序。近年来，随着大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展，基于LLM的APR技术取得了显著进展。尽管潜力巨大，但LLM的有效性在很大程度上依赖于所提供的修复上下文的质量。然而，现有的基于LLM的APR方法在构建此类上下文时存在因果差距。具体而言，在测试侧，现有方法难以应对由噪声干扰或依赖缺失引起的测试上下文模糊性；同时，在源代码侧，现有的检索增强方法主要依赖静态分析，不可避免地引入静态过近似，导致上下文中充满未执行的代码和噪声。因此，这些上下文会误导LLM，阻碍其识别真正的根本原因并导致错误的修复。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了最小因果上下文的概念，定义为解释特定故障所需的基本依赖集。基于此，我们提出了CausalRepair，一种新颖的对话驱动的APR框架，通过协同双切片策略实例化这一概念。具体而言，CausalRepair在测试侧采用上下文感知的静态切片来净化测试语义，并在源代码侧利用基于执行轨迹的动态切片来捕获精确的运行时依赖。这构建了与缺陷因果相关的高质量上下文，过滤掉无关代码并指导迭代修复过程。我们在广泛使用的Defects4J（V1.2和V2.0）以及最新的Defects4J-Trans基准上评估了CausalRepair。为确保公平比较，我们在所有实验中将骨干模型统一为DeepSeek-V3。结果表明，CausalRepair在Defects4J上正确修复了313个缺陷，显著优于ReinFix和TSAPR等最先进方法，同时将平均修复成本降低至每个缺陷0.029美元，实现了有效性和效率的双重优化。

import_candidates.title: Towards Understanding the Bugs in Verilator, a Hardware Description Language Compiler
import_candidates.abstract: Verilator is the premier open-source Hardware Description Language (HDL) compiler. It transforms Verilog and SystemVerilog designs into optimized C++ or SystemC models, enabling high-speed, cycle-accurate simulation prior to large-scale production. As a cornerstone of the hardware verification ecosystem, the correctness of Verilator is paramount; compiler faults can lead to silent simulation errors or unexpected failures, undermining the integrity of the hardware development lifecycle. Unlike traditional software compilers, HDL compilers manage unique concurrency and synthesis semantics, potentially introducing distinct bug patterns and complexities. However, while prior research has explored testing techniques for HDL toolchains, there remains a lack of systematic empirical studies characterizing the specific nature of bugs in Verilator. This knowledge gap hinders the development of targeted improvements in compiler robustness and testing strategies. To address this, we present the first comprehensive empirical study of Verilator bugs. We manually collected, analyzed, and categorized a dataset of 488 confirmed bugs from the official repository over three years. Our study investigates bug symptoms, root causes, and the characteristics of triggering test cases, while also evaluating the effectiveness of existing testing techniques. Based on our findings, we provide actionable guidance for developers to enhance Verilator's reliability and for researchers to design more effective automated testing methodologies for HDL compilers.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Verilator是首屈一指的开源硬件描述语言（HDL）编译器。它将Verilog和SystemVerilog设计转换为优化的C++或SystemC模型，从而能够在大规模生产之前进行高速、周期精确的仿真。作为硬件验证生态系统的基石，Verilator的正确性至关重要；编译器故障可能导致静默仿真错误或意外失败，破坏硬件开发生命周期的完整性。与传统软件编译器不同，HDL编译器管理独特的并发和综合语义，可能引入不同的缺陷模式和复杂性。然而，尽管先前研究探索了HDL工具链的测试技术，但仍缺乏系统的实证研究来刻画Verilator中缺陷的具体性质。这一知识空白阻碍了编译器鲁棒性和测试策略的针对性改进。为此，我们提出了首个针对Verilator缺陷的全面实证研究。我们从官方仓库手动收集、分析并分类了三年内488个已确认缺陷的数据集。我们的研究调查了缺陷症状、根本原因和触发测试用例的特征，同时评估了现有测试技术的有效性。基于我们的发现，我们为开发者增强Verilator的可靠性提供了可操作指导，并为研究人员设计更有效的HDL编译器自动化测试方法提供了建议。

import_candidates.title: DeepSCA: Dependency-Aware Software Composition Analysis for C/C++ Based on a Curated Code Feature Database
import_candidates.abstract: Software Composition Analysis (SCA) identifies reused third-party libraries (TPLs) and their dependencies, forming the basis of Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) for securing software supply chain. Current C/C++ SCA techniques extract code features and match them against a TPL feature database. However, detection recall is limited by feature database coverage, and two key challenges remain: (1) Coverage-Precision Trade-off: Feature databases built from a single repository (e.g., GitHub) often yield high false negatives, as C/C++ TPLs are inherently distributed across diverse hosting platforms (e.g., Debian, ArchLinux, and Xrepo), each offering partially overlapping yet distinct sets of TPLs. Although a multi-repository feature database improves TPL coverage, it inevitably introduces numerous shared functions (e.g., cross-TPL code clones) that map to a broader set of candidate origins. When coupled with the limitations of existing SCA techniques in tracing provenance, this ambiguity further increases false positives. (2) Neglected Dependency Context: Existing SCA techniques primarily focus on detecting reused TPLs but often overlook their inter-dependencies. However, license compatibility constraints are inherently determined by directed dependency relationships among TPLs. DeepSCA addresses Challenge 1 by constructing a feature database with 66,143,596 functions extracted from 33,100 C/C++ TPLs, covering nine mainstream hosting repositories. To reduce false positives from shared functions, DeepSCA groups TPLs with shared code, and uses distinctiveness scores to trace functions to their origins—ensuring high precision without sacrificing recall. To overcome Challenge 2, DeepSCA generates the dependency graph from the detected TPLs. it resolves filename ambiguity by simulating compiler header search paths and mitigates symbol ambiguity via namespace-aware resolution, enabling accurate file-level dependency mapping to TPLs. Evaluated on a ground-truth dataset of 335 OpenHarmony projects (10,583 TPLs, 64,200 dependencies), DeepSCA achieves 85.6\% precision and 87.3\% recall for TPL detection, outperforming state-of-the-art tools (e.g., 16.8\% precision and 21.1\% recall improvement over TPLite). Its dependency graphs reach 91.8\% precision, surpassing Cneps by 11.3\%. Moreover, the dependency graph generated by DeepSCA uncovers previously hidden combinations of license incompatibility issues in real-world projects.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 软件成分分析（SCA）识别被复用的第三方库（TPL）及其依赖关系，构成软件物料清单（SBOM）的基础，以保障软件供应链安全。当前的C/C++ SCA技术提取代码特征，并与TPL特征数据库进行匹配。然而，检测召回率受限于特征数据库的覆盖范围，并且仍存在两个关键挑战：（1）覆盖范围与精度之间的权衡：基于单一仓库（如GitHub）构建的特征数据库通常会导致较高的假阴性，因为C/C++ TPL本质上分布在不同的托管平台（如Debian、ArchLinux和Xrepo）上，每个平台提供部分重叠但不同的TPL集合。尽管多仓库特征数据库提高了TPL覆盖率，但它不可避免地引入了大量共享函数（例如跨TPL代码克隆），这些函数映射到更广泛的候选来源。当与现有SCA技术在溯源方面的局限性相结合时，这种模糊性进一步增加了假阳性。（2）被忽视的依赖上下文：现有SCA技术主要关注检测被复用的TPL，但往往忽视它们之间的相互依赖关系。然而，许可证兼容性约束本质上是由TPL之间的有向依赖关系决定的。DeepSCA通过构建一个包含从33,100个C/C++ TPL中提取的66,143,596个函数的特征数据库来解决挑战1，覆盖九个主流托管仓库。为了减少共享函数带来的假阳性，DeepSCA将具有共享代码的TPL分组，并使用独特性评分将函数溯源到其来源——确保高精度而不牺牲召回率。为了克服挑战2，DeepSCA从检测到的TPL生成依赖图。它通过模拟编译器头文件搜索路径来解决文件名歧义，并通过命名空间感知的解析来缓解符号歧义，从而实现准确的、到TPL的文件级依赖映射。在包含335个OpenHarmony项目（10,583个TPL，64,200个依赖关系）的真实基准数据集上评估，DeepSCA在TPL检测上达到85.6%的精度和87.3%的召回率，优于最先进的工具（例如，相比TPLite精度提高16.8%，召回率提高21.1%）。其依赖图达到91.8%的精度，超过Cneps 11.3%。此外，DeepSCA生成的依赖图揭示了现实项目中以前隐藏的许可证不兼容问题组合。

import_candidates.title: MalTotal: Cost-Effective and Language-Agnostic Malicious Code Poisoning Detection for Millions of Repositories
import_candidates.abstract: The widespread adoption of open source software (OSS) has introduced significant security risks, with malicious code poisoning attacks increasingly targeting public package registries and open-source platforms. Existing detection approaches, including heuristic-, learning-, and LLM-based methods, suffer from language-specific designs, limited generalization, and high analysis costs, making them unsuitable for large-scale multi-language analysis. To address these challenges, we propose MalTotal, a scalable and cost-effective framework for language-agnostic malicious code detection. MalTotal leverages LLM-assisted semantic reasoning to identify sensitive APIs, perform hybrid semantic slicing, and reconstruct malicious behavior contexts while reducing analysis overhead. Our evaluations show that MalTotal outperforms 8 state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an average F1-score of 93.1
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 开源软件（OSS）的广泛采用引入了显著的安全风险，恶意代码投毒攻击越来越多地针对公共包注册表和开源平台。现有检测方法，包括基于启发式、学习和LLM的方法，存在语言特定设计、泛化能力有限和分析成本高昂等问题，使其不适合大规模多语言分析。为应对这些挑战，我们提出MalTotal，一个可扩展且经济高效的语言无关恶意代码检测框架。MalTotal利用LLM辅助的语义推理来识别敏感API、执行混合语义切片，并在降低分析开销的同时重建恶意行为上下文。我们的评估表明，MalTotal优于8个最先进的基线，平均F1分数达到93.1

import_candidates.title: Repair-Driven Greybox Fuzzing
import_candidates.abstract: We present repair-driven greybox fuzzing, a new approach to greybox fuzzing that combines the strengths of unstructured, byte-level input mutation and grammar-guided input generation. By increasing input diversity while preserving input validity, repair-driven fuzzing promises to improve bug-finding ability for systems under test such as programming language interpreters that consume highly structured inputs. Our idea is to first mutate an input using a standard byte-level mutator, typically leading to an invalid input, and then repair the input using a grammar. Aggressively breaking and then repairing an input provides an effective way to reach parts of the input space that would be left unexplored by both byte-level and idiomatic grammar-based mutations. We put this idea into practice via RepairFuzz, a new greybox fuzzer based on AFL++, leveraging the byte level mutations of AFL++ and using the CPCT+ error recovery algorithm for input repair. We present experiments applying RepairFuzz to six SUTs covering four programming language input formats (Lua, PHP, JavaScript and Ruby), and present an experimental comparison with AFL++, Grammarinator and Nautilus, the state-of-the-art in standard greybox fuzzing and grammar-guided fuzzing. Our evaluation shows that RepairFuzz was able to find 13 confirmed bugs that were previously unknown, including 9 that were not found by AFL++, Grammarinator or Nautilus. Further, RepairFuzz yields absolute increases in code coverage for several SUTs and substantial complementary code coverage across all.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了修复驱动的灰盒模糊测试，这是一种新的灰盒模糊测试方法，它结合了非结构化的字节级输入变异和语法引导的输入生成的优势。通过在保持输入有效性的同时增加输入多样性，修复驱动的模糊测试有望提高对被测系统的错误发现能力，例如处理高度结构化输入的编程语言解释器。我们的想法是首先使用标准的字节级变异器对输入进行变异，通常导致无效输入，然后使用语法修复该输入。积极地破坏输入然后修复输入，提供了一种有效的方式来触及字节级变异和惯用语法变异都会未探索的输入空间部分。我们通过 RepairFuzz 将这一想法付诸实践，RepairFuzz 是一种基于 AFL++ 的新型灰盒模糊器，利用 AFL++ 的字节级变异，并使用 CPCT+ 错误恢复算法进行输入修复。我们展示了将 RepairFuzz 应用于六个 SUT 的实验，涵盖四种编程语言输入格式（Lua、PHP、JavaScript 和 Ruby），并与 AFL++、Grammarinator 和 Nautilus 进行了实验比较，这些是标准灰盒模糊测试和语法引导模糊测试的最新技术。我们的评估表明，RepairFuzz 能够发现 13 个先前未知的已确认错误，其中 9 个是 AFL++、Grammarinator 或 Nautilus 未发现的。此外，RepairFuzz 在多个 SUT 上实现了代码覆盖率的绝对增加，并在所有 SUT 上实现了大量的互补代码覆盖率。

import_candidates.title: CLIR: Liveness-Driven and Structure-Aware Fuzzing for the Cranelift Compiler
import_candidates.abstract: Modern compilers are complex software systems that must correctly translate high-level programming languages into machine code across multiple architectures. Cranelift, a fast and modern compiler backend originally developed for WebAssembly and recently adopted as an experimental backend for Rust, has gained increasing importance due to its superior compilation speed compared to LLVM and comprehensive multi-architecture support, including x86-64, AArch64, s390x, and RISCV64. However, despite decades of development in compiler testing, testing Cranelift still presents unique challenges, including (1) constructing valid IR under the strict enforcement of SSA form, (2) generating sequences with sufficient computational density to stress backend components, and (3) balancing broad backend coverage with efficient root cause analysis across heterogeneous architectures. To address these challenges, we propose CLIR, a differential testing framework that integrates a syntax-preserving hierarchical generation strategy to guarantee SSA validity, a liveness-guided instruction refinement mechanism to maximize computational density, and a diagnosis-guided cross-architecture adaptation scheme to facilitate efficient root cause analysis across heterogeneous backends. Our comprehensive evaluation demonstrates that CLIR substantially outperforms existing state-of-the-art baselines, detecting 8{\texttimes}, 24{\texttimes}, and 8{\texttimes} as many unique bugs as cranelift-fuzzgen, wasm-smith, and WASMaker, respectively, while RustSmith uncovered no bugs. Within 72 hours of testing, CLIR discovered 24 bugs spanning all target architectures, with 21 confirmed and 9 fixed.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代编译器是复杂的软件系统，必须正确地将高级编程语言翻译成跨多种架构的机器码。Cranelift是一个快速且现代的编译器后端，最初为WebAssembly开发，最近被采用为Rust的实验性后端。由于其编译速度优于LLVM以及全面的多架构支持（包括x86-64、AArch64、s390x和RISCV64），其重要性日益增加。然而，尽管编译器测试已有数十年的发展，测试Cranelift仍然面临独特挑战，包括：(1) 在严格强制SSA形式下构造有效IR；(2) 生成具有足够计算密度的序列以对后端组件进行压力测试；(3) 在异构架构上平衡广泛的后端覆盖与高效的根本原因分析。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了CLIR，一个差分测试框架，它集成了语法保持的分层生成策略以保证SSA有效性，一种活性引导的指令细化机制以最大化计算密度，以及一种诊断引导的跨架构适配方案以促进异构后端间的高效根本原因分析。我们的综合评估表明，CLIR大幅优于现有最先进的基线，检测到的唯一错误分别是cranelift-fuzzgen、wasm-smith和WASMaker的8倍、24倍和8倍，而RustSmith未发现任何错误。在72小时测试中，CLIR发现了24个覆盖所有目标架构的错误，其中21个已确认，9个已修复。

import_candidates.title: Testing Static Taint Analyzers with Equivalence Modulo Taint
import_candidates.abstract: Static taint analyzers are widely used to detect security vulnerabilities, yet their complexity makes them prone to soundness and precision issues. Validating these analyzers is challenging because ground-truth taint flows are rarely available and differential testing requires multiple comparable tools. To address this challenge, we introduce Equivalence Modulo Taint (EMT), a testing oracle for static taint analysis that defines program equivalence in terms of preserved source-sink flows rather than program semantics. EMT enables testing a single analyzer without ground-truth labels by checking consistency of reported flows across equivalent-modulo-taint program variants. Based on EMT, we present TaintCC, a framework that generates equivalent-modulo-taint variants through semantically equivalent, taint-oblivious, and taint-aware transformations targeting recurring difficulty dimensions in taint analysis. We evaluate TaintCC on four widely used analyzers---FlowDroid, Mariana Trench, Pysa, and Semgrep---and uncover 16 unique developer-confirmed issues, showing that even mature analyzers, whether academic or industrial, remain susceptible to reliability issues.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 静态污点分析器广泛用于检测安全漏洞，然而其复杂性使其容易出现健全性和精度问题。验证这些分析器具有挑战性，因为基准真值污点流很少可得，而差分测试需要多个可比较的工具。为应对这一挑战，我们引入了等价模污点（Equivalence Modulo Taint, EMT），一种用于静态污点分析的测试预言，它根据保留的源-汇流而非程序语义来定义程序等价性。EMT使得无需基准真值标签即可测试单个分析器，通过检查在等价模污点程序变体之间报告流的一致性。基于EMT，我们提出了TaintCC，一个通过语义等价、污点无感和污点感知的变换生成等价模污点变体的框架，这些变换针对污点分析中反复出现的困难维度。我们在四个广泛使用的分析器——FlowDroid、Mariana Trench、Pysa和Semgrep——上评估了TaintCC，并发现了16个由开发者确认的独特问题，表明即使是成熟的分析器，无论是学术的还是工业的，仍然容易受到可靠性问题的影响。

import_candidates.title: How Does Killing Surviving Mutants Help Detect Real Bugs with Assertion Generation? A Controlled Experiment
import_candidates.abstract: Killing surviving mutants is a central activity of mutation testing. This activity is motivated by the coupling-effect hypothesis: tests that expose simple artificial faults can also detect more complex, previously unseen real bugs. Despite these claimed benefits, automated studies have not directly measured the causal impact of mutant killing on real-bug detection. This limitation stems from open-ended mutant-killing strategies and a fundamental evaluation asymmetry that obscures causal attribution. In this work, we present the first large-scale controlled experiment that directly measures whether killing surviving mutants, without knowledge of future real bugs, would have enabled their detection. We model mutant killing as a selective, incremental process under realistic budget constraints, and we restrict test improvements to assertion augmentation. This restriction enables precise attribution of each test augmentation to a specific mutant-killing action. To support the experiment, we design a fully automated, fault-based assertion-augmentation technique that operates uniformly on mutants and real bugs and integrate it into Defects4J. Our controlled experiment yields several key empirical insights: (1) Across 642 Defects4J bugs, we find that 104 bugs would become detectable by adding an additional assertion to an existing passing, non-triggering test. (2) When coupling exists, a real bug is, on average, coupled with 21 surviving mutants, through which mutant killing can produce triggering tests. This number is substantially higher than the average of two mutants reported in prior studies. In those studies, coupling is inferred solely from documented bug-fixing tests rather than from tests derived via mutant killing. (3) Among these bugs, 63 of the 104 are detectable through principled mutant-killing (test augmentation) process. Notably, killing a randomly selected 30\% of relevant surviving mutants, using only one assertion per mutant, suffices to detect 84.5\% of these bugs. (4) By substituting mutants with real bugs and comparing their resulting assertion augmentation outputs, we find that real bugs induce broader behavioral effects than mutants, affecting more memory state locations, variables, and tests. (5) When mutation-derived assertions detect real bugs, they validate program outputs that overlap with, and are often strict subsets of, those affected by the real bugs. This offers a mechanistic explanation for why killing simple mutants can enable the detection of more complex real bugs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 杀死存活的变异体是变异测试的核心活动。这一活动由耦合效应假说驱动：暴露简单人工故障的测试也能检测到更复杂、此前未见的真实缺陷。尽管有这些声称的益处，自动化研究尚未直接测量杀死变异体对真实缺陷检测的因果影响。这一局限源于开放的变异体杀死策略和一种根本性的评估不对称，后者模糊了因果归因。在本工作中，我们提出了首个大规模对照实验，直接测量在不知道未来真实缺陷的情况下，杀死存活变异体是否本应能够检测到这些缺陷。我们将变异体杀死建模为现实预算约束下的选择性、增量过程，并将测试改进限制为断言增强。这一限制使得每次测试增强都能精确归因于特定的变异体杀死动作。为支持实验，我们设计了一种完全自动化、基于故障的断言增强技术，该技术统一作用于变异体和真实缺陷，并将其集成到Defects4J中。我们的对照实验得出了若干关键实证见解：(1) 在642个Defects4J缺陷中，我们发现通过向一个现有的通过但未触发缺陷的测试添加额外断言，104个缺陷将变得可检测。(2) 当耦合存在时，一个真实缺陷平均与21个存活变异体耦合，通过杀死这些变异体可以产生触发测试。这一数字远高于先前研究报告的平均两个变异体。在那些研究中，耦合仅从文档化的修复缺陷测试中推断，而不是从通过杀死变异体衍生的测试中推断。(3) 在这些缺陷中，104个中有63个可通过原则化的变异体杀死（测试增强）过程检测到。值得注意的是，随机选择30%的相关存活变异体，每个变异体仅使用一条断言，就足以检测这些缺陷中的84.5%。(4) 通过用真实缺陷替换变异体并比较它们产生的断言增强输出，我们发现真实缺陷比变异体引发更广泛的行为效应，影响更多的内存状态位置、变量和测试。(5) 当变异体衍生的断言检测到真实缺陷时，它们验证的程序输出与真实缺陷影响的输出重叠，且通常是其严格子集。这为为什么杀死简单变异体能够检测更复杂的真实缺陷提供了一种机制性解释。

import_candidates.title: The Illusion of Success: Learning-Based Android Malware Detectors (Replicability Study)
import_candidates.abstract: Since 2012, hundreds of machine-learning-based classification approaches have been proposed to help separate malware from benign Android applications. These approaches typically collect a large number of applications of both types, split them into training and testing subsets, train a binary classifier on the training subset, and measure accuracy on the testing subset. They typically report very high achieved accuracy, i.e., F1-score of around 95\%. Recent work has also highlighted several biases and flaws in the experimental setup and evaluation methodology of such approaches, questioning the trustworthiness of their reported results. In an effort to better understand the current status of classification-based malware detection, we first conduct a systematic literature review to extract the properties of existing tools and the datasets that they use. We then design a large-scale longitudinal study, where we evaluate the most prominent tools on a range of datasets spanning 13 years (2011-2023), which we systematically collected from the AndroZoo and VirusShare repositories while controlling for the known experimental setup biases. Our results show lower than reported classification performance, with the F1-score for a tool ranging from high 60 to low 90 percent, depending on a dataset. Moreover, even successful classification often utilizes hidden but semantically weak correlations in the data. In fact, a deliberately na{\"i}ve and unreliable classifier we designed for this study, which uses application package names as features for classification, performs comparably to and sometimes even better than the state-of-the-art tools when compared under the same setup. These results challenge the claimed detection capabilities of the tools, render comparisons of reported tool accuracy (without empirical evaluation on the exact same set of applications) practically meaningless, and call for the creation of more reliable and explainable semantic malware detection tools.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 自2012年以来，已有数百种基于机器学习的分类方法被提出，用于帮助区分恶意与良性Android应用。这些方法通常收集大量两类应用，将其划分为训练集和测试集，在训练集上训练二分类器，并在测试集上测量准确率。它们通常报告极高的准确率，即F1分数约为95%。近期工作也指出了此类方法在实验设置和评估方法上的若干偏差与缺陷，质疑其报告结果的可信度。为了更好地理解基于分类的恶意软件检测的现状，我们首先进行系统性文献综述，提取现有工具的特性及其使用的数据集。然后，我们设计了一项大规模纵向研究，在跨越13年（2011-2023）的一系列数据集上评估最突出的工具，这些数据集是我们从AndroZoo和VirusShare仓库中系统收集的，同时控制了已知的实验设置偏差。我们的结果显示分类性能低于报告值，工具的F1分数因数据集不同而在60%多到90%出头之间。此外，即使分类成功，也往往利用了数据中隐藏但语义微弱的关联。事实上，我们为本研究设计的一个刻意朴素且不可靠的分类器，使用应用包名作为分类特征，在相同设置下与最先进的工具相比表现相当，有时甚至更好。这些结果挑战了这些工具所声称的检测能力，使得（未在完全相同应用集上进行实证评估的）工具准确率比较实际上毫无意义，并呼吁创建更可靠且可解释的语义恶意软件检测工具。

import_candidates.title: No One-Size-Fits-All: Adaptive Code Editing with Feature-Based Strategy Selection
import_candidates.abstract: Large language models have shown strong potential in automating code editing (CE) tasks, yet most existing systems rely on a fixed CE strategy (i.e., one-step, search-replace, and plan-apply) across diverse scenarios. In practice, CE tasks vary widely in code context, edit locality, and semantic complexity, causing no single strategy to perform consistently well. Moreover, systematic studies on the relationship between strategies and CE tasks remain scarce, limiting further optimization of LLM-based code editing strategies. To address this gap, we construct CEBench, comprising 500 real-world CE tasks curated from SWE-bench. Then we compare three representative CE strategies (one-step, search-replace, plan-apply). Our study reveals two key findings: (1) each strategy exhibits distinct advantages for specific CE tasks, with no universal optimality; (2) strategy effectiveness is significantly influenced by four core task features: total lines of code, modification type, modification scope, and task type. Motivated by these findings, we propose Ace, an adaptive code editing framework that dynamically selects optimal CE strategies based on task features. Unlike classifier-based or instruction-prompting approaches, Ace employs a fine-tuned LLM that learns feature-strategy mappings from empirical data to recommend strategies with interpretable rationales. Extensive experiments on our CEBench-verified show that Ace outperforms state-of-the-art baselines: it boosts Pass@1 by 21.7\% while reducing token consumption by 27.3\% compared to the best baseline (AutoCodeRover). Our strategy selector achieves 72.6\% selection accuracy with 69.9\% rationale accuracy (Cohen’s Kappa=0.807), providing transparent and trustworthy decision-making for developers.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型在自动化代码编辑（CE）任务中已展现出强大潜力，但大多数现有系统在多样化场景中依赖固定的CE策略（即一步式、搜索替换和计划-应用）。在实践中，CE任务在代码上下文、编辑局部性和语义复杂度方面差异很大，导致没有一种策略能始终表现良好。此外，关于策略与CE任务之间关系的系统性研究仍然稀缺，限制了基于LLM的代码编辑策略的进一步优化。为弥补这一空白，我们构建了CEBench，包含从SWE-bench中筛选出的500个真实世界CE任务。然后我们比较了三种代表性CE策略（一步式、搜索替换、计划-应用）。我们的研究揭示了两项关键发现：(1) 每种策略对特定CE任务表现出独特优势，不存在普遍最优性；(2) 策略有效性显著受到四个核心任务特征的影响：代码总行数、修改类型、修改范围和任务类型。受这些发现启发，我们提出了Ace，一种自适应代码编辑框架，可根据任务特征动态选择最优CE策略。与基于分类器或指令提示的方法不同，Ace采用微调的LLM，从经验数据中学习特征-策略映射，以可解释的理由推荐策略。在我们CEBench-verified上的大量实验表明，Ace优于最先进的基线：与最佳基线（AutoCodeRover）相比，它将Pass@1提升了21.7%，同时将token消耗降低了27.3%。我们的策略选择器实现了72.6%的选择准确率和69.9%的理由准确率（Cohen’s Kappa=0.807），为开发者提供了透明且可信的决策。

import_candidates.title: When Optimizations Backfire: The Paradox of Plaintext Optimizations in Privacy-Preserving ML Compilers
import_candidates.abstract: Growing concerns about data security and privacy have fueled the widespread adoption of Privacy-Preserving Machine Learning (PPML). Cryptography-based PPML, which allows computation directly on encrypted data, significantly mitigates data leakage risks. To facilitate its adoption, Ciphertext Machine Learning Compilers (CMLCs) automate the translation of high-level ML procedures into low-level circuits for encrypted data. Recently, CMLCs have increasingly adopted infrastructure from Plaintext Machine Learning Compilers (PMLCs). While integrating Plaintext-Domain Optimization Passes (PDOPs) into CMLCs offers potential performance, usability, and extensibility benefits, our study shows it can also lead to severe performance regressions — a risk that has been largely overlooked. To address this, we introduce Hopta, a hybrid domain optimization defects tester and analyzer, aiming to find optimization bugs that can degrade the performance of compiled circuits from CMLCs. We carefully design two core components: (1) an optimization pipeline mutation mechanism to detect optimization anomalies by selectively enabling/disabling PDOPs, and (2) a profile-guided code reduction tool that efficiently simplifies defect-triggering programs to isolate optimization anomalies and facilitate debugging. Applying Hopta to SecretFlow-SPU, a production-grade CMLC, we identified 11 optimization defects (spanning matrix indexing,arithmetic/boolean conversion, and cost model deviation) that led to substantial performance regressions, with compiled circuits incurring up to 310.2\% increased cost. Our comprehensive analysis provides empirical insights into fundamental differences between plaintext and ciphertext domain optimization strategies, offering crucial guidance for future CMLC development. We conclude with a brief discussion of extensions to other hybrid ML compilers, underscoring the methodology’s compiler-agnostic nature. This work establishes a new research direction for enhancing CMLC performance and the practical deployment of privacy-preserving ML systems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着对数据安全和隐私的日益关注，隐私保护机器学习（PPML）得到了广泛采用。基于密码学的PPML允许直接在加密数据上进行计算，显著降低了数据泄漏风险。为促进其应用，密文机器学习编译器（CMLC）将高层机器学习过程自动转换为用于加密数据的低层电路。近来，CMLC越来越多地采用明文机器学习编译器（PMLC）的基础设施。虽然将明文域优化遍（PDOP）集成到CMLC中可带来性能、可用性和可扩展性方面的潜在收益，但我们的研究表明，这也可能导致严重的性能回退——这一风险在很大程度上被忽视了。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了Hopta，一种混合域优化缺陷测试与分析器，旨在发现可能降低CMLC编译电路性能的优化缺陷。我们精心设计了两个核心组件：(1) 优化流水线变异机制，通过选择性地启用/禁用PDOP来检测优化异常；(2) 一种profile引导的代码缩减工具，可高效简化触发缺陷的程序，以隔离优化异常并便于调试。将Hopta应用于生产级CMLC SecretFlow-SPU，我们发现了11个优化缺陷（涉及矩阵索引、算术/布尔转换和成本模型偏差），这些缺陷导致了严重的性能回退，编译后的电路成本增加高达310.2%。我们的全面分析提供了关于明文与密文域优化策略根本差异的实证见解，为未来CMLC开发提供了关键指导。我们最后简要讨论了扩展到其他混合机器学习编译器的方法，强调了该方法的编译器无关性。这项工作为提升CMLC性能和隐私保护机器学习系统的实际部署开辟了新的研究方向。

import_candidates.title: Test Case Selection for Deep Neural Networks: A Replication Study on LLMs for Code (Replicability Study)
import_candidates.abstract: Test case selection (TCS) techniques have been explored to support the operational evaluation of deep neural networks (DNNs) under limited testing budgets, where labeling cost is a primary concern and early model failure detection is a key objective. Although prior studies report promising results, existing empirical evaluations focus almost exclusively on vision-based DNNs and datasets. As observed in recent surveys, models and datasets specifically designed for software engineering tasks have not been considered, leaving it unclear whether prior findings generalize to LLM code models. This paper presents a large-scale replication study of TCS techniques in the context of LLM code models. We re-examine established TCS strategies originally proposed for DNNs and complement them with statistical sampling strategies that have not previously been evaluated for TCS. We assess their effectiveness on three code-related classification tasks: clone detection, vulnerability detection, and technical debt prediction. The study spans 17 task-specific fine-tuned model instances, 7 predictive features, and 13 selection strategies, including 12 feature-aware strategies and simple random sampling (SRS) as a feature-agnostic baseline. We evaluate performance along two dimensions: operational accuracy estimation and early failure discovery. The results indicate that only a subset of findings reported for vision-based DNNs generalize when TCS is applied to LLMs for code. In particular, uncertainty-based features are effective for early failure discovery, while representation-based features are more robust for accuracy estimation. At the same time, performance varies substantially across tasks and models, indicating that the effectiveness of TCS techniques is context-dependent. Overall, this study provides empirical evidence on the replicability of TCS techniques beyond vision-based deep learning and offers insights into their use for the operational evaluation of LLMs for code.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 测试用例选择（TCS）技术已被探索用于在有限测试预算下支持深度神经网络（DNN）的运行评估，其中标注成本是主要关注点，而早期模型故障检测是关键目标。尽管先前研究报告了有希望的结果，但现有的实证评估几乎完全集中于基于视觉的DNN和数据集。正如近期综述所观察到的，专门为软件工程任务设计的模型和数据集尚未被考虑，这使得先前的发现能否推广到LLM代码模型仍不清楚。本文提出了在LLM代码模型背景下对TCS技术的大规模复制研究。我们重新检验了最初为DNN提出的成熟TCS策略，并补充了此前未在TCS中评估过的统计采样策略。我们在三个与代码相关的分类任务上评估其有效性：克隆检测、漏洞检测和技术债务预测。该研究涵盖17个任务特定微调模型实例、7个预测特征和13种选择策略，包括12种特征感知策略和作为特征无关基线的简单随机采样（SRS）。我们从两个维度评估性能：运行准确率估计和早期故障发现。结果表明，当TCS应用于代码LLM时，只有一部分针对基于视觉的DNN报告的发现能够推广。特别是，基于不确定性的特征对于早期故障发现有效，而基于表示的特征在准确率估计方面更稳健。同时，不同任务和模型之间的性能差异很大，表明TCS技术的有效性依赖于上下文。总体而言，本研究提供了关于TCS技术在基于视觉的深度学习之外的可复制性的实证证据，并为其在代码LLM运行评估中的使用提供了见解。

import_candidates.title: CAST: A Compiler-Based Framework for Systematically Testing LLM Compositional Safety
import_candidates.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in software pipelines, raising concerns about harmful behaviors in security-critical domains. Existing safety evaluations predominantly probe models with single prompts or short interactions, and therefore do not capture how safety behaves under multi-step workflows where individual requests are composed into complex behavior. This paper introduces compositional safety, the property that an LLM remains safe not only against isolated malicious prompts, but also under structured, long-horizon decompositions of harmful intents. We propose CAST, a systematic testing framework designed to evaluate the compositional safety of LLMs in the domain of malicious code. Drawing inspiration from modern compiler infrastructures, CAST decouples test case generation from test execution using a novel intermediate representation, CAIR. This architecture allows the framework to automatically refine high-level testing intents into granular sub-tasks that serve as unit tests for the model’s alignment. These components are subsequently instantiated by the SUT and reassembled according to the CAIR control structure. The resulting artifact is then evaluated by intent-fulfillment scoring and, for the severity subset, external behavioral detectors and manual inspection. We evaluate CAST on four state-of-the-art LLMs across three security-critical testbeds. Our results demonstrate that CAST systematically exposes severe safety violations in strongly aligned models that resist conventional red-teaming, achieving up to a 365\% increase in successful test cases compared to baseline testing strategies
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于软件流水线中，引发了对其在安全关键领域中有害行为的担忧。现有的安全评估主要用单一提示或简短交互探测模型，因此无法捕捉当单个请求被组合成复杂行为时，安全在多步工作流中的表现。本文引入了组合安全性（compositional safety），即LLM不仅对孤立的恶意提示保持安全，而且在有害意图的结构化、长时程分解下也保持安全。我们提出了CAST，一个系统化测试框架，用于评估LLM在恶意代码领域的组合安全性。受现代编译器基础设施的启发，CAST使用一种新颖的中间表示CAIR将测试用例生成与测试执行解耦。这种架构使框架能够自动将高层测试意图细化为细粒度子任务，作为模型对齐的单元测试。这些组件随后由SUT实例化，并根据CAIR控制结构重新组装。产生的工件随后通过意图实现评分进行评估，对于严重性子集，还使用外部行为检测器和人工检查。我们在三个安全关键测试平台上对四个最先进的LLM评估了CAST。我们的结果表明，CAST系统性地暴露了能够抵抗传统红队测试的强对齐模型中的严重安全违规，与基线测试策略相比，成功测试用例增加了高达365%。

import_candidates.title: CAM: A Causality-Based Analysis Framework for Multi-agent Code Generation Systems
import_candidates.abstract: Despite the remarkable success that Multi-Agent Code Generation Systems (MACGS) have achieved, the inherent complexity of multi-agent architectures produces substantial volumes of intermediate outputs. To date, the individual importance of these intermediate outputs to the system correctness remains opaque, which impedes targeted optimization of MACGS designs. To address this challenge, we propose CAM, the first Causality-based Analysis framework for MACGS that systematically quantifies the contribution of different intermediate features to system correctness. By comprehensively categorizing intermediate outputs and systematically simulating realistic errors on intermediate features, we identify the important features for system correctness and aggregate their importance rankings, facilitating comprehensive analysis of MACGS. We instantiate CAM on representative MACGS across multiple backend LLMs and datasets and conduct extensive empirical analysis on the identified importance rankings. Our analysis reveals intriguing findings: first, we uncover context-dependent features—features whose importance emerges mainly through interactions with other features, revealing that quality assurance for MACGS should move beyond module-level validation to incorporate cross-feature consistency checks; second, we reveal that hybrid backend MACGS with different backend LLMs assigned according to their relative strength achieves up to 7.3\% Pass@1 improvement, underscoring hybrid architectures as a promising direction for future MACGS design. We further demonstrate CAM’s practical utility through two applications: (1) failure repair, which achieves a 73.6\% success rate by optimizing top-3 importance-ranked features and (2) feature pruning, that reduces up to 33.6\% intermediate token consumption with negligible or sometimes positive performance impact by pruning low-importance features. Our work provides actionable insights for MACGS design and deployment, establishing causality analysis as a powerful approach for understanding and improving MACGS.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 尽管多智能体代码生成系统（MACGS）取得了显著成功，但多智能体架构固有的复杂性会产生大量中间输出。迄今为止，这些中间输出对系统正确性的各自重要性仍然不透明，这阻碍了对MACGS设计的针对性优化。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了CAM，这是首个针对MACGS的基于因果性的分析框架，能够系统地量化不同中间特征对系统正确性的贡献。通过全面分类中间输出并系统地在中间特征上模拟真实错误，我们识别出对系统正确性重要的特征，并聚合其重要性排名，从而促进对MACGS的全面分析。我们在多个后端LLM和数据集上，将CAM实例化于具有代表性的MACGS，并对识别出的重要性排名进行了广泛的实证分析。我们的分析揭示了有趣的发现：首先，我们发现了上下文依赖特征——这些特征的重要性主要通过与其他特征的交互而显现，表明MACGS的质量保证应超越模块级验证，纳入跨特征一致性检查；其次，我们揭示出混合后端MACGS（根据不同后端LLM的相对优势进行分配）可实现高达7.3%的Pass@1提升，凸显混合架构是未来MACGS设计的有前景方向。我们通过两个应用进一步展示了CAM的实用价值：(1) 故障修复，通过优化排名前3的重要特征，成功率可达73.6%；(2) 特征剪枝，通过剪枝低重要性特征，最多可减少33.6%的中间令牌消耗，且性能影响可忽略甚至有时为正。我们的工作为MACGS的设计和部署提供了可操作的见解，将因果性分析确立为理解和改进MACGS的强大方法。

import_candidates.title: KaPilot: LLM-Assisted Generation of Kani Specifications for Unsafe Rust Verification
import_candidates.abstract: Rust’s ownership and type system provide strong memory safety guarantees, but unsafe code still presents memory safety risks. Formal verification is crucial for ensuring memory safety, but writing precise specifications for unsafe Rust is challenging and largely manual. Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in generating formal specifications but are often code-centric, prone to inheriting implementation flaws, and lack systematic quality assessment. In this paper, we present KaPilot, a multi-agent framework for automatically generating specifications to verify unsafe Rust memory safety using Kani. The process begins with lightweight program analysis and proof harness generation. The SafetyReq agent extracts a concise, refined list of safety requirements from the target Rust function’s documentation, which guides the SpecGen agent in producing initial specifications that specify memory safety concerns. Then, the specifications are iteratively refined through a generate–precheck–verify loop involving SpecGenerate, SpecPrecheck, and SpecVerify agents, which assess quality and feed errors back. By executing this loop multiple times, KaPilot generates a set of candidate specifications. Finally, the shuffle-and-implication strategy is applied to systematically determine the best specification from these candidates. We evaluated KaPilot on 54 unsafe Rust functions with ground truth and 44 without. KaPilot achieved 88.9\% and 69.2\% specification generation success, respectively, with 57.4\% of generated specifications equivalent to or stronger than the ground truth. Compared with AutoSpec, KaPilot produces 14.8\% more verifiable specifications and 25.9\% more equivalent-or-better specifications.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Rust的所有权和类型系统提供了强大的内存安全保障，但不安全代码仍然存在内存安全风险。形式化验证对于确保内存安全至关重要，但为不安全Rust编写精确的规范具有挑战性且主要依靠人工。大型语言模型（LLM）在生成形式化规范方面已展现出潜力，但往往以代码为中心，容易继承实现缺陷，并缺乏系统性的质量评估。在本文中，我们提出了KaPilot，一个用于自动生成规范以使用Kani验证不安全Rust内存安全的多智能体框架。该过程从轻量级程序分析和证明框架生成开始。SafetyReq智能体从目标Rust函数的文档中提取简洁、精炼的安全需求列表，指导SpecGen智能体生成针对内存安全问题的初始规范。然后，这些规范通过由SpecGenerate、SpecPrecheck和SpecVerify智能体参与的生成—预检查—验证循环进行迭代细化，这些智能体评估质量并反馈错误。通过多次执行该循环，KaPilot生成一组候选规范。最后，应用混洗与蕴含策略从这些候选中系统地确定最佳规范。我们在54个有真实标注的不安全Rust函数和44个没有真实标注的函数上评估了KaPilot。KaPilot分别实现了88.9%和69.2%的规范生成成功率，其中57.4%的生成规范等同于或强于真实标注。与AutoSpec相比，KaPilot生成的可验证规范多14.8%，等同于或更优的规范多25.9%。

import_candidates.title: RippleGUItester: Change-Aware Exploratory Testing
import_candidates.abstract: Software systems evolve continuously through frequent code changes, yet such changes often introduce unintended bugs despite extensive testing and code review. Existing testing approaches are largely constrained to predefined execution paths or rely on unguided exploration, leaving many change-induced issues undetected. To address this challenge, we present RippleGUItester, a change-driven testing system that treats a code change as the epicenter of a ripple effect and explores its broader, user-visible impacts via the GUI. Given a code change, RippleGUItester performs LLM-based change-impact analysis to generate and enrich realistic test scenarios, executes these scenarios on both pre-change and post-change versions of the system, and applies differential analysis to identify behavioral differences. Crucially, RippleGUItester employs multimodal bug detection, comparing visual GUI changes and interpreting them in the context of natural-language change intents to distinguish unintended bugs from intended behavioral updates. We evaluate our approach on hundreds of real-world code changes across four widely used software systems: Firefox, Zettlr, JabRef, and Godot. Our results show that the proposed approach uncovers bugs introduced by code changes that were missed by existing test suites, CI pipelines, and code review. In total, we identify and report 26 previously unknown bugs that still exist in the latest versions of the evaluated systems. 18 bugs have been fixed, 3 have been confirmed, and 5 were marked as intended. We envision RippleGUItester being applied before or shortly after a code change is merged, enabling earlier detection of regressions.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 软件系统通过频繁的代码更改不断演进，然而尽管进行了大量测试和代码审查，这些更改往往仍会引入意外错误。现有的测试方法在很大程度上局限于预定义的执行路径或依赖无引导的探索，导致许多变更引发的问题未被发现。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了RippleGUItester，一种变更驱动的测试系统，它将代码更改视为涟漪效应的中心，并通过GUI探索其更广泛的、用户可见的影响。给定一个代码更改，RippleGUItester执行基于LLM的变更影响分析，以生成和丰富真实的测试场景，在系统的变更前和变更后版本上执行这些场景，并应用差分分析来识别行为差异。关键的是，RippleGUItester采用多模态缺陷检测，比较视觉GUI变化，并在自然语言变更意图的背景下解释这些变化，以区分意外错误和预期的行为更新。我们在四个广泛使用的软件系统（Firefox、Zettlr、JabRef和Godot）的数百个真实代码更改上评估了我们的方法。我们的结果表明，所提出的方法发现了现有测试套件、CI流水线和代码审查所遗漏的由代码更改引入的错误。我们总共识别并报告了26个先前未知的错误，这些错误仍然存在于被评估系统的最新版本中。其中18个错误已被修复，3个已被确认，5个被标记为预期行为。我们设想RippleGUItester可以在代码更改合并之前或之后不久应用，从而实现更早的回归检测。

import_candidates.title: Gleaner: A Semantically-Rich and Efficient Online Sampler for Microservice Diagnostics
import_candidates.abstract: Distributed tracing in microservices is critical for diagnostics but generates overwhelming data volumes, necessitating intelligent sampling. To maximize fidelity, state-of-the-art (SOTA) tail-based samplers analyze complete (or even log-enriched) traces by modeling them as graphs. However, this reliance on computationally expensive graph analysis creates a performance bottleneck that prohibits their use in online settings. To this end, we propose Gleaner, an online tail-sampling framework that breaks this trade-off. It is founded on the key insight that explicit graph structures are unnecessary for high-fidelity trace grouping. Instead, Gleaner represents each trace as a “bag-of-edges” augmented with log semantics, replacing slow graph algorithms with highly efficient set-based operations. It also employs an alarm-driven quota and a diversity-preserving strategy to prioritize anomalous and rare traces for downstream Root Cause Analysis (RCA). Experimentally, Gleaner processes traces at 0.74ms each, improving Trace Pattern Coverage by up to 128.7\% and Shannon Entropy by up to 32.9\% over baselines. At just a 1\% sampling rate, Gleaner improves RCA accuracy by 42\%-107\% over the next-best sampler. Moreover, RCA on Gleaner’s sampled data is more accurate than with the entire, unsampled dataset. This result reframes intelligent sampling from a data reduction technique to a powerful signal enhancement paradigm for automated operations.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 微服务中的分布式追踪对诊断至关重要，但会产生海量数据，因此需要智能采样。为了最大化保真度，最先进的（SOTA）尾部采样器通过将完整（甚至日志增强）的追踪建模为图来进行分析。然而，这种对计算昂贵图分析的依赖造成了性能瓶颈，阻碍了它们在在线场景中的使用。为此，我们提出Gleaner，一个打破这一权衡的在线尾部采样框架。它基于一个关键洞见：高保真追踪分组并不需要显式的图结构。相反，Gleaner将每条追踪表示为一个“边袋”（bag-of-edges），并增强日志语义，用高效的基于集合的运算替代缓慢的图算法。它还采用告警驱动的配额和保持多样性的策略，为下游根因分析（RCA）优先选择异常和稀有追踪。实验表明，Gleaner处理每条追踪耗时0.74毫秒，相比基线将追踪模式覆盖率提升最多128.7%，香农熵提升最多32.9%。仅以1%的采样率，Gleaner就将RCA准确率比次优采样器提升42%-107%。此外，基于Gleaner采样数据的RCA比使用整个未采样数据集更准确。这一结果将智能采样从一种数据缩减技术重新定义为一种用于自动化运维的强大信号增强范式。

import_candidates.title: Context Matters: Improving the Practical Reliability of LLM-Based Unit Test Generation (Experience Paper)
import_candidates.abstract: Automated unit test generation has recently benefited from advances in large language models (LLMs), yet our industrial deployments reveal a persistent gap between promising research results and practical usability. In real-world projects with complex frameworks and cross-file dependencies, LLM-generated tests frequently fail to compile, require costly manual repair, or provide unstable coverage improvements. This paper reports our experience in designing, deploying, and evaluating CATGen, a context-aware workflow for LLM-based unit test generation, informed by repeated industrial failures and refinements. Rather than relying on LLMs to infer incomplete project context, we found that compilation robustness critically depends on making project-level dependencies explicit, stabilizing test class scaffolding, and replacing iterative LLM-based repair with lightweight static analysis. These experience-driven insights shaped CATGen’s multi-stage design, which combines structured context retrieval, deterministic test skeleton construction, and program analysis–based post-processing. We evaluate CATGen on real-world complex focal methods from proprietary industrial projects and additionally on the Defects4J benchmark to assess generalizability. Across both settings, CATGen substantially improves compilation success and structural coverage while significantly reducing generation time and token consumption compared to existing LLM-based approaches. Our results demonstrate that reliable LLM-based unit test generation in practice depends less on prompt engineering alone and more on systematic engineering support grounded in real-world development constraints.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 自动化单元测试生成最近受益于大型语言模型（LLM）的进展，但我们的工业部署揭示出有前景的研究结果与实际可用性之间存在持续差距。在具有复杂框架和跨文件依赖的真实项目中，LLM生成的测试经常无法编译，需要昂贵的人工修复，或提供不稳定的覆盖率提升。本文报告了我们设计、部署和评估CATGen的经验，这是一个面向LLM单元测试生成的上下文感知工作流，其灵感来自反复的工业失败和改进。我们不是依赖LLM来推断不完整的项目上下文，而是发现编译稳健性关键取决于使项目级依赖显式化、稳定测试类脚手架，并用轻量级静态分析替代基于LLM的迭代修复。这些经验驱动的见解塑造了CATGen的多阶段设计，它结合了结构化上下文检索、确定性测试骨架构建和基于程序分析的后处理。我们在来自专有工业项目的真实复杂焦点方法上评估CATGen，并额外在Defects4J基准上评估其泛化性。在两种设置中，与现有基于LLM的方法相比，CATGen显著提高了编译成功率和结构覆盖率，同时显著减少了生成时间和令牌消耗。我们的结果表明，实践中可靠的基于LLM的单元测试生成较少取决于单纯的提示工程，而更多取决于基于真实开发约束的系统化工程支持。

import_candidates.title: Inferring 1-Minimal Trigger Configurations for Assessing Linux Kernel CVE Triggerability
import_candidates.abstract: Vendors assessing Linux kernel CVEs need to know whether a bug is triggerable under production-tailored configurations, not merely whether a version is affected, yet upstream reproducers and vulnerability databases rarely provide configuration-level context. We study minimal trigger-configuration inference: given a CVE entry and a target kernel version (optionally a baseline .config), we synthesize a Kconfig-satisfiable option set that remains effective after make olddefconfig and, when a reproducer is available, still triggers under a specified evaluation protocol; we then prune it to a 1-minimal (subset-minimal) boundary for evaluation. Our framework FCC links vulnerability cues to build-system symbols, completes implicit prerequisites under olddefconfig feedback to avoid silent rollback, and performs runtime-validated minimization guided by dependency topology. We evaluate on KernJC and KernelCTF, totaling 88 CVEs across multiple kernel versions. On the 88-CVE set, FCC improves the post-make olddefconfig configuration success rate from 62.5\% (55/88) to 96.6\% (85/88) over an olddef-only injection baseline; on the KernJC set, FCC reduces the average candidate set size by 78.7\% compared to KernJC (Avg. 14.72 vs. 69.00 options per CVE). A stage-wise analysis of time and token costs shows that Stage I dominates overhead, while CVE-focused evidence selection substantially reduces this cost. By returning an effective and auditable 1-minimal configuration boundary, FCC helps vendors scope triggerability against their deployment configurations with a clear, tool-supported decision line.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 评估Linux内核CVE的供应商需要知道某个缺陷在生产定制配置下是否可触发，而不仅仅是某个版本是否受影响，但上游复现程序和漏洞数据库很少提供配置级别的上下文。我们研究最小触发配置推断：给定一个CVE条目和目标内核版本（可选基线.config），我们合成一个满足Kconfig的选项集，该选项集在make olddefconfig之后仍然有效，并且当有复现程序可用时，在指定的评估协议下仍能触发；然后我们将其修剪为1-最小（子集最小）边界以进行评估。我们的框架FCC将漏洞线索链接到构建系统符号，在olddefconfig反馈下补全隐式先决条件以避免静默回滚，并在依赖拓扑指导下执行运行时验证的最小化。我们在KernJC和KernelCTF上进行评估，总共涵盖多个内核版本的88个CVE。在88个CVE集合上，与仅使用olddef注入的基线相比，FCC将make olddefconfig后的配置成功率从62.5%（55/88）提高到96.6%（85/88）；在KernJC集合上，与KernJC相比，FCC将平均候选集大小减少了78.7%（平均每个CVE 14.72 vs. 69.00个选项）。对时间和token成本的分阶段分析表明，阶段I主导了开销，而针对CVE的证据选择显著降低了这一成本。通过返回有效且可审计的1-最小配置边界，FCC帮助供应商对照其部署配置确定可触发性范围，并提供清晰、工具支持的决策线。

import_candidates.title: The Discreet Charm of the Bugeoisie: A First Look at Bug Reports Created by Researchers
import_candidates.abstract: Many ISSTA papers present automated tools to find software bugs. Some researchers create bug reports for the bugs they deem worth reporting, e.g., new bugs found by the tools. We study bug reports created by researchers and coin the term Bugeoisie to refer to such bug reports. We collect the Bugeoisie for ISSTA 2025 by reading the papers, examining the artifacts, and contacting the authors, trying to “chase” bug report links. This process turns out to be surprisingly challenging because only a few authors make such links readily available. We then analyze the Bugeoisie to understand potential bad practices. For most papers that claim some bugs reported or confirmed, independently checking the claims is again surprisingly challenging. We also start analyzing Bugeoisie for FSE 2025 to check generalizability of our findings. Our findings point out to the important changes that conference organizers and reviewers may want to require for the Bugeoisie. We also provide some suggestions for paper authors to prepare and describe their Bugeoisie in their papers and artifacts.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 许多ISSTA论文展示了用于发现软件缺陷的自动化工具。一些研究者为他们认为值得报告的缺陷（例如工具发现的新缺陷）创建缺陷报告。我们研究研究者创建的缺陷报告，并创造术语Bugeoisie来指代此类缺陷报告。我们通过阅读论文、检查工件并联系作者，尝试“追踪”缺陷报告链接，为ISSTA 2025收集Bugeoisie。这一过程令人惊讶地具有挑战性，因为只有少数作者使此类链接易于获取。然后我们分析Bugeoisie以理解潜在的不良实践。对于大多数声称报告或确认了某些缺陷的论文，独立核查这些声明同样令人惊讶地具有挑战性。我们还开始分析FSE 2025的Bugeoisie，以检查我们发现的普遍性。我们的发现指出了会议组织者和审稿人可能希望对Bugeoisie要求的重要改变。我们还为论文作者提供了一些建议，以便在其论文和工件中准备和描述其Bugeoisie。

import_candidates.title: BinRAG: An RAG-Based Decompilation Framework Fusing Name Prediction and Calling Context
import_candidates.abstract: Decompiling stripped binaries to assist human reverse engineers remains a critical yet highly challenging task in software security. Prior work has developed various neural networks and even dedicated large language models (LLMs) to improve function and variable name recovery in decompiled code. Nonetheless, these approaches alone fall short of enabling a generic LLM-based decompilation pipeline that can reliably enhance the readability and semantic clarity of decompiled outputs. In this paper, we propose BinRAG, a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) based decompilation framework designed to enhance the decompilation of stripped binaries. Building upon name prediction models, BinRAG features three novel designs: (1) it first utilizes name prediction models to transform raw decompiled outputs into enriched, source-like queries for RAG retrieval; (2) it further enhances these queries using a fine-tuned specialized LLM conditioned on the predicted variable names, enabling more accurate retrieval from a curated example database; (3) it then integrates these retrieved examples with the target’s calling context, employing a general-purpose LLM to synthesize high-fidelity, human-readable decompiled code. Evaluation on 3,200 functions from real-world software repositories demonstrates that BinRAG improves readability by 8.4\% over standard RAG and semantic precision by 31.2\% over the next-best prior baseline. Our results show that BinRAG effectively scales to large codebases and significantly reduces manual effort in reverse engineering tasks.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 反编译去符号二进制文件以辅助人工逆向工程师，仍然是软件安全中一项关键但极具挑战性的任务。先前工作已开发出各种神经网络甚至专用大语言模型（LLM），以改进反编译代码中的函数和变量名恢复。然而，仅靠这些方法不足以构建一个通用的基于LLM的反编译流水线，可靠地提升反编译输出的可读性和语义清晰度。本文提出BinRAG，一个基于检索增强生成（RAG）的反编译框架，旨在增强去符号二进制文件的反编译。在名称预测模型的基础上，BinRAG具有三项新颖设计：（1）首先利用名称预测模型将原始反编译输出转换为丰富的、类源代码查询，用于RAG检索；（2）进一步使用一个经过微调的专用LLM，以预测的变量名为条件增强这些查询，从而从精选示例数据库中实现更准确的检索；（3）然后将检索到的示例与目标的调用上下文相结合，采用通用LLM合成高保真、人类可读的反编译代码。在来自真实世界软件仓库的3,200个函数上的评估表明，BinRAG相比标准RAG将可读性提高了8.4%，相比次优先前基线将语义精确度提高了31.2%。我们的结果表明，BinRAG能有效扩展到大型代码库，并显著减少逆向工程任务中的人工工作量。

import_candidates.title: Exploiting Ethereum Rollback Semantics: Profit-Driven Attack Synthesis and Off-Chain Misinterpretation Testing
import_candidates.abstract: The Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) enforces atomic execution through rollback, reverting all state changes when execution fails. While necessary for correctness, rollback semantics introduce a distinct attack surface affecting both on-chain execution and off-chain infrastructures. On-chain, attackers can use conditional failure to filter executions, committing only profitable outcomes while rolling back unprofitable attempts. Off-chain, systems such as explorers, token trackers, and RPC providers may misinterpret aborted executions as successful, leading to inconsistent records or unintended transfers. Existing tools largely treat rollback as an execution endpoint, providing limited support for profit-driven attack synthesis or off-chain misinterpretation testing. To address this gap, we formalize two rollback attack models and develop RollGain, a unified framework for rollback-aware analysis. For on-chain attacks, RollGain models contract structure and value flows, validates candidate executions symbolically, and replays on a forked chain to rank profitability. For off-chain testing, RollGain conducts call tree analysis on 3.08 billion Ethereum transactions to characterize rollback patterns and exercises rollback-inducing execution vectors against external services. On our evaluation datasets, RollGain achieves 95.3\% recall with zero false positives, and uncovers 20 rollback misinterpretation vulnerabilities across 18 off-chain systems, of which 18 have been confirmed, 16 fixed, and 5 assigned CVE identifiers.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 以太坊虚拟机（EVM）通过回滚强制执行原子性执行，当执行失败时回滚所有状态更改。虽然这对于正确性是必要的，但回滚语义引入了一个独特的攻击面，影响链上执行和链下基础设施。在链上，攻击者可以利用条件失败来过滤执行，仅提交有利可图的结果，同时回滚无利可图的尝试。在链下，区块浏览器、代币追踪器和RPC提供商等系统可能将中止的执行误解为成功，导致记录不一致或意外转账。现有工具大多将回滚视为执行终点，对利润驱动的攻击合成或链下误解测试的支持有限。为弥补这一空白，我们形式化了两种回滚攻击模型，并开发了RollGain，一个用于回滚感知分析的统一框架。对于链上攻击，RollGain对合约结构和价值流进行建模，以符号方式验证候选执行，并在分叉链上重放以对盈利能力进行排名。对于链下测试，RollGain对30.8亿笔以太坊交易进行调用树分析，以刻画回滚模式，并针对外部服务测试诱发回滚的执行向量。在我们的评估数据集上，RollGain实现了95.3%的召回率且零误报，并在18个链下系统中发现了20个回滚误解漏洞，其中18个已确认，16个已修复，5个被分配了CVE标识符。

import_candidates.title: Enhancing LLM-Based Bug Reproduction via Code Entity Retrieval and Test Case Repair
import_candidates.abstract: Automated bug reproduction from bug reports is a critical yet challenging step in software debugging. While LLM-based bug reproduction shows promise, its effectiveness is often hampered by insufficient contextual awareness of the relevant codebase and a tendency to produce invalid test cases. To address these limitations, we propose a novel approach, called LTER, that enhances LLM-based bug reproduction through fine-grained code entity retrieval and a feedback-driven dynamic repair loop. LTER first identifies specific code entities within bug reports to automatically extract precise contexts, including class definitions, constructors, and method logic. The extracted contexts are then used to guide the LLM in generating reproduced test cases. To further ensure executability, LTER employs an iterative repair mechanism to resolve complex dependencies. Specifically, upon injecting a generated test case into the project, if a compilation failure occurs, the framework forwards the error messages to the LLM for an initial repair. Should this initial repair fail, it empowers the LLM to analyze diagnostic messages to recognize missing context and retrieve indispensable dependencies, subsequently regenerating the test case with the supplemented data. Finally, LTER employs a hybrid cascade ranking strategy to accurately select the most effective reproduction test case from the generated candidates. The experimental results on the widely-used Defects4J benchmark show that LTER substantially outperforms the best performance in automated bug reproduction, increasing the reproduction success rate to 46.2\% with successfully identifying a valid reproduction test as the top candidate in 38.1\% of the cases. Furthermore, LTER demonstrates strong generalization capability, delivering robust performance on the GHRB dataset containing recent bugs previously unseen by the LLM.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 从缺陷报告中自动复现缺陷是软件调试中关键但具有挑战性的步骤。虽然基于LLM的缺陷复现展现出前景，但其有效性常常受到对相关代码库上下文感知不足以及倾向于生成无效测试用例的阻碍。为解决这些局限，我们提出一种新方法LTER，它通过细粒度代码实体检索和反馈驱动的动态修复循环来增强基于LLM的缺陷复现。LTER首先识别缺陷报告中的特定代码实体，自动提取精确的上下文，包括类定义、构造器和方法逻辑。提取的上下文随后用于指导LLM生成复现测试用例。为进一步确保可执行性，LTER采用迭代修复机制来解决复杂依赖。具体而言，将生成的测试用例注入项目后，如果发生编译失败，框架会将错误消息转发给LLM进行初步修复。若初步修复失败，它使LLM能够分析诊断消息以识别缺失的上下文并检索不可或缺的依赖，随后用补充数据重新生成测试用例。最后，LTER采用混合级联排序策略，从生成的候选中准确选择最有效的复现测试用例。在广泛使用的Defects4J基准上的实验结果表明，LTER在自动缺陷复现方面显著优于最佳性能，将复现成功率提高到46.2%，并在38.1%的案例中成功将有效的复现测试识别为首选候选。此外，LTER展现出强大的泛化能力，在包含LLM此前未见过的近期缺陷的GHRB数据集上提供了稳健的性能。

import_candidates.title: DocPrism: Multi-lingual Detection of Incorrectness Inconsistencies between Code and Documentation
import_candidates.abstract: Code-documentation inconsistencies are common and undesirable: they can lead to developer misunderstandings and software defects. This paper introduces DocPrism, a lightweight multi-language, code-documentation inconsistency detection tool. DocPrism uses a standard large language model (LLM) to analyze and explain inconsistencies, and focuses on outputting incorrectness inconsistencies. Plain use of LLMs for this task yields unacceptably high inconsistency flag rates—i.e., over 90\% of functions are flagged as inconsistent with their documentation. One substantial reason is that LLMs identify natural gaps between high-level documentation and code as incompleteness inconsistencies. We introduce and apply the Local Categorization, External Filtering (LCEF) methodology: LCEF uses an LLM’s local completion skills, rather than its long-term reasoning skills, to focus on reporting incorrectness inconsistencies. In our ablation study, LCEF reduces DocPrism’s inconsistency flag rate from 98\% to 14\%, and increases F1 score from 0.22 to 0.77, compared to standard prompting techniques. On a broad evaluation across Python, TypeScript, C++, and Java, DocPrism maintains a low flag rate of 17\%, and achieves a precision of 0.63 without performing any fine-tuning. We also establish a conservative lower bound across four programming languages, showing that inconsistency errors are present in 11\% of code-documentation pairs. In addition, DocPrism achieves precision comparable to the state-of-the-art on an established synthetic dataset, but substantially outperforms it on our real-world Java dataset in precision (DocPrism: 0.47–0.67 vs. SOTA: 0.05–0.14).
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 代码与文档不一致很常见且不受欢迎：它们可能导致开发者误解和软件缺陷。本文介绍DocPrism，一种轻量级多语言代码-文档不一致检测工具。DocPrism使用标准大型语言模型（LLM）来分析和解释不一致，并专注于输出不正确性不一致。直接使用LLM完成此任务会产生不可接受的高不一致标记率——即超过90%的函数被标记为与其文档不一致。一个主要原因是LLM将高级文档与代码之间的自然差距识别为不完整性不一致。我们引入并应用局部分类、外部过滤（LCEF）方法：LCEF利用LLM的局部补全能力，而非其长期推理能力，以专注于报告不正确性不一致。在我们的消融研究中，与标准提示技术相比，LCEF将DocPrism的不一致标记率从98%降低到14%，并将F1分数从0.22提高到0.77。在跨Python、TypeScript、C++和Java的广泛评估中，DocPrism保持了17%的低标记率，并在没有任何微调的情况下达到了0.63的精确率。我们还建立了跨四种编程语言的保守下界，表明不一致错误存在于11%的代码-文档对中。此外，DocPrism在已建立的合成数据集上达到了与最先进技术相当的精确率，但在我们的真实世界Java数据集上显著优于它（DocPrism: 0.47–0.67 vs. SOTA: 0.05–0.14）。

import_candidates.title: NCFuzz: Configuration-Guided Network Service Fuzzing
import_candidates.abstract: Network services like FTP and DNS are critical components of modern reliable Internet infrastructure. Software fuzzing, especially network protocol fuzzing, is widely used to uncover flaws in these systems. However, conventional fuzzers operate under a single, fixed configuration throughout the fuzzing campaign, leaving the service’s rich configuration space unexplored. Incorporating configurations as a dynamic input dimension is challenging due to complex semantics, trigger conditions, and the resulting enlarged search space. We tackle the problem of finding bugs under non-default configurations, termed ConfBug, by designing a new fuzzer called NCFuzz. The non-default configurations can be uncommon but administrators may enable them, which cannot be exercised by conventional fuzzers. With the assumption that software documentation that describes configuration options is available, NCFuzz leverages two key observations: 1) software documentation contains rich information about configurations; 2) interactions between configuration and network messages can be tracked through code instrumentation and data-flow analysis. Using these insights, NCFuzz uses configuration knowledge and the relationships between configurations and network messages to guide the fuzzer toward new software states. The quality and completeness of the documentation will affect the effectiveness of NCFuzz. Evaluation on six network service implementations shows NCFuzz achieves higher coverage than baseline fuzzers. Five ConfBugs were discovered during fuzzing.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 像FTP和DNS这样的网络服务是现代可靠互联网基础设施的关键组件。软件模糊测试，尤其是网络协议模糊测试，被广泛用于发现这些系统中的缺陷。然而，传统模糊测试器在整个模糊测试过程中在单一固定配置下运行，使服务丰富的配置空间未被探索。将配置作为动态输入维度极具挑战，因为存在复杂语义、触发条件以及由此扩大的搜索空间。我们通过设计一种新的模糊测试器NCFuzz，来解决在非默认配置下发现缺陷的问题，称为ConfBug。非默认配置可能不常见，但管理员可能启用它们，而传统模糊测试器无法覆盖这些配置。假设描述配置选项的软件文档可用，NCFuzz利用两个关键观察：1）软件文档包含丰富的配置信息；2）配置与网络消息之间的交互可以通过代码插桩和数据流分析进行跟踪。利用这些见解，NCFuzz使用配置知识以及配置与网络消息之间的关系来引导模糊测试器走向新的软件状态。文档的质量和完整性会影响NCFuzz的有效性。在六个网络服务实现上的评估表明，NCFuzz比基线模糊测试器实现了更高的覆盖率。在模糊测试过程中发现了五个ConfBug。

import_candidates.title: Re-evaluating Detection of Equivalent Mutants using LLMs: We Should Properly Measure How Far We Are
import_candidates.abstract: Mutation testing is a widely used approach for measuring test-suite quality. A critical problem in mutation testing is equivalent mutant detection (EMD), i.e., determining if a mutant semantically behaves the same as the original code despite some syntactic differences. A recent study has shown that LLM-based EMD techniques hold great promise, reporting substantial improvements over traditional compiler- and machine-learning–based approaches. In this work, we revisit those recent results and evaluate the generalization capabilities of the proposed LLM-based EMD techniques across two additional datasets that differ from the prior dataset in mutation operators, programming languages, or source projects. Contrary to prior findings, the proposed LLM-based EMD techniques suffer substantial performance degradation on the two additional datasets. Through an extensive analysis, we identify a key factor underlying the differences as original-method–level data leakage (i.e., the same original method appearing in both training and testing sets), indicating that prior results under within-method evaluation do not generalize to cross-method evaluation. We find that the studied LLMs tend to rely on a method-wise majority-voting shortcut rather than reasoning about the semantic effects of mutations. Based on these findings, we call for the adoption of realistic cross-method evaluation and the development of mutation-centric semantic reasoning in future LLM-based EMD research.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 变异测试是衡量测试套件质量的一种广泛使用的方法。变异测试中的一个关键问题是等价变异体检测（EMD），即确定某个变异体在语义上是否与原代码行为相同，尽管存在一些句法差异。最近的一项研究表明，基于LLM的EMD技术具有巨大前景，并报告了相对于传统基于编译器和机器学习的方法的显著改进。在本工作中，我们重新审视这些近期结果，并在两个额外数据集上评估所提出的基于LLM的EMD技术的泛化能力，这些数据集在变异算子、编程语言或源项目方面与先前数据集不同。与先前发现相反，所提出的基于LLM的EMD技术在这两个额外数据集上出现显著性能下降。通过广泛分析，我们确定了差异背后的一个关键因素：原始方法级数据泄漏（即同一原始方法同时出现在训练集和测试集中），这表明先前在方法内评估下的结果无法泛化到跨方法评估。我们发现，所研究的LLM倾向于依赖按方法多数投票的捷径，而非推理变异的语义效应。基于这些发现，我们呼吁在未来的基于LLM的EMD研究中采用现实的跨方法评估，并开发以变异为中心的语义推理。

import_candidates.title: CID: Clean-Seed-Free Backdoor Defense via Counterfactual Invariance for Neural Code Models
import_candidates.abstract: Neural code models automate core software engineering tasks such as code classification and generation, but remain vulnerable to backdoor attacks. Existing defenses struggle with both injection-based and Semantically-Equivalent Transformation (SET)-based triggers and often require a trusted, pre-verified in-distribution clean seed set, which can be costly to obtain in third-party fine-tuning. This paper introduces Counterfactual Invariance-based Defense (CID), a clean-seed-free defense requiring no a priori trusted in-distribution clean data and grounded in operational counterfactual invariance tests. CID exploits asymmetric counterfactual behavior: clean predictions tend to degrade under semantic context corruption, whereas backdoor predictions show larger representation drift when shortcut-carrying structures are neutralized. Accordingly, CID applies two orthogonal probes—a contextual intervention for semantic-sufficiency testing and a gradient-guided structural intervention for representation-drift testing—to extract a high-purity clean seed set directly from a mixed dataset. CID then uses these seeds to calibrate representation-space filtering over the full dataset. Across four software engineering tasks, six trigger instantiations, poisoning rates from 1\% to 10\%, multiple model architectures, and multilingual code summarization, CID achieves high poison-detection performance relative to evaluated baselines while keeping false positives low in most settings. Clean-only and selected retraining experiments further show conservative benign-data retention, preserved clean-task utility, and reduced residual attack success rate in challenging Defect Detection settings.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 神经代码模型可以自动化代码分类和生成等核心软件工程任务，但仍然容易受到后门攻击。现有防御难以应对基于注入和基于语义等价变换（SET）的触发器，并且通常需要一个可信、预先验证的同分布干净种子集，而在第三方微调场景中获取这样的种子集可能代价高昂。本文提出基于反事实不变性的防御（CID），这是一种无需干净种子的防御方法，不依赖先验可信的同分布干净数据，并以可操作的反事实不变性测试为基础。CID利用了不对称的反事实行为：干净预测在语义上下文破坏下往往会退化，而后门预测在携带捷径的结构被中和时则表现出更大的表示漂移。据此，CID应用两种正交探针——用于语义充分性测试的上下文干预和用于表示漂移测试的梯度引导结构干预——直接从混合数据集中提取高纯度干净种子集。然后，CID使用这些种子在整个数据集上校准表示空间过滤。在四个软件工程任务、六种触发器实例、1%到10%的投毒率、多种模型架构以及多语言代码摘要上，CID相对于所评估的基线取得了较高的投毒检测性能，同时在大多数设置下保持较低的假阳性。仅干净数据和选择性重训练实验进一步表明，在具有挑战性的缺陷检测设置中，CID能保守地保留良性数据、保持干净任务效用，并降低残余攻击成功率。

import_candidates.title: Provably Lossless Acceleration of DNN Mutation Testing via Memoization
import_candidates.abstract: Mutation analysis has recently reemerged in the context of deep neural networks (DNNs) as a promising, but notoriously costly, approach for assessing test dataset adequacy. Existing techniques speed up DNN mutation testing through lossy approximations that trade efficiency for mutation score accuracy. This paper introduces Mure, the first provably lossless framework for accelerating DNN mutation testing via memoization. Mure is based on the idea that DNN mutants and the original model share substantial redundant computation, so during mutation testing, it executes only the mutated suffixes of each mutant and reuses the common prefix from the original model, which is computed only once. We give a formal account of memoized mutation testing, and prove that Mure is sound, i.e., it produces results equivalent to exhaustive vanilla mutation testing, and identify basic conditions under which speed-up is guaranteed.
