We have implemented Mure and evaluated it on 15 DNN models of various architectures, complexities, and sizes ranging from a few thousands to millions of parameters. This provides empirical evidence that Mure reduces the computational cost of mutation testing by 44.54\%, on average. We also observed that while state-of-the-art techniques tend to yield higher acceleration (up to 88.97\%, on average), they come at the cost of some error in mutation score. We further analyze the effect of mutation generation selection ratio on the effectiveness of Mure and observed predictable reductions in memoization opportunities with increasing the percentage of mutated neurons. We observed that Mure offers more than 20\% speed-up even when as high as 5\% of the neurons are mutated.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 变异分析最近在深度神经网络（DNN）背景下重新兴起，作为一种有前景但以高成本著称的评估测试数据集充分性的方法。现有技术通过有损近似来加速DNN变异测试，以效率换取变异得分准确性。本文提出Mure，这是首个通过记忆化实现DNN变异测试可证明无损加速的框架。Mure基于以下思想：DNN变异体与原始模型共享大量冗余计算，因此在变异测试期间，它只执行每个变异体的变异后缀，并复用原始模型计算一次的共同前缀。我们给出了记忆化变异测试的形式化描述，并证明Mure是可靠的，即其产生的结果等价于穷举的普通变异测试，同时识别了保证加速的基本条件。我们实现了Mure，并在15个不同架构、复杂度和规模的DNN模型上进行了评估，参数从几千到数百万不等。这提供了经验证据，表明Mure将变异测试的计算成本平均降低44.54%。我们还观察到，虽然最先进的技术往往能带来更高的加速（平均高达88.97%），但它们以变异得分存在一定误差为代价。我们进一步分析了变异生成选择比例对Mure有效性的影响，并观察到随着变异神经元百分比的增加，记忆化机会出现可预测的减少。我们观察到，即使高达5%的神经元被变异，Mure也能提供超过20%的加速。

import_candidates.title: Profiling-Guided Bayesian Optimization of JVM Configurations
import_candidates.abstract: Regression testing is essential for maintaining software quality but often incurs substantial time costs. While regression testing time can often be reduced by selectively running fewer tests, prior work has demonstrated that tuning Java Virtual Machine (JVM) configuration flags can also reduce testing time in Java projects, even while running all tests and preserving original testing outcomes. However, finding effective flag combinations remains challenging due to the vast configuration space and complex interactions between flags. Random search and direct modeling approaches that map flag configurations to testing time have shown limited effectiveness in navigating this complex optimization landscape. We present PROBO (PROfiling-Guided Bayesian Optimization), an iterative approach that leverages JVM runtime metrics (e.g., garbage collection frequency, just-in-time (JIT) compilation rates, and memory allocation) to guide Bayesian optimization for testing time reduction. Unlike prior work using Bayesian inference that directly models the relationship from flag configurations to testing time, PROBO decomposes the prediction problem through observable runtime behaviors: a metrics model predicts how flag configurations affect runtime metrics, and a performance model predicts how those metrics affect testing time. PROBO collects 44 runtime metrics using a profiler during test execution, and propagates feature importance scores through both models to identify which flags most strongly influence testing time-predictive metrics. Finally, PROBO generates candidate flag configurations through three complementary strategies guided by expected testing time improvement. We evaluate PROBO on 16 open-source Java projects, comparing against random search and BOCA (a Bayesian optimization baseline). PROBO achieves an average testing time reduction of 10.7\% across all projects when evaluating 20 configurations per project, outperforming random search (5.8\%) by 1.85{\texttimes} and BOCA (4.3\%) by 2.49{\texttimes}. PROBO successfully generates configurations that substantially reduce testing time for all 16 projects, with reductions ranging up to 27.4\%. With a one-hour time budget for search, PROBO maintains its advantage with 8.0\% average reduction, demonstrating practical applicability. PROBO-generated configurations remain effective across software evolution, maintaining 8.8\% average reduction over an average of 88 future commits per project. Our analysis reveals that metrics related to JIT compilation, particularly Total Compilation Rate (methods compiled per second) and C1 Compilation Rate (first-tier JIT compilation rate), are the strongest predictors of testing time, accounting for 67.2\% of consistently important metrics across projects.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 回归测试对于维护软件质量至关重要，但通常会产生大量时间成本。虽然回归测试时间通常可以通过选择性地运行更少的测试来减少，但先前的工作表明，调整Java虚拟机（JVM）配置标志也可以减少Java项目中的测试时间，即使运行所有测试并保持原始测试结果。然而，由于庞大的配置空间和标志之间复杂的相互作用，找到有效的标志组合仍然具有挑战性。将标志配置映射到测试时间的随机搜索和直接建模方法在导航这一复杂优化景观方面效果有限。我们提出了PROBO（PROfiling-Guided Bayesian Optimization），一种迭代方法，利用JVM运行时指标（例如垃圾回收频率、即时（JIT）编译率和内存分配）来指导贝叶斯优化以减少测试时间。与使用贝叶斯推理直接建模从标志配置到测试时间关系的先前工作不同，PROBO通过可观察的运行时行为分解预测问题：一个指标模型预测标志配置如何影响运行时指标，一个性能模型预测这些指标如何影响测试时间。PROBO在测试执行期间使用分析器收集44个运行时指标，并通过两个模型传播特征重要性分数，以识别哪些标志对测试时间预测指标影响最大。最后，PROBO通过三种互补策略生成候选标志配置，这些策略由预期测试时间改进指导。我们在16个开源Java项目上评估PROBO，与随机搜索和BOCA（贝叶斯优化基线）进行比较。当每个项目评估20种配置时，PROBO在所有项目上平均减少测试时间10.7%，比随机搜索（5.8%）高出1.85倍，比BOCA（4.3%）高出2.49倍。PROBO成功为所有16个项目生成配置，大幅减少测试时间，减少幅度最高达27.4%。在搜索时间为1小时的预算下，PROBO保持优势，平均减少8.0%，展示了实际适用性。PROBO生成的配置在软件演化过程中仍然有效，在平均每个项目88个未来提交中保持8.8%的平均减少。我们的分析表明，与JIT编译相关的指标，特别是总编译率（每秒编译的方法数）和C1编译率（第一层JIT编译率），是测试时间的最强预测因子，在所有项目中占持续重要指标的67.2%。

import_candidates.title: Understanding and Improving Model Editing for Secure Code Generation
import_candidates.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used for code generation but may reproduce vulnerabilities learned from insecure training data. Prior work mainly relies on inference-time hardening, which introduces auxiliary components and runtime overhead. We present the first systematic study of model editing as a model-level hardening mechanism for secure code generation, directly injecting security knowledge through localized parameter updates. We evaluate three state-of-the-art editing methods across diverse LLM families against CoSec, a representative inference-time approach, examining security effectiveness and robustness, generalization to unseen vulnerabilities, and functional correctness. Model editing substantially outperforms CoSec on seen vulnerabilities, improving security ratios by 15
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）被广泛用于代码生成，但可能重现从非安全训练数据中学到的漏洞。先前的工作主要依赖推理时加固，这会引入辅助组件和运行时开销。我们首次对模型编辑作为安全代码生成的模型级加固机制进行了系统性研究，通过局部参数更新直接注入安全知识。我们针对代表性的推理时方法CoSec，跨多种LLM系列评估了三种最先进的编辑方法，考察安全有效性和鲁棒性、对未见漏洞的泛化能力以及功能正确性。在已见过的漏洞上，模型编辑显著优于CoSec，将安全比率提高了15

import_candidates.title: Multi-stage On-Demand Program Slicing for Modular Analysis of Multi-threaded Programs
import_candidates.abstract: Precise analysis of multi-threaded programs requires combining flow-sensitive pointer analysis (FSPTA) with interleaving and lock analysis (ILA) to reason about cross-thread value flows under feasible concurrent executions. ILA computes may-happen-in-parallel (MHP) relations and lock-release spans to determine when shared accesses can occur concurrently. Unfortunately, these analyses are both expensive and tightly coupled: FSPTA needs ILA to rule out infeasible inter-thread def-use relations, while ILA needs alias information to identify interference-relevant interactions. As a result, whole-program analyses often spend most of their time on code that is irrelevant to the client query. We present MSli, an on-demand slicing framework for modular analysis of multi-threaded programs. It extracts compact, query-relevant program slices while preserving the answers of downstream analyses. Unlike single-pass slicing over a unified dependence graph, MSliperforms multi-stage slicing with analysis-specific criteria. Concretely, a lightweight pre-analysis establishes an over-approximation of inter-thread value flows and performs ILA slicing source extraction to identify the MHP and lock-span queries required later for ILA slicing. The refined main-phase ILA results then enable reconstruction of a thread-aware value-flow graph to guide FSPTA slicing, supporting modular analysis and downstream clients. We implement MSliin SVF and evaluate it on ten large real-world projects with data race detection as a representative client. Compared with the unsliced baseline (FSAM), MSlireduces the analyzed ICFG to 5.4\% (ILA) and 25.7\% (FSPTA), reduces ILA/FSPTA runtimes to 4.7\%/18.3\%, and cuts total analysis time to 20.8\% on average, while producing identical query outcomes and race alarms.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 多线程程序的精确分析需要结合流敏感指针分析（FSPTA）与交错和锁分析（ILA），以在可行的并发执行下推理跨线程的值流。ILA计算可能并行发生（MHP）关系和锁释放区间，以确定共享访问何时可能并发发生。不幸的是，这些分析既昂贵又紧密耦合：FSPTA需要ILA来排除不可行的线程间定义-使用关系，而ILA需要别名信息来识别与干扰相关的交互。因此，全程序分析通常将大部分时间花在与客户端查询无关的代码上。我们提出MSli，一个用于多线程程序模块化分析的按需切片框架。它提取紧凑的、与查询相关的程序切片，同时保留下游分析的答案。与在统一依赖图上进行单遍切片不同，MSli使用特定于分析的标准执行多阶段切片。具体而言，一个轻量级预分析建立线程间值流的过近似，并执行ILA切片源提取，以识别稍后ILA切片所需的MHP和锁区间查询。精化后的主阶段ILA结果随后支持重建线程感知的值流图，以指导FSPTA切片，从而支持模块化分析和下游客户端。我们在SVF中实现了MSli，并在十个大型真实世界项目上以数据竞争检测作为代表性客户端进行评估。与未切片的基线（FSAM）相比，MSli将被分析的ICFG减少到5.4%（ILA）和25.7%（FSPTA），将ILA/FSPTA运行时间减少到4.7%/18.3%，并将总分析时间平均削减到20.8%，同时产生相同的查询结果和竞争警报。

import_candidates.title: ProgSCA: Software Composition Analysis via Program-Level Modeling
import_candidates.abstract: Software composition analysis (SCA) aims to identify third-party dependencies in programs, which plays a critical role in ensuring software supply chain security. Existing approaches largely follow a rule-based paradigm: they first compute function-level similarities, then aggregate these results using handcrafted heuristics to determine which third-party libraries (TPLs) the target program depends on. However, such rules require substantial manual effort and expert knowledge to design, tune, and maintain. To address this, we present ProgSCA, an SCA framework based on a two-stage strategy and program-level rather than function-level modeling. ProgSCA formulates SCA as a retrieval problem, first employing lightweight methods to quickly filter out irrelevant libraries from numerous candidate TPLs, then using a model trained at the program level to directly predict dependency between programs. Comprehensive evaluations show that ProgSCA achieves state-of-the-art performance in SCA tasks, improving F1 scores over existing methods by 174\% and 100\% in two mainstream scenarios, respectively. Moreover, ProgSCA maintains a consistent advantage across different datasets and different candidate pool scales, and also proves effective in the downstream task of function similarity matching, further demonstrating the practical value of our approach.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 软件成分分析（SCA）旨在识别程序中的第三方依赖，对保障软件供应链安全起着关键作用。现有方法大多遵循基于规则的范式：先计算函数级相似度，再使用手工设计的启发式规则聚合结果，以判断目标程序依赖哪些第三方库（TPL）。然而，此类规则需要大量人工投入和专家知识来设计、调优和维护。为解决这一问题，我们提出 ProgSCA，一个基于两阶段策略并以程序级而非函数级建模的 SCA 框架。ProgSCA 将 SCA 形式化为检索问题，首先采用轻量级方法从大量候选 TPL 中快速过滤掉无关库，然后使用在程序级训练的模型直接预测程序之间的依赖关系。综合评估表明，ProgSCA 在 SCA 任务上达到当前最优性能，在两个主流场景中分别将 F1 分数较现有方法提升 174% 和 100%。此外，ProgSCA 在不同数据集和不同候选池规模下均保持一致优势，并在函数相似度匹配的下游任务中也被证明有效，进一步证明了我们方法的实用价值。

import_candidates.title: SmartDecompiler-R1: Enhancing Faithful and Explainable Smart Contract Bytecode Decompilation with Reinforcement Learning
import_candidates.abstract: Understanding EVM bytecode is critical for smart contract security analysis. Existing decompilers typically rely on heuristic rules or leverage large language models (LLMs) to generate source code after bytecode analysis. However, heuristic-based approaches often produce pseudocode that is difficult for humans to interpret, while LLM-based methods also face several problems. LLMs have little experience with low-level bytecode, which weakens their reasoning and causes inaccurate results. Additionally, their tendency to auto-correct code breaks faithfulness to the original program. A general lack of clarity in these approaches also hinders effective auditing and interpretation. In this paper, we propose SmartDecompiler-R1, an end-to-end decompilation framework that translates Three-Address Code (TAC), a register-based representation of EVM bytecode, into source code using reinforcement learning. SmartDecompiler-R1 significantly improves both the accuracy and consistency of decompiled code, while additionally providing human-readable explanations for the bytecode-to-source generation process. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to design a benchmark equipped with well-defined test cases and a systematic evaluation framework for smart contract decompilation. Experimental results on this benchmark demonstrate that SmartDecompiler-R1 substantially outperforms existing decompilers on execution consistency by 46.23\%. In particular, compared with LLM-based approaches, SmartDecompiler-R1 achieves a significant improvement in preserving vulnerability consistency between the original and decompiled contracts. Furthermore, we conduct extensive ablation studies to validate the effectiveness of individual components of SmartDecompiler-R1, and design targeted experiments to demonstrate the interpretability and readability of the generated explanations.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 理解EVM字节码对于智能合约安全分析至关重要。现有的反编译器通常依赖启发式规则，或利用大语言模型（LLM）在字节码分析后生成源代码。然而，基于启发式的方法往往产生难以被人理解的伪代码，而基于LLM的方法也面临若干问题。LLM对底层字节码经验很少，这削弱了其推理能力并导致结果不准确。此外，它们自动纠正代码的倾向破坏了与原始程序的忠实性。这些方法普遍缺乏清晰性也阻碍了有效的审计和解释。在本文中，我们提出了SmartDecompiler-R1，一种端到端反编译框架，它使用强化学习将三地址码（TAC）——EVM字节码的一种基于寄存器的表示——转换为源代码。SmartDecompiler-R1显著提高了反编译代码的准确性和一致性，同时还为字节码到源代码的生成过程提供了人类可读的解释。据我们所知，我们是第一个为智能合约反编译设计带有明确定义测试用例和系统评估框架的基准。在此基准上的实验结果表明，SmartDecompiler-R1在执行一致性上显著优于现有反编译器46.23%。特别是，与基于LLM的方法相比，SmartDecompiler-R1在保持原始合约与反编译合约之间的漏洞一致性方面取得了显著改进。此外，我们进行了广泛的消融研究以验证SmartDecompiler-R1各个组件的有效性，并设计了针对性实验来展示所生成解释的可解释性和可读性。

import_candidates.title: Revisiting Graph Representations for ML-Based Binary Code Similarity Detection: A Systematic Study
import_candidates.abstract: Binary Code Similarity Detection (BCSD) is a foundational capability in software security, underpinning critical applications ranging from vulnerability detection to malware analysis. While recent tools based on Machine Learning (ML) have achieved significant performance improvements, their efficacy is heavily contingent upon the underlying code representation. Through a systematic literature review of ML-based BCSD papers, we find that existing approaches typically leverage linear sequences or adopt graph-based representations, with the latter constituting the majority (77\%). Despite this prevalence, there is no consensus on which graph representation yields superior effectiveness. Existing works usually couple graph construction with customized learning backbones and evaluate them on inconsistent benchmarks. This makes isolating the representation's impact difficult. Consequently, determining which graph topologies most effectively capture robust binary-code semantics under controlled and comparable evaluation settings remains an open problem. In this paper, we present a systematic study of graph representations for ML-based BCSD to bridge this gap. Specifically, we implement a modular evaluation framework that decouples graph construction from model training. Using this framework, we systematically evaluate seven representative graph representations, finding that no single representation is universally dominant, that distinct topologies exhibit unique strengths depending on the evaluation scenario, and that their rankings are largely backbone-stable despite varying absolute performance. We further investigate their combination effectiveness in N-day vulnerability detection and employ a tailored post-hoc analysis tool to study model-level structural reliance. The results show that DFG, PDG, and SOG subgraph pairs more often preserve trained models' similarity scores under pruning, while several other representations are more sensitive to structural reduction.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 二进制代码相似性检测（BCSD）是软件安全中的一项基础能力，支撑着从漏洞检测到恶意软件分析等关键应用。尽管近期基于机器学习（ML）的工具取得了显著的性能提升，但其有效性在很大程度上取决于底层的代码表示。通过对基于ML的BCSD论文进行系统性文献综述，我们发现现有方法通常利用线性序列或采用基于图的表示，后者占大多数（77%）。尽管基于图的表示如此普遍，但关于哪种图表示能产生更优效果，尚无共识。现有工作通常将图构建与定制的学习骨干网络耦合在一起，并在不一致的基准上进行评估。这使得难以孤立地衡量表示的影响。因此，在受控且可比较的评估设置下，确定哪些图拓扑能最有效地捕获稳健的二进制代码语义，仍然是一个开放问题。在本文中，我们提出了一项针对基于ML的BCSD的图表示的系统性研究，以弥补这一空白。具体而言，我们实现了一个模块化评估框架，将图构建与模型训练解耦。利用该框架，我们系统性地评估了七种具有代表性的图表示，发现没有一种表示具有普遍优势，不同拓扑根据评估场景展现出独特优势，并且尽管绝对性能有所变化，它们的排名在很大程度上对骨干网络保持稳定。我们进一步研究了它们在N日漏洞检测中的组合有效性，并采用定制的事后分析工具来研究模型层面的结构依赖性。结果表明，DFG、PDG和SOG子图对在修剪下更常保持训练模型的相似性分数，而其他几种表示对结构削减更为敏感。

import_candidates.title: SEDCoT: Enhancing LLM-Based COBOL Code Translation via Symbolic Execution and Delta Debugging
import_candidates.abstract: COBOL remains critical across banking, insurance, and government infrastructure. However, maintenance is increasingly challenging due to outdated technologies, sparse documentation, and developer retirement, necessitating code translation into modern languages like C. Traditional rule-based transcompilers yield outputs that are difficult to read and maintain, while general-purpose large language models (LLMs) achieve suboptimal correctness because COBOL is a low-resource language with distinct logic patterns. To bridge this gap, we propose SEDCoT, a novel COBOL-to-C translation framework. SEDCoT first leverages LLMs for initial translation, then combines symbolic execution with LLM guidance to generate test suites and iteratively repair semantic discrepancies. Finally, it integrates delta debugging to minimize failing tests into succinct counterexamples, accelerating automated code repair. Evaluating SEDCoT on a public COBOL-to-C dataset demonstrates that it outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by at least 12\% while producing translations with substantially higher readability than rule-based alternatives.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在银行、保险和政府基础设施中，COBOL仍然至关重要。然而，由于技术过时、文档稀少和开发者退休，维护日益困难，需要将代码翻译成C等现代语言。传统的基于规则的转译器生成的输出难以阅读和维护，而通用大语言模型（LLM）的正确性欠佳，因为COBOL是一种低资源语言，具有独特的逻辑模式。为弥补这一差距，我们提出SEDCoT，一种新颖的COBOL到C翻译框架。SEDCoT首先利用LLM进行初始翻译，然后结合符号执行与LLM引导来生成测试套件，并迭代修复语义差异。最后，它集成增量调试（delta debugging），将失败测试最小化为简洁的反例，从而加速自动代码修复。在公开的COBOL到C数据集上评估SEDCoT表明，它比最先进的基线至少高出12%，同时生成的翻译比基于规则的替代方案具有显著更高的可读性。

import_candidates.title: ConUT: Condition-Aware Test Generation for Complex Java Code
import_candidates.abstract: Automatically generating high-coverage unit tests for complex Java methods remains a formidable challenge, particularly when execution paths are guarded by intricate control-flow nesting and cross-class state dependencies. Existing LLM-based approaches predominantly follow a goal-driven paradigm, relying on unguided code synthesis within a vast search space to satisfy coverage objectives. Lacking explicit guidance on how to construct the precise object states required for complex predicates, these methods suffer from a construction-reachability gap, ultimately resulting in insufficient coverage for complex methods. This paper introduces ConUT, a condition-aware unit test generation framework centered on the paradigm of Configuration-Driven Guidance, which is a strategy that bridges the gap between abstract branch targets and concrete code realization by providing the LLM with structured instantiation recipes. Our core insight is that the implicit causal chain leading to a target branch can be explicitly manifested via static analysis and distilled into structured guidance. ConUT utilizes Backward Dependency Tracing (BDT) to identify the fields and method calls that influence predicates, and distills these findings into structured Configuration Templates (Ccfg). These templates serve as a “semantic roadmap,” pruning the LLM’s search space and transitioning it from a stochastic generator into a guided logic realizer. We evaluate ConUT on eight real-world Java projects characterized by high-complexity “logic hotspots.” Experimental results demonstrate that ConUT outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving an average branch coverage of 72.84\% and line coverage of 83.87\%. Notably, ConUT exceeds the best baseline in average branch coverage by 11.94 percentage points while utilizing 67\% fewer test cases.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 为复杂Java方法自动生成高覆盖率单元测试仍然是一项艰巨挑战，尤其当执行路径受到复杂控制流嵌套和跨类状态依赖的约束时。现有基于LLM的方法主要遵循目标驱动范式，依赖在巨大搜索空间中进行无引导的代码合成以满足覆盖率目标。由于缺乏关于如何构造复杂谓词所需精确对象状态的显式指导，这些方法面临构造-可达性鸿沟，最终导致复杂方法的覆盖率不足。本文提出ConUT，一个以配置驱动引导范式为中心的条件感知单元测试生成框架；该策略通过为LLM提供结构化的实例化配方，弥合抽象分支目标与具体代码实现之间的差距。我们的核心洞见是，通向目标分支的隐式因果链可以通过静态分析显式呈现，并提炼为结构化指导。ConUT利用反向依赖追踪（BDT）识别影响谓词的字段和方法调用，并将这些发现提炼为结构化配置模板（Ccfg）。这些模板充当“语义路线图”，剪枝LLM的搜索空间，使其从随机生成器转变为有引导的逻辑实现器。我们在八个以高复杂度“逻辑热点”为特征的现实Java项目上评估ConUT。实验结果表明，ConUT优于最先进的基线，平均分支覆盖率达到72.84%，行覆盖率达到83.87%。值得注意的是，ConUT在平均分支覆盖率上超过最佳基线11.94个百分点，同时使用的测试用例减少了67%。

import_candidates.title: Testing Method Relocation Algorithms via Template-Based Systematic Structural Traversal and Precondition Filtering
import_candidates.abstract: Method relocation refactorings, primarily Move Method and Pull Up/Push Down Method, are indispensable for reducing coupling and enhancing cohesion. Despite their widespread automation in modern refactoring engines, these algorithms remain notoriously error-prone, posing significant risks to software reliability. A primary challenge in testing them lies in the vast search space of complex program structures and the intricate preconditions required for safe method relocation. To address this, we propose RelocTest, a comprehensive testing framework that combines template-driven structural traversal with automated precondition filtering. RelocTest systematically explores the input space by populating program templates specially designed for method relocation through a two-stage generation process: (1) Skeleton Synthesis, which systematically traverses diverse syntactic structures, and (2) LLM-Guided Completion, which leverages Large Language Models to inject diverse, executable code into these skeletons. This hybrid strategy ensures high structural coverage while maintaining test program validity. Furthermore, to optimize testing efficiency, we introduce an LLM-based Precondition Extractor that analyzes the implementation of method relocation algorithms to identify and prune test programs destined for rejection. We evaluated RelocTest on 7 mainstream refactoring engines. Our approach successfully uncovered 56 previously unknown bugs, with 19 already confirmed by tool vendors, demonstrating its effectiveness in hardening industrial-strength refactoring tools.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 方法重定位重构，主要是移动方法和上移/下移方法，对于降低耦合和提高内聚性不可或缺。尽管在现代重构引擎中广泛自动化，这些算法仍然众所周知地容易出错，对软件可靠性构成重大风险。测试它们的一个主要挑战在于复杂程序结构的巨大搜索空间以及安全方法重定位所需的复杂前置条件。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了RelocTest，一个综合测试框架，结合了模板驱动的结构遍历和自动前置条件过滤。RelocTest通过两阶段生成过程填充专门为方法重定位设计的程序模板，系统地探索输入空间：(1) 骨架合成，系统地遍历多样化的语法结构；(2) LLM引导的补全，利用大型语言模型向这些骨架注入多样化、可执行的代码。这种混合策略确保了高结构覆盖率，同时保持测试程序的有效性。此外，为了优化测试效率，我们引入了一个基于LLM的前置条件提取器，它分析方法重定位算法的实现，以识别并修剪注定被拒绝的测试程序。我们在7个主流重构引擎上评估了RelocTest。我们的方法成功发现了56个先前未知的缺陷，其中19个已被工具供应商确认，证明了其在强化工业级重构工具方面的有效性。

import_candidates.title: E2WR: An Effective and Efficient Reduction Framework for WebAssembly Binaries
import_candidates.abstract: WebAssembly (Wasm) is a prominent programming language enabling high-performance execution across diverse computing environments. However, bugs in Wasm runtimes, which execute Wasm binaries, can lead to severe security breaches and system failures. Manually debugging Wasm binaries that trigger such runtime bugs is exceedingly difficult due to their poor human readability, stemming from low-level stack-based instructions, complex control flow structures, and extraordinary length. Thus, there is a critical need for automated reduction techniques that minimize Wasm binaries while preserving the ability to trigger the original bug. However, existing reducers often suffer from significant limitations in effectiveness and efficiency: language-agnostic reducers frequently generate invalid variants without Wasm validation awareness, while Wasm-specific reducers still lack efficient intra-function instruction-sequence reduction and reduce definitions inefficiently. To address these challenges, we propose E2WR, an effective and efficient reduction framework for Wasm binaries. E2WR introduces a two-stage approach for intra-function instruction-sequence reduction, consisting of operand-dependency guided instruction reduction and combination-aware redundancy elimination to enable efficient delta debugging while avoiding unnecessary padding instructions, and a definition reduction approach that combines static analysis with delta-debugging-guided trials to remove property-irrelevant definitions efficiently. Compared with Wasm-Shrink and Wasm-Reduce, E2WR produces binaries that are 95.0\% and 68.6\% smaller, respectively, and achieves reduction speedups of 7.9{\texttimes}–12.4{\texttimes}.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: WebAssembly（Wasm）是一种突出的编程语言，可在多种计算环境中实现高性能执行。然而，执行 Wasm 二进制文件的 Wasm 运行时中的漏洞可能导致严重的安全漏洞和系统故障。手动调试触发此类运行时漏洞的 Wasm 二进制文件极其困难，因为其可读性差，这源于低级基于栈的指令、复杂的控制流结构以及超常的长度。因此，迫切需要自动化缩减技术，在保留触发原始漏洞能力的同时最小化 Wasm 二进制文件。然而，现有缩减器通常在有效性和效率方面存在显著局限：语言无关的缩减器常常生成未经 Wasm 验证感知的无效变体，而 Wasm 特定的缩减器仍然缺乏高效的函数内指令序列缩减，并且缩减定义效率低下。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 E2WR，一种有效且高效的 Wasm 二进制缩减框架。E2WR 引入了一个两阶段的函数内指令序列缩减方法，包括操作数依赖引导的指令缩减和组合感知的冗余消除，以在避免不必要填充指令的同时实现高效的 delta 调试，以及一种定义缩减方法，将静态分析与 delta 调试引导的试验相结合，以高效移除与性质无关的定义。与 Wasm-Shrink 和 Wasm-Reduce 相比，E2WR 产生的二进制文件分别小 95.0% 和 68.6%，并实现了 7.9 倍至 12.4 倍的缩减加速。

import_candidates.title: LogNexus: Effective Log Compression via Unified Redundancy Encoding
import_candidates.abstract: State-of-the-art log compressors typically rely on a decoupled “parse-then-compress” workflow, where parsing is optimized for semantic accuracy (i.e., event identification) rather than storage efficiency. Through a comprehensive empirical study, we reveal that this architectural decoupling prevents the exploitation of deep correlations between static templates and dynamic variables. To address it, we propose LogNexus based on the principle of unified redundancy encoding, a new log compression paradigm that co-designs structural extraction and variable encoding. LogNexus constructs a Unified Redundancy Tree (URT) using a hierarchical strategy that progressively mines frequent “structure+variable” patterns in logs. Such a design captures deep contextual redundancies ignored by traditional methods while minimizing computational overhead by pre-emptively encoding dominant patterns. Extensive evaluation on 16 benchmark datasets demonstrates that LogNexus establishes a new state-of-the-art. It achieves the highest compression ratio on 14 datasets (outperforming baselines by 9.48\%–89.13\%) and the fastest speed (1.51{\texttimes}–40.06{\texttimes} faster than competitors). Furthermore, when configured in non-chunked mode to maximize global pattern discovery, LogNexus boosts its compression ratio by 285.13\%, which is 27.08\% higher than the best baseline, while retaining a 2.43{\texttimes} speed advantage. The decompression audit further shows that LogNexus successfully restores every token on all 16 datasets.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 最先进的日志压缩器通常依赖于解耦的“先解析后压缩”工作流，其中解析针对语义准确性（即事件识别）而非存储效率进行优化。通过全面的实证研究，我们揭示了这种架构解耦阻碍了对静态模板和动态变量之间深层相关性的利用。为解决此问题，我们提出了基于统一冗余编码原理的LogNexus，一种新的日志压缩范式，它协同设计结构提取和变量编码。LogNexus使用分层策略构建统一冗余树（URT），逐步挖掘日志中频繁的“结构+变量”模式。这种设计捕获了传统方法忽略的深层上下文冗余，同时通过预先编码主导模式来最小化计算开销。在16个基准数据集上的大量评估表明，LogNexus确立了新的最先进水平。它在14个数据集上实现了最高压缩率（比基线高出9.48%–89.13%）和最快速度（比竞争者快1.51–40.06倍）。此外，当配置为非分块模式以最大化全局模式发现时，LogNexus将其压缩率提高了285.13%，比最佳基线高27.08%，同时保持2.43倍的速度优势。解压审计进一步表明，LogNexus成功恢复了所有16个数据集上的每个令牌。

import_candidates.title: Paired Code Smells and Test Smells: A Fine-Grained Longitudinal Empirical Study
import_candidates.abstract: As software systems grow in complexity, ensuring maintainability is essential, but often hindered by various quality issues. Among them, code smells and test smells are widely recognized indicators of technical debt that degrade system quality. While production code and test suites are intrinsically coupled and evolve together, existing research predominantly studies code smells and test smells in isolation, ignoring their underlying connection over time. To bridge this gap, this paper presents a fine-grained longitudinal study on the co-evolutionary dynamics of "paired smells", which refer to cases where code and test smells exist concurrently in linked production and test code. By analyzing 128,417 commits across 19 long-lived open-source Java repositories, we investigate the statistical associations, survival lifespans, and removal motivations of these paired flaws. As a result, we identify 30 statistically significant rules where specific test smells imply the presence of underlying production code smells and our survival analysis reveals that in most repositories, paired smells have relatively shorter lifespans than unpaired ones. To explain this phenomenon, our manual inspection reveals that paired smells often signal deeper structural issues, prompting explicit risk-driven refactoring. Finally, we discuss the implications of these results for code quality analysis and continuous integration tools, suggesting that they should link related smell findings between production and test code and guide synchronized refactoring.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着软件系统复杂性增加，确保可维护性至关重要，但常常受到各种质量问题的阻碍。其中，代码异味和测试异味是被广泛认可的技术债务指标，会降低系统质量。虽然生产代码和测试套件本质上是耦合的并且共同演化，但现有研究主要孤立地研究代码异味和测试异味，忽视了它们随时间推移的潜在联系。为弥补这一空白，本文对“成对异味”的协同演化动态进行了细粒度纵向研究，其中成对异味指在相关联的生产代码和测试代码中同时存在代码异味和测试异味的情况。通过分析19个长期开源Java仓库中的128,417次提交，我们研究了这些成对缺陷的统计关联、生存寿命和移除动机。结果，我们识别出30条统计显著的规则，其中特定的测试异味暗示存在底层的生产代码异味；我们的生存分析揭示，在大多数仓库中，成对异味的寿命相对短于非成对异味。为解释这一现象，我们的手动检查发现，成对异味往往标志着更深层的结构问题，促使以风险为驱动的显式重构。最后，我们讨论了这些结果对代码质量分析和持续集成工具的意义，建议它们应关联生产代码和测试代码中相关的异味发现，并指导同步重构。

import_candidates.title: Fixed-Point Guided ADS Scenario Generation via Multi-modal LLM Reasoning and Software Testing
import_candidates.abstract: Robust scenario generation is essential for systematically testing Autonomous Driving Systems (ADSs) under rare and safety-critical conditions. However, search-based approaches often lack semantic guidance, whereas specification-based approaches rely heavily on manually constructed rules. Existing LLM-assisted techniques primarily translate accident artifacts into scene descriptions without producing executable behavioral specifications that guide subsequent testing. We present InvarGen, a framework that uses a multi-modal LLM as a parametric specification generator. InvarGen organizes safety requirements into a predefined taxonomy of Scenario Fixed Points while dynamically instantiating their predicates, thresholds, and temporal bounds from each accident context. These fixed points serve as executable test oracles and optimization objectives. Unlike static templates, these fixed points adaptively constrain the search space, guiding a hybrid evolutionary process: Intelligent Fuzzing exploits boundary parameters to trigger specific violations, while Structural Mutation ensures the global exploration of diverse environmental contexts. Evaluation using 200 real-world accidents and 1,400 synthesized scenarios shows that InvarGen discovers 37.8\% more critical scenario types than the best baseline, achieves a 30\% fixed-point violation rate, and achieves the highest semantic-diversity score. The scenarios also achieve high physical plausibility and cross-simulator executability, with 100\% syntactic compliance with the evaluated OpenX formats. These results highlight the promise of fixed-point semantics as a principled bridge between unstructured LLM reasoning and rigorous robustness testing.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 鲁棒场景生成对于在罕见且安全攸关的条件下系统性地测试自动驾驶系统（ADS）至关重要。然而，基于搜索的方法往往缺乏语义引导，而基于规约的方法则严重依赖人工构造的规则。现有的LLM辅助技术主要将事故资料转化为场景描述，而没有产生可执行的行为规格来指导后续测试。我们提出InvarGen，一个使用多模态LLM作为参数化规格生成器的框架。InvarGen将安全需求组织到预定义的场景不动点分类体系中，同时根据每个事故上下文动态实例化其谓词、阈值和时间边界。这些不动点充当可执行的测试预言和优化目标。与静态模板不同，这些不动点自适应地约束搜索空间，引导一种混合进化过程：智能模糊测试利用边界参数触发特定违规，而结构变异确保对不同环境上下文的全局探索。使用200个真实世界事故和1,400个合成场景的评估表明，InvarGen发现的关键场景类型比最佳基线多37.8%，达到30%的不动点违反率，并获得最高的语义多样性得分。这些场景还实现了高物理合理性和跨模拟器可执行性，对评估的OpenX格式具有100%的语法合规性。这些结果突显了不动点语义作为非结构化LLM推理与严格鲁棒性测试之间原则性桥梁的前景。

import_candidates.title: ARQ: A Mixed-Precision Quantization Framework for Accurate and Certifiably Robust DNNs
import_candidates.abstract: Mixed precision quantization has become an important technique for optimizing the execution of deep neural networks (DNNs). Certified robustness, which provides provable guarantees about a model’s ability to withstand different adversarial perturbations, has rarely been addressed in quantization due to the unacceptably high cost of certifying robustness. This paper introduces ARQ, an innovative mixed-precision quantization method that not only preserves the clean accuracy of the smoothed classifiers, but also maintains their certified robustness. ARQ uses reinforcement learning to find accurate and robust DNN quantization, while efficiently leveraging randomized smoothing, a popular class of statistical DNN verification algorithms. ARQ consistently performs better than multiple state-of-the-art quantization techniques across all the benchmarks and the input perturbation levels. The performance of ARQ quantized networks reaches that of the original DNN with floating-point weights, while using only 1.5\% instructions and the highest certified radius. ARQ’s code is available at https://github.com/uiuc-arc/ARQ.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 混合精度量化已成为优化深度神经网络（DNN）执行的一项重要技术。可认证鲁棒性提供了关于模型抵御不同对抗扰动能力的可证明保证，但由于认证鲁棒性的成本高得令人无法接受，量化中很少涉及这一问题。本文提出ARQ，一种创新的混合精度量化方法，不仅能保持平滑分类器的干净准确率，还能维持其可认证鲁棒性。ARQ使用强化学习来寻找准确且鲁棒的DNN量化，同时高效利用随机平滑——一类流行的统计DNN验证算法。在所有基准和输入扰动水平上，ARQ始终优于多种最先进的量化技术。ARQ量化网络的性能达到具有浮点权重的原始DNN的水平，同时仅使用1.5%的指令并具有最高的认证半径。ARQ的代码见 https://github.com/uiuc-arc/ARQ。

import_candidates.title: Red-Teaming Coding Agents from a Tool-Invocation Perspective: An Empirical Security Assessment
import_candidates.abstract: Coding agents powered by large language models are becoming central modules of modern IDEs. They help users to perform various complex coding tasks by invoking tools. Although powerful, tool-invocation operation in coding agents opens a substantial attack surface for adversaries. Prior work has demonstrated attacks against both general-purpose LLM agents and domain-specific agents. However, to our knowledge, no previous works focus on the security risks of tool-invocation in coding agents. To fill this gap, we conduct the first systematic, in-depth red-teaming from a tool-invocation perspective in six popular real-world coding agents: Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Windsurf, Cline, and Trae. Our red-teaming proceeds in two phases. In Phase 1, we conduct a prompt leakage as reconnaissance to recover system prompts and related context. Specifically, we identify a mode gap between chat generation and tool-call argument generation: during schema-driven argument completion, the model behaves as if it is performing benign structured filling and may copy hidden agent context into tool-call arguments. We instantiate this gap as ToolLeak, which exfiltrates agent-internal prompts (e.g., system prompts and tool metadata) via required tool parameters. In Phase 2, we hijack the tool-invocation behavior of the coding agent with a novel two-channel prompt injection in the tool description and the tool return. Our hijacking achieves remote code execution (RCE) on major real-world coding agents. We adaptively construct the malicious payload using leaked security information in Phase 1. Our evaluation shows that ToolLeak substantially outperforms strong prompt-leak baselines in both emulated and real-world settings. In the emulated setting, ToolLeak achieves the best overall prompt-exfiltration performance across all six simulated coding agents. On real-world coding agents, ToolLeak achieves the best pseudo-recall on 18 of 25 evaluated agent-LLM pairs. Furthermore, our red-teaming successfully hijacks all six real-world coding agents for RCE and consistently yields higher attack success rates than baseline attacks. Lastly, we present two case studies on Cursor and Claude Code to demonstrate the real-world impact of our red-teaming.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 由大型语言模型驱动的编码代理正在成为现代IDE的核心模块。它们通过调用工具来帮助用户执行各种复杂的编码任务。尽管功能强大，但编码代理中的工具调用操作给对手开辟了巨大的攻击面。已有工作已经展示了对通用LLM代理和特定领域代理的攻击。然而，据我们所知，此前没有工作关注编码代理中工具调用的安全风险。为了填补这一空白，我们从工具调用视角对六个流行的真实世界编码代理进行了首次系统、深入的红队测试：Cursor、Claude Code、Copilot、Windsurf、Cline和Trae。我们的红队测试分两个阶段进行。在第一阶段，我们进行提示泄漏作为侦察，以恢复系统提示和相关上下文。具体而言，我们识别出聊天生成与工具调用参数生成之间存在一种模式差距：在模式驱动的参数补全过程中，模型表现得好像在进行良性的结构化填充，并可能将隐藏的代理上下文复制到工具调用参数中。我们将这一差距实例化为ToolLeak，它通过必需的工具参数泄露代理内部提示（例如系统提示和工具元数据）。在第二阶段，我们通过一种新颖的双通道提示注入在工具描述和工具返回中劫持编码代理的工具调用行为。我们的劫持在主要的真实世界编码代理上实现了远程代码执行（RCE）。我们利用第一阶段泄露的安全信息自适应地构造恶意载荷。我们的评估表明，ToolLeak在模拟和真实世界设置中都显著优于强大的提示泄漏基线。在模拟设置中，ToolLeak在六个模拟编码代理上取得了最佳的整体提示泄露性能。在真实世界编码代理上，ToolLeak在25个评估的代理-LLM对中的18个上取得了最佳伪召回率。此外，我们的红队测试成功劫持了所有六个真实世界编码代理以实现RCE，并且始终比基线攻击产生更高的攻击成功率。最后，我们在Cursor和Claude Code上展示了两个案例研究，以证明我们红队测试的真实世界影响。

import_candidates.title: How Safe Is Your Screen? Understanding and Detecting Privacy Leaks in Sensitive Activities
import_candidates.abstract: Android apps handle sensitive data, often displayed on screens (i.e., Activities), and protecting these activities is vital for ensuring user privacy. Several studies have demonstrated the risk of private data leakage via screen capture and identified malware exploiting this vulnerability. To mitigate such threats, Google introduced FLAG_SECURE, an activity-level security feature that protects an Activity when set by blocking screen capture and restricting display on non-secure devices. Proper usage of this security feature could significantly reduce data leakage risks. However, to the best of our knowledge, its adoption across diverse Android apps has not been systematically studied. In this work, we present a large-scale empirical study of screenshot-based vulnerabilities in Android apps using a systematic static analysis pipeline, ASSA. The pipeline automatically constructs UI models of activities and fragments by leveraging a customized version of Frontmatter, and combines them with a Large Language Model (LLM) to infer runtime context and identify sensitive user data rendered on screens. We apply ASSA to 5,667 popular real-world Android apps and find that 19.8\% contain at least one activity that displays sensitive information without screen-capture protection, while 87.2\% of apps do not apply FLAG_SECURE to any activity, exposing credentials, financial information, and location data to screenshot attacks. Beyond quantifying prevalence, we analyze FLAG_SECURE usage patterns and establish a taxonomy that captures diverse factors influencing developers’ decisions to adopt or omit screen protection, including intentional privacy protection, intellectual property safeguarding, and unintentional inheritance from base activities. To assess real-world impact, we further conduct in-depth case studies on 200 vulnerable apps and responsibly disclose our findings to the affected vendors, receiving 6 confirmed patches and 20 acknowledgments, including 11 vendors who reported ongoing efforts toward mitigation. These findings indicate that screenshot-based vulnerabilities are not only widespread but also systematically overlooked in practice, highlighting the need for greater awareness and more careful handling of sensitive on-screen information by developers.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Android应用处理敏感数据，并经常将其显示在屏幕（即Activity）上，保护这些Activity对于确保用户隐私至关重要。若干研究已经证明了通过屏幕截图造成隐私数据泄露的风险，并识别了利用此漏洞的恶意软件。为缓解此类威胁，Google引入了FLAG_SECURE，这是一种Activity级安全功能，设置后可保护Activity，阻止屏幕截图并限制在非安全设备上的显示。正确使用此安全功能可以显著降低数据泄露风险。然而，据我们所知，其在各种Android应用中的采用情况尚未被系统研究。在这项工作中，我们使用系统化静态分析流水线ASSA，对Android应用中的截图漏洞进行了大规模实证研究。该流水线通过利用定制版Frontmatter自动构建Activity和Fragment的UI模型，并将其与大语言模型（LLM）结合以推断运行时上下文并识别屏幕上渲染的敏感用户数据。我们将ASSA应用于5,667个流行的真实世界Android应用，发现19.8%至少包含一个显示敏感信息且未受屏幕截图保护的Activity，而87.2%的应用未对任何Activity应用FLAG_SECURE，从而将凭据、财务信息和位置数据暴露于截图攻击。除了量化普遍性外，我们还分析了FLAG_SECURE的使用模式，并建立了一个分类法，涵盖影响开发者采用或省略屏幕保护决策的多种因素，包括有意的隐私保护、知识产权保护以及无意间从基类Activity继承。为评估真实世界影响，我们进一步对200个易受攻击的应用进行了深入案例研究，并负责任地向受影响厂商披露我们的发现，获得6个已确认补丁和20个致谢，其中包括11家报告正在努力缓解的厂商。这些发现表明，基于截图的漏洞不仅广泛存在，而且在实践中被系统性地忽视，凸显了开发者需要提高意识并更谨慎地处理屏幕上的敏感信息。

import_candidates.title: Cracking Query Bottlenecks: Towards Efficiency-Oriented Text-to-SQL Generation
import_candidates.abstract: Text-to-SQL models translate natural language questions into SQL, enabling non-technical users to access databases. However, most existing research focuses on correctness, neglecting query efficiency. In this paper, we address the challenge of evaluating the execution efficiency of generated SQL in Text-to-SQL by introducing EESQLBench, a novel benchmark designed to assess both correctness and efficiency. EESQLBench pairs each natural language question with an expert-optimized SQL query, providing a reliable efficiency baseline. We evaluate six representative large language models (LLMs), including four open-source models (SQLCoder, CodeLlama, DeepSeek-Coder, and DeepSeek-R1) and two closed-source models (GPT-5.2 and Gemini-2.5-Pro), using cost-based metrics including Cost Reachability (CR) and Acceptable Reachability at kk (AR@kk). Our results reveal that current LLMs, despite achieving high correctness, struggle to produce efficient queries. We observe substantial efficiency gaps between models and emphasize that semantic correctness alone does not guarantee query efficiency. Furthermore, we provide insights into common inefficiency patterns in LLM-generated SQL queries, such as missing access pruning and inefficient subquery logic.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Text-to-SQL模型将自然语言问题翻译为SQL，使非技术用户能够访问数据库。然而，大多数现有研究关注正确性，而忽视了查询效率。在本文中，我们通过引入EESQLBench——一个旨在评估正确性和效率的新基准——来应对Text-to-SQL中评估生成SQL执行效率的挑战。EESQLBench为每个自然语言问题配对一个专家优化的SQL查询，从而提供可靠的效率基线。我们使用包括成本可达性（CR）和可接受可达性@k（AR@k）在内的基于成本的指标，评估了六个具有代表性的大语言模型（LLM），包括四个开源模型（SQLCoder、CodeLlama、DeepSeek-Coder和DeepSeek-R1）以及两个闭源模型（GPT-5.2和Gemini-2.5-Pro）。我们的结果表明，当前LLM虽然实现了高正确性，却难以生成高效的查询。我们观察到模型之间存在显著的效率差距，并强调仅凭语义正确性并不能保证查询效率。此外，我们还深入分析了LLM生成SQL查询中常见低效模式，例如缺少访问剪枝和低效的子查询逻辑。

import_candidates.title: Lingxi: Repository-Level Issue Resolution Framework Enhanced by Procedural Knowledge Guided Scaling
import_candidates.abstract: Driven by the advancements of Large Language Models (LLMs), LLM-powered agents are making significant improvements in software engineering tasks, yet struggle with complex, repository-level issue resolution. Existing agent-based methods have two key limitations. First, they lack of procedural knowledge (i.e., how an issue is fixed step-by-step and rationales behind it) to learn and leverage for issue resolution. Second, they rely on massive computational power to blindly explore the solution space. To address those limitations, we propose Lingxi, an issue resolution framework that leverages procedural knowledge extracted from historical issue-fixing data to guide agents in solving repository-level issues. Lingxi first constructs this knowledge offline through a hierarchical abstraction mechanism, enabling agents to learn the how and why behind a fix, not just the final solution. During online application, it employs a knowledge-driven scaling method that leverages the procedural knowledge of similar issues to intelligently analyze the target issue from multiple perspectives, in sharp contrast to undirected, brute-force exploration.Lingxi successfully resolves 74.6\% of bugs on the SWE-bench Verified benchmark in Pass@1 setting, outperforming five state-of-the-art techniques by a significant margin (5.4\% to 14.9\%). Our comprehensive ablation study confirmed that the success of Lingxi comes directly from its use of procedural knowledge. Without it, the performance gains from scaling alone is negligible. Our qualitative study further shows that the “design patterns \& coding practices” is the most critical knowledge aspect, and that the roles of different knowledge aspects switch across different stages (i.e., analysis, planning, and fixing).
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在大语言模型（LLM）进步的推动下，由LLM驱动的智能体在软件工程任务上取得了显著改进，但在复杂的仓库级问题解决上仍步履维艰。现有的基于智能体的方法有两个关键局限。第一，它们缺乏过程知识（即一个问题如何逐步修复以及其背后的理由）来学习和利用以解决问题。第二，它们依赖巨大的计算能力盲目探索解空间。为了解决这些局限，我们提出了Lingxi，一个利用从历史问题修复数据中提取的过程知识来指导智能体解决仓库级问题的框架。Lingxi首先通过分层抽象机制离线构建这种知识，使智能体能够学习修复背后的方法和原因，而不仅仅是最终解决方案。在在线应用时，它采用一种知识驱动的扩展方法，利用相似问题的过程知识从多个角度智能分析目标问题，这与无向的蛮力探索形成鲜明对比。Lingxi在SWE-bench Verified基准上以Pass@1设置成功解决了74.6%的bug，显著优于五种最先进技术（5.4%到14.9%）。我们全面的消融研究证实，Lingxi的成功直接来自其对过程知识的使用。没有它，仅靠扩展带来的性能提升可以忽略不计。我们的定性研究进一步表明，“设计模式与编码实践”是最关键的知识方面，并且不同知识方面的作用在不同阶段（即分析、规划和修复）之间会发生转换。

import_candidates.title: Characterizing Real-World Bugs in Tile Programs for Automated Bug Detection
import_candidates.abstract: Tile-based programming frameworks are increasingly adopted to write high-performance GPU kernels in domains such as deep learning and scientific computing. While these frameworks enhance productivity and hardware utilization, their multi-stage compilation pipelines introduce distinct code generation bugs that are tightly coupled to input shapes, data types, and backend targets. These bugs often manifest as silent wrong results or performance issues, making them difficult to detect using existing compiler testing tools. Additionally, the unique programming conventions of tile domain-specific languages complicate root cause identification, while fixing such bugs demands specialized knowledge of tile abstractions and compilation pipelines. Despite the growing adoption of tile-based systems, their code generation bugs remain largely unexplored. This paper presents the first systematic study of tile-program code generation bugs. We curate 401 bug reports from GitHub and identify 301 tile-program codegen bugs for analysis, characterizing their root causes and symptoms, the input patterns that trigger them, the test oracles that detect them, and the strategies for fixing these bugs. Our study provides foundational insights for building debugging, testing, and repair tools tailored to tile-based compiler infrastructures.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 基于Tile的编程框架正越来越多地被用于在深度学习和科学计算等领域编写高性能GPU内核。虽然这些框架提高了生产力和硬件利用率，但其多阶段编译流水线引入了独特的代码生成缺陷，这些缺陷与输入形状、数据类型和后端目标紧密耦合。这些缺陷通常表现为静默的错误结果或性能问题，使其难以用现有的编译器测试工具检测。此外，Tile领域特定语言的独特编程约定使根因识别复杂化，而修复此类缺陷需要关于Tile抽象和编译流水线的专业知识。尽管基于Tile的系统日益普及，其代码生成缺陷在很大程度上仍未得到探索。本文首次对Tile程序代码生成缺陷进行了系统研究。我们从GitHub收集了401份缺陷报告，并识别出301个Tile程序代码生成缺陷进行分析，刻画了它们的根因和症状、触发它们的输入模式、检测它们的测试预言，以及修复这些缺陷的策略。我们的研究为构建面向基于Tile的编译器基础设施的调试、测试和修复工具提供了基础性见解。

import_candidates.title: Automated Program Repair for UI-Centric Android Bugs: How Far Are We?
import_candidates.abstract: Substantial research effort has been devoted to developing techniques for automated program repair (APR) that suggest patches for localized buggy code -- and more recent techniques have begun to leverage the capabilities of code-centric large language models (LLMs). However, the scope and diversity of bugs to which these techniques have historically been applied are limited. In particular, the research community currently lacks a comprehensive understanding of the performance of APR techniques on bugs that arise in UI-centric programs, such as mobile apps. Bugs in UI centric programs carry with them unique challenges, including (i) the need to reason across interconnected subroutines that connect presentation and program logic, (ii) event-driven programming paradigms, and (iii) the need to reason about program state through cues in the UI. In this paper, we investigate the effectiveness of existing APR techniques when applied to fix bugs in UI-centric programs - specifically Android applications. To explore this phenomenon, we conduct a comprehensive empirical study with five existing program repair techniques (including those that utilize LLMs) on a hybrid dataset including 46 synthetic bugs, generated via MDroid+, an Android-specific mutation tool, and 50 real bugs systematically mined from issue reports of 23 popular Android applications. Our findings illustrate important current limitations in resolving UI-related issues in mobile apps. We synthesize these results to form a taxonomy of the limitations of existing program repair techniques. This taxonomy outlines key limitations and can inform future research efforts in designing automated program repair tools for UI-centric bugs in mobile applications.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大量研究工作致力于开发自动程序修复（APR）技术，为局部有缺陷的代码提出补丁——最近的技术已开始利用以代码为中心的大语言模型（LLM）的能力。然而，这些技术历史上所适用的缺陷范围和多样性是有限的。特别是，研究界目前缺乏对APR技术在以UI为中心的程序（如移动应用）中出现的缺陷上的性能的全面理解。以UI为中心的程序中的缺陷带来独特挑战，包括（i）需要跨连接呈现与程序逻辑的相互关联子程序进行推理，（ii）事件驱动编程范式，以及（iii）需要通过UI中的线索推理程序状态。本文研究现有APR技术应用于修复以UI为中心的程序（特别是Android应用）中的缺陷时的有效性。为探索这一现象，我们在一个混合数据集上对五种现有程序修复技术（包括利用LLM的技术）进行了全面的实证研究，该数据集包含通过MDroid+（一种Android专用变异工具）生成的46个合成缺陷，以及从23个流行Android应用的问题报告中系统挖掘出的50个真实缺陷。我们的发现说明了当前在解决移动应用中UI相关问题方面的重要局限。我们综合这些结果，形成了现有程序修复技术局限性的分类法。该分类法概述了关键局限性，并可为未来设计面向移动应用中以UI为中心缺陷的自动程序修复工具的研究工作提供参考。

import_candidates.title: EventSpec: Defining and Detecting Event-Semantic Issues in Blockchain Ecosystems
import_candidates.abstract: In recent years, smart contracts have become the backbone of decentralized applications (DApps), and off-chain systems such as bridges, wallets, and indexers rely heavily on event logs to track contract execution and state changes. However, the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) does not validate or enforce event semantics, so logs can diverge from on-chain state, misleading off-chain systems into accepting incorrect state transitions. Existing smart contract vulnerability detection tools focus on logic bugs, with limited support for detecting event-semantic defects. To address this gap, we collect audit reports and incident cases and apply open card sorting to define five classes of event-semantic defects: event collision, state-event mismatch, unauthorized event emission, event emission mismatch, and event parameter mismatch. We propose EventSpec, which infers event specifications from a contract corpus via behavior inference and semantic-constraint extraction and applies differential checking to identify event-semantic defects in target contracts. We run EventSpec on 6,617 real-world contracts and evaluate detection effectiveness based on manually labeled results; EventSpec achieves an overall comprehensive precision of 90.17\%. We further provide an off-chain evaluation harness that reproduces two off-chain attack vectors on any EVM-compatible chain: event origin confusion caused by unintended emitters and event–state desynchronization where events lack matching state updates. Using this harness, we demonstrate the feasibility of these attacks on bridge relayers, blockchain explorers, and NFT marketplaces, and report six wallet issues, four of which were confirmed (including a $600 bounty), with two remaining pending.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 近年来，智能合约已成为去中心化应用（DApps）的支柱，而桥、钱包和索引器等链下系统严重依赖事件日志来跟踪合约执行和状态变化。然而，以太坊虚拟机（EVM）并不验证或强制执行事件语义，因此日志可能与链上状态不一致，从而误导链下系统接受不正确的状态转换。现有的智能合约漏洞检测工具侧重于逻辑错误，对检测事件语义缺陷的支持有限。为弥补这一空白，我们收集审计报告和事件案例，并应用开放式卡片分类来定义五类事件语义缺陷：事件冲突、状态-事件不匹配、未授权事件发出、事件发出不匹配和事件参数不匹配。我们提出EventSpec，它通过行为推断和语义约束提取从合约语料库中推断事件规范，并应用差分检查来识别目标合约中的事件语义缺陷。我们在6,617个真实世界合约上运行EventSpec，并基于人工标注结果评估检测效果；EventSpec的总体综合精确率达到90.17%。我们进一步提供一个链下评估框架，可在任何EVM兼容链上复现两种链下攻击向量：由非预期发出者引起的事件来源混淆，以及事件缺乏匹配状态更新的事件-状态不同步。使用该框架，我们演示了这些攻击在桥接中继器、区块链浏览器和NFT市场上的可行性，并报告了六个钱包问题，其中四个已确认（包括600美元赏金），两个待处理。

import_candidates.title: avaCGs: Version-Aware Call Graphs for Efficient Version-Range Queries
import_candidates.abstract: Developers employ version ranges to specify a range of valid versions for software libraries their projects depend on. While this can yield benefits like automatic adoption of library updates, it complicates method reachability analysis: a sound whole-program analysis must consider method invocations of every library release within that range. Such releases might themselves introduce transitive ranged dependencies to a project, leading to a combinatorial blow-up in the number of configurations to analyze. If developers wanted to soundly determine whether a critical method might be reachable via a ranged library dependency, they would have to build the individual call graphs for every release within that range, and perform reachability analysis on each one of them. As call-graph construction is an expensive operation, this approach is rarely practical. To enable direct version-range queries, we introduce artifact version-aware call graphs (avaCGs) that comprise call graph information about all versions of a software artifact in a single graph structure. Further, we propose a novel approach that incrementally computes call graphs based on Rapid Type Analysis (RTA), implement it for the JVM platform, and show that it yields identical results to full RTA call-graph builds. Our evaluation shows that on our benchmarks, avaCGs can improve the performance of reachability queries by up to 9.58x, while our incremental construction is up to 79\% faster compared to full builds for each release. We also observe that for real-world libraries hosted on Maven Central, almost 80\% of all releases do not change the RTA call graph compared to their previous release, further justifying the use of incremental approaches.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 开发者使用版本范围来指定其项目所依赖的软件库的一系列有效版本。虽然这可以带来诸如自动采用库更新等好处，但它使方法可达性分析变得复杂：一个可靠的全程序分析必须考虑该范围内每个库发行版的方法调用。这些发行版本身可能给项目引入传递性的范围依赖，导致需要分析的配置数量组合爆炸。如果开发者想要可靠地确定某个关键方法是否可能通过一个范围库依赖可达，他们必须为该范围内的每个发行版分别构建调用图，并对每个调用图执行可达性分析。由于调用图构建是一项昂贵的操作，这种方法很少实用。为了实现直接的版本范围查询，我们引入了工件版本感知调用图（avaCGs），它在单一图结构中包含关于某个软件工件所有版本的调用图信息。此外，我们提出了一种基于快速类型分析（RTA）增量计算调用图的新方法，在JVM平台上实现，并证明其产生与完整RTA调用图构建相同的结果。我们的评估表明，在我们的基准测试中，avaCGs可以将可达性查询的性能提升高达9.58倍，而我们增量构建与为每个发行版进行完整构建相比最高可快79%。我们还观察到，对于Maven Central上的真实世界库，几乎80%的发行版与上一发行版相比不改变RTA调用图，这进一步证明了使用增量方法的合理性。

import_candidates.title: What Makes In-Context Examples Effective for Code Generation?
import_candidates.abstract: In-Context Learning (ICL) has emerged as a promising solution to enhance the code generation capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) by incorporating code examples inside the prompt to let LLMs learn from demonstrations. However, despite their effectiveness gains, it remains unclear which specific properties of ICL-provided code examples (e.g., solution insight, essential contextual information, identifier naming styles, code formatting) drive these gains. This paper systematically investigates the impact of different sources and internal features of code examples on ICL for code generation through controlled experiments on contest-style programming questions and repository-level tasks. Our results show that while LLMs struggle to extract generalizable problem-solving insights from provided solutions to similar questions or repository snippets, their retrieval-augmented ICL performance can significantly benefit from explicit contextual information, such as input/output demonstrations, required helper functions, and namespace information. Through targeted mutation operators, we further find that identifier naming is substantially more critical than code formatting or low-level implementation details, with the elimination of descriptive variable names causing performance drops of up to 30 percentage points. Finally, we demonstrate that LLMs significantly prefer semantically meaningful identifier names and that adherence to surface-level naming conventions is far less important than semantic clarity. These findings provide practical guidelines for constructing effective ICL code examples and highlight challenges in reflection-based learning for code generation.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 上下文学习（ICL）已成为增强大型语言模型（LLMs）代码生成能力的一种有前景的解决方案，其方法是在提示中嵌入代码示例，让LLMs从演示中学习。然而，尽管取得了有效性提升，但ICL提供的代码示例的哪些具体属性（例如，解题思路、必要的上下文信息、标识符命名风格、代码格式）驱动了这些提升，仍不清楚。本文通过在竞赛式编程问题和仓库级任务上进行受控实验，系统性地研究了代码示例的不同来源和内部特征对代码生成中ICL的影响。我们的结果表明，虽然LLMs难以从相似问题或仓库片段提供的解决方案中提取可泛化的解题思路，但它们的检索增强ICL性能可以显著受益于显式的上下文信息，例如输入/输出演示、所需的辅助函数和命名空间信息。通过针对性的变异算子，我们进一步发现标识符命名比代码格式或底层实现细节重要得多，消除描述性变量名会导致性能下降高达30个百分点。最后，我们证明LLMs显著偏好语义上有意义的标识符名称，并且遵循表面命名约定远不如语义清晰重要。这些发现为构建有效的ICL代码示例提供了实践指南，并突显了基于反思的学习在代码生成中的挑战。

import_candidates.title: Code-MUE: Measuring Code LLMs’ Uncertainty through Execution-Based Semantic Interaction Graphs
import_candidates.abstract: As Code Large Language Models (LLMs) become central to modern software engineering, their inherent stochasticity poses significant real-world risks, where even minor errors can lead to severe functional, security, or safety consequences. Reliable automation, therefore, demands the ability to distinguish between confident, well-supported predictions and stochastic guessing. However, existing uncertainty estimation methods face a critical gap: white-box and grey-box techniques are often inapplicable to closed-source models, while standard black-box text metrics fail to capture the unique fragility of code, where syntactic variation does not necessarily imply semantic divergence. To bridge this syntax-semantics gap, we introduce Code-MUE, a purely black-box framework that measures uncertainty through execution-based Semantic Interaction Graphs. Unlike prior approaches that rely on superficial textual similarity, Code-MUE grounds uncertainty in observable runtime behavior and calculates the von Neumann entropy of the solution space to quantify global semantic diversity. A large-scale empirical study across eight state-of-the-art LLMs demonstrates that Code-MUE achieves a strong negative correlation with functional correctness, with Spearman’s correlation reaching up to −0.98. It significantly outperforms lexical and embedding-based baselines while enabling robust risk detection and selective prediction in practical workflows.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着代码大语言模型（LLMs）成为现代软件工程的核心，其固有的随机性带来了重大的现实风险，即使微小的错误也可能导致严重的功能、安全或安全性后果。因此，可靠的自动化需要能够区分自信且有充分支持的预测与随机猜测。然而，现有的不确定性估计方法面临一个关键缺口：白盒和灰盒技术往往不适用于闭源模型，而标准的黑盒文本指标无法捕捉代码特有的脆弱性，即句法变化并不一定意味着语义分歧。为弥合这一句法-语义鸿沟，我们提出Code-MUE，一个纯黑盒框架，通过基于执行的语义交互图来测量不确定性。与依赖表面文本相似性的先前方法不同，Code-MUE将不确定性建立在可观察的运行时行为之上，并计算解空间的冯·诺依曼熵以量化全局语义多样性。对八个最先进LLM的大规模实证研究表明，Code-MUE与功能正确性呈强负相关，Spearman相关系数最高达-0.98。它显著优于基于词汇和嵌入的基线，同时在实际工作流中实现稳健的风险检测和选择性预测。

import_candidates.title: RICE: Harnessing LLMs and Historical Issues to Discover Internal Rust Compiler Errors
import_candidates.abstract: Rust is a modern system-level programming language that emphasizes safety, concurrency, and performance. Ensuring the reliability of the Rust compiler is critical, as undetected compiler defects, particularly internal compiler errors (ICEs), can lead to runtime crashes or undefined behavior in system software. Existing compiler testing methods, including generation-based, mutation-based, and recent LLM-driven approaches, are limited in their ability to systematically uncover ICEs triggered by advanced language features or complex code interactions. In this paper, we propose RICE, an LLM-assisted Rust compiler testing framework that generates test cases by adapting defect-prone patterns extracted from historical ICE issues to diverse code contexts in the official test suite. RICE features simplification-guided identification of defect-prone patterns and context- aware adaptation of patterns to maintain compilability and meaningful semantic interactions. Applied to multiple recent Rust compiler releases, RICE discovered 37 ICEs, including 15 previously unknown zero-day bugs, outperforming existing testing tools in code coverage and ICE discovery. Our results demonstrate that systematically leveraging historical defect-prone patterns enables more effective testing, accelerates bug fixing, and enhances regression testing in Rust compilers
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Rust是一门现代系统级编程语言，强调安全性、并发性和性能。确保Rust编译器的可靠性至关重要，因为未被发现的编译器缺陷，特别是内部编译器错误（ICE），可能导致系统软件在运行时崩溃或出现未定义行为。现有的编译器测试方法，包括基于生成、基于变异以及近期由LLM驱动的方法，在系统性地发现由高级语言特性或复杂代码交互触发的ICE方面能力有限。本文提出RICE，一个LLM辅助的Rust编译器测试框架，它通过将从历史ICE问题中提取的易缺陷模式适配到官方测试套件中的多样代码上下文来生成测试用例。RICE具有简化引导的易缺陷模式识别和上下文感知的模式适配，以保持可编译性和有意义的语义交互。在多个近期Rust编译器版本上应用后，RICE发现了37个ICE，其中包括15个此前未知的零日缺陷，在代码覆盖率和ICE发现方面优于现有测试工具。我们的结果表明，系统性地利用历史易缺陷模式能够实现更有效的测试，加速错误修复，并增强Rust编译器的回归测试。

import_candidates.title: Efficient Predictive Monitoring of Message Passing Interface Programs
import_candidates.abstract: The Message Passing Interface (MPI) is the standard programming model for high-performance computing, yet nondeterministic scheduling in concurrent executions makes reliability assurance highly challenging. Beyond deadlocks, property-related bugs such as modifying a send buffer before a nonblocking send completes or accessing a freed RMA window are often hard to reproduce and validate, as they typically manifest only under rare event interleavings and can be both latent and catastrophic. Existing dynamic checkers usually cover only the observed schedule of a single execution; dynamic verification largely focuses on deadlocks; and static techniques scale poorly to medium-to-large programs, often timing out or running out of memory. Overall, existing techniques do not support scalable analysis of temporal properties in large MPI programs. To address these limitations, we propose the first efficient predictive monitoring approach for temporal properties in MPI programs. From a single execution, we collect an event trace and use trace equivalence to predict the set of legal equivalent executions under the same input. We then check whether any predicted execution satisfies the target property. To make this process sound, we formalize three correctness criteria for MPI trace reordering and enforce them through MPI-semantics-driven dependency extraction, tracked with vector clocks. To improve efficiency, we exploit the bounded length of a pattern language and reduce long-trace reordering to reordering short patterns. We implement our approach in MPI-PRV, instantiate ten representative MPI bug properties, and evaluate it on 13 real-world MPI applications with 38 configurations. MPI-PRV successfully and correctly analyzes all 38 tasks, whereas MPI-SV and MUST analyze only 14 and 11 tasks, respectively. MPI-PRV also achieves orders-of-magnitude reductions in runtime and memory usage, demonstrating strong efficiency and scalability for large MPI programs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 消息传递接口（MPI）是高性能计算的标准编程模型，但并发执行中的非确定性调度使得可靠性保证极具挑战性。除了死锁之外，与性质相关的错误——例如在非阻塞发送完成之前修改发送缓冲区，或访问已释放的RMA窗口——通常难以复现和验证，因为它们通常只在罕见的事件交错下出现，并且可能既是潜在的又是灾难性的。现有的动态检查器通常只覆盖单次执行中观察到的调度；动态验证主要关注死锁；而静态技术难以扩展到中大型程序，常常超时或内存不足。总体而言，现有技术不支持对大型MPI程序中的时序性质进行可扩展分析。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了首个针对MPI程序中时序性质的高效预测性监控方法。我们从单次执行中收集事件迹，并利用迹等价来预测相同输入下合法的等价执行集合。然后我们检查任何预测执行是否满足目标性质。为了使该过程可靠，我们形式化了MPI迹重排序的三个正确性准则，并通过MPI语义驱动的依赖提取来强制执行它们，使用向量时钟进行跟踪。为了提高效率，我们利用了模式语言的有界长度，并将长迹重排序归约为短模式重排序。我们在MPI-PRV中实现了我们的方法，实例化了十个代表性的MPI错误性质，并在13个真实世界MPI应用（38种配置）上进行了评估。MPI-PRV成功且正确地分析了全部38个任务，而MPI-SV和MUST分别只分析了14个和11个任务。MPI-PRV还实现了运行时和内存使用数量级的减少，展示了针对大型MPI程序的强大效率和可扩展性。

import_candidates.title: Contamination Means Overestimation? A Fine-Grained Empirical Study in Code Intelligence
import_candidates.abstract: In recent years, code intelligence has gained increasing importance in the field of automated software engineering. Meanwhile, the widespread adoption of Pretrained Language Models (PLMs) and Large Language Models (LLMs) has raised concerns regarding data contamination and its potential impact on model performance evaluation. Previous studies mainly focused on sample-level contamination, ignoring partial contamination scenarios that are pervasive in code intelligence. This paper fills this gap and presents a systematic empirical study to investigate the fine-grained data contamination on mainstream code tasks. Our study involves diverse representative PLMs: RoBERTa and GPT-2, and LLMs: LLaMA and StarCoder, covering three major tasks: code translation, code generation, and code summarization, across two Programming Languages (PLs): Java and Python. We categorize contamination scenarios into four types according to the code intelligence practice, namely input-only, output-only, unpaired, and paired contamination settings, and construct corresponding experimental and control groups for exploration. Experimental results show that, under the pre-training, fine-tuning, and inference paradigm adopted by PLMs, even deliberately injecting paired contamination does not lead to significant performance overestimation. But direct inference or small-scale fine-tuning uncovers the contamination effects. In contrast, LLMs with pre-training and inference paradigm are significantly affected by the paired contamination. Apart from the above, other contamination scenarios have no impact on both PLMs and LLMs. Our findings challenge the conventional belief that contamination inevitably leads to performance overestimation, providing new insights into the evaluation and deployment of code intelligence models.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 近年来，代码智能在自动化软件工程领域日益重要。与此同时，预训练语言模型（PLMs）和大语言模型（LLMs）的广泛采用引发了人们对数据污染及其对模型性能评估潜在影响的担忧。以往研究主要关注样本级污染，忽略了代码智能中普遍存在的部分污染场景。本文填补这一空白，开展了一项系统性实证研究，以探究主流代码任务中的细粒度数据污染。我们的研究涉及多种代表性PLMs：RoBERTa和GPT-2，以及LLMs：LLaMA和StarCoder，涵盖三项主要任务：代码翻译、代码生成和代码摘要，覆盖两种编程语言（PLs）：Java和Python。我们根据代码智能实践将污染场景分为四类，即仅输入、仅输出、未配对和配对污染设置，并构建相应的实验组和对照组进行探索。实验结果表明，在PLMs采用的预训练、微调和推理范式下，即使故意注入配对污染也不会导致显著的性能高估。但直接推理或小规模微调会揭示污染效应。相反，采用预训练和推理范式的LLMs则受到配对污染的显著影响。除此之外，其他污染场景对PLMs和LLMs均无影响。我们的发现挑战了污染必然导致性能高估的传统观念，为代码智能模型的评估和部署提供了新见解。

import_candidates.title: A Closer Look at the Use of Reinforcement Learning for Speeding Up Runtime Verification of Software Tests (Experience Paper)
import_candidates.abstract: Runtime verification (RV) found many bugs by monitoring passing tests against formal specifications (specs), but it is slow. A recent work, Valg, used reinforcement learning (RL) to speed up RV by up to 551.5x or 27 hours. Valg aims to probabilistically monitor most unique traces—sequences of spec-related events like method calls—and monitor fewer redundant ones. But, there is no in-depth study of Valg’s current limits and how to address them. We study Valg on 93 Java open-source projects to answer five unaddressed questions. (i) How much slower is Valg than optimal baselines? Up to 323.8x, or 3.2 hours vs. running tests without RV, and up to 9.6x, or 25.3 minutes vs. a theoretically optimal baseline that monitors only unique traces. (ii) Where is Valg’s time spent? 30.5\% on monitoring and 18.4\% on signaling events to monitors, on average. (iii) What characterizes code where Valg monitors too many redundant traces or misses unique ones? In 100 cases, 67.8\% of redundant traces are due to limitations of Valg’s RL convergence heuristic, and 41.3\% of missed unique traces occur when a Valg assumption does not hold. (iv) How much can test non-determinism and RL stochasticity cause monitored unique traces to vary? By 42.5 percentage points (pp) and 12.3pp on average, respectively, but they vary by up to 98pp. (v) How do other off-the-shelf RL algorithms compare with Valg’s? Only two of 11 RL algorithms that we survey are feasible for RV during continuous integration. Both are slower and miss more unique traces than Valg, so custom RL algorithms for RV may be needed. So, despite Valg’s promising results, it has plenty of room to improve. We highlight several exciting future directions on using RL to speed up RV.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 运行时验证（RV）通过根据形式化规约（specs）监控通过的测试发现了许多缺陷，但速度很慢。最近的一项工作 Valg 使用强化学习（RL）将 RV 加速了最高 551.5 倍或 27 小时。Valg 旨在以概率方式监控大多数唯一迹（与规约相关的事件序列，如方法调用），并减少对冗余迹的监控。但是，目前尚无对 Valg 当前局限及如何解决这些局限的深入研究。我们在 93 个 Java 开源项目上研究 Valg，以回答五个未解决的问题。(i) Valg 比最优基线慢多少？最高慢 323.8 倍（3.2 小时 vs. 不进行 RV 运行测试），比仅监控唯一迹的理论最优基线最高慢 9.6 倍（25.3 分钟）。(ii) Valg 的时间花在哪里？平均 30.5% 用于监控，18.4% 用于向监控器发送事件信号。(iii) 在哪些代码中 Valg 监控了过多冗余迹或遗漏唯一迹？在 100 个案例中，67.8% 的冗余迹源于 Valg 的 RL 收敛启发式的局限，41.3% 的遗漏唯一迹发生在 Valg 的某个假设不成立时。(iv) 测试非确定性和 RL 随机性可导致监控的唯一迹变化多少？平均分别变化 42.5 个百分点（pp）和 12.3 个百分点，但最多可变化 98 个百分点。(v) 其他现成 RL 算法与 Valg 相比如何？我们调查的 11 种 RL 算法中只有两种适用于持续集成中的 RV。两者都比 Valg 更慢且遗漏更多唯一迹，因此可能需要为 RV 定制 RL 算法。因此，尽管 Valg 的结果很有前景，但它仍有很大的改进空间。我们指出了使用 RL 加速 RV 的几个令人兴奋的未来方向。

import_candidates.title: WITFuzz: Validity-Preserving Greybox Fuzzing for WebAssembly Interface Type Binding Generators
import_candidates.abstract: Modern build pipelines often rely on code generation to turn constraint-rich interface specifications into artifacts for target programming languages. In the WebAssembly component model, binding generators (bindgens) follow this pattern by translating WebAssembly Interface Types (WIT) packages into language-specific bindings that are later compiled with application code. This bindgen step already targets more than ten language ecosystems, and the Rust wit-bindgen crate alone has accumulated tens of millions of downloads. Yet a WIT package may pass WIT validation but still break this build pipeline: bindgens may crash or hang during generation (Phase I), or downstream toolchains may reject the generated bindings even when generation succeeds (Phase II). Testing bindgens at scale is challenging because WIT is strongly typed and constraint-rich, and Phase II failures require language-specific checking. We present WITFuzz, a validity-preserving greybox fuzzer for WIT bindgens. WITFuzz mutates resolved WIT abstract syntax trees via structure-aware rewrites expressed in a small domain-specific language, and propagates correlated updates to maintain WIT validity. When coverage plateaus, WITFuzz expands its strategy pool online using coverage-guided, LLM-assisted DSL synthesis, admitting only strategies that pass local validation. WITFuzz further uses a build-aware, multi-layer oracle that combines in-loop checks with selective asynchronous compilation/typechecking of generated bindings to capture non-crashing build breakers. Across 12 bindgens, WITFuzz improves average edge coverage by 8.3\% over standalone wit-smith. It uncovers 40 previously unknown Phase I and Phase II build-breaking bugs, including 35 that are missed by all external baselines.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代构建流水线常依赖代码生成，将约束丰富的接口规范转换为目标编程语言的工件。在WebAssembly组件模型中，绑定生成器（bindgen）遵循这一模式，将WebAssembly接口类型（WIT）包转换为特定语言的绑定，随后与应用程序代码一起编译。这一bindgen步骤已经面向十多个语言生态系统，仅Rust的wit-bindgen crate就累计了数千万次下载。然而，一个WIT包可能通过WIT验证，却仍然破坏这一构建流水线：bindgen可能在生成期间崩溃或挂起（第一阶段），或者即使生成成功，下游工具链也可能拒绝生成的绑定（第二阶段）。大规模测试bindgen具有挑战性，因为WIT是强类型且约束丰富的，而第二阶段失败需要特定语言的检查。我们提出WITFuzz，一种面向WIT bindgen的保有效性灰盒模糊测试器。WITFuzz通过以小领域特定语言表达的结构感知重写来变异已解析的WIT抽象语法树，并传播相关更新以保持WIT有效性。当覆盖率进入平台期时，WITFuzz使用覆盖率引导、LLM辅助的DSL合成在线扩展其策略池，仅接纳通过本地验证的策略。WITFuzz进一步使用构建感知的多层预言机，将循环内检查与对生成绑定的选择性异步编译/类型检查相结合，以捕获非崩溃的构建破坏。在12个bindgen上，WITFuzz相比独立的wit-smith将平均边覆盖率提高8.3%。它发现了40个此前未知的第一阶段和第二阶段构建破坏性缺陷，其中35个被所有外部基线遗漏。

import_candidates.title: On the Evaluation of Large Language Models in Unit Test Evolution (Experience Paper)
import_candidates.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown promising potential in automating unit test evolution for evolving software systems. However, the effectiveness of LLMs in unit test evolution remains insufficiently understood, particularly with respect to prompt design choices, in-context learning (ICL) strategies, and different types of test evolution. In this paper, we present the first comprehensive empirical study to evaluate LLMs for unit test evolution. We systematically assess nine open-source code LLMs (3B to 34B parameters) and three state-of-the-art commercial models across diverse prompt designs, ICL strategies, and representative test evolution frameworks. To support robust and execution-based evaluation, we construct a new benchmark consisting of 530 real-world focal method–test co-evolution instances collected from seven actively maintained open-source projects. Our evaluation employs a suite of compilation, execution, and coverage-based metrics. Extensive experimental results reveal that prompt design and ICL methods significantly impact LLM effectiveness. Furthermore, the optimal configurations of these strategies vary substantially across different LLMs and evolution types. Based on our findings, we derive actionable insights to guide future research and practical adoption of LLM-based techniques for unit test evolution.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）最近在自动化演化软件系统的单元测试方面展现出潜力。然而，LLM在单元测试演化中的有效性仍未被充分理解，尤其是在提示设计选择、上下文学习（ICL）策略以及不同类型测试演化方面。在本文中，我们提出了首个全面的实证研究，以评估LLM用于单元测试演化的效果。我们系统评估了九个开源代码LLM（3B至34B参数）和三个最先进的商业模型，涵盖了不同的提示设计、ICL策略和代表性测试演化框架。为了支持稳健且基于执行的评估，我们构建了一个新基准，包含从七个活跃维护的开源项目中收集的530个真实世界焦点方法-测试协同演化实例。我们的评估采用了一套编译、执行和覆盖率指标。大量实验结果表明，提示设计和ICL方法显著影响LLM的有效性。此外，这些策略的最优配置在不同LLM和演化类型之间差异很大。基于我们的发现，我们得出了可操作的见解，以指导未来研究和LLM-based单元测试演化技术的实际采用。

import_candidates.title: STARS: Static Analysis-Guided Assertion Synthesis using Large Language Models
import_candidates.abstract: Automated unit test generation promises to reduce the cost of software quality assurance, and hence, is attracting attention from both academia and industry. Yet, generating assertions that are executable, meaningful to developers, and able to catch faults remains an unsolved challenge. Existing approaches either randomly enumerate assertions that are plausible based on static program analysis without considering whether they naturally fit the test prefix or query an LLM to generate assertions based on local context only, such as the test prefix and the focal method. However, we observe that local context alone is insufficient for LLMs to generate high-quality assertions because many desirable assertions are built from components that are almost impossible to guess for an LLM, such as sequences of multiple method calls. This paper presents STARS, a novel test assertion generation technique that combines the benefits of static program analysis and LLM-based synthesis. The key idea is to first gather a set of assertion components based on static program analysis and to then combine, concretize, prioritize, and improve them with an LLM. The resulting assertions go beyond what an LLM alone could realistically guess based on the test prefix and focal method, and they naturally fit the given test case. Empirical results show that STARS consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art baseline in five evaluation metrics. STARS achieves an exact-match rate of at most 83.4\% using GPT-5.4. Compared with the baseline, STARS’s mutation score nearly triples that of the baseline (10.97\% vs. 3.97\%), approaching that of developer-written assertions, while consuming 24.75\% fewer tokens and 30.6\% fewer LLM queries.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 自动化单元测试生成有望降低软件质量保证的成本，因此吸引了学术界和工业界的关注。然而，生成可执行、对开发者有意义且能够捕获故障的断言仍然是一个未解决的挑战。现有方法要么基于静态程序分析随机枚举看似合理的断言，而不考虑它们是否自然地适合测试前缀；要么仅基于局部上下文（如测试前缀和焦点方法）查询大语言模型（LLM）来生成断言。然而，我们观察到仅凭局部上下文不足以让LLM生成高质量断言，因为许多理想的断言是由LLM几乎不可能猜测到的组件构建的，例如多个方法调用的序列。本文提出了STARS，一种新颖的测试断言生成技术，它结合了静态程序分析和基于LLM的合成的优势。其核心思想是首先基于静态程序分析收集一组断言组件，然后利用LLM对它们进行组合、具体化、排序和改进。由此生成的断言超越了仅凭测试前缀和焦点方法LLM能够现实猜测的范围，并且自然地适合给定的测试用例。实证结果表明，STARS在五个评估指标上始终优于最先进的基线。使用GPT-5.4时，STARS的精确匹配率最高可达83.4%。与基线相比，STARS的变异得分几乎是基线的三倍（10.97%对3.97%），接近开发者编写的断言，同时消耗的token减少24.75%，LLM查询减少30.6%。

import_candidates.title: AdaptAgent: A Multi-agent, Domain-Guided Reasoning Framework for Code Adaptation
import_candidates.abstract: Developers often need to adapt into their projects the code generated from LLMs or code snippets from online forums. However, integrating them into an existing repository remains challenging in a manual process. A successful integration typically requires more than copying code as a user must produce correct adapting changes at a designated location in the target repository. We formalize this as the code adaptation problem: given a snippet, functional intent, a target repository, and an adaptation location, generate a patch that adapts the snippet into the repository. We present AdaptAgent, a multi-agent, domain-guided reasoning framework for code adaptation. Rather than relying on single-shot prompting, AdaptAgent decomposes adaptation into specialized agents that communicate via typed artifacts: an Intent Summarizer extracts adaptation goals from Q&A text; a Policy Agent derives domain policies from six adaptation categories; a Domain Planner generates a self-ordered plan; a Context Miner distills sibling-method semantics from the target codebase; and a Code Adapter realizes the plan as a minimal unified diff, iteratively refined using a compiler-based Verifier. This division of labor enables robust, policy-aligned adaptations and supports adapting code snippets into a project. On a real-world dataset, AdaptAgent outperforms strong baselines in semantic correctness and produces patches that mirror developers’ actual adaptation patterns. Our ablation study shows each agent’s necessity, especially planning for code-hardening and exception-handling, and intent for logic customization.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 开发者常常需要将LLM生成的代码或来自在线论坛的代码片段适配到他们的项目中。然而，将其集成到现有代码仓库中仍然是一个具有挑战性的手动过程。成功的集成通常不仅仅是复制代码，因为用户必须在目标仓库的指定位置生成正确的适配变更。我们将其形式化为代码适配问题：给定一个代码片段、功能意图、目标仓库和适配位置，生成一个将该片段适配到仓库中的补丁。我们提出了AdaptAgent，一个用于代码适配的多智能体、领域引导推理框架。AdaptAgent不依赖单次提示，而是将适配分解为通过类型化工件进行通信的专用智能体：意图摘要器从问答文本中提取适配目标；策略智能体从六种适配类别中推导领域策略；领域规划器生成自排序计划；上下文挖掘器从目标代码库中提炼兄弟方法语义；代码适配器将计划实现为最小统一差异补丁，并使用基于编译器的验证器进行迭代精化。这种分工实现了稳健的、策略对齐的适配，并支持将代码片段适配到项目中。在真实数据集上，AdaptAgent在语义正确性方面优于强基线，并产生与开发者实际适配模式相符的补丁。我们的消融研究表明每个智能体的必要性，尤其是规划对于代码加固和异常处理，以及意图对于逻辑定制。

import_candidates.title: Understanding Automated Program Repair Agents through the Lens of Traceability: An Empirical Study
import_candidates.abstract: Automated Program Repair (APR) agents leverage large language models (LLMs) to autonomously diagnose and patch software bugs using planning, reasoning, and tools. Although these agents show strong performance on leaderboards such as SWE-bench, little is understood about how they take actions, where they fail, and how their behavior compares to human developers. In this paper, we present the first systematic analysis of these limitations using 5 state-of-the-art APR agents. We trace the full decision-making pipelines of the 5 APR agents across 500 real-world repair tasks, from issue description to patch validation. Our study reveals that, while agents excel at simple fixes, they struggle with logic-intensive bugs, often generating verbose, overfitted patches that pass existing test suites without solving the root cause. Test generation and regression test selection remain major bottlenecks, as agents fail to reproduce issues or run relevant regression tests. Moreover, many agents operate with primitive tooling (e.g. bash scripts) and do not have access to debuggers or program analysis tools. These findings highlight key limitations of current APR systems and motivate several directions for next-generation APR design, including but not limited to: (1) a shift-left approach emphasizing early, high-quality test generation and validation to reduce spurious fixes and improve semantic correctness; (2) richer, more integrated tool ecosystems; (3) diversified agent architectures that combine complementary strengths; and (4) benchmarks that prioritize semantic repair quality and test-generation fidelity over surface-level success metrics.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 自动化程序修复（APR）代理利用大型语言模型（LLM），通过规划、推理和工具来自主诊断和修补软件缺陷。尽管这些代理在SWE-bench等排行榜上表现出色，但人们对它们如何采取行动、在何处失败以及其行为与人类开发者相比如何知之甚少。在本文中，我们使用5种最先进的APR代理对这些局限性进行了首次系统分析。我们追踪了5种APR代理在500个真实世界修复任务中的完整决策流程，从问题描述到补丁验证。我们的研究揭示，虽然代理在简单修复上表现出色，但它们在逻辑密集型缺陷上表现不佳，常常生成冗长、过拟合的补丁，这些补丁能通过现有测试套件而未解决根本原因。测试生成和回归测试选择仍然是主要瓶颈，因为代理无法重现问题或运行相关的回归测试。此外，许多代理使用原始工具（例如bash脚本），并且无法访问调试器或程序分析工具。这些发现凸显了当前APR系统的关键局限性，并激发了下一代APR设计的若干方向，包括但不限于：（1）左移方法，强调早期、高质量的测试生成和验证，以减少虚假修复并提高语义正确性；（2）更丰富、更集成的工具生态系统；（3）结合互补优势的多样化代理架构；（4）优先考虑语义修复质量和测试生成保真度而非表面成功指标的基准。

import_candidates.title: CONCUR: Benchmarking LLMs for Concurrent Code Generation
import_candidates.abstract: Leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) for code generation has increasingly emerged as a common practice in the domain of software engineering. Relevant benchmarks have been established to evaluate the code generation capabilities of LLMs. However, existing benchmarks focus primarily on sequential code, lacking the ability to effectively evaluate LLMs on concurrent code generation. Compared to sequential code, concurrent code exhibits greater complexity and possesses unique types of bugs, such as deadlocks and race conditions, that do not occur in sequential code.
