Therefore, a benchmark for evaluating sequential code generation cannot be useful for evaluating concurrent code generation with LLMs. To address this gap, we designed a benchmark CONCUR specifically aimed at evaluating the capability of LLMs to generate concurrent code. CONCUR consists of a base set of 43 concurrency problems derived from a standard concurrency textbook, together with 72 validated mutant variants, resulting in 115 total problems. The base problems serve as the semantic core of the benchmark, while the mutants expand linguistic and structural diversity. We conducted an evaluation of a range of LLMs on CONCUR, highlighting limitations of current models. Overall, our work provides a novel direction for evaluating the capability of LLMs to generate code with focus on concurrency.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 利用大型语言模型（LLMs）进行代码生成在软件工程领域已日益成为一种常见做法。已有相关基准用于评估LLMs的代码生成能力。然而，现有基准主要关注顺序代码，缺乏有效评估LLMs并发代码生成的能力。与顺序代码相比，并发代码具有更大的复杂性，并具有顺序代码中不会出现的独特缺陷类型，如死锁和竞态条件。因此，用于评估顺序代码生成的基准无法用于评估LLMs的并发代码生成。为弥补这一空白，我们设计了一个专门用于评估LLMs生成并发代码能力的基准CONCUR。CONCUR由源自标准并发教材的43个基础并发问题组成，加上72个经过验证的变异变体，共计115个问题。基础问题作为基准的语义核心，而变异体则扩展了语言和结构多样性。我们在CONCUR上评估了一系列LLMs，并突出了当前模型的局限性。总体而言，我们的工作为评估LLMs生成代码的能力提供了一个新方向，重点关注并发性。

import_candidates.title: PatchPorter: LLM-Driven Security Patch Porting via Version Tracing and Context Selection for NPM
import_candidates.abstract: Third-Party Libraries are widely used in modern software development, yet their vulnerabilities pose serious security risks. This issue is particularly severe in the NPM ecosystem, where high-risk 1-day vulnerabilities can remain unpatched for extended periods. Although upgrading to the latest patched version is commonly recommended, it often causes major compatibility issues. Patch porting offers an effective solution to this challenge. However, existing patch porting methods are mainly designed for C and have two limitations when applied to NPM. First, they can be brittle in precisely localizing fix locations when substantial semantic gaps exist across versions. Second, they rely on either excessive or insufficient context for patch adaptation, which may introduce redundant information and increase the risk of hallucination. This paper introduces PatchPorter, a method for single-branch security patch porting in NPM that builds on Large Language Models (LLMs). PatchPorter addresses these limitations through two modules. The localization module leverages LLM semantic understanding and code evolution analysis over version histories maintained by version control systems to identify fix locations. The context selection module analyzes patch dependencies to select minimal yet sufficient context around the localized fix location. The selected context is used as input for the LLM to generate the patch. We construct a dataset of 112 NPM vulnerabilities with Proof- of-Concepts for dynamic validation. Experimental results show that PatchPorter significantly surpasses other methods in accuracy, achieving a 26.23\% improvement over the best-performing baseline and a 70.59\% increase on the most difficult tasks. Its ability to handle various vulnerability types highlights its practical value. Additional results confirm that both of its main modules also outperform alternative approaches.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 第三方库在现代软件开发中被广泛使用，然而其漏洞带来了严重的安全风险。这个问题在NPM生态系统中尤为严重，高风险1-day漏洞可能长期未修复。尽管通常建议升级到最新修复版本，但这往往会导致重大兼容性问题。补丁移植为这一挑战提供了有效解决方案。然而，现有补丁移植方法主要针对C语言设计，应用于NPM时存在两个局限。首先，当版本间存在显著语义差异时，它们在精确定位修复位置方面可能很脆弱。其次，它们依赖过多或不足的上下文进行补丁适配，可能引入冗余信息并增加幻觉风险。本文介绍PatchPorter，一种面向NPM单分支安全补丁移植、基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法。PatchPorter通过两个模块解决这些局限。定位模块利用LLM语义理解以及对版本控制系统维护的版本历史的代码演化分析来识别修复位置。上下文选择模块分析补丁依赖关系，以选择局部修复位置周围最小但充分的上下文。所选上下文作为LLM生成补丁的输入。我们构建了包含112个NPM漏洞的数据集，并带有用于动态验证的概念验证。实验结果表明，PatchPorter在准确性上显著超越其他方法，比最佳基线提高26.23%，在最困难任务上提高70.59%。其处理各种漏洞类型的能力凸显了实用价值。额外结果证实，其两个主要模块也优于替代方法。

import_candidates.title: AsyncLeakBench: A Curated Benchmark of Asynchronous Resource Leaks in Open-Source Java Projects
import_candidates.abstract: Asynchronous programming is widely used in modern Java software, including server-side processing, network I/O, reactive streams, task scheduling, and RPC communication. Unlike synchronous executions, resource creation and release in asynchronous programs are distributed across callbacks, Future/Promise chains, threads, and scheduler boundaries. Consequently, resource lifecycles may depend on execution ordering, races, cancellation, and timeouts, making resource leaks a significant source of performance degradation and reliability failures. Prior research and public datasets have largely focused on synchronous resource leaks, which typically involve missing close calls or unhandled exceptional paths within a single call stack. In asynchronous environments, however, resource release may depend on callback execution, Future completion, and scheduler decisions, and the release path may change under cancellation, timeouts, or reordered execution. Existing datasets therefore do not adequately capture the triggering conditions and repair strategies of asynchronous resource leaks, limiting the systematic evaluation of detection and automated repair techniques. To address this gap, we present AsyncLeakBench, a public benchmark of real-world asynchronous resource leak defects fixed in open-source Java projects. Using a semi-automatic mining workflow, we collected 16,242 candidate defect–patch pairs from 31 open-source Java projects. Through iterative filtering, duplicate removal, async-specific validation, and manual inspection of resource lifecycles and patches, we identified 902 high-confidence defect–patch pairs. We further classify these cases into 11 categories that characterize major triggers and repair strategies involving cancellation, timeouts, scheduler boundaries, and other asynchronous events. An initial evaluation of existing resource leak detectors reveals limited effectiveness, particularly for leaks triggered by cancellation and timeouts. AsyncLeakBench provides a realistic and reproducible basis for evaluating resource leak detection and repair, static and dynamic analysis, fault localization, and LLM-based debugging. By characterizing asynchronous resource leaks as a distinct defect class and providing a standardized benchmark, this work enables systematic research on their detection, localization, and repair.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 异步编程在现代Java软件中被广泛使用，包括服务器端处理、网络I/O、响应式流、任务调度和RPC通信。与同步执行不同，异步程序中的资源创建和释放分布在回调、Future/Promise链、线程和调度器边界之间。因此，资源生命周期可能取决于执行顺序、竞争、取消和超时，使得资源泄漏成为性能下降和可靠性故障的重要来源。先前的研究和公开数据集主要关注同步资源泄漏，通常涉及单个调用栈内缺失的close调用或未处理的异常路径。然而，在异步环境中，资源释放可能取决于回调执行、Future完成和调度器决策，并且释放路径可能在取消、超时或重排序执行下发生变化。因此，现有数据集不足以捕捉异步资源泄漏的触发条件和修复策略，限制了检测和自动修复技术的系统评估。为填补这一空白，我们提出AsyncLeakBench，一个公开的基准，包含在开源Java项目中修复的真实世界异步资源泄漏缺陷。使用半自动挖掘工作流，我们从31个开源Java项目中收集了16,242个候选缺陷-补丁对。通过迭代过滤、重复删除、异步特定验证以及对资源生命周期和补丁的手动检查，我们识别出902个高置信度缺陷-补丁对。我们进一步将这些案例分为11个类别，刻画涉及取消、超时、调度器边界和其他异步事件的主要触发因素和修复策略。对现有资源泄漏检测器的初步评估显示其效果有限，特别是对于由取消和超时触发的泄漏。AsyncLeakBench为评估资源泄漏检测与修复、静态和动态分析、故障定位以及基于LLM的调试提供了现实且可复现的基础。通过将异步资源泄漏描述为一个独特的缺陷类别并提供标准化基准，这项工作使得对其检测、定位和修复的系统研究成为可能。

import_candidates.title: Systematically Cover SQL Syntactic Structures via 𝑘-Sequence
import_candidates.abstract: Testing Relational Database Management Systems (RDBMSs) is inherently challenging because SQL, the primary language for interacting with RDBMSs, exhibits a vast and highly complex grammar with hundreds of interdependent production rules in the Extended Backus--Naur Form. While existing grammar-based testing techniques have made progress in covering SQL syntactic structures, they predominantly focus on parent-child relationships in derivation paths, which capture vertical expansions from a non-terminal to its alternatives. However, they overlook an equally critical dimension, sibling-like relationships, which capture co-occurring alternatives across derivation paths. This oversight results in insufficient coverage of intricate syntactic interactions that may trigger unique behaviors or latent bugs in RDBMSs. In this work, we propose k-sequence, a novel coverage criterion that characterizes syntactic structures as ordered sequences of k alternatives encountered during derivation. By simultaneously capturing both vertical parent-child and horizontal sibling-like relationships in the SQL syntactic structures, k-sequence provides a unified framework for comprehensive SQL syntactic coverage. Based on this criterion, we develop KSeqFuzz, a directed fuzzing approach that systematically generates SQL statements to explore previously unseen k-sequences, achieving deeper and broader testing coverage. We implement and evaluate KSeqFuzz on four widely-deployed RDBMSs, i.e., MySQL, MariaDB, TiDB, and OceanBase. In total, KSeqFuzz detects 58 new unique bugs, including 6 critical crashes. Evaluation results demonstrate that KSeqFuzz outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, detecting 26\% more unique bugs during 24-hour testing campaigns.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 测试关系数据库管理系统（RDBMS）本身就具有挑战性，因为SQL作为与RDBMS交互的主要语言，具有庞大且高度复杂的语法，在扩展巴科斯范式（EBNF）中包含数百条相互依赖的产生式规则。尽管现有的基于语法的测试技术在覆盖SQL语法结构方面已取得进展，但它们主要关注推导路径中的父子关系，这些关系捕获从非终结符到其备选项的垂直扩展。然而，它们忽略了一个同样关键的维度，即类兄弟关系，这种关系捕获跨推导路径共同出现的备选项。这一疏忽导致对复杂语法交互的覆盖不足，而这些交互可能触发RDBMS中的独特行为或潜在缺陷。在这项工作中，我们提出k-sequence，一种新颖的覆盖准则，它将语法结构刻画为推导过程中遇到的k个备选项的有序序列。通过同时捕获SQL语法结构中的垂直父子关系和水平类兄弟关系，k-sequence为全面的SQL语法覆盖提供了一个统一框架。基于该准则，我们开发了KSeqFuzz，一种定向模糊测试方法，它系统化地生成SQL语句以探索以前未见的k-sequence，从而实现更深更广的测试覆盖。我们在四个广泛部署的RDBMS（即MySQL、MariaDB、TiDB和OceanBase）上实现并评估了KSeqFuzz。总共，KSeqFuzz检测到58个新的独特缺陷，其中包括6个严重崩溃。评估结果表明，KSeqFuzz优于最先进的基线，在24小时测试活动中检测到多26%的独特缺陷。

import_candidates.title: IssueExec: A Test-Driven Approach for Localizing Software Engineering Issues
import_candidates.abstract: Issue localization, which identifies code locations requiring modification from issue descriptions, is a critical step in automated software maintenance. Existing approaches predominantly attempt to directly align issue descriptions with code elements, yet often struggle due to the inherent abstraction gap between the issue description and code implementation. Seeking alternative signals, our theoretical analysis suggests that test suites can serve as executable proxies for requirements, reducing localization uncertainty by 7.73 bits of entropy on average. A large-scale empirical study on 18 repositories validates this premise: existing tests cover 96.98\% of ground-truth files, and the two-hop pathway yields stronger semantic connectivity than direct matching in 82.4\% of cases. Despite their potential, leveraging tests for localization faces two key challenges: the semantic gap separating issue descriptions from test identifiers, and the substantial noise in execution traces from infrastructure code. To address these, we propose IssueExec, which bridges the semantic gap through domain-knowledge-enhanced test representations and filters noise via hierarchical trace analysis. Experiments on SWE-bench Lite show that IssueExec achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving function-level Recall@1 by 41.57\% over the strongest baseline. When integrated into the Agentless pipeline, IssueExec resolves 17.72\% more issues, demonstrating practical downstream benefits.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 问题定位，即从问题描述中识别需要修改的代码位置，是自动化软件维护中的关键步骤。现有方法主要尝试直接将问题描述与代码元素对齐，但由于问题描述与代码实现之间存在固有的抽象鸿沟，往往难以奏效。为寻求替代信号，我们的理论分析表明，测试套件可以作为需求的可执行代理，平均将定位不确定性降低7.73比特的熵。对18个代码仓库的大规模实证研究验证了这一前提：现有测试覆盖了96.98%的真实文件，并且在82.4%的情况下，两跳路径比直接匹配产生更强的语义连通性。尽管具有潜力，利用测试进行定位仍面临两个关键挑战：问题描述与测试标识符之间的语义鸿沟，以及来自基础设施代码的执行轨迹中的大量噪声。为解决这些问题，我们提出IssueExec，它通过领域知识增强的测试表示来弥合语义鸿沟，并通过分层轨迹分析过滤噪声。在SWE-bench Lite上的实验表明，IssueExec达到了最先进的性能，在函数级Recall@1上比最强基线提高了41.57%。当集成到Agentless流水线中时，IssueExec多解决了17.72%的问题，展示了实际的下游收益。

import_candidates.title: Mathematically-Guided Detection of Floating-Point Errors
import_candidates.abstract: Floating-point computations are important for modern scientific and engineering software, especially for safety-critical systems, yet only a small subset of inputs typically trigger substantial numerical errors. Detecting such error-inducing inputs and the underlying bugs is therefore essential for improving their security and reliability. Existing techniques commonly rely on either oracle-driven exploration that repeatedly compares against high-precision references or search-driven heuristics. Despite the improvements made, they remain limited by (1) Expensive computation of high-precision oracles and (2) Lack of long-range convergence, which often requires dense probing near narrow error-inducing regions and expensive computation. We propose MGDE (Mathematically-Guided Detection of floating-point Errors), a method that replaces trial-and-error exploration with mathematically defined targets and directed convergence. MGDE first uses condition-number theory to identify numerically unstable atomic operations without invoking expensive high-precision oracles during exploration. MGDE exploits the observation that extreme condition numbers occur near structured boundaries (e.g., cancellation points and singularities), reformulating detection as a numerical root-finding problem. By solving the resulting objectives with the Newton–Raphson method, MGDE can steer inputs toward error-prone regions from far-away initializations. We evaluate MGDE on GNU Scientific Library (GSL) functions and compare against two state-of-the-art baselines, ATOMU and FPCC, using triggered bugs as the primary metric. On 88 single-input functions, MGDE triggers 80 numerically validated bugs across 47 functions, outperforming ATOMU (70 bugs in 46 functions) and FPCC (53 bugs in 42 functions). MGDE is also faster: ATOMU and FPCC require 42.71{\texttimes} and 11.17{\texttimes} the exploration time of MGDE, respectively. Regarding multi-input functions, we evaluate MGDE under two complementary settings. On the native multi-input dataset of FPCC, MGDE detects 28 triggered bugs, while FPCC finds 23 bugs. MGDE also takes 8.91 seconds in total, compared with 2,100 seconds used by FPCC. On an additional external benchmark of 18 dual-input GSL functions, MGDE detects nine bugs not found by FPCC. Overall, MGDE substantially advances the state-of-the-art in both effectiveness and efficiency, and we report 16 previously unknown GSL bugs, which have been confirmed by the GSL community.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 浮点计算对于现代科学与工程软件非常重要，尤其是安全关键系统，然而通常只有一小部分输入会触发显著的数值错误。因此，检测这类引发错误的输入及其底层缺陷对于提升其安全性和可靠性至关重要。现有技术通常依赖基于预言机的探索（反复与高精度参考进行比较）或搜索驱动的启发式方法。尽管已有改进，它们仍受限于：(1) 高精度预言机的昂贵计算；(2) 缺乏长程收敛性，这往往需要在狭窄的易错区域附近进行密集探测并付出高昂计算代价。我们提出 MGDE（Mathematically-Guided Detection of floating-point Errors，数学引导的浮点错误检测），一种用数学定义的目标和定向收敛替代试错式探索的方法。MGDE 首先利用条件数理论来识别数值不稳定的原子操作，而无需在探索过程中调用昂贵的高精度预言机。MGDE 利用极端的条件数出现在结构化边界（例如消去点和奇点）附近的观察，将检测重新表述为数值求根问题。通过用牛顿–拉夫森法求解所得目标，MGDE 可以从远离的初始点将输入引导至易错区域。我们在 GNU 科学库（GSL）函数上评估 MGDE，并与两个最先进的基线 ATOMU 和 FPCC 比较，主要指标为触发的缺陷。在 88 个单输入函数上，MGDE 在 47 个函数中触发了 80 个经数值验证的缺陷，优于 ATOMU（46 个函数中 70 个缺陷）和 FPCC（42 个函数中 53 个缺陷）。MGDE 也更快：ATOMU 和 FPCC 所需的探索时间分别是 MGDE 的 42.71 倍和 11.17 倍。对于多输入函数，我们在两种互补设置下评估 MGDE。在 FPCC 的原生多输入数据集上，MGDE 检测到 28 个触发缺陷，而 FPCC 发现 23 个缺陷。MGDE 总共耗时 8.91 秒，而 FPCC 耗时 2,100 秒。在另一个包含 18 个双输入 GSL 函数的外部基准上，MGDE 检测到 FPCC 未发现的 9 个缺陷。总体而言，MGDE 在有效性和效率上大幅推进了最先进水平，并且我们报告了 16 个此前未知的 GSL 缺陷，这些缺陷已得到 GSL 社区的确认。

import_candidates.title: TracePilot: Self-Verifiable Framework for Decentralized Applications Fault Localization across Transactions
import_candidates.abstract: Decentralized Applications (DApps) serve as a critical technical underpinning for business logic and user interaction within the blockchain-powered Web3 ecosystem. However, DApps are prone to faults, and localizing these faults within their intricate and often interconnected logic is a particularly time-consuming process, frequently taking tens of hours and leading to substantial economic losses for developers. Existing state-of-the-art DApp fault localization methods, e.g., FaultSeeker, cannot capture cross-transaction fault logic and produce verifiable diagnostic reports. Therefore, security experts have to spend substantial time manually verifying results and devising fixes. In this paper, we present TracePilot, a large language model (LLM)-based framework that automates DApp fault localization in two phases: distilling global fault insights from transaction sequences and then performing focused trace exploration to isolate the faulty logic. Crucially, we propose a patch verification mechanism that treats attack-blocking patches as executable evidence for fault localization while flagging potential overfitting risks for expert review. This mechanism improves result trustworthiness and reduces manual verification costs. Evaluated on a dataset of 149 real-world cases, TracePilot achieves a 71.14\% Top-1 Recall. In the single-transaction fair comparison, it achieves 72.73\%, substantially outperforming the state-of-the-art method at 32.23\%. On cross-transaction cases, TracePilot achieves a 64.29\% Top-1 Recall. The proposed algorithm is being integrated into the contract security agent developed by Ant Digital Technologies. Moreover, to facilitate further research, our code and dataset are publicly available online: https://github.com/feiqiuaaaa/TracePilot.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 去中心化应用（DApps）是区块链驱动的Web3生态系统中业务逻辑和用户交互的关键技术支撑。然而，DApps容易发生故障，在其复杂且往往相互关联的逻辑中定位这些故障是一个特别耗时的过程，通常需要数十小时，并给开发者带来重大经济损失。现有的最先进的DApp故障定位方法（如FaultSeeker）无法捕获跨交易的故障逻辑，也无法生成可验证的诊断报告。因此，安全专家不得不花费大量时间手动验证结果并制定修复方案。在本文中，我们提出了TracePilot，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的框架，分两个阶段自动化DApp故障定位：从交易序列中提炼全局故障洞察，然后进行聚焦的轨迹探索以隔离故障逻辑。至关重要的是，我们提出了一种补丁验证机制，将阻止攻击的补丁视为故障定位的可执行证据，同时标记潜在的过拟合风险以供专家审查。该机制提高了结果的可信度并降低了手动验证成本。在包含149个真实案例的数据集上进行评估，TracePilot实现了71.14%的Top-1召回率。在单交易公平比较中，它达到72.73%，大幅优于最先进方法的32.23%。在跨交易案例中，TracePilot实现了64.29%的Top-1召回率。所提出的算法正被集成到蚂蚁数字科技开发的合约安全代理中。此外，为促进进一步研究，我们的代码和数据集已在线公开：https://github.com/feiqiuaaaa/TracePilot。

import_candidates.title: Empowering Lightweight Language Models for Security Code Review via Context-Aware Distillation
import_candidates.abstract: Security code review, which specifically examines software from a security perspective, is indispensable for preempting vulnerabilities and bolstering software reliability. However, existing automated approaches face a dilemma. They either rely on large language models with prohibitive deployment costs, or employ lightweight models that struggle with complex reasoning and global contextual understanding. In this paper, we propose LSCR, a context-aware distillation approach that empowers lightweight language models for security code review by distilling static-analysis–style security rationale from powerful teacher models. Rather than directly transferring final review outputs, LSCR guides student models to internalize how high-level security judgments are systematically derived from low-level code evidence, leveraging repository-level context during training. By embedding this evidence-driven analysis paradigm into lightweight models, LSCR enables more reliable security code reviews under constrained model capacity. When compared with competitive lightweight baselines, LSCR attains an average improvement of over 12\% in security issue classification accuracy and more than 13.3\% gains in BLEU score for review generation. Human evaluation reveals that LSCR increases the proportion of instrumental reviews by 52.6\% on average over state-of-the-art baselines, while reducing misleading feedback by 22.6\%. LSCR effectively narrows the performance gap between small-scale and large-scale models, making on-premise security code review more feasible in practice.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 安全代码审查，即从安全角度专门检查软件，对于预防漏洞和增强软件可靠性不可或缺。然而，现有的自动化方法面临两难境地。它们要么依赖部署成本高昂的大型语言模型，要么采用难以进行复杂推理和全局上下文理解的轻量级模型。在本文中，我们提出了LSCR，一种上下文感知蒸馏方法，通过从强大的教师模型中蒸馏出静态分析风格的安全推理依据，来赋能轻量级语言模型进行安全代码审查。LSCR不是直接迁移最终审查输出，而是引导学生模型内化如何从低级代码证据中系统地推导出高级安全判断，并在训练期间利用仓库级上下文。通过将这种证据驱动的分析范式嵌入轻量级模型，LSCR使得在受限模型容量下能够进行更可靠的安全代码审查。与有竞争力的轻量级基线相比，LSCR在安全问题的分类准确率上平均提升超过12%，在审查生成的BLEU分数上提升超过13.3%。人工评估显示，与最先进的基线相比，LSCR平均将有用审查的比例提高了52.6%，同时将误导性反馈减少了22.6%。LSCR有效缩小了小规模与大规模模型之间的性能差距，使本地部署的安全代码审查在实践中更加可行。

import_candidates.title: EvidenT: An Evidence-Preserving Framework for Iterative System-Level Package Repair
import_candidates.abstract: Frequent toolchain updates and the expanding diversity of instruction set architectures (ISAs) have made large-scale system-level software package repair a critical task. Diagnosing and repairing build failures remains challenging due to heterogeneous failure evidence, complex dependency constraints, and architecture-specific build conventions. While recent LLM-based repair methods have shown promise for project-level source code fixes, they struggle with system-level repair where failures involve multi-language artifacts (e.g., build recipes, scripts, and source archives) and require iterative validation through external build services. In this paper, we first conduct a systematic empirical study of real-world system-level build failures. Our findings reveal that 72\% of successful repairs primarily involve adjustments to build configurations, dependencies, or environment settings rather than isolated source-code modifications, suggesting that effective repair must prioritize packaging logic and iterative feedback. Motivated by these insights, we propose EvidenT, an evidence-preserving repair framework that decouples iteration-aware evidence management from tool execution. EvidenT comprises (1) an external Build Service for reproducible build execution and feedback; (2) an Evidence-Preserving Repair Controller that performs cross-modal fusion of repair history, knowledge context, and build artifacts; and (3) an automated Repair Orchestrator that executes a suite of modular tools for failure localization and system-level repair actions within a closed-loop validation environment. We evaluate EvidenT on a benchmark of 219 real-world RISC-V package build failures. EvidenT successfully repairs 118 packages (53.88\%), substantially outperforming state-of-the-art agentic baselines (20.55\%) and direct LLM-based repair (1.83\%). To demonstrate its architectural generality, we extend EvidenT to other ISAs by updating only ISA-specific knowledge context. In preliminary experiments, it achieves success rates of 41.77\% on aarch64 and 46.99\% on x86_64, showcasing its robustness across diverse hardware ecosystems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 频繁的工具链更新和指令集架构（ISA）的日益多样化，使大规模系统级软件包修复成为一项关键任务。由于异构的失败证据、复杂的依赖约束以及特定架构的构建约定，诊断和修复构建失败仍然具有挑战性。尽管近期基于LLM的修复方法在项目级源代码修复方面展现出潜力，但它们在系统级修复中面临困难，因为失败涉及多语言工件（例如构建配方、脚本和源代码归档），并且需要通过外部构建服务进行迭代验证。在本文中，我们首先对真实世界的系统级构建失败进行系统的实证研究。我们的发现表明，72%的成功修复主要涉及对构建配置、依赖项或环境设置的调整，而非孤立的源代码修改，这表明有效的修复必须优先考虑打包逻辑和迭代反馈。受这些见解启发，我们提出EvidenT，一个证据保留的修复框架，它将迭代感知的证据管理与工具执行解耦。EvidenT包含：(1) 一个外部构建服务，用于可复现的构建执行与反馈；(2) 一个证据保留的修复控制器，执行修复历史、知识上下文和构建工件的跨模态融合；以及(3) 一个自动修复编排器，在闭环验证环境中执行一套模块化工具，用于失败定位和系统级修复动作。我们在包含219个真实世界RISC-V软件包构建失败的基准上评估EvidenT。EvidenT成功修复了118个软件包（53.88%），大幅优于最先进的智能体基线（20.55%）和直接基于LLM的修复（1.83%）。为展示其架构通用性，我们仅通过更新ISA特定的知识上下文，将EvidenT扩展到其他ISA。在初步实验中，它在aarch64上达到41.77%的成功率，在x86_64上达到46.99%，展示了其在不同硬件生态系统中的稳健性。

import_candidates.title: CARE: Cascading Impact-Aware Compliance Test Suite Evolution under Regulatory Changes
import_candidates.abstract: In response to frequent changes in regulatory rules, this paper proposes CARE, a cascading impact-aware framework for automated compliance testing evolution. Existing approaches often suffer from over-reuse or missed updates because they treat rule changes in isolation and ignore complex inter-dependencies across testing artifacts. This paper highlights cascading impact propagation as a central challenge in regulation-driven test maintenance and shows that shifting from isolated rule handling to cascading impact-aware evolution is essential for achieving both high test quality and maintenance efficiency. Specifically, our CARE framework addresses this challenge by constructing a unified four-layer cascading relation model spanning Rule-Requirement-Scenario-Test Case, enabling fine-grained traceability across abstraction levels. By explicitly modeling how rule changes propagate and amplify along this chain, the framework precisely identifies impacted scenarios and test cases that need updating, while safely maximizing the reuse of unaffected ones. Experiments conducted on real-world compliance testing tasks across multiple domains show that CARE achieves an average F1 of 90.3\% on updated test suites, outperforming existing methods by up to 164\% and approaching expert-level effectiveness. Ablation studies further demonstrate that explicit cascading impact modeling and handling are key contributors to these improvements. In addition, CARE substantially reduces manual effort and improves test maintenance efficiency, and indicates strong cross-domain generalization.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 为应对监管规则的频繁变化，本文提出了CARE，一个用于自动化合规测试演化的级联影响感知框架。现有方法通常因孤立地处理规则变化并忽略测试工件间复杂的相互依赖关系，而存在过度复用或遗漏更新等问题。本文强调级联影响传播是监管驱动测试维护中的核心挑战，并表明从孤立的规则处理转向级联影响感知的演化，对于同时实现高测试质量和维护效率至关重要。具体而言，我们的CARE框架通过构建一个跨越规则-需求-场景-测试用例的统一四层级联关系模型来应对这一挑战，从而实现跨抽象层次的细粒度可追溯性。通过显式建模规则变化如何沿此链条传播和放大，该框架能精确识别需要更新的受影响场景和测试用例，同时安全地最大化复用未受影响的场景和测试用例。在多个领域的真实世界合规测试任务上进行的实验表明，CARE在更新后的测试套件上平均F1达到90.3%，比现有方法高出最多164%，并接近专家级效果。消融研究进一步表明，显式的级联影响建模和处理是这些改进的关键贡献因素。此外，CARE大幅减少了人工工作量，提高了测试维护效率，并展现出强大的跨领域泛化能力。

import_candidates.title: Fine-Grained Privacy Leakage Detection in OpenHarmony Apps
import_candidates.abstract: In recent years, the distributed operating system OpenHarmony has gained significant popularity. As the number of OpenHarmony apps grows rapidly, privacy abuse and data leakage have emerged as critical concerns. However, the untyped and highly flexible nature of Ark bytecode poses substantial challenges. We propose HScope, a novel fine-grained program analysis framework designed to directly analyze OpenHarmony app bytecode and identify privacy risks. HScope employs abstract interpretation to model the dynamic behaviors of OpenHarmony apps, enabling precise resolution of indirect calls and the complex inter-component communication mechanisms. We evaluate HScope on a dataset of 300 real-world OpenHarmony apps. The results demonstrate that HScope is both effective and comprehensive, successfully uncovering 39 previously unknown privacy issues (corresponding to 27 apps). These findings highlight HScope’s potential as a practical and scalable solution for securing the evolving OpenHarmony ecosystem.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 近年来，分布式操作系统OpenHarmony获得了显著普及。随着OpenHarmony应用数量迅速增长，隐私滥用和数据泄露已成为关键问题。然而，Ark字节码的无类型且高度灵活的性质带来了巨大挑战。我们提出HScope，一种新颖的细粒度程序分析框架，旨在直接分析OpenHarmony应用字节码并识别隐私风险。HScope采用抽象解释来建模OpenHarmony应用的动态行为，从而能够精确解析间接调用和复杂的组件间通信机制。我们在300个真实OpenHarmony应用的数据集上评估了HScope。结果表明HScope既有效又全面，成功发现了39个先前未知的隐私问题（对应27个应用）。这些发现凸显了HScope作为保护不断发展的OpenHarmony生态系统的实用且可扩展解决方案的潜力。

import_candidates.title: An Empirical Study and Benchmark of Kubernetes Misconfiguration Scanners
import_candidates.abstract: Kubernetes is a widely adopted container orchestration framework, yet misconfigurations remain a leading cause of cloud security incidents and a major challenge for practitioners. Automated security scanners are commonly used to detect such misconfigurations, but their effectiveness has not been systematically evaluated. As a result, it remains unclear which tools can be trusted, what misconfigurations they reliably detect, and to what extent they improve Kubernetes security. This paper presents the first systematic investigation of ten prominent Kubernetes security scanners that are actively used in practice. We begin by examining the misconfigurations that each scanner claims to detect. Although scanners provide documentation of their coverage, these descriptions are written in natural language and are often ambiguous, making it unclear what is actually detected. To address this issue, we manually analyze scanner implementations to identify their precise detection targets and validate them through dynamic testing. Our analysis reveals that scanners frequently adopt different criteria for the same documented misconfiguration, exposing significant inconsistencies caused by ambiguous specifications. Building on these results, we introduce the first comprehensive benchmark for Kubernetes misconfigurations, covering all misconfigurations targeted by the ten scanners. The benchmark includes 4,109 misconfiguration files for static and dynamic analysis and 144 shell scripts for dynamic analysis, encompassing 281 unique misconfigurations. Using this benchmark, we conducted an empirical evaluation of ten scanners. Our results show that, in static scanning, Kubescape achieves the highest recall (43.8\%), and it also performs best in dynamic analysis with an recall of 62.3\%. We further analyze the strengths and limitations of each scanner, identifying coverage gaps that significantly affect detection effectiveness. Our findings provide practical guidance for practitioners selecting Kubernetes security scanners and highlight key challenges that should be addressed by the software engineering community. Moreover, the proposed benchmark establishes a foundation for future research on Kubernetes security.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Kubernetes 是一个被广泛采用的容器编排框架，但错误配置仍然是云安全事件的主要原因之一，也是从业者面临的主要挑战。自动化安全扫描器通常用于检测此类错误配置，但其有效性尚未得到系统评估。因此，哪些工具值得信赖、它们能可靠地检测哪些错误配置，以及它们在多大程度上改善 Kubernetes 安全性，仍不清楚。本文首次对实践中积极使用的十款知名 Kubernetes 安全扫描器进行了系统研究。我们首先考察每款扫描器声称能检测的错误配置。尽管扫描器提供了其覆盖范围的文档，但这些描述以自然语言编写，往往模糊不清，导致实际检测内容不明确。为解决这一问题，我们人工分析扫描器实现，以识别其精确检测目标，并通过动态测试进行验证。我们的分析表明，扫描器常常对同一文档化错误配置采用不同标准，暴露出由模糊规范引起的显著不一致。基于这些结果，我们引入了首个面向 Kubernetes 错误配置的综合基准，覆盖十款扫描器所针对的所有错误配置。该基准包含用于静态和动态分析的 4,109 个错误配置文件以及用于动态分析的 144 个 shell 脚本，涵盖 281 种独特错误配置。利用该基准，我们对十款扫描器进行了实证评估。结果表明，在静态扫描中，Kubescape 实现了最高召回率（43.8%），并且在动态分析中也表现最佳，召回率为 62.3%。我们进一步分析每款扫描器的优势与局限，识别出显著影响检测有效性的覆盖缺口。我们的发现为从业者选择 Kubernetes 安全扫描器提供了实用指导，并突出了软件工程社区应解决的关键挑战。此外，所提出的基准为未来 Kubernetes 安全研究奠定了基础。

import_candidates.title: Towards Iterative End-to-End Software Development: A Feature-Driven Multi-agent Framework
import_candidates.abstract: Recent advances in large language model agents offer the promise of automating end-to-end software development from natural language requirements. However, existing approaches largely adopt linear, waterfall-style pipelines, which oversimplify the iterative nature of real-world development and struggle with complex, larger-scale projects. To address these limitations, we propose EvoDev, an iterative software development framework inspired by feature-driven development. EvoDev decomposes user requirements into a set of user-valued features and constructs a Feature Map, a directed acyclic graph that explicitly models dependencies between features. Each feature node in the feature map maintains multi-layer contexts, including business logic, software design, and code implementation, which are propagated along dependencies to provide context for subsequent development iterations. We evaluate EvoDev on challenging Android development tasks and show that it improves Function Completeness by 57.3\% over the best-performing baseline, Claude Code, while achieving 16.0\%–58.5\% improvements over single-agent baselines with different base LLMs. These results highlight the importance of feature decomposition, dependency modeling, context propagation, and workflow-aware agent design for end-to-end software development. Moreover, our work summarizes practical insights for designing iterative, LLM-driven development frameworks and informs future training of base LLMs to better support iterative software development.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 近期，大型语言模型智能体的进展为从自然语言需求出发自动化端到端软件开发带来了希望。然而，现有方法大多采用线性的、瀑布式流水线，这过度简化了现实世界开发的迭代性质，并且难以应对复杂、规模较大的项目。为克服这些局限，我们提出EvoDev，一个受特征驱动开发启发的迭代式软件开发框架。EvoDev将用户需求分解为一组对用户有价值的特征，并构建特征图——一个有向无环图，显式建模特征之间的依赖关系。特征图中的每个特征节点维护多层上下文，包括业务逻辑、软件设计和代码实现，这些上下文沿依赖关系传播，为后续开发迭代提供上下文。我们在具有挑战性的Android开发任务上评估EvoDev，结果表明，与表现最好的基线Claude Code相比，其功能完整性提高了57.3%，同时在不同基础LLM的单智能体基线上实现了16.0%–58.5%的提升。这些结果凸显了特征分解、依赖建模、上下文传播和工作流感知智能体设计对端到端软件开发的重要性。此外，我们的工作总结了设计迭代式、LLM驱动开发框架的实用见解，并为未来基础LLM的训练提供参考，以更好地支持迭代式软件开发。

import_candidates.title: Silence of Commit Messages: An Empirical Study for Vulnerability Commit Message Generation using Large Language Models
import_candidates.abstract: The vulnerability commit message serves as crucial metadata for maintaining software within version control systems. Nonetheless, manually crafted vulnerability commit messages often lack detail or exhibit inconsistent formatting. Recently, the growing use of Large Language Models (LLMs) for code and natural language comprehension has opened avenues to automate the crafting of these messages. This paper systematically and thoroughly explores the generation of security patch commit messages in the context of LLMs, delving into topics such as dataset construction, evaluation method design, and the relationship between vulnerability types and submission structure. First, we explore the elements of commit messages using LLMs and integrate a questionnaire survey to pinpoint four essential types of information: summary, background, impact, and fix, which are essential for developers. This aims to establish a structured dataset of bug submissions and assess its quality. Next, we examine general automated evaluation techniques for assessing LLM-generated commit messages and find that GPT-3.5's evaluation methods align more closely with human judgment. Then, we conduct an organized investigation into how LLM generation effects vary across three principal vulnerability types, uncovering that LLMs' adaptability differs across vulnerabilities. Furthermore, we perform an exhaustive examination of generation quality across various components and find that LLMs excel at generating summaries but struggle to produce impact details. In particular, the smallest DeepSeek-Coder shows a semantic retention advantage in crafting backgrounds, whereas DeepSeek-V3 struggles with impact aspects. Lastly, we investigate the effects of different prompting strategies (e.g., zero-shot, few-shot prompts) and parameter settings (e.g., temperature and top_p) on the quality of commit message generation, finding that prompt and parameter configurations critically influence output quality, with model sensitivity varying.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 漏洞提交信息是版本控制系统中维护软件的关键元数据。然而，人工编写的漏洞提交信息往往缺乏细节或格式不一致。近年来，大型语言模型（LLM）在代码和自然语言理解方面的日益广泛使用，为自动化编写这些信息开辟了途径。本文系统而深入地探讨了在LLM背景下生成安全补丁提交信息的问题，涉及数据集构建、评估方法设计以及漏洞类型与提交结构之间的关系等主题。首先，我们使用LLM探索提交信息的要素，并结合问卷调查，确定了四类对开发者至关重要的信息：摘要、背景、影响和修复。这旨在建立一个结构化的缺陷提交数据集并评估其质量。接着，我们研究了评估LLM生成的提交信息的一般自动化评估技术，发现GPT-3.5的评估方法与人类判断更为一致。然后，我们系统地调查了LLM生成效果在三种主要漏洞类型上的差异，发现LLM的适应性因漏洞而异。此外，我们对各个组件的生成质量进行了详尽检查，发现LLM擅长生成摘要，但难以生成影响细节。特别是，最小的DeepSeek-Coder在编写背景方面表现出语义保留优势，而DeepSeek-V3在影响方面表现不佳。最后，我们研究了不同提示策略（如零样本、少样本提示）和参数设置（如温度和top_p）对提交信息生成质量的影响，发现提示和参数配置对输出质量有重要影响，且模型敏感性各不相同。

import_candidates.title: Characterizing and Repairing Obsolete Android GUI Tests under UI Evolution
import_candidates.abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) tests are widely used in regression testing of mobile applications (apps) to validate app behavior from the user's perspective. However, frequent app evolution, such as UI redesigns and feature updates, often renders existing GUI tests obsolete, even when underlying functionality remains unchanged. Automatically repairing such tests is critical for maintaining test suites and reducing substantial manual effort. Despite the practical importance, there is still a lack of a systematic understanding of the characteristics of obsolete GUI tests and a publicly available benchmark to support their study. To fill this gap, we construct a benchmark comprising 736 obsolete GUI tests collected from 36 real-world mobile apps across 668 historical versions. We then conduct a large-scale empirical study that reveals two major challenges in repairing obsolete GUI tests: First, identifying the intended target widget is difficult because widget attributes are frequently missing or unstable, and visually similar widgets may correspond to different functionalities. Second, the target widget is often no longer directly reachable from the failure state, as it may be hidden behind additional UI interactions or relocated to another page. To address these challenges, we further propose GUIRevive, an automated GUI test repair approach that addresses semantic ambiguity in widget identification and target unreachability under UI evolution by integrating semantic-aware reasoning, functionality-preserving validation, and goal-guided UI exploration. Our evaluation shows that GUIRevive successfully repairs 86.4\% of obsolete GUI tests and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art repair techniques by up to 220\%. Moreover, GUIRevive has been deployed in industrial settings, achieving a 93\% repair success rate on industrial mobile apps.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 图形用户界面（GUI）测试广泛用于移动应用程序（app）的回归测试，以从用户角度验证app行为。然而，频繁的app演化（如UI重新设计和功能更新）往往使现有GUI测试过时，即使底层功能保持不变。自动修复此类测试对于维护测试套件和减少大量人工工作至关重要。尽管具有实际重要性，但目前仍缺乏对过时GUI测试特征的系统性理解以及支持其研究的公开基准。为填补这一空白，我们构建了一个基准，包含从36个真实世界移动app的668个历史版本中收集的736个过时GUI测试。随后，我们进行了一项大规模实证研究，揭示了修复过时GUI测试中的两个主要挑战：第一，由于widget属性经常缺失或不稳定，且视觉相似的widget可能对应不同功能，识别预期目标widget很困难。第二，目标widget通常无法从失败状态直接到达，因为它可能隐藏在额外的UI交互之后或已重新定位到另一个页面。为应对这些挑战，我们进一步提出GUIRevive，一种自动化GUI测试修复方法，通过集成语义感知推理、功能保持验证和目标引导的UI探索，解决UI演化下widget识别中的语义歧义和目标不可达问题。我们的评估表明，GUIRevive成功修复了86.4%的过时GUI测试，并显著优于最先进的修复技术，最高提升220%。此外，GUIRevive已在工业环境中部署，在工业移动app上达到93%的修复成功率。

import_candidates.title: Project-Scale Statement-Level Fault Localization via Multi-view Semantic Learning and Pairwise Reranking
import_candidates.abstract: Statement-level fault localization (FL) is critical for effective software debugging, as it enables developers to precisely identify faulty lines of code. While traditional spectrum-based, mutation-based, and deep learning-based FL techniques have achieved notable progress, they remain limited in modeling rich fault semantics. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) offer new opportunities for FL due to their strong capacity for semantic understanding and reasoning over bugs. However, existing LLM-based FL approaches largely treat fault localization as isolated, code-centric prediction, limiting their ability to perform the holistic fault reasoning required for precise statement-level localization. In this paper, we propose FaultScape, a novel LLM-based framework for project-scale, statement-level FL that formulates FL as a multi-view semantic learning and reasoning problem. FaultScape addresses the limitations of existing approaches through three key components. First, we introduce a joint contrastive fine-tuning strategy that trains LLMs on large-scale bug-fix data to explicitly learn fault semantics from multiple complementary views. View-specific fault semantics, including code semantics, fault type, root cause, and repair intent, are learned via supervised binary classification, while cross-view semantic consistency is enforced through contrastive learning. These two objectives are jointly optimized within a unified training loss. The fine-tuned models extract multi-view fault likelihoods as semantic features for each suspicious statement. Second, we adopt a dynamic feature integration module that combines these semantic features with spectrum-based and mutation-based execution features, producing an initial suspiciousness statement ranking. Third, we design an LLM-based, test-guided pairwise re-ranking strategy that explicitly compares highly suspicious candidate statements using failing-test context. By estimating relative fault likelihoods through pairwise comparison rather than independent scoring, the model produces a refined statement-level ranking. We evaluate FaultScape on Defects4J v1.2.0, where it localizes 112/171/196 bugs at Top-1/3/5 out of 395, outperforming state-of-the-art DL-based and LLM-based baselines. On leakage-free benchmarks, FaultScape further localizes 11/18/20 bugs at Top-1/3/5 on ConDefects (31 bugs) and 12/21/22 bugs on GHRB (34 bugs), demonstrating strong generalization to unseen projects. These results show that combining multi-view fault semantics with contrastive, failure-guided reasoning substantially improves the effectiveness and robustness of statement-level fault localization.Statement-level fault localization (FL) is critical for effective software debugging, as it enables developers to precisely identify faulty lines of code. On leakage-free benchmarks, FaultScape further localizes 11/18/20 bugs at Top-1/3/5 on ConDefects (31 bugs) and 12/21/22 bugs on GHRB (34 bugs), demonstrating strong generalization to unseen projects. These results show that combining multi-view fault semantics with contrastive, failure-guided reasoning substantially improves the effectiveness and robustness of statement-level fault localization.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 语句级故障定位（FL）对于有效的软件调试至关重要，因为它使开发人员能够精确定位有故障的代码行。尽管传统的基于频谱、基于变异和基于深度学习的FL技术已取得显著进展，但它们在建模丰富的故障语义方面仍然有限。大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展为FL提供了新机会，因为它们对缺陷具有很强的语义理解和推理能力。然而，现有的基于LLM的FL方法在很大程度上将故障定位视为孤立的、以代码为中心的预测，限制了它们执行精确语句级定位所需的整体故障推理的能力。在本文中，我们提出FaultScape，一种新颖的基于LLM的项目级语句级FL框架，将FL形式化为多视角语义学习和推理问题。FaultScape通过三个关键组件解决现有方法的局限性。首先，我们引入联合对比微调策略，在大规模缺陷修复数据上训练LLM，以从多个互补视角显式学习故障语义。特定视角的故障语义，包括代码语义、故障类型、根本原因和修复意图，通过监督二元分类学习，而跨视角语义一致性通过对比学习强制实现。这两个目标在统一的训练损失中联合优化。微调后的模型为每个可疑语句提取多视角故障似然作为语义特征。其次，我们采用动态特征集成模块，将这些语义特征与基于频谱和基于变异的执行特征相结合，生成初始可疑度语句排名。第三，我们设计了一种基于LLM、测试引导的成对重排序策略，使用失败测试上下文显式比较高度可疑的候选语句。通过成对比较而不是独立评分来估计相对故障似然，模型产生细化的语句级排名。我们在Defects4J v1.2.0上评估FaultScape，在395个缺陷中，其在Top-1/3/5分别定位了112/171/196个缺陷，优于最先进的基于深度学习和基于LLM的基线。在无泄漏基准上，FaultScape在ConDefects（31个缺陷）上Top-1/3/5分别定位了11/18/20个缺陷，在GHRB（34个缺陷）上定位了12/21/22个缺陷，展示了对未见项目的强泛化能力。这些结果表明，将多视角故障语义与对比性、失败引导推理相结合，显著提高了语句级故障定位的有效性和鲁棒性。

import_candidates.title: Lottery scheduling: flexible proportional-share resource management
import_candidates.abstract: This paper presents lottery scheduling, a novel randomized resource allocation mechanism. Lottery scheduling provides efficient, responsive control over the relative execution rates of computations. Such control is beyond the capabilities of conventional schedulers, and is desirable in systems that service requests of varying importance, such as databases, media-based applications, and networks. Lottery scheduling also supports modular resource management by enabling concurrent modules to insulate their resource allocation policies from one another. A currency abstraction is introduced to flexibly name, share, and protect resource rights. We also show that lottery scheduling can be generalized to manage many diverse resources, such as I/O bandwidth, memory, and access to locks. We have implemented a prototype lottery scheduler for the Mach 3.0 microkernel, and found that it provides flexible and responsive control over the relative execution rates of a wide range of applications. The overhead imposed by our unoptimized prototype is comparable to that of the standard Mach timesharing policy.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的随机化资源分配机制——彩票调度。彩票调度能够高效、灵敏地控制计算执行的相对速率，这种控制能力超出了传统调度器的能力范围，在服务各种重要性请求的系统中（如数据库、媒体应用和网络）尤为可取。彩票调度还支持模块化资源管理，使并发模块能够彼此隔离其资源分配策略。文中引入了货币抽象的概念，以灵活地命名、共享和保护资源权利。同时表明，彩票调度可以被推广用于管理多种多样的资源，如I/O带宽、内存和锁的访问。我们在Mach 3.0微内核上实现了彩票调度器的原型，发现它能灵活而灵敏地控制各种应用程序的相对执行速率。我们未优化的原型所产生的开销与标准Mach分时策略相当。

import_candidates.title: Scheduling for reduced CPU energy
import_candidates.abstract: The energy usage of computer systems is becoming more important, especially for battery operated systems. Displays, disks, and cpus, in that order, use the most energy. Reducing the energy used by displays and disks has been studied elsewhere; this paper considers a new method for reducing the energy used by the cpu. We introduce a new metric for cpu energy performance, millions-of-instructions-per-joule (MIPJ). We examine a class of methods to reduce MIPJ that are characterized by dynamic control of system clock speed by the operating system scheduler. Reducing clock speed alone does not reduce MIPJ, since to do the same work the system must run longer. However, a number of methods are available for reducing energy with reduced clock-speed, such as reducing the voltage [Chandrakasan et al 1992][Horowitz 1993] or using reversible [Younis and Knight 1993] or adiabatic logic [Athas et al 1994].What are the right scheduling algorithms for taking advantage of reduced clock-speed, especially in the presence of applications demanding ever more instructions-per-second? We consider several methods for varying the clock speed dynamically under control of the operating system, and examine the performance of these methods against workstation traces. The primary result is that by adjusting the clock speed at a fine grain, substantial CPU energy can be saved with a limited impact on performance.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 计算机系统的能耗正变得越来越重要，特别是对于电池供电的系统。显示器、磁盘和CPU按顺序消耗最多的能量。降低显示器和磁盘能耗的方法已在别处研究；本文考虑一种降低CPU能耗的新方法。我们引入了一个新的CPU能耗性能指标：每焦耳百万条指令（MIPJ）。我们研究了一类通过操作系统调度器动态控制系统时钟速度来降低MIPJ的方法。仅降低时钟速度并不能降低MIPJ，因为要完成同样的工作，系统必须运行更长时间。然而，有许多方法可以在降低时钟速度的同时减少能耗，例如降低电压[Chandrakasan等，1992]、使用可逆逻辑[Younis和Knight，1993]或绝热逻辑[Athas等，1994]。在需要每秒更多指令的应用存在的情况下，正确的调度算法是什么？我们考虑了在操作系统控制下动态改变时钟速度的几种方法，并根据工作站轨迹检验了这些方法的性能。主要结果是，通过细粒度地调整时钟速度，可以在对性能影响有限的情况下节省大量CPU能耗。

import_candidates.title: Storage alternatives for mobile computers
import_candidates.abstract: Mobile computers such as notebooks, subnotebooks, and palmtops require low weight, low power consumption, and good interactive performance. These requirements impose many challenges on architectures and operating systems. This paper investigates three alternative storage devices for mobile computers: magnetic hard disks, flash memory disk emulators, and flash memory cards.We have used hardware measurements and trace-driven simulation to evaluate each of the alternative storage devices and their related design strategies. Hardware measurements on an HP OmniBook 300 highlight differences in the performance of the three devices as used on the Omnibook, especially the poor performance of version 2.00 of the Microsoft Flash File System [11] when accessing large files. The traces used in our study came from different environments, including mobile computers (Macintosh Power-Books) and desktop computers (running Windows or HPUX), as well as synthetic workloads. Our simulation study shows that flash memory can reduce energy consumption by an order of magnitude, compared to magnetic disk, while providing good read performance and acceptable write performance. These energy savings can translate into a 22\% extension of battery life. We also find that the amount of unused memory in a flash memory card has a substantial impact on energy consumption, performance, and endurance: compared to low storage utilizations (40\% full), running flash memory near its capacity (95\% full) can increase energy consumption by 70-190\%, degrade write response time by 30\%, and decrease the lifetime of the memory card by up to a third. For flash disks, asynchronous erasure can improve write response time by a factor of 2.5.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 笔记型电脑、亚笔记本和掌上电脑等移动计算机需要低重量、低功耗和良好的交互性能。这些需求对体系结构和操作系统提出了许多挑战。本文研究了三种移动计算机的替代存储设备：磁性硬盘、闪存磁盘模拟器和闪存卡。我们利用硬件测量和轨迹驱动模拟来评估每种替代存储设备及其相关设计策略。在HP OmniBook 300上的硬件测量突出了三种设备在Omnibook上使用时性能的差异，特别是微软Flash文件系统2.00版本在访问大文件时的糟糕性能。我们研究中使用的轨迹来自不同环境，包括移动电脑（Macintosh PowerBooks）和桌面电脑（运行Windows或HPUX），以及合成工作负载。我们的模拟研究表明，与磁盘相比，闪存可以将能耗降低一个数量级，同时提供良好的读取性能和可接受的写入性能。这些节能可以转化为电池寿命延长22\%。我们还发现，闪存卡中未使用的内存量对能耗、性能和耐久性有显著影响：与低存储利用率（40\%满）相比，闪存在接近其容量（95\%满）下运行可使能耗增加70-190\%，写入响应时间降低30\%，并使存储卡的寿命缩短三分之一。对于闪存磁盘，异步擦除可以将写入响应时间提高2.5倍。

import_candidates.title: Opportunistic log: efficient installation reads in a reliable storage server
import_candidates.abstract: In a distributed storage system, client caches managed on the basis of small granularity objects can provide better memory utilization then page-based caches. However, object servers, unlike page servers, must perform additional disk reads. These installation reads are required to install modified objects onto their corresponding disk pages. The opportunistic log is a new technique that significantly reduces the cost of installation reads. It defers the installation reads, removing them from the modification commit path, and manages a large pool of pending installation reads that can be scheduled efficiently.Using simulations, we show that the opportunistic log substantially enhances the I/O performance of reliable storage servers. An object server without the opportunistic log requires much better client caching to outperform a page server. With an opportunistic log, only a small client cache improvement suffices.Our results imply that efficient scheduling of installation reads can substantially improve the performance of large-scale storage systems and therefore introduces a new performance tradeoff between page-based and object-based architectures.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在分布式存储系统中，基于小粒度对象管理的客户端缓存可以提供比基于页面的缓存更好的内存利用率。然而，与页面服务器不同，对象服务器必须执行额外的磁盘读取。这些安装读取是必要的，用于将修改后的对象安装到对应的磁盘页面上。机会性日志是一种显著降低安装读取成本的新技术。它延迟安装读取，将其移出修改提交路径，并管理一个大量待处理安装读取的池，以便高效调度。通过模拟，我们表明机会性日志显著提高了可靠存储服务器的I/O性能。没有机会性日志的对象服务器需要更好的客户端缓存才能超越页面服务器。有了机会性日志，只需很小的客户端缓存改进就足够了。我们的结果表明，高效的安装读取调度可以显著提高大规模存储系统的性能，从而在基于页面和基于对象的架构之间引入了新的性能权衡。

import_candidates.title: Metadata update performance in file systems
import_candidates.abstract: Structural changes, such as file creation and block allocation, have consistently been identified as file system performance problems in many user environments. We compare several implementations that maintain metadata integrity in the event of a system failure but do not require changes to the on-disk structures. In one set of schemes, the file system uses asynchronous writes and passes ordering requirements to the disk scheduler. These scheduler-enforced ordering schemes outperform the conventional approach (synchronous writes) by more than 30 percent for metadata update intensive benchmarks, but are suboptimal mainly due to their inability to safely use delayed writes when ordering is required. We therefore introduce soft updates, an implementation that asymptotically approaches memory-based file system performance (within 5 percent) while providing stronger integrity and security guarantees than most UNIX file systems. For metadata update in-tensive benchmarks, this improves performance by more than a factor of two when compared to the conventional approach.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 结构性变化，例如文件创建和块分配，在许多用户环境中一直被认为是文件系统的性能问题。我们比较了几种在系统故障时保持元数据完整性但不需要更改磁盘结构的实现方案。在一组方案中，文件系统使用异步写入并将排序要求传递给磁盘调度器。这些由调度器强制排序的方案在元数据更新密集型基准测试中比传统方法（同步写入）性能提高超过30%，但其次优之处主要在于当需要排序时无法安全地使用延迟写入。因此，我们引入了软更新（soft updates），这是一种渐近接近基于内存的文件系统性能（5%以内）的实现，同时比大多数UNIX文件系统提供更强的完整性和安全保证。对于元数据更新密集型基准测试，与传统方法相比，性能提升超过两倍。

import_candidates.title: Disk-directed I/O for MIMD multiprocessors
import_candidates.abstract: Many scientific applications that run on today's multiprocessors, such as weather forecasting and seismic analysis, are bottlenecked by their file-I/O needs. Even if the multiprocessor is configured with sufficient I/O hardware, the file-system software often fails to provide the available bandwidth to the application. Although libraries and enhanced file-system interfaces can make a significant improvement, we believe that fundamental changes are needed in the file-server software. We propose a new technique, disk-directed I/O, to allow the disk servers to determine the flow of data for maximum performance. Our simulations show that tremendous performance gains are possible. Indeed, disk-directed I/O provided consistent high performance that was largely independent of data distribution, obtained up to 93\% of peak disk bandwidth, and was as much as 16 times faster than traditional parallel file systems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 当今多处理器上运行的许多科学应用（如天气预报和地震分析）都受到文件I/O需求的瓶颈限制。即使多处理器配置了足够的I/O硬件，文件系统软件也往往无法为应用提供可用的带宽。虽然库和增强的文件系统接口可以带来显著改进，但我们认为文件服务器软件需要根本性的变革。我们提出了一种新技术——磁盘导向I/O，让磁盘服务器决定数据流以实现最大性能。我们的模拟表明，可以获得巨大的性能提升。实际上，磁盘导向I/O提供了持续的高性能，其性能在很大程度上独立于数据分布，最高可达峰值磁盘带宽的93%，并且比传统并行文件系统快多达16倍。

import_candidates.title: Message-driven relaxed consistency in a software distributed shared memory
import_candidates.abstract: Message-passing and distributed shared memory have their respective advantages and disadvantages in distributed parallel programming. We approach the problem of integrating both mechanisms into a single system by proposing a new message-driven coherency mechanism. Messages carrying explicit causality annotations are exchanged to trigger memory coherency actions. By adding annotations to standard message-based protocols, it is easy to construct efficient implementations of common synchronization and communication mechanisms. Because these are user-level messages, the set of available primitives is extended easily with language-or application-specific mechanisms. CarlOS, an experimental prototype for evaluating this approach, is derived from the lazy release consistent memory of TreadMarks. We describe the message-driven coherency memory model used in CarlOS, and we examine the performance of several applications.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 消息传递和分布式共享内存在分布式并行编程中各有其优缺点。我们通过提出一种新的消息驱动一致性机制，将两者集成到单个系统中。携带显式因果注释的消息被交换以触发内存一致性操作。通过向基于消息的标准协议添加注释，可以轻松构建常见同步和通信机制的高效实现。由于这些是用户级消息，可用原语集可以轻松扩展语言或应用特定的机制。CarlOS是一个用于评估该方法的实验原型，它源自TreadMarks的宽松释放一致性内存。我们描述了CarlOS中使用的消息驱动一致性内存模型，并检查了几个应用程序的性能。

import_candidates.title: Software write detection for a distributed shared memory
import_candidates.abstract: Most software-based distributed shared memory (DSM) systems rely on the operating system's virtual memory interface to detect writes to shared data. Strategies based on virtual memory page protection create two problems for a DSM system. First, writes can have high overhead since they are detected with a page fault. As a result, a page must be written many times to amortize the cost of that fault. Second, the size of a virtual memory page is too big to serve as a unit of coherency, inducing false sharing. Mechanisms to handle false sharing can increase runtime overhead and may cause data to be unnecessarily communicated between processors.In this paper, we present a new method for write detection that solves these problems. Our method relies on the compiler and runtime system to detect writes to shared data without invoking the operating system. We measure and compare implementations of a distributed shared memory system using both strategies, virtual memory and compiler/runtime, running a range of applications on a small scale distributed memory multicomputer. We show that the new method has low average write latency and supports fine-grained sharing with low overhead. Further, we show that the dominant cost of write detection with either strategy is due to the mechanism used to handle fine-grain sharing.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大多数基于软件的分布式共享内存（DSM）系统依赖操作系统的虚拟内存接口来检测对共享数据的写入。基于虚拟内存页保护策略会给DSM系统带来两个问题。首先，写入开销可能很高，因为需要通过页故障来检测写入，因此必须多次写入一个页才能摊销该故障的成本。其次，虚拟内存页的大小太大，无法作为一致性单元，导致虚假共享。处理虚假共享的机制会增加运行时开销，并可能导致数据在处理器之间不必要地传输。本文提出了一种新的写检测方法来解决这些问题。该方法依靠编译器和运行时系统来检测对共享数据的写入，而无需调用操作系统。我们在小型分布式内存多计算机上运行一系列应用程序，测量并比较了使用两种策略（虚拟内存和编译器/运行时）实现的分布式共享内存系统。我们证明新方法具有较低的平均写入延迟，并支持低开销的细粒度共享。此外，我们表明，无论采用哪种策略，写检测的主要成本都归因于用于处理细粒度共享的机制。

import_candidates.title: The design and evaluation of a shared object system for distributed memory machines
import_candidates.abstract: This paper describes the design and evaluation of SAM, a shared object system for distributed memory machines. SAM is a portable run-time system that provides a global name space and automatic caching of shared data. SAM incorporates mechanisms to address the problem of high communication overheads on distributed memory machines; these mechanisms include tying synchronization to data access, chaotic access to data, prefetching of data, and pushing of data to remote processors. SAM has been implemented on the CM-5, Intel iPSC/860 and Paragon, IBM SP1, and networks of workstations running PVM. SAM applications run on all these platforms without modification.This paper provides an extensive analysis on several complex scientific algorithms written in SAM on a variety of hardware platforms. We find that the performance of these SAM applications depends fundamentally on the scalability of the underlying parallel algorithm, and whether the algorithm's communication requirements can be satisfied by the hardware. Our experience suggests that SAM is successful in allowing programmers to use distributed memory machines effectively with much less programming effort than required today.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文描述了SAM的设计与评估，SAM是一种面向分布式内存机器的共享对象系统。SAM是一个可移植的运行时系统，提供全局命名空间和共享数据的自动缓存。SAM包含解决分布式内存机器高通信开销问题的机制；这些机制包括将同步与数据访问绑定、数据混沌访问、数据预取以及将数据推送到远程处理器。SAM已在CM-5、Intel iPSC/860和Paragon、IBM SP1以及运行PVM的工作站网络上实现。SAM应用程序无需修改即可在所有平台上运行。本文对在多种硬件平台上用SAM编写的几个复杂科学算法进行了广泛分析。我们发现，这些SAM应用程序的性能从根本上取决于底层并行算法的可扩展性，以及该算法的通信需求是否能被硬件满足。我们的经验表明，SAM成功地将程序员从对分布式内存机器的低效使用中解放出来，并且所需的编程工作量远少于当前所需。

import_candidates.title: Performance issues in parallelized network protocols
import_candidates.abstract: Parallel processing has been proposed as a means of improving network protocol throughput. Several different strategies have been taken towards parallelizing protocols. A relatively popular approach is packet-level parallelism, where packets are distributed across processors.This paper provides an experimental performance study of packet-level parallelism on a contemporary shared-memory multiprocessor. We examine several unexplored areas in packet-level parallelism and investigate how various protocol structuring and implementation techniques can affect performance. We study TCP/IP and UDP/IP protocol stacks, implemented with a parallel version of the x-kernel running in user space on Silicon Graphics multiprocessors.Our results show that only limited packet-level parallelism can be achieved within a single connection under TCP, but that using multiple connections can improve available parallelism. We also demonstrate that packet ordering plays a key role in determining single-connection TCP performance, that careful use of locks is a necessity, and that selective exploitation of caching can improve throughput. We also describe experiments that compare parallel protocol performance on two generations of a parallel machine and show how computer architectural trends can influence performance.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 并行处理已被提议作为提高网络协议吞吐量的一种手段。在协议并行化上采取了多种不同策略。一种相对流行的方法是包级并行，其中数据包被分配到多个处理器。本文对当代共享内存多处理器上的包级并行进行了实验性能研究。我们考察了包级并行中若干未探索的领域，并调查了各种协议结构和实现技术如何影响性能。我们研究了基于并行版本的x-kernel实现的TCP/IP和UDP/IP协议栈，运行在Silicon Graphics多处理器的用户空间。我们的结果表明，在TCP下单个连接内只能实现有限的包级并行性，但使用多个连接可以提高可用的并行性。我们还证明，包序在决定单连接TCP性能中起关键作用，仔细使用锁是必要的，选择性利用缓存可以提高吞吐量。我们还描述了在一台并行机器的两代产品上比较并行协议性能的实验，并展示了计算机体系结构趋势如何影响性能。

import_candidates.title: Experiences with locking in a NUMA multiprocessor operating system kernel
import_candidates.abstract: We describe the locking architecture of a new operating system, HURRICANE, designed for large scale shared-memory multiprocessors. Many papers already describe kernel locking techniques, and some of the techniques we use have been previously described by others. However, our work is novel in the particular combination of techniques used, as well as several of the individual techniques themselves. Moreover, it is the way the techniques work together that is the source of our performance advantages and scalability. Briefly, we use: • a hybrid coarse-grain/fine-grain locking strategy that has the low latency and space overhead of a coarse-grain locking strategy while having the high concurrency of a fine-grain locking strategy; • replication of data structures to increase access bandwidth and improve concurrency; • a clustered kernel that bounds the number of processors that can compete for a lock so as to reduce second order effects such as memory and interconnect contention; • Distributed Locks to further reduce second order effects, with modifications that reduce the uncontended latency of these locks to close to that of spin locks.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们描述了一个面向大规模共享内存多处理器设计的新操作系统HURRICANE的锁架构。已有许多论文描述了内核锁技术，我们使用的某些技术也已被他人描述过。然而，我们的工作在新颖之处在于所采用的特定技术组合，以及若干独立技术本身。而且，正是这些技术协同工作的方式带来了我们的性能优势和可扩展性。简言之，我们使用了：• 一种混合粗粒度/细粒度锁策略，它兼具粗粒度锁策略的低延迟和低空间开销，同时拥有细粒度锁策略的高并发性；• 复制数据结构以增加访问带宽并提高并发性；• 集群化内核，限制可竞争同一把锁的处理器数量，以减少内存和互连争用等二阶效应；• 分布式锁以进一步减少二阶效应，并对其进行了修改，使无竞争状态下的延迟接近自旋锁。

import_candidates.title: HiPEC: high performance external virtual memory caching
import_candidates.abstract: Traditional operating systems use a fixed LRU-like page replacement policy and centralized frame pool that cannot properly serve all types of memory access patterns of various applications As a result many memory-intensive applications such as databases multimedia applications and scientific simulators induce excessive page faults and page replacement when running on top of existing operating systems.This paper presents a High Performance External virtual memory Caching mechanism (HiPEC) to provide applications with their own specific page replacement management. The user specific policy programmed in the HiPEC command set is stored in user address space. When a page fault occurs the kernel fetches and interprets the corresponding policy commands to perform the user specific page replacement management. Experimental results show that HiPEC induces little overhead and can significantly improve performance for memory-intensive applications.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 传统操作系统使用固定的类LRU页面替换策略和集中式帧池，无法适当地服务于各种应用程序的各种内存访问模式。因此，许多内存密集型应用程序（如数据库、多媒体应用和科学模拟器）在现有操作系统上运行时，会引发过度的缺页错误和页面替换。本文提出了一种高性能外部虚拟内存缓存机制（HiPEC），为应用程序提供它们自己的特定页面替换管理。在HiPEC命令集中编程的用户特定策略存储在用户地址空间中。当缺页错误发生时，内核获取并解释相应的策略命令，以执行用户特定的页面替换管理。实验结果表明，HiPEC引入的开销很小，并且可以显著提高内存密集型应用的性能。

import_candidates.title: Implementation and performance of application-controlled file caching
import_candidates.abstract: Traditional file system implementations do not allow applications to control file caching replacement decisions. We have implemented two-level replacement, a scheme that allows applications to control their own cache replacement, while letting the kernel control the allocation of cache space among processes. We designed an interface to let applications exert control on replacement via a set of directives to the kernel. This is effective and requires low overhead.We demonstrate that for applications that do not perform well under traditional caching policies, the combination of good application-chosen replacement strategies, and our kernel allocation policy LRU-SP, can reduce the number of block I/Os by up to 80\%, and can reduce the elapsed time by up to 45\%. We also show that LRU-SP is crucial to the performance improvement for multiple concurrent applications: LRU-SP fairly distributes cache blocks and offers protection against foolish applications.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 传统文件系统实现不允许应用程序控制文件缓存的替换决策。我们实现了两级替换方案，该方案允许应用程序控制自身的缓存替换，同时让内核控制各进程间缓存空间的分配。我们设计了一个接口，让应用程序通过一组内核指令来施加对替换策略的控制。这种方法有效且开销较低。我们证明，对于在传统缓存策略下表现不佳的应用程序，良好的应用程序自选替换策略与我们的内核分配策略 LRU-SP 相结合，可以减少最多 80% 的块 I/O，并缩短最多 45% 的运行时间。我们还表明，对于多个并发应用，LRU-SP 对性能提升至关重要：它能公平地分配缓存块，并防止轻率应用程序造成干扰。

import_candidates.title: A caching model of operating system kernel functionality
import_candidates.abstract: Operating system research has endeavored to develop micro-kernels that provide modularity, reliability and security improvements over conventional monolithic kernels. However, the resulting kernels have been slower, larger and more error-prone than desired. These efforts have also failed to provide sufficient application control of resource management required by sophisticated applications.This paper describes a caching model of operating system functionality as implemented in the Cache Kernel, the supervisor-mode component of the V++ operating system. The Cache Kernel caches operating system objects such as threads and address spaces just as conventional hardware caches memory data. User-mode application kernels handle the loading and writeback of these objects, implementing application-specific management policies and mechanisms. Experience with implementing the Cache Kernel and measurements of its performance on a multiprocessor suggest that the caching model can provide competitive performance with conventional monolithic operating systems, yet provides application-level control of system resources, better modularity, better scalability, smaller size and a basis for fault containment.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 操作系统研究一直致力于开发微内核，以提供比传统单内核更好的模块化、可靠性和安全性。然而，由此产生的内核比期望的更慢、更大且更容易出错。这些努力也未能为复杂应用提供所需的资源管理控制。本文描述了在V++操作系统的监管模式组件Cache Kernel中实现的操作系统功能的缓存模型。Cache Kernel像传统硬件缓存内存数据一样缓存线程和地址空间等操作系统对象。用户态应用内核负责这些对象的加载和写回，实现应用特定的管理策略和机制。在Cache Kernel上的实现经验及在多处理器上的性能测量表明，缓存模型可以提供与传统单内核操作系统相当的性能，同时提供应用级的系统资源控制、更好的模块化、更好的可扩展性、更小的体积以及故障隔离的基础。

import_candidates.title: Distributed filaments: efficient fine-grain parallelism on a cluster of workstations
import_candidates.abstract: A fine-grain parallel program is one in which processes are typically small ranging from a few to a few hundred instructions. Fine-grain parallelism arises naturally in many situations such as iterative grid computations recursive fork/join programs the bodies of parallel FOR loops and the implicit parallelism in functional or dataflow languages. It is useful both to describe massively parallel computations and as a target for code generation by compilers. However fine-grain parallelism has long been thought to be inefficient due to the overheads of process creation context switching, and synchronization. This paper describes a software kernel. Distributed Filaments (DF) that implements fine-grain parallelism both portably and efficiently on a workstation cluster DF runs on existing off-the-shelf hardware and software. It has a simple interface so it is easy to use. DF achieves e ciency by using stateless threads on each node overlapping communication and computation, employing a new reliable datagram communication protocol and automatically balancing the work generated by fork/join computations.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 细粒度并行程序是指进程通常很小（从几条到几百条指令）的程序。细粒度并行在多种情况下自然出现，例如迭代网格计算、递归分叉/汇合程序、并行FOR循环体以及函数式或数据流语言中的隐式并行。它既可用于描述大规模并行计算，也可作为编译器代码生成的目标。然而，由于进程创建、上下文切换和同步的开销，细粒度并行长期以来被认为效率低下。本文描述了一个软件内核——分布式细丝（DF），它能在工作站集群上可移植且高效地实现细粒度并行。DF在现有的现成硬件和软件上运行，具有简单的接口，易于使用。DF通过在每个节点上使用无状态线程，重叠通信与计算，采用新的可靠数据报通信协议，并自动平衡fork/join计算产生的工作来实现高效。

import_candidates.title: Integrating coherency and recoverability in distributed systems
import_candidates.abstract: We propose a technique for maintaining coherency of a transactional distributed shared memory, used by applications accessing a shared persistent store. Our goal is to improve support for fine-grained distributed data sharing in collaborative design applications, such as CAD systems and software development environments. In contrast, traditional research in distributed shared memory has focused on supporting parallel programs; in this paper, we show how distributed programs can benefit from this shared-memory abstraction as well.Our approach, called log-based coherency, integrates coherency support with a standard mechanism for ensuring recoverability of persistent data. In our system, transaction logs are the basis of both recoverability and coherency. We have prototyped log-based coherency as a set of extensions to RVM [Satyanarayanan et al. 94], a runtime package supporting recoverable virtual memory. Our prototype adds coherency support to RVM in a simple way that does not require changes to existing RVM applications. We report on our prototype and its performance, and discuss its relationship to other DSM systems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种维护事务性分布式共享内存一致性的技术，该技术用于访问共享持久存储的应用程序。我们的目标是改进协作设计应用程序（如CAD系统和软件开发环境）中细粒度分布式数据共享的支持。相比之下，传统的分布式共享内存研究侧重于支持并行程序；在本文中，我们展示了分布式程序如何也能从这种共享内存抽象中受益。我们的方法称为基于日志的一致性，它将一致性支持与确保持久数据可恢复性的标准机制集成在一起。在我们的系统中，事务日志既是可恢复性也是一致性的基础。我们已经将基于日志的一致性原型化为RVM（一种支持可恢复虚拟内存的运行时包）的一组扩展。我们的原型以一种简单的方式向RVM添加了一致性支持，而无需更改现有的RVM应用程序。我们报告了我们的原型及其性能，并讨论了它与其他DSM系统的关系。

import_candidates.title: Garbage collection and DSM consistency
import_candidates.abstract: This paper presents the design of a copying garbage collector for persistent distributed shared objects in a loosely coupled network with weakly consistent distributed shared memory (DSM). The main goal of the design for this garbage collector is to minimize the communication overhead due to collection between nodes of the system, and to avoid any interference with the DSM memory consistency protocol. Our design is based on the observation that, in a weakly consistent DSM system, the memory consistency requirements of the garbage collector are less strict than those of the applications. Thus, the garbage collector reclaims objects independently of other copies of the same objects without interfering with the DSM consistency protocol. Furthermore, our design does not require reliable communication support, and is capable of reclaiming distributed cycles of dead objects.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种在松散耦合网络和弱一致分布式共享内存（DSM）环境下，针对持久化分布式共享对象的复制式垃圾收集器设计。该垃圾收集器的主要设计目标是最大限度减少因节点间收集而产生的通信开销，并避免干扰DSM内存一致性协议。我们的设计基于以下观察：在弱一致DSM系统中，垃圾收集器的内存一致性要求比应用程序更宽松。因此，垃圾收集器可以独立于同一对象的其他副本回收对象，而不会干扰DSM一致性协议。此外，我们的设计不需要可靠的通信支持，并且能够回收分布式死对象循环。

import_candidates.title: Software prefetching and caching for translation lookaside buffers
import_candidates.abstract: A number of interacting trends in operating system structure, processor architecture, and memory systems are increasing both the rate of translation lookaside buffer (TLB) misses and the cost of servicing amiss. This paper presents two novel software schemes, implemented under Mach 3.0, to decrease both the number and the cost of kernel TLB misses (i.e., misses on kernel data structures, including user page tables). The first scheme is a new use of prefetching for TLB entries on the IPC path, and the second scheme is a new use of software caching of TLB entries for hierarchical page table organizations.For a range of applications, prefetching decreases the number of kernel TLB misses by 40\% to 50\%, and caching decreases TLB penalties by providing a fast path for over 90\% of the misses. Our caching scheme also decreases the number of nested TLB traps due to the page table hierarchy, reducing the number of kernel TLB miss traps for applications by 20\% to 40\%. Prefetching and caching, when used alone, each improve application performance by up to 3.5\%; when used together, they improve application performance by up to 3\%. On synthetic benchmarks that involve frequent communication among several different address spaces (and thus put more pressure on the TLB), prefetching improves overall performance by about 6\%, caching improves overall performance by about 10\%, and the two used together improve overall performance by about 12\%.Our techniques are very effective in reducing kernel TLB penalties, which currently range from 1\% to 5\% of application runtime for the benchmarks studied. Since processor speeds continue to increase relative to memory speeds, our schemes should be even more effective in improving application performance in future architectures.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 操作系统结构、处理器架构和内存系统中的一系列相互作用趋势正在增加转换后备缓冲区（TLB）缺失的频率以及处理缺失的成本。本文提出了两种在Mach 3.0下实现的新型软件方案，旨在减少内核TLB缺失（即内核数据结构（包括用户页表）上的缺失）的数量和成本。第一种方案是在IPC路径上对TLB条目进行预取的新用途；第二种方案是对分层页表组织的TLB条目进行软件缓存的新用途。对于一系列应用程序，预取将内核TLB缺失数量减少了40%至50%，而缓存通过为超过90%的缺失提供快速路径来减少TLB惩罚。我们的缓存方案还减少了由于页表层级导致的嵌套TLB陷阱数量，使应用程序的内核TLB缺失陷阱减少了20%至40%。单独使用预取和缓存，每项都能使应用程序性能提升高达3.5%；同时使用时，它们能使应用程序性能提升高达3%。在涉及多个不同地址空间之间频繁通信的合成基准测试中（从而对TLB施加更大压力），预取使整体性能提升约6%，缓存约提升10%，两者结合使用约提升12%。我们的技术在减少内核TLB惩罚方面非常有效，在研究的基准测试中，这些惩罚目前占应用程序运行时间的1%至5%。由于处理器速度相对于内存速度持续增长，我们的方案在未来架构中应能更有效地提高应用程序性能。

import_candidates.title: Cooperative caching: using remote client memory to improve file system performance
import_candidates.abstract: Emerging high-speed networks will allow machines to access remote data nearly as quickly as they can access local data. This trend motivates the use of cooperative caching: coordinating the file caches of many machines distributed on a LAN to form a more effective overall file cache. In this paper we examine four cooperative caching algorithms using a trace-driven simulation study. These simulations indicate that for the systems studied cooperative caching can halve the number of disk accesses, improving file system read response time by as much as 73\%. Based on these simulations we conclude that cooperative caching can significantly improve file system read response time and that relatively simple cooperative caching algorithms are sufficient to realize most of the potential performance gain.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 新兴的高速网络将允许机器几乎以访问本地数据的速度访问远程数据。这一趋势推动了协作式缓存的使用：协调局域网中多台机器的文件缓存，以形成一个更有效的整体文件缓存。在本文中，我们利用基于轨迹的模拟研究考察了四种协作式缓存算法。这些模拟表明，对于所研究的系统，协作式缓存可以将磁盘访问次数减半，将文件系统读取响应时间提高多达73%。基于这些模拟，我们得出结论：协作式缓存能够显著提高文件系统的读取响应时间，并且相对简单的协作式缓存算法就足以实现大部分潜在的性能提升。

import_candidates.title: Checking system rules using system-specific, programmer-written compiler extensions
import_candidates.abstract: Systems software such as OS kernels, embedded systems, and libraries must obey many rules for both correctness and performance. Common examples include "accesses to variable A must be guarded by lock B," "system calls must check user pointers for validity before using them," and "message handlers should free their buffers as quickly as possible to allow greater parallelism." Unfortunately, adherence to these rules is largely unchecked.This paper attacks this problem by showing how system implementors can use meta-level compilation (MC) to write simple, system-specific compiler extensions that automatically check their code for rule violations. By melding domain-specific knowledge with the automatic machinery of compilers, MC brings the benefits of language-level checking and optimizing to the higher, "meta" level of the systems implemented in these languages. This paper demonstrates the effectiveness of the MC approach by applying it to four complex, real systems: Linux, OpenBSD, the Xok exokernel, and the FLASH machine's embedded software. MC extensions found roughly 500 errors in these systems and led to numerous kernel patches. Most extensions were less than a hundred lines of code and written by implementors who had a limited understanding of the systems checked.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 系统软件（如操作系统内核、嵌入式系统和库）在正确性和性能方面必须遵守许多规则。常见例子包括“对变量A的访问必须由锁B保护”、“系统调用在用户指针使用前必须检查其有效性”以及“消息处理程序应尽快释放缓冲区以允许更大的并行性”。不幸的是，对这些规则的遵守在很大程度上未被检查。本文通过展示系统实现者如何使用元级编译（meta-level compilation, MC）编写简单的、系统特定的编译器扩展来自动检查其代码是否存在规则违规行为，来解决这一问题。通过将领域特定知识与编译器的自动机制相结合，MC将语言级检查和优化的优势提升到这些语言所实现的系统的更高“元”级别。本文通过对四个复杂的真实系统——Linux、OpenBSD、Xok外核和FLASH机器的嵌入式软件——应用MC方法，证明了MC方法的有效性。MC扩展在这些系统中发现了约500个错误，并促成了许多内核补丁。大多数扩展只有不到一百行代码，且由对被检查系统了解有限的实现者编写。

import_candidates.title: Devil: an IDL for hardware programming
import_candidates.abstract: To keep up with the frantic pace at which devices come out, drivers need to be quickly developed, debugged and tested. Although a driver is a critical system component, the driver development process has made little (if any) progress. The situation is particularly disastrous when considering the hardware operating code (i.e., the layer interacting with the device). Writing this code often relies on inaccurate or incomplete device documentation and involves assembly-level operations. As a result, hard-ware operating code is tedious to write, prone to errors, and hard to debug and maintain.This paper presents a new approach to developing hardware operating code based on an Interface Definition Language (IDL) for hard-ware functionalities, named Devil. This IDL allows a high-level definition of the communication with a device. A compiler automatically checks the consistency of a Devil definition and generates efficient low-level code.Because the Devil compiler checks safety critical properties, the long-awaited notion of robustness for hardware operating code is made possible. Finally, the wide variety of devices that we have already specified (mouse, sound, DMA, interrupt, Ethernet, video, and IDE disk controllers) demonstrates the expressiveness of the Devil language.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 为了跟上设备推出的疯狂节奏，驱动程序需要快速开发、调试和测试。尽管驱动程序是关键的组件，但驱动程序开发过程几乎没有取得进展。在处理硬件操作代码（即与设备交互的层）时，情况尤其糟糕。编写这些代码通常依赖于不准确或不完整的设备文档，并涉及汇编级操作。因此，硬件操作代码编写乏味、容易出错，且难以调试和维护。本文提出了一种基于硬件功能接口定义语言（IDL）的新型硬件操作代码开发方法，名为Devil。该IDL支持对设备通信进行高级定义。编译器自动检查Devil定义的一致性并生成高效的低级代码。由于Devil编译器检查安全关键属性，因此硬件操作代码期待已久的健壮性概念成为可能。最后，我们已经规范化的各种设备（鼠标、声音、DMA、中断、以太网、视频和IDE磁盘控制器）展示了Devil语言的表达力。

import_candidates.title: Taming the memory hogs: using compiler-inserted releases to manage physical memory intelligently
import_candidates.abstract: Out-of-core applications consume physical resources at a rapid rate, causing interactive applications sharing the same machine to exhibit poor response times. This behavior is the result of default resource management strategies in the OS that are inappropriate for memory-intensive applications. Using an approach that integrates compiler analysis with simple OS support and a run-time layer that adapts to dynamic conditions, we have shown that the impact of out-of-core applications on interactive ones can be greatly mitigated. A combination of prefetching pages that will soon be needed, and releasing pages no longer in use results in good throughput for the out-of-core task and good response time for the interactive one. Each class of application performs well according to the metric most important to it. In addition, the OS does not need to attempt to identify these application classes, or modify its default resource management policies in any way. We also observe that when an out-of-core application releases pages, it both improves the response time of interactive tasks, and also improves its own performance through better replacement decisions and reduced memory management overhead.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 外核（超出内存）应用程序会快速消耗物理资源，导致共享同一机器的交互式应用响应时间变差。这一行为是操作系统默认资源管理策略对于内存密集型应用不适用的结果。我们采用一种将编译器分析与简单操作系统支持以及适应动态条件的运行时层相结合的方法，证明了可以大幅减轻外核应用对交互应用的影响。预取即将需要的页面与释放不再使用的页面相结合，使得外核任务获得良好吞吐量，交互任务获得良好响应时间。每类应用都能根据对其最重要的指标表现良好。此外，操作系统无需尝试识别这些应用类别，或以任何方式修改其默认资源管理策略。我们还注意到，当外核应用释放页面时，既改善了交互任务的响应时间，也通过更佳的替换决策和降低内存管理开销改进了其自身性能。

import_candidates.title: Surplus fair scheduling: a proportional-share CPU scheduling algorithm for symmetric multiprocessors
import_candidates.abstract: In this paper, we present surplus fair scheduling (SFS), a proportional-share CPU scheduler designed for symmetric multiprocessors. We first show that the infeasibility of certain weight assignments in multiprocessor environments results in unfairness or starvation in many existing proportional-share schedulers. We present a novel weight readjustment algorithm to translate infeasible weight assignments to a set of feasible weights. We show that weight readjustment enables existing proportional-share schedulers to significantly reduce, but not eliminate, the unfairness in their allocations. We then present surplus fair scheduling, a proportional-share scheduler that is designed explicitly for multiprocessor environments. We implement our scheduler in the Linux kernel and demonstrate its efficacy through an experimental evaluation. Our results show that SFS can achieve proportionate allocation, application isolation and good interactive performance, albeit at a slight increase in scheduling overhead. We conclude from our results that a proportional-share scheduler such as SFS is not only practical but also desirable for server operating systems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文提出剩余公平调度（SFS），一种为对称多处理器设计的比例共享CPU调度器。我们首先表明在多处理器环境中，某些权重分配在可行性上的问题会导致许多现有比例共享调度器出现不公平或饥饿现象。我们提出一种新颖的权重重新调整算法，将不可行的权重分配转换为一组可行权重。我们证明权重重新调整能够使现有比例共享调度器显著减少但不消除其分配中的不公平性。然后我们提出剩余公平调度，这是一种专门为多处理器环境设计的比例共享调度器。我们将调度器实现在Linux内核中，并通过实验评估证明其有效性。结果表明，尽管调度开销略有增加，SFS能够实现比例分配、应用隔离和良好的交互性能。我们得出结论，像SFS这样的比例共享调度器不仅是实用的，而且对于服务器操作系统也是可取的。

import_candidates.title: Performance-driven processor allocation
