import_candidates.abstract: This work is focused on processor allocation in shared-memory multiprocessor systems, where no knowledge of the application is available when applications are submitted. We perform the processor allocation taking into account the characteristics of the application measured at run-time. We want to demonstrate the importance of an accurate performance analysis and the criteria used to distribute the processors. With this aim, we present the SelfAnalyzer, an approach to dynamically analyzing the performance of applications (speedup, efficiency and execution time), and the Performance-Driven Processor Allocation (PDPA), a new scheduling policy that distributes processors considering both the global conditions of the system and the particular characteristics of running applications. This work also defends the importance of the interaction between the medium-term and the long-term scheduler to control the multiprogramming level in the case of the clairvoyant scheduling pol-icies1. We have implemented our proposal in an SGI Origin2000 with 64 processors and we have compared its performance with that of some scheduling policies proposed so far and with the native IRIX scheduling policy. Results show that the combination of the SelfAnalyzer+PDPA with the medium/long-term scheduling interaction outperforms the rest of the scheduling policies evaluated. The evaluation shows that in workloads where a simple equipartition performs well, the PDPA also performs well, and in extreme workloads where all the applications have a bad performance, our proposal can achieve a speedup of 3.9 with respect to an equipartition and 11.8 with respect to the native IRIX scheduling policy.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 这项工作集中于共享内存多处理器系统中的处理器分配，其中在提交应用程序时不知道应用程序的任何信息。我们根据运行时测量的应用程序特征来执行处理器分配。我们想证明准确的性能分析和用于分配处理器的标准的重要性。为此，我们提出了SelfAnalyzer，一种动态分析应用程序性能（加速比、效率和执行时间）的方法，以及性能驱动处理器分配（PDPA），一种新的调度策略，它同时考虑系统的全局条件和运行应用程序的特定特征来分配处理器。这项工作还捍卫了中期调度器和长期调度器之间交互的重要性，以控制先见性调度策略情况下的多程序级别1。我们已经在具有64个处理器的SGI Origin2000上实现了我们的提议，并将其性能与迄今为止提出的一些调度策略以及本机IRIX调度策略进行了比较。结果表明，SelfAnalyzer+PDPA与中期/长期调度交互的组合优于所评估的其他调度策略。评估表明，在简单均分运行良好的工作负载中，PDPA也表现出色；在极端工作负载下（即所有应用程序性能不佳时），与均分相比，我们的提议可以实现3.9的加速比，与本机IRIX调度策略相比可实现11.8的加速比。

import_candidates.title: Policies for dynamic clock scheduling
import_candidates.abstract: Pocket computers are beginning to emerge that provide sufficient processing capability and memory capacity to run traditional desktop applications and operating systems on them. The increasing demand placed on these systems by software is competing against the continuing trend in the design of low-power microprocessors towards increasing the amount of computation per unit of energy. Consequently, in spite of advances in low-power circuit design, the microprocessor is likely to continue to account for a significant portion of the overall power consumption of pocket computers.This paper investigates clock scaling algorithms on the Itsy, an experimental pocket computer that runs a complete, functional multitasking operating system (a version of Linux 2.0.30). We implemented a number of clock scaling algorithms that are used to adjust the processor speed to reduce the power used by the processor. After testing these algorithms, we conclude that currently proposed algorithms consistently fail to achieve their goal of saving power while not causing user applications to change their interactive behavior.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 口袋电脑开始出现，具备足够的处理能力和内存容量来运行传统的桌面应用程序和操作系统。软件对这些系统日益增长的需求，与低功耗微处理器设计领域中增加每单位能量计算量的持续趋势形成竞争。因此，尽管低功耗电路设计取得了进步，微处理器仍可能占据口袋电脑总功耗的显著部分。本文研究了Itsy上的时钟缩放算法，Itsy是一台运行完整的多任务操作系统（Linux 2.0.30的一个版本）的实验性口袋电脑。我们实现了多种时钟缩放算法，用于调整处理器速度以减少处理器功耗。在测试这些算法后，我们得出结论：目前提出的算法始终未能实现节省功耗且不改变用户应用程序交互行为的目标。

import_candidates.title: Towards higher disk head utilization: extracting free bandwidth from busy disk drives
import_candidates.abstract: Freeblock scheduling is a new approach to utilizing more of a disk's potential media bandwidth. By filling rotational latency periods with useful media transfers, 20-50\% of a never-idle disk's bandwidth can often be provided to background applications with no effect on foreground response times. This paper describes freeblock scheduling and demonstrates its value with simulation studies of two concrete applications: segment cleaning and data mining. Free segment cleaning often allows an LFS file system to maintain its ideal write performance when cleaning overheads would otherwise reduce performance by up to a factor of three. Free data mining can achieve over 47 full disk scans per day on an active transaction processing system, with no effect on its disk performance.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 自由块调度是一种利用磁盘潜在介质带宽的新方法。通过在旋转延迟期间填充有用的介质传输，一个从不空闲的磁盘的带宽中通常有20%-50%可以提供给后台应用程序，而对前台响应时间没有影响。本文描述了自由块调度，并通过两个具体应用的模拟研究展示了其价值：段清理和数据挖掘。自由段清理通常能使LFS文件系统在清理开销本会使性能降低至多三倍的情况下，保持其理想的写入性能。自由数据挖掘可以在活跃的事务处理系统上每天实现超过47次全盘扫描，而对其磁盘性能没有影响。

import_candidates.title: Latency management in storage systems
import_candidates.abstract: Storage Latency Estimation Descriptors, or SLEDs, are an API that allow applications to understand and take advantage of the dynamic state of a storage system. By accessing data in the file system cache or high-speed storage first, total I/O workloads can be reduced and performance improved. SLEDs report estimated data latency, allowing users, system utilities, and scripts to make file access decisions based on those retrieval time estimates. SLEDs thus can be used to improve individual application performance, reduce system workloads, and improve the user experience with more predictable behavior.We have modified the Linux 2.2 kernel to support SLEDs, and several Unix utilities and astronomical applications have been modified to use them. As a result, execution times of the Unix utilities when data file sizes exceed the size of the file system buffer cache have been reduced from 50\% up to more than an order of magnitude. The astronomical applications incurred 30-50\% fewer page faults and reductions in execution time of 10-35\%. Performance of applications which use SLEDs also degrade more gracefully as data file size grows.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 存储延迟估计描述符（SLEDs）是一种API，允许应用程序理解并利用存储系统的动态状态。通过优先访问文件系统缓存或高速存储中的数据，可以减少总的I/O工作负载并提高性能。SLEDs报告估计的数据延迟，使用户、系统实用程序和脚本能够基于这些检索时间估计做出文件访问决策。因此，SLEDs可用于提高单个应用程序性能、减少系统工作负载，并通过更可预测的行为改善用户体验。我们修改了Linux 2.2内核以支持SLEDs，并修改了几个Unix实用程序和天文学应用程序以使用它们。结果表明，当数据文件大小超过文件系统缓冲区缓存大小时，Unix实用程序的执行时间减少了50%到超过一个数量级。天文学应用程序的缺页错误减少了30-50%，执行时间减少了10-35%。使用SLEDs的应用程序在数据文件大小增长时，性能下降也更加平缓。

import_candidates.title: A low-overhead high-performance unified buffer management scheme that exploits sequential and looping references
import_candidates.abstract: In traditional file system implementations, the Least Recently Used (LRU) block replacement scheme is widely used to manage the buffer cache due to its simplicity and adaptability. However, the LRU scheme exhibits performance degradations because it does not make use of reference regularities such as sequential and looping references. In this paper, we present a Unified Buffer Management (UBM) scheme that exploits these regularities and yet, is simple to deploy. The UBM scheme automatically detects sequential and looping references and stores the detected blocks in separate partitions of the buffer cache. These partitions are managed by appropriate replacement schemes based on their detected patterns. The allocation problem among the divided partitions is also tackled with the use of the notion of marginal gains. In both trace-driven simulation experiments and experimental studies using an actual implementation in the FreeBSD operating system, the performance gains obtained through the use of this scheme are substantial. The results show that the hit ratios improve by as much as 57.7\% (with an average of 29.2\%) and the elapsed times are reduced by as much as 67.2\% (with an average of 28.7\%) compared to the LRU scheme for the workloads we used.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在传统文件系统实现中，最近最少使用（LRU）块替换方案因其简单性和适应性而被广泛用于管理缓冲区缓存。然而，由于LRU方案未利用顺序引用和循环引用等引用规律性，其性能会退化。本文提出了一种统一缓冲区管理（UBM）方案，该方案利用这些规律性且易于部署。UBM方案自动检测顺序引用和循环引用，并将检测到的块分别存储在缓冲区缓存的不同分区中。这些分区根据检测到的模式由适当的替换方案管理。分区间的分配问题也通过边际收益的概念来解决。在基于轨迹的模拟实验以及使用FreeBSD操作系统实际实现的实验研究中，使用该方案获得的性能提升显著。结果表明，与我们使用的工作负载上的LRU方案相比，命中率最多提升57.7%（平均提升29.2%），运行时间最多减少67.2%（平均减少28.7%）。

import_candidates.title: How to build a trusted database system on untrusted storage
import_candidates.abstract: Some emerging applications require programs to maintain sensitive state on untrusted hosts. This paper presents the architecture and implementation of a trusted database system, TDB, which leverages a small amount of trusted storage to protect a scalable amount of untrusted storage. The database is encrypted and validated against a collision-resistant hash kept in trusted storage, so untrusted programs cannot read the database or modify it undetectably. TDB integrates encryption and hashing with a low-level data model, which protects data and metadata uniformly, unlike systems built on top of a conventional database system. The implementation exploits synergies between hashing and log-structured storage. Preliminary performance results show that TDB outperforms an off-the-shelf embedded database system, thus supporting the suitability of the TDB architecture.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 一些新兴应用需要程序在不可信主机上维护敏感状态。本文介绍了一种可信数据库系统TDB的架构与实现，它利用少量可信存储来保护大规模不可信存储。数据库被加密，并通过存储在可信存储中的抗碰撞哈希进行校验，因此不可信程序无法读取数据库或在不可检测的情况下修改它。TDB将加密和哈希与一种低级数据模型集成，为数据和元数据提供统一保护，这不同于构建在传统数据库系统之上的方案。该实现利用了哈希与日志结构存储之间的协同效应。初步性能结果表明，TDB优于现成的嵌入式数据库系统，从而支持了TDB架构的适用性。

import_candidates.title: End-to-end authorization
import_candidates.abstract: Many boundaries impede the flow of authorization information, forcing applications that span those boundaries into hop-by-hop approaches to authorization. We present a unified approach to authorization. Our approach allows applications that span administrative, network, abstraction, and protocol boundaries to understand the end-to-end authority that justifies any given request. The resulting distributed systems are more secure and easier to audit.We describe boundaries that can interfere with end-to-end authorization, and outline our unified approach. We describe the system we built and the applications we adapted to use our unified authorization system, and measure its costs. We conclude that our system is a practical approach to the desirable goal of end-to-end authorization.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 许多边界阻碍了授权信息的流动，迫使跨越这些边界的应用程序采用逐跳（hop-by-hop）的授权方式。我们提出了一种统一的授权方法。该方法允许跨越管理、网络、抽象和协议边界的应用程序理解证明任何给定请求合理性的端到端权威。由此产生的分布式系统更安全且更易于审计。我们描述了可能干扰端到端授权的边界，并概述了我们的统一方法。我们描述了构建的系统以及为使用统一授权系统而改造的应用程序，并衡量了其成本。我们得出结论，我们的系统是实现端到端授权这一目标的一种实用方法。

import_candidates.title: Self-securing storage: protecting data in compromised system
import_candidates.abstract: Self-securing storage prevents intruders from undetectably tampering with or permanently deleting stored data. To accomplish this, self-securing storage devices internally audit all requests and keep old versions of data for a window of time, regardless of the commands received from potentially compromised host operating systems. Within the window, system administrators have this valuable information for intrusion diagnosis and recovery. Our implementation, called S4, combines log-structuring with journal-based metadata to minimize the performance costs of comprehensive versioning. Experiments show that self-securing storage devices can deliver performance that is comparable with conventional storage systems. In addition, analyses indicate that several weeks worth of all versions can reasonably be kept on state-of-the-art disks, especially when differencing and compression technologies are employed.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 自安全存储可防止入侵者不被察觉地篡改或永久删除存储的数据。为实现这一目标，自安全存储设备会内部审计所有请求，并在一定时间窗口内保留数据的旧版本，无论其收到的来自可能已受损主机操作系统的命令是什么。在该时间窗口内，系统管理员可获得这些宝贵信息以进行入侵诊断和恢复。我们的实现称为S4，它将日志结构技术与基于日志的元数据相结合，以最大限度地降低全面版本化的性能成本。实验表明，自安全存储设备可提供与传统存储系统相当的性能。此外，分析表明，在现有磁盘上合理保留数周的所有版本是可行的，尤其是在使用差分和压缩技术的情况下。

import_candidates.title: Fast and secure distributed read-only file system
import_candidates.abstract: Internet users increasingly rely on publicly available data for everything from software installation to investment decisions. Unfortunately, the vast majority of public content on the Internet comes with no integrity or authenticity guarantees. This paper presents the self-certifying read-only file system, a content distribution system providing secure, scalable access to public, read-only data.The read-only file system makes the security of published content independent from that of the distribution infrastructure. In a secure area (perhaps off-line), a publisher creates a digitally-signed database out of a file system's contents. The publisher then replicates the database on untrusted content-distribution servers, allowing for high availability. The read-only file system protocol furthermore pushes the cryptographic cost of content verification entirely onto clients, allowing servers to scale to a large number of clients. Measurements of an implementation show that an individual server running on a 550 Mhz Pentium III with FreeBSD can support 1,012 connections per second and 300 concurrent clients compiling a large software package.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 互联网用户越来越依赖公开可用的数据进行从软件安装到投资决策的一切活动。不幸的是，互联网上绝大多数公开内容都没有完整性或真实性保证。本文介绍了自认证只读文件系统（self-certifying read-only file system），这是一种提供对公共只读数据进行安全、可扩展访问的内容分发系统。只读文件系统使已发布内容的安全性独立于分发基础设施的安全性。在安全区域（可能离线），发布者使用文件系统的内容创建数字签名的数据库。然后，发布者将数据库复制到不受信任的内容分发服务器上，以实现高可用性。只读文件系统协议还将内容验证的密码学成本完全推给客户端，使服务器能够扩展到大量客户端。对实现的测量表明，一台运行FreeBSD的550 MHz Pentium III服务器每秒可以支持1,012个连接，并能支持300个并发客户端编译大型软件包。

import_candidates.title: Overcast: reliable multicasting with on overlay network
import_candidates.abstract: Overcast is an application-level multicasting system that can be incrementally deployed using today's Internet infrastructure. These properties stem from Overcast's implementation as an overlay network. An overlay network consists of a collection of nodes placed at strategic locations in an existing network fabric. These nodes implement a network abstraction on top of the network provided by the underlying substrate network.Overcast provides scalable and reliable single-source multicast using a simple protocol for building efficient data distribution trees that adapt to changing network conditions. To support fast joins, Overcast implements a new protocol for efficiently tracking the global status of a changing distribution tree.Results based on simulations confirm that Overcast provides its added functionality while performing competitively with IP Multicast. Simulations indicate that Overcast quickly builds bandwidth-efficient distribution trees that, compared to IP Multicast, provide 70\%-100\% of the total bandwidth possible, at a cost of somewhat less than twice the network load. In addition, Overcast adapts quickly to changes caused by the addition of new nodes or the failure of existing nodes without causing undue load on the multicast source.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Overcast是一个应用层多播系统，可以利用当今的互联网基础设施进行增量部署。这些特性源于Overcast作为覆盖网络的实现。覆盖网络由放置在现有网络结构中战略位置的一组节点组成。这些节点在底层网络提供的网络之上实现网络抽象。Overcast通过简单的协议构建高效的数据分发树，并适应变化的网络条件，从而提供可扩展且可靠的单源多播。为了支持快速加入，Overcast实现了一种新协议，以高效跟踪变化的分发树的全局状态。基于仿真的结果确认，Overcast在提供其附加功能的同时，其性能与IP多播相当。仿真表明，Overcast能够快速构建带宽高效的分发树，与IP多播相比，可提供总带宽的70%\%-100%，而代价是网络负载略低于两倍。此外，Overcast能快速适应新节点加入或现有节点故障引起的变化，而不会给多播源带来过重负载。

import_candidates.title: System support for bandwidth management and content adaptation in internet applications
import_candidates.abstract: This paper describes the implementation and evaluation of an operating system module, the Congestion Manager (CM), which provides integrated network flow management and exports a convenient programming interface that allows applications to be notified of, and adapt to, changing network conditions. We describe the API by which applications interface with the CM, and the architectural considerations that factored into the design. To evaluate the architecture and API, we describe our implementations of TCP; a streaming layered audio/video application; and an interactive audio application using the CM, and show that they achieve adaptive behavior without incurring much end-system overhead. All flows including TCP benefit from the sharing of congestion information, and applications are able to incorporate new functionality such as congestion control and adaptive behavior.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文描述了操作系统模块——拥塞管理器（CM）的实现与评估，该模块提供集成的网络流管理，并导出一个便捷的编程接口，使应用程序能够获知并适应不断变化的网络条件。我们描述了应用程序与CM交互的API，以及影响其设计的架构考量。为评估该架构和API，我们描述了使用CM实现的TCP、流式分层音/视频应用和交互式音频应用，并表明它们实现了自适应行为而不会产生太多端系统开销。包括TCP在内的所有流都受益于拥塞信息的共享，应用程序能够整合诸如拥塞控制和自适应行为等新功能。

import_candidates.title: Operating system management of MEMS-based storage devices
import_candidates.abstract: MEMS-based storage devices promise significant performance, reliability, and power improvements relative to disk drives. This paper compares and contrasts these two storage technologies and explores how the physical characteristics of MEMS-based storage devices change four aspects of operating system (OS) management: request scheduling, data placement, failure management, and power conservation. Straightforward adaptations of existing disk request scheduling algorithms are found to be appropriate for MEMS-based storage devices. A new bipartite data placement scheme is shown to better match these devices' novel mechanical positioning characteristics. With aggressive internal redundancy, MEMS-based storage devices can mask and tolerate failure modes that halt operation or cause data loss for disks. In addition, MEMS-based storage devices simplify power management because the devices can be stopped and started rapidly.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 基于MEMS的存储设备相较于磁盘驱动器，承诺在性能、可靠性和功耗方面有显著改进。本文比较和对比了这两种存储技术，并探讨了基于MEMS的存储设备的物理特性如何改变操作系统（OS）管理的四个方面：请求调度、数据放置、故障管理和功耗保护。研究发现，对现有磁盘请求调度算法的直接改编适用于基于MEMS的存储设备。一种新的二分数据放置方案能更好地匹配这些设备新颖的机械定位特性。通过积极的内部冗余，基于MEMS的存储设备可以掩盖和容忍那些会导致磁盘停止运行或数据丢失的故障模式。此外，基于MEMS的存储设备简化了电源管理，因为设备可以快速启动和停止。

import_candidates.title: Trading capacity for performance in a disk array
import_candidates.abstract: A variety of performance-enhancing techniques, such as striping, mirroring, and rotational data replication, exist in the disk array literature. Given a fixed budget of disks, one must intelligently choose what combination of these techniques to employ. In this paper, we present a way of designing disk arrays that can flexibly and systematically reduce seek and rotational delay in a balanced manner. We give analytical models that can guide an array designer towards optimal configurations by considering both disk and workload characteristics. We have implemented a prototype disk array that incorporates the configuration models. In the process, we have also developed a robust disk head position prediction mechanism without any hardware support. The resulting prototype demonstrates the effectiveness of the configuration models.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 磁盘阵列文献中存在多种性能增强技术，如条带化、镜像和旋转数据复制。在磁盘预算固定的情况下，必须智能地选择使用这些技术的组合。本文提出了一种设计磁盘阵列的方法，能够灵活且系统地以均衡的方式减少寻道和旋转延迟。我们给出了分析模型，通过考虑磁盘和工作负载特性，指导阵列设计者实现最优配置。我们实现了一个包含配置模型的原型磁盘阵列。在此过程中，我们还开发了一种无需硬件支持的鲁棒磁头位置预测机制。最终原型验证了配置模型的有效性。

import_candidates.title: Interposed request routing for scalable network storage
import_candidates.abstract: This paper explores interposed request routing in Slice, a new storage system architecture for high-speed networks incorporating network-attached block storage. Slice interposes a request switching filter - called a µproxy - along each client's network path to the storage service (e.g., in a network adapter or switch). The µproxy intercepts request traffic and distributes it across a server ensemble. We propose request routing schemes for I/O and file service traffic, and explore their effect on service structure.The Slice prototype uses a packet filter µproxy to virtualize the standard Network File System (NFS) protocol, presenting to NFS clients a unified shared file volume with scalable bandwidth and capacity. Experimental results from the industry-standard SPECsfs97 workload demonstrate that the architecture enables construction of powerful network-attached storage services by aggregating cost-effective components on a switched Gigabit Ethernet LAN.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文探讨了Slice中的插入式请求路由，Slice是一种面向高速网络的新型存储系统架构，集成了网络附加块存储。Slice在每个客户端通向存储服务的网络路径上（例如在网络适配器或交换机中）插入一个请求交换过滤器——称为µproxy。µproxy拦截请求流量，并将其分发到一组服务器上。我们提出了针对I/O和文件服务流量的请求路由方案，并探讨了它们对服务结构的影响。Slice原型使用一个包过滤µproxy来虚拟化标准的网络文件系统（NFS）协议，向NFS客户端提供一个具有可扩展带宽和容量的统一共享文件卷。来自行业标准SPECsfs97工作负载的实验结果表明，该架构通过在交换式千兆以太网局域网上聚合高性价比组件，能够构建强大的网络附加存储服务。

import_candidates.title: Proactive recovery in a Byzantine-fault-tolerant system
import_candidates.abstract: This paper describes an asynchronous state-machine replication system that tolerates Byzantine faults, which can be caused by malicious attacks or software errors. Our system is the first to recover Byzantine-faulty replicas proactively and it performs well because it uses symmetric rather than public-key cryptography for authentication. The recovery mechanism allows us to tolerate any number of faults over the lifetime of the system provided fewer than 1/3 of the replicas become faulty within a window of vulnerability that is small under normal conditions. The window may increase under a denial-of-service attack but we can detect and respond to such attacks. The paper presents results of experiments showing that overall performance is good and that even a small window of vulnerability has little impact on service latency.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文描述了一个容忍拜占庭故障（可能由恶意攻击或软件错误引起）的异步状态机复制系统。我们的系统是首个主动恢复拜占庭故障副本的系统，并且由于使用对称密码学而非公钥密码学进行认证，其性能表现良好。恢复机制使我们能够容忍系统生命周期内任意数量的故障，前提是在一个正常条件下很小的脆弱性窗口内，故障副本数少于三分之一。该窗口在拒绝服务攻击下可能会增加，但我们能够检测并响应此类攻击。本文展示了实验结果，表明整体性能良好，且即使很小的脆弱性窗口对服务延迟的影响也很小。

import_candidates.title: Exploring failure transparency and the limits of generic recovery
import_candidates.abstract: We explore the abstraction of failure transparency in which the operating system provides the illusion of failure-free operation. To provide failure transparency, an operating system must recover applications after hardware, operating system, and application failures, and must do so without help from the programmer or unduly slowing failure-free performance. We describe two invariants that must be upheld to provide failure transparency: one that ensures sufficient application state is saved to guarantee the user cannot discern failures, and another that ensures sufficient application state is lost to allow recovery from failures affecting application state. We find that several real applications get failure transparency in the presence of simple stop failures with overhead of 0-12\%. Less encouragingly, we find that applications violate one invariant in the course of upholding the other for more than 90\% of application faults and 3-15\% of operating system faults, rendering transparent recovery impossible for these cases.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们探讨了故障透明性抽象，其中操作系统提供无故障运行的假象。为了提供故障透明性，操作系统必须在硬件、操作系统和应用程序故障后恢复应用程序，且无需程序员帮助或不当降低无故障性能。我们描述了必须维护的两个不变量以实现故障透明性：一个确保保存足够的应用程序状态以保证用户无法辨别故障，另一个确保丢失足够的应用程序状态以便从影响应用程序状态的故障中恢复。我们发现，几个真实应用程序在简单停止故障情况下实现了故障透明性，开销为0-12%。不太令人鼓舞的是，我们发现应用程序在维护其中一个不变量的过程中违反了另一个不变量，这在超过90%的应用程序故障和3-15%的操作系统故障中发生，使得对这些情况进行透明恢复变得不可能。

import_candidates.title: Design and evaluation of a continuous consistency model for replicated services
import_candidates.abstract: The tradeoffs between consistency, performance, and availability are well understood. Traditionally, however, designers of replicated systems have been forced to choose from either strong consistency guarantees or none at all. This paper explores the semantic space between traditional strong and optimistic consistency models for replicated services. We argue that an important class of applications can tolerate relaxed consistency, but benefit from bounding the maximum rate of inconsistent access in an application-specific manner. Thus, we develop a set of metrics, Numerical Error, Order Error, and Staleness, to capture the consistency spectrum. We then present the design and implementation of TACT, a middleware layer that enforces arbitrary consistency bounds among replicas using these metrics. Finally, we show that three replicated applications demonstrate significant semantic and performance benefits from using our framework.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 一致性、性能和可用性之间的权衡已被充分理解。然而，传统上，复制系统的设计者被迫只能在强一致性保证或完全无一致性保证之间做出选择。本文探索了传统强一致性与乐观一致性模型之间为复制服务提供的语义空间。我们认为，一类重要的应用程序可以容忍放松的一致性，但受益于以应用特定的方式限制最大不一致访问速率。因此，我们开发了一组指标——数值误差（Numerical Error）、顺序误差（Order Error）和过时性（Staleness）——以捕获一致性谱系。随后，我们展示了TACT的设计与实现，这是一个使用这些指标在副本之间强制实施任意一致性界限的中间件层。最后，我们表明三个复制的应用程序在使用我们的框架时展现出显著的语义和性能优势。

import_candidates.title: Scalable, distributed data structures for internet service construction
import_candidates.abstract: This paper presents a new persistent data management layer designed to simplify cluster-based Internet service construction. This self-managing layer, called a distributed data structure (DDS), presents a conventional single-site data structure interface to service authors, but partitions and replicates the data across a cluster. We have designed and implemented a distributed hash table DDS that has properties necessary for Internet services (incremental scaling of throughput and data capacity, fault tolerance and high availability, high concurrency, consistency, and durability). The hash table uses two-phase commits to present a coherent view of its data across all cluster nodes, allowing any node to service any task. We show that the distributed hash table simplifies Internet service construction by decoupling service-specific logic from the complexities of persistent, consistent state management, and by allowing services to inherit the necessary service properties from the DDS rather than having to implement the properties themselves. We have scaled the hash table to a 128 node cluster, 1 terabyte of storage, and an in-core read throughput of 61,432 operations/s and write throughput of 13,582 operations/s.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的持久化数据管理层，旨在简化基于集群的互联网服务构建。这一自管理层称为分布式数据结构（DDS），向服务作者呈现传统的单站点数据结构接口，但将数据在集群中进行分区和复制。我们设计并实现了一个具备互联网服务所需属性（吞吐量和数据容量的增量扩展、容错和高可用性、高并发、一致性和持久性）的分布式哈希表DDS。该哈希表使用两阶段提交来在集群所有节点间提供一致的数据视图，允许任何节点处理任何任务。我们表明，通过将服务特定逻辑与持久化、一致状态管理的复杂性解耦，并允许服务从DDS继承必要的服务属性而非自行实现，该分布式哈希表简化了互联网服务的构建。我们已将哈希表扩展到128个节点的集群、1太字节存储，以及每秒61,432次操作的内存读取吞吐量和每秒13,582次操作的写入吞吐量。

import_candidates.title: Processes in KaffeOS: isolation, resource management, and sharing in java
import_candidates.abstract: Single-language runtime systems, in the form of Java virtual machines, are widely deployed platforms for executing untrusted mobile code. These runtimes provide some of the features that operating systems provide: inter-application memory protection and basic system services. They do not, however, provide the ability to isolate applications from each other, or limit their resource consumption. This paper describes KaffeOS, a Java runtime system that provides these features. The KaffeOS architecture takes many lessons from operating system design, such as the use of a user/kernel boundary, and employs garbage collection techniques, such as write barriers.The KaffeOS architecture supports the OS abstraction of a process in a Java virtual machine. Each process executes as if it were run in its own virtual machine, including separate garbage collection of its own heap. The difficulty in designing KaffeOS lay in balancing the goals of isolation and resource management against the goal of allowing direct sharing of objects. Overall, KaffeOS is no more than 11\% slower than the freely available JVM on which it is based, which is an acceptable penalty for the safety that it provides. Because of its implementation base, KaffeOS is substantially slower than commercial JVMs for trusted code, but it clearly outperforms those JVMs in the presence of denial-of-service attacks or misbehaving code.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 单一语言运行时系统，以Java虚拟机为形式，是执行不可信移动代码的广泛部署平台。这些运行时提供了操作系统提供的一些特性：应用间内存保护和基本系统服务。然而，它们并不能将应用程序相互隔离或限制其资源消耗。本文描述了KaffeOS，一个提供这些特性的Java运行时系统。KaffeOS架构借鉴了操作系统设计的许多经验，如用户/内核边界的使用，并采用了垃圾收集技术，如写屏障。KaffeOS架构在Java虚拟机中支持操作系统进程的抽象。每个进程都表现得像是在自己的虚拟机中运行，包括对其堆的独立垃圾回收。设计KaffeOS的困难在于平衡隔离和资源管理的目标与允许对象直接共享的目标。总体而言，KaffeOS比其基于的免费JVM慢不超过11%，这是为其提供的安全性所可接受的代价。由于其实现基础，KaffeOS在可信代码上明显慢于商业JVM，但在面对拒绝服务攻击或恶意代码时，它明显优于这些JVM。

import_candidates.title: Knit: component composition for systems software
import_candidates.abstract: Knit is a new component definition and linking language for systems code. Knit helps make C code more understandable and reusable by third parties, helps eliminate much of the performance overhead of componentization, detects subtle errors in component composition that cannot be caught with normal component type systems, and provides a foundation for developing future analyses over C-based components, such as cross-component optimization. The language is especially designed for use with component kits, where standard linking tools provide inadequate support for component configuration. In particular, we developed Knit for use with the OSKit, a large collection of components for building low-level systems. However, Knit is not OSKit-specific, and we have implemented parts of the Click modular router in terms of Knit components to illustrate the expressiveness and flexibility of our language. This paper provides an overview of the Knit language and its applications.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Knit是一种用于系统代码的组件定义和链接语言。Knit有助于使C代码更易于第三方理解和重用，有助于消除组件化的许多性能开销，检测普通组件类型系统无法捕获的组件组合中的细微错误，并为开发基于C组件的未来分析方法（如跨组件优化）提供基础。该语言特别设计用于组件套件，在这些场景中，标准链接工具对组件配置的支持不足。具体而言，我们为OSKit开发了Knit，OSKit是一个用于构建底层系统的大型组件集合。然而，Knit并非OSKit专用，我们还用Knit组件实现了Click模块化路由器的部分功能，以展示我们语言的表现力和灵活性。本文概述了Knit语言及其应用。

import_candidates.title: Farsite: federated, available, and reliable storage for an incompletely trusted environment
import_candidates.abstract: Farsite is a secure, scalable file system that logically functions as a centralized file server but is physically distributed among a set of untrusted computers. Farsite provides file availability and reliability through randomized replicated storage; it ensures the secrecy of file contents with cryptographic techniques; it maintains the integrity of file and directory data with a Byzantine-fault-tolerant protocol; it is designed to be scalable by using a distributed hint mechanism and delegation certificates for pathname translations; and it achieves good performance by locally caching file data, lazily propagating file updates, and varying the duration and granularity of content leases. We report on the design of Farsite and the lessons we have learned by implementing much of that design.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Farsite是一个安全、可扩展的文件系统，它在逻辑上充当集中式文件服务器，但在物理上分布在一组不可信的计算机上。Farsite通过随机化复制存储提供文件可用性和可靠性；它利用密码技术确保文件内容的保密性；通过拜占庭容错协议维护文件和目录数据的完整性；通过使用分布式提示机制和用于路径名转换的委派证书，设计为可扩展；并通过在本地缓存文件数据、惰性传播文件更新以及改变内容租约的持续时间和粒度来实现良好的性能。我们报告了Farsite的设计以及我们在实现该设计的大部分过程中吸取的经验教训。

import_candidates.title: Taming aggressive replication in the Pangaea wide-area file system
import_candidates.abstract: Pangaea is a wide-area file system that supports data sharing among a community of widely distributed users. It is built on a symmetrically decentralized infrastructure that consists of commodity computers provided by the end users. Computers act autonomously to serve data to their local users. When possible, they exchange data with nearby peers to improve the system's overall performance, availability, and network economy. This approach is realized by aggressively creating a replica of a file whenever and wherever it is accessed.This paper presents the design, implementation, and evaluation of the Pangaea file system. Pangaea offers efficient, randomized algorithms to manage highly dynamic and potentially large groups of file replicas. It applies optimistic consistency semantics to replica contents, but it also offers stronger guarantees when required by the users. The evaluation demonstrates that Pangaea outperforms existing distributed file systems in large heterogeneous environments, typical of the Internet and of large corporate intranets.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Pangaea是一个支持广泛分布的用户群体共享数据的广域网文件系统。它建立在由最终用户提供的商用计算机组成的对称去中心化基础设施之上。计算机自主运行，向本地用户提供数据；在可能的情况下，它们与附近的对等节点交换数据，以提升系统的整体性能、可用性和网络经济性。这种方法通过在文件被访问时随时随地激进地创建副本来实现。本文介绍了Pangaea文件系统的设计、实现与评估。Pangaea采用高效的随机化算法来管理高度动态且可能规模巨大的文件副本集合，并对副本内容应用乐观一致性语义，同时在用户需要时提供更强的保障。评估表明，在典型的互联网和大型企业内联网等高度异构环境中，Pangaea的性能优于现有分布式文件系统。

import_candidates.title: Ivy: a read/write peer-to-peer file system
import_candidates.abstract: Ivy is a multi-user read/write peer-to-peer file system. Ivy has no centralized or dedicated components, and it provides useful integrity properties without requiring users to fully trust either the underlying peer-to-peer-storage system or the other users of the file system.An Ivy file system consists solely of a set of logs, one log per participant. Ivy stores its logs in the DHash distributed hash table. Each participant finds data by consulting all logs, but performs modifications by appending only to its own log. This arrangement allows Ivy to maintain meta-data consistency without locking. Ivy users can choose which other logs to trust, an appropriate arrangement in a semi-open peer-to-peer system.Ivy presents applications with a conventional file system interface. When the underlying network is fully connected, Ivy provides NFS-like semantics, such as close-to-open consistency. Ivy detects conflicting modifications made during a partition, and provides relevant version information to application-specific conflict resolvers. Performance measurements on a wide-area network show that Ivy is two to three times slower than NFS.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Ivy是一个多用户读写对等文件系统。Ivy没有中心化或专用组件，并提供有用的完整性保证，无需用户完全信任底层对等存储系统或文件系统中的其他用户。Ivy文件系统仅由一组日志组成，每个参与者一个日志。Ivy将其日志存储在DHash分布式哈希表中。每个参与者通过检查所有日志来查找数据，但仅通过附加到自己的日志来执行修改。这种安排使Ivy无需锁定即可保持元数据一致性。Ivy用户可以选择信任哪些其他日志，这在一个半开放的对等系统中是合适的安排。Ivy向应用程序提供传统的文件系统接口。当底层网络完全连接时，Ivy提供类似NFS的语义，如close-to-open一致性。Ivy检测分区期间发生的冲突修改，并向特定于应用程序的冲突解决器提供相关版本信息。广域网上的性能测量表明，Ivy比NFS慢两到三倍。

import_candidates.title: Defensive programming: using an annotation toolkit to build DoS-resistant software
import_candidates.abstract: This paper describes a toolkit to help improve the robustness of code against DoS attacks. We observe that when developing software, programmers primarily focus on functionality. Protecting code from attacks is often considered the responsibility of the OS, firewalls and intrusion detection systems. As a result, many DoS vulnerabilities are not discovered until the system is attacked and the damage is done. Instead of reacting to attacks after the fact, this paper argues that a better solution is to make software defensive by systematically injecting protection mechanisms into the code itself. Our toolkit provides an API that programmers use to annotate their code. At runtime, these annotations serve as both sensors and actuators: watching for resource abuse and taking the appropriate action should abuse be detected. This paper presents the design and implementation of the toolkit, as well as evaluation of its effectiveness with three widely-deployed network services.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文描述了一个工具包，旨在帮助提高代码抵御拒绝服务（DoS）攻击的鲁棒性。我们观察到，在开发软件时，程序员主要关注功能。保护代码免受攻击通常被认为是操作系统、防火墙和入侵检测系统的责任。因此，许多DoS漏洞直到系统遭受攻击并造成损害后才被发现。本文认为，与其在攻击发生后被动应对，更好的解决方案是通过系统地将保护机制注入代码本身来使软件具备防御性。我们的工具包提供了一个API，程序员可以使用它对代码进行注解。在运行时，这些注解既充当传感器又充当执行器：监视资源滥用，并在检测到滥用时采取适当行动。本文介绍了该工具包的设计与实现，并通过三个广泛部署的网络服务对其有效性进行了评估。

import_candidates.title: Using model checking to debug device firmware
import_candidates.abstract: Device firmware is a piece of concurrent software that achieves high performance at the cost of software complexity. They contain subtle race conditions that make them difficult to debug using traditional debugging techniques. The problem is further compounded by the lack of debugging support on the devices. This is a serious problem because the device firmware is trusted by the operating system.Model checkers are designed to systematically verify properties of concurrent systems. Therefore, model checking is a promising approach to debugging device firmware. However, model checking involves an exponential search. Consequently, the models have to be small to allow effective model checking.This paper describes the abstraction techniques used by the ESP compiler to extract abstract models from device firmware written in ESP. The abstract models are small because they discard some of the details in the firmware that is irrelevant to the particular property being verified. The programmer is required to specify the abstractions to be performed. The ESP compiler uses the abstraction specification to extract models conservatively. Therefore, every bug in the original program will be present in the extracted model.This paper also presents our experience with using Spin model checker to develop and debug VMMC firmware for the Myrinet network interfaces. An earlier version of the ESP compiler yielded models that were too large to check for system-wide properties like absence of deadlocks. The new version of the compiler generated abstract models that were used to identify several subtle bugs in the firmware. So far, we have not encountered any bugs that were not caught by Spin.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 设备固件是一种并发软件，它通过牺牲软件复杂性来换取高性能。固件中存在微妙的竞态条件，使得使用传统调试技术难以调试。设备上缺乏调试支持又进一步加剧了问题。这是一个严重的问题，因为操作系统信任设备固件。模型检测器旨在系统地验证并发系统的属性，因此模型检测是调试设备固件的一种很有前途的方法。然而，模型检测涉及指数级搜索，因此模型必须足够小才能进行有效检测。本文描述了ESP编译器用于从以ESP编写的设备固件中提取抽象模型的抽象技术。抽象模型之所以小，是因为它们丢弃了与验证的特定属性无关的固件细节。程序员需要指定要执行的抽象。ESP编译器使用抽象规范来保守地提取模型，因此原始程序中的每个bug都会出现在提取的模型中。本文还介绍了我们使用Spin模型检测器开发和调试Myrinet网络接口VMMC固件的经验。早期版本的ESP编译器生成的模型太大，无法检查系统级属性（如无死锁性）。新版本的编译器生成的抽象模型成功识别了固件中的几个微妙bug。到目前为止，我们还没有遇到Spin未能捕获的bug。

import_candidates.title: CMC: a pragmatic approach to model checking real code
import_candidates.abstract: Many system errors do not emerge unless some intricate sequence of events occurs. In practice, this means that most systems have errors that only trigger after days or weeks of execution. Model checking [4] is an effective way to find such subtle errors. It takes a simplified description of the code and exhaustively tests it on all inputs, using techniques to explore vast state spaces efficiently. Unfortunately, while model checking systems code would be wonderful, it is almost never done in practice: building models is just too hard. It can take significantly more time to write a model than it did to write the code. Furthermore, by checking an abstraction of the code rather than the code itself, it is easy to miss errors.The paper's first contribution is a new model checker, CMC, which checks C and C++ implementations directly, eliminating the need for a separate abstract description of the system behavior. This has two major advantages: it reduces the effort to use model checking, and it reduces missed errors as well as time-wasting false error reports resulting from inconsistencies between the abstract description and the actual implementation. In addition, changes in the implementation can be checked immediately without updating a high-level description.The paper's second contribution is demonstrating that CMC works well on real code by applying it to three implementations of the Ad-hoc On-demand Distance Vector (AODV) networking protocol [7]. We found 34 distinct errors (roughly one bug per 328 lines of code), including a bug in the AODV specification itself. Given our experience building systems, it appears that the approach will work well in other contexts, and especially well for other networking protocols.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 许多系统错误只有在发生某种复杂的事件序列时才会出现。实际上，这意味着大多数系统的错误只有在执行数天或数周后才会触发。模型检查是一种寻找此类微妙错误的有效方法。它采用代码的简化描述，并对所有输入进行穷举测试，利用技术高效地探索巨大的状态空间。然而，尽管对系统代码进行模型检查会非常理想，但在实践中几乎从未这样做过：构建模型太难了。编写模型所花费的时间可能比编写代码本身多得多。此外，检查代码的抽象描述而非代码本身，很容易遗漏错误。本文的第一个贡献是一个新的模型检查器CMC，它直接检查C和C++实现，无需对系统行为进行单独的抽象描述。这有两个主要优点：减少了使用模型检查的工作量，并且减少了由于抽象描述与实际实现之间的不一致而导致的错误遗漏以及浪费时间的误报。此外，实现中的更改可以立即检查，而无需更新高层描述。本文的第二个贡献是通过将CMC应用于Ad-hoc按需距离矢量（AODV）网络协议的三个实现，证明其在真实代码上运行良好。我们发现了34个不同的错误（大约每328行代码一个错误），包括AODV规范本身的一个错误。根据我们构建系统的经验，这种方法在其他环境中也会运行良好，特别是在其他网络协议中。

import_candidates.title: Practical, transparent operating system support for superpages
import_candidates.abstract: Most general-purpose processors provide support for memory pages of large sizes, called superpages. Superpages enable each entry in the translation lookaside buffer (TLB) to map a large physical memory region into a virtual address space. This dramatically increases TLB coverage, reduces TLB misses, and promises performance improvements for many applications. However, supporting superpages poses several challenges to the operating system, in terms of superpage allocation and promotion tradeoffs, fragmentation control, etc. We analyze these issues, and propose the design of an effective superpage management system. We implement it in FreeBSD on the Alpha CPU, and evaluate it on real workloads and benchmarks. We obtain substantial performance benefits, often exceeding 30\%; these benefits are sustained even under stressful workload scenarios.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大多数通用处理器都支持大尺寸内存页，称为超级页面。超级页面使转换后备缓冲器（TLB）中的每个条目能够将大的物理内存区域映射到虚拟地址空间。这显著提高了TLB覆盖面，减少了TLB未命中，并有望为许多应用带来性能提升。然而，支持超级页面给操作系统带来了若干挑战，涉及超级页面分配与提升权衡、碎片控制等。我们分析了这些问题，并提出了一种有效的超级页面管理系统的设计。我们在Alpha CPU上的FreeBSD中实现该系统，并在真实负载和基准测试中进行了评估。我们获得了显著的性能收益，通常超过30%；即使在压力较大的工作负载场景下，这些收益也能维持。

import_candidates.title: Vertigo: automatic performance-setting for Linux
import_candidates.abstract: Combining high performance with low power consumption is becoming one of the primary objectives of processor designs. Instead of relying just on sleep mode for conserving power, an increasing number of processors take advantage of the fact that reducing the clock frequency and corresponding operating voltage of the CPU can yield quadratic decrease in energy use. However, performance reduction can only be beneficial if it is done transparently, without causing the software to miss its deadlines. In this paper, we describe the implementation and performance-setting algorithms used in Vertigo, our power management extensions for Linux. Vertigo makes its decisions automatically, without any application-specific involvement. We describe how a hierarchy of performance-setting algorithms, each specialized for different workload characteristics, can be used for controlling the processor's performance. The algorithms operate independently from one another and can be dynamically configured. As a basis for comparison with conventional algorithms, we contrast measurements made on a Transmeta Crusoe-based computer using its built-in LongRun power manager with Vertigo running on the same system. We show that unlike conventional interval-based algorithms like LongRun, Vertigo is successful at focusing in on a small range of performance levels that are sufficient to meet an application's deadlines. When playing MPEG movies, this behavior translates into a 11\%-35\% reduction of mean performance level over LongRun, without any negative impact on the framerate. The performance reduction can in turn yield significant power savings.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 兼顾高性能与低功耗正成为处理器设计的主要目标之一。越来越多的处理器不再仅依赖休眠模式来节能，而是利用降低CPU时钟频率和相应工作电压可使能耗二次方下降的特性。然而，只有在对软件透明地降低性能而不导致其错过截止期限时，性能降低才是有益的。本文描述了我们在Linux上的电源管理扩展Vertigo的实现和性能设置算法。Vertigo自动做出决策，无需任何特定应用参与。我们描述了如何利用一组针对不同工作负载特性而专长化的性能设置算法层次结构来控制处理器的性能。这些算法彼此独立运行，并可以动态配置。作为与传统算法的比较基准，我们将基于Transmeta Crusoe的计算机上使用其内置LongRun电源管理器所得到的测量结果，与同一系统上运行Vertigo的结果进行对比。我们表明，与类似LongRun的传统基于间隔的算法不同，Vertigo能够成功聚焦于足以满足应用截止期限的一小段性能水平范围。在播放MPEG影片时，这种特性使得平均性能水平较LongRun降低11%至35%，同时不影响帧率。性能降低进而可带来显著的功耗节省。

import_candidates.title: Cooperative I/O: a novel I/O semantics for energy-aware applications
import_candidates.abstract: In this paper we demonstrate the benefits of application involvement in operating system power management. We present Coop-I/O, an approach to reduce the power consumption of devices while encompassing all levels of the system---from the hardware and OS to a new interface for cooperative I/O that can be used by energy-aware applications. We assume devices which can be set to low-power operation modes if they are not accessed and where switching between modes consumes additional energy, e.g. devices with rotating components or network devices consuming energy for the establishment and shutdown of network connections. In these cases frequent mode switches should be avoided.With Coop-I/O, applications can declare open, read and write operations as deferrable and even abortable by specifying a time-out and a cancel flag. This information enables the operating system to delay and batch requests so that the number of power mode switches is reduced and the device can be kept longer in a low-power mode. We have deployed our concept to the IDE hard disk driver and Ext2 file system of Linux and to typical real-life programs so that they make use of the new cooperative I/O functions. With energy savings of up to 50\%, the experimental results demonstrate the benefits of the concept. We will show that Coop-I/O even outperforms the "oracle" shutdown policy which defines the lower bound in power consumption if the timing of requests can not be influenced.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文展示了应用参与操作系统电源管理的好处。我们提出Coop-I/O，一种在涵盖从硬件和操作系统到新型协作式I/O接口的所有系统层面降低设备功耗的方法，该接口可由能量感知的应用使用。我们假设设备在不被访问时可设置为低功耗运行模式，并且模式切换会消耗额外能量，例如带有旋转组件的设备或为建立和断开网络连接而消耗能量的网络设备。在这些情况下，应避免频繁的模式切换。通过Coop-I/O，应用可以将打开、读取和写入操作声明为可延迟甚至可中止的，方法是指定超时和取消标志。这些信息使操作系统能够延迟和批处理请求，从而减少电源模式切换的次数，并让设备在低功耗模式下保持更长时间。我们已将这一概念部署到Linux的IDE硬盘驱动器和Ext2文件系统，并部署到典型的实际程序中，使其利用新的协作式I/O功能。实验结果表明，该概念可节省高达50%的能量。我们将证明，在请求时间无法被影响的情况下，Coop-I/O甚至优于定义了功耗下限的“oracle”关闭策略。

import_candidates.title: TAG: a Tiny AGgregation service for Ad-Hoc sensor networks
import_candidates.abstract: We present the Tiny AGgregation (TAG) service for aggregation in low-power, distributed, wireless environments. TAG allows users to express simple, declarative queries and have them distributed and executed efficiently in networks of low-power, wireless sensors. We discuss various generic properties of aggregates, and show how those properties affect the performance of our in network approach. We include a performance study demonstrating the advantages of our approach over traditional centralized, out-of-network methods, and discuss a variety of optimizations for improving the performance and fault-tolerance of the basic solution.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了用于低功耗、分布式无线环境中的聚合服务的TAG（微型聚合）服务。TAG允许用户表达简单的声明式查询，并在低功耗无线传感器网络中高效地进行分发和执行。我们讨论了聚合的各种通用属性，并展示了这些属性如何影响我们的网内方法的性能。我们提供了一项性能研究，证明了我们的方法相对于传统的集中式网外方法的优势，并讨论了各种优化方法以提高基本解决方案的性能和容错性。

import_candidates.title: Fine-grained network time synchronization using reference broadcasts
import_candidates.abstract: Recent advances in miniaturization and low-cost, low-power design have led to active research in large-scale networks of small, wireless, low-power sensors and actuators. Time synchronization is critical in sensor networks for diverse purposes including sensor data fusion, coordinated actuation, and power-efficient duty cycling. Though the clock accuracy and precision requirements are often stricter than in traditional distributed systems, strict energy constraints limit the resources available to meet these goals.We present Reference-Broadcast Synchronization, a scheme in which nodes send reference beacons to their neighbors using physical-layer broadcasts. A reference broadcast does not contain an explicit timestamp; instead, receivers use its arrival time as a point of reference for comparing their clocks. In this paper, we use measurements from two wireless implementations to show that removing the sender's nondeterminism from the critical path in this way produces high-precision clock agreement (1.85± 1.28μsec, using off-the-shelf 802.11 wireless Ethernet), while using minimal energy. We also describe a novel algorithm that uses this same broadcast property to federate clocks across broadcast domains with a slow decay in precision (3.68± 2.57μsec after 4 hops). RBS can be used without external references, forming a precise relative timescale, or can maintain microsecond-level synchronization to an external timescale such as UTC. We show a significant improvement over the Network Time Protocol (NTP) under similar conditions.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 近年来，小型化以及低成本低功耗设计的进步推动了对大规模小型无线低功耗传感器和执行器网络的积极研究。在传感器网络中，时间同步对于传感器数据融合、协调执行和低功耗占空比等多种目的至关重要。虽然时钟精度和准确度要求通常比传统分布式系统更严格，但严格的能量约束限制了可用于实现这些目标的资源。我们提出了参考广播同步（Reference-Broadcast Synchronization，RBS），这是一种让节点通过物理层广播向其邻居发送参考信标的方案。参考广播不包含显式时间戳；相反，接收端将其到达时间作为比较各自时钟的参考点。在本文中，我们使用两个无线实现的测量结果表明，通过这种方式将发送端的不确定性从关键路径中移除，可以在使用现成802.11无线以太网时实现高精度的时钟一致性（1.85±1.28微秒），同时消耗极少的能量。我们还描述了一种新算法，利用同样的广播特性跨广播域联合时钟，其精度衰减缓慢（4跳后为3.68±2.57微秒）。RBS可以在没有外部参考的情况下使用，形成精确的相对时间尺度，也可以保持与外部时间尺度（如UTC）的微秒级同步。我们展示了在类似条件下相较于网络时间协议（NTP）的显著改进。

import_candidates.title: Supporting time-sensitive applications on a commodity OS
import_candidates.abstract: Commodity operating systems are increasingly being used for serving time-sensitive applications. These applications require low-latency response from the kernel and from other system-level services. In this paper, we explore various operating systems techniques needed to support time-sensitive applications and describe the design of our Time-Sensitive Linux (TSL) system. We show that the combination of a high-precision timing facility, a well-designed preemptible kernel and the use of appropriate scheduling techniques is the basis for a low-latency response system and such a system can have low overhead. We evaluate the behavior of realistic time-sensitive user- and kernel-level applications on our system and show that, in practice, it is possible to satisfy the constraints of time-sensitive applications in a commodity operating system without significantly compromising the performance of throughput-oriented applications.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 通用操作系统越来越多地用于服务时间敏感应用。这些应用需要来自内核和其他系统级服务的低延迟响应。在本文中，我们探讨了支持时间敏感应用所需的各种操作系统技术，并描述了我们的时间敏感Linux (TSL)系统的设计。我们展示了高精度计时设施、设计良好的可抢占内核以及适当的调度技术的结合是低延迟响应系统的基础，且这样的系统可以具有低开销。我们评估了现实中的时间敏感用户级和内核级应用在我们系统上的行为，并表明在实践中，在通用操作系统中满足时间敏感应用的约束是可能的，同时不会显著损害吞吐量导向应用的性能。

import_candidates.title: Memory resource management in VMware ESX server
import_candidates.abstract: VMware ESX Server is a thin software layer designed to multiplex hardware resources efficiently among virtual machines running unmodified commodity operating systems. This paper introduces several novel ESX Server mechanisms and policies for managing memory. A ballooning technique reclaims the pages considered least valuable by the operating system running in a virtual machine. An idle memory tax achieves efficient memory utilization while maintaining performance isolation guarantees. Content-based page sharing and hot I/O page remapping exploit transparent page remapping to eliminate redundancy and reduce copying overheads. These techniques are combined to efficiently support virtual machine workloads that overcommit memory.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: VMware ESX Server是一个轻量级软件层，旨在高效地在一组运行未修改的商用操作系统的虚拟机之间复用硬件资源。本文介绍了用于管理内存的几种新的ESX Server机制和策略。一种气球回收技术回收虚拟机内操作系统认为最不值得保留的页面。一种空闲内存税在维持性能隔离保证的同时实现高效的内存利用。基于内容的内存页共享和热点I/O页重映射利用透明的页重映射来消除冗余并减少复制开销。这些技术相结合，可高效支持超订内存的虚拟机工作负载。

import_candidates.title: Scale and performance in the Denali isolation kernel
import_candidates.abstract: This paper describes the Denali isolation kernel, an operating system architecture that safely multiplexes a large number of untrusted Internet services on shared hardware. Denali's goal is to allow new Internet services to be "pushed" into third party infrastructure, relieving Internet service authors from the burden of acquiring and maintaining physical infrastructure. Our isolation kernel exposes a virtual machine abstraction, but unlike conventional virtual machine monitors, Denali does not attempt to emulate the underlying physical architecture precisely, and instead modifies the virtual architecture to gain scale, performance, and simplicity of implementation. In this paper, we first discuss design principles of isolation kernels, and then we describe the design and implementation of Denali. Following this, we present a detailed evaluation of Denali, demonstrating that the overhead of virtualization is small, that our architectural choices are warranted, and that we can successfully scale to more than 10,000 virtual machines on commodity hardware.

import_candidates.title: ReVirt: enabling intrusion analysis through virtual-machine logging and replay
import_candidates.abstract: Current system loggers have two problems: they depend on the integrity of the operating system being logged, and they do not save sufficient information to replay and analyze attacks that include any non-deterministic events. ReVirt removes the dependency on the target operating system by moving it into a virtual machine and logging below the virtual machine. This allows ReVirt to replay the system's execution before, during, and after an intruder compromises the system, even if the intruder replaces the target operating system. ReVirt logs enough information to replay a long-term execution of the virtual machine instruction-by-instruction. This enables it to provide arbitrarily detailed observations about what transpired on the system, even in the presence of non-deterministic attacks and executions. ReVirt adds reasonable time and space overhead. Overheads due to virtualization are imperceptible for interactive use and CPU-bound workloads, and 13--58\% for kernel-intensive workloads. Logging adds 0--8\% overhead, and logging traffic for our workloads can be stored on a single disk for several months.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 当前系统日志记录器存在两个问题：它们依赖被日志记录的操作系统的完整性，并且它们没有保存足够的信息来重放和分析包含任何非确定性事件的攻击。ReVirt通过将目标操作系统移入虚拟机并在虚拟机之下进行日志记录，消除了对目标操作系统的依赖。这使ReVirt能够在入侵者入侵系统之前、期间和之后重放系统的执行，即使入侵者替换了目标操作系统。ReVirt记录足够的信息，以逐条指令重放虚拟机的长期执行过程。这使其能够提供关于系统上发生之事的任意详细观察，即使在存在非确定性攻击和执行的情况下也是如此。ReVirt增加了合理的时间和空间开销。虚拟化带来的开销对于交互式使用和CPU密集型工作负载而言几乎不可察觉，对于内核密集型工作负载则为13-58%。日志记录增加了0-8%的开销，我们工作负载的日志流量可以存储在单个磁盘上数月之久。

import_candidates.title: Integrated resource management for cluster-based internet services
import_candidates.abstract: Client request rates for Internet services tend to be bursty and thus it is important to maintain efficient resource utilization under a wide range of load conditions. Network service clients typically seek services interactively and maintaining reasonable response time is often imperative for such services. In addition, providing differentiated service qualities and resource allocation to multiple service classes can also be desirable at times. This paper presents an integrated resource management framework (part of Neptune system) that provides flexible service quality specification, efficient resource utilization, and service differentiation for cluster-based services. This framework introduces the metric of quality-aware service yield to combine the overall system efficiency and individual service response time in one flexible model. Resources are managed through a two-level request distribution and scheduling scheme. At the cluster level, a fully decentralized request distribution architecture is employed to achieve high scalability and availability. Inside each service node, an adaptive scheduling policy maintains efficient resource utilization under a wide range of load conditions. Our trace-driven evaluations demonstrate the performance, scalability, and service differentiation achieved by the proposed techniques.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 互联网服务的客户端请求率往往具有突发性，因此在各种负载条件下保持高效的资源利用至关重要。网络服务客户端通常寻求交互式服务，而对于此类服务，保持合理的响应时间通常是必需的。此外，有时还需要为多个服务类别提供差异化的服务质量和资源分配。本文提出了一个集成资源管理框架（Neptune系统的一部分），该框架为基于集群的服务提供了灵活的服务质量规范、高效的资源利用和服务差异化。该框架引入了质量感知服务产出率这一指标，将整体系统效率与单个服务响应时间灵活地结合在一个模型中。资源通过两级请求分发和调度方案进行管理。在集群层面，采用完全去中心化的请求分发架构以实现高可扩展性和可用性。在每个服务节点内部，自适应调度策略在各种负载条件下维持高效的资源利用。我们的基于痕迹的评估证明了所提出技术在性能、可扩展性和服务差异化方面取得的成效。

import_candidates.title: Resource overbooking and application profiling in shared hosting platforms
import_candidates.abstract: In this paper, we present techniques for provisioning CPU and network resources in shared hosting platforms running potentially antagonistic third-party applications. The primary contribution of our work is to demonstrate the feasibility and benefits of overbooking resources in shared platforms, to maximize the platform yeld: the revenue generated by the available resources. We do this by first deriving an accurate estimate of application resource needs by profiling applications on dedicated nodes, and then using these profiles to guide the placement of application components onto shared nodes. By overbooking cluster resources in a controlled fashion, our platform can provide performance guarantees to applications even when overbooked, and combine these techniques with commonly used QoS resource allocation mechanisms to provide application isolation and performance guarantees at run-time. When compared to provisioning based on the worst-case, the efficiency (and consequently revenue) benefits from controlled overbooking of resources can be dramatic. Specifically, experiments on our Linux cluster implementation indicate that overbooking resources by as little as 1\% can increase the utilization of the cluster by a factor of two, and a 5\% overbooking yields a 300--500\% improvement, while still providing useful resource guarantees to applications.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了在运行可能相互对抗的第三方应用的共享托管平台中配置CPU和网络资源的技术。我们工作的主要贡献是证明在共享平台中超售资源的可行性和好处，以最大化平台收益：即由可用资源产生的收入。我们首先通过在专用节点上对应用进行配置文件分析，得出应用资源需求的准确估计，然后使用这些配置文件来指导应用组件在共享节点上的放置。通过以受控方式超售集群资源，我们的平台即使在超售情况下也能为应用提供性能保证，并将这些技术与常用的服务质量（QoS）资源分配机制相结合，在运行时提供应用隔离和性能保证。与基于最坏情况的配置相比，受控超售资源在效率（因而收入）上的收益可能是巨大的。具体来说，在我们Linux集群实现上的实验表明，超售资源即使只有1%，也能将集群利用率提高两倍，而5%的超售则带来300%-500%的改进，同时仍为应用提供有用的资源保证。

import_candidates.title: An integrated experimental environment for distributed systems and networks
import_candidates.abstract: Three experimental environments traditionally support network and distributed systems research: network emulators, network simulators, and live networks. The continued use of multiple approaches highlights both the value and inadequacy of each. Netbed, a descendant of Emulab, provides an experimentation facility that integrates these approaches, allowing researchers to configure and access networks composed of emulated, simulated, and wide-area nodes and links. Netbed's primary goals are ease of use, control, and realism, achieved through consistent use of virtualization and abstraction.By providing operating system-like services, such as resource allocation and scheduling, and by virtualizing heterogeneous resources, Netbed acts as a virtual machine for network experimentation. This paper presents Netbed's overall design and implementation and demonstrates its ability to improve experimental automation and efficiency. These, in turn, lead to new methods of experimentation, including automated parameter-space studies within emulation and straightforward comparisons of simulated, emulated, and wide-area scenarios.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 传统上，三种实验环境支持网络和分布式系统研究：网络仿真器、网络模拟器和真实网络。多种方法的持续使用突显了各自的价值和不足。Netbed作为Emulab的后继者，提供了一个集成这些方法的实验设施，使研究人员能够配置和访问由仿真、模拟和广域网节点与链路组成的网络。Netbed的主要目标是易用性、可控性和真实性，这些通过一致地使用虚拟化和抽象来实现。通过提供类似操作系统的服务（如资源分配和调度）并对异构资源进行虚拟化，Netbed充当了网络实验的虚拟机。本文介绍了Netbed的总体设计和实现，并展示了其提升实验自动化和效率的能力。这些能力进而带来了新的实验方法，包括在仿真中进行自动化参数空间研究，以及对模拟、仿真和广域网场景的直接比较。

import_candidates.title: Scalability and accuracy in a large-scale network emulator
import_candidates.abstract: This paper presents ModelNet, a scalable Internet emulation environment that enables researchers to deploy unmodified software prototypes in a configurable Internet-like environment and subject them to faults and varying network conditions. Edge nodes running user-specified OS and application software are configured to route their packets through a set of ModelNet core nodes, which cooperate to subject the traffic to the bandwidth, congestion constraints, latency, and loss profile of a target network topology.This paper describes and evaluates the ModelNet architecture and its implementation, including novel techniques to balance emulation accuracy against scalability. The current ModelNet prototype is able to accurately subject thousands of instances of a distrbuted application to Internet-like conditions with gigabits of bisection bandwidth. Experiments with several large-scale distributed services demonstrate the generality and effectiveness of the infrastructure.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了ModelNet，一种可扩展的互联网仿真环境，使研究人员能够在可配置的类似互联网的环境中部署未经修改的软件原型，并使其遭受故障和多变的网络条件。运行用户指定的操作系统和应用软件的边缘节点被配置为通过一组ModelNet核心节点路由其数据包，这些核心节点协同作用，使流量受到目标网络拓扑的带宽、拥塞约束、延迟和丢失率的影响。本文描述并评估了ModelNet架构及其实现，包括用于平衡仿真精度与可扩展性的新技术。当前的ModelNet原型能够以吉比特的对分带宽，将数千个分布式应用实例准确地置于类似互联网的条件下。对多个大规模分布式服务的实验证明了该基础设施的通用性和有效性。

import_candidates.title: Pastiche: making backup cheap and easy
import_candidates.abstract: Backup is cumbersome and expensive. Individual users almost never back up their data, and backup is a significant cost in large organizations. This paper presents Pastiche, a simple and inexpensive backup system. Pastiche exploits excess disk capacity to perform peer-to-peer backup with no administrative costs. Each node minimizes storage overhead by selecting peers that share a significant amount of data. It is easy for common installations to find suitable peers, and peers with high overlap can be identified with only hundreds of bytes. Pastiche provides mechanisms for confidentiality, integrity, and detection of failed or malicious peers. A Pastiche prototype suffers only 7.4\% overhead for a modified Andrew Benchmark, and restore performance is comparable to cross-machine copy.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 备份既繁琐又昂贵。个人用户几乎从不备份数据，而在大型组织中，备份也是一项重大成本。本文介绍了Pastiche，一个简单且廉价的备份系统。Pastiche利用多余的磁盘容量进行点对点备份，且无需管理成本。每个节点通过选择与之共享大量数据的对等节点来最小化存储开销。在常见安装中很容易找到合适的对等节点，而且仅需数百字节就能识别出重叠度高的对等节点。Pastiche提供了保密性、完整性以及检测故障或恶意对等节点的机制。Pastiche原型在修改后的Andrew基准测试中仅产生7.4%的开销，其恢复性能与跨机器复制相当。

import_candidates.title: Secure routing for structured peer-to-peer overlay networks
import_candidates.abstract: Structured peer-to-peer overlay networks provide a substrate for the construction of large-scale, decentralized applications, including distributed storage, group communication, and content distribution. These overlays are highly resilient; they can route messages correctly even when a large fraction of the nodes crash or the network partitions. But current overlays are not secure; even a small fraction of malicious nodes can prevent correct message delivery throughout the overlay. This problem is particularly serious in open peer-to-peer systems, where many diverse, autonomous parties without preexisting trust relationships wish to pool their resources. This paper studies attacks aimed at preventing correct message delivery in structured peer-to-peer overlays and presents defenses to these attacks. We describe and evaluate techniques that allow nodes to join the overlay, to maintain routing state, and to forward messages securely in the presence of malicious nodes.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 结构化对等覆盖网络为构建大规模去中心化应用（包括分布式存储、组通信和内容分发）提供了基础。这些覆盖网络具有高度弹性；即使很大一部分节点崩溃或网络发生分区，它们仍能正确路由消息。但当前的覆盖网络并不安全；即使一小部分恶意节点也能在整个覆盖网络中阻止消息的正确传递。这个问题在开放对等系统中尤为严重，因为许多不同的、自治的、没有预先信任关系的参与方希望汇集其资源。本文研究了旨在阻止结构化对等覆盖网络中正确消息传递的攻击，并提出了针对这些攻击的防御措施。我们描述并评估了允许节点加入覆盖网络、维护路由状态以及在存在恶意节点情况下安全转发消息的技术。

import_candidates.title: An analysis of internet content delivery systems
import_candidates.abstract: In the span of only a few years, the Internet has experienced an astronomical increase in the use of specialized content delivery systems, such as content delivery networks and peer-to-peer file sharing systems. Therefore, an understanding of content delivery on the Internet now requires a detailed understanding of how these systems are used in practice.This paper examines content delivery from the point of view of four content delivery systems: HTTP web traffic, the Akamai content delivery network, and Kazaa and Gnutella peer-to-peer file sharing traffic. We collected a trace of all incoming and outgoing network traffic at the University of Washington, a large university with over 60,000 students, faculty, and staff. From this trace, we isolated and characterized traffic belonging to each of these four delivery classes. Our results (1) quantify the rapidly increasing importance of new content delivery systems, particularly peer-to-peer networks, (2) characterize the behavior of these systems from the perspectives of clients, objects, and servers, and (3) derive implications for caching in these systems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在短短几年内，互联网上对专用内容分发系统（如内容分发网络和对等文件共享系统）的使用呈现爆炸式增长。因此，要理解互联网上的内容分发，现在需要对如何使用这些系统有详细的了解。本文从四种内容分发系统的角度考察内容分发：HTTP网络流量、Akamai内容分发网络、以及Kazaa和Gnutella对等文件共享流量。我们收集了华盛顿大学（一所拥有超过60000名学生、教职员工的大型大学）的所有进出网络流量的轨迹。从这个轨迹中，我们分离并表征了属于这四个分发类别的流量。我们的结果(1)量化了新的内容分发系统日益增长的重要性，特别是对等网络；(2)从客户端、对象和服务器的角度表征了这些系统的行为；(3)得出了对缓存设计的影响。

import_candidates.title: TCP Nice: a mechanism for background transfers
import_candidates.abstract: Many distributed applications can make use of large background transfers - transfers of data that humans are not waiting for -- to improve availability, reliability, latency or consistency. However, given the rapid fluctuations of available network bandwidth and changing resource costs due to technology trends, hand tuning the aggressiveness of background transfers risks (1) complicating applications, (2) being too aggressive and interfering with other applications, and (3) being too timid and not gaining the benefits of background transfers. Our goal is for the operating system to manage network resources in order to provide a simple abstraction of near zero-cost background transfers. Our system, TCP Nice, can provably bound the interference inflicted by background flows on foreground flows in a restricted network model. And our microbenchmarks and case study applications suggest that in practice it interferes little with foreground flows, reaps a large fraction of spare network bandwidth, and simplifies application construction and deployment. For example, in our prefetching case study application, aggressive prefetching improves demand performance by a factor of three when Nice manages resources; but the same prefetching hurts demand performance by a factor of six under standard network congestion control.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 许多分布式应用可以利用大规模后台传输（即人类并不等待的数据传输）来提高可用性、可靠性、延迟或一致性。然而，鉴于可用网络带宽的快速波动以及技术趋势带来的资源成本变化，手工调整后台传输的激进程度会带来风险：(1) 使应用复杂化；(2) 过于激进而干扰其他应用；(3) 过于保守而无法获得后台传输的好处。我们的目标是让操作系统管理网络资源，以提供近零成本后台传输的简单抽象。我们的系统TCP Nice可以在受限网络模型中证明后台流对前台流造成的干扰是有界的。我们的微基准测试和案例研究应用表明，它在实践中对前台流的干扰很小，能获取大部分剩余网络带宽，并简化应用的构建和部署。例如，在我们的预取案例研究应用中，当Nice管理资源时，激进预取能将需求性能提升三倍；但在标准网络拥塞控制下，同样的预取会使需求性能降低六倍。

import_candidates.title: The effectiveness of request redirection on CDN robustness
import_candidates.abstract: It is becoming increasingly common to construct network services using redundant resources geographically distributed across the Internet. Content Distribution Networks are a prime example. Such systems distribute client requests to an appropriate server based on a variety of factors---e.g., server load, network proximity, cache locality---in an effort to reduce response time and increase the system capacity under load. This paper explores the design space of strategies employed to redirect requests, and defines a class of new algorithms that carefully balance load, locality, and proximity. We use large-scale detailed simulations to evaluate the various strategies. These simulations clearly demonstrate the effectiveness of our new algorithms, which yield a 60--91\% improvement in system capacity when compared with the best published CDN technology, yet user-perceived response latency remains low and the system scales well with the number of servers.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 使用地理分布在整个互联网上的冗余资源来构建网络服务正变得越来越普遍。内容分发网络（CDN）就是一个典型的例子。这类系统根据多种因素（例如服务器负载、网络邻近性、缓存局部性）将客户端请求分配到合适的服务器，以减少响应时间并提高系统在负载下的容量。本文探索了用于重定向请求的策略设计空间，并定义了一类新算法，这些算法仔细平衡了负载、局部性和邻近性。我们使用大规模详细模拟来评估各种策略。这些模拟清楚地证明了我们新算法的有效性，与已发布的最佳CDN技术相比，系统容量提升了60%至91%，同时用户感知的响应延迟保持较低，并且系统随服务器数量扩展良好。

import_candidates.title: The design and implementation of Zap: a system for migrating computing environments
import_candidates.abstract: We have created Zap, a novel system for transparent migration of legacy and networked applications. Zap provides a thin virtualization layer on top of the operating system that introduces pods, which are groups of processes that are provided a consistent, virtualized view of the system. This decouples processes in pods from dependencies to the host operating system and other processes on the system. By integrating Zap virtualization with a checkpoint-restart mechanism, Zap can migrate a pod of processes as a unit among machines running independent operating systems without leaving behind any residual state after migration. We have implemented a Zap prototype in Linux that supports transparent migration of unmodified applications without any kernel modifications. We demonstrate that our Linux Zap prototype can provide general-purpose process migration functionality with low overhead. Our experimental results for migrating pods used for running a standard user's X windows desktop computing environment and for running an Apache web server show that these kinds of pods can be migrated with subsecond checkpoint and restart latencies.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们创建了Zap，一个用于透明迁移遗留和网络应用的新颖系统。Zap在操作系统之上提供了一层轻量级虚拟化层，引入了“pod”（进程组），这些进程组被赋予一致的、虚拟化的系统视图。这将pod中的进程与对宿主操作系统以及系统上其他进程的依赖解耦。通过将Zap虚拟化与检查点-重启机制集成，Zap可以将一个进程组作为一个单元，在运行独立操作系统的机器之间迁移，而不会在迁移后留下任何残余状态。我们在Linux中实现了一个Zap原型，支持未修改应用的透明迁移，且无需任何内核修改。我们证明了我们的Linux Zap原型能够提供通用目的的进程迁移功能，且开销较低。我们对用于运行标准用户的X窗口桌面计算环境和运行Apache web服务器的pod进行迁移的实验结果表明，这类pod可以以亚秒级的检查点和重启延迟进行迁移。

import_candidates.title: Optimizing the migration of virtual computers
import_candidates.abstract: This paper shows how to quickly move the state of a running computer across a network, including the state in its disks, memory, CPU registers, and I/O devices. We call this state a capsule. Capsule state is hardware state, so it includes the entire operating system as well as applications and running processes.We have chosen to move x86 computer states because x86 computers are common, cheap, run the software we use, and have tools for migration. Unfortunately, x86 capsules can be large, containing hundreds of megabytes of memory and gigabytes of disk data. We have developed techniques to reduce the amount of data sent over the network: copy-on-write disks track just the updates to capsule disks, "ballooning" zeros unused memory, demand paging fetches only needed blocks, and hashing avoids sending blocks that already exist at the remote end. We demonstrate these optimizations in a prototype system that uses VMware GSX Server virtual machine monitor to create and run x86 capsules. The system targets networks as slow as 384 kbps.Our experimental results suggest that efficient capsule migration can improve user mobility and system management. Software updates or installations on a set of machines can be accomplished simply by distributing a capsule with the new changes. Assuming the presence of a prior capsule, the amount of traffic incurred is commensurate with the size of the update or installation package itself. Capsule migration makes it possible for machines to start running an application within 20 minutes on a 384 kbps link, without having to first install the application or even the underlying operating system. Furthermore, users' capsules can be migrated during a commute between home and work in even less time.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文展示了如何快速地在网络上移动一台正在运行的计算机的状态，包括其磁盘、内存、CPU寄存器和I/O设备中的状态。我们将这种状态称为“胶囊”（capsule）。胶囊状态是硬件状态，因此它包含整个操作系统以及应用程序和运行进程。我们选择迁移x86计算机状态，因为x86计算机常见、便宜、运行我们使用的软件，并且拥有迁移工具。不幸的是，x86胶囊可能很大，包含数百兆字节的内存和数千兆字节的磁盘数据。我们开发了减少网络传输数据量的技术：写时复制磁盘仅跟踪胶囊磁盘的更新，“气球”技术将未使用的内存清零，按需分页仅获取需要的块，而哈希技术避免发送远程端已存在的块。我们在一个原型系统中演示了这些优化，该系统使用VMware GSX Server虚拟机监控器来创建和运行x86胶囊。该系统面向低至384 kbps的网络。我们的实验结果表明，高效的胶囊迁移可以改善用户移动性和系统管理。对一组机器进行软件更新或安装只需分发包含新变更的胶囊即可。假设存在先前胶囊，所产生的流量与更新或安装包本身的大小相当。胶囊迁移使机器能够在384 kbps链路上于20分钟内开始运行应用程序，而不必事先安装应用程序甚至底层操作系统。此外，在上下班往返途中，用户的胶囊可以在更短的时间内完成迁移。

import_candidates.title: Luna: a flexible Java protection system
import_candidates.abstract: Extensible Java systems face a difficult trade-off between sharing and protection. On one hand, Java's ability to run different protection domains in a single virtual machine enables domains to share data easily and communicate without address space switches. On the other hand, unrestricted sharing blurs the boundaries between protection domains, making it difficult to terminate domains and enforce restrictions on resource usage. Existing solutions to these problems restrict sharing in an ad-hoc fashion, ruling out many desirable programming styles.This paper presents an extension to Java's type system that systematically addresses the issues of data sharing, revocation, thread control, and resource control. Multiple tasks running in a single virtual machines share data using special remote pointers, which have different types from local pointers. The distinction between local and remote pointers allows the Java runtime system to mediate the communication between tasks without slowing down operations on ordinary pointers. The extensions to Java are implemented by a system called Luna, based on the Guavac and Marmot compilers, extended with special optimizations to support both fast inter-task communication and dynamic access control. The paper describes two applications written in Luna: a simple extensible web server, and an extension of the Squid web cache to support dynamic content generation.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 可扩展的Java系统在共享与保护之间面临艰难的权衡。一方面，Java在单个虚拟机中运行不同保护域的能力使得各域能够轻松共享数据并在无需地址空间切换的情况下进行通信。另一方面，无限制的共享模糊了保护域之间的边界，使得终止域和对资源使用施加限制变得困难。针对这些问题的现有解决方案以特别方式限制共享，排除了许多理想的编程风格。本文提出了对Java类型系统的一种扩展，系统地解决了数据共享、撤销、线程控制和资源控制问题。运行在单个虚拟机中的多个任务通过特殊的远程指针共享数据，这些远程指针具有与本地指针不同的类型。本地指针与远程指针的区分使得Java运行时系统能够调解任务间的通信，而不会减慢普通指针的操作速度。对Java的这些扩展由一个名为Luna的系统实现，该系统基于Guavac和Marmot编译器，并添加了特殊优化以支持快速的任务间通信和动态访问控制。本文描述了用Luna编写的两个应用：一个简单的可扩展Web服务器，以及一个支持动态内容生成的Squid Web缓存的扩展。

import_candidates.title: Rethink the sync
import_candidates.abstract: We introduce external synchrony, a new model for local file I/O that provides the reliability and simplicity of synchronous I/O, yet also closely approximates the performance of asynchronous I/O. An external observer cannot distinguish the output of a computer with an externally synchronous file system from the output of a computer with a synchronous file system. No application modification is required to use an externally synchronous file system: in fact, application developers can program to the simpler synchronous I/O abstraction and still receive excellent performance. We have implemented an externally synchronous file system for Linux, called xsyncfs. Xsyncfs provides the same durability and ordering guarantees as those provided by a synchronously mounted ext3 file system. Yet, even for I/O-intensive benchmarks, xsyncfs performance is within 7\% of ext3 mounted asynchronously. Compared to ext3 mounted synchronously, xsyncfs is up to two orders of magnitude faster.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了外部同步（external synchrony）这一全新模型，用于本地文件I/O，它既具备同步I/O的可靠性和简单性，同时又能在性能上逼近异步I/O。外部观察者无法区分采用外部同步文件系统的计算机与采用同步文件系统的计算机的输出。使用外部同步文件系统无需修改应用程序：事实上，应用程序开发人员可以按照更简单的同步I/O抽象进行编程，同时仍能获得出色的性能。我们在Linux上实现了一个外部同步文件系统，称为xsyncfs。xsyncfs提供了与同步挂载的ext3文件系统相同的持久性和顺序保证。然而，即使面对I/O密集型基准测试，xsyncfs的性能也处于异步挂载ext3的7%范围内。与同步挂载的ext3相比，xsyncfs最多可快两个数量级。

import_candidates.title: Type-safe disks
import_candidates.abstract: We present the notion of a type-safe disk (TSD). Unlike a traditional disk system, a TSD is aware of the pointer relationships between disk blocks that are imposed by higher layers such as the file system. A TSD utilizes this knowledge in two key ways. First, it enables active enforcement of invariants on data access based on the pointer relationships, resulting in better security and integrity. Second, it enables semantics-aware optimizations within the disk system. Through case studies, we demonstrate the benefits of TSDs and show that a TSD presents a simple yet effective general interface to build the next generation of storage systems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了类型安全磁盘（TSD）的概念。与传统磁盘系统不同，TSD能够感知由文件系统等更高层强加于磁盘块之间的指针关系。TSD以两种关键方式利用这一知识：首先，它能够基于指针关系主动强制执行数据访问上的不变量，从而带来更好的安全性和完整性；其次，它使得磁盘系统内部能够进行语义感知的优化。通过案例研究，我们展示了TSD的优势，并表明TSD为构建下一代存储系统提供了一个简单而有效的通用接口。

import_candidates.title: Stasis: flexible transactional storage
import_candidates.abstract: An increasing range of applications requires robust support for atomic, durable and concurrent transactions. Databases provide the default solution, but force applications to interact via SQL and to forfeit control over data layout and access mechanisms. We argue there is a gap between DBMSs and file systems that limits designers of data-oriented applications.Stasis is a storage framework that incorporates ideas from traditional write-ahead logging algorithms and file systems. It provides applications with flexible control over data structures, data layout, robustness, and performance. Stasis enables the development of unforeseen variants on transactional storage by generalizing write-ahead logging algorithms. Our partial implementation of these ideas already provides specialized (and cleaner) semantics to applications.We evaluate the performance of a traditional transactional storage system based on Stasis, and show that it performs favorably relative to existing systems. We present examples that make use of custom access methods, modified buffer manager semantics, direct log file manipulation, and LSN-free pages. These examples facilitate sophisticated performance optimizations such as zero-copy I/O. These extensions are composable, easy to implement and significantly improve performance.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 越来越多的应用需要原子性、持久性和并发事务的健壮支持。数据库提供了默认的解决方案，但强制应用通过SQL进行交互，并放弃对数据布局和访问机制的控制。我们认为数据库管理系统与文件系统之间存在一个空白，这限制了面向数据应用的设计者的发挥。Stasis是一个存储框架，融合了传统预写日志算法和文件系统的思想。它为应用提供了对数据结构、数据布局、健壮性和性能的灵活控制。Stasis通过泛化预写日志算法，支持开发意外出现的移动存储变体。我们对该思想的局部实现已经为应用提供了专门化（且更简洁）的语义。我们评估了基于Stasis的传统移动存储系统的性能，并表明其相对于现有系统具有良好表现。我们提供了利用自定义访问方法、修改缓冲区管理器语义、直接日志文件操作和无LSN页面的示例。这些示例促进了诸如零拷贝I/O之类的复杂性能优化。这些扩展是可组合的，易于实现，并显著提高了性能。

import_candidates.title: SafeDrive: safe and recoverable extensions using language-based techniques
import_candidates.abstract: We present SafeDrive, a system for detecting and recovering from type safety violations in software extensions. SafeDrive has low overhead and requires minimal changes to existing source code. To achieve this result, SafeDrive uses a novel type system that provides fine-grained isolation for existing extensions written in C. In addition, SafeDrive tracks invariants using simple wrappers for the host system API and restores them when recovering from a violation. This approach achieves fine-grained memory error detection and recovery with few code changes and at a significantly lower performance cost than existing solutions based on hardware-enforced domains, such as Nooks [33], L4 [21], and Xen [13], or software-enforced domains, such as SFI [35]. The principles used in SafeDrive can be applied to any large system with loadable, error-prone extension modules.In this paper we describe our experience using SafeDrive for protection and recovery of a variety of Linux device drivers.
