In order to apply SafeDrive to these device drivers, we had to change less than 4\% of the source code. SafeDrive recovered from all 44 crashes due to injected faults in a network card driver. In experiments with 6 different drivers, we observed increases in kernel CPU utilization of 4--23\% with no noticeable degradation in end-to-end performance.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了SafeDrive，一个用于检测和恢复软件扩展中类型安全违规的系统。SafeDrive具有低开销，并且需要对现有源代码进行最小程度的修改。为实现这一目标，SafeDrive使用了一种新颖的类型系统，为用C编写的现有扩展提供细粒度隔离。此外，SafeDrive使用简单的包装器跟踪宿主系统API的不变量，并在从违规中恢复时恢复这些不变量。这种方法实现了细粒度的内存错误检测和恢复，只需很少的代码更改，并且性能成本显著低于基于硬件强制域（如Nooks、L4和Xen）或软件强制域（如SFI）的现有解决方案。SafeDrive中使用的原理可应用于任何具有可加载、易出错扩展模块的大型系统。本文描述了我们将SafeDrive用于保护和恢复各种Linux设备驱动程序的经验。为了将SafeDrive应用于这些设备驱动程序，我们只需更改不到4%的源代码。SafeDrive从网络卡驱动程序中注入故障导致的所有44次崩溃中恢复。在6个不同驱动程序的实验中，我们观察到内核CPU利用率增加了4-23%，而端到端性能没有明显下降。

import_candidates.title: BrowserShield: vulnerability-driven filtering of dynamic HTML
import_candidates.abstract: Vulnerability-driven filtering of network data can offer a fast and easy-to-deploy alternative or intermediary to software patching, as exemplified in Shield [43]. In this paper, we take Shield's vision to a new domain, inspecting and cleansing not just static content, but also dynamic content. The dynamic content we target is the dynamic HTML in web pages, which have become a popular vector for attacks. The key challenge in filtering dynamic HTML is that it is undecidable to statically determine whether an embedded script will exploit the browser at run-time. We avoid this undecidability problem by rewriting web pages and any embedded scripts into safe equivalents, inserting checks so that the filtering is done at run-time. The rewritten pages contain logic for recursively applying run-time checks to dynamically generated or modified web content, based on known vulnerabilities. We have built and evaluated BrowserShield, a system that performs this dynamic instrumentation of embedded scripts, and that admits policies for customized run-time actions like vulnerability-driven filtering.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 基于漏洞的网络数据过滤可以作为一种快速、易于部署的软件补丁替代方案或中间方案，如Shield[43]所示。在本文中，我们将Shield的构想拓展到一个新领域，不仅检查静态内容，还检查并净化动态内容。我们针对的动态内容是网页中的动态HTML，它已成为一种流行的攻击载体。过滤动态HTML的关键挑战在于，静态确定嵌入的脚本是否会在运行时利用浏览器是不可判定的。我们通过将网页和嵌入的脚本重写为安全的等价物来避免这一不可判定问题，插入检查以便在运行时进行过滤。重写后的页面包含递归地将运行时检查应用于动态生成或修改的网页内容的逻辑，且基于已知漏洞。我们构建并评估了BrowserShield系统，该系统执行嵌入脚本的动态插桩，并支持自定义运行时操作策略，如基于漏洞的过滤。

import_candidates.title: XFI: software guards for system address spaces
import_candidates.abstract: XFI is a comprehensive protection system that offers both flexible access control and fundamental integrity guarantees, at any privilege level and even for legacy code in commodity systems. For this purpose, XFI combines static analysis with inline software guards and a two-stack execution model. We have implemented XFI for Windows on the x86 architecture using binary rewriting and a simple, stand-alone verifier; the implementation's correctness depends on the verifier, but not on the rewriter. We have applied XFI to software such as device drivers and multimedia codecs. The resulting modules function safely within both kernel and user-mode address spaces, with only modest enforcement overheads.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: XFI是一个全面的保护系统，在任何特权级别，甚至对于商业系统中的遗留代码，都能提供灵活的访问控制和基本完整性保证。为此，XFI将静态分析与内联软件防护及双栈执行模型相结合。我们已经针对x86架构上的Windows实现了XFI，采用二进制重写和一个简单、独立的验证器；该实现的正确性依赖于验证器，而不依赖于重写器。我们已将XFI应用于设备驱动程序和多媒体编解码器等软件。由此产生的模块在内核和用户态地址空间中都能安全运行，且仅带来适度的强制开销。

import_candidates.title: Operating system profiling via latency analysis
import_candidates.abstract: Operating systems are complex and their behavior depends on many factors. Source code, if available, does not directly help one to understand the OS's behavior, as the behavior depends on actual workloads and external inputs. Runtime profiling is a key technique to prove new concepts, debug problems, and optimize performance. Unfortunately, existing profiling methods are lacking in important areas---they do not provide enough information about the OS's behavior, they require OS modification and therefore are not portable, or they incur high overheads thus perturbing the profiled OS.We developed OSprof: a versatile, portable, and efficient OS profiling method based on latency distributions analysis. OSprof automatically selects important profiles for subsequent visual analysis. We have demonstrated that a suitable workload can be used to profile virtually any OS component. OSprof is portable because it can intercept operations and measure OS behavior from user-level or from inside the kernel without requiring source code. OSprof has typical CPU time overheads below 4\%. In this paper we describe our techniques and demonstrate their usefulness through a series of profiles conducted on Linux, FreeBSD, and Windows, including client/server scenarios. We discovered and investigated a number of interesting interactions, including scheduler behavior, multi-modal I/O distributions, and a previously unknown lock contention, which we fixed.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 操作系统十分复杂，其行为取决于许多因素。源代码（如果有的话）并不能直接帮助人们理解操作系统的行为，因为行为取决于实际工作负载和外部输入。运行时剖析是验证新概念、调试问题和优化性能的关键技术。不幸的是，现有剖析方法在重要领域存在不足——它们无法提供足够的操作系统行为信息，需要修改操作系统因此不可移植，或者带来高开销从而干扰被剖析的系统。我们开发了OSprof：一种基于延迟分布分析的通用、可移植且高效的操作系统剖析方法。OSprof自动选择重要的剖析结果以供后续可视化分析。我们证明了可以使用合适的工作负载来剖析几乎任何操作系统组件。OSprof具有可移植性，因为它可以在用户态或内核内部拦截操作并测量操作系统行为，而无需源代码。OSprof的典型CPU时间开销低于4%。本文描述了我们的技术，并通过在Linux、FreeBSD和Windows上进行的一系列剖析（包括客户端/服务器场景）展示了其实用性。我们发现并调查了若干有趣的交互现象，包括调度器行为、多模态I/O分布以及一个先前未知的锁竞争问题，并对其进行了修复。

import_candidates.title: CRAMM: virtual memory support for garbage-collected applications
import_candidates.abstract: Existing virtual memory systems usually work well with applications written in C and C++, but they do not provide adequate support for garbage-collected applications. The performance of garbage-collected applications is sensitive to heap size. Larger heaps reduce the frequency of garbage collections, making them run several times faster. However, if the heap is too large to fit in the available RAM, garbage collection can trigger thrashing. Existing Java virtual machines attempt to adapt their application heap sizes to fit in RAM, but suffer performance degradations of up to 94\% when subjected to bursts of memory pressure.We present CRAMM (Cooperative Robust Automatic Memory Management), a system that solves these problems. CRAMM consists of two parts: (1) a new virtual memory system that collects detailed reference information for (2) an analytical model tailored to the underlying garbage collection algorithm. The CRAMM virtual memory system tracks recent reference behavior with low overhead. The CRAMM heap sizing model uses this information to compute a heap size that maximizes throughput while minimizing paging. We present extensive empirical results demonstrating CRAMM's ability to maintain high performance in the face of changing application and system load.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现有的虚拟内存系统通常能很好地支持用 C 和 C++ 编写的应用程序，但并不能为垃圾回收应用程序提供足够的支持。垃圾回收应用程序的性能对堆大小很敏感。较大的堆会减少垃圾回收的频率，使其运行速度提升数倍。然而，如果堆太大而无法装入可用 RAM，垃圾回收可能会引发颠簸。现有的 Java 虚拟机尝试调整应用程序堆大小以适应 RAM，但在遭遇内存压力突发时，性能下降幅度可高达 94%。我们提出了 CRAMM（协作式健壮自动内存管理），一个解决这些问题的系统。CRAMM 由两部分组成：(1) 一个新的虚拟内存系统，用于为一个（2）针对底层垃圾回收算法量身定制的分析模型收集详细的引用信息。CRAMM 虚拟内存系统以低开销跟踪近期引用行为。CRAMM 堆大小调整模型利用这些信息来计算一个在最大化吞吐量的同时最小化分页的堆大小。我们提供了广泛的实证结果，证明 CRAMM 能够在应用程序和系统负载变化时保持高性能。

import_candidates.title: Flight data recorder: monitoring persistent-state interactions to improve systems management
import_candidates.abstract: Mismanagement of the persistent state of a system---all the executable files, configuration settings and other data that govern how a system functions---causes reliability problems, security vulnerabilities, and drives up operation costs. Recent research traces persistent state interactions---how state is read, modified, etc.---to help troubleshooting, change management and malware mitigation, but has been limited by the difficulty of collecting, storing, and analyzing the 10s to 100s of millions of daily events that occur on a single machine, much less the 1000s or more machines in many computing environments.We present the Flight Data Recorder (FDR) that enables always-on tracing, storage and analysis of persistent state interactions. FDR uses a domain-specific log format, tailored to observed file system workloads and common systems management queries. Our lossless log format compresses logs to only 0.5--0.9 bytes per interaction. In this log format, 1000 machine-days of logs---over 25 billion events---can be analyzed in less than 30 minutes. We report on our deployment of FDR to 207 production machines at MSN, and show that a single centralized collection machine can potentially scale to collecting and analyzing the complete records of persistent state interactions from 4000+ machines. Furthermore, our tracing technology is shipping as part of the Windows Vista OS.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 系统持久状态——即控制系统运行方式的所有可执行文件、配置设置及其他数据——的管理不善会导致可靠性问题、安全漏洞，并推高运维成本。近期研究追踪持久状态交互（即状态如何被读取、修改等），以帮助故障排除、变更管理和恶意软件缓解，但一直受限于在一台机器上收集、存储和分析每天数千万事件的难度，更不用说在许多计算环境中多达数千台甚至更多的机器。我们提出了飞行数据记录器（FDR），能够实现对持久状态交互的持续追踪、存储和分析。FDR采用一种领域特定的日志格式，该格式针对观察到的文件系统工作负载和常见的系统管理查询进行定制。我们的无损日志格式将日志压缩到每次交互仅0.5–0.9字节。在此日志格式下，1000机器天的日志——超过250亿个事件——可在不到30分钟内完成分析。我们报告了在MSN中207台生产机器上部署FDR的情况，并表明单个集中式收集机器可以扩展到从4000多台机器收集和分析持久状态交互的完整记录。此外，我们的追踪技术已作为Windows Vista操作系统的一部分发货。

import_candidates.title: EXPLODE: a lightweight, general system for finding serious storage system errors
import_candidates.abstract: Storage systems such as file systems, databases, and RAID systems have a simple, basic contract: you give them data, they do not lose or corrupt it. Often they store the only copy, making its irrevocable loss almost arbitrarily bad. Unfortunately, their code is exceptionally hard to get right, since it must correctly recover from any crash at any program point, no matter how their state was smeared across volatile and persistent memory.This paper describes EXPLODE, a system that makes it easy to systematically check real storage systems for errors. It takes user-written, potentially system-specific checkers and uses them to drive a storage system into tricky corner cases, including crash recovery errors. EXPLODE uses a novel adaptation of ideas from model checking, a comprehensive, heavy-weight formal verification technique, that makes its checking more systematic (and hopefully more effective) than a pure testing approach while being just as lightweight.EXPLODE is effective. It found serious bugs in a broad range of real storage systems (without requiring source code): three version control systems, Berkeley DB, an NFS implementation, ten file systems, a RAID system, and the popular VMware GSX virtual machine. We found bugs in every system we checked, 36 bugs in total, typically with little effort.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 存储系统（如文件系统、数据库和RAID系统）有一个简单而基本的契约：你给它们数据，它们不能丢失或损坏。它们常常保存着唯一的副本，使其不可挽回的丢失几乎任意糟糕。不幸的是，它们的代码极难做到正确，因为它必须能够在任何程序点从任何崩溃中正确恢复，而无论其状态如何分布在易失性和持久性内存中。本文描述了EXPLODE，一个能够轻松系统性检查真实存储系统错误的系统。它采用用户编写的、可能特定于系统的检查器，并驱动存储系统进入棘手的边界情况，包括崩溃恢复错误。EXPLODE采用了模型检查思想的创新改编——一种全面的、重量级的形式化验证技术——使其检查比纯测试方法更系统（并且希望更有效），同时又保持轻量级。EXPLODE是有效的。它在各种真实存储系统中发现了严重错误（无需源代码）：三个版本控制系统、Berkeley DB、一个NFS实现、十个文件系统、一个RAID系统以及流行的VMware GSX虚拟机。我们在每个被检查的系统中都发现了错误，总共36个，通常只需很少的努力。

import_candidates.title: Securing software by enforcing data-flow integrity
import_candidates.abstract: Software attacks often subvert the intended data-flow in a vulnerable program. For example, attackers exploit buffer overflows and format string vulnerabilities to write data to unintended locations. We present a simple technique that prevents these attacks by enforcing data-flow integrity. It computes a data-flow graph using static analysis, and it instruments the program to ensure that the flow of data at runtime is allowed by the data-flow graph. We describe an efficient implementation of data-flow integrity enforcement that uses static analysis to reduce instrumentation overhead. This implementation can be used in practice to detect a broad class of attacks and errors because it can be applied automatically to C and C++ programs without modifications, it does not have false positives, and it has low overhead.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 软件攻击常常破坏易受攻击程序中的预期数据流。例如，攻击者利用缓冲区溢出和格式化字符串漏洞将数据写入非预期位置。我们提出了一种通过强制数据流完整性来防止这些攻击的简单技术。该技术利用静态分析计算数据流图，并对程序进行插桩，以确保运行时数据流是数据流图所允许的。我们描述了一种高效的数据流完整性强制执行实现，该实现使用静态分析来减少插桩开销。该实现可用于实际检测广泛类别的攻击和错误，因为它可以自动应用于C和C++程序而无需修改，不会产生误报，且开销较低。

import_candidates.title: From uncertainty to belief: inferring the specification within
import_candidates.abstract: Automatic tools for finding software errors require a set of specifications before they can check code: if they do not know what to check, they cannot find bugs. This paper presents a novel framework based on factor graphs for automatically inferring specifications directly from programs. The key strength of the approach is that it can incorporate many disparate sources of evidence, allowing us to squeeze significantly more information from our observations than previously published techniques.We illustrate the strengths of our approach by applying it to the problem of inferring what functions in C programs allocate and release resources. We evaluated its effectiveness on five codebases: SDL, OpenSSH, GIMP, and the OS kernels for Linux and Mac OS X (XNU). For each codebase, starting with zero initially provided annotations, we observed an inferred annotation accuracy of 80--90\%, with often near perfect accuracy for functions called as little asfive times. Many of the inferred allocator and deallocator functions are functions for which we both lack the implementation and are rarely called---in some cases functions with at most one or two callsites. Finally, with the inferred annotations we quickly found both missing and incorrect properties in a specification used by a commercial static bug-finding tool.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 用于发现软件错误的自动化工具在检查代码之前需要一组规范：如果它们不知道要检查什么，就无法发现缺陷。本文提出了一个基于因子图的新框架，用于直接从程序中自动推断规范。该方法的关键优势在于它能整合许多不同来源的证据，使我们能够从观察中获取比先前发表的技术多得多的信息。我们将该方法应用于推断C程序中哪些函数分配和释放资源的问题，以展示其优势。我们在五个代码库上评估了其有效性：SDL、OpenSSH、GIMP，以及Linux和Mac OS X（XNU）的操作系统内核。对于每个代码库，从零个初始标注开始，我们观察到推断标注的准确率为80%–90%，对于调用次数仅为5次的函数，准确率通常接近完美。许多推断出的分配器和释放器函数，我们既缺乏其实现，又很少被调用——在某些情况下，调用点最多只有一到两处。最后，利用推断出的标注，我们很快在一个商业静态缺陷查找工具所使用的规范中发现了缺失和错误的属性。

import_candidates.title: HQ replication: a hybrid quorum protocol for byzantine fault tolerance
import_candidates.abstract: There are currently two approaches to providing Byzantine-fault-tolerant state machine replication: a replica-based approach, e.g., BFT, that uses communication between replicas to agree on a proposed ordering of requests, and a quorum-based approach, such as Q/U, in which clients contact replicas directly to optimistically execute operations. Both approaches have shortcomings: the quadratic cost of inter-replica communication is un-necessary when there is no contention, and Q/U requires a large number of replicas and performs poorly under contention.We present HQ, a hybrid Byzantine-fault-tolerant state machine replication protocol that overcomes these problems. HQ employs a lightweight quorum-based protocol when there is no contention, but uses BFT to resolve contention when it arises. Furthermore, HQ uses only 3f + 1 replicas to tolerate f faults, providing optimal resilience to node failures.We implemented a prototype of HQ, and we compare its performance to BFT and Q/U analytically and experimentally. Additionally, in this work we use a new implementation of BFT designed to scale as the number of faults increases. Our results show that both HQ and our new implementation of BFT scale as f increases; additionally our hybrid approach of using BFT to handle contention works well.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 目前有两种提供拜占庭容错状态机复制的方法：一种是基于副本的方法（例如BFT），它利用副本之间的通信来商定请求的提议顺序；另一种是基于法定人数的方法（例如Q/U），客户端直接联系副本以乐观地执行操作。两种方法都有缺点：在没有争用的情况下，副本间通信的二次方成本是不必要的；而Q/U需要大量副本，并且在争用情况下表现不佳。我们提出了HQ，一种克服这些问题的混合拜占庭容错状态机复制协议。HQ在没有争用时采用轻量级基于法定人数的协议，但在出现争用时使用BFT来解决。此外，HQ仅使用3f+1个副本即可容忍f个故障，提供了对节点故障的最优弹性。我们实现了HQ的原型，并通过分析和实验将其性能与BFT和Q/U进行比较。此外，在这项工作中，我们使用了一个新的BFT实现，该实现设计为随故障数量增加而扩展。我们的结果表明，HQ和我们新的BFT实现都能随f的增加而扩展；此外，我们使用BFT处理争用的混合方法效果良好。

import_candidates.title: BAR gossip
import_candidates.abstract: We present the first peer-to-peer data streaming application that guarantees predictable throughput and low latency in the BAR (Byzantine/Altruistic/Rational) model, in which non-altruistic nodes can behave in ways that are self-serving (rational) or arbitrarily malicious (Byzantine). At the core of our solution is a BAR-tolerant version of gossip, a well-known technique for scalable and reliable data dissemination. BAR Gossip relies on verifiable pseudo-random partner selection to eliminate non-determinism that can be used to game the system while maintaining the robustness and rapid convergence of traditional gossip. A novel fair enough exchange primitive entices cooperation among selfish nodes on short timescales, avoiding the need for long-term node reputations. Our initial experience provides evidence for BAR Gossip's robustness. Our BAR-tolerant streaming application provides over 99\% convergence for broadcast updates when all clients are selfish but not colluding, and over 95\% convergence when up to 40\% of clients collude while the rest follow the protocol. BAR Gossip also performs well when the client population consists of both selfish and Byzantine nodes, achieving over 93\% convergence even when 20\% of the nodes are Byzantine.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了首个对等数据流应用，该应用在BAR（拜占庭/利他/理性）模型中保证可预测的吞吐量和低延迟。在BAR模型中，非利他节点可能以自利（理性）或任意恶意（拜占庭）的方式行为。我们解决方案的核心是八卦协议的BAR容忍版本，八卦是一种众所周知的可扩展且可靠的数据传播技术。BAR八卦依赖可验证的伪随机伙伴选择来消除可用于操纵系统的不确定性，同时保持传统八卦的鲁棒性和快速收敛。一种新颖的公平足够交换原语在短时间尺度上诱使自私节点合作，避免了对长期节点声誉的需求。我们的初步经验为BAR八卦的鲁棒性提供了证据。当所有客户端自私但未合谋时，我们的BAR容忍流应用对广播更新的收敛率超过99%；当最多40%的客户端合谋而其余客户端遵循协议时，收敛率超过95%。当客户端群体同时包含自私和拜占庭节点时，BAR八卦也表现良好，即使20%的节点是拜占庭的，收敛率也超过93%。

import_candidates.title: Bigtable: a distributed storage system for structured data
import_candidates.abstract: Bigtable is a distributed storage system for managing structured data that is designed to scale to a very large size: petabytes of data across thousands of commodity servers. Many projects at Google store data in Bigtable, including web indexing, Google Earth, and Google Finance. These applications place very different demands on Bigtable, both in terms of data size (from URLs to web pages to satellite imagery) and latency requirements (from backend bulk processing to real-time data serving). Despite these varied demands, Bigtable has successfully provided a flexible, high-performance solution for all of these Google products. In this paper we describe the simple data model provided by Bigtable, which gives clients dynamic control over data layout and format, and we describe the design and implementation of Bigtable.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Bigtable是一种用于管理结构化数据的分布式存储系统，设计目标是扩展到极大规模：跨数千台商用服务器的PB级数据。Google的许多项目（包括网页索引、Google Earth和Google Finance）都将数据存储在Bigtable中。这些应用对Bigtable提出了不同的需求，无论是数据规模（从URL到网页再到卫星图像）还是延迟要求（从后端批量处理到实时数据服务）。尽管需求各异，Bigtable已成功为所有这些Google产品提供了灵活、高性能的解决方案。在本文中，我们描述了Bigtable提供的简单数据模型，该模型让客户端能够动态控制数据布局和格式，并描述了Bigtable的设计与实现。

import_candidates.title: EnsemBlue: integrating distributed storage and consumer electronics
import_candidates.abstract: EnsemBlue is a distributed file system for personal multimedia that incorporates both general-purpose computers and consumer electronic devices (CEDs). Ensem-Blue leverages the capabilities of a few general-purpose computers to make CEDs first class clients of the file system. It supports namespace diversity by translating between its distributed namespace and the local namespaces of CEDs. It supports extensibility through persistent queries, a robust event notification mechanism that leverages the underlying cache consistency protocols of the file system. Finally, it allows mobile clients to self-organize and share data through device ensembles. Our results show that these features impose little overhead, yet they enable the integration of emerging platforms such as digital cameras, MP3 players, and DVRs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: EnsemBlue是一个针对个人多媒体的分布式文件系统，融合了通用计算机和消费电子设备（CED）。EnsemBlue利用少量通用计算机的能力，使CED成为文件系统的一等客户端。它通过在分布式命名空间与CED的本地命名空间之间进行转换，支持命名空间多样性。它通过持久查询（一种利用底层文件系统缓存一致性协议的稳健事件通知机制）支持可扩展性。此外，它允许移动客户端通过设备集合自行组织并共享数据。我们的结果表明，这些功能带来的开销很小，同时它们支持集成数字相机、MP3播放器和DVR等新兴平台。

import_candidates.title: Persistent personal names for globally connected mobile devices
import_candidates.abstract: The Unmanaged Internet Architecture (UIA) provides zero-configuration connectivity among mobile devices through personal names. Users assign personal names through an ad hoc device introduction process requiring no central allocation. Once assigned, names bind securely to the global identities of their target devices independent of network location. Each user manages one namespace, shared among all the user's devices and always available on each device. Users can also name other users to share resources with trusted acquaintances. Devices with naming relationships automatically arrange connectivity when possible, both in ad hoc networks and using global infrastructure when available. A UIA prototype demonstrates these capabilities using optimistic replication for name resolution and group management and a routing algorithm exploiting the user's social network for connectivity.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 非受管互联网架构（UIA）通过个人名称在移动设备之间提供零配置连接。用户通过无需中央分配的临时设备引入过程来分配个人名称。一旦分配，名称便安全地绑定到目标设备的全局身份，与网络位置无关。每个用户管理一个命名空间，该命名空间在用户的所有设备之间共享，并在每台设备上始终可用。用户还可以为其他用户命名，以与可信熟人共享资源。具有命名关系的设备在可能的情况下会自动安排连接，既可在临时网络中也可利用可用时的全球基础设施。UIA原型通过用于名称解析和组管理的乐观复制以及利用用户社交网络进行连接的路由算法展示了这些能力。

import_candidates.title: A modular network layer for sensorsets
import_candidates.abstract: An overall sensornet architecture would help tame the increasingly complex structure of wireless sensornet software and help foster greater interoperability between different codebases. A previous step in this direction is the Sensornet Protocol (SP), a unifying link-abstraction layer. This paper takes the natural next step by proposing a modular network-layer for sensornets that sits atop SP. This modularity eases implementation of new protocols by increasing code reuse, and enables co-existing protocols to share and reduce code and resources consumed at run-time. We demonstrate how current protocols can be decomposed into this modular structure and show that the costs, in performance and code footprint, are minimal relative to their monolithic counterparts.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 一个整体的传感器网络架构将有助于梳理无线传感器网络软件日益复杂的结构，并促进不同代码库之间更强的互操作性。此前朝此方向迈出的一步是Sensornet Protocol（SP），一个统一的链路抽象层。本文提出自然的下一步：在SP之上构建一个模块化的传感器网络网络层。该模块化通过提高代码复用来简化新协议的实现，并使共存协议能够共享代码，从而减少运行时资源消耗。我们展示了当前协议如何被分解为该模块化结构，并表明相对于整体式协议，其在性能和代码占用方面的成本微不足道。

import_candidates.title: Making information flow explicit in HiStar
import_candidates.abstract: HiStar is a new operating system designed to minimize the amount of code that must be trusted. HiStar provides strict information flow control, which allows users to specify precise data security policies without unduly limiting the structure of applications. HiStar's security features make it possible to implement a Unix-like environment with acceptable performance almost entirely in an untrusted user-level library. The system has no notion of superuser and no fully trusted code other than the kernel. HiStar's features permit several novel applications, including an entirely untrusted login process, separation of data between virtual private networks, and privacy-preserving, untrusted virus scanners.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: HiStar是一种旨在最小化需信任代码量的新型操作系统。HiStar提供严格的信息流控制，允许用户指定精确的数据安全策略，同时不过度限制应用程序的结构。HiStar的安全特性使得几乎完全在不受信任的用户级库中实现类似Unix的环境且性能可接受成为可能。该系统没有超级用户的概念，除内核外也没有完全受信任的代码。HiStar的特性支持多种新颖应用，包括完全不受信任的登录进程、虚拟专用网络之间的数据隔离，以及保护隐私的不受信任病毒扫描器。

import_candidates.title: Splitting interfaces: making trust between applications and operating systems configurable
import_candidates.abstract: In current commodity systems, applications have no way of limiting their trust in the underlying operating system (OS), leaving them at the complete mercy of an attacker who gains control over the OS. In this work, we describe the design and implementation of Proxos, a system that allows applications to configure their trust in the OS by partitioning the system call interface into trusted and untrusted components. System call routing rules that indicate which system calls are to be handled by the un-trusted commodity OS, and which are to be handled by a trusted private OS, are specified by the application developer. We find that rather than defining a new system call interface, routing system calls of an existing interface allows applications currently targeted towards commodity operating systems to isolate their most sensitive components from the commodity OS with only minor source code modifications.We have built a prototype of our system on top of the Xen Virtual Machine Monitor with Linux as the commodity OS. In practice, we find that the system call routing rules are short and simple -- on the order of 10's of lines of code. In addition, applications in Proxos incur only modest performance overhead, with most of the cost resulting from inter-VM context switches.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在当前商品化系统中，应用程序无法限制其对底层操作系统（OS）的信任，这使得一旦攻击者控制了操作系统，应用程序便完全任其摆布。在这项工作中，我们描述了Proxos的设计与实现，该系统允许应用程序通过将系统调用接口划分为可信和不可信组件来配置对操作系统的信任。指示哪些系统调用由不可信的商用操作系统处理、哪些由可信的私有操作系统处理的系统调用路由规则，由应用程序开发者指定。我们发现，与其定义一个新的系统调用接口，对现有接口的系统调用进行路由，能使当前面向商用操作系统的应用程序仅需少量源代码修改即可将其最敏感的组件与商用操作系统隔离。我们在Xen虚拟机监视器之上构建了系统原型，以Linux作为商用操作系统。实践中我们发现，系统调用路由规则简短而简单——大约几十行代码。此外，Proxos中的应用程序仅承受适度的性能开销，大部分成本来自虚拟机间上下文切换。

import_candidates.title: Connection handoff policies for TCP offload network interfaces
import_candidates.abstract: This paper presents three policies for effectively utilizing TCP offload network interfaces that support connection handoff. These policies allow connection handoff to reduce the computation and memory bandwidth requirements for packet processing on the host processor without causing the resource constraints on the network interface to limit overall system performance. First, prioritizing packet processing on the network interface ensures that its TCP processing does not harm performance of the connections on the host operating system. Second, dynamically adapting the number of connections on the network interface to the current load avoids overloading the network interface. Third, the operating system can predict connection lifetimes to select long-lived connections for handoff to better utilize the network interface. The use of the first two policies improves web server throughput by 12--31\% over the baseline throughput achieved without offload. The third policy helps improve performance when the network interface can only handle a small number of connections at a time. Furthermore, by using a faster offload processor, offloading can improve server throughput by 33--72\%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文提出了三种策略，用于有效利用支持连接交接的TCP卸载网络接口。这些策略允许连接交接减少主机处理器上数据包处理所需的计算和内存带宽，而不会使网络接口上的资源限制限制整体系统性能。首先，优先处理网络接口上的数据包确保其TCP处理不会损害主机操作系统上连接的性能。其次，动态调整网络接口上的连接数量以适应当前负载，避免网络接口过载。第三，操作系统可以预测连接生命周期，以选择长连接进行交接，从而更好地利用网络接口。使用前两种策略可将Web服务器吞吐量比无卸载的基线吞吐量提高12-31%。当网络接口一次只能处理少量连接时，第三种策略有助于提高性能。此外，通过使用更快的卸载处理器，卸载可将服务器吞吐量提高33-72%。

import_candidates.title: Ceph: a scalable, high-performance distributed file system
import_candidates.abstract: We have developed Ceph, a distributed file system that provides excellent performance, reliability, and scalability. Ceph maximizes the separation between data and metadata management by replacing allocation tables with a pseudo-random data distribution function (CRUSH) designed for heterogeneous and dynamic clusters of unreliable object storage devices (OSDs). We leverage device intelligence by distributing data replication, failure detection and recovery to semi-autonomous OSDs running a specialized local object file system. A dynamic distributed metadata cluster provides extremely efficient metadata management and seamlessly adapts to a wide range of general purpose and scientific computing file system workloads. Performance measurements under a variety of workloads show that Ceph has excellent I/O performance and scalable metadata management, supporting more than 250,000 metadata operations per second.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们开发了Ceph，一个提供出色性能、可靠性和可扩展性的分布式文件系统。Ceph通过用伪随机数据分布函数(CRUSH)替代分配表来最大化数据与元数据管理的分离，该函数专为异构和动态集群的不可靠对象存储设备(OSD)设计。我们利用设备智能，将数据复制、故障检测和恢复分布到运行专用本地对象文件系统的半自主OSD上。一个动态分布式元数据集群提供了极其高效的元数据管理，并能够无缝适应各种通用和科学计算文件系统工作负载。在各种工作负载下的性能测量表明，Ceph具有优秀的I/O性能和可扩展的元数据管理，每秒可支持超过25万次元数据操作。

import_candidates.title: Distributed directory service in the Farsite file system
import_candidates.abstract: We present the design, implementation, and evaluation of a fully distributed directory service for Farsite, a logically centralized file system that is physically implemented on a loosely coupled network of desktop computers. Prior to this work, the Farsite system included distributed mechanisms for file content but centralized mechanisms for file metadata. Our distributed directory service introduces tree-structured file identifiers that support dynamically partitioning metadata at arbitrary granularity, recursive path leases for scalably maintaining name-space consistency, and a protocol for consistently performing operations on files managed by separate machines. It also mitigates metadata hotspots via file-field leases and the new mechanism of disjunctive leases. We experimentally show that Farsite can dynamically partition file-system metadata while maintaining full file-system semantics.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们介绍了Farsite中完全分布式目录服务的设计、实现和评估。Farsite是一个逻辑上集中但在松散耦合的桌面计算机网络上物理实现的文件系统。在这项工作之前，Farsite系统包含用于文件内容的分布式机制，但文件元数据采用了集中式机制。我们的分布式目录服务引入了树状文件标识符，支持任意粒度动态划分元数据；递归路径租约，以可扩展方式维护命名空间一致性；以及在不同机器管理文件时一致执行操作的协议。它还通过文件字段租约和新的析取租约机制缓解元数据热点。我们通过实验证明，Farsite能够在维护完整文件系统语义的同时动态划分文件系统元数据。

import_candidates.title: The Chubby lock service for loosely-coupled distributed systems
import_candidates.abstract: We describe our experiences with the Chubby lock service, which is intended to provide coarse-grained locking as well as reliable (though low-volume) storage for a loosely-coupled distributed system. Chubby provides an interface much like a distributed file system with advisory locks, but the design emphasis is on availability and reliability, as opposed to high performance. Many instances of the service have been used for over a year, with several of them each handling a few tens of thousands of clients concurrently. The paper describes the initial design and expected use, compares it with actual use, and explains how the design had to be modified to accommodate the differences.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文描述了我们在Chubby锁服务上的经验。该服务旨在为松散耦合的分布式系统提供粗粒度锁以及可靠但低容量的存储。Chubby提供的接口非常类似于带建议性锁的分布式文件系统，但设计重点在于可用性和可靠性，而非高性能。多个服务实例已运行一年多，其中几个实例每个并发处理数万个客户端。本文介绍了初始设计和预期用途，与实际使用情况进行了比较，并解释了设计为了适应差异而如何被修改。

import_candidates.title: Experiences building PlanetLab
import_candidates.abstract: This paper reports our experiences building PlanetLab over the last four years. It identifies the requirements that shaped PlanetLab, explains the design decisions that resulted from resolving conflicts among these requirements, and reports our experience implementing and supporting the system. Due in large part to the nature of the "PlanetLab experiment," the discussion focuses on synthesis rather than new techniques, balancing system-wide considerations rather than improving performance along a single dimension, and learning from feedback from a live system rather than controlled experiments using synthetic workloads.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文报告了我们在过去四年中构建PlanetLab的经验。它确定了塑造PlanetLab的需求，解释了解决这些需求之间冲突所产生的设计决策，并报告了我们实施和支持该系统的经验。在很大程度上由于“PlanetLab实验”的性质，讨论侧重于综合而非新技术，平衡系统层面的考虑而非沿单一维度提升性能，以及从真实系统的反馈中学习而非使用合成工作负载进行受控实验。

import_candidates.title: iPlane: an information plane for distributed services
import_candidates.abstract: In this paper, we present the design, implementation, and evaluation of iPlane, a scalable service providing accurate predictions of Internet path performance for emerging overlay services. Unlike the more common black box latency prediction techniques in use today, iPlane adopts a structural approach and predicts end-to-end path performance by composing the performance of measured segments of Internet paths. For the paths we observed, this method allows us to accurately and efficiently predict latency, bandwidth, capacity and loss rates between arbitrary Internet hosts. We demonstrate the feasibility and utility of the iPlane service by applying it to several representative overlay services in use today: content distribution, swarming peer-to-peer filesharing, and voice-over-IP. In each case, using iPlane's predictions leads to improved overlay performance.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们介绍了iPlane的设计、实现和评估，它是一种可扩展的服务，为新兴的覆盖服务提供互联网路径性能的准确预测。与当今使用的更常见的黑盒延迟预测技术不同，iPlane采用结构化方法，通过组合互联网路径的测量网段性能来预测端到端路径性能。对于我们观察到的路径，这种方法使我们能够准确、高效地预测任意互联网主机之间的延迟、带宽、容量和丢包率。我们通过将iPlane应用于当今几种代表性的覆盖服务：内容分发、群组对等文件共享和IP语音，来展示其可行性和实用性。在每种情况下，使用iPlane的预测都能提高覆盖服务的性能。

import_candidates.title: Fidelity and yield in a volcano monitoring sensor network
import_candidates.abstract: We present a science-centric evaluation of a 19-day sensor network deployment at Reventador, an active volcano in Ecuador. Each of the 16 sensors continuously sampled seismic and acoustic data at 100 Hz. Nodes used an event-detection algorithm to trigger on interesting volcanic activity and initiate reliable data transfer to the base station. During the deployment, the network recorded 229 earthquakes, eruptions, and other seismoacoustic events.The science requirements of reliable data collection, accurate event detection, and high timing precision drive sensor networks in new directions for geophysical monitoring. The main contribution of this paper is an evaluation of the sensor network as a scientific instrument, holding it to the standards of existing instrumentation in terms of data fidelity (the quality and accuracy of the recorded signals) and yield (the quantity of the captured data). We describe an approach to time rectification of the acquired signals that can recover accurate timing despite failures of the underlying time synchronization protocol. In addition, we perform a detailed study of the sensor network's data using a direct comparison to a standalone data logger, as well as an investigation of seismic and acoustic wave arrival times across the network.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们对厄瓜多尔Reventador活火山上一个为期19天的传感器网络部署进行了以科学为中心的评估。16个传感器中的每一个都以100 Hz的频率连续采样地震和声学数据。节点使用事件检测算法来触发对有趣火山活动的响应，并启动到基站的高可靠性数据传输。在部署期间，网络记录了229次地震、火山喷发和其他地震声学事件。科学要求包括可靠的数据收集、准确的事件检测和高时间精度，这推动了传感器网络在地球物理监测方面的新的发展方向。本文的主要贡献是将传感器网络作为科学仪器进行评估，在数据保真度（记录信号的质量和准确性）和产出（捕获数据的数量）方面将其与现有仪器的标准进行比较。我们描述了一种对获取信号进行时间校正的方法，即使底层时间同步协议出现故障，也能恢复准确的时间。此外，我们通过与独立数据记录器的直接比较，以及研究网络中地震和声波到达时间，对传感器网络的数据进行了详细研究。

import_candidates.title: DryadLINQ: a system for general-purpose distributed data-parallel computing using a high-level language
import_candidates.abstract: DryadLINQ is a system and a set of language extensions that enable a new programming model for large scale distributed computing. It generalizes previous execution environments such as SQL, MapReduce, and Dryad in two ways: by adopting an expressive data model of strongly typed .NET objects; and by supporting general-purpose imperative and declarative operations on datasets within a traditional high-level programming language.A DryadLINQ program is a sequential program composed of LINQ expressions performing arbitrary side-effect-free transformations on datasets, and can be written and debugged using standard .NET development tools. The DryadLINQ system automatically and transparently translates the data-parallel portions of the program into a distributed execution plan which is passed to the Dryad execution platform. Dryad, which has been in continuous operation for several years on production clusters made up of thousands of computers, ensures efficient, reliable execution of this plan.We describe the implementation of the DryadLINQ compiler and runtime. We evaluate DryadLINQ on a varied set of programs drawn from domains such as web-graph analysis, large-scale log mining, and machine learning. We show that excellent absolute performance can be attained--a general-purpose sort of 1012 Bytes of data executes in 319 seconds on a 240-computer, 960- disk cluster--as well as demonstrating near-linear scaling of execution time on representative applications as we vary the number of computers used for a job.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: DryadLINQ是一个系统和一组语言扩展，它为大规模分布式计算提供了一种新的编程模型。它在两个方面推广了先前诸如SQL、MapReduce和Dryad之类的执行环境：采用强类型.NET对象的表达性数据模型；并支持在传统高级编程语言中对数据集进行通用的命令式和声明式操作。DryadLINQ程序是由LINQ表达式组成的顺序程序，对数据集执行任意的无副作用转换，并且可以使用标准.NET开发工具进行编写和调试。DryadLINQ系统自动且透明地将程序的数据并行部分转换为分布式执行计划，该计划传递给Dryad执行平台。Dryad已在由数千台计算机构成的生产集群上连续运行多年，确保该计划的高效、可靠执行。我们描述了DryadLINQ编译器和运行时的实现。我们在来自Web图分析、大规模日志挖掘和机器学习等领域的多种程序上评估了DryadLINQ。我们展示了可以获得的优异绝对性能——在包含240台计算机、960块磁盘的集群上，对10^12字节数据的通用排序在319秒内完成——同时也展示了在使用不同数量的计算机执行作业时，代表性应用程序的执行时间呈近线性扩展。

import_candidates.title: Everest: scaling down peak loads through I/O off-loading
import_candidates.abstract: Bursts in data center workloads are a real problem for storage subsystems. Data volumes can experience peak I/O request rates that are over an order of magnitude higher than average load. This requires significant overprovisioning, and often still results in significant I/O request latency during peaks.In order to address this problem we propose Everest, which allows data written to an overloaded volume to be temporarily off-loaded into a short-term virtual store. Everest creates the short-term store by opportunistically pooling underutilized storage resources either on a server or across servers within the data center. Writes are temporarily off-loaded from overloaded volumes to lightly loaded volumes, thereby reducing the I/O load on the former. Everest is transparent to and usable by unmodified applications, and does not change the persistence or consistency of the storage system. We evaluate Everest using traces from a production Exchange mail server as well as other benchmarks: our results show a 1.4-70 times reduction in mean response times during peaks.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 数据中心工作负载中的突发峰值对存储子系统而言是一个现实问题。数据卷可能经历比平均负载高一个数量级以上的峰值I/O请求率。这需要大量的过度供应，并且在峰值期间往往仍会导致显著的I/O请求延迟。为解决此问题，我们提出了Everest，它允许将写入超载卷的数据临时卸载到短期虚拟存储中。Everest通过机会性地汇集服务器上或数据中心内服务器间的未充分利用的存储资源来创建短期存储。写入将被临时从超载卷卸载到负载较轻的卷，从而减少前者的I/O负载。Everest对未修改的应用程序透明且可用，并且不会改变存储系统的持久性或一致性。我们使用来自生产环境Exchange邮件服务器以及其它基准测试的痕迹评估Everest：结果显示在峰值期间平均响应时间降低了1.4至70倍。

import_candidates.title: Improving MapReduce performance in heterogeneous environments
import_candidates.abstract: MapReduce is emerging as an important programming model for large-scale data-parallel applications such as web indexing, data mining, and scientific simulation. Hadoop is an open-source implementation of MapReduce enjoying wide adoption and is often used for short jobs where low response time is critical. Hadoop's performance is closely tied to its task scheduler, which implicitly assumes that cluster nodes are homogeneous and tasks make progress linearly, and uses these assumptions to decide when to speculatively re-execute tasks that appear to be stragglers. In practice, the homogeneity assumptions do not always hold. An especially compelling setting where this occurs is a virtualized data center, such as Amazon's Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2). We show that Hadoop's scheduler can cause severe performance degradation in heterogeneous environments. We design a new scheduling algorithm, Longest Approximate Time to End (LATE), that is highly robust to heterogeneity. LATE can improve Hadoop response times by a factor of 2 in clusters of 200 virtual machines on EC2.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: MapReduce正逐渐成为大规模数据并行应用（如网页索引、数据挖掘和科学模拟）的重要编程模型。Hadoop作为MapReduce的开源实现得到广泛采用，并且通常用于低响应时间至关重要的短作业。Hadoop的性能与其任务调度器密切相关，该调度器隐式地假设集群节点是同构的，且任务呈线性进展，并利用这些假设来决定何时推测性地重新执行那些看起来落后的任务。然而在实践中，同构性假设并不总是成立。一个特别具有说服力的场景是虚拟化数据中心，例如亚马逊的弹性计算云（EC2）。我们研究表明，Hadoop的调度器在异构环境中可能导致严重的性能下降。为此，我们设计了一种新的调度算法——最长近似完成时间（LATE），该算法对异构性具有高度鲁棒性。在EC2上由200台虚拟机组成的集群中，LATE可将Hadoop的响应时间提高一倍。

import_candidates.title: Corey: an operating system for many cores
import_candidates.abstract: Multiprocessor application performance can be limited by the operating system when the application uses the operating system frequently and the operating system services use data structures shared and modified by multiple processing cores. If the application does not need the sharing, then the operating system will become an unnecessary bottleneck to the application's performance.This paper argues that applications should control sharing: the kernel should arrange each data structure so that only a single processor need update it, unless directed otherwise by the application. Guided by this design principle, this paper proposes three operating system abstractions (address ranges, kernel cores, and shares) that allow applications to control inter-core sharing and to take advantage of the likely abundance of cores by dedicating cores to specific operating system functions.Measurements of microbenchmarks on the Corey prototype operating system, which embodies the new abstractions, show how control over sharing can improve performance. Application benchmarks, using MapReduce and a Web server, show that the improvements can be significant for overall performance: MapReduce on Corey performs 25\% faster than on Linux when using 16 cores. Hardware event counters confirm that these improvements are due to avoiding operations that are expensive on multicore machines.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 当应用程序频繁使用操作系统，并且操作系统服务使用由多个处理核心共享和修改的数据结构时，多处理器应用程序的性能可能受到操作系统的限制。如果应用程序不需要这种共享，操作系统将成为应用程序性能的不必要瓶颈。本文认为应用程序应控制共享：内核应安排每个数据结构，使得在应用程序未另有指示的情况下，只有单个处理器需要更新它。在这一设计原则的指导下，本文提出了三种操作系统抽象（地址范围、内核核心和份额），这些抽象允许应用程序控制核心间共享，并利用可能多核充裕的优势，将核心专门用于特定的操作系统功能。对体现这些新抽象的Corey原型操作系统的微基准测试表明，控制共享如何提高性能。使用MapReduce和Web服务器的应用基准测试表明，这些改进对整体性能可能具有重要意义：在16核下，Corey上的MapReduce比Linux上运行快25%。硬件事件计数器证实，这些改进归因于避免了在多核机器上开销高昂的操作。

import_candidates.title: CuriOS: improving reliability through operating system structure
import_candidates.abstract: An error that occurs in a microkernel operating system service can potentially result in state corruption and service failure. A simple restart of the failed service is not always the best solution for reliability. Blindly restarting a service which maintains client-related state such as session information results in the loss of this state and affects all clients that were using the service. CuriOS represents a novel OS design that uses lightweight distribution, isolation and persistence of OS service state to mitigate the problem of state loss during a restart. The design also significantly reduces error propagation within client-related state maintained by an OS service. This is achieved by encapsulating services in separate protection domains and granting access to client-related state only when required for request processing. Fault injection experiments show that it is possible to recover from between 87\% and 100\% of manifested errors in OS services such as the file system, network, timer and scheduler while maintaining low performance overheads.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 微内核操作系统服务中发生的错误可能导致状态损坏和服务失败。简单重启失败的服务并不总是提高可靠性的最佳方案。盲目重启维护客户端相关状态（如会话信息）的服务会导致这些状态丢失，并影响所有使用该服务的客户端。CuriOS代表了一种新颖的OS设计，它使用OS服务状态的轻量级分布、隔离和持久化来减轻重启期间状态丢失的问题。该设计还显著减少了操作系统服务维护的客户端相关状态中的错误传播。这是通过将服务封装在独立的保护域中，并仅在处理请求需要时授予对客户端相关状态的访问来实现的。故障注入实验表明，对于文件系统、网络、定时器和调度器等OS服务，可以从87%到100%的已显现错误中恢复，同时保持较低的性能开销。

import_candidates.title: Redline: first class support for interactivity in commodity operating systems
import_candidates.abstract: While modern workloads are increasingly interactive and resource-intensive (e.g., graphical user interfaces, browsers, and multimedia players), current operating systems have not kept up. These operating systems, which evolved from core designs that date to the 1970s and 1980s, provide good support for batch and command-line applications, but their ad hoc attempts to handle interactive workloads are poor. Their best-effort, priority-based schedulers provide no bounds on delays, and their resource managers (e.g., memory managers and disk I/O schedulers) are mostly oblivious to response time requirements. Pressure on any one of these resources can significantly degrade application responsiveness.We present Redline, a system that brings first-class support for interactive applications to commodity operating systems. Redline works with unaltered applications and standard APIs. It uses lightweight specifications to orchestrate memory and disk I/O management so that they serve the needs of interactive applications. Unlike realtime systems that treat specifications as strict requirements and thus pessimistically limit system utilization, Redline dynamically adapts to recent load, maximizing responsiveness and system utilization. We show that Redline delivers responsiveness to interactive applications even in the face of extreme workloads including fork bombs, memory bombs and bursty, large disk I/O requests, reducing application pauses by up to two orders of magnitude.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 虽然现代工作负载日益具有交互性和资源密集性（例如图形用户界面、浏览器和多媒体播放器），但当前操作系统并未跟上步伐。这些操作系统源自可追溯至20世纪70年代和80年代的核心设计，为批处理和命令行应用程序提供了良好支持，但其处理交互式工作负载的临时方法却很糟糕。它们基于尽力而为的优先级调度器对延迟没有界限，其资源管理器（例如内存管理器和磁盘I/O调度器）大多不考虑响应时间要求。对这些资源中的任何一个施加压力都会显着降低应用程序的响应能力。我们提出了Redline，这是一个为商用操作系统带来对交互式应用程序的一等支持的系统。Redline与未经修改的应用程序和标准API协同工作。它使用轻量级规范来协调内存和磁盘I/O管理，使其服务于交互式应用程序的需求。与将规范视为严格要求从而悲观地限制系统利用率的实时系统不同，Redline动态适应近期的负载，最大限度地提高响应能力和系统利用率。我们展示了Redline即使在极端工作负载（包括fork炸弹、内存炸弹和突发性大磁盘I/O请求）下也能为交互式应用程序提供响应能力，将应用程序暂停时间减少高达两个数量级。

import_candidates.title: Network imprecision: a new consistency metric for scalable monitoring
import_candidates.abstract: This paper introduces a new consistency metric, Network Imprecision (NI), to address a central challenge in largescale monitoring systems: safeguarding accuracy despite node and network failures. To implement NI, an overlay that monitors a set of attributes also monitors its own state so that queries return not only attribute values but also information about the stability of the overlay--the number of nodes whose recent updates may be missing and the number of nodes whose inputs may be double counted due to overlay reconfigurations. When NI indicates that the network is stable, query results are guaranteed to reflect the true state of the system. But when the network is unstable, NI puts applications on notice that query results should not be trusted, allowing them to take corrective action such as filtering out inconsistent results. To scalably implement NI's introspection, our prototype introduces a key optimization, dual-tree prefix aggregation, which exploits overlay symmetry to reduce overheads by more than an order of magnitude. Evaluation of three monitoring applications demonstrates that NI flags inaccurate results while incurring low overheads, and monitoring applications that use NI to select good information can improve their accuracy by up to an order of magnitude.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种新的一致性度量——网络不精确性（Network Imprecision, NI）——以解决大规模监控系统中的一个核心挑战：即使存在节点和网络故障，也要保证准确性。为了实现NI，一个监控一组属性的覆盖网络也会监控自身的状态，使得查询不仅返回属性值，还返回关于覆盖网络稳定性的信息——即可能缺少的最近更新的节点数量，以及因覆盖网络重新配置而可能被重复计数的节点数量。当NI表明网络稳定时，查询结果被保证反映系统的真实状态。但当网络不稳定时，NI会提醒应用程序不应信任查询结果，使它们能够采取纠正措施，例如过滤掉不一致的结果。为了可扩展地实现NI的自省，我们的原型引入了一项关键优化——双树前缀聚合（dual-tree prefix aggregation），它利用覆盖网络的对称性将开销降低一个数量级以上。对三个监控应用的评估表明，NI能够标记不准确的结果，同时保持较低的开销，而使用NI来选择良好信息的监控应用可将其准确性提高多达一个数量级。

import_candidates.title: Lightweight, high-resolution monitoring for troubleshooting production systems
import_candidates.abstract: Production systems are commonly plagued by intermittent problems that are difficult to diagnose. This paper describes a new diagnostic tool, called Chopstix, that continuously collects profiles of low-level OS events (e.g., scheduling, L2 cache misses, CPU utilization, I/O operations, page allocation, locking) at the granularity of executables, procedures and instructions. Chopstix then reconstructs these events offline for analysis. We have used Chopstix to diagnose several elusive problems in a largescale production system, thereby reducing these intermittent problems to reproducible bugs that can be debugged using standard techniques. The key to Chopstix is an approximate data collection strategy that incurs very low overhead. An evaluation shows Chopstix requires under 1\% of the CPU, under 256KB of RAM, and under 16MB of disk space per day to collect a rich set of system-wide data.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 生产系统常常受到难以诊断的间歇性问题困扰。本文描述了一种新的诊断工具Chopstix，它持续收集底层操作系统事件（例如调度、L2缓存未命中、CPU利用率、I/O操作、页分配、锁定）的配置信息，粒度涵盖可执行文件、过程和指令。随后，Chopstix离线重建这些事件以供分析。我们使用Chopstix诊断了一个大规模生产系统中的几个难以捉摸的问题，从而将这些间歇性问题简化为可以使用标准技术调试的可复现缺陷。Chopstix的关键是一种开销极低的近似数据收集策略。评估表明，Chopstix每天仅需不到1%的CPU、不到256KB的内存和不到16MB的磁盘空间，即可收集丰富的系统级数据。

import_candidates.title: Automating network application dependency discovery: experiences, limitations, and new solutions
import_candidates.abstract: Large enterprise networks consist of thousands of services and applications. The performance and reliability of any particular application may depend on multiple services, spanning many hosts and network components. While the knowledge of such dependencies is invaluable for ensuring the stability and efficiency of these applications, thus far the only proven way to discover these complex dependencies is by exploiting human expert knowledge, which does not scale with the number of applications in large enterprises.Recently, researchers have proposed automated discovery of dependencies from network traffic [8, 18]. In this paper, we present a comprehensive study of the performance and limitations of this class of dependency discovery techniques (including our own prior work), by comparing with the ground truth of five dominant Microsoft applications. We introduce a new system, Orion, that discovers dependencies using packet headers and timing information in network traffic based on a novel insight of delay spike based analysis. Orion improves the state of the art significantly, but some shortcomings still remain. To take the next step forward, Orion incorporates external tests to reduce errors to a manageable level. Our results show Orion provides a solid foundation for combining automated discovery with simple testing to obtain accurate and validated dependencies.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大型企业网络由成千上万的服务和应用组成。任何特定应用的性能和可靠性可能依赖于跨越许多主机和网络组件的多个服务。虽然此类依赖关系对于确保这些应用的稳定性和效率至关重要，但迄今为止，发现这些复杂依赖关系的唯一经过验证的方法是依靠人类专家知识，这种方法无法随着大型企业中应用数量的增加而扩展。最近，研究者提出了从网络流量中自动发现依赖关系的方法[8,18]。本文通过与微软五个主要应用的真实情况进行比较，对这类依赖发现技术（包括我们之前的工作）的性能和局限性进行了全面研究。我们引入了一个新系统Orion，基于延迟尖峰分析的新颖见解，利用网络流量中的报文头和时序信息来发现依赖关系。Orion显著改善了现有技术水平，但仍存在一些不足。为了更进一步，Orion结合外部测试将错误降低到可管理的水平。结果显示，Orion为将自动发现与简单测试相结合以获得准确且经过验证的依赖关系提供了坚实基础。

import_candidates.title: SQCK: a declarative file system checker
import_candidates.abstract: The lowly state of the art for file system checking and repair does not match what is needed to keep important data available for users. Current file system checkers, such as e2fsck, are complex pieces of imperfect code written in low-level languages. We introduce SQCK, a file system checker based on a declarative query language; declarative queries are a natural match for the cross-checking that must be performed across the many structures of a file system image. We show that SQCK is able to perform the same functionality as e2fsck with surprisingly elegant and compact queries. We also show that SQCK can easily perform more useful repairs than e2fsck by combining information available across the file system. Finally, our prototype implementation of SQCK achieves this improved functionality with comparable performance to e2fsck.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 文件系统检查与修复的现有技术水平远不能满足保持重要数据对用户可用的需求。当前的文件系统检查器（如e2fsck）是以低级语言编写的复杂且不完美的代码。我们引入了SQCK，这是一种基于声明式查询语言的文件系统检查器；声明式查询与跨文件系统映像的多种结构进行交叉检查的需求天然契合。我们展示了SQCK能够以出人意料地优雅和紧凑的查询执行与e2fsck相同的功能。我们还表明，通过结合整个文件系统中的信息，SQCK可以轻松进行比e2fsck更有用的修复。最后，我们的SQCK原型实现在改进功能的同时，性能与e2fsck相当。

import_candidates.title: Transactional flash
import_candidates.abstract: Transactional flash (TxFlash) is a novel solid-state drive (SSD) that uses flash memory and exports a transactional interface (WriteAtomic) to the higher-level software. The copy-on-write nature of the flash translation layer and the fast random access makes flash memory the right medium to support such an interface. We further develop a novel commit protocol called cyclic commit for TxFlash; the protocol has been specified formally and model checked.Our evaluation, both on a simulator and an emulator on top of a real SSD, shows that TxFlash does not increase the flash firmware complexity significantly and provides transactional features with very small overheads (less than 1\%), thereby making file systems easier to build. It further shows that the new cyclic commit protocol significantly outperforms traditional commit for small transactions (95\% improvement in transaction throughput) and completely eliminates the space overhead due to commit records.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 事务性闪存（TxFlash）是一种新型固态硬盘（SSD），它使用闪存并向上层软件提供事务性接口（WriteAtomic）。闪存转换层的写时复制特性和快速随机访问使闪存成为支持此类接口的合适介质。我们进一步为TxFlash开发了一种称为循环提交的新颖提交协议；该协议已被正式规约并通过模型检查。我们在模拟器和真实SSD之上的仿真器上的评估表明，TxFlash并未显著增加闪存固件的复杂性，并以非常小的开销（低于1%）提供事务特性，从而使文件系统更容易构建。评估还表明，新的循环提交协议在小事务方面显著优于传统提交（事务吞吐量提升95%），并完全消除了提交记录带来的空间开销。

import_candidates.title: Avoiding file system micromanagement with range writes
import_candidates.abstract: We introduce range writes, a simple but powerful change to the disk interface that removes the need for file system micromanagement of block placement. By allowing a file system to specify a set of possible address targets, range writes enable the disk to choose the final on-disk location of the request; the disk improves performance by writing to the closest location and subsequently reporting its choice to the file system above. The result is a clean separation of responsibility; the file system (as high-level manager) provides coarse-grained control over placement, while the disk (as low-level worker) makes the final fine-grained placement decision to improve write performance. We show the benefits of range writes through numerous simulations and a prototype implementation, in some cases improving performance by a factor of three across both synthetic and real workloads.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们引入了range writes，这是对磁盘接口的一个简单但强大的改变，消除了文件系统对块放置进行微观管理的需要。通过允许文件系统指定一组可能的地址目标，range writes使磁盘能够选择请求的最终盘上位置；磁盘通过写入最近的位置来提高性能，并随后将其选择报告给上方的文件系统。结果是责任清晰分离；文件系统（作为高层管理器）提供粗粒度的放置控制，而磁盘（作为低层执行者）做出最终的细粒度放置决策以提高写入性能。我们通过大量模拟和原型实现展示了range writes的好处，在合成和真实工作负载中，某些情况下性能提升达三倍。

import_candidates.title: Binary translation using peephole superoptimizers
import_candidates.abstract: We present a new scheme for performing binary translation that produces code comparable to or better than existing binary translators with much less engineering effort. Instead of hand-coding the translation from one instruction set to another, our approach automatically learns translation rules using superoptimization techniques. We have implemented a PowerPC-x86 binary translator and report results on small and large computeintensive benchmarks. When compared to the native compiler, our translated code achieves median performance of 67\% on large benchmarks and in some small stress tests actually outperforms the native compiler. We also report comparisons with the open source binary translator Qemu and a commercial tool, Apple's Rosetta. We consistently outperformthe former and are comparable to or faster than the latter on all but one benchmark.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新的二进制翻译方案，其生成的代码可与现有二进制翻译器相媲美或更优，而工程工作量却大大减少。我们的方法不是手工编写从一种指令集到另一种指令集的翻译规则，而是使用超级优化技术自动学习翻译规则。我们实现了一个PowerPC到x86的二进制翻译器，并在小型和大型计算密集型基准测试上报告了结果。与原生编译器相比，我们翻译后的代码在大型基准测试上的中位性能达到67%，在某些小型压力测试中甚至超过了原生编译器。我们还与开源二进制翻译器Qemu以及商业工具Apple的Rosetta进行了比较。我们在所有基准测试中均持续优于前者，并且除了一个基准测试外，在所有基准测试中与后者相当或更快。

import_candidates.title: R2: an application-level kernel for record and replay
import_candidates.abstract: Library-based record and replay tools aim to reproduce an application's execution by recording the results of selected functions in a log and during replay returning the results from the log rather than executing the functions. These tools must ensure that a replay run is identical to the record run. The challenge in doing so is that only invocations of a function by the application should be recorded, recording the side effects of a function call can be difficult, and not executing function calls during replay, multithreading, and the presence of the tool may change the application's behavior from recording to replay. These problems have limited the use of such tools.R2 allows developers to choose functions that can be recorded and replayed correctly. Developers annotate the chosen functions with simple keywords so that R2 can handle calls with side effects andmultithreading. R2 generates code for record and replay from templates, allowing developers to avoid implementing stubs for hundreds of functions manually. To track whether an invocation is on behalf of the application or the implementation of a selected function, R2 maintains a mode bit, which stubs save and restore.We have implemented R2 on Windows and annotated large parts (1,300 functions) of the Win32 API, and two higher-level interfaces (MPI and SQLite). R2 can replay multithreaded web and database servers that previous library-based tools cannot replay. By allowing developers to choose high-level interfaces, R2 can also keep recording overhead small; experiments show that its recording overhead for Apache is approximately 10\%, that recording and replaying at the SQLite interface can reduce the log size up to 99\% (compared to doing so at the Win32 API), and that using optimization annotations for BitTorrent and MPI applications achieves log size reduction ranging from 13.7\% to 99.4\%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 基于库的记录和重放工具旨在通过记录选定函数调用的结果并在重放时从日志中返回这些结果（而非执行这些函数）来重现应用程序的执行过程。这些工具必须确保重放运行与记录运行完全相同。其中的挑战在于：只应记录应用程序对函数的调用；记录函数调用的副作用可能很困难；不执行函数调用、多线程以及工具本身的存在都可能改变应用程序在重放阶段的执行行为。这些问题限制了此类工具的使用。R2允许开发者选择那些可以被正确记录和重放的函数。开发者用简单的关键字标注所选函数，从而让R2能够处理带副作用的调用和多线程。R2根据模板生成记录和重放代码，使开发者无需手动为数百个函数实现存根（stub）。为了跟踪一次调用是代表应用程序还是代表某个选定函数的实现，R2维护了一个模式位（mode bit），存根会保存和恢复该模式位。我们在Windows上实现了R2，并标注了Win32 API的很大一部分（1300个函数），以及两个更高级别的接口（MPI和SQLite）。R2可以重放多线程Web服务器和数据库服务器，这是此前基于库的工具无法做到的。通过允许开发者选择更高级别的接口，R2还能保持较低的开销；实验表明，其对Apache的录制开销约为10%；在SQLite接口层面上进行记录和重放可将日志大小缩减高达99%（与在Win32 API层面操作相比）；对BitTorrent和MPI应用使用优化标注可将日志大小缩减13.7%至99.4%。

import_candidates.title: KLEE: unassisted and automatic generation of high-coverage tests for complex systems programs
import_candidates.abstract: We present a new symbolic execution tool, KLEE, capable of automatically generating tests that achieve high coverage on a diverse set of complex and environmentally-intensive programs. We used KLEE to thoroughly check all 89 stand-alone programs in the GNU COREUTILS utility suite, which form the core user-level environment installed on millions of Unix systems, and arguably are the single most heavily tested set of open-source programs in existence. KLEE-generated tests achieve high line coverage -- on average over 90\% per tool (median: over 94\%) -- and significantly beat the coverage of the developers' own hand-written test suite. When we did the same for 75 equivalent tools in the BUSYBOX embedded system suite, results were even better, including 100\% coverage on 31 of them.We also used KLEE as a bug finding tool, applying it to 452 applications (over 430K total lines of code), where it found 56 serious bugs, including three in COREUTILS that had been missed for over 15 years. Finally, we used KLEE to crosscheck purportedly identical BUSYBOX and COREUTILS utilities, finding functional correctness errors and a myriad of inconsistencies.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新的符号执行工具KLEE，能够为多种复杂且环境密集型的程序自动生成实现高覆盖率的测试。我们使用KLEE全面检查了GNU COREUTILS工具集中的全部89个独立程序，这些程序构成了数百万Unix系统上安装的核心用户级环境，并且可以说是现存被测试最密集的开源程序集合。KLEE生成的测试达到了高行覆盖率——每个工具平均超过90%（中位数超过94%）——并显著超过了开发者自己手写测试套件的覆盖率。当我们对BUSYBOX嵌入式系统套件中的75个等价工具进行相同操作时，结果甚至更好，其中31个工具实现了100%覆盖率。我们还将KLEE作为bug查找工具应用于452个应用程序（总代码超过43万行），发现了56个严重bug，其中包括COREUTILS中15年来未被发现的三个bug。最后，我们使用KLEE来交叉检查声称相同的BUSYBOX和COREUTILS工具，发现了功能正确性错误以及大量不一致之处。

import_candidates.title: Hardware enforcement of application security policies using tagged memory
import_candidates.abstract: Computers are notoriously insecure, in part because application security policies do not map well onto traditional protection mechanisms such as Unix user accounts or hardware page tables. Recent work has shown that application policies can be expressed in terms of information flow restrictions and enforced in an OS kernel, providing a strong assurance of security. This paper shows that enforcement of these policies can be pushed largely into the processor itself, by using tagged memory support, which can provide stronger security guarantees by enforcing application security even if the OS kernel is compromised.We present the Loki tagged memory architecture, along with a novel operating system structure that takes advantage of tagged memory to enforce application security policies in hardware. We built a full-system prototype of Loki by modifying a synthesizable SPARC core, mapping it to an FPGA board, and porting HiStar, a Unix-like operating system, to run on it. One result is that Loki allows HiStar, an OS already designed to have a small trusted kernel, to further reduce the amount of trusted code by a factor of two, and to enforce security despite kernel compromises. Using various workloads, we also demonstrate that HiStar running on Loki incurs a low performance overhead.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 计算机的安全性众所周知地薄弱，部分原因是应用程序的安全策略难以映射到传统保护机制（如Unix用户账户或硬件页表）上。近期研究表明，应用程序策略可以用信息流限制来表达，并在操作系统内核中实施，从而提供强有力的安全保障。本文表明，这些策略的执行可以大幅下推到处理器本身，通过使用标签内存支持，即使在操作系统内核被攻破的情况下，也能通过执行应用程序安全性来提供更强的安全保证。我们提出了Loki标签内存架构，以及一种利用标签内存在硬件中执行应用程序安全策略的新型操作系统结构。我们通过修改可综合的SPARC内核、将其映射到FPGA板，并移植类Unix操作系统HiStar在其上运行，构建了Loki的全系统原型。一个结果是，Loki允许HiStar——一个本已设计为具有小型可信内核的操作系统——进一步将可信代码量减少一半，并即使在内核被攻破的情况下也能执行安全性。通过多种工作负载，我们还证明了运行在Loki上的HiStar仅产生较低的性能开销。

import_candidates.title: Device driver safety through a reference validation mechanism
import_candidates.abstract: Device drivers typically execute in supervisor mode and thus must be fully trusted. This paper describes how to move them out of the trusted computing base, by running them without supervisor privileges and constraining their interactions with hardware devices. An implementation of this approach in the Nexus operating system executes drivers in user space, leveraging hardware isolation and checking their behavior against a safety specification. These Nexus drivers have performance comparable to inkernel, trusted drivers, with a level of CPU overhead acceptable for most applications. For example, the monitored driver for an Intel e1000 Ethernet card has throughput comparable to a trusted driver for the same hardware under Linux. And a monitored driver for the Intel i810 sound card provides continuous playback. Drivers for a disk and a USB mouse have also been moved successfully to operate in user space with safety specifications.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 设备驱动程序通常在超级用户模式下执行，因此必须被完全信任。本文描述如何通过在没有超级用户权限的情况下运行它们，并限制其与硬件设备的交互，将它们移出可信计算基。Nexus操作系统中的一种实现方法在用户空间中执行驱动程序，利用硬件隔离并对照安全规范检查其行为。这些Nexus驱动程序的性能与内核内的可信驱动程序相当，其CPU开销水平对大多数应用而言可以接受。例如，经过监控的Intel e1000以太网卡驱动程序的吞吐量与Linux下同一硬件的可信驱动程序相当。而经过监控的Intel i810声卡驱动程序可提供连续播放。磁盘和USB鼠标的驱动程序也已成功地在带有安全规范的用户空间中运行。

import_candidates.title: Digging for data structures
import_candidates.abstract: Because writing computer programs is hard, computer programmers are taught to use encapsulation and modularity to hide complexity and reduce the potential for errors. Their programs will have a high-level, hierarchical structure that reflects their choice of internal abstractions. We designed and forged a system, Laika, that detects this structure in memory using Bayesian unsupervised learning. Because almost all programs use data structures, their memory images consist of many copies of a relatively small number of templates. Given a memory image, Laika can find both the data structures and their instantiations.We then used Laika to detect three common polymorphic botnets by comparing their data structures. Because it avoids their code polymorphism entirely, Laika is extremely accurate. Finally, we argue that writing a data structure polymorphic virus is likely to be considerably harder than writing a code polymorphic virus.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 因为编写计算机程序很难，计算机程序员被教导使用封装和模块化来隐藏复杂性并减少出错的可能性。他们的程序将具有反映其内部抽象选择的高层次、分层结构。我们设计并构建了一个名为Laika的系统，利用贝叶斯无监督学习在内存中检测这种结构。由于几乎所有程序都使用数据结构，它们的内存映像由相对较少模板的许多副本组成。给定一个内存映像，Laika可以同时找到数据结构及其实例。然后我们使用Laika通过比较其数据结构来检测三种常见的多态僵尸网络。由于它完全避开了代码多态性，Laika非常准确。最后，我们认为编写数据结构多态病毒可能比编写代码多态病毒要困难得多。

import_candidates.title: Finding and reproducing Heisenbugs in concurrent programs
import_candidates.abstract: Concurrency is pervasive in large systems. Unexpected interference among threads often results in "Heisenbugs" that are extremely difficult to reproduce and eliminate. We have implemented a tool called CHESS for finding and reproducing such bugs. When attached to a program, CHESS takes control of thread scheduling and uses efficient search techniques to drive the program through possible thread interleavings. This systematic exploration of program behavior enables CHESS to quickly uncover bugs that might otherwise have remained hidden for a long time. For each bug, CHESS consistently reproduces an erroneous execution manifesting the bug, thereby making it significantly easier to debug the problem. CHESS scales to large concurrent programs and has found numerous bugs in existing systems that had been tested extensively prior to being tested by CHESS. CHESS has been integrated into the test frameworks of many code bases inside Microsoft and is used by testers on a daily basis.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 并发性在大型系统中普遍存在。线程之间意外的干扰常常导致“Heisenbug”（瞬态bug），这些bug极难复现和消除。我们实现了一个名为CHESS的工具，用于发现并复现此类bug。当CHESS附加到程序上时，它会控制线程调度，并使用高效的搜索技术驱动程序遍历可能的线程交错。这种对程序行为的系统化探索使CHESS能够快速发现那些可能在很长一段时间内隐藏的bug。对于每个bug，CHESS能够一致地复现出展示该bug的错误执行过程，从而显著简化了调试问题的工作。CHESS可扩展到大型并发程序，并已在现有系统中发现了大量在CHESS测试之前已被广泛测试的bug。CHESS已集成到Microsoft内部许多代码库的测试框架中，并被测试人员日常使用。

import_candidates.title: Gadara: dynamic deadlock avoidance for multithreaded programs
import_candidates.abstract: Deadlock is an increasingly pressing concern as the multicore revolution forces parallel programming upon the average programmer. Existing approaches to deadlock impose onerous burdens on developers, entail high runtime performance overheads, or offer no help for unmodified legacy code. Gadara automates dynamic deadlock avoidance for conventional multithreaded programs. It employs whole-program static analysis to model programs, and Discrete Control Theory to synthesize lightweight, decentralized, highly concurrent logic that controls them at runtime. Gadara is safe, and can be applied to legacy code with modest programmer effort. Gadara is efficient because it performs expensive deadlock-avoidance computations offline rather than online. We have implemented Gadara for C/Pthreads programs. In benchmark tests, Gadara successfully avoids injected deadlock faults, imposes negligible to modest performance overheads (at most 18\%), and outperforms a software transactional memory system. Tests on a real application show that Gadara identifies and avoids both previously known and unknown deadlocks while adding performance overheads ranging from negligible to 10\%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着多核革命迫使普通程序员进行并行编程，死锁问题日益紧迫。现有的死锁处理方法要么给开发者带来沉重负担，要么带来高运行时性能开销，要么对未修改的遗留代码没有帮助。Gadara自动化了传统多线程程序的动态死锁避免。它使用全程序静态分析来建模程序，并利用离散控制理论合成轻量级、去中心化、高度并发的逻辑，在运行时控制程序。Gadara是安全的，并且可以以适度的程序员工作量应用于遗留代码。Gadara高效，因为它将昂贵的死锁避免计算离线执行而非在线执行。我们已针对C/Pthreads程序实现了Gadara。在基准测试中，Gadara成功避免了注入的死锁故障，带来了可忽略不计到适度的性能开销（最多18%），且优于软件事务内存系统。在一个真实应用程序上的测试表明，Gadara能够识别并避免先前已知和未知的死锁，同时增加从可忽略到10%的性能开销。

import_candidates.title: Deadlock immunity: enabling systems to defend against deadlocks
import_candidates.abstract: Deadlock immunity is a property by which programs, once afflicted by a given deadlock, develop resistance against future occurrences of that and similar deadlocks. We describe a technique that enables programs to automatically gain such immunity without assistance from programmers or users. We implemented the technique for both Java and POSIX threads and evaluated it with several real systems, including MySQL, JBoss, SQLite, Apache ActiveMQ, Limewire, and Java JDK. The results demonstrate effectiveness against real deadlock bugs, while incurring modest performance overhead and scaling to 1024 threads. We therefore conclude that deadlock immunity offers programmers and users an attractive tool for coping with elusive deadlocks.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 死锁免疫是一种属性，通过该属性，程序一旦遭受特定死锁，就会对将来出现的该死锁及类似死锁产生抵抗能力。我们描述了一种技术，使程序无需程序员或用户协助即可自动获得这种免疫能力。我们在Java和POSIX线程中实现了该技术，并针对多个真实系统进行了评估，包括MySQL、JBoss、SQLite、Apache ActiveMQ、Limewire和Java JDK。结果表明，该方法对真实死锁缺陷有效，同时仅产生适度的性能开销，并可扩展到1024个线程。因此，我们得出结论：死锁免疫为程序员和用户提供了一种有吸引力的工具，用以应对难以捉摸的死锁问题。

import_candidates.title: Difference engine: harnessing memory redundancy in virtual machines
import_candidates.abstract: Virtual machine monitors (VMMs) are a popular platform for Internet hosting centers and cloud-based compute services. By multiplexing hardware resources among virtual machines (VMs) running commodity operating systems, VMMs decrease both the capital outlay and management overhead of hosting centers. Appropriate placement and migration policies can take advantage of statistical multiplexing to effectively utilize available processors. However, main memory is not amenable to such multiplexing and is often the primary bottleneck in achieving higher degrees of consolidation.Previous efforts have shown that content-based page sharing provides modest decreases in the memory footprint of VMs running similar operating systems and applications. Our studies show that significant additional gains can be had by leveraging both sub-page level sharing (through page patching) and in-core memory compression. We build Difference Engine, an extension to the Xen virtual machine monitor, to support each of these--in addition to standard copy-on-write full page sharing--and demonstrate substantial savings not only between VMs running similar applications and operating systems (up to 90\%), but even across VMs running disparate workloads (up to 65\%). In head-to-head memory-savings comparisons, Difference Engine outperforms VMware ESX server by a factor of 1.5 for homogeneous workloads and by a factor of 1.6-2.5 for heterogeneous workloads. In all cases, the performance overhead of Difference Engine is less than 7\%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 虚拟机监视器（VMM）是互联网托管中心和基于云的计算服务的流行平台。通过在多台运行商用操作系统的虚拟机（VM）之间复用硬件资源，VMM降低了托管中心的资本支出和管理开销。适当的放置和迁移策略可以利用统计复用有效利用可用处理器。然而，主内存不适合这种复用，并且通常成为实现更高整合度的主要瓶颈。先前的研究表明，基于内容的页面共享可以将运行相似操作系统和应用程序的虚拟机的内存占用适度减少。我们的研究表明，通过利用子页面级共享（通过页面修补）和内存内压缩，可以获得显著的额外收益。我们构建了差分引擎（Difference Engine），这是Xen虚拟机监视器的一个扩展，用于支持这些功能——除了标准的写时复制全页共享之外——并证明不仅在运行相似应用程序和操作系统的虚拟机之间（最高达90%），甚至在运行不同工作负载的虚拟机之间（最高达65%）也能实现可观的节省。在面对面的内存节省比较中，差分引擎在同构工作负载下比VMware ESX服务器高1.5倍，在异构工作负载下高1.6至2.5倍。在所有情况下，差分引擎的性能开销低于7%。

import_candidates.title: Quanto: tracking energy in networked embedded systems
import_candidates.abstract: We present Quanto, a network-wide time and energy profiler for embedded network devices. By combining well-defined interfaces for hardware power states, fast high-resolution energy metering, and causal tracking of programmer-defined activities, Quanto can map how energy and time are spent on nodes and across a network. Implementing Quanto on the TinyOS operating system required modifying under 350 lines of code and adding 1275 new lines. We show that being able to take fine-grained energy consumption measurements as fast as reading a counter allows developers to precisely quantify the effects of low-level system implementation decisions, such as using DMA versus direct bus operations, or the effect of external interference on the power draw of a low duty-cycle radio. Finally, Quanto is lightweight enough that it has a minimal effect on system behavior: each sample takes 100 CPU cycles and 12 bytes of RAM.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了Quanto，一种用于嵌入式网络设备的全网时间和能量分析器。通过结合定义良好的硬件电源状态接口、快速高分辨率能量计量以及程序员定义活动的因果跟踪，Quanto可以映射能量和时间如何在节点上以及网络中消耗。在TinyOS操作系统上实现Quanto只需修改不到350行代码，并新增1275行代码。我们表明，能够像读取计数器一样快速地进行细粒度能耗测量，使开发者能够精确量化底层系统实现决策（例如使用DMA与直接总线操作）的影响，或外部干扰对低占空比无线电功耗的影响。最后，Quanto足够轻量，对系统行为的影响极小：每次采样仅需100个CPU周期和12字节RAM。

import_candidates.title: Leveraging legacy code to deploy desktop applications on the web
import_candidates.abstract: Xax is a browser plugin model that enables developers to leverage existing tools, libraries, and entire programs to deliver feature-rich applications on the web. Xax employs a novel combination of mechanisms that collectively provide security, OS-independence, performance, and support for legacy code. These mechanisms include memory-isolated native code execution behind a narrow syscall interface, an abstraction layer that provides a consistent binary interface across operating systems, system services via hooks to existing browser mechanisms, and lightweight modifications to existing tool chains and code bases. We demonstrate a variety of applications and libraries from existing code bases, in several languages, produced with various tool chains, running in multiple browsers on multiple operating systems. With roughly two person-weeks of effort, we ported 3.3 million lines of code to Xax, including a PDF viewer, a Python interpreter, a speech synthesizer, and an OpenGL pipeline.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Xax是一种浏览器插件模型，使开发者能够利用现有工具、库和完整程序在Web上提供功能丰富的应用。Xax采用了一种新颖的机制组合，这些机制共同提供了安全性、操作系统无关性、性能以及遗留代码支持。这些机制包括在窄系统调用接口之后执行内存隔离的原生代码，一个提供跨操作系统一致二进制接口的抽象层，通过挂钩现有浏览器机制实现的系统服务，以及对现有工具链和代码库的轻量级修改。我们演示了来自现有代码库的各种应用和库，涵盖多种语言，由多种工具链生成，运行在多种操作系统上的多个浏览器中。我们用大约两周人力的工作量，将330万行代码移植到Xax，其中包括PDF查看器、Python解释器、语音合成器和OpenGL管线。

import_candidates.title: FlightPath: obedience vs. choice in cooperative services
import_candidates.abstract: We present FlightPath, a novel peer-to-peer streaming application that provides a highly reliable data stream to a dynamic set of peers. We demonstrate that FlightPath reduces jitter compared to previous works by several orders of magnitude. Furthermore, FlightPath uses a number of run-time adaptations to maintain low jitter despite 10\% of the population behaving maliciously and the remaining peers acting selfishly. At the core of FlightPath's success are approximate equilibria. These equilibria allow us to design incentives to limit selfish behavior rigorously, yet they provide sufficient flexibility to build practical systems. We show how to use an undefined-Nash equilibrium, instead of a strict Nash, to engineer a live streaming system that uses bandwidth efficiently, absorbs flash crowds, adapts to sudden peer departures, handles churn, and tolerates malicious activity.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出FlightPath，一种新颖的点对点流媒体应用，能够为动态节点集合提供高度可靠的数据流。我们证明，与先前工作相比，FlightPath将抖动降低了数个数量级。此外，FlightPath利用多种运行时自适应机制，在总人口中10%行为恶意、其余节点行为自私的情况下，仍能保持低抖动。FlightPath成功的核心在于近似均衡。这些均衡使我们能够严格地设计激励措施以限制自私行为，同时又提供足够的灵活性来构建实用系统。我们展示了如何利用未定义的纳什均衡（而非严格纳什均衡）来工程设计一个实时流媒体系统，该系统能高效利用带宽、吸收热门突发流量、适应节点突然离开、应对持续扰动，并容忍恶意活动。

import_candidates.title: Mencius: building efficient replicated state machines for WANs
import_candidates.abstract: We present a protocol for general state machine replication - a method that provides strong consistency - that has high performance in a wide-area network. In particular, our protocol Mencius has high throughput under high client load and low latency under low client load even under changing wide-area network environment and client load. We develop our protocol as a derivation from the well-known protocol Paxos. Such a development can be changed or further refined to take advantage of specific network or application requirements.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种用于通用状态机复制的协议——一种提供强一致性的方法——该协议在广域网中具有高性能。特别是，我们的协议Mencius在高客户端负载下具有高吞吐量，在低客户端负载下具有低延迟，即使在变化的广域网环境和客户端负载下也是如此。我们将我们的协议作为著名协议Paxos的推导而开发。这种开发可以根据具体的网络或应用需求进行修改或进一步细化。

import_candidates.title: An analysis of Linux scalability to many cores
import_candidates.abstract: This paper analyzes the scalability of seven system applications (Exim, memcached, Apache, PostgreSQL, gmake, Psearchy, and MapReduce) running on Linux on a 48- core computer. Except for gmake, all applications trigger scalability bottlenecks inside a recent Linux kernel. Using mostly standard parallel programming techniques-- this paper introduces one new technique, sloppy counters-- these bottlenecks can be removed from the kernel or avoided by changing the applications slightly. Modifying the kernel required in total 3002 lines of code changes. A speculative conclusion from this analysis is that there is no scalability reason to give up on traditional operating system organizations just yet.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文分析了在48核计算机上运行的七个系统应用程序（Exim、memcached、Apache、PostgreSQL、gmake、Psearchy和MapReduce）在Linux上的可扩展性。除gmake外，所有应用程序都触发了最近的Linux内核中的可扩展性瓶颈。主要使用标准的并行编程技术（本文介绍了一种新技术——粗略计数器），这些瓶颈可以从内核中移除，或通过稍微修改应用程序来避免。修改内核总共需要3002行代码更改。从这一分析中可以得出一个推测性结论：目前还没有可扩展性理由要放弃传统的操作系统组织方式。

import_candidates.title: Trust and protection in the Illinois browser operating system
import_candidates.abstract: Current web browsers are complex, have enormous trusted computing bases, and provide attackers with easy access to modern computer systems. In this paper we introduce the Illinois Browser Operating System (IBOS), a new operating system and a new browser that reduces the trusted computing base for web browsers. In our architecture we expose browser-level abstractions at the lowest software layer, enabling us to remove almost all traditional OS components and services from our trusted computing base by mapping browser abstractions to hardware abstractions directly. We show that this architecture is flexible enough to enable new browser security policies, can still support traditional applications, and adds little overhead to the overall browsing experience.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 当前的Web浏览器复杂、可信计算基庞大，并为攻击者提供了轻松访问现代计算机系统的途径。在本文中，我们介绍了伊利诺伊浏览器操作系统（IBOS），这是一个新操作系统和一个新浏览器，旨在减少Web浏览器的可信计算基。在我们的架构中，我们在最低软件层暴露浏览器级抽象，通过将浏览器抽象直接映射到硬件抽象，从而几乎将传统操作系统组件和服务从可信计算基中移除。我们展示了这种架构足够灵活，能够支持新的浏览器安全策略，仍然可以支持传统应用程序，并且对整体浏览体验几乎不添加额外开销。

import_candidates.title: FlexSC: flexible system call scheduling with exception-less system calls
import_candidates.abstract: For the past 30+ years, system calls have been the de facto interface used by applications to request services from the operating system kernel. System calls have almost universally been implemented as a synchronous mechanism, where a special processor instruction is used to yield userspace execution to the kernel. In the first part of this paper, we evaluate the performance impact of traditional synchronous system calls on system intensive workloads. We show that synchronous system calls negatively affect performance in a significant way, primarily because of pipeline flushing and pollution of key processor structures (e.g., TLB, data and instruction caches, etc.).We propose a new mechanism for applications to request services from the operating system kernel: exception-less system calls.
