They improve processor efficiency by enabling flexibility in the scheduling of operating system work, which in turn can lead to significantly increased temporal and spacial locality of execution in both user and kernel space, thus reducing pollution effects on processor structures. Exception-less system calls are particularly effective on multicore processors. They primarily target highly threaded server applications, such as Web servers and database servers.We present FlexSC, an implementation of exceptionless system calls in the Linux kernel, and an accompanying user-mode thread package (FlexSC-Threads), binary compatible with POSIX threads, that translates legacy synchronous system calls into exception-less ones transparently to applications. We show how FlexSC improves performance of Apache by up to 116\%, MySQL by up to 40\%, and BIND by up to 105\% while requiring no modifications to the applications.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 过去30多年，系统调用一直是应用程序请求操作系统内核服务的实际接口。系统调用几乎普遍实现为同步机制，其中使用特殊处理器指令将用户态执行切换到内核态。在本文前半部分，我们评估传统同步系统调用对系统密集型工作负载的性能影响。我们表明同步系统调用显著负面影响性能，主要是由于流水线清空以及对关键处理器结构（如TLB、数据和指令缓存等）的污染。我们提出一种新的机制，让应用程序请求操作系统内核服务：无异常系统调用。它通过灵活调度操作系统工作来提高处理器效率，这可以显著增加用户态和内核态执行的时间和空间局部性，从而减少对处理器结构的污染效应。无异常系统调用在多核处理器上尤其有效。它们主要针对高线程服务器应用，如Web服务器和数据库服务器。我们展示了FlexSC——Linux内核中无异常系统调用的实现，以及配套的用户态线程包（FlexSC-Threads），与POSIX线程二进制兼容，能透明地将传统同步系统调用转换为无异常系统调用。我们展示FlexSC如何将Apache性能提升高达116%，MySQL提升高达40%，BIND提升高达105%，而无需修改应用程序。

import_candidates.title: Finding a needle in Haystack: facebook's photo storage
import_candidates.abstract: This paper describes Haystack, an object storage system optimized for Facebook's Photos application. Facebook currently stores over 260 billion images, which translates to over 20 petabytes of data. Users upload one billion new photos (∼60 terabytes) each week and Facebook serves over one million images per second at peak. Haystack provides a less expensive and higher performing solution than our previous approach, which leveraged network attached storage appliances over NFS. Our key observation is that this traditional design incurs an excessive number of disk operations because of metadata lookups. We carefully reduce this per photo metadata so that Haystack storage machines can perform all metadata lookups in main memory. This choice conserves disk operations for reading actual data and thus increases overall throughput.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文介绍Haystack，一个为Facebook照片应用优化的对象存储系统。Facebook目前存储超过2600亿张图片，相当于超过20拍字节的数据。用户每周上传10亿张新照片（约60太字节），Facebook在高峰期每秒服务超过100万张图片。Haystack比我们之前基于NFS的网络附加存储设备方案提供了成本更低、性能更高的解决方案。我们的关键观察是，传统设计因元数据查找而产生过多的磁盘操作。我们精心减少了每张照片的元数据，使得Haystack存储机器能在主内存中完成所有元数据查找。这一选择将磁盘操作保留用于读取实际数据，从而提高了整体吞吐量。

import_candidates.title: Availability in globally distributed storage systems
import_candidates.abstract: Highly available cloud storage is often implemented with complex, multi-tiered distributed systems built on top of clusters of commodity servers and disk drives. Sophisticated management, load balancing and recovery techniques are needed to achieve high performance and availability amidst an abundance of failure sources that include software, hardware, network connectivity, and power issues. While there is a relative wealth of failure studies of individual components of storage systems, such as disk drives, relatively little has been reported so far on the overall availability behavior of large cloudbased storage services.We characterize the availability properties of cloud storage systems based on an extensive one year study of Google's main storage infrastructure and present statistical models that enable further insight into the impact of multiple design choices, such as data placement and replication strategies. With these models we compare data availability under a variety of system parameters given the real patterns of failures observed in our fleet.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 高可用的云存储通常建立在由商品服务器和磁盘驱动器集群构成的复杂多层分布式系统之上。为了在包含软件、硬件、网络连接和电源问题等众多故障源的情况下实现高性能和高可用性，需要复杂的管理、负载均衡和恢复技术。尽管对存储系统单个组件（如磁盘驱动器）的故障研究相对丰富，但迄今为止，关于大型基于云的存储服务的整体可用性行为的报道相对较少。我们基于对Google主要存储基础设施为期一年的广泛研究，描述了云存储系统的可用性特征，并提出了统计模型，以进一步洞察多种设计选择（如数据放置和复制策略）的影响。利用这些模型，我们根据实际观察到的故障模式，在不同系统参数下比较了数据可用性。

import_candidates.title: Nectar: automatic management of data and computation in datacenters
import_candidates.abstract: Managing data and computation is at the heart of datacenter computing. Manual management of data can lead to data loss, wasteful consumption of storage, and laborious bookkeeping. Lack of proper management of computation can result in lost opportunities to share common computations across multiple jobs or to compute results incrementally.Nectar is a system designed to address the aforementioned problems. It automates and unifies the management of data and computation within a datacenter. In Nectar, data and computation are treated interchangeably by associating data with its computation. Derived datasets, which are the results of computations, are uniquely identified by the programs that produce them, and together with their programs, are automatically managed by a datacenter wide caching service. Any derived dataset can be transparently regenerated by reexecuting its program, and any computation can be transparently avoided by using previously cached results. This enables us to greatly improve datacenter management and resource utilization: obsolete or infrequently used derived datasets are automatically garbage collected, and shared common computations are computed only once and reused by others.This paper describes the design and implementation of Nectar, and reports on our evaluation of the system using analytic studies of logs from several production clusters and an actual deployment on a 240-node cluster.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 管理数据和计算是数据中心计算的核心。手动管理数据可能导致数据丢失、存储浪费以及繁重的记录工作。缺乏对计算的适当管理可能导致错失跨多个作业共享公共计算或增量计算结果的机会。Nectar是一个旨在解决上述问题的系统。它自动化并统一了数据中心内数据和计算的管理。在Nectar中，数据和计算通过将数据与其计算关联而可互换地对待。派生数据集（即计算的结果）由生成它们的程序唯一标识，并与其程序一起由数据中心范围的缓存服务自动管理。任何派生数据集都可以通过重新执行其程序而透明地重新生成，任何计算都可以通过使用先前缓存的结果而透明地避免。这使我们能够极大地改善数据中心管理和资源利用：过时或不常用的派生数据集会被自动垃圾收集，共享的公共计算只计算一次并由其他人重用。本文描述了Nectar的设计与实现，并通过对几个生产集群日志的分析研究以及在一个240节点集群上的实际部署来报告我们对系统的评估。

import_candidates.title: Intrusion recovery using selective re-execution
import_candidates.abstract: RETRO repairs a desktop or server after an adversary compromises it, by undoing the adversary's changes while preserving legitimate user actions, with minimal user involvement. During normal operation, RETRO records an action history graph, which is a detailed dependency graph describing the system's execution. RETRO uses refinement to describe graph objects and actions at multiple levels of abstraction, which allows for precise dependencies. During repair, RETRO uses the action history graph to undo an unwanted action and its indirect effects by first rolling back its direct effects, and then reexecuting legitimate actions that were influenced by that change. To minimize user involvement and re-execution, RETRO uses predicates to selectively re-execute only actions that were semantically affected by the adversary's changes, and uses compensating actions to handle external effects.An evaluation of a prototype of RETRO for Linux with 2 real-world attacks, 2 synthesized challenge attacks, and 6 attacks from previous work, shows that RETRO can often repair the system without user involvement, and avoids false positives and negatives from previous solutions. These benefits come at the cost of 35-127\% in execution time overhead and of 4-150 GB of log space per day, depending on the workload. For example, a HotCRP paper submission web site incurs 35\% slowdown and generates 4 GB of logs per day under the workload from 30 minutes prior to the SOSP 2007 deadline.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: RETRO在对手入侵桌面或服务器后进行修复，方法是撤销对手的更改，同时保留合法用户操作，并且只需极少用户参与。在正常操作期间，RETRO会记录一个动作历史图，该图是描述系统执行的详细依赖图。RETRO使用细化（refinement）在多个抽象层次上描述图对象和动作，从而能够获得精确的依赖关系。在修复过程中，RETRO利用动作历史图撤销不需要的动作及其间接影响：首先回滚其直接影响，然后重新执行受该更改影响的合法动作。为了最大限度地减少用户参与和重执行，RETRO使用谓词仅选择性地重执行那些语义上受对手更改影响的动作，并使用补偿动作来处理外部影响。对Linux上RETRO原型的评估使用了2个真实世界攻击、2个合成挑战攻击以及6个来自以往工作的攻击，结果表明RETRO通常可以在无需用户参与的情况下修复系统，并避免了以前解决方案的误报和漏报。这些好处以35-127%的执行时间开销和每天4-150 GB的日志空间为代价，具体取决于工作负载。例如，HotCRP论文提交网站在SOSP 2007截止日期前30分钟的工作负载下，会产生35%的减速，并每天生成4 GB日志。

import_candidates.title: Static checking of dynamically-varying security policies in database-backed applications
import_candidates.abstract: We present a system for sound static checking of security policies for database-backed Web applications. Our tool checks a combination of access control and information flow policies, where the policies vary based on database contents. For instance, one or more database tables may represent an access control matrix, controlling who may read or write which cells of these and other tables. Using symbolic evaluation and automated theorem-proving, our tool checks these policies statically, requiring no program annotations (beyond the policies themselves) and adding no run-time overhead. Specifications come in the form of SQL queries as policies: for instance, an application's confidentiality policy is a fixed set of queries, whose results provide an upper bound on what information may be released to the user. To provide userdependent policies, we allow queries to depend on what secrets the user knows. We have used our prototype implementation to check several programs representative of the data-centric Web applications that are common today.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 用户生成内容网站通常会在Tor等隐私增强代理的用户贡献上设限，因为代理被视为破坏、垃圾邮件和滥用的来源。尽管这些屏蔽或许有效，但未实现的有价值的匿名寻求者贡献所造成的附带损害是看不见的。维基百科作为最大且最重要的用户生成内容网站之一，早在2005年就尝试屏蔽来自Tor用户的贡献。我们证明，这些屏蔽并不完美，且上千次通过Tor编辑维基百科的尝试已经成功。我们利用多种数据来源和分析技术，测量并描述了Tor用户在维基百科上的编辑历史随时间的变化，并将Tor用户的贡献与其他维基百科用户群体的贡献进行了比较。我们的分析表明，虽然绕过维基百科禁令的Tor用户所贡献的内容更可能被回退，也更可能回退他人，但他们的贡献质量在其他方面与未注册参与者以及注册用户的初始贡献相似。

import_candidates.title: Accountable virtual machines
import_candidates.abstract: In this paper, we introduce accountable virtual machines (AVMs). Like ordinary virtual machines, AVMs can execute binary software images in a virtualized copy of a computer system; in addition, they can record non-repudiable information that allows auditors to subsequently check whether the software behaved as intended. AVMs provide strong accountability, which is important, for instance, in distributed systems where different hosts and organizations do not necessarily trust each other, or where software is hosted on third-party operated platforms. AVMs can provide accountability for unmodified binary images and do not require trusted hardware. To demonstrate that AVMs are practical, we have designed and implemented a prototype AVM monitor based on VMware Workstation, and used it to detect several existing cheats in Counterstrike, a popular online multi-player game.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们引入了可审计虚拟机（AVM）。与普通虚拟机一样，AVM可以在计算机系统的虚拟化副本中执行二进制软件映像；此外，它们还能记录不可否认的信息，使审计人员事后能够检查软件是否按预期运行。AVM提供强大的可审计性，这在分布式系统（不同主机和组织不一定相互信任）或软件托管在第三方运营平台上时尤为重要。AVM能够为未修改的二进制映像提供可审计性，且不需要可信硬件。为了证明AVM的实用性，我们基于VMware Workstation设计和实现了一个AVM监控器原型，并用它检测了流行在线多人游戏Counterstrike中的若干现有作弊行为。

import_candidates.title: Bypassing races in live applications with execution filters
import_candidates.abstract: Deployed multithreaded applications contain many races because these applications are difficult to write, test, and debug. Worse, the number of races in deployed applications may drastically increase due to the rise of multicore hardware and the immaturity of current race detectors.LOOM is a "live-workaround" system designed to quickly and safely bypass application races at runtime. LOOM provides a flexible and safe language for developers to write execution filters that explicitly synchronize code. It then uses an evacuation algorithm to safely install the filters to live applications to avoid races. It reduces its performance overhead using hybrid instrumentation that combines static and dynamic instrumentation.We evaluated LOOM on nine real races from a diverse set of six applications, including MySQL and Apache. Our results show that (1) LOOM can safely fix all evaluated races in a timely manner, thereby increasing application availability; (2) LOOM incurs little performance overhead; (3) LOOM scales well with the number of application threads; and (4) LOOM is easy to use.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 已部署的多线程应用程序中包含许多竞争条件，因为这些应用程序难以编写、测试和调试。更糟糕的是，由于多核硬件的兴起和当前竞争条件检测器的不成熟，已部署应用程序中的竞争条件数量可能会急剧增加。LOOM是一个“实时修复”系统，旨在运行时快速安全地绕过应用程序竞争条件。LOOM为开发人员提供了一种灵活且安全的语言，用于编写显式同步代码的执行过滤器。然后，它使用一种疏散算法将过滤器安全地安装到实时应用程序中，以避免竞争条件。它通过结合静态和动态插桩的混合插桩来降低性能开销。我们在来自六种不同应用程序（包括MySQL和Apache）的九个真实竞争条件上评估了LOOM。我们的结果表明：(1) LOOM能够及时安全地修复所有评估的竞争条件，从而提高应用程序的可用性；(2) LOOM产生的性能开销很小；(3) LOOM随着应用程序线程数量的增加具有良好的可扩展性；以及(4) LOOM易于使用。

import_candidates.title: Effective data-race detection for the kernel
import_candidates.abstract: Data races are an important class of concurrency errors where two threads erroneously access a shared memory location without appropriate synchronization. This paper presents DataCollider, a lightweight and effective technique for dynamically detecting data races in kernel modules. Unlike existing data-race detection techniques, DataCollider is oblivious to the synchronization protocols (such as locking disciplines) the program uses to protect shared memory accesses. This is particularly important for low-level kernel code that uses a myriad of complex architecture/device specific synchronization mechanisms. To reduce the runtime overhead, DataCollider randomly samples a small percentage of memory accesses as candidates for data-race detection. The key novelty of DataCollider is that it uses breakpoint facilities already supported by many hardware architectures to achieve negligible runtime overheads. We have implemented DataCollider for the Windows 7 kernel and have found 25 confirmed erroneous data races of which 12 have already been fixed.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 数据竞争是一类重要的并发错误，其中两个线程在没有适当同步的情况下错误地访问同一共享内存位置。本文提出了DataCollider，一种轻量级且有效的技术，用于动态检测内核模块中的数据竞争。与现有的数据竞争检测技术不同，DataCollider不关心程序用于保护共享内存访问的同步协议（如锁纪律）。这对于使用大量复杂架构/设备特定同步机制的底层内核代码尤为重要。为了降低运行时开销，DataCollider随机采样一小部分内存访问作为数据竞争检测的候选对象。DataCollider的关键创新在于它利用了许多硬件架构已支持的断点设施，从而实现可忽略的运行时开销。我们已在Windows 7内核上实现了DataCollider，并发现25个已确认的错误数据竞争，其中12个已被修复。

import_candidates.title: Ad hoc synchronization considered harmful
import_candidates.abstract: Many synchronizations in existing multi-threaded programs are implemented in an ad hoc way. The first part of this paper does a comprehensive characteristic study of ad hoc synchronizations in concurrent programs. By studying 229 ad hoc synchronizations in 12 programs of various types (server, desktop and scientific), including Apache, MySQL, Mozilla, etc., we find several interesting and perhaps alarming characteristics: (1) Every studied application uses ad hoc synchronizations. Specifically, there are 6-83 ad hoc synchronizations in each program. (2) Ad hoc synchronizations are error-prone. Significant percentages (22-67\%) of these ad hoc synchronizations introduced bugs or severe performance issues. (3) Ad hoc synchronization implementations are diverse and many of them cannot be easily recognized as synchronizations, i.e. have poor readability and maintainability.The second part of our work builds a tool called SyncFinder to automatically identify and annotate ad hoc synchronizations in concurrent programswritten in C/C++ to assist programmers in porting their code to better structured implementations, while also enabling other tools to recognize them as synchronizations. Our evaluation using 25 concurrent programs shows that, on average, SyncFinder can automatically identify 96\% of ad hoc synchronizations with 6\% false positives.We also build two use cases to leverage SyncFinder's auto-annotation. The first one uses annotation to detect 5 deadlocks (including 2 new ones) and 16 potential issues missed by previous analysis tools in Apache, MySQL and Mozilla. The second use case reduces Valgrind data race checker's false positive rates by 43-86\%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现有许多多线程程序中的同步是以临时（ad hoc）方式实现的。本文第一部分对并发程序中的临时同步进行了全面的特征研究。通过研究12个不同类型（服务器、桌面和科学计算）的程序（包括Apache、MySQL、Mozilla等）中的229个临时同步，我们发现了一些有趣且可能令人担忧的特征：（1）每个被研究的应用都使用了临时同步。具体而言，每个程序中有6-83个临时同步。（2）临时同步容易出错。其中22-67%的临时同步引入了错误或严重的性能问题。（3）临时同步的实现多种多样，其中许多不易被识别为同步，即可读性和可维护性较差。工作的第二部分构建了一个名为SyncFinder的工具，用于自动识别和注释C/C++并发程序中的临时同步，以帮助程序员将其代码移植为更结构化的实现，同时使其他工具也能将它们识别为同步。我们对25个并发程序的评估表明，SyncFinder平均能自动识别96%的临时同步，误报率为6%。我们还构建了两个用例来利用SyncFinder的自动注释。第一个用例利用注释在Apache、MySQL和Mozilla中检测到5个死锁（包括2个新的）和16个先前分析工具遗漏的潜在问题。第二个用例使Valgrind数据竞争检查器的误报率降低了43-86%。

import_candidates.title: Deterministic process groups in dOS
import_candidates.abstract: Current multiprocessor systems execute parallel and concurrent software nondeterministically: even when given precisely the same input, two executions of the same program may produce different output. This severely complicates debugging, testing, and automatic replication for fault-tolerance. Previous efforts to address this issue have focused primarily on record and replay, but making execution actually deterministic would address the problem at the root.Our goals in this work are twofold: (1) to provide fully deterministic execution of arbitrary, unmodified, multithreaded programs as an OS service; and (2) to make all sources of intentional nondeterminism, such as network I/O, be explicit and controllable. To this end we propose a new OS abstraction, the Deterministic Process Group (DPG). All communication between threads and processes internal to a DPG happens deterministically, including implicit communication via shared-memory accesses, as well as communication via OS channels such as pipes, signals, and the filesystem. To deal with fundamentally nondeterministic external events, our abstraction includes the shim layer, a programmable interface that interposes on all interaction between a DPG and the external world, making determinism useful even for reactive applications.We implemented the DPG abstraction as an extension to Linux and demonstrate its benefits with three use cases: plain deterministic execution; replicated execution; and record and replay by logging just external input. We evaluated our implementation on both parallel and reactive workloads, including Apache, Chromium, and PARSEC.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 当前的多处理器系统以非确定性方式执行并行和并发软件：即使给定完全相同的输入，同一程序的两次执行也可能产生不同输出。这严重复杂化了调试、测试和容错自动复制。以往的努力主要集中于记录和重放，但让执行实际上变成确定性的将从根本上解决问题。我们的目标有二：（1）提供任意、未修改的多线程程序的完全确定性执行作为操作系统服务；（2）使所有有意非确定性的来源（如网络I/O）变得明确且可控。为此，我们提出一种新的操作系统抽象——确定性进程组（DPG）。DPG内部线程和进程之间的所有通信都确定性地发生，包括通过共享内存访问的隐式通信以及通过管道、信号和文件系统等OS通道的通信。为了处理根本上非确定性的外部事件，我们的抽象包含shim层，这是一个可编程接口，介入DPG与外部世界的所有交互，使确定性甚至对反应式应用也很有用。我们在Linux上实现了DPG抽象，并通过三个用例展示了其益处：普通确定性执行、复制执行以及通过仅记录外部输入进行记录和重放。我们在并行和反应式工作负载（包括Apache、Chromium和PARSEC）上评估了我们的实现。

import_candidates.title: Efficient system-enforced deterministic parallelism
import_candidates.abstract: Deterministic execution offers many benefits for debugging, fault tolerance, and security. Current methods of executing parallel programs deterministically, however, often incur high costs, allow misbehaved software to defeat repeatability, and transform time-dependent races into input- or path-dependent races without eliminating them. We introduce a new parallel programming model addressing these issues, and use Determinator, a proof-of-concept OS, to demonstrate the model's practicality. Determinator's microkernel API provides only "shared-nothing" address spaces and deterministic interprocess communication primitives to make execution of all unprivileged code--well-behaved or not-- precisely repeatable. Atop this microkernel, Determinator's user-level runtime adapts optimistic replication techniques to offer a private workspace model for both thread-level and process-level parallel programing. This model avoids the introduction of read/write data races, and converts write/write races into reliably-detected conflicts. Coarse-grained parallel benchmarks perform and scale comparably to nondeterministic systems, on both multicore PCs and across nodes in a distributed cluster.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 确定性执行为调试、容错和安全性带来了诸多好处。然而，现有并行程序的确定性执行方法往往成本高昂，允许行为不当的软件破坏可重现性，并将依赖于时间的竞争转化为依赖输入或路径的竞争，而非消除它们。我们引入了一种新的并行编程模型来应对这些问题，并通过概念验证操作系统 Determinator 证明该模型的实用性。Determinator 的微内核 API 仅提供“无共享”地址空间和确定性进程间通信原语，使所有非特权代码——无论其行为是否规范——都能被精确、可重现地执行。在该微内核之上，Determinator 的用户级运行时采用乐观复制技术，为线程级和进程级并行编程提供私有工作空间模型。该模型避免引入读/写数据竞争，并将写/写竞争转化为可被可靠检测到的冲突。粗粒度并行基准测试表明，无论在多核 PC 上还是在分布式集群的节点间，其性能和扩展性均可与非确定性系统相媲美。

import_candidates.title: Stable deterministic multithreading through schedule memoization
import_candidates.abstract: A deterministic multithreading (DMT) system eliminates nondeterminism in thread scheduling, simplifying the development of multithreaded programs. However, existing DMT systems are unstable; they may force a program to (ad)venture into vastly different schedules even for slightly different inputs or execution environments, defeating many benefits of determinism. Moreover, few existing DMT systems work with server programs whose inputs arrive continuously and nondeterministically.TERN is a stable DMT system. The key novelty in TERN is the idea of schedule memoization that memoizes past working schedules and reuses them on future inputs, making program behaviors stable across different inputs. A second novelty in TERN is the idea of windowing that extends schedule memoization to server programs by splitting continuous request streams into windows of requests. Our TERN implementation runs on Linux. It operates as user-space schedulers, requiring no changes to the OS and only a few lines of changes to the application programs. We evaluated TERN on a diverse set of 14 programs (e.g., Apache and MySQL) with real and synthetic workloads. Our results show that TERN is easy to use, makes programs more deterministic and stable, and has reasonable overhead.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 确定性多线程（DMT）系统消除了线程调度中的非确定性，简化了多线程程序的开发。然而，现有的DMT系统不稳定；即使是输入或执行环境的细微差异，它们也可能迫使程序进入截然不同的调度路径，从而削弱了确定性的许多优点。此外，很少有现有的DMT系统能够处理输入连续且非确定地到达的服务器程序。TERN是一个稳定的DMT系统。TERN的关键创新在于调度记忆化的思想，它记忆过去可行的调度并在未来的输入上重放这些调度，从而使程序行为在不同输入间保持稳定。TERN的第二个创新是窗口化的思想，通过将连续的请求流分割为请求窗口，将调度记忆化扩展到服务器程序。我们在Linux上实现了TERN。它作为用户态调度器运行，无需修改操作系统，仅需改动应用程序的几行代码。我们在14个不同程序（如Apache和MySQL）上使用真实和合成工作负载对TERN进行了评估。结果表明，TERN易于使用，使程序更具确定性和稳定性，且开销合理。

import_candidates.title: Enabling configuration-independent automation by non-expert users
import_candidates.abstract: The Internet has allowed collaboration on an unprecedented scale. Wikipedia, Luis Von Ahn's ESP game, and reCAPTCHA have proven that tasks typically performed by expensive in-house or outsourced teams can instead be delegated to the mass of Internet computer users. These success stories show the opportunity for crowd-sourcing other tasks, such as allowing computer users to help each other answer questions like "How do I make my computer do X?". The current approach to crowd-sourcing IT tasks, however, limits users to text descriptions of task solutions, which is both ineffective and frustrating. We propose instead, to allow the mass of Internet users to help each other answer how-to computer questions by actually performing the task rather than documenting its solution.This paper presents KarDo, a system that takes as input traces of low-level user actions that perform a task on individual computers, and produces an automated solution to the task that works on a wide variety of computer configurations. Our core contributions are machine learning and static analysis algorithms that infer state and action dependencies without requiring any modifications to the operating system or applications.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 互联网实现了前所未有的协作规模。维基百科、Luis Von Ahn的ESP游戏和reCAPTCHA已经证明，通常由昂贵的内部或外包团队执行的任务，可以委托给广大互联网计算机用户。这些成功案例展示了众包其他任务的机会，例如允许计算机用户互相帮助回答诸如“我如何让我的电脑做X？”这样的问题。然而，目前众包IT任务的方法将用户限制为任务解决方案的文本描述，这既无效又令人沮丧。我们建议，转而让广大互联网用户通过实际执行任务而不是记录解决方案来互相帮助解答如何操作计算机的问题。本文介绍了KarDo系统，该系统将单个计算机上执行任务的低级用户操作痕迹作为输入，并生成适用于各种计算机配置的自动化任务解决方案。我们的核心贡献是机器学习和静态分析算法，这些算法在不需要修改操作系统或应用程序的情况下推断状态和动作依赖关系。

import_candidates.title: Automating configuration troubleshooting with dynamic information flow analysis
import_candidates.abstract: Software misconfigurations are time-consuming and enormously frustrating to troubleshoot. In this paper, we show that dynamic information flow analysis helps solve these problems by pinpointing the root cause of configuration errors. We have built a tool called ConfAid that instruments application binaries to monitor the causal dependencies introduced through control and data flow as the program executes -- ConfAid uses these dependencies to link the erroneous behavior to specific tokens in configuration files. Our results using ConfAid to solve misconfigurations in OpenSSH, Apache, and Postfix show that ConfAid identifies the source of the misconfiguration as the first or second most likely root cause for 18 out of 18 real-world configuration errors and for 55 out of 60 randomly generated errors. ConfAid runs in only a few minutes, making it an attractive alternative to manual debugging.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 软件配置错误排查耗时且非常令人沮丧。在本文中，我们证明动态信息流分析能够通过定位配置错误的根本原因来解决这些问题。我们构建了一个名为ConfAid的工具，它对应用程序二进制进行插桩，以监控程序执行期间通过控制流和数据流引入的因果依赖关系——ConfAid利用这些依赖关系将错误行为与配置文件中的特定标记关联起来。我们使用ConfAid解决OpenSSH、Apache和Postfix中的配置错误，结果显示，对于18个真实世界配置错误中的18个以及60个随机生成错误中的55个，ConfAid能识别出配置错误的根源并将其列为第一或第二最可能的根本原因。ConfAid仅需几分钟即可运行，使其成为手动调试的极具吸引力的替代方案。

import_candidates.title: Large-scale incremental processing using distributed transactions and notifications
import_candidates.abstract: Updating an index of the web as documents are crawled requires continuously transforming a large repository of existing documents as new documents arrive. This task is one example of a class of data processing tasks that transform a large repository of data via small, independent mutations. These tasks lie in a gap between the capabilities of existing infrastructure. Databases do not meet the storage or throughput requirements of these tasks: Google's indexing system stores tens of petabytes of data and processes billions of updates per day on thousands of machines. MapReduce and other batch-processing systems cannot process small updates individually as they rely on creating large batches for efficiency.We have built Percolator, a system for incrementally processing updates to a large data set, and deployed it to create the Google web search index. By replacing a batch-based indexing system with an indexing system based on incremental processing using Percolator, we process the same number of documents per day, while reducing the average age of documents in Google search results by 50\%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着文档被爬取，更新网络索引需要在新文档到达时不断转换现有的大型文档仓库。这个任务是一类通过小而独立的变更来转换大型数据仓库的数据处理任务的代表。这些任务存在于现有基础设施能力之间的空白地带。数据库无法满足这些任务的存储或吞吐量要求：谷歌的索引系统存储数十PB的数据，每天在数千台机器上处理数十亿次更新。MapReduce和其他批处理系统无法单独处理小更新，因为它们依赖于创建大批量来提高效率。我们构建了Percolator——一个用于增量处理大数据集更新的系统，并部署它以创建谷歌网络搜索索引。通过用基于Percolator的增量处理索引系统取代基于批处理的索引系统，我们处理了相同数量的每日文档，同时将搜索结果中文档的平均年龄降低了50%。

import_candidates.title: Reining in the outliers in map-reduce clusters using Mantri
import_candidates.abstract: Experience froman operational Map-Reduce cluster reveals that outliers significantly prolong job completion. The causes for outliers include run-time contention for processor, memory and other resources, disk failures, varying bandwidth and congestion along network paths and, imbalance in task workload. We present Mantri, a system that monitors tasks and culls outliers using cause- and resource-aware techniques. Mantri's strategies include restarting outliers, network-aware placement of tasks and protecting outputs of valuable tasks. Using real-time progress reports, Mantri detects and acts on outliers early in their lifetime. Early action frees up resources that can be used by subsequent tasks and expedites the job overall. Acting based on the causes and the resource and opportunity cost of actions lets Mantri improve over prior work that only duplicates the laggards. Deployment in Bing's production clusters and trace-driven simulations show that Mantri improves job completion times by 32\%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 对一个运行中的Map-Reduce集群的经验表明，离群任务会显著延长作业完成时间。离群的原因包括运行时对处理器、内存和其他资源的争用、磁盘故障、网络路径上变化的带宽和拥塞，以及任务工作负载的不均衡。我们提出了Mantri系统，它通过感知原因和资源的技术来监控任务并剔除离群任务。Mantri的策略包括重启离群任务、网络感知的任务放置以及保护有价值任务的输出。利用实时进度报告，Mantri在其生命周期早期检测并处理离群任务。早期行动释放了可供后续任务使用的资源，并整体上加速了作业完成。基于原因以及行动的资源成本和机会成本来采取行动，使Mantri相比仅复制落后任务的先前工作有所改进。在Bing生产集群中的部署和基于轨迹的仿真表明，Mantri将作业完成时间缩短了32%。

import_candidates.title: Transactional consistency and automatic management in an application data cache
import_candidates.abstract: Distributed in-memory application data caches like memcached are a popular solution for scaling database-driven web sites. These systems are easy to add to existing deployments, and increase performance significantly by reducing load on both the database and application servers. Unfortunately, such caches do not integrate well with the database or the application. They cannot maintain transactional consistency across the entire system, violating the isolation properties of the underlying database. They leave the application responsible for locating data in the cache and keeping it up to date, a frequent source of application complexity and programming errors.Addressing both of these problems, we introduce a transactional cache, TxCache, with a simple programming model. TxCache ensures that any data seen within a transaction, whether it comes from the cache or the database, reflects a slightly stale but consistent snapshot of the database. TxCache makes it easy to add caching to an application by simply designating functions as cacheable; it automatically caches their results, and invalidates the cached data as the underlying database changes. Our experiments found that adding TxCache increased the throughput of a web application by up to 5.2\texttimes{}, only slightly less than a non-transactional cache, showing that consistency does not have to come at the price of performance.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 像memcached这样的分布式内存应用数据缓存是扩展数据库驱动网站的热门解决方案。这些系统易于添加到现有部署中，并通过减少数据库和应用服务器上的负载来显著提高性能。不幸的是，此类缓存无法与数据库或应用程序良好集成。它们无法在整个系统中维持事务一致性，从而违反了底层数据库的隔离属性。它们使应用程序负责在缓存中定位数据并保持其最新，这通常是应用程序复杂性和编程错误的来源。针对这两个问题，我们引入了一种具有简单编程模型的事务性缓存TxCache。TxCache确保在事务中看到的任何数据，无论来自缓存还是数据库，都反映出一个略微陈旧但一致的数据库快照。TxCache通过简单地将函数指定为可缓存，使得向应用程序添加缓存变得容易；它会自动缓存函数结果，并在底层数据库变化时使缓存数据失效。实验发现，添加TxCache可将Web应用的吞吐量提高至多5.2倍，仅比非事务性缓存略低，这表明一致性不必以性能为代价。

import_candidates.title: Piccolo: building fast, distributed programs with partitioned tables
import_candidates.abstract: Piccolo is a new data-centric programming model for writing parallel in-memory applications in data centers. Unlike existing data-flow models, Piccolo allows computation running on different machines to share distributed, mutable state via a key-value table interface. Piccolo enables efficient application implementations. In particular, applications can specify locality policies to exploit the locality of shared state access and Piccolo's run-time automatically resolves write-write conflicts using user-defined accumulation functions.Using Piccolo, we have implemented applications for several problem domains, including the PageRank algorithm, k-means clustering and a distributed crawler. Experiments using 100 Amazon EC2 instances and a 12 machine cluster show Piccolo to be faster than existing data flow models for many problems, while providing similar fault-tolerance guarantees and a convenient programming interface.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Piccolo是一种新的以数据为中心的编程模型，用于在数据中心编写并行内存应用程序。与现有的数据流模型不同，Piccolo允许运行在不同机器上的计算通过键值表接口共享分布式可变状态。Piccolo能够实现高效的应用程序实现。特别是，应用程序可以指定局部性策略以利用共享状态访问的局部性，而Piccolo的运行时通过用户定义的累加函数自动解决写写冲突。使用Piccolo，我们实现了多个问题域的应用程序，包括PageRank算法、k-means聚类和分布式爬虫。在100个Amazon EC2实例和12台机器集群上进行的实验表明，对于许多问题，Piccolo比现有的数据流模型更快，同时提供相似的容错保证和方便的编程接口。

import_candidates.title: Depot: cloud storage with minimal trust
import_candidates.abstract: The paper describes the design, implementation, and evaluation of Depot, a cloud storage system that minimizes trust assumptions. Depot tolerates buggy or malicious behavior by any number of clients or servers, yet it provides safety and liveness guarantees to correct clients. Depot provides these guarantees using a two-layer architecture. First, Depot ensures that the updates observed by correct nodes are consistently ordered under Fork-Join-Causal consistency (FJC). FJC is a slight weakening of causal consistency that can be both safe and live despite faulty nodes. Second, Depot implements protocols that use this consistent ordering of updates to provide other desirable consistency, staleness, durability, and recovery properties. Our evaluation suggests that the costs of these guarantees are modest and that Depot can tolerate faults and maintain good availability, latency, overhead, and staleness even when significant faults occur.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文描述了Depot的设计、实现和评估，Depot是一种最小化信任假设的云存储系统。Depot能够容忍任意数量的客户端或服务器的错误或恶意行为，同时为正确客户端提供安全性和活性保证。Depot通过两层架构提供这些保证。首先，Depot确保正确节点观察到的更新在分叉-加入-因果一致性（FJC）下一致排序。FJC是因果一致性的轻微弱化，尽管存在故障节点，它仍然是安全和活跃的。其次，Depot实现了利用这种一致排序更新来提供其他理想的一致性、陈旧性、持久性和恢复属性的协议。我们的评估表明，这些保证的成本适中，并且即使在发生重大故障时，Depot也能容忍故障并保持良好的可用性、延迟、开销和新鲜度。

import_candidates.title: Comet: an active distributed key-value store
import_candidates.abstract: Distributed key-value storage systems are widely used in corporations and across the Internet. Our research seeks to greatly expand the application space for key-value storage systems through application-specific customization. We designed and implemented Comet, an extensible, distributed key-value store. Each Comet node stores a collection of active storage objects (ASOs) that consist of a key, a value, and a set of handlers. Comet handlers run as a result of timers or storage operations, such as get or put, allowing an ASO to take dynamic, application-specific actions to customize its behavior. Handlers are written in a simple sandboxed extension language, providing properties of safety and isolation.We implemented a Comet prototype for the Vuze DHT, deployed Comet nodes on Vuze from PlanetLab, and built and evaluated over a dozen Comet applications. Our experience demonstrates that simple, safe, and restricted extensibility can significantly increase the power and range of applications that can run on distributed active storage systems. This approach facilitates the sharing of a single storage system by applications with diverse needs, allowing them to reap the consolidation benefits inherent in today's massive clouds.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 分布式键值存储系统广泛应用于企业和整个互联网。我们的研究旨在通过特定于应用的定制化来大幅扩展键值存储系统的应用空间。我们设计并实现了Comet，一个可扩展的分布式键值存储系统。每个Comet节点存储一组活动存储对象（ASO），其中包含键、值和一组处理器。Comet处理器由定时器或存储操作（如get或put）触发运行，使ASO能够采取动态的、特定于应用的操作来自定义其行为。处理器使用简单且受沙箱限制的扩展语言编写，从而提供安全性和隔离性属性。我们在Vuze DHT上实现了Comet原型，从PlanetLab将Comet节点部署到Vuze上，并构建和评估了十多个Comet应用。我们的经验表明，简单、安全且受限制的可扩展性能够显著提高可在分布式活动存储系统上运行的应用的能力和范围。这种方法使得具有不同需求的应用程序可以共享一个存储系统，从而充分利用当今大规模云环境中的整合优势。

import_candidates.title: SPORC: group collaboration using untrusted cloud resources
import_candidates.abstract: Cloud-based services are an attractive deployment model for user-facing applications like word processing and calendaring. Unlike desktop applications, cloud services allow multiple users to edit shared state concurrently and in real-time, while being scalable, highly available, and globally accessible. Unfortunately, these benefits come at the cost of fully trusting cloud providers with potentially sensitive and important data.To overcome this strict tradeoff, we present SPORC, a generic framework for building a wide variety of collaborative applications with untrusted servers. In SPORC, a server observes only encrypted data and cannot deviate from correct execution without being detected. SPORC allows concurrent, low-latency editing of shared state, permits disconnected operation, and supports dynamic access control even in the presence of concurrency. We demonstrate SPORC's flexibility through two prototype applications: a causally-consistent key-value store and a browser-based collaborative text editor.Conceptually, SPORC illustrates the complementary benefits of operational transformation (OT) and fork* consistency. The former allows SPORC clients to execute concurrent operations without locking and to resolve any resulting conflicts automatically. The latter prevents a misbehaving server from equivocating about the order of operations unless it is willing to fork clients into disjoint sets. Notably, unlike previous systems, SPORC can automatically recover from such malicious forks by leveraging OT's conflict resolution mechanism.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 基于云的服务对于面向用户的应用（如文字处理和日程安排）是一种有吸引力的部署模型。与桌面应用不同，云服务允许多个用户并发地、实时地编辑共享状态，同时具备可扩展性、高可用性和全球可访问性。不幸的是，这些好处需要以完全信任云提供商处理潜在敏感和重要数据为代价。为了克服这种严格的权衡，我们提出了SPORC，这是一个通用的框架，用于构建具有不可信服务器的各种协作应用。在SPORC中，服务器只能观察到加密数据，并且如果偏离正确执行就无法不被检测到。SPORC允许并发、低延迟地编辑共享状态，支持离线操作，并且即使在并发存在的情况下也支持动态访问控制。我们通过两个原型应用展示了SPORC的灵活性：一个因果一致性的键值存储和一个基于浏览器的协作文本编辑器。从概念上讲，SPORC展示了操作变换（OT）和fork*一致性的互补优势。前者允许SPORC客户端在无需锁定的情况下执行并发操作，并自动解决任何由此产生的冲突。后者防止行为不当的服务器对操作的顺序进行模棱两可的处理，除非它愿意将客户端分叉成不相交的集合。值得注意的是，与之前的系统不同，SPORC可以通过利用OT的冲突解决机制自动从这种恶意分叉中恢复。

import_candidates.title: Onix: a distributed control platform for large-scale production networks
import_candidates.abstract: Computer networks lack a general control paradigm, as traditional networks do not provide any network-wide management abstractions. As a result, each new function (such as routing) must provide its own state distribution, element discovery, and failure recovery mechanisms. We believe this lack of a common control platform has significantly hindered the development of flexible, reliable and feature-rich network control planes.To address this, we present Onix, a platform on top of which a network control plane can be implemented as a distributed system. Control planes written within Onix operate on a global view of the network, and use basic state distribution primitives provided by the platform. Thus Onix provides a general API for control plane implementations, while allowing them to make their own trade-offs among consistency, durability, and scalability.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 计算机网络缺乏通用控制范式，因为传统网络不提供任何网络范围的管理抽象。因此，每种新功能（如路由）都必须提供自身的状态分发、元素发现和故障恢复机制。我们认为，缺乏通用控制平台已严重阻碍了灵活、可靠且功能丰富的网络控制平面的发展。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Onix，一个可以在其上将网络控制平面实现为分布式系统的平台。在Onix内编写的控制平面基于网络的全局视图运作，并使用平台提供的基础状态分发原语。因此，Onix为控制平面实现提供了通用API，同时允许它们在一致性、持久性和可扩展性之间做出自己的权衡。

import_candidates.title: Can the production network be the testbed?
import_candidates.abstract: A persistent problem in computer network research is validation. When deciding how to evaluate a new feature or bug fix, a researcher or operator must trade-off realism (in terms of scale, actual user traffic, real equipment) and cost (larger scale costs more money, real user traffic likely requires downtime, and real equipment requires vendor adoption which can take years). Building a realistic testbed is hard because "real" networking takes place on closed, commercial switches and routers with special purpose hardware. But if we build our testbed from software switches, they run several orders of magnitude slower. Even if we build a realistic network testbed, it is hard to scale, because it is special purpose and is in addition to the regular network. It needs its own location, support and dedicated links. For a testbed to have global reach takes investment beyond the reach of most researchers.In this paper, we describe a way to build a testbed that is embedded in--and thus grows with--the network. The technique--embodied in our first prototype, FlowVisor--slices the network hardware by placing a layer between the control plane and the data plane. We demonstrate that FlowVisor slices our own production network, with legacy protocols running in their own protected slice, alongside experiments created by researchers. The basic idea is that if unmodified hardware supports some basic primitives (in our prototype, Open-Flow, but others are possible), then a worldwide testbed can ride on the coat-tails of deployments, at no extra expense. Further, we evaluate the performance impact and describe how FlowVisor is deployed at seven other campuses as part of a wider evaluation platform.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 计算机网络研究中一个长期存在的问题是验证。在决定如何评估新功能或错误修复时，研究人员或运营商必须在真实性（在规模、实际用户流量、真实设备方面）与成本之间进行权衡（更大规模成本更高，真实用户流量可能需要停机，而真实设备则需要供应商采用，这可能耗时数年）。构建真实的测试平台很难，因为“真实”的网络发生在带有专用硬件的封闭、商用交换机和路由器上。但如果我们使用软件交换机来构建测试平台，它们的运行速度会慢几个数量级。即使我们构建了一个真实的网络测试平台，它也难以扩展，因为它是专用平台，并且是常规网络的补充。它需要自己的位置、支持和专用链路。要让测试平台覆盖全球，其投资超出了大多数研究人员的能力范围。本文描述了一种构建嵌入网络并随网络一同增长的测试平台的方法。该技术——体现在我们的第一个原型FlowVisor中——通过在控制平面和数据平面之间放置一个层来对网络硬件进行切片。我们证明了FlowVisor能够对我们的生产网络进行切片，传统协议在自己的受保护切片中运行，并同时承载研究人员创建的实验。基本思想是，如果未修改的硬件支持一些基本原语（在我们的原型中是OpenFlow，但其他原语也可能），那么一个全球性的测试平台就可以借助部署的顺风车，而无需额外费用。此外，我们评估了性能影响，并描述了FlowVisor作为更广泛评估平台的一部分在另外七所校园中的部署情况。

import_candidates.title: Building extensible networks with rule-based forwarding
import_candidates.abstract: We present a network design that provides flexible and policy-compliant forwarding. Our proposal centers around a new architectural concept: that of packet rules. A rule is a simple if-then-else construct that describes the manner in which the network should - or should not - forward packets. A packet identifies the rule by which it is to be forwarded and routers forward each packet in accordance with its associated rule. Each packet rule is certified, guaranteeing that all parties involved in forwarding a packet agree with the packet's rule. Packets containing uncertified rules are simply dropped in the network. We present the design, implementation and evaluation of a Rule-Based Forwarding (RBF) architecture. We demonstrate flexibility by illustrating how RBF supports a variety of use cases including content caching, middlebox selection and DDoS protection. Using our prototype router implementation we show that the overhead RBF imposes is within the capabilities of modern network equipment.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种提供灵活且符合策略转发的网络设计。我们的提议围绕一个新的架构概念：数据包规则。规则是一种简单的if-then-else结构，描述了网络应该如何或不应该转发数据包。数据包标识了其被转发的规则，路由器根据每个数据包关联的规则进行转发。每个数据包规则都经过认证，确保参与转发数据包的所有各方都同意该数据包的规则。包含未经认证规则的数据包将直接被网络丢弃。我们介绍了基于规则的转发（RBF）架构的设计、实现和评估。我们通过展示RBF如何支持各种用例（包括内容缓存、中间盒选择和DDoS防护）来证明其灵活性。使用我们的原型路由器实现，我们表明RBF引入的开销在现代网络设备的能力范围内。

import_candidates.title: TaintDroid: an information-flow tracking system for realtime privacy monitoring on smartphones
import_candidates.abstract: Today's smartphone operating systems frequently fail to provide users with adequate control over and visibility into how third-party applications use their private data. We address these shortcomings with TaintDroid, an efficient, system-wide dynamic taint tracking and analysis system capable of simultaneously tracking multiple sources of sensitive data. TaintDroid provides realtime analysis by leveraging Android's virtualized execution environment. TaintDroid incurs only 14\% performance overhead on a CPU-bound micro-benchmark and imposes negligible overhead on interactive third-party applications. Using TaintDroid to monitor the behavior of 30 popular third-party Android applications, we found 68 instances of potential misuse of users' private information across 20 applications. Monitoring sensitive data with TaintDroid provides informed use of third-party applications for phone users and valuable input for smartphone security service firms seeking to identify misbehaving applications.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 当今的智能手机操作系统往往无法为用户提供足够的控制力和可见性，来了解第三方应用如何使用他们的私人数据。我们通过TaintDroid解决了这些缺点，这是一个高效、系统级的动态污点追踪和分析系统，能够同时追踪多个敏感数据源。TaintDroid利用Android的虚拟化执行环境提供实时分析。在CPU密集型微基准测试中，TaintDroid仅产生14%的性能开销，并且对交互式第三方应用的开销可忽略不计。使用TaintDroid监控30个流行的第三方Android应用，我们发现20个应用中有68个可能滥用用户私人信息的实例。使用TaintDroid监控敏感数据，为手机用户提供了第三方应用的知情使用，也为寻求识别违规应用的智能手机安全服务公司提供了宝贵输入。

import_candidates.title: StarTrack next generation: a scalable infrastructure for track-based applications
import_candidates.abstract: StarTrack was the first service designed to manage tracks of GPS location coordinates obtained from mobile devices and to facilitate the construction of track-based applications. Our early attempts to build practical applications on StarTrack revealed substantial efficiency and scalability problems, including frequent client-server roundtrips, unnecessary data transfers, costly similarity comparisons involving thousands of tracks, and poor fault-tolerance. To remedy these limitations, we revised the overall system architecture, API, and implementation. The API was extended to operate on collections of tracks rather than individual tracks, delay query execution, and permit caching of query results. New data structures, namely track trees, were introduced to speed the common operation of searching for similar tracks. Map matching algorithms were adopted to convert each track into a more compact and canonical sequence of road segments. And the underlying track database was partitioned and replicated among multiple servers. Altogether, these changes not only simplified the construction of track-based applications, which we confirmed by building applications using our new API, but also resulted in considerable performance gains. Measurements of similarity queries, for example, show two to three orders of magnitude improvement in query times.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: StarTrack是首个用于管理从移动设备获取的GPS位置轨迹并促进基于轨迹应用构建的服务。我们早期在StarTrack上构建实际应用的尝试揭示了严重的效率和可扩展性问题，包括频繁的客户端-服务器往返、不必要的数据传输、涉及数千条轨迹的高成本相似性比较，以及较差的容错性。为解决这些限制，我们修订了整体系统架构、API和实现。API被扩展为操作轨迹集而非单个轨迹，延迟查询执行，并允许缓存查询结果。引入了新的数据结构，即轨迹树，以加速搜索相似轨迹这一常见操作。采用地图匹配算法将每条轨迹转换为更紧凑和规范的路径段序列。并且底层轨迹数据库在多台服务器之间进行了分区和复制。总之，这些更改不仅简化了基于轨迹应用的构建（我们通过使用新API构建应用进行了确认），而且带来了显著的性能提升。例如，对相似性查询的测量显示查询时间改善了两到三个数量级。

import_candidates.title: The turtles project: design and implementation of nested virtualization
import_candidates.abstract: In classical machine virtualization, a hypervisor runs multiple operating systems simultaneously, each on its own virtual machine. In nested virtualization, a hypervisor can run multiple other hypervisors with their associated virtual machines. As operating systems gain hypervisor functionality--Microsoft Windows 7 already runs Windows XP in a virtual machine--nested virtualization will become necessary in hypervisors that wish to host them. We present the design, implementation, analysis, and evaluation of high-performance nested virtualization on Intel x86-based systems. The Turtles project, which is part of the Linux/KVM hypervisor, runs multiple unmodified hypervisors (e.g., KVM and VMware) and operating systems (e.g., Linux and Windows). Despite the lack of architectural support for nested virtualization in the x86 architecture, it can achieve performance that is within 6-8\% of single-level (non-nested) virtualization for common workloads, through multi-dimensional paging for MMU virtualization and multi-level device assignment for I/O virtualization.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在经典机器虚拟化中，虚拟机监控器可以同时运行多个操作系统，每个操作系统位于各自的虚拟机上。在嵌套虚拟化中，虚拟机监控器可以运行其他多个虚拟机监控器及其关联的虚拟机。随着操作系统获得虚拟机监控器功能——Microsoft Windows 7已经在虚拟机中运行Windows XP——嵌套虚拟化对于希望托管它们的虚拟机监控器来说将变得必要。我们介绍了在基于Intel x86架构的系统上实现高性能嵌套虚拟化的设计、实现、分析和评估。作为Linux/KVM虚拟机监控器的一部分，Turtles项目可以运行多个未经修改的虚拟机监控器（例如KVM和VMware）以及操作系统（例如Linux和Windows）。尽管x86架构缺乏对嵌套虚拟化的架构支持，但通过用于内存管理单元（MMU）虚拟化的多维分页和用于I/O虚拟化的多级设备分配，它在常见工作负载下可以达到单级（非嵌套）虚拟化性能的6-8%以内。

import_candidates.title: Flat datacenter storage
import_candidates.abstract: Flat Datacenter Storage (FDS) is a high-performance, fault-tolerant, large-scale, locality-oblivious blob store. Using a novel combination of full bisection bandwidth networks, data and metadata striping, and flow control, FDS multiplexes an application's large-scale I/O across the available throughput and latency budget of every disk in a cluster. FDS therefore makes many optimizations around data locality unnecessary. Disks also communicate with each other at their full bandwidth, making recovery from disk failures extremely fast. FDS is designed for datacenter scale, fully distributing metadata operations that might otherwise become a bottleneck.FDS applications achieve single-process read and write performance of more than 2GB/s. We measure recovery of 92GB data lost to disk failure in 6.2 s and recovery from a total machine failure with 655GB of data in 33.7 s. Application performance is also high: we describe our FDS-based sort application which set the 2012 world record for disk-to-disk sorting.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 扁平数据中心存储（FDS）是一种高性能、容错、大规模、位置无关的块存储系统。通过结合全二分带宽网络、数据与元数据条带化以及流量控制的创新方式，FDS将应用的大规模I/O复用到集群中每块磁盘的可用吞吐量和延迟预算之上。因此，FDS使得许多围绕数据局部性的优化变得不再必要。磁盘之间也能以全带宽相互通信，使得磁盘故障恢复极为迅速。FDS专为数据中心规模设计，完全分布化了原本可能成为瓶颈的元数据操作。FDS应用实现了单进程读写性能超过2GB/s。我们测得在发生磁盘故障后，92GB数据的恢复时间为6.2秒；整机故障时，655GB数据的恢复时间为33.7秒。应用性能也很高：我们描述了基于FDS的排序应用，该应用创造了2012年磁盘到磁盘排序的世界纪录。

import_candidates.title: PowerGraph: distributed graph-parallel computation on natural graphs
import_candidates.abstract: Large-scale graph-structured computation is central to tasks ranging from targeted advertising to natural language processing and has led to the development of several graph-parallel abstractions including Pregel and GraphLab. However, the natural graphs commonly found in the real-world have highly skewed power-law degree distributions, which challenge the assumptions made by these abstractions, limiting performance and scalability.In this paper, we characterize the challenges of computation on natural graphs in the context of existing graph-parallel abstractions. We then introduce the PowerGraph abstraction which exploits the internal structure of graph programs to address these challenges. Leveraging the PowerGraph abstraction we introduce a new approach to distributed graph placement and representation that exploits the structure of power-law graphs. We provide a detailed analysis and experimental evaluation comparing PowerGraph to two popular graph-parallel systems. Finally, we describe three different implementation strategies for PowerGraph and discuss their relative merits with empirical evaluations on large-scale real-world problems demonstrating order of magnitude gains.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大规模图结构计算是定向广告到自然语言处理等任务的核心，并已推动了包括Pregel和GraphLab在内的多种图并行抽象的发展。然而，现实世界中常见的自然图具有高度偏斜的幂律度分布，这挑战了这些抽象所做假设，限制了性能和可扩展性。在本文中，我们在现有图并行抽象的背景下描述了自然图上计算所面临的挑战。然后，我们引入了PowerGraph抽象，它利用图程序的内部结构来应对这些挑战。借助PowerGraph抽象，我们提出了一种新的分布式图放置和表示方法，该方法利用幂律图的结构。我们提供了详细的分析和实验评估，将PowerGraph与两个流行的图并行系统进行比较。最后，我们描述了PowerGraph的三种不同实现策略，并通过对大规模现实问题的实证评估来讨论其相对优缺点，展示了数量级的改进。

import_candidates.title: GraphChi: large-scale graph computation on just a PC
import_candidates.abstract: Current systems for graph computation require a distributed computing cluster to handle very large real-world problems, such as analysis on social networks or the web graph. While distributed computational resources have become more accessible, developing distributed graph algorithms still remains challenging, especially to non-experts.In this work, we present GraphChi, a disk-based system for computing efficiently on graphs with billions of edges. By using a well-known method to break large graphs into small parts, and a novel parallel sliding windows method, GraphChi is able to execute several advanced data mining, graph mining, and machine learning algorithms on very large graphs, using just a single consumer-level computer. We further extend GraphChi to support graphs that evolve over time, and demonstrate that, on a single computer, GraphChi can process over one hundred thousand graph updates per second, while simultaneously performing computation. We show, through experiments and theoretical analysis, that GraphChi performs well on both SSDs and rotational hard drives.By repeating experiments reported for existing distributed systems, we show that, with only fraction of the resources, GraphChi can solve the same problems in very reasonable time. Our work makes large-scale graph computation available to anyone with a modern PC.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 当前的图计算系统需要分布式计算集群来处理大型现实问题，例如社交网络或网络图分析。虽然分布式计算资源变得更容易获取，但特别是对于非专业人员而言，开发分布式图算法仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们展示了GraphChi，一个基于磁盘的系统，可以在具有数十亿条边的图上高效计算。通过一种已知的方法将大图分解为小部分，并采用新颖的并行滑动窗口方法，GraphChi仅使用一台消费级计算机，就能在超大图上执行若干先进的数据挖掘、图挖掘和机器学习算法。我们进一步扩展GraphChi以支持随时间演化的图，并证明在单台计算机上，GraphChi每秒能处理超过十万次图更新，同时还能进行计算。通过实验和理论分析，我们证明GraphChi在固态硬盘和旋转机械硬盘上均表现良好。通过重复现有分布式系统报告的实验，我们表明仅需一小部分资源，GraphChi就能在非常合理的时间内解决相同的问题。这项工作使得任何人都可以用一台现代个人电脑进行大规模图计算。

import_candidates.title: Hails: protecting data privacy in untrusted web applications
import_candidates.abstract: Modern extensible web platforms like Facebook and Yammer depend on third-party software to offer a rich experience to their users. Unfortunately, users running a third-party "app" have little control over what it does with their private data. Today's platforms offer only ad-hoc constraints on app behavior, leaving users an unfortunate trade-off between convenience and privacy. A principled approach to code confinement could allow the integration of untrusted codewhile enforcing flexible, end-to-end policies on data access. This paper presents a new web framework, Hails, that adds mandatory access control and a declarative policy language to the familiar MVC architecture. We demonstrate the flexibility of Hails through GitStar.com, a code-hosting website that enforces robust privacy policies on user data even while allowing untrusted apps to deliver extended features to users.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代可扩展Web平台如Facebook和Yammer依赖第三方软件为用户提供丰富体验。不幸的是，运行第三方“应用”的用户对其如何使用自己的隐私数据几乎没有控制。如今的平台只能对应用行为施加临时性约束，使用户不得不在便利与隐私之间做出取舍。一种有原则的代码隔离方法可以在整合不可信代码的同时，强制执行灵活、端到端的数据访问策略。本文提出了一个新的Web框架Hails，它在熟悉的MVC架构中加入了强制访问控制和声明式策略语言。我们通过GitStar.com——一个即使允许不可信应用为用户提供扩展功能，也能对用户数据执行稳健隐私策略的代码托管网站——展示了Hails的灵活性。

import_candidates.title: Eternal sunshine of the spotless machine: protecting privacy with ephemeral channels
import_candidates.abstract: Modern systems keep long memories. As we show in this paper, an adversary who gains access to a Linux system, even one that implements secure deallocation, can recover the contents of applications' windows, audio buffers, and data remaining in device drivers--long after the applications have terminated.We design and implement Lacuna, a system that allows users to run programs in "private sessions." After the session is over, all memories of its execution are erased. The key abstraction in Lacuna is an ephemeral channel, which allows the protected program to talk to peripheral devices while making it possible to delete the memories of this communication from the host. Lacuna can run unmodified applications that use graphics, sound, USB input devices, and the network, with only 20 percentage points of additional CPU utilization.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代系统保留着长久的内存记忆。正如我们在本文中所展示的，一个获得Linux系统访问权限的 adversary，即使是实现了安全释放的系统，也能在应用程序终止很长时间后恢复应用程序窗口、音频缓冲区以及驻留在设备驱动程序中的数据的剩余内容。我们设计并实现了Lacuna系统，该系统允许用户以“私有会话”方式运行程序。会话结束后，其执行的所有内存痕迹都会被清除。Lacuna中的关键抽象是“瞬时通道”，它允许受保护程序与外围设备通信，同时使主机能够删除该通信的内存痕迹。Lacuna可以运行未修改的使用图形、声音、USB输入设备和网络的应用程序，且仅增加约20个百分点的CPU利用率。

import_candidates.title: CleanOS: limiting mobile data exposure with idle eviction
import_candidates.abstract: Mobile-device theft and loss have reached gigantic proportions. Despite these threats, today's mobile devices are saturated with sensitive information due to operating systems that never securely erase data and applications that hoard it on the vulnerable device for performance or convenience. This paper presents CleanOS, a new Android-based operating system that manages sensitive data rigorously and maintains a clean environment at all times. To do so, CleanOS leverages a key property of today's mobile applications - the use of trusted, cloud-based services. Specifically, CleanOS identifies and tracks sensitive data in RAM and on stable storage, encrypts it with a key, and evicts that key to the cloud when the data is not in active use on the device. We call this process idle eviction of sensitive data. To implement CleanOS, we used the TaintDroid mobile taint-tracking system to identify sensitive data locations and instrumented Android's Dalvik interpreter to securely evict that data after a specified period of non-use. Our experimental results show that CleanOS limits sensitive-data exposure drastically while incurring acceptable overheads on mobile networks.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 移动设备被盗和丢失问题已极为严重。尽管面临这些威胁，当今的移动设备上仍充斥着敏感信息，因为操作系统从不安全地擦除数据，而应用程序为了性能或便利将这些数据囤积在易受攻击的设备上。本文介绍了CleanOS，一种基于Android的新操作系统，它严格管理敏感数据并始终保持干净环境。为此，CleanOS利用了当今移动应用的一个关键特性——使用可信的基于云的服务。具体来说，CleanOS识别并跟踪RAM和稳定存储中的敏感数据，用密钥对其进行加密，并在数据未被设备上活跃使用时将该密钥逐出到云端。我们称此过程为敏感数据的闲置驱逐。为实现CleanOS，我们使用了TaintDroid移动污点跟踪系统来识别敏感数据位置，并对Android的Dalvik解释器进行插桩，以便在指定时间未使用后安全地驱逐该数据。实验结果表明，CleanOS在显著降低敏感数据暴露风险的同时，对移动网络引入了可接受的性能开销。

import_candidates.title: COMET: code offload by migrating execution transparently
import_candidates.abstract: In this paper we introduce a runtime system to allow unmodified multi-threaded applications to use multiple machines. The system allows threads to migrate freely between machines depending on the workload. Our prototype, COMET (Code Offload by Migrating Execution Transparently), is a realization of this design built on top of the Dalvik Virtual Machine. COMET leverages the underlying memory model of our runtime to implement distributed shared memory (DSM) with as few interactions between machines as possible. Making use of a new VM-synchronization primitive, COMET imposes little restriction on when migration can occur. Additionally, enough information is maintained so one machine may resume computation after a network failure.We target our efforts towards augmenting smartphones or tablets with machines available in the network. We demonstrate the effectiveness of COMET on several real applications available on Google Play. These applications include image editors, turn-based games, a trip planner, and math tools. Utilizing a server-class machine, COMET can offer significant speed-ups on these real applications when run on a modern smartphone. With WiFi and 3G networks, we observe geometric mean speed-ups of 2.88\texttimes{} and 1.27\texttimes{} relative to the Dalvik interpreter across the set of applications with speed-ups as high as 15\texttimes{} on some applications.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种运行时系统，允许未经修改的多线程应用程序使用多台机器。该系统允许线程根据工作负载在机器之间自由迁移。我们的原型COMET（通过透明迁移执行实现代码卸载）是基于Dalvik虚拟机构建的该设计的一种实现。COMET利用我们运行时的底层内存模型来实现分布式共享内存（DSM），并尽可能减少机器之间的交互。通过使用一种新的VM同步原语，COMET对迁移何时发生几乎没有限制。此外，系统维护了足够的信息，以便在一台机器在网络故障后可以恢复计算。我们的目标是增强智能手机或平板电脑利用网络中可用的机器。我们在Google Play上可用的几个实际应用上展示了COMET的有效性。这些应用包括图像编辑器、回合制游戏、旅行规划器和数学工具。利用服务器级机器，COMET在现代智能手机上运行这些实际应用时可以提供显著的加速。在WiFi和3G网络中，相对于Dalvik解释器，我们观察到这些应用的几何平均加速分别为2.88倍和1.27倍，其中某些应用的加速比高达15倍。

import_candidates.title: AppInsight: mobile app performance monitoring in the wild
import_candidates.abstract: The mobile-app marketplace is highly competitive. To maintain and improve the quality of their apps, developers need data about how their app is performing in the wild. The asynchronous, multithreaded nature of mobile apps makes tracing difficult. The difficulties are compounded by the resource limitations inherent in the mobile platform. To address this challenge, we develop AppInsight, a system that instruments mobile-app binaries to automatically identify the critical path in user transactions, across asynchronous-call boundaries. AppInsight is lightweight, it does not require any input from the developer, and it does not require any changes to the OS. We used AppInsight to instrument 30 marketplace apps, and carried out a field trial with 30 users for over 4 months. We report on the characteristics of the critical paths that AppInsight found in this data. We also give real-world examples of how AppInsight helped developers improve the quality of their app.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 移动应用市场竞争激烈。为了维持和提高应用质量，开发者需要了解应用在真实环境中的表现。移动应用的异步、多线程特性使得追踪变得困难。移动平台固有的资源限制又使困难加剧。为了应对这一挑战，我们开发了AppInsight，一个对移动应用二进制代码进行插桩的系统，能够自动识别跨异步调用边界用户事务中的关键路径。AppInsight非常轻量，不需要开发者提供任何输入，也不需要修改操作系统。我们使用AppInsight对30个市场应用进行了插桩，并与30位用户进行了为期4个多月的现场试验。我们报告了AppInsight在此数据中发现的关键路径的特征。我们还提供了真实世界的示例，说明AppInsight如何帮助开发者提高应用质量。

import_candidates.title: Spotting code optimizations in data-parallel pipelines through PeriSCOPE
import_candidates.abstract: To minimize the amount of data-shuffling I/O that occurs between the pipeline stages of a distributed data-parallel program, its procedural code must be optimized with full awareness of the pipeline that it executes in. Unfortunately, neither pipeline optimizers nor traditional compilers examine both the pipeline and procedural code of a data-parallel program so programmers must either hand-optimize their program across pipeline stages or live with poor performance. To resolve this tension between performance and programmability, this paper describes PeriSCOPE, which automatically optimizes a data-parallel program's procedural code in the context of data flow that is reconstructed from the program's pipeline topology. Such optimizations eliminate unnecessary code and data, perform early data filtering, and calculate small derived values (e.g., predicates) earlier in the pipeline, so that less data--sometimes much less data--is transferred between pipeline stages. We describe how PeriSCOPE is implemented and evaluate its effectiveness on real production jobs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 为了最小化分布式数据并行程序的管道阶段之间发生的数据混洗I/O量，其过程代码必须在充分感知其执行管道的情况下进行优化。然而，管道优化器和传统编译器都不会同时检查数据并行程序的管道和过程代码，因此程序员要么必须跨管道阶段手动优化其程序，要么忍受较差的性能。为了解决性能与可编程性之间的矛盾，本文描述了PeriSCOPE，它根据从程序管道拓扑重建的数据流上下文来自动优化数据并行程序的过程代码。这类优化消除了不必要的代码和数据，执行早期数据过滤，并在管道中更早地计算小的派生值（如谓词），从而减少阶段之间传输的数据量（有时大幅减少）。我们描述了PeriSCOPE的实现方式，并评估了其在真实生产作业上的有效性。

import_candidates.title: MegaPipe: a new programming interface for scalable network I/O
import_candidates.abstract: We present MegaPipe, a new API for efficient, scalable network I/O for message-oriented workloads. The design of MegaPipe centers around the abstraction of a channel - a per-core, bidirectional pipe between the kernel and user space, used to exchange both I/O requests and event notifications. On top of the channel abstraction, we introduce three key concepts of MegaPipe: partitioning, lightweight socket (lwsocket), and batching.We implement MegaPipe in Linux and adapt memcached and nginx. Our results show that, by embracing a clean-slate design approach, MegaPipe is able to exploit new opportunities for improved performance and ease of programmability. In microbenchmarks on an 8-core server with 64 B messages, MegaPipe outperforms baseline Linux between 29\% (for long connections) and 582\% (for short connections). MegaPipe improves the performance of a modified version of memcached between 15\% and 320\%. For a workload based on real-world HTTP traces, MegaPipe boosts the throughput of nginx by 75\%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了MegaPipe，一种面向消息工作负载的高效、可扩展网络I/O的新API。MegaPipe的设计围绕通道（channel）这一抽象展开——通道是内核与用户空间之间的每核心双向管道，用于交换I/O请求和事件通知。在通道抽象之上，我们引入了MegaPipe的三个关键概念：分区（partitioning）、轻量级套接字（lwsocket）和批处理（batching）。我们在Linux中实现了MegaPipe，并适配了memcached和nginx。结果表明，通过采用全新的设计方法，MegaPipe能够利用新的机会来提升性能并增强可编程性。在8核服务器上使用64字节消息进行的微基准测试中，MegaPipe比基线Linux高出29%（长连接）至582%（短连接）。MegaPipe使修改版memcached的性能提升15%至320%。对于基于真实世界HTTP追踪的工作负载，MegaPipe将nginx的吞吐量提升了75%。

import_candidates.title: DJoin: differentially private join queries over distributed databases
import_candidates.abstract: In this paper, we study the problem of answering queries about private data that is spread across multiple different databases. For instance, a medical researcher may want to study a possible correlation between travel patterns and certain types of illnesses. The necessary information exists today - e.g., in airline reservation systems and hospital records - but it is maintained by two separate companies who are prevented by law from sharing this information with each other, or with a third party. This separation prevents the processing of such queries, even if the final answer, e.g., a correlation coefficient, would be safe to release.We present DJoin, a system that can process such distributed queries and can give strong differential privacy guarantees on the result. DJoin can support many SQL-style queries, including joins of databases maintained by different entities, as long as they can be expressed using DJoin's two novel primitives: BN-PSI-CA, a differentially private form of private set intersection cardinality, and DCR, a multi-party combination operator that can aggregate noised cardinalities without compounding the individual noise terms. Our experimental evaluation shows that DJoin can process realistic queries at practical timescales: simple queries on three databases with 15,000 rows each take between 1 and 7.5 hours.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文研究了回答分布在不同数据库中的私有数据查询的问题。例如，医学研究人员可能希望研究旅行模式与某些类型疾病之间的可能关联。必要的信息如今已经存在——例如在航空预订系统和医院记录中——但这些信息由两家独立的公司维护，法律禁止它们彼此共享这些信息，也禁止与第三方共享。这种隔离使得此类查询无法处理，即使最终答案（如相关系数）发布是安全的。我们提出了DJoin系统，该系统可以处理此类分布式查询，并对结果提供强差分隐私保证。DJoin支持许多SQL风格的查询，包括由不同实体维护的数据库之间的连接，只要这些查询能够用DJoin的两个新原语来表达：BN-PSI-CA（一种差分隐私的私有集交集基数计算形式）和DCR（一种多方组合算子，可以在不叠加各个噪声项的情况下聚合加噪后的基数）。我们的实验评估表明，DJoin能够在实际时间尺度内处理真实查询：对三个各含15,000行的数据库进行简单查询需要1至7.5小时。

import_candidates.title: Improving integer security for systems with KINT
import_candidates.abstract: Integer errors have emerged as an important threat to systems security, because they allow exploits such as buffer overflow and privilege escalation. This paper presents KINT, a tool that uses scalable static analysis to detect integer errors in C programs. KINT generates constraints from source code and user annotations, and feeds them into a constraint solver for deciding whether an integer error can occur. KINT introduces a number of techniques to reduce the number of false error reports. KINT identified more than 100 integer errors in the Linux kernel, the lighttpd web server, and OpenSSH, which were confirmed and fixed by the developers. Based on the experience with KINT, the paper further proposes a new integer family with NaN semantics to help developers avoid integer errors in C programs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 整数错误已成为系统安全的重要威胁，因为它们允许诸如缓冲区溢出和权限提升之类的利用。本文介绍了KINT，一个使用可扩展静态分析来检测C程序中整数错误的工具。KINT从源代码和用户注释中生成约束，并将其输入约束求解器以判断是否可能发生整数错误。KINT引入了多种技术来减少误报数量。KINT在Linux内核、lighttpd Web服务器和OpenSSH中识别出100多个整数错误，这些错误已得到开发人员的确认和修复。基于KINT的经验，本文进一步提出了一种具有NaN语义的新型整数系列，以帮助开发人员避免C程序中的整数错误。

import_candidates.title: Dissent in numbers: making strong anonymity scale
import_candidates.abstract: Current anonymous communication systems make a trade-off between weak anonymity among many nodes, via onion routing, and strong anonymity among few nodes, via DC-nets. We develop novel techniques in Dissent, a practical group anonymity system, to increase by over two orders of magnitude the scalability of strong, traffic analysis resistant approaches. Dissent derives its scalability from a client/server architecture, in which many unreliable clients depend on a smaller and more robust, but administratively decentralized, set of servers. Clients trust only that at least one server in the set is honest, but need not know or choose which server to trust. Unlike the quadratic costs of prior peer-to-peer DC-nets schemes, Dissent's client/server design makes communication and processing costs linear in the number of clients, and hence in anonymity set size. Further, Dissent's servers can unilaterally ensure progress, even if clients respond slowly or disconnect at arbitrary times, ensuring robustness against client churn, tail latencies, and DoS attacks. On DeterLab, Dissent scales to 5,000 online participants with latencies as low as 600 milliseconds for 600-client groups. An anonymous Web browsing application also shows that Dissent's performance suffices for interactive communication within smaller local-area groups.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 当前的匿名通信系统在通过洋葱路由在众多节点之间实现弱匿名和通过DC-net在少数节点之间实现强匿名之间进行权衡。我们在Dissent（一个实用的组匿名系统）中开发了新技巧，将强且抗流量分析方法的可扩展性提高了两个数量级以上。Dissent的可扩展性源自其客户端/服务器架构，其中许多不可靠的客户端依赖一组规模较小但更健壮且管理上分散的服务器。客户端仅需信任这组服务器中至少有一台是诚实的，而无需知道或选择要信任哪一台。与先前的点对点DC-net方案相比，Dissent的客户端/服务器设计使通信和处理成本随客户端数量（即匿名集大小）线性增长，避免了二次方开销。此外，即使客户端响应缓慢或任意时间断开连接，Dissent的服务器也能单方面确保进度，从而保障了对客户端更替、尾延迟和DoS攻击的鲁棒性。在DeterLab上，Dissent可扩展到5000位在线参与者，600个客户端的组延迟可低至600毫秒。一个匿名网页浏览应用也表明，Dissent的性能足以支持较小局域网组内的交互式通信。

import_candidates.title: Efficient patch-based auditing for web application vulnerabilities
import_candidates.abstract: POIROT is a system that, given a patch for a newly discovered security vulnerability in a web application, helps administrators detect past intrusions that exploited the vulnerability. POIROT records all requests to the server during normal operation, and given a patch, re-executes requests using both patched and unpatched software, and reports to the administrator any request that executes differently in the two cases. A key challenge with this approach is the cost of re-executing all requests, and POIROT introduces several techniques to reduce the time required to audit past requests, including filtering requests based on their control flow and memoization of intermediate results across different requests.A prototype of POIROT for PHP accurately detects attacks on older versions of MediaWiki and HotCRP, given subsequently released patches. POIROT's techniques allow it to audit past requests 12-51\texttimes{} faster than the time it took to originally execute the same requests, for patches to code executed by every request, under a realistic Media-Wiki workload.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: POIROT是一个系统，当给定Web应用程序中新发现安全漏洞的补丁时，它帮助管理员检测过去利用该漏洞的入侵行为。POIROT在正常操作期间记录所有到达服务器的请求，并在给定补丁后，使用修补和未修补的软件重新执行请求，然后向管理员报告在两种情况下执行结果不同的任何请求。该方法的一个关键挑战是重新执行所有请求的成本，POIROT引入了多种技术来减少审计过去请求所需的时间，包括基于控制流过滤请求以及在不同请求之间对中间结果进行记忆化。POIROT的PHP原型能够准确检测旧版本MediaWiki和HotCRP上的攻击，并利用后续发布的补丁。对于每次请求都会执行的代码补丁，在现实的MediaWiki工作负载下，POIROT的技术使其审计过去请求的速度比原始执行相同请求的时间快12-51倍。

import_candidates.title: Experiences from a decade of TinyOS development
import_candidates.abstract: When first written in 2000, TinyOS's users were a handful of academic computer science researchers. A decade later, TinyOS averages 25,000 downloads a year, is in many commercial products, and remains a platform used for a great deal of sensor network, low-power systems, and wireless research.We focus on how technical and social decisions influenced this success, sometimes in surprising ways. As TinyOS matured, it evolved language extensions to help experts write efficient, robust systems. These extensions revealed insights and novel programming abstractions for embedded software. Using these abstractions, experts could build increasingly complex systems more easily than with other operating systems, making TinyOS the dominant choice.This success, however, came at a long-term cost. System design decisions that seem good at first can have unforeseen and undesirable implications that play out over the span of years. Today, TinyOS is a stable, self-contained ecosystem that is discouraging to new users. Other systems, such as Arduino and Contiki, by remaining more accessible, have emerged as better solutions for simpler embedded sensing applications.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 当TinyOS于2000年首次编写时，其用户是少数几位学术计算机科学研究者。十年后，TinyOS平均每年下载量达25,000次，被用于许多商业产品中，并且仍然是大量传感器网络、低功耗系统和无线研究工作所采用的平台。我们重点关注技术和社交决策如何影响这一成功，有时以令人惊讶的方式。随着TinyOS的成熟，它发展出了语言扩展来帮助专家编写高效、健壮的系统。这些扩展揭示了嵌入式软件的新见解和新颖的编程抽象。通过这些抽象，专家们可以比其他操作系统更容易地构建日益复杂的系统，使得TinyOS成为主导选择。然而，这种成功也带来了长期成本。最初看起来很好的系统设计决策可能会产生意想不到的不良影响，并在多年后逐渐显现。如今，TinyOS已成为一个稳定、自足的生态系统，却使新用户望而却步。其他系统（如Arduino和Contiki）由于保持更易用性，已为更简单的嵌入式传感应用提供了更好的解决方案。

import_candidates.title: Automated concurrency-bug fixing
import_candidates.abstract: Concurrency bugs are widespread in multithreaded programs. Fixing them is time-consuming and error-prone. We present CFix, a system that automates the repair of concurrency bugs. CFix works with a wide variety of concurrency-bug detectors. For each failure-inducing interleaving reported by a bug detector, CFix first determines a combination of mutual-exclusion and order relationships that, once enforced, can prevent the buggy interleaving. CFix then uses static analysis and testing to determine where to insert what synchronization operations to force the desired mutual-exclusion and order relationships, with a best effort to avoid deadlocks and excessive performance losses. CFix also simplifies its own patches by merging fixes for related bugs.Evaluation using four different types of bug detectors and thirteen real-world concurrency-bug cases shows that CFix can successfully patch these cases without causing deadlocks or excessive performance degradation. Patches automatically generated by CFix are of similar quality to those manually written by developers.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 并发缺陷在多线程程序中普遍存在。修复它们耗时且容易出错。我们提出了CFix，一个自动化修复并发缺陷的系统。CFix可用于多种并发缺陷检测器。对于由缺陷检测器报告的每个可引发故障的交错，CFix首先确定一组互斥和顺序关系，一旦强制执行即可阻止有问题的交错。然后CFix使用静态分析和测试来确定在哪里插入何种同步操作以强制所需的互斥和顺序关系，并尽最大努力避免死锁和过度性能损失。CFix还通过合并相关缺陷的修复来简化自己的补丁。使用四种不同类型的缺陷检测器和十三个真实世界并发缺陷案例的评估表明，CFix能够成功修补这些案例，且不会导致死锁或过度性能退化。CFix自动生成的补丁与开发人员手动编写的补丁质量相当。

import_candidates.title: All about Eve: execute-verify replication for multi-core servers
import_candidates.abstract: This paper presents Eve, a new Execute-Verify architecture that allows state machine replication to scale to multi-core servers. Eve departs from the traditional agree-execute architecture of state machine replication: replicas first execute groups of requests concurrently and then verify that they can reach agreement on a state and output produced by a correct replica; if they can not, they roll back and execute the requests sequentially. Eve minimizes divergence using application-specific criteria to organize requests into groups of requests that are unlikely to interfere. Our evaluation suggests that Eve's unique ability to combine execution independence with nondetermistic interleaving of requests enables high-performance replication for multi-core servers while tolerating a wide range of faults, including elusive concurrency bugs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了Eve，一种新的执行-验证（Execute-Verify）架构，使状态机复制能够扩展到多核服务器。Eve摒弃了传统状态机复制的“协商-执行”（agree-execute）架构：副本首先并发执行请求组，然后验证它们是否能就正确副本产生的状态和输出达成一致；如果不能，则回滚并串行执行这些请求。Eve利用应用特定标准来组织那些不太可能相互干扰的请求组，从而最小化发散。我们的评估表明，Eve将执行独立性与请求的非确定性交错相结合的独特能力，能够在容忍包括难以捉摸的并发错误在内的广泛故障的同时，实现多核服务器的高性能复制。

import_candidates.title: Spanner: Google's globally-distributed database
import_candidates.abstract: Spanner is Google's scalable, multi-version, globally-distributed, and synchronously-replicated database. It is the first system to distribute data at global scale and support externally-consistent distributed transactions. This paper describes how Spanner is structured, its feature set, the rationale underlying various design decisions, and a novel time API that exposes clock uncertainty. This API and its implementation are critical to supporting external consistency and a variety of powerful features: nonblocking reads in the past, lock-free read-only transactions, and atomic schema changes, across all of Spanner.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Spanner是谷歌的可扩展、多版本、全球分布并且同步复制的数据库。它是第一个在全球化范围内分配数据并支持外部一致性分布式事务的系统。本文描述了Spanner的结构、功能集、各种设计决策背后的理由，以及一个暴露时钟不确定性的新颖时间API。该API及其实现对于支持外部一致性以及一系列强大功能至关重要：跨所有Spanner的过去时间点非阻塞读取、无锁只读事务和原子模式变更。

import_candidates.title: Making geo-replicated systems fast as possible, consistent when necessary
import_candidates.abstract: Online services distribute and replicate state across geographically diverse data centers and direct user requests to the closest or least loaded site. While effectively ensuring low latency responses, this approach is at odds with maintaining cross-site consistency. We make three contributions to address this tension. First, we propose RedBlue consistency, which enables blue operations to be fast (and eventually consistent) while the remaining red operations are strongly consistent (and slow). Second, to make use of fast operation whenever possible and only resort to strong consistency when needed, we identify conditions delineating when operations can be blue and must be red. Third, we introduce a method that increases the space of potential blue operations by breaking them into separate generator and shadow phases. We built a coordination infrastructure called Gemini that offers RedBlue consistency, and we report on our experience modifying the TPC-W and RUBiS benchmarks and an online social network to use Gemini. Our experimental results show that RedBlue consistency provides substantial performance gains without sacrificing consistency.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在线服务将状态分布和复制到地理上分散的数据中心，并将用户请求定向到最近或负载最轻的站点。虽然这有效保证了低延迟响应，但与维持跨站点一致性存在矛盾。我们做出三项贡献来解决这一矛盾。首先，我们提出RedBlue一致性，使蓝色操作得以快速（并最终一致），而其余红色操作则强一致（且缓慢）。其次，为了在可能时尽可能使用快速操作，仅在必要时才诉诸强一致性，我们识别了区分操作何时可以是蓝色、何时必须为红色的条件。第三，我们引入一种方法，通过将蓝色操作分解为独立的生成阶段和影子阶段来扩大潜在蓝色操作的空间。我们构建了一个名为Gemini的协调基础设施，提供RedBlue一致性，并报告了使用Gemini修改TPC-W、RUBiS基准测试和在线社交网络的经验。实验结果表明，RedBlue一致性在不牺牲一致性的前提下提供了显著的性能提升。

import_candidates.title: SymDrive: testing drivers without devices
import_candidates.abstract: Device-driver development and testing is a complex and error-prone undertaking. For example, testing error-handling code requires simulating faulty inputs from the device. A single driver may support dozens of devices, and a developer may not have access to any of them. Consequently, many Linux driver patches include the comment "compile tested only."SymDrive is a system for testing Linux and FreeBSD drivers without their devices present. The system uses symbolic execution to remove the need for hardware, and extends past tools with three new features. First, SymDrive uses static-analysis and source-to-source transformation to greatly reduce the effort of testing a new driver. Second, SymDrive checkers are ordinary C code and execute in the kernel, where they have full access to kernel and driver state. Finally, SymDrive provides an execution-tracing tool to identify how a patch changes I/O to the device and to compare device-driver implementations. In applying SymDrive to 21 Linux drivers and 5 FreeBSD drivers, we found 39 bugs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 设备驱动程序的开发和测试是一项复杂且容易出错的任务。例如，测试错误处理代码需要模拟来自设备的故障输入。一个驱动程序可能支持许多设备，而开发人员可能无法访问其中任何一个。因此，许多Linux驱动程序补丁都包含“仅编译测试”的注释。SymDrive是一个无需设备存在即可测试Linux和FreeBSD驱动程序的系统。该系统使用符号执行来消除对硬件的要求，并通过三个新功能扩展了以前的工具。首先，SymDrive使用静态分析和源代码到源代码的转换来大大减少测试新驱动程序的工作量。其次，SymDrive检查器是普通的C代码，在内核中执行，它们可以完全访问内核和驱动程序状态。最后，SymDrive提供了一个执行跟踪工具，用于识别补丁如何改变对设备的I/O，并比较设备驱动程序的实现。在将SymDrive应用于21个Linux驱动程序和5个FreeBSD驱动程序时，我们发现了39个错误。

import_candidates.title: Be conservative: enhancing failure diagnosis with proactive logging
import_candidates.abstract: When systems fail in the field, logged error or warning messages are frequently the only evidence available for assessing and diagnosing the underlying cause. Consequently, the efficacy of such logging--how often and how well error causes can be determined via postmortem log messages--is a matter of significant practical importance. However, there is little empirical data about how well existing logging practices work and how they can yet be improved. We describe a comprehensive study characterizing the efficacy of logging practices across five large and widely used software systems. Across 250 randomly sampled reported failures, we first identify that more than half of the failures could not be diagnosed well using existing log data. Surprisingly, we find that majority of these unreported failures are manifested via a common set of generic error patterns (e.g., system call return errors) that, if logged, can significantly ease the diagnosis of these unreported failure cases. We further mechanize this knowledge in a tool called Errlog, that proactively adds appropriate logging statements into source code while adding only 1.4\% performance overhead. A controlled user study suggests that Errlog can reduce diagnosis time by 60.7\%.
