import_candidates.abstract_zh: 当系统在现场发生故障时，记录的错误或警告消息往往是评估和诊断根本原因的唯一可用证据。因此，这种日志记录的有效性——通过事后日志消息确定错误原因的频率和准确性——是一个具有重大实际意义的问题。然而，关于现有日志实践的效果如何以及如何改进，缺乏实证数据。我们描述了一项全面的研究，对五个大型且广泛使用的软件系统的日志实践效果进行了表征。在随机抽取的250个故障报告中，我们首先发现超过一半的故障无法通过现有日志数据得到良好诊断。令人惊讶的是，我们发现这些未记录故障中的大多数都通过一组常见的通用错误模式（例如系统调用返回错误）表现出来，如果对这些模式进行记录，可以显著简化这些未记录故障案例的诊断。我们进一步将这一知识机械化到名为Errlog的工具中，该工具会主动在源代码中添加适当的日志语句，同时仅增加1.4%的性能开销。一项受控用户研究表明，Errlog可以将诊断时间减少60.7%。

import_candidates.title: X-ray: automating root-cause diagnosis of performance anomalies in production software
import_candidates.abstract: Troubleshooting the performance of production software is challenging. Most existing tools, such as profiling, tracing, and logging systems, reveal what events occurred during performance anomalies. However, users of such toolsmust infer why these events occurred; e.g., that their execution was due to a root cause such as a specific input request or configuration setting. Such inference often requires source code and detailed application knowledge that is beyond system administrators and end users.This paper introduces performance summarization, a technique for automatically diagnosing the root causes of performance problems. Performance summarization instruments binaries as applications execute. It first attributes performance costs to each basic block. It then uses dynamic information flow tracking to estimate the likelihood that a block was executed due to each potential root cause. Finally, it summarizes the overall cost of each potential root cause by summing the per-block cost multiplied by the cause-specific likelihood over all basic blocks. Performance summarization can also be performed differentially to explain performance differences between two similar activities. X-ray is a tool that implements performance summarization. Our results show that X-ray accurately diagnoses 17 performance issues in Apache, lighttpd, Postfix, and PostgreSQL, while adding 2.3\% average runtime overhead.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 对生产软件的性能进行故障排查具有挑战性。大多数现有工具（如性能分析、跟踪和日志系统）揭示了性能异常期间发生了哪些事件。然而，这些工具的用户必须推断为什么发生这些事件；例如，它们的执行是否由特定输入请求或配置设置等根本原因导致。这种推断通常需要源代码和详细的应用知识，超出了系统管理员和最终用户的能力范围。本文介绍了性能摘要（performance summarization）技术，一种自动诊断性能问题根本原因的方法。性能摘要在应用程序执行时对二进制文件进行插桩。它首先将性能成本归因于每个基本块；然后使用动态信息流跟踪来估计因每个潜在根本原因而执行某个块的可能性；最后，通过将所有基本块上每块成本乘以特定于原因的可能性求和，来总结每个潜在根本原因的总体成本。性能摘要还可用于差分分析，以解释两个相似活动之间的性能差异。X-ray是实现性能摘要的工具。我们的结果表明，X-ray准确诊断了Apache、lighttpd、Postfix和PostgreSQL中的17个性能问题，同时平均运行时开销仅为2.3%。

import_candidates.title: Pasture: secure offline data access using commodity trusted hardware
import_candidates.abstract: This paper presents Pasture, a secure messaging and logging library that enables rich mobile experiences by providing secure offline data access. Without trusting users, applications, operating systems, or hypervisors, Pasture leverages commodity trusted hardware to provide two important safety properties: access-undeniability (a user cannot deny any offline data access obtained by his device without failing an audit) and verifiable-revocation (a user who generates a verifiable proof of revocation of unaccessed data can never access that data in the future).For practical viability, Pasture moves costly trusted hardware operations from common data access actions to uncommon recovery and checkpoint actions. We used Pasture to augment three applications with secure offline data access to provide high availability, rich functionality, and improved consistency. Our evaluation suggests that Pasture overheads are acceptable for these applications.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了Pasture，一个安全的消息传递和日志库，可通过安全的离线数据访问提供丰富的移动体验。在不信任用户、应用程序、操作系统或虚拟机监控器的前提下，Pasture利用商用可信硬件提供两个重要的安全属性：访问不可抵赖性（用户无法否认其设备获得任何离线数据访问而不导致审计失败）和可验证撤销（生成未访问数据撤销的可验证证明的用户，将来永远无法访问该数据）。为了实际可行性，Pasture将昂贵的可信硬件操作从常见的数据访问操作转移到罕见的恢复和检查点操作。我们用Pasture增强了三个应用程序，提供安全的离线数据访问，以实现高可用性、丰富功能和改进的一致性。我们的评估表明，对于这些应用，Pasture的开销是可接受的。

import_candidates.title: Dune: safe user-level access to privileged CPU features
import_candidates.abstract: Dune is a system that provides applications with direct but safe access to hardware features such as ring protection, page tables, and tagged TLBs, while preserving the existing OS interfaces for processes. Dune uses the virtualization hardware in modern processors to provide a process, rather than a machine abstraction. It consists of a small kernel module that initializes virtualization hardware and mediates interactions with the kernel, and a user-level library that helps applications manage privileged hardware features. We present the implementation of Dune for 64- bit x86 Linux. We use Dune to implement three user-level applications that can benefit from access to privileged hardware: a sandbox for untrusted code, a privilege separation facility, and a garbage collector. The use of Dune greatly simplifies the implementation of these applications and provides significant performance advantages.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Dune是一个系统，它允许应用程序直接但安全地访问硬件功能，如环保护、页表和带标签的TLB，同时保留现有的操作系统进程接口。Dune利用现代处理器中的虚拟化硬件来提供进程而非机器的抽象。它由一个初始化虚拟化硬件并协调与内核交互的小型内核模块，以及一个帮助应用程序管理特权硬件功能的用户级库组成。我们展示了Dune在64位x86 Linux上的实现。我们使用Dune实现了三个可以从访问特权硬件中受益的用户级应用程序：用于不可信代码的沙箱、权限分离设施和垃圾收集器。Dune的使用大大简化了这些应用的实现，并提供了显著的性能优势。

import_candidates.title: Performance isolation and fairness for multi-tenant cloud storage
import_candidates.abstract: Shared storage services enjoy wide adoption in commercial clouds. But most systems today provide weak performance isolation and fairness between tenants, if at all. Misbehaving or high-demand tenants can overload the shared service and disrupt other well-behaved tenants, leading to unpredictable performance and violating SLAs.This paper presents Pisces, a system for achieving datacenter-wide per-tenant performance isolation and fairness in shared key-value storage. Today's approaches for multi-tenant resource allocation are based either on per-VM allocations or hard rate limits that assume uniform workloads to achieve high utilization. Pisces achieves per-tenant weighted fair shares (or minimal rates) of the aggregate resources of the shared service, even when different tenants' partitions are co-located and when demand for different partitions is skewed, time-varying, or bottlenecked by different server resources. Pisces does so by decomposing the fair sharing problem into a combination of four complementary mechanisms--partition placement, weight allocation, replica selection, and weighted fair queuing--that operate on different time-scales and combine to provide system-wide max-min fairness.An evaluation of our Pisces storage prototype achieves nearly ideal (0.99 Min-Max Ratio) weighted fair sharing, strong performance isolation, and robustness to skew and shifts in tenant demand. These properties are achieved with minimal overhead (<3\%), even when running at high utilization (more than 400,000 requests/second/server for 10B requests).
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 共享存储服务在商业云中被广泛采用。然而，当前大多数系统即使有，也仅能提供租户间较弱的性能隔离和公平性。行为不当或高需求的租户可能使共享服务过载，干扰其他良性租户，导致不可预测的性能并违反SLA。本文介绍了Pisces，一个在共享键值存储中实现数据中心级每租户性能隔离和公平性的系统。当前的多租户资源分配方法要么基于每VM分配，要么基于硬性速率限制，后一种假设负载均匀以实现高利用率。Pisces即使在不同租户的分区共存且不同分区的需求倾斜、随时间变化或受不同服务器资源限制时，也能实现每租户对共享服务聚合资源的加权公平份额（或最小速率）。Pisces通过将公平共享问题分解为四种互补机制——分区放置、权重分配、副本选择和加权公平排队，这些机制在不同时间尺度上运行并相互结合，以提供系统级最大最小公平性。我们Pisces存储原型的评估显示几乎理想的（0.99最小-最大比）加权公平共享、强性能隔离以及对租户需求倾斜和变化的鲁棒性。即使在高利用率（每服务器每秒10B请求超过40万）下运行，这些特性也以极低开销（<3%）实现。

import_candidates.title: Arrakis: the operating system is the control plane
import_candidates.abstract: Recent device hardware trends enable a new approach to the design of network server operating systems. In a traditional operating system, the kernel mediates access to device hardware by server applications, to enforce process isolation as well as network and disk security. We have designed and implemented a new operating system, Arrakis, that splits the traditional role of the kernel in two. Applications have direct access to virtualized I/O devices, allowing most I/O operations to skip the kernel entirely, while the kernel is re-engineered to provide network and disk protection without kernel mediation of every operation. We describe the hardware and software changes needed to take advantage of this new abstraction, and we illustrate its power by showing improvements of 2-5x in latency and 9x in throughput for a popular persistent NoSQL store relative to a well-tuned Linux implementation.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 近期的设备硬件趋势为设计网络服务器操作系统提供了新思路。在传统操作系统中，内核为了实施进程隔离以及网络和磁盘安全，会调解服务器应用对设备硬件的访问。我们设计并实现了一个名为Arrakis的新操作系统，它将内核的传统角色一分为二。应用程序可直接访问虚拟化I/O设备，使大多数I/O操作完全绕过内核，同时重新设计内核，使其无需调解每次操作即可提供网络和磁盘保护。我们阐述了利用这一新的抽象所需的硬件和软件改动，并展示了一个流行的持久化NoSQL存储与精心调优的Linux实现相比，其延迟降低了2-5倍，吞吐量提升了9倍，证明了该方案的能力。

import_candidates.title: Decoupling cores, kernels, and operating systems
import_candidates.abstract: We present Barrelfish/DC, an extension to the Barrelfish OS which decouples physical cores from a native OS kernel, and furthermore the kernel itself from the rest of the OS and application state. In Barrelfish/DC, native kernel code on any core can be quickly replaced, kernel state moved between cores, and cores added and removed from the system transparently to applications and OS processes, which continue to execute.Barrelfish/DC is a multikernel with two novel ideas: the use of boot drivers to abstract cores as regular devices, and a partitioned capability system for memory management which externalizes core-local kernel state.We show by performance measurements of real applications and device drivers that the approach is practical enough to be used for a number of purposes, such as online kernel upgrades, and temporarily delivering hard real-time performance by executing a process under a specialized, single-application kernel.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了Barrelfish/DC，这是对Barrelfish OS的扩展，它将物理核心与本地OS内核解耦，并将内核本身与操作系统的其余部分和应用程序状态解耦。在Barrelfish/DC中，任何核心上的原生内核代码都可以快速替换，内核状态可以在核心之间移动，并且可以透明地将核心添加到系统中或从系统中移除，而应用程序和操作系统进程可继续执行。Barrelfish/DC是一个多内核系统，包含两个新颖的想法：使用引导驱动程序将核心抽象为常规设备，以及使用用于内存管理的分区能力系统，该系统将核心本地内核状态外部化。我们通过真实应用程序和设备驱动程序的性能测量表明，该方法足够实用，可用于在线内核升级等目的，也可通过在专用的单应用程序内核下执行进程来临时提供硬实时性能。

import_candidates.title: Jitk: a trustworthy in-kernel interpreter infrastructure
import_candidates.abstract: Modern operating systems run multiple interpreters in the kernel, which enable user-space applications to add new functionality or specialize system policies. The correctness of such interpreters is critical to the overall system security: bugs in interpreters could allow adversaries to compromise user-space applications and even the kernel.Jitk is a new infrastructure for building in-kernel interpreters that guarantee functional correctness as they compile user-space policies down to native instructions for execution in the kernel. To demonstrate Jitk, we implement two interpreters in the Linux kernel, BPF and INET-DIAG, which are used for network and system call filtering and socket monitoring, respectively. To help application developers write correct filters, we introduce a high-level rule language, along with a proof that Jitk correctly translates high-level rules all the way to native machine code, and demonstrate that this language can be integrated into OpenSSH with tens of lines of code. We built a prototype of Jitk on top of the CompCert verified compiler and integrated it into the Linux kernel. Experimental results show that Jitk is practical, fast, and trustworthy.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代操作系统在内核中运行多个解释器，使用户空间应用能够添加新功能或定制系统策略。这些解释器的正确性对整体系统安全至关重要：解释器中的漏洞可能使攻击者危及用户空间应用甚至内核。Jitk是一种新的基础设施，用于构建内核解释器，在将用户空间策略编译为内核中执行的原生指令时，能够保证功能正确性。为演示Jitk，我们在Linux内核中实现了两个解释器：BPF和INET-DIAG，它们分别用于网络与系统调用过滤以及套接字监控。为帮助应用开发者编写正确的过滤器，我们引入了一种高级规则语言，并证明了Jitk能将高级规则一路正确翻译为原生机器代码，同时展示了该语言只需数十行代码即可集成到OpenSSH中。我们在已验证编译器CompCert之上构建了Jitk原型，并集成到Linux内核中。实验结果表明，Jitk实用、快速且可信。

import_candidates.title: IX: a protected dataplane operating system for high throughput and low latency
import_candidates.abstract: The conventional wisdom is that aggressive networking requirements, such as high packet rates for small messages and microsecond-scale tail latency, are best addressed outside the kernel, in a user-level networking stack. We present IX, a dataplane operating system that provides high I/O performance, while maintaining the key advantage of strong protection offered by existing kernels. IX uses hardware virtualization to separate management and scheduling functions of the kernel (control plane) from network processing (dataplane). The data-plane architecture builds upon a native, zero-copy API and optimizes for both bandwidth and latency by dedicating hardware threads and networking queues to data-plane instances, processing bounded batches of packets to completion, and by eliminating coherence traffic and multi-core synchronization. We demonstrate that IX outperforms Linux and state-of-the-art, user-space network stacks significantly in both throughput and end-to-end latency. Moreover, IX improves the throughput of a widely deployed, key-value store by up to 3.6x and reduces tail latency by more than 2x.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 传统观点认为，对于激进式网络需求，如小消息的高数据包速率和微秒级尾部延迟，最好在内核之外通过用户级网络栈来处理。我们提出了IX，一种数据平面操作系统，它在提供高I/O性能的同时，维持了现有内核所提供的强保护这一关键优势。IX利用硬件虚拟化将内核的管理和调度功能（控制平面）与网络处理（数据平面）分离。数据平面架构建立在原生的零拷贝API之上，并通过将硬件线程和网络队列专用于数据平面实例、处理有界批量的数据包直至完成，以及消除一致性流量和多核同步来同时优化带宽和延迟。我们证明，IX在吞吐量和端到端延迟方面均显著优于Linux和最新的用户态网络栈。此外，IX将广泛部署的键值存储的吞吐量提高了最多3.6倍，并将尾部延迟降低了超过2倍。

import_candidates.title: Willow: a user-programmable SSD
import_candidates.abstract: We explore the potential of making programmability a central feature of the SSD interface. Our prototype system, called Willow, allows programmers to augment and extend the semantics of an SSD with application-specific features without compromising file system protections. The SSD Apps running on Willow give applications low-latency, high-bandwidth access to the SSD's contents while reducing the load that IO processing places on the host processor. The programming model for SSD Apps provides great flexibility, supports the concurrent execution of multiple SSD Apps in Willow, and supports the execution of trusted code in Willow.We demonstrate the effectiveness and flexibility of Willow by implementing six SSD Apps and measuring their performance. We find that defining SSD semantics in software is easy and beneficial, and that Willow makes it feasible for a wide range of IO-intensive applications to benefit from a customized SSD interface.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们探索使可编程性成为SSD接口核心特性的潜力。我们的原型系统名为Willow，允许程序员用应用特定的功能来增强和扩展SSD的语义，同时不损害文件系统的保护。在Willow上运行的SSD应用程序使应用能够以低延迟、高带宽访问SSD的内容，同时减少IO处理给主机处理器带来的负载。SSD应用程序的编程模型提供了极大的灵活性，支持多个SSD应用程序在Willow中并发执行，并支持在Willow中执行可信代码。我们通过实现六个SSD应用程序并测量其性能，证明了Willow的有效性和灵活性。我们发现用软件定义SSD语义既容易又有利，且Willow使得广泛的IO密集型应用能够受益于定制化的SSD接口。

import_candidates.title: Physical disentanglement in a container-based file system
import_candidates.abstract: We introduce IceFS, a novel file system that separates physical structures of the file system. A new abstraction, the cube, is provided to enable the grouping of files and directories inside a physically isolated container. We show three major benefits of cubes within IceFS: localized reaction to faults, fast recovery, and concurrent file-system updates. We demonstrate these benefits within a VMware-based virtualized environment and within the Hadoop distributed file system. Results show that our prototype can significantly improve availability and performance, sometimes by an order of magnitude.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们引入了IceFS，一种新颖的文件系统，它将文件系统的物理结构分离。提供了一种新的抽象——cube，使得文件和目录能够被分组到一个物理隔离的容器中。我们展示了IceFS中cube的三个主要好处：对故障的局部化响应、快速恢复以及并发的文件系统更新。我们在基于VMware的虚拟化环境和Hadoop分布式文件系统中演示了这些好处。结果表明，我们的原型可以显著提高可用性和性能，有时甚至提高一个数量级。

import_candidates.title: Customizable and extensible deployment for mobile/cloud applications
import_candidates.abstract: Modern applications face new challenges in managing today's highly distributed and heterogeneous environment. For example, they must stitch together code that crosses smartphones, tablets, personal devices, and cloud services, connected by variable wide-area networks, such as WiFi and 4G. This paper describes Sapphire, a distributed programming platform that simplifies the programming of today's mobile/cloud applications. Sapphire's key design feature is its distributed runtime system, which supports a flexible and extensible deployment layer for solving complex distributed systems tasks, such as fault-tolerance, code-offloading, and caching. Rather than writing distributed systems code, programmers choose deployment managers that extend Sapphire's kernel to meet their applications' deployment requirements. In this way, each application runs on an underlying platform that is customized for its own distribution needs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代应用在管理当今高度分布和异构环境时面临新的挑战。例如，它们必须将跨越智能手机、平板电脑、个人设备和云服务的代码连接起来，这些设备由可变广域网（如WiFi和4G）连接。本文描述了Sapphire，一个分布式编程平台，简化了当今移动/云应用的编程。Sapphire的关键设计特点是其分布式运行时系统，该系统支持灵活可扩展的部署层，以解决复杂的分布式系统任务，如容错、代码卸载和缓存。程序员不是编写分布式系统代码，而是选择扩展Sapphire内核的部署管理器，以满足其应用的部署需求。通过这种方式，每个应用都运行在为其特定分布需求定制的底层平台上。

import_candidates.title: Pebbles: fine-grained data management abstractions for modern operating systems
import_candidates.abstract: Support for fine-grained data management has all but disappeared from modern operating systems such as Android and iOS. Instead, we must rely on each individual application to manage our data properly - e.g., to delete our emails, documents, and photos in full upon request; to not collect more data than required for its function; and to back up our data to reliable backends. Yet, research studies and media articles constantly remind us of the poor data management practices applied by our applications. We have developed Pebbles, a fine-grained data management system that enables management at a powerful new level of abstraction: application-level data objects, such as emails, documents, notes, notebooks, bank accounts, etc. The key contribution is Pebbles's ability to discover such high-level objects in arbitrary applications without requiring any input from or modifications to these applications. Intuitively, it seems impossible for an OS-level service to understand object structures in unmodified applications, however we observe that the high-level storage abstractions embedded in modern OSes - relational databases and object-relational mappers - bear significant structural information that makes object recognition possible and accurate.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在Android和iOS等现代操作系统中，对细粒度数据管理的支持几乎已经消失。相反，我们必须依赖每个单独的应用程序来妥善管理我们的数据——例如，按要求完整删除我们的电子邮件、文档和照片；不收集超出其功能所需的数据；以及将我们的数据备份到可靠的后端。然而，研究文章和媒体报道不断提醒我们应用程序所采用的不良数据管理实践。我们开发了Pebbles，一种细粒度数据管理系统，能够在强大的新抽象层实现管理：应用级数据对象，如电子邮件、文档、笔记、笔记本、银行账户等。关键贡献在于Pebbles能够识别任意应用程序中的这些高级对象，而无需这些应用程序的任何输入或修改。直观上，操作系统级服务似乎不可能理解未修改应用程序中的对象结构，然而我们观察到，内置于现代操作系统中的高级存储抽象——关系数据库和对象关系映射器——承载了重要的结构信息，使得对象识别变得可能且准确。

import_candidates.title: Protecting users by confining JavaScript with COWL
import_candidates.abstract: Modern web applications are conglomerations of JavaScript written by multiple authors: application developers routinely incorporate code from third-party libraries, and mashup applications synthesize data and code hosted at different sites. In current browsers, a web application's developer and user must trust third-party code in libraries not to leak the user's sensitive information from within applications. Even worse, in the status quo, the only way to implement some mashups is for the user to give her login credentials for one site to the operator of another site. Fundamentally, today's browser security model trades privacy for flexibility because it lacks a sufficient mechanism for confining untrusted code. We present COWL, a robust JavaScript confinement system for modern web browsers. COWL introduces label-based mandatory access control to browsing contexts in a way that is fully backward-compatible with legacy web content. We use a series of case-study applications to motivate COWL's design and demonstrate how COWL allows both the inclusion of untrusted scripts in applications and the building of mashups that combine sensitive information from multiple mutually distrusting origins, all while protecting users' privacy. Measurements of two COWL implementations, one in Firefox and one in Chromium, demonstrate a virtually imperceptible increase in page-load latency.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代 Web 应用程序是由多位作者编写的 JavaScript 的聚合体：应用开发者通常整合第三方库的代码，而混搭应用则综合了来自不同站点托管的数据和代码。在当前的浏览器中，Web 应用程序的开发者和用户必须信任库中的第三方代码不会在应用内部泄露用户的敏感信息。更糟糕的是，在现状下，实现某些混搭应用的唯一方式是让用户将其在一个网站的登录凭据提供给另一个网站的运营者。从根本上说，当今的浏览器安全模型用隐私换取灵活性，因为它缺少一种足够的机制来限制不可信代码。我们提出了 COWL，一种面向现代 Web 浏览器的健壮 JavaScript 限制系统。COWL 以与旧版 Web 内容完全向后兼容的方式，将基于标签的强制访问控制引入到浏览上下文中。我们通过一系列案例研究应用来激励 COWL 的设计，并演示 COWL 如何既允许在应用中包含不可信的脚本，又如何构建结合来自多个互不信任来源的敏感信息的混搭应用，同时全程保护用户的隐私。对两个 COWL 实现（一个在 Firefox 中，一个在 Chromium 中）的测量表明，页面加载延迟的增加几乎不可感知。

import_candidates.title: Code-pointer integrity
import_candidates.abstract: Systems code is often written in low-level languages like C/C++, which offer many benefits but also delegate memory management to programmers. This invites memory safety bugs that attackers can exploit to divert control flow and compromise the system. Deployed defense mechanisms (e.g., ASLR, DEP) are incomplete, and stronger defense mechanisms (e.g., CFI) often have high overhead and limited guarantees [19, 15, 9].We introduce code-pointer integrity (CPI), a new design point that guarantees the integrity of all code pointers in a program (e.g., function pointers, saved return addresses) and thereby prevents all control-flow hijack attacks, including return-oriented programming. We also introduce code-pointer separation (CPS), a relaxation of CPI with better performance properties. CPI and CPS offer substantially better security-to-overhead ratios than the state of the art, they are practical (we protect a complete FreeBSD system and over 100 packages like apache and postgresql), effective (prevent all attacks in the RIPE benchmark), and efficient: on SPEC CPU2006, CPS averages 1.2\% overhead for C and 1.9\% for C/C++, while CPI's overhead is 2.9\% for C and 8.4\% for C/C++.A prototype implementation of CPI and CPS can be obtained from http://levee.epfl.ch.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 系统代码通常使用C/C++等低级语言编写，这些语言带来许多好处，但也将内存管理托付给程序员。这导致内存安全漏洞，攻击者可利用这些漏洞转移控制流并危害系统。已部署的防御机制（如ASLR、DEP）不完整，而更强的防御机制（如CFI）通常具有高开销和有限的保证[19, 15, 9]。我们引入了代码指针完整性（CPI），这是一种新的设计点，保证程序中所有代码指针（例如函数指针、保存的返回地址）的完整性，从而防止所有控制流劫持攻击，包括面向返回编程。我们还引入了代码指针分离（CPS），它是CPI的一种松弛变体，具有更好的性能特性。CPI和CPS提供比现有技术更好的安全-开销比，它们是实用的（我们保护了完整的FreeBSD系统和超过100个软件包，如apache和postgresql）、有效的（阻止了RIPE基准测试中的所有攻击），并且高效：在SPEC CPU2006上，CPS对C的平均开销为1.2%，对C/C++为1.9%，而CPI的开销对C为2.9%，对C/C++为8.4%。CPI和CPS的原型实现可从http://levee.epfl.ch获取。

import_candidates.title: Ironclad apps: end-to-end security via automated full-system verification
import_candidates.abstract: An Ironclad App lets a user securely transmit her data to a remote machine with the guarantee that every instruction executed on that machine adheres to a formal abstract specification of the app's behavior. This does more than eliminate implementation vulnerabilities such as buffer overflows, parsing errors, or data leaks; it tells the user exactly how the app will behave at all times. We provide these guarantees via complete, low-level software verification. We then use cryptography and secure hardware to enable secure channels from the verified software to remote users. To achieve such complete verification, we developed a set of new and modified tools, a collection of techniques and engineering disciplines, and a methodology focused on rapid development of verified systems software. We describe our methodology, formal results, and lessons we learned from building a full stack of verified software. That software includes a verified kernel; verified drivers; verified system and crypto libraries including SHA, HMAC, and RSA; and four Ironclad Apps.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Ironclad应用允许用户安全地将数据传输到远程机器，并保证该机器上执行的每条指令都符合应用行为的正式抽象规范。这不仅仅是消除诸如缓冲区溢出、解析错误或数据泄露等实现漏洞；它还能随时准确地告知用户应用将如何表现。我们通过完整的底层软件验证来提供这些保证。然后，我们利用密码学和安全硬件，实现从经过验证的软件到远程用户的安全通道。为了实现这种完整的验证，我们开发了一套新的和修改过的工具、一系列技术和工程纪律，以及一种专注于快速开发经过验证的系统软件的方法。我们描述了我们的方法、形式化结果以及从构建完整栈经过验证的软件中学到的经验。该软件包括一个经过验证的内核；经过验证的驱动程序；经过验证的系统库和密码库，包括SHA、HMAC和RSA；以及四个Ironclad应用。

import_candidates.title: SHILL: a secure shell scripting language
import_candidates.abstract: The Principle of Least Privilege suggests that software should be executed with no more authority than it requires to accomplish its task. Current security tools make it difficult to apply this principle: they either require significant modifications to applications or do not facilitate reasoning about combining untrustworthy components.We propose SHILL, a secure shell scripting language. SHILL scripts enable compositional reasoning about security through contracts that limit the effects of script execution, including the effects of programs invoked by the script. SHILL contracts are declarative security policies that act as documentation for consumers of SHILL scripts, and are enforced through a combination of language design and sandboxing.We have implemented a prototype of SHILL for FreeBSD and used it for several case studies including a grading script and a script to download, compile, and install software. Our experience indicates that SHILL is a practical and useful system security tool, and can provide fine-grained security guarantees.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 最小权限原则建议，软件应以完成其任务所需的权限来执行，而不应拥有更多权限。当前的安全工具难以应用这一原则：它们要么需要对应用程序进行重大修改，要么不便于对组合不可信组件的安全性进行推理。我们提出了SHILL，一种安全的Shell脚本语言。SHILL脚本通过契约实现组合式安全推理，契约限制了脚本执行的影响，包括脚本所调用程序的影响。SHILL契约是声明性安全策略，作为SHILL脚本使用者的文档，并通过语言设计与沙箱相结合来强制执行。我们为FreeBSD实现了SHILL原型，并将其用于多个案例研究，包括一个评分脚本和一个用于下载、编译及安装软件的脚本。我们的经验表明，SHILL是一种实用且有用的系统安全工具，能够提供细粒度的安全保证。

import_candidates.title: GPUnet: networking abstractions for GPU programs
import_candidates.abstract: Despite the popularity of GPUs in high-performance and scientific computing, and despite increasingly general-purpose hardware capabilities, the use of GPUs in network servers or distributed systems poses significant challenges.GPUnet is a native GPU networking layer that provides a socket abstraction and high-level networking APIs for GPU programs. We use GPUnet to streamline the development of high-performance, distributed applications like in-GPU-memory MapReduce and a new class of low-latency, high-throughput GPU-native network services such as a face verification server.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 尽管GPU在高性能和科学计算中广受欢迎，并且硬件能力日益通用化，但在网络服务器或分布式系统中使用GPU仍面临显著挑战。GPUnet是一个原生GPU网络层，为GPU程序提供套接字抽象和高层网络API。我们使用GPUnet来简化高性能分布式应用（如图内GPU内存MapReduce）以及新型低延迟、高吞吐量的GPU原生网络服务（如人脸验证服务器）的开发。

import_candidates.title: The mystery machine: end-to-end performance analysis of large-scale internet services
import_candidates.abstract: Current debugging and optimization methods scale poorly to deal with the complexity of modern Internet services, in which a single request triggers parallel execution of numerous heterogeneous software components over a distributed set of computers. The Achilles' heel of current methods is the need for a complete and accurate model of the system under observation: producing such a model is challenging because it requires either assimilating the collective knowledge of hundreds of programmers responsible for the individual components or restricting the ways in which components interact.Fortunately, the scale of modern Internet services offers a compensating benefit: the sheer volume of requests serviced means that, even at low sampling rates, one can gather a tremendous amount of empirical performance observations and apply "big data" techniques to analyze those observations. In this paper, we show how one can automatically construct a model of request execution from pre-existing component logs by generating a large number of potential hypotheses about program behavior and rejecting hypotheses contradicted by the empirical observations. We also show how one can validate potential performance improvements without costly implementation effort by leveraging the variation in component behavior that arises naturally over large numbers of requests to measure the impact of optimizing individual components or changing scheduling behavior.We validate our methodology by analyzing performance traces of over 1.3 million requests to Facebook servers. We present a detailed study of the factors that affect the end-to-end latency of such requests. We also use our methodology to suggest and validate a scheduling optimization for improving Facebook request latency.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 当前的调试和优化方法难以有效应对现代互联网服务的复杂性，在这种服务中，单个请求会触发在分布式计算机集合上并行执行大量异构软件组件。当前方法的致命弱点是需要对观察到的系统建立完整且准确的模型：生成这样的模型很困难，因为它需要整合负责各个组件的数百名程序员的集体知识，或者限制组件之间的交互方式。幸运的是，现代互联网服务的规模提供了一个补偿性优势：请求服务的数量庞大意味着，即使采样率很低，我们也能收集到大量经验性的性能观察数据，并应用“大数据”技术来分析这些观察结果。在本文中，我们展示了如何通过预先存在的组件日志自动构建请求执行的模型，方法是生成大量关于程序行为的潜在假设，并拒绝与经验观察相矛盾的假设。我们还展示了如何通过利用大量请求中自然出现的组件行为变化来测量优化单个组件或更改调度行为的影响，从而无需昂贵的实现工作即可验证潜在的性能改进。我们通过分析Facebook服务器上超过130万个请求的性能轨迹来验证我们的方法。我们详细研究了影响此类请求端到端延迟的因素。我们还使用我们的方法提出并验证了一项改善Facebook请求延迟的调度优化。

import_candidates.title: End-to-end performance isolation through virtual datacenters
import_candidates.abstract: The lack of performance isolation in multi-tenant datacenters at appliances like middleboxes and storage servers results in volatile application performance. To insulate tenants, we propose giving them the abstraction of a dedicated virtual datacenter (VDC). VDCs encapsulate end-to-end throughput guarantees--specified in a new metric based on virtual request cost--that hold across distributed appliances and the intervening network.We present Pulsar, a system that offers tenants their own VDCs. Pulsar comprises a logically centralized controller that uses new mechanisms to estimate tenants' demands and appliance capacities, and allocates datacenter resources based on flexible policies. These allocations are enforced at end-host hypervisors through multi-resource token buckets that ensure tenants with changing workloads cannot affect others. Pulsar's design does not require changes to applications, guest OSes, or appliances. Through a prototype deployed across 113 VMs, three appliances, and a 40 Gbps network, we show that Pulsar enforces tenants' VDCs while imposing overheads of less than 2\% at the data and control plane.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 多租户数据中心中诸如中间盒和存储服务器等设备缺乏性能隔离，导致应用程序性能波动。为了隔离租户，我们提出赋予他们专用虚拟数据中心（VDC）的抽象。VDC封装了端到端吞吐量保证——以基于虚拟请求成本的新指标指定——这些保证在分布式设备和中间网络上均成立。我们提出了Pulsar系统，为租户提供他们自己的VDC。Pulsar包含一个逻辑集中的控制器，该控制器使用新机制来估算租户需求和设备容量，并基于灵活策略分配数据中心资源。这些分配在端主机虚拟机监控器中通过多资源令牌桶强制执行，确保工作负载变化的租户不能影响其他租户。Pulsar的设计不需要更改应用程序、客户机操作系统或设备。通过在113台虚拟机、三个设备和一个40 Gbps网络上部署的原型，我们展示了Pulsar能强制实施租户的VDC，同时在数据平面和控制平面上的开销低于2%。

import_candidates.title: Simple testing can prevent most critical failures: an analysis of production failures in distributed data-intensive systems
import_candidates.abstract: Large, production quality distributed systems still fail periodically, and do so sometimes catastrophically, where most or all users experience an outage or data loss. We present the result of a comprehensive study investigating 198 randomly selected, user-reported failures that occurred on Cassandra, HBase, Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS), Hadoop MapReduce, and Redis, with the goal of understanding how one or multiple faults eventually evolve into a user-visible failure. We found that from a testing point of view, almost all failures require only 3 or fewer nodes to reproduce, which is good news considering that these services typically run on a very large number of nodes. However, multiple inputs are needed to trigger the failures with the order between them being important. Finally, we found the error logs of these systems typically contain sufficient data on both the errors and the input events that triggered the failure, enabling the diagnose and the reproduction of the production failures.We found the majority of catastrophic failures could easily have been prevented by performing simple testing on error handling code - the last line of defense - even without an understanding of the software design. We extracted three simple rules from the bugs that have lead to some of the catastrophic failures, and developed a static checker, Aspirator, capable of locating these bugs. Over 30\% of the catastrophic failures would have been prevented had Aspirator been used and the identified bugs fixed. Running Aspirator on the code of 9 distributed systems located 143 bugs and bad practices that have been fixed or confirmed by the developers.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大型生产级分布式系统仍然会定期发生故障，有时甚至是灾难性的故障，导致大多数或所有用户遭遇中断或数据丢失。我们展示了一项综合研究的结果，调查了198个随机选取的用户报告的、发生在Cassandra、HBase、Hadoop分布式文件系统（HDFS）、Hadoop MapReduce和Redis上的故障，目的是理解一个或多个缺陷最终如何演变为用户可见的故障。我们发现，从测试的角度来看，几乎所有故障只需要3个或更少的节点即可重现，考虑到这些服务通常在非常多的节点上运行，这是个好消息。然而，触发故障需要多个输入，且输入之间的顺序很重要。最后，我们发现这些系统的错误日志通常包含关于错误和触发故障的输入事件的充分数据，从而能够诊断和重现生产故障。我们发现，大多数灾难性故障只要对错误处理代码——最后一道防线——进行简单测试就能轻易预防，即使不了解软件设计也是如此。我们从导致一些灾难性故障的缺陷中提取了三条简单规则，并开发了一个静态检查器Aspirator，能够定位这些缺陷。如果使用了Aspirator并修复了已识别的缺陷，超过30%的灾难性故障本可避免。在9个分布式系统的代码上运行Aspirator，定位了143个已被开发者修复或确认的缺陷和不良实践。

import_candidates.title: Shielding applications from an untrusted cloud with Haven
import_candidates.abstract: Today's cloud computing infrastructure requires substantial trust. Cloud users rely on both the provider's staff and its globally-distributed software/hardware platform not to expose any of their private data.We introduce the notion of shielded execution, which protects the confidentiality and integrity of a program and its data from the platform on which it runs (i.e., the cloud operator's OS, VM and firmware). Our prototype, Haven, is the first system to achieve shielded execution of unmodified legacy applications, including SQL Server and Apache, on a commodity OS (Windows) and commodity hardware. Haven leverages the hardware protection of Intel SGX to defend against privileged code and physical attacks such as memory probes, but also addresses the dual challenges of executing unmodified legacy binaries and protecting them from a malicious host. This work motivated recent changes in the SGX specification.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 当今的云计算基础设施需要大量的信任。云用户依赖提供商的工作人员以及其全球分布的软件/硬件平台，以免暴露其任何私有数据。我们引入了屏蔽执行（shielded execution）的概念，该概念保护程序及其数据的机密性和完整性，免受运行该程序的平台（即云运营商的OS、VM和固件）的侵害。我们的原型Haven是第一个在商用操作系统（Windows）和商用硬件上实现对未修改的遗留应用程序（包括SQL Server和Apache）的屏蔽执行的系统。Haven利用Intel SGX的硬件保护来防御特权代码和物理攻击（如内存探测），同时还解决了执行未修改的遗留二进制文件以及保护其免受恶意主机侵害的双重挑战。这项工作推动了SGX规范最近的变更。

import_candidates.title: Apollo: scalable and coordinated scheduling for cloud-scale computing
import_candidates.abstract: Efficiently scheduling data-parallel computation jobs over cloud-scale computing clusters is critical for job performance, system throughput, and resource utilization. It is becoming even more challenging with growing cluster sizes and more complex workloads with diverse characteristics. This paper presents Apollo, a highly scalable and coordinated scheduling framework, which has been deployed on production clusters at Microsoft to schedule thousands of computations with millions of tasks efficiently and effectively on tens of thousands of machines daily. The framework performs scheduling decisions in a distributed manner, utilizing global cluster information via a loosely coordinated mechanism. Each scheduling decision considers future resource availability and optimizes various performance and system factors together in a single unified model. Apollo is robust, with means to cope with unexpected system dynamics, and can take advantage of idle system resources gracefully while supplying guaranteed resources when needed.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在云规模计算集群上高效调度数据并行计算作业，对于作业性能、系统吞吐量和资源利用率至关重要。随着集群规模的增长以及具有不同特征的工作负载日益复杂，这一挑战变得更加严峻。本文介绍了Apollo，一个高度可扩展且协调的调度框架，已在微软的生产集群上部署，用于每天在数万台机器上高效地调度数千个包含数百万个任务的计算。该框架以分布式方式进行调度决策，通过松散协调机制利用全局集群信息。每个调度决策都考虑未来的资源可用性，并在统一的模型中共同优化各种性能和系统因素。Apollo是健壮的，能够应对意外的系统动态，并在需要时优雅地利用空闲系统资源，同时提供有保证的资源。

import_candidates.title: The power of choice in data-aware cluster scheduling
import_candidates.abstract: Providing timely results in the face of rapid growth in data volumes has become important for analytical frameworks. For this reason, frameworks increasingly operate on only a subset of the input data. A key property of such sampling is that combinatorially many subsets of the input are present. We present KMN, a system that leverages these choices to perform data-aware scheduling, i.e., minimize time taken by tasks to read their inputs, for a DAG of tasks. KMN not only uses choices to co-locate tasks with their data but also percolates such combinatorial choices to downstream tasks in the DAG by launching a few additional tasks at every upstream stage. Evaluations using workloads from Facebook and Conviva on a 100-machine EC2 cluster show that KMN reduces average job duration by 81\% using just 5\% additional resources.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 面对数据量的快速增长，及时提供结果对分析框架已变得重要。因此，框架越来越多地只处理输入数据的子集。这种采样有一个关键特性：输入存在组合数量的子集。我们提出KMN，一个利用这些选择进行数据感知调度的系统，即为任务DAG最小化任务读取输入的时间。KMN不仅利用选择将任务与其数据共同放置，还通过在每个上游阶段启动少量额外任务，将这种组合选择渗透到DAG中的下游任务。使用Facebook和Conviva的工作负载在100台机器的EC2集群上进行评估，结果表明KMN仅用5%的额外资源就将平均作业持续时间减少了81%。

import_candidates.title: Heading off correlated failures through independence-as-a-service
import_candidates.abstract: Today's systems pervasively rely on redundancy to ensure reliability. In complex multi-layered hardware/software stacks, however - especially in the clouds where many independent businesses deploy interacting services on common infrastructure - seemingly independent systems may share deep, hidden dependencies, undermining redundancy efforts and introducing unanticipated correlated failures. Complementing existing post-failure forensics, we propose Independence-as-a-Service (or INDaaS), an architecture to audit the independence of redundant systems proactively, thus avoiding correlated failures. INDaaS first utilizes pluggable dependency acquisition modules to collect the structural dependency information (including network, hardware, and software dependencies) from a variety of sources. With this information, INDaaS then quantifies the independence of systems of interest using pluggable auditing modules, offering various performance, precision, and data secrecy tradeoffs. While the most general and efficient auditing modules assume the auditor is able to obtain all required information, INDaaS can employ private set intersection cardinality protocols to quantify the independence even across businesses unwilling to share their full structural information with anyone. We evaluate the practicality of INDaaS with three case studies via auditing realistic network, hardware, and software dependency structures.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 当今系统普遍依赖冗余来保证可靠性。然而，在复杂的多层硬件/软件栈中——尤其是在云环境中，许多独立业务在同一基础设施上部署相互交互的服务——看似独立的系统可能共享深层次、隐藏的依赖关系，从而削弱冗余措施并引入意想不到的关联故障。作为现有故障后取证工作的补充，我们提出了“独立性即服务”（INDaaS），一种主动审计冗余系统独立性的架构，从而避免关联故障。INDaaS首先利用可插拔的依赖获取模块从多种来源收集结构依赖信息（包括网络、硬件和软件依赖）。然后，凭借这些信息，INDaaS通过可插拔的审计模块对目标系统之间的独立性进行量化，提供性能、精度和数据机密性方面的多种权衡。尽管最通用和高效的审计模块假设审计者能够获取所有所需信息，但INDaaS可以采用隐私保护集合交集基数协议，即使在那些不愿向任何人共享完整结构信息的企业之间也能量化独立性。我们通过三个案例研究评估了INDaaS的实用性，分别审计真实的网络、硬件和软件依赖结构。

import_candidates.title: Characterizing storage workloads with counter stacks
import_candidates.abstract: Existing techniques for identifying working set sizes based on miss ratio curves (MRCs) have large memory overheads which make them impractical for storage workloads. We present a novel data structure, the counter stack, which can produce approximate MRCs while using sublinear space. We show how counter stacks can be checkpointed to produce workload representations that are many orders of magnitude smaller than full traces, and we describe techniques for estimating MRCs of arbitrary workload combinations over arbitrary windows in time. Finally, we show how online analysis using counter stacks can provide valuable insight into live workloads.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现有基于缺失率曲线（MRCs）识别工作集大小的技术具有较大的内存开销，这使得它们难以用于存储工作负载。我们提出了一种新颖的数据结构——计数器栈，它可以在使用次线性空间的同时生成近似的MRCs。我们展示了如何对计数器栈进行检查点操作，以生成比完整追踪小多个数量级的工作负载表示，并描述了用于估计任意工作负载组合在任意时间窗口内MRCs的技术。最后，我们展示了使用计数器栈进行在线分析如何为实时工作负载提供有价值的见解。

import_candidates.title: Pelican: a building block for exascale cold data storage
import_candidates.abstract: A significant fraction of data stored in cloud storage is rarely accessed. This data is referred to as cold data; cost-effective storage for cold data has become a challenge for cloud providers. Pelican is a rack-scale hard-disk based storage unit designed as the basic building block for exabyte scale storage for cold data. In Pelican, server, power, cooling and interconnect bandwidth resources are provisioned by design to support cold data workloads; this right-provisioning significantly reduces Pelican's total cost of ownership compared to traditional disk-based storage.Resource right-provisioning in Pelican means only 8\% of the drives can be concurrently spinning. This introduces complex resource management to be handled by the Pelican storage stack. Resource restrictions are expressed as constraints over the hard drives. The data layout and IO scheduling ensures that these constraints are not violated. We evaluate the performance of a prototype Pelican, and compare against a traditional resource overprovisioned storage rack using a cross-validated simulator. We show that compared to this overprovisioned storage rack Pelican performs well for cold workloads, providing high throughput with acceptable latency.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 云存储中存储的很大一部分数据很少被访问。这些数据被称为冷数据；针对冷数据的低成本存储已成为云提供商面临的挑战。Pelican是一种机架规模的基于硬盘的存储单元，旨在作为冷数据的百亿亿级存储的基本构建模块。在Pelican中，服务器、电源、冷却和互连带宽资源通过设计来支持冷数据工作负载；与传统基于磁盘的存储相比，这种合理的资源配置显著降低了Pelican的总拥有成本。Pelican中的资源合理配置意味着只有8%的驱动器可以同时旋转。这带来了由Pelican存储栈处理的复杂资源管理。资源限制被表示为对硬盘驱动器的约束。数据布局和IO调度确保这些约束不被违反。我们评估了一个Pelican原型的性能，并使用交叉验证的模拟器与传统的资源过度配置的存储机架进行比较。我们表明，与这种过度配置的存储机架相比，Pelican在冷工作负载下表现良好，提供了高吞吐量和可接受的延迟。

import_candidates.title: A self-configurable geo-replicated cloud storage system
import_candidates.abstract: Reconfiguring a cloud storage system can improve its overall service. Tuba is a geo-replicated key-value store that automatically reconfigures its set of replicas while respecting application-defined constraints so that it adapts to changes in clients' locations or request rates. New replicas may be added, existing replicas moved, replicas upgraded from secondary to primary, and the update propagation between replicas adjusted. Tuba extends a commercial cloud-based service, Microsoft Azure Storage, with broad consistency choices (as in Bayou), consistency-based SLAs (as in Pileus), and a novel replication configuration service. Compared with a system that is statically configured, our evaluation shows that Tuba increases the reads that return strongly consistent data by 63\%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 重新配置云存储系统可以改善其整体服务。Tuba是一个地理复制的键值存储系统，它在遵守应用程序定义的约束的前提下自动重新配置其副本集合，以适应客户端位置或请求速率的变化。可以添加新副本、移动现有副本、将副本从次级升级为主级，并调整副本之间的更新传播。Tuba扩展了商业云服务Microsoft Azure Storage，提供了广泛的一致性选择（类似于Bayou）、基于一致性的SLA（类似于Pileus），以及一种新颖的复制配置服务。与静态配置的系统相比，我们的评估显示，Tuba将使返回强一致数据读取的比例提高63%。

import_candidates.title: f4: Facebook's warm BLOB storage system
import_candidates.abstract: Facebook's corpus of photos, videos, and other Binary Large OBjects (BLOBs) that need to be reliably stored and quickly accessible is massive and continues to grow. As the footprint of BLOBs increases, storing them in our traditional storage system, Haystack, is becoming increasingly inefficient. To increase our storage efficiency, measured in the effective-replication-factor of BLOBs, we examine the underlying access patterns of BLOBs and identify temperature zones that include hot BLOBs that are accessed frequently and warm BLOBs that are accessed far less often. Our overall BLOB storage system is designed to isolate warm BLOBs and enable us to use a specialized warm BLOB storage system, f4. f4 is a new system that lowers the effective-replication-factor of warm BLOBs while remaining fault tolerant and able to support the lower throughput demands.f4 currently stores over 65PBs of logical BLOBs and reduces their effective-replication-factor from 3.6 to either 2.8 or 2.1. f4 provides low latency; is resilient to disk, host, rack, and datacenter failures; and provides sufficient throughput for warm BLOBs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Facebook的照片、视频和其他二进制大对象（BLOB）语料库需要可靠存储且快速访问，其规模巨大且持续增长。随着BLOB占用空间的增加，将它们存储在我们传统的存储系统Haystack中变得越来越低效。为了提高存储效率（以BLOB的有效复制因子衡量），我们研究了BLOB的底层访问模式，并识别出温度区，包括频繁访问的热BLOB和访问频率低得多的温BLOB。我们的整体BLOB存储系统被设计为隔离温BLOB，并使我们能够使用专门的温BLOB存储系统f4。f4是一个新系统，它降低了温BLOB的有效复制因子，同时保持容错能力并支持较低的吞吐量需求。f4目前存储超过65PB的逻辑BLOB，并将其有效复制因子从3.6降低到2.8或2.1。f4提供低延迟；能够抵御磁盘、主机、机架和数据中心故障；并为温BLOB提供足够的吞吐量。

import_candidates.title: SAMC: semantic-aware model checking for fast discovery of deep bugs in cloud systems
import_candidates.abstract: The last five years have seen a rise of implementation-level distributed system model checkers (dmck) for verifying the reliability of real distributed systems. Existing dmcks however rarely exercise multiple failures due to the state-space explosion problem, and thus do not address present reliability challenges of cloud systems in dealing with complex failures. To scale dmck, we introduce semantic-aware model checking (SAMC), a white-box principle that takes simple semantic information of the target system and incorporates that knowledge into state-space reduction policies. We present four novel reduction policies: local-message independence (LMI), crash-message independence (CMI), crash recovery symmetry (CRS), and reboot synchronization symmetry (RSS), which collectively alleviate redundant reorderings of messages, crashes, and reboots. SAMC is systematic; it does not use randomness or bug-specific knowledge. SAMC is simple; users write protocol-specific rules in few lines of code. SAMC is powerful; it can find deep bugs one to three orders of magnitude faster compared to state-of-the-art techniques.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 过去五年，实现级分布式系统模型检查器（dmck）在验证真实分布式系统可靠性方面有所兴起。然而，由于状态空间爆炸问题，现有的dmck很少同时涉及多个故障，因此未能应对云系统在处理复杂故障时当前的可靠性挑战。为了扩展dmck，我们引入了语义感知模型检查（SAMC），这是一种白盒原则，它获取目标系统的简单语义信息，并将该知识融入到状态空间缩减策略中。我们提出了四种新颖的缩减策略：局部消息独立性（LMI）、崩溃消息独立性（CMI）、崩溃恢复对称性（CRS）和重启同步对称性（RSS），这些策略共同减少了消息、崩溃和重启中的冗余重排序。SAMC是系统性的；它不使用随机性或针对特定缺陷的知识。SAMC很简单；用户只需用几行代码编写协议特定规则。SAMC功能强大；与最先进的技术相比，它能快1到3个数量级地发现深度缺陷。

import_candidates.title: SKI: exposing kernel concurrency bugs through systematic schedule exploration
import_candidates.abstract: Kernel concurrency bugs are notoriously difficult to find during testing since they are only triggered under certain instruction interleavings. Unfortunately, no tools for systematically subjecting kernel code to concurrency tests have been proposed to date. This gap in tool support may be explained by the challenge of controlling precisely which kernel interleavings are executed without modifying the kernel under test itself. Furthermore, to be practical, prohibitive runtime overheads must be avoided and tools must remain portable as the kernel evolves.In this paper, we propose SKI, the first tool for the systematic exploration of possible interleavings of kernel code. SKI finds kernel bugs in unmodified kernels, and is thus directly applicable to different kernels. To achieve control over kernel interleavings in a portable way, SKI uses an adapted virtual machine monitor that performs an efficient analysis of the kernel execution on a virtual multiprocessor platform. This enables SKI to determine which kernel execution flows are eligible to run, and also to selectively control which flows may proceed. In addition, we detail several essential optimizations that enable SKI to scale to real-world concurrency bugs.We reliably reproduced previously reported bugs by applying SKI to different versions of the Linux kernel and to the FreeBSD kernel. Our evaluation further shows that SKI was able to discover, in widely used and already heavily tested file systems (e.g., ext4, btrfs), several unknown bugs, some of which pose the risk of data loss.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 内核并发错误在测试期间极难发现，因为它们仅在特定的指令交错下被触发。不幸的是，迄今为止还没有工具能够系统性地对内核代码进行并发测试。这种工具支持的缺失可以解释为：在不修改被测内核本身的情况下，精确控制哪些内核交错被执行是一项挑战。此外，为了实用化，必须避免过高的运行时开销，并且工具在内核演进过程中必须保持可移植性。本文提出了SKI，这是第一个能够系统性探索内核代码可能交错的工具。SKI在未修改的内核中发现内核错误，因此可直接应用于不同内核。为了以可移植的方式控制内核交错，SKI使用了一个经过改造的虚拟机监视器，在虚拟多处理器平台上对内核执行进行高效分析。这使得SKI能够确定哪些内核执行流有资格运行，并选择性地控制哪些流可以继续。此外，我们详细介绍了若干关键优化，使SKI能够扩展到真实世界的并发错误。我们通过将SKI应用于不同版本的Linux内核和FreeBSD内核，可靠地复现了之前已报告的错误。我们的评估进一步表明，SKI能够在广泛使用且已经过大量测试的文件系统（如ext4、btrfs）中发现若干未知错误，其中一些可能造成数据丢失的风险。

import_candidates.title: All file systems are not created equal: on the complexity of crafting crash-consistent applications
import_candidates.abstract: We present the first comprehensive study of application-level crash-consistency protocols built atop modern file systems. We find that applications use complex update protocols to persist state, and that the correctness of these protocols is highly dependent on subtle behaviors of the underlying file system, which we term persistence properties. We develop a tool named BOB that empirically tests persistence properties, and use it to demonstrate that these properties vary widely among six popular Linux file systems. We build a framework named ALICE that analyzes application update protocols and finds crash vulnerabilities, i.e., update protocol code that requires specific persistence properties to hold for correctness. Using ALICE, we analyze eleven widely-used systems (including databases, key-value stores, version control systems, distributed systems, and virtualization software) and find a total of 60 vulnerabilities, many of which lead to severe consequences. We also show that ALICE can be used to evaluate the effect of new file-system designs on application-level consistency.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们首次对基于现代文件系统的应用程序级崩溃一致性协议进行了全面研究。我们发现应用程序使用复杂的更新协议来持久化状态，而这些协议的正确性高度依赖于底层文件系统的微妙行为，我们称之为持久性属性。我们开发了一个名为BOB的工具来实证测试持久性属性，并使用它来证明这些属性在六个流行的Linux文件系统之间存在很大差异。我们构建了一个名为ALICE的框架，用于分析应用程序更新协议并发现崩溃漏洞，即那些需要特定持久性属性才能正确运行的更新协议代码。使用ALICE，我们分析了十一个广泛使用的系统（包括数据库、键值存储、版本控制系统、分布式系统和虚拟化软件），共发现60个漏洞，其中许多会导致严重后果。我们还展示了ALICE可用于评估新文件系统设计对应用程序级一致性影响。

import_candidates.title: Torturing databases for fun and profit
import_candidates.abstract: Programmers use databases when they want a high level of reliability. Specifically, they want the sophisticated ACID (atomicity, consistency, isolation, and durability) protection modern databases provide. However, the ACID properties are far from trivial to provide, particularly when high performance must be achieved. This leads to complex and error-prone code--even at a low defect rate of one bug per thousand lines, the millions of lines of code in a commercial OLTP database can harbor thousands of bugs.Here we propose a method to expose and diagnose violations of the ACID properties. We focus on an ostensibly easy case: power faults. Our framework includes workloads to exercise the ACID guarantees, a record/replay subsystem to allow the controlled injection of simulated power faults, a ranking algorithm to prioritize where to fault based on our experience, and a multi-layer tracer to diagnose root causes. Using our framework, we study 8 widely-used databases, ranging from open-source key-value stores to high-end commercial OLTP servers. Surprisingly, all 8 databases exhibit erroneous behavior. For the open-source databases, we are able to diagnose the root causes using our tracer, and for the proprietary commercial databases we can reproducibly induce data loss.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 程序员在使用数据库时希望获得高度的可靠性。具体来说，他们需要现代数据库提供的精密ACID（原子性、一致性、隔离性、持久性）保护。然而，ACID属性远非轻易就能提供，尤其是在必须实现高性能时。这导致了复杂且容易出错的代码——即使每千行代码只有一个缺陷，商业OLTP数据库中数百万行代码也可能潜藏着数千个缺陷。本文提出了一种暴露和诊断ACID属性违反的方法。我们专注于一个表面上简单的情况：电源故障。我们的框架包括用于测试ACID保证的工作负载、一个记录/重放子系统以允许受控注入模拟电源故障、一个基于经验的排序算法以确定故障注入的优先位置，以及一个多层跟踪器用于诊断根本原因。利用我们的框架，我们研究了8个广泛使用的数据库，从开源键值存储到高端商业OLTP服务器。令人惊讶的是，所有8个数据库都表现出错误行为。对于开源数据库，我们能够使用跟踪器诊断根本原因；而对于专有商业数据库，我们能够可重复地诱导数据丢失。

import_candidates.title: Fast databases with fast durability and recovery through multicore parallelism
import_candidates.abstract: Multicore in-memory databases for modern machines can support extraordinarily high transaction rates for online transaction processing workloads. A potential weakness, however, is recovery from crash failures. Can classical techniques, such as checkpoints, be made both efficient enough to keep up with current systems' memory sizes and transaction rates, and smart enough to avoid additional contention? Starting from an efficient multicore database system, we show that naive logging and checkpoints make normal-case execution slower, but that frequent disk synchronization allows us to keep up with many workloads with only a modest reduction in throughput. We design throughout for parallelism: during logging, during checkpointing, and during recovery. The result is fast. Given appropriate hardware (three SSDs and a RAID), a 32-core system can recover a 43.2 GB key-value database in 106 seconds, and a > 70 GB TPC-C database in 211 seconds.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 针对现代机器的多核内存数据库可以支持极高的在线事务处理工作负载事务速率。然而，一个潜在的弱点是崩溃恢复。经典的恢复技术（如检查点）能否既高效到足以跟上当前系统的内存大小和事务速率，又足够智能以避免额外的争用？从一个高效的多核数据库系统出发，我们展示了朴素的日志记录和检查点会降低正常情况下的执行速度，但频繁的磁盘同步允许我们在仅适度降低吞吐量的情况下跟上许多工作负载。我们始终以并行性为目标进行设计：在日志记录期间、检查点期间以及恢复期间。结果是快速的。在适当的硬件（三个SSD和一个RAID）支持下，一个32核系统可以在106秒内恢复一个43.2 GB的键值数据库，以及在一个大于70 GB的TPC-C数据库上于211秒内完成恢复。

import_candidates.title: Extracting more concurrency from distributed transactions
import_candidates.abstract: Distributed storage systems run transactions across machines to ensure serializability. Traditional protocols for distributed transactions are based on two-phase locking (2PL) or optimistic concurrency control (OCC). 2PL serializes transactions as soon as they conflict and OCC resorts to aborts, leaving many opportunities for concurrency on the table. This paper presents ROCOCO, a novel concurrency control protocol for distributed transactions that outperforms 2PL and OCC by allowing more concurrency. ROCOCO executes a transaction as a collection of atomic pieces, each of which commonly involves only a single server. Servers first track dependencies between concurrent transactions without actually executing them. At commit time, a transaction's dependency information is sent to all servers so they can re-order conflicting pieces and execute them in a serializable order.We compare ROCOCO to OCC and 2PL using a scaled TPC-C benchmark. ROCOCO outperforms 2PL and OCC in workloads with varying degrees of contention. When the contention is high, ROCOCO's throughput is 130\% and 347\% higher than that of 2PL and OCC.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 分布式存储系统跨机器运行事务以确保可串行化。传统的分布式事务协议基于两阶段锁（2PL）或乐观并发控制（OCC）。2PL在事务一发生冲突时就将其串行化，而OCC则诉诸中止，这都留下了许多并发机会未被利用。本文提出了ROCOCO，一种新颖的分布式事务并发控制协议，它允许更多并发，从而优于2PL和OCC。ROCOCO将事务执行为一系列原子片段，每个片段通常只涉及单个服务器。服务器首先跟踪并发事务之间的依赖关系，但并不实际执行它们。在提交时，事务的依赖信息被发送到所有服务器，以便它们能够对冲突片段重新排序，并以可串行化的顺序执行它们。我们使用缩放后的TPC-C基准将ROCOCO与OCC和2PL进行了比较。在不同争用程度的工作负载中，ROCOCO均优于2PL和OCC。当争用程度高时，ROCOCO的吞吐量比2PL和OCC分别高130%和347%。

import_candidates.title: Salt: combining ACID and BASE in a distributed database
import_candidates.abstract: This paper presents Salt, a distributed database that allows developers to improve the performance and scalability of their ACID applications through the incremental adoption of the BASE approach. Salt's motivation is rooted in the Pareto principle: for many applications, the transactions that actually test the performance limits of ACID are few. To leverage this insight, Salt introduces BASE transactions, a new abstraction that encapsulates the workflow of performance-critical transactions. BASE transactions retain desirable properties like atomicity and durability, but, through the new mechanism of Salt Isolation, control which granularity of isolation they offer to other transactions, depending on whether they are BASE or ACID. This flexibility allows BASE transactions to reap the performance benefits of the BASE paradigm without compromising the guarantees enjoyed by the remaining ACID transactions. For example, in our MySQL Cluster-based implementation of Salt, BASE-ifying just one out of 11 transactions in the open source ticketing application Fusion Ticket yields a 6.5x increase over the throughput obtained with an ACID implementation.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了Salt，一种分布式数据库，它允许开发人员通过逐步采用BASE方法来提高其ACID应用程序的性能和可扩展性。Salt的动机源于帕累托原则：对于许多应用程序，真正考验ACID性能极限的事务很少。为了利用这一见解，Salt引入了BASE事务，这是一种封装性能关键型事务工作流的新抽象。BASE事务保留了原子性和持久性等理想属性，但通过新的Salt隔离机制，控制它们对事务提供的隔离粒度（取决于事务是BASE还是ACID）。这种灵活性使BASE事务能够在不影响剩余ACID事务享受的保证的情况下，获得BASE范式的性能优势。例如，在我们基于MySQL Cluster的Salt实现中，将开源票务应用Fusion Ticket中的11个事务中的仅一个转化为BASE事务，吞吐量相比ACID实现增加了6.5倍。

import_candidates.title: Phase reconciliation for contended in-memory transactions
import_candidates.abstract: Multicore main-memory database performance can collapse when many transactions contend on the same data. Contending transactions are executed serially--either by locks or by optimistic concurrency control aborts--in order to ensure that they have serializable effects. This leaves many cores idle and performance poor. We introduce a new concurrency control technique, phase reconciliation, that solves this problem for many important workloads. Doppel, our phase reconciliation database, repeatedly cycles through joined, split, and reconciliation phases. Joined phases use traditional concurrency control and allow any transaction to execute. When workload contention causes unnecessary serial execution, Doppel switches to a split phase. There, updates to contended items modify per-core state, and thus proceed in parallel on different cores. Not all transactions can execute in a split phase; for example, all modifications to a contended item must commute. A reconciliation phase merges these per-core states into the global store, producing a complete database ready for joined-phase transactions. A key aspect of this design is determining which items to split, and which operations to allow on split items.Phase reconciliation helps most when there are many updates to a few popular database records. Its throughput is up to 38x higher than conventional concurrency control protocols on microbenchmarks, and up to 3x on a larger application, at the cost of increased latency for some transactions.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 多核主内存数据库在大量事务竞争同一数据时，性能可能会崩溃。竞争事务会被串行执行（通过锁或乐观并发控制中止），以确保它们具有可串行化的效果。这导致许多核心闲置且性能不佳。我们引入了一种新的并发控制技术——阶段调和（phase reconciliation），它可以为许多重要工作负载解决这一问题。我们的阶段调和数据库Doppel反复循环经过连接（joined）、分离（split）和调和（reconciliation）阶段。连接阶段使用传统并发控制，允许任意事务执行。当工作负载争用导致不必要的串行执行时，Doppel切换到分离阶段。在那里，对被争用项的更新会修改每个核心的状态，从而在不同核心上并行进行。并非所有事务都能在分离阶段执行，例如，对同一被争用项的所有修改必须可交换。调和阶段将这些每核心状态合并到全局存储中，生成一个完整的数据库，为连接阶段的事务做好准备。该设计的一个关键方面是确定哪些项应被分离，以及允许对分离项执行哪些操作。当许多更新集中在对少数热门数据库记录上时，阶段调和最为有效。在微基准测试中，其吞吐量比传统并发控制协议最高提升38倍，在较大的应用程序中最高提升3倍，但代价是增加了某些事务的延迟。

import_candidates.title: Eidetic systems
import_candidates.abstract: The vast majority of state produced by a typical computer is generated, consumed, then lost forever. We argue that a computer system should instead provide the ability to recall any past state that existed on the computer, and further, that it should be able to provide the lineage of any byte in a current or past state. We call a system with this ability an eidetic computer system. To preserve all prior state efficiently, we observe and leverage the synergy between deterministic replay and information flow. By dividing the system into groups of replaying processes and tracking dependencies among groups, we enable the analysis of information flow among groups, make it possible for one group to regenerate the data needed by another, and permit the replay of subsets of processes rather than of the entire system. We use model-based compression and deduplicated file recording to reduce the space overhead of deterministic replay. We also develop a variety of linkage functions to analyze the lineage of state, and we apply these functions via retrospective binary analysis. In this paper we present Arnold, the first practical eidetic computing platform. Preliminary data from several weeks of continuous use on our workstations shows that Arnold's storage requirements for 4 or more years of usage can be satisfied by adding a 4 TB hard drive to the system. Further, the performance overhead on almost all workloads we measured was under 8\%. We show that Arnold can reconstruct prior state and answer lineage queries, including backward queries (on what did this item depend?) and forward queries (what other state did this item affect?).
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 典型计算机产生的绝大多数状态都是被生成、消耗然后永久丢失的。我们认为，计算机系统反而应当能够回忆计算机上存在过的任何过去状态，并且还应能够提供当前或过去状态中任何字节的谱系。我们称具备这种能力的系统为完整记忆计算机系统。为了高效保留所有先前状态，我们观察并利用了确定性重放与信息流之间的协同作用。通过将系统划分为若干组可重放的进程并跟踪组间的依赖关系，我们能够分析组间的信息流，使一个组能够重新生成另一个组所需的数据，并允许重放部分进程而非整个系统。我们使用基于模型的压缩和去重文件记录来降低确定性重放的空间开销。我们还开发了多种链接函数来分析状态的谱系，并通过回顾性二进制分析来应用这些函数。本文介绍Arnold，第一个实用的完整记忆计算平台。我们工作站上连续数周使用的初步数据显示，Arnold在未来4年以上的存储需求只需在系统中添加一块4TB硬盘即可满足。此外，我们测量到的几乎所有工作负载的性能开销均低于8%。我们证明Arnold能够重建过去状态并回答谱系查询，包括反向查询（此项依赖什么？）和正向查询（此项还影响了其他什么状态？）。

import_candidates.title: Detecting covert timing channels with time-deterministic replay
import_candidates.abstract: This paper presents a mechanism called time-deterministic replay (TDR) that can reproduce the execution of a program, including its precise timing. Without TDR, reproducing the timing of an execution is difficult because there are many sources of timing variability - such as preemptions, hardware interrupts, cache effects, scheduling decisions, etc. TDR uses a combination of techniques to either mitigate or eliminate most of these sources of variability. Using a prototype implementation of TDR in a Java Virtual Machine, we show that it is possible to reproduce the timing to within 1.85\% of the original execution, even on commodity hardware.The paper discusses several potential applications of TDR, and studies one of them in detail: the detection of a covert timing channel. Timing channels can be used to exfiltrate information from a compromised machine; they work by subtly varying the timing of the machine's outputs, and it is this variation that can be detected with TDR. Unlike prior solutions, which generally look for a specific type of timing channel, our approach can detect a wide variety of channels with high accuracy.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: No paper abstract provided.

import_candidates.title: Identifying information disclosure in web applications with retroactive auditing
import_candidates.abstract: RAIL is a framework for building web applications that can precisely identify inappropriately disclosed data after a vulnerability is discovered. To do so, RAIL introduces retroactive disclosure auditing: re-running the application with previous inputs once the vulnerability is fixed, to determine what data should have been disclosed. A key challenge for RAIL is to reconcile state divergence between the original and replay executions, so that the differences between executions precisely correspond to inappropriately disclosed data. RAIL provides application developers with APIs to address this challenge, by identifying sensitive data, assigning semantic names to non-deterministic inputs, and tracking dependencies.Results from a prototype of RAIL built on top of the Meteor framework show that RAIL can quickly and precisely identify data disclosure from complex attacks, including programming bugs, administrative mistakes, and stolen passwords. RAIL incurs up to 22\% throughput overhead and 0.5 KB storage overhead per request. Porting three existing web applications required fewer than 25 lines of code changes per application.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: RAIL是一个构建Web应用的框架，能够在发现漏洞后精确识别被不当披露的数据。为此，RAIL引入了回溯式披露审计：在漏洞修复后使用先前的输入重新运行应用程序，以确定本应披露哪些数据。RAIL的关键挑战是协调原始执行与重放执行之间的状态分叉，从而使两次执行之间的差异能够精确对应被不当披露的数据。RAIL通过识别敏感数据、为非确定性输入分配语义名称以及跟踪依赖关系，为应用开发者提供了应对这一挑战的API。基于Meteor框架的RAIL原型实验结果表明，RAIL能够快速、精确地识别来自复杂攻击的数据泄露，包括编程错误、管理失误和密码被盗。RAIL每个请求的吞吐量开销最高为22%，存储开销为0.5 KB。移植三个现有Web应用所需的代码改动每应用不到25行。

import_candidates.title: Project Adam: building an efficient and scalable deep learning training system
import_candidates.abstract: Large deep neural network models have recently demonstrated state-of-the-art accuracy on hard visual recognition tasks. Unfortunately such models are extremely time consuming to train and require large amount of compute cycles. We describe the design and implementation of a distributed system called Adam comprised of commodity server machines to train such models that exhibits world-class performance, scaling and task accuracy on visual recognition tasks. Adam achieves high efficiency and scalability through whole system co-design that optimizes and balances workload computation and communication. We exploit asynchrony throughout the system to improve performance and show that it additionally improves the accuracy of trained models. Adam is significantly more efficient and scalable than was previously thought possible and used 30x fewer machines to train a large 2 billion connection model to 2x higher accuracy in comparable time on the ImageNet 22,000 category image classification task than the system that previously held the record for this benchmark. We also show that task accuracy improves with larger models. Our results provide compelling evidence that a distributed systems-driven approach to deep learning using current training algorithms is worth pursuing.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大型深度神经网络模型最近在困难的视觉识别任务上展示了最先进的准确性。不幸的是，此类模型训练极其耗时，需要大量的计算周期。我们描述了一个名为Adam的分布式系统的设计和实现，该系统由商用服务器机构成，用于训练此类模型，在视觉识别任务上表现出世界级的性能、可扩展性和任务准确性。Adam通过全系统协同设计实现高效率和可扩展性，优化并平衡工作负载计算和通信。我们在整个系统中利用异步性来提高性能，并表明它还能提高训练模型的准确性。Adam比以前认为可能的更加高效和可扩展，在ImageNet 22,000类图像分类任务上，使用比之前保持该基准记录的系统少30倍的机器，在相当的时间内训练了一个大型20亿连接模型，准确率提高到2倍。我们还表明，任务准确性随着模型变大而提高。我们的结果提供了令人信服的证据，表明使用当前训练算法的分布式系统驱动方法进行深度学习是值得追求的。

import_candidates.title: Scaling distributed machine learning with the parameter server
import_candidates.abstract: We propose a parameter server framework for distributed machine learning problems. Both data and workloads are distributed over worker nodes, while the server nodes maintain globally shared parameters, represented as dense or sparse vectors and matrices. The framework manages asynchronous data communication between nodes, and supports flexible consistency models, elastic scalability, and continuous fault tolerance.To demonstrate the scalability of the proposed framework, we show experimental results on petabytes of real data with billions of examples and parameters on problems ranging from Sparse Logistic Regression to Latent Dirichlet Allocation and Distributed Sketching.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种用于分布式机器学习问题的参数服务器框架。数据和负载都分布在工作者节点上，而服务器节点维护全局共享的参数，以稠密或稀疏向量及矩阵的形式表示。该框架管理节点之间的异步数据通信，并支持灵活的一致性模型、弹性扩展性和持续的容错能力。为了展示所提出框架的可扩展性，我们展示了在PB级真实数据上的实验结果，这些数据涉及数十亿个示例和参数，涵盖从稀疏逻辑回归到潜在狄利克雷分配和分布式草绘等问题。

import_candidates.title: GraphX: graph processing in a distributed dataflow framework
import_candidates.abstract: In pursuit of graph processing performance, the systems community has largely abandoned general-purpose distributed dataflow frameworks in favor of specialized graph processing systems that provide tailored programming abstractions and accelerate the execution of iterative graph algorithms. In this paper we argue that many of the advantages of specialized graph processing systems can be recovered in a modern general-purpose distributed dataflow system. We introduce GraphX, an embedded graph processing framework built on top of Apache Spark, a widely used distributed dataflow system. GraphX presents a familiar composable graph abstraction that is sufficient to express existing graph APIs, yet can be implemented using only a few basic dataflow operators (e.g., join, map, group-by). To achieve performance parity with specialized graph systems, GraphX recasts graph-specific optimizations as distributed join optimizations and materialized view maintenance. By leveraging advances in distributed dataflow frameworks, GraphX brings low-cost fault tolerance to graph processing. We evaluate GraphX on real workloads and demonstrate that GraphX achieves an order of magnitude performance gain over the base dataflow framework and matches the performance of specialized graph processing systems while enabling a wider range of computation.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 为了追求图处理性能，系统社区在很大程度上放弃了通用分布式数据流框架，转而采用专门的图处理系统，这些系统提供定制化的编程抽象并加速迭代图算法的执行。在本文中，我们认为现代通用分布式数据流系统可以恢复专门图处理系统的许多优势。我们介绍了GraphX，一个构建在Apache Spark之上的嵌入式图处理框架，Apache Spark是一个广泛使用的分布式数据流系统。GraphX呈现了一种熟悉的可组合图抽象，足以表达现有的图API，并且仅使用几个基本的数据流运算符（例如join、map、group-by）即可实现。为了在性能上与专门的图系统持平，GraphX将特定于图的优化重新转化为分布式连接优化和物化视图维护。通过利用分布式数据流框架的进展，GraphX为图处理带来了低成本的容错能力。我们在真实负载上评估了GraphX，并证明GraphX相对于基础数据流框架实现了数量级的性能提升，并且与专门的图处理系统性能相当，同时支持更广泛的计算。

import_candidates.title: Nail: a practical tool for parsing and generating data formats
import_candidates.abstract: Nail is a tool that greatly reduces the programmer effort for safely parsing and generating data formats defined by a grammar. Nail introduces several key ideas to achieve its goal. First, Nail uses a protocol grammar to define not just the data format, but also the internal object model of the data. Second, Nail eliminates the notion of semantic actions, used by existing parser generators, which reduces the expressive power but allows Nail to both parse data formats and generate them from the internal object model, by establishing a semantic bijection between the data format and the object model. Third, Nail introduces dependent fields and stream transforms to capture protocol features such as size and offset fields, checksums, and compressed data, which are impractical to express in existing protocol languages. Using Nail, we implement an authoritative DNS server in C in under 300 lines of code and grammar, and an unzip program in C in 220 lines of code and grammar, demonstrating that Nail makes it easy to parse complex real-world data formats. Performance experiments show that a Nail-based DNS server can outperform the widely used BIND DNS server on an authoritative workload, demonstrating that systems built with Nail can achieve good performance.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Nail是一种工具，它能大幅减少程序员在安全解析和生成由语法定义的数据格式时所需的工作量。Nail引入了几个关键思想来实现其目标。首先，Nail使用协议语法不仅定义数据格式，还定义数据的内部对象模型。其次，Nail消除了现有解析器生成器中使用的语义动作概念，这降低了表达能力，但允许Nail通过建立数据格式与对象模型之间的语义双射，既解析数据格式又从内部对象模型生成它们。第三，Nail引入了依赖字段和流转换来捕获诸如大小和偏移字段、校验和以及压缩数据等协议特性，这些特性在现有协议语言中难以表达。我们使用Nail在不到300行的代码和语法中实现了一个权威DNS服务器（C语言），并在220行的代码和语法中实现了一个unzip程序（C语言），展示了Nail使得解析复杂的真实世界数据格式变得容易。性能实验表明，基于Nail的DNS服务器在处理权威工作负载时可以胜过广泛使用的BIND DNS服务器，证明使用Nail构建的系统可以达到良好的性能。

import_candidates.title: lprof: a non-intrusive request flow profiler for distributed systems
import_candidates.abstract: Applications implementing cloud services, such as HDFS, Hadoop YARN, Cassandra, and HBase, are mostly built as distributed systems designed to scale. In order to analyze and debug the performance of these systems effectively and efficiently, it is essential to understand the performance behavior of service requests, both in aggregate and individually.lprof is a profiling tool that automatically reconstructs the execution flow of each request in a distributed application. In contrast to existing approaches that require instrumentation, lprof infers the request-flow entirely from runtime logs and thus does not require any modifications to source code. lprof first statically analyzes an application's binary code to infer how logs can be parsed so that the dispersed and intertwined log entries can be stitched together and associated to specific individual requests.We validate lprof using the four widely used distributed services mentioned above. Our evaluation shows lprof's precision in request extraction is 88\%, and lprof is helpful in diagnosing 65\% of the sampled real-world performance anomalies.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 实现云服务的应用程序（如HDFS、Hadoop YARN、Cassandra和HBase）大多被构建为旨在扩展的分布式系统。为了有效且高效地分析和调试这些系统的性能，必须了解服务请求的性能行为，无论是总体上还是单独地。lprof是一个性能分析工具，能够自动重建分布式应用中每个请求的执行流。与需要插桩的现有方法不同，lprof完全从运行时日志推断请求流，因此不需要对源代码进行任何修改。lprof首先对应用程序的二进制代码进行静态分析，以推断日志的解析方式，从而将分散且交织的日志条目拼接在一起，并与特定请求关联。我们使用上述四个广泛使用的分布式服务对lprof进行了验证。评估结果表明，lprof在请求提取方面的精度为88%，并且lprof有助于诊断65%的抽样真实世界性能异常。

import_candidates.title: Pydron: semi-automatic parallelization for multi-core and the cloud
import_candidates.abstract: The cloud, rack-scale computing, and multi-core are the basis for today's computing platforms. Their intrinsic parallelism is a challenge for programmers, specially in areas lacking the necessary economies of scale in application/ code reuse because of the small number of potential users and frequently changing code and data. In this paper, based on an on-going collaboration with several projects in astrophysics, we present Pydron, a system to parallelize and execute sequential Python code on a cloud, cluster, or multi-core infrastructure. While focused on scientific applications, the solution we propose is general and provides a competitive alternative to moving the development effort to application specific platforms. Pydron uses semi-automatic parallelization and can parallelize with an API of only two decorators. Pydron also supports the scheduling and run-time management of the parallel code, regardless of the target platform. First experiences with real astrophysics data pipelines indicate Pydron significantly simplifies development without sacrificing the performance gains of parallelism at the machine or cluster level.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 云、机架级计算和多核是当今计算平台的基础。它们固有的并行性对程序员来说是一个挑战，尤其是在那些因潜在用户数量少且代码和数据频繁变化而缺乏必要的应用/代码复用规模经济的领域。基于与多个天体物理学项目的持续合作，本文提出了Pydron，一个用于在云、集群或多核基础设施上并行化和执行顺序Python代码的系统。虽然专注于科学应用，但我们提出的方案是通用的，并为将开发工作转移到特定应用平台提供了一种有竞争力的替代方案。Pydron使用半自动并行化，仅需两个装饰器即可实现并行化。Pydron还支持并行代码的调度和运行时管理，无论目标平台如何。在真实天体物理学数据管道上的初步经验表明，Pydron显著简化了开发，同时不牺牲机器或集群级别的并行性能收益。

import_candidates.title: User-guided device driver synthesis
import_candidates.abstract: Automatic device driver synthesis is a radical approach to creating drivers faster and with fewer defects by generating them automatically based on hardware device specifications. We present the design and implementation of a new driver synthesis toolkit, called Termite-2. Termite-2 is the first tool to combine the power of automation with the flexibility of conventional development. It is also the first practical synthesis tool based on abstraction refinement. Finally, it is the first synthesis tool to support automated debugging of input specifications. We demonstrate the practicality of Termite-2 by synthesizing drivers for a number of I/O devices representative of a typical embedded platform.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 自动设备驱动程序综合是一种激进的方法，通过基于硬件设备规范自动生成驱动程序，从而更快地创建驱动程序并减少缺陷。我们介绍了一种新的驱动程序综合工具包 Termite-2 的设计与实现。Termite-2 是第一个将自动化能力与传统开发的灵活性相结合的工具，也是第一个基于抽象细化的实用综合工具，并且是第一个支持对输入规范进行自动调试的综合工具。我们通过综合一个典型嵌入式平台上若干 I/O 设备的驱动程序，证明了 Termite-2 的实用性。

import_candidates.title: Push-button verification of file systems via crash refinement
import_candidates.abstract: The file system is an essential operating system component for persisting data on storage devices. Writing bug-free file systems is non-trivial, as they must correctly implement and maintain complex on-disk data structures even in the presence of system crashes and reorderings of disk operations.This paper presents Yggdrasil, a toolkit for writing file systems with push-button verification: Yggdrasil requires no manual annotations or proofs about the implementation code, and it produces a counterexample if there is a bug. Yggdrasil achieves this automation through a novel definition of file system correctness called crash refinement, which requires the set of possible disk states produced by an implementation (including states produced by crashes) to be a subset of those allowed by the specification. Crash refinement is amenable to fully automated satisfiability modulo theories (SMT) reasoning, and enables developers to implement file systems in a modular way for verification.With Yggdrasil, we have implemented and verified the Yxv6 journaling file system, the Ycp file copy utility, and the Ylog persistent log. Our experience shows that the ease of proof and counterexample-based debugging support make Yggdrasil practical for building reliable storage applications.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 文件系统是操作系统中用于在存储设备上持久化数据的基本组件。编写无错误的文件系统并非易事，因为即使在系统崩溃和磁盘操作重排序的情况下，文件系统也必须正确实现并维护复杂的磁盘上数据结构。本文介绍了Yggdrasil，一个用于编写可“按钮式验证”的文件系统的工具包：Yggdrasil不需要对实现代码进行任何手动注解或证明，如果存在错误则会生成一个反例。Yggdrasil通过一种新颖的文件系统正确性定义——崩溃精化（crash refinement）——实现了这种自动化，该定义要求实现产生的所有可能的磁盘状态集合（包括崩溃产生的状态）必须是规范所允许的状态的子集。崩溃精化适用于完全自动化的可满足性模理论（SMT）推理，并使开发人员能够以模块化的方式实现文件系统以进行验证。利用Yggdrasil，我们实现并验证了Yxv6日志文件系统、Ycp文件复制工具和Ylog持久化日志。我们的经验表明，证明的简便性和基于反例的调试支持使Yggdrasil成为构建可靠存储应用程序的实用工具。

import_candidates.title: Intermittent computation without hardware support or programmer intervention
import_candidates.abstract: As computation scales downward in area, the limitations imposed by the batteries required to power that computation become more pronounced. Thus, many future devices will forgo batteries and harvest energy from their environment. Harvested energy, with its frequent power cycles, is at odds with current models of long-running computation.To enable the correct execution of long-running applications on harvested energy--without requiring special-purpose hardware or programmer intervention--we propose Ratchet. Ratchet is a compiler that adds lightweight checkpoints to unmodified programs that allow existing programs to execute across power cycles correctly. Ratchet leverages the idea of idempotency, decomposing programs into a continuous stream of re-executable sections connected by lightweight checkpoints, stored in non-volatile memory. We implement Ratchet on top of LLVM, targeted at embedded systems with high-performance non-volatile main memory. Using eight embedded systems benchmarks, we show that Ratchet correctly stretches program execution across frequent, random power cycles. Experimental results show that Ratchet enables a range of existing programs to run on intermittent power, with total run-time overhead averaging below 60\%--comparable to approaches that require hardware support or programmer intervention.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着计算在面积上不断缩小，为其供电所需电池带来的限制变得更加显著。因此，许多未来设备将放弃电池，转而从环境中采集能量。然而，采集能量带来的频繁断电循环与当前长期运行计算模型相矛盾。为了在采集能量上实现长期运行应用程序的正确执行——同时无需专用硬件或程序员干预——我们提出了Ratchet。Ratchet是一个编译器，它向未经修改的程序添加轻量级检查点，使现有程序能够跨断电周期正确执行。Ratchet利用了幂等性的思想，将程序分解为由非易失性存储器中存储的轻量级检查点连接的连续可重执行代码段流。我们在LLVM之上实现了Ratchet，目标是具有高性能非易失性主存的嵌入式系统。通过八个嵌入式系统基准测试，我们证明Ratchet能够正确地使程序执行跨越频繁、随机的断电周期。实验结果表明，Ratchet能够使一系列现有程序在间歇性电源上运行，总运行时间开销平均低于60%——与需要硬件支持或程序员干预的方法相当。

import_candidates.title: Machine-aware atomic broadcast trees for multicores
