import_candidates.abstract: Real-world distributed systems suffer unavailability due to various types of failure. But, despite enormous effort, many failures, especially gray failures, still escape detection. In this paper, we argue that the missing piece in failure detection is detecting what the requesters of a failing component see. This insight leads us to the design and implementation of Panorama, a system designed to enhance system observability by taking advantage of the interactions between a system's components. By providing a systematic channel and analysis tool, Panorama turns a component into a logical observer so that it not only handles errors, but also reports them. Furthermore, Panorama incorporates techniques for making such observations even when indirection exists between components. Panorama can easily integrate with popular distributed systems and detect all 15 real-world gray failures that we reproduced in less than 7 s, whereas existing approaches detect only one of them in under 300 s.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现实世界的分布式系统由于各种类型的故障而面临不可用。然而，尽管付出了巨大努力，许多故障，尤其是灰色故障，仍然逃过检测。在本文中，我们认为故障检测中缺失的环节是检测故障组件的请求者所看到的内容。这一见解引导我们设计和实现了Panorama，一个通过利用系统组件之间的交互来增强系统可观测性的系统。通过提供系统性渠道和分析工具，Panorama将组件转变为逻辑观察者，使其不仅能处理错误，还能报告错误。此外，Panorama还引入了即使在组件之间存在间接层时也能进行此类观察的技术。Panorama可以轻松地与流行的分布式系统集成，并在不到7秒内检测出我们复现的所有15个真实世界灰色故障，而现有方法在300秒内只能检测其中一个。

import_candidates.title: REPT: reverse debugging of failures in deployed software
import_candidates.abstract: Debugging software failures in deployed systems is important because they impact real users and customers. However, debugging such failures is notoriously hard in practice because developers have to rely on limited information such as memory dumps. The execution history is usually unavailable because high-fidelity program tracing is not affordable in deployed systems.In this paper, we present REPT, a practical system that enables reverse debugging of software failures in deployed systems. REPT reconstructs the execution history with high fidelity by combining online lightweight hardware tracing of a program's control flow with offline binary analysis that recovers its data flow. It is seemingly impossible to recover data values thousands of instructions before the failure due to information loss and concurrent execution. REPT tackles these challenges by constructing a partial execution order based on timestamps logged by hardware and iteratively performing forward and backward execution with error correction.We design and implement REPT, deploy it on Microsoft Windows, and integrate it into WinDbg. We evaluate REPT on 16 real-world bugs and show that it can recover data values accurately (92\% on average) and efficiently (in less than 20 seconds) for these bugs. We also show that it enables effective reverse debugging for 14 bugs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 调试已部署系统中的软件故障很重要，因为它们会影响真实用户和客户。然而，在实践中调试此类故障非常困难，因为开发人员不得不依赖内存转储等有限信息。执行历史通常不可用，因为在已部署系统中高保真的程序跟踪是不经济的。在本文中，我们提出了REPT，一个支持对已部署系统中的软件故障进行反向调试的实用系统。REPT通过结合程序控制流的在线轻量级硬件跟踪和离线二进制分析（恢复其数据流）来高保真地重建执行历史。由于信息丢失和并发执行，在故障前数千条指令处恢复数据值似乎是不可能的。REPT通过基于硬件记录的时间戳构建部分执行顺序，并迭代地执行带有纠错的前向和后向执行来应对这些挑战。我们设计并实现了REPT，将其部署在Microsoft Windows上，并集成到WinDbg中。我们在16个真实世界漏洞上评估了REPT，表明它可以准确（平均92%）且高效（不到20秒）地恢复这些漏洞的数据值。我们还表明，它为14个漏洞实现了有效的反向调试。

import_candidates.title: Finding crash-consistency bugs with bounded black-box crash testing
import_candidates.abstract: We present a new approach to testing file-system crash consistency: bounded black-box crash testing (B3). B3 tests the file system in a black-box manner using workloads of file-system operations. Since the space of possible workloads is infinite, B3 bounds this space based on parameters such as the number of file-system operations or which operations to include, and exhaustively generates workloads within this bounded space. Each workload is tested on the target file system by simulating power-loss crashes while the workload is being executed, and checking if the file system recovers to a correct state after each crash. B3 builds upon insights derived from our study of crash-consistency bugs reported in Linux file systems in the last five years. We observed that most reported bugs can be reproduced using small workloads of three or fewer file-system operations on a newly-created file system, and that all reported bugs result from crashes after fsync() related system calls. We build two tools, CRASHMONKEY and ACE, to demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach. Our tools are able to find 24 out of the 26 crash-consistency bugs reported in the last five years. Our tools also revealed 10 new crash-consistency bugs in widely-used, mature Linux file systems, seven of which existed in the kernel since 2014. The new bugs result in severe consequences like broken rename atomicity and loss of persisted files.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种测试文件系统崩溃一致性的新方法：有界黑盒崩溃测试（B3）。B3使用文件系统操作的工作负载，以黑盒方式测试文件系统。由于可能的工作负载空间是无限的，B3根据文件系统操作数量或包含哪些操作等参数来界定这一空间，并在该有界空间内穷举生成工作负载。每个工作负载都在目标文件系统上进行测试，方法是模拟执行工作负载时的断电崩溃，并检查文件系统在每次崩溃后是否能恢复到正确状态。B3基于我们对过去五年Linux文件系统中报告的崩溃一致性缺陷的研究所得出的见解。我们观察到，大多数报告的错误可以通过在新创建的文件系统上执行三个或更少文件系统操作的小型工作负载复现，并且所有报告的错误都源于fsync()相关系统调用后的崩溃。我们构建了CRASHMONKEY和ACE两个工具来证明该方法的有效性。我们的工具能够发现过去五年报告的26个崩溃一致性缺陷中的24个。我们的工具还揭示了广泛使用的成熟Linux文件系统中的10个新的崩溃一致性缺陷，其中7个自2014年以来一直存在于内核中。新错误导致严重的后果，如破坏重命名原子性和持久化文件丢失。

import_candidates.title: An analysis of network-partitioning failures in cloud systems
import_candidates.abstract: We present a comprehensive study of 136 system failures attributed to network-partitioning faults from 25 widely used distributed systems. We found that the majority of the failures led to catastrophic effects, such as data loss, reappearance of deleted data, broken locks, and system crashes. The majority of the failures can easily manifest once a network partition occurs: They require little to no client input, can be triggered by isolating a single node, and are deterministic. However, the number of test cases that one must consider is extremely large. Fortunately, we identify ordering, timing, and network fault characteristics that significantly simplify testing. Furthermore, we found that a significant number of the failures are due to design flaws in core system mechanisms.We found that the majority of the failures could have been avoided by design reviews, and could have been discovered by testing with network-partitioning fault injection. We built NEAT, a testing framework that simplifies the coordination of multiple clients and can inject different types of network-partitioning faults. We used NEAT to test seven popular systems and found and reported 32 failures.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们对来自25个广泛使用的分布式系统的136个由网络分区故障导致的系统故障进行了全面研究。我们发现，大多数故障导致了灾难性后果，如数据丢失、已删除数据的重现、锁的破坏和系统崩溃。大多数故障一旦发生网络分区就很容易显现：它们几乎不需要客户端输入或只需很少的输入，可由隔离单个节点触发，并且是确定性的。然而，需要考虑的测试用例数量极其庞大。幸运的是，我们发现了能够显著简化测试的顺序、时序和网络故障特征。此外，我们发现大量故障源于核心系统机制中的设计缺陷。我们发现，大多数故障本可以通过设计审查来避免，并且可以通过网络分区故障注入测试来发现。我们构建了NEAT，一个测试框架，它简化了多个客户端的协调并能注入不同类型的网络分区故障。我们使用NEAT测试了七个流行的系统，发现并报告了32个故障。

import_candidates.title: LegoOS: a disseminated, distributed OS for hardware resource disaggregation
import_candidates.abstract: The monolithic server model where a server is the unit of deployment, operation, and failure is meeting its limits in the face of several recent hardware and application trends. To improve resource utilization, elasticity, heterogeneity, and failure handling in datacenters, we believe that datacenters should break monolithic servers into disaggregated, network-attached hardware components. Despite the promising benefits of hardware resource disaggregation, no existing OSes or software systems can properly manage it.We propose a new OS model called the splitkernel to manage disaggregated systems. Splitkernel disseminates traditional OS functionalities into loosely-coupled monitors, each of which runs on and manages a hardware component. A splitkernel also performs resource allocation and failure handling of a distributed set of hardware components. Using the splitkernel model, we built LegoOS, a new OS designed for hardware resource disaggregation. LegoOS appears to users as a set of distributed servers. Internally, a user application can span multiple processor, memory, and storage hardware components. We implemented LegoOS on x86-64 and evaluated it by emulating hardware components using commodity servers. Our evaluation results show that LegoOS' performance is comparable to monolithic Linux servers, while largely improving resource packing and reducing failure rate over monolithic clusters.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 单体服务器模型将服务器作为部署、运行和故障的单位，却在一些最新的硬件和应用趋势面前达到了极限。为了提高数据中心中的资源利用率、弹性、异构性和故障处理能力，我们相信数据中心应打破单体服务器，将其分解为分散的、网络连接的硬件组件。尽管硬件资源分解具有可观的优势，但现有的操作系统或软件系统都无法对其进行适当的治理。我们提出一种新的操作系统模型，称为拆分内核（splitkernel），用于管理分解后的系统。拆分内核将传统操作系统功能分散到彼此松散耦合的监测器中，每个监测器运行并管理一个硬件组件。拆分内核还对分布式硬件组件组进行资源分配和故障处理。基于拆分内核模型，我们构建了LegoOS，一种专为硬件资源分解而设计的新操作系统。LegoOS对用户表现为一组分布式服务器。在内部，一个用户应用程序可以跨越多个处理器、内存和存储硬件组件。我们在x86-64上实现了LegoOS，并通过使用商用服务器模拟硬件组件对其进行了评估。评估结果表明，LegoOS的效能与单体Linux服务器相当，同时在大幅改善资源聚集度并降低单体集群故障率方面表现优异。

import_candidates.title: The benefits and costs of writing a POSIX kernel in a high-level language
import_candidates.abstract: This paper presents an evaluation of the use of a high-level language (HLL) with garbage collection to implement a monolithic POSIX-style kernel. The goal is to explore if it is reasonable to use an HLL instead of C for such kernels, by examining performance costs, implementation challenges, and programmability and safety benefits.The paper contributes Biscuit, a kernel written in Go that implements enough of POSIX (virtual memory, mmap, TCP/IP sockets, a logging file system, poll, etc.) to execute significant applications. Biscuit makes liberal use of Go's HLL features (closures, channels, maps, interfaces, garbage collected heap allocation), which subjectively made programming easier. The most challenging puzzle was handling the possibility of running out of kernel heap memory; Biscuit benefited from the analyzability of Go source to address this challenge.On a set of kernel-intensive benchmarks (including NGINX and Redis) the fraction of kernel CPU time Biscuit spends on HLL features (primarily garbage collection and thread stack expansion checks) ranges up to 13\%. The longest single GC-related pause suffered by NGINX was 115 microseconds; the longest observed sum of GC delays to a complete NGINX client request was 600 microseconds. In experiments comparing nearly identical system call, page fault, and context switch code paths written in Go and C, the Go version was 5\% to 15\% slower.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文评估了使用带垃圾回收的高级语言（HLL）实现单片POSIX风格内核的方法。目的是通过检查性能成本、实现挑战以及可编程性和安全收益，来探索使用HLL替代C来实现此类内核是否合理。本文贡献了Biscuit，一个用Go编写的内核，它实现了足够的POSIX功能（虚拟内存、mmap、TCP/IP套接字、日志文件系统、poll等），可以运行重要应用程序。Biscuit广泛使用Go的高级语言特性（闭包、通道、映射、接口、垃圾回收的堆分配），这主观上使编程更容易。最具挑战性的难题是处理内核堆内存耗尽的可能性；Biscuit受益于Go源代码的可分析性来应对这一挑战。在一组内核密集型基准测试（包括NGINX和Redis）中，Biscuit在高级语言特性（主要是垃圾回收和线程栈扩展检查）上花费的内核CPU时间比例最高达13%。NGINX遭遇的最长单次GC相关停顿为115微秒；一个完整NGINX客户端请求所经历的最长GC延迟总和为600微秒。在比较用Go和C编写的几乎相同的系统调用、缺页错误和上下文切换代码路径的实验中，Go版本的运行速度慢5%至15%。

import_candidates.title: Sharing, protection, and compatibility for reconfigurable fabric with Amorphos
import_candidates.abstract: Cloud providers such as Amazon and Microsoft have begun to support on-demand FPGA acceleration in the cloud, and hardware vendors will support FPGAs in future processors. At the same time, technology advancements such as 3D stacking, through-silicon vias (TSVs), and FinFETs have greatly increased FPGA density. The massive parallelism of current FPGAs can support not only extremely large applications, but multiple applications simultaneously as well.System support for FPGAs, however, is in its infancy. Unlike software, where resource configurations are limited to simple dimensions of compute, memory, and I/O, FPGAs provide a multi-dimensional sea of resources known as the FPGA fabric: logic cells, floating point units, memories, and I/O can all be wired together, leading to spatial constraints on FPGA resources. Current stacks either support only a single application or statically partition the FPGA fabric into fixed-size slots. These designs cannot efficiently support diverse workloads: the size of the largest slot places an artificial limit on application size, and oversized slots result in wasted FPGA resources and reduced concurrency.This paper presents AMORPHOS, which encapsulates user FPGA logic in morphable tasks, or Morphlets. Morphlets provide isolation and protection across mutually distrustful protection domains, extending the guarantees of software processes. Morphlets can morph, dynamically altering their deployed form based on resource requirements and availability. To build Morphlets, developers provide a parameterized hardware design that interfaces with AMORPHOS, along with a mesh, which specifies external resource requirements. AMORPHOS explores the parameter space, generating deployable Morphlets of varying size and resource requirements. AMORPHOS multiplexes Morphlets on the FPGA in both space and time to maximize FPGA utilization.We implement AMORPHOS on Amazon F1 [1] and Microsoft Catapult [92]. We show that protected sharing and dynamic scalability support on workloads such as DNN inference and blockchain mining improves aggregate throughput up to 4\texttimes{} and 23\texttimes{} on Catapult and F1 respectively.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 亚马逊和微软等云提供商已开始支持云中的按需FPGA加速，硬件厂商也将在未来处理器中支持FPGA。与此同时，3D堆叠、硅通孔（TSV）和FinFET等技术进步极大地提高了FPGA密度。当前FPGA的巨大并行性不仅可以支持极大的应用，还可以同时支持多个应用。然而，FPGA的系统支持仍处于起步阶段。与软件中资源配置仅限于计算、内存和I/O等简单维度不同，FPGA提供了一组多维的资源海洋，称为FPGA架构：逻辑单元、浮点单元、存储器和I/O都可以连接在一起，导致FPGA资源存在空间约束。当前的软件栈要么只支持单个应用，要么将FPGA架构静态划分为固定大小的槽位。这些设计无法有效支持多样化的工作负载：最大槽位的大小对应用规模人为设限，而过大的槽位则造成FPGA资源浪费和并发度降低。本文提出了AMORPHOS，将用户FPGA逻辑封装为可变形态的任务，即Morphlet。Morphlet在互不信任的保护域之间提供隔离和保护，扩展了软件进程的保障。Morphlet可以变形，根据资源需求和可用性动态改变其部署形式。为构建Morphlet，开发者提供参数化的硬件设计以及与AMORPHOS交互的网格（mesh），该网格指定外部资源需求。AMORPHOS探索参数空间，生成不同规模和资源需求的可部署Morphlet。AMORPHOS在时间和空间上对FPGA上的Morphlet进行多路复用，以最大化FPGA利用率。我们在Amazon F1和Microsoft Catapult上实现了AMORPHOS。我们表明，在DNN推理和区块链挖掘等工作负载上，受保护的共享和动态可扩展性支持使Catapult和F1的聚合吞吐量分别提高了4倍和23倍。

import_candidates.title: Adaptive dynamic checkpointing for safe efficient intermittent computing
import_candidates.abstract: Energy-harvesting devices have the potential to be the foundation of emerging, sensor-rich application domains where the use of batteries is infeasible, such as in space and civil infrastructure. Programming on an energy-harvesting device is difficult because the device operates only intermittently, as energy is available. Intermittent operation requires the programmer to reason about energy to understand data consistency and forward progress of their program. Energy varies with input and environment, making intermittent programming difficult. Existing systems for intermittent execution provide an unfamiliar programming abstraction and fail to adapt to energy changes forcing a compromise of either performance or assurance of forward progress.This paper presents Chinchilla, a compiler and runtime system that allows running unmodified C code efficiently on an energy-harvesting device with little additional programmer effort and no additional hardware support. Chinchilla overprovisions code with checkpoints to assure the system makes progress, even with scarce energy. Chinchilla disables checkpoints dynamically to efficiently adapt to energy conditions. Experiments show that Chinchilla improves programmability, is performant, and makes it simple to statically check the absence of non-termination. Comparing to two systems from prior work, Alpaca and Ratchet, Chinchilla makes progress when Alpaca cannot, and has 125\% mean speedup against Ratchet.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 能量采集设备有潜力成为新兴的、传感器丰富的应用领域的基础，在这些领域中电池的使用不可行，例如太空和民用基础设施。由于设备仅在能量可用时间歇性运行，因此编程困难。间歇运行要求程序员考虑能量因素以理解数据一致性和程序的前进进度。能量随输入和环境变化，使间歇编程困难。现有间歇执行系统提供不熟悉的编程抽象，并且无法适应能量变化，迫使在性能或前进进度保证之间妥协。本文介绍了Chinchilla，一个编译器和运行时系统，它可以在能量采集设备上高效运行未修改的C代码，几乎不需要额外的编程工作，也不需要额外的硬件支持。Chinchilla 使用检查点对代码进行超额配置，以确保系统即使在能量稀缺的情况下也能取得进展。Chinchilla 动态禁用检查点，以高效适应能量条件。实验表明，Chinchilla 提高了可编程性，表现出高性能，并使静态检查无终止性变得简单。与先前工作中的两个系统 Alpaca 和 Ratchet 相比，Chinchilla 在 Alpaca 无法取得进展的情况下取得进展，并且相对于 Ratchet 平均加速125%。

import_candidates.title: Arachne: core-aware thread management
import_candidates.abstract: Arachne is a new user-level implementation of threads that provides both low latency and high throughput for applications with extremely short-lived threads (only a few microseconds). Arachne is core-aware: each application determines how many cores it needs, based on its load; it always knows exactly which cores it has been allocated, and it controls the placement of its threads on those cores. A central core arbiter allocates cores between applications. Adding Arachne to memcached improved SLO-compliant throughput by 37\%, reduced tail latency by more than 10x, and allowed memcached to coexist with background applications with almost no performance impact. Adding Arachne to the RAMCloud storage system increased its write throughput by more than 2.5x. The Arachne threading library is optimized to minimize cache misses; it can initiate a new user thread on a different core (with load balancing) in 320 ns. Arachne is implemented entirely at user level on Linux; no kernel modifications are needed.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Arachne是一种新的用户级线程实现，为生命周期极短（仅数微秒）的应用程序提供低延迟和高吞吐量。Arachne是核心感知的：每个应用程序根据其负载确定自身需要多少核心；它始终确切知道已被分配了哪些核心，并控制其线程在这些核心上的放置。一个中央核心仲裁器在应用程序之间分配核心。将Arachne添加到memcached改善了满足SLO的吞吐量37%，将尾部延迟降低了10倍以上，并允许memcached与后台应用程序共存且几乎无性能影响。将Arachne添加到RAMCloud存储系统使其写入吞吐量提升了2.5倍以上。Arachne线程库经过优化以最大限度减少缓存未命中；它可以在320纳秒内启动一个位于不同核心上的新用户线程（并带有负载均衡）。Arachne完全在Linux用户级实现，无需修改内核。

import_candidates.title: Principled schedulability analysis for distributed storage systems using thread architecture models
import_candidates.abstract: In this paper, we present an approach to systematically examine the schedulability of distributed storage systems, identify their scheduling problems, and enable effective scheduling in these systems. We use Thread Architecture Models (TAMs) to describe the behavior and interactions of different threads in a system, and show both how to construct TAMs for existing systems and utilize TAMs to identify critical scheduling problems. We identify five common problems that prevent a system from providing schedulability and show that these problems arise in existing systems such as HBase, Cassandra, MongoDB, and Riak, making it difficult or impossible to realize various scheduling disciplines. We demonstrate how to address these schedulability problems by developing Tamed-HBase and Muzzled-HBase, sets of modifications to HBase that can realize the desired scheduling disciplines, including fairness and priority scheduling, even when presented with challenging workloads.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种系统性检查分布式存储系统可调度性的方法，识别它们的调度问题，并促使在这些系统中实现有效调度。我们使用线程架构模型（TAMs）来描述系统中不同线程的行为和交互，并展示了如何为现有系统构建TAMs以及如何利用TAMs识别关键的调度问题。我们识别了五个阻止系统提供可调度性的常见问题，并表明这些问题存在于HBase、Cassandra、MongoDB和Riak等现有系统中，使得实现各种调度策略变得困难甚至不可能。我们通过开发Tamed-HBase和Muzzled-HBase（对HBase的一组修改）来演示如何解决这些可调度性问题，即使面对具有挑战性的工作负载，也能够实现所需的调度策略，包括公平性和优先级调度。

import_candidates.title: µtune: auto-tuned threading for OLDI microservices
import_candidates.abstract: Modern On-Line Data Intensive (OLDI) applications have evolved from monolithic systems to instead comprise numerous, distributed microservices interacting via Remote Procedure Calls (RPCs). Microservices face sub-millisecond (sub-ms) RPC latency goals, much tighter than their monolithic counterparts that must meet ≥ 100 ms latency targets. Sub-ms-scale threading and concurrency design effects that were once insignificant for such monolithic services can now come to dominate in the sub-ms-scale microservice regime. We investigate how threading design critically impacts microservice tail latency by developing a taxonomy of threading models--a structured understanding of the implications of how microservices manage concurrency and interact with RPC interfaces under wide-ranging loads. We develop µTune, a system that has two features: (1) a novel framework that abstracts threading model implementation from application code, and (2) an automatic load adaptation system that curtails microservice tail latency by exploiting inherent latency trade-offs revealed in our taxonomy to transition among threading models. We study µTune in the context of four OLDI applications to demonstrate up to 1.9\texttimes{} tail latency improvement over static threading choices and state-of-the-art adaptation techniques.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代在线数据密集型（OLDI）应用已从单体系统演变为由众多分布式微服务组成，这些微服务通过远程过程调用（RPC）进行交互。微服务面临亚毫秒级的RPC延迟目标，这比必须满足至少100毫秒延迟目标的单体应用严格得多。对于此类单体服务曾经无关紧要的亚毫秒级线程和并发设计影响，如今在亚毫秒级的微服务环境中可能占据主导地位。我们通过建立线程模型分类法来研究线程设计如何关键地影响微服务尾部延迟——该分类法在不同负载下对微服务如何管理并发以及与RPC接口交互的含义进行了结构化理解。我们开发了µTune系统，该系统具有两个特点：（1）一个新颖的框架，将线程模型实现从应用程序代码中抽象出来；（2）一个自动负载自适应系统，通过利用我们分类法中揭示的固有延迟权衡在不同线程模型之间转换，从而降低微服务尾部延迟。我们在四个OLDI应用的背景下研究µTune，以展示相比静态线程选择和最先进的自适应技术，尾部延迟可改善高达1.9倍。

import_candidates.title: RobinHood: tail latency-aware caching—dynamically reallocating from cache-rich to cache-poor
import_candidates.abstract: Tail latency is of great importance in user-facing web services. However, maintaining low tail latency is challenging, because a single request to a web application server results in multiple queries to complex, diverse backend services (databases, recommender systems, ad systems, etc.). A request is not complete until all of its queries have completed. We analyze a Microsoft production system and find that backend query latencies vary by more than two orders of magnitude across backends and over time, resulting in high request tail latencies.We propose a novel solution for maintaining low request tail latency: repurpose existing caches to mitigate the effects of backend latency variability, rather than just caching popular data. Our solution, RobinHood, dynamically reallocates cache resources from the cache-rich (backends which don't affect request tail latency) to the cache-poor (backends which affect request tail latency). We evaluate RobinHood with production traces on a 50- server cluster with 20 different backend systems. Surprisingly, we find that RobinHood can directly address tail latency even if working sets are much larger than the cache size. In the presence of load spikes, RobinHood meets a 150ms P99 goal 99.7\% of the time, whereas the next best policy meets this goal only 70\% of the time.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 尾部延迟在面向用户的Web服务中至关重要。然而，保持低尾部延迟颇具挑战性，因为对Web应用服务器的单个请求会导致对复杂、多样化的后端服务（数据库、推荐系统、广告系统等）的多次查询。一个请求只有在所有查询完成后才算完成。我们分析了一个微软生产系统，发现后端查询延迟在不同后端之间以及不同时间上存在超过两个数量级的变化，导致请求尾部延迟很高。我们提出了一种新颖的解决方案来维持低请求尾部延迟：重新利用现有缓存来缓解后端延迟变异性的影响，而不仅仅是缓存热门数据。我们的解决方案RobinHood将缓存资源从缓存丰富者（不影响请求尾部延迟的后端）动态重新分配给缓存匮乏者（影响请求尾部延迟的后端）。我们在一个拥有20个不同后端系统的50台服务器集群上使用生产轨迹评估了RobinHood。令人惊讶的是，我们发现即使工作集远大于缓存容量，RobinHood也能直接解决尾部延迟问题。在负载尖峰存在的情况下，RobinHood在99.7%的时间内达到150ms的P99目标，而次优策略仅在70%的时间内达到该目标。

import_candidates.title: Noria: dynamic, partially-stateful data-flow for high-performance web applications
import_candidates.abstract: We introduce partially-stateful data-flow, a new streaming data-flow model that supports eviction and reconstruction of data-flow state on demand. By avoiding state explosion and supporting live changes to the data-flow graph, this model makes data-flow viable for building long-lived, low-latency applications, such as web applications. Our implementation, Noria, simplifies the backend infrastructure for read-heavy web applications while improving their performance.A Noria application supplies a relational schema and a set of parameterized queries, which Noria compiles into a data-flow program that pre-computes results for reads and incrementally applies writes. Noria makes it easy to write high-performance applications without manual performance tuning or complex-to-maintain caching layers. Partial statefulness helps Noria limit its in-memory state without prior data-flow systems' restriction to windowed state, and helps Noria adapt its data-flow to schema and query changes while on-line. Unlike prior data-flow systems, Noria also shares state and computation across related queries, eliminating duplicate work.On a real web application's queries, our prototype scales to 5\texttimes{} higher load than a hand-optimized MySQL baseline. Noria also outperforms a typical MySQL/memcached stack and the materialized views of a commercial database. It scales to tens of millions of reads and millions of writes per second over multiple servers, outperforming a state-of-the-art streaming data-flow system.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们引入了部分有状态数据流，这是一种新的流式数据流模型，支持按需驱逐和重建数据流状态。通过避免状态爆炸并支持对数据流图的实时更改，该模型使数据流能够用于构建长期运行的低延迟应用，例如Web应用。我们的实现Noria简化了读密集型Web应用的后端基础设施，同时提升了其性能。Noria应用提供关系模式及一组参数化查询，Noria将其编译为数据流程序，预先计算结果以支持读取并增量应用写入。Noria使得无需手动性能调优或维护复杂的缓存层即可编写高性能应用。部分有状态特性帮助Noria限制其内存状态，而无需像先前数据流系统那样仅限于窗口状态，并帮助Noria在在线时适应模式及查询变化。与先前的数据流系统不同，Noria还在相关查询之间共享状态和计算，消除了重复工作。在真实Web应用的查询上，我们的原型可承受的负载比手工优化的MySQL基线高出5倍。Noria也优于典型的MySQL/memcached技术栈以及商业数据库的物化视图。它可扩展至多服务器上每秒数千万次读取和数百万次写入，优于最先进的流式数据流系统。

import_candidates.title: Deconstructing RDMA-enabled distributed transactions: hybrid is better
import_candidates.abstract: There is currently an active debate on which RDMA primitive (i.e., one-sided or two-sided) is optimal for distributed transactions. Such a debate has led to a number of optimizations based on one RDMA primitive, which was shown with better performance than the other.In this paper, we perform a systematic comparison between different RDMA primitives with a combination of various optimizations using representative OLTP workloads. More specifically, we first implement and compare different RDMA primitives with existing and our new optimizations upon a single well-tuned execution framework. This gives us insights into the performance characteristics of different RDMA primitives. Then we investigate the implementation of optimistic concurrency control (OCC) by comparing different RDMA primitives using a phase-by-phase approach with various transactions from TPC-C, SmallBank, and TPC-E. Our results show that no single primitive (one-sided or two-sided) wins over the other on all phases. We further conduct an end-to-end comparison of prior designs on the same codebase and find none of them is optimal.Based on the above studies, we build DrTM+H, a new hybrid distributed transaction system that always embraces the optimal RDMA primitives at each phase of transactional execution. Evaluations using popular OLTP workloads including TPC-C and SmallBank show that DrTM+H achieves over 7.3 and 90.4 million transactions per second on a 16-node RDMA-capable cluster (ConnectX-4) respectively, without locality assumption. This number outperforms the pure one-sided and two-sided systems by up to 1.89X and 2.96X for TPC-C with over 49\% and 65\% latency reduction. Further, DrTM+H scales well with a large number of connections on modern RDMA network.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 目前，对于哪种RDMA原语（即单边或双边）最适合分布式事务，存在着激烈的争论。这样的争论催生了许多基于单一RDMA原语的优化，其中一种原语被证明在性能上优于另一种。在本文中，我们对不同RDMA原语结合各种优化在代表性OLTP工作负载下进行了系统比较。具体而言，我们首先在一个精心调优的单一执行框架上实现并比较了不同的RDMA原语以及现有和我们的新优化。这让我们深入了解了不同RDMA原语的性能特性。然后，我们通过分阶段方法并使用TPC-C、SmallBank和TPC-E的各种事务，研究了乐观并发控制（OCC）的实现，比较了不同的RDMA原语。结果表明，没有任何一种单一原语（单边或双边）能在所有阶段中都胜过另一种。我们进一步在同一代码库上对先前设计进行了端到端比较，发现它们都不是最优的。基于上述研究，我们构建了DrTM+H，一种新的混合分布式事务系统，它在事务执行的每个阶段都采用最优的RDMA原语。使用包括TPC-C和SmallBank在内的流行OLTP工作负载的评估表明，在16节点支持RDMA的集群（ConnectX-4）上，DrTM+H分别达到每秒超过730万和9040万次事务，且无需局部性假设。这一成绩在TPC-C上比纯单边和纯双边系统分别最高提升1.89倍和2.96倍，延迟降低超过49%和65%。此外，DrTM+H在现代RDMA网络上能随大量连接良好扩展。

import_candidates.title: Dynamic query re-planning using QOOP
import_candidates.abstract: Modern data processing clusters are highly dynamic - both in terms of the number of concurrently running jobs and their resource usage. To improve job performance, recent works have focused on optimizing the cluster scheduler and the jobs' query planner with a focus on picking the right query execution plan (QEP) - represented as a directed acyclic graph - for a job in a resource-aware manner, and scheduling jobs in a QEP-aware manner. However, because existing solutions use a fixed QEP throughout the entire execution, the inability to adapt a QEP in reaction to resource changes often leads to large performance inefficiencies.This paper argues for dynamic query re-planning, wherein we re-evaluate and re-plan a job's QEP during its execution. We show that designing for re-planning requires fundamental changes to the interfaces between key layers of data analytics stacks today, i.e., the query planner, the execution engine, and the cluster scheduler. Instead of pushing more complexity into the scheduler or the query planner, we argue for a redistribution of responsibilities between the three components to simplify their designs. Under this redesign, we analytically show that a greedy algorithm for re-planning and execution alongside a simple max-min fair scheduler can offer provably competitive behavior even under adversarial resource changes. We prototype our algorithms atop Apache Hive and Tez. Via extensive experiments, we show that our design can offer a median performance improvement of 1:47\texttimes{} compared to state-of-the-art alternatives.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代数据处理集群高度动态——无论是在并发运行的任务数量还是其资源使用方面。为了提高作业性能，近期研究聚焦于优化集群调度器和作业的查询规划器，重点是资源感知地为作业选择正确的查询执行计划（QEP，表示为有向无环图），并以QEP感知的方式调度作业。然而，由于现有解决方案在整个执行过程中使用固定的QEP，无法适应资源变化而重新调整QEP，常常导致较大的性能低效。本文主张进行动态查询重规划，即在作业执行过程中重新评估和重规划作业的QEP。我们表明，设计重规划需要对当前数据分析栈中关键层级（即查询规划器、执行引擎和集群调度器）之间的接口进行根本性改变。我们不是将更多复杂性推入调度器或查询规划器，而是主张重新分配三个组件之间的职责以简化其设计。在这种重新设计下，我们分析性地证明，一个用于重规划和执行的贪心算法与简单的最大最小公平调度器相结合，即使在对抗性资源变化下也能提供可证明的竞争性行为。我们在Apache Hive和Tez之上原型实现了我们的算法。通过大量实验，我们表明与最先进的替代方案相比，我们的设计可以提供1.47倍的中位性能提升。

import_candidates.title: Focus: querying large video datasets with low latency and low cost
import_candidates.abstract: Large volumes of video are continuously recorded by cameras deployed for traffic control and surveillance with the goal of answering "after the fact" queries such as: identify video frames with objects of certain classes (cars, bags) from many days of recorded video. Current systems for processing such queries on large video datasets incur either high cost at video ingest time or high latency at query time. We present Focus, a system providing both low-cost and low-latency querying on large video datasets. Focus' architecture flexibly and effectively divides the query processing work between ingest time and query time. At ingest time (on live videos), Focus uses cheap convolutional network classifiers (CNNs) to construct an approximate index of all possible object classes in each frame (to handle queries for any class in the future). At query time, Focus leverages this approximate index to provide low latency, but compensates for the lower accuracy of the cheap CNNs through the judicious use of an expensive CNN. Experiments on commercial video streams show that Focus is 48\texttimes{} (up to 92\texttimes{}) cheaper than using expensive CNNs for ingestion, and provides 125\texttimes{} (up to 607\texttimes{}) lower query latency than a state-of-the-art video querying system (NoScope).
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大量视频由用于交通控制和监控的摄像头连续记录，目标是回答“事后”查询，例如：从数天录制的视频中识别包含特定类别对象（如汽车、包）的视频帧。当前处理大型视频数据集上此类查询的系统，要么在视频摄取时产生高成本，要么在查询时产生高延迟。我们提出了Focus，一个在大型视频数据集上同时提供低成本和低延迟查询的系统。Focus的架构灵活有效地在摄取时间和查询时间之间划分查询处理工作。在摄取时（对实时视频），Focus使用廉价的卷积网络分类器（CNN）为每帧中所有可能的对象类别构建近似索引（以处理未来任何类别的查询）。在查询时，Focus利用该近似索引实现低延迟，但通过审慎使用昂贵的CNN来补偿廉价CNN的较低准确性。在商业视频流上的实验表明，Focus比使用昂贵CNN进行摄取便宜48倍（最高便宜92倍），并且比最先进的视频查询系统（NoScope）提供低125倍（最高607倍）的查询延迟。

import_candidates.title: Nickel: a framework for design and verification of information flow control systems
import_candidates.abstract: Nickel is a framework that helps developers design and verify information flow control systems by systematically eliminating covert channels inherent in the interface, which can be exploited to circumvent the enforcement of information flow policies. Nickel provides a formulation of noninterference amenable to automated verification, allowing developers to specify an intended policy of permitted information flows. It invokes the Z3 SMT solver to verify that both an interface specification and an implementation satisfy noninterference with respect to the policy; if verification fails, it generates counterexamples to illustrate covert channels that cause the violation.Using Nickel, we have designed, implemented, and verified NiStar, the first OS kernel for decentralized information flow control that provides (1) a precise specification for its interface, (2) a formal proof that the interface specification is free of covert channels, and (3) a formal proof that the implementation preserves noninterference. We have also applied Nickel to verify isolation in a small OS kernel, NiKOS, and reproduce known covert channels in the ARINC 653 avionics standard. Our experience shows that Nickel is effective in identifying and ruling out covert channels, and that it can verify noninterference for systems with a low proof burden.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Nickel是一个帮助开发者设计和验证信息流控制系统的框架，它通过系统性地消除接口中固有的隐蔽信道（这些信道可能被利用来规避信息流策略的执行）来实现这一目标。Nickel提供了一种适用于自动化验证的非干涉性表述，允许开发者指定允许信息流的预期策略。它调用Z3 SMT求解器来验证接口规范和实现是否都满足关于该策略的非干涉性；若验证失败，则生成反例以说明导致违规的隐蔽信道。使用Nickel，我们设计、实现并验证了NiStar，这是首个用于去中心化信息流控制的OS内核，它提供了：(1)其接口的精确规范，(2)接口规范无隐蔽信道的形式化证明，以及(3)实现保持非干涉性的形式化证明。我们还应用Nickel验证了一个小型操作系统内核NiKOS的隔离性，并复现了ARINC 653航空电子标准中已知的隐蔽信道。我们的经验表明，Nickel在识别和排除隐蔽信道方面是有效的，并且能够以较低的证据负担验证系统的非干涉性。

import_candidates.title: Verifying concurrent software using movers in CSPEC
import_candidates.abstract: Writing concurrent systems software is error-prone, because multiple processes or threads can interleave in many ways, and it is easy to forget about a subtle corner case. This paper introduces CSPEC, a framework for formal verification of concurrent software, which ensures that no corner cases are missed. The key challenge is to reduce the number of interleavings that developers must consider. CSPEC uses mover types to re-order commutative operations so that usually it's enough to reason about only sequential executions rather than all possible interleavings. CSPEC also makes proofs easier by making them modular using layers, and by providing a library of reusable proof patterns. To evaluate CSPEC, we implemented and proved the correctness of CMAIL, a simple concurrent Maildir-like mail server that speaks SMTP and POP3. The results demonstrate that CSPEC's movers and patterns allow reasoning about sophisticated concurrency styles in CMAIL.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 编写并发系统软件容易出错，因为多个进程或线程可能以多种方式交错执行，并且很容易忽略一个微妙的边界情况。本文介绍了CSPEC，一个用于并发软件形式化验证的框架，确保不会遗漏任何边界情况。关键挑战是减少开发人员必须考虑的交错数量。CSPEC使用移动者类型对可交换操作进行重新排序，因此通常只需考虑顺序执行而不是所有可能的交错就足够了。CSPEC还通过使用层来模块化验证，并提供可复用证明模式库，使证明更容易。为了评估CSPEC，我们实现并证明了CMAIL的正确性，CMAIL是一个简单的并发类Maildir邮件服务器，支持SMTP和POP3。结果表明，CSPEC的移动者和模式能够对CMAIL中复杂的并发风格进行推理。

import_candidates.title: Proving confidentiality in a file system using DISKSEC
import_candidates.abstract: SFSCQ is the first file system with a machine-checked proof of security. To develop, specify, and prove SFSCQ, this paper introduces DISKSEC, a novel approach for reasoning about confidentiality of storage systems, such as a file system. DISKSEC addresses the challenge of specifying confidentiality using the notion of data noninterference to find a middle ground between strong and precise information-flow-control guarantees and the weaker but more practical discretionary access control. DISKSEC factors out reasoning about confidentiality from other properties (such as functional correctness) using a notion of sealed blocks. Sealed blocks enforce that the file system treats confidential file blocks as opaque in the bulk of the code, greatly reducing the effort of proving data noninterference. An evaluation of SFSCQ shows that its theorems preclude security bugs that have been found in real file systems, that DISKSEC imposes little performance overhead, and that SFSCQ's incremental development effort, on top of DISKSEC and DFSCQ, on which it is based, is moderate.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: SFSCQ是第一个具有机器验证的安全证明的文件系统。为了开发、规范和证明SFSCQ，本文引入了DISKSEC，这是一种推理存储系统（如文件系统）机密性的新方法。DISKSEC通过使用数据非干涉性的概念来应对指定机密性的挑战，在强大而精确的信息流控制保证与较弱但更实用的自主访问控制之间找到了中间地带。DISKSEC使用密封块的概念，将机密性推理与其他属性（如功能正确性）分开。密封块强制文件系统在大部分代码中将机密文件块视为不透明，从而大大减少了证明数据非干涉性的工作量。对SFSCQ的评估表明，其定理排除了在真实文件系统中发现的安全漏洞，DISKSEC带来的性能开销很小，并且SFSCQ在DISKSEC和其基础的DFSCQ之上的增量开发工作量是适中的。

import_candidates.title: Proving the correct execution of concurrent services in zero-knowledge
import_candidates.abstract: This paper introduces Spice, a system for building verifiable state machines (VSMs). A VSM is a request-processing service that produces proofs establishing that requests were executed correctly according to a specification. Such proofs are succinct (a verifier can check them efficiently without reexecution) and zero-knowledge (a verifier learns nothing about the content of the requests, responses, or the internal state of the service). Recent systems for proving the correct execution of stateful computations--Pantry [25], Geppetto [34], CTV [30], vSQL [83], etc.--implicitly implement VSMs, but they incur prohibitive costs. Spice reduces these costs significantly with a new storage primitive. More notably, Spice's storage primitive supports multiple writers, making Spice the first system that can succinctly prove the correct execution of concurrent services. We find that Spice running on a cluster of 16 servers achieves 488-1167 transactions/second for a variety of applications including inter-bank transactions [27], cloud-hosted ledgers [28], and dark pools [63]. This represents an 18,000-685,000\texttimes{} higher throughput than prior work.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了Spice，一个用于构建可验证状态机（VSM）的系统。VSM是一种请求处理服务，能够生成证明，以表明请求已按照规范正确执行。此类证明是简洁的（验证者无需重新执行即可高效检查）且零知识（验证者无法获知请求、响应或服务内部状态的任何内容）。近期用于证明有状态计算正确执行的系统——如Pantry、Geppetto、CTV、vSQL等——虽隐式实现了VSM，但成本高昂。Spice通过一种新的存储原语显著降低了这些成本。更值得注意的是，Spice的存储原语支持多个写入者，使Spice成为首个能够简洁证明并发服务正确执行的系统。我们发现在由16台服务器组成的集群上运行时，对于多种应用（包括银行间交易、云托管账本和暗池），Spice可达到每秒488至1167笔交易的处理速度。这比先前工作的吞吐量高出18000至685000倍。

import_candidates.title: The fuzzylog: a partially ordered shared log
import_candidates.abstract: The FuzzyLog is a partially ordered shared log abstraction. Distributed applications can concurrently append to the partial order and play it back. FuzzyLog applications obtain the benefits of an underlying shared log - extracting strong consistency, durability, and failure atomicity in simple ways - without suffering from its drawbacks. By exposing a partial order, the FuzzyLog enables three key capabilities for applications: linear scaling for throughput and capacity (without sacrificing atomicity), weaker consistency guarantees, and tolerance to network partitions. We present Dapple, a distributed implementation of the FuzzyLog abstraction that stores the partial order compactly and supports efficient appends / playback via a new ordering protocol. We implement several data structures and applications over the FuzzyLog, including several map variants as well as a ZooKeeper implementation. Our evaluation shows that these applications are compact, fast, and flexible: they retain the simplicity (100s of lines of code) and strong semantics (durability and failure atomicity) of a shared log design while exploiting the partial order of the FuzzyLog for linear scalability, flexible consistency guarantees (e.g., causal+ consistency), and network partition tolerance. On a 6-node Dapple deployment, our FuzzyLog-based ZooKeeper supports 3M/sec single-key writes, and 150K/sec atomic cross-shard renames.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: FuzzyLog是一种部分有序的共享日志抽象。分布式应用可以并发地追加到部分有序结构中并进行回放。FuzzyLog应用获得了底层共享日志的好处——以简单方式提取强一致性、持久性和故障原子性——而不会遭受其缺点。通过暴露部分有序结构，FuzzyLog为应用带来了三个关键能力：线性扩展吞吐量和容量（而不牺牲原子性）、较弱的共识保证以及对网络分区的容忍性。我们提出了Dapple，一种FuzzyLog抽象的分布式实现，它紧凑地存储部分有序结构，并通过一种新的排序协议支持高效的追加/回放。我们在FuzzyLog之上实现了多种数据结构和应用，包括多种映射变体以及一个ZooKeeper实现。我们的评估表明，这些应用紧凑、快速且灵活：它们保留了共享日志设计的简单性（数百行代码）和强语义（持久性和故障原子性），同时利用FuzzyLog的部分有序性实现线性可扩展性、灵活的一致性保证（例如因果+一致性）和网络分区容忍性。在6节点Dapple部署上，我们基于FuzzyLog的ZooKeeper支持每秒300万次单键写入，以及每秒15万次原子跨分片重命名。

import_candidates.title: Maelstrom: mitigating datacenter-level disasters by draining interdependent traffic safely and efficiently
import_candidates.abstract: We present Maelstrom, a new system for mitigating and recovering from datacenter-level disasters. Maelstrom provides a traffic management framework with modular, reusable primitives that can be composed to safely and efficiently drain the traffic of interdependent services from one or more failing datacenters to the healthy ones.Maelstrom ensures safety by encoding inter-service dependencies and resource constraints. Maelstrom uses health monitoring to implement feedback control so that all specified constraints are satisfied by the traffic drains and recovery procedures executed during disaster mitigation. Maelstrom exploits parallelism to drain and restore independent traffic sources efficiently.We verify the correctness of Maelstrom's disaster mitigation and recovery procedures by running large-scale tests that drain production traffic from entire datacenters and then retore the traffic back to the datacenters. These tests (termed drain tests) help us gain a deep understanding of our complex systems, and provide a venue for continually improving the reliability of our infrastructure.Maelstrom has been in production at Facebook for more than four years, and has been successfully used to mitigate and recover from 100+ datacenter outages.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了Maelstrom，一种用于缓解和恢复数据中心级灾难的新系统。Maelstrom提供了一个流量管理框架，其中的模块化、可复用的原语可以被组合起来，以安全高效地将相互依赖的服务流量从一个或多个故障数据中心排空到健康的数据中心。Maelstrom通过编码服务间依赖关系和资源约束来确保安全性。Maelstrom利用健康监控实现反馈控制，使得在灾难缓解期间执行的流量排空和恢复过程都能满足所有指定的约束。Maelstrom利用并行性来高效地排空和恢复独立的流量源。我们通过运行大规模测试验证了Maelstrom灾难缓解和恢复流程的正确性，这些测试排空来自整个数据中心的真实生产流量，然后将流量恢复到数据中心。这些测试（称为排空测试）帮助我们深入了解复杂的系统，并为持续改进基础设施的可靠性提供了平台。Maelstrom已在Facebook生产环境中运行超过四年，并已成功用于缓解和恢复100多起数据中心中断事件。

import_candidates.title: Fault-tolerance, fast and slow: exploiting failure asynchrony in distributed systems
import_candidates.abstract: We introduce situation-aware updates and crash recovery (SAUCR), a new approach to performing replicated data updates in a distributed system. SAUCR adapts the update protocol to the current situation: with many nodes up, SAUCR buffers updates in memory; when failures arise, SAUCR flushes updates to disk. This situation-awareness enables SAUCR to achieve high performance while offering strong durability and availability guarantees. We implement a prototype of SAUCR in ZooKeeper. Through rigorous crash testing, we demonstrate that SAUCR significantly improves durability and availability compared to systems that always write only to memory. We also show that SAUCR's reliability improvements come at little or no cost: SAUCR's overheads are within 0\%-9\% of a purely memory-based system.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们引入了情景感知更新与崩溃恢复（SAUCR），一种在分布式系统中执行复制数据更新的新方法。SAUCR根据当前情景调整更新协议：当大量节点在线时，SAUCR将更新缓冲在内存中；当出现故障时，SAUCR将更新刷新到磁盘。这种情景感知使SAUCR能够在提供强持久性和可用性保证的同时实现高性能。我们在ZooKeeper中实现了SAUCR的原型。通过严格的崩溃测试，我们证明与始终仅写入内存的系统相比，SAUCR显著提高了持久性和可用性。我们还表明，SAUCR的可靠性改进几乎或完全没有代价：SAUCR的开销在纯内存系统的0%至9%范围内。

import_candidates.title: Taming performance variability
import_candidates.abstract: The performance of compute hardware varies: software run repeatedly on the same server (or a different server with supposedly identical parts) can produce performance results that differ with each execution. This variation has important effects on the reproducibility of systems research and ability to quantitatively compare the performance of different systems. It also has implications for commercial computing, where agreements are often made conditioned on meeting specific performance targets.Over a period of 10 months, we conducted a large-scale study capturing nearly 900,000 data points from 835 servers. We examine this data from two perspectives: that of a service provider wishing to offer a consistent environment, and that of a systems researcher who must understand how variability impacts experimental results. From this examination, we draw a number of lessons about the types and magnitudes of performance variability and the effects on confidence in experiment results. We also create a statistical model that can be used to understand how representative an individual server is of the general population. The full dataset and our analysis tools are publicly available, and we have built a system to interactively explore the data and make recommendations for experiment parameters based on statistical analysis of historical data.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 计算硬件的性能具有可变性：在相同服务器（或硬件配置看似相同的不同服务器）上重复运行的软件，每次执行都可能产生不同的性能结果。这种变异性对系统研究的可重复性以及不同系统性能的定量比较具有重要影响。它也对商业计算产生影响，因为商业协议通常以满足特定性能目标为条件。在10个月的时间里，我们进行了一项大规模研究，从835台服务器上采集了近90万个数据点。我们从两个角度审视这些数据：一是有意提供一致环境的服务提供商，二是必须了解变异性如何影响实验结果的系统研究人员。通过这一审视，我们得出了关于性能变异性的类型和幅度及其对实验结果置信度影响的若干教训。我们还创建了一个统计模型，可用于了解单台服务器对整体总体的代表性。完整数据集及我们的分析工具已公开，我们还构建了一个系统，可交互式探索数据，并基于对历史数据的统计分析提出实验参数建议。

import_candidates.title: Pocket: elastic ephemeral storage for serverless analytics
import_candidates.abstract: Serverless computing is becoming increasingly popular, enabling users to quickly launch thousands of short-lived tasks in the cloud with high elasticity and fine-grain billing. These properties make serverless computing appealing for interactive data analytics. However exchanging intermediate data between execution stages in an analytics job is a key challenge as direct communication between serverless tasks is difficult. The natural approach is to store such ephemeral data in a remote data store. However, existing storage systems are not designed to meet the demands of serverless applications in terms of elasticity, performance, and cost. We present Pocket, an elastic, distributed data store that automatically scales to provide applications with desired performance at low cost. Pocket dynamically rightsizes resources across multiple dimensions (CPU cores, network bandwidth, storage capacity) and leverages multiple storage technologies to minimize cost while ensuring applications are not bottlenecked on I/O. We show that Pocket achieves similar performance to ElastiCache Redis for serverless analytics applications while reducing cost by almost 60\%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 无服务器计算正变得越来越流行，使用户能够在云中快速启动数千个短期任务，并具备高弹性和细粒度计费。这些特性使得无服务器计算对交互式数据分析具有吸引力。然而，在分析作业的执行阶段之间交换中间数据是一个关键挑战，因为无服务器任务之间的直接通信很困难。自然的做法是将此类临时数据存储在远程数据存储中。然而，现有存储系统在设计上并不能满足无服务器应用在弹性、性能和成本方面的需求。我们提出了Pocket，一种弹性分布式数据存储，它能够自动扩展以低成本为应用提供所需的性能。Pocket在多个维度（CPU核心数、网络带宽、存储容量）上动态调整资源规模，并利用多种存储技术来最小化成本，同时确保应用不会在I/O上成为瓶颈。我们表明，对于无服务器分析应用，Pocket在实现与ElastiCache Redis相当的性能的同时，成本降低了近60%。

import_candidates.title: Sharding the shards: managing datastore locality at scale with Akkio
import_candidates.abstract: Akkio is a locality management service layered between client applications and distributed datastore systems. It determines how and when to migrate data to reduce response times and resource usage. Akkio primarily targets multi-datacenter geo-distributed datastore systems. Its design was motivated by the observation that many of Facebook's frequently accessed datasets have low R/W ratios that are not well served by distributed caches or full replication. Akkio's unit of migration is called a µ-shard . Each µ-shard is designed to contain related data with some degree of access locality. At Facebook, µ-shards have become a first-class abstraction.Akkio went into production at Facebook in 2014, and it currently manages ∼ 100PB of data. Measurements from our production environment show that Akkio reduces access latencies by up to 50\%, cross-datacenter traffic by up to 50\%, and storage footprint by up to 40\% compared to reasonable alternatives. Akkio is scalable: it can support trillions of µ-shards and process many 10's of millions of data access requests per second. And it is portable: it currently supports five datastore systems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Akkio是一个位于客户端应用程序和分布式数据存储系统之间的局部性管理服务。它决定如何以及何时迁移数据，以减少响应时间和资源使用。Akkio主要针对多数据中心的地理分布式数据存储系统。其设计源于这样一个观察：Facebook许多频繁访问的数据集具有较低的读写比，分布式缓存或完全复制并不能很好地满足这些需求。Akkio的迁移单元称为μ-shard。每个μ-shard旨在包含具有一定访问局部性的相关数据。在Facebook，μ-shard已成为头等抽象。Akkio于2014年在Facebook投入生产，目前管理约100PB的数据。来自生产环境的测量表明，与合理的替代方案相比，Akkio可将访问延迟降低最多50%，跨数据中心流量降低最多50%，存储占用降低最多40%。Akkio是可扩展的：它可支持数万亿的μ-shards，并每秒处理数千万次数据访问请求。而且它是可移植的：目前支持五种数据存储系统。

import_candidates.title: Write-optimized and high-performance hashing index scheme for persistent memory
import_candidates.abstract: Non-volatile memory (NVM) as persistent memory is expected to substitute or complement DRAM in memory hierarchy, due to the strengths of non-volatility, high density, and near-zero standby power. However, due to the requirement of data consistency and hardware limitations of NVM, traditional indexing techniques originally designed for DRAM become inefficient in persistent memory. To efficiently index the data in persistent memory, this paper proposes a write-optimized and high-performance hashing index scheme, called level hashing, with low-overhead consistency guarantee and cost-efficient resizing. Level hashing provides a sharing-based two-level hash table, which achieves a constant-scale search/insertion/deletion/update time complexity in the worst case and rarely incurs extra NVM writes. To guarantee the consistency with low overhead, level hashing leverages log-free consistency schemes for insertion, deletion, and resizing operations, and an opportunistic log-free scheme for update operation. To cost-efficiently resize this hash table, level hashing leverages an inplace resizing scheme that only needs to rehash 1/3 of buckets instead of the entire table, thus significantly reducing the number of rehashed buckets and improving the resizing performance. Experimental results demonstrate that level hashing achieves 1:4\texttimes{}-3:0\texttimes{} speedup for insertions, 1:2\texttimes{}-2:1\texttimes{} speedup for updates, and over 4:3\texttimes{} speedup for resizing, while maintaining high search and deletion performance, compared with state-of-the-art hashing schemes.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 非易失性存储器（NVM）作为持久内存，因其非易失性、高密度和近零待机功耗等优势，预计将在内存层级中替代或补充DRAM。然而，由于数据一致性的要求和NVM的硬件限制，传统为DRAM设计的索引技术在持久内存中效率低下。为了高效索引持久内存中的数据，本文提出了一种写优化且高性能的哈希索引方案，称为level hashing，具有低开销的一致性保证和成本高效的扩容。Level hashing提供了一种基于共享的两级哈希表，在最坏情况下实现了常数规模的查找/插入/删除/更新时间复杂度，并且很少产生额外的NVM写入。为了以低开销保证一致性，level hashing利用无日志的一致性方案进行插入、删除和扩容操作，并为更新操作采用机会性无日志方案。为了成本高效地扩容该哈希表，level hashing利用了一种原地扩容方案，仅需重新哈希1/3的桶，而非整个表，从而显著减少了重新哈希的桶数量并提高了扩容性能。实验结果表明，与最先进的哈希方案相比，level hashing在插入操作上实现了1.4倍至3.0倍的加速，更新操作上实现了1.2倍至2.1倍的加速，扩容操作上实现了超过4.3倍的加速，同时保持较高的查找和删除性能。

import_candidates.title: Flashshare: punching through server storage stack from kernel to firmware for ultra-low latency SSDs
import_candidates.abstract: A modern datacenter server aims to achieve high energy efficiency by co-running multiple applications. Some of such applications (e.g., web search) are latency sensitive. Therefore, they require low-latency I/O services to fast respond to requests from clients. However, we observe that simply replacing the storage devices of servers with Ultra-Low-Latency (ULL) SSDs does not notably reduce the latency of I/O services, especially when co-running multiple applications. In this paper, we propose FLASHSHARE to assist ULL SSDs to satisfy different levels of I/O service latency requirements for different co-running applications. Specifically, FLASHSHARE is a holistic cross-stack approach, which can significantly reduce I/O interferences among co-running applications at a server without any change in applications. At the kernel-level, we extend the data structures of the storage stack to pass attributes of (co-running) applications through all the layers of the underlying storage stack spanning from the OS kernel to the SSD firmware. For given attributes, the block layer and NVMe driver of FLASHSHARE differently manage the I/O scheduler and interrupt handler of NVMe. We also enhance the NVMe controller and cache layer at the SSD firmware-level, by dynamically partitioning DRAM in the ULL SSD and adjusting its caching strategies to meet diverse user requirements. The evaluation results demonstrate that FLASHSHARE can shorten the average and 99th-percentile turnaround response times of co-running applications by 22\% and 31\%, respectively.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代数据中心服务器旨在通过共置运行多个应用程序来实现高能效。其中一些应用程序（例如网络搜索）对延迟敏感。因此，它们需要低延迟的I/O服务来快速响应客户端请求。然而，我们观察到，简单地将服务器的存储设备替换为超低延迟（ULL）SSD并不会显著降低I/O服务的延迟，尤其是在共置运行多个应用程序时。在本文中，我们提出了FLASHSHARE来帮助ULL SSD满足不同共置应用程序对不同级别的I/O服务延迟要求。具体来说，FLASHSHARE是一种整体的跨堆栈方法，可以在不改变任何应用程序的情况下显著减少服务器中共置应用程序之间的I/O干扰。在内核层面，我们扩展了存储堆栈的数据结构，以将（共置）应用程序的属性传递到从操作系统内核到SSD固件的底层存储堆栈的所有层。对于给定的属性，FLASHSHARE的块层和NVMe驱动层以不同的方式管理NVMe的I/O调度器和中断处理程序。我们还在SSD固件层面增强了NVMe控制器和缓存层，通过动态分区ULL SSD中的DRAM并调整其缓存策略来满足多样化的用户需求。评估结果表明，FLASHSHARE可以将共置应用程序的平均和99百分位数周转响应时间分别缩短22%和31%。

import_candidates.title: Orca: differential bug localization in large-scale services
import_candidates.abstract: Today, we depend on numerous large-scale services for basic operations such as email. These services are complex and extremely dynamic as developers continuously commit code and introduce new features, fixes and, consequently, new bugs. Hundreds of commits may enter deployment simultaneously. Therefore one of the most time-critical, yet complex tasks towards mitigating service disruption is to localize the bug to the right commit.This paper presents the concept of differential bug localization that uses a combination of differential code analysis and software provenance tracking to effectively pin-point buggy commits. We have built Orca, a customized code search-engine that implements differential bug localization. On-Call Engineers (OCEs) of Orion, a large enterprise email and collaboration service, use Orca to localize bugs to the appropriate buggy commits. Our evaluation shows that Orca correctly localizes 77\% of bugs for which it has been used. We also show that it causes a 3x reduction in the work done by the OCE.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 如今，我们的日常基本操作（如电子邮件）依赖于众多大规模服务。这些服务复杂且高度动态，因为开发人员持续提交代码并引入新功能、修复以及随之而来的新缺陷。数百个提交可能同时进入部署环境。因此，在缓解服务中断中最紧迫但也最复杂的任务之一，是将缺陷准确定位到正确的提交。本文提出了差异缺陷定位的概念，将差异代码分析与软件来源追踪相结合，以有效、精确地定位有问题的提交。我们构建了Orca，一个实现了差异缺陷定位的定制代码搜索引擎。Orion是一家大型企业邮件与协作服务，其值班工程师使用Orca将缺陷定位到相应的问题提交。我们的评估显示，Orca能够对其使用过程中所处理的77%的缺陷进行正确且精准的定位。我们还表明，它使值班工程师的工作量减少了3倍。

import_candidates.title: Differential energy profiling: energy optimization via diffing similar apps
import_candidates.abstract: Mobile app energy profilers provide a foundational energy diagnostic tool by identifying energy hotspots in the app source code. However, they only tackle the first challenge faced by developers, as, after presented with the energy hotspots, developers typically do not have any guidance on how to proceed with the remaining optimization process: (1) Is there a more energy-efficient implementation for the same app task? (2) How to come up with the more efficient implementation?To help developers tackle these challenges, we developed a new energy profiling methodology called differential energy profiling that automatically uncovers more efficient implementations of common app tasks by leveraging existing implementations of similar apps which are bountiful in the app marketplace. To demonstrate its effectiveness, we implemented such a differential energy profiler, DIFFPROF, for Android apps and used it to profile 8 groups (from 6 popular app categories) of 5 similar apps each. Our extensive case studies show that DIFFPROF provides developers with actionable diagnosis beyond a traditional energy profiler: it identifies non-essential (unmatched or extra) and known-to-be inefficient (matched) tasks, and the call trees of tasks it extracts further allow developers to quickly understand the reasons and develop fixes for the energy difference with minor manual debugging efforts.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 移动应用能量剖析器通过识别应用源代码中的能量热点，提供了一种基础的能量诊断工具。然而，它们只解决了开发者面临的首要挑战，因为当面对能量热点后，开发者通常对余下的优化过程没有任何指导：(1)同一应用任务是否存在更节能的实现？(2)如何设计出更高效的实现？为了帮助开发者应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种名为差分能量剖析的新能量剖析方法，该方法利用应用商店中丰富存在的相似应用的现有实现，自动揭示常见应用任务的更高效实现。为证明其有效性，我们为Android应用实现了一个名为DIFFPROF的差分能量剖析器，并使用它剖析了来自6个流行应用类别的8组应用，每组5个相似应用。我们广泛案例研究表明，DIFFPROF提供了超越传统能量剖析器的可操作诊断：它识别出非必要（未匹配或多余）任务以及已知低效（匹配）任务，并且其提取的任务调用树能使开发者通过少量手动调试工作，快速理解能量差异的原因并制定修复方案。

import_candidates.title: wPerf: generic Off-CPU analysis to identify bottleneck waiting events
import_candidates.abstract: This paper tries to identify waiting events that limit the maximal throughput of a multi-threaded application. To achieve this goal, we not only need to understand an event's impact on threads waiting for this event (i.e., local impact), but also need to understand whether its impact can reach other threads that are involved in request processing (i.e., global impact).To address these challenges, wPerf computes the local impact of a waiting event with a technique called cascaded re-distribution; more importantly, wPerf builds a wait-for graph to compute whether such impact can indirectly reach other threads. By combining these two techniques, wPerf essentially tries to identify events with large impacts on all threads.We apply wPerf to a number of open-source multithreaded applications. By following the guide of wPerf, we are able to improve their throughput by up to 4.83\texttimes{}. The overhead of recording waiting events at runtime is about 5.1\% on average.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文试图识别限制多线程应用最大吞吐量的等待事件。为实现这一目标，我们不仅需要理解事件对等待该事件的线程的影响（即局部影响），还需要理解其影响是否能传递给参与请求处理的其他线程（即全局影响）。为应对这些挑战，wPerf 使用一种称为级联重新分配的技术来计算等待事件的局部影响；更重要的是，wPerf 构建一个等待图来计算这种影响是否能够间接地到达其他线程。通过结合这两种技术，wPerf 本质上试图识别对所有线程具有较大影响的事件。我们将 wPerf 应用于多个开源多线程应用。遵循 wPerf 的指引，我们能够将其吞吐量提升最高达 4.83 倍。运行时记录等待事件的平均开销约为 5.1%。

import_candidates.title: Sledgehammer: cluster-fueled debugging
import_candidates.abstract: Current debugging tools force developers to choose between power and interactivity. Interactive debuggers such as gdb let them quickly inspect application state and monitor execution, which is perfect for simple bugs. However, they are not powerful enough for complex bugs such as wild stores and synchronization errors where developers do not know which values to inspect or when to monitor the execution. So, developers add logging, insert timing measurements, and create functions that verify invariants. Then, they re-run applications with this instrumentation. These powerful tools are, unfortunately, not interactive; they can take minutes or hours to answer one question about a complex execution, and debugging involves asking and answering many such questions.In this paper, we propose cluster-fueled debugging, which provides interactivity for powerful debugging tools by parallelizing their work across many cores in a cluster. At sufficient scale, developers can get answers to even detailed queries in a few seconds. Sledgehammer is a cluster-fueled debugger: it improves performance by timeslicing program execution, debug instrumentation, and analysis of results, and then executing each chunk of work on a separate core. Sledgehammer enables powerful, interactive debugging tools that are infeasible today. Parallel retro-logging allows developers to change their logging instrumentation and then quickly see what the new logging would have produced on a previous execution. Continuous function evaluation logically evaluates a function such as a data-structure integrity check at every point in a program's execution. Retro-timing allows fast performance analysis of a previous execution. With 1024 cores, Sledgehammer executes these tools hundreds of times faster than single-core execution while returning identical results.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 当前的调试工具迫使开发者在功能和交互性之间做出选择。交互式调试器（如gdb）允许他们快速检查应用程序状态并监控执行过程，这对于简单缺陷非常理想。然而，它们对于复杂缺陷（如野指针存储和同步错误）不够强大，因为开发者不知道要检查哪些值或何时监控执行。因此，开发者会添加日志、插入时间测量、创建验证不变量的函数，然后使用这些插桩重新运行应用程序。不幸的是，这些强大的工具不具备交互性；它们可能需要几分钟或几小时来回答关于一次复杂执行的一个问题，而调试涉及提出和回答许多此类问题。在本文中，我们提出了集群驱动的调试，通过将强大的调试工具的工作在集群中的多个核心上并行化来提供交互性。在足够规模下，开发者甚至可以在几秒钟内获得详细查询的答案。Sledgehammer是一个集群驱动的调试器：它通过将程序执行、调试插桩和结果分析进行时间切片，然后在单独的核心上执行每个工作块来提升性能。Sledgehammer使得目前不可行的强大交互式调试工具成为可能。并行回溯日志允许开发者更改其日志插桩，然后快速查看在新日志条件下先前执行会产生什么结果。连续函数评估在程序执行的每个点逻辑上评估函数（如数据结构完整性检查）。回溯计时允许对先前执行进行快速性能分析。使用1024个核心，Sledgehammer执行这些工具的速度比单核执行快数百倍，同时返回相同的结果。

import_candidates.title: Ray: a distributed framework for emerging AI applications
import_candidates.abstract: The next generation of AI applications will continuously interact with the environment and learn from these interactions. These applications impose new and demanding systems requirements, both in terms of performance and flexibility. In this paper, we consider these requirements and present Ray--a distributed system to address them. Ray implements a unified interface that can express both task-parallel and actor-based computations, supported by a single dynamic execution engine. To meet the performance requirements, Ray employs a distributed scheduler and a distributed and fault-tolerant store to manage the system's control state. In our experiments, we demonstrate scaling beyond 1.8 million tasks per second and better performance than existing specialized systems for several challenging reinforcement learning applications.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 下一代AI应用将不断与环境交互，并从这些交互中学习。这些应用在性能和灵活性方面带来了新的、高要求的系统需求。本文考虑了这些需求，并提出了Ray——一个解决这些需求的分布式系统。Ray实现了统一的接口，能够表达基于任务并行和基于角色的计算，并由一个动态执行引擎支持。为了满足性能要求，Ray采用了分布式调度器以及一个分布式且容错的状态存储。在我们的实验中，我们证明了其扩展能力超过每秒180万个任务，并且在几个具有挑战性的强化学习应用中，性能优于现有专门系统。

import_candidates.title: TVM: an automated end-to-end optimizing compiler for deep learning
import_candidates.abstract: There is an increasing need to bring machine learning to a wide diversity of hardware devices. Current frameworks rely on vendor-specific operator libraries and optimize for a narrow range of server-class GPUs. Deploying workloads to new platforms - such as mobile phones, embedded devices, and accelerators (e.g., FPGAs, ASICs) - requires significant manual effort. We propose TVM, a compiler that exposes graph-level and operator-level optimizations to provide performance portability to deep learning workloads across diverse hardware back-ends. TVM solves optimization challenges specific to deep learning, such as high-level operator fusion, mapping to arbitrary hardware primitives, and memory latency hiding. It also automates optimization of low-level programs to hardware characteristics by employing a novel, learning-based cost modeling method for rapid exploration of code optimizations. Experimental results show that TVM delivers performance across hardware back-ends that are competitive with state-of-the-art, hand-tuned libraries for low-power CPU, mobile GPU, and server-class GPUs. We also demonstrate TVM's ability to target new accelerator back-ends, such as the FPGA-based generic deep learning accelerator. The system is open sourced and in production use inside several major companies.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 将机器学习应用于各种各样的硬件设备的需求日益增长。当前框架依赖供应商特定的算子库，并针对有限的服务器级GPU进行优化。将工作负载部署到新平台——如手机、嵌入式设备和加速器（例如FPGA、ASIC）——需要大量人工努力。我们提出了TVM，一个编译器，它暴露图级和算子级优化，为跨不同硬件后端的深度学习工作负载提供性能可移植性。TVM解决了深度学习特有的优化挑战，如高级算子融合、映射到任意硬件原语以及内存延迟隐藏。它还通过采用新颖的基于学习的成本建模方法来自动优化低级程序以适应硬件特性，从而快速探索代码优化。实验结果表明，TVM在低功耗CPU、移动GPU和服务器级GPU等硬件后端上提供的性能与最先进的手动调优库相当。我们还展示了TVM针对新加速器后端（如基于FPGA的通用深度学习加速器）的能力。该系统已开源，并在多家主要公司中投入生产使用。

import_candidates.title: Gandiva: introspective cluster scheduling for deep learning
import_candidates.abstract: We introduce Gandiva, a new cluster scheduling framework that utilizes domain-specific knowledge to improve latency and efficiency of training deep learning models in a GPU cluster.One key characteristic of deep learning is feedback-driven exploration, where a user often runs a set of jobs (or a multi-job) to achieve the best result for a specific mission and uses early feedback on accuracy to dynamically prioritize or kill a subset of jobs; simultaneous early feedback on the entire multi-job is critical. A second characteristic is the heterogeneity of deep learning jobs in terms of resource usage, making it hard to achieve best-fit a priori. Gandiva addresses these two challenges by exploiting a third key characteristic of deep learning: intra-job predictability, as they perform numerous repetitive iterations called mini-batch iterations. Gandiva exploits intra-job predictability to time-slice GPUs efficiently across multiple jobs, thereby delivering low-latency. This predictability is also used for introspecting job performance and dynamically migrating jobs to better-fit GPUs, thereby improving cluster efficiency.We show via a prototype implementation and micro-benchmarks that Gandiva can speed up hyper-parameter searches during deep learning by up to an order of magnitude, and achieves better utilization by transparently migrating and time-slicing jobs to achieve better job-to-resource fit. We also show that, in a real workload of jobs running in a 180-GPU cluster, Gandiva improves aggregate cluster utilization by 26\%, pointing to a new way of managing large GPU clusters for deep learning.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们介绍了Gandiva，一种新的集群调度框架，它利用领域特定知识来提高在GPU集群中训练深度学习模型的延迟和效率。深度学习的一个关键特征是反馈驱动的探索，用户通常运行一组作业（或多作业）以针对特定任务达到最佳结果，并利用对准确性的早期反馈动态优先或终止部分作业；整个多作业的同步早期反馈至关重要。第二个特征是深度学习作业在资源使用方面具有异构性，使得难以先验地实现最佳匹配。Gandiva通过利用深度学习的第三个关键特征解决这两个挑战：作业内可预测性，因为它们执行大量重复的迭代，称为小批量迭代。Gandiva利用作业内可预测性来有效地跨多个作业对GPU进行时间切片，从而提供低延迟。这种可预测性也用于内省作业性能和动态迁移作业以更好地匹配GPU，从而提高集群效率。我们通过原型和微基准测试表明，Gandiva可以在深度学习超参数搜索期间将其加速最多一个数量级，并通过透明地迁移和时间切片作业来获得更好的作业-资源匹配，从而获得更高的利用率。我们还表明，在180个GPU集群中运行的真实工作负载中，Gandiva将总体集群利用率提高了26%，指向了一种为深度学习管理大型GPU集群的新方式。

import_candidates.title: Pretzel: opening the black box of machine learning prediction serving systems
import_candidates.abstract: Machine Learning models are often composed of pipelines of transformations. While this design allows to efficiently execute single model components at training-time, prediction serving has different requirements such as low latency, high throughput and graceful performance degradation under heavy load. Current prediction serving systems consider models as black boxes, whereby prediction-time-specific optimizations are ignored in favor of ease of deployment. In this paper, we present PRETZEL, a prediction serving system introducing a novel white box architecture enabling both end-to-end and multi-model optimizations. Using production-like model pipelines, our experiments show that PRETZEL is able to introduce performance improvements over different dimensions; compared to state-of-the-art approaches PRETZEL is on average able to reduce 99th percentile latency by 5.5\texttimes{} while reducing memory footprint by 25\texttimes{}, and increasing throughput by 4.7\texttimes{}.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 机器学习模型通常由一系列转换管道组成。虽然这种设计能够在训练时高效执行单个模型组件，但预测服务有不同的需求，如低延迟、高吞吐量以及在重负载下优雅的性能降级。当前的预测服务系统将模型视为黑箱，偏向于易于部署而忽略了预测时特有的优化。在本文中，我们提出了PRETZEL，一个预测服务系统，引入了新颖的白盒架构，能够实现端到端和多模型优化。使用类似生产环境的模型管道，我们的实验表明，PRETZEL能够在不同维度上带来性能改进；与最先进的方法相比，PRETZEL平均能够将第99百分位延迟降低5.5倍，内存占用减少25倍，吞吐量提高4.7倍。

import_candidates.title: Splinter: bare-metal extensions for multi-tenant low-latency storage
import_candidates.abstract: In-memory key-value stores that use kernel-bypass networking serve millions of operations per second per machine with microseconds of latency. They are fast in part because they are simple, but their simple interfaces force applications to move data across the network. This is inefficient for operations that aggregate over large amounts of data, and it causes delays when traversing complex data structures. Ideally, applications could push small functions to storage to avoid round trips and data movement; however, pushing code to these fast systems is challenging. Any extra complexity for interpreting or isolating code cuts into their latency and throughput benefits.We present Splinter, a low-latency key-value store that clients extend by pushing code to it. Splinter is designed for modern multi-tenant data centers; it allows mutually distrusting tenants to write their own fine-grained extensions and push them to the store at runtime. The core of Splinter's design relies on type- and memory-safe extension code to avoid conventional hardware isolation costs. This still allows for bare-metal execution, avoids data copying across trust boundaries, and makes granular storage functions that perform less than a microsecond of compute practical. Our measurements show that Splinter can process 3.5 million remote extension invocations per second with a median round-trip latency of less than 9 µs at densities of more than 1,000 tenants per server. We provide an implementation of Facebook's TAO as an 800 line extension that, when pushed to a Splinter server, improves performance by 400 Kop/s to perform 3.2 Mop/s over online graph data with 30 µs remote access times.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 使用内核旁路网络的内存键值存储每台机器每秒可处理数百万次操作，延迟为微秒级。它们之所以快，部分原因在于其简单性，但简单的接口迫使应用程序跨网络移动数据。对于需要对大量数据进行聚合的操作来说，这种方式效率低下，并且在遍历复杂数据结构时会造成延迟。理想情况下，应用程序可以将小型函数推送到存储端，以避免往返和数据移动。然而，将代码推送到这些快速系统具有挑战性。任何用于解释或隔离代码的额外复杂性都会削弱其延迟和吞吐量优势。我们提出了Splinter，一种低延迟键值存储，客户端可通过向其推送代码进行扩展。Splinter专为现代多租户数据中心设计；它允许互不信任的租户编写自己的细粒度扩展并在运行时将其推送到存储。Splinter设计的核心依赖于类型安全和内存安全的扩展代码，以避免传统的硬件隔离成本。这仍然可以实现裸机执行，避免跨信任边界的数据复制，并使计算量小于一微秒的细粒度存储功能成为现实。我们的测量表明，Splinter在每台服务器超过1000个租户的密度下，每秒可处理350万次远程扩展调用，中位往返延迟低于9微秒。我们实现了Facebook TAO作为800行扩展，当推送到Splinter服务器时，其性能提升了400 Kop/s，在在线图数据上达到320万次操作/秒，远程访问时间为30微秒。

import_candidates.title: Neural adaptive content-aware internet video delivery
import_candidates.abstract: Internet video streaming has experienced tremendous growth over the last few decades. However, the quality of existing video delivery critically depends on the bandwidth resource. Consequently, user quality of experience (QoE) suffers inevitably when network conditions become unfavorable. We present a new video delivery framework that utilizes client computation and recent advances in deep neural networks (DNNs) to reduce the dependency for delivering high-quality video. The use of DNNs enables us to enhance the video quality independent to the available bandwidth. We design a practical system that addresses several challenges, such as client heterogeneity, interaction with bitrate adaptation, and DNN transfer, in enabling the idea. Our evaluation using 3G and broadband network traces shows the proposed system outperforms the current state of the art, enhancing the average QoE by 43.08\% using the same bandwidth budget or saving 17.13\% of bandwidth while providing the same user QoE.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在过去的几十年里，互联网视频流媒体经历了巨大的增长。然而，现有视频传输的质量严重依赖于带宽资源。因此，当网络条件不利时，用户体验质量（QoE）不可避免地会受到影响。我们提出了一种新的视频传输框架，利用客户端计算和深度神经网络（DNN）的最新进展来减少对传输高质量视频的依赖。DNN的使用使我们能够独立于可用带宽来提升视频质量。我们设计了一个实用系统，解决了实现这一理念的若干挑战，例如客户端异构性、与码率自适应的交互以及DNN迁移。我们使用3G和宽带网络轨迹进行的评估表明，所提出的系统优于当前最先进的系统，在相同带宽预算下将平均QoE提高了43.08%，或者在提供相同用户QoE的同时节省了17.13%的带宽。

import_candidates.title: Floem: a programming system for NIC-accelerated network applications
import_candidates.abstract: Developing server applications that offload computation to a NIC accelerator is complex and laborious. Developers have to explore the design space, which includes semantic changes for different offloading strategies, as well as variations on parallelization, program-to-resource mapping, and communication strategies for program components across devices.We therefore design FLOEM -- a language, compiler, and runtime -- for programming NIC-accelerated applications. FLOEM enables offload design exploration by providing programming abstractions to assign computation to hardware resources; control mapping of logical queues to physical queues; access fields of a packet and its metadata without manually marshaling a packet; use a NIC to memoize expensive computation; and interface with an external application. The compiler infers which data must be transferred between the CPU and NIC and generates a complete cache implementation, while the runtime transparently optimizes DMA throughput. We use FLOEM to explore NIC-offloading designs of real-world applications, including a key-value store and a distributed real-time data analytics system; improve their throughput by 1.3-3.6\texttimes{} and by 75-96\%, respectively, over a CPU-only implementation.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 开发将计算卸载到NIC加速器的服务器应用是复杂且费力的。开发人员必须探索设计空间，包括不同卸载策略的语义变化，以及并行化、程序到资源映射和跨设备程序组件通信策略的变化。因此，我们设计了FLOEM——一种用于编程NIC加速应用的语言、编译器和运行时。FLOEM通过提供编程抽象来实现卸载设计探索：将计算分配给硬件资源；控制逻辑队列到物理队列的映射；访问数据包及其元数据字段而无需手动封包；使用NIC对昂贵计算进行记忆化；以及与外部应用接口。编译器推断CPU与NIC之间需要传输的数据并生成完整的缓存实现，而运行时则透明地优化DMA吞吐量。我们使用FLOEM来探索实际应用的NIC卸载设计，包括一个键值存储和一个分布式实时数据分析系统；与仅使用CPU的实现相比，其吞吐量分别提升了1.3-3.6倍和75-96%。

import_candidates.title: Graviton: trusted execution environments on GPUs
import_candidates.abstract: We propose Graviton, an architecture for supporting trusted execution environments on GPUs. Graviton enables applications to offload security- and performance-sensitive kernels and data to a GPU, and execute kernels in isolation from other code running on the GPU and all software on the host, including the device driver, the operating system, and the hypervisor. Graviton can be integrated into existing GPUs with relatively low hardware complexity; all changes are restricted to peripheral components, such as the GPU's command processor, with no changes to existing CPUs, GPU cores, or the GPU's MMU and memory controller. We also propose extensions to the CUDA runtime for securely copying data and executing kernels on the GPU. We have implemented Graviton on off-the-shelf NVIDIA GPUs, using emulation for new hardware features. Our evaluation shows that overheads are low (17-33\%) with encryption and decryption of traffic to and from the GPU being the main source of overheads.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出Graviton，一种支持GPU上可信执行环境的架构。Graviton使应用程序能够将安全和性能敏感的核函数与数据卸载到GPU，并在与其他在GPU上运行的代码以及主机上所有软件（包括设备驱动程序、操作系统和虚拟机监视器）隔离的环境中执行核函数。Graviton可以以相对较低的硬件复杂度集成到现有GPU中；所有更改都限制在外围组件，如GPU的命令处理器，无需更改现有CPU、GPU核心或GPU的MMU和内存控制器。我们还提出了对CUDA运行时的扩展，用于在GPU上安全地复制数据和执行核函数。我们已经使用仿真新硬件特性的方法，在现成的NVIDIA GPU上实现了Graviton。我们的评估表明，开销较低（17-33%），主要开销来源是与GPU之间传输数据的加解密。

import_candidates.title: ZebRAM: comprehensive and compatible software protection against rowhammer attacks
import_candidates.abstract: The Rowhammer vulnerability common to many modern DRAM chips allows attackers to trigger bit flips in a row of memory cells by accessing the adjacent rows at high frequencies. As a result, they are able to corrupt sensitive data structures (such as page tables, cryptographic keys, object pointers, or even instructions in a program), and circumvent all existing defenses.This paper introduces ZebRAM, a novel and comprehensive software-level protection against Rowhammer. ZebRAM isolates every DRAM row that contains data with guard rows that absorb any Rowhammer-induced bit flips; the only known method to protect against all forms of Rowhammer. Rather than leaving guard rows unused, ZebRAM improves performance by using the guard rows as efficient, integrity-checked and optionally compressed swap space. ZebRAM requires no hardware modifications and builds on virtualization extensions in commodity processors to transparently control data placement in DRAM. Our evaluation shows that ZebRAM provides strong security guarantees while utilizing all available memory.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Rowhammer漏洞常见于许多现代DRAM芯片，它允许攻击者通过高频访问相邻行来触发内存单元行中的位翻转。因此，攻击者能够破坏敏感的数据结构（例如页表、加密密钥、对象指针，甚至程序中的指令），并绕过所有现有防御。本文介绍了ZebRAM，一种新颖且全面的软件级Rowhammer防护方法。ZebRAM将包含数据的每个DRAM行与守卫行隔离，这些守卫行会吸收任何Rowhammer引起的位翻转；这是已知的抵御所有形式Rowhammer的唯一方法。ZebRAM并非闲置守卫行，而是将守卫行用作高效、经过完整性检查且可选压缩的交换空间，从而提高性能。ZebRAM不需要硬件修改，并利用商用处理器中的虚拟化扩展，透明地控制DRAM中的数据放置。我们的评估表明，ZebRAM在利用所有可用内存的同时提供了强大的安全保证。

import_candidates.title: Karaoke: distributed private messaging immune to passive traffic analysis
import_candidates.abstract: Karaoke is a system for low-latency metadata-private communication. Karaoke provides differential privacy guarantees, and scales better with the number of users than prior such systems (Vuvuzela and Stadium). Karaoke achieves high performance by addressing two challenges faced by prior systems. The first is that differential privacy requires continuously adding noise messages, which leads to high overheads. Karaoke avoids this using optimistic indistinguishability: in the common case, Karaoke reveals no information to the adversary, and Karaoke clients can detect precisely when information may be revealed (thus requiring less noise). The second challenge lies in generating sufficient noise in a distributed system where some nodes may be malicious. Prior work either required each server to generate enough noise on its own, or used expensive verifiable shuffles to prevent any message loss. Karaoke achieves high performance using efficient noise verification, generating noise across many servers and using Bloom filters to efficiently check if any noise messages have been discarded. These techniques allow our prototype of Karaoke to achieve a latency of 6.8 seconds for 2M users. Overall, Karaoke's latency is 5\texttimes{} to 10\texttimes{} better than Vuvuzela and Stadium.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Karaoke是一种用于低延迟、元数据私密通信的系统。Karaoke提供差分隐私保证，并且比先前的此类系统（Vuvuzela和Stadium）具有更好的用户规模扩展性。Karaoke通过解决先前系统面临的两个挑战来实现高性能。第一个挑战是差分隐私需要持续添加噪声消息，这会导致高开销。Karaoke使用乐观不可区分性来避免这一开销：在常见情况下，Karaoke不会向对手泄露任何信息，并且Karaoke客户端可以精确检测何时可能泄露信息（因此需要更少的噪声）。第二个挑战在于如何在某些节点可能恶意的分布式系统中生成足够的噪声。先前的工作要么要求每个服务器自行生成足够的噪声，要么使用昂贵的可验证洗牌来防止任何消息丢失。Karaoke通过高效的噪声验证实现高性能，即跨多个服务器生成噪声，并使用布隆过滤器有效检查是否有噪声消息被丢弃。这些技术使我们的Karaoke原型在200万用户下实现了6.8秒的延迟。总体而言，Karaoke的延迟比Vuvuzela和Stadium好5到10倍。

import_candidates.title: Obladi: oblivious serializable transactions in the cloud
import_candidates.abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of Obladi, the first system to provide ACID transactions while also hiding access patterns. Obladi uses as its building block oblivious RAM, but turns the demands of supporting transactions into a performance opportunity. By executing transactions within epochs and delaying commit decisions until an epoch ends, Obladi reduces the amortized bandwidth costs of oblivious storage and increases overall system throughput. These performance gains, combined with new oblivious mechanisms for concurrency control and recovery, allow Obladi to execute OLTP workloads with reasonable throughput: it comes within 5\texttimes{} to 12\texttimes{} of a non-oblivious baseline on the TPC-C, SmallBank, and FreeHealth applications. Latency overheads, however, are higher (70\texttimes{} on TPC-C).
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了Obladi的设计与实现，这是第一个在隐藏访问模式的同时提供ACID事务的系统。Obladi以不经意RAM（ORAM）为构建模块，但将支持事务的需求转化为性能机会。通过在时间段内执行事务并延迟提交决定至时间段结束，Obladi降低了隐晦存储的摊销带宽成本并提高了整体系统吞吐量。这些性能提升，加上用于并发控制和恢复的新隐晦机制，使Obladi能够以合理的吞吐量执行OLTP工作负载：在TPC-C、SmallBank和FreeHealth应用中，其吞吐量达到非隐晦基线的5到12倍之内。然而，延迟开销更高（TPC-C上为70倍）。

import_candidates.title: ASAP: fast, approximate graph pattern mining at scale
import_candidates.abstract: While there has been a tremendous interest in processing data that has an underlying graph structure, existing distributed graph processing systems take several minutes or even hours to mine simple patterns on graphs. This paper presents ASAP, a fast, approximate computation engine for graph pattern mining. ASAP leverages state-of-the-art results in graph approximation theory, and extends it to general graph patterns in distributed settings. To enable the users to navigate the tradeoff between the result accuracy and latency, we propose a novel approach to build the Error-Latency Profile (ELP) for a given computation. We have implemented ASAP on a general-purpose distributed dataflow platform and evaluated it extensively on several graph patterns.
