Our experimental results show that ASAP outperforms existing exact pattern mining solutions by up to 77\texttimes{}. Further, ASAP can scale to graphs with billions of edges without the need for large clusters.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 虽然人们对处理具有底层图结构的数据有了极大的兴趣，但现有的分布式图处理系统需要几分钟甚至几小时才能在图上挖掘简单模式。本文提出了ASAP，一个用于图模式挖掘的快速近似计算引擎。ASAP利用了图近似理论的最新成果，并将其扩展到分布式环境中的一般图模式。为了使用户能够在结果准确性和延迟之间进行权衡，我们提出了一种新颖的方法来为给定计算构建误差-延迟轮廓（ELP）。我们在通用分布式数据流平台上实现了ASAP，并在多个图模式上进行了广泛评估。实验结果表明，ASAP比现有精确模式挖掘解决方案快最多77倍。此外，ASAP可以扩展到具有数十亿条边的图，而无需大型集群。

import_candidates.title: RStream: marrying relational algebra with streaming for efficient graph mining on a single machine
import_candidates.abstract: Graph mining is an important category of graph algorithms that aim to discover structural patterns such as cliques and motifs in a graph. While a great deal of work has been done recently on graph computation such as PageRank, systems support for scalable graph mining is still limited. Existing mining systems such as Arabesque focus on distributed computing and need large amounts of compute and memory resources.We built RStream, the first single-machine, out-of-core mining system that leverages disk support to store intermediate data. At its core are two innovations: (1) a rich programming model that exposes relational algebra for developers to express a wide variety of mining tasks; and (2) a runtime engine that implements relational algebra efficiently with tuple streaming. A comparison between RStream and four state-of-the-art distributed mining/Datalog systems--Arabesque, ScaleMine, DistGraph, and BigDatalog -- demonstrates that RStream outperforms all of them, running on a 10-node cluster, e.g., by at least a factor of 1.7\texttimes{}, and can process large graphs on an inexpensive machine.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 图挖掘是图算法中的一个重要类别，旨在发现图中的结构模式，如团和模体。尽管近期在图计算（如PageRank）方面已有大量工作，但对可扩展图挖掘的系统支持仍然有限。现有的挖掘系统如Arabesque侧重于分布式计算，需要大量的计算和内存资源。我们构建了RStream，这是首个单机、外核挖掘系统，利用磁盘支持来存储中间数据。其核心有两个创新：（1）一个丰富的编程模型，暴露关系代数，使开发人员能够表达各种挖掘任务；（2）一个运行时引擎，通过元组流高效地实现关系代数。RStream与四个最先进的分布式挖掘/Datalog系统（Arabesque、ScaleMine、DistGraph和BigDatalog）的比较表明，RStream在10节点集群上运行时性能优于所有这些系统，例如至少达到1.7倍的提升，并且可以在廉价的机器上处理大型图。

import_candidates.title: Three steps is all you need: fast, accurate, automatic scaling decisions for distributed streaming dataflows
import_candidates.abstract: Streaming computations are by nature long-running, and their workloads can change in unpredictable ways. This in turn means that maintaining performance may require dynamic scaling of allocated computational resources.Some modern large-scale stream processors allow dynamic scaling but typically leave the difficult task of deciding how much to scale to the user. The process is cumbersome, slow and often inefficient. Where automatic scaling is supported, policies rely on coarse-grained metrics like observed throughput, backpressure, and CPU utilization. As a result, they tend to show incorrect provisioning, oscillations, and long convergence times.We present DS2, an automatic scaling controller for such systems which combines a general performance model of streaming dataflows with lightweight instrumentation to estimate the true processing and output rates of individual dataflow operators.We apply DS2 on Apache Flink and Timely Dataflow and demonstrate its accuracy and fast convergence. When compared to Dhalion, the state-of-the-art technique in Heron, DS2 converges to the optimal, backpressure-free configuration in a single step instead of six.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 流式计算本质上长期运行，其工作负载可能以不可预测的方式变化。这反过来意味着，维持性能可能需要动态调整所分配的计算资源。一些现代大规模流处理器支持动态伸缩，但通常将决定需要伸缩多少的困难任务交给用户。这个过程繁琐、缓慢且往往低效。在支持自动伸缩的地方，策略依赖于粗粒度的指标，如观测到的吞吐量、背压和CPU利用率。因此，它们往往表现出错误的资源配置、振荡和较长的收敛时间。我们提出DS2，一种用于此类系统的自动伸缩控制器，它将流数据流的通用性能模型与轻量级插桩相结合，以估算各个数据流算子的真实处理速率和输出速率。我们将DS2应用于Apache Flink和Timely Dataflow，并展示了其准确性和快速收敛性。与Heron中最先进的技术Dhalion相比，DS2能在一步而非六步内收敛到最优的、无背压的配置。

import_candidates.title: Flare: optimizing apache spark with native compilation for scale-up architectures and medium-size data
import_candidates.abstract: In recent years, Apache Spark has become the de facto standard for big data processing. Spark has enabled a wide audience of users to process petabyte-scale workloads due to its flexibility and ease of use: users are able to mix SQL-style relational queries with Scala or Python code, and have the resultant programs distributed across an entire cluster, all without having to work with low-level parallelization or network primitives.However, many workloads of practical importance are not large enough to justify distributed, scale-out execution, as the data may reside entirely in main memory of a single powerful server. Still, users want to use Spark for its familiar interface and tooling. In such scale-up scenarios, Spark's performance is suboptimal, as Spark prioritizes handling data size over optimizing the computations on that data. For such medium-size workloads, performance may still be of critical importance if jobs are computationally heavy, need to be run frequently on changing data, or interface with external libraries and systems (e.g., TensorFlow for machine learning).We present Flare, an accelerator module for Spark that delivers order of magnitude speedups on scale-up architectures for a large class of applications. Inspired by query compilation techniques from main-memory database systems, Flare incorporates a code generation strategy designed to match the unique aspects of Spark and the characteristics of scale-up architectures, in particular processing data directly from optimized file formats and combining SQL-style relational processing with external frameworks such as TensorFlow.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 近年来，Apache Spark已成为大数据处理的实际标准。Spark凭借其灵活性和易用性，使广大用户能够处理PB级工作负载：用户可以混合使用SQL风格的关系查询与Scala或Python代码，并让生成的程序分布在整个集群中，而无需接触底层的并行化或网络原语。然而，许多具有实际重要性的工作负载规模并不足以证明分布式横向扩展执行的合理性，因为数据可能完全驻留在单个强大服务器的主内存中。尽管如此，用户仍希望使用Spark，因为它提供了熟悉的界面和工具。在这种纵向扩展场景下，Spark的性能并不理想，因为Spark优先考虑处理数据规模，而不是优化对该数据的计算。对于此类中型工作负载，如果任务计算量大、需要在变化的数据上频繁运行，或需要与外部库和系统（例如用于机器学习的TensorFlow）交互，性能可能仍然至关重要。我们提出了Flare，这是Spark的一个加速模块，可在纵向扩展架构上为一类广泛的应用程序实现数量级的加速。受主内存数据库系统中的查询编译技术的启发，Flare引入了一种代码生成策略，旨在匹配Spark的独特方面和纵向扩展架构的特征，特别是直接从优化的文件格式处理数据，并将SQL风格的关系处理与TensorFlow等外部框架相结合。

import_candidates.title: Theseus: an experiment in operating system structure and state management
import_candidates.abstract: This paper describes an operating system (OS) called Theseus. Theseus is the result of multi-year experimentation to redesign and improve OS modularity by reducing the states one component holds for another, and to leverage a safe programming language, namely Rust, to shift as many OS responsibilities as possible to the compiler.Theseus embodies two primary contributions. First, an OS structure in which many tiny components with clearly-defined, runtime-persistent bounds interact without holding states for each other. Second, an intralingual approach that realizes the OS itself using language-level mechanisms such that the compiler can enforce invariants about OS semantics.Theseus's structure, intralingual design, and state management realize live evolution and fault recovery for core OS components in ways beyond that of existing works.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文描述了一个名为Theseus的操作系统。Theseus是多年实验的成果，旨在通过减少组件之间相互持有的状态来重新设计和改进操作系统的模块化，并利用Rust这一安全编程语言，尽可能将操作系统职责转移给编译器。Theseus有两个主要贡献：第一，一种操作系统结构，其中许多具有清晰定义、运行时持久边界的微小组件在不为彼此持有状态的情况下进行交互；第二，一种语言内方法，利用语言级机制实现操作系统本身，使编译器能够强制执行有关操作系统语义的不变量。Theseus的结构、语言内设计和状态管理在实时演化和核心操作系统组件故障恢复方面超越了现有工作。

import_candidates.title: RedLeaf: isolation and communication in a safe operating system
import_candidates.abstract: RedLeaf is a new operating system developed from scratch in Rust to explore the impact of language safety on operating system organization. In contrast to commodity systems, RedLeaf does not rely on hardware address spaces for isolation and instead uses only type and memory safety of the Rust language. Departure from costly hardware isolation mechanisms allows us to explore the design space of systems that embrace lightweight fine-grained isolation. We develop a new abstraction of a lightweight language-based isolation domain that provides a unit of information hiding and fault isolation. Domains can be dynamically loaded and cleanly terminated, i.e., errors in one domain do not affect the execution of other domains. Building on RedLeaf isolation mechanisms, we demonstrate the possibility to implement end-to-end zero-copy, fault isolation, and transparent recovery of device drivers. To evaluate the practicality of RedLeaf abstractions, we implement Rv6, a POSIX-subset operating system as a collection of RedLeaf domains. Finally, to demonstrate that Rust and fine-grained isolation are practical--we develop efficient versions of a 10Gbps Intel ixgbe network and NVMe solid-state disk device drivers that match the performance of the fastest DPDK and SPDK equivalents.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: RedLeaf 是一个用 Rust 从零开始开发的新操作系统，旨在探索语言安全对操作系统组织方式的影响。与传统系统不同，RedLeaf 不依赖硬件地址空间进行隔离，而仅使用 Rust 语言的类型安全和内存安全。放弃代价高昂的硬件隔离机制，使我们能够探索采用轻量级细粒度隔离的系统的设计空间。我们开发了一种新的轻量级基于语言的隔离域抽象，它提供了信息隐藏和故障隔离的单元。域可以动态加载并被干净地终止，即一个域中的错误不会影响其他域的执行。基于 RedLeaf 的隔离机制，我们展示了实现端到端零拷贝、故障隔离和设备驱动透明恢复的可能性。为评估 RedLeaf 抽象的实际可行性，我们实现了 Rv6——一个由 RedLeaf 域集合构成的 POSIX 子集操作系统。最后，为证明 Rust 和细粒度隔离的实用性，我们开发了高效的 10Gbps Intel ixgbe 网络设备驱动和 NVMe 固态硬盘驱动，其性能与最快的 DPDK 和 SPDK 等价实现相当。

import_candidates.title: Specification and verification in the field: applying formal methods to BPF just-in-time compilers in the Linux kernel
import_candidates.abstract: This paper describes our experience applying formal methods to a critical component in the Linux kernel, the just-in-time compilers ("JITs") for the Berkeley Packet Filter (BPF) virtual machine. We verify these JITs using Jitterbug, the first framework to provide a precise specification of JIT correctness that is capable of ruling out real-world bugs, and an automated proof strategy that scales to practical implementations. Using Jitterbug, we have designed, implemented, and verified a new BPF JIT for 32-bit RISC-V, found and fixed 16 previously unknown bugs in five other deployed JITs, and developed new JIT optimizations; all of these changes have been upstreamed to the Linux kernel. The results show that it is possible to build a verified component within a large, unverified system with careful design of specification and proof strategy.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文描述了我们将形式化方法应用于Linux内核中的一个关键组件——伯克利包过滤器（BPF）虚拟机的即时编译器（JIT）——的经验。我们使用Jitterbug来验证这些JIT。Jitterbug是第一个为JIT正确性提供精确规范、能够排除真实世界漏洞，并提供可扩展至实际实现的自动化证明策略的框架。利用Jitterbug，我们设计、实现并验证了一个针对32位RISC-V的新型BPF JIT，在另外五个已部署的JIT中发现并修复了16个先前未知的漏洞，并开发了新的JIT优化；所有这些改动都已被合入Linux内核上游。结果表明，通过仔细设计规范和证明策略，可以在一个大型非验证系统中构建经过验证的组件。

import_candidates.title: COBRA: making transactional key-value stores verifiably serializable
import_candidates.abstract: Today's cloud databases offer strong properties, including serializability, sometimes called the gold standard database correctness property. But cloud databases are complicated black boxes, running in a different administrative domain from their clients. Thus, clients might like to know whether the databases are meeting their contract. To that end, we introduce cobra; cobra applies to transactional key-value stores. It is the first system that combines (a) black-box checking, of (b) serializability, while (c) scaling to real-world online transactional processing workloads. The core technical challenge is that the underlying search problem is computationally expensive. COBRA tames that problem by starting with a suitable SMT solver. COBRA then introduces several new techniques, including a new encoding of the validity condition; hardware acceleration to prune inputs to the solver; and a transaction segmentation mechanism that enables scaling and garbage collection. Cobra imposes modest overhead on clients, improves over baselines by 10\texttimes{} in verification cost, and (unlike the baselines) supports continuous verification. Our artifact can handle 2000 transactions/sec, equivalent to 170M/day.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 当今的云数据库提供强大的属性，包括可串行化，这有时被称为数据库正确性的黄金标准。但云数据库是复杂的黑盒，运行在与客户端不同的管理域中。因此，客户端可能希望知道数据库是否在履行其契约。为此，我们引入了COBRA；它适用于事务性键值存储。它是第一个将（a）黑盒检查与（b）可串行化检查相结合，并且（c）能够扩展到真实世界在线事务处理工作负载的系统。核心技术挑战是底层搜索问题计算成本高昂。COBRA通过先选用一个合适的SMT求解器来应对该问题。随后引入了几项新技术，包括新的有效性条件编码；用于缩减求解器输入规模的硬件加速；以及能够实现扩展和垃圾回收的事务分段机制。COBRA对客户端施加的开销适中，与基线相比在验证成本上提升了10倍，并且（与基线不同）支持持续验证。我们的工具能够处理每秒2000个事务，相当于每天1.7亿个事务。

import_candidates.title: Determinizing crash behavior with a verified snapshot-consistent flash translation layer
import_candidates.abstract: This paper introduces the design of a snapshot-consistent flash translation layer (SCFTL) for flash disks, which has a stronger guarantee about the possible behavior after a crash than conventional designs. More specifically, the flush operation of SCFTL also has the functionality of making a "disk snapshot." When a crash occurs, the flash disk is guaranteed to recover to the state right before the last flush. The major benefit of SCFTL is that it allows a more efficient design of upper layers in the storage stack. For example, the file system built on SCFTL does not require the use of a journal for crash recovery. Instead, it only needs to perform a flush operation of SCFTL at the end of each atomic transaction. We use a combination of a proof assistant, a symbolic executor, and an SMT solver, to formally verify the correctness of our SCFTL implementation. We modify the xv6 file system to support group commit and utilize SCFTL's stronger crash guarantee. Our evaluation using file system benchmarks shows that the modified xv6 on SCFTL is 3 to 30 times faster than xv6 with logging on conventional FTLs, and is in the worst case only two times slower than the state-of-the-art setting: the ext4 file system on the Physical Block Device (pblk) FTL.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于闪存盘、具有快照一致性保证的闪存转换层（SCFTL）的设计，该设计比传统设计对崩溃后可能的系统行为提供了更强的保证。更具体地说，SCFTL的flush操作还具备创建“磁盘快照”的功能。当发生崩溃时，闪存盘保证恢复到最近一次flush之前的状态。SCFTL的主要优点在于它使得存储栈上层的设计更加高效。例如，基于SCFTL构建的文件系统无需使用日志即可进行崩溃恢复；相反，它只需在每个原子事务结束时执行一次SCFTL的flush操作。我们结合使用证明助手、符号执行器和SMT求解器来形式化验证SCFTL实现的正确性。我们修改了xv6文件系统以支持组提交，并利用SCFTL更强的崩溃保证。通过文件系统基准测试进行的评估表明，基于SCFTL的修改版xv6比基于传统FTL并带有日志的xv6快3到30倍，在最坏情况下也仅比最新技术设置——基于物理块设备(pblk)FTL上的ext4文件系统——慢两倍。

import_candidates.title: Storage systems are distributed systems (so verify them that way!)
import_candidates.abstract: To verify distributed systems, prior work introduced a methodology for verifying both the code running on individual machines and the correctness of the overall system when those machines interact via an asynchronous distributed environment. The methodology requires neither domain-specific logic nor tooling. However, distributed systems are only one instance of the more general phenomenon of systems code that interacts with an asynchronous environment. We argue that the software of a storage system can (and should!) be viewed similarly. We evaluate this approach in VeriBetrKV, a key-value store based on a state-of-the-art Bεtree.In building VeriBetrKV, we introduce new techniques to scale automated verification to larger code bases, still without introducing domain-specific logic or tooling. In particular, we show a discipline that keeps the automated verification development cycle responsive. We also combine linear types with dynamic frames to relieve the programmer from most heap-reasoning obligations while enabling them to break out of the linear type system when needed. VeriBetrKV exhibits similar query performance to unverified databases. Its insertion performance is 24\texttimes{} faster than unverified BerkeleyDB and 8\texttimes{} slower than RocksDB.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 为了验证分布式系统，先前的工作提出了一种方法论，用于验证单个机器上运行的代码以及当这些机器通过异步分布式环境交互时整个系统的正确性。该方法论既不需要特定领域的逻辑，也不需要特定领域的工具。然而，分布式系统只是与异步环境交互的系统代码这一更普遍现象的一个实例。我们认为存储系统的软件也可以（并且应该！）以类似的方式看待。我们在VeriBetrKV中评估了这种方法，这是一个基于最先进的Bε树的关键值存储。在构建VeriBetrKV时，我们引入了新技术，将自动化验证扩展到更大的代码库，同时仍然不引入特定领域的逻辑或工具。具体而言，我们展示了一种保持自动化验证开发周期响应性的纪律。我们还将线性类型与动态帧相结合，以减轻程序员大部分堆推理义务，同时使他们在需要时能够跳出线性类型系统。VeriBetrKV的查询性能与未经验证的数据库相似。其插入性能比未经验证的BerkeleyDB快24倍，比RocksDB慢8倍。

import_candidates.title: Fast RDMA-based ordered key-value store using remote learned cache
import_candidates.abstract: RDMA (Remote Direct Memory Access) has gained considerable interests in network-attached in-memory key-value stores. However, traversing the remote tree-based index in ordered stores with RDMA becomes a critical obstacle, causing an order-of-magnitude slowdown and limited scalability due to multiple roundtrips. Using index cache with conventional wisdom--caching partial data and traversing them locally--usually leads to limited effect because of unavoidable capacity misses, massive random accesses, and costly cache invalidations.We argue that the machine learning (ML) model is a perfect cache structure for the tree-based index, termed learned cache. Based on it, we design and implement XSTORE, an RDMA-based ordered key-value store with a new hybrid architecture that retains a tree-based index at the server to perform dynamic workloads (e.g., inserts) and leverages a learned cache at the client to perform static workloads (e.g., gets and scans). The key idea is to decouple ML model retraining from index updating by maintaining a layer of indirection from logical to actual positions of key-value pairs. It allows a stale learned cache to continue predicting a correct position for a lookup key. XSTORE ensures correctness using a validation mechanism with a fallback path and further uses speculative execution to minimize the cost of cache misses. Evaluations with YCSB benchmarks and production workloads show that a single XSTORE server can achieve over 80 million read-only requests per second. This number out-performs state-of-the-art RDMA-based ordered key-value stores (namely, DrTM-Tree, Cell, and eRPC+Masstree) by up to 5.9\texttimes{} (from 3.7\texttimes{}). For workloads with inserts, XSTORE still provides up to 3.5\texttimes{} (from 2.7\texttimes{}) throughput speedup, achieving 53M reqs/s. The learned cache can also reduces client-side memory usage and further provides an efficient memory-performance tradeoff, e.g., saving 99\% memory at the cost of 20\% peak throughput.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: RDMA（远程直接内存访问）在网络附加内存键值存储中引起了相当大的关注。然而，在有序存储中通过RDMA遍历远程基于树的索引成为一个关键障碍，由于多次往返，导致性能降低一个数量级并限制可扩展性。使用传统智慧的索引缓存（在本地缓存部分数据并遍历）通常效果有限，因为不可避免的容量缺失、大量随机访问和昂贵的缓存失效。我们认为机器学习（ML）模型是树状索引的完美缓存结构，称为学习型缓存。在此基础上，我们设计并实现了XSTORE，一个基于RDMA的有序键值存储，采用新的混合架构：在服务器端保留树状索引以处理动态工作负载（如插入），并在客户端利用学习型缓存处理静态工作负载（如查询和扫描）。关键思想是通过维护从逻辑位置到键值对实际位置的间接层，将ML模型重新训练与索引更新解耦。这允许过时的学习型缓存继续为查找键预测正确位置。XSTORE使用带有回退路径的验证机制确保正确性，并进一步利用推测执行最小化缓存未命中的成本。使用YCSB基准测试和生产工作负载的评估表明，单个XSTORE服务器可以达到每秒超过8000万次只读请求。这一数字比最先进的基于RDMA的有序键值存储（即DrTM-Tree、Cell和eRPC+Masstree）高出高达5.9倍（从3.7倍起）。对于包含插入的工作负载，XSTORE仍提供高达3.5倍（从2.7倍起）的吞吐量加速，达到5300万请求/秒。学习型缓存还可以减少客户端内存使用，并提供高效的内存-性能权衡，例如，以20%的峰值吞吐量代价节省99%的内存。

import_candidates.title: CrossFS: a cross-layered direct-access file system
import_candidates.abstract: We design CrossFS, a cross-layered direct-access file system disaggregated across user-level, firmware, and kernel layers for scaling I/O performance and improving concurrency. CrossFS is designed to exploit host- and device-level compute capabilities. For concurrency with or without data sharing across threads and processes, CrossFS introduces a file descriptor-based concurrency control that maps each file descriptor to one hardware-level I/O queue. This design allows CrossFS's firmware component to process disjoint access across file descriptors concurrently. CrossFS delegates concurrency control to powerful host-CPUs, which convert the file descriptor synchronization problem into an I/O queue request ordering problem. To guarantee crash consistency in the cross-layered design, CrossFS exploits byte-addressable nonvolatile memory for I/O queue persistence and designs a lightweight firmware-level journaling mechanism. Finally, CrossFS designs a firmware-level I/O scheduler for efficient dispatch of file descriptor requests. Evaluation of emulated CrossFS on storage-class memory shows up to 4.87X concurrent access gains for benchmarks and 2.32X gains for real-world applications over the state-of-the-art kernel, user-level, and firmware file systems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们设计了CrossFS，一种跨层直接访问文件系统，它被分解到用户层、固件层和内核层，以扩展I/O性能并提高并发性。CrossFS旨在利用主机和设备级的计算能力。为了支持线程和进程间无论是否共享数据的并发，CrossFS引入了一种基于文件描述符的并发控制，将每个文件描述符映射到一个硬件级I/O队列。这种设计允许CrossFS的固件组件并发地处理跨文件描述符的不相交访问。CrossFS将并发控制委托给强大的主机CPU，将文件描述符同步问题转化为I/O队列请求排序问题。为了保证跨层设计中的崩溃一致性，CrossFS利用字节寻址的非易失性内存实现I/O队列持久化，并设计了一种轻量级的固件级日志机制。最后，CrossFS设计了一个固件级I/O调度器，用于高效调度文件描述符请求。在存储级内存上对CrossFS的模拟评估显示，与最先进的内核级、用户级和固件级文件系统相比，基准测试的并发访问性能提升可达4.87倍，实际应用程序的并发访问性能提升可达2.32倍。

import_candidates.title: From WiscKey to Bourbon: a learned index for log-structured merge trees
import_candidates.abstract: We introduce BOURBON, a log-structured merge (LSM) tree that utilizes machine learning to provide fast lookups. We base the design and implementation of BOURBON on empirically-grounded principles that we derive through careful analysis of LSM design. BOURBON employs greedy piecewise linear regression to learn key distributions, enabling fast lookup with minimal computation, and applies a cost-benefit strategy to decide when learning will be worthwhile. Through a series of experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets, we show that BOURBON improves lookup performance by 1.23\texttimes{}-1.78\texttimes{} as compared to state-of-the-art production LSMs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们介绍了BOURBON，一种利用机器学习提供快速查找的日志结构合并（LSM）树。我们基于通过仔细分析LSM设计而得出的经验性原则来设计和实现BOURBON。BOURBON采用贪婪分段线性回归来学习键分布，以最小的计算量实现快速查找，并应用成本效益策略来决定何时学习是值得的。通过在合成数据集和真实数据集上的一系列实验，我们表明，与最先进的生产级LSM相比，BOURBON将查找性能提高了1.23倍至1.78倍。

import_candidates.title: A large scale analysis of hundreds of in-memory cache clusters at Twitter
import_candidates.abstract: Modern web services use in-memory caching extensively to increase throughput and reduce latency. There have been several workload analyses of production systems that have fueled research in improving the effectiveness of in-memory caching systems. However, the coverage is still sparse considering the wide spectrum of industrial cache use cases. In this work, we significantly further the understanding of real-world cache workloads by collecting production traces from 153 in-memory cache clusters at Twitter, sifting through over 80 TB of data, and sometimes interpreting the workloads in the context of the business logic behind them. We perform a comprehensive analysis to characterize cache workloads based on traffic pattern, time-to-live (TTL), popularity distribution, and size distribution. A fine-grained view of different workloads uncover the diversity of use cases: many are far more write-heavy or more skewed than previously shown and some display unique temporal patterns. We also observe that TTL is an important and sometimes defining parameter of cache working sets. Our simulations show that ideal replacement strategy in production caches can be surprising, for example, FIFO works the best for a large number of workloads.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代Web服务广泛使用内存缓存来提高吞吐量和降低延迟。已有若干针对生产系统的工作负载分析，推动了提高内存缓存系统有效性的研究。然而，考虑到工业缓存用例的广泛范围，覆盖仍然稀少。在这项工作中，我们通过从Twitter的153个内存缓存集群收集生产跟踪、筛选超过80 TB数据，并有时结合其背后的业务逻辑来解释工作负载，进一步加深了对真实世界缓存工作负载的理解。我们基于流量模式、生存时间（TTL）、流行度分布和大小分布进行了全面分析以刻画缓存工作负载。对不同工作负载的细粒度视图揭示了用例的多样性：许多工作负载比此前显示的更偏向写入密集型或更倾斜，有些还显示出独特的时间模式。我们还观察到TTL是缓存工作集的一个重要且有时具有决定性的参数。我们的模拟表明，生产缓存中的理想替换策略可能出人意料，例如，在许多工作负载中，FIFO效果最佳。

import_candidates.title: Generalized sub-query fusion for eliminating redundant I/O from big-data queries
import_candidates.abstract: SQL is the de-facto language for big-data analytics. Despite the cost of distributed SQL execution being dominated by disk and network I/O, we find that state-of-the-art optimizers produce plans that are not I/O optimal. For a significant fraction of queries (25\% of popular benchmarks like TPCDS), a large amount of data is shuffled redundantly between different pairs of stages. The fundamental reason for this limitation is that optimizers do not have the right set of primitives to perform reasoning at the map-reduce level that can potentially identify and eliminate the redundant I/O.This paper proposes RESIN, an optimizer extension that adds first-class support for map-reduce reasoning. RESIN uses a novel technique called Generalized Sub-Query Fusion that identifies sub-queries computing on overlapping data, and fuses them into the same map-reduce stages. The analysis is general; it does not require that the sub-queries be syntactically the same, nor are they required to produce the same output. Sub-query fusion allows RESIN to sometimes also eliminate expensive binary operations like Joins and Unions altogether for further gains.We have integrated RESIN into SPARKSQL and evaluated it on TPCDS, a standard analytics benchmark suite. Our results demonstrate that the proposed optimizations apply to 40\% of the queries and speed up a large fraction of them by 1.1-6\texttimes{}, reducing the overall execution time of the benchmark suite by 12\%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: SQL是大数据分析的事实标准语言。尽管分布式SQL执行的成本主要由磁盘和网络I/O决定，但我们发现最先进的优化器生成的计划并不是I/O最优的。在相当大比例的查询中（如TPCDS等流行基准测试的25%），大量数据在不同阶段对之间被冗余地重排。这种局限的根本原因在于优化器缺乏在map-reduce层面进行推理的正确原语，从而无法识别和消除冗余I/O。本文提出了RESIN，一个优化器扩展，为map-reduce推理添加了一等支持。RESIN使用一种称为通用子查询融合的新技术，识别在重叠数据上计算的子查询，并将其融合到相同的map-reduce阶段。该分析是通用的；它不要求子查询语法相同，也不要求它们产生相同的输出。子查询融合有时还使RESIN能够完全消除昂贵的二元操作（如Join和Union）以进一步获益。我们已将RESIN集成到SPARKSQL中，并在标准分析基准套件TPCDS上进行了评估。结果表明，所提出的优化适用于40%的查询，并加速了其中很大一部分1.1-6倍，将整个基准套件的总执行时间减少了12%。

import_candidates.title: A simpler and faster NIC driver model for network functions
import_candidates.abstract: The advent of software network functions calls for stronger correctness guarantees and higher performance at every level of the stack. Current network stacks trade simplicity for performance and flexibility, especially in their driver model. We show that performance and simplicity can coexist, at the cost of some flexibility, with a new NIC driver model tailored to network functions. The key idea behind our model is that the driver can efficiently reuse packet buffers because buffers follow a single logical path.We implement a driver for the Intel 82599 network card in 550 lines of code. By merely replacing the state-of-the-art driver with our driver, formal verification of the entire software stack completes in 7x less time, while the verified functions' throughput improves by 160\%. Our driver also beats, on realistic workloads, the throughput of drivers that cannot yet be formally verified, thanks to its low variability and resource use.Our code is available at github.com/dslab-epfl/tinynf.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 软件网络功能的出现对整个协议栈的每一层都提出了更强的正确性保证和更高性能的要求。当前的网络栈在驱动模型上牺牲了简洁性以换取性能和灵活性。我们表明，如果在灵活性方面做出一定的让步，一个针对网络功能定制的新NIC驱动模型可以实现性能与简洁性的共存。我们模型背后的关键思想是，由于缓冲区沿着单一逻辑路径流动，驱动程序可以高效地重复利用数据包缓冲区。我们用550行代码为Intel 82599网卡实现了一个驱动程序。仅仅是将现有最先进的驱动程序替换为我们编写的驱动程序，整个软件栈的形式化验证时间就缩短了7倍，同时通过验证的函数的吞吐量提高了160%。在现实负载下，我们的驱动程序依靠较低的可变性和资源占用，超越了那些目前仍无法进行形式化验证的驱动程序的吞吐量。我们的代码发布在github.com/dslab-epfl/tinynf。

import_candidates.title: PANIC: a high-performance programmable NIC for multi-tenant networks
import_candidates.abstract: Programmable NICs have diverse uses, and there is a need for a NIC platform that can offload computation from multiple co-resident applications to many different types of substrates, including hardware accelerators, embedded FPGAs, and embedded processor cores. Unfortunately, there is no existing NIC design that can simultaneously support a large number of diverse offloads while ensuring high throughput/low latency, multi-tenant isolation, flexible offload chaining, and support for offloads with variable performance.This paper presents PANIC, a new programmable NIC. There are two new key components of the PANIC design that enable it to overcome the limitations of existing NICs: 1) A high-performance switching interconnect that scalably connects independent engines into offload chains, and 2) A new hybrid push/pull packet scheduler that provides cross-tenant performance isolation and low-latency load-balancing across parallel offload engines. From experiments performed on an 100 Gbps FPGA-based prototype, we find that this design overcomes the limitations of state-of-the-art programmable NICs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 可编程网卡具有多种用途，并且需要一种网卡平台，能够将多个共存应用程序的计算卸载到多种不同类型的底层设施上，包括硬件加速器、嵌入式FPGA和嵌入式处理器核心。不幸的是，现有网卡设计无法同时支持大量多样化卸载，同时保证高吞吐量/低延迟、多租户隔离、灵活的卸载链，以及支持性能可变的卸载。本文提出PANIC，一种新型可编程网卡。PANIC设计的两个关键新组件使其能够克服现有网卡的局限性：1）一种高性能交换互连，可将独立引擎可扩展地连接成卸载链；2）一种新的混合推/拉分组调度器，可提供跨租户性能隔离和跨并行卸载引擎的低延迟负载均衡。通过在100 Gbps FPGA原型上进行的实验，我们发现该设计克服了最先进可编程网卡的局限性。

import_candidates.title: Semeru: a memory-disaggregated managed runtime
import_candidates.abstract: Resource-disaggregated architectures have risen in popularity for large datacenters. However, prior disaggregation systems are designed for native applications; in addition, all of them require applications to possess excellent locality to be efficiently executed. In contrast, programs written in managed languages are subject to periodic garbage collection (GC), which is a typical graph workload with poor locality. Although most datacenter applications are written in managed languages, current systems are far from delivering acceptable performance for these applications.This paper presents Semeru, a distributed JVM that can dramatically improve the performance of managed cloud applications in a memory-disaggregated environment. Its design possesses three major innovations: (1) a universal Java heap, which provides a unified abstraction of virtual memory across CPU and memory servers and allows any legacy program to run without modifications; (2) a distributed GC, which offloads object tracing to memory servers so that tracing is performed closer to data; and (3) a swap system in the OS kernel that works with the runtime to swap page data efficiently. An evaluation of Semeru on a set of widely-deployed systems shows very promising results.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 资源分解架构已在大型数据中心中日益流行。然而，先前的分解系统是为原生应用程序设计的；此外，所有此类系统都要求应用程序具备良好的局部性才能高效执行。相比之下，用托管语言编写的程序需要定期进行垃圾回收（GC），这是典型的图工作负载，具有较差的局部性。尽管大多数数据中心应用程序都是用托管语言编写的，现有系统却远不能为这些应用程序提供可接受的性能。本文提出了Semeru，一种分布式JVM，可以显著提升内存分解环境中托管云应用程序的性能。其设计包含三项主要创新：（1）通用Java堆，跨CPU和内存服务器提供统一的虚拟内存抽象，允许任何遗留程序无需修改即可运行；（2）分布式GC，将对象追踪任务卸载到内存服务器，使追踪更接近数据；（3）操作系统内核中的交换系统，与运行时协同高效地交换页面数据。在一组广泛部署的系统上对Semeru的评估显示了非常有前景的结果。

import_candidates.title: Caladan: mitigating interference at microsecond timescales
import_candidates.abstract: The conventional wisdom is that CPU resources such as cores, caches, and memory bandwidth must be partitioned to achieve performance isolation between tasks. Both the widespread availability of cache partitioning in modern CPUs and the recommended practice of pinning latency-sensitive applications to dedicated cores attest to this belief.In this paper, we show that resource partitioning is neither necessary nor sufficient. Many applications experience bursty request patterns or phased behavior, drastically changing the amount and type of resources they need. Unfortunately, partitioning-based systems fail to react quickly enough to keep up with these changes, resulting in extreme spikes in latency and lost opportunities to increase CPU utilization.Caladan is a new CPU scheduler that can achieve significantly better quality of service (tail latency, throughput, etc.) through a collection of control signals and policies that rely on fast core allocation instead of resource partitioning. Caladan consists of a centralized scheduler core that actively manages resource contention in the memory hierarchy and between hyperthreads, and a kernel module that bypasses the standard Linux Kernel scheduler to support microsecond-scale monitoring and placement of tasks. When colocating memcached with a best-effort, garbage-collected workload, Caladan outperforms Parties, a state-of-the-art resource partitioning system, by 11,000\texttimes{}, reducing tail latency from 580 ms to 52 µs during shifts in resource usage while maintaining high CPU utilization.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 传统观点认为，必须对CPU资源（如核心、缓存和内存带宽）进行分区，才能在任务之间实现性能隔离。现代CPU中缓存分区技术的广泛可用性以及将延迟敏感型应用固定到专用核心的推荐做法都证明了这一信念。在本文中，我们表明资源分区既不必要也不充分。许多应用会出现突发性请求模式或阶段性行为，导致其所需资源的数量和类型发生剧烈变化。不幸的是，基于分区的系统无法足够快速地做出反应以适应这些变化，从而导致极端的延迟尖峰和CPU利用率提升机会的丧失。Caladan是一种新的CPU调度器，通过一系列依赖于快速核心分配而非资源分区的控制信号和策略，能够实现显著更好的服务质量（尾延迟、吞吐量等）。Caladan由一个集中式调度器核心组成，该核心主动管理内存层次结构和超线程之间的资源争用，并包含一个绕过标准Linux内核调度器以支持微秒级任务监控和放置的内核模块。当将memcached与一个尽力而为的、带垃圾回收的工作负载共存时，Caladan比最先进的资源分区系统Parties性能提升11,000倍，在资源使用变化期间将尾延迟从580毫秒降低到52微秒，同时保持较高的CPU利用率。

import_candidates.title: Overload control for µs-scale RPCs with breakwater
import_candidates.abstract: Modern datacenter applications are composed of hundreds of microservices with high degrees of fanout. As a result, they are sensitive to tail latency and require high request throughputs. Maintaining these characteristics under overload is difficult, especially for RPCs with short service times. In this paper, we consider the challenging case of microsecond-scale RPCs, where the cost of communicating information and dropping a request is similar to the cost of processing a request. We present Breakwater, an overload control scheme that can prevent overload in microsecond-scale services through a new, server-driven admission control scheme that issues credits based on server-side queueing delay. Breakwater contributes several techniques to amortize communication costs. It engages in demand speculation, where it assumes clients have unmet demand and issues additional credits when the server is not overloaded. Moreover, it piggybacks client-side demand information in RPC requests and credits in RPC responses. To cope with the occasional bursts in load caused by demand speculation, Breakwater drops requests when overloaded using active queue management. When clients' demand spikes unexpectedly to 1.4\texttimes{} capacity, Breakwater converges to stable performance in less than 20 ms with no congestion collapse while DAGOR and SEDA take 500 ms and 1.58 s to recover from congestion collapse, respectively.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代数据中心应用由数百个具有高扇出度的微服务组成。因此，它们对尾延迟敏感，并需要高请求吞吐量。在过载情况下维持这些特性十分困难，尤其是对于服务时间很短的RPC。在本文中，我们考虑了微秒级RPC这一具有挑战性的场景，其中通信信息和丢弃请求的成本与处理请求的成本相近。我们提出了Breakwater，一种过载控制方案，通过一种新的、基于服务器端队列延迟发放信用的服务器驱动准入控制机制，来防止微秒级服务的过载。Breakwater贡献了几项摊销通信成本的技术。它进行需求推测，假设客户端有未满足的需求，并在服务器未过载时发放额外信用。此外，它在RPC请求中捎带客户端需求信息，在RPC响应中捎带信用。为了应对需求推测偶尔引起的负载突发，Breakwater在过载时使用主动队列管理丢弃请求。当客户端需求意外飙升至容量的1.4倍时，Breakwater在不到20毫秒内收敛到稳定性能且不发生拥塞崩溃，而DAGOR和SEDA分别需要500毫秒和1.58秒才能从拥塞崩溃中恢复。

import_candidates.title: AIFM: high-performance, application-integrated far memory
import_candidates.abstract: Memory is the most contended and least elastic resource in datacenter servers today. Applications can use only local memory--which may be scarce--even though memory might be readily available on another server. This leads to unnecessary killings of workloads under memory pressure and reduces effective server utilization.We present application-integrated far memory (AIFM), which makes remote, "far" memory available to applications through a simple API and with high performance. AIFM achieves the same common-case access latency for far memory as for local RAM; it avoids read and write amplification that paging-based approaches suffer; it allows data structure engineers to build remoteable, hybrid near/far memory data structures; and it makes far memory transparent and easy to use for application developers.Our key insight is that exposing application-level semantics to a high-performance runtime makes efficient remoteable memory possible. Developers use AIFM's APIs to make allocations remoteable, and AIFM's runtime handles swapping objects in and out, prefetching, and memory evacuation.We evaluate AIFM with a prototypical web application frontend, a NYC taxi data analytics workload, a memcached-like key-value cache, and Snappy compression. Adding AIFM remoteable memory to these applications increases their available memory without performance penalty. AIFM outperforms Fastswap, a state-of-the-art kernel-integrated, paging-based far memory system [6] by up to 61\texttimes{}.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 内存是当今数据中心服务器中争用最严重且弹性最差的资源。应用程序只能使用本地内存（可能很稀缺），即使另一台服务器上可能很容易获得内存。这导致在内存压力下不必要地终止工作负载，并降低了服务器的有效利用率。我们提出了应用集成远端内存（AIFM），它通过一个简单的API以高性能将远端“远”内存提供给应用程序。AIFM实现了与本地RAM相同的常见访问延迟；它避免了基于分页的方法所遭受的读和写放大；它允许数据结构工程师构建可远程化的混合近/远内存数据结构；并使远端内存对应用程序开发人员透明且易于使用。我们的关键见解是，将应用程序级语义暴露给高性能运行时可以实现高效的远程内存。开发人员使用AIFM的API使分配可远程化，AIFM的运行时处理对象的换入换出、预取和内存疏散。我们使用一个原型Web应用程序前端、一个纽约出租车数据分析工作负载、一个类memcached的键值缓存以及Snappy压缩来评估AIFM。为这些应用程序添加AIFM可远程内存可在无性能损失的情况下增加其可用内存。AIFM的性能比最先进的基于内核集成、分页的远端内存系统Fastswap [6] 最多可提高61倍。

import_candidates.title: Performance-optimal read-only transactions
import_candidates.abstract: Read-only transactions are critical for consistently reading data spread across a distributed storage system but have worse performance than simple, non-transactional reads. We identify three properties of simple reads that are necessary for read-only transactions to be performance-optimal, i.e., come as close as possible to simple reads. We demonstrate a fundamental tradeoff in the design of read-only transactions by proving that performance optimality is impossible to achieve with strict serializability, the strongest consistency.Guided by this result, we present PORT, a performance-optimal design with the strongest consistency to date. Central to PORT are version clocks, a specialized logical clock that concisely captures the necessary ordering constraints. We show the generality of PORT with two applications. Scylla-PORT provides process-ordered serializability with simple writes and shows performance comparable to its nontransactional base system. Eiger-PORT provides causal consistency with write transactions and significantly improves the performance of its transactional base system.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 只读事务对于一致地读取分布式存储系统中分布的数据至关重要，但其性能比简单的非事务性读取要差。我们确定了简单读取的三个属性，这些属性对于只读事务达到性能最优（即尽可能接近简单读取）是必要的。我们通过证明在最严格的一致性——严格可串行化下，性能最优无法实现，展示了只读事务设计中的一个根本性权衡。受此结果指导，我们提出了PORT，一个至今在最强一致性下实现性能最优的设计。PORT的核心是版本时钟（version clocks），一种专门化的逻辑时钟，能够简洁地捕获必要的排序约束。我们通过两个应用展示了PORT的通用性。Scylla-PORT提供具有简单写入的进程有序可串行化，并展现出与其非事务性基础系统相当的性能。Eiger-PORT提供支持写事务的因果一致性，并显著提高了其事务性基础系统的性能。

import_candidates.title: Toward a generic fault tolerance technique for partial network partitioning
import_candidates.abstract: We present an extensive study focused on partial network partitioning. Partial network partitions disrupt the communication between some but not all nodes in a cluster.First, we conduct a comprehensive study of system failures caused by this fault in 12 popular systems. Our study reveals that the studied failures are catastrophic (e.g., lead to data loss), easily manifest, and can manifest by partially partitioning a single node.Second, we dissect the design of eight popular systems and identify four principled approaches for tolerating partial partitions. Unfortunately, our analysis shows that implemented fault tolerance techniques are inadequate for modern systems; they either patch a particular mechanism or lead to a complete cluster shutdown, even when alternative network paths exist.Finally, our findings motivate us to build Nifty, a transparent communication layer that masks partial network partitions. Nifty builds an overlay between nodes to detour packets around partial partitions. Our prototype evaluation with six popular systems shows that Nifty overcomes the shortcomings of current fault tolerance approaches and effectively masks partial partitions while imposing negligible overhead.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们针对部分网络分区进行了广泛的研究。部分网络分区会中断集群中部分节点之间的通信，但并非所有节点。首先，我们对该故障在12个流行系统中造成的系统故障进行了全面的研究。我们的研究表明，所研究的故障是灾难性的（例如导致数据丢失），很容易显现，并且可以通过部分分区单个节点来显现。其次，我们剖析了八个流行系统的设计，并确定了容忍部分分区的四种原则性方法。不幸的是，我们的分析表明，已实现的容错技术不足以满足现代系统的需求；它们要么修补某个特定机制，要么导致整个集群停机，即使存在替代网络路径也是如此。最后，我们的研究结果促使我们构建了Nifty，一个透明的通信层，用于掩盖部分网络分区。Nifty在节点之间构建一个覆盖网络，将数据包绕开部分分区。我们使用六个流行系统进行的原型评估表明，Nifty克服了当前容错方法的缺点，能有效掩盖部分分区，同时引入的开销可忽略不计。

import_candidates.title: PACEMAKER: avoiding HeART attacks in storage clusters with disk-adaptive redundancy
import_candidates.abstract: Data redundancy provides resilience in large-scale storage clusters, but imposes significant cost overhead. Substantial space-savings can be realized by tuning redundancy schemes to observed disk failure rates. However, prior design proposals for such tuning are unusable in real-world clusters, because the IO load of transitions between schemes overwhelms the storage infrastructure (termed transition overload).This paper analyzes traces for millions of disks from production systems at Google, NetApp, and Backblaze to expose and understand transition overload as a roadblock to disk-adaptive redundancy: transition IO under existing approaches can consume 100\% cluster IO continuously for several weeks. Building on the insights drawn, we present PACEMAKER, a low-overhead disk-adaptive redundancy orchestrator. PACEMAKER mitigates transition overload by (1) proactively organizing data layouts to make future transitions efficient, and (2) initiating transitions proactively in a manner that avoids urgency while not compromising on space-savings. Evaluation of PACEMAKER with traces from four large (110K-450K disks) production clusters show that the transition IO requirement decreases to never needing more than 5\% cluster IO bandwidth (0.2-0.4\% on average). PACEMAKER achieves this while providing overall space-savings of 14-20\% and never leaving data under-protected. We also describe and experiment with an integration of PACEMAKER into HDFS.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 数据冗余为大型存储集群提供了弹性，但会带来显著的额外成本。通过根据观测到的磁盘故障率调整冗余方案，可以实现可观的存储空间节省。然而，之前针对此类调整的设计方案在实际集群中不可用，因为方案转换所产生的IO负载会使存储基础设施不堪重负（称为转换过载）。本文分析了来自Google、NetApp和Backblaze生产系统中数百万磁盘的跟踪数据，以揭示并理解转换过载作为磁盘自适应冗余的主要障碍：现有方法下的转换IO可能连续数周消耗100%的集群IO。基于这些洞察，我们提出了PACEMAKER，一种低开销的磁盘自适应冗余编排器。PACEMAKER通过以下方式减轻转换过载：(1) 主动组织数据布局，使未来的转换更高效，(2) 主动发起转换以避免紧急性，同时不损害空间节省。使用来自四个大型（110K-450K磁盘）生产集群的跟踪数据进行的评估显示，转换IO需求降低到永远不需要超过5%的集群IO带宽（平均0.2-0.4%）。PACEMAKER在实现这一点的同时，总体节省了14-20%的存储空间，并且从未使数据保护不足。我们还描述并实验了PACEMAKER集成到HDFS的方案。

import_candidates.title: Pegasus: Tolerating skewed workloads in distributed storage with in-network coherence directories
import_candidates.abstract: High performance distributed storage systems face the challenge of load imbalance caused by skewed and dynamic workloads. This paper introduces Pegasus, a new storage system that leverages new-generation programmable switch ASICs to balance load across storage servers. Pegasus uses selective replication of the most popular objects in the data store to distribute load. Using a novel in-network coherence directory, the Pegasus switch tracks and manages the location of replicated objects. This allows it to achieve load-aware forwarding and dynamic rebalancing for replicated keys, while still guaranteeing data coherence and consistency. The Pegasus design is practical to implement as it stores only forwarding metadata in the switch data plane. The resulting system improves the throughput of a distributed in-memory key-value store by more than 10\texttimes{} under a latency SLO - results which hold across a large set of workloads with varying degrees of skew, read/write ratio, object sizes, and dynamism.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 高性能分布式存储系统面临由偏斜和动态工作负载引起的负载不平衡挑战。本文介绍了Pegasus，一种利用新一代可编程交换机ASIC来平衡存储服务器负载的新型存储系统。Pegasus通过对数据存储中最流行的对象进行选择性复制来分散负载。利用一种新颖的网内一致性目录，Pegasus交换机跟踪并管理复制对象的位置。这使得它能够实现对复制键的负载感知转发和动态重新平衡，同时仍然保证数据的一致性和连贯性。Pegasus的设计具有实用性，因为它只在交换机数据平面中存储转发元数据。由此产生的系统在延迟SLO下将分布式内存键值存储的吞吐量提高了10倍以上——这一结果在具有不同程度偏斜、读写比、对象大小和动态性的大量工作负载中均成立。

import_candidates.title: FlightTracker: consistency across read-optimized online stores at facebook
import_candidates.abstract: Social media platforms deliver fresh personalized content by performing a large number of reads from an online data store. This store must be optimized for read efficiency, availability, and scalability. Multi-layer caches and asynchronous replication can satisfy these goals, such as in Facebook's graph store TAO, but it is challenging for the resulting system to provide a developer-friendly consistency model. TAO originally provided read-your-writes (RYW) consistency via write-through caching, but scaling challenges with this approach have led us to a new implementation.This paper introduces FlightTracker, a family of APIs and systems which now manage consistency for online access to Facebook's graph. FlightTracker implicitly provides RYW and can be explicitly used to provide alternative consistency guarantees for special use cases; it enables flexible communication patterns between caches, which we have found important as the number of datacenters increases; it extends the same consistency guarantees to cross-shard indexes and materialized views, allowing us to transparently optimize queries; and it provides a uniform primitive for clients to obtain desired consistency guarantees across a variety of data stores. FlightTracker delivers these advantages while preserving the efficiency, latency, and availability benefits of asynchronous replication for the underlying systems, managing consistency for billions of users and more than 1015 queries per day.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 社交媒体平台通过从在线数据存储执行大量读取来提供新鲜个性化内容。该存储必须针对读取效率、可用性和可扩展性进行优化。多层缓存和异步复制可以满足这些目标，例如 Facebook 的图存储 TAO，但由此产生的系统很难提供对开发者友好的一致性模型。TAO 最初通过写穿缓存提供读己之写（RYW）一致性，但这种方法带来的扩展挑战使我们的实现焕然一新。本文介绍 FlightTracker，这是一个 API 和系统家族，现在用于管理对 Facebook 图的在线访问一致性。FlightTracker 隐式提供 RYW，并且可显式用于为特殊用例提供替代一致性保证；它支持缓存之间灵活的通信模式，我们发现在数据中心数量增加时这很重要；它将相同的一致性保证扩展到跨分片索引和物化视图，使我们能够透明地优化查询；并且它为客户端提供统一的原语，以在各种数据存储中获得所需的一致性保证。FlightTracker 在保持底层系统异步复制的效率、延迟和可用性优势的同时，带来了这些优势，管理着数十亿用户和每天超过 10^15 次查询的一致性。

import_candidates.title: KVell+: snapshot isolation without snapshots
import_candidates.abstract: Snapshot Isolation (SI) enables online analytical processing (OLAP) queries to observe a snapshot of the data at the time the query is issued, despite concurrent updates by online transactional processing (OLTP) transactions. The conventional implementation of SI creates a new version of a data item when it is updated, rather than overwriting the old version. Versions are garbage collected when they can no longer be read by any OLAP query. Frequent updates during long-running OLAP queries therefore create significant space amplification, and garbage collection can give rise to latency spikes for OLTP transactions. These problems are exacerbated on modern low-latency drives that can persist millions of updates per second.We observe that analytic queries often consist in large part of commutative processing of data items resulting from range scans in which each item in the range is read exactly once. We introduce Online Commutative Processing (OLCP), a new model for processing analytical queries, that takes advantage of this observation. Under OLCP, analytical queries observe the same snapshot of the data as they would under conventional SI, but space amplification and garbage collection costs are largely and oftentimes nearly entirely avoided. When an item in such a range is updated, the old version of the item is propagated to the OLCP queries that might need it instead of being kept in the store.We demonstrate OLCP's expressiveness by showing how to formulate, among others, the TPC-H benchmark queries in OLCP. We implement OLCP in KVell+, an extension of KVell, a key-value store for NVMe SSDs. Using YCSB-T, TPC-CH and production workloads from Nutanix, we run a wide range of analytics queries concurrently with write-intensive transactions. We show that OLCP incurs little or no space amplification or garbage collection overhead. As a surprising by-product we also show that OLCP speeds up analytical queries compared to SI.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 快照隔离（SI）使在线分析处理（OLAP）查询能够在发出查询时观察到数据的快照，尽管在线事务处理（OLTP）事务会并发更新。SI的常规实现是在数据项更新时创建其新版本，而非覆盖旧版本。当旧版本不再被任何OLAP查询读取时，它们会被垃圾回收。因此，在长时间运行的OLAP查询期间频繁更新会导致显著的空间放大，而垃圾回收可能引起OLTP事务的延迟尖峰。在现代低延迟驱动器上，这些问题会更加严重，因为此类驱动器每秒可持久化数百万次更新。我们观察到，分析查询通常在很大程度上包含由范围扫描产生的数据项的交换性（commutative）处理，其中范围内每个项恰好被读取一次。我们引入在线交换处理（OLCP），一种处理分析查询的新模型，利用了这一观察。在OLCP下，分析查询观察到的数据快照与常规SI下相同，但空间放大和垃圾回收成本在很大程度上（往往几乎完全）被避免。当此类范围内的一个项被更新时，该项的旧版本会被传播给可能需要它的OLCP查询，而不是存储在存储中。我们通过展示如何用OLCP表述TPC-H基准查询（以及其他查询），证明了OLCP的表达能力。我们在KVell+中实现了OLCP，KVell+是KVell（一种面向NVMe SSD的键值存储）的扩展。使用YCSB-T、TPC-CH和Nutanix的生产工作负载，我们并发运行了广泛的分析查询与写密集型事务。我们表明，OLCP几乎或完全不产生空间放大或垃圾回收开销。作为令人惊讶的副产品，我们还表明，与SI相比，OLCP加速了分析查询。

import_candidates.title: Serving DNNs like clockwork: performance predictability from the bottom up
import_candidates.abstract: Machine learning inference is becoming a core building block for interactive web applications. As a result, the underlying model serving systems on which these applications depend must consistently meet low latency targets. Existing model serving architectures use well-known reactive techniques to alleviate common-case sources of latency, but cannot effectively curtail tail latency caused by unpredictable execution times. Yet the underlying execution times are not fundamentally unpredictable--on the contrary we observe that inference using Deep Neural Network (DNN) models has deterministic performance.Here, starting with the predictable execution times of individual DNN inferences, we adopt a principled design methodology to successively build a fully distributed model serving system that achieves predictable end-to-end performance. We evaluate our implementation, Clockwork, using production trace workloads, and show that Clockwork can support thousands of models while simultaneously meeting 100 ms latency targets for 99.9999\% of requests. We further demonstrate that Clockwork exploits predictable execution times to achieve tight request-level service-level objectives (SLOs) as well as a high degree of request-level performance isolation.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 机器学习推理正成为交互式Web应用的核心构建模块。因此，这些应用所依赖的底层模型服务系统必须始终满足低延迟目标。现有的模型服务架构使用众所周知的响应式技术来缓解常见情况的延迟来源，但无法有效抑制由不可预测的执行时间引起的尾部延迟。然而，底层执行时间并非根本不可预测——相反，我们观察到使用深度神经网络模型的推理具有确定性性能。在此，从单个DNN推理的可预测执行时间开始，我们采用一种有原则的设计方法，逐步构建一个完全分布式的模型服务系统，实现可预测的端到端性能。我们使用生产工作负载轨迹评估了我们的实现Clockwork，并表明Clockwork可以支持数千个模型，同时为99.9999%的请求满足100毫秒的延迟目标。我们进一步证明，Clockwork利用可预测的执行时间来实现严格的请求级服务级别目标(SLO)以及高度的请求级性能隔离。

import_candidates.title: A unified architecture for accelerating distributed DNN training in heterogeneous GPU/CPU clusters
import_candidates.abstract: Data center clusters that run DNN training jobs are inherently heterogeneous. They have GPUs and CPUs for computation and network bandwidth for distributed training. However, existing distributed DNN training architectures, all-reduce and Parameter Server (PS), cannot fully utilize such heterogeneous resources. In this paper, we present a new distributed DNN training architecture called BytePS. BytePS can leverage spare CPU and bandwidth resources in the cluster to accelerate distributed DNN training tasks running on GPUs. It provides a communication framework that is both proved optimal and unified - existing all-reduce and PS become two special cases of BytePS. To achieve the proved optimality in practice, BytePS further splits the functionalities of a parameter optimizer. It introduces a Summation Service abstraction for aggregating gradients, which is common for all the optimizers. Summation Service can be accelerated by AVX instructions and can be efficiently run on CPUs, while DNN model-related optimizer algorithms are run on GPUs for computation acceleration. BytePS can accelerate DNN training for major frameworks including TensorFlow, PyTorch and MXNet. For representative DNN training jobs with up to 256 GPUs, BytePS outperforms the state-of-the-art open source all-reduce and PS by up to 84\% and 245\%, respectively.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 运行DNN训练作业的数据中心集群本质上是异构的。它们拥有用于计算的GPU和CPU，以及用于分布式训练的网络带宽。然而，现有的分布式DNN训练架构——全归约（all-reduce）和参数服务器（Parameter Server，PS）——无法充分利用这些异构资源。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的分布式DNN训练架构，称为BytePS。BytePS可以利用集群中空闲的CPU和带宽资源来加速运行在GPU上的分布式DNN训练任务。它提供了一个既被证明最优又统一的通信框架——现有的all-reduce和PS架构成为BytePS的两种特例。为了在实践中实现被证明的最优性，BytePS进一步拆分参数优化器的功能。它引入了一个用于梯度聚合的求和服务（Summation Service）抽象，该抽象对所有优化器都是通用的。求和服务可以通过AVX指令加速，并且可以在CPU上高效运行，而与DNN模型相关的优化器算法则在GPU上运行以实现计算加速。BytePS可以加速包括TensorFlow、PyTorch和MXNet在内的主要框架的DNN训练。对于多达256个GPU的代表性DNN训练作业，BytePS相比最先进的开源all-reduce和PS架构，分别实现了高达84%和245%的性能提升。

import_candidates.title: Heterogeneity-aware cluster scheduling policies for deep learning workloads
import_candidates.abstract: Specialized accelerators such as GPUs, TPUs, FPGAs, and custom ASICs have been increasingly deployed to train deep learning models. These accelerators exhibit heterogeneous performance behavior across model architectures. Existing schedulers for clusters of accelerators, which are used to arbitrate these expensive training resources across many users, have shown how to optimize for various multi-job, multiuser objectives, like fairness and makespan. Unfortunately, existing schedulers largely do not consider performance heterogeneity. In this paper, we propose Gavel, a heterogeneityaware scheduler that systematically generalizes a wide range of existing scheduling policies. Gavel expresses these policies as optimization problems and then systematically transforms these problems into heterogeneity-aware versions using an abstraction we call effective throughput. Gavel then uses a round-based scheduling mechanism to ensure jobs receive their ideal allocation given the target scheduling policy. Gavel's heterogeneity-aware policies allow a heterogeneous cluster to sustain higher input load, and improve end objectives such as makespan and average job completion time by 1.4\texttimes{} and 3.5\texttimes{} compared to heterogeneity-agnostic policies.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: GPU、TPU、FPGA和定制ASIC等专用加速器已被越来越多地用于训练深度学习模型。这些加速器在不同的模型架构上表现出异构的性能行为。现有的加速器集群调度器（用于在众多用户之间仲裁这些昂贵的训练资源）已展示如何为各种多作业、多用户目标（如公平性和完工时间）进行优化。不幸的是，现有调度器在很大程度上未考虑性能异构性。在本文中，我们提出Gavel，一种异构感知调度器，它系统地将广泛的现有调度策略泛化。Gavel将这些策略表示为优化问题，然后使用我们称之为“有效吞吐量”的抽象将这些系统性地转化为异构感知版本。随后，Gavel使用基于轮次的调度机制，确保作业在给定目标调度策略下获得理想的分配。Gavel的异构感知策略使异构集群能够维持更高的输入负载，并相比异构不可知策略，将完工时间和平均作业完成时间等最终目标分别提升了1.4倍和3.5倍。

import_candidates.title: PipeSwitch: fast pipelined context switching for deep learning applications
import_candidates.abstract: Deep learning (DL) workloads include throughput-intensive training tasks and latency-sensitive inference tasks. The dominant practice today is to provision dedicated GPU clusters for training and inference separately. Due to the need to meet strict Service-Level Objectives (SLOs), GPU clusters are often over-provisioned based on the peak load with limited sharing between applications and task types. We present PipeSwitch, a system that enables unused cycles of an inference application to be filled by training or other inference applications. It allows multiple DL applications to time-share the same GPU with the entire GPU memory and millisecond-scale switching overhead. With PipeSwitch, GPU utilization can be significantly improved without sacrificing SLOs. We achieve so by introducing pipelined context switching. The key idea is to leverage the layered structure of neural network models and their layer-by-layer computation pattern to pipeline model transmission over the PCIe and task execution in the GPU with model-aware grouping. We also design unified memory management and active-standby worker switching mechanisms to accompany the pipelining and ensure process-level isolation. We have built a PipeSwitch prototype and integrated it with PyTorch. Experiments on a variety of DL models and GPU cards show that PipeSwitch only incurs a task startup overhead of 3.6-6.6 ms and a total overhead of 5.4-34.6 ms (10-50\texttimes{} better than NVIDIA MPS), and achieves near 100\% GPU utilization.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 深度学习（DL）工作负载包括高吞吐量的训练任务和延迟敏感的推理任务。当前的主流做法是分别部署专用GPU集群用于训练和推理。由于需要满足严格的服务级别目标（SLO），GPU集群往往按峰值负载过度配置，且应用与任务类型之间共享有限。我们提出了PipeSwitch，一种能够利用推理应用的空闲周期来运行训练或其他推理应用的系统。它允许多个深度学习应用以毫秒级切换开销共享同一GPU，并充分利用整个GPU内存。通过引入流水线式上下文切换，PipeSwitch能够在不牺牲SLO的情况下显著提高GPU利用率。其关键在于利用神经网络模型的分层结构及逐层计算模式，通过模型感知的分组，将模型在PCIe上的传输与GPU中的任务执行进行流水线化。我们还设计了统一内存管理和主备工作线程切换机制，配合流水线并确保进程级隔离。我们构建了PipeSwitch原型，并将其集成到PyTorch中。在多种深度学习模型和GPU卡上的实验表明，PipeSwitch的任务启动开销仅为3.6–6.6毫秒，总开销为5.4–34.6毫秒（比NVIDIA MPS高10–50倍），并实现了接近100%的GPU利用率。

import_candidates.title: HiveD: sharing a GPU cluster for deep learning with guarantees
import_candidates.abstract: Deep learning training on a shared GPU cluster is becoming a common practice. However, we observe severe sharing anomaly in production multi-tenant clusters where jobs in some tenants experience worse queuing delay than they would have in a private cluster with their allocated shares of GPUs. This is because tenants use quota, the number of GPUs, to reserve resources, whereas deep learning jobs often use GPUs with a desirable GPU affinity, which quota cannot guarantee.HiveD is the first framework to share a GPU cluster safely, so that such anomaly would never happen by design. In HiveD, each tenant reserves resources through a Virtual Private Cluster (VC), defined in terms of multi-level cell structures corresponding to different levels of GPU affinity in a cluster. This design allows HiveD to incorporate any existing schedulers within each VC to achieve their respective design goals while sharing the cluster safely.HiveD develops an elegant buddy cell allocation algorithm to ensure sharing safety by efficiently managing the dynamic binding of cells from VCs to those in a physical cluster. A straightforward extension of buddy cell allocation can further support low-priority jobs to scavenge the unused GPU resources to improve cluster utilization.With a combination of real deployment and trace-driven simulation, we show that: (i) sharing anomaly exists in three state-of-the-art deep learning schedulers, incurring extra queuing delay of up to 1,000 minutes; (ii) HiveD can incorporate these schedulers and eliminate the sharing anomaly in all of them, achieving separation of concerns that allows the schedulers to focus on their own scheduling goals without violating sharing safety.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在共享GPU集群上进行深度学习训练已成为普遍做法。然而，我们观察到生产环境中的多租户集群存在严重的共享异常：某些租户的作业经历的排队延迟比它们使用所分配GPU份额的私有集群时更差。这是因为租户使用配额（GPU数量）来预留资源，而深度学习作业通常以理想的GPU亲和性使用GPU，这是配额无法保证的。HiveD是第一个能够安全共享GPU集群的框架，在设计中从根本上杜绝此类异常。在HiveD中，每个租户通过虚拟私有集群（VC）预留资源，VC以多级单元结构定义，对应集群中不同级别的GPU亲和性。该设计使HiveD能够在每个VC内整合任何现有调度器，以实现各自的设计目标，同时安全地共享集群。HiveD提出了一种优雅的伙伴单元分配算法，通过有效管理VC单元与物理集群单元的动态绑定来确保共享安全。伙伴单元分配的直接扩展还能支持低优先级作业回收未使用的GPU资源，以提高集群利用率。结合实际部署和基于轨迹的模拟，我们表明：（i）共享异常存在于三种最先进的深度学习调度器中，造成高达1000分钟的额外排队延迟；（ii）HiveD可以整合这些调度器并消除所有共享异常，实现关注点分离，使调度器在满足自身调度目标的同时不违反共享安全。

import_candidates.title: AntMan: dynamic scaling on GPU clusters for deep learning
import_candidates.abstract: Efficiently scheduling deep learning jobs on large-scale GPU clusters is crucial for job performance, system throughput, and hardware utilization. It is getting ever more challenging as deep learning workloads become more complex. This paper presents AntMan, a deep learning infrastructure that co-designs cluster schedulers with deep learning frameworks and has been deployed in production at Alibaba to manage tens of thousands of daily deep learning jobs across thousands of GPUs. AntMan accommodates the fluctuating resource demands of deep learning training jobs. As such, it utilizes the spare GPU resources to co-execute multiple jobs on a shared GPU. AntMan exploits unique characteristics of deep learning training to introduce dynamic scaling mechanisms for memory and computation within the deep learning frameworks. This allows fine-grained coordination between jobs and prevents job interference. Evaluations show that AntMan improves the overall GPU memory utilization by 42\% and computation utilization by 34\% in our multi-tenant cluster without compromising fairness, presenting a new approach to efficiently utilizing GPUs at scale.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在大型GPU集群上高效调度深度学习作业对作业性能、系统吞吐量和硬件利用率至关重要。随着深度学习工作负载变得越来越复杂，这一挑战也日益严峻。本文介绍了AntMan，这是一个深度学习基础设施，它将集群调度器与深度学习框架协同设计，并已在阿里巴巴生产环境中部署，用于管理数千个GPU上每天数以万计的深度学习作业。AntMan适应深度学习训练作业波动的资源需求，因此它利用空闲的GPU资源在共享GPU上共同执行多个作业。AntMan利用深度学习训练的独特特性，在深度学习框架内引入了内存和计算的动态扩缩容机制。这实现了作业之间的细粒度协调，并防止作业干扰。评估表明，在不牺牲公平性的前提下，AntMan在我们的多租户集群中将整体GPU内存利用率提高了42%，计算利用率提高了34%，为大规模高效利用GPU提供了一种新方法。

import_candidates.title: Write dependency disentanglement with HORAE
import_candidates.abstract: Storage systems rely on write dependency to achieve atomicity and consistency. However, enforcing write dependency comes at the expense of performance; it concatenates multiple hardware queues into a single logical queue, disables the concurrency of flash storage and serializes the access to isolated devices. Such serialization prevents the storage system from taking full advantage of high-performance drives (e.g., NVMe SSD) and storage arrays.In this paper, we propose a new IO stack called HORAE to alleviate the write dependency overhead for high-performance drives. HORAE separates the dependency control from the data flow, and uses a dedicated interface to maintain the write dependency. Further, HORAE introduces the joint flush to enable parallel FLUSH commands on individual devices, and write redirection to handle dependency loops and parallelize in-place updates. We implement HORAE in Linux kernel and demonstrate its effectiveness through a wide variety of workloads. Evaluations show HORAE brings up to 1.8\texttimes{} and 2.1\texttimes{} performance gain in MySQL and BlueStore, respectively.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 存储系统依赖写依赖来实现原子性和一致性。然而，强制实施写依赖会牺牲性能；它将多个硬件队列串联成一个逻辑队列，禁用了闪存的并发性，并将对隔离设备的访问串行化。这种串行化使得存储系统无法充分利用高性能驱动器（如NVMe SSD）和存储阵列。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为HORAE的新型IO栈，以缓解高性能驱动器上的写依赖开销。HORAE将依赖控制与数据流分离，并使用专用接口来维护写依赖。此外，HORAE引入了联合刷新（joint flush）以实现在各独立设备上并行执行FLUSH命令，以及写重定向（write redirection）来处理依赖循环并并行化就地更新。我们在Linux内核中实现了HORAE，并通过多种工作负载证明了其有效性。评估表明，在MySQL和BlueStore中，HORAE分别带来了高达1.8倍和2.1倍的性能提升。

import_candidates.title: Blockene: a high-throughput blockchain over mobile devices
import_candidates.abstract: We introduce Blockene, a blockchain that reduces resource usage at member nodes by orders of magnitude, requiring only a smartphone to participate in block validation and consensus. Despite being lightweight, Blockene provides a high throughput of transactions and scales to a large number of participants. Blockene consumes negligible battery and data in smartphones, enabling millions of users to participate in the blockchain without incentives, to secure transactions with their collective honesty. Blockene achieves these properties with a novel split-trust design based on delegating storage and gossip to untrusted nodes.We show, with a prototype implementation, that Blockene provides throughput of 1045 transactions/sec, and runs with very low resource usage on smartphones, pointing to a new paradigm for building secure, decentralized applications.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了Blockene，一种将成员节点的资源使用量降低数个数量级的区块链，仅需一部智能手机即可参与区块验证和共识。尽管轻量级，Blockene仍能提供高交易吞吐量，并可扩展至大量参与者。Blockene在智能手机上仅消耗极少的电量和数据，使得数百万用户无需激励即可参与区块链，并以其集体诚实行为为交易提供安全保障。Blockene通过一种新颖的基于将存储和流言委托给不可信节点的分裂信任设计来实现这些特性。通过原型实现，我们展示了Blockene可提供每秒1045笔交易的吞吐量，并且在智能手机上以极低的资源占用运行，这为构建安全的去中心化应用指明了新模式。

import_candidates.title: Tolerating slowdowns in replicated state machines using copilots
import_candidates.abstract: Replicated state machines are linearizable, fault-tolerant groups of replicas that are coordinated using a consensus algorithm. Copilot replication is the first 1-slowdown-tolerant consensus protocol: it delivers normal latency despite the slowdown of any 1 replica. Copilot uses two distinguished replicas--the pilot and copilot--to proactively add redundancy to all stages of processing a client's command. Copilot uses dependencies and deduplication to resolve potentially differing orderings proposed by the pilots. To avoid dependencies leading to either pilot being able to slow down the group, Copilot uses fast takeovers that allow a fast pilot to complete the ongoing work of a slow pilot. Copilot includes two optimizations--ping-pong batching and null dependency elimination--that improve its performance when there are 0 and 1 slow pilots respectively. Our evaluation of Copilot shows its performance is lower but competitive with Multi-Paxos and EPaxos when no replicas are slow. When a replica is slow, Copilot is the only protocol that avoids high latencies.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 复制状态机是由共识算法协调的、具有线性一致性和容错能力的副本组。Copilot复制是第一个容忍1个副本速度下降的共识协议：即使任意1个副本出现速度下降，它仍能提供正常延迟。Copilot使用两个特殊的副本——主驾驶(pilot)和副驾驶(copilot)——在处理客户端命令的所有阶段主动添加冗余。Copilot使用依赖关系和去重来解决主驾驶可能提出的不同顺序。为了避免依赖关系导致任一主驾驶拖慢整个组，Copilot采用了快速接管机制，使快速主驾驶能够完成缓慢主驾驶正在进行的操作。Copilot包含两项优化——乒乓批处理和空依赖消除——分别在0个和1个缓慢主驾驶的情况下提高其性能。我们对Copilot的评估表明，当没有副本速度下降时，其性能低于但与Multi-Paxos和EPaxos相当。当某个副本速度下降时，Copilot是唯一能避免高延迟的协议。

import_candidates.title: Microsecond consensus for microsecond applications
import_candidates.abstract: We consider the problem of making apps fault-tolerant through replication, when apps operate at the microsecond scale, as in finance, embedded computing, and microservices apps. These apps need a replication scheme that also operates at the microsecond scale, otherwise replication becomes a burden. We propose Mu, a system that takes less than 1.3 microseconds to replicate a (small) request in memory, and less than a millisecond to fail-over the system--this cuts the replication and fail-over latencies of the prior systems by at least 61\% and 90\%. Mu implements bona fide state machine replication/consensus (SMR) with strong consistency for a generic app, but it really shines on microsecond apps, where even the smallest overhead is significant. To provide this performance, Mu introduces a new SMR protocol that carefully leverages RDMA. Roughly, in Mu a leader replicates a request by simply writing it directly to the log of other replicas using RDMA, without any additional communication. Doing so, however, introduces the challenge of handling concurrent leaders, changing leaders, garbage collecting the logs, and more--challenges that we address in this paper through a judicious combination of RDMA permissions and distributed algorithmic design. We implemented Mu and used it to replicate several systems: a financial exchange app called Liquibook, Redis, Memcached, and HERD [33]. Our evaluation shows that Mu incurs a small replication latency, in some cases being the only viable replication system that incurs an acceptable overhead.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们考虑了当应用程序以微秒级运行时（如金融、嵌入式计算和微服务应用），通过复制实现容错的问题。这些应用需要一种同样以微秒级运行的复制方案，否则复制将成为负担。我们提出了Mu，一个在内存中复制（小）请求耗时不到1.3微秒、故障转移时间不到1毫秒的系统——这比先前系统的复制和故障转移延迟至少降低了61%和90%。Mu为通用应用实现了真正意义上的状态机复制/共识（SMR），并保证强一致性，但它在微秒级应用上表现尤为出色，因为即使最小的开销也举足轻重。为了实现这种性能，Mu引入了一种新的SMR协议，巧妙利用了RDMA。大致而言，在Mu中，领导者通过RDMA将请求直接写入其他副本的日志中，无需额外通信即可完成复制。然而，这样做引入了处理并发领导者、领导者更换、日志垃圾回收等挑战——我们通过结合RDMA权限和分布式算法设计解决了这些挑战。我们实现了Mu，并用它复制了多个系统：一个名为Liquibook的金融交易应用、Redis、Memcached和HERD[33]。我们的评估表明，Mu引入了很小的复制延迟，在某些情况下是唯一能带来可接受开销的可行复制系统。

import_candidates.title: Virtual consensus in delos
import_candidates.abstract: Consensus-based replicated systems are complex, monolithic, and difficult to upgrade once deployed. As a result, deployed systems do not benefit from innovative research, and new consensus protocols rarely reach production. We propose virtualizing consensus by virtualizing the shared log API, allowing services to change consensus protocols without downtime. Virtualization splits the logic of consensus into the VirtualLog, a generic and reusable reconfiguration layer; and pluggable ordering protocols called Loglets. Loglets are simple, since they do not need to support reconfiguration or leader election; diverse, consisting of different protocols, codebases, and even deployment modes; and composable, via RAID-like stacking and striping. We describe a production database called Delos1 which leverages virtual consensus for rapid, incremental development and deployment. Delos reached production within 8 months, and 4 months later upgraded its consensus protocol without downtime for a 10X latency improvement. Delos can dynamically change its performance properties by changing consensus protocols: we can scale throughput by up to 10X by switching to a disaggregated Loglet, and double the failure threshold of an instance without sacrificing throughput via a striped Loglet.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 基于共识的复制系统复杂、整体化，且一旦部署就难以升级。因此，已部署的系统无法受益于创新研究，新的共识协议也很少投入生产。我们提出通过虚拟化共享日志API来实现共识的虚拟化，使服务无需停机即可更改共识协议。虚拟化将共识逻辑拆分为VirtualLog（一个通用且可重用的重配置层）和称为Loglets的可插拔排序协议。Loglets简单，因为它们不需要支持重配置或领导者选举；多样化，由不同的协议、代码库甚至部署模式组成；并且可组合，通过类似RAID的堆叠和条带化。我们描述了一个名为Delos的生产数据库，它利用虚拟共识进行快速、增量的开发和部署。Delos在8个月内投入生产，4个月后在不停机的情况下升级了其共识协议，实现了10倍的延迟改进。Delos可以通过更改共识协议来动态改变其性能特性：通过切换到分离式Loglet，我们可以将吞吐量扩展至10倍；通过条带化Loglet，可以在不牺牲吞吐量的情况下将实例的故障阈值提高一倍。

import_candidates.title: Byzantine ordered consensus without byzantine oligarchy
import_candidates.abstract: The specific order of commands agreed upon when running state machine replication (SMR) is immaterial to fault-tolerance: all that is required is for all correct deterministic replicas to follow it. In the permissioned blockchains that rely on Byzantine fault tolerant (BFT) SMR, however, nodes have a stake in the specific sequence that ledger records, as well as in preventing other parties from manipulating the sequencing to their advantage. The traditional specification of SMR correctness, however, has no language to express these concerns. This paper introduces Byzantine ordered consensus, a new primitive that augments the correctness specification of BFT SMR to include specific guarantees on the total orders it produces; and a new architecture for BFT SMR that, by factoring out ordering from consensus, can enforce these guarantees and prevent Byzantine nodes from controlling ordering decisions (a Byzantine oligarchy). These contributions are instantiated in Pompe, a BFT SMR protocol that is guaranteed to order commands in a way that respects a natural extension of linearizability.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在运行状态机复制（SMR）时，所商定的具体命令顺序对容错来说并不重要：所有正确且确定性的副本只需遵循该顺序即可。然而，在依赖拜占庭容错（BFT）SMR的许可区块链中，节点对账本记录的具体顺序以及对防止其他方为自身利益操纵排序有着利害关系。然而，传统的SMR正确性规范没有表达这些关切的语言。本文引入了拜占庭有序共识（Byzantine ordered consensus），这是一种新的原语，它增强了BFT SMR的正确性规范，以包含对其产生的全序关系的具体保证；并引入了一种新的BFT SMR架构，通过将排序从共识中分离出来，可以执行这些保证并防止拜占庭节点控制排序决策（即拜占庭寡头）。这些贡献在Pompe中得到了实例化，Pompe是一种BFT SMR协议，其保证以一种自然扩展线性一致性的方式对命令进行排序。

import_candidates.title: From global to local quiescence: wait-free code patching of multi-threaded processes
import_candidates.abstract: Live patching has become a common technique to keep long-running system services secure and up-to-date without causing downtimes during patch application. However, to safely apply a patch, existing live-update methods require the entire process to enter a state of quiescence, which can be highly disruptive for multi-threaded programs: Having to halt all threads (e.g., at a global barrier) for patching not only hampers quality of service, but can also be tremendously difficult to implement correctly without causing deadlocks or other synchronization issues.In this paper, we present WFPATCH, a wait-free approach to inject code changes into running multi-threaded programs. Instead of having to stop the world before applying a patch, WFPATCH can gradually apply it to each thread individually at a local point of quiescence, while all other threads can make uninterrupted progress.We have implemented WFPATCH as a kernel service and user-space library for Linux 5.1 and evaluated it with Open-LDAP, Apache, Memcached, Samba, Node.js, and MariaDB on Debian 10 ("buster"). In total, we successfully applied 33 different binary patches into running programs while they were actively servicing requests; 15 patches had a CVE number or were other critical updates. Applying a patch with WFPATCH did not lead to any noticeable increase in request latencies - even under high load - while applying the same patch after reaching global quiescence increases tail latencies by a factor of up to 41\texttimes{} for MariaDB.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 实时修补已成为保持长期运行的系统服务安全且最新状态的常用技术，而不会在修补应用期间导致停机。然而，为了安全地应用补丁，现有的实时更新方法要求整个进程进入静止状态，这对多线程程序来说可能极具破坏性：为了修补而必须停止所有线程（例如，在全局屏障处）不仅会妨碍服务质量，而且可能极难正确实现，同时避免死锁或其他同步问题。在本文中，我们提出了WFPATCH，一种将代码更改注入运行中的多线程程序的无等待方法。WFPATCH无需在应用补丁前停止整个世界，而是可以在局部静止点逐步将补丁应用于每个线程，而所有其他线程则可以不受干扰地继续推进。我们将WFPATCH作为Linux 5.1的内核服务和用户空间库实现，并在Debian 10（“buster”）上使用Open-LDAP、Apache、Memcached、Samba、Node.js和MariaDB对其进行了评估。总体而言，我们成功地将33个不同的二进制补丁应用到了正在运行且积极处理请求的程序中；其中15个补丁带有CVE编号或是其他关键更新。使用WFPATCH应用补丁没有导致请求延迟的任何明显增加——即使在高压负载下也是如此——而在达到全局静止后应用相同的补丁则使MariaDB的尾部延迟增加了最多41倍。

import_candidates.title: Testing database engines via pivoted query synthesis
import_candidates.abstract: Database Management Systems (DBMSs) are used widely, and have been extensively tested by fuzzers, which are successful in finding crash bugs. However, approaches to finding logic bugs, such as when a DBMS computes an incorrect result set, have remained mostly untackled. To this end, we devised a novel and general approach that we have termed Pivoted Query Synthesis. The core idea of this approach is to automatically generate queries for which we ensure that they fetch a specific, randomly selected row, called the pivot row. If the DBMS fails to fetch the pivot row, the likely cause is a bug in the DBMS. We tested our approach on three widely used and mature DBMSs, namely SQLite, MySQL, and PostgreSQL. In total, we found 121 unique bugs in these DBMSs, 96 of which have been fixed or verified, demonstrating that the approach is highly effective and general. We expect that the wide applicability and simplicity of our approach will enable improving the robustness of many DBMSs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 数据库管理系统（DBMS）被广泛使用，并已通过模糊测试工具进行了大量测试，这些工具在发现崩溃缺陷方面取得了成功。然而，寻找逻辑缺陷（例如数据库管理系统计算结果集不正确的情况）的方法在很大程度上仍未被解决。为此，我们设计了一种新颖且通用的方法，称为‘枢轴查询合成’。该方法的核心思想是自动生成查询，并确保这些查询能够获取一个特定的、随机选择的行，称为枢轴行。如果数据库管理系统未能获取枢轴行，则可能存在缺陷。我们将该方法应用于三个广泛使用且成熟的数据库管理系统：SQLite、MySQL和PostgreSQL。总共在这些数据库管理系统中发现了121个独特缺陷，其中96个已被修复或验证，表明该方法非常有效且通用。我们预期该方法具有广泛的适用性和简洁性，将有助于提升众多数据库管理系统的健壮性。

import_candidates.title: Gauntlet: finding bugs in compilers for programmable packet processing
import_candidates.abstract: Programmable packet-processing devices such as programmable switches and network interface cards are becoming mainstream. These devices are configured in a domain-specific language such as P4, using a compiler to translate packet-processing programs into instructions for different targets. As networks with programmable devices become widespread, it is critical that these compilers be dependable.This paper considers the problem of finding bugs in compilers for packet processing in the context of P416. We introduce domain-specific techniques to induce both abnormal termination of the compiler (crash bugs) and miscompilation (semantic bugs). We apply these techniques to (1) the opensource P4 compiler (P4C) infrastructure, which serves as a common base for different P4 back ends; (2) the P4 back end for the P4 reference software switch; and (3) the P4 back end for the Barefoot Tofino switch.Across the 3 platforms, over 8 months of bug finding, our tool Gauntlet detected 96 new and distinct bugs (62 crash and 34 semantic), which we confirmed with the respective compiler developers. 54 have been fixed (31 crash and 23 semantic); the remaining have been assigned to a developer. Our bug-finding efforts also led to 6 P4 specification changes. We have open sourced Gauntlet at p4gauntlet.github.io and it now runs within P4C's continuous integration pipeline.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 可编程数据包处理设备（如可编程交换机和网络接口卡）正在成为主流。这些设备使用P4等特定领域语言进行配置，通过编译器将数据包处理程序转换为不同目标的指令。随着可编程设备网络日益普及，这些编译器的可靠性至关重要。本文研究了在P416背景下查找数据包处理编译器错误的问题。我们引入了特定领域技术来诱发编译器的异常终止（崩溃错误）和错误编译（语义错误）。我们将这些技术应用于：(1) 开源的P4编译器（P4C）基础设施，该基础设施是不同P4后端的公共基础；(2) P4参考软件交换机的P4后端；(3) Barefoot Tofino交换机的P4后端。在3个平台上，经过8个月的错误查找，我们的工具Gauntlet检测到96个新的且不同的错误（62个崩溃错误和34个语义错误），并已与相应的编译器开发人员确认。其中54个已修复（31个崩溃错误和23个语义错误）；其余已分配给开发人员。我们的错误查找工作还促成了6项P4规范的变更。我们已在p4gauntlet.github.io开源了Gauntlet，目前它已在P4C的持续集成管道中运行。

import_candidates.title: Aragog: scalable runtime verification of shardable networked systems
import_candidates.abstract: Network functions like firewalls, proxies, and NATs are instances of distributed systems that lie on the critical path for a substantial fraction of today's cloud applications. Unfortunately, validating these systems remains difficult due to their complex stateful, timed, and distributed behaviors.In this paper, we present the design and implementation of Aragog, a runtime verification system for distributed network functions that achieves high expressiveness, fidelity, and scalability. Given a property of interest, Aragog efficiently checks running systems for violations of the property with a scale-out architecture consisting of a collection of global verifiers and local monitors. To improve performance and reduce communication overhead, Aragog includes an array of optimizations that leverage properties of networked systems to suppress provably unnecessary system events and to shard verification over every available local and global component. We evaluate Aragog over several network functions including a NAT Gateway that powers Azure, identifying both design and implementation bugs in the process.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 防火墙、代理和NAT等网络功能是分布式系统的实例，它们位于当今云应用中相当大比例部分的临界路径上。然而，由于这些系统具有复杂的有状态、定时和分布式行为，验证它们仍然很困难。在本文中，我们提出了Aragog的设计与实现，这是一个用于分布式网络功能的运行时验证系统，实现了高表达力、高保真度和可扩展性。给定一个感兴趣的属性，Aragog通过包含一组全局验证器和本地监控器的横向扩展架构，高效地检查运行中的系统是否存在违反该属性的行为。为了提高性能并降低通信开销，Aragog包含一系列优化，利用网络系统的特性来抑制可证明不必要的事件，并在所有可用的本地和全局组件上分片验证。我们针对包括为Azure提供支持的NAT网关在内的多个网络功能对Aragog进行了评估，过程中发现了设计和实现上的缺陷。

import_candidates.title: Automated reasoning and detection of specious configuration in large systems with symbolic execution
import_candidates.abstract: Misconfiguration is a major cause of system failures. Prior solutions focus on detecting invalid settings that are introduced by user mistakes. But another type of misconfiguration that continues to haunt production services is specious configuration-- settings that are valid but lead to unexpectedly poor performance in production. Such misconfigurations are subtle, so even careful administrators may fail to foresee them.We propose a tool called Violet to detect specious configuration. We realize the crux of specious configuration is that it causes some slow code path to be executed, but the bad performance effect cannot always be triggered. Violet thus takes a novel approach that uses selective symbolic execution to systematically reason about the performance effect of configuration parameters, their combination effect, and the relationship with input. Violet outputs a performance impact model for the automatic detection of poor configuration settings. We applied Violet on four large systems. To evaluate the effectiveness of Violet, we collect 17 real-world specious configuration cases. Violet detects 15 of them. Violet also identifies 11 unknown specious configurations.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 错误配置是系统故障的主要原因。现有解决方案侧重于检测由用户错误引入的无效设置。但另一种继续困扰生产服务的错误配置类型是可疑配置（specious configuration）——即有效但导致生产中意外性能低下的设置。此类错误配置较为微妙，即使谨慎的管理员也可能无法预见。我们提出了一个名为Violet的工具来检测可疑配置。我们意识到可疑配置的关键在于它导致某些慢速代码路径被执行，但糟糕的性能影响并非总能被触发。因此，Violet采用了一种新颖的方法，使用选择性符号执行系统地推理配置参数的性能影响、它们的组合效应以及与输入的关系。Violet输出一个性能影响模型，用于自动检测糟糕的配置设置。我们将Violet应用于四个大型系统。为了评估Violet的有效性，我们收集了17个真实世界的可疑配置案例。Violet检测出其中15个。Violet还识别出11个未知的可疑配置。

import_candidates.title: Testing configuration changes in context to prevent production failures
import_candidates.abstract: Large-scale cloud services deploy hundreds of configuration changes to production systems daily. At such velocity, configuration changes have inevitably become prevalent causes of production failures.
