Evaluations show that Vegito can perform 1.9 million TPC-C NewOrder transactions and 24 TPC-H-equivalent queries per second simultaneously, which retain the excellent performance of specialized OLTP and OLAP counterparts (e.g., DrTM+H and MonetDB). These results outperform state-of-the-art HTAP systems by several orders of magnitude on transactional performance, while just incurring little performance slowdown (5% over pure OLTP workloads) and still enjoying data freshness for analytical queries (less than 20 ms of maximum delay) in the failure-free case. Further, Vegito can recover from cascading machine failures by using the columnar backup in less than 60 ms.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 许多应用领域可以通过混合事务/分析处理（HTAP）受益，即在并发事务产生的实时数据集上执行查询。然而，由于大内存和快速互连带来的越来越快的事务和查询，商用HTAP系统不得不在数据新鲜度和性能下降之间做出权衡。幸运的是，我们观察到现代分布式OLTP系统中用于高可用的备份可以经过改造，以在HTAP工作负载中桥接分析查询和事务。在本文中，我们提出了Vegito，一个分布式内存HTAP系统，通过以下三种技术同时实现新鲜度和性能：（1）一种轻量级的类似gossip的方案，以在备份上一致地应用日志；（2）一种基于块的多版本列式备份设计；（3）一种用于备份的基于树的索引的两阶段并发更新机制。这些技术共同使备份保持新鲜、列式且容错，即使面对每秒数百万的并发事务。评估表明，Vegito可以同时每秒执行190万次TPC-C NewOrder事务和24次TPC-H等价查询，保持了专用OLTP和OLAP系统（如DrTM+H和MonetDB）的卓越性能。这些结果在事务性能上比最先进的HTAP系统高出几个数量级，同时在无故障情况下仅对纯OLTP工作负载造成很小的性能损失（5%），并且分析查询仍然享有数据新鲜度（最大延迟小于20毫秒）。此外，Vegito可以在不到60毫秒内通过使用列式备份从级联机器故障中恢复。

import_candidates.title: The nanoPU: A Nanosecond Network Stack for Datacenters
import_candidates.abstract:
We present the nanoPU, a new NIC-CPU co-design to accelerate an increasingly pervasive class of datacenter applications: those that utilize many small Remote Procedure Calls (RPCs) with very short (μs-scale) processing times. The novel aspect of the nanoPU is the design of a fast path between the network and applications---bypassing the cache and memory hierarchy, and placing arriving messages directly into the CPU register file. This fast path contains programmable hardware support for low latency transport and congestion control as well as hardware support for efficient load balancing of RPCs to cores. A hardware-accelerated thread scheduler makes sub-nanosecond decisions, leading to high CPU utilization and low tail response time for RPCs. 

We built an FPGA prototype of the nanoPU fast path by modifying an open-source RISC-V CPU, and evaluated its performance using cycle-accurate simulations on AWS FPGAs. The wire-to-wire RPC response time through the nanoPU is just 69ns, an order of magnitude quicker than the best-of-breed, low latency, commercial NICs. We demonstrate that the hardware thread scheduler is able to lower RPC tail response time by about 5✕ while enabling the system to sustain 20% higher load, relative to traditional thread scheduling techniques. We implement and evaluate a suite of applications, including MICA, Raft and Set Algebra for document retrieval; and we demonstrate that the nanoPU can be used as a high performance, programmable alternative for one-sided RDMA operations.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了nanoPU，一种新的NIC-CPU协同设计，旨在加速数据中心应用中日益普遍的一类工作负载：那些使用大量小规模远程过程调用（RPC）且处理时间极短（微秒级）的应用。nanoPU的创新之处在于设计了网络与应用之间的快速路径——绕过缓存和内存层级，将到达的消息直接放入CPU寄存器文件中。该快速路径包含用于低延迟传输和拥塞控制的可编程硬件支持，以及用于将RPC高效负载均衡到各核心的硬件支持。硬件加速的线程调度器做出亚纳秒级决策，从而实现高CPU利用率和RPC的低尾延迟。我们通过修改一个开源的RISC-V CPU构建了nanoPU快速路径的FPGA原型，并使用AWS FPGA上的周期精确模拟评估了其性能。经过nanoPU的端到端RPC响应时间仅为69纳秒，比最先进的低延迟商业NIC快一个数量级。我们证明，相对于传统的线程调度技术，硬件线程调度器能够将RPC尾延迟降低约5倍，同时使系统维持高出20%的负载。我们实现并评估了一套应用程序，包括MICA、Raft和用于文档检索的Set Algebra；并证明nanoPU可以用作单侧RDMA操作的高性能可编程替代方案。

import_candidates.title: Beyond malloc efficiency to fleet efficiency: a hugepage-aware memory allocator
import_candidates.abstract: Memory allocation represents significant compute cost at the warehouse scale and its optimization can yield considerable cost savings. One classical approach is to increase the efficiency of an allocator to minimize the cycles spent in the allocator code. However, memory allocation decisions also impact overall application performance via data placement, offering opportunities to improve fleetwide productivity by completing more units of application work using fewer hardware resources. Here, we focus on hugepage coverage. We present TEMERAIRE, a hugepage-aware enhancement of TCMALLOC to reduce CPU overheads in the application’s code. We discuss the design and implementation of TEMERAIRE including strategies for hugepage-aware memory layouts to maximize hugepage coverage and to minimize fragmentation overheads. We present application studies for 8 applications, improving requests-per-second (RPS) by 7.7% and reducing RAM usage 2.4%. We present the results of a 1% experiment at fleet scale as well as the longitudinal rollout in Google’s warehouse scale computers. This yielded 6% fewer TLB miss stalls, and 26% reduction in memory wasted due to fragmentation. We conclude with a discussion of additional techniques for improving the allocator development process and potential optimization strategies for future memory allocators.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在仓库规模下，内存分配代表了显著的计算成本，其优化可以带来可观的成本节约。一种经典方法是提高分配器的效率，以最小化分配器代码中消耗的周期。然而，内存分配决策也通过数据放置影响整体应用程序性能，从而提供了通过使用更少的硬件资源完成更多单位应用程序工作来改善群体生产力的机会。在这里，我们专注于大页覆盖率。我们提出了TEMERAIRE，这是TCMALLOC的一种大页感知增强，以减少应用程序代码中的CPU开销。我们讨论了TEMERAIRE的设计和实现，包括用于最大化大页覆盖率和最小化碎片开销的大页感知内存布局策略。我们展示了8个应用的案例研究，将每秒请求数(RPS)提高了7.7%，并将RAM使用量减少了2.4%。我们展示了在车队规模上进行的1%实验以及其在Google仓库规模计算机中的纵向推广结果。这导致了TLB未命中停顿减少6%，以及因碎片化造成的内存浪费减少26%。最后，我们讨论了改进分配器开发过程的其他技术和未来内存分配器的潜在优化策略。

import_candidates.title: Scalable Memory Protection in the PENGLAI Enclave
import_candidates.abstract: Secure hardware enclaves have been widely used for protecting security-critical applications in the cloud. However, existing enclave designs fail to meet the requirements of scalability demanded by new scenarios like serverless computing, mainly due to the limitations in their secure memory protection mechanisms, including static allocation, restricted capacity and high-cost initialization. In this paper, we propose a software-hardware co-design to support dynamic, fine-grained, large-scale secure memory as well as fast-initialization. We first introduce two new hardware primitives: 1) Guarded Page Table (GPT), which protects page table pages to support page-level secure memory isolation; 2) Mountable Merkle Tree (MMT), which supports scalable integrity protection for secure memory. Upon these two primitives, our system can scale to thousands of concurrent enclaves with high resource utilization and eliminate the high-cost initialization of secure memory using fork-style enclave creation without weakening the security guarantees. We have implemented a prototype of our design based on Penglai, an open-sourced enclave system for RISC-V. The experimental results show that Penglai can support 1,000s enclave instances running concurrently and scale up to 512GB secure memory with both encryption and integrity protection. The overhead of GPT is 5% for memory-intensive workloads (e.g., Redis) and negligible for CPU-intensive workloads (e.g., RV8 and Coremarks). Penglai also reduces the latency of secure memory initialization by three orders of magnitude and gains 3.6x speedup for real-world applications (e.g., MapReduce).
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 安全的硬件飞地已被广泛用于保护云中的安全关键应用。然而，现有的飞地设计无法满足无服务器计算等新场景对可扩展性的要求，这主要是由于其安全内存保护机制的限制，包括静态分配、有限容量和高成本的初始化。在本文中，我们提出了一种软件-硬件协同设计，以支持动态、细粒度、大规模的安全内存以及快速初始化。我们首先引入了两个新的硬件原语：1）受保护页表（GPT），保护页表页面以支持页级安全内存隔离；2）可挂载的Merkle树（MMT），支持安全内存的可扩展完整性保护。基于这两个原语，我们的系统可以扩展到数千个并发飞地，具有高资源利用率，并通过分叉式飞地创建消除了安全内存的高成本初始化，且不削弱安全保障。我们基于Penglai（一个开源的RISC-V飞地系统）实现了我们设计的原型。实验结果表明，Penglai可以支持1000个并发运行的飞地实例，并可扩展到512GB的安全内存，同时具备加密和完整性保护。GPT的开销对内存密集型工作负载（如Redis）为5%，对CPU密集型工作负载（如RV8和Coremarks）可忽略不计。Penglai还将安全内存初始化的延迟降低了三个数量级，并为真实应用（如MapReduce）获得了3.6倍的加速。

import_candidates.title: NrOS: Effective Replication and Sharing in an Operating System
import_candidates.abstract:
Writing a correct operating system kernel is notoriously hard. Kernel code requires manual memory management and type-unsafe code and must efficiently handle complex, asynchronous events. In addition, increasing CPU core counts further complicate kernel development. Typically, monolithic kernels share state across cores and rely on one-off synchronization patterns that are specialized for each kernel structure or subsystem. Hence, kernel developers are constantly refining synchronization within OS kernels to improve scalability at the risk of introducing subtle bugs.

We present NrOS, a new OS kernel with a safer approach to synchronization that runs many POSIX programs. NrOS is primarily constructed as a simple, sequential kernel with no concurrency, making it easier to develop and reason about its correctness. This kernel is scaled across NUMA nodes using node replication, a scheme inspired by state machine replication in distributed systems. NrOS replicates kernel state on each NUMA node and uses operation logs to maintain strong consistency between replicas. Cores can safely and concurrently read from their local kernel replica, eliminating remote NUMA accesses.

Our evaluation shows that NrOS scales to 96 cores with performance that nearly always dominates Linux at scale, in some cases by orders of magnitude, while retaining much of the simplicity of a sequential kernel.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 编写正确的操作系统内核以著称地困难。内核代码需要手动内存管理和类型不安全代码，并且必须高效地处理复杂的异步事件。此外，CPU核心数量的增加进一步复杂化了内核开发。通常，单片内核跨核心共享状态，并依赖于针对每个内核结构或子系统专门化的一次性同步模式。因此，内核开发人员不断优化操作系统内核中的同步以提高可扩展性，但冒着引入微妙错误的风险。我们提出NrOS，一个采用更安全的同步方法并运行许多POSIX程序的新操作系统内核。NrOS主要构建为一个小型、顺序的内核，没有并发性，使其更容易开发和推理正确性。该内核使用节点复制（一种受分布式系统中状态机复制的启发的方法）跨NUMA节点进行扩展。NrOS在每个NUMA节点上复制内核状态，并使用操作日志维护副本之间的强一致性。核心可以安全地并发读取其本地内核副本，从而消除远程NUMA访问。我们的评估表明，NrOS扩展到96个核心，在规模上的性能几乎始终优于Linux，在某些情况下高出一个数量级，同时保留了顺序内核的许多简单性。

import_candidates.title: Addra: Metadata-private voice communication over fully untrusted infrastructure
import_candidates.abstract: Metadata from voice calls, such as the knowledge of who is communicating with whom, contains rich information about people’s lives. Indeed, it is a prime target for powerful adversaries such as nation states. Existing systems that hide voice call metadata either require trusted intermediaries in the network or scale to only tens of users. This paper describes the design, implementation, and evaluation of Addra, the first system for voice communication that hides metadata over fully untrusted infrastructure and scales to tens of thousands of users. At a high level, Addra follows a template in which callers and callees deposit and retrieve messages from private mailboxes hosted at an untrusted server. However, Addra improves message latency in this architecture, which is a key performance metric for voice calls. First, it enables a caller to push a message to a callee in two hops, using a new way of assigning mailboxes to users that resembles how a post office assigns PO boxes to its customers. Second, it innovates on the underlying cryptographic machinery and constructs a new private information retrieval scheme, FastPIR, that reduces the time to process oblivious access requests for mailboxes. An evaluation of Addra on a cluster of 80 machines on AWS demonstrates that it can serve 32K users with a 99-th percentile message latency of 726 ms—a 7✕  improvement over a prior system for text messaging in the same threat model.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 语音通话的元数据，例如谁与谁通信的信息，包含了人们生活中丰富的信息。事实上，它是国家等强大对手的主要目标。现有的隐藏语音通话元数据的系统要么需要在网络中拥有可信中介，要么只能扩展到几十个用户。本文描述了Addra的设计、实现和评估，这是第一个在完全不可信的基础设施上隐藏元数据并扩展到数万用户的语音通信系统。在高层面上，Addra遵循一种模板，其中主叫方和被叫方在托管于不可信服务器的私有邮箱中存放和检索消息。然而，Addra改进了这种架构中的消息延迟，而这是语音通话的关键性能指标。首先，它利用一种新的用户邮箱分配方式（类似于邮局向客户分配邮政信箱），使主叫方能够以两跳的方式将消息推送给被叫方。其次，它在底层密码机制上进行创新，构建了一种新的私有信息检索方案FastPIR，减少了处理邮箱不经意访问请求的时间。在AWS的80台机器集群上对Addra的评估表明，它可以为32K用户提供服务，99百分位消息延迟为726毫秒——与先前在相同威胁模型下的文本消息系统相比，性能提升了7倍。

import_candidates.title: Bringing Decentralized Search to Decentralized Services
import_candidates.abstract:
This paper addresses a key missing piece in the current ecosystem of decentralized services and blockchain apps: the lack of decentralized, verifiable, and private search. Existing decentralized systems like Steemit, OpenBazaar, and the growing number of blockchain apps provide alternatives to existing services. And yet, they continue to rely on centralized search engines and indexers to help users access the content they seek and navigate the apps. Such centralized engines are in a perfect position to censor content and violate users’ privacy, undermining some of the key tenets behind decentralization.

To remedy this, we introduce DeSearch, the first decentralized search engine that guarantees the integrity and privacy of search results for decentralized services and blockchain apps. DeSearch uses trusted hardware to build a network of workers that execute a pipeline of small search engine tasks (crawl, index, aggregate, rank, query). DeSearch then introduces a witness mechanism to make sure the completed tasks can be reused across different pipelines, and to make the final search results verifiable by end users. We implement DeSearch for two existing decentralized services that handle over 80 million records and 240 GBs of data, and show that DeSearch can scale horizontally with the number of workers and can process 128 million search queries per day.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文解决了当前去中心化服务和区块链应用生态系统中一个关键缺失环节：缺乏去中心化、可验证且私密的搜索。现有的去中心化系统（如 Steemit、OpenBazaar 以及越来越多的区块链应用）提供了现有服务的替代品，但它们仍然依赖中心化搜索引擎和索引器来帮助用户获取所需内容并导航应用。此类中心化引擎处于审查内容和侵犯用户隐私的完美位置，削弱了去中心化背后的一些关键原则。为此，我们提出了 DeSearch，这是首个保证去中心化服务和区块链应用搜索结果完整性与隐私性的去中心化搜索引擎。DeSearch 使用可信硬件构建一个工作节点网络，执行一系列小型搜索引擎任务（爬取、索引、聚合、排序、查询）。随后，DeSearch 引入一种见证机制，确保已完成的任务可在不同流程间复用，并让最终搜索结果可供最终用户验证。我们针对两个现有去中心化服务实现了 DeSearch，这些服务处理超过 8000 万条记录和 240 GB 数据，并证明 DeSearch 能够随工作节点数量水平扩展，每天可处理 1.28 亿次搜索查询。

import_candidates.title: Finding Consensus Bugs in Ethereum via Multi-transaction Differential Fuzzing
import_candidates.abstract: Ethereum is the second-largest blockchain platform next to Bitcoin. In the Ethereum network, decentralized Ethereum clients reach consensus through transitioning to the same blockchain states according to the Ethereum specification. Consensus bugs are bugs that make Ethereum clients transition to incorrect blockchain states and fail to reach consensus with other clients. Consensus bugs are extremely rare but can be exploited for network split and theft, which cause reliability and security-critical issues in the Ethereum ecosystem. We describe Fluffy, a multi-transaction differential fuzzer for finding consensus bugs in Ethereum. First, Fluffy mutates and executes multi-transaction test cases to find consensus bugs which cannot be found using existing fuzzers for Ethereum. Second, Fluffy uses multiple existing Ethereum clients that independently implement the specification as cross-referencing oracles. Compared to a state-of-the-art fuzzer, Fluffy improves the fuzzing throughput by 510× and the code coverage by 2.7× with various optimizations: in-process fuzzing, fuzzing harnesses for Ethereum clients, and semantic-aware mutation that reduces erroneous test cases. Fluffy found two new consensus bugs in the most popular Geth Ethereum client which were exploitable on the live Ethereum mainnet. Four months after we reported the bugs to Geth developers, one of the bugs was triggered on the mainnet, and caused nodes using a stale version of Geth to hard fork the Ethereum blockchain. The blockchain community considers this hard fork the greatest challenge since the infamous 2016 DAO hack. We have made Fluffy publicly available at https://github.com/snuspl/fluffy to contribute to the security of Ethereum.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 以太坊是仅次于比特币的第二大区块链平台。在以太坊网络中，去中心化的以太坊客户端通过依据以太坊规范转换到相同的区块链状态来达成共识。共识漏洞是指使以太坊客户端转换到不正确的区块链状态并无法与其他客户端达成共识的漏洞。共识漏洞极为罕见，但可能被利用导致网络分裂和盗窃，从而在以太坊生态系统中引发可靠性和安全关键问题。我们描述了Fluffy，一个用于发现以太坊共识漏洞的多交易差分模糊测试工具。首先，Fluffy变异并执行多交易测试用例，以发现现有以太坊模糊测试工具无法找到的共识漏洞。其次，Fluffy使用多个现有的独立实现规范的以太坊客户端作为交叉引用预言机。与最先进的模糊测试工具相比，Fluffy通过多种优化将模糊测试吞吐量提高了510倍，代码覆盖率提高了2.7倍，这些优化包括：进程内模糊测试、以太坊客户端的模糊测试套件，以及减少错误测试用例的语义感知变异。Fluffy在最流行的Geth以太坊客户端中发现了两个新的共识漏洞，这些漏洞在以太坊主网上可利用。我们向Geth开发者报告漏洞四个月后，其中一个漏洞在主网上被触发，导致使用旧版本Geth的节点硬分叉了以太坊区块链。区块链社区认为这次硬分叉是自2016年臭名昭著的DAO黑客事件以来最大的挑战。我们已在https://github.com/snuspl/fluffy公开提供Fluffy，以助力以太坊的安全。

import_candidates.title: MAGE: Nearly Zero-Cost Virtual Memory for Secure Computation
import_candidates.abstract: Secure Computation (SC) is a family of cryptographic primitives for computing on encrypted data in single-party and multi-party settings. SC is being increasingly adopted by industry for a variety of applications. A significant obstacle to using SC for practical applications is the memory overhead of the underlying cryptography. We develop MAGE, an execution engine for SC that efficiently runs SC computations that do not fit in memory. We observe that, due to their intended security guarantees, SC schemes are inherently oblivious—their memory access patterns are independent of the input data. Using this property, MAGE calculates the memory access pattern ahead of time and uses it to produce a memory management plan. This formulation of memory management, which we call memory programming, is a generalization of paging that allows MAGE to provide a highly efficient virtual memory abstraction for SC. MAGE outperforms the OS virtual memory system by up to an order of magnitude, and in many cases, runs SC computations that do not fit in memory at nearly the same speed as if the underlying machines had unbounded physical memory to fit the entire computation.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 安全计算（Secure Computation, SC）是一族用于在单方和多方场景下对加密数据进行计算的密码学原语。SC正越来越多地被工业界用于各种应用。使用SC实际应用的一个重大障碍是底层密码学带来的内存开销。我们开发了MAGE，一个用于SC的执行引擎，能够高效运行那些无法放入内存的SC计算。我们观察到，由于其期望的安全保证，SC方案本质上是盲目（oblivious）的——它们的内存访问模式与输入数据无关。利用这一性质，MAGE提前计算出内存访问模式，并利用它生成内存管理方案。这种内存管理的表述，我们称之为“内存编程”，是分页（paging）的一种推广，使MAGE能够为SC提供一种高效的虚拟内存抽象。MAGE的性能比操作系统虚拟内存系统高出一个数量级，并且在许多情况下，运行无法放入内存的SC计算时，其速度几乎与底层机器拥有无界物理内存、整个计算可完全容纳时一样快。

import_candidates.title: Zeph: Cryptographic Enforcement of End-to-End Data Privacy
import_candidates.abstract: As increasingly more sensitive data is being collected to gain valuable insights, the need  to natively integrate privacy controls in data analytics frameworks is growing in importance.  Today, privacy controls are enforced by data curators with full access to data in the clear. However, a plethora of recent data breaches show that even widely trusted service providers can be compromised. Additionally, there is no assurance that data processing and handling comply with the claimed privacy policies. This motivates the need for a new approach to data privacy that can provide strong assurance and control to users. This paper presents Zeph, a system that enables users to set privacy preferences on how their data can be shared and processed. Zeph enforces privacy policies cryptographically and ensures that data available to third-party applications complies with users' privacy policies.  Zeph executes privacy-adhering data transformations in real-time and scales to thousands of data sources,  allowing it to support large-scale low-latency data stream analytics. We introduce a hybrid cryptographic protocol for privacy-adhering transformations of encrypted data. We develop a prototype of Zeph on Apache Kafka to demonstrate that Zeph can  perform large-scale privacy transformations with low overhead.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着越来越多敏感数据被收集以获取宝贵见解，将隐私控制原生集成到数据分析框架中的需求日益重要。如今，隐私控制由能够完全访问明文数据的数据管理者执行。然而，大量近期数据泄露事件表明，即使是广受信任的服务提供商也可能遭到入侵。此外，没有保证数据处理和处理过程符合声称的隐私政策。这促使我们需要一种新的数据隐私方法，能够为用户提供强有力的保证和控制。本文提出Zeph系统，使用户能够设置关于其数据如何被共享和处理的隐私偏好。Zeph以密码学方式执行隐私政策，并确保第三方应用程序可用的数据符合用户的隐私政策。Zeph实时执行符合隐私的数据转换，可扩展至数千个数据源，使其能够支持大规模低延迟的数据流分析。我们引入了一种混合密码学协议，用于对加密数据进行符合隐私的转换。我们在Apache Kafka上开发了Zeph原型，以证明Zeph能够以低开销执行大规模隐私转换。

import_candidates.title: AI in Finance: Scope and Examples
import_candidates.abstract: AI enables principled representation of knowledge, complex strategy optimization, learning from data, and support to human decision making. Manuela will present examples and discuss the scope of AI in her research in the finance domain.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 人工智能能够实现知识的原则化表示、复杂策略优化、从数据中学习以及对人类决策的支持。Manuela将展示人工智能在她金融领域研究中的应用示例，并讨论其范围。

import_candidates.title: It's Time for Operating Systems to Rediscover Hardware
import_candidates.abstract: A glance at this year's OSDI program shows that Operating Systems are a small niche topic for this conference, not even meriting their own full session. This is unfortunate because good OS design has always been driven by the underlying hardware, and right now that hardware is almost unrecognizable from ten years ago, let alone from the 1960s when Unix was written. This change is receiving considerable attention in the architecture and security communities, for example, but in contrast, so-called OS researchers are mostly in denial. Even the little publishable OS work that is not based on Linux still assumes the same simplistic hardware model (essentially a multiprocessor VAX) that bears little resemblance to modern reality. In this talk, I'll speculate on how we came to this unfortunate state of affairs, and what might be done to fix it. In particular, I'll argue for re-engaging with what computer hardware really is today and give two suggestions (among many) about how the OS research community can usefully do this, and exploit what is actually a tremendous opportunity.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 从今年OSDI的程序安排可以看出，操作系统已成为该会议的一个小众话题，甚至不值得为其单独开设一个完整分会场。这是不幸的，因为优秀的操作系统设计始终由底层硬件驱动，而当前的硬件与十年前相比几乎面目全非，更不用说与1960年代Unix诞生时相比了。例如，这种变化在体系结构社区和安全社区已受到相当大的关注，但相比之下，所谓的操作系统研究者大多处于否认状态。即便是少量不基于Linux的可发表操作系统工作，也仍然假设同一种过于简单的硬件模型（本质上是一台多处理器VAX），而这与现实情况几乎毫无相似之处。在本次演讲中，我将推测我们是如何走到这种不幸境地的，以及可以做些什么来修复它。具体而言，我将主张重新与当今计算机硬件真正是什么样的事实接轨，并就操作系统研究社区如何可以有效地做到这一点给出两个建议（在很多可能中），同时利用一个实际上非常巨大的机会。

import_candidates.title: DistAI: Data-Driven Automated Invariant Learning for Distributed Protocols
import_candidates.abstract: Distributed systems are notoriously hard to implement correctly due to non-determinism. Finding the inductive invariant of the distributed protocol is a critical step in verifying the correctness of distributed systems, but takes a long time to do even for simple protocols. We present DistAI, a data-driven automated system for learning inductive invariants for distributed protocols. DistAI generates data by simulating the distributed protocol at different instance sizes and recording states as samples. Based on the observation that invariants are often concise in practice, DistAI starts with small invariant formulas and enumerates all strongest possible invariants that hold for all samples. It then feeds those invariants and the desired safety properties to an SMT solver to check if the conjunction of the invariants and the safety properties is inductive. Starting with small invariant formulas and strongest possible invariants avoids large SMT queries, improving SMT solver performance. Because DistAI starts with the strongest possible invariants, if the SMT solver fails, DistAI does not need to discard failed invariants, but knows to monotonically weaken them and try again with the solver, repeating the process until it eventually succeeds. We prove that DistAI is guaranteed to find the ∃-free inductive invariant that proves the desired safety properties in finite time, if one exists. Our evaluation shows that DistAI successfully verifies 13 common   distributed protocols automatically and outperforms alternative methods both in the number of protocols it verifies and the speed at which it does so, in some cases by more than two orders of magnitude.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 分布式系统因非确定性而难以正确实现。寻找分布式协议的归纳不变量是验证分布式系统正确性的关键步骤，但即使对于简单的协议也需要很长时间。我们提出了DistAI，一个用于自动学习分布式协议归纳不变量的数据驱动系统。DistAI通过在不同实例规模下模拟分布式协议并记录状态作为样本来生成数据。基于不变量在实践中通常简洁的观察，DistAI从小规模不变量公式开始，枚举所有在样本上成立的最强可能不变量。然后，它将那些不变量与期望的安全属性输入到SMT求解器，检查这些不变量与安全属性的合取是否具备归纳性。从小型不变量公式和最强可能不变量开始避免了大型SMT查询，提高了SMT求解器的性能。由于DistAI从最强可能不变量开始，如果SMT求解器失败，DistAI无需丢弃失败的不变量，而是单调地弱化它们再尝试求解器，重复这一过程直到最终成功。我们证明，如果存在这样的∃-free归纳不变量，DistAI保证能在有限时间内找到它并证明期望的安全属性。我们的评估表明，DistAI自动验证了13种常见的分布式协议，并且在所验证的协议数量和验证速度上均优于替代方法，某些情况下快了两个数量级以上。

import_candidates.title: GoJournal: a verified, concurrent, crash-safe journaling system
import_candidates.abstract: The main contribution of this paper is GoJournal, a verified, concurrent journaling system that provides atomicity for storage applications, together with Perennial 2.0, a framework for formally specifying and verifying concurrent crash-safe systems. GoJournal’s goal is to bring the advantages of journaling for code to specs and proofs. Perennial 2.0 makes this possible by introducing several techniques to formalize GoJournal’s specification and to manage the complexity in the proof of GoJournal’s implementation. Lifting predicates and crash framing make the specification easy to use for developers, and logically atomic crash specifications allow for modular reasoning in GoJournal, making the proof tractable despite complex concurrency and crash interleavings.GoJournal is implemented in Go, and Perennial is implemented in the Coq proof assistant. While verifying GoJournal, we found one serious concurrency bug, even though GoJournal has many unit tests. We built a functional NFSv3 server, called GoNFS, to use GoJournal. Performance experiments show that GoNFS provides similar performance (e.g., at least 90% throughput across several benchmarks on an NVMe disk) to Linux’s NFS server exporting an ext4 file system, suggesting that GoJournal is a competitive journaling system. We also verified a simple NFS server using GoJournal’s specs, which confirms that they are helpful for application verification: a significant part of the proof doesn’t have to consider concurrency and crashes.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: GoJournal是一个经过验证的、并发的、崩溃安全的日志系统，它为存储应用程序提供原子性，同时Perennial 2.0是一个用于形式化规范和验证并发崩溃安全系统的框架。GoJournal的目标是将在代码中使用日志系统的优势引入到规范与证明中。Perennial 2.0通过引入若干技术来形式化GoJournal的规范并管理其实现证明的复杂性，从而使这一目标成为可能。提升谓词和崩溃框架使规范易于开发者使用，而逻辑原子的崩溃规范允许对GoJournal进行模块化推理，使得即使在复杂的并发和崩溃交错情况下，证明仍然易于处理。GoJournal用Go实现，而Perennial在Coq证明助手中实现。在验证GoJournal时，尽管它有许多单元测试，我们还是发现了一个严重的并发错误。我们构建了一个功能完整的NFSv3服务器GoNFS来使用GoJournal。性能实验表明，GoNFS在多个基准测试中的吞吐量（在NVMe磁盘上）至少达到Linux NFS服务器导出ext4文件系统的90%，这表明GoJournal是一个具有竞争力的日志系统。我们还使用GoJournal的规范验证了一个简单的NFS服务器，这证实了这些规范对应用程序验证是有帮助的：证明的很大一部分无需考虑并发和崩溃。

import_candidates.title: STORM: Refinement Types for Secure Web Applications
import_candidates.abstract: We present Storm, a web framework that allows developers to build MVC applications with compile-time enforcement of centrally specified data-dependent security policies. Storm ensures security using a Security Typed ORM that refines the (type) abstractions of each layer of the MVC API with logical assertions that describe the data produced and consumed by the underlying operation and the users allowed access to that data. To evaluate the security guarantees of Storm, we build a formally verified reference implementation using the Labeled IO (LIO) IFC framework. We present case studies and end-to-end applications that show how Storm lets developers specify diverse policies while centralizing the trusted code to under 1% of the application, and statically enforces security with modest type annotation overhead, and no run-time cost.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了Storm，一个Web框架，允许开发者构建MVC应用，并在编译时强制执行集中指定的数据依赖安全策略。Storm通过一个安全类型化ORM确保安全性，该ORM用逻辑断言精化MVC API每一层的（类型）抽象，这些断言描述底层操作产生和消费的数据以及被允许访问该数据的用户。为了评估Storm的安全保证，我们使用Labeled IO（LIO）信息流控制框架构建了一个经过形式化验证的参考实现。我们展示了案例研究和端到端应用，说明Storm如何让开发者指定多样化策略，同时将可信代码集中到应用的1%以下，并以适度的类型注解开销和零运行时成本静态执行安全性。

import_candidates.title: Horcrux: Automatic JavaScript Parallelism for Resource-Efficient Web Computation
import_candidates.abstract:
Web pages today commonly include large amounts of JavaScript code in order to offer users a dynamic experience. These scripts often make pages slow to load, partly due to a fundamental inefficiency in how browsers process JavaScript content: browsers make it easy for web developers to reason about page state by serially executing all scripts on any frame in a page, but as a result, fail to leverage the multiple CPU cores that are readily available even on low-end phones.

In this paper, we show how to address this inefficiency without requiring pages to be rewritten or browsers to be modified. The key to our solution, Horcrux, is to account for the non-determinism intrinsic to web page loads and the constraints placed by the browser’s API for parallelism. Horcrux-compliant web servers perform offline analysis of all the JavaScript code on any frame they serve to conservatively identify, for every JavaScript function, the union of the page state that the function could access across all loads of that page. Horcrux’s JavaScript scheduler then uses this information to judiciously parallelize JavaScript execution on the client-side so that the end-state is identical to that of a serial execution, while minimizing coordination and offloading overheads. Across a wide range of pages, phones, and mobile networks covering web workloads in both developed and emerging regions, Horcrux reduces median browser computation delays by 31-44% and page load times by 18-37%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 如今的网页通常包含大量JavaScript代码，以便为用户提供动态体验。这些脚本常常使页面加载缓慢，部分原因在于浏览器处理JavaScript内容时存在根本性的低效：浏览器通过串行执行页面中任何框架的所有脚本，使Web开发人员能够轻松推理页面状态，但结果便是无法利用即便是低端手机上也可用的多个CPU核心。在本文中，我们展示了如何在不要求重写页面或修改浏览器的情况下解决这种低效问题。我们解决方案的关键是Horcrux，它需要处理网页加载固有的不确定性以及浏览器API对并行性施加的约束。符合Horcrux规范的Web服务器对其服务的任何框架上的所有JavaScript代码进行离线分析，以保守地识别每个JavaScript函数在该页面所有加载中可能访问的页面状态的并集。随后，Horcrux的JavaScript调度程序利用这一信息，在客户端明智地并行化JavaScript执行，使最终状态与串行执行完全一致，同时最小化协调和卸载开销。在涵盖发达地区和新兴地区Web工作负载的各种页面、手机和移动网络上，Horcrux将浏览器计算延迟中位数降低了31%-44%，页面加载时间降低了18%-37%。

import_candidates.title: SANRAZOR: Reducing Redundant Sanitizer Checks in C/C++ Programs
import_candidates.abstract: Sanitizers detect unsafe actions such as invalid memory accesses by inserting checks that are validated during a program’s execution. Despite their extensive use for debugging and vulnerability discovery, sanitizer checks often induce a high runtime cost. One important reason for the high cost is, as we observe in this paper, that many sanitizer checks are redundant — the same safety property is repeatedly checked — leading to unnecessarily wasted computing resources. To help more profitably utilize sanitizers, we introduce SanRazor, a practical tool aiming to effectively detect and remove redundant sanitizer checks. SanRazor adopts a novel hybrid approach — it captures both dynamic code coverage and static data dependencies of checks, and uses the extracted information to perform a redundant check analysis. Our evaluation on the SPEC benchmarks shows that SanRazor can reduce the overhead of sanitizers significantly, from 73.8% to 28.0–62.0% for AddressSanitizer, and from 160.1% to 36.6–124.4% for UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer (depending on the applied reduction scheme). Our further evaluation on 38 CVEs from 10 commonly-used programs shows that SanRazor reduced checks suffice to detect at least 33 out of the 38 CVEs. Furthermore, by combining SanRazor with an existing sanitizer reduction tool ASAP, we show synergistic effect by reducing the runtime cost to only 7.0% with a reasonable tradeoff of security.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Sanitizer通过插入在程序执行期间进行验证的检查来检测不安全操作，例如无效的内存访问。尽管它们广泛用于调试和漏洞发现，但Sanitizer检查通常会导致高昂的运行时开销。高成本的一个重要原因是，正如我们在本文中所观察到的，许多Sanitizer检查是冗余的——相同的安全属性被反复检查——导致不必要的计算资源浪费。为了帮助更有益地利用Sanitizer，我们引入了SanRazor，一个旨在有效检测和移除冗余Sanitizer检查的实用工具。SanRazor采用了一种新颖的混合方法——它同时捕捉检查的动态代码覆盖率和静态数据依赖，并使用提取的信息执行冗余检查分析。我们在SPEC基准测试上的评估表明，SanRazor可以显著降低Sanitizer的开销，AddressSanitizer从73.8%降至28.0–62.0%，UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer从160.1%降至36.6–124.4%（取决于所应用的简化方案）。我们进一步对10个常用程序中的38个CVE进行的评估表明，SanRazor简化的检查足以检测至少33个CVE。此外，通过将SanRazor与现有Sanitizer简化工具ASAP相结合，我们展示了协同效应，将运行时成本降至仅7.0%，并具有合理的安全权衡。

import_candidates.title: Dorylus: Affordable, Scalable, and Accurate GNN Training with Distributed CPU Servers and Serverless Threads
import_candidates.abstract:
A graph neural network (GNN) enables deep learning on structured graph data. There are two major GNN training obstacles: 1) it relies on high-end servers with many GPUs which are expensive to purchase and maintain, and 2) limited memory on GPUs cannot scale to today's billion-edge graphs. This paper presents Dorylus: a distributed system for training GNNs. Uniquely, Dorylus can take advantage of serverless computing to increase scalability at a low cost.

The key insight guiding our design is computation separation. Computation separation makes it possible to construct a deep, bounded-asynchronous pipeline where graph and tensor parallel tasks can fully overlap, effectively hiding the network latency incurred by Lambdas. With the help of thousands of Lambda threads, Dorylus scales GNN training to billion-edge graphs. Currently, for large graphs, CPU servers offer the best performance-per-dollar over GPU servers. Just using Lambdas on top of CPU servers offers up to 2.75✕  more performance-per-dollar than training only with CPU servers. Concretely, Dorylus is 1.22✕  faster and 4.83✕  cheaper than GPU servers for massive sparse graphs. Dorylus is up to 3.8✕  faster and 10.7✕  cheaper compared to existing sampling-based systems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 图神经网络（GNN）能够在结构化图数据上进行深度学习。GNN训练面临两大障碍：1）它依赖配备许多GPU的高端服务器，这些服务器购买和维护成本高昂；2）GPU的有限内存无法扩展到当今数十亿条边的图。本文提出Dorylus：一个用于训练GNN的分布式系统。独特的是，Dorylus能够利用无服务器计算以低成本提高可扩展性。指导我们设计的关键洞察是计算分离。计算分离使得构建深度、有界异步流水线成为可能，其中图并行和张量并行任务可以完全重叠，从而有效隐藏Lambda产生的网络延迟。借助数千个Lambda线程，Dorylus将GNN训练扩展到十亿条边的图。目前，对于大型图，CPU服务器在性能价格比上优于GPU服务器。在CPU服务器之上仅使用Lambda，比仅使用CPU服务器训练的性能价格比最多提高2.75倍。具体来说，对于大规模稀疏图，Dorylus比GPU服务器快1.22倍且便宜4.83倍。与现有基于采样的系统相比，Dorylus最多快3.8倍且便宜10.7倍。

import_candidates.title: GNNAdvisor: An Adaptive and Efficient Runtime System for GNN Acceleration on GPUs
import_candidates.abstract: As the emerging trend of graph-based deep learning, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) excel for their capability to generate high-quality node feature vectors (embeddings). However, the existing one-size-fits-all GNN implementations are insufficient to catch up with the evolving GNN architectures, the ever-increasing graph size, and the diverse node embedding dimensionality. To this end, we propose GNNAdvisor, an adaptive and efficient runtime system to accelerate various GNN workloads on GPU platforms. First, GNNAdvisor explores and identifies several performance-relevant features from both the GNN model and the input graph, and use them as a new driving force for GNN acceleration. Second, GNNAdvisor implements a novel and highly-efficient 2D workload management tailored for GNN computation to improve GPU utilization and performance under different application settings. Third, GNNAdvisor capitalizes on the GPU memory hierarchy for acceleration by gracefully coordinating the execution of GNNs according to the characteristics of the GPU memory structure and GNN workloads. Furthermore, to enable automatic runtime optimization, GNNAdvisor incorporates a lightweight analytical model for an effective design parameter search. Extensive experiments show that GNNAdvisor outperforms the state-of-the-art GNN computing frameworks, such as Deep Graph Library (3.02✕ faster on average) and NeuGraph (up to 4.10✕ faster), on mainstream GNN architectures across various datasets.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着基于图的深度学习的新兴趋势，图神经网络（GNN）因其能够生成高质量节点特征向量（嵌入）的能力而表现出色。然而，现有的一刀切式GNN实现不足以跟上不断发展的GNN架构、日益增长的图规模以及多样化的节点嵌入维度。为此，我们提出了GNNAdvisor，一个自适应且高效的运行时系统，用于在GPU平台上加速各种GNN工作负载。首先，GNNAdvisor从GNN模型和输入图中探索并识别若干与性能相关的特征，并将其用作GNN加速的新驱动力。其次，GNNAdvisor实现了一种新颖高效的二维工作负载管理方法，专门针对GNN计算设计，以提高不同应用设置下的GPU利用率和性能。第三，GNNAdvisor利用GPU内存层级结构进行加速，根据GPU内存结构和GNN工作负载的特征优雅地协调GNN的执行。此外，为了实现自动运行时优化，GNNAdvisor整合了一个轻量级分析模型，用于有效的设计参数搜索。大量实验表明，在各种数据集的主流GNN架构上，GNNAdvisor平均比最先进的GNN计算框架（如Deep Graph Library平均快3.02倍，NeuGraph最高快4.10倍）表现更优。

import_candidates.title: Marius: Learning Massive Graph Embeddings on a Single Machine
import_candidates.abstract: We propose a new framework for computing the embeddings of large-scale graphs on a single machine. A graph embedding is a fixed length vector representation for each node (and/or edge-type) in a graph and has emerged as the de-facto approach to apply modern machine learning on graphs. We identify that current systems for learning the embeddings of large-scale graphs are bottlenecked by data movement, which results in poor resource utilization and inefficient training. These limitations require state-of-the-art systems to distribute training across multiple machines. We propose Marius, a system for efficient training of graph embeddings that leverages partition caching and buffer-aware data orderings to minimize disk access and interleaves data movement with computation to maximize utilization. We compare Marius against two state-of-the-art industrial systems on a diverse array of benchmarks. We demonstrate that Marius achieves the same level of accuracy but is up to one order of magnitude faster. We also show that Marius can scale training to datasets an order of magnitude beyond a single machine's GPU and CPU memory capacity, enabling training of configurations with more than a billion edges and 550 GB of total parameters on a single machine with 16 GB of GPU memory and 64 GB of CPU memory.  Marius is open-sourced at www.marius-project.org.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种在单台机器上计算大规模图嵌入的新框架。图嵌入是图中每个节点（和/或边类型）的固定长度向量表示，已成为对图应用现代机器学习的事实标准方法。我们发现，当前用于学习大规模图嵌入的系统受到数据移动的瓶颈限制，导致资源利用率低和训练效率低下。这些局限性要求最先进的系统在多台机器上分布训练。我们提出Marius，一个高效训练图嵌入的系统，它利用分区缓存和缓冲区感知的数据排序来最小化磁盘访问，并将数据移动与计算交错以最大化利用率。我们将Marius与两个最先进的工业系统在多样化的基准测试上进行比较。我们证明Marius实现了相同的准确度，但速度最高提升了一个数量级。我们还表明，Marius可以将训练扩展到单台机器的GPU和CPU内存容量一个数量级以上的数据集，从而能够在拥有16 GB GPU内存和64 GB CPU内存的单台机器上训练超过十亿条边和550 GB总参数的配置。Marius已在www.marius-project.org开源。

import_candidates.title: P3: Distributed Deep Graph Learning at Scale
import_candidates.abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have gained significant attention in the recent past, and become one of the fastest growing subareas in deep learning. While several new GNN architectures have been proposed, the scale of real-world graphs—in many cases billions of nodes and edges—poses challenges during model training. In this paper, we present P3, a system that focuses on scaling GNN model training to large real-world graphs in a distributed setting. We observe that scalability challenges in training GNNs are fundamentally different from that in training classical deep neural networks and distributed graph processing; and that commonly used techniques, such as intelligent partitioning of the graph do not yield desired results. Based on this observation, P3 proposes a new approach for distributed GNN training. Our approach effectively eliminates high communication and partitioning overheads, and couples it with a new pipelined push-pull parallelism based execution strategy for fast model training. P3 exposes a simple API that captures many different classes of GNN architectures for generality. When further combined with a simple caching strategy, our evaluation shows that P3 is able to outperform existing state-of-the-art distributed GNN frameworks by up to 7✕.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 图神经网络（GNN）近年来受到了广泛关注，并成为深度学习中增长最快的子领域之一。尽管已经提出了多种新的GNN架构，但真实世界图数据的规模（在许多情况下可达数十亿节点和边）给模型训练带来了挑战。在本文中，我们提出P3，一个专注于在分布式环境下对大规模真实世界图进行GNN模型训练的系统。我们观察到，训练GNN时的可扩展性挑战与训练经典深度神经网络和分布式图处理有着根本不同；并且常用的技术（如图的智能划分）无法产生预期效果。基于这一观察，P3提出了一种新的分布式GNN训练方法。该方法有效消除了高通信和划分开销，并与之结合了一种基于流水线式推拉并行（pipelined push-pull parallelism）的执行策略，以实现快速模型训练。P3提供了一个简单的API，能够涵盖多种不同类别的GNN架构，以保证通用性。当进一步与简单的缓存策略结合时，我们的评估表明，P3能够比现有最先进的分布式GNN框架性能提升高达7倍。

import_candidates.title: Surprise-Inspired Networking
import_candidates.abstract: The Information Theory concept of surprisal suggests that, in the future, the most valuable information will be the "new" information entering the cloud from the edge rather than the "prior" information that is stored and processed deeper within the cloud. This talk will discuss the implications of this relatively simple concept for future systems and networks. In particular, it will focus on the role that "near the edge" computing and storage can play in synthesizing the "new" and "old" information.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 信息论中的惊奇度概念表明，未来最有价值的信息将是从边缘进入云端的新信息，而不是存储在云端深处并经过更深入处理的旧信息。本文将讨论这一相对简单的概念对未来系统和网络的影响。特别是，它将关注“近边缘”计算与存储在融合“新信息”和“旧信息”方面所能发挥的作用。

import_candidates.title: Owl: Scale and Flexibility in Distribution of Hot Content
import_candidates.abstract: Owl provides high-fanout distribution of large data objects to hosts in Meta’s private cloud. Owl combines a decentralized data plane based on ephemeral peer-to-peer distribution trees with a centralized control plane in which tracker services maintain detailed metadata about peers, their cache state, and ongoing downloads. In Owl, peer nodes are simple state machines and centralized trackers decide from where each peer should fetch data, how they should retry on failure, and which data they should cache and evict. Owl trackers provide a highly-flexible and configurable policy interface that customizes and optimizes behavior for widely-varying distribution use cases. In contrast to prior assumptions about peer-to-peer distribution, Owl shows that centralizing the control plan is not a barrier to scalability: Owl distributes over 800 petabytes of data per day to millions of client processes. Owl improves download speeds by a factor of 2–3 over both BitTorrent and a prior decentralized static distribution tree used at Meta, while supporting 106 use cases which collectively employ 55 different distribution policies.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Owl在Meta的私有云中实现大规模对象的扇出分发。Owl将基于临时点对点分发树的去中心化数据平面与集中式控制平面相结合，在控制平面中，跟踪服务维护有关对等节点、其缓存状态和进行中下载的详细元数据。在Owl中，对等节点是简单的状态机，而集中式跟踪器决定每个对等节点应从何处获取数据、失败时如何重试，以及应缓存和逐出哪些数据。Owl跟踪器提供了高度灵活且可配置的策略接口，可为多种多样的分发用例定制和优化行为。与以往关于点对点分发的假设相反，Owl表明集中控制平面并不构成可扩展性的障碍：Owl每天向数百万客户端进程分发超过800PB的数据。与BitTorrent以及Meta此前使用的一种去中心化静态分发树相比，Owl将下载速度提高了2–3倍，同时支持106个用例，这些用例共同采用了55种不同的分发策略。

import_candidates.title: BlockFlex: Enabling Storage Harvesting with Software-Defined Flash in Modern Cloud Platforms
import_candidates.abstract:
Cloud platforms today make efficient use of storage resources by slicing them among multi-tenant applications on demand. However, our study discloses that the cloud storage is still seriously underutilized for both allocated and unallocated storage. Although cloud providers have developed harvesting techniques to allow evictable virtual machines (VMs) to use unallocated resources, these techniques cannot be directly applied to storage resources, due to the lack of systematic support for isolation of space, bandwidth, and data security in storage devices.

In this paper, we present Blockflex, a learning-based storage harvesting framework, which can harvest available flash-based storage resources at a fine-grained granularity in modern cloud platforms. We rethink the abstractions of storage virtualization and enable transparent harvesting of both allocated and unallocated storage for evictable VMs. Blockflex explores both heuristics and learning-based approaches to maximize the storage utilization, while ensuring the performance and security isolation between regular and evictable VMs at the storage device level. We develop Blockflex with programmable solid-state drives (SSDs) and demonstrate its efficiency with various datacenter workloads.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 当今云平台通过按需将存储资源切片分配给多租户应用来实现高效利用。然而，我们的研究表明，云存储中的已分配和未分配存储仍然被严重低利用率。尽管云提供商已开发出回收技术，允许可被驱逐的虚拟机（VM）使用未分配的资源，但这些技术由于缺乏存储设备中空间、带宽和数据安全隔离的系统性支持，无法直接应用于存储资源。本文提出了Blockflex，一个基于学习的存储回收框架，能够在现代云平台中以细粒度回收可用的闪存存储资源。我们重新思考了存储虚拟化的抽象，并实现了对已分配和未分配存储的透明回收，供可被驱逐的虚拟机使用。Blockflex结合启发式与基于学习的方法，在确保存储设备层面上常规虚拟机与可被驱逐虚拟机之间的性能和安全隔离的同时，最大化存储利用率。我们使用可编程固态硬盘（SSD）开发了Blockflex，并通过各种数据中心工作负载验证了其效率。

import_candidates.title: MemLiner: Lining up Tracing and Application for a Far-Memory-Friendly Runtime
import_candidates.abstract:
Far-memory techniques that enable applications to use remote memory are increasingly appealing in modern datacenters, supporting applications’ large memory footprint and improving machines’ resource utilization. Unfortunately, most far-memory techniques focus on OS-level optimizations and are agnostic to managed runtimes and garbage collections (GC) underneath applications written in high-level languages. With different object-access patterns from applications, GC can severely interfere with existing far-memory techniques, breaking prefetching algorithms and causing severe local-memory misses.

We developed MemLiner, a runtime technique that improves the performance of far-memory systems by “lining up” memory accesses from the application and the GC so that they follow similar memory access paths, thereby (1)reducing the local-memory working set and (2) improving remote-memory prefetching through simplified memory access patterns. We implemented MemLiner in two widely-used GCs in OpenJDK: G1 and Shenandoah. Our evaluation with a range of widely-deployed cloud systems shows MemLiner improves applications’ end-to-end performance by up to 2.5×.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 远内存技术使应用程序能够使用远程内存，在现代数据中心中越来越有吸引力，支持应用程序的大内存占用量并提高机器的资源利用率。然而，大多数远内存技术专注于操作系统级优化，而不考虑用高级语言编写的应用程序之下的托管运行时和垃圾收集（GC）。由于应用程序的对象访问模式不同，GC可能会严重干扰现有的远内存技术，破坏预取算法并导致严重的本地内存缺失。我们开发了MemLiner，一种运行时技术，通过“对齐”应用程序和GC的内存访问，使其遵循相似的内存访问路径，从而(1)减少本地内存工作集，(2)通过简化的内存访问模式改进远程内存预取。我们在OpenJDK中的两个广泛使用的GC—G1和Shenandoah—中实现了MemLiner。我们使用一系列广泛部署的云系统进行的评估表明，MemLiner将应用程序的端到端性能最多提高了2.5倍。

import_candidates.title: Carbink: Fault-Tolerant Far Memory
import_candidates.abstract: Far memory systems allow an application to transparently access local memory as well as memory belonging to remote machines. Fault tolerance is a critical property of any practical approach for far memory, since machine failures (both planned and unplanned) are endemic in datacenters. However, designing a fault tolerance scheme that is efficient with respect to both computation and storage is difficult. In this paper, we introduce Carbink, a far memory system that uses erasure-coding, remote memory compaction, one-sided RMAs, and offloadable parity calculations to achieve fast, storage-efficient fault tolerance. Compared to Hydra, a state-of-the-art fault-tolerant system for far memory, Carbink has 29% lower tail latency and 48% higher application performance, with at most 35% higher memory usage.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 远内存系统允许应用程序透明地访问本地内存以及属于远程机器的内存。容错是任何实用远内存方法的关键属性，因为机器故障（计划内和计划外）在数据中心中广泛存在。然而，设计一种在计算和存储方面都高效的容错方案是困难的。在本文中，我们介绍了Carbink，一种远内存系统，它利用纠删编码、远程内存压缩、单边RMA和可卸载的奇偶校验计算来实现快速、存储高效的容错。与最先进的远内存容错系统Hydra相比，Carbink的尾延迟降低了29%，应用性能提高了48%，而内存使用最多增加35%。

import_candidates.title: Metastable Failures in the Wild
import_candidates.abstract:
Recently, Bronson et al. introduced a framework for understanding a class of failures in distributed systems called metastable failures. The examples of metastable failures presented in that work are simplified versions of failures observed at Facebook. In this work, we study the prevalence of such failures in the wild by scouring over publicly available incident reports from many organizations, ranging from hyperscalers to small companies.

Our main findings are threefold. First, metastable failures are universally observed—we present an in-depth study of 22 metastable failures from 11 different organizations. Second, metastable failures are a recurring pattern in many severe outages—e.g., at least 4 out of 15 major outages in the last decade at Amazon Web Services were caused by metastable failures. Third, we extend the model by Bronson et al. to better reflect the metastable failures seen in the wild by categorizing two types of triggers and two types of amplification mechanisms, which we confirm through developing multiple example applications that reproduce different types of metastable failures in a controlled environment. We believe our work will aid in a deeper understanding of metastable failures and in coming up with solutions to them.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 最近，Bronson等人提出了一个用于理解分布式系统中称为“亚稳态故障”的一类故障的框架。该工作中给出的亚稳态故障示例是对Facebook观察到的故障的简化版本。在这项工作中，我们通过梳理多家机构——从超大规模云服务商到小型公司——公开发布的事故报告，来研究此类故障在现实世界中的普遍性。我们的主要发现有三个方面。第一，亚稳态故障普遍存在——我们对来自11家不同机构的22起亚稳态故障进行了深入研究。第二，亚稳态故障是许多严重故障中反复出现的模式——例如，在过去十年亚马逊网络服务（AWS）的15次重大故障中，至少有4次是由亚稳态故障引起的。第三，我们扩展了Bronson等人的模型，将触发和放大机制各分为两类，以更好地反映现实中的亚稳态故障，并通过开发多个示例应用在受控环境中复现不同类型的亚稳态故障来验证这一模型。我们相信，我们的工作将有助于更深入地理解亚稳态故障并找到解决办法。

import_candidates.title: Demystifying and Checking Silent Semantic Violations in Large Distributed Systems
import_candidates.abstract:
Distributed systems today offer rich features with numerous semantics that users depend on. Bugs can cause a system to silently violate its semantics without apparent anomalies. Such silent violations cause prolonged damage and are difficult to address. Yet, this problem is under-investigated.

In this paper, we first study 109 real-world silent semantic failures from nine widely-used distributed systems to shed some light on this difficult problem. Our study reveals more than a dozen informative findings. For example, it shows that surprisingly the majority of the studied failures were violating semantics that existed since the system’s first stable release.

Guided by insights from our study, we design Oathkeeper, a tool that automatically infers semantic rules from past failures and enforces the rules at runtime to detect new failures. Evaluation shows that the inferred rules detect newer violations, and Oathkeeper only incurs 1.27% overhead.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 当代分布式系统提供了丰富的特性和众多用户依赖的语义。错误可能导致系统在不出现明显异常的情况下静默违反其语义。此类静默违规会造成长期损害且难以处理。然而，这个问题尚未得到充分研究。在本文中，我们首先研究了来自九个广泛使用的分布式系统的109个真实静默语义故障，以揭示这一难题。我们的研究揭示了数十条有信息量的发现。例如，它表明令人惊讶的是，所研究的大多数故障违反的语义在系统首次稳定发布时就已存在。在研究的见解指导下，我们设计了Oathkeeper，一个能够从过去的故障中自动推断语义规则并在运行时强制执行这些规则以检测新故障的工具。评估表明，推断出的规则能检测到较新的违规行为，且Oathkeeper仅引入1.27%的开销。

import_candidates.title: RESIN: A Holistic Service for Dealing with Memory Leaks in Production Cloud Infrastructure
import_candidates.abstract:
Memory leak is a notorious issue. Despite the extensive efforts, addressing memory leaks in large production cloud systems remains challenging. Existing solutions incur high overhead and/or suffer from high inaccuracies.

This paper presents RESIN, a solution designed to holistically address memory leaks in production cloud infrastructure. RESIN takes a divide-and-conquer approach to tackle the challenges. It performs a low-overhead detection first with a robust bucketization-based pivot scheme to identify suspicious leaking entities. It then takes live heap snapshots at appropriate time points in carefully sampled leak entities. RESIN analyzes the collected snapshots for leak diagnosis. Finally, RESIN automatically mitigates detected leaks.

RESIN has been running in production in Microsoft Azure for 3 years. It reports on average 24 leak tickets each month with high accuracy and low overhead, and provides effective diagnosis reports. Its results translate into a 41× reduction of VM reboots caused by low memory.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 内存泄漏是一个臭名昭著的问题。尽管人们付出了大量努力，但在大型生产云系统中解决内存泄漏仍然具有挑战性。现有解决方案要么开销高，要么准确性差。本文介绍了RESIN，一种旨在整体解决生产云基础设施中内存泄漏的解决方案。RESIN采用分而治之的方法来应对挑战。它首先通过一种基于稳健分桶的枢纽方案进行低开销的检测，以识别可疑的泄漏实体。然后，在仔细抽样的泄漏实体的适当时间点获取实时堆快照。RESIN分析收集的快照以进行泄漏诊断。最后，RESIN自动缓解检测到的泄漏。RESIN已在Microsoft Azure中生产运行3年。它每月平均报告24个泄漏问题单，准确性高且开销低，并提供有效的诊断报告。其成果使得因内存不足而导致的虚拟机重启减少了41倍。

import_candidates.title: Cancellation in Systems: An Empirical Study of Task Cancellation Patterns and Failures
import_candidates.abstract: Modern software applications rely on the execution and coordination of many different kinds of tasks. Often overlooked is the need to sometimes prematurely terminate or cancel a task, either to accommodate a conflicting task, to manage system resources, or in response to system or user events that make the task irrelevant. In this paper, we studied 62 cancel-feature requests and 156 cancel-related bugs across 13 popular distributed and concurrent systems written in Java, C#, and Go to understand why task cancel is needed, what are the challenges in implementing task cancel, and how severe are cancel-related failures. Guided by the study, we generalized a few cancel-related anti-patterns, and implemented static checkers that found many code snippets matching these anti-patterns in the latest versions of these popular systems. We hope this study will help guide better and more systematic approaches to task cancellation.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代软件应用依赖多种任务的执行和协调。但往往被忽视的是，有时需要提前终止或取消某个任务，以适应冲突任务、管理系统资源，或响应使任务不再相关的系统或用户事件。在本文中，我们研究了13个用Java、C#和Go编写的流行分布式及并发系统中的62个取消功能请求和156个与取消相关的bug，以理解为什么需要任务取消、实现任务取消面临哪些挑战，以及取消相关故障的严重程度。在研究指引下，我们总结了一些与取消相关的反模式，并实现了静态检查器，在这些流行系统的最新版本中发现了大量匹配这些反模式的代码片段。我们希望这项研究能有助于指导更好、更系统的任务取消方法。

import_candidates.title: Automatic Reliability Testing For Cluster Management Controllers
import_candidates.abstract:
Modern cluster managers like Borg, Omega and Kubernetes rely on the state-reconciliation principle to be highly resilient and extensible. In these systems, all cluster-management logic is embedded in a loosely coupled collection of microservices called controllers. Each controller independently observes the current cluster state and issues corrective actions to converge the cluster to a desired state. However, the complex distributed nature of the overall system makes it hard to build reliable and correct controllers – we find that controllers face myriad reliability issues that lead to severe consequences like data loss, security vulnerabilities, and resource leaks.

We present Sieve, the first automatic reliability-testing tool for cluster-management controllers. Sieve drives controllers to their potentially buggy corners by systematically and extensively perturbing the controller’s view of the current cluster state in ways it is expected to tolerate. It then compares the cluster state’s evolution with and without perturbations to detect safety and liveness issues. Sieve’s design is powered by a fundamental opportunity in state-reconciliation systems – these systems are based on state-centric interfaces between the controllers and the cluster state; such interfaces are highly transparent and thereby enable fully-automated reliability testing. To date, Sieve has efficiently found 46 serious safety and liveness bugs (35 confirmed and 22 fixed) in ten popular controllers with a low false-positive rate of 3.5%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 像Borg、Omega和Kubernetes这样的现代集群管理器依赖状态协调原则来实现高弹性和可扩展性。在这些系统中，所有集群管理逻辑都嵌入在称为控制器的松散耦合的微服务集合中。每个控制器独立观察当前集群状态，并发出纠正措施以将集群收敛到期望状态。然而，整个系统的复杂分布式特性使得构建可靠且正确的控制器变得困难——我们发现控制器面临诸多可靠性问题，这些问题的后果很严重，例如数据丢失、安全漏洞和资源泄漏。我们提出了Sieve，这是首个用于集群管理控制器的自动可靠性测试工具。Sieve通过系统性地、大规模地扰动控制器对当前集群状态的视图（以控制器预期容忍的方式）将控制器驱动到可能存在错误的角落，然后比较有扰动和无扰动情况下集群状态的演变，以检测安全性和活性问题。Sieve的设计源于状态协调系统的一个基本机会——这些系统基于控制器与集群状态之间的以状态为中心的接口；这种接口高度透明，因此能够实现全自动的可靠性测试。迄今为止，Sieve已经在十个流行的控制器中高效地发现了46个严重的安全性和活性错误（其中35个已确认，22个已修复），误报率仅为3.5%。

import_candidates.title: ListDB: Union of Write-Ahead Logs and Persistent SkipLists for Incremental Checkpointing on Persistent Memory
import_candidates.abstract: Due to the latency difference between DRAM and non-volatile main memory (NVMM) and the limited capacity of DRAM, incoming writes are often stalled in LSM tree-based key-value stores. This paper presents ListDB, a write-optimized key-value store for NVMM to overcome the gap between DRAM and NVMM write latencies and thereby, resolve the write stall problem. The contribution of ListDB consists of three novel techniques: (i) byte-addressable Index-Unified Logging, which incrementally converts write-ahead logs into SkipLists, (ii) Braided SkipList, a simple NUMA-aware SkipList that effectively reduces the NUMA effects of NVMM, and (iii) Zipper Compaction, which moves down the LSM-tree levels without copying key-value objects, but by merging SkipLists in place without blocking concurrent reads. Using the three techniques, ListDB makes background compaction fast enough to resolve the infamous write stall problem and shows 1.6x and 25x higher write throughputs than PACTree and Intel Pmem-RocksDB, respectively.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 由于DRAM与非易失性主存（NVMM）之间的延迟差异以及DRAM容量有限，基于LSM树的键值存储中，传入的写入常常被阻塞。本文提出了ListDB，一种面向NVMM的写优化键值存储，以克服DRAM和NVMM写入延迟之间的差距，从而解决写入停滞问题。ListDB的贡献由三种新技术组成：（i）字节可寻址的索引统一日志，将写前日志增量转换为跳表；（ii）编织跳表，一种简单的NUMA感知跳表，有效减少NVMM的NUMA效应；（iii）拉链压缩，在不复制键值对象的情况下向下移动LSM树层级，通过原地合并跳表而不阻塞并发读取。利用这三种技术，ListDB使后台压缩足够快，解决了臭名昭著的写入停滞问题，其写入吞吐量分别是PACTree和Intel Pmem-RocksDB的1.6倍和25倍。

import_candidates.title: ODINFS: Scaling PM Performance with Opportunistic Delegation
import_candidates.abstract:
Existing file systems for persistent memory (PM) exploit its byte-addressable non-volatile access with low latency and high bandwidth. However, they do not utilize two unique PM properties effectively. The first one is contention awareness, i.e., a small number of threads cannot thoroughly saturate the PM bandwidth, while many concurrent accesses lead to significant PM performance degradation. The second one is NUMA awareness, i.e., exploiting the remote PM efficiently, as accessing remote PM naively leads to significant performance degradation.

We present ODINFS, a NUMA-aware scalable datapath PM file system that addresses these two challenges using a novel opportunistic delegation scheme. Under this scheme, ODINFS decouples the PM accesses from application threads with the help of background threads that access PM on behalf of the application. Because of PM access decoupling, ODINFS automatically parallelizes the access to PM across NUMA nodes in a controlled and localized manner. Our evaluation shows that ODINFS outperforms existing PM file systems up to 32.7× on real-world workloads.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现有的持久内存（PM）文件系统利用了其字节可寻址的非易失性访问特性，具有低延迟和高带宽。然而，它们未能有效利用PM的两个独特属性。第一个是争用感知：少量线程无法完全饱和PM带宽，而大量并发访问则会导致显著的PM性能下降。第二个是NUMA感知：有效利用远程PM具有挑战性，因为简单访问远程PM会导致显著的性能下降。我们提出了ODINFS，一个NUMA感知的可扩展数据路径PM文件系统，通过一种新颖的机会式委派方案来解决这两个挑战。在该方案下，ODINFS借助后台线程代表应用程序访问PM，将PM访问与应用程序线程解耦。由于PM访问的解耦，ODINFS以受控和本地化的方式自动并行化跨NUMA节点的PM访问。我们的评估表明，在真实工作负载上，ODINFS的性能比现有PM文件系统最高提升32.7倍。

import_candidates.title: DURINN: Adversarial Memory and Thread Interleaving for Detecting Durable Linearizability Bugs
import_candidates.abstract:
Non-volatile memory (NVM) has promoted the development of concurrent crash-consistent data structures, which serve as the backbone of various in-memory persistent applications. Durable linearizability defines the correct semantics of NVM-backed concurrent crash-consistent data structures, in which linearizability is preserved even in the presence of a crash event. However, designing and implementing a correct durable linearizable data structure remain challenging as developers are to manually control durability (persistence) using low-level cache flush and store fence instructions.

We present DURINN, to the best of our knowledge, the first durable linearizability checker for concurrent NVM data structures. DURINN is based on the novel observation on the gap between linearizability point – when the changes to a concurrent data structure become publicly visible – and durability point – when the changes become persistent. From the detailed gap analysis, we derive three durable linearizability bug patterns that render a linearizable data structure not durable linearizable. To tame the huge NVM states and thread interleaving test space, DURINN statically identifies likely-linearization points and actively constructs adversarial NVM state and thread interleaving settings that increase the likelihood of revealing DL bugs. DURINN effectively detected 27 (15 new) durable linearizability bugs from 12 concurrent NVM data structures without a test space explosion problem.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 非易失性内存（NVM）推动了并发崩溃一致性数据结构的发展，这些结构构成了各种内存持久化应用的骨干。持久线性izability定义了NVM支持的并发崩溃一致性数据结构的正确语义，即使在发生崩溃事件时也能保持线性izability。然而，设计和实现正确的持久线性izable数据结构仍然具有挑战性，因为开发者需要使用底层的缓存刷新和存储栅栏指令手动控制持久性（persistence）。我们提出了DURINN，据我们所知，这是第一个面向并发NVM数据结构的持久线性izability检查器。DURINN基于对线性化点（当对并发数据结构的更改变为公开可见时）与持久点（当更改变为持久时）之间差距的新颖观察。通过详细的差距分析，我们推导出三种持久线性izability bug模式，它们使一个线性izable数据结构不再是持久线性izable的。为了控制巨大的NVM状态和线程交错测试空间，DURINN以静态方式识别可能的线性化点，并主动构造对抗性的NVM状态和线程交错设置，以增加揭示DL错误的可能性。DURINN有效地从12个并发NVM数据结构中检测到27个（其中15个是新的）持久线性izability错误，而没有出现测试空间爆炸的问题。

import_candidates.title: SparTA: Deep-Learning Model Sparsity via Tensor-with-Sparsity-Attribute
import_candidates.abstract:
Sparsity is becoming arguably the most critical dimension to explore for efficiency and scalability, as deep learning models grow significantly larger and more complex. After all, the biological neural networks, where deep learning draws inspirations, are naturally sparse and highly efficient. 

We advocate an end-to-end approach to model sparsity via a new abstraction called Tensor-with-Sparsity-Attribute (TeSA), which augments the default Tensor abstraction that is fundamentally designed for dense models. TeSA enables the sparsity attributes and patterns (e.g., for pruning and quantization) to be specified, propagated forward and backward across the entire deep learning model, and used to create highly efficient, specialized operators, taking into account the execution efficiency of different sparsity patterns on different (sparsity-aware) hardware. The resulting SparTA framework can accommodate various sparsity patterns and optimization techniques, delivering 1.7x~8.4x average speedup on inference latency compared to seven state-of-the-art (sparse) solutions with smaller memory footprints. As an end-to-end model sparsity framework, SparTA facilitates sparsity algorithms to explore better sparse models.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着深度学习模型变得显著更大、更复杂，稀疏性可以说是探索效率和可扩展性方面最关键的方向。毕竟，深度学习所借鉴的生物神经网络天然是稀疏且高效的。我们通过一种名为“带稀疏属性的张量”（TeSA）的新抽象来倡导一种端到端的模型稀疏化方法，该抽象增强了默认为密集模型设计的Tensor抽象。TeSA使得稀疏属性和模式（例如用于剪枝和量化）能够在整个深度学习模型中被指定、向前和向后传播，并用于创建高效、专门的算子，同时考虑不同稀疏模式在不同（感知稀疏性的）硬件上的执行效率。由此产生的SparTA框架可以容纳各种稀疏模式和优化技术，与七种最先进的（稀疏）解决方案相比，推理延迟平均提升1.7倍至8.4倍，且内存占用更小。作为一个端到端的模型稀疏化框架，SparTA有助于稀疏算法探索更好的稀疏模型。

import_candidates.title: ROLLER: Fast and Efficient Tensor Compilation for Deep Learning
import_candidates.abstract:
Despite recent advances in tensor compilers, it often costs hours to generate an efficient kernel for an operator, a compute-intensive sub-task in a deep neural network (DNN), on various accelerators (e.g., GPUs). This significantly slows down DNN development cycles and incurs heavy burdens on the development of general kernel libraries and custom kernels, especially for new hardware vendors. The slow compilation process is due to the large search space formulated by existing DNN compilers, which have to use machine learning algorithms to find good solutions.

In this paper, we present ROLLER, which takes a different construction-based approach to generate kernels. At the core of ROLLER is rTile, a new tile abstraction that encapsulates tensor shapes that align with the key features of the underlying accelerator, thus achieving efficient execution by limiting the shape choices. ROLLER then adopts a recursive rTile-based construction algorithm to generate rTile-based programs (rProgram), whose performance can be evaluated efficiently with a micro-performance model without being evaluated in a real device. As a result, ROLLER can generate efficient kernels in seconds, with comparable performance to the state-of-the-art solutions on popular accelerators like GPUs, while offering better kernels on less mature accelerators like IPUs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 尽管张量编译器取得了近期进展，但为深度神经网络(DNN)中的算子（一项计算密集型子任务）在各种加速器（例如GPU）上生成高效内核，往往需要花费数小时。这显著减慢了DNN开发周期，并给通用内核库和自定义内核的开发带来沉重负担，尤其是对新的硬件供应商而言。编译过程缓慢是因为现有DNN编译器所构建的大规模搜索空间，这些编译器必须使用机器学习算法来寻找良好解。在本文中，我们提出了ROLLER，它采用一种不同的基于构建的方法来生成内核。ROLLER的核心是rTile，一种新的磁贴抽象，它封装了与底层加速器关键特征对齐的张量形状，从而通过限制形状选择来实现高效执行。ROLLER随后采用基于rTile的递归构建算法来生成基于rTile的程序(rProgram)，其性能可以通过微性能模型高效评估，而无需在真实设备上运行。因此，ROLLER可以在数秒内生成高效内核，在GPU等流行加速器上与最先进方案性能相当，同时在IPU等不太成熟的加速器上提供更好的内核。

import_candidates.title: Walle: An End-to-End, General-Purpose, and Large-Scale Production System for Device-Cloud Collaborative Machine Learning
import_candidates.abstract: To break the bottlenecks of mainstream cloud-based machine learning (ML) paradigm, we adopt device-cloud collaborative ML and build the first end-to-end and general-purpose system, called Walle, as the foundation. Walle consists of a deployment platform, distributing ML tasks to billion-scale devices in time; a data pipeline, efficiently preparing task input; and a compute container, providing a cross-platform and high-performance execution environment, while facilitating daily task iteration. Specifically, the compute container is based on Mobile Neural Network (MNN), a tensor compute engine along with the data processing and model execution libraries, which are exposed through a refined Python thread-level virtual machine (VM) to support diverse ML tasks and concurrent task execution. The core of MNN is the novel mechanisms of operator decomposition and semi-auto search, sharply reducing the workload in manually optimizing hundreds of operators for tens of hardware backends and further quickly identifying the best backend with runtime optimization for a computation graph. The data pipeline introduces an on-device stream processing framework to enable processing user behavior data at source. The deployment platform releases ML tasks with an efficient push-then-pull method and supports multi-granularity deployment policies. We evaluate Walle in practical e-commerce application scenarios to demonstrate its effectiveness, efficiency, and scalability. Extensive micro-benchmarks also highlight the superior performance of MNN and the Python thread-level VM. Walle has been in large-scale production use in Alibaba, while MNN has been open source with a broad impact in the community.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 为突破主流基于云的机器学习（ML）范式的瓶颈，我们采用端云协同机器学习，并构建了首个端到端、通用型的系统，命名为Walle，作为基础。Walle由部署平台、数据管道和计算容器组成。部署平台将ML任务及时分发到十亿级设备上；数据管道高效地准备任务输入；计算容器提供跨平台的高性能执行环境，同时促进日常任务迭代。具体来说，计算容器基于移动神经网络（MNN），它包含一个张量计算引擎以及数据处理和模型执行库，通过精炼的Python线程级虚拟机（VM）暴露接口，以支持多样化的ML任务和并发任务执行。MNN的核心是算子分解和半自动搜索的新机制，大幅减少了为数十个硬件后端手动优化数百个算子的工作量，并能进一步为计算图快速确定具有运行时优化的最佳后端。数据管道引入了设备端流处理框架，以便在源头处理用户行为数据。部署平台采用高效的先推送后拉取方法发布ML任务，并支持多粒度的部署策略。我们在实际的电子商务应用场景中评估了Walle，以证明其有效性、效率和可扩展性。大量的微基准测试也突出了MNN和Python线程级虚拟机的卓越性能。Walle已在阿里大规模生产中使用，而MNN已开源并在社区中产生广泛影响。

import_candidates.title: Unity: Accelerating DNN Training Through Joint Optimization of Algebraic Transformations and Parallelization
import_candidates.abstract:
This paper presents Unity, the first system that jointly optimizes algebraic transformations and parallelization in distributed DNN training. Unity represents both parallelization and algebraic transformations as substitutions on a unified parallel computation graph (PCG), which simultaneously expresses the computation, parallelization, and communication of a distributed DNN training procedure.

Optimizations, in the form of graph substitutions, are automatically generated given a list of operator specifications, and are formally verified correct using an automated theorem prover. Unity then uses a novel hierarchical search algorithm to jointly optimize algebraic transformations and parallelization while maintaining scalability. The combination of these techniques provides a generic and extensible approach to optimizing distributed DNN training, capable of integrating new DNN operators, parallelization strategies, and model architectures with minimal manual effort. 

We evaluate Unity on seven real-world DNNs running on up to 192 GPUs on 32 nodes and show that Unity outperforms existing DNN training frameworks by up to 3.6× while keeping optimization times under 20 minutes. Unity is available to use as part of the open-source DNN training framework FlexFlow at https://github.com/flexflow/flexflow.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文提出了Unity，这是第一个在分布式DNN训练中联合优化代数变换与并行化的系统。Unity将并行化和代数变换都表示为对统一并行计算图（PCG）的替换，该图同时表达分布式DNN训练过程的计算、并行化和通信。优化以图替换的形式，根据算子规范列表自动生成，并使用自动化定理证明器进行形式化验证。Unity随后采用一种新颖的层次化搜索算法来联合优化代数变换和并行化，同时保持可扩展性。这些技术的结合提供了一种通用且可扩展的方法来优化分布式DNN训练，能够以最少的人工工作量集成新的DNN算子、并行化策略和模型架构。我们在多达32个节点上的192块GPU上对七个真实DNN进行了评估，结果表明Unity在保持优化时间低于20分钟的同时，比现有DNN训练框架的性能最高提升3.6倍。Unity可作为开源DNN训练框架FlexFlow的一部分使用，地址：https://github.com/flexflow/flexflow。

import_candidates.title: Trustworthy Open Source: The Consequences of Success
import_candidates.abstract: Wide-spread use of open-source software is a remarkable achievement, but also creates a tremendous responsibility. How can we collectively step up to ensure open-source software is worthy of the trust the world now expects and deserves? We cover a range of structural and security challenges and how we might address them, including our hopes for a more sustainable future.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 开源软件的广泛使用是一项非凡的成就，但也带来了巨大的责任。我们如何共同采取措施，确保开源软件能够不辜负世界现在期望和理应得到的信任？我们探讨了一系列结构性和安全性挑战以及可能的应对方式，包括我们对于更可持续未来的期望。

import_candidates.title: Trinity: High-Performance Mobile Emulation through Graphics Projection
import_candidates.abstract: Mobile emulation, which creates full-fledged software mobile devices on a physical PC/server, is pivotal to the mobile ecosystem, especially for PC-based mobile gaming, app debugging, and malware detection. Unfortunately, existing mobile emulators perform poorly on graphics-intensive apps in terms of both efficiency and compatibility. To address this, we introduce graphics projection, a novel graphics virtualization mechanism that adds a small-size projection space inside the guest memory of a virtual mobile device. The projection space processes graphics operations involving control contexts and resource handles without host interactions. Novel flow control and data teleporting mechanisms are used to match the decoupled graphics processing rates of the virtual device and the host GPU to maximize performance. The resulting new Android emulator, dubbed Trinity, exhibits an average of 93.3% native hardware performance and 97.2% app support, in some cases outperforming other emulators by more than an order of magnitude. It has been adopted by Huawei DevEco Studio, a major Android IDE with millions of developers.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 移动模拟是在物理PC/服务器上创建功能完备的软件移动设备，对移动生态系统至关重要，尤其是在面向PC的移动游戏、应用调试和恶意软件检测方面。不幸的是，现有的移动模拟器在图形密集型应用上的性能和兼容性都很差。为此，我们引入了图形投影，一种新颖的图形虚拟化机制，在虚拟移动设备的客户内存中添加一个小型投影空间。投影空间处理涉及控制上下文和资源句柄的图形操作，无需与宿主机交互。新颖的流控制和数据传送机制用于匹配虚拟设备和宿主机GPU之间解耦的图形处理速率，从而最大化性能。由此产生的新的Android模拟器Trinity平均达到93.3%的本地硬件性能和97.2%的应用支持，在某些情况下比其他模拟器快一个数量级以上。它已被华为DevEco Studio（拥有数百万开发者的主要Android IDE）采用。

import_candidates.title: ORION and the Three Rights: Sizing, Bundling, and Prewarming for Serverless DAGs
import_candidates.abstract: Serverless applications represented as DAGs have been growing in popularity. For many of these applications, it would be useful to estimate the end-to-end (E2E) latency and to allocate resources to individual functions so as to meet probabilistic guarantees for the E2E latency. This goal has not been met till now due to three fundamental challenges. The ﬁrst is the high variability and correlation in the execution time of individual functions, the second is the skew in execution times of the parallel invocations, and the third is the incidence of cold starts. In this paper, we introduce ORION to achieve these goals. We ﬁrst analyze traces from a production FaaS infrastructure to identify three characteristics of serverless DAGs. We use these to motivate and design three features. The ﬁrst is a performance model that accounts for runtime variabilities and dependencies among functions in a DAG. The second is a method for co-locating multiple parallel invocations within a single VM thus mitigating content-based skew among these invocations. The third is a method for pre-warming VMs for subsequent functions in a DAG with the right look-ahead time. We integrate these three innovations and evaluate ORION on AWS Lambda with three serverless DAG applications. Our evaluation shows that compared to three competing approaches, ORION achieves up to 90% lower P95 latency without increasing $ cost, or up to 53% lower $ cost without increasing tail latency.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 以DAG形式表示的无服务器应用日益流行。对于许多此类应用，估计端到端延迟并分配资源给单个函数以满足端到端延迟的概率性保证将非常有用。由于三个基本挑战，这一目标至今尚未实现：第一是单个函数执行时间的高变异性和相关性，第二是并行调用执行时间的偏斜，第三是冷启动的发生。本文引入了ORION来实现这些目标。我们首先分析生产级FaaS基础设施的轨迹，以识别无服务器DAG的三个特征，并据此设计三项功能。第一是考虑DAG中函数间运行时变异和依赖关系的性能模型；第二是将多个并行调用共置在单个VM中以缓解这些调用间基于内容偏斜的方法；第三是以适当的提前量预热DAG中后续函数VM的方法。我们将这三项创新整合起来，在AWS Lambda上使用三个无服务器DAG应用评估ORION。评估表明，与三种竞争方法相比，ORION在不增加成本的情况下将P95延迟降低了高达90%，或在不必增加尾部延迟的情况下将成本降低了高达53%。

import_candidates.title: Occualizer: Optimistic Concurrent Search Trees From Sequential Code
import_candidates.abstract:
This paper presents Occualizer, a mechanical source code transformation for adding scalable optimistic synchronization to a sequential search tree implementation. Occualizer injects synchronization only to the update steps of tree operations, leaving traversal steps to execute unsynchronized, thereby maximizing parallelism.

We use Occualizer to create concurrent versions of a sequential B+tree, trie, and red-black tree. Evaluation on a 28-core machine shows that Occualizer's trees significantly outperform prior mechanically-crafted trees on non-read-only workloads and are comparable (within 4%) on read-only workloads. Overall, Occualizer shrinks the performance gap between mechanically- and hand-crafted trees by up to 13×. When using Occualizer's B+tree as the index in the STO main-memory database, the system's throughput degrades by less than 30% compared to the default Masstree index, and it scales better.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了Occualizer，这是一种机械化源代码转换，用于为顺序搜索树实现添加可扩展的乐观同步。Occualizer仅向树操作的更新步骤注入同步，而使遍历步骤在无同步状态下执行，从而最大化并行性。我们使用Occualizer创建了顺序B+树、字典树和红黑树的并发版本。在28核机器上的评估表明，Occualizer生成的树在非只读工作负载上显著优于先前机械构造的树，在只读工作负载上则与之相当（差距在4%以内）。总体而言，Occualizer将机械构造树与手工构造树之间的性能差距缩小了最多13倍。当使用Occualizer的B+树作为STO主存数据库的索引时，与默认的Masstree索引相比，系统吞吐量下降不超过30%，并且扩展性更好。

import_candidates.title: Immortal Threads: Multithreaded Event-driven Intermittent Computing on Ultra-Low-Power Microcontrollers
import_candidates.abstract: We introduce Immortal Threads, a novel programming model that brings pseudo-stackful multithreaded processing to intermittent computing. Programmers using Immortal Threads are oblivious to intermittent execution and write their applications in a multithreaded fashion using common event-driven multithreading primitives. Our compiler fronted transforms the stackful threads into stackless threads that waste a minimum amount of computational progress upon power failures. Our runtime implements fair scheduling to switch between threads efficiently. We evaluated Immortal Threads on real hardware by comparing it against the state-of-the-art intermittent runtimes. Our comparison showed that the price paid for the Immortal Threads is a runtime overhead comparable to existing intermittent computing runtimes.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们引入了不朽线程（Immortal Threads），一种新颖的编程模型，为间歇计算带来了伪栈式多线程处理。使用不朽线程的程序员无需关注间歇执行，可以使用常见的事件驱动多线程原语以多线程方式编写应用程序。我们的编译器前端将栈式线程转换为无栈线程，在掉电时浪费最少的计算进展。我们的运行时实现了公平调度，以在线程间高效切换。我们在真实硬件上通过将不朽线程与最先进的间歇运行时进行比较来评估其性能。比较结果表明，不朽线程所付出的运行时常量开销与现有的间歇计算运行时相当。

import_candidates.title: Debugging the OmniTable Way
import_candidates.abstract:
Debugging is time-consuming, accounting for roughly 50% of a developer's time. To identify the cause of a failure, a developer usually tracks the state of their program as it executes on a failing input. Unfortunately, most debugging tools make it difficult for a developer to specify the program state that they wish to observe and computationally expensive to observe execution state. Moreover, existing work to improve our debugging tools often restrict the state that a developer can track by either exposing incomplete execution state or requiring manual instrumentation.

In this paper, we propose an OmniTable, an abstraction that captures all execution state as a large queryable data table. We build a query model around an OmniTable that supports SQL to simplify debugging without restricting the state that a developer can observe: we find that OmniTable debugging queries are more succinct than equivalent logic specified using existing tools. An OmniTable decouples debugging logic from the original execution, which SteamDrill, our prototype, uses to reduce the performance overhead of debugging. The system employs lazy materialization: it uses deterministic record/replay to store the execution associated with each OmniTable and resolves queries by inspecting replay executions. It employs a novel multi-replay strategy that partitions query resolution across multiple replays and a parallel resolution strategy that simultaneously observes state at multiple points-in-time. We find that SteamDrill queries are an order-of-magnitude faster than existing debugging tools.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 调试耗时巨大，约占开发人员约50%的时间。为了确定故障原因，开发人员通常会在有问题的输入上跟踪程序执行时的状态。遗憾的是，大多数调试工具难以让开发人员指定他们想观察的程序状态，并且在观察执行状态时计算开销很高。此外，现有改进调试工具的工作往往限制了开发人员可以跟踪的状态，要么暴露不完整的执行状态，要么需要手动插桩。在本文中，我们提出了OmniTable，一种将执行中的所有状态捕获为大型可查询数据表的抽象。我们围绕OmniTable构建了一种支持SQL的查询模型，以简化调试且不限制开发人员可观察的状态：我们发现OmniTable调试查询比使用现有工具实现等效逻辑更加简洁。OmniTable将调试逻辑与原始执行解耦，我们的原型SteamDrill利用这一点来降低调试的性能开销。系统采用惰性物化：它使用确定性记录/重放来存储与每个OmniTable关联的执行，并通过检查重放执行来解析查询。它采用了一种新颖的多重放策略，将查询解析分区到多次重放中，以及一种并行解析策略，可同时观察多个时间点的状态。我们发现SteamDrill查询比现有调试工具快一个数量级。

import_candidates.title: XRP: In-Kernel Storage Functions with eBPF
import_candidates.abstract: With the emergence of microsecond-scale NVMe storage devices, the Linux kernel storage stack overhead has become significant, almost doubling access times. We present XRP, a framework that allows applications to execute user-defined storage functions, such as index lookups or aggregations, from an eBPF hook in the NVMe driver, safely bypassing most of the kernel’s storage stack. To preserve file system semantics, XRP propagates a small amount of kernel state to its NVMe driver hook where the user-registered eBPF functions are called. We show how two key-value stores, BPF-KV, a simple B+-tree key-value store, and WiredTiger, a popular log-structured merge tree storage engine, can leverage XRP to significantly improve throughput and latency.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着微秒级NVMe存储设备的出现，Linux内核存储栈的开销变得显著，几乎使访问时间翻倍。我们提出了XRP，一个允许应用程序在NVMe驱动程序的eBPF钩子中执行用户定义的存储函数（如索引查找或聚合）的框架，安全地绕过内核存储栈的大部分。为了保持文件系统语义，XRP将少量内核状态传播到其NVMe驱动程序钩子，在那里调用用户注册的eBPF函数。我们展示了两个键值存储——BPF-KV（一个简单的B+树键值存储）和WiredTiger（一个流行的日志结构合并树存储引擎）——如何利用XRP显著提高吞吐量和延迟。

import_candidates.title: TriCache: A User-Transparent Block Cache Enabling High-Performance Out-of-Core Processing with In-Memory Programs
import_candidates.abstract:
Out-of-core systems rely on high-performance cache sub-systems to reduce the number of I/O operations. While the page cache in modern operating systems enables transparent access to memory and storage devices, it suffers from efficiency and scalability issues on cache misses, forcing out-of-core systems to design and implement their own cache components, which is a non-trivial task.

This study proposes TriCache, a cache mechanism that enables in-memory programs to efficiently process out-of-core datasets without requiring any code rewrite. It provides a virtual memory interface on top of the conventional block interface to simultaneously achieve user transparency and sufficient out-of-core performance. A multi-level block cache design is proposed to address the challenge of per-access address translations required by a memory interface. It can exploit spatial and temporal localities in memory or storage accesses to render storage-to-memory address translation and page-level concurrency control adequately efficient for the virtual-memory interface.

Our evaluation shows that in-memory systems operating on top of TriCache can outperform Linux OS page cache by more than one order of magnitude, and can deliver performance comparable to or even better than that of corresponding counterparts designed specifically for out-of-core scenarios.
