As our investigation reveals that all known hypervisor vulnerabilities that threaten the host kernel lie in the VM plane, delegated virtualization completely offloads the in-kernel VM plane to a user-space hypervisor called DuVisor that directly interacts with its VM without exiting to the host kernel, based on a small hardware extension (481 lines of Chisel). We have implemented the hardware extension on an open-source RISC-V CPU on FireSim and built a Rust-based DuVisor atop it. The evaluation results demonstrate that DuVisor significantly reduces the attack surface with negligible performance overhead (< 5%). DuVisor’s source code is publicly available at https://github.com/IPADS-DuVisor.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 当前主流虚拟化系统由于KVM等内核内hypervisor组件暴露了巨大的攻击面而受到严重的安全威胁。为解决这一问题，本文提出了一种称为委派虚拟化的新颖设计，它将商品化hypervisor解耦为两个平面：hypervisor平面（用于hypervisor控制，通常较小且逻辑固定）和VM平面（用于在运行时处理虚拟机（VM）请求和异常）。由于我们的调查显示，所有已知威胁宿主内核的hypervisor漏洞都位于VM平面，因此委派虚拟化将内核内VM平面完全卸载到名为DuVisor的用户空间hypervisor，它基于一个小的硬件扩展（481行Chisel代码）直接与其VM交互，而无需退出到宿主内核。我们已在FireSim上的开源RISC-V CPU上实现了该硬件扩展，并在其上构建了基于Rust的DuVisor。评估结果表明，DuVisor显著减少了攻击面，而性能开销可以忽略不计（<5%）。DuVisor的源代码可在https://github.com/IPADS-DuVisor公开获取。

import_candidates.title: Core slicing: closing the gap between leaky confidential VMs and bare-metal cloud
import_candidates.abstract:
Virtual machines are the basis of resource isolation in today's public clouds, yet the security risks of entrusting that isolation to a cloud provider's hypervisor are substantial. Such concerns have motivated the design of hardware extensions for "confidential VMs" that seek to remove the hypervisor from the trusted computing base by adding a highly-privileged firmware layer that checks hypervisor actions, and supports memory encryption and remote attestation. However, the hypervisor retains control of resource management and observes associated actions of the guest including nested page table faults and CPU scheduling, and thus confidential VMs remain vulnerable to an ever-changing variety of hypervisor-level side channel attacks.  Bare-metal cloud servers avoid such leaks, but remain a niche due to the high cost of dedicated hardware.

We observe that typical cloud VMs run with a static allocation of memory and discrete cores, and increasingly rely on I/O offload, thus negating the apparent need for a hypervisor and the fragile hypervisor/guest isolation boundary. Our design, core slicing, enables multiple untrusted guest OSes to run on shared bare-metal hardware. To ensure isolation without the complexity of virtualization, we propose simple hardware extensions that restrict guests to a static slice of a machine's cores, memory and virtual I/O devices, and delegate resource allocation to a dedicated management slice. We demonstrate practicality and evaluate performance with prototypes for RISC-V and x86.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 虚拟机是当今公有云中资源隔离的基础，但将这种隔离委托给云提供商的管理程序所带来的安全风险是巨大的。这些担忧促使了针对“机密虚拟机”的硬件扩展设计，这些扩展旨在通过增加一个高度特权的固件层来检查管理程序的行为，并支持内存加密和远程证明，从而将管理程序从可信计算基中移除。然而，管理程序仍然保留着对资源管理的控制，并观察客户机的相关行为，包括嵌套页表故障和CPU调度，因此机密虚拟机仍然容易受到各种不断变化的管理程序级侧信道攻击。裸机云服务器可以避免此类泄漏，但由于专用硬件成本高昂，仍然是小众产品。我们观察到，典型的云虚拟机以静态内存和离散核心分配运行，并且越来越依赖I/O卸载，从而否定了对管理程序及其脆弱的管理程序/客户机隔离边界的明显需求。我们的设计“核心切片”使得多个不受信任的客户机操作系统能够在共享的裸机硬件上运行。为了在没有虚拟化复杂性的情况下实现隔离，我们提出了简单的硬件扩展，将客户机限制在机器核心、内存和虚拟I/O设备的静态切片上，并将资源分配委托给专门的管理切片。我们通过RISC-V和x86的原型证明了其实用性并评估了性能。

import_candidates.title: ExoFlow: A Universal Workflow System for Exactly-Once DAGs
import_candidates.abstract:
Given the fundamental tradeoff between run-time and recovery performance, current distributed systems often build application-specific recovery strategies to minimize overheads. However, it is increasingly common for different applications to be composed into heterogeneous pipelines. Implementing multiple interoperable recovery techniques in the same system is rare and difficult. Thus, today's users must choose between: (1) building on a single system, and face a fixed choice of performance vs. recovery overheads, or (2) the challenging task of stitching together multiple systems that can offer application-specific tradeoffs.

We present ExoFlow, a universal workflow system that enables a flexible choice of recovery vs. performance tradeoffs, even within the same application. The key insight behind our solution is to decouple execution from recovery and provide exactly-once semantics as a separate layer from execution. For generality, workflow tasks can return references that capture arbitrary inter-task communication. To enable the workflow system and therefore the end user to take control of recovery, we design task annotations that specify execution semantics such as nondeterminism. ExoFlow generalizes recovery for existing workflow applications ranging from ETL pipelines to stateful serverless workflows, while enabling further optimizations in task communication and recovery.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 鉴于运行时间与恢复性能之间的基本权衡，当前的分布式系统通常会构建应用特定的恢复策略以最小化开销。然而，将不同的应用组合成异构流水线正变得越来越普遍。在同一系统中实现多种可互操作的恢复技术是罕见且困难的。因此，今天的用户必须在以下两者之间做出选择：（1）构建在单一系统之上，忍受固定选择的性能与恢复开销之间的权衡；或（2）自行拼接多个能够提供应用特定权衡的系统。我们提出了ExoFlow，一个通用工作流系统，即使在同一个应用内也能灵活选择恢复与性能之间的权衡。我们解决方案的关键见解是将执行与恢复解耦，并将确切一次语义作为独立于执行的一层提供。为了通用性，工作流任务可以返回捕获任意任务间通信的引用。为了使工作流系统乃至最终用户能够控制恢复，我们设计了指定执行语义（如非确定性）的任务注解。ExoFlow统一了从ETL流水线到有状态无服务器工作流等现有工作流应用的恢复机制，同时在任务通信和恢复方面实现了进一步优化。

import_candidates.title: Hyrax: Fail-in-Place Server Operation in Cloud Platforms
import_candidates.abstract:
Today’s cloud platforms handle server hardware failures by shutting down the affected server and only turning it back online once it has been repaired by a technician. At cloud scale, this all-or-nothing operating model is becoming increasingly unsustainable. This model is also at odds with technology trends, such as the need for new cooling technology.

This paper introduces Hyrax, a datacenter stack that enables compute servers with failed components to continue hosting VMs while hiding the underlying degraded capacity and performance. A key enabler of Hyrax is a novel model of changes in memory interleaving when deactivating faulty memory modules. Experiments on cloud production servers show that Hyrax overcomes common hardware failures without impacting peak VM performance. In large-scale simulations with production traces, Hyrax reduces server repair requirements by 50-60% without impacting VM scheduling.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 如今的云平台通常通过关闭受影响的服务器来处理硬件故障，并且只有在技术人员维修完毕后才会将其重新上线。在云规模下，这种全有或全无的运营模式正变得越来越不可持续。这一模式也与技术趋势相悖，例如对新型冷却技术的需求。本文介绍了Hyrax，一种数据中心堆栈，使得带有故障组件的计算服务器能够继续托管虚拟机，同时隐藏底层容量和性能的下降。Hyrax的一个关键推动因素是，在停用故障内存模块时，提出了一种新的内存交错变化模型。在云生产服务器上的实验表明，Hyrax能够克服常见硬件故障而不影响虚拟机峰值性能。在使用生产迹线的大规模仿真中，Hyrax将服务器维修需求降低了50%至60%，且不影响虚拟机调度。

import_candidates.title: NCC: Natural Concurrency Control for Strictly Serializable Datastores by Avoiding the Timestamp-Inversion Pitfall
import_candidates.abstract:
Strictly serializable datastores greatly simplify application development. However, existing techniques pay unnecessary costs for naturally consistent transactions, which arrive at servers in an order that is already strictly serializable. We exploit this natural arrival order by executing transactions with minimal costs while optimistically assuming they are naturally consistent, and then leverage a timestamp-based technique to efficiently verify if the execution is indeed consistent. In the process of this design, we identify a fundamental pitfall in relying on timestamps to provide strict serializability and name it the timestamp-inversion pitfall. We show that timestamp inversion has affected several existing systems.  

We present Natural Concurrency Control (NCC), a new concurrency control technique that guarantees strict serializability and ensures minimal costs---i.e., one-round latency, lock-free, and non-blocking execution---in the common case by leveraging natural consistency. NCC is enabled by three components: non-blocking execution, decoupled response management, and timestamp-based consistency checking. NCC avoids the timestamp-inversion pitfall with response timing control and proposes two optimization techniques, asynchrony-aware timestamps and smart retry, to reduce false aborts. Moreover, NCC designs a specialized protocol for read-only transactions, which is the first to achieve optimal best-case performance while guaranteeing strict serializability without relying on synchronized clocks. Our evaluation shows NCC outperforms state-of-the-art strictly serializable solutions by an order of magnitude on many workloads.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 严格可序列化的数据存储极大地简化了应用程序开发。然而，现有技术为自然一致的事务付出了不必要的成本，这些事务到达服务器的顺序本身已经是严格可序列化的。我们利用这种自然到达顺序，以最小的成本乐观地执行事务，假设它们是自然一致的，然后利用基于时间戳的技术有效验证执行是否确实一致。在这一设计过程中，我们发现了一个依赖时间戳提供严格可序列化性的基本陷阱，并将其命名为时间戳反转陷阱。我们表明时间戳反转影响了几个现有系统。我们提出了自然并发控制（NCC），一种新的并发控制技术，通过利用自然一致性，在常见情况下保证严格可序列化性并确保最小成本——即单轮延迟、无锁和非阻塞执行。NCC由三个组件实现：非阻塞执行、解耦的响应管理和基于时间戳的一致性检查。NCC通过响应时间控制避免了时间戳反转陷阱，并提出了两种优化技术，即异步感知时间戳和智能重试，以减少错误中止。此外，NCC为只读事务设计了一种专门的协议，这是第一个在不依赖同步时钟的情况下保证严格可序列化性并实现最优最佳情况性能的协议。我们的评估表明，在许多工作负载上，NCC比最先进的严格可序列化解决方案高出一个数量级。

import_candidates.title: Conveyor: One-Tool-Fits-All Continuous Software Deployment at Meta
import_candidates.abstract: We present Conveyor, Meta's software deployment tool, along with the valuable data obtained from managing over 30,000 deployment pipelines that deploy all kinds of services at Meta across millions of machines. We describe a wide range of deployment scenarios that Conveyor supports to achieve universal coverage. At Meta, out of all the deployment pipelines for services deployed via containers, 97% of them employ fully automated deployments without manual intervention: 55% utilize continuous deployment, instantly deploying every code change to production after passing automated tests, and the remaining 42% are automatically deployed on a fixed schedule (mostly daily or weekly) without manual validation. We highlight several distinguishing features of Conveyor, including safe in-place updates to reduce hardware costs, analysis of code dependencies to prevent faulty releases, and the capability to deploy complex ML models at scale.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们介绍了Meta的软件部署工具Conveyor，以及从管理超过30,000条部署流水线（在Meta数百万台机器上部署各类服务）中获得的宝贵数据。我们描述了Conveyor支持的各种部署场景，以实现全面覆盖。在Meta所有通过容器部署的服务的部署流水线中，97%采用全自动部署而无需人工干预：其中55%采用持续部署，每次代码变更通过自动化测试后立即部署到生产环境；其余42%按照固定计划自动部署（大多为每日或每周），无需人工验证。我们强调了Conveyor的几个显著特性，包括安全的原地更新以降低硬件成本、代码依赖分析以防止故障发布，以及大规模部署复杂机器学习模型的能力。

import_candidates.title: Chardonnay: Fast and General Datacenter Transactions for On-Disk Databases
import_candidates.abstract:
Distributed on-disk database systems could either use an expensive commit protocol like two-phase commit (2PC) to guarantee atomicity, and suffer from slow distributed transactions, or forgo 2PC, which lead to weaker semantics, limitations to the programming model, or constrained scalability, making the system less general. We argue this compromise is no longer necessary within modern datacenters. Low latency 2PC (∼150 μs on Azure for 2PC over Paxos) can be achieved using low-latency storage for the relatively small transaction logs, fast RPCs, and careful protocol design. With fast 2PC, the data contention bottleneck for many transactions shifts from 2PC to reading the data itself from the relatively slow storage while holding transaction locks.

We present Chardonnay, a scalable, on-disk, multi-versioned transactional key-value store optimized for single datacenter deployments with fast 2PC. Chardonnay has a general interface supporting point reads, scans, and writes within multi-step strictly serializable ACID transactions. The key mechanism underlying Chardonnay's design is strongly consistent snapshot reads on commodity hardware, using a novel lock-free read protocol. Chardonnay uses this protocol to cheaply determine the read-write sets of queries, enabling Chardonnay to transparently prefetch data needed for a transaction prior to the execution of the transaction and the acquisition of locks. This enables Chardonnay to achieve fast transactions by minimizing contention, and avoids aborts due to deadlocks by ordering lock requests.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 分布式磁盘数据库系统要么使用类似两阶段提交（2PC）这样的昂贵提交协议来保证原子性，因此面临缓慢的分布式事务；要么放弃2PC，从而导致较弱的语义、编程模型的限制或可扩展性受限，使系统不够通用。我们认为在现代化数据中心内，这种折衷已不再必要。借助低延迟存储来存放相对较小的事务日志、快速RPC以及仔细的协议设计，可以实现低延迟的2PC（在Azure上2PC叠加Paxos约150微秒）。使用快速2PC后，许多事务的数据争用瓶颈从2PC转移到在持有事务锁的同时从相对较慢的存储读取数据本身。我们提出Chardonnay，这是一个可扩展的、基于磁盘的、多版本事务键值存储，针对采用快速2PC的单数据中心部署进行了优化。Chardonnay有一个通用接口，支持在多步严格可序列化的ACID事务中进行点读、扫描和写入。Chardonnay设计的关键机制是使用一种新颖的无锁读协议，在商用硬件上实现强一致的快照读。Chardonnay使用该协议廉价地确定查询的读写集合，从而能够在事务执行和获取锁之前透明地预取事务所需的数据。这使得Chardonnay通过最小化争用来实现快速事务，并通过排序锁请求避免因死锁而中止。

import_candidates.title: ScaleDB: A Scalable, Asynchronous In-Memory Database
import_candidates.abstract:
ScaleDB is a serializable in-memory transactional database that achieves excellent scalability on multi-core machines by asynchronously updating range indexes. We find that asynchronous range index updates can significantly improve database scalability by applying updates in batches, reducing contention on critical sections. To avoid stale reads, ScaleDB uses small hash indexlets to hold delayed updates. We use indexlets to design ACC, an asynchronous concurrency control protocol providing serializability. With ACC, it is possible to delay range index updates without adverse performance effects on transaction execution in the common case.

ACC delivers scalable serializable isolation for transactions, with high throughput and low abort rate. Evaluation on a dual-socket server with 36 cores shows that ScaleDB achieves 9.5× better query throughput than Peloton on the YCSB benchmark and 1.8× better transaction throughput than Cicada on the TPC-C benchmark.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: ScaleDB是一个可序列化的内存事务数据库，通过异步更新范围索引，在多核机器上实现了出色的可扩展性。我们发现，异步范围索引更新可以通过批量应用更新来显著提高数据库的可扩展性，减少关键部分上的争用。为了避免读取过时数据，ScaleDB使用小型哈希索引块来保存延迟的更新。我们利用索引块设计了ACC，一种提供可序列化性的异步并发控制协议。通过ACC，可以在常见情况下延迟范围索引更新，而不会对事务执行的性能产生不利影响。ACC为事务提供可扩展的可序列化隔离，具有高吞吐量和低终止率。在双插槽36核服务器上的评估表明，在YCSB基准测试中，ScaleDB的查询吞吐量比Peloton高9.5倍，在TPC-C基准测试中，事务吞吐量比Cicada高1.8倍。

import_candidates.title: VBASE: Unifying Online Vector Similarity Search and Relational Queries via Relaxed Monotonicity
import_candidates.abstract:
Approximate similarity queries on high-dimensional vector indices have become the cornerstone for many critical online services. An increasing need for more sophisticated vector queries requires integrating vector search systems with relational databases. However, high-dimensional vector indices do not exhibit monotonicity, a critical property of conventional indices. The lack of monotonicity forces existing vector systems to rely on monotonicity-preserving tentative indices, set up temporarily for a target vector's TopK nearest neighbors, to facilitate queries. This leads to suboptimal performance due to the difficulty to predict the optimal K.

This paper presents VBase, a system that efficiently supports complex queries of both approximate similarity search and relational operators. VBase identifies a common property, relaxed monotonicity, to unify two seemingly incompatible systems. This common property allows VBase to circumvent the constraints of a TopK-only interface to achieve significantly higher efficiency, while provably preserving the semantics of TopK-based solutions. Evaluation results show VBase offers up to three orders-of-magnitude higher performance than state-of-the-art vector systems on complex online vector queries. VBase further enables analytical similarity queries that previous vector systems do not, and shows 7,000× speedup with 99.9% accuracy of exact queries.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 高维向量索引上的近似相似性查询已成为许多关键在线服务的基石。对于更复杂的向量查询的需求日益增长，要求将向量搜索系统与关系数据库集成。然而，高维向量索引不具备单调性，而单调性是传统索引的一个关键属性。缺乏单调性迫使现有的向量系统依赖于临时的、保持单调性的试探性索引（为目标向量的TopK最近邻临时设置）来促进查询。由于难以预测最优K值，这导致了次优的性能。本文介绍了VBase，一个高效支持近似相似性搜索和关系运算符的复杂查询的系统。VBase识别出一个共同属性——松弛单调性，以统一两个看似不兼容的系统。这一共同属性使VBase能够绕开仅TopK接口的限制，实现显著更高的效率，同时可证明地保留了基于TopK的解决方案的语义。评估结果表明，在复杂的在线向量查询上，VBase的性能比最先进的向量系统高出多达三个数量级。VBase还支持了先前向量系统无法实现的分析性相似性查询，显示相比精确查询有7000倍的加速，并具有99.9%的准确率。

import_candidates.title: Detecting Transactional Bugs in Database Engines via Graph-Based Oracle Construction
import_candidates.abstract:
Transactions are an important feature of database management systems (DBMSs), as they provide the ACID guarantees for a sequence of database operations. Consequently, approaches have been proposed to automatically find transactional bugs in DBMSs. However, they cannot handle complex operations and predicates common in real-world database queries, and thus miss bugs.

This paper introduces a general, effective technique for finding transactional bugs in DBMSs that supports complex SQL queries and predicates. At the conceptual level, we address the test-oracle problem by constructing semantically-equivalent test cases based on fine-grained statement-level dependencies in transactions. At the technical level, we introduce (1) statement-dependency graphs to describe dependencies among SQL statements in transactions, (2) SQL-level instrumentation to capture possible statement-level dependencies, and (3) transactional oracle construction to generate semantically-equivalent test cases using statement-dependency graphs. We also establish the correctness of our approach in generating semantically-equivalent test cases. We have realized our technique as a tool, TxCheck, and evaluated it on three widely-used and well-tested DBMSs, namely TiDB, MySQL, and MariaDB. In total, TxCheck found 56 unique bugs, 52 of which have been confirmed and 18 already fixed. We believe that TxCheck can help solidify DBMSs’ support for transactions thanks to its generality and effectiveness.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 事务是数据库管理系统（DBMS）的重要特性，因为它为一组数据库操作提供了ACID保证。为此，人们已经提出了自动发现DBMS中事务性缺陷的方法。然而，这些方法无法处理现实数据库查询中常见的复杂操作和谓词，因此会漏掉缺陷。本文介绍了一种通用的、有效的技术，用于在支持复杂SQL查询和谓词的DBMS中发现事务性缺陷。在概念层面，我们通过基于事务中细粒度的语句级依赖来构造语义等价的测试用例，从而解决测试预言问题。在技术层面，我们引入了(1)描述事务中SQL语句间依赖关系的语句依赖图，(2)用于捕获可能语句级依赖的SQL级插桩，以及(3)利用语句依赖图生成语义等价测试用例的事务性预言构造。我们还证明了我们的方法在生成语义等价测试用例方面的正确性。我们将该技术实现为工具TxCheck，并在三个广泛使用且经过良好测试的DBMS（即TiDB、MySQL和MariaDB）上进行了评估。TxCheck总共发现了56个独特缺陷，其中52个已确认，18个已修复。我们相信，凭借其通用性和有效性，TxCheck能够帮助巩固DBMS对事务的支持。

import_candidates.title: Take Out the TraChe: Maximizing (Tra)nsactional Ca(che) Hit Rate
import_candidates.abstract: Most caching policies focus on increasing object hit rate to improve overall system performance. However, these algorithms are insufficient for transactions. In this work, we define a new metric, transactional hit rate, to capture when caching reduces latency for transactions. We present DeToX, a caching system that leverages transactional dependencies to make eviction and prefetching decisions. DeToX is able to significantly outperform single-object alternatives on real-world workloads and popular OLTP benchmarks, providing up to a 130% increase in transaction hit rate and 3.4x improvement in cache efficiency.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大多数缓存策略侧重于提高对象命中率以提升整体系统性能。然而，这些算法对事务处理并不足够。在这项工作中，我们定义了一个新指标，即事务命中率，用于捕捉缓存何时能降低事务延迟。我们提出了DeToX，一个利用事务依赖关系来做出驱逐和预取决策的缓存系统。DeToX在真实工作负载和流行的OLTP基准测试上显著优于单一对象替代方案，提供高达130%的事务命中率提升和3.4倍的缓存效率改进。

import_candidates.title: Replicating Persistent Memory Key-Value Stores with Efficient RDMA Abstraction
import_candidates.abstract: Combining persistent memory (PM) with RDMA is a promising approach to performant replicated distributed key-value stores (KVSs). However, existing replication approaches do not work well when applied to PM KVSs: 1) Using RPC induces software queueing and execution at backups, increasing request latency; 2) Using one-sided RDMA WRITE causes numerous streams of small PM writes, leading to severe device-level write amplification (DLWA) on PM.In this paper, we propose Rowan, an efficient RDMA abstraction to handle replication writes in PM KVSs; it aggregates massive concurrent remote writes from different servers, and lands these writes to PM in a sequential (thus low DLWA) and one-sided (thus low latency) manner. We realize Rowan with off-the-shelf RDMA NICs. Further, we build Rowan-KV, a log-structured PM KVS using Rowan for replication. Evaluation shows that under write-intensive workloads, compared with PM KVSs using RPC and RDMA WRITE for replication, Rowan-KV boosts throughput by 1.22× and 1.39× as well as lowers median PUT latency by 1.77× and 2.11×, respectively, while largely eliminating DLWA.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 将持久内存（PM）与RDMA相结合是构建高性能复制分布式键值存储（KVS）的一种有前景的方法。然而，现有的复制方法在应用于PM KVS时效果不佳：1）使用RPC会在备份端引入软件排队和执行，增加请求延迟；2）使用单侧RDMA WRITE会导致大量小规模PM写入流，从而在PM上造成严重的设备级写放大（DLWA）。在本文中，我们提出了Rowan，一种用于处理PM KVS中复制写入的高效RDMA抽象；它聚合来自不同服务器的大量并发远程写入，并以顺序（因此低DLWA）和单侧（因此低延迟）的方式将这些写入落盘到PM。我们使用现成的RDMA NIC实现了Rowan。此外，我们构建了Rowan-KV，一个使用Rowan进行复制的日志结构PM KVS。评估表明，在写密集型工作负载下，与使用RPC和RDMA WRITE进行复制的PM KVS相比，Rowan-KV的吞吐量分别提升了1.22倍和1.39倍，中位数PUT延迟分别降低了1.77倍和2.11倍，同时大幅消除了DLWA。

import_candidates.title: eZNS: An Elastic Zoned Namespace for Commodity ZNS SSDs
import_candidates.abstract:
Emerging Zoned Namespace (ZNS) SSDs, providing the coarse-grained zone abstraction, hold the potential to significantly enhance the cost-efficiency of future storage infrastructure and mitigate performance unpredictability. However, existing ZNS SSDs have a static zoned interface, making them in-adaptable to workload runtime behavior, unscalable to underlying hardware capabilities, and interfering with co-located zones. Applications either under-provision the zone resources yielding unsatisfied throughput, create over-provisioned zones and incur costs, or experience unexpected I/O latencies.   

We propose eZNS, an elastic-zoned namespace interface that exposes an adaptive zone with predictable characteristics. eZNS comprises two major components: a zone arbiter that manages zone allocation and active resources on the control plane, a hierarchical I/O scheduler with read congestion control, and write admission control on the data plane. Together, eZNS enables the transparent use of a ZNS SSD and closes the gap between application requirements and zone interface properties. Our evaluations over RocksDB demonstrate that eZNS outperforms a static zoned interface by 17.7% and 80.3% in throughput and tail latency, respectively, at most.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 新兴的区域命名空间（ZNS）SSD 提供了粗粒度的区域抽象，有潜力显著提高未来存储基础设施的成本效益，并缓解性能不可预测性。然而，现有的ZNS SSD具有静态的分区接口，导致其无法适应工作负载的运行时行为、无法可扩展地匹配底层硬件能力，并会干扰共存区域。应用程序要么区域资源供应不足而达不到满意的吞吐量，要么过度配置区域而产生额外成本，要么经历意外I/O延迟。我们提出了eZNS，一种弹性分区命名空间接口，能提供可预测特性的自适应分区。eZNS包含两个主要组件：分区仲裁器，用于在控制平面管理分配和活动资源；以及分层I/O调度器，包含读拥塞控制和写接纳控制，运行在数据平面。二者共同实现了对ZNS SSD的透明使用，弥合了应用需求与分区接口属性之间的差距。我们对RocksDB的评估表明，与静态分区接口相比，eZNS在吞吐量和尾延迟上分别最高提升17.7%和80.3%。

import_candidates.title: SEPH: Scalable, Efficient, and Predictable Hashing on Persistent Memory
import_candidates.abstract: With the merits of high density, non-volatility, and DRAM-scale latency/bandwidth, persistent memory (PM) brings hope to high-performance storage systems, in which hashing-based index structures receive great attention owing to the efficient query performance. Though lots of efforts have been made to rethink the hashing schemes for PM in recent years, nevertheless, based on our investigation, none of them can hit performance scalability, efficiency, and predictability with one stone, seriously limiting their practicality to time-sensitive or latency-critical applications. To this end, this paper presents SEPH, a Scalable, Efficient, and Predictable Hashing for PM. SEPH paves a new direction to build the hash table by introducing the novel Level Segment (LS) structure, a key to breaking the dilemma between efficiency and predictability standing in front of the existing hashing schemes for PM. With the LS-based hash table structure, SEPH further enables a low-overhead split to greatly suppress the resizing-incurred unpredictability, and develops a semi lock-free concurrency control that requires a nearly-minimal amount of writes to handle an item insertion for achieving ever-higher efficiency and scalability while ensuring the correctness and crash consistency. Compared to state-of-the-art hashing schemes, SEPH demonstrates higher efficiency (up to 15.4× higher throughput), better scalability (performance scales up to 48 threads), and more reliable predictability (improving the tail latency by up to 19.3×).
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 持久内存凭借高密度、非易失性以及DRAM级延迟/带宽的优点，为高性能存储系统带来了希望，其中基于哈希的索引结构因高效的查询性能而受到广泛关注。尽管近年来人们为重新设计适用于持久内存的哈希方案做出了许多努力，但根据我们的调查，没有任何一种方案能够同时兼顾性能可扩展性、效率和可预测性，这严重限制了它们在时间敏感或延迟关键型应用中的实用性。为此，本文提出了SEPH，一种面向持久内存的可扩展、高效且可预测的哈希方案。SEPH通过引入新颖的Level Segment（LS）结构开辟了构建哈希表的新方向，这是打破现有持久内存哈希方案在效率与可预测性之间困境的关键。基于LS的哈希表结构，SEPH进一步实现了低开销的分裂机制，大幅抑制了由调整大小引起的不可预测性，并开发了一种半无锁并发控制，该控制以接近最少的写入量来处理条目插入，以实现更高的效率和可扩展性，同时确保正确性和崩溃一致性。与最先进的哈希方案相比，SEPH表现出更高的效率（吞吐量最高提升15.4倍）、更好的可扩展性（性能可扩展到48个线程）以及更可靠的可预测性（尾部延迟最高改善19.3倍）。

import_candidates.title: No Provisioned Concurrency: Fast RDMA-codesigned Remote Fork for Serverless Computing
import_candidates.abstract: Serverless platforms essentially face a tradeoff between container startup time and provisioned concurrency (i.e., cached instances), which is further exaggerated by the frequent need for remote container initialization. This paper presents MITOSIS, an operating system primitive that provides fast remote fork, which exploits a deep codesign of the OS kernel with RDMA. By leveraging the fast remote read capability of RDMA and partial state transfer across serverless containers, MITOSIS bridges the performance gap between local and remote container initialization. MITOSIS is the first to fork over 10,000 new containers from one instance across multiple machines within a second, while allowing the new containers to efficiently transfer the pre-materialized states of the forked one. We have implemented MITOSIS on Linux and integrated it with FN, a popular serverless platform. Under load spikes in real-world serverless workloads, MITOSIS reduces the function tail latency by 89% with orders of magnitude lower memory usage. For serverless workflow that requires state transfer, MITOSIS improves its execution time by 86%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 无服务器平台本质上面临着容器启动时间与预置并发（即缓存实例）之间的权衡，而频繁的远程容器初始化需求进一步加剧了这一矛盾。本文提出MITOSIS，一种提供快速远程分支的操作系统原语，其利用了操作系统内核与RDMA的深度协同设计。通过借助RDMA的快速远程读取能力和跨无服务器容器的部分状态传输，MITOSIS弥合了本地与远程容器初始化之间的性能差距。MITOSIS是第一个能在不到一秒内从单个实例跨多台机器分支（fork）超过10,000个新容器的系统，同时允许新容器高效地转移已分支容器的预物化状态。我们在Linux上实现了MITOSIS，并将其集成到FN这一流行的无服务器平台中。在真实世界无服务器工作负载的负载尖峰下，MITOSIS将函数尾延迟降低了89%，内存使用量降低了几个数量级。对于需要状态转移的无服务器工作流，MITOSIS将其执行时间提升了86%。

import_candidates.title: Johnny Cache: the End of DRAM Cache Conflicts (in Tiered Main Memory Systems)
import_candidates.abstract:
We demonstrate that hardware management of a tiered memory system offers better performance for many applications than current methods of software management. Hardware management treats the fast memory as a cache on slower memory. The advantages are that caching can be done at cache line granularity and that data appears in fast memory as soon as it is accessed. The potential for cache conflicts has, however, led previous works to conclude these hardware methods generally perform poorly.   

In this paper, we show that the use of low-overhead conflict avoidance techniques eliminates conflicts almost entirely and thereby address the above limitation. We explore two techniques. One technique simply tries to avoid conflicts between pages at page allocation time. The other technique relies on sampling memory accesses to avoid specifically conflicts between hot pages, at page allocation time and by dynamic remapping in the case of conflicts between hot pages missed at allocation time. 

We have implemented these techniques in the Linux kernel on an Intel Optane machine in a system called JC. We use HPC applications, key-value stores and databases to compare JC to the default Linux tiered memory management implementation and to a state-of-the-art software management approach, as exemplified by the HeMem system. 

Our measurements show that JC outperforms Linux and HeMem by up to 5x. A surprising conclusion of this paper is that a cache can be made to perform close-to-optimally by minimizing conflicts at page allocation time, without any monitoring of hot pages or dynamic page remapping.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们证明，对于许多应用而言，硬件管理的分层内存系统比当前的软件管理方法能提供更好的性能。硬件管理将快速内存视为慢速内存上的缓存。其优点在于可以以缓存行粒度进行缓存，并且数据在访问后立即出现在快速内存中。然而，缓存冲突的可能性导致以往的工作认为这些硬件方法通常性能较差。在本文中，我们表明，使用低开销的冲突避免技术几乎可以完全消除冲突，从而解决上述局限性。我们探索了两种技术。一种技术尝试在页分配时避免页之间的冲突。另一种技术依靠对内存访问进行采样，以避免热页之间的冲突，具体做法是在页分配时进行规避，并在分配时遗漏热页冲突的情况下通过动态重映射来处理。我们在配备Intel Optane机器的Linux内核中实现了这些技术，构建了一个名为JC的系统。我们使用HPC应用、键值存储和数据库，将JC与默认的Linux分层内存管理实现以及最先进的软件管理方法（以HeMem系统为代表）进行比较。测量表明，JC的性能比Linux和HeMem最多高出5倍。本文的一个惊人结论是：通过在页分配时最小化冲突，无需监控热页或进行动态页重映射，缓存就能实现接近最优的性能。

import_candidates.title: TAILCHECK: A Lightweight Heap Overflow Detection Mechanism with Page Protection and Tagged Pointers
import_candidates.abstract: A heap overflow vulnerability occurs when a program written in an unmanaged language such as C or C++ accesses a memory location beyond an object allocation boundary. Malicious users may exploit this vulnerability to corrupt an adjacent object in memory, creating an entry point for a security attack. Despite decades of research, unfortunately, it still remains challenging to detect heap overflow vulnerabilities in real-world programs at a low cost.We present TAILCHECK, a new lightweight heap overflow detection scheme that leverages page protection and pointer tagging. When an object is created, TAILCHECK allocates an additional page-protected shadow object, called a TailObject, placing the distance from the object to its TailObject as a tag stored in the unused high-order bits of the object pointer. For every access to the original object, TAILCHECK performs an additional memory access to the TailObject, whose address is computed using the tag. Heap overflows are detected as page faults when an access occurs beyond the TailObject. We evaluated TAILCHECK with four server applications (apache, nginx, memached, redis) and the SPEC CPU2017 and SPEC CPU2006 benchmarks, successfully finding heap overflows in SPEC CPU2017 gcc. TAILCHECK experiences 4% and 2% run-time overhead for the average and tail (99%) latencies for server applications; and only 33% and 29% run-time overhead for SPEC CPU2017 and SPEC CPU2006, respectively, less than the state-of-the-art solution.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 当使用C或C++等非托管语言编写的程序访问超出对象分配边界的内存位置时，就会发生堆溢出漏洞。恶意用户可能利用此漏洞破坏内存中的相邻对象，从而为安全攻击提供入口。尽管经过数十年的研究，不幸的是，在实际程序中低成本地检测堆溢出漏洞仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了TAILCHECK，一种新型轻量级堆溢出检测方案，它利用页保护和指针标记。当一个对象被创建时，TAILCHECK分配一个额外的受页保护的影子对象，称为TailObject，并将从该对象到其TailObject的距离作为标记存储在对象指针未使用的高位中。对原始对象的每次访问，TAILCHECK都会对TailObject进行一次额外的内存访问，其地址通过标记计算。当访问超出TailObject时，堆溢出会作为页错误被检测到。我们使用四个服务器应用程序（apache、nginx、memcached、redis）和SPEC CPU2017及SPEC CPU2006基准对TAILCHECK进行了评估，在SPEC CPU2017 gcc中成功发现了堆溢出。TAILCHECK在服务器应用程序的平均和尾部（99%）延迟方面分别有4%和2%的开销；而在SPEC CPU2017和SPEC CPU2006上的运行时开销仅为33%和29%，优于现有最佳方案。

import_candidates.title: SMART: A High-Performance Adaptive Radix Tree for Disaggregated Memory
import_candidates.abstract:
Disaggregated memory (DM) is an increasingly prevalent architecture in academia and industry with high resource utilization. It separates computing and memory resources into two pools and interconnects them with fast networks. Existing range indexes on DM are based on B+ trees, which suffer from large inherent read and write amplifications. The read and write amplifications rapidly saturate the network bandwidth, resulting in low request throughput and high access latency of B+ trees on DM. 

In this paper, we propose to use the radix tree, which is more suitable for DM than the B+ tree due to smaller read and write amplifications. However, constructing a radix tree on DM is challenging due to the costly lock-based concurrency control, the bounded memory-side IOPS, and the complicated computing-side cache validation. To address these challenges, we design SMART, the first radix tree for disaggregated memory with high performance. Specifically, we leverage 1) a hybrid concurrency control scheme including lock-free internal nodes and fine-grained lock-based leaf nodes to reduce lock overhead, 2) a computing-side read-delegation and write-combining technique to break through the IOPS upper bound by reducing redundant I/Os, and 3) a simple yet effective reverse check mechanism for computing-side cache validation. Experimental results show that SMART achieves 6.1x higher throughput under typical write-intensive workloads and 2.8x higher throughput under read-only workloads, compared with state-of-the-art B+ trees on DM.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 分离内存（DM）是一种在学术界和工业界日益普及的架构，具有高资源利用率。它将计算资源和内存资源分成两个资源池，并通过高速网络互联。现有的基于DM的范围索引基于B+树，但B+树存在较大的固有读写放大问题。读写放大迅速使网络带宽饱和，导致B+树在DM上的请求吞吐量低和访问延迟高。本文提出使用基数树，因为其读写放大更小，比B+树更适合DM。然而，在DM上构建基数树面临挑战，包括高成本的基于锁的并发控制、有限的内存端IOPS以及复杂的计算端缓存验证。为应对这些挑战，我们设计了SMART——首个面向分离内存的高性能基数树。具体而言，我们利用：1）混合并发控制方案，包括无锁内部节点和细粒度基于锁的叶节点，以减少锁开销；2）计算端读委托和写合并技术，通过减少冗余I/O突破IOPS上限；3）一种简单有效的计算端缓存验证反向检查机制。实验结果表明，与DM上最先进的B+树相比，SMART在典型写密集型工作负载下吞吐量提高了6.1倍，在只读工作负载下吞吐量提高了2.8倍。

import_candidates.title: ORC: Increasing Cloud Memory Density via Object Reuse with Capabilities
import_candidates.abstract:
Cloud environments host many tenants, and typically there is substantial overlap between the application binaries and libraries executed by tenants. Thus, memory de-duplication can increase memory density by allocating memory for shared binaries only once. Existing de-duplication approaches, however, either rely on a shared OS to de-deduplicate binary objects, which provides unacceptably weak isolation; or exploit hypervisor-based de-duplication at the level of memory pages, which is blind to the semantics of the objects to be shared.

We describe Object Reuse with Capabilities (ORC), which supports the fine-grained sharing of binary objects between tenants, while isolating tenants strongly through a small trusted computing base (TCB). ORC uses hardware support for memory capabilities to isolate tenants, which permits shared objects to be accessible to multiple tenants safely. Since ORC shares binary objects within a single address space through capabilities, it uses a new relocation type to create per-tenant state when loading shared objects. ORC supports the loading of objects by an untrusted guest, outside of its TCB, only verifying the safety of the loaded data. Our experiments show that ORC achieves a higher memory density with a lower overhead than hypervisor-based de-deduplication.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 云环境托管着众多租户，通常租户执行的应用程序二进制文件和库之间存在大量重叠。因此，内存去重可以通过只为共享二进制文件分配一次内存来提高内存密度。然而，现有的去重方法要么依赖共享操作系统对二进制对象进行去重，这提供了不可接受的弱隔离；要么在内存页级别使用基于虚拟机监控器的去重，这无法理解要共享对象的语义。我们描述了对象复用与能力（Object Reuse with Capabilities, ORC），它支持租户之间细粒度的二进制对象共享，同时通过一个小的可信计算基（TCB）实现强隔离。ORC利用硬件对内存能力的支持来隔离租户，这使得共享对象可以被多个租户安全地访问。由于ORC通过能力在单个地址空间内共享二进制对象，它使用一种新的重定位类型在加载共享对象时创建每租户状态。ORC支持由不受信任的客户机在其TCB之外加载对象，仅验证加载数据的安全性。我们的实验表明，与基于虚拟机监控器的去重相比，ORC以更低的开销实现了更高的内存密度。

import_candidates.title: Global Capacity Management With Flux
import_candidates.abstract:
Customers of both private and public cloud providers must wrestle with the problem of regionalization: how should service capacity be apportioned across a large number of geo-distributed datacenter regions? This problem is further complicated by the complex service dependency graphs that arise from microservice architectures, as well as capacity availability and hardware mix that can vary greatly by region.   

Historically, regionalization has been solved through a slow-moving and manual process, whereby owners of large services directly negotiate capacity allocation and distribution with the cloud provider. However, as both service and cloud footprints continue to grow, these manual processes are becoming untenable, and tend to produce both a great amount of toil for everyone involved, as well as suboptimal results.   

At Meta we have built a system, Flux, to automate capacity regionalization, moving it from a bottoms-up, manual process, to a top-down, automated one. Flux employs RPC tracing to identify service capacity models, and uses these to compute an optimal joint capacity and traffic distribution plan that spans 1000s of services across 10s of products, and involves millions of servers. These plans are orchestrated by a system that safely and efficiently rebalances service capacity and product traffic across 10s of regions on a continuous basis.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 私有云和公有云的客户都必须应对区域化问题：如何在大量地理分布的数据中心区域之间分配服务容量？微服务架构带来的复杂服务依赖图，以及各区域差异很大的容量可用性和硬件组合，使这个问题更加复杂。历史上，区域化是通过缓慢的手动过程解决的，大型服务的拥有者直接与云提供商协商容量分配和分布。然而，随着服务和云足迹的持续增长，这些手动过程变得难以维持，往往会给所有相关人员带来大量辛劳，并产生次优结果。在Meta，我们构建了Flux系统来自动化容量区域化，将其从自下而上的手动过程转变为自上而下的自动化过程。Flux利用RPC追踪来识别服务容量模型，并以此计算跨数十个产品中的数千个服务、涉及数百万台服务器的最优联合容量和流量分配计划。这些计划由一个系统编排，在数十个区域之间持续安全高效地重新平衡服务容量和产品流量。

import_candidates.title: Defcon: Preventing Overload with Graceful Feature Degradation
import_candidates.abstract:
Every day, billions of people depend on Internet services for communication, commerce, and entertainment. Yet planetary-scale data center infrastructures consisting of millions of servers experience unplanned capacity outages and unexpected demand for resources; how can such infrastructures remain reliable in the face of capacity and workload flux?

In this paper, we introduce Defcon, a system for improving the availability of large-scale, globally-distributed Internet services using graceful feature degradation. In response to overload conditions, Defcon enables site operators to gradually disable less-critical features in order to reduce resource demand. Defcon presents a common interface to product developers to define feature knobs that represent degradation capabilities. Defcon automatically tests knobs to understand each knob’s product- and infrastructure-level trade-offs. At Meta, we have used Defcon to improve global product availability in the face of worldwide demand-surges in addition to large-scale infrastructure failures.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 每天，数十亿人依靠互联网服务进行通信、商业和娱乐。然而，由数百万台服务器组成的全球规模的数据中心基础设施会经历意外容量中断和突发的资源需求；面对容量和负载波动，这类基础设施如何保持可靠性？在本文中，我们介绍Defcon，一个利用优雅特性降级来提高大规模全球分布式互联网服务可用性的系统。面对过载情况，Defcon使站点操作员能够逐步禁用不太关键的特性以减少资源需求。Defcon向产品开发人员提供了一致的接口，用于定义表示降级能力的特性开关。Defcon自动测试这些开关，以了解每个开关在产品级和基础设施级上的权衡。在Meta，我们使用Defcon在全球需求激增和大型基础设施故障期间提高了全球产品的可用性。

import_candidates.title: Cilantro: Performance-Aware Resource Allocation for General Objectives via Online Feedback
import_candidates.abstract:
Traditional systems for allocating finite cluster resources among competing jobs have either aimed at providing fairness, relied on users to specify their resource requirements, or have estimated these requirements via surrogate metrics (e.g. CPU utilization). These approaches do not account for a job’s real world performance (e.g. P95 latency). Existing performance-aware systems use offline profiled data and/or are designed for specific allocation objectives. In this work, we argue that resource allocation systems should directly account for real-world performance and the varied allocation objectives of users. In this pursuit, we build Cilantro.   

At the core of Cilantro is an online learning mechanism which forms feedback loops with the jobs to estimate the resource to performance mappings and load shifts. This relieves users from the onerous task of job profiling and collects reliable real-time feedback. This is then used to achieve a variety of user-specified scheduling objectives. Cilantro handles the uncertainty in the learned models by adapting the underlying policy to work with confidence bounds. We demonstrate this in two settings. First, in a multi-tenant 1000 CPU cluster with 20 independent jobs, three of Cilantro’s policies outperform 9 other baselines on three different performance-aware scheduling objectives, improving user utilities by up to 1.2 − 3.7x. Second, in a microservices setting, where 160 CPUs must be distributed between 19 inter-dependent microservices, Cilantro outperforms 3 other baselines, reducing the end-to-end P99 latency to x0.57 the next best baseline.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 传统的在竞争作业之间分配有限集群资源的系统要么旨在提供公平性，要么依赖用户指定其资源需求，或者通过替代指标（如CPU利用率）来估计这些需求。这些方法并未考虑作业的真实世界性能（如P95延迟）。现有的性能感知系统使用离线配置文件数据和/或针对特定的分配目标进行设计。在这项工作中，我们主张资源分配系统应直接考虑真实世界的性能和用户多样化的分配目标。为此，我们构建了Cilantro。Cilantro的核心是一种在线学习机制，它与作业形成反馈回路，以估计资源到性能的映射和负载变化。这减轻了用户进行作业配置文件的繁重任务，并收集可靠的实时反馈。然后利用这些反馈来实现各种用户指定的调度目标。Cilantro通过调整底层策略以适应置信区间来处理所学模型中的不确定性。我们在两种设置中进行了演示。首先，在一个拥有1000个CPU的多租户集群中，有20个独立作业，Cilantro的三种策略在三个不同的性能感知调度目标上优于9个其他基线，将用户效用提高了1.2至3.7倍。其次，在微服务环境中，160个CPU必须分配给19个相互依赖的微服务，Cilantro优于其他3个基线，将端到端P99延迟降低到次优基线的0.57倍。

import_candidates.title: Karma: Resource Allocation for Dynamic Demands
import_candidates.abstract: The classical max-min fairness algorithm for resource allocation provides many desirable properties, e.g., Pareto efficiency, strategy-proofness and fairness. This paper builds upon the observation that max-min fairness guarantees these properties under a strong assumption---user demands being static over time---and that, for the realistic case of dynamic user demands, max-min fairness loses one or more of these properties. We present Karma, a generalization of max-min fairness for dynamic user demands. The key insight in Karma is to introduce "memory" into max-min fairness --- when allocating resources, Karma takes users' past allocations into account: in each quantum, users donate their unused resources and are assigned credits when other users borrow these resources; Karma carefully orchestrates exchange of credits across users (based on their instantaneous demands, donated resources and borrowed resources), and performs prioritized resource allocation based on users' credits. We prove theoretically that Karma guarantees Pareto efficiency, online strategy-proofness, and optimal fairness for dynamic user demands (without future knowledge of user demands). Empirical evaluations over production workloads show that these properties translate well into practice: Karma is able to reduce disparity in performance across users to a bare minimum while maintaining Pareto-optimal system-wide performance.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 经典的资源分配最大最小公平算法具有许多理想的属性，例如帕累托效率、策略抵抗性和公平性。本文基于以下观察：最大最小公平性在用户需求随时间保持静态这一强假设下保证这些属性，而对于用户需求动态变化的现实情况，最大最小公平性会失去上述部分或全部属性。我们提出了Karma，一种适用于动态用户需求的最大最小公平性泛化方法。Karma的关键洞察是在最大最小公平性中引入“记忆”——在分配资源时，Karma会考虑用户过去的分配情况：在每个时间量子中，用户捐赠其未使用的资源，并在其他用户借用这些资源时获得信用额度；Karma精心编排用户间的信用交换（基于其实时需求、捐赠资源和借用资源），并基于用户的信用执行优先级资源分配。我们理论上证明了Karma能够保证动态用户需求下的帕累托效率、在线策略抵抗性和最优公平性（无需未来用户需求的知识）。对生产工作负载的实证评估表明，这些属性在实践中具有良好的表现：Karma能够将用户间的性能差异降至最低，同时维持系统级的帕累托最优性能。

import_candidates.title: AlpaServe: Statistical Multiplexing with Model Parallelism for Deep Learning Serving
import_candidates.abstract: Model parallelism is conventionally viewed as a method to scale a single large deep learning model beyond the memory limits of a single device. In this paper, we demonstrate that model parallelism can be additionally used for the statistical multiplexing of multiple devices when serving multiple models, even when a single model can fit into a single device. Our work reveals a fundamental trade-off between the overhead introduced by model parallelism and the opportunity to exploit statistical multiplexing to reduce serving latency in the presence of bursty workloads. We explore the new trade-off space and present a novel serving system, AlpaServe, that determines an efficient strategy for placing and parallelizing collections of large deep learning models across a distributed cluster. Evaluation results on production workloads show that AlpaServe can process requests at up to 10× higher rates or 6× more burstiness while staying within latency constraints for more than 99% of requests.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 模型并行通常被视为将单个大型深度学习模型扩展到超出单个设备内存限制的一种方法。在本文中，我们证明模型并行还可以在提供多个模型时用于多个设备的统计复用，即使单个模型可以放入单个设备中。我们的工作揭示了模型并行引入的开销与在突发工作负载下利用统计复用来降低服务延迟的机会之间的基本权衡。我们探索了这一新的权衡空间，并提出了一个新颖的服务系统AlpaServe，它确定在分布式集群中放置和并行化大型深度学习模型集合的有效策略。对生产工作负载的评估结果表明，AlpaServe可以将请求处理速率提高至10倍，或在超过99%请求保持在延迟限制内的情况下处理高达6倍的突发性。

import_candidates.title: Cocktailer: Analyzing and Optimizing Dynamic Control Flow in Deep Learning
import_candidates.abstract:
With the growing complexity of deep neural networks (DNNs), developing DNN programs with intricate control flow logic (e.g., loops, branches, and recursion) has become increasingly essential. However, executing such DNN programs efficiently on accelerators is challenging. Current DNN frameworks typically process control flow on the CPU, while offloading the remaining computations to accelerators like GPUs. This often introduces significant synchronization overhead between CPU and the accelerator, and prevents global optimization across control flow scopes.

To address this challenge, we propose Cocktailer, a new DNN compiler that co-optimizes the execution of control flow and data flow on hardware accelerators. Cocktailer provides the uTask abstraction to unify the representation of DNN models, including both control flow and data flow. This allows Cocktailer to expose a holistic scheduling space for rescheduling control flow to the lower-level hardware parallelism of accelerators. Cocktailer uses a heuristic policy to find efficient schedules and is able to automatically move control flow into kernels of accelerators, enabling optimization across control flow boundaries. Evaluations demonstrate that Cocktailer can accelerate DNN models with control flow by up to 8.2× over the fastest one of the state-of-the-art DNN frameworks and compilers.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着深度神经网络（DNN）日益复杂，开发具有复杂控制流逻辑（如循环、分支和递归）的DNN程序变得越来越重要。然而，在加速器上高效执行此类DNN程序颇具挑战。当前的DNN框架通常在CPU上处理控制流，而将剩余的计算任务卸载到GPU等加速器上。这通常会在CPU和加速器之间引入显著的同步开销，并阻碍跨控制流范围的全局优化。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了Cocktailer，一种新的DNN编译器，可在硬件加速器上协同优化控制流和数据流的执行。Cocktailer提供了uTask抽象，以统一表示DNN模型，包括控制流和数据流。这使得Cocktailer能够将控制流重新调度到加速器底层硬件并行度的整体调度空间。Cocktailer使用启发式策略来寻找高效调度，并能自动将控制流移入加速器内核，实现跨控制流边界的优化。评估表明，与最快的SOTA DNN框架和编译器相比，Cocktailer可将带控制流的DNN模型加速最高达8.2倍。

import_candidates.title: Welder: Scheduling Deep Learning Memory Access via Tile-graph
import_candidates.abstract:
With the growing demand for processing higher fidelity data and the use of faster computing cores in newer hardware accelerators, modern deep neural networks (DNNs) are becoming increasingly memory intensive. A disparity between underutilized computing cores and saturated memory bandwidth has been observed in various popular DNN models. This inefficiency is caused by both the conventional treatment of DNNs as compute-intensive workloads and the lack of holistic memory access optimization in DNN models.

In this paper, we introduce Welder, a deep learning compiler that optimizes the execution efficiency from a holistic memory access perspective. The core of Welder is tile-graph, an abstraction that facilitates fine-grained data management at tile level. By leveraging the observation of optimization independence across memory layers, Welder is able to decompose the whole combinatorial DNN optimization space into several independent ones and effectively trade off between intra- and inter-operator data reuse using a tile traffic-based cost model. This allows Welder to unify previous ad-hoc memory optimizations into a single space, generate efficient execution plans with 89 more optimization patterns, and outperform state-of-the-art solutions significantly. Welder is also able to handle DNN models with arbitrarily large input by combining the existing accelerator memory and host memory as a whole system.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着处理更高保真度数据的需求日益增长，以及新型硬件加速器中更快计算核心的使用，现代深度神经网络（DNN）变得越来越内存密集。在许多流行的DNN模型中，可以观察到计算核心未充分利用与内存带宽饱和之间的失衡。这种低效源于将DNN视为计算密集型工作负载的传统处理方式，以及DNN模型中缺乏整体性内存访问优化。在本文中，我们介绍了Welder，一种从整体内存访问角度优化执行效率的深度学习编译器。Welder的核心是tile-graph，一种在tile级别实现细粒度数据管理的抽象。通过利用内存层间优化独立性的观察，Welder能够将整个组合DNN优化空间分解为几个独立空间，并基于tile流量成本模型有效权衡算子内和算子间的数据复用。这使得Welder能够将先前各种特定的内存优化统一到单一空间中，生成包含89种以上优化模式的高效执行计划，并显著优于最先进的解决方案。Welder还通过将现有加速器内存和主机内存作为整体系统相结合，能够处理输入任意大的DNN模型。

import_candidates.title: Effectively Scheduling Computational Graphs of Deep Neural Networks toward Their Domain-Specific Accelerators
import_candidates.abstract:
Fully exploiting the computing power of an accelerator specialized for deep neural networks (DNNs) calls for the synergy between network and hardware architectures, but existing approaches partition a computational graph of DNN into multiple sub-graphs by abstracting away hardware architecture and assign resources to each sub-graph, not only producing redundant off-core data movements but also under-utilizing the hardware resources of a domain-specific architecture (DSA).

This paper introduces a systematic approach for effectively scheduling DNN computational graphs on DSA platforms. By fully taking into account hardware architecture when partitioning a computational graph into coarse-grained sub-graphs, our work enables the synergy between network and hardware architectures, addressing several challenges of prior work: (1) it produces larger but fewer kernels, converting a large number of off-core data movements into on-core data exchanges; (2) it exploits the imbalanced memory usage distribution across DNN network architecture, better saturating the DSA memory hierarchy; (3) it enables across-layer instruction scheduling not studied before, further exploiting the parallelism across different specialized compute units. 

Results of seven DNN inference models on a DSA platform show that our work outperforms TVM and AStitch by 11.15× and 6.16×, respectively, and obtains throughput competitive to the vendor-crafted implementation. A case study on GPU also demonstrates that generating kernels for our sub-graphs can surpass CUTLASS with and without convolution fusion by 1.06× and 1.23×, respectively.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 要充分挖掘专用于深度神经网络（DNN）的加速器的计算能力，需要网络与硬件架构之间的协同，但现有方法在将DNN计算图划分为多个子图时抽象掉了硬件架构并向每个子图分配资源，这不仅会产生冗余的核外数据移动，而且会低估领域专用架构（DSA）的硬件资源利用率。本文介绍了一种在DSA平台上有效调度DNN计算图的系统性方法。通过在划分计算图为粗粒度子图时充分考虑硬件架构，我们的工作实现了网络与硬件架构的协同，解决了先前工作中的多个挑战：(1) 生成更大但更少的内核，将大量核外数据移动转化为核内数据交换；(2) 利用DNN网络架构中不平衡的内存使用分布，更好地饱和DSA内存层次结构；(3) 实现了此前未研究的跨层指令调度，进一步利用不同专用计算单元之间的并行性。在DSA平台上对七个DNN推理模型的结果表明，我们的工作分别比TVM和AStitch快了11.15倍和6.16倍，并获得了与厂商精心实现相当的吞吐量。GPU上的案例研究还表明，为我们的子图生成内核可以在有/无卷积融合的情况下分别超过CUTLASS 1.06倍和1.23倍。

import_candidates.title: EINNET: Optimizing Tensor Programs with Derivation-Based Transformations
import_candidates.abstract: Boosting the execution performance of deep neural networks (DNNs) is critical due to their wide adoption in real-world applications. However, existing approaches to optimizing the tensor computation of DNNs only consider transformations representable by a fixed set of predefined tensor operators, resulting in a highly restricted optimization space. To address this issue, we propose EinNet, a derivation-based tensor program optimizer. EinNet optimizes tensor programs by leveraging transformations between general tensor algebra expressions and automatically creating new operators desired by transformations, enabling a significantly larger search space that includes those supported by prior works as special cases. Evaluation on seven DNNs shows that EinNet outperforms existing tensor program optimizers by up to 2.72× (1.52× on average) on NVIDIA A100 and up to 2.68× (1.55× on average) on NVIDIA V100. EinNet is publicly available at https://github.com/InfiniTensor/InfiniTensor.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 深度神经网络（DNN）在现实世界应用中的广泛采用，使得提升其执行性能至关重要。然而，现有的DNN张量计算优化方法仅考虑由一组预定义张量算子表示的变换，导致优化空间高度受限。为解决此问题，我们提出EinNet，一种基于推导的张量程序优化器。EinNet通过利用通用张量代数表达式之间的变换并自动创建变换所需的新算子来优化张量程序，从而实现显著更大的搜索空间，并将先前工作支持的变换作为特例包含在内。对七个DNN的评估表明，在NVIDIA A100上EinNet比现有张量程序优化器最高提升2.72倍（平均1.52倍），在NVIDIA V100上最高提升2.68倍（平均1.55倍）。EinNet可在https://github.com/InfiniTensor/InfiniTensor公开获取。

import_candidates.title: Hydro: Surrogate-Based Hyperparameter Tuning Service in Datacenters
import_candidates.abstract: Hyperparameter tuning is an essential step in deep learning model development that provides better model performance at the cost of substantial resources. While existing systems can improve tuning efficiency, they still fail to handle large models with billions of parameters and efficiently leverage cluster resources. Motivated by these deficiencies, we introduce Hydro, a surrogate-based hyperparameter tuning service that optimizes tuning workloads in both the job-level and cluster-level granularities. Specifically, it consists of two key components: (1) Hydro Tuner automatically generates and optimizes surrogate models via scaling, parametrization and fusion; (2) Hydro Coordinator improves tuning efficiency and cluster-wide resource utilization by adaptively leveraging ephemeral and heterogeneous resources. Our comprehensive experiments on two tuning algorithms across six models show that Hydro Tuner can dramatically reduce tuning makespan by up to 78.5x compared with Ray Tune and no reduction in tuning quality. Hydro's source code is publicly available at https://github.com/S-Lab-System-Group/Hydro.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 超参数调优是深度学习模型开发中的重要步骤，它以消耗大量资源为代价换取更好的模型性能。虽然现有系统可以提高调优效率，但它们仍然无法处理具有数十亿参数的大模型，也无法高效利用集群资源。针对这些不足，我们提出了Hydro，一种基于代理的超参数调优服务，它在作业级和集群级两个粒度上优化调优工作负载。具体来说，它包含两个关键组件：（1）Hydro Tuner通过缩放、参数化和融合自动生成并优化代理模型；（2）Hydro Coordinator通过自适应利用临时和异构资源来提高调优效率和集群范围的资源利用率。我们对两种调优算法在六个模型上的综合实验表明，与Ray Tune相比，Hydro Tuner可以将调优完成时间大幅缩短多达78.5倍，且调优质量不降低。Hydro的源代码可在https://github.com/S-Lab-System-Group/Hydro公开获取。

import_candidates.title: MGG: Accelerating Graph Neural Networks with Fine-Grained Intra-Kernel Communication-Computation Pipelining on Multi-GPU Platforms
import_candidates.abstract:
The increasing size of input graphs for graph neural networks (GNNs) highlights the demand for using multi-GPU platforms. However, existing multi-GPU GNN systems optimize the computation and communication individually based on the conventional practice of scaling dense DNNs. For irregularly sparse and fine-grained GNN workloads, such solutions miss the opportunity to jointly schedule/optimize the computation and communication operations for high-performance delivery. 

To this end, we propose MGG, a novel system design to accelerate full-graph GNNs on multi-GPU platforms. The core of MGG is its novel fine-grained dynamic software pipeline to facilitate fine-grained computation-communication overlapping within a GPU kernel. Specifically, MGG introduces GNN-tailored pipeline construction and GPU-aware pipeline mapping to facilitate workload balancing and operation overlapping. MGG also incorporates an intelligent runtime design with analytical modeling and optimization heuristics to dynamically improve the GNN execution performance. Extensive evaluation reveals that MGG outperforms state-of-the-art full-graph GNN systems across various settings: on average 4.41×, 4.81×, and 10.83× faster than DGL, MGG-UVM, and ROC frameworks, respectively.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 图神经网络（GNN）输入图规模的不断增大凸显了对多GPU平台的需求。然而，现有多GPU GNN系统基于扩展稠密DNN的传统做法，分别优化计算和通信。对于不规则稀疏且细粒度的GNN工作负载，此类解决方案错失了联合调度/优化计算与通信操作以实现高性能交付的机会。为此，我们提出MGG，一种在多GPU平台上加速全图GNN的新型系统设计。MGG的核心是其新颖的细粒度动态软件流水线，以促进GPU内核内细粒度的计算-通信重叠。具体而言，MGG引入面向GNN的流水线构建和GPU感知的流水线映射，以促进工作负载均衡和操作重叠。MGG还结合了具有分析建模和优化启发式方法的智能运行时设计，以动态提升GNN执行性能。大量评估表明，MGG在各种设置下均优于最先进的全图GNN系统：平均比DGL、MGG-UVM和ROC框架分别快4.41倍、4.81倍和10.83倍。

import_candidates.title: Optimizing Dynamic Neural Networks with Brainstorm
import_candidates.abstract:
Dynamic neural networks (NNs), which can adapt sparsely activated sub-networks to inputs during inference, have shown significant advantages over static ones in terms of accuracy, computational efficiency, and adaptiveness. However, existing deep learning frameworks and compilers mainly focus on optimizing static NNs with deterministic execution, missing optimization opportunities brought by non-uniform distribution of activation in dynamic NNs. The key to optimizing dynamic NNs is the traceability of how data are dynamically dispatched to different paths at inference. Such dynamism often happens at sub-tensor level (e.g., conditional dispatching tokens of a tensor), thus hard for existing tensor-centric frameworks to trace due to misaligned expression granularity.

In this paper, we present Brainstorm, a deep learning framework for optimizing dynamic NNs, which bridges the gap by unifying how dynamism should be expressed. Brainstorm proposes (1) Cell, the key data abstraction that lets model developers express the data granularity where dynamism exists, and (2) Router, a unified interface to let model developers express how Cells should be dynamically dispatched. Brainstorm handles efficient execution of routing actions. This design allows Brainstorm to collect profiles of fine-grained dataflow at the correct granularity. The traceability further opens up a new space of dynamic optimization for dynamic NNs to specialize their execution to the runtime dynamism distribution. Extensive evaluations show Brainstorm brings up to 11.7× speedup (3.29× on average) or leads to 42% less memory consumption for popular dynamic neural networks with the proposed dynamic optimizations.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 动态神经网络（NN）可以在推理过程中根据输入自适应地激活稀疏子网络，与静态网络相比，在准确性、计算效率和自适应性方面具有显著优势。然而，现有的深度学习框架和编译器主要专注于优化具有确定性执行的静态神经网络，错过了动态神经网络中非均匀激活分布所带来的优化机会。优化动态神经网络的关键在于推理时数据如何动态分发到不同路径的可追踪性。这种动态性通常发生在子张量级别（例如，条件分发张量的令牌），因此由于表达粒度不对齐，现有以张量为中心的框架难以追踪。在本文中，我们提出了Brainstorm，一个用于优化动态神经网络的深度学习框架，通过统一表达动态性的方式弥合了这一差距。Brainstorm提出了（1）Cell，作为关键的数据抽象，让模型开发者可以表达动态性存在的数据粒度，以及（2）Router，一个统一接口，让模型开发者表达Cell应如何被动态分发。Brainstorm处理路由操作的高效执行。这种设计使Brainstorm能够在正确的粒度上收集细粒度数据流的配置文件。这种可追踪性进一步为动态神经网络开辟了新的动态优化空间，使其执行能够针对运行时动态分布进行特化。大量评估表明，Brainstorm在流行的动态神经网络上带来了最高11.7倍的加速（平均3.29倍），或通过所提出的动态优化减少了42%的内存消耗。

import_candidates.title: AdaEmbed: Adaptive Embedding for Large-Scale Recommendation Models
import_candidates.abstract:
Deep learning recommendation models (DLRMs) are using increasingly larger embedding tables to represent categorical sparse features such as video genres. Each embedding row of the table represents the trainable weight vector for a specific instance of that feature. While increasing the number of embedding rows typically improves model accuracy by considering more feature instances, it can lead to larger deployment costs and slower model execution. 

Unlike existing efforts that primarily focus on optimizing DLRMs for the given embedding, we present a complementary system, AdaEmbed, to reduce the size of embeddings needed for the same DLRM accuracy via in-training embedding pruning. Our key insight is that the access patterns and weights of different embeddings are heterogeneous across embedding rows, and dynamically change over the training process, implying varying embedding importance with respect to model accuracy. However, identifying important embeddings and then enforcing pruning for modern DLRMs with up to billions of embeddings (terabytes) is challenging. Given the total embedding size, AdaEmbed considers embeddings with higher runtime access frequencies and larger training gradients to be more important, and it dynamically prunes less important embeddings at scale to automatically determine per-feature embeddings. Our evaluations in industrial settings show that AdaEmbed saves 35-60% embedding size needed in deployment and improves model execution speed by 11-34%, while achieving noticeable accuracy gains.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 深度学习推荐模型（DLRM）正使用越来越大的嵌入表来表示类别稀疏特征，如视频类型。表中的每一行嵌入表示该特征特定实例的可训练权重向量。虽然增加嵌入行数通常通过考虑更多特征实例来提高模型准确性，但也可能导致更高的部署成本和更慢的模型执行速度。与现有主要针对给定嵌入优化DLRM的工作不同，我们提出了一种互补系统AdaEmbed，通过训练中嵌入剪枝来减少达到相同DLRM精度所需的嵌入大小。我们的关键洞察是，不同嵌入的访问模式和权重在嵌入行之间是异构的，并在训练过程中动态变化，这意味着嵌入对模型准确性的重要性各不相同。然而，对于拥有高达数十亿嵌入（TB级）的现代DLRM，识别重要嵌入并实施剪枝具有挑战性。在给定总嵌入大小的情况下，AdaEmbed认为运行时访问频率更高且训练梯度更大的嵌入更为重要，它在大规模下动态剪枝不太重要的嵌入，以自动确定每个特征的嵌入。我们在工业环境中的评估表明，AdaEmbed在部署中节省了35%-60%的嵌入大小，模型执行速度提高了11%-34%，同时实现了显著的准确率提升。

import_candidates.title: BWoS: Formally Verified Block-based Work Stealing for Parallel Processing
import_candidates.abstract:
Work stealing is a widely-used scheduling technique for parallel processing on multicore. Each core owns a queue of tasks and avoids idling by stealing tasks from other queues. Prior work mostly focuses on balancing workload among cores, disregarding whether stealing may adversely impact the owner's performance or hinder synchronization optimizations. Real-world industrial runtimes for parallel processing heavily rely on work-stealing queues for scalability, and such queues can become bottlenecks to their performance. 

We present Block-based Work Stealing (BWoS), a novel and pragmatic design that splits per-core queues into multiple blocks. Thieves and owners rarely operate on the same blocks, greatly removing interferences and enabling aggressive optimizations on the owner's synchronization with thieves. Furthermore, BWoS enables a novel probabilistic stealing policy that guarantees thieves steal from longer queues with higher probability. In our evaluation, using BWoS improves performance by up to 1.25x in the Renaissance macrobenchmark when applied to Java GC, provides average 1.26x speedup in JSON processing when applied to Go runtime, and improves maximum throughput of Hyper HTTP server by 1.12x when applied to Rust Tokio runtime. In microbenchmarks, it provides 8-11x better performance than state-of-the-art designs. We have formally verified and optimized BWoS on weak memory models with a model-checking-based framework.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 工作窃取是一种广泛使用的多核并行处理调度技术。每个核心拥有一个任务队列，并通过窃取其他队列的任务来避免空闲。先前的工作大多侧重于平衡核心间的工作负载，而忽略了窃取是否会对拥有者性能产生不利影响或阻碍同步优化。现实世界中的并行处理工业运行时高度依赖工作窃取队列来实现可扩展性，而此类队列可能成为其性能瓶颈。我们提出了基于块的工作窃取（BWoS），一种新颖且实用的设计，将每核心队列拆分为多个块。窃取者和拥有者很少操作同一块，大大减少了干扰，并允许对拥有者与窃取者的同步进行激进优化。此外，BWoS引入了一种新颖的概率窃取策略，保证窃取者以更高的概率从更长的队列中窃取。在我们的评估中，将BWoS应用于Java GC时，在Renaissance宏基准测试中性能提升最高达1.25倍；应用于Go运行时，JSON处理平均加速1.26倍；应用于Rust Tokio运行时，Hyper HTTP服务器的最大吞吐量提升1.12倍。在微基准测试中，其性能比最先进的设计好8-11倍。我们使用基于模型检查的框架在弱内存模型上对BWoS进行了形式化验证和优化。

import_candidates.title: Spoq: Scaling Machine-Checkable Systems Verification in Coq
import_candidates.abstract: System software is often large and complex, resulting in many vulnerabilities that can potentially be exploited to compromise the security of a system. Formal verification offers a potential solution to creating bug-free software, but a key impediment to its adoption remains proof cost. We present Spoq, a highly automated verification framework to construct machine-checkable proofs in Coq for system software with much less proof cost. Spoq introduces a novel program structure reconstruction technique to leverage LLVM to translate C code into Coq, supporting full C semantics, including C macros, inline assembly, and compiler directives, so that source code no longer has to be manually modified to be verified. Spoq leverages a layering proof strategy and introduces novel Coq tactics and transformation rules to automatically generate layer specifications and refinement proofs to simplify verification of concurrent system software. Spoq also supports easy integration of manually written layer specifications and refinement proofs. We use Spoq to verify a multiprocessor KVM hypervisor implementation. Verification using Spoq required 70% less proof effort than the manually written specifications and proofs to verify an older implementation. Furthermore, the proofs using Spoq hold for the unmodified implementation that is directly compiled and executed.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 系统软件通常庞大而复杂，导致许多可能被利用来危害系统安全的漏洞。形式化验证为创建无缺陷软件提供了一种潜在解决方案，但阻碍其采用的一个关键因素仍然是证明成本。我们提出了Spoq，一个高度自动化的验证框架，能够在Coq中为系统软件构建机器可检查的证明，从而大幅降低证明成本。Spoq引入了一种新颖的程序结构重建技术，利用LLVM将C代码翻译为Coq，支持完整的C语义，包括C宏、内联汇编和编译器指令，从而无需为了验证而手动修改源代码。Spoq采用分层证明策略，并引入新颖的Coq策略和转换规则，以自动生成层规范与精化证明，从而简化并发系统软件的验证。Spoq还支持轻松集成手动编写的层规范和精化证明。我们使用Spoq验证了一个多处理器KVM虚拟机监控器实现。与验证旧实现时手动编写的规范和证明相比，使用Spoq进行验证所需的证明工作量减少了70%。此外，使用Spoq的证明适用于未被修改且直接编译和执行的具体实现。

import_candidates.title: Verifying vMVCC, a high-performance transaction library using multi-version concurrency control
import_candidates.abstract: Multi-version concurrency control (MVCC) is a widely used, sophisticated approach for handling concurrent transactions. vMVCC is the first MVCC-based transaction library that comes with a machine-checked proof of correctness, providing clients with a guarantee that it will correctly handle all transactions despite a complicated design and implementation that might otherwise be error-prone. vMVCC is implemented in Go, stores data in memory, and uses several optimizations, such as RDTSC-based timestamps, to achieve high performance (25–96% the throughput of Silo, a state-of-the-art in-memory database, for YCSB and TPC-C workloads). Formally specifying and verifying vMVCC required adopting advanced proof techniques, such as logical atomicity and prophecy variables, owing to the fact that MVCC transactions can linearize at timestamp generation prior to transaction execution.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 多版本并发控制（MVCC）是一种广泛使用且复杂的事务并发处理方法。vMVCC 是首个带有机检正确性证明的基于 MVCC 的事务库，它向客户端保证：尽管设计和实现复杂且可能容易出错，该库仍能正确处理所有事务。vMVCC 使用 Go 语言实现，将数据存储在内存中，并采用多种优化手段（如基于 RDTSC 的时间戳）以获得高性能（在 YCSB 和 TPC-C 工作负载下，吞吐量达到最先进内存数据库 Silo 的 25%–96%）。由于 MVCC 事务可以在事务执行之前的时间戳生成处进行线性化，因此正式规范并验证 vMVCC 需要采用先进的证明技术，如逻辑原子性和预言变量。

import_candidates.title: Automated Verification of Idempotence for Stateful Serverless Applications
import_candidates.abstract:
Serverless computing has become a popular cloud computing paradigm. By default, when a serverless function fails, the serverless platform re-executes the function to tolerate the failure. However, such a retry-based approach requires functions to be idempotent, which means that functions should expose the same behavior regardless of retries. This requirement is challenging for developers, especially when functions are stateful. Failures may cause functions to repeatedly read and update shared states, potentially corrupting data consistency.   

This paper presents Flux, the first toolkit that automatically verifies the idempotence of serverless applications. It proposes a new correctness definition, idempotence consistency, which stipulates that a serverless function’s retry is transparent to users. To verify idempotence consistency, Flux defines a novel property, idempotence simulation, which decomposes the proof for a concurrent serverless application into the reasoning of individual functions. Furthermore, Flux extends existing verification techniques to realize automated reasoning, enabling Flux to identify idempotence-violating operations and fix them with existing log-based methods.   

We demonstrate the efficacy of Flux with 27 representative serverless applications. Flux has successfully identified previously unknown issues in 12 applications. Developers have confirmed 8 issues. Compared to state-of-the-art systems (namely Beldi and Boki) that log every operation, Flux achieves up to 6× lower latency and 10× higher peak throughput, as it logs only the identified idempotence-violating ones.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 无服务器计算已成为一种流行的云计算范式。默认情况下，当无服务器函数失败时，平台会重新执行该函数以容忍故障。然而，这种基于重试的方法要求函数是幂等的，也就是说，无论重试多少次，函数都应表现出相同的行为。这一要求对开发者而言具有挑战性，尤其是当函数是有状态的。故障可能导致函数反复读取和更新共享状态，从而可能破坏数据一致性。本文提出了Flux，这是第一个自动验证无服务器应用幂等性的工具包。它定义了一个新的正确性概念——幂等一致性，规定无服务器函数的重试对用户是透明的。为了验证幂等一致性，Flux定义了一个新属性——幂等模拟，它将并发无服务器应用的证明分解为对各个函数的推理。此外，Flux扩展了现有的验证技术以实现自动化推理，使其能够识别违反幂等性的操作，并用现有的基于日志的方法加以修复。我们用27个代表性的无服务器应用展示了Flux的有效性。Flux成功识别了12个应用中先前未知的问题。开发人员已确认其中8个问题。与对所有操作都记录日志的最新系统（即Beldi和Boki）相比，Flux仅记录识别到的违反幂等性的操作，因此实现了最高6倍的更低延迟和10倍的更高峰值吞吐量。

import_candidates.title: Sharding the State Machine: Automated Modular Reasoning for Complex Concurrent Systems
import_candidates.abstract: We present IronSync, an automated verification framework for concurrent code with shared memory. IronSync scales to complex systems by splitting system-wide proofs into isolated concerns such that each can be substantially automated. As a starting point, IronSync's ownership type system allows a developer to straightforwardly prove both data safety and the logical correctness of thread-local operations. IronSync then introduces the concept of a Localized Transition System, which connects the correctness of local actions to the correctness of the entire system. We demonstrate IronSync by verifying two state-of-the-art concurrent systems comprising thousands of lines: a library for black-box replication on NUMA architectures, and a highly concurrent page cache.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了 IronSync，一个用于共享内存并发代码的自动化验证框架。IronSync 通过将系统级证明分解为孤立关注点，使得每个关注点都可以大幅自动化，从而扩展到复杂系统。作为起点，IronSync 的所有权类型系统允许开发者直接证明数据安全性和线程本地操作的逻辑正确性。接着，IronSync 引入了局部迁移系统（Localized Transition System）的概念，将局部动作的正确性与整个系统的正确性联系起来。我们通过验证两个包含数千行代码的最新并发系统来演示 IronSync：一个用于 NUMA 架构上的黑盒复制库，以及一个高度并发的页缓存。

import_candidates.title: Flor: An Open High Performance RDMA Framework Over Heterogeneous RNICs
import_candidates.abstract: Datacenter applications have been increasingly applying RDMA for the ultra-low latency and low CPU overhead. However, RDMA-capable NICs (RNICs) of different vendors and different generations from the same vendors do not cooperate well, which causes bandwidth imbalance in the production network. Our observation of the heterogeneous RNICs is that though the data path functions of these RNICs follow the same RoCEv2 specifications, their control path functions are vendor and version specific. To this end, we propose Flor, an open framework that provides a flexible control plane in software and a unified hardware plane by adopting heterogeneous RNICs. The hardware plane requires no changes of current specifications. The software plane can run in NPU of RNICs, DPUs and host CPUs, following which we build up strengthen reliable transport over the large-scale lossy Ethernet. We implemented and evaluated Flor in both testbed and production clusters over Intel E180, Mellanox CX-4 and CX-5 and Broadcom RNICs. Experiments show that Flor achieves comparable performance to vanilla RDMA in many scenarios including 1/4096 packet loss, 6000:1 incast, and large-scale cross-pod communication. Flor mitigates the performance gap of CX-4 and CX-5 RNICs from 24.3% to 1.3% when they are deployed together without PFC dependency.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 数据中心应用越来越多地采用RDMA以获得超低延迟和低CPU开销。然而，不同厂商以及同一厂商不同代际的RDMA网卡（RNIC）之间协作不佳，导致生产网络中带宽失衡。我们对异构RNIC的观察是，虽然这些RNIC的数据路径功能遵循相同的RoCEv2规范，但其控制路径功能是厂商和版本特定的。为此，我们提出了Flor，一个开放框架，通过在软件中提供灵活的控制平面，并采用异构RNIC实现统一的硬件平面。该硬件平面无需修改现有规范。软件平面可运行于RNIC的NPU、DPU和主机CPU之上，从而在大规模有损以太网上建立增强的可靠传输。我们在Intel E180、Mellanox CX-4和CX-5以及Broadcom RNIC的测试床和生产集群中实现并评估了Flor。实验表明，在包括1/4096丢包、6000:1 发塞流量和大规模跨Pod通信的许多场景中，Flor均实现了与原生RDMA相当的性能。当CX-4和CX-5 RNIC共同部署时，Flor将它们的性能差距从24.3%降至1.3%，且不依赖PFC。

import_candidates.title: ShRing: Networking with Shared Receive Rings
import_candidates.abstract:
Multicore systems parallelize to accommodate incoming Ethernet traffic, allocating one receive (Rx) ring with ≥1Ki entries per core by default. This ring size is sufficient to absorb packet bursts of single-core workloads. But the combined size of all Rx buffers (pointed to by all Rx rings) can exceed the size of the last-level cache. We observe that, in this case, NIC and CPU memory accesses are increasingly served by main memory, which might incur nonnegligible overheads when scaling to hundreds of incoming gigabits per second. 

To alleviate this problem, we propose "shRing," which shares each Rx ring among several cores when networking memory bandwidth consumption is high. ShRing thus adds software synchronization costs, but this overhead is offset by the smaller memory footprint. We show that, consequently, shRing increases the throughput of NFV workloads by up to 1.27x, and that it reduces their latency by up to 38x. The substantial latency reduction occurs when shRing shortens the per-packet processing time to a value smaller than the packet interarrival time, thereby preventing overload conditions.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 多核系统通过并行化来接纳传入的以太网流量，默认情况下为每个核心分配一个具有≥1K个条目的接收(Rx)环。该环的大小足以吸收单核工作负载的数据包突发。但所有Rx缓冲区（由所有Rx环指向）的总大小可能超过末级缓存的大小。我们观察到，在这种情况下，NIC和CPU的内存访问越来越多地由主内存来服务，当扩展到每秒数百吉比特的传入流量时，这可能会产生不可忽略的开销。为缓解这一问题，我们提出了“shRing”，当网络内存带宽消耗较高时，它在多个核心之间共享每个Rx环。因此，shRing增加了软件同步成本，但这一开销会被更小的内存占用所抵消。我们表明，shRing可以将NFV工作负载的吞吐量提升至多1.27倍，并将其延迟降低至多38倍。当shRing将每数据包处理时间缩短到小于数据包到达间隔时，就会实现显著的延迟降低，从而防止过载情况的发生。

import_candidates.title: ServiceRouter: Hyperscale and Minimal Cost Service Mesh at Meta
import_candidates.abstract: Datacenter applications are often structured as many interconnected microservices, and the service mesh has become a popular approach to route RPC traffic among services. This paper presents Meta's global service mesh, called ServiceRouter (SR), which has been in production since 2012. SR differs from publicly known service meshes in several important ways. First, SR is designed for hyperscale and currently uses millions of L7 routers to route tens of billions of requests per second across tens of thousands of services. Second, while SR adopts the common approach of using sidecar or remote proxies to route 1% of RPC requests in our fleet, it employs a routing library that is directly linked into service executables to route the remaining 99% directly from clients to servers, without the extra hop of going through a proxy. This approach significantly reduces the hardware costs of our hyperscale service mesh, saving hundreds of thousands of machines. Third, SR provides built-in support for sharded services, which account for 68% of RPC requests in our fleet, whereas existing general-purpose service meshes do not support sharded services. Finally, SR introduces the concept of locality rings to simultaneously minimize RPC latency and balance load across geo-distributed datacenter regions, which, to our knowledge, has not been attempted before.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 数据中心应用程序通常由许多互相连接的微服务组成，服务网格已成为在服务之间路由RPC流量的流行方法。本文介绍了Meta的全球服务网格，称为ServiceRouter（SR），自2012年以来一直在生产环境中运行。SR在一些重要方面与公开已知的服务网格不同。首先，SR被设计用于超大规模场景，目前使用数百万个L7路由器每秒路由数百亿请求，跨越数万个服务。第二，虽然SR采用常用方法使用sidecar或远程代理来路由我们数据中心内1%的RPC请求，但它使用一个直接链接到服务可执行文件中的路由库，将剩余的99%直接从客户端路由到服务器，无需经过代理的额外一跳。这种方法大幅降低了超大规模服务网格的硬件成本，节省了数十万台机器。第三，SR为分片服务提供内建支持，这占了我们数据中心内68%的RPC请求，而现有的通用服务网格不支持分片服务。最后，SR引入了定位环的概念，以同时最小化RPC延迟并均衡跨地理分布式数据中心区域的负载，据我们所知，此前尚未有过这样的尝试。

import_candidates.title: Characterizing Off-path SmartNIC for Accelerating Distributed Systems
import_candidates.abstract: SmartNICs have recently emerged as an appealing device for accelerating distributed systems. However, there has not been a comprehensive characterization of SmartNICs, and existing designs typically only leverage a single communication path for workload offloading. This paper presents the first holistic study of a representative off-path SmartNIC, specifically the Bluefield-2, from a communication-path perspective. Our experimental study systematically explores the key performance characteristics of communication among the client, on-board SoC, and host, and offers insightful findings and advice for designers. Moreover, we propose the concurrent use of multiple communication paths of a SmartNIC and present a pioneering guideline to expose new optimization opportunities for various distributed systems. To demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, we conducted case studies on a SmartNIC-based distributed file system (LineFS) and an RDMA-based disaggregated key-value store (DrTM-KV). Our experimental results show improvements of up to 30% and 25% for LineFS and DrTM-KV, respectively.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: SmartNIC最近已成为加速分布式系统的一种有吸引力的设备。然而，尚未有对SmartNIC的全面特征化，现有设计通常只利用单一通信路径进行工作负载卸载。本文从通信路径的角度首次对具有代表性的路径外SmartNIC（特别是Bluefield-2）进行了整体研究。我们的实验研究系统地探索了客户端、片上SoC和主机之间通信的关键性能特征，并为设计者提供了有见地的发现和建议。此外，我们提出了并发使用SmartNIC的多条通信路径，并提出了开创性的指导方针，以揭示各种分布式系统的新优化机会。为了证明我们方法的有效性，我们基于SmartNIC的分布式文件系统（LineFS）和基于RDMA的分解式键值存储（DrTM-KV）进行了案例研究。实验结果显示，LineFS和DrTM-KV的性能分别提升了高达30%和25%。

import_candidates.title: Ensō: A Streaming Interface for NIC-Application Communication
import_candidates.abstract:
Today, most communication between the NIC and software involves exchanging fixed-size packet buffers. This packetized interface was designed for an era when NICs implemented few offloads and software implemented the logic for translating between application data and packets. However, both NICs and networked software have evolved: modern NICs implement hardware offloads, e.g., TSO, LRO, and serialization offloads that can more efficiently translate between application data and packets. Furthermore, modern software increasingly batches network I/O to reduce overheads. These changes have led to a mismatch between the packetized interface, which assumes that the NIC and software exchange fixed-size buffers, and the features provided by modern NICs and used by modern software. This incongruence between interface and data adds software complexity and I/O overheads, which in turn limits communication performance.

This paper proposes Ensō, a new streaming NIC-to-software interface designed to better support how NICs and software interact today. At its core, Ensō eschews fixed-size buffers, and instead structures communication as a stream that can be used to send arbitrary data sizes. We show that this change reduces software overheads, reduces PCIe bandwidth requirements, and leads to fewer cache misses. These improvements allow an Ensō-based NIC to saturate a 100 Gbps link with minimum-sized packets (forwarding at 148.8 Mpps) using a single core, improve throughput for high-performance network applications by 1.5-6x, and reduce latency by up to 43%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 如今，NIC与软件之间的大多数通信均涉及交换固定大小的数据包缓冲区。这种数据包化接口设计于一个NIC仅实现少量卸载、而由软件实现应用数据与数据包之间转换逻辑的时代。然而，无论是NIC还是网络软件都已演变：现代NIC实现了硬件卸载（例如TSO、LRO以及串行化卸载），可以更高效地在应用数据与数据包之间进行转换。此外，现代软件日益采用批处理网络I/O以降低开销。这些变化导致数据包化接口（假设NIC与软件交换固定大小缓冲区）与现代NIC提供的特性和现代软件采用的做法之间产生了错配。接口与数据之间的这种不一致增加了软件复杂性和I/O开销，进而限制了通信性能。本文提出Ensō，一种新的数据流式NIC到软件接口，旨在更好地支持当今NIC与软件的交互方式。Ensō的核心是摒弃固定大小缓冲区，而是将通信结构化为一个可用于发送任意大小数据的流。我们表明，这一改变降低了软件开销、减少了PCIe带宽需求，并减少了缓存未命中。这些改进使基于Ensō的NIC能够用单个内核以最小大小数据包饱和100 Gbps链路（148.8 Mpps转发），将高性能网络应用的吞吐量提升1.5-6倍，并将延迟降低高达43%。

import_candidates.title: Sabre: hardware-accelerated snapshot compression for serverless MicroVMs
import_candidates.abstract: MicroVM snapshotting significantly reduces the cold start overheads in serverless applications. Snapshotting enables storing part of the physical memory of a microVM guest into a file, and later restoring from it to avoid long cold start-up times. Prefetching memory pages from snapshots can further improve the effectiveness of snapshotting. However, the efficacy of prefetching depends on the size of the memory that needs to be restored. Lossless page compression is therefore a great way to improve the coverage of the memory footprint that snapshotting with prefetching achieves. Unfortunately, the high overhead and high CPU cost of software-based (de)compression make this impractical.We introduce Sabre, a novel approach to snapshot page prefetching based on hardware-accelerated (de)compression. Sabre leverages an increasingly pervasive near-memory analytics accelerator available in modern datacenter processors. We show that by appropriately leveraging such accelerators, microVM snapshots of serverless applications can be compressed up to a factor of 4.5\texttimes{}, with nearly negligible decompression costs. We use this insight to build an efficient page prefetching library capable of speeding up memory restoration from snapshots by up to 55\%. We integrate the library with the production-grade Firecracker microVMs and evaluate its end-to-end performance on a wide set of serverless applications.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 微虚拟机快照大大减少了无服务器应用中的冷启动开销。快照可以将微虚拟机客户机的部分物理内存存储到文件中，并在之后进行恢复，以避免漫长的冷启动时间。从快照预取内存页面可以进一步提高快照的有效性。然而，预取的效果取决于需要恢复的内存大小。因此，无损页面压缩是提高预取式快照所覆盖内存占用范围的好方法。不幸的是，基于软件的解/压缩的高开销和高CPU成本使其不切实际。我们介绍了Sabre，一种基于硬件加速解/压缩的快照页面预取新方法。Sabre利用了现代数据中心处理器中日益普及的近内存分析加速器。我们表明，通过适当利用此类加速器，无服务器应用的微虚拟机快照可以被压缩高达4.5倍，而解压成本几乎可以忽略不计。我们利用这一见解构建了一个高效的页面预取库，能够将快照的内存恢复速度提升高达55%。我们将该库与生产级Firecracker微虚拟机集成，并在广泛的无服务器应用上评估其端到端性能。
