import_candidates.abstract_zh: 多版本并发控制可以避免联机事务处理(OLTP)工作负载中的大多数读写冲突。然而，与单版本系统相比，多版本系统通常具有更高的复杂性和开销，因为需要分配、搜索和垃圾回收版本。因此，单版本系统往往能在性能上显著超过多版本系统。我们提出了Epic，这是首个基于GPU的多版本确定性OLTP数据库。Epic采用批量执行方案，在执行一批事务之前先对该批次进行并发控制初始化。通过利用预定的事务顺序，Epic完全消除了版本搜索，并显著降低了版本分配和垃圾回收的开销。我们的方法利用GPU体系结构的计算能力来加速Epic的并发控制初始化，并有效地并行化批量事务执行，同时确保低延迟。我们的评估表明，与最先进的单版本和多版本系统相比，Epic在低争用下实现了相当的性能，在中高争用下持续实现更高的性能。

import_candidates.title: Burstable cloud block storage with data processing units
import_candidates.abstract: Cloud block storage (CBS) is a key pillar of public clouds. Today's CBS distinguishes itself from physical counterparts (e.g., SSDs) by offering unique burst capability as well as enhanced throughput, capacity, and availability. We conduct an initial characterization of our CBS product, a globally deployed cloud block storage service at public cloud provider Alibaba Cloud. A key observation is that the storage agent (SA) running on a data processing unit (DPU) which connects user VMs to the backend storage is the major source of performance fluctuation with burst capability provided. In this paper, we propose a hardware-software co-designed I/O scheduling system BurstCBS to address load imbalance and tenant interference at SA. BurstCBS exploits high-performance queue scaling to achieve near-perfect load balancing at line rate. To mitigate tenant interference, we design a novel burstable I/O scheduler that prioritizes resource allocation for base-level usage while supporting bursts. We employ a vectorized I/O cost estimator for comprehensive measurements of the consumed resources of different types of I/Os. Our evaluation shows that BurstCBS reduces average latency by up to 85\% and provides up to 5\texttimes{} throughput for base-level tenants under congestion with minimal overhead. We verify the benefits brought by BurstCBS with a database service that internally relies on CBS, and show that up to 83\% latency reduction is observed on customer workloads.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 云块存储（CBS）是公有云的关键支柱。如今的CBS通过提供独特的突发能力以及增强的吞吐量、容量和可用性，与物理存储设备（如SSD）区分开来。我们对我们的CBS产品进行了初步表征，该产品是公有云提供商阿里云在全球部署的云块存储服务。一个关键观察是，运行在将用户虚拟机连接到后端存储的数据处理单元（DPU）上的存储代理（SA）是提供突发能力时性能波动的主要来源。在本文中，我们提出了一种软硬件协同设计的I/O调度系统BurstCBS，以解决SA上的负载不均衡和租户干扰问题。BurstCBS利用高性能队列扩展实现了接近完美的线速负载均衡。为了缓解租户干扰，我们设计了一种新颖的突发I/O调度器，在支持突发的同时优先为基础用量分配资源。我们采用矢量化的I/O成本估算器来全面测量不同类型I/O的资源消耗。我们的评估表明，在拥塞情况下，BurstCBS将基础租户的平均延迟降低高达85%，并提供高达5倍的吞吐量，且开销最小。我们通过一个内部依赖CBS的数据库服务验证了BurstCBS带来的好处，并观察到客户工作负载的延迟最多降低83%。

import_candidates.title: Motor: enabling multi-versioning for distributed transactions on disaggregated memory
import_candidates.abstract: In modern datacenters, memory disaggregation unpacks monolithic servers to build network-connected distributed compute and memory pools to improve resource utilization and deliver high performance. The compute pool leverages distributed transactions to access remote data in the memory pool to provide atomicity and strong consistency. Existing single-versioning designs have been constrained due to limited system concurrency and high logging overheads. Although the multi-versioning design in the conventional monolithic servers is promising to offer high concurrency and reduce logging overheads, which however fails to work in the disaggregated memory. In order to bridge the gap between the multi-versioning design and the disaggregated memory, we propose Motor that holistically redesigns the version structure and transaction protocol to enable multi-versioning for fast distributed transaction processing on the disaggregated memory. To efficiently organize different versions of data in the memory pool, Motor leverages a new consecutive version tuple (CVT) structure to store the versions together in a continuous manner, which allows the compute pool to obtain the target version in a single network round trip. On top of CVT, Motor leverages a fully one-sided RDMA-based MVCC protocol to support fast distributed transactions with flexible isolation levels. Experimental results demonstrate that Motor improves the throughput by up to 98.1\% and reduces the latency by up to 55.8\% compared with state-of-the-art systems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在现代数据中心中，内存分解将单体服务器拆解为通过网络连接的分布式计算池和内存池，以提高资源利用率并提供高性能。计算池利用分布式事务访问内存池中的远程数据，以提供原子性和强一致性。由于系统并发性受限和日志开销过高，现有的单版本设计一直受到制约。尽管传统单体服务器中的多版本设计有望提供高并发并降低日志开销，但它在分解内存中却无法工作。为了弥合多版本设计与分解内存之间的差距，我们提出了Motor，它整体重新设计了版本结构和事务协议，以实现在分解内存上进行快速分布式事务处理的多版本化。为了高效组织内存池中数据的不同版本，Motor利用一种新的连续版本元组（CVT）结构将版本连续存储在一起，使计算池能够在单次网络往返中获得目标版本。在CVT之上，Motor利用一种完全基于单侧RDMA的MVCC协议，以支持具有灵活隔离级别的快速分布式事务。实验结果表明，与最先进的系统相比，Motor的吞吐量最高提升98.1%，延迟最高降低55.8%。

import_candidates.title: Detecting logic bugs in database engines via equivalent expression transformation
import_candidates.abstract: Database management systems (DBMSs) are crucial for storing and fetching data. To improve the reliability of such systems, approaches have been proposed to detect logic bugs that cause DBMSs to process data incorrectly. These approaches manipulate queries and check whether the query results produced by DBMSs follow the expectations. However, such query-level manipulation cannot handle complex query semantics and thus needs to limit the patterns of generated queries, degrading testing effectiveness.In this paper, we tackle the problem using a fine-grained methodology--expression-level manipulation--which empowers the proposed approach to be applicable to arbitrary queries. To find logic bugs in DBMSs, we design a novel and general approach, equivalent expression transformation (EET). Our core idea is that manipulating expressions of a query in a semantic-preserving manner also preserves the semantics of the entire query and is independent of query patterns. EET validates DBMSs by checking whether the transformed queries still produce the same results as the corresponding original queries. We realize our approach and evaluate it on 5 widely used and extensively tested DBMSs: MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, ClickHouse, and TiDB. In total, EET found 66 unique bugs, 35 of which are logic bugs. We expect the generality and effectiveness of EET to inspire follow-up research and benefit the reliability of many DBMSs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 数据库管理系统（DBMS）对于数据的存储和获取至关重要。为提高此类系统的可靠性，已有多种方法用于检测逻辑缺陷，这些缺陷会导致数据库管理系统错误地处理数据。这些方法操纵查询，并检查数据库管理系统产生的查询结果是否符合预期。然而，这种查询级别的操纵无法处理复杂的查询语义，因此需要限制生成查询的模式，从而降低了测试效果。本文采用更细粒度的表达式级别操纵方法解决该问题，使得所提方法适用于任意查询。为了发现数据库管理系统中的逻辑缺陷，我们设计了一种新颖且通用的方法——等价表达式变换（EET）。核心思想是：以保持语义的方式操纵查询的表达式，同样能保持整个查询的语义，并且与查询模式无关。EET通过检查变换后的查询是否仍产生与原始查询相同的结果来验证数据库管理系统。我们在5个广泛使用且经过大量测试的数据库管理系统上实现并评估了我们的方法：MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite、ClickHouse和TiDB。EET共发现66个独特缺陷，其中35个为逻辑缺陷。我们希望EET的通用性和有效性能够启发后续研究，并使众多数据库管理系统的可靠性受益。

import_candidates.title: Inductive invariants that spark joy: using invariant taxonomies to streamline distributed protocol proofs
import_candidates.abstract: Proving the correctness of a distributed protocol is a challenging endeavor. Central to this task is finding an inductive invariant for the protocol. Currently, automated invariant inference algorithms require developers to describe protocols using a restricted logic. If the developer wants to prove a protocol expressed without these restrictions, they must devise an inductive invariant manually.We propose an approach that simplifies and partially automates finding the inductive invariant of a distributed protocol, as well as proving that it really is an invariant. The key insight is to identify an invariant taxonomy that divides invariants into Regular Invariants, which have one of a few simple low-level structures, and Protocol Invariants, which capture the higher-level host relationships that make the protocol work.Building on the insight of this taxonomy, we describe the Kondo methodology for proving the correctness of a distributed protocol modeled as a state machine. The developer first manually devises the Protocol Invariants by proving a synchronous version of the protocol correct. In this simpler version, sends and receives are replaced with atomic variable assignments. The Kondo tool then automatically generates the asynchronous protocol description, Regular Invariants, and proofs that the Regular Invariants are inductive on their own. Finally, Kondo combines these with the synchronous proof into a draft proof of the asynchronous protocol, which may then require a small amount of user effort to complete. Our evaluation shows that Kondo reduces developer effort for a wide variety of distributed protocols.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 证明分布式协议的正确性是一项艰巨的任务。此任务的核心是为协议找到一个归纳不变量。目前，自动不变量推理算法要求开发者使用受限逻辑描述协议。如果开发者想要证明一个没有这些限制所表达的协议，他们必须手动设计归纳不变量。我们提出了一种方法，简化并部分自动化了寻找分布式协议归纳不变量的过程，以及证明它确实是不变量的过程。关键洞见是识别一个不变量分类法，将不变量分为常规不变量（具有少数简单底层结构之一）和协议不变量（捕获使协议工作的高层主机关系）。基于这一分类法的洞见，我们描述了Kondo方法论，用于证明建模为状态机的分布式协议的正确性。开发者首先通过证明协议的同步版本正确来手动设计协议不变量。在这个简化版本中，发送和接收被原子变量赋值替代。Kondo工具随后自动生成异步协议描述、常规不变量以及常规不变量自身具有归纳性的证明。最后，Kondo将这些与同步证明结合成异步协议的草稿证明，之后可能需要少量用户努力来完成。我们的评估表明，Kondo减少了对多种分布式协议开发者的努力。

import_candidates.title: Performance interfaces for hardware accelerators
import_candidates.abstract: Designing and building a system that reaps the performance benefits of hardware accelerators is challenging, because accelerators provide little concrete visibility into their expected performance. Developers must invest many person-months into benchmarking to determine if their system would indeed benefit from using a particular accelerator. This must be done carefully, because accelerators can actually hurt performance for some classes of inputs, even if they help for others [53].We demonstrate that it is possible for hardware accelerators to ship with performance interfaces that provide actionable visibility into their performance, just like semantic interfaces do for functionality. We propose an intermediate representation (IR) for accelerator performance that precisely captures all performance-relevant details of the accelerator while abstracting away all other information, including functionality. We develop a toolchain (ltc) that, based on the proposed IR, automatically produces human-readable performance interfaces that help developers make informed design decisions. ltc can also automatically produce formal proofs of performance properties of the accelerator, and can act as a fast performance simulator for concrete workloads.We evaluate our approach on accelerators used for deep learning, serialization of RPC messages, JPEG image decoding, genome sequence alignment, and on an RMT pipeline used in programmable network switches.We demonstrate that the performance IR provides an accurate and complete representation of performance behavior, and we describe a variety of use cases for ltc and the resulting performance interfaces. The code for ltc is open-source and freely available at [68].
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 设计和构建一个能够发挥硬件加速器性能优势的系统颇具挑战性，因为加速器对其预期性能几乎不提供具体可见性。开发者必须花费很多人月进行基准测试，以确定他们的系统是否确实会受益于使用特定加速器。这必须谨慎进行，因为即使加速器对某些输入可能有帮助，对其他类别的输入实际上也可能损害性能[53]。我们证明，硬件加速器有可能附带性能接口，为性能提供可操作的可见性，就像语义接口为功能所做的那样。我们提出一种加速器性能的中间表示（IR），该表示精确捕获加速器的所有性能相关细节，同时抽象掉所有其他信息，包括功能。我们开发了一个工具链（ltc），基于所提出的IR，自动生成帮助开发者做出明智设计决策的人可读性能接口。ltc还可以为加速器的性能属性自动生成形式化证明，并可作为具体工作负载的快速性能模拟器。我们在用于深度学习、RPC消息序列化、JPEG图像解码、基因组序列比对以及可编程网络交换机中使用的RMT流水线的加速器上评估了我们的方法。我们证明了性能IR提供了性能行为的准确完整表示，并描述了ltc及由此产生的性能接口的多种用例。ltc的代码是开源的，可在[68]免费获取。

import_candidates.title: IronSpec: increasing the reliability of formal specifications
import_candidates.abstract: The guarantees of formally verified systems are only as strong as their trusted specifications (specs). As observed by previous studies [22, 52], bugs in formal specs invalidate the assurances that proofs provide. Unfortunately, specs--by their very nature--cannot be proven correct. Currently, the only way to identify spec bugs is by careful, manual inspection.In this paper we introduce IronSpec, a framework of automatic and manual techniques to increase the reliability of formal specifications. IronSpec draws inspiration from classical software testing practices, which we adapt to the realm of formal specs. IronSpec facilitates spec testing with automated sanity checking, a methodology for writing Spec-Testing Proofs (STPs), and automated spec mutation testing.We evaluate IronSpec on 14 specs, including six specs of real-world verified codebases. Our results show that IronSpec is effective at flagging discrepancies between the spec and the developer's intent, and has led to the discovery of ten specification bugs across all six real-world verified systems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 形式化验证系统的保证，其强度取决于其所信赖的规范（specs）。正如之前的研究[22, 52]所观察到的，形式化规范中的缺陷会使证明所提供的保障失效。不幸的是，规范本身的性质决定了它们无法被证明是正确的。目前，识别规范缺陷的唯一方法是仔细的人工审查。在本文中，我们介绍了IronSpec——一个由自动化和手动技术组成的框架，旨在提高形式化规范的可靠性。IronSpec借鉴了经典软件测试实践，并对其进行了改编以适应形式化规范领域。IronSpec通过自动健全性检查、编写规范测试证明（STPs）的方法论以及自动规范变异测试来促进规范测试。我们在14个规范上评估了IronSpec，其中包括六个真实世界已验证代码库的规范。我们的结果表明，IronSpec能有效标记规范与开发者意图之间的差异，并已在所有六个真实世界验证系统中发现了十个规范缺陷。

import_candidates.title: Identifying on-/off-CPU bottlenecks together with blocked samples
import_candidates.abstract: The rapid advancement of computer system components has necessitated a comprehensive profiling approach for both on-CPU and off-CPU events simultaneously. However, the conventional approach lacks profiling both on- and off-CPU events, so they fall short of accurately assessing the overhead of each bottleneck in modern applications.In this paper, we propose a sampling-based profiling technique called blocked samples that is designed to capture all types of off-CPU events, such as I/O waiting, blocking synchronization, and waiting in CPU runqueue. Using the blocked samples technique, this paper proposes two profilers, bperf and BCOZ. Leveraging blocked samples, bperf profiles applications by providing symbol-level profile information when a thread is either on the CPU or off the CPU, awaiting scheduling or I/O requests. Using the information, BCOZ performs causality analysis of collected on- and off-CPU events to precisely identify performance bottlenecks and the potential impact of optimizations. The profiling capability of BCOZ is verified using real applications. From our profiling results followed by actual optimization, BCOZ identifies bottlenecks with off-CPU events precisely, and their optimization results are aligned with the predicted performance improvement by BCOZ's causality analysis.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 计算机系统组件的快速发展要求同时对CPU上事件和CPU外事件进行全面剖析。然而，传统方法缺乏同时剖析CPU上事件和CPU外事件的能力，因此无法准确评估现代应用中每个瓶颈的开销。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于采样的剖析技术——阻塞样本（blocked samples），旨在捕获所有类型的CPU外事件，如I/O等待、阻塞同步和CPU运行队列中的等待。利用阻塞样本技术，本文提出了两个剖析器：bperf和BCOZ。bperf利用阻塞样本在线程处于CPU上或CPU外（等待调度或I/O请求）时提供符号级剖析信息，从而对应用进行剖析。BCOZ利用这些信息对所收集的CPU上和CPU外事件进行因果分析，以精确识别性能瓶颈以及优化的潜在影响。BCOZ的剖析能力已通过实际应用得到验证。从我们的剖析结果及随后的实际优化来看，BCOZ能够精确定位涉及CPU外事件的瓶颈，其优化结果与BCOZ因果分析预测的性能提升一致。

import_candidates.title: dLoRA: dynamically orchestrating requests and adapters for LoRA LLM serving
import_candidates.abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is a popular approach to finetune pre-trained large language models (LLMs) to specific domains. This paper introduces dLoRA, an inference serving system for LoRA models. dLoRA achieves high serving efficiency by dynamically orchestrating requests and LoRA adapters in terms of two aspects: (i) dynamically merge and unmerge adapters with the base model; and (ii) dynamically migrate requests and adapters between different worker replicas. These capabilities are designed based on two insights. First, despite the allure of batching without merging a LoRA adapter into the base model, it is not always beneficial to unmerge, especially when the types of requests are skewed. Second, the autoregressive nature of LLM requests introduces load imbalance between worker replicas due to varying input and output lengths, even if the input requests are distributed uniformly to the replicas. We design a credit-based batching algorithm to decide when to merge and unmerge, and a request-adapter co-migration algorithm to decide when to migrate. The experimental results show that dLoRA improves the throughput by up to 57.9\texttimes{} and 26.0\texttimes{}, compared to vLLM and HugginFace PEFT, respectively. Compared to the concurrent work S-LoRA, dLoRA achieves up to 1.8\texttimes{} lower average latency.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 低秩适配（LoRA）是将预训练大语言模型（LLM）微调到特定领域的流行方法。本文介绍了dLoRA，一个针对LoRA模型的推理服务系统。dLoRA通过两个方面动态协调请求和LoRA适配器来获得高服务效率：（i）动态地将适配器与基模型合并和拆分；（ii）在不同工作副本之间动态迁移请求和适配器。这些能力基于两个洞察而设计。首先，尽管无需将LoRA适配器合并到基模型中即可进行批处理颇具吸引力，但拆分并不总是有益的，尤其是在请求类型倾斜时。其次，LLM请求的自回归特性导致即使输入请求均匀分配到不同副本，不同工作副本之间也会因输入和输出长度变化而出现负载不均衡。我们设计了一种基于信用额的批处理算法来决定何时合并和拆分，以及一种请求-适配器协同迁移算法来决定何时迁移。实验结果表明，与vLLM和HuggingFace PEFT相比，dLoRA分别将吞吐量提升了高达57.9倍和26.0倍。与同期工作S-LoRA相比，dLoRA将平均延迟降低了高达1.8倍。

import_candidates.title: Parrot: efficient serving of LLM-based applications with semantic variable
import_candidates.abstract: The rise of large language models (LLMs) has enabled LLM-based applications (a.k.a. AI agents or co-pilots), a new software paradigm that combines the strength of LLM and conventional software. Diverse LLM applications from different tenants could design complex workflows using multiple LLM requests to accomplish one task. However, they have to use the over-simplified request-level API provided by today's public LLM services, losing essential application-level information. Public LLM services have to blindly optimize individual LLM requests, leading to sub-optimal end-to-end performance of LLM applications.This paper introduces Parrot, an LLM service system that focuses on the end-to-end experience of LLM-based applications. Parrot proposes Semantic Variable, a unified abstraction to expose application-level knowledge to public LLM services. A Semantic Variable annotates an input/output variable in the prompt of a request, and creates the data pipeline when connecting multiple LLM requests, providing a natural way to program LLM applications. Exposing Semantic Variables to the public LLM service allows it to perform conventional data flow analysis to uncover the correlation across multiple LLM requests. This correlation opens a brand-new optimization space for the end-to-end performance of LLM-based applications. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that Parrot can achieve up to an order-of-magnitude improvement for popular and practical use cases of LLM applications.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的兴起使得基于LLM的应用程序（又称AI代理或协驾员）成为可能，这是一种将LLM与传统软件优势相结合的新软件范式。来自不同租户的多种LLM应用程序可以设计复杂的工作流，使用多个LLM请求来完成一个任务。然而，它们必须使用今天公共LLM服务提供的过度简化的请求级API，从而丢失了关键的应用程序级信息。公共LLM服务不得不盲目优化单个LLM请求，导致LLM应用程序的端到端性能欠佳。本文介绍了Parrot，一个专注于LLM应用端到端体验的LLM服务系统。Parrot提出了语义变量（Semantic Variable），这是一种统一的抽象，将应用级知识暴露给公共LLM服务。语义变量注释请求提示词中的输入/输出变量，并在连接多个LLM请求时创建数据流水线，为LLM应用编程提供了一种自然的方式。将语义变量暴露给公共LLM服务，使其能够执行传统的数据流分析，以揭示多个LLM请求之间的关联。这种关联为LLM应用的端到端性能开辟了全新的优化空间。大量评估表明，对于LLM应用的热门和实际用例，Parrot可以实现高达一个数量级的改进。

import_candidates.title: USHER: holistic interference avoidance for resource optimized ML inference
import_candidates.abstract: Minimizing monetary cost and maximizing the goodput of inference serving systems are increasingly important with the ever-increasing popularity of deep learning models. While it is desirable to spatially multiplex GPU resources to improve utilization, existing techniques suffer from inter-model interference, which prevents them from achieving both high computation and memory utilizations. We present USHER, a system that maximizes resource utilization in a holistic fashion while being interference-aware. USHER consists of three key components: 1) a cost-efficient and fast GPU kernel-based model resource requirement estimator, 2) a lightweight heuristic-based interference-aware resource utilization-maximizing scheduler that decides the batch size, model replication degree, and model placement to minimize monetary cost while satisfying latency SLOs or maximize the goodput, and 3) a novel operator graph merger to merge multiple models to minimize interference in GPU cache. Large-scale experiments using production workloads show that USHER achieves up to 2.6\texttimes{} higher goodput and 3.5\texttimes{} better cost-efficiency compared to existing methods, while scaling to thousands of GPUs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着深度学习模型的日益普及，最小化推理服务系统的货币成本并最大化其有效吞吐量变得越来越重要。虽然期望在空间上复用GPU资源以提高利用率，但现有技术会受到模型间干扰的影响，这使它们无法同时实现高计算利用率和高内存利用率。我们提出了USHER，一个以整体方式最大化资源利用率且具有干扰感知能力的系统。USHER由三个关键组件组成：1) 一种成本高效且快速的基于GPU内核的模型资源需求估算器；2) 一种轻量级、基于启发式的干扰感知资源利用率最大化调度器，用于决定批大小、模型复制程度和模型放置位置，以在满足延迟SLO的同时最小化货币成本或最大化有效吞吐量；3) 一种新颖的算子图合并器，用于合并多个模型以最小化GPU缓存中的干扰。使用生产工作负载进行的大规模实验表明，与现有方法相比，USHER可实现高达2.6倍的有效吞吐量和3.5倍的成本效率提升，同时可扩展到数千个GPU。

import_candidates.title: Fairness in serving large language models
import_candidates.abstract: High-demand LLM inference services (e.g., ChatGPT and BARD) support a wide range of requests from short chat conversations to long document reading. To ensure that all client requests are processed fairly, most major LLM inference services have request rate limits, to ensure that no client can dominate the request queue. However, this rudimentary notion of fairness also results in under-utilization of the resources and poor client experience when there is spare capacity. While there is a rich literature on fair scheduling, serving LLMs presents new challenges due to their unpredictable request lengths and their unique batching characteristics on parallel accelerators. This paper introduces the definition of LLM serving fairness based on a cost function that accounts for the number of input and output tokens processed. To achieve fairness in serving, we propose a novel scheduling algorithm, the Virtual Token Counter (VTC), a fair scheduler based on the continuous batching mechanism. We prove a 2\texttimes{} tight upper bound on the service difference between two backlogged clients, adhering to the requirement of work-conserving. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate the superior performance of VTC in ensuring fairness, especially in contrast to other baseline methods, which exhibit shortcomings under various conditions. The reproducible code is available at https://github.com/Ying1123/VTC-artifact.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 高需求的LLM推理服务（如ChatGPT和BARD）支持从简短聊天对话到长文档阅读的各种请求。为了确保所有客户端请求都被公平处理，大多数主流LLM推理服务都设置了请求速率限制，以防止任何客户端主导请求队列。然而，这种粗粒度的公平性概念也会导致资源利用不足，并且在有剩余容量时给客户端带来较差的体验。尽管关于公平调度有丰富的文献，但LLM服务因其不可预测的请求长度以及在并行加速器上独特的批处理特性而带来了新的挑战。本文基于一个考虑输入和输出token数量的成本函数，提出了LLM服务公平性的定义。为了实现服务中的公平性，我们提出了一种新颖的调度算法——虚拟Token计数器（VTC），它是一种基于连续批处理机制的公平调度器。我们证明了在满足工作保守性要求的情况下，两个积压客户端之间的服务差异存在2倍的紧上界。通过大量实验，我们证明了VTC在确保公平性方面的优越性能，尤其是在与其他基线方法进行对比时，这些基线方法在各种条件下都存在缺陷。可复现代码见 https://github.com/Ying1123/VTC-artifact。

import_candidates.title: MonoNN: enabling a new monolithic optimization space for neural network inference tasks on modern GPU-centric architectures
import_candidates.abstract: In this work, we reveal that the kernel-by-kernel execution scheme in the existing machine learning optimizing compilers is no longer effective in fully utilizing hardware resources provided by the advances of modern GPU architectures. Specifically, such scheme suffers from severe non-computation overhead and off-chip memory traffic, making the optimization efforts from the state-of-the-art compiler techniques greatly attenuated on the newer generations of GPUs. To address this emerging challenge, we propose MonoNN, the first machine learning optimizing compiler that enables a new monolithic design and optimization space for common static neural network (NN) inference tasks on a single GPU. MonoNN can accommodate an entire neural network into a single GPU kernel, drastically reducing non-computation overhead and providing further fine-grained optimization opportunities from the newly formed monolithic optimization space. Most importantly, MonoNN identifies the resource incompatibility issue between various NN operators as the key design bottleneck for creating such a monolithic optimization space. Then MonoNN effectively tackles it by systematically exploring and exploiting the parallelism compensation strategy and resource trade-offs across different types of NN computations, and by proposing a novel schedule-independent group tuning technique to significantly shrink the extremely large tuning space. Finally, MonoNN provides a compiler implementation that incorporates our proposed optimizations and automatically generates highly efficient kernel code. Extensive evaluation on a set of popular production inference tasks demonstrates that MonoNN achieves an average speedup of 2.01\texttimes{} over the state-of-the-art frameworks and compilers. Specifically, MonoNN outperforms TVM, TensorRT, XLA, and AStitch by up to 7.3\texttimes{}, 5.9\texttimes{}, 1.7\texttimes{} and 2.9\texttimes{} in terms of end-to-end inference performance, respectively. MonoNN source code is publicly available at https://github.com/AlibabaResearch/mononn.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们揭示了现有机器学习优化编译器中逐内核（kernel-by-kernel）的执行方式在充分利用现代GPU架构进步所提供的硬件资源方面已不再有效。具体来说，这种方式存在严重的非计算开销和片外内存流量，使得最先进的编译器技术的优化效果在新一代GPU上被大幅削弱。为了应对这一新挑战，我们提出了MonoNN，这是第一个能够在单个GPU上为常见静态神经网络（NN）推理任务实现新型整体设计和优化空间的机器学习优化编译器。MonoNN可以将整个神经网络容纳到单个GPU内核中，大幅减少非计算开销，并从新形成的整体优化空间中提供更细粒度的优化机会。最重要的是，MonoNN识别出不同NN算子之间的资源不兼容问题是创建这种整体优化空间的关键设计瓶颈。然后，MonoNN通过系统性地探索和利用不同NN计算类型之间的并行性补偿策略和资源权衡，并提出了新颖的与调度无关的组调优技术来大幅缩小极大的调优空间，从而有效解决了这一问题。最后，MonoNN提供了一个编译器实现，融入了我们提出的优化，并自动生成高效的内核代码。在若干流行的生产推理任务上的广泛评估表明，与最先进的框架和编译器相比，MonoNN平均实现了2.01倍的加速。具体而言，在端到端推理性能方面，MonoNN分别比TVM、TensorRT、XLA和AStitch最高快7.3倍、5.9倍、1.7倍和2.9倍。MonoNN源代码可在 https://github.com/AlibabaResearch/mononn 公开获取。

import_candidates.title: Basilisk: using provenance invariants to automate proofs of undecidable protocols
import_candidates.abstract: Distributed protocols are challenging to design correctly. One promising approach to improve their reliability is to use formal verification to prove that a protocol satisfies a desired safety property. These proofs require finding an inductive invariant that holds in the initial states of the system, implies safety, and is inductive over state transitions. Devising an inductive invariant is a difficult task that prior work has either required the developer to find manually by a painful search process, or automated by constraining the protocol to a decidable but restrictive fragment of logic.In this work, we aim to automatically find inductive invariants without restricting the logic. We achieve this with two key insights. First, many of the complex inter-host properties that prior work required the developer to provide can instead be expressed using Provenance Invariants, a class of invariants that relate a local variable in a host to its provenance, i.e., the protocol step that caused it to take on its current value. By tracing the provenance of one host variable back to another host's actions, we can derive an invariant relating the two hosts' states. Second, we develop an algorithm called atomic sharding to derive Provenance Invariants automatically by statically analyzing the protocol's steps.We implement these ideas in a tool called Basilisk and apply it to 16 distributed protocols, including complex ones like Multi-Paxos. Basilisk automatically finds inductive invariants and proves their inductiveness, with little or no developer assistance. In all cases, these generated inductive invariants are sufficient for us to prove safety without needing to identify any new invariants.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 分布式协议难以正确设计。一种改进其可靠性的有前景的方法是使用形式化验证来证明协议满足所需的安全属性。这些证明需要找到一个归纳不变量，它在系统的初始状态中成立，蕴含安全性，并在状态转换上具有归纳性。设计归纳不变量是一项困难的任务，先前的工作要么要求开发人员通过痛苦的搜索过程手动找到它，要么通过将协议限制在可判定但受限的逻辑片段来自动化。在这项工作中，我们旨在不限制逻辑的情况下自动找到归纳不变量。我们通过两个关键见解实现这一点。首先，先前工作需要开发人员提供的许多复杂的跨主机属性，可以改用溯源不变量（Provenance Invariants）来表达。溯源不变量是将主机中的局部变量与其来源（即导致其采用当前值的协议步骤）相关联的一类不变量。通过将一个主机变量的来源追溯到另一个主机的行为，我们可以推导出一个关联两个主机状态的不变量。其次，我们开发了一种称为原子分片（atomic sharding）的算法，通过静态分析协议的步骤自动推导溯源不变量。我们将这些想法实现为一个名为Basilisk的工具，并应用于16个分布式协议，包括像Multi-Paxos这样的复杂协议。Basilisk自动找到归纳不变量并证明其归纳性，几乎不需要或不需要开发人员协助。在所有情况下，这些生成的归纳不变量都足以让我们证明安全性，而无需识别任何新的不变量。

import_candidates.title: Deriving semantic checkers from tests to detect silent failures in production distributed systems
import_candidates.abstract: Production distributed systems provide rich features, but various defects can cause a system to silently violate its semantics without explicit errors. Such failures cause serious consequences. Yet, they are extremely challenging to detect, as it requires deep domain knowledge and substantial manual efforts to write good checkers.In this paper, we explore a novel approach that directly derives semantic checkers from system test code. We first present a large-scale study on existing system test cases. Guided by the study findings, we develop T2C, a framework that uses static and dynamic analysis to transform and generalize a test into a runtime checker. We apply T2C on four large, popular distributed systems and successfully derive tens to hundreds of checkers. These checkers detect 15 out of 20 real-world silent failures we reproduce and incur small runtime overhead.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 生产分布式系统提供了丰富的功能，但各种缺陷可能导致系统在没有显式错误的情况下静默地违反其语义。此类故障会造成严重后果。然而，它们极难检测，因为编写好的检查器需要深厚的领域知识和大量的手工工作。本文探索了一种直接从系统测试代码派生语义检查器的新方法。我们首先对现有系统测试用例进行了大规模研究。在研究发现的指导下，我们开发了T2C，一个使用静态和动态分析将测试转换并泛化为运行时检查器的框架。我们将T2C应用于四个大型流行的分布式系统，成功派生出数十至数百个检查器。这些检查器在我们复现的20个真实静默故障中检测到15个，并且运行时开销很小。

import_candidates.title: Picsou: enabling replicated state machines to communicate efficiently
import_candidates.abstract: Replicated state machines (RSMs) cannot communicate effectively today as there is no formal framework or efficient protocol to do so. To address this issue, we introduce a new primitive, Cross-Cluster Consistent Broadcast (C3B) and present PICSOU, a practical implementation of the C3B primitive. PICSOU draws inspiration from networking and TCP to allow two RSMs to communicate with constant metadata overhead in the failure-free case and a minimal number of message resends in the case of failures. PICSOU is flexible and allows both crash fault tolerant and Byzantine fault tolerant consensus protocols to communicate. At the heart of PICSOU's good performance and generality is the concept of QUACKs (quorum acknowledgments). QUACKs allow nodes in each RSM to precisely determine when messages have definitely been received, or likely lost. Our results are promising: we obtain up to 24\texttimes{} better performance than prior solutions on microbenchmarks and applications, ranging from disaster recovery to data reconciliation.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 目前，复制状态机（RSM）之间无法有效通信，因为缺乏正式的框架或高效的协议。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一种新的原语——跨集群一致性广播（C3B），并提出了C3B的实用实现PICSOU。PICSOU借鉴了网络和TCP的思想，使得两个RSM在无故障情况下能够以恒定的元数据开销进行通信，并且在故障情况下只需要最少数量的消息重发。PICSOU非常灵活，允许崩溃容错和拜占庭容错的共识协议进行通信。PICSOU良好性能和通用性的核心是QUACK（仲裁确认）概念。QUACK允许每个RSM中的节点精确地确定消息是已经被确定接收还是可能丢失。我们的结果令人鼓舞：在微基准测试和应用中，无论是在灾难恢复还是数据对账方面，我们都获得了比现有解决方案最高24倍的性能提升。

import_candidates.title: FineMem: breaking the allocation overhead vs. memory waste dilemma in fine-grained disaggregated memory management
import_candidates.abstract: RDMA-enabled memory disaggregation has emerged as an attractive approach to reducing memory costs in modern data centers. While RDMA enables efficient remote read/write operations, it presents challenges in remote memory (de)allocation. Consequently, existing systems adopt coarse-grained allocations (in GBs), leading to memory waste.We introduce FineMem, an RDMA-connected remote memory management system that enables high-performance, fine-grained memory allocation. FineMem addresses latency and scalability challenges related to fine-grained allocations. It removes RDMA memory region (MR) registration costs from allocation paths through per-compute node MR preregistration, while ensuring remote memory isolation using RDMA memory windows and a trusted allocation service on each compute node. It employs a lock-free, one-sided RDMA-based protocol to allocate memory chunks (e.g., 4KB, 2MB) without involving the memory node's CPU and maintains metadata consistency during compute node failures via logging. We show that FineMem reduces remote memory allocation latency by as much as 95\% compared to state-of-the-art remote memory management systems. It enables memory malloc systems, key-value stores systems, and swap systems running on FineMem to achieve low memory waste with minimal overhead.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 基于RDMA的内存分解已成为现代数据中心降低内存成本的一种引人注目的方法。虽然RDMA支持高效的远程读/写操作，但在远程内存（解除）分配方面带来了挑战。因此，现有系统采用粗粒度分配（以GB为单位），导致内存浪费。我们介绍了FineMem，一个基于RDMA的远程内存管理系统，支持高性能、细粒度的内存分配。FineMem解决了与细粒度分配相关的延迟和可扩展性问题。它通过每个计算节点的MR预注册将RDMA内存区域（MR）注册成本从分配路径中移除，同时利用RDMA内存窗口和每个计算节点上的可信分配服务确保远程内存隔离。它采用基于无锁、单边RDMA的协议分配内存块（例如4KB、2MB），而无需内存节点CPU参与，并通过日志在计算节点故障期间保持元数据一致性。我们表明，与最先进的远程内存管理系统相比，FineMem将远程内存分配延迟降低了多达95%。它使运行在FineMem上的内存malloc系统、键值存储系统和交换系统能够以极小开销实现低内存浪费。

import_candidates.title: To PRI or not To PRI, that's the question
import_candidates.abstract: SR-IOV and I/O device passthrough enable network and storage devices to be shared among multiple tenants with high density using virtual functions (VFs), achieving nearnative performance. However, passthrough does not support page faults, requiring the hypervisor to statically pin the VM-allocated memory. This approach is unacceptable for cloud service providers (CSPs) that rely on oversubscription to enhance memory utilization and reduce costs. The Page Request Interface (PRI) was designed to support device-side I/O page faults (IOPFs) through collaboration among devices, Input-Output Memory Management Units (IOMMU), and the OS. But PRI has not seen broad adoption in devices like NICs and storage.We propose VIO, a novel dynamic I/O device passthrough approach that achieves near-native performance and is hardware-independent. By leveraging a shadow available queue, VIO can dynamically and transparently switch devices between VIO and passthrough modes based on I/O operations per second (IOPS) pressure, balancing resource utilization and performance. Each DMA request is probed via IOPA-snooping in the virtio data plane to eliminate IOPFs, while device interrupts are directly passed through to the VM guest, enabling performance close to passthrough. VIO is extensively tested and deployed by a leading global CSP across 300K VMs, supporting both legacy and new instances while reclaiming up to the equivalent of 30K VM memory daily without compromising user Service Level Objectives (SLOs). As the scale grows, the benefits continue to increase.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: SR-IOV和I/O设备直通技术允许通过虚拟函数(VFs)在多租户之间共享网络和存储设备，实现接近原生的性能。然而，直通不支持页错误，需要虚拟机监控器静态固定虚拟机分配的内存。这种方法对于依赖过额订阅来提高内存利用率并降低成本的云服务提供商(CSPs)来说是不可接受的。页面请求接口(PRI)被设计为通过设备、I/O内存管理单元(IOMMU)和操作系统协作来支持设备端的I/O页错误(IOPFs)，但PRI尚未在网卡和存储等设备中获得广泛采用。我们提出了VIO，一种新颖的动态I/O设备直通方法，它达到接近原生的性能且与硬件无关。通过利用影子可用队列，VIO能够基于每秒I/O操作数(IOPS)压力动态且透明地将设备在VIO与直通模式之间切换，从而平衡资源利用率和性能。在virtio数据平面中通过IOPA-snooping探测每个DMA请求以消除IOPFs，同时将设备中断直接传递给虚拟机客户机，从而实现接近直通的性能。VIO已经由一家全球领先的CSP在30万个虚拟机上得到广泛测试和部署，同时支持传统实例和新实例，每天可回收相当于3万个VM内存的资源，且不损害用户服务等级目标(SLOs)。随着规模的增长，收益持续增加。

import_candidates.title: Enabling efficient GPU communication over multiple NICs with FuseLink
import_candidates.abstract: Machine learning (ML) clusters stack multiple network interface cards (NICs) within each server to improve inter-server GPU communication bandwidth. However, existing systems fall short in fully utilizing NICs because of static GPU-NIC bindings. This leads to bottlenecks at hot-spot NICs when handling imbalanced communication in ML tasks. For example, large language model serving instances may have different communication demands across NICs; expert-parallel training tasks have imbalanced all-to-all traffic; and the embedding transmission volumes during recommendation model training vary across GPUs. To fully utilize all NICs, we propose FuseLink to enable efficient GPU communication over multiple NICs. FuseLink extends inter-server network by integrating high-speed intra-server connections, and leverages GPUs to efficiently relay traffic to idle NICs. We implement FuseLink and integrate it into NCCL, so that ML applications can benefit from FuseLink seamlessly without code modifications. Compared to NCCL, we demonstrate that FuseLink achieves up to 212GBps bandwidth between two inter-server GPUs and accelerates ML tasks with dynamic traffic patterns. Specifically, it reduces the latencies of first-token generation in LLM model servings by 1.04-2.73\texttimes{}, improves the training throughput of mixture-of-experts model by up to 1.3\texttimes{}, and accelerates deep learning recommendation model training by up to 1.2\texttimes{}.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 机器学习（ML）集群在每台服务器中堆叠多个网络接口卡（NIC），以提高GPU之间的服务器间通信带宽。然而，由于GPU与NIC的静态绑定，现有系统无法充分发挥所有NIC的潜力。这在处理ML任务中不平衡的通信时，会导致热点NIC出现瓶颈。例如，大型语言模型服务实例在不同NIC上可能有不同的通信需求；专家并行训练任务具有不平衡的全对全流量；推荐模型训练过程中的嵌入传输量因GPU而异。为了充分利用所有NIC，我们提出了FuseLink，以实现跨多个NIC的高效GPU通信。FuseLink通过集成高速服务器内连接来扩展服务器间网络，并利用GPU高效地将流量中继到空闲NIC。我们实现了FuseLink，并将其集成到NCCL中，使ML应用无需修改代码即可无缝受益于FuseLink。与NCCL相比，我们展示了FuseLink在两个服务器间GPU之间实现高达212GBps的带宽，并加速了具有动态流量模式的ML任务。具体来说，它将LLM模型服务的首token生成延迟降低了1.04-2.73倍，将混合专家模型的训练吞吐量提高了高达1.3倍，并加速了深度学习推荐模型的训练，最高可达1.2倍。

import_candidates.title: Tigon: a distributed database for a CXL pod
import_candidates.abstract: Building efficient distributed transactional databases remains a challenging problem despite decades of research. Existing distributed databases synchronize cross-host concurrent data accesses over a network, which requires numerous message exchanges and introduces performance overhead.We describe Tigon, the first distributed in-memory database that synchronizes concurrent cross-host data accesses using atomic operations on CXL memory. Using CXL memory is more efficient than network-based approaches, but Tigon's design must address CXL's higher latency and lower bandwidth relative to local DRAM, as well as CXL's limited hardware support for cross-host cache coherence. For TPC-C and a variant of YCSB, Tigon achieves up to 2.5\texttimes{} higher throughput compared with two optimized shared-nothing databases that use CXL memory as a transport and up to 18.5\texttimes{} higher throughput compared with an RDMA-based distributed database.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 尽管经过了数十年的研究，构建高效的分布式事务数据库仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。现有的分布式数据库通过网络同步跨主机的并发数据访问，这需要大量的消息交换并引入性能开销。我们描述了Tigon，第一个利用CXL内存上的原子操作来同步跨主机并发数据访问的分布式内存数据库。使用CXL内存比基于网络的方法更高效，但Tigon的设计必须解决CXL相对于本地DRAM更高的延迟和更低的带宽，以及CXL对跨主机缓存一致性有限的硬件支持。对于TPC-C和YCSB的一种变体，与两个使用CXL内存作为传输的优化无共享数据库相比，Tigon实现了高达2.5倍的吞吐量提升；与基于RDMA的分布式数据库相比，吞吐量提升了高达18.5倍。

import_candidates.title: Mako: speculative distributed transactions with geo-replication
import_candidates.abstract: This paper introduces Mako, a highly available, high-throughput, and horizontally scalable transactional key-value store. Mako performs strongly consistent geo-replication to maintain availability despite entire datacenter failures, uses multi-core machines for fast serializable transaction processing, and shards data to scale out. To achieve these properties, especially to overcome the overheads of distributed transactions in geo-replicated settings, Mako decouples transaction execution and replication. This enables Mako to run transactions speculatively and very fast, and replicate transactions in the background to make them fault-tolerant. The key innovation in Mako is the use of two-phase commit (2PC) speculatively to allow distributed transactions to proceed without having to wait for their decisions to be replicated, while also preventing unbounded cascading aborts if shards fail prior to the end of replication. Our experimental evaluation on Azure shows that Mako processes 3.66M TPC-C transactions per second when data is split across 10 shards, each of which runs with 24 threads. This is an 8.6\texttimes{} higher throughput than state-of-the-art systems optimized for geo-replication.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了Mako，一个高可用、高吞吐量且可水平扩展的事务性键值存储。Mako执行强一致的地理复制，以在面对整个数据中心故障时保持可用性，使用多核机器进行快速的可串行化事务处理，并对数据进行分片以进行扩展。为了实现这些特性，特别是为了克服地理复制环境中分布式事务的开销，Mako将事务执行与复制解耦。这使Mako能够以投机方式非常快速地执行事务，并在后台复制事务以使其具备容错能力。Mako的关键创新在于投机性地使用两阶段提交（2PC），使分布式事务无需等待其决策被复制即可继续进行，同时防止在复制完成之前分片发生故障时产生无界的级联中止。我们在Azure上的实验评估表明，当数据分布在10个分片上（每个分片以24个线程运行）时，Mako每秒处理366万次TPC-C事务，比为地理复制优化的最先进系统吞吐量高出8.6倍。

import_candidates.title: Quake: adaptive indexing for vector search
import_candidates.abstract: Vector search, the task of finding the k-nearest neighbors of a query vector against a database of high-dimensional vectors, underpins many machine learning applications, including retrieval-augmented generation, recommendation systems, and information retrieval. However, existing approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) methods perform poorly under dynamic and skewed workloads where data distributions evolve. We introduce Quake, an adaptive indexing system that maintains low latency and high recall in such environments. Quake employs a multi-level partitioning scheme that adjusts to updates and changing access patterns, guided by a cost model that predicts query latency based on partition sizes and access frequencies. Quake also dynamically sets query execution parameters to meet recall targets using a novel recall estimation model. Furthermore, Quake utilizes NUMA-aware intraquery parallelism for improved memory bandwidth utilization during search. To evaluate Quake, we prepare a Wikipedia vector search workload and develop a workload generator to create vector search workloads with configurable access patterns. Our evaluation shows that on dynamic workloads, Quake achieves query latency reductions of 1.5-38\texttimes{} and update latency reductions of 4.5-126\texttimes{} compared to state-of-the-art indexes such as SVS, DiskANN, HNSW, and SCANN.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 向量搜索是根据查询向量在高维向量数据库中找到其k个最近邻的任务，它是许多机器学习应用的基础，包括检索增强生成、推荐系统和信息检索。然而，在数据分布演变的动态和倾斜工作负载下，现有的近似最近邻方法表现不佳。我们提出Quake，一个自适应索引系统，在此类环境中维持低延迟和高召回率。Quake采用多级分区方案，根据更新和变化的访问模式进行调整，并由一个基于分区大小和访问频率预测查询延迟的成本模型指导。Quake还利用新颖的召回率估计模型动态设置查询执行参数以满足召回率目标。此外，Quake利用NUMA感知的查询内并行性来改善搜索期间的内存带宽利用。为了评估Quake，我们准备了一个维基百科向量搜索工作负载，并开发一个工作负载生成器来创建具有可配置访问模式的向量搜索工作负载。我们的评估显示，在动态工作负载上，相比SVS、DiskANN、HNSW和SCANN等最先进的索引，Quake实现了1.5-38倍的查询延迟降低和4.5-126倍的更新延迟降低。

import_candidates.title: Achieving low-latency graph-based vector search via aligning best-first search algorithm with SSD
import_candidates.abstract: We propose PipeANN, an on-disk graph-based approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS) system, which significantly bridges the latency gap with in-memory ones. We achieve this by aligning the best-first search algorithm with SSD characteristics, avoiding strict compute-I/O order across search steps. Experiments show that PipeANN has 1.14\texttimes{}-2.02\texttimes{} search latency compared to in-memory Vamana, and 35.0\% of the latency of on-disk DiskANN in billion-scale datasets, without sacrificing search accuracy.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了PipeANN，一种基于磁盘的图近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）系统，它显著缩小了与内存系统的延迟差距。我们通过将最佳优先搜索算法与SSD特性对齐来实现这一点，避免搜索步骤之间严格的计算-I/O顺序。实验表明，在十亿规模数据集上，PipeANN的搜索延迟是内存Vamana的1.14倍至2.02倍，是磁盘DiskANN的35.0%，同时不损失搜索精度。

import_candidates.title: Skybridge: bounded staleness for distributed caches
import_candidates.abstract: Meta Platforms Inc. is a social media company whose products require high availability and low latency. Meta's services run in multiple geographic locations around the world and use asynchronous replication to keep the numerous cached copies of the datastore in sync. This setup reduces consistency in order to meet availability and latency requirements. Eventual consistency due to asynchronous replication causes issues for Meta's services, ranging from minor annoyances to product-breaking bugs. Therefore, we ask: can we put meaningful bounds on how long it takes writes to be visible while maintaining the scalability afforded by eventual consistency?In this work we present Skybridge, an out-of-band replication stream for providing bounded staleness for distributed caches. Skybridge takes advantage of the fact that Meta's systems already have a reliable delivery stream and instead focuses on real-time delivery of updates. Skybridge is complementary to the main replication pipeline and avoids correlated failures while being lightweight. We show that Skybridge helps provide 2-second bounded staleness for 99.99998\% of writes, while the main replication pipeline only achieves this 99.993\% of the time. Skybridge is able to achieve this while only being 0.54\% the size of cache deployments.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Meta Platforms Inc. 是一家社交媒体公司，其产品要求高可用性和低延迟。Meta 的服务遍布全球多个地理位置，并使用异步复制来保持数据存储的众多缓存副本同步。这种设置降低了一致性，以满足可用性和延迟要求。异步复制导致的最终一致性给 Meta 的服务带来了问题，从小烦恼到破坏产品的错误不一而足。因此，我们问：能否在保持最终一致性带来的可扩展性的同时，对写入可见时间设置有意义的界限？在这项工作中，我们提出了 Skybridge，一个带外复制流，用于为分布式缓存提供有限的过期性。Skybridge 利用 Meta 系统已有可靠交付流的优势，专注于更新的实时交付。Skybridge 与主复制管道互补，避免了相关性故障，同时保持轻量级。我们表明，Skybridge 帮助为 99.99998% 的写入提供 2 秒的有限过期性，而主复制管道仅在 99.993% 的时间内实现这一点。Skybridge 在实现这一目标的同时，仅占缓存部署规模的 0.54%。

import_candidates.title: KPerfIR: towards an open and compiler-centric ecosystem for GPU kernel performance tooling on modern AI workloads
import_candidates.abstract: In this work, we propose KPerfIR, a novel multilevel compiler-centric infrastructure to enable the development of customizable, extendable, and portable profiling tools tailored for modern artificial intelligence (AI) workloads on modern GPUs. Our approach integrates profiling capabilities directly into the compiler workflow, allowing profiling functionalities to be implemented as compiler passes, offering a programmable and reusable framework for performance analysis. This design bridges the gap between compilers and profilers, enabling fine-grained insights into complex optimization challenges such as overlapping the execution of fine-grained function units on GPUs. KPerfIR is integrated into the Triton infrastructure to highlight the power of a compiler-centric approach to advance performance analysis and optimization in the ever-evolving landscape of AI compilers. Our evaluation shows that our tool incurs low overhead (8.2\%), provides accurate measurements (2\% relative error), and delivers actionable insights into complicated GPU intra-kernel optimizations.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了KPerfIR，一种新颖的多层级、以编译器为中心的基础设施，旨在支持为现代GPU上的现代人工智能（AI）工作负载定制、扩展和可移植的性能分析工具。我们的方法将性能分析能力直接集成到编译器工作流程中，使性能分析功能可以以实现为编译器pass的形式提供，从而提供一个可编程、可重用的性能分析框架。该设计弥合了编译器与性能分析器之间的鸿沟，能够对诸如在GPU上重叠细粒度功能单元执行等复杂优化挑战提供细粒度的洞察。KPerfIR已集成到Triton基础设施中，以彰显以编译器为中心的方法在推动不断演进的AI编译器领域中的性能分析和优化的力量。我们的评估表明，该工具开销低（8.2%），测量准确（相对误差2%），并能对复杂的GPU内核内优化提供可操作的洞察。

import_candidates.title: Mirage: a multi-level superoptimizer for tensor programs
import_candidates.abstract: We introduce Mirage, the first multi-level superoptimizer for tensor programs. A key idea in Mirage is µGraphs, a uniform representation of tensor programs at the kernel, thread block, and thread levels of the GPU compute hierarchy. µGraphs enable Mirage to discover novel optimizations that combine algebraic transformations, schedule transformations, and generation of new custom kernels. To navigate the large search space, Mirage introduces a pruning technique based on abstraction that significantly reduces the search space and provides a certain optimality guarantee. To ensure that the optimized µGraph is equivalent to the input program, Mirage introduces a probabilistic equivalence verification procedure with strong theoretical guarantees. Our evaluation shows that Mirage significantly outperforms existing approaches even for DNNs that are widely used and heavily optimized. Mirage is publicly available at https://github.com/mirage-project/mirage.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们介绍了Mirage，这是首个用于张量程序的多层超级优化器。Mirage的一个关键思想是µGraphs，一种在GPU计算层次的kernel、线程块和线程级别上统一表示张量程序的机制。µGraphs使Mirage能够发现结合代数变换、调度变换和新自定义kernel生成的新颖优化。为了在巨大的搜索空间中导航，Mirage引入了一种基于抽象化的剪枝技术，该技术显著减少了搜索空间，并提供了一定的最优性保证。为了确保优化后的µGraph与输入程序等价，Mirage引入了一种具有强理论保证的概率等价性验证程序。我们的评估表明，即使对于广泛使用且经过高度优化的深度神经网络，Mirage也显著优于现有方法。Mirage可在https://github.com/mirage-project/mirage上公开获取。

import_candidates.title: QiMeng-Xpiler: transcompiling tensor programs for deep learning systems with a neural-symbolic approach
import_candidates.abstract: Heterogeneous deep learning systems (DLS) such as GPUs and ASICs have been widely deployed in industrial data centers, which requires to develop multiple low-level tensor programs for different platforms. An attractive solution to relieve the programming burden is to transcompile the legacy code of one platform to others. However, current transcompilation techniques struggle with either tremendous manual efforts or functional incorrectness, rendering "Write Once, Run Anywhere" of tensor programs an open question.We propose a novel transcompiler, i.e., QiMeng-Xpiler, for automatically translating tensor programs across DLS via both large language models (LLMs) and symbolic program synthesis, i.e., neural-symbolic synthesis. The key insight is leveraging the powerful code generation ability of LLM to make costly search-based symbolic synthesis computationally tractable. Concretely, we propose multiple LLM-assisted compilation passes via pre-defined meta-prompts for program transformation. During each program transformation, efficient symbolic program synthesis is employed to repair incorrect code snippets with a limited scale. To attain high performance, we propose a hierarchical auto-tuning approach to systematically explore both the parameters and sequences of transformation passes. Experiments on 4 DLS with distinct programming interfaces, i.e., Intel DL Boost with VNNI, NVIDIA GPU with CUDA, AMD MI with HIP, and Cambricon MLU with BANG, demonstrate that QiMeng-Xpiler correctly translates different tensor programs at the accuracy of 95\% on average.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 异构深度学习系统（如GPU和ASIC）已广泛部署在工业数据中心，这要求为不同平台开发多个底层张量程序。减轻编程负担的一个有吸引力的解决方案是将一种平台的遗留代码跨编译到其他平台。然而，当前的跨编译技术要么需要大量人工努力，要么产生功能错误，使得张量程序的“一次编写，随处运行”仍是一个开放问题。我们提出了一种新颖的跨编译器QiMeng-Xpiler，它通过大型语言模型（LLM）和符号程序合成（即神经-符号合成）自动跨深度学习系统翻译张量程序。关键洞察是利用LLM强大的代码生成能力，使昂贵的基于搜索的符号合成在计算上可行。具体而言，我们通过预定义的元提示提出多个LLM辅助的编译步骤进行程序转换。在每次程序转换期间，采用高效的符号程序合成来修复有限范围内不正确的代码片段。为了获得高性能，我们提出了一种分层自动调优方法，系统地探索转换步骤的参数和顺序。在4种具有不同编程接口的深度学习系统（即带有VNNI的Intel DL Boost、带有CUDA的NVIDIA GPU、带有HIP的AMD MI以及带有BANG的寒武纪MLU）上的实验表明，QiMeng-Xpiler以平均95%的准确率正确翻译不同的张量程序。

import_candidates.title: WaferLLM: large language model inference at wafer scale
import_candidates.abstract: Emerging AI accelerators increasingly adopt wafer-scale manufacturing technologies, integrating hundreds of thousands of AI cores in a mesh architecture with large distributed on-chip memory (tens of GB in total) and ultra-high on-chip memory bandwidth (tens of PB/s). However, current LLM inference systems, optimized for shared memory architectures like GPUs, fail to exploit these accelerators fully.We introduce WaferLLM, the first wafer-scale LLM inference system. WaferLLM is guided by a novel PLMR model (pronounced as "Plummer") that captures the unique hardware characteristics of wafer-scale architectures. Leveraging this model,WaferLLM pioneers wafer-scale LLM parallelism, optimizing the utilization of hundreds of thousands of on-chip cores. It also introduces MeshGEMM and MeshGEMV, the first GEMM and GEMV implementations designed to scale effectively on wafer-scale accelerators.Evaluations show that WaferLLM achieves up to 200\texttimes{} higher accelerator utilization than state-of-the-art methods. Leveraging a wafer-scale accelerator (Cerebras WSE2), WaferLLM delivers GEMV operations 606\texttimes{} faster and 16\texttimes{} more energy-efficient than on an NVIDIA A100 GPU. For full LLM inference, WaferLLM achieves 10-20\texttimes{} speedups over A100 GPU clusters running SGLang and vLLM. These advantages are expected to grow as wafer-scale AI models, software, and hardware continue to mature. WaferLLM is open-sourced at https://github.com/MeshInfra/WaferLLM.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 新兴的人工智能加速器日益采用晶圆级制造技术，以网格架构集成了数十万个人工智能核心，具有大的分布式片上内存（总量数十GB）和超高的片上内存带宽（数十PB/s）。然而，当前的LLM推理系统针对GPU等共享内存架构进行了优化，无法充分利用这些加速器。我们提出了WaferLLM，这是首个晶圆级LLM推理系统。WaferLLM由一个新颖的PLMR模型（发音为“Plummer”）指导，该模型捕捉了晶圆级架构独特的硬件特性。利用这一模型，WaferLLM开创了晶圆级LLM并行技术，优化了数十万个片上核心的利用率。它还引入了MeshGEMM和MeshGEMV，这是首个能在晶圆级加速器上有效扩展的GEMM和GEMV实现。评估显示，WaferLLM的加速器利用率比最先进的方法高出200倍。利用晶圆级加速器（Cerebras WSE2），WaferLLM的GEMV操作比NVIDIA A100 GPU快606倍，能效高16倍。对于完整的LLM推理，WaferLLM相比运行SGLang和vLLM的A100 GPU集群实现了10-20倍的加速。随着晶圆级AI模型、软件和硬件的不断成熟，这些优势预计将进一步增长。WaferLLM已在https://github.com/MeshInfra/WaferLLM开源。

import_candidates.title: BLITZSCALE: fast and live large model autoscaling with O(1) host caching
import_candidates.abstract: Model autoscaling is the key mechanism to achieve serverless model-as-a-service, but it faces a fundamental trade-off between scaling speed and storage/memory usage to cache parameters, and cannot meet frequent scaling requirements across multiple hosts. The key problem is that data plane performance is slow, and scaled instances remain stopped while parameters are loading.In this paper, we first show that the data plane can be made fast with no or O(1) caching by loading parameters through the compute network between GPUs because: (1) its speed is comparable to host cache and is underutilized, and (2) scaling multiple instances requires no or O(1) caching with network-optimized multicast. Second, autoscaling can be made live by breaking the scaling abstraction for inference from a coarse-grained instance-level to a fine-grained layer-level. This allows us to offload the layer computation from the overloaded serving instances to the scaled ones without waiting for the parameters to be fully loaded.Under real-world workloads, our system BLITZSCALE achieves up to 94\% lower tail latency reductions compared to state-of-the-art autoscaling system (ServerlessLLM), and it reduces the GPU time used for serving by 49\% when compared with serving systems that do not support autoscaling like Dist-Serve and vLLM with the same service-level-agreement.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 模型自动扩展是实现无服务器模型即服务的关键机制，但它面临着扩展速度与缓存参数所需的存储/内存使用之间的基本权衡，并且无法满足跨多个主机的频繁扩展需求。关键问题在于数据平面性能缓慢，且在加载参数时扩展的实例仍处于停止状态。在本文中，我们首先表明，通过计算网络在GPU之间加载参数，可以使数据平面在没有缓存或O(1)缓存的情况下变得快速，其原因在于：(1) 其速度与主机缓存相当且未得到充分利用，(2) 通过网络优化的组播，扩展多个实例无需缓存或仅需O(1)缓存。其次，通过将用于推理的扩展抽象从粗粒度的实例级分解为细粒度的层级，可以使自动扩展变得“实时”。这使得我们能够将层计算从过载的 serving 实例卸载到扩展实例，而无需等待参数完全加载。在真实世界的工作负载下，与最先进的自动扩展系统（ServerlessLLM）相比，我们的系统BLITZSCALE实现了高达94%的尾部延迟降低，并且与不支持自动扩展的 serving 系统（如Dist-Serve和vLLM）相比，在相同服务水平协议下，将用于服务的GPU时间减少了49%。

import_candidates.title: Bayesian code diffusion for efficient automatic deep learning program optimization
import_candidates.abstract: We introduce Bayesian code diffusion, a new deep learning program optimization strategy devised to accelerate the auto-tuning process of deep learning compilers. Using the concepts of prior and posterior distributions in the Bayesian framework and reformulating them in the context of deep learning program optimization, the proposed approach efficiently searches for optimal program code in a significantly reduced search space through an iterative diffusion of program code. To further enhance the efficiency of program optimization, we propose pre-training and fine-tuning for the cost model, which improves both the model's predictive accuracy and training efficiency. We implement Bayesian code diffusion in Ansor and evaluate its performance on a wide range of deep learning models on both CPUs and GPUs. Existing approaches struggle to reliably generate high-performing deep learning programs, i.e. achieving low program execution latency, across various configurations, including diverse deep learning model architectures and hardware platforms (CPU and GPU). In contrast, Bayesian code diffusion reduces the end-to-end compilation (optimization) time required to generate the equivalent program execution latency in various configurations, i.e., achieving up to 3.31\texttimes{} optimization speedup. This substantial improvement demonstrates that Bayesian code diffusion performs efficient and principled deep learning program optimization across a wide range of deep learning models, operators, and hardware (CPU and GPU).
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了贝叶斯代码扩散（Bayesian code diffusion），一种新的深度学习程序优化策略，旨在加速深度学习编译器的自动调优过程。利用贝叶斯框架中的先验分布和后验分布概念，并将其重新定义到深度学习程序优化的背景下，该方法通过程序代码的迭代扩散，在显著缩小的搜索空间中高效搜索最优程序代码。为了进一步提高程序优化的效率，我们提出了成本模型的预训练和微调，这既提高了模型的预测准确性，也提高了训练效率。我们在Ansor中实现了贝叶斯代码扩散，并在CPU和GPU上的多种深度学习模型上评估了其性能。现有方法在各种配置下（包括多样化的深度学习模型架构和硬件平台CPU和GPU）难以可靠地生成高性能的深度学习程序，即实现较低的程序执行延迟。相比之下，贝叶斯代码扩散减少了在各种配置下生成等效程序执行延迟所需的端到端编译（优化）时间，即实现了最高3.31倍的优化加速。这一显著改进表明，贝叶斯代码扩散在广泛的深度学习模型、算子以及硬件（CPU和GPU）上执行了高效且原则化的深度学习程序优化。

import_candidates.title: Training with confidence: catching silent errors in deep learning training with automated proactive checks
import_candidates.abstract: Training deep learning (DL) models is a complex process, making it prone to silent errors that are challenging to detect and diagnose. This paper presents TRAINCHECK, a framework that takes a proactive checking approach to address silent training errors. TRAINCHECK automatically infers invariants tailored for DL training. It uses these invariants to proactively detect silent errors during the training process while providing debugging help. To evaluate TRAINCHECK, we reproduce 20 real-world silent training errors with diverse root causes. TRAINCHECK successfully detects 18 errors within a single training iteration. It also uncovers 6 unknown bugs in popular training libraries that lead to silent errors.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 训练深度学习（DL）模型是一个复杂的过程，容易出现难以检测和诊断的静默错误。本文提出了TRAINCHECK，一个采用主动检查方法来处理静默训练错误的框架。TRAINCHECK自动推断专为DL训练定制的固定规则。它利用这些固定规则在训练过程中主动检测静默错误，同时提供调试帮助。为了评估TRAINCHECK，我们复现了20个具有不同根本原因的真实世界静默训练错误。TRAINCHECK在单次训练迭代内成功检测出18个错误。它还在流行的训练库中发现了6个导致静默错误的未知缺陷。

import_candidates.title: NEUTRINO: fine-grained GPU kernel profiling via programmable probing
import_candidates.abstract: As GPUs play an increasingly important role in computer systems in the scaling laws era, understanding fine-grained GPU runtime behavior is more crucial than ever. However, existing GPU kernel profilers, typically kernel-exclusive or hardware-dependent, often fail to capture fine-grained measurements. This paper presents NEUTRINO, a programmable interface for GPU kernel profiling that leverages assembly-layer probing to achieve instruction-level fine granularity, profiling versatility across time and value domains, and hardware independence. To better visualize the rich details captured by NEUTRINO, we introduce the Densified Memory Access Timeline (DMAT), a novel representation that offers new insights into GPU runtime behavior. We implement NEUTRINO in Linux for both NVIDIA and AMD GPUs and conduct extensive evaluations and analyses. The results demonstrate NEUTRINO's superior capabilities in GPU kernel profiling with low overhead. We envision NEUTRINO as a valuable tool for the community and have open-sourced it to facilitate future research at https://github.com/open-neutrino/neutrino.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在扩展律时代，GPU在计算机系统中扮演着越来越重要的角色，理解细粒度的GPU运行时行为比以往任何时候都更为关键。然而，现有的GPU内核剖析器通常是内核独占的或依赖硬件的，往往无法捕获细粒度的测量数据。本文提出了NEUTRINO，一个可编程的GPU内核剖析接口，利用汇编层探针实现指令级细粒度、跨时间和值域的剖析通用性以及硬件独立性。为了更好地可视化NEUTRINO捕获的丰富细节，我们引入了密集内存访问时间线（DMAT），这是一种新颖的表示方法，为GPU运行时行为提供了新的见解。我们在Linux上为NVIDIA和AMD GPU实现了NEUTRINO，并进行了广泛的评估和分析。结果表明NEUTRINO在GPU内核剖析方面具有卓越的能力且开销较低。我们期望NEUTRINO能成为社区的有用工具，并已将其开源以促进未来研究，地址为https://github.com/open-neutrino/neutrino。

import_candidates.title: Principles and methodologies for serial performance optimization
import_candidates.abstract: Throughout the history of computer science, optimizing existing systems to achieve higher performance has been a longstanding aspiration. While the primary emphasis of this endeavor lies in reducing latency and increasing throughput, these two are closely intertwined, and answering the how question has remained a challenge, often relying on intuition and experience.This paper introduces a systematic approach to optimizing sequential tasks, which are fundamental for overall performance. We define three principles--task removal, replacement, and reordering--and distill them into eight actionable methodologies: batching, caching, precomputing, deferring, relaxation, contextualization, hardware specialization, and layering. Our review of OSDI and SOSP papers over the past decade shows that these techniques, when taken together, comprehensively account for the observed sequential optimization strategies.To illustrate the framework's practical value, we present two case studies: one on file and storage systems, and another analyzing kernel synchronization to uncover missed optimization opportunities. Furthermore, we introduce SysGPT, a fine-tuned GPT model trained on curated literature analysis, which offer context-aware performance suggestions. SysGPT's outputs are more specific and feasible than GPT-4's, aligning with core strategies from recent research without direct exposure, demonstrating its utility as an optimization assistant.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在计算机科学的整个历史中，优化现有系统以实现更高性能一直是长期的追求。虽然这一努力的主要重点在于减少延迟和增加吞吐量，但这两者紧密相连，而且如何优化的问题仍然是一个挑战，往往依赖于直觉和经验。本文介绍了一种系统化的方法来优化串行任务，这些任务对于整体性能至关重要。我们定义了三个原则——任务移除、替换和重排序——并将其提炼为八种可操作的方法：批处理、缓存、预计算、延迟执行、松弛化、情境化、硬件专用化和分层。我们回顾了过去十年中OSDI和SOSP论文，显示这些技术综合在一起，能够全面解释所观察到的串行优化策略。为了展示该框架的实用价值，我们提出了两个案例研究：一个关于文件和存储系统，另一个分析内核同步以发现被遗漏的优化机会。此外，我们引入了SysGPT，一个基于精选文献分析微调的GPT模型，能够提供情境感知的性能建议。SysGPT的输出比GPT-4更具体且更可行，与近期研究的核心策略一致而无需直接接触，展示了其作为优化助手的实用性。

import_candidates.title: S\"{o}ze: one network telemetry is all you need for per-flow weighted bandwidth allocation at scale
import_candidates.abstract: Weighted bandwidth allocation is a powerful abstraction that has a wide range of use cases in modern data center networks. However, realizing highly agile and precise weighted bandwidth allocation for large-scale cloud environments is fundamentally challenging. In this paper, we propose S\"{o}ze, a lightweight decentralized weighted bandwidth allocation system that leverages simple network telemetry features of commodity Ethernet switches. Given the flow weights, S\"{o}ze can effectively use the telemetry information to compute and enforce the weighted bandwidth allocations without per-flow, topology, or routing knowledge. We demonstrate the effectiveness of S\"{o}ze through simulations and testbed experiments, improving TPC-H jobs completion time by up to 0.59\texttimes{} and 0.79\texttimes{} on average.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 加权带宽分配是一种强大的抽象，在现代数据中心网络中有广泛的应用场景。然而，为大规模云环境实现高度敏捷和精确的加权带宽分配从根本上具有挑战性。在本文中，我们提出了Söze，一个轻量级的去中心化加权带宽分配系统，它利用商用以太网交换机的简单网络遥测特性。给定流权重，Söze可以有效地利用遥测信息来计算和执行加权带宽分配，而无需每流、拓扑或路由知识。我们通过模拟和测试平台实验证明了Söze的有效性，将TPC-H作业完成时间平均最多提高了0.59倍和0.79倍。

import_candidates.title: Decouple and decompose: scaling resource allocation with DEDE
import_candidates.abstract: Efficient resource allocation is essential in cloud systems to facilitate resource sharing among tenants. However, the growing scale of these optimization problems have outpaced commercial solvers commonly employed in production. To accelerate resource allocation, prior approaches either customize solutions for narrow domains or impose workload-specific assumptions. In this work, we revisit real-world resource allocation problems and uncover a common underlying structure: the vast majority of these problems are inherently separable, i.e., they optimize the aggregate utility of individual resource and demand allocations, under separate constraints for each resource and each demand. Building on this observation, we develop DEDE, a scalable and theoretically rooted optimization framework for large-scale resource allocation. At the core of DEDE is a decouple-and-decompose approach: it decouples entangled resource and demand constraints and thereby decomposes the overall optimization into alternating per-resource and per-demand subproblems that can be solved efficiently and in parallel. We have implemented and released DEDE as a Python package with a familiar modeling interface. Our experiments on three representative resource allocation tasks--cluster scheduling, traffic engineering, and load balancing--demonstrate that DEDE delivers significant speedups while generating higher-quality allocations.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 高效的资源分配对于云系统中促进租户之间的资源共享至关重要。然而，这些优化问题的规模不断增长，已经超越了生产环境中常用的商业求解器。为了加速资源分配，先前的方法要么为狭窄领域定制解决方案，要么施加负载特定假设。在这项工作中，我们重新审视真实的资源分配问题，并揭示了一个共同的底层结构：绝大多数问题本质上是可分离的，即它们在每个资源和每个需求的单独约束下，优化各资源和需求分配的总体效用。基于这一观察，我们开发了DEDE，这是一个可扩展且具有理论根基的大规模资源分配优化框架。DEDE的核心是一种解耦-分解方法：它解耦相互纠缠的资源约束和需求约束，从而将整体优化分解为可高效并行解决的逐资源和逐需求交替子问题。我们已将DEDE作为Python包实现并发布，具有熟悉的建模接口。我们在三个代表性资源分配任务上的实验——集群调度、流量工程和负载均衡——表明，DEDE在生成更高质量分配的同时带来了显著加速。

import_candidates.title: Quantum virtual machines
import_candidates.abstract: Cloud computing services offer time on quantum computers, but users are forced to each use the entire quantum computer to run their programs as there is no way to multiplex a quantum computer among multiple programs at the same time. We present HyperQ, a system that introduces virtual machines for quantum computers to provide fault isolation, better resource utilization, and lower latency for quantum cloud computing. A quantum virtual machine is defined in terms of quantum computer hardware, specifically its quantum gates and qubits arranged in a hardware-specific topology. HyperQ enables quantum virtual machines to be simultaneously executed together on a quantum computer by multiplexing them in time and space on the hardware and ensuring that they are isolated from one another. HyperQ works with existing quantum programs and compiler frameworks; programs are simply compiled to run in virtual machines without the programs or compilers needing to know what else might be executed at the same time. We have implemented HyperQ for the IBM quantum computing service, the largest quantum computing fleet in the world. Our experimental results running quantum programs in virtual machines using the IBM service demonstrate that HyperQ can increase utilization and throughput while reducing program latency, by up to an order of magnitude, without sacrificing, and in some cases improving, fidelity in the results of quantum program execution.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 云计算服务提供量子计算机的使用时间，但用户被迫各自使用整台量子计算机来运行他们的程序，因为目前还没有办法在同一时间在多个程序之间复用量子计算机。我们提出了HyperQ，一个为量子计算机引入虚拟机以提供故障隔离、更优资源利用率和更低延迟的系统，用于量子云计算。量子虚拟机以量子计算机硬件来定义，具体包括其量子门和按硬件特定拓扑排列的量子比特。HyperQ通过在硬件上对量子虚拟机进行时间和空间复用，并确保它们彼此隔离，从而使其能在量子计算机上同时执行。HyperQ可与现有量子程序和编译器框架配合工作；程序只需编译到虚拟机中运行，而程序或编译器无需知道同一时间还可能执行什么其他内容。我们已在IBM量子计算服务上实现了HyperQ，该服务是世界上最大的量子计算车队。我们使用IBM服务在虚拟机中运行量子程序的实验结果表明，HyperQ能够提高利用率和吞吐量，同时将程序延迟降低多达一个数量级，且不会牺牲（在某些情况下还会提高）量子程序执行结果的保真度。

import_candidates.title: QOS: quantum operating system
import_candidates.abstract: Quantum computers face challenges due to hardware constraints, noise errors, and heterogeneity, and face fundamental design tradeoffs between key performance metrics such as quantum fidelity and system utilization. This substantially complicates managing quantum resources to scale the size and number of quantum algorithms that can be executed reliably in a given time.We introduce QOS, a modular quantum operating system that holistically addresses the challenges of quantum resource management by systematically exploring key design tradeoffs across the stack. QOS exposes a hardware-agnostic API for transparent quantum job execution, mitigates hardware errors, and systematically multi-programs and schedules the jobs across space and time to achieve high quantum fidelity in a resource-efficient manner. QOS's modular design enables synergistic cross- and intra-layer optimizations, while introducing new concepts such as compatibility-based multi-programming and effective utilization.We evaluate QOS on real quantum devices hosted by IBM, using 7000 real quantum runs of more than 70.000 benchmark instances. We show that the QOS achieves 2.6-456.5\texttimes{} higher fidelity, increases resource utilization by up to 9.6\texttimes{}, and reduces waiting times by up to 5\texttimes{} while sacrificing only 1-3\% fidelity, on average, compared to the baselines.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 量子计算机由于硬件限制、噪声错误和异质性而面临挑战，并在量子保真度和系统利用率等关键性能指标之间面临根本性的设计权衡。这大大复杂化了量子资源的管理，难以在给定时间内扩大可可靠执行的量子算法的规模和数量。我们介绍了QOS，一个模块化的量子操作系统，通过系统地探索整个技术栈中的关键设计权衡，全面应对量子资源管理的挑战。QOS为透明的量子作业执行提供了一种与硬件无关的API，减轻了硬件错误，并系统地跨空间和时间对作业进行多程序设计和调度，以资源高效的方式实现高量子保真度。QOS的模块化设计能够实现跨层和层内的协同优化，同时引入了基于兼容性的多程序设计和有效利用率等新概念。我们使用IBM托管的真实量子设备对QOS进行了评估，使用了7000次真实量子运行，涵盖超过7万个基准实例。我们证明，与基线相比，QOS平均将保真度提高了2.6-456.5倍，资源利用率提高了高达9.6倍，等待时间减少了高达5倍，而平均仅牺牲了1-3%的保真度。

import_candidates.title: Scalio: scaling up DPU-based JBOF key-value store with NVMe-oF target offload
import_candidates.abstract: The rapid growth of data-intensive applications has created a demand for high-density storage systems. Data-Processing-Unit-based (DPU-based) Just a Bunch of Flash (JBOF) solutions provide an energy-efficient and cost-effective architecture to meet this need. However, existing JBOF solutions struggle with scalability when handling an increasing number of attached SSDs, due to their heavy reliance on the DPU's CPU for SSD I/O operations.In this paper, we introduce Scalio, a scalable disaggregated key-value store designed to address the limitations of current DPU-based JBOF systems. Scalio offloads as many SSD I/O operations as possible to the DPU's network I/O capabilities, including traditional RDMA verbs and a recent hardware optimization, NVMe over Fabrics Target Offload. Additionally, Scalio incorporates a two-layer design with compact in-memory data structures to handle hot read traffic and manage bursty writes. One of the key challenges in this design is ensuring consistency between the DRAM states in the DPU and the SSD states, which, unlike CPU L1/L2 caches, are not automatically synchronized through hardware cache coherence protocols. To address this, Scalio introduces an RDMA-based cache consistency protocol that guarantees linearizability across the system, despite the disaggregated nature of the architecture.Our experiments show that Scalio significantly improves both scalability and throughput, achieving up to 3.3\texttimes{} higher throughput compared to existing systems, especially in high-density SSD configurations.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 数据密集型应用的快速增长产生了对高密度存储系统的需求。基于数据处理单元（DPU）的“一堆闪存”（JBOF）解决方案提供了一种节能且成本效益高的架构来满足这一需求。然而，现有的JBOF解决方案在处理越来越多的直连SSD时，由于其对DPU的CPU处理SSD I/O操作的过度依赖，面临着可扩展性问题。在本文中，我们介绍了Scalio，一种可扩展的解聚合键值存储，旨在解决当前基于DPU的JBOF系统的局限性。Scalio将尽可能多的SSD I/O操作卸载到DPU的网络I/O能力上，包括传统的RDMA动词和最近的一种硬件优化——NVMe over Fabrics目标卸载。此外，Scalio采用了两层设计，具有紧凑的内存中数据结构，以处理热读流量和管理突发写入。这种设计中的一个关键挑战是确保DPU中的DRAM状态与SSD状态之间的一致性，这与CPU L1/L2缓存不同，它们不会通过硬件缓存一致性协议自动同步。为解决此问题，Scalio引入了一种基于RDMA的缓存一致性协议，尽管架构具有解聚合性，但保证了跨系统的线性一致性。我们的实验表明，Scalio显著提高了可扩展性和吞吐量，特别是在高密度SSD配置下，与现有系统相比实现了高达3.3倍的吞吐量提升。

import_candidates.title: Low end-to-end latency atop a speculative shared log with fix-ante ordering
import_candidates.abstract: Today's shared logs incur expensive coordination to globally order records across storage shards before they can deliver records to applications. This makes them unsuitable for many modern applications that must process ingested data as early as possible and realize low end-to-end (e2e) latencies. We propose SpecLog, a new shared log abstraction that delivers records by speculating the global order, allowing the application's computation and shared-log coordination to be overlapped, thus reducing e2e latency. To enable accurate speculations, we introduce fix-ante ordering, a novel ordering mechanism that predetermines the global order and makes the shards adhere to the predetermined order. With fix-ante ordering, shards, except in rare cases, can accurately predict where their records will sit in the total order before global coordination. We build Belfast, an implementation of the SpecLog abstraction and fix-ante ordering. Our experiments show that Belfast offers lower e2e latencies than current shared logs while preserving their elasticity, flexibility, and scalability.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 如今的共享日志需要在将记录传递给应用程序之前，通过昂贵的协调机制在存储分片之间全局排序记录。这使得它们不适用于许多现代应用程序，这些应用程序必须尽早处理摄入的数据，并实现低端到端（e2e）延迟。我们提出了SpecLog，一种新的共享日志抽象，它通过推测全局顺序来传递记录，使应用程序的计算与共享日志的协调能够重叠，从而降低端到端延迟。为了实现准确的推测，我们引入了“前置固定顺序”（fix-ante ordering），这是一种新颖的排序机制，它预先确定全局顺序并使分片遵循该预定顺序。通过前置固定顺序，分片在极少数情况之外，都能在全局协调之前准确预测其记录在总顺序中的位置。我们构建了Belfast，即SpecLog抽象和前置固定顺序的实现。实验表明，与当前的共享日志相比，Belfast在保持其弹性、灵活性和可扩展性的同时，提供了更低的端到端延迟。

import_candidates.title: Understanding stragglers in large model training using what-if analysis
import_candidates.abstract: Large language model (LLM) training is one of the most demanding distributed computations today, often requiring thousands of GPUs with frequent synchronization across machines. Such a workload pattern makes it susceptible to stragglers, where the training can be stalled by few slow workers. At ByteDance we find stragglers are not trivially always caused by hardware failures, but can arise from multiple complex factors. This work aims to present a comprehensive study on the straggler issues in LLM training, using a five-month trace collected from our ByteDance LLM training cluster. The core methodology is what-if analysis that simulates the scenario without any stragglers and contrasts with the actual case. We use this method to study the following questions: (1) how often do stragglers affect training jobs, and what effect do they have on job performance; (2) do stragglers exhibit temporal or spatial patterns; and (3) what are the potential root causes for stragglers?
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型训练是当今最苛刻的分布式计算任务之一，通常需要数千个 GPU，并跨机器频繁同步。这种工作负载模式使其容易受到落伍者（straggler）的影响，即训练可能被少数缓慢的工作节点所阻塞。在字节跳动，我们发现落伍者并非总是由硬件故障引起的，而可能源于多种复杂因素。本工作旨在通过我们从字节跳动 LLM 训练集群收集的五个月追踪数据，对 LLM 训练中的落伍者问题进行全面的研究。核心方法是假设分析（what-if analysis），它模拟没有落伍者的场景，并与实际情况进行对比。我们使用这种方法研究以下问题：（1）落伍者影响训练任务的频率以及它们对任务性能的影响；（2）落伍者是否表现出时间或空间模式；（3）落伍者的潜在根本原因是什么？

import_candidates.title: Fork in the road: reflections and optimizations for cold start latency in production serverless systems
import_candidates.abstract: Serverless computing has seen widespread adoption in public cloud environments. However, it continues to suffer from long cold start latency, which remains a key performance bottleneck. We have conducted an in-depth investigation of existing cold start optimizations and evaluated their effectiveness in large-scale industrial deployments. Our study reveals several common limitations in prior research: (1) reliance on simplified assumptions that overlook the complexities of large-scale systems; (2) a narrow focus on optimizing isolated components of the cold start process, while ignoring end-to-end workflow interactions; and (3) insufficient attention to the challenges introduced by concurrent execution environments. As a result, despite incorporating prior techniques, cold start latency on the Ant Group serverless platform remains in the range of hundreds of milliseconds to several seconds.This paper identifies three previously overlooked sources of latency: (1) control path latency, stemming from interactions within the serverless runtime; (2) resource contention latency, arising under high concurrency and sustained execution; and (3) user code initialization latency, which reflects the trade-off between resource efficiency and startup performance. To address these challenges, we propose a suite of novel techniques that overcome key limitations in existing approaches. These techniques are designed to be both adaptable to real-world workloads and scalable to large deployments. Our system, AFaaS (short for Ant FaaS), reduces cold start latency to the millisecond level. AFaaS has been deployed in production for over 18 months and has consistently demonstrated stable performance at scale.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 无服务器计算已在公共云环境中得到广泛采用。然而，它仍然饱受冷启动延迟过长之苦，这依然是一个关键的性能瓶颈。我们对现有的冷启动优化进行了深入调查，并评估了它们在大规模工业部署中的有效性。我们的研究揭示了先前研究的几个常见局限：(1) 依赖简化假设，忽视大规模系统的复杂性；(2) 只关注优化冷启动过程的孤立组件，而忽略端到端工作流交互；(3) 对并发执行环境带来的挑战关注不足。因此，尽管采用了先前的技术，蚂蚁集团无服务器平台上的冷启动延迟仍在数百毫秒到数秒之间。本文指出了三个先前被忽视的延迟来源：(1) 控制路径延迟，源于无服务器运行时的内部交互；(2) 资源争用延迟，在高并发和持续执行情况下出现；(3) 用户代码初始化延迟，反映了资源效率与启动性能之间的权衡。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一套新技术，克服了现有方法中的关键局限。这些技术既适用于真实工作负载，又可扩展到大规模部署。我们的系统AFaaS（蚂蚁无服务器函数即服务的缩写）将冷启动延迟降低到毫秒级。AFaaS已投入生产超过18个月，并始终表现出大规模稳定性能。

import_candidates.title: Kamino: efficient VM allocation at scale with latency-driven cache-aware scheduling
import_candidates.abstract: In virtual machine (VM) allocation systems, caching repetitive and similar VM allocation requests and associated resolution rules is crucial for reducing computational costs and meeting strict latency requirements. While modern allocation systems distribute requests among multiple allocator agents and use caching to improve performance, current schedulers often neglect the cache state and latency considerations when assigning each new request to an agent. Due to the high variance in costs of cache hits and misses and the associated processing overheads of updating the caches, simple load-balancing and cache-aware mechanisms result in high latencies. We introduce Kamino, a high-performance, latency-driven and cache-aware request scheduling system aimed at minimizing end-to-end latencies. Kamino employs a novel scheduling algorithm grounded in theory which uses partial indicators from the cache state to assign each new request to the agent with the lowest estimated latency. Evaluation of Kamino using a high-fidelity simulator on large-scale production workloads shows a 42\% reduction in average request latencies. Our deployment of Kamino in the control plane of a large public cloud confirms these improvements, with a 33\% decrease in cache miss rates and 17\% reduction in memory usage.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在虚拟机（VM）分配系统中，缓存重复和相似的虚拟机分配请求及相关的解析规则对于降低计算成本和满足严格的延迟要求至关重要。虽然现代分配系统将请求分发到多个分配代理并使用缓存来提高性能，但当前的调度器在为每个新请求分配代理时往往忽略了缓存状态和延迟考虑。由于缓存命中和未命中的成本差异极大，以及更新缓存的相关处理开销，简单的负载均衡和缓存感知机制会导致较高的延迟。我们提出了Kamino，一种高性能、延迟驱动且缓存感知的请求调度系统，旨在最小化端到端延迟。Kamino采用了一种基于理论的新型调度算法，利用缓存状态的部分指标，将每个新请求分配给估算延迟最低的代理。使用高保真模拟器在大型生产工作负载上对Kamino的评估显示，平均请求延迟降低了42%。我们在大型公有云控制平面中部署Kamino，证实了这些改进，缓存未命中率降低了33%，内存使用量减少了17%。

import_candidates.title: ZEN: empowering distributed training with sparsity-driven data synchronization
import_candidates.abstract: Distributed training is the de facto standard to scale up the training of deep learning models with multiple GPUs. Its performance bottleneck lies in communications for gradient synchronization. Although high tensor sparsity is widely observed, the optimal communication scheme to fully leverage sparsity is still missing. This paper aims to bridge this gap. We first analyze the characteristics of sparse tensors in popular models to understand the fundamentals of sparsity. We then systematically explore the design space of communication schemes for sparse tensors and find the optimal ones. These findings give a new understanding and inspire us to develop a holistic gradient synchronization system for sparse tensors called ZEN. We demonstrate that ZEN can achieve up to 5.09\texttimes{} speedup in communication time and up to 2.48\texttimes{} speedup in training throughput compared to the state-of-the-art methods.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 分布式训练是通过多个GPU扩展深度学习模型训练的事实标准。其性能瓶颈在于梯度同步的通信。虽然经常观察到较高的张量稀疏性，但充分利用稀疏性的最优通信方案仍然缺失。本文旨在弥合这一差距。我们首先分析流行模型中稀疏张量的特征，以理解稀疏性的基本原理。然后我们系统探索稀疏张量通信方案的设计空间，并找到最优方案。这些发现提供了新的认识，并启发我们开发了一个针对稀疏张量的整体式梯度同步系统，称为ZEN。我们证明，与最先进的方法相比，ZEN在通信时间上可实现高达5.09倍的加速，在训练吞吐量上可实现高达2.48倍的加速。

import_candidates.title: Extending applications safely and efficiently
import_candidates.abstract: This paper presents the Extension Interface Model (EIM) and bpftime, which together enable safer and more efficient extension of userspace applications than the current state-of-the-art. EIM is a new model that treats each required feature of an extension as a resource, including concrete hardware resources (e.g., memory) and abstract ones (e.g., the ability to invoke a function from the extended application).
