An extension manager, i.e., the person who manages a deployment, uses EIM to specify only the resources an extension needs to perform its task. bpftime is a new extension framework that enforces an EIM specification. Compared to prior systems, bpftime is efficient because it uses extended Berkeley Packet Filter (eBPF)-style verification, hardware-supported isolation features (e.g., Intel MPK), and dynamic binary rewriting. Moreover, bpftime is easy to adopt into existing workflows since it is compatible with the current eBPF ecosystem. We demonstrate the usefulness of EIM and bpftime across 6 use cases that improve security, monitor and enhance performance, and explore configuration trade-offs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文提出了扩展接口模型（EIM）和bpftime，它们共同比当前最先进技术更安全、更高效地扩展用户空间应用程序。EIM是一种新模型，它将扩展的每个必要特性视为一种资源，包括具体的硬件资源（例如内存）和抽象资源（例如调用被扩展应用程序函数的能力）。扩展管理器（即管理部署的人员）使用EIM来仅指定扩展执行其任务所需的资源。bpftime是一个新扩展框架，用于强制实施EIM规范。与先前的系统相比，bpftime高效的原因在于它采用了eBPF风格的验证、硬件支持的隔离特性（例如Intel MPK）以及动态二进制重写。此外，bpftime兼容现有的eBPF生态系统，因此易于被纳入现有工作流程。我们通过6个用例展示了EIM和bpftime在改善安全性、监控和提升性能以及探索配置权衡方面的实用性。

import_candidates.title: Tintin: a unified hardware performance profiling infrastructure to uncover and manage uncertainty
import_candidates.abstract: Hardware performance counters (HPCs) enable the measurement of microarchitectural events, which are crucial for tracking and predicting program behavior. High-fidelity measurement and precise attribution are essential for accurate profiling. However, existing profiling tools have fundamental challenges in both aspects. In measurement, numerous events compete for limited hardware monitoring resources; while for attribution, applications have diverse requirements, but systems provide limited support. Existing tools mitigate the former limitation through event multiplexing, but this approach introduces non-trivial errors. The latter limitation, however, remains largely unaddressed.This paper introduces Tintin, an HPC profiling infrastructure with a modular three-component design that addresses both challenges. Tintin introduces mechanisms to mitigate multiplexing errors by characterizing uncertainty at runtime, scheduling events to minimize it, and reporting uncertainty to applications. It also proposes the Event Profiling Context (ePX) as a new OS primitive to unify diverse profiling requirements. Tintin is evaluated using benchmarks as well as real-world resource orchestration, performance debugging, and intrusion detection systems, to demonstrate its ability to improve hardware profiling with low runtime overhead.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 硬件性能计数器（HPC）能够测量微架构事件，这对于跟踪和预测程序行为至关重要。高保真测量和精确归因是准确剖析的关键。然而，现有剖析工具在测量和归因两方面都面临根本性挑战。测量方面，众多事件竞争有限的硬件监控资源；归因方面，应用具有多样化的需求，但系统所提供的支持有限。现有工具通过事件多路复用来缓解前一种局限，但这种方法引入了不小的误差；后者则基本未得到解决。本文介绍了 Tintin——一个具有模块化三组件设计的 HPC 剖析基础设施，旨在同时应对这两个挑战。Tintin 引入了相应机制，通过运行时表征不确定性、调度事件以最小化不确定性，以及向应用报告不确定性来缓解多路复用误差。它还提出了事件剖析上下文（ePX）作为一种新的操作系统原语，以统一多样的剖析需求。Tintin 使用基准测试以及真实世界的资源编排、性能调试和入侵检测系统进行了评估，展示了其能够以较低运行时开销改进硬件剖析的能力。

import_candidates.title: Building bridges: safe interactions with foreign languages through Omniglot
import_candidates.abstract: Memory- and type-safe languages promise to eliminate entire classes of systems vulnerabilities by construction. In practice, though, even clean-slate systems often need to incorporate libraries written in other languages with fewer safety guarantees. Because these interactions threaten the soundness of safe languages, they can reintroduce the exact vulnerabilities that safe languages prevent in the first place.This paper presents Omniglot: the first framework to efficiently uphold safety and soundness of Rust in the presence of unmodified and untrusted foreign libraries. Omniglot facilitates interactions with foreign code by integrating with a memory isolation primitive and validation infrastructure, and avoids expensive operations such as copying or serialization.We implement Omniglot for two systems: we use it to integrate kernel components in a highly-constrained embedded operating system kernel, as well as to interface with conventional Linux userspace libraries. Omniglot performs comparably to approaches that deliver weaker guarantees and significantly better than those with similar safety guarantees.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 内存安全和类型安全的语言承诺从根本上消除整类系统漏洞。然而在实践中，即使是全新设计的系统也常常需要引入用其他安全性保证较少的语言编写的库。由于这些交互威胁到安全语言的可信性（soundness），它们可能重新引入安全语言一开始所防止的那些漏洞。本文提出Omniglot：第一个能够在存在未修改且不可信的外部库的情况下高效维护Rust安全性和可信性的框架。Omniglot通过集成内存隔离原语和验证基础设施来促进与外部代码的交互，并避免了复制或序列化等昂贵操作。我们为两个系统实现了Omniglot：一个用于在高度受限的嵌入式操作系统内核中集成内核组件，另一个用于与常规Linux用户空间库进行接口交互。Omniglot的性能可与提供较弱保证的方法相媲美，并且明显优于提供类似安全保证的方法。

import_candidates.title: KRR: efficient and scalable kernel record replay
import_candidates.abstract: Modern kernels are large, complex, and plagued with bugs. Unfortunately, their large size and complexity make kernel failures very challenging for developers to diagnose since failures encountered in deployment are often notoriously difficult to reproduce. Although record-replay techniques provide the powerful ability to accurately record a failed execution and deterministically replay it, enabling advanced manual and automated analysis techniques, they are inefficient and do not scale with modern I/O-intensive, concurrent workloads.This paper introduces KRR, a kernel record-replay framework that provides a highly efficient execution recording mechanism by narrowing the scope of the record and replay boundary to the kernel. Unlike previous record-replay wholestack approaches, KRR adopts a split-recorder design that employs the guest and the host to jointly record the kernel execution. Our evaluation demonstrates that KRR scales efficiently up to 8 cores, across a range of different workloads, including kernel compilation, RocksDB, and Nginx. When recording 8-core VMs that run RocksDB and kernel compilation, KRR incurs only a 1.52\texttimes{} ∼ 2.79\texttimes{} slowdown compared to native execution, while traditional whole-VM RR suffers from 8.97\texttimes{} ∼ 29.94\texttimes{} slowdown. We validate that KRR is practical and has a broad recording scope by reproducing 17 bugs across different Linux versions, including 6 non-deterministic bugs and 5 high-risk CVEs; KRR was able to record and reproduce all but one non-deterministic bug.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代内核庞大、复杂且充满漏洞。不幸的是，其规模和复杂性使得内核故障对开发者来说极具挑战性，因为部署中遇到的故障通常难以复现。尽管记录重放技术提供了准确记录失败执行并确定性重放的能力，从而支持高级的人工和自动分析技术，但它们效率低下，无法扩展到现代I/O密集型并发工作负载。本文介绍了KRR，一种内核记录重放框架，通过将记录和重放的边界缩小到内核来提供高效的执行记录机制。与以往的整体栈记录重放方法不同，KRR采用分裂记录器设计，利用客户机和主机共同记录内核执行。我们的评估表明，在内核编译、RocksDB和Nginx等一系列不同工作负载下，KRR能够高效扩展到8核。在记录运行RocksDB和内核编译的8核虚拟机时，KRR仅产生1.52倍至2.79倍于原生执行的减速，而传统的整虚拟机RR则遭受8.97倍至29.94倍的减速。通过复现不同Linux版本中的17个bug（包括6个非确定性bug和5个高危CVE），我们验证了KRR的实用性和广泛的记录范围。除一个非确定性bug外，KRR成功记录并复现了其余所有bug。

import_candidates.title: Deterministic client: enforcing determinism on untrusted machine code
import_candidates.abstract: This paper presents Deterministic Client (DeCl), a software-based sandboxing system for enforcing deterministic behavior on untrusted machine code, either x86-64 or Arm64. DeCl adapts techniques from Software Fault Isolation (SFI) traditionally used to guarantee memory isolation to instead enforce the stronger property of determinism. By using a simple and efficient machine code verifier that can guarantee that a program behaves deterministically, DeCl does not rely on a trusted compiler/interpreter for correctness. This allows the use of LLVM without compromising the size of the trusted code base. We also describe how to implement two efficient metering mechanisms that enforce deterministic preemption of sandboxed programs, and how DeCl can be implemented in combination with traditional software-based isolation, by making the sandboxed code position-oblivious. DeCl is able to combine and improve upon the benefits of both interpreters and JIT compilers at once, with low CPU overhead, fast startup time, and strong security via a small trusted code base. We evaluate DeCl's effectiveness on general-purpose CPU benchmarks, as well as in an application-specific context by integrating with the Groundhog smart contract engine, and using DeCl for zero-knowledge-proof verification.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了确定性客户端（Deterministic Client, DeCl），一种基于软件的沙箱系统，用于在不信任的机器代码（x86-64或Arm64）上强制确定性行为。DeCl改编了传统上用于保证内存隔离的软件故障隔离（SFI）技术，转而强制实现更强的确定性属性。通过使用一种简单高效的机器代码验证器来保证程序行为是确定性的，DeCl在正确性上不依赖受信任的编译器或解释器。这使得在不损害可信计算基规模的前提下可以使用LLVM。我们还描述了如何实现两种高效的计量机制来强制沙箱程序的确定性抢占，以及如何通过使沙箱代码位置无关来将DeCl与传统基于软件的隔离相结合。DeCl能够同时结合并改进解释器和JIT编译器的优势，具有低CPU开销、快速启动时间和通过小型可信计算基实现的强安全性。我们在通用CPU基准测试上评估了DeCl的有效性，并通过与Groundhog智能合约引擎集成以及使用DeCl进行零知识证明验证来评估其在特定应用场景中的效果。

import_candidates.title: Disentangling the dual role of NIC receive rings
import_candidates.abstract: CPUs parallelize packet processing across cores via per-core receive (Rx) rings, which are typically sized to absorb bursts with ≥1Ki entries by default. The combined I/O working set (packet buffers pointed to by all Rx rings) easily exceeds the LLC capacity, thus degrading performance due to high memory bandwidth pressure. Recent work has reduced the I/O working set size by sharing Rx rings among cores with the "shRing" system. But this approach suffers from a bottleneck under imbalanced loads, which are common.We contend that the bottleneck stems from an unnecessary entanglement of two orthogonal producer-consumer structures: (1) memory allocation, where the core produces empty buffers that the NIC consumes to store packets; and (2) packet delivery, where the NIC produces incoming packets that the core consumes. We propose rxBisect, a new CPU-NIC interface that decouples these structures. RxBisect replaces each Rx ring with two separate rings corresponding to the two structures, allowing memory allocation to be performed independently of packet reception. RxBisect can thus pass empty buffers efficiently between cores upon imbalance, thereby eliminating the aforementioned bottleneck. We implement rxBisect with software emulation and find that it improves throughput by up to 20\% and 37\% relative to the state-of-the-art (shRing) and state-of-the-practice (per-core Rx rings).
import_candidates.abstract_zh: CPU通过每核接收（Rx）环路并行处理数据包，这些环路通常默认配置为能够吸收包含≥1K条目的突发流量。组合的I/O工作集（所有Rx环路指向的数据包缓冲区）很容易超过LLC容量，从而由于高内存带宽压力而降低性能。近期工作通过'共享环路'（shRing）系统在核心间共享Rx环路来减小I/O工作集大小，但这种方法在常见的不平衡负载下会遭遇瓶颈。我们认为，该瓶颈源于两个正交的生产者-消费者结构的不必要纠缠：（1）内存分配，其中核心产生空闲缓冲区供NIC消费以存储数据包；（2）数据包交付，其中NIC产生传入数据包供核心消费。我们提出了rxBisect，一种新的CPU-NIC接口，用于解耦这些结构。rxBisect将每个Rx环路替换为对应两个结构的两个独立环路，使得内存分配能够独立于数据包接收进行。这样，rxBisect可以在不平衡时将空闲缓冲区高效地在核心间传递，从而消除上述瓶颈。我们通过软件模拟实现了rxBisect，并发现相对于当前最优方法（shRing）和当前实践常态（每核Rx环路），其吞吐量分别提升了最高20%和37%。

import_candidates.title: XSched: preemptive scheduling for diverse XPUs
import_candidates.abstract: XPUs, such as GPUs, NPUs, ASICs, and FPGAs, lack flexible scheduling capabilities, failing to meet rich application requirements (e.g., priority and fairness) in multitasking environments. This paper presents XSched, a scheduling framework that enables preemptive scheduling on diverse XPUs with flexible policies. XSched provides unified interfaces for scheduling XPU tasks through a preemptible command queue abstraction (XQueue). The key challenge in implementing the abstraction is adapting to XPUs with diverse and evolving hardware capabilities and software stacks. XSched proposes a multi-level hardware model that enables mature, advanced XPUs to achieve optimal scheduling performance while maintaining compatibility with emerging, wimpy XPUs. To demonstrate the generalizability of XSched, we adapted it to ten XPUs of different types, brands, and generations across seven software platforms and implemented two hardware-agnostic scheduling policies. We further evaluated XSched through three case studies of multitasking workloads on XPUs. XSched effectively achieves various scheduling objectives using its efficient and flexible preemption mechanisms.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: XPU（如GPU、NPU、ASIC和FPGA）缺乏灵活的调度能力，无法满足多任务环境中丰富的应用需求（如优先级和公平性）。本文提出了XSched，一个调度框架，能够通过灵活的策略在多样化的XPU上实现抢占式调度。XSched通过可抢占的命令队列抽象（XQueue）为XPU任务调度提供统一接口。实现该抽象的关键挑战在于适应具有多样化且不断发展的硬件功能和软件栈的XPU。XSched提出了一种多级硬件模型，使成熟且先进的XPU能够实现最优调度性能，同时保持对新兴且功能较弱的XPU的兼容性。为证明XSched的通用性，我们将其适配到涵盖七个软件平台的十种不同类型、品牌和代际的XPU上，并实现了两种与硬件无关的调度策略。我们通过三个在XPU上的多任务负载案例研究对XSched进行了进一步评估。XSched利用其高效灵活的抢占机制有效实现了多种调度目标。

import_candidates.title: OS rendering service made parallel with out-of-order execution and in-order commit
import_candidates.abstract: Rendering service is an indispensable OS service on smart-device OSes like Android, iOS and OpenHarmony. However, the recent shift towards highly scalable display scenarios, such as foldable and multiple screens, has notably amplified the rendering workload, leading to low frame rates that degrade user experience. Yet, rendering services predominantly follow a sequential model, which is notoriously hard to parallelize due to the complex state dependency, drawing order dependency, and interface dependency.This paper observes that a significant portion of the rendering procedure is potentially parallelizable through proper state pre-untangling and drawing order post-preserving. To this end, this paper introduces Spars, a scalable parallelized OS rendering service inspired by the out-of-order execution with in-order commit in computer architecture. Spars revolutionizes the rendering procedure by initially generating self-contained rendering tasks through in-order preparation, executing such tasks in an out-of-order manner to maximize multi-core parallelism, and subsequently committing the tasks in-order to enforce drawing order dependencies. Evaluation results on state-of-the-art single-screen, dual-fold, and trifold smartphones (Mate 70, X5, XT) as well as one-chip-multiple-screen configurations show an average frame rate improvement of 1.76\texttimes{}-1.91\texttimes{}. Moreover, Spars is able to decrease the device power consumption by 3.0\% or increase the budget of graphics primitives by 2.31\texttimes{} for more appealing visual effects with the same stable frame rate.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 渲染服务是Android、iOS和OpenHarmony等智能设备操作系统中不可或缺的OS服务。然而，近年来向高度可扩展显示场景（如可折叠屏和多屏）的转变显著增加了渲染工作负载，导致帧率降低，用户体验下降。然而，渲染服务主要遵循顺序模型，由于复杂的状态依赖、绘制顺序依赖和接口依赖，该模型众所周知难以并行化。本文观察到，渲染过程的很大一部分通过适当的状态预解缠和绘制顺序后保留是可能并行的。为此，本文介绍了Spars，一种受计算机体系结构中乱序执行和顺序提交启发的可扩展并行OS渲染服务。Spars革新了渲染过程：首先通过有序准备生成自包含的渲染任务，以乱序方式执行这些任务以最大化多核并行性，随后按顺序提交任务以强制执行绘制顺序依赖。在最新一代单屏、双折叠和三折叠智能手机（Mate 70、X5、XT）以及一芯多屏配置上的评估结果显示，平均帧率提高了1.76倍至1.91倍。此外，Spars能够将设备功耗降低3.0%，或在保持相同稳定帧率的情况下将图元预算增加2.31倍，以实现更吸引人的视觉效果。

import_candidates.title: EMT: an OS framework for new memory translation architectures
import_candidates.abstract: With terabyte-scale memory capacity and memory-intensive workloads, memory translation has become a major performance bottleneck. Many novel hardware schemes are developed to speed up memory translation, but few are experimented with commodity OSes. A main reason is that memory management in major OSes, like Linux, does not have the extensibility to empower emerging hardware schemes.We develop EMT, a pragmatic framework atop Linux to empower different hardware schemes of memory translation such as radix tree and hash table. EMT provides an architecture-neutral interface that 1) supports diverse memory translation architectures, 2) enables hardware-specific optimizations, 3) accommodates modern hardware and OS complexity, and 4) has negligible overhead over hardwired implementations. We port Linux's memory management onto EMT and show that EMT enables extensibility without sacrificing performance. We use EMT to implement OS support for ECPT and FPT, two recent experimental translation schemes for fast translation; EMT enables us to understand the OS perspective of these architectures and further optimize their designs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着TB级内存容量和内存密集型工作负载的出现，内存转换已成为主要的性能瓶颈。许多新型硬件方案被提出以加速内存转换，但很少在商用操作系统上得到实验验证。一个主要原因是主流操作系统（如Linux）中的内存管理缺乏可扩展性，无法赋能新兴硬件方案。我们开发了EMT，一个基于Linux的实用框架，用以支持不同的内存转换硬件方案（如基数树和哈希表）。EMT提供了一种与架构无关的接口，能够：1）支持多样化的内存转换架构；2）实现硬件特定优化；3）适应现代硬件和操作系统的复杂性；4）相比硬接线实现具有可忽略的开销。我们将Linux的内存管理移植到EMT上，并证明EMT能够在不牺牲性能的情况下实现可扩展性。我们使用EMT为ECPT和FPT这两个近期用于快速内存转换的实验性方案提供操作系统支持；EMT使我们能够从操作系统视角理解这些架构，并进一步优化其设计。

import_candidates.title: Tiered memory management beyond hotness
import_candidates.abstract: Tiered memory systems often rely on access frequency ("hotness") to guide data placement. However, hot data is not always performance-critical, limiting the effectiveness of hotness-based policies. We introduce amortized offcore latency (AOL), a novel metric that precisely captures the true performance impact of memory accesses by accounting for memory access latency and memory-level parallelism (MLP). Leveraging AOL, we present two powerful tiering mechanisms: SOAR, a profile-guided allocation policy that places objects based on their performance contribution, and ALTO, a lightweight page migration regulation policy to eliminate unnecessary migrations. SOAR and ALTO outperform four state-of-the-art tiering designs across a diverse set of workloads by up to 12.4\texttimes{}, while underperforming in a few cases by no more than 3\%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 分层内存系统通常依赖访问频率（“热度”）来指导数据放置。然而，热数据并不总是性能关键的，这限制了基于热度的策略的有效性。我们引入了摊销非核心延迟（AOL），这是一种新的度量指标，通过考虑内存访问延迟和内存级并行性（MLP）来精确捕获内存访问的真实性能影响。利用AOL，我们提出了两种强大的分层机制：SOAR，一种基于配置文件指导的分配策略，根据对象的性能贡献进行放置；以及ALTO，一种轻量级的页面迁移调节策略，以消除不必要的迁移。SOAR和ALTO在多种工作负载上比四种最先进的分层设计性能提升高达12.4倍，而在少数情况下性能下降不超过3%。

import_candidates.title: NanoFlow: towards optimal large language model serving throughput
import_candidates.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have resulted in a surging demand for planet-scale serving systems, where tens of thousands of GPUs continuously serve hundreds of millions of users. Consequently, throughput has emerged as a key metric that determines serving systems' performance. Due to large model sizes and memory-intensive self-attention, LLM serving has been commonly assumed to be memory-bound. Through a detailed analysis, we show that despite having memory-intensive components, end-to-end LLM serving is compute bound for most common workloads and LLMs. Alas, most existing serving engines fall short from optimal compute utilization, because the heterogeneous operations that comprise LLM serving--compute, memory, networking--are executed sequentially within a device.We propose NanoFlow, a novel serving framework that exploits intra-device parallelism, which overlaps the usage of heterogeneous resources within a single device. NanoFlow splits inputs into smaller nano-batches and duplicates operations to operate on each portion independently, enabling overlapping. NanoFlow automatically identifies the number, size, ordering, and GPU resource allocation of nano-batches to minimize the execution time, while considering the interference of concurrent operations. We evaluate NanoFlow's end-to-end serving throughput on several popular models such as LLaMA-2-70B, Mixtral 8\texttimes{}7B, LLaMA-3-8B, etc. With practical workloads, NanoFlow provides 1.91\texttimes{} throughput boost compared to state-of-the-art serving systems, achieving between 50\% to 72\% of optimal throughput across popular models.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）引发了对全球规模服务系统的巨大需求，在这些系统中，数万个GPU持续为数亿用户提供服务。因此，吞吐量已成为决定服务系统性能的关键指标。由于模型规模庞大且自注意力机制对内存需求高，LLM服务通常被认为受内存限制。通过详细分析，我们表明尽管存在内存密集型组件，端到端LLM服务在大多数常见工作负载和LLM下实际上是计算受限的。然而，大多数现有服务引擎远未达到最佳计算利用率，因为LLM服务包含的异构操作——计算、内存、网络——在设备内是顺序执行的。我们提出了NanoFlow，一种利用设备内并行性的新型服务框架，它在单个设备内重叠使用异构资源。NanoFlow将输入拆分为更小的纳米批次，并复制操作以独立处理每个部分，从而实现重叠。NanoFlow自动确定纳米批次的数量、大小、顺序和GPU资源分配，以最小化执行时间，同时考虑并发操作的干扰。我们在几个流行模型上评估了NanoFlow的端到端服务吞吐量，如LLaMA-2-70B、Mixtral 8×7B、LLaMA-3-8B等。在实际工作负载下，与最先进的服务系统相比，NanoFlow提供了1.91倍的吞吐量提升，在流行模型上实现了最优吞吐量的50%至72%。

import_candidates.title: PipeThreader: software-defined pipelining for efficient DNN execution
import_candidates.abstract: To effectively utilize heterogeneous specialized hardware units in modern GPUs, such as TensorCores and Tensor Memory Accelerators, this paper introduces PipeThreader, a new DNN compiler. PipeThreader proposes shifting scheduling functionality from hardware to software so as to enable more efficient and sophisticated computation pipelining with minimal manual effort. This is achieved through sTask-graph, a new DNN computation abstraction, a hierarchical hardware abstraction that captures the capabilities of specialized units, and new scheduling primitives. As a result, PipeThreader can discover efficient pipeline scheduling for well-studied DNN architectures like FlashAttention, achieving comparable or even superior performance. Additionally, it can uncover novel pipeline schemes for emerging models like Mamba2, delivering significantly better performance compared to state-of-the-art hand-crafted implementations. The code is open-sourced at https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 为了有效利用现代GPU中的异构专用硬件单元（如TensorCores和Tensor Memory Accelerators），本文介绍了PipeThreader，一种新的DNN编译器。PipeThreader提出将调度功能从硬件转移到软件，从而以最小的人工努力实现更高效和复杂的计算流水线。这是通过sTask-graph（一种新的DNN计算抽象）、捕获专用单元能力的层次化硬件抽象以及新的调度原语实现的。因此，PipeThreader能够为像FlashAttention这样的经过充分研究的DNN架构发现高效的流水线调度，实现可比甚至更优越的性能。此外，它还能为像Mamba2这样的新兴模型发现新颖的流水线方案，与最先进的手工实现相比提供显著更好的性能。代码已在https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang开源。

import_candidates.title: WLB-LLM: workload-balanced 4D parallelism for large language model training
import_candidates.abstract: In this work, we present WLB-LLM, a WorkLoad-Balanced 4D Parallelism for Large Language Model Training. We first thoroughly analyze the workload imbalance issue in LLM training and identify two primary sources of imbalance at the pipeline parallelism and context parallelism levels. Then, to address the imbalance issue, at the pipeline parallelism level, WLB-LLM incorporates a workload-aware variable-length document packing method to balance the computation and communication workload across micro-batches. Additionally, at the context parallelism level, WLB-LLM introduces a novel fine-grained per-document sharding strategy, ensuring each worker within a context parallelism group has an identical workload. Comprehensive experiments under different model scales demonstrate that WLB-LLM significantly mitigates the workload imbalance during 4D parallelism LLM training and achieves an average speedup of 1.23\texttimes{} when applying WLBLLM in our internal LLM training framework.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了WLB-LLM，一种用于大语言模型训练的工作负载均衡4D并行方法。我们首先深入分析了LLM训练中的工作负载不均衡问题，并识别出流水线并行和上下文并行层面的两个主要不均衡来源。然后，为解决该不均衡问题，在流水线并行层面，WLB-LLM引入了一种负载感知的可变长度文档打包方法，以平衡各微批次的计算和通信负载。此外，在上下文并行层面，WLB-LLM提出了一种新颖的基于每个文档的细粒度分片策略，确保上下文并行组内的每个工作节点具有相同的工作负载。在不同模型规模下的综合实验表明，WLB-LLM显著缓解了4D并行LLM训练中的工作负载不均衡问题，并在我们内部的LLM训练框架中应用WLB-LLM后实现了平均1.23倍的加速。

import_candidates.title: DecDEC: a systems approach to advancing low-bit LLM quantization
import_candidates.abstract: Quantization of Large Language Models (LLMs) has recently gained popularity, particularly for on-device settings with limited hardware resources. While efficient, quantization inevitably degrades model quality, especially in aggressive lowbit settings such as 3-bit and 4-bit precision. In this paper, we propose DecDEC, an inference scheme that improves the quality of low-bit LLMs while preserving the key benefits of quantization: GPU memory savings and latency reduction. DecDEC stores the residual matrix--the difference between full-precision and quantized weights--in CPU, and dynamically fetches the residuals for only a small portion of the weights. This portion corresponds to the salient channels, marked by activation outliers, with the fetched residuals helping to correct quantization errors in these channels. Salient channels are identified dynamically at each decoding step by analyzing the input activations--this enables adaptation to the dynamic nature of activation distribution, thus maximizing the effectiveness of error compensation. We demonstrate the effectiveness of DecDEC by augmenting state-of-the-art quantization methods. For example, DecDEC reduces the perplexity of a 3-bit Llama-3-8B-Instruct model from 10.15 to 9.12--outperforming its 3.5-bit counterpart--while adding less than 0.0003\% to GPU memory usage and incurring only a 1.7\% inference slowdown on NVIDIA RTX 4050 Mobile.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的量化最近变得流行，特别是在硬件资源有限的自带设备环境中。虽然量化高效，但不可避免地会降低模型质量，尤其是在3位和4位精度等激进的低位设置中。在本文中，我们提出了DecDEC，一种推理方案，可提高低位LLM的质量，同时保持量化的关键优势：GPU内存节省和延迟降低。DecDEC将残差矩阵——全精度与量化权重之间的差异——存储在CPU中，并仅对一小部分权重动态获取残差。这部分对应于以激活异常值为标志的显著通道，获取的残差有助于纠正这些通道中的量化误差。在每个解码步骤中，通过分析输入激活来动态识别显著通道——这能够适应激活分布的动态特性，从而最大化误差补偿的有效性。我们通过增强最先进的量化方法来证明DecDEC的有效性。例如，DecDEC将3位Llama-3-8B-Instruct模型的困惑度从10.15降低到9.12，超过了其3.5位对应版本，同时增加不到0.0003%的GPU内存使用，并在NVIDIA RTX 4050 Mobile上仅引起1.7%的推理减速。

import_candidates.title: Stripeless data placement for erasure-coded in-memory storage
import_candidates.abstract: Erasure coding plays a crucial role in distributed storage systems to provide fault tolerance at a low storage cost. Conventional erasure coding schemes determine data placement based on stripes. However, placing data into stripes can incur non-negligible performance overheads that will manifest in emerging fast in-memory storage systems, making conventional erasure coding schemes suboptimal in such scenarios.Aiming to eliminate such overheads, we present Nos, a stripeless placement scheme for erasure-coded in-memory storage. It lets each node independently replicate data to other nodes and encode received data replicas into parities with XOR. Thus, it avoids the overheads caused by stripes. To enable failure recovery, Nos uses a combinatoric structure called symmetric balanced incomplete block design (SBIBD) to decide primary-to-backup node affinities during replication. Atop Nos, we further build Nostor, a distributed in-memory key-value store. Evaluations demonstrate that Nostor achieves 1.61\texttimes{} to 2.60\texttimes{} throughputs with similar or lower latencies than stripe-based erasure coding baselines.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 纠删码在分布式存储系统中发挥着关键作用，以较低的存储成本提供容错能力。传统的纠删码方案基于条带来确定数据放置。然而，将数据放入条带会产生不可忽略的性能开销，这在新兴的快速内存存储系统中会显现出来，使得传统纠删码方案在这种场景下不是最优的。为了消除这些开销，我们提出了Nos，一种用于纠删码内存存储的无条带放置方案。它让每个节点独立地将数据复制到其他节点，并用XOR将接收到的数据副本编码为奇偶校验。因此，它避免了由条带引起的开销。为了支持故障恢复，Nos使用一种称为对称平衡不完全区组设计（SBIBD）的组合结构来决定复制期间主节点到备份节点的亲和性。在Nos之上，我们进一步构建了Nostor，一个分布式内存键值存储系统。评估表明，与基于条带的纠删码基线相比，Nostor实现了1.61倍至2.60倍的吞吐量，且延迟相似或更低。

import_candidates.title: PoWER never corrupts: tool-agnostic verification of crash consistency and corruption detection
import_candidates.abstract: Storage systems must maintain integrity even after rare and difficult-to-test-for conditions like power losses and media errors. Formal verification presents a promising avenue to ensure storage systems are resilient, but current approaches involve significant complexity and rely on verification constructs or forms of logic beyond what most verifiers natively support. In this paper, we present two new verification techniques that rely only on standard constructs provided by most verification tools such as Hoare logic, ghost variables, and quantifiers. First, we introduce PoWER (Preconditions on Writes Enforcing Recoverability), a novel approach to verifying crash consistency that encodes its requirements in the preconditions of storage API methods. Second, we present a new model of media corruption for provable corruption detection on any type of storage device. To demonstrate the power of these new techniques, we use them to build two verified storage systems using two different verification frameworks. We build and verify the key-value (KV) store CAPYBARAKV using Verus and the notary server CAPYBARANS using Dafny. Both systems are built for persistent memory (PM), which we target due to new challenges it presents to building resilient storage systems. We develop new techniques to address these challenges, including the corruption-detecting Boolean, a new primitive for atomic checksum updates. Both systems verify in under a minute, and CAPYBARAKV achieves performance competitive with similar unverified PM KV stores.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 存储系统即使在诸如电源故障和介质错误等罕见且难以测试的条件下也必须保持完整性。形式化验证为确保存储系统的韧性提供了一条有前景的途径，但当前的方法涉及显著的复杂性，并且依赖于大多数验证器原生不支持的特殊验证构造或逻辑形式。在本文中，我们提出了两种新技术，仅依赖于大多数验证工具提供的标准构造，如Hoare逻辑、幽灵变量和量词。首先，我们引入PoWER（强力写入前置条件以强制执行可恢复性），这是一种新颖的崩溃一致性验证方法，将其需求编码在存储API方法的前置条件中。其次，我们提出了一种新的介质损坏模型，以在任何类型的存储设备上进行可证明的损坏检测。为了展示这些新技术的能力，我们使用它们构建了两个经过验证的存储系统，并采用了两个不同的验证框架。我们使用Verus验证了键值存储CAPYBARAKV，并使用Dafny验证了公证服务器CAPYBARANS。这两个系统均为持久内存而构建，我们选择该目标是因为它在构建有韧性的存储系统时带来了新的挑战。我们开发了新技术来应对这些挑战，包括损坏检测布尔值——一种用于原子校验和更新的新原语。两个系统均在一分钟内完成验证，而CAPYBARAKV的性能与类似的未经验证的持久内存键值存储相当。

import_candidates.title: Fast and synchronous crash consistency with metadata write-once file system
import_candidates.abstract: Low-latency persistent memory (PM) encourages file systems to pursue synchronous crash consistency. However, existing crash consistency approaches, such as journaling and log structure file system, incur many small, random, and ordered metadata I/Os, failing to exploit PM I/O potential. We propose a new file system model called metadata write-once file system (WOFS) to achieve fast and synchronous crash consistency. The key idea is to generate specific metadata for each file operation as a checksum-protected package and write it once with a single ordering point. The package is then managed to provide file abstractions through a package translation layer without extra writes. Using an array of techniques to generate, organize, and recover from packages, WOFS can provide practical, efficient, and reliable file system services. We implement WOLVES as a WOFS prototype in Linux kernel. Experiments using benchmarks and applications suggest that WOLVES can recover from crashes, improve operation throughput, and potentially reach PM I/O bandwidth limits.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 低延迟持久内存（PM）促使文件系统追求同步崩溃一致性。然而，现有的崩溃一致性方法（如日志和日志结构文件系统）会产生大量小型、随机的有序元数据I/O，无法发挥PM的I/O潜力。我们提出了一种名为元数据一次写入文件系统（WOFS）的新文件系统模型，以实现快速同步的崩溃一致性。其关键思想是为每个文件操作生成特定的元数据，作为受校验和保护的数据包，并通过单个排序点一次性写入。随后，该数据包通过一个包翻译层被管理以提供文件抽象，而无需额外写入。利用一系列生成、组织和从数据包中恢复的技术，WOFS可以提供实用、高效且可靠的文件系统服务。我们在Linux内核中实现了WOLVES作为WOFS原型。使用基准测试和应用程序的实验表明，WOLVES可以从崩溃中恢复，提高操作吞吐量，并可能达到PM I/O带宽极限。

import_candidates.title: Decentralized, epoch-based F2FS journaling with fine-grained crash recovery
import_candidates.abstract: F2FS, a log-structured filesystem, has gained widespread adoption in Android systems. However, F2FS relies on coarse-grained checkpointing for crash recovery. When triggered, this mechanism significantly degrades system performance by blocking file writes. Additionally, F2FS's checkpointing approach may not fully recover file data and metadata to a consistent state after a crash. Given these limitations, it is crucial to design a new journaling mechanism for F2FS that provides fine-grained crash recovery. While journaling methods are well-studied for in-place-update filesystems (such as JBD2 for EXT4), directly applying these state-of-the-art techniques to F2FS - an out-of-place-update filesystem - does not yield similar benefits.In this paper, we propose a novel journaling technique, called F2FSJ, for F2FS with ordered journal mode. Catering to the out-of-place update features of F2FS, F2FSJ incorporate several innovative designs. First, in F2FSJ, only metadata changes are journaled and committed after data flushing, by which I/O and storage overheads can be mitigated. Second, we propose a decentralized journal design by embedding journal logs into inodes, which significantly reduces lock contention and interference when recording metadata changes. Third, we propose an epoch-based approach with a novel data/controlplane decoupling mechanism, which eliminates waiting times during journal period transfers. Finally, for journal apply, we propose a fast-forward-to-latest approach to consolidate multiple small updates into one update for reducing small writes. We have implemented a fully functional prototype of F2FSJ and conducted extensive experiments. Our experimental results demonstrate that F2FSJ can effectively reduce the checkpointing time by up to 4.9x and reduce the latency by up to 35\% compared with F2FS. F2FSJ is open-sourced for public access.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: F2FS作为一种日志结构化文件系统，已在Android系统中得到广泛应用。然而，F2FS依赖粗粒度的检查点机制进行崩溃恢复。该机制被触发时会阻塞文件写入，从而显著降低系统性能。此外，F2FS的检查点方法在崩溃后可能无法将文件数据和元数据完全恢复至一致状态。鉴于这些限制，为F2FS设计一种提供细粒度崩溃恢复的新日志机制至关重要。尽管针对原地更新文件系统（如EXT4的JBD2）的日志方法已有深入研究，但将这些先进技术直接应用于F2FS——一种非原地更新文件系统——并不能带来类似的收益。在本文中，我们为F2FS提出了一种新的日志技术F2FSJ，采用顺序日志模式。针对F2FS非原地更新的特性，F2FSJ融入了多项创新设计。首先，F2FSJ仅记录元数据变更并在数据刷新后提交，从而减轻I/O和存储开销。其次，我们提出了一种去中心化日志设计，通过将日志嵌入inode，显著减少了记录元数据变更时的锁竞争和干扰。第三，我们提出了一种基于时代的方法，并引入新颖的数据/控制平面解耦机制，消除了时代切换期间的等待时间。最后，对于日志应用，我们提出了一种快速前滚至最新状态的方法，将多个小更新合并为一次更新以减少小写操作。我们已实现F2FSJ的完整功能原型并进行了大量实验。实验结果表明，与F2FS相比，F2FSJ能有效将检查点时间最多减少4.9倍，并将延迟最多降低35%。F2FSJ已开源供公众使用。

import_candidates.title: Okapi: decoupling data striping and redundancy grouping in cluster file systems
import_candidates.abstract: The Okapi cluster file system decouples how data is spread across disks (data striping) for IO efficiency from how data is erasure coded together (redundancy grouping) for durability. Existing systems couple these two mechanisms' configurations, inducing significant inefficiencies. Decoupling allows grouping to be configured based on reliability and space efficiency goals, while simultaneously allowing striping to be configured based on performance goals. Decoupling also allows redundancy scheme changes from one EC scheme to another (e.g., to react to data temperature or disk failure rate changes) to occur without having to re-write data. Evaluation of an Okapi prototype shows that decoupling can be accomplished with <1\% increase in metadata size and file manager memory, and minimal file creation and degraded read resource increase. Experiments demonstrate that decoupling can improve read throughput by 80\% and reduce seeks per second by up to 70\%, without yielding any data reliability, and reduce the overhead of redundancy transitions by up to 70\%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Okapi集群文件系统将数据在磁盘上的分布方式（数据条带化，以提高IO效率）与数据一起进行纠删码编码的方式（冗余分组，以实现持久性）解耦。现有系统将这两种机制的配置耦合在一起，导致显著的效率低下。解耦允许根据可靠性和空间效率目标来配置分组，同时允许根据性能目标来配置条带化。解耦还允许冗余方案从一种纠删码方案更改为另一种（例如，为了响应数据温度或磁盘故障率的变化），而无需重写数据。对Okapi原型的评估表明，解耦可以实现元数据大小和文件管理器内存增加不足1%，文件创建和降级读资源增加最小。实验表明，解耦可以将读吞吐量提高80%，并将每秒寻道次数减少最多70%，而不会牺牲任何数据可靠性，并且可以将冗余转换的开销减少最多70%。

import_candidates.title: Compass: encrypted semantic search with high accuracy
import_candidates.abstract: We present Compass, a semantic search system for encrypted data that achieves high accuracy, matching state-of-the-art plaintext search quality, while ensuring the privacy of data, queries, and results, even if the server is compromised. Compass contributes a novel way to traverse a state-of-the-art graph-based semantic search index and a white-box co-design with Oblivious RAM, a cryptographic primitive that hides access patterns, to enable efficient search over encrypted embeddings. With our techniques, Directional Neighbor Filtering, Speculative Neighbor Prefetch, and Graph-Traversal Tailored ORAM, Compass achieves user-perceived latencies within or around a second and is orders of magnitude faster than baselines under various network conditions.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了Compass，一个针对加密数据的语义搜索系统，实现了与最先进明文搜索相当的高精度，同时即使在服务器被攻破的情况下也能保证数据、查询和结果的隐私。Compass提出了一种新颖的方式，遍历最先进的基于图的语义搜索索引，并与Oblivious RAM（一种隐藏访问模式的密码学原语）进行白盒协同设计，以支持对加密嵌入的高效搜索。借助我们的定向邻居过滤、推测性邻居预取和图遍历定制ORAM技术，Compass实现了约1秒以内或1秒左右的用户感知延迟，并在各种网络条件下比基线方法快数个数量级。

import_candidates.title: Weave: efficient and expressive oblivious analytics at scale
import_candidates.abstract: Many distributed analytics applications offloaded to the cloud operate on sensitive data. Even when the computations for such analytics workloads are confined to trusted hardware enclaves, and all stored data and network communications are encrypted, several studies have shown that they are still vulnerable to access pattern attacks. Prior efforts to prevent access pattern leakage often incur network and compute overheads that are logarithmic in dataset size while also limiting the functionality of supported analytics jobs.We present Weave, an efficient, expressive, and secure analytics platform that scales to large datasets. Weave employs a combination of noise injection and hardware memory isolation to reduce the network and compute overheads for oblivious analytics to a constant factor. Weave also employs several optimizations and extensions that exploit dataset and workload-specific properties to ensure performance at scale without compromising functionality. Weave reduces the end-to-end execution time for a wide range of analytics jobs on large real-world datasets by 4-10\texttimes{} compared to prior state-of-the-art while providing strong obliviousness guarantees.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 许多卸载到云端的分布式分析应用程序处理敏感数据。即使此类分析工作负载的计算被限制在可信硬件飞地内，并且所有存储的数据和网络通信都经过加密，多项研究表明它们仍容易受到访问模式攻击。先前防止访问模式泄漏的努力通常在网络和计算开销上以数据集大小的对数为量级，同时也限制了所支持分析工作的功能。我们提出了Weave，一个高效、富有表现力且安全的分析平台，可扩展到大型数据集。Weave结合噪声注入和硬件内存隔离，将不经意分析的网络和计算开销降低到常数因子。Weave还采用了一些利用数据集和工作负载特定属性的优化和扩展，以确保在大规模下不牺牲功能的性能。与现有最先进技术相比，Weave在大型真实世界数据集上的各类分析工作的端到端执行时间减少了4-10倍，同时提供了强不经意性保证。

import_candidates.title: Paralegal: practical static analysis for privacy bugs
import_candidates.abstract: Finding privacy bugs in software today usually requires onerous manual audits. Code analysis tools could help, but existing tools aren't sufficiently practical and ergonomic to be used.Paralegal is a static analysis tool to find privacy bugs in Rust programs. Key to Paralegal's practicality is its distribution of work between the program analyzer, privacy engineers, and application developers. Privacy engineers express a high-level privacy policy over markers, which application developers then apply to source code entities. Paralegal extracts a Program Dependence Graph (PDG) from the program, leveraging Rust's ownership type system to model the behavior of library code. Paralegal augments the PDG with the developers' markers and checks privacy policies against the marked PDG.In an evaluation on eight real-world applications, Paralegal found real privacy bugs, including two previously unknown ones. Paralegal supports a broader range of policies than information flow control (IFC) and CodeQL, a widely-used code analysis engine. Paralegal is fast enough to deploy interactively, and its markers are easy to maintain as code evolves.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 如今发现软件中的隐私缺陷通常需要繁重的人工审计。代码分析工具可以提供帮助，但现有工具还不够实用和人性化。Paralegal是一个用于在Rust程序中查找隐私缺陷的静态分析工具。Paralegal实用性的关键在于它在程序分析器、隐私工程师和应用程序开发人员之间分配工作。隐私工程师在标记上表达高层隐私策略，应用程序开发人员随后将这些标记应用于源代码实体。Paralegal从程序中提取程序依赖图（PDG），利用Rust的所有权类型系统来建模库代码的行为。Paralegal为PDG增加开发人员的标记，并对照标记后的PDG检查隐私策略。在对八个真实应用的评估中，Paralegal发现了真实的隐私缺陷，包括两个此前未知的缺陷。Paralegal支持比信息流控制（IFC）和广泛使用的代码分析引擎CodeQL更广泛的策略。Paralegal的速度足够快，可交互部署，并且其标记在代码演进过程中易于维护。

import_candidates.title: MettEagle: costs and benefits of implementing containers on microkernels
import_candidates.abstract: Today, many applications are hosted by cloud providers. In order to isolate the workloads of different clients, cloud enterprises mostly rely on containers rather than standard processes, since the latter are able to exercise a lot of ambient authority. Containers counter this deficiency by sandboxing processes. To this end, they use dedicated security mechanisms such as seccomp-bpf. However, these mechanisms add complexity to the kernel and increase its attack surface, thus prompting new security challenges.Processes in microkernel-based systems do not have ambient authority. Thus, they do not require additional security mechanisms to build sandboxes. In this paper, we try to answer the question whether a microkernel-based OS architecture enables a leaner and more secure container infrastructure. Based on a CVE analysis, we show that the conceptual simplicity of containers on microkernels results in a better security posture than that typically found on monolithic systems.We furthermore demonstrate the practical feasibility of implementing containers on state-of-the-art microkernels by building MettEagle, a prototype container service running on L4Re. We found that applications running in containers on L4Re expose performance characteristics comparable to that of containers on Linux for both synthetic and real-world benchmarks. In some cases, the container implementation of L4Re even outperforms Linux, accelerating container startup latency and improving network performance.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 如今，许多应用由云提供商托管。为了隔离不同客户端的工作负载，云企业主要依赖容器而非标准进程，因为标准进程能够行使大量环境权限。容器通过沙箱化进程来弥补这一缺陷。为此，它们使用诸如seccomp-bpf等专用安全机制。然而，这些机制增加了内核的复杂性并扩大了其攻击面，从而带来了新的安全挑战。在基于微内核的系统中，进程没有环境权限。因此，它们不需要额外的安全机制来构建沙箱。在本文中，我们试图回答基于微内核的操作系统架构能否实现更精简、更安全的容器基础设施这一问题。基于CVE分析，我们表明微内核上容器的概念简单性使其安全态势优于典型的单体系统。此外，我们通过构建MettEagle（一个运行在L4Re上的原型容器服务）证明了在现代微内核上实现容器的实际可行性。我们发现，在L4Re容器中运行的应用程序，在合成基准和真实世界基准测试中均表现出与Linux容器相当的性能特征。在某些情况下，L4Re的容器实现甚至优于Linux，缩短了容器启动延迟并改善了网络性能。

import_candidates.title: Strata: Hierarchical Context Caching for Long Context Language Model Serving
import_candidates.abstract:
Long-context large language models (LLMs) enable applications that reason over hundreds of thousands to millions of tokens, but serving these workloads efficiently is challenging. Modern systems cache key-value (KV) states and rely on hierarchical context caching across GPU HBM, CPU memory, and SSDs. We show that naïve designs often become I/O-bound: fragmented KV layouts lead to small transfers that underutilize bandwidth, cache loading stalls prefill, and schedulers that ignore cache-loading latency and delay hits (concurrent requests for the same context during a cache miss) suffer severe throughput degradation.
We present Strata, a hierarchical context caching framework for long-context LLM serving. Strata introduces a GPU-assisted I/O mechanism that decouples GPU and host layouts to enable efficient large transfers, and a cache-aware scheduler that mitigates delay hits, balances batches to hide cache-loading latency, and opportunistically overlaps complementary work. Implemented as part of SGLang and deployed in production, Strata improves throughput by up to 5× over vLLM-LMCache and 3.75× over NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, without hurting short-context performance.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 长上下文大语言模型（LLM）催生了能够对数十万至数百万个标记进行推理的应用，但高效服务这些工作负载颇具挑战。现代系统会缓存键值（KV）状态，并依赖于跨GPU HBM、CPU内存和SSD的分层上下文缓存。我们发现，朴素的设计往往容易受到I/O瓶颈的制约：碎片化的KV布局导致小规模传输，使带宽利用不足；缓存加载会阻塞预填充阶段；而忽略缓存加载延迟的调度器会因命中延迟（在缓存未命中期间对相同上下文的并发请求）而遭受严重的吞吐量下降。我们提出了Strata，一个面向长上下文LLM服务的分层上下文缓存框架。Strata引入了GPU辅助的I/O机制，将GPU和主机布局解耦，以实现高效的大规模传输，并采用一个缓存感知调度器，用于缓解命中延迟、平衡批次以隐藏缓存加载延迟，并机会式地重叠互补工作。作为SGLang的一部分实现并部署于生产环境，Strata在吞吐量上最高比vLLM-LMCache提升5倍，比NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM提升3.75倍，且不影响短上下文性能。

import_candidates.title: ECHO: Efficient KV Cache Offloading with Lossless Prefetching for Serving Native Sparse Attention LLMs
import_candidates.abstract: Native sparse attention has emerged as a promising approach for efficient long-context LLM inference without compromising accuracy. While it significantly reduces the attention computation and KV cache access costs, the KV cache size exhibits steeper linear growth with the context length. As a result, GPU HBM capacity becomes the bottleneck, limiting the concurrency of long-context requests and leading to poor hardware utilization and low generation throughput. We introduce ECHO, a serving system designed for native sparse-attention LLMs that employs KV cache offloading to overcome GPU HBM capacity limits. ECHO incorporates a graph-friendly cache manager that enables efficient dynamic KV cache eviction and recall entirely within GPU graphs, minimizing management overhead. Furthermore, by exploiting the numerical predictability of index scores and the sequential processing of queries, ECHO enables lossless intra-query prefetching for decoding and inter-query prefetching for prefill. By applying a fully pipelined fused GPU kernel, ECHO overlaps the recall overhead with indexer computation. Experiments show that ECHO delivers up to 2.1× higher generation throughput than state-of-the-art systems such as SGLang and vLLM under long-context workloads, while maintaining comparable latency under light load.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 原生稀疏注意力已成为一种在不损失准确性的前提下实现高效长上下文LLM推理的有前景方法。虽然它显著降低了注意力计算和KV缓存访问成本，但KV缓存大小随上下文长度呈更陡峭的线性增长。因此，GPU HBM容量成为瓶颈，限制了长上下文请求的并发度，导致硬件利用率低下和生成吞吐量较低。我们提出了ECHO，一种专为原生稀疏注意力LLM设计的服务系统，采用KV缓存卸载来突破GPU HBM容量限制。ECHO结合了图友好的缓存管理器，能够在GPU图内高效实现动态KV缓存驱逐和召回，最大程度减少管理开销。此外，通过利用索引分数的数值可预测性和查询的序列化处理，ECHO实现了解码阶段的无损查询内预取和预填充阶段的查询间预取。通过应用完全流水线化的融合GPU内核，ECHO将召回开销与索引器计算重叠。实验表明，在长上下文工作负载下，与SGLang和vLLM等最先进系统相比，ECHO的生成吞吐量最高可提升2.1倍，同时在轻负载下保持相当的延迟。

import_candidates.title: No Buffer, No Bottleneck: Efficient Zero-Copy KV Cache Offloading for Long-Context LLMs
import_candidates.abstract: Long-context large language models (LLMs) store computed attention key and value (KV) matrices from previous decoding steps to avoid full-sequence recomputation. While this reuse reduces computation, the KV cache grows linearly with sequence length, exerting significant pressure on GPU memory capacity. Existing offloading stores KV blocks in CPU memory but requires extra GPU buffers, wasting GPU memory and doubling CPU–GPU transfers, which creates capacity and bandwidth bottlenecks. We present DirectKV, to our knowledge, the first zero-copy KV cache offloading system for modern heterogeneous CPU–GPU platforms such as NVIDIA GH200/GB200 with high-bandwidth NVLink-C2C interconnects. By leveraging NVLink-C2C instead of PCIe, DirectKV makes CPU memory a practical extension of GPU KV-cache capacity during long-context inference. DirectKV eliminates the GPU staging buffer (no buffer) by enabling GPU kernels to directly access CPU-resident KV cache, and substantially reduces the CPU– GPU data-movement bottleneck (no bottleneck) through CPU-memory-aware CUDA kernels tailored for heterogeneous CPU–GPU platforms. It further fuses KV generation with attention computation into a single CUDA kernel and employs warp-level pipelining to overlap KV fetching, computation, and write-back, thereby hiding stalls caused by CPU memory access. On GH200, DirectKV reduces CPU–GPU transfer volume by up to 50%, cuts GPU memory usage by 43%, and improves end-to-end performance by up to 1.2× compared to existing solutions.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 长上下文大语言模型(LLM)存储先前解码步骤中计算得到的注意力键和值(KV)矩阵，以避免全序列重新计算。虽然这种复用减少了计算量，但KV缓存随序列长度线性增长，给GPU内存容量带来了显著压力。现有的卸载方法将KV块存储在CPU内存中，但需要额外的GPU缓冲区，浪费了GPU内存并使CPU-GPU传输加倍，从而造成容量和带宽瓶颈。我们提出了DirectKV，据我们所知，这是首个针对现代异构CPU-GPU平台(如NVIDIA GH200/GB200)上高带宽NVLink-C2C互连的零拷贝KV缓存卸载系统。通过利用NVLink-C2C而非PCIe，DirectKV使CPU内存成为长上下文推理期间GPU KV缓存容量的实用扩展。DirectKV通过让GPU内核直接访问驻留在CPU上的KV缓存，消除了GPU暂存缓冲区(无缓冲)，并通过专为异构CPU-GPU平台定制的CPU内存感知CUDA内核显著减少了CPU-GPU数据移动瓶颈(无瓶颈)。它还将KV生成与注意力计算融合到单个CUDA内核中，并采用warp级流水线来重叠KV获取、计算和写回，从而隐藏CPU内存访问引起的停顿。在GH200上，与现有解决方案相比，DirectKV将CPU-GPU传输量减少了高达50%，将GPU内存使用量减少了43%，并将端到端性能提升了高达1.2倍。

import_candidates.title: Simple Is Better: Multiplication May Be All You Need for LLM Request Scheduling
import_candidates.abstract:
High-quality LLM request scheduling requires meeting two key objectives: ensuring the routed instance has KV$ to accelerate request execution, and ensuring that the workload is balanced across instances. Achieving both objectives is challenging because pursuing one may compromise the other. Current approaches use various combinators (e.g., linear combinations) to compute a scheduling score that combines indicators for the two objectives. These approaches are complex: they either require significant workload-specific hyperparameter tuning or model-hardware-aware simulator development, yet could still lead to suboptimal performance.
In this paper, we show that using a simple multiplication of two carefully chosen indicators—one KV$-aware (new prefill tokens if routed to an instance) and one load-balancing-aware (current batch size of the instance)—as the scheduling score (LMetric) can achieve both objectives simultaneously without any hyperparameter tuning. The key idea is that the simply multiplied score considers both objectives in a manner similar to a linear combination, but the original hyperparameters cancel out during comparison, so no tuning is needed to find the best parameters. The two indicators are chosen based on our analysis of LLM characteristics. Our extensive experiments show that this simple approach can reduce TTFT by 92% and 39%, and TPOT by 24% and 51%, compared to vLLM-v1 and an in-production scheduler on real-world workloads covering chatbots and coding agents. We also derive the mathematical conditions under which multiplication may fail, and find that such conditions are extremely rare in practice and can be detected (and mitigated) beforehand.
LMetric has been deployed in production and canary release confirms its effectiveness.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 高质量的LLM请求调度需要满足两个关键目标：确保路由到的实例有KV缓存以加速请求执行，以及确保工作负载在实例之间平衡。实现这两个目标具有挑战性，因为追求一个目标可能会损害另一个目标。当前方法使用各种组合器（例如线性组合）来计算调度分数，以结合两个目标的指标。这些方法很复杂：它们要么需要大量特定于工作负载的超参数调整，要么需要开发模型-硬件感知的模拟器，但仍可能导致次优性能。在本文中，我们表明使用两个精心选择的指标的简单乘法——一个与KV缓存相关（如果路由到某个实例则产生新的预填充令牌）和一个与负载平衡相关（实例的当前批次大小）——作为调度分数（LMetric），可以同时实现两个目标而无需任何超参数调整。关键思想是，简单相乘的分数类似于线性组合的方式同时考虑两个目标，但原始超参数在比较过程中会抵消，因此无需调整即可找到最佳参数。这两个指标是基于我们对LLM特征的分析选择的。我们的大量实验表明，在覆盖聊天机器人和编码代理的真实工作负载上，与vLLM-v1和实际生产调度器相比，这种简单方法可以分别将TTFT降低92%和39%，将TPOT降低24%和51%。我们还推导了乘法可能失败的数学条件，并发现这些条件在实践中极为罕见，并且可以提前检测（并缓解）。LMetric已部署到生产中，金丝雀发布确认了其有效性。

import_candidates.title: Prism: Cost-Efficient Multi-LLM Serving via GPU Memory Ballooning
import_candidates.abstract: Inference providers must maintain availability for many LLMs, including low-volume but essential models, making resource efficiency increasingly important as token prices fall. Analysis of production traces reveals a dynamic bursty-group pattern in which sets of models become active together and shift over time; existing space- and time-sharing approaches lack principled mechanisms to adapt to this variability, forcing trade-offs between SLO adherence and efficiency. We observe that elastic memory allocation can unify spatial and temporal sharing. Based on this insight, we have developed Prism, a memory-centric LLM co-serving framework that applies memory ballooning to reclaim memory across models and support both forms of sharing under a single scheme. Prism’s balloon driver, referred to as kvcached, has been open-sourced at https://github.com/ovg-project/kvcached, and deployed in production environments across 10K+ GPUs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 推理提供商必须为许多LLM维持可用性，包括低流量但至关重要的模型，随着token价格下降，资源效率变得越来越重要。对生产轨迹的分析揭示了一种动态突发组模式，其中多组模型同时变为活跃状态并随时间转移；现有的空间和时间共享方法缺乏适应这种可变性的原则性机制，从而在SLO达标与效率之间被迫做出权衡。我们观察到弹性内存分配可以统一空间和时间共享。基于这一洞察，我们开发了Prism，一个以内存为中心的LLM协同服务框架，应用内存气球技术跨模型回收内存，并在单一方案下支持两种共享形式。Prism的气球驱动程序称为kvcached，已在https://github.com/ovg-project/kvcached开源，并部署在10K+ GPU的生产环境中。

import_candidates.title: Break On Through to the Other Side: Pooling Memory Elastically with RamRyder
import_candidates.abstract: Cloud vendors offer diverse infrastructure services by flexibly allocating resources, such as compute, storage, and networking, across virtual machines. However, memory allocation is still less flexible: the vendors allocate memory capacity in a fixed ratio to virtual CPUs and provide no mechanism for allocating memory bandwidth. Recent data show that this can lead to underutilization of both capacity and bandwidth when an application’s demands diverge or change over time. To address these challenges, we propose RamRyder, a software-defined elastic memory system for cloud virtual machines that allows the system to allocate memory bandwidth and capacity (mostly) independently. RamRyder controls the mapping between memory pages in the guest OS and the underlying memory channels, providing performance isolation between virtual machines and allowing dynamic changes to bandwidth and capacity allocation. RamRyder improves average capacity and bandwidth utilization by 28.6% and 43.2%, respectively, across the cluster while delivering performance comparable to the best case with exclusive access.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 云供应商通过跨虚拟机灵活分配计算、存储和网络等资源来提供多样化的基础设施服务。然而，内存分配仍然不够灵活：供应商以固定比例将内存容量分配给虚拟CPU，并且没有提供分配内存带宽的机制。近期数据表明，当应用程序的需求不同或随时间变化时，这可能导致容量和带宽利用率不足。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了RamRyder，一种面向云虚拟机的软件定义弹性内存系统，它允许系统（基本独立地）分配内存带宽和容量。RamRyder控制客户操作系统中内存页与底层内存通道之间的映射，在虚拟机之间提供性能隔离，并允许动态更改带宽和容量分配。RamRyder在集群中的平均容量和带宽利用率分别提高了28.6%和43.2%，同时提供了与独占访问最佳情况相当的性能。

import_candidates.title: MAC: Metadata Acceleration for Sustainable Performance in Big-Data Systems with CXL DRAM
import_candidates.abstract: Compute Express Link (CXL) DRAM has emerged as a promising solution to address the capacity constraints of conventional systems using DDR DRAM. By decoupling memory expansion from the DDR interface generation imposed by the host CPU’s memory controller, CXL DRAM allows cost-effective scaling of system memory capacity. However, as memory capacity grows, memory management metadata can become too large to fit entirely in DDR DRAM, necessitating that part or all of it to be placed in CXL DRAM. Moreover, since the OS views CXL DRAM as a CPU-less remote node, the host CPU manages metadata in CXL DRAM, thereby increasing metadata management latency. We find that this overhead significantly reduces memory reclamation efficiency and causes considerable increases in the tail latency of latency-sensitive applications. In this work, we investigate the performance impact of metadata placement in CXL DRAM and propose MAC, a near-memory processing (NMP) solution that accelerates memory-intensive components of metadata management directly within CXL DRAM to improve memory reclamation efficiency. Compared to conventional OS-based memory reclamation, MAC reduces application tail latency by up to 98%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Compute Express Link（CXL）DRAM已成为解决传统DDR DRAM系统容量限制的有前景方案。通过将内存扩展与主机CPU内存控制器所依赖的DDR接口代际解耦，CXL DRAM能够以经济高效的方式扩展系统内存容量。然而，随着内存容量增长，内存管理元数据可能变得过大而无法完全容纳在DDR DRAM中，从而需要将部分或全部元数据放置在CXL DRAM中。此外，由于操作系统将CXL DRAM视为无CPU的远程节点，主机CPU管理CXL DRAM中的元数据，从而增加了元数据管理延迟。我们发现这种开销显著降低了内存回收效率，并导致延迟敏感应用的尾延迟大幅增加。在本工作中，我们研究了元数据放置在CXL DRAM中的性能影响，并提出MAC——一种近内存处理（NMP）解决方案，直接在CXL DRAM中加速内存管理中的内存密集型组件，以提高内存回收效率。与传统的基于操作系统的内存回收相比，MAC最高可将应用尾延迟降低98%。

import_candidates.title: Finding NEMO: Nimble and Expressive Memory Observability
import_candidates.abstract:
Modern datacenter servers increasingly deploy heterogeneous, multi-tier memory hierarchies. For these new architectures, OSes depend on measurements of memory usage to make intelligent placement and control decisions. However, existing hardware and software mechanisms for tracking memory usage on these systems require difficult tradeoffs between coverage, timeliness, granularity, flexibility, and overhead.
We present NEMO, a nimble and expressive hardware memory telemetry engine for server memory controllers (MCs) that gives OS subsystems policy-specific views of memory behavior. NEMO enables flexible telemetry rules that filter memory operations, map accesses to counters, and apply simple updates to per-counter state. We prototype NEMO on an FPGA-based CXL-attached memory expander. Evaluating three diverse use cases, we show that NEMO provides higher-fidelity signals at substantially lower CPU overhead across a range of state-of-the-art memory management systems: it speeds up HeMem’s reaction to hot-set changes by 5×, accelerates THP splitting in MEMTIS by 10.4×, and detects noisy neighbors in Linux with 350× lower overhead. These telemetry improvements yield up to 1.7× higher throughput and 23% lower latency across key-value stores and databases.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代数据中心服务器日益部署异构、多层级的内存层次结构。对于这些新架构，操作系统依赖内存使用情况的测量来做出智能的放置和控制决策。然而，现有的硬件和软件跟踪机制在这些系统上往往需要在覆盖范围、及时性、粒度、灵活性和开销之间进行艰难的权衡。我们提出了NEMO，一种用于服务器内存控制器（MC）的灵活且富有表现力的硬件内存遥测引擎，它为操作系统子系统提供策略特定的内存行为视图。NEMO支持灵活的遥测规则，这些规则可以过滤内存操作、将访问映射到计数器，并对每个计数器状态应用简单的更新。我们在基于FPGA的CXL连接内存扩展器上对NEMO进行了原型验证。通过评估三种不同的用例，我们表明NEMO在一系列最先进的内存管理系统中以显著更低的CPU开销提供了更高保真度的信号：它将HeMem对热集变化的反应速度提高了5倍，将MEMTIS中的THP拆分加速了10.4倍，并以低350倍的开销在Linux中检测噪声邻居。这些遥测改进使键值存储和数据库的吞吐量最高提升1.7倍，延迟最低降低23%。

import_candidates.title: OBASE: Object-Based Address-Space Engineering to Improve Memory Tiering
import_candidates.abstract: Hardware and OS mechanisms for memory tiering are widely deployed, yet datacenters still overprovision DRAM. The root cause is hotness fragmentation: allocators place objects by size rather than access pattern, so hot and cold objects become interleaved within the same pages. A single hot object marks its page as active, trapping surrounding cold data in expensive DRAM. Our analysis of Google datacenter workloads shows that up to 97% of the bytes in active pages are cold and unreclaimable. We propose address-space engineering: dynamically reorganizing virtual memory so that hot objects cluster into uniformly hot pages and cold objects into uniformly cold pages. We present OBASE, a compiler-runtime system for unmanaged languages that serves as an object-aware frontend for page-aware OS backends. OBASE tracks accesses via lightweight pointer instrumentation and migrates objects at runtime using a lock-free protocol that is safe under concurrency. By reorganizing the address space, OBASE enables unmodified backends (kswapd, TMO, TPP, Memtis) to tier memory effectively. Across ten concurrent data structures, six backends, and production traces from Meta and Twitter, OBASE improves page utilization by 2–4× and reduces memory footprint by up to 70%, with only 2–5% overhead.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 硬件和操作系统层面的内存分层机制已被广泛部署，但数据中心仍然过度配置DRAM。根本原因在于热度碎片化：分配器按大小而非访问模式放置对象，导致热对象和冷对象交错在同一页面内。一个热对象就会将其所在页面标记为活跃，从而使周围的冷数据困在昂贵的DRAM中。我们对谷歌数据中心工作负载的分析显示，活跃页面中高达97%的字节是冷的且无法回收。我们提出地址空间工程：动态重组虚拟内存，使热对象聚集成均匀的热页面，冷对象聚集成均匀的冷页面。我们提出了OBASE，一个针对非托管语言的编译器-运行时系统，充当面向页面的操作系统后端之前端。OBASE通过轻量级指针插桩来跟踪访问，并使用在并发下安全的无锁协议在运行时迁移对象。通过重组地址空间，OBASE使未经修改的后端（kswapd、TMO、TPP、Memtis）能够有效进行内存分层。在十个并发数据结构、六个后端以及来自Meta和Twitter的生产流量上，OBASE将页面利用率提高了2–4倍，并将内存占用减少高达70%，开销仅为2–5%。

import_candidates.title: MDK: Rethinking the Data Center Memory Reclamation Problem
import_candidates.abstract:
The traditional memory management problem maximizes application performance when constrained by a fixed-size memory. Today’s data centers face a different problem: their goal is to maximize the number of jobs on a server without violating performance Service Level Objectives (SLOs). Since a key constraint for placing additional jobs is memory, data center systems proactively reclaim memory from running jobs to create space for new jobs. This difference fundamentally flips the optimization problem that memory management policies need to address. 
Designing practical policies requires a set of tools: 1) an optimal policy that provides a bound on what any policy can achieve, 2) metrics to compare policies, and 3) efficient techniques for evaluating potential policies. However, we find that foundational tools from the traditional setting, such as the optimal policy OPT, Miss Ratio Curves (MRCs), and efficient ways to generate MRCs, do not apply in this new setting. The data center setting demands a new set of tools.
We present the Memory Designer’s Kit, MDK, a framework for designing and evaluating data center memory management policies. MDK includes an offline provably optimal policy; Memory Performance Curves (MPCs), which show how memory savings vary when constrained by performance; and an efficient technique that is up to 208× faster than simulation for producing MPCs. We demonstrate MDK’s utility by developing three data center policies that improve average memory savings by up to 10% relative to a state-of-the-art policy.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 传统内存管理问题是在内存大小固定的约束下最大化应用程序性能。今天的数据中心面临着一个不同的问题：其目标是在不违反性能服务级别目标(SLO)的情况下最大化服务器上的作业数量。由于放置额外作业的关键约束是内存，数据中心系统会主动从正在运行的作业中回收内存，为新的作业腾出空间。这种差异从根本上颠倒了内存管理策略需要解决的优化问题。设计实用的策略需要一套工具：1）一个最优策略，为任何策略能达成的效果提供界限；2）用于比较策略的指标；3）评估可能策略的高效技术。然而，我们发现传统场景中的基础工具，如最优策略OPT、未命中率曲线(MRC)以及生成MRC的高效方法，并不适用于这个新场景。数据中心场景需要一套新的工具。我们提出了MDK（Memory Designer's Kit），一个用于设计和评估数据中心内存管理策略的框架。MDK包括一个离线可证明最优的策略；内存性能曲线(MPC)，它展示了在性能约束下内存节省如何变化；以及一种高效技术，其生成MPC的速度比模拟快最多208倍。我们通过开发三种数据中心策略来展示MDK的实用性，与最先进的策略相比，平均内存节省最多提升10%。

import_candidates.title: USEC: A User-Requirement-Driven Mandatory Access Control Framework for Operating Systems (Operational Systems)
import_candidates.abstract: Fine-grained access control over kernel resources is essential for containing compromised applications and protecting modern operating systems. However, mainstream mandatory access control (MAC) mechanisms such as SELinux are notoriously hard to configure, incur non-trivial performance overhead, and often break compatibility. In practice, many enterprise Linux deployments disable SELinux by default due to its complexity, configuration burden, and compatibility issues. In this paper, we present USEC, a new kernel access-control framework co-designed with security vendors to make strong MAC practical at scale. USEC introduces: (1) simpler configuration via resource-centric policy templates and semantic resource classes; (2) a demand-driven enforcement path with decision caching that reduces kernel overhead; and (3) binary-compatible LSM interfaces for process lifecycle, file I/O, and socket events that coexist with existing modules for compatibility. We implement USEC as a Linux security extension and evaluate it in terms of configuration simplicity, runtime overhead, and compatibility. Under the same security requirements,USEC policies contain up to 10× fewer lines of policy code than SELinux, while reducing runtime overhead by 3.4%–17.1% relative to SELinux across representative server and desktop workloads. USEC has been adopted by over 210 security vendors, including QiAnXin, 360, and NSFOCUS. As of early 2025, it has been deployed on more than 8,000,000 enterprise endpoints in production. These results demonstrate that USEC can provide strong, configurable kernel protection that is both efficient and widely deployable.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 对内核资源进行细粒度访问控制对于遏制被攻陷应用和保护现代操作系统至关重要。然而，SELinux等主流强制访问控制（MAC）机制以难以配置而著称，会带来不可忽视的性能开销，并且经常破坏兼容性。在实践中，许多企业Linux部署默认禁用SELinux，原因在于其复杂性、配置负担和兼容性问题。本文提出了USEC，一个与安全厂商共同设计的新型内核访问控制框架，旨在使强大的MAC能够在大规模场景下实际落地。USEC引入了：（1）通过以资源为中心的策略模板和语义化资源类实现更简单的配置；（2）一条需求驱动的强制执行路径，并带有决策缓存以降低内核开销；（3）兼容二进制的LSM接口，涵盖进程生命周期、文件I/O和套接字事件，并与现有模块共存以保持兼容性。我们将USEC实现为一个Linux安全扩展，并从配置简洁性、运行时开销和兼容性三个方面进行评估。在相同安全需求下，USEC策略的策略代码行数比SELinux最多少10倍，同时在具有代表性的服务器和桌面工作负载上，运行时开销比SELinux降低3.4%–17.1%。USEC已被包括奇安信、360和绿盟科技在内的210多家安全厂商采用。截至2025年初，它已部署在生产环境中的800多万个企业端点。这些结果表明，USEC能够提供强大、可配置的内核保护，且兼具高效性和广泛可部署性。

import_candidates.title: Mohabi: Disaggregating and Sandboxing the Firefox JavaScript Engine
import_candidates.abstract:
We present Mohabi—a modern Firefox browser with a securely sandboxed JavaScript engine. Mohabi leverages software-based fault isolation (SFI) to ensure JavaScript engine bugs cannot affect the rest of the browser. To achieve this, we disaggregated the JavaScript engine (SpiderMonkey) from the rest of the browser, and developed techniques that leverage the type system and automatic code generation to make this complex transformation—that spans numerous data structures and deeply intertwined control flow across tens of thousands of functions—safe and tractable with reasonable engineering effort.
We then sandboxed SpiderMonkey using an optimized SFI toolchain we developed to meet the unique challenges of JavaScript engines, such as efficient support for large memory footprints. Mohabi only incurs modest overheads on common benchmarks—24.82% on JetStream and 24.43% on Speedometer. Mohabi is the most ambitious case study in retrofitting in-process sandboxing in a large system to date, and our x86-64 SFI toolchain is the fastest to date, imposing overheads between 5.9%–6.6% in SPEC 2017.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了Mohabi——一个带有安全沙箱化JavaScript引擎的现代Firefox浏览器。Mohabi利用基于软件的故障隔离（SFI）来确保JavaScript引擎的缺陷不会影响浏览器的其他部分。为实现这一目标，我们将JavaScript引擎（SpiderMonkey）与浏览器其他部分拆分，并开发了利用类型系统和自动代码生成的技术，使这一涉及众多数据结构和跨越数万函数深度交织的控制流的复杂转换变得安全可信且工程工作量合理。随后，我们使用自研的优化SFI工具链对SpiderMonkey进行了沙箱化，以应对JavaScript引擎的独特挑战，例如对大内存足迹的高效支持。Mohabi在常见基准上仅带来适度开销——JetStream为24.82%，Speedometer为24.43%。Mohabi是迄今为止在大型系统中进行就地沙箱化改造的最雄心勃勃的案例研究，我们的x86-64 SFI工具链也是迄今最快的，在SPEC 2017中开销介于5.9%–6.6%之间。

import_candidates.title: Ichnaea: A Framework for Precise Tracking of Memory Objects
import_candidates.abstract:
Tracing memory objects (who accessed what object and when) is often important for understanding the runtime behavior of modern software. This type of rich per-access metadata can aid in debugging, tracing, forensics and other tasks. Collecting this information is non-trivial since it will either be incomplete or requires heavy instrumentation and/or hardware support and likely adds significant runtime overheads (e.g., Intel Pin or Valgrind slow programs down by 10−100x).
We present Ichnaea, a purpose-built, precise and complete framework based on memory protection keys (MPK) that delivers context-rich object events at very low cost to the application. Ichnaea is dormant until one of the objects of interest (ObjOfInterest) is read or written to — at which point it logs any access attempts and changes to the ObjOfInterest along with rich context information ("who is attempting access?", "what changes, if any, are being applied?") before returning control to the application. In general Ichnaea reduces the tracing overheads by 10−60x when compared to the widely used framework Intel Pin, while still capturing precise, per-access information needed to diagnose memory vulnerabilities, performance hot-spots and subtle concurrency errors.

import_candidates.title: Extracting Database Access-Control Policies from Web Applications
import_candidates.abstract:
To safeguard sensitive user data, web developers typically rely on implicit access-control policies, which they implement using access checks and query filters. This ad hoc approach is error-prone as these scattered checks and filters are easy to misplace or misspecify, and the lack of an explicit policy precludes external access-control enforcement. More critically, it is difficult for humans to discern what policy is embedded in application code (i.e., what data the application may access)—an issue that worsens as development teams evolve.
This paper tackles policy extraction: the task of extracting the access-control policy embedded in an application by summarizing its data queries. An extracted policy, once vetted for errors, can stand alone as a specification for the application’s data access, and can be enforced to ensure compliance as code changes over time. We introduce Ote, a policy extractor for Ruby on Rails web applications. Ote uses concolic execution to explore execution paths through the application, generating traces of SQL queries and conditions that trigger them. It then merges and simplifies these traces into a final policy that aligns with the observed behaviors. We applied Ote to three real-world applications and compared extracted policies to handwritten ones, revealing several errors in the latter.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 为了保护敏感的用户数据，Web开发者通常依赖于隐式的访问控制策略，这些策略通过访问检查和查询过滤器来实现。这种临时性的方法容易出错，因为分散的检查和过滤器很容易被放错位置或错误指定，并且缺乏显式策略会妨碍外部的访问控制执行。更重要的是，人类很难辨别嵌入在应用程序代码中的策略（即应用程序可以访问哪些数据），而随着开发团队的发展，这个问题会更加严重。本文解决了策略提取问题：通过总结应用程序的数据查询来提取嵌入其中的访问控制策略。提取出的策略在审查错误后，可以独立地作为应用程序数据访问的规范，并可在代码随时间变化时强制执行以确保合规。我们介绍了Ote，一个用于Ruby on Rails Web应用程序的策略提取工具。Ote使用concolic执行来探索应用程序的执行路径，生成触发这些路径的SQL查询和条件的踪迹，然后将这些踪迹合并和简化，形成与观察行为一致的最终策略。我们将Ote应用于三个真实世界的应用程序，并将提取出的策略与手写的策略进行比较，发现后者存在多个错误。

import_candidates.title: iLand: An Instruction-Level Dynamic Binary Instrumentation Framework for iOS
import_candidates.abstract:
Dynamic binary instrumentation (DBI) enables monitoring and modification of executing programs and forms the foundation for a range of program analysis and security testing. On iOS, however, no DBI is available for non-jailbroken devices. Existing approaches on other platforms (e.g., Android) rely on JIT compilation, which is prohibited by the iOS sandbox. The limited CPU and memory resources of mobile devices further constrain the practical deployment of DBI.
We propose iLand, a novel instruction-level DBI framework for iOS. Instead of JIT compilation, it translates instructions into predefined micro-operations and interprets using precompiled atomic execution units. To reduce CPU and memory overhead, it employs application-only emulation: only the app’s code is interpreted, while system libraries run natively. We implement iLand as a standard sandboxed iOS app capable of emulating other apps. It preserves the emulated apps’ original functionality and user experience such as dynamic UI rendering, real-time interaction, live video streaming.
Based on this DBI framework, we further implemented an instruction-level dynamic tracing tool and used it to study policy‑violation behaviors on 60 top-ranked App Store apps. We found that 13 (21%) apps are still invoking private APIs, of which 2 invoke APIs explicitly prohibited by Apple. Our analysis further revealed the new and stealthy methods employed by apps to evade Apple’s App Review. In particular, in 15 (25%) of the apps, we observed a new way to collect sensitive information by direct invocation of the SVC instruction.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 动态二进制插桩（DBI）能够监控和修改正在执行的程序，是多种程序分析与安全测试的基础。然而，在iOS上，对于未越狱设备没有可用的DBI框架。其他平台（如Android）的现有方法依赖于JIT编译，而JIT编译被iOS沙盒禁止。移动设备有限的CPU和内存资源进一步限制了DBI的实际部署。我们提出了iLand，一个面向iOS的新型指令级动态二进制插桩框架。它不采用JIT编译，而是将指令翻译为预定义的微操作，并使用预编译的原子执行单元进行解释。为了降低CPU和内存开销，它采用仅应用程序模拟：只有应用程序的代码被解释，而系统库则原生运行。我们将iLand实现为一个标准的沙盒化iOS应用，能够模拟其他应用。它保留了被模拟应用原有的功能和用户体验，如动态UI渲染、实时交互和实时视频流。基于该DBI框架，我们进一步实现了一个指令级动态跟踪工具，并用它研究了60个顶级App Store应用中的违规行为。我们发现13个（21%）应用仍在调用私有API，其中2个调用了苹果明确禁止的API。我们的分析进一步揭示了应用为规避苹果应用审核所采用的新颖且隐蔽的方法。特别是，在15个（25%）应用中，我们观察到一种通过直接调用SVC指令来收集敏感信息的新方式。

import_candidates.title: Tessera: A Holistic Pipeline Parallelism Framework for Trillion-Parameter Heterogeneous MoE Training (Operational Systems)
import_candidates.abstract:
Training trillion-parameter models relies on pipeline parallelism to scale across thousands of accelerators. However, architectures exemplified by the Qwen family are evolving from uniform Transformer blocks into heterogeneous compositions that combine sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) with different attention variants. This heterogeneity breaks the uniformity assumption behind existing pipeline systems: partitions chosen from serial layer costs become imbalanced after communication is overlapped with computation, because different layer combinations hide different fractions of their communication. Furthermore, at the scale of 10K+ GPUs, MoE routing variation adds a runtime source of stalls, creating transient idle slots that static plans cannot anticipate.
We present Tessera, a framework that co-optimizes partitioning and overlap scheduling for heterogeneous pipeline training, and adapts to runtime dynamics. Tessera introduces: (1) an overlap scheduler that synthesizes fine-grained interleavings for each layer combination; (2) an overlap-aware partitioner that uses profiled post-overlap cost to select partitions balanced for parallel execution; and (3) a dynamic bubble optimizer that fills routing-induced idle slots with movable tasks at runtime. Deployed on production clusters for pre-training Qwen3 and Qwen3-Next, Tessera improves throughput by 20%–33% over our production baseline across five workloads at scales from 4,096 to 12,288 GPUs, reaching 39% MFU on a trillion-parameter model. In controlled experiments against Megatron-Core MoE with public recipes, Tessera achieves up to 1.24× higher MFU.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 训练万亿参数模型依赖流水线并行来扩展到数千个加速器。然而，以Qwen系列为代表的架构正在从统一的Transformer模块演变为异构组合，将稀疏混合专家（MoE）与不同的注意力变体相结合。这种异构性打破了现有流水线系统背后的均匀性假设：根据串行层成本选择的分区在通信与计算重叠后会变得不平衡，因为不同的层组合隐藏了其通信的不同比例。此外，在10K+ GPU规模下，MoE路由变化增加了运行时的停顿源，产生了静态计划无法预见的瞬时空闲槽位。我们提出了Tessera，一个针对异构流水线训练协同优化分区和重叠调度，并适应运行时动态的框架。Tessera引入了：(1) 一个重叠调度器，为每种层组合合成细粒度的交错执行；(2) 一个感知重叠的分区器，使用分析后的重叠后成本来选择适用于并行执行均衡的分区；(3) 一个动态气泡优化器，在运行时用可移动任务填充路由导致的空闲槽位。在生产集群上预训练Qwen3和Qwen3-Next时，Tessera在五类工作负载、4096至12288个GPU规模下，相比我们的生产基线将吞吐量提升了20%至33%，在万亿参数模型上达到了39%的MFU。在与采用公开配方的Megatron-Core MoE的对照实验中，Tessera实现了高达1.24倍的MFU提升。

import_candidates.title: Hetu v2: A General and Scalable Deep Learning System with Hierarchical and Heterogeneous Single Program Multiple Data Annotations
import_candidates.abstract:
The Single-Program Multiple-Data (SPMD) paradigm provides a unified abstraction to annotate various parallel dimensions in distributed deep learning (DL) training. With SPMD, users can write training programs from the viewpoint of a single device, and the system will automatically deduce the tensor sharding and communication patterns. However, with the recent development in large-scale DL models, distributed training exhibits spatial and temporal workload heterogeneity, arising from both device disparities (e.g., mixed hardware, failures) and data variations (e.g., uneven sequence lengths). Such heterogeneity violates SPMD’s assumption of symmetric workload partitioning, which restricts its ability to express and optimize heterogeneous parallel strategies effectively. 
To address this, we propose HSPMD within the Hetu v2 system to achieve general and scalable DL training. HSPMD extends SPMD’s declarative annotations to support asymmetric sharding and composes standard communication primitives for hierarchical communication, all while retaining the simplicity of a single-device programming model. HSPMD handles spatial heterogeneity through progressive graph specialization, enabling device-specific execution logic, and addresses temporal heterogeneity via dynamic graph switching. Evaluations on (a) heterogeneous devices, (b) unstable devices, and (c) mixed-length data scenarios show that HSPMD matches or outperforms specialized systems, providing a flexible and efficient solution for modern distributed DL training. Code is available: https://github.com/PKU-DAIR/Hetu.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 单程序多数据（SPMD）范式为分布式深度学习训练中的各种并行维度提供了统一抽象。使用SPMD，用户可以从单个设备的角度编写训练程序，系统将自动推导张量切分和通信模式。然而，随着大规模深度学习模型的最新发展，分布式训练呈现出空间和时间上的工作负载异构性，这既源于设备差异（如混合硬件、故障），也源于数据变化（如不均匀的序列长度）。这种异构性违反了SPMD对对称工作负载划分的假设，从而限制了其有效表达和优化异构并行策略的能力。为解决这一问题，我们在Hetu v2系统中提出了HSPMD，以实现通用且可扩展的深度学习训练。HSPMD扩展了SPMD的声明式注释以支持不对称切分，并组合标准通信原语实现层次化通信，同时保留了单设备编程模型的简洁性。HSPMD通过渐进式图特化处理空间异构性，从而实现设备特定的执行逻辑，并通过动态图切换解决时间异构性。在（a）异构设备、（b）不稳定设备和（c）混合长度数据场景下的评估表明，HSPMD匹配或超越了专门系统，为现代分布式深度学习训练提供了灵活高效的解决方案。代码可在https://github.com/PKU-DAIR/Hetu获取。

import_candidates.title: Syncopate: Efficient Multi-GPU AI Kernels via Automatic Chunk-Centric Compute-Communication Overlap
import_candidates.abstract: Communication has become a first-order bottleneck in large-scale GPU workloads, and existing distributed compilers address it mainly by overlapping whole compute and communication kernels at the stream level. This coarse granularity incurs extra kernel launches, forces device-wide synchronizations at kernel boundaries, and leaves substantial slack when the slowest tile or kernel stretches the communication tail. We present Syncopate, a compiler and runtime that enable automatic fine-grained overlap around a single fused compute kernel. Syncopate introduces a communication chunk abstraction that decouples communication granularity from kernel structure and backend mechanisms, allowing chunk-level plans to be ported from existing distributed compilers, written directly by users, or instantiated from reusable templates. Given a local Triton kernel and a chunk schedule, Syncopate performs transformations to align computation with chunk availability. Implemented as a source-to-source compiler on Triton, Syncopate delivers an average end-to-end speedup of 1.3× and up to 4.7× on multi-GPU workloads. Our code is open-sourced at https://github.com/tie-pilot-qxw/syncopate.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 通信已成为大规模GPU工作负载中的首要瓶颈，现有的分布式编译器主要通过流级重叠整个计算和通信内核来解决这一问题。这种粗粒度会引入额外的内核启动，强制在内核边界进行设备级同步，并且在最慢的块或内核拉长通信尾部时留下大量空档。我们提出了Syncopate，一个编译器和运行时，能够实现围绕单个融合计算内核的自动细粒度重叠。Syncopate引入了通信块抽象，将通信粒度与内核结构和后端机制解耦，使得块级计划可以从现有的分布式编译器中移植、由用户直接编写或从可复用的模板中实例化。给定一个本地Triton内核和一个块调度，Syncopate执行变换以使计算与块可用性对齐。Syncopate作为Triton上的源到源编译器实现，在多GPU工作负载上平均端到端加速1.3倍，最高可达4.7倍。我们的代码已在https://github.com/tie-pilot-qxw/syncopate开源。

import_candidates.title: Teaching the Old Dog New Tricks: Building Efficient Data Pipelines for Large-Scale LLM Pre-Training (Operational Systems)
import_candidates.abstract: Data pipelines play a critical role in the performance of large-scale pre-training jobs running on thousands of GPUs. In this work, we present a comprehensive quantitative analysis of data access patterns from production workloads and reveal three previously underreported bottlenecks. First, cross-datacenter traffic emerges as a major source of latency when evaluating in-training models using remote checkpoints. Second, checkpoint loading during startup phases frequently suffers from I/O contention that delays job initialization. Third, data transformation during loading becomes a significant and CPU-intensive bottleneck for multimodal models. Guided by these findings, we introduce three optimizations: global-namespace-based predictive checkpoint replication, proactive hot-file replication, and offloading data transformation to storage-tier CPU resources. Crucially, we demonstrate that these optimizations are not system-specific but address fundamental architectural mismatches in the LLM era. They are broadly applicable to both legacy and modern storage systems, offering a high-return path to upgrade infrastructure with minimal engineering intrusion. Together, these techniques reduce wasted GPU hours per evaluation from 16,800 to 4,000, shorten checkpoint loading time at each training start by 40.8%, and reduce training stalls caused by dataloading by 63.2%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 数据流水线在运行于数千个GPU上的大规模预训练任务的性能中起着关键作用。在这项工作中，我们对生产工作负载中的数据访问模式进行了全面的定量分析，并揭示了三个此前未被充分报道的瓶颈。首先，当使用远程检查点进行训练中模型评估时，跨数据中心流量成为延迟的主要来源。其次，启动阶段的检查点加载经常遭受I/O争用，从而延迟作业初始化。第三，加载过程中的数据转换成为多模态模型的重大CPU密集型瓶颈。在这些发现的指导下，我们引入了三项优化：基于全局命名空间的预测性检查点复制、主动式热文件复制，以及将数据转换卸载到存储层CPU资源。至关重要的是，我们证明这些优化并非特定于系统，而是解决了LLM时代的基础架构错配问题。它们广泛适用于传统和现代存储系统，提供了一条以最小工程侵入升级基础设施的高回报路径。这些技术合计将每次评估浪费的GPU小时数从16,800减少到4,000，将每次训练启动时的检查点加载时间缩短40.8%，并将由数据加载引起的训练停滞减少63.2%。

import_candidates.title: Cocoon: A System Architecture for Differentially Private Training with Correlated Noises
import_candidates.abstract: Machine learning (ML) models memorize and leak training data, causing serious privacy issues to data owners. Training algorithms with differential privacy (DP) have been gaining attention as a solution. However, these algorithms add noise at each training iteration and degrade accuracy, limiting their real-world adoption. To improve accuracy, a new family of approaches adds carefully designed correlated noises, so that noises cancel out each other across iterations. We performed an extensive characterization study of these new mechanisms and show they incur non-negligible overheads when the model is relatively large or uses large embedding tables compared to the hardware capacity. Motivated by the analysis, we propose Cocoon, a framework for efficient training with correlated noises. Cocoon stores and processes the large noise history across CPU, GPU, and memory extension module, introduces optimizations for sparse embedding tables, and leverages to-be-commercialized near-memory processing (NMP) devices. On a real system with an FPGA-based NMP device prototype, Cocoon improves the performance by 1.23–10.82×.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 机器学习（ML）模型会记忆并泄露训练数据，给数据所有者带来严重的隐私问题。具有差分隐私（DP）的训练算法正作为解决方案受到越来越多的关注。然而，这些算法在每次训练迭代中都会添加噪声，从而导致精度下降，限制了其实际应用。为了提高精度，一系列新方法会添加经过精心设计的相关噪声，使噪声在迭代之间相互抵消。我们对这些新机制进行了广泛的表征研究，并表明当模型相对较大或使用与硬件容量相比更大的嵌入表时，它们会产生不可忽视的开销。受上述分析启发，我们提出了Cocoon——一个用于高效相关噪声训练的系统框架。Cocoon在CPU、GPU和内存扩展模块之间存储和处理庞大的噪声历史，引入针对稀疏嵌入表的优化，并利用即将商业化的近内存处理（NMP）设备。在带有基于FPGA的NMP设备原型的真实系统上，Cocoon将性能提升了1.23–10.82倍。
