import_candidates.title: ValScope: Value-Semantics-Aware Metamorphic Testing for Detecting Logical Bugs in DBMSs
import_candidates.abstract:
Database Management Systems (DBMSs) are crucial for data processing in many large-scale applications. However, detecting logical bugs in DBMSs remains challenging, as defining what constitutes a correct query result is inherently difficult. Metamorphic testing (MT) addresses this issue by checking relations between systematically transformed queries. However, existing MT approaches mainly rely on equivalent or set-semantic relations, and thus fail to detect subtle bugs that preserve the result set while corrupting value semantics, such as faulty aggregation, ordering, or numeric computation.
In this paper, we propose a unified SQL query approximation model that integrates set-semantic and value-semantic reasoning. Beyond result set inclusion or equivalence, our model captures how value-level changes affect query correctness. Based on this model, we develop ValScope, which generates and mutates SQL queries using predefined mutators and performs approximation propagation analysis to reason about global semantic effects. We evaluate ValScope on 6 widely used DBMSs and uncover 67 unique logical bugs, many of which were missed by prior approaches. The results show that ValScope substantially broadens the spectrum of detectable logical bugs beyond existing MT techniques.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 数据库管理系统（DBMS）在许多大规模应用中对于数据处理至关重要。然而，检测DBMS中的逻辑错误仍然具有挑战性，因为定义什么是正确的查询结果本身就很难。蜕变测试（MT）通过检查系统性转换后的查询之间的关系来解决这个问题。然而，现有的MT方法主要依赖于等价或集合语义关系，因此无法检测保留结果集同时破坏值语义的细微错误，例如错误的聚合、排序或数值计算。在本文中，我们提出了一种统一的SQL查询逼近模型，该模型集成了集合语义和值语义推理。除了结果集的包含或等价性之外，我们的模型还捕捉值级变化如何影响查询正确性。基于该模型，我们开发了ValScope，它使用预定义的变异算子生成和变异SQL查询，并执行逼近传播分析以推理全局语义效应。我们在6个广泛使用的DBMS上评估了ValScope，发现了67个独特的逻辑错误，其中许多是先前方法未发现的。结果表明，ValScope在现有MT技术之上显著拓宽了可检测逻辑错误的种类。

import_candidates.title: The Abstention Protocol: RCA for Clos Fabrics (Operational Systems)
import_candidates.abstract:
Root cause analysis (RCA) in large datacenter networks is challenging because telemetry is noisy, partial, and asynchronous. Score-based approaches degrade under these conditions, often yielding unstable or incorrect attributions.
We present CoreSec, a production RCA system that replaces weighted fusion with a PAM-style abstention algebra. Telemetry agents are composed using control flags that yield deterministic decisions and explicit abstention when evidence is ambiguous. CoreSec combines this algebra with topology-aware configurations that capture failure surfaces across Clos fabrics and converge monotonically as evidence accumulates.
Deployed at hyperscale, CoreSec provides stable and explainable RCA behavior across diverse environments without retuning. Our experience shows that structured composition with abstention forms a practical foundation for automated RCA in real-world cloud networks.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在大型数据中心网络中进行根因分析（RCA）具有挑战性，因为遥测数据嘈杂、不完整且异步。基于评分的方法在这些条件下会退化，常常产生不稳定或错误的归因。我们提出了 CoreSec，一个生产级 RCA 系统，它用 PAM 风格的弃权代数取代了加权融合。遥测代理通过控制标志组合，产生确定性决策，并在证据不明确时明确弃权。CoreSec 将该代数与拓扑感知配置相结合，这些配置捕捉了 Clos 网络结构上的故障面，并随着证据积累而单调收敛。在超大规模部署中，CoreSec 无需重新调优即可在各种环境中提供稳定且可解释的 RCA 行为。我们的经验表明，带弃权的结构化组合为真实世界云网络中的自动化 RCA 奠定了实用的基础。

import_candidates.title: When Sampling Lies: Trustworthy Performance Profiling for Flat Workloads with Blink (Operational Systems)
import_candidates.abstract:
Performance optimization of mobile systems is critical for achieving responsive user experiences. However, accurately measuring the effects of such optimizations is challenging. We found that real-world mobile workloads exhibit a flat profile, invoking thousands of short-lived routines that contribute evenly to overall performance with no dominant bottlenecks. Sampling-based profilers such as perf struggle in this setting: skid, shadow effects, and incomplete function coverage can yield systematically incorrect results, not just high variance.
We present Blink, a lightweight instrumentation framework that provides robust coverage for short-lived routines while maintaining low overhead. Blink inserts instrumentation into functions, enabling precise measurements. We show that Blink achieves 99.999% accuracy while incurring 1% overhead. Deployed in a variety of use cases at Huawei, Blink offers a practical and reliable alternative for mobile compiler performance analysis.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 移动系统的性能优化对于实现响应式用户体验至关重要。然而，准确衡量这些优化的效果具有挑战性。我们发现，真实世界的移动工作负载呈现出平坦的轮廓，调用成千上万个短暂例程，它们均匀地贡献整体性能，没有主导性瓶颈。基于采样的分析工具（如perf）在此境况下难以胜任：skid（偏移）、影子效应以及不完整的函数覆盖不仅会导致高方差，还可能产生系统性错误的结果。我们提出了Blink，一个轻量级的插桩框架，在保持低开销的同时为短暂例程提供稳健的覆盖。Blink在函数中插入插桩，从而实现精确测量。我们展示Blink达到了99.999%的准确率，同时产生1%的开销。在华为的多种用例中部署，Blink为移动编译器性能分析提供了一种实用且可靠的替代方案。

import_candidates.title: Breaking the Reward Barrier: Accelerating Tree-of-Thought Reasoning via Speculative Exploration
import_candidates.abstract:
Tree-of-Thought (ToT) reasoning structures Large Language Model (LLM) inference as a tree-based search, demonstrating strong potential for solving complex mathematical and programming tasks. However, its efficiency is constrained by the reward dependency barrier—a synchronization bottleneck caused by sequential reward-guided exploration that limits search parallelism and introduces substantial latency. Prior system optimizations, mainly designed for linear Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, cannot address these challenges, leaving the efficiency of ToT underexplored.
To enhance ToT reasoning efficiency, we observe that the reasoning paths can be explored speculatively to break the reward synchronization barrier. Therefore, in this paper, we propose SPEX and introduce three key techniques: (i) intra-query speculative path selection to predict and expand high-potential branches of ToT, (ii) inter-query budget allocation to balance speculative resource allocation across queries dynamically, and (iii) adaptive early termination to prune deep and redundant branches for a skewed search tree.
We implement SPEX on top of the SGLang framework and evaluate it across diverse ToT algorithms and LLMs. Extensive experiments show that SPEX achieves 1.2 3 × speedup for different ToT reasoning algorithms. Moreover, SPEX synergizes with token-level speculative decoding, achieving cumulative speedups of up to 4.1×. Ablation studies further confirm the contributions of each technique. Overall, SPEX represents a significant step toward efficient and scalable ToT reasoning, unlocking the parallelism required for high-performance inference-time scaling for LLMs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 思维树（Tree-of-Thought，ToT）推理将大语言模型（LLM）推理结构化为基于树的搜索，展现出解决复杂数学和编程任务的巨大潜力。然而，其效率受到奖励依赖障碍的制约——这是一种由顺序奖励引导探索引起的同步瓶颈，限制了搜索并行性并引入了大量延迟。先前的系统优化主要针对线性思维链（Chain-of-Thought，CoT）推理设计，无法解决这些挑战，导致ToT的效率未得到充分探索。为提高ToT推理效率，我们观察到推理路径可以被推测性探索，从而打破奖励同步障碍。因此，在本文中，我们提出SPEX并引入三种关键技术：（i）查询内推测性路径选择，以预测并扩展ToT的高潜力分支；（ii）查询间预算分配，以动态平衡跨查询的推测性资源分配；以及（iii）自适应提前终止，以剪除偏斜搜索树中深层和冗余的分支。我们在SGLang框架之上实现了SPEX，并在多种ToT算法和LLM上进行了评估。大量实验表明，SPEX对不同ToT推理算法实现了1.2至3倍的加速。此外，SPEX与token级推测解码协同工作，累计加速可达4.1倍。消融研究进一步证实了每种技术的贡献。总体而言，SPEX朝着高效且可扩展的ToT推理迈出了重要一步，释放了LLM高性能推理时扩展所需的并行性。

import_candidates.title: Controlling Opaque-Component Effects with Semisolates and Try
import_candidates.abstract: Many developers and systems today rely on opaque software components. When executing, these components affect each other and the broader environment in which they execute. Some of these effects are expected and desired; others not so. This paper introduces semisolates, an abstraction and corresponding subsystem for controlling and manipulating the effects of opaque components. Available as an unprivileged, higher-order, language-agnostic command, try interposes on a component’s execution to automatically capture and control its effects. Effect control includes introspection, optional application, effect stacking, and further manipulation—all driven by several real-world case studies. Today try is used in research and production applications across several organizations, mediating potentially undesired effects, maintaining full compatibility with real-world components, and incurring a modest performance overhead well within each case’s acceptable levels.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 如今许多开发者和系统都依赖不透明软件组件。在执行时，这些组件会相互影响并影响其运行所在的更广泛环境。其中一些影响是预期且期望的，另一些则不然。本文介绍了半隔离（semisolates），这是一种用于控制和操纵不透明组件效应的抽象及相应子系统。作为一个无特权的、高阶的、与语言无关的命令，try 会在组件执行时对其进行拦截，以自动捕获和控制其影响。效应控制包括内省、可选应用、效应叠加以及进一步操作——所有这些都由多个真实世界的案例研究驱动。目前，try 已被多个组织的研究和生产应用所使用，用于调解潜在的不良效应，保持与现实世界组件的完全兼容性，并产生适当且可接受的性能开销，在各类可接受范围内。

import_candidates.title: SBB: Eliminating Centralized Bottlenecks in Userspace Network Runtime
import_candidates.abstract:
To achieve high throughput, low latency, and high CPU efficiency, userspace network runtimes must perform three types of scheduling: 1) request preemption to minimize tail latency, 2) CPU allocation among services to avoid wasting CPU cycles when the load is low, and 3) request load balancing across worker cores to achieve work conservation. However, prior designs rely on centralized components, which inevitably become scalability bottlenecks as the number of CPU workers increases, limiting system performance scaling.
This paper presents SBB, a purely decentralized userspace network runtime that simultaneously delivers high performance, high CPU efficiency, and high scalability by advancing in both system mechanism and scheduling policy. For system mechanism, SBB leverages the emerging User Interrupt mechanism in a novel way, delivering two types of device interrupts to the userspace runtime: 1) user-level timer interrupts for request preemption, and 2) user-level NIC interrupts for packet arrival to perform CPU allocation. For scheduling policy, SBB introduces a two-level algorithm, which marries flow migration (for persistent imbalance) with task stealing (for temporary imbalance), challenging the conventional wisdom that centralized load balancing outperforms decentralized approaches. Evaluation shows that SBB achieves 1.7× to 5.2× higher throughput when scaling to 48 cores, while meeting the same tail latency target.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 为了实现高吞吐量、低延迟和高CPU效率，用户态网络运行时必须执行三种类型的调度：1）请求抢占以最小化尾部延迟，2）服务之间的CPU分配以避免在负载较低时浪费CPU周期，以及3）跨工作核心的请求负载均衡以实现工作守恒。然而，先前的设计依赖集中式组件，随着CPU工作线程数量的增加，这些组件不可避免地将成为可扩展性瓶颈，从而限制系统性能的扩展。本文提出了SBB，一种纯分布式的用户态网络运行时，通过推进系统机制和调度策略两方面，同时实现高性能、高CPU效率和高可扩展性。在系统机制方面，SBB以新颖的方式利用新兴的用户中断机制，向用户态运行时传递两种类型的设备中断：1）用于请求抢占的用户级定时器中断，以及2）用于数据包到达以执行CPU分配的用户级NIC中断。在调度策略方面，SBB引入了一种两级算法，将流迁移（针对持续不均衡）与任务窃取（针对临时不均衡）相结合，挑战了集中式负载均衡优于分布式方法的传统观点。评估表明，在扩展到48个核心时，SBB实现了1.7倍到5.2倍的更高吞吐量，同时满足相同的尾部延迟目标。

import_candidates.title: Rakaia: Scalable In-Kernel Scheduling for TCP-Based RPCs
import_candidates.abstract:
Delivering RPCs with high throughput and low latency demands work-conserving scheduling across many CPU cores and eliminating head-of-line (HOL) blocking across all messages. By exposing per-connection byte streams rather than messages to userspace, the POSIX TCP API inherently induces HOL blocking both within and across connections. To mitigate HOL blocking, RPC frameworks such as gRPC must reconstruct message semantics in userspace through additional abstractions including dedicated I/O threads, work queues, and worker thread pools, introducing significant context switching and synchronization overheads.
This paper presents Rakaia, a framework that hides all TCP-level abstractions from userspace and exposes a purely message-oriented API. By performing message parsing and work-conserving scheduling directly in the kernel’s TCP receive path, at the earliest possible point, Rakaia efficiently eliminates HOL blocking and avoids the heavy userspace machinery imposed by stream-based APIs.
We implemented Rakaia as a Linux kernel module with support for kTLS. Rakaia is compatible with the kernel’s TCP stack and existing RPC protocols. We also adapted gRPC to use Rakaia’s API. Our evaluation shows Rakaia: (i) consistently eliminates HOL blocking across a wide range of connection counts; (ii) achieves up to 5× higher throughput-under-SLO than KCM, Linux’s current in-kernel message API over TCP; (iii) improves gRPC-Go’s throughput-under-SLO by up to 1.56×, and gRPC-C++’s by up to 2.69×; and (iv) improves the throughput-under-SLO for real-world applications including Silo running TPC-C and OpenTelemetry Collector by 1.39× and 1.42×, respectively.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 以高吞吐量和低延迟交付RPC，要求跨多个CPU核心进行工作守恒调度，并消除所有消息的头对行阻塞。通过向用户空间公开每连接的字节流而非消息，POSIX TCP API固有地在连接内部和跨连接间引发HOL阻塞。为缓解HOL阻塞，gRPC等RPC框架必须在用户空间重建消息语义，采用专用I/O线程、工作队列和工作者线程池等额外抽象，从而引入显著的上下文切换和同步开销。本文提出Rakaia框架，该框架对用户空间隐藏所有TCP级抽象，并公开纯面向消息的API。通过在内核TCP接收路径中尽可能早的位置直接执行消息解析和工作守恒调度，Rakaia高效地消除了HOL阻塞，并避免了基于流的API所强加的重型用户空间机制。我们以支持kTLS的Linux内核模块形式实现了Rakaia。Rakaia与内核TCP栈及现有RPC协议兼容。我们还改造了gRPC以使用Rakaia的API。评估表明，Rakaia：(i)在多种连接数量下持续消除HOL阻塞；(ii)相比KCM（Linux当前的TCP内核消息API），SLO吞吐量最高提升5倍；(iii)使gRPC-Go的SLO吞吐量最高提升1.56倍，gRPC-C++最高提升2.69倍；(iv)使实际应用（包括运行TPC-C的Silo和OpenTelemetry Collector）的SLO吞吐量分别提升1.39倍和1.42倍。

import_candidates.title: kSTEP: Characterization and Deterministic Testing of Linux CPU Scheduler Bugs
import_candidates.abstract: We present an in-depth study of CPU scheduler bugs, covering both functional violations and misalignments between implementation and policy. Our study shows that these bugs are hard to observe and even harder to trigger. To close this gap, we introduce kSTEP. kSTEP gives testers fine-grained control over scheduler-invoking events and runs them deterministically on isolated CPUs. kSTEP produces noise-free, repeatable traces that expose subtle behavior. We then build a coverage-guided fuzzer on top of kSTEP for automated CPU scheduler testing. We demonstrate kSTEP’s effectiveness by reproducing seven real-world scheduler bugs and uncovering four new ones. kSTEP is publicly available at https://github.com/kstep-dev/kstep.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们深入研究了CPU调度器缺陷，涵盖了功能违规和实现与策略之间的不匹配。我们的研究表明，这些缺陷很难观察，更难触发。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了kSTEP。kSTEP让测试人员能够对调度器调用事件进行细粒度控制，并在隔离的CPU上确定性地运行它们。kSTEP产生无噪声、可重复的追踪，揭示微妙的行为。然后我们在kSTEP之上构建了一个覆盖引导的模糊器，用于自动CPU调度器测试。我们通过重现七个真实世界的调度器缺陷并发现四个新缺陷来证明kSTEP的有效性。kSTEP可在https://github.com/kstep-dev/kstep公开发布。

import_candidates.title: What Are You (M)Waiting For: The Hidden Cost of Idle in the Hyperscale Cloud (Operational Systems)
import_candidates.abstract:
Oversubscription is central to large-scale clouds: multiplexing virtual CPUs (vCPUs) over fewer physical CPUs (pCPUs) improves utilization and sales density, but meeting strict latency Service Level Objectives (SLOs) requires precise control over idle behavior. In 1:1 settings, idle-passthrough—especially mwait-passthrough—works well: by allowing guests to initiate hardware idle transitions directly, it eliminates idle-induced Virtual Machine (VM) exits and achieves near–bare-metal latency.
In production oversubscribed environments, however, passthrough breaks down. Because the hypervisor cannot observe mwait idleness, a vCPU never yields its pCPU, causing idle vCPU to monopolize cores and driving up contention, steal time ratios, live migrations, and SLO alarms across regions. Controlled experiments reproduce these production symptoms: even an idle vCPU executing mwait can raise colocated tail latency by up to 3×.
We present mwait-sched, a virtualization-aware redesign of mwait handling that reconciles bare-metal-like idle latency with predictable pCPU multiplexing. mwait-sched integrates deterministic timer-based emulation, fine-grained idle-interval classification, and a scalable multi-address mwait-proxy that restores idle visibility without frequent VM exits. Across nine representative workloads, it reduces P99 (99th percentile) latency by 30–50% and reduces steal ratio by 30–40%. At hyperscale, across globally distributed production regions comprising ∼3.2M pCPUs, it reduces high-contention steal events by over 80%, cuts daily live migrations by 30–50%, and raises oversubscription ratio from 1.0% to 20.3%, effectively adding ∼600,000 vCPUs of sellable capacity.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 超订阅是大规模云的核心：将虚拟CPU（vCPU）多路复用到更少的物理CPU（pCPU）上可提高利用率和销售密度，但满足严格的延迟服务级别目标（SLO）要求对空闲行为进行精确控制。在1:1设置中，空闲直通——尤其是mwait直通——效果良好：它允许guest直接发起硬件空闲转换，从而消除了空闲引起的虚拟机（VM）退出，并实现了接近裸机的延迟。然而，在生产环境的超订阅情况下，直通会失效。由于hypervisor无法观察到mwait空闲状态，vCPU永远不会让出其pCPU，导致空闲vCPU独占核心，并在各区域引发争用、窃取时间比率、实时迁移和SLO告警的增加。受控实验重现了这些生产症状：即使是执行mwait的空闲vCPU也可能将共置的尾部延迟最多提高3倍。我们提出了mwait-sched，一种虚拟机感知的mwait处理重新设计，它调和了类似裸机的空闲延迟与可预测的pCPU多路复用。mwait-sched集成了基于定时器的确定性模拟、细粒度的空闲间隔分类以及可扩展的多地址mwait代理，无需频繁的VM退出即可恢复空闲可见性。在九个代表性工作负载中，它将P99（第99百分位）延迟降低30-50%，窃取比率降低30-40%。在超大规模场景中，在全球分布的生产区域（约320万pCPU）中，它使高争用窃取事件减少超过80%，将每日实时迁移减少30-50%，并将超订阅比率从1.0%提高到20.3%，实际上增加了约60万个vCPU的可销售容量。

import_candidates.title: Xkernel: Principled Performance Tunability of Operating System Kernels
import_candidates.abstract: The Linux kernel is permeated with constant values that are critical to system performance. Many of these constants, referred to as perf-consts, are magic numbers with brittle assumptions on hardware and workloads. Unfortunately, there is no capability of in-situ tuning of perf-const values on deployed kernels. This paper rethinks OS performance tunability. We present Xkernel, a system that offers a safe, efficient, and programmable interface for in-situ tuning of any perf-consts directly on a running kernel. Xkernel transforms any perf-const into a tunable knob on demand using a novel approach called Scoped Indirect Execution (SIE). SIE captures precise binary boundaries where a perf-const enters system state and redirects control to synthesized instructions that update the state as if new values were used. Xkernel goes beyond version atomicity when updating perf-consts to guarantee side-effect safety, a property notably absent in existing kernel update mechanisms. Case studies on various OS subsystems demonstrate significant performance benefits of tuning perf-consts which is made possible by Xkernel.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Linux内核中充斥着对系统性能至关重要的常量。这些常量中有许多被称为性能常量（perf-consts），它们是对硬件和工作负载有着脆弱假设的魔数。不幸的是，在已部署的内核上，没有对性能常量的值进行原位调整的能力。本文重新思考了操作系统性能的可调性。我们提出了Xkernel，一个为运行中的内核上的任何性能常量提供安全、高效且可编程的原位调整接口的系统。Xkernel通过一种称为“作用域间接执行”（Scoped Indirect Execution，简称SIE）的方法，按需将任何性能常量转换为可调旋钮。SIE精确捕获性能常量进入系统状态的二进制边界，并将控制流重定向到合成的指令，这些指令更新状态，就像使用了新值一样。在更新性能常量时，Xkernel超越版本原子性，保证副作用安全性——这是现有内核更新机制中明显缺失的属性。对各种操作系统子系统的案例研究表明，Xkernel使得调整性能常量能够带来显著的性能提升。

import_candidates.title: Murakkab: Resource-Efficient Agentic Workflow Orchestration in Cloud Platforms
import_candidates.abstract:
Agentic workflows commonly coordinate multiple models and tools with complex control logic. They are quickly becoming the dominant paradigm for AI applications. However, serving them remains inefficient with today’s frameworks. The key problem is that they expose workflows as opaque sequences of model and tool calls that tightly couple agent logic with model and hardware choices. This prevents systems from holistically reasoning about trade-offs across accuracy, latency, energy, and cost. This leads to resource waste and degraded service-level objectives (SLOs).
We present Murakkab, a resource-efficient serving system for agentic workflows. Murakkab introduces a declarative abstraction that decouples workflow specification from execution configuration. A profile-guided optimizer and adaptive runtime jointly manage the full stack: orchestrating workflow components, mapping them to models and hardware, and dynamically reconfiguring execution to satisfy user-defined SLOs. By exposing the internal structure of agentic workflows, Murakkab enables cross-layer optimization that existing frameworks and cloud schedulers cannot achieve.
Our evaluation on diverse workflows shows that, compared to state-of-the-art systems, Murakkab reduces GPU usage by up to 2.8×, energy consumption by 3.7×, and cost by 4.3× while maintaining SLOs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 智能体工作流通常以复杂的控制逻辑协调多个模型和工具，正迅速成为AI应用的主导范式。然而，如今的框架在服务它们时仍然效率低下。关键问题在于，这些框架将工作流暴露为模型和工具调用的不透明序列，将智能体逻辑与模型及硬件选择紧密耦合，从而阻止系统对准确性、延迟、能耗和成本之间的权衡进行整体推理，导致资源浪费和服务级目标（SLO）退化。我们提出了Murakkab，一个面向智能体工作流的资源高效服务系统。Murakkab引入了一种声明式抽象，将工作流规范与执行配置解耦。一个基于配置文件的优化器和自适应运行时共同管理整个栈：编排工作流组件，将其映射到模型和硬件，并动态重新配置执行以满足用户定义的SLO。通过暴露智能体工作流的内部结构，Murakkab实现了现有框架和云调度器无法实现的跨层优化。我们对多样化工作流的评估显示，与最先进系统相比，Murakkab在保持SLO的同时，将GPU使用量降低高达2.8倍，能耗降低3.7倍，成本降低4.3倍。

import_candidates.title: ECO: An AI-Driven Code Efficiency Optimizer for Warehouse Scale Computers (Operational Systems)
import_candidates.abstract:
Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown significant promise in automating code efficiency optimization. While prior work demonstrates these techniques on artificial datasets such as programming competitions or small benchmarks, deploying these techniques at scale in production has remained an open problem. Arguably, two challenges have prevented the adoption in large-scale real-world systems: opportunity localization and reliability. First, applying an LLM to every line across a large code base is expensive and prone to generating an overwhelming number of low-quality suggestions, placing unsustainable cognitive load on human code reviewers. Second, the inherent unreliability of LLM-generated code risks introducing errors that can lead to production incidents. These challenges are largely orthogonal to the ML techniques prior work has focused on; they are real-world systems problems.
This paper introduces ECO, a system that automatically modifies source code to improve performance at scale. ECO overcomes the localization problem by combining fleet-wide continuous profiling to identify performance-critical code with an embedding-based search to pinpoint specific optimization candidates, guided by a mined dictionary of performance anti-patterns. It overcomes the reliability problem through a multi-stage verification approach that uses automated testing, LLM-based self-review, and post-deployment monitoring to ensure changes are both correct and effective. Fully productionized and deployed within Google’s hyperscale production fleet, ECO has successfully landed over 6,400 commits, changing more than 25,000 lines of production code. Incorrect changes are caught before they are submitted to production, and 99.5% of the submitted commits did not cause any rollbacks. These optimizations have resulted in savings equivalent to several hundred thousand normalized CPU cores, showing that ECO makes LLM-based optimization both practical at scale and highly impactful in real-world settings.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在自动化代码效率优化方面展现了显著潜力。虽然先前的工作在人工数据集（如编程竞赛或小型基准）上展示了这些技术，但在生产中大规模部署这些技术仍然是一个未解决的问题。可以说，有两个挑战阻碍了在大型真实世界系统中的采纳：机会定位和可靠性。首先，将LLM应用于大型代码库的每一行代码成本高昂，并且容易产生大量低质量建议，给人工代码审查者带来不可持续的认知负担。其次，LLM生成代码固有的不可靠性有可能引入导致生产事故的错误。这些挑战在很大程度上与先前工作所关注的机器学习技术无关；它们是现实世界的系统问题。本文介绍了ECO，一个自动修改源代码以大规模提升性能的系统。ECO通过结合整个机群的持续性能剖析来识别性能关键代码，并利用嵌入搜索在挖掘出的性能反模式词典指导下精确定位候选优化点，从而克服了定位问题。它通过多阶段验证方法克服了可靠性问题，该方法使用自动化测试、基于LLM的自审和部署后监控来确保更改既正确又有效。ECO已在Google的超大规模生产机群中完全投入生产并部署，成功落地了超过6400个提交，更改了超过25000行生产代码。错误的更改在提交到生产环境之前就被捕获，99.5%的已提交未引起任何回滚。这些优化节省了相当于数十万个标准化CPU内核的计算资源，表明ECO使基于LLM的优化在大规模生产中既实用又具有高度影响力。

import_candidates.title: StriaTrace: Efficient Tracing and Diagnosis for Online LLM Inference (Operational Systems)
import_candidates.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) inference services in production operate under stringent, fine-grained Service Level Objectives (SLOs). Unlike throughput-oriented LLM training, even sporadic performance anomalies during inference can violate SLOs, underscoring the need for improved tracing and diagnosis solutions. However, existing solutions face two primary limitations: (1) existing tracing tools incur prohibitive overhead; (2) training-centric diagnosis tools are ill-suited for capturing sporadic inference anomalies. To bridge these gaps, we propose StriaTrace, a novel tracing and diagnosis system tailored for online LLM inference. StriaTrace is built upon three principles distilled from production experience: (1) tracing key synchronization points, (2) tracing critical paths, and (3) detailed tracing only during abnormalities. StriaTrace further constructs a dynamic regression-based roofline model and correlation-based diagnosis to identify why each LLM inference abnormality happens. Evaluations show that StriaTrace reduces tracing overhead by 97.8% relative to alternatives. StriaTrace has been widely used in our development, testing, and production release cycles, and has successfully diagnosed hundreds of abnormalities spanning 19 distinct root causes.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 生产环境中的大型语言模型（LLM）推理服务在严格的、细粒度的服务等级目标（SLO）下运行。与面向吞吐量的LLM训练不同，推理过程中即使是偶发的性能异常也可能违反SLO，这凸显了改进追踪和诊断解决方案的必要性。然而，现有解决方案面临两个主要限制：（1）现有追踪工具会产生过高的开销；（2）以训练为中心的诊断工具不适合捕获偶发的推理异常。为了弥补这些差距，我们提出了StriaTrace，一种专为在线LLM推理定制的全新追踪与诊断系统。StriaTrace建立在从生产经验中提炼的三条原则之上：（1）追踪关键同步点，（2）追踪关键路径，（3）仅在异常期间进行详细追踪。StriaTrace还构建了一个基于动态回归的屋顶线模型和基于相关性的诊断方法，以识别每次LLM推理异常发生的原因。评估表明，与替代方案相比，StriaTrace将追踪开销降低了97.8%。StriaTrace已广泛用于我们的开发、测试和生产发布周期，并成功诊断了涵盖19种不同根本原因的数百个异常。

import_candidates.title: Diagnosing Performance Issues in Application-Defined Resources
import_candidates.abstract:
Many performance issues in large software systems are caused by application-defined resources, such as buffer pools, query caches, and temporary data structures. These resources are managed within the application logic and can strongly affect program execution. However, their resource-specific semantics are often not visible through system-level metrics. As a result, inefficient designs in the management of these resources can cause performance degradation that is difficult to observe and diagnose with existing profilers.
This paper presents gigiprofiler, a profiler that diagnoses performance problems caused by application-defined resources. gigiprofiler uses a hybrid method that combines LLM-based semantic inference with static analysis: LLM identifies candidate application-defined resources and their usage events from semantic cues, while static analysis validates these candidates against the code. gigiprofiler then tracks how each request interacts with inferred resources and records usage events at runtime. gigiprofiler detects bottlenecks from aggregate usage events and attributes each resource bottleneck to responsible requests and links the runtime evidence back to code paths to explain how the bottleneck occurs.
We evaluated gigiprofiler on 15 real-world performance issues in five widely deployed applications. gigiprofiler detects and diagnoses all 15 issues and further uncovers two previously unknown performance issues in MariaDB, both later confirmed by the developers.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大型软件系统中的许多性能问题是由应用程序定义的资源引起的，例如缓冲池、查询缓存和临时数据结构。这些资源在应用程序逻辑中管理，并能强烈影响程序执行。然而，它们特定于资源的语义通常无法通过系统级指标可见。因此，这些资源管理中的低效设计可能导致性能下降，而现有的分析器很难观察和诊断这些问题。本文介绍了 gigiprofiler，一个诊断由应用程序定义资源引起的性能问题的分析器。gigiprofiler 使用结合基于 LLM 的语义推理和静态分析的混合方法：LLM 从语义线索中识别候选的应用程序定义资源及其使用事件，而静态分析则根据代码验证这些候选。然后 gigiprofiler 跟踪每个请求如何与推断的资源交互，并在运行时记录使用事件。gigiprofiler 从聚合的使用事件中检测瓶颈，并将每个资源瓶颈归因于负责的请求，并将运行时的证据链接回代码路径以解释瓶颈是如何发生的。我们在五个广泛部署的应用程序中的 15 个真实性能问题上评估了 gigiprofiler。gigiprofiler 检测并诊断了所有 15 个问题，还进一步发现了 MariaDB 中两个先前未知的性能问题，这两个问题后来都得到了开发人员的确认。

import_candidates.title: hS: Speculative Script Reordering at Subprocess Granularity
import_candidates.abstract: Shell scripts are pervasive, acting as the glue between commands and subprocesses that are written in a variety of languages and perform complex, system-wide effects. Given the black-box nature of these subprocesses, all work that optimizes script performance until now has relied on handwritten annotations that describe subprocess effects. In this paper we introduce hS, a system that brings out-of-order, speculative execution to scripts that invoke subprocesses without requiring any user input or annotations about them. hS speculatively executes command instances—typically simple commands, pipelines, or small synchronization regions—dynamically detecting their effects: blocking unsafe ones, like network accesses, and selectively committing independent effects, like file writes, given no conflicts. On a wide range of real-world scripts, hS offers up to 9.3× speedups compared to bash, and up to 7× speedups over PaSh—all while not requiring any developer involvement or command annotations.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Shell脚本无处不在，充当命令与子进程之间的粘合剂，这些子进程以多种语言编写并执行复杂的系统级影响。鉴于这些子进程的黑盒特性，迄今为止所有优化脚本性能的工作都依赖于描述子进程效果的手写注释。本文介绍了hS，一个将乱序、推测性执行引入调用子进程的脚本的系统，无需任何用户输入或关于子进程的注释。hS推测性地执行命令实例（通常是简单命令、管道或小的同步区域），动态检测它们的效果：阻止不安全的操作（如网络访问），并在无冲突的情况下选择性提交独立的效果（如文件写入）。在广泛的真实世界脚本上，与bash相比，hS提供了高达9.3倍的加速，比PaSh提供了高达7倍的加速——而且无需任何开发人员参与或命令注释。

import_candidates.title: Incr: Faster Re-Execution via Bolt-On Incrementalization
import_candidates.abstract: While most software development is incremental, most execution environments are not: even small program modifications fail to take advantage of prior executions, at worst requiring full re-execution of all computational stages in the modified program. Such full re-execution decelerates software development and debugging, especially in dynamic polyglot environments such as the Unix and Linux shell. This paper presents Incr, a system that accelerates the re-execution of unmodified shell programs by automatically incrementalizing their execution. Incr analyzes and tracks interdependencies to detect and store key intermediate results, reusing them on subsequent re-executions whenever possible. Incr’s effect analysis supports correct re-execution even for non-idempotent computations, and several static and dynamic optimizations reduce the runtime and storage overheads of incrementalization. Applied to diverse real-world scenarios, Incr accelerates re-execution by an average of 34.2× and a maximum of 373.3×—all while requiring no developer annotations or code modifications and remaining behaviorally indistinguishable on over 10,000 test cases.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 尽管大多数软件开发是增量的，但大多数执行环境并非如此：即使是微小的程序修改也无法利用先前的执行，最坏情况下需要完整重新执行修改后程序的所有计算阶段。这种完全重新执行会拖慢软件开发和调试，尤其是在Unix和Linux shell等动态多语言环境中。本文介绍了Incr，一个通过自动增量执行来加速未修改shell程序的系统。Incr分析并跟踪依赖关系以检测和存储关键中间结果，并在后续重新执行时尽可能重用它们。Incr的效果分析即使对于非幂等计算也能支持正确的重新执行，多种静态和动态优化降低了增量执行的运行时和存储开销。应用于多样化的真实场景中，Incr平均加速重新执行34.2倍，最大加速达373.3倍——且无需任何开发人员注释或代码修改，并在超过10，000个测试用例上保持行为上的不可区分性。

import_candidates.title: A Compilation-Based Under-Constrained Execution Engine
import_candidates.abstract: Software bugs continue to pose significant challenges to the security and correctness of computer systems. Finding and eliminating bugs for large-scale software systems, such as the Linux kernel, remains a difficult task. Static analyses can cover the whole codebase, but often produce too many false positives. Whole program dynamic testing is precise but has limited code coverage, and could require special environments. Due to the modular design of large software systems, a promising alternative is to instantiate an execution environment for individual components in isolation, and then apply precise dynamic analyses to these components. Unfortunately, existing execution engines that support such under-constrained execution are all interpreter-based, thus suffering from poor scalability. In this paper, we introduce UCSan, a compilation-based under-constrained execution engine that can compile an arbitrary set of C/C++ functions into a self-contained executable without manual modifications. To demonstrate the scalability and versatility of UCSan, we showcase combining UCSan with a compilation-based concolic execution engine to conduct under-constrained symbolic execution. Our evaluation shows that the resulting analysis engine is up to 15.06x faster on Linux kernel analysis tasks than the KLEE-based engine. This enhanced scalability not only improves the bug detection effectiveness but also enables its application across a broader range of software systems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 软件缺陷持续对计算机系统的安全性和正确性构成重大挑战。对于Linux内核等大型软件系统，查找和消除缺陷仍然是一项艰巨的任务。静态分析可以覆盖整个代码库，但往往产生过多误报。全程序动态测试虽然精确，但代码覆盖率有限，并且可能需要特殊环境。由于大型软件系统的模块化设计，一个很有前景的替代方案是为单个组件单独实例化执行环境，然后对这些组件应用精确的动态分析。不幸的是，支持这种欠约束执行的现有执行引擎都是基于解释器的，因此扩展性差。在本文中，我们介绍了UCSan，一种基于编译的欠约束执行引擎，可以将任意一组C/C++函数编译成自包含的可执行文件，无需手动修改。为了展示UCSan的扩展性和通用性，我们演示了将UCSan与基于编译的混合执行引擎相结合，以进行欠约束符号执行。我们的评估表明，在Linux内核分析任务中，所得到的分析引擎比基于KLEE的引擎快达15.06倍。这种增强的扩展性不仅提高了缺陷检测的有效性，还使其能够应用于更广泛的软件系统。

import_candidates.title: Aletheia: Automated Detection of Data Integrity Violations in Microservices
import_candidates.abstract:
The decomposition of applications into microservices results in data being stored across heterogeneous systems, with data schemas partitioned and managed by separate services. As the size and complexity of microservice deployments grow, the consistency of data associations at the application level can be overlooked, and it becomes challenging to manually identify data integrity violations.
In this paper, we present a systematic approach for identifying semantic violations in microservice ecosystems, namely operations and service interactions that break data integrity. We formalize these violations by leveraging the Entity-Relationship model and relational algebra to characterize problematic operation patterns across distributed services. We then introduce Aletheia, a static analysis tool that operationalizes this framework, using the static single assignment (SSA) representation to track data flow and a novel abstract call graph to detect integrity violations. We evaluate Aletheia on 7 open-source applications, detecting 46 previously unreported integrity violations, and use production-scale synthetic applications to demonstrate scalability to large call graphs with up to 500 microservices.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 将应用程序拆分为微服务会导致数据存储在异构系统中，数据模式由各个服务分区和管理。随着微服务部署的规模和复杂性增长，应用程序级别的数据关联一致性可能被忽视，手动识别数据完整性违规变得具有挑战性。在本文中，我们提出了一种系统方法，用于识别微服务生态系统中的语义违规，即破坏数据完整性的操作和服务交互。我们利用实体-关系模型和关系代数来形式化这些违规，以描述跨分布式服务的有问题的操作模式。然后，我们介绍了Aletheia，一个静态分析工具，它使用静态单赋值（SSA）表示来跟踪数据流，并使用新颖的抽象调用图来检测完整性违规，从而实现了该框架。我们在7个开源应用程序上评估了Aletheia，检测到46个先前未报告的完整性违规，并使用生产级合成应用程序证明了其可扩展性，可扩展到多达500个微服务的大型调用图。

import_candidates.title: Arctic: A Practical Lock-Free Adaptive Radix Tree
import_candidates.abstract: Indexing data structures are vital to the modern systems ecosystem, but there are no indexes that offer high performance, lock freedom, and range scans. Arctic is a lock-free adaptive radix tree that achieves all three: Arctic outcompetes lock-based indexes, including a concurrent hash map, on many YCSB configurations, guarantees non-blocking operation through careful metadata layout and an (eponymous) freezing-based coordination protocol, and offers non-linearizable range and prefix scans. Arctic also contributes a novel safe memory reclamation scheme that uses operation keys to approximate reachable pointers. We integrate Arctic into RocksDB and Turso, improving throughput up to 40% and 12% on their write-heavy benchmarks relative to their default skiplist indexes.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 索引数据结构对现代系统生态系统至关重要，但目前还没有同时具备高性能、无锁操作和范围扫描能力的索引。Arctic是一种无锁的自适应基数树，它同时实现了这三个目标：在许多YCSB配置下，Arctic的性能优于基于锁的索引（包括并发哈希表）；通过精心的元数据布局和一种（同名的）基于冻结的协调协议，它保证了无阻塞操作；并且它提供了不可线性化的范围和前缀扫描。Arctic还贡献了一种新颖的安全内存回收方案，该方案使用操作键来近似可达指针。我们将Arctic集成到RocksDB和Turso中，在它们的写密集型基准测试中，相对于它们默认的跳表索引，吞吐量分别提升了40%和12%。

import_candidates.title: Efficient and Scalable Synchronization via Generalized Cache Coherence
import_candidates.abstract:
We explore the design of efficient and scalable synchronization for disaggregated shared memory. Porting existing synchronization primitives to such architectures results in poor performance scaling due to redundant inter-cache communications, exacerbated by high cache-coherence latency in disaggregated shared memory.
Driven by our insight that synchronization is a generalization of cache coherence in time and space, we argue for minimally extending existing cache coherence protocols to support synchronization primitives, thereby eliminating the redundant inter-cache communication inherent in layered synchronization. We propose a novel Generalized cache-Coherence Protocol (GCP) that realizes this insight by leveraging wait queues and variable-size cache lines directly at the cache-coherence layer for temporal and spatial generalization, respectively. We have verified GCP’s correctness using model checking. We present Soul, an end-to-end system implementation of GCP atop a disaggregated shared-memory platform. Soul supports popular lock APIs through a user-space library that offers improved performance without requiring any changes to application code. Our evaluation of Soul against state-of-the-art locks shows that it improves the performance of unmodified real-world applications at scale by 1–2 orders of magnitude while incurring <8% storage overhead.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们探索了针对分解式共享内存的高效且可扩展的同步设计。将现有的同步原语移植到此类架构中，会因冗余的缓存间通信而导致性能扩展不佳，而分解式共享内存中高延迟的缓存一致性又加剧了这一问题。基于我们的洞察——同步在时间和空间上是缓存一致性的泛化——我们主张在最小编程范围内扩展现有的缓存一致性协议以支持同步原语，从而消除分层同步中固有的冗余缓存间通信。我们提出了一种新颖的广义缓存一致性协议（GCP），该协议通过在缓存一致性层直接利用等待队列和可变大小缓存行来实现时间和空间上的泛化。我们已使用模型检查验证了GCP的正确性。我们提出了Soul，一种在分解式共享内存平台上实现GCP的端到端系统。Soul通过用户态库支持流行的锁API，无需应用程序代码修改即可提供改进的性能。我们与最先进的锁进行的评估表明，Soul能够让未经修改的真实应用在大规模部署下的性能提升1至2个数量级，同时引入的存储开销低于8%。

import_candidates.title: Shaving the Peaks: Taming Tail Latency for Managed Workloads via Disaggregated Garbage Collection
import_candidates.abstract:
Language runtimes are essential systems commonly used in multi-tenant cloud scenarios, such as interactive web services and other cloud workloads. They usually provide memory management services, or garbage collection (GC), to automatically reclaim memory and reduce the labor work of application developers. Recent concurrent collectors allow GC to co-run with application threads (mutators), which reduces application pauses and intends to improve the applications’ tail latency. However, this work observes that periodic GC workloads remain a primary source of long tail latency, particularly in resource-constrained multi-tenant environments. In such settings, GC threads consume significant CPU resources, leading to severe performance contention with mutators.
To resolve the contention, this work presents DGC, a disaggregated GC architecture that exposes GC as an external service. DGC decouples the most costly marking phase in concurrent GC and offloads it to a disaggregated marking engine. Through a co-design of the GC marking algorithm and an RDMA-based software paging mechanism, DGC’s disaggregated marking engine achieves performance on par with local execution while offloading marking to a remote node. To improve resource utilization, DGC introduces a global GC orchestrator to serve multiple runtimes while minimizing the conflicts due to the overlapping of individual GC triggering points. DGC is implemented on the OpenJDK HotSpot Java virtual machine, and the evaluation results on representative latency-sensitive applications show that DGC reduces P99 latency by up to 64.4% under moderate workloads and improves the peak goodput by up to 24.0%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 用户生成内容网站通常会屏蔽来自Tor等隐私增强代理用户的贡献，因为人们认为这些代理是破坏、垃圾邮件和滥用的来源。尽管这类屏蔽可能有效，但未实现的匿名寻求者有价值贡献这一附带损害却是不可见的。维基百科作为最大和最重要的用户生成内容网站之一，早在2005年就尝试屏蔽Tor用户的贡献。我们证明这些屏蔽并不完善，并且有成千上万次通过Tor编辑维基百科的尝试获得了成功。我们利用多个数据源和分析技术，对Tor用户在维基百科上的编辑历史进行了随时间变化的测量和描述，并将Tor用户的贡献与其他维基百科用户群体的贡献进行比较。我们的分析表明，虽然绕过维基百科禁令的Tor用户所贡献的内容更可能被回退，也更可能回退他人的编辑，但除此之外，他们的贡献质量与其他未注册参与者以及注册用户的初始贡献相似。

import_candidates.title: DeLFS: A Decentralized Log-Structured File System for Manycores
import_candidates.abstract: This paper introduces DeLFS, a novel decentralized log-structured file system (LFS) designed for manycore scalability. DeLFS decentralizes metadata/data organization and management with an LFS-aware decentralized locking scheme that distributes lock ownership to eliminate global contention. In addition, DeLFS disentangles the critical path from the deferrable path to further increase concurrency. We implement DeLFS with three techniques in the Linux kernel and evaluate it on a 128-core machine. The experimental results show that DeLFS outperforms F2FS, MAX, and F2FSJ by up to 4.34×, 4.29×, and 4.50×, respectively, and delivers up to 2.00× higher sustained performance than ScaleLFS.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了DeLFS，一种新颖的面向众核可扩展性的去中心化日志结构化文件系统（LFS）。DeLFS通过一种LFS感知的去中心化锁机制来实现元数据/数据组织与管理的去中心化，该机制通过分散锁所有权来消除全局竞争。此外，DeLFS将关键路径与可延迟路径解耦，以进一步提高并发性。我们在Linux内核中用三种技术实现了DeLFS，并在128核机器上进行了评估。实验结果表明，DeLFS相比F2FS、MAX和F2FSJ分别最高提升了4.34倍、4.29倍和4.50倍，并且其持续性能比ScaleLFS高出达2.00倍。

import_candidates.title: Weave: Efficient Co-Scheduling for Disaggregated RL Post-Training
import_candidates.abstract: Rollout–training disaggregation is emerging as the standard architecture for Reinforcement Learning (RL) post-training, where memory-bound rollout and compute-bound training are physically disaggregated onto purpose-built clusters to maximize hardware efficiency. However, the strict synchronization required by on-policy algorithms introduces severe dependency bubbles, forcing one cluster to idle while the dependent phase is running on the other. We present WEAVE, a cluster scheduling framework that reclaims these bubbles through cross-cluster orchestration. WEAVE is built on the insight that the structural idleness of one job can be effectively utilized by the active phase of another. To realize this, we introduce the co-execution group abstraction, which partitions the cluster into isolated locality domains. This abstraction enables a two-tier scheduling architecture: an inter-group scheduler that optimizes job placement using conservative stochastic planning, and an intra-group scheduler that orchestrates a provably optimal round-robin schedule. The group abstraction also imposes a residency constraint, ensuring that massive model states remain cached in host memory to enable “warm-start” context switching. We evaluate WEAVE on a production-scale testbed with 328 H20 and 328 H800 GPUs. WEAVE improves cost efficiency by 1.84× over standard disaggregation and 1.38× over state-of-the-art co-located baselines, all while achieving 100% SLO attainment.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 推出（rollout）与训练（training）的解聚正在成为强化学习（RL）后训练的标准架构，其中内存密集的推出任务和计算密集的训练任务被物理地分离到专用集群上，以最大化硬件效率。然而，同策略算法所要求的严格同步引入了严重的依赖气泡，导致一个集群在另一个集群运行依赖阶段时空闲。我们提出了WEAVE，一个通过跨集群编排来回收这些气泡的集群调度框架。WEAVE的核心洞见是：一个作业的结构性空闲可以被另一个作业的活动阶段有效利用。为此，我们引入了共同执行组（co-execution group）抽象，它将集群划分为隔离的局部性域。该抽象支持一种两层调度架构：组间调度器使用保守随机规划优化作业放置，组内调度器则编排一个可证明最优的轮询调度。组抽象还施加了驻留约束，确保大型模型状态保留在主机内存缓存中，从而实现“热启动”上下文切换。我们在包含328块H20和328块H800 GPU的生产规模测试平台上对WEAVE进行了评估。相对于标准解聚，WEAVE将成本效率提高了1.84倍；相对于最先进的共置基线，提高了1.38倍，同时实现了100%的服务水平目标（SLO）达成率。

import_candidates.title: RLinf: Flexible and Efficient Large-Scale Reinforcement Learning via Macro-to-Micro Flow Transformation
import_candidates.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has demonstrated immense potential in advancing artificial general intelligence, agentic intelligence, and embodied intelligence. However, the inherent heterogeneity and dynamicity of RL workflows often lead to low hardware utilization and slow training on existing systems. In this paper, we present RLinf, a high-performance RL training system based on our key observation that the major roadblock to efficient RL training lies in system flexibility. To maximize flexibility and efficiency, RLinf is built atop a novel RL system design paradigm called macro-to-micro flow transformation (M2Flow), which automatically breaks down high-level, easy-to-compose RL workflows at both the temporal and spatial dimensions, and recomposes them into optimized execution flows. Supported by Rinf worker’s adaptive communication capability, we devise context switching and elastic pipelining to realize M2Flow transformation, and a profiling-guided scheduling policy to generate optimal execution plans. Extensive evaluations on both reasoning RL and embodied RL tasks demonstrate that Rinf consistently outperforms state-of-the-art systems, achieving 1.07×∼2.43× speedup in end-to-end training throughput.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）在推进通用人工智能、智能体智能和具身智能方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，RL工作流固有的异构性和动态性往往导致现有系统硬件利用率低、训练速度慢。本文提出RLinf，一个高性能强化学习训练系统，其核心观察是：高效RL训练的主要障碍在于系统灵活性。为了最大化灵活性和效率，RLinf基于一种名为“宏到微流程转换”（M2Flow）的新型RL系统设计范式构建，该范式在时间和空间维度上自动分解高层、易于组合的RL工作流，并将它们重新组合为优化的执行流程。依托RLinf worker的自适应通信能力，我们设计了上下文切换和弹性流水线以实现M2Flow转换，并采用基于配置的调度策略生成最优执行计划。在推理型RL和具身型RL任务上的广泛评估表明，RLinf持续优于最先进系统，端到端训练吞吐量提升了1.07倍至2.43倍。

import_candidates.title: DynaRL: Flexible and Dynamic Scheduling of Large-Scale Reinforcement Learning Training
import_candidates.abstract: Modern reinforcement learning (RL) workloads, powering large language models, long‑horizon reasoning, and agentic systems, exhibit extreme dynamicity due to heavy‑tailed rollouts, irregular multi‑turn tool interactions, and time‑varying bottlenecks. Static resource allocations in today’s distributed RL systems leave large fractions of compute idle and prolong training. This paper presents DynaRL, the first RL system that dynamically reallocates computation, memory, and communication resources across heterogeneous RL components. DynaRL models the entire RL pipeline with a dynamic hypergraph that serves as a centralized, continuously-evolving control surface. Supported by a unified resource migration interface and context‑aware data routing, the scheduler reallocates GPUs from overprovisioned components to the current bottleneck via a combination of a multi-level scheduling algorithm and fine-grained resource migration. Comprehensive evaluation demonstrates that DynaRL improves end-to-end throughput on math-reasoning and agentic RL workloads by up to 1.98×, with negligible online scheduling overhead.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代强化学习（RL）工作负载为大语言模型、长时推理和智能体系统提供支持，由于重尾的轨迹生成、不规则的多轮工具交互以及随时间变化的瓶颈，这些工作负载表现出极大的动态性。当今分布式RL系统中的静态资源分配使得大量计算资源闲置并延长训练时间。本文提出了DynaRL，这是首个在不同RL组件之间动态重新分配计算、内存和通信资源的RL系统。DynaRL使用动态超图对整个RL流程进行建模，该超图作为集中式、持续演变的控制面。在统一资源迁移接口和上下文感知数据路由的支持下，调度器通过多级调度算法与细粒度资源迁移的结合，将GPU从过量配置的组件重新分配到当前瓶颈。综合评估表明，DynaRL在数学推理和智能体RL工作负载上可将端到端吞吐量提升高达1.98倍，且在线调度开销可忽略不计。

import_candidates.title: RollArt: Disaggregated Multi-Task Agentic RL Training at Scale
import_candidates.abstract:
Agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL) trains LLMs through multi-turn interactions with environments, producing workloads that mix compute-bound prefill, bandwidth-bound decoding, CPU-heavy environment execution, and bursty reward evaluation. Existing systems either colocate all stages on a single GPU cluster or decouple them only at a coarse granularity, overlooking hardware heterogeneity and incurring substantial synchronization overhead across stages.
We present ROLLART, a system for multi-task agentic RL on disaggregated infrastructure. ROLLART maps each pipeline stage to best-fit hardware, routing prefill-heavy tasks to compute-optimized GPUs, decode-heavy tasks to bandwidth-optimized GPUs, and environments to CPU clusters. It decouples rollout at the trajectory level, allowing generation, environment interaction, and reward scoring to proceed independently, so that slow or failed environments never block the others. ROLLART offloads stateless reward computation to serverless infrastructure and overlaps rollout with training via staleness-bounded asynchronous weight synchronization. Our results demonstrate that ROLLART effectively improves training throughput and achieves 1.31–2.05× training time reduction compared to various RL systems. We also evaluated ROLLART by training a hundreds-of-billions-parameter MoE model for Qoder product on an Alibaba cluster with above 3,000 GPUs, demonstrating its stability and scalability.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 智能体强化学习（Agentic RL）通过与环境的多轮交互来训练大语言模型，产生的工作负载混合了计算密集的预填充阶段、带宽受限的解码阶段、CPU密集的环境执行以及突发的奖励评估。现有系统要么将所有阶段部署在单一GPU集群上，要么仅以粗粒度进行解耦，忽视了硬件异构性并导致跨阶段大量同步开销。我们提出了ROLLART，一个用于解聚式基础设施上多任务智能体强化学习的系统。ROLLART将每个流水线阶段映射到最合适的硬件上，将预填充密集型任务路由到计算优化GPU，解码密集型任务路由到带宽优化GPU，环境任务路由到CPU集群。它在轨迹级别上解耦环境交互，使得生成、环境交互和奖励评分能够独立进行，从而缓慢或失败的环境不会阻塞其他环境。ROLLART将无状态奖励计算卸载到无服务器基础设施，并通过有界陈旧性的异步权重同步将环境交互与训练重叠。我们的结果表明，ROLLART有效提高了训练吞吐量，相比各种RL系统实现了1.31–2.05倍的训练时间缩减。我们还通过在阿里巴巴一个超过3000个GPU的集群上为Qoder产品训练一个数千亿参数的MoE模型来评估ROLLART，证明了其稳定性和可扩展性。

import_candidates.title: Seer: Online Context Learning for Fast Synchronous LLM Reinforcement Learning
import_candidates.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a critical technique for advancing modern Large Language Models (LLMs), yet existing synchronous RL systems face severe performance bottlenecks. The rollout phase, which dominates end-to-end iteration time, suffers from substantial long-tail latency and poor resource utilization due to inherent workload imbalance. We present Seer, a novel context learning RL system that addresses these challenges through a key observation: requests sharing the same prompt exhibit strong similarities in output lengths and response patterns. Leveraging this insight, Seer introduces three coordinated techniques: (1) divided rollout for dynamic load balancing, (2) context-aware scheduling to mitigate long-tail request delays, and (3) adaptive grouped speculative decoding to accelerate generation. These mechanisms work in concert to markedly reduce long-tail latency and improve resource efficiency during rollout. Evaluations on production-grade RL workloads demonstrate that Seer achieves up to 2.04× end-to-end rollout throughput improvement compared to the state-of-the-art synchronous RL systems, while notably reducing long-tail latency by 72–94%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）已成为推动现代大型语言模型（LLM）发展的关键技术，然而现有的同步RL系统面临严重的性能瓶颈。在端到端迭代时间中占主导地位的rollout阶段，由于固有的工作负载不平衡，遭受了严重的尾部延迟和资源利用率低下。我们提出了Seer，一种新颖的上下文学习RL系统，通过一个关键观察来解决这些挑战：共享相同提示的请求在输出长度和响应模式上表现出强烈的相似性。利用这一见解，Seer引入了三种协调技术：（1）分段rollout以实现动态负载均衡，（2）上下文感知调度以缓解尾部请求延迟，（3）自适应分组推测解码以加速生成。这些机制协同工作，显著减少了rollout过程中的尾部延迟并提高了资源效率。在生产级RL工作负载上的评估表明，与最先进的同步RL系统相比，Seer实现了高达2.04倍的端到端rollout吞吐量提升，同时将尾部延迟显著降低了72-94%。

import_candidates.title: Harvesting Sub-Microsecond CXL Memory Stalls with LiteSwitch
import_candidates.abstract: Compute Express Link (CXL) offers a practical path to scale memory capacity and bandwidth available to a single host. However, CXL memory incurs sub-microsecond latency that is typically 3× or more compared to local memory, exacerbating memory-induced CPU stalls and degrading application performance. This paper presents LiteSwitch, a lightweight hardware-software co-design that opportunistically harvests otherwise idle cycles caused by CXL memory accesses. LiteSwitch introduces: (1) a hardware mechanism that precisely identifies a CXL-induced memory stall and exposes it to software with near-perfect accuracy and minimal overhead; (2) an ultra-fast software path that switches to another ready thread for harvesting in under 20 nanoseconds, an order of magnitude faster than conventional context switches. Together, these mechanisms enable efficient harvesting of sub-μs-scale memory stalls (>200 nanoseconds), without requiring changes to the application. The evaluation demonstrates that with a sufficient number of available threads per core, LiteSwitch recovers up to 80% of the performance lost due to CXL access latency, enabling the adoption of CXL memory without prohibitive slowdowns.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Compute Express Link (CXL) 为扩展单主机可用的内存容量和带宽提供了一条实用途径。然而，CXL 内存产生的亚微秒延迟通常是本地内存的 3 倍或更高，这会加剧内存引起的 CPU 停顿并降低应用程序性能。本文介绍了 LiteSwitch，一种轻量级的软硬件协同设计，它机会性地利用 CXL 内存访问引起的空闲周期。LiteSwitch 引入了：(1) 一种硬件机制，能够精确识别 CXL 引起的内存停顿，并以接近完美的准确度和极低开销将其暴露给软件；(2) 一条超快软件路径，可在 20 纳秒内切换到另一个就绪线程以利用这些周期，比传统上下文切换快一个数量级。这些机制共同实现了对亚微秒级（超过 200 纳秒）内存停顿的高效利用，且无需修改应用程序。评估表明，在每核拥有足够可用线程的情况下，LiteSwitch 可以恢复因 CXL 访问延迟而损失的多达 80% 的性能，从而使采用 CXL 内存不会带来令人望而却步的减速。

import_candidates.title: Duhu: Shared Disaggregated Memory for Distributed Data Processing Frameworks
import_candidates.abstract: Today’s distributed data processing frameworks (DDFs) have large memory and network transfer overheads because these frameworks require that each node (server or VM) copy objects into local memory before processing. Emerging shared disaggregated memory (SDM) clusters enable an alternate approach because they allow nodes to access data in a shared memory. However, using SDMs for DDFs is challenging: current SDM clusters provide weak coherence guarantees, and even for emerging SDMs coherence poses a scalability and complexity challenge. Thus, to adopt SDMs, a DDF would need to modify its logic and implement software coordination. In this paper, we describe Duhu, an SDM-based object store that is designed to allow DDFs to use SDMs without these changes, simplifying their adoption. We have integrated Duhu with Ray, and evaluated our system on an SDM cluster with a prototype CXL-attached memory pool. We show that Duhu can improve job completion time (JCT) by up to 3.39× on a shuffle workload.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 当今的分布式数据处理框架（DDFs）具有较大的内存和网络传输开销，因为这些框架要求每个节点（服务器或虚拟机）在处理之前将对象复制到本地内存。新兴的共享分解内存（SDM）集群提供了一种替代方法，因为它们允许节点访问共享内存中的数据。然而，将SDM用于DDFs具有挑战性：当前的SDM集群提供较弱的连贯性保证，即使对于新兴的SDM，连贯性也带来了可扩展性和复杂性的挑战。因此，为了采用SDM，DDF需要修改其逻辑并实现软件协调。在本文中，我们描述了Duhu，一个基于SDM的对象存储，旨在让DDF无需这些更改即可使用SDM，从而简化其采用。我们已将Duhu与Ray集成，并在带有原型CXL附加内存池的SDM集群上评估了我们的系统。我们表明，Duhu在shuffle工作负载上可以将作业完成时间（JCT）提高最多3.39倍。

import_candidates.title: Blowfish: Elastic Virtual Machine Memory for Disaggregated Memory
import_candidates.abstract: Cold memory rebalancing exhibits unique challenges to the existing memory overcommitment mechanisms, such as page tracking under Transparent Huge Pages (THP) and frequent remapping of page tables, leading to a series of throughput and latency issues. In this paper, we propose Blowfish, a memory overcommitment framework built on disaggregated memory, performing cold (and free) memory reclamation and restoration at μs-scale. Based on paravirtualization, Blowfish leverages a lightweight guest-level THP-aware hotness tracker to monitor page access and let the hypervisor directly reclaim and reallocate host physical memory across VMs with a dedicated cross-layer path for cold memory, bypassing the modifications of guest page table and modifications of I/O page table while benefiting from the rich program semantics of guest VM when recognizing the cold memory. As a result, Blowfish significantly speeds up the page reclamation and restoration, 2.48× and 2.14× faster than the state-of-the-art solution, HyperAlloc, respectively, and improves memory reclamation ratios by 1.6×-6.1× within 5% performance degradation.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 冷内存重新平衡对现有内存超卖机制提出了独特挑战，例如透明大页（THP）下的页面跟踪以及页表的频繁重映射，从而导致一系列吞吐量和延迟问题。在本文中，我们提出了Blowfish，一个构建在分解内存上的内存超卖框架，能在微秒级执行冷（和空闲）内存回收与恢复。基于半虚拟化，Blowfish利用一个轻量级的访客级THP感知热度跟踪器来监控页面访问，并让Hypervisor通过一条专用的跨层路径直接跨虚拟机回收和重新分配主机物理内存，从而绕过访客页表和I/O页表的修改，同时在识别冷内存时受益于访客虚拟机的丰富程序语义。因此，Blowfish显著加速了页面回收和恢复，分别比最先进的解决方案HyperAlloc快2.48倍和2.14倍，并且在5%的性能下降内将内存回收率提高了1.6倍至6.1倍。

import_candidates.title: Espresso: Constructing Cost-Efficient CXL JBOF via Inter-SSD Computing Resource Sharing
import_candidates.abstract: Enterprise SSDs integrate substantial computing resources (e.g., ARM processor and onboard DRAM) to handle I/O bursts. However, these resources significantly raise SSD monetary cost and suffer severely underutilized in JBOF deployments due to the sporadic nature of I/O bursts. In this paper, we present Espresso, a cost-efficient JBOF design that provisions only moderate computing resources per SSD at low monetary cost, while delivering demanded I/O performance through efficient inter-SSD resource sharing. Specifically, Espresso first disaggregates SSD architecture into functionally distinct components, enabling fine-grained SSD internal resource management. Espresso then employs a decentralized scheme to manage these disaggregated resources and harvests the computing resources of idle SSDs to assist busy SSDs in handling I/O bursts. This idea is facilitated by the cache-coherent CXL fabric, with which the busy SSDs can directly utilize the harvested computing resources to accelerate metadata processing. The evaluation results show that Espresso can improve SSD resource utilization by 50.4% and reduce monetary cost by 19.0% with negligible performance degradation, compared to the state-of-the-art JBOF designs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 企业级固态硬盘（SSD）集成了大量计算资源（如ARM处理器和板载DRAM）以处理I/O突发。然而，这些资源显著提高了SSD的货币成本，并且在JBOF部署中由于I/O突发的偶发性，这些资源严重利用不足。在本文中，我们提出了Espresso，一种成本高效的JBOF设计，该设计在低货币成本下为每个SSD配备适度的计算资源，同时通过高效的SSD间资源共享提供所需的I/O性能。具体而言，Espresso首先将SSD架构分解为功能不同的组件，实现细粒度的SSD内部资源管理。然后，Espresso采用去中心化方案来管理这些分解后的资源，并利用空闲SSD的计算资源来帮助繁忙的SSD处理I/O突发。这一想法由缓存一致性CXL架构促进，借助该架构，繁忙的SSD可以直接利用所获取的计算资源来加速元数据处理。评估结果表明，与最先进的JBOF设计相比，Espresso可以将SSD资源利用率提高50.4%，同时将货币成本降低19.0%，且性能损失可忽略不计。

import_candidates.title: FORGE: Mitigating Synchronization Amplification for Memory-Disaggregated Caching Systems
import_candidates.abstract: Disaggregated Memory (DM) architectures offer caching systems the potential for elastic scaling and improved resource utilization by decoupling compute and memory. However, this advantage is undermined by costly cross-node synchronization, which exacerbates the overheads of critical cache operations, including hotness tracking, eviction coordination, and memory defragmentation. To address this challenge, we present FORGE, a caching system tailored for DM that prioritizes synchronization efficiency. FORGE groups cached objects based on similarity and performs group-level synchronizations to amortize overheads. It evicts cold groups via a contention-free and hotness-aware FIFO queue, efficiently sustaining high hit ratios while mitigating memory fragmentation. Leveraging the predictability of FIFO evictions, FORGE adopts a lazy synchronization strategy that updates hotness metrics just-in-time for eviction and offloads this process to on-chip memory in RDMA NICs for acceleration. Extensive evaluations on YCSB and real-world workloads demonstrate that FORGE achieves up to 4.5× higher throughput, 4.0×/7.5× lower P50/P99 latency, and an average of 1.14× higher cache hit ratio compared with state-of-the-art systems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 内存分离（Disaggregated Memory, DM）架构通过解耦计算与内存，为缓存系统提供了弹性扩展和改善资源利用率的潜力。然而，这一优势被昂贵的跨节点同步所削弱，这会加剧关键缓存操作的开销，包括热度跟踪、逐出协调和内存碎片整理。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了FORGE，一个专为DM设计的缓存系统，优先考虑同步效率。FORGE基于相似性对缓存对象进行分组，并执行组级同步以分摊开销。它通过一个无竞争且热度感知的FIFO队列逐出冷组，有效维持高命中率的同时减轻内存碎片化。利用FIFO逐出的可预测性，FORGE采用惰性同步策略，在逐出时即时更新热度指标，并将该过程卸载到RDMA网卡中的片上内存以加速。对YCSB和真实工作负载的大量评估表明，与最先进系统相比，FORGE实现了高达4.5倍的吞吐量提升、4.0倍/7.5倍的P50/P99延迟降低，以及平均1.14倍的缓存命中率提升。

import_candidates.title: Accelerating Confidential Databases with Crypto-Free Mappings
import_candidates.abstract:
Confidential databases (CDBs) enable secure queries over sensitive data in untrusted cloud environments using confidential computing hardware. While adoption is growing, widespread deployment is hindered by high overheads from frequent synchronous cryptographic operations, which cause significant computational and I/O bottlenecks.
ZENO is a novel CDB design that removes cryptographic operations from the critical path. It introduces crypto-free mappings that maintain data-independent identifiers within the database while securely mapping them to plaintext secrets in a trusted domain. This paradigm shift yields substantial performance gains across industry-standard benchmarks (TPC-C, TPC-H) and a real-world industrial workload. Specifically, ZENO speeds up TPC-H queries by up to 53.1× on ARM S-EL2 and 94.7× on x86 TDX compared to HEDB. ZENO’s optimization techniques have been integrated into GaussDB.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 机密数据库（CDBs）利用机密计算硬件在不受信任的云环境中对敏感数据执行安全查询。虽然采用率正在增长，但由于频繁的同步密码操作带来的巨大计算和 I/O 瓶颈，其广泛部署仍受到阻碍。ZENO 是一种新颖的 CDB 设计，它将密码操作从关键路径中移除。它引入了无密码映射，在数据库内维护与数据无关的标识符，同时在可信域内安全地将它们映射到明文秘密。这种范式转变在行业标准基准测试（TPC-C、TPC-H）和真实工业负载中取得了显著的性能提升。具体来说，与 HEDB 相比，ZENO 在 ARM S-EL2 上将 TPC-H 查询速度提升了最多 53.1 倍，在 x86 TDX 上提升了最多 94.7 倍。ZENO 的优化技术已集成到 GaussDB 中。

import_candidates.title: JANUS: Cross-World, Cooperative Nested Virtualization for Secure Containers
import_candidates.abstract:
Secure containers such as Kata Containers strengthen isolation by running each container inside a lightweight VM. On today’s virtualized clouds, this creates an unavoidable form of nested virtualization with dominant cost in memory virtualization. Existing approaches entangle CPU virtualization and three-level page-table management across hypervisors, forcing frequent cross-world synchronization and producing severe overheads for mixed memory-access workloads.
We present JANUS, a cross-world, cooperative nested virtualization architecture that cleanly separates CPU and memory virtualization responsibilities. JANUS performs all guest world switches entirely within the guest hypervisor through a lightweight switcher mechanism, while delegating all memory translation to the host hypervisor. This separation removes the host from the critical path of CPU events and eliminates the intermediate shadow or nested page tables that burden existing designs. JANUS introduces several key techniques, including VMFUNC-based EPTP switching for trap-free transitions between guest and nested-guest address spaces; a shadow-root mechanism that protects world-switch integration while allowing direct updates to the nested guest’s page tables; and in-guest virtualization exception handling that enables the guest hypervisor to resolve second-level faults with only a single lightweight host interaction. Evaluations demonstrate that JANUS delivers an average performance improvement of 144% over PVM and 28.6% over KVM-based nested virtualization for real-world applications, and imposes less than 5% overhead compared to native containers in production deployment. JANUS demonstrates that rethinking nested virtualization around cross-world cooperation yields strong isolation with near-native container performance.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Kata Containers 等安全容器通过将每个容器运行在轻量级虚拟机内来增强隔离性。在当今的虚拟化云环境中，这不可避免地形成嵌套虚拟化，其主要代价在于内存虚拟化。现有方法将 CPU 虚拟化和跨两层虚拟机监控器的三级页表管理纠缠在一起，导致频繁的跨世界同步，并对混合内存访问工作负载产生严重开销。我们提出 JANUS，一种跨世界、协作式嵌套虚拟化架构，将 CPU 虚拟化与内存虚拟化职责清晰分离。JANUS 完全在客户机虚拟机监控器内部通过轻量级切换机制执行所有客户机世界切换，同时将所有内存翻译委托给宿主机虚拟机监控器。这种分离使宿主机不再处于 CPU 事件关键路径，并消除了现有设计所负担的中间影子页表或嵌套页表。JANUS 引入了多项关键技术，包括基于 VMFUNC 的 EPTP 切换，实现客户机与嵌套客户机地址空间之间的无陷阱转换；一种影子根机制，在允许直接更新嵌套客户机页表的同时保护世界切换集成；以及客户机内虚拟化异常处理，使客户机虚拟机监控器仅需一次轻量级宿主机交互即可解析二级故障。评估表明，对于真实应用，JANUS 相比 PVM 平均性能提升 144%，相比基于 KVM 的嵌套虚拟化提升 28.6%，并且在生产部署中相比原生容器开销低于 5%。JANUS 表明，围绕跨世界协作重新思考嵌套虚拟化可以在保持近原生容器性能的同时提供强隔离。

import_candidates.title: Osprey: Transparent and Efficient Virtual Memory for Secure Computation
import_candidates.abstract:
There is increasing interest in privacy-preserving data analytics applications. These applications rely on Secure Computation (SC), a family of cryptographic techniques for computing on encrypted data. Unfortunately, SC amplifies the memory overhead of data-intensive data analytics applications, presenting a serious obstacle to their widespread deployment.
Osprey is a memory management framework that enables SC to efficiently page to an SSD. It works at runtime and is transparent to SC applications, similar to classical OS virtual memory. This resolves a serious limitation in prior SC-aware memory management, which requires up-front planning and rewriting applications in a new programming framework.
Osprey achieves this using speculative execution. While speculative execution is powerful, it normally requires complex and error-prone in-kernel support, and therefore is not widely deployed for OS processes. Our central observation in Osprey is that, by carefully leveraging SC’s obliviousness, we can make speculative execution for SC workloads practical and efficient. Osprey requires changing < 200 lines of code in each SC library that we tested, and no lines of code in SC applications written against those libraries.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 人们对隐私保护的数据分析应用越来越感兴趣。这类应用依赖安全计算（Secure Computation, SC），即在加密数据上进行计算的密码学技术。然而，SC会放大数据密集型数据分析应用的内存开销，严重阻碍了其大规模部署。Osprey是一个内存管理框架，能够让SC高效地分页到SSD。它在运行时工作，对SC应用透明，类似于经典操作系统虚拟内存。这解决了先前SC感知内存管理的严重局限——需要预先规划并用新的编程框架重写应用。Osprey利用投机执行实现这一点。尽管投机执行十分强大，但通常需要复杂且容易出错的内核支持，因此并未被操作系统进程广泛采用。我们在Osprey中的核心观察是：通过仔细利用SC的不经意性，可以使投机执行对SC工作负载变得实用且高效。在我们测试的每个SC库中，Osprey仅需修改不到200行代码，而针对这些库编写的SC应用则无需修改任何代码。

import_candidates.title: Nested SEV: Secure and Generic SEV Support for Nested Virtualization
import_candidates.abstract: In cloud environments, sensitive information in virtual machines (VMs) is exposed to insider threats. To protect VMs from malicious cloud insiders, modern clouds provide confidential VMs based on technologies such as AMD SEV, which transparently encrypts the memory of VMs and the state of CPU registers while ensuring their integrity. However, existing SEV support is not sufficient for nested virtualization, where a guest hypervisor (L1 hypervisor) runs inside a host VM (L1 VM) managed by the host hypervisor (L0 hypervisor) and creates guest VMs (L2 VMs). This paper proposes nested SEV to provide more secure and generic SEV support for nested virtualization. Nested SEV allows SEV-enabled L2 VMs to run inside an SEV-enabled L1 VM. It supports two trust models: (1) both the L0 and L1 hypervisors are untrusted, and (2) the L0 hypervisor is untrusted but the L1 hypervisor is trusted. For these trust models, nested SEV provides two mechanisms. SEV virtualization protects L2 VMs against both the L0 and L1 hypervisors. In contrast, SEV passthrough protects them against the L0 hypervisor but allows the L1 hypervisor to access the memory of L2 VMs by sharing the SEV context. These mechanisms rely on emulation-less multiplexing and SEV context decoupling. We implemented nested SEV in three different types of hypervisors and showed that the average performance degradation ranged from 0.9% to 30% across three SEV variants.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在云环境中，虚拟机中的敏感信息面临内部威胁的威胁。为了保护虚拟机免受恶意云内部人员的侵害，现代云基于AMD SEV等技术提供机密虚拟机，这些技术透明地加密虚拟机的内存和CPU寄存器状态，同时确保其完整性。然而，现有的SEV支持不足以支持嵌套虚拟化，其中客户机管理程序（L1管理程序）运行在宿主机管理程序（L0管理程序）管理的宿主机虚拟机（L1 VM）内，并创建客户机虚拟机（L2 VM）。本文提出了嵌套SEV，为嵌套虚拟化提供更安全、更通用的SEV支持。嵌套SEV允许启用SEV的L2虚拟机在启用SEV的L1虚拟机内运行。它支持两种信任模型：（1）L0和L1管理程序均不可信；（2）L0管理程序不可信但L1管理程序可信。针对这些信任模型，嵌套SEV提供了两种机制。SEV虚拟化可保护L2虚拟机免受L0和L1管理程序的攻击。相比之下，SEV透传则保护它们免受L0管理程序的攻击，但允许L1管理程序通过共享SEV上下文访问L2虚拟机的内存。这些机制依赖于无模拟多路复用和SEV上下文解耦。我们在三种不同类型的管理程序中实现了嵌套SEV，结果显示平均性能下降幅度在0.9%至30%之间，横跨三种SEV变体。

import_candidates.title: μUSB: Practical and Safe USB Driver Reuse for Arm TrustZone
import_candidates.abstract:
TrustZone isolates device access with secure I/O, yet lacks support for USB devices, which constitute the most diverse peripherals. Existing approaches to integrate USB drivers into the TEE are impractical due to the complex USB protocols, high-frequency DMA accesses, and varying vendor implementations.
In this paper, we present μUSB, a system that derives a functional, micro USB driver for TrustZone from the observable concrete execution traces of a full-fledged, complex USB driver, an approach we dub record, lift, and replay. Based on the key insight of kernel specialization and the deterministic nature of USB FSMs, μUSB proposes a lightweight mutational recorder and a novel program analysis technique, addressing two challenges: how to record USB execution sufficiently and analyze the traces deeply?
Across four major USB classes and six diverse devices, μUSB generates performant, ready-to-use USB drivers for TrustZone, enabling in-TEE apps to, for the first time, leverage complex USB devices with near-native performance while still enjoying full TrustZone protection.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: TrustZone通过安全I/O隔离设备访问，但缺乏对USB设备的支持，而USB设备构成了最多样化的外设。由于USB协议复杂、DMA访问频繁且供应商实现各异，将USB驱动集成到TEE的现有方法并不实用。在本文中，我们提出了μUSB，一种基于完整复杂USB驱动的可观察具体执行轨迹，为TrustZone派生出一个功能性的微型USB驱动的系统，这种方法我们称之为“记录、提升与重放”（record, lift, and replay）。基于内核特化和USB有限状态机确定性这一关键见解，μUSB提出了一种轻量级突变记录器和一种新颖的程序分析技术，解决了两个挑战：如何充分记录USB执行以及如何深度分析轨迹。在四大USB类别和六种不同设备上，μUSB生成了性能良好、可即用的TrustZone USB驱动，使TEE内应用首次能够利用复杂的USB设备，获得接近原生的性能，同时享受完整的TrustZone保护。

import_candidates.title: Achieving Cloud-Grade SLOs for Local Mixture-of-Experts Inference through CPU–GPU Hybrid Design
import_candidates.abstract: Local deployment of large Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models falls short of the service quality achieved in cloud-scale environments, even under low-concurrency workloads. We identify four key gaps in local MoE inference: reliance on capacity-reduced models (quantized, distilled, rerouted), inability to meet 30-second TTFT for long prefills (>12K), sub-baseline decode throughput (<20 tokens/s), and poor concurrency under mixed prefill–decode and batched decode workloads. We present a CPU–GPU hybrid system that achieves cloud-level SLOs on dual-socket commodity CPUs and consumer GPUs by (1) stream-loading prefill (SLP), boosting prefill throughput to 1,200 tokens/s and enabling 32K prompts within 30 seconds; (2) distributed SLP (DSLP) with SmallEP expert parallelism, reaching 1,800 tokens/s and 45K prompts in 30 seconds on two RTX 5090s; (3) intra-node prefill–decode disaggregation with zero-copy shared weights and a dual-batch attention–MoE overlap scheme, sustaining concurrency with <15% latency increase and 50% throughput gains; (4) an AVX-512–optimized FP8 GEMV kernel, enabling native CPU FP8 inference while delivering 4–5× lower CPU latency; and (5) fine-grained CPU parallelism that attains 28 tokens/s on INT4 DeepSeek-V3 and 21.5 tokens/s on intact FP8 V3. Evaluations show our system delivers cloud-level QoS for flagship MoE models on consumer CPU–GPU platforms, reshaping local deployment with intact, original-precision inference and enabling high-quality, cost-effective access without datacenter infrastructure.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大型混合专家（MoE）模型的本地部署在服务质量上达不到云规模环境所达到的水平，即使在低并发工作负载下也是如此。我们识别了本地MoE推理中的四个关键差距：依赖容量缩减的模型（量化、蒸馏、重路由）、无法为长预填充（>12K）满足30秒的TTFT、低于基线的解码吞吐（<20 tokens/s），以及在混合预填充-解码和批量解码工作负载下的并发性差。我们提出了一个CPU–GPU混合系统，通过以下方式在双插槽商用CPU和消费级GPU上实现云级SLO：（1）流式加载预填充（SLP），将预填充吞吐量提高到1,200 tokens/s，并能在30秒内处理32K提示；（2）分布式SLP（DSLP）与SmallEP专家并行，在两块RTX 5090上达到1,800 tokens/s和45K提示/30秒；（3）节点内预填充-解码分离，具有零拷贝共享权重和双批注意–MoE重叠方案，在<15%延迟增加和50%吞吐提升的情况下维持并发；（4）一个AVX-512优化的FP8 GEMV内核，使原生CPU FP8推理成为可能，同时将CPU延迟降低4–5倍；（5）细粒度CPU并行性，在INT4 DeepSeek-V3上达到28 tokens/s，在完整FP8 V3上达到21.5 tokens/s。评估表明，我们的系统在消费级CPU–GPU平台上为旗舰MoE模型提供了云级QoS，以完整、原始精度的推理重塑本地部署，无需数据中心基础设施即可实现高质量、成本效益高的访问。

import_candidates.title: UEP: Portable Expert-Parallel Communication
import_candidates.abstract: Modern Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) workloads rely on expert parallelism (EP) to achieve high GPU efficiency. State-of-the-art EP communication libraries, such as DeepEP, rely on GPU-initiated RDMA communication. Although performant, they have poor portability across heterogeneous GPU and NIC hardware. The poor portability is rooted in its architecture: GPU-initiated RDMA communication requires tight vertical integration between GPUs and NICs, e.g., GPU writing to NIC driver/MMIO interfaces. We present UEP, a portable EP communication system that delivers high performance across heterogeneous GPU and NIC hardware. UEP replaces GPU-initiated RDMA with a high-throughput GPU-CPU control channel: compact token-routing commands are transferred to multithreaded CPU proxies, which then issue GPUDirect RDMA operations on behalf of GPUs. UEP further emulates various ordering semantics required by specialized EP communication modes using RDMA immediate data, enabling correctness on NICs that lack such ordering, e.g., AWS EFA. We implement UEP on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs with EFA and Broadcom NICs. On EFA, it outperforms the best existing EP solution by 2.1× for dispatch and combine throughput. UEP also improves token throughput on SGLang by up to 40% on the NVIDIA+EFA platform, and improves DeepSeek-V3 training throughput over the AMD Primus/Megatron-LM framework by up to 45% on a 16-node AMD+Broadcom platform.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代混合专家（MoE）工作负载依赖专家并行（EP）来实现高 GPU 效率。最先进的 EP 通信库（如 DeepEP）依赖 GPU 发起的 RDMA 通信。虽然性能优异，但它们在异构 GPU 和 NIC 硬件上的可移植性较差。这种可移植性差的根源在于其架构：GPU 发起的 RDMA 通信要求 GPU 与 NIC 之间紧密的垂直集成，例如 GPU 直接写入 NIC 驱动/MMIO 接口。我们提出 UEP，一个可移植的 EP 通信系统，可在异构 GPU 和 NIC 硬件上提供高性能。UEP 用高吞吐量的 GPU-CPU 控制通道取代了 GPU 发起的 RDMA：紧凑的令牌路由命令被传输到多线程 CPU 代理，然后由代理代表 GPU 发起 GPUDirect RDMA 操作。UEP 还利用 RDMA 立即数据模拟特定 EP 通信模式所需的各种排序语义，从而在缺乏此类排序的 NIC（如 AWS EFA）上保证正确性。我们在 NVIDIA 和 AMD GPU 上，使用 EFA 和 Broadcom NIC 实现了 UEP。在 EFA 上，其调度和组合吞吐量比现有最佳 EP 解决方案高出 2.1 倍。UEP 在 NVIDIA+EFA 平台上将 SGLang 的令牌吞吐量提升了高达 40%，并在 16 节点 AMD+Broadcom 平台上，将 DeepSeek-V3 训练吞吐量较 AMD Primus/Megatron-LM 框架提升了高达 45%。

import_candidates.title: BatchGen: An Architecture for Scalable and Efficient Batch Inference
import_candidates.abstract:
Batch inference has become a central mode of AI computation, yet existing inference engines still rely on execution models designed for interactive serving. When scaled to millions of sequences, batch workloads reveal two fundamental requirements: the ability to handle extreme inter- and intra-sequence load variation that emerges only at runtime, and the ability to sustain high utilization across large fleets of GPUs. Existing systems fail to meet these requirements, losing substantial fractions of achievable throughput.
We introduce a new architectural foundation for batch inference: the sequence coroutine compute model, which represents each sequence as a fine-grained, event-driven coroutine. This model exposes expressive primitives that allow the runtime to reorganize work dynamically, enabling larger expert-level batches, mitigating stragglers, reallocating work across devices, and maintaining utilization even on cost-effective or memory-constrained GPUs. Building on this abstraction, we implement BatchGen, a production-ready system that uses the coroutine model at cluster scale. On a 128-GPU cluster, BatchGen reduces batch completion time by up to 2.3×, and on memory-constrained accelerators it outperforms the strongest offloading baseline by up to 9.6×.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 批处理推理已成为AI计算的核心模式，然而现有推理引擎仍依赖于为交互式服务设计的执行模型。当扩展到数百万序列时，批处理工作负载揭示了两个基本需求：一是能够处理仅在运行时出现的极端序列间和序列内负载变化，二是能够在大型GPU机群上维持高利用率。现有系统无法满足这些需求，从而损失了相当大比例的可实现吞吐量。我们引入了批处理推理的新架构基础：序列协程计算模型，即将每个序列表示为一个细粒度的事件驱动协程。该模型暴露了富有表现力的原语，使运行时能够动态重新组织工作，从而实现更大的专家级批次、缓解掉队者、跨设备重新分配工作，即使在经济型或内存受限的GPU上也能保持利用率。基于此抽象，我们实现了BatchGen，一个在集群规模上使用协程模型的生产级系统。在128个GPU组成的集群上，BatchGen将批次完成时间缩短了最多2.3倍，在内存受限的加速器上，其性能比最强的卸载基线高出最多9.6倍。

import_candidates.title: UCCL-Tran: An Extensible Software Transport Layer for GPU Networking
import_candidates.abstract: Fast-evolving machine learning (ML) workloads have increasing requirements for networking. However, host network transport on RDMA NICs is hard to evolve, causing problems for ML workloads. For example, single-path RDMA traffic is prone to flow collisions that severely degrade collective communication performance. We present UCCL-Tran, an extensible software transport layer to evolve GPU networking. UCCL-Tran decouples the data path and control path of existing RDMA NICs and efficiently runs the control-path transport on host CPUs. This software extensibility brings in transport innovations that cannot be achieved in hardware for ML workloads, e.g., a multipath transport to resolve flow collisions. ML collectives atop UCCL-Tran achieve up to 4.5× higher performance compared to existing RDMA NICs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 快速发展的机器学习（ML）工作负载对网络的需求日益增加。然而，RDMA网卡上的主机网络传输难以演进，这给ML工作负载带来了问题。例如，单路径RDMA流量容易发生流冲突，严重降低集合通信性能。我们提出UCCL-Tran，一种可扩展的软件传输层，以演进GPU网络。UCCL-Tran将现有RDMA网卡的数据路径和控制路径解耦，并在主机CPU上高效运行控制路径传输。这种软件可扩展性带来了ML工作负载中硬件无法实现的传输创新，例如解决流冲突的多路径传输。基于UCCL-Tran的ML集合通信相比现有RDMA网卡性能最高提升4.5倍。

import_candidates.title: Hardware Lifecycle-Aware Power Planning in Commercial Hyperscale Datacenters (Operational Systems)
import_candidates.abstract:
Modern commercial datacenters operate with heterogeneous hardware, deploying new servers to meet the growing compute demands while retaining older servers due to budgetary and environmental constraints. Datacenter planners can use daily performance and power profiling data to continually refine power budgets for legacy hardware. By contrast, power planning for new hardware must begin as early as the pre-silicon stage of server development when such data is not yet available. This paper presents our practical experience in power planning for Meta’s datacenters over the past decade, emphasizing heterogeneous hardware, and shares strategies for future power planning and management.
To plan power more efficiently, we begin with a comprehensive power characterization study for hyperscale workloads in Meta’s datacenters, using live production traffic data spanning millions of servers across multiple hardware generations. Building on characterization insights, we present a hardware lifecycle-aware rack power budgeting methodology accounting for both the hardware and workload heterogeneity. This methodology has been deployed at scale in Meta’s datacenters for over a decade, enabling an average power oversubscription of approximately 20% across the fleet.
Though effective, the current power planning approach requires production-level power telemetry, which is typically unavailable during the early stages of hardware development. To address this challenge, we develop PowerSight, a machine learning-based model to predict system power without relying on power sensor data. We demonstrate practical use cases of PowerSight for improving power planning in future system deployments. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first comprehensive study to formally introduce the concept of hardware lifecycles in commercial datacenters, along with tailored power budgeting strategies for each phase.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代商业数据中心以异构硬件运行，一方面部署新服务器以满足不断增长的计算需求，另一方面因预算和环境限制保留旧服务器。数据中心规划者可以利用每日性能和功耗画像数据来不断优化旧硬件的功耗预算。相比之下，新硬件的功耗规划必须在服务器开发的硅前阶段就启动，而此时这类数据尚不可用。本文介绍了我们在Meta数据中心过去十年中关于功耗规划的实际经验，强调了异构硬件，并分享了未来功耗规划和管理策略。为了更高效地规划功耗，我们首先对Meta数据中心中的超大规模负载进行全面的功耗特征分析，使用来自数百万台服务器、跨越多个硬件代际的实时生产流量数据。基于特征分析的洞察，我们提出了一种硬件生命周期感知的机架功耗预算方法，同时考虑了硬件和工作负载的异构性。该方法已在Meta数据中心大规模部署超过十年，实现了整个机群平均约20%的功耗超额订阅。尽管有效，当前的功耗规划方法需要生产级功耗遥测，而这在硬件开发的早期阶段通常不可用。为解决这一挑战，我们开发了PowerSight，一个基于机器学习的模型，在不依赖功率传感器数据的情况下预测系统功耗。我们展示了PowerSight在改善未来系统部署中功耗规划的实际用例。据我们所知，这是第一项正式引入商业数据中心硬件生命周期概念以及针对每个阶段量身定制的功耗预算策略的综合研究。

import_candidates.title: Kareus: Joint Reduction of Dynamic and Static Energy in Large Model Training
import_candidates.abstract:
The computing demand of AI is growing at an unprecedented rate, but energy supply is not keeping pace. As a result, energy has become an expensive and contended resource that requires explicit management and optimization. Although recent works have made significant progress in large model training optimization, they focus on optimizing either dynamic or static energy consumption.
We find that fine-grained kernel scheduling and frequency scaling jointly and interdependently impact both dynamic and static energy consumption. Based on this finding, we design Kareus, a training system that pushes the time–energy tradeoff frontier by optimizing both aspects. Kareus decomposes the intractable joint optimization problem into local, partition-based subproblems. It then uses a multi-pass multi-objective optimization algorithm to find execution schedules that push the time–energy tradeoff frontier. Compared to the state of the art, Kareus reduces training energy by up to 28.3% at the same training time, or reduces training time by up to 27.5% at the same energy consumption.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 人工智能的计算需求正以前所未有的速度增长，但能源供应却未能跟上步伐。因此，能源已成为一种昂贵且备受争抢的资源，需要明确的管理和优化。尽管近期工作在大型模型训练优化方面取得了重大进展，但它们仅侧重于优化动态或静态能耗之一。我们发现细粒度的内核调度和频率调节会共同且相互依赖地影响动态和静态能耗。基于这一发现，我们设计了Kareus——一个通过优化这两个方面来推动时间-能耗权衡前沿的训练系统。Kareus将棘手的联合优化问题分解为局部的、基于分区的子问题，然后使用多遍多目标优化算法来寻找能够推动时间-能耗权衡前沿的执行调度。与现有最先进方法相比，Kareus在相同训练时间下能耗最多减少28.3%，或在相同能耗下训练时间最多减少27.5%。

import_candidates.title: SPADE: Signal-Aware DAG Scheduling and Dynamic Provisioning for Data Processing Clusters
import_candidates.abstract: As AI-driven demand reshapes the data center landscape, external signals—such as energy cost, carbon intensity, power availability, and water usage—are increasingly dictating how much compute is available at any moment.
