These signals tend to vary over time, challenging traditional cluster schedulers, which implicitly assume stable resource supply, and calls for systems that continuously adapt to time-varying conditions. We focus on batch data-processing workloads, which are delay-tolerant but constitute a healthy fraction of total compute, making them a natural target for such flexibility. The directed acyclic graph (DAG) structure of these data-processing jobs makes decisions uniquely challenging, since delaying certain tasks in the DAG (e.g., bottleneck tasks) can stall entire pipelines. We introduce SPADE, a signal-aware scheduling and provisioning system that jointly considers workload DAG structure and external time-varying signals when deciding how (provisioning) and when (scheduling) to allocate resources. To underscore the importance of coupling these decisions, we evaluate SAP, an ablated system that preserves SPADE’s signal-aware provisioning but delegates scheduling to arbitrary signal-agnostic policies. Using a Spark prototype deployed on a 100-node Kubernetes cluster, we show that SPADE reduces a secondary objective (e.g., the cost associated with carbon intensity or energy price) by 32.9% while maintaining overall cluster throughput.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着人工智能驱动的需求重塑数据中心格局，外部信号（如能源成本、碳强度、电力可用性和用水量）日益决定着任一时刻可用的计算量。这些信号往往随时间变化，对传统集群调度器构成挑战，因为传统调度器隐含地假设资源供应稳定，因此需要能够持续适应时变条件的系统。我们聚焦于批处理数据处理工作负载，这类负载对延迟不敏感，但占总计算量的相当比例，因此是这种灵活性的自然目标。这些数据处理作业的有向无环图（DAG）结构使决策尤为困难，因为延迟DAG中的某些任务（如瓶颈任务）可能导致整个流水线停滞。我们提出了SPADE，一个信号感知的调度和资源供给系统，在决定如何（资源供给）和何时（调度）分配资源时，联合考虑工作负载DAG结构和外部时变信号。为了强调耦合这些决策的重要性，我们评估了一个消融系统SAP，该系统保留SPADE的信号感知资源供给，但将调度委托给任意的信号无关策略。通过在一个100节点Kubernetes集群上部署的Spark原型，我们证明SPADE在保持整体集群吞吐量的同时，将次要目标（例如与碳强度或能源价格相关的成本）降低了32.9%。

import_candidates.title: Quota Marketplace: Dynamic Pricing for Efficient Allocation of ML Training Resources
import_candidates.abstract:
The escalating demand for Machine Learning (ML) training resources in recent years has resulted in a substantial gap between the high demand and the available supply. Efficient allocation of these scarce and expensive resources is crucial for organizations to maximize their return on investment. Existing resource allocation mechanisms, like Karma [OSDI ’23], are designed to guarantee Pareto efficiency and max-min fairness in settings with dynamic (time-varying) user demands, but fail to preserve these key properties in the presence of demands with heterogeneous values. Given the ubiquity and inevitability of heterogeneity in organizational values of different workloads, effective resource allocation policies must accommodate these variations.
In this paper, we describe the design, implementation, deployment, and theoretical analysis of Quota Marketplace, a market-based mechanism to efficiently allocate ML training chips (like GPUs), explicitly addressing scenarios with demands of heterogeneous value. We detail the implementation of this mechanism within Google and present metrics that demonstrate its impact. We also discuss many business-critical requirements that the Quota Marketplace handles quite effectively, and document the gains and opportunities it has unlocked. We establish theoretically how this market-based approach achieves the essential properties of Pareto efficiency and max-min fairness by allowing the users to express the value of their workloads and enabling dynamic resource pricing based on supply and demand fluctuations. Ultimately, the market facilitates resource allocation that aligns with organizational priorities.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 近年来，对机器学习（ML）训练资源的需求不断攀升，导致高需求与可用供应之间出现巨大缺口。有效配置这些稀缺且昂贵的资源，对于组织实现投资回报最大化至关重要。现有的资源分配机制（如Karma[OSDI '23]）旨在保障动态（随时间变化）用户需求环境下的帕累托效率和最大最小公平性，但在需求具有异质价值时却无法保持这些关键性质。鉴于组织中不同工作负载的价值异质性普遍存在且不可避免，有效的资源分配策略必须适应这些差异。本文描述了Quota Marketplace的设计、实现、部署和理论分析。Quota Marketplace是一种基于市场的机制，用于高效分配ML训练芯片（如GPU），明确处理具有异质价值需求的场景。我们详细介绍了该机制在Google内部的实现，并展示了体现其影响的指标。我们还讨论了Quota Marketplace高效处理的许多业务关键需求，并记录了它带来的收益和机遇。我们从理论上确立了这种基于市场的方法如何通过允许用户表达其工作负载的价值，并根据供需波动实现动态资源定价，从而获得帕累托效率和最大最小公平性这两个关键性质。最终，该市场促进了与组织优先级相符的资源分配。

import_candidates.title: Bodega: Localized Linearizable Reads at Anywhere Anytime via Roster Leases
import_candidates.abstract:
We present Bodega, the first consensus protocol that serves linearizable reads locally from any desired node, regardless of interfering writes. Bodega attains this capability via a new notion of cluster metadata called the roster, which is a generalization of leadership; it tracks arbitrary subsets of replicas as responder nodes for local reads. A consistent agreement on the roster is established through roster leases, an all-to-all leasing mechanism that generalizes existing all-to-one leasing approaches (Leader Leases, Quorum Leases), unlocking a new point in the protocol design space. Bodega further employs optimistic holding and early accept notifications optimizations to minimize interruption from interfering writes, and smart roster coverage and lightweight heartbeats to maximize practicality. Bodega is a non-intrusive extension to classic consensus; it imposes no special requirements on writes other than a responder-covering quorum.
We implement Bodega and related works in Summerset, a protocol-generic replicated key-value store written in async Rust. We compare it to previous protocols (Leader Leases, EPaxos, PQR, and Quorum Leases) and two production coordination services (etcd and ZooKeeper). Bodega speeds up average client read requests by 5.6x∼13.1x on real WAN clusters versus previous approaches under moderate write interference, and closely matches the performance of sequentially-consistent etcd and ZooKeeper deployments across YCSB workloads. Bodega supports fast proactive roster changes and delivers on-par write performance. Our Summerset codebase is open-sourced at https://github.com/josehu07/summerset/tree/bodega-artifact.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出Bodega，这是第一个共识协议，能从任意所需节点本地提供线性一致的读取，无论是否存在干扰性写入。Bodega通过一种称为roster（花名册）的新型集群元数据实现了这一能力，该元数据是领导权的推广；它跟踪任意的副本子集作为本地读取的响应节点。通过roster租约——一种全到全的租约机制，推广了现有的全到一租约方法（Leader租约、Quorum租约）——建立对roster的一致性共识，从而解锁了协议设计空间中的新点。Bodega进一步采用乐观持有和提前接受通知的优化，以最小化干扰性写入的影响，并通过智能roster覆盖和轻量级心跳来最大化实用性。Bodega是对经典共识协议的非侵入式扩展；除了需要包含响应节点的法定人数外，它对写入不施加任何特殊要求。我们用Summerset实现了Bodega及其相关工作，这是一个用异步Rust编写的协议通用复制键值存储。我们将其与之前的协议（Leader租约、EPaxos、PQR和Quorum租约）以及两个生产级协调服务（etcd和ZooKeeper）进行了比较。在真实的广域网集群中，与之前的方法相比，在适度的写入干扰下，Bodega将平均客户端读取请求加速了5.6倍至13.1倍，并且在YCSB工作负载下与顺序一致的etcd和ZooKeeper部署性能基本相当。Bodega支持快速主动的roster变更，并提供相当的写入性能。我们的Summerset代码库已在https://github.com/josehu07/summerset/tree/bodega-artifact开源。

import_candidates.title: Equal Opportunity: A Correctness Condition for Ordered Consensus
import_candidates.abstract: In proof-of-stake blockchains based on State Machine Replication (SMR), the order of transactions directly affects client-visible financial outcomes. Ordered consensus augments the SMR specification by imposing correctness conditions on transaction ordering, with a focus on limiting Byzantine influence. However, real-world ordering attacks can occur even when these conditions hold, often enabled by advantages such as faster networks or proximity to the blockchain infrastructure that allow an adversary to systematically bias outcomes without violating the conditions. To address this gap, we extend ordered consensus with a new model and correctness condition based on  equal opportunity, a notion of fairness widely used in legal contexts. Equal opportunity requires that candidates who are equally qualified—according to criteria deemed  relevant—have equal chances of being selected (here, for a given position in the total order). We show how carefully introduced randomness can bound ordering bias, and we introduce the Secret Random Oracle (SRO), a fault-tolerant abstraction for generating such randomness. We present two SRO constructions, based on trusted hardware and threshold verifiable random functions, respectively, and use them to build Pompē-SRO, a new ordered consensus protocol that mitigates well-known ordering attacks. Our evaluation shows that Pompē-SRO effectively mitigates front-running and sandwich attacks at a moderate cost to latency.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在基于状态机复制（SMR）的权益证明区块链中，交易顺序直接影响客户端可见的财务结果。有序共识通过施加关于交易顺序的正确性条件来扩展SMR规范，重点限制拜占庭影响。然而，即使满足这些条件，现实中的排序攻击仍可能发生，通常借助更快的网络或靠近区块链基础设施等优势，使对手能够系统性地偏置结果而不违反条件。为解决这一差距，我们将有序共识扩展为一个基于“平等机会”（equal opportunity）的新模型和正确性条件。“平等机会”是法律语境中广泛使用的公平性概念，要求同等合格的候选人——根据被认为相关的标准判定——在选中机会上相等（此处指在总顺序中占据给定位置的机会）。我们展示了如何通过精心引入的随机性来限制排序偏差，并引入了秘密随机预言机（SRO），一种用于生成此类随机性的容错抽象。我们提出了两种SRO构造，分别基于可信硬件和阈值可验证随机函数，并使用它们构建Pompē-SRO，一种可缓解著名排序攻击的新型有序共识协议。我们的评估表明，Pompē-SRO以适度的延迟成本有效缓解了抢跑攻击和三明治攻击。

import_candidates.title: Jetpack: Consensus Made Generally Fast
import_candidates.abstract: Classic consensus protocols such as Raft require 2 round- trip times (RTTs) for a client to commit a command. Recent protocols reduce this latency to 1 RTT through a carefully designed fast path, but these fast paths are tightly coupled to their host protocols and cannot be retrofitted to existing systems. This paper presents Jetpack, a plugin framework that adds a 1-RTT fast path to existing consensus protocols with minimal modifications. Jetpack issues commands concurrently to both a fast path and the original path, committing when the fast path succeeds while ensuring the original path honors the same decision. The key challenge is maintaining this guarantee across view changes: we identify the view change hazard, a subtle correctness issue where promises made during stable operation can become invalid after leader elections. Jetpack captures this in two structural requirements and two design principles that a fast-path layer can apply across consensus environments, conditions that are easy to overlook when a fast-path idea is adapted to a new setting, as we illustrate with prior designs and a deployed system. We evaluate Jetpack on six consensus systems across 10 AWS datacenters. Results show that Jetpack achieves 1-RTT latency, reducing average commit latency by as much as 60%, while preserving the original path’s performance and proper- ties when the fast path is not used.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 诸如Raft之类的经典共识协议需要2次往返时间（RTT）才能让客户端提交一条命令。最近的协议通过精心设计的快速路径将延迟降低到1 RTT，但这些快速路径与其宿主协议紧密耦合，无法改造到现有系统中。本文提出了Jetpack，一个插件框架，能以最小的修改为现有共识协议添加1-RTT快速路径。Jetpack同时向快速路径和原始路径并发发出命令，在快速路径成功时提交，同时确保原始路径遵循相同的决定。关键挑战是在视图变更期间维持这一保证：我们发现了视图变更隐患，这是一个微妙的正确性问题，即稳定运行期间做出的承诺在领导者选举后可能失效。Jetpack通过两个结构要求和两个设计原则加以解决，快速路径层可以跨共识环境应用这些原则和条件。正如我们通过先前的设计和已部署系统所展示的，当一个快速路径的想法被适配到新环境时，这些条件很容易被忽视。我们在10个AWS数据中心上的六个共识系统上评估了Jetpack。结果表明，Jetpack实现了1-RTT延迟，平均提交延迟最多降低60%，同时在不使用快速路径时保留了原始路径的性能和属性。

import_candidates.title: Ambulance: Saving BFT through Racing
import_candidates.abstract: Today’s practical Byzantine Fault Tolerant (BFT) state machine replication deployments are vulnerable to slowdowns. The main culprit is timeouts. Aggressive timeouts spuriously trigger expensive leader changes, while conservative timeouts leave the system idle and let slowdowns severely inflate latency. Two main alternatives exist: hedging, which improves recovery from slow leaders but still incurs a time-based hedging delay, and cooperative asynchronous protocols, which recover quickly from slowdowns but suffer from high common-case latency and low throughput. This paper presents Ambulance: a BFT state machine replication protocol that sidesteps this trade-off through protocol-rigged races, where replicas, rather than race against the clock, race against each other by executing protocol steps. This enables Ambulance to achieve high throughput and low latency comparable to state-of-the-art timeout-based BFT, while matching the robustness of cooperative approaches.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 当今实用的拜占庭容错（BFT）状态机复制部署容易受到减速的影响。主要罪魁祸首是超时。激进的超时会错误地触发昂贵的领导者更换，而保守的超时则会使系统空闲并让减速严重增加延迟。存在两种主要替代方案：对冲（hedging），它可以改善从慢速领导者中恢复的能力，但仍会带来基于时间的对冲延迟；以及协作式异步协议，它可以从减速中快速恢复，但会遭受较高的常见情况延迟和较低的吞吐量。本文提出了Ambulance：一种通过协议预设竞赛（protocol-rigged races）来规避这一权衡的BFT状态机复制协议，其中副本不是与时间赛跑，而是通过执行协议步骤相互竞争。这使得Ambulance能够实现与最先进的基于超时的BFT相当的高吞吐量和低延迟，同时具备协作方法般的鲁棒性。

import_candidates.title: SDCs in the Wild: Characterizing and Diagnosing SDC-Defective GPUs in Production LLM Training (Operational Systems)
import_candidates.abstract: Silent Data Corruption (SDC) has emerged as a critical reliability bottleneck in Large Language Model (LLM) training, where hardware faults are frequently indistinguishable from software anomalies. While standard industry practice relies on synthetic microbenchmarks for fault isolation, our experience shows these methods miss over 60% of defective devices. To understand this gap, we present a comprehensive characterization of 23 SDC-defective GPUs harvested from a large-scale production cluster. Our analysis reveals three key insights: (1) SDCs are not confined to new hardware but often arise later due to aging; (2) SDCs are highly data-dependent and unit-specific, meaning devices that pass general stress tests often fail under specific training input data; and (3) standard ECC and thermal protections fail to capture these logic-level bit flips. Driven by these findings, we propose SDCHunter, an automated diagnosis system for detecting SDC-defective GPUs in a large-scale training cluster. Instead of relying on generic benchmarks, SDCHunter employs execution replay with the exact training workload and input data that triggered the failure. Deployed at ByteDance, SDCHunter successfully mitigated 40 SDC incidents in production.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 静默数据损坏（SDC）已成为大规模语言模型（LLM）训练中的关键可靠性瓶颈，硬件故障常常与软件异常难以区分。虽然行业标准做法依赖合成微基准测试进行故障隔离，但我们的经验表明这些方法会漏掉超过60%的有缺陷设备。为理解这一差距，我们对从大型生产集群中收集的23块SDC缺陷GPU进行了全面表征。我们的分析揭示三个关键发现：（1）SDC不仅出现在新硬件中，而且常因老化而后期出现；（2）SDC高度依赖数据且具有单元特异性，意味着通过通用压力测试的设备常常在特定训练输入数据下失效；（3）标准的ECC和热防护无法捕捉这些逻辑级比特翻转。基于这些发现，我们提出SDCHunter，一个用于在大规模训练集群中检测SDC缺陷GPU的自动化诊断系统。SDCHunter不依赖通用基准测试，而是采用精确触发故障的训练工作负载和输入数据进行执行重放。SDCHunter已在字节跳动部署，成功缓解了生产环境中的40起SDC事件。

import_candidates.title: Safeguarding LLM Training at Scale: Online SDC Detection and Insights from 35 Million GPU Hours
import_candidates.abstract: Silent Data Corruption (SDC) poses a critical threat to large-scale LLM training. Existing offline tests and online detection methods provide solutions for large-scale systems, yet they suffer from high overhead or low detection accuracy in LLM training. This paper presents AEGIS, an online SDC detection framework for large-scale LLM training. We introduce a two-stage cSensor-cVerifier abstraction that decouples SDC detection into lightweight corruption sensing and definitive corruption verification. Based on this abstraction, AEGIS co-designs new detection techniques by integrating the inherent features of LLM training with GPU characteristics, enabling practical online SDC detection. In a production deployment spanning 3.5 × 107 GPU-hours, AEGIS identified 18 real-world SDC incidents and 13 faulty GPUs while incurring only 0.86% performance overhead, enabling a systematic empirical characterization of SDCs in large-scale LLM training.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 静默数据损坏（SDC）对大规模LLM训练构成了关键威胁。现有的离线测试和在线检测方法为大规模系统提供了解决方案，但它们在LLM训练中面临高开销或低检测精度的问题。本文提出了AEGIS，一个面向大规模LLM训练的在线SDC检测框架。我们引入了一个两阶段的cSensor-cVerifier抽象，将SDC检测解耦为轻量级的损坏感知和确定性的损坏验证。基于这一抽象，AEGIS通过结合LLM训练的内在特征与GPU特性来协同设计新的检测技术，实现了实用的在线SDC检测。在一个涵盖3.5×10^7 GPU小时的生产部署中，AEGIS识别了18个真实SDC事件和13块故障GPU，同时仅带来0.86%的性能开销，从而支持对大规模LLM训练中SDC进行系统性的实证表征。

import_candidates.title: OpGuard: Bitwise Alignment for Precise and General Debugging of Production LLM Training
import_candidates.abstract: Large-scale LLM training runs on many GPUs for weeks atop rapidly evolving software stacks. Bugs or hardware glitches can silently corrupt the computation and only surface much later. Debugging becomes finding a needle in a haystack across time. Developers often use another training run and compare their loss, gradient norms, etc. But these aggregate signals are noisy and easily diluted across millions of operations, offering little guidance on why the divergence occurs. This paper introduces bitwise alignment as a correctness oracle and debugging primitive for LLM training, and OpGuard, a practical system that realizes it at production scale. OpGuard discovers semantic-stable operator boundaries across heterogeneous training stacks, and wraps them with lightweight fingerprinting. A schedule-tolerant mapper computes the longest prefix where two executions produce bitwise-identical tensors. The first mismatching point becomes a pivot for debugging and is presented with rich context. By carefully controlling benign nondeterminism, OpGuard makes the first mismatch strong evidence of error. OpGuard has been deployed at ByteDance across pre-training and post-training workloads. It diagnosed over twenty production issues, including subtle kernel races and silent data corruptions missed by existing checks, reducing debugging time from days to minutes.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大规模LLM训练在快速演进的软件栈上跨越数周在众多GPU上运行。错误或硬件故障可能悄悄破坏计算，直到很晚才显现。调试就像在时间维度上的大海捞针。开发者常常再次运行训练并比较损失、梯度范数等，但这些聚合信号嘈杂，并且在数百万次操作中容易被稀释，对分歧原因几乎没有指导作用。本文引入了位对齐（bitwise alignment）作为LLM训练的正确性预言和调试原语，以及OpGuard——一个在生产规模上实现该理念的实用系统。OpGuard发现异构训练栈中语义稳定的算子边界，并为其包裹轻量级指纹。一个调度容忍映射器计算两个执行产生比特相同张量的最长前缀。第一个不匹配点成为调试枢轴，并附带丰富上下文展示。通过精心控制非确定性良性变化，OpGuard使首次不匹配成为错误的强有力证据。OpGuard已在字节跳动部署于预训练和后训练任务中。它诊断了二十多个生产问题，包括现有检查遗漏的细微内核竞争和静默数据损坏，将调试时间从几天缩短到几分钟。

import_candidates.title: RobustRL: Role-Based Fault Tolerance System for RL Post-Training
import_candidates.abstract:
RL post-training for LLMs has been widely scaled to enhance reasoning and tool-using capabilities. However, RL post-training interleaves training and inference workloads, exposing the system to faults from both sides. Existing fault tolerance frameworks for LLMs target either training or inference, leaving the optimization potential in the asynchronous execution unexplored for RL. Our key insight is role-based fault isolation so the failure in one machine does not affect the others. We treat trainer, rollout, and other management roles in RL training as distinct distributed sub-tasks. Instead of restarting the entire task in pretrain robust system ByteRobust, we recover only the failed role and reconnect it to living ones, thereby eliminating the full-restart overhead including rollout replay and initialization delay.
We present RobustRL, the first comprehensive robust system to handle GPU machine errors for RL post-training ETTR (Effective Training Time Ratio) improvement via a Detect-Restart-Reconnect paradigm. (1) Detect. We implement role-aware monitoring to distinguish actual failures from role-specific behaviors to avoid the false positive and delayed detection. (2) Restart. For trainers, we implement a non-disruptive recovery where rollouts persist state and continue trajectory generation, while the trainer is rapidly restored via rollout warm standbys. For rollout, we perform isolated machine replacement without interrupting the RL task. (3) Reconnect. We replace static collective communication with dynamic, UCX-based (Unified Communication X) point-to-point communication, enabling immediate weight synchronization between recovered roles. In an RL training task on a 256-GPU cluster with Qwen3-8B-Math workload under 10% failure injection frequency, RobustRL can achieve an ETTR of over 80% compared with the 60% in ByteRobust and achieves 8.4%-17.4% faster in end-to-end training time.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 针对大语言模型的RL后训练已广泛扩展以增强推理和工具使用能力。然而，RL后训练将训练和推理工作负载交错进行，使系统面临来自两方面的故障。现有的LLM容错框架要么针对训练，要么针对推理，未挖掘异步执行中可用于RL优化的潜力。我们的关键见解是角色的故障隔离，这样一台机器的故障不会影响其他机器。我们将RL训练中的训练器、回放和其他管理角色视为不同的分布式子任务。与在预训练鲁棒系统ByteRobust中重启整个任务不同，我们只恢复故障的角色并将其连接到存活的角色，从而消除包括回放重放和初始化延迟在内的完全重启开销。我们提出了RobustRL，这是第一个通过“检测-重启-重连”范例来处理RL后训练中GPU机器错误的全面鲁棒系统，以提高有效训练时间比（ETTR）。（1）检测：我们实现了角色感知监控，以区分实际故障和角色特定行为，避免误报和延迟检测。（2）重启：对于训练器，我们实现了无中断恢复，其中回放保持状态并继续轨迹生成，而训练器则通过回放热备快速恢复。对于回放，我们在不中断RL任务的情况下执行隔离的机器替换。（3）重连：我们用基于UCX（Unified Communication X）的动态点对点通信替代静态集合通信，实现恢复角色之间的即时权重同步。在一个256-GPU集群上使用Qwen3-8B-Math工作负载、10%故障注入频率的RL训练任务中，RobustRL可实现超过80%的ETTR，而ByteRobust为60%，且端到端训练时间快8.4%-17.4%。

import_candidates.title: Oxbow: A Coordinated Architecture for Multi-Component File Systems
import_candidates.abstract:
Fast storage hardware and computational SSDs have outpaced the traditional kernel-centric or kernel-bypass file system designs, fragmenting modern storage stacks across library file systems, kernel subsystems, and in-device file systems. Each architecture offers only a subset of desired properties: userlevel designs deliver low latency but lose kernel services and isolation, kernel file systems retain rich functionality but become CPU-bound and slow, and device-resident logic reduces host load but suffers from PCIe latency and wimpy processors.
This paper presents Oxbow, a coordinated storage architecture that composes kernel, user-space, and device components to achieve all four goals simultaneously: high performance, strong kernel interoperability, low CPU consumption, and fast development velocity. Oxbow combines a kernel-based read path with a kernel-bypassing write path, shared-ownership metadata, and Split Journaling, a host–device journaling mechanism that decouples fsync from background commits using staging areas and DMA-based snapshots. We demonstrate that Oxbow delivers kernel-level protection and sharing semantics while matching or exceeding the performance of state-of-the-art user-level file systems and substantially reducing host CPU use through offload to computational SSDs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 快速存储硬件和计算型固态硬盘已超越传统的以内核为中心或内核旁路的文件系统设计，将现代存储栈碎片化为库文件系统、内核子系统和设备内文件系统。每种架构仅提供所需属性的一部分：用户级设计提供低延迟但丢失内核服务和隔离性；内核文件系统保留丰富功能但CPU受限且速度慢；设备驻留逻辑减少主机负载但受限于PCIe延迟和弱处理器。本文提出Oxbow，一种协调的存储架构，组合内核、用户空间和设备组件，以同时实现四个目标：高性能、强内核互操作性、低CPU消耗和快速开发速度。Oxbow结合基于内核的读路径与内核旁路的写路径、共享所有权元数据，以及分离日志（Split Journaling）——一种主机-设备日志机制，利用暂存区域和基于DMA的快照将fsync与后台提交解耦。我们证明Oxbow能够提供内核级保护和共享语义，同时匹配或超越最先进的用户级文件系统的性能，并通过向计算型固态硬盘卸载来大幅减少主机CPU使用。

import_candidates.title: Scaling the IO Wall with Declarative IO
import_candidates.abstract:
HDD capacities will greatly increase over the next ten years, lowering cost-per-TB in large-scale storage systems. Unfortunately, device bandwidth will not grow proportionally to device capacity. Hence, storage systems will face an IO wall where the demand for HDD IO will outstrip supply.
We find that, surprisingly, between 45% and 70% of after-cache HDD IO demand for 6 hyperscalers comes from crucial maintenance tasks that ensure data reliability and efficiency (e.g. scrubbing, garbage collection). Unfortunately, caching maintenance tasks is ineffective — individual tasks have little reuse and inter-task reuse is too far apart in time. Fortunately, maintenance tasks are flexible in the timing, ordering of data accesses, and even which data they access. However, the current imperative storage interface (e.g., read/write) hides maintenance tasks’ flexible nature. We propose Declarative IO, a new interface for distributed storage systems that allows developers to expose tasks’ flexibility to the storage system. This interface allows tasks to send a declaration to our distributed storage system, DINGO, specifying sets of data and their associated deadlines, such as “process all blocks of this device within 7 days”. In processing declarations, DINGO coordinates IO across different tasks to create timely data reuse. DINGO achieves a 26–51% IO savings for maintenance task mixes corresponding to real hyperscalers, enabling the deployment of 1.7×larger HDDs than in imperative systems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 机械硬盘（HDD）的容量将在未来十年大幅增加，从而降低大规模存储系统中每TB的成本。但遗憾的是，设备带宽不会随设备容量成比例增长。因此，存储系统将面临IO壁垒，即对HDD IO的需求将超过供给。我们发现，令人惊讶的是，6家超大规模服务商的缓存后HDD IO需求中，有45%至70%来自确保数据可靠性和效率的关键维护任务（例如数据擦洗、垃圾回收）。遗憾的是，缓存维护任务效果不佳——单个任务几乎没有复用，任务间复用在时间上相隔太远。幸运的是，维护任务在时间安排、数据访问顺序甚至访问哪些数据方面具有灵活性。然而，当前的命令式存储接口（如读/写）隐藏了维护任务的灵活性。我们提出声明式IO（Declarative IO），一种用于分布式存储系统的新接口，允许开发者将任务的灵活性暴露给存储系统。该接口允许任务向我们的分布式存储系统DINGO发送声明，指定数据集及其关联截止时间，例如“在7天内处理该设备的所有块”。在处理声明时，DINGO协调不同任务之间的IO，以创造及时的数据复用。与命令式系统相比，DINGO针对对应真实超大规模服务商的维护任务组合实现了26%–51%的IO节省，从而支持部署1.7倍更大的HDD。

import_candidates.title: Umap: Revisiting Memory-Mapped I/O on Distributed File Systems for Efficient Matrix Access (Operational Systems)
import_candidates.abstract:
Our production experience in large-scale data-processing pipelines shows that, despite its attractive programming model, memory-mapped I/O (mmap-IO) on distributed file systems (DFS) exhibits severe operational pathologies—livelocks during write-heavy phases, chronically low multi-threaded throughput, and high memory footprints that may trigger out-of-memory kills in containerized environments. 
Our measurements further show that mmap-IO on DFS is 3×–10× slower than on local file systems (LFS) for matrix random-access workloads, primarily because page-granularity network I/O underutilizes high-speed networks and deferred write-back behavior incurs expensive distributed flushes and metadata operations. We present umap, a DFS-agnostic runtime that delivers near-in-memory matrix-access performance on DFS via network-efficient communication, a concurrency-aware cache protocol with linear scalability, and lazy-expansion cache management. 
Deployed in production for over 18 months, umap has eliminated livelocks and out-of-memory-induced job failures while improving throughput by up to 6.7× across diverse matrix-access workloads. Our experience shows that rethinking mmap-IO’s interaction with DFS is essential for robust, predictable performance in modern large-scale clusters.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们在大规模数据处理流程中的生产经验表明，尽管内存映射I/O（mmap-IO）具有吸引人的编程模型，但在分布式文件系统（DFS）上却表现出严重的运营缺陷——写密集阶段出现活锁、多线程吞吐量长期偏低，以及可能导致容器化环境中内存耗尽（OOM）杀进程的高内存占用。我们的测量还显示，对于矩阵随机访问工作负载，DFS上的mmap-IO比本地文件系统（LFS）慢3到10倍，主要原因是页粒度的网络I/O未能充分利用高速网络，以及延迟回写行为引发了昂贵的分布式刷新和元数据操作。我们提出了umap——一个与DFS无关的运行时，它通过网络高效通信、具有线性可扩展性的并发感知缓存协议以及惰性扩展缓存管理，在DFS上实现了接近内存级的矩阵访问性能。umap已投入生产使用超过18个月，消除了活锁和内存耗尽导致的作业失败，同时使不同矩阵访问工作负载的吞吐量提升了高达6.7倍。我们的经验表明，重新思考mmap-IO与DFS的交互来实现现代大规模集群中稳健且可预测的性能至关重要。

import_candidates.title: CoPilotIO: CPU as a Co-Pilot for GPU I/O to Free GPU Compute
import_candidates.abstract: Limited GPU memory increasingly forces modern AI and data analytics workloads to access terabyte-scale datasets and model states from storage, making efficient GPU I/O critical. Existing GPU I/O engines are either CPU-centric or GPU-centric. CPU-centric approaches avoid consuming GPU resources but often fail to provide high-throughput, on-demand GPU access due to kernel overheads and limited parallelism. GPU-centric approaches enable fine-grained on-demand I/O but require intensive I/O polling that consumes valuable GPU resources and introduces intra-warp, inter-warp, and inter-SM I/O stalls. We present CoPilotIO, a novel GPU I/O engine that delivers high-throughput, on-demand storage access without sacrificing GPU compute resources. CoPilotIO adopts an asynchronous GPU I/O architecture in which GPUs initiate I/O while CPU cores act as I/O co-pilots responsible for completion polling. To enable efficient coordination, CoPilotIO introduces a split SQ/CQ architecture, hardware barrier-based synchronization, a lock-free barrier-table, and adaptive CPU-GPU co-polling. Across microbenchmarks and real applications, including GoFS, LLM Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) inference, and Deep Learning Recommendation Models (DLRM), CoPilotIO reduces I/O-induced stalls by up to 55.5%, requires 50% fewer SMs to saturate the GPU PCIe bandwidth, accelerates GoFS by up to 17.4%, and improves application performance by up to 85%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 有限的GPU内存日益迫使现代AI和数据分析工作负载从存储访问TB级数据集和模型状态，使高效的GPU I/O变得至关重要。现有的GPU I/O引擎要么是CPU中心的，要么是GPU中心的。CPU中心的方法避免消耗GPU资源，但由于内核开销和有限的并行性，往往无法提供高通量的按需GPU访问。GPU中心的方法能够实现细粒度的按需I/O，但需要密集的I/O轮询，消耗宝贵的GPU资源，并引入warp内、warp间以及SM间的I/O停顿。我们提出了CoPilotIO，一种新颖的GPU I/O引擎，在不牺牲GPU计算资源的前提下提供高通量的按需存储访问。CoPilotIO采用异步GPU I/O架构，其中GPU发起I/O，而CPU核心充当I/O副驾驶，负责完成轮询。为了实现高效协调，CoPilotIO引入了分离的SQ/CQ架构、基于硬件屏障的同步、无锁屏障表以及自适应的CPU-GPU协同轮询。在微基准测试和真实应用（包括GoFS、LLM混合专家（MoE）推理和深度学习推荐模型（DLRM））中，CoPilotIO将I/O引起的停顿减少了高达55.5%，饱和GPU PCIe带宽所需的SM减少50%，将GoFS加速高达17.4%，并将应用性能提升高达85%。

import_candidates.title: RoCE BALBOA: Service-Enhanced RDMA Offload Engine for Data Center SmartNICs
import_candidates.abstract: Remote Direct Memory Access (RDMA) has become the de facto standard for high-performance data center networking. However, current deployments rely heavily on fixed-function, commercial NICs. These "black box" commercial hardware implementations prevent researchers and system architects from modifying the transport layer for specialized tasks. In parallel, research on NICs often lacks offloaded networking stacks or uses simplified protocol implementations, limiting insight into novel networking solutions in realistic settings. In this paper, we bridge this gap by introducing BALBOA, an open-source, 100 Gbps RDMA offload engine designed for research on networking and fully compatible with commercial RNICs. Unlike prior stack implementations which lack scalability and bandwidth, or struggle with data center interoperability and miss strict protocol compliance, BALBOA supports hundreds of Queue Pairs in switched network environments and allows for line-rate offloads, making it a viable platform for realistic data center research. We describe the system architecture, detailing how BALBOA overcomes FPGA memory and timing bottlenecks through a decoupled state architecture and streaming control-data separation. We evaluate BALBOA on a hardware cluster with FPGAs, RNICs, and switches, showing that it matches the performance of commercial ASICs while offering full customization. Finally, we showcase BALBOA’s potential through novel case studies: protocol enhancements for infrastructure purposes (encryption, deep packet inspection) and an offloaded preprocessing pipeline for deep learning recommender systems, which applies streaming transformations to the incoming data before feeding it directly to a GPU for model serving.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 远程直接内存访问（RDMA）已成为高性能数据中心网络的事实标准。然而，当前的部署高度依赖固定功能的商用网卡。这些商用硬件实现的“黑盒”特性使研究人员和系统架构师无法针对特定任务修改传输层。与此同时，针对网卡的研究往往缺乏卸载的网络协议栈，或使用简化的协议实现，限制了在现实环境中对新网络解决方案的洞察。在本文中，我们通过引入BALBOA来弥合这一差距——BALBOA是一个开源的、100 Gbps的RDMA卸载引擎，专为网络研究设计，并与商用RNIC完全兼容。与以往缺乏可扩展性和带宽、难以实现数据中心互操作或达不到严格协议合规性的协议栈实现不同，BALBOA支持交换网络环境中的数百个队列对，并提供线速卸载，使其成为现实数据中心研究的可行平台。我们描述了系统架构，详细说明了BALBOA如何通过解耦状态架构和流式控制-数据分离来克服FPGA存储器和时序瓶颈。我们在一个包含FPGA、RNIC和交换机的硬件集群上评估了BALBOA，表明它在提供完全定制能力的同时，性能可与商用ASIC媲美。最后，我们通过新颖的案例研究展示了BALBOA的潜力：用于基础设施目的（加密、深度包检测）的协议增强，以及用于深度学习推荐系统的卸载预处理流水线，该流水线在将数据直接馈送到GPU进行模型推理之前对流式数据执行转换。

import_candidates.title: DPA-Store: An Ordered Network Data Path Key-Value Store
import_candidates.abstract:
Remote in-memory key–value (KV) stores are fundamental to a wide range of applications, many of which depend on efficient range operations. However, existing designs fall short of simultaneously providing high performance, low complexity, and full range-query support. Host-based systems like Redis and Memcached are constrained by the kernel network stack and NIC–host interactions. Implementations of hash-based structures that bypass the OS kernel or serve directly from SmartNICs demonstrate upper performance limits but cannot support range queries. Distributed RDMA systems offer high throughput and range functionality when using stateful clients, but these clients increase the risk of faults and complicate scaling. Finally, SmartNICs traversing host-memory trees suffer from high numbers of DMA round-trips.
This paper presents DPA-Store, which uses the on-path Data Path Accelerators (DPAs) of the BlueField-3 SmartNIC to circumvent OS overheads while supporting stateless clients and range queries. The DPAs fetch incoming requests directly from the NIC buffers and traverse a lock-free learned index tree within the DPA memory. Values are fetched from a host-side replica of the tree when reaching the leaf level. Writes are buffered in DPA memory and transferred in batches to the host. Compute-heavy structural operations are executed on the host and transactionally stitched back to the SmartNIC. Complemented with a read cache directly on the NIC, DPA-Store sustains 33 million operations per second (MOPS) for lookups and 13 MOPS for range queries. Our evaluation shows that DPA-Store is already faster than or competitive with state-of-the-art solutions, and we demonstrate how small changes to the BlueField-3 hardware could additionally increase performance.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 远程内存键值存储是广泛应用程序的基础，其中许多应用依赖于高效的范围操作。然而，现有设计无法同时提供高性能、低复杂性和完整的范围查询支持。基于主机的系统（如Redis和Memcached）受到内核网络协议栈和NIC-主机交互的限制。绕过操作系统内核或直接由SmartNIC服务的基于哈希结构的实现展示了性能上限，但不能支持范围查询。分布式RDMA系统在使用有状态客户端时可提供高吞吐量和范围功能，但这些客户端增加了故障风险并使扩展复杂化。最后，遍历主机内存树的SmartNIC遭受大量DMA往返。本文提出了DPA-Store，它利用BlueField-3 SmartNIC上的路径上Data Path Accelerators（DPA）来规避操作系统开销，同时支持无状态客户端和范围查询。DPA直接从NIC缓冲区获取传入请求，并在DPA内存中遍历无锁的学习索引树。到达叶节点层时，从主机侧的树副本中获取值。写入在DPA内存中缓冲并批量传输到主机。计算密集型的结构操作在主机上执行，并以事务方式缝合回SmartNIC。结合NIC上的直接读缓存，DPA-Store可维持3300万次每秒的查找操作和1300万次每秒的范围查询。我们的评估表明，DPA-Store已经比最先进的解决方案更快或与之相当，并演示了对BlueField-3硬件的微小更改如何能进一步提高性能。

import_candidates.title: FARLock: Asymmetric RDMA Locking Made Fair
import_candidates.abstract:
Distributed locking is essential for coordinating access to shared resources in modern RDMA-based distributed systems. While state-of-the-art RDMA locks can deliver high-performance by introducing asymmetry (i.e., treating requests that are local and remote to the lock differently), they often trade off fairness as they fail to grant locks in the expected first-come first-serve manner. This can lead to long delays for critical tasks, missing service level objectives. 
We present FARLock, a fast and fair RDMA lock to solve this problem. Drawing inspiration from ticket and MCS locks, FARLock employs tickets and MCS-style handover to ensure that locks are granted strictly by arrival order. Through careful coordination between request queues and the ticket, FARLock provides strong fairness semantics with high performance. Our evaluation on a range of workloads shows that FARLock guarantees fairness and achieves lower latencies compared to prior state-of-the-art. Incorporating FARLock in a recent RDMA-based distributed indexing solution improves its query tail latencies.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 分布式锁定对于在基于RDMA的现代分布式系统中协调对共享资源的访问至关重要。虽然最先进的RDMA锁通过引入非对称性（即对本地和远程的锁请求区别对待）可以实现高性能，但它们常常牺牲公平性，因为无法按预期的先到先服务方式授予锁。这可能导致关键任务长时间延迟，无法满足服务级别目标。我们提出了FARLock，一种快速且公平的RDMA锁来解决这个问题。FARLock借鉴ticket和MCS锁的思想，采用ticket和MCS式交接，确保严格按到达顺序授予锁。通过请求队列与ticket之间的仔细协调，FARLock提供了强公平性语义与高性能。我们对一系列工作负载的评估表明，FARLock保证了公平性，并且与之前的最先进方法相比实现了更低的延迟。将FARLock集成到近期基于RDMA的分布式索引解决方案中，可改善其查询尾部延迟。

import_candidates.title: When DDIO Meets Page Coloring: Revisiting DDIO Performance with Sepia
import_candidates.abstract:
In modern host network stacks, Direct Cache Access (DCA) technology, such as Intel’s Data Direct I/O (DDIO), plays a crucial role in packet processing by allowing received packet data to be accessed directly from the last-level cache (LLC) instead of host memory. However, DDIO performance is often constrained by the leaky DMA problem, where the packet data is evicted from the LLC before processing completes due to the limited capacity of the DDIO-reserved portion.
In this study, we revisit this issue and reveal that conflict misses, rather than capacity limitations alone, are the primary co-contributor to LLC misses in DDIO. Our in-depth analysis indicates that introducing page coloring to DDIO can increase the effective LLC capacity by 77.8–94.4% over Linux. Motivated by this insight, we present Sepia, a color-aware page allocator that reduces LLC misses during packet processing (including copy-to-user) by leveraging a deeper understanding of LLC behavior. Under configurations that jointly avoid capacity and conflict misses, our Linux kernel prototype saturates a 200Gbps link using only 3.5 CPU cores, 2.5 fewer than the default Linux stack, while maintaining low LLC miss rates (∼0.4%). This improves total throughput per unit of core utilization by ∼1.51× across diverse setups and real-world applications.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在现代主机网络栈中，直接缓存访问（DCA）技术（如英特尔的Data Direct I/O（DDIO））在数据包处理中扮演着关键角色，它允许接收到的数据包数据直接从最后一级缓存（LLC）而非主机内存中访问。然而，DDIO的性能常常受到“泄漏DMA”问题的制约，即由于DDIO保留部分容量有限，数据包数据在处理完成前可能被从LLC中驱逐。在本研究中，我们重新审视了这个问题，并揭示冲突未命中而非单纯容量限制是DDIO中LLC未命中的主要共同贡献因素。我们的深入分析表明，将页着色引入DDIO可以使有效LLC容量相对于Linux增加77.8%–94.4%。基于这一见解，我们提出了Sepia，一个颜色感知的页分配器，通过更深入地理解LLC行为来减少数据包处理（包括复制到用户空间）过程中的LLC未命中。在联合避免容量和冲突未命中的配置下，我们的Linux内核原型仅用3.5个CPU核心即可使200Gbps链路饱和，比默认Linux栈少2.5个核心，同时保持较低的LLC未命中率（约0.4%）。在多种设置和实际应用中，每单位核心利用率的总体吞吐量提高了约1.51倍。

import_candidates.title: Disentangling Graph Dependencies for Efficient Billion-Scale GPU Vector Search
import_candidates.abstract:
Graph-based approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS) drives high-performance vector search for AI systems. Nowadays, GPU becomes the emerging ANNS platform for its high performance and cost efficiency. However, GPU’s limited memory capacity hinders graph ANNS systems from scaling to billion-level, due to graph’s high memory consumption (239–334 GB). Existing efforts mitigate this by offloading graph to CPU memory; however, this incurs severe performance penalties due to data transfer overhead and GPU stalls.
We identify the root cause of this inefficiency: a strict step-level dependency in graph search, where each step relies on the traversal and computations of all nodes in the previous step. Our key insight is that this monolithic step-level dependency can be disentangled into a more flexible, fine-grained node-level dependency. Specifically, for each node, it is first accessed as a neighbor via an edge (i.e., discovery), and later selected as a parent to traverse its neighbors (i.e., expansion). These two stages are typically separated by many steps, exposing a sufficient discovery-expansion window. Leveraging this time window, the edge fetching to access some neighbors can be deferred and overlapped with computation. Based on this insight, we propose FlowANN, a graph-based ANNS system that efficiently supports billion-scale search on a single GPU. FlowANN employs a tiered graph structure, offloading the edges connected to neighbors that have sufficient time windows to the CPU. It effectively pipelines GPU computation with edge fetching via optimized asynchronous transfer and dynamic coordination. Evaluations show that FlowANN outperforms state-of-the-art systems by 4.08–45.7× on average (up to 172.6×), without compromising search accuracy.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 基于图的近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）驱动着AI系统的高性能向量搜索。如今，GPU因其高性能和成本效益而成为新兴的ANNS平台。然而，GPU有限的内存容量阻碍了图ANNS系统扩展到十亿级，原因是图的高内存消耗（239-334 GB）。现有方法通过将图卸载到CPU内存来缓解这一问题；然而，这会导致严重的数据传输开销和GPU停顿，从而带来严重的性能损失。我们找出了这种低效的根本原因：图搜索中存在严格的步级依赖，每一步都依赖于上一步所有节点的遍历和计算。我们的关键见解是，这种整体性的步级依赖可以被解耦为更灵活、更细粒度的节点级依赖。具体来说，对于每个节点，它首先作为邻居通过边被访问（即发现），之后被选为父节点以遍历其邻居（即扩展）。这两个阶段通常被许多步骤隔开，从而暴露出足够的发现-扩展窗口。利用这一时间窗口，访问某些邻居的边获取可以被延迟并与计算重叠。基于这一见解，我们提出了FlowANN，一个基于图的ANNS系统，可在单个GPU上高效支持十亿级搜索。FlowANN采用分层图结构，将连接到具有足够时间窗口的邻居的边卸载到CPU，并通过优化的异步传输和动态协调有效地将GPU计算与边获取流水线化。评估表明，FlowANN平均比最先进的系统快4.08-45.7倍（最高达172.6倍），且不牺牲搜索精度。

import_candidates.title: Efficient GPU-Centric Evolving Graph Processing at Scale
import_candidates.abstract:
Large-scale evolving graph analytics (EGA), which evaluates graph queries over sequences of snapshots, is facing growing demands for real-time insight extraction. While GPUs offer immense potential for accelerating graph workloads, they suffer from the memory capacity wall and poor hardware utilization when applied to EGA.
To bridge this gap, this work presents POEGA, a GPU-centric framework for efficient large-scale EGA. The core idea of POEGA is to leverage proxy graphs to minimize out-of-memory IO. It achieves this by first analyzing a compact in-memory graph abstraction to drive approximate results, thereby guiding the out-of-memory refinement. Although this approach incurs more computations, our key insight is that this cost can be amortized by exploiting the GPU’s massive parallelism to process multiple snapshots concurrently. This concurrency is supported by a carefully designed fused kernel and a novel bound-based pruning technique. Furthermore, we address a commonly overlooked memory bottleneck caused by multi-version vertex states, which arises when scaling concurrent analysis to a large number of snapshots, by introducing an adaptive state compaction format. Evaluation shows that POEGA yields 3.7-23.5× speedups over the state-of-the-art EGA solutions across a range of real-world datasets.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大规模演化图分析（EGA）在快照序列上评估图查询，正面临实时洞察提取日益增长的需求。尽管GPU在加速图工作负载方面具有巨大潜力，但在应用于EGA时，它们受到内存容量瓶颈和硬件利用率低下的困扰。为弥合这一差距，本工作提出了POEGA，一个用于高效大规模EGA的GPU中心框架。POEGA的核心思想是利用代理图来最小化内存溢出的I/O。它首先分析一个紧凑的内存图抽象以驱动近似结果，从而引导内存外细化。虽然这种方法会产生更多计算，但我们的关键见解是，通过利用GPU的巨量并行性并发处理多个快照，可以摊销这一成本。这种并发性由精心设计的融合内核和新颖的基于边界的剪枝技术支撑。此外，我们通过引入自适应状态压缩格式，解决了在将并发分析扩展到大量快照时由多版本顶点状态引起的常被忽视的内存瓶颈。评估表明，在各种真实世界数据集上，POEGA相比最先进的EGA解决方案实现了3.7-23.5倍的加速。

import_candidates.title: Pluto: High-Performance, Memory-Efficient Distributed Graph Analytics through Advanced Mirroring
import_candidates.abstract: Inter-host communication poses a significant performance bottleneck in distributed graph analytics due to synchronization overheads. To mitigate this, state-of-the-art systems typically employ the full mirroring technique to replicate all potentially needed remote data and adopt a bulk-synchronous parallel execution model for coarse-grained communication. While effective for reducing network traffic, these approaches substantially increase memory footprint and constrain system parallelism. This paper introduces Pluto, a memory-efficient distributed graph analytics system based on two advanced mirroring designs: static partial mirroring and a mirror-free architecture. Nonproductive data duplication is avoided to reduce memory usage, while the work migration mechanism allows communication-computation overlap for performance improvement. For homogeneous graphs, Pluto achieves up to 3.8× speedup (harmonic mean 1.75×) compared to a full mirroring baseline and delivers up to 12× speedup (harmonic mean 1.75×) over existing open-source systems. For labeled property graphs, Pluto achieves up to 2.6× speedup (harmonic mean 1.37×) and lowers the minimum host requirement to 50%–90% of the baseline.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在分布式图分析中，由于同步开销，主机间通信构成了显著的性能瓶颈。为了缓解这一问题，最先进的系统通常采用完全镜像技术来复制所有可能需要的远程数据，并采用批量同步并行执行模型以实现粗粒度通信。虽然这些方法能有效减少网络流量，但会显著增加内存占用并限制系统并行性。本文介绍了Pluto，一个基于两种高级镜像设计的内存高效分布式图分析系统：静态部分镜像和无镜像架构。它避免了非生产性数据复制以减少内存使用，同时工作迁移机制允许通信与计算重叠以提升性能。对于同构图，与完全镜像基线相比，Pluto实现了最高3.8倍的加速（调和平均值1.75倍），相比现有开源系统则实现了最高12倍的加速（调和平均值1.75倍）。对于带标签的属性图，Pluto实现了最高2.6倍的加速（调和平均值1.37倍），并将最低主机需求降低到基线的50%–90%。

import_candidates.title: The Clustering Strikes Back: Building Cost-Effective and High-Performance ANNS at Scale with Helmsman (Operational Systems)
import_candidates.abstract:
RedNote (a.k.a., Xiaohongshu, a global-scale social network platform) widely adopts approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS) to power its search, recommendation, and advertising services. Due to the demanding Service Level Agreements (SLAs), we have to rely on in-memory graph-based ANNS (i.e., HNSW) to provide high throughput and low latency.
However, the ever-growing user base and content volume have led to an explosive increase in memory footprint and consequently huge CapEx and OpEx. After exploring various alternatives, we find that building a clustering-based ANNS on top of all-flash servers can be promising. Yet, we still experience severe overheads from the kernel I/O stack, a fixed pruning strategy, and slow index construction.
We present Helmsman, a high-performance and cost-effective clustering-based ANNS system, which combines an ANNS-oriented userspace storage stack, a leveling-learned pruning module, and GPU-accelerated pipelines of construction. Helmsman saves over 90% of hardware costs and enables billion-scale index (re)builds within hours. In the current production deployment, operating stably for several months, 40 machines now host ANNS workloads that previously required about 35,000 cores and 0.35 PB DRAM.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: RedNote（即小红书，一个全球规模的社交网络平台）广泛采用近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）来支持其搜索、推荐和广告服务。由于严格的服务级别协议（SLA），我们不得不依赖基于内存的图ANNS（即HNSW）来提供高吞吐量和低延迟。然而，不断增长的用户群和内容量导致内存占用爆炸式增长，从而带来巨大的资本支出和运营支出。在探索了各种替代方案后，我们发现基于全闪存服务器构建聚类型ANNS是有前景的。然而，我们仍然遇到了来自内核I/O栈、固定剪枝策略和缓慢索引构建的严重开销。我们提出了Helmsman，一个高性能且成本效益高的聚类型ANNS系统，它结合了面向ANNS的用户态存储栈、分层学习剪枝模块和GPU加速的构建流水线。Helmsman节省了超过90%的硬件成本，并在数小时内实现十亿级索引的（重建）。在当前的生产部署中，系统已稳定运行数月，40台机器如今承载了ANNS工作负载，而这些工作负载以前需要约35,000个核心和0.35 PB的DRAM。

import_candidates.title: WiseCode: Breaking the Scalability Barriers of Wide-Stripe Vector Codes
import_candidates.abstract:
Wide-stripe erasure codes, with tens to over a hundred data chunks per stripe, offer high reliability at low storage overhead. Existing wide-stripe designs that are based on scalar codes (e.g., LRCs in Google and Azure) reduce repair traffic but increase storage overhead. Although vector codes are theoretically optimal in both metrics, they face severe scalability barriers in wide-stripe deployments.
We present WiseCode, the first practical and scalable wide-stripe vector-coding approach that achieves both efficient repair and ultra-low storage overhead. WiseCode overcomes three key scalability barriers through innovations in coding structure, coefficient selection, and coding algorithms. It introduces a template-unfold structure design that avoids sub-packetization blowup, a repetition-minimized search strategy that reduces coefficient search cost, and a two-stage coding algorithm that enables efficient encoding and decoding.
Evaluations on Ceph with ∼100-wide stripes and 1.04–1.06 storage overhead show that WiseCode increases repair throughput by 1.41×–2.18× compared to Google’s UCLRCs at equal storage overhead, and also delivers higher throughput even at 2% lower storage overhead. WiseCode retains this advantage when combined with advanced repair-scheduling methods, consistently outperforming UCLRCs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 宽条带纠删码每个条带包含数十至一百多个数据块，以较低的存储开销提供高可靠性。现有基于标量码（如Google和Azure中的LRC）的宽条带设计减少了修复流量，但增加了存储开销。尽管向量码在这两个指标上理论上都是最优的，但在宽条带部署中面临严重的可扩展性障碍。我们提出了WiseCode，这是第一种实用且可扩展的宽条带向量编码方法，同时实现了高效修复和超低存储开销。WiseCode通过在编码结构、系数选择和编码算法方面的创新，克服了三个关键的可扩展性障碍。它引入了模板展开结构设计以避免子分组爆炸，一种最小化重复的搜索策略以降低系数搜索成本，以及一种两阶段编码算法以实现高效编码和解码。在Ceph上使用约100宽条带和1.04–1.06存储开销的评估表明，与Google的UCLRC相比，在相同存储开销下，WiseCode将修复吞吐量提高了1.41–2.18倍，并且在存储开销低2%的情况下也提供了更高的吞吐量。当与先进的修复调度方法结合时，WiseCode保持了这一优势，始终优于UCLRC。

import_candidates.title: The LogDrive: Composable Durability for Cloud-Based Shared Logs
import_candidates.abstract: A growing class of systems leverages inexpensive cloud object storage as a disaggregated data plane, offloading durability and scaling to the cloud. Storing the metadata for such systems in a cloud database is too expensive; while self-managed databases are complex and fragile. Conflux provides a third option by storing a shared log on cloud storage and using it to replicate state across VMs. A key innovation in Conflux is the separation of durability from sequencing. Durability is provided solely by the novel LogDrive abstraction: a simple, low-level substrate that can be layered above arbitrary cloud storage, striped for throughput, and – unlike shared logs – composed via quorum-based replication. Sequencing is provided by the AtomicLog, which implements a conventional shared log over any LogDrive. This design allows Conflux to replicate arbitrary state machines while using RAID-like compositions of cloud storage for durability. Conflux is deployed in production at Confluent as the metadata service for an S3-based publish-subscribe system called K2. We show that Conflux can run on diverse storage services (e.g., DynamoDB, S3, S3Express) with just a few hundred extra LOC per service; as well as augment the durability of these services (e.g., with synchronous cross-region replication). Conflux unlocks new cost vs. latency trade-offs over cloud storage: for our representative workloads and latency SLAs (compared to using DynamoDB directly) Conflux-over-DynamoDB slashes metadata cost by 10X and overall cost by 3X.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 一类不断增长的系统利用廉价的云对象存储作为分离的数据平面，将持久性和扩展性卸载到云端。将此类系统的元数据存储在云数据库中成本过高；而自管理数据库则复杂且脆弱。Conflux通过将共享日志存储在云存储上并利用它在VM之间复制状态，提供了第三种选择。Conflux的一个关键创新是将持久性与排序分离。持久性完全由新颖的LogDrive抽象提供：一个简单、低级的底层组件，可以分层在任何云存储之上，为了吞吐量进行条带化，并且与共享日志不同，可以通过基于仲裁的复制进行组合。排序由AtomicLog提供，AtomicLog在任何LogDrive上实现传统的共享日志。这种设计允许Conflux在利用类似RAID的云存储组合实现持久性的同时，复制任意状态机。Conflux在Confluent生产环境中部署，作为基于S3的发布-订阅系统K2的元数据服务。我们表明，Conflux可以在多种存储服务（例如DynamoDB、S3、S3Express）上运行，每种服务仅需额外的几百行代码；并且可以增强这些服务的持久性（例如，通过同步跨区域复制）。Conflux开启了云存储上新的成本与延迟权衡：对于我们代表性的工作负载和延迟SLA（与直接使用DynamoDB相比），基于DynamoDB的Conflux将元数据成本降低了10倍，总成本降低了3倍。

import_candidates.title: Timelock Drive: Isolated Time-Based Defense for Storage Systems
import_candidates.abstract:
Data is one of the most critical assets for organizations and individuals, yet its integrity is increasingly threatened by ransomware, data tampering, sabotage, and intentional data vandalism. While most organizations rely on backups, backups themselves are also vulnerable. Even a fully secure software system may be insufficient, as nearly two-thirds of attacks exploit human errors to steal access credentials.
We present Timelock Drive (TD), which allows users to timelock a physical disk block for a duration during which the stored data cannot be modified by anyone, including credentialed users. We show that this enables a secure backup system where the versioning system itself is not part of the TCB. Only a small, isolated checker remains in the TCB, and we formally verify it. A critical challenge we address is maintaining metadata without overwriting prior state using a pure append-only design. We solve the performance problem of scanning logs to retrieve metadata by offloading metadata management to the untrusted host while ensuring security through integrity checks.
Our experiments show that TD incurs negligible space, performance, and storage I/O overheads compared to conventional versioning systems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 数据是组织和个人最关键资产之一，但其完整性正日益受到勒索软件、数据篡改、破坏及蓄意数据破坏的威胁。虽然多数组织依赖备份，但备份本身也易受攻击。即使完全安全的软件系统也可能不足，因为近三分之二的攻击利用人为错误窃取访问凭证。我们提出了Timelock Drive（TD），它允许用户对一个物理磁盘块进行时间锁定，在一段持续时间内，任何人都无法修改其中存储的数据，包括持有凭证的用户。我们表明，这可以实现一种安全备份系统，其中版本控制系统本身不在可信计算基（TCB）内。只有一个小的隔离检查器保留在TCB中，我们对其进行了形式化验证。我们解决的一个关键挑战是，采用纯追加写的设计，在不覆盖先前状态的情况下维护元数据。我们通过将元数据管理卸载到不可信主机上，同时通过完整性检查确保安全，从而解决了扫描日志以检索元数据的性能问题。实验表明，与传统版本控制系统相比，TD在空间、性能和存储I/O开销方面几乎可以忽略不计。

import_candidates.title: High Fidelity Models for Large Scale Stateful Services (Operational Systems)
import_candidates.abstract: The Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) is 20 years old, hosts more than 500 trillion objects, and averages over 200 million requests per second. Its API must continuously evolve and adapt to new workloads and use cases, sometimes resulting in full re-implementations like the S3 Express One Zone storage class. This highlights two conflicting requirements: ensuring that every change preserves backward compatibility and maintaining a high-paced development environment. We report on our experience combining the use of reference models, in a model-based testing (MBT) style, with abstraction to systematically explore all behaviors of the S3 API. Our approach is grounded in the abstraction of API requests and state elements, enabling systematic validation of all abstract inputs and system states. Through rigorous validation, we produce models that are sufficiently accurate to be used as de facto specifications of S3. Our tool continuously runs in the S3 development and deployment (CI/CD) cycle, validating changes, preventing regressions, and supporting the development of new features.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Amazon简单存储服务（S3）已有20年历史，托管超过500万亿个对象，平均每秒处理超过2亿个请求。其API必须不断演进以适应新的工作负载和使用场景，有时会导致完全重新实现，如S3 Express One Zone存储类。这凸显了两个相互冲突的需求：确保每次更改保持向后兼容性，以及维持高速开发环境。我们报告了将参考模型（以基于模型的测试风格）与抽象化相结合，系统探索S3 API所有行为的经验。我们的方法基于API请求和状态元素的抽象化，能够对所有抽象输入和系统状态进行系统验证。通过严格验证，我们生成的模型足够准确，可实际作为S3的规范。我们的工具持续运行在S3开发和部署（CI/CD）循环中，验证更改、防止回归，并支持新功能的开发。

import_candidates.title: M3U: Scalable Kernel Memory Management for Efficient Post-Copy Live Migration of High-End Virtual Machines
import_candidates.abstract:
High-end virtual machines (VMs) have become essential in public clouds for supporting large-scale guest applications. While conventional pre-copy live migration cannot reliably migrate such high-end VMs due to convergence problems, post-copy migration offers a viable alternative. However, high-end post-copy migration suffers from significant performance penalties, including extended downtime, prolonged post-copy duration and degraded guest performance, which stem from scalability bottlenecks in kernel memory management.
We identify the unnecessary overuse of lock protection as the root cause of scalability bottlenecks in existing approaches, which can be effectively resolved through strategic lock relaxation. To address this challenge, we propose M3U, a scalable kernel memory management approach for post-copy live migration of high-end VMs. M3U customizes lock-protected memory management operations, reducing operation overhead and minimizing critical sections. Additionally, M3U employs lock-reduced parallelism to decrease dirty page registration overhead. M3U also implements a decoupled fault handling pipeline to maximize page transfer efficiency, and utilizes fault-aware page size determination to meet minimum fault latency requirements. For pass-through devices, M3U further provides proactive identification and pre-transmission of device states, effectively eliminating 98.5% of hardware I/O page faults. Our evaluation demonstrates that M3U achieves a 47.0% reduction in downtime, an 89.6% reduction in post-copy duration, and a 4.1× improvement in guest performance.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 高端虚拟机在公共云中对于支持大规模客户端应用已变得不可或缺。由于收敛问题，传统的预拷贝在线迁移无法可靠地迁移此类高端虚拟机，而后拷贝迁移则提供了一种可行的替代方案。然而，高端后拷贝迁移面临严重的性能损失，包括更长的停机时间、更长的后拷贝持续时间和更差的客户机性能，这些问题的根源在于内核内存管理中的可扩展性瓶颈。我们发现对锁保护的不必要过度使用是现有方法中可扩展性瓶颈的根本原因，这可以通过有策略地放宽锁来有效解决。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了M3U，一种面向高端虚拟机后拷贝在线迁移的可扩展内核内存管理方法。M3U自定义了受锁保护的内存管理操作，减少了操作开销并最小化了临界区。此外，M3U采用减少锁的并行性来降低脏页注册开销。M3U还实现了解耦的故障处理流水线以最大化页面传输效率，并利用故障感知的页面大小确定来满足最小故障延迟要求。对于透传设备，M3U进一步提供设备状态的主动识别和预传输，有效消除了98.5%的硬件I/O缺页故障。我们的评估表明，M3U实现了47.0%的停机时间减少、89.6%的后拷贝持续时间减少，以及4.1倍的客户机性能提升。

import_candidates.title: Compaction-Free Memory Defragmentation for Virtualization via Infinite Guest Physical Address Space
import_candidates.abstract:
In virtualized environments, guest memory defragmentation is essential for exploiting huge-page benefits and improving application performance. However, existing approaches directly reuse host-side defragmentation and assume a limited guest physical address (GPA) space. As a result, they rely on memory compaction to defragment this constrained space, causing throughput to drop by up to 51% and latency to rise by up to 102% in YCSB-Redis workloads.
This paper proposes InfiniDefrag, a compaction-free memory defragmentation technique for virtualization. Our key insight is that the GPA space can be regarded as (nearly) infinite by controlling the mapping between GPA and host physical address (HPA), thereby eliminating the need for guest-side memory compaction. To realize this insight, we introduce (1) Infinite Address Manager that expands the GPA space while reclaiming free fragment pages; (2) Host Memory Guard that maintains the GPA–HPA mapping and constrains HPA usage within each VM’s quota; and (3) Scalability Optimizer that scales GPA/HPA space management to multi-thread and multi-VM environments. Experiments on micro-benchmarks and real-world applications show that InfiniDefrag outperforms state-of-the-art approaches and can achieve ideal, fragmentation-free performance.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在虚拟化环境中，客户机内存碎片整理对于利用大页优势和提升应用性能至关重要。然而，现有方法直接复用宿主机侧的碎片整理，并假设客户机物理地址空间是有限的。因此，它们依赖内存压缩来整理这一受限空间，导致在YCSB-Redis工作负载中吞吐量下降高达51%，延迟上升高达102%。本文提出InfiniDefrag，一种用于虚拟化的无压缩内存碎片整理技术。我们的关键洞察是，通过控制客户机物理地址与宿主机物理地址之间的映射，可以将客户机物理地址空间视为（近乎）无限的，从而消除对客户机侧内存压缩的需求。为实现这一洞察，我们引入了(1)无限地址管理器，用于扩展客户机物理地址空间并回收空闲碎片页；(2)宿主机内存守卫，用于维护GPA-HPA映射并将宿主机物理地址使用限制在每个虚拟机配额内；以及(3)可扩展性优化器，用于将GPA/HPA空间管理扩展到多线程和多虚拟机环境。在微基准测试和真实应用上的实验表明，InfiniDefrag的性能优于最先进的方法，并能够实现理想的、无碎片化性能。

import_candidates.title: Inside Out: A Paradigm Shift in VM Introspection
import_candidates.abstract: We present GOODKIT, a new framework for live virtual machine introspection (LVMI) designed for performance, scalability, and safe integration in modern cloud environments. Unlike existing approaches—such as LibVMI—which rely on heavy VM pausing, GOODKIT executes observers as lightweight VMs colocated with the VMM, enabling nativespeed access to the target state while preserving strong isolation. GOODKIT introduces fine-grained, lock-aware memory–coherence mechanisms, a configurable probing subsystem for I/O and kernel-level events, and a mutualization layer that allows multiple observers to operate concurrently without degrading target performance. Across 21 real world use cases, including rootkit detection, ransomware monitoring, and scheduler introspection, GOODKIT delivers high performance (compared to LibVMI), strong isolation, and broad applicability.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了GOODKIT，这是一个用于实时虚拟机自省（LVMI）的新框架，专为在现代云环境中实现高性能、可扩展性和安全集成而设计。与现有方法（如LibVMI）依赖于大量虚拟机暂停不同，GOODKIT将观察者作为与VMM同置的轻量级虚拟机来执行，从而在保持强隔离的同时，能够以原生速度访问目标状态。GOODKIT引入了细粒度的、具有锁感知的内存一致性机制，一个用于I/O和内核级事件的可配置探测子系统，以及一个共享化（mutualization）层，允许多个观察者并发运行而不会降低目标性能。在包括rootkit检测、勒索软件监控和调度器自省在内的21个现实世界用例中，GOODKIT展现了相较于LibVMI的高性能、强隔离性和广泛的适用性。

import_candidates.title: vBOIDs: Taming Chaos via Coarse-Grained Scheduling Abstraction for Containers
import_candidates.abstract: Today’s high-density container deployment often descends into scheduling chaos, where fine-grained, per-thread scheduling decisions lead to thrashing and unpredictable performance. We present vBOIDS, a container scheduling system that tames this chaos with two key techniques: a coarse-grained BOID abstraction and a two-level balancing scheme. The BOID abstraction groups tasks into larger units to dramatically reduce scheduling churn, while two-level balancing coordinates global and local scheduling to ensure efficient resource utilization without oscillation. Our evaluation shows that vBOIDS improves the throughput of containerized microservices with thousands of threads by up to 3× under highly dynamic workloads compared with existing approaches, while incurring minimal overhead and yielding negligible performance impact even in high parallel workloads. vBOIDS effectively restores order to container scheduling, delivering high performance even under chaotic conditions.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 当今高密度的容器部署常常陷入调度混乱，其中细粒度的每线程调度决策会导致抖动和不可预测的性能。我们提出了vBOIDS，一个容器调度系统，它通过两种关键技术来驯服这种混乱：粗粒度的BOID抽象和两级平衡方案。BOID抽象将任务分组为更大的单元，显著减少调度抖动，而两级平衡则协调全局与本地调度，确保资源利用高效且不发生振荡。我们的评估表明，在高动态工作负载下，与现有方法相比，vBOIDS将拥有数千线程的容器化微服务的吞吐量提升了多达3倍，同时引入了极小的开销，即使在高并行工作负载下也带来了可忽略的性能影响。vBOIDS有效地恢复了容器调度的秩序，即使在混乱条件下也能提供高性能。

import_candidates.title: Efficient LLM Serving on Commodity GPU Clusters with Data-Reduced Cross-Instance Orchestration
import_candidates.abstract:
Existing LLM serving strategies can be categorized by whether prefill and decode phases are disaggregated: non-disaggregated (NoDG) or fully disaggregated (FuDG). However, they neither fit commodity GPU clusters, which remain widely deployed as mainstream AI infrastructure. NoDG suffers from severe prefill–decode interference, while FuDG depends heavily on high-performance interconnects that such clusters lack. 
We present EcoServe, an LLM serving system tailored to commodity GPU clusters. It enables a data-reduced collaboration among inference instances to mitigate prefill-decode interference, termed the partially disaggregated (PaDG) strategy. Particularly, within a single instance, PaDG disaggregates the prefill and decode phases along the time dimension to mitigate interference and enhance throughput. Next, it coordinates multiple instances and cyclically activates them to ensure the continuous availability of prefill processing, thereby rescuing latency. Thus, EcoServe’s basic serving unit is the macro instance, within which multiple instances collaborate. It further incorporates an adaptive scheduling algorithm to route requests in a macro instance and a mitosis scaling approach for fine-grained capacity adjustments in online scenario.
On a 32-GPU NVIDIA L20 cluster over Ethernet, EcoServe improves goodput by 1.96×, 1.99×, 2.51×, and 2.40× when serving 30B- and 70B-scale LLMs, compared to four representative NoDG and FuDG systems, vLLM, Sarathi, DistServe, and MoonCake. EcoServe remains competitive even on an NVIDIA H100 cluster with NVLink and InfiniBand. Our code is released at https://github.com/MLSysU/EcoServe.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现有的LLM服务策略可以分为是否将预填充和解码阶段进行分离：非分离（NoDG）或完全分离（FuDG）。然而，它们都不太适合商品GPU集群，而商品GPU集群仍然作为主流AI基础设施被广泛部署。NoDG存在严重的预填充-解码干扰，而FuDG则严重依赖高性能互连，而这类集群缺乏这种互连。我们提出了EcoServe，一个为商品GPU集群量身定制的LLM服务系统。它实现了推理实例之间的数据精简协作，以减轻预填充-解码干扰，称为部分分离（PaDG）策略。特别地，在单个实例内，PaDG沿时间维度分离预填充和解码阶段，以减轻干扰并提高吞吐量。接下来，它协调多个实例并循环激活它们，以确保预填充处理的持续可用性，从而解决延迟问题。因此，EcoServe的基本服务单元是宏实例（macro instance），其中多个实例协作工作。它还结合了自适应调度算法来在宏实例内路由请求，以及一种有丝分裂（mitosis）缩放方法，用于在线场景中精细调整容量。在用于30B和70B规模LLM的32-GPU NVIDIA L20以太网集群上，与四个代表性的NoDG和FuDG系统（vLLM、Sarathi、DistServe和MoonCake）相比，EcoServe的有效吞吐量（goodput）分别提升了1.96倍、1.99倍、2.51倍和2.40倍。即使在具有NVLink和InfiniBand的NVIDIA H100集群上，EcoServe仍然具备竞争力。我们的代码发布在 https://github.com/MLSysU/EcoServe。

import_candidates.title: Revisiting Pipeline Parallelism for LLM Serving
import_candidates.abstract:
As the memory capacity of a single GPU is insufficient to accommodate large language models (LLMs), model parallelism has become the standard approach for serving LLMs across multiple GPUs. In online serving environments, tensor parallelism has become the de facto way in single-node multi-GPU systems because it can reduce the computation latency through parallel execution. Although pipeline parallelism can offer higher throughput, it suffers from pipeline imbalance that is exacerbated under online workloads, leading to resource underutilization and performance degradation.
In this study, we revisit pipeline parallelism for serving LLMs. Our analysis shows that computational imbalance between pipeline stages becomes exacerbated in online serving. To address these pipeline inefficiencies, we propose three techniques: two mechanisms, greedy and predictive schemes, that dynamically adjust the chunk size to mitigate prefill-induced bubbles, and a delay scheduling technique that dynamically rebalances decode workloads across pipeline stages to further reduce pipeline bubbles. We implement our techniques on top of SGLang and demonstrate that, for Qwen2.5 32B and 14B on four NVIDIA A100 40GB GPUs, pipeline parallelism with our mechanisms outperforms tensor parallelism.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 由于单个GPU的内存容量无法容纳大语言模型(LLM)，模型并行已成为跨多个GPU服务LLM的标准方法。在在线服务环境中，张量并行已成为单节点多GPU系统中的事实标准，因为它可以通过并行执行降低计算延迟。虽然流水线并行可以提供更高的吞吐量，但它存在流水线不平衡的问题，该问题在在线工作负载下会加剧，导致资源利用率不足和性能下降。在本研究中，我们重新审视了用于服务LLM的流水线并行。我们的分析表明，管道阶段之间的计算不平衡在在线服务中会加剧。为了解决这些流水线低效问题，我们提出了三种技术：两种机制（贪婪和预测方案），动态调整块大小以缓解预填充引起的空闲；以及一种延迟调度技术，该技术动态地在流水线阶段之间重新平衡解码工作负载，以进一步减少流水线空闲。我们在SGLang之上实现了我们的技术，并证明在四块NVIDIA A100 40GB GPU上，对于Qwen2.5 32B和14B模型，带有我们机制的流水线并行优于张量并行。

import_candidates.title: OpenTela: Unifying Decentralized Computing Resources for Heterogeneous LLM Serving (Operational Systems)
import_candidates.abstract:
Large language models (LLMs) are becoming critical to a variety of public services, motivating sovereign AI initiatives that seek to serve models on infrastructure they control. Yet much of this infrastructure is built as HPC clusters optimized for batch jobs rather than interactive, always-on inference services. Existing LLM serving engines efficiently execute requests on GPUs, but rely on an external control plane (e.g., Kubernetes in cloud environments) for service discovery, routing, health monitoring, and load balancing. In HPC environments, these primitives are often unavailable: resources are managed by schedulers such as Slurm, allocations are transient, compute nodes may be unreachable from outside the cluster, and GPU capacity is fragmented across heterogeneous clusters and administrative domains.
We present OpenTela, a user-space orchestration overlay that turns existing fragmented HPC clusters into a unified, cross-institutional serving platform. OpenTela provides fault-tolerant service discovery via a CRDT-based gossip network, a unified API over heterogeneous cluster managers and serving engines, and a heterogeneity-aware scheduler, all in user-space without root privileges or cluster reconfiguration. OpenTela has been deployed for over 22 months, serving 13 million requests and 15 billion tokens across 142 models to over 1000 researchers across multiple institutions. We open-source the system and release an anonymized production trace to facilitate further research into real-world LLM serving workloads, and provide a replicable blueprint for other sovereign AI initiatives to harness their own federated GPU infrastructure.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）正成为各种公共服务的关键，推动了主权人工智能倡议，这些倡议寻求在自身控制的基础设施上服务模型。然而，这些基础设施中有许多是为批处理作业优化而非交互式、常驻推理服务的HPC集群。现有的LLM服务引擎能够在GPU上高效执行请求，但依赖外部控制平面（例如云环境中的Kubernetes）进行服务发现、路由、健康监控和负载均衡。在HPC环境中，这些原语往往不可用：资源由Slurm等调度器管理、分配是短暂的、计算节点可能无法从集群外部访问，并且GPU容量碎片化地分布在异构集群和管理域中。我们提出了OpenTela，一种用户空间编排覆盖层，将现有的碎片化HPC集群转变为统一的、跨机构的服务平台。OpenTela通过基于CRDT的八卦网络提供容错服务发现、在异构集群管理器和服务引擎之上提供统一API，并提供感知异构性的调度器，所有这些都在用户空间中完成，不需要根权限或集群重新配置。OpenTela已部署超过22个月，在142个模型上服务了1300万次请求和150亿个token，为多个机构的1000多名研究人员提供服务。我们开源了该系统并发布了匿名化生产跟踪数据，以促进对真实世界LLM服务工作负载的进一步研究，并为其他主权人工智能倡议提供可复制的蓝图，使其能够利用自己的联邦GPU基础设施。

import_candidates.title: Kairox: Adaptive GPU-CPU Hybrid LLM Inference via Online Neuron Balancing
import_candidates.abstract:
Hybrid LLM inference systems exploit both GPU and CPU for computation and memory but are bottlenecked by the CPU’s lower computational capabilities. Recent approaches leverage activation sparsity by offline partitioning FFN neurons into "hot" (frequently activated) and "cold" (rarely activated) sets. This approach retains critical computations on the GPU, yet static partitioning struggles to adapt to runtime activation changes, leading to suboptimal throughput.
We present Kairox, an adaptive GPU-CPU hybrid inference system that addresses these limitations through online neuron balancing, a mechanism that dynamically redistributes neurons between the GPU and CPU based on activation patterns. To realize this, Kairox introduces a Live Pipeline designed to prefetch neurons by predicting next-layer activation patterns. Furthermore, leveraging activation locality, we develop a Temporal Activation Momentum cache policy to prioritize neurons with sustained utility while minimizing transient, wasteful transfers. Finally, an Adaptive Neuron Balancer modulates the balancing intensity according to runtime resource conditions, maintaining an optimal equilibrium between competing system bottlenecks. For standard completion on consumer-grade PCs, Kairox improves end-to-end throughput by up to 7.57×, 3.70×, 6.35×, and 3.76× over llama.cpp, PowerInfer, Neuralink, and Q-Infer, respectively. Across all evaluated settings, it achieves geomean speedups of 3.15× and 3.93× over llama.cpp on two representative PCs and around 2.1× over the three sparse baselines.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 混合LLM推理系统同时利用GPU和CPU进行计算和内存，但受到CPU较低计算能力的瓶颈限制。近期的技术通过将FFN神经元离线划分为“热”（频繁激活）和“冷”（很少激活）集合来利用激活稀疏性。这种方法将关键计算保留在GPU上，但静态分区难以适应运行时激活变化，导致吞吐量欠优。我们提出了Kairox，一种自适应GPU-CPU混合推理系统，通过在线神经元平衡机制解决这些限制——该机制根据激活模式在GPU和CPU之间动态重新分配神经元。为实现这一点，Kairox引入了一个实时流水线（Live Pipeline），通过预测下一层激活模式来预取神经元。此外，利用激活局部性，我们开发了一种时间激活动量缓存策略（Temporal Activation Momentum cache policy），以优先保留具有持续效用的神经元，同时最大限度地减少瞬时且浪费的数据迁移。最后，一个自适应神经元平衡器（Adaptive Neuron Balancer）根据运行时资源条件调整平衡强度，在相互竞争的系统瓶颈之间保持最优均衡。在消费级PC上的标准补全任务中，Kairox相对于llama.cpp、PowerInfer、Neuralink和Q-Infer分别将端到端吞吐量最高提升了7.57倍、3.70倍、6.35倍和3.76倍。在所有评估设置下，它在两款代表性PC上相对于llama.cpp分别实现了3.15倍和3.93倍的几何平均加速，并相对于三个稀疏基线实现约2.1倍的加速。

import_candidates.title: ADAngel: Accelerating Arbitrary-Precision Quantized LLMs with Adaptive Computing Mapping
import_candidates.abstract:
Arbitrary-Precision Quantization (APQ), which uses asymmetric bit-widths for weights and activations (e.g., W4A8), is a prevalent technique for LLM inference because of its excellent accuracy-performance balance. APQ transforms the general matrix multiplications (GEMM), the core of LLM computation, into mixed-precision GEMM (mpGEMM) whose two operand matrices have different quantization bit-widths. However, we identify that the computation paradigms of mpGEMM in current APQ LLM inference systems are sub-optimal because the shapes and bit-widths of mpGEMM tasks in APQ LLM are highly variable, whereas existing static and workload-unaware paradigms can only accelerate mpGEMM tasks with the same or similar shapes and bit-widths.
Based on this finding, we propose ADAngel, a framework for creating a workload-adaptive mpGEMM computation core for target LLMs. The theoretical foundation of ADAngel is the DPR (Decomposition-Partial Product-Reconstruction) computation model, which enables systematic generation of a diverse portfolio of mpGEMM algorithms by specifying different bit-partition schemes. Guided by this model, ADAngel constructs a Computation Strategy Set comprising several highly optimized mpGEMM kernels, and exhaustively analyzes the strategy set to create an Oracle Policy Map, which enables a lightweight dispatcher to select and execute the optimal kernel for runtime mpGEMM tasks with negligible overhead. Our evaluation shows that the ADAngel-specialized engine achieves up to a 5.10× speedup in decode throughput over llama.cpp; while in the prefill stage, it demonstrates its adaptivity by delivering speedups ranging from 1.17× to 2.38× over TensorRT-LLM in Time-To-First-Token (TTFT).
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 任意精度量化（APQ）是一种广泛用于大语言模型（LLM）推理的技术，它采用非对称的权重和激活位宽（如W4A8），在精度和性能之间取得了出色的平衡。APQ将LLM计算的核心——通用矩阵乘法（GEMM）——转化为混合精度GEMM（mpGEMM），其中两个操作数矩阵具有不同的量化位宽。然而，我们发现当前APQ LLM推理系统中的mpGEMM计算范式是次优的，因为APQ LLM中的mpGEMM任务的形状和位宽变化很大，而现有的静态且不感知工作负载的范式只能加速具有相同或相似形状和位宽的mpGEMM任务。基于这一发现，我们提出了ADAngel，一个为目标LLM创建工作负载自适应的mpGEMM计算核心的框架。ADAngel的理论基础是DPR（分解-部分积-重构）计算模型，它通过指定不同的比特划分方案，能够系统性地生成多样化的mpGEMM算法组合。在该模型的指导下，ADAngel构建了一个包含多个高度优化的mpGEMM内核的计算策略集，并详尽分析该策略集以创建Oracle策略映射，从而使一个轻量级调度器能够以可忽略的开销为运行时mpGEMM任务选择并执行最优内核。我们的评估表明，ADAngel专用引擎在解码吞吐量上比llama.cpp最高可提速5.10倍；在预填充阶段，它通过相较于TensorRT-LLM在首令牌时间（TTFT）上提供1.17倍至2.38倍的加速，展示了其自适应性。

import_candidates.title: Optimal Software Pipelining and Warp Specialization for Tensor Core GPUs
import_candidates.abstract: GPU architectures have continued to grow in complexity, with recent incarnations introducing increasingly powerful fixed-function units for matrix multiplication and data movement to accompany highly parallel general-purpose cores. To fully leverage these machines, software must use sophisticated schedules that maximally utilize all hardware resources. Since realizing such schedules is complex, both programmers and compilers routinely employ program transformations, such as software pipelining (SWP) and warp specialization (WS), to do so in practice. However, determining how best to use SWP and WS in combination is a challenging problem that is currently handled through a mix of brittle compilation heuristics and fallible human intuition, with little insight into the space of solutions. To remedy this situation, we introduce a novel formulation of SWP and WS as a joint optimization problem that can be solved holistically by off-the-shelf constraint solvers. We reify our approach in Twill, the first system that automatically derives optimal SWP and WS schedules for a large class of iterative programs. Twill is heuristic-free, easily extensible to new GPU architectures, and guaranteed to produce optimal schedules. We show that Twill can rediscover, and thereby prove optimal, the SWP and WS schedules manually developed by experts for Flash Attention on both the NVIDIA Hopper and Blackwell GPU architectures.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: GPU 架构持续变得更加复杂，最新版本在高度并行的通用核心之外，引入了功能日益强大的固定功能单元，用于矩阵乘法和数据移动。为了充分利用这些机器，软件必须采用复杂的调度方案，以最大限度地利用所有硬件资源。由于实现此类调度较为复杂，程序员和编译器在实践中通常采用程序转换技术，例如软件流水线（SWP）和 Warp 专业化（WS）。然而，确定如何最佳地组合使用 SWP 和 WS 是一个具有挑战性的问题，当前常依靠脆弱的编译启发式方法和易错的人类直觉来处理，而对解决方案空间缺乏深入理解。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的 SWP 和 WS 联合优化公式，可通过现成的约束求解器进行整体求解。我们将该方法具体化为 Twill——第一个能够对一大类迭代程序自动推导出最优 SWP 和 WS 调度的系统。Twill 无需启发式，易于扩展到新的 GPU 架构，并保证生成最优调度。我们展示 Twill 能够重新发现并因此证明专家为 NVIDIA Hopper 和 Blackwell GPU 架构上的 Flash Attention 手动开发的 SWP 和 WS 调度方案的最优性。

import_candidates.title: TileLoom: Automatic Dataflow Planning for Tile-Based Languages on Spatial Dataflow Accelerators
import_candidates.abstract:
Spatial dataflow accelerators are a promising direction for next-generation computer systems because they can reduce the memory bottlenecks of traditional von Neumann machines such as CPUs and GPUs. They organize computation around explicit, compiler-managed data movement over on-chip networks, allowing operands to be forwarded directly between processing elements and reducing reliance on high-latency, bandwidth-limited global shared memory. However, their performance depends strongly on how workloads are mapped to hardware. Naive mappings can perform poorly, and most users rely on hand-tuned vendor libraries. Thus, despite their potential for high performance, energy efficiency, and cost efficiency, limited programmability remains a major barrier to wider adoption.
This paper presents TileLoom, an MLIR-based end-to-end framework that compiles tile-based programs, such as Triton kernels, onto spatial dataflow architectures. Unlike compiler frameworks that focus on optimizing code generation within a single tile, TileLoom distributes tile instances across spatially distributed cores and exploits the on-chip network and distributed memories to increase data reuse and reduce communication. TileLoom introduces a hardware representation that captures interconnect topology, memory hierarchy, and compute capabilities, enabling both architecture-specific optimizations and support for diverse spatial dataflow targets. In experiments on two generations of Tenstorrent systems, TileLoom achieves performance comparable to vendor libraries on various kernels.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 空间数据流加速器是下一代计算机系统的一个有前景的方向，因为它们可以减少传统冯·诺依曼机器（如CPU和GPU）的内存瓶颈。它们围绕显式的、编译器管理的片上网络数据移动来组织计算，允许操作数在处理单元之间直接转发，从而减少对高延迟、带宽受限的全局共享内存的依赖。然而，它们的性能在很大程度上取决于工作负载如何映射到硬件上。简单的映射可能表现不佳，而大多数用户依赖手工调优的厂商库。因此，尽管它们具有高性能、高能效和高成本效率的潜力，有限的可编程性仍然是阻碍其更广泛采用的主要障碍。本文提出了TileLoom，一个基于MLIR的端到端框架，用于将基于块的程序（如Triton内核）编译到空间数据流架构上。与专注于在单个块内优化代码生成的编译器框架不同，TileLoom将块实例分布到空间分布的核心上，并利用片上网络和分布式内存来增加数据重用并减少通信。TileLoom引入了一种硬件表示，用于捕获互连拓扑、内存层次结构和计算能力，从而支持架构特定的优化以及对不同空间数据流目标的适配。在Tenstorrent两代系统上的实验表明，TileLoom在各种内核上实现了与厂商库相当的性能。

import_candidates.title: MPK: A Compiler and Runtime for Mega-Kernelizing Tensor Programs
import_candidates.abstract: We introduce Mirage Persistent Kernel (MPK), the first compiler and runtime system that automatically transforms multi-GPU model inference into a single high-performance mega-kernel. MPK introduces an SM-level graph representation that captures data dependencies at the granularity of individual streaming multiprocessors (SMs), enabling cross-operator software pipelining, fine-grained overlap of computation and communication, and other optimizations that are infeasible under the conventional kernel-per-operator execution model. The MPK compiler lowers tensor programs into optimized SM-level task graphs and generates fast CUDA implementations for each task, while the MPK in-kernel parallel runtime executes these tasks within a single persistent mega-kernel using decentralized scheduling across SMs. Together, these components provide end-to-end kernel fusion with minimal developer effort, while preserving the flexibility of existing programming models. Our evaluation shows that MPK significantly outperforms existing kernel-per-operator LLM serving systems, achieving up to 1.7× lower end-to-end inference latency and pushing LLM inference performance close to the limits of the underlying hardware. MPK is publicly available at https://github.com/mirage-project/mirage.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们介绍了Mirage Persistent Kernel (MPK)，这是首个自动将多GPU模型推理转换为单个高性能超级内核的编译器和运行时系统。MPK引入了SM级图表示，以单个流式多处理器（SM）的粒度捕获数据依赖关系，从而实现跨算子软件流水线、计算与通信的细粒度重叠，以及在传统算子级内核执行模型下不可行的其他优化。MPK编译器将张量程序降级为优化的SM级任务图，并为每个任务生成高效的CUDA实现，而MPK的内核内并行运行时则通过SM间的去中心化调度，在单个持久化超级内核内执行这些任务。这些组件共同以最小化开发者努力的方式提供端到端的内核融合，同时保留现有编程模型的灵活性。我们的评估表明，MPK显著优于现有的算子级内核LLM服务系统，实现了高达1.7倍的端到端推理延迟降低，使LLM推理性能接近底层硬件的极限。MPK可在 https://github.com/mirage-project/mirage 公开获取。

import_candidates.title: GraCE: Unlocking CUDA Graphs with Compiler Support for ML Workloads
import_candidates.abstract:
Machine learning (ML) workloads launch hundreds of short-running GPU kernels per iteration. With GPU compute throughput growing rapidly, CPU-side launch latency of kernels is emerging as a bottleneck. CUDA Graphs promise to address this by replaying a set of kernels with a single dispatch of the graph, removing per-kernel launch costs. However, CUDA Graphs remain surprisingly difficult to deploy correctly and efficiently.
We present GraCE—a compiler framework to maximize the coverage and benefits of CUDA Graphs for ML workloads. It introduces three novel optimizations: it applies automatic code transformations to make ML applications amenable for CUDA Graphs; it eliminates the parameter copy overheads for kernels executing in CUDA Graphs, and it selectively deploys CUDA Graphs guided by a cost–benefit analysis. For 25 ML workloads from TorchBench, HuggingFace and TIMM, GraCE more than doubles the benefit from deploying CUDA Graph compared to the most popular and widely used ML compiler PyTorch2. GraCE is built atop PyTorch2’s compilation framework and requires no programmer intervention.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 机器学习（ML）工作负载每次迭代会启动数百个短时运行的GPU内核。随着GPU计算吞吐量快速增长，CPU端的核启动延迟正成为瓶颈。CUDA Graphs有望通过一次性调度一组内核来消除每次内核的启动开销。然而，CUDA Graphs在实际部署中仍然难以做到既正确又高效。我们提出了GraCE——一个编译器框架，旨在最大化CUDA Graphs在ML工作负载中的覆盖范围和收益。它引入了三项新颖的优化：应用自动代码转换使ML应用适应CUDA Graphs；消除在CUDA Graphs中执行的内核的参数复制开销；以及根据成本-收益分析选择性部署CUDA Graphs。对于来自TorchBench、HuggingFace和TIMM的25个ML工作负载，GraCE相比最流行且广泛使用的ML编译器PyTorch2，将从部署CUDA Graphs中获得的收益提升了一倍以上。GraCE构建在PyTorch2的编译框架之上，无需程序员干预。

import_candidates.title: VTC: DNN Compilation with Virtual Tensors for Data Movement Elimination
import_candidates.abstract:
With the widening gap between compute and memory operation latencies, data movement optimizations have become increasingly important for DNN compilation. Current optimizations such as layout transformations and operator fusion only target a subset of tensor operators and consequently miss important opportunities for reducing data movement in contemporary DNN workloads, including large language models.
We introduce VTC, a novel tensor compilation framework that for the first time eliminates all unnecessary data movement by targeting the full spectrum of data movement operators. VTC proposes the concept of virtual tensors to track data movement between compute operators via index mappings rather than expensive physical data transfers to and from global memory, which can seamlessly interoperate with existing computation kernels and handle arbitrary tensor operator compositions. We also introduce a novel data movement elimination algorithm to automatically identify a profitable virtual tensor creation strategy. Evaluation on a variety of DNNs shows that VTC can outperform existing ML compilers by up to 1.93× (1.28× on average) on NVIDIA GPUs with up to 60% (17.5% on average) inference memory savings.
