import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着计算与内存操作延迟之间的差距不断拉大，数据移动优化在DNN编译中变得越来越重要。当前诸如布局转换和算子融合之类的优化仅针对一部分张量算子，因此错过了在当代DNN工作负载（包括大型语言模型）中减少数据移动的重要机会。我们提出了VTC，一种新颖的张量编译框架，首次通过针对全部数据移动算子来消除所有不必要的数据移动。VTC提出了虚拟张量的概念，通过索引映射而非与全局内存之间进行昂贵的物理数据传输来跟踪计算算子之间的数据移动，从而能与现有计算内核无缝互操作，并处理任意张量算子组合。我们还引入了一种新颖的数据移动消除算法，以自动识别有利可图的虚拟张量创建策略。对各种DNN的评估表明，VTC在NVIDIA GPU上相比现有ML编译器可实现最高1.93倍（平均1.28倍）的性能提升，并可节省高达60%（平均17.5%）的推理内存。

import_candidates.title: Stop Pretending to Be Busy: A Case for Serverless Paradigms in Co-Located Batch Workloads (Operational Systems)
import_candidates.abstract:
High resource utilization is significant for cloud vendors. To achieve this, a common practice is to co-locate low-priority batch workloads (typically Spark-based analytics) with high-priority online services, while strictly maintaining Service Level Objectives (SLOs). This paper presents an empirical study of co-location and overcommitment in a production-scale datacenter. Specifically, within Ant Group, online services utilize only 22.0% of available CPU resources. By carefully overcommitting resources to deploy batch workloads, the system harvests an additional 26.8% of CPU capacity.
Despite this increased density, we observe that batch workloads remain inefficient, with a useful computation ratio of only 67%. We identify the root causes of this low "effective utilization" as four types of idleness: (1) slot idle, arising from coarse-grained resource management in Spark; (2) gap idle, caused by hardware heterogeneity and interference; and (3/4) start/stop idles, resulting from the high latency of launching and destroying analytic instances. To address these inefficiencies, we propose Quark, a novel framework that integrates serverless paradigms into batch analytics. Quark eliminates these idles through fine-grained resource allocation, heterogeneity and skew-aware scheduling, and rapid instance provisioning. Experimental results show that Quark increases cluster utilization by about 37.37% and reduces the proportion of long-tail jobs from 15% to 2%. Quark has been deployed at scale within Ant Group, processing 350,000 offline query jobs daily across a deployment footprint of 600,000 CPU cores, processing between 7,500 TB and 10,000 TB of data daily, and saving more than 100,000 CPU cores.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 高资源利用率对云厂商至关重要。为实现这一目标，一种常见做法是将低优先级批处理工作负载（通常是基于Spark的分析任务）与高优先级在线服务共置，同时严格维持服务级别目标（SLO）。本文对生产规模数据中心中的共置和超卖进行了一项实证研究。具体来说，在蚂蚁集团内，在线服务仅利用22.0%的可用CPU资源。通过仔细对资源进行超卖以部署批处理工作负载，系统额外收获了26.8%的CPU容量。尽管密度有所提高，我们观察到批处理工作负载仍然低效，其有用计算比例仅为67%。我们将这种低"有效利用率"的根源归结为四类空闲：（1）时隙空闲，源于Spark中的粗粒度资源管理；（2）间隙空闲，由硬件异构性和干扰造成；（3/4）启动/停止空闲，源于启动和销毁分析实例的高延迟。为应对这些低效问题，我们提出了Quark，一个将无服务器范式集成到批处理分析中的新型框架。Quark通过细粒度资源分配、异构性和倾斜感知调度以及快速实例供应消除了这些空闲。实验结果表明，Quark将集群利用率提高了约37.37%，并将长尾作业的比例从15%降低到2%。Quark已在蚂蚁集团大规模部署，每天处理350,000个离线查询作业，部署规模达600,000个CPU核心，每天处理7,500TB至10,000TB的数据，并节省了超过100,000个CPU核心。

import_candidates.title: Continuation-Centric Computing with Arca
import_candidates.abstract:
This paper presents continuation-centric computing, an operating system design paradigm for “serverless”-style workloads: short-lived tasks that spend a substantial fraction of time waiting on dependencies and other services. Under this paradigm, a running function can capture its current continuation—a lightweight snapshot of its state—as a distinct function that can be paused, migrated, or copied as needed.
This paper evaluates the continuation-centric computing model using Arca, an operating system providing continuation capture as a core service. Arca supports a process abstraction that is broadly similar to Unix processes in guarantees and isolation, but additionally provides efficient capture and resumption of serializable, portable continuations.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文提出以续延为中心的计算（continuation-centric computing），这是一种面向“无服务器”（serverless）类工作负载的操作系统设计范式：短生命周期任务在依赖和其他服务上花费大量时间等待。在该范式下，正在运行的函数可以捕获其当前续延——其状态的轻量快照——作为独立的函数，可根据需要暂停、迁移或复制。本文使用Arca评估了以续延为中心的计算模型，Arca是一个提供续延捕获作为核心服务的操作系统。Arca支持与Unix进程在保证和隔离性上大致相似的进程抽象，但额外提供了可序列化、可移植续延的高效捕获与恢复。

import_candidates.title: Rethinking Process Snapshots for Near-Warm Serverless Cold Starts
import_candidates.abstract:
Serverless computing promises effortless resource elasticity, yet this vision remains fundamentally limited by cold-start delays. Despite years of optimization, many function invocations still incur delays of tens to hundreds of milliseconds, often exceeding the function’s actual execution time. Existing systems attempt to avoid redundant initialization by snapshotting functions after startup and restoring them on demand, but they still struggle to deliver consistently low-latency startup from disk.
We show that these limitations stem from a lack of OS support for snapshot restoration. Current memory primitives, tailored for incremental process startup, force a trade-off between efficient on-disk layout and cheap virtual address space reconstruction. Furthermore, the kernel lacks a bulk-restore mechanism for process metadata, forcing expensive, fine-grained reconstruction from userspace.
To address this, we introduce the Snapshot Hybrid ELF (SHELF) format and a co-designed kernel primitive, the spliceVMA, which decouple a snapshot’s physical layout on storage from the process’s virtual-memory layout. This enables the efficient overlay of sparse and reordered pages, reliable prefetching, and the elimination of unnecessary I/O, copies, and faults. In parallel, we build an efficient process-metadata restore path that reconstructs process state in bulk rather than using a large number of system calls from userspace.
We implement these mechanisms in Spice, restoring and running functions from disk within 0.6–18ms of warm-invocation latency (compared to 3.6–1197ms in existing systems). For representative Java, Python, and Node.js functions, Spice reduces end-to-end latency by 7.5× and 9.5× on average over state-of-the-art process- and VM-based systems, respectively.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 无服务器计算承诺轻松的资源弹性，但这一愿景仍然从根本上受到冷启动延迟的限制。尽管经过多年的优化，许多函数调用仍然会产生数十到数百毫秒的延迟，往往超过函数实际执行时间。现有系统试图通过在启动后对函数进行快照并按需恢复来避免冗余初始化，但仍然难以实现从磁盘稳定地提供低延迟启动的体验。我们表明，这些限制源于操作系统缺乏对快照恢复的支持。当前为增量进程启动而设计的内存原语迫使人们在高效的磁盘布局与廉价的虚拟地址空间重建之间做出权衡。此外，内核缺少进程元数据的批量恢复机制，迫使从用户空间进行昂贵的细粒度重建。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了快照混合ELF（SHELF）格式和共同设计的内核原语spliceVMA，该原语将快照在存储上的物理布局与进程的虚拟内存布局解耦。这实现了稀疏和重排页面的高效覆盖、可靠的预取，并消除了不必要的I/O、拷贝和缺页中断。与此同时，我们构建了一条高效的进程元数据恢复路径，该路径批量重建进程状态，而不是依赖用户空间的大量系统调用。我们在Spice中实现了这些机制，从磁盘恢复并运行函数，热调用延迟为0.6–18毫秒（而现有系统为3.6–1197毫秒）。对于具有代表性的Java、Python和Node.js函数，Spice相比最先进的基于进程和基于虚拟机的系统，平均端到端延迟分别降低了7.5倍和9.5倍。

import_candidates.title: Distributed Speculative Execution for Resilient Cloud Applications
import_candidates.abstract: Fault-tolerance is critically important in highly distributed modern cloud applications. Solutions such as Temporal, Azure Durable Functions, and Beldi hide fault-tolerance complexity from developers by automatically persisting execution state and resuming seamlessly after failure. This pattern, often called durable execution, usually forces frequent and synchronous persistence, resulting in significant latency overheads. In this paper, we propose distributed speculative execution (DSE), a technique for implementing the durable execution abstraction without incurring this penalty. With DSE, developers write code assuming synchronous persistence, and a DSE runtime is responsible for transparently eliding persistence and reactively repairing application state on failure. We present libDSE, the first DSE application framework that achieves this vision. To hide speculation from application code, we design a novel programming model centered around message-passing, atomic code blocks, and lightweight threads, and show that it allows developers to build a variety of speculative services, including write-ahead logs, key-value stores, event brokers, and fault-tolerant workflows. Our evaluation shows that libDSE reduces end-to-end latency by up to an order of magnitude for persistence-bound applications compared to current durable execution systems with minimal runtime overhead and complexity.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 容错在现代高度分布式云应用中至关重要。诸如Temporal、Azure Durable Functions和Beldi等解决方案通过自动持久化执行状态并在故障后无缝恢复，将容错复杂性对开发者隐藏。这种模式通常称为持久执行，通常强制频繁的同步持久化，导致显著的延迟开销。在本文中，我们提出了分布式推测执行（DSE），一种在不产生这种代价的情况下实现持久执行抽象的技术。使用DSE时，开发者以同步持久化为假设编写代码，而DSE运行时负责透明地省略持久化并在故障时反应性地修复应用状态。我们提出了libDSE，这是第一个实现这一愿景的DSE应用框架。为了将推测性对应用代码隐藏，我们设计了一种围绕消息传递、原子代码块和轻量级线程的新型编程模型，并表明它允许开发者构建各种推测性服务，包括预写日志、键值存储、事件代理和容错工作流。我们的评估表明，与当前的持久执行系统相比，libDSE在持久化密集型应用上的端到端延迟降低最多可达一个数量级，且运行时开销和复杂度极低。

import_candidates.title: TrainMover: An Interruption-Resilient Runtime for ML Training
import_candidates.abstract: Large-scale ML training jobs are frequently interrupted by hardware and software anomalies, failures, and management events. Existing solutions like checkpoint-restart or runtime reconfiguration suffer from long downtimes and degraded performance. We present TrainMover, a resilient LLM training runtime that leverages elastic and standby machines to handle interruptions with minimal downtime and zero memory overhead. To achieve these goals, TrainMover introduces three key techniques: two-phase, delta-based communication group setup; communication-free sandboxed warmup; and general standby design that enables failure recovery from any role. Our evaluation shows that TrainMover consistently achieves around 20 seconds of downtime when handling various interruptions at the 1024-GPU scale. TrainMover is projected to reduce wasted GPU hours by 55% compared to the best alternative, saving 1.4 million GPU-hours per week at the 64K-GPU scale.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大规模机器学习训练任务经常因硬件和软件异常、故障及管理事件而中断。现有解决方案如检查点重启或运行时重新配置，存在停机时间长和性能下降的问题。我们提出了TrainMover，一个具有弹性的LLM训练运行时，利用弹性机器和备用机器来处理中断，实现最小停机时间和零内存开销。为实现这些目标，TrainMover引入了三项关键技术：基于增量的两阶段通信组建立；免通信的沙箱热身；以及支持任意角色故障恢复的通用备用设计。我们的评估表明，在1024-GPU规模下，TrainMover在处理各种中断时能持续实现约20秒的停机时间。在64K-GPU规模下，与最佳替代方案相比，TrainMover预计可将浪费的GPU时数减少55%，每周节省140万GPU时。

import_candidates.title: MoonBright: A GPU Memory Allocator with Device-Side Page Table Materialization and Deferred TLB Coherence
import_candidates.abstract: Modern GPU workloads increasingly rely on dynamic and fine-grained memory allocation, yet GPU memory management remains CPU-centric. In current GPU runtimes, allocation metadata updates, page-table construction, translation-state propagation, and TLB shootdowns are largely serialized through the host control path, introducing substantial latency. We present MoonBright, a GPU memory allocator that enables device-side page-table materialization and deferred TLB coherence on commodity GPUs. MoonBright keeps validation and allocation metadata on the host, but moves bulk page-table construction to the GPU, turning translation updates into data-parallel device-memory operations. To avoid costly TLB shootdowns on the common path, MoonBright assigns fresh virtual addresses to new mappings, ensuring that no stale same-address TLB entries can exist. Our evaluation shows that MoonBright reduces allocation latency, improves LLM inference performance, and mitigates allocator-level external fragmentation across diverse workloads. Unlike application-specific memory managers, MoonBright requires no GPU hardware modifications and runs on commodity NVIDIA and AMD GPUs with software-only changes. MoonBright is publicly available at https://github.com/MoonBright-project.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代GPU工作负载越来越依赖于动态和细粒度的内存分配，但GPU内存管理仍然以CPU为中心。在当前的GPU运行时中，分配元数据更新、页表构建、转换状态传播和TLB shootdown大多通过主机控制路径串行化，引入了大量延迟。我们提出了MoonBright，一种GPU内存分配器，可在商用GPU上实现设备端页表物化和延迟TLB一致性。MoonBright将验证和分配元数据保留在主机端，但将大规模的页表构建转移到GPU端，使转换更新成为数据并行的设备内存操作。为了避免常见路径上昂贵的TLB shootdown，MoonBright为新映射分配全新的虚拟地址，确保不存在相同地址的陈旧TLB条目。我们的评估表明，MoonBright在不同工作负载中降低了分配延迟，提升了LLM推理性能，并减轻了分配器级别的外部碎片。与应用专用的内存管理器不同，MoonBright不需要修改GPU硬件，仅通过软件改动即可在商用NVIDIA和AMD GPU上运行。MoonBright已公开于https://github.com/MoonBright-project。

import_candidates.title: Nixie: Efficient, Transparent Temporal Multiplexing for Consumer GPUs
import_candidates.abstract:
Consumer machines are increasingly running large ML workloads such as large language models (LLMs), text-to-image generation, and interactive image editing. Unlike datacenter GPUs, consumer GPUs serve single-user, rapidly changing workloads, and each model’s working set often nearly fills the GPU memory. As a result, existing sharing mechanisms, such as NVIDIA Unified Virtual Memory (UVM), suffer from severe memory thrashing and consume excessive CPU pinned memory when multiple applications are active.
We design and implement Nixie, a system service that enables efficient and transparent temporal multiplexing on consumer GPUs without requiring any application or driver changes. Nixie coordinates GPU memory allocation and kernel launch behavior to efficiently utilize the CPU-GPU bi-directional bandwidth and CPU pinned memory. A lightweight scheduler in Nixie further improves responsiveness by automatically prioritizing latency-sensitive interactive jobs using MLFQ-inspired techniques. Our evaluations show that, compared to UVM-based approaches, Nixie improves the latency of interactive code-completion tasks co-located with a long-running LLM by up to 3.8x and reduces CPU pinned memory usage by up to 66.8% under the same latency requirement.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 消费级机器越来越多地运行大型机器学习工作负载，如大型语言模型（LLM）、文本到图像生成和交互式图像编辑。与数据中心GPU不同，消费级GPU服务于单用户、快速变化的工作负载，而每个模型的工作集通常几乎占满GPU内存。因此，现有的共享机制（如NVIDIA统一虚拟内存（UVM））在多个应用程序同时活跃时会遭遇严重的内存抖动，并消耗过多的CPU锁定内存。我们设计并实现了Nixie，一种系统服务，无需任何应用程序或驱动程序更改即可在消费级GPU上实现高效且透明的时分复用。Nixie协调GPU内存分配和内核启动行为，以高效利用CPU-GPU双向带宽和CPU锁定内存。Nixie中的一个轻量级调度器通过采用受MLFQ启发的技术自动优先处理延迟敏感的交互式作业，进一步提高了响应性。我们的评估表明，与基于UVM的方法相比，Nixie将与长时间运行的LLM共置的交互式代码补全任务的延迟提高了最多3.8倍，并在相同延迟要求下减少了最多66.8%的CPU锁定内存使用。

import_candidates.title: μShell: A Microkernel-based FPGA Shell Architecture
import_candidates.abstract:
FPGAs are widely adopted in cloud environments to meet the growing demand for high-performance, energy-efficient computing, thanks to their unique reconfigurability and programmability. However, the state-of-the-art design of FPGA shells is built for monolithic applications, creating a fundamental architectural mismatch with real-world applications that are highly modular and composable. Modern applications consist of diverse, independent tasks that are often instantiated as standalone hardware modules on FPGAs. The current FPGA shell design statically connects these modules to compose an application-specific, monolithic accelerator on a single virtual FPGA (vFPGA), leading to fundamental challenges such as limited flexibility, poor scalability, resource inefficiency, high scheduling overheads, and programmability issues.
To bridge this research gap, we introduce μShell, a new hardware-OS co-design that addresses these challenges by applying microkernel principles to FPGA acceleration. μShell treats accelerators as a collection of shareable, composable hardware modules, deploying them into distinct vFPGAs and dynamically linking them with a novel inter-process communication (IPC) mechanism. This approach is further supported by capability-enforced isolation and a component-aware task scheduler. Our implementation of a μShell prototype and its evaluation against a state-of-the-art monolithic shell demonstrate that it effectively deploys real-world applications with improved performance, flexibility, and resource efficiency.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: FPGA凭借其独特的可重构性和可编程性，被广泛用于云环境，以满足对高性能、高能效计算日益增长的需求。然而，最先进的FPGA shell设计是针对单体应用打造的，与实际应用中高度模块化和可组合的特性存在根本性的架构不匹配。现代应用包含多样化、独立的任务，这些任务通常作为独立的硬件模块实例化在FPGA上。当前的FPGA shell设计静态连接这些模块，以在单个虚拟FPGA（vFPGA）上组合成应用特定的单体加速器，从而导致灵活性有限、可扩展性差、资源利用率低、调度开销大和可编程性差等根本性挑战。为弥补这一研究空白，我们提出μShell，一种新的硬件-操作系统协同设计，通过将微内核原理应用于FPGA加速来应对这些挑战。μShell将加速器视为一组可共享、可组合的硬件模块，将其部署到不同的vFPGA中，并使用一种新颖的进程间通信（IPC）机制动态连接它们。这种方法进一步由基于能力的隔离和组件感知的任务调度器所支撑。我们实现了μShell原型，并与最先进的单体shell进行对比评估，结果表明它能够以更好的性能、灵活性和资源效率部署真实应用。

import_candidates.title: Virtualizing eBPF with Late-Binding
import_candidates.abstract:
While eBPF has become the de facto standard for kernel customization in cloud-native systems, its design implicitly assumes a single trust domain. Allowing multiple tenants to deploy their own eBPF programs breaks this assumption, making the system both insecure and inefficient. We identify the root cause as eBPF’s static-binding model, which rigidly couples logical eBPF programs to physical kernel hooks, forcing tenants to contend for shared execution contexts.
We propose vBPF, a virtualization layer that shifts to a late-binding model. By repurposing physical hooks as generic interposition points and deferring the binding until the event is attributed at runtime, vBPF decouples tenant context from the underlying kernel. vBPF achieves this via three key mechanisms: (1) a Sniffer that accurately attributes interrupt-driven events to tenants, (2) a Dispatcher that replaces linear traversal with scalable O(1) program lookup, and (3) a compiler-assisted framework for state isolation. Implemented on Linux 6.12, vBPF enables the secure coexistence of multi-tenant workloads. Our evaluation shows that vBPF reduces latency by up to 3.9× (lmbench) and improves throughput by 29% (PostgreSQL) compared to native contention.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 尽管 eBPF 已成为云原生系统中内核定制的实际标准，其设计却隐含地假设了单一信任域。允许多个租户部署各自的 eBPF 程序会打破这一假设，从而使系统既不安全又低效。我们将根本原因归结为 eBPF 的静态绑定模型，该模型将逻辑 eBPF 程序与物理内核钩子僵化地耦合在一起，迫使租户争用共享执行上下文。我们提出了 vBPF，一个转向晚绑定模型的虚拟化层。通过将物理钩子重新用作通用拦截点，并将绑定推迟到运行时事件归属之后，vBPF 将租户上下文与底层内核解耦。vBPF 通过三项关键机制实现这一目标：（1）一个能够将中断驱动事件准确归属到租户的嗅探器；（2）一个用可扩展的 O(1) 程序查找取代线性遍历的调度器；（3）一个用于状态隔离的编译器辅助框架。vBPF 基于 Linux 6.12 实现，能够支持多租户工作负载的安全共存。我们的评估表明，与原生的争用情况相比，vBPF 可将延迟降低最多 3.9 倍（lmbench），并将吞吐量提升 29%（PostgreSQL）。

import_candidates.title: DVLA: Dynamic VM Lifetime Aware Scheduling for Drifting Lifetime Distributions and Long-Lived VM Placement Debt (Operational Systems)
import_candidates.abstract:
Efficient Virtual Machine (VM) scheduling is critical for maximizing resource utilization in cloud computing. However, state-of-the-art lifetime-aware schedulers face two critical issues in real-world deployments. First, their static policies are brittle against the significant spatial and temporal drifts of VM lifetime distributions. Second, and more insidiously, their placement strategies inadvertently scatter long-lived VMs, creating a persistent long-lived VM placement debt. This debt, compounded by inevitable prediction errors, pins down machines and cripples cluster-wide resource reclamation, and cannot be repaid by online scheduling alone.
To address these challenges, we present Dynamic VM Lifetime Aware scheduling (DVLA), an end-to-end system that synergistically combines online scheduling with offline rectification. DVLA comprises four key components: (1) a Hierarchical Lifetime Prediction Model that delivers multi-horizon predictions to inform both initial placement and offline optimization; (2) a Dynamic Affinity Grouping strategy that adapts to workload distribution drifts in real time; (3) a Debt-Aware Placement Policy (DAPP) that proactively consolidates long-lived VMs to minimize debt creation at the source; and (4) a Placement Debt Rectification Engine (PDRE) that employs strategic live migrations to amortize accumulated debt offline. Extensive trace-driven simulations and a large-scale production deployment at Alibaba Cloud demonstrate that DVLA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving an additional 0.6 percentage points in packing density. This translates to saving thousands of machines in production, delivering substantial cost reductions.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 高效的虚拟机（VM）调度对于最大化云计算中的资源利用率至关重要。然而，最先进的生命周期感知调度器在实际部署中面临两个关键问题。首先，其静态策略在面对虚拟机生命周期分布的重大空间和时间漂移时具有脆弱性。其次，更隐蔽的是，其放置策略会无意中分散长期存在的虚拟机，造成持续的长期虚拟机放置债务。这种债务加上不可避免的预测误差，会钉住机器并削弱整个集群的资源回收能力，仅靠在线调度无法偿还。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了动态虚拟机生命周期感知调度（DVLA），一个将在线调度与离线修正协同结合的自组织系统。DVLA包含四个关键组件：（1）分层生命周期预测模型，提供多时间范围预测以支持初始放置和离线优化；（2）动态亲和性分组策略，实时适应工作负载分布漂移；（3）债务感知放置策略（DAPP），主动整合长期虚拟机以从根本上最小化债务创建；以及（4）放置债务修正引擎（PDRE），通过战略性实时迁移在离线状态下摊销累积债务。大量基于轨迹的模拟以及在阿里云的大规模生产部署表明，DVLA始终优于最先进的方法，额外实现了0.6个百分点的装箱密度提升。这相当于在生产中节省数千台机器，带来显著的成本降低。

import_candidates.title: PIMS: Fleet-Wide Datacenter Maintenance with Minimal Capacity Buffer and Predictable Latency (Operational Systems)
import_candidates.abstract:
Maintenance is a fundamental operation in datacenters to ensure that hardware and software operate correctly, efficiently and use up-to-date versions. We present Meta’s maintenance system in production over the last five years that provides continuous support to tens of thousands of services running on our fleet of millions of servers and seamlessly orchestrates this process. To our knowledge, this is the first paper to discuss predictable maintenance at scale.
The key challenge is how to minimize the capacity buffer—servers reserved to absorb capacity loss caused by maintenance—while providing a predictable latency to maintenance operations. This paper presents a series of strategies and techniques we use to accomplish this goal, such as aligning maintenance with fault domains, placing hardware evenly across fault domains, a maintenance contract among participating parties, etc. Indicatively, we observe that these techniques have helped us reduce the size of the capacity buffer by about 15% in one quarter of 2025 and allowed us to perform a fleet-wide deployment under targeted SLOs (e.g., 45 days for a new OS, 90 days for a new firmware).
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 维护是数据中心的一项基本操作，旨在确保硬件和软件正确、高效运行并保持最新版本。我们介绍了Meta在过去五年中用于生产环境的维护系统，该系统为运行在我们数百万台服务器舰队上的数万个服务提供持续支持，并无缝地编排这一过程。据我们所知，这是第一篇讨论大规模可预测维护的论文。关键挑战是如何在维护操作提供可预测延迟的同时最小化容量缓冲——即用于吸收维护造成的容量损失的预留服务器。本文介绍了一系列我们为实现这一目标而采用的策略和技术，例如使维护与故障域对齐、跨故障域均匀放置硬件、参与方之间的维护契约等。指示性地，我们观察到这些技术帮助我们在2025年某个季度将容量缓冲规模减少了约15%，并使我们能够在目标SLO（例如，新操作系统45天，新固件90天）下进行全舰队部署。

import_candidates.title: Heterogeneity at Hyperscale: Characterization and Scheduling of Large Production AI Clusters at Alibaba (Operational Systems)
import_candidates.abstract: The rapid scaling of generative AI (GenAI), alongside the continued reliance on classical deep neural networks (DNNs), has pushed production AI infrastructure toward massive, heterogeneous GPU fleets. We present a comprehensive characterization of Alibaba Serverless Infrastructure (ASI), a hyperscale production cluster, based on a six-month trace covering 155,410 GPUs of multiple vendors and generations and jobs from 81 departments, spanning ad-hoc development, training, and online and offline inference. Our central finding is that high GPU demand does not yield high effective utilization: idle GPUs frequently become unallocatable because free capacity is stranded across nodes, lacks matching CPUs, or violates network-locality constraints, and because users reserve ample headroom for production safety. Notably, fractional-GPU fragmentation, a focus of prior work, is now negligible, as GPU sharing is rarely used. We detail deployed solutions that recover this capacity: a practical GPU defragmentation algorithm that cuts the number of nodes with slack resources by 20.2%, and SpotGPU, a preemption-cost-aware scheduling framework that safely harvests idle resources and raises the GPU allocation ratio from 68% to 93%. We further surface open challenges in skewed multi-vendor GPU adoption, bandwidth bottlenecks between heterogeneous GPUs, and interference among colocated workloads. We release the ASI trace, the most comprehensive to date in workload diversity and cluster scale, to support future research.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能（GenAI）的快速扩展，加上对经典深度神经网络（DNN）的持续依赖，已将生产AI基础设施推向大规模、异构的GPU集群。我们基于一份涵盖155,410块多厂商、多代GPU以及来自81个部门的作业（涵盖临时开发、训练、在线和离线推理）的六个月追踪数据，对阿里巴巴无服务器基础设施（ASI）这一超大规模生产集群进行了全面特征刻画。我们的核心发现是，高GPU需求并未带来高有效利用率：空闲GPU常常变得无法分配，因为空闲容量散布在节点间、缺乏匹配的CPU或违反网络局部性约束，而且用户为生产安全保留了充足余量。值得注意的是，先前工作关注的分数GPU碎片化问题现在已可忽略，因为GPU共享很少使用。我们详细介绍了恢复这类容量的已部署解决方案：一种实用的GPU碎片整理算法，将具有空闲资源的节点数量减少了20.2%；以及SpotGPU——一种预抢占成本感知的调度框架，可安全地回收空闲资源并将GPU分配率从68%提升到93%。我们进一步揭示了多厂商GPU采用不平衡、异构GPU间的带宽瓶颈以及共置工作负载间干扰等开放挑战。我们发布了ASI追踪数据，这是迄今为止在工作负载多样性和集群规模方面最全面的数据集，以支持未来研究。

import_candidates.title: Mimesys: Generating Realistic Executable Testing Environments from Resource Usage Traces
import_candidates.abstract:
Testing applications under realistic resource contention is challenging because production workloads are often inaccessible due to privacy and proprietary concerns. Existing approaches either use simplistic resource stressors that fail to capture temporal dynamics and multi-resource interactions, rely on limited benchmark suites, or require exhaustive per-application profiling. This paper explores an alternative direction: Synthesizing executable workloads from resource usage traces to reproduce realistic colocation scenarios.
We present Mimesys, a system that transforms time-series resource usage traces into executable workloads that emulate resource contention patterns. Mimesys represents emulated workloads as compositions of resource stressors and employs a diffusion-based generative model to learn the inverse mapping from traces to stressor compositions. We introduce two key ideas: state-aware conditioning that conditions generation on both target traces and prior system state to capture temporal dependencies, and execution-driven alignment that adapts the model to real application patterns using direct execution feedback without requiring ground-truth labels. Our evaluation shows that Mimesys achieves up to 5.5× higher trace similarity and reproduces application performance under contention 2.6× more accurately than baselines.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在真实资源争用条件下测试应用程序具有挑战性，因为生产工作负载通常由于隐私和专有问题而无法访问。现有方法要么使用过于简单的资源压力工具，无法捕捉时间动态和多资源交互，要么依赖有限的基准测试集，要么需要对每个应用程序进行详尽的性能剖析。本文探索了一种替代方向：从资源使用轨迹中合成可执行工作负载，以重现真实的共置场景。我们提出了Mimesys，一个将时间序列资源使用轨迹转换为可执行工作负载以模拟资源争用模式的系统。Mimesys仿真工作负载表示为资源压力工具的组合，并采用基于扩散的生成模型来学习从轨迹到压力工具组合的逆映射。我们引入了两个关键思想：状态感知条件生成，即同时基于目标轨迹和先前系统状态进行条件生成以捕获时间依赖性；以及执行驱动对齐，即利用直接执行反馈使模型适应真实应用程序模式，而无需地面实况标签。我们的评估表明，Mimesys实现了比基线高达5.5倍的轨迹相似度提升，并在争用条件下以比基线精确2.6倍的效果重现了应用程序性能。

import_candidates.title: Merlin: An Efficient Adaptive Cache Eviction Algorithm via Fine-Grained Characterization
import_candidates.abstract:
The diverse and complex modern workloads pose a major challenge for cache to remain effective across all scenarios, degrading the performance of critical systems such as web caches. Adaptive cache eviction algorithms promise to address this challenge by observing access patterns and adjusting their behavior accordingly. However, existing ones fail this promise, even underperforming static policies. Our analysis shows that this is because they adapt only to a few typical patterns, incurring poor performance on others. Moreover, they adapt by switching between supposedly complementary algorithms, which turn out to interfere with each other.
We present Merlin, an efficient adaptive algorithm that robustly handles diverse access patterns while maintaining low overhead and high multicore scalability. The efficiency of MERLIN stems from a principled pattern characterization method that can express a wide spectrum of access patterns rather than a few typical ones. This is achieved by characterizing at the level of individual objects while accounting for both access locality and cache size. Furthermore, MERLIN cleanly decouples responsibilities among its components, with each component performing a single task, thereby eliminating the costly interference between base algorithms. Our evaluation across 11 datasets with 5423 traces shows that MERLIN achieves robust improvements in hit rate over existing algorithms, increasing throughput by 1.4x to 7.8x.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代工作负载多样而复杂，给缓存在所有场景下保持有效带来了重大挑战，降低了诸如Web缓存等关键系统的性能。自适应缓存替换算法有望通过观察访问模式并相应地调整行为来应对这一挑战。然而，现有算法未能实现这一承诺，甚至表现逊于静态策略。我们的分析表明，这是因为它们只能适应少数典型模式，导致在其他模式上性能不佳。此外，它们通过在不同所谓互补算法之间切换来适应，而这些算法却被发现会相互干扰。我们提出了Merlin，一种高效的自适应算法，能够稳健地处理多样的访问模式，同时保持低开销和高多核可扩展性。Merlin的效率源于一种原则性的模式表征方法，可以表达广泛的访问模式，而不仅仅是少数典型模式。这是通过在单个对象的层面进行表征，同时兼顾访问局部性和缓存大小来实现的。此外，Merlin在其各组件之间清晰分离职责，每个组件只执行单一任务，从而消除了底层算法之间高代价的干扰。我们在11个数据集的5423条轨迹上的评估表明，相对于现有算法，Merlin在命中率上取得了稳健的提升，吞吐量提高了1.4倍到7.8倍。

import_candidates.title: Learning-Augmented Heuristics: Simple Yet Smart, Robust and Interpretable Cache Eviction
import_candidates.abstract:
Caching is widely used across the system stack to improve performance and efficiency, with eviction algorithms at its core. Existing cache eviction policies fall into two broad categories: static heuristics (e.g., 2Q, S3-FIFO) and smart algorithms (e.g., ARC, LRB). Smart caches can adapt to workloads and have the potential to achieve higher efficiency and robustness than static heuristics. However, we find that existing smart caches suffer from objective mismatches and instability.
We introduce Learning-Augmented Heuristics (LAH), a framework that learns the cache-level parameters of static heuristics. By decoupling the data and control planes, LAH supports simple, high-speed data reads and writes on the data plane, while performing occasional asynchronous learning on the control plane using cache-level features.
We demonstrate the effectiveness of LAH through S4-FIFO, a Smart S3-FIFO cache eviction algorithm. We pre-train a single model on 4,140 production traces and embed it in S4-FIFO to learn optimal cache parameters. On 1,035 evaluation traces, S4-FIFO improves the mean efficiency by 26% compared to S3-FIFO and by 8% compared to 3L-Cache, the best state-of-the-art algorithm. S4-FIFO is also robust—increasing miss ratio over FIFO by 0.8% on the worst trace, whereas 3L-Cache increases FIFO’s miss ratio by 8.8%. Finally, S4-FIFO’s decisions are also interpretable: a language model can provide a rationale for why a particular configuration was chosen.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 缓存广泛应用于系统堆栈中，以提高性能和效率，其核心是驱逐算法。现有的缓存驱逐策略大致分为两类：静态启发式（如2Q、S3-FIFO）和智能算法（如ARC、LRB）。智能缓存能够适应工作负载，并有可能比静态启发式实现更高的效率和稳健性。然而，我们发现现有的智能缓存存在目标错位和不稳定的问题。我们引入了学习增强启发式（LAH），这是一个学习静态启发式缓存级参数的框架。通过解耦数据平面和控制平面，LAH支持在数据平面上进行简单高速的读写，同时在控制平面上利用缓存级特征进行偶尔的异步学习。我们通过S4-FIFO（一种智能S3-FIFO缓存驱逐算法）证明了LAH的有效性。我们在4,140条生产轨迹上预训练了一个单一模型，并将其嵌入S4-FIFO以学习最佳缓存参数。在1,035条评估轨迹上，S4-FIFO相比S3-FIFO平均效率提升了26%，相比最先进的3L-Cache算法提升了8%。S4-FIFO也具有稳健性——在最差的轨迹上，其相比FIFO的未命中率增加仅为0.8%，而3L-Cache则使FIFO的未命中率增加了8.8%。最后，S4-FIFO的决策还具有可解释性：语言模型可以为选择特定配置提供理由。

import_candidates.title: WriteGuards: Distributed Storage Support for Strongly Consistent Caches
import_candidates.abstract: This paper presents a set of in-process and remote distributed caches for datacenter environments, CLINK and CRINK respectively, that provide linearizable reads entirely from memory without contacting storage. These caches remain loosely coupled to the storage layer and achieve high performance, scale, and availability by cooperating with auto-sharders and by tracking consistency metadata at the granularity of key ranges rather than individual keys. To our knowledge, CLINK is the first distributed linked cache that delivers scalable, linearizable reads from memory while remaining loosely coupled with storage. At the heart of these caches is a lightweight storage primitive called WriteGuards that can be easily added to a distributed store. WriteGuards prevent a subtle race we call the delayed-writes anomaly arising during changes in ownership of key ranges. Each write carries a small fencing value tied to the current owner, and the storage system checks this value to reject delayed writes. WriteGuards apply to key ranges instead of individual keys for scalability, add only a conditional check on the write path, and require no coordination on reads. We implemented our cache designs on TiDB. The in-process cache CLINK cuts tail read latency by three orders of magnitude, and the remote cache CRINK reduces it by 2.2−2.4× relative to direct storage access and existing strongly consistent remote caches.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一组用于数据中心环境的进程内和远程分布式缓存，分别称为CLINK和CRINK，它们能完全从内存中提供线性一致性的读取，而无需联系存储层。这些缓存与存储层保持松散耦合，并通过与自动分片器协作以及按键范围而非单个键跟踪一致性元数据，实现高性能、可扩展性和可用性。据我们所知，CLINK是首个在保持与存储松散耦合的同时，能提供可扩展、可线性化内存读取的分布式链接缓存。这些缓存的核心是一个名为WriteGuards的轻量级存储原语，它可以轻松添加到分布式存储中。WriteGuards防止了在键范围所有权变更期间出现的一种我们称之为“延迟写入异常”的微妙竞态。每次写入都携带一个与当前所有者关联的小型栅栏值，存储系统通过检查该值来拒绝延迟写入。WriteGuards应用于键范围而非单个键，以提升可扩展性；仅在写入路径上增加一次条件检查，并且读取无需协调。我们在TiDB上实现了我们的缓存设计。进程内缓存CLINK将尾部读取延迟降低了三个数量级，而远程缓存CRINK与直接存储访问和现有的强一致性远程缓存相比，将尾部读取延迟降低了2.2至2.4倍。

import_candidates.title: MEGALON: Efficient Data Sharing for Partly Coherent CXL Memory
import_candidates.abstract: CXL allows multiple hosts to share memory. However, the hardware is expected to provide cache coherence only for a small region of CXL memory and it is difficult for hosts to share data in the non-coherent region. Recent work proposes using the small coherent region (SCR) to track coherence metadata and enables coherent and correct sharing of data in the software. We find that this approach suffers from poor performance for large datasets as it cannot fit the metadata in SCR. We propose MEGALON, a new data-sharing approach for CXL that uses a novel split approach, where big but infrequently updated metadata is logically shared via replication, and only small and heavily updated metadata is shared via SCR. This enables MEGALON to support much larger datasets with high performance. MEGALON augments the split approach with novel techniques enabled by a CXL shared log that unlock high performance under many workloads.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: CXL允许多个主机共享内存。然而，硬件预计仅对CXL内存的一小部分区域提供缓存一致性，并且主机难以在非一致区域中共享数据。近期工作提出使用小型一致区域（SCR）来跟踪一致性元数据，并实现在软件中一致且正确地共享数据。我们发现，这种方法在处理大型数据集时性能较差，因为元数据无法容纳在SCR中。我们提出了MEGALON，一种适用于CXL的新数据共享方法，采用新颖的分离方法，其中较大但更新不频繁的元数据通过复制进行逻辑共享，而仅有较小且更新频繁的元数据通过SCR共享。这使得MEGALON能够以高性能支持更大的数据集。MEGALON通过CXL共享日志增强分离方法，并利用新颖技术在许多工作负载下释放高性能。

import_candidates.title: Inference in the Shadows: Taming Memory Bandwidth Contention in Mobile LLM Inference with Sereno
import_candidates.abstract: The proliferation of large language models (LLMs) on mobile devices introduces a new performance challenge: resource contention between compute-intensive inference and latency-sensitive foreground applications. We identify a severe and asymmetric interference where concurrent LLM inference substantially degrades foreground applications’ quality-of-service (QoS)—increasing the aggregate jank rate (the fraction of frames that appear as visible stutters) by 153%. In contrast, LLM throughput degrades by only 1.01% and 1.64% during prefill and decode stages, respectively. This imbalance arises because the hardware prioritizes NPU memory traffic—originally to guarantee critical media tasks (e.g., video recording)—a privilege that best-effort LLM inference inherits, causing aggressive bandwidth contention. To address this asymmetric degradation, we present SERENO, a foreground-QoS-friendly LLM inference framework that resolves bandwidth contention between foreground applications and background LLM inference, without hardware modification. SERENO repurposes speculative decoding to introduce fine-grained yield points for preemptible execution, letting the system detect memory contention and dynamically yield bandwidth to the foreground without losing inference progress. Extensive evaluations on commercial smartphones across diverse categories of popular applications demonstrate that SERENO reduces the foreground jank rate by up to 92.6% (58.5% on average) while boosting LLM throughput by up to 67.9% (26.4% on average). Compared with vanilla speculative decoding, SERENO can reduce the foreground jank rate by up to 72.1% while incurring only a 6.2% performance degradation.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在移动设备上的普及引入了一个新的性能挑战：计算密集型推理与延迟敏感的前台应用之间的资源争用。我们发现了一种严重且不对称的干扰：并发的 LLM 推理会显著降低前台应用的服务质量（QoS），使总卡顿率（表现为可见卡顿的帧比例）增加 153%。相比之下，LLM 吞吐量在预填充（prefill）和解码（decode）阶段仅分别下降 1.01% 和 1.64%。这种不平衡源于硬件优先保障 NPU 内存流量——最初是为了保证关键媒体任务（如视频录制）——而尽力而为的 LLM 推理继承了这一特权，导致激进的带宽争用。为解决这种不对称退化，我们提出了 SERENO，一个对前台 QoS 友好的 LLM 推理框架，在不修改硬件的情况下解决前台应用与后台 LLM 推理之间的带宽争用。SERENO 重新利用推测解码来引入细粒度的让出点，实现可抢占执行，使系统能够检测内存争用并动态地将带宽让给前台，且不损失推理进度。在商业智能手机上跨多类热门应用的广泛评估表明，SERENO 将前台卡顿率降低高达 92.6%（平均 58.5%），同时将 LLM 吞吐量提升高达 67.9%（平均 26.4%）。与原始推测解码相比，SERENO 可将前台卡顿率降低高达 72.1%，而仅产生 6.2% 的性能下降。

import_candidates.title: LifeLine: An Object-Page Lifetime Alignment GC Enabling Minimal Memory Copying for Mobile Devices
import_candidates.abstract: LifeLine is a garbage collection (GC) framework for Android that tackles the fundamental object–page lifetime mismatch. Existing copying collectors move objects, while the OS manages pages; mixed lifetimes within a page force excessive object copying instead of efficient page remapping. LifeLine explicitly aligns object lifetimes with physical pages via three components. First, lifetime-based graph partitioning monitors reference updates and partitions the object graph into subgraphs with strong lifetime affinity. Second, lifetime-aligned GC packs these subgraphs into pages so that each page contains almost entirely live or dead objects, enabling effective page-level management. Third, near-zero-copy GC exploits this bimodal per-page liveness by remapping mostly-live pages and copying only the few surviving objects from mostly-dead pages in cooperation with the OS. Implemented in the Android Runtime and evaluated on real smartphones and popular mobile applications, LifeLine significantly cuts GC copy volume by 57.4%, reduces GC time by 22.7% on average, and improves user-visible responsiveness with modest CPU and memory overhead.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: LifeLine是一个面向Android的垃圾回收（GC）框架，旨在解决基本的对象-页生命周期不匹配问题。现有的复制式收集器移动对象，而操作系统管理页面；页内混合生命周期导致过度对象复制而非有效的页面重映射。LifeLine通过三个组件将对象生命周期与物理页显式对齐。首先，基于生命周期的图分区监视引用更新，并将对象图划分为具有强生命周期亲缘性的子图。其次，生命周期对齐的GC将这些子图打包到页中，使每页几乎完全包含存活或死亡对象，从而实现有效的页级管理。第三，近零拷贝GC利用这种每页双峰存活率，通过与操作系统合作，主要重映射存活页面，仅从大多数死亡页面中复制少量幸存对象。LifeLine在Android运行时中实现，并在真实智能手机和流行移动应用上进行了评估，显著减少了57.4%的GC拷贝量，平均减少22.7%的GC时间，并在适度的CPU和内存开销下提高了用户可见的响应性。

import_candidates.title: Unleash All Cores: Asymmetry-Aware Scalable DNN Inference on Mobile CPUs
import_candidates.abstract:
Asymmetric Multiprocessing (AMP) CPUs are now central to mobile devices, but exploiting them for efficient Deep Neural Network (DNN) inference remains challenging. Naive scheduling across heterogeneous cores often triggers a performance-collapse paradox: adding LITTLE cores degrades throughput due to workload imbalance. Existing approaches rely on static partitioning, which partially mitigates imbalance but fails to adapt to runtime interference, incurs extra task acquisition overhead, and ignores core–kernel affinities—leaving substantial performance untapped.
We present SANI, a scalable, asymmetry-aware inference framework that unleashes the full potential of AMP architectures. SANI introduces three key mechanisms: (1) an affinity-aware kernel issuer that selects cluster-optimal kernels to exploit core–kernel efficiency from the outset; (2) an adaptive granularity scheduler that dynamically merges or splits tasks, balancing load under runtime interference by mapping smaller tasks to slower cores and larger ones to faster cores; and (3) an on-demand kernel switcher that efficiently transforms kernels during workload migration, preserving affinity across clusters. We implement SANI atop Arm-CL and evaluate it on five mobile SoCs. SANI reduces DNN inference latency by 17.6%–23.7% on average (up to 29.5% on some models) while lowering energy consumption by up to 39% compared to state-of-the-art baselines, scaling efficiently across both symmetric and asymmetric CPU configurations.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 非对称多处理（AMP）CPU现在是移动设备的核心，但利用它们进行高效的深度神经网络（DNN）推理仍然具有挑战性。跨异构核心的朴素调度常常引发性能崩溃悖论：由于工作负载不平衡，添加LITTLE核心会降低吞吐量。现有方法依赖静态划分，这在一定程度上缓解了不平衡，但无法适应运行时干扰，产生额外的任务获取开销，并忽略核心-内核亲和性，留下了大量未开发的性能。我们提出了SANI，一个可扩展的、非对称感知的推理框架，以释放AMP架构的全部潜力。SANI引入了三个关键机制：（1）亲和性感知的内核发放器，从一开始就选择集群最优内核以利用核心-内核效率；（2）自适应粒度调度器，动态合并或拆分任务，通过将较小任务映射到较慢核心、较大任务映射到较快核心来平衡运行时干扰下的负载；（3）按需内核切换器，在工作负载迁移期间高效转换内核，保持跨集群的亲和性。我们在Arm-CL之上实现了SANI，并在五个移动SoC上进行了评估。与最先进的基线相比，SANI平均降低DNN推理延迟17.6%至23.7%（某些模型最高降低29.5%），同时能耗降低高达39%，在对称和非对称CPU配置下都能高效扩展。

import_candidates.title: Surviving the Impossible Trinity: Revisiting CPU Scheduling Problem on Modern COTS Mobile Devices (Operational Systems)
import_candidates.abstract: CPU scheduling performance on mobile devices, especially under user interactions, is hindered by a fundamental semantic gap: the kernel scheduler lacks visibility into the user interaction context, treating latency-critical UI threads and background tasks equally. In this paper, we identify an impossible trinity, i.e., scarce prime cores, cross-process IPC dependencies, and tight latency deadlines, which exacerbate the mobile scheduling problem. To survive the impossible trinity, we present MUSched, a semantic-aware scheduling framework for modern mobile devices that makes interaction capability a first-class scheduling objective. MUSched disentangles cross-process dependencies for critical threads along the interaction path and places these threads in a new VIP scheduling class between RT and CFS, allowing interaction-critical tasks to preempt normal background work without compromising system stability. Furthermore, MUSched proposes a scheduling policy plug-and-play mechanism that facilitates on-demand policy update in the user space without kernel recompilation for COTS mobile devices. In laboratory evaluations, MUSched reduces average application cold-start time by 14.8%. Furthermore, MUSched has been deployed on more than 20 million mobile devices since 2024. The deployment results show that MUSched reduces real-world startup anomalies by more than 30.7%. This deployment underscores the pivotal role of semantic-aware scheduling in achieving optimal mobile Quality of Experience.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 移动设备上的CPU调度性能（尤其是在用户交互场景下）受到一个基本语义鸿沟的阻碍：内核调度器缺乏对用户交互上下文的可见性，将延迟敏感的UI线程与后台任务同等对待。本文识别出一个“不可能三角”，即稀缺的主核资源、跨进程IPC依赖和紧张的延迟截止时间，这加剧了移动调度问题。为了在不可能三角中生存，我们提出了MUSched，一个面向现代移动设备的语义感知调度框架，将交互能力作为一级调度目标。MUSched解开交互路径上关键线程的跨进程依赖，并将这些线程置于RT与CFS之间的新的VIP调度类中，使得交互关键任务能够抢占正常后台工作而不损害系统稳定性。此外，MUSched提出了一种调度策略即插即用机制，使得商用移动设备能够在用户空间按需更新策略而无需重新编译内核。在实验室评估中，MUSched将应用平均冷启动时间降低了14.8%。此外，自2024年以来，MUSched已部署在超过2000万台移动设备上。部署结果表明，MUSched将实际世界中的启动异常减少超过30.7%。这一部署凸显了语义感知调度在实现最优移动体验质量中的关键作用。

import_candidates.title: qTPU: Hybrid Tensor Networks for Quantum-Classical Acceleration
import_candidates.abstract:
Classical accelerators (GPUs, TPUs) excel at high-performance computing but cannot efficiently represent problems that scale exponentially, such as highly entangled quantum states. Quantum processors (QPUs) address these intractable problems but are constrained by noise, high error rates, and low throughput. This necessitates hybrid quantum-classical execution: computationally complex kernels are offloaded to QPUs, while scalable computation runs on classical accelerators.
Despite this clear need for hybrid systems, we currently lack a concise programming paradigm for expressing and optimizing them. Developers must manually partition and orchestrate applications across quantum and classical hardware through ad hoc approaches that produce fragmented, inflexible workflows. This prevents holistic optimization across the quantum-classical interface and limits scalability.
To this end, we introduce the hybrid tensor network (hTN) abstraction—a unified representation capturing quantum-classical computation—realized in qTPU, an end-to-end system comprising: the qTPU programming model for declarative hybrid computation specification; the qTPU compiler for holistic hTN optimization balancing classical cost against quantum error; and the qTPU runtime for scalable execution across heterogeneous QPUs and classical accelerators.
Our evaluation demonstrates that qTPU achieves 3–4 orders of magnitude lower classical overhead, up to 7.2× lower quantum error rates, up to 53× faster compilation, and over 20× end-to-end speedups across hybrid ML, circuit knitting, and quantum error mitigation.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 经典加速器（GPU、TPU）在高性能计算方面表现出色，但无法高效表示指数级扩展的问题，例如高度纠缠的量子态。量子处理器（QPU）可以解决这些棘手的问题，但受到噪声、高错误率和低吞吐量的限制。这要求混合量子-经典执行：计算复杂的核被卸载到QPU上，而可扩展计算则在经典加速器上运行。尽管对混合系统有明确的需求，但目前我们缺乏一种简洁的编程范式来表达和优化它们。开发人员必须通过临时方法在量子与经典硬件之间手动划分和编排应用程序，这会产生碎片化、不灵活的工作流程。这阻碍了跨量子-经典接口的整体优化，并限制了可扩展性。为此，我们引入了混合张量网络（hTN）抽象——一种统一的表示形式，用于捕获量子-经典计算——并在qTPU中实现，qTPU是一个端到端系统，包括：用于声明式混合计算规范的qTPU编程模型；用于在经典成本与量子错误之间进行整体hTN优化的qTPU编译器；以及用于跨异构QPU和经典加速器可扩展执行的qTPU运行时。我们的评估表明，qTPU实现了3-4个数量级的经典开销降低，高达7.2倍的量子错误率降低，高达53倍的编译加速，以及跨混合机器学习、电路裁剪和量子错误缓解的20倍以上端到端加速。

import_candidates.title: Acumen: A Platform for Encrypted and Accountable Collaborative Editing
import_candidates.abstract:
Modern-day collaborative editing tools must reconcile a prominent tension between user privacy and collaboration: encrypting user data prevents an application server from processing user edits. We present Acumen, a cryptographic system for real-time collaborative applications based on conflict-free replicated data types (CRDTs). Acumen is the first system to provide strong snapshot consistency, enabling untrusted users to create verifiable document snapshots used to invite new collaborators. Acumen also provides confidentiality, integrity, fork-causal consistency, and ensures that invited users do not learn the previous edit history of the document.
We achieve these properties through the use of cryptographic accumulators and a novel secure garbage collection mechanism. Our evaluation shows that Acumen can support 25 users each simultaneously typing 60 WPM with negligible degradation in latency and availability.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代协作编辑工具必须调和用户隐私与协作之间的突出矛盾：加密用户数据会阻止应用服务器处理用户编辑。我们提出 Acumen，一种基于无冲突复制数据类型（CRDT）的实时协作应用密码系统。Acumen 是首个提供强快照一致性的系统，使不受信任的用户能够创建可验证的文档快照，用于邀请新协作者。Acumen 还提供保密性、完整性、分叉因果一致性，并确保被邀请用户不会了解文档先前的编辑历史。我们通过密码累加器和一种新型安全垃圾收集机制实现这些性质。我们的评估表明，Acumen 可支持25名用户同时以每分钟60词的速度输入，而延迟和可用性的下降可忽略不计。

import_candidates.title: Drs.NAS: Ultra-Efficient Neural Architecture Search for Recommendation Systems
import_candidates.abstract: Deep learning-based recommendation systems (DRS) have become a dominant workload in hyperscale data centers. However, designing DRS architectures that balance high predictive performance with computational efficiency remains a major challenge due to ever-increasing model complexity and scale. Neural architecture search (NAS) has recently emerged as a promising automated design approach and is now adopted in production by major hyperscalers. Yet, existing NAS methods face two critical limitations: (i) prohibitive search costs—often requiring several GPU hours to days—which hinder rapid iteration, and (ii) the resulting architectures are typically computation- and memory-intensive, limiting practical deployment. In this paper, we propose Drs.NAS, an ultra-efficient NAS framework for DRS. (i) Ultra-efficient search: We propose a novel metric, superproxy, which enables NAS without the costly training and validation required by existing NAS methods. Compared to SOTA NAS search times of 5!∼!18 GPU-hours, Drs.NAS completes the search within two minutes on a commodity CPU. (ii) Ultra-efficient results: The models discovered by Drs.NAS drastically reduce resource demands—achieving on average 108.3× and 34.9× smaller model sizes, and 88.8× and 14.7× fewer FLOPs, compared to handcrafted and SOTA NAS results, respectively. Crucially, these gains come without sacrificing predictive quality: Drs.NAS delivers on par or even superior predictive performance, surpassing handcrafted and NAS baselines by 0.0123 and 0.0056 in average AUC across three representative benchmarks, respectively.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 基于深度学习的推荐系统（DRS）已成为超大规模数据中心中的主导工作负载。然而，由于模型复杂度和规模不断增加，设计既能保持高预测性能又具有计算效率的DRS架构仍然是一个重大挑战。神经架构搜索（NAS）最近已成为一种有前景的自动化设计方法，现已被大型超大规模企业采用。然而，现有NAS方法面临两个关键限制：（i）搜索成本过高——通常需要数GPU小时到数天——阻碍了快速迭代；（ii）生成的架构通常计算密集且内存消耗大，限制了实际部署。在本文中，我们提出了Drs.NAS，一个面向DRS的超高效NAS框架。（i）超高效搜索：我们提出了一种新颖的指标——superproxy，使得NAS无需现有NAS方法所需的昂贵训练和验证。与SOTA NAS搜索时间5至18 GPU小时相比，Drs.NAS在普通CPU上可在两分钟内完成搜索。（ii）超高效结果：Drs.NAS发现的模型大幅降低了资源需求——与手工设计和SOTA NAS结果相比，平均模型大小分别缩小108.3倍和34.9倍，FLOPs分别减少88.8倍和14.7倍。关键的是，这些收益并未牺牲预测质量：在三个代表性基准测试上，Drs.NAS的平均AUC分别超过手工设计和NAS基线0.0123和0.0056，预测性能持平甚至更优。

import_candidates.title: SMARTTalk: Teaching SMART Logs to Talk to LLMs
import_candidates.abstract:
SMART attributes are the main telemetry for monitoring Solid State Drives (SSDs) and predicting failures in large fleets, but existing methods rely on heavy feature engineering and large supervised pipelines that must be retrained as hardware or workloads change and that compress rich temporal behavior into opaque numeric scores. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer structured reasoning and explanations, yet perform poorly on raw SMART logs because the histories are long and multivariate, their temporal inductive bias is weak, and they hallucinate on numeric inputs. We present SMARTTalk, a new systems architecture that introduces a representation layer for device telemetry. SMARTTalk converts each n day SMART window into a sequence of symbolic trend tokens that an LLM can reliably reason over. The system separates numerical trend extraction from language based reasoning through three stages. (1) It slices n-day SMART windows into short temporal patches and encodes them with lightweight Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), then it clusters the resulting embeddings to form compact libraries of attribute-level and cross-attribute temporal patterns; (2) It converts each pattern into concise, human-readable text tokens that are stable across drives and over time; and (3) It feeds these pattern summaries to an LLM with chain-of-thought prompting, augmented with an online pattern memory that detects and incorporates previously unseen behaviors without retraining. By reasoning in natural language, SMARTTalk gives transparent explanations and interactive workflows.
Evaluations on production datacenter SSD traces, across both open-source and proprietary LLMs, show that SMARTTalk delivers roughly 50× higher F0.5 than Raw-LLM, about 4× higher than the Heuristic-LLM, and approximately 25% more accurate health classification than existing SMART-based methods, while achieving time-to-failure estimates with bucketed MAE near 10 days. SMARTTalk’s natural-language outputs are rated highly by LLM-as-judge, with explanation and recommendation scores around 4.5 out of 5 and perturbation robustness above 80%, making the system operator friendly and ready for the deployment.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: SMART属性是监控固态硬盘（SSD）和预测大规模集群故障的主要遥测手段，但现有方法依赖繁重的特征工程和大型监督流水线，这些流水线在硬件或工作负载变化时必须重新训练，并将丰富的时域行为压缩成不透明的数值分数。大型语言模型（LLM）提供结构化推理和解释能力，但在原始SMART日志上表现不佳，因为其历史序列长且多变量，时间归纳偏差较弱，并且会在数字输入上产生幻觉。我们提出了SMARTTalk，一种新的系统架构，引入了设备遥测的表示层。SMARTTalk将每个n天的SMART窗口转换为LLM可以可靠推理的符号趋势令牌序列。该系统通过三个阶段将数值趋势提取与基于语言的推理分开：（1）将n天SMART窗口切分为短时间补丁，并通过轻量级卷积神经网络（CNN）编码，然后对得到的嵌入进行聚类，形成属性级和跨属性时间模式的紧凑库；（2）将每个模式转换为简洁、人类可读的文本令牌，这些令牌在不同驱动器和时间上保持稳定；（3）将这些模式摘要提供给带有思维链提示的LLM，并增强一个在线模式内存，该内存能够在不重新训练的情况下检测和整合先前未看到的行为。通过在自然语言中进行推理，SMARTTalk提供了透明的解释和交互式工作流。在数据中心生产环境的SSD踪迹上进行评估，涵盖开源和专有LLM，结果显示SMARTTalk的F0.5比Raw-LLM高约50倍，比Heuristic-LLM高约4倍，健康分类准确率比现有基于SMART的方法高约25%，同时实现时间到故障估计的桶化MAE接近10天。SMARTTalk的自然语言输出通过LLM-as-judge获得高分，解释和推荐得分约为4.5/5，扰动鲁棒性高于80%，使得系统操作员友好且可部署。

import_candidates.title: Svalinn: Overload Control in Large-Scale Servers with Multiple Resource Bottlenecks
import_candidates.abstract:
Modern overload controllers treat application binaries as monoliths and react to aggregate performance, a misconception we call the single-queue fallacy. Real applications have diverse, data-dependent execution paths that stress different resources. Reacting to overall performance forces the controller to focus on the most bottlenecked resource while leaving others underutilized.
We present Svalinn, a modular overload controller designed to maximize utilization across multiple potential bottlenecks such as CPU, memory bandwidth, and contended locks. Svalinn separates throughput control and latency control. A credit-based admission controller regulates offered load to maximize a user-defined utility function. Per-bottleneck controllers then enforce latency targets using Active Queue Management (AQM) policies. While AQM is straightforward for resources with explicit software queues, managing memory-bandwidth-intensive operations is challenging due to the absence of such queues. To handle this case, we introduce msemaphore, which adaptively limits the number of concurrent memory-bandwidth-intensive requests to achieve high memory-bandwidth utilization using the minimum necessary CPU cores. We integrate Svalinn into four applications and two runtimes and show that it improves goodput by up to 6.51× without compromising latency.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代的过载控制器将应用程序二进制视为单一整体，并仅对整体性能做出反应，我们称这种误解为“单队列谬误”。真实应用具有多样且依赖数据的执行路径，会消耗不同的资源。对整体性能做出反应，会迫使控制器专注于最紧张的资源，而让其他资源未被充分利用。我们提出了 Svalinn，一种模块化的过载控制器，旨在最大化多个潜在瓶颈（如 CPU、内存带宽以及有争议的锁）上的资源利用率。Svalinn 将吞吐量控制与延迟控制分离。一个基于信用的准入控制器调节进入的负载，以最大化用户定义的效用函数。随后，每个瓶颈控制器利用主动队列管理（AQM）策略来强制实现延迟目标。虽然对于具有显式软件队列的资源而言，AQM 非常直接，但管理内存带宽密集型操作因缺少此类队列而具有挑战性。为处理这种情况，我们引入了 msemaphore，它自适应地限制并发内存带宽密集型请求的数量，以利用最少的必要CPU核数实现高内存带宽利用率。我们将 Svalinn 集成到四个应用和两个运行时中，结果表明它能在不牺牲延迟的前提下将有效吞吐量提高最高达6.51倍。

import_candidates.title: PeeR: First-Class Scheduling for Latency-Critical eBPF Applications
import_candidates.abstract: We present PeeR, a novel eBPF runtime that makes latency-critical eBPF programs preemptable and schedulable while maintaining low overhead. As eBPF programs grow more complex, they expose a fundamental gap: performance-critical hooks execute in a non-preemptable softirq context, which is invisible to the scheduler. These programs bypass resource controls, break isolation, and cause head-of-line blocking, degrading tail latency. PeeR exploits two key properties of eBPF: the verifier enforces clean program state at helper function boundaries, making these sites natural preemption points, and non-trivial programs frequently call helpers, ensuring fine-grained preemption opportunities. Building on these properties, PeeR brings cooperative preemption to eBPF: lightweight budget checks, inserted at each helper call, force programs exceeding their budget to yield and resume later on per-CPU kernel threads. To handle a wide variety of workloads, PeeR uses a two-level scheduling model that integrates with schedext, where the outer level controls aggregate CPU time for eBPF workloads, while an inner micro-scheduler orders individual tasks according to an operator-defined policy. Our evaluation on Redis, Memcached, echo-server, and TPC-C workloads shows that PeeR reduces p99 latency for latency-sensitive requests by 3× to 19.8× over the current eBPF runtime, without starving competing long-running requests.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了PeeR，一种新型eBPF运行时，它在保持低开销的同时，使延迟关键的eBPF程序变得可抢占和可调度。随着eBPF程序变得越来越复杂，它们暴露了一个根本性缺陷：性能关键钩子在不可抢占的软中断上下文中执行，这对调度器不可见。这些程序绕过资源控制，破坏隔离，并导致队头阻塞，使尾部延迟恶化。PeeR利用了eBPF的两个关键特性：验证器在辅助函数边界强制保持清晰的程序状态，使这些位置成为自然的抢占点；并且非平凡的程序频繁调用辅助函数，确保细粒度的抢占机会。基于这些特性，PeeR为eBPF引入了协作式抢占：在每个辅助函数调用处插入轻量级预算检查，强制超过预算的程序让出CPU并在每CPU内核线程上稍后恢复。为了处理各种各样的工作负载，PeeR使用一种与schedext集成的两级调度模型，其中外层控制eBPF工作负载的聚合CPU时间，而内层微调度器根据操作员定义的策略对单个任务进行排序。我们在Redis、Memcached、echo-server和TPC-C工作负载上的评估表明，与当前eBPF运行时相比，PeeR将延迟敏感请求的p99延迟降低了3倍至19.8倍，而不会使竞争的长运行请求饥饿。

import_candidates.title: TypeCraft: A Lightweight Data Type Profiler with High Resolution
import_candidates.abstract: Improving software efficiency often involves optimizing data locality to reduce memory stalls. However, identifying such optimization opportunities, particularly in complex production software like the Linux kernel, is challenging. Existing profiling tools typically provide metrics such as cache and TLB misses for instructions, loops, functions, or heap allocations, still requiring substantial manual efforts to identify optimization opportunities. To overcome this, we introduce TypeCraft, a lightweight, high-resolution data type profiler, integrated into the Linux perf tool, that annotates individual memory access instructions with their associated data types and fields. TypeCraft provides detailed type-centric telemetry such as access counts, CPU cycle costs, cache or TLB misses, which helps identify optimization opportunities around the expensive types. Applying TypeCraft to the Linux kernel, we gain insights that guide us in implementing simple yet effective optimizations. These optimizations, including reordering structure fields and removing pointer chasing patterns, result in significant performance improvements for both benchmarks and real-world workloads.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 提高软件效率通常涉及优化数据局部性以减少内存停顿。然而，识别此类优化机会（尤其是在Linux内核等复杂生产软件中）具有挑战性。现有的剖析工具通常提供指令、循环、函数或堆分配的高速缓存和TLB未命中指标，但仍需要大量人工努力来识别优化机会。为解决这一问题，我们引入了TypeCraft，这是一种集成在Linux perf工具中的轻量级、高分辨率数据类型剖析器，可将其相关的数据类型和字段注释到单个内存访问指令上。TypeCraft提供详细的类型中心遥测数据，如访问次数、CPU周期成本、缓存或TLB未命中数，有助于识别围绕昂贵类型的优化机会。将TypeCraft应用于Linux内核，我们获得了指导实现简单而有效优化的洞察。这些优化（包括重排结构字段和去除指针追逐模式）在基准测试和真实工作负载中均带来了显著的性能提升。

import_candidates.title: All Along the Watchtower: Achieving the Trinity of Observability in Cloud with DiTing
import_candidates.abstract: Observability is crucial for diagnosing and troubleshooting cloud systems as they grow in scale and complexity. However, telemetry data are often stored and processed in siloed systems, leading to high latency, redundant data movement, and low operational efficiency. To address these challenges, we present DiTing, an observability framework that unifies the storage and processing of heterogeneous telemetry data, including logs, metrics, and traces. The key idea of DiTing is to harvest underutilized cloud resources for cost-effective processing while relying on centralized storage systems for reliable data persistence and failover. We have deployed DiTing in production at scale, and DiTing can achieve sub-second data ingestion, high-throughput query processing, and up to 65× lower CapEx than existing solutions.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 可观测性对于诊断和排查随规模和复杂性不断增长的系统至关重要。然而，遥测数据通常在孤立的系统中存储和处理，导致高延迟、冗余数据移动和低运维效率。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了DiTing，一个统一异构遥测数据（包括日志、指标和追踪）存储与处理的可观测性框架。DiTing的关键在于利用利用不足的云资源进行经济高效的处理，同时依赖集中式存储系统实现可靠的数据持久化与故障转移。我们已在生产中大规模部署DiTing，DiTing能够实现亚秒级的数据摄取、高吞吐量的查询处理，以及比现有解决方案最高降低65倍资本支出。

import_candidates.title: jwmalloc: A Verified Memory Allocator for Mobile Devices
import_candidates.abstract:
Dynamic memory allocators provide memory allocation and release functionality to languages such as C, C++, and Rust. Existing allocators have been primarily optimized for performance and timely memory release. However, emerging mobile workloads also emphasize CPU, energy, and memory usage under soft real-time constraints.
We present jwmalloc, a novel memory allocator built from the ground up to address these mobile-specific challenges. It is based on three key innovations: a uniform slab size with pooling that enables immediate cross-size-class reuse of any emptied slab; the closed sibling tree, a new data structure for efficiently managing fragments; and a two-buffer lifetime tracker that categorizes short- and long-lived objects to guide memory reclamation. For timely response in soft real-time and oversubscription scenarios, all operations are non-blocking. We verified jwmalloc with a bounded model checker under weak memory models. Replacing jemalloc on a flagship smartphone running real-world workloads, jwmalloc reduces whole-system instructions by 10% and cuts allocator-side instruction counts by 3.84x, while lowering CPU power consumption by 5-11%, all at a comparable memory footprint. jwmalloc has been deployed in production on 12 million commercial mobile devices, operating stably for over 30 billion user hours.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 动态内存分配器为C、C++和Rust等语言提供内存分配与释放功能。现有分配器主要针对性能和及时的内存释放进行优化。然而，新兴的移动工作负载在软实时约束下还强调CPU、能量和内存使用。我们提出了jwmalloc，一种从头构建以应对这些移动特定挑战的新型内存分配器。它基于三项关键创新：一种具有池化的统一槽大小，使得任何腾空的槽都能立即在跨大小类间重用；closed sibling tree，一种用于高效管理碎片的新数据结构；以及一个两缓冲区的生命周期跟踪器，用于分类短命和长命对象以指导内存回收。为了在软实时和超额订阅场景中及时响应，所有操作都是非阻塞的。我们使用有界模型检查器在弱内存模型下验证了jwmalloc。在一部运行真实工作负载的旗舰智能手机上，用jwmalloc替代jemalloc将整个系统指令减少了10%，分配器端指令计数减少了3.84倍，同时CPU功耗降低了5-11%，且内存占用相当。jwmalloc已部署在1200万台商用移动设备上，稳定运行超过300亿用户小时。

import_candidates.title: Neuro-Symbolic Proof Generation for Scaling Systems Software Verification
import_candidates.abstract: Formal verification via interactive theorem proving is increasingly used to ensure the correctness of critical systems, yet constructing large proof scripts remains highly manual and limits scalability. Advances in large language models (LLMs), especially in mathematical reasoning, make their integration into software verification increasingly promising. This paper introduces a neuro-symbolic proof generation framework designed to automate proof search for system-level verification projects. The framework performs a best-first tree search over proof states, repeatedly querying an LLM for the next candidate proof step. On the neural side, we fine-tune LLMs using datasets of proof state–step pairs; on the symbolic side, we incorporate a range of ITP tools to repair rejected steps, filter and rank proof states, and automatically discharge subgoals when search progress stalls. This synergy enables data-efficient LLM adaptation and semantics-informed pruning of the search space. We implement the framework on a new Isabelle REPL that exposes fine-grained proof states and automation tools, and evaluate it on the FVEL seL4 benchmark and additional Isabelle developments. On seL4, the system proves up to 77.6% of the theorems, substantially surpassing previous LLM-based approaches and standalone Sledgehammer, while solving significantly more multi-step proofs. Results across further Isabelle benchmarks demonstrate strong generalization, indicating a viable path toward scalable automated software verification.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 通过交互式定理证明进行的形式化验证越来越多地被用于确保关键系统的正确性，然而构造大型证明脚本仍然高度依赖人工，限制了可扩展性。大语言模型（LLM）的进步，尤其是在数学推理方面的进步，使得将其集成到软件验证中越来越有前景。本文介绍了一种神经符号证明生成框架，旨在为系统级验证项目自动化证明搜索。该框架对证明状态执行最佳优先树搜索，反复查询LLM以获取下一个候选证明步骤。在神经侧，我们使用证明状态-步骤对的数据集对LLM进行微调；在符号侧，我们集成了一系列ITP工具来修复被拒绝的步骤、过滤和排序证明状态，并在搜索进展停滞时自动处理子目标。这种协同作用实现了数据高效的LLM适应和基于语义的搜索空间剪枝。我们在一个新的伊莎贝尔REPL上实现了该框架，该REPL暴露了细粒度的证明状态和自动化工具，并在FVEL seL4基准和额外的伊莎贝尔开发项目上进行了评估。在seL4上，该系统证明了多达77.6%的定理，大幅超越了以往基于LLM的方法和独立的Sledgehammer，同时解决了更多多步证明。在进一步的伊莎贝尔基准上的结果表明其具有很强的泛化能力，为可扩展的自动化软件验证指明了一条可行路径。

import_candidates.title: Spain: Succinct Proofs for Numerical Computations
import_candidates.abstract: In a succinct proof protocol, a verifier gets assurance that an untrusted prover executed an agreed computation, without requiring the verifier to re-execute the computation itself. In little more than a decade, this area has undergone a remarkable transformation from theory to implemented systems. This activity is extremely exciting. But there is a catch. To apply succinct proofs, one needs to translate one’s computation to a set of equations, or constraints. The required translation has so far completely blocked systematic support for numerical computations, namely those for which the bulk of the computation uses approximations of real numbers. This paper fills that void with the design, implementation, and evaluation of a system called Spain. The starting insight of Spain is that since numerical computations inherently have approximation error, the constraint formalism should likewise allow for approximate satisfiability. Based on this insight, Spain introduces a new proof protocol and new ways to translate computations to constraints. Spain’s implementation improves over natural baselines by multiple orders of magnitude.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在简洁证明协议中，验证者无需重新执行计算本身即可获得保证：不可信证明者已执行了约定的计算。在短短十多年时间里，这一领域经历了从理论到实现系统的显著转变。这一进展令人振奋，但也存在一个障碍：应用简洁证明需要将计算转换为方程组或约束条件。目前这一转换彻底阻碍了对数值计算的系统性支持，即那些大部分计算使用实数近似的计算。本文通过一个名为Spain的系统设计、实现和评估填补了这一空白。Spain的出发点是：由于数值计算天生存在近似误差，约束形式也应允许近似可满足性。基于这一见解，Spain引入了一种新的证明协议以及将计算转换为约束的新方法。Spain的实现相比自然基线提升了多个数量级。

import_candidates.title: RT: Regular Types for the Streaming Shell
import_candidates.abstract: This paper presents an overlay type system, RT, for statically checking streaming shell programs or fragments before their execution. RT’s regular types offer expressiveness appropriate for capturing a command’s standard input and output streams, support computationally tractable and efficient type checking, and provide an interface encoded as regular expressions—i.e., annotations and error messages familiar to developers versed in the Unix environment. RT’s extensions around type polymorphism, finite-state transductions, environment concretization, and syntactic primitives offer additional expressiveness and improved precision. Applying RT to hundreds of programs from various sources including StackOverflow, GitHub, and prior literature indicates efficient type checking (0.02s on average), effectiveness at discovering serious bugs (91% accuracy), and key benefits from RT’s extensions (up to 83% reduction in false negatives).
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个叠加类型系统（overlay type system）RT，用于在流式shell程序或片段执行前对其进行静态检查。RT的正则类型具有足够的表达能力来捕获命令的标准输入和输出流，支持计算上可处理且高效的类型检查，并提供以正则表达式编码的接口——即熟悉Unix环境的开发者所熟悉的标注和错误消息。RT围绕类型多态、有限状态转换、环境具体化和语法原语的扩展提供了额外的表达能力和精度提升。将RT应用于来自StackOverflow、GitHub及先前文献的数百个程序，结果表明其类型检查高效（平均0.02秒），发现严重错误有效（准确率91%），且RT的扩展带来了关键好处（误报最多减少83%）。

import_candidates.title: Janus: Multi-LLM Serving at Production Scale
import_candidates.abstract: Production LLM serving multiplexes hundreds of heterogeneous models on shared clusters, exposing three challenges that existing systems fail to address simultaneously: unpredictable bursts, power-law application popularity, and heterogeneous yet complementary resource demands. We present Janus, a Service-Engine co-designed multi-model serving system built around dual-timescale scheduling. At the Service layer, a Model Scheduler driven by a Performance Oracle combines vector bin-packing every 30 seconds for steady-state colocation with elastic scaling every 0.5 seconds. A new LST-IMH Request Scheduler maximizes SLO attainment with a proven 2-approximation guarantee. At the Engine layer, xTensor virtualizes HBM, while a three-state model lifecycle and device-to-device (D2D) fork enable elastic multi-model colocation and sub-second burst scale-out. We deploy Janus on a 768-device production cluster serving 62 applications and 45.6 M requests/day, and evaluate it with a 603 K-request open-loop replay sampled from that production day. Janus maintains 0.97-1.0 SLO attainment, versus 0.80-0.92 for the strongest baseline, while using 13,440 device-hours/day, 27\% less than static Serverless-LLM. Janus is available as open source at https://github.com/Janus2026/Janus.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 生产环境中的LLM服务在共享集群上复用数百个异构模型，暴露出三个现有系统无法同时应对的挑战：不可预测的突发流量、幂律分布的应用流行度，以及异构但互补的资源需求。我们提出Janus，一个服务层与引擎层协同设计的多模型服务系统，围绕双时间尺度调度构建。在服务层，由性能预言机驱动的模型调度器将每30秒一次的向量装箱用于稳态共置，与每0.5秒一次的弹性扩缩容相结合。一种新的LST-IMH请求调度器最大化SLO达成率，并具有已证明的2-近似保证。在引擎层，xTensor虚拟化HBM，同时三态模型生命周期和设备到设备（D2D）fork实现弹性多模型共置和亚秒级突发扩容。我们在一个768设备的生产集群上部署Janus，服务62个应用和每天4560万次请求，并使用从该生产日采样的60.3万次请求的开环回放进行评估。Janus保持0.97-1.0的SLO达成率，而最强基线为0.80-0.92，同时使用13,440设备小时/天，比静态Serverless-LLM少27%。Janus已在https://github.com/Janus2026/Janus开源。

import_candidates.title: Sandhi: Fine-Grained Merging for Memory Efficient Multi-Model Serving
import_candidates.abstract: As autoregressive models become adept at handling various domain-specific tasks, it is necessary to deploy several fine-tuned models concurrently in real-world scenarios. Such deployments are limited by GPU memory, which dictates the cost (i.e., how many models can be hosted) and their performance (i.e., latency and throughput). In this paper, we propose model merging as a way to reduce the memory footprint of co-located models. While model merging in a traditional sense—where multiple models are combined to create a single model to instill emergent behaviors—may seem like a natural fit for memory reduction, we show that directly extending it results in unacceptable accuracy drops. We present Sandhi, a system that adaptively merges models, at a component granularity, while adhering to user's accuracy requirements. Our evaluation on 12 models spanning 3 model families across 9 different benchmarks shows that Sandhi reduces GPU memory footprint by up to 49.8\%, which translates to improvements of up to 2.93{\texttimes} in throughput and 2{\texttimes} lower cost.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着自回归模型在处理各种领域特定任务方面变得娴熟，在实际场景中需要同时部署多个微调模型。此类部署受限于GPU内存，而GPU内存决定了成本（即可以托管多少模型）及其性能（即延迟和吞吐量）。在本文中，我们提出模型合并作为一种减少共置模型内存占用的方法。传统意义上的模型合并——将多个模型组合成一个单一模型以灌输涌现行为——似乎天然适合内存缩减，但我们表明直接扩展它会导致不可接受的精度下降。我们提出Sandhi，一个以组件粒度自适应地合并模型、同时遵守用户精度要求的系统。我们在涵盖3个模型家族、9个不同基准的12个模型上的评估表明，Sandhi将GPU内存占用降低高达49.8%，这转化为吞吐量提升高达2.93倍和成本降低2倍。

import_candidates.title: Batched in Back: Characterizing and Optimizing Offline LLM Inference in Production with ACDC
import_candidates.abstract: Serving offline large language model (LLM) inference workloads (e.g., log summarization and bulk translation) can consume up to 30\% of GPUs in production. Despite this significant share, the characteristics of offline inference remain largely understudied. In this paper, we start by analyzing 1.5 million tasks comprising 23 billion requests across text and multi-modal models. We discover that the key properties of offline workloads, namely inherent determinism and throughput orientation, are neither exploited by online LLM serving systems nor by existing offline serving frameworks.We design ACDC, a task-aware offline serving system that leverages these properties along three orthogonal axes, namely resource orchestration, cache management, and execution flow. ACDC has been deployed in production for over three months, achieving up to 3.9{\texttimes} higher output cost-efficiency. Beyond isolated deployment, we further identify that online prefill stages leave up to 38.3\% of capacity idle as resource bubbles. We design a hybrid-serving mechanism that harvests these bubbles for offline tasks, improving end-to-end throughput by up to 35.7\% over the state-of-the-art alternative.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 服务离线大语言模型（LLM）推理工作负载（例如日志摘要和批量翻译）在生产环境中可消耗高达30%的GPU。尽管占比显著，离线推理的特征仍被广泛研究不足。本文中，我们首先分析了跨越文本和多模态模型的150万个任务，包含230亿次请求。我们发现离线工作负载的关键属性，即固有的确定性和吞吐量导向，既未被在线LLM服务系统利用，也未被现有离线服务框架利用。我们设计了ACDC，一种任务感知的离线服务系统，它沿三个正交维度利用这些属性，即资源编排、缓存管理和执行流。ACDC已在生产环境中部署超过三个月，实现了高达3.9倍的输出成本效率提升。除了孤立部署之外，我们进一步发现在线预填充阶段因资源气泡而闲置高达38.3%的容量。我们设计了一种混合服务机制，利用这些气泡处理离线任务，将端到端吞吐量相较于最先进的替代方案提升高达35.7%。

import_candidates.title: Taming Inference Workloads at Global Scale: Foundation Model Serving in Amazon Bedrock
import_candidates.abstract: Foundation model (FM) inference platforms must manage scarce accelerator capacity distributed unevenly across regions. They must also handle requests whose token consumption varies widely and may be revealed progressively during generation, while sharing capacity across workloads with different latency and throughput objectives. This paper describes the architecture of the Workload Management System (WLM) deployed in Amazon Bedrock, which serves millions of inference requests per minute across more than 30 regions. The architecture follows two principles. First, decouple request ingress from execution to form a logical execution pool within permitted geographic and model-placement scopes, with prompt-cache stability as a first-class routing constraint. Second, favor bounded inconsistency with defense in depth over synchronous global coordination. WLM comprises five cooperating subsystems: admission control, traffic classification, cross-region routing, request scheduling, and orchestration. Admission and routing decisions use local or cached state; quota consumption is reconciled periodically across regions, while routing weights are refreshed off the request path from regional capacity and health signals. We evaluate WLM using production observations, benchmark measurements, and controlled load tests comparing bounded-staleness with synchronous admission. The evaluation characterizes accelerator utilization, cache stability, request latency, priority behavior, throughput, request-path overhead, quota-enforcement accuracy, and behavior under selected failures.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 基础模型（FM）推理平台必须管理跨区域不均匀分布的稀缺加速器容量。它们还必须处理token消耗差异巨大且可能在生成过程中逐步揭示的请求，同时在具有不同延迟和吞吐量目标的工作负载之间共享容量。本文描述了部署在Amazon Bedrock中的工作负载管理系统（WLM）的架构，该系统在超过30个区域每分钟服务数百万次推理请求。该架构遵循两项原则。第一，将请求入口与执行解耦，在允许的地理和模型放置范围内形成逻辑执行池，并将提示缓存稳定性作为一等路由约束。第二，倾向于有限不一致与纵深防御，而非同步全局协调。WLM由五个协作子系统组成：准入控制、流量分类、跨区域路由、请求调度和编排。准入和路由决策使用本地或缓存状态；配额消耗跨区域定期对账，而路由权重则从区域容量和健康信号中在请求路径之外刷新。我们使用生产观察、基准测量以及比较有限陈旧与同步准入的受控负载测试来评估WLM。评估表征了加速器利用率、缓存稳定性、请求延迟、优先级行为、吞吐量、请求路径开销、配额执行准确性以及在选定故障下的行为。

import_candidates.title: Beyond Utilization: Energy-Conscious GPU Sharing for Inference Serving
import_candidates.abstract: GPUs are expensive, yet inference-serving GPU clusters remain heavily underutilized. To improve utilization, state-of-the-art systems adopt GPU multiplexing. However, optimizing solely for utilization can counterintuitively increase energy consumption. Designing policies that treat power and energy as first-order metrics requires understanding how deployment decisions—GPU allocation size, operating frequency, and batch size—affect energy, latency, and throughput. These relationships are complex, leading existing approaches to rely on extensive profiling. At scale, profiling becomes prohibitively expensive: each model can be deployed under hundreds of configurations, and profiling itself incurs significant energy cost, necessitating accurate yet energy-conscious methods. Further, such systems must model the power draw of colocated models on shared GPUs and adapt to dynamic workload fluctuations. We present EnerTune, an inference serving system that reduces energy consumption while meeting performance SLOs. EnerTune introduces analytical models to estimate per-model performance and power, and the power draw of colocated models on shared GPUs, and uses them in an energy-aware bin-packing algorithm to jointly determine model placement and configuration. EnerTune meets performance SLOs while reducing energy consumption by 1.4-2.3{\texttimes} and power draw by 1.3-2.6{\texttimes} over state-of-the-art baselines.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: GPU价格昂贵，但用于推理服务的GPU集群仍严重利用不足。为了提高利用率，最先进的系统采用GPU多路复用。然而，仅以利用率为优化目标可能反而增加能耗。设计将功率和能耗作为首要指标的策略，需要理解部署决策——GPU分配规模、运行频率和批大小——如何影响能耗、延迟和吞吐量。这些关系复杂，导致现有方法依赖大量性能分析。在大规模下，性能分析变得过于昂贵：每个模型可在数百种配置下部署，且分析本身消耗大量能源，因此需要准确而又节能的方法。此外，此类系统必须对共享GPU上共置模型的功耗进行建模，并适应动态工作负载波动。我们提出EnerTune，一个在满足性能SLO的同时降低能耗的推理服务系统。EnerTune引入分析模型来估计每个模型的性能与功耗，以及共享GPU上共置模型的功耗，并将其用于能耗感知的装箱算法，以联合确定模型放置和配置。与最先进的基线相比，EnerTune在满足性能SLO的同时，将能耗降低1.4-2.3倍，功耗降低1.3-2.6倍。

import_candidates.title: Big Bird: Resilient Privacy Budgeting Across Untrusted Web Domains
import_candidates.abstract: The W3C Attribution API is an emerging standard for privacy-preserving advertising measurement. Its current privacy architecture enforces individual differential privacy (IDP) independently for each domain (e.g., an advertiser) issuing queries. We show that this guarantee is unsound under realistic system behavior: it fails under cross-querier data adaptivity and can also fail when shared limits are enforced across queriers. The issue is not the on-device accounting model itself - device-epoch IDP - but treating each querying domain in isolation. We propose Big Bird, a privacy-budget manager that makes global device-epoch IDP - enforced jointly across all domains - both sound and deployable for Attribution. Big Bird addresses the main obstacle to global enforcement in open multi-querier systems: denial-of-service depletion of a shared global budget by Sybil web domains. Its key insight is that benign Attribution workloads have a stock-and-flow structure: impressions create potential privacy loss, conversions realize it, and meaningful budget consumption should be tied to genuine user actions across distinct web domains. Big Bird enforces this structure with privacy-loss-based quotas on impression and conversion sites and a per-user-action cap on how many quotas can be activated, ensuring that adversarial impact scales with genuine user interactions rather than with the number of Sybil domains. We implement Big Bird in Rust, integrate it into Firefox's Attribution prototype, and evaluate it theoretically and empirically on real ad-tech data. We show that Big Bird provides rigorous global device-epoch IDP, formal resilience to depletion attacks, and utility for benign queriers under attack.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: W3C归因API是隐私保护广告测量领域的一个新兴标准。其当前的隐私架构为每个发起查询的域（例如广告商）独立地强制执行个体差分隐私（IDP）。我们表明，在实际系统行为下，这种保证是不健全的：它在跨查询者数据自适应下会失效，并且在跨查询者强制执行共享限制时也可能失效。问题不在于设备上的核算模型本身——设备纪元IDP——而在于将每个查询域孤立对待。我们提出Big Bird，一种隐私预算管理器，它使全局设备纪元IDP——在所有域之间联合强制执行——既健全又可用于归因。Big Bird解决了开放多查询者系统中全局强制执行的主要障碍：Sybil Web域对共享全局预算的拒绝服务耗尽攻击。其关键洞察是，良性归因工作负载具有存量-流量结构：曝光产生潜在隐私损失，转化实现它，而有意义的预算消耗应绑定到跨不同Web域的真实用户行为。Big Bird通过基于隐私损失的曝光和转化站点配额，以及对可激活配额数量的每用户行为上限来强制执行这一结构，确保对抗性影响随真实用户交互而非Sybil域的数量而扩展。我们在Rust中实现了Big Bird，将其集成到Firefox的归因原型中，并在真实广告技术数据上进行了理论和实证评估。我们表明，Big Bird提供了严格的全局设备纪元IDP、对耗尽攻击的形式化弹性，以及在攻击下对良性查询者的实用性。

import_candidates.title: Cohort: Decentralized PIR
import_candidates.abstract: Private Information Retrieval (PIR) underpins privacy-preserving applications such as private content delivery, contact discovery, and anonymous advertising, where users need to discreetly query a database. However, PIR usually relies on expensive fully homomorphic encryption and scales poorly with the database size, making it difficult to deploy at scale. As a result, most PIR-based systems are expected to have a single provider, or a few, bearing the operational costs of running a limited number of servers. Such deployments are susceptible to provider takedowns, churn, DoS, and censorship, making availability fragile.We present Cohort, a decentralized PIR protocol that distributes the database across multiple servers, eliminating vulnerabilities stemming from the provider bottleneck and sharing operational costs across many parties. Cohort integrates error correction directly into the BGV homomorphic encryption scheme, enabling clients to partition encrypted queries and read correct data even when up to 25\% of servers return adversarial responses. Cohort also enables clients to generate publicly verifiable proofs of misbehavior without compromising query privacy, allowing the system to evict malicious servers. We implement Cohort in Go and show that asymptotic performance scales similarly to centralized PIR schemes with the database size, and the load on each Cohort server reduces proportionally to the number of servers in the system. Concretely, we measure that retrieving 16 KB from a 2 GB database takes under 170 ms. We demonstrate that this performance is sufficient to support a private news radio streaming service, illustrating that Cohort is practical for latency-sensitive applications.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 私有信息检索（PIR）支撑着隐私保护应用，例如私有内容分发、联系人发现和匿名广告，其中用户需要隐蔽地查询数据库。然而，PIR通常依赖于昂贵的全同态加密，并且随数据库规模扩展性很差，使其难以大规模部署。因此，大多数基于PIR的系统预期只有单个或少数提供商，由它们承担运行有限数量服务器的运营成本。此类部署容易受到提供商下架、节点流失、DoS和审查的影响，导致可用性脆弱。我们提出Cohort，一种去中心化的PIR协议，将数据库分布在多个服务器上，消除源于提供商瓶颈的脆弱性，并在多方之间分摊运营成本。Cohort将纠错直接集成到BGV同态加密方案中，使客户端能够对加密查询进行分片，并且即使多达25%的服务器返回对抗性响应，也能读取正确数据。Cohort还使客户端能够在不损害查询隐私的情况下生成可公开验证的恶意行为证明，从而使系统能够驱逐恶意服务器。我们用Go实现了Cohort，并表明其渐近性能随数据库规模的变化与集中式PIR方案相似，且每个Cohort服务器上的负载与系统中服务器数量成比例地降低。具体而言，我们测得从2 GB数据库中检索16 KB数据耗时不到170 ms。我们证明这一性能足以支持私有新闻广播流媒体服务，表明Cohort对于延迟敏感的应用是实用的。

import_candidates.title: CryptDough: A Unified Analytics Engine for Secure Multiparty Computation
import_candidates.abstract: We present CryptDough, a unified analytics engine for secure multiparty computation (MPC). CryptDough enables multiple distrusting parties to jointly execute a data analysis pipeline on their private inputs and learn nothing beyond the result (e.g., aggregate statistics).
