Unlike existing MPC solutions that support a single threat model or workload type, CryptDough provides built-in support for cross-domain analytics (relational, time series, ML inference) under various threat models, all within the same system runtime.CryptDough contributes (i) a hierarchical system design that facilitates modularity and extensibility through progressive lowering of abstractions, and (ii) the concept of virtual vectors that enable users to write single-threaded code across all layers of the software stack, while pushing the complexity of communication, parallelization, and memory management down to the execution engine. We show that CryptDough generalizes the functionality of state-of-the-art MPC systems and remains competitive on the analytics they support, often outperforming them by more than 2{\texttimes}.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了CryptDough，一个用于安全多方计算（MPC）的统一分析引擎。CryptDough使多个互不信任的参与方能够在其私有输入上联合执行数据分析流水线，并且除结果（例如聚合统计量）外不泄露任何信息。与支持单一威胁模型或工作负载类型的现有MPC解决方案不同，CryptDough在同一系统运行时内内置支持跨域分析（关系型、时间序列、ML推理），并适用于各种威胁模型。CryptDough的贡献包括：(i) 一种分层系统设计，通过逐步降低抽象层次来促进模块化和可扩展性；(ii) 虚拟向量的概念，使用户能够在软件栈的所有层次上编写单线程代码，同时将通信、并行化和内存管理的复杂性下推到执行引擎。我们表明，CryptDough泛化了最先进MPC系统的功能，并在其支持的分析任务上保持竞争力，通常性能超过它们2倍以上。

import_candidates.title: DISCO*: Distributed and SCalable Oblivious Joins and Oblivious Primitives
import_candidates.abstract: Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) let clients outsource computation to untrusted clouds, but they remain vulnerable to side-channel and leakage-abuse attacks. Recent work closes this gap by combining hardware enclaves with oblivious computation, which offers strong security guarantees yet struggles to meet the performance and scalability demands of real-world deployments. In this work, we present DISCO, the first scalable, distributed, and fully oblivious database system that seamlessly combines hardware enclaves with cutting-edge oblivious primitives and novel optimizations that significantly reduce inter-server communication overheads. What distinguishes DISCO from prior work is a suite of distributed frameworks that unlock parallel computation and fundamentally shift the design paradigm of distributed oblivious systems, enabling practical deployment at scales that were unattainable with previous solutions. We provide a thorough evaluation of the performance of our system on both synthetic and real-world datasets. Our evaluation demonstrates that our design significantly reduces the gap between theory and practice, achieving 88{\texttimes} speedup over Jodes and 180{\texttimes} over SODA on non-foreign key joins with N = 225 elements. Most importantly, we report, for the first time, results for computations at the terabyte scale.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 可信执行环境（TEE）允许客户端将计算外包给不可信的云，但它们仍然容易受到侧信道和泄漏滥用攻击。近期工作通过将硬件隔离区与不经意计算相结合来弥合这一差距，这提供了强安全保证，却难以满足现实部署的性能和可扩展性需求。在这项工作中，我们提出 DISCO，这是首个可扩展、分布式且完全不经意的数据库系统，它无缝结合了硬件隔离区与前沿的不经意原语以及显著降低服务器间通信开销的新颖优化。DISCO 与先前工作的区别在于一套分布式框架，这些框架释放了并行计算能力，并从根本上转变了分布式不经意系统的设计范式，使得以前解决方案无法达到的规模上的实际部署成为可能。我们在合成和真实数据集上对系统性能进行了全面评估。我们的评估表明，我们的设计显著缩小了理论与实践之间的差距，在 N = 225 个元素的非外键连接上，相比 Jodes 实现了 88 倍加速，相比 SODA 实现了 180 倍加速。最重要的是，我们首次报告了太字节规模的计算结果。

import_candidates.title: Cerium: A Multi-GPU Framework for Terabyte-Scale Encrypted Inference
import_candidates.abstract: Encrypted AI using fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) enables inference directly over encrypted queries, providing strong privacy guarantees. However, its computational and memory overheads have limited practical deployment. Custom FHE accelerators improve performance, but rely on advanced manufacturing technologies that limit their accessibility. GPUs offer a more widely available alternative, yet achieving ASIC-class performance on GPUs is challenging. Large models such as LLMs compound these challenges by requiring optimized kernels, terabyte-scale memory management, and efficient execution across multiple devices.We present Cerium, a multi-GPU framework for large-scale FHE inference. Cerium combines a domain-specific language, an optimizing compiler, and a runtime system to automatically generate optimized GPU kernels, compress plaintext data, manage terabyte-scale memory footprints, and optimize multi-GPU communication.Implemented on NVIDIA GPUs, Cerium outperforms expert-written GPU libraries by up to 2.25{\texttimes} and achieves performance competitive with state-of-the-art FHE ASICs, matching the CraterLake ASIC. It is the first GPU system to execute CKKS bootstrapping in under 10 milliseconds, achieving 7.5 milliseconds, and is the first to demonstrate encrypted inference for BERT-Base and Llama3-8B prefill in 8 seconds and 43 seconds, respectively. The Cerium framework is open-source and available at https://github.com/CMU-CAOS/Cerium
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 使用全同态加密（FHE）的加密AI能够直接在加密查询上进行推理，提供强隐私保证。然而，其计算和内存开销限制了实际部署。定制的FHE加速器能提升性能，但依赖先进制造技术，限制了可及性。GPU提供了更广泛可用的替代方案，但在GPU上达到ASIC级性能颇具挑战。LLM等大型模型通过要求优化内核、TB级内存管理和跨多设备高效执行，加剧了这些挑战。我们提出Cerium，一个用于大规模FHE推理的多GPU框架。Cerium结合了领域特定语言、优化编译器和运行时系统，以自动生成优化的GPU内核、压缩明文数据、管理TB级内存占用并优化多GPU通信。Cerium在NVIDIA GPU上实现，性能比专家编写的GPU库高出至多2.25倍，并与最先进的FHE ASIC性能相当，可匹配CraterLake ASIC。它是首个在10毫秒内执行CKKS自举的GPU系统，达到7.5毫秒，并首次展示了BERT-Base和Llama3-8B预填充的加密推理，分别用时8秒和43秒。Cerium框架是开源的，可在https://github.com/CMU-CAOS/Cerium获取。

import_candidates.title: Borges: A Low-Latency Distributed Shared Log on a CXL Memory/SSD Hybrid
import_candidates.abstract: Fault-tolerant, distributed shared logs are a useful substrate for distributed applications, but existing designs coordinate shard servers, sequencers, and replicas over the network, so append and replay latency is dominated by message exchange. We present Borges, to our knowledge the first fault-tolerant shared log whose data and ordering state reside in a DRAM/SSD hybrid device accessed with Compute Express Link (CXL). Because current CXL pods lack inter-host cache coherence, Borges assigns every shared metadata word a single writer, atomically publishes each committed prefix as a matching global cut and stream index pair, and tracks each stream with compact byte offsets, so replay stays cheap even when a stream spans shards. We evaluate Borges on Samsung's CMM-H device against CXL ports of Scalog and Boki, using a linearizable lock, a key-value store, and a fault-tolerant workflow with exactly-once semantics. Borges achieves 2.87{\texttimes} lower append p99 latency and 2.16{\texttimes} higher throughput than the Scalog port, and for the Retwis workflow application it lowers p50 latency by 5.7{\texttimes}/22.5{\texttimes} relative to the Scalog/Boki ports.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 容错的分布式共享日志是分布式应用的有用基础，但现有设计通过网络协调分片服务器、定序器和副本，因此追加和重放延迟主要由消息交换决定。我们提出了Borges，据我们所知，这是第一个容错的共享日志，其数据和排序状态驻留在通过Compute Express Link (CXL)访问的DRAM/SSD混合设备中。由于当前的CXL pod缺乏跨主机缓存一致性，Borges为每个共享元数据字分配单一写入者，将每个已提交前缀原子地发布为匹配的全局截断和流索引对，并用紧凑的字节偏移跟踪每个流，因此即使流跨分片，重放也保持廉价。我们在三星的CMM-H设备上评估Borges，与Scalog和Boki的CXL移植版本进行对比，使用线性化锁、键值存储和具有恰好一次语义的容错工作流。与Scalog移植版本相比，Borges实现了追加p99延迟降低2.87倍，吞吐量提高2.16倍；对于Retwis工作流应用，相对于Scalog/Boki移植版本，其p50延迟降低了5.7倍/22.5倍。

import_candidates.title: Disk-Based LSMs: An Unexpectedly Good Index for Partly Coherent CXL Memory
import_candidates.abstract: Abstract. We consider the design of an in-memory range index for systems with CXL shared memory in which only a small part of the memory is cache coherent. While existing index data structures can be ported to such a setting using a software-coherence approach, the result performs poorly. We find that the key reason is that such data structures have a large updatable surface area—the part of the data structure that can be modified in-place. We propose a new design that, perhaps surprisingly, is based on log-structured merge trees (LSMs)—data structures originally designed for disks rather than memory. We further enhance LSMs by allowing in-place updates to the upper level of the LSM. The resulting data structure outperforms state-of-the-art schemes based on Adaptive Radix Trees (ARTs) and B-trees ported to our setting, achieving up to 9.4{\texttimes} higher peak throughput over in-memory indexes and up to 15.1{\texttimes} over existing CXL systems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 摘要。我们考虑为具有CXL共享内存的系统设计内存范围索引，其中只有一小部分内存是缓存一致的。虽然现有的索引数据结构可以使用软件一致性方法移植到这种设置中，但结果性能很差。我们发现关键原因是这类数据结构具有较大的可更新表面积——即数据结构中可以就地修改的部分。我们提出了一种新的设计，也许令人惊讶的是，它基于日志结构合并树（LSM）——最初为磁盘而非内存设计的数据结构。我们进一步增强了LSM，允许对LSM的上层进行就地更新。由此产生的数据结构优于基于自适应基数树（ART）和移植到我们设置中的B树的最先进方案，与内存索引相比实现了高达9.4倍的峰值吞吐量，与现有CXL系统相比高达15.1倍。

import_candidates.title: StarfishOS: Revisiting Single System Image on CXL with State-Partitioned Microkernel
import_candidates.abstract: Single System Image (SSI) offers an attractive OS abstraction that enables single-machine applications to transparently execute on multiple machines with improved resource utilization. The emergence of Compute Express Link (CXL) shifts cross-machine synchronization from message passing to coherent shared memory, which may help overcome SSI's long-standing adoption barrier caused by inefficient cross-machine message passing. However, placing state in slow CXL memory degrades performance and makes the system vulnerable to partial failures, since inconsistent CXL-resident state may block or crash the whole system.This paper notes that microkernels' minimized kernelspace state and capability-based state management allow easier state partitioning to minimize state on CXL. To this end, we propose a state-partitioned microkernel, and realize it in StarfishOS, the first OS-level SSI that leverages CXL shared memory for both high efficiency and partial failure resilience by keeping CXL state minimal and recoverable. Evaluations show that applications can transparently scale on StarfishOS with zero code changes, and achieve up to 5.2{\texttimes} and 4.1{\texttimes} the throughput of their distributed and CXL-optimized versions, respectively. Moreover, StarfishOS utilizes all stranded CPU resources by running applications across machines.StarfishOS is open source and available at https://github.com/starfishos-org/starfishos.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 单系统映像（SSI）提供了一种有吸引力的操作系统抽象，使单机应用能够透明地在多台机器上执行，并提高资源利用率。Compute Express Link（CXL）的出现将跨机同步从消息传递转变为一致性共享内存，这可能有助于克服SSI长期存在的采用障碍，该障碍源于低效的跨机消息传递。然而，将状态放在慢速CXL内存中会降低性能，并使系统容易受到部分故障的影响，因为不一致的CXL驻留状态可能阻塞或使整个系统崩溃。本文指出，微内核最小化的内核空间状态和基于能力的状态管理允许更容易地进行状态分区，从而最小化CXL上的状态。为此，我们提出了一种状态分区微内核，并在StarfishOS中实现，这是首个OS级SSI，通过保持CXL状态最小且可恢复，利用CXL共享内存实现高效率和部分故障弹性。评估表明，应用可以在StarfishOS上透明扩展，无需修改代码，并分别达到其分布式版本和CXL优化版本吞吐量的5.2倍和4.1倍。此外，StarfishOS通过跨机运行应用利用了所有闲置的CPU资源。StarfishOS是开源的，可在 https://github.com/starfishos-org/starfishos 获取。

import_candidates.title: XTRA: Unifying Cache Coherence and Concurrency Control for Distributed Transactions in a CXL Pod
import_candidates.abstract: Distributed transactions on CXL memory pools allow hosts to directly access shared data, bypassing message-based coordination. However, the limited cross-host hardware cache coherence (HCC) in CXL hinders synchronization for consistency and concurrency control across large memory pools. To overcome this limitation, we present XTRA, a novel synchronization architecture that efficiently scales CXL distributed TRAnsactions. XTRA decouples the synchronization state from individual data records, consolidating it into a compact directory within the HCC region, while keeping data in the large non-coherent pool. Distributed transactions leverage this decoupled directory to coordinate concurrent access across the entire shared pool. To ensure efficient and consistent access, XTRA unifies cache coherence with concurrency control by exploiting their semantic redundancy, directly repurposing transactional conflict detection to guarantee cache freshness lazily upon read. Furthermore, by using software mutual exclusion to manage the directory, XTRA's decoupled synchronization generalizes to commodity CXL memory without HCC, while preserving upper-layer protocols. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that XTRA improves throughput by up to 15.6{\texttimes} over state-of-the-art systems and reduces P50/P99 latency by up to 4.0{\texttimes}/283.9{\texttimes}.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: CXL内存池上的分布式事务允许主机直接访问共享数据，绕过基于消息的协调。然而，CXL中有限的跨主机硬件缓存一致性（HCC）阻碍了大型内存池中用于一致性和并发控制的同步。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了XTRA，一种新颖的同步架构，可高效扩展CXL分布式事务。XTRA将同步状态与单个数据记录解耦，将其整合到HCC区域内的紧凑目录中，同时将数据保留在大型非一致池中。分布式事务利用这个解耦目录来协调整个共享池中的并发访问。为了确保高效和一致的访问，XTRA通过利用缓存一致性与并发控制之间的语义冗余，将两者统一起来，直接重新利用事务冲突检测来在读取时惰性地保证缓存新鲜度。此外，通过使用软件互斥来管理目录，XTRA的解耦同步可推广到没有HCC的商用CXL内存，同时保留上层协议。大量评估表明，XTRA相比最先进的系统将吞吐量提高了高达15.6倍，并将P50/P99延迟降低了高达4.0倍/283.9倍。

import_candidates.title: Scheduling Linux Threads under I/O Chiplet Wall Using cSwitch
import_candidates.abstract: Chiplet-based processors have become the dominant architecture for modern servers, partitioning functionality across compute chiplets and a centralized I/O chiplet. While this design improves scalability, it introduces a new bottleneck— the I/O Chiplet Wall—where off-chip memory and device requests contend along a shared communication path through the I/O chiplet and interconnect fabric. Our characterization of an AMD EPYC processor shows that this bottleneck significantly impacts performance: it introduces non-trivial latency overheads, caps memory bandwidth, propagates congestion back to cores, reduces per-core effective bandwidth, and lacks traffic control. However, existing OS schedulers remain unaware of this bottleneck, leading to pathological scheduling behaviors and substantial inefficiencies.This paper presents cSwitch, a Linux scheduling framework that addresses the I/O Chiplet Wall. Our key insight is to model the I/O chiplet as a software switch that orchestrates thread-induced data movement. cSwitch represents threads as data flows (cFlows) annotated with communication features, transforming CPU scheduling into a flow scheduling problem and employing networking-inspired techniques. To realize this, we build an I/O Chiplet Loading Map to infer the runtime traffic load, define Chiplet Traffic Label to capture per-flow behavior, and design a cFlow scheduler that combines rate control, contention-aware refinement, and bandwidth-aware migration. Further, cSwitch supports coordinated workloads via MegaCFlow and provides a user-defined policy interface using sched_ext and eBPF. We build cSwitch and evaluate it against EEVDF, ARCAS, and Caladan+ across diverse workloads. Our experimental results show that cSwitch improves performance by up to 2.7{\texttimes}, reduces latency and increases throughput under contention, and achieves better scalability with modest overheads.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 基于芯粒（Chiplet）的处理器已成为现代服务器的主导架构，它将功能划分到多个计算芯粒和一个集中式 I/O 芯粒上。虽然这种设计提高了可扩展性，但它引入了一个新的瓶颈——I/O 芯粒墙——其中片外存储器和设备请求在通过 I/O 芯粒和互连结构的共享通信路径上竞争。我们对 AMD EPYC 处理器的表征表明，这一瓶颈会显著影响性能：它带来不小的延迟开销、限制内存带宽、将拥塞传播回核心、降低每核有效带宽，并且缺乏流量控制。然而，现有操作系统调度器仍未意识到这一瓶颈，导致病态的调度行为和严重的低效。本文提出 cSwitch，一个解决 I/O 芯粒墙问题的 Linux 调度框架。我们的关键见解是将 I/O 芯粒建模为一个软件交换机，用于编排线程引发的数据移动。cSwitch 将线程表示为带有通信特征标注的数据流（cFlows），将 CPU 调度转化为流调度问题，并采用受网络启发的技术。为实现这一点，我们构建了 I/O 芯粒负载图来推断运行时流量负载，定义了芯粒流量标签来捕获每流行为，并设计了 cFlow 调度器，它结合了速率控制、争用感知细化和带宽感知迁移。此外，cSwitch 通过 MegaCFlow 支持协调工作负载，并使用 sched_ext 和 eBPF 提供用户定义策略接口。我们构建了 cSwitch，并在多种工作负载下将其与 EEVDF、ARCAS 和 Caladan+ 进行了评估。实验结果表明，cSwitch 可将性能提升高达 2.7 倍，在争用下降低延迟并提高吞吐量，并以适度的开销实现更好的可扩展性。

import_candidates.title: Tierce: Observability-Driven Tiered Memory Management for Colocated Workloads
import_candidates.abstract: Tiered memory systems rely on hardware signals to estimate page criticality and decide which pages should remain in fast memory. Colocation corrupts these estimates at two points: shared LLC interference changes whether accesses reach memory, and downstream memory contention changes their stall cost. Both effects blend colocated workloads' behavior into shared page-criticality estimates, creating a fundamental observability gap for tiered memory management.We present Tierce, an observability substrate for colocated tiered memory. Tierce estimates workload-local exposed stall by measuring per-workload memory-level parallelism and scoring pages by realized access latency. It bounds LLC interference with explicit cache-way allocation. Across 8 colocated pairs that run four foreground workloads against a bandwidth-intensive and a bursty, phase-varying co-runner, Tierce outperforms PACT, the best prior art, on every pair, by 2.2\% to 12.6\%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 分层内存系统依赖硬件信号来估计页面关键性，并决定哪些页面应保留在快速内存中。共置会在两个环节破坏这些估计：共享LLC干扰改变了访存是否到达内存，而下层内存争用改变了其停顿代价。这两种效应将共置工作负载的行为混入共享的页面关键性估计中，从而为分层内存管理制造了根本性的可观测性缺口。我们提出Tierce，一种面向共置分层内存的可观测性基础机制。Tierce通过测量每个工作负载的内存级并行度，并按实际访存延迟对页面评分，来估计工作负载局部暴露的停顿。它通过显式的缓存路分配来限制LLC干扰。在8对共置组合（四个前台工作负载分别与一个带宽密集型和一个突发性、相位变化的共同运行者配对）上，Tierce在每一对上都优于现有最佳方案PACT，提升幅度为2.2%至12.6%。

import_candidates.title: GAZE: Rearchitecting Log-Structured Filesystem for Garbage Collection on Zoned Namespace Flash Storage
import_candidates.abstract: We rearchitect the log-structured filesystem for garbage collection on zoned namespace flash storage. We find that the existing garbage collection mechanisms share three design principles that, while reasonable at small scale, become critical limitations when reclaiming gigabyte-scale zones: serial segment cleaning, page-cache-oriented page allocation, and blocking garbage collection. To address these limitations, we develop Pipelined Garbage Collection, Garbage Collection Page Pool, and Selective Blocking. Pipelined Garbage Collection restructures the garbage collection workflow into a four-stage pipeline, enabling concurrent execution of computation- and I/O-intensive stages. Garbage Collection Page Pool preallocates physical pages for garbage collection, avoiding expensive kernel services for allocating and managing pages. Selective Blocking exploits the delayed allocation mechanism of the filesystem, allowing buffered write requests to proceed during garbage collection instead of blocking all types of write() requests. GAZE outperforms F2FS with ZNS support, ZNS+, and P-GC by up to 3{\texttimes} (FIO), ScaleLFS by up to 4.4{\texttimes} (FIO), and IPLFS by up to 1.9{\texttimes} (YCSB-A). GAZE reduces the garbage collection latency to $f13 of that of F2FS.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们重新架构了日志结构文件系统，以在分区命名空间闪存存储上实现垃圾回收。我们发现，现有的垃圾回收机制共享三条设计原则，这些原则在小规模下虽然合理，但在回收GB级分区时成为关键限制：串行段清理、面向页缓存的页分配和阻塞式垃圾回收。为了解决这些限制，我们开发了流水线垃圾回收、垃圾回收页池和选择性阻塞。流水线垃圾回收将垃圾回收工作流重构为四阶段流水线，使计算密集型和I/O密集型阶段能够并发执行。垃圾回收页池为垃圾回收预分配物理页，避免用于分配和管理页的高开销内核服务。选择性阻塞利用文件系统的延迟分配机制，允许缓冲写请求在垃圾回收期间继续进行，而不是阻塞所有类型的write()请求。GAZE在FIO下比支持ZNS的F2FS、ZNS+和P-GC快高达3倍，在FIO下比ScaleLFS快高达4.4倍，在YCSB-A下比IPLFS快高达1.9倍。GAZE将垃圾回收延迟降至F2FS的1/3。

import_candidates.title: ProbeFS: Hierarchical DNA File Systems via Biochemical Content Addressability and Parallelism
import_candidates.abstract: DNA storage offers exceptional density, durability, and energy efficiency, yet existing DNA file systems provide only flat storage abstractions with no hierarchical directory structure. Directly applying conventional hierarchy to DNA storage is impractical: hierarchy creates cross-file dependencies whose resolution demands multi-round DNA sequencing, either through sequential directory traversal at read time or cascading propagation at write time. We observe that two inherent biochemical properties of DNA—content-addressability via Watson-Crick base pairing and massive parallelism via concurrent molecular hybridization—can effectively address this overhead. We present ProbeFS, a hierarchical DNA file system co-designed with these properties. ProbeFS introduces path identifiers, a DNA encoding in which files sharing a common ancestor share subsequences, enabling (1) probe-based path resolution that locates files without directory traversal, (2) one-shot file retrieval that fetches entire directory subtrees in a single hybridization without knowing file identities in advance, and (3) chained delta updates that efficiently modify immutable DNA strands. Wet-lab experiments, thermodynamic simulations at scales up to 100K files, and in silico evaluation show that ProbeFS reduces read amplification by up to 5,124{\texttimes} and serialized sequencing rounds by up to 54{\texttimes}, achieving end-to-end retrieval latency of 1.3-2.7 hours—comparable to Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: DNA存储具有卓越的密度、耐久性和能效，然而现有的DNA文件系统仅提供扁平存储抽象，没有分层目录结构。直接将传统层次结构应用于DNA存储是不切实际的：层次结构会产生跨文件依赖，解决这些依赖需要多轮DNA测序，要么在读取时通过顺序目录遍历，要么在写入时通过级联传播。我们观察到DNA的两个固有生化特性——通过Watson-Crick碱基配对实现的内容可寻址性，以及通过并发分子杂交实现的大规模并行性——可以有效解决这一开销。我们提出了ProbeFS，一个与这些特性协同设计的分层DNA文件系统。ProbeFS引入了路径标识符，一种DNA编码，其中共享共同祖先的文件共享子序列，从而实现：(1)基于探针的路径解析，无需目录遍历即可定位文件；(2)一次性文件检索，在事先不知道文件身份的情况下，通过单次杂交获取整个目录子树；(3)链式增量更新，高效修改不可变的DNA链。湿实验室实验、高达10万个文件规模的热力学模拟以及计算机评估表明，ProbeFS将读取放大降低最多5,124倍，将串行测序轮数减少最多54倍，实现1.3-2.7小时的端到端检索延迟——与Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval相当。

import_candidates.title: Don't Let AI Agents YOLO Your Files: Information and Control in Agent-Native Filesystems
import_candidates.abstract: AI coding agents regularly misuse their filesystem access, causing data corruption, loss, and leakage. We conduct the first systematic study of this problem through an analysis of 290 public reports. Our study reveals two fundamental gaps: users and agents have limited information about filesystem effects and insufficient control over them.To close these gaps, we propose to shift information and control from agents to filesystems. We introduce agent-native filesystems and identify three primitives they should provide: introspect effects, undo mutations, and gate accesses. These primitives let agents operate autonomously while reserving user interaction for sensitive accesses and final review.We build YoloFS, an agent-native filesystem. YoloFS stages mutations until the user commits them, snapshots intermediate states for agent self-correction, and uses progressive permission to let users adapt access rules during execution. We evaluate YoloFS with a new methodology that captures interactions among the user, agent, and filesystem. On 11 tasks with hidden side effects, YoloFS enables agents to self-correct in 8 and stages all mutations for user review. On 112 routine tasks, YoloFS reduces user interaction while matching the baseline success rate.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: AI编码代理经常滥用其文件系统访问权限，导致数据损坏、丢失和泄露。我们通过分析290份公开报告，首次对这一问题进行了系统性研究。我们的研究揭示了两个根本性缺口：用户和代理对文件系统影响的信息有限，且对其控制不足。为弥合这些缺口，我们提出将信息和控制从代理转移到文件系统。我们引入代理原生文件系统，并确定其应提供的三种原语：内省影响、撤销变更和门控访问。这些原语让代理能够自主运行，同时将用户交互保留给敏感访问和最终审查。我们构建了YoloFS，一个代理原生文件系统。YoloFS会暂存变更直到用户提交，为代理自我纠正快照中间状态，并使用渐进式权限让用户在运行期间调整访问规则。我们采用一种新方法评估YoloFS，该方法捕获用户、代理和文件系统之间的交互。在11个带有隐藏副作用的任务中，YoloFS使代理在8个任务中实现自我纠正，并暂存所有变更以供用户审查。在112个常规任务中，YoloFS在匹配基线成功率的同时减少了用户交互。

import_candidates.title: TensorDex: A Compact, Tensor-Centric Storage System for Modern AI Models
import_candidates.abstract: Modern model hubs store hundreds of petabytes of large language models (LLMs), with fine-tuned variants dominating the storage footprint. These variants contain substantial cross-model redundancy that delta compression can exploit by storing only the difference between a target and a reference model. However, compression effectiveness depends critically on choosing a similar reference. At model-hub scale, this is challenging because model lineage metadata is often missing or unreliable, and different tensors within the same model may be most similar to tensors from different models. Consequently, model-level pairing leaves substantial redundancy unexploited.We present TensorDex, a lossless, tensor-centric storage system that performs delta compression at tensor granularity. TensorDex decomposes models into tensors, uses compact bit-level fingerprints to predict tensor-pair compressibility, and incrementally organizes tensors into multi-center clusters to select effective bases as new models arrive. Evaluated on 2,890 randomly sampled Hugging Face models, Tensor-Dex reduces storage footprint by 70.5\%, 37\% lower than the state-of-the-art design. It achieves 22.9 GB/s compression and 28.4 GB/s decompression throughput, 3.86{\texttimes} and 1.49{\texttimes} faster than the next-best system, respectively.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代模型中心存储着数百PB的大型语言模型（LLM），其中微调变体占据了主要存储空间。这些变体包含大量的跨模型冗余，增量压缩可以通过仅存储目标模型与参考模型之间的差异来利用这些冗余。然而，压缩效果关键取决于选择相似的参考模型。在模型中心规模下，这具有挑战性，因为模型谱系元数据通常缺失或不可靠，并且同一模型内的不同张量可能最相似于来自不同模型的张量。因此，模型级配对留下了大量未利用的冗余。我们提出TensorDex，一种无损的、以张量为中心的存储系统，它在张量粒度上执行增量压缩。TensorDex将模型分解为张量，使用紧凑的位级指纹来预测张量对的可压缩性，并增量地将张量组织成多中心聚类，以便在新模型到达时选择有效的基。在2,890个随机抽样的Hugging Face模型上进行评估，TensorDex将存储占用减少了70.5%，比最先进的设计低37%。它实现了22.9 GB/s的压缩和28.4 GB/s的解压吞吐量，分别比次优系统快3.86倍和1.49倍。

import_candidates.title: VoliStorM: A Crash-Consistent I/O Cache with Two Kernels Instead of Two Caches
import_candidates.abstract: A crash-consistent I/O cache is essential to ensure data integrity while optimizing performance. However, a general-purpose kernel fails to ensure integrity efficiently because of the high cost of synchronizing I/O requests with the many subsystems that rely on the cache. As a consequence, applications that must store data consistently mostly bypass the kernel I/O cache to implement a second cache in user space. This approach defeats the purpose of centralizing system mechanisms within the OS, induces overheads due to data copying and serialization, and leads to high engineering costs as user-space processes lack direct access to hardware features like page tables.In this paper, we address these drawbacks by doubling the number of kernels instead of doubling the number of caches. The first kernel is general-purpose, while the second provides an independent I/O stack tailored to efficiently ensure integrity. We implemented this design in VoliStorM using hardware virtualization. Our evaluation shows that, across databases, in-memory cache checkpointing, and language runtimes, VoliStorM outperforms the dual-cache approach while simplifying application code and improving code reuse.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 崩溃一致的I/O缓存对于在优化性能的同时确保数据完整性至关重要。然而，通用内核无法高效地确保完整性，因为将I/O请求与依赖该缓存的众多子系统进行同步的成本很高。因此，必须一致地存储数据的应用大多绕过内核I/O缓存，在用户空间实现第二个缓存。这种方法违背了将系统机制集中于操作系统内的初衷，因数据复制和序列化而引入开销，并且由于用户空间进程无法直接访问页表等硬件特性，导致高昂的工程成本。在本文中，我们通过将内核数量加倍而不是将缓存数量加倍来解决这些缺点。第一个内核是通用的，而第二个内核提供独立的I/O栈，专门用于高效地确保完整性。我们使用硬件虚拟化在VoliStorM中实现了该设计。我们的评估表明，在数据库、内存缓存检查点和语言运行时方面，VoliStorM优于双缓存方法，同时简化了应用代码并提高了代码复用性。

import_candidates.title: AgileLog: A Forkable Shared Log for Agents on Data Streams
import_candidates.abstract: In modern data-streaming systems, alongside traditional programs, a new type of entity has emerged that can interact with streaming data: AI agents. Unlike traditional programs, AI agents use LLM reasoning to accomplish high-level tasks specified in natural language over streaming data. Unfortunately, current streaming systems cannot fully support agents: they lack the fundamental mechanisms to avoid the performance interference caused by agentic tasks and to safely handle agentic writes. We argue that the shared log, the core abstraction underlying streaming data, must support creating forks of itself, and that such a forkable shared log serves as a great substrate for agents acting on streaming data. We propose AgileLog, a new shared log abstraction that provides novel forking primitives for agentic use cases. We design Bolt, a system that implements the AgileLog abstraction. Bolt uses many novel techniques to make forks cheap and to provide logical and performance isolation.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在现代数据流系统中，除了传统程序之外，出现了一种可以与流数据交互的新实体：AI代理。与传统程序不同，AI代理使用LLM推理来完成以自然语言指定的、作用于流数据的高层任务。遗憾的是，当前的流系统无法完全支持代理：它们缺乏基本机制来避免代理任务造成的性能干扰，并安全地处理代理写入。我们认为，作为流数据核心抽象的共享日志必须支持创建自身的分叉，而这种可分叉的共享日志是代理作用于流数据的理想基座。我们提出AgileLog，一种新的共享日志抽象，为代理用例提供新颖的分叉原语。我们设计Bolt，一个实现AgileLog抽象的系统。Bolt使用许多新颖技术使分叉变得廉价，并提供逻辑隔离和性能隔离。

import_candidates.title: Computation Is Fast, Use Threadlet!: Efficient Threading for μs-Scale Computing via OS/Hardware Co-Design
import_candidates.abstract: The conventional threading model multiplexes software threads onto hardware cores. This model inherently suffers from the overhead of 1) context switching, 2) scheduling, and 3) system event notifications (e.g., I/O interrupts). As computing enters μs-scale, such overheads become the key bottleneck of a wide range of domains: networking, concurrency control, and microservice scheduling, etc. Existing software solutions, such as cooperative scheduling and polling, sacrifice correctness and/or CPU efficiency, while hardware offers only point solutions with suboptimal performance.To eliminate the threading overheads without introducing difficult tradeoffs, our key insight is that hardware should directly expose schedulable, basic units of execution (i.e., software threads) instead of computational resources (i.e., cores). We propose threadlet, a new hardware abstraction that is lighter than a software thread by removing uncritical state (e.g., floating-point registers). A core caches a few active threadlets in its register file, while spilling the rest to the memory hierarchy. Thus, context switching incurs minimal overhead by simply resuming execution with the next threadlet's state. Moreover, threadlet comes with hardware support that can express diverse OS scheduling policies, enabling fast and flexible scheduling. Finally, as a hardware abstraction, threadlets directly interface with microarchitectural mechanisms (e.g., cache coherence) for efficient event notifications. We build a supporting architecture on an FPGA and a research OS for threadlet, outperforming prior works by 3{\texttimes} to 47{\texttimes} on real-world applications. Our artifact is publicly available at https://github.com/TELOS-syslab/Threadlet.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 传统的线程模型将软件线程多路复用到底层硬件核心上。该模型固有地遭受以下开销：1) 上下文切换，2) 调度，以及 3) 系统事件通知（例如 I/O 中断）。随着计算进入微秒级，此类开销成为网络、并发控制和微服务调度等广泛领域的关键瓶颈。现有的软件解决方案，如协作式调度和轮询，牺牲了正确性和/或 CPU 效率，而硬件仅提供性能次优的局部解决方案。为了在不引入困难权衡的情况下消除线程开销，我们的关键见解是：硬件应直接暴露可调度的基本执行单元（即软件线程），而不是计算资源（即核心）。我们提出 threadlet，一种新的硬件抽象，它通过移除非关键状态（例如浮点寄存器）而比软件线程更轻量。核心在其寄存器文件中缓存少量活动 threadlet，将其余的溢出到内存层次结构中。因此，上下文切换通过简单地用下一个 threadlet 的状态恢复执行而产生最小开销。此外，threadlet 附带硬件支持，可以表达多样的操作系统调度策略，从而实现快速灵活的调度。最后，作为一种硬件抽象，threadlet 直接与微体系结构机制（例如缓存一致性）接口，以实现高效的事件通知。我们在 FPGA 上构建了支持架构，并为 threadlet 构建了一个研究操作系统，在真实应用上比先前工作快 3 倍到 47 倍。我们的工件公开在 https://github.com/TELOS-syslab/Threadlet。

import_candidates.title: It's the Kernel's Fault! Custom Page Fault Handling With bpf_fault
import_candidates.abstract: Page faults, which occur when a program accesses a virtual memory page that is not mapped to physical memory, are traditionally handled by the operating system. However, many applications benefit from running custom page fault handling logic. For example, some applications may seek to prefill newly faulted pages with content, or intercept writes in order to make a copy of the original contents. Linux's userfaultfd interface enables some of these use cases by offloading fault handling to userspace. Unfortunately, it suffers from significant limitations, namely high overhead, poor scalability, and a design that precludes its use in libraries.We present bpf_fault, a framework that allows applications to run page fault handlers directly within the Linux kernel using eBPF. By eliminating the overheads and complexity associated with userfaultfd, bpf_fault reduces fault latency by 2.8-6.7{\texttimes} and eliminates userfaultfd's scalability bottleneck. We integrate bpf_fault with several applications, such as VM live snapshots in Firecracker and QEMU, which eliminates tail latency spikes caused by snapshots. By leveraging bpf_fault, we also design a novel lazy dynamic linking mechanism for Linux that defers relocations to fault time, a use case impossible with userfaultfd, which reduces dirty memory usage of widely used applications like Chrome and Clang by up to 50\%. Together, these results demonstrate that eBPF-based fault handling can improve performance and reduce resource usage in widely deployed applications.To find fault is easy; to do better may be difficult.—Plutarch
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 缺页发生在程序访问未映射到物理内存的虚拟内存页时，传统上由操作系统处理。然而，许多应用受益于运行自定义的缺页处理逻辑。例如，一些应用可能试图预填新缺页的内容，或拦截写入以复制原始内容。Linux 的 userfaultfd 接口通过将缺页处理卸载到用户空间来支持部分这些用例。不幸的是，它存在显著限制，即高开销、可扩展性差，以及一种使其无法在库中使用的设计。我们提出 bpf_fault，一个允许应用使用 eBPF 直接在 Linux 内核中运行缺页处理程序的框架。通过消除与 userfaultfd 相关的开销和复杂性，bpf_fault 将缺页延迟降低了 2.8-6.7 倍，并消除了 userfaultfd 的可扩展性瓶颈。我们将 bpf_fault 与多个应用集成，例如 Firecracker 和 QEMU 中的虚拟机实时快照，从而消除了快照引起的尾部延迟尖峰。通过利用 bpf_fault，我们还为 Linux 设计了一种新颖的惰性动态链接机制，将重定位推迟到缺页时，这是 userfaultfd 无法实现的用例，它可将 Chrome 和 Clang 等广泛使用的应用的脏内存使用量降低最多 50%。这些结果共同表明，基于 eBPF 的缺页处理可以改善广泛部署应用的性能并减少资源使用。发现错误容易；做得更好却可能很难。——普鲁塔克

import_candidates.title: MCon: Building an Elastic Cloud for Android Applications with Framework Consolidation
import_candidates.abstract: Cloud execution of mobile apps—running unmodified apps inside full mobile OSes on commodity servers—is gaining adoption for uses such as GUI agent training and large-scale app testing. These workloads are both temporally dynamic (from second-scale agent interactions to hour-long tests) and highly bursty (up to hundreds of concurrent jobs), demanding an elastic platform that can provision mobile environments both quickly and at high density. Existing stacks fall short because each tenant has a separate copy of the mobile framework (a large collection of shared libraries and system services), which is slow to start and heavy to keep.We present MCon, the first container system with the framework consolidation architecture: the framework is run as a shared, multi-tenant service instead of a per-tenant component. The core challenge is to practically enable per-tenant isolation on a large framework with no native multi-tenant support. MCon achieves this from outside the framework: we virtualize the IPC control path through which apps access shared framework services, and combine it with per-tenant virtual device slices to construct private views of framework and device resources. Compared to the best existing stacks, MCon achieves sub-second cold tenant allocation (15{\texttimes} as fast), with 70\%-82\% less host memory and 1\%-33\% less GPU memory usage. MCon has been adopted by Infinigence AI.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 移动应用的云执行——在商用服务器上的完整移动操作系统中运行未经修改的应用——正被用于GUI代理训练和大规模应用测试等场景。这些工作负载既具有时间动态性（从秒级的代理交互到长达数小时的测试），又具有高度突发性（最多可达数百个并发作业），因此需要一个能够快速且高密度地配置移动环境的弹性平台。现有技术栈的不足在于，每个租户都有一份独立的移动框架副本（一个包含大量共享库和系统服务的集合），启动慢且维护沉重。我们提出了MCon，这是首个采用框架整合架构的容器系统：框架作为共享的多租户服务运行，而不是每个租户的组件。核心挑战是在一个没有原生多租户支持的大型框架上实际实现每租户隔离。MCon从框架外部实现这一点：我们虚拟化应用访问共享框架服务的IPC控制路径，并将其与每租户虚拟设备切片相结合，以构建框架和设备资源的私有视图。与现有最佳技术栈相比，MCon实现了亚秒级冷租户分配（快15倍），主机内存减少70%-82%，GPU内存使用减少1%-33%。MCon已被Infinigence AI采用。

import_candidates.title: Skill VM: Write Once, Run Everywhere Efficiently
import_candidates.abstract: LLM agents increasingly adopt skills as a reusable unit of composition. While skills are shared across diverse agent platforms, current systems treat them as raw context, causing the same skill to behave inconsistently for different agents. This fragility undermines skill portability and execution efficiency.To address this challenge, we analyze 118,000 skills and draw inspiration from traditional compiler design. We treat skills as code and LLMs as heterogeneous processors. To make portability actionable, we decompose a skill's requirements into a set of primitive capabilities, and measure how well each model-harness pair supports them. Based on these capability profiles, we propose SkillVM, a compilation and runtime system designed for portable and efficient skill execution. At compile time, SkillVM performs capability-based compilation, environment binding, and concurrency extraction. At runtime, SkillVM applies JIT code solidification and adaptive recompilation for performance optimization.We evaluate SkillVM across ten LLMs of varying scales and four agent harnesses, covering SkillsBench and representative skill tasks. Results demonstrate that SkillVM significantly improves task completion rates across different models and environments while reducing token consumption by up to 40\%. In terms of performance, SkillVM achieves up to 3.2{\texttimes} speedup with enhanced parallelism, and 19-50{\texttimes} latency reduction through code solidification.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: LLM代理越来越多地将技能作为可复用的组合单元。虽然技能在不同代理平台之间共享，当前系统却将它们视为原始上下文，导致同一技能在不同代理上表现不一致。这种脆弱性损害了技能的可移植性和执行效率。为应对这一挑战，我们分析了118,000个技能，并从传统编译器设计中汲取灵感。我们将技能视为代码，将LLM视为异构处理器。为使可移植性可操作，我们将技能的需求分解为一组原语能力，并测量每个模型-框架对它们的支持程度。基于这些能力画像，我们提出SkillVM，一个为可移植且高效的技能执行而设计的编译与运行时系统。在编译时，SkillVM执行基于能力的编译、环境绑定和并发提取。在运行时，SkillVM应用JIT代码固化和自适应重编译以优化性能。我们在十个不同规模的LLM和四个代理框架上评估SkillVM，覆盖SkillsBench和代表性技能任务。结果表明，SkillVM显著提高了不同模型和环境下的任务完成率，同时将token消耗降低最多40%。在性能方面，SkillVM通过增强并行性实现最高3.2倍加速，并通过代码固化实现19-50倍延迟降低。

import_candidates.title: Turning Linux into a High-Performance Library OS with Flux
import_candidates.abstract: Modern high-performance applications increasingly bypass the host kernel for I/O and scheduling and rely on library OSes for operating-system services. High-performance library OSes are often built from scratch, but supporting unmodified applications requires reimplementing mature Linux semantics. Running Linux itself as a library OS avoids this cost, yet existing Linux-based designs remain slow. Our analysis of LKL shows that the main bottlenecks lie in the surrounding user-space runtime rather than Linux subsystems.We present Flux, a Linux-based library OS that reduces the runtime bottlenecks while keeping Linux subsystems largely intact. Flux redesigns scheduling, user-space interrupt delivery, and syscall paths, and introduces a new process abstraction that supports Linux fork semantics without giving up direct-call syscalls. Flux improves Nginx throughput by up to 18.5{\texttimes} over Linux, and approaches Junction's Memcached throughput under a 100μs p99 latency target, showing that Linux can provide a high-performance library OS without rebuilding Linux functionality from scratch.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代高性能应用越来越多地绕过宿主内核进行I/O和调度，并依赖库操作系统提供操作系统服务。高性能库操作系统通常从头构建，但支持未经修改的应用程序需要重新实现成熟的Linux语义。将Linux本身作为库操作系统运行可以避免这种成本，然而现有的基于Linux的设计仍然很慢。我们对LKL的分析表明，主要瓶颈在于周围的用户空间运行时，而非Linux子系统。我们提出了Flux，一种基于Linux的库操作系统，它在保持Linux子系统基本完整的同时减少了运行时瓶颈。Flux重新设计了调度、用户空间中断传递和系统调用路径，并引入了一种新的进程抽象，支持Linux fork语义而不放弃直接调用系统调用。Flux将Nginx吞吐量比Linux提升高达18.5倍，并在100微秒p99延迟目标下接近Junction的Memcached吞吐量，表明Linux可以在不从头重建Linux功能的情况下提供高性能库操作系统。

import_candidates.title: You Can Always Get What You Want: CPU Virtualization Made Fast and Free
import_candidates.abstract: Dedicated VMs provide near bare-metal performance through CPU pinning, interrupt passthrough, and idle passthrough. In conventional deployments, however, these optimizations lock physical cores to individual VMs and prevent CPU sharing. In one of the world's largest cloud platforms, 74\% of Dedicated VMs average below 10\% CPU utilization, yet they occupy 95\% of the physical infrastructure. This paper describes more than three years of deployment experience with Dynamic-Dedicated VMs (DDVMs) to safely reclaim this spare capacity. DDVMs combine workload-signature profiling, mediated posted interrupts, and occupancy-aware idle reclamation to dynamically share CPU cores while preserving Dedicated-VM-level SLOs. The challenge lies not in any single mechanism, but in making conservative, production-safe sharing decisions: identifying when sharing is safe, bounding interrupt latency when vCPUs are preempted, and recovering quickly when conditions change. Deployed across 37 regions and 92,000 servers, DDVMs improve CPU utilization by 10.5\% at a 1.1{\texttimes} oversubscription ratio, while keeping SLO scores within the 20\% latency-tolerance threshold and the mature-deployment performance-related ticket rate at 0.00035\%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 专用VM通过CPU绑定、中断直通和空闲直通提供接近裸机的性能。然而在传统部署中，这些优化将物理核心锁定到单个VM并阻止CPU共享。在全球最大的云平台之一中，74%的专用VM平均CPU利用率低于10%，但它们却占用了95%的物理基础设施。本文描述了三年多部署动态专用VM（DDVM）以安全回收这些空闲容量的经验。DDVM结合了工作负载特征分析、中介的投递中断和占用感知的空闲回收，以在保持专用VM级SLO的同时动态共享CPU核心。挑战不在于任何单一机制，而在于做出保守的、生产安全的共享决策：确定何时共享是安全的、在vCPU被抢占时限制中断延迟，以及在条件变化时快速恢复。DDVM部署在37个区域和92,000台服务器上，在1.1倍超配率下将CPU利用率提高了10.5%，同时将SLO分数保持在20%的延迟容忍阈值内，并将成熟部署的与性能相关的工单率保持在0.00035%。

import_candidates.title: DiFlow: A System for Micro-Serving Text-to-image Diffusion Workflows
import_candidates.abstract: Text-to-image generation executes a diffusion workflow comprising multiple models centered on a base diffusion model. Existing serving systems treat each workflow as an opaque monolith, provisioning, placing, and scaling all constituent models together, which obscures internal dataflow, prevents model sharing, and enforces coarse-grained resource management. In this paper, we make a case for micro-serving diffusion workflows with DiFlow, a system that decomposes a workflow into loosely coupled model-execution nodes that can be independently managed and scheduled. By explicitly managing individual model inference, DiFlow unlocks cluster-scale optimizations, including per-model scaling, model sharing, and adaptive model parallelism. Collectively, DiFlow outperforms existing diffusion workflow serving systems, sustaining up to 3{\texttimes} higher request rates and tolerating up to 8{\texttimes} higher burst traffic. We have open-sourced DiFlow at https://github.com/diflow-project/diflow.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 文本到图像生成会执行一个扩散工作流，该工作流由以基础扩散模型为中心的多个模型组成。现有的服务系统将每个工作流视为不透明的整体，统一地配置、放置和伸缩所有组成模型，这掩盖了内部数据流、阻碍了模型共享，并强制实施粗粒度的资源管理。在本文中，我们倡导使用 DiFlow 对扩散工作流进行微服务化，该系统将工作流分解为可独立管理和调度的松耦合模型执行节点。通过显式管理单个模型推理，DiFlow 解锁了集群级优化，包括按模型伸缩、模型共享和自适应模型并行。总体而言，DiFlow 优于现有扩散工作流服务系统，可维持高达 3 倍的请求率，并容忍高达 8 倍的突发流量。我们已在 https://github.com/diflow-project/diflow 开源 DiFlow。

import_candidates.title: LMTracer: Fine-Grained and Real-Time Performance Profiling for Production LLM Systems
import_candidates.abstract: Training and serving large language models (LLMs) has become a core business for AI providers. To ensure a high-quality user experience while optimizing infrastructure costs, providers need to closely monitor the performance of LLM executions in production. However, existing performance profiling tools fall short in this context, as they are either too coarse-grained to capture performance bottlenecks, or too intrusive to avoid significant performance degradation.This paper presents LMTracer, a fine-grained and real-time performance profiling framework for production LLM services. We find that the inefficiency of existing techniques mainly stems from disruptions in highly asynchronous GPU execution flows. To address this, our key idea is to embed profiling logic into the execution through graph-embedded probing. This is achieved by compiling lightweight probe kernels that realize profiling logic as special trace nodes in GPU execution graphs, and streaming buffered profiling data to CPUs on demand to keep the execution of user kernels uninterrupted. LMTracer has been deployed in production for eight months. It incurs only 0.9\% average overhead across various LLM workloads (e.g., training, serving, and fine-tuning), and has proactively uncovered 15 performance issues. After fixing these issues, we observed 21.2\% latency reduction and 24.5\% throughput improvement for LLM services.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 训练和服务大型语言模型（LLM）已成为人工智能提供商的核心业务。为了在确保高质量用户体验的同时优化基础设施成本，提供商需要密切监控生产环境中LLM执行的性能。然而，现有的性能分析工具在这种情况下存在不足：它们要么粒度太粗，无法捕捉性能瓶颈，要么侵入性太强，无法避免显著的性能下降。本文提出了LMTracer，一个面向生产LLM服务的细粒度实时性能分析框架。我们发现现有技术的低效主要源于高度异步的GPU执行流受到干扰。为解决这一问题，我们的核心思想是通过图嵌入探测将分析逻辑嵌入执行过程。具体而言，我们编译轻量级探测内核，将分析逻辑实现为GPU执行图中的特殊跟踪节点，并按需将缓冲的分析数据流式传输到CPU，以保持用户内核的执行不中断。LMTracer已在生产环境中部署八个月。它在各种LLM工作负载（如训练、服务和微调）中仅产生0.9%的平均开销，并主动发现了15个性能问题。修复这些问题后，我们观察到LLM服务的延迟降低了21.2%，吞吐量提高了24.5%。

import_candidates.title: Scalable Context Orchestration for Serving LLMs Over Voice
import_candidates.abstract: Voice AI applications are gaining popularity as advances in large language models (LLMs) enable more natural and accessible spoken interactions. Serving these applications requires accounting not only for what users say, but also for how they speak (e.g., speaking rate) and the conditions under which their audio is captured and transmitted (e.g., background noise and packet loss). However, existing LLM systems represent conversation context as a flat, growing sequence of messages, leaving voice-specific context implicit in the audio. As a result, they can generate responses that are poorly aligned with user preferences, degrade interaction quality under adverse environmental conditions, and incur high costs over long voice sessions.We present llmovoice, a context-management middleware that explicitly models voice context and orchestrates its use. At each turn, llmovoice constructs a bounded voice context from the current user input, relevant interaction history, and explicit paralinguistic and environmental states. It then uses the serving LLM to reason over this context and generate runtime directives that guide how the system responds. We evaluate llmovoice on real-world voice applications and benchmarks. It reduces speaking-rate alignment error by 52.4\%, lowers the false-interruption rate from 46.0\% to 0.9\% under packet loss, and reduces model usage cost by 79.2\%. For long sessions, llmovoice reduces per-turn cost by up to 24.9{\texttimes} while retaining up to 98.7\% of baseline answer quality.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的进步使语音交互更加自然和可及，语音AI应用正日益流行。为这些应用提供服务不仅需要考虑用户说了什么，还需要考虑他们如何说话（例如语速）以及音频被采集和传输的条件（例如背景噪声和丢包）。然而，现有的LLM系统将对话上下文表示为扁平且不断增长的消息序列，使语音特定上下文隐含在音频中。因此，它们可能生成与用户偏好严重不符的回复，在不利环境条件下降低交互质量，并在长语音会话中产生高成本。我们提出llmovoice，一种上下文管理中间件，它显式地建模语音上下文并编排其使用。在每一轮中，llmovoice从当前用户输入、相关交互历史以及明确的副语言和环境状态中构建有界的语音上下文。然后，它利用服务LLM对该上下文进行推理，并生成指导系统如何响应的运行时指令。我们在真实语音应用和基准上评估llmovoice。它将语速对齐误差降低52.4%，在丢包情况下将误打断率从46.0%降至0.9%，并将模型使用成本降低79.2%。对于长会话，llmovoice将每轮成本降低至多24.9倍，同时保留高达98.7%的基线答案质量。

import_candidates.title: TuxBot: Semantic-Aware Online OS Tuning with LLMs
import_candidates.abstract: Online OS tuning can improve long-running services, but existing tuners are not well suited for live hosts. They treat scheduler, power, memory, and I/O controls as black-box variables and optimize a scalar reward. This approach ignores cross-knob policy structure, breaks down when application metrics are unavailable, and can push a running service into degraded regions that persist after a bad setting is removed. We present TuxBot, a bounded LLM-based tuner for steady-state online OS tuning. TuxBot constructs a structured decision context from telemetry, knob schemas, recent trajectories, and prior sessions; pairs low-latency and deeper reasoning models; and applies only typed, validated knob updates. TuxBot is able to reason about knob semantics, subsystem interactions, and indirect performance signals without granting the model unconstrained host control.Across 13 live workloads from five benchmark suites, tuning up to 41 Linux parameters, TuxBot consistently outperforms prior tuners while avoiding catastrophic configurations. On the 11 workloads where baselines do not fail catastrophically, TuxBot improves stable-phase performance by 87.2\% over defaults, compared with 50.5\% for MLOS, the strongest non-LLM baseline; on the remaining two workloads, baselines enter severe-degradation regions that TuxBot avoids altogether. Remarkably, using only machine-level metrics, TuxBot still achieves a 64.0\% improvement, outperforming MLOS with access to direct application-level metrics.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在线操作系统调优可以改善长时间运行的服务，但现有的调优器并不适合实时主机。它们将调度器、电源、内存和I/O控制视为黑盒变量，并优化标量奖励。这种方法忽略了跨旋钮的策略结构，在应用指标不可用时失效，并且可能将运行中的服务推入降级区域，即使移除不良设置后该降级状态仍会持续。我们提出了TuxBot，一种用于稳态在线操作系统调优的基于有界LLM的调优器。TuxBot从遥测数据、旋钮模式、近期轨迹和先前会话中构建结构化决策上下文；配对低延迟与更深层推理模型；并且仅应用类型化、经过验证的旋钮更新。TuxBot能够推理旋钮语义、子系统交互和间接性能信号，而无需授予模型不受约束的主机控制权。在来自五个基准套件的13个实时工作负载上，调优多达41个Linux参数，TuxBot始终优于先前调优器，同时避免灾难性配置。在基线未发生灾难性失败的11个工作负载上，TuxBot将稳定阶段性能比默认值提升了87.2%，而最强的非LLM基线MLOS为50.5%；在其余两个工作负载上，基线进入严重降级区域，而TuxBot完全避开。值得注意的是，仅使用机器级指标，TuxBot仍实现了64.0%的提升，优于能够访问直接应用级指标的MLOS。

import_candidates.title: StreamEP: Straggler-Tolerant MoE Decoding without Communication Barriers
import_candidates.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models use expert parallelism (EP) to distribute experts across GPUs, relying on collective communication that synchronizes every device at every layer. To minimize communication latency, hyperscalers provision abundant network bandwidth in data centers and deploy MoE-optimized stacks that require Hopper-generation GPU features. But on commodity GPU clusters with shared and nonuniform interconnects, this communication barrier serializes execution behind the slowest transfer.We present stream expert parallelism (StreamEP), a paradigm that removes the collective communication barrier entirely: each GPU independently receives tokens, executes the appropriate layer, and forwards results as they become ready. We build StreamInfer, a serving system that realizes StreamEP on vanilla NCCL. StreamInfer introduces per-layer token queues for asynchronous token management, a defragmenting scheduler that consolidates partial batches while guaranteeing forward progress, and a two-phase communicator for asynchronous and variable-size GPU-to-GPU transfers. On 16{\texttimes}L40S and 16{\texttimes}A100 clusters with 200 Gbps inter-node networking, StreamInfer achieves up to 1.7{\texttimes} higher decoding throughput than traditional EP, demonstrating that efficient large-scale MoE serving is achievable on commodity hardware.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 专家混合（MoE）模型使用专家并行（EP）将专家分布到多个GPU上，依赖集合通信在每个层同步每个设备。为了最小化通信延迟，超大规模厂商在数据中心配置充足网络带宽，并部署需要Hopper代GPU特性的MoE优化栈。但在具有共享且非均匀互连的商用GPU集群上，这种通信障碍会将执行串行化在最慢的传输之后。我们提出流式专家并行（StreamEP），一种完全消除集合通信障碍的范式：每个GPU独立接收令牌，执行相应层，并在结果就绪时转发结果。我们构建了StreamInfer，一个在原生NCCL上实现StreamEP的服务系统。StreamInfer引入了用于异步令牌管理的逐层令牌队列、一个在保证向前进展的同时合并部分批次的碎片整理调度器，以及一个用于异步且可变大小GPU到GPU传输的两阶段通信器。在具有200 Gbps节点间网络的16×L40S和16×A100集群上，StreamInfer实现比传统EP高达1.7倍的解码吞吐量，证明在商用硬件上可实现高效的大规模MoE服务。

import_candidates.title: I3DP: Neuro-Symbolic Inductive Invariant Inference for Distributed Protocols
import_candidates.abstract: Distributed protocols are notoriously difficult to verify correctly. Proving safety typically requires inductive invariants that both imply the desired property and are preserved by every protocol transition; yet inferring such invariants remains a major bottleneck: existing approaches either restrict the protocol models to a decidable fragment of first-order logic or demand expert-crafted templates.We present I3DP, a neuro-symbolic framework that synthesizes inductive invariants by executing an IC3-style process over TLA+ states with the assistance of large language models (LLMs). At large, I3DP combines a symbolic IC3 controller which decomposes invariant synthesis into focused blocking tasks, and an LLM which provides protocol-level reasoning that IC3 alone lacks for TLA+ specifications. This integration enables a disciplined yet flexible search for invariants without imposing logical restrictions or requiring manual templates.We evaluate I3DP on 29 distributed protocols spanning consensus, reconfiguration, and client-server systems, and compare it against Endive, IC3PO, SWISS, DuoAI, and P-FOLIC3. I3DP discovers candidate invariants for all 29 protocols. Among them, MongoLoglessDynamicRaft models the core mechanism of an industrial-scale Raft-based reconfiguration protocol, and none of the compared tools reports a solution for it. In each case, the invariants synthesized on finite instances are shown in TLAPS to be inductive for the full unbounded protocol, thereby establishing safety.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 分布式协议的正确性验证向来极为困难。证明安全性通常需要归纳不变式，这些不变式既要蕴含所需性质，又要被每个协议转换所保持；然而，推断此类不变式仍是一个主要瓶颈：现有方法要么将协议模型限制在一阶逻辑的可判定片段内，要么要求专家手工编写模板。我们提出 I3DP，一个神经符号框架，它在大型语言模型（LLM）的辅助下，通过在 TLA+ 状态上执行 IC3 风格的过程来合成归纳不变式。总体而言，I3DP 结合了一个符号 IC3 控制器，它将不变式合成分解为聚焦的阻塞任务，以及一个 LLM，它提供 IC3 单独针对 TLA+ 规范所缺乏的协议级推理。这种集成实现了对不变式的有纪律而灵活的搜索，且不施加逻辑限制或要求手工模板。我们在 29 个分布式协议上评估 I3DP，这些协议涵盖共识、重配置和客户端-服务器系统，并将其与 Endive、IC3PO、SWISS、DuoAI 和 P-FOLIC3 进行比较。I3DP 为所有 29 个协议发现了候选不变式。其中，MongoLoglessDynamicRaft 建模了一个工业级基于 Raft 的重配置协议的核心机制，而所有对比工具均未报告针对它的解决方案。在每个案例中，在有限实例上合成的不变式均在 TLAPS 中被证明对完整无界协议是归纳的，从而确立了安全性。

import_candidates.title: Lion: Modular Verification of Async Runtime Liveness
import_candidates.abstract: Asynchronous programming (async) is the dominant paradigm for developing high-performance systems, where concurrent tasks voluntarily yield control to an async runtime when resources are unavailable. These programs expect a fundamental liveness promise from the runtime: every task that yields will eventually be resumed when its awaited event fires. A single scheduling bug can silently break this contract, leaving tasks permanently stalled with no observable symptoms, such as a crash or error trace, to signal the failure. We present a general parametric specification framework and methodology for discharging this promise in runtimes composed of multiple interacting modules. Our approach introduces an append-only logical event log that abstracts implementation details and enables a Kamp-style translation of Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) into First-Order Logic. This enables deductive program verifiers to reason about progress via monotonic timestamps without needing native temporal logic support. Our main liveness theorem abstracts over the sufficient conditions, such as environmental assumptions and calling conventions, allowing these proof obligations to be instantiated for different runtime implementations. We demonstrate this framework via Lion, a Tokio-compatible runtime in Rust verified using Verus. By establishing a bijective mapping between log events and concrete actions, we prove that Lion maintains the liveness contract and measure at least 95\% of unverified-runtime throughput on nine real-world workloads.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 异步编程（async）是开发高性能系统的主导范式，其中并发任务在资源不可用时自愿将控制权让给异步运行时。这些程序期望运行时提供一个基本的活性承诺：每个让出的任务在等待的事件触发时最终都会被恢复。单个调度错误就可能悄无声息地破坏这一契约，使任务永久停滞，且没有可观察的症状（如崩溃或错误跟踪）来表明失败。我们提出了一个通用的参数化规范框架和方法论，用于在由多个交互模块组成的运行时中履行这一承诺。我们的方法引入了一个仅追加的逻辑事件日志，它抽象了实现细节，并支持将线性时序逻辑（LTL）以Kamp风格翻译为一阶逻辑。这使得演绎程序验证器能够通过单调时间戳来推理进展，而无需原生时序逻辑支持。我们的主要活性定理抽象了充分条件（如环境假设和调用约定），使得这些证明义务可以针对不同的运行时实现进行实例化。我们通过Lion展示了该框架，这是一个用Rust实现的Tokio兼容运行时，并使用Verus进行了验证。通过在日志事件和具体动作之间建立双射映射，我们证明了Lion维持了活性契约，并在九个真实世界工作负载上测得至少95%的未验证运行时吞吐量。

import_candidates.title: Sockeye: Bug-finding and proofs for platform configurations and hardware based on reference manuals
import_candidates.abstract: The ever increasing complexity of hardware platforms poses a challenge to systems programmers. Correctly programming a multitude of components, providing functionality and security, is difficult: semantics of individual units are described in prose, underspecified, and prone to inaccuracies. Rigorous statements about platform security are often impossible.We are the first to address this problem for closed-source hardware platforms, by introducing a domain-specific language to formally describe hardware semantics based on hardware-reference manuals, assumptions about software behavior, and desired security properties. We demonstrate the practicality of our approach by creating machine-readable specifications for a diverse set of eight platforms from their reference manuals, and formally proving their (in-)security. In addition to security proofs about memory confidentiality and integrity, we discover a handful of documentation errors. Finally, our analysis also revealed a vulnerability on a real-world server chip, which was confirmed by the vendor to apply to a wide family of deployed network appliances. Our tooling offers system integrators a way of formally describing security properties for whole platforms, and the means to find counterexamples, or proving them correct.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 硬件平台日益增加的复杂性给系统程序员带来了挑战。正确编程众多组件，提供功能性和安全性，是困难的：各个单元的语义以散文描述、规格不足，并且容易出现不准确之处。关于平台安全性的严谨陈述往往是不可能的。我们首次针对闭源硬件平台解决了这个问题，通过引入一种领域特定语言，基于硬件参考手册、对软件行为的假设以及所需的安全属性，形式化地描述硬件语义。我们通过从参考手册中为八个不同平台创建机器可读的规范，并形式化地证明其（不）安全性，展示了我们方法的实用性。除了关于内存机密性和完整性的安全证明之外，我们还发现了一些文档错误。最后，我们的分析还揭示了一个真实世界服务器芯片上的漏洞，供应商确认该漏洞适用于广泛部署的网络设备系列。我们的工具为系统集成商提供了一种形式化描述整个平台安全属性的方法，以及寻找反例或证明其正确性的手段。

import_candidates.title: Verifying a high-performance distributed transaction system using permissioned state machines
import_candidates.abstract: Tulip is a high-performance distributed transaction system that uses sharding for scalability, replication within each shard for fault tolerance, and TAPIR-style inconsistent replication for high performance. Tulip comes with a machine-checked proof of correctness showing that its implementation meets a simple specification identical to a local strictly serializable transaction system, abstracting away implementation details such as crash recovery, multi-versioning, replication, sharding, and coordinator recovery.The contribution of this paper is the permissioned state machine (PSM) approach, which extends TLA-style protocol reasoning with ideas from concurrent separation logic. PSM enables the developer to specify and verify complex protocols, such as Tulip, by breaking them down into smaller modules. PSM makes all dependencies between modules explicit using permissions, which limits the ways these modules can interact, and thereby reduces proof effort.The prototype of Tulip consists of 3,956 lines of Go code, achieving performance competitive with that of TAPIR. Tulip's proof is decomposed into 10 types of modules; the majority of logical proof steps (“actions”) involve just one module, demonstrating that PSM enables local reasoning.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Tulip是一个高性能分布式事务系统，它使用分片实现可扩展性，在每个分片内使用复制实现容错，并采用TAPIR风格的非一致复制以实现高性能。Tulip附带了一个机器检验的正确性证明，表明其实现满足与本地严格可串行化事务系统相同的简单规范，抽象掉了崩溃恢复、多版本、复制、分片和协调者恢复等实现细节。本文的贡献是许可状态机（PSM）方法，它用并发分离逻辑的思想扩展了TLA风格的协议推理。PSM使开发者能够通过将复杂协议（如Tulip）分解为更小的模块来指定和验证它们。PSM使用许可显式地表示模块之间的所有依赖关系，这限制了这些模块交互的方式，从而减少了证明工作量。Tulip的原型由3,956行Go代码组成，性能可与TAPIR相媲美。Tulip的证明分解为10种类型的模块；大多数逻辑证明步骤（“动作”）只涉及一个模块，这表明PSM支持局部推理。

import_candidates.title: Validating a High-Performance Cloud Object Store with Lightweight Formal Methods
import_candidates.abstract: We report on our experience validating S3 Express One Zone, a high-performance Amazon S3 storage class launched in November 2023. We focused on its distributed metadata index, which implements a hierarchical namespace using distributed transactions. We check strong consistency and durability under crashes, network delays, and timeouts. Building on our prior work on lightweight formal methods, we combined executable reference models with property-based testing and stateless model checking. Applying these techniques to a production distributed system required three new techniques: a white-box approach to checking serializability; compositional validation of the data and control planes; and long-running canaries that use reference models to check correctness across deployments. We extended Shuttle, our open-source stateless checker, to support a production async Rust runtime and failure injection, including cancelled operations and timeouts. Our main finding is that this approach is sustainable at engineering scale. After launch, the engineering team took ownership of models and test infrastructure, increasing its share of validation commits from 41\% to 84\% and independently extending the models for conditional writes, object append, and atomic rename, with little involvement from the formal methods team.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们报告了验证S3 Express One Zone的经验，这是2023年11月推出的高性能Amazon S3存储类。我们重点关注其分布式元数据索引，该索引使用分布式事务实现分层命名空间。我们检查在崩溃、网络延迟和超时下的强一致性和持久性。基于我们之前在轻量级形式化方法方面的工作，我们将可执行参考模型与基于属性的测试和无状态模型检查相结合。将这些技术应用于生产分布式系统需要三项新技术：一种检查可串行化的白盒方法；数据平面和控制平面的组合验证；以及使用参考模型跨部署检查正确性的长时间运行金丝雀。我们扩展了开源无状态检查器Shuttle，以支持生产异步Rust运行时和故障注入，包括取消的操作和超时。我们的主要发现是，这种方法在工程规模上是可持续的。发布后，工程团队接管了模型和测试基础设施，将其在验证提交中的份额从41%提高到84%，并独立扩展了用于条件写入、对象追加和原子重命名的模型，而形式化方法团队的参与很少。

import_candidates.title: Welder: Compositional Liveness Verification of Cluster Control Planes
import_candidates.abstract: We present the first compositional approach to formally verifying cluster control planes such as Kubernetes. Control planes are large, distributed systems composed of interacting controllers with subtle liveness and safety dependencies. Our approach, Welder, emphasizes compositionality to make verification manageable and scalable. Welder makes threefold contributions on specification, proof, and implementation. First, Welder provides a general specification called Compositional REconciliation (CORE). CORE states that a set of controllers collectively reconcile the cluster state correctly, precluding bugs in both individual controllers and cross-controller interactions. CORE is an open specification that enables compositional verification: if two compatible sets of controllers each implement CORE, so does their composition. Second, Welder introduces new proof techniques for compositional liveness reasoning about controller interactions, including liveness dependencies and interference. Third, we mechanize Welder as a framework and use it to implement and verify a fraction of the Kubernetes control plane—three core controllers and one custom controller. The verified controllers can readily be deployed in Kubernetes platforms with comparable performance to (unverified) official ones. Welder enables a progressive way to verify cluster control planes by gradually verifying that each controller implements CORE.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出首个用于形式化验证集群控制平面（如Kubernetes）的组合式方法。控制平面是大型分布式系统，由相互作用的控制器组成，具有微妙的活性和安全性依赖。我们的方法Welder强调组合性，以使验证可管理且可扩展。Welder在规约、证明和实现三方面做出贡献。首先，Welder提供了一种称为组合式协调（Compositional REconciliation, CORE）的通用规约。CORE指出，一组控制器共同正确地协调集群状态，从而防止单个控制器以及跨控制器交互中的错误。CORE是一种开放规约，支持组合式验证：如果两个兼容的控制器集合各自实现CORE，那么它们的组合也实现CORE。其次，Welder引入了新的证明技术，用于对控制器交互进行组合式活性推理，包括活性依赖和干扰。第三，我们将Welder机械化为一个框架，并用它来实现和验证Kubernetes控制平面的一部分——三个核心控制器和一个自定义控制器。经过验证的控制器可以很容易地部署在Kubernetes平台中，性能与（未经验证的）官方控制器相当。Welder通过逐步验证每个控制器实现CORE，实现了逐步验证集群控制平面的方式。

import_candidates.title: Pirateship: Append-Only Ledgers for (Mostly) Trusted Execution Environments
import_candidates.abstract: Distributed ledgers are increasingly relied upon by industry to provide trustworthy accountability, strong integrity-protection, and high availability for critical data without centralizing trust. Recently, distributed append-only logs are opting for a layered approach, combining crash-fault-tolerant (CFT) consensus with hardware-based Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) for greater resiliency. Unfortunately, hardware TEEs can be subject to (rare) attacks, undermining the very guarantees that distributed ledgers are carefully designed to achieve. In response, we present Pirateship, a new distributed consensus protocol that cautiously trusts the guarantees of TEEs. Pirateship carefully embeds a Byzantine fault-tolerant (BFT) protocol inside of a CFT protocol with no additional messages. This is made possible through careful refactoring of both the CFT and BFT protocols such that their structure aligns. Pirateship achieves performance in line with regular TEE-enabled consensus protocols, while guaranteeing integrity in the face of TEE platform compromises.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 分布式账本正日益被工业界依赖，以在不集中信任的情况下为关键数据提供可信问责、强完整性保护和高可用性。最近，分布式仅追加日志开始采用分层方法，将崩溃容错（CFT）共识与基于硬件的可信执行环境（TEE）相结合，以获得更强的韧性。不幸的是，硬件TEE可能遭受（罕见的）攻击，从而破坏分布式账本精心设计所要实现的保证。为此，我们提出Pirateship，一种新的分布式共识协议，它谨慎地信任TEE的保证。Pirateship在不增加额外消息的情况下，将拜占庭容错（BFT）协议谨慎地嵌入到CFT协议中。这通过对CFT和BFT协议进行仔细重构，使它们的结构对齐而成为可能。Pirateship的性能与常规的TEE启用共识协议相当，同时在TEE平台被攻陷时仍能保证完整性。

import_candidates.title: DDB: Source-Level Interactive Debugging for Distributed Applications
import_candidates.abstract: Interactive debugging is an effective tool for understanding program behavior at the source level, allowing developers to pause execution, navigate the call stack, and inspect runtime state. However, interactive debuggers are designed for single-process execution, and interactive debugging has been widely considered impractical for distributed systems. Call stacks stop at process boundaries, debugging state fails to survive infrastructure dynamics, and, most critically, debugger-induced execution pauses trigger catastrophic timeout cascades that destroy the intended debug flow. Consequently, developers are forced to abandon live hypothesis testing in favor of unwieldy and iterative log-and-redeploy cycles.We present DDB, a source-level interactive debugger that extends interactive debugging capabilities to distributed applications. We show that each of these challenges admits a targeted solution. To bridge disjoint processes, Distributed Backtrace (DBT) embeds compact causality metadata in every RPC and reconstructs a unified call stack across RPC boundaries. To manage the lifecycle of a distributed session, an intent-preserving control plane automatically coordinates and propagates breakpoints across dynamic process sets. To make pausing safe, Pause-Erased Time (PET) virtualizes each process's clock, decoupling logical time from physical pauses and preventing timeout cascades. DDB integrates with an RPC framework in 10-60 lines of code. Evaluated on gRPC, ServiceWeaver, Nu, and Quicksand across up to 122 processes, DDB achieves 30 ms median cross-RPC backtrace latency, sub-5 ms time jump under repeated execution pauses, and adds 1-5\% throughput overhead, comparable to attaching a single-process debugger. In a controlled user study, DDB achieves a 100\% fault localization success rate (compared to 38.5\% for baseline tools) with a median localization time of ~8 minutes.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 交互式调试是在源代码级别理解程序行为的有效工具，允许开发者暂停执行、浏览调用栈并检查运行时状态。然而，交互式调试器是为单进程执行设计的，而且交互式调试一直被广泛认为对分布式系统不切实际。调用栈在进程边界处终止，调试状态无法在基础设施动态变化中存活，并且最关键的是，调试器引起的执行暂停会触发灾难性的超时级联，破坏预期的调试流程。因此，开发者被迫放弃实时假设检验，转而采用笨拙且迭代的日志-重新部署循环。我们提出DDB，一种源代码级交互式调试器，将交互式调试能力扩展到分布式应用。我们表明，这些挑战中的每一个都有针对性的解决方案。为了连接不相交的进程，分布式回溯（DBT）在每个RPC中嵌入紧凑的因果元数据，并跨RPC边界重建统一的调用栈。为了管理分布式会话的生命周期，一个保持意图的控制平面自动在动态进程集合之间协调和传播断点。为了使暂停安全，暂停擦除时间（PET）虚拟化每个进程的时钟，将逻辑时间与物理暂停解耦，并防止超时级联。DDB以10-60行代码与RPC框架集成。在gRPC、ServiceWeaver、Nu和Quicksand上，跨多达122个进程进行评估，DDB实现了30毫秒的中位跨RPC回溯延迟，在重复执行暂停下小于5毫秒的时间跳变，并增加1-5%的吞吐量开销，与附加单进程调试器相当。在一项受控用户研究中，DDB实现了100%的故障定位成功率（相比之下，基线工具为38.5%），中位定位时间约为8分钟。

import_candidates.title: Sintr: Safe Interactive Transactions in the Presence of Byzantine Clients
import_candidates.abstract: Byzantine fault-tolerant (BFT) systems are, in principle, an appealing foundation for transactional applications involving mutually distrustful participants. Yet their adoption has been hampered by two persistent stumbling blocks—performance and developer convenience—which are often in tension with one another. Recent systems show promising progress on both fronts by shifting to a client-centric architecture; clients execute transactions locally and concurrently, while the system resolves any data conflicts to maintain database serializability. We argue that, in its current form, this approach introduces a critical vulnerability: it leaves the integrity of the database exposed to Byzantine clients, which may issue malicious or incorrect transactions. We address this threat with Sintr, a framework that prevents Byzantine clients from compromising database integrity by executing rogue transactions. Sintr combines redundant execution to validate transaction outcomes with a flexible, heterogeneous policy framework for expressing an application's data integrity requirements. We apply Sintr to harden several existing BFT database systems and find that it imposes only modest overheads—3\%-16\% in throughput and 3\%-21\% in latency.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 拜占庭容错（BFT）系统原则上是为涉及互不信任参与者的交易应用提供的一个有吸引力的基础。然而，其采用一直受到两个持续障碍的阻碍——性能和开发者便利性——这两者往往相互制约。最近的系统通过转向以客户端为中心的架构，在这两方面都显示出有希望的进展；客户端在本地并发执行事务，而系统解决任何数据冲突以保持数据库可串行化。我们认为，当前形式的这种方法引入了一个关键漏洞：它使数据库的完整性暴露于拜占庭客户端，后者可能发出恶意或不正确的事务。我们用 Sintr 来应对这一威胁，Sintr 是一个框架，通过防止拜占庭客户端执行恶意事务来破坏数据库完整性。Sintr 结合了冗余执行以验证事务结果，以及一个灵活的、异构的策略框架来表达应用的数据完整性要求。我们将 Sintr 应用于加固几个现有的 BFT 数据库系统，发现它只带来适度的开销——吞吐量 3%-16%，延迟 3%-21%。

import_candidates.title: Smaran: Serving Authenticated Time-Travel Queries
import_candidates.abstract: Time-travel queries ask what data looked like at a past time or over an interval. Modern databases support time-travel queries, but this support is insufficient for applications that cannot trust the query server, such as secure messaging and decentralized applications, where clients need proofs that the returned results are correct. Existing approaches either require aggregating evidence from multiple auditors, incur per-step proof costs that scale linearly with history length, or impose massive storage and communication costs.In this paper, we introduce Smaran, an authenticated data structure that enables servers to answer time-travel queries efficiently with a constant number of fixed-size proofs, independent of the query range. Smaran achieves this through a novel integration of segment trees with vector commitments, sidestepping scalability challenges as history grows via a hierarchical architecture, and avoiding redundancy by introducing versioned vector commitments.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 时间旅行查询询问数据在过去某个时间或某个时间段的样子。现代数据库支持时间旅行查询，但这种支持不足以满足无法信任查询服务器的应用，如安全消息传递和去中心化应用，其中客户端需要证明返回结果是正确的。现有方法要么需要从多个审计者那里聚合证据，要么产生随历史长度线性增长的每步证明成本，要么施加巨大的存储和通信成本。本文中，我们介绍 Smaran，一种可认证的数据结构，使服务器能够以恒定数量的固定大小证明高效地回答时间旅行查询，且与查询范围无关。Smaran 通过将线段树与向量承诺新颖地集成来实现这一点，通过分层架构规避了历史增长带来的可扩展性挑战，并通过引入版本化向量承诺避免了冗余。

import_candidates.title: RPCShield: Defending Microservices Against Cascading Failures
import_candidates.abstract: Microservice-based systems are tightly interdependent. A failure in one service can propagate to a dependent service, potentially bringing down critical, user-facing functionality. We have developed and deployed RPCShield, a suite of program analyses for Go and Java that detects such cascading-failure risks. RPCShield uses static program analysis to track error and exception propagation through service code. Two insights make this practical. First, error propagation needs to be only checked per service, so the analysis is intra-service and avoids inter-service analysis entirely. Second, deciding the property counterfactually, by asking whether an endpoint could have succeeded had a given call succeeded, attributes the failure to the specific responsible dependency rather than to every dependency whose error reaches the caller. We have deployed RPCShield at Uber, across a fleet of over 6K microservices. Since deployment, it has detected over 3,800 cascading failure risks, of which service owners have already remediated more than 1,300. Manual review indicates that RPCShield has a false positive rate of around 5\%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 基于微服务的系统紧密相互依赖。一个服务的故障可能传播到依赖服务，可能使关键的用户功能瘫痪。我们开发并部署了RPCShield，这是一套用于Go和Java的程序分析工具，可检测此类级联故障风险。RPCShield使用静态程序分析来跟踪错误和异常在服务代码中的传播。两个见解使其切实可行。首先，错误传播只需按服务检查，因此分析是服务内的，完全避免了服务间分析。其次，通过反事实地判定属性，即询问如果给定调用成功，端点是否可能成功，将故障归因于具体负责的依赖项，而不是每个错误到达调用者的依赖项。我们已在Uber部署RPCShield，覆盖超过6000个微服务的集群。自部署以来，它已检测到超过3800个级联故障风险，服务所有者已修复超过1300个。人工审查表明，RPCShield的误报率约为5%。

import_candidates.title: QProf: Fleetwide Transitive Cost Profiling of Warehouse-Scale Services
import_candidates.abstract: Warehouse-scale services form the backbone of major cloud services relied on by billions of users every day. As these systems grow increasingly complex, understanding them and finding opportunities for optimization becomes more and more difficult. In this paper, we present QProf, a distributed systems profiler built upon RPC tracing. Going well beyond prior work that focuses on fleetwide profiling of single programs, QProf focuses on cost profiling of entire services. By treating a distributed program as if it were a single process, QProf can produce call-graph profiles of entire systems, so it can measure the transitive cost of services through the entire stack of backend dependencies. QProf is backed by a novel tracing mechanism called skeletal tracing which is exceedingly low-overhead and invisible to applications, ensuring that tracing minimally perturbs application behavior. An ambient per-query CPU profiler ensures high profiling coverage across thousands of microservices without manual instrumentation, and new fan-in APIs provide support for representing batched requests in a tracing data model that is tree-centric. QProf processes billions of traces per day to produce aggregated datasets which can be queried by engineers. Despite the sampled nature of traces, QProf is highly accurate in measuring QPS and CPU across thousands of microservices in an extremely diverse datacenter fleet. QProf has been deployed for every job in Google's production fleet for several years. It has a myriad of use cases, and we present several case studies showing how it has been used to find the “room-at-the-top” in complex systems and optimize them across many dimensions.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 仓库级服务构成了每天数十亿用户所依赖的主要云服务的骨干。随着这些系统日益复杂，理解它们并寻找优化机会变得越来越困难。本文提出 QProf，一个基于 RPC 追踪的分布式系统剖析器。远超先前专注于单程序全集群剖析的工作，QProf 聚焦于整个服务的成本剖析。通过将分布式程序视为单个进程，QProf 可以生成整个系统的调用图剖析，从而可以测量服务通过整个后端依赖栈的传递成本。QProf 由一种新颖的追踪机制——骨架追踪（skeletal tracing）支撑，该机制开销极低且对应用不可见，确保追踪对应用行为的扰动最小。环境式每查询 CPU 剖析器确保在数千个微服务之间具有高剖析覆盖率而无需手动插桩，新的扇入 API 提供了在树为中心的追踪数据模型中表示批量请求的支持。QProf 每天处理数十亿条追踪以生成可由工程师查询的聚合数据集。尽管追踪具有采样性质，QProf 在极其多样化的数据中心集群中跨数千个微服务测量 QPS 和 CPU 时仍高度准确。QProf 已在 Google 生产集群中的每个作业上部署多年。它有无数的用例，我们展示了几个案例研究，说明它如何被用于发现复杂系统中的“顶部空间”并在多个维度上优化它们。

import_candidates.title: Anchor: Mitigating GPU Shallow Disruptions with Decoupled Memory
import_candidates.abstract: Job failures are frequent in large-scale GPU clusters for LLM workloads, leading to significant resource wastage. The vast majority of these are shallow disruptions (e.g., software errors or updates), where only the worker process crashes while the underlying GPU and OS kernel remain intact. Existing recovery systems, however, are failure-agnostic, relying on heavyweight checkpointing that forces a full, slow state reload even when the data could have survived on the GPU.In this paper, we propose Anchor, a system that avoids this overhead by decoupling memory ownership from the failure-prone worker process. Anchor uses a daemon process to manage GPU memory. Leveraging the GPU's native IPC memory mechanism, Anchor enables a restarted worker to remap and reuse the daemon-managed memory with no overhead on the normal execution path. To make this idea practical for real-world ML applications, Anchor introduces an access-path-based identity resolution mechanism to remap logical tensors to their physical memory objects after restart. Anchor also provides lightweight, application-aware consistency protocols to ensure data integrity with little overhead. We integrate Anchor into DeepSpeed and vLLM. Our evaluation demonstrates recovery acceleration, with recovery time reduced by 60.7\% for inference and 26.6\% for training on average. For Qwen3-235B inference, Anchor reduces the recovery time from 143.78 s to 27.85 s.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在大规模GPU集群中，LLM工作负载的作业故障频繁发生，导致显著的资源浪费。其中绝大多数是浅层故障（例如软件错误或更新），此时只有工作进程崩溃，而底层GPU和操作系统内核仍保持完好。然而，现有的恢复系统不区分故障类型，依赖于重量级检查点，即使数据本可以在GPU上存活，也会强制进行完整且缓慢的状态重载。在本文中，我们提出Anchor，一种通过将内存所有权与易故障工作进程解耦来避免这种开销的系统。Anchor使用守护进程管理GPU内存。利用GPU原生的IPC内存机制，Anchor使重启后的工作进程能够重新映射并复用守护进程管理的内存，且在正常执行路径上无额外开销。为了使这一想法适用于现实世界的机器学习应用，Anchor引入了基于访问路径的身份解析机制，在重启后将逻辑张量重新映射到其物理内存对象。Anchor还提供轻量级、应用感知的一致性协议，以极小的开销确保数据完整性。我们将Anchor集成到DeepSpeed和vLLM中。我们的评估表明恢复加速：推理平均恢复时间减少60.7%，训练平均减少26.6%。对于Qwen3-235B推理，Anchor将恢复时间从143.78秒减少到27.85秒。

import_candidates.title: Linux AGX: An Adaptive GPU eXtension to Linux Fair Scheduling for Physical AI and Robotic Systems
import_candidates.abstract: Linux fair scheduling (EEVDF in kernel ≥ 6.6, CFS in older releases) is the default time-sharing policy on many production robots. ML-driven robotic pipelines, combining perception, planning, and on-device LLM/VLM inference, create workloads in which short CPU preparation steps gate GPU launches and the active task graph reconfigures at runtime as scenes change, humans intervene, or new behaviors are triggered. Because Linux fair scheduling observes only CPU service and sleep-wake events, it cannot identify GPU-gating feeder slices or adapt as the critical path shifts, leading to avoidable GPU idle time and inflated end-to-end latency on single-GPU embedded platforms.We present AGX (Adaptive GPU eXtension), a lightweight, scheduler-agnostic mechanism that preserves Linux fair scheduling's pick logic, virtual-deadline computation, and fairness semantics while making its weight interface GPU-, dependency-, and adaptation-aware. A user-space profiler periodically computes a bounded per-task importance score, which the kernel applies as an effective weight, requiring no new queues, locks, or vendor-specific paths. AGX tracks the evolving critical path online without manual retuning. We prove that AGX preserves proportional fairness under effective weights and bounds competition-induced GPU launch delay, yielding a K-independent bound when the bounded boost is not clipped and bounded coalescing otherwise. AGX instantiates on EEVDF, specializes to CFS, and generalizes to any proportional-share fair scheduler.Experiments on three NVIDIA platforms across fuzz-generated DAGs, realistic robotic pipelines, background CPU-pressure stress tests, and a physical TurtleBot stack show that AGX reduces makespan by 6.0-20.0\% and raises average GPU utilization by 7.6-22.1\% relative to vanilla EEVDF. Under background CPU pressure, AGX cuts p99 perception-to-control latency by 38.5\% and deadline misses by 33.8 percentage points while preserving CPU-only fairness. AGX incurs minimal overhead and remains a drop-in extension that degrades cleanly to vanilla behavior.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Linux 公平调度（内核 ≥ 6.6 中的 EEVDF，旧版本中的 CFS）是许多生产机器人的默认分时策略。由机器学习驱动的机器人流水线结合感知、规划和设备端 LLM/VLM 推理，所产生的工作负载中，短的 CPU 准备步骤会限制 GPU 启动，并且随着场景变化、人工干预或新行为触发，活动任务图会在运行时重新配置。由于 Linux 公平调度只观察 CPU 服务和睡眠-唤醒事件，它无法识别限制 GPU 的供给切片，也无法在关键路径发生变化时进行调整，导致单 GPU 嵌入式平台上出现可避免的 GPU 空闲时间和端到端延迟增加。我们提出 AGX（自适应 GPU 扩展），一种轻量级、调度器无关的机制，它保留 Linux 公平调度的选择逻辑、虚拟截止时间计算和公平性语义，同时使其权重接口能够感知 GPU、依赖关系和自适应。用户空间分析器定期计算有界的每任务重要性分数，内核将其作为有效权重应用，不需要新的队列、锁或供应商特定路径。AGX 在线跟踪不断变化的关键路径，无需手动重新调优。我们证明 AGX 在有效权重下保持比例公平性，并限制竞争引起的 GPU 启动延迟，当有界提升未被裁剪时得到与 K 无关的界，否则得到有界合并。AGX 在 EEVDF 上实例化，专门化到 CFS，并推广到任何比例份额公平调度器。在三个 NVIDIA 平台上的实验，涵盖模糊生成的 DAG、真实机器人流水线、后台 CPU 压力压力测试和物理 TurtleBot 栈，表明相对于原生 EEVDF，AGX 将完工时间减少 6.0-20.0%，并将平均 GPU 利用率提高 7.6-22.1%。在后台 CPU 压力下，AGX 将 p99 感知到控制延迟降低 38.5%，将截止时间错过减少 33.8 个百分点，同时保持仅 CPU 的公平性。AGX 开销极小，并保持即插即用扩展，可干净地退化为原生行为。

import_candidates.title: TensorHub: Scalable and Elastic Weight Transfer for LLM RL Training
import_candidates.abstract: Modern LLM reinforcement learning (RL) workloads require a high-performance weight transfer system to scale training across heterogeneous compute resources. However, efficiently transferring terabyte-scale model weights across thousands of GPUs remains challenging because the system must accommodate clusters that dynamically scale up and down while keeping coordination, data movement, and storage overhead low.We introduce Reference-Oriented Storage (ROS), a new storage abstraction for RL weight transfer that exploits highly replicated model weights in place. ROS presents the illusion that certain versions of the model weights are stored and can be fetched on demand. Underneath, ROS does not physically store any copies of the weights; instead, it tracks the workers that hold these weights on GPUs for inference. Upon request, ROS directly uses them to serve reads. We build TensorHub, a production-quality system that instantiates the ROS idea with topology-aware transfer, model-parallel consistency, and fault tolerance. Evaluation shows that TensorHub saturates RDMA bandwidth and adapts to three distinct rollout workloads with minimal engineering effort. Specifically, TensorHub reduces total GPU stall time by up to 6.7{\texttimes} for standalone rollouts, accelerates weight updates for elastic rollouts by up to 4.8{\texttimes}, and cuts cross-datacenter rollout stall time by up to 19{\texttimes}.
