TensorHub has been deployed in ByteDance production to support cutting-edge RL training.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代LLM强化学习（RL）工作负载需要高性能的权重传输系统，以便在异构计算资源上扩展训练。然而，在数千个GPU之间高效传输TB级模型权重仍然具有挑战性，因为系统必须适应动态扩缩容的集群，同时保持协调、数据移动和存储开销较低。我们引入面向引用的存储（Reference-Oriented Storage，ROS），一种用于RL权重传输的新存储抽象，它就地利用高度复制的模型权重。ROS呈现出某些版本的模型权重已被存储并可按需获取的假象。实际上，ROS并不物理存储任何权重副本；相反，它跟踪在GPU上持有这些权重用于推理的工作节点。收到请求时，ROS直接使用它们来服务读取。我们构建了TensorHub，一个生产级系统，通过拓扑感知传输、模型并行一致性和容错来实例化ROS理念。评估表明，TensorHub能够饱和RDMA带宽，并以最小的工程工作量适应三种不同的rollout工作负载。具体而言，TensorHub将独立rollout的总GPU停顿时间减少高达6.7倍，将弹性rollout的权重更新加速高达4.8倍，并将跨数据中心的rollout停顿时间减少高达19倍。TensorHub已部署在字节跳动生产环境中，以支持前沿RL训练。

import_candidates.title: A Few GPUs, A Whole Lotta Scale: Faithful LLM Training Emulation with CrystalLLM
import_candidates.abstract: Large language model (LLM) training today runs on clusters spanning thousands of GPUs. While this scale enables rapid model advances, developing, debugging, and performance-tuning, the training framework inevitably becomes complex and costly. This is because engineers often need to reproduce production behaviors to diagnose failures or evaluate optimizations, thereby demanding frequent and even exclusive access to production-scale clusters—which becomes increasingly hard given that the majority of GPUs are already committed to production workloads. Simulation relies on complex performance models that are difficult to maintain, and downscaled experiments often fail to capture scale-dependent behaviors.We present CrystalLLM to decouple large-scale execution from the need to access large clusters, enabling engineers to run and observe ranks of interest under faithful large-scale behavior using only a few GPUs. CrystalLLM constructs a high-fidelity execution graph via a slicing-based approach that captures computation, communication, and dependencies of the target scale. Then, CrystalLLM performs hybrid emulation where selected ranks execute the original program while the remaining are replayed as virtual participants.Experiments on large-scale LLM training workloads show that CrystalLLM accurately reproduces performance and memory behavior, achieving only 0.58\% average error in iteration time and less than 0.01\% error in peak GPU memory usage. CrystalLLM can emulate clusters of up to 8192 GPUs using fewer than 1\% of the physical GPUs required by the original deployment.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 当前大语言模型（LLM）训练运行在跨越数千个GPU的集群上。虽然这种规模使模型快速进步成为可能，但开发、调试和性能调优的训练框架不可避免地变得复杂且昂贵。这是因为工程师经常需要复现生产行为以诊断故障或评估优化，从而需要频繁甚至独占访问生产规模集群——鉴于大多数GPU已被用于生产工作负载，这变得越来越困难。仿真依赖难以维护的复杂性能模型，而降规模实验往往无法捕捉规模相关行为。我们提出CrystalLLM，将大规模执行与访问大型集群的需求解耦，使工程师仅使用少量GPU即可运行并观察感兴趣的rank，同时呈现忠实的大规模行为。CrystalLLM通过基于切片的方法构建高保真执行图，捕获目标规模的计算、通信和依赖关系。然后，CrystalLLM执行混合仿真，其中选定的rank执行原始程序，而其余rank作为虚拟参与者重放。在大规模LLM训练工作负载上的实验表明，CrystalLLM准确复现了性能和内存行为，迭代时间平均误差仅为0.58%，峰值GPU内存使用误差小于0.01%。CrystalLLM可以使用不到原始部署所需物理GPU的1%来仿真多达8192个GPU的集群。

import_candidates.title: LLM-42: Enabling Determinism in LLM Inference with Verified Speculation
import_candidates.abstract: In LLM inference, the same prompt often returns different outputs across different runs. At the system level, this non-determinism arises from floating-point non-associativity interacting with dynamic batching and GPU kernels whose reduction orders vary with batch size. A straightforward way to eliminate nondeterminism is to disable dynamic batching, but doing so severely degrades throughput. Another approach is to make the kernels batch-invariant; however, this tightly couples determinism to kernel design, requires new implementations, and imposes fixed overheads regardless of how much of the workload actually requires determinism.Inspired by self-speculative decoding, we present LLM-42 — a scheduling-based approach to enable determinism in LLM inference. Our key observation is that a given sequence of tokens is likely to emit the same next token across multiple runs, even with dynamic batching. Moreover, most GPU kernels use the same reduction schedules for all inputs of a given shape. Leveraging these insights, LLM-42 decodes tokens using a nondeterministic fast path and enforces determinism through a verify-rollback protocol. The verifier replays fast path tokens under a fixed batch size to obtain a deterministic reference output, commits tokens that match the reference, and rolls back those that do not. LLM-42 reuses many existing kernels unchanged and incurs overhead only proportional to the fraction of traffic that requires determinism.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在LLM推理中，相同的提示在不同运行中往往返回不同的输出。在系统层面，这种非确定性源于浮点非结合性与动态批处理和GPU内核相互作用，而后者的归约顺序会随批大小变化。消除非确定性的一种直接方法是禁用动态批处理，但这样做会严重降低吞吐量。另一种方法是使内核批不变；然而，这会将确定性与内核设计紧密耦合，需要新的实现，并且无论工作负载中实际需要确定性的比例如何，都会带来固定开销。受自推测解码的启发，我们提出LLM-42——一种基于调度的方法来实现LLM推理的确定性。我们的关键观察是，即使使用动态批处理，给定令牌序列在多次运行中也很可能发出相同的下一个令牌。此外，大多数GPU内核对于给定形状的所有输入使用相同的归约调度。利用这些见解，LLM-42使用非确定性快速路径解码令牌，并通过验证-回滚协议强制确定性。验证器在固定批大小下重放快速路径令牌以获得确定性参考输出，提交与参考匹配的令牌，并回滚不匹配的令牌。LLM-42重复使用许多现有内核而无需更改，并且仅按需要确定性的流量比例产生开销。

import_candidates.title: Ahead-of-Time Analysis of Shell Program Effects
import_candidates.abstract: The Unix shell remains a core system substrate across system administration, automation, and software development. Shell programs, however, are prone to subtle, severe, and often irreversible effects that are difficult to predict. The challenge stems from the shell's unique execution model, its reliance on external computation and state, its highly dynamic expansion semantics, and the complex interactions among these features. This paper presents SaSh, a system that statically analyzes shell programs to identify errors in their execution before they occur. SaSh introduces an optimistic symbolic execution engine for shell programs that limits path explosion and focuses on high-impact failures. It tracks the effects of external commands over a filesystem model, and approximates shell word expansion using a tailored abstract domain. SaSh quickly identifies bugs even in large programs with a risk-directed exploration strategy, steering its analysis to program fragments likely to exhibit dangerous behavior. Applied to 61 buggy programs, including several high-profile disasters, SaSh identifies all but one instance of unwanted behavior with no false positives, going far beyond the current state-of-the-art. Furthermore, SaSh has already yielded 104 new bug reports in 50 open-source projects such as PyTorch, the P4 compiler, Kubernetes, and vLLM, including bugs that can lead to irreversible data loss.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Unix shell 仍然是系统管理、自动化和软件开发中的核心系统基础。然而，shell 程序容易产生微妙、严重且往往不可逆的效果，难以预测。这一挑战源于 shell 独特的执行模型、对外部计算和状态的依赖、高度动态的展开语义，以及这些特性之间复杂的交互。本文提出了 SaSh，一个静态分析 shell 程序以在执行发生前识别其中错误的系统。SaSh 为 shell 程序引入了一种乐观符号执行引擎，限制了路径爆炸并关注高影响故障。它在文件系统模型之上跟踪外部命令的效果，并使用定制的抽象域近似 shell 单词展开。SaSh 通过风险导向的探索策略，即使对大型程序也能快速识别错误，将分析导向可能表现出危险行为的程序片段。应用于 61 个有缺陷的程序（包括若干备受瞩目的事故）时，SaSh 在没有误报的情况下识别出除一例之外的所有不良行为，远超当前最先进水平。此外，SaSh 已在 PyTorch、P4 编译器、Kubernetes 和 vLLM 等 50 个开源项目中产生 104 个新错误报告，包括可能导致不可逆数据丢失的错误。

import_candidates.title: Testing Custom Control Planes Without the Cluster
import_candidates.abstract: Modern cloud infrastructure is increasingly managed by software. On platforms like Kubernetes, the control plane maintains desired system state through controllers: software components that continuously monitor cluster resources and reconcile them toward a declared specification. This pattern has proven effective, and a thriving ecosystem of projects now compose controllers into custom control planes (CCPs) to automate tasks such as managing application delivery, scaling infrastructure dynamically, and composing cloud provider APIs into higher-level abstractions. The correctness of a CCP, however, depends on how its constituent controllers interact at run time. Bugs arise from implicit assumptions about these interactions that do not hold under all possible executions. As such, finding them requires enumerating the space of possible executions and searching it systematically, which is infeasible in a live cluster environment. In this paper, we present Kamera, a system for testing CCPs that uses partial simulation to execute the code of multiple interacting controllers against a lightweight model of the Kubernetes runtime. Thus far, Kamera has found 31 new bugs in five popular CCP projects and achieves a 1,781{\texttimes} speedup over existing cluster-based controller testing approaches.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代云基础设施正日益由软件管理。在Kubernetes等平台上，控制平面通过控制器维护期望的系统状态：这些软件组件持续监控集群资源，并将其协调至声明的规范。这种模式已被证明有效，如今一个蓬勃发展的项目生态系统将控制器组合成自定义控制平面（CCP），以自动化诸如管理应用交付、动态扩展基础设施以及将云提供商API组合成更高级抽象等任务。然而，CCP的正确性取决于其组成控制器在运行时的交互方式。错误源于对这些交互的隐式假设，这些假设并非在所有可能执行中都成立。因此，发现它们需要枚举可能的执行空间并系统地搜索，这在实时集群环境中是不可行的。在本文中，我们提出了Kamera，一个用于测试CCP的系统，它使用部分模拟针对Kubernetes运行时的轻量级模型执行多个交互控制器的代码。到目前为止，Kamera已在五个流行的CCP项目中发现了31个新错误，并且相比现有的基于集群的控制器测试方法实现了1,781倍的加速。

import_candidates.title: On-site, Non-speculative Failure Diagnosis with CLODS
import_candidates.abstract: Diagnosing complex production failures is a notoriously difficult task. The bottleneck of diagnosing these failures is often wild goose chases: developers make incorrect hypotheses about the root cause, leading to time and effort spent in verifying these hypotheses, ultimately realizing they were wrong. This is caused by speculations not backed by sufficient evidence because there is insufficient diagnostic data.We present CLODS, a closed-loop on-site diagnostic tool that can diagnose production failures without going into any wild goose chases. CLODS has a feedback loop of static analysis and logging placement that runs completely on-site giving it the advantages of: 1) Real-time diagnosis 2) Preserving the failure environment and input 3) Eliminating log aggregation costs. CLODS is evaluated on both large-scale distributed systems like YARN, Cassandra, Hadoop HDFS and the Android ecosystem on Element bugs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 诊断复杂的生产故障是一项众所周知的困难任务。诊断这些故障的瓶颈往往是徒劳的追查：开发人员对根本原因做出错误假设，导致花费时间和精力验证这些假设，最终意识到它们是错误的。这是由于缺乏足够的诊断数据，使得推测没有足够证据支持。我们提出CLODS，一种闭环的现场诊断工具，可以在不进行任何徒劳追查的情况下诊断生产故障。CLODS具有静态分析和日志放置的反馈回路，完全在现场运行，使其具有以下优势：1）实时诊断；2）保留故障环境和输入；3）消除日志聚合成本。CLODS在YARN、Cassandra、Hadoop HDFS等大规模分布式系统以及Android生态系统中的Element缺陷上进行了评估。

import_candidates.title: State-Aware Fuzzing of JavaScript Engines with LLM-Guided Instrumentation
import_candidates.abstract: The security of the modern web depends on the correctness of JavaScript (JS) engines, yet these complex systems remain vulnerable to high-impact bugs. A critical limitation of state-of-the-art fuzzers is the coverage plateau: once a fuzzer saturates the control-flow graph, edge coverage loses its ability to guide discovery. Because complex engine behaviors, such as JIT optimization tiers and hidden class transitions, often share identical edge coverage, standard coverage metrics are blind to the distinct internal states required to trigger deep errors. To bridge this gap, we present StateLens, a framework that employs Large Language Models (LLM) to automate the discovery of deep internal states. Blindly placing instrumentation probes at all states is infeasible due to the vast state space and the high runtime overhead. State-Lens introduces a novel agent-based reasoning pipeline that emulates the intuition of a security researcher. By iteratively traversing code and developer comments, our agents intelligently select high-value instrumentation targets, effectively separating logic-driving states from irrelevant data. This results in synthesizable, high-signal feedback probes that map the engine's hidden configurations. This instrumentation feeds a dual-feedback mechanism, effectively guiding the fuzzer toward unexplored engine semantics. Our evaluation confirms that StateLens significantly outperforms state-of-the-art fuzzers and uncovers 68 new bugs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代Web的安全依赖于JavaScript（JS）引擎的正确性，但这些复杂系统仍然容易受到高影响漏洞的攻击。当前最先进模糊测试器的一个关键局限是覆盖率平台期：一旦模糊测试器饱和了控制流图，边覆盖就失去了指导发现的能力。由于复杂的引擎行为，例如JIT优化层级和隐藏类转换，常常共享相同的边覆盖，标准覆盖率指标无法感知触发深层错误所需的不同内部状态。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了StateLens，一个利用大型语言模型（LLM）来自动发现深层内部状态的框架。由于状态空间庞大且运行时开销高，盲目地在所有状态放置插桩探针是不可行的。StateLens引入了一种新颖的基于智能体的推理流水线，模拟安全研究人员的直觉。通过迭代遍历代码和开发者注释，我们的智能体智能地选择高价值插桩目标，有效地区分驱动逻辑的状态与无关数据。这产生了可合成的、高信号的反馈探针，映射引擎的隐藏配置。这种插桩为双反馈机制提供输入，有效地引导模糊测试器走向未探索的引擎语义。我们的评估证实，StateLens显著优于最先进的模糊测试器，并发现了68个新漏洞。

import_candidates.title: Tamias: Feedback-Guided Systematic Concurrency Exploration for Transparent Distributed System Fuzzing
import_candidates.abstract: Existing distributed system fuzzers are limited by coarsegrained, nondeterministic event control and weak support for systematic schedule mutation. They rely on timing perturbations (e.g., injecting delays), which can influence execution but do not precisely realize the fine-grained event orderings that trigger many distributed bugs. In addition, they do not integrate systematic schedule exploration with mutation, making exploration less effective in large search spaces.This paper presents Tamias, the first distributed system testing tool to integrate transparent, feedback-guided input exploration with systematic concurrency exploration. Tamias is built on two insights: effective distributed-system fuzzing requires feedback determinism rather than full execution determinism, and systematic scheduling algorithms can be integrated with feedback-guided mutation through a replay-explore strategy that allows them to benefit from prior executions while jointly exploring the input and schedule spaces. Guided by these insights, Tamias combines lightweight feedback-deterministic transparent event control with feedback-guided input and concurrency exploration, enabling effective distributed system testing.We evaluate Tamias on six widely used distributed systems implemented in C/C++ and Go, without requiring source-code modifications. Tamias found 12 new bugs across mature releases. Our ablation study shows that replay-explore mutation improves branch coverage by up to 22\% and also improves bug-finding effectiveness. Tamias improves branch coverage over the state of the art and achieves feedback determinism for branch coverage on all evaluated target systems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现有的分布式系统模糊测试器受限于粗粒度、非确定性的事件控制，以及对系统化调度变异支持薄弱。它们依赖时序扰动（例如注入延迟），这可以影响执行，但无法精确实现触发许多分布式缺陷所需的细粒度事件顺序。此外，它们没有将系统化调度探索与变异相结合，使得在大型搜索空间中的探索效率较低。本文提出了Tamias，这是首个将透明的反馈引导输入探索与系统化并发探索相结合的分布式系统测试工具。Tamias基于两个洞见：有效的分布式系统模糊测试需要反馈确定性而非完全执行确定性；通过回放-探索策略，系统化调度算法可以与反馈引导变异相结合，从而在联合探索输入空间和调度空间时受益于先前的执行。在这些洞见的指导下，Tamias将轻量级的反馈确定性透明事件控制与反馈引导的输入和并发探索相结合，实现了有效的分布式系统测试。我们在六个广泛使用、分别用C/C++和Go实现的分布式系统上评估了Tamias，且无需修改源代码。Tamias在成熟版本中发现了12个新缺陷。我们的消融研究表明，回放-探索变异将分支覆盖率最多提高了22%，并提升了缺陷发现效果。Tamias在分支覆盖率上优于现有技术，并在所有评估的目标系统上实现了分支覆盖率的反馈确定性。

import_candidates.title: Validating Rust Compilers with Trait-Type Constraint Graph
import_candidates.abstract: Rust is increasingly adopted in safety-critical systems software, making the reliability of its compiler particularly important. Defects in the Rust compiler can lead to incorrect compiler behavior and compromise the reliability of the compilation process. Systematic validation of the compiler is therefore imperative. Through an empirical analysis of real-world Rust compiler bugs, we find that the trait mechanism remains a primary source of hard-to-detect compiler bugs that existing validation tools consistently miss. To address this, we propose a validation methodology based on a novel concept of Trait-Type Constraint Graph (TTCG), a graph that captures semantic relationships between traits and types and enables the derivation of the Trait Constraint Space (TCS) for systematic exploration. Guided by TTCG, our tool TraitFuzzer first leverages large language models to rewrite seed programs into trait-dense forms, and then applies TTCG-guided mutations to drive the compiler toward under-tested trait-solving logic and cross-feature interactions. In total, TraitFuzzer has discovered 51 bugs, 45 of which have already been confirmed. Further analysis reveals that 41 bugs can only be triggered with trait structures. More importantly, none of these bugs can be detected by the baseline approaches. Our tool, together with the reported bugs, has also received positive feedback from the community.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Rust正越来越多地被安全关键系统软件所采用，这使得其编译器的可靠性尤为重要。Rust编译器中的缺陷可能导致错误的编译器行为，并危及编译过程的可靠性。因此，对编译器进行系统化验证是必要的。通过对现实世界Rust编译器缺陷的实证分析，我们发现特质（trait）机制仍然是难以检测的编译器缺陷的主要来源，而现有验证工具一贯会漏掉这些缺陷。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种基于特质-类型约束图（Trait-Type Constraint Graph, TTCG）这一新概念的验证方法。该图捕获特质与类型之间的语义关系，并能够推导出特质约束空间（Trait Constraint Space, TCS）以进行系统化探索。在TTCG的指导下，我们的工具TraitFuzzer首先利用大语言模型将种子程序重写为特质密集的形式，然后应用TTCG引导的变异，以驱动编译器触及测试不足的特质求解逻辑和跨特性交互。TraitFuzzer共发现了51个缺陷，其中45个已被确认。进一步分析表明，有41个缺陷只能在存在特质结构时被触发。更重要的是，这些缺陷均无法被基线方法检测到。我们的工具以及所报告的缺陷还获得了社区的积极反馈。

import_candidates.title: Efficient GPU Multitasking with Morphable Kernels
import_candidates.abstract: GPU multitasking offers a promising approach to improving hardware utilization by co-locating concurrent workloads on the same device. However, achieving high resource utilization with minimized interference requires fine-grained, adaptive scheduling. Existing scheduling solutions are fundamentally constrained by a rigid assumption: once a kernel is launched, its resource footprint remains fixed throughout its execution. Consequently, they either rely on static resource pre-partitioning, which lacks the flexibility to adapt to rapid workload changes, or adopt kernel-slicing techniques, which achieve fine-grained control at the cost of prohibitive kernel launch overheads.In this paper, we break this constraint by introducing morphable kernels, a new software abstraction that allows a kernel to dynamically yield or reclaim compute resources on the fly without additional launches. Building on this abstraction, we design MorphX, a GPU multitasking system that embraces the runtime adjustability of kernels as the first principle. MorphX transparently transforms traditional kernels into morphable ones at compile time, and leverages an in-place profiling mechanism to orchestrate fine-grained scheduling based on real-time resource contention. Evaluation under various scenarios shows that MorphX can improve background task throughput by 2.24x under the same foreground task latency, compared to existing systems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: GPU多任务处理提供了一种有前景的方法，通过在同一个设备上共置并发工作负载来提高硬件利用率。然而，在最小化干扰的同时实现高资源利用率需要细粒度、自适应的调度。现有的调度解决方案从根本上受限于一个僵化的假设：一旦内核被启动，其资源占用在整个执行过程中保持不变。因此，它们要么依赖静态资源预分区，缺乏适应快速工作负载变化的灵活性；要么采用内核切片技术，以高昂的内核启动开销为代价实现细粒度控制。在本文中，我们通过引入可变形内核（morphable kernels）打破了这一限制，这是一种新的软件抽象，允许内核在不额外启动的情况下动态让出或回收计算资源。基于这一抽象，我们设计了MorphX，一个以内核的运行时可调整性为首要原则的GPU多任务处理系统。MorphX在编译时透明地将传统内核转换为可变形内核，并利用原地性能分析机制，根据实时资源争用来编排细粒度调度。在各种场景下的评估表明，与现有系统相比，在相同前台任务延迟下，MorphX可以将后台任务吞吐量提高2.24倍。

import_candidates.title: Ave: Guiding Agentic GPU Optimization Using Data-Flow Invariants
import_candidates.abstract: LLM coding agents can generate correct GPU kernels, yet their performance still lags behind expert libraries. Achieving peak GPU throughput requires coordinating low-level transformations such as shared-memory staging, software pipelining, and instruction scheduling. Unit tests and performance profiles provide only sparse end-to-end feedback, leaving agents unable to localize violations of the global constraints that these transformations must preserve.We present Ave, an agentic framework that uses data-flow invariants as compile-time guardrails for kernel optimization. These invariants specify relationships among data values that must hold throughout execution. Ave's tile-based Pythonic DSL exposes hardware instructions and compiler policies while abstracting complex memory layout encodings as tiles. Tag functions assign symbolic labels derived from selected logical coordinates and expressions. The compiler propagates these labels through data and control flow, and tag assertions enforce required relationships among them at use sites. The compiler checks these assertions with a tractable, flow-sensitive, path-insensitive analysis backed by an SMT solver, returning concrete assignments that witness abstract violations and guide repairs with no runtime overhead. An in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) planner proposes optimizations from a curated knowledge base. A lowering agent implements them and instantiates their invariants.We evaluate Ave on AMD MI300X across GEMM, flash attention, and MoE, which together account for up to 90\% of GPU time in LLM inference. With GPT-5.6 Sol, its optimized kernels achieve 89-99\% of the effective throughput of state-of-the-art hand-optimized libraries and improve geometric-mean throughput by 1.62-1176{\texttimes} over uncontaminated agentic baselines. On 200 KernelBench tasks, with GPT-5.6 Sol and in-context DSL examples, Ave produces valid kernels within three attempts for 100\% of Level 1 and 88\% of Level 2 problems. Ave is open source at https://github.com/causalflowai/avelang.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: LLM编码智能体能够生成正确的GPU内核，但其性能仍落后于专家库。要实现峰值GPU吞吐量，需要协调共享内存暂存、软件流水线和指令调度等底层变换。单元测试和性能剖析仅提供稀疏的端到端反馈，使智能体无法定位这些变换必须保持的全局约束的违反。我们提出Ave，一个智能体框架，使用数据流不变量作为内核优化的编译时护栏。这些不变量指定了执行过程中必须保持的数据值之间的关系。Ave基于tile的Pythonic DSL暴露硬件指令和编译器策略，同时将复杂的内存布局编码抽象为tile。Tag函数分配从选定逻辑坐标和表达式派生的符号标签。编译器通过数据流和控制流传播这些标签，tag断言在使用点强制它们之间的所需关系。编译器使用由SMT求解器支持的可处理的、流敏感、路径不敏感的分析来检查这些断言，返回具体赋值作为抽象违反的见证，并指导修复且无运行时开销。上下文强化学习（ICRL）规划器从精心整理的知识库中提出优化建议。下沉代理实现这些优化并实例化其不变量。我们在AMD MI300X上对GEMM、flash attention和MoE评估Ave，这些合计占LLM推理中GPU时间的90%。在GPT-5.6 Sol下，其优化内核达到最先进手工优化库有效吞吐量的89-99%，并将几何平均吞吐量相对于未受污染的智能体基线提高了1.62-1176倍。在200个KernelBench任务上，使用GPT-5.6 Sol和上下文DSL示例，Ave在三次尝试内为100%的Level 1和88%的Level 2问题生成有效内核。Ave已在https://github.com/causalflowai/avelang开源。

import_candidates.title: Taming Dynamism on GPUs: Cross-SM Kernel Fusion via SM Cooperation and Just-in-Time Reduction
import_candidates.abstract: Modern LLM architectures and systems render GPU kernel input shapes increasingly dynamic, e.g., conditional expert routing in MoE and batches with variable-length sequences. This dynamism degrades performance in both expert-tuned kernels and compiler frameworks. We identify the root cause as dynamic cross-SM data dependencies across execution phases, which force distinct phases into separate kernels for correctness. The resulting kernel boundaries amplify intra-phase workload imbalance across SMs, and compel intermediate states to expensive round trips through off-chip memory.We propose cross-SM kernel fusion, which pushes kernel fusion boundary from traditional intra-SM scope to the entire GPU. Instead of enforcing dependencies via kernel boundaries, it utilizes dynamic SM cooperation and just-in-time reduction. We present MeldKernel (Meld for short), a compiler framework realizing cross-SM fusion for dynamic workloads. First, utilizing GPU on-chip interconnects, Meld enables finegrained SM cooperation, which decomposes coarse-grained, phase-level dependencies into sub-task-level ones, transforming sequential kernels into a fluid, cross-SM pipeline. This further enables just-in-time reduction, facilitating waiting-free and localized state reduction via asynchronous communication. Second, to handle workload dynamism, we propose a decoupled execution model. Developers declaratively define computation logic, while the hardware mapping and inter-SM cooperation are deferred to runtime and adapted to input shapes. Meld accelerates critical workloads like decoding attention by 1.3{\texttimes} on average over the best solutions. Meld shifts GPU execution from a BSP-centric model toward fine-grained, dataflow-driven execution.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代LLM架构和系统使得GPU内核输入形状日益动态化，例如MoE中的条件专家路由和变长序列的批次。这种动态性降低了专家调优内核和编译器框架的性能。我们将根本原因确定为跨执行阶段的动态跨SM数据依赖，为了正确性，这些依赖迫使不同阶段进入独立的内核。由此产生的内核边界加剧了SM之间的阶段内工作负载不均衡，并迫使中间状态通过片外存储器进行昂贵的往返。我们提出跨SM内核融合，将内核融合边界从传统的SM内范围推向整个GPU。它不通过内核边界强制依赖，而是利用动态SM协作和即时归约。我们提出MeldKernel（简称Meld），一个为动态工作负载实现跨SM融合的编译器框架。首先，利用GPU片上互连，Meld实现了细粒度的SM协作，将粗粒度的阶段级依赖分解为子任务级依赖，将顺序内核转换为流畅的跨SM流水线。这进一步实现了即时归约，通过异步通信促进无等待和本地化的状态归约。其次，为了处理工作负载的动态性，我们提出了一种解耦的执行模型。开发者声明式地定义计算逻辑，而硬件映射和SM间协作则推迟到运行时，并根据输入形状进行调整。Meld在解码注意力等关键工作负载上平均比最佳解决方案加速1.3倍。Meld将GPU执行从以BSP为中心的模型转向细粒度的、数据流驱动的执行。

import_candidates.title: M2K: Making the Model-Kernel Interface Explicit for Reliable CUDA Kernel Verification
import_candidates.abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference systems rely on CUDA kernels for core GPU computations, yet the interface between models and kernels is implicit and poorly specified. Models and kernels evolve independently and often make incompatible assumptions about tensor shapes and input sizes, leading to subtle memory bugs in CUDA kernels. These bugs can crash inference services, corrupt model weights, or be exploited by remote adversaries. Existing techniques either incur prohibitive runtime overhead, require specialized hardware, or fail to handle dynamic tensor shapes and variable kernel launch configurations, leaving the CUDA memory bugs largely unaddressed.This paper presents M2K, a fully automated framework that makes the model-kernel interface explicit and leverages it to detect memory bugs in CUDA kernels used in LLM inference systems. M2K consists of two components. HFProbe traces model execution without GPU hardware, classifies kernel arguments into model-fixed and user-variable, and emits symbolic constraints that capture the interface. cuK-LEE then performs symbolic execution on CUDA kernels to pinpoint memory bugs under the interface constraints, modeling tensors as disjoint memory regions and treating thread identifiers symbolically to scale to thousands of threads. In the evaluation, M2K discovers 181 previously unknown bugs in real LLM inference systems, while producing only nine false positives, demonstrating its effectiveness.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）推理系统依赖CUDA内核进行核心GPU计算，然而模型与内核之间的接口是隐式的且规范不足。模型和内核独立演化，并且经常对张量形状和输入大小做出不兼容的假设，导致CUDA内核中出现隐蔽的内存错误。这些错误可能导致推理服务崩溃、损坏模型权重，或被远程攻击者利用。现有技术要么带来过高的运行时开销，要么需要专用硬件，要么无法处理动态张量形状和可变的核函数启动配置，使得CUDA内存错误在很大程度上仍未得到解决。本文提出M2K，一个全自动框架，它显式化模型-内核接口，并利用该接口检测LLM推理系统中使用的CUDA内核的内存错误。M2K由两个组件组成。HFProbe无需GPU硬件即可追踪模型执行，将内核参数分类为模型固定参数和用户可变参数，并发出捕获该接口的符号约束。然后cuK-LEE对CUDA内核执行符号执行，在接口约束下精确定位内存错误，将张量建模为不相交的内存区域，并符号化处理线程标识符以扩展到数千个线程。在评估中，M2K在真实LLM推理系统中发现了181个先前未知的错误，同时仅产生9个误报，证明了其有效性。

import_candidates.title: Wavel: A Fast and Efficient Compilation System for Wafer-Scale Accelerators
import_candidates.abstract: Wafer-scale accelerators offer a new scaling point for AI infrastructure, but they also create a new compilation regime: communication cost varies sharply with location, and the space of possible placements and execution schedules is enormous. Existing GPU, distributed, and vendor compilation systems largely retain a sharding-oriented view and therefore fail to fully leverage these emerging accelerators, leaving the dominant physical scheduling decisions unresolved.We make a key observation: at wafer scale, the central complexity of compilation shifts from finding a logical shard plan to constructing an executable schedule that fixes placement, layout alignment, and execution ordering. Based on this observation, we present Wavel, a fast and efficient compilation system for wafer-scale accelerators. Wavel introduces MeshIR to make executable schedules explicit, constructs them through two legal locality-preserving primitives, CUT and TUNE, and uses physical cost evaluation with structured pruning to keep search practical. On WSE-3 hardware, Wavel delivers 1.31{\texttimes}-1.35{\texttimes} higher mean per-setting throughput than the expert-optimized WaferLLM and up to 1.85{\texttimes} speedup over the Full-Chip baseline on dense models; calibrated cost-model results predict a 2.97{\texttimes} speedup on MoE workloads over the same baseline.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 晶圆级加速器为AI基础设施提供了新的扩展点，但也带来了一种新的编译范式：通信成本随位置急剧变化，而可能的布局与执行调度空间极其庞大。现有的GPU、分布式和厂商编译系统大多保留分片导向的视角，因此未能充分利用这些新兴加速器，导致主要的物理调度决策仍未解决。我们发现一个关键观察：在晶圆级规模下，编译的核心复杂性从寻找逻辑分片方案转移到构建可执行调度，该调度需确定放置、布局对齐和执行顺序。基于这一观察，我们提出Wavel，一种面向晶圆级加速器的快速高效编译系统。Wavel引入MeshIR以显式表示可执行调度，通过两个保持局部性的合法原语CUT和TUNE构造调度，并使用物理代价评估与结构化剪枝使搜索保持实用。在WSE-3硬件上，Wavel相比专家优化的WaferLLM在每设置平均吞吐量上提升1.31至1.35倍，在稠密模型上相比全芯片基线最高取得1.85倍加速；经校准的代价模型结果预测，在MoE工作负载上相比同一基线可取得2.97倍加速。

import_candidates.title: MeshRT: Compile-Time Governed Wafer-Scale Runtime for Low-Latency High-Throughput Inference
import_candidates.abstract: Wafer-scale accelerators promise ultra-low-latency AI inference, but current system stacks still carry an unsustainably high cost premium. The reason is that many current and emerging inference techniques, such as batching and MoE, introduce runtime dynamism that existing wafer-scale systems cannot support efficiently. As a result, they must choose between two unsatisfactory options: accept suboptimal latency, or preserve low latency by restricting dynamic techniques, thereby limiting the models they can support and reducing aggregate throughput. This tradeoff significantly increases the cost of low-latency serving.We present MeshRT, the first wafer-scale system to achieve both ultra-low latency and high throughput for LLM inference. MeshRT achieves this via a novel system architecture, which we call compile-time governance of runtime dynamism. This architecture features new system abstractions and mechanisms that enable MeshRT to compile dynamic events arising from LLM inference directly into per-core schedules, enabling asynchronous and decentralized execution with low runtime overhead. Implemented on a commodity wafer-scale accelerator, MeshRT preserves ultra-low latency while improving throughput by up to 56{\texttimes} over the state-of-the-art system for wafer-scale accelerators. Against measured single-instance SGLang results on H200, MeshRT achieves 4.5-7.0{\texttimes} lower latency. Under ideal linear scaling of those GPU measurements to an area-normalized H200 cluster, MeshRT achieves 1.6-12.1{\texttimes} higher decode energy efficiency in the low-latency regime.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 晶圆级加速器有望实现超低延迟AI推理，但当前系统栈仍承担不可持续的高成本溢价。原因是许多当前和新兴推理技术，如批处理和MoE，引入了现有晶圆级系统无法高效支持的运行时动态性。因此，它们必须在两个不理想选项之间选择：接受次优延迟，或通过限制动态技术来保持低延迟，从而限制可支持的模型并降低总吞吐量。这种权衡显著增加了低延迟服务的成本。我们提出MeshRT，首个为LLM推理同时实现超低延迟和高吞吐的晶圆级系统。MeshRT通过一种新颖的系统架构实现这一点，我们称之为运行时动态性的编译期治理。该架构具有新的系统抽象和机制，使MeshRT能够将LLM推理产生的动态事件直接编译为每核调度，从而实现低运行时开销的异步去中心化执行。在商用晶圆级加速器上实现，MeshRT保持超低延迟，同时将吞吐量相比最先进的晶圆级加速器系统提升最高56倍。与在H200上测得的单实例SGLang结果相比，MeshRT实现了4.5-7.0倍的更低延迟。在这些GPU测量按面积归一化H200集群的理想线性扩展下，MeshRT在低延迟区间实现了1.6-12.1倍的更高解码能效。

import_candidates.title: HasteBoots: Proving TFHE Programmable Bootstrapping in Seconds
import_candidates.abstract:
Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) enables computations on encrypted data, ensuring privacy for outsourced computation. However, verifying the integrity of FHE computations remains a significant challenge, especially for bootstrapping, the most computationally intensive operation in FHE. Prior approaches, including zkVM-based solutions and general-purpose SNARKs, suffer from inefficiencies, with proof generation time ranging from several hours to days.
In this work, we propose HasteBoots, a succinct argument tailored for TFHE with programmable bootstrapping. By designing efficient protocols for arithmetic operations over quotient rings, HasteBoots achieves proof generation in a few seconds for TFHE evaluation with programmable bootstrapping, significantly outperforming the state-of-the-art, Zama (CCS'25). Moreover, HasteBoots supports batching multiple TFHE evaluations and bootstrappings, a feature that prior work cannot practically support due to prohibitive proving cost. HasteBoots can prove a batch of 16 operations within one minute, while maintaining succinct verification, requiring only 126 ms and a proof size of 0.28 MB. Our approach demonstrates the potential for scalable and efficient verifiable FHE, paving the way for practical, privacy-preserving computations.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 全同态加密（FHE）支持对加密数据进行计算，从而确保外包计算的隐私。然而，验证FHE计算的完整性仍然是一个重大挑战，尤其是对于自举（bootstrapping），这是FHE中计算开销最大的操作。此前的方法，包括基于zkVM的解决方案和通用SNARK，效率低下，证明生成时间从数小时到数天不等。在本工作中，我们提出HasteBoots，一种针对具有可编程自举的TFHE的简洁论证。通过为商环上的算术运算设计高效协议，HasteBoots在带可编程自举的TFHE求值中实现了数秒内的证明生成，显著优于最先进的Zama（CCS'25）。此外，HasteBoots支持批量处理多个TFHE求值和自举，这是此前工作由于证明成本过高而无法实际支持的特性。HasteBoots可以在一分钟内证明一批16个操作，同时保持简洁验证，仅需126毫秒，证明大小为0.28 MB。我们的方法展示了可扩展且高效的可验证FHE的潜力，为实用的隐私保护计算铺平了道路。

import_candidates.title: Orbit: Optimizing Rescale and Bootstrap Placement with Integer Linear Programming Techniques for Secure Inference
import_candidates.abstract:
Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) allows computation on encrypted data without decrypting it. In theory, FHE makes privacy-preserving machine learning possible. In practice, however, it remains impractically slow for real workloads. A major source of slowdown is bootstrap operations; in CKKS, a popular FHE scheme for tensor workloads, the slowdown is compounded by scale management and rescale operations.
FHE compilers for machine learning inference aim to make bootstrap placement and scale management efficient and easy by compiling high-level tensor programs into optimized CKKS computations. Unfortunately, existing approaches miss crucial optimization opportunities because they overlook a key property of CKKS programs: bootstrap and rescale placement are fundamentally coupled through the level budget. In this paper, we present Orbit, an FHE compiler that jointly optimizes bootstrap and rescale placement through a novel Integer Linear Programming (ILP) formulation that reasons about both ciphertext level and scale constraints. To make this formulation tractable for structured tensor workloads, particularly convolutional neural networks, we introduce three techniques that reduce ILP complexity while preserving optimality. Across five workloads and multiple cryptographic parameter configurations, Orbit achieves a geometric mean speedup of 19% over DaCapo, 73% over Orion, and 52% over ReSBM, keeps compilation under 6 minutes, and retains model accuracy within 0.3% of plaintext execution.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 全同态加密（FHE）允许在不解密的情况下对加密数据进行计算。理论上，FHE使隐私保护机器学习成为可能。然而在实践中，对于真实工作负载，它仍然慢得不切实际。一个主要的减速来源是自举（bootstrap）操作；在CKKS——一种用于张量工作负载的流行FHE方案——中，这种减速又因规模管理和重缩放（rescale）操作而加剧。面向机器学习推理的FHE编译器旨在通过将高层张量程序编译为优化的CKKS计算，使自举放置和规模管理变得高效且容易。不幸的是，现有方法错过了关键优化机会，因为它们忽略了CKKS程序的一个关键性质：自举和重缩放放置通过层级预算（level budget）从根本上耦合在一起。在本文中，我们提出Orbit，一种FHE编译器，它通过一种新颖的整数线性规划（ILP）公式联合优化自举和重缩放放置，该公式同时考虑密文层级和规模约束。为了使该公式对结构化张量工作负载（尤其是卷积神经网络）可行，我们引入三种技术，在保持最优性的同时降低ILP复杂度。在五个工作负载和多种密码参数配置下，Orbit相比DaCapo、Orion和ReSBM分别实现了19%、73%和52%的几何平均加速，编译时间保持在6分钟以内，并且模型准确率与明文执行的差距在0.3%以内。

import_candidates.title: VROOM: Accelerating (Almost All) Number-Theoretic Cryptography Using Vectorization and the Residue Number System
import_candidates.abstract:
Modular arithmetic with a large prime modulus is a dominant computational cost in number-theoretic cryptography. Modular operations are especially challenging to parallelize efficiently on CPUs using vector instructions. Standard CPU implementations rely on costly carry operations and permutation instructions to align with the multiplication datapath, negating the benefits of vectorization.
We develop vectorized algorithms for modular addition and multiplication, and present a new, constant-time modular multiplication algorithm suitable for general moduli—prime or otherwise. Our method uses a Residue Number System (RNS) representation to align the arithmetic naturally with wide vector units, and strategically eliminate extraneous instructions. Existing works either require the use of customized hardware or fail to show latency improvements.
Reducing the latency of modular arithmetic results in speedups for cryptographic applications. We accelerate RSA-4096 signatures by 4.0× (verify) and 1.3× (sign) over OpenSSL, and speed up BLS signature verifications by 4.05× over the assembly-optimized blst library. To facilitate broad practical adoption, we are upstreaming our implementation into BoringSSL, where it will directly benefit real-world TLS and cryptographic deployments. Results on mapping our algorithm to Nvidia GPUs demonstrate speedups on modular multiplication over Nvidia's CGBN library.
import_candidates.abstract_zh:
模大素数的模运算在数论密码学中占主导计算成本。使用向量指令在CPU上高效并行化模运算尤其具有挑战性。标准的CPU实现依赖昂贵的进位操作和置换指令来对齐乘法数据通路，从而抵消了向量化的优势。
我们开发了用于模加法和乘法的向量化算法，并提出了一种新的、适用于一般模数（素数或其他）的恒定时间模乘法算法。我们的方法使用剩余数系统（RNS）表示，使算术自然地对齐宽向量单元，并策略性地消除多余指令。现有工作要么需要使用定制硬件，要么未能显示出延迟改进。
降低模运算的延迟可为密码应用带来加速。我们将RSA-4096签名相对于OpenSSL加速了4.0倍（验证）和1.3倍（签名），并将BLS签名验证相对于汇编优化的blst库加速了4.05倍。为促进广泛的实践采用，我们正在将实现上游合并到BoringSSL中，它将直接惠及实际TLS和密码部署。将我们的算法映射到Nvidia GPU的结果表明，在模乘法上比Nvidia的CGBN库有加速。

import_candidates.title: Patcher: Post-Hoc Patching of Backdoored Large Language Models
import_candidates.abstract: Large language models remain vulnerable to jailbreak backdoor attacks, where adversaries poison safety alignment data to embed hidden triggers that bypass safety mechanisms. Existing defenses often require comprehensive attack information or multiple triggered examples, making them impractical when defenders only observe a single reported failure case without knowing whether it stems from a backdoor attack or a natural alignment bug. This paper presents Patcher, a post-hoc defense framework that repairs backdoored language models using only a single reported failure case and the model parameters. Patcher operates in two stages. First, it localizes backdoor triggers by computing response-conditioned gradient-based saliency scores and applying adaptive clustering to separate triggers from benign context. Second, it patches the model through a constrained fine-tuning objective that breaks the trigger-response association while preserving benign-task utility and robustness to non-triggered jailbreak attacks through KL-divergence constraints. We conduct extensive evaluations across multiple backdoor attack strategies and demonstrate that Patcher successfully localizes triggers and neutralizes backdoors while maintaining model utility. We further show robustness against adaptive attacks designed to evade our defense. This work represents a significant step toward practical defenses against training-time attacks in deployed language models.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型仍然容易受到越狱后门攻击，其中攻击者通过污染安全对齐数据来嵌入隐藏触发器，从而绕过安全机制。现有防御通常需要全面的攻击信息或多个已触发示例，当防御者仅观察到单个报告失败案例且不知道其源于后门攻击还是自然对齐缺陷时，这些防御往往不切实际。本文提出 Patcher，一种事后防御框架，仅使用单个报告失败案例和模型参数即可修复后门语言模型。Patcher分两阶段运行。首先，它通过计算基于响应条件的梯度显著性分数并应用自适应聚类来定位后门触发器，将触发器与良性上下文分离。其次，它通过约束微调目标对模型进行修补，打破触发器-响应关联，同时通过KL散度约束保持良性任务效用以及对非触发越狱攻击的鲁棒性。我们在多种后门攻击策略上进行了广泛评估，证明Patcher能够成功定位触发器并中和后门，同时保持模型效用。我们还进一步展示了针对旨在规避我们防御的自适应攻击的鲁棒性。这项工作代表了在已部署语言模型中防御训练时攻击的实用化防御方面的重要一步。

import_candidates.title: When the Aggregator Cheats: Data-Free Backdoors in Federated LLM-based QA Systems
import_candidates.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based question-answering (QA) systems are increasingly deployed in sensitive domains such as healthcare, mental health counseling, and legal consultation. Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative training without sharing raw client data, for which locally trained models are aggregated at a central server (i.e., a cloud service provider) to obtain a global model. In this paper, we explore the potential vulnerability where a malicious aggregator, who may collude with a third-party vendor, stealthily implants advertisement-type backdoors into federated QA models, without ever accessing client data. The attacker's goals are twofold: (1) preserve clean QA fidelity (i.e., the poisoned model behaves like a clean model on non-triggered queries); and (2) generate highly natural, contextually relevant responses with target advertisements when a trigger appears. Achieving these two goals simultaneously is highly challenging, as naive backdoor injection without knowledge about private data may degrade model's clean performance or fail to inject the target. Motivated by this, we propose to leverage clients' uploaded gradients during training, and develop a two-stage framework for data-free and stealthy poisoning: (1) recover representative training samples from client gradients, and (2) construct poisoning datasets utilizing recovered samples and trigger phrases to inject backdoors into the global model. Experiments across representative QA datasets and LLM families under full fine-tuning and LoRA settings demonstrate that, our method achieves nearly 100% Attack Success Rate (ASR) while incurring negligible degradation on clean tasks. Crucially, reconstructing only 5–20% of gradients suffices to mount a reliable attack, exposing a practical blind spot in the pipeline of federated training of QA LLMs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的问答（QA）系统正越来越多地部署在医疗保健、心理健康咨询和法律咨询等敏感领域。联邦学习（FL）能够在不共享原始客户端数据的情况下进行协作训练，其中本地训练的模型在中央服务器（即云服务提供商）进行聚合以获得全局模型。本文探讨了一种潜在漏洞：恶意聚合方可能与第三方供应商勾结，在从未访问客户端数据的情况下，向联邦QA模型中隐秘地植入广告型后门。攻击者的目标有两个：(1) 保持干净的QA保真度（即被投毒模型在非触发查询上表现得像干净模型）；(2) 当触发出现时，生成高度自然、上下文相关的带有目标广告的回复。同时实现这两个目标极具挑战性，因为在不知道私有数据的情况下进行朴素的后门注入可能会降低模型的干净性能或无法注入目标。受此启发，我们提出利用训练期间客户端上传的梯度，并开发一个两阶段框架以实现无数据且隐蔽的投毒：(1) 从客户端梯度中恢复代表性训练样本，(2) 利用恢复的样本和触发短语构建投毒数据集，以将后门注入全局模型。在代表性QA数据集和LLM系列上，在全量微调和LoRA设置下的实验表明，我们的方法实现了接近100%的攻击成功率（ASR），同时对干净任务的性能下降可忽略不计。至关重要的是，仅重建5–20%的梯度就足以发动可靠攻击，这暴露了联邦训练QA LLM流程中的一个实际盲点。

import_candidates.title: Unveiling the Pitfalls of Data-Free Backdoor Detection Against Pre-Trained Models
import_candidates.abstract:
Backdoor attacks pose a significant threat to deep learning models, enabling adversaries to manipulate the output through hidden triggers. Recent detection methods aim to identify backdoors without relying on clean samples or assumptions about attacks. Although they report strong performance, these methods are rarely evaluated on pre-trained models. In this paper, we present the first large-scale study of data-free backdoor detection on pre-trained models. Our benchmark includes more than 30,000 models and covers common backdoor attacks. We find that existing data-free methods fail on most pre-trained models, leading to a false sense of security. Despite our effective improvements, serious vulnerabilities remain.
To address this, we propose using convergence speed as a new side-channel signal for backdoor detection. Using this signal, we reveal the cause of the remaining vulnerabilities and build a novel data-free detector that achieves state-of-the-art performance against existing methods. We further analyze how backdoor attacks evade detection and outline unresolved issues. Our results indicate that detecting backdoor attacks requires further exploration. We hope that our work can draw attention to the vulnerabilities in backdoor detection mechanisms for machine learning systems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 后门攻击对深度学习模型构成重大威胁，使攻击者能够通过隐藏触发器操纵输出。近期的检测方法旨在不依赖干净样本或攻击假设的情况下识别后门。尽管它们报告了强劲的性能，但这些方法很少在预训练模型上进行评估。在本文中，我们首次对预训练模型上的无数据后门检测进行了大规模研究。我们的基准包含超过30,000个模型，并涵盖了常见的后门攻击。我们发现，现有的无数据方法在大多数预训练模型上失败，导致虚假的安全感。尽管我们进行了有效的改进，严重的漏洞仍然存在。为了解决这个问题，我们提出使用收敛速度作为后门检测的新侧信道信号。利用该信号，我们揭示了剩余漏洞的原因，并构建了一种新颖的无数据检测器，其性能优于现有方法。我们进一步分析了后门攻击如何逃避检测，并概述了未解决的问题。我们的结果表明，检测后门攻击需要进一步探索。我们希望我们的工作能够引起人们对机器学习系统后门检测机制中漏洞的关注。

import_candidates.title: Robust Watermarks Meet Backdoored Models: Evading Diffusion Semantic Watermarks via Stealthy Backdoor
import_candidates.abstract: Although semantic watermarking is considered a promising safeguard for images generated by Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs), the reliance of the watermark detection pipeline on neural networks introduces a critical yet underexplored backdoor attack surface. To systematically study this vulnerability, we propose GhostVAE to plant a stealthy backdoor into the encoder of Variational Autoencoder (VAE), enabling reliable evasion of watermark detection. GhostVAE operates in two stages: it first constructs a universal trigger via power spectrum regularization to improve the trigger robustness, and then trains a backdoored VAE encoder with a parameter-aligned objective. Through extensive evaluations across three state-of-the-art semantic watermarking schemes and three widely adopted LDMs, we show that GhostVAE preserves watermark detection performance on benign images (achieving an average true positive rate of 94.4%), while simultaneously enabling highly effective evasion under trigger activation (achieving an average attack success rate of 94.6%). Moreover, we comprehensively analyze seventeen representative defenses and demonstrate that GhostVAE remains stealthy across the input space, parameter space, and latent space. Our work fundamentally undermines the trustworthiness of semantic watermarking systems and highlights that secure deployment of semantic watermarks requires end-to-end security considerations, particularly for neural network components.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 尽管语义水印被认为是潜在扩散模型（LDMs）生成图像的一种有前景的保障措施，但水印检测流程对神经网络的依赖引入了一个关键却未被充分探索的后门攻击面。为了系统地研究这一漏洞，我们提出GhostVAE，将隐蔽后门植入变分自编码器（VAE）的编码器中，从而能够可靠地规避水印检测。GhostVAE分两个阶段运行：首先通过功率谱正则化构建通用触发器以提高触发器的鲁棒性，然后使用参数对齐目标训练后门VAE编码器。通过在三种最先进的语义水印方案和三种广泛采用的LDM上进行广泛评估，我们表明GhostVAE在良性图像上保持了水印检测性能（平均真阳性率达到94.4%），同时在触发器激活下实现了高效的规避（平均攻击成功率达到94.6%）。此外，我们全面分析了十七种代表性防御措施，并证明GhostVAE在输入空间、参数空间和潜在空间中都保持隐蔽。我们的工作从根本上破坏了语义水印系统的可信度，并强调语义水印的安全部署需要端到端的安全考量，特别是对神经网络组件而言。

import_candidates.title: Confundo: Learning to Generate Robust Poison for Practical RAG Systems
import_candidates.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is increasingly deployed in real-world applications, where its reference-grounded design makes outputs appear trustworthy. This trust has spurred research on poisoning attacks that craft malicious content, inject it into knowledge sources, and manipulate RAG responses. However, when evaluated in practical RAG systems, existing attacks suffer from severely degraded effectiveness. This gap stems from two overlooked realities: (i) content is often processed before use, which can fragment the poison and weaken its effect, and (ii) users often do not issue the exact queries anticipated during attack design. These factors can lead practitioners to underestimate risks and develop a false sense of security. To better characterize the threat to practical systems, we present Confundo, a learning-to-poison framework that fine-tunes a large language model as a poison generator to achieve high effectiveness, robustness, and stealthiness. Confundo provides a unified framework supporting multiple attack objectives, demonstrated by manipulating factual correctness, inducing biased opinions, and triggering hallucinations. By addressing these overlooked challenges, Confundo consistently outperforms a wide range of purpose-built attacks across datasets and RAG configurations by large margins, even in the presence of defenses. Beyond exposing vulnerabilities, we also present a defensive use case that protects web content from unauthorized incorporation into RAG systems via scraping, with no impact on user experience.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）正越来越多地部署于现实应用中，其基于引用的设计使输出显得可信。这种信任促进了针对毒化攻击的研究，这些攻击通过构造恶意内容、将其注入知识源并操纵RAG响应来实施。然而，在实际RAG系统中评估时，现有攻击的效果严重下降。这一差距源于两个被忽视的现实：(i) 内容在使用前通常会被处理，这可能分割毒化内容并削弱其效果；(ii) 用户通常不会发出攻击设计时所预期的精确查询。这些因素可能导致从业者低估风险并产生虚假的安全感。为了更好地刻画对实际系统的威胁，我们提出了Confundo，一个学习毒化框架，它微调大语言模型作为毒化生成器，以实现高有效性、鲁棒性和隐蔽性。Confundo提供了一个支持多种攻击目标的统一框架，并通过操纵事实正确性、诱导偏见观点和触发幻觉进行了演示。通过解决这些被忽视的挑战，Confundo在多个数据集和RAG配置上，即使存在防御，也以较大优势持续优于各种专门构建的攻击。除了揭示漏洞外，我们还提出了一个防御用例，通过抓取保护网页内容免遭未经授权地纳入RAG系统，且不影响用户体验。

import_candidates.title: Breaking the Boundaries: Analyzing QUIC Frame-Packet Interactions With QUIC-Attacker
import_candidates.abstract:
QUIC is a new network protocol based on UDP that replaces TCP and TLS with an integrated protocol. It provides multiplexing of streams over a single encrypted and authenticated connection. The QUIC standard allows many different combinations of UDP datagrams, and QUIC packets, frames, and streams to transport the same information. This implies that testing the receiving side of QUIC is difficult.
We develop probes to explore how different QUIC server implementations handle the coalescence and fragmentation of payloads, covering both valid and invalid combinations of datagrams, packets, and frames. Already at this basic level, we observe significant differences between implementations, some of which pointing towards exploitable vulnerabilities. Previous QUIC research tools were not designed to implement such probes. To address this limitation, we present QUIC-Attacker, a testing framework that allows maximum freedom on the sending side of QUIC.
We present our results on these probes when applied to 15 QUIC server libraries, uncovering eight DoS vulnerabilities caused by unhandled exceptions and exploitable injection vulnerabilities in Kwik and Alibaba's XQUIC.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: QUIC 是一种基于 UDP 的新网络协议，用集成协议取代 TCP 和 TLS。它通过单个加密和认证连接提供流的复用。QUIC 标准允许 UDP 数据报以及 QUIC 包、帧和流的许多不同组合来传输相同信息。这意味着测试 QUIC 的接收端很困难。我们开发探测方法来探索不同 QUIC 服务器实现如何处理载荷的合并与分片，涵盖数据报、包和帧的有效和无效组合。仅在这个基本层面上，我们就观察到实现之间的显著差异，其中一些指向可利用的漏洞。先前的 QUIC 研究工具并未设计用于实现此类探测。为解决这一限制，我们提出 QUIC-Attacker，一个允许在 QUIC 发送端拥有最大自由度的测试框架。我们展示了对 15 个 QUIC 服务器库应用这些探测的结果，发现了 8 个由未处理异常引起的 DoS 漏洞，以及 Kwik 和阿里巴巴 XQUIC 中可利用的注入漏洞。

import_candidates.title: When Authorization Loses Its Meaning: Breaking and Fixing Third-Party Online Payments
import_candidates.abstract: Third-party online payment systems, such as Alipay and PSPB, constitute critical infrastructure for modern e-commerce. However, their security rests on the unrealistic assumption of fully trusted communication channels. While prior studies have identified isolated vulnerabilities, a systematic formal analysis of payment protocol security remains absent. This paper presents formal security models for six third-party payment protocols, spanning three major payment scenarios and two dominant payment service providers. Our analysis reveals a fundamental design flaw: whenever channel integrity is compromised between the merchant client, merchant server, or payment system, order tampering attacks become feasible. We validate this threat on Android, where over 20% of tested merchant applications allow order tampering through implicit Intent hijacking. To mitigate this threat, we propose user-side order authentication, where per-user-merchant key pairs cryptographically bind consent to order semantics. Formal verification demonstrates its resilience against identified attacks under weak channel assumptions. By bridging formal methods and empirical analysis, this work offers actionable guidance for standardizing secure payment protocols.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 第三方在线支付系统，如支付宝和PSPB，构成了现代电子商务的关键基础设施。然而，其安全性建立在完全可信通信信道这一不现实的假设之上。尽管此前研究已发现一些孤立的漏洞，但对支付协议安全性的系统性形式化分析仍然缺失。本文提出了六种第三方支付协议的形式化安全模型，涵盖三大支付场景和两家主要支付服务提供商。我们的分析揭示了一个根本性设计缺陷：一旦商户客户端、商户服务器或支付系统之间的信道完整性遭到破坏，订单篡改攻击就成为可能。我们在Android上验证了这一威胁，超过20%的受测商户应用允许通过隐式Intent劫持进行订单篡改。为缓解这一威胁，我们提出了用户侧订单认证，其中每用户-商户密钥对将同意与订单语义进行密码学绑定。形式化验证表明，在弱信道假设下，该方法能够抵御所识别的攻击。通过连接形式化方法与实证分析，本工作为标准化安全支付协议提供了可操作的指导。

import_candidates.title: TONTOU: On the Exploitability of Time-of-Neutralization to Time-of-Use Windows
import_candidates.abstract:
Recently deployed Spectre v2 mitigations neutralize branch predictor state when switching privilege contexts or immediately prior to indirect branch execution, either through domain isolation or sanitization. These defenses assume that subsequent branch predictor behavior remains free from attacker influence until the neutralized state is used.
Unfortunately, this paper shows that this assumption does not hold on recent AMD and Intel CPUs. We find that postneutralization (Time-of-Neutralization to Time-of-Use, TONTOU) windows can be exploited by an attacker to re-poison the predictor. Specifically, within the post-neutralization window, the attacker can re-direct control-flow of the victim to a training gadget that updates the predictor.
To re-direct control-flow, we introduce INTERRUPT INJECTION, a primitive that exploits post-neutralization windows by leveraging the fact that interrupts can occur at nearly any point in time. Using this primitive, we demonstrate that an attacker can trigger mispredictions during kernel execution on recent AMD and Intel CPUs. To prove its practicality, we build an end-to-end exploit using INTERRUPT INJECTION that leaks arbitrary kernel memory on AMD Zen 2 at a rate of 5.47 bytes/s, despite the latest neutralization techniques.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 最近部署的Spectre v2缓解措施在切换特权上下文或间接分支执行之前立即中和分支预测器状态，方式包括域隔离或清理。这些防御假设后续分支预测器行为在已中和状态被使用之前不受攻击者影响。不幸的是，本文表明这一假设在最近的AMD和Intel CPU上并不成立。我们发现，中和后（Time-of-Neutralization to Time-of-Use, TONTOU）窗口可被攻击者利用来重新污染预测器。具体而言，在中和后窗口内，攻击者可以将受害者的控制流重定向到更新预测器的训练gadget。为了重定向控制流，我们引入了INTERRUPT INJECTION，一种利用中断几乎可在任何时间点发生这一事实来利用中和后窗口的原语。利用该原语，我们证明攻击者可以在最近的AMD和Intel CPU上触发内核执行期间的错误预测。为证明其实用性，我们构建了一个使用INTERRUPT INJECTION的端到端利用，尽管采用了最新的中和技术，仍能以5.47字节/秒的速度泄露AMD Zen 2上的任意内核内存。

import_candidates.title: Amortizing Randomness Cost: Efficient Masked Implementation of SDitH Signatures with Common Shares
import_candidates.abstract:
MPC-in-the-Head (MPCitH) signatures are attractive for postquantum deployment, but they are structurally vulnerable to side-channel leakage: verification opens almost all simulated views, so any leakage correlated with the remaining unopened view(s) can be amplified and exploited to recover the witness. Among the MPCitH-based signature candidates considered in NIST’s additional-signature round, Syndrome-Decodingin-the-Head (SDitH)-Hypercube is particularly susceptible to this concern, since its signing process combines: (i) offline last-party completion involving nonlinear arithmetic computations, (ii) online Baum–Nof (BN) arithmetic checking, and (iii) Keccak sponge calls that generate or absorb secretbearing values.
To the best of our knowledge, this is the first protocol-compatible masked implementation-level protection architecture for SDitH-Hypercube on Cortex-M4. Our implementation combines three techniques, each protecting one attackcritical hotspot: (i) Common Shares to amortize the masking randomness required by masked multiplications in the offline phase, (ii) a Sec/Pub typing discipline that reconstructs transcript-public and verifier-reconstructible values early to avoid costly Sec×Sec gadgets in the online BN kernels, and (iii) selective masked Keccak backends applied only to secretbearing sponge call sites.
On the L1 parameter set, Common Shares reduces arithmetic masking randomness from 8.37 KiB/signature of the Strong Non-Interference (SNI) profile to 16 B/signature, while the Sec/Pub-typed optimization removes 3,264 B/signature from the online BN kernels. When Keccak is masked, masking randomness is dominated by the sponge: 41,118.75 KiB/signature with DOM-Keccak and 82,237.50 KiB/signature with SNI-Keccak, motivating selective masked hashing and tunable backends. We implement a low-stack reference signer and all protected signers on Cortex-M4. Across protected profiles, signing takes 913.7–1,542.0 Mcycles (1.84×–3.10× over the *Corresponding Author. reference), and fits within 155.6 KiB flash, 136.7 KiB static RAM, and 7.96 KiB signing stack. A 1M-trace first-order fixed-vs-random Test Vector Leakage Assessment (TVLA) experiment on Cortex-M4 no longer detects the previously observed leakage peaks after protection.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: MPC-in-the-Head（MPCitH）签名对于后量子部署具有吸引力，但其结构上易受侧信道泄漏影响：验证会打开几乎所有模拟视图，因此任何与剩余未打开视图相关的泄漏都可能被放大并用于恢复见证。在NIST额外签名轮次考虑的基于MPCitH的签名候选中，Syndrome-Decoding-in-the-Head（SDitH）-Hypercube尤其容易受到这一问题影响，因为其签名过程结合了：(i) 涉及非线性算术计算的离线最后一方完成；(ii) 在线Baum–Nof（BN）算术检查；以及 (iii) 生成或吸收含密值的Keccak海绵调用。据我们所知，这是首个在Cortex-M4上针对SDitH-Hypercube的协议兼容的掩码实现级保护架构。我们的实现结合了三种技术，每种技术保护一个攻击关键热点：(i) 公共份额（Common Shares）以摊销离线阶段掩码乘法所需的掩码随机性；(ii) Sec/Pub类型规约，提前重建转录公开和验证者可重建的值，以避免在线BN内核中昂贵的Sec×Sec小工具；(iii) 选择性掩码Keccak后端，仅应用于含密值的海绵调用点。在L1参数集上，公共份额将算术掩码随机性从强非干涉（SNI）配置的每个签名8.37 KiB降低到每个签名16 B，而Sec/Pub类型化优化从在线BN内核中每个签名移除3,264 B。当Keccak被掩码时，掩码随机性由海绵主导：使用DOM-Keccak时为每个签名41,118.75 KiB，使用SNI-Keccak时为每个签名82,237.50 KiB，这促使采用选择性掩码哈希和可调后端。我们在Cortex-M4上实现了低栈参考签名器和所有受保护签名器。在受保护配置中，签名需要913.7–1,542.0 M周期（为参考实现的1.84×–3.10×），并适配于155.6 KiB闪存、136.7 KiB静态RAM和7.96 KiB签名栈。在Cortex-M4上进行的一百万条轨迹的一阶固定-随机测试向量泄漏评估（TVLA）实验在保护后不再检测到先前观察到的泄漏峰。

import_candidates.title: Principled Design of Indexing Functions for Memory Coloring
import_candidates.abstract:
On shared multi-core CPUs, memory coloring achieves microarchitectural isolation by partitioning resources between trust domains. Previous work has shown that memory coloring can, in principle, be used to isolate multiple components simultaneously, e.g., both the last-level (L3) cache and DRAM. The number of colors obtained by these methods depends on the algebraic properties of the indexing functions, though, and today's off-the-shelf CPU designs are often not suited for multi-component memory coloring. 
We develop algorithms to automatically synthesize indexing functions that guarantee a minimum number of colors. Given a set of typical workloads and some context on the CPU design, our algorithms compute a new linear indexing function that supports the requested number of colors while maximizing the performance on the workloads. Our approach is based on the observation that the number of colors depends on the overlap of the algebraic kernels of the involved indexing functions. Building on this observation, we translate the requirements that the CPU design imposes on the function into algebraic constraints that our algorithms enforce. 
In a case study on a 16-core server-class CPU, we show that our framework yields a coloring scheme that partitions the L3 cache and DRAM banks, increasing the number of colors from 1 to 16 while incurring less than 2.5% performance overhead, on average across SPEC and PARSEC benchmarks.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在共享多核CPU上，内存着色通过在不同信任域之间划分资源来实现微架构隔离。先前工作表明，内存着色原则上可用于同时隔离多个组件，例如末级(L3)缓存和DRAM。然而，这些方法获得的颜色数量取决于索引函数的代数性质，而当今的现成CPU设计往往不适合多组件内存着色。我们开发了自动合成索引函数的算法，以保证最低数量的颜色。给定一组典型工作负载以及有关CPU设计的一些上下文，我们的算法计算一个新的线性索引函数，在支持所需颜色数量的同时最大化工作负载上的性能。我们的方法基于这样的观察：颜色数量取决于相关索引函数的代数核的重叠。基于这一观察，我们将CPU设计对函数施加的要求转化为我们的算法所执行的代数约束。在一项针对16核服务器级CPU的案例研究中，我们展示了我们的框架产生了一种着色方案，该方案划分L3缓存和DRAM bank，将颜色数量从1增加到16，同时在SPEC和PARSEC基准测试上平均带来不到2.5%的性能开销。

import_candidates.title: An Integer Overflow Endgame: Compiler and Architecture Support for Default-On Integer Overflow Mitigation
import_candidates.abstract:
Integer overflow checks are off-by-default in most production settings due to their high overheads. Consequently, many serious vulnerabilities remain unmitigated. We analyze the source of these overheads---in compilers including LLVM (UBSan, Rust), and in processors including x86-64, ARM64, and RISC-V---and show how to eliminate them.
Overheads in LLVM stem from how overflow semantics are expressed in LLVM IR. LLVM's current approach, based on intrinsics and branches, interferes with a variety of middle end optimizations. We develop an alternative approach that tracks overflow semantics with metadata, but otherwise leaves LLVM IR unchanged, eliminating this overhead. Overheads in hardware primarily result from current ISA designs, that require doubling the number of μops for checked vs. unchecked arithmetic, stressing the processor pipeline. We show how simple ISA extensions can alleviate this stress, enabling overflow-checked arithmetic to issue as a single μop.
We evaluate these extensions through compiler-based emulation on real hardware and simulation in gem5. Our work offers a path to significantly reducing the cost of overflow checks in existing compilers, and demonstrates that integer overflow mitigation can be cheap enough for default-on use in future hardware.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 由于开销高昂，整数溢出检查在大多数生产环境中默认关闭。因此，许多严重漏洞仍未得到缓解。我们分析了这些开销的来源——包括LLVM（UBSan、Rust）等编译器，以及x86-64、ARM64和RISC-V等处理器——并展示了如何消除它们。LLVM中的开销源于溢出语义在LLVM IR中的表达方式。LLVM当前基于内建函数和分支的方法会干扰多种中端优化。我们开发了一种替代方法，用元数据跟踪溢出语义，但在其他方面保持LLVM IR不变，从而消除了这一开销。硬件中的开销主要源于当前ISA设计，这些设计使得带检查的算术与未检查的算术相比需要加倍的μop，给处理器流水线带来压力。我们展示了简单的ISA扩展如何缓解这种压力，使溢出检查算术能够以单个μop发射。我们通过真实硬件上的基于编译器的仿真和gem5中的模拟来评估这些扩展。我们的工作为显著降低现有编译器中溢出检查的成本提供了一条路径，并表明整数溢出缓解可以足够廉价，以便在未来硬件中默认开启使用。

import_candidates.title: HyperAudit: Towards User Transparent and Highly Efficient System Auditing for Cloud Platforms
import_candidates.abstract:
System auditing is a critical security primitive for cloud platforms, but existing auditing frameworks place the log collection module inside the compromise-prone guest kernel. This design exposes a large attack surface and enables race condition attacks, where an attacker that compromises the kernel can tamper with uncommitted logs and erase pre-compromise traces. Prior secure collectors mitigate this by frequent synchronous or timed submissions, which incur non-trivial runtime overhead.
We present HyperAudit, a hypervisor-assisted auditing architecture that isolates the log collection module from the guest kernel while keeping collection efficient and deployable. HyperAudit injects a kernel-independent collector into a hidden memory region, protects its code with execute-only permissions, and shields the log buffer with guard-page trapping, minimizing the exposed attack surface. Logs are asynchronously pulled by a consumer in a dedicated Secure VM, avoiding periodic synchronous commits. Under the common auditing assumption that logs generated after kernel compromise are untrustworthy, HyperAudit guarantees the integrity of all pre-compromise logs against race condition and flooding attacks. We implement HyperAudit on both x86 and Arm without extra hardware, and show that it reduces log-intensive application overhead by 49% and 66% compared to eAudit and HitchHiker, even outperforming host-only collectors.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 系统审计是云平台的关键安全原语，但现有审计框架将日志收集模块置于易受攻击的客户机内核中。这种设计暴露了较大的攻击面，并使得竞态条件攻击成为可能：攻击者一旦攻陷内核，就可以篡改未提交的日志并抹除攻陷前的痕迹。先前的安全收集器通过频繁的同步或定时提交来缓解这一问题，但这会带来不小的运行时开销。我们提出 HyperAudit，一种虚拟机监控器辅助的审计架构，它将日志收集模块与客户机内核隔离，同时保持收集高效且可部署。HyperAudit 将内核无关的收集器注入隐藏内存区域，使用只执行权限保护其代码，并通过保护页陷阱保护日志缓冲区，从而最小化暴露的攻击面。日志由专用安全虚拟机中的消费者异步拉取，避免周期性的同步提交。在常见的审计假设下，即内核攻陷后生成的日志不可信，HyperAudit 保证所有攻陷前日志在面对竞态条件和洪泛攻击时的完整性。我们在 x86 和 Arm 上实现了 HyperAudit，无需额外硬件，并表明与 eAudit 和 HitchHiker 相比，它将日志密集型应用开销降低了 49% 和 66%，甚至优于仅宿主机收集器。

import_candidates.title: Anchors that Don't Lift: Understanding Supply Chain Driven Kernel Lock-In and Governance-Mediated Mitigation Strategies in SOHO Devices
import_candidates.abstract:
Small Office/Home Office (SOHO) devices are widely popular, yet often attacked due to security vulnerabilities in their firmware, affecting tens of thousands of devices at a time. These security vulnerabilities often stem from outdated Linux kernel versions included in SOHO device firmware. Naturally, prior work audited the extent and impact of this issue by simple Linux version extraction and version number based vulnerability mapping. However, it is unclear how many of these anticipated vulnerabilities actually exist in the heavily customized SOHO kernels and if there are any barriers towards updating Linux kernels in SOHO firmwares. 
To address this gap, we uncover actual kernel-related vulnerabilities found in 306 SOHO devices using a high-precision template-based CVE detection mechanism on GPL source releases of more than 900 firmwares from these devices (multiple versions per device). Next, as a first, we traced the supply chain of these vulnerable SOHO devices at scale and identify kernel lock-in as a significant security issue---SOHO vendors are effectively locked to specific (often older) kernel versions due to the system-on-chip (SoC) SDKs they use. This kernel lock-in produces a vulnerability debt that is inherited along the supply chain from SoC vendor to firmware creators (ODM/OEM) to router/IP-camera vendor and ultimately borne by end users. All five SoC vendors in our dataset have used SDKs with Linux kernels that had reached End of Life (EoL) more than a year before their usage in a SOHO device. Finally, we explore the mitigation-potential of individual, regulatory and community governance by analyzing social media posts, regulations and community efforts. Our results show that regulation compliance is insufficient and only SoC vendors who engage with communities for kernel upgradation offered a viable path towards mitigation. We conclude by discussing broader implications of our work for improving holistic security of the supply chain for SOHO devices.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 小型办公室/家庭办公室（SOHO）设备广受欢迎，但由于其固件中的安全漏洞而经常遭受攻击，一次会影响数万台设备。这些安全漏洞通常源于SOHO设备固件中包含的过时Linux内核版本。自然，先前的工作通过简单的Linux版本提取和基于版本号的漏洞映射来审计此问题的范围和影响。然而，尚不清楚这些预期漏洞中有多少实际存在于高度定制的SOHO内核中，以及是否存在更新SOHO固件中Linux内核的障碍。为弥补这一空白，我们对306台SOHO设备中实际发现的内核相关漏洞进行了挖掘，使用高精度基于模板的CVE检测机制，对来自这些设备的900多个固件的GPL源代码发布（每个设备多个版本）进行分析。接下来，作为首次，我们大规模追踪了这些易受攻击的SOHO设备的供应链，并确定内核锁定是一个重要的安全问题——SOHO供应商实际上由于使用的片上系统（SoC）SDK而被锁定在特定（通常较旧）的内核版本上。这种内核锁定产生了一种漏洞债务，它沿着供应链从SoC供应商继承到固件创建者（ODM/OEM），再到路由器/IP摄像头供应商，最终由最终用户承担。我们数据集中的所有五家SoC供应商都使用了Linux内核已达到生命周期终止（EoL）超过一年后才用于SOHO设备的SDK。最后，我们通过分析社交媒体帖子、法规和社区努力，探索了个人、监管和社区治理的缓解潜力。我们的结果表明，法规合规不足，只有与社区合作进行内核升级的SoC供应商提供了可行的缓解路径。我们最后讨论了我们的工作对改善SOHO设备供应链整体安全性的更广泛影响。

import_candidates.title: When HTTP 402 Meets the Blockchain: Risks on Emerging x402 Payments
import_candidates.abstract:
x402 is an emerging payment protocol for Web APIs and autonomous AI agents. It is driven by the rise of LLM-based agents that can autonomously purchase access to online services. x402 extends HTTP 402 with a payment negotiation flow and delegates payment proof verification and on-chain settlement to third-party facilitators. As a result, facilitators serve as a shared payment infrastructure for many independent merchants. This centralizes trust and validation in one component, so a single flaw can affect many services. Despite rapid adoption by major vendors and economically meaningful mainnet activity, the security posture of real-world x402 deployments remains poorly characterized.
We present the first systematic study of authorization correctness and execution safety in current facilitator-mediated x402 deployments in the wild, identifying eight security rules for facilitators as critical payment infrastructure. Based on our analysis of rule violations, we derive four new attack vectors, including Free Shopping, Asset Theft, Service Denial, and Gas Abuse. These attacks exploit weaknesses in the real-world facilitator and server implementations and cause severe harm, including direct financial loss to merchants, theft of facilitator-held assets, unbounded sponsor-paid gas/fees, and disruption of payment services. To assess the security of x402 deployments at scale, we propose a semi-automated black-box tool and apply it to 15 major x402 facilitators collectively used by over 60K sellers and 360K buyers. Alarmingly, we find violations in all evaluated facilitators. We responsibly disclosed our findings to the affected parties, who acknowledged the issues and adopted mitigations, including changes by Coinbase. Finally, we complement our controlled testing with an empirical measurement of over 119 million recent Base and Solana transactions, quantifying x402 adoption, facilitator centralization, and ecosystem-level risk indicators.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: x402是一种面向Web API和自主AI代理的新兴支付协议。其兴起由能够自主购买在线服务访问权限的基于LLM的代理推动。x402通过支付协商流程扩展了HTTP 402，并将支付证明验证和链上结算委托给第三方 facilitator。因此，facilitator 成为许多独立商户共享的支付基础设施。这将信任和验证集中在一个组件中，因此单个缺陷可能影响许多服务。尽管被主要供应商迅速采用，并且主网活动具有经济意义，但现实世界x402部署的安全态势仍然缺乏系统刻画。我们提出了首个针对当前由 facilitator 中介的x402真实部署中授权正确性与执行安全性的系统研究，识别出作为关键支付基础设施的 facilitator 应遵循的八条安全规则。基于对规则违反情况的分析，我们推导出四种新的攻击向量，包括免费购物、资产盗窃、服务拒绝和Gas滥用。这些攻击利用了真实 facilitator 和服务器实现中的弱点，并造成严重危害，包括商户直接财务损失、facilitator 持有资产被盗、无上限的赞助方支付Gas/费用，以及支付服务中断。为了大规模评估x402部署的安全性，我们提出了一种半自动化黑盒工具，并将其应用于15个主要x402 facilitator，这些 facilitator 合计被超过6万卖家和36万买家使用。令人担忧的是，我们在所有评估的 facilitator 中都发现了违规行为。我们负责任地向受影响方披露了发现结果，他们确认了问题并采取了缓解措施，包括Coinbase所做的更改。最后，我们通过测量超过1.19亿笔近期Base和Solana交易来补充受控测试，量化了x402采用情况、facilitator 中心化程度和生态系统层面的风险指标。

import_candidates.title: Kintsugi: Empowering LLMs to Mitigate Web Vulnerabilities via Runtime Policy Injection
import_candidates.abstract: The "response gap" between vulnerability detection and patching leaves web applications exposed to high-impact exploits such as remote code execution, command injection, and server-side request forgery. Current mitigations are flawed: code fixes often break functionality, while global runtime policies produce excessive false positives. We propose Kintsugi, an automated runtime containment system that provides temporary protection for exploits that manifest as diverging syscall behaviors at the OS level. Kintsugi uses a three-stage pipeline: First, by performing differential syscall analysis on normal and malicious requests, it locates a few vulnerability-related functions. Subsequently, leveraging LLMs, it precisely delineates the boundaries of the specific code snippets causing the malicious behavior within these functions and establishes policy trigger points. Finally, by analyzing the execution profiles from normal requests, it derives a deterministic, least-privilege syscall whitelist to serve as the runtime policy. This policy is enforced at the kernel level via eBPF and cgroups and is dynamically activated only when the request's execution flow enters the protected code snippet. Evaluation on 27 real-world CVEs across PHP, Python, and Java shows that Kintsugi effectively neutralizes diverse exploits and their variants while preserving original application functionality. Kintsugi achieves an average response time of 7.6 minutes. While the enforcement of surgical policies introduces a modest average latency overhead of 9.2% on targeted APIs, the impact on concurrent non-vulnerable traffic remains minimal, with an average throughput (RPS) drop of only 2.21%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 漏洞检测与修补之间的“响应差距”使Web应用暴露于远程代码执行、命令注入和服务器端请求伪造等高危利用。当前的缓解措施存在缺陷：代码修复常常破坏功能，而全局运行时策略会产生过多误报。我们提出Kintsugi，一种自动化运行时遏制系统，为在操作系统层面表现为系统调用行为偏离的漏洞利用提供临时保护。Kintsugi采用三阶段流水线：首先，通过对正常请求和恶意请求进行差分系统调用分析，定位少量与漏洞相关的函数。随后，利用LLM，精确刻画这些函数中导致恶意行为的特定代码片段的边界，并建立策略触发点。最后，通过分析正常请求的执行画像，推导出确定性的最小权限系统调用白名单作为运行时策略。该策略通过eBPF和cgroups在内核级强制执行，并且仅当请求的执行流进入受保护代码片段时动态激活。在涵盖PHP、Python和Java的27个真实世界CVE上的评估表明，Kintsugi有效中和了多样化的漏洞利用及其变体，同时保留原始应用功能。Kintsugi平均响应时间为7.6分钟。虽然精准策略的执行在目标API上引入了9.2%的平均延迟开销，但对并发非漏洞流量的影响仍然很小，平均吞吐量(RPS)仅下降2.21%。

import_candidates.title: Alias Equals Zone? Large-Scale and Stealthy Takeover of Domain Hosting Service via CNAME-Following Cross-Domain Verification
import_candidates.abstract: CNAME records define alias relationships between domains and are widely used for service hosting and load balancing. We find that popular domain hosting providers misinterpret CNAME semantics during domain ownership verification. They accept DNS records after CNAME redirection as valid challenge tokens for alias domains, even though these domains do not configure any tokens. Based on this flaw, we propose ALIASLEAP, a novel domain takeover attack that enables hijacking hosting services of alias domains in CNAME chains. ALIASLEAP poses a serious threat in the real world: we identify four email and seven web hosting providers that are vulnerable, affecting over two million domains, including 200K in the Tranco Top 1M domain list. ALIASLEAP is highly stealthy because vulnerable CNAME chains are typically legitimate and long-lived: about half persist for more than 12 months, and up to 19,819 domains have been exposed for over 10 years. We propose mitigation strategies and responsibly disclose ALIASLEAP to 11 affected hosting providers, receiving confirmations from eight of them. We call on the Internet community to revisit the usage practices and capability boundaries of CNAME records.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: CNAME记录定义了域之间的别名关系，广泛用于服务托管和负载均衡。我们发现流行域名托管提供商在域名所有权验证过程中误解了CNAME语义。它们接受CNAME重定向后的DNS记录作为别名域的有效质询令牌，即使这些域未配置任何令牌。基于此缺陷，我们提出ALIASLEAP，一种新型域名接管攻击，能够劫持CNAME链中别名域的托管服务。ALIASLEAP在现实世界中构成严重威胁：我们发现四个电子邮件和七个Web托管提供商存在漏洞，影响超过200万个域，其中包括Tranco Top 1M域名列表中的20万个。ALIASLEAP极具隐蔽性，因为易受攻击的CNAME链通常是合法且长期存在的：约一半持续超过12个月，多达19,819个域已暴露超过10年。我们提出缓解策略，并负责任地向11家受影响托管提供商披露ALIASLEAP，收到其中8家的确认。我们呼吁互联网社区重新审视CNAME记录的使用实践和能力边界。

import_candidates.title: Securing Retrieval-Augmented Code Generation via Contextual Knowledge Injection: A Case for Embedded IoT Applications
import_candidates.abstract:
Repository-grounded retrieval-augmented code generation (RACG) is increasingly used in embedded IoT development by retrieving code and documentation from a pinned RTOS/SDK repository (e.g., Zephyr OS). In this setting, security risks are often version-inherited: even without retrieval poisoning, generated applications may invoke benign-looking public APIs that transitively reach vulnerable internal routines in the pinned snapshot, thereby inheriting known CVEs. Existing secure RACG pipelines largely focus on task-level intent and generic vulnerability patterns, which can miss repository- and version-specific exposure. Meanwhile, conventional CVE scanners can flag vulnerable locations but cannot determine whether those vulnerabilities are reachable through the public APIs that the generator commits to during repository-grounded generation.
In this paper, we present IoTRAGuarder, a contextual knowledge injection framework that aligns security hardening with generation-time API selection under repository grounding. IoTRAGuarder (i) recovers auditable reverse call chains from CVE-localized internals to exposing public APIs via static analysis plus an evidence-gated LLM to bridge indirections and macro-driven "call-graph islands", (ii) constructs a version-aware security knowledge base that binds affected version intervals to exposed public APIs with prompt-ready constraints, safer alternatives, or avoidance/upgrade guidance, and (iii) performs dual-layer, API-aligned online retrieval to inject concise, version-matched constraints into the final prompt. We evaluate IoTRAGuarder on 44 real-world Zephyr tasks across four LLMs. Compared to the prior state-of-the-art secure RACG baseline, IoTRAGuarder improves the overall security success rate from 5.11% to 78.41%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh:
基于仓库的检索增强代码生成（RACG）正越来越多地用于嵌入式物联网开发，其方式是从固定的RTOS/SDK仓库（例如Zephyr OS）中检索代码与文档。在此场景中，安全风险往往是版本继承的：即使没有检索投毒，生成的应用程序也可能调用看似良性的公共API，而这些API会传递性地到达固定快照中存在漏洞的内部例程，从而继承已知CVE。现有的安全RACG流水线主要关注任务级意图和通用漏洞模式，可能遗漏仓库和版本特定的暴露面。与此同时，传统CVE扫描器可以标记易受攻击的位置，但无法确定这些漏洞是否可通过生成器在基于仓库的生成过程中所承诺的公共API到达。
在本文中，我们提出IoTRAGuarder，一种上下文知识注入框架，使安全加固与基于仓库的生成时API选择保持一致。IoTRAGuarder (i) 通过静态分析以及一个证据门控的LLM来恢复从CVE定位的内部例程到暴露的公共API的可审计反向调用链，以桥接间接调用和宏驱动的“调用图孤岛”；(ii) 构建版本感知的安全知识库，将受影响版本区间与暴露的公共API绑定，并提供可直接用于提示的约束、更安全的替代方案或规避/升级指导；(iii) 执行双层、与API对齐的在线检索，以将简洁、版本匹配的约束注入最终提示。我们在44个真实Zephyr任务上跨四个LLM评估IoTRAGuarder。与之前最先进的安全RACG基线相比，IoTRAGuarder将整体安全成功率从5.11%提升至78.41%。

import_candidates.title: Discovering, characterizing and exploiting controllable-copy objects for kernel data-only attacks with CopyKat
import_candidates.abstract: Modern kernel hardening mechanisms considerably reduce the viability of control-flow hijacking attacks, prompting attackers to shift their focus to data-only attacks. These attacks depend on corrupting non-control data to amplify limited memory-corruption primitives into more powerful capabilities such as arbitrary writes. Prior work has identified small sets of such objects in specific circumstances. However, no existing approach discovers and characterizes them at scale. In this paper, we introduce CopyKat, a fully automated pipeline for identifying and characterizing Controllable-Copy Objects (CCOs): heap-allocated kernel structures whose fields can be corrupted to redirect a store or memory-transfer operation involving attacker-controlled data. We propose a multi-stage methodology with progressive filtering of objects. Through lightweight taint-analysis applied to a fuzzing campaign, we uncover candidate CCOs. Then, we confirm such taint by using a precise taint engine, thereby enhancing our precision. Finally, we perform the corruption of the CCO using a concolic execution engine to verify the controllability of the object. We also collect the necessary path and value constraints for exploitation. We find 122 verified CCOs and build 8 end-to-end exploits involving different exploitation patterns, showcasing the correctness of our characterization and the flexibility of the discovered objects.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代内核加固机制大幅降低了控制流劫持攻击的可行性，促使攻击者将焦点转向数据攻击。这些攻击依赖于破坏非控制数据，将有限的内存破坏原语放大为任意写等更强大的能力。已有工作已在特定情形下识别出少量此类对象。然而，尚无现有方法能够大规模地发现和刻画它们。在本文中，我们提出CopyKat，一个全自动流水线，用于识别和刻画可控复制对象（CCO）：即堆分配的内核结构，其字段可被破坏以重定向涉及攻击者可控数据的存储或内存传输操作。我们提出一种多阶段方法，对对象进行渐进式过滤。通过对模糊测试活动应用轻量级污点分析，我们发现候选CCO。然后，我们使用精确的污点引擎确认此类污点，从而提高精度。最后，我们使用混合执行引擎对CCO进行破坏，以验证对象的可控性。我们还收集利用所需的路径和值约束。我们找到了122个已验证的CCO，并构建了8个涉及不同利用模式的端到端漏洞利用，展示了我们刻画的正确性和所发现对象的灵活性。

import_candidates.title: SoK: On the Fragility of Memory Error Exploit Mitigations
import_candidates.abstract:
The perennial war in memory has long been shaped by a continuous arms race: defenses are deployed, bypasses emerge, and stronger mitigations follow, only for the cycle to repeat. This pattern persists in part due to the fragility of many defenses, which often fail when assumptions change. Such fragility reflects how security guarantees are assessed, often through ad hoc reasoning tied to specific threat models. In a fast-evolving landscape of polyglot applications and heterogeneous systems, manually re-evaluating these guarantees for every new context is both labor-intensive and error-prone.
This SoK advocates for a more systematic,adversary-aware approach. We introduce a graph-based framework for evaluating the fragility of memory safety defenses by modeling the progression of memory corruption exploits, and where, how, and under what assumptions defenses intervene and may fail. We demonstrate the utility of this model by revisiting flaws in prominent defenses and showing how their shortcomings could have been anticipated. Finally, we release open-source tooling that implements our model and supports systematized and semi-automated fragility testing.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 内存领域长期存在的战争一直由持续不断的军备竞赛所塑造：防御措施被部署，绕过方法出现，更强的缓解措施随之而来，然后循环重复。这种模式之所以持续，部分原因在于许多防御措施的脆弱性——当假设发生变化时，它们往往就会失效。这种脆弱性反映了安全保证的评估方式，通常是通过与特定威胁模型绑定的临时性推理。在多语言应用和异构系统快速演变的背景下，针对每个新环境手动重新评估这些保证既费力又容易出错。本SoK倡导一种更系统化、更具对手意识的方法。我们引入一个基于图的框架，通过建模内存破坏利用的进展过程，以及防御措施在何处、如何以及在何种假设下介入并可能失效，来评估内存安全防御的脆弱性。我们通过重新审视著名防御措施中的缺陷并展示其不足如何本可被预见，来证明该模型的实用性。最后，我们发布实现了该模型并支持系统化和半自动化脆弱性测试的开源工具。

import_candidates.title: Fence2Pwn: KFENCE-Enabled Kernel Exploitation Bypassing Slab Hardening and Memory Tagging
import_candidates.abstract:
While the Linux kernel remains a prime target due to its privileged execution model, exploitation has become substantially more difficult in recent years. Kernel hardening efforts have increasingly focused on the slab allocator, aiming to mitigate entire vulnerability classes (e.g., via memory tagging) or disrupt exploit techniques (e.g., via heap object segregation). However, it remains unclear whether these protections are consistently enforced across all allocation paths.
In this paper, we find that one allocation path is excluded from all state-of-the-art slab defenses: the path used for KFENCE allocations. KFENCE is designed as a low-overhead sampling-based memory-safety error detector for production kernels. It is enabled by default and active in billions of systems including on Android, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, and most Linux distributions. We show that it unintentionally enables a new exploit technique, Fence2Pwn. Concretely, Fence2Pwn leverages several KFENCE-specific behaviors. Three are particularly notable: (i) using a timing side channel, we detect when the kernel falls back to KFENCE allocations; (ii) KFENCE allocations are served by KFENCE-managed caches rather than size- and type-segregated slab caches, enabling bypass of heap segregation; and (iii) KFENCE allocations are untagged, enabling bypass of memory tagging. We evaluate Fence2Pwn by profiling our timing side channel, KFENCE's object slot dynamics as well as different environments and noise floors.
