Specifically, we introduce counterfactual explanation logic to reduce the alerts and find the minimal structural subset (i.e., the core attack edges) within an alert that determines its malicious prediction. This subset, when perturbed, can subvert the model's original prediction. The framework then applies a staged solidification strategy to enhance the precision and stability of the alert analysis. Ultimately, ProvX outputs an actionable core edge list for immediate response and blocking of critical attack steps. Experiments on DARPA datasets demonstrate that ProvX can locate key behaviors within alerts that are highly relevant to real-world attacks, and the identified core edges can flip many detector alerts under the simulated intervention used in our model-level evaluation. Furthermore, we explore and provide a preliminary validation of an alert-feedback enhancement framework, showing that ProvX's analysis results can guide model optimization in adversarial scenarios.
import_candidates.abstract_zh:
基于溯源的入侵检测系统（PIDS）是防御高级持续性威胁（APT）的关键防线。然而，其实际部署因告警泛滥而严重受阻；最先进的PIDS侧重于检测性能，会输出数千条低信息量、不可操作的告警。这些输出无法隔离检测器告警的真正原因，也无法为安全运营中心（SOC）提供可操作的阻断策略。
为应对这一挑战，我们提出了ProvX，一种新颖的APT防御框架，旨在阻断告警中的攻击步骤。与现有工作不同，ProvX并不旨在仅仅提高攻击检测性能；它致力于将不可操作的原始告警转化为可供即时审查的核心边列表。具体而言，我们引入反事实解释逻辑来减少告警，并找到告警中决定其恶意预测的最小结构子集（即核心攻击边）。该子集在被扰动时，可以颠覆模型的原始预测。然后，该框架应用分阶段固化策略，以提高告警分析的精度和稳定性。最终，ProvX输出一个可操作的核心边列表，用于即时响应和阻断关键攻击步骤。在DARPA数据集上的实验表明，ProvX能够定位告警中与现实世界攻击高度相关的关键行为，并且所识别的核心边在我们模型级评估中使用的模拟干预下可以翻转许多检测器告警。此外，我们探索并初步验证了一个告警反馈增强框架，表明ProvX的分析结果可以在对抗场景中指导模型优化。

import_candidates.title: COGNITION: From Evaluation to Defense against Multimodal LLM CAPTCHA Solvers
import_candidates.abstract: This paper studies how multimodal large language models (MLLMs) undermine the security guarantees of visual CAPTCHA. We identify the attack surface where an adversary can cheaply automate CAPTCHA solving using off-the-shelf models. We evaluate 7 representative MLLMs on 18 real-world CAPTCHA task types, measuring single-shot accuracy, success under limited retries, end-to-end latency, and per-solve cost. We further validate our findings through a supplemental external dataset and an adaptive-attacker setting with session memory, while also analyzing the impact of task-specific prompt engineering and few-shot demonstrations on solver effectiveness. We reveal that MLLMs can reliably solve recognition-oriented and low-interaction CAPTCHA tasks at human-like cost and latency, whereas tasks requiring fine-grained localization, multi-step spatial reasoning, or cross-frame consistency remain significantly harder for current models. By examining the reasoning traces of such MLLMs, we investigate the underlying mechanisms of why models succeed/fail on specific CAPTCHA puzzles and use these insights to derive defense-oriented guidelines for selecting and strengthening CAPTCHA tasks. To validate these principles, we present a proof-of-concept by hardening a vulnerable CAPTCHA type using our guidelines. We demonstrate that incorporating fine-grained localization and implicit counting reduces the success rate of state-of-the-art MLLMs from over 95% to 0%, confirming that structural changes can effectively mitigate the threat. We conclude by emphasizing the urgent need for CAPTCHA redesign as MLLM capabilities increasingly threaten existing defenses.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文研究了多模态大语言模型（MLLM）如何削弱视觉验证码的安全保障。我们识别了一个攻击面，攻击者可以利用现成模型以低成本自动化破解验证码。我们在18种真实世界的验证码任务类型上评估了7种代表性MLLM，测量了单次尝试准确率、有限重试下的成功率、端到端延迟以及每次破解成本。我们进一步通过一个补充的外部数据集和具有会话记忆的自适应攻击者设置验证了我们的发现，同时分析了任务特定提示工程和少样本演示对求解器有效性的影响。我们发现，MLLM能够以类人的成本和延迟可靠地解决面向识别和低交互的验证码任务，而需要细粒度定位、多步空间推理或跨帧一致性的任务对当前模型仍然困难得多。通过检查这些MLLM的推理轨迹，我们研究了模型在特定验证码谜题上成功/失败背后的机制，并利用这些见解得出用于选择和强化验证码任务的防御导向指南。为了验证这些原则，我们通过使用我们的指南强化一种脆弱的验证码类型来提供概念验证。我们证明，结合细粒度定位和隐式计数可将最先进MLLM的成功率从95%以上降至0%，证实结构性改变可以有效缓解威胁。最后，我们强调，随着MLLM能力日益威胁现有防御，验证码重新设计的紧迫需求。

import_candidates.title: Fuzzing Open-Source GPU Hardware with SIMT Program Generation
import_candidates.abstract:
GPUs have become critical components in computing systems. In the post-Moore's Law era, the demand for performance is driving increasing GPU microarchitectural complexity, which in turn gives rise to new vulnerabilities.
In this paper, we present the first framework for fuzzing GPU hardware designs at the Register Transfer Level (RTL) to automatically discover vulnerabilities. At the core of FuzzGPU is a novel generator that randomly constructs valid SIMT test programs with complex data and control flow, explicitly exercising the GPU execution model and thereby triggering diverse hardware behaviors. This bridges a key gap: prior processor fuzzers predominantly target CPUs and largely ignore GPU hardware. FuzzGPU further implements a GPU-specific differential testing harness. It tackles microarchitectural non-determinism (e.g., caches and memory timing) and enables trace-driven differential testing against an ISA-level oracle. This technique unlocks vulnerability detection and localization with instruction-level precision. We evaluated FuzzGPU on two real-world open-source GPUs, Vortex and Ventus OpenGPGPU, uncovering 20 previously unknown bugs, including 17 RTL bugs and 3 ISS bugs, 10 of which were assigned CVE identifiers.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: GPU已成为计算系统中的关键组件。在后摩尔定律时代，对性能的需求推动GPU微架构复杂性不断增加，进而引发新的漏洞。本文提出了首个用于在寄存器传输级（RTL）模糊测试GPU硬件设计以自动发现漏洞的框架。FuzzGPU的核心是一种新颖的生成器，可随机构建具有复杂数据流和控制流的有效SIMT测试程序，显式地执行GPU执行模型，从而触发多样化的硬件行为。这弥合了一个关键空白：此前的处理器模糊测试器主要针对CPU，并在很大程度上忽略了GPU硬件。FuzzGPU进一步实现了GPU专用的差分测试框架。它解决了微架构非确定性（例如缓存和内存时序），并支持针对ISA级预言机的迹驱动差分测试。该技术实现了指令级精度的漏洞检测与定位。我们在两个真实开源GPU——Vortex和Ventus OpenGPGPU——上评估了FuzzGPU，发现了20个此前未知的缺陷，包括17个RTL缺陷和3个ISS缺陷，其中10个被分配了CVE标识符。

import_candidates.title: Injected and Leaked: Actively Inducing Side-Channel Leakage Using Electromagnetic Injection and Hardware Nonlinearity
import_candidates.abstract: Electromagnetic (EM) side-channel leakage and injection are typically treated as distinct physical phenomena, threatening data confidentiality and integrity respectively. This work investigates how EM injection can be used to amplify side-channel leakage that is otherwise infeasible. We introduce a novel framework for Injection-Induced EM Side Channels to enable integrated, closed-loop EM security analysis. Our theoretical modeling and experimental measurements reveal that nonlinear hardware components, such as ubiquitous amplifiers, analog-to-digital converters, and power converters, can modulate secret electrical signals onto an injected EM carrier and thus upconvert low-frequency secrets into measurable EM emissions. By tuning the injection frequency and amplitude, adversaries gain the ability to actively shape the effective spectrum and entropy of the resulting leakage. We design InjectEave attack and demonstrate eavesdropping on the audio played through wired and wireless headphones from up to 30~m away with accessible RF equipment, as well as in through-wall scenarios, and characterize injection-induced EM leakage of other low-frequency secrets such as power consumption of smart home devices and analog sensor inputs. Case studies further demonstrate how the proposed techniques enable closed-loop eavesdropping and manipulation of landline-phone conversations. Finally, we analyze the broader security challenges and mitigations.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 电磁（EM）侧信道泄漏和注入通常被视为不同的物理现象，分别威胁数据机密性和完整性。这项工作研究了如何利用EM注入来放大原本不可行的侧信道泄漏。我们引入了一个用于注入诱导EM侧信道的新型框架，以实现集成的闭环EM安全分析。我们的理论建模和实验测量表明，非线性硬件组件，如无处不在的放大器、模数转换器和功率转换器，可以将秘密电信号调制到注入的EM载波上，从而将低频秘密上变频为可测量的EM发射。通过调节注入频率和幅度，攻击者能够主动塑造所产生泄漏的有效频谱和熵。我们设计了InjectEave攻击，并演示了从最远30米外使用可获得的RF设备窃听通过有线和无线耳机播放的音频，以及在穿墙场景中窃听，并刻画了其他低频秘密（如智能家居设备的功耗和模拟传感器输入）的注入诱导EM泄漏。案例研究进一步展示了所提出的技术如何实现对固定电话通话的闭环窃听和操纵。最后，我们分析了更广泛的安全挑战和缓解措施。

import_candidates.title: DRVFuzz: Data-Sensitive RISC-V CPU Fuzzing
import_candidates.abstract:
The rapid adoption of RISC-V across modern computing systems has made the security integrity of its implementations a paramount concern. Logic bugs in RISC-V cores can lead to critical failures, such as faulty privilege transitions and architectural state corruption. While hardware fuzzing has emerged as a powerful technique for automated bug discovery, existing frameworks remain largely data-agnostic. By prioritizing instruction sequence diversity while treating operands as incidental random values, these tools often fail to trigger guarded microarchitectural states that manifest only under precise, data-dependent conditions.
In this work, we present DRVFuzz, a data-sensitive fuzzing framework designed to expose hardware vulnerabilities by explicitly modeling and navigating the data-sensitive semantics. First, DRVFuzz introduces a sensitive data model (SDModel) that hierarchically codifies ISA semantics to synthesize tailored operands, including boundary values and exception triggers. Second, to effectively exploring data-dependent paths, DRVFuzz employs transition-guided fuzzing, prioritizing testcases that trigger previously unseen state transitions as labeled by the SDModel. We evaluated DRVFuzz on six real-world RISC-V CPUs with varying microarchitectural complexity, uncovering 22 previously unknown bugs (19 new CVEs).
import_candidates.abstract_zh: RISC-V在现代计算系统中的快速采用，使其实现的安全完整性成为首要关注。RISC-V核心中的逻辑错误可能导致严重故障，例如特权转换错误和架构状态损坏。尽管硬件模糊测试已成为自动发现漏洞的强大技术，现有框架在很大程度上仍是数据无关的。这些工具优先考虑指令序列的多样性，而将操作数视为附带的随机值，因此往往无法触发仅在精确的、数据相关条件下才出现的受保护微架构状态。在这项工作中，我们提出DRVFuzz，一个数据敏感的模糊测试框架，旨在通过显式建模和导航数据敏感的语义来暴露硬件漏洞。首先，DRVFuzz引入敏感数据模型（SDModel），它分层地编码ISA语义以合成定制的操作数，包括边界值和异常触发器。其次，为了有效探索数据相关路径，DRVFuzz采用转换引导的模糊测试，优先选择那些触发SDModel标记的先前未见状态转换的测试用例。我们在六个具有不同微架构复杂度的真实世界RISC-V CPU上评估了DRVFuzz，发现了22个先前未知的漏洞（19个新CVE）。

import_candidates.title: "Tap" Without Tapping: A Tag Discovery Forgery Attack on Android NFC
import_candidates.abstract: Tap-to-X, such as tap-to-pay, which uses an NFC tag tap to trigger the logic flow, is widely used today. Tap-to-X apps treat the tap as proof of user proximity and intent, i.e., the tap is assumed to be intentional and user-aware. On Android, the OS reads data from the tag and eventually dispatches the data to an expected app, yet the security of this post-discovery dispatch process remains under-investigated. In this paper, we analyze Android's post-tap tag dispatch and identify two OS-level design weaknesses that create a semantic origin gap, allowing a local malicious app to mimic a physical tap without any NFC interaction. Exploiting these weaknesses, we develop the tag-dispatch forgery attack (TDFA) and demonstrate that TDFA affects several real-world apps, including Alipay, Huawei AI Life, and Samsung Galaxy Wearable. To measure the impact of TDFA at ecosystem scale, we conduct a large-scale analysis of 76,333 Google Play apps, identify 601 potentially affected apps with externally startable RW handlers, and confirm successful forged delivery in 498 of 597 installable and testable apps through on-device validation. We propose an OS-level fix to fundamentally mitigate TDFA and provide suggestions for app developers while the OS-level mitigation is unavailable. We responsibly reported our findings to relevant stakeholders, including the Android Security team, Alipay, and Huawei. They confirmed and acknowledged the corresponding findings and awarded us 7,000, ¥2,000 (∼300), and ¥4,000 (∼$600) as bug bounties, respectively. Google assigned CVE-2026-0081 to the Android vulnerability.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 点击即执行（Tap-to-X），例如利用NFC标签轻触触发逻辑流程的点击支付（tap-to-pay），如今已被广泛使用。Tap-to-X应用将轻触视为用户邻近和意图的证明，即假定轻触是有意的且用户知情的。在Android上，操作系统从标签读取数据，并最终将数据分派给预期的应用，然而这一发现后分派过程的安全性仍未被充分研究。在本文中，我们分析了Android的轻触后标签分派，并识别出两个操作系统级设计弱点，它们造成了语义来源缺口，使得本地恶意应用能够在没有任何NFC交互的情况下模拟物理轻触。利用这些弱点，我们开发了标签分派伪造攻击（TDFA），并证明TDFA影响多个真实世界应用，包括支付宝、华为AI Life和三星Galaxy Wearable。为了在生态系统规模上衡量TDFA的影响，我们对76,333个Google Play应用进行了大规模分析，识别出601个具有外部可启动RW处理程序的潜在受影响应用，并通过设备上验证确认在597个可安装和可测试的应用中有498个成功实现了伪造投递。我们提出了一种操作系统级修复方案，以从根本上缓解TDFA，并在操作系统级缓解措施不可用时为应用开发者提供建议。我们负责任地向相关利益相关者报告了我们的发现，包括Android安全团队、支付宝和华为。他们确认并认可了相应的发现，并分别授予我们7,000、¥2,000（约300美元）和¥4,000（约600美元）的漏洞赏金。Google为相应Android漏洞分配了CVE-2026-0081。

import_candidates.title: PHANTOM: Undermining Mobile System Availability via Malformed Installation Metadata
import_candidates.abstract:
Modern mobile operating systems rely on package metadata to manage application lifecycles, permissions, and system integration. While these platforms enforce stringent code signing and sandboxing to prevent malicious code execution, they implicitly treat package metadata as benign configuration.
We challenge this assumption by introducing PHANTOM (P ackage-based Harmful Attack via No-code Triggered OS Malfunction), a new class of attacks that weaponizes malformed installation metadata to undermine mobile system availability without executing any code. Our key insight is that package metadata crosses privilege boundaries and is parsed by highly privileged system services during installation and boot, yet lacks systematic validation and robust bounds checking. PHANTOM leverages four attack primitives—long string injection, repetitive tag construction, signature chain inflation, and indirect resource references—to trigger resource exhaustion, inter-process communication (IPC) buffer overflows, and unhandled exceptions in critical system components. Crucially, PHANTOM requires no code execution: the attack activates as soon as a crafted package reaches a valid installation path, and severe effects can recur at boot when static metadata is re-parsed.
We systematically evaluate PHANTOM across Android and iOS, testing 979 configuration fields through a two-phase methodology combining documentation-driven and source-code-driven analysis. We identify 65 exploitable attack vectors (33 in Android and 32 in iOS) capable of causing impacts ranging from partial service disruption to persistent boot loops requiring factory reset or Device Firmware Update (DFU) reflashing with complete data loss. Notably, on iOS, an enterprise-signed iPhone Application Archive (IPA) delivered through a valid installation channel such as AirDrop can trigger metadata parsing before application launch or execution trust, creating a proximal persistent denial-of-service (DoS) risk. We responsibly disclosed our findings to Google and Apple, resulting in five CVE assignments. Several of our proposed mitigations have been integrated into production systems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代移动操作系统依赖包元数据来管理应用程序生命周期、权限和系统集成。虽然这些平台执行严格的代码签名和沙箱机制以防止恶意代码执行，但它们隐含地将包元数据视为良性配置。我们挑战这一假设，提出了PHANTOM（Package-based Harmful Attack via No-code Triggered OS Malfunction），这是一类新的攻击，利用畸形的安装元数据来破坏移动系统可用性，且无需执行任何代码。我们的核心见解是：包元数据跨越权限边界，并在安装和启动期间由高权限系统服务解析，却缺乏系统化验证和健壮的边界检查。PHANTOM利用四种攻击原语——长字符串注入、重复标签构造、签名链膨胀和间接资源引用——在关键系统组件中触发资源耗尽、进程间通信（IPC）缓冲区溢出和未处理异常。关键的是，PHANTOM无需代码执行：一旦精心构造的包到达有效安装路径，攻击就会激活，并且当静态元数据在启动时被重新解析时，严重效果可能再次出现。我们系统地评估了PHANTOM在Android和iOS上的表现，通过结合文档驱动和源代码驱动的两阶段方法测试了979个配置字段。我们识别出65个可利用的攻击向量（Android中33个，iOS中32个），能够造成从部分服务中断到持续启动循环的影响，后者需要恢复出厂设置或设备固件更新（DFU）重新刷写，并导致完全数据丢失。值得注意的是，在iOS上，通过AirDrop等有效安装渠道传递的企业签名iPhone应用程序归档（IPA）可以在应用程序启动或执行信任之前触发元数据解析，从而造成近端持续拒绝服务（DoS）风险。我们负责任地向谷歌和苹果披露了我们的发现，共获得五个CVE编号。我们提出的一些缓解措施已被集成到生产系统中。

import_candidates.title: AutoFail: Breaking Web Boundaries using Android's Autofill Framework
import_candidates.abstract:
Password managers (PWMs) are widely used to improve both usability and security in password-based authentication. On Android, PWMs typically rely on the Autofill Framework (AF) to provide automatic credential filling in native applications and web browsers. The AF acts as an intermediary between apps and PWMs by offering a unified interface for credential extraction and injection. However, web content does not natively match the object structure expected by the AF, which forces browsers to translate a website's Document Object Model (DOM) into an Android-specific representation. This translation step introduces a complex and security-sensitive layer in the autofill pipeline.
In this paper, we present the first systematic security analysis of Android's Autofill Framework pipeline. We introduce ADAPT, a differential-testing based approach that enables an end-to-end inspection of the autofill flow, from the browser's DOM translation process to the PWM's credential matching and filling logic. We identify multiple critical vulnerabilities affecting 9 password managers and 5 widely used mobile browsers. These flaws allow attackers to leak credentials to attacker-controlled origins, bypass web isolation mechanisms, and infer user account relationships across services. We precisely define preconditions for the attacks and evaluate their prevalence in the wild.
We also propose concrete mitigations and a standardized design for secure DOM translation and context-aware credential filling. We disclosed our findings to the affected vendors. Major browser and password manager developers have confirmed our results and are implementing the suggested fixes.
import_candidates.abstract_zh:
密码管理器（PWM）被广泛用于提升基于密码的身份验证的可用性和安全性。在Android上，PWM通常依赖自动填充框架（AF）在原生应用和网页浏览器中提供自动凭据填充。AF通过提供统一的凭据提取和注入接口，充当应用与PWM之间的中介。然而，Web内容并不原生匹配AF期望的对象结构，这迫使浏览器将网站的文档对象模型（DOM）转换为Android特定的表示。这一转换步骤在自动填充管道中引入了一个复杂且安全敏感的层。
在本文中，我们首次对Android自动填充框架管道进行了系统性安全分析。我们提出ADAPT，一种基于差分测试的方法，能够对自动填充流程进行端到端检查，从浏览器的DOM转换过程到PWM的凭据匹配与填充逻辑。我们识别出影响9个密码管理器和5个广泛使用的移动浏览器的多个严重漏洞。这些缺陷允许攻击者将凭据泄露给攻击者控制的源、绕过Web隔离机制，并推断跨服务的用户账户关系。我们精确定义了攻击的前置条件，并评估了它们在真实环境中的普遍性。
我们还提出了具体缓解措施以及用于安全DOM转换和上下文感知凭据填充的标准化设计。我们向受影响的供应商披露了发现。主要浏览器和密码管理器开发者已确认我们的结果，并正在实施建议的修复。

import_candidates.title: SoK: History Doesn't Repeat Itself, but Android Design-Level Vulnerabilities Rhyme in OpenHarmony
import_candidates.abstract:
The dominant market share of Android across the world has led to significant scrutiny by security researchers. Over the years, many security issues were identified and remedied not only in its implementation but also in its design. Interestingly, academia has not further systematized these design flaws. This is an important gap, especially as many phone vendors have recently begun developing their own mobile operating systems (OSes). While they do not necessarily reuse the code of Android, they may share much of its design as they often use Android as a starting point. A prime example is Huawei's new OS, OpenHarmony, which has been deployed on over one billion devices, but its security has not been studied in academia. We posit that the Design-Level Vulnerabilities in Android can affect these emerging mobile OSes, leaving their users at risk.
In this paper, we systematically study Design-Level Vulnerabilities in Android and how they affect emerging mobile OSes. First, we review 116 publications on Android from industry and academia, and we extract 56 unique vulnerabilities reported in Android's design. For each, we identify a reusable auditing methodology to enable testing of emerging mobile OSes. In a second step, we apply our auditing methodologies to OpenHarmony and demonstrate that OpenHarmony is vulnerable to 24 of the vulnerabilities, including ones that compromise user privacy, enable stealthy privilege escalation, and undermine overall system reliability.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Android在全球市场的主导份额引发了安全研究人员的广泛审视。多年来，许多安全问题不仅在其实现中，而且在其设计中得到了识别和修复。有趣的是，学术界尚未进一步系统化这些设计缺陷。这是一个重要的空白，尤其是因为许多手机厂商最近开始开发自己的移动操作系统（OS）。虽然它们不一定重用Android的代码，但它们可能共享其大部分设计，因为它们通常以Android为起点。一个典型的例子是华为的新操作系统OpenHarmony，它已部署在超过十亿台设备上，但其安全性尚未在学术界得到研究。我们假定Android中的设计级漏洞可能影响这些新兴移动操作系统，使其用户面临风险。在本文中，我们系统地研究了Android中的设计级漏洞以及它们如何影响新兴移动操作系统。首先，我们回顾了来自工业界和学术界的116篇关于Android的出版物，并提取了Android设计中报告的56个独特漏洞。对于每个漏洞，我们确定了一种可重用的审计方法，以便测试新兴移动操作系统。在第二步中，我们将审计方法应用于OpenHarmony，并证明OpenHarmony容易受到其中24个漏洞的影响，包括危及用户隐私、实现隐蔽权限提升和破坏整体系统可靠性的漏洞。

import_candidates.title: Health Hazard, Handle with Care: Investigating the Privacy Risks of Android's Health Connect
import_candidates.abstract: Android's Health Connect framework was recently introduced to unify health and fitness data management across apps, promising transparency, user control, and privacy through on-device storage and fine-grained permissions. In this paper, we present the first empirical investigation of Health Connect and show that its design suffers from inherent flaws that introduce serious privacy risks, including the creation of a covert communication channel that can be used to bypass existing access control mechanisms. Accordingly, we use dynamic analysis to systematically examine Health Connect apps, and uncover widespread privacy-invasive behaviors. We find that 60.9% of apps fail to comply with Health Connect's UI data transparency guidelines, and 25.6% do not report the collection or sharing of health records. Additionally, 19.6% of the apps exfiltrate Health Connect data (including records generated by other apps) over the network, combining health information (e.g., blood pressure) with personally identifiable data such as names, emails, Advertising IDs, and phone numbers. These practices violate Google's policies and undermine user expectations of control. We disclosed our findings to Android's Health Connect team, who verified our findings and informed us that our research allowed them to strengthen their review and policy enforcement processes, and take action against bad actors. While this is a step in the right direction, our research demonstrates that Health Connect's design falls short of its stated goals and, ultimately, undermines the privacy protections Android has introduced in recent years.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Android的Health Connect框架最近被引入，以统一跨应用的健康和健身数据管理，承诺通过设备端存储和细粒度权限实现透明度、用户控制和隐私。在本文中，我们首次对Health Connect进行实证研究，并表明其设计存在固有缺陷，引入了严重的隐私风险，包括创建了一个可用于绕过现有访问控制机制的隐蔽通信通道。因此，我们使用动态分析系统地检查Health Connect应用，并揭示了普遍存在的隐私侵犯行为。我们发现，60.9%的应用未遵守Health Connect的UI数据透明性指南，25.6%未报告健康记录的收集或共享。此外，19.6%的应用通过网络外泄Health Connect数据（包括其他应用生成的记录），将健康信息（如血压）与个人可识别数据（如姓名、电子邮件、广告ID和电话号码）结合。这些做法违反了Google的政策，并破坏了用户对控制的期望。我们向Android的Health Connect团队披露了发现，他们验证了我们的发现，并告知我们，我们的研究使他们能够加强审查和政策执行流程，并对不良行为者采取行动。虽然这是朝着正确方向迈出的一步，但我们的研究表明，Health Connect的设计未能达到其宣称的目标，并最终削弱了Android近年来引入的隐私保护。

import_candidates.title: Plain Text, Plain Risks: Measuring HTTP Inclusion in Android WebViews at Scale
import_candidates.abstract:
While the widespread adoption of HTTPS and browser-based visual warnings for HTTP content has largely mitigated machine-in-the-middle (MitM) attacks on the traditional Web, the mobile ecosystem presents a different situation. Web content embedded via the Android WebView component commonly lacks these built-in visual security indicators and grants apps granular control over transport-layer security. This flexibility raises a critical question: does the mobile-Web ecosystem keep up with the advancements of the modern Web?
In this paper, we perform the first large-scale analysis of HTTP inclusion in WebViews across 189,779 Google Play apps. Despite Android's default policy of blocking HTTP traffic, we find that 33.74% of apps explicitly opt out. Dynamic analysis of 35,000 apps reveals that 69.96% of apps that opt out also relax the Mixed Content Policy, and we observe active HTTP traffic in 2,790. The security impact of these configurations is severe. We identify high-profile apps with 10M+ installations vulnerable to attacks ranging from phishing to full app takeover. Furthermore, we identify a major ad library transmitting cleartext ads, exposing billions of users to MitM attacks. We conclude with a qualitative developer study revealing that insecure practices are frequently driven by the requirements of third-party ad libraries and misconceptions regarding WebView's security configuration modes.
import_candidates.abstract_zh:
尽管HTTPS的广泛采用以及浏览器针对HTTP内容的视觉警告已大大缓解了传统Web上的中间人（MitM）攻击，但移动生态系统呈现出不同的情况。通过Android WebView组件嵌入的Web内容通常缺乏这些内置的视觉安全指示器，并赋予应用对传输层安全的细粒度控制。这种灵活性引发了一个关键问题：移动Web生态系统是否跟上了现代Web的进步？
在本文中，我们对189,779个Google Play应用中的WebView HTTP包含进行了首次大规模分析。尽管Android默认策略阻止HTTP流量，但我们发现33.74%的应用明确选择退出。对35,000个应用的动态分析显示，选择退出的应用中69.96%还放宽了混合内容策略，并且我们在2,790个应用中观察到活跃的HTTP流量。这些配置的安全影响是严重的。我们识别出安装量超过1000万的高知名度应用容易受到从钓鱼到完全应用接管等攻击。此外，我们发现一个主要广告库传输明文广告，使数十亿用户暴露于MitM攻击。最后，我们进行了一项定性开发者研究，揭示不安全做法通常由第三方广告库的需求以及对WebView安全配置模式的误解所驱动。

import_candidates.title: SoK: DARPA's AI Cyber Challenge (AIxCC): Competition Design, Architectures, and Lessons Learned
import_candidates.abstract: DARPA's AI Cyber Challenge (AIxCC, 2023--2025) is the largest competition to date for building fully autonomous cyber reasoning systems (CRSs) that leverage recent advances in AI --- particularly large language models (LLMs) --- to discover and remediate vulnerabilities in real-world open-source software. This paper presents the first systematic analysis of AIxCC. Drawing on design documents, source code, execution traces, and discussions with organizers and competing teams, we examine the competition's structure and key design decisions, characterize the architectural approaches of finalist CRSs, and analyze competition results beyond the final scoreboard. Our analysis reveals the factors that truly drove CRS performance, identifies genuine technical advances achieved by teams, and exposes limitations that remain open for future research. We conclude with lessons for organizing future competitions and broader insights toward deploying autonomous CRSs in practice.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: DARPA的人工智能网络挑战赛（AIxCC，2023--2025）是迄今为止规模最大的竞赛，旨在构建完全自主的网络推理系统（CRSs），利用人工智能（特别是大型语言模型，LLMs）的最新进展来发现和修复现实世界开源软件中的漏洞。本文首次对AIxCC进行系统性分析。基于设计文档、源代码、执行轨迹以及与组织者和参赛团队的讨论，我们考察了竞赛的结构和关键设计决策，刻画了决赛入围CRS的架构方法，并分析了最终排行榜之外的竞赛结果。我们的分析揭示了真正驱动CRS性能的因素，识别了各团队取得的真正技术进步，并暴露了未来研究仍待解决的局限性。最后，我们总结了组织未来竞赛的经验教训，以及关于在实践中部署自主CRS的更广泛见解。

import_candidates.title: Towards Generality: Task-Adaptive Binary Analysis via Semantic Retrieval and Verifiable Reasoning
import_candidates.abstract:
Stripped binaries dominate real-world security analysis: COTS software, firmware, and malware are released without symbols, obscuring program semantics. Recent LLM-based approaches target narrowly predefined tasks, limiting applicability in intent-driven analysis. Toward general binary analysis, agentic LLMs provide a natural direction, yet achieving generality remains challenging: query intent is hard to ground in stripped binaries, and effective tool-driven analysis is difficult.
We present BINREX, the first agentic framework for general, fully automated static binary analysis. BINREX employs a dual-encoder pipeline to enrich stripped functions with semantic context, paired with hierarchical planning to decompose intents into executable subtasks. It leverages code synthesis to translate subtasks into IDAPython scripts, executed with iterative validation to produce outputs aggregated into the final report.
We evaluate BINREX on BinREval, a benchmark of 72 tasks across seven COTS categories with machine-checkable oracles. BINREX achieves 83.3% success rate, outperforming baselines (Codex: 27.8%, Codex with IDA: 43.1%) while reducing total analysis time from 87.9 to 36.1 hours. On domain benchmarks (Juliet, NYU CTF), BINREX is competitive with task-specific methods on their respective evaluation settings. Human study and industrial deployment confirm practical value: BINREX identifies 395 unknown malware samples with 96× average efficiency gain over experts.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 剥离符号的二进制文件在现实世界的安全分析中占主导地位：商业现成软件、固件和恶意软件在发布时都不带符号，掩盖了程序语义。最近的基于LLM的方法针对狭窄预定义任务，限制了在意图驱动分析中的适用性。走向通用二进制分析，智能体LLM提供了一个自然方向，但实现通用性仍然具有挑战性：查询意图难以在剥离符号的二进制文件中落地，而有效的工具驱动分析也很困难。我们提出BINREX，这是首个用于通用、全自动静态二进制分析的智能体框架。BINREX采用双编码器流水线，用语义上下文丰富剥离符号的函数，并结合分层规划将意图分解为可执行子任务。它利用代码合成将子任务转换为IDAPython脚本，通过迭代验证执行，将输出聚合成最终报告。我们在BinREval上评估BINREX，这是一个包含72个任务、跨越七个COTS类别、带有机器可检查预言机的基准。BINREX达到83.3%的成功率，优于基线（Codex：27.8%，Codex加IDA：43.1%），同时将总分析时间从87.9小时减少到36.1小时。在领域基准（Juliet、NYU CTF）上，BINREX在其各自的评估设置中与任务特定方法具有竞争力。人类研究和工业部署证实了实用价值：BINREX识别出395个未知恶意软件样本，平均效率比专家提高96倍。

import_candidates.title: Melting the Flesh of PHP's Memory Hardening
import_candidates.abstract: Heap allocators are responsible for efficiently allocating or releasing memory on the heap. In addition, they also commonly implement various mitigation measures to defend against heap-based memory corruption. Recently, the PHP project launched a heap hardening initiative aimed at stopping popular heap exploit techniques or restricting the exploit strategy space. In this paper, we conduct the first security study to understand the impact and effectiveness of these new protective measures. We find that while they are effective at stopping current-generation exploits, they fall short against determined attackers who will adapt. Through our analysis, we not only identify the flaw that allows specific mitigations to be bypassed, but also a new suite of novel exploitation strategies that work for the most common vulnerabilities involving out-of-bounds memory write and use-after-free write primitives. Notably, our strategy is generic across the built-in PHP objects and can still work even with a single-byte out-of-bounds memory write primitive. Finally, we evaluate our exploit strategies against five real vulnerabilities in an environment with all evaluated protections enabled. The results show that although the new protection measures can effectively defend against the exploitation of most vulnerabilities, the attack strategies proposed by this work can still make these vulnerabilities exploitable again. The identified flaw has since been patched after our responsible disclosure.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 堆分配器负责高效地在堆上分配或释放内存。此外，它们通常还实现各种缓解措施，以防御基于堆的内存破坏。最近，PHP 项目发起了一项堆加固计划，旨在阻止流行的堆利用技术或限制利用策略空间。在本文中，我们开展了首个安全性研究，以理解这些新保护措施的影响和有效性。我们发现，尽管它们能有效阻止当前一代的利用，但对于会适应调整的坚定攻击者仍显不足。通过分析，我们不仅识别出允许特定缓解措施被绕过的缺陷，还提出了一套新颖的利用策略，适用于涉及越界内存写入和释放后使用写入原语的最常见漏洞。值得注意的是，我们的策略在 PHP 内置对象上具有通用性，甚至仅凭单字节越界内存写入原语也能奏效。最后，我们在启用所有评估保护措施的环境中，针对五个真实漏洞评估了我们的利用策略。结果表明，尽管新保护措施能有效防御大多数漏洞的利用，但本工作提出的攻击策略仍可使这些漏洞重新可被利用。所识别的缺陷已在我们的负责任披露后得到修补。

import_candidates.title: Retrofit: Continual Learning with Controlled Forgetting for Binary Security Detection and Analysis
import_candidates.abstract:
Binary security has increasingly relied on deep learning to reason about malware behavior and program semantics. However, the performance often degrades as threat landscapes evolve and code representations shift. While continual learning (CL) offers a natural solution through sequential updates, most existing approaches rely on data replay or unconstrained updates, limiting their applicability and effectiveness in data-sensitive security environments. We propose RETROFIT, which regulates knowledge retention and adaptation with controlled forgetting at each update, without requiring historical data. Our key idea is to consolidate previously trained and newly fine-tuned models, serving as teachers of legacy and emergent knowledge, through retrospective-free parameter merging. Forgetting control is achieved by 1) constraining parameter changes to low-rank and sparse subspaces for approximate orthogonality, and 2) employing a confidence-guided arbitration mechanism to dynamically aggregate knowledge from both teachers.
Our evaluation on two representative applications demonstrates that RETROFIT consistently mitigates forgetting while maintaining adaptability. In malware detection under temporal drift, it substantially improves the retention score, from 20.2% to 38.6% over CL baselines, and exceeds the oracle upper bound on new data. In binary summarization across decompilation levels, where analyzing stripped binaries is especially challenging, RETROFIT achieves over 2x the BLEU score of transfer learning used in prior work and surpasses all baselines in cross-representation generalization.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 二进制安全越来越依赖深度学习来推理恶意软件行为和程序语义。然而，随着威胁格局演变和代码表示发生变化，性能往往会下降。虽然持续学习（CL）通过顺序更新提供了自然的解决方案，但大多数现有方法依赖数据回放或无约束更新，限制了其在数据敏感的安全环境中的适用性和有效性。我们提出了RETROFIT，它在每次更新时通过受控遗忘来调节知识保留与适应，且不需要历史数据。我们的核心思想是通过无回顾的参数合并，整合先前训练和新微调的模型，分别作为遗留知识和新兴知识的教师。遗忘控制通过以下方式实现：1）将参数变化约束在低秩和稀疏子空间以实现近似正交性，2）采用置信度引导的仲裁机制动态聚合来自两个教师的知识。我们在两个代表性应用上的评估表明，RETROFIT在保持适应性的同时持续缓解遗忘。在时间漂移下的恶意软件检测中，它将保留分数从20.2%显著提高到38.6%，超过CL基线，并在新数据上超过了oracle上界。在跨反编译级别的二进制摘要中，分析剥离二进制文件尤其具有挑战性，RETROFIT的BLEU分数达到先前工作中迁移学习的2倍以上，并在跨表示泛化方面超越了所有基线。

import_candidates.title: Butterfly: Scalable Multi-Party Circuit-PSI via Triplet Zero-Sharing
import_candidates.abstract:
Multi-party circuit private set intersection (MP-CPSI) enables m parties to compute the intersection of their private sets in secret-shared form, facilitating secure downstream computations. However, existing protocols face severe efficiency bottlenecks: they either rely on generic circuit-based approaches (e.g., Sort-Compare-Shuffle) that incur prohibitive non-linear complexity, or they aggregate pairwise two-party protocols using full-scale m-party MPC, where the communication cost scales super-linearly with the number of participants.
In this work, we propose Butterfly, a highly scalable MP-CPSI protocol that achieves the communication cost of each party independent of the number of parties m and linear in the set size n. Our construction reduces the general m-party problem to an honest-majority three-party committee via a novel dual-execution blueprint and triplet zero-sharing, leveraging only efficient key-value stores (KVS) and symmetric-key operations. Furthermore, our protocol decouples the complexity of downstream generic computations from m, allowing the subsequent circuits to be evaluated using efficient generic honest-majority three-party computations among the committee (the "body"), while the other m-3 clients (the "wings") achieve only one-shot communication and are dropout-tolerant. The security of our protocol relies on the non-collusion assumption among the committee and is secure against any adversary corrupting arbitrary clients and at most one committee party. We further provide an efficient extension of our protocol to support associated payloads, enabling downstream complex analytics with practical efficiency. 
Compared to the state-of-the-art baselines without non-collusion assumptions, our protocol achieves up to 10130× and 3231× reductions in communication and running time, respectively, for m=30. In the special case of m=3, our protocol requires 4× less communication and runs 14× faster than the honest-majority baseline in the same model. We separately evaluate our protocol in large-scale settings, which runs in just 2.66 (resp. 65.5) seconds under a 10Gbps (resp. 200Mbps) network for 120 parties each holding 220 items, incurring only 1405 MB communication costs in total.
import_candidates.abstract_zh:
多方电路私有集合交集（MP-CPSI）使 m 个参与方能够以秘密共享形式计算其私有集合的交集，从而促进安全的下游计算。然而，现有协议面临严重的效率瓶颈：它们要么依赖通用电路方法（例如 Sort-Compare-Shuffle），导致难以承受的非线性复杂度；要么使用全规模 m 方 MPC 来聚合两两双方协议，其中通信成本随参与方数量超线性增长。
在这项工作中，我们提出 Butterfly，一种高度可扩展的 MP-CPSI 协议，使得每个参与方的通信成本与参与方数量 m 无关，且与集合大小 n 呈线性关系。我们的构造通过一种新颖的双重执行蓝图和三元组零共享，将一般 m 方问题归约到一个诚实多数三方委员会，仅利用高效的键值存储（KVS）和对称密钥操作。此外，我们的协议将下游通用计算的复杂度与 m 解耦，允许后续电路在委员会（“主体”）中通过高效的通用诚实多数三方计算进行评估，而其他 m-3 个客户端（“翼”）仅需一次性通信且可容忍掉线。我们协议的安全性依赖于委员会之间的非合谋假设，并且能够安全抵御腐败任意客户端和至多一个委员会方的对手。我们进一步提供协议的高效扩展以支持关联载荷，从而以实际效率支持下游复杂分析。
与没有非合谋假设的最先进基线相比，对于 m=30，我们的协议在通信和运行时间上分别实现了高达 10130 倍和 3231 倍的降低。在 m=3 的特殊情况下，我们的协议比同一模型下的诚实多数基线所需通信少 4 倍，运行速度快 14 倍。我们单独在大规模设置中评估了我们的协议，在 10Gbps（或 200Mbps）网络下，对于 120 个各持有 2^20 个条目的参与方，其运行时间仅为 2.66（或 65.5）秒，总通信成本仅为 1405 MB。

import_candidates.title: Enhanced Private Set Union from Secret-shared Private Membership Test
import_candidates.abstract:
Private set union (PSU) enables two parties to compute the union of their sets without revealing additional information. Jia et al. (USENIX Security 2024) point out that most scalable PSU protocols suffer from during-execution leakage, whereby membership information is revealed to the receiver before the protocol completes, and consequently introduce the functionality of enhanced PSU to mitigate this issue. While several recent works propose protocols for enhanced PSU, existing solutions either incur high computational overhead due to reliance on computation-intensive public-key primitives, or suffer from large communication costs arising from generic secure computation.
In this work, we present a modular framework for constructing enhanced PSU based on the multi-query secret-shared private membership test (ssPMT) protocol (ASIACRYPT 2023) and a new primitive called secret-shared oblivious transfer with default (ssOTd). Our framework eliminates duringexecution leakage by ensuring that all intermediate information remains secret-shared between the parties throughout the protocol. At its core, we present two efficient ssPMT constructions relying primarily on lightweight symmetric-key primitives. We further design a customized, communication-efficient ssOTd protocol to optimize the overhead of enhanced PSU. As a byproduct, we obtain a computation-efficient construction of multi-query reverse PMT (mqRPMT) that avoids the computation-heavy public-key primitives used in the stateof-the-art approaches.
We implement two enhanced PSU protocols, denoted as ePSU-fast and ePSU-low, which are optimized for computational efficiency and communication efficiency, respectively, making them suitable for different network settings. Extensive evaluations show that ePSU-low simultaneously achieves lower computation and communication overhead than the state-of-the-art protocols by Jia et al. (USENIX Security 2024) and Tu et al. (USENIX Security 2025). Moreover, the ePSUfast protocol further reduces computation costs compared to ePSU-low, at the expense of increased communication.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 隐私集合求并（PSU）使两方能够计算其集合的并集而不泄露额外信息。Jia等人（USENIX Security 2024）指出，大多数可扩展的PSU协议在执行期间存在泄露，即在协议完成之前成员信息就被泄露给接收方，并因此引入了增强PSU的功能来缓解此问题。虽然最近有几项工作提出了增强PSU的协议，但现有解决方案要么因依赖计算密集型的公钥原语而带来高计算开销，要么因通用安全计算而产生大量通信成本。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个模块化框架，用于基于多查询秘密共享私有成员测试（ssPMT）协议（ASIACRYPT 2023）和一个称为带默认值的秘密共享不经意传输（ssOTd）的新原语来构建增强PSU。我们的框架通过确保所有中间信息在整个协议过程中始终在双方之间秘密共享，从而消除了执行期间泄露。其核心是我们提出了两种高效的ssPMT构造，主要依赖轻量级对称密钥原语。我们进一步设计了一种定制的、通信高效的ssOTd协议，以优化增强PSU的开销。作为副产品，我们获得了一种计算高效的多查询反向PMT（mqRPMT）构造，避免了当前最先进方法中使用的计算量大的公钥原语。我们实现了两种增强PSU协议，分别称为ePSU-fast和ePSU-low，它们分别针对计算效率和通信效率进行了优化，适用于不同的网络设置。大量评估表明，ePSU-low同时实现了比Jia等人（USENIX Security 2024）和Tu等人（USENIX Security 2025）的最先进协议更低的计算和通信开销。此外，ePSU-fast协议与ePSU-low相比进一步降低了计算成本，但代价是通信量增加。

import_candidates.title: SING: Improving the Efficiency of MPC Protocol Assignment using Graph Neural Networks
import_candidates.abstract:
Secure Multi-Party Computation (MPC) enables private computation, but has significantly higher overhead than plaintext execution. Hybrid MPC compilers improve concrete efficiency by mapping distinct computation parts to contextually optimal MPC protocols. However, state-of-the-art systems like Silph (Chen et al., S&P'23) depend on deployment-specific cost models that are cumbersome to retune, and compute mappings via brittle heuristics or costly Integer Linear Programming (ILP), limiting scalability and portability across protocols and deployment settings.
We present SING, the first machine-learning-based framework for hybrid MPC share assignment. SING leverages Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for: (1) imitation of Silph's assignments, accelerating share assignment by up to 76,697x with comparable quality; and (2) cost-driven learning, where we train a GNN cost predictor on synthetic or empirical costs (e.g., runtime or communication), freeze it, and train the share-assigning GNN to minimize predicted costs. The latter supports expressive non-linear cost models, avoiding ILP's linearity constraints, and enables retargeting to new protocol suites and deployment settings by re-fitting the predictor. Finally, we release our synthetic benchmark resources, including a dataset of 704 MPC circuits with wide-ranging hybrid assignments.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 安全多方计算（MPC）使私有计算成为可能，但开销显著高于明文执行。混合MPC编译器通过将不同计算部分映射到上下文最优的MPC协议来提高具体效率。然而，Silph（Chen et al., S&P'23）等最先进系统依赖特定部署的成本模型，重新调整十分繁琐，并且通过脆弱启发式或昂贵的整数线性规划（ILP）计算映射，限制了可扩展性以及跨协议和部署设置的便携性。我们提出SING，首个基于机器学习的混合MPC份额分配框架。SING利用图神经网络（GNN）进行：(1) 模仿Silph的分配，将份额分配加速高达76,697倍且质量相当；(2) 成本驱动学习，我们在合成或经验成本（例如运行时间或通信）上训练GNN成本预测器，冻结它，并训练份额分配GNN以最小化预测成本。后者支持表达性非线性成本模型，避免ILP的线性约束，并可通过重新拟合预测器重定向到新协议套件和部署设置。最后，我们发布合成基准资源，包括一个包含704个MPC电路及广泛混合分配的数据集。

import_candidates.title: FLOSS: Fast Linear Online Secret-Shared Shuffling
import_candidates.abstract: Randomly permuting secret data vectors is a core building block in many privacy-preserving protocols, including those for analytics, advertising, and communication. Existing approaches either rely on computation-heavy public key cryptography and zero-knowledge proofs or scale poorly for large vectors due to use of a quasilinear-sized permutation network. This work presents a preprocessing approach to enable fast linear-time online shuffles in the malicious-secure two-party computation (2PC) setting. We propose FLOSS, a 2PC protocol for securely computing any interactive arithmetic permutation circuit, a notion we introduce to capture how higher level protocols are built on secret-shared field arithmetic and permutations. We show how secret-shared sorting (a subprotocol in data analytics) can be described as an arithmetic permutation circuit, and can thus be compiled to an efficient online 2PC protocol using FLOSS. Our implementation and evaluation confirm FLOSS performs online shuffles fast: shuffling 2^20 elements in under 500ms, greater than 800× faster than state-of-the-art alternatives.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随机置换秘密数据向量是许多隐私保护协议的核心构建模块，包括用于分析、广告和通信的协议。现有方法要么依赖计算密集的公钥密码学和零知识证明，要么由于使用准线性大小的置换网络而难以扩展到大型向量。本文提出一种预处理方法，以在恶意安全的两方计算（2PC）设置中实现快速线性时间的在线混洗。我们提出FLOSS，一种用于安全计算任何交互式算术置换电路的2PC协议，我们引入这一概念来刻画更高级别协议如何构建在秘密共享域算术和置换之上。我们展示了秘密共享排序（数据分析中的子协议）如何可以描述为算术置换电路，并因此可以使用FLOSS编译为高效的在线2PC协议。我们的实现和评估证实FLOSS执行在线混洗很快：在500毫秒内混洗2^20个元素，比最先进的替代方案快800倍以上。

import_candidates.title: Lighthouse: Single-Server Secure Aggregation with O(1) Server-Committee Communication at Scale
import_candidates.abstract:
Secure aggregation is a core primitive for privacy-preserving federated learning, enabling a server to compute aggregates of client updates without learning individual inputs. Recent protocols have explored committee-based designs to reduce client overhead and tolerate weakly connected participants. However, existing approaches still incur communication and computation costs that scale with the number of clients and/or the size of model updates. This becomes a serious bottleneck in interaction between the server and the committee, given that model updates are high-dimensional and the committee is a small set of clients.
We present Lighthouse, a new secure aggregation protocol that supports one-shot client communication and achieves constant committee computation and communication overhead with the server, independent of both the number of clients and the size of the input vector. Our protocol attains the best-known round complexity of two rounds, matching OPA (CRYPTO 2025) and TACITA (ePrint 2025) and improving upon Flamingo (S&P 2023) and Willow (CRYPTO 2025). Our core technical contribution is a novel application of recent advances in batched threshold encryption, which enables succinct server–committee interaction while preserving security and correctness. Beyond asymptotic improvements over prior works, Lighthouse yields substantial concrete efficiency gains: For an aggregation with 1024 clients, we reduce server-to-committee communication by over 100× and committee-to-server communication by over 300× compared to Flamingo and Willow. Also, we present an extension that supports dynamic client participation, a critical requirement for practical deployments at scale, while preserving the asymptotic and concrete efficiency of the static protocol for clients.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 安全聚合是隐私保护联邦学习的核心原语，使服务器能够计算客户端更新的聚合值，而无需获知单个输入。近期协议探索了基于委员会的设计，以降低客户端开销并容忍弱连接参与者。然而，现有方法仍会产生随客户端数量和/或模型更新规模而增长的通信与计算成本。鉴于模型更新是高维的且委员会是小型客户端集合，这成为服务器与委员会之间交互的严重瓶颈。我们提出Lighthouse，一种新的安全聚合协议，支持一次性客户端通信，并实现与服务器之间恒定的委员会计算与通信开销，且不依赖于客户端数量与输入向量规模。我们的协议达到已知最佳的两轮轮复杂度，与OPA (CRYPTO 2025)和TACITA (ePrint 2025)相当，并优于Flamingo (S&P 2023)和Willow (CRYPTO 2025)。我们的核心技术贡献是对近期批量阈值加密进展的新颖应用，从而在保持安全性和正确性的同时实现简洁的服务器-委员会交互。除了对先前工作的渐近改进外，Lighthouse还带来显著的具体效率提升：对于1024个客户端的聚合，与Flamingo和Willow相比，我们将服务器到委员会的通信降低超过100倍，委员会到服务器的通信降低超过300倍。此外，我们提出一种支持动态客户端参与的扩展，这是大规模实际部署的关键需求，同时为客户端保持静态协议的渐近和具体效率。

import_candidates.title: Revelio: A Global Study of VoIP Blocking
import_candidates.abstract:
Online censorship has substantially increased over the past decade. While prior work on censorship detection has largely focused on the web, the landscape and mechanisms of VoIP censorship remain poorly understood.
This work presents the first global study of VoIP blocking by introducing Revelio, a system that systematically detects and comprehensively analyzes VoIP censorship at scale. Unlike the only prior work, which is limited to two countries and requires authors to travel to conduct measurements, Revelio remotely uncovers VoIP blocking by carefully crafting probe packets and strategically leveraging IP address space within target countries, enabling detection of otherwise invisible VoIP censorship.
Using Revelio, we studied 71 countries, covering 11 widely used VoIP applications. Our findings reveal evidence of VoIP blocking in 19 countries, primarily through targeted interference with the STUN traffic. By studying packet traces, we reverse-engineer censorship behavior and uncover four classes and six subtypes of middleboxes that trigger on unique application-specific STUN packets. We further analyze domain-level blocking at the HTTP and HTTPS layers, revealing cases where only VoIP calling is blocked while messaging remains accessible.
Overall, our study advances the understanding of the privacy and censorship community by providing the first comprehensive, global view of an understudied yet highly prevalent form of censorship. We release our code to support reproducibility and future research.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 过去十年中，在线审查显著增加。尽管此前关于审查检测的工作主要集中于Web，但VoIP审查的格局和机制仍然鲜为人知。这项工作通过引入Revelio，提出了首个VoIP封锁的全球研究，Revelio是一个能够大规模系统地检测并全面分析VoIP审查的系统。与唯一一项先前工作（仅限于两个国家，且需要作者亲自前往进行测量）不同，Revelio通过精心构造探测数据包并策略性地利用目标国家内的IP地址空间，远程揭示VoIP封锁，从而能够检测到原本不可见的VoIP审查。使用Revelio，我们研究了71个国家，覆盖11种广泛使用的VoIP应用。我们的发现揭示了19个国家存在VoIP封锁的证据，主要是通过对STUN流量的定向干扰。通过研究数据包轨迹，我们逆向工程了审查行为，并发现了四类六种子类型的中介盒，它们由独特的应用特定STUN数据包触发。我们进一步分析了HTTP和HTTPS层面的域名级封锁，揭示了仅VoIP通话被封锁而消息传递仍可访问的情况。总体而言，我们的研究通过提供对这一研究不足但高度普遍的审查形式的首个全面全球视角，增进了隐私与审查领域的理解。我们发布代码以支持可复现性和未来研究。

import_candidates.title: Towards Practical Few-shot Multi-tab Website Fingerprinting
import_candidates.abstract: Website fingerprinting (WF) attacks can infer the visited websites to deanonymize Tor networks by analyzing encrypted traffic patterns. Recent few-shot WF methods reduce reliance on large-scale data collection, yet they predominantly formulate WF as a single-label classification task and rely on meta-learning episodes that assume disjoint label sets and stable embedding spaces. These assumptions break down in the realistic multi-tab browsing, where traffic from multiple websites interleaves within a single observation window and the number of concurrent tabs is unknown. Meanwhile, the label space grows exponentially as the monitored set expands, making existing multi-tab WF methods costly to update. To address these challenges, we propose MMF, a novel framework for few-shot multi-tab WF. MMF shifts the meta-learning objective from single-label classification to support-guided presence detection. In each episode, we pair a mixed multi-tab query trace with a small set of single-tab support traces for each monitored website, and generate class-specific features by feature reweighting to decide which websites are present. This detection-centric formulation yields well-defined few-shot tasks in multi-tab scenarios and enables MMF to detect previously unseen websites from limited traces. We evaluate MMF on established public datasets and a new real-world dataset collected under varied browsing conditions. Results demonstrate that MMF consistently outperforms state-of-the-art multi-tab WF attacks across all settings. Notably, in the 5-shot scenario, MMF achieves improvements of up to 300% in Novel Precision@k, highlighting its strong capability for few-shot detection in dynamically growing website sets.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 网站指纹（WF）攻击可以通过分析加密流量模式来推断访问的网站，从而对Tor网络进行去匿名化。最近的少样本WF方法减少了对大规模数据收集的依赖，但它们主要将WF表述为单标签分类任务，并依赖元学习片段，这些片段假设标签集不相交且嵌入空间稳定。这些假设在现实的多标签页浏览中不成立，因为来自多个网站的流量在单个观察窗口内交织，且并发标签页的数量未知。同时，随着监控集合扩大，标签空间呈指数增长，使得现有多标签页WF方法更新成本高昂。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了MMF，一种新颖的少样本多标签页WF框架。MMF将元学习目标从单标签分类转变为支持引导的存在检测。在每个片段中，我们将混合的多标签页查询轨迹与每个监控网站的一小组单标签页支持轨迹配对，并通过特征重加权生成类别特定特征，以决定哪些网站存在。这种以检测为中心的表述在多标签页场景中产生了明确定义的少样本任务，并使MMF能够从有限的轨迹中检测以前未见过的网站。我们在既有的公共数据集和在不同浏览条件下收集的新真实世界数据集上评估MMF。结果表明，MMF在所有设置中始终优于最先进的多标签页WF攻击。值得注意的是，在5-shot场景中，MMF在Novel Precision@k上实现了高达300%的提升，突显了其在动态增长的网站集合中进行少样本检测的强大能力。

import_candidates.title: Technical Analysis of the Geedge Networks Firewall Source Code Leak
import_candidates.abstract:
In September 2025, over 100K internal documents (including code, communications, etc.) from Geedge Networks, a Chinese DPI company with ties to the Great Firewall of China, were leaked to the public. In this paper, we analyze the source code from this leak, focusing on Geedge Networks' flagship product, the Tiangou Secure Gateway (TSG) firewall. Working across multiple repositories, we successfully build and run a local copy of TSG---revealing key aspects of its architecture, including the protocols it is capable of parsing and the format of blocking rules used to censor sites, proxies, and other resources. Finally, we extract several fingerprints from TSG, including custom random number generators and parsing idiosyncrasies that allow us to identify its use and similar deployments in the Great Firewall of China.
This is the first time that the source code of a commercial DPI has been leaked, and our work is the first code analysis of a core firewall component used in national censorship infrastructure. This unprecedented investigation offers insights that can assist circumvention developers and Internet security researchers in further understanding the capabilities and limitations of modern censorship technology.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 2025年9月，与中国防火墙有关联的中国DPI公司Geedge Networks的超过10万份内部文档（包括代码、通信等）被泄露给公众。在本文中，我们分析此次泄露中的源代码，重点关注Geedge Networks的旗舰产品“天狗安全网关”（TSG）防火墙。我们在多个代码仓库间工作，成功构建并运行了TSG的本地副本——揭示了其架构的关键方面，包括它能够解析的协议以及用于审查网站、代理和其他资源的封锁规则格式。最后，我们从TSG中提取了若干指纹，包括自定义随机数生成器和解析特性，使我们能够识别其在中国的防火墙中的使用及类似部署。这是商业DPI源代码首次被泄露，我们的工作是首次对国家审查基础设施中使用的核心防火墙组件进行代码分析。这项前所未有的调查提供了洞见，可帮助规避开发者与互联网安全研究人员进一步理解现代审查技术的能力与局限。

import_candidates.title: From Symmetry toward Weak Asymmetry: Secure Steganography under the Receiver's Partial Channel Knowledge
import_candidates.abstract: Provably secure steganography enables covert communication by disguising secret messages as normal communication content while guaranteeing computational indistinguishability. Recent work typically assumes that the sender can construct stegotext based on explicit conditional distributions, while the receiver either has access to the same distributions for decoding or has no such access at all. In many realistic communication settings, however, the receiver's access lies between these two extremes, a regime that is not captured by either assumption. We therefore introduce and study a new setting, called weakly asymmetric steganography, in which the sender has access to the full conditional distributions used for stegotext construction, while the receiver only has partial knowledge derived from them. We design provably secure steganography schemes under several representative forms of receiver-side knowledge. Specifically, we consider binary alphabets in which the receiver only knows whether a symbol's probability exceeds a given threshold, as well as general alphabets where the receiver only observes a possibly partial ranking of symbols by probability. We evaluate our rank-based constructions in language-model-based text steganography under both limited receiver-side knowledge and precision-induced distribution mismatch. The results show that weakly asymmetric steganography can achieve non-trivial embedding capacity, and further suggest the potential of this setting in distribution-mismatch scenarios.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 可证明安全的隐写术通过将秘密消息伪装成正常通信内容，同时保证计算不可区分性，从而实现隐蔽通信。近期工作通常假设发送方能够基于显式条件分布构造隐写文本，而接收方要么能够访问相同的分布以进行解码，要么完全无法访问这些分布。然而，在许多现实通信环境中，接收方的访问权限介于这两个极端之间，而这一情形未被上述任一假设所刻画。因此，我们引入并研究一种新设定，称为弱不对称隐写术：发送方可以访问用于构造隐写文本的完整条件分布，而接收方仅拥有由这些分布导出的部分知识。我们针对几种具有代表性的接收方知识形式设计了可证明安全的隐写方案。具体而言，我们考虑二元字母表下接收方仅知道某个符号的概率是否超过给定阈值的情形，以及一般字母表下接收方仅观察到符号按概率的（可能不完整的）排序的情形。我们在基于语言模型的文本隐写中，在有限的接收方知识与精度引起的分布失配两种情况下评估了基于排序的构造。结果表明，弱不对称隐写术能够实现非平凡的嵌入容量，并进一步表明该设定在分布失配场景中具有潜力。

import_candidates.title: Do You Need a Receipt? Anonymous Credential Revocation at Continental Scale via Private Record Certification
import_candidates.abstract:
A key challenge in digital credential systems is revocation, that is, the ability to invalidate credentials post-issuance and verify their status upon presentation. While anonymous credentials enhance privacy over classical credentials (e.g., by providing unlinkability), they complicate revocation. Existing revocation schemes for anonymous credentials often suffer from high client or verifier computation, long delays before revocation takes effect (e.g., epoch-based settings), or require updates to all users with each revocation.
We present an efficient, real-time revocation system for anonymous credentials with decentralized revocation authorities based on a novel primitive called Private Record Certification (PRC). PRC enables users to obtain a certificate for a record stored in a server-managed database without the servers learning which record was requested. This primitive is of independent interest, and we construct it by combining techniques from private information retrieval and secure multi-party computation. Our revocation scheme outsources its computation to the revocation authorities and has minimal overhead for clients and verifiers, while ensuring the communication costs are sublinear in the number of credentials. We build a prototype and demonstrate that our system achieves sub-second real-time latency for PRC requests, at a scale of over 1 billion credentials, with an online operational cost of 2.5$ per server for processing 1 million PRC requests.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 数字凭证系统中的一个关键挑战是撤销，即能够使已签发的凭证失效并在出示时验证其状态。虽然匿名凭证相比传统凭证增强了隐私（例如通过提供不可链接性），但它们使撤销变得复杂。现有的匿名凭证撤销方案通常面临客户端或验证者计算开销高、撤销生效前延迟长（例如基于纪元的设置），或者每次撤销都需要更新所有用户的问题。我们提出了一种高效、实时的匿名凭证撤销系统，其撤销机构是去中心化的，基于一种称为私有记录认证（PRC）的新原语。PRC使用户能够获得服务器管理数据库中存储的记录的证书，而服务器不会得知请求的是哪条记录。该原语具有独立的研究价值，我们通过结合私有信息检索和安全多方计算的技术来构建它。我们的撤销方案将计算外包给撤销机构，对客户端和验证者的开销最小，同时确保通信成本与凭证数量呈亚线性关系。我们构建了一个原型并证明，我们的系统在超过10亿凭证的规模下，PRC请求可实现亚秒级实时延迟，处理100万次PRC请求的在线运营成本为每台服务器2.5美元。

import_candidates.title: Remise: Authorized Anonymous Communication Systems
import_candidates.abstract: We present Remise, a two-server authorized anonymous communication system built on Distributed Oblivious RAM (DORAM). Remise supports two modes of operation: (i) an anonymous bulletin board, where messages are publicly revealed at the end of each epoch without linking senders to messages, and (ii) anonymous communication channels, where messages remain secret-shared, and writers selectively grant and revoke read access to chosen readers. In both modes, the two servers execute read and write operations without learning which indices are accessed, which authorization tokens are used, or which relationships exist between writers and readers, assuming no collusion between the servers. A central contribution of Remise is a lightweight and efficient access-control mechanism. Authorization tokens are maintained in secret-shared form across the two servers, enabling oblivious verification and updates, while preventing leakage even under client–server collusion. Unlike prior DPF-based systems, Remise provides built-in auditing by having the semi-honest servers generate standard-basis vector shares internally, eliminating the need for server-side DPF validity checks. We implement a prototype of Remise and evaluate it under realistic network conditions. Our experiments show an 80× improvement in online server time for request validity check when compared to PACL (IEEE S&P 2023) for large database size.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们提出了Remise，一个基于分布式不经意RAM（DORAM）的两服务器授权匿名通信系统。Remise支持两种操作模式：(i) 匿名公告板，消息在每个epoch结束时公开，但不将发送者与消息关联；(ii) 匿名通信通道，消息保持秘密共享，写入者可以选择性地授予和撤销选定读取者的读取权限。在这两种模式中，两个服务器执行读写操作时不会得知访问了哪些索引、使用了哪些授权令牌，或者在假设服务器之间不串通的情况下，写入者和读取者之间存在哪些关系。Remise的一个核心贡献是轻量级且高效的访问控制机制。授权令牌以秘密共享的形式在两个服务器上维护，从而实现不经意验证和更新，同时即使在客户端-服务器串通下也能防止泄漏。与先前的基于DPF的系统不同，Remise通过让半诚实服务器内部生成标准基向量份额来提供内置审计，从而消除了对服务器端DPF有效性检查的需求。我们实现了Remise的原型，并在真实网络条件下对其进行了评估。我们的实验表明，对于大型数据库大小，与PACL（IEEE S&P 2023）相比，请求有效性检查的在线服务器时间提高了80倍。

import_candidates.title: Sliced Rényi Pufferfish Privacy: Tractable Privatization Mechanism and Private Learning with Gradient Clipping
import_candidates.abstract: We study the design of a privatization mechanism and privacy accounting in the Pufferfish Privacy (PP) family. Specifically, motivated by the curse of dimensionality and lack of practical composition tools for iterative learning in the recent Rényi Pufferfish Privacy (RPP) framework, we propose Sliced Rényi Pufferfish Privacy (SRPP). SRPP preserves PP/RPP semantics (customizable secrets with probability-aware secret–dataset relationships) while replacing high-dimensional Rényi divergence with projection-based quantification via two sliced measures, Average SRPP and Joint SRPP. We develop sliced Wasserstein mechanisms, yielding sound SRPP certificates and closed-form Gaussian noise calibration. For iterative learning systems, we introduce an SRPP-SGD scheme with gradient clipping and new accountants based on History-Uniform Caps (HUC) and a subsampling-aware variant (sa-HUC), enabling decompose-then-compose privatization and additive composition under a common slicing geometry. Experiments on static and iterative privatization show that the proposed framework exhibits favorable privacy–utility trade-offs, as well as practical scalability.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们研究Pufferfish隐私（PP）族中私有化机制的设计和隐私核算。具体而言，受近期Rényi Pufferfish隐私（RPP）框架中维数灾难以及迭代学习缺乏实用组合工具的启发，我们提出切片Rényi Pufferfish隐私（SRPP）。SRPP保留PP/RPP语义（可定制秘密以及概率感知的秘密-数据集关系），同时通过两种切片度量（平均SRPP和联合SRPP）以基于投影的量化替代高维Rényi散度。我们开发切片Wasserstein机制，给出可靠的SRPP证书和闭式高斯噪声校准。对于迭代学习系统，我们引入带梯度裁剪的SRPP-SGD方案，以及基于历史均匀上限（HUC）和子采样感知变体（sa-HUC）的新核算器，从而在共同切片几何下实现先分解后组合的私有化和加性组合。静态和迭代私有化实验表明，所提框架展现出有利的隐私-效用权衡以及实际可扩展性。

import_candidates.title: sigma-rs: A Modular Approach for Keyed-Verification Anonymous Credentials
import_candidates.abstract:
We introduce a new software stack in Rust aimed at simplifying constructions and deployments of protocols based on modern anonymous credential systems.
The stack, called sigma-rs, through its layered design, abstracts cryptographic complexity while remaining flexible enough to support a range of credential schemes, proofs, and access policies. It emphasizes misuse resistance via type safety, domain separation, and prover-state discipline, and supports side-channel-aware constant-time strategies.
We evaluate practicality through re-implementations of Tor's Lox bridge distribution protocols and of user authentication in the Open Observatory for Network Interference.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们推出了一种新的Rust软件栈，旨在简化基于现代匿名凭证系统的协议的构建和部署。该软件栈名为sigma-rs，通过其分层设计抽象了密码学复杂性，同时保持足够的灵活性以支持一系列凭证方案、证明和访问策略。它通过类型安全、域分离和证明者状态纪律来强调防误用性，并支持侧信道感知的常数时间策略。我们通过重新实现Tor的Lox网桥分发协议以及开放网络干扰观测站（OONI）中的用户认证来评估其实用性。

import_candidates.title: A Cuckoo in the Nest: Multi‑Stage, Multi‑Identifier Hijacking in BACnet/SC
import_candidates.abstract: To address the well-known security limitations of legacy Building Automation and Control Network (BACnet), BACnet Secure Connect (BACnet/SC) introduces mutually authenticated WebSocket Secure (WSS) channels and mandates PKI-based certificate management. Despite these protections, we identify a fundamental identifier-binding failure in BACnet/SC's security model: X.509 certificate authentication is not cryptographically bound to the logical identifiers used for connection management (UUID) and message forwarding (VMAC). Through a systematic analysis of BACnet/SC connection state machines, we show that this decoupling enables a multi-stage, multi-identifier hijacking attack, in which malicious roles progressively displace a legitimate device's authenticated connection state and persistently intercept its traffic. We term this attack the Cuckoo Attack and validate it across the official BACnet/SC Reference Stack, the open-source BACnet-Stack, and commercial building automation platforms from major vendors, including Siemens, Johnson Controls, Honeywell, and Carrier. We further propose mitigation measures to address this vulnerability. Our findings provide the first systematic characterization of an authentication-identifier decoupling flaw in BACnet/SC, highlight a broader class of identifier-binding risks in stateful secure protocols, and have been presented to and acknowledged by ASHRAE SSPC 135, the standards committee responsible for BACnet.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 为解决传统楼宇自动化和控制网络（BACnet）众所周知的安全限制，BACnet安全连接（BACnet/SC）引入了相互认证的WebSocket安全（WSS）通道，并强制实施基于PKI的证书管理。尽管有这些保护措施，我们仍发现BACnet/SC安全模型中存在一个根本性的标识符绑定缺陷：X.509证书认证在密码学上并未绑定到用于连接管理（UUID）和消息转发（VMAC）的逻辑标识符。通过对BACnet/SC连接状态机进行系统分析，我们表明这种解耦使得一种多阶段、多标识符劫持攻击成为可能，其中恶意角色逐步取代合法设备的已认证连接状态并持续拦截其流量。我们将此攻击称为杜鹃攻击，并在官方BACnet/SC参考栈、开源BACnet-Stack以及来自主要厂商（包括西门子、江森自控、霍尼韦尔和开利）的商业楼宇自动化平台上进行了验证。我们进一步提出了缓解措施以解决此漏洞。我们的发现首次系统性地刻画了BACnet/SC中的认证-标识符解耦缺陷，揭示了有状态安全协议中更广泛的一类标识符绑定风险，并已提交给负责BACnet的标准委员会ASHRAE SSPC 135并获得其确认。

import_candidates.title: ARTO: Efficient Execution Integrity Attestation for Real-Time Operation of Cyber-Physical Systems
import_candidates.abstract: Real-time embedded systems are prevalent in cyber-physical applications such as drones and autonomous vehicles. Due to their high complexity, the environmental uncertainties, and the openness to remote control, these systems are vulnerable to control-flow hijacking and data-only attacks that compromise runtime integrity and reliability. Traditional control-flow integrity (CFI) and data-flow integrity (DFI) approaches impose excessive overhead, while the control-flow attestation (CFA) allows detection latency incompatible with real-time constraints. This paper presents ARTO, the first control-flow and data-flow protection approach that integrates the control-flow attestation to provide strong security with competitive runtime overhead. Through the prover-side path segmentation and hash-based validation result caching, ARTO provides partial context-sensitive protection at minimal runtime cost, offloading complete context-sensitive detection to the remote verifier. Furthermore, ARTO implements an equivalence-class-based data-flow protection that combines the address-based target check for memory reads with the value-based checks to protect critical variables, stronger than the SOTA operation integrity enforcement in validating the read source for critical variables. Extensive evaluations on robotic vehicle autopilots confirm ARTO's efficacy in mitigating both control-flow and data-only attacks while maintaining runtime overhead within real-time limits, outperforming SOTA CFA and operation-integrity enforcement methods in operation execution time.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 实时嵌入式系统广泛应用于无人机和自动驾驶汽车等信息物理应用中。由于其高度复杂性、环境不确定性以及远程控制的开放性，这些系统容易受到控制流劫持和仅数据攻击，从而危及运行时完整性和可靠性。传统的控制流完整性（CFI）和数据流完整性（DFI）方法开销过大，而控制流证明（CFA）的检测延迟与实时约束不兼容。本文提出ARTO，这是首个将控制流证明与数据流保护集成以提供强安全性且运行时开销具有竞争力的方法。通过证明方路径分段和基于哈希的验证结果缓存，ARTO以最小的运行时成本提供部分上下文敏感保护，将完整的上下文敏感检测卸载到远程验证方。此外，ARTO实现了基于等价类的数据流保护，将针对内存读取的基于地址的目标检查与基于值的检查相结合以保护关键变量，在验证关键变量的读取来源方面比最先进的操作完整性执行方法更强。对机器人车辆自动驾驶仪的广泛评估证实了ARTO在缓解控制流和仅数据攻击方面的有效性，同时将运行时开销保持在实时限制内，在操作执行时间上优于最先进的CFA和操作完整性执行方法。

import_candidates.title: BLE Theft Auto: Evaluating the Security of Aftermarket BLE-based Automotive Remote Control Systems
import_candidates.abstract: Vehicles are increasingly remotely controllable from smartphone apps that function like keyfobs: unlocking a vehicle's doors and even starting its engine. These systems use Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) for ofﬂine remote control. However, they do not use BLE's built-in security; instead they use proprietary application-layer protocols, introducing a new attack surface. This is especially concerning for aftermarket BLE remote control systems, because they have not received scrutiny by security researchers. In this paper, we evaluate feasible BLE-based attacks on aftermarket vehicle remote control systems. We discovered six aftermarket BLE remote control systems in use today, and analyzed their application-layer BLE security. We found critical vulnerabilities in three systems, exposing what we estimate to be 1.4 million aftermarket BLE control systems to attack. We show that targeted BLE remote attacks are practical: an attacker can use crowdsourced Bluetooth scanning databases to target speciﬁc vehicles with vulnerable systems installed. Our disclosures lead all vendors to patch improved app-layer BLE security into their systems, affecting many vehicle owners that did not even know they had a BLE remote control system installed.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 车辆正越来越多地可以通过功能类似钥匙扣的智能手机应用进行远程控制：解锁车门甚至启动发动机。这些系统使用低功耗蓝牙（BLE）进行离线远程控制。然而，它们并未使用BLE内置的安全机制；相反，它们使用专有的应用层协议，从而引入了新的攻击面。这对售后市场BLE远程控制系统尤其令人担忧，因为它们尚未受到安全研究人员的审视。在本文中，我们评估了对售后市场车辆远程控制系统可行的基于BLE的攻击。我们发现了目前正在使用的六种售后市场BLE远程控制系统，并分析了它们的应用层BLE安全性。我们在三个系统中发现了严重漏洞，据我们估计，这使约140万个售后市场BLE控制系统面临攻击。我们表明，针对性的BLE远程攻击是可行的：攻击者可以使用众包蓝牙扫描数据库来定位安装了易受攻击系统的特定车辆。我们的披露促使所有供应商将其系统修补为改进的应用层BLE安全，影响了许多甚至不知道自己安装了BLE远程控制系统的车主。

import_candidates.title: Lost in Encapsulation: Exploiting Open Tunnelling Hosts and Attacking Private Networks
import_candidates.abstract:
Tunnelling protocols form an essential backbone of today's Internet, where they primarily interconnect remote networks. However, many tunnelling hosts do not implement authentication, making them behave as open one-way proxies and, in turn, introducing denial-of-service (DoS) risks. 
In this paper, we show that the security risk of open tunnelling hosts extends beyond DoS attacks. First, we study NAT-enabled tunnelling hosts and demonstrate a novel attack that manipulates the NAT's TCP state, enabling an attacker to fingerprint and inject traffic into the co-located private network. We also study tunnelling hosts that translate global IP addresses, and turn them into two-way proxies. We demonstrate how these two-way proxies enable an attacker to: (1) spoof TCP connections; and (2) launch a novel loop DoS attack. Additionally, we show that Layer 2 (L2) tunnelling hosts, specifically GRETAP, can be abused to attack the LAN, and we demonstrate the impact with 5 attacks: leaking the host's global and private MAC addresses, DHCP starvation, DNS poisoning, ARP spoofing, and an infinite loop DoS attack. 
To evaluate the prevalence of vulnerable hosts, we conduct 9 Internet-wide scans and identify that 438,280 hosts are potentially vulnerable. Overall, we show that open tunnelling protocols enable new attacks on co-located private networks, and we hope our work encourages the adoption of new defences.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 隧道协议构成了当今互联网的重要骨干，主要用于互连远程网络。然而，许多隧道主机未实现身份验证，使其表现为开放的单向代理，进而引入拒绝服务（DoS）风险。在本文中，我们表明开放隧道主机的安全风险不仅限于DoS攻击。首先，我们研究启用NAT的隧道主机，并展示了一种新型攻击，该攻击操纵NAT的TCP状态，使攻击者能够对同地私有网络进行指纹识别并注入流量。我们还研究了转换全局IP地址的隧道主机，并将其变为双向代理。我们展示了这些双向代理如何使攻击者能够：(1) 欺骗TCP连接；(2) 发动一种新型循环DoS攻击。此外，我们表明二层（L2）隧道主机，特别是GRETAP，可被滥用来攻击局域网，并通过5种攻击展示其影响：泄露主机的全局和私有MAC地址、DHCP耗尽、DNS投毒、ARP欺骗以及无限循环DoS攻击。为了评估易受攻击主机的普遍性，我们进行了9次全网扫描，并识别出438,280台潜在易受攻击的主机。总体而言，我们表明开放隧道协议能够对同地私有网络发起新攻击，并希望我们的工作能促进新防御措施的采用。

import_candidates.title: TED: Abusing Tunnel Hosts and IPv6 Extension Headers for Pulsing DoS Attacks
import_candidates.abstract: IP tunneling mechanisms are widely deployed to facilitate the Internet's transition from IPv4 to IPv6, yet their security implications remain insufficiently scrutinized. In this paper, we present TED, a novel pulsing denial-of-service attack that exploits structural vulnerabilities in IP tunneling and IPv6 Extension Headers (EHs) processing. Unlike prior reflection attacks that depend on application-layer services, TED operates entirely at the network layer, requiring no victim interaction, prolonged traffic accumulation, or protocol-specific dependencies. Delay lines are constructed by TED through nested EHs, capitalizing on the tunnel hosts' blind forwarding logic and lack of deep packet inspection. These artificial delay lines allow attackers to solve the send-time schedule problem, converging asynchronous, low-rate traffic into a destructive, high-magnitude pulse at the victim. Our Internet-wide measurement identified over 1.9 million vulnerable tunnel hosts acting as unwitting relays, including hosts within critical satellite infrastructure. Evaluation results demonstrate that TED achieves normalized pulse amplitude exceeding 180× while successfully evading existing low-rate and pulsing attack detection mechanisms based on specific application layer protocols. We discuss the root causes of these transitional vulnerabilities and possible mitigation strategies for network operators and equipment vendors.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: IP隧道机制被广泛部署以促进互联网从IPv4向IPv6的过渡，然而其安全影响仍未得到充分审视。在本文中，我们提出TED，一种新颖的脉冲式拒绝服务攻击，它利用IP隧道和IPv6扩展首部（EH）处理中的结构性漏洞。与先前依赖应用层服务的反射攻击不同，TED完全在网络层运行，不需要受害者交互、长时间流量累积或协议特定依赖。TED通过嵌套EH构造延迟线，利用隧道主机的盲目转发逻辑和缺乏深度包检测。这些人工延迟线使攻击者能够解决发送时间调度问题，将异步的低速率流量汇聚成对受害者的破坏性高幅度脉冲。我们的互联网范围测量识别出超过190万台易受攻击的隧道主机作为不知情的中继，包括关键卫星基础设施内的主机。评估结果表明，TED实现了超过180倍的归一化脉冲幅度，同时成功规避了基于特定应用层协议的现有低速率和脉冲攻击检测机制。我们讨论了这些过渡性漏洞的根本原因以及网络运营商和设备供应商可能的缓解策略。

import_candidates.title: Toward Understanding the Security Implications in Python Configuration Files
import_candidates.abstract: Security incidents targeting open-source software have increased substantially in recent years, yet existing defenses primarily focus on analyzing source code while largely overlooking configuration files that define how software is built, installed, and executed. In this paper, we present an in-depth study of security risks in Python configuration files, analyzing five widely used formats across the project lifecycle. We focus on risks that exploit configuration files to silently redirect dependency resolution to attacker-controlled infrastructure or hijack benign commands. We design an automated framework and identify 39 configuration fields that can be exploited under realistic usage scenarios. We further demonstrate that existing malware detection tools fail to detect most of these risks. As mitigation, we develop ConfigScoper, which not only examines security-relevant fields but also employs multiple vulnerability detectors to identify potential malicious behaviors. We apply ConfigScoper in a measurement study analyzing millions of open-source Python projects on GitHub, and our empirical results show that exploitable risks already exist in real-world projects. Finally, we have responsibly disclosed the identified vulnerabilities to relevant stakeholders.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 近年来，针对开源软件的安全事件大幅增加，然而现有防御主要集中于分析源代码，而很大程度上忽略了定义软件如何构建、安装和执行的配置文件。本文对Python配置文件中的安全风险进行了深入研究，分析了项目生命周期中五种广泛使用的格式。我们关注利用配置文件将依赖解析静默重定向到攻击者控制的基础设施或劫持良性命令的风险。我们设计了一个自动化框架，并识别出在现实使用场景中可被利用的39个配置字段。我们进一步证明，现有恶意软件检测工具无法检测出其中大多数风险。作为缓解措施，我们开发了ConfigScoper，它不仅检查与安全相关的字段，还采用多个漏洞检测器来识别潜在恶意行为。我们将ConfigScoper应用于一项测量研究，分析了GitHub上数百万个开源Python项目，实证结果表明可被利用的风险已存在于现实项目中。最后，我们负责任地向相关利益相关者披露了所识别的漏洞。

import_candidates.title: FRAGJAM: DoS Attacks Using IP Reassembly Congestion
import_candidates.abstract:
UDP, one of the major transport protocols for multiple popular services such as DNS and video conferencing, is an important component of today's network. Its reliance on IP fragmentation is known to cause both security and reliability issues. To avoid fragmentation, UDP-based applications hence usually limit the payload size. Currently, Linux's IP fragment reassembling algorithm relies on a per-network-namespace buffer size limit. That is, a classic resource-exhaustion DoS attack against UDP services relying on IP fragmentation is possible. However, the fragility of present real-world services has not yet been thoroughly researched.
In this paper, we examine the practicability of such an IP-fragmentation-based DoS attack against real-world providers of popular UDP-based services, including VPN, video conferencing, and RADIUS. We assess the attack from both the client and service provider perspectives. On the server side, we observe that many real-world service providers fragment the server-to-client traffic with respect to artificially small path MTUs when receiving attacker forged ICMP Fragmentation Needed messages. On the client side, we show the chance of dropping server-to-client fragmented traffic by flooding Linux-based NAT gateways with bogus fragments. Through simulated attacks, we demonstrate that the fragmentation-based DoS attack is realistic, affecting various providers such as Zoom and ExpressVPN. We conduct a comprehensive disclosure to affected parties and suggest possible mitigations.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: UDP是DNS和视频会议等多种流行服务的主要传输协议之一，是当今网络的重要组成部分。其依赖IP分片已知会导致安全性和可靠性问题。为了避免分片，基于UDP的应用程序通常限制有效载荷大小。目前，Linux的IP分片重组算法依赖于每个网络命名空间的缓冲区大小限制。也就是说，针对依赖IP分片的UDP服务的经典资源耗尽型DoS攻击是可能的。然而，现实世界中服务的脆弱性尚未得到彻底研究。在本文中，我们研究了这种基于IP分片的DoS攻击对现实世界中流行UDP服务（包括VPN、视频会议和RADIUS）提供商的可行性。我们从客户端和服务提供商两个角度评估该攻击。在服务器端，我们观察到许多现实世界服务提供商在收到攻击者伪造的ICMP分片需要（Fragmentation Needed）消息时，会以人为缩小的路径MTU来分片服务器到客户端的流量。在客户端，我们展示了通过用伪造分片洪泛基于Linux的NAT网关来丢弃服务器到客户端分片流量的可能性。通过模拟攻击，我们证明基于分片的DoS攻击是现实的，影响Zoom和ExpressVPN等各种提供商。我们向受影响方进行了全面披露，并提出了可能的缓解措施。

import_candidates.title: Download More RAM: Dismantling Windows Operating System Defences with Mischievous Memory
import_candidates.abstract: Virtualisation-Based Security (VBS) is the cornerstone of modern Windows desktop defences, relied upon by both the operating system and third-party software, with a virtualised secure kernel providing strong security guarantees against even privileged attackers. In this paper, we introduce Download More RAM, software-only memory aliasing attack that breaks these guarantees without physical access. On systems running the most common consumer DIMMs, our attack allows arbitrary memory read/write, letting a privileged user compromise the OS at every level, including the secure kernel, Hypervisor Enforced Code Integrity (HVCI), and all defences it provides. With this access we develop a series of case study attacks targeting VBS-protected processes, Windows Defender, anti-virus & EDR software, and game anti-cheats. Our work breaks the strongest security guarantees offered by the Windows OS, questioning key trust assumptions on such systems. Microsoft have assigned CVE-2026-23670 to our findings and issued a patch that partially mitigates our attack.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 基于虚拟化的安全（VBS）是现代Windows桌面防御的基石，操作系统和第三方软件都依赖它，其虚拟化安全内核即使面对特权攻击者也能提供强大的安全保证。在本文中，我们提出了“下载更多RAM”（Download More RAM），一种纯软件的内存别名攻击，无需物理访问即可破坏这些保证。在运行最常见消费级DIMM的系统上，我们的攻击允许任意内存读写，使特权用户能够在各个层面攻破操作系统，包括安全内核、虚拟机监控程序强制代码完整性（HVCI）及其提供的所有防御。利用这种访问权限，我们开发了一系列案例研究攻击，针对受VBS保护的进程、Windows Defender、杀毒软件与EDR软件以及游戏反作弊系统。我们的工作打破了Windows操作系统提供的最强安全保证，质疑了此类系统上的关键信任假设。微软已为我们的发现分配了CVE-2026-23670，并发布了一个部分缓解我们攻击的补丁。

import_candidates.title: Secpoline: A Scalable Approach to Build Secure In-Process Syscall Interposers
import_candidates.abstract:
In-process system call interposers are increasingly used to extend or monitor application functionality without context-switching or inter-process communication (IPC) overhead. However, when embedded inside untrusted applications, existing solutions face a trade-off: they either enforce no isolation at all, or impose severe restrictions on the monitor's isolated programming environment that are incompatible with complex, real-world use cases.
This paper presents Secpoline, a new interposition platform that allows in-process monitors to support arbitrary interposer functionality without compromising isolation. Secpoline achieves this via isolated multi-program loading and a novel meta-monitor design that interposes the monitor itself to emulate a seamless programming environment. In addition, Secpoline implements the first fully self-contained in-process sandbox to harden its own isolation primitive, while preserving fast-path syscall interposition with zero kernel involvement.
Our evaluation shows that Secpoline matches the efficiency of state-of-the-art secure in-process interposers while enabling a significantly more expressive programming environment. We specifically demonstrate this by implementing a kernel-module-free version of the Falco intrusion detection engine. We also implement an in-process ProxySQL sidecar, embedded directly into the application process, where Secpoline transparently provides a kernel-bypass communication path to increase throughput by roughly 50%. These results confirm that Secpoline finally delivers on the promise of secure, complex application monitoring at in-process speeds.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 进程内系统调用拦截器越来越多地被用于扩展或监控应用程序功能，同时避免上下文切换或进程间通信（IPC）开销。然而，当嵌入到不可信应用程序中时，现有解决方案面临一种权衡：它们要么完全不实施隔离，要么对监控器的隔离编程环境施加与复杂现实用例不兼容的严格限制。本文提出了Secpoline，一种新的拦截平台，允许进程内监控器在不损害隔离性的情况下支持任意拦截器功能。Secpoline通过隔离的多程序加载以及一种新颖的元监控器设计来实现这一点，该设计拦截监控器本身以模拟无缝编程环境。此外，Secpoline实现了首个完全自包含的进程内沙箱来加固其自身的隔离原语，同时保持零内核参与的快速路径系统调用拦截。我们的评估表明，Secpoline在保持与最先进的安全进程内拦截器相同效率的同时，提供了显著更具表达力的编程环境。我们通过实现一个无需内核模块的Falco入侵检测引擎版本具体证明了这一点。我们还实现了一个直接嵌入应用程序进程的进程内ProxySQL边车，其中Secpoline透明地提供内核旁路通信路径，使吞吐量提高约50%。这些结果证实，Secpoline最终兑现了以进程内速度进行安全、复杂应用程序监控的承诺。

import_candidates.title: SoK: Capability Operating Systems: Is the Future Finally Here?
import_candidates.abstract: Capability operating systems have existed for six decades, yet we do not have a systematic way to compare them and their different design aspects. We even lack a consensus on the purpose of capabilities in these systems. Given the recent resurgence of interest in capability systems in different domains, we provide a definition of such systems and a set of characteristics to describe and distinguish them. Applying our characteristics to seminal capability systems, we then provide a taxonomy of fundamental design approaches that emerged over the last sixty years. Our results lead us to discuss further research in this field and highlight open challenges in creating pure object-capability systems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 能力操作系统已经存在了六十年，但我们还没有一种系统化的方法来比较它们及其不同的设计方面。我们甚至对这些系统中能力的目的缺乏共识。鉴于近来在不同领域对能力系统的兴趣重新兴起，我们提供了此类系统的定义以及一组用于描述和区分它们的特征。将我们的特征应用于开创性的能力系统，我们提供了过去六十年中出现的基本设计方法的分类学。我们的结果促使我们讨论该领域的进一步研究，并强调创建纯对象能力系统中的开放挑战。

import_candidates.title: Enjoy the Free Lunch, Someone Paid for Us: Escaping Resource Limits of MicroVM-based Containers
import_candidates.abstract:
MicroVM-based containers are increasingly deployed in public clouds (e.g., AWS, Azure, and Alibaba Cloud) to combine container efficiency with strong isolation. However, we demonstrate that microVM-based architectures introduce a new class of resource accounting vulnerabilities which cause discrepancies between the physical resources consumed by a guest and the resource usage accounted by the host. To systematically uncover such issues, we propose a resource accounting analysis framework that examines accounting inconsistencies across both memory and storage subsystems. Using this framework, we identify three easily exploitable attack vectors: (i) writable memory accounting evasion via shared file-backed mappings, (ii) read-only memory accounting evasion via private file-backed mappings, and (iii) a storage accounting evasion that enables unbounded disk consumption through unmonitored file paths.
We further combine these attack vectors into FREE (File-based Resource Expansion & Exploitation), a consolidated attack that freely inflates both memory and storage usage while evading associated resource accounting and billings.
