We also present a practical attack implementation capable of seamless integration into real-world applications, leveraging a custom dynamic shared library that transparently redirects standard allocations (e.g., malloc) to unaccounted file-backed mappings. We validate the feasibility of the FREE attack on MicroVM-based containers deployed in AWS, Azure and Alibaba Cloud, and use a billing evaluation model to quantify the economic profit of adversarial tenants. Our evaluation demonstrates that FREE can reduce the attacker's billed cost to 42.12% (Kata) and 41.93% (Firecracker) of the original payment. FREE can also be used to degrade the performance of co-located tenants, including up to 57.1% reduction in memory bandwidth and 67.06% loss in I/O throughput.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 基于MicroVM的容器正越来越多地部署在公有云（如AWS、Azure和阿里云）中，以结合容器的效率与强隔离。然而，我们证明基于MicroVM的架构引入了一类新的资源计量漏洞，导致客户机消耗的物理资源与宿主机计量的资源使用量之间存在差异。为了系统性地发现此类问题，我们提出了一个资源计量分析框架，用于检查内存和存储子系统中的计量不一致性。利用该框架，我们识别出三个易于利用的攻击向量：(i) 通过共享的文件后备映射逃逸可写内存计量；(ii) 通过私有的文件后备映射逃逸只读内存计量；(iii) 一种存储计量逃逸，可通过未监控的文件路径实现无限制的磁盘消耗。我们进一步将这些攻击向量组合成FREE（基于文件的资源扩展与利用），这是一种综合攻击，可在逃避相关资源计量和计费的同时，自由膨胀内存和存储使用量。我们还提出了一种实用的攻击实现，能够无缝集成到真实应用中，利用自定义的动态共享库透明地将标准分配（例如malloc）重定向到未计量的文件后备映射。我们在AWS、Azure和阿里云部署的基于MicroVM的容器上验证了FREE攻击的可行性，并使用计费评估模型量化了恶意租户的经济收益。我们的评估表明，FREE可以将攻击者的计费成本降至原费用的42.12%（Kata）和41.93%（Firecracker）。FREE还可用于降低共置租户的性能，包括内存带宽最多降低57.1%和I/O吞吐量损失67.06%。

import_candidates.title: Plaintext Recovery Against Post-Filtering Access Control
import_candidates.abstract:
Fine-grained access control (FGAC) mechanisms such as row-level security (RLS) and document-level security (DLS) are widely deployed in databases to restrict access to data stored in physical indexing structures shared by multiple users (e.g., in multi-tenant databases, or in the implementation of least-privilege within an organization). FGAC implementations often use post-filtering where untrusted queries run over all data and private results are redacted afterwards. Prior work shows this approach can lead to side-channels that enable attackers to test if a chosen value exists in unseen data. While damaging, prior attacks do not enable the efficient recovery of rich, high-entropy data like full records or text documents.
We show these side-channels are more damaging than previously thought. Using rich query interfaces (e.g., range, prefix, and conjunctive predicates), we amplify existence leakage into reconstruction attacks. We do this in two settings:

PostgreSQL (RLS timing). We exploit a timing side-channel and expressive SQL queries (e.g., ranges, conjunctions) to enumerate unknown attribute values and, in turn, full records via binary search over large domains.
Elasticsearch/OpenSearch (DLS scoring). We exploit scoring and prefix-expansion side-channels to recover indexed terms from documents. In some cases, we can extract n-grams in the corpus to recover approximate text.

Our results show that FGAC side-channels must be evaluated in the presence of rich predicates, which can turn membership tests into scalable reconstruction of high-entropy records.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 细粒度访问控制（FGAC）机制，如行级安全（RLS）和文档级安全（DLS），广泛部署在数据库中，用于限制对存储在多个用户共享的物理索引结构中的数据的访问（例如，在多租户数据库中，或在组织内实现最小权限）。FGAC实现通常使用后过滤，即不受信任的查询在所有数据上运行，随后对私有结果进行脱敏。先前工作表明，这种方法可能导致侧信道，使攻击者能够测试所选值是否存在于未见数据中。虽然具有破坏性，但先前的攻击无法高效恢复丰富的高熵数据，如完整记录或文本文档。我们表明，这些侧信道的破坏性比之前认为的更大。利用丰富的查询接口（例如范围、前缀和合取谓词），我们将存在性泄漏放大为重构攻击。我们在两种设置中实现了这一点：PostgreSQL（RLS计时）。我们利用计时侧信道和表达性SQL查询（例如范围、合取），通过在大域上进行二分搜索来枚举未知属性值，进而枚举完整记录。Elasticsearch/OpenSearch（DLS评分）。我们利用评分和前缀扩展侧信道，从文档中恢复索引词项。在某些情况下，我们可以提取语料库中的n-gram以恢复近似文本。我们的结果表明，必须在存在丰富谓词的情况下评估FGAC侧信道，因为丰富谓词可以将成员测试转变为对高熵记录的可扩展重构。

import_candidates.title: PICASSO: Scaling CHERI Use-After-Free Protection to Millions of Allocations using Colored Capabilities
import_candidates.abstract:
While the CHERI instruction-set architecture extensions for capabilities enable strong spatial memory safety, CHERI lacks built-in temporal safety, particularly for heap allocations. Prior attempts to augment CHERI with temporal safety fall short in terms of scalability, memory overhead, and incomplete security guarantees due to periodical sweeps of the system's memory to individually revoke stale capabilities.
We address these limitations by introducing colored capabilities that add a controlled form of indirection to CHERI's capability model. This enables provenance tracking of capabilities to their respective allocations via a hardware-managed provenance-validity table, allowing bulk retraction of dangling pointers without needing to quarantine freed memory. Colored capabilities significantly reduce the frequency of capability revocation sweeps while improving security.
We realize colored capabilities in PICASSO, an extension of the CHERI-RISC-V architecture on a speculative out-of-order FPGA softcore (CHERI-Toooba). We also integrate colored-capability support into the CheriBSD OS and CHERI-enabled Clang/LLVM toolchain. Our evaluation shows effective mitigation of use-after-free and double-free bugs across all heap-based temporal memory-safety vulnerabilities in NIST Juliet test cases, real-world CVEs, only a small performance overhead on SPEC CPU benchmarks (≈ 5% g.m.), less latency, and more consistent performance in long-running SQLite, PostgreSQL, and gRPC workloads compared to prior work.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 虽然CHERI指令集架构的能力扩展实现了强空间内存安全，但CHERI缺乏内置的时间安全，尤其是对堆分配而言。此前为CHERI增加时间安全的尝试因需要周期性扫描系统内存以逐个撤销过期能力，在可扩展性、内存开销和完整安全保证方面存在不足。我们通过引入带色能力（colored capabilities）来解决这些限制，它们为CHERI的能力模型增加了一种受控的间接形式。这通过硬件管理来源有效性表，实现能力到各自分配的来源跟踪，从而无需隔离已释放内存即可批量撤回悬空指针。带色能力显著降低了能力撤销扫描的频率，同时提高了安全性。我们在PICASSO中实现了带色能力，这是CHERI-RISC-V架构在推测性乱序FPGA软核（CHERI-Toooba）上的扩展。我们还将带色能力支持集成到CheriBSD操作系统和启用CHERI的Clang/LLVM工具链中。我们的评估表明，在NIST Juliet测试用例中所有基于堆的时间内存安全漏洞、真实世界CVE中，有效缓解了释放后使用和双重释放错误，在SPEC CPU基准测试中仅带来较小性能开销（约5%几何平均），与先前工作相比，在长时间运行的SQLite、PostgreSQL和gRPC工作负载中延迟更低且性能更一致。

import_candidates.title: Trust Nothing: RTOS Security without Run-Time Software TCB
import_candidates.abstract:
Embedded devices face an ever-expanding threat landscape: vulnerabilities in application software, operating system kernels, and peripherals threaten the embedded device integrity. Existing computer-architectural defenses fully consider at most two of these threat vectors in their security model.
This paper aims at addressing this gap using a novel capability architecture. To this end, we combine a token capability approach suitable for building an untrusted operating system with protection against malicious devices without requiring hardware changes to peripherals.
First, we develop and evaluate a full FPGA implementation of our capability architecture around legacy hardware components. Further, we present a soft real-time operating system based on Zephyr that has no run-time software TCB. To this end, we disaggregate Zephyr's subsystems into small, mutually isolated components. All subsystems that exist at run time, including scheduler, allocator and DMA drivers, and all peripherals are fully untrusted. We believe that our work offers a foundation for more rigorous security-by-design in tomorrow's security-critical embedded devices.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 嵌入式设备面临不断扩大的威胁格局：应用软件、操作系统内核和外设中的漏洞威胁着嵌入式设备的完整性。现有的计算机体系结构防御在其安全模型中最多只考虑其中两个威胁向量。本文旨在利用一种新颖的能力架构来弥补这一空白。为此，我们将一种适用于构建不可信操作系统的令牌能力方法与针对恶意设备的防护相结合，且无需对硬件外设进行更改。首先，我们围绕传统硬件组件开发并评估了我们能力架构的完整FPGA实现。此外，我们提出了一种基于Zephyr的软实时操作系统，其没有任何运行时软件TCB。为此，我们将Zephyr的子系统分解为小型、相互隔离的组件。所有运行时存在的子系统，包括调度器、分配器和DMA驱动程序，以及所有外设，都是完全不可信的。我们相信，我们的工作为未来安全关键嵌入式设备中更严格的安全设计奠定了基础。

import_candidates.title: Security and Privacy Considerations for Confirming Payments in Rwandan Mobile Money Systems
import_candidates.abstract: Mobile money (MoMo) services let users pay individual merchants or businesses using either a smartphone or a basic phone. They are widely used for commerce in African countries, including Rwanda. To better understand the security and privacy aspects of how Rwandan businesses confirm MoMo payments in practice, we interviewed 30 Rwandan business owners and employees. While MoMo services send payment confirmations over SMS to both senders (customers) and recipients (merchants), we found that merchants often inspect confirmation messages on customers' phones, not their own. The reasons included confirmation messages being sent only to business owners' (not employees') phones, busy markets, phones being physically unavailable, and delayed SMS delivery. Trust also played a major role. As the customer controls their phone, this workaround can enable fraud via screenshots of past messages or spoofed confirmations. As these confirmation messages include customers' account balances, participants also reported privacy concerns. In response, we investigated the design space of alternative workflows, finding promise in redesigning customers' confirmation screens to remove private information and to add a secret known only to the merchant. We reflect on designing for security and privacy under the unique constraints of Sub-Saharan Africa.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 移动货币（MoMo）服务让用户可以使用智能手机或基础手机向个体商户或企业付款。它们在包括卢旺达在内的非洲国家的商业中被广泛使用。为了更好地理解卢旺达企业实际确认MoMo付款的安全和隐私方面，我们采访了30位卢旺达企业主和员工。虽然MoMo服务通过短信向发送方（客户）和接收方（商户）发送付款确认，但我们发现商户经常查看客户手机上的确认消息，而不是自己的手机。原因包括确认消息仅发送到企业主（而非员工）的手机、市场繁忙、手机物理上不可用以及短信延迟。信任也起了重要作用。由于客户控制着自己的手机，这种变通方法可能通过过往消息的截图或伪造确认来促成欺诈。由于这些确认消息包含客户的账户余额，参与者还报告了隐私担忧。作为回应，我们研究了替代工作流程的设计空间，发现重新设计客户的确认屏幕以移除私人信息并添加仅商户知道的秘密是有前景的。我们反思了在撒哈拉以南非洲独特约束下进行安全和隐私设计的问题。

import_candidates.title: Cross-National Information Attacks: A Two-Decade Analysis of Troll Behavior in Korea
import_candidates.abstract: Coordinated foreign influence operations pose a growing threat to online platforms, but detecting state-linked troll activity and tracking its evolution remain challenging. This paper presents an explainable machine learning framework for theory-guided detection and longitudinal analysis of suspected trolling within Korean online news comment sections. Our hierarchical model classifies comments along three dimensions central to influence campaigns: foreign origin, moral-emotional framing, and target country. To support explainability, it also extracts brief span-level textual evidence that provides human-interpretable rationales. We apply the approach to 112M South Korean news comments authored by 4M users over nearly 20 years, identifying 23,998 accounts exhibiting behavior consistent with coordinated manipulation. Analyzing these accounts, we find that they predominantly rely on morally condemning rhetoric rather than direct promotion of foreign-aligned narratives; this rhetoric receives significantly higher user engagement. Among the highest-engagement comments, the moral condemnation most frequently targets domestic political figures (e.g., presidents or party leaders) on both the left and the right, potentially amplifying polarization. Our framework supports transparent platform governance through explainable, evidence-based moderation. These observed rhetorical and engagement patterns can inform how platforms and observatories prioritize defenses and intervene before harmful narrative-target combinations achieve widespread reach.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 协调性的外国影响力行动对在线平台构成日益严重的威胁，但检测与国家相关的网络喷子活动并追踪其演变仍然具有挑战性。本文提出了一个可解释的机器学习框架，用于在韩国在线新闻评论区中，进行理论指导的检测和纵向分析疑似网络喷子行为。我们的分层模型从影响力行动核心的三个维度对评论进行分类：外国来源、道德-情感框架和目标国家。为支持可解释性，该模型还提取简短的片段级文本证据，提供人类可理解的依据。我们将该方法应用于近20年间由400万用户撰写的1.12亿条韩国新闻评论，识别出23,998个表现出与协调操纵一致行为的账户。分析这些账户，我们发现它们主要依赖道德谴责修辞，而非直接推广与外国一致的叙事；这种修辞获得了显著更高的用户参与度。在参与度最高的评论中，道德谴责最常针对左翼和右翼的国内政治人物（如总统或政党领袖），可能加剧两极分化。我们的框架通过可解释、基于证据的审核，支持透明的平台治理。这些观察到的修辞和参与模式可以为平台和观察机构如何优先安排防御措施、并在有害叙事-目标组合获得广泛传播之前进行干预提供信息。

import_candidates.title: Exploring Privacy Negotiation Strategies for Camera-Equipped Smart Home Devices in Airbnb
import_candidates.abstract: Privacy conflicts among multiple users are prevalent in smart environments. To address such conflicts and mitigate the privacy concerns of bystanders, privacy negotiation has been proposed as a promising approach. Yet it remains unclear what makes such negotiations accessible to tenants. In this paper, using camera-equipped smart devices in Airbnb as a case, we explored different privacy negotiation strategies to shed light on future designs to support such actions. We developed 24 storyboards varying four factors, including device types (e.g., driveway camera, video conferencing device for TVs, smart display device), negotiation initiators (host vs. tenant), strategies (physical adjustment vs. monetary compensation), and outcomes (accepted vs. declined). Then, using a vignette survey study (N = 400), we find that device type and strategy significantly shape evaluations: physical adjustment was consistently preferred over monetary compensation, and driveway camera negotiations were evaluated more favorably than those involving indoor devices (video conferencing device for TVs, smart display device). We summarize design implications to support privacy negotiations.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在智能环境中，多用户之间的隐私冲突普遍存在。为了解决此类冲突并减轻旁观者的隐私担忧，隐私协商已被提出作为一种有前景的方法。然而，目前尚不清楚如何使这种协商对租户而言是可行的。本文以Airbnb中配备摄像头的智能设备为例，探索了不同的隐私协商策略，以期为未来支持此类行动的设计提供启示。我们开发了24个故事板，变化了四个因素，包括设备类型（例如，车道摄像头、用于电视的视频会议设备、智能显示设备）、协商发起者（房东 vs. 租户）、策略（物理调整 vs. 金钱补偿）以及结果（接受 vs. 拒绝）。然后，通过一项小插图调查研究（N = 400），我们发现设备类型和策略显著影响评估：物理调整始终比金钱补偿更受青睐，并且车道摄像头协商比涉及室内设备（用于电视的视频会议设备、智能显示设备）的协商得到更积极的评价。我们总结了支持隐私协商的设计启示。

import_candidates.title: Selling the Dream: How Intimate Insiders and Identity-Based Attackers Disrupt Micro-businesses
import_candidates.abstract:
Micro-businesses represent the majority of all businesses, and act as vehicles to economic freedom for many at-risk population groups. At the risk of falling behind, many microbusiness owners (MBOs) increasingly adopt platforms as their primary infrastructure, and rely heavily on recruiting friends, families, and even romantic partners for running essential operations. Despite these facts, most prior work has focused on larger corporations and enterprise cybersecurity hygiene, ignoring the cybersecurity risks that such social relationships and changes in visibility introduce.
In this work, we conduct a deep dive into the experiences of MBOs through two complementary analyses: an evaluation of case records of 38 at-risk MBOs subject to insider threats, and semi-structured interviews with 16 MBOs. Our analysis show a combination of restricted access to financial resources and disruption to relationships drove them to take greater risks in recruiting and access control, leaving them more vulnerable to malicious insider attacks. They also shared that their pursuit of market reach frequently led to an unwanted, hypervisible presence, inadvertently providing intimate insiders among other adversaries with further leverage or information needed to cause harm. We conclude by proposing avenues for eCommerce governance that address these risks, focusing on preventing insider harm within these highly visible environments.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 微型企业占所有企业的大多数，并且是许多高风险人群实现经济自由的载体。为了避免落后，许多微型企业主（MBO）越来越多地采用平台作为其主要基础设施，并严重依赖招募朋友、家人甚至恋爱伴侣来运行关键业务。尽管有这些事实，大多数先前工作都聚焦于大型企业和企业网络安全卫生，忽视了此类社会关系和可见性变化所引入的网络安全风险。在这项工作中，我们通过两项互补分析深入探究了MBO的经历：对38家遭受内部威胁的高风险MBO的案例记录进行评估，以及对16家MBO进行半结构化访谈。我们的分析表明，财务资源获取受限和关系中断共同驱使他们在大幅招募和访问控制方面承担更大风险，从而使他们更容易受到恶意内部攻击。他们还分享说，他们对市场覆盖的追求经常导致一种不受欢迎的、过度可见的存在，无意中为亲密内部人员及其他对手提供了造成伤害所需的进一步杠杆或信息。最后，我们提出了针对这些风险的电子商务治理途径，重点关注在这些高度可见的环境中防止内部人员伤害。

import_candidates.title: WarrInt: Integrity Validation for Criminal Legal Process
import_candidates.abstract: In the U.S., criminal legal process (e.g., a search warrant) is the key mechanism by which law enforcement entities and courts compel third parties (e.g., Google or Meta) to produce evidence in support of a criminal investigation. However, these legal orders are simply documents, commonly served electronically, and there is no inherent mechanism to guarantee their integrity. In recent years, law enforcement has increasingly reported the use of forged legal process used to advance a variety of malign purposes, with online sellers offering such capabilities for a fee. We design a practical system, WarrInt, that is compatible with the constraints of existing process mechanics and helps third parties identify when the legal orders they receive may be forged or tampered with. Our evaluation on real and modified legal process documents shows that WarrInt is effective at identifying modifications.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在美国，刑事法律流程（例如搜查令）是执法机构和法院强制第三方（例如谷歌或Meta）提供支持刑事调查证据的关键机制。然而，这些法律命令只是文件，通常以电子方式送达，并且没有内在机制保证其完整性。近年来，执法部门越来越多地报告有人使用伪造的法律流程来推进各种恶意目的，在线卖家以收费方式提供此类能力。我们设计了一个实用系统WarrInt，它与现有流程机制的约束兼容，帮助第三方识别其收到的法律命令可能被伪造或篡改的情况。我们在真实和修改过的法律流程文件上的评估表明，WarrInt能有效识别修改。

import_candidates.title: Characterizing Security and Privacy Teaching Standards for Schools in the United States
import_candidates.abstract: Increasingly, students begin learning aspects of security and privacy during their primary and secondary education (grades K-12 in the United States). Individual U.S. states and some national organizations publish teaching standards—guidance that outlines expectations for what students should learn. However, research has not yet examined what is covered by these standards and whether the topics align with what the broader security and privacy community thinks students should know. To shed light on these questions, we manually examined 12,201 standards from all U.S. states and eight national organizations. We labeled 3,920 of them as being related to security and privacy, further classifying these into 109 topics ranging from encryption to appropriate online behavior.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 越来越多的学生在小学和中学教育阶段（美国K-12年级）开始学习安全与隐私方面的内容。美国各州和一些全国性组织发布了教学标准——概述学生应学习内容的指导方针。然而，研究尚未考察这些标准涵盖了哪些内容，以及这些主题是否与更广泛的安全与隐私社区认为学生应该知道的内容相一致。为了阐明这些问题，我们人工审查了来自美国所有州和八个全国性组织的12,201项标准。我们将其中3,920项标记为与安全与隐私相关，并进一步将其归类为109个主题，从加密到适当的在线行为不等。

import_candidates.title: Resilience Amid Diffused Surveillance During a Political Movement in Bangladesh
import_candidates.abstract: In July 2024, Bangladesh witnessed a historic, student-led uprising where social media became both a tool of mobilization and a site of repression. While surveillance is often framed through Bentham's vertical Panopticon model, our study extends the discourse on lateral surveillance. Drawing on 23 interviews with protesters, activists, and digital organizers, we examine how lateral surveillance operates within a political movement in Bangladesh, where discipline is enacted not only by the state but also through peers, kin, and intimate social ties. Participants described living under constant fear while also developing creative strategies of resilience, from improvised encrypted systems and panic deletions to cultural tactics like satire and hidden speech. We contribute to security and privacy literature on activism by highlighting the need for designs that strengthen safety, anonymity, and collective resilience in fragile and repressive contexts.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 2024年7月，孟加拉国见证了一场历史性的、由学生领导的起义，社交媒体既是动员工具，也是镇压场所。虽然监控通常以边沁的垂直全景敞视模型来框定，但我们的研究扩展了关于横向监控的讨论。基于对23名抗议者、活动人士和数字组织者的访谈，我们考察了横向监控如何在孟加拉国的政治运动中运作，其中纪律不仅由国家实施，也通过同伴、亲属和亲密社会关系来执行。参与者描述了在持续恐惧中生活，同时也发展出创造性的韧性策略，从临时加密系统和恐慌性删除到讽刺和隐蔽言论等文化策略。我们通过强调在脆弱和压制性语境中需要加强安全、匿名性和集体韧性的设计，为关于行动主义的安全与隐私文献做出贡献。

import_candidates.title: Information Security in Small-Scale Protests: Surveillance of Ugandan Anti-EACOP Protesters
import_candidates.abstract: We examine the information security practices of Ugandan climate activists protesting the development of the East African Crude Oil Pipeline (EACOP). We conducted five-week fieldwork in Kampala, Uganda, which included interviews with 13 anti-EACOP activists. Through an inductive analysis, we report on the complexities faced by small groups of predominantly student protesters as they covertly organise small-scale anti-EACOP protests within a context marked by state surveillance and repression. Our study points to a multi-layered adversarial landscape, where participants' experiences of direct threats, including arrests and information compromise, and their fears of abduction, shaped their security practices. These practices were rooted in autonomous decision-making within groups. We present a grounded understanding of how participants' need to protect information for their own security, as well as that of others, permeated their lives, leading them to adjust day-to-day aspects of their device management, communication, accommodation, transport and social relations as deliberate tactics to mitigate surveillance.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 我们考察了乌干达气候活动人士在抗议东非原油管道（EACOP）开发过程中的信息安全实践。我们在乌干达坎帕拉进行了为期五周的实地调研，其中包括对13名反EACOP活动人士的访谈。通过归纳分析，我们报告了一群以学生为主的抗议者在国家监控和镇压背景下秘密组织小规模反EACOP抗议时所面临的复杂性。我们的研究揭示了一个多层次的对抗性环境，参与者对直接威胁（包括逮捕和信息泄露）的经历以及对绑架的恐惧塑造了他们的安全实践。这些实践植根于群体内部的自主决策。我们提出了一种扎根的理解：参与者保护自身及他人信息安全的需求渗透到他们的生活中，促使他们调整设备管理、通信、住宿、交通和社会关系等日常方面，作为减轻监控的刻意策略。

import_candidates.title: BugAuditor: Detecting Bugs via Inconsistent Defensive Code Auditing
import_candidates.abstract:
Modern software systems contain complex behaviors that are prone to bugs when handled incorrectly. Detecting such bugs requires reliable oracles, which are difficult to construct as they require project-specific knowledge. Prior studies mainly obtain oracles from comparable code deviations, documentation, or historical bugs. However, these sources are inherently limited, leaving many project-specific bugs undetected.
In this paper, we propose inconsistent defensive handling as a new bug oracle for LLM-driven bug auditing. Specifically, we observe that real-world systems contain abundant defensive code, where developers proactively apply defensive handling in security-sensitive contexts to prevent bugs, and inconsistencies in such handling can indicate bugs. To realize this idea, we design BugAuditor, a framework that performs bug auditing via inconsistent defensive handling. BugAuditor first locates defensive code snippets across the codebase. It then reasons about the code to infer its security intent and underlying defensive patterns, characterizing the associated security-sensitive behaviors and defensive handling. Finally, BugAuditor applies the inferred patterns to audit the codebase and reports inconsistent defensive handling of the same security-sensitive behaviors across different contexts.
We evaluate BugAuditor on the Linux kernel. The results show that BugAuditor effectively mines project-specific knowledge embedded in defensive code that existing methods miss. Using the inferred defensive patterns, BugAuditor detects 54 long-latent bugs, including resource leaks, information leaks, and invalid pointer dereferences. To date, 20 bugs have been confirmed and fixed in the latest version, and two have been assigned CVE identifiers.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代软件系统包含复杂行为，若处理不当容易产生缺陷。检测此类缺陷需要可靠的判定基准（oracles），而这些基准因需要项目特定知识而难以构建。先前研究主要从可比较的代码偏差、文档或历史缺陷中获取判定基准。然而，这些来源本质上有限，导致许多项目特定缺陷未被检测到。本文提出不一致的防御性处理（inconsistent defensive handling）作为面向LLM驱动缺陷审计的新缺陷判定基准。具体而言，我们观察到现实世界系统中包含大量防御性代码，开发者在安全敏感情境中主动应用防御性处理以防止缺陷，而此类处理中的不一致可能指示缺陷。为实现这一想法，我们设计了BugAuditor，一个通过不一致防御性处理执行缺陷审计的框架。BugAuditor首先在代码库中定位防御性代码片段；然后对代码进行推理，推断其安全意图和底层防御模式，刻画相关的安全敏感行为与防御性处理；最后，BugAuditor将推断出的模式应用于整个代码库进行审计，并报告不同情境下对同一安全敏感行为的不一致防御性处理。我们在Linux内核上评估BugAuditor。结果表明，BugAuditor有效挖掘出现有方法遗漏的、嵌入在防御性代码中的项目特定知识。利用推断出的防御模式，BugAuditor检测到54个长期潜伏缺陷，包括资源泄漏、信息泄漏和无效指针解引用。迄今为止，已有20个缺陷在最新版本中被确认并修复，两个被分配了CVE编号。

import_candidates.title: TrioFuzz: A Three-Tier Architecture for Adaptive Strategy Selection in Fuzzing
import_candidates.abstract:
Adaptive strategy selection is a promising direction for improving fuzzing effectiveness, yet existing learning-based approaches often fail to outperform random selection in practice. We identify the root cause as an architectural mismatch rather than an algorithmic limitation. Our empirical study reveals that strategy effectiveness shifts at minute-level timescales, while existing in-loop architectures require tens of minutes per learning cycle. This order-of-magnitude gap prevents timely adaptation regardless of which learning algorithm is used. 
We propose TrioFuzz, a new fuzzing engine that decouples learning from execution through a three-tier thread architecture. A centralized learning thread aggregates feedback from parallel execution threads, compressing the adaptation cycle to under one minute. TrioFuzz integrates the same learning algorithms as prior work, isolating the architectural contribution from algorithmic factors. Our ablation study shows that learning algorithms perform significantly better under our proposed architecture than under their original in-loop implementations. Notably, native MOpt underperforms baselines, but becomes the top performer under TrioFuzz's architecture. Evaluation on FuzzBench and OSS-Fuzz shows that TrioFuzz achieves the highest coverage on 7 out of 9 FuzzBench targets and 8 out of 10 OSS-Fuzz projects, triggers 17% more vulnerabilities than AFL++ on Magma, and discovers 19 new CVEs in 6 real-world projects
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 自适应策略选择是提高模糊测试有效性的一个有前景的方向，然而现有的基于学习的方法在实践中往往无法超越随机选择。我们确定根本原因在于架构不匹配，而非算法限制。我们的实证研究表明，策略有效性在分钟级时间尺度上发生变化，而现有的循环内架构每个学习周期需要数十分钟。这种数量级的差距阻碍了及时适应，无论使用哪种学习算法。我们提出TrioFuzz，一种新的模糊测试引擎，通过三层线程架构将学习与执行解耦。一个集中式学习线程聚合来自并行执行线程的反馈，将适应周期压缩到一分钟以内。TrioFuzz集成了与先前工作相同的学习算法，将架构贡献与算法因素隔离开来。我们的消融研究表明，学习算法在我们提出的架构下比其原始循环内实现表现显著更好。值得注意的是，原生MOpt表现不如基线，但在TrioFuzz的架构下成为最佳表现者。在FuzzBench和OSS-Fuzz上的评估表明，TrioFuzz在9个FuzzBench目标中的7个和10个OSS-Fuzz项目中的8个上实现了最高覆盖率，在Magma上比AFL++多触发17%的漏洞，并在6个真实世界项目中发现了19个新CVE。

import_candidates.title: Generating Precise Format Specification for Network Protocols Through Adversarial LLM Interactions
import_candidates.abstract: This paper aims to address a significant gap in inferring precise format specifications for network protocols, particularly regarding the exact constraints on network packet fields. That is, while current methods can often derive accurate syntactic structures that divide a network packet into multiple fields, they typically struggle to capture the semantic dependencies or constraints among those fields. To address this issue, our central insight is that large language models (LLMs) have proven effective across various tasks, and adversarial interactions among these tasks can significantly alleviate the hallucination problem. Based on the insight, we propose a novel approach to generating precise protocol formats by adversarially combining LLM-based specification inference and code generation. By inputting the structured RFC documents of network protocols into LLMs, we generate both packet formats and reference packet parsers that iteratively refine one another to reduce hallucinations: the packet formats allow us to create a variety of network packets for parser testing, while runtime checks in the parsers help identify format errors. Our evaluation of 8 protocols shows a significant increase in precision and recall, achieving a 326% improvement over the state of the art in inferring field constraints. Furthermore, the improved format specifications enable effective fuzzing, leading to the discovery of 24 zero-day vulnerabilities in widely used protocol implementations.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文旨在解决推断网络协议精确格式规范中的重大空白，特别是关于网络包字段的确切约束。也就是说，现有方法通常能够推导出将网络包划分为多个字段的准确语法结构，但往往难以捕获这些字段之间的语义依赖或约束。为了解决这个问题，我们的核心洞见是，大型语言模型（LLM）已在各种任务中被证明有效，而这些任务之间的对抗性交互可以显著缓解幻觉问题。基于这一洞见，我们提出了一种新方法：通过对抗性结合基于LLM的规范推断和代码生成，生成精确的协议格式。将网络协议的结构化RFC文档输入LLM，我们生成数据包格式和参考数据包解析器，它们相互迭代细化以减少幻觉：数据包格式允许我们创建各种网络数据包用于解析器测试，而解析器中的运行时检查有助于识别格式错误。我们对8种协议的评估表明，精度和召回率显著提高，在推断字段约束方面比现有技术提升了326%。此外，改进后的格式规范实现了有效的模糊测试，从而在广泛使用的协议实现中发现了24个零日漏洞。

import_candidates.title: Bulbasaur: Branch-Guided Online Mutator Generation for Greybox Fuzzing
import_candidates.abstract:
Coverage-guided greybox fuzzing (CGF) hinges on generating inputs that satisfy branch constraints in order to explore deep code regions. Existing CGF techniques propose various approaches to improve the probability of solving such constraints. However, they still rely on general-purpose mutators, which lack the ability to precisely manipulate relevant input bytes to satisfy complex constraints.
Our analysis reveals that LLMs can more accurately solve branch constraints by generating tailored mutators. These mutators enable the fuzzer to perform localized and reusable modifications on inputs that reach target branches, producing precise mutations to satisfy target constraints. To achieve this, we propose Bulbasaur, a branch-guided framework for online LLM-based mutator generation. Bulbasaur employs hard frontier-guided branch selection to identify critical branches, continuously collects and organizes relevant static and dynamic context to support high-quality mutator generation, and adopts an efficient and adaptive strategy to apply generated mutators during fuzzing.
We evaluate Bulbasaur on the FuzzBench and UniFuzz benchmarks. The results show that Bulbasaur improves line and branch coverage by up to 23.18% and 24.46%, respectively, over state-of-the-art fuzzers, discovers 21 vulnerabilities missed by all baselines, and identifies 15 previously unknown vulnerabilities on OSS-Fuzz, all of which have been assigned CVE identifiers.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 覆盖率引导的灰盒模糊测试（CGF）依赖于生成满足分支约束的输入，以探索深层代码区域。现有的CGF技术提出了各种方法来提高求解此类约束的概率。然而，它们仍然依赖通用变异器，这些变异器缺乏精确操纵相关输入字节以满足复杂约束的能力。我们的分析表明，LLM可以通过生成定制的变异器来更准确地求解分支约束。这些变异器使模糊测试器能够对到达目标分支的输入进行局部化和可重用的修改，从而产生满足目标约束的精确变异。为实现这一目标，我们提出了Bulbasaur，一个分支引导的在线LLM变异器生成框架。Bulbasaur采用硬前沿引导的分支选择来识别关键分支，持续收集和组织相关的静态与动态上下文以支持高质量变异器生成，并采用高效且自适应的策略在模糊测试过程中应用生成的变异器。我们在FuzzBench和UniFuzz基准上评估了Bulbasaur。结果表明，Bulbasaur相比最先进的模糊测试器，将行覆盖率和分支覆盖率分别最多提高了23.18%和24.46%，发现了所有基线均遗漏的21个漏洞，并在OSS-Fuzz上识别出15个此前未知的漏洞，所有这些漏洞均已分配CVE标识符。

import_candidates.title: Death by a Thousand Drips: Uncovering Critical Resource Leaks in the Windows Ecosystem
import_candidates.abstract: Windows remote services are a critical attack surface due to their privileged execution and widespread deployment. Under the shared service-host model (svchost.exe), a single resource-exhaustion bug can trigger fate-sharing failures across co-resident services. Yet most vulnerability discovery remains crash-centric and is thus blind to silent, long-horizon resource leaks (e.g., memory/handle exhaustion) that do not cause immediate exceptions, while the closed-source Windows ecosystem limits the applicability of source-level sanitizers. We present REDOSPECTOR, a fuzzing framework for discovering resource-oriented Denial-of-Service (DoS) vulnerabilities in opaque Windows binaries. REDOSPECTOR combines (1) lightweight in-process hook-based telemetry by intercepting native ntdll heap routines, (2) an amplification-based oracle that identifies persistent leaks via repeated execution and growth-trend analysis, and (3) a hybrid seed-generation pipeline that leverages static binary analysis and Large Language Models (LLMs) to reach deep protocol states. Evaluated on the latest builds of Windows 11 (24H2) and Windows Server Preview, REDOSPECTOR uncovers 19 vulnerabilities in core services (including MSMQ, Remote Desktop Gateway, and CDP), leading to 12 assigned CVEs. Microsoft confirmed seven pre-authentication DoS issues in CDP and performed architectural adjustments, demonstrating that REDOSPECTOR can expose resource-mismanagement flaws that evade conventional fuzzing.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Windows远程服务因其特权执行和广泛部署而成为关键攻击面。在共享服务宿主模型（svchost.exe）下，单个资源耗尽漏洞可引发共驻服务间的命运共享故障。然而，大多数漏洞发现仍以崩溃为中心，因而对不会立即引发异常的静默、长周期资源泄漏（例如内存/句柄耗尽）视而不见，而闭源Windows生态系统又限制了源码级清理器（sanitizers）的适用性。我们提出REDOSPECTOR，一个用于发现不透明Windows二进制中面向资源的拒绝服务（DoS）漏洞的模糊测试框架。REDOSPECTOR结合了：(1)通过拦截原生ntdll堆例程实现的轻量级进程内钩子遥测；(2)一种基于放大的预言机，通过重复执行和增长趋势分析识别持续性泄漏；(3)一种混合种子生成流水线，利用静态二进制分析和大型语言模型（LLM）到达深层协议状态。在Windows 11（24H2）和Windows Server Preview的最新版本上评估，REDOSPECTOR在核心服务（包括MSMQ、远程桌面网关和CDP）中发现了19个漏洞，导致分配了12个CVE。微软确认了CDP中的七个预认证DoS问题并进行了架构调整，表明REDOSPECTOR能够暴露规避传统模糊测试的资源管理缺陷。

import_candidates.title: RecStruct: Recovering Nested Struct Types from Stripped Binaries via Stack-Driven Unification
import_candidates.abstract: Recovering composite data types from stripped binaries is critical for reverse engineering and vulnerability analysis. Existing approaches either rely on heavyweight decompilers with limited type reasoning, or employ expensive constraint solvers that fail to scale. While some methods can handle nested structures, they struggle with large real-world binaries due to prohibitive computational costs. We present RecStruct, a fast type recovery framework that reconstructs nested structures without dependence on any decompiler. RecStruct lifts binaries directly, performs flow-insensitive symbolic execution to reduce memory aliases, and introduces Stack-Driven Unification—a novel union-find algorithm that maintains an offset stack during traversal to merge types only when their nesting depths align. This enables precise recovery of recursive structures. We implement an end-to-end pipeline and evaluate it on 418 binaries comprising 744,770 functions, including benchmarks from prior work and large-scale programs such as QEMU and OpenSSL. Experimental results demonstrate competitive accuracy compared to existing tools, with substantial improvements in efficiency and scalability, enabling analysis of binaries that were previously intractable.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 从剥离二进制中恢复复合数据类型对于逆向工程和漏洞分析至关重要。现有方法要么依赖类型推理能力有限的重量级反编译器，要么采用无法扩展的昂贵约束求解器。虽然一些方法能够处理嵌套结构，但由于计算成本过高，它们难以应对大型真实世界二进制。我们提出RecStruct，一个快速类型恢复框架，无需依赖任何反编译器即可重建嵌套结构。RecStruct直接提升二进制，执行流不敏感符号执行以减少内存别名，并引入栈驱动统一——一种新颖的并查集算法，在遍历过程中维护偏移栈，仅当嵌套深度对齐时合并类型。这能够精确恢复递归结构。我们实现了端到端流水线，并在418个二进制（包含744,770个函数）上评估，包括先前工作的基准测试以及QEMU和OpenSSL等大规模程序。实验结果表明，与现有工具相比具有竞争性的准确性，并在效率和可扩展性方面有显著提升，使得以前难以处理的二进制分析成为可能。

import_candidates.title: Crypto Wars in Secure Messaging: Covert Channels in Signal Despite Leaked Keys
import_candidates.abstract:
End-to-end encryption (E2EE) is the foundation of modern secure messaging, with the Signal protocol as the de facto standard in applications such as Signal, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger and Google Messages. At the same time, the deployment of E2EE has led to growing pressure from authorities to decrypt user traffic under law enforcement. This raises a critical question: if an adversary can routinely decrypt Signal messages (for example via a mandated access or a leaked key), can users still communicate securely and covertly? 
We address this question through the lens of anamorphic encryption, which enables hidden communication within seemingly legitimate ciphertexts, even against an adversary who can decrypt them. We design two constructions that embed covert channels into the existing Signal Double Ratchet protocol. Concretely, we show how to embed covert messages (i) into Diffie-Hellman keys used in the asymmetric ratchet, or (ii) into authentication tags produced in the symmetric ratchet. Our techniques are compatible with existing Signal-style deployments and require no changes by the service provider. 
We formalize security in threat models that capture adversaries with decryption capabilities granted through lawful-access mechanisms, and prove that the resulting protocol transcripts are indistinguishable from those of standard Signal. We implement our constructions in the official Signal library and Android client, and show that they incur low overhead and are practical in real-world settings. Our results show that covert communication channels can persist even when conventional E2EE guarantees are compromised.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 端到端加密（E2EE）是现代安全消息传递的基础，Signal协议是Signal、WhatsApp、Facebook Messenger和Google Messages等应用中的事实标准。与此同时，E2EE的部署导致当局施加越来越大的压力，要求执法部门解密用户流量。这提出了一个关键问题：如果对手能够例行解密Signal消息（例如通过强制访问或泄露的密钥），用户还能安全且隐蔽地通信吗？我们通过变形加密的视角来解决这个问题，该技术能够在看似合法的密文中实现隐藏通信，即使对手可以解密它们。我们设计了两种构造，将隐蔽信道嵌入现有的Signal双棘轮协议中。具体而言，我们展示了如何将隐蔽消息（i）嵌入非对称棘轮中使用的Diffie-Hellman密钥，或（ii）嵌入对称棘轮中生成的身份验证标签。我们的技术与现有Signal风格部署兼容，且无需服务提供商进行任何更改。我们在威胁模型中形式化安全性，这些模型捕获通过合法访问机制获得解密能力的对手，并证明生成的协议记录与标准Signal的记录不可区分。我们在官方Signal库和Android客户端中实现了我们的构造，并表明它们开销低且在现实环境中实用。我们的结果表明，即使传统E2EE保证被破坏，隐蔽通信信道仍可保持。

import_candidates.title: Oblivious Signaling
import_candidates.abstract:
An anonymous messaging service has to solve a basic routing problem: a server must deliver an encrypted message to its recipient without learning who the recipient is. Broadcasting all ciphertexts hides the destination but forces every recipient to constantly scan for new messages. Oblivious Message Retrieval (OMR; CRYPTO~'22) tackles this by using fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) to let an untrusted server perform message retrieval on a recipient's behalf without learning which messages are pertinent.
We introduce Oblivious Signaling, which shifts this cost from retrieval to sending. The server maintains a fixed-size encrypted inbox for each recipient. When a sender submits a message, the server applies the same homomorphic update to every inbox: the intended inbox absorbs the message, and the rest remain unchanged at the plaintext level. The update is uniform, can be parallelized across inboxes, and ties the delivery cost strictly to the size of the anonymity set rather than global traffic. Recipients retrieve by fetching and decrypting their inbox, so checking for new messages is independent of the global traffic.
We formalize receiver privacy against an untrusted server, even when it colludes with other users, give a concrete construction based on fully homomorphic encryption, and analyze the resulting ``digital postage'' trade-off: delivery is expensive, but checking is cheap. Our prototype identifies practical regimes in which this cost-model shift is preferable to scan-based retrieval, even with highly optimized OMR implementations. This cost model is well-suited to settings where recipients check frequently, and messages arrive sporadically, and it naturally discourages high-volume spam.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 匿名消息服务必须解决一个基本的路由问题：服务器必须将加密消息投递给其接收者，同时不能获知接收者是谁。广播所有密文隐藏了目的地，但迫使每个接收者不断扫描新消息。不经意消息检索（OMR；CRYPTO '22）通过使用全同态加密（FHE）让不可信服务器代表接收者执行消息检索，同时不获知哪些消息是相关的，从而解决了这个问题。我们引入了不经意信令，它将这种成本从检索转移到发送。服务器为每个接收者维护一个固定大小的加密收件箱。当发送者提交消息时，服务器对每个收件箱应用相同的同态更新：目标收件箱吸收该消息，其余收件箱在明文层面保持不变。该更新是统一的，可以跨收件箱并行化，并将投递成本严格地与匿名集的大小而非全局流量挂钩。接收者通过获取并解密其收件箱来检索，因此检查新消息与全局流量无关。我们对不可信服务器形式化了接收者隐私，即使服务器与其他用户勾结；我们给出了基于全同态加密的具体构造，并分析了由此产生的“数字邮资”权衡：投递昂贵，但检查便宜。我们的原型确定了实际场景，在这些场景中，即使使用高度优化的OMR实现，这种成本模型转变也比基于扫描的检索更可取。这种成本模型非常适合接收者频繁检查且消息零星到达的场景，并且天然抑制高容量垃圾邮件。

import_candidates.title: Message Injection Attacks Against Signal
import_candidates.abstract: Signal is a secure messaging app offering end-to-end security for pairwise and group communications. It has tens of millions of users, and has heavily influenced the design of other secure messaging apps (including WhatsApp). Signal has been heavily analysed and, as a result, is rightly regarded as setting the "gold standard" for messaging apps by the scientific community. We present two practical attacks that break the integrity properties of Signal in its advertised threat model. Each attack arises from different features of Signal that are poorly documented and have eluded formal security analyses. The first attack, affecting Android and Desktop, arises from Signal's introduction of identities based on usernames (instead of phone numbers) in early 2022. We show that the protocol for resolving identities based on usernames and on phone numbers introduced a vulnerability that allows a malicious server to inject arbitrary messages into one-to-one conversations under specific circumstances. The injection causes a user-visible alert about a change of safety numbers, but if the users compare their safety numbers, they will be correct. The second attack is even more severe. It arises from Signal's Sealed Sender (SSS) feature, designed to allow sender identities to be hidden. We show that a combination of two errors in the SSS implementation in Android allows a malicious server to inject arbitrary messages into both one-to-one and group conversations. The errors relate to missing key checks and the loss of context when cryptographic processing is distributed across multiple software components. The attack is undetectable by users and can be mounted at any time, without any preconditions. As far as we can tell, the vulnerability has been present since the introduction of SSS in 2018. We disclosed both attacks to the engineers at Signal who promptly developed and deployed patches. Beyond presenting these devastating attacks on Signal's end-to-end security guarantees, we discuss more broadly what can be learned about the challenges of deploying new security features in complex software projects.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Signal是一款安全消息应用，为成对和群组通信提供端到端安全。它有数千万用户，并深刻影响了其他安全消息应用（包括WhatsApp）的设计。Signal已被大量分析，因此科学界正确地将其视为消息应用的“黄金标准”。我们提出两种实际攻击，打破了Signal在其宣称威胁模型下的完整性属性。每种攻击都源于Signal的不同特性，这些特性文档不足且未经过形式化安全分析。第一种攻击影响Android和桌面版，源于Signal在2022年初引入基于用户名（而非电话号码）的身份。我们表明，基于用户名和电话号码解析身份的协议引入了一个漏洞，允许恶意服务器在特定情况下向一对一对话中注入任意消息。注入会导致用户可见的关于安全号码更改的警报，但如果用户比较他们的安全号码，它们将是正确的。第二种攻击更为严重。它源于Signal的密封发送者（Sealed Sender, SSS）功能，该功能旨在隐藏发送者身份。我们表明，Android中SSS实现的两个错误组合允许恶意服务器向一对一和群组对话中注入任意消息。这些错误涉及缺少密钥检查以及当密码处理分布在多个软件组件时上下文的丢失。该攻击用户无法检测，并且可以在任何时间、无任何前提条件的情况下发动。据我们所知，该漏洞自2018年引入SSS以来一直存在。我们向Signal的工程师披露了这两种攻击，他们迅速开发并部署了补丁。除了展示这些对Signal端到端安全保证的毁灭性攻击外，我们还更广泛地讨论了在复杂软件项目中部署新安全功能所面临的挑战中可以学到什么。

import_candidates.title: Cryptanalysis of LDPC-Based Pseudorandom Error-Correcting Codes
import_candidates.abstract: Pseudorandom error-correcting codes (PRCs), a novel cryptographic primitive recently proposed at CRYPTO 2024, are primarily applied in undetectable watermarking schemes for large generative models. However, the security of PRCs has not yet been systematically analyzed. To fill this gap, we present the first cryptanalysis of PRCs. Specifically, focusing on LDPC-PRC, the only known practical instantiation of PRCs, we propose three novel attacks that challenge its undetectability and robustness. To rigorously demonstrate the practical threat, we analyze the concrete attack complexity under realistic parameters and validate the attack effectiveness on both real-world large language models and generative image models, including DeepSeek and Stable Diffusion. Our analysis shows that the claimed security guarantees of LDPC-PRC are undermined across all practically feasible regimes. For example, our attacks can detect the presence of a watermark with overwhelming probability at a cost of 222 operations. Beyond attacks, we further propose three defenses: parameter recommendation, implementation suggestion, and a revised key generation function. However, PRC-based watermarking schemes still fail to achieve 128-bit security due to inherent constraints of large generative models, such as the maximum output length of large language models. Overall, our work clarifies the concrete security limits of PRCs in real-world watermarking applications.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 伪随机纠错码（PRCs）是最近在CRYPTO 2024上提出的一种新型密码学原语，主要应用于大型生成模型的水印方案中，以实现不可检测性。然而，PRCs的安全性尚未得到系统分析。为填补这一空白，我们提出了首个针对PRCs的密码分析。具体而言，我们聚焦于LDPC-PRC——目前已知唯一实用的PRCs实例化方案——提出了三种新颖攻击，挑战其不可检测性和鲁棒性。为严格证明实际威胁，我们分析了现实参数下的具体攻击复杂度，并在真实世界的大型语言模型和生成图像模型（包括DeepSeek和Stable Diffusion）上验证了攻击有效性。我们的分析表明，LDPC-PRC所声称的安全保障在所有实际可行的范围内均被削弱。例如，我们的攻击能够以压倒性概率检测到水印的存在，成本仅为222次操作。除了攻击，我们还提出了三种防御措施：参数推荐、实现建议和修订的密钥生成函数。然而，由于大型生成模型的固有限制（例如大型语言模型的最大输出长度），基于PRC的水印方案仍然无法达到128位安全性。总体而言，我们的工作阐明了PRCs在实际水印应用中的具体安全限制。

import_candidates.title: Anamorphic Messaging: Analyzing the Double Ratchet, Triple Ratchet, PQ3, and MLS
import_candidates.abstract:
Anamorphic cryptography targets the scenario in which a dictator does not forbid the use of cryptography but requires all users to reveal their secret keys to them. Thus, the dictator can decrypt all honestly generated ciphertexts. The approach for bypassing this is to identify spots, such as random nonces, in existing cryptographic protocols in which secret messages can be hidden using an additional secret double key. So far, the literature mostly focused on identifying such spots in simple primitives like public-key encryption or signatures; only recently, an initial work identified limited spots in Signal's Double Ratchet Algorithm.
We are the first to leverage the statefulness of cryptographic communication protocols to employ continuously updated double states and, thereby, achieve Forward Security: Even if the adversary (i) observes all traffic, (ii) knows all users' regular secret key material at any stage of the protocol execution, and (iii) at some point learns the secret double state, the entire protocol execution looks benign although covert messages were previously hidden in the traffic anamorphically. We formalize this notion and also cover robustness and authenticity, which appear to be particularly relevant in the messaging context.
In this new model, we study four of the most relevant messaging protocols and identify hiding spots therein: Signal's Double Ratchet, Signal's Triple Ratchet, Apple's PQ3, and the two-party core of the Messaging Layer Security Standard. We focus on the cryptographic parts of these protocols and, despite their complexity, identify surprisingly few anamorphic hiding spots. We prove that all these protocols offer forward secure, authenticated anamorphic channels and we evaluate their bandwidths: While 16 bits can be embedded in every epoch of the Double Ratchet, Triple Ratchet and PQ3 provide 176 bits, respectively 256 bits, of bandwidth per post-quantum epoch, and MLS provides 688 bits per epoch.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 变形密码学针对的场景是：独裁者并不禁止使用密码学，但要求所有用户向其揭示秘密密钥。因此，独裁者可以解密所有诚实生成的密文。绕过这一点的方法是在现有密码协议中识别一些位置，例如随机数，在这些位置可以使用额外的秘密双密钥隐藏秘密消息。迄今为止，文献大多集中于在公钥加密或签名等简单原语中识别此类位置；直到最近，一项初期工作才在Signal的双棘轮算法中识别出有限的位置。我们首次利用密码通信协议的有状态性来采用持续更新的双状态，从而实现前向安全：即使对手（i）观察所有流量，（ii）在协议执行的任何阶段都知道所有用户的常规秘密密钥材料，并且（iii）在某个时刻获知秘密双状态，整个协议执行看起来也是良性的，尽管此前曾以变形方式在流量中隐藏了隐蔽消息。我们将这一概念形式化，并且还涵盖鲁棒性和真实性，这些在消息传递场景中似乎特别相关。在这个新模型中，我们研究了四个最相关的消息传递协议，并识别出其中的隐藏位置：Signal的双棘轮、Signal的三棘轮、Apple的PQ3，以及消息层安全标准的两方核心。我们关注这些协议的密码学部分，尽管它们很复杂，但我们识别出的变形隐藏位置少得惊人。我们证明所有这些协议都提供前向安全的、经过认证的变形信道，并评估其带宽：双棘轮的每个纪元可嵌入16比特，而三棘轮和PQ3在每个后量子纪元分别提供176比特和256比特的带宽，MLS每个纪元提供688比特。

import_candidates.title: ORPHEUS: A Separation-Robust Proactive Defense for Singing Voice Conversion
import_candidates.abstract: Recent advances in singing voice conversion enable realistic cloning of a singer's voice, raising concerns about unauthorized voice misuse. Existing proactive defenses inject imperceptible perturbations to disrupt such conversion, and they are designed for vocal signals rather than mixed music. In real-world scenarios, however, attackers usually obtain mixed music and apply source separation to decompose the mixture into vocal and backing tracks before conversion. Since separation models are trained to distinguish vocals from background components, perturbations are often treated as backing, causing the perturbations to be filtered out. To address this, we present ORPHEUS, the first proactive defense framework tailored for singing voice conversion involving source separation. Specifically, we jointly (i) interfere with the separation model via mask-misguiding and cross-track losses, (ii) disrupt identity information using an ensemble of heterogeneous speaker encoders to enhance transferability, and (iii) optimize perceptual quality through tonality harmony constraints and psychoacoustic masking. To evaluate ORPHEUS, we conduct experiments on two datasets with three source separation models and four singing voice conversion systems. Compared with the best-performing baseline, ORPHEUS further reduces identity similarity by 8.02% and 5.61% on two speaker verification models, respectively, demonstrating consistently stronger defense effectiveness and cross-model transferability.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 近年来，歌声转换的进展使得能够逼真地克隆歌手的声音，引发了对其未经授权使用的担忧。现有的主动防御方法通过注入不可察觉的扰动来破坏这种转换，并且它们是针对人声信号而非混合音乐设计的。然而在现实场景中，攻击者通常获取混合音乐，并在转换前应用源分离将混合音分解为人声和伴奏轨。由于分离模型被训练来区分人声和背景成分，扰动往往被当作伴奏，从而被滤除。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 ORPHEUS，这是首个针对涉及源分离的歌声转换量身定制的主动防御框架。具体来说，我们联合 (i) 通过掩码误导和跨轨损失干扰分离模型，(ii) 使用异构说话人编码器集成来破坏身份信息以增强可迁移性，以及 (iii) 通过音调和谐约束和心理声学掩蔽来优化感知质量。为了评估 ORPHEUS，我们在两个数据集上使用三个源分离模型和四个歌声转换系统进行了实验。与最佳基线相比，ORPHEUS 在两个说话人验证模型上分别进一步将身份相似度降低了 8.02% 和 5.61%，展示了持续更强的防御效果和跨模型可迁移性。

import_candidates.title: On Improving Robustness of Deepfake Image Detectors
import_candidates.abstract:
The rapid advancement of Generative AI has introduced remarkable opportunities while simultaneously raising critical concerns regarding content authenticity. While recent work has increasingly focused on improving the generalization of deepfake detectors across unseen generative models, their robustness against adversarial attacks remains limited. In particular, Abdullah et al. (IEEE SP 2024) evaluated eight detectors and demonstrated that most of them exhibit significant performance degradation under adversarial attacks. We also observed the same phenomenon by testing seven most recent state-of-the-art detectors. To address this problem, we propose a unified framework that integrates three complementary design principles without relying on adversarial training data: (i) higher-order statistical modeling in the frequency domain via Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT)-based moment pooling up to fourth order, (ii) content-agnostic feature representations derived from noise residuals, and (iii) cross-scene generalization enforced through patch-level semantic disruption. A key insight underpinning our approach is that adversarial attacks primarily operate on low-order statistics and visual semantics,
leaving higher-order residual-frequency characteristics, particularly kurtosis, largely unconstrained. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently improves robustness across six architecturally diverse detectors. Notably, we achieve up to 88.9% reduction in recall degradation on current adversarial benchmarks, and improve the best-performing recent detector (Yang et al., IEEE CVPR 2025) from 81.9% to 97.15% accuracy under attack. Overall, our method provides a principled, architecture-agnostic approach for improving deepfake detection robustness against current attacks.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 生成式AI的快速发展带来了显著机遇，同时也引发了关于内容真实性的严重担忧。尽管近期工作越来越关注提高深度伪造检测器在未见生成模型上的泛化能力，但其对抗对抗性攻击的鲁棒性仍然有限。特别是，Abdullah等人（IEEE SP 2024）评估了八种检测器，并证明大多数在对抗性攻击下表现出显著性能下降。我们通过测试七种最新的最先进检测器也观察到了同样现象。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个统一框架，集成了三种互补的设计原则，且不依赖对抗训练数据：(i) 通过基于离散余弦变换（DCT）的矩池化高达四阶的频率域高阶统计建模，(ii) 从噪声残差导出的内容无关特征表示，以及 (iii) 通过补丁级语义破坏强制实现的跨场景泛化。支撑我们方法的一个关键见解是，对抗性攻击主要作用于低阶统计和视觉语义，而高阶残差频率特征，特别是峰度，基本不受约束。大量实验表明，我们的方法在六种架构多样的检测器上持续提高了鲁棒性。值得注意的是，我们在当前对抗基准上实现了召回率下降最多减少88.9%，并将表现最好的最新检测器（Yang等人，IEEE CVPR 2025）在攻击下的准确率从81.9%提高到97.15%。总体而言，我们的方法提供了一种原则性的、与架构无关的方法，用于提高深度伪造检测对当前攻击的鲁棒性。

import_candidates.title: SafeAdapt: Safety Alignment with Adaptive Thinking Allocation for Large Reasoning Models
import_candidates.abstract:
Reasoning models have garnered growing importance as their strong Chain-of-Thought (CoT) capabilities unleash exceptional performance on complex tasks. Consequently, an emerging research direction explores "safety thinking" which leverages reasoning models' reasoning capabilities to assess the safety of input prompts and prevent harmful content generation. A prevailing yet under-examined belief in existing studies is that allocating more computational resources to the safety reasoning budget, i.e., rolling out longer safety thinking trajectories, necessarily yields safer behavior. However, this premise has not been systematically analyzed, despite the widespread adoption of reasoning models.
In this paper, we aim to fill this gap by conducting a rigorous safety evaluation to examine the relationship between the safety reasoning budget and the safety of reasoning model generations, particularly under adversarial conditions. Our analysis reveals that safety does not monotonically improve with longer thinking trajectories: both over-thinking on simple attacks and under-thinking on difficult attacks incur excess safety risks, leading to systematic failures under fixed-budget safety policies. Motivated by these key findings, we propose SafeAdapt: Safety Alignment with adaptive thinking Allocation, a novel approach that learns to dynamically adjust reasoning models' safety thinking budget based on prompt difficulty. This enables reasoning models to allocate computational resources adaptively, rather than following a single fixed thinking pattern (e.g., the longer the safer), thereby mitigating excess risks incurred by under-/over-thinking. Experiments across multiple adversarial benchmarks demonstrate that SafeAdapt significantly improves safety performance with a more ideal thinking budget under diverse and challenging attack settings.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 推理模型因其强大的思维链（CoT）能力而在复杂任务上表现出色，日益重要。因此，一个新兴的研究方向探索“安全思维”，利用推理模型的推理能力来评估输入提示的安全性并防止有害内容生成。现有研究中一个普遍但未经充分检验的信念是，为安全推理预算分配更多计算资源，即展开更长的安全思考轨迹，必然会产生更安全的行为。然而，尽管推理模型被广泛采用，这一前提尚未得到系统分析。本文旨在填补这一空白，通过严格的安全评估来考察安全推理预算与推理模型生成安全性之间的关系，特别是在对抗条件下。我们的分析表明，安全性并不会随思考轨迹变长而单调提升：对简单攻击的过度思考和对困难攻击的思考不足都会带来过度的安全风险，导致固定预算安全策略下的系统性失败。基于这些关键发现，我们提出SafeAdapt：安全对齐与自适应思考分配，这是一种学习根据提示难度动态调整推理模型安全思考预算的新方法。这使推理模型能够自适应地分配计算资源，而不是遵循单一的固定思考模式（例如越长越安全），从而缓解由思考不足/过度思考带来的过度风险。在多个对抗性基准上的实验表明，SafeAdapt在多样且具有挑战性的攻击设置下，以更理想的思考预算显著提升了安全性能。

import_candidates.title: GoodVibe: Security-by-Vibe for LLM-Based Code Generation
import_candidates.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation in fast, informal development workflows, often referred to as vibe coding, where speed and convenience are prioritized, and security requirements are rarely made explicit. In this setting, models frequently produce functionally correct but insecure code, creating a growing security risk. Existing approaches to improving code security rely on full-parameter fine-tuning or parameter-efficient adaptations, which are either costly and prone to catastrophic forgetting or operate at coarse granularity with limited interpretability and control. We present GoodVibe, a neuron-level framework for improving the security of code language models by default. GoodVibe is based on the key insight that security-relevant reasoning is localized to a small subset of neurons. We identify these neurons using gradient-based attribution from a supervised security task and perform neuron-selective fine-tuning that updates only this security-critical subspace. To further reduce training cost, we introduce activation-driven neuron clustering, enabling structured updates with minimal overhead. We evaluate GoodVibe on six LLMs across security-critical programming languages, including C++, Java, Swift, and Go. GoodVibe substantially improves the security of generated code while preserving general model utility, achieving up to a 2.5× improvement over base models, achieving performance competitive with full fine-tuning while using over 4700× fewer trainable parameters, and reducing training computation by more than 3.6× compared to the parameter-efficient baseline (LoRA). Our results demonstrate that neuron-level optimization offers an effective and scalable approach to securing code generation without sacrificing generality.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于快速、非正式的开发工作流中的代码生成，这种工作流通常被称为氛围编程（vibe coding），其中速度和便利性被优先考虑，而安全需求很少被明确。在这种场景下，模型经常生成功能正确但不安全的代码，从而造成日益严重的安全风险。现有改善代码安全性的方法依赖于全参数微调或参数高效适配，这些方法要么成本高昂且容易发生灾难性遗忘，要么在粗粒度上操作，可解释性和控制力有限。我们提出GoodVibe，一个神经元级框架，用于默认提升代码语言模型的安全性。GoodVibe基于一个关键洞察：与安全相关的推理局限于一小部分神经元。我们使用来自监督式安全任务的基于梯度的归因来识别这些神经元，并执行神经元选择性微调，仅更新这个安全关键子空间。为进一步降低训练成本，我们引入激活驱动的神经元聚类，以最小开销实现结构化更新。我们在六种LLM上跨安全关键编程语言（包括C++、Java、Swift和Go）评估GoodVibe。GoodVibe大幅提升生成代码的安全性，同时保持模型通用效用，相比基础模型提升最高2.5倍，在使用超过4700倍更少可训练参数的情况下达到与全微调相当的性能，并且相比参数高效基线（LoRA）减少超过3.6倍训练计算量。我们的结果表明，神经元级优化为在不牺牲通用性的情况下保障代码生成安全提供了一种有效且可扩展的方法。

import_candidates.title: SPIRIT: Batch Hintless Single-Server PIR via Stateful Ciphertext Conversion
import_candidates.abstract: This work proposes a single-server private information retrieval (PIR) protocol for the efficient evaluation of batched queries without offline hints. It has recently been shown that hintless PIR can be established through the cross-scheme ciphertext conversion technique. However, we point out that such a conversion introduces a considerable amount of computational and communication overheads in the batch PIR setting. To tackle the performance challenge, we propose SPIRIT, a batch, hintless, and single-server PIR protocol that leverages stateful ciphertext conversion to simultaneously achieve high-throughput query execution and low communication cost. To enhance computational efficiency, we develop a novel stateful key expansion procedure that amortizes the conversion cost across multiple queries, significantly accelerating the query evaluation speed. To reduce the communication overhead, we derive a new response compression strategy based on a shared intermediate representation, such that a batch of PIR responses can be packed into a single ciphertext efficiently. In experiments, we show that SPIRIT can achieve up to by 3.1×−5.1× speedup in query execution and reduce the communication bandwidth by 2.3×−3.6× compared to state-of-the-art batch PIR protocols.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种单服务器私有信息检索（PIR）协议，用于在无需离线提示的情况下高效执行批量查询。最近的研究表明，无提示PIR可以通过跨方案密文转换技术来实现。然而，我们指出这种转换在批量PIR场景中会引入大量的计算和通信开销。为了解决性能挑战，我们提出了SPIRIT，一种批量、无提示且单服务器的PIR协议。它利用有状态密文转换来同时实现高吞吐量查询执行和低通信成本。为了提高计算效率，我们开发了一种新颖的有状态密钥扩展过程，将转换成本分摊到多个查询上，从而显著加速查询评估速度。为了降低通信开销，我们基于共享中间表示推导出一种新的响应压缩策略，使得一批PIR响应可以高效地打包到单个密文中。实验表明，与最先进的批量PIR协议相比，SPIRIT在查询执行方面可实现高达3.1倍至5.1倍的加速，并将通信带宽减少2.3倍至3.6倍。

import_candidates.title: Your Keywords Know Each Other: Breaking SSE with <1% Leaked Documents
import_candidates.abstract:
Searchable symmetric encryption (SSE) schemes inevitably leak search, access, and volume patterns, which adversaries can exploit along with partial knowledge of the data to recover documents and queries. Prior passive attacks rely on document-keyword occurrence matching, but under realistic low leakage, many keywords induce identical patterns, forming large ambiguous groups that sharply limit recovery.
We observe this failure arises from missing relational signals among keywords. Keywords, however, exhibit stable semantic regularities across corpora even when direct co-occurrence is sparse, allowing external linguistic knowledge to augment observed leakage. Based on this insight, we present Whisper, a staged co-occurrence augmented query recovery framework that weaves LLM-synthesized corpora with pre-trained embeddings to densify co-occurrence matrices and disambiguate otherwise indistinguishable candidates.
We evaluate Whisper on six diverse real-world datasets, including three collected in late 2025 to test generalization beyond LLM training cutoffs. At 0.1% leakage, previously considered safe, Whisper boosts correct query recovery from 1727% under current SOTA to 36–49% across all datasets, a 22.5× improvement. Even at 1% leakage, Whisper approaches near-complete recovery, exceeding 80% on most datasets and peaking at 95%, while remaining effective against padding and volume hiding defenses, exposing a previously underestimated vulnerability in SSE.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 可搜索对称加密（SSE）方案不可避免地泄露搜索、访问和体积模式，敌手可以利用这些模式以及部分数据知识来恢复文档和查询。先前的被动攻击依赖于文档-关键词出现匹配，但在现实的低泄露条件下，许多关键词会产生相同模式，形成大型歧义组，严重限制了恢复。我们观察到这一失败源于关键词之间缺失的关系信号。然而，即使在直接共现稀疏的情况下，关键词在语料库中也表现出稳定的语义规律，这使得外部语言知识可以增强观察到的泄露。基于这一见解，我们提出了 Whisper，一个分阶段的共现增强查询恢复框架，它将 LLM 合成的语料库与预训练嵌入编织在一起，以稠密化共现矩阵并消歧原本不可区分的候选。我们在六个多样化的真实世界数据集上评估 Whisper，包括三个在 2025 年底收集的数据集，以测试超出 LLM 训练截止时间的泛化能力。在 0.1% 泄露（此前被认为安全）下，Whisper 将所有数据集上的正确查询恢复率从当前 SOTA 的 17–27% 提升到 36–49%，提高了 22.5 倍。即使在 1% 泄露下，Whisper 也接近完全恢复，在大多数数据集上超过 80%，最高达 95%，同时对填充和体积隐藏防御仍然有效，暴露了 SSE 中此前被低估的漏洞。

import_candidates.title: Non-Interactive Key Exchange from Lattices in the Standard Model
import_candidates.abstract: Existing non-interactive key exchange (NIKE) constructions in the CKS-heavy security model either incur loose security reductions or lack lattice instantiations due to the absence of suitable hash proof systems (HPS). To overcome this limitation, we introduce a new cryptographic primitive, named as decoupled key encapsulation mechanisms (decoupled KEMs), which separates recipient-independent ciphertext generation from recipient-specific key derivation. Moreover, we formalize the security of our decoupled KEM as MU-IND-wCCA^Corr+, which is a multi-user security notion. Based on this, we give a new framework that any decoupled KEM with MU-IND-wCCA^Corr+ implies a NIKE protocol with much tighter security in the CKS-heavy security model. For concrete instantiation, we first construct a specific HPS based on Modulus-LWE in the standard model, and then obtain a decoupled KEM with the desired security notion. Applying our framework, we obtain a lattice-based NIKE secure in the standard model, denoted NIKEHPS. NIKEHPS. achieves a linear security reduction loss in the number of users and close to the known optimum, improving upon the quadratic loss of SWOOSH (USENIX Security' 24) under CKS-heavy security. Experiments show that our protocol achieves significant speedups in key generation and shared-key derivation over SWOOSH.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现有的CKS-heavy安全模型下的非交互密钥交换（NIKE）构造要么安全归约不紧，要么由于缺乏合适的哈希证明系统（HPS）而无法给出格上实例。为克服这一限制，我们引入一种新的密码原语，称为解耦密钥封装机制（解耦KEM），它将接收者无关的密文生成与接收者特定的密钥派生分离。此外，我们将解耦KEM的安全性形式化为MU-IND-wCCA^Corr+，这是一个多用户安全概念。在此基础上，我们给出一个新框架：任何满足MU-IND-wCCA^Corr+的解耦KEM都可蕴含一个在CKS-heavy安全模型下具有更紧安全性的NIKE协议。具体实例化时，我们首先在标准模型下基于Modulus-LWE构造一个特定的HPS，然后得到一个具有所需安全概念的解耦KEM。应用我们的框架，我们获得一个标准模型下安全的基于格的NIKE，记为NIKEHPS。NIKEHPS实现了用户数量上的线性安全归约损失，接近已知最优，改进了SWOOSH（USENIX Security' 24）在CKS-heavy安全性下的二次损失。实验表明，我们的协议在密钥生成和共享密钥派生方面较SWOOSH有显著加速。

import_candidates.title: DuetORAM: Two-Server Distributed ORAM with Constant Rounds and O(log N) Communication
import_candidates.abstract:
Distributed Oblivious RAM (DORAM) is a promising building block for privacy-preserving cloud databases and outsourced storage systems. However, existing two-server designs often rely on slow linear scans or heavy cryptographic primitives, making them struggle to balance efficiency and bandwidth, and thus hindering their practical deployment.
We present DuetORAM, a two-server DORAM that achieves constant-round access with O(log N) communication while avoiding these computational bottlenecks. Our key idea is a replicated-to-shared block encoding that allows servers to keep identical ciphertexts for efficient PIR-based retrieval, while locally interpreting them as secret shares to enable oblivious eviction via a lightweight shuffle. We further design a secret-shared shuffle with an offline-online decomposition that shifts most bandwidth-intensive work to a preprocessing phase, significantly reducing online communication. We implement a prototype of DuetORAM and evaluate it under diverse network conditions. Our results show that DuetORAM outperforms both the state-of-the-art two-server scheme DUORAM (reducing retrieval latency by up to 170× in LAN settings), and three-server design S^3ORAM (reducing retrieval latency by 1.7× in LAN and accelerating eviction by 7× in LAN and 5× in WAN, respectively).
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 分布式不经意随机访问存储器（DORAM）是隐私保护云数据库和外包存储系统的有前景的构建模块。然而，现有的双服务器设计通常依赖缓慢的线性扫描或重量级密码原语，难以平衡效率与带宽，从而阻碍了实际部署。我们提出DuetORAM，一种双服务器DORAM，在避免这些计算瓶颈的同时，实现常数轮次访问和O(log N)通信。我们的核心思想是一种复制到共享的块编码，允许服务器保留相同的密文以进行高效的基于PIR的检索，同时在本地将其解释为秘密共享，从而通过轻量级混洗实现不经意驱逐。我们进一步设计了一种具有离线-在线分解的秘密共享混洗，将大多数带宽密集型工作转移到预处理阶段，显著减少在线通信。我们实现了DuetORAM的原型，并在多种网络条件下进行评估。结果表明，DuetORAM优于最先进的双服务器方案DUORAM（在局域网设置中检索延迟降低高达170倍）和三服务器设计S^3ORAM（在局域网中检索延迟降低1.7倍，在局域网中驱逐加速7倍，在广域网中加速5倍）。

import_candidates.title: HijackKV: New Threat in Position-Independent KV Cache Reuse
import_candidates.abstract:
Key-Value (KV) cache reduces inference latency in large language models (LLMs). Traditional prefix-based reuse has low cache hit rates across inference requests because it requires exact token and position matches. To improve efficiency, recent system optimizations introduce position-independent KV reuse, allowing KV cache to be reused whenever identical text chunks appear, regardless of their position in the sequence.
We show this design introduces a new threat, KV Cache Hijacking. Since KV caches are retrieved by token match but encode the context in which they were originally computed, the KV tied to a benign-looking token chunk may encode an attacker-controlled prefix. When later reused in a victim query, this contaminated KV silently hijacks the model's behavior, even if no attacker-controlled text appears in the input.
We introduce HIJACKKV, the first attack framework that systematically exploits this vulnerability, demonstrating its severity and practicality. HIJACKKV optimizes an attacker-controlled prefix, so that the KV computed for a subsequent common benign text encodes the attacker's goal, while the text remains unchanged for future cache hits. HIJACKKV achieves an average 94% success rate in a single attempt, remains effective under realistic constraints including low hit rates (10%) and frequent recomputation (50%), persists over multi-turn interactions, and transfers across models in black-box settings. We further provide design insights for building secure KV reuse systems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh:
键值（KV）缓存降低了大型语言模型（LLM）的推理延迟。传统的基于前缀的重用在不同推理请求之间的缓存命中率较低，因为它要求精确的token和位置匹配。为了提高效率，近期系统优化引入了位置无关的KV重用，允许只要出现相同的文本块就重用KV缓存，而不管其在序列中的位置。
我们表明这种设计引入了一种新威胁：KV缓存劫持。由于KV缓存通过token匹配来检索，但编码了其最初计算时的上下文，与看似良性的token块绑定的KV可能编码了攻击者控制的前缀。当稍后在受害者查询中被重用时，这种受污染的KV会静默地劫持模型的行为，即使输入中没有出现攻击者控制的文本。
我们介绍了HIJACKKV，这是首个系统性地利用该漏洞的攻击框架，展示了其严重性和实用性。HIJACKKV优化攻击者控制的前缀，使得后续常见良性文本计算出的KV编码了攻击者的目标，同时该文本保持不变以便未来缓存命中。HIJACKKV在单次尝试中平均达到94%的成功率，在现实约束下（包括10%的低命中率和50%的频繁重计算）仍然有效，在多轮交互中持续存在，并在黑盒设置中跨模型迁移。我们进一步为构建安全的KV重用系统提供了设计见解。

import_candidates.title: MarkNull: Model-Agnostic Watermark Removal in AI-Generated Images via On-Manifold Latent Manipulation
import_candidates.abstract: Digital watermarking has emerged as a critical technique for provenance and copyright attribution in AI-generated imagery, yet its robustness against realistic, model-agnostic removal attacks remains poorly explored. Existing attacks either succeed only against specific generative models or achieve removal at the cost of severe visual degradation. In this paper, we propose MarkNull, a model-agnostic watermark removal attack via on-manifold latent manipulation. MarkNull is grounded in a key observation: watermarked images exhibit a strong statistical dependency between the generated latent representation and the embedded initial noise. To quantify this dependency, we introduce the Noise-Latent Alignment Score (NLAS) and formulate an optimization objective that selectively decorrelates the latent representation from the embedded watermark while preserving semantic fidelity. Extensive evaluations across different categories of watermarking paradigms, including post-hoc, fine-tuning-based, and initial-noise-based schemes, demonstrate that MarkNull reduces average bit accuracy to 53.14%, approaching random-guessing (50%), without perceptible image degradation. To further improve scalability, we propose MarkNull-A, an amortized, optimization-free variant that distills the attack into a single forward pass, achieving 0.50 s/image with modest computational overhead. Notably, our attacks successfully compromise Google's SynthID-Image system while preserving high visual quality and transfer effectively to video watermarking. Finally, we present an attack detection mechanism as a defensive counterpart to MarkNull and MarkNull-A, highlighting the necessity of developing watermark designs resilient to model-agnostic latent-space attacks.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 数字水印已成为AI生成图像中出处和版权归属的关键技术，然而其针对现实、模型无关的移除攻击的鲁棒性仍鲜有探索。现有攻击要么仅对特定生成模型有效，要么在实现移除的同时造成严重视觉退化。本文提出MarkNull，一种通过流形上潜在操纵实现的模型无关水印移除攻击。MarkNull基于一个关键观察：带水印图像在生成的潜在表示与嵌入的初始噪声之间表现出强统计依赖。为量化这种依赖，我们引入噪声-潜在对齐分数（NLAS），并制定优化目标，选择性地使潜在表示与嵌入水印去相关，同时保持语义保真度。在不同水印范式（包括事后、微调式和初始噪声式方案）上的广泛评估表明，MarkNull将平均比特准确率降至53.14%，接近随机猜测（50%），且无可察觉的图像退化。为进一步提高可扩展性，我们提出MarkNull-A，一种摊销的、无需优化的变体，将攻击蒸馏为单次前向传播，以0.50秒/图像的速度实现且计算开销适中。值得注意的是，我们的攻击成功攻破了Google的SynthID-Image系统，同时保持高视觉质量，并可有效迁移到视频水印。最后，我们提出一种攻击检测机制，作为MarkNull和MarkNull-A的防御对应，强调开发能够抵御模型无关潜在空间攻击的水印设计的必要性。

import_candidates.title: BadGraph: Structural Knowledge Isolation Attacks against Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
import_candidates.abstract:
Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) improves cross-document reasoning by introducing graph structures into retrieval. However, these graph structures also expose an under-studied topological attack surface. Existing research on GraphRAG attacks primarily focuses on targeted attacks based on text or relation manipulation, which induce the model to generate specific incorrect answers by injecting factual errors. These attacks often rely on explicit false-answer payloads, poisoned relations, or corpus rewriting, and their documents can be easier to flag during content auditing.
In this paper, we propose a targeted availability attack against GraphRAG: Structural Knowledge Isolation. Unlike traditional wrong-answer manipulation attacks, this attack targets the system's availability by degrading retrieval of critical evidence through topological manipulation. The resulting context can lack the evidence needed for grounded answer generation. We first mathematically analyze three topological vulnerabilities of graph algorithms used in GraphRAG systems when subjected to topological perturbations. Based on this analysis, we propose the BadGraph attack framework. By injecting a small amount of semantically neutral text, it generates adversarial subgraphs in the knowledge graph and reduces the visibility of target evidence in top-ranked retrieval contexts. Experiments show that with a small document injection budget (49 documents on HotpotQA and 30 on 2WikiMultiHopQA), BadGraph consistently lowers source recall and end-to-end QA F1 on three mainstream GraphRAG systems (MS-GraphRAG, LightRAG, and FastGraphRAG), while using neutral linker documents.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 图检索增强生成（GraphRAG）通过将图结构引入检索来改进跨文档推理。然而，这些图结构也暴露了一个未被充分研究的拓扑攻击面。现有的GraphRAG攻击研究主要关注基于文本或关系操纵的目标攻击，这些攻击通过注入事实错误来诱导模型生成特定的错误答案。这类攻击通常依赖于显式的错误答案载荷、被污染的关系或语料库重写，其文档在内容审计期间更容易被标记。在本文中，我们提出了一种针对GraphRAG的目标可用性攻击：结构化知识隔离。与传统的错误答案操纵攻击不同，该攻击通过拓扑操纵降低对关键证据的检索，从而针对系统的可用性。由此产生的上下文可能缺乏生成有依据答案所需的证据。我们首先从数学上分析了GraphRAG系统中所用图算法在遭受拓扑扰动时的三种拓扑脆弱性。基于此分析，我们提出了BadGraph攻击框架。通过注入少量语义中性的文本，它在知识图谱中生成对抗性子图，并降低目标证据在排名靠前的检索上下文中的可见性。实验表明，在较小的文档注入预算下（HotpotQA上49篇文档，2WikiMultiHopQA上30篇文档），BadGraph持续降低了三种主流GraphRAG系统（MS-GraphRAG、LightRAG和FastGraphRAG）的来源召回率和端到端问答F1，同时使用中性的链接文档。

import_candidates.title: FragFuse: Bypassing Access Control of Large Language Model Agents via Memory-Based Query Fragmentation and Fusion
import_candidates.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on long-term memory to support complex task execution, user personalization, and domain adaptation. Meanwhile, emerging access-control mechanisms for LLM agents are being explored to block policy-violating requests, aiming to prevent misuse and improve resource efficiency. In this paper, we reveal a novel attack surface arising from agents' memory operations: prohibited content triggering access control can be fragmented across interactions, stored in long-term memory in a benign-appearing form, and later reconstructed through memory retrieval, without appearing explicitly in the final user query. Specifically, we propose FragFuse, the first attack that enables unprivileged users to bypass agent access control by exploiting this temporal channel introduced by long-term memory. FragFuse operates in three stages: (1) identifying rejection-responsible fragments via black-box adaptive querying with fragment masking; (2) injecting these fragments into memory using marked carrier queries; and (3) retrieving and fusing the stored fragments through a follow-up attack query. While FragFuse can be instantiated manually for individual agents, we propose an optimization scheme that tunes fusion instructions and marker designs on surrogate models, enabling automated attack generation without violating the attacker's threat model assumptions. We evaluate FragFuse across four representative agent settings and task domains, covering three state-of-the-art agent access-control mechanisms. FragFuse achieves an average bypass success rate of 86.3% and an average end-to-end harmful task success rate of 41.1% across all settings, with only 4.4% average task success rate degradation compared to configurations without access control. Additionally, we show that alternative defenses, such as state-of-the-art prompt-injection detectors and perplexity detectors, cannot effectively address our attack.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体日益依赖长期记忆来支持复杂任务执行、用户个性化和领域适应。同时，针对LLM智能体的新兴访问控制机制正在被探索，以阻止违反策略的请求，旨在防止滥用并提高资源效率。在本文中，我们揭示了智能体记忆操作带来的新型攻击面：触发访问控制的禁止内容可以跨交互被碎片化，以看似无害的形式存储在长期记忆中，随后通过记忆检索重建，而不会明确出现在最终用户查询中。具体而言，我们提出了FragFuse，这是首个使无权限用户能够利用长期记忆引入的时序信道绕过智能体访问控制的攻击。FragFuse分三个阶段运行：(1) 通过带片段掩码的黑盒自适应查询识别导致拒绝的片段；(2) 使用标记载体查询将这些片段注入记忆；(3) 通过后续攻击查询检索并融合存储的片段。虽然FragFuse可以针对单个智能体手动实例化，但我们提出了一种优化方案，在替代模型上调整融合指令和标记设计，从而在不违反攻击者威胁模型假设的情况下实现自动化攻击生成。我们在四个代表性智能体设置和任务领域中评估了FragFuse，涵盖三种最先进的智能体访问控制机制。FragFuse在所有设置中平均绕过成功率达到86.3%，平均端到端有害任务成功率达到41.1%，与无访问控制配置相比，平均任务成功率仅下降4.4%。此外，我们表明，诸如最先进的提示注入检测器和困惑度检测器等替代防御措施无法有效应对我们的攻击。

import_candidates.title: From Zero to Hero: Cross-modal-enhanced Adversarial Item Promotion Attack against Multimodal Recommender Systems
import_candidates.abstract: Multimodal recommender systems (MRSs) jointly leverage visual and textual item representations to determine item ranking and exposure in modern online platforms. Their strong dependence on item content, however, introduces new security risks. In particular, malicious sellers can conduct the adversarial item promotion (AIP) attack to manipulate item content to deceive the recommender into overranking specific items. When it succeeds, the promoted items gain disproportionately higher exposure, leading to significant market visibility and direct economic gain. However, existing AIP research primarily targets unimodal recommenders, leaving the unique vulnerabilities of MRSs largely unexplored. Meanwhile, multimodal adversarial attacks for vision–language models (VLMs) optimize objectives unrelated to ranking and lack cross-modal coordination unique to MRSs. To bridge this gap, we propose CREAM (CRoss-modal-Enhanced AIP attack against MRSs). Our key insight is to jointly perturb multiple modalities in a semantically consistent manner}. We integrate a tailored visual perturbator, a text generator, and a joint optimization controller to fully exploit cross-modal correlations in a black-box setting. Our comprehensive evaluation shows that CREAM significantly outperforms existing methods, achieving on average 5.75x and 2.89x higher exposure at top-10 and top-50 metrics, and demonstrates robustness under evolving real-world conditions. This exposes a tangible economic risk to recommender platforms. Meanwhile, CREAM maintains high imperceptibility across visual, textual, and cross-modal dimensions. We further investigate several potential defense strategies and demonstrate their limitations, highlighting the urgent need for stronger protections against adversarial threats in MRSs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 多模态推荐系统（MRSs）联合利用视觉和文本物品表示来确定现代在线平台中的物品排名和曝光。然而，它们对物品内容的高度依赖引入了新的安全风险。特别是，恶意卖家可以执行对抗性物品推广（AIP）攻击，操纵物品内容以欺骗推荐系统对特定物品进行过度排名。当攻击成功时，被推广的物品获得不成比例的高曝光，带来显著的市场可见性和直接经济收益。然而，现有的AIP研究主要针对单模态推荐系统，使得MRSs特有的脆弱性在很大程度上未被探索。同时，针对视觉-语言模型（VLMs）的多模态对抗攻击优化的目标与排名无关，并且缺乏MRSs特有的跨模态协调。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了CREAM（针对MRSs的跨模态增强AIP攻击）。我们的关键见解是以语义一致的方式联合扰动多个模态。我们集成了一个定制的视觉扰动器、一个文本生成器和一个联合优化控制器，以在黑盒设置下充分利用跨模态相关性。我们的综合评估表明，CREAM显著优于现有方法，在top-10和top-50指标上平均分别实现了5.75倍和2.89倍更高的曝光，并在不断变化的现实条件下表现出鲁棒性。这给推荐平台带来了切实的经济风险。同时，CREAM在视觉、文本和跨模态维度上保持了高不可感知性。我们进一步研究了几种潜在的防御策略并展示了它们的局限性，突显了针对MRSs中对抗性威胁需要更强保护的紧迫性。

import_candidates.title: Low-Cost Hard-Label Adversarial Attack with Theoretical Foundations
import_candidates.abstract: Hard-label black-box attacks, relying solely on top-1 predictions, represent one of the most challenging yet practically threat models. Despite recent progress, existing approaches face two key limitations: (1) they overlook the critical role of initialization, focusing primarily on optimization strategies; and (2) they rely heavily on empirical heuristics without theoretical guarantees. To bridge this gap, we establish a unified theoretical framework showing that existing sign-flipping hard-label attacks can be understood as approximating the true gradient sign. Guided by this {principled analysis}, we propose a novel attack framework featuring a zero-query initialization strategy and a Pattern-Driven Optimization (PDO) algorithm. We provide theoretical guarantees that our initialization yields higher cosine similarity to the true gradient sign than random baselines, and our PDO module achieves significantly lower query complexity than baseline search methods. Extensive experiments across CIFAR-10, ImageNet, and ObjectNet—covering standard and adversarially trained models, commercial APIs, and CLIP models—demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms SOTA hard-label attacks in both success rate and efficiency, particularly under low query budgets. Furthermore, our method demonstrates robust generalization across corrupted data (ImageNet-C), biomedical images (PathMNIST), and dense prediction tasks such as segmentation. Notably, it bypasses the stateful defense Blacklight, achieving a 0% detection rate.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 硬标签黑盒攻击仅依赖 top-1 预测，是最具挑战性但也最切实的威胁模型之一。尽管近期取得了进展，现有方法仍面临两个关键局限：(1) 它们忽视了初始化的关键作用，主要关注优化策略；(2) 它们严重依赖经验启发式方法，缺乏理论保证。为弥补这一空白，我们建立了一个统一的理论框架，表明现有的符号翻转硬标签攻击可以理解为对真实梯度符号的近似。在这一原则性分析的指导下，我们提出了一种新的攻击框架，其特色是零查询初始化策略和模式驱动优化（PDO）算法。我们提供理论保证：我们的初始化比随机基线具有更高的与真实梯度符号的余弦相似度，并且我们的 PDO 模块比基线搜索方法实现了显著更低的查询复杂度。在 CIFAR-10、ImageNet 和 ObjectNet 上的大量实验——涵盖标准和对抗训练模型、商业 API 以及 CLIP 模型——表明我们的方法在成功率和效率上始终优于最先进的硬标签攻击，尤其是在低查询预算下。此外，我们的方法在损坏数据（ImageNet-C）、生物医学图像（PathMNIST）以及分割等密集预测任务上表现出稳健的泛化能力。值得注意的是，它绕过了有状态防御 Blacklight，实现了 0% 的检测率。

import_candidates.title: BlockMeNot: Automatic Selection of Domain and URL Blocking Granularity to Minimize Collateral Damage and Evasion
import_candidates.abstract: Domain and URL blocking is a fundamental mechanism for mitigating malicious, illegal, and inappropriate online content. Yet, selecting the right blocking granularity remains a largely unexplored problem. Overblocking can cause severe collateral damage if the content to be blocked uses the infrastructure of benign services, which may be unintentionally disrupted. Underblocking instead enables trivial evasion. This paper addresses this gap by proposing a novel approach that, given a domain or URL to be blocked, automatically selects the most appropriate blocking granularity (URL, subdomain, or apex) to minimize collateral damage and evasion opportunities. At the core of our approach are two novel machine learning classifiers to identify URL-leasing and subdomain-leasing apexes. The classifiers are trained and evaluated using a manually labeled dataset of 10,843 apexes, achieving F1 scores over 0.9. We implement our approach into BlockMeNot, a tool for identifying potential collateral damage prior to enforcement. We evaluate BlockMeNot on 225,355 entries (i.e., domains and URLs) collected from six blocklists and two threat exchanges. Although only 2.6% of apexes belong to leasers, they host 34.7% of the entries, and up to 71.7% in phishing-focused blocklists, underscoring the importance of fine-grained blocking. BlockMeNot identifies 1,976 leasing apexes, 59.3% of which were not in our ground truth, demonstrating the limitations of static lists and the need for our classifiers. Only 37.2% of blocklist entries are listed at the optimal granularity, 1.3% produce collateral damage, and 61.6% enable easy evasion.
