Overall, our work provides the first automated solution for domain and URL blocking granularity selection and offers practical guidance for block requesters, executors, and blocklist maintainers.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 域名和URL屏蔽是缓解恶意、非法和不当在线内容的基本机制。然而，选择正确的屏蔽粒度仍然是一个很大程度上未被探索的问题。如果待屏蔽内容使用了良性服务的基础设施，过度屏蔽可能导致严重的附带损害，可能无意中干扰这些服务。相反，屏蔽不足则会导致轻易规避。本文针对这一空白，提出了一种新颖方法：给定要屏蔽的域名或URL，自动选择最合适的屏蔽粒度（URL、子域名或根域名），以最小化附带损害和规避机会。我们方法的核心是两个新颖的机器学习分类器，用于识别URL租赁和子域名租赁的根域名。这些分类器使用手动标记的10,843个根域名数据集进行训练和评估，F1分数超过0.9。我们将该方法实现为BlockMeNot，一个用于在强制执行前识别潜在附带损害的工具。我们在从六个屏蔽列表和两个威胁交换平台收集的225,355个条目（即域名和URL）上评估BlockMeNot。尽管只有2.6%的根域名属于租赁者，但它们承载了34.7%的条目，在专注于网络钓鱼的屏蔽列表中这一比例高达71.7%，凸显了细粒度屏蔽的重要性。BlockMeNot识别出1,976个租赁根域名，其中59.3%不在我们的真实标注中，这展示了静态列表的局限性以及我们分类器的必要性。只有37.2%的屏蔽列表条目以最优粒度列出，1.3%产生附带损害，61.6%使规避变得容易。总体而言，我们的工作提供了首个用于域名和URL屏蔽粒度选择的自动化解决方案，并为屏蔽请求者、执行者和屏蔽列表维护者提供了实用指导。

import_candidates.title: H3Act: Automated Measuring Semantic Conversion Anomalies of HTTP/3-to-HTTP/1.1 Translation in CDNs
import_candidates.abstract: Content Delivery Networks (CDNs) are adopting HTTP/3 to enhance performance; however, they often need to convert it to HTTP/1.1 for compatibility. This conversion creates significant attack surfaces and may reintroduce confirmed or even patched vulnerabilities in HTTP/2 or HTTP/1. Unfortunately, existing tools struggle to adapt to the HTTP/3 environment and efficiently leverage accumulated attack knowledge. To overcome these challenges and systematically measure HTTP/3-to-HTTP/1.1 conversion anomalies within the black-box CDN environment, we present H3Act, a dual-agent, knowledge-driven fuzzing framework targeting HTTP/3-to-HTTP/1.1 semantic conversion anomalies. Our approach combines Large Language Models (LLMs) with Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to automatically transform protocol specifications and historical threat intelligence into high-precision HTTP/3 test payloads, enabling regression testing of semantic translation risks. In a large-scale study of 9 commercial CDNs, including Cloudflare, Cloudfront, and Tencent CDN, we found a significant regression in protocol security, which means vulnerabilities in old protocols are reintroduced in HTTP/3. Our research identified 7 common attack vectors across various categories, including request smuggling, cache poisoning, and Denial-of-Service (DoS) amplification. Every CDN is vulnerable to at least one attack vector. We have responsibly disclosed these vulnerabilities and have received confirmations from some vendors. These findings highlight that the CDN ecosystem currently lacks the capacity to maintain security consistency checks while pursuing improvements in protocol performance.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 内容分发网络（CDN）正在采用HTTP/3以提升性能；然而，为了兼容性，它们通常需要将其转换为HTTP/1.1。这种转换为攻击面创造了显著空间，并可能重新引入HTTP/2或HTTP/1中已确认甚至已修补的漏洞。不幸的是，现有工具难以适应HTTP/3环境并高效利用积累的攻击知识。为克服这些挑战并在黑盒CDN环境中系统性地测量HTTP/3到HTTP/1.1转换异常，我们提出了H3Act，一个双智能体、知识驱动的模糊测试框架，针对HTTP/3到HTTP/1.1语义转换异常。我们的方法将大型语言模型（LLM）与混合检索增强生成（RAG）相结合，自动将协议规范和历史威胁情报转化为高精度HTTP/3测试载荷，从而实现对语义转换风险的回归测试。在对9个商业CDN（包括Cloudflare、Cloudfront和腾讯CDN）的大规模研究中，我们发现协议安全性出现显著回归，这意味着旧协议中的漏洞在HTTP/3中被重新引入。我们的研究识别出跨多个类别的7种常见攻击向量，包括请求走私、缓存投毒和拒绝服务（DoS）放大。每个CDN都至少容易受到一种攻击向量的影响。我们已负责任地披露这些漏洞，并收到部分厂商的确认。这些发现突出表明，CDN生态系统目前在追求协议性能提升的同时，缺乏维持安全一致性检查的能力。

import_candidates.title: JScamd: An Automated Static Taint Analysis Framework for Detecting Cryptographic API Misuses in JavaScript
import_candidates.abstract:
Cryptographic APIs are essential to application security, yet frequent developer misuse leads to widespread vulnerabilities. Detecting cryptographic misuse in JavaScript is challenging due to its dynamic semantics and fragmented cryptographic library ecosystem, which hinder static analysis tools from accurately modeling data flows and covering non-standard or evolving libraries, leading to high false-negative rates.
In this paper, we propose JScamd, a static analysis framework for scalable detection of cryptographic misuse in JavaScript. JScamd integrates an enhanced program representation engine, an LLM-assisted taint rule generation pipeline, and a precise static taint analysis engine to address JavaScript dynamic features. Building upon 16 systematically defined cryptographic security constraints, JScamd automatically analyzes cryptographic APIs, identifies security-sensitive taint sources and sinks, and synthesizes comprehensive taint analysis rules. This design enables accurate detection of cryptographic misuse across diverse JavaScript libraries and application scenarios. We performed a comprehensive large-scale evaluation on 322 widely adopted JavaScript projects. JScamd detects 1,059 misuses and achieves 97.78% precision, significantly outperforming three state-of-the-art tools. Our analysis further uncovers previously unknown vulnerabilities, resulting in 41 assigned CVEs. These results demonstrate that JScamd effectively bridges cryptographic security specifications and ecosystem-scale vulnerability detection in JavaScript.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 密码API对应用安全至关重要，然而开发者频繁的误用导致广泛漏洞。由于JavaScript的动态语义和碎片化的密码库生态系统，检测JavaScript中的密码误用颇具挑战，这阻碍了静态分析工具准确建模数据流并覆盖非标准或不断演化的库，导致高漏报率。本文提出JScamd，一个用于可扩展检测JavaScript中密码误用的静态分析框架。JScamd集成了增强的程序表示引擎、LLM辅助的污点规则生成流水线以及精确的静态污点分析引擎，以应对JavaScript动态特性。基于16个系统定义的密码安全约束，JScamd自动分析密码API，识别安全敏感的污点源和汇聚点，并合成全面的污点分析规则。该设计能够跨多样化的JavaScript库和应用场景准确检测密码误用。我们在322个广泛采用的JavaScript项目上进行了全面大规模评估。JScamd检测到1,059处误用，精确率达97.78%，显著优于三个最先进的工具。我们的分析进一步揭示了此前未知的漏洞，获得41个分配的CVE。这些结果表明JScamd有效桥接了JavaScript中密码安全规范与生态系统规模漏洞检测之间的鸿沟。

import_candidates.title: BUIzz: Finding Policy Enforcement Bugs via Interaction Simulation on the Browser User Interface
import_candidates.abstract:
Modern web ecosystems rely on security policy headers, such as Content Security Policy (CSP) and the SameSite cookie attribute, for client-side defenses. Because browsers enforce these headers, browser bugs in policy enforcement directly undermine these defenses. While recent studies have attempted to find such bugs, they largely overlook bugs triggered by user interactions on the browser user interface (BUI).
In this paper, we propose BUIZZ, the first testing framework that identifies policy enforcement bugs triggered by BUI-level user interactions. BUIZZ first collects a comprehensive set of interactions by referencing browser manuals, right-click context menus, and known browser bugs. It then executes each interaction and their combinations on the test pages via OS-level simulation. Instead of cross-browser differential testing, BUIZZ leverages a pre/post-interaction oracle that checks for enforcement inconsistencies before and after applying interactions, enabling bug detection within a single browser. We demonstrate the efficacy of BUIZZ by finding 35 security bugs and three functional bugs across six browsers, including Chrome and Firefox. Our reports have led to fixes for 14 security bugs, resulting in seven CVEs and $14,700 in bug bounties.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代Web生态系统依赖安全策略头，如内容安全策略（CSP）和SameSite cookie属性，来实现客户端防御。由于浏览器执行这些头，策略执行中的浏览器缺陷会直接削弱这些防御。虽然近期研究试图发现此类缺陷，但它们在很大程度上忽略了由浏览器用户界面（BUI）上的用户交互触发的缺陷。在本文中，我们提出BUIZZ，这是首个识别由BUI级用户交互触发的策略执行缺陷的测试框架。BUIZZ首先通过参考浏览器手册、右键上下文菜单和已知浏览器缺陷来收集一组全面的交互。然后，它通过操作系统级模拟在测试页面上执行每个交互及其组合。BUIZZ不采用跨浏览器差分测试，而是利用交互前/后预言机，检查应用交互前后执行的不一致性，从而在单个浏览器内实现缺陷检测。我们通过发现六个浏览器（包括Chrome和Firefox）中的35个安全缺陷和三个功能缺陷，证明了BUIZZ的有效性。我们的报告已促成14个安全缺陷的修复，产生了七个CVE和14,700美元漏洞赏金。

import_candidates.title: Raising the Flag: Detecting Missing Permission Controls in Mini-Program APIs
import_candidates.abstract: Mini-programs embedded within super-apps like WeChat have surged in popularity due to their flexibility and convenience, offering rich functionalities through underlying APIs. However, this tight integration introduces serious security risks: mini-programs often inherit the mobile operating system's permissions granted to their host super-app, potentially bypassing critical security checks. In this paper, we address the urgent need for more fine-grained access control tailored to mini-programs. We propose PERMSCOPE, a systematic framework to detect and analyze missing scope checks in mini-program APIs, revealing instances where Android permissions are implicitly inherited and exercised in mini-program APIs, i.e., cases where "ask and check'' primitives are absent. Our empirical analysis of four major super-apps reveals that 183 (8.85%) APIs are not properly protected at the mini-program API layer. We discuss the challenges underlying this issue and advocate for super-app developers to enforce fine-grained access control mechanisms at the API boundary, thereby strengthening the trustworthiness of the mobile super-app ecosystem.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 嵌入微信等超级应用中的小程序因其灵活性和便利性而迅速流行，通过底层 API 提供丰富的功能。然而，这种紧密集成带来了严重的安全风险：小程序通常继承宿主超级应用所获得的移动操作系统权限，可能绕过关键的安全检查。在本文中，我们针对小程序更细粒度访问控制的迫切需求，提出了 PERMSCOPE，一个系统化框架，用于检测和分析小程序 API 中缺失的作用域检查，揭示 Android 权限被隐式继承并在小程序 API 中行使的情况，即缺少“询问并检查”（ask and check）原语的情形。我们对四大超级应用的实证分析表明，有 183 个（8.85%）API 在小程序 API 层没有得到适当保护。我们讨论了该问题背后的挑战，并倡导超级应用开发者在 API 边界实施细粒度访问控制机制，从而增强移动超级应用生态系统的可信度。

import_candidates.title: Meerkat: Pushing the Practical Limits of Dynamic Bisection with PoC Mutation
import_candidates.abstract: Once a Linux kernel bug is identified, the developers perform the difficult task of patching it. Triage tools such as Syz-bisect provide a form of root cause analysis called bisection, which systematically checks historical kernel commits for the presence of the bug until it determines the Bug-Introducing Commit (BiC). Unfortunately, Syz-bisect correctly identifies the BiC for only 35% of bugs. In order to improve Syz-bisect while remaining within its time and resource constraints, we identify three areas where Syz-bisect could be improved: bug deduplication, the use of all available PoCs, and PoC mutation. Our solution Meerkat is the first dynamic bisection tool to apply scalable PoC mutation, improving over Syz-bisect by 64%. Through an in-depth manual analysis of Meerkat's bisection results, we find that dynamic bisection is critically limited by bug detectors changing with kernel versions, changes near the buggy code, and unrelated bugs that block dynamic analysis. Based on the nature of these issues, we argue that Meerkat is approaching the practical limits of what is possible with dynamic bisection in the real world. Furthermore, we correct the ground truth for 13 bugs, thus improving the dataset for future research.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 一旦Linux内核漏洞被识别，开发者就要执行修补它的艰巨任务。诸如Syz-bisect之类的分类工具提供了一种称为二分定位的根本原因分析，它系统地检查历史内核提交中是否存在该漏洞，直到确定引入漏洞的提交（BiC）。不幸的是，Syz-bisect仅能正确识别35%漏洞的BiC。为了在保持其时间和资源约束的前提下改进Syz-bisect，我们识别出Syz-bisect可以改进的三个领域：漏洞去重、使用所有可用的PoC以及PoC变异。我们的解决方案Meerkat是首个应用可扩展PoC变异的动态二分定位工具，相比Syz-bisect提升了64%。通过对Meerkat的二分定位结果进行深入人工分析，我们发现动态二分定位受到随内核版本变化的漏洞检测器、有缺陷代码附近的更改以及阻塞动态分析的不相关漏洞的严重限制。基于这些问题的性质，我们认为Meerkat正逼近现实世界中动态二分定位所能达到的实用极限。此外，我们修正了13个漏洞的真值，从而为未来研究改进了数据集。

import_candidates.title: BenchChecker: Assessing the Credibility of Bug-Fixing Benchmarks for LLMs
import_candidates.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise for Automatic Program Repair (APR), existing benchmarks suffer from data contamination, in which test samples appear in training sets, artificially inflating performance. To address this, we propose BenchChecker, a framework compatible with both open-source and closed-source models that supports more credible evaluation by detecting such contamination. Grounded in the observation that persistent patches likely remain in recent repository snapshots used for training, BenchChecker employs a forensics-based two-stage detection process using only textual model outputs together with public repository history. The first stage conducts a repository presence test by probing the model with code prefixes to infer training inclusion; the second stage performs a patch presence test to verify patch persistence via similarity alignment and test-suite verification. Evaluations using StarCoder-15B, StarCoder2-15B, and CodeGen2-16B trained on The Stack v2 demonstrate that BenchChecker achieves robust detection with AUC scores around 0.9 across six benchmarks. Furthermore, applying BenchChecker to SWE-bench Verified and Multi-SWE-bench reveals that filtering contaminated samples reduces the reported resolution rates of most LLMs by more than 20% relative to the original rates on medium-difficulty tasks.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）在自动程序修复（APR）方面显示出前景，但现有基准存在数据污染问题，即测试样本出现在训练集中，人为地夸大了性能。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了BenchChecker，一个兼容开源和闭源模型的框架，通过检测此类污染来支持更可信的评估。基于持久性补丁可能保留在用于训练的近期仓库快照中的观察，BenchChecker采用基于取证的两阶段检测过程，仅使用文本模型输出和公共仓库历史。第一阶段通过用代码前缀探测模型来进行仓库存在性测试，以推断训练包含情况；第二阶段进行补丁存在性测试，通过相似性对齐和测试套件验证来验证补丁的持久性。使用在The Stack v2上训练的StarCoder-15B、StarCoder2-15B和CodeGen2-16B进行评估，结果表明BenchChecker在六个基准上实现了稳健的检测，AUC分数约为0.9。此外，将BenchChecker应用于SWE-bench Verified和Multi-SWE-bench，发现过滤受污染样本后，大多数LLM报告的中等难度任务解决率相对于原始率下降了20%以上。

import_candidates.title: Firmenstein: Scaling Dynamic Analysis for Linux-Based Firmware Services via API-Centric Intervention Code Synthesis
import_candidates.abstract:
The rapid proliferation of Linux-based IoT devices necessitates rigorous security analysis. To achieve scalable, hardware-free analysis, firmware rehosting has become essential for constructing faithful emulated environments. However, existing approaches rely on inflexible heuristics to perform semantic-agnostic interventions, failing to generalize to diverse targets and leaving many firmware samples unanalyzable.
In this paper, we propose FIRMENSTEIN, a novel API-centric framework that unifies the complex and cumbersome rehosting process into a systematic program analysis and synthesis task. Specifically, we introduce an agentic cross-program analysis built upon the API Dependency Graph to automatically diagnose rehosting roadblocks. Guided by these diagnostics, FIRMENSTEIN further introduces a roadblock-driven workflow to synthesize high-fidelity intervention code that resolves environmental dependencies, thereby enabling successful firmware execution. Evaluation on an LFwC-based dataset demonstrates that FIRMENSTEIN enables 2.5×, 3.1×, and 2.1× more firmware samples to reach interact states than the state-of-the-art rehosting tools Greenhouse, FirmAE, and Penguin, respectively. Even with incomplete rehosting, FIRMENSTEIN executes 29% more basic blocks than Greenhouse. Furthermore, FIRMENSTEIN executes 5.2% more basic blocks than Greenhouse in interactive testing, validates 29 out of 31 known N-day vulnerabilities, and facilitates the discovery of 43 previously unknown vulnerabilities, with 19 CVE IDs assigned to date.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 基于Linux的IoT设备的快速普及需要进行严格的安全分析。为了实现可扩展、无需硬件的分析，固件重宿主已成为构建高保真仿真环境的关键。然而，现有方法依赖不灵活的启发式规则来执行语义无关的干预，无法泛化到多样化的目标，并导致许多固件样本无法被分析。在本文中，我们提出FIRMENSTEIN，一种新颖的以API为中心的框架，将复杂繁琐的重宿主过程统一为系统化的程序分析与合成任务。具体而言，我们引入基于API依赖图的代理式跨程序分析，以自动诊断重宿主障碍。在这些诊断的指导下，FIRMENSTEIN进一步引入障碍驱动的工作流，合成高保真干预代码以解决环境依赖，从而实现成功的固件执行。在基于LFwC的数据集上的评估表明，与最先进的重宿主工具Greenhouse、FirmAE和Penguin相比，FIRMENSTEIN分别使多2.5倍、3.1倍和2.1倍的固件样本达到交互状态。即使重宿主不完整，FIRMENSTEIN执行的基本块比Greenhouse多29%。此外，在交互测试中，FIRMENSTEIN执行的基本块比Greenhouse多5.2%，验证了31个已知N-day漏洞中的29个，并促进了43个先前未知漏洞的发现，其中19个已分配CVE ID。

import_candidates.title: CULPA: Universal Detection of Memory-Safety Bugs in Unsafe Rust Through the Lens of Safety Requirements
import_candidates.abstract: Rust has emerged as a leading system programming language by providing strong compile-time guarantees for memory safety. However, these guarantees do not extend to unsafe Rust, where developers may bypass compiler checks and inadvertently introduce memory-safety vulnerabilities. Although prior static analyzers have made progress in detecting such bugs, existing approaches are often fragmented: they target specific coding patterns or bug classes without modeling the underlying causes of unsafety. In this paper, we present CULPA, a universal detector for memory-safety bugs in Rust programs. The key insight of CULPA is to detect the root cause of such bugs: the violation of safety requirements in unsafe Rust contexts. To do so, CULPA first transforms the safety requirements in the standard library documentation into machine-executable predicates. Then it constructs the distinct memory segments to comply with safety requirements. Finally, CULPA collects all safety-relevant safeguards to construct the Requirement Graph. Based on the requirement graph traversal, we can determine whether violations inside unsafe blocks can be triggered. CULPA covers existing bug classes addressed by four prior static analyzers and identifies additional memory-safety vulnerabilities beyond their scope. We evaluate CULPA on the top 1,000 Rust packages. CULPA uncovers 55 previously unknown (zero-day) memory-safety bugs, 29 of which have been confirmed by developers. Most of these vulnerabilities are missed by four state-of-the-art Rust static analyzers and one LLM-based tool. To date, we have received five RustSec IDs and one CVE ID.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Rust 已成为领先的系统编程语言，因为它为内存安全提供了强编译期保证。然而，这些保证并不适用于 unsafe Rust，开发者可能绕过编译器检查并无意中引入内存安全漏洞。尽管先前的静态分析器在检测此类缺陷方面取得了进展，但现有方法往往是碎片化的：它们针对特定编码模式或缺陷类别，而没有对不安全性的根本原因建模。在本文中，我们提出了 CULPA，一种用于 Rust 程序中内存安全缺陷的通用检测器。CULPA 的关键见解是检测此类缺陷的根本原因：在不安全 Rust 上下文中违反安全要求。为此，CULPA 首先将标准库文档中的安全要求转换为机器可执行的谓词。然后，它构造不同的内存段以符合安全要求。最后，CULPA 收集所有与安全相关的保障措施以构建需求图。基于需求图遍历，我们可以确定不安全块内的违规是否可以被触发。CULPA 覆盖了四个先前静态分析器所处理的现有缺陷类别，并识别出其范围之外的额外内存安全漏洞。我们在排名前 1000 的 Rust 包上评估了 CULPA。CULPA 发现了 55 个先前未知（零日）的内存安全缺陷，其中 29 个已得到开发者确认。大多数这些漏洞被四个最先进的 Rust 静态分析器和一个基于 LLM 的工具遗漏。迄今为止，我们已收到五个 RustSec ID 和一个 CVE ID。

import_candidates.title: InSPECtor: Improving SLEIGH Specification Veracity via Proxy
import_candidates.abstract:
Processor specifications underpin critical security and program-analysis tools such as disassemblers, decompilers, and emulators, yet, their correctness is rarely examined. Errors in specifications distort program behaviour, obscure vulnerabilities, and enable analysis-evasion techniques. Validating processor specifications is a non-trivial task. Our study is a significant undertaking to enable, for the first time, the systematic validation of open-source SLEIGH language specifications, predominantly used by Ghidra. We design and implement a testing framework based on an automated oracle validation strategy by proxy. Our approach leverages the structure encoded in a specification itself to enumerate decodable instruction forms and generate targeted initial states. Then differentially test the successful decoding and emulation of those instructions by comparing emulators exercising the processor specification against hardware references.
Applying InSPECtor across diverse, open-source specifications—x86-64, AArch64, ARM/Thumb, RISC-V, MSP430—embedding differences in specification styles, author preferences, and instruction set architecture designs, we uncovered over 38,900 discrepancies that led to 125 unique bugs with proposed fixes, identifying decoding and semantic defects as well as cross-vendor inconsistencies. We distill our findings into 8 concrete recommendations to drive future improvements. Our work underscores the importance of specification correctness and provides a practical tool to substantially improve the fidelity of SLEIGH processor specifications, strengthening the reliability of downstream security and analysis tools.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 处理器规范是反汇编器、反编译器和模拟器等关键安全与程序分析工具的基础，然而其正确性却很少被审视。规范中的错误会扭曲程序行为、掩盖漏洞并助长分析规避技术。验证处理器规范并非易事。我们的研究是一项重大努力，首次实现了对开源SLEIGH语言规范（主要被Ghidra使用）的系统性验证。我们设计并实现了一个基于代理的自动化预言机验证策略的测试框架。我们的方法利用规范本身编码的结构来枚举可解码的指令形式并生成有针对性的初始状态。然后，通过将执行处理器规范的模拟器与硬件参考进行比较，对这些指令的成功解码和模拟进行差分测试。我们将InSPECtor应用于多种开源规范——x86-64、AArch64、ARM/Thumb、RISC-V、MSP430——这些规范在风格、作者偏好和指令集架构设计上存在差异，发现了超过38,900处差异，导致125个独特错误并提出了修复建议，识别了解码和语义缺陷以及跨供应商不一致。我们将发现提炼为8条具体建议以推动未来改进。我们的工作强调了规范正确性的重要性，并提供了一个实用工具，可大幅提高SLEIGH处理器规范的保真度，从而增强下游安全与分析工具的可靠性。

import_candidates.title: Wormholes in the File System: Understanding the Misunderstanding of Symlinks
import_candidates.abstract:
Symlinks, a file system feature supported at the operating system level for more than four decades, are deeply integrated across the software stack, making them an indispensable component of modern computing environments. The symlink mechanism is highly flexible, allowing references to nearly any location in the file system and enabling complex resolution behaviors. However, this flexibility also introduces significant misunderstandings for developers, which has led to widespread misuse and become a primary vector for critical security vulnerabilities in file-handling software, e.g., arbitrary file write and code execution.
In this paper, we present the first systematic study of how symlinks are incorrectly handled and the substantial security risks. Specifically, we study how programming language standard libraries improperly utilize symlink-related system calls, and how such misuse and misunderstanding propagates to downstream applications which results in various inadequate path validations. To further understand whether these inadequate path validations could be exploited in real world, we design and implement five path validation bypass schemes and three arbitrary write methods. Our evaluation across 85 projects uncovered 16 arbitrary file write vulnerabilities, two of which have been assigned high-severity CVEs. We also demonstrate their severe impacts in real-world scenarios and propose multiple mitigation strategies. We have responsibly disclosed these issues to the affected vendors.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 符号链接（Symlinks）是一种在操作系统层面支持了四十多年的文件系统特性，已深度集成于整个软件栈，成为现代计算环境不可或缺的组成部分。符号链接机制高度灵活，允许引用文件系统中几乎任何位置，并支持复杂的解析行为。然而，这种灵活性也为开发者带来了严重的误解，导致广泛误用，并成为文件处理软件中关键安全漏洞的主要载体，例如任意文件写入和代码执行。本文首次系统性地研究了符号链接被错误处理的方式及其重大安全风险。具体而言，我们研究编程语言标准库如何不正确地使用符号链接相关的系统调用，以及此类误用和误解如何传播到下游应用程序，导致各种不充分的路径验证。为了进一步了解这些不充分的路径验证是否可在真实世界中被利用，我们设计并实现了五种路径验证绕过方案和三种任意写方法。我们对85个项目的评估发现了16个任意文件写入漏洞，其中两个已被分配高严重性CVE。我们还展示了它们在真实场景中的严重影响，并提出了多种缓解策略。我们已负责任地向受影响厂商披露了这些问题。

import_candidates.title: SoK: Deep Learning-based Physical Side-channel Analysis
import_candidates.abstract: Deep learning-based side-channel analysis (DLSCA) represents a powerful paradigm for running side-channel attacks. DLSCA, in a state-of-the-art setting, can break multiple targets with a single attack trace, requiring minimal feature engineering. As such, DLSCA is an extremely active research area for both industry and academia. At the same time, due to domain activity, it becomes more difficult to understand the current trends and challenges. In this systematization of knowledge, we provide a critical overview of developments in DLSCA over the past years, enabling us to offer concrete suggestions and taxonomies. Moreover, we examine the reproducibility perspective and show that achieving it in full is difficult and requires a careful experimental setup.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 基于深度学习的侧信道分析（DLSCA）是一种执行侧信道攻击的强大范式。在最先进的设置中，DLSCA 可以用单条攻击轨迹破解多个目标，且需要最少的特征工程。因此，DLSCA 是工业界和学术界都极为活跃的研究领域。与此同时，由于领域的活跃，理解当前趋势和挑战变得更加困难。在本系统化知识综述中，我们对过去几年 DLSCA 的发展进行了批判性概述，从而能够提供具体建议和分类体系。此外，我们考察了可复现性视角，并表明完全实现可复现性很困难，需要仔细的实验设置。

import_candidates.title: Charting the Cache Side-Channel Frontier: A Systematic Study of Eviction Set Construction on Apple Silicon
import_candidates.abstract: Eviction sets constitute the fundamental primitive for conflict-based cache side-channel attacks, enabling unprivileged adversaries to induce contention deterministically. However, the security landscape of Apple Silicon remains largely underexplored due to the challenges of constructing these sets. We conduct a systematic reverse engineering study on the Apple M4 to uncover the root causes of these limitations, key microarchitectural impediments: an SLC victim buffer that obscures latency-based verification, a DRAM-to-Cache Prefetcher (DCP) that violates strict LRU replacement, and an opaque SLC allocation policy modulated by L2 Insertion/Promotion Vectors (IPV). Guided by these insights, we optimize construction strategies to overcome these impediments. Our enhanced Prime-Prune-Probe (PPP) achieves 88.2% success rate for L2 eviction sets. Furthermore, we employ a hierarchical filtering strategy to construct the first practical fine-grained SLC eviction sets on Apple Silicon. Our SLC optimal approach achieves a 90% success rate, unlocking fine-grained cross-cluster attack primitives previously deemed infeasible.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 驱逐集是基于冲突的缓存侧信道攻击的基本原语，使非特权对手能够确定性地制造竞争。然而，由于构建这些集合的挑战，Apple Silicon 的安全图景在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索。我们对 Apple M4 进行了系统性逆向工程研究，以揭示这些限制的根本原因和关键微架构障碍：一个模糊基于延迟验证的 SLC victim buffer、一个违反严格 LRU 替换的 DRAM 到缓存预取器（DCP），以及一个由 L2 插入/提升向量（IPV）调制的、不透明的 SLC 分配策略。在这些洞见的指导下，我们优化了构建策略以克服这些障碍。我们增强的 Prime-Prune-Probe（PPP）在 L2 驱逐集上达到 88.2% 的成功率。此外，我们采用分层过滤策略，在 Apple Silicon 上构建了首个实用的细粒度 SLC 驱逐集。我们的 SLC 最优方法达到 90% 的成功率，解锁了此前被认为不可行的细粒度跨集群攻击原语。

import_candidates.title: microSCALE: Static Analysis for Microarchitectural Side-channel Leakage Evaluation
import_candidates.abstract:
Developing cryptographic implementations that are resistant to side-channel attacks is challenging in modern CPUs. Data-dependent switching activity induces subtle transitions deep in the microarchitecture that can cause sensitive information to leak through the CPU's power consumption. Existing leakage detection tools largely rely on simulation-based testing, which is not only time-consuming but is also limited to the explored execution scenarios.
We present microSCALE, a fully automated framework for detecting power side-channel leakages that occur due to transitions in the CPU's microarchitecture. By statically analyzing the CPU's RTL, microSCALE enables systematic exploration of microarchitectural leakage sources within seconds. It precisely localizes the origin of leakage in the hardware and traces it back to the corresponding software instructions. We evaluate microSCALE on several protected crypto-implementations, including GIFT, ASCON, PRESENT, and AES, running on an open-source RISC-V processor, and identify several leakage sources. For instance, we identify that a protected implementation of the GIFT cipher has about 80% of its instructions that leak on the Rocket Core. We show how microSCALE can help in hardening this implementation, reducing the side-channel leakage around 90.3%.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在现代CPU中，开发能够抵御侧信道攻击的密码实现具有挑战性。数据相关的开关活动会在微架构深处引发微妙的转换，从而导致敏感信息通过CPU的功耗泄漏。现有的泄漏检测工具主要依赖于基于仿真的测试，这不仅耗时，而且仅限于所探索的执行场景。我们提出了microSCALE，一个全自动框架，用于检测由于CPU微架构中的转换而产生的功耗侧信道泄漏。通过静态分析CPU的RTL，microSCALE能够在几秒钟内系统地探索微架构泄漏源。它精确定位硬件中泄漏的起源，并将其追溯到相应的软件指令。我们在开源RISC-V处理器上对多个受保护的密码实现（包括GIFT、ASCON、PRESENT和AES）评估了microSCALE，并识别出多个泄漏源。例如，我们发现受保护的GIFT密码实现在Rocket Core上有大约80%的指令会泄漏。我们展示了microSCALE如何帮助加固该实现，将侧信道泄漏减少约90.3%。

import_candidates.title: Spectre on RISC-V Silicon: Attacks and Defenses on Commercial Out-of-Order Processors
import_candidates.abstract:
Speculative execution attacks have been extensively studied on mainstream x86 and ARM architectures. However, on RISC-V, research has mostly concentrated on open-source academic designs. Commercially available RISC-V silicon is widely perceived as too simple to be vulnerable, and as a result, no end-to-end attacks have been demonstrated on real hardware to date and essential software such as the Linux kernel remains unmitigated.
In this paper, we challenge that assumption. We systematically assess all commercially available out-of-order RISC-V processors (SiFive P550 and T-Head Xuantie C910/C920), finding them vulnerable to a range of Spectre attacks, and demonstrate the first Spectre attack leaking arbitrary kernel memory on real RISC-V hardware. Concerningly, our analysis reveals that mitigations in compilers, operating systems, and applications remain largely absent, and that the RISC-V instruction set lacks a dedicated speculation barrier. As a stopgap solution, we empirically characterize which instructions can halt speculation on commercial processors. We additionally audit the Linux kernel for Spectre gadgets and contribute patches, several of which have been accepted upstream. Finally, we evaluate and benchmark software-based Spectre mitigations and derive recommendations for the evolving RISC-V ecosystem, laying the groundwork for securing real hardware as it enters security-critical deployments.
import_candidates.abstract_zh:
推测执行攻击已在主流 x86 和 ARM 架构上得到广泛研究。然而，在 RISC-V 上，研究大多集中于开源的学术设计。商用 RISC-V 芯片被普遍认为过于简单而不易受攻击，因此，迄今为止尚未在真实硬件上演示端到端攻击，且诸如 Linux 内核等关键软件仍未得到缓解。
在本文中，我们挑战这一假设。我们系统性地评估了所有商用乱序 RISC-V 处理器（SiFive P550 和 T-Head 玄铁 C910/C920），发现它们易受一系列 Spectre 攻击影响，并首次在真实 RISC-V 硬件上演示了泄露任意内核内存的 Spectre 攻击。令人担忧的是，我们的分析表明，编译器、操作系统和应用中的缓解措施仍然基本缺失，且 RISC-V 指令集缺乏专用的推测屏障。作为临时解决方案，我们通过实证刻画了哪些指令可以在商用处理器上停止推测。我们还审计了 Linux 内核中的 Spectre 小工具（gadgets）并贡献了补丁，其中若干补丁已被上游接受。最后，我们评估并基准测试了基于软件的 Spectre 缓解措施，并为不断发展的 RISC-V 生态系统提出了建议，为在真实硬件进入安全关键部署时保障其安全奠定了基础。

import_candidates.title: Exploiting Hidden Resource Contention in Selective Speculation Defenses
import_candidates.abstract:
Transient execution attacks continue to evolve beyond cache-centric channels, motivating selective speculation defenses that aim to provide comprehensive protection with low overhead by delaying only transmit instructions. In this work, we show that several state-of-the-art selective-speculation defenses rest on shared assumptions that overlook important microarchitectural behaviors, leaving systematic blind spots that admit secret-dependent reservation-station (RS) contention. 
Our analysis identifies three limitations in optimized selective-speculation designs. First, existing transmit taxonomies emphasize post-issue execution effects and miss dispatch-phase channels, such as operand-dependent μop expansion in instructions (e.g., REP-prefixed string operations) that create operand-dependent RS occupancy before execution. Second, the delay-until-resolution strategy focuses on redirect-based control leakage, but predicated instructions (e.g., x86 CMOV and RISC-V Zicond) enable secret-dependent selection without branch resolution, allowing secrets to steer operand-dependent μop expansion (e.g., REP iteration counts). Finally, the older-μop-first allocation strategy assumes unsafe contention is prevented by prioritizing non-transient μops, yet undelayed arithmetic and cache-hit memory μops can still lead to secret-dependent RS pressure through latency-amplifying dependency chains.
Guided by these findings, we construct Spectre-v1-style gadgets that bypass STT/DOLMA on x86 and RISC-V gem5 models. We further validate RS-contention effects on real CPUs, including a REP MOVSB- and REP STOSB-based proof-of-concept and a real-world RS-contention pattern identified by our LLVM pass, demonstrating realistic gadget structure and measurable signal. Finally, we propose strengthened STT mechanisms that close both existing and newly exposed gaps at moderate performance overhead.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 瞬态执行攻击不断演进，已超越以缓存为中心的通道，这促使选择性推测防御旨在仅延迟发送指令，以低开销提供全面保护。在本工作中，我们表明若干最先进的选择性推测防御建立在共同假设之上，这些假设忽略了重要的微架构行为，留下了系统性盲点，允许依赖于秘密的保留站（RS）争用。我们的分析指出了优化选择性推测设计中的三个局限。首先，现有发送分类法强调发射后执行效应，遗漏了分派阶段通道，例如指令中依赖于操作数的微操作扩展（如REP前缀字符串操作），在执行前造成依赖于操作数的RS占用。其次，延迟至解决策略关注基于重定向的控制泄漏，但谓词指令（如x86 CMOV和RISC-V Zicond）无需分支解决即可实现依赖于秘密的选择，使秘密能够操控依赖于操作数的微操作扩展（如REP迭代次数）。最后，较旧微操作优先分配策略假设通过优先处理非瞬态微操作来防止不安全争用，然而未延迟的算术和缓存命中内存微操作仍可通过延迟放大依赖链导致依赖于秘密的RS压力。在这些发现的指导下，我们构造了Spectre-v1风格的小工具，在x86和RISC-V gem5模型上绕过STT/DOLMA。我们进一步在真实CPU上验证了RS争用效应，包括基于REP MOVSB和REP STOSB的概念验证，以及由我们的LLVM遍识别出的真实世界RS争用模式，展示了现实的小工具结构和可测量信号。最后，我们提出了增强的STT机制，以中等性能开销关闭现有和新暴露的漏洞。

import_candidates.title: “Maybe there’s only one passkey?”: Challenges Investigating and Remediating Adversarial Passkeys
import_candidates.abstract:
Passkeys are being actively rolled out by hundreds of web services who market them as a promising passwordless authentication method. However, it remains unclear whether people understand how to manage passkeys as part of their broader account security management, particularly in the aftermath of account compromise. We conducted a qualitative lab-based study that explores how people investigate and remediate suspicious activity when passkeys are used as a vector for illicit account access on three popular, passkey-supporting services: Google, PayPal, and LinkedIn. We recruited 31 participants with diverse technical backgrounds and tasked them with: (1) investigating a potential incident of compromise involving passkeys and (2) taking steps needed to re-secure the account.
Participants struggled to manage passkeys within account security settings and on devices, even when supported by service-provided email notifications, account security interfaces (ASIs), and streamlined wizards. The design and content of notifications and ASIs were often confusing or unclear, while the service-provided wizards were incomplete or misleading. This resulted in participants missing key steps required to discover adversarial passkeys and fully secure the account to prevent continued adversarial access. We discuss design implications and opportunities for future work to improve passkey management tools in ways that better support people experiencing account compromise.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 通行密钥正被数百家网络服务积极推广，它们将其宣传为一种有前景的无密码认证方法。然而，人们是否理解如何将通行密钥作为更广泛账户安全管理的一部分进行管理，尤其是在账户被入侵之后，仍不清楚。我们进行了一项基于实验室的定性研究，探讨当通行密钥在三个支持通行密钥的热门服务（Google、PayPal 和 LinkedIn）上被用作非法账户访问的途径时，人们如何调查和修复可疑活动。我们招募了 31 名具有不同技术背景的参与者，并让他们完成以下任务：(1) 调查一起涉及通行密钥的潜在入侵事件；(2) 采取必要步骤重新保护账户安全。即使在服务提供的电子邮件通知、账户安全界面（ASI）和精简向导的支持下，参与者仍在账户安全设置和设备上难以管理通行密钥。通知和 ASI 的设计与内容常常令人困惑或不清楚，而服务提供的向导则不完整或具有误导性。这导致参与者遗漏了发现对抗性通行密钥并完全保护账户以防止攻击者继续访问所需的关键步骤。我们讨论了设计启示以及未来工作的机会，以改进通行密钥管理工具，从而更好地支持经历账户入侵的人们。

import_candidates.title: X-rated Compliance Theater: An Empirical Evaluation of European Age Verification Systems in Adult Websites
import_candidates.abstract: Age verification is rapidly emerging as a central regulatory instrument for protecting minors online, with several jurisdictions mandating its deployment for access to adult and pornographic content. This regulatory direction raises significant privacy concerns, as it risks binding sensitive content access to identity-related attributes. It also introduces security risks, since age-verification mechanisms are often outsourced to third-party providers with limited transparency into the robustness of their verification processes. In this work, we conduct, to the best of our knowledge, the first exploratory security assessment of regulation-mandated age-verification mechanisms deployed by adult websites. Rather than treating age verification as a purely regulatory question, we empirically examine whether current deployments provide security guarantees commensurate with the privacy risks of relying on sensitive identity-related data. Our methodology combines ecosystem mapping, adversary modeling, and empirical testing across four countries, covering document-based verification, biometric age estimation, indirect signals, and website-workflow integration. Our results reveal systemic weaknesses across mechanisms and integrations under realistic threat assumptions, including failures against low-cost, widely accessible attacks. Finally, we derive concrete guidelines and design directions for mitigating the security and privacy risks exposed by current age-verification deployments.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 年龄验证正迅速成为保护未成年人上网的核心监管工具，多个司法管辖区已强制要求部署年龄验证以访问成人及色情内容。这一监管方向引发了重大隐私担忧，因为它可能将敏感内容访问与身份相关属性绑定。它还引入了安全风险，因为年龄验证机制通常外包给第三方提供商，而对其验证流程的稳健性透明度有限。在这项工作中，据我们所知，我们首次对成人网站部署的、监管强制要求的年龄验证机制进行了探索性安全评估。我们不将年龄验证视为纯粹的监管问题，而是实证检验当前部署是否提供了与依赖敏感身份相关数据所带来的隐私风险相称的安全保障。我们的方法结合了生态系统映射、对手建模以及在四个国家开展的实证测试，涵盖基于文件的验证、生物特征年龄估计、间接信号以及网站工作流集成。我们的结果揭示了在现实威胁假设下，各种机制和集成方式存在系统性弱点，包括无法抵御低成本、广泛可用的攻击。最后，我们得出了具体指南和设计方向，以缓解当前年龄验证部署所暴露的安全与隐私风险。

import_candidates.title: Designing Wallet-Based User Intervention for Approval Phishing Mitigation
import_candidates.abstract: Approval phishing is a form of Web3 phishing that exploits token approval mechanisms to trick users into granting attackers spending authority over their tokens. As attackers increasingly hijack legitimate websites, URL-based detection alone becomes insufficient, leaving crypto wallets as the last line of defense. Based on the characteristics of approval mechanisms, we propose four wallet-based interventions for mitigating approval phishing: Spending Cap Suggestion, Active Spender Warning, Passive Spender Warning, and Delayed Confirmation. We evaluate the interventions through a between-subjects experiment (n = 364) and semi-structured interviews (n = 23). Compared with the control group, the Spending Cap Suggestion condition significantly increases the likelihood that users set spending caps. The Active Spender Warning, Passive Spender Warning, and Delayed Confirmation conditions all increase cancellation rates of phishing tasks, although the increases are statistically significant only for Active Spender Warning and Delayed Confirmation conditions. The effectiveness of the interventions varies across users, as users may struggle to interpret suspicious cues and focus on transaction outcomes while overlooking approval details. Our findings highlight the need to strengthen defenses against such attacks by increasing users' awareness of post-approval consequences and supporting approval-parameter verification at the moment of authorization.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 授权钓鱼是Web3网络钓鱼的一种形式，其利用代币授权机制诱骗用户授予攻击者对其代币的支出权限。随着攻击者越来越多地劫持合法网站，仅基于URL的检测变得不足，使得加密钱包成为最后一道防线。基于授权机制的特点，我们提出了四种基于钱包的干预措施来缓解授权钓鱼：支出上限建议、主动支出者警告、被动支出者警告和延迟确认。我们通过被试间实验（n = 364）和半结构化访谈（n = 23）评估了这些干预措施。与对照组相比，支出上限建议条件显著提高了用户设置支出上限的可能性。主动支出者警告、被动支出者警告和延迟确认条件都提高了钓鱼任务的取消率，尽管只有主动支出者警告和延迟确认条件的提高具有统计显著性。干预措施的有效性因用户而异，因为用户可能难以解读可疑线索，并关注交易结果而忽视授权细节。我们的发现强调，需要通过提高用户对授权后后果的认识，并在授权时刻支持授权参数验证，来加强对此类攻击的防御。

import_candidates.title: What You Decode Depends on Where You Stand: Distance-Based Optical QR Code
import_candidates.abstract: Quick Response (QR) codes are ubiquitous; we can see them in authentication, payments, advertising, and other information-sharing use cases. QR code’s security relies on the assumption that every scanner decodes identical information from the same code. This work introduces Optical Quick Response (OQR) codes, a novel multi-layer QR code design that challenges this assumption. OQR uses specially designed optical patterns to encode distinctive information across distance-dependent layers within a single code, while upholding full backward compatibility with standard QR decoders. This paper presents 2-layer (OQR2) and 3-layer (OQR3) OQR configurations that achieve up to 300% higher data capacity. Exploiting this multi-layer capability, a filter evasion vulnerability is identified in which automated QR validators decode only the innermost layer of pixel-perfect images, enabling attackers to conceal malicious content in the outer layers and remain undetected. To counter this threat, a blurring-based defense is developed that recovers all layer content, enabling detection and flagging of malicious OQR codes before they reach end users. A custom dataset of 600 OQR codes was generated for evaluation. Results across six smartphones, for both printed and digital formats, demonstrate a reliable multi-layer Code Decodability Rate (CDR) of 100% for OQR2 and over 98% for OQR3. The filter evasion attack success rate against two popular QR decoding libraries reaches 100% for OQR2 and 98.67% for OQR3.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 快速响应（QR）码无处不在；我们可以在身份验证、支付、广告和其他信息共享用例中看到它们。QR码的安全性依赖于这样一个假设：每个扫描器从同一码中解码出相同的信息。这项工作引入了光学快速响应（OQR）码，一种新颖的多层QR码设计，挑战了这一假设。OQR使用专门设计的光学图案，在单个码内跨距离依赖层编码不同的信息，同时保持与标准QR解码器的完全向后兼容。本文提出了2层（OQR2）和3层（OQR3）OQR配置，数据容量最高提高300%。利用这种多层能力，发现了一种过滤器规避漏洞，其中自动QR验证器仅解码像素完美图像的最内层，使攻击者能够将恶意内容隐藏在外部层中而不被发现。为了应对这一威胁，开发了一种基于模糊的防御方法，可恢复所有层的内容，从而在恶意OQR码到达最终用户之前对其进行检测和标记。生成了包含600个OQR码的自定义数据集用于评估。在六款智能手机上，针对打印和数字格式的结果表明，OQR2的多层码可解码率（CDR）可靠地达到100%，OQR3超过98%。针对两个流行的QR解码库，过滤器规避攻击成功率对于OQR2达到100%，对于OQR3达到98.67%。

import_candidates.title: What Adults Will (and Won't) Do to Prove Their Age: Empirical Evidence from a Deceptive Web Experiment
import_candidates.abstract: As age verification laws proliferate across the United States and internationally, limited empirical evidence exists on how adults actually respond to these systems in practice. We conducted an IRB-approved, deceptive web experiment (n = 1,635) to examine how different age verification methods affect adults' decisions to access age-restricted content. Participants, recruited to evaluate R-rated movie clips, were randomly assigned to one of seven verification conditions: checkbox self-attestation, government-issued ID upload (with varying privacy reassurances), government-issued ID with liveness check, AI facial age estimation, or email age estimation. Completion rates varied substantially by method. Checkbox self-attestation achieved 99% completion, government-ID methods 18–27% regardless of reassurances, email 86%, and AI 51%. Follow-up surveys (n = 881) revealed low comfort even among participants who completed verification. Participants perceived government-ID and AI methods as significantly riskier, rated no method as particularly effective at preventing minors' access, and found government-ID methods significantly less convenient. Higher comfort and lower perceived risk were associated with higher completion. These findings have important implications for balancing child protection with adults' access rights. We offer recommendations for policymakers and platform operators implementing age verification systems.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 随着年龄验证法律在美国及国际上激增，关于成年人实际如何应对这些系统的实证证据仍然有限。我们进行了一项经IRB批准的欺骗性网络实验（n = 1,635），以考察不同年龄验证方法如何影响成年人访问年龄限制内容的决定。参与者被招募来评估R级电影片段，被随机分配到七种验证条件之一：复选框自我声明、政府签发身份证件上传（隐私保证程度不同）、带活体检测的政府签发身份证件、AI面部年龄估计或电子邮件年龄估计。完成率因方法而异显著。复选框自我声明达到99%完成率，政府身份证件方法无论是否有隐私保证均为18–27%，电子邮件为86%，AI为51%。后续调查（n = 881）显示，即使在完成验证的参与者中，舒适度也很低。参与者认为政府身份证件和AI方法风险显著更高，认为没有一种方法能特别有效地防止未成年人访问，并发现政府身份证件方法显著更不方便。更高的舒适度和更低的感知风险与更高的完成率相关。这些发现对平衡儿童保护与成年人访问权具有重要启示。我们为实施年龄验证系统的政策制定者和平台运营者提供建议。

import_candidates.title: STALEUS: Breaking AMD SEV-SNP via Memory Incoherence
import_candidates.abstract: AMD SEV-SNP provides confidential computing capabilities on AMD platforms. To secure confidential virtual machines, AMD relies on a trusted co-processor known as the Platform Security Processor (PSP). The PSP executes on an Arm core, which is connected to the x86 interconnect via dedicated hardware bridges. We show that a malicious hypervisor can configure one of these bridges to render the PSP cache-incoherent with respect to the x86 caches. We present a novel attack called STALEUS that demonstrates how to leverage this vulnerability to break SEV-SNP. We show the impact of STALEUS by achieving arbitrary read and write primitives within a fully attested CVM
import_candidates.abstract_zh: AMD SEV-SNP在AMD平台上提供机密计算能力。为了保护机密虚拟机，AMD依赖一个称为平台安全处理器（PSP）的可信协处理器。PSP在Arm核上执行，该核通过专用硬件桥连接到x86互连。我们表明，恶意hypervisor可以配置其中一个桥，使PSP相对于x86缓存处于缓存不一致状态。我们提出了一种名为STALEUS的新型攻击，展示了如何利用此漏洞来攻破SEV-SNP。我们通过在完全认证的CVM内实现任意读写原语来展示STALEUS的影响。

import_candidates.title: XCFI: Comprehensive Control-Flow Integrity for Arm TrustZone-M
import_candidates.abstract:
Arm TrustZone-M (TZ-M) provides hardware-based isolation for tiny embedded systems by partitioning execution into secure and non-secure states. However, despite this isolation, memory vulnerabilities in software running within either state can still be exploited to perform control-flow hijacking attacks. To mitigate these threats, numerous control-flow integrity (CFI) studies have been proposed for embedded systems, but they have several limitations: many neglect the secure state, fail to protect control-flow events during TZ-M security state transitions, or incur prohibitive performance overhead. 
In this paper, we present XCFI, a comprehensive CFI mechanism for TZ-M. XCFI employs a 32-bit control-flow identifier (CID) based protection to uniformly enforce fine-grained CFI across both secure and non-secure states, covering all control-flow events, including indirect branches, returns, and exceptions. Crucially, XCFI extends CFI enforcement to cross-state control-flow events in TZ-M, which have not been protected by prior work. Overall, XCFI provides comprehensive control-flow protection across all TZ-M execution contexts while incurring only modest runtime overhead.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: Arm TrustZone-M (TZ-M) 通过将执行划分为安全和非安全状态，为微型嵌入式系统提供基于硬件的隔离。然而，尽管有这种隔离，运行在任一状态中的软件内存漏洞仍可被利用来执行控制流劫持攻击。为缓解这些威胁，已有许多针对嵌入式系统的控制流完整性（CFI）研究被提出，但它们存在若干局限：许多研究忽视了安全状态，未能保护 TZ-M 安全状态转换期间的控制流事件，或带来过高的性能开销。在本文中，我们提出 XCFI，一种面向 TZ-M 的全面 CFI 机制。XCFI 采用基于 32 位控制流标识符（CID）的保护，在安全和非安全状态中统一实施细粒度 CFI，覆盖所有控制流事件，包括间接分支、返回和异常。关键的是，XCFI 将 CFI 实施扩展到 TZ-M 中的跨状态控制流事件，而此前工作未曾保护这些事件。总体而言，XCFI 在 TZ-M 的所有执行上下文中提供全面的控制流保护，同时仅带来适度的运行时开销。

import_candidates.title: Rarus: A Succinct and Efficient Range Proof for Polynomial-based Vector Commitment
import_candidates.abstract:
Range proofs enable a prover to convince a verifier that a committed value lies within a specific interval without revealing additional information. They are fundamental to privacy-preserving systems including anonymous credentials, e-voting, e-cash, and cryptocurrencies like Monero and Grin. A critical challenge is efficiently proving that multiple committed values simultaneously satisfy range constraints while minimizing communication overhead.
Vector commitment schemes provide a promising approach to this problem. Missileproof (CCS'24) recently proposed a range proof for vector commitments achieving O(1) proof size and verifier time, but with prover complexity of O(Nℒlog(Nℒ)) for proving ℒ values in [0,2N).
We present Rarus, an efficient range proof for polynomial-based vector commitments that achieves optimal asymptotic complexity across all metrics. Our key innovation is replacing binary decomposition with optimized b b-ary decomposition, coupled with Bi-variate Zero-Test and accelerated Uni-variate Sum-Check protocols. Rarus achieves O(1) proof size and verifier time, while reducing prover time to O (Nℒ / log (Nℒ)) G + O (Nℒ)F, where G and F denote group and field operations respectively. In addition , our protocol supports arbitrary ranges [0,R) beyond powers of two. Experimental results demonstrate that Rarus achieves a 20× speedup over both Bulletproofs and Missileproof when proving 16,384 values in [0,264 =).
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 范围证明使证明者能够在不泄露额外信息的情况下，让验证者相信某个已承诺值位于特定区间内。它们是隐私保护系统的基础，包括匿名凭证、电子投票、电子现金，以及 Monero 和 Grin 等加密货币。一个关键挑战是高效地证明多个已承诺值同时满足范围约束，同时最小化通信开销。向量承诺方案为解决该问题提供了一种有前景的方法。Missileproof (CCS'24) 最近提出了一种面向向量承诺的范围证明，实现了 O(1) 证明大小和验证者时间，但在证明 [0,2^N) 内的 ℒ 个值时，证明者复杂度为 O(Nℒ log(Nℒ))。我们提出了 Rarus，一种面向基于多项式的向量承诺的高效范围证明，在所有指标上实现了最优渐近复杂度。我们的关键创新是用优化的 b 进制分解替代二进制分解，并结合双变量零测试和加速的一元求和检查协议。Rarus 实现了 O(1) 证明大小和验证者时间，同时将证明者时间降低到 O(Nℒ / log(Nℒ)) G + O(Nℒ)F，其中 G 和 F 分别表示群运算和域运算。此外，我们的协议支持任意范围 [0,R)，而不仅限于二次幂。实验结果表明，在证明 [0,2^64) 内的 16,384 个值时，Rarus 相比 Bulletproofs 和 Missileproof 均实现了 20 倍加速。

import_candidates.title: Prezta: Provable Remote Execution of Zero-Trust Authorization using SNARKs
import_candidates.abstract:
Modernizing the security of operational technology systems that control critical infrastructure has become a pressing challenge. Because edge devices have limited capabilities, modernization has relied on application gateways that interface with identity management systems and enforce access policies. These gateways are powerful enough to perform complex authorization decisions and support zero-trust architectures but create major deployment and management burdens: they must be collocated with remote, distributed edge devices, kept up to date with security patches, and managed with minimal downtime.
We propose Provable Remote Execution of Zero-Trust Authorization (Prezta), an architecture that eliminates these gateways by evaluating policies within a zero-knowledge virtual machine (zkVM) running on the client. The zkVM produces a succinct proof of authorization that edge devices can verify efficiently, extending the zero-trust security envelope to the edge. Policies and identity management schemes can evolve without updating edge devices.
To demonstrate the feasibility of Prezta, we implement a prototype, built using the RISC Zero zkVM, that supports XACML 3.0 policies and JWT identity claims. While zkVMs introduce substantial proof overhead, we mitigate this by compiling policies to Rust code and pre-compiling regular expressions. Combined with optimized signature verification and JWT parsing, these measures reduce prover time by more than an order of magnitude. Our compiler correctly implements 83% of the XACML 3.0 conformance suite, with proof generation completing in tens of seconds on a desktop. Verification, by contrast, takes only tens of milliseconds—fast enough for even resource-constrained edge devices.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 现代化控制关键基础设施的运营技术系统的安全性已成为一项紧迫挑战。由于边缘设备能力有限，现代化一直依赖于与身份管理系统接口并执行访问策略的应用网关。这些网关足够强大，可以执行复杂的授权决策并支持零信任架构，但带来了重大的部署和管理负担：它们必须与远程、分布式边缘设备并置，保持安全补丁更新，并以最短停机时间进行管理。我们提出可证明的零信任授权远程执行（Prezta），这是一种架构，通过在客户端上运行的零知识虚拟机（zkVM）中评估策略来消除这些网关。zkVM生成一个简洁的授权证明，边缘设备可以高效验证，从而将零信任安全边界扩展到边缘。策略和身份管理方案可以演进，而无需更新边缘设备。为了证明Prezta的可行性，我们实现了一个原型，使用RISC Zero zkVM构建，支持XACML 3.0策略和JWT身份声明。虽然zkVM引入了大量的证明开销，但我们通过将策略编译为Rust代码并预编译正则表达式来缓解这一点。结合优化的签名验证和JWT解析，这些措施将证明者时间减少了一个数量级以上。我们的编译器正确实现了XACML 3.0一致性套件的83%，证明生成在台式机上在数十秒内完成。相比之下，验证仅需数十毫秒——快到足以满足资源受限的边缘设备。

import_candidates.title: Efficiently Provable Approximations for Non-Polynomial Functions
import_candidates.abstract:
Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKPs) are now widely used to verify the correctness of various types of computations. However, despite phenomenal advancements, current ZKPs are inefficient for applications that need accurate evaluation of non-polynomial functions over floating-point numbers, such as machine learning, decentralized finance, scientific computing, and geolocation. Current state-of-the-art approaches typically emulate floating-point numbers using fixed-point representations (via quantization), and handle non-polynomial functions using lookup tables, piece-wise or low-degree polynomial approximations, which lead to sub-optimal performance and/or loss in accuracy or generality, limiting their potential for adoption in practice.
In this work, we present a general framework for approximating a large class of non-polynomial functions using Gauss-Legendre quadrature, which supports efficient ZKPs of correct computation. We show that our approach can scale to decrease the error up to the inherent limits imposed by quantization, without increasing the multiplicative circuit depth beyond a small constant (≤ 4). This is a strong deviation from prior approximation techniques, where decreasing the error leads to increased multiplicative depth– the main factor determining the error growth of an approximation. We implement and evaluate our approach in Noir/Barretenberg, and we obtain absolute errors 2−256× lower than comparable baselines for most non-polynomial functions with low prover overhead. We also demonstrate an efficient prover and low errors for high-accuracy applications in DeFi and astronomy that require non-polynomial functions, again obtaining errors 4−64× lower than the baseline approximations.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 零知识证明（ZKPs）现已广泛用于验证各类计算的正确性。然而，尽管取得了显著进展，当前的ZKPs对于需要在浮点数上精确评估非多项式函数的应用（如机器学习、去中心化金融、科学计算和地理定位）而言仍然效率低下。当前最先进的方法通常通过定点表示（经由量化）来模拟浮点数，并使用查找表、分段或低阶多项式近似来处理非多项式函数，这导致性能次优和/或精度或通用性损失，限制了其在实际中的应用潜力。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个通用框架，使用高斯-勒让德求积来近似一大类非多项式函数，该框架支持对正确计算进行高效的ZKPs。我们表明，我们的方法可以扩展以将误差降低到量化所施加的固有极限，而不会将乘法电路深度增加到超过一个小常数（≤ 4）。这与先前的近似技术形成强烈反差，在先前的技术中，降低误差会导致乘法深度增加——而乘法深度是决定近似误差增长的主要因素。我们在Noir/Barretenberg中实现并评估了我们的方法，对于大多数非多项式函数，我们获得了比可比基线低2–256倍的绝对误差，且证明者开销较低。我们还展示了在需要非多项式函数的DeFi和天文学高精度应用中的高效证明者和低误差，再次获得了比基线近似低4–64倍的误差。

import_candidates.title: TensorZKP: Repurposing GPU Tensor Cores for High-Performance Zero-Knowledge Proofs
import_candidates.abstract:
GPU Tensor Cores, specialized hardware units designed to accelerate matrix multiplication, have served as the primary engine behind the AI revolution. Given the exponential performance gains they have delivered, aligning cryptographic implementations with this hardware evolution is critical. This is particularly acute for zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs), a cryptographic primitive that currently grapples with high proof generation costs. Existing GPU implementations for ZKPs rely exclusively on general-purpose SIMT cores, leaving the massive computational power of Tensor Cores untapped.
In this paper, we introduce TensorZKP, the first GPU framework to harness Tensor Cores for ZKP acceleration. Since Tensor Cores are designed for low-precision matrix multiplication, mapping ZKP's arithmetic to this hardware is non-trivial. To bridge this gap, we develop Tensor-Core-compatible finite field arithmetic and reformulate ZKP modules, specifically sum-check protocols and Spielman code, into matrix multiplication tasks. Furthermore, we design an asynchronous warp-specialized framework that pipelines memory access, Tensor Core matrix operations, and SIMT-based modular reductions. We instantiate these optimizations with HyperPlonk as the Polynomial Interactive Oracle Proof (PIOP) and Brakedown as the Polynomial Commitment Scheme (PCS) to enable end-to-end proof generation.
The evaluation results show that TensorZKP exhibits remarkable efficiency. At a 2^25 scale, the underlying building blocks complete in 0.85 ms for inner product, 0.91 ms for scalar-vector multiplication, 4.04 ms for degree-2 sum-check, and 11.58 ms for the encoder. For a circuit with 2^25 multiplication gates, TensorZKP achieves a proof generation time of only 215.28 milliseconds, representing a 955× speedup over the CPU baseline and a 36.2× improvement over state-of-the-art SIMT-based GPU implementations.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: GPU Tensor Core 是专为加速矩阵乘法设计的硬件单元，已成为人工智能革命背后的主要引擎。鉴于其带来的指数级性能提升，使密码实现与这一硬件演进保持一致至关重要。对于零知识证明（ZKP）而言，这一问题尤为突出，因为这一密码学原语目前正面临高昂的证明生成成本。现有的 ZKP GPU 实现完全依赖通用 SIMT 核心，未能利用 Tensor Core 的巨大计算能力。本文提出 TensorZKP，这是首个利用 Tensor Core 加速 ZKP 的 GPU 框架。由于 Tensor Core 专为低精度矩阵乘法设计，将 ZKP 的算术映射到该硬件并非易事。为弥合这一差距，我们开发了与 Tensor Core 兼容的有限域算术，并将 ZKP 模块（特别是 sum-check 协议和 Spielman 码）重新表述为矩阵乘法任务。此外，我们设计了一个异步 warp 专用框架，将内存访问、Tensor Core 矩阵运算和基于 SIMT 的模约简流水线化。我们以 HyperPlonk 作为多项式交互式预言证明（PIOP），以 Brakedown 作为多项式承诺方案（PCS）来实例化这些优化，以实现端到端的证明生成。评估结果表明，TensorZKP 具有显著效率。在 2^25 规模下，底层构建块完成时间分别为：内积 0.85 ms，标量-向量乘法 0.91 ms，二次 sum-check 4.04 ms，编码器 11.58 ms。对于具有 2^25 个乘法门的电路，TensorZKP 的证明生成时间仅为 215.28 毫秒，相比 CPU 基线实现了 955 倍加速，相比最先进的基于 SIMT 的 GPU 实现提升了 36.2 倍。

import_candidates.title: Icefish: Practical zk-SNARKs for Verifiable Genomics
import_candidates.abstract:
Individual genomic data is a uniquely sensitive type of user data. While many papers have considered using Multi-Party Computation (MPC) or Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) to allow collaborators to study combined genomic datasets they cannot share, few have considered verifying the results of genomic computations, either in research studies or in the emerging area of personalized genetic therapies.
In this paper, we initiate the first systematic study of zero-knowledge proofs for verifiable genomics, providing both building blocks for verifying common operations in computational genomics, such as sequence alignment, and exploring two end-to-end applications:
Verifiable Genome-Wide Association Studies: A Genome-Wide Association Study (GWAS) study operates over a repository of genomic data, identifying statistical correlations between genetic variations and observed traits or medical conditions. Our system enables third parties to verify that research was honestly computed over an authenticated, untampered database, ensuring both the integrity of the underlying data set and the correctness of the resulting science. We achieve practical performance (<40 minutes proving time) for studies of sizes equal to those in the existing genomics literature.
Verifiable CRISPR eligibility: We propose using zk-SNARKs in the context of gene engineering (e.g. CRISPR). To our knowledge, this is a new use case for zk-SNARKs. We implement and optimize models for detecting "on-target" and "off-target" sites for a CRISPR probe in zk-SNARKs, so users can, for example, demonstrate eligibility for a therapy or trial without having to reveal their own DNA sequence.
In support of these applications, we develop new building blocks, like zero-knowledge proofs of sequence alignment that are 30x faster than the prior state of the art, and storage-efficient indexes for Merkle trees for large scale genomic data that asymptotically reduce storage costs.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 个体基因组数据是一种独特敏感的用户数据。虽然许多论文考虑使用多方计算（MPC）或全同态加密（FHE）来让合作者研究他们无法共享的组合基因组数据集，但很少有人考虑验证基因组计算的结果，无论是在研究中还是在个性化基因治疗这一新兴领域。在本文中，我们首次对可验证基因组学的零知识证明进行了系统研究，既提供了用于验证计算基因组学中常见操作（如序列比对）的构建模块，也探索了两个端到端应用：可验证的全基因组关联研究：全基因组关联研究（GWAS）在基因组数据存储库上运行，识别遗传变异与观察到的性状或医学状况之间的统计相关性。我们的系统使第三方能够验证研究是在一个经过认证、未被篡改的数据库上诚实地计算的，从而确保底层数据集的完整性和所得科学的正确性。对于与现有基因组学文献中规模相当的研究，我们实现了实用性能（证明时间<40分钟）。可验证的CRISPR资格：我们提出在基因工程（如CRISPR）背景下使用zk-SNARKs。据我们所知，这是zk-SNARKs的一个新用例。我们在zk-SNARKs中实现并优化了用于检测CRISPR探针的“在靶”和“脱靶”位点的模型，因此用户可以在不透露自己DNA序列的情况下，证明自己有资格接受某种治疗或参加某项试验。为了支持这些应用，我们开发了新的构建模块，例如比先前最先进技术快30倍的序列比对零知识证明，以及用于大规模基因组数据的节省存储的Merkle树索引，这些索引渐近地降低了存储成本。

import_candidates.title: Boosting Efficiency and Security in Arithmetization-Oriented Hashing for Zero-Knowledge Proof Systems
import_candidates.abstract:
Cryptographic compression functions are a core component of vector commitment schemes, including Merkle tree commitments, which are widely used in modern ZK-SNARK and STARK frameworks. Arithmetization-Oriented (AO) compression functions minimize multiplicative complexity over the framework's native field F_p, making them significantly more efficient than bit-oriented designs in algebraic circuits. To date, AO compression functions have been almost exclusively constructed by applying the Sponge mode to an AO permutation.
In this work, we introduce two novel approaches for building permutation-based AO compression modes: the PA family, based on a Permutation with feedforward Addition, and PAX, as an eXtension of the PA family. We formally establish that, in contrast to the Sponge construction, our modes achieve optimal collision and preimage resistance. We also prove that PAX is indifferentiable from a random oracle, further strengthening its security and composability guarantees. We further show that variable-input-length hash functions can be safely instantiated from the PA(X) modes by applying appropriate domain extenders.
Beyond their strong security guarantees, our modes provide a framework that unifies and extends the description of several recently proposed modes that have been studied via cryptanalysis but do not come with provable security guarantees, including Jive and Trunc, as used in the AO designs Anemoi and Poseidon2.
Finally, through extensive experimental evaluation, we compare the concrete efficiency improvement that our modes offer compared to the Sponge approach over two popular AO permutation designs, Poseidon permutation and Rescue. For 128 bits of collision resistance, our modes can achieve up to a 2x speed-up over Sponge for equivalent compression rates in a software implementation. When considering R1CS arithmetization in the Groth16 framework, the PA(X) preimage-verification circuit can be 10% faster than Sponge. In the Plonky2 framework, PA(X) can achieve up to a 60% speed-up.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 密码学压缩函数是向量承诺方案（包括 Merkle 树承诺）的核心组成部分，这些方案广泛用于现代 ZK-SNARK 和 STARK 框架中。面向算术化（Arithmetization-Oriented, AO）的压缩函数最小化框架原生域 F_p 上的乘法复杂度，使其在代数电路中比面向比特的设计显著更高效。迄今为止，AO 压缩函数几乎都是通过将 Sponge 模式应用于 AO 置换来构造的。在这项工作中，我们引入了两种构造基于置换的 AO 压缩模式的新方法：PA 家族，基于带前馈加法的置换（Permutation with feedforward Addition），以及 PAX，作为 PA 家族的扩展（eXtension）。我们形式化地证明，与 Sponge 构造相比，我们的模式实现了最优的碰撞阻力和原像阻力。我们还证明 PAX 与随机预言机不可区分（indifferentiable），进一步增强了其安全性和可组合性保证。我们进一步表明，通过应用适当的域扩展器，可以从 PA(X) 模式安全地实例化可变输入长度哈希函数。除了强大的安全性保证之外，我们的模式提供了一个框架，统一并扩展了若干最近提出的模式的描述，这些模式已经通过密码分析进行了研究，但没有可证明的安全性保证，包括用于 AO 设计 Anemoi 和 Poseidon2 的 Jive 和 Trunc。最后，通过广泛的实验评估，我们比较了我们的模式相对于 Sponge 方法在两个流行的 AO 置换设计（Poseidon 置换和 Rescue）上提供的具体效率提升。对于 128 位碰撞阻力，在软件实现中，对于等效压缩率，我们的模式可以实现比 Sponge 高达 2 倍的加速。在考虑 Groth16 框架中的 R1CS 算术化时，PA(X) 原像验证电路可以比 Sponge 快 10%。在 Plonky2 框架中，PA(X) 可以实现高达 60% 的加速。

import_candidates.title: SoK: Colluding Adversaries in Machine Learning Pipelines
import_candidates.abstract: Machine learning (ML) models are susceptible to various security, privacy, and fairness risks. Adversaries with different characteristics (i.e., objectives, knowledge, and capabilities) can collude by executing one attack to amplify others. Existing work lacks a systematic framework to explore collusion among adversaries, and to study the implications of the adversaries' characteristics. We present a framework covering collusion (a) between train- and inference-time adversaries, and (b) among inference-time adversaries. Our framework accounts for factors enabling collusion between adversaries. We propose a guideline to conjecture about the potential for collusion using enabling factors. We use it to explain prior work, conjecture about unexplored collusions, and empirically validate five such cases. Finally, we discuss how adversaries' characteristics influence the potential for collusion.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 机器学习（ML）模型容易受到各种安全、隐私和公平性风险的影响。具有不同特征（即目标、知识和能力）的对手可以通过执行一种攻击来放大其他攻击，从而实现合谋。现有工作缺乏一个系统框架来探索对手之间的合谋，并研究对手特征的影响。我们提出了一个涵盖以下合谋的框架：(a) 训练时和推理时对手之间的合谋，以及 (b) 推理时对手之间的合谋。我们的框架考虑了促成对手之间合谋的因素。我们提出了一种利用促成因素来推测潜在合谋的指南。我们用它来解释先前工作、推测未探索的合谋，并实证验证了五个此类案例。最后，我们讨论了对手特征如何影响合谋的可能性。

import_candidates.title: Certified in Theory, Broken in Practice: Assumption Gaps in Cryptographic Model Certification
import_candidates.abstract:
Privacy-preserving machine learning auditing protocols allow auditors to assess models for properties such as accuracy or fairness, without revealing their internals or training data. This makes them especially attractive for auditing models deployed in sensitive domains such as healthcare or finance. For these protocols to be meaningful in real-world audit settings, though, their guarantees must reflect how the model will behave once deployed, rather than merely certifying its behavior during an audit. Existing security definitions often miss this mark: most certify model behavior only on a fixed audit dataset, without ensuring that the same guarantees generalize to other datasets drawn from the same distribution. We show that a model provider can attack many cryptographic model certification (CMC) schemes built on secure zero knowledge proofs (ZKP) by carefully engineering training data, resulting in models that exhibit benign behavior during an audit, but pathological behavior in practice. For example, we empirically demonstrate that an attacker can certify that a model achieves over 99% accuracy on an audit dataset, but less than 30% accuracy on fresh samples from the same distribution.
To address this gap, we formalize rigorous cryptographic security notions tailored to CMC frameworks, introduce a generic protocol template, and prove that it satisfies these requirements. Our results thus offer both cautionary evidence about existing approaches and constructive guidance for designing secure, privacy-preserving ML auditing protocols.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 隐私保护机器学习审计协议允许审计者评估模型的准确性或公平性等属性，而无需泄露其内部结构或训练数据。这使得它们对于审计部署在医疗保健或金融等敏感领域的模型尤其有吸引力。然而，要使这些协议在真实世界审计场景中有意义，其保证必须反映模型部署后的行为，而不仅仅是证明其在审计期间的行为。现有的安全定义往往未能达到这一目标：大多数只证明模型在固定审计数据集上的行为，而没有确保相同的保证能泛化到来自同一分布的其他数据集。我们表明，模型提供者可以通过精心设计训练数据来攻击许多基于安全零知识证明（ZKP）的加密模型认证（CMC）方案，从而导致模型在审计期间表现良性，但在实践中表现病态。例如，我们通过经验证明，攻击者可以认证一个模型在审计数据集上达到超过99%的准确率，但在同一分布的新样本上准确率低于30%。为弥补这一缺口，我们针对CMC框架形式化了严格的密码学安全概念，引入了一个通用协议模板，并证明其满足这些要求。因此，我们的结果既提供了关于现有方法的警示性证据，也为设计安全、隐私保护的机器学习审计协议提供了建设性指导。

import_candidates.title: MATE: Policy-Aware Security Auditing for Mobile Agents via Synthesis-Driven Trajectory Learning
import_candidates.abstract: Mobile agents powered by foundation models now automate complex, multi-step workflows on real devices, but their trajectories can violate app-specific security policies. Existing trajectory-level defenses rely on LLM prompting or rigid rules, and thus fail to support fine-grained, natural-language policies that generalize across apps and tasks. In this work, we introduce MATE, a lightweight, policy-conditioned auditor that encodes both agent trajectories and natural-language security policies to determine whether a trajectory violates a given policy and to explain why. Treating policies as editable text rather than fixed model parameters allows MATE to handle user-defined and evolving requirements without retraining. To construct MATE, we build a knowledge base by extracting app descriptions, workflows, and policies from hundreds of popular mobile apps worldwide, and synthesizing over 140K semantically realistic, policy-conditioned trajectories with a multi-stage pipeline. We further release MATEBench, a trajectory-level auditing benchmark with two synthetic subsets and one real-world subset of manually collected trajectories. Models trained with our synthesis-driven trajectory learning achieve over 95% accuracy on MATEBench, retain strong performance on external safety benchmarks, and audit trajectories from Zhipu's AutoGLM and Alibaba's Mobile-Agent on real devices with over 95% accuracy, outperforming prior methods by over 20%. MATE shows that practical, fine-grained security auditing for heterogeneous mobile agents is both feasible and effective.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 由基础模型驱动的移动代理如今可在真实设备上自动化复杂的多步工作流，但其轨迹可能违反应用特定的安全策略。现有的轨迹级防御依赖于LLM提示或刚性规则，因而无法支持可跨应用和任务泛化的细粒度、自然语言策略。在这项工作中，我们提出MATE，一种轻量级的策略条件化审计器，它对代理轨迹和自然语言安全策略进行编码，以判断轨迹是否违反给定策略并解释原因。将策略视为可编辑文本而非固定模型参数，使MATE无需重新训练即可处理用户定义且不断演变的需求。为构建MATE，我们通过从全球数百个流行移动应用中提取应用描述、工作流和策略，并利用多阶段流水线合成了超过14万条语义真实、策略条件化的轨迹，从而构建了一个知识库。我们进一步发布MATEBench，一个轨迹级审计基准，包含两个合成子集和一个由人工收集轨迹组成的真实世界子集。使用我们合成驱动的轨迹学习训练的模型在MATEBench上达到超过95%的准确率，在外部安全基准上保持强劲性能，并在真实设备上以超过95%的准确率审计来自智谱AutoGLM和阿里巴巴Mobile-Agent的轨迹，比先前方法高出20%以上。MATE表明，面向异构移动代理的实用、细粒度安全审计既可行又有效。

import_candidates.title: Trusting What You Cannot See: Auditable Fine-Tuning and Inference for Proprietary AI
import_candidates.abstract:
Cloud-based infrastructure has become the dominant platform for deploying large models, particularly large language models (LLMs). Fine-tuning and inference are increasingly delegated to cloud providers for simplified deployment and access to proprietary models, yet this creates a fundamental trust gap. Although cryptographic and TEE-based verification approaches exist, prohibitive proving costs and limited TEE memory prevent them from scaling to modern LLMs, leaving clients unable to practically audit these processes. This lack of transparency creates concrete security risks that can silently compromise service integrity. 
We present AFTUNE, an auditable and verifiable framework that ensures the computational integrity of cloud-based fine-tuning and inference. AFTUNE incorporates a lightweight recording and spot-check mechanism that produces verifiable traces of execution. These traces enable clients to later audit whether the fine-tuning and inference processes followed the agreed configurations, by verifying sampled execution blocks inside a TEE, each covering only a small portion of the model and the execution trace. Our evaluation shows that AFTUNE adds modest overhead and makes auditing practical for clients.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 基于云的基础设施已成为部署大型模型（尤其是大型语言模型，LLM）的主导平台。微调与推理越来越多地被委托给云服务提供商，以简化部署并获取专有模型，但这造成了根本性的信任鸿沟。尽管存在基于密码学和TEE的验证方法，但高昂的证明成本和有限的TEE内存使其无法扩展到现代LLM，导致客户端实际上无法审计这些过程。这种缺乏透明度的情况带来了具体的安全风险，可能悄无声息地破坏服务完整性。我们提出AFTUNE，一个可审计且可验证的框架，确保基于云的微调与推理的计算完整性。AFTUNE结合了轻量级记录与抽查机制，可生成可验证的执行轨迹。这些轨迹使客户端能够事后审计微调与推理过程是否遵循了商定的配置，方法是在TEE内验证采样的执行块，每个块仅覆盖模型和执行轨迹的一小部分。我们的评估表明，AFTUNE仅增加适度开销，并使审计对客户端而言变得切实可行。

import_candidates.title: Certification of Machine Learning Models via Directional Sharpness
import_candidates.abstract: In machine learning, model certification has been identified as an important method for gaining assurance about a model's trustworthiness and quality. A model's quality is largely determined by its ability to generalize, i.e., to perform well on data beyond what it was trained on. It is not possible to certify generalization directly, however, as it depends on unknown data and is not directly measurable. Proxies such as test accuracy can be misleading when the training process is perturbed (intentionally or accidentally), and metrics such as sharpness—which has an empirically supported link to generalization—are computationally expensive and can also serve as unreliable signals when training deviates from a prescribed procedure. In this work, we propose directional sharpness, a metric designed to efficiently and reliably indicate generalization despite potential training deviations. We provide empirical and analytical evidence that directional sharpness (1) correlates more strongly with generalization than existing metrics and (2) identifies models with poor generalization more reliably than existing metrics. Furthermore, directional sharpness is efficiently computable in model auditing settings, where the verifier has access to training data, and via zero-knowledge proofs that certify quality without revealing training data.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 在机器学习中，模型认证已被确定为获取模型可信度和质量保证的重要方法。模型的质量很大程度上取决于其泛化能力，即在训练数据之外的数据上表现良好的能力。然而，直接认证泛化是不可能的，因为它取决于未知数据且无法直接测量。当训练过程受到扰动（有意或无意）时，测试准确率等代理指标可能产生误导，而锐度等指标——虽有经验支持其与泛化能力的联系——计算成本高昂，且当训练偏离规定流程时也可能成为不可靠的信号。在这项工作中，我们提出了方向锐度，一种旨在即使存在潜在训练偏差也能高效可靠地指示泛化能力的度量。我们提供经验与分析证据表明，方向锐度（1）与泛化能力的相关性比现有度量更强，（2）比现有度量更可靠地识别泛化能力差的模型。此外，方向锐度在模型审计场景中可高效计算，此时验证者可访问训练数据，并且可通过零知识证明认证质量而无需泄露训练数据。

import_candidates.title: When Address Learning Goes Wrong: Inducing Forwarding Loops and DoS Amplification in SDN
import_candidates.abstract: Address learning is a fundamental SDN service that maintains a dynamic mapping from host addresses to switch ports, supporting many critical network applications. However, the address learning's core position makes it an attractive attack target. Meanwhile, unfortunately, it lacks security protection from a global view, resulting in the fact that individual, normal events can collectively cause damage. Based on it, this paper proposes LoopGen, a new attack targeting the address learning mechanism. LoopGen shows that adversaries who compromised hosts can induce the controller to create a data-plane forwarding loop by only sending crafted packets in a specific order. This loop makes LoopGen a cost-effective DoS amplifier that can be combined with different DoS attacks. We conduct extensive experiments, evaluating LoopGen using diverse real-world topologies, different open-source controllers, and heterogeneous switches. The results show that LoopGen has non-trivial feasibility, significant amplification effect, low attack cost, and high stealthiness under existing defenses. Finally, we propose two countermeasures to mitigate this attack.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 地址学习是SDN的一项基础服务，它维护从主机地址到交换机端口的动态映射，支持许多关键网络应用。然而，地址学习的核心地位使其成为有吸引力的攻击目标。同时，不幸的是，它缺乏全局视角的安全保护，导致单个正常事件可以共同造成损害。基于此，本文提出了LoopGen，一种针对地址学习机制的新型攻击。LoopGen表明，攻陷主机的攻击者只需按特定顺序发送精心构造的数据包，就能诱导控制器创建数据平面转发环路。这个环路使LoopGen成为一种成本低廉的DoS放大器，可与不同的DoS攻击结合。我们进行了大量实验，使用多种真实拓扑、不同的开源控制器和异构交换机评估LoopGen。结果表明，LoopGen具有非平凡的可行性、显著的放大效应、低攻击成本以及在现有防御下的高隐蔽性。最后，我们提出了两种对策来缓解这种攻击。

import_candidates.title: The Ivory Tower Syndrome: Operators' Reflections on Academic BGP Security Solutions
import_candidates.abstract: The Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) is the backbone of Internet routing, primarily used for exchanging network reachability information between autonomous systems on the Internet. BGP leverages a trust-based framework, where networks rely on each other's routing information implicitly. However, the initial design of BGP lacks in-built security mechanisms, thus making it vulnerable to various attacks and possibly network failures. Over the years, academics have introduced several solutions to enhance BGP security and address these vulnerabilities such as Resource Public Key Infrastructure (RPKI), Secure Border Gateway Protocol, and BGPsec. However, academic solutions may not always be readily applied by network operators. It is, therefore, important to understand the existing challenges in the transition from academic research to widespread implementation. We engaged with 12 network operators via online focus groups, focusing on their work experiences in implementing various BGP security mechanisms. All participants noted a gap between academic research and industry needs, indicating misaligned priorities. To bridge this gap, they suggested more collaboration between the two domains -- particularly through increased researcher involvement in the network operators' community to understand practical challenges. We propose ways to foster such collaboration and urge the research community to reflect on the purpose behind publishing.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 边界网关协议（BGP）是互联网路由的骨干，主要用于在互联网上的自治系统之间交换网络可达性信息。BGP采用基于信任的框架，网络之间隐含地依赖彼此的路由信息。然而，BGP的初始设计缺乏内置安全机制，因此容易受到各种攻击，并可能导致网络故障。多年来，学术界提出了若干增强BGP安全并解决这些漏洞的解决方案，例如资源公钥基础设施（RPKI）、安全边界网关协议（Secure BGP）和BGPsec。然而，学术解决方案可能并不总能被网络运营商直接采用。因此，理解从学术研究到广泛实施这一转变中存在的挑战非常重要。我们通过在线焦点小组与12名网络运营商进行了交流，重点关注他们实施各种BGP安全机制的工作经验。所有参与者都注意到学术研究与行业需求之间存在差距，表明优先事项不一致。为了弥合这一差距，他们建议两个领域之间加强合作——特别是通过研究人员更多地参与网络运营商社区以理解实际挑战。我们提出了促进这种合作的方式，并敦促研究社区反思发表背后的目的。

import_candidates.title: ASRogue: Manipulating ASRank-Inferred AS Relationships
import_candidates.abstract: Accurate knowledge of Autonomous System (AS) business relationships is critical for many Internet security and networking tasks. Since these relationships are not publicly visible, operators and researchers rely on algorithms that infer them from empirical routing data. Yet, despite decades of widespread deployment, the security of AS relationship inference against adversarial manipulation remains largely underexplored. To close this gap, we conduct a systematic security analysis of ASRank, a foundational algorithm that underpins many established methods and widely used datasets. We show that ASRank's output is highly sensitive to small, targeted perturbations of AS triplets extracted from BGP paths. Carefully chosen triplet changes can alter inference order and trigger cascading misclassifications. Building on this insight, we present ASRogue, a manipulation attack against ASRank-based inference. ASRogue adaptively crafts AS triplets to steer inference order and outcomes, scales triplet injection via prefix splitting and AS-path poisoning, and embeds forged triplets into policy-compliant BGP announcements that can evade common routing defenses. Extensive evaluation shows that when the attacker controls at least two ASes, ASRogue achieves an overall 96.7% manipulation success rate, exceeding 99% for small and medium-sized providers, and remains effective under constrained attack overhead and temporal variation. Finally, controlled experiments on the PEERING testbed validate the feasibility of launching ASRogue attacks in the real-world Internet.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 准确了解自治系统（AS）的商业关系对于许多互联网安全和网络任务至关重要。由于这些关系并不公开可见，运营商和研究人员依赖从实测路由数据中推断它们的算法。然而，尽管这些算法已广泛部署数十年，AS关系推断对抗性操纵的安全性在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索。为填补这一空白，我们对ASRank进行了系统的安全分析，ASRank是一个基础算法，支撑了许多现有方法和广泛使用的数据集。我们表明，ASRank的输出对从BGP路径中提取的AS三元组的微小、有针对性扰动高度敏感。精心选择的三元组改变可以改变推断顺序并触发级联误分类。基于这一洞察，我们提出了ASRogue，一种针对基于ASRank推断的操纵攻击。ASRogue自适应地构造AS三元组以引导推断顺序和结果，通过前缀拆分和AS路径毒化来扩展三元组注入，并将伪造三元组嵌入符合策略的BGP公告中，从而能够规避常见的路由防御。大量评估表明，当攻击者控制至少两个AS时，ASRogue实现了整体96.7%的操纵成功率，对于中小型提供商超过99%，并且在受限攻击开销和时间变化下仍然有效。最后，在PEERING测试平台上的受控实验验证了在真实互联网中发动ASRogue攻击的可行性。

import_candidates.title: Understanding Implicit Trust Errors in Core Carrier Networks through Multi-Agent Flaw Discovery and Analysis
import_candidates.abstract:
Core network (CN) is at the center of a cellular system and was historically protected by physical isolation, but the shift to cloud-native deployments breaks this protection and introduces new attack interfaces. Indeed, from reported GitHub issues, we found that many security flaws within CNs can be attributed to blind trust underlying interactions across different CN components. Under such trust assumptions, one component may fail to properly verify the syntactic and semantic content of messages received from other internal components, and may also grant resources to requesters without validation of resource availability. These weaknesses, once coupled with the risks of exposing internal interfaces to unauthorized external parties, as observed in our research, will lead to serious consequences, including session hijacking and denial of services. In our research, we call these newly discovered weaknesses implicit trust errors or iTrue. 
To detect iTrues and understand their security impacts, we designed and implemented a multi-agent framework, dubbed iFinder. iFinder automatically analyzes and summarizes known security flaws, and uses them as ``seeds'' to detect related vulnerabilities from the CN simulators. To suppress hallucinations produced by large language models (LLMs), not only have we developed a Chain of Thought (CoT) reasoning to guide agents, but we also build an innovative strategy that cross-checks both 3GPP specifications and CN code to capture existing protection missed by the agents. Further, we developed a technique that uses LLMs to generate proof-of-concept (PoC) exploits for potential iTrues and iteratively refine the PoCs by automatically executing them against CN simulators and analyzing results. Running iFinder on 7 prominent simulators, we discovered 84 previously unknown vulnerabilities. Among them 70 have already been confirmed with 40 CVE assignments already awarded. Our findings highlight the pervasiveness of iTrue risks across the cellular core networks and the urgent needs for elevated protection within the original trust domains. We plan to make the service of iFinder publicly available to help enhance the security qualities of cellular core networks.
import_candidates.abstract_zh: 核心网（CN）位于蜂窝系统的中心，历史上通过物理隔离受到保护，但向云原生部署的转变打破了这种保护，并引入了新的攻击接口。事实上，从已报告的GitHub问题中，我们发现CN内的许多安全缺陷可归因于不同CN组件之间交互所隐含的盲目信任。在这种信任假设下，一个组件可能无法正确验证从其他内部组件接收到的消息的语法和语义内容，也可能在未验证资源可用性的情况下向请求者授予资源。这些弱点一旦与我们研究中观察到的将内部接口暴露给未授权外部方的风险相结合，将导致严重后果，包括会话劫持和拒绝服务。在我们的研究中，我们将这些新发现的弱点称为隐式信任错误（implicit trust errors）或iTrue。为了检测iTrue并理解其安全影响，我们设计并实现了一个多智能体框架，称为iFinder。iFinder自动分析和总结已知安全缺陷，并将它们用作“种子”来从CN模拟器中检测相关漏洞。为了抑制大语言模型（LLM）产生的幻觉，我们不仅开发了思维链（CoT）推理来引导智能体，还构建了一种创新策略，交叉检查3GPP规范和CN代码，以捕获智能体遗漏的现有保护。此外，我们开发了一种技术，使用LLM为潜在iTrue生成概念验证（PoC）漏洞利用，并通过针对CN模拟器自动执行PoC并分析结果来迭代改进PoC。在7个主流模拟器上运行iFinder，我们发现了84个先前未知的漏洞。其中70个已被确认，40个已分配CVE编号。我们的发现凸显了iTrue风险在蜂窝核心网中的普遍性，以及在原始信任域内提升保护的迫切需求。我们计划公开提供iFinder服务，以帮助提高蜂窝核心网的安全质量。

import_candidates.title: iROV: Breaking the Silence of RPKI with Interactive Validation
import_candidates.abstract: While Route Origin Validation (ROV) effectively mitigates prefix hijacking, it drops BGP updates that are inconsistent with currently published ROAs without consulting the prefix owner. This silent-drop behavior creates a serious agility gap: when a resource owner must urgently redirect traffic during DDoS mitigation, the temporary route may deviate from the currently published ROAs and be dropped before a ROA update propagates. We propose iROV (interactive ROV), a lightweight extension to ROV, to address the agility gap by transforming validation from a static local decision into an interactive, owner-involved process. iROV enables routers to query prefix owners for "Just-in-Time" authorization of invalid routes. This interactivity also allows prefix owners to receive real-time visibility feedback on ROV-invalidation events, which helps them detect remote prefix-hijacking attempts or quickly discover their own benign misconfigurations. To mitigate availability threats introduced by this interactivity, iROV employs validity stapling to suppress redundant queries, and probabilistic querying to bound owner-side query load.
